chapters.text: A hruothu lie Khazing ta alyi hne avuo a sa tiy yi ta,
alyi ca hmingsuo hnyi vyi, a hrikatlawpa tana a cuo. Riyliy ca zingna ta buvkhung te Khazing Thlaapa ca tiy cunglie ca aa khie.
Cakhutaata Khazing ta, “Khena aw se,” ta te khena a aw.
Khazing ta khena ca a pha ta pata a hmung. Cakhutaata khena ca zingna taata a che.
Khazing ta khena ca Ningchung ta te, zingna ca Zuo a ta. Zuoluo ca a khung, mawdiy vya chiy te, capa ca ning khana ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata Khazing ta, tiy liekhingkhuo lieta tiy hne tiy pache riypata aa kung pata avuo aw se a ta.
Cahaacata Khazing ta aa kung pata avuo pa-aw sa te a rawlie a awpa tiy hne a cunglie a awpa tiy ta pata che te capa haa cata ama aw.
Khazing ta aa kungpa ca Avuo a ta. Zuoluo ca a khung, mawdiy vya chiy te, capa ca ning hningna ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata Khazing ta, “Avuo rawlie a awpa tiy ca suv kha ta a hmya se la alyi huvpa a luo se ta te capa haa cata a vya cuo.
Khazing ta alyi huvpa ca Alyi ta te, suv kha lie aa hmyapa tiy ca Riyliy a ta. Khazing ta capa ca a pha ta pata a hmung.
Cakhutaata Khazing ta, “Alyi lie hing uohnaasiyyhnaa, hmung a hnyipa hne a thyi chunglie a hmung a hnyipa thingkungruokung phangting pu se,” ta te capa haa cata a vya cuo.
Alyi lie ca uohnaasiyyhnaa, hmung a hnyipa hne a thyi chunglie hmung a hnyipa thingkungruokung phangting ta a pu. Khazing ta capa ca a pha ta pata a hmung.
Zuoluo ca a khung, mawdiy vya chiy te, capa ca ning thungna ta a cuo.
Khazing ta, “Chung hne zuo a che riypa hne ning hne kung hne cuo a che riypata aa kungpa avuo lie kha khena aw sala,
capa ca ta avuo kha khena pi sala alyi kha khena pi se,” ta te capa haa cata a vya cuo.
Khazing ta khena lepa suohning tue te, a le viepa khena ta ningchung kha uv te a caw viepa khena ta zuo kha a uv. Aasiy zaw kha a sa.
Khazing ta iema ca alyi kha khena pi riypa hne
chung hne zuo kha uv pata khena kha zingna taata pache riypata avuo lie ca a chi yi. Khazing ta capa ca a pha ta pata a hmung.
Zuoluo ca a khung, mawdiy vya chiy te, capa ca ning paliyna ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata Khazing ta, “Tiy chunglie a hringpa tiy saruopa phangting aw sala alyi cung luo avuo lie khiy pavaa phangting zaw a zu yi se,” a ta.
Cahaacata Khazing ta ciy aa chiypa a lesapa tiy saruopa zaw cuose, tiy chunglie a hringpa tiy saruopa phangting hne pavaa phangting zaw kha a sa yi. Khazing ta capa ca a pha ta pata a hmung.
Khazing ta iema ca thluechiy pi yi te, “Pungzaa ung la riyliy tiy chunglie hing bi mya ung, pavaa ca alyi lie hing pungzaa mang sue,” a ta.
Zuoluo ca a khung, mawdiy vya chiy te capa ca ning pangaana ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata Khazing ta, “Alyi lie hing a hringpa saruopa phangting: ing lie a ziypa sahring phangting, ruosaa phangting hne aa valepa saruopa phangting aw se, ta te capa haa cata a vya cuo.
Khazing ta alyi lie a awpa ruosaa phangting, ing lie a ziypa sahring phangting, hne alyi lie aa valepa saruopa phangting kha a sa yi. Khazing ta capa ca a pha ta pata a hmung.

Cakhutaata Khazing ta, “Kiema hmingsuo malie a lu pata cawsaa sa ung siy; iema ca riyliy lie a awpa ngaa, avuo lie a awpa pavaa, ing lie a ziypa sahring, alyi lie a awpa saruopa phangting hne alyi cunglie a valepa saruopa phangting cunglie kha naw ama hnyi aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Khazing ta cawsaa kha ama hmingsuo a lu pata a sa yi, Khazing hmingsuo a lu pata a sa yi; capaa hne canung a sa yi.

Khazing ta iema kha thluechiy pi yi te, “Saata a hluvsa sa ung la pungzaa ung la, alyi lie hing bi ung la alyi hing te tie ung; riyliy lie a awpa ngaa, avuo lie a zulepa pavaa alyi lie a awpa a hringpa saruopa phangting cunglie hing naw hnyi tie ung,” a ta yi.
Khazing ta, “Mang tie ung, alyi lie a pupa hmung a hnyipa thingkungruokung bangkhuo hne a thyi chunglie hmung a hnyipa thingkung bangkhuo hing nama ning riypa tana ica pi yi.

Phyipaliypa ruosaa bangkhuo, avuo lie a zupa pavaa bangkhuo, alyi lie a valepa saruopa bangkhuo, a huv a sungpa a hringpa bangkhuo cuota thinghnaaruohnaa bangkhuo hing ning riypata i pi yi,” a ta. Cakhutaata cahaacata a vya cuo.
Khazing ta a tuepa bangkhuo kha mang te a pha hringhruo a ta. Zuoluo kha a khung, mawdiy vya chiy te ning caruvna ta a cuo.
Cahaacata alyi hne avuo hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo ca sa pata ama cuo.
Ning sariynapa ning ca Khazing ta a hriepa re kha patlung te re hrie li pata aa pahy.
Caacuonakawta Khazing ta ning sariyna ca thluechiy pi te a pathe sa. Tahematapakieca capa ning ca Khazing ca sanapa re bangkhuo kha patlung te aa pahyna ningta a cuo.
Alyi hne avuo hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo sana kaw ca cahaaca tana a cuo.
alyi cunglie aphuv khaapahmuo aw valie, saciy khaapahmuo pu valie, tahematapakieca AbyipaKhazing ta alyi cunglie kha khy pasaa sa li lie pata alyi lieta lu a thlupa ahunghmuo aw valie yi.
Cuorasala alyi chungtaata tiy kya pya te alyi kha a pahna diy.
Cakhutaata AbyipaKhazing ta alyi diypa ta cawsaa kha a sa; hringna huv kha a hnaakhue chung luo sungsue te cawsaa ca a kya hring.
Cakhutaata AbyipaKhazing ta ningchiyluo ta a awpa Eden lie kha diedung suokha tue te a sapa cawsaa ca capa lie ca a chi.

AbyipaKhazing ta alyi taa cata a puvthesapa hne sa cuota a phapa thingkung a phangphang kha a papu sa. Diedung liekhingkhuo lie ca hringna thingkung, a pha hne a chie pachangkhuna thingkung zaw kha a papu sa.
Eden taa cata diedung tiy bya riypata cavaa vaa kha lang te, capa taa cata cavaa vaa paliy ta aa che.
Cavaa vaa khanapa a ming ca Pishon cuo te, capa cavaa ca siy pyanapa Havilah ruo kha cahraw te a lang.
Capa ruo taata a pyapa siy ca siy phasapa phang ta a cuo. Bdellium thingcathliy muosungpa hne oniks lungvaa muosungpa zaw a pya.
Cavaa vaa hningnapa a ming ca Gihon ta a cuo; capa cavaa ca Kush ruo kha cahraw te a lang.
Cavaa vaa thungnapa a ming ca Tigris ta cuo te, capa cavaa ca Assiria ningchiyluo kuo kha cahraw te a lang. Cavaa vaa paliynapa ca Zufrates cavaa ta a cuo.
AbyipaKhazing ta diedung thlu riypa hne mangchiy riypata cawsaapa ca Eden diedung chunglie ca a chi.
AbyipaKhazing ta cawsaapa kha naw pi te, “Diedung lie thingthyi phangting hing na ning khu,
cuorasala a pha a chie thleduo khuna thingkungpa a thyi hing ca ning'a vaciy, na ning kieca na ning ningpa ta na thiy aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata AbyipaKhazing ta, “Cawsaapa ama selaw ta a awpa hing pha vyi; a byatuv riypa tana a viesaa pakha i sapa aa,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta AbyipaKhazing ta alyi taa khata saruopa phangting hne pavaa phangting kha sa te, cawsaapa'a luo ca ming paphya riypata a vaakhyi. Cawsaapa ta ming a dina haa yi khata ama ming ta a cuo pathla.
Cawsaapa ca ta ing lie a ziypa sahring bangkhuo, avuo lie a zupa pavaa bangkhuo hne ruo lie a awpa saruopa bangkhuo kha ming a sa; cuorasala cawsaapa ca ama a byatuv riypa viesaa hnyi vyi.
Caacuonakawta AbyipaKhazing ta cawsaapa kha thuvhunglung khata pahmung sa te, aa hmung chung cata a vuoruv suokha kha a da te capa aa danapa ca a saa ta a paping.
AbyipaKhazing ta aa dapa a vuoruv cata cawsaanung pakha kha sa te cawsaapa'a luo ca aa vawkhyi.
Cakhutaata cawsaapa ca ta, “Ata hing muo i ruv chung taapa ruv, i saa chung taapa saa ta a cuo ta; Capaa chungtaata lapa a cuo nakawta, Canung ta pata kupa cuo se,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta capaa ta a paa hne a nung kha thuse yi te a napuv kha a hlaw te pang kha ta ama cuopa hingta a cuo.
Capaa hne a napuvnung ca ama pahning ta ama thliehripa ta ama cuo, cuorasala ama nang zaa vyi.

AbyipaKhazing ta a sapa saruopa hrangpa tie laata pariy ca a zyate viepa ta a cuo. Pariy ta canung ca thukhyi te, “Khazing ta, ‘Diedung chunglie thingthyi suokhakha hing ning'a va ung ciy aca tapa yi a aw ma?” a ta.
Canung ta, “Diedung chunglie a awpa thingthyi bangkhuo hing ma ning khu;
cuorasala Khazing ta, “Diedung liekhingkhuo lie a awpa thingthyi ca ning'a va ung ciy, a hrie hmuo hrie'a va ung ciy, nama ning kieca nama thiy aa malie a ta,” a ta.
Cuorasala pariy ta, “Thiy'a va ung ciy;
nama ning kieca nama ning khu pahne ta nama ming vuo'a te Khazing haata a pha hne a chie kha nama pachang ra aa, tapa kha Khazing ta a pachang nakaw tana a cuo,” a ta.

Canung ta capa thingkungpa a thyi ta malie palung a lanazya, a puvthenazya, hne singna riypata khing aa chiynazya kha a hmung tiyta a thyi kha lu te a ning; aa thaalie a awpa a navaapa zaw kha a cawta pi te a ning ra.
Ama ning khu pahne ta ama ming kha vuo te ama thliehripa ta ama awpa kha amaa pachang; caacuonakawta thyikuv hnaa kha bie yi te amaa hryi.
Zuoluo ningne ning, capa diedung lie AbyipaKhazing a vya cakuolepa pu kha ama thyi tiyta capaa hne a napuvnung ca AbyipaKhazing hmiekung taa khata diedung chung thingkungpa hraw luo kha ama vaa nu.
Cuorasala AbyipaKhazing ta capaa kha u te, “Khaapaliema nama aw?” a ta.
Ama ta, “Diedung lie na vya cakuolepa pu kha thyi angte na i thliehripa ta i aw nakawta ca ciy angte i nu,” a ta.
Khazing ta, “Ahungma na thliehripa ta na awpa ca caa chang?” Ning'a va ung ciy ica tapa yi thingthyi kha ning kanaa ung ciy? a ta.
Capaa ta, “Kama ina pipa ciy canung hingta thingthyi ca na pi tena i ning,” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata Khazing ta canung kha, “Na tuepa hmang hing khaapatama a cuo? a ta. Canung ta, “Pariy ta na dung tena i ning,” a ta.
AbyipaKhazing ta pariy kha, “Nama ca hingpa hmang hing na tue nakawta, saruopa bangkhuo hrawlie chiesana kha na ang aa; na pavaw ta a thiy'a cate, alyi diypa kha na chuo chung bangkhuo ta na ning aa.
Canung hne namaa lalalieta cuose, canung ciyhruo hne nama ciyhruo alalalieta cuose a cariena kha i chi aa; ama ta na luv kha ca carie'a te, nama ta a lidu kha na daw aa,” a ta.
Canung kyihuo khata, “Nu na phya tiyta pasana i paruv sa vie aa; pasana a hluvsa na ang cangta na saa na sa aa, cuorasala na navaapa ca khing ngiethie'a cate, ama ta aca uv aa,” a ta.

Cakhutaata capaa kyihuo khata, “Nama ca na napuvnung bie kha naa ngie nakawta hne, ‘Ning'a va ung ciy,’ ica tapa yi thingthyi kha na ning nakawta, na cuota alyi hing chie i sa aa; na chuo chung bangkhuo riethyisa pata re hrie'a cate na sa na ning aa;
alyi lie ahling hne asu kya pu'a te, lu lie a pupa uohnaasiyyhnaa kha na ning aa.

Alyi luo na kaana te ta, na hmie taata na mathle aa ruo pathlana te ta re hrie'a cate na sa na ning aa. Tahematapakieca alyi ta sapa tana na cuo. Nama ca alyi diypa ta cuo cate alyi diypa luona na kaa pakhaa aa,” a ta.
Capaa ta a napuvnung kha Evi ta pata ming a sa, tahematapakieca ama ca cawsaa bangkhuo nung tana a cuo.
Cakhutaata AbyipaKhazing ta Adam hne a napuvnung ca savang ta caw kha tuepa yi te a pahryi yi.
Cakhutaata AbyipaKhazing ta, “Mang tie ung, cawsaa hing a chie a pha pachang te kiema malie a lu tli hing, hringna thingkung a thyi hing lu'a te, ning'a te chuozaa ta a hring pathlyi aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta AbyipaKhazing ta Eden diedung taa khata papya te ama a sanapa ta a cuopa alyi kha thlu riypata a pathlie.
Khazing ta cawsaa ca papya te hringna thingkung luopuv kha rieve riypata Eden diedung ningchiyluo kuo lie kha cherubim hne a kuo ting ta aa pahie thepa a khe hunglungpa zueziy kha a chi.
Cakhutaata Adam ca a napuvnung Evi kha pachang te nu a phya. Kain kha sa te, “Abyipaabyana thueta sacapaa i sa tli,” a ta.
Cakhutaata a nuta Abel kha a sa. Abel ca tuv a khiepa cuo te Kain ca lu a thlupa ta a cuo.
Cuo aa vya de tiyta Kain ta Abyipaabie riypata lu taata a vyipa kha a vya cyi.
Abel zaw ta a pachuo taapa a tuvtaata kha vya cyi te, thie te a thu cenapa kha la te Abyipaca a pihluo ra. Abyipaca Abel hne a pihluopa cunglie kha a palung a tluo.
Cuorasala Kain hne a pihluopa cunglie kha a palung tling vyi. Caacuonakawta Kain ca a hi haasa te a minghmie a chie.
Abyipata Kain kha, “Khaapanakawma na hi haa te na minghmie ca a chie? A phasa pata tue la cuhluo li pata ica aw'a ma?
A phata tah na tue li kieca suena ta chiypakaa lie kha a nu te aca bya thluo kha; suena ta nama kha aca uv khing, cuorasala nama ta na uv riypa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Kain ta a nuta Abel kyihuo khata, “Ruo luo si'a puv,” a ta. Ruo luo ama chiy taata a nuta Abel kha a thie.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Kain kha, “Na nuta Abel ca khaapaliema a aw?” a ta. Kain ta, “Pachang va ang; Kama ca i nuta a kingtuv tama i cuo?” a ta.
Abyipata, “Tuokhaapa hmang ma na tue? Naathlie tie; Na nuta thiyse na alyi taata kama'a luo a kya khi!
Nama ca na kuv ta na palangpa na nuta thiyse dang riypata a pakaa a kya uopa alyi taata chiesapa tana na cuo tli.
Lu na thlu tiyta alyi ta na cuota kung pavyi'a vyi; ing li lu li pata a vievuvlepa tana na cuo aa,” a ta.
Kain ta Abyipaca, “Duo ina tepa ca hing ang khu'apa cuo vyi!
Ataning ca alyi taa hingta inaa cade tli ciy, na hmiekung taa hingta i nu aa; hingpa alyi lie hing ing li lu li pata vievuvle'a angte, naa hmungpa mekaa ta ina thie'a yi,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Abyipata, “Cahaacata cuo'a vyi! Ahunghmuo cuose Kain a thiepa ca le sariy tana phuv la pata a cuo aa,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Ama a hmungpa ahungtahmuo a ma thie li riypata Abyipata Kain cunglie kha pachangna riypa suokha a chi.
Cakhutaata Kain ca Abyipahmiekung taa khata a ruo te Eden ningchiyluo ta a awpa Nod ruo lie kha khy a sa.
Kain ta a napuvnung kha pachang te nu phya te Enok a sa. Khypuv khy kha tla te a sacapaa ming la pata Enok a ta.
Enok ta Irad a sa; Irad ca Mehujael paa ta a cuo, Mehujael ca Methushael paa ta a cuo, Methushael ca Lamek paa ta a cuo.
Lamek ca napuv pahning a hnyi; pakha ca Adah ta yi te a hrangpa pakha ca Zillah ama ta.
Adah ta Jabal kha sa te ama ca thluodaa lie aw yi te sahring a ziypa zaw bangkhuo ciypathlatuv ta a cuo.
A uvnupa ming ca Jubal ta cuo te ama ca tingtuo hne ramang a tungtuv bangkhuo ciypathlatuv ta a cuo.
Zillah ta Tubal-kain kha sa te, ama ca daa hne thaa su a sapa bangkhuo ciypathlatuv ta a cuo. Tubal-kain sietanung ca Naamah ta a cuo.
Lamek ta a napuvnung zaw kha: “Adah hne Zillah, na naathlie tie ung; niema Lamek napuv zaw, i ripa hing naathlie tie ung; Hmaa ina paphya nakaw tana satliepa pakha i thie,
Kain a thiepa kha le sariy ta phuv lapa a cuo kieca, Lamek a thiepa ca le sawsariy le sariy ta phuv lapa a cuo hrahring aa,” a ta.
Adam ta a napuvnung kha pachang pakhaa te, sacapaa pakha sa te Seth ta pata ming a di, tahematapakieca ama ta, “Kain ta Abel a thie nakaw tana Khazing ta Abel luvriy ta haatiy pakha ina pi,” a ta.
Seth zaw ta saata pakha sa te, Enosh ta pata ming a sa. Capa cuo ning taa cata Abyipaming hmuo pata abie hruo ama za pathu.
Hingpa hing Adam ciypathla pasuvna ta a cuo. Khazing ta cawsaa a sa tiyta, ama hminghmie a lu pata a sa yi.
Capaa hne canung kha sa yi te, thluechiy pi yi te “Cawsaa” ta pata ming a sa yi.
Adam ca kung zakha sawthung a ta pata ama a lupa sacapaa pakha sa te Seth ta pata ming a sa.
Seth a sa khutaata Adam ca kung zacari hring kalie te sacanung sacapaa hrangpa zaw kha a sa yi.
Adam ca a bangkhuo ta kung zacaky sawthung hring te a thiy.
Seth ca zakha kung pangaa a ta pata Enosh kha a sa.
Enosh a sa khutaata zacari kung sariy hring te sacanung sacapaa hrangpa zaw kha a sa yi.
Cakhutaa cata Seth ca zacaky kung hraa hlyihning hring te a thiy.
Enosh ca kung sawcaky a ta pata Kenan a sa.
Enosh ca Kenan a sa khutaata za cari kung hraa hlyipangaa hring te sacanung sacapaa hrangpa zaw kha a hnyi khutaa yi ta a thiy.
Cahaacata Enosh ca a bangkhuo ta sawcaky kung pangaa hring te a thiy.
Kenan ca kung sawsariy a ta pata Mahalalel kha a sa.
Mahalalel a sa khutaata zacari kung sawliy hring te, sacanung sacapaa hrangpa zaw kha a sa.
Kenan ca a bangkhuo ta zacaky kung hraa hring te a thiy.
Mahalalel ca sawcaruv kung pangaa a ta pata Jared kha a sa.
Jared a puv khutaata zacari kung sawthung hring te sacanung sacapaa hrangpa zaw kha a sa yi.
Mahalalel ca a bangkhuo ta zacari sawcaky kung pangaa hring te a thiy.
Jared ca kung zakha sawcaruv kung hning a ta pata Enok a sa.
Enok a puv khutaata kung zacari hring te sacanung sacapaa hrangpa zaw kha a sa yi.
Jared ca a bangkhuo ta za caky sawcaruv kung hning hring te a thiy.
Enok ca kung sawcaruv kung pangaa a ta pata Methuselah a sa.
Cakhutaa cata Khazing hne a viesaa pata kung zakha sawthung hring te sacanung sacapaa hrangpa zaw kha a sa yi.
Cakhutaa cata Enok ca zathung sawcaruv kung pangaa a hring.
A hring chung bangkhuo Khazing hne a viesaa te Khazing ta a la nakawta ama ca aw va tli.
Mathuselah ca zakha sawcari kung sariy a ta pata Lamek a sa.
Lamek a puv khutaata zasariy sawcari kung hning hring te sacanung sacapaa hrangpa zaw kha a sa yi.
Mathuselah ca a bangkhuo ta kung zacaky sawcaruv kung caky hring te a thiy.
Lamek ca zakha sawcari kung hning a ta pata sacapaa pakha sa te,
“Hingpa paa hing ca Abyipata chie a sapa alyi lie ma kuv ta ruvnaasa pata re ma hriena taa hingta malie a palawsa riypa tana a cuo aa,” tana ta Noah ta pata ming a sa.
Noah a puv khutaata zapangaa sawcaky kung pangaa hring te sacanung sacapaa hrangpa zaw kha a sa yi.
Lamek ca a bangkhuo ta zasariy sawsariy kung sariy hring te a thiy.
Noah ca kung zapangaa a ta pata Shem, Ham, hne Jafeth kha a sa yi.
Alyi lie cawsaa pungzaa yi te, sacanung zaw kha ama sa tiyta,
Khazing sacapaa zaw ta ama puvthepa kha hmung yi te, ama khingpa kha a tlaw yi te napuv ta amaa tue.
Cakhutaata Abyipata, “I thlaapa hing cawsaa zaw hrawlie chuozaa ta aw pathla'a vyi, tahematapakieca iema ca thiysaa tana ama cuo; ama kung ca kung 120 cuo se,” a ta.

Capa cuo ning hne capa khutaa zaw ca ta Nefilim tie hing alyi lie za aw yi te, Khazing sacapaa zaw ta cawsaa sacanung zaw a hlaw yi te ama sapa saata zaw ta ama cuo. Iema ca a hluo ningta cawsaa riephapa hne mingpathuopa tie ta ama cuo.
Abyipata alyi lie cawsaa pha lina a lenazya hne ama pathiypalung lie ama ruepa hne ama pacuopa bangkhuo a pha lipa selaw ta a cuo paripa kha a hmung.
Caacuonakawta Abyipata alyi lie cawsaa a sapa yi kha a ngiepachiy te a palung pha vyi.
Caacuonakawta Abyipata, “I sapa cawsaa, saruopa, a pavaw ta a thiylepa hne thliy lie a zupa pavaa bangkhuo hing alyi taata i pahli diy'a yi; tahematapakieca iema i sapa yi hingna i ngiepachiy,” a ta.
Cuorasala Noah ca Abyipahmiekunglie kha hmiephaa a hmung.
Noah ciypathla ca hingpa zaw hingta ama cuo. Noah ca cawsaa aa dangpa hne a chuo lieta risie a aw lipa hne Khazing hneta a hringpa a cuo.
Sacapaa pathung hnyi te, Shem, Ham, hne Jafeth ta ama cuo.
Alyi ca Khazing hmungna lieta ra te tuechiena ta a bi.
Khazing ta alyi ca a ra ta pata a hmung; tahematapakieca alyi lieta cawsaa bangkhuo ama cyicuo ta ama ra diy.

Caacuonakawta Khazing ta Noah kha, “Cawsaa hing ama bangkhuo ta para diy riypa tana bie i chi tli, tahematapakieca iema nakawta alyi hing tuechiena tana a bi tli, caacuonakawta iema ca alyi hne hing tana i para pakhaw'a yi,” a ta.
Saipres thing ta namata tah tiypalaw suokha sa la a khuo zaw kha tue la achung hne ale taa khata kattazaa thuv diy tie.
Tuokhaatama na sa aa tapa kieca: a tung daw zathung, a haa daw sawngaa, hne a suona daw sawthung ta a cuo aa.
A thlungkhuv tue la a thlungkhuv hne tlepie alalalie kha daw kha na pa-aw aa; a kuoluo ta ingchiypakaa na pa-aw aa; a raw duo, a lie duo, a cung duo ta pata duo thung ta na sa aa.
Avuo rawlie a awpa a huv sung te a hringpa bangkhuo para diy riypata alyi cunglie tiypa-aa patlung sa'a angte, alyi cunglie a awpa bangkhuo ama thiy diy aa.
Cuorasala nama hneta biekuona tue'a angte, na napuv, na sacapaa tie, na sacapaa tie napuv zaw kha tiypalaw chung luo ca naa ngiekhyi'a yi.
A hringpa saruopa bangkhuo taata a canung hne a capaa kha a ba ta la'a cate nama hneta ama hring ra riypata tiypalaw chung luo ca naa ngiekhyi'a yi.
Pavaa, saruopa, alyi lie a pavaw ta a valepa hne a thiylepa saruopa tie kha, ama phang cyicuo ta sahning kaluo, ama hringna riypata naa ngiekhyi'a yi.
Niema hne saruopa ning riypata ning thepa sa bangkhuo kha a ngiekhyi la na pacung aa,” a ta.
Noah ca Khazing ta naw a pipa bangkhuo kha a tue diy.

Cakhutaa cata Abyipata Noah kha, “Nama hne na ingchungkhue bangkhuo khata tiypalaw chung luo ca a ngie tie ung, tahematapakieca ata chuo lie hing nama pakha kyalya dyi hingna i hmiekunglie aa dangpa ta ica hmung,
A pathepa saruopa a canung a capaa ba sariy, a pathe lipa saruopa a canung a capaa ba kha;
pavaa a canung a capaa ba sariy kaluo kha alyi lie ama ciy a ming li riypata a ngiekhyi tie.
Tahematapakieca ata taa hingta ning sariyna lie alyi luo hing ning sawliy hne zuo sawliy chung khy pasaa sa'a angte i sapa a hringpa bangkhuo alyi taa hingta i pahli diy'a yi,” a ta.
Noah ca Abyipata naw a pipa bangkhuo kha a tue.
Alyi cunglie tiypa-aa a tlung ning kha Noah ca kung 600 na a ta.
Noah ca a sacapaa zaw, a napuvnung hne a munung zaw hne cata tiypa-aa taata law riypata tiypalaw luo ca amaa ngie.
Khazing ta Noah kha naw a pipa haata a pathepa saruopa, a pathe lipa saruopa, pavaa hne alyi lie a valepa saruopa,
a canung hne a capaa, a ba a ba ta tiypalaw chung luo ca Noah hne cata amaa ngie hne.
Ning sariy khutaata alyi lie tiypa-aa a tlung.
Noah kung 600 a tling kung, thla hning thlaa, ning hraa hlyisariy ning ta aa thuvna lie a awpa riyliy tiyhnaa bangkhuo ca a pahaw te, avuo thlaluo-aw bangkhuo zaw aa pahaw.
Ning sawliy hne zuo sawliy chung alyi lie khy a saa.
Capa ning cata Noah hne a sacapaa zaw, Shem hne Ham hne Jafeth, Noah napuvnung hne a munung zaw pathung ca tiypalaw chung luo a maa ngie.
Iema hne cata saruopa phangting, sahring phangting, alyi lie a valepa saruopa phangting, pavaa phangting hne a mathlaa a hnyipa saruopa phangting zaw amaa ngie ra.
A huv a sungpa saruopa bangkhuo a ba a ba ta Noah hne cata tiypalaw chung luo ca amaa ngie.
Khazing ta Noah kha naw a pipa haa cata saruopa bangkhuo a canung a capaa a tling pata amaa ngie; Noah aa ngie khutaata Abyipata ingchiy kha a khaakhung.
Ning sawliy chung aa pazue pata tiy a pa-aa; tiy ca kya pa-aa vie le te tiypalaw kha kya pha te alyi ca a vya.
Alyi lie ca tiy ca pa-aa hryly te tiypalaw ca tiy cunglie a paphang.
Alyi cunglie ca tiy ca khuosa ta pa-aa hryly te tluo aa suopa bangkhuo kha a vya;
tiy ca tluodaw taata daw hraa hlyipangaa a kie.
Alyi lie a awpa a huv sungpa pavaa, sahring, saruopa, alyi lie a valepa saruopa bangkhuo hne cawsaa bangkhuo ama thiy diy;
alyi lie a awpa a huv sung te a hringpa bangkhuo ama thiy diy.
Alyi lieta a awpa a huv a sungpa bangkhuo, cawsaa hne saruopa hne a valepa saruopa hne pavaa bangkhuo kha a pahli diy yi. Noah hne tiypalaw chunglie ama hneta a awpa tie dyi kha amaa ngaa.
Cahaacata alyi cunglie ca ning zakha sawngaa chung bangkhuo tiypa-aa ca a tlung.
Cuorasala Khazing ta Noah hne tiypalaw chunglie ama hne a awpa saruopa bangkhuo hne sahring bangkhuo kha aa thyi yi. Caacuonakawta alyi cung luo kha thliy pahruosa te tiy ca a kyle.
Aa thuvna lie a awpa tiyhnaa zaw, avuo thlaluo-aw zaw kha khaa te, avuo taata zaa saapa khy ca a huo.
Alyi lie tiy ca kyle hryly te, ning zakha sawngaa a ta ningpa,
thla sariynapa a ning hraa hlyisariynapa lie tiypalaw ca Ararat ama tapa tluo cunglie aa tuo.
Tiy ca thla hraanapa te khata ky hryly te, thla hraanapa a ning khanapa lie tluodaw ca aa luo.
Ning sawliy khutaata Noah ta tiypalaw thlaluo-aw kha pahaw te,
ra-aa kha a pathlie; alyi lie tiy a kyna te ta kaabung kaathaw te aa zule pari.
Cakhutaa cata alyi taata tiy kha a ky sasaw tli ma tapa pachang riypata thuvruv kha a pathlie;

cuorasala alyi lie tiy kha a ky vie li lie nakawta thuvruv ca aa cangna riypa hmung li pata tiypalaw luo kha a vya kaa. Caacuonakawta Noah ta a kuv kya pazupa te tiypalaw chung luo ca a pangie pakhaa.
Ning sariy a huo khutaata thuvruv ca tiypalaw taa cata a pathlie pakhaa;
thuvruv ca olif thinghnaa hringpa kha a hmyataw lie a vya puvle te zuoluo ta a vya kaa pakhaa; caacuonakawta Noah ta alyi lie tiy a ky tli tapa kha a pachang.
Cakhutaa cata Noah ta ning sariy huo pakhaa te thuvruv kha a pathlie ca ama'a luo vya kaa va tli.
Noah kung 601 a ta kungpa, thla khanapa a ning khanapa lieta alyi taata tiy ca a ky diy. Noah ta tiypalaw thlungkhuv kha pahaw te a mang ca alyi ca a huv tli tapa kha a hmung.
A thla hningnapa, ning kiy ning sariynapa ning lie kha alyi ca a huv diy tli.
Cakhutaata Khazing ta Noah kha,
“Nama hne na napuv hne na sacapaa zaw hne ama napuv zaw hne khata tiypalaw taa hingta pya tie ung.
Nama hne a awpa a hringpa saruopa bangkhuo, pavaa hne saruopa, alyi lie a valepa saruopa bangkhuo ca alyi lie hing ama pung ama zaa riypata pyakhyi tie yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Noah ca a napuvnung, a sacapaa zaw'a nata ama napuv zaw hneta tiypalaw taa cata ama pya.
Saruopa bangkhuo, aa valepa saruopa bangkhuo hne pavaa bangkhuo, alyi lie a tle thepa bangkhuo ca a phuvphuv ta tiypalaw taa cata ama pya.
Cakhutaa cata Noah ca bienatluophie suokha kha sa te, a pathepa saruopa hne pavaa phang taa khata phang kha kaluo kha la te, myirue panaana pihluo te Abyipakha aa bie.

Abyipata capa rangpa-ue ca a thyi tiyta a palung chungraw ta, “Alyi hing cawsaa nakaw hingta khatiy tahmuo chie sa pakhaa'a va tli ang, tahematapakieca cawsaa pathiypalung ca ama cawta baataata a chie tlarya; khatiy tahmuo ata i tuepa haa hingta a hringpa sapa hmang tie hing para pakhaa'a va tli ang.
Alyi aa hmang chung bangkhuo ca, ciycyi cuo aw'a te sahrie cuo a aw aa, a kang cuo hne a lung cuo aw'a te, cuovuo hne thlasiy, chung hne zuo ca khatiy tahmuo ci buo'a vyi,” a ta.
Khazing ta Noah hne a sacapaa zaw kha thluechiy pi yi te, “Saata a hluvsa sa ung la, pungzaa ung la alyi lie hing bi tie ung.
Alyi cung saruopa phangting, pavaa phangting, alyi lie a valepa saruopa phangting, hne riyliy lie ngaa bangkhuo ta aca ciy'a yi; iema ca niema kuv luona pi pata ama cuo.
Hring te aa tle thepa bangkhuo ca uohnaasiyyhnaa ica pipa yi haa hing tana nama ning riypata ica pi yi.
Cuorasala saa kha a chunglie thiy a aw pata ce'a va ung ciy, thiy ca hringna tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca niema hringna thiyse khana ica hie'a yi: cawsaa hne saruopa'a taa zaw ta ica hie'a yi. Pakha cyicuo kha ama uvnu hringna thiyse kha i hie'a yi.
Cawsaa thiyse a palangpa ahunghmuo, cawsaa kuv ta a thiyse palangpa a cuo ra aa; Tahematapakieca Khazing ta cawsaa ca ama hmingsuo a lu pata a sapa tana a cuo.
Niema ca saata a hluvsa sa ung la pungzaa ung la alyi lie hing bi tie ung,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata Khazing ta Noah hne a sacapaa zaw kha ku yi te,
“Niema hne niema hnangluo ta nama ciypathla tie hne cuose,
niema hneta a awpa a hringpa sapa bangkhuo, pavaa zaw, sahring zaw, niema hne a awpa saruopa bangkhuo, tiypalaw taata a kya pyapa bangkhuo hneta biekuona i tue.
Niema hne biekuona i tue, khatiy ning hmuo a hringpa saruopa bangkhuo hing tiypa-aa ta para'a va tli, khatiy ning hmuo tiypa-aa ta alyi hing para'a va tli,” a ta.
Khazing ta, “Kama hne, niema hne niema'a lie a awpa a hringpa saruopa bangkhuo hne hmieluo a vya aw riypa tie bangkhuo alalalieta biekuo pacusana ta i tuepa pahmungsana ca:
I buvtuvruoriy ca amyi cunglie khiy chi'a angte, capa ca kama hne alyi alalalieta i tuepa biekuo pahmungsana ta a cuo aa.
Alyi cunglie hing amyi pazu sa'a angte amyi cunglie buvtuvruoriy aa luo tiyta,
Kama hne niema hne a hringpa sapa hmang bangkhuo alalalieta tuepa, tiypa-aa ta a hringpa bangkhuo hing khatiy tahmuo para pakhaa'a va tli tapa i biekuo kha i thyi aa.
Amyi cunglie buvtuvruoriy aa luo tiyta, khapa kha hmung'a angte, Khazing hne alyi lieta a awpa a hringpa sapa hmang bangkhuo alalalieta tuepa chuozaa aa hmangpa biekuo kha i thyi aa,” a ta.
Khazing ta Noah kha, “Hingpa hingna kama hne alyi lie a awpa a hringpa bangkhuo alalalieta i tuepa biekuo pahmungsana ta a cuo,” a ta.
Tiypalaw taata a pyapa Noah sacapaa zaw ca Shem, Ham hne Jafeth ta ama cuo. Ham ca Kanaan paa ta a cuo.
Hingpa pathung hing Noah sacapaa zaw ta cuo yi te, iema hing alyi cung cawsaa bangkhuo ciypathlatuv ta ama cuo.
Noah ca lu a thlupa ta cuo te mingsuv diedung a tue taapa ta a cuo.
Mingsuvtiy kha dang te a pariy nakawta thluodaa chunglie kha a sasepa ta a laa.
Kanaan paa Ham ca ta a paa a sasepa ta a awpa kha a hmung tiyta ale lie a awpa a uvnu zaw pahning kha a chang yi.
Shem hne Jafeth ta pang zung kha la yi te, ama letung lie kha pake yi te ama hnangluo taata a sawsue yi te a sasepa ta a awpa ama paa kha ama pabuv.
Noah ca mingsuvtiy a pariyna taa cata kya sing te a sacapaa a syipa ta a cunglie a tuepa kha a pachang tiyta,
“Kanaan ca chiesapa cuo se; a uvta zaw sii hrawlie aa ne cepa ta cuo se,” a ta.
A ri kaliepa ca, Abyipai Khazing thluechiy ca Shem cunglie aw sala; Kanaan ca a sii ta cuo mang sue.
Khazing ta Jafeth hing a ruoriy paku sala, a samingsahlaa zaw ca Shem samingsahlaa zaw hne khysa pakhaw yi sala, Kanaan ca Jafeth sii ta cuo mang sue,” a ta.
Noah ca tiypa-aa tlung khutaata kung zathung sawngaa hring te,
a kung zacaky sawngaa a ta pata a thiy.
Noah sacapaa Shem, Ham hne Jafeth zaw ta tiypa-aa tlung khutaata ama sapa ama ciypathla zaw ca hingpa zaw hing tana ama cuo.
Jafeth ciypathla tie: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek, hne Tiras ta ama cuo.
Gomer ciypathla tie: Ashkenaz, Rifath hne Togarmah ta ama cuo.
Javan ciypathla tie: Elishah, Tarshish, Kit ming hne Rodan ming ta ama cuo.
Iema chung taa hing tana riyliy kie lie khy a sapa tie ca ama pungzaa. Iema hing Jafeth ciypathla ta cuo yi te ama ruo cyicuo lie, ama mingphang cyicuo ta ama ryi cyicuo kha cyi yi te khy ama sa.
Ham ciypathla tie: Kush, Izipt, Put, hne Kanaan ta ama cuo.
Kush ciypathla tie: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah hne Sabteka ta ama cuo. Raamah ciypathla zaw ca: Sheba hne Dedan ta ama cuo.
Kush ca Nimrod paa ta a cuo; ama ca alyi cunglie a cahrapa rietetuv taapa ta a cuo.
Ama ca Abyipahmiekunglie a cahrapa, saa a ka thepa ta a cuo. Caacuonakawta, “Abyipahmiekunglie a cahrapa, saa a ka thepa Nimrod haata,” ta pata ripa a cuo.
A pena aa pathu taanapa ca Babel, Erek, hne Akkad ta cuo yi te, ama bangkhuo hingta Shinar ruo chunglie a awpa tana ama cuo.
Capa ruo taa cata Assiria ruo luo kha si te, Nineveh, Rehoboth-ir, Kalah, hne
Nineveh hne Kalah alalalie a awpa khypuv lesapa Resen zaw kha a tla.
Izipt ca Lud ming, Anam ming, hne Lehab ming,
Pathrus ming hne Kasluh ming hne Kaftor ming zaw ama paa khata cuo te iema zaw chung taa hingta Filistin ming kha ama puv.
Kanaan ca a sacapaa uvthyi Sidon, hne Heth,
hne Jebus ming, Amor ming, Girgash ming,
Hiv ming, Arki ming, hne Sin ming,
Arvad ming, Zemar ming, hne Hamath ming zaw ama paa ta a cuo. Cakhutaata Kanaan mingphang ca ruo ting ta amaa ze.
Kanaan ming ama ruoriy ca Sidon taata Gerar luota Gaza te, Sodom luota Gomorrah, Admah, Zeboiim hne Lasha te ta a cuo.
Hingpa tie hing Ham ciypathla zaw ta cuo yi te, ama phang cyicuo, ama ruo cyicuo ta ama ryi cyicuo kha cyi yi te khy ama sa.
Jafeth a uvta Shem zaw ta saata sa te, ama ca Eber samingsahlaa zaw ama thukinapa ta a cuo.
Shem ciypathla tie: Elam, Asshur, Arpakshad, Lud hne Aram ta ama cuo.
Aram ciypathla zaw ca: Uz, Hul, Gether hne Mash ta ama cuo.
Arpakshad ca Shelah paa ta cuo te, Shelah ca Eber paa ta a cuo.
Eber ta sacapaa pahning a sa yi: pakhapa a ming ca Peleg ta a cuo, ama chuo ning hing alyi kha amaa zaa che. A uvnupa a ming ca Joktan ta a cuo.
Joktan ca Almodad, Shelef, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
Ofir, Havilah hne Jobab zaw ama paa ta a cuo; hingpa zaw bangkhuo hing Joktan ciypathla ta ama cuo.
Ama awnapa ruo ca Mesha taata Sefar te, ningchiyluo tluocung ruo khata a cuo.
Hingpa tie hing Shem ciypathla zaw ta cuo yi te, ama phang cyicuo, ama ruo cyicuo ta ama ryi cyicuo kha cyi yi te khy ama sa.
Hingpa tie hing Noah sacapaa zaw taata pathlapa mingphang zaw ama thukinapa ta a cuo. Alyi cung mingphang zaw bangkhuo hing tiypa-aa khutaata iema chung taa hingta a pungzaapa tana ama cuo.
Alyi cung bangkhuo hingta ryi phang kha dyi za hnyi yi te biesuo zaw a zaa lu diy.
Ningchiy taata a vya palaw yi te ase ruo Shinar luo vya chiy yi te capa lie ca khy ama sa.
Cakhutaata pakha hne pakha kha, “A vaw tie ung, lungrue tue ung sala a cuosa pata rue ung siy.” Cahaacata ing sana riypata lungrue kha hnyi yi te maasalaa riypata thung kha ama hnyi.

Cakhutaa cata thukhyi yi te, “A vaw ung la ima cuota khypuv kha sa'a ung puv, avuo a kya depa ing a suosapa kha ima ming riypata sa'a ung puv; cata a cuo li kieca alyi cung ting ta a chepatlaa diy'a kie ung puv,” amaa ta.
Cawsaapa zaw ta ama sapa khypuv hne ing a suosapa ca mang riypata Abyipaca a za cung.

Cakhutaa cata Abyipata, “Mang tie ung, iema hing mingphang phang kha ta cuo yi te, ryi ryi kha ama cyi pakhaw; ata ama tuepa hmang hing ama tue riypa hmang a hruothuna dyi tana a cuo kalie, ama tue khingpa bangkhuo hing ama vya tue diy aa.
A vaw tie ung, cung ung sala pakha hne pakha amaa thyi the li riypata ama ryi za pananang sa'a ung puv,” amaa ta.
Caacuonakawta Abyipata capa hmang taa cata alyi cung ruo ting ta chepatlaa diy yi te khypuv sa ca ama taw.
Caacuonakawta capa khypuv ca Babel ama ta, tahematapakieca capa lie ca Abyipata ama ryi kha pananang yi te, capa hmang taa cata iema kha alyi cung ruo ting ta a chepatlaa diy yi.
Hingpa hing Shem ciypathla zaw ta ama cuo. Shem kung zakha a ta kung, tiypa-aa tlung khutaata kung hning a ta pata sacapaa Arpakshad kha a sa.
Arpakshad a sa khutaata kung zapangaa hring kalie te a hrangpa sacapaa hne sacanung zaw kha a sa yi.
Arpakshad ca sawthung kung pangaa a ta pata sacapaa Shelah a sa.
Shelah a sa khutaata zapaliy kung thung hring kalie te sacapaa hne sacanung hrangpa zaw kha a sa yi.
Shelah ca kung sawthung a ta pata sacapaa Eber kha a sa.
Eber a sa khutaata zapaliy kung thung hring kalie te sacapaa hne sacanung hrangpa zaw kha a sa yi.
Eber ca sawthung kung paliy a ta pata sacapaa Peleg kha a sa.
Peleg a sa khutaata kung zapaliy sawthung hring kalie te sacapaa hne sacanung hrangpa zaw kha a sa yi.
Peleg ca kung sawthung a ta pata sacapaa Reu kha a sa.
Reu a sa khutaata kung zahning kung caky hring kalie te sacapaa hne sacanung hrangpa zaw kha a sa yi.
Reu ca sawthung kung hning a ta pata sacapaa Serug kha a sa.
Serug a sa khutaata zahning kung sariy hring kalie te sacapaa hne sacanung hrangpa zaw kha a sa yi.
Serug ca kung sawthung a ta pata sacapaa Nahor kha a sa.
Nahor a sa khutaata kung zahning hring kalie te sacapaa hne sacanung hrangpa zaw kha a sa.
Nahor ca kung kiy kung caky a ta pata sacapaa Terah kha a sa.
Terah a sa khutaata zakha kung hraa hlyicaky hring kalie te sacapaa hne sacanung hrangpa zaw kha a sa yi.
Terah ca kung sawsariy a ta pata sacapaa Abram, Nahor hne Haran kha a sa yi.
Hingpa tie hing Terah ciypathla zaw ta ama cuo. Terah ca Abram, Nahor hne Haran paa ta cuo te, Haran ca Lot a paa ta a cuo.
Haran ca a paa a thiy hluo ta a puvnapa Khaldi ruo Ur khy lie kha a thiy.
Abram hne Nahor ca napuv kha ama chiy; Abram napuvnung a ming ca Sarai ta cuo te Nahor napuvnung ming ca Milkah ta a cuo. Ama ca Milkah hne Iskah ama paa Haran sacanung ta a cuo.
Sarai ca ciing te saata hnyi khu vyi.

Terah ca a sacapaa Abram hne Haran sacapaa, a samingta Lot hne a sacapaa Abram napuvnung Sarai hne khata Kanaan ruo luo si riypata Khaldi ruo Ur khy taa khata amaa tha. Cuorasala Haran ama phapa khata capa lie ca khy ama sa.
Terah ca zahning kung pangaa a ta pata Haran lie a thiy.
Abyipata Abram kha, “Na ruo hne na tieriy hne na paa ing kha thuse la ica pahmung sa riypa ruo luo kha si tie.
Nama ca mingphang lepa ta ica tue aa. Thluechiy ca pi'a angte na ming pathuo riypata ica tue aa. Caacuonakawta nama ca malie cuota thluechiy tana na cuo aa.
Nama thluechiy caa pipa kha thluechiy pi'a angte, nama chie caa sapa kha chie i sa aa; nama thue hingta mingphang bangkhuo ca thluechiy pi pata ama cuo aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Abram ca Abyipata a changpa haa khata si te, Lot ca ama hne khata a si ra. Abram ca Haran taata aa thu ning kha sawsariy kung pangaa a ta tli.
A napuvnung Sarai hne a uvta sacapaa Lot, hne ama hnyipa chechiy bangkhuo hne Haran lie ama hnyipa sii bangkhuo hne khata Kanaan luo kha amaa tha.
Abram ca ruo chung kha cahraw te Shekhem ama tapa hmang Moreh mathliy diy luo kha a va chiy. Capa cuo ning ca Kanaan ming kha capa ruo lie ca ama aw.
Cakhutaata Abyipaca Abram'a lie kha zaa luo te, “Na samingsahlaa zaw khana hingpa ruo hing i pi'a yi,” a ta. Caacuonakawta capa lie ca ama'a lie zaa luopa Abyipahuo khata bienatluophie kha a sa.

Capa taa cata Bethel ningchiyluo ta a awpa tluocung ruo luo kha si te, Bethel taata ningchiyluo kuo, Ai taata ningtlaluo kuo, aa lalalie kha thluodaa kha aa tuv. Capa lie ca bienatluophie kha sa te Abyipakha aa bie.
Cahaacata Abram ca sile hryly te Negeb luo a chiy.
Capa ruo lie ca khuopuv ta cakuo a tlung nakawta Abram ca a pe riypata Izipt luo kha a si.
Izipt luo amaa ngie'a nang caw ta a napuvnung Sarai kyihuo khata, “Nama ca canung puvthesapa na cuopa kha i pachang.
Caacuonakawta Izipt ming ta aca hmung tiy yi ta, “Hingpa nung hing a napuv tana a cuo ta'a yi te, kama kha na thie'a yi te nama kha aca pahring'a yi.
Nama nakawta kama cuo a phana riypa hne ina pahringna riypa yi ta, a sietanung tana i cuo na tapa tana a pha aa,” a ta.
Abram ca Izipt luo a ngie tiyta Izipt ming ta a napuvnung a puvthesapa kha ama hmung.
Faro abyi tie ta cawsaanung a puvthe hringhruopa kha ama hmung tiyta, Faro ca ama chang. Caacuonakawta cawsaanung ca Faro ing chung luo kha amaa chiyle.
Sarai thue cata Faro ta Abram ca a phasa pata mangsang te, tuv, cue, laa a canung a capaa, siicanung siicapaa hne kala-uv zaw kha a pi.
Cuorasala Abram napuv Sarai nakaw ca ta Abyipata Faro hne a ing lie a awpa bangkhuo cunglie kha ciy aa chiypa pasana a patlung sa.
Caacuonakawta Faro ta Abram kha ku te, “I cunglie na tuepa hmang hing khaapatama a cuo? Na napuv ta a cuopa hing khaapanakawma ina chang vaciy?
Khaapanakawma, “I sietanung tana a cuo ta cate, kama ca napuv riypata ina pala sa ciy? Ata hingta na napuvnung hing a la lah si tie,” a ta.
Faro ta a cawsaa zaw kha naw pi yi te Abram ca a napuvnung hne a hnyipa bangkhuo hne khata ama pasi sa.
Caacuonakawta Abram ca a napuvnung hne a hnyipa bangkhuo hne khata Izipt taata Negeb luo a sithaw.
Abram ca sahring cuose, siy hne ngu cuose a hluvsa a hnyi.
Negeb taa khata suv kha hnang suv kha ta sile te Bethel te, capa taa cata a hruothu ningta thluodaa a za sanapa Bethel hne Ai alala te kha a kya chiy.
Capa lie ca bienatluophie kha sa te Abyipakha aa bie.
Abram hneta a si pakhawlepa Lot zaw ca tuv hne mie, cue hne, cawsaa
a hluvsa a hnyi ra. Ama hnyipa kha a hluv tuv nakawta aw pakhaw riypa kha luruo ta a zu the va tli yi.
Abram sahring a khietuv hne Lot sahring a khietuv tie alalalie kha ahruna a aw lawmaw. Capa cuo ning ca Kanaan ming hne Periz ming kha capa ruo lie ca ama aw.
Caacuonakawta Abram ta Lot kha, “Kiema ca tieriy ta ma cuo; caacuonakawta kama hne nama cuose, na sahring a khiepa hne i sahring a khiepa zaw a hru pata pha vyi.
Na hmiekunglie ruo kupuv a aw cuo va ma? Kama'a taa hingta a che tie. Nama cavyiluo naa tlaw kie kama cacuoluo i si aa; nama cacuoluo naa tlaw kie kama cavyiluo i si aa,” a ta.
Lot ca ruo kha suo te, Jordan bawphie ca Zoar khy te ta tiy rungsa te, Abyipadiedung haata hne Izipt ruo haata a tapa kha a hmung. Capa ca Abyipata Sodom hne Gomorrah a para hluota a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Lot ca Jordan bawphie kha a tlaw te ningchiyluo ta a si. Cahaacata Abram hne Lot ca amaa che.
Abram ca Kanaan ruo lie kha khy a sa. Lot ca bawphie ruo khypuv zaw lie kha awle te Sodom lie kha khy a sa.
Sodom khy ming ca cawsaa pha lipa cuo yi te, Abyipahmiekunglie khuopuv ta a suepa ama cuo.
Lot ama'a taata aa che khutaata Abyipata Abram kyihuo khata, “Na awnapa hmang taa khata chaluo hne sungluo hne ningchiy ningtla kha ta suo tie;
na hmungpa ruo bangkhuo kha nama hne na samingsahlaa na chuozaa ta ica pi'a yi.
Na samingsahlaa ca alyi lie buvcing zaa hing pa ta sa'a yi angte, buvcing ca ahungtahmuo ama ri khu lipa haata na samingsahlaa ca ahungtahmuo ri khu'a va yi.
Thu la ruo a ku a baa hingta a khie tie, a bangkhuo ta nama na ica pi aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Abram ca a thluodaa kha hnyi te Hebron khy mathliy diy a awna lie kha a va aw; capa hmang lie ca Abyipahuota bienatluophie kha a sa.
Capa cuo ning cata Shinar siepahruo Amrafel, Ellasar siepahruo Ariok, Elam siepahruo Khedorlaomer hne Goiim siepahruo Tidal zaw khata,
Sodom siepahruo Bera, Gomorrah siepahruo Birsha, Admah siepahruo Shinab, Zeboiim siepahruo Shemeber hne Bela (Zoar ama tapa) siepahruo tie kha rie amaa du.
Iema bangkhuo hing Siddim (Riyliy Thiypa ama tapa) bawphie lie kha amaa hmya.
Kung hraa hlyihning chung bangkhuo Khedorlaomer kuv rawlie za aw yi te kung hraa hlyithungnapa lie ama kha amaa du.

Kung hraa hlyipaliynapa lieta Khedorlaomer hne ama kuo luo ta a daapa siepahruo tie kha a vaw hnue yi te, Refaim ming kha Ashteroth-karnaim lie, Zuzim ming kha Ham lie, Emim ming kha Shaveh-kiriathaim lie,
Hor ming kha Seir tluocung ruo lie kha a du yi te ama te khutaata ruocaapa kielie a awpa El-paran khy te khata amaa cade.
Cakhutaa cata hnangluo vya kaa yi te En-mishpat (Kadesh ama tapa), hne Amalek ming ruo bangkhuo hne Hazazon-tamar lie a awpa Amor ming ruo bangkhuo kha a du yi te ama te.
Cakhutaa cata Sodom siepahruo, Gomorrah siepahruo, Admah siepahruo, Zeboiim siepahruo hne Bela (Zoar ama tapa) siepahruo tie khata
Elam siepahruo Khedorlaomer, Goiim siepahruo Tidal, Shinar siepahruo Amrafel hne Ellasar siepahruo Ariok tie kha Siddim bawphie lie kha rie amaa vya du.
Siddim bawphie ca kattazaa khue aa thuvsapa ta a bi. Sodom siepahruo hne Gomorrah siepahruo tie kha amaa ruo ca, chekha ca capa khue luo ca tla yi te, chekha ca tluocung ruo chung luo kha amaa ruo.
Caacuonakawta carie tie ta Sodom hne Gomorrah lie a awpa chechiy bangkhuo hne sa bangkhuo kha la yi te ama sikhyi.
Sodom lie a awpa, Abram a uvta sacapaa Lot zaw kha a chechiy bangkhuo hneta ama sikhyi ra.
Carie kuv taata a lawpa pakha kha a vaw te Eshkol hne Aner uvnupa, Amor ming Mamre mathliy diy kielie a awpa Hebru ming Abram kha capa kaw ca a vya chang. Iema ca Abram a daakhyipa tie ta ama cuo.
Abram ta a uvta sacapaa ama sikhyipa kha a thyi tiyta, a ing lie a puvpa, a phata tah a pacuvpa cawsaa 318 kha ku yi te carie tie ca Dan te amaa cade.
Abram ta a cawsaa kha phuv hning ta che yi te zuo ta ama carie tie kha a du yi te ama te. Damaskas khy chaluo ta a awpa Hobah khy te khata amaa cade.
Ama chechiy bangkhuo, a uvta sacapaa Lot chechiy bangkhuo, hne canung zaw hne cawsaa zaw kha a vya sikhyi pakhaa yi.

Abram ca Khedorlaomer hne ama kuo luota a daapa siepahruo tie kha a te khutaa yi ta a vya kaaluo lie kha Sodom siepahruo ta Shaveh bawphie (Siepahruo bawphie ama tapa) lie kha a taw riypata aa kya hladaw.
Cungnungce Khazing tluobyi, Salem Siepahruo Melkhizedek ta viechuo hne mingsuvtiy kha vya cyi te,
Abram kha hing haa hingta thluechiy a pi: “Alyi hne avuo a satuv Cungnungce Khazing ta, Abram ca thluechiy pi se;
Na carie tie kha na kuv luo caa pituv Cungnungce Khazing ca thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue!” a ta. Abram ta hmangting bangkhuo chung taa khata chehraachekha a pi.
Cakhutaa cata Sodom siepahruo ta Abram kha, “Cawsaa zaw kha na pi la chechiy hing ca a la tie,” a ta.
Cuorasala Abram ta Sodom siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Alyi hne avuo a satuv Abyipa, Cungnungce Khazing'a luo kha chie i sa tli.
Nama ta, ‘Abram ca kama thueta na a hnyi a rung,’ ina ta li riypa cata na huopa a cuopa bangkhuo, lariy riy kha hne phanaah riy taata pathu pata suokha hmuo a la'a va ang,” a ta.
Kama ca khaapahmuo a la'a va ang, cuorasala satlie tie ning ciepa hne kama hne a vya si rapa tie ama cuvu dyina i la aa. Aner, Eshkol hne Mamre ta ama cuvu kha a la ra yi se, a ta.
Cakhutaa cata Abram muocuo lie kha Abyipaa luo te, “Abram, ciy khah, Kama ca na cuota phya tana i cuo; na lawmuo ca a le hringhruo aa,” a ta.
Cuorasala Abram ta, “Vya Abyipa Khazing, khaapama ina pi'a ciy, kama ca saata a hnyi lipa ta cuo angte, i ru naa cu riypa ca Damaskas khypa Eliezer hing tana a cuo,” a ta.
“Samingsahlaa ina pi li nakaw ca ta i ing lie a puvpa i sii pakha na i ru naa cu aa,” a ta.
Cuorasala Abyipabie ca Abram luo kha a zuv te, “Hingpa paa hing na rucutuv ta cuo'a vyi; na sapa na saata hrahring na na ru caa cu aa,” a ta.
Ale luo kha pyakhyi te, “Avuo khiy mang la aasiy khiy ri tie, na ri khu kie ri tie,” a ta. Cakhutaa cata, “Na ciypathla zaw ca khiypa aasiy zaa khiy ama ta aa,” a ta.
Abram ta Abyipaca zang te, Abyipata capa a zangna ca adangna ta a cuhluopa.
Cakhutaa cata Abyipata, “Kama ca hingpa ruo hing nama pi riypata Khaldi ruo Ur taata caa vya sikhyituv Abyipatana i cuo,” a ta.
Cuorasala Abram ta, “Vya Abyipa Khazing, hingpa ruo hing kama huopa tana a cuo aa, tapa ca tuokhaatama i pachang aa?” a ta.
Abyipata, “Kung thung a tapa cuelaanung sakha, kung thung a tapa mielaanung sakha, kung thung a tapa tuvtungpa sakha, thuvruv sakha hne valale sakha kha kama'a luo vya cyi tie,” a ta.
Capa bangkhuo ca Khazing'a luo ca a vya cyi. Buv hning ta tepachung te kuo vyicuo ta a pahlaa. Pavaa ca tepachung vyi.
Luotaa zaw ta za tlachiy yi te Abram ta aa cade yi.
Ning a vya tla nguoluolepa khata Abram ca khuopuv ta a hmung te a cunglie kha ciy aa chiypa zingna a tlung.
Cakhutaa cata Abyipata Abram kyihuo khata, “Na samingsahlaa zaw ca ama ruo a cuo lipa lie khyche ta ama cuo aa. Capa lie ca sii ta cuo'a yi te kung zapaliy chung hrisaa pata ama cuo aa.
Cuorasala ama re ama hriepapa mingphang tie kha duo te'a yi angte, cakhutaa cata iema ca suethiy a hluvsa hneta ama pya aa.
Nama ca na macuosana te ta hring'a cate thlaalungna hneta mingchingmingvuo tie'a luo na si aa.
Amor ming pha lina ca a dena te a pha li lie nakawta na samingsahlaa tie ca chuopaliynapa lieta hingpa luo hing ama vya kaa pakhaa aa,” a ta.
Ning tla te a vya zing ca a khuv a khuvpa myi bi suokha hne aa hlaa nguoluopa myisaa taw kha capa saa tepachungpa tie alalalie kha amaa khiele.
Capa ning lie ca Abyipata Abram hneta biekuona tue te, “Na ciypathla zaw ca hingpa ruo hing i pi'a yi. Izipt cavaa taata cavaa lesapa Zufrates cavaa te,
Ken ming ruo, Keniz ming ruo, Kadmon ming ruo,
Hit ming ruo, Periz ming ruo, Refaim ming ruo,
Amor ming ruo, Kanaan ming ruo, Girgash ming ruo hne Jebus ming ruo zaw bangkhuo hing,” a ta.
Abram napuvnung Sarai ca saata sa vyi. Ama ta Izipt zaanung sii pakha hnyi te a ming ca Hagar ama ta.
Sarai ta Abram kyihuo khata, “Abyipata saata ina pasa sa lipa hing na pachang; i siicanung hing a ziekhyi la ama ta saata na sapa ngiethie'a va ma? a ta. Abram ta Sarai bie ca aa ngie.
Cahaacata Abram ca Kanaan ruo lie kha kung hraa a aw khutaata a napuvnung Sarai ta a siicanung, Izipt zaanung Hagar kha napuv ta a pi pata a cuo.
Abram ta Hagar kha a ziekhyi te nu a phya. Nu na i phya tapa aa pachang tiyta a ziynungnung kha siysaa ri li pata a aw.

Ca tiyta Sarai ta Abram kha, “I cunglie a tlungpa pha lina hing na cunglie tlung mang sue! I siicanung ca napuv riypata ica pi, nu na i phya tapa aa pachang pahne ta siysaa na ri li pata a aw. Abyipata nama hne kama alalalieta bie chi mang sue!” a ta.
Cuorasala Abram ta, “Na siicanung ca na kuv rawlie na a aw, na khing ta na tue khu,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Sarai ta khuosa ta a hrisaa ca Hagar ca aa ruo.
Abyipaavuoming ta Hagar ca Shur luo sinapa ruocaapa acaa kielie kha a hmung.
Avuoming ta, “Sarai siicanung Hagar, khaapa taata vya si cate ma khaapa luo na si'a nang?” a ta. Hagar ta, “I ziynungnung Sarai'a taa tana i ruo,” a ta.
Abyipaavuoming ca ta, “Na ziynungnung'a luo kha kaa la a ri kha a ngie tie,” a ta.
Abyipaavuoming ta a ta kaliepa ca, “Na samingsahlaa hing a mingluv ta ri tie lina te ta i papungzaa sa'a yi,” a ta.
Abyipaavuoming ta, “Ata hing nu phya cate sacapaa na sa aa; a ming ca Ishmael na ta aa, tahematapakieca na ruvnaanapa khana Abyipata aca pachangpa.
Ama ca laa ruotle na a lu aa, a kuv ta cawsaa ting kha a du'a yi te, cawsaa ting ta ama kha amaa du aa; A tieriy hneta hmuo a tla a re the'a vyi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Hagar ta ama hne bie a ripa Abyipaca, “Nama ca El-roi tana na cuo,” a ta. Tahematapakieca, “Khazing kha i hmung hmisi tli nakawta i hmung khutaa hingta i hring kalie'a ma?” a ta.
Caacuonakawta capa takhue ca Beer-lahai-roi ama ta. Capa takhue ca Kadesh hne Bered alalalie tana a aw.
Hagar ta Abram ca sacapaa a sapa. Hagar ta a sapapa a sacapaa ca Abram ta Ishmael ta pata ming a sa.
Hagar ta Ishmael a sapa ning kha Abram ca kung 86 na a ta.
Abram kung sawcaky kung caky a ta ningta Abyipakha ama'a luo zaa luo te, “Kama ca Lesyice Khazing tana i cuo, i hmiekunglie hing risie riy aw li pata hring tie.
Kama hne nama alalalieta i biekuona kha tue'a angte, khuopuv ta ica papungzaa sa aa,” a ta.
Abram ca a bu te, Khazing ta,
“Kama ta nama hne biekuona i tuepa ca: Nama ca mingphang hluvpuv ciypathlatuv ta na cuo aa.
Na ming ca Abram ta cuo'a va tli, cuorasala Abraham tana a cuo'a tli; tahematapakieca nama ca mingphang hluvpuv ciypathlatuv tana ica tue tli.
Khuopuv ta ica papungzaa sa aa; mingphang hluvpuv ta ca tue'a angte, nama chung taa hingta siepahruo zaw ama cuo aa.

I biekuona ca nama hne nama hnang taata a vaw riypa na samingsahlaa zaw chuo bangkhuo alalalieta chuozaa biekuona cuo riypata pahmang sa'a angte, nama hne nama hnang taata a vaw riypa na samingsahlaa zaw chuo bangkhuo cuo te ta nama Khazing ta i cuo aa.

Cakhutaata nama hne nama hnang taata a vaw riypa na samingsahlaa zaw kha ata lieta khyche ta nama cuonapa, Kanaan ruo bangkhuo hing chuozaa ta ca pi'a yi angte, kama ca nama Khazing ta i cuo aa,” a ta.
Khazing ta Abraham kha, “Nama zaw ta i biekuona hing na ziy hrahring aa, nama hne nama hnang taata a vaw riypa na samingsahlaa chuo lie zaw ama ziy hrahring aa.
Kama hne nama, hne nama hnang taata a vaw riypa na samingsahlaa zaw ta nama ziy hrahring riypa i biekuona ca: Niema chungtaata capaa a cuopa bangkhuo ca nama vangdaw namaa te aa.
Nama vangdaw kha a te'a ung cate, capa ca kama hne niema alalalieta biekuona pachangsana ta a cuo aa.

Nama chuo chung bangkhuo niema chungtaata capaa a cuopa bangkhuo ca ning cari a ta pata vangdaw nama te aa, nama'a chungkhue lie a puvpa sii hne tuokaa ta nama calyipa ruohrang ming, nama samingsahlaa a cuo lipa tie zaw te nama te diy aa.
Nama'a chungkhue lie a puvpa sii hne tuokaa ta nama calyipa ruohrang ming kha vangdaw amaa te aa. Cahaacata kama biekuona ca nama saa lieta chuozaa biekuona a cuo aa.
Vangdaw a te lipa capaa bangkhuo ca a mingphang taata thaw pata a cuo aa; ama ca kama biekuona a parapa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Khazing ta Abraham ca, “Na napuvnung Sarai zaw kha Sarai ta pata ku'a va tli ciy, a ming ca Sarah tana a cuo'a tli.

Ama ca thluechiy i pi aa, ca hlyitaw taata ama'a taa hingta sacapaa pakha ica pi aa. Ama ca thluechiy pi'a angte mingphang zaw nung ta a cuo aa; ama'a taa hingta mingphang tie siepahruo zaw ama pya aa,” a ta.
Abraham ca alyi lie kha a bu te, “Kung zakha a ta tlipa paa ta sacapaa a hnyi khu'a ma? Kung sawcaky a ta tlipa Sarah ta saa a sa khu'a ma? ta te a pahnyi.
Cakhutaata Abraham ta Khazing kha, “Ishmael ca na hmiekunglieta hring thi se,” a ta.

Khazing ta, “Cuo vyi, na napuvnung Sarah ta sacapaa pakha sa'a te, a ming ca Isak ta pata na sa aa. I biekuona kha ama hne pacu sa'a angte ama hnang taata a vawpa a samingsahlaa cuota chuozaa biekuona ta i pacuo sa aa.
Ishmael kawlieta na bie kha naa ica thlie; Ama kha thluechiy pi'a angte khuopuv ta i papungzaa sa aa. Ama ca siepahruo pahraa hlyihning tie paa ta cuo'a te, mingphang lepuv ta i pacuo sa aa.
Cuorasala i biekuona ca huokung ata tiy hingta Sarah ta aca sapa riypa Isak hneta i pacu sa aa,” a ta.
Ama hne bie ama ri khutaata Khazing ca Abraham'a taa cata cung luo a kie.

Cakhutaata Abraham ta a sacapaa Ishmael hne a ing lie a awpa capaasaata bangkhuo, a ing lie a puvpa sii bangkhuo hne tuokaa ta a calyipa tie bangkhuo kha capa ning cata Khazing a ripa haata ama vangdaw a te yi.
Abraham ca vangdaw aa te ningta kung 99 ta te,
a sacapaa Ishmael ca kung hraa hlyithung a ta.
Capa ning caci cata Abraham hne a sacapaa Ishmael ca vangdaw amaa te.
A ing lieta capaa bangkhuo, a chungkhue lie a puvpa sii zaw hne tuokaa ta a calyipa ruohrang ming zaw kha ama hne cata vangdaw te pakhawpa ama cuo.
Abyipaca Mamre mathliy diy kielie a awpa Abraham'a lie kha aa luo.

Abraham ca ningchung ning ling liyciy ta a thluodaa chiypakaa lie kha a tu te hmiehmie a kya pase ca aa thaalieta cawsaa pathung amaa daapa kha a hmung. A kya hmung pahne yi ta a thluodaa chiypakaa taa khata iema a taw riypa yi cata a ruo te ama hmiekunglie kha alyi lie a bu te,
“I byipaa zaw, nama hmiekunglie hmiephaa i hmung kieca nama changtaapa hing na lawse thi khah ung.
Tiy a cawta vya cyi'a angte, nama phyi hing a siy ung la thingkungpa rawlie hing a pahy caw tie ung.

Nama changtaapa'a luo namaa vawpaa pawlaw tlipa ca, viechuo a cawta vya cyi'a angte ning ung la nama nangbuo namaa pape khutaata si lavuo ung ciy,” a ta yi. Caacuonakawta iema ta, “Na ripa haata tue tie,” ama ta.
Abraham ca thluodaa chunglie a awpa Sarah'a luo kha a catlisa pata a ngie te, “Jungsacuo viedie a pha cepa libang zung thung la la viechuo rue pahraa tie,” a ta.
Cue hraw luo kha a ruo te a saa pahuo liyciy riypa cue a thukalypa sakha kha patuv te a catli pata pasu riypata a changtaapa pakha kha a pi.
Cakhutaa cata thawpat hne cuehnung hneta a changpa saa ca iema hmiekunglie kha pachie te, ama ning chung bangkhuo khata amaa thaalie thingkung ningdiy lie kha aa tupuo yi.
Iema ta, “Na napuvnung Sarah khaapaliema a aw?” ama ta. Abraham ta, “Thluodaa chunglie hue na a aw,” a ta.

Cakhutaata pakha ta, “A cuo aa de ningta niema'a luo hing a vaw pakhaa hrahring'a angte, na napuvnung Sarah ta sacapaa a sa aa,” a ta. Sarah ta ama khychepa paa hnangkaa thluodaa chiypakaa taa khata naa a thlie.
Abraham hne Sarah ca ama kung hluvsa tli te ama macuo nungpuv tli nakawta Sarah ca canung phung hmuo pachang va tli.
Caacuonakawta Sarah ca amata tah pahnyi te, “I nungpuvsa mangtli, i navaapa zaw a macuosa mangtli, i nuopaa khu hmisi'a ma?” a ta.
Abyipata Abraham kyihuo khata, “Khaapanakawma Sarah ca pahnyi te, “I nungpuvsa tlipa hingta saata i sa'a ma? a ta,” a ta.
Abyipata a tue khu lipa hmang suokha chuo a aw ma? Thliciepa cuo, a cuo aa de ningta niema'a luo hing a vaw pakhaa'a angte Sarah ta sacapaa a sa aa,” a ta.
Cuorasala Sarah ca a thlaa a zang nakawta a sie te, “Pahnyi va ang,” a ta. Ama ta, “Na pahnyi thluo kha,” a ta.
Cawsaa zaw ca capa hmang taa cata a thu yi te Sodom luo kha ama si. Abraham ca iema pathlie riypata iema'a lie ca a si ra.
Abyipata, “I tue riypa hmang hing Abraham chang li pata i aw'a ma?
Abraham ca a lepa hne a cahrapa mingphang ta cuo'a te, alyicung mingphang bangkhuo ca ama thue hingta thluechiy pi pata ama cuo aa.

Tahematapakieca ama kha a tlaw tli angte, aa dangpa hne biedangpa tuena ta Abyipaluopuv ziy riypa kha ama hnang taata a vawpa a saata zaw hne a chungkhue kha a pasu'a yi; cahaacata Abyipata ama'a lie bie a kuopa kha a cunglie a patling sa aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipata, “Sodom hne Gomorrah suebena ueryi ca a suo hringhruo te ama suena ca a le suesaa!
Kama'a luo a kya chiypa suebena ueryi haa hingta ama tue sasaw ma, tue va yi ma tapa kha pachang riypa tana cung'a angte i za mang aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta cawsaa zaw ca capa taa cata a pali yi te Sodom luo kha ama si. Abraham ca Abyipahmiekunglie kha aa daa thluo.
Abraham ta Abyipakha a vya ngie te, “Aa dangpa tie kha cawsaa pha lipa tie hneta na para pakhaw hmisi'a yi ma?
Sodom khypuv chunglie aa dangpa sawngaa aw biephung yi sala, capa aa dangpa sawngaa tie thue cata a ngiethena hnyi li pata na para ngiethie'a ma?
Cahaapa hmang tue riypa ca nama hneta a hla thi se, aa dangpa tie hne cawsaa pha lipa tie kha aa lu pata thie hnepa ca! Alyicung bangkhuo Bieripatuv ta hmangdangpa kha tue'a va ca ma?” a ta.
Abyipata, “Sodom khypuv chunglie aa dangpa sawngaa i hmung kie yi ca iema thue cata khypuv yalya khata i ngiethe aa,” a ta.
Abraham ta palie te, “Kama ca buvcing hne buvcuo i cuo raalaa pata i rie a papha angte Abyipa'a luo kha bie i ri aa.
Aa dangpa sawngaa laata papangaa caw vie yi sala haw? Papangaa ama caw vie nakawta khypuv yalya ta na para'a ma?” a ta. Abyipata, “Sawliy papangaa i hmung kieca para'a va ang,” a ta.
Abraham ta ri pakhaa te, “Sawliy dyi aw yi sala haw?” a ta. Abyipata, “Sawliy tie thueta para'a va ang,” a ta.
Cakhutaata ama ta, “VyaAbyipa, ri pakhaa'a angte na hi haa thi khah se. Sawthung aw yi sala haw?” a ta. Abyipata, “Sawthung i hmung kie yi ca para'a va ang,” a ta.
Abraham ta, “I hmie a pasu'a angte Abyipa'a luo ca ri'a ang. Pakiy aw yi sala haw?” a ta. Abyipata, “Pakiy tie thueta para'a va ang,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abraham ta, “Vya Abyipa, yi khata dyi ri kalie'a angte na hi haa thi khah se. Pahraa aw yi sala haw?” a ta. Abyipata, “Pahraa tie thueta para'a va ang,” a ta.
Abraham hne bie ama ri khutaa cata Abyipaca cakuo te Abraham zaw ing luo aa diy.
Zuoluocaw ta avuoming pahning Sodom khy luo amaa vaw ning kha Lot ca hukaa lie a zaa tu. Iema kha a hmung pahne yi ta vaa ruodaw yi te ama hmiekunglie kha aa bu.

Ama ta, “I byipaa zaw, i ing luo hing a vya ngie ung la, nama phyi a siy ung la, zuo kha chuo a vya ripaa tie ung, mawluo mawdiy ta thu'a ung cate nama si khingna luo ca si lavuo ung ciy,” a ta yi. Iema ta, Cuo vyi, khypuv ahmyana hmang lie hingna maa ri aa,” ama ta.
Cuorasala khuopuv ta a thlu nakaw yi ta a ing luo ca amaa ngie. Thiynung phuv lipa viechuo kha tuepa yi te, sa pahuosapa duo yi te ama ning.
Cuorasala amaa zie hluo khata Sodom khypuv lie a awpa capaa mingnu hne uvthyi yalya ta ing kha ama vya cadung.
Lot kha u yi te, “Ata zuo na ing lie a ripa capaa zaw kha khaapaliema ama aw? Kya papya tie yi, ma suehne khing yi,” ama ta.
Lot ta cawsaa tie'a luo kha pya te ingchiy a khaa khutaata,
“Vya uvnu zaw, paa na ica kie yi, hmang pha li hringhruopa hing tue khah ung.

Mang tie ung, capaa a pachang buo li liepa sacanung pahning i hnyi yi hing; iema hing kya pyakhyi'a yi angte, nama khingna haata tue tie ung; hingpa cawsaa tie cunglie hing ca khaapahmuo tue thi khah ung, ing naa tlungpa i mangchiy riypa i khyche tana ama cuo,” a ta yi.

Iema ta, palie yi te, “A phe! Nama mingpepa hing ma bie malie a chipa'a ciy? Iema laata nama hing a pasa vie ta ca tue'a kie puv,” ama ta. Lot ca khuosa ta nuopuo yi te chiypakaa kha phawpahaw amaa nang.
Cuorasala ing chunglie a awpa cawsaa tie ca ta Lot kha kya paza yi te ing chung luo amaa da khutaata ingchiypakaa kha ama khaa.
Cakhutaata ingchiypakaa athaalie a awpa cawsaa a le a caw ta li pata ama ming pacue diy yi te ingchiypakaa kha hmung the va tli yi.

Cakhutaata cawsaa tie ca ta Lot kyihuo khata, “Hingpa lie hing cawsaa hrangpa na hnyi yi ma? Sacapaa, sacanung, na piepa, khy chunglie nama hne a awpa na cawsaa bangkhuo pakiy yi la hingpa taa hingta pyakhyi tie yi.
Tahematapakieca, hingpa khy hingna ma para'a tli, hingpa cawsaa tie suebena ueryi hing Abyipahmiekunglie a paring laalaw tli nakawta kiema hing para riypata malie a pathliepa tana ma cuo,” ama ta.

Caacuonakawta Lot ca pya te, a piepa zaw kyihuo khata, “Thu ung la hingpa hmang taa hingta pya tie ung, tahematapakieca Abyipana hingpa khypuv hing a para'a nang tli,” a ta yi. Cuorasala a piepa zaw ta se na a sung ta pata ama rue.

Khy a kya dyi tiyta, avuoming ta Lot kha, “Thu pahraa la hingpa lie a awpa na napuvnung hne na sacanung pahning hing pyakhyi tie yi, caacuolikieca hingpa khypuv duotena lie hingna aca kuopuo'a yi,” ama ta.

Cuorasala Lot ta a sawdung a vadung ta a aw ca, Abyipata ngie a chi nakawta cawsaa tie ca ta ama hne a napuvnung hne a sacanung zaw kha ama buo ta a dale yi te khy le luo ama pyakhyi khutaata capa lie ca ama thuse siy.

Khy le luo ama pyakhyi khutaata iema ta, “Nama hring riypata a ruo tie ung, hnangluo a pali khah ung, ase lie kha a daa khah ung; tluocung luo khiy a ruo tie ung, caacuolikieca aca kuopuo'a yi,” a ma ta.
Ca tiyta Lot ta iema kyihuo khata, “Cuo vyi, vya i byipaa zaw;
na changtaapa hing hmiephaa ina pi tli ciy, i hringna kha na khuo cate kaw ina pacuo tli ciy; tluocung luo ca a ruo khu'a va ang, rana a taw'a angte i thiy aa tapa na i ciy.
Mang tie, huepa khy hue a ngie te a ruo hmuona riypata a cuo, khyta zaw ta a cuo. Huepa luo hue a ruo thi'a ang, khytaata cuo va ma? I hringna zaw aa bang aa,” a ta.
Ama ta, “A phasa, capa na hiepa zaw ca pipa cuo cate, na ripa khy hue para pata cuo'a vyi.
A ruo pahraa tie, huepa luo hue na chiy hluo li khaapahmuo tue the'a va ang,” a ta. Caacuonakawta capa khypuv ca Zoar ama ta.
Ning a kya chiypa khiyta Lot ca Zoar luo a vya chiy.
Cakhutaa cata Abyipata Sodom hne Gomorrah cung luo ca kemyi kha khy haata a za pasaa sa.
Capa khypuv tie ca cuose, ase ruo bangkhuo kha cuose, khypuv chunglie a awpa hne alyi lie a pupa bangkhuo kha a para diy.
Cuorasala Lot napuvnung ca hnangluo a pali te a mang nakawta paciy tung ta aa li.
Abraham ca Abyipahmiekunglie aa tu tawnapa luo kha mawdiy ta a cakuo.
Sodom hne Gomorrah hne ase ruo luo kha a suo ca susana myikhuv haata myikhuv a kya thupa kha a hmung.
Cuorasala Khazing ta ase ruo khypuv tie a para ning kha Abraham ca a thyi te, Lot a awnapa khypuv a para ning kha, a parapa khypuv chung taa cata Lot kha aa bangta tah a palaw sa.
Lot ca Zoar lie aw riypa kha a ciy nakawta pya te, a sacanung pahning hne khata tluocung luo kie yi te lungkaraw lie kha ama aw.
A uvthyinung ta a syinung kyihuo khata, “Ma paa hing a macuo tli, chuelyi phung haata kiema hne a hlaw riypa capaa pakha hmuo aw va yi.
A vaw tie, ma paa hing mingsuvtiy padang'a pate a ziekhyi'a puv, a ciyhruo a vie li riypata,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta capa zuo cata a paa ca mingsuvtiy padang yi te, a sacanung uvthyi ta aa ziekhyi; a paa ta a sacanung a vaa ziepa hne a thupa kha pachang vyi.
A mawluopa ta a uvthyinung ca ta, “Mang tie, azuohnie kha kama ta i paa i ziekhyi; ata zuo zaw hing mingsuvtiy padang'a pate nama ta a ziekhyi tie, a ciyhruo a vie li riypata,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta ama paa kha mingsuvtiy padang pakhaa yi te a sacanung a syinung ta aa ziekhyi; a paa ta a sacanung a vaa ziepa hne a thupa kha pachang vyi.
Cahaacata Lot sacanung zaw ca ama pahning ta ama paa saata ca ama phya.
A uvthyinung ta sacapaa sa te Moab ta pata ming a sa; ama ca ata lie Moab ming ciypathlatuv ta a cuo.
A syinung zaw ta sacapaa sa te Ben-ammi ta pata ming a sa; ama ca ata lie Ammon ming ciypathlatuv ta a cuo.
Capa taa cata Abraham ca Negeb ruo luo kha si te Kadesh hne Shur alalalie kha a aw.

Gerar lie mingpe ta a aw nguoluo ning kha Abraham ta a napuvnung Sarah kha, “I sietanung tana a cuo,” a tapa kha a cuo. Caacuonakawta Gerar siepahruo Abimelek ta a cawsaa kha pathlie yi te Sarah kha a pala sa yi.
Cuorasala capa zuo cata Abimelek muo lie kha Khazing zaa luo te, “Na lapa cawsaanung nakaw hingta na thiy aa, tahematapakieca ama ca navaa a hnyipa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Abimelek ca cawsaanung kha cadi vyi. Khazing kyihuo khata, “Abyipa, a sue lipa cawsaa ca na thie'a ma?
Ama ta, ‘I sietanung tana a cuo,’ na ta va ma? Cawsaanung hrahring zaw ta, ‘I caapaapa tana a cuo,’ ina ta. Palung pathesa pata hne a pathepa kuv tana hingpa hmang hing i tue,” a ta.
A muo lie ca ta Khazing ta, “A cuo, hingpa hmang hing palung pathesa pata na tuepa kha i pachang; caacuonakaw ca ta muo i cunglie na sue li riypata a hrie hmuo ica pahrie sa va ta.

Ata hingta cawsaapa napuvnung hing va pi pakhaa tie; tahematapakieca ama ca profet ta cuo te ama ta thlaa ca chuopa'a te na hring aa. Cuorasala hingpa nung hing na va pi pakhaa li kieca nama hne na chungkhue cawsaa bangkhuo nama thiy diy aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Abimelek ca mawdiy ta thu te a sii zaw kha ku yi te capa kaw ca a chang yi ca ama ciy hringhruo.

Cakhutaa cata Abimelek ta Abraham kha ku te, “Ma cunglie hing khaapa hmang ma na tue? Na cunglie khaapa suena i tue nakawta ma hing haapa pha lina lepuv hing kama hne i pena cung luo na vya chiykhyi? Tue li riypa hmang na i cunglie na tue tli,” a ta.
Abimelek ta Abraham kha, “Khaapa za rue cate ma hingpa hmang hing na tue,” a ta.
Abraham ta, “Hingpa khy hne ruo lie hing Khazing ciyzaana aw vyi tapa kha i hmung, caacuonakawta i napuvnung kawlie hingta kama hing na thie'a kie yi i ta nakaw tana hingpa hmang hing i tue.
Capa hlyitaw taata ama ca i sietanung zaw a cuo hmisi, i paa sacanung ta cuo te, i nung sacanung ca cuo vyi, caacuonakawta napuv ta i la.

Caacuonakaw tana Khazing ta i paa ing taata ruo hrang luo khy ina patlaw sa tiyta, ama kyihuo hingta i changpa ca, i cunglie kawpacuona hne na tue riypa ca ma chiynapa hmangting lie kha, ‘Ama ca i caapaapa tana a cuo,’ ina ta'a ciy, tapa hingta a cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abimelek ta Abraham kha tuv, cue, siicanung hne siicapaa zaw kha pi te, a napuvnung Sarah kha a pi pakhaa.
Abimelek ca ta, “I ruo ca na hmiekunglie a aw thluo hing, na khingnapa hmang lie hing khysa tie,” a ta.

Sarah kyihuo kha ta, “Mang tie, na caapaapa ca ngu tuokaa thawkha i pi hing; hingpa hing nama'a lie a awpa zaw bangkhuo hmiekunglieta suebena taa tana lawnapa paluo sana tana a cuo; nama ca suena tue bangby li pata na pathe,” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata Abraham ta Khazing'a luo kha thlaachuo te Khazing ta Abimelek hne a napuvnung hne a siicanung zaw kha saata ama sa khu riypata a patluo sa yi.
Tahematapakieca Sarah kawlie khata Abyipata Abimelek chungkhue lie canung tie bangkhuo saata sa khu li riypata ama chiy kha a za paping diy yi.
Abyipata a ripa haata Sarah kha vihnyi te bie a kuopa haa khata a cuota a tue.
Sarah ca nu phya te Abraham kha a macuo tli pata sacapaa a sapa. Khazing ta a changpa cuo lie kha nu ca a za puv.
Sarah ta a sapapa sacapaa ca Abraham ta Isak ta pata ming a paphya.
Abraham ta a sacapaa Isak ca ning cari a ta pata Khazing ta bie a pina haa khata vangdaw a te.
Isak a puv ning hing Abraham ca kung zakha a ta tli.
Sarah ta, “Khazing na pahnyina cuo naa pi tli; naa thyipa bangkhuo ta ina pahnyi khyi'a yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata, “Sarah na haatiy ahnung a pazaw sa aa, ta pata Abraham kyihuo ta ahung ta chuo ama za ta buo'a ma? Cuorasala a macuo tli pata na sacapaa i sapa,” a ta.
Haatiy ca kya le te ahnung a pathlie. Isak ahnung a pathlie ning ca Abraham ta pyi lesapa a tuepa.
Cuorasala Sarah ta Izipt zaanung Hagar ta Abraham hne ama sapa a sacapaa hne ama sacapaa Isak ama cang hnepa kha a hmung.
Caacuonakawta Abraham kyihuo khata, “Hingpa siizaanung hne a sacapaa hing papya tie yi; tahematapakieca hingpa siizaanung saata hing i sacapaa Isak hneta ru cu hne khu'a vyi,” a ta.
Abraham ca a sacapaa kawlieta capa bie a thyi tiyta a palung rie a thyisa.

Cuorasala Khazing ta Abraham kha, “Haatiypa kawlie hne siizaanung kawlieta na palung rie thyi khah se; Sarah ta aca changpa bangkhuo hing a ripa haata tue tie, tahematapakieca Isak chungtaata a puvpa tie hingna na samingsahlaa ta ripa a cuo'a yi.
Siizaanung sacapaa zaw hing ma na ciyhruo a cuo nakawta mingphang phang kha ta i pacuo sa ra aa,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Abraham ca mawdiy ta thu te viechuo hne savang ungthyi tiy zungkha a awpa kha Hagar ca a pi. A sacapaa kha papy sa te a pasi sa yi. Hagar ca ing taa khata pya te Beer-sheba ruocaapa lie kha a sile byalya.
Savang ungthyi chunglie tiy a chuo tiyta haatiy kha ruohraw rawlie kha a thuse.
Cakhutaa cata cuoti ka khang aa hlanapa luo kha va cakuo te haatiy kha hnangchaw te aa tu. “Haatiypa a thiypa kha na pahmung sa thi khah,” ta te khuopuv ta a caa.
Khazing ta haatiy a caapa ueryi kha a thyi; avuoming pakha ta Hagar kha vuoruo taata za ku te, “Khaapama ruvnaana caa pi? Ciy khah; Khazing na haatiypa a awna lie a caapa ueryi kha a thyi tli.
A vaw la, haatiypa kha va la lah vaa paw tie, ama ca mingphang lepa tana i pacuo sa aa,” a ta.
Ca khu pahne ta Khazing ta a ming kha pavuo sa te, takhue suokha a pahmung sa. Vaa te savang ungthyi zung kha ta tiy a raw khutaata haatiypa kha a padang sa.
Khazing ta haatiypa ca awpuo te, kya lethaw te ruocaapa lie kha aw te cuoti ka a the ciemuopa ta a cuo.
Ama ca Paran ama tapa ruocaapa lie kha aw te, a nung ta Izipt zaanung kha napuv ta a hiepa.
Capa ning cata Abimelek ca a riekabyi le cepa Fikol hneta Abraham kyihuo khata, “Na hmang tuepa bangkhuo lie Khazing ta aca awpuo;

caacuonakawta kama cuose, i saata hne i samingsahlaa zaw cuose malie na dungvie li riypata Khazing ming ta kama'a lie hing bie a kuo tie. Na hmiekunglie zang tluo aa tlasa pata i awpa haa hingta kama hmiekunglie hne, mingpe ta na awnapa hingpa ruo chunglie hing zang tluo aa tlasa pata na aw riypata bie a kuo tie,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abraham ta, “Bie i kuo,” a ta.
Abraham ta Abimelek changtaapa zaw ta ama chuvpa takhue kaw kha Abimelek ca a chang.
Abimelek ta, “Capa hmang ca ahungma a tue tapa pachang va ang; nama zaw na za chang vaciy, ataning tepa hingta thyi buo va ang,” a ta.
Abraham ta tuv hne cue zaw kha Abimelek ca pi te biekuona ama tue.
Abraham ta tuvlaanung sasariy kha a nanang ta a chi.
Caacuonakawta Abimelek ta Abraham kyihuo khata, “Tuvlaanung sasariy a nanang ta na chipa hing khaapa siyluo tama a cuo?” a ta.
Ama ta, “Hingpa takhue hing kama na a cu ang tapa kha naa pachangkhyituv na cuo riypata hingpa tuvlaanung sasariy hing na cuhluo thi tie,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta capa hmang ca Beer-sheba ta pata ama ku, tahematapakieca capa lie ca ama pahning ta chie a sa yi te bie amaa kuo.
Beer-sheba lie biekuona ama tue khutaa cata Abimelek hne a riebyipa Fikol ca Filistin ruo luo kha ama kaa pakhaa.
Abraham ta Beer-sheba lie ca beke kung kung kha a ling te AbyipaChuozaa Khazing kha aa bie.
Cakhutaa cata Abraham ca Filistin ruo lie ca cuo pasiypuv mingpe ta a aw.
Cakhutaa cata Khazing ta Abraham ca a dyapasya. “Abraham,” ta te a ku. Abraham ta, “Hingpa lie hingna i aw,” a ta.
Khazing ta, “Na duesapa na sacapaa pakha dyipa Isak kha la lah Moriah ruo luo kha si tie. Capa lie ica pahmung sapa tluo lie kha Isak ca myirue panaana ta na pihluo tie,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Abraham ca mawdiy ta thu te, laa kedie kha padie te a changtaapa pahning hne Isak hne khata amaa tha. Myirue panaana tuena riypata thing a hluopaale te Khazing ta a pahmung sapa luohlaa luo kha ama si.
Ning thungnapa lieta Abraham ta capa hmang ca luohlaa taata ava hmung.
Abraham ta a changtaapa tie kyihuo khata, “Laa hne hingta hingpa lie hing za aw tie ung, satliepa hne kama hing huepa luo hue abiena va tue'a pate niema'a luo ma vya kaa pakhaa aa,” a ta yi.
Abraham ca myirue panaana tuena riypa thing kha a sacapaa Isak kha paphya sale te ama ca myi hne cizung kha aa cyile. Ama pahning cata ama cakuo hnele.

Isak ta a paa Abraham kyihuo cata, “I paa,” ta pata a ku. Abraham ta, “Khaapama i sacapaa,” a ta. Isak ta, “Myi hne thing ca ama aw, cuorasala myirue panaana pihluo riypata tuv haw khaapaliema a aw?” a ta.
Abraham ta, “Myirue panaana riypa tuv ca Khazing na malie a parawpa aa,” a ta. Cahaacata ama pahning cata ama cakuo hnele pakhaa.
Khazing ta a pahmung sapa hmang luo ama chiy tiyta, Abraham ta bienatluophie kha sa te thing kha a cahaw. A sacapaa Isak kha ciypaki te bienatluophie thing cunglie ca a pahlaa.
Cakhutaa cata Abraham ca a sacapaa thiena riypata cizung kha aa la.
Cuorasala Abyipaavuoming ta vuoruo taata, “Abraham, Abraham,” ta te a za ku. Abraham ta, “Hingpa lie hingna i aw,” a ta.

Avuoming ca ta, “Haatiypa cunglie na kuv pathlie pata khaapahmuo tue khah. Tahematapakieca na sacapaa pakha dyi na hnyi tlakuopa kha i cuota pahya li pata na aw li nakawta Khazing na ciyzaa tapa kha ica pachang,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abraham ta hmiehmie a pase ca zungriy lie a kiy a kalaapa tuvtungpa kha a hmung. Va patuv te a sacapaa cuopa ta myirue panaana ta a pihluo.
Caacuonakawta Abraham ta capa hmang ca, “Jehovah Jireh,” a ta. Caacuonakawta ata chuo te hingta, “Abyipatluo lie ca Abyipana a paraw aa,” ama ta.
Abyipaavuoming ta vuoruo taata Abraham kha a yihningnapa ta u te,
“Abyipata, Kama hne kama bie i kuo, tahematapakieca sacapaa pakhata dyi na hnyipa kha i cuota pahya li pata aw li pata ina pi tli ciy.
Thluechiy ica pi hrahring aa. Na samingsahlaa ca avuo lie aasiy zaa hne riyliy ngiekuo lie viehnang zaa i pata sa aa. Na samingsahlaa tie ta ama carie tie khy chiypakaa kha ama uv aa.
Na samingsahlaa tie thue hingta alyi cunglie mingphang bangkhuo ta thluechiy ama hmung aa. Tahematapakieca i ueryi khana ina naathlie ciy,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Abraham ca a changtaapa tie'a luo kha kaa te, a tha yi te Beer-sheba luo kha ama si pakhaw; Abraham ca Beer-sheba lie ca a aw.
Cakhutaa cata, “Na uvnu Nahor napuvnung Milkah na saata zaw a sa yi,” ta pata ama chang.
Sacapaa uvthyi Uz, a nuta Bus, Aram paa Kemuel,
Khesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaf hne Bethuel zaw ta ama cuo.
(Bethuel ca Rebekah paa khata a cuo). Milkah ta Abraham uvnu Nahor kha hingpa sacapaa pacari hing a sapa.
Ca hlyitaw taata a nungthangnung Reumah ta Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, hne Maakah kha a sa yi.
Sarah ca kung zakha sawsariy hring te,
Kiriath-arba (Hebron zaw ama tapa) khy lie kha a thiy. Abraham ta Sarah ca caa te a muochie a sa.
Abraham ca a napuvnung riyy taa cata a kya daa te, Hit ming kyihuo khata,
Kama ca niema hrawlie khyche hne ruohrang ming tana i cuo; a thiypa i napuvnung i pabyna riypata alyi a baata na zaa tie ung,” a ta.
Hit ming ca ta Abraham kha,

“I byipaapa, malie naathlie tie, nama ca kiema hrawlie hing a lesyipa byi tana na cuo. Na khing cepa thluo kha a tlaw la na napuvnung ca paby tie; kiema chungtaata ahung hingta hmuo na napuvnung pabyna riypata thluo a pahya lipa aw'a vapuv,” ama ta.
Abraham ca a daa te, capa ruo cawsaa ta a cuopa Hit ming hmiekunglie kha a bung te,
“Na naathlie thi tie ung, i napuvnung riyy kha hingpa lie hing i pabypa inaa khingkhyi kie ungca ca, Zohar sacapaa Efron kha,
a lu kielieta a awpa Makpelah lungkhue kha ina pi riypata paa na kiepa tie ung. Niema zaw hmiekunglie kha a muo bangkhuo ca pi ang sala a pabyna hmang i hnyi riypata thluo ca na pi se,” a ta.
Capa ning ca Efron ca Hit ming hrawlie kha a tu te, capa khy hukaa lie a tupa Hit ming thyipa cata,
“Cuo vyi, i byipaapa, na naathlie tie; i lu kha ca pi angte a chunglieta a awpa lungkhue zaw kha ica pi; i cawsaa zaw hmiekunglie hrahring hing tana ica pi, naa thiypa ca paby tie,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abraham ca capa ruo ming hmiekunglie ca a bung te,
cawsaa bangkhuo thyi pata Efron kha, “Na naathlie thi tie, i napuvnung kha i paby the riypata alyi muo hing ca pi'a angte na cuhluo thi tie,” a ta.
Efron ta Abraham kha palie te,
“I byipaapa, na naathlie tie; alyi baata hing ngu tuokaa zapaliy muo dyina a cuo, nama hne kama alalalieta khaapa tluo hmuo cuo vyi, na napuvnung ca paby thluo tie,” a ta.
Abraham ta Efron ripa ca a palung tling te, Hit ming thyi pata Efron a ripa ngu tuokaa zapaliy kha sung a palipa tie ama pathliepa haa khata pathlie te Efron ca a pi.
Cahaacata Mamre ningchiyluo kuo ta a awpa Makpelah lie Efron lu ca, a lu hne a chunglie a awpa lungkhue hne thingkungpa zaw bangkhuo hne,
khypuv thlake a hmyana hmang luo a vya chiypa Hit ming hmiekunglie kha Abraham ca pi pata a cuo.
Cakhutaa cata Abraham ta a napuvnung Sarah ca Kanaan ruo, Mamre hne aa hmiepachawpa Makpelah (Hebron zaw ama tapa) lie, lu chunglie a awpa lungkhue lie kha a paby.
Cahaacata Hit ming ta Abraham ca lu hne a chunglie a awpa lungkhue kha thluo hmang ta a hnyi riypata ama pi.
Abraham ca macuo te a kung a uvthyisa mangtli. Hmangting bangkhuo lie Abyipata thluechiy a pi.
Abraham ta a ing chunglieta a uvthyi cepa a changtaapa kha ku te, “I bawtung rawlie hing na kuv chi la,
alyi hne avuo a sapa Abyipa, Khazing ming ta chie ca pasa sa'a ang, ata i awnapa Kanaan zaa zaw hing i sacapaa napuv riypata na la li riypa hne,
i ruo luo si pata i tieriy zaw chung taa khata i sacapaa Isak cuota napuv chiy riypata chie a sa tie,” a ta.
A changtaapa ta, “Cawsaanung ta hingpa ruo luo hing na vya ziyle khing li pata aw biephung sala, na sacapaa hing ma na vya sinapa ruo luo kha i kaakhyi aa? a ta.
Abraham ta, “I sacapaa kha capa ruo luo ca sikhyi'a vaciy,” a ta.

I paa ing taata hne i puvnapa ruo taata na pyakhyi te, ‘Na samingsahlaa zaw na hingpa ruo hing i pi'a yi,’ naa tapa vuoruo Khazing, Abyipata na hmiekung luo kha avuoming za pathlie'a te capa taa cata i sacapaa napuv kha na la khu ngiethie aa.
Cuorasala cawsaanung khata aca vya ziyle khing li biephung kieca hingpa bie ica kuopa taa hingta na law aa, tuokhaata a cuo zaw i sacapaa hing ca capa ruo luo ca sikhyi'a vaciy,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta a changtaapa ca a byipaapa Abraham bawtung raw luo kha a kuv ca chi te capa kaw ca bie aa kuo.
Cakhutaata a changtaapa ca a byipaapa lasaw muosungpa phangting kha pachie te, kala-uv sahraa kha la te Nahor khypuv, Aram-naharaim luo kha aa tha.
Zuoluocaw ta canung zaw tiy the riypata ama pya cuo ning kha khypuv le lie takhue athaalie kha a kala-uv ca a pabu.
Cakhutaata, “Vya Abyipa, i byipaapa Abraham Khazing, i byipaapa Abraham kha aa hmangpa duena ta na duepa kha na pahmung sa la, ataning hing hluetlingna na pi thi tie.
Kama ca hingpa khy chung lesaa zaw tiy ama thenapa takhue kielie tana i daa nguoluo.

“Na tiybi lie tiy kha na padang sa thi tie,” i ta tiyta, “Dang tie, na kala-uv zaw kha tiy ca padangpa'a ang,” naa ta nung ca na changtaapa Isak cuota nama naa tlawpa ta cuo se. Cahaacata aa hmangpa duena ta i byipaapa na duepa kha i pachang aa,” a ta.

A bieri hmuo a patlung hluota Rebekah ca a tiybi kha a letung lie vya khangle te aa vaw. Rebekah ca Bethuel sacanung ta a cuo, Bethuel ca Milkah sacapaa ta cuo te Milkah ca Abraham uvnu Nahor napuvnung ta a cuo.
Rebekah ca a puvthesa, capaa a pachang buo lipa lesaa pathenung ta a cuo. Takhue luo kha cung te, a tiybi zungkha ta tiy kha the te a kya pya.
Abraham changtaapa ca lesaanung'a luo kha vaa ruo te, “Na tiybi lie tiy hing na padang thi tie,” a ta.
Cawsaanung ta, “I byipaapa, dang tie,” ta te a letung lie tiybi kha pachung te tiy kha a pi.
Dang riypa tiy a pi khutaa khata, “Na kala-uv tie huo zaw hing tiy ca thepa'a angte ama khingna zaa ta dang naase yi,” a ta.
A tiybi lie tiy kha hraky chungluo a catlisa pata patle te tiy the riypa cata takhue luo kha a ruo pakhaa. Cahaacata kala-uv bangkhuo dang riypa tiy kha a thepa.
Abraham changtaapa ca ta, Abyipata i khytlawna hing hluetlingna ina pi ma na pi va ma ta pata cawsaanung kha a dieta tah a mang thluo.
Kala-uv tie tiy ama dang khutaata Abraham changtaapa ca ta shekel khingkhuo aa riypa siy hnacabuv ra-aw suokha hne shekel suohraa aa riypa kukaw suohning kha pachiy te,
“Ahung sacanung tama na cuo tapa kha na chang tie. Na paa ing lie ca kiema cuota arina khuo aw'a ma?” a ta.
Cawsaanung ca ta, “Kama ca Nahor napuvnung Milkah sacapaa Bethuel sacanung tana i cuo,” a ta.
A ri viepa ca, “Ma ing lie ca aphuv caapa hne sahring la a hluvsa hnyi pate arina khuo zaw a aw,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abraham changtaapa ca a bung te, Abyipakha abie te,

“I byipaapa cunglie aa hmangpa a duena hne zang tluo aa tlana a pahmang sa paripa, i byipaapa Abraham Khazing, Abyipaca thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue. Abyipata i byipaapa tieriy zaw ing luo kha luo inaa chiy tli,” a ta.
Lesaanung ca a nung chungkhue tie'a luo kha a ruo te capa kaw bangkhuo ca a chang yi.
Rebekah ta Laban ama tapa caapaapa pakha a hnyi. Laban ca cawsaapa awnapa takhue luo ca aa ruo.

Ama ta hnacabuv ra-aw hne a sietanung kuvbuo lie kukaw zaw kha hmung te a sietanung Rebekah ta a ripa, “Cawsapa ta cahaacata na chang te,” a tapa bie kha a thyi tiyta cawsaapa'a luo kha a ruo te takhue lie kala-uv zaw athaalie a zaa daa nguoluopa kha a hmung.

Ama ta, “Vya Abyipata thluechiy a pipa, a vaw tie. Khaapanakawma ale lie ca naa daa? Na cuota ing kha ca pare daw angte kala-uv awna zaw hmang aa tlaw sa,” a ta. Caacuonakawta cawsaapa ca ing chung luo kha a zaa ngie. Laban ta kala-uv hmang kha pachung te aphuv caapa hne sahring la zaw kha ama ca a pi.
Cawsaapa a phyi a siyna riypa tiy hne a cawsaa zaw ama phyi a siyna riypa tiy zaw kha a pi yi.
Cakhutaata a hmiekunglie sa ama kya pachie ca, cawsaapa ca ta, “I ri riypa bie i ri hluota ca ning'a va ang,” a ta. Laban ta, “Ri tie,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta ama ta, “Kama ca Abraham changtaapa tana i cuo.
Abyipata i byipaapa kha thluechiy a hluvsa pi te ama ca a hnyirung ciemuo tli. Tuv, cue, siy hne ngu, kala-uv hne laa, siicanung hne siicapaa zaw kha a pi.
I byipaapa napuvnung Sarah ta i byipaapa a macuo caw ta sacapaa pakha sa pate i byipaapa ca ta a hnyipa bangkhuo kha a sacapaa ca a pi.
I byipaapa ca ta kama kha bie na pakuo sa te, ‘Ama ruo lie i awnapa Kanaan zaa zaw hing i sacapaa napuv riypata la'a vaciy;
cuorasala i paa ing luo, i tieriy zaw'a luo kha si'a cate na, i sacapaa napuv kha na chiy aa,’ ina ta.
Kama ta i byipaapa kyihuo khata, ‘Cawsaanung ta na ziy khing li pata aw biephung sala,’ i ta ca,
Ama ta, ‘A ri i ngie paripa, Abyipata avuoming ca za pathliepa'a te na re lie hluetlingna aca pi aa. I paa ing, i tieriy zaw'a taata i sacapaa napuv kha na chiy aa.
Cakhutaata i tieriy zaw'a luo na chiy kieca i chiesana taa hingta na law aa; iema ta lesaa kha aca pi li kie zaw yi ma i chiesana taa hingta na law aa,’ ina ta.
