“Ataning takhue luo i vya chiy tiyta, “Vya Abyipai byipaapa Abraham Khazing, ata i hrie nguoluopa re hing hluetlingna ina pipa cata a cuo kieca,
takhue kielie hing a daa'a angte, tiy the riypata a vawpa lesaa pakha kyihuo khata, Na tiybi chunglie tiy hing dang riypata na pi thi tie i ta aa.”
Ca tiyta, “Dang tie, na kala-uv tie cuo zaw ta tiy ica thepa aa,” naa tapa ca Abyipata i byipaapa sacapaa cuota aa tlawpa ta cuo se,” i ta.
“I palungruv ta capa bie ca ri angte i patlung hluota, Rebekah ca tiybi kha a letung lie vya khangle te, takhue luo kha cung te tiy a the. Kama ta, ‘Tiy na padang tie,’ i ta.
A tiybi kha a letung taa cata a catlisa pata pachung te, ‘Dang la, na kala-uv tie zaw hing tiy i padang ra aa,’ ina ta. Cahaacata kama ca tiy dang angte i kala-uv tie zaw kha tiy a padang sa ra yi.

Cakhutaa cata, ‘Ahung sacanung tama na cuo,’ ta angte i hiehriy. Ama ta, ‘Nahor hne Milkah sacapaa Bethuel sacanung tana i cuo,’ ina ta. Caacuonakawta hnacabuv haalaw kha pabaa angte, kukaw kha a buo lie i paku.

Cakhutaa cata a bung angte, i khytlawnapa luo naa chiy te, i byipaapa uvnu a cuopa samingta kha i byipaapa sacapaa napuv riypata naa pahmung sapa i byipaapa Abraham Khazing, Abyipakha abie angte i pathuosa.

Cakhutaata i byipaapa cunglie hing a phung haata hne aa hmuopa tana ma hrie aa nama ta kieca, ata hingta na chang tie ung; hrie'a vapuv nama ta kie zawma na chang tie ung, cakiedyina cavyiluo ma i ziy aa cacuoluo ma i ziy aa tapa kha i pachang aa,” a ta.
Laban hne Bethuel ca ta, “Hingpa hmang hing Abyipa'a taata a zuvpa tana a cuo; a chie a pha kha kiema ta ca chang the vapuv.
Rebekah ca na hmiekunglie a aw thluo hing, a la lah si tie, Abyipata a ripa haa cata na byipaapa sacapaa napuv cata cuo se,” ama ta.
Abraham changtaapa ta capa bie ca a thyi tiyta, Abyipahmiekunglie kha a bung te aa bie.
Cakhutaata siy hne ngu ta tuepa suethiy zaw, cawsie zaw kha pachiy te Rebekah ca a pi. A caapaapa hne a nung zaw kha a muo ruvsapa hne a puvthesapa lasaw a pi ra yi.
Ama hne a cawsaa zaw ca ning yi dang yi te, capa zuo ca capa lie ca amaa ri. Maw ama kya thu tiyta, “I byipaapa'a luo na pasi sa thi tie ung,” a ta.
A caapaapa hne a nung ta, “Lesaanung hing a caw ce ning hraa chuo kiema'a lie aw caw se, cakhutaa cata si lavuo,” ama ta.
Cuorasala ama ta, “Na pahaa na pasaa sa thi khah ung, Abyipata i khytlawna lie hluetlingna ina pi tli, i byipaapa'a luo ca kaa thi paatie ang se,” a ta yi.
Iema ta, “Lesaanung ca ku'a pate hiehriy taa'a puv,” ama ta.
Rebekah ca ku yi te, “Hingpa paa'a lie hing na si ra paluo'a ma? ama ta. Ama ta, “I si ra aa,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta ama sietanung Rebekah hne a mangchiytuv nung ca Abraham changtaapa hne a cawsaa zaw hne khata ama pasi sa.
Rebekah ca thluechiy pi yi te, “Ma sietanung, nama ca cawsaa a thaw hluvpuv nung ta va cuo la, na samingsahlaa zaw ta ama carie tie khypuv kha te mang yi sue,” ama ta.
Rebekah hne a mangchiytuv canung zaw ca a thu yi te, kala-uv kha a khang yi te cawsaapa ca ama ziy. Cahaacata Abraham changtaapa ca ta Rebekah ca a la te ama si.
Isak ca Beer-lahai-roi taa khata vya si te Negeb lie a aw.
Isak ca zuoluocaw ta ruo chunglie a va cakuolepa khata ruo a suo ca kala-uv zaw ama vya silepa kha a hmung.
Rebekah zaw ta Isak kha a va hmung ca, a kala-uv cung taa khata cung pahraa te,

Abraham changtaapa kyihuo khata, “Huepa lieta cawsaapa, kiema a taw riypata ruo chunglie a vya cakuolepa hue ahungtama a cuo?” a ta. Ama ta, “I byipaapa tana a cuo,” a ta. Caacuonakawta a hmiepakhuv kha a la te a hmie kha aa pahruv.
Changtaapa ca ta a tuepa hmang bangkhuo kha Isak ca a chang.

Cakhutaa cata Isak ta a nung Sarah thluodaa chung luo kha Rebekah ca a ngiekhyi te a napuv ta a cuo. Isak ta Rebekah ca a duesa. Caacuonakawta a nung thiy khutaata Isak ca Rebekah ca ta a hnaa a panguo.
Abraham ta Keturah ama tapa napuv hrangpa pakha a chiy.
Keturah ca ta Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak hne Shuah a sa yi.
Jokshan ca Sheba hne Dedan paa ta a cuo. Dedan sacapaa zaw ca Asshurim, Letushim hne Leummim ta ama cuo.
Midian sacapaa zaw ca Efah, Efer, Hanok, Abida, hne Eldaah ta ama cuo. Hingpa zaw bangkhuo hing Keturah ciypathla zaw ta ama cuo.
Abraham ca a hnyipa zaw bangkhuo kha Isak a pi.
Cuorasala a nungthangnung sacapaa zaw ca a hring chung khata lasaw pi yi te Isak'a taata aa hlanapa ruo, ningchiy ruo luo kha a pasi sa yi.
Abraham ca zakha sawsariy kung pangaa a hring.
A macuosana te ta, a chuo tlungsa pata hring te a thiy khutaata a cawsaa zaw'a luo kha pahlaw pata a cuo.
A sacapaa Isak hne Ishmael ta Mamre taata ningchiyluo kuo ta a awpa Hit ming Zohar sacapaa Efron lu chunglie, Makpelah lungkhue lie kha ama paby.
Capa ca Abraham ta Hit ming'a taata a calyipa tana a cuo.
Abraham a thiy khutaata a sacapaa Isak kha Khazing ta thluechiy a pi. Isak ca Beer-lahai-roi lieta khy a sa.
Hingpa tie hing Sarah siicanung, Izipt zaanung Hagar ta Abraham hne ama sapa Ishmael ciypathla zaw ta ama cuo.
Ishmael sacapaa zaw a uvthyi ce taata aa paziy pata ama ming ca: Nebaioth, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
Mishma, Dumah, Massa,
Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Nafish hne Kedemah ta ama cuo.
Hingpa tie hing ama khy hne ama awna hmang hne ama mingphang ziy pata ming pipa Ishmael sacapaa siepahruo pahraa hlyihning tie ta ama cuo.
(Ishmael ca zakha sawthung kung sariy a ta pata thiy te a cawsaa zaw'a luo kha pahlaw pata a cuo.)
Iema ca Izipt ruo taata ningchiyluo kuo, Assiria luo sinapa luopuv, Havilah taata Shur alala ruo lie kha khy ama sa.
Abraham sacapaa Isak ciypathla ca hing haa hing tana a cuo: Abraham ca Isak paa ta a cuo,
Isak ca kung sawliy a ta pata Paddan-aram ruo lie Aramean mingphang Bethuel sacanung, Laban sietanung Rebekah kha aa hlaw.
Isak ca a napuvnung kha saata a hnyi khu li nakawta Abyipa'a luo kha thlaachuo te Abyipa ta a thlaachuona kha palie te a napuvnung Rebekah ca nu a phya.
A riy chunglieta haatiy ca pakha hne pakha kha amaa nuo byalya nakawta, “Hing haa hingta a cuo kieca khaapama i hringpuopa a aw aa,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Abyipa'a luo hiehriy riypata a si.

Abyipata, Na chunglie hing mingphang phanghning aw yi te, na sapa cawsaa pahning hing amaa che aa. Pakha hing a hrangpa pakha laata a thaa ruv vie'a te, a uvthyipa ca a syipa rehrietuv tana a cuo aa,” a ta.
A ningthlaa tling te nu a za puv tiyta mingphie ta ama cuo.
Zaa puv taapa ca se te a pangpa bangkhuo ca pang hming thuepa haata a hming ta a pahlaw nakawta a ming ca Esau ama ta.
Cakhutaata a nuta ca Esau lidu kha a cusa pata a patuvpuo pata a za puv nakawta Jakob ta pata ming ama sa. Rebekah ta iema a sa ning yi kha Isak ca kung sawcaruv a ta tli.
Haatiy zaw ca kya le yi te Esau ca saa a ka thesapa, ruo si a khingsapa ta a cuo. Jakob ca a ryi sungsapa, ing lie dyi a awpa ta a cuo.
A saa kapa saa kha a ce taw nakawta Isak ta Esau kha a due, cuorasala Rebekah ta Jakob kha a due.
Ning kha ca Jakob ta sa a chang nguoluo ning kha Esau ca ruo taata vya chiy te a nang a diy hringhruo.
Caacuonakawta Jakob kyihuo khata, “I nang na a diy hringhruo, na tiyhuo sepa kha ning buo thi'a ang,” a ta. (Caacuonakawta ama ca Edom ta pata upa a cuo.)
Jakob ta, “Sacapaa uvthyi na cuonapa kha na zaa taa tie,” a ta.
Esau ta, “I thiy tyalya tli hing; sacapaa cuona ca khaapama i tuena aa?” a ta.
Jakob ta, “Bie ca naa kuo taa tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta bie ca a kuo te a sacapaa uvthyi cuona ca Jakob'a luo ca a zaa.
Cakhutaa cata Jakob ta Esau ca viechuo hne abie sepa tiyhuo ca pi te a ning khutaata thu te a cakuo. Cahaacata Esau ta a sacapaa uvthyi cuona kha siysaa ri li pata a aw.
Abraham chuo ningta a tlungpa cakuo khutaa khata ama ruo lie cakuo a tlung pakhaa nakawta Isak ca Filistin siepahruo Abimelek awnapa Gerar luo kha a si.
Abyipaca Isak'a lie kha a luo te, “Izipt ruo luo kha si khah, kama ica pahmung sa riypa ruo lie kha khysa tie.
Hingpa ruo lie hing mingpe ta aw tie, ca awpuo'a angte thluechiy ica pi aa. Nama hne na ciypathla kha hingpa ruo bangkhuo hing ca pi'a yi angte na paa Abraham'a lieta bie i kuopa kha i patling sa aa.

Na ciy na hruo kha avuo lie aasiy zaa pa ta sa'a yi angte hingpa ruo bangkhuo hing na samingsahlaa kha i pi'a yi. Alyi lie a awpa mingphang bangkhuo hing nama samingsahlaa tie'a taa hingta thluechiy ama hmung aa.
Tahematapakieca Abraham ca i ueryi kha naathlie te, i changpa, i nawbie, i upadi hne i phungbie kha a ziy tli,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Isak ca Gerar lie ca khy a sa.

Capa lie a awpa tie ta a napuvnung kaw kha ama hiehriy tiyta, “I sietanung tana a cuo,” a ta. Tahematapakieca Rebekah ca a puvthesa nakawta, “I napuvnung tana a cuo,” i ta kieca hingpa hmang lie a awpa cawsaa zaw hingta Rebekah kawlie hingta na thie'a kie yi tapa kha a ciy nakawta a cuo.
Isak ca capa lie ca cuo pasiy puo a aw khutaata Filistin siepahruo Abimelek ca thlaluo-aw taata hmiehmie pase te Isak ta Rebekah kha a paw te a pazuv hyalyapa kha a hmung.

Caacuonakawta Abimelek ta Isak kha ku te, “Rebekah hing na napuvnung muo a cuo ta! Khaapanakawma, ‘I sietanung na a cuo,’ na ta?” a ta. Isak ta, “Ama kawlie hingta thiy'a kie ang i ta nakaw tana a cuo,” a ta.
Abimelek ta, “Ma cunglie na tuepa hmang hing khaapatama a cuo? Cawsaa pakhakha ta na napuvnung hing a ziehne pathlyi yi sala suena malie a phyatuv ta cuo'a va ca ma?” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Abimelek ta cawsaa bangkhuo kha, “Hingpa cawsaapa hne a napuvnung hing ruvnaana a pipa ahunghmuo thie pata nama cuo aa,” a ta.
Capa ruo lie ca Isak ta saciy kha tuv te capa kungpa cata a tuvpa zaa le zakha ta a pahriy.
Abyipata thluechiy pi te a hnyirungpa ta aa li. Hnyirungle hryly te a dawphaasapa ta aa li.
Cue hne tuv a hluvsa hnyi te changtaapa zaw a hluvsa a hnyi ca Filistin ming ta ama kha hie ama tlie.
(Caacuonakawta Filistin ming ta a paa Abraham chuo ning a changtaapa zaw ta ama za cupa takhue mekaa kha alyi ta ama pame diy.)
Cakhutaata Abimelek ta Isak kyihuo khata, “Malie sise paatie, kiema laa tana na lesyi vie karaa tli,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Isak ca capa hmang taa cata pya te Gerar lie kha khy a sa.
Isak ta a paa Abraham chuo ningta a za cupa takhue, Filistin ming ta Abraham a thiy khutaata ama pabipa tie kha cu pakhaa te, a paa ta a paphyapa ming kha a paphya pakhaa diy.
Cuorasala Isak changtaapa tie ta bawphie lie ca takhue kha cu yi te tiy ama hmung tiyta,
Gerar ming, sahring a khiepa tie khata, “Hingpa tiy hing kiema huopa tana a cuo,” ama ta. Caacuonakawta Isak ta amaa hrupuopa capa takhue ca Esek ta pata ming a sa.
Cakhutaata iema ta a hrangpa takhue kha ama cu ca amaa hrupuo ngiethie nakawta Sitnah ta pata ming a sa.

Capa taa cata a hnyi te takhue hrangpa a cu ca capa takhue ca a hrupuo va tli yi; caacuonakawta capa takhue ca Rehoboth ta pata ming sa te, “Ata hing ca Abyipata awna hmang malie pi tli te hingpa ruo lie hing ma pung ma zaa aa,” a ta.
Capa hmang taa cata Isak ca Beer-sheba luo a sithaw.

Capa zuo cata Abyipakha ama'a lie a luo te, “Kama ca na paa Abraham Khazing tana i cuo; ciy khah, tahematapakieca i changtaapa Abraham nakawta nama kha ca awpuo'a angte thluechiy ca pi'a angte na samingsahlaa kha i papungzaa sa'a yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta capa hmang lie ca bienatluophie kha sa te, Abyipakha aa bie. Thluodaa zaw kha sa te, a changtaapa zaw ta takhue kha ama cu.
Abimelek ca ruena a pituv Ahuzzath hne a riekabyi le cepa Fikol hne khata Gerar taata Isak'a luo kha amaa vaw.
Isak ta, “Na hue ung cate inaa cade khutaa ung cata kama'a luo ca khaapanakawma namaa vaw?” a ta yi.
Iema ta, “Abyipana caa awpuo tapa kha a siesa pata ma hmung,

caacuonakawta kiema ta nama kha khaapahmuo ca ta lipa pata a dieta tah maca pasi sapa haata nama zaw kiema kha ruvnaana malie na pi li riypata kiema hne nama alalalie hing chie a sa pata a phasa pata biekuona tuepa kha ma khing. Nama ca Khazing ta thluechiy a pipa tana na cuo,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Isak ta pyi tuepa yi te ama ning ama dang.
A mawluopa ca mawdiy ta thu yi te biekuona ama tue. Isak ta luopuv luo kha va pathlie yi te, palung diesa pata ama si.
Capa ning ngiethie cata Isak changtaapa zaw kha a vaw yi te ama cupa takhue kaw kha ama vya chang. “Tiy na ma hmung tli,” ama vya ta.
Capa takhue ca Shibah ta pata ming a sa. Caacuonakawta capa khypuv ca ataning tepa hingta Beer-sheba ta pata kupa a cuo.
Esau ca kung sawliy a ta pata Hit ming Judith sacanung Beeri hne Hit ming Elon sacanung Basemath kha napuv ta a hnyi yi.
Isak hne Rebekah ca capa canung zaw kawlie ca ta ama hring he ta a nuo khu yi.
Isak ca macuosa tli te, a ming zing te a hmung the li tli taata a sacapaa uvthyi Esau kha ku te, “I sacapaa,” a ta. Esau ta, “Hingpa lie hingna i aw,” a ta.
Isak ta, “Macuo tli angte i thiyna'apa ning hing pachang khu va ang.
Caacuonakawta na cehre ta a cuopa, na lavaabya hne na liy kha a la lah ruo vaa khie la saa na va kapa tie.
Cakhutaa cata i ning khingsa tawpa haa khata a pahuosa pata na changpa la na vya pi tie. I thiy hluo hingta thluechiy ca pi naase ang,” a ta.
Isak ta a sacapaa Esau a changpa bie kha Rebekah ta naa a thlie paruv yi. Caacuonakawta Esau ruo a vaa khie chung khata,
Rebekah ta a sacapaa Jakob kha, “Na paa ta na uvta Esau kyihuo ta,
‘Saa na kapa la tiyhuo a pasisa pata chang la na vya pi tie, i thiy hluo hingta Khazing hmielie thluechiy ca pi naase ang, a tapa kha i thyi.'
Caacuonakawta i sacapaa, i ri hing naa ngie tie.
Mie hraw luo kha vaa la, a ningkhingsa tawpa tiyhuo a pasisa pata i changpa khu riypata a thukalypa mienuta sahning na pi tie.
Na paa kha ning riypata pi'a cate a thiy hluota thluechiy ca pi naase,” a ta.
Cuorasala Jakob ta a nung Rebekah kyihuo khata, “I uvta Esau ca a hming rungsapa cuo te, kama ca a vang mekalangpa ta i cuo.
I paa ta na hrie pachiy biephung sala, i dungpa kha na pachang'a te thluechiy ca ta li pata chiesana tlaku i cunglie i patlung sa pali'a ma?” a ta.
A nung ta, “Nama chiesana ca i cunglie tlung lavuo, i sacapaa; i ripa bie dyi hing ziy la, va la lah, mie ca na pi tie,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta vaa te mie ca va la te a nung kha a vya pi. A nung ca ta a paa ta a tlechuo thepa, a pasisapa tiyhuo ca a changpa.
Cakhutaa cata Rebekah ta a sacapaa uvthyi Esau caw a pha cepa kha la te Jakob ca a pahryi.
A kuvbuo hne a hming a aw linapa a rue lie kha mie vang ta a pahlaw.
Cakhutaa cata a pasisapa tiyhuo hne a pasupa viechuo ca a sacapaa Jakob kha a pi.
Jakob ca a paa'a luo kha a ngie te, “I paa,” a ta. A paa ta, “Hingpa lie hingna i aw i sacapaa, ahungtama na cuo ca? a ta.
Jakob ta a paa kha, “Na sacapaa uvthyi Esau tana i cuo,” a ta. Ina changpa ca kha i tue tli. A kya tu la ica changpapa saa hing na ningpa la thluechiy ca na pi tie,” a ta.
Cuorasala Isak ta, “I sacapaa, tuokhaatama hing tluv a catli pata saa ca na ka khu?” a ta. Ama ta, “Nama Khazing Abyipata tena ina pi nakaw tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata Isak ta Jakob kha, “I sacapaa, naa vya ngie la ca hrie pachiy'a ang, i sacapaa Esau ta na cuo hmisi ma cuo hmisi va ca ma tapa kha ca pachang naase ang,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Jakob ta a paa kha vaa ngie te, a hrie pachiy khutaata, “Na ueryi ca Jakob ueryi ta a cuo, cuorasala na kuvbuo ca Esau kuvbuo ta a cuo tlung,” a ta.
A kuvbuo ca a hming thue te Esau kuvbuo a lu nakawta pachang khu li pata, Jakob ca thluechiy a pi.
“I sacapaa Esau ta na cuo hmisi ma?” a ta. Ama ta, “I cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata Isak ta, “Vya cyi tie, i sacapaa, na changpa saa ca ning'a angte thluechiy ca pi naase ang,” a ta. Caacuonakawta va pi te a ning khutaata mingsuvtiy zaw kha pi te a dang.
Cakhutaata a paa Isak ca ta, “I sacapaa naa vya ngie la na pahnuo tie,” a ta.
Jakob ta vaa ngie te a pahnuo. A paa ta a caw rang kha pahnuo te thluechiy a pi. “I sacapaa rang hing Abyipata thluechiy a pipa ruo rang na a pahnuo.
Abyipata avuo aduotiy ca pi sala, na luruo kha alyi phapa ta cuo yi se, sa hne mingsuvtiy a hluvsa ca pi se.

Cawsaa zaw ta na re hrie yi sala, mingphang zaw kha na hmiekunglie a vya bung yi se. Na uvnu zaw cunglie abyi cuo la, na nung sacapaa zaw kha na hmiekunglie a vya bung yi se. Nama chie caa sapa ca chiesapa cuo yi sala, thluechiy caa pipa ahunghmuo thluechiypa ta cuo yi se!” a ta.
Isak ta Jakob kha thluechiy a pi khutaata a paa Isak hmiekung taata a pya khu pahne ta a uvta Esau ca ruo aa khiena taata a vya chiy.
Ama zaw sa hne tiyhuo kha a pasisa pata chang te, a paa'a luo kha a vya cyi. A paa kyihuo khata, “I paa, kya thu la na sacapaa i vya phyapa saa ca ning la, thluechiy ca na pi naase ciy,” a ta.
A paa Isak ta, “Ahungtama na cuo?” a ta. Ama ta, “Na sacapaa uvthyi Esau tana i cuo,” a ta.

Ca khu pahne ca Isak ca a cathangsa te, “Nama naa vaw hluota hingta a kapa saa kama'a luo a vya cyipa kha ahungtama a cuo aa? A bangkhuo ta ning angte thluechiy i pi tlipa kha! A cuo, ama kha na, thluechiy ca a hmung aa,” a ta.
Esau ta a paa bie kha a thyi tiyta ngiechisa pata khuopuv ta caa te, “I paa, kama zaw thluechiy na pi ra tie,” a ta.
Cuorasala a paa ta, “Na nuta kha zyatesa pata a vaw te na thluechiy ca aa la tli,” a ta.

Esau ta, “Jakob tapa ming a phyapa hing aa hmuo hringhruo. Tahematapakieca ata hne hingta yi hning ina dung tli. Sa uvthyi i cuona kha ina chuv khutaata ata hing i thluechiy kha ina chuv hyi tli,” a ta. Cakhutaata, “I cuota thluechiy suokha chuo pangaa va ca ma?” a ta.

Isak ta Esau kyihuo khata, “Ama ca nama byipaapa ta tue tli angte, a uvnu bangkhuo kha a changtaapa ta i pi diy tli. Sa hne mingsuvtiy zaw kha i pi diy tli. I sacapaa, khaapama ica tuepa khu'a tli?” a ta.
Esau ca ta a paa kyihuo khata, “Thluechiy suokha chuo hnyi va tli ca ma, i paa?” a ta. Cakhutaa cata Esau ca a ueriyliy khata a caa.
Cakhutaata a paa Isak ta, “Na awna ruo ca alyi phapa ruo ta cuo'a vyi, na ruo lie avuo aduotiy zaw tla'a vyi.
Na zueziy ta hring'a cate, na nuta re khana na hrie aa. Cuorasala naa du kieca, na ruetung lie ruekhang kha na thlipachung aa,” a ta.
Esau ta Jakob kha a paa ta a pipa thluechiy kawlieta a hue. Caacuonakawta a palung chunglie kha, “I paa hing vya thiy'a te muochie sa ma patlung pahne ta i nuta Jakob hing i thie aa,” a ta.
Cuorasala a sacapaa uvthyipa Esau ta a ripa bie kha Rebekah ta a thyi tiyta, Jakob kha ku te, “Na uvta Esau na nama kha thie acaa nang.
Caacuonakawta i sacapaa, i bie hing naathlie tie. Haran lie a awpa i caapaapa Laban'a luo kha atabala hingta a ruo la,
na uvta hihaana a diena te, cuo kha chung va aw caw tie.

Na uvta hihaana a diena te va aw caw la, a cunglie na tuepa hmang kha a maw thueta cawsaa vya pathlie'a angte ica vya paku sa pakhaa'a yi. Khaapanakawma ning kha chunglie nama pahning ta ina thiyse'a ung ciy?” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata Rebekah ta Isak kyihuo khata, “Hit zaanung zaw hingna naa nangsa tli yi. Jakob zaw hingna ata haa hingta Hit zaanung a chiy ra tapa kieca, i hringpuopa aw va tli,” a ta.
Isak ta Jakob kha thluechiy a pi khutaata, “Kanaan zaanung ca napuv ta chiy'a vaciy.
Ata hingta a pachie la Paddan-aram lie a awpa, na nung a paa Bethuel ing luo kha si la, na nung caapaapa Laban sacanung zaw chung taa khata pakha kha napuv ta va chiy tie.
Lesyice Khazing ta thluechiy ca pi sala sacanung sacapaa a hluvsa ca pi se. Ca papungzaa sala mingphang lepa ca pacuo sa se.
Ama ta nama hne na samingsahlaa kha Abraham thluechiy kha ca pi yi sala, Khazing ta Abraham a pipa ruo, ata lie mingpe ta na awnapa ruo hing nama huopa ta pacuo sa mang sue,” a ta.
Cahaacata Isak ta Jakob ca Paddan-aram lie a awpa Aramean ming Bethuel sacapaa Laban'a luo kha a pathlie. Laban ca Jakob hne Esau nung Rebekah caapaapa khata a cuo.
Isak ta Jakob kha thluechiy pi te na, napuv va chiy riypata Paddan-aram luo a pathlie tapa kha cuose, thluechiy a pi ningta, “Kanaan zaanung ca napuv ta chiy'a vaciy,” a tapa kha cuose,
Jakob ta a nung hne a paa ri kha a ngie te Paddan-aram luo a sipa kha cuose, Esau ta a pachang.
Esau ta Kanaan zaa zaw hingta a paa Isak palung patluo va yi tapa kha a pachang tiyta,
Ishmael'a luo kha si te, a hnyi ciepa a napuv zaw thing taa khata Abraham sacapaa Ishmael sacanung, Nebaioth sietanung Mahalath kha napuv ta a chiy.
Jakob ca Beer-sheba taa khata a tha te Haran luo kha a si.
Suv kha luo a chiypa khata ning a tla nakawta capa lie ca zuo kha aa ri. Alung suokha kha la te, lahya ta a hy te aa zie.
Muo sa te, a muo cata alyi taata avuo te a phapa hlyidaw suokha aw te, capa hlyidaw lie ca Khazing avuoming kie yi cung yi ama tapa kha a hmung.
Abyipakha aa thaalie a daa te, “Kama ca na paa Abraham Khazing hne Isak Khazing, Abyipatana i cuo. Ata naa zienapa alyi hing nama hne na samingsahlaa zaw kha ca pi'a yi angte,

na samingsahlaa zaw ca alyi lie buvcing zaa ama ta aa. Ningchiy, ningtla, sungluo hne chaluo ta a ze diy'a ung cate, chuelyi mingphang bangkhuo ca nama hne na samingsahlaa zaw thueta thluechiy pipa ama cuo aa.
Khaapa luo na cakuo zaw nama kha ca awpuo'a angte, hingpa ruo luo hing ica vya kaakhyi pakhaa aa; tahematapakieca bie ica kuopa hing i tue diyna te ta ca thuse'a va ang,” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata Jakob ca a kya cha te, “Hingpa hmang lie hing Abyipana a aw hrahring, i za pachang va muo!” a ta.
Kya ciy pathingsa te, “Hingpa hmang hing kha tluv tama ciy aa chiy! A hrangpa cuo vade, Khazing ing hne vuoruo chiypakaa ta muo a va cuo ta,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Jakob ca mawdiy ta thu te, lahya ta aa hypa alung kha la te, lungbang ta a bang khutaata a daw taa khata chiytiy a bya.
Capa hmang ca Bethel ta pata ming a sa. Ahluo ta ca, capa khy a ming ca Luz tapa tana a za cuo.
Cakhutaa cata Jakob ta, “Khazing ca kama kha na awpuo te, i sinapa luopuv lie kha na mangchiy te, ning riypa sa hne a buv a se riypa cawsie kha na pi te,
i paa ing luo thlaalungna hne i vya kaa pakhaa khu kieca Abyipaca i Khazing ta a cuo aa.
Hingpa alung, lungbang ta i bangpa hing Khazing ing ta cuo'a te, nama ta ina pipa bangkhuo chung taa hingta chehraachekha ica pi aa,” ta pata bie aa kuo.
Cakhutaa cata Jakob ca a khytlaw kha pazue te ningchiyluo cawsaa tie ruo luo kha a chiy.

Hmiehmie a pase ca ruo lieta takhue suokha kha hmung te tuvrung rung thung ta a kie lie amaa bupuopa kha a hmung. Tahematapakieca capa takhue taa cata tuv tie kha tiy ama padang taw. Takhue ama pahruvpa alung ca a lesa nakawta
tuvrung bangkhuo amaa vya hmya diy taa khata takhue ama pahruvpa alung ca tuvkhietuv tie ta hnyi yi te, tuv kha tiy ama padang khutaata takhue kha ama pahruv siy pakhaa taw.
Jakob ta iema kha, “I uvnu zaw, khaapa taata ma namaa vaw?” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Haran taa tana maa vaw,” ama ta.
Ama ta, “Nahor sacapaa Laban kha nama pachang ma?” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Ma pachang,” ama ta.
Ama ta, “A hnaa tluo ma?” a ta yi. Iema ta, “A tluo, a sacanung Rachel zaw a tuv hne aa vaw hing,” ama ta.
Ama ta, “Ata hing ning a suosa kalie te tuv pahmya tiy ta valie de, tiy padang ung la patle pakhaa caw tie nie ung,” a ta yi.

Cuorasala iema ta, “Tuvrung bangkhuo hing ma pahmya diy khu hluo li hne takhue pahruvpa alung hing ma hnyi khu hluo li ca tiy kha padang khu'a vapuv, cakhutaata kie kyalya dyina ma tuv ca tiy ma padang khu aa,” a ma ta.
Bie ama ri nguoluopa cata Rachel ca a paa tuv hneta a vya chiy, tahematapakieca ama ca tuvkhietuv tana a cuo.
Jakob ca a nung caapaapa Laban sacanung Rachel hne a nung caapaapa Laban tuv zaw kha a hmung tiyta, vaa te, takhue ama pahruvpa alung kha hnyi te a nung caapaapa Laban tuv kha tiy a padang yi.
Cakhutaata Jakob ta Rachel kha pahnuo te khuosa ta a caa.
Jakob ca ta Rachel kha, ama ca Rebekah sacapaa ta cuo te a paa tuvpaapa ta a cuopa kha a chang ca vaa ruo te a paa kha a va chang.
Laban ta a sietanung sacapaa Jakob kaw kha a thyi ca a taw riypata a vya ruo te, a paw te a pahnuo. Cakhutaa cata a ing luo aa chiyle. Jakob ta Laban ca hmang chiycuona bangkhuo kha a chang.
Cakhutaa cata Laban ta, “Nama ca i ruv hne i saa hrahring tana na cuo,” a ta. Cakhutaata ama'a lie ca thla kha a aw.
Laban ta Jakob kha, “Nama ca i tieriy na cuo zaw ta, i re ca a sepa ta hrie'a vaciy? Na thavie muo khaapama a cuo aa? tapa kha na chang tie,” a ta.
Laban ta sacanung pahning hnyi te, a uvthyi nung ca Leah ta yi te, a syinung ca Rachel ama ta.
Leah ca a ming a puvthesa, Rachel ca a pangruepa a puvthesa nakawta khing a chiysa.
Jakob ta Rachel kha a khing nakawta, “Na sacanung a syinung Rachel vuopa hingta na re kung sariy chung i hrie aa,” a ta.
Laban ta, “Cawsaa hrangpa i pipa laata nama ica pipa ca a pha vie, kama'a lie ca aw tie,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Rachel a hlaw khu riypata kung sariy re a hrie. Cuorasala Rachel kha a khingsa nakawta ama cuota ca ning cawta haa tana a ri.
Jakob ta Laban kha, “I napuvnung ca i hlaw the riypata na pi paatie, tahematapakieca i cuo ca a tling tli,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Laban ta capa hmang lie a awpa bangkhuo kha ku pakiy yi te pyi a tue.
Cuorasala capa zuo cata a sacanung Leah kha Jakob ca pi te Jakob ca ta aa ziekhyi.
(Laban ta a siizaanung Zilpah kha a mangchiytuv riypata a sacanung Leah kha a pi).
Maw khy a vya dyi ca Leah ta a cuo! Caacuonakawta Jakob ta Laban kha, “I cunglie na tuepa hmang hing khaapatama a cuo? Rachel cu riypata na re kha hrie va ang ma? Khaapanakawma ina dung ciy?” a ta.
Laban ta, “Kiema ruo lie ca a uvthyi vie tungtuv hluota a syi vie ta tungtuv phung cuo vyi.
Ata zaa kha hing patling sa la, a hrangpa kung sariy i re na hrie vie kieca Rachel zaw hing ica pi aa,” a ta.
Jakob ca a naa a tla. Leah hne amaa chiyhienapa ningzaa zaa kha a tling tiyta Laban ta a sacanung Rachel ca napuv riypata a pi.
(Laban ta a siizaanung Bilhah kha a mangchiytuv riypata a sacanung Rachel kha a pi).
Jakob ta Rachel zaw kha a ziekhyi te Rachel ca Leah laa khata a due vie. A hrangpa kung sariy chung Laban re kha a hrie pakhaa.
Abyipata Leah ca due uo lipa a cuopa kha a hmung tiyta saa sa khuna pi te, cuorasala Rachel ca saata hnyi khu li pata a aw.
Leah ca nu phya te, sacapaa pakha sa te Reuben ta pata ming a sa. Tahematapakieca ama ta, “Khazing na i riethyivuosuona kha naa hmungpa tli; i navaapa ta i na due'a tli,” a ta.
Nu phya pakhaa te, sacapaa pakha sa pakhaa te Simeon ta pata ming a sa. Tahematapakieca ama ta, “Kama ca huepa ta i cuopa hing Abyipata na hmung tena hingpa sacapaa hing ina pi,” a ta.
Nu phya pakhaa hyi te, sacapaa pakha sa pakhaa te Levi ta pata ming a sa. Tahematapakieca ama ta, “Sacapaa pathung i sapa tli nakawta i navaapa hing kama hing inaa viesaa vie'a tli,” a ta.
Nu phya pakhaa ngiethie te sacapaa pakha a sa pakhaa. “Ata hing ca Khazing na i pathuosa aa,” ta te, Judah ta pata ming a sa. Cakhutaata ca saata sa va tli.
Rachel ta Jakob saata a sapa khu lipa kha a pachang tiyta a uvtanung kha hietlie te Jakob kyihuo khata, “Haatiy na pi tie; ca lipa kieca i thiy aa,” a ta.
Jakob ta Rachel cunglie kha a hi haa hringhruo te, “Nama kha saata caa pi lipa Khazing a daa hmang lie ca i aw the'a ma?” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata Rachel ta, “Hingpa lie hing i siicanung a aw hing, a ziehne tie, ama ta i pakhuv cunglie hing saata na sapa'a te ama thueta kama zaw saata i hnyi khu ra aa,” a ta.
Cahaacata a siicanung Bilhah ca a napuv riypata pi te Jakob ta aa ziekhyi.
Bilhah ca nu phya te Jakob kha sacapaa a sapa.
Rachel ta, “Khazing ta kamaluo kuo taata bie na ripa te, i ueryi zaw kha ina thyi nakawta sacapaa pakha ina pi ta te, Dan ta pata ming a paphya.
Rachel siicanung Bilhah ca nu hnyi pakhaa te Jakob kha sacapaa pahningnapa a sapa pakhaa.
Rachel ta, “I uvtanung hne khuosa ta a zue pate i te tli,” ta te, Naftali ta pata ming a paphya.
Leah ta saata sa khu va tli ang tapa kha a pachang tiyta, a siicanung Zilpah ca Jakob kha napuv riypata a pi.
Leah siicanung Zilpah ta Jakob kha sacapaa pakha a sapa.
Leah ta, “Vuophaa tana a cuo,” ta te Gad ta pata ming a sa.
Leah siicanung Zilpah ta Jakob kha sacapaa pahningnapa a sapa.
Leah ca ta, “Kha tluv tama i palung a tluo! Canung zaw ta palungtluo nung ina ta'a yi,” ta te Asher ta pata ming a sa.
Jungsacuo uo cuo ning kha Reuben ca lu luo kha si te, mandarek kha hmung te a nung Leah kha a pi. Rachel ta Leah kyihuo khata, “Na sacapaa huopa mandarek chekha kha na pi ra thi tie,” a ta.

Cuorasala ama ta, “I navaapa ina chuvpa ca hing hmang taata tah ri kanaa ciy? I sacapaa huopa mandarek zaw te ma ina chuv khing ciy?” a ta. Rachel ta, “Na sacapaa huopa mandarek kha ina pipa cata a cuo kieca ata zuo nama hne aa vya zie aa,” a ta.

Zuoluocaw ta Jakob kha lu taata a vya chiy ca, Leah ta vaa hladaw te, “Kama'a liena naa zie aa, tahematapakieca i sacapaa huopa khingna ca-ie thyi tana icaa hluo tli,” a ta. Caacuonakawta capa zuo ca Leah'a lieta aa ri.
Leah thlaachuona ca Khazing ta naathlie te, nu phya te Jakob kha sacapaa papangaanapa a sapa.
Leah ta, “I siicanung kha i navaapa i pina muo na Khazing ta ina pi,” ta te, Issakhar ta pata ming a sa.
Cakhutaa cata Leah ca nu phya pakhaa te Jakob kha sacapaa pacaruvnapa a sapa pakhaa.
Leah ta, “Khazing na lasaw sungnaapa naa pi, tahematapakieca sacapaa pacaruvnapa kha i sapa mangtli,” ta te Zebulun ta pata ming a sa.
Cakhutaa cata sacanung pakha sa te Dinah ta pata ming a paphya.
Cakhutaata Khazing ta Rachel kha a thyi te, a thlaachuona kha naathlie te saata sa khuna kha a pi.
Nu kha hnyi te sacapaa pakha a sa. Ama ta, “Ese hyalyapa i cuonapa khana Khazing ta ina thawpa tli,
Abyipata sacapaa hrangpa zaw na pi kalie se,” ta te Josef ta pata ming a sa.
Rachel ta Josef kha a sa khutaata, Jakob ta Laban kha, “I khyruo hne i ing luo i kaa thena riypata na pathlie paa tie.
Nama'a lie re i hrienapa, i napuv hne i saa zaw kha na pi yi la si paatie ang se; na re a phasa pata i hriepa kha na pachang,” a ta.
Cuorasala Laban ta, “Bie na pari sa ra thi tie. Nama thue tana Abyipata thluechiy ina pi tapa hing hmungdawluna ta i pachang;
na hrie muo ca ri la ica pi aa,” a ta.
Jakob ta, “Tuokhaatama na re i hrie tapa hne kama mangchiyna rawlie na sahring kha tluv tama a pung tapa ca nama na a pachang ciy.

Tahematapakieca i vya chiy hluota ca a cawta dyi za hnyi cate, ata hing ca pungzaa te a hluv hringhruo. I tuehriepa bangkhuo taata Abyipata thluechiy aca pi. Cuorasala ata hing ca i ingchungkhue i mangchiy a hu ra va tli ma?” a ta.
Laban ta, “Khaapama ica pi aa?” a ta. Jakob ta, “Khaapahmuo na pi'a vaciy; i ripa hing na tue kieca, na sahring kha a la pi'a angte ica kingpa pakhaa aa:

Ataning hingta na sahring hraw luo hing vaa khie'a angte, a pecipa, a cikarypa hne a vawpa tuv hne tuvtaata bangkhuo cuose, a pecipa hne a cikarypa mie bangkhuo kha a hrang ta pache'a angte, capa ca i re hrie muo ta a cuo aa,” a ta.

Ningthlaahezuo thue a vaw'a cate i hrie muo hing na vya mang tiyta i dangnapa hingta kama cuota bie a ri aa. A pecipa hne a cikarypa a cuo lipa mie hne a vawpa a cuo lipa tuv kha kama'a lie na hmung kieca aparuvpa na a cuo ta pata rue tie,” a ta.
Laban ta, “A pha, na ripa haa cata cuo se,” a ta.

Cuorasala capa ning cata Laban ta mietungpa a pecipa hne a cikarypa bangkhuo, miepuvnung a pecipa hne a cikarypa bangkhuo, a peruopa bangkhuo, hne tuv a vawpa bangkhuo kha pache diy te a sacapaa zaw kha a pakhie sa yi.
Jakob hne ning thung luosi aa hlanapa luo kha a va chi yi. Jakob ca aa ngaapa Laban sahring ca a king.
Cakhutaata Jakob ca poplar kung, almond kung hne ahre kung a hringpa nge kha la te, a haw kha khaw buo te aa capepa ta a tue.
Thingnge cikarypa tie ca sahring tiydangnapa hraky zaw athaalie, sahring zaw hmiekunglie kha caby te a chi. Sahring ca tiydangna luo amaa vaw ning kha sapaa ama kie the nakawta a cuo.
Thingnge cikarypa hmielieta sapaa a kie nakawta a taata a pachuo tiyta a pecipa, a cikarypa hne a peruopa kha ama pachuo.
Jakob ta tuv zaw kha a hrang ta che te, Laban sahring a pecipa, a vaw diypa sahring tie'a luo kha pahyi te a chi. Ama sahring phuv kha a nanang ta chi te Laban sahring phuv hne khata chi pakhaw vyi.
A thaaruv viepa sahring tie sapaa a kie tiyta, thingnge cikarypa tie hrawlie sapaa a kie riypata Jakob ta thingnge kha sahring tiy dangnapa hraky athaalie, sahring zaw hmiekunglie kha a chi.
Cuorasala a thaa dyapa sahring zaw cuota ca thingnge kha chi vyi. Caacuonakawta a thaa dyapa tie ca Laban huopa ta cuo te, a thaaruvpa tie ca Jakob huopa ta ama cuo.
Cahaacata Jakob ca a hnyirungsale paluo. Tuv hne mie a hluvsa, siicapaa hne siicanung, kala-uv hne laa zaw kha a hluvsa a hnyi.
Laban sacapaa zaw ta, “Jakob na ma paa hnyipa bangkhuo a la diy tli. A hnyirungna bangkhuo ca ma paa hnyipa taata a hmungpa tana a cuo,” ama tapa kha Jakob ta a thyi.
Cakhutaata Laban ta hmiephaa a za pi tawpa haata a pi li tlipa kha a hmung.
Ca tiyta Abyipata Jakob kha, “Na mingchingmingvuo tie ruo luo, na tieriy zaw'a luo kha kaa tie, kama ta ica awpuo aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Jakob ta Rachel hne Leah kha sahring a khienapa ruo luo kha ama a vya taw riypata a paku sa yi.
Cakhutaata iema kyihuo khata, “Nama paa hing a hluo haata na tlechuo va tli tapa kha i pachang. Cuorasala i paa Khazing ta ca ina awpuo.
I thaazuo a awpa bangkhuo ta nama paa re i hriepa kha nama pachang;
cadyiseca nama paa ta na dung te i hrie muo yi hraa ina thle tli. Cuorasala kama riethyi pi riypa kha Khazing ta pase vyi.
Ama ta a pecipa hingna na hrie muo ta a cuo aa a ta kieca sahring bangkhuo ta a pecipa ama pachuo; a cikarypa na na hrie muo ta a cuo aa a ta kie sahring bangkhuo ta a cikarypa ama pachuo.
Khazing ta na paa sahring kha la te kama ina pi.
Sahring sapaa a kie thlaa ning kha muo sa angte a puvnung sapaa a lepa mietungpa bangkhuo ca a cikarypa, a pecipa hne a peruopa selaw ta ama cuo.
I muo lie ca ta Khazing avuoming ta, ‘Jakob,’ na ta te kama ta, ‘Hingpa lie hingna i aw,’ i ta.
Ama ta, ‘Mang tie, mietungpa sapaa a kiepa bangkhuo ca a cikarypa, a pecipa hne a peruopa selaw tana ama cuo; tahematapakieca Laban ta na cunglie a tuepa hmang khana i hmung.
Lungbang kha sathu bya cate kama'a luo bie naa kuonapa Bethel Khazing kha tana i cuo. Ata hingta hingpa ruo hing pyase la na puvna ruo luo kha si tie,’ ina ta,” a ta yi.
Rachel hne Leah ta, “Ma paa ing lie kiema cuvu hne ru a ngaapa suokha chuo a aw ma?
Ruohrang ming haa tana malie a hmung cuo va ma? Malie zaa te ma muo a hmungpa tuokaa bangkhuo ca a hmuo diy tli.
Khazing ta ma paa'a taata a lapa suethiy bangkhuo ca kiema hne ma saata zaw huopa tana a cuo. Khazing ta aca changpa haa khata tue tie,” a ma ta.
Caacuonakawta Jakob ca thu te, a saata zaw hne a napuv zaw kha kala-uv cung luo a khang yi.
A sahring bangkhuo kha hmieluo ta pasi sa lu te, Paddan-aram lie a hmungpa sahring bangkhuo hne, a hnyipa suethiy bangkhuo hne khata Kanaan ruo lie a awpa a paa'a luo kha a si.
Laban ca tuv hming ngu riypata a si chung khata Rachel ta a paa chungkhue khazing kuvtuezuv tie kha a paruv.
Jakob ta Aramean pa Laban ca dung te, a ruo riypata aa tingpa kha chang vyi.
Cahaacata a hnyipa bangkhuo hne khata a ruo te, Eufrates cavaa kha va te te Gilead tluocung ruo luo kha a si.
A ning thungnapa ta Jakob aa ruopa kaw kha Laban ca ama chang.
Caacuonakawta a phang kha cawsaa kha ku yi te Jakob kha ning sariy chung amaa cade khutaata Gilead tluocung ruo lie kha ama pha.
Cuorasala Aramean pa Laban'a luo kha zuo a muo ta Khazing a luo te, “Jakob'a lie kha biepha a cuo zaw biechie a cuo zaw kaa kha hmuo na ri li riypata a raaring tie,” a ta.
Laban ta Jakob ca ava pha. Jakob ca tluocung lie kha thluodaa za sa tli te, Laban hne a phang kha cawsaa zaw ca Gilead tluocung ruo lie ca amaa ri ra.
Laban ta Jakob kha, “Khaapama na tue? Na dung cate, hruocawsaa haata i sacanung zaw kha naa ruokhyi yi.
Khaapanakawma na chang lipa cata na dung cate a paruv ta naa ruo? Palungtluosa pata hlaa hne akhang hne tingtuo hneta ica pathlie'apa puv?
Khaapanakawma i tuvsaa hne i sacanung zaw kha pahnuo pata muopha mya ung ta riypa hmuo cuo ina pi vaciy? Na hmang tuepa hing na ngaa suesaa de!
Nama hing riethyi ica pi khu thluo; cuorasala na paa Khazing ta azuohnie kha bie na chang te, ‘Jakob cunglie kha biechie a cuo zaw biephaa a cuo zaw khaapahmuo ri khya,’ ina ta.
Na paa ing kha vuo laalaw tli cate na si riypata a cuo zaw, khaapanakawma i khazing tie kha na paruv?” a ta.
Jakob ta Laban ca palie te, “Na sacanung zaw kha hruohra ta na chuv'a kie ciy ta pata i rue nakaw tana a cuo.

Cuorasala ahung cunglie hmuo cuose na khazing tie kha na hmung kieca capa cawsaa ca thie pata cuo se. Kama'a lie na huopa na hmungpa a aw kieca na phang kha cawsaa zaw hmiekunglie hing na kuvdaw ta daw la a la tie,” a ta. Rachel ta khazing tie a paruvpa kha Jakob ta pachang vyi.

Caacuonakawta Laban ca Jakob thluodaa chung luo hne Leah thluodaa chung luo hne ama siicanung pahning zaw thluodaa chung luo kha a ngie te a khazing zaw kha hmung vyi. Leah thluodaa taata kya pya te Rachel thluodaa luo kha aa ngie.
Rachel ta ingchungkhue khazing zaw ca kala-uv kedie chunglie kha pasuo te aa tusue. Laban ta thluodaa chung bangkhuo kha a huv diy, cuorasala hmung vyi.

Rachel ta a paa ca, “Canung phungpa aa vaw nakawta na hmiekunglie i daa khu lipa hing i byipaapa na hi haa thi khah se,” a ta. Cahaacata Laban ta a huv raalaa ca ingchungkhue khazing tie kha hmung vyi.
Jakob ca a hi haa te Laban kha, “Khaapa suena tue angte ma khaapa pha lina i tue nakawta inaa cade ciy?

I chechiy bangkhuo catla diy cate na huv mangtli; na huopa suokha chuo na hmung ma? Na phang kha cawsaa hne i phang kha cawsaa zaw hmiekunglie hing vya pazya tie. Maa lalalie hing biechina malie tuepa naase yi.
Kung kiy chung bangkhuo nama'a lie aw angte, na tuvpuvnung hne na miepuvnung zaw saasa hruv buo va yi; na tuvrung chungtaata tuvtungpa zaw ce buo va ang.
Saa ta a siepa sakha hmuo nama'a luo vya chiykhyi va ang, kamata tana ica thung. Ningchung ta ama paruvpa cuose, zuo ta ama paruvpa cuose, inaa pathung sa ciy.
Ningchung ta ning lingpa kha i ang, zuo ta thlasiy kha ang angte mingkuv zaw kha i hruv taw.
Kung kiy chung bangkhuo na ing lie za aw angte, na sacanung zaw pahning cuota kung hraa hlyipaliy, na sahring zaw cuota kung caruv na re hrie angte, cadyiseca i hrie muo kha yi hraa ina thle ciy.

I paa Khazing, Abraham Khazing, Isak ta a za ciyzaapa Khazing na naa awpuo va tapa cuo sala, i kuv cahripa tana ina pasi sa'a ciy. Khazing ta ruvnaana i angpa hne i re hriepa kha hmung te azuohnie aca chuo tli kha,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Laban ta Jakob kha palie te, “Sacanung zaw hing kama sacanung zaw ta ama cuo, haatiy zaw hing kama haatiy ta ama cuo, sahring zaw hing kama sahring ta cuo yi te, na hmungpa bangkhuo hing kama huopa tana ama cuo. Cuorasala ataning hing hingpa i sacanung zaw hne ama sapa i haatiy zaw kawlie hing khaapama i tue khupa a aw?
A vaw la, nama hne kama alalalieta pachangkhyituv a cuo riypata biekuona tue'a puv.
Caacuonakawta Jakob ta alung suokha kha la te lungbang ta a bang.
A phang kha cawsaa zaw kha, “Alung vya pahmya tie ung,” a tapa haa yi ta vya papung yi te capa lungpapung cunglie ca sa ama ning.
Laban ta capa ca Jegar-sahadutha ta pata ming sa te, cuorasala Jakob ta Galeed ta pata ming a sa.
Laban ta, “Hingpa lungpapung hing nama hne kama alalalieta pachangkhyituv tana a cuo,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Galeed a ta.
Laban ngiethie ca ta Mizpah ta pata ming sa pakhaa te, “A nanang ta ma aw chung bangkhuo nama hne kama alalalie hing Abyipaaw mang sue.

I sacanung zaw hing tuechie yi cate, iema thing taa hingta napuv hrang na chiy pata a cuo kieca, ahunghmuo pachangkhyituv ama aw li zaw ta, nama hne kama alalalieta Khazing na pachangkhyituv a cuo tapa kha maw khya,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Laban ta Jakob kha, “Kama hne nama alalalie i chipa hingpa lungpapung hne lungbang hing mang tie.

Kama ta hingpa lungpapung hing vya law pata nama kha ruvnaana ica pi li riypa hne, nama zaw hingpa lungpapung hing vya law pata kama kha ruvnaana ina pi li riypa cata hingpa lungpapung hne lungbang hing tehte tana a cuo.
Abraham Khazing hne Nahor Khazing, iema paa Khazing ta nama hne kama alalalieta bie malie chipa mang sue,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Jakob ca a paa ta a zaa biepa Khazing'a lie biekuona a tue.
Jakob ta tluocung lie kha hriykhungrina pihluo te a phang kha cawsaa zaw kha sa ning riypata a ku yi. Sa kha ning yi te tluocung ruo lie ca amaa ri.
Laban ca mawluo mawdiy ta thu te, a samingta zaw hne a sacanung zaw kha pahnuo yi te thluechiy a pi khutaa yi ta a thu te ing luo kha a kaa.
Jakob ca a sile nguoluo ning kha Khazing avuoming ta amaa taw.
Jakob ta a hmung tiy yi ta “Khazing riekaphuv na a cuo yi!” ta te capa hmang ca Mahanaim ta pata ming a sa.
Jakob ta Edom ruo Seir ama tapa hmang lieta a awpa a uvta Esau'a luo kha biephyatuv a pathlie yi.
Bie a taapa yi ca, “I byipaapa Esau kha hing haa hingta nama chang aa: Na changtaapa Jakob na, ‘Laban'a lie kha khychepa haata ata te hing i aw tli;
cue, laa, tuv hne mie, siicanung siicapaa zaw kha i hnyi. I byipaapa nama hmiekunglie hmiephaa hmung riypa tana i vya pathlie yi, ta pata va chang tie ung,” a ta yi.
Biephyatuv tie ca Jakob'a luo kha vya kaa yi te, “Na uvta Esau'a luo kha ma va chiy mangtli. Nama a taw riypa tana a rieka za paliy hneta a vya sile nguoluo,” ama ta.
Jakob ca khuopuv ta kya ciy te a palung rie a thyisa. Caacuonakawta ama'a lie a awpa cawsaa, tuv hne mie, kha che yi te, cue hne kala-uv zaw kha phuv hning ta a che yi.
“Esau ta phuv kha hing hmung te a para zaw ta, phuv kha chuo hing ca amaa ruo hmuo aa,” ta pata a rue nakawta a cuo.
Cakhutaata Jakob ta, “Vya i paa Abraham Khazing hne i paa Isak Khazing, Vya Abyipa, nama ta, ‘Na ruo luo hne na tieriy'a luo kha kaa la na cunglie a phapa na i patlung sa aa,’ ina ta ciy.

Na changtaapa ina pahmung sapa ciy aa hmangpa na duena hne zang tluo naa tlanapa a caw cepa hmuota hmung tluo a tla va ang. Tahematapakieca hingpa Jordan cavaa hing i khuecahryi suokha hne kyalya ta te angte, ata hing ca phuv hning hneta i cuo tli.
I uvta Esau kuv chung taa hingta na khuo thi tie, tahematapakieca haatiy hne ama nung zaw hne ma yalya hingta malie vya thie diy lie tapa na i ciy.
Nama ta, na cuota a phapa i patlung sa aa, na samingsahlaa ca riyliy viehnang zaa pa ta sa'a yi angte, ahungtahmuo ri diy khu'a va yi,” ina ta ciy, a ta.
Capa lie ca zuo kha a ri te, a hnyipa chungtaata a uvta Esau kha lasaw pi riypata,
miepuvnung zahning hne mietungpa sakiy, tuvpuvnung zahning hne tuvtungpa sakiy,
aa hnung sue nguoluopa kala-uv sawthung hne a taata zaw, cuepuvnung sawliy hne cuetungpa sahraa, laapuvnung sakiy hne laatungpa sahraa kha aa tlaw.

Capa bangkhuo ca a phuv nanang ta a changtaapa zaw kuv luo kha pi yi te, a phuv nanang tana nama sikhyi aa, a ta yi. “I hmiekung luo hingta si ung la phuv kha hne phuv kha aa hlapuo pata nama sile aa,” a ta yi.
Luohmaa a sapa kha, “I uvta Esau ta caa taw te, ‘Ahung cawsaa tama na cuo? Khaapa luo ma nama si aa? Na kya tanglepa sahring zaw hing ahung huopa tama a cuo?’ ta pata aca hiehriy kie yi ca,
‘Na changtaapa Jakob huopa tana a cuo; i byipaapa Esau nama cuota lasaw ta aca paphyapa tana a cuo; ca hlyitaw taata ama zaw kiema hnangtalie hingna a vya sile,” nama ta aa, a ta yi.
Ama ta phuvhningnapa hne phuvthungnapa hne phuv hrangpa bangkhuo zaw kha cahaacata bie taa yi te, “Esau namaa taw tiyta aa lusa pata ri'a ung cate,

‘Ca hlyitaw taata na changtaapa Jakob zaw ma hnangtalie hingna a vya sile', nama ta aa,” a ta yi. Tahematapakieca ama ta, “I hmiekunglie a silepa lasaw hingta paakie'a angte, kama hing na cuhluo'a te hmiephaa i hmung thlu aa,” ta pata a rue.
Caacuonakawta lasaw kha a hmiekung luota pasilu te, ama ca arina hmang lie kha capa zuo ca aa ri.
Capa zuo cata Jakob ca thu te a napuvnung pahning, a siicanung pahning, hne a saata zaw pahraa hlyikha hne khata Jabbok cavaa kha tiyhaa lieta ama va te.
Iema bangkhuo hne a hnyipa mekaa kha cavaa huesuo luo kha a paphya diy yi.
Jakob ca ama selaw ta a ngaa siy te cawsaa pakha ta khydyina te ta aa pie.
Cawsaapa ta te khu va tli ang tapa kha a pachang tiyta, a liyky ruv kha phaw te amaa piepa cata Jakob ca a liyky ruv ca a phie te aa suvhlyi.
Cawsaapa ca ta, “Khy na a dyi tli, cakuo'a ang,” a ta. Cuorasala Jakob ta, “Thluechiy ina pi hluo li ciy ca pathlie'a va ang,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta cawsaapa ca ta, “Na ming ahung ma?” a ta ca, “Jakob,” a ta.
Cawsaapa ca ta, “Nama ca Jakob ta pata kupa cuo'a va tli ciy, Israel tapa tana kupa na cuo'a tli, tahematapakieca nama ca Khazing hne cuose, cawsaa hne cuose a pie cate na te tli yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata Jakob ta, “Na ming na chang thi tie,” ta pata a hiehriy. Cuorasala ama ta, “Khaapanakawma i ming ina hiehriy ciy?” ta te, capa lie ca thluechiy a pi.
“Khazing kha a hmiepachaw pata i hmung pata i hring kalie,” ta te, Jakob ta capa hmang ca Peniel ta pata ming a sa.
Peniel a va lawpa khata ning a kya chiy, a laky ruv nakaw khata a cabie.
Caacuonakawta ataning tepa hingta Israel ming ta a liyky saa kha ce li pata ama aw, tahematapakieca cawsaapa ta Jakob a za phawpa kha a liyky saa lie kha tana a cuo.
Jakob ta a va suo ca, cawsaa zapaliy hneta Esau a vya silepa kha a va hmung. Caacuonakawta haatiy zaw kha che yi te Leah hne Rachel hne a siicanung pahning tie kha a re yi.
A siicanung zaw kha ama saata zaw hneta hmieluo ta a chi yi; Leah hne a saata zaw kha a paziy pata chi yi te, Rachel hne Josef kha hnangluo a pachuo yi.
Ama ca hmaaluo kha sa te, a uvta'a luo a chiy caw khata alyi luo yi sariy aa bung.
Cuorasala Esau ca ama a taw riypa khata a vya ruo te, cakuv te a pahnuo. Ama pahning ta ama caa.

Esau ta hmiehmie a pase ca canung zaw hne ama saata zaw kha a hmung tiy yi ta, “Nama hne a vya si rapa tie hing ahung zaw tama ama cuo?,” a ta. Jakob ta, “Khazing ta na changtaapa ina pipa yi haatiy zaw tana ama cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata a siicanung zaw hne ama saata zaw kha a vaw yi te amaa vya bung;
cahaacata Leah hne a saata zaw kha a vaw yi te amaa vya bung, a hnangcaw ce ta Rachel hne Josef kha a vaw yi te amaa vya bung.
“Phuv hrangpa i tawpa tie kha haw khaapa na khingnapa tama a cuo?” a ta. Jakob ta, “I byipaapa hmiephaa ica hmungna riypa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cuorasala Esau ta, “I nuta, aa depa ta i hnyi, na hnyipa kha nama huota a chi tie,” a ta.

Jakob ta, “Cuo vyi, na hmiephaa na i hmung ta pata a cuo kieca, ngiechina ta i kuv taata lasaw hing cuhluo thi tie; hing haa hingta hmiephaa na pi cate, na hmie i hmungpa hing Khazing hmie hmungpa haa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Nama'a luo i vya phyapa lasaw ca cuhluo thi tie, tahematapakieca Khazing ta na duesa te i khingpa palang i hnyi diy,” a ta. A hripuo byalya nakawta Esau ta aa la.
Cakhutaa cata, Esau ta, “Si'a ung puv, Kama hmie ca sapa'a yi ang,” a ta.

Cuorasala Jakob ta, “Haatiy zaw hing panusa kalie yi te, tuv hne mie hne cue zaw hing a taata cangpa se ta ama cuo nakawta mangchiy byalya amaa hu, ning kha chunglie khuo tuv ta ma tang kie yi ca sahring zaw hing ama thiy diy aa, tapa kha i byipaapa ta na pachang.

I byipaapa ta na changtaapa hmieluo hingta na sise tie. I hmiekunglie a awpa sahring zaw hne haatiy zaw hne hingta i byipaapa na awnapa Seir luo ma vya chiy hluo li, ama si khu thiyta tah i vya sikhyi'a yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Esau ta, “I cawsaa chekha hing ca thupase siy'a yi ang,” a ta. Cuorasala Jakob ta, “A hu thi'a vyi, i byipaapa na hmiephaa i hmungpa hingta aa de,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Esau ca capa ningpa cata Seir luo kha a kaa.
Cuorasala Jakob ca Sukkoth luo kha si te ama cuota ing, hne a sahring cuota thluodaa zaw kha a sa. Caacuonakawta capa hmang ca Sukkoth ta pata kupa a cuo.
Jakob ca Paddan-aram taata a vya sinapa luopuv Kanaan ruo chunglie a awpa Shekhem khypuv luo kha aa bangsa pata a chiy. Khypuv hmielie kha thluodaa ca aa sa.
Shekhem ming Hamor sacapaa zaw'a lieta tuokaa zakha ta a calyipa alyi baata lie kha thluodaa ca a sa.
Capa lie ca bienatluophie suokha sa te, El-Elohe-Israel ta pata ming a sa.
Jakob hne Leah sacanung Dinah ca capa ruo ming canung tie kha a parie yi.
Capa ruo lie uvtuv ta a cuopa Hiv ming Hamor sacapaa Shekhem ta a hmung ca patuv te hruohra ta aa ziehne.
A pathiypalung kha Dinah cunglie dyi ca aw te a khingsa nakawta, Dinah kha bie nesapa ta a chaw.
Caacuonakawta Shekhem ta a paa kyihuo khata, “Hingpa nung hing i napuv riypata na hiepa tie,” a ta.
Jakob ta Shekhem na a sacanung a papya a palyi tapa kha a thyi; cuorasala a sacapaa zaw kha ruo lie cue ama khie nakawta iema ama vya chiy hluo li ca a dieta tah a aw.
Shekhem paa Hamor ta Jakob'a luo kha bie a rue riypata a vaa cuo ning kha,

Jakob sacapaa zaw ca ruo taata ama vya chiy. Capa thuo ca ama thyi tiyta, ama hi a haa hringhruo, tahematapakieca Jakob sacanung kha hruohra ta a ziehne te Israel ming cunglie tue byi lipa, esenutaana hmang a tue nakawta a cuo.
Cuorasala Hamor ta iema kyihuo khata, “I sacapaa Shekhem pathiypalung ca nama sacanung'a lie dyina a aw tli; napuv riypata pi thi tie ung,” a ta.
Kiema hne a chiyhie tie ung; nama sacanung zaw kha malie pi ung la, ma sacanung zaw kha a la tie ung.
Kiema'a lie hing khysa ra ung la; nama khingnapa lie hing aw ung la, sung pali ung la, hnyirung tie ung.
Shekhem zaw khata Dinah paa hne a caapaapa tie kha, “Hmiephaa na pi thi tie ung, ina hupa bangkhuo ung ca kha ica pi'a yi,” a ta.
Ina hupa ung ciy sue hne lasaw bangkhuo, khazaa a cuo zaw ica pi'a yi; lesaanung dyi hing i napuv riypata na pi tie ung,” a ta yi.
Jakob sacapaa zaw khata Shekhem hne a paa Hamor kha dung yi te bie ama palie, tahematapakieca ama ta ama sietanung Dinah kha a papya a palyi tli nakawta a cuo.
Iema ta, “Capa hmang ca tue khu'a vapuv, vangdaw a te lipa paa'a luo ma sietanung pipa ca ima cuota nangzaa aa chiypa hmang tana a cuo.
Kiema haa hingta capaa bangkhuo vangdaw namaa te kie dyina ma naa a tla khu aa.
Cakhutaa cata ma sieta tie kha ca pi'a yi pate, kiema zaw nama sieta tie kha maa la'a yi, niema'a lie kha khysa'a pate mingphang phang kha ta ma cuo aa.
Cuorasala ma bie hing naathlie khing lipa ung cata vangdaw namaa te li kieca ma sacanung hing la'a pate ma si aa,” ama ta.
Ama bie ca ta Hamor hne Hamor sacapaa Shekhem palung kha a patluo sa.
Jakob sacanung kha a khingsa nakawta, cuo paru li pata ama ripa hmang kha a tue paluo. Ama ca ama chungkhue lieta ama pa-uvsathyi cepa pakha ta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Hamor hne a sacapaa Shekhem ca ama khypuv hukaa luo kha pya yi te ama khypuv capaa tie'a lie kha bie ama ri.

“Hingpa cawsaa tie hing kiema hne maa viesaa sa tli; ma ruo lie hing aw ra yi sala sung pali yi se, ma ruo hing iema aw khang riypata a ku sa kalie thluo; ama sacanung zaw hing chiyhie'a yi pate, ma sacanung zaw hing iema kha pi ra'a ung puv.
Iema vangdaw amaa tepa haata capaa bangkhuo vangdaw maa te kie kyalya dyina kiema hrawlie aw pata mingphang phang kha cuo riypa hing ama palung a tling aa.
Ama sahring bangkhuo hne ama suethiy bangkhuo hing kiema huopa cuo'a va ma? Capa suokhata ca ima naa tla sala kiema hrawlie hing aw ra yi se,” ama ta.
Hukaa luo a pyapa bangkhuo ca Hamor hne a sacapaa Shekhem bie kha ama naa tla te, capaa bangkhuo ca ama vangdaw amaa te diy.

A ning thungnapa lie, ama hmaa a pasa liyciy ta, Jakob sacapaa pahning, Simeon hne Levi, Dinah caapaapa tie khata ama zueziy kha a la yi te, khy chung luo kha ama pachang li chungta a ngie chiy yi te capaa bangkhuo kha ama thie diy.
Hamor hne a sacapaa Shekhem kha ama zueziy ta thie yi te, Dinah kha Shekhem ing chung taa khata la yi te ama si.
Ama sietanung ama papyapalyi nakaw khata Jakob sacapaa hrangpa tie zaw khata ama thieciepa tie'a luo kha vaa yi te, khy chung lie hmang bangkhuo kha ama la diy.
Ama tuv, ama mie, sahring bangkhuo, laa zaw hne ama khypuv chunglie hne lu chunglie a awpa bangkhuo kha ama la diy.
Ama hnyirungna bangkhuo, canung hne haatiy bangkhuo, ama ing lie a awpa bangkhuo kha amaa la diy.

Cakhutaata Jakob ta Simeon hne Levi kha, “Ruvnaana na ina phya ung ciy; hingpa ruo lie khy a sapa Kanaan ming hne Periz ming hue riypata ina tue tli ung ciy. Mingluv ca ta ma cawsa, a pakiy yi sala ina vya tuv kie yi ca, kama hne i ingchungkhue ca ina para diy'a yi,” a ta yi.
Cuorasala iema ta, “Ma sietanung kha siyhrawnung haata ama tue riypata a cuo ma?” ama ta.
Khazing ta Jakob kha, “Thu la, Bethel luo kha khaw la khy kya sa tie. Na uvta Esau'a taata naa ruo ningta nama'a lie a luopa Khazing cuo khata capa lie ca bienatluophie kha sa tie,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Jakob ta a ingchungkhue tie hne ama'a lie a awpa bangkhuo kha, “Niema hrawlie a awpa ruohrang khazing kha thaw ung la, a pathe diy ung la nama caw kha a thle tie ung;

cakhutaa cata a vaw ung la Bethel luo kha khaw'a ung puv, i palung rie thyi ningta na palie te, i cakuona bangkhuo lie naa awpuopa Khazing cuo khata capa hmang lie ca bienatluophie kha i sa aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta iema ta ruohrang khazing ama hnyipa bangkhuo hne ama naa lie haalaw bangkhuo kha Jakob ca pi yi te, Jakob ta Shekhem khy kie lie a awpa mathliy kung rawlie kha a paby.
Iema ca khytlaw amaa thu tiyta, khypuv hne a cahriy a cake lie a awpa bangkhuo tie cunglie kha Khazing'a taata ciyna a tlung nakawta ahungtahmuo iema kha a cade nguo va yi.
Jakob ca ama hne ama'a lie a awpa a cawsaa zaw bangkhuo hne khata Kanaan ruo lie a awpa Luz (Bethel ama tapa) luo kha pha te,

capa lie ca bienatluophie kha sa te capa hmang ca El-bethel ta pata ming a sa. Tahematapakieca a uvta'a taata a zaa ruo ning kha Khazing ama hrahring ta khapa hmang lie kha ama'a lie a zaa luo nakawta a cuo.
Cakhutaa cata Rebekah a mangchiytuv Deborah kha thiy te Bethel khy raw mathliy kung rawlie kha a ama paby. Caacuonakawta capa thingkung ca, “Caanapa Mathliy kung,” ta pata ming ama sa.
Jakob ca Paddan-aram taata a vya kaa ning kha Khazing ta ama'a lie kha a luo pakhaa te thluechiy a pi.
Khazing ta, “Na ming hing Jakob ta a cuo; ata taa hingta Jakob ta pata kupa cuo'a va tli ciy, cuorasala Israel hingna na ming ta a cuo'a tli,” a ta. Caacuonakawta ama ca Israel ta pata ama ku.

Khazing ta, “Kama ca Lesyice Khazing tana i cuo: saata a hluvsa sa ung la pungzaa tie ung; mingphang phang kha hne mingphang hluvpuv phuv zaw kha nama'a taa hingta puv'a yi te nama chung taa hingta siepahruo zaw ama cuo aa.
Abraham hne Isak i pipa yi ruo hing nama ca pi'a angte, hingpa ruo hing na hnangluo ta a awpa na samingsahlaa zaw kha i pi'a yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata Khazing ta Jakob ca bie a rihnenapa hmang lie kha thuse te vuoruo luo a kie.
Jakob ta Khazing hne bie ama rihnenapa hmang lie kha lungbang suokha bang te, dangpa ta panaana ta a pihluopa mingsuvtiy hne olifthu kha a bya.
Caacuonakawta Khazing ta bie a rihnenapa hmang kha Jakob ta Bethel ta pata ming a sa.
Cakhutaata Bethel taa khata a thu yi te Efrath khy taata a hlapuona lie kha Rachel ca nu puv riypata cuo te a riy khuosa ta a pasa.
A rie a thyisa ning kha, nu pa-awtuvnung khata, “Ciy khah, sacapaa na na sa aa,” a ta.
Rachel ta a thiy'a nang caw khata Ben-oni ta pata ming a paphya siy; cuorasala a paa ta Benjamin a ta.
Rachel ca thiy te Efrath (Bethlehem ama tapa) luo sinapa luopuv lie kha ama paby.
Jakob ta a thluo cunglie kha lungbang bang te, capa “Rachel thluolung” ca ataning tepa hingta capa lie ca a aw kalie.
Israel ca a khytlaw kha pazue te Eder ing a suopuv va lawpa khata thluodaa kha a sa.
Israel capa ruo lie a aw ning cata, Reuben na a paa nungthangnung Bilhah a ziehne tapa kha Israel ta a thyi. Jakob sacapaa zaw ca pahraa hlyihning ama ta.
Leah sacapaa zaw: Reuben (Jakob sacapaa uvthyi ce), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issakhar, hne Zebulun ta ama cuo.
Rachel sacapaa zaw: Josef hne Benjamin ta ama cuo.
Rachel siicanung Bilhah sacapaa zaw: Dan hne Naftali ta ama cuo.
Leah siicanung Zilpah sacapaa zaw: Gad hne Asher ta ama cuo. Hingpa zaw hing Paddan-aram lie a puvpa Jakob sacapaa zaw ta ama cuo.
Jakob ca Abraham hne Isak khyche cuo pata ama za awnapa Mamre khy lie a paa Isak luo kha a pha (Mamre ca Kiriath-arba acuolikie Hebron ta pata zaw kupa a cuo).
Isak ca kung zakha sawcari a ta tli.
Ama ca a macuosa pata hne a kungtluvsa tli pata thiy te a cawsaa zaw'a luo kha pahlaw pata a cuo; a sacapaa Esau hne Jakob ta ama paby.
Esau (Edom ama tapa) ciypathla zaw ca hingpa zaw hing tana ama cuo.
Esau ca Kanaan zaanung zaw kha napuv ta a chiy yi. Hit ming Elon sacanung Adah, Hiv ming Zibeon sacapaa Anah sacanung Oholibamah,
hne Ishmael sacanung Nebaioth sietanung Basemath zaw ta ama cuo.
Adah ta Elifaz kha a sa; Basemath ta Reuel kha a sa;
Oholibamah ta Jeush, Jalam, hne Korah kha a sa yi. Hingpa tie hing Esau ta Kanaan ruo lie a sapa sacapaa zaw ta ama cuo.

Cakhutaata Esau ta a napuv zaw, a sacapaa zaw, a sacanung zaw hne a ingchungkhue cawsaa zaw, a cue hne a sahring bangkhuo, Kanaan ruo chunglie a hnyipa chechiy bangkhuo kha la te a nuta Jakob'a taata a cawta aa hlanapa hmang luo kha aa palaw.
Tahematapakieca ama hnyipa kha a hluv tuv nakawta awhne the aw va tli; ama sahring zaw kha a hluv tuv tli nakawta ama awnapa ruo lie kha a tlaw va tli yi.
Caacuonakawta Esau ca tluocung ruo ta a cuopa Seir lie kha khy a sa. Esau ca Edom ta a cuo.
Seir tluocung ruo lieta Edom ming a pathlatuv Esau ciypathla zaw ca hingpa zaw hing tana ama cuo.
Esau sacapaa zaw ming ca hingpa zaw hing tana ama cuo: Esau napuvnung Adah sacapaa Elifaz, Esau napuvnung Basemath sacapaa Reuel zaw ta ama cuo.
Elifaz sacapaa zaw ca Teman, Omar, Zefo, Gatam, hne Kenaz zaw ta ama cuo.
(Timna ca Esau sacapaa Elifaz nungthangnung ta cuo te, ama ta Amalek a sa). Hingpa zaw hing Esau napuvnung Adah sacapaa zaw ta ama cuo.
Reuel sacapaa zaw ca hingpa zaw hing tana ama cuo: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, hne Mizzah. Esau napuvnung Basemath sacapaa zaw ca hingpa zaw hingta ama cuo.
Zibeon sacapaa Anah sacanung, Esau napuvnung Oholibamah sacapaa zaw ca hingpa zaw hingta ama cuo. Ama ta Esau kha Jeush, Jalam, hne Korah zaw kha a sapa yi.
Esau sacapaa zaw ciypathla tie ca hingpa zaw hing tana ama cuo. Esau sacapaa uvthyi Elifaz sacapaa zaw ca: Teman, Omar, Zefo, Kenaz,
Korah, Gatam, hne Amalek zaw ta cuo yi te Edom ruo lie Elifaz ciypathla zaw ta ama cuo.
Esau sacapaa Reuel sacapaa zaw ca: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, hne Mizzah zaw ta cuo yi te Edom ruo lie Reuel ciypathla zaw ta ama cuo.
Esau napuvnung Oholibamah sacapaa zaw ca: Jeush, Jalam, hne Korah zaw ta cuo yi te, Anah sacanung, Esau napuvnung Oholibamah ta a sapa tie ciypathlatuv zaw ta ama cuo.
Hingpa zaw hing Esau (Edom ama tapa) sacapaa zaw hne ama ciypathla zaw ta ama cuo.
Capa ruo lie a awpa Hor ming Seir sacapaa zaw ca: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
Dishon, Ezer, hne Dishan zaw ta ama cuo. Edom ruo lie a awpa Seir sacapaa zaw ta cuo yi te Hor mingphang ciypathlatuv zaw ta ama cuo.
Lotan sacapaa zaw ca Hori hne Heman ta cuo yi te Lotan sietanung ca Timna ta a cuo.
Shobal sacapaa zaw ca: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shefo, hne Onam zaw ta ama cuo.
Zibeon sacapaa zaw ca: Aiah hne Anah ta cuo yi te Anah ca a paa laa a khiepa ta ruocaapa lie acaa a hmungpa kha tana a cuo.
Anah saata zaw ca Dishon hne Oholibamah zaw ta ama cuo.
Dishon sacapaa zaw ca: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, hne Cheran zaw ta ama cuo.
Ezer sacapaa zaw ca: Bilhan, Zaavan, hne Akan ta ama cuo.
Dishan sacapaa zaw ca: Uz hne Aran ta ama cuo.
Hor mingphang ciypathlatuv zaw ca: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
Dishon, Ezer, hne Dishan zaw hingta ama cuo. Seir ruo lie a chung a chung ta Hor ming ciypathlatuv zaw ca hingpa tie hing tana ama cuo.
Israel ming cunglie ahunghmuo siepahruo ama cuo hluota Edom lie siepahruo zaa cuopa tie ca hingpa zaw hing tana ama cuo.
Beor sacapaa Bela ca Edom lieta siepahruo za cuo te a khypuv ca Dinhabah ta a cuo.
Bela a thiy khutaata Bozrah ming Zerah sacapaa Jobab ta a thle te siepahruo a cuo.
Jobab a thiy khutaata Teman ming ruo lie a awpa Husham ta a thle te siepahruo a cuo.
Husham a thiy khutaata Moab ruo lieta Midian ming zaa tetuv Bedad sacapaa Hadad ta a thle te siepahruo cuo te, a khypuv ming ca Avith ta a za cuo.
Hadad a thiy khutaata Masrekah ming Samlah ta a thle te siepahruo a cuo.
Samlah a thiy khutaata Zufrates cavaa kielie a awpa Rehoboth khypa Shaul ta a thle te siepahruo a cuo.
Shaul a thiy khutaata Akbor sacapaa Baal-hanan ta a thle te siepahruo a cuo.

Akbor sacapaa Baal-hanan a thiy khutaata Hadar ta a thle te siepahruo a cuo. A khypuv ming ca Pau ta cuo te, a napuvnung ming ca Mehetabel cuo te ama ca Me-zahab sacanung ta a cuo. Me-zahab ca Matred sacanung ta a cuo.
Hingpa tie hing ama phang hne ama awnapa khy aa ziy pata Esau ciypathla tie ama ming ta a cuo: Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
Magdiel, hne Iram zaw ta ama cuo. Ama awnapa hmang hne ama ruo aa ziy pata capepa Edom (Edom ming ama paa Esau) ciypathla zaw ca hingpa tie hing tana ama cuo.
Josef ca a paa a za awnapa Kanaan ruo lie kha khy a sa.

Jakob ingchungkhue ama chuobie ca hing haa hing tana a cuo. Josef ca kung hraa hlyisariy a tapa khata a paa napuvnung Bilhah hne Zilpah sacapaa zaw a cuopa a uvta zaw hne khata tuv hne mie kha khie taw yi te, a uvta zaw hmang pha lipa ama tuepa kaw kha a paa a chang taw.
Josef ca a macuo tlipa ta a sapa a cuo nakawta a saata hrangpa zaw laa khata a due vie. Caacuonakawta buohryi pasiypa a buo syipa kha a tuepa.
Cuorasala a uvnu hrangpa zaw ta a paa ta iema laata a due viepa kha ama hmung tiyta ama kha hue yi te biephaa ta chaw khing va yi.
Luo kha ca Josef ta muo suokha sa te a uvta zaw kha a chang yi ca ama hue hryly.
Ama ta, “Muo i sapa hing naathlie tie ung.
Lu chunglie sa-uv ma cataw nguoluo pata kama sa-uv kha sungkha ta aa dangta tah a kya daa te, niema sa-uv tie khata cadung yi te kama sa-uv kha amaa bie,” a ta.
A uvta zaw ta, “Nama ma ma cunglie siepahruo a cuo'a ciy? Nama ma malie a uv'a ciy?” ama ta. Caacuonakawta a muo hne a bie kawlie khata ama hue hryly.
Muo hrangpa suokha sa pakhaa te a uvta zaw kyihuo khata, “Muo hrangpa suokha sa pakhaa angte, capa i muo lie ca ning hne thlaapa hne aasiy suo hraa hlyikha ta inaa bie yi,” a ta.

Cuorasala capa a muo ca a paa hne a uvta zaw a chang tiy yi ta a paa ta chuo te, “Tuokhaapa muo ma na sa? Kama hne na nung hne na uvta zaw hing a vaw'a pate ma na hmiekunglie ca maa vya bung aa?” a ta.
Caacuonakawta a uvta zaw ta ama kha i-aw hnyi yi te, cuorasala a paa ta ca a palungruv lie a pari.
Josef uvta zaw ca ama paa sahring khie riypata Shekhem luo kha ama si.
Israel ta Josef kha, “Na uvta zaw ca Shekhem liena sahring ama khie cuo va ma? A vaw tie, iema'a luo na ica pathlie aa,” a ta. Josef ta, “Aw, i pachie tli,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta a paa ta, “Si la, na uvta zaw ama tluo ma, sahring zaw aa bangsusa pata ama aw ma tapa kha va mang tie, cakhutaata kama'a luo kha bie ina vya chang'a ciy,” a ta. Cahaacata a paa ta Josef ca Hebron bawphie luo kha a pathlie. Shekhem luo ca va chiy te,
ruo chunglie aa khie nguoluopa kha cawsaa pakha ta hmung te, “Khaapama na huv?,” a ta.
Ama ta, “I uvta zaw na i huv yi, khaapaliema sahring ama khie tapa kha na chang thi tie,” a ta.
Cawsaapa ca ta, “Hingpa hmang taa hingta ca ama pya tli, ‘Dothan luo si'a ung puv,’ amaa tapa ca i thyi,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Josef ca Dothan luo kha si te a uvta zaw ca a va hmung yi.
Luohlaa taata a vya silepa kha a uvta zaw ta va hmung yi te, iema'a luo a vya chiy hluo khata ama thie riypa kha khue ama khuo pacie.
Iema pakha hne pakha kha, “Muo a sapa paa aa vaw tli hue.
A vaw tie ung, ama kha thie'a ung pate khue chung luo thaw'a ung puv; saa na a sie ta'a ung pate a muo ca khaapama a vya lu tapa kha mang'a ung puv,” amaa ta.
Cuorasala Reuben ta a thyi tiyta, “A thie ca thie khah ung siy,” ta te, a hringna kha iema kuv chung taa cata a khuo.

Reuben ta iema kha, “Kuv pathlie pata thiyse ca palang khah ung, hingpa ruocaapa lieta khue chung luo hing thaw tie ung,” a ta yi. Cahaacata a tapa yi ca, Josef kha iema kuv chung taa khata khuo pata a paa'a luo paphya pakhaa naase ang tapa a khing nakaw tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Josef ca iema'a luo a vya chiy pahne khata a buohryi pasiypa a buo syipa kha hlepa yi te,
khuetlungpa chung luo ca ama thaw. Khuetlungpa ca a hripa ta cuo te, tiy aw vyi.

Cakhutaata sa ning riypata amaa tupa khata hmiehmie ama pase ca, Gilead taata a vya silepa khy a tlawpa Ishmael ming kha ama hmung. Ama kala-uv khata raabaa, thing cathliy rang pa-uepa, hne cariy zaw kha Izipt ruo luo ama phya.
Judah ta a uvnu zaw kha, “Ma nuta kha thie'a pate maa sie zawta khaapama a thlahne aa?
A vaw tie ung, Ishmael ming'a luo hing zaa'a ung puv, a cunglie ma kuv pathlie khah ung siy, ma nuta, ma thiysaa tana a cuo,” a ta. A uvnu zaw ca ama palung a tling.
Midian ming sungpalituv tie ama vya chiy tiyta, Josef ca khuetlungpa chung taa cata thue yi te, Ishmael ming'a luo ca ngu tuokaa phie kiy ta ama za. Iema ca ta Josef ca Izipt luo amaa chiyle.
Reuben ca khuetlungpa luo kha vaa te Josef kha a hmung li tiyta a caw kha thlaa te,
a uvnu zaw'a luo kha vaa te, “Satliepa kha aw va tli; tuokhaatama i tue aa?” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata mie sakha thie yi te Josef buohryi pasiypa kha mie thiy lie ca ama naw.
Josef buohryi pasiypa a buo syipa ca a paa'a luo kha cyile yi te, “Hingpa hingna ma hmung; mang tie, na sacapaa buohryi ta a cuo ma cuo va ma?” ama ta.
A paa ca ta pachang paluo te, “I sacapaa buohryi tana a cuo! Saa muo a sie ta; ama caphi patlaa diy hing haw!” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata Jakob ca a pang kha thlaa te, buri caw kha a se lie a paze te, ning pasiypuv chung caa te a sacapaa muochie kha a sa.

A sacapaa bangkhuo hne a sacanung bangkhuo ta hnaa panguo amaa zue raalaa pata, khing li pata, “Cuo vyi, a muochie i sa cang hing tana Sheol luo, i sacapaa'a luo ca i si aa,” a ta. Cahaacata a paa ca ngiechisa pata aa ngiy byalya.
Capa cuo lie ca Midian ming khata Josef ca Izipt ruo lie siepahruo ing a huopa tie a uvtuvpa riebyi Potifar'a luo kha ama va zaa.
Capa cuo ning ca Judah kha a uvnu zaw'a taa khata si te Adullam khy ming Hirah athaalie kha a za aw.
Judah ta Shua ama tapa Kanaan ming sacanung pakha kha hmung te aa hlaw.
Nu phya te, sacapaa kha sa te Er ta pata ming a paphya.
Nu phya pakhaa te sacapaa sa te Onan ta pata ming a paphya.
Sacapaa sa pakhaa te Shelah ta pata ming a sa. Shelah a sa ning kha Khezib lie a aw ningta a cuo.
Judah ta a sacapaa uvthyi Er cuo khata napuv chiy te a ming ca Tamar ta a cuo.
Cuorasala Judah sacapaa uvthyi Er ca Abyipahmiekunglie kha a zya a pha li nakawta Abyipata a thie.
Cakhutaa cata Judah ta Onan kha, “Na uvta napuvnung kha vaa ziehne la, aa vaapa nuta na cuonapa hrievu kha va patling sa la na uvta kha ciyhruo hnyi naase,” a ta.
Cuorasala Onan ta a sapa saata kha ama ciyhruo a cuo li riypa a pachang tiyta, a uvta cuota ciyhruo aw li riypata a uvta napuvnung hne amaa ziehne kyry ta a ciy kha ale luo a papya lawmaw.
A tuepa hmang kha Abyipaa palung a tluo li nakawta ama zaw kha a thie.

Cakhutaata Judah ta a munung Tamar kyihuo khata, “I sacapaa Shelah a kya lena te ta na paa ing lie kha va nunghlyi caw tie,” a ta. Tahematapakieca Shelah zaw kha a uvta zaw haata thiy ra'a kie tapa a ciy nakawta a cuo. Caacuonakawta Tamar ca a paa ing luo kha a va aw.
Cuo a vya ru vie tiyta Judah napuvnung, Shua sacanung kha a thiy. A muochie sana cuo a patlung khutaata a tuv hming a ngupa tie'a luo, Timnah luo kha Adullam khypa a viesaapa Hirah hne khata ama si.
“Naa vaapa a paa na a tuv hming ngu riypata Timnah luo a si,” ta pata Tamar kha ama chang tiyta,

a nunghlyi caw kha thlie te, a hmiepakhuv kha a khuv te, pang ta a pahlaw te, Timnah luo sinapa luopuv lie a awpa Enaim khy hukaa lie kha aa tu. Shelah kha a uvthyi tli raalaa pata ama pahlaw khing lipa kha a pachang.
Judah ta ama kha a hmung tiyta, a hmie aa pahruv nakaw khata siyhrawnung ta a ri.
Luo kielie ama'a luo kha vaa te, “A vaw la caa ziehne'a ang,” a ta. Tahematapakieca a munung a cuopa kha pachang vyi. Cawsaanung ca ta, “Inaa ziehne'a nakaw ca ta khaapama ina pi'a ciy,” a ta.
Ama ta i sahring zaw chungtaata mietaata sakha na ica vya paphya aa,” a ta. Cakhutaata cawsaanung ta, “Mietaata ina vya paphya hluo cata biekuona chechiy suokha na chi siy caw kiena a pha aa,” a ta.

Ama ta, “Khaapa biekuona chechiy ma i chi siy caw aa?” a ta. Cawsaanung ca ta, “Na caakhena hne a riy, hne na kuv lie naa hriepa khuecahryi,” a ta. Caacuonakawta pi te, a ziehne te cawsaanung ca nu a phya.
Cakhutaa cata cawsaanung ca thu te a cakuo, a hmiepakhuv kha hle te a nunghlyi caw kha aa tue.
Cawsaanung'a taata a chi siypa biekuona chechiy kha la pakhaa riypata a viesaapa Adullam khypa kha mietaata ca a va pa pi sa, cuorasala cawsaanung kha hmung khu vyi.
Khy ming kyihuo khata, “Enaim khy luopuv kielie a tupa siyhrawnung kha khaapaliema a aw? ta pata a hiehriy yi. Iema ta, “Capa hmang lie ca siyhrawnung aw buo vyi,” a ma ta.
Caacuonakawta Judah'a luo kha kaa te, “Cawsaanung kha hmung khu va ang; ca hlyitaw taata khy ming ta, “Hingpa lie hing siyhrawnung aw buo vyi, ina ta yi,” ta pata a chang.
Judah ta, “Chechiy zaw kha a la lavuo; cata a cuo li kieca cawsaa na malie a pahnyisue'a yi, mietaata paphya angte na hmung khu li taa ca,” a ta.
Thla thung khutaata Judah kha, “Na munung Tamar ca siyhrawle tena nu a phya,” ama ta. Cakhutaata Judah ta, “Ale luo kha papya ung la myi ta rue tie ung,” a ta.

Tamar ca ale luo ama pyakhyi tiyta, a vaapa a paa kha bie taa te, “Hingpa chechiy zaw a hnyituv hingna nu naa paphya; mang la, hingpa caakhena hne a riy, hne khuecahryi hing ahung huopa tama a cuo,” a pata sa yi.
Capa chechiy zaw ca Judah ta a pachang nakawta, “Ama ca kama laata aa dang vie, ama kha i sacapaa Shelah hneta i za pahlaw riypa tana a cuo raalaa,” a ta. Cakhutaata ca ama kha a ziehne va tli.
Nu puv tiy aa de tiyta a riy chunglie nuta ca mingphie ta a cuo.
A riy a pasapa khata nuta pakha ca a kuv suokha kha a za papya; nu a pa-awnung khata a kuv lie kha lariy sepa ta cakhiy te, “Ama hingna a zaa puv taa aa,” a ta.
Cuorasala a kuv a zaa da pahne pakhapa kha a za puv taa. Nu a pa-awnung ta, “Nama pali hing ma zaa puv taa ciy!” a ta. Caacuonakawta ama ca Perez ta pata ming ama sa.
Cakhutaa cata a nuta ca a kuv lie lariy sepa aa cakhiy pata za puv te, Zerah ta pata ming ama sa.
Josef ca Izipt ruo luo kha sikhyi yi te, Siepahruo ing a huotuv tie uvtuv, Faro riekabyi, Izipt ming Potifar ta capa hmang luo zaa sikhyipa Ishmael ming'a lie kha a calyi.
Abyipata Josef ca awpuo te, a tuepa bangkhuo lie tena a hmunglepa pakha ta a vya cuo. Ama ca Izipt ming a byipaapa ing lie kha a aw.
Abyipata awpuo te, a tuepa bangkhuo kha Abyipata tluo a patlingsa le tapa kha a byipaapa ta a hmung.
Caacuonakawta Josef kha hmiephaa pi te a ing hne a hnyipa bangkhuo mangchiytuv ta a chi.

A ing hne a hnyipa bangkhuo cunglie Josef kha mangchiytuv ta a chi ning taata Izipt cawsaapa ing ca Josef thue khata Abyipata thluechiy pi te, a ing, a lu hne a hnyipa bangkhuo cunglie kha Abyipathluechiy a tlung.
Caacuonakawta a hnyipa bangkhuo kha Josef kuv cunglieta chi diy te, a ningpa sa ta li pata ca khaapa kawlie hmuo a palung rie thyi vyi. Josef ca a pangruepa phasa te a puvthepa pakha ta a cuo.
Cuo kha khutaata a byipaapa napuvnung ta Josef kha tlechuo te, “Naa vya ziehne tie,” a ta.

Cuorasala bu te, a byipaapa napuvnung kyihuo khata, “Kama i aw nakawta ing chunglie a awpa khaapa kawlie hingta hmuo i byipaapa a palung rie thyi vyi, a hnyipa bangkhuo kha i kuv chunglieta a chi diy.

Hingpa ing chunglie hing ama tluv ta naw hnyi angte, a napuv nama ta li pata ca i cuota a pahya lipa aw vyi. Tuokhaatama hing tluv ta a lepa pha lina ca tue'a angte Khazing hmiekunglie i sue aa?” a ta.
Ning kha hnang ning kha ta a ripasa pari raalaa pata ama hne a ziehne riypa hne awhne riypa kha a palung tling buo vyi.
Cuorasala ning kha ca Josef kha re hrie riypata ing chung luo aa ngie pata, pakha hmuo ing chunglie ama aw li chung ta,
a buohryi ta vya patuv te, “Naa ziehne tie!” a ta. Cuorasala Josef ta a buohryi kha a kuv chunglie thuse te ale luo aa ruo.
A buohryi kha a kuv chunglie thuse te aa ruopa kha a hmung tiyta,
a ingchungkhue cawsaa tie kha ku yi te, “Mang tie ung, malie a ese riypata hingpa Hebrupa hing i navaapa ta a vya chiykhyi hing! Kama kha a ziekhyi riypata zaa ngie tena khuosa ta i khi.
I ue pachiy angte i khipa kha a thyi tiyta i thaalie a buohryi thuse te ale luo aa ruo,” a ta.
A byipaapa a vya chiyna te ta a buohryi kha aa thaalie a chi.
A ri ciepa haa khata, “Kiema'a luo na vya chiykhyipa sii, Hebrupa khana i thuo pachi riypata i khuo chung luo naa ngie chiy;
cuorasala khuosa ta i khi pahne ta a buohryi hing i thaalie chi siy te ale luo aa ruo,” a ta.
A byipaapa ca a napuvnung ta, “Na siipaapa na cahaacata naa tue,” ta pata a napuvnung a changpa bie kha a thyi ca a hi a haa suesaa.
Caacuonakawta a byipaapa ta Josef ca patuv sa yi te, siepahruo ta thaw a pathlapa tie a ma khungnapa lie kha thaw pathla te capa lie ca a aw.
Cuorasala Abyipata Josef kha awpuo te aa hmangpa a duena ta a due nakawta, thaw-ing uvtuv hmielie kha hmiephaa a pahmung sa.
Thaw-ing uvtuv ca ta thaw-ing lie a awpa thaw a tlapa bangkhuo kha Josef kuv cung luo kha pi te, thaw-ing lie khaapa hmang ama tue zawta Josef ta a patung a paphyi diy.
Josef ta a hriepa bangkhuo ca thaw-ing uvtuv ta mangpakhaa a hu va tli, tahematapakieca Abyipa ta awpuo te a tuepa hmang bangkhuo kha tluo a tling nakawta a cuo.
Capa khutaa cata a ru hluota mingsuvtiy pituv byi hne viechuo tuetuv byi tie ta ama byipaapa Izipt siepahruo kha a palung lu li pata ama aw.
Faro ca mingsuvtiy pituv byi hne viechuo tuetuv abyi tie cunglie kha a hi haa te,
Josef ama khungnapa thaw-ing, siepahruo ing a huotuv tie uvtuv riekabyi ing lie, thaw chunglie kha thaw a pathla yi.
Thaw-ing byipa ca ta Josef kha iema re a hriepatuv riypata chi te thaw chunglie kha cuo pasiypuv ama aw pakhaw.
Zuo kha ca Izipt siepahruo mingsuvtiy pituv byi hne viechuo tuetuv byi ca ama pahning ta siyluo a hnyipa muo ama sa kaluo.
Maw ta Josef kha iema'a luo aa vaw ca ama hmiephya a pha lipa kha a hmung yi.
Caacuonakawta a byipaapa ing thaw chunglie thaw a tlahnepa Faro abyi tie ca, “Khaapanakawma ataning hing nama hmiephya pha li pata nama aw?” a ta yi.
Iema ta, “Muo sa pate na a siyluo malie a paliepa riypa aw li pata ama aw,” ama ta. Josef ta, “Muo palie khuna ca Khazing huopa tana a cuo cuo va ma? Nama muo ca na chang tie ung,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta mingsuvtiy pituv byi ta Josef kha a muo ca a chang. “I muo lie ca i hmiekunglieta mingsuv kung suokha aw te,
a ce suothung a aw. A hnaa a kya pakiy pahne ta a paa kya paa te a thyi kha a hming.
Faro panuo kha i kuv lie aw te, mingsuv thyi kha la angte Faro panuo chunglie ca sue angte, panuo ca Faro kuv luo kha i pi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Josef ta, “A siyluo ca hing haa hing tana a cuo: a ce suothung ca ning thung tana a cuo;
ning thung chunglie Faro ta ca papya'a te na re kha aca pi pakhaa aa; mingsuv pituv byi na za hrie ning na za tue tawpa haa khata Faro kuv luo kha mingsuv panuo na hluo pakhaa aa.
Cahaacata na luo aa dang tiyta kama kha naa thyi thi la, hingpa hmang taa hingta ina papya riypata Faro kha na changpa thi mya,” a ta.
Hmisi ta ripa kieca kama ca Hebru ming ruo taata paruvpa tana i cuo. Hingpa lie zaw hing thaw tlana riypa te ta i tuesuepa khaapahmuo aw vyi,” a ta.
Viechuo tuetuv byi ta muo a pacuepa kha a phana luo tana a cuo tapa a hmung tiyta, Josef kyihuo khata, “Kama zaw muo suokha i sa ra: i luv cunglie viechuo pakhue suothung aw te,
a cung ce luo ta a chuopa pakhue lie kha Faro huo chuore phangting ta a aw. Cuorasala i luv cung pakhue lie a awpa chuore bangkhuo kha pavaa ta ama ning diy,” a ta.
Josef ta, “A siyluo ca hing haa hing tana a cuo: pakhue suothung ca ning thung ta a cuo;
ning thung chunglieta Faro ta ca papya'a te, na luv kha ca te'a te atung cunglie ca pathlie'a te na saa kha pavaa zaw ta aca ning'a yi,” a ta.
Ning thungnapa, Faro puvnapa ning kha a changtaapa zaw bangkhuo cuota pyi tue te, mingsuv pituv byi hne viechuo tuetuv byi kha a changtaapa zaw hmiekunglie ca a papya yi.
Mingsuv pituv byi kha a re pi pakhaa te mingsuv panuo ca Faro kuv luo a pi;
cuorasala viechuo pituv byi ca Josef ta a muo siyluo a pacuepa haa yi khata a rue lie khuhriy ta pa-uo te a pathlie.
Mingsuv pituv byi ta Josef kha a thyi li tli pata a maw.
Kung hning khutaata Faro ta muo sa te, a muo ca ta Nail cavaa kielie kha aa daa.
Nail cavaa chung taa cata a thusapa cue sasariy kya pya te cavaa kie aphuv hrawlie kha ama tle.
Cakhutaa cata iema hnang taa khata a zuekaripa cue sasariy Nail cavaa chung taa cata kya pya ra yi te, cavaa kielie cue hrangpa tie athaalie kha amaa daa.
A zuekaripa cue sasariy tie ca ta a thusapa cue sasariy tie kha ama ce diy. Cakhutaa cata Faro ca aa kya cha.
A hmung pakhaa te a suohningnapa muo a sa pakhaa. Suo kung kung kha taata a patasapa sa-uv suosariy a kya pya.
Ningchiy thliy ta a parapa a siykarepa sa-uv suosariy zaw kha iema hnang taa cata a kya pya ra.
A siykarepa sa-uv suosariy ca ta a patasapa sa-uv suosariy ca a paluo diy yi. Faro kha aa kya cha ca a muo ta a cuo.
Mawluo maw ca a palung a nuo li pata Izipt ruo chunglie pacuo a thepa bangkhuo kha a paku sa diy yi. Faro ta a muo kha a chang yi, cuorasala a muo siyluo a pali khupa pakha hmuo aw va yi.
Cakhutaa cata mingsuv pituv byi ta Faro kyihuo khata, “Ataning hing i suenapa na i thyi.
Luo kha ning, na changtaapa zaw cunglie na hi a za haa ningta, kama hne viechuo tuetuv byi kha siepahruo ing a huotuv tie uvtuv riekabyi ing, thaw chunglie malie na pathla.
Ama hne kama hneta zuo kha chunglie muo sa pate, ma muo ca ama cyicuo ta siyluo ama hnyi kaluo.
Siepahruo ing a huotuv tie uvtuv riekabyi changtaapa, Hebru mingnuta pakha kha kiema hne a aw ra. Ama kha ma chang tiyta, ma muo kha malie palipa te, ma muo cyicuo khata a siyluo malie a chang.
Malie a palipapa haa khata a vya cuo hmisi; kama ca i re tawpa kha pahrie sa pakhaa pata cuo angte, viechuo pituv byi ca pathliesa pata a cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Faro ta Josef kha va paku sa yi te, ama ca thaw chung taa khata a catlisa pata ama papya. A hmyahming a ngu te caw aa thle khu pahne ta Faro hmiekung luo kha aa vaw.
Faro ta Josef kha, “Muo suokha sa angte ahunghmuo na palipa khu va yi. Nama ca muo a siyluo na a pali khu ta pata na ica thyi,” a ta.
Josef ta Faro kyihuo khata, “Kama cuo li pata Khazing ta Faro kha khing aa chiypa siyluo aca chang aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Faro ta Josef kha, “I muo ta Nail cavaa kielie i daa.
A thusapa cue sasariy kha Nail cavaa chungtaata kya pya te cavaa kielie kha ama tle.
Cakhutaa cata a zuekaripa cuo sasariy kha iema hnang taa cata a kya pya. Izipt ruo chung bangkhuo lie hing cahaacata a zuepa hne a chiepa cue ca hmung buo va ang.
A zuekaripa cue tie ca ta a thusapa cue sasariy ca a ce diy.
Cuorasala ama ce diy khutaa zaw khata a hluo haa khata ama zuekari thluo nakawta, ama ce diy, tapa kha ahungtahmuo pachang'a va yi. Cakhutaa cata i kya cha.
A hmung pakhaa angte, i muo cata a patasapa sa-uv suosariy kha suo kung suokha taata a kya pyapa kha i hmung.
Ningchiy thliy ta a parapa, a siykarepa sa-uv suosariy zaw kha iema hnang taa cata a kya pya ra.
A siykarepa sa-uv suosariy ca ta a patasapa sa-uv suosariy ca ama paluo diy. Pacuo a thepa tie kha i chang raalaa pa yi ta, a siyluo naa chang khupa ahunghmuo aw va yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Josef ta Faro kha, “Faro na muo zaw hing aa lupa hne suokha tana a cuo; Khazing na a tue riypa hmang kha caa pahmung sa.
A thusapa cue sasariy ca kung sariy ta cuo te, a patasapa sa-uv suosariy zaw ca kung sariy ta a cuo; na muo hing suokha tana a cuo.
Iema hnang taata a kya pyapa, a zuekaripa cue sasariy hing kung sariy ta cuo te, cahaacata ningchiy thliy ta a parapa a siykarepa sa-uv suosariy ca kung sariy ta a cuo ra.
Faro kha ica chang tlipa haata; Khazing na Faro kha a tue khingpa hmang caa chang.
Izipt ruo chung bangkhuo lie hing kungvyi kung kung sariy a tlung aa.
Cakhutaa cata cakuo kung sariy tlung'a te, Izipt ruo chunglie kungvyisana kung bangkhuo kha maw pata a cuo aa. Cakuo kha ta ruo kha a para aa.
A vya paziy riypa cakuo ca a ruv tuv hringhruo nakawta kungvyi kung kha ruo chung bangkhuo lie maw diy pata a cuo aa.
Faro ta yi hning te muo na sapa hing, Khazing ta hingpa hmang hing pacusa tli te, a vya patlung sa patang aa tanapa tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Faro ta thleduo khuna a hnyipa hne a singpa cawsaa pakha kha a tlaw la, Izipt ruo bangkhuo hrievu a hnyituv ta chi tie.
Re mangpatuv tie zaw kha hrievu pi vie yi la, kungvyisana kung kung sariy chunglie a vyipa sa che pangaa lie che kha kha pahmya yi se.
A vaw riypa kungvyisana kung chunglieta sa bangkhuo kha pahmya yi sala, Faro nawhnyina rawlie kha khypuv chunglie kha sa ca papung yi sala mangchiy yi se.
Capa sa ca Izipt ruo chung bangkhuo lie kung sariy chung a vya tlung riypa cakuo kung chung cuota pacung paciepa cuo'a te, cakuo chung bangkhuo ruo kha ra'a vyi,” a ta.
Josef chiykhyipa bie ta Faro hne a changtaapa bangkhuo kha ama palung a patluo yi.
Faro ta a changtaapa tie kha, “Khazing Thlaapa ta a awpuopa hingpa paa haapa hing khaapaliema ma hmung khu aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Faro ta Josef kha, “Khazing ta hingpa bangkhuo hing aca pahmung sa tli, ahung pakha hmuo nama haata thleduo khuna a hnyipa hne a singpa aw va yi.
Nama hing i siepahruo ing uvtuv ta cuo'a cate, nama naw pina haata i cawsaa zaw ta ama hrie aa; i siepahruo thude kawlie dyi hingna nama laata i lesyi vie aa,” a ta.
