Cakhutaata Faro ta Josef kha, “Mang tie, Nama kha Izipt ruo bangkhuo uv riypata ica chi tli,” a ta.
Faro ta a caakhenapa kuvpahryi kha thlie te Josef kuv lie kha a pahryi. Cawthang phapa kha pahryi te a rue lie kha siy pachiy a pa-ya.
Siepahruo a tuna a paziypa aruole kha pakhang sa te, a hmieluo khata, “A bung ung,” ta pata ama khile. Cahaacata Josef ca Izipt ruo bangkhuo uvtuv ta a chi.
Ca hlyitaw taata Faro ta Josef kha, “Kama ca Faro ta i cuo, nama ri ta ta li pata Izipt ruo chunglie hing ahunghmuo a kuv caba pata a phyi calang khu'a vyi,” a ta.
Faro ta Josef ca, Zafenath-paneah ta pata ming a paphya; a napuv riypata On tluobyipa Potifera sacanung Asenath kha a pi. Cahaacata Josef ca Izipt ruo chung bangkhuo cunglie kha naw a hnyi.
Izipt siepahruo Faro re hrie riypata aa pathu ning kha Josef ca kung sawthung na a ta. Josef ca Faro hmiekung taa khata pya te Izipt ruo chung bangkhuo kha a tlaw.
Kungvyisana kung sariy chunglie kha alyi ta khuopuv ta kung a pavyi.

Izipt ruo chunglie kungvyisana kung sariy chunglie a vyipa sa bangkhuo kha pahmya te khypuv zaw chunglie kha a pacung. Khypuv bangkhuo lie kha a cahriy cyicuo lie a awpa lu taa khata sa kha a pacungle.
Josef ca riyliy lie viehnang zaa khata sa ca pacung te, panang khu a aw li tli nakawta panang va tli yi.
Cakuo a tlung hluota Josef ca On tluobyipa Potifera sacanung Asenath hneta sacapaa pahning ama hnyi.
Josef ta, “Khazing ta i te-angna bangkhuo hne i paa ing zaw ina pamaw sa tli,” ta te a sacapaa uvthyi ca Manasseh ta pata ming a sa.
“Khazing na i ruvnaasanapa hmang lie naa papungzaa sa ta te, a pahningnapa kha Efraim ta pata ming a sa.
Josef a ripa haata, Izipt ruo chunglie kungvyisana kung sariy ca vya chuo te
cakuo kung sariy ca aa pathu, cuorasala Izipt ruo chung bangkhuo lieta sa a aw.

Izipt ruo chung bangkhuo ta cakuo a tlung tiyta, cawsaa ta Faro'a luo kha sa amaa vya hie. Faro ta Izipt ming bangkhuo kyihuo khata, “Josef'a luo kha vaa ung la, tue ung la aca tapa yi kha tue tie ung,” a ta yi.
Cakuo ca ruo chung bangkhuo lie a tlung tiyta, Josef ta sa-ing bangkhuo kha pahaw te Izipt ming kha a zaa yi, tahematapakieca Izipt ruo chunglie cakuo ca a pasa hringhruo.
Ca hlyitaw taata, cakuo ca chuelyi khyzaa lie khuosa ta a tlung ra nakawta chuelyi khyzaa taata Izipt ruo Josef'a luo kha sa calyi riypata ama vya pangie.
Izipt ruo liena sa a aw tapa kha Jakob ta a thyi tiyta, a sacapaa zaw kyihuo khata, “Khaapanakawma pakha hne pakha ca namaa mang?
Izipt liena sa a aw tapa tana i thyi, thiy li pata ma hring the riypata zuv ung la ma cuota sa ca za calyi tie ung,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta Josef uvnu pahraa tie ca Izipt luo kha sa calyi riypata ama sibung.
Ruvnaana a taw'a kie a ta nakawta Jakob ta Josef nuta Benjamin ca a uvnu zaw'a lie kha pathlie vyi.
Kanaan ruo lie cakuo a tlung nakawta Israel sacapaa zaw ca a hrangpa tie zaw hne khata sa calyi riypata ama si.
Josef ca capa ruo uvtuv byi cuo te, ruo chung cawsaa bangkhuo kha sa a zaatuv yi ta a cuo. Josef uvnu zaw ca a vaw yi te a hmiekunglie kha amaa vya bung.

Josef ta a uvnu zaw kha a hmung tiy yi ta a pachang paluo yi, cuorasala maliepa haa khata a pa-aw sa te bie a hruosa pata a chaw yi. Ama ta, “Khaapa taata ma namaa vaw?” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Sa calyi riypa tana Kanaan taata imaa zuv,” ama ta.
Josef ta a uvnu zaw kha a pachang raalaa pa yi ta iema ta pachang va yi.
Josef ta iema kaw muo a sapa zaw kha aa thyi. Ama ta iema kha, “Niema hing ma ruo thaacawnapa ngiepatlietuv tana nama cuo,” a ta yi.
Cuo vyi, ma byipaapa; na changtaapa tie hing sa calyi riypa tana ma za chiy.
Ma bangkhuo hingta pakha saata tah cuo pate, aa dangpa cawsaa tana ma cuo; khatiy ning hmuo ngiepatlietuv cuo buo vapuv,” ama ta.
Cuorasala ama ta, “Cuo vyi, ma ruo thaacawnapa mangparuv riypa tana namaa zuv,” a ta yi.

Iema ta, “Kiema, na changtaapa zaw hing uvcanu pahraa hlyihning ta pate, Kanaan ruo lie a awpa cawsaa pakha saata tana ma cuo, a syi cepa pakha ca ata hing ma paa'a lie aw te, pakha ca malie a thiyse tli,” ama ta.
Cuorasala Josef ta iema kha, “Ica tapa haa yi ta nama cuo; ngiepatlietuv tana nama cuo.
Hingpa hingna niema dyapasyana ta a cuo aa: nama nuta ca na hingpa luo hing a vaw va ta pata a cuo kieca, Faro a hringpa haata, hingpa hmang taa hingta pya'a va ung ciy.

Nama bie hing a hmisipa ta a cuo ma cuo va ma tapa kha aa cie riypata, a hrangpa tie thaw chunglie nama aw chung hingta, niema chung taata pakha a pathlie ung la nama nuta ca zaa chiy se, caacuolikieca Faro a hringpa haata, niema ca ngiepatlietuv tana nama cuo hrahring,” a ta.
Cakhutaata iema bangkhuo kha ning thung chung thaw a pathla yi.
A ning thungnapa ta Josef ta iema kha, “Kama ca Khazing a ciyzaapa i cuo nakawta hingpa hing nama tue kieca nama hring aa.

Aa dangpa cawsaa ta nama cuo kieca, niema uvcanu hraw taa hingta pakha hing hingpa thaw chunglie hing thuse tie ung. A hrangpa tie hingta ning riy a hnyi lipa nama ingchungkhue tie cuota nama calyipa sa hing phya ung la si tie ung,
nama nuta ca kama'a luo za chiykhyi tie ung. Cahaacata nama bie ca paciepa cuo'a te thiyna taata nama law aa,” a ta yi. Cahaacata tue riypata ama palung a tling.

Iema ta pakha hne pakha, “Ma nuta cunglie ma tuenapa muo khana ma pahriy. Paa malie a kie ningta a cuo pasazya kha ma hmung thluo ung, cuorasala naa za thlie va ung puv. Khapa a riethyina khana kiema'a luo a vya kaa,” amaa ta.

Cakhutaa cata Reuben ta palie yi te, “Satliepa cunglie hing hmang pha lipa tue khah ung la ca ta va yi ang ma? Cuorasala naathlie va ung ciy. Caacuonakawta ata hing ca a thiyse na malie a kaahning tli,” a ta yi.
Josef ta a thyi diypa yi kha pachang va yi, tahematapakieca ryipalietuv hmuo te bie a chaw nakaw yi ta a cuo.
Ama ca a hrang luo kha cakuo te a caa. Vya kaa te bie a rihne pakhaa yi. Cakhutaata Simeon kha a tlaw te ama hmungna lie kha a paciy sa yi.
Josef ta ama chawkue lie a bisa pata sa rawpa riypa, ama chawkue cyicuo lie tuokaa pasuopa pakhaa riypa, hne luopuv lie ama ningle riypa zaw ama pi riypata bie a pi yi. Capa ca iema cuota a tuepa yi.
Ama sa ca ama laa kha paphya sa yi te amaa tha.
Amaa rina hmang lie kha pakha ta a laa sa pi riypata a chawkue kha a pahaw ca a chawkue dawlie ca a tuokaa kha a hmung.

Ama ta a uvnu zaw kha, “I tuokaa na i chawkue chunglie ina pasuopa pakhaa yi,” a ta yi. Tuokaa kha ama hmung ca, ama thlaa zangsa te amaa cathangpuo pata pakha hne pakha kha, “Khazing ta ma cunglie a tuepa hing tuokhaapa tama a cuo?” amaa ta.
Kanaan ruo lie ama paa Jakob'a luo kha ama kya chiy tiyta, ama cunglie a chiy a cuopa hmang zawdya kaw kha ama chang.
“Izipt ruo uvtuvbyi ta kiema kha bie a hruosa pata malie chaw te, ma ruo chung a vya ngiepatliepa tana nama cuo ta pata malie a be.
Cuorasala kiema ta, ‘Kiema ca aa dangpa cawsaa tana ma cuo, ngiepatlietuv cuo vapuv.
Kiema ca paa pakha sacapaa uvcanu pahraa hlyihning cuo pate, pakha ca malie thiyse tli te, a syi cepa ca Kanaan ruo liena ma paa hneta a aw,’ ma ta, ama ta.

Cakhutaata capa ruo uvtuvbyi ca ta, ‘Aa dangpa nama cuopa ca hingpa hingta pachang ang se: kama'a lie hing nama uvnu pakha chi siy ung la, ning riy a hnyi lipa nama chungkhue cawsaa tie cuota sa kha phya ung la si tie ung.

Kama'a luo hing nama nuta a syi cepa ca za chiykhyi ung la, capa ca ta niema ca ngiepatlietuv cuo li pata aa dangpa nama cuopa kha ica pachang'a yi. Cakhutaa cata nama uvnupa hing ca pathliepa'a yi angte, hingpa ruo lie hing sung nama pali aa,’ malie a ta,” ama ta.
Ama chawkue chungtaata sa kha ama patle tiyta, ama chawkue cyicuo taata ama tuokaa baw kha ama hmung kaluo. Iema hne ama paa ca ama tuokaa kha ama hmung tiyta ama thlaa ta a zangsa.

Ama paa Jakob ta iema kyihuo khata, “I saata zaw na ina pahlipa diy tli ung ciy: Josef aw va tli, Simeon aw va tli, cakhutaata ata hing Benjamin nama sikhyi hyi aa. Hingpa bangkhuo hing i cunglie a tlung tli hing haw!” a ta.

Cakhutaata Reuben ta a paa kha, “Benjamin hing nama'a luo i kya chiykhyi pakhaa li kieca i sacapaa zaw pahning hing thie lavuo yi ciy. I kuv chunglie hing chi la i kya chiykhyi pakhaa hrahring aa,” a ta.

Cuorasala Jakob ta, “I sacapaa ca nama'a lie si ra khu vyi, tahematapakieca a uvta a thiy tli, ama dyina a ngaa tli. Nama sinapa luo lie thiylina a taw pathlyi sala, i suo paa cang hing tana ngiechina hne ina pathiy'a ung ciy,” a ta yi.
Ruo chunglie cakuo ca a pasa hringhruo.
Izipt taata ama kya phyapa sa kha ama pachuo tiyta, ama paa ta, “Zuv pakhaa ung la sa ca a cawta chuo za calyi tie ung,” a ta yi.
Cuorasala Judah ta, “Cawsaapa ta a cusa pata bie malie taa pacie te, ‘Nama nuta namaa zaa chiy li kieca i hmie hmuo na hmung khu'a va ung ciy,’ malie a ta.
Ma nuta hingna kiema hneta na pasi sa ra tapa kieca zuv'a pate na cuota sa ma za calyi aa;
cuorasala kiema hneta na pasi sa ra li kieca zuv the'a vapuv. Tahematapakieca cawsaapa ta kiema kha, “Nama nuta kha namaa zaa chiy li kieca i hmie na hmung khu'a va ung ciy,’” malie a ta, a ta.
Israel ta, “Khaapanakawma nuta hrangpa na ma hnyi tapa kha capa cawsaapa ca chang ung cate hing haa hingta ina tuechie ung ciy?” a ta yi.

Iema ta, “Cawsaapa ta kiema hrahring hne ma tieriy kaw kha, ‘Nama paa a hring kalie ma? Uvnu hrangpa nama hnyi ma? ta pata a siesa pata malie a hiehriy. A bie hiehriypa khana kiema ta ma palie. Nama nuta zaa chiy ung la malie a ta thlu'a mang tapa ca ma pachang ma,’” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Judah ta a paa Israel kha, “Satliepa hing kama'a lie pasi sa tie, nama hne kiema hne ma saata zaw bangkhuo ma hring thena riypata a pachie'a pate a tha'a puv.
Ama cuo hingta kama hringnapa hing tana bie icaa kuo. Kama cunglie hing khang diy tie. Ama hing kya kaakhyi li pata, na hmiekung luo i kya chiykhyi li kieca chuozaa ta chiesana ang se ang.
Palaw li pata aw se pala, yi hning ca maa lie'a tli,” a ta.

Cakhutaata ama paa Israel ta, “Cahaacata a cuo riypata a cuo kieca, hing haa hingta tue tie ung, hingpa ruo chunglie a pyapa hrawtaata a pha cepa ta a cuopa: thing cathliy rang pa-uepa a cawta, khyitiy a cawta, raabaa, cariy, atuv mathliy thyi hne almond thyi zaw kha nama chawkue lie a suole ung la cawsaapa ca lasaw phya tie ung.
Tuokaa kha le hning ta a phya tie ung. Nama chawkue daw lie aca pasuopapa yi tuokaa kha phya pakhaa tie ung, maw yi te ama tuesuepa tana a cuo aa.
Nama nuta zaw ca a chiy tie ung, a ting ung la cawsaapa'a luo ca si tie ung.

Nama uvnupa pakha hne Benjamin a kya pasi sa pakhaa riypa yi ta Lesyice Khazing ta cawsaapa hmiekunglie ca nang ca due yi se. Kama tuv ca, i saata zaw na naa thiyse yi tapa kiema, thiysepa tana i cuo thluo'a tle,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta lasaw kha cuose, tuokaa le hning kha cuose, a phya yi te Benjamin zaw kha amaa chiy. Cahaacata Izipt luo ca sibung yi te, Josef hmiekung luo ca ama chiy.

Josef ta Benjamin kha iema hneta a hmung tiyta, a ing lie kingkaatuv kha, “Cawsaa zaw hing ing chung luo kha a ngiekhyi tie yi, sahring kha thie ung la sa kha chang tie ung, tahematapakieca kama hne tana ningchung sa ama ning aa,” a ta.
Mangchiykingkaatuv ca ta Josef a ripa haa cata tue te cawsaa tie ca Josef ing luo kha a cakuokhyi yi.

Iema kha Josef ing luo ama cakuokhyi nakawta uvnu tie ca ama thlaa zang te, “A yikhanapa lieta ma chawkue lie malie ama pasuopa pakhaapa tuokaa kawlie kha tana ing chung luo hing malie amaa ngiekhyipa a cuo aa. Sii ta a ziy riypa hne ma laa zaw chuv diy riypata ma cunglie bie ama tue'a tli hing haw!” amaa ta.
Caacuonakawta Josef ing lie kingkaatuv ing luo kha cakuo yi te a ing luo a ngienapa lie kha ama hneta bie amaa rue.
Iema ca ta, “Vya, ma byipaapa, sa calyi riypata yi kha maa zuv mangtli.
Arina hmang luo ma chiy tiyta, ma chawkue kha ma pahaw ca, ma chawkue daw lie kha ma tuokaa cyicuo ca a tlingsa pata a aw kaluo. Caacuonakawta capa tuokaa ca ma za phyale pakhaa.
Ca hlyitaw taata sa calyina riypa zaw kha tuokaa a hlyi ta maa zaa phya. Ahungma ma chawkue lie tuokaa a pasuo tapa kha pachang vapuv,” ama ta.

Ama ta, “Nama thlaa zang khah se, ciy khah ung; nama Khazing hne nama paa Khazing na tuokaa kha nama chawkue lie caa pasuopa yi; sa muo tuokaa kha a tling pata i hmung,” a ta yi. Cakhutaata Simeon kha iema'a luo a kya pyakhyi.
Kingkaatuv ta iema ca Josef ing chung luo kha aa ngiekhyi yi. Tiy kha pi yi te ama phyi kha amaa siy. Ama laa kha a la a pi yi.
Ningchung ta Josef aa vaw thue pi riypata ama lasaw kha ama pachie pacie, tahematapakieca capa lie ca na sa ma ning aa tapa kha ama pachang.
Josef kha ing luo a vya chiy tiyta, ing chung luo ama vya cyipa lasaw kha pi yi te a hmiekunglie kha amaa bung.
Ama thuohlaa kha khie yi te, “A kaw ina changpa ung ciy nama paa, macuopa ca a tluo ma? A hring kalie ma?” a ta yi.
Iema ta, “Na changtaapa, ma paa ca a tluo; a hring kalie,” ama ta. A bung yi te pa-uvsathyina ama pi.
Cakhutaa cata hmiehmie pase te a nung sacapaa, a nuta Benjamin kha a hmung ca, “A kaw ina changpa ung ciy nama nuta a syi cepa ca ama hingta ma a cuo? I sacapaa, Khazing ta vi ca hnyi thi se!” a ta.
Cakhutaata Josef ca a catlisa pata a cakuo, tahematapakieca a nuta kawlieta a palung a kya panu. Caacuonakawta a khuo luo kha a ngie te a caa.
Cakhutaata a hmie kha a siy te a kya pya; khaapahmuo a ta lipa haa khata a pa-aw sa te, “Sa ca pachie tie ung,” a ta.

Josef cuota a nanang ta suv kha, a uvnu zaw cuota suv kha, ama'a lie a ning rapa Izipt ming cuota suv kha ta pata ama pachie. Tahematapakieca Izipt ming ca Hebru tie hneta sa ning pakhaw khing va yi, capa hmang ca ama pasiypa tana a cuo.
Josef hmiekunglie kha ama patu tiyta, a uvthyi ce taata a syi ce te ta aa paziy pata ama patu sa. Uvcanu tie ca ama nang uosa pata pakha hne pakha kha amaa mang.
Josef cabya taata ama savu cyicuo kha ama pi ca Benjamin cuvu ca a uvnu zaw pakha cyicuo laata le pangaa a hluv vie. Cahaacata ning yi dang yi te amaa nuo.
Josef ta a ing kingkaatuv kha ku te, “Cawsaa tie chawkue lie kha a ma phya khu thiy ta sa kha rawpa yi la ama chawkue daw cyicuo lie kha ama tuokaa kha pasuopa tie yi.
I panuo, i ngu panuo kha sa muo tuokaa hne khata a syi cepa chawkue daw lie kha pasuo tie,” a ta. Josef a ripa haa khata a tue.
Mawluo khy a dyi pahne ta ama laa hne khata ama pasi sa.

Khypuv taata a syi ama chiy hluo khata, Josef ta kingkaatuv kha ku te, “Cakuo la, cawsaa tie kha a cade yi la na pha pahne yi ta, “Khaapanakawma hmang phapa kha hmang chiepa ta malie nama thung? Khaapanakawma i ngu panuo kha nama paruv?
I byipaapa ca hingpa hing tana a dang cuo va ma? Hingpa hingna hmungdawluna ta a hmuo cuo va ma? Hmang pha li ciemuopa na nama hrie,” ta tie yi, a ta.
Mangchiykingkaatuv ta va pha yi te, Josef ta a taapa dala haa khata a ta yi.
Iema ta, “Khaapanakawma ma byipaapa ta cahaapa bie ca na ri? Na changtaapa zaw hing cahaapa hmang a tue riypa cuo chiyhie vade puv!
Ma chawkue daw lie ma hmungpa tuokaa kha Kanaan ruo taata ma za phya pakhaapa malie na pachang. Khaapanakawma na byipaapa ing lie siy hne ngu ca ma paruv aa?
Na changtaapa zaw hraw taa hingta pakhakha cunglie na hmung pata a cuo kieca capa paa ca thiy se. Ca hlyitaw taata aa ngaapa kiema bangkhuo hing na sii ta ma cuo aa,” ama ta.
Ama ta, “A cuo; nama ripa haata cuo se. A cunglie ma hmungpa ca kama sii ta a cuo aa, cuorasala aa ngaapa niema bangkhuo ca nama si khu thluo aa,” a ta yi.
Ama hmang kha pachung yi te, ama chawkue kha ama pahaw kaluo.
Mangchiykingkaatuv ca ta a uvthyi cepa chawkue taata a syi cepa chawkue te a huv tiyta, ngu panuo ca Benjamin chawkue lie kha a hmung.
Capa hne cata ama caw kha ama thlaa. Cakhutaata ama hmang kha laa cung luo khang yi te khypuv luo ca ama kaa.
Josef kha ing lie a aw kaliepa ta Judah hne a uvnu zaw ca Josef ing luo kha ama za chiy.
Josef ta iema kha, “Nama tuepa hing khaapatama a cuo? Kama haapa cawsaa hingta ca hmungdawluna a hnyi tapa kha na pachang the va ung ca ma?” a ta yi.

Judah ta, “Ma byipaapa'a lie kha khaapa bie ca ma ma ri khu aa? Khaapama ma ri the aa? Khaapa ca ma maa pasie ri aa? Khazing na na changtaapa zaw suenapa kha malie a phu tli; ma byipaapa na sii tana ma cuo, kiema hne na panuo ama hmungnapa paa hne tana na sii ta ma cuo aa,” ama ta.
Cuorasala ama ta, “Cuo vyi, cahaacata tue'a va ang. A hmang chunglie panuo ama hmungnapa paa dyina i sii ta a cuo aa; cuorasala niema ca nama paa'a luo kha thlaalungna hne si tie ung,” a ta yi.

Cakhutaata Judah kha a daa te Josef kyihuo khata, “Vya, I byipaapa, I byipaapa na thyi riypata bie suokha na pari sa thi la, na changtaapa cunglie hing na hi haa thi khah se; tahematapakieca Faro hrahring haa tana na cuo thluo.
I byipaapa ta na changtaapa zaw kha, ‘Paa nama hnyi ma? Uvnu hrangpa haw nama hnyi kalie ma?’ ta pata malie na hiehriy.

Kiema ta, ‘A macuosa tlipa paa ma hnyi. Ma paa ta a macuo tli pata a sapa nuta pakha zaw ma hnyi. A uvta ca a thiy tli. A nung ta a sapa zaw hrawlie ama dyi hing a ngaa te a paa ta a due hringhruo,’ maca ta.
Cakhutaata nama ta na changtaapa zaw kyihuo khata, ‘I hmung thena riypata kama'a luo zaa chiy tie ung,’ malie na ta.
Kiema ta ma byipaapa kha, ‘Haatiypa ta a paa kha thuse khu'a vyi, a thuse kieca a paa na a thiy aa,’ maca ta.
Cakhutaata nama ta na changtaapa zaw kha, ‘Nama nuta a syi cepa kha namaa zaa chiy li kieca i hmie na hmung khu'a va ung ciy,’ malie na ta.
Na changtaapa i paa'a luo i kaa tiyta i byipaapa na bie kha ma chang.
Ma paa ta, ‘Si pakhaa ung la sa ca a cawta chuo malie za calyipa tie ung,’ ma lie a ta tiyta,
kiema ta, ‘Si khu'a vapuv, ma nuta a syi cepa a za si ra kie dyina ma si aa, ma nuta a syi cepa na zaa si ra va tapa kieca cawsaapa kha a taw khu'a vapuv,’ ma ta.
Cakhutaata na changtaapa, ma paa ca ta, ‘I napuvnung ta sacapaa pahning ina sapa tapa kha nama pachang.
Pakha ca na thiyse tli te, saa na a caphi patlaa diy, i ta. Capa yalya taa cata hmung va tli ang.
Hingpa paa hing kama'a taata la'a ung cate, a cunglie ruvna a tlung sue kieca, suo paa cang hing tana ngiechina hne Sheol luo ina pasi'a ung ciy,’ malie a ta.
Caacuonakawta ata hingta na changtaapa hing i paa'a luo kha haatiypa li pata i chiy kieca, a hringna ca haatiypa hringna hne hingta aa pazue nakawta,
haatiypa kiema'a lie a hmung li pahne ta thiy'a te, na changtaapa zaw hingta na changtaapa ma paa, a suo paapa ca ngiechina hne Sheol luo ma pasi sasaw aa.

Na changtaapa kama ca haatiypa cuopa hingta i hringna ta i pa'a lie biekuona tue angte, “Haatiypa hing nama'a luo i kya chiykhyi pakhaa li kieca i chuo chung bangkhuo suebena ca na hmiekunglie hing ang lavuo ang,’ i ta.
Caacuonakawta haatiypa cuopa hingta na changtaapa hing i byipaapa na sii ta a ngaa thi ang sala, haatiypa hing a uvta zaw hne hingta pasi sa thi tie.
Tuokhaatama haatiypa li pata i paa luo ca i si nguo aa? I paa cunglie a tlung riypa ruvnaana ca hmung nguo'a va ang,” a ta.

Josef ca a thaalie a tupa tie zaw hmiekunglie kha a ang khu li tli pata, “Cawsaa bangkhuo hing kama'a taata papya diy ung,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Josef ta a uvta zaw aa pachang sa ning yi kha a thaalie ahunghmuo aw va yi.
Khuosa ta a caa nakawta Izipt ming ta thyi yi te, Faro chungkhue zaw ta ama thyi pachaa.
Josef ta a uvta zaw kha, “Kama ca Josef tana i cuo. I paa ca a hring kalie ma?” a ta yi. Cuorasala a uvta zaw ta palie khu va yi, a hmiekunglie kha a ca-ang ta ama ca-ang.
Cakhutaata Josef ta a uvta zaw kha, “A vaw ung la naa vie ngie vie tie ung,” a ta yi. Iema ta amaa vya ngie vie. Ama ta, “Kama hing Izipt luo nama zaapa nama nuta Josef tana i cuo.

Kama kha hingpa ruo luo hing ina za zaa nakaw ung cata niema hne niema kha nama palung rie thyi pata sue a phaw khah ung. Tahematapakieca cawsaa hringna khuo riypa tana Khazing ta niema hmieluo ta ina pathlielu.
Ruo chunglie cakuo a tlungpa hing kung hning a ta tli. Kung pangaa a ngaa kalie te capa cuo chunglie ca lu thlu hne sa hrie tapa aw'a vyi.
Niema hing hingpa chuelyi lie hing a ngaa pata nama hring the riypa hne cawsaa hluvpuv khuona riypata Khazing ta nama hmieluo ta ina pathliepa tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta hingpa luo naa paphyapa hing niema ta cuo va ung ciy, Khazing tana a cuo; Faro cuota a paa haata na tue te, a ing uvtuv byi hne Izipt ruo bangkhuo uvtuv ta ina tue.
I paa'a luo ca a catli pata si ung la, ‘Na sacapaa Josef ca Khazing na Izipt ruo bangkhuo uvtuv ta a tue tli, haasaa li pata a zuv se.
Nama, na saata zaw hne na samingta zaw, na tuv, na mie, na sahring zaw bangkhuo hne na hnyipa zaw bangkhuo hneta Goshen lie hing khysa'a ung cate, i thaa liena nama aw aa.

Capa lie ca kama ta ica ring'a yi. A vaw riypa kung pangaa chung cakuo a tlung kalie'a nakawta nama hne na ingchungkhue, na sahring zaw bangkhuo sa ning riy hnyi li pata ruvnaana namaa taw li riypata capa lie ca kama ta ica ring'a yi, kya ta tie ung.
Niema hne i nuta Benjamin ming hmungna lie kama pakaa hrahring ta ica chang yi hing.
Izipt ruo lie hing kha tluv tama ina pa-uvsathyi yi tapa hne nama hmungpa bangkhuo hing kya chang tie ung. Catli ung la i paa ca zaa chiy tie ung,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaa cata a nuta Benjamin kha a paw te a caa. Benjamin zaw a caa ra.
A uvta zaw bangkhuo kha a paw yi te a caa. Cakhutaa cata a uvta zaw khata bie ama rihne.
“Josef uvnu zaw na a zuv yi,” tapa kha Faro chungkhue luo thuohlaa a thyi te, Faro hne a changtaapa zaw ca ama palung a tluo.
Faro ta Josef kyihuo khata, “Na uvnu zaw ca chang tie yi. ‘Ama sahring hmang kha pachie yi sala Kanaan ruo luo ca si yi se.
Na paa hne ama chungkhue zaw kha kya la yi sala kama'a luo za si yi se. Tahematapakieca Izipt lie a pha cenapa ruo kha pi'a yi angte, aa nuosa pata na nama hring aa,’ ta tie yi.
Ica chang kalie, ‘Nama saata zaw, nama napuv zaw a khang riypata aruole kha a phya ung la nama paa kha a zaa chiy tie ung.
Nama hnyipa hmang kawlie nama palung rie thyi khah se, tahematapakieca Izipt ruo chunglie a pha cena bangkhuo ca niema huo tana a cuo,’ ta tie yi,” a ta.
Israel sacapaa zaw ta cahaacata ama tue. Faro ta a changpa haata Josef ta aruole kha pi yi te, luopuv lie ning riypa zuorie zaw a rawpa yi.
Pakha cyicuo kha yi kha a thlena riypa caw zaw a pi kaluo yi. Cuorasala Benjamin kha ngu tuokaa zathung hne yi pangaa a thlena riypa caw a pi.
A paa kha Izipt ruo lie a pyapa chechiy pha cepa laa sahraa phya, luopuv lie ning riypa sa, viechuo hne ning riypa phangting zaw kha laapuvnung sahraa phya a paphya.
Cakhutaa cata a uvnu zaw ca pa si yi te, ama sipuolepa khata, “Luopuv lie a hrule khya ung,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta Izipt taa cata pya yi te Kanaan ruo ama paa Jakob awna luo kha ama kya si.
Ama paa kha, “Josef kha a hring kalie. Izipt ruo bangkhuo uvtuv tana a za cuo,” ama ta. Ama ca a ca-ang ta ca-ang te, zang khu va yi.
Cuorasala iema ta Josef bie bangkhuo kha ama chang. Ama aa khang riypata Josef ta a kya paphyapa aruole zaw kha a hmung tiyta a lawsa te a palung a cahra pakhaa.
Israel ta, “Aa de! I sacapaa Josef na a hring kalie. I thiy hluo hingta si'a angte na i zaa taw aa,” a ta.
Israel ca a hnyipa hmang bangkhuo hne khata a tha te Beer-sheba luo a chiy tiyta, a paa Isak Khazing'a lie kha hriykhungrina a tue.
Khazing ta Israel ca zuo ta muocuo pahmung sa te a chaw. “Jakob, Jakob,” ta te, ama ta, “Hingpa lie hingna i aw,” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata, “Kama ca Khazing, na paa Khazing tana i cuo. Izipt luo si riypa hing ciy khah, tahematapakieca Kama na capa ruo lie ca mingphang lepa ta caa tue'a ang.
Kama hrahring nama hne Izipt luo si'a angte, kama ta ica kya kaakhyi pakhaa aa. Na thiy tiyta Josef hrahring na a kuv ta na ming caa pahruv aa,” a ta.
Jakob ca Beer-sheba taata aa tha. Israel sacapaa zaw ca ta ama paa Jakob hne ama saata zaw hne ama napuv zaw kha Faro ta a kya paphyapa aruole lie kha ama patu sa.
Kanaan lie ama hnyipa sahring hne chechiy bangkhuo hne khata Izipt ruo luo ca ama si. Jakob ca ama hne a samingsahlaa zaw ta a cuopa,
a sacapaa zaw, a sacapaa tie sacapaa zaw, a sacanung zaw, a sacapaa tie sacanung zaw, a samingsahlaa bangkhuo kha ama hneta a za sikhyi diy yi.
Jakob hne a samingsahlaa, Izipt luo zaa sipa Israel ming ming ca hing haa hing tana a cuo. Jakob sacapaa uvthyi Reuben,
hne Reuben saata zaw ta a cuopa Hanok, Pallu, Hezron, hne Karmi.
Simeon saata zaw: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, hne Kanaan zaanung sacapaa Shaul.
Levi saata zaw: Gershon, Kohath, hne Merari.
Judah saata zaw: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, hne Zerah (Er hne Onan ca Kanaan ruo lieta a ma thiy); hne Perez saata zaw ca Hezron hne Hamul ta ama cuo.
Issakhar saata zaw ca: Tola, Puvah, Jashub, hne Shimron.
Zebulun saata zaw ca: Sered, Elon, hne Jahleel
(Iema hing ama siicanung Dinah hneta Paddan-aram lieta Leah ta Jakob a sapapa yi sacapaa zaw ta ama cuo. A sacapaa hne a sacanung zaw ama bangkhuo ta sawthung pathung ama ta).
Gad saata zaw: Zifion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, hne Areli.
Asher saata zaw: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, hne ama sietanung Serah. Beriah saata zaw: Heber hne Malkhiel.
(Hingpa tie hing Laban ta a sacanung Leah a pipa Zilpah ta Jakob a sapapa saata zaw ta ama cuo. Ama bangkhuo ta pahraa hlyicaruv ama ta).
Jakob napuvnung Rachel saata zaw: Josef hne Benjamin.
Potifera tluobyipa On sacanung Asenath ta Izipt ruo lie Josef a sapapa Manasseh hne Efraim.
Benjamin saata zaw: Bela, Bekher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, hne Ard.
(Hingpa tie hing Rachel ta Jakob a sapapa saata zaw ta ama cuo, ama bangkhuo ta pahraa hlyipaliy ama ta).
Dan saata zaw: Hashum.
Naftali saata zaw: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, hne Shillem.
(Hingpa tie hing Laban ta a sacanung Rachel a pipa Bilhah ta Jakob a sapapa sacapaa zaw tana ama cuo. Ama bangkhuo ta pasariy ama ta).
A sacapaa napuv zaw ripuo li pata Izipt luo zaa sipa Jakob samingsahlaa zaw ca ama bangkhuo ta sawcaruv pacaruv ama ta.
Izipt lieta a puvpa Josef sacapaa zaw pahning ta yi te, Izipt luo zaa sipa Jakob ingchungkhue cawsaa ama bangkhuo ta sawsariy ama ta.
Israel ta Judah kha Goshen luo silu riypata Josef'a luo kha a pathlie.
Goshen luo ama pha tiyta,
Israel ta Josef kyihuo khata, “Kama hrahring na hring kaliepa ica hmung tli nakaw hingta i thiy a pahuo'a mangtli,” a ta.
Josef ta a uvta zaw'a nata a paa ingchungkhue tie kha, “Faro'a luo kha khaw'a angte, ‘Kanaan lie a awpa i uvta zaw hne i paa ingchungkhue tie na zaa chiy yi.
Iema ca tuvkhietuv ta cuo yi te sahring a khiepa tana ama cuo. Ama sahring hne ama hnyipa bangkhuo kha ama za sikhyi diy,’ ta pata i kya chang aa.
Faro ta ca u'a yi te, ‘Khaapa re ma nama hrie?’ aca ta kie yi ca,

‘Ma mingchingmingvuo tie zaw ama za hriepa haata na changtaapa zaw hing ma cawta baataata ata tepa hingta sahring a khiepa tana ma cuo,’ nama ta aa. Cakiedyina Goshen lie khy nama sa the aa, tahematapakieca tuvkhietuv bangkhuo ca Izipt ming ta ama duvpa tana a cuo,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta Josef ta vaa te Faro kha, “I paa hne i uvta zaw ca ama sahring hne ama hnyipa bangkhuo hneta Kanaan taata za si yi te ata hing Goshen liena ama aw,” a ta.
A uvta zaw chungtaata cawsaa papangaa kha Faro hmiekung luo a chiykhyi yi.
Faro ta a uvta zaw kha, “Khaapa re ma nama hrie?” a ta yi. Iema ta Faro kyihuo khata, “Ma mingchingmingvuo tie zaw haata na changtaapa zaw hing tuvkhietuv tana ma cuo,” ama ta.

Kanaan ruo lieta cakuo a pasa tuv nakawta na changtaapa zaw hing ma sahring tlena riypa hmuo aw vyi. Caacuonakaw tana na ruo lie hing khychepa haata aw riypata ma za si. Na changtaapa zaw hing Goshen lieta malie pa-aw sa thi tie,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Faro ta Josef kha, “Na paa hne na uvta zaw ca namaa'a luo ama za si tli.

Izipt ruo ca na hmiekunglie na a aw thluo. Na paa hne na uvta zaw ca ruo chunglie a pha cenapa lie hing pa-aw sa tie yi; Goshen lie ca aw yi se. Iema chungtaata hmang a tue khu riypa na hmung kie yi ca i sahring khietuv zaw uvtuv ta chi tie yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Josef ta a paa Jakob kha ing chung luo zaa ngiekhyi te Faro kha a pahmung sa. Jakob ta Faro kha thluechiy a pi.
Faro ta Jakob ca, “Na kung kung khazaa ma a ta tli? a ta.

Jakob ta Faro kyihuo khata, “Chuelyi lie khyche i cuonapa kung zakha sawthung a ta tli. I hring kung hing pachang te a ruv. Chuelyi lie kung pasiypuv khyche a cuopa mingchingmingvuo tie hringna kung hneta ca pakhingpuo tluopa cuo vyi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Jakob ta Faro kha thluechiy pi te a hmiekung taa cata a pya.
Faro ta a changpa haa khata Josef ta a paa hne a uvta zaw kha Izipt ruo chunglie khysana tuepa yi te, ruo chung bangkhuo lieta a pha cenapa Rameses pe lie kha a pa-aw sa yi.
Josef ta a paa, a uvta zaw, hne a paa ingchungkhue cawsaa bangkhuo kha sa a ring diy yi.
Cakuo kha a pasa tuv nakawta ruo chung bangkhuo lie sa aw vyi. Cakuo nakaw ca ta Izipt ruo hne Kanaan ruo ca ama thaa a cawsa.
Josef ca sa calyina ta ama vya cyipa, Izipt ruo hne Kanaan ruo lie tuokaa bangkhuo kha pakhaw te Faro ing lie a chi.

Izipt ruo lie hne Kanaan ruo lie a awpa tuokaa kha a chuo taata, Izipt ming ca Josef'a luo kha a vaw yi te, “Sa malie pi tie. Ma tuokaa a chuo tli zawta khaapanakawma na hmiekunglie ca ima thiy aa?” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Josef ta, “Nama sahring kha na pi tie ung. Nama sahring kha sa ta ca thle'a yi ang. Nama tuokaa a chuo kieca,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta ama sahring kha Josef'a luo ca vya cyi yi te, aruo, tuv, mie, laa hne ama sahring zaw kha sa ta a thle yi.

Capa kung ca chuo te, a huokungpa lie zaw kha a vaw yi te, Josef kyihuo khata, “Abyipanama'a taata khaapahmuo nu khu vapuv, ma tuokaa kha chuo te, ma sahring zaw ma byipaapa nama huopa tana a cuo diy tli. Ma pangpa hne ma luruo ta li pata ma byipaapa na hmungna lie khaapahmuo a ngaa va tli.

Ma pangpa hne ma luruo hneta ma na hmiekunglie ca ma thiy aa? Kiema hne ma luruo kha sa ta malie thle tie. Kiema hne ma luruo hneta Faro si ta cuo lavuo puv. Ma thiy li riypa hne ma ruo hing a caking li riypata saciy ca malie pi tie,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Josef ta Izipt ruo palang kha Faro huota a calyi. Cakuo kha a pasasa nakawta Izipt ming bangkhuo ta amaa lyi kha zaa yi te, alyi ca Faro huota a cuo diy.
Izipt ruo kiy kha taata kiy kha te ta a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo ca sii ta a tue diy yi.
Tluobyi tie alyi dyi khana ama ta a calyi va. Tahematapakieca iema ca Faro ta ning riypa a pipa tie ta cuo yi te, capa a pipa yi ca ama ning nakawta amaa lyi kha zaa va yi.
Cakhutaata Josef ta cawsaa zaw kha, “Ataning hing niema hne namaa lyi hne Faro huota ica calyi diy tli yi. Hingpa lie hing saciy aw te nama lu lie kha va cyi tie ung.

Sa nama hrie tiyta che pangaa che kha kha Faro huo cuo'a te, che pangaa chunglie che paliy kha niema huota a cuo aa. Lu lie saciy riypa, niema hne nama ingchungkhue hne nama saata zaw cuota ning riypa sa ta a cuo aa,” a ta.
Iema ta, “Nama na ma hringna malie a khuo ciy; hingpa hingta ma byipaapa palung ca patluo se, kiema ca Faro sii tana ma cuo aa,” ama ta.

Caacuonakawta Izipt alyi taata a pyapa che pangaa che kha ca Faro huopa tana a cuo aa ta pata Josef ta phungluo suokha sa te, capa upadi ca ataning tepa hingta aa hmang. Tluobyi tie alyi dyina Faro huopa ta a cuo va.
Cahaacata Israel ca Izipt ruo Goshen lie kha khy a sa. Vya hnyi vya rung yi te, saata a hluvsa sa yi te khuopuv ta ama pungzaa.
Jakob ca Izipt ruo lie kung hraa hlyisariy aw te, zakha sawliy kung sariy a hring.

Israel ca a thiy tiy aa de tiyta, a sacapaa Josef kha ku te, “Hmiephaa na ina pi ciy ta pata a cuo kieca, i baw alalalie hing na kuv kha chi la, zang tluo aa tlasa pata hne hmisi ta bie naa kuo tie. Izipt lie na za paby'a vaciy.
I mingchingmingvuo tie'a luo i pahy tiyta, Izipt taa hingta na phya la iema thluo lie kha na paby tie,” a ta. Josef ta, “Na ripa haata i tue aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata “Chie a sa la bie a kuo tie,” a ta. Chie a sa te bie aa kuo. Cakhutaa cata Israel ca a iehmang aluvluo kuo lie kha a bung te Khazing aa bie.
Cakhutaa cata Josef kha, “Na paa na a pasa,” ta pata ama chang. Caacuonakawta a sacapaa zaw pahning, Manasseh hne Efraim kha ku yi te a sikhyi yi.
Jakob kha, “Na sacapaa Josef na nama'a luo a vaw,” ta pata ama chang tiyta, a thaa kha pachiy te a iehmang cunglie aa kya tu.
Cakhutaata Jakob ta Josef kyihuo khata, “Kanaan ruo Luz lie kha Lesyice Khazing kama'a lie a luo te, thluechiy na pi te ina changpa ca,

‘Kama ta ca papungzaa sa'a angte a hluvsa ica pata sa aa. Mingphang hluvpuv ta ca tue'a angte, chuozaa ta ama za hnyi riypata nama khutaata a vya aw riypa na samingsahlaa zaw kha hingpa ruo hing i pi'a yi'.
Caacuonakawta kama i za si hluota Izipt ruo lie na sapa na sacapaa pahning hing kama huopa tana ama cuo. Reuben hne Simeon haa hing tana Efraim hne Manasseh hing kama huopa ta ama cuo aa.
Iema khutaata na sapa na saata zaw ca nama huopa ta a ma cuo aa. Cuorasala rucuna kawlieta ca ama uvta zaw ming rawlieta patluopa ama cuo aa.

Tahematapakieca Paddan taata i vya si ning kha, Efrath khy luo pha'a nangcaw khata Kanaan ruo chung luopuv lie kha Rachel ta na thiyse te, Efrath luo sinapa luopuv lie ca i paby,” a ta. (Efrath ca Bethlehem ta a cuo).
Israel ta Josef sacapaa zaw kha a hmung tiy yi ta, “Ahung zaw tama ama cuo?” a ta.
Josef ta a paa kha, “Hingpa ruo lie Khazing ta ina pipa i sacapaa zaw tana ama cuo,” a ta. Israel ca ta, “Kama'a luo a vawkhyi tie yi, thluechiy pi naase yi ang,” a ta.
Israel ca a macuo tli nakawta a ming zing te hmung khu tuv va tli. Caacuonakawta Josef ta iema kha aa thaa luo a vawkhyi yi te, a paw yi te a pahnuo yi.
Israel ta Josef kha, “Na hmie hmung pakhaa riypa hing a nguopuo khu va tli ang, cuorasala Khazing ta na saata zaw kha ina pahmung sa yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata Josef ta iema kha a paa baw cung taa cata pachung yi te a hmielie kha alyi luo aa bung.

Josef ta a sacapaa pahning kha ama kuv ta a ca-yale yi. Efraim kha a paa Israel cacuoluo a chuo the riypata a cavyiluo kuv ta ca-yale te, Manasseh kha a cavyiluo a chuo the riypata a cacuoluo kuv ta a ca-yale.
Cuorasala Israel ta a kuv kha a vaacapie pata pazu te, a cacuoluo kuv kha a syi viepa Efraim luv cunglie a chi, a cavyiluo kuv kha a uvthyi viepa Manasseh luv cunglie kha a chi.
Ama ta Josef kha thluechiy pi te, “I mingpa Abraham hne i paa Isak ama hmieluo ta a cakuosatuv, I hring chung bangkhuo ataning te ta, naa mangchiytuv Khazing,

Kama kha ruvnaana chungtaata naa khuotuv avuoming ta, haatiy zaw hing thluechiy pi tie yi. Iema chunglie hing kama ming, i mingpa Abraham ming hne i paa Isak ming kha cipari hring mang sue. Iema ca chuelyi lie hing pungzaa yi sala mingphang hluvpuv ta a li mang yi sue,” a ta.
A paa ta a cacuoluo kuv Efraim luv cunglie a chipa kha Josef ta a hmung tiyta, a palung a pha li nakawta, a paa kuv kha Efraim luv cung taata Manasseh luv cung luo palaw riypata a la.
A paa kyihuo khata, “Cuo vyi, i paa. Hingpa paa hing a uvthyi vie ta a cuo nakawta na cacuoluo kuv kha a luv cunglie hing chi tie,” a ta.

Cuorasala a paa ta bu te, “I pachang, I sacapaa, i pachang thluo; ama zaw hing cawsaa hluvpuv ta vya cuo'a te, a lesyisa ra thluo aa. Cadyiseca a nuta hing ca ama laata lesyi vie'a te, a samingsahlaa ca mingphang lepuv tana ama cuo aa,” a ta.

Capa ning lie ca ta thluechiy pi yi te, “'Khazing ta Efraim haata hne Manasseh haata ca tue yi se,’ ta pata Israel ming ta na ming ta thluechiy amaa pi aa,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Efraim kha Manasseh hmaa luo ta a chi.
Cakhutaata Israel ta Josef kha, “Kama ca i thiy'a mang tli, cuorasala Khazing ta ca awpuo sala na mingchingmingvuo tie ruo luo caa chiy pakhaa mang sue.
Na uvta zaw laa tana cuvu suokha a hlyi ta ica pi, i kuv lie i zueziy hne i liy ta Amor ming kuv taata i lapa ruo khana cuvu ica pi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Jakob ta a sacapaa zaw kha ku yi te, “Na vya cadung ung la, hmieluo cuo lie khaapama a vya cuo aa tapa kha ca chang'a yi ang.
Vya Jakob sacapaa zaw, a vya hmya ung la; nama paa Israel hing na naathlie tie ung.
Reuben, nama ca i sa-uvthyi tana na cuo, I cahrana, i thaazuo hne i thyipaa taapa tana na cuo, aa suo cepa hne a cahra cepa tana na cuo.
Nama ca tiylaw pachipa haata cuo cate, a aw hyalya the lipa na cuo nakawta, aa suo cepa cuo'a va tli ciy, tahematapakieca na paa iehmang luo kie cate na papya na palyi.
Simeon hne Levi hing uvcanu tana ama cuo; tuechiena cehre ca ama zueziy kha tana a cuo.
Amaa hmyana lie aw ra buo hluo'a va ang; iema kha a phuv'a va yi ang. Tahematapakieca ama hihaa pata cawsaa kha thie yi te, cang-iena ta cuetungpa cazaa kha ama sapachung.
Ama hihaa chiepa hne ama pathiylingna pha lipa ca, chiesa pata cuo mang sue. Jakob chunglie kha che'a yi angte, Israel chunglie kha i chepatlaa diy'a yi.
Judah, nama ca na uvnu zaw ta aca pathuosa'a yi; na kuv ta na carie tie rue kha hmi'a cate, na paa sacapaa zaw ta na hmiekunglie kha amaa vya bung aa.
Judah ca chingde thuthawpa cuo te, i sacapaa, na saa siena taata lungkaraw luo na kya kie. A vabungle te, chingde haata a vaa pazuole, chingdepuvnung haata, ahungma a pacha nguo aa?
Judah ca a byikhuecahryi ta a che buo'a vyi, ngukhyi ama vya pina te hne, mingphang zaw pa-uvsathyina kha ama huo a cuo diy hluo li, a phyi alalalie a uvna khuecahryi ta ama kha a che buo'a vyi.
A laa kha mingsuv kung lie hre te, a laataata kha a pha cepa mingsuv kung lie a hre. A caw kha mingsuvtiy chunglie a pasuv;
a ming ca mingsuvtiy laata se vie te, a haa ca cuehnung laata a ruo vie.
Zebulun ca riyliy kielie khy a sa aa; ama ca tiypalaw a pahyna ta cuo'a te, a ruoriy ca Sidon te a cuo aa.
Issakhar ca a cahrapa laa ta a cuo; a hmang phyapa tung hning alalalie kha a bu te,
aa hyna hmang kha a pha ta pata a hmung nakaw hne, capa ruo ca aa nuo tapa kha a hmung nakawta; hmang phya riypata a letung kha pane te, re pahriesapa sii ta aa li.
Dan ca Israel ming mingphang hrang zaw haa khata, a cawsaa zaw kha a uv'a yi.
Dan ca luopuv kielie a awpa pariy haata hne, luopuv lie a awpa calyize haa tana a cuo aa. Aruo phyi kha daw te, a khangpa kha a yapathla yi te ama tla.
Vya Abyipakama ca na khuona khana i huo aa.
Gad ca damie tie ta tlangkhy vya tuv yi te, cuorasala tuv hriy yi te aa cade'a yi.
Asher luruo taata sa pahuo daduo a pya aa, siepahruo ning riypa kha a ring aa.
Naftali ca a tle hyalyapa sasuv, a taata puvthesapa a pachuopa tana a cuo.
Josef ca a pathyisapa thingce, acaa kielie thingce pathyisapa tana a cuo; a ce zaw ta lungruetlepie kha ama law pakhung.
Liy ka a thepa tie ta khuosa ta amaa du; khuopuv ta vya nuopuo yi te ama vya ka.
Cuorasala a liy ca kacu pari te, a kuv ca a catli. Capa ca Jakob Khazing Cungnungce kuv thueta, Israel ming alungpuvnung, Tuvkhietuv ming ta cuose,

nama caa byatuv riypa na paa Khazing thueta hne cung luo vuoruo thluechiy ta nama thluechiy caa pituv Lesyice thueta cuose, aa thuvna a rawlie a awpa thluechiy ta nama thluechiy caa pituv thueta hne ahnung hne pavaw thluechiy ta nama thluechiy caa pituv thue tana a cuo.

Na paa thluechiy ca chuozaa tluo thluechiy laata cahra vie te, chuozaa tluothlue thluechiy laata a cahra vie. Capa thluechiy ca Josef luv cunglie kha tlung sala, a uvta zaw'a taata a nanang ta a awpa paa lakiy lie kha tlung se.
Benjamin ca a nangdiypa cahnie ta cuo te, mawdiy ta a siepa saa kha ce te, zuo luo ta aa ngaapa kha caphi te a che.
Hingpa zaw bangkhuo hing Israel ming phang hraa hlyihning ta cuo yi te, hingpa bie zaw hing iema thluechiy a pi ning yi ta ama paa ta a ripa bie ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata Jakob ta a saata zaw kha, “I cawsaa piy zaw'a luo kha pahmya pata i cuo'a mang tli. I mingchingmingvuo tie hne khata Hit ming Efron lu lungkhue chunglie kha ina paby'a ung ciy.
Abraham ta a pabyna riypata Hit ming Efron lu hne a calyipuopa, Kanaan ruo chung Mamre athaalie, Makpelah lie a awpa lu chunglie lungkhue kha tana a cuo.
Capa lie ca Abraham hne a napuvnung Sarah kha ama paby; capa lie ca Isak hne a napuvnung kha ama paby; capa lie ca kama ta Leah zaw kha i paby.
Lu hne a chunglie a awpa lungkhue kha Hit ming'a lieta calyipa tana a cuo.
Jakob ca a sacapaa zaw bie a taapa yi kha a pachuo khutaata, a phyi kha a da te iehmang cung luo a chi khutaata a huv ci te a cawsaa zaw'a luo kha pahmya pata a cuo.
Josef ta a paa kha a bungchiy te caa te a hmie lie kha a pahnuo.
Cakhutaata a kuv rawlie re a hriepa siyybyi tie kha a paa riyy kha a ra khu li riypata siyy ta tue riypata bie a pi yi. Caacuonakawta siyybyi tie ta Israel ca siyy ta tue yi te, ning sawliy ama ru.
Cahaacata tuena riypata ning sawliy ru tawpa a cuo. Izipt ming ta ning sariy chung ama caa.
A paa ama caana cuo ca a chuo taata Josef ta Faro rehrietuv byi tie kyihuo khata, “Hmiephaa na ina pi ung ciy tapa kieca, Faro kha hing haa hingta na changpa tie ung:

I paa ta a thiy hluota lieta, ‘I thiy'a mangtli. Kanaan ruo lie kama hrahring ta i za ryipa thluo lie khana ina paby'a ciy,’ ta pata bie ina pakuo sa. Caacuonakawta i paa paby riypata khaw'a angte i za kaa pakhaa aa, a ta ta pata na va changpa tie ung,” a ta.
Faro ta, “Khaw la, tue riypata bie aca pakuo sapa haata na paa ca kya paby tie,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Josef ca a paa paby riypata a si. Ama hneta Faro changtaapa tie bangkhuo, a ing lie re a hriepa uvthyi bangkhuo, Izipt ruo lie uvthyi bangkhuo ama si ra.
Cahaa ngiethie cata Josef ingchungkhue tie, a uvnu zaw, a paa ingchungkhue cawsaa zaw bangkhuo ama si ra. Ama haatiy tie, tuv, mie hne sahring zaw dyi kha Goshen lie ca ama thuse.
Aruole hne aruole rieka tie zaw kha ama hneta si ra yi te buv lepuv ta ama cuo.
Jordan cavaa huesuo lie a awpa Atad lie suo-aciyna luo ama chiy tiyta, a lesapa hne ngiechi aa chiysapa a thiypa caana kha a lesa ta ama tue. Josef ta a paa kha ning sariy chung a caa.

Capa ruo lie a awpa Kanaan ming ta Atad lie suo-aciyna lieta ama tuepa muochiesana kha ama hmung tiyta, “Izipt ming na khuopuv ta muochie a sa yi,” ama ta. Caacuonakawta capa hmang ca Abel-mizraim ama ta. Jordan cavaa huesuoluo kuo tana a aw.
Cahaacata a chang siypa haa yi ta a sacapaa zaw ta ama tuepa.
Kanaan luo kha sikhyi yi te, Abraham ta Hit ming Efron'a taata a pabyna riypata a calyipa, Mamre athaalie a awpa Makpelah lu chung lungkhue lie kha ama paby.
A paa kha a paby khutaata Josef ca a uvnu zaw hne a paa paby riypata a si rapa bangkhuo hne khata Izipt luo kha ama za kaa.
Ama paa a thiy khutaata Josef uvnu zaw khata, “Josef hingta malie hue kalie sala, a cunglie ma tuepa hmang pha lipa bangkhuo cuo khata vieriy malie a thung kie tuokhaatama maa tue aa,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Josef kyihuo khata, “Na paa ta a thiy hluota hingpa bie hing malie a taa siy,

‘Josef kha chang ung la: Icaa nue, na uvnu zaw ta na cunglie ama suenapa hne nama ruvnaana pi pata hmang pha lipa ama tuepa kha zaa ngiethe mya yi caa ta,’ ama ta. Caacuonakawta na paa Khazing sii zaw ta a cuopa tie suenapa hing malie a ngiethe thi tie,” ama ta. Hingpa bie ama chang tiyta Josef ca a caa.
A uvnu zaw kha ama caa ra. A hmiekunglie kha a bu yi te, ama kha, “Kiema ca na sii zaw tana ma cuo,” ama ta.
Cuorasala Josef ta, “Ciy khah ung! Khazing adaahmang lie ca i daa the'a ma?
Niema ta ruvnaana ina pi khing zaw ung cata, ataning a cuopa haa hingta cawsaa hluvpuv hringna khuo riypata a phana luo ta Khazing ta a tingpa tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta ciyna hnyi khah ung; kama hrahring na niema hne nama saata zaw hne caa ring'a yi ang,” a ta yi. Cahaacata iema kha duena hne bie rihne yi te ama hnaa a panguo yi.
Cahaacata Josef ca a paa ingchungkhue cawsaa zaw hne khata Izipt lie kha aw yi te, kung zakha kung hraa a hring.
Josef ca Efraim saata zaw kha chuo thung te hmung yi te, Manasseh sacapaa Makhir saata zaw kha a ingchungkhue lie a pasuvpuo yi.

Cakhutaata Josef ta a uvnu zaw kha, “I thiy'a mang tli; cuorasala niema'a luo kha Khazing a zuv'a te, hingpa hmang taa hingta Abraham, Isak hne Jakob bie a kuopa yi ruo luo kha aca sikhyi'a yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Josef ta Israel ming kha bie pakuo sa yi te, “Khazing niema'a luo a zuv tiyta hingpa hmang taa hingta i ruv hing nama phyale aa,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaa cata kung 110 a ta pata Josef ca thiy te, thuv the linapa siyy thuv yi te riyy thingkaw chunglie khung yi te Izipt ruo lie ama chi.
Hingpa tie hing Jakob hneta Izipt luo zaa sipa Israel sacapaa zaw ma chungkhue cyicuo ta ama ming ta a cuo:
Reuben, Simeon, Levi, hne Judah,
Issakhar, Zebulun, hne Benjamin,
Dan hne Naftali, Gad hne Asher.
Jakob a sapa ama bangkhuo ta sawsariy ama ta. Josef ca Izipt lie a za aw lu tli.
Josef hne a uvnu zaw bangkhuo, capa chuolie'apa bangkhuo ca ama thiy diy.
Cuorasala Israel ming ca pungzaa ciemuo yi te, cahrasa yi te ruo chunglie ca ama bi.
Cakhutaata Josef a pachang lipa siepahruo thaapa kha Izipt ruo lie siepahruo a vya cuo.
Ama ta a cawsaa zaw kha, “Mang tie ung, Israel ming hing kiema laata hluv vie yi te ama cahra vie hing.

A vaw tie ung, singvaasa pata iema cunglie hing re hrie'a ung puv, caacuolikieca hluv hryly'a yi te, rie thu sala ma carie tie kha a be'a yi te, kiema pali kha malie tuv'a yi te hingpa ruo chung taa hingta amaa ruo aa,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta khuosa ta re hri riypata rehrituv tie kha ama chi. Israel ming ta sa pacungna riypata Pithom hne Rameses kha Faro cuota ama sa.
Cuorasala hrisaa hryly yi, pung hryly yi te ruo chung ting ta a ze hryly yi ama ta nakawta Izipt ming ta Israel ming kha ciy yi te ama hue.
Caacuonakawta a cawta hehmuo kawpacuona aw li pata khuopuv ta re kha ama pahrie sa.
Lungrue tuena lie, ing sa re lie hne lu re phangting kha pahrie sa yi te ama hringrie kha ama pathyi. Kawpacuona hnyi li pata re ama pahrie sa.
Izipt siepahruo ta nu a pa-awtuv Hebru tie Shifrah hne Puah kyihuo khata,
“Hebru canung zaw kha nu nama pa-aw tiyta, nuta kha capaa a cuo kie thie ung la, canung a cuo kie pahring mya ung,” a ta yi.
Cuorasala nu pa-awtuv tie ta Khazing kha ciy yi te, Izipt siepahruo nawpina haata tue lipa yi ta, capaa saata zaw kha ama pahring.
Caacuonakawta Izipt siepahruo ta nu pa-awtuv tie kha ku yi te, “Khaapanakawma hing haa hingta tue ung cate capaa saata nama pahring?” a ta yi.
Nu pa-awtuv tie ta Faro kha, “Hebru canung ca Izipt canung haata cuo va yi, cahrasa yi te ama nu aw a nasa nakawta nu pa-awtuv iema'a luo a chiy hluota nu a za aw lawmaw tli,” ama ta.
Khazing ca nu pa-awtuv tie'a lie kha pha te, Israel ming ca hluv vie hryly yi te ama cahra hryly.
Nu pa-awtuv tie ca Khazing ama ciyzaa nakawta Khazing ta saata nuta a pi ra yi.
Cakhutaata Faro ta a cawsaa zaw kha naw pi yi te, “Hebru ming ta ama sapa capaasaata bangkhuo ca Nail cavaa chung luona nama thaw aa,” a ta yi.
Levi phang chungtaata capaa pakha ta Levi phang canung pakha kha napuv ta a chiy.
Canung ca nu phya te sacapaa a sa. A chiythesapa a cuopa kha a hmung tiyta thla thung chung a nu.
A nu khu li tli taata phiepahlaa kung ta ama sapa nu-yibaw kha la te, kattazaa hne thing cathliy kha a thuv khutaata capa chunglie ca haatiy kha khung te cavaa kie aphuv hrawlie kha a chi.
Khaapama a vya cuo aa tapa kha pachang riypata a uvtanung ta luohlaa taata a huo.

Faro sacanung kha tiy a siy riypata cavaa luo a vaw te ama a mangsangpa canung zaw ca cavaa kielie kha amaa khie. Siepahruo sacanung ca ta phiepahlaa hrawlie nu-yibaw kha hmung te ama a mangsangnung kha a pala sa.
A pahaw ca haaseta pakha kha a hmung. “Hingpa hing ca Hebru tie saata tana a cuo aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata a uvtanung ca ta Faro sacanung kyihuo khata, “Haatiy mangchiy riypa hingta Hebru canung pakha ica huvpa'a ma?” a ta.
Faro sacanung ca ta, “Cuo se,” a ta. Caacuonakawta haatiynung ca ta haaseta a nung kha a va ku.
Faro sacanung ta ama kha, “Hingpa haaseta hing la la kama cuota na mangsangpa tie. Na thavie muo ca ica pi aa,” a ta. Caacuonakawta capa nung ca ta haaseta ca a mangsang.
Haatiypa a kya le tiyta, Faro sacanung'a luo kha vaakhyi te, Faro sacanung ca ta a sacapaa ta aa la. “Tiy chungtaata i thuepa tana a cuo,” ta te, Moses ta pata ming a sa.
Moses a uvthyi khutaata, ning kha ca, a cawsaa tie'a luo kha vaa te rehruopa khuopuv ta ama pahrie sapa kha a hmung. Izipt cawsaa pakha ta a phang kha cawsaa Israel cawsaa pakha a tuvpa kha a hmung.
Hmiehmie pase te ahunghmuo a hmung li nakawta Izipt cawsaapa kha thie te viehnang chunglie a nu.
A mawluopa khata pya pakhaa te, Hebru ming pahning amaa tuvpa kha a hmung tiyta, a suepa paa kha, “Khaapanakawma na viesaa Hebru pa ca na tuv?” a ta.
Ama ta, “Ahungma nama hing kiema uvtuv bieripatuv ta caa chi? Izipt pa na thiepa haa khata ma ina thie khing ciy?” a ta. Moses ca a thlaa kya zang te, “I tuepa hmang hing ina pachang tli yi,” a ta.
Faro ta capa bie ca a thyi tiyta, Moses kha thie riypata a huv. Cuorasala Moses ca Faro'a taata aa ruo. Midian ruo luo chiy te takhue athaalie kha aa tu.
Midian tluobyipa ta sacanung pasariy a hnyi yi. Tiy the riypata a vaw yi te, ama paa sahring zaw kha tiy padang sa riypata hraky lie kha tiy ama pabi.
Cuorasala tuvkhietuv chekha a vaw yi te iema kha amaa cade. Moses ca thu te, iema kha a bya yi te ama sahring zaw kha tiy a padangpa yi.
Ama paa Reuel'a luo ama kaa tiyta, “Khaapanakawma ataning hing nama vya chiy patang?” a ta yi.
Iema ta, “Izipt pa pakha ta kiema kha tuvkhietuv tie kuv taata malie khuo te, tiy malie thepa te tuv hne mie zaw kha tiy a padang sa,” a ma ta.
Ama ta a sacanung zaw kyihuo khata, “Capa paa ca khaapaliema a aw? Khaapanakawma nama thuse siy? Sa ning riypata va ku tie ung,” a ta yi.
Moses ta capa cawsaapa'a lie aw riypa kha a palung tling te, ama ca ta a sacanung Zipporah kha Moses ca napuv riypata a pi.
Zipporah ta sacapaa sa te, Moses ta, “Kama ca malie ruo lieta khyche cuo angte i aw,” ta te, Gershom ta pata ming a sa.
Cuo pasiypuv khutaata Izipt siepahruo ca a thiy. Israel ming ca ama siicuona kawlieta a hrung yi te ama khi. Ama siicuona chung taa cata Khazing'a luo kha khi yi te abyana amaa hie.
Khazing ta amaa hrungnapa kha thyi te, Abraham, Isak, hne Jakob'a lie a biekuona kha aa thyi.
Khazing ta Israel ming kha hmung yi te, aa pachang sa yi.
Moses ca Midian tluobyipa, a puvpa Jethro sahring kha khie te, a sahring kha ruocaapa va lawkhyi te Khazing tluo ama tapa Horeb luo kha a chiy.
Capa lie ca Abyipaavuoming pakha ca ruohraw myi a kuopa myipalyi chungtaata ama'a lie kha aa luo. Moses ta a mang ca, ruohraw ca a hlaa ciemuo, cuorasala myi ta kuo vyi.
Cakhutaata Moses ta, “Vaa ngie vie'a angte na i hmungpa hingpa kharuehaa hmang hing i mang aa, khaapanakawma ruohraw hing a kuo va?” a ta.
Abyipata aa vya ngie viepa kha a hmung tiyta, ruohraw chung taa cata, “Moses, Moses!” ta pata a u. Moses ta, “Hingpa lie hingna i aw,” a ta.
Cakhutaata, “Naa vya ngie vie khah! Na phyipakaw kha thlie tie, tahematapakieca naa daana hmang hing a pathepa hmang tana a cuo,” a ta.
A ri vie kaliepa ca, “Kama ca na paa Khazing, Abraham Khazing, Isak Khazing hne Jakob Khazing tana i cuo,” a ta. Khazing mang riypa kha a ciy nakawta Moses ca a hmie kha a nu.
Cakhutaata Abyipata, “Izipt lie a awpa i cawsaa zaw ama hringriethyina kha i hmung tli; rehrituv tie nakawta ama khina ueryi kha i thyi tli. Ama te-angna kha i pachang tli.

Caacuonakawta iema kha Izipt ming kuv chungtaata lawna pi riypa hne khapa ruo taa khata a phapa hne a kupa ruo, Kanaan ming, Hit ming, Amor ming, Periz ming, Hiv ming, hne Jebus ming awnapa ruo, cuehnung hne khyitiy langnapa ruo luo a chiy riypata i zuv tli.
Israel ming ama khina ueryi ca kama'a luo kya chiy tli te, Izipt ming ta kha tluv tama ama hrisaa tapa kha i hmung tli.
Caacuonakawta a vaw tie, i cawsa Israel ming kha Izipt taata pyakhyi riypa tana Faro'a luo ica pathlie aa,” a ta.
Cuorasala Moses ta Khazing kha, “Faro'a luo vaa pata Israel ming kha Izipt taata pyakhyi riypata kama hing ahungtama i cuo?” a ta.

Ama ta, “Kama na caa awpuo'a ang; caa pathlietuv ca kama tana i cuo tanapa a paluosa riypa ca hingpa hing tana a cuo: cawsaa kha Izipt taata na pyakhyi tiy yi ta, hingpa tluo lie hing Khazing kha namaa bie aa,” a ta.

Cuorasala Moses ta Khazing kha, “Israel ming'a luo kha vaa'a angte iema kha, ‘Nama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing na niema'a luo hing naa vya pathlie,’ i ta tiy yi ta, iema ta, ‘A ming ahung ama ta ma?’ na ta yi sala tuokhaatama i palie'a yi?” a ta.
Khazing ta Moses kha, ‘KAMA CA KAMA TANA I CUO,’ a ta. A ri kaliepa ca, “Israel ming kha KAMA na niema'a luo hing naa pathlie, na va ta'a yi,’” a ta.

Khazing ta Moses kha, “Israel ming kha hing haa hingta na va ta'a yi, ‘Abyipa, nama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing, Abraham Khazing, Isak Khazing, hne Jakob Khazing na niema'a luo hing naa pathlie': Hingpa hingna chuozaa ta i ming ta a cuo, hingpa hingna chuo kha hnang chuo kha ina kuna riypa yi ta a cuo.

Vaa la Israel ming uvthyi tie kha pahmya yi la, “Abyipa, nama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing, Abraham Khazing, Isak Khazing, hne Jakob Khazing kha kama'a lie a luo te: Izipt ruo chunglie tuokhaatama aca tue yi tapa kha ica hmung mangtli yi.

Izipt ruo chunglie khuopuv ta nama palungriethyina taata, Kanaan ming, Hit ming, Amor ming, Periz ming, Hiv ming, hne Jebus ming ruo, cuehnung hne khyitiy langnapa ruo luo kha ica pyakhyi'a yi,’ a ta ta pata va chang tie yi.

Iema ta na bie kha aca naathlie'a yi. Nama hne uvthyi tie hne khata Izipt siepahruo'a luo kha vaa ung la, ‘Abyipa, Hebru ming Khazing na malie a taw; caacuonakawta Abyipa, ma Khazing kha abie riypata ning thung luosi a cuopa ruocaapa luo khana ma si aa, va ta tie ung,’ a ta yi.
Cadyiseca a cahrapa kuv ta hruohra ta nungpuo lipa kieca Izipt siepahruo hingta ca pasi sa'a va yi tapa kha i pachang.
I kuv pazuo'a angte, i tue riypa kharuehaa hmang hingta Izipt ming kha duo i te'a yi, cakhutaa dyi ca tana aca papya'a yi.
Hingpa mingphang hing Izipt ming'a lie hmiephaa pahmung sa'a yi angte, nama pya tiyta kuv cahripa ta pya'a va ung ciy.

Canung bangkhuo ta iema'a na ama ingpaa hne ama ing lie a awpa canung bangkhuo'a lie kha siy hne ngu, suethiy hne caw kha a hie'a yi te, nama sacanung nama sacapaa tie kha nama pahryi sa aa. Cahaacata Izipt ming ca ama chechiy kha nama chuv diy aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Moses ta, “Cuorasala iema ta na zang lipa yi ta, ‘Abyipanama'a lie a luo vyi,’ ina ta kie yi haw?” a ta.
Abyipata, “Na kuv lie a awpa kha khaapatama a cuo?” a ta. Ama ta, “Khuecahryi,” a ta.
Abyipata, “Alyi luo kha thaw tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta ama ta khuecahryi ca alyi luo kha a thaw ca, pariy ta a li te, Moses ca hnangluo kha aa saw.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kha, “Na kuv ta va paza la a lahmyi khata patuv tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Moses ta a kuv ta va paza te a patuv ca a kuv lie kha khuecahryi ta aa li pakhaa.
“Hing haa hingta na tue kieca Abyipa, ama mingchingmingvuo Khazing, Abraham Khazing, Isak Khazing, hne Jakob Khazing nama'a lie aa luopa kha aca zang'a yi,” a ta.
Abyipaca ta, “Na kuv kha na buohryi pasiypa raw luo chi tie,” a ta. A kuv ca buohryi pasiypa raw luo kha chi te aa da pakhaa ca a kuv kha caahminghmaa phya te cahue haata a ruo.
Cakhutaata Khazing ta, “Na kuv kha na buohryi pasiypa raw luo chi pakhaa tie,” a ta. A kuv kha a buohryi pasiypa raw luo chi pakhaa te aa da pakhaa ca a pangpa hrang luo haata a tluo pakhaa.
Nama kha ca zang lipa yi ta kharuehaa hmang suokhana zaw kha ama zang li kiema, kharuehaa hmang suohningna kha ca ama zang aa.

Hingpa kharuehaa hmang suohning hne nama kha aca zang li kie yi ca, Nail cavaa lieta tiy kha a cawta va la lah alyi huvpa kha na bya aa. Nail cavaa lieta na lapa tiy ca alyi lie kha thiy ta aa li aa,” a ta.

Cuorasala Moses ta Abyipakyihuo khata, “Vya i Byipaapa, a chuo ciepa cuo lie cuose, ata nama ta na changtaapa ina chaw khutaa zaw hing cata cuose, kama ca a bie ri a kiepa, a ca-ungca-aapa tana i cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipata, “Cawsaapa hing ahungma bie a pari sa? Ahungma bie ri the li pata tue te a naa a parue sa? Ahungma pahmung sa te a ming a pacue sa? AbyipaKama ta cuo va ang ma?
Caacuonakawta ata hingta cakuo la na palyi na pakaa lie ca awpuo'a angte na ri riypa kha ica pacuv aa,” a ta.
Cuorasala Moses ta, “Vya Abyipa, a hrangpa pakha kha pathlie thi tie,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Abyipaca Moses cunglie kha a hi haa te, “Levi pa Aaron hing na uvta cuo va ma? Ama ca bie ri a thesapa a cuopa kha i pachang. Ata hing hmuo nama a taw riypata a vaw te, aca hmung tiyta a palung a tluo hringhruo aa.
Na ri khingpa bie kha ama ca chang la, kama ta khaapama na ma ri aa tapa hne khaapama nama tue aa tapa kha ica pacuv'a yi.
Ama ta nama cuopa ta cawsaa'a luo kha bie ri'a te ama ca na pakaa ta a cuo aa. Nama ca ama cuota Khazing haata cuo'a cate a ri riypa a changtuv ta na cuo aa.
Khuecahryi hing a la lah, hingpa hingta kharuehaa hmang kha na tue aa,” a ta.
Moses ca a puvpa Jethro'a luo kha kaa te, “Izipt ruo lie i tieriy zaw kha ama hring kalie ma ta pata za mang riypata na pasi sa thi tie,” a ta. Jethro ta Moses kha, “Diena hne si tie,” a ta.
Abyipata Midian ruo lieta Moses kha chaw te, “Izipt luo kha kaa tie, tahematapakieca caa thie khingpa bangkhuo ca ama thiy diy tli,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Moses ca a napuv hne a sacapaa zaw kha laa cung luo khang yi te Izipt luo kha ama kaa. Moses ta a kuv chunglie kha Abyipakhuecahryi ca aa cyile.

Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kha, “Izipt luo na kaa tiyta, tue khu riypata ica pipa kharuehaa hmang zaw kha Faro hmielie ca va tue tie, cuorasala a palung kha pacuosa'a angte cawsaa kha pasi sa khing'a va yi.
Ca tiyta nama ta Faro kha, “Abyipana Israel ca i sacapaa uvthyi tana a cuo.
‘Kama abie riypata i sacapaa ca si se,’ caa ta. Cuorasala pasi sa khing vaciy. Caacuonakawta na sacapaa uvthyi khana i thie aa, aca ta, va ta tie,” a ta.
Luopuv lie zuo amaa rina lie kha Abyipata Moses kha a taw te thie aa nang.
Cuorasala Zipporah ta vuokhawlung cahrepa kha la te, a sacapaa vangdaw kha te te, capa ca ta Moses phyi kha pade sa te, “Nama ca vangdaw tenapa thiyse a palangtuv i navaapa tana na cuo,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Khazing ta Moses ca a pahring. Vangdaw tenapa a ri khingpa kha tana, Zipporah ta, “Vangdaw tena thueta thiyse palangtuv i navaapa,” a tanapa khata a cuo.
Abyipata Aaron kha, “Ruocaapa luo kha si la Moses kha vaa taw tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta si te, Ama ca Khazing tluo lie kha a taw te a pahnuo.
Moses ta Aaron kha Abyipata a pathlienapa bie bangkhuo hne tue riypata a changpa kharuehaa hmang zaw bangkhuo kaw kha a chang.
Cakhutaa cata Moses hne Aaron ta Israel ming uvthyi bangkhuo kha ama pahmya.
Aaron ta Moses'a lie Abyipata a ripa bie bangkhuo kha chang yi te, kharuehaa hmang zaw kha cawsaa zaw hmiekunglie ca a tue.
Cawsaa zaw ca ta ama zang. Abyipata Israel ming kha kaw malie pacuo te khuopuv ta ma palungriethyina kha malie a hmungpa tapa ama thyi tiyta a bung yi te amaa bie.

Cakhutaata Moses hne Aaron ca Faro'a luo kha vaa yi te, “Israel Khazing Abyipana, ‘I cawsaa zaw ta ruocaapa lie kha kama'a luo abiena pyi ama tue the riypata pathlie yi la,’ caa ta,” ta pata ama va chang.
Cuorasala Faro ta, “A bie a ngie'a angte, Israel ming i pasi riypa yi ta Abyipaca ahungma a cuo?” Abyipaca pachang va ang, Israel ming zaw pasi sa'a va yi ang,” a ta.

Cakhutaa cata iema ta, “Hebru ming Khazing kha kiema'a lie aa luo tli. Ning thung luosi a cuopa ruocaapa luo kha sipa sala ma Khazing Abyipakha vaa bie pase, caacuolikieca puvtlung pasana ta ma, zueziy ta ma na malie a thie aa,” ama ta.
Cuorasala Izipt siepahruo ca ta iema kha, “Moses hne Aaron, khaapanakawma cawsaa zaw re pahrie sa the li pata nama aw, nama re kha va hrie tie ung,” a ta yi.
Faro ta pazue te, “Ata hing iema ca hingpa ruo ming laa hingta hluv vie yi te, iema hing ma, re hrie li pata nama pa-aw sa khing?” a ta yi.
Capa ningpa cata Faro ta cawsaa zaw rehrituv tie hne re-uvtuv tie kha naw pi yi te,
“Cawsaa tie kha lungrue tuena riypata a hluo ning zaa ta sacuo kung pi khah ung, iemata tah sacuo kung kha a huv yi se, a ta.

Cuorasala ahluo ta ama tuepa zaa ta lungrue kha nama patue sa aa. Pachungpa hrahring'a va ung ciy. Tahematapakieca khaapanakawma ama thaa thuv te, ‘Malie pasi sa la Abyipa na ma vaa bie aa,’ ina ta yi.
Re ruv viepa kha ama cunglie khang ung la, capa ca hrie'a yi te, dungviena bie kha naathlie'a va yi, a ta.
Caacuonakawta rehrituv tie hne re-uvtuv tie ca cawsaa zaw'a luo kha vaa yi te, “Faro na, ‘Sacuo kung ca pi'a va yi ang.
Niemata tah khaapa taata a cuo zaw sacuo kung kha a huv tie ung, cuorasala nama re ca a cawta hehmuo pachungpa cuo'a vyi,’ caa ta yi,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta cawsaa ca sacuo kung huv riypata Izipt ruo ting khata amaa chepatlaa.
Rehrituv tie ta tangcahrue yi te, “Sacuo kung aca pi ning yi ta ning kha nama hriepa zaa kha nama patlung aa,” ama ta.

Rehrituv tie ca ta Faro re-uvtuv tie ta cawsaa zaw cunglie re-uvtuv ta ama chi pachaapa Israel ming ca tuv yi te, “Khaapanakawma azuochaning hne ataning hing nama tue tawpa zaa ta lungrue tue li pata nama aw?” ama ta.
Israel ming re-uvtuv tie ca Faro'a luo kha a vaw yi te, “Khaapanakawma na changtaapa zaw hing hing haa hingta malie na tue?
Na changtaapa zaw hing sacuo kung malie pi va yi. Cuorasala ‘Lungrue ca tue ung la,’ malie ama ta. Mang tie, na changtaapa zaw malie ama tuvpa hing. Na cawsaa zaw cunglie a dang vaciy,” ama ta.
Ama ta, “Nama thaa na a thuv, a thaa thiypa tana nama cuo; caacuonakawta muo, ‘Malie pasi sa la Abyipana ma vaa bie aa,’ nama ta ta.
Ata hingta vaa ung la re va hrie ung; sacuo kung ca ca pi'a va yi, cuorasala lungrue ca nama tue tawpa zaa nama tue ngiethie aa,” a ta yi.
Israel ming re-uvtuv tie ca, “Nama za tue tawpa zaa khana lungrue ca nama tue ngiethie aa,” a ta nakaw yi ta ruvna chungliena ima aw tli tapa kha ama pachang.
Faro'a taata ama pya pahne ta a taw riypata iema a huo nguoluopa yi Moses hne Aaron'a luo kha ama vaa.

Iema ta, “Abyipata ca za hmung yi sala nama cunglie biechina za tue se. Faro hne a kuv raw byi tie ta malie ama hue the riypa hne malie ama thie the riypa tana ama kuv lie zueziy nama chi tli,” a ma ta.
Cakhutaa cata Moses ca Abyipa'a luo kha a pali te, “Vya Abyipakhaapanakawma hingpa cawsaa tie hing na hrisaa yi? Khaapanakawma kama hing ina pathlie ciy?
Na ming ta Faro'a luo bie ri riypata i vaw taa ning taata, hingpa cawsaa tie hing hrisaa yi te, na cawsaa zaw palaw sa riypata khaapahmuo tue tlung vaciy,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kha, “Ata hing ca Faro cunglie khaapama i tue aa tapa kha na hmung'a tli: Kama cahrana thueta iema kha pasi sa'a yi te, kama cahrana thueta iema kha a ruo chungtaata aa cade'a yi,” a ta.
Khazing zaw ta Moses kha, “Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo.
Kama ca Abraham, Isak, hne Jakob zaw'a luo kha Lesyice Khazing cuona ta i zaa luo, cuorasala Abyipatapa ming ta a luo angte, iema kha a pachang sa va yi ang.
Iema hne khata khyche haata ama za awnapa Kanaan ruo kha pi riypata biekuona zaw i za tue.
Izipt ming ta sii haata ama za tuepa Israel ming amaa hrungnapa ueryi zaw kha thyi angte i biekuo kha maw va ang.

Caacuonakawta Israel ming i changpa yi ca, ‘Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo. Kama ta Izipt ming siicuona taa hingta niema kha ica palaw sa'a yi. I vya pazuopa i buo hne a cahrapa i bieripana ta niema kha ica khuo yi.

Niema kha i cawsaa ta caa la'a yi angte, kama ca nama Khazing ta i cuo aa. Niema ta kama ca Abyipahne nama Khazing ta i cuopa hne Izipt ming siicuona taata caa palawsapa i cuopa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy.
Kama ta Abraham, Isak, hne Jakob zaw kyihuo ta niema huo tana ica pi'a yi ta angte bie i kuopa yi ruo chung luo khana i caa chiy'a yi. Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo,’” a ta.
Moses ta capa ca Israel ming kha chang yi te, cuorasala ama sii cuona kha pasa tuv te ama palung a chuo tuv nakawta iema ta Moses kha naathlie va yi.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata,
“Cakuo la Izipt siepahruo Faro kha a ruo taata Israel ming a papya sa riypa yi ta va chang tie,” a ta.
Cuorasala Moses ta Abyipakha, “Israel ming ta i bie kha na naathlie va yi; tuokhaatama Faro ta ina naathlie aa? Kama bie ri a the lipa paa hing,” a ta.
Cahaacata Abyipata Moses hne Aaron'a lie kha bie ri te, Israel ming'a nata Izipt siepahruo Faro kaw hne aa patuvpa khata naw pi yi te, Israel ming kha Izipt ruo taata palaw sa riypa yi ta a chang yi.
A raw luo'a pa tie hing ama phang ciypathlatuv zaw ta ama cuo: Israel sacapaa uvthyi Reuben sacapaa zaw ca: Hanok, Pallu, Hezron, hne Karmi; hingpa hing Reuben phang ta ama cuo.
Simeon sacapaa zaw: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakhin, Zohar hne Kanaan zaanung sacapaa Shaul; hingpa tie hing Simeon phang ta ama cuo.
A raw luo hing thukina hne aa patuv pata Levi sacapaa zaw ming ta a cuo: Gershon, Kohath, hne Merari. Levi ca zakha sawthung kung sariy a hring.
Gershon sacapaa zaw: ama phang ming ta Libni hne Shimei.
Kohath sacapaa zaw: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, hne Uzziel ta ama cuo. Kohath ca zakha sawthung kung thung a hring.
Merari sacapaa zaw: Mahli hne Mushi. Hingpa tie hing Levi ming thukina hne aa patuv pata ama phang ta a cuo.
Amram ta a paa siicanung Jokhebed kha a hlaw te Aaron hne Moses kha a sa yi. Amram ca zakha sawthung kung sariy a hring.
Izhar sacapaa zaw ca: Korah, Nepheg, hne Zikhri ta ama cuo.
Izziel sacapaa zaw ca: Mishael, Elzafan, hne Sithri ta ama cuo.
Aaron ca Amminadab sacanung, Nahshon sietanung Elisheba hne khata a hlaw yi te, Nadab;, Abihu, Eleazar, hne Ithamar kha a sa yi.
Korah sacapaa zaw: Assir, Elkanah, hne Abiasaf ta ama cuo. Hingpa tie hing Korah chung ta ama cuo.
Aaron sacapaa Eleazar ta Putiel sacanung zaw chungtaata pakha kha a hlaw te Phinehas a sa. Hingpa tie hing Levi ming a chung a chung ta ciypathlatuv tie ta ama cuo.
Abyipata, “Israel ming ca a phuv a phuv ta Izipt ruo taa hingta pyakhyi tie ung,” a tapa ca hingpa Aaron hne Moses hing tana ama cuo.
Izipt ruo taata Israel ming papya riypata Izipt siepahruo Faro'a luo bie a ripa ca hingpa Moses hne Aaron hing tana ama cuo.
Izipt ruo chunglie Khazing ta Moses'a lie bie a ri ning kha,
“Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo; nama'a lie ica changpa hing Izipt siepahruo Faro'a luo kha va chang tie,” a ta.
Cuorasala Moses ta Abyipahmiekunglie kha, “Kama ca bie ri a the lipa tana i cuo, tuokhaatama Faro ta ina naathliepa aa? a ta.
Abyipata Moses kha, “Mang tie, Faro'a luo kha nama ca Khazing haata ca tue'a angte, na uvta Aaron ca na profet ta a cuo aa.
Kama ta naw ica pipa kha nama ta ri'a cate, na uvta Aaron ta a ruo chungtaata Israel ming papya riypa kha Faro ca a chang aa.
Cuorasala kama ta Faro palung kha pacuo sa'a angte Izipt ruo chunglie kharuehaa hmang kha a hluvsa i tue aa.

Faro ta niema kha aca naathlie li tiy yi ta, Izipt ming cunglie kha i kuv pathlie'a angte, a lepa duotena i patlung khutaata i cawsaa Israel ming kha Izipt ruo chung taa khata a phuv a phuv ta i pyakhyi'a yi.
I buo ca Izipt ming'a luo kha pazuo'a angte iema chungtaata Israel ming i pyakhyi tiy yi ta, Izipt ming ta Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi,” a ta.
Abyipata naw a pipa yi haa khata Moses hne Aaron ta ama tue.
Faro'a luo bie ama ri ning kha Moses ca kung sawcari ta te, Aaron ca sawcari kung thung a ta.
Abyipata Moses hne Aaron kha,
“Faro ta kharuehaa hmang ca tue tie ung, aca ta tiy yi ta, nama ta Aaron kha, ‘Na khuecahryi kha la lah Faro hmiekunglie kha thaw tie, pariy ta aa li aa,’ na ta aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Moses hne Aaron ca Faro'a luo kha cakuo yi te Abyipata a changpa haa yi khata ama tue. Aaron ta a khuecahryi kha Faro hne a rehrietuv byi zaw hmiekunglie kha thaw te pariy ta aa li.
Cakhutaa cata Faro ta Izipt mingsing tie, ca-ie a thepa tie hne Izipt ming pacuo a thepa tie kha ku yi te iema zaw ta cahaacata ama tue khu ra.
Pakha cyicuo ta ama khuecahryi kha thaw yi te pariy ta amaa li ra; cuorasala Aaron huopa ta a paluo diy yi.
Faro ca a palung cuosa ngiethie kalie te, Abyipaa ripa haa khata iema bie kha a ngie khing vyi.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kha, “Faro palung ca a cuo ciemuo. Cawsaa kha pasi sa khing va yi.
Faro'a luo kha cavaa luo a cakuo cuo ning, mawdiy ta vaa la, ama a taw riypata cavaa kielie kha vaa daa la pariy ta zaa lipa khuecahryi kha na kuv lie a cyi tie.

Ama kha, ‘Abyipa, Hebru ming Khazing na, “Ruocaapa chunglie kama kha inaa bie riypa yi ta i cawsaa zaw kha pasi sa tie yi,” ta pata nama chang riypata naa vya pathlie. Cuorasala ata tepa hingta naathlie vaciy.
Caacuonakawta Abyipana, “Hingpa hing tana kama ca Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a ciy,” caa ta. Mang tie, i kuv lie a awpa khuecahryi hingta Nail cavaa lie tiy hing a hluo'a angte thiy ta aa li aa.
Cavaa chunglie a awpa ngaa kha thiy'a yi te, cavaa ca thuv'a te Izipt ming ta Nail lieta tiy kha dang khu the'a va yi,’ a ta,” a ta.

Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata, “Aaron kha chang tie, ‘Na khuecahryi kha a la lah Izipt ruo chunglie a awpa cavaa cuose, tiypalang cuose, tiypa-ang cuose, tiy-ang cuose, tiy bangkhuo cunglie kha na kuv kha pazuo tie. Tiy ca thiyse ta aa li aa; Izipt ruocaapa bangkhuo lie thing sawkaw chunglie tiy hne alung sawkaw chunglie tiy te khata thiy ta amaa li diy aa,’ ta pata chang tie,” a ta.
Moses hne Aaron ca Abyipata a changpa haa yi khata ama tue. Faro hne a rehrietuv byi zaw hmielie kha Aaron ta cavaa tiy kha a khuecahryi khata a chi. Cavaa chunglie tiy bangkhuo ca thiy ta a li te,
cavaa chunglie ngaa ca ama thiy. Cavaa ca pahnuosa te Izipt ming ca cavaa tiy kha dang khu va yi. Izipt ruo chung bangkhuo ca thiy selaw ta a cuo.

Cuorasala Izipt ruo chunglie pacuo a thepa tie ta ama thenapa ta cahaacata ama tue khu ra. Caacuonakawta Faro palung ca a cuo tawpa haa khata cuo ngiethie te Abyipaa ripa haa khata iema bie kha naathlie vyi.
Faro ta capa kaw ca siysaa hehmuo ri li pata a ing luo kha a kaa.
Cadyiseca Izipt ming ca cavaa tiy kha ama dang khu li nakawta dang riypa tiy ama hmung the riypata Nail cavaa kie bangkhuo kha khue ama cule.
Abyipata Nail a tuv khutaata ning sariy a law tli.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kha, “Faro'a luo kha vaa la va chang tie, ‘Abyipana: Kama inaa bie the riypa yi ta i cawsaa zaw hing pasi sa tie yi.
Iema si riypa hing na thlu kie yi ca, na ruo chung bangkhuo hing ca-uv tana nang-uoruvnaana i pi aa.

Cavaa ca ca-uv ta a bi aa. Na siepahruo ing luo kha a khaw'a yi te, naa ziena khuo, na iehmang cung, na rehrietuv byi tie hne na cawsaa zaw ing chung, na buvca hne viechuo na nawnapa bikang chung te khata amaa ngie aa.
Ca-uv ca nama hne na cawsaa zaw, hne na rehrietuv byi tie cung te khata a kie aa,’ caa ta, va ta tie,” a ta.

Cakhutaa cata Abyipata Moses ca, “Aaron kha chang la, ‘Cavaa cung luo hne tiyluopuv cung luo hne, tiypa-ang cung luo kha na khuecahryi kha patuv pata na buo kha pazuo la, Izipt ruo chung luo ca-uv a kie riypata tue tie,’ va ta tie,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Aaron ta Izipt ruo tiy bangkhuo cung luo ca a buo kha a pazu ca, ca-uv ca kya kie te Izipt ruo chung bangkhuo khata a bi.
Cuorasala pacuo a thepa tie ta cahaacata tue khu ra yi te ca-uv ca Izipt ruo chung luo kha a kya kie.

Cakhutaata Faro ta Moses hne Aaron kha ku yi te, “Kama hne i cawsaa zaw'a taata ca-uv kha a la riypata Abyipa'a luo kha thlaachuo tie ung. Caacuokieca Abyipaabie riypata cawsaa zaw kha i pasi sa'a yi, a ta.

Moses ta Faro kha, “Nama hne na ing taata ca-uv kha pya diy yi sala Nail cavaa lie dyi ama aw riypata nama hne na rehrie byi tie, hne na cawsaa zaw cuota khatiythuema thlaa i chuo aa tapa kha na chang thi tie,” a ta.
Faro ta, “Mawluo,” a ta. Moses ta, “Na ripa haata a cuo aa. Abyipama Khazing haapa khazing pakha hmuo a aw lipa kha na pachangna riypata,
ca-uv ca nama hne na ing hne na rehrietuv byi tie hne na cawsaa zaw kha ca pyase'a yi te, Nail cavaa lie dyi ama aw aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Moses hne Aaron ca Faro'a taa khata ama pya. Faro cunglie a patlungsuepa ca-uv kawlie ca ta Moses ca Abyipa'a luo kha khuopuv ta thlaa a chuo.
Moses ta a hiepa haata Abyipata tue te, ing chunglie, tlawhmie lie, hne ruo lie a awpa ca-uv bangkhuo kha ama thiy diy.
Izipt ming ta pakhaw yi te ama papung ca ruo ting ta a pahnuo diy.
Faro ta hmang a cuopa a vya pha viepa kha a hmung tiyta, a palung kha cuo pakhaa te Abyipaa ripa haa khata iema bie kha naathlie li pata a aw.

Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata, “Aaron kha chang la, ‘Na kuv kha pazuo la na khuecahryi khata alyi lie buvcing kha tuv tie, Izipt ruo chunglie buvcing bangkhuo khata macing tana aa li aa,’ va ta tie,” a ta.

Cahaacata ama tue. Aaron ta a khuecahryi patuv te a buo kha pazuo te alyi lie buvcing kha a chi. Buvcing ca macing ta a li te cawsaa hne sahring kha a baw ta a baw yi. Izipt ruo chung bangkhuo alyi lie buvcing ca macing ta aa li diy.
Pacuo a thepa tie ta ama thena ta macing papya ra riypa kha amaa zue ca, tue khu va yi. Macing ca cawsaa hne sahring cunglie kha amaa cang.
Pacuo a thepa tie ta Faro kha, “Hingpa hing ca Khazing tuepa hmang tana a cuo,” ama ta. Cuorasala Faro ca a palung cuosa ngiethie te, Abyipaa ripa haa khata iema bie kha naathlie li pata a aw.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kha, “Mawdiy ta thu la Faro kha cavaa luo a cakuo ningta vaa taw la, “Abyipana: Kama inaa bie riypa yi ta i cawsaa zaw kha pasi sa tie yi.

I cawsaa zaw kha na pasi sa li kie yi ca thuhring na ica pathliesue'a yi. Nama, na rehrietuv byi tie, hne na cawsaa zaw, hne nama ing chung luo, hne Izipt ming bangkhuo ing chunglie ama awnapa alyi lie te kha tana thuhring ta ama bi aa.
Hingpa ruo lie hing kama hingna Abyipata a cuo ang tapa kha ina pachang riypa cata capa ning lie ca i cawsaa zaw awnapa Goshen ca pangaa'a angte, capa lie ca thuhring sakha hmuo aw'a vyi.
Cahaacata i cawsaa hne na cawsaa zaw kha i pananang'a yi. Capa kharuehaa hmang ca mawluo a tlung aa,” a ta.
Khazing ta cahaacata tue hmisi te thuhring ca a buv lesa pata a vya zu yi te Faro ing hne a rehrietuv byi tie ing luo kha amaa vya ngie. Izipt ruo chung bangkhuo ca thuhring ca ta a para.
Cakhutaa cata Faro ta Moses hne Aaron kha ku yi te, “Vaa ung la hingpa ruo chunglie hing nama Khazing ca abie tie ung,” a ta yi.

Cuorasala Moses ta, “Cahaacata tue riypata pha'a vyi. Tahematapakieca kiema ta Abyipa'a luo hriykhungrina ta ma pipa kha Izipt ming ta ama duvsapa tana a cuo. Izipt ming hmiekunglie kha ama duvsapa ta hriykhungrina ma tue kieca alung ta malie vaa'a va yi ma?
Ama ta malie a changpa haa kha tana ning thung luosi a cuopa ruocaapa luo kha si'a pate Abyipama Khazing kha maa bie aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Faro ta, “Ruocaapa chunglie Abyipanama Khazing abie riypata ica pasi sa'a yi. Luohlaatuv luo ca si khya ung. Thlaa na chuopa tie ung,” a ta yi.

Cakhutaa cata Moses ta, “Nama'a taata i cakuo pahne hingta Abyipa'a luo kha thlaachuo'a angte, mawluo lie khiy thuhring ca nama hne na rehrietuv byi tie hne na cawsaa zaw'a taata ama pya aa. Cadyiseca Abyipa'a luo hriykhung a ri riypata cawsaa zaw kha pasi sa li pata aw'a vaciy,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Moses ca Faro'a taa khata pya te Abyipa'a luo kha thlaa a chuo.
Khazing ta Moses a hiepa haa khata tue te: thuhring ca Faro hne a rehrietuv byi tie hne a cawsaa tie'a taa khata phe diy te sakha hmuo a tuo vyi.
Cuorasala ata cuo lie zaw hing Faro ca a palung cuosa ngiethie te cawsaa kha pasi sa khing va yi.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kha, “Faro'a luo kha vaa la, ‘Hebru Khazing Abyipana: Kama inaa bie riypa yi ta i cawsaa zaw kha pasi sa tie yi.
I cawsaa zaw si riypa kha thlu yi cate na patuv kie yi ca,
Abyipakuv na, ruo lie a awpa nama sahring: aruo, laa, kala-uv, cue, tuv hne mie zaw kha puvtlung pasana ta a de'a yi.
Cuorasala Abyipata Israel ming sahring hne Izipt ming sahring kha pananang'a te Israel ming hnyipa sahring ca sakha hmuo thiy'a vyi.'”
Abyipata a cuo thli tli te, “Capa hmang ca mawluo na hingpa ruo chunglie hing a tue aa, va ta tie,” a ta.
A mawluopa ca Abyipata tue hmisi te, Izipt ming sahring bangkhuo ca a thiy diy, cuorasala Israel ming sahring ca sakha hmuo thiy vyi.
Faro ta a khieluo ca Israel ming sahring sakha hmuo a thiy lipa kha a pachang. Cuorasala Faro ca a palung cuosa ngiethie te cawsaa kha pasi sa khing va yi.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses hne Aaron kha, “Buvca lie buvcuo kha nama pazaa ta va phuo ung la capa buvcuo ca Moses ta Faro hmiekunglie kha thliy luo va hi se.
Capa buvcuo ca Izipt ruo chung bangkhuo kha buvcing haata a zu'a te Izipt ruo chung bangkhuo lie a awpa cawsaa hne saruopa cunglie kha khiyhliy a pathla sa'a yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta buvca lieta buvcuo kha la yi te Faro hmiekunglie ca amaa daa. Moses ca buvcuo ca thliy chung luo kha hi te capa ca ta cawsaa hne saruopa cunglie kha khiyhliy a pathla sa yi.
Pacuo a thepa tie ca Moses hmiekunglie kha a daa khu va yi, tahematapakieca Izipt ming bangkhuo haa khata pacuo a thepa tie zaw kha khiyhliy ta a thla ra yi.
Cuorasala Abyipata Faro palung kha pacuo sa te, Abyipata Moses'a lie a ripa haa khata iema bie kha naathlie li pata a aw.
Cakhutaata Khazing ta Moses kha, “Mawdiy ta thu la Faro'a luo kha vaa la, ‘Hebru ming Khazing Abyipana: Kama kha inaa bie riypa yi ta i cawsaa zaw kha pasi sa tie yi.

Hingpa alyi lie hing kama haapa pakha hmuo aw va yi tapa kha na pachang riypata, ata hing ca nama hrahring, na rehrietuv byi zaw, hne na cawsaa zaw cunglie kha nang-uoruvnaana bangkhuo i patlung sa aa.
Ata taa hingta i buo hing pazuo ang sala nama hne na cawsaa zaw kha puvtlung pasana ta ica tuv kie yi ca alyi lie hing aw'a va tli ung ciy.
Cuorasala i cahranapa kha pahmung sa riypa hne alyi cung bangkhuo lie i ming ri paripa a cuo riypata nama kha ica pahring.
Nama ca i cawsaa zaw'a lie kha a pale cate pasi sa khing va yi ciy.
Mawluo ata tiy hingta Izipt ruo a zaa daa baataata ata tepa ta a aw buo lipa ari pangkatupa kha i patla sa aa.

Caacuonakawta nama sahring hne ale lie a awpa hmang hrangpa bangkhuo kha canawna hmang luo khung diy ung la ta pata chang tie yi. Cawsaa cuose, sahring cuose ale lie aw te, canawna hmang lie a aw lipa bangkhuo ca a ri ta de'a yi te ama thiy aa,’ va ta tie yi,” a ta.
Abyipaa ciypa Faro rehrietuv byi tie ca ama sii tie hne ama sahring kha canawna hmang luo ama chi pahraa.
Abyipabie kha siysaa a ri lipa tie ca ama sii tie hne ama sahring zaw kha ale lie ca ama pa-aw sa.
Abyipata Moses kha, “Izipt ruo chung bangkhuo lie cawsaa cunglie, sahring cunglie hne lu lie a pupa sa kung cunglieta ari a tla riypata na buo kha avuo luo pazu tie,” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata Moses ta a khuecahryi kha avuo luo a pazu ca, Abyipata khalung hne ari kha pathlie te alyi luo kha thinghlaa a zaa cakang. Cahaacata Abyipata Izipt ruo lie ca ari a patla sa.
Thinghlaa a cakang te ari ca aa pazuepa ta a tla. Izipt ruo a zaa daa baataata cahaapaapa a ri pangkatupa ca tla buo vyi.
Izipt ruo chung bangkhuo lie a le lie a awpa bangkhuo ca cawsaa hne sahring hne ari ca ta a de diy yi. Lu chunglie sa kung bangkhuo zaw kha para diy te, thingkungpa bangkhuo kha a thli diy.
Israel ming khy ama sanapa Goshen ruo lie kyalya dyi kha ari tla li pata a aw.

Cakhutaata Faro ta Moses hne Aaron kha ku yi te, “Ata lie ca kama na a sue ang; Abyipaca a hmuo te kama hne i cawsaa zaw ca ma paa. Abyipa'a luo kha thlaachuo tie ung! Khazing khalung hne ari ca a de buo se! Ica pasi sa'a yi; a syi aw'a va tli ung ciy,” a ta yi.
Abyipa'a luo kha thla chuo tie! Khazing khalung hne ari ca aa desa tli. Ica pathlie'a tli, na aw vie kalie a hu va tli,” a ta.

Moses ta, “Nama ta hingpa alyi hing Abyipahuopa tana a cuo tapa kha na pachang the riypata, khypuv taa hingta i pya pahne ta Abyipa'a luo kha i buo pazuo'a angte, khalung ca die'a te a ri tla'a va tli.
Cuorasala nama hne na rehrietuv byi tie ta AbyipaKhazing ciy va ung ciy tapa kha ica pachang yi.
(Buri kung hne barli ca a ra diy, tahematapakieca barli ca a uv uv tli te buri kung ca a daw a paruo ningta a cuo.
Cuorasala jungsacuo hne sapang ca ra va yi, tahematapakieca iema ca ama vyi haa vie.)
Caacuonakawta Moses ca Faro kha cakuose te khypuv taa khata a pya. Abyipa'a luo kha a buo ca pazuo te khalung hne ari kha die yi te alyi luo khy za saa va tli.
Cuorasala Faro ta khy saapa hne ari hne khalung a diepa kha a hmung tiyta yi kha sue vie pakhaa te, ama hne a rehrietuv byi tie hneta ama palung kha amaa pacuo sa pakhaa hyi.
Caacuonakawta Faro ca a palung kha cuosa te, Abyipata Moses'a lie a ripa haa khata Israel ming kha pasi sa khing va yi.

Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kha, “Faro'a luo kha cakuo tie; tahematapakieca kama ta iema hrawlie hingpa kharuehaa hmang hing i paluo sa the riypata ama hne a rehrietuv byi tie palung kha i pacuo sa tli.

Cakhutaata niema ta kama ca Abyipai cuopa kha nama pachang riypata, tuokhaatama Izipt ming kha a ngaapa ta tue yi angte khaapa kharuehaa hmang ma iema hrawlie i tue tapa kha nama saata hne nama samingta zaw nama chang riypata a cuo aa,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Moses hne Aaron ca Faro'a luo kha vaa yi te, “Hebru ming KhazingAbyipata, ‘Khacuo ma i hmiekunglie hing nama hne nama kha a pane khing li pata na aw aa? Kama kha inaa bie riypa yi ta i cawsaa zaw kha pasi sa tie yi.
I cawsaa zaw kha pasi sa li pata na aw kieca mawluo khiy na ruo chung luo khawbyapa i vya pathlie aa.
Alyi kha buv diy'a yi te ahungtahmuo alyi kha hmung khu'a va yi. Ari ta a de khutaata aa ngaapa kha ce diy'a yi te ruo lieta a pupa thingkung bangkhuo zaw kha ama ce diy aa.

Na ing lie hne, na rehrietuv byi tie ing lie hne Izipt ming zaw ing lie kha ama bi aa. Nama paa tie hne nama mingpa tie zaw alyi luo ama za puv baataata ataning tepa hingta cahaapa ca hmung buo pata cuo vyi,’ a ta,” a ta. Cakhutaa cata a pali te Faro'a taa cata a pya.
