Faro a rehrietuv byi tie ta ama kha, “Khacuo te ma hingpa paa hingta ruvnaana malie a pi aa? Abyipaama Khazing bie riypata cawsaa ca si yi se. Izipt a ra tlipa hing pachang va ca ma?” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Moses hne Aaron ca Faro'a luo kha a vya chiy pakhaa yi te, iema kyihuo khata, “Si ung la Abyipanama Khazing ca vaa bie tie ung. Cuorasala ahung zaw ma a si'a ung ciy?” a ta yi.

Moses ta, “Abyipaabiena pyi kha tue riypa ma cuo nakawta, ma mingnu tie hne ma nungpuv macuo tie, ma sacapaa tie hne ma sacanung tie, ma tuv hne ma mie, hne ma cue zaw bangkhuo hne tana ma si aa,” a ta.
Faro ta iema kyihuo khata, “Abyipata caa bya yi se. Canung hne haatiy ca sikhyina naw ca pi va yi ang. Atingna pha lipa na nama hnyi tapa kha a siesa.

Cuo vyi, cuo buo hluo'a vyi! Niema capaa tie kha si'a ung cate Abyipaca namaa bie aa, tahematapakieca capa ca na inaa hiepa ung cata a cuo,” a ta. Cakhutaa cata iema ca Faro hmiekung taa khata amaa cade.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kha, Izipt ruo kha khawbyapa ta buv'a te ari ta a pangaapa alyi lie a pupa bangkhuo a ce diy riypata na kuv kha Izipt ruo cunglie ca pazu tie,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Moses ta Izipt ruo cunglie kha a khuecahryi ca pazu te, Abyipata capa ruo luo ca ning-aw ningtlabu hne zuo khydyi ta ningchiy thliy kha a pahruo sa. Mawluo maw ta ca ningchiy thliy ca ta khawbyapa kha a vya phyale.
Khawbyapa ca Izipt ruo alyi bangkhuo lie kha aw te ruo chung bangkhuo kha a bi. Ca zaa nanaapa khawbyapa ca a hluo zaw za aw buo li pata hmieluo zaw aw pakhaa buo'a va tli.

Ruo bangkhuo kha a buv ta buv yi te, alyi ca a vaw ta a vaw. Ari ta a pangaapa alyi lie a pupa thingkungruokung bangkhuo hne thingthyi bangkhuo kha ama ce diy; thinghnaa hringpa suokha hmuo a ngaa vyi, Izipt ruo chung bangkhuo lie thingkungruokung suokha hmuo a ngaa vyi.
Faro ta Moses hne Aaron kha a catlisa pata ku yi te, “AbyipaKhazing'a lie hne niema'a lie kha i sue tli.
I suenapa kha ata luo kha hing ca naa ngiethe ung la, hingpa thiyna duotena hing Abyipanama Khazing ta ina phepa riypata thlaachuo tie ung,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta Faro'a taa khata pya te Abyipa'a luo kha thlaa a chuo.
Abyipata thliy kha a cahrasapa ningtla thliy ta thle te, capa ca ta khawbyapa kha phya diy te Riyliy Sepa luo a pasi diy. Izipt ruo chung bangkhuo lie khawbyapa sakha hmuo thuse vyi.
Cuorasala Abyipata Faro palung kha pacuo sa te Israel ming kha pasi sa khing va yi.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kha, “Izipt ruo chunglie a zing tuv pata a ping ta a pingpa zingna a tlung riypata na buo kha avuo luo pazu tie,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Moses ta a buo kha avuo luo pazuo te Izipt ruo chung bangkhuo lie kha a zing tuv pata a ping ta a pingpa zingna kha ning thung chung a tlung.
Ning thung chung cawsaa kha pakha hne pakha a hmung the lipa yi ta ama awna taata a hnyi the va yi. Cuorasala Israel ming bangkhuo ama awna lie ca khena a aw.
Cakhutaa cata Faro ta Moses kha ku te, “Si ung la Abyipaca vaa bie tie ung. Nama tuv hne nama mie, hne nama cue dyi khana nama thuse siy aa. Nama haatiy tie kha hmuo namaa chiyle aa,” a ta.
Cuorasala Moses ta, “Abyipama Khazing'a lie hriykhung a rina riypa hne myirue panaana pi riypa na malie na pi a hu aa.

Ma sahring kha sakha hmuo thuse li pata ma sikhyi aa hu aa. Tahematapakieca abiena hmang luo ma chiyna te ta Abyipaabiena riypata khaapa hing ma ma hmuo aa tapa kha ma pachang li lie nakaw hne Abyipama Khazing abiena riypa kha maa tlaw chaw aa hu nakaw tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cuorasala Abyipata Faro palung kha a pacuo sa nakawta iema pasi sa riypa kha khing vyi.
Cakhutaa cata Faro ta Moses kha, “Kama'a taa hingta pya! I hmie ina hmung pakhaa li riypa cata a raaring. I hmie ina hmung ningpa lie ca na thiy ning tana a cuo aa,” a ta.
Moses ta, “Na ripa haa cata cuo se! Khatiy ning hmuo na hmie ca hmung'a va tli ang,” a ta.
Abyipata Moses kha, “Faro hne Izipt ming cunglie kha nang-uoruvnaana a hrangpa suokha i patlung sa vie aa. Cakhutaa cata aca pasi sa'a yi; aca pasi sa tiy yi ta a cade ta acaa cade'a yi.
Na cawsaa zaw kha chang yi la capaa ta a ingpaa capaa kha cuose, canung ta a ingpaa canung kha cuose, siy hne ngu ta tuepa suethiy kha a hie yi se,” a ta.

Abyipata a cawsaa tie kha Izipt ming hmiekunglie hmiephaa a pahmung sa yi. Ca hlyitaw taata, Moses hrahring kha Faro rehrietuv byi tie hne cawsaa zaw ta Izipt ruo lieta cawsaa lepa pakha ta ama hmung.
Moses ta, “Abyipata: Izipt ruo bangkhuo kha zuocang ta i khie aa.

Izipt lieta sa-uvthyi bangkhuo ama thiy aa. A byithude lie a tupa Faro sa-uvthyi taata pathu pata sacuo riena lie re a hriepa siizaanung sa-uvthyi te, hne sahring ta a pachuo taapa sa-uvthyi bangkhuo ama thiy diy aa.
Cakhutaata Izipt ruo chung bangkhuo a zaa aw buo lipa hne a aw buo li tli riypa caana ueryi khuopuv ta a aw aa.
Cuorasala Abyipata Izipt ming hne Israel ming a pananangnazya yi kha nama pachangna riypata Israel ming ca cawsaa cuose, sahring cuose uv tahmuo nga'a va yi.

Cakhutaa cata hingpa na rehrietuv byi tie bangkhuo hing kama'a luo a zuv'a yi te, i hmiekunglie a bung'a yi te, ‘Nama hne caa ziypa na cawsaa zaw hne khata malie pyase thi tie ung,’ ina ta'a yi. Cakhutaa cata i pya aa,” a ta. Hihaasana cangta Faro'a taa cata a pya.
Abyipata Moses ca, “Izipt ruo lie kama kharuehaa hmang tuena a hluv hryly thena riypata, Faro ta na bie hing ca naathlie'a vyi,” a ta.
Moses hne Aaron ta hingpa kharuehaa hmang bangkhuo hing Faro hmiekunglie ama tue; cuorasala Abyipata Faro palung kha a pacuo sa nakawta, Israel ming kha a ruo taata papya sa khing va yi.
Izipt ruo lie kha Abyipata Moses hne Aaron kyihuo khata:
Ata thlaa hing thlaa zaw a pathanapa; niema cuota kung khana lie thla taapa ta a cuo aa.
Israel ming cawsaazaapuv kha chang yi la, ata thlaa a ning hraanapa ning hing ingchungkhue khue kha ta tuvtaata sakha kaluo namaa sang aa.
Tuv sakha yalya ce riypata ingchungkhue kha nama cawtuv pata a cuo kieca; namaa ngie cepa ingpaa hneta sakha kha a hraw'a ung cate, a ce riypa mingluv ri pata namaa re aa.
Tuv acuolikie mie kha a tlaw'a cate, a dutlapa hne kung kha a ta pata a cuo aa.
Ata thlaa ning hraa hlyipaliy te khiy a chi'a ung cate, aa hmyapa Israel ming cawsaazaapuv ta zuoluo ningtla caw ta ama thie kaluo aa.
A thiy chekha kha la'a yi te saa ama cenapa ing ingchiypakaa tung tung hning hne a cung luo tluo lie kha ama thuv aa.
Capa zuo ca ta saa ca myi lie kha a e ta e'a ung cate thiynung phuv lipa viechuo hne uocuokhaa hne khata namaa hmie aa.
A hringpa ta cuose, pasupa ta cuose ce'a va ung ciy. Cuorasala myi lie kha a luv, a phyi, a chungriy zaw hne khata e'a ung cate nama ce aa.
Saa kha mawluo maw te ta suokha hmuo pangaa'a va ung ciy. Aa ngaapa a aw kieca nama lyi aa.

Nama ningnazya riypa ca hing haa hingta a cuo aa: pangtaw kha nama se lie a se ung la, phyipakaw kha a pakaw ung la, nama khuecahryi kha a cyi ung la, a catli pata nama ning aa. Capa ca AbyipaLawsena Pyi ta a cuo aa.

Capa zuo ca ta Izipt ruo chung kha a khie'a angte, Izipt ruo lie sa-uvthyi bangkhuo kha cawsaa cuose, sahring cuose i thie'a yi. Izipt ruo chunglie a awpa khazing tie kha bie i ripa'a yi: Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo.
Thiyse ca niema nama awnapa ing aa hnangna ta a cuo aa. Thiyse i hmung tiyta ca lawse'a yi angte, Izipt ruo duo i te ning yi hing niema ca khaapa nang-uoruvnaana tahmuo ca para'a va yi.
Capa ning ca niema cuota a thyi paripa ning ta cuo'a te, Abyipa'a luo pyi nama tue ningta a cuo aa. Aa hmang paripa pyi ta cuo'a te chuo kha hnang chuo kha ta namaa uv aa.

Ning sariy chung thiynung phuv lipa viechuo kha nama ning aa. A ning khanapa ning lieta thiynung kha nama ing taata nama pathe aa. Tahematapakieca a ning khanapa taata a ning sariynapa te chunglie thiynung phuvpa viechuo a ningpa ca Israel mingphang taata papyapa a cuo aa.
A ning khanapa lie hne a ning sariynapa lie ca biena a pung pakhawna kha nama tue aa. Capa ning hning chung ca ning dang pachie riypa ta li pata re hrangpa hrie'a va ung ciy.

Thiynung phuv lipa viechuo pyi ca namaa uv aa. Tahematapakieca niema kha Izipt ruo taata ica pyakhyi ning yi tana a cuo. Hingpa ning hing ca aa hmang paripa pyi ta cuo'a te chuo kha hnang chuo kha ta namaa uv aa.
Thla khanapa lie ca ning hraa hlyipaliynapa zuoluo taata ning kiy ning khanapa zuoluo te kha thiynung phuv lipa viechuo kha nama ning aa.

Ning sariy chung ca nama ing lie thiynung aw'a vyi; tahematapakieca thiynung phuvpa viechuo a ningpa ca ruohrang ming a cuo zaw Israel ming ama cuo zaw Israel ming zapuv chungtaata papya pata ama cuo aa.
Thiynung phuvpa viechuo kha ning'a va ung ciy, nama awna bangkhuo lie kha thiynung phuv lipa viechuo dyina nama ning aa.
Cakhutaata Moses ta Israel ming uvthyi bangkhuo kha ku yi te, “Cakuo ung la nama chungkhue cyicuo cuota tuvtaata kha vaa tlaw ung la Lawsena pyi saa ca va thie tie ung.
Hissop nge taw kha kha la ung la, bikang lie thiyse chung luo kha naw ung la chiypakaa a cungluo tluo hne a tung suohning kha thuv tie ung. Mawluo maw te ta pakha hmuota ingle luo pya'a va ung ciy.

Tahematapakieca Abyipakha Izipt ming thie riypata a khiele'a te ingchiypakaa a cungluo tluo lie hne a tung tung hning lie thiy kha a hmung tiyta, Abyipata paratuv tie kha niema thie riypata nama ingchiypakaa luo pangie sa'a va yi.
Hingpa abiena phung hing a uv'a ung cate niema hne nama saata zaw cuota nama ziy pari riypa ziyphung ta a cuo aa.
Abyipata bie aca kuo ciepa haa yi ta aca pi riypa yi ruo luo nama chiy tiyta, hingpa phung hing nama ziy pari aa.
Nama saata zaw ta, “Hingpa phung hing a siyluo khaapatama a cuo? aca ta tiy yi ta,

‘Abyipa'a luo hriykhung a rinapa Lawsena Pyi tana a cuo, tahematapakieca Izipt ming a za thie ning yi kha Izipt ruo lieta Israel ming ing kha lawse te ma ing kha a pangaa siy yi,’ ta pata nama palie aa. Cakhutaata Israel ming ca a bung yi te amaa bie.
Cakhutaa cata Israel ming ca cakuo yi te Abyipata Moses hne Aaron a changpa haa yi khata ama tue.
Zuocang ta Abyipata Izipt ruo lie sa-uvthyi bangkhuo ca a thie yi, a byithude cunglie a tupa Faro sa-uvthyi taata thaw chunglie thaw a tlapa sa-uvthyi, hne sahring sa-uvthyi te ta a thie yi.
Faro hne a rehrietuv byi tie hne Izipt ming bangkhuo ca zuo ta thu yi te, Izipt lie ca caana ueryi a bi, tahematapakieca a thiypa a aw linapa ing ing kha hmuo aw vyi.
Cakhutaata Moses hne Aaron kha ku yi te, “Thu ung la, niema hne Israel ming ca i cawsaa zaw'a taa hingta pya tie ung. Si ung la nama ripa haa khata Abyipaca abie tie ung.
Nama ripa haa khata nama tuv hne nama mie hne nama cue zaw kha la ung la si tie ung. Kama zaw kha thluechiy na pi tie ung,” a ta yi.
Izipt ming zaw ta, Ma bangkhuo ta ma thiy diy'a tli hing,” ta yi te, ama ruo taata a catli pata ama pya riypata paa ama kie.
Caacuonakawta thiynung phuv lipa viechuo kha la yi te, viechuo nawnapa bikang hne khata pang ta cataw yi te ama letung lie amaa puvle.
Israel ming ca Moses ta a changpa haa yi khata Izipt ming kha siy hne ngu suethiy hne cawsie kha amaa hie.
Abyipata Izipt ming hmiekunglie kha hmiephaa pahmung sa yi te, amaa hiepa bangkhuo kha ama pi. Cahaacata Izipt ming hnyipa kha ama chuv diy.
Israel ming haatiy ri li pata capaa seta thaw za caruv hraw ca Rameses taata Sukkoth luo kha phyi ta ama si.
Aa pyapatlawpa cawsaa hluvpuv, hne tuv hne mie hne cue zaw kha iema hne cata ama si ra.

Izipt taata ama vya phyapa thiynung phuv lipa viechuo kha ama e. Thiynung phuv lipa ta a cuo, tahematapakieca iema ca Izipt taata a catli tuv pata a cadepa cuo yi te, ama ning riypa kha a tue hmuo va yi.
Israel ming Izipt lie ama awna cuo ca kung zapaliy sawthung ta a cuo.
Kung zapaliy sawthung a chuo ningpa caci khata Abyipacawsaa zaw ca Izipt ruo taata ama pya.

Capa zuo ca Israel ming kha Izipt taata pyakhyi riypata Abyipaa hmung li pata a aw zuo ta a cuo. Capa zuo ca Israel ming ama chuo chung bangkhuo lieta Abyipacuota zuo a hmung li pata amaa thyi pari riypa zuo ta a cuo.
Abyipata Moses hne Aaron kha, “Lawsena Pyi lie ziy riypa phung ca hingpa hing tana a cuo aa: ruohrang ming ta lawsena sa kha ning'a va yi,
cuorasala tuokaa ta calyipa sii ca vangdaw aa te tli kieca a ning aa;
a vya aw siypa hne a hluopa rehrietuv tie ca ning'a va yi.
Capa ca ing kha chunglie kha ning pata a cuo aa; saa kha ingle luo a cyile'a va ung ciy, cakhutaata a ruv suokha hmuo thli'a va ung ciy.
Israel ming cawsaazaapuv ta capa pyi ca nama tue aa.

Niema'a lie a awpa ruohrang ming pakhakha ta Abyipa'a lie kha Lawsena Pyi a tue khing ra kieca vangdaw amaa te taa aa; cakhutaa cata pyi luo kha a vaw ra'a te ama ca ruocaapa ming haata rue pata a cuo aa. Cuorasala vangdaw a te lipa ca ning'a vyi.
Ruochung ming hne niema hrawlie a awpa ruohrang ming cuota ziyphung suokha ta a cuo aa,” a ta yi.
Israel ming ca Abyipata Moses hne Aaron'a lie a changpa haa yi khata ama tue.
Capa ning hrahring cata Abyipata Israel ming kha Izipt ruo taa cata a phuv a phuv ta a pyakhyi yi.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata,
“Sa-uvthyi ca kama'a luona ina pi'a ung ciy; Israel ming chunglieta sa-uvthyi bangkhuo ca cawsaa cuose, sahring cuose, kama huopa tana ama cuo.

Moses ta Israel ming kha, “Izipt ruo, siicuona ing taata nama vya pyanapa ning kha a thyi pari tie ung, tahematapakieca Abyipata a cahrapa a kuv ta niema ca khapa ruo taa khata aca pyakhyi tli yi. Thiynung phuv lipa viechuo khana nama ning aa.
Ataning Abib thlaa ning hingna nama vya pya.

Abyipata niema pi riypata nama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie bie a kuopa, cuehnung hne khyitiy a langnapa ruo, Kanaan ming hne Hit ming hne Amor ming hne Hiv ming hne Jebus ming ruo chung luo acaa vya chiy tiy yi hingta, ata thlaa chunglie hingta hingpa a uv riypa ziyphung hing nama ziy aa.
Ning sariy chung kha thiynung phuv lipa viechuo ning'a ung cate, capa ning sariynapa lie ca Abyipa'a luo kha pyi nama tue aa.
Thiynung phuv lipa viechuo kha ning sariy chung ning'a ung cate, thiynung phuvpa viechuo cuose, thiynung cuose nama hnyipa chunglie hne nama ruo chunglie pa-aw sa'a va ung ciy.
Capa ning lie ca ta na saata kha, ‘Hingpa hmang i tuepa hing Izipt taata i vya pya ningta Abyipata kama cuota a tuepa ta a cuo nakaw tana a cuo,’ ta pata na chang aa.

Abyipata a cahrapa a kuv ta Izipt taata aca pyakhyi nakaw yi ta, Abyipapacuvna ca nama ri pari riypata, capa ziyphung ca niema cuota nama buo cunglie aa hnangna hne nama puo lieta pachang sa pakhaatuv haata a cuo aa.
Niema ta capa a uv riypa ziyphung ca ama'a na a cuota ning kha kung kha hnang kung kha ta nama ziy pari aa.
Ama ta niema hne mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie bie acaa kuopa haa yi ta, Abyipata niema kha Kanaan ruo luo caa vya chiy yi te capa ruo ca aca pi tiy yi ta,
nama sa taapa sa-uvthyi bangkhuo kha Abyipacuota a nanang ta nama che aa. Nama sahring ta a pachuo taapa a capaa bangkhuo ca Abyipahuopa tana a cuo aa.
Cuorasala laataata sa-uvthyi ca tuvtaata tah namaa thla aa. Namaa thla li kieca a rue kha nama thli aa. Nama saata zaw chungtaata sa-uvthyi bangkhuo kha namaa thla aa.

Hmieluo thueta nama saata zaw ta, ‘Hingpa hing a siyluo khaapatama a cuo,’ ta pata aca hiehriy kie yi ca niema ta, ‘Izipt ruo, siicuona ing taata Abyipata a cahrapa a kuv ta kiema kha malie a za pyakhyi.

Faro ta palung lesa pata kiema kha malie pasi sa khing li pata a aw ning kha, Abyipata Izipt ruo lie a awpa cawsaa sa-uvthyi taata saruopa sa-uvthyi bangkhuo kha a thie yi. Caacuonakawta sahring sa-uvthyi bangkhuo kha Abyipa'a luo hriykhungrina ta pi pate, cuorasala ma sacapaa uvthyi zaw hing ca maa thla yi,’ ta pata nama palie aa.
Abyipata a cahrapa a kuv ta Izipt ruo taata aca pyakhyi nakaw yi ta, hingpa ziyphung hing nama buo lie hne nama puo lieta pachangsana ta a cuo aa,” a ta.

Faro ta Israel ming a pasi sa tiy yi ta, aa ngie vie raalaa pata Khazing ta Filistin ruo chung luopuv luo ta a chiy va yi. Tahematapakieca Khazing ta, “Rie kha amaa du kieca ama palung a pali'a te Izipt luo kaa kie yi,” a ta nakawta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Khazing ta iema kha ruocaapa luo ta cahlung khyi yi te Riyliy Sepa kuo luo kha a sikhyi yi. Israel ming ca rie tuv riypa a ting pacie pata Izipt ruo taa khata ama pya.

Israel ming kyihuo ta, “Khazing ta caa zaa bya'a yi te aca pyakhyi tiy yi ta, i ruv kha hingpa hmang taa hingta niema'a lie nama phyale aa,’ ta pata a cusa pata bie a pakuosapa haa yi ta Moses ta Josef ruv ca a phyale.
Iema ca Sukkoth taa khata a tha yi te ruocaapa a kiy lieta a awpa Etham lie kha amaa ri.

Chung hne zuo hneta ama si khuna riypata Abyipaca iema kha luo a chiy riypata ningchung ta amyi taw haata ama hmieluo khata sile te, zuo ta ca iema kha khena pi riypata myihlaa taw haata ama hmieluo kha a sile.
Ningchung ta amyi taw cuose, zuo ta myihlaa taw cuose Israel ming hmiekunglie kha ama aw pari.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kha,
“Israel ming kha hnangluo vya kaa yi sala Pi-hahiroth hmie, Migdol hne riyliy alala, Baal-zefon hmie, riyliyluo kuo aa hyi lie kha ta a ri ung la, ta pata chang tie yi.
Faro ta, ‘Israel ming ca cuokaa mangpuopa hnyi li pata na ruocaapa lie amaa khie, ruocaapa na a khaakhung diy yi,’ a ta aa.
Izipt ming ta kama ca Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachangna riypa yi hne Faro cunglie rungnaana i hmungna riypata Faro palung kha pacuo sa'a angte ama ta Israel ming kha a cade'a yi,” ata.

Israel ming na a ruo tli yi ta pata Izipt siepahruo ca ama chang tiyta, Faro hne a rehrietuv byi tie palung ca cawsaa zaw cunglie kha a thle te, “Israel ming ma re hriena taata ma pasi sapa yi hing khaapama ma tue?” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta aa ruole kha pachie te a rieka tie kha a sikhyi yi.
Aruole pha cepa za caruv hne a hrangpa Izipt ming aruole bangkhuo kha riebyi tie hneta a sikhyi yi.
Abyipata Izipt siepahruo Faro palung kha pacuo sa te, riephasa pata a sipa Israel ming kha aa cade yi.
Izipt ming ca ta iema kha Faro aruo hne aa ruole tie, aa ruole a mawpa tie hne a rieka tie zaw hne khata a cade yi te, Pi-hahiroth a thaa, Baal-zefon hmie, riyliy kielie amaa ri pata ama pha.

Faro ta a vya ngie vie hryly yi te, Israel ming ca hnangluo kha a pali yi te ama mang ca, Izipt ming ta ama vya cadisa tlipa kha ama hmung. Israel ming ca ciy hringhruo yi te, Abyipa'a luo kha khuosa ta ama khi.
Iema ta Moses kha, “Izipt lie kha thluo a aw li nakaw ma ruocaapa lie thiy riypa hingta malie na vya pyakhyi? Izipt taata malie pyakhyi cate ima cunglie hing khaapama na tue?

Izipt lie kha, ‘Malie thuse la Izipt ming re hing za hrie thluo lavuo puv,’ tapa hingna maca za chang cuo va ma? Izipt ruocaapa chunglie thiy riypa laa hingta Izipt ming re hriepa kha a pha vie aa,” a ma ta.

Cuorasala Moses ta cawsaa kha, “Ciy khah ung, a cusa pata a daa tie ung, ataning niema khuona riypa kha Abyipata tuokhaatama a patlung aa tapa kha mang tie ung; tahematapakieca ataning nama hmungpa Izipt ming hing khatiy tahmuo hmung'a va tli ung ciy.
Abyipata niema cuota rie kha tuv'a te, niema ca a dieta khata aw tie ung,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kha, “Khaapanakawma ina u pari ciy? Israel ming kha hmieluo tung riypata chang tie yi.
Cuorasala nama ca na khuecahryi kha caba la, riyliy luo kha na buo pazuo la riyliy kha pache tie, cahaacata Israel ming ca riyliy chung alyi huvpa cunglie kha ziy'a yi te ama va te pathla aa.

Cakhutaa cata kama ta Izipt ming palung kha pacuo sa'a angte, iema ta Israel ming kha ama vaa cade aa. Caacuonakawta kama ca Faro hne a rieka bangkhuo, aa ruole hne aruole a mawtuv tie zaw cunglie kha rungnaana i hmung aa.
Cahaacata kama ta Faro hne aa ruole hne aruole a mawtuv tie cunglie kha rungnaana i hmung tiyta Izipt ming ta kama ca Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi.
Israel ming rieka tie hmielieta a sipa Khazing avuoming ca a hnyi te iema hnangluo kha a va aw. Amyi taw zaw kha iema hmiekung taa khata a hnyi te ama hnangluo ta a va aw ra.
Amyi taw ca Izipt rieka tie hne Israel rieka tie alalalie khata a aw. Cahaacata amyi ca amaa lalalie kha zingna ta zuokhydyi aw te, kuo kha hne kuo kha kha a cadi khu va yi.
Cakhutaata Moses ca a buo kha riyliy cung luo a pazu. Abyipata a cahrapa ningchiy thliy kha zuokhydyi pahruo sa te, alyi huvpa kha a luo te riyliy tiy ca aa che.
Israel ming ca riyliy chung alyi huvpa lie ca cakuo yi te, tiy ca ama cacuoluo hne ama cavyiluo khata tlepie haata aa chung.
Izipt ming ta Faro aruo bangkhuo, aruole bangkhuo, hne aruole a mawtuv bangkhuo hne khata ama vaa cade.
Mawdiy khydyi hluota lieta myihlaa taw hne amyi taw chungtaata Abyipata Izipt rieka tie kha za mang yi te, ciyna hne thlaazangna a za patlung sa.
Amaa ruole phyi kha ca-y sa te a ruvsa pata ama si. Izipt ming ca ta, “Israel ming'a taa hingta a ruo'a ung puv, tahematapakieca a Abyipana iema cuota kiema hing malie a du,” a ma ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kha, “Riyliy tiy khata Izipt ming, amaa ruole hne aruole a mawtuv tie a kaasue riypa yi ta, na buo kha riyliy cung luo pazu tie,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Moses ta a buo kha riyliy cung luo pazu te khy a vya dyipa khiy ta ca riyliy ca aa thuv tawpa zaa ta aa thuv pakhaa. Izipt ming ca amaa ruo raalaa pata Abyipata tiy chung luo a paby diy yi.
Tiy ca vya kaa te, aruole, aruole a mawtuv tie, riyliy chung luo iema a vya cadepa Faro rieka bangkhuo kha buvkhung diy yi te, pakha hmuo a ngaa va yi.
Cuorasala Israel ming ca riyliy chung alyi huvpa cunglie kha cakuo yi te, riyliy tiy ca ama cacuoluo hne ama cavyiluo khata tlepie haata aa chung.
Cahaacata capa ning lie ca Abyipata Israel ming kha Izipt ming'a taata khuo yi te, Israel ming ta Izipt ming riyliy kielie ama thiypa kha ama hmung.
Abyipata Izipt ming a du pata re lepuv a hriepa kha Israel ming ta ama hmung. Caacuonakawta cawsaa ta Abyipakha ciy yi te, Abyipahne a changtaapa Moses kha ama zang.

Cakhutaata Moses hne Israel ming ta hingpa hlaa hing Abyipa'a luo ama sa: Abyipa'a luona hlaa i sa aa, tahematapakieca ama na rungnaana hneta a te tli; aruole hne a khangpa tie kha riyliy chung luo a thaw yi.
Abyipaca i thaazuo hne i cahrana, kama khuona tana a cuo. Ama ca i Khazing cuo te, i pathuosa aa, i paa Khazing cuo te, i cyicalang aa.
Abyipaca rieka tana a cuo; a ming ca Abyipatana a cuo.
"3Faro aruole hne a rieka tie kha riyliy chung luo a thaw yi; aa tlawpa a rehrietuv byi tie ca Riyliy Sepa chung luona ama tla.
Tiy aa thuvpa na a buvkhung yi; iema ca alung haa tana aa thuvna luo ama tla.
Vya Abyipa, na cacuoluo kuv ca cahrana ta rungnaa te, vya Abyipana cacuoluo kuv ta carie tie kha a dechi patlaa yi.
A lesyipa na linghlaa ta na carie tie kha na thawpatyi yi, na hihaana kha pa thlie cate, sacuo kung caapa haata myi ta a kuo yi.
Na hnacabuv taa na pachiypa thliy ta tiy kha pahmya te, tiy ca tlepie haata aa chung; riyliy aa thuvpa ca cuokarue khata aa daa.
Carie tie ta, ‘Kama na a cade'a ang, i pha'a yi, ama suethiy kha pache diy'a angte, i khingpa kha i la aa. I zueziy kha a da'a angte, i kuv ta i para'a yi,’ ama ta.
Na huv ta hmung yi cate, riyliy ta a buvkhung yi; a cahrapa tiy chung luo kha kawthuv haata ama tla.
“Vya Abyipakhazing zaw hrawlie hing ahungma nama haapa a aw? pathena lieta ahungma nama haapa a aw? na khetuv pata ciy naa chiyna hne kharuehaa hmang tuena lie ahungma nama caa lu?
Na cacuoluo buo kha pazuo cate, alyi ta iema kha a paluo yi.
“Na khuo ciepa na cawsaa zaw kha, aa hmangpa na duena ta naa chiy yi; na ruo pathepa luo kha na cahrana ta naa chiy yi.
Mingphang tie ta thyi yi te ama ciy pata amaa cathang; Filistin ruo lie a awpa tie ca khuosa ta pasana kha ama ang.
Cakhutaata Edom byi tie kha ama nang ta uo te, Mob byi tie ca aa cathang ta amaa cathang; Kanaan ruo lie a awpa bangkhuo ca ama palung a rasa.

Ciyna hne thlaazangna kha ama cunglie tlung te, vya Abyipana cawsaa zaw ama khungna te khata, nama naa thlapa na cawsaa zaw ta ama law diyna te khata, a cahrapa na buo thueta a ca-ang ta ca-ang yi te alung haa khata amaa daa.
Nama ta a vya chiy yi cate, nama na hnyipa tluo, Vya Abyipanama awna riypata na sapa hmang, Vya Abyipana kuv ta na sapa hmangpathepa lie kha naa ling yi.
Abyipaca chuozaa taata chuozaa te siepahruo a cuo aa.

Faro aruo tie hne aa ruole tie hne aruole a mawtuv tie zaw riyliy luo ama tla tiyta, Abyipata riyliy tiy kha iema cung luo a vya pakaasue yi; cuorasala Israel ming ca riyliy chung alyi huvna lie kha ama cakuo.
Cakhutaata Aaron sietanung profet Miriam ca karuv-akhang kha a la te, canung zaw bangkhuo ta ama kha paziy yi te amaa khang hneta ama luo.
Miriam ca ta iema'a lie kha: Abyipa'a luo kha hlaa sa tie ung, tahematapakieca rungnaasa pata na tena a hmung; aruo hne aruo rieka tie kha riyliy luo a thaw yi,” ta pata hlaa a sa.
Cakhutaata Moses ta Israel ming kha Riyliy Sepa taata a tha riypata bie pi yi te Shur ruocaapa luo kha ama si. Ning thung chung ruocaapa lie kha si yi te tiy hmung va yi.
Marah luo ama vya chiy tiyta, Marah tiy ca a kha nakawta dang khu va yi.
Cawsaa ta Moses'a lie kha a cie yi te, “Khaapama ma dang aa?” ama ta.

Ama ta Abyipa'a luo kha khuosa ta thlaachuo te, Abyipata thing suokha kha a pahmung sa. Ama ta thing kha tiy chung luo a pathla ca tiy ca a thlung. Capa lie ca Abyipata dyapasya yi te phungluo zaw a pi yi.

Ama ta, “Niema ta nama Khazing Abyipabie kha a phasa pata naathlie ung cate, a hmungna lieta hmang phapa tue ung cate, a nawbie kha ziy ung cate a phungluo kha nama patling kieca, Izipt ming'a lie i patlung sapa pasana suokha hmuo niema cunglie patlung sa'a va ang; tahematapakieca kama ca niema caa patluosapa Abyipatana i cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata acaa suohraa hlyihning a awnapa hne tungkung sawsariy a punapa Elim luo kha vya si yi te, capa lieta tiy athaalie kha amaa ri.
Israel ming cawsaazaapuv ca Elim taa khata a thu yi te, Izipt taata ama pyana taata a thla hningna ning hraa hlyipangaana lie kha Elim hne Sinai alala Sin ruocaapa luo kha ama va chiy.
Israel ming cawsaazaapuv ta ruocaapa lie kha Moses hne Aaron cunglie kha amaa cie.

Israel ming ta iema kha, “Saa kha bi ta zaa patupuo pate, ma riy bina te ta sa ma za ning ning khata, Izipt ruo lie kha Abyipakuv ta za thiy se pala a pha vie aa. Cuorasala niema ca hingpa cawsaazaapuv hing nangdiy pata thiy diy riypa tana hingpa ruocaapa luo hing malie nama vya sikhyi,” ama ta.

Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kha, “Kama na niema huota viechuo kha avuo taata khy haata zaa pasaa sa'a ang. Cawsaa kha ningting ta pya'a yi te ning kha huota aa de zaa kha amaa haa aa. I biepipa kha ama ziy ma ziy va yi ma tapa kha cahaacata i dyapasya'a yi.
Ning caruvna lie ca ning hrang amaa haapa laata le hning ta a haa'a yi te amaa ring pacie aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Moses hne Aaron ta Israel ming kha, “Ata zuoluo ta Izipt ruo chungtaata niema caa pyakhyituv ca Abyipaa cuopa kha pachang'a ung cate,
mawluo maw ta Abyiparungnaana kha nama hmung aa. Tahematapakieca ama na Abyipanamaa ciesuepa kha a thyi tli,” ama ta.

Cakhutaata Moses ta, “Zuoluo ning riypata saa ca pi yi te, maw ning riypata viechuo caa pipa yi ca Abyipatana a cuo. Tahematapakieca ama namaa ciesuepa kha na Abyipata a thyi tli. Kiema hing tuokhaapa tama ma cuo ung? Namaa ciesuepa ca kiema cuo vapuv, Abyipatana a cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata Moses ta Aaron kha, “Israel ming cawsaazaapuv kha chang yi la, ‘Abyipaathaa luo kha a vya ngie tie ung, tahematapakieca namaa ciesuepa khana a thyi tli, ta tie yi,” a ta.
Aaron ta Israel ming cawsaazaapuv kha bie a changpa haa yi ta ruocaapa luo kha ama mang ca amyi cunglie Abyiparungnaana kha a zaa luo.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata,

“Israel ming ta inaa ciesuepa yi kha i thyi tli, iema kha chang tie yi, ‘Zuoluo a zing baaning pata saa ce'a ung cate, mawluo maw ta viechuo kha nama riy bina te ta nama ning aa; Cakhutaata kama ca Abyipanama Khazing i cuopa kha nama pachang aa,” ta pata chang tie yi,” a ta.
Zuoluo ta mamang kha kya kie ciemuo yi te amaa rina hmang kha a buv ta ama buv. Maw ta aduo kha amaa rina hmang athaalie ca aa paata tah a tla.
Aduo aa pe tiyta alyi lie a tlapa cahue haata a tapa a paakadiyta kha ruocaapa lie ca ama aw patlaw.

Israel ming ta ama hmung tiyta, pakha hne pakha kha, “Khaapatama a cuo? amaa ta. Tahematapakieca khaapatama a cuo tapa kha pachang va yi. Moses ta iema kha, “Abyipata nama ning riypata aca pipa yi viechuo tana a cuo.
Abyipata bie aca pipa yi ca: Namaa huna zaa tana namaa haa aa, nama mingluv zaa ta pakha ta omer suokha law ta nama thluodaa cyicuo acaa zuna te yi ta namaa haa aa,” a ta.
Israel ming ta a ripa haa cata ama tue, chekha ta a hluv vie ta a haa yi te, chekha ta a caw vie ta amaa haa.
Cuorasala omer ta ama panang tiyta a hluv vie ta a haapa kha a hlyi ta hmung li pata a caw vie ta a haapa zaw a cawtuv dyi hmung ra vyi. Iema'a na amaa huna zaa kha tana ama hmung kaluo.
Cakhutaata Moses ta iema kha, “Viechuo suokha hing hmuo mawluo maw te ta pangaa'a va ung ciy,” a ta yi.
Cuorasala iema ta Moses bie kha a ngie lipa yi ta, a chebuo kha mawluo maw te ta amaa chi ca alung ta thla te a thuv diy. Moses ca khapa tie cunglie kha a hi a haa.
A maw tating ta amaa dena te ta viechuo ca amaa haa, cuorasala ning a paling tiyta a tiy ta a lang diy.
Ning caruvnapa ning ca le hning ta a haa yi te, omer suohning amaa haa. Israel ming cawsaazaapuv luochiytuv tie ta a vaw yi te Moses kha ama chang tiyta,

ama ta iema kyihuo khata, “Abyipabie pipa ca hing haa hing tana a cuo: Mawluo ca phung haata a ding ning, Abyipacuota a pathepa ningzaa ning tana a cuo. Nama e khingpa kha e ung la, nama pasu khingpa kha pasu tie ung, nama pangaa khingpa bangkhuo kha che ung la mawluo maw te a chi tie ung,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta Moses ta a changpa haa yi ta mawluo maw te a chi yi te, thuv li pata alung zaw thla vyi.
Moses ta, “Ataning ca hingpa hing ning tie ung, tahematapakieca ataning ca Abyipacuota ningzaa ning tana a cuo. Ataning ca hingpa hing ruo lieta hmung'a va ung ciy.
Ning caruv chung hingpa hing a haa ung cate, cuorasala ning sariy ning, ningzaa ning ca suokha hmuo aw'a vyi,” a ta yi.
Ning sariy ning kha cawsaa chekha ta a haa riypata ama pya, cuorasala suokha hmuo hmung va yi.
Abyipata Moses kha, “I nawbie hne i pacuvna hing khatiy te ma ziy li pata nama aw aa?

Mang tie! Abyipata ningzaa aca pi yi. Caacuonakawta ning caruvnapa lie ca ning hning cuota sa aca pi yi. Nama awnapa cyicuo lie khana nama aw aa. Ningzaa ning ca nama awna hmang kha pyase'a va ung ciy,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta ning sariy ning ca cawsaa kha amaa ding.
Israel ming ta capa sa ca manna ama ta. Koriander hmung kha a lusa, ruo te, a pahuonazya ca khyitiy ta ama tuepa viechuo kuopa haa kha tana a cuo.

Moses ta, “Abyipata aca pipa yi nawbie ca hing haa hing tana a cuo: ‘Niema kha Izipt ruo taata ica pyakhyi tiy yi ta, ruocaapa lie ica pipa yi viechuo kha nama samingsahlaa zaw chuo bangkhuo ta ama hmungna riypata manna omer suokha kha chaw tie ung,’” a ta.
Cakhutaata Moses ta Aaron kha, “Bi suokha kha la lah, manna omer suokha kha a chung luo pasuo tie. Chuo bangkhuo ta chaw riypata Abyipahmiekunglie kha chi tie,” a ta.
Abyipata Moses kha bie a pipa haata, Aaron ta manna bi ca aa bangsa pata a aw the riypata nawbie thingkaw hmielie kha a chi.
Israel ming ta manna ca kung sawliy chung ama ning. Khy ama sana riypa ruo ama phana te ta ama ning. Kanaan ruoriy ama phana te ta manna ca ama ning.
Omer suokha ca ephah che hraa che kha tana a cuo.

Israel ming cawsaazaapuv ca Sin ruocaapa taa khata a thu yi te Abyipata bie a pina haa yi khata suv kha hnang suv kha ta amaa hnyile. Rafidim lie kha a ri yi te, cuorasala cawsaa dang riypa tiy aw vyi.
Iema ta Moses kha a hru yi te, “Dang riypa tiy malie pi tie,” ama ta. Moses ta, “Khaapanakawma kama inaa hru ung ciy? Khaapanakawma Abyipanama dyapasya?” a ta yi.

Cuorasala cawsaa ca ama tiy a hriesa nakawta Moses kha a ciesue yi te, “Khaapanakawma Izipt ruo chungtaata malie na pyakhyi? Kiema hne ma saata zaw hne ma sahring zaw kha tiy kuo pamaa sa pata thie riypata ma malie na pyakhyi?” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Moses ca Abyipa'a luo kha u te, “Hingpa cawsaa zaw hing tuokhaatama i tue'a yi? Kama kha alung ta vaasa riypata inaa nang yi,” a ta.
Abyipata Moses kha, “Cawsaa hmieluo kha pya la, Israel ming uvthyi chekha kha a chiy tie yi. Nail cavaa na tuvnapa khuecahryi kha na kuv lie a cyile la cakuo tie.

Horeb lie alung cunglie kha na hmiekunglie i zaa daa aa. Alung kha a hluo la cawsaa dang riypata alung chung taa cata tiy a pya aa,” a ta. Israel ming uvthyi tie hmiekunglie kha Moses ta cahaacata a tue.
Capa hmang ca ama ta Massah hne Meribah ta pata ming a sa. Tahematapakieca Israel ming ta “Abyipahing kiema'a lie a aw ma aw va ma?” ta yi te, Abyipakha a hru yi te ama dyapasya nakawta a cuo.
Cakhutaata Amalek ming ta Israel ming kha Refidim lieta amaa du.
Moses ta Joshua kyihuo khata, “Cawsaa chekha kha a tlaw yi la, si la, Amalek ming kha vaa du tie yi. Mawluo khiy Khazing khuecahryi kha i kuv lie a hrie'a angte tluo cunglie khiy i kya daa aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Joshua ca Moses ta a changpa haa khata Amalek ming kha a du yi te, capa ning ca Moses hne Aaron hne Hur ca tluo cung luo kha ama kie.
Moses ta a buo a pazu chung bangkhuo kha Israel ming ta te yi te, a buo a pathla pahne Amalek ming ta ama te.

Cuorasala Moses ca a buo a ri; caacuonakawta alung kha la yi te, a rawlie chi yi te, capa cunglie ca aa tu. Aaron hne Hur ta pakha ta kuokhaluo, a hrangpa pakha ta kuokhaluo ta pata a kuv kha dyi yi te ama calang sa. Ning tlana te ta a kuv ca dyi yi te ama calang sa.
Joshua ta Amalek hne a cawsaa zaw kha a zueziy ta a te yi.

Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kha, “Hingpa hing a thyi pari riypata caa-uv chunglie kha cape la Joshua kha pathyi sa hrahring tie. Tahematapakieca vuoruo rawlie Amalek ming a thyi pakhaana riypata a awpa bangkhuo ca i para diy aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata Moses ta bienatluophie kha sa te, ‘Abyipaca i tena tana a cuo,’ a ta.
Ama ta, “Abyipatena kha nama kuv pazukhyi tie ung. Abyipata Amalek ming kha chuo kha hnang chuo kha ta rie aa du'a yi,” a ta.
Midian ruo tluobyi Jethro, Moses puvpa ta Moses hne a cawsaa Israel ming cuota Khazing ta a tuepa bangkhuo hne, Abyipata Israel ming kha Izipt ruo taata tuokhaatama a pyakhyi yi tapa kha a thyi.
Moses ta a vya paphya pakhaapa a napuv Zipporah hne a sacapaa pahning kha vya sikhyi yi te a vya chiy.
Pakhapa a ming ca Gershom ta te (“Ruohrang liena khyche ta i za cuo,” a tanapa a cuo),
a hrangpa pakhapa ming ca Eliezer a ta (“I paa Khazing ca kama naa byatuv hne Faro zueziy taata naa khuotuv tana a cuo,” a tanapa a cuo).
Moses puvpa Jethro ca Moses sacapaa zaw hne a napuvnung kha a vya chiy yi te, Moses aa rinapa ruocaapa chunglie Khazing tluo luo kha a vya chiy.
Moses'a luo kha, “Kama, na puvpa na na napuv hne na sacapaa zaw hneta nama'a luo a vya sile nguoluo ang,” ta pata bie a taa.
Moses ta a puvpa ca vaa hladaw te, a hmiekunglie kha a bung te a pahnuo khutaata ama hnaa a tluo hne tluo li kaw zaw kha pakha hne pakha kha a hiehriy yi te, thluodaa luo kha amaa ngie.

Cakhutaata Moses ta Israel ming kawlieta Abyipata Faro hne Izipt ming cunglie a tuepa bangkhuo, luopuv lie a pakhuo a padyipa yi ruvnaana bangkhuo kaw, tuokhaatama Abyipata a palaw sale yi tapa mekaa kha a puvpa ca a chang diy.
Jethro ca Izipt ming kuv chungtaata palawsana kawlie Abyipata Israel ming cunglie a tuepa hmang phapa bangkhuo kawlie kha a palung a tluo.
Jethro ta, “Izipt ming hne Faro kuv chungtaata caa palawsapa yi Abyipaca thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue.

Ata hing ca Abyipaca khazing hrangpa bangkhuo laata a le vie tapa kha i pachang, tahematapakieca iema'a lie kha palungle hruotlesa pata hmang ama tue tiyta, a cawsaa zaw kha Izipt ming kuv chungtaata a palaw sa yi,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Moses puvpa Jethro ta Khazing'a luo kha myirue panaana ta hriykhungrina a tue; Aaron hne Israel ming uvthyi zaw bangkhuo ca Khazing hmiekunglie Moses puvpa hne sa ning pakhaw riypata amaa vaw.
A mawluopa ning lie ca Moses ca a cawsaa zaw bieripa riypata a tu te, cawsaa zaw ca a hmielie kha maw taata zuoluo te amaa daa.

Moses ta cawsaa zaw cuota a hriepa bangkhuo kha a puvpa ta a hmung tiyta, “Cawsaa zaw cuota na hriepa hing tuokhaapa tama a cuo? Khaapanakawma nama se ta a tu cate, cawsaa bangkhuo ta ca cadung yi te maw taata zuoluo te amaa daa?” a ta.
Moses ta a puvpa kha, “Cawsaa zaw ca Khazing khingna kha pachang khing yi te na kama'a luo kha amaa vaw,” a ta.
Cawsaa kha amaa hru tiyta, kama'a luo a vaw yi te pakha hne pakha alalalie kha bie i ripa yi, Khazing phungluo hne biepi zaw kha i chang yi,” a ta.
A puvpa ta ama kha, “Na hriepa hing a phapa ta cuo vyi.
Nama zaw na thaa a buo tuv aa, nama'a lie a awpa cawsaa zaw hing ama thaa a buo tuv aa. Tahematapakieca re hing na cuota aa riy tuv; nama selaw ta te'a vaciy.
Na naathlie tie. Ruena ca pi'a angte Khazing ta ca awpuo mang sue! Nama ca cawsaa zaw cuota Khazing hmiekung luo biephyatuv ta cuo'a cate ama bie kha Khazing'a luo na chiykhyi aa.
Phungluo hne biepi zaw kha pacuv yi la ama ziy riypa luo hne ama tue riypa hmang kha na pachang sa'a yi.

Cawsaa zaw hrawlieta hmang a tue khupa cawsaa, Khazing a ciyzaapa, zang tluo aa tlapa, nawthuv pi khu a aw lipa kha huv yi la, thawkha uvtuv, zakha uvtuv, sawngaa uvtuv, hne pahraa uvtuv ta pata chi tie yi.

Iema ca cuotling ta cawsaa bie a ripatuv ta cuo'a yi te, bie ruv viepa kha nama'a luo chiykhyi'a yi te, bie na viepa kha iemata tah ama ripa aa. Caacuokieca iema ta na hmangriy kha ca phyakhyi'a yi te na cuota a na vie aa.
Cahaacata Khazing biepipa haata na hrie kieca na rie thyi tuv li pata, hingpa cawsaa bangkhuo zaw hing thlaalungna hne ing luo amaa diy aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Moses ta a puvpa bie kha a ngie te a ripa bangkhuo kha a tue.
Israel ming chungtaata hmang a tue khupa cawsaa kha a tlaw yi te cawsaa uvtuv riypata thawkha uvtuv, zakha uvtuv sawngaa uvtuv, pahraa uvtuv ta pata re a pi yi.
Iema ta cawsaa kha cuotling ta bie ama ripa. Bie ruv viepa kha Moses'a luo ama chiykhyi, cuorasala bie na viepa kha iemata tah ama ripa.
Cakhutaata Moses ta a puvpa ca pathlie te, Jethro ca a ruo luo kha a kaa.
Israel ming Izipt ruo taata ama vya pya khutaata thla thungnapa thlaa ning khanapa ning kha Sinai ruocaapa luo ama pha.
Refidim taata pya yi te, Sinai ruocaapa luo kha a ngie yi te tluo hmiekunglie kha amaa ri.
Cakhutaata Moses ca Khazing'a luo kha khaw te, tluo cung taa khata Abyipata ku te, “Jakob phang Israel ming'a luo na ri riypa ca:
Izipt ming'a lie i tuepa kha hmung tli ung cate, hmungthlu mathlaa ta ca phya yi angte kama'a luo tuokhaatama icaa chiy yi tapa zaw kha nama pachang.

Caacuonakawta i ri kha naa ngie ung cate i nawbie kha nama ziy kieca, niema ca kama cawsaa, mingphang hrang bangkhuo laata kama cuota muosung viepa ta nama cuo aa. Hmisi ta ripa kieca, alyi hing a yalya ta kama huopa tana a cuo.
Cuorasala niema ca kama cuota tluobyi haata i re a hrie riypa pathesapa mingphang tana nama cuo aa. Hingpa hingna Israel ming na chang riypa yi bie ta a cuo,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Moses ca a vaw te, Israel ming uvthyi tie kha kupakiy yi te Khazing ta a pipa bie kha a chang yi.
Cawsaa bangkhuo ca ta: “Abyipaa ripa bangkhuo ca ma tue aa,” ama ta. Moses ta cawsaa zaw ama bie ca Abyipa'a luo a pathyi sa.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kha, “Cawsaa ta nama hne bie ma ripa kha thyi'a yi te aca zang pari riypa yi ta nama'a luo kha amyi chaasapa chungtaata i vaw aa,” a ta.
Abyipata Moses kha: “Cawsaa zaw'a luo kha vaa la, ataning hne mawluo khiy a pathe sa yi se. Ama caw kha a pasuv yi sala
ning thungnapa ning cuota a ting daw yi se. Tahematapakieca ning thungnapa ning lie khiy Abyipana Sinai tluo cunglie cawsaa zaw hmungna lie kha a zaa cung aa.
Cawsaa zaw cuo khata tluo cahlung pata ruoriy chikhuo yi la, tluo cung luo kie li riypa hne ruoriy kya de khu li riypa kha chang tie yi. Ahung a cuo zaw tluo a kya de khupa ca thie pata nama cuo aa.

Iema ca ahungtahmuo kuv ta taw'a va yi, cuorasala alung ta vaasa riypa, acuolikie cuoti ta kasa riypa tana ama cuo aa. Sahring cuose, cawsaa cuose pahringpa cuo'a va yi. Hmyakaa pu a pasiypuv ta a paring tiyta cawsaa ca tluo cung luo kha ama kya kie aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Moses ca tluo cung taa khata cawsaa zaw'a luo kha a cung. Cawsaa kha pathe sa yi te, ama caw kha amaa pasuv.
Cakhutaata cawsaa zaw kyihuo khata, “Ning thungnapa ning cuota a pathe tie ung; canung athaa luo kha cakuo'a va ung ciy,” a ta yi.
Ning thungnapa maw lie ca khalung aa thy, thinghlaa a cakang te tluo cunglie kha amyi chaakaluvpa a aw. Hmyakaa kha khuosa ta paring te arina hmang lie a awpa bangkhuo ca amaa cathangsa.
Moses ta Khazing hne a taw riypata cawsaa kha ale luo a pyakhyi yi. Tluo phyichaa lie kha amaa daa.

Sinai tluo ca myikhuv ta a buv diy, tahematapakieca Abyipaca a cunglie kha myi ta za cung te, tluo yalya ta khuopuv ta aa cahang ning kha myikhuv ca myipung taata a pyapa haa khata avuo luo a kiethaw.
Hmyakaa ue khuopuv ta a paring hryly ning kha Moses ta bie ri te Khazing ta khalung pu chunglie kha a palie.
Abyipaca Sinai tluodaw lie za cung te, Moses kha tluodaw luo ku te, a kupa haata a kiethaw.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kha, “Cungbung la cawsaa kha Abyipamang riypata ruoriy law pata amaa kya ngie li riypa kha a raaringna za pi tie yi, cata a cuo li kieca a hluvsa ama thiy aa.
Tluobyi tie hmuo Abyipa'a luo a khawpa ca iema hne iema kha amaa pathe aa, caacuolikieca Abyipana duo a te pathlyi'a yi,” a ta.

Moses ta Abyipakha, “Cawsaa tie ca Sinai tluo cung luo kie riypata pa-awpa cuo va yi; tahematapakieca nama pangpa ta, ‘Tluo a cahlung pata ruoriy tue la capa ca a pathepa ta chi tie ung,’ malie na ta,” a ta.
Khazing ta Moses kha, “Cung la Aaron kha a kya chiy tie; cuorasala tluobyi tie cuose, cawsaa zaw cuo yi se, Abyipa'a luo kha a kya ngie khah yi se, caacuolikieca ama na duo a te pathlyi'a yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Moses ca cawsaa zaw'a luo kha cung te a chang yi.
Cakhutaata Khazing ta hingpa bie bangkhuo hing a ri:
Kama ca Abyipa na Khazing, sii na cuonapa Izipt ruo taata caa vya pyakhyipa tana i cuo.
Kama ta li pata khazing hrangpa kha hnyi khah.
Cungluo vuoruo lie a awpa, acuolikie arawluo alyi lie a awpa, acuolikie alyi raw riyliy lie a awpa hmang suokhakha hmingsuo a lupa kuvtuezuv kha na cuota a tue khah.

Iema hmiekunglie kha a bung pata abie khah, tahematapakieca kama Abyipanama Khazing ca hietlie a hmuopa Khazing tana i cuo, kama naa thawpa tie ama chuo, chuo thung chuo paliy te ta ama nungpaa tie pha lina kha saata zaw cunglie duo a tepa tana i cuo.
Cuorasala kama na due te i nawbie a ziypa tie cunglieta aa hmangpa i duena kha chuo thawkha te ta a paluo sapa tana i cuo.
Abyipana Khazing ming kha a cuo lipa lie va hmuo khah, tahematapakieca Abyipata a cuo lipa lie a ming a hmuopa ca a ngiethe khu'a vyi.
Sabbath ning kha a thyi la pathe sa tie.
Ning caruv chung kha na re bangkhuo naa hrie aa.

Cuorasala a ning sariynapa ca Abyipana Khazing sabbath ning tana a cuo. Nama, na sacapaa hne na sacanung, na siicapaa hne siicanung, na sahring, acuolikie na khy lie khy a sapa ruohrang ming ta pata khaapa re hmuo hrie'a va ung ciy.

Tahematapakieca ning caruv chunglie kha Abyipata alyi hne avuo, riyliy, hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo kha sa te, cuorasala ning sariyna lie ca aa pahy. Caacuonakawta Abyipata ningzaa ning ca thluechiy pi te a pathe sa.
Na nung hne na paa va ciyzaa yi, cahaacata na tue kieca Abyipana Khazing ta aca pipa ruo lie hing na hring a pasiy aa.
Lie va naw khah.
Nungvaathingsuena tue khah.
Paruv khah.
Na ingpaa cunglie aa hmuo lipa tehte cuo khah.
Na ingpaa ing kha hietlie khah. Na ingpaapa napuv, a siicapaa hne a siicanung, a cuetungpa, a laa, acuolikie na ingpaa ta a hnyipa hmang suokhakha kha hietlie khah.
Cawsaa bangkhuo ca ta khalung aa thypa hne paci a tlapa, hmyakaa ueryi hne tluo cunglie myikhuv kha ama hmung tiyta ama ciynapa ta a cathangsa yi te luohlaa puv taa khata a daa yi te,
Moses kyihuo khata,” Nama ta malie chang la maca naathlie aa, cuorasala Khazing ta ca malie chang khah se, ma thiy diy pali aa,” ama ta.
Moses ta cawsaa zaw kyihuo khata, “Ciy khah ung; tahematapakieca Khazing ca ama nama ciy riypa hne nama sue li riypa tana niema dyapasya riypata aa vaw pata a cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Moses ta khyzingna chaasapa luo a vaa ngiele ning kha cawsaa ca luohlaa taa khata amaa daa.
Khazing ta Moses kha, “Israel ming kha hing haa hingta chang tie yi: ‘Kama ta vuoruo taata niema hne bie i ripa kha nama hmung tli.
Kama hne pakhing pata ngu ta cuose, siy ta cuose Khazing a tue'a va ung ciy.

Kama cuota Bienatluophie suokha kha alyi ta sa la, na tuv hne na cuetungpa zaw khata myirue panaana hne aviesaa panaana ta hriykhungrina tue tie; ama ming a thyi pari riypata ica changpa abiena hmang khaapa lie a cuo zaw a vaw'a angte thluechiy ica pi aa.
Cuorasala kama cuota alung ta bienatluophie na sa kieca, uopa alung ta sa'a vaciy; tahematapakieca sata tah na khe ciepa alung kha na hmuo kieca bienatluophie khana na papya na palyi.
I bienatluophie luo kha hlyidaw ta kie'a vaciy, na kie kieca na cawdaa pathlyi aa,’ a ta, ta tie yi,” a ta.
Israel ming na pi riypa yi biena ziyphung ca hingpa tie hing tana a cuo:
Hebru cawsaa a cuopa sii kha na calyi tiyta, kung caruv chung na sii cuo'a te, kung sariynapa lie ca lyibuo aw li pata hya a zangpa cawsaa ta a cuo aa.
Aa vaw ning kha ama selaw ta a cuo kieca ama selaw ta cakuo sa'a ung cate, a napuv hneta aa vaw kieca a napuv hneta nama cakuo sa aa.
A ziypaapa ta napuv pi te sacapaa hne sacanung ama hnyi kieca, a napuv hne a saata zaw ca a ziypaapa huopa ta cuo'a yi te, ama selaw ta a cakuo aa.
Cuorasala sii a cuopa ta, “I ziypaapa, i napuv hne i saata zaw na i due yi, hya zang pata cakuo khing va ang,” a ta kieca,
a ziypaapa ta Khazing hmiekung luo kha a chiykhyi aa. Chiypakaa acuolikie chiypakaa tung luo kha cakuokhyi'a te, a naakhue vaa'a te, cakhutaata ca a chuo chung bangkhuo sii ta a cuo aa.
Cawsaa pakha ta a sacanung kha sii ta a zaa kieca, siicapaa hya pazang sapa a cuopa haa khata cuo'a vyi.
Napuv ta a tue khingpa a ziypaapa palung kha a patluo li kieca, a thla pakhaa riypata luo a pa-aw aa. A cunglie aa dang li pata a hrie nakawta ruohrang ming'a luo zaa khu vyi.
A sacapaa napuv riypata a khing kieca, sacanung haata a rue aa.
Napuv hrangpa kha a hnyi vie kieca, a napuv taapa cuota sa, cawsie, hne napuv cuonapa kha pachungpa vie'a vyi.
Hingpa suothung hingna a tuepa va tapa kieca, lyibuo hnyi li pata hne tuokaa lu li pata hya a pazang aa.
Cawsaa kha tuv te a thiepa ca thie pata a cuo aa.
A ting tlarya pata a thiepa cuo li pata a hringnapa kha Khazing ta a kuv luo a pipa phang a cuo kieca cawsaa a thie pathlyipa tie a ruona riypa hmang kha kama ta i chipa'a yi.
Cuorasala cawsaa pakhakha ta a ting tlarya pata cawsaa a thie kieca abangna hmung riypata i bienatluophie luo hmuo pangie ra sala a dapathla'a cate na thie aa.
A paa hne a nung kha tuv te a thiepa ca thie pata a cuo aa.
Cawsaa a paruvpa ca, a zaa zawta, a kuv cunglie hmung pata a cuo zawta, thie pata a cuo aa.
A paa hne a nung kha chie a sapa ca thie pata a cuo aa.
Cawsaa kha a tuv yi te pakha ta a hrangpa pakha kha alung ta acuolikie maathung ta phaw te, a thiy raalaa li pata a ziena lie kha aa kung kie cuose,
tluo vie te khuecahryi a chung te a cakuopuo khu pata a cuo kie cuose, a phawpa paa ca biehnyina taata palaw sa pata a cuo aa. Cadyiseca a cuo aa sungpa muo kha lu'a te a tluona te a mangchiy aa.
Sii a hnyipa pakha ta a siicapaa cuose, a siicanung cuose asung ta tuv te a tuv khu pahne ta a thiy kieca a hnyituv ca duote pata a cuo aa.
Cuorasala sii ca ning kha ning hning a hring pata a cuo kieca, duotena aw'a vyi; tahematapakieca sii ca a hnyituv huopa tana a cuo.

Cawsaa amaa tuv ningta nu a phyapa kha phaw khu yi te, nu kha a ra raalaa pata aa phawna hrangpa a aw li kieca a phaw khupa ca cawsaanung navaapa ta a hiepa zaa kha bierituv byi tie biechina haata a lu aa.
Cuorasala hmaa a phya kieca, hringna cuota hringna,
ming cuota ming, haa cuota haa, kuv cuota kuv, phyi cuota phyi,
myikuona cuota myikuona, hmaa cuota hmaa, hmaadaa cuota hmaadaa pihriy pata a cuo aa.
Sii a hnyipa ta a siicapaa ma a siicanung ma a ming lie kha chi pathlyi te a ming a ra kieca a ming muo ca ta hya a pazang sa aa.
Sii a hnyipa ta a siicapaa ma a siicanung ma a haa kha a phaw pathla kieca a haa cuo khata hya a pazang sa aa.
Cuetungpa ta canung acuolikie capaa pakha kha de te a thiy kieca capa cuetungpa ca alung ta vaasapa cuo'a te a saa ce pata cuo'a vyi. Cuorasala a hnyituv ca duote pata cuo'a vyi.

A chuo ciepa cuo ningta cue kha malie zaa de buopa cuo te, a hnyituv zaw kha changpa a cuo thluo pata hre li pata aw te, capa cue ca ta capaa acuolikie canung pakha kha de te a thiy kieca, cuetungpa ca alung ta vaasapa cuo'a te, a hnyituv zaw thiepa a cuo aa.
Cadyiseca, athlana muo kha a hnyituv'a luo hiepa a cuo kieca a hringna a thlana riypata ama hupa zaa kha a pi aa.
Cuetungpa ta haatiypa ma haatiynung ma a desa kieca a cung luo phung haa hingta ziypa a cuo aa.
Cuetungpa ta siicapaa acuolikie siicanung kha a desa kieca cue a hnyituv ta sii a hnyituv kha ngu shekel sawthung lu'a te, cuetungpa ca alung ta vaasapa a cuo aa.
Cawsaa pakhakha ta khue kha pahruv li pata thuse te, acuolikie khue kha cu te a pahruv li nakawta cue acuolikie laa kha a tla kieca,
khue a hnyituv ta cue a hnyituv kha tuokaa ta lu'a te, cuorasala sahring thiypa kha ca aa la aa.
Cawsaa pakhakha cue ta a hrangpa pakhakha cue kha a desa kieca, a hringpa cue kha zaa'a yi te a muo kha khingkhuo ta amaa che aa. A thiypa sahring zaw kha khingkhuo ta amaa che aa.
Cuorasala capa cue ca ahluo ta de a hmuopa a cuopa kha pachangpa cuo te a hnyituv ta a hre li kieca, a hnyituv ta cue muo kha cue ta lu'a te a thiypa cue kha aa la aa.
Cawsaa pakhakha ta cuetungpa cuose, tuv cuose paruv te a thie kie cuose, a zaa kie cuose, a paruvtuv ca ta cuetungpa sakha cuota cuetungpa sapangaa, tuv sakha cuota tuv sapaliy a thung hriy aa.

Aparuvpa ca ta a thung pakhaa aa, cuorasala a hnyipa a aw li kieca a paruvpa thungna riypata a paruvtuv kha zaa pata a cuo aa. A paruvpa sahring, cuetungpa acuolikie laa acuolikie tuv kha a paruvtuv kuv lie hmungpa a cuo kieca a paruvtuv ta le hning ta a thung aa.
A paruvtuv kha zuo ta ing a caphi nguoluo pata hmung yi te ama tuvsa pata a cuo kieca, a tuvsapa ca lie a nawpa ta cuo'a vyi;
cuorasala capa ca ning chiy khutaata a cuo kieca lie a nawpa ta a cuo aa.
Cawsaa pakhakha ta a sahring kha lu lie cuose, mingsuv diedung lie cuose patle te malie lu kha a ce kieca, sahring a hnyituv lu acuolikie mingsuv diedung taata a pyapa a pha cepa khata a lu aa.
Myi ta ruo kuo te, sacuo pie cuose, sacuo kung cuose, lu cuose, a kuo kieca myi a pakuotuv ta a kuopa muo kha a lu aa.
Cawsaa pakhakha ta a ingpaa kha tuokaa acuolikie chechiy paking sa te, a ingpaa ing taa cata ama paruv kieca, a paruvtuv kha ama patuv khu kieca a le hning ta a lu aa.
Cuorasala a paruvtuv kha ama patuv khu li kieca, ama ta a ingpaa chechiy kha a la ma la va ma tapa kha biechi the riypata ing hnyituv ca Khazing hmiekung luo chiykhyi pata a cuo aa.

Cuetungpa, laa, tuv, cawsie, acuolikie a viepa chechiy suokhakha kha amaa chuv kieca ama kuo hning khata Khazing hmiekung luo chiykhyi pata ama cuo aa. Khazing ta sue a phawpa khata a hrangpa pakha kha le hning ta a lu aa.

Cawsaa pakhakha ta laa, cuetungpa, tuv, acuolikie sahring hrangpa sakhakha kha cawsaa hrangpa paking sa te a sahring ca a thiy acuolikie hmaa a phya, acuolikie ahungtahmuo hmung li pata amaa ruokhyi kieca,
a kingtuv khata paruv va ang ta pata Abyipahmiekunglie chie aa sana khata iema pahning alalalie kha bie a chi aa. A paruv li kieca a hnyituv ta chiesana kha aa paw aa. Lu a hu'a vyi.
Cuorasala a paruv kieca a hnyituv'a luo kha a lu aa.
Saa ta a sie kieca a ce buopa kha tehte riypata chiykhyi se. Lu a hu'a vyi.
Cawsaa pakha ta cawsaa hrangpa'a taata sahring kha a hluo te a hnyituv a aw li chungta hmaa aa hmung kie cuose, a thiy kie cuose, a tlingsa pata a lu aa.
A hnyituv a aw ra kieca a hluotuv ta lu'a vyi. A muo pi riypata aa hluo kieca, aa hluona muo dyina a pi aa.
Capaa pakha ta pahaa lipa lesaa pakha kha dung te aa ziehne kieca sue kha muo'a te napuv ta aa la aa.
Cuorasala a paa ta a pi khing li kieca lesaa nung muo hneta aa khingpa zaa kha a pi aa.
Ca-ie a thepa canung kha pahring khah ung.
Sahring hneta suena a tuepa cawsaa ca thie pata cuo se.
Abyipapakha ta li pata khazing hrangpa'a luo kha hriykhung a ripa ca thie pata a cuo aa.
Nama ruo lie a pepa ruohrang ming kha tuechie'a va ung ciy. Tahematapakieca niema zaw Izipt ruo lie kha mingpe tana nama za cuo ra.
Nunghlyi hne haaraa kha ese'a va ung ciy.
Ese ung cate kama'a luo kha ama kya khi tiyta, ama khi ryi kha thyi'a yi angte,
i pathiy kha myi ie ta ie'a te, zueziy ta ca thie'a yi angte, nama napuv kha nunghlyi ta a li'a yi te nama saata kha haaraa ta amaa li aa.
Niema hrawlie a siypasapa i cawsaa tie kha tuokaa nama pahlie kieca, tuokaa ducyi a pituv tie ta ama tuepa haata tue'a va ung ciy; iema'a taata amie kha la'a va ung ciy.
Na ingpaa pang kha biekuona cuota na patuv kieca ning a tla hluota na pi pakhaa aa.

Tahematapakieca capa zung kha kyalya dyi ca aa buv riyta a hnyipa cuo sala, khaapa a buv'a te ma aa zie aa? Kama'a luo kha a kya khi kieca i naathliepa aa, tahematapakieca kama ca kawpacuona a hnyipa tana i cuo.
Khazing kha ripachie'a vaciy, nama cawsaa luochiytuv a cuopa kha chie sa'a vaciy.
Na sa hne na mingsuvtiy hne na olif chiytiy zaw kama'a luo ahlu pi riypa kha haasaa'a vaciy. Sacapaa uvthyi kha kama'a luo ina pi'a ung ciy.
Cahaacata nama cue, nama tuv zaw kha ina pi'a ung ciy: ning sariy te kha a nung'a lie aw'a te, ning carinapa lie kha kama'a luo ina pi'a ung ciy.
Niema ca kama cuota a pathepa cawsaa ta nama cuo aa; caacuonakawta ruo lie saa ta a siepa saruopa saa kha ce'a va ung ciy, uv na nama thaw aa.
Aa dang lipa thuohlaa kha ri pachaa'a vaciy. Aa hmuo lipa tehte cuo riypata cawsaa pha lipa kha a phuv'a vaciy.
Pha lina tuena kawlieta hluv vie ama cuo zaw ziy'a va yi ciy; bieripana lie tehte na cuo tiyta, biedangpa para riypata hluv vie kuo luo kha a daa'a vaciy.
Bieripana lieta siypasa tie kha pahlyipale'a va yi ciy.
Na cariepa cuetungpa acuolikie laa a viepa kha na hmung kieca, naa vya dapa pakhaale aa.
Nama caa huepa paa a laa kha a hmang ta vy te a laapa na hmung kieca sise'a vaciy, hya pazang riypata naa bya aa.
Nama cawsaa siypasa tie kha aa dangta tah bie ripa tie yi.
Aa dang li pata malie sue be kha cahriy tie. Suena a hnyi lipa hne aa dangpa tie kha thie'a va yi ciy, tahematapakieca a suepa tie ca a ngiethe'a va yi ang.
Nawthuv ning'a vaciy, tahematapakieca nawthuv ca byi tie ming kha pacue te, aa dangpa tie bie kha a pali a pahnaa ta a tue taw.
Na ruo lie a pepa ruohrang ming kha hrisaa'a vaciy, tahematapakieca niema zaw Izipt ruo lie kha mingpe za cuo ung cate mingpe pathiypalung kha nama pachang.
Kung caruv chung na lu kha thlu'a cate a chungtaata a pyapa sa kha na la aa;

cuorasala kung sariynapa lie ca thlu li pata na pahy sa aa, caacuokieca na cawsaa siypasa tie khata ning'a yi te aa ngaapa kha saruopa zaw ta ama ning aa. Na mingsuv dung hne na olif dung zaw kha cahaa ngiethie cata na tue aa.

Ning caruv chung kha na re hrie'a cate, cuorasala ning sariynapa lie ca naa pahy aa, caacuokieca na cuetungpa hne na laa zaw kha a pahy'a yi te, naa chungkhue sii hne mingpe tie zaw thaazuo thaapa ama hmung aa.
Ica changpa mekaa hing a phasa pata naathlie tie. Khazing hrangpa tie ming ta thlaachuo khah, na pakaa taata thyipa cuo khah se.
Kung kha ta yi thung kama cuota pyi na tue aa.

Thiynung Phuv Lipa Viechuo Pyi kha na tue aa; bie ica pipa haa khata, Abib thlaa chunglie ning thlipa ning sariy chung kha thiynung phuv lipa viechuo kha na ning aa, tahematapakieca capa thlaa chunglie cana Izipt taata na vya pya. Ahunghmuo kuv cahri pata kama'a luo a vaw'a va ung ciy.

Sathaapa Pyi kha na tue aa; na lu lie ciy na cyipa taata na la taapa sathaapa khata na tue aa. Sa Pahmya Pyi kha na tue aa; kung chuonapa cuo lie, na lu lie a pyapa sa na pahmyana cuo lie khata a cuo aa.
Kung kha ta yi thung na capaa tie bangkhuo ca AbyipaKhazing hmiekung luo kha amaa luo aa.
Hriykhungrinapa thiyse kha thiynung phuvpa viechuo hneta na pi'a vaciy. I pyi lie thiepa saa a thupa ca mawluo maw te ta pangaa'a vaciy.
Na lu taata na la taapa a pha cepa sathaapa kha Abyipana Khazing ing luo na chiykhyi aa. Mietaata kha a puvnung ahnungtiy ta pasu'a vaciy.
Na luopuv lie nama caa mangchiytuv riypa yi hne kama i tingpa hmang luo caa vya chiy riypa yi ta na hmiekung luo khata avuoming ica pathliepa aa.
A ri a ngie la a bie kha naathlie tie. Ama kha a du khah, tahematapakieca i ming ca ama chunglie aw te, na tuesuena kha caa ngiethe'a vyi.
Cuorasala a ripa kha a phasa pata naathlie cate, i ripa bangkhuo kha na tue kieca, kama ca na carie tie carie ta cuo'a angte, caa dutuv tie a dutuv ta i cuo aa.
I vuoming kha na hmiekunglie si'a te, nama kha Amor ming, Hit ming, Periz ming, Kanaan ming, Hiv ming hne Jebus ming'a luo kha aca sikhyi kieca iema kha kama ta i para diy'a yi.

Ama khazing tie hmiekunglie kha a bu'a vaciy, a bie'a vaciy, iema phung kha ziy ra'a vaciy, cuorasala ama khazing tie ca para diy karue'a cate, ama khahrung abiena lungbang bangkhuo kha na para patlaa diy aa.
Niema ca Abyipanama Khazing re khana nama hrie aa. Na sa hne na tiy kha thluechiy pi'a angte, pasana zaw kha nama'a taata ica lapa aa.
Na ruo lie hing ahunghmuo nu a rapa hne nu a hnyi khu lipa aw'a va yi. Na chuo ica pasiy sa aa.

Na hmiekung luota ciy aa chiypa kha pathlie'a angte, na vya sina riypa lie caa dupa mingphang zaw chunglie kha ataw-amuona i thawsue'a yi. Na carie tie kha ta hnang ca chaw'a yi te amaa ruo riypata i tue'a yi.
Puvtlung pasana zaw kha na hmiekung luota pathlie'a angte, capa ca ta Hiv ming, Kanaan ming, hne Hit ming zaw kha aa cade diy'a yi.
Ruo kha duothling sa'a te saa a hruopa kha nama laata pungzaa vie'a kie yi ta pata kung kha chunglieta ca a cade diy'a va yi ang.
Nama kha pungzaa viele'a cate ruo na lana te ta a cawta a cawta tana i cade'a yi.
Na ruoriy ca Riyliy Sepa taata Filistin riyliy te, hne ruocaapa taata Zufrates cavaa te ta a cuo aa. Tahematapakieca capa ruo ming ca na kuv luo kha ca pi'a angte, naa cade diy'a yi.
Iema hne cuose, ama khazing tie hne cuose biekuona tue'a vaciy.
Iema ca na ruo lie kha aw'a va yi, caacuolikieca nama khana kama'a lie aca pasue sa'a yi; tahematapakieca iema khazing kha naa bie kieca nama cuota na ranapa cyihyi tana a cuo aa.
Cakhutaa cata Abyipata Moses kha, “Nama hne Aaron, Nadab, hne Abihu, hne Israel uvthyi sawsariy kha Abyipa'a luo kya kie ung la, luohlaa taa khata naa bie tie ung.
Moses dyi kha Abyipahne aa ngiena luo naa vaw aa; cuorasala a hrangpa tie ca naa vya ngie'a va yi. Cawsaa kha tluo cung luo kya kie'a va yi,” a ta.
Moses ca cawsaa tie'a luo kha a vaw te Abyipabie hne ziyphung bangkhuo kha a chang yi. Cawsaa bangkhuo ta, “Abyipamalie a changpa bangkhuo ca ma tue aa, ama ta.
Cakhutaa cata Moses ta Abyipabie bangkhuo kha a cape. Mawdiy ta thu te tluo thabaw lie kha bienatluophie sa te lungbang suohraa hlyihning kha Israel mingphang phang hraa hlyihning cuopa khata a bang.
Ama ta Israel mingnu tie kha pathlie yi te, cuetungpa ta myirue panaana hne aviesaa panaana ta Abyipakha amaa bie.
Moses ta cuetungpa thiy chekha kha la te bikang lie chi te khingkhuo yalya khata bienatluophie kha a hi.
Cakhutaata biekuona caa-uv kha la te cawsaa zaw thyinapa lie kha a ri. Cakhutaata iema ta, “Abyipaa ripa bangkhuo ca tue'a pate ma ziy aa,” ama ta.
Moses ta thiy kha la te, cawsaa tie kha hi yi te, “Hing bie bangkhuo hne aa ziy pata Abyipata a tuepa biekuona thiyse hing mang tie ung,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Moses hne Aaron, Nadab hne Abihu, hne Israel ming uvthyi tie sawsariy ca kiethaw yi te Israel Khazing kha ama hmung.
A phyipazaa rawlie ca safaiar lungvaa phaapa haata cuo te, avuo pathepa haa khiyta a pathe.
Khazing ta Israel ming uvthyi tie kha ruvnaana pi va yi; Khazing kha hmung yi te ama ning ama dang.
Abyipata Moses kha, “Tluo cung luo kha kya kie la capa lie ca na huo tie. I cawsaa zaw cawpa riypata i phungbie hne i nawbie i capenapa lungphie khana ica pi aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Moses ca ama a byatuv Joshua hne khata a thu yi te, Moses ca Khazing tluo cung luo kha a kie.

Uvthyi tie kyihuo khata, “Niema'a luo ma za kaa pakhaana te ta hingpa taa hingta kiema kha malie za huo mya ung. Aaron hne Hur kha niema'a lie ama aw thluo nakawta bie a hnyipa nama aw kieca iema'a luo kha cakuo riypa tana a cuo aa,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata Moses ca tluo cung luo kha kie te, amyi ta tluo kha a pahlaw diy.
Abyiparungnaana ca Sinai Tluo lie kha za cung te, amyi ta ning caruv chung a pahlaw. Ning sariynapa lie ca Abyipata amyi chungtaata Moses kha a u.
Israel ming hmungnapa lieta Abyiparungnaana ca tluo cunglie a hlaa nguoluopa myi hne tana aa lu.
Moses ca amyi chung luo kha a ngie te tluo cung luo ca a kie. Moses ca ning sawliy hne zuo sawliy chung tluo cunglie ca a aw.
Abyipata Moses kha:
Israel ming kha kama cuota lungthe pina thu riypata chang tie yi; ama palung lie a kya puvpa haata ina pipa yi kha na cuhluo aa.
Iema'a taata na cuhluo riypa lungthe pina ca: siy, ngu, daa,
a dungpa, a ciycaapa, hne a sedungpa palaa, cawthang a phapa, mie hming,
siyy sepa thuv ciepa tuvtungpa vang, savang phapa, akasia thing,
myi-ing cuota sathu, tluobyi sathu rangpa-ue, rangpa-ue pakhuv riypa ziyhmyi,
oniks alung hne, tluobyi buohryi hne cacunghnaabe lie be riypa hne pathlie riypa lungvaa zaw ta a cuo aa.
Iema hrawlie i aw the riypata hmangpathepa na sapa yi se.
Bienathluodaa hmingsuo hne a chunglie hmangbya bangkhuo ca ica pahmungsapa haa khata a cuo aa.
Akasia thing ta thingkaw suokha na tue aa; a syina daw hning a che, a kuna daw kha a che, aa suona daw kha a che ta a cuo aa.
Achungluo hne aleluo kha siy pathepa pakhuv'a cate, thingkaw a tluo aa dung diy pata siy na pakaw aa.
Siy tieky suopaliy patle'a cate a phyi suopaliy lie kha nama bang aa; suohning kha kuokhaluo, a hrangpa suohning kha kuokhaluo ta na bang aa.
Aluo zaw kha akasia thing ta tue'a cate siy ta nama pakhuv aa.
Aluo ca thingkaw a kuo vyicuo lieta nama bangpa a tieky lie kha pahryi'a cate capa ca ta naa puv aa.
Aluo zaw ca thingkaw tieky lie kha pahryi pacie pata a aw pari aa, a da pathla'a vaciy.
Ica pipa biekuona kha capa thingkaw lie ca na chi aa.
Cakhutaata a pahruv kha siy pathepa selaw ta nama tue aa; a syina daw hning a che, a kuna daw kha a che ta a cuo aa.
A pahruv a dawluo kuo hning lie kha a de ta depa siy ta cherubim suohning na tue aa.
Cherubim suokha kha a daw suokhaluo, cherubim suokha kha a hrangpa a daw suokhaluo ta pata a pahruv hneta aa pazue pata a dawluo kuo hning lie khata na tue aa.
Cherubim ca ama mathlaa kha a cung luo ta pazu'a yi te thingkaw pahruv kha ningdiy ama padiy aa. Cherubim tie ca a hmiepachaw'a yi te thingkaw pahruv luo kha amaa hyi kaluo aa.
A pahruv ca thingkaw cunglie khata chi'a cate a chunglie ca ica pi riypa biekuona ca na chi aa.
Capa lie ca nama kha caa taw'a angte, thingkaw pahruv cung, biekuona thingkaw cunglie a awpa cherubim sahning alala taa khata Israel ming cuota i nawbie bangkhuo kha nama'a luo ica pi aa.
Akasia thing ta cabya suokha tue'a cate, a syina daw hning, a kuna daw kha, aa suona daw kha a che ta a cuo aa.
Siy pathepa pakhuv'a cate a kie aa dung pata siy na pakaw aa.
A kie ca a chi aa dung diy pata pazaa phie ta tue'a cate siy na pakaw diy aa.
Capa cuo ca ta siy tieky suo paliy tue'a cate, a kiy kiy paliy lieta a phyi suo paliy lie kha na bang aa.
Aa puvnapa aluo pahryinapa a tieky ca a tluopakaw hne khata aa ngie aa.
Akasia thing ta aluo kha tue'a cate siy ta na pakhuv diy aa. Capa ca ta cabya kha namaa puv aa.
Rangpa-ue pakhuvna riypata pakaa hne pakaa aa thuvpa, dangpa ta panaana patlena riypata khazaa-ung hne kuotung zaw bangkhuo kha siy pathepa ta na tue aa.
I hmiekung cabya lie kha Phuovaa viechuo ca na chi pari aa.
Myi vuona tung kha siy pathepa ta na tue aa. A patunapa hne a tung ca a de ta depa siy ta na tue aa; a papuvthesapa paapaapa, a paa pake, hne a paa pamangta zaw kha aa pazue diy pata na tue aa.
A kuo cyicuo khata a ce ce caruv pya'a te, ce thung kha myi vuona tung kuokhaluo, ce thung kha a hrangpa kuokhaluo ta a pya aa.

Ce kha lie kha almond paa haa khata a nge nge thung aw'a te, a nge cyicuo lie kha a paa pamangta hne a paa paketa ama aw. Ce kha luo zaw kha almond paa haa khata a nge nge thung aw'a te, a paa paketa hne a paa pamangta hneta a aw aa. Caacuonakawta myi vuona tung lie ca a ce ce caruv ta a kya pya.
Myi vuona tung taa hrahring khata a papuvthesapa a nge nge paliy pya te, suokha cyicuo khata almond paa haa khata a paa pamangta hne a paa paketa zaw ama hnyi.

A ce ba kha rawlie kha a paa pamangta suokha, a suohningnapa a ce ba kha rawlie kha a paa pamangta suokha, a hnangcaw cepa a ce ba kha rawlie kha a paa pamangta suokha ta pata a aw aa; caacuonakawta myi vuona tung taa khata a ce ce caruv a pya aa.
A paa pamangta hne a ce tie ca aa pazue pata aw'a te, a bangkhuo ca ta a de ta depa siy pathepa ta tuepa a cuo aa.
Capa myi vuona tung cuo ca ta myi-ing suosariy tue'a cate, a hmieluo hmang yalya kha khena pi riypata a cunglie kha bang'a cate na vuo aa.
A cecakie hne a buvcuo liyna pakaa zaw kha siy pathepa ta tuepa a cuo aa.
Myi vuona tung hne capa hne aa pazuepa a chechiy tingby bangkhuo kha siy pathepa talen suokha chuo pata na tue aa.
Tluo cunglie ica pahmung sapa hmingsuo haa kha tana na tue aa.
Ca hlyitaw taata bienathluodaa kha a dungpa, a ciycaapa hne a sedungpa a bya ta pahiepa palaa ta taapa cawthang, a cunglie cherubim zuv a puvthesa pata sapa cawthang zung hraa ta sa tie.
Capa pangzu cyicuo ca a syina luo daw kiy daw cari, a kuna luo daw paliy cuo'a te a le a caw amaa khing diy aa.
Zung pangaa tie kha patue'a cate, a hrangpa zung pangaa tie zaw kha na patue aa.
Na patue taapa pangzu zung khanapa a kie cunglie kha cawthang a dungpa ta a naabale na thla aa. Cahaacata a zung hningna na patuepa a kie cunglie zaw kha cawthang a dungpa ta a naabale na thla ra aa.

Na patue taapa pangzu a kie cunglie kha a naabale sawngaa thla'a cate, a suohningnapa nama patuepa pangzu a kie cunglie zaw kha a naabale sawngaa na thla ra aa. A naabale tie ca kuo vyicuo ta ama aw aa.
Siy hyiluo sawngaa tue'a cate, capa ca ta patuepa pangzu zung hning kha a naabale taa khata cakhiy'a cate bienathluodaa suokha ta a cuo aa.
Bienathluodaa a cungkhuv riypata mie hming ta taapa pangzu zung hraa hlyikha zaw kha na taa aa.
Capa pangzu zung kha ca a tung daw sawthung cuo'a te, a haa daw paliy ta a cuo aa. Zung hraa hlyikha yalya cata a le a caw amaa khing diy aa.
Zung pangaa kha suokha ta patue'a cate, a hrangpa zung pangaa kha suokha ta na patue aa. A suocaruvnapa pangzu ca bienathluodaa hmielie kha thang hning ta na kadiy aa.
Pangzu na patuepa zung khanapa a kie cunglie kha a naabale sawngaa, a zung hningnapa na patuepa a kie cunglie kha a naabale sawngaa na tue aa.
Daa hyiluo sawngaa tue'a cate, a naabale taa khata hyiluo cata cakhiy'a cate zung kha ta aa li aa.
Bienathluodaa lie a hlepa cawthang a che ca bienathluodaa a hnangluo khata aa pathlie aa.
Bienathluodaa cawthang a syina luota a hlepa, kuokhaluo ta daw kha, a hrangpa kuokhaluo ta daw kha ca bienathluodaa kuo vyicuo kha a buv riypata aa pathlie aa.
Bienathluodaa a cungkhuv riypa kha siyy sepa ama thuvpa tuvtungpa vang ta tue'a cate, a cungkhuv a pakhuv pachaapa ca savang phapa kha na tue aa.
Bienathluodaa ca akasia thing hmuo pata a tung luo ta tlepie na chung aa.
Tlepie suokha ca daw hraa syi'a te, daw kha a che a ku aa.
Tlepie suokha hne suokha patuena riypata tlepie suokha lie kha a liy suohning na tue aa. Bienathluodaa tlepie bangkhuo kha cahaacata na tue aa.
Bienathluodaa sungluo kuo cuota tlepie ca suokiy a cuo aa.

Tlepie suokiy cuo ca ta ngu ta tuepa a liypatu sawliy na tue aa, tlepie suokha lie a awpa a liy suohning cuota a liypatu suohning cuo'a te a vya paziypa tlepie suokha a liy suohning cuota a liypatu suohning ta a cuo aa.
Bienathluodaa a kuo hningnapa luo, chaluo kuo ta tlepie suokiy
hne ngu ta tuepa a liypatu sawliy, tlepie suokhanapa rawlieta a liypatu suohning, a vya paziypa tlepie suokha cuota a liypatu suohning ta pata na tue aa.
Bienathluodaa ningtlaluo kuo ta tlepie suocaruv na tue aa.
Bienathluodaa a hnangluo kuo ingkiy vyicuo lie kha tlepie suohning na tue aa.
Iema ca a nanang ta a daa'a yi te, cuorasala a cung luo a tieky suokhana lie kha a kya hrepuo vyicuo aa. A suohning ta cahaacata cuo'a te ingkiy kiy hning kha cahaacata tuepa a cuo aa.
Cahaacata ingkiy tlepie ca suocari cuo'a te, a liypatu suohraa hlyicaruv a cuo aa. Tlepie suokhana cuota a liypatu suohning, a hrangpa suokha cuota a liypatu suohning ta pata a cuo aa.
Bienathluodaa kuokhaluo kuo tlepie suopangaa cuota a tluo suopangaa kha akasia thing ta na tue aa.
A hrangpa kuokhaluo kuo tlepie cuota tluo pangaa a cuo aa. Bienathluodaa ningtlaluo kuo tlepie cuo zaw kha tluo pangaa a cuo aa.
Tlepie a khingkhuo lieta a sipa a tluo ca kuo kha taata kuo kha luo a chuona te a syi tlungluopa ta a cuo aa.
Tlepie ca siy pakhuv'a ung cate a tluo pahryina riypata a tieky kha siy ta na tue aa. Tlepie tluo zaw kha siy na pakhuv aa.
Tluo cunglie ica pahmung sapa yi pungsaan haa khata bienathluodaa ca na sa aa.
A dungpa, a ciycaapa, hne a sedungpa palaa, a bya ta pahiepa palaa ta ama taapa cawthang, cherubim zuv aa luo pata taapa cawthang khata pangzu na tue aa.
Capa pangzu ca a daw lie siy ta ama tuepa cawthang pathlienapa kyipa ama bangpa, ngu ta ama tuepa a liypatu lie ama patupa, siy ama pakhuv diypa akasia tung lie kha na pathlie aa.

Pangzu ca a pathlienapa kyipa lie ca buo'a cate na pathlie aa. Biekuona thingkaw ca capa pangzu chung luo cata chi'a ung cate, pangzu ca ta niema cuota hmang pathepa ca hmang pathe cepa taata a che aa.
Hmang pathe cepa chunglie a awpa biekuona thingkaw kha a pahruv na pahruv aa.
Pangzu le luo khata cabya kha na chi aa. Cabya taata kuokhaluo, bienathluodaa sungluo kuo khata myi vuona tung kha na chi aa. Cabya ca chaluo kuo khata na chi aa.
Thluodaa luo a ngiena riypa a thlake pangzu ca, a dungpa, a ciycaapa hne a sedungpa palaa, a bya ta pahiepa palaa ta taapa, ciphang ta paapaapa daw yi te ama pangipa cawthang phapa ta na tue aa.
Ingchiypakaa pangzu cuo ca ta akasia tung tung pangaa tue'a ung cate siy ta na pakhuv diy aa. A pang pathlienapa a kyipa ca siy ta tue'a cate, a liypatu suopangaa kha daa ta na tue aa.
Bienatluophie ca akasia thing ta na tue aa. A syina daw pangaa, a kuna daw pangaa, atung ahaa aa khing pata cuo'a te, daw thung aa suo aa.
A kiy kiy paliy lie kha a thingpazue tue'a cate, a thingpazue hne a tluophie hne ca aa pazue diy aa. A yalya khata daa ta na pakaw diy aa.
A buvcuo liyna riypata bi, hne kawpia, pakaa aa thuvpa, khazin hne buvcuo liyna phie zaw kha na tue aa. A chechiy tingby bangkhuo hingta daa ta na tue aa.
Daa syry zaw kha tue'a cate, a kiy kiy paliy lie kha daa tieky suopaliy na bang aa.
Bienatluophie a tluo rawlie khata bang'a cate, bienatluophie khingkhuo hraw te kha a za pha aa.
Bienatluophie cuo khata akasia thing ta a tluo tue'a cate daa na pakaw diy aa.
Bienatluophie kha a puvpa a cuo tiyta a kuo hning ta aluo a aw the riypata aluo ca a tieky lie kha pahryi pata a cuo aa.
Bienatluophie ca a chung a karaw riypata thingphie ta na sa aa. Tluo cunglie ica pahmung sapa haa kha tana na sa aa.
Bienathluodaa kha a dungkhuo na tue aa. Sungluo kuo ta a dungkhuo ca a bya ta pahiepa palaa ta taapa cawthang phapa ta na dungkhuo aa, daw zakha a syi aa.
A tung tung kiy hne a patuna suokiy ca daa ta tue pata cuo'a te, cuorasala a kyipa hne a tluo tie ca ngu ta tue pata a cuo aa.
Cahaacata chaluo kuo zaw a dungkhuo a syina ca daw zakha cuo'a te, a tung tung kiy, a liypatu suokiy ca daa ta tue pata a cuo aa, cuorasala a kyipa hne a tluo ca ngu ta tue pata a cuo aa.
Ningtlaluo kuo ta a dungkhuo a kuna ca daw sawngaa cuo'a te, aa tung tung hraa hne a liypatu suohraa a cuo aa.
Ningchiyluo kuo, a hmieluo ta a dungkhuo a kupa ca daw sawngaa ta a cuo aa.
Kuokhaluo a dungkhuo a kupa ca daw hraa hlyipangaa ta cuo'a te a tung tung thung hne a tung liypatu suothung a cuo aa.
A hrangpa kuokhaluo kuo ta a dungkhuo ca daw hraa hlyipangaa cuo ra'a te, a tung tung thung hne a tung liypatu suothung a cuo ra aa.

A dungkhuo thlake cuota pangzu ca daw kiy a syi aa, a dungpa, a ciycaapa, a sedungpa palaa, a bya ta pahiepa palaa ta taapa cawthang phapa, ciphang ta daw yi te ama papuvthe sapa cawthang ta tuepa cuo'a te, a tung tung paliy hne a tung liypatu suopaliy a hnyi aa.
A dungkhuona tung bangkhuo ca ngu ta tuepa a tluo ta patuv sa diy pata cuo'a te, a kyipa ca ngu ta cuo'a te a liypatu bangkhuo ca daa ta a cuo aa.
A dungkhuo ca a syina daw zakha, a kuna daw sawngaa, aa suona daw pangaa ta a cuo aa. A pangzu ca a bya ta pahiepa palaa ta taapa cawthang phapa hne a tung liypatu ca daa ta tuepa a cuo aa.
Bienatluophie lie hmuopa a chechiy tingby bangkhuo, chechiy buonapa bangkhuo hne a dungkhuo lie chechiy buonapa bangkhuo ca daa ta tue pata a cuo aa.
Myi-ing kha cipari vuopa a cuo the riypata, olif thyi kha suv yi te ama lapa olif thu kha nama'a luo ama vya chiykhyi riypata Israel ming kha bie na pi'a yi.

Bienathluodaa ahmyana hmang, biekuona thingkaw hmie, pangzu le luo lie, Abyipahmiekunglie kha Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw ta, zuoluocaw taata maw te ta ama huo aa. Capa ca Israel ming ta chuo kha hnang chuo kha ama ziy pari riypa ziyphung ta a cuo aa.
Cakhutaata kama cuota tluobyi re a hrie riypata Israel ming chung taa khata na uvta Aaron hne a sacapaa tie Nadab hne Abihu, Eleazar hne Ithamar kha nama'a luo ku tie yi.
Na uvta Aaron kha rungnaana hne linghlaa awsa riypata a pathepa tluobyi cawsie kha na tuepa aa.
Kama ta thena i pipa kuvzung thena a hnyipa tie bangkhuo kha chang yi la, Aaron ta tluobyi re a hrie the riypata tluobyi cawsie kha tuepa yi se.

Tluobyi cawsie ama tue riypa ca: cacunghnaabe suokha, tluobyi buohryi zung kha, buohryi pasiypa zung kha, a paa ama dawpa buohryi rawpatlung zung kha, pawde zung kha, hne tesaw suo kha zaw ta ama cuo aa. Na uvta Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw tluobyi re ama hrie the riypata a pathepa tluobyi caw ama tue tiyta,
siy, a dungpa, a ciycaapa hne a sedungpa palaa ta ama taapa cawthang phapa kha ama hmuo aa.
Tluobyi buohryi ca siy, a dungpa, a ciycaapa, hne a sedungpa palaa, a bya ta pahiepa palaa ta taapa cawthang phapa, a paa zaw ama dawpa cawthang ta na tue aa.
Aa pazue the riypata a kiy kuo vyicuo lie kha letung riy suohning thla pata a cuo aa.

Capa cunglie a awpa a puvthesa pata taapa tesaw ama taanazya hne ama hmuopa a chechiy ca a lu'a te, siy, a dungpa, a ciycaapa, a sedungpa palaa, hne ama pahiepa palaa ta taapa cawthang phapa ta tuepa a cuo aa.
Oniks alung suohning la'a cate Israel sacapaa zaw ming kha na cape aa.
Ama puvna ning ziy pata aa paziy pata pacaruv ming kha alung suokha cunglie cape'a cate, aa ngaapa a hrangpa pacaruv ming kha alung hrangpa lie kha na cape aa.
Lung muosung a uotuv ta caakhe lie caa ama capepa haa khata alung suohning cunglie kha Israel sacapaa zaw ming kha cape'a cate, siy ta a tluo na pakaw aa.
Israel sacapaa zaw maw lina ta capa alung suohning ca tluobyi buohryi a riy lie kha na bang aa. Athyi parina riypata Abyipahmiekunglie kha Aaron ta iema ming kha a letung cunglie ca a phya pari aa.
Siy tluopakaw hne
siy pathepa ta tuepa a riy tie kha khuhriy camaapuopa haa khata ciypuo'a cate na patue aa.
Bieripana cacunghnaabe kha kuvzung phasa pata na tue aa. Tluobyi buohryi lie haa khata siy, a dungpa, a ciycaapa, hne a sedungpa palaa, a bya ta pahiepa palaa ta taapa cawthang phapa ta na tue aa.
Atung hne ahaa a khing'a te, thang hning ta cuo'a te, atung kha kha, ahaa kha kha ta a cuo aa.
Lungvaa kha tluo paliy ta na be aa. Karnelian, khrisolait, hne emerald tie kha tluo khana lie;
tluo hningna lie ca lungvaa hringpa, safaiar hne daimon;
a tluo thungna lie ca jasin, agate, hne amethist;
a tluo paliyna lie ca beril, oniks hne jasper ta a cuo aa.

Alung suohraa hlyihning cunglie kha Israel sacapaa zaw ming kha a cyicuo ta cape pata a cuo aa. Alung suokha lie kha ming suokha ta caakhe lie caa capepa haa khata Israel ming phang hraa hlyihning ming kha cape pata a cuo aa.
Cacunghnaabe buoliriy kha khuhriy haata aa camaa pata siy pathepa ta na tue aa.
Cakhutaata cacunghnaabe cuota siy kuvpahryi suohning tue'a cate, a daw suohning lie kha na be aa.
Siy buoliriy a daw kha cacunghnaabe a daw lie a awpa siy kuvpahryi suohning lie kha na cakhiy aa.
Siy buoliriy a daw suohning ca siy tluo pakaw suohning lie kha cakhiy'a cate, tluobyi buohryi letung riy a hmieluo'apa lie kha na cakhiy aa.
Siy tieky suohning tue'a cate, tluobyi buohryi a kya phapa cacunghnaabe a chungluo a daw suohning lie kha na bang aa.
Siy tieky suohning kha tue'a cate, tluobyi buohryi a letung riy a raw luo, a hmieluo kuo khata cakhiy'a cate, a puvthesa pata tuepa a tesaw cunglie kha a zaa patue aa.

Cacunghnaabe lie a tieky tie ca tluobyi buohryi a tieky tie hne khata pataw'a cate a dungpa camaapa riy ta na ciy paki aa. A tieky tie kha pangipa tluobyi buohryi tesaw cunglie khata laa'a te, cacunghnaabe ca tluobyi buohryi taa khata a pathluo li pata a aw aa.

Caacuonakawta Abyipahmiekunglie a thyi parina riypata hmang pathepa luo kha aa ngie tiyta, Aaron ta a palung cunglie a awpa bieripana cacunghnaabe cunglie a awpa Israel sacapaa tie ming kha a phyale pari aa.

Bieripana cacunghnaabe chunglie kha Urim hne Thummim kha khung'a ung cate, Abyipahmiekung luo Aaron a cakuo thue kha a palung chunglieta a aw aa. Cahaacata Aaron ca Abyipahmiekunglieta Israel ming bieripana kha a palung lie a chi pari aa.
Tluobyi buohryi pasiypa bangkhuo ca a dungpa palaa ta taapa a cuo aa.
A liekhingkhuo lie kha luv pahryina riypata a khue suokha pahawpa cuo'a te, a tlaa li riypata rieka buohryi cungpakaw haa khata a khue pahawnapa lie kha rue pakaw pakaw pata a cuo aa.
Arawluo a daw lie kha a dungpa, a ciycaapa hne a sedungpa ta tuepa cale thyi pathlie'a cate, arawluo a daw aa dungpa khata cale thyi amaa lalalie kha siy daaking na pathlie aa.
Cale thyi hne siy daaking kha aa ypaci pata buohryi pasiypa arawluo a daw aa dung pata na pathlie aa.
Aaron ta tluobyi re a hrie tiyta a hryi'a te, Abyipahmiekung hmang pathepa luo a vaa tiyta hne a vya kaa tiyta a paringpa kha thyi pata cuo'a te ama ca thiyna ang'a vyi.
Siy pathepa ta a phiephiepa suokha kha tue'a cate, caakhe lie capepa haa khata “Abyipacuota a Pathepa,” ta pata caa na khe aa.
Capa ca pawde a hmieluo kuo khata a dungpa palaa camaapa ta na biepuo aa.

Capa ca Aaron puo lie khata aw'a te, Israel ming ta ama pipa a pathepa a hlu kawlieta suena a awpa kha ama ta a phya aa. Iema ta Abyipahmiephaa ama hmungna riypata capa ca Aaron puo lie kha a aw pari aa.
Buohryi rawpatlung cikarypa kha palaa ta ama taapa cawthang phapa ta na tue aa. Cakhutaata palaa phapa ta taapa pawde hne ciphang ta a paa dawpa tesaw kha na tue aa.
Aaron sacapaa zaw kha linghlaa hnyi yi sala puvthe naase yi ta pata buohryi rawpatlung, tesaw hne pawde kha na tuepa'a yi.
Na uvta Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw kha cahaacata caw kha pahryi sa'a yi cate, i tluobyi re kha ama hrie the riypata iema kha sathu pathuv'a yi cate, pipa-ina tue'a yi cate, na pathe sa aa.
Ama sasepa ta ama awpa kha pahlaw riypata cawthang phapa ta ama se taata ama baw te a phapa tawhryi pachangpa kha na tuepa aa.

Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw ca a tawnapa thluodaa chung luo kha ama cakuo tiyta, acuolikie hmang pathepa lie re hrie riypata bienatluophie luo ama vaa ngie tiyta capa ca amaa hryi aa. Caacuolikieca iema hne iema cunglie kha suena a khang'a yi te ama thiy aa. Hingpa hing ama hne ama khutaata a ciypathla tie cuota ama ziy pari riypa ziyphung tana a cuo aa.
Iema ta kama cuota tluobyi re ama hrie thena riypata iema pathe sa riypata na tue riypa re ca hingpa hing tana a cuo.

Cuetungpa a panuta sakha hne syisaa riy a aw lipa tuvtungpa sahning, thiynung phuv lipa viechuo, sathu hne pyapa thiynung phuv lipa chuokaa, sathu thuvpa thiynung phuv lipa viechuo kuopa kha na la aa. Capa viechuo tie ca a pha cepa jungsacuo viedie ta nama tue aa.
Capa ca beke luo pasuo'a cate, beke ta vya phyale'a cate cuetungpa hne tuvtungpa kha na vya cyi aa.
Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw kha a tawnapa thluodaa a ngiena thlake luo kha a vawkhyi'a yi cate tiy ta na pasiy'a yi.

Cakhutaa cata tluobyi cawsie tie kha vya cyi'a cate, Aaron kha buohryi rawpatlung hne tluobyi buohryi pasiypa, tluobyi buohryi, hne cacunghnaabe zaw kha pahryi'a cate cakhutaata pangipa tluobyi buohryi riy ta na sepuo aa.
A luv lie kha pawde papaw'a cate a pawde cunglie ca siy byilakhuv taata kha na be aa.
Tluobyi sathu kha la'a cate, a luv lie kha bya'a cate na pathuv aa.
Cakhutaata a sacapaa zaw kha a vawkhyi'a yi cate buohryi rawpatlung kha na pahryi'a yi.
Tesaw kha pasaw'a yi cate pawde kha na papaw yi. Tluobyi re hrie ca iema re ta cuo'a te ama tue pari riypa ziyphung ta a cuo aa. Nama ta Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw kha na pathe sa aa.
