Cuetungpa kha atawna thluodaa luo na vya chiykhyi aa. Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw ta cuetungpa luv cunglie kha ama kuv khang'a yi te,
cuetungpa ca Abyipahmiekunglie kha na thie aa.
Cuetungpa a thiy chekha kha la'a cate bienatluophie thingpazue tie kha na kuvdaw ta na thuv'a yi. Aa ngaapa a thiy kha bienatluophie a thabaw lie kha na lyi aa.
A chungriy a pahlawpa a thupa bangkhuo, a pathiy a pahlawpa a thu a paata, a bawkaw hne a pahlawpa a thupa tie kha la'a cate, bienatluophie cunglie kha hriykhungrina ta na rue aa.
Cuorasala cuetungpa a saa, a vang hne a i bangkhuo ca arina thluodaa aleluo lie kha myi ta na rue aa. Sue angiethena hriykhungrina tana a cuo.
Cakhutaata tuvtungpa sakha kha la lah Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw ta a luv cunglie kha ama kuv khang'a yi te, na thie aa.
A thiy kha la'a cate bienatluophie a kuo bangkhuo khata na hi aa.
Cakhutaa cata a saa kha a ce'a cate, a chungriy hne a phyi kha pasiy'a cate, a saa hrangpa hne a luv hne khata na chi pakhaw aa.
Bienatluophie lie kha myi ta na rue aa. Capa ca Abyipakha myirue panaana ta abie pata cuo te, Abyipakha rangpa-ue, myirue pata abiena tana a cuo.
A hrangpa tuvtungpa kha la'a cate, a luv cunglie kha Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw ta ama kuv kha khang'a yi te na thie aa.

A thiy chekha kha la'a cate, Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw ama cacuoluo naakue daw lie kha na hnie'a yi. Ama cacuoluo kuvpuv lie hne ama cacuoluo phyipuv lie zaw kha na hnie'a yi. Aa ngaapa a thiy kha bienatluophie akuo bangkhuo khata na hi aa.

Cakhutaa cata bienatluophie cunglie a awpa a thiy chekha kha, hne tluobyi sathu kha la'a cate, Aaron hne a tluobyi cawsie kha cuose, a sacapaa zaw hne ama tluobyi cawsie kha cuose iema hne khata na hi aa. Cakhutaa cata ama hne a tluobyi cawsie zaw ca pathe'a te, cahaacata a saata zaw hne ama tluobyi cawsie zaw kha a pathe aa.

Tuv thupa, a lahmyi lie a thupa, a chungriy a pahlawpa a thupa, a pathiy lie a thupa, a bawkaw suohning hne a pahlawpa a thupa, hne a cacuoluo baw (hingpa tuv hing tluobyi ta a pathesana cuota ama hmuopa tana a cuo) kha na la aa.
Viechuo tluo kha, sathu hneta tuepa viechuo tluo kha, viechuo kuopa phie kha zaw kha Abyipahmiekunglie na pipa thiynung phuv lipa viechuo beke taa khata na la aa.
Capa zaw bangkhuo ca Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw kuv cung luo kha chi'a cate, ama kuv cata Abyipahmiekunglie kha calang'a yi te calangpa panaana kha ama pihluo aa.

Cakhutaata capa bangkhuo ca ama kuv taa khata la'a cate, Abyipahmiekunglie a palung a patluopa rang pa-uepa cuo riypata bienatluophie cunglie kha myi lie rue'a cate myirue panaana na pihluo aa; Abyipakha myi ta abiena tana a cuo.
Aaron pathesana cuota hmuopa tuv a ngaw kha la'a cate, Abyipahmiekunglie kha calangpa panaana pi'a cate, capa ca nama cuvu ta a cuo aa.

Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw a pathesana cuota hmuopa tuvtungpa chungtaata calangpa panaana ta pipa angaw hne tluobyi ta a pathesana cuota ama hmuopa tuv a baw kha la'a cate na pathe sa aa. Capa ca Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw cuvu ta a cuo aa.

Hingpa hing Israel ming ta Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw cuota ama ziy pari riypa ziyphung ta a cuo aa. Hingpa hing Israel ming ta aviesaa panaana hriykhungrina taata ama pi riypata cuo te, Abyipa'a luo ama pipa tana a cuo.
Aaron tluobyi cawsie pathepa tie ca a sacapaa zaw ta aa paziy aa paziy pata cule'a yi te, capa cawsie hne cata sathu pathuv pata pathesana tuepa ama cuo aa.
Ama adaahmang lieta tluobyi a cuopa a sacapaa khata hmang pathepa chunglie rehrie riypata atawna thluodaa chung luo aa ngie tiyta ning sariy chung aa hryi aa.
A pathesana cuota hmuopa tuv kha la'a cate hmang pathepa lie kha tiy ta na pasu aa.
Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw ta atawna thluodaa a ngienapa lie kha tuv saa hne beke chunglie'apa viechuo kha ama ning aa.
Iema a pathesana hne pathesana riypata sue angiethena cuota hmuopa sa kha iema hrahring ta ama ning aa. Capa sa ca a pathepa a cuo nakawta a hrangpa ahungtahmuo ning'a va yi.
A pathesana cuota hmuopa saa, acuolikie viechuo kha mawluo maw te ta aa ngaa biephung kieca a pathepa a cuo nakawta ning li pata myi ta na rue aa.
Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw ca kama bie ica pipa haa hingta na tuepa'a yi; ning sariy chung pathesana na tue aa.

Sue angiethena riypata cuetungpa ta sue pathe sa panaana kha ningting ta na tue aa. Bienatluophie cuo khata sue pathe sa panaana kha tue'a cate, pathe sa riypata sue angiethena naa hie ning kha bienatluophie ca sathu na bya aa.

Bienatluophie cuota ning sariy chung kha sue angiethena hie'a cate, na pathe sa aa. Cahaacata bienatluophie ca a pathe cepa ta cuo'a te, bienatluophie a de khupa tuokhaapa a cuo zaw a pathepa ta aa li aa.
Bienatluophie lie na pihluo riypa ca hing haa hing tana a cuo aa: ningting ta kung kha a tapa tuv sahning na pi pari aa.
Tuv sakha ca maw ta pihluo'a ung cate, a hrangpa tuv sakha ca zuoluo ta nama pihluo aa.

Tuv sakhanapa hne khata jungsacuo viedie ephah che hraa che kha hne olif thu a phapa hin che paliy che kha pyapa kha pihluo pata cuo'a te, dangpa ta panaana cuota mingsuvtiy hin chepaliy chekha zaw kha pihluo pata a cuo aa.
A hrangpa tuv kha sa ta panaana hne dangpa ta panaana hne khata zuoluo ta na pihluo aa. Maw ta namaa biepa haa khata rangpa-ue cuo riypata Abyipakha myi ta pihluona ta namaa bie pata a cuo.

Capa ca chuo kha hnang chuo kha ta nama tue pari riypa myirue panaana ta a cuo aa. Abyipahmiekung, a tawnapa thluodaa a ngienapa lie kha tue pata cuo'a te, capa lie ca niema kha caa taw'a yi angte bie ica chang'a yi.
Capa lie ca Israel ming kha a taw'a yi angte, capa hmang ca i rungnaana ta a pathe sa aa.
Kama ta a tawnapa thluodaa hne bienatluophie kha i pathe sa aa. Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw kha tluobyi cuo riypata i pathe sa'a yi.
Israel ming hrawlie kha aw'a angte, ama Khazing ta i cuo aa.
Cahaacata iema ta kama kha Abyipaama Khazing, iema hrawlie aw riypata Izipt ruo taata iema a vya pyakhyipa i cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi. Kama ca Abyipaiema Khazing tana i cuo.
Rangpa-ue ruena riypa bienatluophie kha akasia thing ta na tue aa.
A syina daw kha, a kuna daw kha ta cuo'a te, atung ahaa aa khing pata a cuo aa. Daw hning a suo'a te, a thingpazue hneta aa pazue diy aa.
A daw, a kuo bangkhuo hne a thingpazue tie kha siy pakhuv'a cate, a tluo kha a chi aa dung pata siy na pakaw aa.
Capa cuo ca ta a tluo raw a kuo vyicuo lieta a tieky kha siy ta tue'a cate, capa lie ca aa puvnapa aluo kha na pahryi aa.
Aluo kha akasia thing ta tue'a cate, siy ta na pakhuv aa.
Capa bienatluophie ca a pahruv pahruvpa biekuona thingkaw pathlie khuopa pangzu hmielie khata chi'a cate, capa lie ca nama kha icaa taw aa.
Aaron ta myi-ing kha a vuo tiyta bienatluophie cunglie kha a maw tating ta rangpa-ue kha a rue aa.
Zuoluo ta myi-ing a vuo tiy zaw ta rangpa-ue kha a rue aa. Capa ca nama chuo chung bangkhuo ta Abyipahmiekunglie tue pari riypa rangpa-ue abiena ta a cuo aa.
A pathe lipa rangpa-ue ta a bie'a va ung ciy. Myirue panaana, sa ta panaana, dangpa ta panaana zaw kha capa cunglie ca tue'a va ung ciy.

Aaron ta sue angiethe hriykhungrina kha thing pazuepa cunglie ca kung kha ta luo kha a tue aa. Nama chuo chung bangkhuo ta capa sue a ngiethe ahiena ca sue pathe sa panaana lie hmuopa sahring thiy khata kung kha luo kha a tue pari aa. Capa ca Abyipacuota a pathe cepa tana a cuo.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo ta:

“Israel ming kha pasuv riypata mingluv na ri tiy yi ta, mingluv ripa ama cuo nakawta ama cunglie puvtlung pasana a tlung li riypata, capa mingluv rina lie ca ama hring athlana muo kha Abyipa'a luo ama pi kaluo aa.
Capa ca mingluv pasuvna lie khungpa bangkhuo ta ama pi hrahring aa. Hmangpathepa lie patangnapa shekel ta shekel khingkhuo (shekel suokha ca gerah suokiy tana a cuo) kha Abyipa'a luo ahlu ama pi aa.
Mingluv pasuvna lie khungpa, kung kiy taata a cung luo bangkhuo ta Abyipakha ahlu ama pi aa.

A hnyirungpa ta a hluv vie pi'a vyi, siypasapa ta a caw vie pi'a vyi, shekel khingkhuo kaluo pi pata a cuo aa. Hingpa ahlu Abyipa'a luo nama vya cyi tiy hingta nama hringna cuota sue a ngiethe ahiena pata a cuo aa.

Capa sue angiethena tuokaa ca Israel ming'a taa khata la'a cate, atawna thluodaa lie hmuo riypata na chi aa. Abyipahmiekunglie Israel ming nama hring a thlana muo cuota nama pipa tana a cuo tapa a thyi pakhaana tana a cuo.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo ta:
“Daa rahung suokha tue la a tieky zaw kha daa ta na tue aa. Capa ca atawna thluodaa hne bienatluophie alalalie kha patu'a cate tiy na pabi aa.
Capa tiy cata Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw ca ama kuv hne ama phyi kha amaa siy aa.
Atawna thluodaa luo amaa ngie tiyta, acuolikie bienatluophie athaa luo rehrie riypata, Abyipa'a luo myirue panaana ama pi tiyta ama thiy li riypata tiy kha ta amaa siy aa.
Ama thiy li riypata ama kuv hne ama phyi kha amaa siy aa. Hingpa hing ama chuo chung bangkhuo iema hne ama ciypathla zaw cuota ama ziy pari riypa ziyphung ta a cuo aa.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo ta:
A pha cepa ziyhmyi kha la lah: mura ziyhmyi a tiy shekel za pangaa, a rang pa-uesapa cinnamon ziyhmyi shekel za hning sawngaa, a rang pa-uesapa pasuv shekel za hning sawngaa,
kassia ziyhmyi shekel za pangaa kha hmangpathepa lie panangnapa shekel khata panang la,
olif chiytiy hin kha hne khata pya la rangpa-ue a tuepa ta a tuepa haa khata a pathepa tluobyi sathu kha tue tie.
Capa ca ta atawna thluodaa hne biekuona thingkaw,
cabya hne a chechiy tingby bangkhuo, myi vuona tung hne a chechiy tingby bangkhuo, rangpa-ue pakhuvnapa bienatluophie,
myirue panaana tuenapa bienatluophie hne a chechiy tingby bangkhuo, rahung hne a patunapa tieky zaw bangkhuo kha na thuv aa.
Capa bangkhuo ca a pathe cepa ama cuo riypata pathe sa'a cate, capa tie a de khupa bangkhuo ca a pathepa ta amaa li aa.
Kama tluobyi re kha ama hrie the riypata Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw kha thuv'a yi cate na pathe sa yi.
Israel ming kyihuo khata, “Hingpa thu hing ca nama chuo chung bangkhuo ta kama cuota a pathepa tluobyi sathu tana a cuo aa.

Hingpa thu hing pangpa lie a thuv cakhaw riypata hmuopa cuo'a vyi. Hingpa thu hneta aa lupa a hrangpa thu zaw tuepa cuo'a vyi. Hingpa hing ca a pathe, hingpa hing ca niema cuota a pathepa tana a cuo aa.
Hingpa haapa thu a tuepa hne cuona a patling lipa cawsaa pakha cunglie hingpa thu a thuvpa ca a mingphang chungtaata thawpa tana a cuo aa,” na ta'a yi, a ta.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo ta: A pa-uesapa ziyhmyi, stakte, onikha, galbanum, hne frankinsens pathepa kha aa khing pata la lah,
rangpa-ue a tuepa ta a tuepa haa khata rangpa-ue kha tue tie. A pathe riypa hne a pathepa a cuo riypata paciy kha thla tie.
Chekha kha a diykariy pata suv la, chekha kha niema icaa tawna riypa yi atawna thluodaa chunglie a awpa biekuona thingkaw hmielie kha na chi aa. Capa ca niema cuota a pathe cepa tana a cuo aa.
Cahaacata pya cate rangpa-ue na tue tiyta, niema pangpa cuota a tue'a vaciy. Abyipacuota a pathepa tana a cuo tapa tana na rue aa.
Ahunghmuo hing haapa rangpa-ue hing ama hmuo riypata a tuepa ca a mingphang chungtaata thawpa a cuo aa.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo ta:
Mang tie, Judah phang Hur sacapaa Uri sacapaa Bezalel kha i tlaw tli.
Ama kha thena, singna, pachangkhuna, hne kuvzung thena phangting kha a hnyi riypata Khazing thlaapa ta pabi tli angte,
hmingsuo puvthesa pata sa thena, siy, ngu hne daa re thena,
alung uo thena, thing ta a zuvta sa thena, hne kuvzung thena phangting zaw kha i pi tli.
Ca hlyitaw taata Dan phang Ahisamak sacapaa Oholiab kha a tlaw tli angte, nama bie ica pipa mekaa kha ama tue the riypata thena phangphang kha i pi tli.
Capa tie ca, atawna thluodaa, biekuona thingkaw, hne a cunglie a awpa a pahruv, thluodaa chechiy tingby bangkhuo,
cabya hne a chechiy tingby bangkhuo, a pathepa myi vuona tung hne a chechiy tingby bangkhuo, rangpa-ue pakhuvnapa bienatluophie,
myirue panaana tuenapa bienatluophie hne a chechiy tingby bangkhuo, hne rahung hne a patunapa tieky,
a linghlaa a awsapa tluobyi cawsie, ama tluobyi rehriena le ama hmuopa tluobyi Aaron a pathepa tluobyi cawsie hne a sacapaa zaw tluobyi cawsie,
tluobyi sathu hne hmang pathepa lie pakhuvpa rangpa-ue zaw ta ama cuo. Nama ica changpa haa khata iema ta ama tue aa.
Abyipata Moses kha:

Nama hrahring ta Israel ming kha chang yi la: “I sabbath ning hing namaa uv aa, tahematapakieca hingpa hing kama hne niema hne nama ciypathla zaw alalalieta Abyipakama hingna caa pathe sa yi ang tapa nama pachangna riypata ica pipa yi aa hnangna tana a cuo.

Niema ta sabbath ca namaa uv aa, tahematapakieca niema cuota a pathepa tana a cuo; sabbath a parapa ahunghmuo thie pata a cuo aa. Hingpa ning lie hing re a hriepa ahunghmuo cawsaa zaw'a taata thaw pata a cuo aa.
Ning caruv chunglie re hrie'a ung cate, cuorasala a ning sariynapa ca a dingna riypa sabbath ning, Abyipacuota a pathepa ning tana a cuo. Sabbath ning ta re a hriepa ahunghmuo thie pata ama cuo aa.
Caacuonakawta Israel ming ta sabbath ning ca chuozaa biekuona cuota ama ciy pathla zaw chuo bangkhuo te ta amaa uv aa.
Hingpa ning hing ca kama hne Israel cawsaa zaw cuota chuozaa aa hnangna tana a cuo. Ning caruv chung Abyipata alyi hne avuo kha sa te, ning sariynapa lie ca a pahy te thaazuo thaa aa la,” na ta'a yi.
Sinai tluo cunglie Khazing ta Moses hne bie a ripa kha a patlung khutaata, biekuona lungphie suohning, Khazing ta a kuvdaw ta a capepa lungphie tie kha a pi.

Cawsaa ta Moses tluocung taata a za cung haasapa kha ama hmung tiyta Aaron kha a vya hmyasue yi te, “A vaw la kiema hmieluo ta a si riypa khazing kha malie tuepa tie; kiema kha Izipt ruo chungtaata malie a vya pyakhyipa Moses cunglieta khaapama a tlung tapa kha pachang vapuv,” ama ta.
Aaron ta, “Nama napuvnung, nama sacapaa hne nama sacanung zaw ama naa lie amaa baapa siy ra-aw kha thluo ung la kama'a luo vya cyi tie ung,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta cawsaa bangkhuo ta ama siy ra-aw kha thluo yi te Aaron'a luo kha ama vya cyi.
Iema'a lieta siy kha la te a tiy ta palang te patle te cuetaata zuv kha a tue. Iema ta, “Vya Israel, hingpa hingna Izipt ruo chungtaata caa vya pyakhyipa yi nama khazing tie ta a cuo yi,” ama ta.
Capa ca Aaron ta a hmung tiyta cuetaata zuv hmiekunglie kha bienatluophie sa te, thuo pathyisana tue te a ripa ca, “Mawluo ca Abyipa'a luo pyi tue ning tana a cuo aa,” a ta.
Mawluo ca mawdiy ta thu yi te, myirue panaana tue yi te, aviesaa panaana riypa kha ama vya cyi. Cawsaa ca ning riypa hne dang riypa khata a tu yi te, thu yi te mang aa ngie lina te ta amaa nuo.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata, “A catli pata cung tie, tahematapakieca Izipt ruo taata na vya pyakhyipa na cawsaa zaw na a tue chiesa yi.

Kama ta bie i pipa yi luopuv kha a catlisa pata a palise yi te, cuetaata zuv kha patle yi te amaa bie. Hriykhungrina tue yi te, “Vya Israel, hingpa hingna Izipt ruo taata caa vya pyakhyipa na khazing tie ta a cuo yi, ama ta,” a ta.
Abyipata Moses kha, “Hingpa cawsaa zaw hing kha tluv tama ama palung a pang tapa kha i pachang.
Kama kha na thlu khah, i pathiy kha myi ie ta ie te i para diy'a yi. Cakhutaata nama kha mingphang lepa ta ica tue aa,” a ta.

Cuorasala Moses ta Abyipaa Khazing kha khuosa ta paakie te, “Vya Abyipa, khaapanakawma a lepa na cahrana hne a thaaruvpa na kuv ta Izipt ruo taata na vya pyakhyipa na cawsaa zaw cunglie ca na hi a haa?

Khaapanakawma Izipt ming ta, “Iema kha tluocung lie thie riypata hne alyi taa hingta para diy riypa atingna pha lipa hne tana a pyakhyi yi,” aca ta'a yi? Na hihaana kha pachung la na palung kha pathla tie. Na cawsaa zaw cunglieta rana patlung sa thi khah.

Na changtaapa Abraham, Isak hne Israel kha a thyi pakhaa thi tie yi. “Nama ciypathla zaw ca avuo lie aasiy zaa khiy ta i papungpazaa sa'a yi. Bie icaa kuopa yi hingpa ruo bangkhuo hing na ciypathla zaw kha pi'a yi angte, iema ta chuozaa ta ama cu aa, ta pata nama pangpa ta bie naa kuopa yi kha maw thi khah,” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata Abyipaca a palung a thle te a cawsaa zaw cunglie i patlung sa aa a tapa rana kha patlung sa li pata a aw.
Cakhutaata Moses ca a pali te tluo cung taa cata a za cung, a kuv ta biekuona lungphie suohning, a kuo vyicuo ta ama capepa, a hnangluo hne a hmieluo hneta ama capepa kha a za cyile.
Lungphie ca Khazing ta a tuepa, a caa zaw Khazing ta alung kha khe te a capepa ta a cuo.
Joshua ta cawsaa tie ama khi ama unapa kha a thyi tiyta, Moses kyihuo khata, “Arina hmang lie rie a dunapa ueryi tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cuorasala Moses ta, Capa ca rie a tepa tie ueryi ta cuo li pata, rie a sungpa tie ueryi zaw ta cuo vyi; i thyipa ca hlaasana ueryi tana a cuo,” a ta
Arina hmang athaa luo kha za pha te cuetaata hne ama luopa kha a hmung pahne ta Moses ca a hi haa suesaa te a kuv lieta lungphie kha thaw te tluo thabaw lie kha a dechi.
Ama tuepa cuetaata ca la te myi lie rue te a diykariy pata a rie khutaata tiy lie kha phuv te Israel ming kha a padang sa yi.
Moses ta Aaron kha, “Hingpa cawsaa zaw hingta na cunglie khaapa ama tue nakawta ma hing tluv ta a lepa suena hing ama cunglie na patlung sa?” a ta.
Aaron ta, “I byipaapa, na hi haa thi khah se; hingpa cawsaa tie hingta hmang pha lipa ama tue khingsapa kha na pachang.
Iema ta, “'Ma hmieluo ta a si riypa khazing kha malie tuepa tie, kiema kha Izipt ruo taata malie a vya pyakhyipa Moses cunglieta khaapama a tlung tapa kha pachang vapuv,’ ina ta yi.
Caacuonakawta kama ta, ‘Siy a hnyipa ta thluo se,’ ta angte, ama siy kha na pi yi te myi chung luo thaw angte cuetaata hing a kya pya,” a ta.
Cawsaa zaw duvkhing ta ama awpa kha Moses ta a hmung tiyta (tahematapakieca Aaron ta ama carie tie pahnyisue hyalya riypata duvkhing ta aw riypata a pathlie thluo yi),
arina hmang thlake lie kha a tu te, “Ahungma Abyipakuo luo ta a aw aa? Kama'a luo a vaw tie ung,” a ta yi. Levi sacapaa bangkhuo ta ama'a luo kha amaa vya hmya.

Ama ta, “AbyipaIsrael Khazing na a ta, ‘Nama zueziy kha a ya kaluo ung. Arina hmang thlake suokha taata suokha te khata cakuo ung la, pakha cyicuo khata nama uvnu, nama viesaa hne nama ingpaa zaw kha thie tie ung,’” a ta yi.
Levi sacapaa zaw ca ta Moses ta bie a pipa haa yi cata tue yi te capa ning lie ca cawsaa thawthung ama thiy.

Moses ta, “Ataning hing Abyipare hrie riypata niema'a na niema kha nama saata acuolikie nama uvnu tie thie pata namaa pacusa kaluo tli, capa ca ta ataning hing nama cunglie thluechiy aca vya phya tli yi,” a ta.
A mawluopa ta Moses ta cawsaa zaw kha, “Suena le suesaapa na nama tue tli. Cuorasala ata hingta Abyipa'a luo kie'a angte, nama cuota sue angiethena kha a hmung zaw te ma i hmung,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta Moses ca Abyi'a'a luo kha kaa te, “Vya Abyipa, hingpa cawsaa zaw hing suena le suesaapa na ama tue tli. Iema'a na iema tana ama cuota siy khazing amaa tue.
Cuorasala nama ta ama suena kha a ngiethe thi tie yi. Cuorasala naa ngiethe khu li kie yi ca nama na cape ciepa caa-uv taa khata i ming kha hruv tie,” a ta.
Cuorasala Abyipata Moses kha, “I cunglie a suepa khana i caa-uv taata a ming para pata a cuo aa.

Cuorasala ata hingta cakuo la cawsaa zaw kha kama ta ica changpa hmang luo kha sikhyi tie yi. Kama avuoming na nama hmieluo ta caa sikhyile'a yi. Cuorasala duotenapa ning a vya tlung tiyta iema kha ama suena cuota duo i te'a yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipata cawsaa zaw cunglie kha puvtlung pasana a patlung sa. Tahematapakieca Aaron ama patue sapa cuetaata kha ama tue nakawta a cuo.

Abyipata Moses kha, “Izipt ruo taata na vya pyakhyipa cawsaa zaw hne khata hingpa hmang hing pyase ung la, Abraham, Isak, hne Jakob, kyihuo ta “Nama ciypathla tie khana i pi'a yi,” ta pata bie i kuopa yi ruo luo kha si tie ung.
Kama ta nama hmieluo khata avuoming pathlie'a yi angte, Kanaan ming, Amor ming, Hit ming, Periz ming, Hiv ming hne Jebus ming zaw kha i cade diy'a yi.
Cuehnung hne khyitiy a langnapa ruo luo kha sithaw tie ung. Cuorasala kama ca niema hrawlie kha si ra'a va ang. Nama palung le tuv te luopuv liena ica pahlipadie diy pathlyi'a yi,” a ta.
Capa thuohlaa pha lipa ca ama thyi tiyta, a ngiy a phie yi te ama caa, ahunghmuo siy zaw ngu zaw a tue va yi.

Tahematapakieca Abyipata Moses kyihuo ta, “Israel ming kha chang yi la, ‘Niema ca a palung lesapa cawsaa tana nama cuo; niema'a lie hing cuo pachang ta i si ra kieca ica naw diy pathlyi'a yi,” a ta nakawta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Israel ming ca Horeb tluo taata hmieluo bangkhuo khata ca ama siy ama ngu bangkhuo kha ama thluo diy.

Moses ta thluodaa kha la te arina hmang ale luo, aa hlapuona luo khata a sa taw. Capa ca atawna thluodaa ta pata ming a sa. Abyipaa huvpa bangkhuo ca arina hmang le luo ta a awpa atawna thluodaa luo ca ama vaa taw.
Moses kha thluodaa luo a vaa kyry ta cawsaa bangkhuo ca ama thluodaa luo a ngienapa cyicuo taa khata a daa yi te, Moses thluodaa chung luo aa ngiena te khata ama mang taw.
Moses thluodaa luo aa ngie khutaata amyi taw kha za cung te, thluodaa luo a ngienapa lie kha a daa te, cakhutaa cata Abyipaca Moses hne khata bie a ri taw.
Thluodaa angienapa lie amyi taw aa daapa kha cawsaa bangkhuo ta ama hmung tiyta, ama thluodaa angienapa taa khata a daa yi te amaa bung kaluo taw.

Cahaacata Abyipata Moses kha a hmiepachaw pata viesaa'a lie bie ri haa khata a rihne taw. Cakhutaata ama ca arina hmang luo kha kaa te, cuorasala ama a byatuv satlie, Nun sacapaa Joshua ca thluodaa kha thuse taw vyi.

Moses ta Abyipakha, “'Hingpa cawsaa tie hing sikhyi tie yi,’ ina ta ciy, cuorasala kama hneta ahungma na pathlie aa tapa kha na pachang sa vaciy. Nama ta, ‘A phata tah ca pachang angte, kama hmiephaa a hmungpa tana na cuo,’ ina ta ciy.

Na hmiephaa a hmungpa ta i cuo kieca nama kha ica pachang riypa hne na hmiephaa i hmung pazue riypata na luopuv kha na chang tie. Hingpa mingphang hing na cawsaa ta ama cuopa zaw kha ruepuo tie,” a ta.
Ama ta, “Kama kha nama'a lie si'a angte hnaanguona ica pi aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Moses ta, “Nama na kiema'a lie a si vaciy tapa kieca hingpa hmang taa hingta malie pasi sa khah.

Kiema'a lie na si li kieca kama hne na cawsaa zaw ta nama hmiephaa ma hmungpa kha tuokhaatama pachang pata a cuo aa? Cahaacata a cuo kie dyi muo kama hne na cawsaa zaw ca hing alyi lie a awpa cawsaa zaw laa hingta due pa-ipa ma cuo'a ta,” a ta.
Abyipata Moses kha, “I hmiephaa hmung cate a phasa pata ica pachang nakawta, kama'a lie na hiepa hmang hing ica tuepa aa,” a ta.
Moses ta, “Na rungnaana kha na pahmung sa tie, icaa hie,” a ta.
Ama ta, “I phana bangkhuo hing na hmiekunglie pasi sa'a angte, Abyipatapa ming kha na hmiekunglie i pathyi sa aa. Vi i hnyi khingpa kha vi hnyi'a angte, i nangdue khingpa kha i nangdue'a yi,” a ta.
Cuorasala, ama ta, “Nama ca i hmie kha na hmung khu'a vaciy, tahematapakieca kama naa hmungpa ca ahunghmuo hring'a va yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipata pazue te, “Mang tie, alung cunglie naa daana riypa hmang i thaalie a aw hing.
I rungnaana a vya sile ning kha alung karaw lie hing ca chi'a angte, ica lawpakhungna te i kuv ica pakhuo aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata i kuv kha la'a angte, nama ca i ke kha na hmung aa; cuorasala i hmie ca hmung'a vaciy,” a ta.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata, “Lungphie taapa haa khata lungphie phie hning tue tie. Na dechipa lungphie taapa lie aa capepa haa khata lungphie lie ca kama ta i cape aa.
Mawruo khata a ting pacie pata aw la Sinai tluo luo kha kya kie la tluodaw lieta kama kha naa kya taw tie.
Ahunghmuo nama hne kya kie ra khah yi se, tluo cung bangkhuo lie kha ahunghmuo aw khah yi se, tluo hmielie kha tuv, mie, hne khaapa sahring hmuo tle khah se.
Caacuonakawta Abyipata bie a pipa haa khata, Moses ta lungphie taapa haa khata lungphie suohning a tue; mawdiy ta thu te, lungphie suohning kha a kuv lie cyile te Sinai tluo cung luo kha a kie.
Abyipaca amyi chung taa khata za cung te capa lie ca ama hne cata a daa te, a ming ca Abyipata te a pathyi sa.
Abyipaca a hmiekunglie kha vya si te, Abyipa, Abyipa, vihnyituv hne nangduetuv Khazing, a nangtlawpa, aa hmangpa duena hne zang tluo atlana hne a bi paripa,

chuo thawkha te ta aa hmangpa duena a pacu sa paripa, pha lina hne tuesuena hne suena zaw a ngiethe te, cadyiseca pha lina kha a luopuv li pata a pathe sa lipa, cuorasala paa zaw pha lina kha saata zaw cunglie, saata tie saata zaw cunglie, chuo thung hne chuo paliy te ta duote a patlyi lipa,” ta pata a pathyi sa.
Moses ca a catli pata alyi luo kha a bu te aa bie.

Ama ta, “Vya Abyipa, na hmiekunglie hmiephaa i hmung pata a cuo kieca, nama ca kiema'a lie hing si thi tie, tapa tana paa ica kie. Hingpa cawsaa zaw hing a palung lepa cawsaa ma cuo raalaa pata, ma pha lina hne ma suena kha malie a ngiethe la, kiema kha na ru ta malie a la tie,” a ta.

Ama ta: Biekuona i tue. Na cawsaa zaw bangkhuo hmielie kha alyi cung bangkhuo lie hne khaapa mingphang cunglie hmuo tue buo lipa kharuehaa hmang kha i tue aa. Capa hmang ca niema'a lie i tue riypa nang-uo aa chiypa hmang ta cuo te, niema hrawlie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo ta Abyipatuepa hmang a cuopa kha ama hmung aa.
Ataning kama ta bie ica pipa hing ziy tie. Mang tie, kama ta Amor ming, Kanaan ming, Hit ming, Periz ming, Hiv ming hne Jebus ming kha na hmiekung taata i cade diy'a yi.
Na silenapa ruo lie khy a sapa tie hneta biekuona na tue li riypata a cadang tie, caacuolikieca na cuo tana cyihyi haata a cuo aa.
Ama bienatluophie kha nama para aa, ama lungbang kha nama de pachung aa, ama Asherah tung zaw kha nama hu pachung diy aa
(khazing hrangpa kha abie'a vaciy, tahematapakieca Abyipa, a ming Hietlie a cuopa ca hie a tliepa Khazing tana a cuo).

Nama ca nama silenapa ruo ming hne khata biekuona tue'a vaciy, tahematapakieca siyhrawnung haata ama khazing kha abie yi te ama hriykhung amaa rina lie kha, iema hraw taata pakhakha ta ca hry'a yi te, hriykhung a rinapa sa kha na ning ra pathlyi aa.

Ama sacanung zaw hraw taa khata na sacapaa zaw cuota napuv chiy pathlyi'a cate, siyhrawnung haata ama khazing abiepa ama sacanung zaw khata na sacapaa zaw kha siyhrawpaa haata iema khazing kha ama pabie sa ra pathlyi aa.
Patlepa khazing kha tue'a vaciy.

Thiynung phuv lipa viechuo pyi kha na tue pari aa. Kama ta bie ica pipa haata Abib thlaa chunglie kha tue'a cate, ning sariy chung thiynung phuv lipa viechuo kha na ning aa. Tahematapakieca Abib thlaa liena Izipt ruo taa khata na vya pya.
Nu-ing a pahaw taapa sacapaa bangkhuo ca kama huopa tana a cuo. Nama sahring ta a pachuo taapa a capaa bangkhuo, cue a cuo zaw tuv a cuo zaw kama huopa tana a cuo.

Laa ta a pachuo taapa bangkhuo ca tuvtaata tah naa thla aa. Naa thla li kieca a rue kha na camaa pachung aa. Sacapaa uvthyi bangkhuo kha naa thla aa. Ahunghmuo a kuv cahripa ta kama'a luo a vaw'a vyi.
Ning caruv chung re hrie'a cate, ning sariynapa lie kha naa pahy aa. Le thaw cuo hne sa hrie cuo lie hmuo cuo sala naa pahy aa.
Jungsacuo na la taa ning kha sathaapa pyi tue'a cate, kung chuona lie kha sala pyi na tue aa.
Capaa bangkhuo ta kung kha ta yi thung AbyipaKhazing, Israel Khazing hmiekung luo namaa luo aa.

Tahematapakieca mingphang zaw kha na hmiekung taata a cade diy'a yi angte, na ruo kha ica paku pa aa. Abyipana Khazing hmiekung luo kha kung kha ta yi thung na vaa luo tiyta na ruo kha ahungtahmuo hie ca tlie'a va yi.
Kama'a luo hriykhung naa rinapa thiy kha thiynung hneta na pihluo'a vaciy. Lawsena pyi lie hriykhung a rinapa saa kha mawluo maw te ta pangaa'a vaciy.
Na lu taata na la taapa a pha cepa sathaapa kha Abyipana Khazing ing luo na chiykhyi aa. Mietaata kha a puvnung ahnungtiy ta pasu'a vaciy.
Abyipata Moses kha, “Hingpa bie hing cape tie; hingpa bie hne hingta aa ziy pata na nama'a na Israel ming hneta biekuona kha i tue.
Moses ca capa hmang lie ca sa ning li tiy dang li pata ning sawliy chung Abyipahneta a aw. Biekuona bie, nawbie suohraa kha lungphie cunglie ca a cape.
Moses ca Sinai Tluo taata a za cung. A kuv lieta biekuona lungphie kha za cyile te tluo cung taata a za cung ning kha Khazing hne bie ama ri nakawta a hmie vang a khepa kha a pachang vyi.
Aaron hne Israel ming bangkhuo ta ama hmung tiyta, a hmie vang kha a khe nakawta ama kha a ngie nguo va yi.
Cuorasala Moses ta iema kha u yi te, cakhutaa cata Aaron hne cawsaazaapuv luochiytuv tie ca ama'a luo kha a vaw yi te Moses ta bie aa rue yi.
Cakhutaa kyalya cata Israel ming bangkhuo ta aa thaa luo kha a vaw yi te Sinai Tluo lie Abyipata a changpa nawbie kha a pi yi.
Moses ca iema hne bie a ri khutaa khata a hmie kha pangluv aa khuv.
Cuorasala Moses ca Abyipahmiekung luo kha ama hne bie ri riypata a cakuo kyry ta a kya pya pakhaana te kha a hmiepakhuv kha a hle taw. A kya pya tiyta bie a pipa kha Israel ming ca a chang yi.
Israel ming ta Moses a hmie vang a khepa kha ama hmung. Caacuonakawta ama hne bie ri riypata aa ngie pakhaa hluo li ta a hmiepakhuv kha aa khuv pakhaa taw.
Moses ta Israel ming bangkhuo kha pahmya yi te, Abyipata tue riypata bie aca pipa yi ca hingpa hing tana a cuo:
Ning caruv chung re nama hrie aa, cuorasala a ning sariynapa ca Abyipacuota a dingna ning, Sabbath ning tana a cuo aa. Hingpa ning lieta re a hriepa ca thie pata a cuo aa.
Sabbath ning ca nama awnapa bangkhuo lie kha myi hmuo patiy'a va ung ciy.
Moses ta Israel ming bangkhuo kha, Abyipata bie aca pipa yi ca hingpa hing tana a cuo:
Nama hnyipa chungtaata Abyipakha ahlu pi tie ung. Pahyana pathiypalung a hnyipa ta Abyipa'a luo kha ahlu vya cyi tie ung. Siy, ngu, daa;
a dungpa, a ciycaapa, hne a sedungpa palaa, cawthang a phapa, mie hming,
siyy sepa thuv ciepa tuvtungpa vang, savang phapa, akasia thing,
myi-ing cuota sathu, tluobyi sathu rangpa-ue, rangpa-ue pakhuv riypa ziyhmyi,
hne tluobyi buohryi hne cacunghnaabe lie pathlie riypa oniks alung hne lungvaa zaw kha vya cyi tie ung, a ta.
Niema hrawlie a kuvzung a thepa bangkhuo a vaw'a ung cate Abyipata bie aca pipa yi kha nama tue aa: bienathluodaa,
a thluodaa hne a thlungkhuv, a liy hne a tlepie, a tluo, a tung, hne a liypatu,
thingkaw hne aa puvnapa a tluo, a pahruv, hne zukhuopa pangzu,
cabya hne aa puvnapa a tluo, hne a chechiy tingby bangkhuo, Phuovaa viechuo,
myivuonapa tung, a chechiy tingby hne a myi-ing zaw, myi vuo riypa myitiy,
bienatluophie rangpa-ue, hne aa puvnapa tluo, tluobyi sathu hne pakhuv riypa rangpa-ue, bienathluodaa luo a ngienapa lie pangzu, bienathluodaa luo a ngienapa;
myirue panaana cuota bienatluophie hne daa syry, aa puvnapa tluo tie, a chechiy tingby bangkhuo, rahung hne a patunapa,
a dungkhuo lie pathlie riypa cawthang, a tung hne a liypatu, a dungkhuo thlake lie pangzu,
bienatluophie lie chechiy buonapa bangkhuo, a dungkhuo lie chechiy buonapa bangkhuo, hne a khuhriycamaa,
hmang pathepa lie re hriena riypata a phasa pata ama taapa tluobyi cawsie, Aaron tluobyi cawsie pathepa, tluobyi re hriena riypata a sacapaa tie tluobyi cawsie zaw ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata Israel ming bangkhuo ca Moses kha thuse yi te ama cakuo.
A palung a thupa hne a pi khingpa bangkhuo ta atawna thluodaa hne a sana lie hmuo riypa, hne tluobyi caw pathepa cuo khata ahlu ca Abyipa'a luo kha ama vya cyi.

Caacuonakawta capaa hne canung hne, pi khing na pathiypalung a hnyipa bangkhuo ta cacunghnaa lie bepa, ra-aw, kuvpahryi, hnacabuv ra-aw, siy ta tuepa chechiy phangting, tapa tie kha Abyipa'a luo ca ama vya cyi.
A dungpa, a ciycaapa, a sedungpa palaa, cawthang phapa, mie hming, siyy sepa thuv ciepa tuvtungpa vang, savang phapa, tapa tie kha a hnyipa tie ta ama vya cyi.
A hlu khupa tie ta ngu hne daa zaw kha Abyipa'a luo vya hlu yi te, akasia thing a hnyipa tie zaw khata aa huna lie hmuo riypata ama vya hlu ra.
Kuvzung a thepa canung tie ta ama pahie ciepa, a dungpa, a ciycaapa hne a sedungpa palaa hne cawthang phapa zaw kha ama vya cyi.
Ama zungthenapa hmuo khingna pathiypalung a hnyipa canung bangkhuo ta mie hming zaw kha ama pahie.
Uvthyi tie ta oniks alung hne lungvaa hrangpa zaw kha tluobyi buohryi hne cacunghnaabe lie be riypata cuose,
myi vuo riypata rangpa-ue hne myitiy, tluobyi sathu, hne a khuv ta pakhuv riypa rangpa-ue zaw kha ama vya cyi.
Pi khingna pathiypalung a hnyipa Israel ming canung hne capaa bangkhuo ta Abyipata Moses'a lie hrie riypata a changpa re lie hmuo riypa chechiy kha palung thusa pata Abyipa'a luo ama vya hlu kaluo.
Cakhutaata Moses ta Israel ming kha: Mang tie ung, Abyipana Judah phang a cuopa Hur sacapaa Uri a sacapaa Bezalel kha a ming ri te a u.
Ama ta Khazing thlaapa ta pabi te, kuvzung thena, pachangkhuna hne, kuvzung thena ta tue khu riypa phangting thesingna kha a pi.
Hmingsuo puvthesa pata sa thena, siy, ngu, hne daa re thena,
alung uo thena, thing ta a zuvta sa thena, hne kuvzung thena phangting zaw kha a pi.
Ama hne Dan phang ta a cuopa Ahisamak sacapaa Oholiab ca Abyipata malie pacuv pachaa thenapa kha a pi yi.

Ama ta iema ca kuvzung a thepa tie ta ama tue thepa re phangting thena, hmingsuo a sa thepa tie thepa thena phangting, a dungpa, a ciycaapa, hne a sedungpa palaa ta paapaapa daw thenapa thena, cawthang phapa taa thenapa thena hne kuvzung thena hne hmingsuo sa thenapa thena a phangting kha a pi yi.
Bezalel hne Oholiab hne hmangpathepa sanapa re kha tuokhaatama ma hrie aa tapa a pachangpa, Abyipata zung thenapa hne pachangnapa a pipa tie ta Abyipata bie a pina haa yi khata ama hrie aa.
Cakhutaata Moses ta Bezalel hne Oholiab hne Abyipata thena a pipa zung a thepa tie, re hrie riypata a palung a thupa tie kha ku yi te,

iema ca ta hmangpathepa sana riypata Israel ming ta palung thusa pata ama vya cyipa ahlu kha Moses'a taata ama cuhluo. Israel ming ta palung thusa pata ama pipa ahlu ca a maw tating ta ama vya cyi pari.
Caacuonakawta hmangpathepa lie re phangting a hriepa kuv zung a thepa tie ta ama re hriena cyicuo taa khata
Moses'a luo kha a vaw yi te, “Abyipata tue riypata bie ma lie a pipa re hriena riypata cawsaa ta ama vya pipa ca aa huna laa tana a hluv vie karaa tli,” ama ta.

Caacuonakawta Moses ta bie pi yi te arina hmang bangkhuo khata, “Canung cuose, capaa cuose hmangpathepa sana riypata ahungtahmuo ahlu pi'a va tli ung ciy,” ta pata ama pathyi. Caacuonakawta cawsaa ta khaapahmuo vya cyi va tli yi.
Tahematapakieca ama vya cyi ciepa ca re bangkhuo hriena riypata aa hupa laata a hluv vie tli.

Re a hriepa tie hrawtaata a kuvzung a thepa tie ta bienathluodaa ca a dungpa, a ciycaapa, hne a sedungpa palaa pahiepa ta taa yi te a cunglie cherubim zuv ama dawpa cawthang phapa zung hraa ta ama sa.
Capa pangzu cyicuo ca a syina luo daw kiy daw cari, a kuna luo daw paliy ta cuo te a le a caw amaa khing diy.
Zung pangaa tie kha patue yi te ama bie, a hrangpa zung pangaa zaw kha patue yi te ama bie.
Ruobuoluo ce ta a awpa pangzu pangtluo lie kha cawthang a dungpa ta tuepa a naabale ama thla, a suohningnapa pangzu lie zaw kha cahaacata ama thla ra.
Pangzu zung khapa lie kha a naabale sawngaa, pangzu zung hningnapa a tluo lie kha a naabale sawngaa ta thla yi te a naabale tie ca kuo vyicuo ta ama aw.
Siy ta a hyiluo sawngaa tue yi te pangzu suokha hne suokha kha ama cakhiy ca bienathluodaa ca suokha ta a cuo.
Bienathluodaa a cungkhuv riypata mie hming ta taapa pangzu suohraa hlyikha zaw kha ama tue.
Capa pangzu zung kha ca a tung daw sawthung, a haa daw paliy cuo te zung hraa hlyikha yalya cata a le a caw amaa khing diy.
Pangzu zung pangaa kha patue yi te, zung caruv kha a hrang ta ama patue.
Tue kha ta ama patuepa pangzu a buobuoluo ce ta a awpa pangtluo lie kha a naabale sawngaa thla yi te, a hrangpa tue khapa tluo lie zaw kha a naabale sawngaa ama thla.
Thluodaa kha a patue te suokha ta a cuo riypata daa hyiluo sawngaa a ma tue.
Thluodaa a cungkhuv riypa kha siyy sepa ama thuvpa tuvtungpa vang ta tue yi te, a cungkhuv a pakhuv pachaapa ca savang phapa ta ama tue.
Bienathluodaa ca akasia thing hmuo yi te a tung luo ta tlepie ama chung.
Tlepie suokha ca daw hraa syi te daw kha a che a ku.
Tlepie suokha hne suokha patuena riypata tlepie suokha ta a liy suohning kaluo ama tue, tlepie bangkhuo kha cahaacata ama tue.
Bienatluophie cuota tlepie ca cahaacata tue yi te, sungluo kuo ta tlepie suokiy ta a cuo.

Tlepie suokiy cuo ca ta ngu ta tuepa a liypatu sawliy ama tue, tlepie suokha lie a awpa a liy suohning cuota a liypatu suohning, a vya paziypa tlepie suokha a liy suohning cuota a liypatu suohning ta pata ama tue.
Bienathluodaa a kuo hningnapa luo, chaluo kuo ta tlepie suokiy hne
ngu ta tuepa a liypatu sawliy, tlepie suokhanapa rawlieta ca liypatu suohning, a vya paziypa suokha cuota a liypatu suohning ta ama tue.
Bienathluodaa ningtlaluo kuo ta tlepie suocaruv ama chung.
Bienathluodaa a hnangluo kuo ing kiy vyicuo lie kha tlepie suohning ama chung.
A thabaw lie ca a che te, cuorasala a daw luo ca a tieky suokhanapa lie kha amaa kya pazue. A kiy kiy hning lie tlepie suohning ca cahaacata ama tue.
Ngu ta tuepa a liypatu kaluo hne tlepie suocari cuo ta a liypatu suohraa hlyicaruv ta a cuo, tlepie suokha lie a liypatu suohning ta a cuo.
Bienathluodaa kuokhaluo kuo tlepie suopangaa cuota a tluo suopangaa kha akasia thing ta ama tue.
A hrangpa kuokhaluo kuo tlepie cuota tluo pangaa ama tue. Bienathluodaa ningtlaluo kuo tlepie cuo zaw kha tluo pangaa ama tue.
Tlepie a khingkhuo lieta a sipa a tluo ca kuo kha taata kuo kha luo a chuona te a syi tlungluopa ta ama pasi.
Tlepie ca siy pakhuv yi te, a tluo pahryina riypa a tieky kha siy ta ama tue. A tluo kha siy ama pakhuv.
A pangzu kha a dungpa, a ciycaapa hne a sedungpa palaa pahiepa ta ama taapa, zung phasa pata cherubim zuv ama dawpa cawthang phapa ta ama tue.
Capa cuo ca ta akasia thing a tung tung paliy tue yi te siy ta ama pakhuv. Siy ta tuepa a kyipa kha ama bang. A liypatu suopaliy kha ngu ta patle yi te ama tue.
Thluodaa luo a ngiena riypa a thlake pangzu ca a dungpa, a ciycaapa, hne a sedungpa palaa, a bya ta pahiepa palaa ta taapa, ciphang ta paapaapa daw yi te ama pangipa cawthang phapa hne
a kyipa bang ciepa a tung tung pangaa ta ama tue. A tung a dawluo hne a thabawluo kha siy pakhuv yi te, a liypatu suopangaa ca daa ta ama tue.
Bezalel ta biekuona thingkaw kha akasia thing ta a tue. A syina daw hning a che, a kuna daw kha a che, aa suona daw kha a che ta a cuo.
Thingkaw achungluo hne aleluo kha siy pathepa ta pakhuv te, thingkaw a tluo aa dung diy pata siy a pakaw.
A phyi suopaliy cuota a tieky suopaliy kha siy ta patle te, a tieky suohning kha kuokhaluo cuota cuo te suohning kha a hrangpa kuokhaluo cuota a cuo.
Akasia thing ta aluo suohning tue te siy a pakhuv.
Aluo ca kuo vyicuo lie, siy tieky tie lie kha pahryi te a puvna riypata a tue.
A pahruv kha siy pathe pata a tue; a syina daw hning a che, a kuna daw kha a che ta a cuo.
A pahruv a dawluo kuo hning lie kha a de ta depa siy ta cherubim suohning a tue.
Cherubim suokha kha a daw suokhaluo, cherubim suokha kha a hrangpa a daw suokhaluo ta pata a pahruv hneta aa pazue pata a dawluo kuo hning lie khata a tue.
Cherubim ca ama mathlaa kha a cung luo ta pazu yi te thingkaw pahruv kha ningdiy ama padiy. Cherubim tie ca a hmiepachaw yi te thingkaw pahruv luo kha amaa hyi kaluo.
Ama ca ta cabya zaw kha akasia thing ta tue te, a syina daw hning, a kuna daw kha, hne aa suona daw kha a che ta a cuo.
Siy pathepa ta pakhuv diy te a kie aa dung pata siy a pakaw.
A kie ca a chi aa dung diy pata pazaa phie ta tue te siy ta a pakaw diy.
A tieky suopaliy kha siy ta patle te, a kiy kiy paliy lie a awpa a phyi suo paliy lie kha a bang.
Cabya a puvna riypa a tluo a patuvpa a tieky tie ca a tluo hne khata aa ngie.
Cabya a puvna riypa aluo kha akasia thing ta tue te siy ta a pakhuv.
Cabya lie a aw riypa a chechiy tie, rangpa-ue pakhuvna riypata pakaa hne pakaa aa thuvpa, dangpa ta panaana tuena riypa kuotung hne khazaa-ung zaw kha siy ta ama tue diy.
Myi vuona tung zaw kha siy pathepa ta a tue. A patunapa hne a tung ca a de ta depa siy ta a tue; a papuvthesapa paapaapa, a paa pamangta hne a paa pake zaw kha aa pazue diy pata a tue.
A kuo cyicuo khata a ce ce caruv pya te, ce thung kha myi vuona tung kuokhaluo, ce thung kha a hrangpa kuokhaluo kuo ta a pya.

Ce kha lie kha almond paa haa khata a nge nge thung aw te, a nge cyicuo lie kha a paa pamangta hne a paa paketa hne ama aw. Ce kha luo zaw kha almond paa haa khata a nge nge thung aw'a te, a paa paketa hne a paa pamangta hneta a aw aa. Caacuonakawta myi vuona tung lie ca a ce ce caruv ta a kya pya.
Myi vuona tung taa hrahring khata a papuvthesapa a nge nge paliy pya te, suokha cyicuo khata almond paa haa khata a paa pamangta hne a paa paketa zaw ama hnyi.
A ce ba kha rawlie kha a paa pamangta suokha, a suohningnapa a ce ba kha rawlie kha a paa pamangta suokha, a hnangcaw cepa a ce ba kha rawlie kha a paa pamangta suokha ta pata a aw.
A paa pamangta hne a ce tie ca aa pazue pata aw te, a bangkhuo ca ta a de ta depa siy pathepa ta tuepa a cuo.
A myi-ing suosariy hne a cecakie hne a buvcuo liyna pakaa ca siy pathepa ta a tue.
Myi vuona tung hne a chechiy tingby bangkhuo kha siy pathepa talen suokha chuo pata a tue.
Rangpa-ue ruena riypa bienatluophie kha akasia thing ta a sa. A syina daw kha, a kuna daw kha, atung ahaa aa khing pata, hne aa suona daw hning ta a cuo. A thingpazue tie hneta aa pazue diy.
A daw, a kuo bangkhuo hne a thingpazue tie kha siy pakhuv te a tluo kha a chi aa dung pata siy a pakaw diy.
Siy tieky suohning kha patle te aa puvna riypata a kuo vyicuo a tluo pakaw rawlie kha a bang.
Cakhutaata a puvna riypa aluo kha akasia thing ta tue te siy a pakhuv.
Ama ta a pathepa tluobyi sathu zaw kha tue te, rangpa-ue ta pakhuv riypa ziyhmyi zaw kha rangpa-ue a tue thepa tie ama tuepa haata a tue.
Myirue panaana tuena riypa bienatluophie zaw kha akasia thing ta a tue. A syina daw pangaa, a kuna daw pangaa, atung ahaa aa khing pata, daw thung aa suo pata a sa.
A kiy kiy paliy lie kha a thingpazue tue te, a thingpazue hne a tluophie ca aa pazue diy. A yalya khata daa ta a pakaw.
Bienatluophie a chechiy tingby bangkhuo, bi, kawpia, bikang, khazin, hne buvcuo liyna phie tapa tie kha daa ta a tue.
Daa syry kha tue te bienatluophie a tluo rawlie khata chi te bienatluophie a khingkhuo te a za chiy.
Daa syry a kiy kiy paliy lie kha a tluo pahryina riypa a tieky suopaliy a tue.
A puvna riypa aluo kha akasia thing ta tue te daa a pakaw.
Bienatluophie a kuoluo a tieky lie ca aa puvna riypa aluo kha a pahryi. Bienatluophie ca thingphie ta tue te a chung ca a karaw.
Daa rahung hne a tieky kha a tawnapa thluodaa lie re a hriepa canung tie daa thlaluo khata a tue.
Bienathluodaa dungkhuo kha a tue. Sungluokuo ta a dungkhuo ca palaa pahiepa ta taapa cawthang phapa ta tue te, daw zakha a syi.
A tung tung kiy hne a patuvna suokiy ca daa ta cuo te, cuorasala a kyipa hne a tluo tie ca ngu ta a cuo.
Chaluo kuo dungkhuo ca daw zakha a syi. A tung tung kiy hne a liypatu suokiy ca daa ta cuo te, cuorasala a kyipa hne a tluo ca ngu ta a cuo.
Ningtlaluo kuo ta a dungkhuo ca daw sawngaa a syi. A tung tung hraa hne a liypatu suohraa cuo te, a kyipa hne a tluo ca ngu ta a cuo.
Ningchiyluo kuo, a hmieluo ca daw sawngaa ta a cuo.
Thlake taata kuokhaluo a dungkhuo ca daw hraa hlyipangaa cuo te, a tung tung thung hne a liypatu suothung a cuo.
Cahaacata kuokhaluo kuo zaw a kuo vyicuo ta a awpa a dungkhuona ca daw hraa hlyi pangaa cuo te, a tung tung thung hne a liypatu suothung ta a cuo.
A dungkhuo pangzu ca pahiepa palaa phapa ta ama taapa cawthang phapa ta a cuo.
A liypatu tie ca daa ta cuo te, cuorasala a kyipa hne a tluo tie ca ngu ta a cuo; aa tung daw pakhuv zaw kha ngu ta ama tue. A tung bangkhuo kha ngu ta tuepa a tluo pasi yi te ama patuv sa diy.

A dungkhuo luo a ngiena lie pangzu ca a dungpa, a ciycaapa, hne a sedungpa palaa pahie pata ama taapa, ciphang ta a paa dawpa cawthang phapa ta a cuo. A dungkhuo lie pathliepa tie haa khata a syina daw kiy, aa suona daw pangaa ta a cuo.
A tung tung paliy a cuo. A liypatu suopaliy ca daa ta cuo te, a kyipa tie ca ngu ta a cuo, cakhutaata atung daw pakhuv tie hne a tluo tie ca daa ta a pakaw.
Bienathluodaa lie hne a dungkhuo lie hmuopa siekhe bangkhuo ca daa ta tuepa a cuo.
Moses biepina haata tluobyi Aaron sacapaa Ithamar tluotla khuekhuona ta Levi ming ta ama capepa biekuona thingkaw ama chinapa bienathluodaa kaw ca hing haa hing tana a cuo.
Abyipata Moses a changpa bangkhuo haa khata Judah phang Hur sacapaa Uri sacapaa Bezalel ta a tue.

Ama hne a hrie hnepa ca Dan phang Ahisamak sacapaa Oholiab ta cuo te, alung a khe thepa, hmingsuo a sa thepa, a dungpa, a ciycaapa hne a sedungpa palaa ta cawthang phapa cunglie a paapaapa a daw thepa ta a cuo.
Hmangpathepa sana re bangkhuo lieta ama hmuopa, ama hlupa siy ca hmangpathepa cyi pathlienapa ta ama pathlie tiyta a bangkhuo ta talen suokiy suopangaa hne shekel zasariy sawthung ta a cuo.
Mingluv rina lie ama ripa cawsaazaapuv ta ama pipa ngu ca hmangpathepa cyi pathlienapa ta ama pathlie tiyta talen zakha hne shekel thawkha zasariy sawsariy suopangaa ta a cuo.

Pakha ta beka suokha (hmangpathepa cyi pathlienapa ta ama pathlie tiyta shekel a che) ta a cuo, tahematapakieca kung kiy taata a cung luo mingluv rina lieta ama ripa bangkhuo ca ting zacaruv ting thung zapangaa sawngaa ta ama cuo.
Hmangpathepa a patuna ama patlena lieta ngu talen zakha, pangzu pathlienapa a patuna zakha cuota ngu talen zakha; a patuna suokha cuota talen suokha ta a cuo.
Ngu shekel thawkha zasariy sawsariy suopangaa khata atung lie bangpa kyipa, atung daw pakhuv hne atung patuvsanapa tluo tie kha ama tue.
Daa ama hlupa ca talen suosariy, hne shekel thawhning zapaliy ta a cuo.
Capa ca ta atawna thluodaa a ngiena lie a patuna tie, daa bienatluophie, daa syry hne bienatluophie a chechiy tingby,
a chi aa dung pata a dungkhuo patuna tie, bienathluodaa lie siekhe bangkhuo, hne a dungkhuo lie siekhe bangkhuo kha ama tue.
Hmang pathepa chunglie re hriena riypa hne Aaron cuota tluobyi caw pathepa kha Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haa khata a dungpa, a ciycaapa hne a sedungpa palaa phapa ta ama tue.
Tluobyi buohryi ca siy, a dungpa, a ciycaapa hne a sedungpa palaa pahiepa ta taapa cawthang phapa ta a tue.
Siy phie kha a paata tah de yi te lariy haata a uo khutaata a dungpa, a ciycaapa, hne a sedungpa palaa hne khata a puvthesa pata cawthang phapa lie kha a taapuo.
Tluobyi buohryi ca a letung riy kha tue yi te a daw daw hning lie kha ama patue.

Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haa khata, capa cunglie a awpa a puvthesa pata taapa tesaw ama hmuopa a chechiy hne ama taanazya ca a lu'a te, siy, a dungpa, a ciycaapa, a sedungpa palaa, hne ama pahiepa palaa phapa ta taapa cawthang phapa ta tuepa a cuo aa.
Oniks alung kha cata yi te, Israel sacapaa zaw ming kha aa paziy pata caakhe lie caa ama capepa haa khata cape yi te siy tluopakaw chunglie kha ama khung.
Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haata, Israel sacapaa zaw maw lina ta capa ca tluobyi buohryi riy lie kha ama be.
Cacunghnaabe zaw kha tluobyi buohryi ama tuepa haa khata siy, a dungpa, a ciycaapa, a sedungpa palaa pahiepa ta taapa cawthang phapa khata kuvzung phasa pata ama tue.
Cacunghnaabe ca thang hning ta tuepa cuo te, atung a haa a khing te, ama kadiy tiyta a syina kha kha, a kuna kha kha ta a cuo.
Lungvaa kha tluo paliy ta ama be. Tluo khana lie ca karnelian, khrisolait, hne emerald;
tluo hningna lie ca lungvaa hringpa, safaiar, hne daimon;
a tluo thungna lie ca jasin, agate, hne amethist;
a tluo paliyna lie ca beril, oniks, hne jasper ta ama cuo.

Alung suohraa hlyihning cunglie kha Israel sacapaa zaw ming kha a cyicuo ta cape pata a cuo. Alung suokha lie kha ming suokha ta caakhe lie caa capepa haa khata Israel ming phang hraa hlyihning ming kha cape pata a cuo.
Cacunghnaabe buoliriy kha khuhriy haata aa camaa pata siy pathepa ta ama tue.
Siy tluopakaw suohning hne siy kuvpahryi suohning kha tue yi te, cacunghnaabe a daw suohning lie kha ama be.
Cakhutaata siy buoliriy a daw kha cacunghnaabe a daw lie a awpa siy kuvpahryi suohning lie kha ama cakhiy.
Siy buoliriy a daw suohning kha siy tluopakaw suohning luo kha kya cakhiy yi te, cahaacata tluobyi buohryi letung riy a hmieluo'apa lie kha ama cakhiy chiy.
Cakhutaata siy tieky suohning tue yi te, tluobyi buohryi a kya phapa cacunghnaabe a chungluo a daw suohning lie kha ama bang.
Siy tieky suohning kha tue yi te, tluobyi buohryi a letung riy a rawluo, a hmieluo khata ama bang, a puvthesa pata tuepa a tesaw a cunglie kha a zaa patue.

Cacunghnaabe lie a tieky tie ca tluobyi buohryi a tieky tie hne khata pataw'a cate a dungpa camaapa riy ta na ciy paki aa. A tieky tie kha pangipa tluobyi buohryi tesaw cunglie khata laa'a te, cacunghnaabe ca tluobyi buohryi taa khata a pathluo li pata a aw aa. Cahaacata ama tuepa ca Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haa kha tana a cuo.
Tluobyi buohryi pasiypa bangkhuo ca a dungpa palaa ta a taa.
Buohryi a lie khingkhuo lie pahawpa a khue ca a tlaa li riypata rieka buohryi cungpakaw haa khata ama pahawnapa lie kha rue pakaw pakaw pata a cuo.
Buohryi pasiypa a raw tluo lie kha a dungpa, a ciycaapa, hne a sedungpa palaa pahiepa ta taapa cawthang phapa ta ama tuepa cale thyi tie kha ama tue.
Siy pathepa ta daakingta zaw kha tue yi te, buohryi a raw tluo lie cale thyi suokha hne suokha alalalie kha a chi aa dung pata ama pathlie.
Abyipata Moses bie a pina haa khata tluobyi re hriena riypa buohryi pasiypa a raw tluo lie ca a chi aa dung pata daaking suokha, cale thyi kha ta pata ama pathlie.
Aaron hne a sacapaa tie cuo zaw khata Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haata cawthang phapa ta buohryi rawpatlung zaw kha ama tuepa.
Palaa phapa ta taapa pawde, palaa phapa ta taapa lakhuv, pahiepa palaa ta taapa cawthang phapa ta biepa tawhryi pachangpa,
pahiepa palaa phapa ta ama taapa cawthang phapa, a dungpa, a ciycaapa, hne a sedungpa palaa ta a paa ama dawpa tesaw zaw kha Abyipata Moses bie a pina haa khata ama tuepa.
Siy pathepa ta tuepa siy a phiephiepa ta byilakhuv tue yi te, capa cunglie ca caakhe lie capepa haa khata “Abyipacuota a Pathepa,” ta pata caa ama khe.
Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haa khata, capa ca pawde cunglie kha palaa dungpa ta ama biepuo.
Cahaacata bienatluophie re bangkhuo ca palang pata a cuo. Abyipata Moses'a lie bie a pina haa khata Israel ming ta ama hrie diy.
Cakhutaata bienatluophie ca Moses'a luo kha amaa vawkhyi; thluodaa hne a chechiy tingby bangkhuo, a kyipa, a tlepie, a tluo, a tung, hne a liypatu;
siyy sepa ta buv ciepa tuvtungpa vang hne savang phapa a cungkhuv, pathliepa pangzu,
biekuona thingkaw, hne aa puvnapa aluo, hne a pahruv,
cabya hne a chechiy tingby bangkhuo, Phuovaa viechuo,
a pathepa myi vuona tung hne a myi-ing tie, hne a chechiy tingby bangkhuo, myi vuo riypa myitiy,
siy bienatluophie, tluobyi sathu, hne pakhuv riypa rangpa-ue, thluodaa luo a ngienapa pangzu,
daa bienatluophie, daa syry, aa puvnapa aluo tie, hne a chechiy tingby bangkhuo, a rahung hne a patunapa,
a dungkhuo, a tung, hne a liypatu, a dungkhuo lie a ngienapa pangzu, a riy, a siekhe, bienathluodaa re hriena lie hmuopa a chechiy tingby bangkhuo, atawna thluodaa;
hmang pathepa lie re hriena riypata a phasa pata ama taapa tluobyi cawsie, Aaron tluobyi cawsie pathepa, tluobyi re hriena riypata a sacapaa tie tluobyi cawsie zaw ta ama cuo.
Abyipata Moses'a lie bie a pina haa khata Israel ming ta re bangkhuo ca ama hrie.
Abyipata bie a pina dadang haata re bangkhuo ama hriepa kha hmung te iema kha thluechiy a pi yi.
Abyipata Moses kha:
Thla khanapa ning khanapa lie kha atawna bienathluodaa kha na padaa aa.
A chunglie kha biekuona thingkaw chi'a cate pangzu ta na khaakhuo aa.
Cabya kha a chung luo pangie'a cate a chechiy bangkhuo kha na chi aa. Myi vuona tung kha a chung luo pangie'a cate, a myi-ing kha na bang aa.
Biekuona thingkaw hmielie kha rangpa-ue pakhuvna riypa siy bienatluophie kha chi'a cate, bienathluodaa a ngiena lie kha pangzu na pathlie aa.
Myirue panaana riypa bienatluophie kha atawna thluodaa bienatluophie luo a ngienapa hmiekunglie kha na chi aa.
Cakhutaata rahung kha atawna thluodaa hne bienatluophie alalalie kha chi'a cate tiy na pabi aa.
A dungkhuo kha aa dung pata pathlie diy'a cate, a dungkhuo chungluo a ngienapa thlake lie kha pangzu na pathlie aa.

Cakhutaata tluobyi sathu kha la'a cate, bienathluodaa hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo kha na thuv diy aa. Bienathluodaa hne a chunglie a awpa a chechiy tingby bangkhuo kha a pathepa a cuo riypata na pathe sa aa.
Myirue panaanapa bienatluophie hne a chechiy tingby bangkhuo kha thuv diy'a cate, bienatluophie ca a pathe cepa a cuo riypata na pathe sa aa.
Rahung hne a patunapa zaw kha thuv'a cate na pathe sa aa.
Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw kha atawna bienathluodaa a ngienapa luo kha a vawkhyi'a yi cate, iema kha tiy ta na pasiy'a yi.
Cakhutaata Aaron kha a pathepa a tluobyi caw kha pahryi'a cate, i tluobyi re a hrie thena riypata sathu pathepa kha pathuv'a cate na pathe sa aa.
A sacapaa zaw kha a vawkhyi'a yi cate, buohryi rawpatlung kha na pahryi aa.
I tluobyi re ama hrie the riypata ama paa sathu na pathuvpa haa khata sathu na pathuv'a yi. Iema sathu pathuvnapa ca ta iema kha chuo bangkhuo chuozaa tluobyi a pacuo sa'a yi.
Moses ca hmang bangkhuo kha Abyipata bie a pipa haata a tue diy.
A kung hningnapa thla khana, a ning khanapa lieta bienathluodaa ca a padaa.
Moses ta bienathluodaa kha padaa te, a tlepie kha a chung, a thingtluo kha pahryi te a tung a padaa.
Abyipata Moses'a lie bie a pipa haa khata bienathluodaa cunglie ca thluodaa kha pake te, a cungkhuv kha a pakhuv.
Biekuona thingkaw kha la te bienathluodaa chung luo kha a chi. A tluo kha pahryi te biekuona thingkaw a pahruv kha a pahruv.
Biekuona thingkaw kha bienathluodaa chung luo zaa ngiekhyi te, Abyipata Moses kha bie a pipa haata pangzu a pathla khuo.
Cabya kha atawna thluodaa pangzu ale luo lie kha chi te,
Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haa khata Abyipahmiekunglie kha a pachie.
Myi vuona tung kha atawna thluodaa sungluo kuo, cabya taata kuokhaluo lie khata a chi.
Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haa khata Abyipahmiekunglie ca myi-ing kha a vuo.
Siy bienatluophie kha atawna thluodaa pangzu hmielie khata chi te,
Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haa khata a cunglie ca rangpa-ue kha a rue.
Bienatluophie luo a ngienapa lie zaw kha pangzu a pathlie.
Myirue panaana bienatluophie kha atawna bienathluodaa a ngiena lie kha chi te, Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haa khata capa cunglie ca myirue panaana hne sa ta panaana kha a pihluo.
Atawna thluodaa hne bienatluophie alalalie kha rahung patu te a siyna riypa tiy kha a chi.
Capa tiy cata Moses hne Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw ca ama kuv hne ama phyi kha amaa siy.
Atawna thluodaa luo amaa ngie tiyta hne bienatluophie luo ama vaa ngie tiyta, Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haa khata amaa siy taa taw.
Bienathluodaa hne bienatluophie kha a dungkhuo tue te, a dungkhuo thlake lie kha pangzu a pathlie. Cahaacata Moses ta re kha a palang.
Cakhutaata amyi ta atawna thluodaa kha a pahlawna te ta bienathluodaa ca Abyiparungnaana ta a bi.
Atawna thluodaa kha amyi ta pahlaw te, Abyiparungnaana ta bienathluodaa ca a bi nakawta Moses ca thluodaa chung luo kha a ngie khu vyi.
Bienathluodaa taata amyi calangthawpa a cuo tiyta Israel ming ca ama khytlawna kha amaa thu taw.
Cuorasala amyi kha calangthawpa acuolikie ca, amyi calangthawpa a cuona ning te khata khy tlaw a thu va yi.
Ama khy tlawnapa tlungluo lieta Israel ming hmungna lie kha, ningchung ta bienathluodaa cunglie kha Abyipaamyi aw te, zuo ta amyi chunglie kha myi a aw.
Abyipata Moses kha u te atawna thluodaa taata chaw te hing haa hingta a ri:

Israel ming kha hing haa hingta chang tie yi: Niema chungtaata ahung nama cuo zaw Abyipa'a luo hriykhungrina sahring kha nama pi khing kieca nama sahring zaw chung taa khata cue acuolikie, tuv hne mie kha nama vya cyi aa.
Cue ta myirue panaana pihluo riypa a cuo kieca, a tungpa a dutlapa ta a cuo aa. Abyipata a cuhluo the riypata atawna thluodaa luo a ngienapa luo kha a vya chiykhyi aa.
Myirue panaana sahring a luv cunglie kha nama kuv khang'a ung cate niema sue angiethena riypata niema cuopa ta cuhluopa a cuo aa.
Cue ca Abyipahmiekunglie kha thiepa cuo'a te, Aaron sacapaa tluobyi tie khata a thiy ca pihluo'a yi te atawna thluodaa a ngiena lieta a awpa bienatluophie kha a kuo bangkhuo ta ama hi aa.
Myirue panaanapa saa ca a vang hle'a yi te ama caphi aa.
Tluobyi Aaron sacapaa zaw khata bienatluophie lie myi patiy'a yi te thing ama tiy aa.
Aaron sacapaa tluobyi tie khata ama caphipa saa ca a luv hne a thupa hne khata bienatluophie myi cung luo kha ama khang aa.

Cuorasala a chungriy hne a phyicamaa zaw kha ca tiy ta ama pasiy aa. Cakhutaa cata tluobyi tie ta a bangkhuo ca ta bienatluophie cunglie kha myi ta rue'a yi te, myirue panaana ama pihluo aa. Myirue panaana ca Abyipaa tlechuopa rangpa-ue tana a cuo.
Myirue panaana ta nama pihluopa ca tuv hne mie ta a cuo kieca, a dutlapa a tungpa ta a cuo aa.
Abyipahmiekunglie, bienatluophie chaluo kuo khata nama thie aa. Aaron sacapaa tie, tluobyi tie khata a thiy ca bienatluophie a kuo bangkhuo khata ama hi aa.
Saa ca caphi'a ung cate, a luv hne a thupa hne kha tluobyi tie ta bienatluophie cung myi cunglieta thing cung luo kha ama khang aa.

Cuorasala a chungriy hne a phyicamaa zaw kha ca tiy ta ama pasiy aa. Cakhutaata tluobyi ta a bangkhuo khata bienatluophie cunglie kha myi ta rue'a te myirue panaana a pihluo aa. Myirue panaana ca Abyipaa tlechuopa rangpa-ue tana a cuo.
Abyipa'a luo myirue panaana nama pihluopa ca pavaa ta a cuo kieca thuvruv acuolikie valale chung taa khata namaa tlaw aa.
Tluobyi ta bienatluophie luo kha vya cyile'a te, a rue kha camaa pachung'a te a luv kha myi ta a rue aa. Bienatluophie a saa lie kha a thiy a pangiesue aa.
A cahaw kha a chunglie sa hne khata la'a te bienatluophie ningchiyluo kuo buvcuo china lie kha a thaw aa.

A mathlaa hne aa pazue yalya khata para li pata a cacuo kha a hle aa. Cakhutaa cata tluobyipa ca ta bienatluophie cunglie kha myi cunglieta thing cunglie kha myi ta a rue aa. Capa ca myirue panaana, Abyipata a tlechuopa rangpa-ue ta a cuo.
Ahung a cuo zaw Abyipakha sa ta panaana a pihluo khing kieca, jungsacuo viedie taa khata la'a te, chiytiy kha bya'a te frankinsens zaw kha a bya khutaata

Aaron sacapaa tluobyi tie'a luo kha a vya cyi aa. Capa chung taa cata jungsacuo viedie hne chiytiy ca frankinsens bangkhuo hne khata pazaa zung kha la'a te, bienatluophie lie kha myi ta a rue aa. Myirue panaana ca Abyipata a tlechuopa rangpa-ue tana a cuo.
Sa ta panaana lie a hlyipa ca Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw cuota a cuo aa. Hingpa hing caAbyipakha myirue panaana pihluopa chungtaata a pathe cepa tana a cuo.

Myipung lie epa ta sa ta panaana kha na pihluo kieca, a pha cepa jungsacuo viedie ta tuepa, sathu pya ciepa thiynung phuv lipa viechuo, acuolikie chiytiy thuvpa thiynung phuv lipa viechuo kuopa ta a cuo aa.
Namaa biena ca talang lie tuepa viechuo ta a cuo kieca, jungsacuo viedie a pha cepa hne chiytiy pyapa, thiynung pya lipa ta tuepa a cuo aa.
A diyta tah chechi diy'a cate chiytiy na thuv aa. Capa ca sa ta abiena ta a cuo.
Namaa biena ca talang lie tuepa viechuo ta a cuo kieca, jungsacuo a pha cepa hne chiytiy ta tuepa ta a cuo aa.
Cahaacata phang kha lalaa ta nama tuepa sa ta panaana ca tluobyi hmiekung luo vya cyi'a ung cate, ama ta bienatluophie luo kha Abyipapihluo riypata a cyile aa.
Tluobyi ca ta sa ta panaana lie'apa kha aa dena zaa ta la'a te bienatluophie cunglie kha myi ta a rue aa. Capa ca myi ta abiena Abyipata a tlechuopa rangpa-ue ta a cuo.
Sa ta panaana aa ngaapa ca Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw cuota a cuo aa. Hingpa hing ca Abyipakha myirue panaana pihluopa chungtaata a pathe cepa tana a cuo.
Abyipa'a luo nama vya cyipa sa ta panaana ca thiynung ta tuepa suokha hmuo aw'a vyi, tahematapakieca khaapa thiynung hne khaapa khyitiy hmuo Abyipa'a luo kha myirue panaana ta pihluo'a va ung ciy.
Sathaapa pacuona lie ca Abyipahmiekung luo kha nama vya chiykhyi thluo aa, cuorasala bienatluophie lie ca myirue panaana ta pihluo'a va ung ciy.
Nama Khazing hneta biekuona nama tuenapa sa ta panaana bangkhuo lie kha paciy maw'a va ung ciy. Nama pihluopa bangkhuo lie kha paciy nama pihluopuo pari aa.
Sathaapa kha sa ta panaana pihluo riypata Abyipa'a luo nama vya cyi kieca, nama vya cyipa sathaapa ca ziyzaa lie pacuo'a ung cate, myi lie nama pakuopa ta a cuo aa.
Capa luo ca chiytiy kha bya'a ung cate frankinsens zaw nama bya ra aa. Capa ca sa ta panaana ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata tluobyi ta myi lie nama pakuo ciepa sachuo hne chiytiy hne frankinsens kha aa dena zaa ta la'a te myi ta a rue aa. Capa ca Abyipakha myirue panaana pihluo pata a cuo.
Abiena nama pihluopa ca aviesaa panaana ta a cuo kieca, sahring chungtaata a canung acuolikie a capaa kha nama pihluo kieca, Abyipahmiekunglieta a dutlapa ta a cuo aa.

Abiena ta nama pihluopa sahring a luv cunglie kha nama kuv khang'a ung cate, atawna thluodaa a ngienapa lie kha nama thie aa. Aaron sacapaa tluobyi tie khata a thiy kha bienatluophie a kuo bangkhuo khata ama hi aa.
Aviesaa panaana saa chungtaata myirue panaana ta Abyipa'a luo nama pihluo riypa ca, a chungriy a pahlawpa a thupa, hne a riy chunglieta a thupa bangkhuo,
a lungsarue suohning cunglie a awpa a thupa hne a liyky lie a awpa a thupa, hne a lungsarue hneta la hnepa a pathiy a pahlawpa a thupa zaw ta ama cuo aa.
Cakhutaata Aaron sacapaa tie khata bienatluophie lie, myi cunglie thing cunglie a awpa myirue panaana saa hne khata myi ta rue'a yi te Abyipakha ama pihluo aa.
Aviesaa panaana ta Abyipa'a luo nama pihluopa ca tuv hne mie, a capaa acuolikie a canung ta a cuo kieca, a dutlapa kha nama pihluo aa.
Abiena riypata tuv kha nama pihluo kieca, Abyipahmiekung luo kha vya cyi'a ung cate
a luv cunglie kha nama kuv nama khang aa. Atawna thluodaa hmielie kha thie'a ung cate, Aaron sacapaa zaw ta bienatluophie a kuo bangkhuo khata a thiy kha ama hi aa.

Aviesaa panaana saa chungtaata myi ta rue pata Abyipa'a luo nama pihluo riypa tie ca: a zungruv daw taata te pachungpa a lahmyi yalya, a chungriy a pahlawpa a thupa bangkhuo, a riy chunglie a awpa a thupa bangkhuo,
a lungsarue suohning cunglie a awpa a thupa hne a liyky lie a awpa a thupa, hne a lungsarue hneta la hnepa a pathiy a pahlawpa a thupa zaw ta ama cuo aa.
Cakhutaata tluobyi ta bienatluophie lie kha myi ta rue'a te sa ta panaana kha Abyipa'a luo ca a pihluo aa.
Abiena nama pihluopa ca mie ta a cuo kieca, Abyipahmiekung luo kha vya cyi'a ung cate,
a luv cunglie kha nama kuv khang'a ung cate, atawna thluodaa hmielie kha nama thie aa.
Capa chung taa cata myirue panaana ta Abyipa'a luo nama pihluo riypa ca, a chungriy a pahlawpa a thupa, a riy chunglie a awpa a thupa bangkhuo,
a lungsarue suohning cunglie a awpa a thupa, a liyky lie a awpa a thupa, hne a lungsarue hneta la hnepa a pathiy a pahlawpa a thupa zaw ta ama cuo aa.
Cakhutaata tluobyi ta bienatluophie lie kha myi ta rue'a te sa ta panaana kha Abyipa'a luo ca a pihluo aa. A thupa bangkhuo ca Abyipahuopa tana a cuo.
Nama awna lie bangkhuo ta a thupa cuose, a thiy cuose ning'a va ung ciy. Capa ca nama chuo chung bangkhuo ta nama ziy pari riypa phungluo tana a cuo aa.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata,
Israel ming kha chang tie yi: Cawsaa pakha ca a ting ciemuo pata cuo li pata suena tue te, tue li riypa tapa Abyipanawbie kha a para kieca a raw luo haa hingta a tue riypa a cuo aa:

A suepa ca sathu pathuvpa tluobyi ta a cuo kieca, Israel ming'a luo kha suena a chiykhyi pata cuo te, capa a suena a ngiethena riypata cuetungpa a panuta a dutlapa kha sue pathe sa panaana ta Abyipa'a luo kha a pihluo aa.
Cuetungpa ca atawna thluodaa a ngiena Abyipahmiekung luo kha vya chiykhyi'a te, a luv cunglie kha a kuv khang'a te, Abyipahmiekunglie kha cuetungpa ca a thie aa.
Sathu pathuvpa tluobyi ta cuetungpa thiy chekha kha la'a te atawna thluodaa luo kha a vya cyi aa.
Tluobyi ca ta a kuvdaw kha thiy chung luo ca naw'a te, Abyipahmiekunglie kha hmangpathepa pangzu a hmieluo kha yi sariy a hi aa.

Tluobyi ca ta Abyipahmiekung atawna thluodaa chung rangpa-ue pakhuvnapa bienatluophie thingpazue tie kha a thiy chekha kha a thuv aa. Aa ngaapa cuetungpa thiy chekha kha atawna thluodaa luo a ngiena lie a awpa myirue panaana bienatluophie a patuna lie kha a lyisue aa.
Sue pathe sa panaana lie thiepa cuetungpa a thu bangkhuo: a chungriy a pahlawpa a thupa bangkhuo hne a riy chunglie a awpa a thupa bangkhuo,
a lungsarue suohning hne a pahlawpa a thupa hne a liyky lie a awpa a thupa, a lungsarue hneta la hnepa a pathiy a pahlawpa a thupa zaw kha
aviesaa panaana lie pihluopa cuetungpa thu a la diypa haa khata a la diy aa. Tluobyi ca ta myirue panaana bienatluophie lie kha myi ta a rue aa.
Cuorasala cuetungpa a vang hne a saa, a luv, a phyicamaa, a chungriy, hne a i,
cuetungpa a pangpa yalya khata arina hmang ale luo, a pathenapa hmang buvcuo lyinapa luo kha a puvle'a te, thing cunglie kha a rue aa, buvcuo lyina hmang lie kha a rue aa.
Israel ming cawsaazaapuv ta a ting ciemuo pata cuo li pata Abyipanawbie ta tue li riypa a tapa suokhakha kha ama tue nakawta suena chiykhyi yi te,
capa ama suenapa ca pachangpa a cuo tiyta, cawsaazaapuv ca ta cuetungpa a panuta sakha kha atawna thluodaa hmiekung luo kha vya cyi'a yi te sue pathe sa panaana ta ama pihluo aa.
Cawsaazaapuv chungtaata uvthyi tie ta Abyipahmiekunglieta ama kuv kha a luv cunglie ca khang'a yi te, Abyipahmiekunglie ca cuetungpa ca ama thie aa.
Sathu pathuvpa tluobyi ta cuetungpa a thiy chekha kha atawna thluodaa chung luo cyile'a te,
Abyipahmiekunglie kha a kuvdaw kha thiy chung luo ca naw'a te, pangzu a hmieluo kha yi sariy a hi aa.

Abyipahmiekung atawna thluodaa bienatluophie thingpazue tie kha a thiy chekha ca a thuv aa. Aa ngaapa a thiy chekha kha atawna thluodaa a ngiena lie a awpa myirue panaana bienatluophie a patuna lie kha a lyisue aa.
A thupa bangkhuo kha la'a te bienatluophie cunglie kha myi ta a rue aa.
Sue pathe sa panaana lie pipa cuetungpa a tuepa haa khata a tue aa. Tluobyi ta iema cuo khata sue angiethena hiepa'a yi te, ama suena kha a ngiethe pata ama cuo aa.
Cuetungpa ca arina hmang ale luo kha pyakhyi'a te, cawsaazaapuv sue pathe sa panaana riypata cuetungpa taapa a ruepa haa khata myi ta a rue aa.
Uvtuv pakha ta a ting ciemuo li pata a Khazing Abyipanawbie ta tue li riypa a tapa kha a tue nakawta suena chiykhyi te,
capa suena a tuepa ca aa pachang tiyta, hriykhung a rina riypata a dutlapa mietungpa kha a pihluo aa.
A kuv kha mie luv cunglie ca khang'a te, Abyipahmiekung myirue panaana ama tuena hmang lie kha a thie aa. Capa ca sue pathe sa panaana tana a cuo.

Tluobyi ta sue pathe sa panaana mie a thiy kha a kuvdaw ta a cawta la'a te, myirue panaana bienatluophie thingpazue tie kha a thuv aa. Cakhutaata aa ngaapa a thiy khata myirue panaana bienatluophie a patuna kha a lyisue aa.

A thupa bangkhuo ca bienatluophie lie kha aviesaa panaana lie thiepa saa a thupa haa khata myi ta a rue aa. Cahaacata uvtuv suenapa cuo ca ta tluobyi ta sue angiethena hiepa'a te, ama ca sue a ngiethe pata a cuo aa.
Niema hrawlie cawsaa cakhawpa pakha ta a ting ciemuo li pata Abyipanawbie ta tue li riypa a tapa kha nama tue nakawta suena chiykhyi ung cate,
nama tuepa suena kha namaa pachang kieca, nama tuepa suena cuo khata hriykhung a rina riypata a dutlapa mietungpa kha namaa vya cyi aa.
Sue pathe sa panaana mie a luv cunglie kha nama kuv khang'a ung cate, myirue panaana hmang lie kha nama thie aa.
Tluobyi ta a thiy chekha kha a kuvdaw ta la'a te, myirue panaana bienatluophie thingpazue tie kha a thuv aa. Cakhutaata aa ngaapa a thiy kha bienatluophie a patuna lie kha a lyisue aa.

Aviesaa panaana lie hmuopa sahring a thupa a lapa haa khata a thupa bangkhuo kha la'a te, Abyipacuota a tlechuopa rangpa-ue cuo riypata bienatluophie lie kha myi ta a rue aa. Cahaacata tluobyi ta niema cuota sue angiethena kha hie'a te niema ca a ngiethepa nama cuo aa.
Sue pathe sa panaana riypata nama vya cyipa ca tuv ta a cuo kieca, a dutlapa tuv canung kha nama vya cyi aa.
Sue pathe sa panaana cuota pipa tuv luv cunglie ca nama kuv kha khang'a ung cate, myirue panaana ta nama pihluopa sahring thiena hmang lie kha sue pathe sa panaana riypata nama thie aa.

Tluobyi ta sue pathe sa panaana ta thiepa a thiy ca a kuvdaw ta la'a te myirue panaana bienatluophie thingpazue tie kha a thuv aa. Cakhutaata aa ngaapa a thiy kha bienatluophie patuna lie kha a lyisue aa.

Aviesaa panaana lie pipa tuv a thupa nama lapa haa khata a thupa bangkhuo kha la'a ung cate, tluobyi ta bienatluophie cunglie kha myi ta rue'a te Abyipa'a luo kha myirue panaana ta a pihluo aa. Cahaacata nama tuepa suena cuo khata tluobyi ta niema cuota sue angiethena ca hiepa'a yi te, niema ca angiethe pata nama cuo aa.
Ahunghmuo cuo ung la, tehte cuo riypata cawsaazaapuv hmielie kha chie pasa sapa a cuo pata a thyipa hne a hmungpa kha a ri khing li kieca, sue duotena ang riypata a cuo aa.

Ahunghmuo cuo ung la, a pathe lipa hmang, a pathe lipa saruopa a thiypa, a pathe lipa sahring a thiypa, a pathe lipa aa valepa saruopa a thiypa kha nama pachang li pata nama taw tiyta, a pathe lipa ta cuo ung cate a suepa ta nama cuo.
Cawsaa pathe lipa kha na pachang li pata na taw tiyta, tuokhaapa pathe lina ta a pathe lipa a cuo zaw, naa pachang pahne ta a suepa ta na cuo.

Ahunghmuo cuo ung la phana acuolikie chiena cuo tana a cuo tapa kha rue taa li pata hne nama pachang li pata chie a sa ung cate, nama vya pachang tiyta, capa suokhakha kawlie ca ta a suepa tana nama cuo.
Capa suokhakha kawlieta nama suepa kha namaa pachang tiyta, nama tuepa suena cuo khata sue namaa phu aa.

Nama sue duotena cuo khata sue pathe sa panaana riypata tuv a canung acuolikie mie a canung kha Abyipahmiekung luo vya cyi'a ung cate, tluobyi ta nama suena cuo khata niema cuo pata sue angiethena a hie aa.

Cuorasala tuv nama pi khu li kieca nama sue duotena cuo khata thuvruv sahning acuolikie valale sahning, sakha kha sue pathe sa panaana cuo hne a hrangpa sakha kha myirue panaana cuota Abyipahmiekung luo kha nama vya chiykhyi aa.
Tluobyi'a luo kha chiykhyi'a ung cate, a pangpa para li pata a rue kha camaa'a te, sue pathe sa panaana ta a pihluo aa.
Sue pathesana ta pihluopa saa a thiy chekha kha bienatluophie a kuo lie kha hi'a te, aa ngaapa a thiy chekha kha bienatluophie a patuna lie kha a pangiesue aa; capa ca sue pathe sa panaana ta a cuo.
A sahningnapa kha ziyphung haata myirue panaana ta a pihluo aa. Cahaacata tluobyi ca ta nama suena cuo khata niema cuopa ta sue angiethena hie'a te niema ca a ngiethe pata nama cuo aa.

Cuorasala thuvruv sahning hne valale sahning kha nama pi khu li kieca, nama suena cuota sue pathe sa panaana pihluo riypata a pha cepa jungsacuo viedie ephah che hraa lie che kha nama pi aa. Sue pathe sa panaana a cuo nakawta chiytiy acuolikie frankinsens kha pya'a va ung ciy.,

Tluobyi'a luo kha vya cyi'a ung cate, aa dena zaa kha a kuv pazaa ta phuo'a te, bienatluophie lie kha myi ta rue'a te Abyipakha myirue panaana ta a pihluo aa; capa ca sue pathe sa panaana ta a cuo aa.

Cahaacata tluobyi ta nama tuepa khaapa suenapa cuo ta a cuo zaw, niema cuopa ta sue angiethena kha hie'a te, niema ca a ngiethe pata nama cuo aa. Sa ta panaana haa khata aa ngaapa ca tluobyi cuota a cuo aa.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:

Ahunghmuo cuo ung la Abyipahmang pathepa cunglie a ting ciemuo li pata suena nama tue tlamu kieca a dutlapa tuvtungpa sakha, hne hmangpathepa shekel ta pathlie pa, tuvtungpa muo hneta aa khingpa ngu kha sue a ngiethe panaana cuota Abyipa'a luo kha nama pihluo aa. Capa ca sue a ngiethe panaana ta a cuo.

A pathepa hmang cunglie tue li pata nama aw tlamupa cuota thungpakhaana kha che pangaa lie che kha kha chachiy'a ung cate tluobyi kha nama pi aa. Tluobyi ta niema cuopa ta tuvtungpa ta sue a ngiethe panaana kha tue'a te, niema ca a ngiethe pata nama cuo aa.
Ahunghmuo cuo ung la, Abyipanawbie ta tue li riypa a tapa kha nama pachang li pata nama tue kieca, suena a tuepa cuo ung cate, sue duotena kha nama ang aa.

Tluobyi'a luo kha a dutlapa tuvtungpa sakha, acuolikie sue a ngiethe panaana lie haa khata a muo hne aa khingpa ngu kha nama vya cyi aa. Tluobyi ta a ting ciemuo li pata nama tuepa suena cuo khata niema cuopa ta sue angiethena hie'a te, niema ca a ngiethe pata nama cuo aa.
Capa ca Abyipahmiekunglie nama sue nakawta sue a ngiethe panaana nama pihluopa tana a cuo.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:

Ahunghmuo cuo ung la, chechiy cake sa cawpa kawlie, hne biekuona hneta ama vya chisue cawpa chechiy kawlieta a ingpaa kha a dung kie cuose, chechiy kha a chuv kie cuose, a tuokaa kha aa hmuo li pata a hmuopa kie cuose,
a viepa chechiy suokhakha a hmung pata a phiy kie cuose, cahaapa suokhakha kawlieta Abyipa'a lie suena kha tue te aa hmuo li pata chie namaa sa tiyta,
nama sue khutaata nama suepa kha namaa pachang kieca, nama chuvpa chechiy, dung ung cate nama hmungpa chechiy, aca cake sa cawpa yi chechiy, vie te na hmungpa chechiy,

aa hmuo li pata chie a sa cate na hmung pa chechiy suokhakha cuo khata a muo hne a muo che pangaa che kha kha pahlaw chiy'a cate na thung aa. Na suena naa pachang pahne khata a hnyituv kha na thung aa.
Cakhutaata Abyipa'a luo sue pathe sa panaana cuo khata a dutlapa tuvtungpa sakha, acuolikie a muo zaa kha tluobyi'a luo nama vya cyi aa.
Tluobyi ta Abyipahmiekunglie kha niema cuopa ta sue angiethena hie'a te, acaa pasue sapa yi suena taa khata a ngiethepa nama cuo aa.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:

Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw kha bie pi yi la: Hingpa hingna myirue panaana lie ziy riypa phungluo ta a cuo, ta tie yi. Myirue panaana ta pihluopa sahring ca bienatluophie myiruena alung padiepa cunglie kha zuokhydyi ta, maw te khata aw'a te, bienatluophie lie myi zaw kha aa hlaa pari aa.

Tluobyi ca cawthang phapa ta biepa a buohryi rawpatlung pasiypa aa hryi khutaata cawthang phapa ta biepa a tluobyi caw kha a hryi pathang'a te, bienatluophie lie myirue panaana buvcuo kha la'a te bienatluophie kielie khata a chi aa.
Cakhutaata a tluobyi caw kha thlie'a te, caw hrangpa kha a hryi'a te, buvcuo ca arina hmang ale luo a pathenapa hmang luo kha a pyakhyi aa.

Bienatluophie cunglie myi ca a hlaa pari aa, pathiy'a va ung ciy. A maw tating ta tluobyi ta thing kha tiy chiy pari'a te, thing cunglie ca myirue panaana kha a khang aa. Aviesaa panaana ta pipa saa a thupa kha myi ta a rue aa.
Bienatluophie cunglie myi ca a hlaa pari'a te, pathiy'a va ung ciy.
Hingpa hingna sa ta panaana phungluo ta a cuo. Aaron sacapaa zaw ta Abyipahmiekunglie, bienatluophie lie kha ama tue aa.

Sa ta panaana jungsacuo viedie phapa chung taa khata viedie kuv pazaa zung kha hne chiytiy hne frankinsens yalya hne kha aa de zaa ta la'a te, Abyipatlechuopa rangpa-ue cuo riypata bienatluophie cunglie kha myi ta a rue aa.
Aa ngaapa kha Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw ta atawna thluodaa dungkhuo chung hmang pathepa lie kha thiynung phuv li pata ama ning aa.
Thiynung hneta ruepa cuo'a vyi. Myirue panaana ina pihluopa chung taa yi ta iema vu ta kama ta i pipa yi tana a cuo. Sue pathe sa panaana hne sue a ngiethe panaana haa khata a pathe cepa tana a cuo.

Aaron ciypathla chungtaata capaa bangkhuo ta capa ca ama ning aa. Abyipa'a luo myirue panaana pihluopa chungtaata nama chuo chung bangkhuo ta nama hmung pari riypa nama cuvu tana a cuo. Capa abiena sa a dekhupa ahunghmuo a pathepa ta aa li aa.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:

Hingpa hing Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw ta chiytiy pathuvpa a cuo ningta Abyipa'a luo abiena ama pihluo riypata a cuo aa. Pihluo tawpa haa khata jungsacuo viedie phapa ephah suokha chungtaata che hraa lie che kha, khingkhuo kha maw ta, khingkhuo kha zuoluo ta pihluo riypa a cuo aa.
Chiytiy hneta pya pata uvkuo lie ruepa cuo'a te, sa ta panaana viechuo kuopa haa khata a diyta tah chechi diy'a ung cate, a tlechuopa rangpa-ue cuo riypata Abyipakha nama pihluo aa.

Cahaacata a ciypathla zaw chungtaata Aaron a thle riypata sathu pathuvpa tluobyi ta capa ca a pihluo aa. Capa ca Abyipa'a lie nama tue pari riypa cuo te, a bangkhuo ta myi ta nama rue diy riypata a cuo aa.
Tluobyi ta a pihluopa sa ta panaanapa bangkhuo ca myi ta rue diy riypa a cuo aa; ning pata cuo'a vyi.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:

Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw kha chang tie yi: Hingpa hingna sue pathe sa panaana phungluo ta a cuo. Sue pathe sa panaana lie pihluopa sahring ca myirue panaana lie pihluopa sahring nama thienapa hmang Abyipahmiekunglie kha nama thie aa; capa ca a pathe cepa ta a cuo.
A pihluotuv tluobyi ta atawna thluodaa a dungkhuo chung hmang pathepa lie kha a ning aa.
Capa saa a dekhupa mekaa ca a pathepa ta aa li aa. Cakhutaata thiy ca ta caw kha aa kaa kieca capa caw ca hmang pathepa lie kha pasuv pata a cuo aa.
Capa saa pasunapa alyi bi ca dechi pata a cuo aa, cuorasala daa bi ta ama pasu kieca a phasa pata hna'a yi te tiy ta pasiy pata a cuo aa.
Tluobyi chung capaa bangkhuo ta ama ning aa; hingpa hing a pathe cepa ta a cuo.
Cuorasala hmang pathepa chunglie sue angiethena cuota atawna thluodaa chung luo a thiy amaa ngiekhyipa sue pathe sa panaana saa ca ning'a va ung ciy; myi tana nama rue aa.
Sue a ngiethe panaana phungluo ca hing haa hing tana a cuo. A pathe cepa ta a cuo.
Sue a ngiethe panaana ta pihluopa sahring ca myirue panaana ta pihluopa sahring ama thienapa lie kha ama thie aa. A thiy ca bienatluophie a kuo bangkhuo khata ama hi aa.
A thupa bangkhuo ca pihluo diypa a cuo aa. A lahmyi yalya, a chungriy a pahlawpa a thupa,
a lungsarue suohning hne a pahlawpa a thupa hne a liyky lie a awpa a thupa, a lungsarue hne la hnepa a pathiy lie a thupa zaw ta ama cuo aa.
Tluobyi ta Abyipa'a luo kha myirue panaana ta bienatluophie cunglie kha myi ta a rue diy aa; capa ca sue a ngiethe panaana ta a cuo.
Tluobyi chung capaa mekaa ta hmang pathepa lie kha ama ning aa. Capa ca a pathe cepa tana a cuo.
Sue a ngiethe panaana ca sue pathe sa panaana haa khata a cuo. Ziy riypa phungluo zaw aa lu. Sue angiethena a hiepatuv tluobyi ta saa kha aa la aa.
Caacuonakawta, ahung abienapa a cuo zaw, abiena a pihluotuv tluobyi ta myirue panaana lie ama pihluopa sahring a vang kha aa la aa.
Myipung lie ruepa, talang lie acuolikie uvkuo lie tuepa sa ta panaana bangkhuo ca a pihluotuv tluobyi huopa tana a cuo aa.
Cuorasala a hrangpa sa ta panaana lie pihluopa mekaa ca chiytiy hne pyapa a cuo zaw a huvpa a cuo zaw Aaron sacapaa zaw ta aa khing law ta amaa la aa.
Cawsaa pakhakha ta Abyipa'a lie a pihluopa aviesaa panaana kawlieta ziy riypa phungluo ca hingpa hing tana a cuo.

Palungtluo pihluona ta nama pihluopa a cuo kieca thiynung phuv lipa viechuo chiytiy hneta pyapa, thiynung phuv lipa viechuo kuopa chiytiy thuvpa, jungsacuo viedie phapa ta tuepa viechuo chiytiy lie pacipa tie kha nama pihluo aa.
Aviesaa panaana lie pihluopa hne khata thiynung phuvpa viechuo kha nama vya cyi hne aa.
Abyipa'a luo nama pihluopa abiena cyicuo chung taa khata viechuo hlung kha law la'a ung cate, capa ca aviesaa panaana lie pipa sahring thiyse a hituv tluobyi cuo khata a cuo aa.
Cakhutaata palungtluona ta aviesaa panaana lie nama pihluopa saa ca capa ning lie ca ta nama ning diy aa, mawluo maw te ta khaapahmuo pangaa'a va ung ciy.

Cuorasala hriykhungrina nama pihluopa ca biekuopuopa pihluona acuolikie palung thu pata nama pihluopa a cuo kieca, hriykhungrina nama pihluo ning cata ning'a ung cate, aa ngaapa kha a mawluopa ta nama ning aa.
Cuorasala hriykhung a rina saa aa ngaapa ca a ning thungnapa lie kha myi ta nama rue diy aa.

Aviesaa panaana lie pihluopa hriykhungrina saa ca ning thungna lieta ning pata a cuo kieca cuhluo pata cuo'a vyi, a pihluotuv zaw cuhluo pata cuo'a vyi, duvsamakhie aa chiypa ta cuo'a te, a ningpa ca suena kha a ang aa.
Hriykhungrina saa ca a pathe lipa suokhakha a de khu pathlyi kieca ning li riypata cuo'a te, myi ta nama rue aa. Saa hrangpa tie kha ca a pathepa tie ta ama ning aa.
A pathe lipa adaahmang lie aa daa pata Abyipa'a luo aviesaa panaana ta ama pihluopa saa kha a ningpa ca a mingphang taata thawpa a cuo aa.

Niema chungtaata pakhakha ta a pathe lipa suokhakha, cawsaa pathe lina acuolikie a pathe lipa ing saruopa, acuolikie a pathe lipa ruo saruopa kha taw ung cate Abyipa'a luo aviesaa panaana saa kha nama ning kieca, nama mingphang taata thawpa nama cuo aa.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Israel ming kha chang tie yi: cuetungpa thupa, tuv thupa, hne mie thupa kha ning'a va ung ciy.
A thiypa acuolikie saa ta a siepa saruopa thupa ca suokhakha lie hmuo riypata namaa chi khu, cuorasala ning hrahring'a va ung ciy.
Niema chungtaata cawsaa pakhakha ta Abyipa'a luo myirue panaana ta ama pihluopa saa a thupa kha nama ce kieca nama mingphang taata thawpa nama cuo aa.
Niema ca khaapalie nama aw zawta pavaa acuolikie saruopa thiy, khaapa thiy hmuota ning'a va ung ciy.
Ahung nama cuo zawta thiy a ningpa ca nama mingphang taata thawpa tana nama cuo aa.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Israel ming kha chang tie yi: Niema ahunghmuo Abyipakha aviesaa panaana a pihluopa ca aviesaa panaana ta nama pihluopa kha niema hrahring ta Abyipa'a luo nama vya cyi aa.
Myirue panaana ta nama pihluopa kha niema kuv hrahring ta nama vya cyi aa; Abyipahmiekunglie calangpa panaana ta a bie pata nama cathlu riypata a ngaw hne a thupa kha nama vya cyi aa.
