Tluobyi ta a thupa ca bienatluophie cunglie kha myi ta a rue aa, cuorasala a ngaw ca Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw cuvu tana a cuo aa.
Cakhutaata aviesaa panaana ta nama pihluopa a cacuoluo baw ca tluobyi kha nama pi aa.
Aaron sacapaa zaw chungtaata aviesaa panaana lie a thiy hne a thupa a pihluopa tluobyi khata a cacuoluo baw ca a cu aa.
Tahematapakieca calangpa panaana a ngaw, hne pihluopa a cacuoluo baw ca Israel ming'a taa khata kama ta la angte, Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw kha Israel ming'a taata ama cu pari riypata i pi tli yi.
Hingpa hing Abyipatluobyi re hrie riypata amaa tlaw ningta Abyipa'a luo pihluopa myirue panaana taata Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw cuota pipa cuvu ta a cuo.
Capa ca iema chiytiy a pathuv ningpa yi khata Abyipata iema pi riypata Israel ming bie a pipa yi, ama chuo bangkhuo ta Israel ming'a taata ama cu pari riypa tana a cuo.
Hingpa hing myirue panaana, sa ta abiena, sue pathe sa panaana, sue a ngiethe panaana, chiytiy pathuv abiena hne aviesaa panaana lie ziy riypa phungluo ta a cuo.
Ama pihluopa kha Abyipa'a luo vya cyi riypata Sinai ruocaapa lie Israel ming bie a pi ning yi ta, Abyipata Sinai tluo lie Moses bie a pipa tana a cuo.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Aaron hne a sacapaa tie kha, tluobyi tie caw, tluobyi sathu, sue pathe sa panaana cuetungpa, tuvtungpa sahning, thiynung phuv lipa viechuo beke zung kha hne khata a vya chiy yi la,
cawsaazaapuv kha atawna thluodaa luo a ngienapa lie kha pahmya tie yi.
Abyipata bie a pipa haa khata Moses ta a tue. Atawna thluodaa lie cawsaazaapuv amaa hmya tiyta,
Moses ta cawsaazaapuv kha, “Abyipata tue riypata bie malie a pipa ca hingpa hing tana a cuo,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata Moses ta Aaron hne a sacapaa tie kha zaapuv hmieluo vya pyakhyi yi te tiy ta a pasiy yi.
Buohryi rawpatlung kha pahryi te tesaw kha a pasaw. Buohryi pasiypa kha pahryi te tluobyi buohryi kha a pahryi chiy. Cakhutaata a puvthesa pata panginapa tluobyi buohryi riy khata a ciypuo.
Cacunghnaabe kha be te Urim hne Thummim kha a chi.
Pawde kha papaw te Abyipata Moses kha a changpa haata a pawde hmieluo kuo khata siy byilakhuv taata kha a be.
Cakhutaata Moses ta tluobyi sathu kha la te bienathluodaa hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo kha pathuv te a pathe sa.
Chekha kha bienatluophie lie yi sariy hi te a bienatluophie hne a chechiy tingby bangkhuo, hne rahung hne a patunapa zaw kha a pathe sa.
Tluobyi sathu chekha kha Aaron luv cunglie kha bya te, pathuv te a pathe sa.
Cakhutaata Moses ta Aaron sacapaa zaw kha a hmieluo vya pyakhyi yi te, Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haa khata buohryi rawpatlung kha a pahryi yi, tesaw kha pasaw yi te, pawde kha a papaw yi.
Sue pathe sa panaana cuetungpa ca hmieluo vya pyakhyi te, Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw ta ama kuv kha cuetungpa luv cunglie kha khang yi te ama thie.

Moses ta a thiy chekha kha la te, bienatluophie thingpazue tie kha a kuvdaw ta hnie te a pathe sa; cakhutaa cata bienatluophie thabaw lie kha a thiy ca a lyisue. Cahaacata bienatluophie ca sue angiethena tuena riypata a pathe sa.
Moses ta a chungriy a pahlawpa a thupa bangkhuo, a pathiy lie a thupa, hne a lungsarue suohning kha a thupa hneta la te bienatluophie lie kha myi ta a rue.
Cuorasala cuetungpa ca a vang hne a saa hne a i kha Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haata arina hmang ale lie kha myi ta a rue.
Cakhutaa cata myirue panaana tuvtungpa kha a vya pyakhyi. Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw ta tuvtungpa luv cunglie kha ama kuv khang yi te ama thie.
Moses ta a thiy kha bienatluophie a kuo bangkhuo khata a hi.
Tuvtungpa saa ca ca-uo yi te, Moses ta a luv hne a saa hne a thupa kha myi ta a rue.

A chungriy hne a camaa ca tiy ta a pasiy khutaata, Moses ta tuvtungpa ca bienatluophie cunglie kha a yalya ta myi ta a rue. Capa ca rangpa-ue cuo riypata myi ta panaana cuo te, Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haa khata Abyipa'a luo myirue panaana ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata tluobyi tie sathu pathuvna lie hmuo riypa, a sahningnapa tuvtungpa kha ama vya pyakhyi. Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw ta ama kuv kha tuvtungpa luv cunglie ca khang yi te,
ama thie. Moses ta a thiy chekha kha la te, Aaron cacuoluo naakue daw lie, a cacuoluo kuvpuv lie, hne a cacuoluo phyipuv lie kha a thuv.
Aaron sacapaa zaw kha a hmieluo ama vya pyakhyi khutaata, Moses ta a thiy chekha kha la te, ama cacuoluo naakue dawta lie, ama cacuoluo kuvpuv lie, hne ama cacuoluo phyipuv lie kha a thuv yi.
Ama ta a thupa hne a thupa a lahmyi, a chungriy a pahlawpa a thupa bangkhuo, a pathiy lie a thupa, a lungsarue suohning hne a thupa, hne a cacuoluo baw kha a la.
Abyipahmiekunglie a awpa beke taata thiynung phuv lipa viechuo tluo kha, chiytiy hne viechuo tluo kha, hne viechuo kuopa suokha tapa tie kha a thupa hne a cacuoluo phyibaw cunglie kha a chi.
Capa zaw bangkhuo ca Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw kuv cunglie kha chi te, Abyipahmiekunglie kha calang yi te, calangpa panaana ta ama pihluo.
Cakhutaa cata Moses ta iema kuv taa khata la te, myi ta rue te myirue panaana ta a pihluo.

Moses ta a ngaw kha la te Abyipahmiekunglie kha calangpa panaana ta a pihluo. Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haata hingpa hing tluobyi tie sathu pathuvna lie hmuopa tuvtungpa saa chungtaata Moses cuvu ta a cuo.

Cakhutaata Moses ta tluobyi sathu chekha hne bienatluophie lie thiy chekha kha la te Aaron hne a tluobyi caw kha hi te, a sacapaa zaw hne ama caw zaw kha a hi. Cahaacata Aaron hne a caw kha pathe sa te, a sacapaa zaw hne ama caw zaw kha a pathe sa ra.

Cakhutaata Moses ta Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw kyihuo khata, “Atawna thluodaa a ngienapa lie kha saa kha pasu ung la, kama ina changpa haa khata tluobyi tie sathu pathuvna lie hmuopa beke chunglie viechuo hne khata khapa lie kha ning tie ung. Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw ta ning'a yi te,
aa ngaapa saa hne viechuo kha myi ta nama rue aa.
Atawna thluodaa luo a ngienapa taa khata ning sariy chung, tluobyi tie sathu pathuvna cuo a tlingna te ta ale luo pya'a va ung ciy.
Nama sue angiethena riypata ataning ma tuepa haa hingta tue riypa hing Abyipabiepina tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca kama’ lie bie ina pipa haa khata, Abyipabiepina kha ziy'a ung cate, nama thiy li riypata atawna thluodaa angiena lie kha ning sariy chung, chung hne zuo ta nama aw aa,” a ta yi.
Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw ca Abyipata Moses bie a taapa haa khata a palang ta ama tue diy.
A ning carina lieta Moses ta Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw hne Israel ming kha a pahmya yi.
Aaron kyihuo khata, “Sue pathe sa panaana riypata a dutlapa cuetungpa a panuta sakha hne myirue panaana riypata a dutlapa tuvtungpa sakha kha la lah Abyipakha pihluo tie.
Cakhutaata Israel kha, “Sue pathe sa panaana riypata mietungpa sakha, myirue panaana riypata kung kha a tlingpa a dutlapa cuetaata sakha hne tuvtaata sakha,

aviesaa panaana riypata cuetungpa sakha hne tuvtungpa sakha, hne chiytiy hne pyapa sa ta panaana zaw khata Abyipaca pihluo tie ung. Tahematapakieca ataning hing Abyipaca niema'a lie kha aa luo aa, ta tie yi,” a ta.
Moses ta bie a pipa haa yi khata atawna thluodaa luo kha vya chiykhyi yi te, cawsaazaapuv ca Abyipahmiekung luo kha a vya ngie yi te amaa tu.
Moses ta, “Abyiparungnaana niema'a lie aa luo riypata Abyipata aca changpa yi nama tue riypa ca hingpa hing tana a cuo,” a ta yi.

Cakhutaata Moses ta Aaron kha, “Bienatluophie luo kha vaa ngie la sue pathe sa panaana hne myirue panaana kha pihluo tie. Abyipabiepina haa khata nama hne cawsaa zaw cuo khata sue angiethena kha hie tie. Cakhutaata cawsaa ta hriykhungrina riypata ama vya cyipa kha pihluo la, iema cuota sue angiethena kha hie tie,” a ta.
Aaron ca bienatluophie luo kha vaa ngie te, ama cuota sue pathe sa panaana cuetaata kha a thie.
A sacapaa zaw ta a thiy kha ama'a luo vya cyi yi te, a kuvdaw kha thiy luo ca naw te bienatluophie thingpazue tie kha a thuv. Aa ngaapa a thiy khata bienatluophie thabaw kha a lyisue.
Cuorasala sue pathe sa panaana saa a thupa, a lungsarue, a pathiy lie a thupa tie kha ca Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haata bienatluophie lie kha myi ta a rue.
A saa hne a vang kha arina hmang ale lie kha myi ta a rue.
Cakhutaata myirue panaana sahring zaw kha a thie. A sacapaa zaw ta a thiy kha ama'a luo vya cyi yi te, ama ta bienatluophie a kuo bangkhuo khata a hi.
Cakhutaa cata myirue panaana saa ca suokha suokha khata a luv hne vya pi yi te myi ta a rue.
A chungriy hne a camaa zaw kha pasiy te myirue panaana saa hne khata bienatluophie lie ca myi ta a rue.
Cakhutaa cata cawsaa zaw hriykhungrina ca a pihluo. Cawsaa zaw suepathesana cuota panaanapa mie kha la te a thie, a tue taapa haa khata sue pathe sa panaana ta a pihluo.
Myirue panaana ta pihluo te ziyphung haa khata hriykhungrina a tue.
Maw ta pihluopa myirue panaana hlyitaw taa khata sa ta panaana zaw kha a pihluo, a kuvpazaa zung kha la te bienatluophie lie kha myi ta a rue.
Cawsaa zaw cuota aviesaa panaana cuetungpa hne tuvtungpa zaw kha a thie. Aaron sacapaa zaw khata ama'a luo ca bienatluophie a kuo bangkhuo ta a hipa a thiy,
cuetungpa hne tuvtungpa a thu, a thupa a lahmyi, a chungriy a pahlawpa a thupa, a lungsarue suohning hne a pahlawpa a thupa, a pathiy lie a thupa zaw kha ama vya cyi.
A thupa kha a ngaw zaw cunglie ama chi khutaata a thupa ca bienatluophie cunglie kha myi ta a rue.
Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haata, Aaron ta a ngaw hne a cacuoluo phyibaw kha calang te calangpa panaana ta a pihluo.
Aaron ta cawsaa zaw'a luo kha a buo pazu te thluechiy a pi yi. Sue pathe sa panaana, myirue panaana hne aviesaa panaana zaw a pihluo khutaata a za cung.
Moses hne Aaron ca atawna thluodaa chung luo kha a ngie yi te, cakhutaata kya pya yi te cawsaa kha thluechiy ama pi. Abyiparungnaana ca cawsaa bangkhuo ‘a lie kha aa luo.
Abyipa'a taata myi pya te bienathluodaa cunglie myirue panaana hne a thupa tie kha myi ca ta a kuo. Cawsaa bangkhuo ta ama hmung tiyta khi yi te amaa bu.

Aaron sacapaa Nadab hne Abihu ta myi lanapa daa pakaa kha la yi te, a chunglie kha myi chi yi te, ziyhmyi phuv yi te Abyipabiepina haata a cuo lipa, a pathe lipa myi ta abiena kha Abyipahmiekunglie ama pihluo.
Abyipahmiekung taata myi pya te, iema kha kuo yi te Abyipahmiekunglie ca ama thiy.

Cakhutaata Moses ta Aaron kha, “Abyipata, ‘Kama naa ngiepa tie'a taata a pathepa i cuopa kha paluo sa'a angte, cawsaa bangkhuo hmiekunglie ina parungnaa sa'a yi,’ a tapa ca hingpa hingna a ri khingpa ta a cuo,” a ta. Aaron ca a dieta tah a aw.

Moses ta Aaron puvpa Uzziel sacapaa Mishael hne Elzafan kha ku yi te iema kyihuo khata, “Hmie luo vya pya ung la nama uvnu tie hing hmangpathepa hmiekung taa hingta arina hmang ale luo kha pyakhyi tie ung,” a ta yi.
Hmie luo vya pya yi te Moses ta bie a pipa haa yi khata ama buohryi rawpatlung khata calangle yi te arina hmang ale luo kha ama pyakhyi.

Cakhutaa cata Moses ta Aaron hne a sacapaa Eleazar hne Ithamar kha, “Nama suo a zi li pata aw khah ung, nama caw zaw thlaa khah ung, caacuolikieca thiy'a ung cate Abyipahihaana ta cawsaazaapuv kha a de diy'a yi. Cuorasala Abyipata a za pathliepa myikuona kha nama uvnu tie, Israel ming bangkhuo ta muochie sa yi se.
Niema ca atawna thluodaa a ngiena taa khata pya'a va ung ciy, nama pya kieca nama thiy aa, tahematapakieca Abyipatluobyi sathu na nama cunglie a aw,” a ta yi. Moses bie a pipa haa yi khata ama tue.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Aaron kyihuo khata,

“Nama cuose, na sacapaa zaw cuo yi se, nama thiy li riypata atawna thluodaa luo namaa ngie tiyta, mingsuvtiy hne sahmaa kha dang khah ung. Capa ca chuo kha hnang chuo kha ta nama ziy riypa phungluo tana a cuo.
Niema ta a pathepa hne a zaaruopa cuose, a pathe lipa hne a pathepa cuose nama thleduo the aa.
Abyipata Moses'a lie a za ripa phungluo bangkhuo kha niema ta Israel ming kha nama pacuv aa.

Moses ta Aaron hne aa ngaapa a sacapaa Eleazar hne Ithamar kha: Myi ta rue ung cate sa ta panaana ta Abyipanama pihluo buopa kha bienatluophie kie lie kha thiynung phuv li pata ning tie ung. Tahematapakieca hingpa hing a pathe cepa ta cuo te,
hmang pathepa liena nama ning aa. Tahematapakieca kama'a lie bie pipa haata Abyipa'a luo myirue panaana nama pipa chungtaata nama cuvu hne na sacapaa zaw cuvu tana a cuo.

Cuorasala calangpa a ngaw hne calangpa a phyibaw ca nama hne na sacapaa zaw na sacanung zaw ta a pathepa hmang khaapa lie a cuo zawta nama ning khu. Tahematapakieca Israel ming ta aviesaa panaana ta ama pihluopa chungtaata nama hne na saata zaw cuvu ta pipa tana a cuo.

Abyipahmiekunglie calangpa panaana ta pihluo riypata calangpa a phyibaw hne calangpa a ngaw kha myi ta ruepa a thupa hne khata vya cyihne ung la, Abyipabiepina haata, capa tie ca chuozaa ta nama hne na saata zaw cuvu ta a cuo aa.
Cakhutaata Moses ta sue pathe sa panaana mie kaw kha a hiehriy tiy yi ta myi ta ama za rue tli! Moses ca aa ngaapa Aaron sacapaa Eleazar hne Ithamar cunglie kha a hi haa te,

“Khaapanakawma sue pathe sa panaana saa kha hmangpathepa lie ning li pata nama aw? Tahematapakieca hingpa hing a pathe cepa, hne Abyipahmiekunglie cawsaazaapuv suena kha lapa pata iema cuopa ta sue angiethena nama hiena riypata Khazing ta aca pipa yi tana a cuo.
A thiy hing ca hmangpathepa chung ching khuo luo a ngiekhyi'a va ung ciy. Kama ta bie ica pipa haa yi ta hmangpathepa chunglie nama ning hrahring riypa tana a cuo,” a ta yi.

Cakhutaata Aaron ta Moses kyihuo khata, “Mang tie, ataning hing iema ta Abyipahmiekunglie ama sue pathe sa panaana hne ama myirue panaana kha ama pihluo tli. Ata zaw hing hing haapa hmang hingta i cunglie ina tlungsue! Ataning hing sue pathe sa panaana saa hing ning ang sala, Abyipacuota palung tling aa chiypa a cuo'a maw?” a ta.
Moses ta capa ca a thyi tiyta, a palung a tling.
Abyipata Moses hne Aaron kyihuo khata:
Israel ming kha hing haa hingta chang tie ung: Chuelyi cunglie a awpa saruopa bangkhuo chungtaata hingpa tie hing nama ning the riypata ama cuo aa.
A caki a che te, a sa pakaa te a ca-yipa kha nama ning aa.

Cuorasala capa zaw hraw taa ca ta a sa pakaa te a ca-yipa cuose, a caki aa chepa cuose a raw luo'apa tie hing ca ning'a va ung ciy: kala-uv, a la pakaa te a ca-yi raalaa pata a caki a che vyi; niema cuota pathe vyi.
Piyvu, a sa pakaa te a ca-yi raalaa pata a caki a che vyi; niema cuota pathe vyi.
Savi lepa, a sa pakaa te a ca-yi raalaa pata a caki a che vyi; niema cuota pathe vyi.
Va, a caki aa che raalaa pata a sa pakaa vyi; niema cuota pathe vyi.
A saa ce'a va ung ciy, a thiypa a pangpa zaw taw'a va ung ciy; niema cuota pathe va yi.
Tiy chunglie a awpa saruopa chungtaata hingpa tie hing nama ning aa. Riyliy lie a awpa cuose, cavaa lie a awpa cuose mathlaa hne phuvhling a hnyipa tiy chunglie a awpa bangkhuo ca nama ning aa.
Cuorasala tiy chunglie a awpa a mathlaa hne a phuvhling a hnyi lipa, tiy chunglie a thiylepa hne tiy chunglie a hringpa saruopa bangkhuo ca nama cuota duv aa chiypa tana ama cuo.
Nama cuota duv aa chiypa tana ama cuo pari aa. A saa kha ce li'apa ung cata, a thiypa a pangpa zaw kha duv aa chiypa ta nama rue aa.
Tiy chunglie a awpa mathlaa a hnyi lipa hne phuvhling a hnyi lipa bangkhuo ca nama cuota duv aa chiypa tana ama cuo.
Pavaa zaw hrawlieta hingpa tie hing duv aa chiypa ta nama rue aa. Capa tie ca ning'a va ung ciy; capa tie ca duvsamakhie aa chiypa ta ama cuo: hmungthlu, luotaa, thluruo,
hmungchiy, pahmung phangting;
ra-aa phangting;
kala-uvpavaa, zuohmungthlu, riyliypavaa, hmungthlu phangting;
buobary, tiypuvvaapung, tutaru,
tiy-aa, ruocaatutaru, sathuvluotaa,
aathlaruo, tiypavaa phangting, cuovuolyithuvpa hne bahla.
A mathlaa hnyi te a phyi suopaliy ta a cakuopa taataapa bangkhuo ca duv aa chiypa tana a cuo.
Cuorasala mathlaa hnyi te a phyi suopaliy ta a cakuo raalaa pata alyi taata aa cathluna riypata a kuokung a hnyipa ca nama ning aa.
Capa chung taa cata nama ning the riypa ca: khawbyapa phangting, tekarypa phangting, thinghnaa khawbyapa phangting khata ama cuo.
Cuorasala a hrangpa mathlaa hnyi te a phyi suopaliy a hnyipa bangkhuo ca niema cuota duv aa chiypa tana ama cuo.
Hingpa zaw nakaw hingta a pathe lipa ta nama cuo aa; a thiypa saruopa a tawpa ahung a cuo zaw zuoluo te a pathe lipa ta a cuo aa.
A thiypa saruopa a khaapahmuo cuose a phyapa ca a caw kha pasuv'a te zuoluo te a pathe lipa ta a cuo aa.
A caki a tlaa raalaa pata a che pathla lipa hne a sa pakaa te a ca-yi lipa saruopa ca niema cuota a pathe lipa tana a cuo. Ahung a cuo zaw a tawpa ca a pathe lipa tana a cuo aa.
A phyi suopaliy ta a cakuopa saruopa zaw hrawtaata, a phyi pating a hnyipa saruopa ca niema cuota a pathe lipa tana a cuo aa. Cahaapa saruopa thiypa a tawpa ca zuoluo te ta a pathe lipa ta a cuo aa.
Cahaapa saruopa thiypa a phyapa ca a caw kha pasuv'a te zuoluo te ta a pathe lipa ta a cuo aa; cahaapa saruopa tie ca niema cuota a pathe lipa tana ama cuo.
Alyi lie aa va ta a valepa chungtaata hingpa tie hing nama cuo ta a pathe lipa ta ama cuo: sapahriy, pazuv, lilita lepa phangting,
tauhte, saathuo, tlawkahniepa, viehnang lilita, hne vuokangpa.
Aa valepa phangting chungtaata hingpa tie hing niema cuota a pathe lipa ta ama cuo; hingpa saruopa phangkhakha a thiypa a tawpa ca zuoluo te ta a pathe lipa ta a cuo.

Capa tie a thiypa phangkhakha ta ama tlasuepa hmang ca a pathe lipa ta a cuo aa. Thing ta tuepa chechiy cuose, caw cuose, savang cuose, chawkue cuose, khaapa cuota hmuopa khaapa chechiy a cuo zaw; tiy chunglie pacipa cuo'a te, zuoluo te ta a pathe lipa a cuo aa, cakhutaa cata a pathe aa.
Capa zaw chung taa cata phangkhakha ta alyibi chung luo kha a tla pathlyi kieca capa chunglie a awpa bangkhuo ca a pathe lipa tana a cuo aa, alyibi kha nama dechi aa.
Cahaapa alyibi taata tiy ta ning riypa sa a tlasue kieca a pathe lipa a cuo aa; cakhutaata cahaapa alyibi chunglie a awpa dang riypa tuokhaapa atiy a cuo zaw a pathe lipa a cuo aa.

A thiypa saruopa ta a tlasuepa khaapa hmangbya a cuo zaw a pathe lipa tana a cuo aa. Chuore ruenapa a cuo zaw, alyi ta tuepa bi changnapa a cuo zaw, nama phawchi diy aa; pathe va yi; nama cuota pathe va yi.
Cuorasala acaa hne tiy pacungnapa ca a pathe aa, capa chunglieta a thiypa saruopa a dekhupa dyi khana pathe lipa ta a cuo aa.
A thiypa khaapa saruopa ta a cuo zaw ta a tlasuepa ciycyi riypa saciy ca a pathe aa.
Cuorasala tiyta paci ciepa saciy cunglie lie a tlasue kieca, capa ca nama cuota a pathe lipa a cuo aa.
Ning pa phang saruopa phangkhakha a thiy tiyta, capa a thiypa a tawpa ca zuoluo te a pathe lipa ta a cuo aa.
Capa a thiypa saruopa saa a ningpa ca a caw kha pasuv'a te, zuoluo te a pathe lipa a cuo aa, capa a thiypa saruopa a phyalepa ca a caw kha pasuv'a te zuoluo te a pathe lipa a cuo aa.
Alyi lie aa valepa saruopa bangkhuo ca a pathe lipa tana ama cuo, ningpa ta cuo'a va yi.
A pavaw ta a vapa a thiylepa a cuo zaw, a phyi suopaliy ta a vapa a cuo zaw, a phyi a hluvsa ta a vapa a cuo zaw, alyi lie a valepa saruopa ca ning'a va ung ciy; duv aa chiypa tana ama cuo.
Capa a valepa saruopa zaw nakawta nama hne nama kha duv aa chiypa ta a tue'a vaciy, a papya a palyi'a vaciy, a pathe lipa ta a tue'a vaciy.
Tahematapakieca kama ca Abyipana Khazing tana i cuo, caacuonakawta a pathe sa la a pathepa cuo tie, tahematapakieca kama ca i pathe.
Tahematapakieca kama ca nama Khazing cuo riypata niema kha Izipt ruo taata caa vya pyakhyipa Abyipatana i cuo; niema ca nama pathe riypa tana a cuo, tahematapakieca kama ca i pathe.
Hingpa hing alyi lie saruopa hne pavaa hne tiy lie a awpa a hringpa saruopa bangkhuo hne alyi lie a valepa saruopa bangkhuo tie kha
a pathepa hne a pathe lipa, a hringpa saruopa ningpa phang hne a hringpa saruopa ning lipa phang thleduona hne aa patuvpa phungbie tana a cuo.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Israel ming kha hing haa hingta chang tie yi: Canung ta nu hnyi te sacapaa a sa kieca, ama ca ning sariy chung a pathe lipa ta a cuo aa; canung phung a pachang ning haa khata a pathe lipa a cuo aa.
Ning carina lieta haatiypa ca a vangdaw te pata a cuo aa.
A nung a pathesana cuo ca ning sawthung ning thung cuo'a te, a pathesana cuo a chuo hluo li a pathepa hmang khaapahmuo taw li pata hmangpathepa chung luo zaw a ngie'a vyi.
Canung saata kha a sa kieca ama ca ningzaa zaa hning chung a pathe lipa ta a cuo aa, canung phungpa a pachang ning haa khata. Ama a pathesana cuo ca ning saw caruv ning caruv ta a cuo aa.

A pathesana ning a tling tiyta, a saata ca capaa a cuo zaw canung a cuo zaw kung kha a tapa tuvtaata sakha, hne valale sakha acuolikie thuvruv sakha hne khata atawna thluodaa luo a ngienapa lieta tluobyipa'a luo kha a chiykhyi aa.

Tluobyipa ca ta Abyipahmiekung luo kha pihluo'a te canung cuo ca ta sue angiethena a hie aa; cakhutaa cata ama ca thiy langnapa taata a pathe aa. Capa ca sacapaa a cuo zaw sacanung a cuo zaw a sapa canung cuota phungbie ta a cuo aa.

Ama ta tuv kha a hnyi li kieca thuvruv sahning acuolikie valale sahning kha myirue panaana cuota sakha, sue pathe sa panaana cuota sakha ta pata, tluobyipa ta ama cuota sue angiethena kha hiepa'a te ama ca a pathe aa.
Abyipata Moses hne Aaron kyihuo khata:
Cawsaa pakhakha ta a vang lie a thlingpa cuose, hmaa cuose, a phaapa cuose hnyi te caahminghmaa ta aa li kieca ama ca Aaron’ luo acuolikie a sacapaa tie pakhakha'a luo kha chiykhyi pata a cuo aa.

Tluobyipa ta a vang lie pasana ca mangpasie'a te, pasana a awna lie a hming kha ruo te pasana a awna lie a vang kha aa thuv vie kieca capa ca caahminghmaa pasana ta a cuo. Tluobyi ta a mangpasie khutaata ama ca pathe vyi ta pata a pathyi sa aa.
Cuorasala a phaapa ca ruo raalaa te a thuv vie li pata, capa lieta a hming ca a ruo li kieca tluobyipa ta capa a hmaa a awpa cawsaa ca ning sariy chung a hrang ta a chi aa.
Tluobyipa ca ta a ning sariynapa lie mangpasie'a te, a hmaa kha a cakule li kieca a hrangpa ning sariy chung a hrang ta a chi vie aa.

Tluobyipa ca ta a ning sariynapa mangpasie pakhaa'a te a hmaa ca pha vie te a cakule li kieca, tluobyipa ta a pathe ta pata a pathyi sa aa. Hmaa cakhawpa ta cuo te, a caw kha pasuv'a te a pathepa ta a cuo aa.
Cuorasala tluobyipa kha a phasa pata aa pamang sa te a pathe a ta khutaata a hmaa kha a cakule kieca tluobyi kha a pamang sa pakhaa aa.
Tluobyipa ta mangpasie pakhaa'a te a hmaa kha a cakule kieca tluobyipa ca ta pathe vyi ta pata a pathyi sa aa. Capa ca caahminghmaa tana a cuo.
Cawsaa pakha ta caahminghmaa pasana a hnyi kieca ama ca tluobyipa'a luo chiykhyi pata a cuo aa.
Tluobyipa ta a mangpasie tiyta, a vang lieta a hmaa kha ruo te a hming zaw ruo te a hmaa kha a thukaluv kieca,
a tluo khu lipa caahminghmaa ta a cuo. Tluobyipa ta pathe vyi ta pata pathyi sa'a te, ama ca a hrang ta chi'a vyi, tahematapakieca a pathe lipa tana a cuo.
Cuorasala a vang lieta a hmaa kha pya te, a luv taata a phyipazaa te ta a buv diy kieca,
tluobyipa ta a mangpasie aa. Caahminghmaa ca ta a pangpa bangkhuo a buvkhung diy kieca, a pasana taata a pathe ta pata a pathyi aa. Tahematapakieca a bangkhuo ta ruo diy tli te ama ca a pathe.
Cuorasala a vang cunglie a hmaa a aw kieca ama ca pathe'a vyi.
Tluobyipa ta a hmaa kha mangpasie'a te pathe vyi ta pata a pathyi sa aa. Hmaa ca a pathe lipa ta a cuo, tahematapakieca caahminghmaa pasana tana a cuo.
Cuorasala a hmaa kha a ruopa ta aa li kieca tluobyipa'a luo kha cakuo'a te,
tluobyipa ca ta a mangpasie aa. A hmaa ca a ruopa ta aa li kieca tluobyipa ta ama ca a pathe ta pata a pathyi sa aa. Ama ca a pathe.
Cawsaa pakhakha khiyhliy a tluo tlinapa lieta,
a phaapa lie kha thling te a ruo kie cuose, a sepuo a ruopuo pata a aw kie cuose, tluobyipa kha a pamang sa aa.
Tluobyipa ta mangpasie'a te, a vang hrangpa lie laata a thuv vie te a hming kha a ruo kieca, tluobyipa ta pathe vyi ta pata a pathyi sa aa. Capa ca caahminghmaa pasana khana hmaachie ta a kya luo.

Cuorasala tluobyipa ta mangpasie te a hming zaw ruo li, a vang zaw kha a hrang lie laata aa thuv vie li raalaa pata a hmaa lie kha a vaw hriehruv kieca tluobyipa ta ning sariy chung a hrang ta a chi aa.
A hmaa kha a caku viele kieca tluobyipa ta pathe vyi ta pata a pathyi sa aa; tahematapakieca capa ca pasana tana a cuo.
Cuorasala a phaapa ca cakule li pata a aw kieca khiyhliy hmaadaa ta cuo te, tluobyi ta a pathe ta pata a pathyi sa aa.
Cawsaa pakha a vang lie myi ta kuo te capa a kuonapa a phaapa ca a sepuo a ruopuo, acuolikie a ruo kieca,

tluobyipa ta a mangpasie aa. A phaapa lie a hming kha ruo te, a vang hrangpa laata aa thuv vie kieca, capa ca caahminghmaa pasana ta a cuo. Myikuo hmaa lie a kya pyapa caahminghmaa pasana cuo te, tluobyipa ta pathe vyi ta pata a pathyi sa aa. Caahminghmaa pasana tana a cuo.
Cuorasala tluobyipa ta mangpasie te a phaapa lieta a hming kha a ruo li kie cuose, a vang hrangpa lie laata a thuv vie li pata a vaw hriehruv kieca, tluobyipa ta ning sariy chung a hrang ta a chi aa.
Ning sariy chung a hrang ta a chi chung ta a hmaa kha a cakule kieca tluobyipa ta pathe vyi ta pata a pathyi sa aa. Caahminghmaa pasana tana a cuo.
Cuorasala a phaapa ca cakule li pata suv kha lie dyi ca ta aw te a vawpuo kieca myikuo hmaa a thlingpa cuo te tluobyipa ta a pathe ta pata a pathyi sa aa; tahematapakieca myikuo hmaadaa tana a cuo.
Capaa acuolikie canung pakhakha a luv lie cuose, a cakha-ya lie cuose a hmaa a aw kieca,

tluobyipa ta a pasana kha a mangpasie aa. Capa a hmaa ca a luv vang hrang lie laata a thuv vie te capa a hmaa lie a suo ca me te a chie vie kieca tluobyipa ta pathe vyi ta pata a pathyi sa aa; capa ca retha cuo te, luv lie acuolikie cakha-ya lie a awpa caahminghmaa pasana tana a cuo.
Tluobyipa ta capa a pathapa pasana ca mangpasie'a te a vang hrang lie laata a thuv vie li raalaa pata a suo a vaw li kieca tluobyipa ta ning sariy chung a hrang ta a chi aa.
A ning sariynapa lie tluobyipa ta a hmaa kha mang'a te, cakule li pata hne a me rieruvpa a suo zaw aw li pata a hmaa ca a vang hrang lie laata aa thuv vie li kieca,
a hmaa awnapa ta li pata a suo kha a ngu se. Tluobyipa ta retha pasana a hnyipa ca ning sariy chung a hrang ta chi vie se.

A ning sariyna lie tluobyipa ta mangpasie'a te a hmaa ca cakule li pata a vang hrang lie laata aa thuv vie li kieca, tluobyipa ta a pathe ta pata pathyi se. A caw kha a pasuv'a te a pathepa ta a cuo aa.
A pathe ta pata tluobyipa ta a pathyi khutaata a hmaa kha a cakule pakhaa kieca,
tluobyipa ta a mangpasie aa. A pathanapa a hmaa kha a cakule kieca tluobyi ta a suo me rieruvpa kha huv a hu vyi; ama ca a pathe lipa tana a cuo.
Cuorasala hmaa lieta a suo vawpa pu te, a hmaa zaw kha a tluo vie ta pata tluobyipa ta a hmung kieca ama ca a pathepa ta a cuo; tluobyipa ta a pathe ta pata a pathyi sa aa.
Capaa acuolikie canung pakhakha ta a vang cunglie kha a phaapa aw te a ruo kieca,
tluobyipa ta a mangpasie aa. A vang cunglie a phaapa ca thling te a ruo kieca, a hmaa cakhawpa ta cuo te ama ca a pathe.
Cawsaa pakhakha ca a suo paw te a luv a tlaw, cuorasala ama ca a pathe.
A puo suo hne a naabe suo paw te a luv a tlaw, cuorasala a pathe.
Cuorasala a puo tlawpa lie hne a luv tlawpa cunglie a seviyvaapa hne a ruoviyvaapa a phaanapa a aw kieca a puo tlawpa hne a luv tlawpa lie a awpa caahminghmaa pasana ta a cuo.
Tluobyipa ta mangpasie'a te, a puo tlawpa hne a luv tlawpa lie a awpa a hmaa ca caahminghmaa pasana lu te, thling te a seviyvaapa hne a ruoviyvaapa ta a cuo kieca,
ama ca caahminghmaa a phyapa tana a cuo, pathe vyi. Tluobyipa ta pathe vyi ta pata a pathyi sa aa; a luv cungliena pasana a aw.
Caahminghmaa pasana a hnyipa cawsaa ca caw tlaapa kha a tue aa; a suo kha aa thuvkaraw pata chi'a te, a cung luo a hmya kha a pahruv'a te, “Pathe va ang, pathe va ang,” ta pata a khi aa.
Pasana a hnyi chung bangkhuo ca a pathe li pata a cuo aa; ama ca pathe vyi. Ama dyi ta aw'a te, a awna hmang ca khyle luo ta a cuo aa.
Caw hne aa patuv pata: tuvhming ta acuolikie palaa ta taapa cawthang phapa,
palaa acuolikie tuvhming ta ama taapa hne ama siypa, savang acuolikie savang ta ama tuepa khaapa hmang a cuo zaw,
taapa acuolikie siypa caw lie cuose, savang lie hne savang ta ama tuepa lie cuose, pasanapa ca a hringpuo pata cuose, a sepuo pata cuose aa luo kieca tluobyipa'a luo kha pahmung riypata a cuo aa.
Tluobyipa ta pasana aa luonapa hmang ca mangpasie'a te ning sariy chung a phasa pata a chi aa.

Ning sariyna lie kha pasana ca a mangpasie aa. Pasana ca taapa acuolikie siypa caw lie hne savang acuolikie savang ta tuepa lie kha a cakule kieca capa ca caahminghmaa pasana ta cuo te, a pathe lipa a cuo.

Pasana ca tuvhming ta taapa acuolikie siypa caw, palaa ta taapa acuolikie siypa caw, savang hne savang ta tuepa lie kha a aw kieca capa ca myi ta a rue aa, tahematapakieca capa ca caahminghmaa pasana ta a cuo; myi ta rue riypa tana a cuo.
Tluobyi ta mangpasie te pasana ca taapa hne siypa caw lie acuolikie savang ta tuepa suokhakha lie kha a cakule li kieca,
tluobyi ta pasana aa luonapa caw ca pasuv sa'a yi te, ning sariy chung a phasa pata a chi pathlyi aa.

Pasana aa luonapa caw ca ama pasuv khutaata tluobyi ta a mangpasie aa. Pasana a awnapa a phaapa lie kha pasana ca a cakule li raalaa pata a hmingciy aa thle li kieca, pathe vyi; caahminghmaa pasana a phaapa ca achungluo a cuo zaw aleluo a cuo zaw, myi ta nama rue aa.
Tluobyi ta mangpasie te pasana ca ama pasuvpuo khutaata a vie viele kieca, taapa acuolikie siypa acuolikie savang ta tuepa caw kha pasana a awnapa a phaapa lie kha a thlaapuo aa.
Taapa acuolikie siypa hne savang ta tuepa caw lie kha pasana ca aa luo pakhaa kieca pasana aa luonapa caw kha myi ta nama rue aa.
Cuorasala taapa acuolikie siypa acuolikie savang ta tuepa caw lie kha nama pasuv khutaata pasana kha a vie kieca a yihningnapa pasuv pakhaa ung la capa ca a pathepa ta a cuo aa.
Capa ca tuvhming acuolikie palaa ta tuepa caw, taapa acuolikie siypa, acuolikie savang ta tuepa caw lie caahminghmaa pasana hne aa patuv pata a pathe a pathe li biechina riypa ziyphung ta a cuo.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Hingpa hing caahminghmaa pasana a hnyipa aa pathe ningta a ziy riypa phung ta a cuo aa a ta. Ama ca tluobyi'a luo cakuokhyi pata a cuo aa;
tluobyi ca arina hmang taa khata pya'a te a mangpasie aa. Caahminghmaa ta a pasapa ca a tluo kieca,
tluobyi ta a hringpa pavaa pathepa sahning, sidar thing, palaa sepa hne hissop nge kha pathe sa riypa cawsaa cuo ca ta vya cyi riypata bie a pi'a yi.
Tluobyi ca ta pavaa sakha kha alyi bi chunglie ama chipa tiy pathepa cunglie kha thie riypata bie a pi'a yi.
A hringpa pavaa hne sidar thing hne palaa sepa hne hissop nge kha la'a te, capa tie hne pavaa hringpa kha tiy pathepa cunglie thiepa pavaa thiy lie kha a naw aa.
Caahminghmaa pasana taata pathe sa riypa cawsaa kha yi sariy hi'a te, a pathe ta pata pathyi sa'a te a hringpa pavaa kha luruopa luo a pathlie aa.

Pathe sa riypa cawsaa ca a caw kha pasuv'a te, a luv kha aa pamyi aa. Tiy ta a siy'a te ama ca a pathe aa. Cakhutaa cata arina hmang luo kha a vaw'a te, cuorasala a thluodaa le lie kha ning sariy a aw aa.
A ning sariynapa lie kha a luv aa pamyi aa; a suo, a hmyahming, a mingtluo hming; a hming bangkhuo kha aa ngu aa. Cakhutaata a caw kha pasuv'a te, a pangpa kha tiy lie a siy'a te a pathe aa.

A kung carinapa lie kha kung kha a tapa a dutlapa tuvtungpa sahning hne tuvlaanung sakha, sa ta panaana riypata chiytiy hne pyapa jungsacuo viedie ephah che hraa che thung, hne chiytiy thyi kha kha a la aa.
A pathesatuv tluobyi ca ta pathesapa cawsaa hne capa hmang zaw ca atawna thluodaa luo a ngienapa, Abyipahmiekunglie kha a chi aa.
Tluobyi ca ta tuv sakha kha la'a te, chiytiy thyi kha hne khata sue a ngiethe panaana pihluo'a te, Abyipahmiekunglie kha calang'a te calangpa panaana a pihluo aa.

Tuvtaata ca sue pathe sa panaana hne myirue panaana sahring ama thienapa hmang pathepa lie kha a thie aa; tahematapakieca sue a ngiethe panaana ca sue pathe sa panaana haata tluobyi cuvu ta cuo te a pathe cepa tana a cuo.
Tluobyi ta sue a ngiethe panaana thiy chekha kha la'a te pathe sapa cawsaa a cacuoluo naakue daw lie cuose, a cacuoluo kuvpuv lie hne a cacuoluo phyipuv daw lie kha a hnie aa.
Cakhutaata tluobyi ca ta chiytiy chekha zaw kha la'a te, a cavyiluo kuvpazaa lie kha a bya aa.
A cacuoluo kuvdaw kha a cavyiluo kuvpazaa lie a awpa chiytiy luo ca naw'a te, a kuvdaw ta Abyipahmiekunglie kha yi sariy a hi aa.
Tluobyi ca ta a kuvpazaa lie aa ngaa kalie pa chiytiy chekha kha pathe sa riypa a cacuoluo naakue daw lie cuose, a cacuoluo kuvpuv lie hne a cacuoluo phyipuv lie kha a hnie aa.

Tluobyi ca ta a kuvpazaa chunglie aa ngaa kaliepa chiytiy ca pathe sapa cawsaa a luv lie kha a thuv aa. Cakhutaa cata tluobyi ca ta Abyipahmiekunglie kha pathe sapa cuota sue angiethena kha a hiepa aa.
Pathe sapa cawsaa kha a pathe lina taata a pathe riypata tluobyi ta sue pathe sa panaana kha a pihluo aa. Cakhutaata myirue panaana sahring kha thie'a te,
tluobyi ca ta bienatluophie cunglie ca myirue panaana hne sa ta panaana kha a pihluo aa. Tluobyi ta pathe sapa cawsaa cuo ca ta sue angiethena kha hiepa'a te ama ca a pathe aa.

Cuorasala ama ca a siypasa te capa zaa ca a patling khu li kieca, ama cuota sue angiethena hie thena riypata; calangpa panaana ta pihluo riypata sue a ngiethe panaana cuota tuvtaata sakha, sa ta panaana pihluo riypata chiytiy hne pyapa a pha cepa jungsacuo viedie ephah che hraa che kha, hne chiytiy thyi kha;
ama ta a tue khu thathiypa thuvruv sahning acuolikie valale sahning kha a vya cyi aa; sakha ca sue pathe sa panaana cuota cuo'a te sakha ca sue a ngiethe panaana cuota a cuo aa.
A ning carina lie kha ama pathe sa riypata capa zaw ca Abyipahmiekung, atawna thluodaa luo angiena lie, tluobyi'a luo kha a vya cyi aa.
Tluobyi ca ta sue a ngiethe panaana tuvtaata hne chiytiy kha la'a te, Abyipahmiekunglie kha calang'a te calangpa panaana kha a pihluo aa.

Tluobyi ta sue a ngiethe panaana tuvtaata ca thie'a te, a thiy chekha kha la'a te, pathe sapa cawsaa a cacuoluo naakue daw lie cuose, a cacuoluo kuvpuv lie hne a cacuoluo phyipuv daw lie kha a hnie aa.
A cacuoluo kuvdaw kha a cavyiluo kuvpazaa lie a awpa chiytiy luo ca naw'a te,
a kuvdaw ta Abyipahmiekunglie kha yi sariy a hi aa.

Tluobyi ca ta sue a ngiethe panaana pihluopa thiy ama china hmang lie kha a kuvpazaa lie chiytiy chekha kha pathe sa riypa a cacuoluo naakue daw lie cuose, a cacuoluo kuvpuv lie hne a cacuoluo phyipuv lie kha a hnie aa.
Abyipahmiekunglie kha pathe sapa cuota sue angiethena hie riypata a kuvpazaa chunglie aa ngaa kaliepa chiytiy ca pathe sapa cawsaa a luv lie kha a thuv aa.
Cakhutaa cata pathe sapa cawsaa ta a tue khu thathiypa thuvruv acuolikie valale kha a pihluo aa;

sakha kha sue pathe sa panaana, hne sakha kha myirue panaana ta, sa ta panaana hne khata a pihluo pakhaw aa. Cakhutaata tluobyi ca ta pathesapa cawsaa cuo khata Abyipahmiekunglie kha sue angiethena a hiepa aa.
Hingpa hing caahminghmaa pasana hnyi te ama pathe sa riypata a patling khu lipa cuota ziyphung ta a cuo.
Abyipata Moses hne Aaron kyihuo khata hing haa hingta a ta yi:
Niema cu riypata ica pipa yi Kanaan ruo chung luo namaa ngie tiyta, nama cupa ruo chunglie, ing chunglie kha caahminghmaa pasana i chi kieca,
ing a hnyituv ta tluobyi'a luo a vaw'a te, “I ing chunglie hing pasana phangkhakha a awpa na a lu,” a vya ta aa.

Ing chunglie a awpa chechiy bangkhuo ca pathe vyi ta pata a cuo li riypata tluobyi ta pasana a va mangpasie hluo khata ing kha pahri riypata bie a pi'a yi; cakhutaa cata tluobyi ca ing kha mangpasie riypata a vaa aa.
Pasana ca mangpasie'a te, ing tlepie lie kha a hringpuopa acuolikie a sepuopa a phaapa ta a aw kie cuose, a hrang lie laata aa thuv vie kieca,
tluobyi ca ingchiypakaa taa khata pya'a te ing ca ning sariy chung khaa pata a cuo aa.
Tluobyi ca a ning sariynapa lie a vaw pakhaa'a te a mangpasie aa. Pasana ca ing tlepie lie kha a cakule kieca,
tluobyi ca ta pasana aa luonapa alung ca la pathla pata khypuv le luo a pathe lina hmang luo kha thaw riypata bie a pi'a yi.
Ing chung tlepie ca a phasa pata pahue sa diy'a yi te, ama hue pathlanapa palastaa zungpa ca khypuv le luo a pathe lipa hmang luo kha a palyi sa'a yi.
Alung hrangpa kha la'a yi te ama la pathlapa alung hmang lie kha ama ne aa. Tlepie ca palastaa thaapa be'a yi te ama pame pakhaa aa.
Alung kha lapathla yi te, tlepie kha hue diy yi te palastaa ama be diy khutaata capa ing lie ca pasana kha aa luo pakhaa kieca,
tluobyi ta vaa'a te ava mangpasie aa; pasana ca ing chunglie kha a cakule kieca, capa ca ing chunglieta a cakulepa caahminghmaa pasana a aw ta pata a cuo; capa ing ca pathe vyi.
Ing ca phi pata cuo'a te, alung hne thing hne palastaa bangkhuo kha khy le luo hmang pathe lipa lie kha va thaw pata a cuo aa.
Ing ama khaa chung ta a chung luo a ngiepa bangkhuo ca zuoluo te a pathe lipa ta ama cuo aa.
Ing chunglie a ziepa bangkhuo hne ing chunglie sa a ningpa bangkhuo ta ama caw kha ama pasuv aa.
Ing kha palastaa ama be diy khutaata tluobyi a vaw te a vya mangpasie tiyta, pasana kha ing chunglie a cakule li kieca, tluobyi ta ing ca a pathe ta pata a pathyi sa aa; pasana ca a tluo tli.
Ing pathena riypata pavaa sahning, sidar thing hne palaa sepa hne hissop kha la'a te,
pavaa sakha kha tiy pathepa ama rawnapa alyi bi cunglie kha a thie aa.
Cakhutaa cata sidar thing hne hissop hne palaa sepa kha a hringpa pavaa hne khata la'a te, capa tie ca a thiepa pavaa thiy lie hne tiy pathepa chunglie kha naw'a te ing kha yi sariy a hi aa.
Cahaacata ing ca pavaa thiy hne tiy pathepa, hne pavaa hringpa, hne sidar thing, hne hissop hne palaa sepa ta a pathe sa aa.
Cakhutaata a hringpa pavaa ca khy chung taa khata luruopa luo a pathlie aa. Cahaacata ing cuo khata sue angiethena hie'a te, ing ca a pathe aa.
Hingpa hing tuokhaapa caahminghmaa pasana cuota a cuo zaw ziy riypa ziyphung ta a cuo: retha,
caw hne ing lie a kaapa caahminghmaa pasana,
a thlingpa acuolikie hmaa a phaapa ta a awpa zaw cuota
a pathe a pathe li biechina cuota a cuo. Hingpa hing caahminghmaa pasana cuota ziyphung ta a cuo.
Abyipata Moses hne Aaron kyihuo khata:
Israel ming ca hing haa hingta chang tie ung a ta: Capaa pakhakha ca a huopa taata atiy a pya kieca capa nakaw ca ta ama ca pathe vyi.
Atiy ca a pya byalya a cuo zaw, aa pahy caw a cuo zaw, a cuota pathe lina tana a cuo.
Capa paa aa zienapa iehmang ca pathe vyi; aa tunapa khaapa hmang a cuo zaw pathe vyi.
A iehmang a dekhupa ahung a cuo zaw a caw kha pasuv'a te tiy aa siy aa; zuoluo te ta a pathe lipa ta a cuo aa.
A huopa taata atiy a pyapa paa aa tunapa lie a tupa bangkhuo ca ama caw kha pasuv'a yi te, tiy amaa siy aa; zuoluo te ta a pathe lipa ta ama cuo aa.
A huopa taata atiy a pyapa paa a pangpa a dekhupa bangkhuo ca ama caw kha pasuv'a yi te, tiy amaa siy aa; zuoluo te ta a pathe lipa ta ama cuo aa.
A huopa taata atiy a pyapa paa ta cawsaa pakhakha kha a paciy ta a pacha kieca, a caw kha pasuv'a te tiy aa siy aa; zuoluo te ta a pathe lipa ta a cuo aa.
A huopa taata atiy a pyapa paa aa tunapa kedie ca pathe vyi.

Ama rawlie a awpa chechiy suokhakha a dekhupa bangkhuo ca zuoluo te ta a pathe lipa ta ama cuo aa; cahaapaapa hmang a phyapa bangkhuo ca ama caw kha pasuv'a yi te tiy amaa siy aa; zuoluo te ta a pathe lipa ama cuo aa.
A huopa taata atiy a pyapa paa ta tiy ta a kuv a siy li pata a taw pathlyipa bangkhuo ca ama caw kha pasuv'a yi te tiy amaa siy aa; zuoluo te ta a pathe lipa ama cuo aa.
A huopa taata atiy a pyapa paa ta a tawpa khaapa alyi bi a cuo zaw dechi pata a cuo aa; thing bi a cuo kieca tiy ta pasiy pata a cuo aa.

A huopa taata atiy a pyapa paa ca a pasanapa taa cata pathe sapa a cuo tiyta, a pathena riypata ning sariy huo'a te, tiy pathepa lieta a caw kha pasuv'a te tiy aa siy aa; cakhutaa cata ama ca a pathepa ta a cuo aa.
A ning carina lieta thuvruv sahning acuolikie valale sahning kha Abyipahmiekunglie, atawna thluodaa luo a ngienapa luo kha vya cyi'a te, tluobyi kha a pi aa.
Tluobyi ta sakha kha sue pathe sa panaana, hne sakha kha myirue panaana ta a pihluo aa. Cakhutaata tluobyi ta atiy a pyapa paa cuo ca ta Abyipahmiekunglie kha arena a hie aa.
Capaa pakha ca a ciytiy a pya kieca a pangpa bangkhuo kha tiy ta aa siy aa, zuoluo te a pathe lipa ta a cuo aa.
A ciytiy ta a tlasuepa palaa ta tuepa hne savang ta tuepa chechiy suokhakha ca tiy ta pasuvpa cuo'a te, zuoluo te ta a pathe lipa a cuo aa.
Capaa ta canung kha a ziekhyi te a ciytiy a pya kieca ama pahning ta tiy amaa siy aa, zuoluo te ta a pathe lipa ama cuo aa.
Canung pakha ta canung phung a pachang kieca ning sariy chung a pathe lipa a cuo aa. Ama a dekhupa ahunghmuo zuoluo te ta a pathe lipa a cuo aa.
Canung phung a pachang chungta aa zienapa khaapa hmang a cuo zaw a pathe lipa cuo'a te, ama ta aa tusuepa khaapa hmang a cuo zaw a pathe lipa a cuo aa.
A iehmang a dekhupa ca a caw kha pasuv'a te tiy aa siy aa, zuoluo te ta a pathe lipa a cuo aa.
Ama ta aa tusuepa khaapa chechiy a cuo zaw a dekhupa ca a caw kha pasuv'a te tiy aa siy aa, zuoluo te ta a pathe lipa ta a cuo aa.
Iehmang a cuo zaw, ama ta aa tusuepa khaapa chechiy a cuo zaw a dekhupa ca zuoluo te ta a pathe lipa a cuo aa.
Capaa pakhakha ta ama ca a ziekhyi te, a canung phung thiy ta aa hlaw kieca ama ca ning sariy chung a pathe lipa ta a cuo aa; ama aa zienapa iehmang zaw a pathe lipa a cuo aa.

Canung pakha ca a canung phung pachang cuo a cuo li pata ning hluvpuv a thiy a lang kie cuose, a canungphung pachang cuo a lawna te ta a thiy a lang kie cuose, a thiy lang cuo bangkhuo kha aa pazue pata a pathe lipa ta a cuo aa; a canung phung cuo lie haa khata a pathe lipa ta a cuo aa.

A thiy a lang cuo ning bangkhuo ta aa zienapa iehmang ca canung phung a pachang ningta aa zienapa iehmang haata ruepa ta a cuo aa. Ama ta aa tusuepa bangkhuo zaw, canung phung a pachang cuo ning haa khata a pathe lipa tana a cuo aa.
Capa chechiy zaw a tawpa ahunghmuo a pathe lipa ta a cuo aa, a caw kha pasuv'a te tiy aa siy aa, zuoluo te ta a pathe lipa ta a cuo aa.
A thiy langnapa taata pathe sapa a cuo kieca ning sariy chung huo'a te, cakhutaa cata ama ca a pathepa ta a cuo aa.
A ning carina lieta thuvruv sahning acuolikie valale sahning kha atawna thluodaa luo a ngienapa luo tluobyi'a luo kha a vya cyi aa.
Tluobyi ta sakha kha sue pathe sa panaana hne a hrangpa sakha kha myirue panaana ta a pihluo aa. Tluobyi ta capa nung cuo ca ta, thiy lang pathe lina cuo khata Abyipahmiekunglie kha arena a hiepa aa.
Cahaacata Israel ming ca ama hrawlie a awpa kama bienathluodaa kha papyapalyi yi te ama pathe lina chunglie kha ama thiy li riypata a pathe lipa tie kha pache'a yi cate na chi pathlyi'a yi.
Hingpa hing a pangpa chungtaata a pathe lipa a pyapa tie cuota ziyphung ta a cuo: A huopa taata atiy pya te a ciytiy a pya nakawta a pathe lipa capaa tie,

canung phung a pachang nakawta a pathe lipa canung tie, ahung a cuo zaw, capaa acuolikie canung, a huopa taata atiy a pyapa hne a thiy a langpa, a pathe lipa canung a ziekhyipa capaa zaw cuota ziyphung ta a cuo.
Aaron sacapaa pahning zaw Abyipahmiekung luo kha vaa ngie yi te ama thiy khutaata Abyipata Moses kha bie a chang.

Abyipata Moses kha hing haa hingta a chang: Na uvta Aaron kha pangzu zukhuopa hmangpathepa chung nawbie thingkaw pahruv hmieluo kha na khing thiy ta a vaw'a vaciy ta pata chang tie, acuolikie ca a thiy aa; tahematapakieca nawbie thingkaw pahruv cung amyi lie khana i luo aa.
Aaron ca hmang pathepa luo kha aa vaw kieca: sue pathe sa panaana cuota cue atungnupa sakha hne myirue panaana cuota tuvtungpa sakha hne khata a vaw se.

Palaa ta taapa cawthang phapa ta ama tuepa buohryi rawpatlung pathepa kha a hryi'a te palaa ta taapa cawthang phapa ta biepa tawhryi rawpatlung kha aa hryi aa, palaa ta taapa tesaw kha a saw'a te palaa ta taapa pawde kha aa paw aa; hingpa tie hing tluobyi caw ta ama cuo. A pangpa kha tiy ta a siy'a te capa tie ca aa hryi aa.
Israel ming cawsaazaapuv taa khata mietungpa sahning kha sue pathe sa panaana cuota la'a te, tuvtungpa sakha kha myirue panaana cuota a la aa.
Aaron ca cuetungpa kha ama cuota sue pathe sa panaana ta a pihluo aa. Ama cuo hne a chungkhue cuo khata sue angiethena kha a hie aa.
Mie sahning kha la'a te Abyipahmiekung atawna thluodaa luo a ngienapa lie kha a chi aa.
Aaron ta mie sahning kha vyisung ta a da'a te, vyisung suokha ca Abyipacuota cuo'a te, a hrangpa vyisung suokha ca Azazel cuota a cuo aa.
Aaron ta Abyipacuota vyisung a tlanapa mie ca vya cyi'a te sue pathe sa panaana ta a pihluo aa.
Cuorasala Azazel cuota vyisung a tlanapa mie kha a cunglie arena hiena riypata Abyipahmiekung luo vya cyi'a te, capa ca Azazel cuo khata ruocaapa luo pathlie pata a cuo aa.
Aaron ta cuetungpa kha ama cuota sue pathe sa panaana ta pihluo'a te, ama hne a chungkhue cuota sue angiethena a hie aa. Ama cuota cuetungpa kha sue a ngiethe panaana ta a pihluo aa.
Abyipahmiekung bienatluophie taa khata myihyi sekhalapa daa pakaa zungkha hne a diykariy pata ama riepa ziyhmyi rangpa-ue pazaa zung hning kha pangzu zukhuopa chung luo kha aa ngiekhyi aa.
Ziyhmyi rangpa-ue ca Abyipahmiekung myi chung luo kha thung'a te, rangpa-ue khuv ca ta nawbie thingkaw pahruv kha aa zesue aa, caacuolikieca a thiy aa.
Cuetungpa thiy chekha kha la'a te, a kuvdaw khata nawbie thingkaw pahruv a hmieluo kuo kha a hi aa, cakhutaa cata nawbie thingkaw pahruv a hmiekunglie kha a kuvdaw ta yi sariy a hi aa.

Cawsaa zaw cuota sue pathe sa panaana mie kha thie'a te a thiy kha pangzu zukhuona chung luo a ngiekhyi'a te, cuetungpa thiy a tuepa haa khata a tue aa. Nawbie thingkaw pahruv cunglie hne a hmiekunglie kha a hi aa.

Cahaacata Israel ming ama tuesuena kawlie hne ama suena bangkhuo kawlieta hmangpathepa cuota sue angiethena kha a hie aa. Cahaa ngiethie cata iema pathe lina chunglieta iema hne a aw paripa atawna thluodaa cuo khata a tue aa.

Aaron ca atawna thluodaa chung luo kha a ngie te, ama cuo, a chungkhue cuo hne Israel ming bangkhuo cuota hmangpathepa lie sue angiethena a hie khutaata a kya pya pakhaana te ta atawna thluodaa chunglie kha ahunghmuo aw'a va yi.

Cakhutaata Abyipahmiekunglie a awpa bienatluophie luo ca pya'a te capa cuo ca ta sue angiethena a hie aa. Cuetungpa thiy chekha hne mie thiy chekha kha la'a te bienatluophie thingpazue tie kha a hnie diy aa.
Capa zaw cunglie ca thiy chekha kha a kuvdaw ta yi sariy hi'a te, Israel ming pathe lina chung taa khata a pathe sa aa.
Hmang pathepa hne atawna thluodaa hne bienatluophie cuota sue angiethena a hie khutaata a hringpa mie kha a pihluo aa.

Cakhutaata Aaron ta a kuv hra hning kha mie luv cunglie ca khang'a te, Israel ming pha lina bangkhuo, tuesuena bangkhuo hne suena bangkhuo kha phu diy'a te, mie luv cunglie a chi diy khutaata a ting ciepa ta a awpa pakha ta ruocaapa luo kha a pathlie aa.
Mie ca ta ama suenapa bangkhuo ca phya'a te ruocaapa luo ca a sikhyi aa; mie ca ruocaapa luo pathlie pata a cuo aa.
Cakhutaa cata Aaron ca atawna thluodaa chung luo kha a ngie'a te, hmang pathepa luo aa ngie ningta aa hryipa cawthang phapa ta biepa tluobyi caw tie kha a thlie aa.

Hmang pathepa lie kha tiy ta a nge a siy'a te, a tluobyi caw kha a hryi'a te a kya pya aa. Ama cuota myirue panaana hne cawsaa zaw cuota myirue panaana kha pihluo'a te, ama cuo hne cawsaa zaw cuota sue angiethena kha a hie aa.
Sue pathe sa panaana saa a thupa kha bienatluophie lie kha myi ta a rue aa.
Azazel cuota mie vaa pathliepa ca tiy ta a caw pasuv'a te a nge aa siy khutaata arina hmang luo kha aa ngie aa.

Sue pathe sa panaana cuetungpa hne sue pathe sa panaana mie, hmang pathepa lie sue angiethe hiena ta hmang pathepa luo a thiy ama vya cyipa tie kha arina hmang luo ama pyakhyi aa; ama vang hne ama saa hne ama i kha myi ta ruepa a cuo aa.
Capa tie a ruepa ca tiy ta a caw pasuv'a te a nge aa siy khutaata arina hmang luo kha aa ngie aa.

Capa ca chuozaa ta nama ziy riypa phungluo ta a cuo aa. Thla sariynapa ning hraanapa lie ca Israel ming nama cuo zaw, niema hrawlie a awpa ruohrang ming ama cuo zaw sa a uv'a ung cate re hrie'a va ung ciy.
Tahematapakieca capa ning lie ca niema kha pathe sa riypata niema cuota arena tuepa a cuo aa; Abyipahmiekunglie kha nama suena bangkhuo taata nama pathe aa.
Niema cuota namaa pahy karue riypa sabbath ning ta cuo'a te sa namaa uv aa; hingpa hing niema cuota chuozaa ta phungluo tana a cuo.
A paa re a thle riypata sathu pathuvpa hne pathe sapa tluobyi ta palaa ta taapa cawthang phapa ta biepa tluobyi caw tie, tluobyi caw pathepa tie kha a hryi'a te sue angiethena kha a hie aa.
Ama ta hmangpathepa cuota sue angiethena a hie aa, atawna thluodaa cuo hne bienatluophie cuota sue angiethena a hie aa, tluobyi tie cuo hne aa hmyapa cawsaa bangkhuo cuota sue angiethena a hie aa.
Capa ca Israel ming ama suena bangkhuo cuota kung kha luo kha arena nama hie na riypa, niema cuota chuozaa ta phungluo a cuo aa. Cakhutaata Abyipata bie a pina haata Moses ta a tue.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata hing haa hingta a chang:
Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw hne Israel ming bangkhuo kha, ‘Hingpa hing Abyipabiepipa tana a cuo,’ ta pata chang tie yi.
Israel chungkhue ming pakhakha ta cuetungpa cuose, tuvtaata cuose, mie cuose arina chunglie acuolikie arina le lie kha thie te,

Abyipabienathluodaa hmiekung atawna thluodaa angiena Abyipa'a luo kha panaana pihluo riypata a chiykhyi li kieca, capa paa ca thiyse palang suena a cunglie khangpa a cuo aa; ama ca thiyse kha a palang tli, cawsaa zaw hrawtaata thawpa a cuo aa.

Hingpa hing Israel ming ta khyle lie hriykhungrina ta ama pihluopa kha Abyipa'a luo, atawna thluodaa luo angiena lie a awpa tluobyi'a luo ama vya cyi thena riypa hne Abyipa'a luo kha aviesaa panaana ta ama pihluo thena riypata a cuo.
Tluobyi ta atawna thluodaa luo angiena lie Abyipabienatluophie kha thiy ca ta hi'a te, a thupa ca Abyipa'a luo kha rangpa-ue pakhuv riypata myi lie a rue aa.

Caacuonakawta iema hne iema siyhrawnung ama za cuopuonapa mie-khachie'a luo kha hriykhungrina ama pi li tli riypata a cuo. Hingpa hing ama chuo chung bangkhuo chuozaa ta ama ziy riypa phungluo ta a cuo aa.
Cakhutaata Israel chungkhue cawsaa pakhakha acuolikie iema hrawlie a awpa ruohrang ming pakhakha ta myirue panaana acuolikie hriykhungrina a tue pata,
Abyipa'a luo pihluo riypata atawna thluodaa angiena luo kha a vya cyi li kieca a cawsaa zaw'a taata thawpa a cuo aa.

Israel chungkhue cawsaa pakhakha acuolikie iema hrawlie a awpa ruohrang ming pakhakha ta khaapa thiy hmuo cuose a ning kieca, capa thiyse a ningpa ca minghmie pha pi li'apa angta, a cawsaa zaw'a taata i thaw aa.

Tahematapakieca saapa hringna ca thiyse chungliena a aw. Capa ca nama hringna cuota bienatluophie lie sue angiethena hiena riypata ica pipa yi tana a cuo. Tahematapakieca, hringna haata, thiyse ca sue angiethena a tuepa tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta kama ta Israel ming kha: Niema hrawtaata ahungtahmuo thiyse ning'a vyi, niema hrawlie khy a sapa ruohrang ming ahungtahmuo thiyse ning'a vyi, i ta.

Cakhutaata Israel ming ahung a cuo zaw, acuolikie niema hrawlie a awpa ruohrang ming ahung a cuo zaw ning thepa saruopa acuolikie pavaa a patuv kieca a thiy kha palang'a te alyi diypa a buvkhung siy aa.

Tahematapakieca a hringpa bangkhuo ama thiy ca ama hringna tana a cuo. Caacuonakawta kama ta Israel ming kha: Tuokhaapa saa thiy hmuo ning'a va ung ciy i ta yi, tahematapakieca a hringpa bangkhuo ama hringna ca thiy tana a cuo; a ningpa ahunghmuo thaw pata a cuo aa.

Ama thiy ta a thiypa, acuolikie saa ta a siepa saa a ningpa cawsaa bangkhuo, Israel ming acuolikie ruohrang ming ca, ama caw kha pasuv'a yi te tiy amaa siy aa, zuoluo te ta a pathe lipa ama cuo aa; cakhutaa cata ama pathe aa.
Cuorasala ama caw kha pasuv li pata ama pangpa kha tiy amaa siy li kieca ama suenapa ca iema na a ang'a yi.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Israel ming kha hing haa hingta chang tie yi: Kama ca Abyipanama Khazing tana i cuo.
Niema ca nama za awnapa Izipt ming haa khata aw'a va ung ciy. Niema ica sikhyina riypa yi Kanaan ming haata zaw aw'a va ung ciy. Iema phungluo kha ziy'a va ung ciy.
Kama ica pipa yi ziyphung hne phungluo khana nama ziy aa: Kama ca Abyipanama Khazing tana i cuo.
Niema ca kama phungluo hne ziyphung khana nama ziy aa; cahaacata nama tue kiena nama hring aa: Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo.
Nama tieriy pakhakha hneta canungcapaa thiysaa anuona tue'a va ung ciy. Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo.
Na nung hneta canung capaa anuona na tue nakawta na paa nang pazaa khah. Ama ca na nung ta cuo te, ama hneta canung capaa anuona tue'a vaciy.
Na paa napuvnung hneta canung capaa anuona na tue nakawta na paa nang pazaa khah.
Na sietanung hneta canung capaa anuona tue'a vaciy, na paa sacanung a cuo zaw, na nung sacanung a cuo zaw, ing chunglie a puvpa a cuo zaw, a hrang lie a puvpa a cuo zaw.
Na sacapaa sacanung acuolikie na sacanung sacanung hneta canung capaa anuona tue'a vaciy. Na nangzaa hmiechina tana a cuo aa.
Na paa napuvnung sacanung hneta canung capaa anuona tue'a vaciy, na sietanung tana a cuo ra.
Na paa sietanung hneta canung capaa anuona tue'a vaciy, ama ca na paa hne thiysaa aa ngieta tana a cuo.
Na nung nutanung hneta canung capaa anuona tue'a vaciy, ama ca na nung hne thiysaa aa ngieta tana a cuo.
Na paa uvnu hneta canung capaa anuona tue'a vaciy, capa ca a napuvnung kha suekhyi khingna hneta a ngie'a vaciy tanapa tana a cuo, ama ca na nung tana a cuo.
Na sacapaa napuv hneta canung capaa anuona tue'a vaciy; ama ca na sacapaa napuv tana a cuo; ama hneta canung capaa anuona tue'a vaciy.
Na uvnu napuv hneta canung capaa anuona tue'a vaciy; ama ca na uvnu huopa tana a cuo.

Canung hne capaa anuona na tuekhyipanung a sacanung hneta canung capaa anuona tue'a vaciy, a sacapaa sacanung acuolikie a sacanung sacanung hneta canung capaa anuona tue'a vaciy. Iema ca nama thiysaa tana ama cuo; pha li suesaanapa tana a cuo.
Na napuv uvnu kha na napuv a hring chung ta napuv ta lapuo pata ama hneta canung capaa anuona tue'a vaciy.
Canung pakha kha canung phungpa pachang te a pathe lina cuo lieta ama hneta canung capaa anuona tue'a vaciy.
Na tieriy napuv hneta canung capaa anuona tue pata nama hne nama kha a papya a palyi'a vaciy.
Molek'a luo hriykhung arina riypata na saata zaw kha pi'a va yi ciy. Na Khazing ming kha cahaacata papyapalyi'a vaciy: Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo.
Canung hne a ziehnepa haata capaa hneta a ziehne'a vaciy. Capa ca duvsamakhie aa chiypa tana a cuo.
Tuokhaapa saruopa hneta hmuo suena tue pata nama hne nama kha a papya a palyi khah. Ahung canung tahmuo saruopa hne suehne riypata a pi khah se; a cuo byi lipa tana a cuo.
Niema hne niema kha cahaapaapa hmang cata a papya a palyi khah ung, tahematapakieca niema hluota i cadepa tie ca hing haapa hmang hing tana iema hne iema kha amaa papya amaa palyi.
Cahaacata ruo ca pyalyi te, a pha lina kawlie duo i te nakawta a chunglie khy a sapa tie kha alyi ta a paliy yi.
Cuorasala niema ca i phungluo hne i ziyphung kha ziy ung la, Israel ming nama cuo zaw niema hrawlie khy a sapa ruohrang ming ama cuo zaw duvsamakhie aa chiypa kha tue khah ung.
(Tahematapakieca niema hluota hingpa ruo lie khy zaa sapa tie hingta duvsamakhie aa chiypa kha tue yi te na ruo hing a pyalyi);
cata acuolikieca ruo nama papyapalyi nakawta niema hluota khy zaa sapa tie a paliypa haa yi khata niema zaw aca paliy'a yi.
Tahematapakieca hing haapa duvsamakhiepa hmang a tuepa ahunghmuo ama mingphang taata thaw pata ama cuo aa.

Caacuonakawta niema hluota ama za tuepa tuokhaapa duvsamakhiepa hmang hmuo nama tue li riypata ica changpa yi hing ziy ung la niema hne niema kha a papya a palyi khah ung: Kama ca Abyipanama Khazing tana i cuo.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata hing haa hingta a chang:
Israel ming cawsaazaapuv kha chang tie yi: Niema ca nama pathe aa, tahematapakieca kama ca Abyipaa pathepa nama Khazing tana i cuo.
Cawsaa bangkhuo ta nama nung hne nama paa kha nama pa-uvsathyi aa. I sabbath ning zaw kha namaa uv aa. Kama ca Abyipanama Khazing tana i cuo.
Kuvtuezuv'a luo kha a pali khah ung, patlepa zuv kha nama cuota a tue'a va ung ciy. Kama ca Abyipanama Khazing tana i cuo.
Niema ta Abyipakha aviesaa panaana nama pihluo tiyta nama cuota cuhluo tluo aa tla pata pihluo tie ung.
Nama pihluo ningpa, acuolikie a mawluopa tana nama ning diy aa. Ning thungna te ta a aw kalie kieca myi ta nama rue diy aa.
A ning thungnapa ning tana nama ning diy ta pata a cuo kieca, capa ca duvsamakhiepa tana a cuo; cuhluo pata cuo'a vyi.
A ningpa bangkhuo ca duote pata ama cuo aa, tahematapakieca Abyipacuota a pathepa khana a papya a palyi. Cahaapa cawsa ahunghmuo cuo se a cawsaa zaw'a taata thaw pata a cuo aa.
Nama lu lie sa nama hrie tiyta, nama luriy te ta sa kha la diy'a va ung ciy. Samang zaw thang'a va ung ciy.
Nama mingsuv thyi kha lu diy karue'a va ung ciy, a zungpa zaw kha a haa'a va ung ciy. Siypasa tie hne ruohrang ming cuo tana nama pangaa buo aa: Kama ca Abyipanama Khazing tana i cuo.
Paruv'a va ung ciy. Hang'a va ung ciy. Pakha hne pakha a dung'a va ung ciy.
I ming ta hanghie pata chie a sa'a va ung ciy, capa ca nama Khazing ming nama papyapalyi pata na a cuo: Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo.
Na ingpaa kha ese'a vaciy. Paruv'a vaciy. Vie a hluepa thavie muo kha a mawluo maw te ta pi li pata aw'a vaciy.
A naa ruepa kha ese pata bie ri'a vaciy. A ming cuepa hmiekunglie aa pachiyna riypa chechiy chi'a vaciy. Nama Khazing kha nama ciy aa: Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo.
Aa hmuo lipa biechina tue'a vaciy; a siypasapa kha pahlyipale'a vaciy; a hnyirungpa hmie zaw mang'a vaciy. Adangna hneta na ingpaa tie bie kha ripa tie yi.
Malie kaw ri riypata na cawsaa zaw hrawlie kha a khie'a vaciy. Na ingpaa hringna kha para riypata a daa'a vaciy: Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo.
Na tieriy pakha hmuota na palung chunglie hue'a va yi ciy. A luohuo tana sue na phaw aa, caacuolikieca nama hne nama tlaku na naa pasue sa aa.
Na phang kha cawsaa ahung cunglie hmuo phuv la'a vaciy, hue'a va yi ciy. Cuorasala nama naa duepa haata na ingpaa kha va due tie: Kama ca Abyipa tana i cuo.
I phungluo hing na ziy aa. Na sahring kha sahring phanghrangpa hneta a paa pakie sa'a vaciy. Na lu lie saciy phang hning ta cyi'a vaciy. Palaa phanghning ta ama taapa caw kha a hryi'a vaciy.

Cawsaa pakha ta a hrangpa capaa pakha cuota pahaa ciepa, muo ama muo li liepa siicanung pakha kha canung capaa anuona a tuekhyi kieca alu taa pata a cuo aa. Iema ca thiepa cuo'a va yi, tahematapakieca a siicuona taata hya pazang sapa cuo valie.
Cuorasala Abyipa'a luo, atawna thluodaa a ngiena luo kha tuvtungpa sakha vya cyi'a te ama pangpa cuota sue a ngiethe panaana kha a pihluo aa.
Cakhutaata tluobyi ta sue a ngiethe panaana tuvtungpa khata Abyipahmiekunglie kha a tuesuepa a suena cuo khata sue angiethena hie pa'a te, a suena ca a ngiethe pata a cuo aa.
Kanaan ruo chung luo a ngie ung cate ning thepa thingkung namaa ling tiyta, a pathyi taanapa kung taata kung thung chung ca a pathe lipa ta rue'a ung cate a thyi kha ning'a va ung ciy.
A kung paliyna lieta a pathyipa a thyi bangkhuo ca palungtluona ta Abyipa'a luo nama pi aa.
Cuorasala a kung pangaana lie a pathyipa a thyi ca niema ta nama ning aa, cahaacata niema cuota a hluv vie hryly ta a pathyi aa: Kama ca Abyipanama Khazing tana i cuo.
Khaapa saa hmuo a thiy cangta ce'a va ung ciy. Kuvcaa mangpa cuose, ca-iepa cuose tue'a va ung ciy.
Nama sieliy suo kha a ngu’ va ung ciy, nama hmyahming daw zaw a te'a va ung ciy.
A thiypa kawlieta nama ngesaa kha a uo'a va ung ciy, nama ngesaa lie tuokhaapa aa hnangna hmuo daw pata cape'a va ung ciy: Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo.
Ruo kha siyhrawna ta a li'a te pha lina a bi li riypata na sacanung ca siyhrawnung ta tue pata papyapalyi khah.
I sabbath kha a uv'a ung cate i hmangpathepa ca nama pa-uvsathyi aa: Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo.
Apyipa hne khuevuo ta aa hryipa ta cuo khah ung, capa tie'a luo zaw ca a papya a palyi riypata cakuo khah ung: Kama ca Abyipanama Khazing tana i cuo.
Kung macuo tie hmiekunglie ca a daa'a cate na hmiezaa'a yi. Na Khazing kha na ciyzaa aa: Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo.
Nama ruo chunglie a awpa mingpepa kha hrisaa'a va ung ciy.

Niema'a luo caa vya pepa yi ruohrangpa ca niema hrawlie kha niema ruo ming haata cuo ra'a te, niema namaa duepa haa khata nama due aa, tahematapakieca niema zaw Izipt ruo lie kha ruohrang ming tana nama za cuo: Kama ca Abyipanama Khazing tana i cuo.
A syina taana lie cuose, aa riyna pathliena lie hne a hluv a caw patangna lie kha cawsaa dung'a va ung ciy.
Aa hmuopa cyipathliena, aa hmuopa cyilung, aa hmuopa ephah, hne aa hmuopa hin khana nama hmuo aa: Kama ca Izipt ruo taata caa vya pyakhyipa Abyipanama Khazing tana i cuo.
I phungluo bangkhuo hne i ziyphung bangkhuo ziy tie ung: Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo.
Khazing ta Moses kyihuo khata hing haa hingta a chang:

Israel ming kha chang vie tie yi: Israel ming pakhakha, acuolikie Israel ming hrawlie khy a sapa pakhakha ta a saata kha Molek'a luo a pihluo kieca thie pata a cuo aa; ruo chunglie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo ta alung ta vaa sapa a cuo aa.
Kama hrahring ta hnangchaw'a yi angte a cawsaa zaw'a taata thaw pata a cuo aa. Tahematapakieca ama saata kha Molek'a luo pihluo yi te, i hmangpathepa hne i ming pathepa kha ama papyapalyi.
Ama saata zaw Molek'a luo ama pihluopa kha hingpa ruo lie a awpa i cawsaa zaw hingta a hmung li hruo a cuo yi te, ama thie li kieca,
kama hrahring ta iema kha hnangchaw'a yi angta iema cuose, iema kha paziy yi te Molek'a lie siyhraw pata a awpa bangkhuo kha ama cawsaa zaw'a taata i thaw'a yi.
Apyipa hne khuevuo ta aa hryipa tie'a luo kha cakuo te ama hne ama a papya a palyipa ca hnangchaw'a yi angte ama cawsaa zaw'a taata i thaw'a yi.
Caacuonakawta niema hne niema kha a pathe ung la pathe tie ung; tahematapakieca Kama ca Abyipanama Khazing tana i cuo.
I phungluo kha ziy ung la tue tie ung; kama ca Abyipatana i cuo; kama na caa pathe yi ang.
A nung hne a paa sie a pipa bangkhuo ca thie pata ama cuo aa. A nung hne a paa kha chie a sa nakaw yi ta, iema thiyse na a cung luo a tlung.
Capaa pakha ta a ingpaa napuvnung hneta nungvaathingsuena ama tue kieca capaa hne canung hne thie pata ama cuo aa.
A paa napuvnung a ziehnepa ca a paa zuu a paluopa a cuo nakawta; ama pahning ta thiepa ama cuo aa; iema thiyse ca iema cungliena a tlung.
Capaa pakha ta a munung hne aa ziehne kieca ama pahning ta thie pata ama cuo aa, tue byi lipa ama tue nakawta iema thiyse ca iema cungliena a tlung.
Capaa pakha ta capaa kha canung haata aa ziehne kieca, ama pahning ta duvsamakhie aa chiypa suena ama tue nakawta iema ca thie pata ama cuo aa; iema thiyse ca iema cungliena a tlung.

Capaa pakha ta a napuvnung hne a nung hneta napuv ta a hnyi kie yi ca, capa ca hringzya chiepa a cuo nakawta nama hrawlie cahaapa hringzya chiepa a aw li tli riypata ama pathung ta myi ta ruesa pata ama cuo aa.
Capaa pakha ta saruopa hne anuona a tue kieca ama ca thiepa cuo'a te, saruopa zaw kha nama thie aa.
Canung pakha ta saruopa hne anuona a tue kieca canung hne saruopa hne khata nama thie aa; iema ca thie pata ama cuo aa, iema thiyse na iema cunglie a tlung.

Capaa pakha ta a sietanung, a paa sacanung acuolikie a nung sacanung kha napuv ta a chiy kieca, capa ca zuu paluo pata a cuo nakawta ama cawsaa zaw'a taata thawpa cuo'a yi te, capa paa ca duote pata a cuo aa.
Capaa pakha ta canung phungpa a pachang ningta canung pakha kha aa ziehne kieca iema pahning ca ama cawsaa zaw'a taata thaw pata ama cuo aa.
Na nung uvnu cuose, na paa sietanung cuose a ziehne'a va yi ciy, tahematapakieca thiysaa aa ngiesapa kha suehnena a cuo nakawta iema ca duote pata ama cuo aa.
Capaa pakha ta a paa uvnu napuv kha aa ziehne kieca, a paa uvnu nang a pazaapa ta a cuo nakawta iema ca duote pata ama cuo aa; saata hnyi li pata na ama thiy aa.
Capaa pakha ta a uvnu napuv kha aa la kieca, capa ca a pathe lipa tana a cuo; a uvnu nang a pazaapa ta a cuo nakawta saata sa'a va yi.
Niema ca i phungluo hne i ziyphung kha ziy'a ung cate nama tue aa, cakiedyina khy nama sana riypata icaa vya ngiekhyinapa yi hingpa ruo hingta ca paliy lipa yi ta a aw aa.
Nama hmiekunglie i cadepa yi mingphang tie phung hne hringzya kha ziy'a va ung ciy. Tahematapakieca capa hmang ca ama tue nakawta i duv yi.

Cuorasala niema ca ica chang yi: ama ruo hing nama cu aa, cuehnung hne khyitiy langnapa ruo hing niema huopa tana kama ta ica pi'a yi. Kama ca Abyipanama Khazing tana i cuo; kama na cawsaa hrangpa tie chungtaata caa pache yi ang.

Caacuonakawta niema ta a pathepa saruopa hne a pathe lipa saruopa, a pathe lipa pavaa hne a pathepa pavaa tapa kha nama thleduo aa. Saruopa kawlie cuose, pavaa kawlie cuose, kama ta nama cuota pathe vyi ica tapa yi alyi lie a awpa khaapa phang kawlie tahmuo cuose, niema'a na niema kha duvsamakhiepa hmang a patlungsue khah ung.
Niema ca kama cuota nama pathe aa, tahematapakieca kama Abyipaca i pathe, kama na cawsaa hrangpa zaw chungtaata kama huopa riypata caa pache pathlyi yi ang.
Apyipa hne khuevuo ta aa hryipa ca canung a cuo zaw capaa a cuo zaw thie pata a cuo aa; alung ta vaasa pata ama cuo aa, iema thiy na iema cunglie a tlung.
Abyipata Moses kha hing haa hingta a chang: Tluobyi tie, Aaron sacapaa zaw kha chang tie yi: Ama tieriy hrawlie a thiypa kawlieta ahunghmuo a papya a palyi'a va yi.
Niema hne aa ngie cepa tieriy: a nung, a paa, a sacapaa, a sacanung, a uvnu kawlieta ta li pata ca a papya a palyi'a va ung ciy.
Cahaacata, na vaa a hnyi lipa a sietanung cuota ca aa papya aa palyi khu thluo.
Cuorasala achiyhiena luo kuo taata ama hne aa patuvpa ama thiy tiyta a papya a palyi khah se.
Iema ca ama luv khaapa suv lie kha hmuo a ngu'a va yi, ama hmyahming zaw a te'a va yi, ama ngesaa lie zaw a uo'a va yi.

Iema ca ama Khazing cuota ama pathe aa, ama Khazing ming kha siysaa ri li pata aw'a va yi. Tahematapakieca iema ca ama Khazing sa, myi ta ama ruepa Abyipa'a luo hriykhungrina kha a pihluo pata ama cuo. Caacuonakawta iema ca ama pathe aa.
Iema ca siyhrawnung acuolikie papyapalyi buopa canung kha napuv ta chiy'a va yi; a navaapa hne a chepa canung zaw kha napuv ta chiy'a va yi. Tahematapakieca iema ca ama Khazing cuota ama pathe aa.
Nama sa kha Khazing'a luo a pihluopa ama cuopa haata a pathepa ta nama rue aa; iema ca niema cuota ama pathe aa, tahematapakieca niema caa pathe sapa kama Abyipaca i pathe.
Tluobyi pakha sacanung ta siyhrawnung cuonapa ta aa papya aa palyi kieca, a paa a papya a palyi pata a cuo; myi ta rue sapa a cuo aa.
A luv cunglie sathu pathuvpa, tluobyi caw pathepa a hryi riypata pathe sapa, a viesaa zaw hrawlie cyicalang a cuopa ca a suo kha pathlie'a vyi, a caw zaw thlaa'a vyi.
A thiypa riyy awna luo zaw cakuo'a vyi. A nung hne a paa kawlieta hmuo ama hne ama kha a papya a palyi'a vyi.
Hmangpathepa ale luo kha pya pata a Khazing hmangpathepa kha papyapalyi khah se. Tahematapakieca Khazing huota sathu pathuv pata pathesapa a cuona ca ama cungliena a aw; kama ca Abyipatana i cuo.
Lesaa pathenung dyina napuv ta a chiy aa.
Nunghlyinung, a navaapa hne a chepa canung, papyapalyi buopa canung, siyhrawnung, tapa tie ca napuv ta chiy'a vyi.

A phang kha zaw hrawlieta a saata zaw a papya a palyi li riypa yi ta, a phang kha zaw chungtaata lesaa pathenung kha napuv ta a chiy aa. Tahematapakieca kama ca Abyipatana i cuo; kama na a pathe sa ang.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata hing haa hingta a chang:
“Aaron kha chang tie: Na samingsahlaa zaw chungtaata a dutla lipa ca chuo kha hnang chuo kha ta Khazing'a luo sa pihluo khu'a va yi.
Tahematapakieca a ming cuepa, a kuv a phyi cabiepa, a hmie rapa, a kuv a phyi syi pahyapa,
a kuv a phyi tlipa,
a ke bupa hne puvpasiy te a dang a nesapa, a ming rupa, retha a phyapa, hne tiydiypa, tapa a dutla lipa ahungtahmuo pihluo khu'a va yi.
Tluobyi Aaron ciypathla chungtaata a dutla lipa ahunghmuo Abyipakha myi ta abie riypata a pachie'a va yi, a Khazing kha sa pihluo riypata a pachie'a vyi.
Khazing sa a pathe cepa hne a pathepa kha a ning thluo aa.

Cuorasala pangzu athaa luo acuolikie bienatluophie luo ca vya cadi'a vyi, tahematapakieca ama ca a dutla lipa tana a cuo, i hmangpathepa kha papyapalyi'a vyi. Tahematapakieca kama ca Abyipatana i cuo; kama na a pathe sa yi ang.
Cahaacata Moses ta Aaron hne a sacapaa tie hne Israel cawsaa bangkhuo kha a chang yi.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata hing haa hingta a chang:

“Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw kha, i ming pathepa ama papyapalyi li riypata, Israel cawsaa ta kama ina pipa yi a pathepa pihluopa kawlieta a cadangsa pata hrie mang yi se, ta pata chang tie yi; Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo.

Iema kha chang tie yi: chuo kha hnang chuo khata, na samingsahlaa chungtaata pakhakha ta, Israel ming ta Abyipa'a luo ama pipa a pathepa pihluopa hmang kha, pathe lina a hnyi ningta a vya cadi kieca, capa cawsaa ca i awna taata thawpa a cuo aa; Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo.

Aaron samingsahlaa pakhakha chungtaata ahung a cuo zaw caahminghmaa pasana a hnyipa acuolikie a huopa taata atiy a pyapa ca a pathena te ta a pathepa pihluopa sa kha ning'a vyi. A thiypa riyy kawlieta a pathe lipa chechiy suokhakha a tawpa, a huopa taata atiy a pyapa,
ama a papya a palyi riypata aa thiylepa saruopa sakhakha a tawpa, khaapa kawlieta a pathe lipa a cuo zaw,
cahaapa a pathe lipa hmang suokhakha a tawpa ca zuoluo te ta a pathe lipa cuo'a te, a pangpa yalya ta tiy ta aa siy li kieca a pathepa pihluopa sa kha ning'a vyi.
Ning a tla taata ca a pathe aa; cakhutaa cata a pathepa pihluopa sa kha a ning aa, tahematapakieca ama ning riypa sa tana a cuo.
A thiypa hne saa ta a siepa kha a tawpa tie ca a pathe li nakawta a pathepa pihluopa sa kha ning'a vyi; Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo.
Hmangpathepa kha ama papyapalyi nakawta sue yi te a chunglie ama thiy li riypata i pipa yi phung kha ziy yi se; Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo; Kama na a pathe sa yi ang.
Tluobyi chung a cuo lipa ca a pathepa pihluopa sa kha ning'a vyi. Tluobyi'a lie a awpa acuolikie vie a hluepa zaw a pathepa pihluopa sa kha ning'a vyi.
Cuorasala tluobyi ta calyipa a cawsaa hne a chungkhue lie a puvpa ta ca capa sa ca a ning aa.
Tluobyi sacanung ta tluobyi chungkhue a cuo lipa kha aa hlaw kieca, capa nung ca a pathepa pihluopa sa kha ning'a vyi.
Cuorasala tluobyi sacanung ca saata hnyi li pata a navaapa hne aa che acuolikie nunghlyi te a paa ing luo kha a vya kaa kieca a paa sa kha a ning aa. Tluobyi chungkhue a cuo lipa ta ca ning'a vyi.
Pachang li pata a pathepa pihluopa sa kha a ning tlamu kieca a muo che pangaa che kha kha bechiy'a te a pathepa pihluopa ca tluobyi kha a pi aa.
Israel ming ta Abyipa'a luo ama pihluopa a pathepa pihluopa ca ahungtahmuo papyapalyi khah se.
A pathepa pihluopa ama ningna thue kha tana sue a ngiethe panaana pihluo a hupa suena kha ama ang aa. Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo: Kama na a pathe sa yi ang.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:

“Aaron hne a sacapaa tie hne Israel cawsaa bangkhuo kha chang tie yi: Israel ming pakhakha acuolikie Israel ming hrawlie khy a sapa ruohrang ming pakhakha ta bie aa kuopa kha cuose, ama palung thu ta cuose, Abyipa'a luo myirue panaana a pihluo tiyta,
cue acuolikie tuv acuolikie mie a tungpa a dutlapa kha pihluo se.
A dutla lipa kha pihluo'a va ung ciy, tahematapakieca ca cuhluopa'a va yi.

Cawsaa pakhakha ta bie aa kuopa patling sa riypata cuose, ama palung thu ta cuose, Abyipakha aviesaa panaana a pihluo tiyta, cue cuose, tuv cuose, a sahring ca cuhluo tluo aa tlapa a dutlapa ta a cuo aa, a dutla lipa cuo'a vyi.

A ming cuepa ma, hmaa a phyapa ma, a kuv phyi tlipa ma, a hnie a langpa hmaa a hnyipa ma, retha a phyapa ma, tapa tie kha Abyipapihluo'a va ung ciy; myi ta rue pata Abyipapihluo riypata bienatluophie cung luo kha khang'a va ung ciy.

Cuetungpa acuolikie tuvtaata a kuv a phyi suokhakha a syi tuv, acuolikie a pachangtuvpa kha palung thu pihluona riypata na hmuo khu; cuorasala biekuo patling sa riypata pihluona lie ca cuhluo pata cuo'a vyi.
A tiy phawchipa, dechipa, thlaachipa hne uochipa sahring kha Abyipapihluo'a va ung ciy. Cahaapa ca nama ruo chunglie zaw tue'a va ung ciy.
Cahaapa sahring ca na Khazing sa cuota pihluo riypata ruohrang ming'a taa zaw ta cuhluo'a vaciy. Dutla lipa a cuo nakawta ca cuhluopa'a va yi.
Khazing ta Moses kyihuo khata:
Cuetungpa cuose, tuv cuose, mie cuose a pachuo khutaata ning sariy chung kha a puvnung hne aw'a te, ning carina lie ca myi ta rue pata Abyipapihluo riypata cuhluopa a cuo aa.
Cuorasala cue a cuo zaw, tuv hne mie a cuo zaw ning kha chunglie nungsaa ta thie hne'a va ung ciy.
Abyipa'a luo kha palungtluo panaana nama pihluo tiyta cuhluopa nama cuo riypa tana nama pihluo aa.
Capa ning lie ca ta ning diy'a ung cate mawluo maw te ta nama pangaapa aw'a vyi: Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo.
Cahaacata i nawbie kha nama ziy aa: Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo.
Niema ta i ming pathepa kha papyapalyi'a va ung ciy, cuorasala Israel ming chunglieta kama ca pathesapa i cuo aa: Kama ca Abyipacuo angte, Kama na caa pathe sa yi ang.
Nama Khazing cuo riypata Izipt ruo chungtaata caa pyakhyipa yi tana i cuo: Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Israel ming kha chang tie yi: Hingpa tie hing ama'a na a cuo lieta tuepa pyi, kama ta a cuo i thlipa Abyipapyi, niema ta a pathepa ahmyana ning ta pata nama pathyi sa riypa pyi tana a cuo.

Ning caruv chung re hrie pata a cuo aa; cuorasala a ning sariynapa ning ca lungphaa ta a pahyna sabbath ning, a pathepa ahmyana ning ta a cuo aa. Re hrie'a va ung ciy: nama awnapa cyicuo lie Abyipacuota sabbath ning tana a cuo.
Hingpa tie hing cuo thlipa Abyipapyi, a pathepa ahmyana ning, ama'a na a cuo ningta nama tue riypata ama cuo.
Thla khanapa ning hraa hlyipaliy ning zuoluo lie kha Abyipacuota lawsena pyi ca tue pata a cuo aa.
Capa thlaa ning hraa hlyicaruv ning ca Abyipacuota thiynung phuv lipa viechuo pyi ta a cuo aa; ning sariy chung thiynung phuv lipa viechuo kha nama ning aa.
A ning khana lie ca a pathepa apungna nama hnyi aa. Nama re kha hrie'a va ung ciy.
Ning sariy chung Abyipakha myirue panaana pihluo'a ung cate, a ning sariyna lie ca a pathepa apungna ning ta a cuo aa: nama re kha hrie'a va ung ciy.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata hing haa hingta a chang:
Israel ming kha chang tie yi: Niema ica pipa yi ruo luo kha a ngie ung cate sa nama hrie tiyta, nama la taapa sa-uv taw kha kha tluobyi'a luo nama chiykhyi aa.
Niema ca cuhluopa nama cuo riypata tluobyi ta sa-uv kha Abyipahmiekunglie a calang thaw aa. Sabbath a mawluopa ning lie khana cahaacata a calang thaw aa.
Sa-uv nama calangna ning lie ca risie riy a aw lipa, a dutlapa, kung kha a tapa tuvtaata kha Abyipa'a luo myirue panaana ta nama pihluo aa.

Capa hne cata nama tuehne riypa sa ta panaana ca chiytiy hne pyapa a pha cepa jungsacuo viedie ephah che hraa che hning ta cuo'a te, Abyipa'a luo rangpa-ue cuo riypata myi ta rue pata pihluopa a cuo aa. Capa hne cata nama tuehne riypa dangpa ta panaana ca mingsuvtiy hin che paliy che kha a cuo aa.

Abyipa'a luo pihluona nama tue hluo, capa ning te cata nama sathaapa kha a viechuo ta cuose, myi lie a ngupa hne e pata cuose, a hipa ta cuose ning'a va ung ciy. Hingpa hing nama chuo chung bangkhuo nama awnapa lie nama ziy pari riypa phungluo tana a cuo aa.
Sabbath ning a mawluo, sa-uv taw vya cyi ung cate calangpa panaana nama tue ning taa khata ningzaa zaa sariy pasuv'a ung cate, a tling aa.
Sabbath yi sariyna a mawluo te kha pasuv'a ung cate, ning sawngaa a tling aa. Cakhutaa cata sathaapa kha vya cyi'a ung cate Abyipa'a luo nama pihluo aa.

Nama awnapa taa khata viechuo tluo hning kha calangpa panaana cuota nama vya cyi aa. Viechuo tluo kha ca a pha cepa jungsacuo viedie ephah che hraa che hning kha thiynung hne pya pata epa cuo'a te, Abyipa'a luo kha sathaapa cuopa ta pihluopa a cuo aa.

Viechuo hne cata risie riy a aw lipa kung kha a tapa tuvtaata sasariy, cue atungnupa sakha, hne tuvtungpa sahning tapa tie kha nama pi aa. Capa tie ca Abyipa'a luo myirue panaana ta a cuo aa. Sa ta panaana, dangpa ta panaana hne Abyipa'a luo rangpa-ue cuo riypata myi ta ruepa pihluopa hne khata pihluohne pata a cuo aa.
Sue pathe sa panaana cuota mietungpa sakha, hne aviesaa panaana cuota kung kha a tapa tuvtungpa sahning zaw kha nama pihluo aa.
Tluobyi ta sathaa pacuopa viechuo ca tuvtaata sahning hne khata Abyipahmiekunglie kha calang'a te, calangpa panaana ta a pihluo aa. Abyipahmiekunglie a pathepa cuo'a te tluobyi cuvu ta a cuo aa.

Capa ning lie ca ta pathyisana nama tue aa; a pathepa ahmyana nama tue aa; nama re kha hrie'a va ung ciy. Hingpa hing nama chuo chung bangkhuo nama awnapa lie nama ziy pari riypa phungluo tana a cuo aa.

Nama lu lie sa nama hrie tiyta, nama lu a kiy te ta sa kha uo diy'a va ung ciy, samang zaw thang'a va ung ciy. Siypasa tie hne ruohrang ming cuo khata nama pangaa buo aa: Kama ca Abyipanama Khazing tana i cuo.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Israel ming kha chang tie yi: Thla sariynapa chung, a ning khanapa lie ca lungphaa ta a pahy'a ung cate, hmyakaa tungna hne a thyi pari riypa ning, a pathepa ahmyana ning ta a cuo aa.
Nama re hrie'a va ung ciy; Abyipakha myiruepa nama pihluo aa.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Thla sariyna a ning hraanapa hing ca sue angiethena ning ta cuo'a te, niema cuota a pathepa ahmyana ning ta a cuo aa. Nama cuota anaa ning cuo'a te, Abyipakha myirue panaana nama pihluo aa.
Ning-aw ta re hrie li pata aw'a ung cate sue angiethena ning ta a cuo aa. Abyipanama Khazing hmiekung luo kha sue angiethena namaa hie aa.
Capa ning ning-aw ta sa a ang lipa ca a cawsaa zaw'a taata thawpa a cuo aa.
Capa ning lie re suokhakha a hriepa cawsaa ca a cawsaa zaw hrawtaata i para aa.
Khaapa re hmuo hrie'a va ung ciy: Hingpa hing nama chuo chung bangkhuo nama awna lieta nama ziy pari riypa phungluo tana a cuo aa.
Nama cuota ning-aw ta lungphaa ta namaa pahyna sabbath ning ta cuo'a te, nama cuota anaa ning ta a cuo aa. Capa thlaa ning caky ning zuoluo taata a mawluo zuoluo te khata sabbath ca namaa uv aa.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Israel ming kha chang tie yi: Hingpa thla sariyna ning hraa hlyipangaa ning taa hingta ning sariy chung ca Abyipacuota thluodaa pyi tana a cuo aa.
A ning khana ca a pathepa ahmyana ning ta cuo'a te, nama re hrie'a va ung ciy.

Ning sariy chung Abyipakha myirue panaana nama pihluo aa. Ning carina lie kha a pathepa apungna tue'a ung cate Abyipakha myirue panaana nama pihluo aa. Capa ca a siyhaa a awsapa ahmyana cuo'a te, nama re kha hrie'a va ung ciy.

Hingpa tie hingAbyipacuota ama'a na a cuo lieta tuepa pyi ta cuo yi te a pathepa ahmyana ta nama hmuo aa. Tahematapakieca Abyipa'a luo kha myi ta ruepa pihluona ta a cuopa; myirue panaana, sa ta panaana, hriykhungrina hne dangpa ta panaana zaw kha ama'a na a ning cyicuo khata nama pihluo aa.

Capa pyi zaw ca Abyipasabbath ning hlyi taata cuose, na lasaw pihluopa hlyi taata cuose, biekuopuopa pihluona hlyi taata cuose, nama palung thu ta na pipa pihluona hlyi taata cuose Abyipa'a luo nama pipa pihluona tana ama cuo.

Thla sariyna ning hraa hlyipangaa ning, nama lu taata a vyipa sa nama la diy tiyta, Abyipacuota ning sariy chung pyi nama tue aa. Ning khana lie ca lungphaa ta namaa pahy aa, ning carina lie zaw namaa pahy aa.

Ning khana lie ca thingkung puvthepa thyi, tungkung hnaa, a hnaa rungsapa thingce baw, hne cavaa kielie paasung hnaa zaw kha la'a ung cate, Abyipanama Khazing hmiekunglie kha ning sariy chung namaa nuo aa.
Capa ca Abyipacuota nama tue riypa pyi ta a cuo. Kung kha chunglie ning sariy, thla sariyna thlaa lieta tue'a ung cate, nama chuo chung bangkhuo ta nama ziy riypa phungluo ta a cuo aa.
Thluodaa chunglie ning sariy nama aw aa; Israel ruo ming a cuopa bangkhuo ta thluodaa chunglie nama aw aa.

Izipt ruo taata ica vya pyakhyi tiy yi ta, Israel cawsaa ca thluodaa lie ica pa-aw sapa yi kha nama ciypathla zaw ta ama pachang riypata thluodaa chunglie kha nama aw aa: Kama ca Abyipanama Khazing tana i cuo.
Cahaacata Moses ta ama'a na a cuo lieta tuepa Abyipapyi ca Israel ming'a luo kha a pathyi sa.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Israel ming kha, myi-ing cipari a khe thena riypata olif thyi kha phaw pata ama lapa olif thu a pathepa kha nama'a luo vya cyi riypata bie pi tie yi.

Myi ca Abyipahmiekunglie zuoluo taata mawdiy te a khe pari riypata biekuona thluodaa pangzu le lie, atawna thluodaa lie kha Aaron ta a vuo aa. Hingpa hing nama chuo chung bangkhuo chuozaa ta nama ziy pari riypa phungluo ta a cuo aa.
Abyipahmiekunglie a khe pari riypata ama ta myi-ing kha siy pathepa ta tuepa myi vuonapa tung lie kha a vuo aa.
Jungsacuo a pha cepa kha la lah viechuo tluo kha lieta ephah che hraa che hning ta viechuo tluo hraa hlyihning e tie.
Capa viechuo ca siy pathepa ta tuepa cabya lie kha tluo hning ta patluo la, tluo kha lie kha viechuo tluo caruv ta chi tie.
Abyipa'a luo myi ta na pihluopa viechuo cuopa khata a tluo cyicuo lie ca frankinsens pathepa kha na chi aa.
Sabbath ning mekaa ta Aaron ta Abyipahmiekunglie kha a phung haata chi pari'a te, capa ca Israel ming ta chuozaa biekuona ta amaa pinapa paluosana ta a cuo aa.

Capa viechuo ca Aaron hne a ciypathla zaw cuota cuo'a te hmang pathepa chunglie kha ama ning aa. Tahematapakieca Abyipamyi ta ama pihluopa chunglieta ama cuota a pathe cepa, a hmung pari riypa cuvu tana a cuo.
