A nung Israel ming cuo te, a paa Izipt ming ta a cuopa pakha ca Israel ming hrawlie kha aw te, capa Israel zaanung sacapaa ca hne Israel cawsaa pakha ca arina hmang lieta amaa tuv.
Israel zaanung sacapaa ca ta Khazing ming kha ripachie te chie a sa. Ama ca Moses'a luo kha amaa vawkhyi. A nung ming ca Shelomith cuo te, Dan mingphang Dibri sacanung ta a cuo.
Abyipabiechina kha a siesa pata iema'a luo paluo sapa a cuo hluo li ama kha thaw chunglie ama chi.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata,
Khazing a ripachiepa paa hing arina hmang ale luo kha pyakhyi tie. A bie ripa a thyipa bangkhuo ta a luv cunglie kha ama kuv khang yi sala, cawsaazaapuv khata alung ta vaa yi se.
Israel ming kyihuo khata: Khazing chie a sapa ca a suena kha a ang aa, ta pata chang tie yi.

Abyipaming a ripachiepa ca thie pata a cuo aa; Khazing a ripachiepa ca cawsaazaapuv ta alung ta vaapa tana a cuo aa. Ruohrang ming ama cuo zaw, ruocaapa ming ama cuo zaw, a Ming a ripachiepa ca thie pata ama cuo aa.
Cawsaa a thiepa ca thie pata ama cuo ra aa.
Sahring a thiepa ca a luvriy a lu aa, hringna cuota hringna.
Malie kha ama pangpa cunglie suokhakha a rana te ta a tuepa ca malie cunglie a tuepa haata ama cunglie zaw tue pata a cuo ra aa:
ruv thli cuota ruv thli ra, ming cuota ming, haa cuota haa, malie kha hmaa a paphya kieca ama kha hmaa paphya ra pata a cuo aa.
Sahring a thiepa ca sahring kha a luvriy ta lu'a te, cawsaa a thiepa ca ama kha thie pata a cuo ra aa.
Mingpe tie hne Israel ming cuota phungbie suokha nama hnyi aa: Kama ca Abyipanama Khazing tana i cuo,” a ta.
Cahaacata Moses ta Israel ming kha chang yi te, iema ta Khazing chie a sapa kha arina hmang taata ale luo pyakhyi yi te alung ta ama vaa sa. Abyipata bie a pipa haa yi khata Israel ming ta ama tue.
Abyipata Sinai tluo cunglie kha Moses kyihuo khata:
Israel ming kha chang tie yi: Kama ta ica pipa yi ruo chung luo namaa ngie tiyta, capa ruo ca ta Abyipacuota sabbath kha aa uv aa.
Kung caruv chung nama lu lie ciy nama cyi aa; cakhutaata kung caruv chung nama mingsuv dung kha khaasie'a ung cate a thyipaa kha nama la aa.
Cuorasala a kung sariyna lie ca ruo cuota lungphaa ta a pahynapa, Abyipacuota sabbath kung ta a cuo aa. Nama lu lie ciy cyi'a va ung ciy, nama mingsuv dung zaw pasiypathe'a va ung ciy.
Nama lu lie sahliypa kha la'a va ung ciy. Nama pasiypathe li pata a pathyipa mingsuv thyi zaw lu'a va ung ciy. Capa kung ca ruo cuota a pahy hyalyana kung tana a cuo aa.
Sabbath kung lie nama lu taata a vyipa sa ca niema ta nama ning aa: niema, nama siicapaa hne nama siicanung, a muo pi pata namaa hluopa niema'a lie a awpa nama rehrietuv,
nama sahring hne nama ruo chunglie a awpa saruopa zaw cuo te ta nama sa ta a cuo aa.
Kung sariy kung sariy ta yi sariy ri ung la, sabbath kung yi sariy ca nama cuota sawliy kung caky a cuo aa.
Thla sariynapa ning hraa ning, sue angiethena ning lie kha nama ruo chung bangkhuo lieta hmyakaa kha a paringsa pata nama tung aa.

Cahaacata kung sawngaanapa ca pathe sa'a ung cate, ruo chunglie khy a sapa tie bangkhuo'a luo kha hyazangna nama pathyi sa aa. Capa ca nama cuota Jubilee ta a cuo aa: niema, niema mekaa ta nama hnyipa hne nama ingchungkhue luo nama kaa pakhaa diy aa.

Hingpa kung sawngaana ca nama cuota jubilee kung ta a cuo aa: ciy cyi'a va ung ciy, a hliypa ta a vyipa zaw kha hrie'a va ung ciy; nama pasiypathe lipa mingsuv dung lie a pathyipa mingsuv thyi zaw kha lu'a va ung ciy.
Tahematapakieca jubilee tana a cuo; nama cuota a pathepa tana a cuo aa: nama thlu lipa lu taata a vyipa dyi khana nama ning aa.
Hingpa jubilee kung lie hing ca za zaapa bangkhuo ca zaa hnyituv kuv luo kha pi pakhaa diy pata a cuo aa.
Nama ingpaa'a luo nama zaa kie cuose, nama ingpaa'a taata nama calyi kie cuose, pakha hne pakha a dung'a va ung ciy.
Nama ingpaa'a taata nama calyi tiyta, jubilee kung khutaata sa a vyi kung zaa kha pasuv'a ung cate a calyituv ta aa ngaapa a kung zaa khata a muo kha a pi aa.
A kung a hluv kie a muo kha hluv vie'a te, a kung a caw vie kie a muo kha a cung vie aa. Tahematapakieca sa a pavyipa zaa khana calyi pata a cuo.
Pakha hne pakha a dung'a va ung ciy, cuorasala nama Khazing kha nama ciyzaa aa; Kama ca Abyipanama Khazing tana i cuo.
Ruo chunglie aa bangsa pata nama aw the riypata i phungluo hne i ziyphung kha zang tluo aa tlasa pata ziy tie ung.
Ruo ta kung pavyi'a te, nama riy a bi sa pata ning'a ung cate, aa bangsa pata nama aw aa.
Ciy cyi li sa hrie li pata ma aw kie, kung sariyna lie ca khaapama ma ning aa?, ina ta'a ung ciy.
Kung caruvna lie kha i thluechiy ca niema cuota naw pi'a angte, kung thung ning khang ta kung a pavyi aa.
A kung carina lie ciy nama cyi tiyta, sahlungpa kha ning'a ung cate, a kung cakyna kung nama ciy cyipa a vya vyina te khata sahlungpa na nama ning kalie aa.
Nama luruo kha chuozaa cuota zaa'a va ung ciy, tahematapakieca luruo ca kama huopa tana a cuo; niema ca kama'a lie mingpe hne khyche tana nama cuo.
Luruo namaa calyi tiyta zaa hnyi taapa ta aa thla pakhaa khu pari aa.
Na tieriy pakhakha ta ruvnaana a taw te, a luruo kha a zaa kieca, aa ngie cepa a tieriy ta a vaw'a te a tieriy ta a zaapa ca aa thla aa.
Capa cawsaa ca ta a thlapa riy hnyi li pata, cuorasala a chyachang a ky te amata tah a thla khunapa adaahmang a pha kieca,
jubilee kung a phana te khata a kung pasuv sala a za zaapa paa'a lie kha a muo pi se; cahaacata a luruo ca aa la pakhaa aa.
Cuorasala aa thla khu li kieca, a zaapa ca jubilee kung te khata a calyipa kuv chunglie kha a aw aa; jubilee kung lie kha pathlie'a te, a zaa hnyi taapa kuv luo kha a kaa aa.
Cawsaa pakha ta dungkhuopa khypuv chunglie a ing kha a zaa kieca kung kha chunglie aa thla pakhaa khu aa; a thla pakhaa khuna ca kung kha chung ta a cuo aa.
Kung kha a tling hluota aa thla pakhaa khu li kieca, dungkhuopa khypuv chunglie a awpa ing ca chuozaa ta a calyituv hne a ciypathla zaw huopa ta cuo'a te, jubilee lie zaw pakaa pakhaa pata cuo'a vyi.
Cuorasala dungkhuo a hnyi lipa khyta chunglie ing tie ca luruo haa khata ripa cuo'a te, a thla khu pata a cuo aa; jubilee ning ta pakaa pakhaa pata a cuo aa.
Levi ming khypuv, iema khypuv chunglie ing zaw ca Levi ming ta khatiy ning tahmuo cuose amaa thla khu aa.

Cahaacata a thla pakhaa khu a awpa Levi ming huopa, ama khypuv chunglie ing ca jubilee ning ta pakaa pakhaa pata a cuo aa; tahematapakieca Levi ming ama khy chunglie ing ca Israel cawsaa zaw hrawlieta ama cuvu tana a cuo.
Cuorasala ama khy cahriylie a awpa luruo ca khatiy tahmuo zaapa cuo'a vyi, tahematapakieca capa ca chuozaa ta ama huopa tana a cuo.
Na tieriy pakhakha ca ruvnaana a taw te nama kha aca pangie kieca, ama kha mangchiy'a cate, mingpe tie haa khata nama'a lie a aw aa.
Ama'a taata amie la'a vaciy, acuolikie amie zaw huv'a vaciy; cuorasala na Khazing kha ciy la, iema ca nama'a lie kha aw yi se.
Na tuokaa kha amie ta pahlie'a vaciy, na sa zaw kha sapaa la pata paning sa'a vaciy.
Kama ca Abyipanama Khazing, niema kha Kanaan ruo pi riypata Izipt ruo chungtaata caa vya pyakhyipa yi tana i cuo.
Nama caa tupa pakhakha ca a siy pasasa te ama hne ama kha nama'a luo acaa zaa kieca na sii ta tue'a vaciy.
Ama ca a muo pipa rehrietuv haa tana nama'a lie kha a aw aa. Jubilee kung te kha na re a hrie aa.
Cakhutaa cata iema hne nama'a lie a awpa ama saata zaw hne khata pya'a yi te, iema'a na ama chungkhue luo kha kaa'a yi te ama ciypathlatuv tie luruo kha pi pata ama cuo aa.
Tahematapakieca iema ca i changtaapa, Izipt ruo chungtaata i vya pyakhyipa ta cuo yi te, sii zaw zaapa haa khata zaa pata cuo'a va yi.
Iema kha aa hruosa pata uv'a va yi ciy, cuorasala na Khazing kha na ciy aa.
Siicapaa hne siicanung ta nama hnyi riypa tie ca, niema cahriylie a awpa mingphang zaw taa hing tana nama calyi aa.
Niema'a lie khy a sapa ruohrang ming hne nama ruo lie a puvpa ama chungkhue cawsaa zaw kha calyi khu'a ung cate, nama huopa ta ama cuo aa.
Iema ca ing zaw luruo zaw haata nama saata zaw cuota ru ta nama chipa khu. Iema ca sii ta nama hnyi khu, cuorasala nama mingphang ta a cuopa Israel ming ca ahungtahmuo aa hruosa pata uv'a va ung ciy.

Niema hrawlie khy a sapa ruohrang ming pakhakha kha vya hnyirung te, na tieriy pakhakha ca ruvnaana aa taw nakawta capa ruohrang ming acuolikie aa chungkhue pakhakha'a luo kha ama hne ama aa zaa kieca,
a thlana naw a aw aa; ama uvnu pakhakha ta iema kha amaa thla aa;
acuolikie, a paa uvnu ma a paa uvnu sacapaa zaw ma ta amaa thla aa; acuolikie a ingchungkhue a cuopa pakhakha ta aa thla aa; acuolikie iema kha ama hnyirung kieca iema'a na iemata tah amaa thla aa.

A calyituv hne khata iema hne iema amaa zaanapa taa khata jubilee kung te khata pasuv'a yi te, hyazangna muo ca a kung zaa haa khata a cuo aa: a hnyituv'a lie ama awna cuo zaa ca viehluena cuo haa khata ripa pata ama cuo aa.
A lawna riypata kung hluvpuv a bu kalie kieca a kung zaa kha pasuv pata calyinapa muo taa khata pakaa pakhaa pata a cuo aa.
Jubilee kung te khata pasuv pata kung a cawta dyi a bu kieca, a kung zaa khata iema a thlana muo kha pi pata a cuo aa.
A muo pi pata a kung ta a hluopa rehrietuv ta a cuo kieca ruohrang ming kuv rawlie ca a aw aa, tuokhaata a cuo zaw nama ming hmungna lieta aa hruosa pata uvpa cuo'a va yi.
Ama ca cahaacata a thlapa acuolikie ca jubilee kung ning kha ama hne a saata zaw hne khata hya pazangpa ama cuo aa.
Tahematapakieca kama cuota ca Israel ming ca i changtaapa tana ama cuo; Izipt ruo chungtaata i pyakhyipa i changtaapa tana ama cuo: Kama ca Abyipanama Khazing tana i cuo.
Niema ca kuvtuezuv a sa'a va ung ciy; khepa hne capepa lungbang cuose, capepa alung cuose nama ruo chunglie kha abie riypata bang'a va ung ciy.
I sabbath kha a uv'a ung cate i hmangpathepa kha nama pa-uvsathyi aa: Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo.
I phungluo kha ziy ung cate i nawbie kha zang tluo aa tla pata nama ziy kieca,
Ama'a na a cuota lieta khytiy kha ca pi'a yi angte, nama luruo ta sa pavyi'a te, nama lu lie thingkung zaw ta a thyi ama pathyi aa.
Na suo-aciyna ta mingsuv nawna cuo te kha pha'a te, mingsuv nawna cuo ta na ciy cyi thlaa te kha a pha aa. Sa kha nama riy bisa pata ning'a ung cate, nama ruo lie aa bangsa pata khy nama sa aa.

Nama ruo chunglie kha thlaalungna ca pi'a yi angte, namaa zie tiyta ahungtahmuo nama thlaa ca pazang'a va yi. Nama ruo chungtaata ciy aa chiypa saa a hruopa tie kha a cade'a angte, nama ruo lie zueziy a cyi pata rie aduna aw'a vyi.
Nama carie tie kha a cade'a ung cate, nama hmiekunglie kha zueziy hmaa ta amaa lie aa.
Niema papangaa ta zakha kha a cade'a ung cate, zakha ta thawhraa kha namaa cade aa; nama carie tie ca nama hmiekunglie kha zueziy hmaa ta amaa lie aa.
Kama ta hmiephaa ca pi'a yi angte, saata a hluvsa hnyi'a ung cate nama pungzaa aa; cakhutaata niema hne i biekuona kha i pahmang sa aa.
Sahlungpa kha ning'a ung cate, sathaapa china riypata sahlungpa kha nama papya aa.
I awna kha niema hrawlie chi'a angte, ca hue'a va yi ang.
Niema hrawlie a khie'a angte, kama ca nama Khazing ta cuo'a angte, niema ca i cawsaa ta nama cuo aa.
Kama ca iema sii nama cuo li tli riypata Izipt ruo taata caa pyakhyipa Abyipanama Khazing tana i cuo; nama ruekhang tluo kha ca thlipa yi angte aa dangta tah a daa pata caa cakuo satuv yi tana i cuo.
Cuorasala kama ri kha namaa ngie li pata ica pipa yi nawbie bangkhuo kha nama ziy li kie cuose,
i phungluo kha ziy li pata i ziyphung kha nama hue kie cuose, i nawbie bangkhuo kha ziy li pata i biekuo kha nama para kie cuose,

kama zaw ta hingpa hing niema'a lie i tue ra aa. Ciysabaraw aa chiypa, ming kha para te pangpa thaazuo a pacunglepa ngyi pasana kha nama cunglie i patlung sa aa. Nama ciycyipa ca a hrihripa ta aa li aa, tahematapakieca nama carie tie na a ning'a yi.
Hnang ca chaw'a yi angte, nama carie tie ta ca te'a yi te aca uv'a yi; ahungtahmuo acaa cade lipa yi ta namaa ruo aa.
Cahaacata a cuo thluo pata i ri namaa ngie li ngiethie kieca nama suena cuo khata le sariy ta duo ica te'a yi.
Namaa palesakhyipa nama rungnaana kha i thlipachung aa; nama avuo kha thaa haata tue'a angte, nama chuelyi kha daa haata i tue aa.
Nama thaazuo kha a cuo lipa lie hmuo'a ung cate, nama ruo ta kung pavyi'a vyi; thingkung zaw ta a thyi pathyi'a vyi.
I bie kha naathlie li pata inaa du kalie kie ungca ca, nama suenapa le sariy ta ruvna i patlung sa aa.
Niema'a luo kha aa hruopa saa ca pathliesue'a yi angte, nama saata hne nama sahring kha sie'a yi te, mingluv kha cawle'a ung cate, nama luopuv kha a duothlingle aa.
Cahaacata duotena nama ang thluo pata kama'a luo vya kaa li pata kama kha ina hue ngiethie kie ungca ca,
kama zaw niema kha ca hue ra'a yi angte, Kama pangpa ta nama suena cuota le sariy ta ica tuv'a yi.

Niema a du riypata zueziy kha niema'a luo vya cyi'a angte, biekuona cuota phuvlana a tue aa. Nama khypuv chung luo namaa ruo kie zaw nama cunglie kha puvtlung pasana patlung sa'a angte, niema ca nama carie tie kuv luo kha pi pata nama cuo aa.
Nama sa hmungnapa kha i chipachung tiyta, viechuo enapa suokha lie kha canung pahraa ta viechuo ama rue aa; acyi pathlie'a yi te amaa re'a nakawta nama ning raalaa pata nama riy bi'a vyi.
Cuorasala cahaacata nama te-ang tli raalaa pata i ri naa ngie lipa ung cata ina hue ngiethie kalie kie ungca ca,
kama zaw i hihaasa pata ca hue ra'a yi angte, nama suena cuo khata le sariy ta duo ica te'a yi.
Nama sacapaa zaw saa kha ce'a ung cate, nama sacanung zaw saa kha nama ce aa.
Nama khahrungtluobu tie kha para'a angte, nama rangpa-ue pinapa bienatluophie kha i para aa. Nama riyy kha kuvtuezuv tie riyy cunglie papung'a angte, niema kha ica hue'a yi.
Nama khypuv kha a hri pata tue'a angte, nama hmangpathepa kha a duokaring aa; nama rangpa-ue kha saw'a va ang.
Ruo ca para patlaa'a angte, a vaw yi te a chunglie a awpa nama carie tie ca ama kharue haa'a te ama thlaa a zang aa.
Niema kha mingphang zaw hrawlie ca chepatlaa'a yi angte, i zueziy kha a da'a angte icaa cade'a yi. Nama ruo ca a duothlingpa ta cuo'a te nama khypuv ca a rue aa.
Cakhutaata niema ca nama carie tie ruo lie kha aw ung cate, nama ruo ca a hri pata a aw chung bangkhuo kha a sabbath kha aa lawkhyi aa; ruo ca a pahy'a te a sabbath kung tie kha aa lawkhyi aa.
A duothling chung bangkhuo ca aa ding aa; a chunglie nama aw ning nama sabbath kung zaw ningta ruo ta a hmung lipa a dingna kha a hmung aa.

Niema chunglie a hring kaliepa tie cuota, ama carie tie ruo lie kha palung cawnapa patlung sa'a angte, thinghnaa aa tlepa pu ta iema kha paruo'a yi te, cawsaa pakha zueziy rie ciy pata aa ruopa haa khata amaa ruo aa; ahungtahmuo a cade li pata amaa lie aa.
Ahungtahmuo acaa cade li raalaa pa yi ta zueziy rie ciy ta a ruopa tie haa khata pakha cunglie pakha a lie'a ung cate, nama carie tie a du riypata cahrana hnyi'a va ung ciy.
Mingphang zaw hrawlie kha ra'a ung cate nama carie tie ruo khata aca ce sa diy'a yi.
Niema a hring pata aa ngaapa tie ca nama pha lina kawlieta nama carie tie ruo lie kha vievuv'a ung cate, nama mingchingmingvuo tie pha lina kawlie zaw ta nama vievuv aa.

Cuorasala iema ta iema pha lina hne ama mingchingmingvuo tie pha lina kha a cuo hmisi ta yi te, cata a cuo thluo pata kama'a lie kha biekuo para yi te, ca hlyitaw taata, kama kha aa pazue pata ina hue kie yi ca,
kama zaw ta a pazue pata hue ra'a yi angte, ama carie tie ruo luo kha i chiy'a yi; cakhutaa cata vangdaw te lipa ama pathiypalung kha pachung yi te ama pha lina taata amaa thle kieca,
cakhutaa cata Jakob hne i tuepa biekuona kha i thyi pakhaa aa; Isak hne i tuepa biekuona hne Abraham hne i tuepa biekuona zaw kha a thyi'a angte, ruo kha i thyi pakhaa aa.

Ruo ca a ruose'a yi te, ama pha lina cuota amaa thle hluo chung, iema li pata a duokaring pata a laa chung kha a sabbath kung zaw kha a lawkhyi aa. Tahematapakieca iema ca i ziyphung kha siysaa ri lipa yi ta i phungluo kha ama hue.

Cuorasala capa zaw bangkhuo cuo ca ta, ama carie tie ruo lie ama aw ning kha siysaa ri li pata aw li pata aw'a va yi ang, iema kha para diy pata iema hne i biekuo parana te ta iema kha hue'a va yi ang; tahematapakieca kama ca Abyipaama Khazing tana i cuo.

Cuorasala iema kawpacuo pata ama Khazing cuo riypata mingphang zaw hmungna lie Izipt ruo chungtaata i vya pyakhyipa yi ama mingchingmingvuo tie hne i tuepa biekuona kha i thyi aa: Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo.
Hingpa hing Abyipata Moses thueta Sinai tluo cunglie ama hne Israel ming alalalie a pacusapa phungluo hne ziyphung hne phungbie zaw ta ama cuo.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:

Israel ming kha chang tie yi: Cawsaa pakhakha ta bie aa kuopa patling sa riypata Abyipa'a luo aa pi kieca, cawsaa muo ca hing zaa hing tana a cuo aa ta pata thlipa tuokaa zaa khata hya pazang sapa a cuo aa.
Capaa kung kiy taata kung sawcaruv te ca ngu shekel sawngaa, hmangpathepa lie hmuopa shekel ta pathliepa a cuo aa.
Canung pakha ca shekel sawthung a cuo aa.
Kung pangaa taata kung kiy te ama cuo kieca capaa pakha cuota shekel suokiy cuo'a te canung pakha cuota shekel suohraa ta a cuo aa.
Thla kha taata kung pangaa te ama cuo kieca capaa pakha cuota shekel suopangaa cuo'a te, canung pakha cuota ngu shekel suothung a cuo aa.
Cawsaa ca kung caruv hlyi a cuo kieca capaa pakha cuota shekel suohraa hlyipangaa cuo'a te, canung pakha cuota shekel suohraa ta a cuo aa.

Pakhakha ta a muo zaa kha a pi khu li kieca iema kha tluobyi'a luo a vawkhyi pata cuo'a yi te, tluobyi ta a muo kha a thli aa; tluobyi ca ta biekuona a tuepa a pi khu riypa zaa khata a muo ca a thli aa.
Abyipa'a luo pihluo riypata ama vya cyipa ca sahring ta a cuo kieca, Abyipa'a luo ama pihluopa ca a pathepa ta a cuo aa.

Capa sahring ca a hrangpa ta thle'a vyi, a chiepa kha a phapa ta acuolikie a phapa kha a chiepa ta thle'a vyi. Sahring sakha kha a hrangpa ta a thle kieca, capa sahring ca hne a thlenapa sahring a sahning ta a pathepa ta amaa li aa.
Abyipapihluo riypata vya cyi li riypa a pathe lipa sahring ta a cuo kieca, capa sahring ca tluobyi'a luo kha a vya cyi aa.
Tluobyi ta a muo a thli aa: a pha zaw a chie zaw, tluobyi ta a muo a thlipa haa khata a cuo aa.
Cuorasala a thla riypata a cuo kieca, a muo thlipa zaa lie kha che pangaa che kha a chachiy aa.
Cawsaa pakhakha ta Abyipakha ing a pihluo pata a cuo kieca, tluobyi ta a muo a thli aa: a pha a cuo zaw, a chie a cuo zaw, tluobyi ta a thlipa haa khata a cuo aa.
Ing a pihluopa khata aa thla khing kieca, a muo thlipa zaa che pangaa che kha kha a chachiy aa, cakhutaa cata a zaa hnyipa kha pi pakhaa pata a cuo aa.

Cawsaa pakhakha ta ru a cupa luruo kha Abyipaa pihluo kieca, a chunglie saciy tuvpa zaa kha mang pata a muo thlipa a cuo aa. Jungsacuo ciy humer suokha tuvnapa lu ca ngu tuokaa shekel sawngaa ta a muo thlipa a cuo aa.
Cawsaa pakhakha ta a lu kha jubilee kung lieta a pihluo pata a cuo kieca, a muo thlipa haa khata aa hmang aa.
Cuorasala lu ca jubilee khutaata a pihluo pata a cuo kieca, tluobyi ta jubilee pakhaapa te ta aa tuo kaliepa kung zaa kha pasuv'a te a muo ca pachung vie'a te a thli aa.
Lu a pihluopa ta aa thla khing kieca, a muo thlipa lie kha che pangaa che kha chachiy'a te, a zaa hnyi taapa'a luo kha pi pakhaa pata a cuo aa.
Cuorasala lu ca aa thla li kieca, acuolikie pakhakha'a luo a zaa kieca, a thla riypata cuo'a va tli.
Cuorasala capa lu ca jubilee ning ta hya pazangpa a cuo kieca, bie a kuo pata pihluopa lu haa khata Abyipacuota a pathepa a cuo aa; tluobyi huopa ta aa li aa.
Cawsaa pakha ta ru ta a cupa luruo cuo li pata a calyipa lu kha Abyipa'a luo a pihluo kieca,
tluobyi ta a vaw riypa jubilee kung te ta a muo khazaa ma a cuo aa tapa kha thli'a te, capa Abyipacuota a pathe pata pihluopa ning lie ca a thlipa zaa ca a pi aa.
Jubilee kung lie ca ta lu ca ama za calyinapa paa, ru ta zaa cupa paa'a luo kha pi pakhaa pata a cuo aa.
Muo thlina bangkhuo ca hmangpathepa shekel ta a cuo aa: shekel suokha ca gerah suokiy ta a cuo aa.
Sahring sahrangta, a pachuo taapa sahring ca Abyipahuopa tana a cuo, ahungtahmuo Abyipa'a luo pihluo khu'a vyi; cuetungpa cuose tuv cuose, Abyipahuopa tana a cuo.
A pathe lipa sahring ta a cuo kieca, a muo thlipa haata a thlapa cuo'a te, che pangaa che kha chachiypa a cuo aa; a thla pata a cuo li kieca, a muo thlipa haata zaa pata a cuo aa.

Cawsaa pakhakha ta Abyipa'a luo kha chie a sa pata a pihluopa: cawsaa cuose, sahring cuose, acuolikie ru ta a cupa luruo cuose, suokha hmuo zaapa cuo'a vyi, a thlapa zaw cuo'a vyi. Chie a sa pata pipa mekaa ca Abyipacuota a pathe cepa tana a cuo.
Chie a sa pata pihluopa ca cawsaa kha hmuo a thla pata cuo'a vyi, thie pata na a cuo aa.
Luruo taata a pyapa chehraachekha bangkhuo, alyi taata saciy cuose, thingkung taata thingthyi cuose, Abyipahuopa tana a cuo; Abyipacuota a pathepa tana a cuo.
Cawsaa ta ama chehraachekha kha amaa thla khing kieca, a muo zaa che pangaa che kha kha ama chachiy aa.
Tuv hne cue chehraachekha bangkhuo, tuvkhietuv khuecahryi rawlie a cakuopa a sahraanapa mekaa ca Abyipacuota a pathepa tana a cuo aa.
Ahungtahmuo a pha a chie kha hiehriy khah se, a thle zaw thle khah se, a thle kieca a thlepa sahring hne a thlenapa sahring hne khata a sahning ta a thla khu pata cuo'a vyi.
Hingpa hing Abyipata Israel ming cuota Sinai Tluo cunglie Moses a pipa nawbie tana a cuo.
Israel ming Izipt ruo taata ama vya pya khutaata kung hningnapa kung a thla hningnapa thlaa ning khanapa ning lietaAbyipata Moses ca Sinai ruocaapa, atawna thluodaa chunglie kha bie a chang.
Israel ming bangkhuo kha mingluv ri tie yi, a phang ta, a chung ta, pakha hnang pakha ta capaa bangkhuo kha ama mingluv ri tie ung;
kung kiy taata a cungluo Israel ming bangkhuo rietuvna luo a si khu riypa kha, a phuvphuv khata Aaron hne nama ta ri tie ung.
Phang kha taata capaa pakha kaluo nama'a lie aw'a yi te, iema ca ama chung cyicuo cuota luv ama cuo aa.
Hingpa tie hing nama caa byatuv riypa tie ming ta a cuo: Reuben phang taata, Shedeur sacapaa Elizur;
Simeon phang taata, Zurishaddai sacapaa Shelumiel;
Judah phang taata, Amminadab sacapaa Nahshon;
Isskhar phang taata, Zuar sacapaa Nethanel.
Zebulun phang taata Helon sacapaa Eliab.
Josef sacapaa zaw chungtaata: Efraim chungtaata Ammihud sacapaa Elishama; Manasseh chungtaata Pedahzur sacapaa Gamaliel;
Benjamin chungtaata Gideoni sacapaa Abidan.
Dan chungtaata Ammishaddai sacapaa Ahiezer;
Asher chungtaata Ochran sacapaa Pagiel;
Gad chungtaata Deuel sacapaa Eliasaf;
Naftali chungtaata Enan sacapaa Ahira.
Hingpa tie hing zaapuv ta amaa tlawpa tie, ama chung luochiytuv tie, Israel ming ama mingphang tie luv a cuopa tie ta ama cuo.
Moses hne Aaron ta ming cabypa tie kha la yi te,
a thla hningna ning khanapa lieta cawsaazaapuv ca ama pahmya. Ama phang cyicuo ta, a chung a chung ta, kung kiy taata a cungluo bangkhuo pakha hnang pakha ta ming amaa pi,
Abyipata Moses a changpa haa khata. Caacuonakawta ama ta Sinai ruocaapa lie kha ming ca a la yi.
Israel sacapaa uvthyi Reuben ciypathla tie, a phang a phang ta, a chung a chung ta rietuvna luo a si khu riypa, kung kiy taata a cungluo capaa ming lapa tie:
Ming khungpa Reuben phang tie ca thawsawliy thawcaruv zapangaa ta ama cuo.
Simeon ciypathla tie, a phang a phang ta, a chung a chung ta rietuvna luo a si khu riypa, kung kiy taata a cungluo capaa ming lapa tie:
Ming khungpa Simeon phang tie ca thawsawngaa thawcaky zathung ta ama cuo.
Gad ciypathla tie, a phang a phang ta, a chung a chung ta rietuvna luo a si khu riypa, kung kiy taata a cungluo capaa ming lapa tie:
Ming khungpa Gad phang tie ca thawsawliy thawpangaa zacaruv sawngaa ta ama cuo.
Judah ciypathla tie, a phang a phang ta, a chung a chung ta rietuvna luo a si khu riypa, kung kiy taata a cungluo capaa ming lapa tie:
Ming khungpa Judah phang tie ca thawsawsariy thawpaliy zacaruv ta ama cuo.
Isskhar ciypathla tie, a phang a phang ta, a chung a chung ta rietuvna luo a si khu riypa, kung kiy taata a cungluo capaa ming lapa tie:
Ming khungpa Isskhar phang tie ca thawsawngaa thawpaliy zapaliy ta ama cuo.
Zebulun ciypathla tie, a phang a phang ta, a chung a chung ta rietuvna luo a si khu riypa, kung kiy taata a cungluo capaa ming lapa tie:
Ming khungpa Zebulun phang tie ca thawsawngaa thawsariy zapaliy ta ama cuo.
Josef ciypathla tie, Efraim ciypathla chungtaata a phang a phang ta, a chung a chung ta rietuvna luo a si khu riypa, kung kiy taata a cungluo capaa ming lapa tie:
Ming khungpa Josef phang tie ca thawsawliy zapangaa ta ama cuo.
Manasseh ciypathla tie, a phang a phang ta, a chung a chung ta rietuvna luo a si khu riypa, kung kiy taata a cungluo capaa ming lapa tie:
Ming khungpa Manasseh phang tie ca thawsawthung thawhning zahning ta ama cuo.
Benjamin ciypathla tie, a phang a phang ta, a chung a chung ta rietuvna luo a si khu riypa, kung kiy taata a cungluo capaa ming lapa tie:
Ming khungpa Benjamin phang tie ca thawsawthung thawpangaa zapaliy ta ama cuo.
Dan ciypathla tie, a phang a phang ta, a chung a chung ta rietuvna luo a si khu riypa, kung kiy taata a cungluo capaa ming lapa tie:
Ming khungpa Dan phang tie ca thawsawcaruv thawhning zasariy ta ama cuo.
Asher ciypathla tie, a phang a phang ta, a chung a chung ta rietuvna luo a si khu riypa, kung kiy taata a cungluo capaa ming lapa tie:
Ming khungpa Asher phang tie ca thawsawliy thawkha zapangaa ta ama cuo.
Naftali ciypathla tie, a phang a phang ta, a chung a chung ta rietuvna luo a si khu riypa, kung kiy taata a cungluo capaa ming lapa tie:
Ming khungpa Naftali phang tie ca thawsawngaa thawthung zapaliy ta ama cuo.
Hingpa tie hing ming khungpa tie ta ama cuo, Moses hne Aaron ta ama chung cyicuo taata luv a cuopa Israel ming pahraa hlyihning abyana ta ming ama khungpa tie ta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Israel ming bangkhuo, ama chung cyicuo taata, kung kiy taata a cungluo, rietuvna luo a si khupa ca
ama bangkhuo ta thawzacaruv thawthung zapangaa sawngaa ta ama cuo.
Cuorasala Levi ming ca iema ciypathla phang tie'a lie kha ripuo pata cuo va yi.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Levi ming phang kyalya dyina ming khungpuo li pata, Israel mingphang hrangpa tie hneta mingluv lapuo li pata na aw aa.

Levi ming ca biekuona thluodaa, a chechiytingby bangkhuo, hne capa tie hne cata aa patuvpa bangkhuo lie re a hrie riypata chi'a yi cate, bienathluodaa hne a chechiytingby bangkhuo kha a puvle'a yi te, ama kingkaa aa; bienathluodaa athaalie kha amaa ripuo aa.

Bienathluodaa ca sikhyi riypa a cuo tiyta, Levi ming ta phi'a yi te, bienathluodaa kha bang riypa a cuo tiyta Levi ming ta ama bang aa. Cawsaa hrangpa ahunghmuo bienathluodaa luo a vya cadipa ca thie pata a cuo aa.
Israel mingphang a hrangpa tie ca iema'a na riekaphuv cyicuo khata a phuv a phuv ta amaa ri aa.
Cuorasala Levi ming ca bienathluodaa cahriylie kha amaa ri aa; Israel ming zaapuv cunglie Khazing hihaana a tlung li riypata biekuona thluodaa kha ama huo aa.
Cahaacata Israel ming ta ama tue; Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haa khata iema ta ama tue.
Abyipata Moses hne Aaron kyihuo khata:
Israel ming ca iema'a na ama phuv cyicuo ta ama phang a paluosapa pangtaa athaalie kha aw'a yi te, atawna thluodaa luo hmie pachaw pata amaa ri aa.
Ningchiyluo, ning a kya chiyna kuo luota a aw riypa phuv tie ca Judah phang ta ama cuo aa. Judah phang tie ama luochiytuv ca Amminadab sacapaa Nahshon ta a cuo aa,
ama phuv ca a mingluv ta thawsawsariy thawpaliy zacaruv ta ama cuo.
Ama a vya paziy pata arina hmang a la riypa ca Issakhar phang ta ama cuo aa. Issakhar phang tie ama luochiytuv ca Zuar sacapaa Nethanel ta a cuo aa,
ama phuv ca a mingluv ta thawsawngaa thawpaliy zapaliy ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata Zebulun phang: Zebulun phang tie ama luochiytuv ca Helon sacapaa Eliab ta a cuo,
ama phuv ca a mingluv ta thawsawngaa thawsariy zapaliy ta ama cuo.
Judah arina hmang lie ca a phuv a phuv ta, ama bangkhuo ta thawzakhasawcari thawcaruv zapaliy ama ta.
Sungluo kuo ta a aw riypa phuv tie ca Reuben phang ta ama cuo aa. Reuben phang tie ama luochiytuv ca Shedeur sacapaa Elizur ta a cuo aa,
ama phuv ca a mingluv ta thawsawliy thawcaruv zapangaa ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata a paziy pata arina hmang a la riypa ca Simeon phang ta ama cuo aa. Simeon phang tie ama luochiytuv ca Zurishaddai sacapaa Shelumiel ta a cuo aa,
ama phuv ca a mingluv ta thawsawngaa thawcaky zathung ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata Gad phang ta ama cuo aa, Gad phang tie ama luochiytuv ca Reuel sacapaa Eliasaf ta a cuo aa,
ama phuv ca a mingluv ta thawsawliy thawpangaa zacaruv sawngaa ta ama cuo.
Reuben arina hmang lie ca a phuv a phuv ta, ama bangkhuo ta thawzakhasawngaa thawkha zapaliy sawngaa ama ta. Iema hing a pahningnapa ta a pya riypata ama cuo aa.
Arina hmang liekhingkhuo lie atawna thluodaa hne Levi phuv ca ama pya aa, arina hmang ama lana haa khata a phuv a phuv ta ama pangtaa cyicuo ziy pata ama pya aa.
Ningtlaluo kuo ta a aw riypa phuv tie ca Efraim phang ta ama cuo aa. Efraim phang tie ama luochiytuv ca Ammihud sacapaa Elishama ta a cuo aa,
ama phuv ca a mingluv ta thawsawliy zapangaa ta ama cuo.
Ama a paziy pata arina hmang a la riypa ca Manasseh phang ta ama cuo aa. Manasseh phang tie ama luochiytuv ca Pedahzur sacapaa Gamaliel ta a cuo aa,
ama phuv ca a mingluv ta thawsawthung thawhning zahning ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata Benjamin phang ta ama cuo aa: Benjamin phang tie ama luochiytuv ca Gideoni sacapaa Abidan ta a cuo aa,
ama phuv ca a mingluv ta thawsawthung thawpangaa zapaliy ta ama cuo.
Efraim arina hmang lie ca a phuv a phuv ta, ming khungpa ama bangkhuo ta thawzakha thawcari zakha ama ta. Iema hing a pathungnapa ta a pya riypata ama cuo aa.
Chaluo kuo ta a aw riypa phuv tie ca Dan phang ta ama cuo aa. Dan phang tie ama luochiytuv ca Ammishaddai sacapaa Ahiezer ta a cuo aa,
ama phuv ca a mingluv ta thawsawcaruv thawhning zasariy ta ama cuo.
Ama a vya paziy pata arina hmang a la riypa ca Asher phang ta ama cuo aa. Asher phang tie ama luochiytuv ca Okhran sacapaa Pagiel ta a cuo aa,
ama phuv ca a mingluv ta thawsawliy thawkha zapangaa ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata Naftali phang ta ama cuo a: Naftali phang tie ama luochiytuv ca Enan sacapaa Ahira ta a cuo aa,
ama phuv ca a mingluv ta thawsawngaa thawthung zapaliy ta ama cuo.
Dan arina hmang lie ca a phuv a phuv ta, ming khungpa ama bangkhuo ta thawzakhasawngaa thawsariy zacaruv ama ta. Iema hing a hnangcaw ta a pya riypata ama cuo aa.
Hingpa hing ama phang ziy pata ming khungpa Israel ming ta ama cuo; arina hmang lie a phuv a phuv ta ming khungpa bangkhuo ca thawzacaruv thawthung zapangaa sawngaa ta ama cuo.
Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haa khata, Levi ming ca Israel ming a hrangpa tie hne khata pasuvpuo va yi.
Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haa khata Israel ming ta ama tue: iema'a na ama phang, iema'a na ama chung cyicuo khata a phuv a phuv ta a ri yi te, a phuv a phuv ta ama pya.
Abyipata Sinai Tluo lie Moses kyihuo ta bie a chang ningta, Aaron hne Moses ciypathla zaw ca hing haa hing tana a cuo.
Aaron sacapaa zaw ama ming ca: Sa-uvthyi Nadab, hne Abihu, Eleazar, hne Ithamar;
hingpa zaw hing Aaron sacapaa zaw, sathu pathuvpa tluobyi tie, tluobyi re hrie riypata pacusapa tie ta ama cuo.

Nadab hne Abihu ca Sinai ruocaapa lie Abyipa hmiekunglie phungbie ta a thlupa myi ama pihluona lie thiy yi te, saata hnyi va yi. Ama paa Aaron a hring chung bangkhuo kha Eleazar hne Ithamar ta tluobyi ama hrie.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Levi phang tie kha a vawkhyi yi la tluobyi Aaron hmiekunglie kha chi tie yi, a re a bya naase yi.
Iema ca bienatluophie lie re ama hriepuo pata atawna thluodaa hmielie kha ama cuo hne zaapuv cuota re hrie naase yi.
Iema ca atawna thluodaa chechiytingby bangkhuo kha mangchiytuv cuo'a yi te, bienathluodaa lie re ama hriepuo pata Israel ming cuo khata re ama hrie aa.
Levi ming ca Aaron hne a ciypathla tie'a luo kha pi'a yi cate, Israel ming chung taa khata iema ca Aaron'a luo kha pi diy pata ama cuo aa.
Cuorasala Aaron hne a ciypathla zaw kha ca tluobyi a hrie riypata pachi tie yi. Cawsaa hrangpa ahunghmuo cuo se ama vya cadi kieca thie pata ama cuo aa.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Israel ming chungtaata Levi ming ca a nung chiy a pahaw taapa sa-uvthyi haata a paw tli yi angte, iema ca kama huopa ta ama cuo aa,

tahematapakieca sa-uvthyi bangkhuo ca kama huopa tana ama cuo. Izipt ruo lie sa-uvthyi bangkhuo i za thie ning yi kha, Israel sa-uvthyi bangkhuo, cawsaa hne sahring hne ca i cuota i pathe sa yi; iema ca kama huopa ta ama cuo aa. Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kyihuo ta Sinai ruocaapa lie kha:
Levi ming kha a phang a phang ta cuose, a chung a chung ta cuose mingluv ri tie yi. Thla kha taata a cungluo capaa bangkhuo kha na pasuvpuo diy'a yi.
Caacuonakawta Abyipata bie a pina haa khata Moses ta mingluv a ri yi.
A raw luo haa hingta Levi sacapaa zaw ca ama cuo: Gershon, Kohath hne Merari.
Hingpa hing ama chung ta ri pata Gershon sacapaa zaw ta ama cuo: Libni hne Shimei.
Ama chung ta ri pata Kohath sacapaa zaw ca: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, hne Uzziel.
Ama chung ta ri pata Merari sacapaa zaw ca: Mahli hne Mushi. Hingpa tie hing ama chung ta pasuv pa kieca Levi chung ta ama cuo.
Gershon ca Libni chung hne Shimei chung pathlatuv ta a cuo; hingpa tie hing Gershon chung tie ta ama cuo.
Ama mingluv rina lie thla kha taata a cungluo bangkhuo ama pasuvpa ca thawsariy zapangaa ta ama cuo.
Gershon chung tie ca bienathluodaa hnangluo, ningtlaluo kuo ta a cuo aa.
Gershon phang chungtaata Lael sacapaa Eliasaf ca ama luv ce ta a cuo aa.
Atawna thluodaa lie Gershon sacapaa zaw ta ama hrie riypa ca bienathluodaa cata a cuo aa, a thluodaa hne a cungkhuv, atawna thluodaa lie pathliepa pangzu,

tlawhmie dungkhuonapa pangzu, tlawhmie dungkhuo chungluo, bienathluodaa hne bienatluophie a cadungpa tlawhmie dungkhuo chungluo a ngienapa thlake pangzu, capa tie pathlienapa a riy; capa bangkhuo hne aa patuvpa re bangkhuo.
Kohath ca Amram chung hne, Izhar chung hne Hebron chung hne Uzziel chung pathlatuv ta a cuo; hingpa tie hing Kohath chung ta ama cuo.
Thla kha taata a cungluo capaa bangkhuo pasuv pata hmangpathepa lie re a hrie riypa thawcari zacaruv ta ama cuo.
Kohath chung tie ca bienathluodaa sungluo kuo ta arina hmang ama la aa.
Kohath chung tie chungtaata Uzziel sacapaa Elizafan ca ama luochiytuv ta a cuo aa.
Iema ama hrie riypa ca nawbie thingkaw, cabya, myi-ing tung, bienatluophie, tluobyi tie rehriena lie ama hmuopa hmangpathepa biphie, hne pangzu; capa zaw bangkhuo hne a patuvpa re bangkhuo.
Tluobyi Aaron sacapaa Eleazar ca Levi uvthyi zaw bangkhuo cunglie luv ce ta cuo'a te, hmangpathepa lie re a hnyipa tie uvtuv ta a cuo aa.
Merari ca Mahli chung hne Mushi chung pathlatuv ta a cuo: hingpa zaw hing Merari chung ta ama cuo.
Ama mingluv rina lie thla kha taata a cungluo bangkhuo ama pasuvpa ca thaw caruv zahning ta ama cuo.
Abihail sacapaa Zuriel ca Merari chung tie luochiytuv ta a cuo aa; iema ca bienathluodaa chaluo kuo ta arina hmang ama la aa.
Merari sacapaa zaw ama hrie riypa re ca bienathluodaa a tungtluo ta a cuopa a tluo, a tung, a patuna tie hne capa tie hne aa patuvpa a chechiy bangkhuo; capa tie hne aa patuvpa re bangkhuo,
tlawhmie dungkhuo atung bangkhuo zaw, a patuna hne a liy hne a riy zaw.
Bienathluodaa ningchiyluo kuo ta arina hmang a la riypa ca Moses hne Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw ta ama cuo aa, Israel ming cuota hmangpathepa chunglie hrie riypa bangkhuo ca iema hrievu ta a cuo aa.
Abyipabiepina ta Moses hne Aaron ta Levi ming mingluv ama lapa, thla kha taata a cungluo capaa bangkhuo ca thawkiy thawhning ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata: Israel ming sa-uvthyi capaa, thla kha taata a cungluo bangkhuo kha ama ming la yi la mingluv ri tie yi.
Cuorasala Israel ming sa-uvthyi cuopa ta Levi ming kha cuose, Israel ming sahring sa-uvthyi cuopa ta Levi ming sahring sa-uvthyi kha cuose kama cuota la tie, kama ca Abyipatana i cuo.
Caacuonakawta Abyipata bie a pipa haa khata Moses ta Israel ming sa-uvthyi bangkhuo ca mingluv a ri diy.
Thla kha taata a cungluo ming ta pasuvpa sa-uvthyi bangkhuo ca thawkiy thawhning zahning sawsariy pathung ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Israel ming sa-uvthyi cuopa ta Levi ming kha cuose, Israel ming sahring sa-uvthyi cuopa ta Levi ming sahring sa-uvthyi kha cuose kama cuota la tie, kama ca Abyipatana i cuo.
Levi ming capaa laata a hlyi ta a hluv viepa Israel ming sa-uvthyi zahning sawsariy pathung a thlana riypata
cawsaa pakha ta shekel suopangaa na la'a yi, shekel suokha ta gerah suokiy a tapa hmangpathepa lie hmuopa panangna ta na panang aa.
A hlyi ta a cuopa tie a thlanapa tuokaa ca Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw kha pi tie yi.
Caacuonakawta Moses ta Levi ming ta amaa thlapa tie khutaata a hlyi ta a cuopa tie'a taa khata a thlanapa tuokaa kha a la;
Israel ming sa-uvthyi tie'a taa khata hmangpathepa lie hmuopa panangna haata thawkha zathung sawcaruv suopangaa a la.
Cakhutaata a thlanapa tuokaa ca Moses ta Abyipabie haata, Abyipabiepina haa khata Aaron hne a sacapaa tie'a luo kha a pi.
Abyipata Moses hne Aaron kyihuo khata:
Levi ming hrangpa tie'a taata che yi la Kohath ming kha a phang a phang ta hne a chung a chung ta mingluv ri tie yi.
Kung sawthung taata kung sawngaa te, atawna thluodaa hne aa patuv pata re a hrie khu riypa bangkhuo kha mingluv ri tie yi.
Kohath ming ta atawna thluodaa hne aa patuv pata ama hriepa re ca a pathe cepa tana a cuo.
Arina hmang taata a thu riypa a cuo tiyta, Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw ta a ngie'a yi te pangzu kha pachung'a yi te, capa ca ta nawbie thingkaw kha ama buv aa.
Cakhutaata capa cunglie ca savang pha cepa khata buv'a yi te, cakhutaata a bangkhuo ta a dungpa cawthang khata buv'a yi te aa puvnapa aluo kha ama pahryi aa.

Phuovaa viechuo cabya cunglie kha cawthang a dungpa kha buv'a yi te, cakhutaata a cunglie kha pakaa, rangpa-ue pakaa aa thuvpa, kuotung, hne dangpa ta panaana khazaa-ung zaw kha ama chi aa; chi tawpa viechuo zaw kha capa cunglie ca chi pata a cuo aa.
Cakhutaata capa zaw ca cawthang sedungpa ama buv aa, savang pha cepa ta buvkhung'a yi te, cakhutaata aa puvnapa aluo ca ama pahryi aa.
Cawthang a dungpa kha la'a yi te, khena cuota myi vuona tung, a myi-ing, myi pachenapa cecakie, buvcuo liynapa, hne myitiy bi bangkhuo kha ama buv aa.
Capa ca a chechiytingby bangkhuo hne khata savang pha cepa khata pahlaw'a yi te a puvnapa aluo cunglie kha ama khang aa.
Siy bienatluophie lie kha cawthang a dungpa phaa'a yi te, savang pha cepa ta ama buv aa, cakhutaa cata aa puvnapa aluo lie kha ama pahryi aa.
Hmangpathepa lie ama hmuopa chechiy tingby bangkhuo kha la'a yi te, cawthang a dungpa chunglie kha chi'a yi te, savang phapa ta ama buv khutaata aa puvnapa aluo cunglie kha ama khang aa.
Bienatluophie lie buvcuo kha liy'a yi te, a cunglie kha cawthang ciycaapa ama phaa aa;

cakhutaata capa cunglie ca bienatluophie lie rehrie tiyta hmuopa chechiy tingby bangkhuo, buvcuo liyna phie zaw, khazin zaw, kawpia zaw, rahung zaw tapa tie bangkhuo kha chi'a yi te, savang pha cepa ta ama buv khutaata aa puvnapa aluo kha ama pahryi aa.

Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw ta hmangpathepa hne hmangpathepa chechiy tingby bangkhuo kha ama buvkhung diy khutaata arina hmang taata pyapa cuo'a te, Kohath ming ca ta capa zaw ca amaa puvle aa, cuorasala chechiy pathepa tie kha de khu'a va yi, ama de khu pathlyi kieca ama thiy aa. Hingpa tie hing Kohath ming ta amaa puvle riypa atawna thluodaa chechiy ta ama cuo.

Aaron sacapaa tluobyi Eleazar ca vuo riypa myitiy, rangpa-ue ziyhmyi, tue paripa sa ta panaana hne a thuv riypa chiytiy, bienathluodaa yalya hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo, hmangpathepa hne a chechiytingby bangkhuo mangchiytuv ta a cuo aa.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses hne Aaron kyihuo khata:
Kohath chung tie hing Levi ming chungtaata parapa ama cuo li riypa hne
a pathe cepa hmang luo amaa vaw tiyta thiy li pata ama hring riypata Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw khata a ngie yi sala ama hrie riypa re cyicuo kha a rite yi se.
Cuorasala Kohath ming ca cuo khata hmuota hmangpathepa mang repata a ngie khah yi se, caacuolikieca ama thiy aa.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Gershon ming kha a phang a phang hne a chung a chung khata mingluv ri tie yi;
kung sawthung taata kung sawngaa te, atawna thluodaa lie re a hrie khu riypa bangkhuo khata.
Gershon chung ta ama hrie riypa hne ama phya riypa ca hingpa hing tana a cuo aa:
Bienathluodaa hne a pangzu, atawna thluodaa hne a cungkhuv, tuvphya pha cepa ta tuepa a cungkhuv, atawna thluodaa angiena lie pathliepa pangzu,

a dungkhuo lie pathliepa pangzu, bienathluodaa hne bienatluophie a cadungpa a dungkhuo thlake lie pathliepa pangzu hne a riy, capa rehriena lie hmuopa chechiy bangkhuo; hne capa zaw hne cata aa patuvpa tue riypa bangkhuo kha ama tue aa.
Gershon ming ama hrie riypa bangkhuo, ama phya riypa hne ama tue riypa bangkhuo ca Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw ta ama changpa hne ama ritepa haa khata a cuo aa.
Atawna thluodaa hne aa patuv pata Gershon chung ta ama hriepa re ca tluobyi Aaron sacapaa Ithamar ta a uv'a yi.
Merari ming ca a phang a phang hne a chung a chung khata mingluv na ri'a yi.
Atawna thluodaa lie re a hrie khu riypa bangkhuo, kung sawthung taata kung sawngaa te kha mingluv na riy'a yi.
Iema phya riypata ama ritepa ca hingpa hing tana a cuo. Atawna thluodaa lie hrie riypa bangkhuo: a tungtluo yalya, a tluo zaw, a tung zaw, a liypatu zaw,
A dungkhuo tung bangkhuo hne a liypatu zaw, a liy zaw, a riy zaw, a chechiy bangkhuo hne capa tie hne aa patuvpa re bangkhuo; ama phya riypa hmang kha a ming ta na chang'a yi.
Capa ca tluobyi Aaron sacapaa Ithamar kuv rawlieta Merari chung ta atawna thluodaa hne aa patuv pata ama hrie riypa re ta a cuo.
Moses hne Aaron hne cawsaazaapuv luochiytuv tie ta Kohath ming ca a phang a phang ta hne a chung a chung ta,
atawna thluodaa hne aa patuv pata re a hrie khu riypa, kung sawthung taata kung sawngaa te kha mingluv ama ri.
A chung a chung ta mingluv ama ripa ca thawhning zasariy sawngaa ta ama cuo.
Capa ca Moses'a taata Abyipabiepina haata Moses hne Aaron ta mingluv ama ripa, atawna thluodaa lie re a hriepa, a chung a chung ta mingluv ripa Kohath ming ta ama cuo.
Atawna thluodaa hne aa patuv pata re a hrie khu riypa, kung sawthung taata kung sawngaa te,
a phang a phang ta hne a chung a chung ta mingluv ripa Gershon ming ca
thawhning zacaruv sawthung ama ta.
Moses hne Aaron ta Abyipabiepina haata mingluv ama lapa, atawna thluodaa lie re a hriepa tie, Gershon ming a chung a chung ta mingluv rina ca cahaacata a za cuo.
Merarit ming a phang a phang ta hne a chung a chung ta mingluv rina,
atawna thluodaa lie re a hrie khu riypa kung sawthung taata kung sawngaa te,
a chung a chung ta mingluv ripa ca thawthung zahning ta ama cuo.
Abyipata Moses bie a pina haata Moses hne Aaron ta mingluv ama ripa Merarit chung mingluv rina ta a cuo.
Moses hne Aaron ta a phang a phang ta hne a chung a chung ta mingluv ama ripa, mingluv ripa Levi ming bangkhuo, atawna thluodaa hne aa patuvpa re a hrie khu riypa bangkhuo,
kung sawthung taata kung sawngaa te, atawna thluodaa lie re a hrie khu riypa bangkhuo ca
thawcari zapangaa sawcari ta ama cuo.
Moses'a taata pipa Abyipanawbie haata ama ta mingluv kha ri yi te, ama hrie riypa re hne ama phya riypa hmang cyicuo kha Abyipa ta Moses bie a pina haa khata rite pata ama cuo.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Israel ming kha naw pi yi la caahminghmaa pasana a hnyipa bangkhuo, a huopa taata a tiy a pyapa, a thiypa riyy a taw nakawta a pathe lipa
canung hne capaa tie kha arina hmang taata nama papya aa; iema hrawlie kama i awnapa amaa rina hmang kha papyapalyi khah yi se.
Abyipata Moses a changpa haa khata Israel ming ta ama tue sasaw, a pathe lipa tie kha arina hmang taata ama papya.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Israel ming kha chang tie yi: capaa ta cuose, canung ta cuose malie cunglie pha lina tue te, Abyipaa zangna kha a para kieca
a suena kha aa pathlie aa. A suena cuo khata a tlingsa pata thungpakhaana a tue aa. A suena muo che pangaa che kha kha cha chiy'a te a cunglie a suenapa cawsaa kha a pi aa.
Suena muo thungpakhaapa a cu riypa uvnu ama aw li kieca Abyipa'a luo kha tluobyi cuota pipa a cuo aa, suena a tuetuv cuota pipa sue angiethena tuvtungpa hlyitaw taa khata pipa tana a cuo aa.
Israel ming ta tluobyi'a luo ama vya cyipa a pathepa pihluopa bangkhuo ca tluobyi huota a cuo aa.
A pathepa pihluopa, cawsaa ta tluobyi'a luo ama pipa khaapa hmang a cuo zaw ama huota a cuo aa.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Israel ming kha chang tie yi: Napuv pakha ca siyhraw te a navaapa cuota zang tluo aa tla li kieca,
capaa pakha ta suekhyi te cuorasala a navaapa kha chang li pata a phiy kieca, ama ca aa papya aa palyi tli raalaa pata a luo li pata a aw kieca, ama kha a hmungpuopa tehte ama aw tlung li kieca;

ruvphuvnapa pathiypalung hnyi te, aa papya aa palyi tlipa a napuv cunglie kha a palung a hring kieca, acuolikie ruvphuvnapa pathiypalung hnyi te, aa papya aa palyi li raalaa pata a napuv kha a zang li kieca,

a navaapa ta a napuvnung kha tluobyi'a luo a chiykhyi aa. Ama cuota aa hupa pihluo riypa jungsacuo viedie ephah che hraa che kha kha a vya cyi aa. Chiytiy bya'a vyi, frankinsens zaw bya'a vyi, tahematapakieca ruvphuvna kawlieta sa ta panaana cuo te, a thyi pakhaana sa ta panaana, pha lina a thyi pakhaana cuota tuepa panaana tana a cuo.
Cakhutaata tluobyi ta cawsaanung ca Abyipahmiekung luo kha a vya chiykhyi aa;
tluobyi ta alyi bi lie tiy pathepa kha la'a te, bienathluodaa lie alyi diyta zaw kha la'a te tiy chung luo kha a thung aa.
Tluobyi ta cawsaanung kha Abyipahmiekunglie kha padaa'a te, a suo kha phie'a te ruvphuvna kawlie sa ta panaana ta a cuopa a thyi pakhaana ta sa ta panaanapa sa kha a kuvpazaa chunglie kha a chi aa.

Cakhutaata tluobyi ta cawsaanung kha hing haa hingta chie a pasa sa aa. “Na navaapa uvna chunglie na aw ningta pathe lina luo a pali li pata, capaa ahungtahmuo acaa ziehne li kie yi ca chiesana a vya tlungkhyipa hingpa tiy khapa taa hingta law tie.
Cuorasala na navaapa uvna rawlie na aw ningta luo pie cate, na navaapa a cuo lipa capaa pakhakha ta caa ziekhyi te naa papya naa palyi kieca,”
tluobyi ta cawsaanung ca chie pasa sa sala, “Nama ca Abyipata na cawsaa zaw hrawlie chiesapa ca pacuo sa sala, na nu-ing kha patla sa sala, na pavaw kha papiy sa se;
chiesana a phyapa hingpa tiy hing na riy chung luo a ngie sala na nu-ing kha papiy sa sala patla sa se!” a ta aa. Cakhutaata cawsaanung ca ta, “Amen, Amen,” a ta aa.
Cakhutaata tluobyi ta capa chiesana ca caa ta cape'a te, tiy chunglie kha a paci aa.
Tluobyi ca ta chiesana tiy khapa ca cawsaanung kha a padang sa aa. Chiesana tiy ca a chung luo kha a ngie'a te khuopuv ta pasana kha a ang aa.
Tluobyi ta cawsaanung kuv lie ruvphuvna ta panaanapa sa kha la'a te, capa sa ta panaana ca Abyipahmiekunglie kha calang'a te bienatluophie luo kha a cyile aa.
Tluobyi ta a thyi parina riypata capa sa ta panaana ca a kuvpazaa zungkha ta la'a te, bienatluophie cunglie kha myi ta a rue aa. Cakhutaa cata cawsaanung kha tiy ca a padang sa aa.

Tiy a padang sa ning khata, cawsaanung ca a papya a palyi te a navaapa cuo khata zang tluo aa tla li kieca, chiesana tiy ca a chung luo kha a ngie'a te khuopuv ta pasana kha a ang aa. A nu-ing ca piy'a te a tla aa, ama ca a cawsaa zaw hrawlie kha chiesapa ta a cuo aa.
Cawsaanung ca a papya a palyi li pata a pathe kieca ama ca law'a te saata a sa aa.
Hingpa hing a navaapa uvna rawlie a awpa napuv pakha ta a papya a palyi te a siyhraw ningta cuose,

acuolikie navaapa palung chunglie ruvphuvna a ngie te a napuv a ruvphuv ningta cuose ziy riypa phungbie ta a cuo aa. Ama ta cawsaanung kha Abyipahmiekunglie padaa'a te, tluobyi ta hingpa phungbie bangkhuo haa hingta cawsaanung cunglie ca a tue aa.
Capaa ca pha lina taata law'a te, cuorasala canung ca a pha lina kha a ang aa.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Israel ming kha chang tie yi: canung cuo yi se, capaa cuo yi se a hlyi ta biekuona, nazir biekuona tue yi te Abyipacuota a nanang ta ama aw ning ca

mingsuvtiy hne zuvre kha dang'a va yi: mingsuvtiy pathuepa hne a hrangpa pathuepa tiy, mingsuv thyi taata tuepa tuokhaapa a tiy hmuo cuose dang'a va yi, mingsuv thyi kha a hringpa cuose, a caapa cuose ce'a va yi.
Nazir ama cuo chung bangkhuo ca mingsuvtiy taata tuepa khaapahmuo ning'a va yi, a hmung hne a haw hmuota ning'a va yi.
Nazir biekuona rawlie ama aw chung bangkhuo ca ama suo a ngu'a va yi; Abyipacuota a nanang ta ama awna cuo a tlingna te ca, iema ca ama pathe aa; ama suo kha amaa pahlung aa.
Abyipacuota a nanang ta ama aw chung bangkhuo ca a thiypa riyy athaa luo cakuo'a va yi.
Ama nung acuolikie ama paa, ama uvnu acuolikie ama sieta hmuo thiy yi sala a papya a palyi'a va yi; tahematapakieca Khazing'a luo amaa pathena ca ama luv cungliena a aw.
Nazir ama cuo chung bangkhuo ca Abyipacuota a pathepa tana ama cuo.

A thaalie ta cawsaa pakhakha sungkha ta thiy tlabya te, aa pathe sapa a luv kha aa papya aa palyi pathlyi kieca, aa pathe ningpa khata a luv kha aa pamyi aa; ning sariyna lie kha a luv kha aa pamyi aa.
Ning carina lie kha thuvruv sahning acuolikie valale sahning kha atawna thluodaa luo a ngienapa lie a awpa tluobyi'a luo kha a vya cyi aa.

Tluobyi ca ta sakha kha sue pathe sa panaana hne a hrangpa sakha kha myirue panaana ta pihluo'a te, ama cuo ca ta sue angiethena kha a hie aa, tahematapakieca athiypa riy kawlie tana a pyalyi tli. Capa ning caci lie kha a luv ca aa pathe sa aa.

Nazir cuo riypata Abyipacuota a nanang ta aw'a te kung kha a tapa tuvtungpa kha sue a ngiethe panaana riypata a vya cyi aa. A za tue taapa cuo kha ca ri lipa tana a cuo aa, tahematapakieca aa pathe sapa luv kha a pyalyi tli.
Capa ca nazir phungbie ta a cuo. Amaa pathe sana ningcuo kha a chuo taata: iema kha atawna thluodaa ingchiypakaa luo kha a vawkhyi pata ama cuo aa.

Ama lasaw ca Abyipakha ama pihluo aa, myirue panaana cuota kung kha a tapa a dutlapa tuvtungpa sakha, sue pathe sa panaana cuota kung kha a tapa a dutlapa tuvlaanung sakha, aviesaa panaana cuota a dutlapa tuvtungpa sakha,

thiynung phuv lipa viechuo beke zungkha, chiytiy hne pyapa jungsacuo viedie pha cepa tie ta tuepa viechuo, thiynung phuv lipa chiytiy thuvpa viechuo kuopa, hne sa ta panaana hne dangpa ta panaana zaw ta a cuo aa.
Tluobyi ta Abyipahmiekung luo kha chiykhyi'a te, sue pathe sa panaana hne myirue panaana kha a pihluo aa.
Cakhutaata tuvtungpa ca thiynung phuv lipa viechuo beke zungkha hne khata Abyipa'a luo kha aviesaa panaana ta a pihluo aa. Tluobyi ca ta sa ta panaana hne dangpa ta panaana zaw kha a pihluo aa.
Cakhutaa cata nazir tie ca atawna thluodaa ingchiypakaa lie kha amaa pathesapa ama luv ca a ngu'a yi te, aviesaa panaana rawlie a awpa myi chung luo kha ama thaw aa.

Amaa pathe sapa ama suo amaa ngu khutaa khata tluobyi ta pasu ciepa tuvtungpa pale, beke chunglie thiynung phuv lipa viechuo tluo kha, thiynung phuv lipa viechuo kuopa kaa kha zaw kha la'a te, nazir tie kuv chunglie kha a chi aa.

Cakhutaata tluobyi ca ta calang'a te Abyipahmiekunglie kha calangpa panaana ta a pihluo aa; capa tie ca calangpa a ngaw hne pihluopa a baw hne khata tluobyi cuota a pathepa cuvu ta a cuo aa. Cakhutaa cata nazir tie ca mingsuvtiy kha ama dang aa.

Hingpa hingna biekuona a tuepa nazir tie phungbie ta a cuo. Abyipa'a luo ama pihluopa zaw hing nazir biekuona phungbie haata a cuo aa, capa phungbie le luo ta ca tue khu'a va yi. Khaapa biekuona ama tue zaw amaa pathenapa phungbie ziy pata na ama tue aa.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw kha hing haa hingta chang tie yi. Hing haa hingta ri'a ung cate na Israel ming kha thluechiy nama pi aa:
Abyipata thluechiy ca pi yi sala, ca mangchiy yi se;
Abyipata nama cunglie a hmie ning haata za pa-ie sa sala, vi ca hnyi yi se;
Abyipata hmiephaa ca pi yi sala, thlaalungna ca pi yi se.
Cahaacata i ming ca Israel ming cunglie chi'a yi te, thluechiy i pi'a yi.
Moses ta bienathluodaa kha patlung te capa thluodaa hne a chechiytingby bangkhuo hne a biphie bangkhuo kha chiytiy pathuv te a pathe sa ning kha,
Israel uvthyi tie, a chung a chung ta uvthyi tie, a phang a phang ta uvthyi tie, mingluv lapa tie cunglie uvthyi a cuopa tie ta pihluona ama tue aa.

Iema ta ama pihluo riypa, a cungkhuv a hnyipa le suocaruv hne cuetungpa sahraa hlyihning, uvthyi pahning cuota le suokha, uvthyi pakha cuota cuetungpa sakha kha bienathluodaa hmiekunglie Abyipa'a luo kha ama vya chiykhyi.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Atawna thluodaa rehriena cuota hmuo riypata hingpa zaw hing iema'a taa khata cuhluo tie, iema'a na ama re hriena cyicuo cuo khata Levi ming kha pi tie yi, a ta.
Caacuonakawta Moses ta le hne cuetungpa zaw kha la te Levi ming kha a pi yi.
Le suohning hne cuetungpa sapaliy kha iema re hriena haa khata Gershon ming a pi yi.
Le suopaliy hne cuetungpa sa cari kha tluobyi Aaron sacapaa Ithamar mangchiyna rawlie a awpa Merari ming kha iema re hriena haa khata a pi yi.
Cuorasala Kohath ming ca khaapahmuo pi va yi, tahematapakieca iema ca letung ta a puvle riypa chechiy pathepa mangchiy riypata pachipa tana ama cuo.
Uvthyi tie zaw ta bienatluophie pathe sa ning, sathu ama pathuv ning ca ama lasaw kha vya cyi yi te bienathluodaa hmielie kha pihluona ama hnyi.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata: Bienathluodaa pathesana ta uvthyi pakha ta ning kha kaluo ta ama lasaw kha ama pihluo aa.
A ning khana lie pihluona a hnyipa ca Judah phang chungtaata Amminadab sacapaa Nahshon ta a cuo.

A pihluopa ca hmangpathepa lie hmuopa panangna ta shekel zakha sawthung aa riypa ngu pakaa suokha, shekel sawsariy aa riypa ngu rahung suokha, hne sa ta panaana cuota capa suohning lie a bi pata chiytiy hne pya ciepa jungsacuo viedie;
shekel suohraa aa riypa siy pakaa suokha, capa pakaa a bi pata rangpa-ue;
myirue panaana cuota cuetungpa sakha, tuvtungpa sakha, kung kha a tapa tuvtungpa sakha;
sue pathe sa panaana cuota mietungpa sakha;
aviesaa panaana cuota cuetungpa sahning, tuvtungpa sapangaa, mietungpa sapangaa, hne kung kha a tapa tuvtungpa sapangaa zaw ta a cuo. Capa ca Amminadab sacapaa Nahshon ta a pihluopa ta a cuo.
A ning hningna lie ca Issakhar ming uvtuv Zuar sacapaa Nethanel ta a pihluo.

A pihluopa ca, hmangpathepa lie hmuopa panangna ta shekel zakha sawthung aa riypa ngu pakaa suokha, shekel sawsariy aa riypa ngu rahung suokha, sa ta panaana cuota capa suohning a bi pata chiytiy pya ciepa jungsacuo viedie;
shekel suohraa aa riypa siy pakaa suokha;
myirue panaana cuota cuetungpa sakha, tuvtungpa sakha, kung kha a tapa tuvtungpa sakha;
sue pathe sa panaana cuota mietungpa sakha;
aviesaa panaana cuota cuetungpa sahning, tuvtungpa sapangaa, mietungpa sapangaa, hne kung kha a tapa tuvtungpa sapangaa zaw ta a cuo. Capa ca Zuar sacapaa Nethanel ta a pihluopa ta a cuo.
A ning thungna lie a pihluopa ca Zebulun ming uvtuv Helon sacapaa Eliab ta a cuo:

a pihluopa ca, hmangpathepa lie hmuopa panangna ta shekel zakha sawthung aa riypa ngu pakaa suokha, shekel sawsariy aa riypa ngu rahung suokha, sa ta panaana cuota capa suohning a bi pata chiytiy pya ciepa jungsacuo viedie;
shekel suohraa aa riypa siy pakaa suokha, capa pakaa a bi pata rangpa-ue;
myirue panaana cuota cuetungpa sakha, tuvtungpa sakha, kung kha a tapa tuvtungpa sakha;
sue pathe sa panaana cuota mietungpa sakha;
aviesaa panaana cuota cuetungpa sahning, tuvtungpa sapangaa, mietungpa sapangaa, hne kung kha a tapa tuvtungpa sapangaa ta a cuo. Capa ca Helon sacapaa Eliab ta a pihluopa ta a cuo.

A ning hraa hlyihningna lie ca Naftali ming uvtuv Enan sacapaa Ahira ta a pihluo:

a pihluopa ca, hmangpathepa lie hmuopa panangna ta shekel zakha sawthung aa riypa ngu pakaa suokha, shekel sawsariy aa riypa ngu rahung suokha, sa ta panaana cuota capa suohning a bi pata chiytiy pya ciepa jungsacuo viedie;
shekel suohraa aa riypa siy pakaa suokha, capa pakaa a bi pata rangpa-ue;
myirue panaana cuota cuetungpa sakha, tuvtungpa sakha, kung kha a tapa tuvtungpa sakha,
sue pathe sa panaana cuota mietungpa sakha;
aviesaa panaana cuota cuetungpa sahning, tuvtungpa sapangaa, mietungpa sapangaa, hne kung kha a tapa tuvtungpa sapangaa ta a cuo. Capa ca Enan sacapaa Ahira ta a pihluopa ta a cuo.

Bienathluodaa kha chiytiy ama thuv ningta, Israel ming uvthyi tie ta bienathluodaa pathesana cuota ama pihluopa ca: ngu pakaa suohraa hlyihning, ngu rahung suohraa hlyihning, siy pakaa suohraa hlyihning,
ngu pakaa suokha cyicuo aa riyna ca shekel sawthung, hne rahung suokha cyicuo aa riyna ca shekel sawsariy, ngu bi bangkhuo ca hmangpathepa panangna ta shekel thawhning zapaliy aa riy.
Hmangpathepa panangna ta ngu rahung suohraahlyihning ca rangpa-ue a bi pata shekel suohraa kaluo, ngu rahung bangkhuo ta shekel zakha suokiy;

myirue panaana cuota hmuopa sahring bangkhuo ca, cuetungpa sahraa hlyihning, tuvtungpa sahraa hlyihning, kung kha a tapa tuvtungpa sahraa hlyihning, sa ta panaana cyicuo hneta a cuo; cakhutaa cata sue pathe sa panaana cuota mietungpa sahraa hlyihning;

aviesaa panaana cuota hmuopa sahring bangkhuo ca, cuetungpa sakiy sapaliy, tuvtungpa sawcaruv, mietungpa sawcaruv, kung kha a tapa tuvtungpa sawcaruv ta a cuo. Capa ca chiytiy pathuv khutaata bienatluophie pathesana cuota hmuopa tie ta ama cuo.

Moses ca Abyipahne bie a chaw riypata atawna thluodaa luo aa ngie ning kha, biekuona thingkaw cunglie a awpa cherubim sahning tie alalalie a awpa nangduena thude cung taata ama'a luo bie zaa ripa ueryi kha a thyi.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Aaron kha chang tie: Myi-ing na vuo tiyta, myi-ing suosariy tie khata myi-ing tung hmieluo kha a pakhe riypata a cuo aa, a ta.
Aaron ta cahaacata a tue; Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haa khata myi-ing kha myi-ing tung luo a khe riypata a vuo.
Myi-ing tung ama tuenazya ca, siy kha khunglung ta de yi te tuepa phang ta a cuo. Abyipata Moses a pahmung sapa haa khata a thabaw taata a paapaapa te ta khunglung ta de pata tuepa a cuo.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Levi ming ca Israel ming chung taa khata la yi la pathe sa tie yi.
Cahaacata iema kha na pathe sa khutaa yi ta: tiy pathepa kha hi'a yi cate, ama pangpa lie a awpa hming bangkhuo kha a ngu'a yi te ama caw kha pasuv'a yi te amaa pathe sa aa.
Cakhutaata cue atungnupa sakha kha chiytiy pya ciepa jungsacuo viedie phapa, sa ta panaana hne khata cuose, sue pathe sa panaana cuota a hrangpa cue atungnupa sakha zaw kha ama la aa.
Levi ming kha atawna thluodaa hmiekung luo a vawkhyi'a ung cate, Israel ming cawsaazaapuv kha na pahmya'a yi.
Levi ming kha Abyipahmiekunglie na pahmya tiy yi ta, Israel ming khata Levi ming cung luo kha ama kuv pazu'a yi te,
Iema ta Abyipare kha ama hrie thena riypata, Israel ming calangpa panaana cuota, Aaron ta Abyipa'a luo kha a pihluo'a yi.

Levi ming ta cuetungpa luv cunglie kha ama kuv khang'a yi te, nama ta sakha kha sue pathe sa panaana ta cuose, a hrangpa sakha kha myirue panaana ta cuose, Levi ming sue angiethena cuota Abyipa'a luo na pihluo aa.
Cakhutaata Levi ming kha Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw hmiekunglie padaa'a yi cate, Abyipa'a luo kha calangpa panaana ta na pihluo'a yi.
Cakhutaata Levi ming kha Israel ming hrangpa chungtaata che'a yi cate, Levi ming ca kama huopa ta ama cuo aa.
Cakhutaa cata Levi ming ca calangpa panaana ta na pihluo khutaa yi ta atawna thluodaa chunglie re hrie riypata amaa ngie aa.
Tahematapakieca iema ca Israel ming chungtaata kama'a luo ama yalya ta pipa tana ama cuo. Iema ca Israel ming sahrangta, a nung chiy a pahaw taapa tie haata kama huota i lapa yi tana ama cuo.
Israel ming chunglie sahrangta bangkhuo, cawsaa hne sahring hne ca kama huopa tana a cuo. Izipt ruo lieta sahrangta bangkhuo i za thie diy ning yi kha iema ca kama huota i za pathe sa yi,
cuorasala Levi ming ta Israel ming chunglie sahrangta bangkhuo cuopa ta kama ta i la tli yi.

Ca hlyitaw taata, Israel ming chungtaata Levi ming ca Israel ming cuota atawna thluodaa lie re hrie riypata cuose, Israel ming cuota sue angiethena tue riypata cuose, Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw kha lasaw ta i pi tli yi. Israel ming ta hmangpathepa luo amaa vya ngie tuv nakawta ama cunglie puvtlung pasana a tlung li riypa tana a cuo, a ta.
Abyipata iema hne aa patuv pata Moses cunglie bie a pipa haa khata Moses hne Aaron hne Israel ming cawsaazaapuv ta Levi ming cunglie kha a phungpa haata ama tue.

Levi ming ca ama suena taata a pathe sa yi te ama caw kha ama pasuv; cakhutaata Aaron ta iema ca Abyipahmiekunglie kha calangpa panaana haata pihluo yi te, iema kha pathe sa riypata sue angiethena a tuepa yi.
Cakhutaa cata Levi ming ca re hrie riypata atawna thluodaa lie Aaron hne a sacapaa zaw'a luo kha amaa ngie. Levi ming hne aa patuv pata Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haa khata iema cunglie kha ama tue.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Hing haa hing tana Levi ming ta re ama hrie aa: kung kiy kung pangaa taata a cung luo tie ta atawna thluodaa lie kha re ama hrie aa;
kung sawngaa ama hlyi kieca re taata a ding'a yi te hrie'a va tli yi.
Atawna thluodaa lie re a hriepa ama uvnu zaw kha a bya'a yi te, cuorasala iema ta ca re kha hrie'a va tli yi. Cahaacata Levi ming re hrie riypa ca na rite'a yi.
Izipt ruo taata ama vya pya khutaata a kung hningnapa thla khana lieta Abyipata Moses kha Sinai ruocaapa chunglie chaw te:
Israel ming ta lawsena pyi ca thli ciepa a cuo lie khata tue yi se.
Ata thlaa ning hraa hlyipaliy ning, ning tla cawta, a cuo thli ciena haa khata; a phungluo hne ziyphung haa khata nama tue aa, a ta.
Caacuonakawta Moses ta Israel ming kha lawsena pyi kha tue riypata a chang yi.
Israel ming ta lawsena pyi ca thla khana thlaa ning hraa hlyipaliy ning, ning tla caw khata Sinai ruocaapa lie kha ama tue. Abyipata Moses bie a pipa dadang haa khata Israel ming ta ama tue.
Cawsaa chekha ca a thiypa riyy kha ama taw nakawta pathe li pata aw yi te, capa ning lie ca lawsena pyi kha tue khu va yi. Moses hne Aaron'a luo kha a vaw yi te:
“A thiypa riyy ma taw nakawta pathe li pata aw hmuo ra pa sala, Israel ming hrawlieta a cuo thli ciepa lie Abyipa'a luo pihluona tue riypa kha khaapanakawma malie nama thlu aa?” ama ta.
Moses ta iema kha, “Niema kawlie Abyipata tuokhaatama bie ina pi tapa kha huo caw tie ung,” a ta yi.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:

Israel ming kha chang tie yi: Niema chungtaata cawsaa pakhakha acuolikie nama ciypathla pakhakha ca cawsaa riyy kha taw te a pathe li kie cuose, luohlaa luo khy a tlaw kie cuose, Abyipacuota lawsena pyi kha a tue ngiethie aa.
Thla hningna ning hraa hlyipaliy ning ning tla caw ta ama tue aa; thiynung phuv lipa viechuo hne a khapa hnaa hne khata ama ning aa.
Maw te ta khaapahmuo pangaa'a va yi, a ruv zaw suokha hmuo thli'a va yi; lawsena pyi phungluo haa kha tana ama tue aa.

Cuorasala a pathepa cuo te luohlaa luo khy a tlaw li pata lawsena pyi a tue lipa ca thli ciepa cuo ningta Abyipa'a luo pihluona a tue li nakawta a cawsaa zaw'a taata thaw pata a cuo aa; a suena muo kha ama ta a ang aa.
Niema hrawlie a awpa ruohrang ming ta Abyipa'a luo lawsena pyi kha a tue khing kieca Lawsena pyi phungluo hne ziyphung haa khata a tue aa; mingpe hne ruo ming cuota phungluo suokha na nama hnyi aa.
Bienathluodaa ama padaa ning kha amyi ta bienathluodaa, biekuona thluodaa ca a buv; zuoluocaw taata maw te khata bienathluodaa cunglie ca myihlaa haa khata a aw.
Cahaacata a aw pari: ningchung ta amyi ta buv te zuo ca myihlaa haa khata a aw.
Thluodaa taa khata amyi aa calangthaw pahne ta Israel ming ca si riypata amaa thu; amyi za cung te aa daana lie kha Israel ming ca arina hmang amaa tue.
Israel ming ca Abyipabiepina haa khata si yi te, Abyipabiepina haa khata arina hmang amaa tue. Bienathluodaa lie amyi aa pahy chung bangkhuo kha arina hmang lie ama aw.
Amyi ca bienathluodaa cunglie kha ning hluvpuv a aw kie zawma Israel ming ta Abyipabie kha ziy yi te si riypata a tha va yi.
Cuokhakha ca amyi ca bienathluodaa cunglie kha ning cawta dyi aw te, Abyipabiepina haa khata arina hmang lie kha amaa aw, Abyipabiepina haa khata si riypata amaa tha.
Cuokhakha ca amyi ca zuoluocaw taata maw te khata aa pahy; amyi ca maw ta a si kieca iema zaw a tha yi te ama si.

Amyi kha ning hning, acuolikie thla kha, acuolikie cuo syi vie bienathluodaa cunglie kha aa pazue pata aw te aa pahy kieca, Israel ming ca arina hmang lie kha aw yi te si riypata a tha va yi; cuorasala amyi kha a calang te a si kieca iema zaw a tha yi te ama si.
Abyipabiepina hne a ding yi te, Abyipabiepina hneta a tha yi te ama si. Abyipata Moses bie a pina haa khata Abyipabie ca a ma ziy.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Hmyakaa suohning tue tie; khunglung ta depa ta na tue aa; cawsaazaapuv kuna hne arina hmang taata a thana riypa cuota na hmuo aa.
Capa hmyakaa suohning ama tung pahne ta cawsaazaapuv ca na hmiekunglie atawna thluodaa angiena lie kha amaa vya hmya aa.
Cuorasala suokha dyi ama tung kieca uvthyi tie, Israel ming a phang luv a cuopa tie kha na hmiekung luo amaa vya hmya aa.
Pahlupadana ta na tung kieca arina hmang ningchiyluo kuo ta a ripa tie kha a tha'a yi te ama si aa.
A yihningnapa pahlupadana ta na tung kieca arina hmang sungluo kuo lie a ripa tie kha a tha'a yi te ama si aa.
Cuorasala cawsaazaapuv kha a hmya riypata a cuo kieca, na tung aa, cuorasala pahlupadana ta tung'a vaciy.
Aaron sacapaa, tluobyi tie khata hmyakaa kha ama tung aa; hingpa hing nama chuo bangkhuo ta nama ziy pari riypa tana a cuo aa.

Nama ruo chunglie niema caa tuechiepa nama carie tie hne namaa du tiyta, hmyakaa kha pahlupadana ta na tung aa; Abyipahmiekunglie kha a thyi pata cuo'a te nama carie tie'a taata khuo pata nama cuo aa.

Namaa lawna ning ta a cuopa, ama'a na a cuo lieta tuepa pyi, hne nama thlaa hruothuna lie zaw kha, nama myirue panaana hne aviesaa panaana lie zaw kha hmyakaa ca nama tung aa; capa ca Abyipata niema a caa thyina yi a cuo aa: Kama ca niema AbyipaKhazing tana i cuo.
A kung hningnapa thla hningna thlaa ning kiy ning ta amyi ca bienathluodaa taata aa calang.
Israel ming ca Sinai ruocaapa taa cata a tha yi te ama si, cakhutaata amyi ca Paran ruocaapa lie kha aa daa.
Abyipa ta Moses bie a pina haata amaa tha taanapa tana a cuo.
Ama pangtaa kha calangle yi te Judah phang ca arina hmang taa khata amaa tha taa, iema phuv uvtuv hne luochiytuv ca Amminadab sacapaa Nahshon ta a cuo.
Isskhar ming phang a phuv uvtuv hne luochiytuv ca Nethanel ta a cuo.
Zebulun phang uvtuv hne luochiytuv ca Helon sacapaa Eliab ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata bienathluodaa ca phi yi te, bienathluodaa a phyatuv Gershon ming hne Merari ming ca amaa tha.
A paziy pata Reuben phang kha a phuv a phuv ta arina hmang taa cata amaa tha; Iema phang a uvtuv hne luochiytuv ca Shedeur sacapaa Elizur ta a cuo.
Simeon phang a uvtuv hne luochiytuv ca Zurishaddai sacapaa Shelumiel ta cuo te,
Gad mingphang a uvtuv hne luochiytuv ca Deuel sacapaa Eliasaf ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata chechiy pathepa a puvlepa Kohath ming kha amaa tha; iema ama pha hluo cata bienathluodaa ca ama za padaa tli.
Cakhutaata Efraim ming kha a phuv a phuv ta ama pangtaa calangle yi te amaa tha, iema a uvtuv hne luochiytuv ta Ammihud sacapaa Elishama ta a cuo.
Manasseh ming a uvtuv hne luochiytuv ca Pedahzur sacapaa Gamaliel ta a cuo.
Benjamin phang a uvtuv hne luochiytuv ca Gideoni sacapaa Abidan ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata arina hmang bangkhuo rievetuv Dan phang ca ama pangtaa kha calangle yi te a phuv a phuv ta amaa tha, iema tie phang a uvtuv hne luochiytuv ca Ammishaddai sacapaa Ahiezer ta a cuo.
Asher phang uvtuv hne luochiytuv ca Ochran sacapaa Pagiel ta a cuo.
Naphtali phang a uvtuv hne luochiytuv ca Enan sacapaa Ahira ta a cuo.
Capa ca Israel ming a phuv a phuv ta a tha yi te ama silenazya ta a cuo.

Moses ta a puvpa Midian ming phang Reuel sacapaa Hobab kyihuo khata: Kiema ca Abyipata niema na ica pi'a yi malie a tapa ruo luo khana ma sile nguoluo; kiema'a lie hing vya si ra tie; na cunglie ma pha aa; tahematapakieca Abyipana Israel ming kha a phapa bie malie a kuo,” a ta.
Cuorasala ama ta, “Vya si ra'a va ang, cuorasala i ruo luo, i tie ta zaw'a luo khana i kaa aa,” a ta.
Ama ta, “Malie thuse thi khah, tahematapakieca ruocaapa lie kha tuokhaatama arina hmang maa tue aa tapa kha nama na a pachang ciy, nama ta malie na mangkhyile kie dyi muo a cuo the'a ta.
Ca hlyitaw taata, kiema hne na vya si ra kieca, Abyipata kiema'a lie khaapa phana a tue zaw, nama cunglie kha ma tue ra aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Abyipatluo taa cata a tha yi te, Abyipabiekuona thingkaw hne cata ning thung chung ama si; iema cuota a dingna hmang huvlu riypa khata ning thung chung ama silu.
Arina hmang taata ama pya tiyta Abyipaamyi ca ningchung kha iema cunglie a awle.
Biekuona thingkaw aa tha kyry ta, Moses ta, “Thu tie, Vya Abyipa, na carie tie ca a chepatlaa diy yi se, nama caa cariepa tie ca na hmiekung taa khata a ruo yi se,” a ta.
Aa pahy kyry ta, Vya Abyipa, Vya kaa tie, a thaw a saa Israel ming'a luo hing,” a ta.
Cawsaa ta Abyipathyinapa lie kha ama riethyina kawlieta amaa cie tiyta, Abyipata thyi te a hihaana ca myi ie ta a ie. Abyipamyi ta iema ca kuo yi te, arina hmang a kieluo kuo kha a kuo.
Ca tiyta cawsaa zaw ta khi yi te Moses kha ama chang. Moses ta Abyipa'a luo kha thlaachuo te myi ca a die.
Caacuonakawta capa hmang ca Taberah ama ta, tahematapakieca Abyipamyi ta iema kha a kuo yi.
Iema hrawlie a si rapa ruohrang ming chekha ca ama nang a paruosa; Israel ming zaw ta caa yi te, “Saa ce riypa hnyi se pala ca!” ama ta.
Izipt ruo lie a muo li pata ma ce tawpa ngaa, paziy, phazeti, ruo khaachung, khaachung sepa hne khaachung ruopa zaw khana vuo a chiysa;
cuorasala ata hing ca ma thaa chuo te, hingpa manna ri li pata ca a hrangpa khaapahmuo hmung vapuv,” ama ta.
Manna ca koriander hmung kha lu te, a hmingciy ca myisaa cathliy haata a ta.
Cawsaa ta vaa khie yi te ama pakhaw, rienapa alung ta ama rie, acuolikie sungcuo lie kha suv yi te, bi ta pasu yi te viechuo ama tue; a pahuonazya ca chiytiy hneta ruepa viechuo haata a ta.
Arina hmang lie zuo ta aduo a tlapa hneta manna ca a za tla pakhaw.
Moses ta cawsaa tie chungkhue kyry ta ama ingchiypakaa lie ama caapa kha a thyi. Abyipaca a hi haa hringhruo te, Moses ca a palung tluo vyi.

Caacuonakawta Moses ta Abyipakyihuo khata, “Khaapanakawma na changtaapa hing pha li ta ina tue ciy? Khaapanakawma na hmiephaa na pahmung sa lipa cata hingpa cawsaa bangkhuo tie hmangriypa hing i cunglie na khang?

Nama ta, “Nu a awkhyipa ta meme a pazaw kaliepa haatiy kha a cacunghnaa lie a pabepuopa haata ama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie ica pi hrahring'a yi ta pata chie a sa angte bie i kuopa ruo luo kha sikhyi tie yi, ta riypa hingta, hingpa cawsaa zaw hing nu haata phya yi angte ma kama ta i sa yi?
Hingpa cawsaa zawdya pi riypa saa hing khaapaliema i hmung khu aa? Kama'a luo vya caa yi te, “Ma ce riypa saa malie pi tie,” ina ta yi?
Kama selaw ta ca hingpa cawsaa bangkhuo hing phya khu'a va yi ang, i cuo tana amaa riy tuv suesaa.
Hing haa hing tana ina tue'a ciy tapa kieca, sungkhata tah na za thie tie, na hmiephaa na i hmung tapa kieca, palungriethyina kha na pahmung sa khah,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata, “Israel ming uvthyi sawsariy, cawsaa cunglie uvthyi hne uvtuv ta ama cuo ta pata na pachangpa tie kha kama cuota na pahmyapa tie yi; atawna thluodaa luo kha a vawkhyi yi la capa lie ca naa thaalie kha padaa tie yi.

Za cung'a angte capa lie ca nama hne bie i ri aa; na cunglie a awpa thlaapa chekha kha la'a angte, iema cunglie kha chi'a angte, nama seta cawsaa zaw hmang riy kha na phya li riypata iema ta aca phya khyi'a yi.

Cakhutaata cawsaa tie kha: Mawluo cuota niema hne niema kha a pathe sa tie ung, saa na nama ce aa; tahematapakieca Abyipathyinapa lie kha caa ung cate, ‘Saa ce riypa hnyi se pala a pha'a pa kha! Izipt lie ma awpa khana kiema cuota a pha vie,’ nama ta. Caacuonakawta Abyipata saa ca pi'a yi te nama ce aa.
Ning kha dyi, ning hning dyi, ning pangaa dyi, ning hraa dyi, ning kiy dyi ce'a va ung ciy,

cuorasala thla kha bangpa ta na nama ce aa, nama hnaakhue taata saa rang pya'a te saa kha duv ung cate nama huena te tana nama ce aa, tahematapakieca nama hrawlie a awpa Abyipakha thaw ung cate, ‘Khaapanakawma Izipt kha ma vya pyase?’ ta ung cate a hmiekunglie kha nama caa,” ta tie yi, a ta.
Cuorasala Moses ta, “Kama ripuo pata phyi ta a cakuopa cawsaa thaw za caruv ma ta; nama ta, ‘Iema kha saa pi'a yi angte thla kha bangpa ta ama ce aa!’ na ta.
Iema cuota thiepa riypa yi tuv hne cue aa de pata a aw'a ma? a ta.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata: Abyipacahrana hing tue khu lipa a hnyi ma? I bie hing na cuota aa hmuo ma a hmuo va ma tapa na hmung aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Moses ca pya te cawsaa kha Abyipabie ca a chang yi; cakhutaata uvthyi sawsariy kha pahmya yi te thluodaa athaalie kha a chi yi.

Cakhutaata Abyipaca amyi taa khata za cung te ama'a lie kha bie a ri, cakhutaata thlaapa chekha kha la te uvthyi sawsariy tie cunglie kha a chi. Thlaapa kha iema cunglie a tlung tiyta profet bie kha ama ri. Cuorasala cahaacata tue pakhaa va tli yi.

Eldad ama tapa paa hne a hrangpa pakha Medad ama tapa kha arina hmang lie a ngaa yi te ama cunglie thlaapa a tlung. Iema ca ming pasuvpa lie kha ama aw ra raalaa pata thluodaa luo kha vaa ra va yi, caacuonakawta arina hmang lie kha profet bie ca ama ri.
Satlie pakha ta a ruo te, “Eldad hne Medad na arina hmang lie profet bie a ri yi,” ta pata Moses kha a va chang.
Cakhutaata Moses ta aa tlawpa a re a byatuv, Nun sacapaa Joshua ta, “I byipa Moses, thlu tie yi!” a ta.
Cuorasala Moses ta, “Kama kawlieta hietliena hnyi kanaa ciy? Abyipacawsaa bangkhuo hing profet cuo yi sala, Abyipata ama cunglie kha a thlaapa chi se tapa i khing nala ta!” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata Moses hne uvthyi tie ca arina hmang luo kha ama kaa.

Cakhutaata Abyipa'a taata thliy kha a hruo te, riyliy taata mamang kha vya phya te arina hmang athaalie kha a vya pathla, hingpaluo kuo hingta ning kha luosi tluv, kuokhaluo kuo ta ning kha luosi tluv, arina hmang a cadung pata daw hning tluv a chaa pata a pathla.

Caacuonakawta cawsaa tie ca capa ning ningchung hne zuo, hne mawluo ning-aw ningtlabu ta mamang ca amaa haa. A caw ce a haa pata homer suohraa a haa; amaa rina hmang cahriy bangkhuo khata phu yi te ama pacaa.
Cuorasala saa ca ama haa alalalie a aw kalie ning, ama ce diy hluota Abyipahihaana kha cawsaa zaw cunglie ca tlung te, Abyipata cawsaa zaw kha a lesapa puvtlung pasana ta a de yi.
Caacuonakawta capa hmang ca Kibroth-hattaavah ama ta, tahematapakieca capa lie ca a nangparuopa cawsaa tie kha ama paby nakawta a cuo.
Cawsaa ca Kibroth-hattaavah taa cata Hazeroth luo kha ama si.
Hazeroth lie ama aw ning kha Moses ta Kush zaanung kha aa hlaw nakawta Aaron hne Miriam ta Moses thuochi kha ama ri.
Iema ta, “Moses'a taa kyalya dyi tama Abyipata bie a ri? Kiema'a taa zaw hingta ri ra'a va ma” ama ta. Capa ca Abyipata a thyi.
Moses ca chuelyicung cawsaa hrawlie raw a canaw cepa ta a cuo.
Sungkhabala ta Abyipata Moses, Aaron hne Miriam zaw kyihuo khata, “Kya pya tie ung, nama pathung ta, atawna thluodaa luo kha,” a ta yi. Caacuonakawta ama pathung ta ama kya pya.
Cakhutaata Abyipaca amyi taw khata za cung te, thluodaa luo a ngiena lie kha a daa te, Aaron hne Miriam kha a u yi; ama pahning ta hmieluo kha ama vya pya.
Cakhutaata ama ta, “I bie hing naathlie tie ung: Niema hrawlie profet ama aw tiyta, Kama Abyipata muocuo ta i pachang sa yi; ama muo ta bie i chang yi.
Cuorasala i changtaapa Moses ca cahaacata cuo vyi; i ing kha a kuv chungliena i chi diy.

Ama hne ca a hmiepachaw pata bie ri angte, bienupa ta cuo li pata, a siesa pata na i chang. Cakhutaata ama ca, Abyipahmingsuo a hmungpa tana a cuo. Khaapanakawma i changtaapa Moses hing a thuo nama pachi nguo?” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipaca iema cunglie a hi haa cangta a cakuo.
Amyi ca thluodaa cung taa khata aa hnyi pahne ta Miriam ca caahminghmaa pasana kha hnyi te cahue haata a ruo. Aaron ca Miriam'a luo kha aa pali ca caahminghmaa pasana a hnyipa kha a hmung.
Cakhutaata Aaron ta Moses kyihuo khata, “Vya, i byipa, ma ngaa tuv pata ma tuepa suena cuo khata duo malie te thi khah.
Ama ca a nung riy chungtaata a za puv ningta a saa chekha a chuo cie tlipa haata pacuo sa thi khah,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Moses ta Abyipakha u te, “Vya Khazing hingpa nung hing patluo sa thi tie,” a ta.

Cuorasala Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata, “A paa ta a hmielie kha a paciy ta pacha sala, a nangzaana kha ning sariy ca a ang aa cuo va ma? Ama ca ning sariy chung arina hmang taata papya pata cuo sala, cakhutaa cata a chung luo pangie pakhaa pata cuo se,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Miriam ca arina hmang taata ning sariy chung papya pata a cuo aa; Miriam ama pangie pakhaa hluo li cawsaa zaw ca a tha li pata ama aw.
Ama pangie khutaa dyi ta cawsaa zaw ca Hazeroth taa khata a tha yi te, Paran ruocaapa lie kha arina hmang amaa tue.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata,
“Israel ming i pi riypa yi ruo kha vaa ngiepatlie riypata mingphang phang kha taata uvtuv hne luochiytuv pakha kaluo a tlaw yi la Kanaan ruo luo kha pathlie tie yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Moses ta Abyipabiepina haa khata Israel ming uvtuv hne luochiytuv bangkhuo ca Paran ruocaapa taa khata a pathlie yi.
Ama ming ca: Reuben phang taata Zakkur sacapa Shammua,
Simeon phang taata Hori sacapaa Shafat;
Judah phang taata Jefunneh sacapaa Kaleb;
Issakhar phang taata Josef sacapaa Igal;
Efraim phang taata Nun sacapaa Hoshea;
Benjamin phang taata Rafu sacapaa Palti;
Zebulun phang taata Sodi sacapaa Gaddiel;
Josef phang taata (capa ca Manasseh phang taata a cuo) Susi sacapaa Gaddi;
Dan phang taata Gemalli sacapaa Ammiel;
Asher phang taata Mikhael sacapaa Sethur;
Naftali phang taata Vofsi sacapaa Nahbi;
Gad phang taata Makhi sacapaa Geuel;
Hingpa tie hing Moses ta ruo a ngiepatlie riypata a pathliepa tie ta ama cuo. Moses ta Nun sacapaa Hoshea kha Joshua ta pata a ming a thle.
Moses ta iema ca Kanaan ruo kha a ngiepatlie riypata pathlie yi te hing haa hingta a chang yi, “Negeb ruo luo khiy si ung la, tluocung ruo chung khiy sithaw tie ung,
ruo ca khaapama a lu tapa kha mang ung la, a chunglie a awpa cawsaa zaw kha ama thaa a ruv ma acuolikie ama thaa a caw ma, a ma hluv ma acuolikie ama caw ma,
ama chuelyi haw a pha ma a chie ma, ama awnapa khypuv zaw kha a dungkhuo lipa ma acuolikie a cusa pata dungkhuopa ma,

ama ruo ca a hnyirung ma a siypasa ma, thingkungpa a aw ma aw va ma tapa kha nama mang aa. Nama rie pha se, cakhutaata ruo lie a awpa thingthyi chekha za phya mya ung,” a ta yi. Capa cuo ca mingsuv thyi a hming taapa tie a hming cuo ningta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta iema ca sithaw yi te Zin ruocaapa taata Lebo-hamath athaalie a awpa Rehob ruocaapa te kha amaa kya ngiepatlie.

Negeb luo kha a kya ngie yi te Hebron luo kha amaa vaw; capa lie ca Anak ming Ahiman, Sheshai, hne Talmai tapa tie kha ama za aw. (Hebron ca Izipt lie Zoan ama za tla hluo kung sariy lieta za tlapa tana a cuo).

Cakhutaa cata Eshkol bawphie luo kha ama pha, capa ruo lie a pathyipa mingsuv thyi baw kha kha a nge ta sapachung yi te cawsaa pahning ta aluo ta amaa puvle. Cale thyi hne thyikuv zaw kha ama za phyale.
Capa hmang ca Eshkol Bawphie ama ta, tahematapakieca Israel ming ta mingsuv thyi baw kha a nge ta ama sapachungnapa hmang a cuo nakawta a cuo.
Ning sawliy a chuo taata ruo a ngiepatliena taa khata ama za kaa.

Cakhutaata Paran ruocaapa chung Kadesh lie, Moses hne Aaron hne Israel ming cawsaazaapuv'a luo kha za pha yi te, iema hne cawsaazaapuv'a luo ca bie za phya yi te, ama za phyapa thingthyi zaw kha ama pahmung.
Cakhutaata Moses kyihuo khata, “Malie na pathlienapa ruo luo kha ma chiy; cuehnung hne khyitiy za lang te, hingpa hing a thingthyi ta a cuo.
Capa ruo lie a awpa cawsaa zaw ca ama thaa a ruv, khypuv zaw ca le hringhruo yi te aa dungkhuo diy; ca dyi cuo li pata Anak ciypathla zaw kha capa lie ca ma hmung yi.
Negeb ruo lieta Amalek ming aw yi te, tluocung ruo lie kha Hit ming, Jebus ming hne Amor ming ama aw; Kanaan ming kha riyliy kie hne Jordan cavaa kie thlyalya ta ama aw,” ama ta.
Cuorasala Kaleb ta cawsaa zaw kha Moses hmiekunglie ca a dieta tah pa-aw sa yi te, “Sithaw paluo ung sala ama ruo ca kya la ung siy, tahematapakieca a nasa pata ma te'a yi,” a ta.
Ama hne a sihnepa cawsaa tie khata, “Iema kha a du khu'a va yi puv, tahematapakieca iema ca kiema laa tana ama thaa a ruv vie,” ama ta.

Cahaacata amaa kya ngiepatliepa ruo kaw ca Israel ming'a lie kha a pha lina kuo luo ta ri yi te, “A ngiepatlie riypata ma si hnuepa ruo ca a chunglie a awpa cawsaa zaw a ningpa ruo tana a cuo; cakhutaata capa ruo lie a awpa ma hmungpa cawsaa zaw ca ama pangpa a le laalaw.
Capa lie ca Nefilim ming (Nefilim ciypathla Anak ming) kha hmung yi pate, iema hmiekunglie ca khawbyapa tie dyi ta a hmung pate, iema hmungna lie zaw cahaaca tana ma cuo,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata cawsaazaapuv ca khuosa ta khi yi te, capa zuo ca cawsaa kha ama caa.
Israel ming cawsaa bangkhuo khata Moses hne Aaron kha sue be yi te, “Izipt ruo lie kha za thiy se pala a pha vie aa! Acuolikie ruocaapa chunglie hing thiy se pala a pha vie aa!
