Khaapanakawma Abyipata zueziy ta thiy diy riypata hingpa ruo luo hing malie aa chiy? Ma napuv hne ma saata bangkhuo hing carie ta patuv riypa dyi ta muo ama cuo'a ta; Izipt luo kaa se pala kiema cuota pha vie'a va ma?” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta pakha hne pakha kha, “Uvtuv hne luochiytuv pakha a tlaw ung sala Izipt luo kha kaa ung siy,” amaa ta.
Cakhutaata Moses hne Aaron ca aa hmyapa Israel ming cawsaazaapuv hmielie kha a lyi lie amaa bu.
Ruo a ngiepatlie riypata a sipa tie hrawtaata Nun sacapaa Joshua hne Jefunneh sacapaa Kaleb ta ama caw kha thlaa yi te,
Israel ming cawsaazaapuv kyihuo khata, “Maa kya ngiepatliepa ruo hing a pha hringhruopa ruo tana a cuo.
Abyipana ima cunglie a palung a tluo tapa kieca, ama ta malie a chiyle'a te capa cuehnung hne khyitiy langnapa ruo ca malie a pi aa.

Cadyiseca Abyipahing ca a du khah ung siy, capa ruo lie cawsaa zaw kha ciy khah ung siy, tahematapakieca ma cuota sa tana ama cuo; iema amaa bangna ca iema'a taata hnyi pata cuo tli te, Abyipaca kiema'a liena a aw; iema kha ciy khah ung,” ama ta.
Cuorasala cawsaazaapuv yalya ta iema kha alung ta vaa amaa nang. Cakhutaata Abyiparungnaana ca atawna thluodaa lie cawsaazaapuv'a lie kha aa luo.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata, “Hingpa cawsaa zaw hingta khacuo te ma ina nutaa'a yi? Iema hrawlie kharuehaa hmang kha zawdya i tue cangta khacuo ma na zang khing li pata ama aw aa?
Iema kha puvtlung pasana ta de'a yi angte rucutuv taata i thaw'a yi, nama kha iema laata a le viepa hne a cahra viepa mingphang ta ica tue aa,” a ta.
Cuorasala Moses ta Abyipakyihuo khata, “Cata a cuo kieca Izipt ming ta capa thuohlaa ca ama thyi aa, tahematapakieca na cahrana ta iema hrawtaata na vya pyakhyi pata na ama cuo,

iema ta hingpa ruo ming zaw hing ama chang aa. Vya Abyipa, nama ca hingpa cawsaa zaw hrawlie hing aw cate, Vya Abyipanama kha hmie a pachaw pata ca hmung yi te, naa myi ca ama cunglie kha a daa te, ningchung ta amyi taw ta cuose, zuo ta myi taw ta cuose iema hmieluo ta na si.
Hingpa cawsaa tie hing sungkha ta na thie diy kie yi ca, capa kaw a thyipa mingphang tie ta,
‘Ama ta bie a kuopa yi ruo luo aa chiy khu li nakaw yi tana Abyipata iema ca ruocaapa lie a thie diy yi ama ta aa,’ a ta.
Caacuonakawta bie na za kuonazya yi a lepa haata Abyipana cahrana ca lesyi mang sue.

‘Abyipaca a hi haa mala li pata aa hmangpa duena a hnyi, pha lina hne tuesuena kha aa ngiethe, cuorasala suena ca a luo li pata pathe sa vyi nungpaa zaw pha lina kha saata zaw cunglie chuo thung chuo paliy te ta a thungpa tana a cuo'.
Aa hmangpa na duena a lena tluv ta, Izipt taata ataning te ta naa zaa ngiethepa haa yi khata hingpa cawsaa zaw pha lina hing a ngiethe tie yi,” a ta.
Abyipata “Ina hiepa haa cata i ngiethe yi;
tuokhaata a cuo zaw kama i hringpa haata, hne hing alyi hing Abyipacahrana ta a vie diy'apa haata,
Izipt ruo ruocaapa lie i tuepa kharuehaa hmang hne i rungnaana kha ama hmung thluo pata kama kha yi hraa te na dyapasya yi te i ueryi a naathlie lipa cawsaa tie, kama naa nutaapa tie ca
iema mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie ica pi'a yi ta pata bie i zaa kuopa ruo kha ahunghmuo hmung'a va yi.
Cuorasala i changtaapa Kaleb ca a ruena a nanang te pathiypalung yalya ta ina ziy nakawta, a va sinapa ruo luo kha a chiy'a angte a ciypathla zaw ta capa ruo ca ama cu aa.
Amalek ming hne Kanaan ming kha bawphie chunglie ama aw nakawta mawluo ca a pali ung la, Riyliy Sepa luo kha ruocaapa luo ziy pata si tie ung,” a ta.
Abyipata Moses hne Aaron kyihuo khata:
Hingpa a pha lipa cawsaazaapuv hingta khacuo ma inaa ciesue'a yi?
Chang tie yi, Abyipata “I hringpa haa hingta, nama ripa i thyipa dadang haa khata niema'a lie i tue aa:
Niema ca hingpa ruocaapa lie hrahring hingta nama thiy diy aa; kung kiy taata a cung luo, mingluv rina lie a tepa, kama naa ciesuepa bangkhuo ca,
ica pa-aw sa'a yi ta pata bie icaa kuopa yi ruo luo kha Jefunneh sacapaa Kaleb hne Nun sacapaa Joshua ta li pata pakha hmuo a ngie'a va ung ciy.
Cuorasala nama haatiy tie, iema ca carie tie ta patuv riypa tana ama cuo aa nama tapa tie kha a ngiekhyi'a yi angte iema ta siysaa ama ri lipa ruo lie kha ama aw aa.
Cuorasala niema ca hingpa ruocaapa chunglie hingna nama thiy diy aa.
Cakhutaata nama saata zaw ca ruocaapa lie hing kung sawliy chung tuvkhietuv cuo'a yi te, nama thiy diy hluo li niema zang tluo namaa tla lina kha ama ang aa.
Kanaan ruo namaa kya ngiepatlie ning nama rupa ning zaa, ning kha cuota kung kha, ning sawliy cuota kung sawliy kha nama pha lina muo ang'a ung cate, i palung tluo lina kha nama pachang aa,” a ta.
Kama Abyipata i ri tli; kama a du riypata a hmyapa cawsaa pha lipa tie bangkhuo cunglie hingpa hing i tue hrahring aa: hingpa ruocaapa lie hing thiy diy'a yi te ama chuo karue aa.
Cakhutaata Moses ta Kanaan ruo kha a ngiepatlie riypata a pathliepa cawsaa tie, ama za kaa tiyta ruo kaw kha thuohlaa chiepa za phya yi te, cawsaazaapuv kha kama a ciesue riypata a tuepa tie,
ruo kaw kha tlechuo aa chiy lipa thuohlaa zaa phyapa tie ca Abyipahmiekunglie kha puvtlung pasana ta ama thiy.
Cuorasala ruo a ngiepatlie riypata pathliepa cawsaa zaw hraw taa khata Nun sacapaa Joshua hne Jefunneh sacapaa Kaleb dyi kha a hringpa ta amaa ngaa.
Moses ta capa kaw ca Israel ming kha a chang tiy yi ta, cawsaa ca khuopuv ta ama caa.
Mawdiychie ta thu yi te tluocung ruo aa suona luo kha kie yi te, “Hingpa lie hingna ma aw. Abyipata bie malie a kuopa ruo luo ca ma si aa, tahematapakieca ma sue mangtli,” ama ta.
Cuorasala Moses ta, “Khaapanakawma Abyipabiepina kha aa pazue pata nama para? Cuo khu'a vyi.
Sithaw khah ung, tahematapakieca Abyipaniema'a lie aw vyi; nama carie tie hmiekunglie thie riypata a tue khah ung.
Tahematapakieca Amalek ming hne Kanaan ming khata caa du'a yi te, zueziy tana nama thiy diy aa; tahematapakieca Abyipakha namaa palise tli nakawta Abyipaca niema'a lie aw'a vyi,” a ta.
Cuorasala Abyipabiekuona thingkaw hne Moses hmuo arina hmang taata ama pya li pata iema ca tluocung ruo aa suona luo kha kie amaa nang ngiethie.
Cakhutaata capa tluocung ruo aa suona lie khy a sapa Amalek ming hne Kanaan ming ta za cung chiy yi te, tuv yi te ama te; Hormah te ta amaa cade.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Israel ming kha chang tie yi: Kama ta ica pipa yi, nama awna riypa ruo luo nama pha tiyta,

nama cuerung taata cuose, nama tuvrung taata cuose myirue panaana acuolikie hriykhungrina, biekuo patling na acuolikie lungthe panaana acuolikie ama'a na a cuo lieta nama tuepa pyi zaw ca, Abyipapalung a patluo riypa rangpa-ue tana a cuo.
Abyipa'a luo cahaapa pihluona a tuepa ta ca sa ta panaana ta chiytiy hin che paliy che kha hne pya pa jungsacuo viedie a pha cepa ephah che hraa lie che kha zaw kha a pihluo aa.
Ca hlyitaw taata, myirue panaana acuolikie hriykhungrina lie pihluopa tuvtaata sakha kaluo cuota dangpa ta panaana ta mingsuvtiy hin che paliy che kha zaw kha nama pihluo aa.
Tuvtungpa cuota ca chiytiy hin che thung che kha hne pya ciepa jungsacuo viedie pha cepa ephah che hraa che hning kha sa ta panaana ta nama pihluo aa.
Dangpa panaana cuota mingsuvtiy hin che thung che kha nama pihluo aa, Abyipapalungtluona rangpa-ue tana a cuo.
Biekuo patling sana acuolikie aviesaa panaana cuota cuetungpa kha myirue panaana acuolikie hriykhungrina ta Abyipa'a luo nama pihluo tiyta,
cuetungpa hne khata chiytiy hin che hne pya ciepa jungsacuo viedie ephah che hraa che thung kha sa ta panaana ta nama pihluo aa.
Cakhutaata mingsuvtiy hin a che kha dangpa ta panaana ta nama pihluo aa, Abyipapalungtluona rangpa-ue tana a cuo.
Cuetungpa, tuvtungpa, tuvtaata a capaa, hne mietaata sakha kaluo ta panaana nama pihluo tiyta cahaacata tue riypata a cuo.
Nama pihluopa sahring zaa khata sakha kaluo cuota tue kaluo riypata a cuo.
Ruo chung cawsaa Israel ming bangkhuo ta Abyipa'a luo rangpa-ue cuo riypata myi ta ruepa pihluona nama tue tiyta cahaacata nama tue aa.

Niema'a lie a awpa ruohrang ming, acuolikie ruo ming cuona a la tlipa ruohrang ming pakha ta Abyipacuota rangpa-ue cuo riypata myi ta ruepa pihluona a tue khing kieca niema nama tuepa haa tana a tue aa.

Cawsaa bangkhuo cuota, niema hne niema hrawlie a awpa ruohrang ming cuota phungluo ca suokha tana a cuo aa, chuo kha hnang chuo kha ci li pata nama ziy riypa phungluo ta a cuo aa; niema hne ruohrang ming ca Abyipahmiekunglie namaa lu aa.
Niema hne niema'a lie a awpa ruohrang ming ta aa lupa phungbie hne aa lupa ziyphung kha nama hnyi aa.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Israel ming kha chang tie yi: Kama ta icaa chiylenapa yi ruo pha ung cate,
ruo chunglie a awpa sa nama ning kyry ta nama sa chekha kha Abyipa'a luo pihluona nama hnyi aa.
Viechuo nama tue taapa chungtaata tluo kha kha nama pihluo aa; suo-aciyna taa ta pihluopa haa khata nama pihluo aa.
Chuo kha hnang chuo kha ta nama tue taapa viechuo taa khata Abyipakha nama pihluo aa.
Cuorasala Abyipata Moses a changpa biepina ca rue li pata ziy khu li pata aw ung cate,
Abyipata Moses'a taata bie aca pipa yi ca aca pi ning taa hne capa khutaa cata, chuo kha hnang chuo kha ziy khu li pata aw ung cate,

capa ca cawsaazaapuv ta pachang li pata ama tue tlamu kieca, cawsaa bangkhuo khata cuetungpa sakha kha myirue panaana ta nama pihluo aa, Abyipacuota rangpa-ue tana a cuo. Capa hne cata sa ta panaana, dangpa ta panaana, hne sue pathe sa panaana kha ziyphung haa khata nama pihluo aa.

Tluobyi ta Israel ming bangkhuo cuo khata sue angiethena hie'a te, a ngiethe pata ama cuo aa; tahematapakieca capa ca ama tue pathlyi pata cuo te, ama suena cuo khata Abyipa'a luo myi ta pihluona hne a hmiekunglie sue pathe sa panaana kha ama vya chiykhyi tli.
Israel ming bangkhuo ca iema'a lie khy a sa rapa ruohrang ming bangkhuo hne khata a ngiethe pata ama cuo aa, tahematapakieca cawsaa bangkhuo ca capa hmang tue tlamuna lie ca ama aw ra diy.
Cawsaa pakhakha ta a ting li pata a sue pathlyi kieca kung kha a tapa mietungpa kha sue pathe sa panaana ta a pihluo aa.

Cakhutaata tluobyi ta suena a tue pathlyipa cuo ca ta Abyipahmiekunglie kha sue angiethena a tuepa aa; a ting li pata tue tlamupa cuo te, ama cuo ca ta sue angiethena kha a tuepa kieca a ngiethe pata a cuo aa.
Israel ming cuose, iema hrawlie a awpa ruohrang ming cuose, suena a tuepa pakhakha cuota, aa lupa phungbie na nama hnyi aa.
Cuorasala lunghaaraa ta a tuepa ca Abyipakha a esepa ta cuo te, a cawsaa zaw'a taata thawpa tana a cuo aa.
Abyipabie kha nutaa te a biepina kha a parapa cawsaa ca thaw hrahring pata cuo'a te a suena kha a ang hrahring aa.
Israel ming ca ruocaapa lie ama aw ning kha thingpahri a pakhawpa pakha kha ama hmung.
A hmungpa tie ca ta Moses, Aaron hne cawsaazaapuv'a luo kha amaa vawkhyi.
Tuokhaatama ma tue aa tapa kha ama pachang li nakawta thaw-ing lie ama khung.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata “Cawsaapa hing thie riypa tana a cuo; cawsaazaapuv ta arina hmang khungthing lie kha alung ta vaasa riypa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Abyipata Moses'a lie bie a pipa haata cawsaazaapuv khata arina hmang khungthing luo pyakhyi yi te alung ta ama vaasa.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Israel ming kha chang tie yi, chuo kha hnang chuo kha ta ama pang daw lie kha pangdawpaa tue yi sala a dungpa palaa ta ciy yi se.
A pangdawpaa nama tuepa ca hmung'a ung cate, nama pathiypalung khingna hne nama hmung khingpa kha tue li mang li pata Abyipabiepina kha tue riypata namaa thyi pakhaa aa.
Cahaacata i biepina bangkhuo ca a thyi pakhaa ung cate nama tue nakawta nama Khazing'a lie kha nama pathe aa.
Kama ca Abyipanama Khazing tana i cuo, nama Khazing cuo riypata Izipt ruo taata caa vya pyakhyipa tana i cuo: Kama ca Abyipanama Khazing tana i cuo.
Levi sacapaa Kohath sacapaa Izhar sacapaa Korah, Eliab sacapaa tie Dathan hne Abiram, hne Peleth sacapaa On, Reuben ciypathla zaw khata
cawsaazaapuv luochiytuv, ahmyana taata a tlawpa, cawsaa ta pachangpa Israel ming zahning sawngaa tie kha a chiy yi te, Moses kha amaa du.

Moses hne Aaron kha a hmyasue yi te, “Nama lawpakhungtuv tli! Cawsaazaapuv hing pakha cyicuo ta pathe kaluo yi te iema hrawlie Abyipaa aw. Caacuonakawta khaapanakawma Abyipacawsaazaapuv cunglie hing niema hne niema namaa cyicalang?” ama ta.
Moses ta capa ca a thyi tiyta aa bu.

Cakhutaata Korah hne a viesaa palang kyihuo khata, “Mawluo maw thue ta, ahungma ama huopa ta a cuo, ahungma a pathe, ahungma ama athaa luo a ku aa tapa kha Abyipata malie a pachang sa aa; ama ta aa tlawpa kha ama athaa luo a ku aa.
Hingpa hing tue tie ung: Korah hne a viesaa bangkhuo zaw, myi lanapa daa pakaa kha a la ung la,

a mawluopa ta Abyipahmiekunglie kha a chunglie myi kha chi ung la myi cunglie kha rangpa-ue chi tie ung; Abyipata aa tlawpa cawsaa ca a pathepa ta a cuo aa. Niema Levi ming hing nama lawpakhungtuv tli!” a ta.
Cakhutaata Moses ta Korah kyihuo khata, “Levi ming na naathlie tie ung!

Israel Khazing ta niema ca Israel ming cawsaazaapuv chungtaata ca che yi te Abyipabienathluodaa lie re hrie pata ama hne namaa ngie the riypata cuose, cawsaazaapuv hmiekunglie a daa pata iema cuota re nama hrie the riypata cuose, a nanangta tah acaa tlawpa yi hing nama cuota a cawtuvpa hmang ta a cuo ma?
Abyipata ama athaa luo a ngie the riypata nama hne Levi ming na uvnu zaw kha acaa tlaw tli yi; Ata ca tluobyi re zaw te ma la namaa ting?
Caacuonakawta nama hne na viesaa zaw bangkhuo ta a hmya ung cate Abyipakha namaa du. Aaron namaa dupa ca ama ca khaapatama a cuo?” a ta.
Moses ta Eliab sacapaa Dathan hne Abiram kha a paku sa yi, cuorasala iema ta, “A vaw khu'a vapuv!
Kiema kha ruocaapa lie thie riypata cuehnung hne khyitiy a langnapa ruo taata malie na vya pyakhyipa hing hmang cawta tah a cuo ma, kiema cunglie abyi ta naa tuepa zaw hing?

Cuehnung hne khyitiy a langnapa ruo luo malie tlungkhyi lipa cata luruo hne mingsuv diedung zaw ru ta malie na pi lipa ca a siesa thluo. Hingpa cawsaa zaw hing ama ming na cakhyi'a yi ma? A vaw'a vapuv,” ama ta.
Moses ca a hi haa laalaw te Abyipakha, “Ama pihluona ca khaapatahmuo ri khah. Iema'a taata laa sakha hmuo la va ang, iema pakha hmuo tuechie va yi ang,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Moses ta Korah kyihuo khata, “Nama hne na viesaa bangkhuo ta mawluo khiy Abyipahmiekung luo vya pya tie ung, nama hne iema hne Aaron hneta;

cakhutaata niema pakha cyicuo ta myi lanapa daa pakaa kha a la ung la, rangpa-ue kha a cunglie chi ung la nama cyicuo khata Abyipahmiekung luo ca chiykhyi tie ung, daa pakaa zahning sawngaa; nama hne Aaron hne nama daa pakaa cyicuo ta,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta ama cyicuo ta ama daa pakaa ca a la yi te, a chunglie kha myi chi yi te a cunglie kha rangpa-ue ca ama chi, Moses hne Aaron hne khata atawna thluodaa ingchiypakaa lie kha amaa tu.
Korah ta cawsaazaapuv kha atawna thluodaa chiypakaa lie ca a pahmya yi. Cakhutaata Abyiparungnaana ca cawsaazaapuv cunglie kha aa luo.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses hne Aaron kyihuo khata:
Hingpa cawsaazaapuv'a taa hingta a pache tie ung, tahematapakieca sungkha ta i ruesa diy the riypa yi ta, a ta.
Iema ca a bu yi te, “Vya Khazing, saapa bangkhuo tie thlaapa Khazing, cawsaa pakha suena kawlie kha cawsaa bangkhuo cunglie na hi a haa'a ma?” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Cawsaazaapuv kha: Korah, Dathan, hne Abiram tie'a taa khata amaa phe riypata chang tie yi, a ta.
Caacuonakawta Moses ca thu te Dathan hne Abiram athaa luo kha a vaa; Israel uvthyi tie ta ama paziy.
Ama ta cawsaazaapuv kha, “Hingpa cawsaa pha lipa tie thluodaa taa hingta a phe ung la ama huopa khaapahmuo de khu khah ung, niema zaw hingna iema suena kawlieta aca parapuo diy'a yi,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta iema ca Korah, Dathan, hne Abiram awna taa khata amaa phe. Dathan hne Abiram ca kya pya yi te ama thluodaa chiypakaa lie kha ama napuv zaw, ama saata zaw, ama haatiy zaw hne khata amaa tu pakhaw.
Cakhutaata Moses ta, “Hingpa re hrie riypa hing kama palung thu ta cuo li pata Abyipana naa pathlie tapa kha hing haa hingta nama pachang aa.
Hingpa cawsaa zaw hing malie thiy hie ta thiy yi sala, malie siypasa ang hie ta ama ang ra kieca, kama hing Abyipata ina pathliepa cuo'a vyi.

Cuorasala Abyipata hmang thaapa suokhakha tue te, alyi kha a pakaa kya uo te, iema hing ama hnyipa chechiy yalya hneta paluo yi te, ama hring pata Sheol luo ama tla kieca, hingpa cawsaa tie hingta Abyipaama ese tapa kha nama pachang aa,” a ta yi.
Capa bie ca a ri khu pahne ta ama rawlie alyi ca aa kya chechi.
Alyi ca a pakaa kya uo te iema hne ama ingchungkhue, hne Korah cawsaa bangkhuo hne ama chechiy bangkhuo kha a paluo yi.
Caacuonakawta iema hne ama hnyipa bangkhuo ca ama hring pata Sheol luo ama tla diy; alyi ta iema ca a pataw sue yi. Iema ca cawsaazaapuv hraw taa khata vie yi te ama ra.
Ama khi ama upa ueryi a thyipa ama cahriylie Israel ming ca a ruo yi te, “Kiema zaw alyi ta malie a paluo ra pathlyi aa,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipa'a taata myi pya te rangpa-ue a pihluo nguoluopa cawsaa zahning sawngaa ca a kuo diy yi.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Tluobyi Aaron sacapaa Eleazar kha chang la, myihlaa chungtaata myilanapa daa pakaa kha la lah, myi ca cathie patlaa diy tie.

Tahematapakieca ama hringna muo ta a cuopa a suepa tie ama myilanapa daa pakaa ca a pathepa tana a cuo. Bienatluophie pahruv riypata khunglung ta depa myilanapa pakaa ta tue tie, tahematapakieca Abyipahmiekunglie ama pihluopa cuo te, a pathepa tana a cuo. Cahaacata iema ca Israel ming cuota pamangsana riypata ama cuo aa.
Caacuonakawta tluobyi Eleazar ta myi ta a kuosapa tie myilanapa daa pakaa tie ca la te khunglung ta depa bienatluophie pahruv ta a patue sa yi.

Abyipata Moses'a taata Eleazar'a lie a ripa haata, Aaron ciypathla ta a cuo lipa ahunghmuo Abyipahmiekunglie rangpa-ue pihluo riypata amaa ngie li riypa hne Korah hne a cawsaa zaw haata ama cuo li riypata a pathyi sa pakhaapa a cuo riypa tana a cuo.
Cadyiseca, a mawluopa ta Israel ming cawsaazaapuv ta Moses hne Aaron kha a ciesue yi te, “Abyipacawsaa zaw na nama thie,” ama ta.
Cahaacata cawsaazaapuv ta iema kha a du pata amaa hmya tiyta, Moses hne Aaron ca Abyipaatawna hmang luo kha amaa hyi; atawna hmang kha amyi ta buv te Abyiparungnaana aa luo.
Cakhutaata Moses hne Aaron kha atawna hmang a hmieluo amaa vaw ca,
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata,
“Hingpa cawsaazaapuv taa hingta a phe tie ung, sungkha ta i ruesa diy the riypa yi ta,” a ta. Cakhutaata alyi lie kha amaa bu.

Moses ta Aaron kyihuo khata, “Na myilanapa daa pakaa kha la tie, bienathluodaa taata myi kha la lah a cunglie kha rangpa-ue kha khang tie, cakhutaata cawsaazaapuv'a luo kha a catlisa pata cyile te iema cuota sue angiethena kha tue tie. Tahematapakieca hihaana ca Abyipa'a taata pya te puvtlung pasana ca aa pathu tli,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Aaron ca Moses ta a changpa haa cata myilanapa pakaa kha la te puvtlung pasana aa pathu tlinapa cawsaazaapuv hraw luo kha aa ruokhyi. Rangpa-ue kha rue te cawsaazaapuv cuota sue angiethena kha a tue.
Ama ca a thiypa hne a hringpa alalalie kha a tu te cakhutaata puvtlung pasana ca a die.
Puvtlung pasana ta a thiypa ca thawhraa hlyipaliy za sariy ta ama cuo.
Puvtlung pasana a die tiyta, Aaron ca Moses athaa luo, atawna thluodaa chiypakaa luo kha a vya kaa.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:

Israel ming kha va chang yi la, iema'a taa khata khuecahryi suohraa hlyihning va la tie, phang kha cuota suokha kaluo, ama phang luochiytuv bangkhuo tie'a taa khata va la tie. Ama ming cyicuo kha ama khuecahryi cunglie kha cape la,
Levi khuecahryi cunglie ca Aaron ming kha cape tie. Tahematapakieca ama phang uvthyi cyicuo cuo khata khuecahryi suokha kaluo ta a cuo aa.
Atawna thluodaa biekuona thingkaw hmielie, icaa tawnapa yi hmang lie kha chi tie.
Cakhutaata i tlawpa cawsaapa khuecahryi ca a daw a kya pakiy aa; cahaacata Israel ming ta nama acaa ciesue paripa yi kha i padie sa aa.

Moses ta Israel ming kha chang yi te, luochiytuv tie bangkhuo khata khuecahryi ca ama pi. Ama phang cyicuo ta luochiytuv pakha cyicuo cuota suokha, khuecahryi suohraa hlyihning cuo te, Aaron khuecahryi ca iema huopa hrawlie ca a aw ra.
Cakhutaa cata Moses ta khuecahryi bangkhuo ca biekuona thluodaa chung Abyipahmiekunglie kha a chi.
A mawluopa ta Moses kha biekuona thluodaa chung luo aa ngie ca Levi phang a cuopa Aaron khuecahryi ca a daw a pakiy. A daw daw paliy kya pakiy te, kya paa te almond thyi a hmingpa kha a pathyi.
Cakhutaata Moses ta khuecahryi bangkhuo kha Abyipahmiekung taa khata Israel ming'a luo kha a kya pyakhyi; mang yi te ama khuecahryi kha amaa la.

Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata, “Aaron khuecahryi kha a dutuv zaw a raaring pina riypata biekuona hmiekunglie kha chi pata a cuo aa, cahaacata iema ta inaa ciesuenapa yi kha na pachuo sa aa, caacuolikieca ama thiy aa,” a ta.
Abyipata bie a pina haa khata Moses ta a tue.
Israel ming ta Moses kyihuo khata, “Kiema ca ima ra mangtli; ima vie mangtli, ma bangkhuo ta ima vie diy mangtli!
Abyipathluodaa vaa cadipa mekaa ca ama thiy aa. Ima bangkhuo tama ma ra diy aa?” ama ta.

Abyipata Aaron kyihuo khata: Hmangpathepa hne aa patuvpa suena muo ca nama hne na sacapaa zaw hne na chungkha cawsaa zaw ta ang'a ung cate, tluobyi hne aa patuv pata suena muo ca nama hne na sacapaa dyina a ang'a ung ciy.
Caacuonakawta biekuona thluodaa hmielie nama hne na sacapaa zaw re nama hrie ningta caa bya riypa yi ta Levi ming na uvnu zaw, na phang kha cawsaa zaw kha a vya chiy tie yi.

Iema ta niema kha re caa bya'a yi te thluodaa chung bangkhuo lie kha re ama hrie aa. Cuorasala hmangpathepa lie chechiy tingby tie hne bienatluophie kha ca cadi'a va yi, ama cadi pathlyi kieca iema hne niema hneta nama thiy aa.
Atawna thluodaa lie re hrie riypa hne thluodaa re bangkhuo hrie riypata niema'a luo kha acaa pahlaw'a yi; ale cawsaa ca cadi'a va yi.
Israel ming cunglie Khazing hihaana a tlung li riypata hmangpathepa hne bienatluophie lie re kha ca niema hrahring na a hrie'a ung ciy.
Kama na nama uvnu Levi ming ca Israel ming chungtaata a la yi ang; iema ca atawna thluodaa lie re hrie riypata Abyipa'a luo pihluopa, nama cuota lasaw tana ama cuo.
Cuorasala bienatluophie hne pangzu hnangkaa lie hne aa patuvpa tluobyi re ca nama hne na sacapaa zaw na a phasa pata a hrie'a ung ciy. Cawsaa hrangpa ahunghmuo cuose capa luo vaa cadipa ca a thiy aa.
Abyipata Aaron kyihuo khata: Israel ming ta ama pihluopa a pathepa lasaw bangkhuo ca nama na ica pi; nama hne na sacapaa zaw khana chuozaa ta nama hmung riypata tluobyi cuvu ta ica pi yi.

Kama'a luo ina pihluopa yi a pathe cepa lasaw ta a cuopa, sa ta panaana, sue pathe sa panaana, sue a ngiethe panaana pihluopa chungtaata myi ta rue lipa aa ngaapa bangkhuo ca nama hne na sacapaa zaw cuo tana ica pi yi.
Hmang pathepa lieta nama ning aa; capaa bangkhuo ta nama ning aa; nama cuota a pathepa tana a cuo.

Hingpa Israel ming ta calangpa panaana ta ama pihluopa lasaw bangkhuo zaw hing nama hne na sacanung na sacapaa zaw hneta nama hmung pari riypata ica pi yi, na ing chunglie a awpa a pathepa cawsaa mekaa ta ama ning khu aa.
Chiytiy a pha cepa hne mingsuvtiy a pha cepa hne sa a pha cepa, Abyipaama pipa bangkhuo zaw kha nama na ica pi.
Abyipa'a luo ama vya cyipa ama ruo chungtaata sathaapa bangkhuo zaw nama huopa tana a cuo aa; na ing chunglie a awpa a pathepa cawsaa mekaa ta ama ning khu aa.
Israel ming ta ina pihluopa yi bangkhuo ca nama huopa tana a cuo aa.
Abyipa'a luo ama pihluopa sahrangta bangkhuo ca nama huopa tana a cuo aa; cuorasala cawsaa sahrangta hne a pathe lipa sahring sahrangta ca naa thla aa.
Capa tie ca thla kha ama ta taata a thla pata cuo'a te a thlanapa muo ca hmangpathepa panangnapa shekel ta panang pata ngu shekel suopangaa ta a cuo aa (shekel suokha ca kerah suokiy ta a cuo).

Cuorasala cue sahrangta, tuv sahrangta, hne mie sahrangta ca a thla'a vaciy; iema ca ama pathe. Ama thiy ca bienatluophie lie kha hi'a cate ama thu ca Abyipacuota rangpa-ue cuo riypata myi ta rue'a cate na pihluo aa.
Cuorasala ama saa ca nama huopa tana ama cuo aa, calangpa pihluona lie angaw hne a baw ca nama huopa a cuopa haa khata.

Israel ming ta Abyipa'a luo ama pihluopa a pathepa pihluopa bangkhuo ca nama hne na sacapaa na sacanung zaw na chuozaa nama cuvu riypata ica pi yi; hingpa hing nama hne na ciypathla zaw cuota Abyipahmiekunglie aa hmang paripa biekuona tana a cuo.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Aaron kyihuo khata: Nama ca ama ruo chunglie luruo cuvu hnyi'a vaciy, khaapa cuvu hmuo hnyi'a vaciy; Kama hingna Israel ming hrawlie nama cuvu hne nama huopa ta a cuo'a ang.
Israel ming ama chehraachekha ca Levi ming na ru ta i pi yi, atawna thluodaa lie ama rehrie muo ta i pi yi.
Ata taa hingta ca Israel ming ta atawna thluodaa kha cadi'a va tli yi, ama cadi pathlyi kieca suena muo ang'a yi te ama thiy aa.

Cuorasala Levi ming ta atawna thluodaa lie re kha hrie'a yi te, ama suena muo ca iema ta ama ang aa; capa ca chuo kha hnang chuo kha chuozaa cuota ziyphung a cuo aa. Cuorasala Israel ming hrawlie kha cuvu hnyi'a va yi,
tahematapakieca kama ta Levi ming ca Israel ming chehraachekha, Abyipapihluo riypata a nanang ta ama chipa kha ama cuvu ta i pi tli yi.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:

Levi ming kha chang tie yi: Kama ta na cuvu ta ica pipa Israel ming chehraachekha kha na cuhluo tiyta, capa chung taa cata chekha kha Abyipa'a luo pihluo riypata na che aa, chehraachekha chung taa khata chehraachekha kha.
Capa ca suo-aciyna taata suo haa khata hne mingsuv nawnapa taata mingsuvtiy haa khata nama lasaw ta cuhluopa pata nama cuo aa.
Cahaacata Israel ming'a taata nama cuhluopa chehraachekha taata a chebuo kha Abyipapihluo riypata nama che aa; capa chung taa cata Abyipanama pihluo riypa kha tluobyi Aaron'a luo nama pi aa.
Lasaw nama hmungpa chungtaata a pha cepa kha Abyipa'a luo pihluo riypata nama che aa.

Iema kha chang tie yi: A pha cepa tie kha nama che khutaata aa ngaapa tie ca Levi ming cuota suo-aciyna taata a pyapa suo haata hne mingsuv nawna taata a pyapa mingsuvtiy haata cuhluopa pata ama cuo aa.
Nama hne na ingchungkhue ta capa ca khaapa lie hmuo cuo sala nama ning aa, tahematapakieca atawna thluodaa lie nama rehrie muo tana a cuo.
A pha cepa kha nama pihluo tiyta, capa kawlie ca ta suena ang'a va ung ciy. Cuorasala Israel ming a pathepa lasaw kha papyapalyi'a va ung ciy, thiyna na nama ang pathlyi aa.
Abyipata Moses hne Aaron kyihuo khata:

Hingpa hing Abyipabiepipa phungbie a phungluo tana a cuo: Israel ming kha nama'a luo a dutlapa cuelaanung ama vya cyi riypata chang yi la, risie riy a aw lipa hne a ruetung lie ruekhang khang buo li liepa ta a cuo aa.
Capa ca tluobyi Eleazar kha pi'a cate, arina hmang le luo kha pyakhyi'a yi te ama hmiekunglie kha ama thie aa.
Tluobyi Eleazar ta a thiy chekha kha a kuvdaw ta la'a te atawna thluodaa kha yi sariy a hi aa.
Cakhutaata cuelaanung kha a hmiekunglie myi ta ama rue aa; a vang, a saa, a thiy zaw kha a i hneta rue pata a cuo aa.
Tluobyi ta sidar thing, hyssop, hne caw sedungpa kha la'a te cuelaanung a kuo nguoluopa myi chung luo kha a thaw aa.
Cakhutaata tluobyi ca a caw kha pasuv'a te tiy lie kha a nge aa siy aa, cakhutaa cata arina hmang luo kha aa vaw aa, cuorasala tluobyi ca zuoluo te khata pathe'a valie.
Cuelaanung a ruepa ca a caw kha pasuv'a te a pangpa kha tiy ta aa siy aa; ama ca zuoluo te khata pathe'a valie.

Cakhutaata a pathepa cawsaa pakha ta cuelaanung buvcuo kha liy'a te arina hmang aleluo a pathena lie kha a chi aa; cakhutaata Israel ming cuota a siyna riypa tiy kha ama chi aa. Capa ca pathesana panaana tana a cuo.
Cuelaanung buvcuo a liypa cawsaa ca a caw kha pasuv'a te zuoluo te ta pathe'a valie. Hingpa hing Israel ming hne iema'a lie khy a sapa ruohrang ming cuota chuozaa ta ziy riypa phungluo ta a cuo aa.
Ahunghmuo cuose a thiypa riyy a dekhupa ca ning sariy chung pathe'a vyi.

A ning thungnapa lie hne a ning sariynapa ta iema hne iema kha tiy ta a pathe'a yi te, cahaacata ama pathe aa; cuorasala iema hne iema kha ning thungna lie hne ning sariyna lieta amaa pathe li kieca, iema ca pathe'a va yi.

A thiypa riyy a dekhupa bangkhuo ca iema hne iema kha amaa pathe li kieca Abyipabienathluodaa kha a papya a palyipa tana ama cuo; cahaapa cawsaa ca Israel ming'a taata thawpa tana ama cuo aa. A pathena tiy kha iema cunglie ama hi li kieca, a pathe lipa cuo yi te ama pathe lina ca ama cunglie kha a aw pari.
Thluodaa lie pakhakha a thiy tiyta phungbie ca hing haa hing tana a cuo: thluodaa luo a vawpa ahunghmuo cuose, thluodaa chunglie a awpa ahunghmuo cuose ning sariy pathe'a va yi.
Aa pahawpa bi, a pahruv pahruv lipa ca pathe vyi.
Ahunghmuo cuo sala lu lieta zueziy ta ama thiepa, phuvthiy ta a thiypa, acuolikie cawsaa ruv, hne thluo zaw a dekhupa ca ning sariy chung pathe'a vyi.
A pathe lipa tie cuota myi ta pathesana panaana buvcuo kha la'a yi te, a lang nguoluopa tiy a cawta kha bi chunglie ama raw chiy aa.

Cakhutaata a pathepa cawsaa pakha ta hyssop kha la'a te tiy chunglie kha naw'a te thluodaa kha tiy a hi aa; chechiy tingby bangkhuo, capa lie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo, cawsaa ruv a tawpa cawsaa cunglie, ama thiepa a tawpa, cawsaa riy hne thluo a tawpa cawsaa cunglie zaw kha a hi aa.

A pathepa cawsaa ca ta a pathe lipa kha ning thungnapa hne ning sariynapa lie kha hi'a te, cahaacata ning sariyna lie kha a pathe sa aa. Cakhutaata ama caw kha pasuv'a yi te, tiy a siy'a yi te zuoluo ta ama pathe aa.

A pathe lipa, iema hne iema kha a pathe lipa ca Abyipahmangpathepa kha a papya a palyi nakawta cawsaazaapuv'a taata thaw pata ama cuo aa. A pathena tiy kha hi pata ama cuo li kieca iema ca pathe va yi.
Capa ca iema cuota phungluo ta a cuo pari aa. A pathena tiy a hipa ca a caw kha a pasuv aa; a pathena tiy a tawpa ca zuoluo te ta pathe'a vyi.
A pathe lipa ta a tawpa khaapa hmang a cuo zaw pathe'a vyi, capa a pathe lipa hmang suokhakha a tawpa zaw zuoluo te pathe'a vyi.
Israel ming cawsaazaapuv ca thla khana lieta Zin ruocaapa luo kha a ngie yi te, cawsaa ca Kadesh lie kha ama aw. Miriam ca capa lie ca thiy te ama paby.
Capa lie ca cawsaazaapuv cuota tiy aw vyi; caacuonakawta a hmya yi te Moses hne Aaron kha amaa du.
Cawsaa ta Moses ca a hru yi te, “Abyipahmiekunglie ma uvnu zaw ama za thiy ning kha ma ma thiy ra hrue va!
Khaapanakawma Abyipacawsaa phuv hing cawsaa hne ma sahring hne thiy diy riypata hingpa ruocaapa luo hing malie naa vya ngiekhyi?

Khaapanakawma Izipt taata malie pyakhyi cate hingpa ruo chiepa luo hing malie naa vya chiy? Hingpa ruo hing sa, thyikuv, mingsuv hne cale zaw tlanapa hmang cuo vyi; dang riypa tiy zaw aw vyi,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Moses hne Aaron ca cawsaazaapuv'a taa khata atawna thluodaa chiypakaa luo kha cakuo yi te alyi lie kha a bu yi te Abyiparungnaana kha iema'a lie ca aa luo.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:

Na khuecahryi kha a la lah cawsaazaapuv kha pahmya tie yi, nama hne na uvta Aaron hne khata, cakhutaata iema hmiekunglie kha tiy papya riypata alung kha bie pi tie. Cahaacata iema cuo khata alung taata tiy kha papya'a cate iema hne ama sahring hne dang riypa tiy kha na pi'a yi.
Caacuonakawta bie pipa a cuopa haata Abyipahmiekung taa khata khuecahryi kha a la.
Moses hne Aaron ta cawsaazaapuv ca alungpuvnung hmiekunglie kha pahmya yi te, “Niema a du a hmuopa tie, naathlie tie ung, “Hingpa alung chung taa hingta niema huo tiy ma papya'a ma?” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Moses ca a kuv kha caba te a khuecahryi khata alung ca sung hning aa hluo; tiy ca a hluvsa ta kya pya te cawsaazaapuv hne ama sahring hne cata ama dang.

Cuorasala Abyipata Moses hne Aaron kyihuo khata, “Kama kha ina zang li nakaw ung cata Israel ming ming hmungna lieta i pathena kha pahmung sa riypata, hingpa cawsaazaapuv hing iema i pipa yi ruo luo kha a ngiekhyi'a va ung ciy,” a ta yi.
Hingpa hing Meribah tiy ta a cuo, Israel ming ta Abyipaamaa hruna, hne capa ca ta a pathena a pahmung sapa yi ta a cuo.
Moses ta biephyatuv tie kha Kadesh taata Edom siepahruo'a luo kha pathlie yi te, “Na uvnu Israel ming na caa ta yi: Kiema cunglie a tlungpa ruvnaana bangkhuo ca na pachang:
tuokhaatama mingchingmingvuo tie Izipt luo ama si, Izipt ruo lie cuo pasiypuv aw pate Izipt ming ta mingchingmingvuo tie hne kiema kha malie ama hrisaa.
Abyipa'a luo ma u tiyta, ma ueryi kha malie thyi te avuoming pakha za pathlie te Izipt taata malie a pyakhyi; ata hing hingpa na ruoriy athaalie a awpa Kadesh khy liena ma aw.

Na ruo cahraw pata malie pasi sa thi tie. Lu hne mingsuv diedung luo kha pie paa'a vapuv, khaapa takhue taata hmuo tiy dang'a vapuv; Siepahruo Luopuvlepa kha tathlyalya ziy'a pate na ruo ma pachuona te ta cavyi cacuo amaa'a vapuv,” ama va ta.
Cuorasala Edom ta, “I ruo kha cahraw'a va ung ciy, nama cahraw kieca niema a du riypata zueziy hne tana ma vya pya aa,” a ta.
Israel ming ta ama kyihuo khata, “Luopuvlepa liena ma aw aa; kiema hne ma sahring ta na tiy kha ma dang kieca a muo na maca pi aa. Capata dyi cana a cuo aa; malie cahraw sa thi tie,” ama ta.
Cuorasala ama ta, “Cahraw khu'a va ung ciy,” a ta yi. Cakhutaata Edom ca ta cehre hne rieka hluvpuv ta a pyahnue yi.
Cahaacata Edom ta Israel ming ta a ruo ama cahraw riypa kha a khing li nakawta Israel ming ca kaa yi te ama cahriy.
Israel ming cawsaazaapuv ca Kadesh taa cata pya yi te Hor Tluo luo kha ama pha.
Abyipata Edom ruo ruoriy Hor Tluo lie ca Moses hne Aaron kyihuo khata,
“Aaron ta a cawsaa zaw kha pakiy yi se. Tahematapakieca Israel ming i pipa yi ruo luo kha ama ca a ngie'a vyi, tahematapakieca Meribah tiy lie khana i bie pipa namaa du.
Aaron hne a sacapaa Eleazar kha ku yi la Hor Tluo luo kha suokhyi tie yi.
Aaron ca a caw kha thliepa la a sacapaa Eleazar kha pahryi tie. Cuorasala Aaron ca a cawsaa zaw kha pakiy'a yi te khapa lie kha a thiy aa,” a ta.
Abyipabiepina haa khata Moses ta a tue; cawsaazaapuv hmungna lie kha Hor Tluo luo ca ama kie.
Moses ta Aaron caw ca thliepa te a sacapaa Eleazar kha a pahryi; Aaron ca capa tluodaw lie ca a thiy. Moses hne Eleazar ca tluo cung taa cata ama za cung.
Cawsaazaapuv ta Aaron a thiypa kha ama hmung tiyta, Israel ming bangkhuo ta ning sawthung chung Aaron kha muochie ama sa.
Negeb lie a awpa Kanaan ming siepahruo Arad ta Israel ming na Atharim luopuv luo taata a vya si yi tapa kha a thyi tiyta Israel ming kha a du yi te cawsaa chekha kha a patuv yi.
Cakhutaata Israel ming ta Abyipa'a lie kha chie a sa pata bie a kuo yi te, “Hingpa cawsaa tie hingna ma kuv luo malie na pi ta pata a cuo kieca ama khy hing ma para karue aa,” ama ta.
Abyipata ama bie kha naathlie te Kanaan ming kha ama kuv luo a pi yi; iema hne ama khy zaw kha ama para diy karue; caacuonakawta capa hmang ca Hormah ama ta.
Hor Tluo taa cata Edom ruo kha cahlung yi te Riyliy Sepa luo kuo kha ama si; cuorasala luopuv lie ca cawsaa kha ama palung pasiy khu va tli.
Cawsaa ta Khazing hne Moses kha ripachie yi te, “Khaapanakawma ruocaapa lie thiy riypata Izipt taata malie na pyakhyi? Tahematapakieca hingpa lie hing sa hne tiy aw vyi,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipata a ca-ie ruvsapa pariy kha cawsaa hraw luo pathlie te, iema ca ta cawsaa kha daw yi te a hluvsa ama thiy.

Cawsaa ca Moses'a luo kha a vaw yi te, “Abyipahne nama a du pata bie ma ri nakawta ma sue tli; kiema'a taa hingta pariy kha a la riypata Abyipa’ a luo kha thlaachuo tie,” a ma ta. Caacuonakawta Moses ta cawsaa zaw cuo khata thlaa a chuo.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata, “A ca-ie ruvsapa pariy sakha kha tue la atung cunglie kha calya tie; pariy ta a dawpa mekaa ta capa ca mang'a yi te ama hring aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Moses ta daa pariy kha tue te, atung cunglie kha a calya. Pariy ta cawsaa pakhakha kha a daw tiyta, capa cawsaa ca ta daa pariy kha mang'a te a hring aa.
Israel ming ca a thu yi te Oboth lie kha amaa ri.
Oboth taa khata a thu yi te Moab taata ningchiyluo kuo, ruocaapa lie a awpa Iye-abarim lie kha amaa ri.
Capa taa cata thu yi te Zered Bawphie lie kha amaa ri.

Capa taa cata a thu pakhaa yi te Amor ming ruoriy taata a pathupa ruocaapa lie a awpa Arnon cavaa huesuo lie kha amaa ri; Arnon ca Moab ruoriy cuo te, Moab hne Amor ming alalalieta a langpa cavaa tana a cuo.
Capa hne aa ziy pata AbyipaRieduna Caa-uv lieta a ripa ca, “Suphah lie Waheb khy hne cavaata tie, Arnon cavaa hne
cavaata luo a pachungbungpa tluo Ar khy te pha te, Moab ruoriy hne a laa hnepa,” a ta.
Capa taa cata Beer te ama si; capa ca Abyipata Moses kyihuo ta, “Cawsaa kha pahmya yi la tiy na i pi'a yi,” a tapa takhue kha tana a cuo.
Cakhutaata Israel ming ta hingpa hlaa hing ama sa: “Vya takhue! tiy papya tie, Hlaa ta pathuosa tie ung!
luochiytuv zaw ta ama za cupa takhue, Cawsaa hrawlie byi a cuopa zaw ta ama byikhuecahryi ta ama cupa takhue tana a cuo,” ta pata ama sa. Ruocaapa chungtaata Mattanah te,
Mattanah taata Nahaliel te, Nahaliel taata Bamoth te,
Bamoth taata Moab ruoriy lie a awpa bawphie te, ruocaapa luo vaa hyipa Pisgah tluodaw te ta ama si.
Cakhutaata Israel ming ta Amor ming siepahruo Sihon'a luo kha biephyatuv pathlie yi te,

“Na ruo cahraw pata malie pasi sa thi tie; lu hne mingsuv diedung luo kha pie paa'a vapuv; khaapa takhue taata hmuo tiy dang'a vapuv; Siepahruo Luopuvlepa kha tathlyalya ziy'a pate na ruo ma pachuona te ta cavyi cacuo amaa'a vapuv,” ama ta.

Cuorasala Sihon ta Israel ming ca a ruo cahraw riypa kha khing vyi. Sihon ta a cawsaa zaw kha pahmya yi te, Israel ming a du riypata ruocaapa luo kha a pya. Jahaz luo kha chiy te Israel ming ca aa du yi.
Israel ming ta zueziy ta thie yi te, a ruo kha Arnon taata Jabbok te, Ammon ming awnapa te ta ama la, tahematapakieca Ammon ming ruoriy ca a cusa.
Israel ming ta capa khy bangkhuo ca la yi te Amor ming khy bangkhuo lie kha ama aw. Heshbon lie hne a khyta zaw bangkhuo lie kha.
Tahematapakieca Heshbon ca Amor ming Siepahruo Sihon khypuv ta a cuo. Ama ca Moab siepahruo taapa kha tuv te a ruo kha Arnon te ta a lapa tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta mingnungmingpa hlaa a sapa tie ta, “Heshbon luo a vaw ung la, sa'a ung puv; Shihon khypuv hing pacu sa'a ung puv.
Tahematapakieca Heshbon taata myi thu te, Sihon taata myihlaa a pya. Capa ca ta Moab ruo Ar khy kha kuo te, Arnon ruo aa suona hmang kha a kuo diy.

Vya Moab, bawchie ciemuopa tana na cuo! Vya Khemosh cawsaa zaw niema ca nama ra diy tli hing haw! Ama ta a sacapaa zaw ca carie rieciy ta paruo sa diy yi te, a sacanung zaw kha Amor siepahruo Sihon'a luo kha hruocawsaa ta a pi yi.
Caacuonakawta ama ruo ca Heshbon taata Dibon te a ra diy, Medeba te myi a kuo hluo li ma para yi.
Cahaacata Israel ming ca Amor ming ruo lie kha khy ama sa.
Moses ta Jazer luo kha ngiepatlietuv a pathlie; a khyta zaw kha la yi te, capa lie a awpa Amor ming kha ama papya.
Cakhutaata a pali yi te Bashan luopuv luo kha ama sithaw. Bashan siepahruo Og ca a cawsaa zaw hne khata iema a du riypata Edrei luo kha a pya.

Cuorasala Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata, “Ama kha ciy khah; tahematapakieca ama a cawsaa zaw, a ruo zaw bangkhuo hne tana na kuv luo ica pi. Heshbon a uvpa Amor ming siepahruo Sihon na tuepa haa kha tana na tue aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta ama, a sacapaa zaw, hne a cawsaa zaw kha pakha hmuo pangaa li pata ama thie; a ruo zaw kha ama la.
Israel ming ca a thu yi te, Jeriko a thaa Jordan huesuo Moab ase ruo lie kha amaa ri.
Zippor sacapaa Balak ta Israel ming ta Amor ming cunglie ama tuepa bangkhuo kha a hmung.
Moab ming ca ama ciy hringhruo, tahematapakieca Israel ming ca ama hluv suesaa. Moab ming ca Israel ming ama ciynapa khata a tesa yi.

Caacuonakawta Moab ta Midian uvthyi tie kha, “Cuetungpa ta ama patlena hmang lie a phuv kha a baapa haata hingpa cawsaa buvpuv hingta ma cahriylie a awpa bangkhuo hing ama baa diy aa,” a ta. Zippor sacapaa Balak ca capa cuo ning cata Moab siepahruo ta a cuo.

Ama ta Amaw ruo, Eufrates cavaa kie, Pethor lie a awpa Beor sacapaa Balaam kha ku riypata biephyatuv pathlie te, “Izipt taata a vya pyapa cawsaa tie ta alyi lie bi diy yi te i thaalie awna hmang ama la tli.

A vaw la hingpa cawsaa tie hing chie na vya sapa tie yi, iema ca kama laata ama cahra vie; cuorasala te'a yi angte i ruo taa hingta i cade khu the'a yi; tahematapakieca nama ta thluechiy na pipa tie ca thluechiy hmung yi te, nama ta chie na sapa tie ca chiesapa tana ama cuo,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Moab hne Midian uvthyi tie ca hmungdawluna muo kha ama kuv lie a cyi yi te Balaam'a luo va pha yi te Balak ta bie a taapa yi kha ama chang.
Ama ta, “Ata zuo ca hingpa lie hing a ri tie ung, Abyipata ina changpa haata niema kha bie ica chang'a yi,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Moab abyi tie ca Balaam'a lie kha amaa ri.
Khazing ta Balaam kyihuo khata, “Nama hne a awpa cawsaa zaw hing ahung zaw tama ama cuo?” a ta.
Balaam ta Khazing kyihuo khata, “Moab pa Zippor sacapaa siepahruo Balak na hingpa bie hing naa vya taa:
‘Izipt taata a vya pyapa cawsaa tie ca alyi ama bi tli; a vaw la hingpa cawsaa tie hing chie na vya sapa tie yi, caacuokieca te'a yi angte i cade khu the'a yi,’ a ta,” a ta.
Khazing ta Balaam kyihuo khata, “Nama ca iema hne khata si'a vaciy; cawsaa tie kha chie sa'a va yi ciy, tahematapakieca iema ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Balaam ca mawdiy ta thu te, Balak abyi tie kyihuo khata, “Nama ruo luo kha si tie ung, tahematapakieca Abyipata niema hne si riypata na pase vyi,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta Moab abyi tie ca Balak'a luo kha vaa yi te, “Balaam ta kiema hne a vaw riypa kha khing vyi,” ama ta.
Balak ta aa suo viepa abyi tie kha a hluo laata a hluv vie ta a pathlie pakhaa yi.
Iema ca ta Balaam'a luo kha vaa yi te, “Zippor sacapaa Balak na: ‘Kama'a luo a vaw riypa kha khaapahmuo a pakhuo sa khah se;
tahematapakieca pa-uvsathyina lepuv ca pi hrahring'a angte, na ripa haata na cunglie i tue aa; a vaw la hingpa cawsaa tie hing chie na vya sapa tie yi,’ a ta,” ama ta.
Cuorasala Balaam ta Balak changtaapa tie kyihuo khata, “Balak ta siy hne ngu a bi pata a ing ina pi zawta Abyipai Khazing ta bie ina pipa law pata khaapahmuo tue khu va ang.
Hingpa lie hing aw caw tie ung, a hrangpa tie zaw haa khata, tahematapakieca Abyipata khaapama ina chang vie aa tapa kha i pachang the riypata,” a ta yi.
Capa zuo ca ta Khazing ca Balaam'a luo kha a vaw te, “Cawsaapa hingta aca vya paku sa kie yi ca, thu la iema hne khata si tie; cuorasala kama ta tue riypata ica changpa dyi khana na tue aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Balaam ca mawdiy ta thu te, a laa kha kedie padie te Moab byi tie hne khata a si.
Balaam a si nakawta Khazing hihaana ca a ie ta ie te, Abyipaavuoming pakha ta luopuv lie kha carie haata aa daakhuo. Ama ca laa kha a khang te, a changtaapa pahning hneta ama cuo.

Laa ta Abyipaavuoming ca a kuv lie zueziy a da cie pata luopuv khingkhuo lie a daapa kha a hmung; caacuonakawta laa ca luopuv taa khata pie te lu chung luo khata a si ca luopuv luo amaa riypata Balaam ta a khuecahryi ta a chi.
Cakhutaata Abyipaavuoming ca mingsuv diedung hne mingsuv diedung alala luopuv baata lie kha a daa te a kuo hning ta piehu a aw khuo kaluo.
Laa ta avuoming kha a hmung tiyta piehu luo kha cadi te a si ca Balaam phyi kha piehu hne a cadiepuo nakawta laa ca a chi pakhaa.
Cakhutaata Abyipaavuoming ca hmieluo kha si te, cavyiluo hne cacuoluo piena a aw lina luopuv baata lie kha aa daa.
Laa ta Abyipaavuoming kha a hmung tiyta, Balaam ca aa bukhyi. Balaam ca a pathiy myi ie ta ie te laa ca a khuecahryi ta a chi.
Cakhutaata Abyipa ta laa pakaa kha pa-uo sa te Balaam kyihuo khata, “Tuokhaata ca ta angte ma yi thung nanaa ina chi ciy?” a ta.
Balaam ta laa kyihuo khata, “Tahematapakieca kama khana a ngaapa haata ina tue ciy! I kuv lie hing zueziy aw sala na i khing! Ata hingta ica thie'a pa kha!” a ta.
Cuorasala laa ta Balaam kyihuo khata, “Kama ca na chuo chunglie ataning te ta naa khangpa na laa ta cuo va ang ma? Hing haa hingta ica tue buo ma?” a ta. Ama ta, “Tue buo vaciy,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Khazing ta Balaam ming kha pahmung sa te, Abyipaavuoming pakha a kuv lie zueziy a da pacie pata luopuv lie aa daapa kha a hmung ca a bung te alyi lie aa bu.
Abyipaavuoming ta ama kha, “Khaapanakawma na laa kha yi thung nanaa na chi? I hmiekunglie na tue li riypa hmang na tue nakaw tana na cariepa haata icaa daakhuo.
Laa ta na hmung te kama'a taata yi thung luo a pie. Luo pie li pata aw sala nama kha ca thie hmisi'a angte ama kha i pahring aa,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Balaam ta Abyipaavuoming kyihuo khata, “I sue mangtli, tahematapakieca kama a du riypata luopuv lie naa daapa khana i pachang va. Caacuonakawta na palung na a tluo va tapa kieca ing luona i kaa aa,” a ta.
Abyipaavuoming ta Balaam kyihuo khata, “Cawsaa zaw hne khata si tie, cuorasala ri riypata ica changpa dyi khana na ri aa,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Balaam ca Balak abyi zaw hne khata a si.
Balaam na a vaw tapa kha Balak ta a thyi tiyta, ama kha a taw riypata Arnon ming hne ama ruoriy, aa hlacenapa Ir-moab luo kha a pya.
Balak ta Balaam kyihuo khata, “Caa vya kupa i vya pathlie cuo va ma? Khaapanakawma kama'a luo naa vaw va? Pa-uvsathyina caa pi khu li riypata ma i cuo?” a ta.
Balaam ta Balak kyihuo khata, “Ata hing i vaw hing, cuorasala kama ca bie kaa kha hmuo ri khuna i hnyi ma? Khazing ta i hmya lie a chipa bie khana i ri aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Balaam ca Balak hne khata si yi te Kiriath-huzoth luo kha ama pha.
Balak ta cuetungpa hne tuv ta hriykhungrina tue te ama hne a awhnepa Balaam hne byi tie kha a zuo yi.
A mawluopa ta Balak ta Balaam kha Bamoth-baal luo a sikhyi; capa taa cata Israel ming chekha kha a hmung khu yi.
Cakhutaata Balaam ta Balak kyihuo khata, “Hingpa lie hing bienatluophie suo sariy na sapa la, cuetungpa sa sariy hne tuvtungpa sa sariy na pi tie,” a ta.
Balak ta Balaam a ripa haata a tue; Balak hne Balaam hneta cuetungpa hne tuvtungpa kha bienatluophie suokha kaluo lie ama pihluo.

Cakhutaata Balaam ta Balak kyihuo khata, “Kama a hrang luo i cakuo chung hingpa na myirue panaana athaalie hing za aw caw tie. Abyipata inaa taw ngiethie thlu aa. Tuokhaapa ina pahmung zawta ica chang aa,” a ta. Cakhutaata tluodaw utlaw luo kha a kie.
Cakhutaata Khazing ta Balaam kha aa taw; Balaam ta, “Bienathluodaa suosariy sa angte, bienathluodaa suokha cyicuo lie kha cuetungpa sakha hne tuvtungpa sakha kha i pihluo,” a ta.
Abyipata Balaam hmya lie kha bie chi te, “Balak luo kha kaa la na ri riypa bie ca hing haa hingta a cuo aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Moab abyi zaw hneta a myirue panaana athaalie a daapa Balak'a luo kha a kaa.

Cakhutaata Balaam ta profet bie kha a ri: “Balak ta Aram taata inaa vya chiy, ningchiy tluo zaw taata Moab siepahruo ta naa vya chiy te: A vaw la, Jakob hing chie na sapa tie; A vaw la Israel hing thaw tie!’ i na ta.
Tuokhaatama Khazing ta chie a sa lipa kha chie i sa khu aa? Tuokhaatama Abyipata a thaw lipa kha kama ta i thaw khu aa?
Tahematapakieca kama ta lungkuo daw taata i hmung, tluo cung taata ama kha i mang; Ama selaw ta a awpa cawsaa na hingpa lie hing a aw, mingphang hrang zaw hrawlie ama hne ama a ripuo lipa tana a cuo.
Jakob ciypathla lyicadiy hing ahungma a ri tie aa, ahungma Israel ming che paliy che kha hing a ri khu aa? Aa dangpa tie thiypa haa khata thiy ang sala, i chuona ca ama kha lu ang se!” a ta.
Cakhutaata Balak ta Balaam kyihuo khata, “I cunglie hing khaapama na tue? I carie tie chie sa riypata icaa vya chiy, cuorasala nama ta khaapahmuo tue lipa cata thluechiy na pi pali yi,” a ta.
Ama ta, “Abyipata i hmya lie a chipa ca i ri riypa cuo va ma?” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Balak ta, “Kama hneta a hrangpa hmang luo kha a vaw la Israel ming chekha kha na hmung'a yi; chekha dyina na hmung'a yi, ama bangkhuo ta hmung'a va yi ciy; capa taa cata iema kha chie na sapa tie yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Pisgah tluodaw lie a awpa Zofim lu luo kha a sikhyi. Ama ta bienathluodaa suo sariy sa te, bienathluodaa suokha cyicuo taa khata cuetungpa sakha hne tuvtungpa sakha kha a pihluo.
Balaam ta Balak kyihuo khata, “Huepa lie Abyipai vaa taw chung hing, hingpa na myirue panaana kielie hing zaa daa mya,” a ta.
Abyipata Balaam kha a taw te, a hmya lie kha bie chi te a tapa ca, “Balak'a luo kha kaa la hing haa hingta va chang tie,” a ta.
Ama'a luo a vya kaa ca Balak ca Moab abyi tie hne khata a myirue panaana athaalie kha amaa zaa daa. Balak ca ta, “Abyipaca khaapama aca chang?” a ta.
Cakhutaata Balaam ta profet bie kha ri te: “Balak, thu la naathlie tie; Vya Zippor sacapaa, kama kha na naathlie tie:

Khazing ca tuokhaatama hangbie a ri the aa, ama ca cawsaa ta hmuo a cuo lipa ca, a palung a thle riypata ca cawsaa hmuo a cuo lipa puv. Biekuo malie a pi khutaata, hrie li pata a aw'a ma? A ri khutaata patling sa li pata a aw'a ma?
Mang tie, thluechiy pi riypa tana bie ina pi; ama ta thluechiy a pi tlipa ca, kama ta pakaa khu va ang.
Jakob cunglie vuochina hmung vyi; Israel cunglie ruvnaana hmung vyi. AbyipaKhazing ca iema'a lie aw te, siepahruo pathuosana ueryi na iema hrawlie a aw.
Iema kha Izipt taata a vya pyakhyipa yi Khazing ca iema cuota calietungpa kiy haa tana a cuo.
Jakob ca a ca-ie khupa aw va yi, hmungdawluna ta Israel ca a du khu vyi.
Mang tie, cawsaa ca chingdepuvnung haata thu te, chingde tungpa haata aa daa! A siepa saa kha a ce diy hluo li hne, a thiepa sa a thiy kha a dang diy hluo li a bu vyi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Balak ta Balaam kyihuo khata, “Iema ca chie zaw sa hrahring khah yi, thluechiy zaw pi hrahring khah yi,” a ta.
Cuorasala Balaam ta Balak kha palie te, ‘Abyipata a ripa khana i tue riypata a cuo,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Balak ta Balaam kha, “A vaw tie, hmang hrangpa luo kha ca vaakhyi'a ang; capa ca ta Khazing palung patluo'a te, capa taa cata kama cuota iema kha chie na sa ngiethie thlu'a yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Balak ta Balaam kha ruocaapa luo aa hyipa Peor tluodaw luo kha a kiekhyi.
Balaam ta Balak kha, “Kama cuota bienatluophie suo sariy sa la cuetungpa sa sariy hne tuvtungpa sa sariy kha na pi tie,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Balak ca Balaam ripa haa khata tue te, bienatluophie cyicuo lie kha cuetungpa hne tuvtungpa ca a pihluo.

Israel ming thluechiy pipa hing Abyipapalungtluona tana a cuo tapa kha Balaam ta a pachang, caacuonakawta ning hrang haa khata pamangsana tuena luo kha cakuo va tli, cuorasala ruocaapa luo kha aa hyi.
Balaam ta ruo kha a suo ca Israel ming a phang a phang ta arina hmang lie ama awpa kha a hmung. Cakhutaata Khazing thlaapa kha a cunglie za aw te,
profet bie kha a ri: Boer sacapaa Balaam ripa profet bie, a ming a pasingsapa profet bie ca,
Khazing bie a thyipa profet bie, Lesyice muocuo kha a hmungpa, aa lie raalaa pata, a ming a pasing lipa:
Vya Jakob, kha tluv tama na thluodaa ca a puvthe, Vya Israel, naa rina hmang ca kha tluv tama a puvthe!
Tung kung aa mepa bawphie lu te, cavaa kie lie diedung na a lu. Abyipata aa lingpa aloes kung hne, tiy kielie ta sidar kung na a lu.
A tiypung taata tiy lang'a te, a ciycyi ta tiy a hluvsa a hmung aa. A siepahruo ca Agag laata a suo vie'a te, a pena ca cyicalang pata a cuo aa.
Izipt taata a vya pyakhyipa yi Khazing ca, ama cuota calietungpa kiy haa tana a cuo. A carie ta a cuopa mingphang tie kha paluo diy'a yi te, ama ruv kha a thli diy'a yi, a cuoti khata a ka'a yi.

A vale te chingde haa khata aa bu, chingdepuvnung na a lu; ahungma a pathu nguo aa? Nama thluechiy caa pipa bangkhuo ca thluechiypa ta cuo yi te, Nama chie caa sapa bangkhuo ca chiesapa ta ama cuo,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Balak hihaana Balaam cunglie kha myi ie ta ie te, a kuvpazaa kha a tung. Balak ta Balaam kyihuo khata, “I carie tie chie sa riypa tana ica ku, cuorasala yi thung yalya ta thluechiy na pi yi.
Ata ca maa che'a tli! Na ing luo si tie! Lawmuo a hluvsa ca pi naase ang ica ta raalaa, cuorasala Abyipana nama lawmuo pi riypa kha a khing va,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Balaam ta Balak kyihuo khata, “Na vya pathliepa biephyatuv tie kyihuo ta,

‘Balak ta a ing zungkha ta siy hne ngu lasaw ina pi zaw, Abyipabie lawpakhung pata a phapa cuose, a chiepa cuose kama ri ta khaapahmuo tue khu'a va ang; Abyipaa ripa kha kama zaw i ri aa,’ i ta tlarya yi cuo va ma?
Caacuonakawta ata hing ca i cawsaa zaw'a luo khana i si aa; a vaw riypa cuo lie hingpa cawsaa zaw hingta na cawsaa zaw cunglie khaapama ama tue aa tapa kha ca chang'a ang,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta ama ta a hmungpa profet bie kha a ri: “Boer sacapaa Balaam ripa profet bie, a ming pasingsapa cawsaapa pamang sana,
Khazing bie a thyipa profet bie, Cungnungce pachangna a pachangpa, Lesyice muocuo a hmungpa, a lie ra sala a ming a pasing lipa a bie ca:

Ama ca i hmung, cuorasala ata hing cuo vyi; ama ca i mang, cuorasala a ngie vyi, Jakob chungtaata aasiy suokha a pya aa, Israel chungtaata byikhuecahryi suokha a pya aa. Capa ca ta Moab ruoriy kha para'a te, Sheth ruoriy zaw kha a para aa.
Edom ca te pata cuo'a te, Seir zaw a cariepa ta a te aa; Israel ta riephasa pata a hrie thue ca.
Jakob chungtaata pakha ta uv'a te, a hringpa ta aa ngaapa Ir tie kha a para diy'a yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Amalek luo kha suo te, profet bie ca a ri: “Amalek ca mingphang zaw hrawlie pakhana tana a cuo, cuorasala a chuona ca chuozaa rana tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Ken ming kha suo yi te, profet bie ca a ri: “Na awna hmang ca a cupa tana a cuo, na buv ca alung chunglie tuepa tana a cuo.
Cuorasala Kain ca myi ta kuo diy riypa na aa puvkhyi. Khacuo te ma Asshur ta sii ta aca sikhyi aa?” a ta.
Profet bie kha a ri pakhaa hyi: “Ah!, Khazing ta capa a tue ning ca ahungma a hring khu aa?
Cuorasala Kittim taata tiypalaw a vaw'a te, Asshur hne Eber kha tuechie'a yi te, ama zaw chuozaa ta a vie ra aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Balaam ca thu te a awna hmang luo kha a si, Balak zaw a si ra.
Israel ming ca Shittim lie ama aw ning kha Moab canung zaw hneta canung capaa anuona ama tue taw.
Capa tie ca ta cawsaa kha ama khazing hriykhungrina luo kha hry yi te, cawsaa ca capa lie ca sa ning yi te ama khazing hmiekunglie kha a bung yi te amaa bie.
Cahaacata Israel ming ca Peor lie Baal kha abie yi te a sa kha ama ning nakawta Abyipahihaana ca ama cunglie myi ie ta a ie.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata, “Abyipahihaana ciy aa chiypa ca Israel ming'a taata aa phe the riypata Israel ming byi bangkhuo kha ku yi la Abyipahmiekung ningsaa lie kha thie tie yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Moses ta Israel ming bieripatuv tie kyihuo khata, “Peor lie Baal abiepa nama cawsaa tie kha thie kaluo tie ung,” a ta.

Ca khu pahne ta Israel ming pakha ta atawna thluodaa luo angiena lie Israel ming ama caa nguoluo ning kha Moses hmungna lie hne Israel ming cawsaazaapuv hmungna lieta Midian cawsaanung pakha kha a ingchungkhue luo a vya chiykhyi.
Tluobyi Aaron sacapaa Eleazar sacapaa Phinehas ta capa ca a hmung tiyta, cawsaazaapuv'a taa khata thu te, asyi kha a kuv lie a cyile te,

Israel pa ca thluodaa chung luo kha paziyle te, Israel pa hne cawsaanung hne cata ama pahning ta ama tepaw lieta asyi ta a cakha pahaw yi. Caacuonakawta Israel ming hrawlieta puvtlung pasana ca aa pe.
Cadyiseca puvtlung pasana ta a thiypa ca thawkiy thawpaliy ama ta.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:

“Tluobyi Aaron sacapaa Eleazar a sacapaa Finehas ta Israel ming'a lie i hihaana ca a maa tli, tahematapakieca iema hrawlie kha cahaapa a hrakuona kha a paluosa nakawta, Israel ming kha thiesa diy'a va yi ang.
Caacuonakawta chang tie, ‘Kama na i biekuona diena kha a pi ang.
Capa ca ama hne a ciypathla cuota tluobyi cuo pari riypa biekuona tana a cuo, tahematapakieca ama ca a Khazing cuota a karuo aw te, Israel ming cuota sue angiethena a tuepa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Midian cawsaanung hneta ama thiepa Israel cawsaapa ca Simeon phang uvthyi tie chungtaata Salu sacapaa Zimri ta a cuo.
Ama thiepa Midian cawsaanung ca Midian phang uvthyi Zur sacanung Kozbi ta a cuo.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata,
“Midian tie kha tuv yi la te tie yi;
tahematapakieca Peor lie puvtlung pasana a tlung ningta thiepa Midian luochiytuv sacanung, ama sietanung, Kozbi kawlie hne Peor kawlie kha ca dung yi te aca pataw aca pamuo yi,” a ta.
Puvtlung pasana a tlung khutaata Abyipata Moses hne tluobyi Aaron sacapaa Eleazar kyihuo khata,
“Israel ming cawsaazaapuv kung kiy taata a cung luo, rie a tuv khu riypa bangkhuo hing a chung a chung ta mingluv ri tie ung,” a ta yi.
Moses hne tluobyi Eleazar ta Moab bawphie Jeriko huesuo Jordan cavaa kie lie kha iema kyihuo khata,
Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haa khata, “Kung kiy taata a cungluo cawsaa kha mingluv ri tie ung,” a ma ta. Izipt ruo taata a vya pyapa Israel ming ca:
Reuben, Israel sacapaa uvthyi. Reuben ciypathla zaw ca: Hanok pathla Hanok chung, Pallu pathla Pallu chung,
Hezron pathla Hezron chung, Karmi pathla Karmi chung zaw ta ama cuo.
Hingpa tie hing Reuben chung ta ama cuo; mingluv ripa bangkhuo ca thawsawliy thawthung zasariy sawthung ta ama cuo.
Pallu ciypathla tie: Eliab.

Eliab ciypathla ca: Nemuel, Dathan hne Abiram ta ama cuo. Hingpa tie hing cawsaazaapuv hraw taata a tlawpa Dathan hne Abiram khata cuo yi te, Korah hne a cawsaa zaw ta Moses hne Aaron amaa du ning kha a pahlaw yi te a du rapa tie ta ama cuo. Abyipakha amaa du tiyta,
alyi ta a pakaa kya uo te Korah hne khata a paluo yi. Capa cawsaa phuv ama thiy ning kha, myi ta cawsaa zahning sawngaa kuo sa diy yi te, iema ca a raaringna ta ama cuo.
Cahaacata a cuo raalaa pata Korah sacapaa zaw ca thiy va yi.
Simeon ciypathla zaw ca a chung a chung ta: Nemuel pathla Nemuel chung, Jamin pathla Jamin chung, Jakin pathla Jakin chung,
Zerah pathla Zerah chung, Shaul pathla Shaul chung zaw ta ama cuo.
Hingpa tie hing Simeon chung ta cuo yi te, thawkiy thawhning zahning ta ama cuo.
Gad ciypathla tie ca a chung a chung ta: Zefon pathla Zefon chung, Haggi pathla Haggi chung, Shuni pathla Shuni chung,
Ozni pathla Ozni chung, Eri pathla Eri chung,
Arod pathla Arod chung, Areli pathla Areli chung zaw ta ama cuo.
Hingpa tie hing Gad chung ta cuo yi te: mingluv ripa bangkhuo ca thawsawliy zapangaa ta ama cuo.
Judah sacapaa zaw: Er hne Onan; Er hne Onan ca Kanaan ruo liena ama thiy.
Judah ciypathla zaw a chung a chung ta: Shelah pathla Shelah chung; Perez pathla Perez chung; Zerah pathla Zerah chung zaw ta ama cuo.
Perez ciypathla zaw ca: Hezron pathla Hezron chung; Hamul pathla Hamul chung zaw ta ama cuo.
Hingpa tie hing Judah chung ta ama cuo: mingluv ripa bangkhuo ca thawsawsariy thawcaruv zapangaa ta ama cuo.
Issakhar ciypathla a chung a chung ta: Tola pathla Tola chung, Puvah pathla Puvah chung;
Jashub pathla Jashub chung; Shimron pathla Shimron chung zaw ta ama cuo.
Hingpa tie hing Isskhar chung ta ama cuo: mingluv ripa bangkhuo ta thawsawcaruv thawpaliy zathung ta ama cuo.
Zebulun ciypathla tie a chung a chung ta: Sered pathla Sered chung; Elon pathla Elon chung; Jahleel pathla Jahleel chung zaw ta ama cuo.
Hingpa tie hing Zebulun chung ta ama cuo; mingluv ripa bangkhuo ta thawsawcaruv zapangaa ta ama cuo.
Josef sacapaa zaw a chung a chung ta: Manasseh hne Efraim.
Manasseh ciypathla: Makhir pathla Makhir chung; Makhir ca Gilead paa ta a cuo; Gilead pathla Gilead chung zaw ta ama cuo.
Hingpa tie hing Gilead ciypathla zaw ta ama cuo: Iezer pathla Iezer chung; Helek pathla Helek chung;
Asriel pathla Asriel chung; hne Shekhem pathla Shekhem chung;
hne Shemida pathla Shemida chung; Hefer pathla Hefer chung zaw ta ama cuo.
Hefer sacapaa Zelofehad ca sacapaa hnyi vyi, cuorasala sacanung a hnyi yi: Zelofehad sacanung zaw ama ming ca: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah, hne Tirzah zaw ta ama cuo.
Hingpa tie hing Manasseh chung ta ama cuo; mingluv ripa bangkhuo ca thawsawngaa thawhning zasariy ta ama cuo.
Hingpa tie hing Efraim ciypathla a chung a chung ta ama cuo: Shuthelah pathla Shuthelah chung; Bekher pathla Bekher chung; Tahan pathla Tahan chung zaw ta ama cuo.
Hingpa tie hing Shuthelah ciypathla zaw ta ama cuo: Eran pathla Eran chung ta ama cuo.
Hingpa tie hing Efraim chung ta ama cuo: mingluv ripa bangkhuo ta thawsawthung thawhning zapangaa ta ama cuo. Hingpa tie hing Josef ciypathla a chung a chung ta ama cuo.
Benjamin ciypathla zaw ca a chung a chung ta: Bela pathla Bela chung, Ashbel pathla Ashbel chung; Ahiram pathla Ahiram chung;
Shefufam pathla Shefufam chung; Hufam pathla Hufam chung zaw ta ama cuo.
Bela sacapaa zaw ca Ard hne Naaman: Ard pathla ca Ard chung; Naaman pathla ca Naaman chung zaw ta ama cuo.
Hingpa tie hing Benjamin ciypathla a chung a chung ta ama cuo; mingluv ripa bangkhuo ca thawsawliy thawpangaa zacaruv ta ama cuo.
Hingpa tie hing Dan ciypathla zaw a chung a chung ta ama cuo: Shuham pathla Shuham chung ta ama cuo. Hingpa tie hing Dan pathla a chung a chung ta ama cuo. Shuham pathla a chung a chung ta:
mingluv ripa bangkhuo thawsawcaruv thawpaliy zapaliy ama cuo.
Asher ciypathla a chung a chung ta: Imnah pathla Imnah chung; Ishvi pathla Ishvi chung; Beriah pathla Beriah chung zaw ta ama cuo.
Beriah ciypathla zaw: Heber pathla Heber chung; Malkhiel pathla Malkhiel chung zaw ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata Asher sacanung a ming ca Serah ta a cuo.
Hingpa tie hing Asher chung ta ama cuo: mingluv ripa ama bangkhuo ta thawsawngaa thawthung zapaliy ta ama cuo.
Naftali ciypathla a chung a chung ta: Jahzeel pathla Jahzeel chung, Guni pathla Guni chung;
Jezer pathla Jezer chung; Shillem pathla Shillem chung zaw ta ama cuo.
Hingpa tie hing Naftali pathla a chung a chung ta ama cuo: mingluv ripa bangkhuo ta thawsawliy thawpangaa zapaliy ta ama cuo.
Hingpa hing mingluv ripa Israel ming ta ama cuo: thawzacaruv thawkha zasariy sawthung ta ama cuo.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Hingpa tie hing ama ming rina haata ru cuota ruo kha che pata ama cuo aa.
Phang le viepa kha a le vie ta ru nama pi aa, a caw viepa phang kha a caw vie ta ru nama pi aa; phang bangkhuo kha mingluv rina haata ru nama pi aa.
Cuorasala ruo ca vyisung a da pata na pipa a cuo aa, ama ciypathlatuv tie phang ming haa khata ama cuo aa.
Ama ru ca a phang le viepa hne a phang caw viepa alalalie kha vyisung a da pata pipa ama cuo aa.
Hingpa hing Levi ming a chung a chung ta mingluv rina cuo te: Gershon pathla Gershon chung; Kohath pathla Kohath chung; Merari pathla Merari chung zaw ta ama cuo.
Hingpa tie hing Levi chung, Libni chung, Hebron chung, Mahli chung, Mushi chung, Korah chung tapa zaw ta ama cuo. Kohath ca Amram paa ta a cuo.
Amram napuvnung ca Levi sacanung Jokhebed ta cuo te, Levi ta Izipt ruo lie a sapa tana a cuo. Ama ta Amram hneta Aaron, Moses, hne ama sietanung Miriam kha ama sa.
Aaron ta Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar hne Ithamar kha a sa yi.
Cuorasala Nadab hne Abihu ca Abyipahmiekunglie phung ta a khuopa myi ama za pihluo ning kha ama thiy.

Thla kha taata a cung luo mingluv ripa bangkhuo ca thawsawthung thawthung ta ama cuo. Iema ca Israel ming mingluv rina lieta pasuvpuo pata cuo va yi, tahematapakieca Iema ca Israel ming hrawlie kha pasuvpuo pata luruo repa cuo va yi.
Hingpa tie hing Moses hne tluobyi Eleazar ta Jeriko huesuo Jordan cavaa kie Moab bawphie lieta mingluv ama ripa Israel ming ta ama cuo.
Hingpa zaw hrawlie hing Moses hne tluobyi Aaron ta Sinai ruocaapa lie Israel ming mingluv ama za ripa tie pakha hmuo aw ra va tli yi.
Tahematapakieca Abyipata iema kha, “Iema ca ruocaapa liena ama thiy aa,” a ta yi. Jefunneh sacapaa Kaleb hne Nun sacapaa Joshua ta li pata pakha hmuo a ngaa va yi.

Cakhutaata Zelofehad sacanung zaw amaa vaw. Iema ca Josef sacapaa, Manasseh chung; Manasseh sacapaa Makhir, Makhir sacapaa Gilead, Gilead sacapaa Hefer, Hefer sacapaa Zelofehad sacanung zaw ta ama cuo. A sacanung zaw ming ca: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah, hne Tirzah zaw ta ama cuo.
Iema ca Moses, tluobyi Eleazar, uvthyi zaw, hne cawsaa bangkhuo hmiekunglie, atawna thluodaa chiypakaa lie kha a tu yi te,
“Ma paa ca ruocaapa lie khana a za thiy; ama ca Abyipaa du riypata a hmyapa Korah phuv lie kha aw ra vyi, cuorasala ama suena kawlieta thiy te sacapaa hnyi vyi.
Khaapanakawma ma paa ming ca sacapaa a hnyi li nakawta a chungkha ming taata thawpa a cuo aa? Ma paa uvnu zaw hrawlie hing cuvu malie pi ra tie ung,” ama ta.
Moses ta ama kaw ca Abyipa hmiekung luo kha a chiykhyi.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Zelofehad sacanung zaw ama ripa hing aa hmuo; a paa uvnu zaw hrawlieta ru nama pacu sa ra hrahring riypa tana a cuo, ama paa ru ca iema kha pi tie ung.
Israel ming zaw kha chang tie ung, “Cawsaa pakhakha thiy te sacapaa a hnyi li kieca a ru ca a sacanung khana nama pi aa.
Sacanung a hnyi li kieca a uvnu kha nama pi aa.
Ama ta uvnu a hnyi li kieca a paa uvnu tie kha nama pi aa.
A paa ta uvnu a hnyi li kieca a tieriy aa ngie cepa kha a ru ca nama pi aa. Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haa khata, capa ca Israel ming phungluo hne ziyphung ta a cuo aa,” a ta.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata, “Abarim tluothlue luo khiy kie la Israel ming i pipa yi ruo kha suo tie.
Na hmung khutaata na cawsaa zaw’ luo kha pahmya pata na cuo aa, na uvta Aaron haa khata,

tahematapakieca Zin ruocaapa lie cawsaazaapuv ta inaa hru ning yi khana i bie naa zaa du. Iema hmiekunglie, tiy lie kha i pathena paluo sa vaciy,” a ta. (Capa ca Zin ruocaapa lie a awpa Meribath-kadesh tiy khata a cuo).
Moses ta Abyipakyihuo khata,
“Abyipa, Saapa bangkhuo tie thlaapa Khazing, cawsaazaapuv luochiytuv riypa pakhakha a tlaw tie,
ama hmiekunglie a pya riypa hne a ngie riypa, a pyakhyi riypa yi hne a ngiekhyi riypa yi ta, cakiedyina Abyipana cawsaazaapuv hing a khietuv a hnyi lipa tuvrung hne a lu li pata ama aw aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Abyipata, “Nun sacapaa Joshua, a chunglie thlaapa a hnyipa paa kha la lah, a luv cunglie kha na kuv khang tie;
tluobyi Eleazar hne cawsaazaapuv hmiekunglie kha padaa la iema ming hmungna lieta naw hnyina kha pi tie.
Israel ming cawsaazaapuv bangkhuo ta ama pa-uvsathyi riypata nama nawhnyina chekha kha pi tie.

Cuorasala ama ca tluobyi Eleazar hmiekunglie kha a daa'a te, ama ta Urim biechina kha Abyipahmiekunglie ta a hiehriypa aa; iema ca ama bie ta pya'a yi te amaa ngie aa, ama hne Israel ming cawsaazaapuv hne cata,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Moses ca Abyipabiepina haa cata a tue. Joshua ca la te tluobyi Eleazar hne cawsaazaapuv hmiekunglie kha a padaa;
Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haa khata a kuv kha a luv cunglie khang te nawhnyina kha a pi.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:

Israel ming kha bie pi yi la hing haa hingta chang tie yi: Kama'a luo pihluopa, myi ta rue pata kama'a luo pihluopa sa, kama'a luo rangpa-ue pihluopa tie kha ama'a na a cuota lieta pihluo riypata namaa raaringsa aa.
Iema kha chang yi la, hingpa hing Abyipanama pihluo riypa myi ta ruepa pihluona tana a cuo, na ta'a yi: kung kha a tapa a dutlapa tuvtungpa sahning ca ningting pihluo riypata a cuo aa.
Tuv sakha ca maw ta pihluo'a ung cate, a hrangpa tuv sakha ca zuoluo ta nama pihluo aa.
Jungsacuo viedie a pha cepa ephah che hraa che kha, chiytiy hin che paliy che kha hne pya ciepa zaw kha sa ta panaana ta nama pihluo aa.
Hingpa hing Sinai tluo lie rangpa-ue cuo riypata pacuosapa, myi ta rue pata Abyipa'a luo pihluopa, tue pari riypa myirue panaana ta a cuo.
Dangpa ta panaana ca tuvtaata sakha cyicuo cuota hin che paliy che kha ta a cuo aa; dangpa ta panaana ca hmangpathepa lie kha Abyipacuota nama bya aa.
A hrangpa tuv sakha kha sa ta panaana hne dangpa ta panaana hne khata maw ta nama pihluopa haa khata zuoluocaw ta nama pihluo aa; Abyipa'a luo rangpa-ue cuo riypata myi ta rue pata nama pihluo aa.
Sabbath ning mekaa kha: a dutlapa tuvtungpa sahning, chiytiy hne pya ciepa jungsacuo viedie pha cepa ephah che hraa che hning kha sa ta panaana ta nama pihluo aa.
Ningting myirue panaana hne dangpa ta panaana thang taa hingta myirue panaana kha sabbath ning kyry ta nama tue aa.
Thlaa a pathu ning kha Abyipa'a luo kha myirue panaana nama pihluo aa: cuetungpa a panu ta sahning, tuvtungpa sakha, a dutlapa kung kha a tapa tuvtungpa sasariy;

cuetungpa sakha cyicuo cuota chiytiy hne pya ciepa jungsacuo viedie a pha cepa ephah che thung che kha; tuvtungpa sakha cuota sa ta panaana riypata chiytiy hne pya ciepa jungsacuo viedie a pha cepa ephah che hraa che hning;
tuvtaata zaw cuota sa ta panaana riypata chiytiy hne pya ciepa jungsacuo viedie a pha cepa ephah che hraa che kha kha Abyipa'a luo rangpa-ue cuo riypata myirue panaana ta nama pihluo aa.

Dangpa panaana ca cuetungpa sakha cuota mingsuvtiy hin khingkhuo, tuvtungpa sakha cuota hin che thung che kha, tuvtaata sakha cuota hin che paliy che kha ta a cuo aa. Hingpa hing kung kha chung bangkhuo thla tating ta tue riypa myirue panaana ta a cuo aa.
Cakhutaata pihluo pari pa myirue panaana hne dangpa ta panaana thang taa hingta sue pathe sa panaana cuota Abyipa'a luo kha mietungpa sakha nama pihluo aa.
Thla khanapa ning hraa hlyipaliy ningta lawsena pyi pihluona kha Abyipa'a luo nama hnyi aa.
Capa thlaa ning hraa hlyipangaa ning kha pyi ning ta a cuo; thiynung phuv lipa viechuo kha ning sariy chung nama ning aa.
A ning khana lie ca a pathepa apungna nama hnyi aa. Nama re kha hrie'a va ung ciy.
Abyipa'a luo kha myirue panaana nama pihluo aa: cuetungpa a panuta sahning, tuvtungpa sakha, kung kha a tapa tuvtungpa sasariy; capa bangkhuo ca a dutlapa ama cuo aa.
Iema cuota sa ta panaana pihluo riypa ca chiytiy hne pya ciepa jungsacuo viedie a pha cepa cuo'a te: cuetungpa sakha cuota ephah che hraa che thung, tuvtungpa sakha cuota che hraa che hning,
tuvtaata sakha cyicuo cuota che hraa che kha ta nama pihluo aa;
Niema cuota sue angiethena hienapa mietungpa sakha kha sue pathe sa panaana ta nama pihluo aa.
Pihluo paripa maw ta tuepa myirue panaana thang taa hingta hingpa pihluona hing nama tue riypata a cuo.

Cahaa ngiethie cata Abyipa'a luo rangpa-ue cuo riypata myi ta ruepa sa ta pihluona zaw kha ning sariy chung ningting ta nama tue aa; Hingpa hing cipari nama tuepa myirue panaana hne dangpa ta panaana thang taa khata nama pihluo riypata a cuo.
Cakhutaata a ning sariyna lie ca a pathepa apungna ta a cuo aa; re hrie'a va ung ciy.
Sathaapa pihluo ning, Sathaapa pyi ningta sathaapa kha sa ta panaana ta Abyipa'a luo nama pihluo ning kha a pathepa apungna nama hnyi aa; re hrie'a va ung ciy.
Abyipa'a luo rangpa-ue cuo riypata myirue panaana kha nama pihluo aa: cuetungpa a panuta sahning, tuvtungpa sakha, kung kha a tapa tuvtungpa sasariy kha nama pihluo aa.
Cuetungpa sakha cuota sa ta panaana ta pihluo riypa ca chiytiy pya ciepa jungsacuo viedie a pha cepa ephah che hraa che thung, tuvtungpa sakha cuota che hraa che hning,
tuvtaata sasariy cuota che hraa che kha ta a cuo aa;
Niema cuota sue angiethena hiena riypata mietungpa sakha zaw kha nama pihluo aa.
Pihluo paripa myirue panaana hne sa ta panaana thang taa khata iema cuota dangpa ta panaana kha nama pihluo aa. Sahring bangkhuo ca a dutlapa ta a cuo aa.
A thla sariyna ning khana lie kha a pathepa apungna nama hnyi aa; re hrie'a va ung ciy. Niema cuota hmyakaa tungna ning ta cuo'a te,
Abyipacuota rangpa-ue cuo riypata myirue panaana kha nama pihluo aa: cuetungpa sakha, tuvtungpa sakha, a dutlapa kung kha a tapa tuvtaata sasariy kha nama pihluo aa.
Iema cuota sa ta panaana pihluo riypa ca, cuetungpa cuota chiytiy pya ciepa jungsacuo viedie a pha cepa ephah che hraa che thung, tuvtungpa cuota che hraa che hning,
tuvtaata sasariy cyicuo cuota che hraa che kha;
niema cuota sue angiethena riypata mietungpa sakha hneta nama pihluo aa.

Hingpa tie hing iema'a na ama ziyphung haa khata thla thaapa ning myirue panaana hne capa cuota sa ta panaana, cipari tue tawpa myirue panaana hne capa cuota sa ta panaana, hne capa tie cuota dangpa ta panaana zaw thang taa khata Abyipacuota rangpa-ue cuo riypata myi ta rue pata pihluopa ama cuo.
Capa thla sariy thlaa ning hraa ning kha a pathepa apungna nama hnyi aa, nama khingna kha a ang'a ung cate re hrie'a va ung ciy.
Abyipacuota rangpa-ue cuo riypata myirue panaana kha nama pihluo aa: cuetungpa sakha, tuvtungpa sakha, kung kha a tapa tuvtaata sasariy ta pata cuo'a te a dutlapa ta ama cuo aa.
Iema cuota sa ta panaana ta pihluo riypa ca cuetungpa cuota chiytiy pya ciepa jungsacuo viedie a pha cepa ephah che hraa che thung, tuvtungpa sakha cuota che hraa che hning,
tuvtaata sakha cyicuo cuota che hraa che kha kaluo;

kha sue pathe sa panaana cuota mietungpa sakha hneta nama pihluo aa, capa ca sue angiethena hiena cuota sue pathe sa panaana, hne cipari tue tawpa myirue panaana hne capa cuota sa ta panaana, hne dangpa ta panaana thang taa khata pihluopa tana a cuo.
Thla sariyna ning hraa hlyipangaa ning kha a pathepa apungna nama hnyi aa; re hrie'a va ung ciy. Abyipacuota ning sariy chung pyi nama tue aa.

Abyipacuota rangpa-ue cuo riypata myirue panaana kha nama pihluo aa: cuetungpa a panuta sahraa hlyithung, tuvtungpa sahning, kung kha a tapa tuvtaata sahraa hlyipaliy nama pihluo aa. Iema ca a dutlapa ta ama cuo aa.
Cuetungpa sahraa hlyithung, sakha cyicuo cuota chiytiy pya ciepa jungsacuo viedie pha cepa ephah che hraa che kha, tuvtungpa sahning, sakha cyicuo cuota che hraa che hning,
tuvtaata sahraa hlyipaliy, sakha cyicuo cuota che hraa che kha;
cipari tue tawpa myirue panaana hne, capa cuota sa ta panaana hne dangpa ta panaana zaw hlyitaw taata sue pathe sa panaana cuota mietungpa sakha zaw kha nama pihluo aa.
A ning hningna lie kha: cuetungpa sahraa hlyihning, tuvtungpa sahning, a dutlapa kung kha a tapa tuvtaata sahraa hlyipaliy,
kha cuetungpa tie cuota sa ta panaana hne dangpa ta panaana, tuvtungpa tie hne tuvtaata tie cuo zaw khata a phung haata hne a sa zaa hne aa ziy pata nama pihluo aa.
Cipari tue tawpa myirue panaana hne capa cuota sa ta panaana hne iema cuota dangpa ta panaana thang taa khata sue pathe sa panaana ta mietungpa sakha zaw kha nama pihluo aa.
A ning thungna lie kha: cuetungpa sahraa hlyithung, tuvtungpa sahning, a dutlapa kung kha a tapa tuvtungpa sahraa hlyipaliy,
kha cuetungpa tie cuota sa ta panaana hne dangpa ta panaana, tuvtungpa tie, hne tuvtaata tie cuo zaw khata a phung haata hne a sa zaa hne aa ziy pata nama pihluo aa;
cipari tue tawpa myirue panaana hne capa cuota sa ta panaana hne dangpa ta panaana hlyitaw taa khata sue pathe sa panaana cuota mietungpa sakha zaw kha nama pihluo aa.
A ning paliyna lie kha: cuetungpa sahraa, tuvtungpa sahning, a dutlapa kung kha a tapa tuvtungpa sahraa hlyipaliy,
kha cuetungpa tie cuota sa ta panaana hne dangpa ta panaana, tuvtungpa tie, hne tuvtaata tie cuo zaw khata a phung haata hne a sa zaa hne aa ziy pata nama pihluo aa;
cipari tue tawpa myirue panaana hne capa cuota sa ta panaana hne dangpa ta panaana hlyitaw taata sue pathe sa panaana cuota mietungpa sakha zaw kha nama pihluo aa.
A ning pangaana lie kha: cuetungpa sacaky, tuvtungpa sahning, a dutlapa kung kha a tapa tuvtungpa sahraa hlyipaliy,
kha cuetungpa tie cuota sa ta panaana hne dangpa ta panaana, tuvtungpa tie, hne tuvtaata tie cuo zaw khata a phung haata hne a sa zaa hne aa ziy pata nama pihluo aa;
cipari tue tawpa myirue panaana hne capa cuota sa ta panaana hne dangpa ta panaana thang taa khata sue pathe sa panaana cuota mietungpa sakha zaw kha nama pihluo aa.
A ning caruvna lie kha: cuetungpa sacari, tuvtungpa sahning, a dutlapa kung kha a tapa tuvtungpa sahraa hlyipaliy,
kha cuetungpa tie cuota sa ta panaana hne dangpa ta panaana, tuvtungpa tie, hne tuvtaata tie cuo zaw khata a phung haata hne a sa zaa hne aa ziy pata nama pihluo aa;
cipari tue tawpa myirue panaana hne capa cuota sa ta panaana hne dangpa ta panaana hlyitaw taa khata sue pathe sa panaana cuota mietungpa sakha zaw kha nama pihluo aa.
A ning sariyna lie kha: cuetungpa sasariy, tuvtungpa sahning, a dutlapa kung kha a tapa tuvtungpa sahraa hlyipaliy,
kha cuetungpa tie cuota sa ta panaana hne dangpa ta panaana, tuvtungpa tie, hne tuvtaata tie cuo zaw khata a phung haata hne a sa zaa hne aa ziy pata nama pihluo aa;
cipari tue tawpa myirue panaana hne capa cuota sa ta panaana hne dangpa ta panaana thang taa khata sue pathe sa panaana cuota mietungpa sakha zaw kha nama pihluo aa.
A ning carina lie kha phung haata a pathepa apungna kha nama hnyi aa; re hrie'a va ung ciy.
Abyipacuota rangpa-ue cuo riypata myirue panaana kha nama pihluo aa: cuetungpa sakha, tuvtungpa sakha, a dutlapa kung kha a tapa tuvtaata sasariy,
cuetungpa tie cuota sa ta panaana hne dangpa ta panaana, tuvtungpa, hne tuvtaata tie cuo khata a phung haata a sa zaa hne aa ziy pata nama pihluo aa.
Cipari tue tawpa myirue panaana hne capa cuota sa ta panaana hne dangpa ta panaana thang taa khata sue pathe sa panaana cuota mietungpa sakha zaw kha nama pihluo aa.

Hingpa tie hing ama'a na a cuo lieta nama tuepa pyi mekaa ning kha Abyipa'a luo nama pihluo aa. Bie a kuo pata nama pihluopa panaana hne nama lungthe panaana zaw thang taa khata, myirue panaana zaw, sa ta panaana zaw, dangpa ta panaana zaw, hne aviesaa panaana zaw kha nama pihluo diy aa.
Caacuonakawta Abyipata Moses bie a pina haa khata Moses ta Israel ming ca zezaw bangkhuo kha a chang yi.
Cakhutaata Moses ta Israel ming mingphang luv a cuopa tie kyihuo khata: Hingpa hing Abyipata bie ina pipa tana a cuo.
Capaa pakha ta Abyipa'a lie kha chie a sa pata biekuona a tue kie cuose, ama hne ama kha chie a sa pata bie a kuo kieca, a bie kha pathli'a vyi; a pakaa taata a pyapa haa kha tana a tue aa.
Canung pakha ta a lesaata ning, a paa ing lie a aw ning kha Abyipa'a lie chie a sa pata biekuona tue te, acuolikie biekuona ta ama hne ama aa ciypuo;
cahaacata chiesana ta ama hne ama aa ciypuopa kha a paa ta a thyi thluo pata khaapahmuo a ta li kieca; chie aa sana bangkhuo ca aa hmang aa; biekuona ta ama hne ama aa ciypuopa zaw kha aa hmang aa.

Cuorasala a paa ta khapa bie a thyi ning khata a naa a tlakhyi lina kha a ri kieca, chie aa sana bangkhuo hne biekuona ta ama hne ama aa ciypuopa zaw bangkhuo kha a hmang'a vyi, a paa ta ama'a luo kha a palung tling lina a ri tli nakawta Abyipata ama kha aa ngiethe aa.
Chie aa sa cangta a cuo zaw, acuolikie khue rue laliy li pata a ripa bie ta ama hne ama aa ciypuo pata navaa kha hnyi te,
a navaapa ta a thyi thluo pata khaapahmuo a ri li kieca, chie aa sana ca a hmang'a te, biekuona ta ama hne ama aa ciypuopa zaw kha aa hmang aa.
Cuorasala a navaapa ta a thyi tiyta, a palung a tlingkhyi lina kha a ri kieca, chie aa sapa hne rue pawliy li pata ri te aa ciypuopa bie kha a navaapa ta a para; Abyipata aa ngiethe aa.
(Cuorasala nunghlyinung acuolikie a navaapa hne aa chepa canung ta chie aa sana hne ama hne ama aa ciypuopa bie ca ama kha a ciypuo pari aa.)
A navaapa ing lie chie a sa te, acuolikie bie a kuo te ama hne ama a bie ta aa ciypuopa kha,
a navaapa ta thyi te khaapahmuo a ri li kieca, a naa a tlakhyi lina kaw kha a ri li kieca, chie aa sana bangkhuo ca a hmang'a te, bie ri te aa ciypuopa bangkhuo ca aa hmang aa.
Cuorasala a navaapa ta a bie a thyi ning kha a para kieca, bie aa kuopa hne chie a sa pata a ripa bie ta aa ciypuopa zaw kha ra'a te Abyipata aa ngiethe aa.
Chie aa sapa hne bie a kuo te aa ciypuopa ca a navaapa ta a pahmang sa khu, acuolikie a para khu.

Cuorasala a navaapa ta ning kha hnang ning kha khaapahmuo ri li pata a aw kieca, chie aa sapa hne bie a kuo te aa ciypuopa, a cunglie aa pavypa kha a pacu sa pata a cuo, tahematapakieca a thyi ningta ama'a lie khaapahmuo a ri li nakawta a pacu sa pata na a cuo.
A thyi khutaata a para kieca a napuvnung pha lina kha ama na a ang aa, a ta.
Hingpa tie hing navaapa hne napuvnung hneta aa patuv pata cuose, a paa hne lesaata a paa ing lie a aw kaliepa sacanung hne aa patuv pata Abyipata Moses bie a pipa phungluo tana a cuo.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata,
“Israel ming phuv ca Midian ming'a lie kha la tie; ca khutaata nama ca na cawsaa zaw'a luo kha pahmya pata na cuo aa,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Moses ta cawsaa tie kha, “Rie tuv riypata na cawsaa chekha kha cehre pi tie yi, tahematapakieca Abyipata Midian ming cunglie phuv a lana kha patlung riypa tana Midian ming kha amaa du aa.
Israel ming phang kha chungtaata thawkha kaluo pathlie tie yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Israel ming thaw hluvpuv chungtaata phang kha taata thawkha kha u yi te rie tuv riypata cehre ama patuv sa.
Moses ta phang kha taata thawkha, hne tluobyi Eleazar sacapaa Finehas kha hmangpathepa biphie hne a raaring pina ta tung riypa hmyakaa pacyi sa te rie tuv riypata a pathlie yi.
Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haata Midian ming kha tuv yi te capaa bangkhuo kha ama thie diy.

Iema ta Midian siepahruo tie kha ama thie: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, hne Reba, tapa Midian siepahruo papangaa kha ama thie, a hrangpa ama thiepa tie thang taa khata Boer sacapaa Balaam zaw kha zueziy ta ama thie.
Israel ming ca ta Midian canung tie, ama saata zaw kha sii ta patuv yi te, ama cue, ama tuv hne ama chechiy bangkhuo kha hruosue ta ama la diy.
Ama za awnapa ama khypuv zaw hne amaa rinapa hmang bangkhuo kha myi ta ama rue diy.
Cuorasala rietuvna lie ama lapa hruosue, cawsaa hne sahring bangkhuo kha amaa la diy.
Cakhutaata hruocawsaa tie hne hruosue zaw kha Moses hne tluobyi Eleazar hne Israel ming cawsaazaapuv'a luo, Moab bawphie Jordan kie lie a awpa Jeriko luo kha ama vya chiykhyi.
Moses, hne tluobyi Eleazar, hne cawsaazaapuv luochiytuv bangkhuo ta arina hmang le luo kha daw riypata ama pya.
Moses ca rietuvna taata a vya kaapa riekabyi tie, thawkha uvtuv hne zakha uvtuv tie cunglie kha a hi a haa.
Moses ta iema kyihuo khata, “Canung tie bangkhuo hing pahring riypata biepipa nama cuo ma?
