Hingpa canung tie hingna Balaam ta ruena pi yi te Peor kawlieta Israel ming kha Abyipa'a lie biekuo a para sa yi, capa nakaw ca tana Abyipacawsaa tie cunglie kha puvtlung pasana a za tlung.
Caacuonakawta haatiy zaw hraw taa hingta capaa bangkhuo kha thie ung la, capaa a pachang buopa canung bangkhuo kha thie tie ung.
Cuorasala capaa a pachang buo li liepa canung bangkhuo kha ca niema cuota a chi tie ung.
Arina hmang ale luo khata a ri ung la, cawsaa a thiepa hne a thiypa riyy a tawpa niema hne nama hruocawsaa tie bangkhuo ca ning thung ning hne ning sariy ning kha a pathe tie ung.
Caw bangkhuo, savang ta tuepa chechiy bangkhuo, mie hming ta tuepa chechiy bangkhuo, hne thing ta tuepa chechiy bangkhuo kha pathe tie ung,” a ta yi.
Tluobyi Eleazar ta rietuvna luo a sipa rieka tie kyihuo khata: “Hingpa hing Abyipata Moses'a lie bie a pipa phungluo tana a cuo:
siy, ngu, daa, thaa, cuophiy, kawthuv,
myi a ang khupa bangkhuo ca myi ta rue'a ung cate nama pathe aa. Cuorasala tiy ta pathe sana zaw kha nama tue aa; myi ta ruepa a ang khu lipa tie kha tiy ta nama pathe aa.
Ning sariyna lieta nama caw kha pasuv'a ung cate, nama pathe aa; cakhutaa dyi cata arina hmang luo kha namaa ngie aa,” a ta.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata,
“Nama hne tluobyi Eleazar hne cawsaazaapuv chungtaata a chung a chung ta uvthyi tie ta rie lie patuvpa cawsa, sahring hne chechiy cazing kha tue tie ung.
Hruosue kha che hning ta che tie ung, rietuvna luo a sipa rieka tie hne cawsaazaapuv cuo khata.
Rietuvna luo a sipa rieka tie cuvu taa khata cawsaa a cuo kie zapangaa lie pakha, cuetungpa, laa, tuv, hne mie a cuo kie zapangaa lie sakha ta pata Abyipahuota chi pathlyi tie ung.
Capa chung taa khata khingkhuo kha che la Abyipa'a luo panaana riypata tluobyi Eleazar kha pi tie.

Cakhutaata Israel ming cuvu khingkhuo cawsaa a cuo kie sawngaa lie pakha, cuetungpa, laa, tuv, hne mie, sahring bangkhuo taata sawngaa lie sakha kha la lah Abyipacuota bienathluodaa lie re a hriepa Levi ming kha pi tie yi.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haa khata Moses hne tluobyi Eleazar ta ama tue.
Rieka ta amaa la khutaata aa ngaa kaliepa hruosue ca tuv zacaruv sawsariy sapangaa,
cuetungpa thawsawsariy thawhning,
laa thawzacaruv thawkha,
cawsaa, capaa a pachang buo lipa canung bangkhuo ta thawsawthung thawhning ama cuo.
Rietuvna luo a sipa tie ama cuvu khingkhuo ca tuv hne mie thawzathung angkha thawsawthung thawsariy zapangaa ta cuo te,
Abyipacuota lasaw ca tuv hne mie zacaruv sawsariy sapangaa ta a cuo.
Cuetungpa thawsawthung thawcaruv cuo te Abyipacuota lasaw ca sawsariy sahning ta a cuo.
Laa ca thawsawthung zapangaa cuo te, Khazing cuota lasaw ca sawcaruv sakha ta a cuo.
Cawsaa ca thawhraa hlyi caruv cuo te Abyipacuota lasaw ca sawthung pahning ta ama cuo.
Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haa khata, Moses ta tluobyi Eleazar kha Abyipa'a luo panaana riypata a pi.
Moses ta rieka tie'a taata la te Israel ming cawsaazaapuv a pipa yi khingkhuo ca,
tuv hne mie thawzathung angkha thawsawthung thawsariy zapangaa,
cuetungpa thawsawthung thawcaruv,
laa thawsawthung zapangaa,
cawsaa thawhraa hlyicaruv ta a cuo.
Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haata, Moses ta Israel ming cuvu khingkhuo chungtaata, sawngaa chunglie suokha a lapa cawsaa hne sahring kha Abyipathluodaa lie re a hriepa Levi ming kha a pi yi.
Cakhutaata rieka a thaw cunglie byi a cuopa tie, a thaw ta a uvpa riebyi, a za ta a uvpa riebyi tie ta Moses kha a vya ngie yi te,
“Ma uvna rawlie a awpa rieka tie kha ri yi pate pakha hmuo bu va yi.

Abyipahmiekunglie kiema cuota sue angiethena riypata Abyipa'a luo pihluo riypata kiema cyicuo ta ma hmungpa; siy ta tuepa chechiy, kuvpahryi hne kukaw, mingse a cungnapa kuvpahryi, ra-aw hne haalaw zaw kha ma vya cyi mangtli,” a ma ta.
Moses hne tluobyi Eleazar ta chechiy ta tue tlipa siy bangkhuo kha ama cuhluo.
A thaw ta a uvpa riekabyi tie hne a za ta a uvpa riekabyi tie'a taata ama cuhluopa siy, Abyipa'a luo ama pihluopa siy bangkhuo ca shekel thawhraa hlyicaruv zasariy sawngaa ta a cuo.
(Rieka tie bangkhuo ca rie lieta iema ama lapa hruosue kha amaa la).

Caacuonakawta Moses hne tluobyi Eleazar ca rieka a thaw hne a za ta a uvpa riebyi tie'a taa khata siy kha cuhluo yi te, Israel ming cuota Abyipahmiekunglie athyipakhaana cuo riypata atawna thluodaa chung luo kha amaa ngiekhyi.
Reuben phang hne Gad phang tie ta sahring a hluvsa ama hnyi. Iema ta Jazer ruo hne Gilead ruo kha sahring cuota a phasapa ruo tana a cuo tapa kha ama hmung tiyta,
a vaw yi te Moses, hne tluobyi Eleazar, hne cawsaazaapuv luochiytuv tie kyihuo khata,
“Abyipata Israel ming cawsaazaapuv hmiekunglie a tepa ruo, Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, hne Beon
tapa tie hing sahring cuota a phasapa ruo tana ama cuo; nama changtaapa zaw hing sahring ma hnyi,” ama ta.
Pazue yi te, “Nama hmiekunglie na hmiephaa ma hmung ta pata a cuo kieca, hingpa ruo hing nama changtaapa zaw hing malie pi thi tie ung; Jordan huesuo luo malie pasi sa thi khah ung,” ama ta.
Cuorasala Moses ta Gad phang tie hne Reuben phang tie kha, “Nama uvnu zaw rie ama tuv ning kha ma namaa tu thluo aa?
Khaapanakawma Abyipata a pipa yi ruo chungluo vaa ngie riypata Israel ming kha ama thaa nama pachi aa?
Kadesh-barnea taata ruo mang riypata i pathlie ning yi khana nama paa zaw ta hing haa hingta ama za tue.
Eshkol Bawphie luo sithaw yi te ruo ama hmung tiyta, Abyipata a pipa yi ruo chung luo a ngie riypata Israel ming kha ama thaa ama za pachi.
Capa ning lie ca Abyipahihaana kha myi ie ta ie te iema kha,

‘Izipt taata a vya pyapa kung kiy taata a cung luo cawsaa pakha hmuota Abraham, Isak hne Jakob pi riypata chie a sa angte bie i kuopa yi ruo luo kha a ngie hrahring'a va yi; tahematapakieca iema ca pathiypalung hmisi ta na ziy va yi.
Keniz phang Jefunneh sacapaa Kaleb hne Nun sacapaa Joshua dyina ama pathiypalung hmisi ta Abyipaa ziy yi,’ a ta.

Cakhutaata Abyipahihaana ca Israel ming cunglie kha myi ie ta ie te, Abyipahmungna lie hmang pha lipa a tuepa tie chuo lie cawsaa ama thiy diy hluo li ta iema kha kung sawliy chung ruocaapa lie a pakhie sa yi.
Ata zaw hing, Israel ming cunglie Abyipahihaana aa chana riypata niema, a suepa phuv hing nama paa zaw hmang lie namaa daa hyi tli hing haw!
Niema hing na ama ziy li pata a palise ung ciy tapa kieca Abyipata iema hing ruocaapa lie a thuse pakhaa'a yi; hingpa cawsaa bangkhuo hing nama para diy aa,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata iema ta a vya ngie vie yi te, “Hingpa lie hing ma sahring zaw cuota te sapa siy'a pate haatiy zaw cuota khy ma tuepa siy'a yi,

cuorasala Israel ming ama awna riypa te ama chiy hluo li cehre a la'a pate hmieluo ta ma si aa. Hingpa ruo lie a awpa tie kawlie hingta capa cuo chunglie ca ma saata zaw kha a dungkhuopa khy lie kha ama aw aa.
Israel ming ta ama cu riypa ruo ama hmung diy hluo li ma ing luo kaa'a vapuv.
Kiema ca Jordan cavaa huesuo ruo ca iema hneta cu ra'a va tli puv, tahematapakieca hingpa Jordan cavaa ningchiy suo luo hing ma cu tli nakawta,” a ma ta.
Caacuonakawta Moses ta iema kha, “Cahaacata Abyipahmiekung luo rie tuv riypata cehre a la ung cate,
cehre a cyipa niema bangkhuo ta Abyipahmiekunglie kha Jordan va te pata, Abyipata a hmiekung taata a carie tie kha aa cade diy hluo li yi, hne

Abyipahmiekunglie ruo hing tepa a cuo hluo li rie namaa du kieca, cakhutaa cata niema ca kaa'a ung cate, Abyipahne Israel ming hmiekunglie kha mawchie riypa aw li pata, hingpa ruo hing Abyipahmiekunglie nama ruo ta a cuo aa.
Cuorasala cahaacata nama tue li kieca, Abyipacunglie sue tli ung cate, nama suena ta aca hmung ngiethie'a yi tapa kha pachang tie ung.
Nama saata zaw cuota khy kha tue ung la, nama sahring cuota te kha sa tie ung; cuorasala bie namaa kuopa haa khata tue tie ung,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata Gad phang hne Reuben phang tie ta Moses kha, “Ma byipa ta bie malie na pipa haata ma tue aa.
Ma saata zaw, ma napuv zaw, hne ma sahring zaw ca Gilead ruo khy tie lie hing amaa zaa ngaa aa;
cuorasala na changtaapa zaw ca ma byipa ta bie malie na pipa haata cavaa hing vya te'a pate, cehre a cyipa palang ta Abyipahuota rie maa du aa,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta iema hne aa patuv pata Moses ta tluobyi Eleazar, Nun sacapaa Joshua hne Israel phang a chung a chung ta uvthyi tie kha bie a pi yi.

Cakhutaata Moses ta iema kha, “Gad phang hne Reuben phang tie, Abyipahmiekunglie rie tuv riypata cehre a cyipa bangkhuo ta Jordan vya te'a yi te ruo kha te pata a cuo kieca, Gilead ruo ca iema kha ama cuvu ta nama pi aa;
cuorasala cehre a cyi pata niema hne cavaa kha ama vya te li kieca, Kanaan ruo chunglie kha niema hrawlie cuvu ama hnyi ra aa,” a ta yi.
Gad phang hne Reuben phang tie khata, “Abyipata a changtaapa zaw malie a changpa haata ma tue aa.
Abyipahmiekunglie cehre a cyipa palang ta cavaa kha va te'a pate Kanaan ruo chung luo kha maa ngie aa, cuorasala kiema ma cuvu riypa ru ca Jordan cavaa hingpa suo luo hing tana a cuo aa,” ama ta.

Moses ta Gad phang hne Reuben phang hne Josef sacapaa Manasseh phang khingkhuo kha Amor Siepahruo Sihon pena ruo hne Bashan Siepahruo Og pena ruo kha a luruo hne a khy hne a cadungpa a cahriy ruo zaw kha a pi yi.
Cakhutaata Gad phang tie ta Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
Atroth-shofan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
Beth-nimrah, hne Beth-haran, cariekyikuo a hnyipa khy zaw kha sa hru yi te, tuvte zaw kha ama sa.
Reuben phang tie ta Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
Nebo, hne Baal-meon (ming chekha ca ama thle tli), hne Sibmah; ama sa hrupa khy tie kha iema ta ming ama sa.
Manasseh sacapaa Makhir hne a ciypathla tie ta Gilead luo kha vaa yi te, la yi te, capa lie a awpa Amor ming kha amaa cade diy.
Caacuonakawta Moses ta Gilead ca Manasseh sacapaa Makhir kha pi te capa lie ca a aw.
Manasseh sacapaa Jair ta vaa te khyta zaw kha a la, capa tie ca Havvoth-jair ta pata ming a sa.
Cakhutaata Nobah ta vaa te Kenath hne a khyta zaw kha la te ama ming ziy pata Nobah ta pata ming a sa hru.
Moses hne Aaron luochiyna ta riekaphuv haata Izipt ruo taata a vya pyapa Israel ming khytlawna luopuv ca aa paziy aa paziy ta hing haa hing tana a cuo.
Abyipabiepina haata Moses ta amaa vya thana taata hmang kha hnang hmang kha ta a cape; hingpa tie hing amaa vya tha baataata a chuo a chuo ta amaa rina hmang tie ta ama cuo.
Thla khana lie Rameses taata amaa vya tha, thla khana thlaa ning hraa hlyipangaana, lawsena ning khutaata a mawluopa ta,

Izipt ming ta iema chungtaata Abyipata a thiepa sa-uvthyi tie ama paby nguoluo ning kha Israel ming ca Izipt ming hmungna lie riephasa pata amaa vya tha. Ama khazing tie zaw kha Abyipa ta bie a ripa yi.
Caacuonakawta Israel ming ca Rameses taata a vya tha yi te Sukkoth lie amaa ri.
Sukkoth taata a thu yi te, ruocaapa hne aa riyna lie a awpa Etham lie amaa ri.
Etham taata a thu yi te, Pi-hahiroth luo kha kaa yi te, Baal-zefon hne aa hmiepachawna lie, Migdol hmielie kha amaa ri.
Pi-hahiroth taata a thu yi te, riyliy kha vya te yi te ruocaapa luo a ngie yi te, Etham ruocaapa lie ning thung ama si khutaata Marah lie amaa ri.
Marah taata a thu yi te Elim luo ama vya chiy; Elim lie ca acaa suohraa hlyihning hne tungkung sawsariy a awnapa cuo te, capa lie ca amaa ri.
Elim taata a thu yi te Riyliy Sepa athaalie kha amaa ri.
Riyliy Sepa taata a thu yi te Sin ruocaapa lie kha amaa ri.
Sin ruocaapa taata a thu yi te Dofkah lie amaa ri.
Dofkah taata a thu yi te Alush lie amaa ri.
Alush taata a thu yi te cawsaa cuota dang riypa tiy a aw linapa Refidim lie a maa ri.
Refidim taata a thu yi te Sinai ruocaapa lie kha amaa ri.
Sinai ruocaapa taata a thu yi te Kibroth-hattaavah lie amaa ri.
Kibroth-hattaavah taata a thu yi te Hazeroth lie amaa ri.
Hazeroth taata a thu yi te Rithmah lie amaa ri.
Rithmah taata a thu yi te Rimmon-perez lie amaa ri.
Rimmon-perez taata a thu yi te Libnah lie amaa ri.
Libnah taata a thu yi te Rissah lie amaa ri.
Rissah taata a thu yi te Kehelathah lie amaa ri.
Kehelathah taata a thu yi te Shefer Tluo lie amaa ri.
Shefer Tluo taata a thu yi te Haradah lie amaa ri.
Haradah taata a thu yi te Makheloth lie amaa ri.
Makheloth taata a thu yi te Tahath lie amaa ri.
Tahath taata a thu yi te Terah lie amaa ri.
Terah taata a thu yi te Mithkah lie amaa ri.
Mithkah taata a thu yi te Hashmonah lie amaa ri.
Hashmonah taata a thu yi te Moseroth lie amaa ri.
Moseroth taata a thu yi te Bene-jaakan lie amaa ri.
Bene-jaakan taata a thu yi te Hor-haggidgad lie amaa ri.
Hor-haggidgad taata a thu yi te Jotbathah lie amaa ri.
Jotbathah taata a thu yi te Abronah lie amaa ri.
Abronah taata a thu yi te Ezion-geber lie amaa ri.
Ezion-geber taata a thu yi te Zin (capa ca Kadesh tana a cuo) ruocaapa lie amaa ri.
Kadesh taata a thu yi te Edom ruoriy lie a awpa Hor Tluo lie amaa ri.
Tluobyi Aaron ca Abyipabiepina haata Hor Tluo cung luo kha kie te, Israel ming Izipt taata ama vya pya taata kung sawliyna kung thla pangaa thlaa ning khana lie kha capa lie ca a thiy.
Aaron ca Hor Tluo cunglie a thiy ning kha kung zakha kung kiy kung thung a ta tli.
Kanaan ming, Arad siepahruo, Kanaan ruo Negeb lie a awpa ta Israel ming amaa vawpa kha a thyi.
Hor Tluo taata a thu yi te Zalmonah lie amaa ri.
Zalmonah taata a thu yi te Punon lie amaa ri.
Punon taata a thu yi te Oboth lie amaa ri.
Oboth taata a thu yi te Moab ruoriy Iye-abarim lie amaa ri.
Iyim taata a tha yi te Dibon-gad lie amaa ri.
Dibon-gad lie a ri yi te Almon-diblathaim lie amaa ri.
Almon-diblathaim taata a thu yi te Nebo hmie Abarim tluo lie amaa ri.
Abarim tluo taata a thu yi te Moab ruo Jordan cavaa kie Jeriko lie amaa ri.
Moab ase ruo Jordan cavaa kie lie ca Beth-jeshimoth taata Abel-shittim te khata amaa ri.
Moab ase ruo Jordan cavaa kie Jeriko lie kha Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Israel ming kha chang tie yi: Jordan cavaa kha te ung cate Kanaan ruo chung namaa ngie tiyta,
nama hmielie capa ruo lie a awpa tie kha a cade diy'a ung cate, ama lungbang bangkhuo, ama patlepa ama khazing zuv tie, hne ama khahrungtluobu zaw kha nama para diy aa.
Ruo ca cu'a ung cate a chunglie nama aw aa, tahematapakieca ruo ca nama cu riypata ica pi tli yi.

Ruo ca a chung a chung ta vyisung a da'a ung cate namaa re aa; a le viepa phang tie kha a le vie ta ru pi ung la, a caw viepa phang tie kha a caw vie ta ru nama pi aa; ahunghmuo cuose vyisung aa dapa haa khata ru ca a cuo aa, a chung a chung khata ru ca nama cu aa.

Cuorasala capa ruo lie a awpa tie ca nama hmiekung taata namaa cade diy li kieca, cahaacata nama pangaapa tie ca nama ming lie mingbuo haata cuo'a yi te nama vuo lie caa chungpa yi ahling haa tana ama cuo aa; nama awnapa ruo lie khana riethyi aca pi'a yi.
Cakhutaata iema'a lie tue riypata i ruepa kha niema'a lie i tue aa.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Israel ming kha bie pi yi la chang tie yi: Kanaan ruo luo namaa ngie tiyta (hingpa ruo hing ru ta nama cu riypa ruo ta a cuo, Kanaan ruo, a ruoriy tue ciepa yalya haa hingta)
sungluo kuo nama ruoriy ca Zin ruocaapa taata patha'a te Edom ruoriy te a cuo aa. Sungluo kuo nama ruoriy ca ningchiyluo Riyliy Thiypa a chuona taa khata a patha aa.

Nama ruoriy ca Akrabbim luo kya kiena taa khata sungluo ta a maa'a te, Zin lie khata si'a te, a chuona ca Kadesh-barnea raw luo te khata a cuo aa; cakhutaata Hazar-addar luo ta si'a te Azmon a pha aa;
ruoriy ca Azmon taa cata a maa'a te Izipt ruo cavaata te kha pha'a te, Riyliy lie kha a za chuo aa.
Ningtlaluo ruoriy ca Riyliy Lepa hne a kie kha nama ung diy aa; capa ca ningtlaluo nama ruoriy ta a cuo aa.
Chaluo kuo nama ruoriy ca hing haa hingta a cuo aa: Riyliy Lepa taata Hor Tluo te khata kya cuo aa;
Hor Tluo taata Lebo-hamath te, capa taa cata Zedad te ta a cuo aa;
cakhutaata ruoriy ca Zifron te ta si'a te a chuona ca Hazar-enan lieta a cuo aa; capa ca chaluo kuo nama ruoriy ta a cuo aa.
Ningchiyluo kuo nama ruoriy ca Hazar-enan taata Shefam te pha'a te,
a pazue bung'a te Shefam taata Ain ningchiyluo kuo ta a awpa Riblah te, sibung pakhaa'a te Khinnereth riyliy ningchiyluo kuo a pachungna te ta a cuo aa;
cakhutaata ruoriy ca Jordan luo kha sibung'a te, a chuona ca Riyliy Thiypa lieta a cuo aa. Capa ca nama ruo a kuo bangkhuo ruoriy ta a cuo aa.
Moses ta Israel ming kha bie pi yi te: Hingpa hingna vyisung a da pata nama cu riypa ruo, Abyipa ta phang caky hne phang che tie pi riypata bie ina pipa ruo ta a cuo;
tahematapakieca Reuben phang hne Gad phang ca a chung a chung ta ama cuvu ruo kha amaa la tli, Manasseh phang che hning che kha zaw kha amaa la ra tli;
phang hning hne phang che tie ca Jordan cavaa huesuo ruo, Jeriko ningchiyluo kuo khata ama cu riypa ru kha amaa la mangtli.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Hingpa tie hing nama cu riypa ruo caa retuv riypa tie ama ming ta a cuo: tluobyi Eleazar hne Nun sacapaa Joshua.
Phang mekaa taata ruo caa retuv riypa luochiytuv pakha kaluo ta naa tlaw'a yi.
Hingpa tie hing a tlawpa tie ming cata a cuo: Judah phang taata, Jefunneh sacapaa Kaleb.
Simeon phang taata, Ammihud sacapaa Shemuel.
Benjamin phang taata Khislon sacapaa Elidad.
Dan phang taata luochiytuv pakha, Jogli sacapaa Bukki.
Josef phang: Manasseh phang taata luochiytuv pakha, Efod sacapaa Hanniel,
hne Efraim phang taata luochiytuv pakha, Shiftan sacapaa Kemuel.
Zebulun phang taata luochiytuv pakha, Parnach sacapaa Eli-zafan.
Issakhar phang taata luochiytuv pakha, Azzan sacapaa Paltiel.
Asher phang taata luochiytuv pakha, Shelomi sacapaa Ahihud.
Naftali phang taata luochiytuv pakha, Ammihud sacapaa Pedahel.
Hingpa tie hing Kanaan ruo lie Israel ming ama cuvu ruo a retuv riypata Abyipata bie a pipa tie ta ama cuo.
Moab ase ruo Jordan cavaa kie Jeriko lie kha, Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Israel ming kha bie pi yi la, ru ta cu yi te ama hnyipa ruo taa khata Levi ming kha ama awna riypa khy pi yi se; ama sahring tlena riypata ama khy cahriy alyi zaw kha pi yi se.
Khy ca ama awna riypata cuo'a te, khy cahriy ruo ca ama sahring tlena riypata a cuo aa.
Khy kha cuota sahring tlena ta Levi ming nama pi riypa ca, khy a cadung pata khy lungruetlepie chungkhuo taata daw thawkha a cuo aa.

Khy le ca taa'a ung cate, ningchiyluo kuo daw thawhning, sungluo kuo daw thawhning, ningtlaluo kuo daw thawhning, chaluo kuo daw thawhning taa ung cate khy ca a lie khingkhuo lieta a aw aa; capa ca ama khy cuota sahring patlena riypata iema ta ama hnyi aa.

Levi ming nama pipa khypuv chunglie ca canawna khypuv khy caruv nama pipuo aa, capa luo ca cawsaa a thiepa tie a ruo riypa kha nama pa-aw aa. Capa khypuv tie thang taa cata khy sawliy khy hning nama pi aa.
Levi ming nama pipa khy ca khy sawliy khy hning cuo'a te, ama sahring tlena cyicuo hneta a cuo aa.

Israel ming ama hnyipa ruo chungtaata nama pi riypa khy zaw ca, a le viepa phang tie ta a hluv vie namaa la aa, a caw viepa phang tie ta a caw vie ta namaa la aa; ru ama hmungpa cyicuo zaa haa khata Levi ming ca ama pi aa.
Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata:
Israel ming kha chang tie yi: Jordan kha te ung cate Kanaan ruo chung luo namaa ngie tiyta,
a ting li pata cawsaa a thie pathlyipa tie a ruona riypata canawna khypuv riypata khypuv tie kha namaa tlaw aa.
Cawsaa a thie pathlyipa ca cawsaazaapuv hmiekung luo, bieripana hmang luo a chiy hluota a thiy li riypata, capa khypuv tie ca phuvlana taata law riypata canawna khypuv ta ama cuo aa.
Namaa tlawpa khypuv suocaruv tie ca nama cuota canawna ta a cuo aa:
Jordan ningtlaluo ruo lie kha khypuv suothung a tlaw'a ung cate, khypuv suothung ca Kanaan ruo chunglieta a cuo aa, canawna khypuv riypata.
Capa khypuv suocaruv ca Israel ming, khy a sa tlipa mingphang hrangpa tie, hne a vya tlaw siypa mingphang hrangpa tie chungtaata, a ting li pata cawsaa a thie pathlyipa tie a ruona riypata a cuo aa.
Cuorasala cawsaa pakhakha ta a hrangpa pakha kha thaa ta tuepa cehre ta tuv te a thiy kieca, lie a nawpa ta a cuo; lie a nawpa ca thie pata a cuo aa.
Acuolikie cawsaa pakhakha ta a hrangpa pakha kha a kuv lie aa hriepa alung ta de te a thiy kieca, lie a nawpa tana a cuo; lie a nawpa ca thie pata a cuo aa.
Acuolikie cawsaa pakhakha ta a hrangpa pakha kha a kuv lie aa hriepa thing ta tuepa cehre suokhakha ta tuv te a thiy kieca, lie a nawpa tana a cuo; lie a nawpa ca thie pata a cuo aa.
Thiyse phuv a latuv ta lie a nawpa kha a thie aa; amaa taw tiyta thiyse phuv a latuv ta a thie aa.
Cahaacata, cawsaa pakha ta a hrangpa pakha kha hue te a nuo, acuolikie a bawkhuo te suokhakha ta a vaa nakawta a thiy kieca,
acuolikie a hue nakawta a kuv ta phaw te a thiy kieca, lie a nawpa tana a cuo, a maa taw tiyta thiyse phuv a latuv ta a thie aa.
Cuorasala cawsaa pakha ta a hrangpa pakha kha huena aw li pata a nuo kie cuose, a bawkhuo li pata suokhakha ta vaa te a thiy kieca,
acuolikie, cawsaa pakha ta aa cariepa ama cuo li pata, hne ruvna pi riy aa ting li pata alung vaa te cawsaa hrangpa pakha kha khe te a thiy kieca,
cawsaazaapuv ta a thietuv hne thiyse phuv a latuv alalalie kha hingpa ziyphung haa hingta bie ama ripa aa;

cawsaazaapuv ta lie a nawpa kha thiyse phuv latuv'a taa khata ama khuo aa. Cakhutaata cawsaazaapuv ta lie a nawpa kha a zaa ruonapa canawna khypuv luo kha ama pasi sa pakhaa aa. Capa lie ca tluobyi lepa a thiyna te khata a aw aa.
Cuorasala cawsaa a thiepa ca khaapa cuo ning a cuo zaw a canawna khypuv ruoriy le luo a pya pata,
thiyse phuv latuv khata khypuv le lie ca hmung te a thie kieca a cunglie thiyse kawlie suena aw'a vyi.
Tahematapakieca lie a nawpa ca tluobyi lepa a thiyna te ta canawna khypuv lie kha a aw aa; cuorasala tluobyi lepa a thiy khutaata ca a ing luo a kaa khu aa.
Khaapa lie nama aw zaw nama chuo chung bangkhuo ta hingpa tie hing nama cuota phungluo hne ziyphung ta a cuo pari aa.
Cawsaa pakhakha ta a hrangpa pakha kha a thie kieca, lie a nawpa ca tehte tie ripa bie haata thiepa a cuo aa; cuorasala cawsaa pakha ca tehte pakha dyi ripa bie ta thie pata cuo'a vyi.
Ca hlyitaw taata thiy aa phuvpa lienawtuv cuota ca khaapa athlana muo kha hmuota la'a va ung ciy.
Cakhutaata canawna khypuv luo a ruopa pakha ta tluobyi lepa a thiy hluota a ruo luo a kaa khing nakawta a thlana muo a pi kieca cuhluo'a va ung ciy.

Nama awna ruo kha papyapalyi'a va ung ciy; tehematapakieca thiyse na ruo kha a papya a palyi, a cunglie lyipa thiyse cuota ca khaapatahmuo pathesana tue khu cuo vyi, capa thiy a palangtuv thiyse kyalya dyina a pathe sa khu.
Nama awnapa ruo kha papyapalyi'a va ung ciy, khapa lie kha kama zaw i aw ra; tahematapakieca Kama Abyipaca Israel ming hrawlie na i aw.

Josef phang chungtaata Manasseh sacapaa Makhir sacapaa Gilead ciypathla a chung a chung tie luv a cuopa tie khata Moses hne luochiytuv tie, Israel ming a chung a chung ta luv a cuopa tie'a luo kha a vaw yi te,
“Abyipata ma byipaapa kha Israel ming ama cu riypa ruo ca vyisung a da pata pi riypata bie aca pi; cakhutaata ma byipaapa ca Abyipata ma uvnupa Zelofehad ru ca a sacanung zaw pi riypata bie aca pi.

Cuorasala iema ta Israel ming phang hrangpa tie'a luo kha tung ama tuv kieca, iema ama cupa ru ca kiema mingchingmingvuo tie ru taa khata la pata, iema navaa ama va hnyinapa phang ru luo kha pahlaw riypata a cuo aa; caacuonakawta vyisung a da pata ma cupa ru ca lapa pata ma cuo aa.
Cakhutaata Israel ming jubilee a vya tlung tiyta iema ru ca navaa ama va hnyinapa phang ru luo kha pahlaw pata cuo'a te, kiema ciypathlatuv tie phang ru taa khata lapa a cuo aa,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Moses ta Abyipata a changpa haa khata Israel ming kha a chang yi, “Josef ciypathla phang tie ta ama ripa ca aa hmuopa tana a cuo.
Zelofehad sacanung zaw hne aa patuv pata Abyipabiepina ca hing haa hing tana a cuo, ‘Iema ta a pha ce ama tapa kha a hlaw yi se; cuorasala ama paa phang chung taa dyi tana a cuo aa.
Israel ming ru ca phang kha taata phang kha luo a palaw khah se; tahematapakieca Israel ming ca iema'a na ciypathlatuv phang tie ru kha ama pahmang aa.

Israel ming phangkhakha cunglieta ru a hnyipa canung ca a paa phang chungkhakha tie'a luo dyi kha navaa hnyi se, tahematapakieca Israel ming phang bangkhuo ca ama chung ingchungkhue tie ru kha ama hnyi patlung aa.
Tuokhaapa ru hmuo phang kha taata phang kha luo a palaw khah se; tahematapakieca Israel ming phang ca cyicuo ta iema ru kha ama pahmang sa aa,” a ta.
Zelofehad sacanung zaw ca Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haa khata ama tue.
Zelofehad sacanung Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milkah, hne Noah zaw ca ama paa uvnu sacapaa zaw kha amaa hlaw.
Iema ta Josef sacapaa Manasseh ciypathla chung taa khata navaa ama hnyi nakawta, ama ru ca ama paa phang chunglie kha aa hmang.
Hingpa hing Moab ase ruo, Jordan cavaa kie Jeriko lieta, Abyipata Moses'a taata Israel ming bie a pipa yi biepina hne ziyphung tana a cuo.
Hingpa hing Jordan cavaa huesuo ruocaapa lie, Suf a rie-e ase ruo lie, Paran hne Tofel, Laban, Hazeroth, hne Di-zahab alalalie Moses ta Israel ming bangkhuo cunglie a ripa bie tana a cuo.
(Horeb taata Kadesh-barnea ca Seir Tluo luo ziy pata ning hraa hlyikha luosi tana a cuo.)
A kung sawliyna thla hraa hlyikha thlaa, ning khana lie kha Abyipata iema chang riypata bie a pipa haa khata Moses ta Israel ming kha a chang yi.
Hingpa hing ama ta Heshbon lie siepahruo a cuopa Amor siepahruo Sihon, hne Ashtaroth hne Edrei lie siepahruo a cuopa Bashan siepahruo Og a te khutaa yi ta a cuo.
Jordan cavaa huesuo Moab ruo lie kha Moses ta a raw luo haa hingta phungbie kha a pasiepa yi.
Abyipaima Khazing ta Horeb lie hing haa hingta malie a chang, “Hingpa tluo lie hing aa dena te ta nama aw tli.

Nama khytlawna ca pathu pakhaa tie ung, Amor tluocung ruo khyta chung luo hne a cahriy ruo tie, Arabah ruo, tluocung ruo, Shefelah ruo, Negeb ruo, hne riyliy kie ruo tie, Kanaan ruo hne Lebanon ruo zaw kha cuose, cavaa lepa, Zufrates cavaa te khata si tie ung.

Mang tie ung, ruo ca nama hmiekunglie na i chi tli; nama mingchingmingvuo tie Abraham, Isak, Jakob hne ama ciypathla zaw kha pi riypata chie a sa angte bie i kuopa yi ruo luo kha a ngie ung la va cu tie ung,” a ta yi.
Khapa ning kha, “Kama selaw ta ca ca mangchiy khu'a va yi ang, ica ta tli yi.
Abyipanama Khazing ta ca papungzaa sa yi te ataning hing niema ca avuo lie aasiy zaa nama ta tli.
Bie acaa kuopa haa yi ta nama mingchingmingvuo tie AbyipaKhazing ta a le thawkha laata a hluv vie ta ca papungzaa sa yi se!
Cuorasala tuokhaatama kama selaw ta ca nama hnaahnawnapa hmangriy bangkhuo hing i phya khu aa?
Nama phang cyicuo taata a singpa, thleduo khuna a hnyipa hne a ming pathuo viepa tie kha nama luochiytuv riypata a tlaw tie ung,” a ta yi.
Niema ta, “Na tingtuona ca a phapa tana a cuo,” ina ta ung ciy,” a ta yi.

Caacuonakawta nama phang taata luochiytuv tie kha la yi angte, a singpa hne a ming a pathuopa tie kha nama cunglie luochiytuv ta i chi yi, a thaw luochiytuv, a za luochiytuv, sawngaa luochiytuv ta pata nama phang bangkhuo cunglie kha i chi yi.

Capa cuo ningta bieripatuv tie kha, “Nama cawsaa zaw bie kha a phata tah naathliepa ung la, pakha hne pakha alalalie kha, ruocaapa ming ama cuo zaw, ruo chunglie khy a sa tlipa ruohrang ming ama cuo zaw, a dangta tah bie ripa tie ung.

Bieripana lie kha a kuo ta a daa'a va ung ciy: cawsaa cawta cuose, cawsaa lepa cuose, aa khing pata naathliepa ung la, ahunghmuo ciy khah ung, tahematapakieca bieripana ca Khazing huopa tana a cuo. Nama cuota a ruv tuvpa bie kha kama'a luo vya chiykhyi ung la kama ta i naathliepa'a yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta nama tue riypa hmang bangkhuo hne khata capa cuo ning ca ta bie ica pi tli yi.
Cakhutaata, Abyipaima Khazing ta bie malie a pipa haata, Horeb taata a thu pate Amor ming tluocung ruo luo sinapa, nama hmungpa a lesapa hne ciy aa chiypa ruocaapa kha Kadesh-barnea te ta ma cahraw.
Kama ta, “Abyipaima Khazing ta malie a pipa Amor tluocung ruo kha nama pha tli.

Mang tie ung, Abyipanama Khazing ta niema aca pipa yi ruo ca khaw ung la kya cu tie ung; nama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing, Abyipata bie acaa kuopa haa yi ta ciy khah ung; nama palung zaw chuo khah se,” ica ta yi.

Niema bangkhuo ta a vaw ung cate kama kha, “Khaapa luopuv ziy'a pate ma khaapa khypuv luo ma pha aa tapa kha malie a chang pakhaa riypata ma hmieluo ta ruo ngiepatlietuv kha pathlie'a ung puv nama ta,” a ta yi.
Nama tingpa ca a pha ta pata rue angte, phang kha taata pakha kaluo ta cawsaa pahraa hlyihning kha i tlaw yi.
A thu yi te tluocung ruo luo kha sithaw yi te Eshkol bawphie ama pha taata ruo kha amaa ngiepatlie.
Ruo chungtaata a pyapa kha pakhaw yi te kiema'a luo ama za phya. Bie malie za phya yi te, “Abyipaima Khazing ta malie a pipa ruo ca ruo phapa tana a cuo,” malie ama ta.
Cuorasala sithaw khing va ung ciy. Niema ta Abyipanama Khazing biepina kha namaa du;
nama thluodaa chunglie kha a paruvta tah, “Abyipata malie a hue nakaw tana Izipt ruo taata malie sikhyi te, Amor ming kuv luo kha para riypata malie a pi.

Khaapa luo ma ma sile? Ma uvnu tie ta, ‘Cawsaa tie ca kiema laata ama thaa ruv vie te ama dang aa suo vie; ama khypuv zaw ca le te a dungkhuo ca avuo na a de hlyahlya! Capa lie ca Anakim ciypathla zaw na ma hmung hmisi yi, ta yi te ma palung malie ama para,’” nama ta.
Kama ta. “Iema kha ciy pata a cathang khah ung.
Abyipanama Khazing, nama hmieluo ta a sipa na niema cuota caa dupa'a yi, Izipt lie, nama ming hmungna lie hrahring ta niema cuota a tuepa haa khata,
ruocaapa lieta Abyipanama Khazing ta tuokhaatama acaa chiy yi tapa kha nama hmung, hingpa hmang nama vya phana te hingta cawsaa pakha ta haatiyta aa chiypa haata acaa chiy yi.
Cuorasala cahaacata a cuo thluo pata Abyipanama Khazing,
nama luopuv lie hmaa ca sapa yi te arina hmang caa huvpapa yi, zuo ta myi ta cuose, ningchung ta amyi ta cuose, nama ziy riypa luopuv caa pahmung satuv kha a ringchuo va ung ciy,” a ta.
Abyipata nama bie kha a thyi tiyta a hi haa hringhruo te,
“Hingpa tie chung taa hingta pakha hmuo, hingpa a pha lipa chuo tie taa hingta pakha hmuo, nama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie bie i kuopa yi ruo phapa kha hmung'a va ung ciy,
Jefunneh sacapaa Kaleb ta li pata ca. Abyipakha zang tluo aa tlasa pata a ziy nakawta capa ruo ca hmung'a te, ama hne a ciypathla zaw kha a phyi ta a tlawpa ruo kha i pi'a yi,” a ta.
Niema kawlieta Abyipaca kama cunglie kha hmuo a hi haa te, “Nama zaw capa ruo luo ca a ngie'a vaciy.
Nama re caa byatuv Nun sacapaa Joshua na a ngie aa; ama kha thaa pi tie, tahematapakieca ama na Israel ming kha capa ruo ca ru ta a pacu sa'a yi.
Nama haatiy, carie tie patuv riypa tana ama cuo aa nama tapa tie, ata lie a chie a pha a pachang li liepa tie na capa ruo luo ca a ngie'a yi; iema kha pi'a yi angte iema na a cu'a yi.
Cuorasala niema ca, Riyliy Sepa luo kuo, ruocaapa luo kha a pali ung la si tie ung,” a ta.

Niema ta na palie ung cate, “Abyipa'a lieta ma sue tli! Abyipaima Khazing bie malie a pipa haata kiema ca sithaw pata a du riypata ma cuo tli,” ina ta ung ciy. Caacuonakawta pakha cyicuo ta cehre a la ung cate, tluocung ruo luo sithaw riypa kha a nata tah nama rue.
Abyipata kama kha, “Iema kha chang tie yi, ‘Sithaw khah ung, a kya du khah ung, tahematapakieca niema hrawlie aw va ang, nama carie tie na acaa te'a yi a ta,''’ ica ta yi.
Ica chang raalaa pa yi ta, na naathlie va ung ciy. Abyipabiepina kha a du ung cate, tluocung ruo luo kha rie pha tuv pata nama sithaw.
Capa tluocung ruo lie a awpa Amor ming ca ta ca kya pyahnue yi te, khyi a cade ta acaa cade yi. Seir taata Hormah te ca nawpuole yi te acaa cade yi.
Za kaa ung cate Abyipahmiekunglie nama caa tiyta, Abyipata nama ryi kha ca naathlie lipa yi ta siysaa ca ri va yi.
Kadesh lie kha a hluo nama za awpa haata ning pasiypuv nama aw.
Cakhutaata Abyipabiepina haata ruocaapa luo kha a pali pate, Riyliy Sepa luo kha ma si, ning hluvpuv chung Seir Tluo kha ma cahlung.
Cakhutaata Abyipata kama kha:
“Hingpa tluocung ruo hing aa dena te nama cahlung mangtli. Chaluo kha a hyi ung la si tie ung.
Cakhutaata cawsaa kha hing haa hingta chang tie yi: Sier lie a awpa, Esau ciypathla, nama uvnu tie ruoriy khana nama cahraw aa. Niema kha aca ciy'a yi, caacuonakawta, a raaringsa mya ung.
Iema kha a du'a va ung ciy, tahematapakieca Seir Tluo ca Esau kha ru ta i pi tli nakawta ama ruo hing phyipazaa zaa kha pathlana khang hmuo ca pi'a va yi ang,
Iema'a taata sa kha tuokaa ta a calyi'a ung cate na nama ning aa; tiy zaw kha tuokaa ta a calyi'a ung cate na nama dang aa.

Abyipanama Khazing ta nama kuv ta nama hriepa kha thluechiy aca pi hmisi yi; hingpa a lesapa ruocaapa lie nama cahrawpa hing a pachang. Hingpa kung sawliy chung hing Abyipanama Khazing ca niema'a lie aw te namaa phahlapa aw vyi,” ina ta.
Caacuonakawta Seir lie a awpa Esau ciypathla ma uvnu tie ca sise pata, Arabah luopuv kha hnangchaw pate, Elath hne Ezion-geber kha ma sise. Moab ruocaapa luo kuo ta ma si ning kha,

Abyipata kama kha: “Moab hing patawpahrie khah ung, aa du zaw a du khah yi, tahematapakieca ama ruo khaapa kha hmuo cu riypata ca pi'a va yi ang, Ar ca Lot ciypathla tie khana ama cu riypata i pi tli yi,” ina ta.
(Ahluo ta ca Emim ming, a lesapa hne a hluvsapa tie, Anakim ming haata a dang a suosapa tie na zaa aw yi.
Anakim ming haa khata iema ca Refaim ming ta pata pachangpa tana ama za cuo, cuorasala Moab ming ta Emim ming ta pata ama ku.

Ca hlyitaw taata ahluo ta ca Horim ming kha Seir lie ama za aw, cuorasala Abyipata ru ta a pipa yi ruo lie Israel ta a tuepa haata Esau ciypathla tie ta iema kha phya yi te, iema kha para yi te ama awna lie kha khy ama sa.)
“Ata hingta Zered cavaata ca va te tie ung,” ina ta. Caacuonakawta Zered cavaata ca ma va te.

Abyipata iema hne aa patuv pata chie a za sapa haa yi ta, chuo kha chung yalya lie'apa rieka tie bangkhuo ama thiy diyna te, Kadesh-barnea taata a thu pate Zered cavaata ma va tena te ta ma khytlawna kung ca kung sawthung kung cari a ta tli.
Arina hmang taata phie pathla pata ama bangkhuo ta ama ra diyna te tana Abyipakuv hrahring ta iema kha aa du yi.
Rieka bangkhuo kha cawsaa hrawtaata ama thiy diypa hneta,
Abyipata kama'a lie kha bie ri te,
“Ataning hing Moab ruoriy khana Ar lieta nama va te aa.

Ammon ming ruoriy athaa luo nama va chiy tiyta, iema kha patawpahrie li pata, a du zaw a du'a va ung ciy, tahematapakieca Lot ciypathla tie kha i pi tli nakaw yi ta Ammon ming ruo kha nama cu riypata ca pi'a va yi ang,” ina ta.
(Capa zaw ca Refaim ming ruo ta pata pachangpa a cuo. Ahluo ta ca Refaim ming na zaa aw taa yi, cuorasala Ammon ming ta iema kha Zamzummim ta yi te,

a thaaruvpa hne a hluvsapa cawsaa ta ama cuo, Anakim ming haa khata ama dang aa suosa. Cuorasala Abyipata Ammon ming hmiekunglie kha a para yi. Caacuonakawta Ammon ming ca ta phya yi te ama awna lie kha khy ama sa.

Seir lie a awpa, Esau ciypathla tie cuo zaw khata cahaacata a tue, Horim ming kha ama hmiekunglieta a para yi. Caacuonakawta iema ta Horim ming ca phya yi te ama awna lie kha ataning tepa hingta khy ama sa.
Gaza cahriylie a awpa Avvim ming cuo zaw khata Kaftor taata a vawpa Kaftor ming kha para yi te iema awna lie kha a pa-aw sa yi.)
“Nama khytlawna kha pazue ung la Arnon Bawphie kha va te tie ung. Mang tie ung, Heshbon lie a awpa Amor ming siepahruo Sihon ca niema na ica pi yi. Ama kha a du ung la a ruo ca cu tie ung.
Ataning taa hingta vuoruotyi lie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo kha niema ciyna hne thlaazangna kha pahnyi sa'a yi angte, niema kaw kha ama thyi pahne ta, a cathang'a yi te ama thlaa a zang aa,” ina ta.
Caacuonakawta Kedemoth ruocaapa taa cata Heshbon siepahruo Sihon'a luo ca biephyatuv pathlie angte a raw luo haa hingta diena bie i taa:
Na ruo hing ina cahraw sapa cata a cuo kieca, luopuv dyina i ziy aa; cavyi cacuo pie'a va ang.
I ning riypa sa kha tuokaa ta na zaa'a cate, i dang riypa tiy zaw kha tuokaa ta ina zaa'a ciy.

Abyipama Khazing ta malie a pipa ruo chung luo a ngie riypata Jordan i tena te ta Seir lie a awpa Esau ciypathla zaw hne Ar lie a awpa Moab tie zaw ta i cunglie ama tuepa haa khata i phyi ta cakuo pata na cahraw sa tie,” i ta.

Cuorasala Heshbon siepahruo Sihon ta a ruo chunglie kha malie cahraw sa khing vyi, tahematapakieca ata a tuepa haa hingta Abyipanama Khazing ta ama kha niema kuv chung luo pi riypata a palungphya kha pacuo sa te a palung a pale sa.
Abyipata kama kha, “Mang tie, Sihon hne a ruo kha nama'a luo pi riypata i pathu tli. A ruo kha la ung la cu tie ung,” ina ta.
Caacuonakawta Sihon hne a cawsaa zaw bangkhuo ca kiema kha Jahaz lie a du riypata ama vya pya.
Abyipakiema Khazing ta ama kha malie pi te, ama hne a samingsahlaa zaw hne a cawsaa zaw bangkhuo kha ma thie diy yi.
Capa ning lie ca ta a khy bangkhuo kha la diy pate, khy kha cyicuo lie a awpa capaa, canung hne haatiy bangkhuo kha ma thie diy karue yi, pakha hmuo pa hring va yi puv.
Sahring hne ma lapa chechiy zaw dyi kha kiema cuota hruosue ta maa la.

Aroer taata Arnon Bawphie (bawphie lie a awpa khy ripuo pata) kie lie a awpa Gilead te, kiema cuota ama khy dungkhuona lungruetlepie aa suotuvpa aw vyi. Abyipaima Khazing ta zezaw bangkhuo kha malie a pi.
Tuokhaata a cuo zaw, Abyipaima Khazing ta malie a thlupa, Ammon ming ruo, Jabbok cavaa chaluo kuo bangkhuo hne tluocung ruo khy tie kha cahriy pate tuv va yi puv.
Bashan luopuv luo ma sithawle tiyta, Bashan siepahruo Og ca ama hne a cawsaa zaw hne khata kiema kha Edrei lie a du riypata a vya pya.

Abyipata kama kyihuo khata, “Ama kha ciy khah, tahematapakieca ama hne a cawsaa zaw hne a ruo kha na kuv luo na ica pi. Heshbon lie a awpa Amor ming siepahruo Sihon na tuepa haa khata tue tie,” ina ta.
Caacuonakawta Abyipaima Khazing ta Bashan siepahruo Og hne a cawsaa zaw bangkhuo kha kiema kuv luo malie a pi. Pakha hmuo pahring li pata ma thie diy yi.
Capa cuo ning ca a khy bangkhuo kha ma la diy; Bashan lieta Og pena ruo, Argob ruo chung, khy sawcaruv kha ma la lipa khy aw vyi.
Capa khy bangkhuo ca khy dungkhuo aa suosapa, thlake suohning, hne a hrena a hnyipa cuo yi te a cahriylie khyta a hluvsa a hnyipa ta ama cuo.
Heshbon siepahruo Sihon cunglie ma tuepa haa khata ma para diy karue yi; khypuv cyicuo lieta capaa, canung, haatiy yalya ma para diy karue yi.
Cuorasala ama sahring bangkhuo hne khy lie ma lapa bangkhuo kha kiema huota hruosue ta maa la.
Caacuonakawta capa cuo ning ca ta Jordan cavaa huesuo ruo, Arnon Bawphie taata Hermon Tluo te kha Amor siepahruo pahning tie'a taata ma la,
(Amor ming ta Senir ta yi te Sidon tie ta Hermon Sirion ama ta),
ase ruo lie a awpa khy bangkhuo, Gilead yalya, Bashan bangkhuo, Salekah hne Edrei te, Og pena Bashan lie khy tie kha ma la.

(Siepahruo Og ca Refaim ming chungtaata a hnangcaw ce ta a tuopa tana a cuo. A iehmang ca thaa iehmang ta cuo te, ata tepa hingta Ammon ming khypuv Rabbah lieta a aw kalie. A tung daw caky, a haa daw paliy ta a cuo.)
Capa ruo ca cu riypata ma za la ning kha, Arnon Bawphie kie ruoriy lieta a awpa Aroer chaluo ruo, Gilead tluocung ruo khingkhuo kha a khy zaw hneta i pi yi.
Cakhutaata Manasseh phang khingkhuo tie kha Gilead ruo aa ngaapa hne Og pena pa Bashan ruo yalya ca i pi yi. (Bashan ruo chung Argob ruo aylya ca Refaim ming ruo ta pata a cuo.
Manasseh phang Jair ta Bashan ruo chung Argob ruo ca Geshur hne Maakath ruoriy te yalya khata a la, ama mingchang la pata Havvoth-jair ta pata ming sa te ataning tepa hingta cahaacata ku pata a cuo.)
Makhir ca Gilead kha i pi.
Cakhutaata Gilead taata Arnon Bawphie te, bawphie ruo khingkhuo kha ama ruoriy ta a cuo pata, chaluo kuo ta Jabbok cavaa Ammon ming tie ruoriy te kha Reuben ming hne Gad ming kha i pi yi.
Arabah zaw kha Jordan cavaa hne a kiecahriy, Chinnereth taata Arabah riyliy te, ningchiyluo kuo ta Pisgah a pachungbung Riyliy Thiypa te khata i pi yi.

Capa ning ca ta a raw luo haa hingta bie ca pi yi angte: “Abyipanama Khazing ta hingpa ruo hing cu riypata aca pi raalaa pa yi ta, cehre a cyipa nama rieka bangkhuo ca nama uvnu Israel ming hmiekunglie kha Jordan cavaa ca ama va te taa aa.
Nama napuv zaw, nama saata zaw'a nata nama sahring (sahring a hluvsa nama hnyipa kha ica pachang yi) zaw kha ica pipa yi khy zaw lie kha hnangluo ta amaa ngaa siy aa.

Abyipata niema haata nama uvnu tie kha a pahyna cuo a pi tiy yi ta, Abyipanama Khazing ta a pipa yi Jordan cavaa ningtla ruo kha ama la khutaata, niema cyicuo zaw ica pipa yi ruo luo kha nama kaa kaluo aa,” ica ta yi.

Cahaacata capa ning ca ta Joshua kyihuo khata: “Hingpa siepahruo pahning cunglie Abyipanama Khazing ta a tuepa hmangting kha nama ming hrahring ta nama hmung mangtli; niema nama cahraw riypa ruo bangkhuo kha Abyipata cahaacata a tue aa.
Iema kha ciy khah ung, tahematapakieca niema cuota rie a dupa ca Abyipanama Khazing tana a cuo,” a ta.
Capa cuo ning ngiethie ca ta kama ta Abyipakha paakie angte:

“Vya AbyipaKhazing, na lesyina hne na cahrana kha na changtaapa pahmung sa riypata naa pathu baaningpa tana a cuo; alyi hne avuo lie a awpa khaapa khazing hmuota nama na tuepa hmang hne kharuehaana hing tue buo valie yi!
“Jordan cavaa ningtla ruo phapa hne huepa tluocung ruo phapa hne Lebanon ruo zaw hue hmung riypata cavaa hing va te thi ang se,” i ta.
Cuorasala niema kawlie hingta Abyipaca i cunglie a hi haa te na palie vyi. Abyipata kama kha, “A de buo se! Hingpa kaw hing khaapaning hmuo na chang khah tie!
Pisgah tluodaw luo kha kiethaw la ningtla, chaluo, sungluo hne ningchiyluo kha suo tie. A phasa pata suo tie, tahematapakieca hingpa Jordan cavaa hing va te'a vaciy.
Cuorasala Joshua kha bie pi tie, pasu la thaazuo pi tie, tahematapakieca ama hingna a cawsaa zaw hmiekunglie kha Jordan cavaa ca va te'a te, na hmung riypa ruo ca a pacu sa'a yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Beth-peor a rie-e bawphie lie kha maa ri.

Caacuonakawta vya Israel, nama hring riypata hne, nama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing Abyipata aca pipa yi ruo kha nama cu the riypata, nama ziy riypata ica pacuvpa yi phungluo hne ziyphung kha a phasa pata naathlie tie ung.
Kama ta ica pipa yi bie hing suokha hmuo thaw li pata suokha hmuo chachiy'a va ung ciy, cuorasala ica pipa yi dadang haa hing tana Abyipanama Khazing nawbie hing nama ziy aa.

Peor lie a awpa Baal hne aa patuv pata Abyipata tuokhaatama a tue tapa hne niema hrawlie a awpa, Baal hnang a ziypa mekaa kha Abyipanama Khazing ta tuokhaatama a para yi tapa kha nama ming hrahring ta nama hmung mangtli.
Capa cuo ningta niema Abyipanama Khazing kha a cusa pata a patuvpa tie ca ataning tepa hingta nama hring.
Mang tie, nama cu riypa ruo lieta nama ziy riypa phungluo hne ziyphung zaw kha Abyipai Khazing ta ina changpa haata niema kha ica pacuv yi.

Capa ca a phasa pata ziy ung la, singna hne pachangkhuna kha aca pi'a yi. Capa phungluo ca ama thyi tiyta, “Hingpa mingphang lepa tie hing ca a singpa hne pachangkhuna a hnyipa tana ama cuo,” aca ta'a yi.
Abyipaima Khazing kha ma u tiyta malie aa ngiepa haata ama khazing kha ama u tiyta ama khazing ta aa ngiepa yi mingphang lepa ahungma a aw?
Ataning nama hmiekunglie i chipa phungbie bangkhuo haa hingta phungluo hne ziyphung a hnyipa mingphang lepa ahungma a aw?
A phasa pata a raaring ung la a ve tie ung, nama ming ta a hmungpa hmang kha nama hring chung bangkhuo ta nama maw li riypa hne nama palung chunglie a vie li riypata,

Abyipata kama kyihuo ta, “Cawsaa kha na papungpa tie yi, i bie kha thyi'a yi te chuelyi lie ama hring chung bangkhuo ina ciyzaa riypa yi hne ama saata zaw kha ama chang pachaa riypata,” ina ta ningta Abyipanama Khazing hmiekunglie Horeb lie kha zaa daa ung cate,
tluo a kuopa myihlaa ca avuo kya de te amyi ta zingkaluv khata a pahlaw ningta tluo thabaw luo vaa hnyi ung cate namaa daapa zaw kha nama saata hne nama samingta zaw kha pachang sa tie ung.
Cakhutaata Abyipata myi chungtaata bie aca chang yi. A bie ca thyi ung cate, cuorasala a hmingsuo ca hmung va ung ciy; a ueryi dyina a cuo.
A biekuo kha niema'a lie ca pathyi sa yi te ziy riypata aca chang yi, capa ca phungbie suohraa ta cuo te, lungphie suohning lie kha a cape.
Cakhutaata khapa cuo ning kha Abyipata niema kha a chung luo vaa ngie'a ung cate, nama cu riypa ruo lie nama ziy riypa phungluo hne ziyphung zaw pacuv riypata bie ina pi.
Horeb lie myi chungtaata Abyipata bie aca chang ning yi kha a hmingsuo nama hmung li nakawta, a phasa pata a raaring ung la a ve tie ung,
tahematapakieca nama cuota khaapa hmingsuo a lupa a cuo zaw; capaa acuolikie canung hmingsuo a lupa,
alyi lie a awpa tuokhaapa saruopa hmingsuo a lupa, thliy lie a zulepa tuokhaapa pavaa hmingsuo a lupa,

alyi lie a valepa tuokhaapa saruopa hmingsuo a lupa, tiy chunglie a awpa tuokhaapa ngaa hmingsuo a lupa a cuo zaw; nama cuota kuvtuezuv a tue pata nama aw pathlyi li riypata a phasa pata a raaring ung la a ve tie ung.

Cakhutaata avuo luo mang ung cate thlaapa, hne aasiy zaw, avuo lie a awpa hmang bangkhuo nama hmung tiyta capa zaw hmiekunglie a bung pata namaa bie pathlyi li riypata a raaring tie ung. Hingpa zaw hing ca Abyipanama Khazing ta vuoruotyi lie a awpa mingphang zaw bangkhuo khana a pi yi.
Cuorasala Abyipata niema ca ata haa hingta a cawsaa cuo riypata thaa tiy palangna sumyi, Izipt ruo chungtaata aca pyakhyi yi.
Niema kawlieta Abyipaca kama'a lie kha a hi haa te, Jordan cavaa i va te li riypa hne Abyipanama Khazing ta nama cu riypata aca pipa yi ruo phapa chung luo i ngie li riypata chiesana a tue.
Caacuonakawta Jordan ca va te li pata hingpa ruo lie hing thiy'a angte, cuorasala niema ca va te'a ung cate capa ruo phapa ca nama cu aa.
Caacuonakawta Abyipanama Khazing ta niema hne a tuepa biekuona ca maw li riypata a raaring ung la, Abyipanama Khazing ta a thlupa khaapa hmingsuo a lupa kuvtuezuv kha hmuo nama cuota a tue khah ung.
Tahematapakieca Abyipanama Khazing ca aa hlaa nguoluopa myi, hietlie a hmuopa Khazing tana a cuo.
Saata hne samingta zaw hnyi ung cate ruo chunglie nama ngie acaa rawsa tiy yi ta, hmingsuo suokhakha a hnyipa kuvtuezuv tue pata hne Abyipahmiekunglie a pha lipa tue pata a hi nama pahaa kieca,

Jordan cavaa va te pata nama cu riypa ruo lie nama ra paluo aa ta pata alyi hne avuo pachangkhyi pata ataning hing bie i ri; capa ruo lie ca a syi aw'a va ung ciy, cuorasala para diy karue pata nama cuo aa.
Abyipata mingphang zaw hrawlie kha aca chepatlaa diy'a yi; mingphang zaw hrawlie Abyipata aa chiy riypata a cawta dyina aca pangaa'a yi.
Capa lie ca cawsaa kuv ta tuepa khazing hrangpa, thing hne lung ta tuepa, a hmung khu lipa, a thyi khu lipa, a ning the lipa hne rang a thyi lipa khazing kha namaa bie aa.
Capa lie ca Abyipanama Khazing kha huv'a ung cate, pathiypalung hmisi hne nama ruena yalya ta nama huv kieca nama hmung aa.
Riethyivuosuona lie aw ung cate capa hmang bangkhuo namaa taw tiy dyi ta Abyipanama Khazing'a luo kha vya kaa'a ung cate a bie kha naa nama thlie aa.
Tahematapakieca Abyipanama Khazing ca kawpacuotuv Khazing ta cuo te, khatiy tahmuo caa ruose li'apa yi ta ca para'a va yi; nama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie chie a sa te bie aa kuopa kha maw'a vyi.

Niema zaw hluo karaa, Khazing ta alyi lie cawsaa a za sa ning taa khata pathu pata hluo chuo tie kha hiehriy tie ung; vuoruo dena taata kuokhaluo vuoruo dena te khata hiehriy tie ung: hing haapa hmang lesyipa hing a za aw buo ma, a thyi zaw nama thyi buo ma?
Niema ta nama thyipa haa hingta myi chungtaata khazing bie ripa kha thyi yi te a hringpa cawsaa ama aw tapa kha nama thyi buo ma?

Acuolikie, nama ming hmung hrahring ta Abyipanama Khazing ta Izipt lie a tuepa haa hingta khaapa khazing pakha chuo ta mingphang phang kha kha a hrangpa mingphang hrawtaata a cawsaa cuo riypata dyapasyana, kharuehaa hmang tuena, rietuvna, a cahrapa kuv hne a buo va pazuo pata, ciy aa chiypa cahrana paluo sa pata la te a sikhyi buo yi ma?
Abyipaca Khazing ta a cuopa kha pachang sa riypata niema ca pahmungsapa nama cuo; ama hlyi taata a hrangpa ahunghmuo aw va yi.
Niema pasiypa-ya riypata a ueryi kha vuoruo taata aca pathyi sa yi. Alyi lieta a lepa a myi kha ca pahmung sa yi te capa taa cata a ueryi kha aca pathyi sa yi.
Cakhutaata nama mingchingmingvuo tie kha a due nakaw yi ta, iema khutaata ama ciypathla zaw kha aa tlaw yi. Ama ta aca awpuonapa yi hne, a lesyipa a cahrana ta niema kha Izipt taata aca pyakhyi yi.
Ataning te ta a cuopa haa hingta, niema kha a chung luo pangie riypa hne ama ruo pacu sa riypata niema laata a le viepa hne a cahra viepa tie kha nama hmiekunglieta aa cade yi.
Caacuonakawta a cung vuoruo hne alyi cunglie hing Abyipaca Khazing tana a cuo tapa kha pachang ung la nama palung lie pari tie ung; a hrangpa ahunghmuo aw vyi.

Niema hne nama hnang taata a vawpa nama ciypathla zaw phana riypa hne Abyipanama Khazing ta chuozaa cuota ica pipa yi ruo lie hing cuo pasiysa nama aw riypata ataning ica pipa yi a phungluo hne a nawbie hing ziy tie ung.
Cakhutaata Moses ta Jordan cavaa ningchiyluo lie kha khy suothung a chi, cawsaa
pahning alalalie a huena aw li pata a ingpaa kha a thie pathlyipa, cawsaa a thiepa ta va canaw'a te a hringna riypata a cuo.
Reuben ming cuota ruocaapa tluocung lie a awpa Bezer, Gad ming cuota Gilead lie a awpa Ramoth, Manasseh ming cuota Bashan lie a awpa Golan zaw ta ama cuo.
Hingpa hing Moses ta Israel ming hmiekunglie a chipa phungbie ta a cuo.
Hingpa tie hing Izipt taata ama kya pya ningta Moses ta Israel ming a changpa yi phungluo hne ziyphung zaw ta a cuo.
Izipt taata ama kya pya ningta Moses hne Israel ming ta ama tepa Beth-peor a rie-e Jordan cavaa huesuo bawphie, Heshbon lie a awpa Amor ming siepahruo Sihon ruo chunglie kha a chang yi.
Iema ta capa paa ruo hne Bashan lie a awpa siepahruo Og ruo kha ama la, Jordan cavaa ningchiyluo kuo ta a awpa Amor ming siepahruo pahning tie ta ama cuo.
Arnon Bawphie kie lie a awpa Aroer taata Sirion Tluo te (capa ca Hermon ta a cuo),
Jordan cavaa ningchiyluo kuo ta a awpa Arabah ruo bangkhuo hne khata Pisgah tluo pachung rawlie a awpa Arabah Riyliy te ta ama la.
Moses ta Israel ming bangkhuo kha ku pakhaw yi te: Vya Israel, ataning ica changpa yi phungluo hne ziyphung zaw hing thyi tie ung; a cuv ung la a phasa pata ziy tie ung.
Abyipama Khazing ta Horeb lie kiema hne biekuona a tue tli.
Abyipata mingchingmingvuo tie hne a tuepa cuo vyi, cuorasala ataning a hringpa hingpa lie kiema hne hing tana a tue.
Abyipata a hmiepachaw pata tluo lie myi chungtaata aca chaw yi.

(Khapa cuo ning kha kama ca niema'a luo Abyipabie pathyi riypata Abyipahne niema alalalie kha i daa; tahematapakieca myi kha ciy ung cate tluo cung luo kha kie va ung ciy). Cakhutaata ama ta a ripa ca:
Kama ca Abyipana Khazing, sii na cuonapa Izipt ruo taata caa vya pyakhyipa tana i cuo;
Kama ta li pata khazing hrangpa kha hnyi khah.
Cungluo vuoruo lie a awpa, acuolikie arawluo alyi lie a awpa, acuolikie alyi raw riyliy lie a awpa hmang suokhakha hmingsuo a lupa kuvtuezuv kha na cuota a tue khah.

Iema hmiekunglie kha a bung pata abie khah; tahematapakieca kama Abyipanama Khazing ca hietlie a hmuopa Khazing tana i cuo, kama naa thawpa tie ama chuo, chuo thung chuo paliy te ta ama nungpaa tie pha lina kha saata zaw cunglie duo a tepa tana i cuo.
Cuorasala kama na due te i nawbie a ziypa tie cunglieta aa hmangpa i duena kha chuo thawkha te ta a paluo sapa tana i cuo.
Abyipana Khazing ming kha a cuo lipa lie va hmuo khah, tahematapakieca Abyipa ta a cuo lipa lie a ming a hmuopa ca a ngiethe khu'a vyi.
Abyipana Khazing ta bie aca pipa haata sabbath ning ca a uv la pathe sa tie.
Ning caruv chung kha na re bangkhuo naa hrie aa.

Cuorasala a ning sariynapa ca Abyipana Khazing sabbath ning tana a cuo; nama, na sacapaa hne na sacanung, na siicapaa hne na siicanung, na cuetungpa acuolikie na laa, tuokhaapa na sahring a cuo zaw, na khy lie khy a sapa ruohrang ming ta pata khaapa re hmuo hrie'a va ung ciy. Nama naa pahypa haata na siicanung siicapaa zaw kha amaa pahy ra aa.
Izipt lie sii na za cuopa kha maw khah. Abyipana Khazing ta capa taa cata a cahrapa a buo kha pazuo te aca pyakhyi; caacuonakawta Abyipana Khazing ta sabbath ning kha naa uv riypata bie aca pi.
Abyipana Khazing biepina haata, na nung hne na paa va ciyzaa yi, cahaacata na tue kieca Abyipana Khazing ta aca pipa ruo lie hing na hring pasiy'a te na cuota a pha aa.
Lie va naw khah.
Nungvaathingsuena tue khah.
Paruv khah.
Na ingpaa cunglie aa hmuo lipa tehte cuo khah.
Na ingpaapa napuv kha hietlie khah. Na ingpaa ing, lu, a siicapaa hne a siicanung, a cuetungpa, a laa, acuolikie na ingpaa ta a hnyipa hmang suokhakha kha hietlie khah.

Hingpa bie hing Abyipata cawsaazaapuv'a lie kha myi chungtaata hne amyi zingkaruvpa chungtaata ueryi paringsapa ta ca chang yi te, khaapahmuo chachiy vyi. Lungphie suohning cunglie kha cape te kama kha ina pi.
A zingkaruvpa chungtaata ueryi nama thyi tiyta, tluo ca myi ta a kuo ning kha, nama phang luochiytuv tie hne uvthyi tie yalya hne khata naa vya ngie ung cate,

“Mang tie ung, Abyipama Khazing na a rungnaana hne a lesyina malie pahmung sa te, a ueryi kha myi chungtaata ima thyi. Khazing ta cawsaa kha bie chang te na cawsaa a hring kalie tapa kha ataning hing ima hmung.
Caacuonakawta khaapanakawma ima thiy aa? Tahematapakieca hingpa myi lepa hingta malie a kuo diy aa; Abyipama Khazing ueryi kha ma thyi kalie kieca ma thiy aa.
Tahematapakieca myi chungtaata bie a ripa, a hringpa Khazing ueryi kha kiema haata a thyi pata a hringpa ahungma a aw?

Nama hrahring ta vaa ngie la Abyipama Khazing ta a ri riypa bie bangkhuo kha va naathlie tie. Cakhutaata Abyipama Khazing ta aca changpa bangkhuo kha kiema ca malie chang tie; capa ca kiema ta naathlie'a pate ma tue aa,” nama ta.
Kama'a lie nama ripa bie kha Abyipata a thyi tiyta kama kyihuo khata: “Hingpa cawsaa zaw ta nama'a lie ama ripa bie kha i thyi tli; ama ripa bie bangkhuo ca aa hmuopa tana a cuo.
Cahaapa pathiypalung ca phya hmisi yi te, kama kha na ciy yi te i nawbie kha chuozaa ta ama ziy kieca, iema hne ama saata zaw cuota chuozaa ta kha-aw ama tawna ta a cuo aa.
Vaa la iema kha, ‘Nama thluodaa luo kaa tie ung,’ va ta tie yi.
Cuorasala nama ca hingpa kama athaalie hing a daa la, ama cu riypata i pi riypa yi ruo lie ama tue riypata nawbie bangkhuo, iema na pacuv riypa yi phungluo hne ziyphung zaw kha ica chang aa,” ina ta.
Caacuonakawta Abyipanama Khazing ta bie aca pipa haa yi ta a raaringsa pata tue tie ung; cacuoluo a cuo zaw cavyiluo a cuo zaw pie khah ung.
Nama cu riypa ruo lie hring'a ung cate, nama cuota pha te nama chuo a pasiy riypata Abyipanama Khazing ta bie aca pipa yi luo kha aa hmuosa pata nama ziy aa.
Abyipanama Khazing ta niema pacuv riypata ina changpa, nama cu riypa ruo lie nama ziy riypa nawbie, phungluo hne ziyphung zaw ca hingpa hing tana a cuo.

Niema hne nama saata hne nama samingsahlaa zaw ta nama chuo chung bangkhuo Abyipanama Khazing kha nama ciy riypa hne nama chuo a pasiy riypata kama ica pipa yi phungluo hne a nawbie bangkhuo kha ziy tie ung.

Caacuonakawta, Vya Israel, na mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing, Abyipata bie aca kuopa haa yi ta, cuehnung hne khyitiy a langnapa ruo lie hing na cuota pha te nama pungzaa riypata capa phungluo hne nawbie bangkhuo ca a phasa pata ziy tie.
Thyi tie, Vya Israel: Abyipaca ima Khazing tana a cuo, Abyipapakha kyalya hing.
Abyipana Khazing ca na pathiypalung yalya, na hringna yalya, hne na cahrana yalya tana na due aa.
Ataning ica pipa bie hing na chunglie pari tie.
Na saata zaw kha a phasa pata chang yi la, ing lie na aw ning cuose, ale lie na aw ning cuose, naa zie ning cuose, na thu ning cuose na chang pari'a yi.
Na buo lie kha pamangsana riypata ciypuo la, na puo lie kha pachangna riypata be tie.
Cakhutaata hingpa tie hing na ingchiypakaa tung lie hne na thlake lie zaw kha cape tie.
Abyipana Khazing ta na mingchingmingvuo tie, Abraham, Isak hne Jakob tie'a lie pi riypata chie aa sapa ruo, hmang phapa ta a bipa ruo, niema nama sa lipa khypuv zaw,

nama ta na pabi lipa hmang phapa daduo ta a bipa ing zaw, nama ta na cu lipa takhue zaw, nama ta naa ling lipa mingsuv diedung hne olif thingdiy luo zaw kha caa ngiekhyi te, na riy bisa pata na ning tiyta,
sii na cuonapa ing, Izipt ruo taata caa vya pyakhyipa Abyipakha na maw li riypata a raaring tie.
Abyipana Khazing kha na ciyzaa aa; a re kha na hrie aa, ama ming dyi ta chie naa sa aa.
Na cahriylie a awpa mingphang tie khazing hrangpa, khaapa khazing a cuo zaw ziy'a vaciy.
Tahematapakieca nama'a lie a awpa Abyipana Khazing ca hietlie a hmuopa Khazing tana a cuo. Abyipana Khazing hihaana ca a ie ta ie'a te alyi taa hingta nama kha aca para'a yi.
Massah lie na dyapasyapa haa khata Abyipana Khazing kha dyapasya khah.
Abyipana Khazing ta aca pipa nawbie, hne a phungluo zaw kha a phasa pata ziy tie.
Abyipata na mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie pi riypata chie aa sapa ruo phapa luo kha a ngie cate na cu riypa hne na cuota a pha riypata Abyipahmiekunglieta aa dangpa hne a phapa kha tue tie.
Abyipata bie aa kuopa haata nama carie bangkhuo kha nama hmiekung taata aa cade diy yi.
Hmieluo cuo lie na saata zaw ta, “Abyipata nama'a lie aca pipa phungluo hne ziyphung zaw a siyluo ca khaapatama a cuo,” ta pata aca hiehriy kie yi ca,
nama ta na saata zaw kha, “Kiema ca Izipt lie Faraoh sii tana ma za cuo, cuorasala Abyipata a cahrapa a kuv ta Izipt taata malie a pyakhyi.
Abyipata a lepa hne ciy aa chiypa kharuehaa hmang kha Izipt, Faraoh hne a ingchungkhue tie ming hmung ta a paluo sa.
Ama ta ma mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie pi riypata chiesana ta bie aa kuopa ruo luo kha a ngiekhyi riypata khapa taa khata malie a vya pyakhyi.
Cakhutaata ata a cuopa haa hingta, malie pahring te phana ma hmung pari riypa, hne Abyipama Khazing kha ma ciyzaa riypata phungluo bangkhuo kha ma ziy riypata Abyipata bie malie a pi.
Ama ta bie malie a pipa haata Abyipama Khazing hmiekunglie hingpa nawbie bangkhuo hing a phasa pata ma ziy kieca kiema cuota adangna a cuo aa,” na ta'a yi.

Abyipana Khazing ta na cu riypa ruo luo acaa ngiekhyi tiy ta, nama laata a cahra viepa hne a hluv viepa mingphang phang sariy, Hit ming, Girgash ming, Amor ming, Kanaan ming, Periz ming, Hiv ming hne Jebus ming zaw kha na hmiekung taata a papya yi.
Cakhutaata Abyipana Khazing ta iema kha nama'a luo ca pi te na te tiy yi ta, iema kha na para diy karue'a yi. Iema hne biekuona tue'a vaciy, ama cunglie nangduena zaw hnyi'a vaciy.
Iema hne a chiy a hie'a va ung ciy, na sacanung kha ama sacapaa zaw pi'a va yi ciy, ama sacanung kha nama sacapaa huota la'a va ung ciy.

Tahematapakieca capa ca ta na saata zaw kha kama hnang ziyna taata papie sa'a yi te khazing hrangpa re kha a pahrie sa'a yi. Cakhutaata Khazing hihaana kha niema cunglie myi ie ta ie'a te, a catlisa pata aca para'a yi.

Cuorasala iema cunglie kha hing haa hingta nama tue aa: ama bienatluophie kha nama para aa, ama lungbang kha nama phawchi aa, ama Asherah tung zaw kha hu patyi'a ung cate ama kuvtuezuv kha myi ta nama rue aa.

Tahematapakieca niema ca Abyipanama Khazing cuota a pathepa mingphang tana nama cuo; Abyipanama Khazing ta a mingphang riypa hne a huopa riypata alyi cung mingphang zaw bangkhuo hrawtaata acaa tlaw yi.
Abyipata nama cunglie a palung chi te acaa tlawpa yi hing mingphang hrangpa tie laata nama hluv vie nakawta cuo vyi, niema ca mingphang hrang zaw hrawlie a caw cepa tana nama cuo.

Abyipata niema aca duepa yi hing nama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie chie a zaa sa nakaw tana a cuo, capa nakaw ca ta Abyipata a cahrapa a kuv ta sii nama cuonapa ing, Izipt siepahruo Faro kuv taata aca khuo yi.
Caacuonakawta Abyipanama Khazing ca ama a duepa hne a nawbie a ziypa tie cunglie kha a biekuona kha chuo thawkha te pacu sa te, zang tluo aa tlapa Khazing a cuonapa, hne
ama a thawpa tie kha iema cunglie hrahring vieriy a thungpa a cuopa kha pachang tie ung. Ama a thawpa tie kha palaw li pata iema cunglie hrahring ta vieriy a thungpa tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta kama ta ataning ica pipa yi nawbie, phungluo, hne ziyphung zaw hing a phasa pata ziy tie ung.
Hingpa ziyphung zaw hing naathlie ung cate a phasa pata nama ziy kieca, Abyipanama Khazing ta nama mingchingmingvuo tie hne chie aa sapa biekuona kha niema'a lie a pacu sa aa.

Nama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie pi riypata bie aa kuopa ruo lie kha, aca due'a yi, thlue aca chiy'a yi, aca papungzaa'a yi; nama pangpa thyipaa hne namaa lyi thyipaa kha thlue a chiy aa, nama sa, hne nama mingsuvtiy hne nama chiytiy zaw kha thlue chiy'a te, nama cue zaw hne nama tuvrung zaw kha thlue a chiy aa.
Niema ca mingphang thluechiy cepa ta cuo'a ung cate, niema hrawlie saata a sa khu lipa aw'a va ung ciy, nama sahring hrawlie a cingpa aw'a vyi.

Abyipata pasana bangkhuo taata ca khuo'a yi te, Izipt lieta namaa tawpa ciy aa chiypa pasana zaw kha nama cunglie patlung sa'a vyi, cuorasala niema caa huepa bangkhuo tie cunglie khana a patlung sa aa.
Abyipanama Khazing ta aca pipa yi mingphang bangkhuo kha nama para aa, ama cunglie nangduena hnyi'a va ung ciy; ama khazing kha abie'a va ung ciy, tahematapakieca cyihyi liena aca pa-uo'a yi.
Niema'a na niema kha, “Hingpa mingphang tie hing kiema laata ama hluv vie; tuokhaatama ima phya khu'a yi?” a ta'a va ung ciy.
Iema kha ciy khah ung. Abyipanama Khazing ta Faraoh hne Izipt ming bangkhuo kha tuokhaatama a tue yi tapa kha a thyi tie ung.

Nama ming ta nama hmungpa ciy aa chiypa hmang zaw, kharuehaa hmang zaw, a cahrapa kuv hne a pazuopa buo ta Abyipanama Khazing ta aca vya pyakhyi yi. Abyipanama Khazing na nama ciypa mingphang zaw bangkhuo cunglie hing khapa haa khata a tue aa.
Ca hlyitaw taata, Abyipanama Khazing ta iema kha puvtlung pasana a pathliesue'a yi, a hring tlakuopa tie hne aa ngaa tlakuopa tie hmuo ama ra diyna te khata.
Iema kha ciy khah ung, tahematapakieca niema'a lie a awpa, Abyipanama Khazing ca a lepa hne ciy aa chiypa Khazing tana a cuo.
Abyipanama Khazing ta hingpa mingphang tie hing nama hmiekunglie a cawta a cawta tah a cade'a yi; sungkha ta a cade diy'a va ung ciy, caacuolikieca ruosaa na niema'a lie caa pungzaasue sa'a yi.
Cuorasala Abyipanama Khazing ta iema kha niema'a luo ca pi'a yi te, para diypa ama cuona te ta thlaazang pata a pa-aw sa'a yi.
Ama ta ama siepahruo tie zaw kha nama kuv luo ca pi'a yi te, iema ming kha hingpa avuo raw chuelyi taa hingta nama pavie aa; nama para diyna te ta pakha tahmuo caa daakhuo nguopa aw'a va yi.

Ama khazing tie zuv kha myi ta nama rue aa. Capa zaw cunglie a awpa siy hne ngu zaw kha hietlie pata niema cuota a la'a va ung ciy, cyihyi liena aca pa-uo'a yi; tahematapakieca Abyipanama Khazing cuota duv aa chiypa tana a cuo.

Duv aa chiypa hmang kha nama ing chung luo a ngiekhyi khah ung, khapa hmang haa kha tana niema zaw para riypata chipa nama cuo aa. Khapa hmang tie kha hue ung la duv tie ung, tahematapakieca para riypata chipa tana ama cuo.
Nama hnaatluo te nama pung riypa hne Abyipata nama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie pi riypata chie aa sapa ruo kha nama cu riypata ataning ica pipa yi nawbie bangkhuo hing a phasa pata ziy tie ung.

Raw nama canaw the riypa, nama pathiypalung chunglie khaapama a aw tapa kha dyapasya riypa, hne a nawbie kha nama ziy ma ziy va ung ca ma ta pata Abyipata kung sawliy chung ruocaapa lie acaa chiynapa yi kha a thyi pakhaa tie ung.

Cawsaa hing sa dyi ta hring vyi, cuorasala Abyipata a ripa bie mekaa kha tana a hring aa, a tapa kha nama pachang riypata nama nang ca padiy yi te, cakhutaata niema hne nama mingchingmingvuo tie ta nama pachang buo lipa manna kha ning riypata aca pi yi.
Hingpa kung sawliy chunglie hing nama ke lie caw tlaa li pata nama phyi zaw thling vyi.
Caacuonakawta nungpaa ta saata zaw ama pasiypa-yapa haa tana Abyipanama Khazing ta aca pasiypa-ya yi tapa kha nama palung lie pachang tie ung.
Caacuonakawta Abyipanama Khazing nawbie kha ziy tie ung; a luopuv ziy ung la, ama kha ciyzaa tie ung.
Tahematapakieca Abyipanama Khazing ta ruo phapa chung luo acaa ngiekhyi yi. Cavaata zaw a langnapa ruo, bawphie hne tluo lie a langpa acaa hne takhue zaw aa thluvnapa,
jungsacuo, barli, mingsuv, thyikuv, cale, aa thluvnapa ruo, olif kung hne khyitiy aa thluvnapa ruo,
viechuo kha a cangkuo li pata nama ningna riypa ruo, namaa phahlapa a aw linapa ruo, aa lung zaw thaa ta a cuopa ruo hne a tluo lie daa nama cunapa ruo tana a cuo aa.
Nama riy bina te ning'a ung cate Abyipanama Khazing ta aca pipa yi ruo phapa kawlie khata nama pathuosa aa.
Ataning ica pipa yi a nawbie, a ziyphung hne a phungluo zaw ziy li pata Abyipanama Khazing kha nama maw li riypata a raaring tie ung.
Nama riy bina te ning ung cate, ing phasapa a sa ung cate a chunglie nama tlung tiyta,
hne nama sahring hne nama tuv zaw a pungzaa tiyta, siy hne ngu zaw a hluv vie nama hnyi tiyta, hne nama hnyipa bangkhuo a hluv viele tiyta,
niema hne niema kha a pale pata, Abyipanama Khazing, Izipt ruo, siicuona ing chungtaata caa pyakhyipa yi kha nama maw li riypata a raaring tie ung.

Ama ca a lepa hne ciy aa chiypa ruocaapa, a ca-ie ruvsapa pariy hne tluociekuo zaw ama awnapa ruocaapa luo caa chiytuv yi tana a cuo. Ama ta niema cuota, vuokhawlung lungpuv chungtaata tiy papya sa te,
ruocaapa lie kha nama mingchingmingvuo tie ama pachang buo lipa ning riypa manna kha aca pi yi. A chuona lieta niema kha hmang phapa tuepa riypata raw ca canaw sa yi te aca dyapasya yi.
Niema'a na niema kha, “Kama cahrana hne i kuv thaazuo tana hingpa suethiy hing i hmung,” ta lie ung ciy.

Cuorasala Abyipanama Khazing kha a thyi tie ung, tahematapakieca hnyirungna caa pipa yi ca ama tana a cuo, ataning a tuepa haa hingta nama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie chie aa sapa biekuona kha a pacu sa khing nakaw tana a cuo.
Abyipanama Khazing kha maw ung cate, khazing hrangpa re kha hrie ung cate namaa bie kieca, nama ra hrahring aa ta pata ataning hing a siesa pata a raaringna ica pi yi.
Abyipanama Khazing bie kha nama ziy li kieca nama hmiekunglie a parapa mingphang tie haa hingta para pata nama cuo ra hrahring aa.
Vya Israel, Naathlie tie! Nama laata a le viepa hne a cahra viepa mingphang, avuo phana te ta aa suopa dungkhuo a hnyipa khypuv lepa tie,

a thaaruvpa hne aa suosapa mingphang, Anak samingsahlaa tie, “Anak cawsaa zaw hmiekunglie ahungma a daa khu aa?” ama tapa na thyi tawpa tie kha phya riypata ataning hing Jordan cavaa kha na va te'a tli.

Abyipana Khazing ca a kuo nguoluopa myi haata nama hmiekunglie cavaa vaa tepa a cuopa kha ataning pachang tie. Ama ta na hmiekunglie te'a yi te a kuv rawlie a chi'a yi, caacuonakawta Abyipata bie acaa kuopa haata nama ta phya'a yi cate a catlisa pata na para'a yi.

Abyipana Khazing ta na hmiekunglie aa cade tiy yi ta, “Kama i dang nakaw tana hingpa ruo hing cu riypata Abyipata inaa vya chiy,” ta'a vaciy. Hingpa mingphang tie zaw ama pha li nakaw tana Abyipata na hmiekung taata aa cadepa yi ta a cuo hriy.

Naa dang nakaw hne na pathiypalung a pha nakawta hingpa ruo luo hing cu riypata naa ngiepa cuo vyi; cuorasala hingpa mingphang tie ama pha li nakawta hne Abyipata na mingchingmingvuo tie, Abraham, Isak, hne Jakob tie'a lie bie aa kuopa a patling sa khing nakaw tana a cuo.
Cakhutaata, Abyipata hingpa ruo cu riypa hing naa dang nakawta aca pipa cuo vyi tapa kha pachang tie; tahematapakieca nama ca a palung lepa tana na cuo.

Ruocaapa chunglieta Abyipana Khazing kha kha tluv tama a hi na pahaa tapa kha a thyi pakhaa la maw khah. Izipt ruo taata na vya pya baataata hingpa hmang na vya chiyna te hingta Abyipaca naa du byalya.
Horeb lie kha hmuo Abyipakha a hi pahaa cate, Abyipaca a hi a haa tuv nakawta para ta aacaa nang.
Lungphie zaw, Abyipata nama hne a tuepa biekuona lungphie la riypata tluo cung luo i kie ning kha sa ning li tiy dang li pata tluo cunglie kha ning sawliy hne zuo sawliy i aw.

Cakhutaata Abyipata Khazing kuvdaw ta a capepa lungphie suohning kha ina pi; capa lungphie zaw cunglie ca a pungnapa ning lieta, tluo cunglie myi chungtaata Abyipata niema'a lie a ripa bie bangkhuo kha a aw.
Ning sawliy hne zuo sawliy a chuo ning kha Abyipata biekuona lungphie phie hning ca ina pi.

Cakhutaata Abyipata kama kha, “Thu la hingpa taa hingta a catlisa pata cung tie, tahematapakieca Izipt taata na vya pyakhyipa yi na cawsaa zaw na a ra tli yi. Kama ta bie i pipa yi luopuv taa khata a catlisa pata pie yi te na, iema cuota kuvtuezuv kha amaa patle tli,” ina ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipata, “Hingpa cawsaa tie hing a palung lepa mingphang tana ama cuo.
Na thlu khah, para'a yi angte hingpa avuo raw taa hingta ama ming hing para ang se; cakhutaata nama kha iema laata a cahra viepa hne ale viepa mingphang ta ica tue aa,” ina ta kalie.
Caacuonakawta a pali angte tluo cung taa khata i za cung, tluo ca myi ta a kuo, biekuona lungphie suohning ca i kuv lie ama aw.

Cakhutaata niema ca Abyipanama Khazing kha a du ung cate a cunglie nama sue hrahring tapa kha ica hmung yi; cuetaata zuv kha nama cuota a patle ung cate Abyipata bie aca pipa yi luopuv taa khata a catlisa pata nama pie.
Caacuonakawta lungphie suohning kha la angte nama hmiekunglie ta a kyipatlaa diyna te ta i vaachi.

Cakhutaata a hluo haa khata Abyipahmiekunglie kha a bu angte, ning sawliy hne zuo sawliy chung kha sa ning li tiy dang li pata i aw; tahematapakieca a hmiekunglie niema nama tuepa suena khata Abyipakha a hi a pahaa.
Tahematapakieca niema cunglie Abyipahihaana ca myi ie ta a ie nakawta ta niema kha aca para pathlyi'a yi tapa kha i ciy. Cuorasala capa cuo lie zaw kha Abyipata i bie kha naa a thlie ngiethie.
Abyipata Aaron cunglie kha a hi a haa tuv hringhruo nakawta ama kha para aa ting, cuorasala khapa cuo ning zaw kha Aaron cuota thlaa i chuopa.
Cakhutaata niema nama tuepa hmang pha lipa cuetaata zuv kha la angte, myi ta rue angte i dechi kary diy. A diykariyna te i carie diy khutaata tluo cung taata zaa langpa cavaa luo kha i lyi diy.
Taberah lie zaw, Massah lie hne Kibroth-hattaavah lie zaw Abyipakha a hi nama pahaa.

Cakhutaata Abyipata Kadesh-barnea taata ca pathlie yi te, “Si ung la ica pipa yi ruo kha kya cu tie ung,” aca ta ning zaw yi ta Abyipanama Khazing ta bie aca pipa yi kha a du ung cate, a bie kha zang lipa ung ca ta ziy va ung ciy.
Ica za pachang baataa yi ta Abyipakha namaa du pari.
Abyipata niema kha para acaa nang tiy yi ta, Abyipahmiekunglie kha ning sawliy hne zuo sawliy chung i bu.

Abyipa'a luo kha thlaachuo angte, “AbyipaKhazing, nama huopa ta a cuopa mingphang tie kha para thi khah yi, a cahrapa na kuv ta Izipt ruo taata na pyakhyipa yi, na lesyina cuota naa thlapa tie tana ama cuo.
Na changtaapa Abraham, Isak, hne Jakob tie kha a thyi tie yi; hingpa mingphang tie palunglena, ama pha lina hne suena kha siysaa ri thi khah.

Cata acuolikieca malie na vya pyakhyinapa ruo tie khana, ‘Abyipata iema bie a kuopa yi ruo luo a chiykhyi khu li nakaw yi hne a hue nakaw yi tana ruocaapa lie thiy riypa hingta a vya pyakhyi yi,” a ta'a yi.
Tahematapakieca, iema ca a lesyipa na cahrana hne na pazuopa na buo ta na vya pyakhyipa yi na mingphang hrahring tana ama cuo,” i ta.
Capa cuo lie ca Abyipata kama kha, “Ahluo ta lungphie taapa tie haa khata lungphie suohning kha tue la, tluo cung luo, kama'a luo kha kya kie tie, cakhutaata thing thingkaw zaw kha sa tie,” ina ta.
Ahluo ta na vaa chi patlaapa lungphie taapa tie lie aa capepa bie kha ata lungphie tie cunglie hing cape pakhaa'a angte, thingkaw chunglie kha na khung'a yi,” ina ta.
Caacuonakawta akasia thing ta thingkaw kha tue angte, ahluo ta lungphie taapa haapa lungphie suohning kha i syi khutaata, i kuv ta cyile angte tluo cung luo ca i kie.
Cakhutaata lungphie tie cunglie ca ahluo taapa bie, Abyipata tluo cunglie namaa pung ning myi chungtaata a ripa, nawbie suohraa kha a cape khutaata Abyipaca ta kama kha ina pi.
Cakhutaata a pali angte tluo cung taa cata i za cung. Abyipata bie ina pipa haata lungphie ca i tuepa thingkaw lie kha pasuo angte, capa lie ca ama aw.
(Israel ming ca Beeroth-bene-jaakan taata Moserah luo kha ama si. Capa ruo lie ca Aaron kha thiy te ama paby; a sacapaa Eleazar ta ama kha aa thle.
Capa taa cata Gudgodah luo kha ama si, Gudgodah taata cavaa a hluvsanapa Jotbathah luo ama si.

Capa cuo taa cata Abyipata Levi ming kha Abyipabiekuona thingkaw a puv riypata cuose, Abyipahmiekunglie a daa pata a re hrie riypata cuose, a ming ta thluechiy pi riypata cuose a nanang ta re pi yi te ataning tepa hingta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Levi ca a uvnu zaw hrawlieta cuvu hne ru hnyi vyi; Abyipanama Khazing ta bie aca kuopa haa yi ta, Abyipaca a cuvu ta a cuo.)
Ahluo ta i tuepa haa khata tluo cunglie kha ning sawliy hne zuo sawliy i aw. Abyipata i bie kha na naathliepa pakhaa hyi te, Abyipata niema kha ca para khing va yi.
Abyipata kama kha, “Thu la, ama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lieta pi riypata chie i sapa ruo chung luo ca a ngie pata ama cu riypata cawsaa zaw ca hmie sapa yi la si tie,” ina ta.

Caacuonakawta, Vya Israel, Abyipana Khazing ta aca changpa hing khaapatama a cuo? Abyipana Khazing kyalya dyi kha ciyzaa riypa, a luopuv bangkhuo kha ziy riypa, ama kha due riypa, Abyipana Khazing kha na pathiypalung yalya hne na ruena aylya ta due riypa, hne
nama phana cuota ataning bie ica pipa ziyphung bangkhuo hne a nawbie zaw kha ziy riypata a cuo.
Aa suo cepa avuo hne alyi hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo ca Abyipana Khazing huopa ta a cuo raalaa pata,
Abyipaca na mingchingmingvuo tie dyi kha due yi te, iema khutaata ama ciypathla nama kha mingphang zaw bangkhuo chungtaata acaa tlaw, ataning a cuopa haa hingta.
Cakhutaata na palung vangdaw kha a te la, na palung le khah tie se.
Tahematapakieca Abyipana Khazing ca khazing tie Khazing, byi tie Abyipatana a cuo, a lesyipa Khazing, a cahrapa hne ciy aa chiypa Khazing, pahlyipalena a hnyi lipa hne nawthuv a la lipa tana a cuo.
Haaraa hne nunghlyi cuota aa dang pata biechipatuv, khyche kha due te sa hne caw a pipa tana a cuo.
Niema zaw mingpe kha due tie ung, tahematapakieca Izipt lie kha mingpe tana nama za cuo.
Abyipana Khazing kha na ciyzaa aa; ama pakha dyi kha naa bie aa; ama kha naa be aa, ama ming ta chie naa sa aa.
Ama ca na pathuosa riypa, na Khazing, na ming hrahring ta na hmungpa a lesyipa hne ciy aa chiypa hmang kha na cuota a tuepa tana a cuo.
Na mingchingmingvuo tie Izipt ruo luo ama sibung tiyta cawsaa saw sariy na a ta yi; ata hing ca Abyipana Khazing ta avuo lie aasiy zaa ta aca papungzaa sa tli yi.
Tahematapakieca Abyipana Khazing kha na due aa, aca changpa a ziyphung hne a nawbie zaw kha na ziy pari aa.
Nama saata (Abyipana Khazing pasiypa-yana kha a pachang lipa hne a hmung buo lipa) cuo li pata niema'a liena i ri, a lesyina, a cahrapa hne a pazuopa a buo,
Izipt siepahruo Faro hne a ruo bangkhuo zaw cunglie a tuepa kharuehaa hmang tie,

Izipt rieka tie cunglie a tuepa, amaa ruo hne a ruole zaw cunglie a tuepa, niema caa vya cadepa tie zaw cunglie a buvkhung diy riypata Riyliy Sepa kha tuokhaatama a tue tapa, Abyipata ataning tepa hingta a paranapa yi;
ruocaapa lie niema cunglie kha tuokhaata tue te ma, hingpa hmang te nama vya chiy tapa;

Reuben sacapaa Eliab sacapaa zaw a cuopa Dathan hne Abiram cunglie khaapama a tue tapa, Israel ming bangkhuo hmiekunglieta alyi ta a pakaa kya uo te iema kha ama ingchungkhue cawsaa yalya hne, ama thluodaa hne, iema hrawlie a hringpa bangkhuo hneta tuokhaatama a paluo yi tapa,
Abyipata a tuepa hmang lesyi hringhruopa bangkhuo kha nama ming hrahring ta nama hmung mangtli.
Caacuonakawta, ataning ica pipa yi nawbie bangkhuo hing ziy tie ung. Cakiedyina si pata nama cu riypa ruo luo kha a ngie pata cu khunapa thaazuo nama hnyi aa.
Cakhutaata Abyipata nama mingchingmingvuo tie hne ama ciypathla tie'a lie pi riypata chie aa sapa, cuehnung hne khyitiy a langnapa ruo lie ca nama chuo a pasiy aa.
Tahematapakieca si pata nama cu riypa ruo hing nama vya pyanapa Izipt ruo, nama saciy kha vaa ung cate uohnaasiyyhnaa diedung kha nama phyi ta tiy nama byanapa hne khata a lu vyi.
Cuorasala si pata nama cu riypa ruo ca tluo hne bawphie zaw a binapa ruo, avuo taata khytiy ta tiy a byapa,
Abyipanama Khazing ta a mangchiypa ruo tana a cuo. Abyipanama Khazing ming ca kung hruothu taata kung chuona te capa ruo cunglie cana a aw pari.
Ataning ica pipa yi nawbie bangkhuo hing naathlie pata, Abyipanama Khazing kha due ung cate, a re kha nama pathiypalung yalya ta hne nama ruena yalya ta nama hrie kieca,
ama ta a khycuo ziy pata khytiy taapa hne khytiy tliepa kha ca pi'a yi te, sa hne mingsuvtiy hne chiytiy zaw kha pahmya'a ung cate,
cakhutaata nama sahring zaw cuota nama lu lie kha a phuv ca pi'a yi te, nama riy bisa pata nama ning aa.
A raaring tie ung, caacuolikieca khazing hrangpa re hrie riypa hne abie riypata dungpa tana nama cuo pathlyi aa.

Cahaacata nama tue kieca Abyipahihaana kha niema a carie pata myi haata a ie aa, a vuo khiy khaa'a te khy saa li pata alyi ta thyipaa a hnyi'a li nakawta, Abyipata aca pipa yi ruo phapa lie hing a catlisa pata nama ra aa.
Hingpa bie hing nama pathiypalung chunglie hne nama ruena chunglie chi tie ung, nama buo lie kha pamangsana riypata a ciypuo ung la, nama puo lie kha pachangna riypata be tie ung.
Nama saata zaw kha pacuv ung la ing lie nama aw ning cuose, a le lie nama pya ning cuose, namaa zie ning hne nama thu tiy zaw khata pacuv pari tie ung.
Hingpa tie hing nama ingchiypakaa tung lie hne nama thlake lie kha cape tie ung.

Cahaacata nama tue kieca Abyipata nama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie pi riypata chie aa sapa ruo chunglie hing avuo ca alyi cunglie a aw chung bangkhuo ta niema hne nama saata zaw ca nama chuo a pasiy aa.
Kama ta ica pipa yi nawbie bangkhuo hing a phasa pata nama ziy pata, Abyipanama Khazing kha due ung cate, ama kha a be pata a luopuv bangkhuo kha nama ziy kieca,
nama hmiekunglie a awpa mingphang bangkhuo hing Abyipata a cade diy'a yi te, niema laa ta a le viepa hne a cahra viepa mingphang tie kha nama phya khu aa.
Nama phyipazaa ta nama tlawnapa hmang bangkhuo kha niema huopa tana a cuo aa; nama ruoriy ca ruocaapa taa khata Lebanon te, Eufrates cavaa taata Ningtla Riyliy te ta a cuo aa.
Ahunghmuo niema kha caa du khu'a va yi; Abyipanama Khazing ta a biekuona haata nama phyipazaa ta nama tlawnapa ruo bangkhuo lie kha niema ciyna hne thlaazangna kha a chi aa.
Mang tie ung, ataning hing nama hmiekunglie na thluechiyna hne chiesana i chi:
ataning ica pipa yi Abyipanama Khazing nawbie kha nama ziy kieca thluechiy ta cuo'a te,
nama za pachang buo lipa khazing hrangpa kha ziy riypata, ataning kama ta bie ica pipa yi taa hingta pie ung cate, Abyipanama Khazing nawbie kha nama ziy li kieca chiesana ta a cuo aa.
Cu riypata namaa ngienapa ruo chung luo kha Abyipanama Khazing ta acaa ngiekhyi tiy yi ta, thluechiyna kha Gerizim Tluo cunglie chi'a ung cate, chiesana kha Ebal Tluo cunglie nama chi aa.
Nama pachangpa haata, capa tluo tie ca Jordan cavaa ningtlaluo,
Abyipanama Khazing ta aca pipa yi ruo chung luo ca vaa ngie pata cu riypata Jordan kha nama te tiyta, hne cu ung cate a chunglie nama aw tiyta,
kama ta ataning ica pipa yi phungluo hne ziyphung bangkhuo hing a phasa pata nama ziy aa.

Nama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing, Abyipa ta cu riypata aca pipa yi ruo chunglie, alyi cunglie nama hring chung bangkhuo ta a phasa pata nama ziy riypa phungluo hne ziyphung ca hingpa tie hing tana a cuo.
Niema ta nama phya riypa tie mingphang amaa biepa tluo a suopa cunglie, tluothlue cunglie, thingkung lepa bangkhuo rawlie ama khazing amaa bienapa hmang bangkhuo ca nama para diy karue aa.

Ama bienatluophie kha phi diy ung la ama lungbang kha dechi diy tie ung, ama Ashera tung kha myi ta rue ung la ama khazing kuvtuezuv tie kha hu patyi diy tie ung; ama awna hmang taa khata ama ming kha para diy karue tie ung.
Abyipanama Khazing ca cahaacata abie'a va ung ciy.
Cuorasala Abyipanama Khazing ta nama phang zaw chungtaata a awna riypa hne a ming china riypata aa tlaw riypa hmang ca huv tie ung. Capa luo ca cakuo'a ung cate,

nama myirue panaana hne nama hriykhungrina zaw, nama chehraachekha hne namaa hlu zaw, biekuona ta nama pipa lasaw zaw, nama lungthe panaana zaw, nama sahring hne nama tuvrung chungtaata a pachuo taapa tie zaw kha nama vya cyi aa.
Cakhutaata Abyipanama Khazing hmiekunglie kha ning'a ung cate, nama tuepa bangkhuo cunglie Abyipanama Khazing ta thluechiy aca pipa yi cunglie kha niema hne nama ingchungkhue yalya ta namaa law aa.
Kiema khingna cyicuo ta ataning hingpa lie ma tuepa haa hingta tue'a va ung ciy,
tahematapakieca Abyipanama Khazing ta aca pipa yi nama cu riypa adingna hmang luo ca pha valie ung ciy.
Jordan kha va te ung cate, Abyipanama Khazing ta aca pacu sapa yi ruo chunglie nama aw tiyta hne, aa bangsa pata nama aw thena riypata nama cahriylie nama carie tie'a taata adingna aca pi tiy yi ta,

Abyipanama Khazing ta, a ming awna riypata aa tlaw riypa hmang luo kha, kama ta bie ica pipa yi bangkhuo kha nama vya cyi aa: nama myirue panaana hne hriykhungrina zaw, nama chehraachekha hne namaa hlu zaw, Abyipa'a luo bie namaa kuopa biekuona lasaw zaw bangkhuo kha nama vya cyi aa.

Cakhutaata Abyipanama Khazing hmiekunglie kha nama hne na sacapaa hne na sacanung zaw, na siicanung hne na siicapaa zaw, nama khy lie a awpa Levi ming zaw (iema ca niema hneta cuvu hne ru ama hnyi li nakawta) hne khata namaa law pakhaw aa.
Nama hmungpa hmang mekaa lieta myirue panaana tue'a va ung ciy.
