Cuorasala niema phang kha lalaa tie ruo, Abyipata aa tlaw riypa hmang lie dyi khana myirue panaana pihluo'a ung cate, kama ta bie ica pipa yi bangkhuo kha nama tue aa.

Cuorasala Abyipanama Khazing ta thluechiy aca pipa hne yi ta aa ziy pata khaapa khy lie a cuo zaw nama khing ning thiy khata saa ca thie ung la ning tie ung; sakhiy hne sasuv saa nama cepa haa khata, a pathe lipa nama cuo zaw a pathepa nama cuo zaw ce tie ung.
Tuokhaata a cuo zaw a thiy ca ning'a va ung ciy; tiy haa khata alyi luo kha nama lyi pathla aa.

Nama sa, nama mingsuvtiy hne nama chiytiy chehraachekha, nama sahring hne nama tuvrung ta a pachuo taapa sa-uvthyi zaw, biekuona ta nama pipa nama lasaw zaw, nama lungthe panaana zaw acuolikie nama lungthe pina zaw kha nama khy lieta ning'a va ung ciy;

Abyipanama Khazing ta aa tlaw riypa hmang lieta, ama hmiekunglie khana nama hne na sacapaa na sacanung, na siicapaa na siicanung zaw, nama khy lie khy a sapa Levi ming zaw hne kha tana Abyipanama Khazing hmiekunglie kha a lawsa pata nama ning aa.
Nama ruo lie nama aw chung bangkhuo Levi ming kha hnangchaw li riypata a raaring tie ung.
Abyipanama Khazing ta niema kha bie aca kuopa haa yi ta nama ruo kha nama paku tiyta hne saa nama ce khing nakawta, “Saa na i ce aa,” nama ta tiyta saa kha nama khing zaa ta ce tie ung.

Abyipanama Khazing ta a ming china riypata aa tlaw riypa hmang ca niema hne aa hla tuv kieca, Abyipata aca pipa yi nama sahring hne tuvrung chung taa khata bie ica pipa haa yi khata thie ung la nama khy chunglie kha nama khing cuo ning khata ning tie ung.
Hmisi ta ripa kieca, sakhiy hne sasuv saa nama cepa haa kha tana nama ce aa, a pathe lipa hne a pathepa hneta aa lu pata nama ce aa.
A thiy kha ca ning hrahring'a va ung ciy; tahematapakieca thiy ca hringna tana a cuo, hringna ca saa hneta ce'a va ung ciy.
Ning'a va ung ciy, tiy haa kha tana alyi luo nama lyi aa.
Ning'a va ung ciy, tahematapakieca Abyipahmungna lie kha hmang phapa na tue nakawta nama hne na hnang taata a vawpa na saata zaw cuota aa raw aa pusa aa.
Cuorasala nama pipa a pathepa lungthe pina, biekuona ta nama pipa lasaw zaw kha ca Abyipata aa tlaw riypa hmang luo khana nama vya cyi aa.

Nama myirue panaana zaw, a saa hne a thiy hne khata Abyipanama Khazing bienatluophie lie kha nama pihluo aa; a hrangpa nama hriykhungrinapa thiy kha ca Abyipanama Khazing bienatluophie athaalie kha nama lyi aa, cuorasala a saa kha ca nama ning aa.

Tahematapakieca Abyipanama Khazing hmungna lie kha hmang phapa nama tue nakawta nama hne na hnang taata a vawpa na saata zaw cuota a pha riypata ataning ica pipa yi bie bangkhuo hing a raaringsa pata nama ziy aa.
Phya riypata namaa ngiechiypa mingphang tie ca nama hmiekunglie kha Abyipanama Khazing ta sa pachung diy yi te, iema kha phya ung cate ama ruo lie nama aw tiyta,

iema haa kha la pata cyihyi lie namaa uo li riypa kha a raaring tie ung. “Hingpa mingphang tie hingta ama khazing kha tuokhaatama amaa bie? Kama zaw iema haa tana i tue ra khing,” ta pata ama khazing kaw kha khieluo lie ung ciy.

Abyipanama Khazing cunglie kha iema haata tue'a va ung ciy, tahematapakieca Abyipata a huepa a pyalyipa hmang khana ama khazing cuota ama tue. Ama sacapaa hne ama sacanung tie kha hmuo ama khazing tie cuota myi ta a ruepa tana ama cuo.
Kama ta ica pipa yi bie khana a phasa pata nama ziy aa; chachiy'a va ung ciy, suokha hmuo thaw buo'a va ung ciy.
Profet tie acuolikie muo a sapa tie kha niema hrawlie aw yi te, pamangsana hne kharuehaa hmang kha bie caa kuo yi te,
ama ripa pamangsana hne kharuehaa hmang kha vya tling te, iema ta, “khazing hrangpa tie (nama pachang buo lipa khazing tie) kha ziy ung sala iema re kha hrie ung siy,” aca ta tiy yi ta,

capa profet tie hne muo a sapa tie bie kha naathlie'a va ung ciy; tahematapakieca Abyipanama Khazing kha pathiypalung yalya hne nama ruena yalya ta nama due ma due va ung ca ma tapa kha pachang riypa tana Abyipanama Khazing ta aca dyapasya yi.
Abyipanama Khazing kha ziy'a ung cate, ama pakha kyalya dyi kha nama ciyzaa aa, a nawbie kha ziy'a ung cate, a ueryi kha nama naathlie aa, ama re kha hrie'a ung cate, ama kha namaa patuv karue aa.

Cuorasala capa profet tie hne muo a sapa tie ca thie pata ama cuo aa, tahematapakieca Izipt ruo sii nama cuonapa taata caa thla yi te caa vya pyakhyipa yi Abyipanama Khazing kha a du pata ama ta ziy riypata bie aca pipa yi luopuv taata pie riypata caa dyapasyatuv tana ama cuo. Caacuonakawta niema hraw taa khata pha lina ca nama pathe sa aa.

Na uvnu, na paa sacapaa acuolikie na nung sacapaa, na sacapaa acuolikie na sacanung, na duepa na napuv, naa ngie cepa na viesaa, tapa tie pakhakha ta a paruvta tah ca ripasa yi te, niema acuolikie nama mingchingmingvuo tie ta nama za pachang buo lipa khazing tie,

niema cahriy cake lie a awpa tuokhaapa cawsaa tie khazing a cuo zaw, niema hne aa ngiena lie a awpa acuolikie aa hlana lie a awpa a cuo zaw, chuelyi kiy kha taata kiy kha luo a awpa a cuo zaw, “Khazing hrangpa tie kha abie'a ung puv,” aca ta kie yi ca,
cahaapa cawsaa tie ta aca changpa yi ca na naa zaw tla li pata a bie zaw naathlie'a vaciy. Iema cunglie ngiechina hne kawpacuona hnyi'a vaciy, a daakhuo'a va yi ciy.
Cuorasala iema kha na thie hrahring'a yi; iema thie riypata a kuv a pathla taapa cuo la cakhutaata cawsaa hrangpa bangkhuo kuv ta capa ziy se.
Izipt ruo, siicuona ing taata caa pyakhyipa yi Abyipanama Khazing kha nama piese riypata amaa zue nakawta iema ca alung ta nama vaasa aa.
Cakhutaata Israel ming bangkhuo khata thyi'a yi te, kha haapa hmang pha lipa kha tue'a va tli yi.
Abyipanama Khazing ta nama awna riypata aca pipa yi khy, khy kha lalaa lie kha,

niema hrawtaata cawsaa pha lipa tie ta khy chunglie a awpa tie'a luo kha cakuo yi te nama pachang lipa khazing tie kha abie riypata, “Cakuo ung sala khazing hrangpa tie kha abie ung siy,” ama tapa kha nama thyi kieca,
a phasa pata khieluo ung la hiehriy tie ung. Cahaapa duv aa chiypa hmang ca niema hrawlie ama tuepa kha paciepa a cuo kieca,
capa khy lie a awpa tie kha zueziy ta nama thie aa, a khy hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo kha para diy karue'a ung cate, ama sahring kha hmuo zueziy ta nama thie diy aa.

Hruosue bangkhuo kha khypuv ahmyana hmang lie kha papung'a ung cate, cakhutaa cata a khy hne a hruosue bangkhuo kha myi ta rue'a ung cate, papungpa myirue panaana ta Abyipanama Khazing kha nama pihluo aa. Capa khy ca chuozaa ta a ra yalya khata a aw aa, sa pakhaa pata cuo'a va tli.

Para riypata pi ciepa hmang suokha hmuo nama kuv ta taw'a va ung ciy. Ataning kama ta bie ica pipa yi haata a nawbie bangkhuo hing ziy pata Abyipanama Khazing ueryi kha naathlie ung cate, Abyipanama Khazing ming hmungna lie hmang phapa kha nama hrie kieca, Abyipata a ie ta a iepa a hihaana kha niema'a taata maa'a te, nama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie chie aa sapa haa khata, kawpacuona ca hnyi'a yi te aca papungzaa sa'a yi.
Niema ca Abyipanama Khazing saata tana nama cuo. Athiypa cuota nama ngesaa kha a uo'a va ung ciy, nama lakiy suo zaw a ngu'a va ung ciy.
Tahematapakieca niema ca Abyipanama Khazing cuota a pathepa mingphang tana nama cuo; a huopa cuo riypata, alyi cunglie a awpa mingphang zaw hrawtaata Abyipata aa tlawpa tana nama cuo.
Duv aa chiypa khaapa sa hmuo ning'a va ung ciy.
Hingpa tie hing nama ning riypa saruopa ta ama cuo: cue, tuv, mie,
sasuv, sakhiy, saazaa, sathaa, ruocaa sathaa, atuv sakhiy, hne tluocung tuv.
A caki a che te caki ki hning a hnyipa, a sa a pakaapa saruopa tie kha nama ning aa.
Cuorasala a sa pakaa te a caki a chepa tie lieta kala-uv, savi hne lungkuo savi ca ning'a va ung ciy, tahematapakieca sa ama pakaa raalaa pata ama caki a che vyi; a pathe lipa tana ama cuo.
Cakhutaata va, a caki aa che raalaa pata a sa pakaa vyi, nama cuota a pathe lipa tana a cuo. A saa kha ning'a va ung ciy, a thiy ciepa a pangpa zaw kha taw'a va ung ciy.
Tiy chunglie a awpa zaw bangkhuo hrawlieta hingpa tie hing nama ning aa: mathlaa hne phuvhling a hnyipa ngaa kha nama ning aa.
Mathlaa hne phuvhling a hnyi lipa ngaa kha ning'a va ung ciy.
A pathepa pavaa kha nama ning aa.
Cuorasala hingpa tie hing ca ning'a va ung ciy: hmungthlu, luotaa, thluruo,
hmungchiy, pahmung phangting,
ra-aa phangting;
kala-uvpavaa, zuohmungthlu, riyliypavaa, hmungthlu phangting;
buobary, tutaru, tiy aa,
ruocaatutaru, sathuvluotaa, tiypuvvaapung,
aathlaruo, tiypavaa phangting, cuovuolyithuvpa, hne bahla.
A mathlaa ta a zupa hninghnaa khawbya phang bangkhuo ca niema cuota pathe vyi; capa tie ca ning'a va ung ciy.
A mathlaa a hnyipa a pathepa phang bangkhuo ca nama ning aa.

Ama thiy ta a thiypa bangkhuo ning'a va ung ciy; nama khy lie khy a sapa mingpe tie khana nama pi aa, acuolikie ruohrang ming khana nama zaa aa. Tahematapakieca niema ca Abyipanama Khazing cuota a pathepa tana nama cuo. Mietaata kha a nung ahnungtiy ta pasu'a va ung ciy.
Kung tating ta nama lu taata a vyipa sa chehraachekha kha a nanang ta nama chi aa.

Abyipanama Khazing kha nama ciyzaa the pari riypata, nama sa chehraachekha, nama mingsuvtiy, nama chiytiy, nama sahring hne nama tuvrung taata a pachuo taapa sa-uvthyi tapa tie kha, Abyipanama Khazing hmiekunglie, a ming awna riypata aa tlaw riypa hmang lie ca nama ning aa. Cahaacata Abyipa nama Khazing kha cipari ta nama ciyzaa the aa.
Abyipanama Khazing ta thluechiy aca pi tiy yi ta, Abyipanama Khazing ta a ming awna riypata aa tlaw riypa hmang ca aa hla tuv nakawta nama phyale khu li kieca,
tuokaa ta nama pali aa. Tuokaa kha a phyale'a ung cate, Abyipanama Khazing ta aa tlaw riypa hmang luo kha nama si aa;

cuetungpa, tuv, mingsuvtiy, mingsuv sahmaa, acuolikie nama khingpa khaapa a cuo zaw calyina ta nama tuokaa kha nama hmuo aa. Abyipanama Khazing hmiekunglie, capa lie ca ning'a ung cate, niema hne nama ingchungkhue hneta namaa nuo pakhaw aa.
Nama khy chunglie a awpa Levi ming kha hnangchaw'a va ung ciy, tahematapakieca iema ca niema'a lieta cuvu hne ru hnyi va yi.
Kung thungna kyry ta, capa kung lie nama pavyipa sa chehraachekha bangkhuo kha vya chiykhyi'a ung cate, nama khy lie kha nama raw aa;

Abyipanama Khazing ta nama hriepa re bangkhuo lie thluechiy aca pi riypa yi ta, Levi ming, iema ca niema hneta cuvu hne ru ama hnyi li nakawta, mingpe, haaraa, nama khy chunglie a awpa nunghlyi zaw kha a vaw'a yi te ama riy bina te ta ama ning aa.
A kung sariyna kyry ta lyibuo angiethena kha nama tue aa.

Angiethenazya ca hing haa hingta a cuo aa: Ducyi a pituv ahung a cuo zaw a ingpaa ta aa awkhyipa ducyi kha aa ngiethe aa, a phang kha a cuopa a ingpaa tie kha lyibuo hie'a va yi, tahematapakieca Abyipaangiethena ca pathyi sapa a cuo tli.
Ruohrang ming ca lyibuo nama hie aa, cuorasala nama phang kha cawsaa a cuopa ta acaa uopa yi kha ca hie'a va ung ciy.
Niema hrawlie aa phahlapa pakha hmuo aw'a va ung ciy, tahematapakieca Abyipanama Khazing ta ru ta nama cu riypata aca pipa yi ruo chunglie kha thluechiy aca pi hrahring'a yi,
kama ta ica pipa yi nawbie bangkhuo hing a phasa pata ziy ung cate Abyipanama Khazing kha nama pa-uvsathyi kieca.

Ama ta bie aca kuopa haa yi ta, Abyipanama Khazing ta thluechiy aca pi tiy yi ta, mingphang hluvpuv kha ducyi nama pi aa, cuorasala niema ca ducyi a lapa cuo'a va ung ciy; mingphang hluvpuv kha uv'a ung cate, cuorasala iema ta niema kha ca uv'a va yi.

Abyipanama Khazing ta aca pipa yi ruo chunglie, nama khy khy kha lalaa lie kha, nama hrawlie nama phang kha cawsaa aa phahlapa pakhakha a aw kieca, nama palung ingchiy khaa khuo li pata nama kuv zaw cahuv khuo'a va ung ciy.
Nama kuv kha pakepa hriy'a ung cate, khaapa a cuo zaw, aa hupa aa dena zaa khata ducyi nama pi aa.

“Kung sariyna, ducyi a ngiethena kung na a ngie tli,” ta pata nama rue li riypa kha a raaring tie ung; cahaacata rue ung cate, aa phahlapa nama ingpaa kha mang khing li pata khaapahmuo nama pi li kieca, nama ingpaa kha ta niema kawlieta Abyipakha u'a te, niema cuota suena ta a cuo aa.
Nama pi tiy zaw ta pahyasana hne palungthusa pata pi tie ung, hingpa kawlie hingta Abyipanama Khazing ta nama re bangkhuo hne nama hriepa bangkhuo lie thluechiy aca pi'a yi.
Phahlapa tie ca alyi lie hing ama aw pari'a nakawta, kama ta, “Nama ruo chunglie a awpa siypasa hne phahlapa nama ingpaa cuo khata nama kuv pakepa tie ung,” ta pata bie ica pi yi.
Nama phang kha cawsaa pakha, Hebru capaa acuolikie Hebru canung pakhakha ca zaa yi te, nama cuota kung caruv re a hrie kieca, a kung sariyna lie ca nama palaw sa aa.
Cakhutaata nama palaw sa ning kha a kuv cahri pata pathlie'a va ung ciy.
Nama tuvrung chungtaata cuose, nama suo-aciyna taata hne nama mingsuv nawna taa khata cuose, Abyipanama Khazing ta thluechiy aca pipa yi haa khata pahyasa pata pi tie ung.
Niema ca Izipt ruo lie sii ta nama cuopa hne, Abyipanama Khazing ta aca khuopa yi kha a thyi pari tie ung, capa kawlie ca tana hingpa bie hing ica pi yi.
Cuorasala ama ta, niema nama ingchungkhue kha ca due yi te, niema'a lie a ngie aa raw nakawta, “Niema'a taa hingta pya khing va ang,” aca ta kie yi ca,
thaa sungtiy kha a la ung la ingchiypakaa lie kha a naakhue nama vaa khutaata ama ca chuozaa ta nama sii a cuo aa. Nama siicanung cunglie zaw kha cahaa ngiethie cata nama tue aa.

Niema'a taata palaw sa ung cate nama pathlie tiyta, a ruvsa pata rue khah ung, tahematapakieca kung caruv chung bangkhuo a hluopa rehrietuv haata nama re kha ama hrie mangtli, Abyipanama Khazing na nama tuepa bangkhuo cunglie thluechiy caa pi'a yi.

Nama cue hne nama tuv ta ama pachuo taapa sahrangta a capaa bangkhuo ca Abyipanama Khazing'a luona nama pihluo aa; sahrangta cuetungpa ta re hrie'a va ung ciy, nama tuv sahrangta a capaa kha a hming ngu'a va ung ciy.
Abyipata aa tlaw riypa hmang, Abyipanama Khazing hmiekunglie kha niema hne nama ingchungkhue tie hne khata a kung tating ta nama ning hne aa.
Cuorasala a du a tla li kieca, a phyi a cabie, acuolikie a ming a cue kieca, capa ca ta Abyipanama Khazing'a lie kha hriykhung a ri'a va ung ciy.
Nama khy chunglie khana nama ning aa, a pathepa ta cuose, a pathe lipa ta cuose, sakhiy hne sasuv nama ningpa haa khata nama ning aa.
Tuokhaata a cuo zaw ta a thiy ca ning'a va ung ciy; alyi luo khana tiy haa khata nama lyi aa.
Abyipanama Khazing cuota lawsena pyi kha tue ung la Abib thlaa kha a uv tie ung, tahematapakieca Abib thlaa liena Abyipanama Khazing ta zuo ta aca vya pyakhyi yi.
Abyipata a ming awna riypata aa tlaw riypa hmang lie kha nama cue chungtaata cuose, nama tuv chungtaata cuose Abyipanama Khazing kha lawsena hriykhungrina kha pihluo tie ung.

Lawsena hriykhungrina saa kha thiynung phuvpa viechuo hneta ning hne'a va ung ciy. Ning sariy chung ca thiynung phuv lipa viechuo, te-angna viechuo hne kha tana nama ning aa, tahematapakieca a pahraasa pata na Izipt ruo chung taa khata nama vya pya, caacuonakawta Izipt ruo taata nama vya pyanapa ningkhue kha nama chuo chung bangkhuo namaa thyi pari aa.
Ning sariy chung, nama ruo chunglie kha thiynung phuvpa viechuo hmungpa cuo khah se; a ning khana zuoluo ta nama thiepa saa suokha hmuo mawluo maw te ta a ngaa khah se.
Abyipanama Khazing ta aca pipa yi khaapa khy lie hmuo lawsena hriykhungrina tue riypata pa-awpa cuo va ung ciy.
Cuorasala Abyipanama Khazing ta a ming awna riypata aa tlawpa hmang lie kyalya dyi khana zuoluo ningtla cuo, Izipt taata nama vya pyanapa cuo lie kha lawsena hriykhungrina kha nama pihluo aa.
Abyipanama Khazing ta aa tlaw riypa hmang lie khana chang'a ung cate nama ning aa; a mawluo maw ta nama thluodaa luo kha nama kaa aa.
Ning caruv chung kha aa pazue pata thiynung phuv lipa viechuo kha nama ning aa, ning sariyna lie kha Abyipanama Khazing cuota a pathepa apungna tue'a ung cate, re hrie'a va ung ciy.
Sa hrie nama pathu ning taata zaa sariy te kha nama ri aa.
Cakhutaata Abyipanama Khazing cuota ningzaa pyi kha nama tue aa, Abyipanama Khazing'a taata nama hmungpa thluechiy hne aa ziy pata lungthe panaana kha nama pihluo aa.

Abyipanama Khazing ta a ming awna riypata aa tlaw riypa hmang lieta, Abyipahmiekunglie kha, niema hne nama sacanung nama sacapaa zaw, nama siicanung nama siicapaa zaw, nama khy lie a awpa Levi ming zaw, khyche zaw, haaraa zaw, niema hrawlie a awpa nunghlyi zaw hne khata namaa nuo aa.
Izipt ruo lie sii nama za cuopa kha a thyi ung la hingpa phungluo tie hing a phasa pata ziy tie ung.
Nama suo-aciyna taata hne nama mingsuv nawna taata nama hmungpa kha nama pahmya diy khutaata Thluodaa Pyi ca ning sariy chung nama tue aa.

Nama hne na sacapaa zaw na sacanung zaw, na siicanung hne na siicapaa zaw, Levi ming zaw, khyche ming zaw, haaraa tie zaw, nama khy lie a awpa nunghlyi tie zaw hne kha ta nama pyi lie ca a nuo tie ung.

Abyipata aa tlaw riypa hmang lie kha, Abyipanama Khazing cuota ning sariy chung kha pyi nama tue aa; Abyipanama Khazing ta nama chiykhyipa hmang bangkhuo hne nama hriepa re bangkhuo lie thluechiy ca pi'a yi te, nama palung a tluosa aa.

Niema chungtaata capaa bangkhuo ta, Abyipanama Khazing aa tlaw riypa hmang lie, Khazing hmiekung luo kha kung kha ta yi thung namaa luo aa: thiynung phuv lipa viechuo pyi, ningzaa pyi, thluodaa pyi ning zaw ta a cuo aa. Abyipahmiekung luo kha ama kuv cahri pata cakuo'a va yi;
Abyipanama Khazing aca pipa yi thluechiy hne aa ziy pata ama bangkhuo ta ama pi khu thiy ta ama pi aa.
Abyipanama Khazing ta aca pipa yi nama khy bangkhuo lie kha nama phang chungtaata bieripatuv byi hne uvtuv tie kha chi'a ung cate, iema ta cawsaa kha aa dangta tah bie ama ripa aa.
Biedangpa kha para'a va ung ciy; akuo ta a daa'a va ung ciy; nawthuv ning'a va ung ciy, tahematapakieca nawthuv ta mingsing tie ming kha pacue te aa dangpa tie bie kha a pali a pahnaa ta a tue taw.
Biedangpa, biedangpa kyalya kha huv tie ung, cata a cuo kieca hring'a ung cate Abyipanama Khazing ta aca pipa yi ruo kha nama cu aa.
Abyipanama Khazing cuota nama sapa bienathluodaa athaalie kha tuokhaapa thingkungpa hmuo Asherah tung cuo riypata a ling'a va ung ciy,
lungbang zaw bang'a va ung ciy. Abyipanama Khazing ta a huepa tana a cuo.
Abyipanama Khazing kha cuetungpa a cuo zaw, tuv a cuo zaw a dutla lipa ta hriykhungrina pihluo'a va ung ciy; tahematapakieca Abyipanama Khazing cuota duv aa chiypa tana a cuo.
Abyipanama Khazing ta aca pipa yi khy khy kha lalaa lieta Abyipanama Khazing hmungna lie kha niema hrawlie canung pakha acuolikie capaa pakhakha ta,
ning acuolikie thlaapa acuolikie kama ta i thlupa avuo aasiy suokha lalaa kha abie te a re a hrie kie cuose,
cahaacata a tuepa kha ca chang yi te nama thyi kie cuose, a phasa pata hiehriy'a ung cate bie nama pacie aa. Israel ming chunglieta cahaapa duv aa chiypa hmang a aw hmisipa kha pacu sapa a cuo kieca,
cahaapa hmang pha lipa a tuepa capaa acuolikie canung ca nama hukaa luo kha pyakhyi'a ung cate a thiyna te ta alung ta nama vaa sa aa.
Thie riypata biechina ca pachangkhyituv pahning acuolikie pathung aw pata tuepa a cuo aa; pachangkhyituv pakha dyi bie ta cawsaa pakha kha thie pata cuo'a vyi.
Thie riypa cawsaa pakha cunglie a kuv a pathla taapa ca pachangkhyituv ta cuo'a te, cakhutaata cawsaa bangkhuo ta kuv pathliepa a cuo aa. Cahaacata niema hrawtaata pha lina kha nama pathe sa aa.

Cawsaa thiyse palangna bie lie hne a hrangpa bie lie cuose, cuvu hmung khingna kawlie hne a hrangpa kawlie cuose, a tuv a dena kawlie hne a hrangpa kawlie cuose, nama khy chunglieta a hrangpa cahaapa a hru a ina kawlieta biechi riypa kha nama cuota a ruv tuv pata a cuo kieca, sungkha ta thu ung la Abyipanama Khazing ta aa tlaw riypa hmang luo kha cakuo tie ung.
Capa hmang lie ca capa ning lie zung a kiepa Levi tluobyi tie hne bieripatuv tie zaw hne khata patla pakhaw'a ung cate, capa bie kawlieta biechina ca iema ta niema'a luo kha aca pathyi sa'a yi.
Abyipata aa tlaw riypa hmang lie iema ta aca pathyi sapa yi biechina kha ama china dadang kha ta nama tue aa, iema ta aca changpa haa yi khata a phasa pata nama tue aa.

Niema cuota phungbie haata ama biechina hne aca pathyisapa yi uvna phung kha a phasa pata ziy'a ung cate, niema'a lie aca pathyisapa yi biechina kha cavyi cacuo ta maa pata a pali a pahnaa ta tue'a va ung ciy.
Abyipanama Khazing re hrie riypata re nama pipa tluobyi acuolikie bieripatuv byi ri kha a ngie lipa cawsaa ca thie pata a cuo aa. Cahaacata pha lina kha Israel ming'a taata nama pathe sa aa.
Cawsaa bangkhuo kha ta thyi'a yi te ama ciy aa, hruohra ta tue pakhaa nguo'a va tli yi.

Abyipanama Khazing ta aca pipa yi ruo chung luo kha a ngie ung cate, cu ung cate a chunglie nama aw tiyta, “Kiema athaalie a awpa mingphang bangkhuo haa hing tana ma cunglie siepahruo ma chi aa,” nama ta.

Abyipanama Khazing ta aa tlaw riypa cawsaa ca nama cunglie siepahruo ta nama chi hmisi aa. Nama phang kha cawsaa chungtaata pakha kha niema cunglie siepahruo ta nama chi aa, niema uvnu ta a cuo lipa ruohrang ming kha nama cunglie siepahruo pacuo sa'a va ung ciy.

Siepahruo ca aruo a hluvsa hnyi riypa kha a zue khah se, acuolikie aruo a hluvsa hmung riypata cawsaa kha Izipt luo pakaa sa khah yi se, tahematapakieca Abyipata, “Niema ca khapa luopuv luo kha khatiy tahmuo kaa'a va ung ciy,” aca ta yi.
Cakhutaata napuv zaw kha a hluvsa huv khah se, a palung na a vievuv pathlyi aa; siy hne ngu a hluvsa zaw kha ama cuota huv khah se.
A pena byithude lie aa tu tiyta, Levi tluobyi tie hmiekung phungbie caa-uv taata ama patlawpa phungbie caa-uv suokha kha a hnyi aa.

Capa phungbie caa-uv ca Abyipaa Khazing kha a ciy thena riypa hne capa phungbie hne phungluo zaw kha a phasa pata a ziy thena riypata ama'a lie chi pari'a te a chuo chung bangkhuo, ningting ta a ri aa.

Ama hne a ciypathla tie zaw Israel ruo chung a pena lie kha chuo pasiypuv siepahruo ama cuo the riypata a phang kha cawsaa cunglie kha ama hne ama a cyicalang'a vyi, nawbie taa khata cacuoluo acuolikie cavyiluo pie'a vyi.
Levi tluobyi tie, Levi phang yalya ta Israel ming hrawlie cuvu hne ru hnyi'a va yi. Hriykhungrinapa Abyipacuvu khana ama ning aa.
Ama phang kha uvnu tie hrawlie ru hnyi'a va yi; ama ta bie a kuopa haa yi ta, Abyipakhana ama ru ta a cuo aa.
Hriykhungrina a pihluopa cawsaa tie'a taata tluobyi tie ta ama hmung riypa ca, cuetungpa a cuo zaw, tuv a cuo zaw, tluobyi tie ta ama cu riypa ca: a pale, a hrakuo vyicuo, a pavawpuv zaw ta a cuo aa.
Nama la taapa sa chungtaata sathaapa, nama mingsuvtiy, nama chiytiy, nama ngu taapa tuvhming tapa tie kha nama pi aa.
Tahematapakieca Abyipana Khazing ta Abyipaming ta a daa pata a re hrie riypata Levi hne a sacapaa zaw ca nama phang bangkhuo chung taa khata aa tlaw tli yi.
Levi ming pakha ca Israel ruo chung a awnapa khy suokhakha taata pya te, Abyipata aa tlaw riypa hmang luo aa vaw kieca (a khing thathiynapa khaapa luo a cuo zaw),
capa lie, Abyipahmiekunglie kha a daa'a yi te a re a hriepa a viesaa Levi ming haa khata Abyipaa Khazing ming ta re a hrie aa.
Chungkhue hnyipa hmang zaana muo tuokaa ama hnyi zawta, ning riypa kha aa khing aa nguo pata ama hmung aa.
Abyipanama Khazing ta aca pipa yi ruo nama chiy tiyta capa ruo lie a awpa mingphang tie ta ama tuepa duv aa chiypa kha haa la pata a cuv'a va ung ciy.
Niema chungtaata a sacapaa acuolikie a sacanung kha myi ta a pihluopa pakha hmuo hmung pata cuo khah se, acuolikie hmungdawlutuv tie, ridawlutuv tie, acuolikie kuvcaa a mangpa, ca-ie a thepa,
pacue a thepa, khuevuo a chaw thepa, athiy a tlawpa pakha hmuo hmung pata cuo khah se.
Tahematapakieca cahaapa hmang a tuepa ca Abyipata a duvpa tana ama cuo; cahaapa, duv aa chiypa hmang ama tue nakaw kha tana Abyipanama Khazing ta nama hmiekung taata aa cade yi.
Niema ca Abyipanama Khazing hmiekunglie kha zang tluo aa tla karue pata nama hring aa.
Nama va phya riypa mingphang tie hing ca ridawlutuv tie hne hmungdawlutuv tie bie kha a naathliepa cuo yi te, cuorasala niema ca Abyipanama Khazing ta cahaacata tue riypa kha ca khing va yi.
Abyipana Khazing ta na cawsaa zaw chung taa hingta kama haapa profet pakha papuv sa'a te, capa profet bie ca nama naathlie aa.

Horeb tluo lie a pung ningta “Abyipai Khazing ueryi hingna i thyi vie, acuolikie myi lepuv hingna i hmung pakhaa ta pata a cuo kieca, i thiy aa,” ta pata Abyipanama Khazing'a luo nama za hiepa khata a cuo.
Cakhutaata Abyipata kama kha na palie te, “Ama ripa ca aa hmuo.
Kama ta iema huota nama haapa profet pakha padaa'a angte, i bie kha a pakaa lieta i chi aa, kama biepipa bangkhuo kha ama ta iema kha a chang'a yi.
Profet ta kama ming ta a ri riypa bie kha a naathlie lipa ca, kama hrahring ta bie i hiehriy aa.
Cuorasala khazing hrangpa tie ming ta bie a ripa profet, acuolikie ri riypata bie i pi li pata a cuo thlu aa ta pata i ming ta bie a ripa profet, cahaapa profet ca a thiy aa,” ina ta.
Niema ta, “Abyipata a ripa hne a ri lipa ca tuokhaatama ma pachang khu aa? nama ta aa.

Profet pakha ta Abyipaming ta bie ri biephung te, cuorasala a ripa ca tling li pata a vya cuo sasaw li kieca, capa ca Abyiparipa bie ta cuo vyi. Profet ta riepha tuv pata a ripa tana a cuo; ciy khah ung.
Abyipanama Khazing ta aca pipa yi ruo lie a awpa mingphang tie kha Abyipanama Khazing ta thaw yi te, niema ta iema kha phya ung cate ama khy lie hne ama ing lie kha nama aw tiyta,
Abyipanama Khazing ta cu riypata aca pipa yi ruo chunglieta khypuv suothung kha a nanang ta nama chi aa.
Cawsaa a thiepa pakha ta capa khy khy kha lalaa luo kha aa ruo the riypata, Abyipanama Khazing ta nama cu riypata aca pipa yi ruo kha che thung ta che ung la luopuv zaw kha sa tie ung.
Cawsaa pahning ca zaa huenapa khaapahmuo aw li pata, a ting li pata cawsaa pakha ta a hrangpa pakha kha thie pathlyi te, capa luo ca aa ruo kieca a hring aa.

Cawsaa pakha ca a hrangpa pakha hneta thing hu riypata ruo luo kha si yi te, thing a hu nguoluo pata ahryi thaa ca ahryi haa taata tling te a hrangpa pakha kha va khe te a thiy kieca, cawsaa a thietuvpa ca capa khy suokha lalaa luo kha a ruo'a te a hring aa.

Cuorasala zaa huenapa aw li pata a thie pathlyipa ca, thie hriy riypata aa phuv li raalaa pata, luopuv kha aa hla tuv nakawta, thiyse phuvlatuv ta hi haa tuv pata cawsaa a thiepa paa ca a cade te thie te a thiy aa.
Caacuonakaw tana khypuv suothung kha a nanang ta chi riypata bie ica pi yi.
Abyipanama Khazing ta nama mingchingmingvuo tie pi riypata bie aa kuopa ruo bangkhuo kha niema ca pi yi te, nama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie chie aa sapa haata nama ruoriy kha a paku kieca,

Abyipanama Khazing kha due ung cate a luopuv kha cipari ziy ung cate, ataning kama ta ica pipa yi nawbie bangkhuo hing a phasa pata nama ziy kieca, hingpa khy thung lie hing a hrangpa khy thung nama cha chiy aa.
Abyipanama Khazing ta ru ta aca pipa yi ruo chunglie a sue lipa thiyse palangpa a cuo li riypa hne nama cunglie thiyse suena a tlung li riypata a cuo.
Cuorasala cawsaa pakha ta a hrangpa pakha kha hue te, a bawkhuo te tuv te a thiy nakawta capa khy khy kha lalaa luo kha aa ruo kieca,
cawsaa a thietuv khy taata uvthyi tie khata cawsaa pathlie'a yi te, lie a nawpa kha capa taa cata la'a yi te, thiyse phuvlatuv kuv luo kha thie riypata ama pi aa.
Ama kha ngie chi khah; na cuo ta a pha riypata a sue lipa thiyse palangnapa suena kha na pathe sa aa.
Abyipanama Khazing ta cu riypata aca pipa yi ruo chunglie, nama cu riypata aca repa yi luruo lie, a hluo ning taata ama za caby ciepa nama ingpaa ruoriy kha hnyi'a va ung ciy.

Cawsaa pakhakha ta hmang pha lipa a tuena kawlie cuose, phung para pata a tuepa hne aa patuvpa suena kawlie cuose, bie chipa riypata tehte pakha dyi ta ca a de vyi. Tehte pahning acuolikie pathung ripasiena dyi tana pacu sa pata a cuo aa.
Huena a hnyipa tehte pakha ta cawsaa pakha kha hmang pha lipa tue a pachie kieca,
tazaa a cyipa phuv hning tie ca Abyipahmiekung luo, hne capa ningta zung lie a awpa tluobyi tie hne bieripatuv tie hmiekung luo kha vya chiy'a yi te,
bieripatuv khata a phasa pata hiehriypasiena a tue aa. Tehte ca a hangpa tehte ta cuo te, malie kha aa hmuo li pata a pachiepa tehte ta a cuo kieca,
malie cunglie tue aa tingpa haa khata a cunglie tue pata a cuo aa. Pha lina kha niema chungtaata nama pathe sa aa.
Aa ngaapa tie khata thyi'a yi te ama ciy aa, khapa haapa hmang pha lipa kha niema chungtaata khatiy tahmuo tue pakhaapa cuo'a va tli.
Ama kha ngie chi khah ungh: hringna cuota hringna, ming cuota ming, haa cuota haa, kuv cuota kuv, phyi cuota phyi ta a cuo aa.

Nama carie tie a du riypata pya ung cate, niema laata a hluv viepa rieka, aruo zaw, aruole zaw nama hmung tiyta ciy'a va ung ciy; tahematapakieca niema kha Izipt taata caa vya pyakhyipa yi Abyipanama Khazing na caa awpuo yi.
Rie tuv nama pathu hluota tluobyi ca rieka tie hmieluo kha vya pya'a te,
iema kyihuo khata, “Vya Israel, naathlie tie! Ataning hing niema ca rie tuv riypata carie tie kha nama vaa ngie tli. Nama palung caw khah se, ciy khah ung, a cathang khah ung, iema kha ciy khah ung;
tahematapakieca nama carie tie kha a du pata niema cuota rie tuv riypa hne niema kha tena pi riypata niema'a lie a sipa ca Abyipanama Khazing tana a cuo,” a ta'a yi.

Cakhutaata riebyi tie zaw khata rieka tie kyihuo khata, “Ing thaapa sa te a pihluo li liepa nama aw ma? Capa paa ca a ing luo kha kaa se, rietuvna hmang lie thiy'a tena cawsaa hrangpa ta ama pihluo pali aa.
Mingsuv diedung kha tue te a thyi a ning li liepa nama aw ma? Capa paa ca a ing luo kha kaa se, caacuolikieca rietuvna hmang lie thiy'a tena cawsaa hrangpa ta mingsuv thyi kha a ning pali aa.
Lesaa kha pahaa te a hlaw li liepa nama aw ma? Capa paa ca a ing luo kha kaa se, caacuolikieca rietuvna hmang lie thiy'a tena cawsaa hrangpa ta amaa hlaw pali aa.

Riebyi tie ta pazue yi te rieka tie kyihuo khata, “A ciypa acuolikie a palung a cawpa nama aw ma? Capa paa ca a ing luo kha kaa se, acuolikie ca a rieka viesaa tie palung zaw khana ama palung haata a caw ra pali aa,” ta yi se.
Riebyi tie ta rieka tie kha cahaacata ama chang khutaata riebyilepa ta iema ca rietuvna luo sikhyi yi se.
Niema ta khy khy kha kha a du riypata nama vaa ngie tiyta diena bie kha nama pathyi taa'a yi.
Capa khy ca ta diena bie nama pathyipa kha cuhluo yi te niema'a luo kha acaa pi kie yi ca, capa khy lieta a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo ca nama re hrietuv ta ama cuo aa.
Cuorasala nama'a luo kha a dieta tah caa pi li pata rie a caa du kie yi ca cadung'a ung cate,
Abyipanama Khazing ta nama kuv luo aca pi tiy yi ta capaa bangkhuo kha zueziy ta nama thie aa.

Tuokhaata a cuo zaw, khy chunglie a awpa canung tie, haatiy tie hne sahring, hne chechiy bangkhuo, hruosue bangkhuo kha namaa la aa, Abyipanama Khazing ta aca pipa yi nama carie tie taata hruosue kha nama khing thiy ta nama hmuo aa.
Hingpa lie a awpa mingphang tie khy ta a cuo lipa, niema hne aa hlasana lie a awpa khy bangkhuo kha cahaacata nama tue aa.
Cuorasala Abyipanama Khazing ta ru ta aca pipa yi, hingpa cawsaa tie khy lie hing ca a huv a sungpa khaapahmuo pa hring'a va ung ciy.
Hit ming hne Amor ming, Kanaan ming hne Periz ming, Hiv ming hne Jebus ming zaw kha ca Abyipanama Khazing ta bie aca pipa yi haa khata ama ciy na paming diy'a yi.
Tahematapakieca iema ta ama khazing cuota ama tuepa, duv aa chiypa bangkhuo kha aca pacuv li riypa yi hne niema ta Abyipanama Khazing'a lie nama sue li riypa kha tana a cuo.

Khy khy kha kha cuo pasiypuv cadung ung cate, la riypata rie namaa du kieca, a thingkung zaw kha hu'a va ung ciy. A thyi kha ning'a ung cate a kung kha hu'a va ung ciy. Lu chunglie thingkung ca cawsaa ta cuo yi te ma niema ta nama cadung aa?
A thyi pathyi vyi ta pata nama pachangpa thingkung tie kha ca nama hu khu, hu'a ung cate, niema hne rie a dupa khy ca aa sung hluo li, riekhuocaaca sana lie kha nama hmuo aa.
Abyipanama Khazing ta cu riypata aca pipa yi ruo chunglie, ruo lie kha cawsaa riyy ca laa thluo te, ahungma a thie tapa kha pachang li pata a cuo kieca,
nama uvthyi tie hne bieripatuv tie ca pya'a yi te, cawsaa riyy hne aa ngiepa khy kha khacuo ma aa hla ta pata ama taa aa.
Thiepa cawsaa hne aa ngie cepa khy taata uvthyi tie ta re a hrie buo li liepa, hne ruekhang zaw a rue lie khang buo li liepa cuelaanung sakha kha ama la aa,

capa khy lie uvthyi tie khata cuelaanung ca tiy a lang nguoluopa cavaata, alyi ama pali buo linapa hne ciy ama cyi buo linapa luo kha sikhyi'a yi te, capa cavaata lie ca cuelaanung kha a hning ama thli aa.

Cakhutaata tluobyi tie, Levi sacapaa zaw kha hmieluo ama vya pya aa, tahematapakieca Abyipanama Khazing ta iema ca ama re a hrie riypa hne Abyipaming ta thluechiy a pi riypata aa tlawpa ta cuo yi te, a i a chuena hne a tuv a dena bie bangkhuo ca iema bie tana bie chipa a cuo aa.
Cawsaa riyy hne aa ngie cepa khy taata uvthyi tie bangkhuo ca cavaata lie a rue ama thlipa cuelaanung cunglie kha ama kuv a siysue'a yi te,
iema ta, “Hingpa thiyse hing kiema kuv ta palang vyi, hingpa kawlie tehte zaw cuo vapuv”

Vya Abyipa, naa thlapa na cawsaa Israel ming ca a ngiethe tie yi; suena a hnyi lipa thiyse palangna suena ca na cawsaa Israel ming hrawlie hing pa-aw sa thi khah,” ama ta aa. Cakhutaata iema ca thiyse palang suena taata a ngiethepa ama cuo aa.
Cahaacata Abyipahmiekunglie ca aa hmuopa kha tue'a ung cate suena a hnyi lipa thiyse palangna suena niema hrawtaata na pathe aa.
Nama carie tie a du riypata si ung cate, Abyipanama Khazing ta nama kuv cung luo capi te cawsaa nama patuv tiyta,
hruocawsaa hrawlie a puvthesapa canung, tlechuo cate napuv riypata na khingpa kha na hmung biephung kieca,
na ing luo kha a chiyle'a cate, a luv kha a pamyi'a te, a pating kha aa te aa,

na patuv ningta aa hryipa a caw kha thaw'a cate, na ing chunglie kha thla kha bangpa aw'a te a nung hne a paa kha muochie a sa'a yi; cakhutaa cata a ziekhyi'a cate, a navaapa ta cuo'a cate na napuv ta a cuo aa.
Cuorasala ama cunglie kha na palung a tling li kieca, hyazangsa pata cakuo sa'a cate, tuokaa ta zaa'a vaciy. Sii haata a cunglie tue'a vaciy, a ling na pazue tli nakawta.
Capaa pakha ta napuv pahning hnyi te, pakha kha due te pakha kha due li pata, a duepa hne a due lipa hneta sacapaa sapa kaluo yi te, zaa puv taapa sacapaa ca a due lipa nung sacapaa ta a cuo kieca,
a sacapaa zaw kha ru a pi ning yi ta, a due lipa napuv sacapaa sa-uvthyi a cuopa kha pahlyipale pata a duepa napuv sacapaa kha, sa-uvthyi ta tue khu vyi.

A due lipa napuv sacapaa kha sa-uvthyi a cuonapa a paw pata, a hnyipa bangkhuo taa khata a cuvu kha vu hning ta a pi aa; tehematapakieca ama ca a thaazuo thyipaa taapa ta cuo te, sa-uvthyi cuona ca ama huopa tana a cuo.
Cawsaa pakha ta a palung a lepa hne a du a hmuopa, a paa hne a nung ri a ngie lipa sacapaa hnyi te, ama pasiypa-yapa kha aa ngie khing li kieca,
a nung hne a paa ta patuv'a yi te, ama khy uvthyi tie'a luo, ama awnapa khy thlake luo kha ama chiykhyi aa.
Ama khy uvthyi tie kyihuo khata, “Hingpa ma sacapaa hing a palung le te a du a hmuo. Ma ri malie a ngie vyi. A hrahruepa hne sahmaa a pariypa ta a cuo,” ama ta aa.
Cakhutaa cata khychung capaa bangkhuo ta alung ta ama vaa sa aa. Cahaacata niema hrawtaata pha lina kha nama pathe sa aa; Israel ming bangkhuo ta thyi'a yi te, ama ciy aa.
Thiy tluo aa tlapa suena a tuepa cawsaa pakha ca thie pata cuo te, thingkung cunglie pathlie pata a cuo tiyta,

a riyy kha zuokhydyi ta thingkung cunglie aw'a vyi; capa ning ca ta pabypa a cuo aa, tahematapakieca thingkung cunglie pathliepa pakha ca Khazing chiesana rawlie a awpa tana a cuo. Abyipanama Khazing ta cu riypata aca pipa yi ruo ca papyapalyi'a va ung ciy.
Na uvnu cuetungpa acuolikie tuv, luo a viepa kha na hmung kieca, a hnyituv'a luo khana naa vya chiy pakhaa aa.

A hnyituv ca naa thaalie a aw lipa acuolikie a hnyituv kha na pachang li kieca, na ing luo kha naa vya chiy aa, a hnyituv ta a vya padangna te ta nama'a lie kha na chi aa; cakhutaa cata na pi pakhaa aa.
Cahaacata na uvnu laa zaw kha na tue aa; cahaacata na uvnu pang zaw kha na tue aa; cahaacata na uvnu ta a paviepa chechiy na hmungpa kha na tue aa. A bya li pata aw'a vaciy.
Na uvnu laa acuolikie cuetungpa luopuv lie aa liepa kha na hmung kieca mangthluo'a vaciy; a pathu kha naa bya aa.
Canung ta capaa caw kha a hryi'a vyi, capaa zaw ta canung caw kha a hryi'a vyi; tahematapakieca cahaapa hmang a tuepa ca Abyipanama Khazing hmiekunglie duv aa chiypa tana a cuo.

Thingkungpa cunglie cuose, alyi lie cuose, pavaa buv hmung cate, a puvnung ta a changta cunglie aa bupa acuolikie a tiy cunglie a tlungpa kha na hmung kieca, a puvnung kha a changta hneta la hne'a vaciy.
A puvnung kha pazang'a cate a changta dyi kha nama huota naa la aa, cakiedyina na cuota pha'a te na hring a pasiy aa.
Ing thaapa na sa tiyta, na ingcung kha chungkhuo na tue aa; cahaacata na tue li kieca, na ingcung taata pakhakha tla pathlyi'a te, na ing lieta thiyse suena a tlung aa.
Na mingsuv dung chunglie ciycyi hrangpa cyi'a vaciy, caacuolikieca ciycyi hrangpa na cyipa hne mingsuv hne khata a vyipa bangkhuo ning a naapa tana ama cuo aa.
Cuetungpa hne laa kha ruekhang khang hne pata le thaw'a va ung ciy.
Saahming hne palaa pakhe pata taapa caw a tue'a va ung ciy.
Naa buvpa pang kiy kiy paliy lie kha a paapaapa na pathlie aa.
Capaa pakha ta canung pakha kha a hlaw te, cuorasala aa ziehne khutaata khing li tli pata,
“Hingpa canung hing napuv ta chiy angte i ziehne tiyta, lesaa pathenung a cuona hmung va ang,” ta pata a thuo a pachi biephung kieca,
lesaanung a paa hne a nung ta lesaa pathenung acuona paluosanapa kha khy uvthyi tie hmiekunglie, khy thlake lie kha ama chiykhyi aa.
Lesaanung a paa khata khy uvthyi tie kyihuo khata, “I sacanung ca hingpa paa hing napuv ta pi angte cuorasala ama ta hue pakhaa te,

‘Na sacanung hing lesaa pathenung acuona hmung va ang,’ ta pata a thuo a pachi. Cuorasala hingpa hing i sacanung lesaa pathenung a cuona paluosanapa tana a cuo,” a ta aa. Cakhutaata caw ca uvthyi tie hmiekunglie kha ama phaa aa.
Capa khy lie uvthyi tie ca ta cawsaapa paa kha duo ama te aa.

Tahematapakieca Israel lesaa pathenung a cuona kha a ling a pazue nakawta ngu shekel zakha duo ama te aa. Capa ca lesaanung a paa kha ama pi aa. Lesaanung ca a napuv a cuo yalya ta a aw aa, a hring chung bangkhuo ta ma khu'a vyi.
Tuokhaata a cuo zaw, capa bie ca a hmisipa ta cuo te, lesaanung a pathepa a cuona kha hmung lipa a cuo kieca,

lesaanung ca a paa ing thlake luo kha cakuokhyi'a yi te, a khy lie capaa tie khata a thiyna te ta alung ta ama vaa sa aa, tahematapakieca a paa ing lie kha siyhraw te Israel chunglie kha nangzaa aa chiypa hmang a tue tli. Caacuonakawta pha lina kha nama hrawtaata nama pathe aa.
Capaa pakha ta malie napuv aa ziekhyipa kha hmung pata a cuo kieca, ama pahning ta, canung a ziekhyipa paa hne canung hne cata, ama thiy aa. Cahaacata Israel chungtaata pha lina ca nama pathe aa.
Capaa pakha ta pahaa ciepa lesaa pathenung kha a khy lie kha hmung te aa ziekhyi kieca,

ama pahning khata khy thlake luo kha pyakhyi'a ung cate, ama thiyna te ta alung ta nama vaa aa, canung ta byana hie pata a khi li nakaw hne capaa ta a ingpaa napuv kha a para nakawta a cuo. Cahaacata niema hrawtaata pha lina ca nama pathe aa.
Cuorasala capaa ta pahaa ciepa canung kha ruo lie hmung te, patuv te aa ziekhyi kieca, ama a ziekhyipa capaa dyi khana a thiy aa.
Lesaanung cunglie kha khaapahmuo tue'a va ung ciy; lesaanung ta thiy aa phuvpa suena tue vyi, tahematapakieca hingpa hmang hing ca pakhakha ta a ingpaa kha tuv te a thiepa haa tana a cuo.
Capaa ta canung kha ruo lie va hmung te, byana hmung riypata canung ca a khi raalaa pata, a bya riypa aw va yi.
Capaa pakha ta pahaa li liepa lesaa pathenung pakha kha a taw te, patuv te aa ziekhyipa kha ama phaw kieca,

a ziekhyituv capaa khata lesaanung a paa kha ngu shekel sawngaa pi'a te lesaanung ca a napuv ta a cuo aa. Tahematapakieca ama ta lesaanung kha a para tli nakawta a hring chung bangkhuo ta ma khu'a vyi.
Cawsaa pakha ta a paa napuv kha napuv ta a tue'a vyi, a paa cuvu a parapa tana a cuo.
A tiy lupa hne a capaa cuona tepachungpa a cuopa ca Abyipacawsaazaapuv chunglie kha aw ra khu'a vyi.
Riesaa ta sapa ca Abyipacawsaa zaw ahmyana lie aw ra khu'a vyi. Chuo hraa te ta hmuo a ciypathla zaw kha Abyipacawsaa zaw ahmyana lie aw ra khu'a va yi.
Ammon ming cuose, Moab ming cuose, Abyipacawsaa zaw ahmyana lie kha aw ra khu'a va yi. Chuo hraa te ta hmuo ama ciypathla zaw kha Abyipacawsaa zaw ahmyana lie aw ra khu'a va yi;

tahematapakieca Izipt taata nama vya pya ning kha iema ta viechuo hne tiy kha a cyi pata caa vya hladaw va yi, Mesopotamia ruo Pethor khy lie a awpa Beor sacapaa Balaam kha niema chiesa riypata a muo pi yi te amaa hluo.
(Cuorasala Abyipanama Khazing ta Balaam bie kha naathlie vyi; tahematapakieca Abyipanama Khazing ta niema kha aca due nakaw yi ta, Abyipanama Khazing ta chiesana kha nama cuota thluechiy ta a pali).
Niema ta iema phana hne hnyirungna kha khatiy tahmuo tuepa'a va ung ciy.
Edom ming kha hue'a va ung ciy, tahematapakieca iema ca nama uvnu tana ama cuo. Izipt ming kha hue'a va ung ciy, tahematapakieca niema ca iema ruo lie khana mingpe ta nama za cuo.
Iema ta ama sapa saata chuo thungnapa ca Abyipacawsaa zaw ahmyana lie kha ama aw ra aa.
Carie tie a du riypata nama si tiyta, a pha lipa bangkhuo kha tue'a va ung ciy.
Niema chungtaata pakhakha ca a huopa taata zuo ta atiy pya te a pyalyi kieca, arina hmang ale luo kha a pya aa; arina hmang chung luo kha zaa ngie'a vyi.
Zuoluocaw khata tiy ta a siy'a te, ning a tla tiyta, arina hmang luo kha aa ngie aa.
Arina hmang ale lie kha hmang suokha hnyi'a ung cate, capa luo ca nama cakuo taw aa.
Nama chechiy zaw lie khata cungcaphuv suokha hnyi'a ung cate, nama pazung thue kha, capa ca ta khue cu'a ung cate, nama ii kha nama khaakhung siy aa.

Tahematapakieca Abyipanama Khazing ca niema kha khuo riypa hne nama carie tie kha nama kuv luo pi riypata namaa rina hmang lie kha aa khie nakawta nama hrawlie kha mang aa ngie lipa suokhakha hmung te niema'a taata a kaa li riypata namaa rina hmang ca pathe se.
A hnyituv tie'a taata niema'a luo a vya ruopa sii kha iema'a luo pakaa'a va ung ciy.
Nama khy khy kha lalaa lie ama khingna hmang amaa tlawpa lie kha, niema hrawlieta ama aw aa. Iema kha tuechie'a va ung ciy.
Israel sacanung pakha hmuo biena-ing siyhrawnung cuo'a va yi; Israel sacapaa pakha hmuo biena-ing siyhrawpaa cuo'a va yi.

Siyhrawnung ta cuose, siyhrawpaa ta cuose siyhraw muo ama hmungpa tuokaa kha biekuo na tuepa muo pi riypata biena-ing luo chiykhyi pata cuo'a vyi, tahematapakieca hingpa hmang suohning hing Abyipanama Khazing hmiekunglie duv aa chiypa tana a cuo.
Israel cawsaa hrangpa tie’ luo kha amie ta ducyi pi'a va ung ciy, tuokaa cuose, sa cuose, hmang suokhakha cuose amie la pata pahlie'a va ung ciy.

Ruohrang ming ca amie la pata ducyi nama pi khu aa, cuorasala vaa ngie'a ung cate nama cu riypa ruo lieta nama tuehriepa bangkhuo cunglie Abyipanama Khazing ta thluechiy aca pi riypa yi ta Israel cawsaa hrangpa tie ca amie ta ducyi pi khu'a va ung ciy.
Abyipanama Khazing'a luo kha bie namaa kuo kieca, patling sa riypa kha palaw'a va ung ciy; tahematapakieca Abyipanama Khazing ta aca hie hrahring'a yi, ca tiyta nama cuota suena ta a cuo aa.
Cuorasala biekuo tue kha nama cahriy kieca, nama cuota suena aw'a vyi.
Abyipanama Khazing'a luo kha niema'a na niema ta bie a kuo ung cate, nama pakaa ta nama ri tlipa bie kha a phasa pata nama tue aa.
Nama ingpaa tie mingsuv diedung luo nama vaa kieca mingsuv thyi kha nama khing thiy ta, nama riy bina te ta nama ning aa, cuorasala na sawpaa chung luo ca a pasuo'a va ung ciy.
Nama ingpaa sacuo lyi lie nama cakuole tiyta, a uv kha nama kuv ta nama pahriy khu, cuorasala nama ingpaa sacuo uv kha tuokyi ta uo'a va ung ciy.

Cawsaa pakha ta napuv chiy te a cunglie palung tling li riypa suokhakha a hmung nakawta aa hlaw khing li tli kieca, manapa caa kha cape'a te, a kuv chung luo kha pi'a te, a ing taa khata a cakuo sa aa; capa nung ca a ing taa khata pya'a te,
capaa hrangpa napuv ta a cuo khu.
A pahningnapa paa khata a khing li biephung kieca, manapa caa kha cape'a te, a kuv chung luo kha pi'a te, a ing taa khata a cakuo sa aa (acuolikie a navaapa pahningnapa kha a thiy kieca);

a navaapa taapa, a ing taata a cakuo sa tlipa paa kha ta papyapalyi pata a cuo tlipa khapa nung kha a napuv riypata la pakhaa khu'a vyi; tahematapakieca Abyipacuota duv aa chiypa tana a cuo aa, Abyipanama Khazing ta nama cu riypata aca pipa yi ruo lie kha suena chiykhyi'a va ung ciy.

Napuv a chiy thaapa pakha ca, rietuvna luo pasi sa riypata cuo vyi, re hrangpa zaw chang riypata cuo vyi. A chiy thaapa a napuv hne aa nuosa pata aw riypata kung kha chung ing lie retlawsa pata pa-aw sa riypa tana a cuo.
Ahungtahmuo sa rienapa acuolikie a cung a chuopa sariena lung kha biekuona cuota a patuvpa'a va ung ciy, tahematapakieca cawsaa hringna patuvpa haa tana a cuo aa.

Cawsaa pakha ta Israel ming hrangpa kha paruv te, sii ta aa tuepa acuolikie a zaapa kha pachang pata a cuo kieca capa cawsaa ca thie pata a cuo aa. Cahaacata pha lina kha nama hrawtaata nama pathe aa.
Caahminghmaa a puv kieca namaa raaringsa aa; kama ta bie i pipa haa yi ta hne Levi tluobyi tie ta aca changpa haa yi khata a phasa pata nama tue aa.
Izipt ruo taata pya ung cate nama sile ningta Abyipanama Khazing ta Miriam cunglie khaapama a tue tapa kha maw khah ung.
Na ingpaa kha khaapa a cuo zaw ducyi na pi tiyta, biekuona cuota suokhakha patuv riypata a ing chung luo a ngie'a vaciy.
Ducyi na pipa paa ta biekuona cuota patuv riypa kha ale luo a kya pyakhyina te ta ale taa khata na huo aa.
Dawchiepa ta a cuo kieca, biekuona cuota aca pipa pang kha khydyina te ta a chipuo'a vaciy.
Ning tla hluota na pi pakhaa aa, cakiedyina na ingpaa ca pang a buv pata a zie'a te thluechiy aca pi aa; capa ca Abyipana Khazing hmiekunglie na cuota adangna a cuo aa.
Israel hrangpa acuolikie nama ruo khy kha lalaa lieta khy a sapa mingpe cuose, rehrie na changpa siypasa vuosuopa tie thavie muo kha pi khing li pata aw'a vaciy.

Ning tating, ningtla hluota ama thavie muo kha na pi'a yi, tahematapakieca iema ca ama dawchie nakawta capa dyi cana amaa nguopuo. Cata acuolikieca nama a du pata Abyipa'a luo kha khi'a yi te, na cunglie suena a tlung aa.
Saata kawlie ama nungpaa kha thie pata cuo'a va yi, nungpaa kawlie zaw saata kha thie pata cuo'a va yi; cawsaa pakha ca ama pangpa suena kawlie dyi tana thie pata a cuo aa.
Mingpe hne haaraa ta ama hmung riypa biedangpa kha parapa'a va ung ciy; nunghlyinung pang zaw biekuona cuota patuvpa'a va ung ciy.
Izipt lie sii ta nama za cuopa hne Abyipanama Khazing ta capa ruo lieta acaa thlapa yi kha maw'a va ung ciy; caacuonakaw tana hingpa hing tue riypata bie ica pi yi.

Nama lu lie sa nama hrie tiyta sa-uv suokha nama maw kieca, la riypata kaachiy'a va ung ciy; ruohrang ming, haaraa, hne nunghlyi cuota pangaa pata a cuo aa, cakiedyina Abyipanama Khazing ta nama tuepa bangkhuo lie thluechiy aca pi'a yi.
Olif thyi nama cakhaw tiyta, aa ngaapa kha cakhaw pakhaa'a va ung ciy; ruohrang ming, haaraa hne nunghlyi cuota pangaa pata a cuo aa.
Nama mingsuv diedung lie mingsuv thyi nama lu tiyta, aa ngaapa kha a mang thang'a va ung ciy; ruohrang ming, haaraa hne nunghlyi cuota pangaa pata a cuo aa.
Izipt ruo lie sii ta nama za cuopa kha maw'a va ung ciy; caacuonakaw tana hing haa hingta tue riypata bie ica pi yi.
Cawsaa pahning amaa hru nakawta tazaa a cyi yi te, bieripatuv byi ta bie a ripa kie yi ca, pakha kha paduo'a te pakha kha a pasue aa.
A suepa paa ca tuv aa tla pata a cuo kieca, bieripatuv byi ta pabu sa'a te a suena hne aa phuvna zaa ta a hmiekunglie kha a patuv sa'a yi.
Yi sawliy tuv khu pata a cuo, cuorasala hlyi'a vyi; a hlyi ta tuvpa a cuo kieca, na ingpaapa ca na hmiekunglieta a ling na a zue aa.
Suo a ciy nguoluopa cuetungpa kha a hmya hy khah ung.

Uvnu zaw aw pakhaw yi te, pakha kha sacapaa hnyi li pata a thiy tiyta, a thiypa paa a napuv kha ingchungkhue le luo maliepa hneta pahlaw riypata cuo vyi. A navaapa uvnu ta napuv ta a la'a te, a ziekhyi'a te, ama cunglie kha navaapa uvnu hrie riypa kha a hrie aa.
Cakhutaata a sapa sacapaa pakhanapa kha a thiypa a uvnu sacapaa ta ri pata a cuo aa, a ming ca Israel chungtaata thawpa a cuo li riypata a cuo.

Cuorasala cawsaapa ca ta a uvnu napuv nunghlyinung kha aa hlaw khing li kieca, a uvnu napuv nunghlyinung ca ta hukaa luo uvthyi tie'a luo kha cakuo'a te, “I navaapa uvnu ta a uvnu ming kha Israel chunglie pahmang khing vyi; navaapa uvnu re kha i cunglie hrie khing vyi,” a ta aa.
Cakhutaata khy uvthyi tie ca ta ama kha ku'a yi te ama chang aa. Cuorasala “Ama ca a hlaw khing va ang,” a ta ngiethie kieca,

a uvnu napuv ca ta uvthyi tie hmiekunglie kha cakuochiy'a te, a phyipakaw kha thliepa'a te, a hmie lie a paciy ta a pacha khutaata, “A uvnu ing a sa khing lipa paa cunglie ca hing haa hing tana ama tue,” ta pata a pathyi sa aa.
Israel ming chunglieta a ingchungkhue ca, “A phyipakaw thliepa pata a cuopa paa ing,” ta pata pachang pa a cuo aa.
Capaa pakha hne pakha a tuv yi te, pakhapa napuv ta a vaapa kha a bya te pakhapa a chiepha ta patuv te aa da kieca,
ama kha ngie chi li pata a kuv kha te pata a cuo aa.
Na sahrie lieta a lepa hne a cawpa ta pata cyilung suohning hnyi'a vaciy.
Na ing lieta a lepa hne a cawpa ta pata panangnapa suohning hnyi'a vaciy.
Abyipana Khazing ta aca pipa ruo lie na hring a pasiy riypata, a tlingpa hne aa dangpa cyilung, hne a tlingpa hne aa dangpa panangna khana na hnyi aa.
Tahematapakieca cahaapa hmang a tuepa, aa dang li pata re a hriepa tie ca Abyipanama Khazing hmielie duv aa chiypa tana ama cuo.
Izipt ruo taata nama pya ningta Amalek ming ta luopuv lie,
niema'a lie ama tuepa, hne nama thaabuo riethyi ningta tuokhaata ca tuv yi te ma, Khazing ciy li pata hnangluo a kya chuolepa tie zaw kha ama thie diy tapa kha maw khah.

Caacuonakawta Abyipanama Khazing ta cu riypata ru ta aca pipa yi ruo lie, Abyipanama Khazing ta nama carie tie kuv taata a pahyna aca pi tiy yi ta, Amalek ming a thyi parina riypa ca vuoruotyi lie hing nama para diy aa; a maw he hmuo maw'a va ung ciy.
Abyipanama Khazing ta ru ta cu riypata aca pipa yi ruo chung luo a ngie ung cate, cu ung cate a chunglie khy nama sa tiyta,

Abyipanama Khazing ta aca pipa yi alyi thyipaa bangkhuo chungtaata sathaapa chebuo kha la ung lah, beke luo kha pasuo ung la, Abyipanama Khazing ta a ming awna riypata aa tlawpa hmang luo kha chiykhyi tie ung.

Capa cuo ningta zung chunglie a awpa tluobyi'a luo kha cakuo la, “Abyipata ma mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kiema pi riypata chie a sa te bie aa kuopa ruo luo kha ma vya chiy tli ta pata Abyipa na Khazing'a luo kha ataning hing i pathyi sa tli,” ta pata na chang aa.
Tluobyi ta beke kha na kuv taata la te Abyipa na Khazing hmiekunglie kha a chi tiyta,

hingpa hing Abyipana Khazing hmiekunglie kha na ri aa; “I mingchingmingvuo ca aa khielepa Aram ming tana a za cuo, Izipt luo kha sibung te capa lie ca mingpe cuo te a aw, a mingluv ta a cawsa, cakhutaata capa lie ca mingphang lepa, a cahrapa hne a hluvsa pata aa li.
Izipt ming ta re ruvpa kha ma cunglie khang yi te, ang khu li riypa te ta ruvnaana malie ama pi.
Abyipa, mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing'a luo kha khi pate, Abyipata ma ueryi kha malie thyi te, ma ruvnaana, ma riethyina hne malie ama tuechienapa kha malie a hmung.
Abyipata a cahrapa a kuv hne a pazuopa a buo ta, ciy aa chiysapa hne pamangsana hne kharuehaa hmang zaw hneta Izipt taata malie a vya pyakhyi.
Cakhutaata hingpa hmang luo hing malie a vya chiy te hingpa ruo, cuehnung hne khyitiy langnapa ruo hing malie a pi.

Caacuonakawta, Vya Abyipa, nama ta malie na pipa alyi thyipaa sathaapa kha ata hing ma vya chiykhyi,” nama ta aa. Abyipanama Khazing hmiekunglie kha chi'a ung cate, Abyipana ma Khazing hmiekunglie kha namaa bu aa.
Cakhutaata niema, Levi ming hne niema hrawlie khy a sapa ruohrang ming hne khata Abyipanama Khazing ta niema hne nama ingchungkhue cunglie a patlung sapa phana bangkhuo kha namaa law aa.

A kung thungna (chehraachekha kung) lie na hmungpa bangkhuo taata chehraachekha kha pi diy ung cate, na khy lie a awpa Levi ming, mingpe tie, haaraa tie, hne nunghlyi zaw ta ama riy bisa pata ama ning the riypata nama pi khutaata,

Abyipanama Khazing hmiekunglie kha: “Nama ta ina pipa ciy na nawbie bangkhuo haata a pathepa cuvu kha i ing taata papya angte, Levi ming, mingpe tie, haaraa tie hne nunghlyi zaw kha i pi tli yi; na nawbie suokha hmuo para va ang, maw va ang:

Muochie i sa ningta khapa kha ning va ang; i pathe li ningta khapa suokha kha hmuo palaw va ang, a thiypa cuo ta khapa suokha kha hmuo pi va ang. Abyipai Khazing ri kha caa ngie angte, nama ta ina pipa ciy bie haata i tue tli.

Na awnapa, a pathepa vuoruo taata za mangbung la, na cawsaa Israel ming hne ma mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie chie a sa cate bie naa kuopa haata, malie na pipa alyi, cuehnung hne khyitiy a langnapa ruo hing thluechiy za pi tie,” nama ta aa.
Ataning hrahring hingta Abyipanama Khazing ta hingpa phungluo hne ziyphung hing ziy riypata Abyipata bie aca pi yi; caacuonakawta na pathiypalung yalya, na ruena yalya ta a phasa pata ziy tie.
Ataning hing Abyipaca na Khazing ta cuo riypata nama palung a tling; a luopuv kha ziy riypa cuose, a phungluo, a nawbie hne a ziyphung kha ziy pata ama pa-uvsathyi riypa kha nama palung a tling tli.
Niema kha bie aca kuopa haa yi ta, ama cawsaa muosung cuo riypata cuose, a nawbie ziy riypata cuose,

pathuosana, mingpathuona hne pa-uvsathyina lieta ama ta a sapa mingphang zaw bangkhuo cunglie aa suo vie ta chi riypata cuose, ama ta bie aca kuopa haa yi ta, Abyipanama Khazing cuota a pathepa cawsaa nama cuo riypata cuose, ataning hing nama palungtlingna kha Abyipata a cuhluo tli.
Cakhutaata Moses hne Israel uvthyi tie ta cawsaa bangkhuo kha bie pi yi te: Ataning ica pipa yi nawbie hing a bangkhuo ta nama ziy aa.
Jordan cavaa kha va te'a ung cate Abyipanama Khazing ta aca pipa yi ruo kha nama pha tiyta, alung lesapa tie kha bang'a ung cate palastaa ta nama pame aa.

Abyipa, nama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing ta bie aca kuopa haa yi ta, Abyipanama Khazing ta aca pipa yi ruo, cuehnung hne khyitiy a langnapa ruo luo a ngie riypata nama va te tiyta, hingpa phungbie bangkhuo hing a cunglie kha nama cape aa.
Jordan cavaa kha nama va te khutaata, hingpa kaw hne aa patuv pata ataning bie ica pipa yi haa hingta alung zaw hing Ebal tluo cunglie kha bang'a ung cate palastaa ta nama pame aa.
Capa lie ca Abyipanama Khazing cuota bienatluophie, alung bienatluophie kha sa'a ung cate, thaa chechiy hmuo'a va ung ciy.
AbyipaKhazing bienatluophie kha te lipa alung ta nama sa aa. Cakhutaata capa cunglie ca Abyipanama Khazing kha myirue panaana nama pihluo aa,
aviesaa panaana kha pihluo'a ung cate, capa lie ca ning'a ung cate Abyipanama Khazing hmiekunglie kha namaa nuo aa.
Hingpa alung zaw cunglie hing phungbie bangkhuo kha a siesa pata nama cape aa.
Cakhutaata Moses hne Levi tluobyi tie ta Israel ming bangkhuo kha: Vya Israel ming a dieta tah aw ung la naathlie tie ung! Ataning hrahring hingta Abyipanama Khazing cawsaa ta nama cuo tli.
Caacuonakawta Abyipanama Khazing ri hing a ngie ung la ataning ica pipa yi a nawbie hne a phungluo hing ziy tie ung.
Capa ning lie ca ta Moses ta cawsaa tie kha hing haa hingta bie a pi yi:
Jordan nama va te khupa hneta cawsaa kha thluechiy pi riypata hingpa tie hing Gerizim tluo cunglie a daa yi se: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issakhar, Josef, hne Benjamin.
Cakhutaata hingpa tie hing chiesa riypata Ebal Tluo cunglie a daa yi se: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, hne Naphtali.
Cakhutaata Levi ming khata Israel ming bangkhuo'a luo kha ama ueryi aa thyisa pata ama pathyi sa aa:

“Abyipacuota duv aa chiypa, kuvzung a thepa tie ta ama tuepa kuvtuezuv acuolikie ama patlepa kuvtuezuv kha a paruvta tah a huota a chipa ca chiesa pata cuo se,” ta pata ama pathyi sa aa. Cawsaa bangkhuo ta, “Amen,” ta pata ama palie aa.
“Paa hne nung a pa-uvsathyi lipa ca chiesa pata cuo se,” ta pata ama pathyi sa aa. Cawsaa bangkhuo ta, “Amen,” ta pata ama palie aa.
“A ingpaa ruoriy kha a hnyipa ca chiesa pata cuo se,” ama ta aa. Cawsaa bangkhuo ta, “Amen,” ta pata ama palie aa.
“Mingcuepa kha luopuv a pasichie sapa ca chiesa pata cuo se,” ta pata ama pathyi aa. Cawsaa bangkhuo ta, “Amen,” ta pata ama palie aa.
“Mingpe, haaraa, hne nunghlyi ta ama hmung riypa biedangpa kha a parapatuv ca chiesa pata cuo se,” ta pata ama pathyi aa. Cawsaa bangkhuo ta, “Amen,” ta pata ama palie aa.
“A paa napuv kha a ziekhyipa ca chiesa pata cuo se, tahematapakieca a paa cuvu khana a para,” ta pata ama pathyi aa. Cawsaa bangkhuo ta, “Amen,” ta pata ama palie aa.
“Tuokhaapa saruopa kha hmuo a ziekhyipa ca chiesa pata cuo se,” ta pata ama pathyi sa aa. Cawsaa bangkhuo ta, “Amen,” ta pata ama palie aa.
“A paa sacanung acuolikie a nung sacanung a cuopa a sieta kha a ziekhyipa ca chiesa pata cuo se,” ta pata ama pathyi sa aa. Cawsaa bangkhuo ta, “Amen,” ta pata ama palie aa.
“A napuv a nung kha a ziekhyipa ca chiesa pata cuose,” ta pata ama pathyi sa aa. Cawsaa bangkhuo ta, “Amen,” ta pata ama palie aa.
“A ingpaa kha a paruvta tah a thiepa ca chiesa pata cuo se,” ta pata ama pathyi sa aa. Cawsaa bangkhuo ta, “Amen,” ta pata ama palie aa.
“A sue lipa cawsaa thie riypata nawthuv a ningpa ca chiesa pata cuo se,” ta pata ama pathyi aa. Cawsaa bangkhuo ta, “Amen,” ta pata ama palie aa.
“Hingpa phungbie hing a daakhyi pata a ziy lipa ca chiesa pata cuo se,” ta pata ama pathyi sa aa. Cawsaa bangkhuo ta, “Amen,” ta pata ama palie aa.

Ataning kama ta ica pipa yi nawbie bangkhuo hing a phasa pata ziy ung cate, Abyipanama Khazing kha nama pa-uvsathyi kieca, Abyipanama Khazing ta niema kha alyi lie mingphang bangkhuo cunglieta aca chi aa.
Abyipanama Khazing kha nama pa-uvsathyi kieca hingpa thluechiy bangkhuo hing nama cunglie tlung'a te aca ziy yi:
Khypuv chunglie thluechiy pi pata nama cuo aa, lu chunglie thluechiy pipa ta nama cuo aa.
Nama saata zaw thluechiy pi pata ama cuo aa, nama chuelyi thyipaa thluechiy pi pata a cuo aa, nama sahring taata zaw, nama cue pungzaana hne nama tuv pungzaana zaw thluechiy pi pata a cuo aa.
Nama beke hne nama viechuo nenapa bikang kha thluechiy pi pata a cuo aa.
Namaa vya ngiena luo thluechiy pi pata cuo'a ung cate, nama pyana luo thluechiy pi pata nama cuo aa.
Niema caa dupa nama carie tie kha Abyipata nama hmiekunglie a pasung sa'a yi; niema a du riypata luopuv suokha ta a vaw'a yi te, nama hmiekung taata luopuv suosariy ta amaa ruo aa.
Nama sa-ing hne nama tuepa bangkhuo lie Abyipata thluechiy kha nama cuota bie pi'a te, Abyipanama Khazing ta aca pipa yi ruo chunglie kha thluechiy aca pi aa.
Abyipanama Khazing nawbie kha ziy ung cate, a luopuv kha nama ziy kieca, niema'a lie chie aa sapa haata, Abyipata niema kha a mingphang pathepa ta aca tue'a yi.
Chuelyi cung mingphang bangkhuo ta Abyipaming ta kupa nama cuopa kha pachang'a yi te, aca ciy'a yi.
Abyipata nama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie pi riypata chie aa sapa ruo chunglie kha nama saata zaw, nama sahring taata zaw, nama chuelyi thyipaa zaw taa khata aca pahnyiparung sa'a yi.

Nama ruo lie kha ama'a na a cuo lieta khy pasaa sa riypata hne nama tuepa bangkhuo lie thluechiy pi riypata, Abyipata a suethiy pacungna ing, avuo zaw kha aca pahawpa'a yi. Mingphang hluvpuv kha ducyi nama pi'a yi, cuorasala niema ca ducyi la'a va ung ciy.

Kama ta ataning ica pipa yi bie, Abyipanama Khazing nawbie zaw hing a phasa pata ziy ung cate, ataning ica pipa yi bie taa hingta cacuoluo acuolikie cavyiluo pie li pata, khazing hrangpa re kha nama hrie li kieca, Abyipata niema ca luv ta aca tue'a yi, lahmyi ta ca tue'a va yi, a daw lie dyi aw'a ung cate, a thabaw lie aw'a va ung ciy.
Cuorasala ataning ica pipa yi Abyipanama Khazing nawbie hne phungluo bangkhuo hing a phasa pata nama ziy li kieca, hingpa chiesana bangkhuo hing niema cunglie tlung'a te aca ziy'a yi:
Khypuv chunglie chiesa pata nama cuo aa, lu chunglie chiesa pata nama cuo aa.
Nama beke hne nama viechuo nenapa bikang kha chiesa pata a cuo aa.
Nama saata zaw chiesa pata ama cuo aa, nama chuelyi thyipaa chiesa pata a cuo aa, nama sahring taata zaw, nama cue pungzaana hne nama tuv pungzaana zaw chiesa pata a cuo aa.
Namaa ngiena luo chiesa pata cuo'a ung cate, nama pyana luo chiesa pata nama cuo aa.

Tahematapakieca kama kha na thaw ung cate, hmang pha lipa nama tue nakawta a catlisa pata para pata cuo'a ung cate, Abyipata nama tuepa bangkhuo cunglie kha rana, thlaazangna, hne rutlazangna zaw kha a patlung sa aa.
Cu riypata namaa ngienapa ruo taata aca pape hluo li yi, Abyipata nama cunglie pasana chiepa aca patlungsue'a yi.
Abyipata ngyina, ngelingna, thlingna, ningkuo hriy hne caavungna, thuvna hne hmawna zaw kha nama ra hluo li aca patlung sue'a yi.
Nama luv cunglie avuo ca daa haata cuo'a te, nama rawlie alyi ca thaa haata a cuo aa.
Abyipata nama ruo khytiy kha alyidiypa ta pali'a te, nama rana te ta, nama luv cunglie kha avuo taata alyidiypa a zaa saa aa.

Abyipata nama carie tie hmiekunglie kha ca pasung sa'a yi te, luopuv suokha ziy pata nama vaa hnue pa yi ta luopuv suosariy ziy pata ama hmiekung taata namaa ruo aa. Chuelyi cung pena zaw hmungna lie ciysabaraw aa chiypa ta nama cuo aa.
Nama riyy ca avuo lie pavaa hne alyi lie saruopa zaw cuota ama sa ta cuo'a te, a lepa riypa pakha hmuo aw'a va yi.
Abyipata a tluo the lipa Izipt ruo khiyhliy, retha thupa, hne retha caapa zaw kha nama cunglie a patlung sa aa.
Abyipata ngaana, mingcuena, hne palung myalaana zaw aca patlungsue'a yi.
Mingcuepa ta zingna lie a pathuolepa haata ningchung khata pathuole'a ung cate, nama luopuv hmung the'a va ung ciy. Hrisaapa hne chuvpa cuole pari'a ung cate ahungtahmuo caa bya riypa aw'a va yi.
Canung kha pahaa'a ung cate, cuorasala capaa hrangpa ta amaa ziekhyi aa. Ing kha sa'a ung cate, cuorasala awna'a va ung ciy. Mingsuv diedung kha tue'a ung cate, cuorasala a thyi kha lu'a va ung ciy.

Nama cuetungpa kha nama ming hmungna lie thie'a yi te, cuorasala a saa kha ce'a va ung ciy. Nama laa kha nama hmiekunglie paruv'a yi te, ca pi pakhaa'a va yi. Nama tuv kha nama carie tie pi'a yi te, ahungtahmuo caa bya riypa aw'a va yi.
Nama sacapaa hne nama sacanung zaw kha nama hmung thluopa ta cawsaa hrangpa kha pipa cuo'a yi te, ning-aw ta, nama ming rina te ta nama suole raalaa zaw ta a thlahnenapa aw'a vyi.
Nama pachang lipa mingphang tie ta nama chuelyi lie nama rehriena thyipaa kha ning diy'a yi te, niema ca hrisaapa hne tlawpuopa ta nama cuo aa.
Nama ming ta nama hmungpa khata aca pangaa sa'a yi.
Abyipata nama pakhuv hne nama phyi kha pa tluo sa khu a cuo lipa khiyhliy aca patlungsue'a yi, nama phyidaw taata nama lakiy te khata.

Abyipata niema hne nama cunglieta nama chipa siepahruo kha niema hne nama mingchingmingvuo tie ta nama pachang buo lipa mingphang tie'a luo kha ca sikhyi'a yi te, capa lie ca thing hne alung ta tuepa khazing hrangpa kha namaa bie aa.
Abyipata acaa chiylena riypa yi ruo cawsaa tie hrawlie kha ciysabaraw aa chiypa, phungthluv ta ri riypa hne sesungna ta ripa nama cuo aa.
Lu luo kha saciy a hluvsa phyale'a ung cate, cuorasala a cawta dyina sa nama la aa, tahematapakieca khawbyapa ta a ce diy nakawta a cuo.
Mingsuv diedung kha tue'a ung cate, nama mangsang aa, cuorasala mingsuvtiy kha dang li'apa ung cata mingsuv thyi zaw lu'a va ung ciy, tahematapakieca alungpa ta a ce nakawta a cuo.
Nama ruo chung bangkhuo lie kha olif kung nama hnyi aa, cuorasala olif thu kha a thuv'a va ung ciy, tahematapakieca olif thyi kha a zung diy nakawta a cuo.
Sacapaa hne sacanung kha nama hnyi'a yi, cuorasala nama huopa ta cuo'a va yi, tahematapakieca sii ta a dapa tana ama cuo aa.
Nama thingkung hne alyi thyipaa zaw bangkhuo ca khawbyapa ta ama ce diy aa.
Niema athaalie a awpa mingpe tie kha nama cunglie a suo viele hryly'a yi te niema ca namaa ne viele hryly aa.
Iema ta ca pahlie'a yi te cuorasala niema ta pahlie'a va yi ciy; iema ca luv ta cuo'a yi te, niema ca lahmyi tana nama cuo aa.

Hingpa chiesana bangkhuo hing nama cunglie a tlung aa, nama ra hluo li ca ziy'a yi te aca pha'a yi, tahematapakieca ama ta aca pipa yi nawbie hne phungluo kha ziy pata Abyipanama Khazing kha a ri namaa ngie li nakawta a cuo.
Capa ca niema hne nama ciypathla zaw hrawlie kha chuozaa ta kharuehaa hmang hne pahmungsana ta ama cuo aa.
Niema ca hmangting kha lunghruo tlungsa pata nama hnyi raalaa pata Abyipanama Khazing kha palung tluosa pata hne a lawsa pata nama pathuosa li nakawta,

Abyipata aca vya pathliesuepa nama carie tie re kha nangdiy tiyhriena, cahripa ta hne zezaw bangkhuo lie vuo a suosa pata nama hrie aa. Aca para hluo li yi thaa ruekhang kha nama rue lie aca khang'a yi.
Abyipata aa luohlaasapa alyi dena taata niema kha hmungthlu haata tlasue riypata, ama ryi nama thyi buo lipa mingphang,
nungpuv macuo kha pa-uvsathyi li pata mingnu zaw a tlechuo lipa, a hmiephya chiesapa mingphang kha aca vya pathliesue'a yi.

Capa tie ca ta parapa nama cuo hluo li nama sahring taata hne namaa lyi thyipaa zaw kha ama ning diy aa, niema kha aca para hluo li yi ta sa, mingsuvtiy, chiytiy, nama tuvtaata zaw hne nama cuetaata zaw kha khaapahmuo pangaa'a va yi.

Nama ruo chung bangkhuo lie namaa buchuopa, a cupa hne aa suopa khy dungkhuona lungruetlepie bangkhuo a cing diyna te ta aca cadung'a yi. Abyipanama Khazing ta aca pipa yi ruo chunglie nama khypuv bangkhuo kha ama cadung aa.
Nama carie tie ta aca cadung nakaw yi ta nangping vuosuo pata aw'a ung cate, Abyipanama Khazing ta aca pipa yi nama sapa, nama sacapaa hne nama sacanung zaw saa kha nama ce aa.
Niema hrawlie a rie paluo cepa hne a nang ne cepa tahmuo, a uvnu, a cakuvpa a napuv, a hnangcaw ce ta aa ngaapa a saata,

iema chungtaata ahung kha hmuo a ce nguoluopa a saata saa kha pi riypata pahya'a vyi; tahematapakieca khy bangkhuo kha carie ta cadung diy te nangping vuosuo pata a cuo nakawta ama huota khaapahmuo a ngaa va tli.
Niema hrawlie a nang ne ce nung, a panu diyliy ce nung, a phyipazaa ta alyi hmuo a tlaw nguo li nung tahmuo, a cakuvpa a navaapa, a sacapaa, hne a sacanung cuota sa pahya'a vyi,

carie tie ta khy zaw kha cadung yi te, nangping vuosuo pata cuo te ning riypa khaapahmuo a aw li nakawta a bawtung hne a bawtung alala taata zaa pyapa hnuo, hne a sapa a saata kha a paruvta tah a ning aa.
Hingpa caa-uv lie capepa phungbie hing a phasa pata ziy lipa ung cata, Abyipanama Khazing a rungnaapa hne ciy aa chiypa ming hing nama ciyzaa li kieca,
Abyipata niema hne nama samingsahlaa tie kha a pasasapa hne a tluo the li tlipa pasana, ang khu a aw lipa hne a tluo khu li tlipa pasana kha aca patlungsue'a yi.
Izipt ruo lie ciy aa chiysapa pasana kha ca patlungsue'a yi te capa tie ca ta niema kha acaa bepuole'a yi.
Hingpa phungbie caa-uv lie a cape lipa pasana hne te-angna zaw kha nama ra hluo li ta aca patlungsue'a yi.
Abyipanama Khazing ri kha namaa ngie li nakawta, avuo lie aasiy zaa a ta tawpa kha a cawta dyi pangaa pata nama cuo aa.

Cakhutaata Abyipata niema kha pahnyirung sa riypa hne papungzaa sa riypa kha a za khingpa haata, niema para riypa hne ra riypa zaw kha a khing thluo ra aa; cu riypata nama vaa ngienapa ruo taa khata aca phie'a yi.

Abyipata mingphang zaw hrawlie kha alyi kiy kha taata a dena te ta aca cadaapatlaa diy'a yi; niema ta cuose, nama mingchingmingvuo tie ta cuose nama pachang lipa, thing hne alung ta tuepa khazing hrangpa kha namaa bie aa.

Capa mingphang zaw hrawlie ca thlaalungna hmung khu'a va ung ciy, nama phyipazaa pathlana hmang hmuo hnyi'a va ung ciy. Capa lie ca Abyipata palungriethyina, ming thaahang lina, hne palung chuona aca pi'a yi.
Nama hringna ca thiy hne hring alalalie a aw aa, chung hne zuo ta ciyna chunglie aw'a ung cate, nama hringna cuota hnaanguo tapa aw'a vyi.
Nama palung lie ciyna hne nama ming ta nama hmungpa kawlie kha ta, maw khata, “zuoluo ta cuo sala!” ta'a ung cate, zuoluo khata, “maw ta cuo sala!” nama ta aa.

Hmung pakhaa buo'a va tli ung ciy ta pata bie ica kuopa yi luopuv ziy pata Abyipata Izipt luo kha tiypalaw ta ca vya kaakhyi pakhaa'a yi te, capa lie ca niema hne niema kha nama carie tie'a luo siicapaa hne siicanung cuo riypata namaa zaa raalaa pata caa calyi riypa aw'a va yi.
Horeb lie iema hne a za tuepa biekuona hlyi taa khata, Moab ruo lieta Abyipata Moses kha bie pi te, Israel ming hne a patue sapa biekuona chunglie bie ca hing haa hing tana a cuo.
Moses ta Israel ming bangkhuo kha ku yi te: Izipt ruo nama ming hmungna lieta Abyipata Faro hne a changtaapa bangkhuo hne a ruo chung yalya lie a tuepa bangkhuo kha nama hmung mangtli,
nama ming ta nama hmungpa dyapasyana lesapa zaw, pamangsana hne kharuehaa hmang zaw ta ama cuo.
Cuorasala ataning tepa hingta Abyipata pachangna pathiypalung, acuolikie hmungna ming, acuolikie thyina naa zaw ca pi va yi.
Ruocaapa chunglie kung sawliy icaa chiy mangtli yi. Nama ke cunglie caw tlaa vyi, nama phyi cunglie phyipakaw zaw tlaa va yi;
kama ca Abyipanama Khazing i cuopa kha ina pachang riypa ung cata niema ca viechuo kha ce va ung ciy, mingsuvtiy acuolikie mingsuv sahmaa kha dang va ung ciy.
Hingpa hmang luo hing nama vya chiy tiyta, Heshbon Siepahruo Sihon hne Bashan Siepahruo Og ta kiema kha rie malie amaa du, cuorasala ma te yi.
Ama ruo kha la pate Reuben phang, Gad phang, hne Manasseh phang khingkhuo kha ru ta ma pi yi.
Caacuonakawta nama tuepa bangkhuo lie tena nama hmung riypata hingpa biekuona hing a phasa pata ziy tie ung.
Ataning hing nama bangkhuo ta a hmya ung cate, Abyipanama Khazing hmiekunglie namaa daa; nama phang luochiytuv tie, nama uvthyi tie, hne nama byi tie, Israel ming capaa bangkhuo,
nama haatiy zaw, nama canung zaw, namaa rina hmang lie a awpa mingpe tie, nama thing a uopa tie nama tiy a thepa tie ta pata.
Abyipanama Khazing ta ataning niema hneta a tuepa, chiesana ta bie namaa kuopa, Abyipanama Khazing biekuona luo a ngie riypa tana nama cuo.

Niema kha bie caa kuo yi te, nama mingchingmingvuo tie, Abraham, Isak, hne Jakob zaw'a lieta bie aa kuopa haata, ataning hing niema ca a cawsaa ta pacu sa riypa hne ama ca nama Khazing cuo riypa khata a cuo.
Hingpa biekuona hing chie a sa pata i tuepa ca ataning Abyipama Khazing hmiekunglie a daapa niema hne dyi cuo li pata,
ataning kiema hneta a aw ra lipa tie zaw hneta tuepa a cuo ra.
Izipt ruo lie tuokhaatama ma aw tapa hne ma vya cahrawlepa mingphang zaw hrawlie kha tuokhaatama ma vya sile tapa kha nama pachang.
Duv aa chiypa hne a pyalyipa thing hne alung ta tuepa ama kuvtuezuv, siy hne ngu ta tuepa ama kuvtuezuv, iema hrawlie a awpa zaw kha nama hmung tli.

Capa mingphang zaw khazing tie kha abie riypata Abyipama Khazing'a taata a pathiypalung a maapa canung hne capaa, ingchungkhue hne phang zaw nama aw khu. Niema hrawlie hing a ca-ie a awpa hne a khasapa kha pu te a lethawnapa zaw nama aw khu.

Hingpa biekuona a thyipa tie ta iema hne iema kha thluechiy a pi yi te, ama palung chunglie kha, “I palung lenapa luopuv hing ziy thluo ra mang ang sala i bang thluo aa,” ta pata ama rue (capa ca ta a pahnapa hne a huvpa zaw cunglie kha aa lu pata rana a vya phya).

Abyipata a ngiethe khing'a va yi, tahematapakieca Abyipahihaana khata myikhuv haata khuv'a te aa du'a yi. Hingpa caa-uv lie capepa chiesana bangkhuo ama cunglie tlung'a te, Abyipata avuo raw taa hingta a pahli'a yi.
Hingpa phungbie caa-uv lie capepa biekuona lie chiesana haa hingta Abyipata iema ca Israel ming mingphang zaw bangkhuo chungtaata chiena hmung riypata che'a yi te a chi pathlyi'a yi.

A vaw riypa chuo, niema hnang taata a vya puv riypa nama saata zaw hne aa hlasapa ruo taata a vya sipa ruohrang ming zaw ta capa ruo khuosa ta a ranapa hne Abyipata a patlungsuepa yi pasana zaw kha ama hmung aa.

Abyipata a pathiylingna ta a parapa Sodom hne Gomorrah, Admah hne Zeboiim zaw haa khata a chuelyi ca ke hne paciy ta kuo te khaapahmuo a ling li, khaapahmuo pu li, tuokhaapa uohnaasiyyhnaa hmuo a aw khu linapa ta a cuo,
iema hne mingphang bangkhuo khata, “Khaapanakawma Abyipata hingpa ruo hing hing haa hingta a tue? Khaapama hing tluv nanaapa hihaana hing a papya sa'a e? ta'a yi te ama nang ta a uo aa.
Iema ta, “Hingpa hing ca, Abyipa, ama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing ta Izipt ruo taata a vya pyakhyi ning yi ta iema hne a tuepa biekuona kha ama thaw nakaw tana a cuo.
Khazing kha a palise yi te, ama pachang buo lipa hne khaapahmuo a pi lipa yi khazing hrangpa kha amaa bie nakaw tana a cuo;
caacuonakawta na Abyipahihaana ca ie te biekuona caa-uv chunglie aa capepa chiesana bangkhuo kha hingpa ruo cunglie hing a patlung sa.
Abyipata a hihaana, myi ie ta a iepa a pathiylingna ta iema kha ama ruo taata phie pathla yi te, ata haa hingta ruo hrang luo a thaw pa yi ta a cuo,” ama ta aa.
Aa nupa hmang zaw hing ca Abyipama Khazing huopa tana a cuo, cuorasala hingpa phungbie zaw hing ma ziy khuna riypata phupa hmang zaw hing ca, chuozaa ta, kiema hne ma saata zaw cuo tana a cuo.

Hingpa hmang bangkhuo, nama hmiekunglie i chipa thluechiyna hne chiesana zaw hing nama cunglie a tlung tiyta, Abyipanama Khazing ta acaa cadenapa yi mingphang zaw hrawlieta hingpa hing naa thyi pakhaa kieca,
Abyipanama Khazing'a luo kha kaa ung la, ataning bie ica pipa yi haa hingta, niema hne nama saata zaw ta nama pathiypalung yalya hne nama ruena yalya ta a ri namaa ngie kieca,
Abyipanama Khazing ta vuophana ca pi pakhaa'a yi te, kawpacuona aca hnyi pakhaa'a yi, Abyipanama Khazing ta aca chepatlaanapa yi mingphang zaw hraw taa khata aca pakiy pakhaa'a yi.
Chuelyi dena te ta hmuo ca papepatlaa ra mang yi sala, capa taa cata Abyipanama Khazing ta ca pakiy'a yi te, acaa vya chiy pakhaa'a yi.
Abyipanama Khazing ta na mingchingmingvuo tie ama za cupa ruo luo kha caa vya chiy'a yi te, nama cu aa; nama mingchingmingvuo tie laa khata a hnyirung viepa hne a hluv viepa ta aca tue'a yi.

Ca hlyitaw taata, Abyipanama Khazing kha nama pathiypalung yalya hne nama ruena yalya ta due ung cate, nama hring riypata, Abyipanama Khazing ta nama pathiypalung hne nama ciypathla tie pathiypalung vangdaw kha a te aa.
Abyipanama Khazing ta hingpa chiesana bangkhuo hing nama carie tie hne caa du yi te caa hrisaapa tie cunglie kha a patlung sa aa.
Cakhutaata Abyipari kha a ngie pakhaa'a cate, ataning ica pipa a nawbie bangkhuo hing na ziy aa.

Abyipanama Khazing ta nama tue na hriena bangkhuo taata cuose, nama saa nama nu taata cuose, nama sahring aavaa taata, hne naa lyi thyipaa taata hnyirungna aca pi'a yi. Tahematapakieca Abyipata nama mingchingmingvuo tie hnyirungna a pina lie yi kha aa lawpa haata niema hnyirungna aca pina lie yi kha aa law pakhaa aa.

Hingpa caa-uv lie capepa nawbie hne phungluo zaw kha ziy pata Abyipanama Khazing ri kha a ngie ung cate, Abyipanama Khazing'a luo kha nama pathiypalung yalya hne nama ruena yalya ta namaa maa nakawta hnyirungna kha aca pi'a yi.
Ataning ica pipa yi nawbie hing nama cuota a ruv tuvpa hne nama ziy khu li riypata cuo vyi.
“Ahungma kiema cuo hingta vuoruo luo kie'a te, zaa cungkhyi aa?” nama ta riypata hingpa hing avuo lie a aw pata cuo vyi.
“Ahungma kiema cuo hingta riyliy huesuo luo va te'a te, thyi'a pate ma ziy riypata malie vaa lapa aa?” nama ta riypata riyliy huesuoluo a aw pata zaw cuo vyi.
Bie ca niema athaata liena a aw; nama ziy riypa tana nama hmya lie hne nama palung chunglie a aw.
Mang tie, ataning hing nama hmiekunglie na hringna hne hnyirungna, thiyna hne vuochina kha i chi.

Ataning ica pipa yi Abyipanama Khazing nawbie hing Abyipanama Khazing duena, a luopuv ziyna, a nawbie, a ziyphung hne a phungluo zaw tuena ta nama ziy kieca, hring'a ung cate nama pungzaa aa, cakhutaata Abyipanama Khazing ta cu riypata nama vaa ngienapa ruo lie hing thluechiy aca pi'a yi.
Cuorasala nama palung a maa te thyi lipa ung cata, khazing hrangpa kha abie riypa hne a re hrie riypata luo nama pie kieca,
Jordan va te ung cate cu riypata nama vaa ngienapa ruo lie hing a syi hring'a va ung ciy, nama ra aa; ta pata ataning hing i pathyi sa.

Nama hmiekunglie hringna hne thiyna, thluechiyna hne chiesana chi angte ataning hing pachangkhyituv ta alyi hne avuo kha i ku yi. Niema hne nama ciypathla zaw nama hring riypata thluechiy kha a tlaw tie ung.

Abyipanama Khazing kha due ung la, a ri a ngie ung la, a cusa pata a patuv tie ung; tahematapakieca capa ca nama cuota hringna hne chuo pasiyna ta a cuo, Abyipata nama mingchingmingvuo tie, Abraham, Isak, hne Jacob zaw'a lie pi riypata chie aa sapa ruo lie kha nama aw thena riypata thluechiy kha a tlaw tie ung.
Moses ta hingpa bie zaw bangkhuo hing Israel ming'a lie ri te a pachuo tiyta,
iema kyihuo khata: “Ata hing ca kung zakha kung kiy i ta tli. A pya khupa a ngie khupa ta cuo va tli ang. Cakhutaata Abyipata, ‘Hingpa Jordan cavaa hing va te'a vaciy,’ ina ta.
Abyipanama Khazing hrahring ta nama hmiekunglie va te'a te, iema kha nama phya aa. Abyipata bie acaa kuopa haa yi khata, Joshua zaw kha nama hmiekunglie a va te aa.
Abyipata Sihon hne Og, Amor ming siepahruo tie hne ama ruo a para ningta a tuepa haa khata iema cunglie kha a tue ra aa.
Abyipata iema ca niema kha ca pi'a yi te, bie ica pipa yi haa khata ama cunglie kha nama tue aa.
Cahra ung la nama rie pha se; iema kha ciy khah ung, nama rie chie khah se; tahematapakieca Abyipanama Khazing na niema hneta a si; ca pathlahla'a va yi, ca thaw'a va yi,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Moses ta Joshua kha ku te, Israel ming bangkhuo hmungna lie kha: “Cahra la na rie pha se, tahematapakieca nama ca Abyipata ama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lieta ica pi'a yi ta pata chie aa sapa ruo chung luo kha hingpa cawsaa zaw hne hingta a si riypa tana na cuo; iema kha ru ta na pacu sa'a yi.
Na hmiekunglie a sipa ca Abyipatana a cuo; ama ta ca pathlahla'a vyi, ca thaw ra'a vyi. Ciy khah, na palung zaw chuo khah se,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Moses ta hingpa phungbie hing cape te, tluobyi tie, Abyipabiekuona thingkaw a puvpa Levi sacapaa tluobyi tie hne Israel uvthyi tie kha a pi yi.
Moses ta iema kha bie pi yi te: “Kung sariy kyry, a ngiethenapa cuo thlipa chunglie, thluodaa pyi ning kha,
ama ta aa tlaw riypa hmang, Abyipanama Khazing hmiekunglie Israel ming bangkhuo amaa vaw tiyta, Israel ming bangkhuo ama thyina lieta hingpa phungbie hing nama ri aa.
Capaa, canung, hne haatiy, nama khy lie khy a sapa mingpe tie zaw khata thyi yi te, Abyipanama Khazing kha ciy'a yi te hingpa phungbie bangkhuo hing a phasa pata ama ziy riypa hne,

capa ca a pachang li liepa nama haatiy zaw ta thyi yi te, cu riypata Jordan cavaa nama va te hnuochuopa ruo chunglie nama awna te ta, Abyipanama Khazing kha ama ciy the riypata cawsaa ca pahmya tie ung,” a ta yi.

Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata, “Na thiyna'apa cuo na a ngie tli; Joshua kha ku la atawna thluodaa luo a vaw tie, ama kha re i pi thena riypata,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Moses hne Joshua ca atawna thluodaa chung luo kha ama vaa.
Abyipaca thluodaa lie kha amyi taw ta aa luo; amyi taw ca thluodaa luo a ngienapa lie kha aa daa.

Abyipata Moses kyihuo khata, “A ru hluota na mingchingmingvuo tie hneta naa zie'a mangtli. Cakhutaata hingpa cawsaa tie hing iema hrawlie a awpa ruohrang khazing, ama silenapa ruo ming khazing tie'a luo kha ama va siyhrawle aa, kama kha na maw'a yi te, iema hne i tuepa i biekuona kha ama para aa.

Capa ning thueta ca i hihaana kha iema cunglie myi ie ta a ie aa. Iema kha thaw'a yi angte iema'a taata i hmie kha i nu aa; iema ca anata tah para khupa cuo'a yi te, ciy aa chiypa ruvnaana ta a tlungsue'a yi. Capa ning thueta ca iema ta, ‘Kiema hrawlie ima Khazing a aw li nakaw tana hingpa ruvnaana hing ma cunglie a tlung cuo va ma?,’ ama ta aa.
Hmang pha lipa ama tuepa bangkhuo hne khazing hrangpa'a luo amaa pali nakawta capa ning thueta ca i hmie kha i nu khuo hrahring'a yi.
Caacuonakawta hingpa hlaa hing cape la Israel ming kha chang tie yi; kama cuota, i dunapa yi tehte cuo riypata ama hmya lie kha chi tie.

Tahematapakieca ama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie pi riypata chie i sapa, khyitiy hne cuehnung langnapa ruo luo kha a chiy yi angte, ama riy bisa pata ning yi te ama thu tiyta, khazing hrangpa tie'a luo kha a maa'a yi te amaa bie aa, na ese'a yi te i biekuona kha ama para aa.

Cakhutaata ciy aa chiysapa ruvnaana kha ama cunglie a tlung tiyta, hingpa hlaa hingta iema a du pata tehte a cuo aa, tahematapakieca hingpa hlaa hing ama ciypathla zaw hmya lie kha vie the'a vyi. Chiesana ta bie i kuopa yi ruo chung luo i chiykhyi hluo yi, ata hingta hmuo khaapama ama tue khing tapa kha i pachang,” a ta.
Capa ning hrahring lie ca ta Moses ta hlaa ca cape te Israel ming kha a pacuv yi.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Nun sacapaa Joshua kha re pi te, “Cahra la na rie pha se, tahematapakieca nama na Israel ming hing bie i kuopa yi ruo luo kha a sikhyi'a yi ciy; Kama na caa awpuo'a ang,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Moses ta phungbie chunglie bie bangkhuo kha caa-uv chunglie a chuona te a cape diy khutaata,
Abyipanawbie thingkaw a puvlepa Levi ming kha ku yi te,
“Hingpa phungbie caa-uv hing la ung la, Abyipanama Khazing biekuona nawbie thingkaw kielie kha chi tie ung; niema a du pata tehte ta cuo pari naase.
