Tahematapakieca niema ca kha tluv ta du a hmuopa hne a palung lepa tama nama cuo tapa kha ica pachang yi. Kama i hring chunglie hmuota Abyipakha hing tluv ta namaa du kieca, kama i thiy khutaa changchiy ca kha tluv tama namaa du hryly aa!
Nama phang uvthyi tie bangkhuo hne byi tie kha kama'a luo a vya hmya tie ung, alyi hne avuo kha iema a du pata tehte cuo riypata hingpa bie zaw hing ama thyina lie ri naase ang.

Tahematapakieca i thiy khutaata ca hmang pha lipa kha za tue ngiethie'a ung cate, bie ica pipa yi luopuv taata nama pie aa. Abyipahmungna lie kha a pha lipa tue'a ung cate, nama kuv ta a hriepa re ta a hi kha nama pahaa'a nakawta, ruvnaana ta aca tlungsue'a yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Moses ta Israel ming cawsaazaapuv hmiekunglie kha hingpa hlaa bie hing a chuona te ta a ri:
Vya avuo zaw, na naathlie tie ung, ri'a ang; alyi ta i pakaa ta i ripa bie hing thyi se.
I pacuvna ca khy haata saa sala, i bie ca aduo haata tla se; aphuv cunglie myithliy a hipa haata hne chinghmya cunglie khy a saapa haata cuo se.
Tahematapakieca Abyipaming khana i ukhyi aa; Lesyina ca ma Khazing kha pi tie ung.
Alungpuvnung, a re ca tluo a tling, a luopuv bangkhuo ca biedangpa liena a cuo. Zang tluo aa tlapa Khazing, dungviena a hnyi lipa, ama ca a dang te a phapa tana a cuo.
A zya pha lipa a saata zaw na a cunglie pha lina a tue yi, a sichiepa hne a zyatepa tana ama cuo.
Vya a ngaapa hne ruena a hnyi lipa cawsaa zaw, Abyipama hing haa hingta nama thung aa? Ama ca na paa, nama caa sapa, nama caa tuepa hne caa pacusatuv cuo va ma?
A khung ciepa ning zaw kha a thyi pakhaa tie, malie a lawse karaa tlipa kung zaw kha pacuo pakhaa tie; na paa kha hiehriy la aca pachang sa aa; na uvthyi tie kha hiehriy yi la aca chang'a yi.
Cungnungce ta mingphang zaw kha ru pi yi te, cawsaa kha a che tiy yi ta, Israel ming ama hluv ama caw kha ziy pata, cawsaa zaw ruoriy kha a thlaapa yi.
Abyipaa cuvu ca a cawsaa zaw khata cuo yi te, Jakob ca ama cuvu tana a cuo.
Ama ta ruocaapa, thliy dyi aa hrungnapa lie kha hmung te, phya haata pakhuo te a mangchiy, a mingpavaata haa khata a mangchiy.
Hmungthlu ta a buv kha cahang te, a taata cunglie kha vaa zu te, a mathlaa kha pake te, a cunglie a patuv khutaa yi ta, aa zukhyipa haa yi ta,
Abyipapakha kyalya na ama kha luo a chiy; ruohrang khazing kha ama hneta aw ra vyi.
Ama ta ruo aa suopa daw lie kha chi te, lu lie a vyipa ta a riy a caw, lungkuo khyipuv tiy hne vuokhawlung chungtaata chiytiy khata a caw.
Cuehnung a kaapa hne, tuvhnung, tuvtaata hne tuvtungpa thu, Bashan cuetungpa hne mie zaw ca, Jungsacuo pha cepa hne khata ning cate, mingsuv thiy taata a pha cepa mingsuvtiy kha na dang.
Jakob ca a riy bi pata ning te, Jeshurun ca thusa te, a phyi a pachi. Na thu, na ping, na chaakaluv! Ama ta a sapa Khazing kha thaw te, ama khuona Alungpuvnung kha a tue hyalya.
Iema ta ruohrang khazing abie pata ama kha a hietlie riypata ama tue, duv aa chiypa hmang ta a hi ama pahaa.
Khazing'a lie cuo li pata, ama pachang buo lipa, a thaa bala ta a vya chiypa khachie, mingchingmingvuo tie zaw ta ama za ciyzaa buo lipa, khachie'a lie kha hriykhung amaa ri.
Nama na puvnapa Alungpuvnung kha siysaa ri lipa cata, nama caa sapa Khazing kha na maw.
Abyipata khapa kha hmung te hietliena a hnyi, a sacapaa hne a sacanung zaw kha a thaw yi.
Ama ta: I hmie kha nukhuo'a yi angte, ama chuonapa khana i mang'a yi; tahematapakieca iema ca a sichiepa chuo, zang tluo aa tla lipa saata tana ama cuo.

Iema ta khazing a cuo lipa hmang khata i hie na patlie sa yi te, ama kuvtuezuv ta i hi ina pahaa yi. Caacuonakawta cawsaa a cuo lipa khata ama hie patlie sa'a yi angte, a ngaapa mingphang ta ama hi i pahaa'a yi.
I hihaana ta myi pahlaa te, Sheol aa thuvna hmang te a kuo; alyi hne a thyipaa bangkhuo kha uv diy'a te, tluo thabaw zaw kha a kuo diy aa.
Ama cunglie rana kha hi'a angte, i cuoti kha iema a duna ta i hmuo aa:
nangdiy pata vievuv'a yi te, a kuo ta a kuopa riethyina hne a ruvsapa puvtlung pasana ta a tlungsue'a yi. Saahruo haa zaw hne buvcing lie a valepa pariy ca-ie zaw kha iema a du riypata i pathlie aa.
Satlie hne lesaa, haaseta hne nungpuv macuo zaw kha luopuv lie zueziy ta thiepa cuo'a yi te,
iema kha chepatlaa diy riypa hne cawsaa zaw ta amaa thyi riypa taa khata i hruv diy'a yi ta pata i rue.

Cuorasala carie tie ta i hi ina pahaa riypa yi kha i ciy, tahematapakieca ama carie tie ta, “Ma kuv tana ma te yi, ta pata a law'a yi te, Hingpa bangkhuo a tuepa hing Abyipacuo vyi,” ta pata ama rue riypa khana i ciy.
Iema ca ruena a hnyi lipa mingphang tana ama cuo; ama chunglie pachangna aw vyi.
Sing yi sala, hingpa hing ama pachang the aa; a chuona lie khaapama a cuo aa tapa kha ama rue khu aa.
Amaa Lungpuvnung ta a zaa li kie yi hne, Abyipata iema kha a thaw li kie yi ca, tuokhaatama pakha ta thawkha kha a cade yi te, pahning ta thawhraa kha amaa cade khu aa?
Iema amaa lungpuvnung ca kiema Alungpuvnung hne a lu vyi; ma carie tie ca a ngaapa na a cuo yi.
Ama mingsuv kung ca Sodom mingsuv kungpuvnung hne Gomorrah mingsuv diedung taata a vawpa tana a cuo; ama mingsuv thyi ca ca-ie a hnyipa cuo te, a mingsuv baw ca a kha;
ama mingsuvtiy ca pariy ca-ie ta cuo te, ciy aa chiypa pariy ca-ie ruvsapa tana a cuo.
Hingpa hing kama'a lie pacung angte, i suethiy thingkaw lie i hrepuopa cuo va ma?
Ama phyi a pahnie ningta phuvlana hne vieriy thung ca kama huopa tana a cuo. Tahematapakieca ama rana riypa ning ca i kuv liena a aw; ama duotena ning ca a catlisa pata na aa vaw.

Hmisi ta ca, ama cahrana chuo te, ciypakipa cuose, hya a zangpa cuose, a ngaa va tli yi tapa kha a hmung tiyta, Abyipata a cawsaa zaw ama sue lina kha paluosa'a te, a changtaapa zaw cunglie kha kawpacuona a hnyi'a yi.
Cakhutaata ama ta: Ama khazing tie ca khaapaliema ama aw, ama canawnapa alung,
hriykhung amaa rinapa saathupa a ningpa hne dangpa ta panaana mingsuvtiy a dangpa tie ca khaapaliema ama aw? Thu yi sala caa bya yi se, niema caa khuotuv ta cuo yi se!

Ata hing ca pachang tie ung, Kama, kama tlarya hing, ama ca cuo angte, Kama ta lipa hingta Khazing hrangpa aw vyi. Kama ta thie angte, kama ta i pahring; kama ta hmaa paphya angte, kama ta i patluo sa; I kuv taata naa chuv khupa ahunghmuo aw va yi.
Tahematapakieca i kuv kha avuo luo pazu angte chie i sa: Chuozaa ta i hringpa haata,
Aa li dyi a lipa i zueziy kha cata angte, i kuv ta bieripana kha a patuv tiyta, i carie tie cunglie kha phuv la'a angte, naa huepa tie kha i thung'a yi.
I cuoti kha thiyse pariy sa'a angte, i zueziy ta saa a ce aa, thiepa hne hruocawsaa tie thiy hne a suo syipa carie tie luv taa khata dang'a yi te ama ce aa.

Vya mingphang zaw, a cawsaa kha pathuosa tie ung, khazing tie bangkhuo zaw, ama kha abie tie ung! Tahematapakieca ama ta a saata zaw thiyse phuv kha la'a te, a carie tie'a lie kha phuv a la aa; ama a huepa tie kha thung'a yi te, a cawsaa cuota ruo kha a pathe sa aa.
Moses ta a vaw te hingpa hlaa chunglie bie bangkhuo kha cawsaa zaw thyipa ta a ri, ama hne Nun sacapaa Joshua ta ama ri.
Moses ta hingpa bie bangkhuo hing Israel ming bangkhuo'a lie a ri khutaata,

Iema kyihuo khata: “Niema'a lie tehte cuo riypata ataning ica changpa yi bie hing nama palung lie pari tie ung; hingpa phungbie bangkhuo hing a phasa pata ama ziy riypata nama saata zaw kha bie pi tie ung.
Hingpa hing niema cuota hmang cawnuta tah cuo vyi, cuorasala nama hringna hrahring tana a cuo; hingpa hing tana cu riypata Jordan nama va te hnuepa ruo lieta nama chuo a pasiy aa,” a ta.
Capa ning lie hrahring ca ta Abyipata Moses kha hing haa hingta a chang:
“Jeriko huesuo, Moab ruo chung, Abarim tluothlue, Nebo tluo luo kha kie la ru riypata Israel ming i pipa, Kanaan ruo kha suo tie;
na uvta Aaron ca Hor Tluo cunglie kha thiy te a cawsaa zaw'a luo pahmya pata a cuopa haata, na kiepa tluo lie kha thiy'a cate, na cawsaa zaw'a luo kha pahmya pata na cuo aa.
Tahematapakieca Zin ruocaapa lie Meribath-kadesh tiy lie, Israel ming hrawlie kha kama'a lie zangna kha nama pahning ta nama para.
Ruo kha luohlaa taata na suo raalaa'a pata, a chung luo a ngie'a vaciy, kama ta Israel ming i pipa yi ruo luo kha,” a ta.
Hingpa hing Khazing cawsaapa Moses ta a thiy hluota Israel ming thluechiy a pipa yi ta a cuo.

Ama ta: Khazing ca Sinai taa tana aa vaw, Seir taata kiema cung luo kha za pa-ie te, Paran Tluo taata a za khe. Ama hne a vaw pakhawpa ca mingpathepa thawhraa ta ama cuo; a cacuoluo kuv lie myi iepa aa cyi.
A cuo, a cawsaa zaw kha a due yi, a cawsaa pathepa bangkhuo ca ama'a liena ama aw; na phyi thabaw luo kha a vya ngie yi te, na bie kha ama naathlie.
Jakob cawsaazaapuv ta cu riypa phungbie kha Moses ta malie a pi.
A palung aa lupa Israel phang tie, cawsaa tie luochiytuv zaw amaa hmya tiyta, Jeshurun chunglie kha siepahruo a cuo.
Mingluv ta ama caw raalaa pata, Reuben ca hring sala, thiy khah se.
Judah kawlieta hingpa hing a ri: Vya AbyipaJudah ueryi kha naathlie la, a cawsaa zaw'a luo kha a chiy tie; a kuv ca a cuota thaa patlung la, a carie tie a du riypa kha a bya tie.

Cakhutaata Levi kaw kha a ri. Nama huopa Thummim ca Levi kha pi la, na huopa Urim ca na cuota aa dangpa paa kha pi tie, Massah lie dyapasya cate, Meribah acaa lie kha zang tluo ama cuona ca na pacu sa.
A nung hne a paa kha “siysaa ri va yi ang,” a ta. A uvnu kha maw te, a saata zaw kha pachang va yi. Tahematapakieca na bie kha naathlie yi te, na biekuo kha ama ziy.
Iema ta Jakob kha na ziyphung pacuv yi te, Israel kha na phungbie ama pacuv; na hmiekunglie kha rangpa-ue chi yi te, na bienatluophie lie kha a pangpa yalya ta myirue panaana aca pihluo yi.
Vya Abyipa, a suethiy kha thluechiy pi la, a kuv ta a hriepa re kha cuhluo tie; amaa kya daa pakhaa khu li riypata ama a huepa a carie tie sesie kha thli tie.
Benjamin kaw a ripa ca: Abyipata a duepa paa ca aa bangsa pata na aa pahy, Cungnungce Khazing ta ning-aw ta a cadung, a letung hne a letung alalalie na a chi.
Cakhutaata Josef kaw kha a ri: A ruo ca Abyipathluechiy pipa ta cuo se, cungluo avuo lasaw pha cepa, rawluo tiy aa thuvpa lasaw pha cepa hne,
ningsaa ta a papuvpa thyipaa pha cepa, thlaapa ta a papuvpa thyipaa sungnaapa;
hluoning taata a awpa tluo zaw thyipaa pha cepa, chuozaa aa hmangpa tluo zaw thyipaa hluvpuv tie;
alyi taata a pyapa a pha cepa lasaw phangtling, Sinai lie a awpa paa duena; hingpa thluechiy zaw hing Josef luv cunglie, a uvnu zaw hrawlie byi a cuopa lakiy lie kha tlung mang sue.

Sahrangta cuetungpa linghlaa ca ama huopa tana a cuo! a kiy zaw ca calie kiy tana ama cuo; a kiy ta cawsaa kha de yi te, alyi dena te ta aa cade yi; capa tie ca Efraim ming thaw saw hluvpuv tie hne, Manasseh tie thaw hluvpuv tie ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata Zebulun kaw kha a ri: Zebulun, na pyana luo lie a law la; Issakhar ca na thluodaa chunglie a law tie.
Iema ta cawsaa kha tluocung luo ku yi te, capa lie ca aa dangpa hriykhungrina ama tue; tahematapakieca iema ta riyliy hnyirungna hne viehnang ta a nupa suethiy kha ama cu.
Cakhutaata Gad kaw kha a ri: Gad ruo pakusana ca thluechiy pata cuo mang sue! Gad ca chingde haa tana a aw; buo hne luvvang kha a hlepatlaa.

Ama cuota a pha cepa kha a tlaw te, tahematapakieca capa lie cana luochiytuv cuvu kha chipa pata a cuo; cawsaa tie luv cuona cangta a vaw te, Abyipahmang dangpa hne, Israel ming cuota ziyphung zaw kha tluo a tling riypata a hrie.
Cakhutaata Dan kaw kha a ri: Dan ca chingdetaata, Bashan taata zaa zupa tana a cuo.
Cakhutaata Naftali kaw kha a ri: Vya Naftali, tlechuona hneta a bipa, Abyipathluechiy ta a bipa, ningchiy ruo hne ningtla ruo kha cu tie.
Cakhutaata Asher kaw kha a ri: Sacapaa zaw hrawlie thluechiy cepa ca Asher ta cuo se; ama ca a uvnu zaw tlechuopa cuo se, a phyipazaa ca chiytiy chunglie paci se.
Na thlake hrenapa sung ca thaa hne daa ta cuo sala, na hring chung bangkhuo na thaa tlungsa se.
Vya Jeshurun, Khazing haapa ahunghmuo aw va yi, nama a bya riypata avuo kha a khang te, avuo lie khiy linghlaa ta a bi.
Hluoning khazing tie kha te yi te, a hlungpa cahrana kha a dechi diy; carie kha na hmiekung taata a cade te, “Para tie!” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Israel ca aa bangta tah aw te, Jakob ciyhruo lie ca ruvnaana aw'a vyi, sa hne mingsuvtiy ta a binapa ruo, avuo ta aduo a za patlasanapa ruo lie ca.

Vya Israel, alawna ca nama huopa tana a cuo! nama haapa ahungma a aw? Abyipata a khuopa cawsaa cuo cate, ama ca naa phya hne caa byatuv, na tena zueziy tana a cuo! Na carie zaw ca na hmiekunglie kha a vya bu'a yi te, na phyi ta ama ke kha na tlaw aa.
Cakhutaata Moses ca Moab ase ruo taa khata Jeriko huesuo ruo lie a awpa Nebo Tluo, Pisgah tluodaw luo kha kie te, Abyipata ruo bangkhuo ca a pahmung sa: Gilead ruo ca Dan te ta,
Naftali ruo bangkhuo, Efraim hne Manasseh ruo, Judah ruo bangkhuo kha Ningtla Riyliy te ta,
Negeb ruo, hne ase ruo, Jeriko bawphie, tungkung khypuv Zoar te ta.

Abyipata ama kyihuo khata, “Hingpa hing Abraham, Isak, hne Jakob zaw'a lieta, ‘Nama ciypathla zaw na i pi'a yi,’ ta pata chie i sapa ruo tana a cuo. Na ming ta ca pahmung sa angte, cuorasala huepa luo hue ca va zang'a vaciy,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipachangtaapa Moses ca Abyipabiekuona lie, Moab ruo lie kha a thiy.
Ama ca Beth-peor a rie-e Moab bawphie ruo lie kha ama paby, cuorasala ataning tepa hingta ama pabynapa hmang kha ahungtahmuo pachang va yi.
Moses ca a thiy ning kha kung zakha kung kiy a ta tli; a ming zing vyi, a thaazuo cung vyi.
Israel ming ta Moses kha Moab ase ruo lieta ning sawthung ama caa; cakhutaata Moses muochiesanapa cuo ca a chuo.
Nun sacapaa Joshua ca Moses ta a cunglie a kuv a khang nakawta, singna thlaapa ta a bi, caacuonakawta Israel ming ta ama kha pa-uvsathyi yi te, Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haa khata ama tue.
Capa cuo taa cata Abyipata hmie a pachaw pata a pachangpa, Moses haapa profet ca Israel ming chunglie pya buo va tli.
Izipt ruo chunglie, Faro hne a changtaapa zaw bangkhuo hne ruo chung bangkhuo lie pamangsana hne kharuehaa hmang, Abyipata Moses a patue sapa haapa hne
a cahrapa a hmang tuena hne a cahrapa ciy aa chiypa paluosana, Moses ta Israel ming bangkhuo hmiekunglie a tuepa haata a tue khupa cawsaa hrangpa ahunghmuo aw va yi.
Abyipachangtaapa Moses a thiy khutaata Moses a byatuv, Nun sacapaa Joshua kha Abyipata,
“I changtaapa Moses ca a thiy tli. Caacuonakawta nama hne hingpa cawsaa zaw bangkhuo hingta Jordan cavaa kha va te ung la iema, Israel ming i pipa yi ruo chung luo ca vaa ngie tie ung.
Nama phyipazaa ta a chaa riypa hmang bangkhuo ca Moses'a lie bie i kuopa haa khata niema na ica pi yi.
Ruocaapa chungtaata hne Lebanon taata cavaa lepa Eufrates cavaa te, Hit ming ruo bangkhuo, ningtlaluo Riyliy Lepa te ta nama ruo a cuo aa.
Na hring chung bangkhuo ta ahunghmuo na hmiekunglie a daa khupa aw'a va yi. Moses i awpuopa haa khata nama zaw ica awpuo ra aa; ca pathlahla'a va ang, ca thaw'a va ang.
Cahra la na rie pha se; tahematapakieca hingpa cawsaa zaw hing ama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie pi riypata chie i sapa ruo kha ru ta na pacu sa'a yi.
Cahra la na rie phasa se, i changtaapa Moses ta bie aca pipa haa khata a raaringsa pata aw tie, na cakuona mekaa lie tena na hmung riypata hingpa taa hingta cacuoluo cuose, cavyiluo cuose amaa khah.

Hingpa phungbie caa-uv hingta na pakaa kha pyase khah se, hingpa chunglie aa capepa haa hingta a raaringsa pata na aw the riypata hingpa hing chung zuo ta rue tie. Tahematapakieca cakhutaa ca tana kha-aw taw'a cate tena na hmung aa.
Bie na ica pi: Cahra la na rie pha se; na thlaa zang khah se, na palung zaw ra khah se, tahematapakieca Abyipana Khazing ca na cakuona bangkhuo lieta naa thaalie aca awpuo pari,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Joshua ta byi tie kha bie a pi yi,

“Arina hmang chunglie kha a khie ung la cawsaa zaw kha bie pi tie ung: ‘Zuorie a ring ung; ning thung chunglie hingta Abyipanama Khazing ta cu riypata aca pipa yi ruo kha cu riypata Jordan cavaa kha nama va te aa,’ ta tie ung,” a ta yi.
Reuben phang, Gad phang, hne Manasseh phang khingkhuo kha Joshua ta,
“Abyipachangtaapa Moses ta, ‘Abyipanama Khazing na namaa pahyna riypa ruo, hingpa ruo hing caa pi yi,’ aca tapa yi bie kha a thyi pari tie ung.

Nama napuv zaw, nama saata zaw, hne nama sahring zaw ca Moses ta aca pipa yi Jordan cavaa hing suo lie hing amaa zaa tuo siy aa. Cuorasala niema hrawtaata cawsaa riephapa bangkhuo ca cehre a la pata nama uvnu zaw hmiekunglieta Jordan kha va te ung la,

Abyipata nama uvnu zaw cuose, niema cuose, a pahyna cuo aca pina te yi, Abyipanama Khazing ta cu riypata a pipa yi ruo kha ama cu rana te ta iema kha namaa bya aa. Cakhutaata Abyipachangtaapa Moses ta aca pipa yi Jordan cavaa ningchiyluo ruo, nama ruo ta a cuopa luo kha kaa ung la va cu tie ung,” a ta.
Iema ta Joshua kha: “Nama ta bie malie na pipa bangkhuo kha ma tue aa, khaapa luo malie na paphya zawta ma si aa.
Zezaw bangkhuo lieta Moses ri maa ngiepa haata, nama ri zaw maacaa ngie aa. Abyipana Khazing ta Moses a awpuopa haa khata nama zaw ca awpuo ra se!
Ahung a cuo zaw, na bie caa ipa hne a ziy lipa ca thie pata cuo se. Cadyiseca cahra la na rie pha se,” ama ta.

Cakhutaata Nun sacapaa Joshua ta Shittim taa khata ngiepatlietuv pahning kha a paruvta tah pathlie yi te, “Si ung la ruo kha vaa ngiepatlie tie ung, a pa-i vie ta Jeriko kha,” a ta yi. Caacuonakawta si yi te, Rahab ama ta nung, siyhrawnung ing luo kha a ngie yi te, amaa ri.
Jeriko siepahruo kha, “Israel ming chekha na ruo a ngiepatlie riypata hingpa luo hing ata zuo a vya chiy yi,” ta pata ama chang.

Cakhutaata Jeriko siepahruo ta Rahab kha bie pi te, “Nama'a luo a vawpa, na ing luo a ngiepa tie kha kya papya tie yi, tahematapakieca ma ruo bangkhuo a ngiepatlie riypata a vawpa tana ama cuo,” a ta.
Cuorasala cawsaanung ca ta capaa pahning tie ca a nu yi. Cakhutaata, “Aa hmuo, cawsaa zaw ca amaa vaw, khaapa taata ma amaa vaw tapa ca pachang va ang.
Khy zing te khypuv thlake khaa tiy a tapa kha tana ama pya. Khaapa luo ma ama pya tapa ca pachang va ang. A catli pata namaa cade kieca nama pha thluo aa,” a ta.
Cadyiseca, ingcung luo kha kiekhyi yi te, ingcung lie a zepa burikung lie kha a nu yi.
Caacuonakawta Jordan luo sinapa luopuv luo kha tiyhaa tena hmang te ta ama vaa cade. A vya huvpa tie ama pya pahne ta khypuv thlake kha a khaa.
Iema amaa hmung hluo khata, ingcung luo kha kie te,

cawsaa tie kyihuo khata, “Abyipata hingpa ruo hing aca pi tli yi tapa kha i pachang, niema ima ca ciynapa yi ta hingpa ruo lie khy a sapa bangkhuo ca nama hmiekunglie aa cathang dyina amaa cathang tli.

Tahematapakieca Izipt taata nama vya pya ning kha Abyipata nama hmiekunglie tuokhaatama Riyliy Sepa tiy a paky sa tapa hne, Jordan cavaa huesuoluo lie a awpa Amor siepahruo tie Sihon hne Og zaw kha tuokhaata tue ung cate ma nama para diy tapa kha ma thyi mangtli.
Capa ca ma thyi pahne ta niema kawlieta ma palung rasa te, ahung'a lie hmuo riephana aw khu vyi. Abyipanama Khazing ca cungluo vuoruo lie hne rawluo alyi lie Khazing hmisi tana a cuo.
Cakhutaata ata hing ca, niema'a lie duena i tuepa haata i ingchungkhue cunglie Abyipaming ta duena nama tue hriy riypata chie naa sa ung la,
i paa hne i nung, i caapaapa zaw i nutanung zaw hne iema huopa bangkhuo, ma hringna hing thiyna taata malie nama khuo riypata zangna phapa pamangsana na pi tie ung,” a ta.

Cawsaa tie ca ta, “Ma hringna ca niema hringna cuo tana a cuo! Hingpa ma re hriepa hingna na phu va tapa kieca, Abyipata ruo malie a pi tiyta, na cunglie hing duena hne zang tluo aa tlapa ta ma tue aa,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata thlaluo-aw taata khuhriy ta a pathla yi, tahematapakieca a ing ca khy dungkhuona lungruetlepie kie lieta sapa ta cuo te ama ca lungruetlepie chung luo khata a aw.

Ama ta iema kha, “Caa cadepa tie ta aca hmung li riypa yi ta tluocung ruo luo kha si tie ung. Caa cadepa tie ama vya kaana te ta ning thung chung a nu ung la, cakhutaa cata nama khingna luo kha si tie ung,” a ta yi.
Cawsaa tie ca ta ama kyihuo khata, “Chie malie na pasa sapa dyi hingta ca suebepa ta cuo khah se puv.

Ruo hing ma vya la tiyta malie na pathlanapa thlaluo-aw taa hingta hingpa palaariy sepa hing za pathlie tie, cakhutaata na paa hne na nung, na caapaapa zaw hne na ingchungkhue bangkhuo kha na ing chunglie hing na za pahmya'a yi.

Ahunghmuo cuo ung la, na ingchiypakaa taata luopuv luo ama pya kieca, ama thiy kie zaw iema suena kawlie cuo'a te, kiema luv cunglie tla khah se; cuorasala na ing chunglie a awpa ahung cunglie hmuota kuv pathliepa a cuo kieca ama thiyna ca kiema luv cunglie tla se.
Cuorasala hingpa ma re hriepa hing na phu kieca, kiema ca na cunglie bie malie na pakuosapa taa hingta ma law aa,” ama ta.
Ama ta, “Nama bie haata cuo mang sue,” a ta. Pathlie yi te ama si. Cakhutaata palaariy sepa kha thlaluo-aw taa cata a pathlie.
Iema ca tluocung luo kha si yi te a cadepa tie ama vya kaana te, ning thung chung tluo cunglie kha ama aw. A cadetuv tie ta luopuv tlungluo khata huv yi te hmung va yi.
Cakhutaata cawsaa pahning tie ca tluocung ruo taa khata ama za cung pakhaa. Cavaa kha va te yi te, Nun sacapaa Joshua'a luo kha a vaw yi te, hmang a cuopa bangkhuo kha ama chang.

Iema ta Joshua kyihuo khata, “Abyipata ruo kha ma kuv chung luo malie a pi hmisi saw tli; ca hlyitaw taata, ruo chunglie khy a sapa bangkhuo ca kiema kha malie ama ciy nakawta ama palung a rasa,” ama ta.
Joshua ca mawdiy ta thu te Israel ming bangkhuo hne khata Shittim taata amaa thu. Jordan cavaa ama va te hluo khata amaa ri.
Ning thung khutaata byi tie ta arina hmang lie kha a khie yi te,
cawsaa kha, “Abyipanama Khazing biekuona thingkaw kha Levi tluobyi tie ta amaa puvlepa nama hmung tiyta nama awna hmang taa khata thu'a ung cate nama ziy aa.

Tahematapakieca hingpa luo hing nama si buo li lie nakawta nama sina riypa luopuv kha nama pachang na a hu. Cuorasala niema hne biekuona thingkaw alalalie kha daw thawhning tluv aa hla aa; capa laa cata a ngie vie'a va ung ciy,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Joshua ta cawsaa tie kha, “A pathe tie ung; tahematapakieca mawluo khiy Abyipana nama hrawlie kharuehaa hmang a tue aa,” a ta.
Joshua ta tluobyi tie kyihuo khata, “Biekuona thingkaw kha la ung la cawsaa tie hmie luo kha ta si tie ung,” a ta. Caacuonakawta biekuona thingkaw kha la yi te, cawsaa zaw hmie luo khata ama si.

Abyipata Joshua kyihuo khata, “Kama ca Moses'a lie i awpa haa khata nama'a lie i aw aa tapa kha ama pachang the riypata nama kha Israel ming bangkhuo hmiekunglie ataning taa hingta cyicalang hruo ica pathu aa.
Biekuona thingkaw a puvpa tluobyi tie kha, ‘Jordan cavaa kie nama chiy tiyta Jordan cavaa chunglie kha namaa daa pari aa,’ ta pata bie a pituv ta na cuo aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Joshua ta Israel ming kha, “Naa vya ngie ung la Abyipanama Khazing bie hing naathlie tie ung,” a ta yi.

Joshua ta, “Niema hrawlie a awpa a hringpa Khazing ta Kanaan ming, Hit ming, Hiv ming, Periz ming, Girgash ming, Amor ming hne Jebus ming zaw kha niema hmiekung taata patlyi li pata aa cade'a yi tapa kha hingpa hing tana nama pachang aa:
Alyicung bangkhuo tie Abyipabiekuona thingkaw ca nama hmiekunglieta Jordan cavaa huesuo kha a va zang aa.
Caacuonakawta ata hingta Israel ming phang zaw chungtaata cawsaa hlyihning, phang kha chungtaata pakha kaluo kha a tlaw tie yi.
Alyicung bangkhuo tie Abyipabiekuona thingkaw a puvpa tluobyi tie phyipazaa ta Jordan cavaa tiy ama tlaw tiyta, cungluo taata zaa langpa Jordan cavaa tiy ca ci'a te, suv kha ta aa pating aa.
Cawsaa ca Jordan te riypata ama thluodaa taata ama pya tiyta, biekuona thingkaw a puvpa tie ca cawsaa hmie luo khata ama si.
Sa hrie cuo chung palang ca Jordan cavaa ca tiy le te a kaw a bi. Biekuona thingkaw a puvpa tie Jordan luo vya chiy yi te tiy kie lie ama phyi ta ama tlaw pahne ta,

cungluo taata zaa langpa tiy ca suv kha ta a pating te, Zarethan khypuv athaalie a awpa Adam khy te khata a liy ta aa kya ang. Arabah riyliy, Riyliy Thiypa luo a langpa tiy ca a ci karue. Cakhutaata cawsaa ca Jeriko a dadaw lie khata ama va te.

Israel ming bangkhuo ta alyi huvpa lie ama va te chung, ama mingphang yalya ta Jordan ama va te khuna te khata, biekuona thingkaw a puvpa tluobyi tie ca Jordan cavaa khingkhuo alyi huvpa lie kha amaa daa.
Ama mingphang yalya ta Jordan ama te diy khutaata, Abyipata Joshua kyihuo khata,
“Cawsaa zaw chung taa khata cawsaa hlyihning a tlaw la, phang kha taata pakha ta a cuo aa,

iema kha, ‘Hingpa Jordan cavaa a liekhingkhuo, tluobyi tie phyi tlawnapa taa hingta alung hlyihning la ung la, a kya puvle ung la ata zuo namaa rina hmang lie kha bang tie ung,’ ta pata bie pi tie yi,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata Joshua ta Israel ming chungtaata, phang kha chungtaata pakha kaluo ta a tlawpa cawsaa hlyihning kha a ku yi.
Joshua ta iema kha, “Abyipanama Khazing biekuona thingkaw hmie luo, Jordan cavaa khingkhuo luo kha vaa ung la, Israel mingphang zaa ta, pakha ta alung suokha law ta a kya puv tie ung.
Nama saata zaw ta, ‘Hingpa alung zaw hing khaapa siyluo tama ama cuo? aca ta tiy yi ta, niema cuota pamangsana ta a cuo aa.

Ca tiyta niema ta Abyipabiekuona thingkaw hmielieta na Jordan cavaa tiy kha a ci nama ta aa. Jordan a va te ning khana Jordan tiy ca a ci. Caacuonakawta hingpa alung zaw hing Israel ming cuota a thyi parina tana a cuo aa,” a ta.

Israel ming ca Joshua ta bie a pipa haa yi khata ama tue. Abyipata Joshua a changpa haa khata, Israel ming ama phang zaa khata Jordan cavaa a liekhingkhuo taata alung hlyihning kha la yi te, amaa rina hmang luo kha a kya puvle yi te capa lie ca ama bang.
(Joshua ta Jordan cavaa liekhingkhuo lie, biekuona thingkaw a puvpa tluobyi tie phyi ta a tlawna hmang lie kha alung hlyihning bang te, ataning tepa hingta capa lie ca a aw.)

Moses ta Joshua bie a za pipa bangkhuo haa khata Abyipata Joshua kha cawsaa zaw chang riypa yi ta bie a pipa bangkhuo a chuo hluo li, biekuona thingkaw a puvpa tie ca Jordan cavaa khingkhuo lie kha amaa daa. Cawsaa ca a pahraasa pata ama va te.
Cawsaa bangkhuo ama va te diy khu pahne ta, Abyipabiekuona thingkaw hne tluobyi tie ca cawsaa zaw hmiekunglie kha ama va te.
Moses ta bie a pipa yi haa khata, Reuben phang, Gad phang, hne Manasseh phang khingkhuo ca ama cehre hneta Israel ming hmiekunglie kha ama va te.
Rie du riypata cehre a patuvpa thawpaliy hraw ca rie tuv riypata cavaa ca va te yi te Jeriko ase ruo luo kha ama si.
Capa ning lie ca ta Abyipata Joshua kha Israel ming bangkhuo hmiekunglie kha cyicalang te Moses ama ciyzaapa haa khata ama chuo chung ta ama kha ama ciyzaa.
Abyipata Joshua kyihuo khata,
“Biekuona thingkaw a puvpa tluobyi tie kha Jordan cavaa taata ama kya pya riypata bie pi tie yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Joshua ta tluobyi tie kha, “Jordan taata kya pya tie ung,” a ta yi.

Abyipabiekuona thingkaw a puvpa tluobyi tie kha Jordan cavaa khingkhuo taata kya pya yi te, tluobyi tie bangkhuo ama phyipazaa kha alyi huvpa a tlaw diy pahne ta Jordan cavaa tiy ca iema hmang luo kha lang pakhaa te, a hluo haa khata a kaw lie kha a bi pakhaa.
Cawsaa ca thla khanapa a ning khana ning lie kha Jordan taata kya pya yi te, Jeriko ningchiyluo ruoriy lie a awpa Gilgal lie kha amaa ri.
Jordan taata ama lapa alung hlyihning kha Joshua ta Gilgal lie ca bang te,
Israel ming kyihuo khata, “Hmieluo thueta nama saata zaw ta, ‘Hingpa alung hing khaapa siyluo tama a cuo?’ aca ta tiy yi ta,
‘Israel ming na Jordan cavaa hing alyi huvpa lie a vya te yi,’ ta pata nama pachang sa aa.
Tahematapakieca kiema ma te khuna te ta tiy a pakysapa kha Abyipanama Khazing ta Riyliy Sepa lie a tuepa haata Abyipanama Khazing ta nama te diyna te ta Jordan cavaa tiy kha nama cuota a paky sa.
Tahematapakieca alyi cung cawsaa bangkhuo ta Abyipakuv ca a cahra tapa kha ama pachang riypa, hne Abyipanama Khazing kha chuozaa ta nama ciy thena riypa tana a cuo,” a ta.

Jordan cavaa huesuo, ningtlaluo a awpa Amor ming, hne riyliy kielie a awpa Kanaan siepahruo tie bangkhuo ta Israel ming ta ama te diy hluo li tana Jordan cavaa tiy kha Abyipata a paky sa tapa kha ama thyi tiyta, Israel ming kawlie khata, ama thlaa zang hringhruo te, ama palung a vie.
Capa cuo lie ca ta Abyipata Joshua kha, “Vuokhawlung cizung tue la Israel ming kha a yihningnapa ta vangdaw te tie yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Joshua ta vuokhawlung cizung tue te Israel ming kha Gibeath-haaraloth lieta vangdaw a te yi.
Joshua ta vangdaw a te hnuochuonapa yi ca: Izipt taata a vya pyapa capaa bangkhuo, rieka bangkhuo ca Izipt taata ama vya pya khutaata ruocaapa lie ama vya silenapa luopuv lie kha ama thiy diy.
A vya pyapa capaa bangkhuo kha vangdaw tepa ama za cuo raalaa pata, Izipt taata ama vya pya khutaata ruocaapa lie, luopuv lie a puvpa bangkhuo ca vangdaw a te valie yi.

Tahematapakieca Abyipaueryi kha ama naathlie li nakawta, ama phang yalya ta, Izipt taata a vya pyapa rieka, ama ra diy hluo li, Israel ming ca ruocaapa lie kha kung sawliy chung ama za vievuv. Iema kyihuo khata, Abyipata nama mingchingmingvuo tie kyihuo ta pi riypata chie i sapa ruo, cuehnung hne khyitiy a langnapa ruo kha ahunghmuo ca pahmung sa'a va yi ang ta pata chie aa sa.
Caacuonakawta iema cuota ama ta a padaapa yi ama saata zaw ca vangdaw amaa te li lie nakawta Joshua ta luopuv lieta vangdaw a te yi.
Ama phang yalya ta vangdawtena ama tue nakawta, iema ama tluona te ta amaa rina hmang lie kha ama aw.
Abyipata Joshua kyihuo khata, “Ataning hing Izipt nangzaana ca niema'a taata i thaw diy tli,” a ta. Caacuonakawta ataning tepa hingta capa hmang ca Gilgal ama ta.
Israel ming ca Gilgal lie amaa ri ning, capa thlaa ning hraa hlyipaliy ning zuoluo ta lawsena pyi kha Jeriko ase ruo lie ca ama tue.
Lawsena Pyi a mawluopa, capa ning lie caci cata, capa ruo taata a pyapa thiynung phuv lipa viechuo hne vie-aw kha ama ning.
Capa ruo taata a pyapa ama ning ningpa ca ta manna kha chuo te, Israel ming ta manna hnyi va tli yi; capa kung ca Kanaan ruo taata a pyapa sa kha ama ning.

Luo kha ca, Joshua kha Jeriko athaalie a aw pata a kya mang ca, a kuv lie a baw taata a da ciepa zueziy a hriepa cawsaa pakha a hmiekunglie aa daapa kha a hmung. Joshua ta ama'a luo kha vaa te, “Kiema cawsaa tama na cuo, carie tie tama na cuo?” a ta.

Capa paa ca ta, “Cuo va ang,” cuorasala Abyipariekaphuv uvtuv cuona tana ata hing i vaw,” a ta. Cakhutaata Joshua ca alyi lie kha a bu te aa bie; ama kyihuo khata, “I byipaapa, na changtaapa hing tuokhaapa bie ma ina pi ciy?” a ta.
Abyipariekabyipa ca ta Joshua kha, “Na phyipakaw kha thlie tie, tahematapakieca naa daanapa hmang hing hmang pathepa tana a cuo,” a ta. Joshua ta cahaacata a tue.
Israel ming kawlieta Jeriko ca a chungtaata cuose, ale taata cuose ama khaa karue; a ngiepa hne a pyapa pakha hmuo aw va yi.
Abyipata Joshua kha, “Mang tie, Jeriko hing a siepahruo hne a rieka zaw hne tana nama ica pi.
Khypuv kha cahlung'a cate, rieka bangkhuo ta chi kha ama cahlung aa. Cahaacata ning caruv chung nama tue aa.
Biekuona thingkaw hmiekunglie kha tluobyi pasariy ta tuvtungpa kiy hmyakaa kha amaa cyi aa. A ning sariyna lie kha khypuv ca yi sariy nama cahlung aa, tluobyi tie ta hmyakaa kha ama tung aa.

Tuvtungpa kiy kha a pasiysa pata ama tung tiyta, hmyakaa paringpa nama thyi pahne ta, cawsaa bangkhuo ca khuosa ta khi'a ung cate, khypuv dungkhuonapa lungruetlepie ca cing'a te, cawsaa bangkhuo ca hmieluo kha aa dangsa pata ama si aa.

Caacuonakawta Nun sacapaa Joshua ta tluobyi tie kha ku yi te, “Biekuona thingkaw kha la ung la, Abyipabiekuona thingkaw hmiekunglie kha tluobyi pasariy ta tuvtungpa kiy hmyakaa suosariy kha namaa cyi aa,” a ta.
Cawsaa zaw kyihuo khata, “Hmieluo kha si ung la khypuv kha cadung tie ung; cehre a cyipa tie kha Abyipabiekuona thingkaw hmieluo ta si yi se,” a ta.

Joshua ta cawsaa zaw kha bie a pipa haa yi ta, Abyipahmiekunglie tuvtungpa kiy hmyakaa a cyipa tluobyi pasariy ca hmyakaa ama tungpuopa khata hmaa sa yi te, Abyipabiekuona thingkaw ta iema kha a paziy yi.
Cakhutaata rieka tie kha hmyakaa a tungpa tluobyi tie hmiekung luo ta si yi te, hmyakaa ama tungpuo nguoluopa cata hnangluo rievetuv tie ca biekuona thingkaw hnang kha ama ziy.

Joshua ta cawsaa kha hingpa bie hing a pi yi: “Niema ca khi buo ung ica ta hluo li yi ta khi'a va ung ciy, nama ryi thyipa cuo khah se, bie zaw ri khah ung. Khi riypata ica chang ningpa te yi ta khi'a va ung ciy. Capa ning taa dyi ca tana nama khi aa,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta Abyipabiekuona thingkaw ca khypuv kha chi kha cahlung te, arina hmang chung luo a vaw yi te, arina hmang chunglie ca zuo kha amaa ri.
Cakhutaata Joshua ca mawdiy ta thu te, tluobyi tie ca Abyipabiekuona thingkaw kha amaa puv.

Tuvtungpa kiy hmyakaa a cyipa tluobyi pasariy ca hmyakaa ama tungpuopa khata Abyipabiekuona thingkaw hmieluo khata ama si. Hmyakaa ama tungpuo nguoluopa cata, cehre a cyipa cawsaa tie kha ama hmieluo ta si yi te, hnangluo rievetuv tie ca Abyipabiekuona thingkaw kha ama paziy.
A ning hningna lie ca khypuv kha chi kha cahlung yi te, cakhutaata arina hmang luo kha ama vya kaa. Ning caruv chung cahaacata ama tue.
A ning sariyna lie ca mawdiy ta thu patang yi te ama tue tawpa haa khata khypuv ca chi sariy ama cahlung. Capa ning lie dyi ca ta khypuv ca chi sariy ama cahlung.
A chi sariynapa lie tluobyi tie ta hmyakaa ama tung tiy khata, Joshua ta cawsaa tie kha, “Khi tie ung! Abyipana khypuv ca caa pi tli yi.

Khypuv hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo ca para riypa tana Abyipa'a luo pihluo pata a cuo aa. Kiema ta ma pathliepa biephyatuv tie kha a nu nakaw yi ta siyhrawnung Rahab hne ama hneta a ing chunglie a awpa bangkhuo dyina a hring'a yi.

Niema ca, para riypata pihluopa chechiy kha la'a va ung ciy. Hingpa pihluopa chechiy suokhakha kha hietlie ung cate nama la kieca Israel arina hmang luo kha ruvnaana vya chiykhyi'a ung cate, para riypa hmang ta nama tue pathlyi aa.
Cuorasala siy hne ngu, daa hne thaa ta tuepa biphie zaw ca Abyipacuota a pathepa tana a cuo aa; capa bangkhuo ca Abyipasuethiy tana chi pata a cuo aa,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta cawsaa ca khi yi te, hmyakaa ca ama tung. Cawsaa ca hmyakaa pu ama thyi pahne ta khuosa ta ama khi, khypuv dungkhuonapa lungruetlepie ca a cing; caacuonakawta cawsaa ca ama hmieluo cyicuo taa khata khy chung luo kha a ngie yi te ama la.
Cakhutaata khy chunglie a awpa bangkhuo ca, canung hne capaa, haatiy hne macuo, cuetungpa, tuv, laa ta pata zueziy ta ama thie diy.
Joshua ta ruo a ngiepatliepa cawsaa pahning kyihuo khata, “Siyhrawnung ing chung luo kha a ngie ung la, chie namaa sapa haa khata, cawsaanung hne ama huopa bangkhuo kha kya pyakhyi tie ung,” a ta yi.

Caacuonakawta ngiepatlietuv satlie tie ca ta a ngie yi te Rahab, hne cata a paa, a nung, a caapaapa zaw, hne a huopa bangkhuo, a tieriy bangkhuo kha kya pyakhyi yi te, Israel arina hmang ale lie kha ama chi.
Iema ta a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo hne khata khypuv ca myi ta ama rue; siy hne ngu, daa hne thaa ta tuepa biphie zaw dyi kha Abyipaing suethiy luo kha ama chi.

Cuorasala siyhrawnung Rahab, a ingchungkhue hne ama huopa ta a cuopa bangkhuo ca Joshua ta a pahring yi. A ingchungkhue ca ata tepa hingta Israel chunglie ama aw. Tahematapakieca Joshua ta Jeriko a ngiepatlie riypata a pathliepa tie kha a za nu nakaw yi ta a cuo.

Cakhutaata Joshua ta hingpa chiesana bie hing a ri, “Hingpa khypuv, hingpa Jeriko hing sa riypata te a maapa ca Abyipahmiekunglie chiesa pata cuo mang sue! A sacapaa uvthyipa luv sung pata a hruo bang sala, a sacapaa syi cepa luv sung pata a thlake bang mang sue!” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Abyipata Joshua kha awpuo te, ruo chung yalya lie a ming a pathuo.

Cuorasala pihluopa hmang kawlieta Israel ming ca zang tluo aa tla pata aw va yi: Judah phang Zerah sacapaa Zabdi sacapaa Karmi sacapaa Akhan ta pihluopa chechiy chekha a la, caacuonakawta Abyipahihaana ca Israel ming cunglie myi haata a ie.

Joshua ta cawsaa kha Jeriko taata Bethel ningchiyluo Beth-aven athaalie a awpa Ai luo kha pathlie yi te, iema kha, “Sithaw ung la ruo kha a kya ngiepatlie tie ung,” a ta yi. Cawsaa tie ca sithaw yi te Ai kha amaa kya ngiepatlie.

Cakhutaata iema ca za kaa yi te Joshua kha, “Cawsaa bangkhuo ta sithaw a hu'a vyi; cawsaa thawhning acuolikie thawthung hraw si yi sala Ai ca kya tuv yi se. Iema ca cawsaa cawta dyi ama cuo nakawta cawsaa bangkhuo ta rie a kya pathyi a hu vyi,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta cawsaa thawthung hraw dyi sithaw yi te, Ai khy ming hmiekunglie a sung yi te amaa ruo.
Ai khy ming ta sawthung pacaruv hraw ama thie. Thlake ale luo taata Shebarim te a cade yi te, iema ca cabung lie kha ama thie. Cawsaa pathiypalung ca a tiy ta lang te tiy haata a cuo.
Cakhutaata Joshua ca a caw kha thlaa te, Abyipabiekuona thingkaw hmiekunglie kha zuoluo te ta alyi lie aa bu, ama hne Israel uvthyi tie kha amaa bu; ama luv lie buvcing amaa phuv.
Joshua ta, “Vya AbyipaKhazing! Khaapanakawma hingpa cawsaa tie hing Jordan cavaa huesuo luo a chiy yi cate, Amor ming kuv luo kha para riypata malie na pi?
Vya Khazing, ata hing ca Israel ming ta ama carie tie kha a ruopa yi te, khaapama i ri khu aa?

Kanaan ming hne hingpa ruo chunglie khy a sapa bangkhuo ta hingpa hing thyi'a yi te, malie cadung'a yi te, alyi cung taa hingta ma ming kha malie ama hruv aa. A lesyipa na ming cuota khaapama na tuepa aa?
Abyipata Joshua kyihuo khata, “Thu tie! Khaapanakawma naa bu thluo?
Israel ca a sue tli; i pipa yi biekuona na ama para tli. Pihluopa chechiy chekha na amaa la; ama paruv, duv aa chiypa hmang na ama tue, capa ca iema chechiy hrawlie kha ama chi.

Caacuonakawta Israel ming ca ama carie tie hmiekunglie kha a daa khu va yi; ama carie tie kha amaa ruopa, tahematapakieca pihluopa chechiy kawlie na iema'a na iema kha para riypata amaa tue. Nama hraw taa khata para riyta pihluopa chechiy kha la pata na para li kieca, ca awpuo'a va tli ang.

Thu la, cawsaa kha pathe sa tie yi, ‘Mawluo a pathe tie ung; tahematapakieca Abyipa, Israel Khazing na, “Vya Israel ming, para riypata pihluopa chechiy na niema hrawlie a aw; niema hrawtaata para riypata pihluopa chechiy kha nama thaw hluo li nama carie tie hmiekunglie a daa khu'a va ung ciy,” a ta, ta pata chang tie yi, a ta.

Caacuonakawta maw ta a phang a phang ta nama vya pya aa. Abyipata a lapa phang kha a chung a chung ta aa ngie luo a vaw'a ung cate, Abyipata a lapa chung kha ingchungkhue ta aa ngie luo namaa vaw aa, Abyipata a lapa ingchungkhue kha pakha pakha ta aa ngie luo namaa vaw aa.

Cakhutaata para riypata pihluopa chechiy na a hnyi ta pata patuvpuopa ca ama hne a hnyipa bangkhuo hne khata myi ta ruepa a cuo aa, tahematapakieca Abyipabiekuo kha para te, Israel ming chungliena hmang pha lipa a tue,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Joshua ca mawdiy ta thu te, Israel ming ca a phang a phang ta aa ngie luo kha amaa vawkhyi ca Judah phang kha la pata a cuo.

Judah phang kha a chung a chung ta aa ngie luo a vawkhyi yi te, Zerah chung kha la pata a cuo. Zerah chung kha a chungkhue a chungkhue ta aa ngie luo a vawkhyi yi te, Zabdi ingchungkhue kha la pata a cuo.
A ingchungkhue tie kha pakha pakha ta aa ngie luo a vawkhyi yi te, Judah phang Zerah sacapaa Zabdi sacapaa Karmi sacapaa Akhan ca la pata a cuo.
Cakhutaata Joshua ta Akhan kha, “I sacapaa, Abyipa, Israel Khazing kha rungnaana pi la ama'a lie kha na suena phu tie. Khaapama na tue tapa kha nu li pata na chang tie,” a ta.
Akhan ta Joshua kha palie te, “A cuo; kama hing na Abyipa, Israel Khazing'a lie a suepa ta a cuo ang. I tuepa hmang ca:

hruosue hrawlie kha a puvthesapa Shinar pang, hne ngu shekel zahning, hne shekel sawngaa aa riypa siy tluo kha zaw kha i hmung tiyta, i hietlie te i la. Ata hing i thluodaa chung, alyi liena ngu kha a raw ce luo pachuo angte i nu yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Joshua ta biephyatuv tie pathlie yi te, thluodaa luo kha amaa ruo; thluodaa chunglie ca ngu kha araw pachuo te a za nu hmisi sasaw.
Thluodaa chung taa cata thue yi te, Joshua hne Israel ming bangkhuo'a luo kha chiykhyi yi te, Abyipahmiekunglie kha ama ze.

Cakhutaata Joshua hne Israel ming bangkhuo ta Zerah sacapaa Akhan ca ngu, pang, hne siy tluo, a sacapaa hne a sacanung zaw, a cuetungpa zaw, laa zaw, tuv zaw, a thluodaa hne a hnyipa bangkhuo hne khata Akhor Bawphie luo ama sikhyi.

Joshua ta, “Khaapanakawma kiema'a luo kha ruvnaana na vya tlungkhyi? Ataning hing Abyipana nama'a luo ruvnaana a vya tlungkhyi,” a ta. Cakhutaata Israel ming bangkhuo ta ama kha alung ta ama vaasa, myi ta rue yi te alung ama papungsue.
A cunglie kha a lesa pata alung papung yi te, ataning te ta a aw kalie. Cakhutaata Abyipahihaana ca a die. Caacuonakawta ataning tepa ta capa hmang ca Akhor Bawphie ama ta.

Cakhutaata Abyipata Joshua kyihuo khata, “Ciy khah, na palung chuo khah se; rieka bangkhuo kha a chiy yi la, Ai luo kha khaw tie ung. Mang tie, Ai siepahruo ca a cawsaa, a khypuv, hne a ruo hne khata na kuv luo ica pi aa.

Jeriko hne a siepahruo cunglie na tuepa haa kha tana Ai hne a siepahruo cunglie kha na tue aa; A hruosue hne a sahring dyi khana niema cuota namaa la aa. Khy a du riypa tie kha khypuv hnangkaa luo khata ngie na pasa sa'a yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Joshua hne rieka tie ca Ai a du riypata ama sithaw. Joshua ta a riephapa rieka thawsawthung kha a tlaw yi te,
biepi yi te, zuo ta a pathlie yi. “Niema ca khypuv hnangkaa lie khata ngie nama sa aa; khypuv hne a hla tuv'a va ung ciy, cuorasala a raaringsa pata nama aw aa.
Kama hne kama'a lie a awpa cawsaa ta khypuv kha ma vaa ngie aa. Kiema a du riypata ama kya pya tiyta, a hluo haa khata, kiema ca maa ruo aa.
Kiema kha malie a cade'a yi te, khypuv taata aa hlapuona te maa cade sa'a yi. Iema ta, ‘Ahluo haa tana malie amaa ruopa hyi,’ ama ta aa. Iema'a taata maa ruo ning kha,
ngie nama sana taa khata thu'a ung cate khypuv ca nama la aa; tahematapakieca Abyipanama Khazing ta nama kuv luo aca pi'a yi.
Khypuv kha nama la khu tiyta, Abyipata bie malie a pina haa khata tue'a ung cate, myi ta nama rue aa; mang tie ung, kama na bie caa pi yi ang,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Joshua ta pathlie yi te, ngie ama sana riypa hmang, Ai ningtlaluo, Ai hne Bethel alalalie kha ama aw, cuorasala Joshua ca capa zuo ca arina hmang lie kha a aw.
Joshua ca maw ta thu patang te cawsaa kha pahmya yi te, Israel ming uvthyi zaw hne khata cawsaa zaw hmiekunglie kha Ai luo ama sithaw.
Ama'a lie a awpa rieka bangkhuo ca sithaw yi te, khypuv kha a hmieluo kuo taata vaa ngie yi te, Ai khy chaluo kuo lie kha amaa ri. Iema hne khypuv alalalie kha huekaw lepuv suokha a aw.
Cawsaa zapangaa kha Bethel hne Ai alalalie, khypuv ningtlaluo kuo khata ngie a pasa sa yi.
Cahaacata rieka ca a chi yi, arina hmang le cepa ca khypuv chaluo kuo ta chi te, rie a vepa phuv ca ningtlaluo kuo ta a chi yi. Cuorasala capa zuo ca Joshua ca bawphie lie kha aa ri.

Ai siepahruo ta capa ca a hmung tiyta, ama hne capa lie khy a sapa cawsaa bangkhuo ca mawdiy ta thu yi te, Israel ming a du riypata atawna hmang Arabah luo kha a catlisa pata ama si. Cuorasala khypuv hnangkaalie ta iema a du riypata ngie a sapa rieka tie ama awpa kha pachang vyi.
Cakhutaata Joshua hne Israel ming bangkhuo ca a sungpa haa khata a pa-aw sa yi te ruocaapa luo kha amaa ruo.
Caacuonakawta khypuv chunglie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo kha iema a cade riypata a ku yi te, amaa thyi hmuo li pata khypuv hne aa hlana te ta Joshua kha amaa cade.
Israel a cadena luo si li pata Ai hne Bethel lie a ngaapa pakha hmuo aw va yi; khypuv kha a pahaw yalya ta sise yi te, Israel ming kha amaa cade.

Cakhutaata Abyipata Joshua kyihuo khata, “Na kuv lie a awpa zueziy kha Ai luo daw tie; tahematapakieca na kuv luo na ica pi aa,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Joshua ta a kuv lie a awpa zueziy khata khypuv luo ca a daw.
A kuv ta ava daw pahne ta ngie a sapa riekaphuv ca a catlisa pata thu yi te hmieluo kha amaa ruo. Khypuv chung luo kha a ngie yi te, la yi te, khypuv kha myi ta ama rue.

Caacuonakawta Ai khy ming ca hnangluo kha amaa pali tiyta, khypuv myikhuv ca avuo luo a kiepa kha ama hmung. Khaapa luo hmuo a ruo khu va tli yi. Ruocaapa chung luo a ruopa cawsaa zaw khata vya kaa hnue yi te a vya cadepa tie kha ama vya tuv.
Joshua hne Israel ming bangkhuo ta ngie a sapa rieka tie ta khypuv kha la yi te, khypuv myikhuv avuo luo a kya kiepa kha ama hmung tiyta, vya kaa hnue yi te Ai khy ming kha ama thie.

Cakhutaata a hrangpa tie kha ta khypuv chungtaata pya yi te amaa du nakawta iema ca Israel ming ta ama cadung; a che ta kuo kha taata, a hrangpa a che ta kuo kha taata cadung yi te a hringpa hne hya a zangpa pakha hmuo aw lina te ta Israel ming ca ta ama thie diy.
Cuorasala Ai siepahruo ca a hringpa ta patuv yi te Joshua'a luo kha ama vya chiykhyi.
Israel ming ta Ai lie khy a sapa bangkhuo kha iema amaa vya cadenapa ruocaapa lie kha zueziy ta ama naw diy khutaata Israel ming bangkhuo ta Ai luo kha vya kaa hnue yi te, zueziy ta ama thie.
Capa ning lieta a thiypa Ai khy ming bangkhuo ca, canung hne capaa, ama bangkhuo ta thawhraa hlyihning ama ta.
Tahematapakieca Ai lie khy a sapa bangkhuo a thie diy hluo li yi ta, Joshua ca zueziy a cyi te a dawpa a kuv kha pathla vyi.
Abyipata Joshua'a lie bie a pipa haa khata, sahring hne khypuv ama tuvna lie ama hmungpa hruosue dyi kha Israel ming ta iema huo ta amaa la.
Caacuonakawta Joshua ta Ai ca myi ta rue te ataning te ta a cuopa haa hingta, khyrue ta a pacuo sa.

Cakhutaata Ai siepahruo ca thingkungpa cunglie zuoluo te ta ama pathlie; ning a tla pahne ta Joshua ta bie pi yi te, thingkungpa taa cata pa chung yi te, khypuv luo a ngienapa thlake athaalie kha ama thaw. Alung kha aa suosana te ta papungsue yi te capa lie ca ataning tepa hingta a aw.
Cakhutaata Joshua ta Ebal Tluo cunglie kha Abyipa, Israel Khazing cuota bienatluophie suokha a sa.

Abyipachangtaapa Moses ta Israel ming bie a pipa haa yi khata, Moses phungbie caa-uv chunglie, “uo lipa alung ta sapa bienathluodaa, a cunglie thaa chechiy hmuo lipa,” ta pata aa capepa haa khata a sa. Capa cunglie ca Abyipa'a luo kha myirue panaana pihluo yi te, aviesaa panaana zaw ama pihluo.
Cakhutaata capa lie, Israel ming hmiekunglie ca, Joshua ta, Moses ta a capepa phungbie kha alung cunglie ca a cape.

Israel ming bangkhuo, mingpe hne Israel chungchiy hne, ama uvthyi tie hne amaa byi tie hne ama bieripatuv tie ca Abyipabiekuona thingkaw a puvpa Levi tluobyi tie hmiekunglie, biekuona thingkaw a hmiepachaw pata amaa daa, khingkhuo kha Gerizim Tluo hmielie, khingkhuo kha Ebal Tluo hmielie ta pata, Israel ming kha thluechiy pi the riypata Abyipachangtaapa Moses ta a za ripa haa khata amaa daa.
Cakhutaata phungbie chunglie bie bangkhuo, thluechiy hne chiesana kha, phungbie caa-uv chunglie aa capepa haa khata a ri.
Moses bie pipa chung taa khata Joshua ta Israel ming aa hmyapa bangkhuo, canung, haatiy, hne iema hrawlie khy a sapa mingpe tie hmiekunglie kha a ri lipa bie suokha hmuo aw vyi.

Jordan cavaa huesuo tluocung ruo hne ase ruo Riyliy Lepa kie tathlyalya ta Lebanon te lie a awpa Hit ming, Amor ming, Kanaan ming, Periz ming, Hiv ming, hne Jebus ming siepahruo tie bangkhuo ta capa kaw ca ama thyi tiyta,
Joshua hne Israel kha a du riypata palung a pakha pata amaa hmya.
Cuorasala Gibeon lie khy a sapa tie ta Joshua ta Jeriko hne Ai a tuepa kha ama thyi tiyta,
Iema kuo luo taata zyatesa pata ama hriepa ca: vaa yi te zuorie kha amaa ring, ama laa kha caw te a tlaapa chawkue hne caw tli te abie thlapa savang ungchuo kha ama paphya sa.
Tlaa te abie thlapa phyipakaw kha a pakaw yi te, caw a tlaapa kha amaa hryi; ama zuorie bangkhuo ca a caapa hne a myapa ta a cuo.
Iema ca Gilgal lie arina hmang luo, Joshua'a luo kha vaa yi te, ama hne Israel ming kyihuo khata, “Kiema hing luohlaasa taata a vawpa tana ma cuo, kiema hne hingta arena biekuo tue tie ung,” ama ta.
Cuorasala Israel ming ta Hiv ming kyihuo khata, “Kiema hrawlie a awpa tana nama cuo thlu aa; caacuokieca tuokhaatama niema hne arena biekuo ma tue the aa,” ama ta.
Iema ta Joshua kyihuo khata, “Kiema ca nama changtaapa tie tana ma cuo,” ama ta. Cakhutaata Joshua ta iema kyihuo khata, “Ahung zaw tama nama cuo? Khaapa taata ma hingpa luo hing namaa vaw?” a ta yi.
Iema ta, “Abyipana Khazing ming kawlieta na na changtaapa zaw hing a luohlaasapa ruo taata maa vaw; tahematapakieca Izipt lie a tuepa,
Jordan cavaa huesuoluo a awpa Amor ming siepahruo pahning ta a cuopa Ashtaroth lie a awpa Heshbon siepahruo Sihon hne Bashan siepahruo Og tie zaw cunglie a tuepa bangkhuo kha ma thyi.

Caacuonakawta ma uvthyi tie hne ma ruo lie a awpa tie bangkhuo ta kiema kha, ‘Nama khytlawna riypata zuorie kha a phya ung la iema kha vaa taw tie ung, cakhutaata iema kyihuo khata, “Kiema ca nama changtaapa tie tana ma cuo, kiema hne hingta arena biekuo tue tie ung,” va ta tie ung,’ malie ama ta.
Hinglie hing ma viechuo a cuo, khytlawna lie ma ning riypata ing taata maa vya thakhyi ningta ca a lungpa tana a cuo, cuorasala ata hing ca mang tie ung, caa te a mya diy tli;

hingpa mingsuv ungchuo zaw hing ma raw thaa ningta ca a thaapa tana a cuo, mang tie ung, ama pachi diy tli hing; cakhutaata hingpa ma caw hne ma phyipakaw zaw hing ma khytlawna luo a pasiy tuv nakawta a tlaa diy tli,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta cawsaa tie ta Abyipa'a taata khaapahmuo hiehriy li pata ama sungcue kha ama ningkhyi.
Cakhutaata Joshua ta iema hne khata arena biekuo ca a tue; cakhutaata cawsaazaapuv luochiytuv tie ta iema'a lie kha chie amaa sa.
Cuorasala iema hne arena biekuo ama tue khutaata ning thung a ta pata iema ca ama ingpaa tie hne ama hrawlie a awpa ama cuopa kha ama pachang.
Caacuonakawta Israel ming ca a thu yi te, ama khypuv ca ning thung ta ama va pha. Ama khypuv zaw ca Gibeon, Khefirah, Beeroth, hne Kiriath-jearim ta ama cuo.

Cuorasala Israel ming ta iema kha a du va yi, tahematapakieca cawsaazaapuv luochiytuv tie ta Abyipa, Israel Khazing ming ta chie amaa sa nakawta a cuo. Cakhutaata cawsaazaapuv ca luochiytuv tie cunglie ca amaa cie.
Cuorasala luochiytuv tie bangkhuo ta cawsaazaapuv kyihuo khata, “Abyipa, Israel Khazing ming ta iema'a lie chie maa sa tli, caacuonakawta iema hing de'a va ung puv.
Iema cunglie ma tue riypa ca hingpa hing tana a cuo aa: Iema'a lie chie a sa pate bie maa kuo tli nakawta, hihaana ma cunglie a tlung li riypata iema hing ma pahring'a ung,” ama ta.

Luochiytuv tie ta iema kyihuo khata, “Hring thluo yi se,” ama ta. Caacuonakawta iema hne aa patuv pata uvthyi tie ta bie ama china haata, iema ca zaapuv cuo khata thing a hluopatuv hne tiy a thepatuv ta amaa li.
Joshua ta iema kha ku yi te, “Khaapanakawma kiema hrawlie nama aw thluo pata, ‘niema'a taata luohlaasa luo lie a awpa tana ma cuo,’ ta ung cate malie nama dung,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta ata hing niema ca chiesapa tana nama cuo, niema chekha hing chuozaa sii tana nama cuo aa, I Khazing ing cuota thing a hluopatuv hne tiy a thepatuv tana nama cuo aa,” a ta yi.

Iema ta Joshua kha palie yi te, “Abyipana Khazing ta a changtaapa Moses kha hingpa ruo hing a bangkhuo ta niema kha pi riypa hne nama hmiekung taata hingpa ruo lie a awpa bangkhuo kha para riypata bie a pi ta pata na changtaapa zaw hing a siesa pata malie ama chang, caacuonakawta niema kawlie hingta ma hringna kawlie hing ma palung rie a thyi hringhruo nakawta hingpa hmang hing ma tue pata a cuo,” ama ta.
Ata hing ca na kuv chungliena ma aw: na hmungna lieta a pha na tapa hne aa dang na tapa haa khata ma cunglie hing tue tie,” ama ta.
Hingpa hing iema cuota a tuepa ta a cuo: Iema kha Israel ming kuv chungtaata hya pazang yi te, thie pata cuo va yi.
Cuorasala capa ning lie ca ta Joshua ta cawsaazaapuv cuo hne aa tlaw riypa hmang Abyipabienatluophie cuo khata iema ca ataning tepa hingta thing a hluopatuv hne tiy a thepatuv ta a tue yi.

Joshua ta Ai kha tuokhaata la te ma a para diy karue tapa, hne Ai hne a siepahruo ca Jeriko hne a siepahruo cunglie a tuepa haa kha tana a tue tapa, hne tuokhaatama Gibeon lie khy a sapa tie ta Israel ming hne diena tue yi te iema hrawlie ama aw tapa kha Jerusalem siepahruo Adoni-zedek ta a thyi tiyta a thlaa a zang hringhruo.
Tahematapakieca Gibeon ca siepahruo khypuv suokha haa khata khylepuv suokha ta a cuo, Ai laata le vie te a cawsaa bangkhuo ca a thaaruvpa ta ama cuo diy.
Caacuonakawta Jerusalem siepahruo Adoni-zedek ta Hebron siepahruo Hoham, Jarmuth siepahruo Piram, Lakhish siepahruo Jafia, hne Eglon siepahruo Debir tapa tie kha bie taa yi te,
“A khaw ung la naa kya bya tie ung, Gibeon ca tuv ung siy; tahematapakieca Joshua hne Israel ming hne tana arena biekuo a tue,” a ta yi.

Cakhutaata Amor siepahruo papangaa tie, Jerusalem siepahruo, Hebron siepahruo, Jarmuth siepahruo, Lakhish siepahruo, hne Eglon siepahruo tapa tie ta ama rieka kha pahmya yi te, ama rieka bangkhuo hne cata sithaw yi te, Gibeon ca a kya ri hnue yi te amaa du.

Cakhutaata Gibeon ming ca ta Gilgal arina hmang lie Joshua'a luo kha bie taa yi te, “Na changtaapa zaw hing hnang malie chaw thi khah; kiema'a luo kha a catlisa pata a khaw la malie khuo tie, tahematapakieca tluocung ruo lie a awpa Amor siepahruo tie na kiema a du riypata a hmya yi,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Joshua ca a rieka bangkhuo hne a riephapa hne a thaaruvpa bangkhuo hne khata a sithaw.
Abyipata Joshua kyihuo khata, “Iema kha ciy khah yi, tahematapakieca iema ca na kuv cung luo na ica pi tli yi; na hmiekunglie pakha hmuo a daa khu'a va yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Joshua ca Gilgal taa khata zuokhydyi kya si te iema kha tlangkhy ta a tuv yi.

Cakhutaata Abyipata iema kha Israel ming hmiekunglie ca khuopuv ta paciy sa yi te, Israel rieka tie ta Gibeon athaalie ca a hluvsa ama thie, Beth-horon luo kienapa luo lie kha a cade yi te, Azekah hne Makkedah te khata ama thiele.

Israel ming hmiekung taata a ruo yi te, Beth-horon cabung ama cung ning kha Abyipata avuo taata alung tung lesapa kha Azekah te khata pathlasuele yi te ama thiy; ari lungtung ta a thiypa ca Israel ming zueziy ta a thiypa laata ama hluv vie.

Abyipata Amor ming kha Israel ming kuv cung luo a pi ningpa yi ta, Joshua ta Abyipa'a luo bie a ri; Israel ming hmungna lieta a ripa ca: Ning, Gibeon lie kha a daa la, Thlaapa, Aijalon bawphie lie kha a daa tie,” a ta.

Mingphang tie ta ama carie tie cunglie phuv ama la hluo li ta, Ning ca a daa pari te, thlaapa ca aa daa thluo. Hingpa hing Jashar caa-uv lie aa cape cuo va ma? Ning ca avuo liekhingkhuo lie khiy a daa te, ningtlabu ta tla a pahraa li pata a aw.
Abyipata ca haa cata cawsaa ueryi naa a thliena ning ca, capa hluota cuose, capa khutaata cuose aw buo vyi; tahematapakieca Abyipana Israel cuota rie a du.
Cakhutaata Joshua hne Israel ming bangkhuo ca Gilgal arina hmang luo kha ama kaa.
Capa chung cata, hingpa siepahruo papangaa tie hing a ruo yi te Makkedah lungkhue lie kha amaa nu.
Cakhutaata capa ca Joshua kha chang yi te, “Siepahruo papangaa tie ca Makkedah lungkhue lie amaa nupa tana ama hmung,” ama ta.
Joshua ta, “Lungkhue pakaa luo kha lungtung lepuv kha pahlang ung la, iema huo riypata rievetuv kha chi tie ung,

cuorasala niema ca khapa lie kha aw khah ung, nama carie tie kha a cade ung la, thiele tie ung, ama khy chung luo pangie sa khah ung, tahematapakieca Abyipanama Khazing na niema kuv cung luo caa pi yi,” a ta.
Joshua hne Israel ming ta iema kha thie diy yi te ama paming diy khutaata, hne aa ngaapa tie kha dungkhuopa khy chung luo amaa ngie tiyta,
cawsaa bangkhuo ca arina hmang Makkedah lie Joshua'a luo kha aa bangsa pata ama vya kaa, ahunghmuo Israel ming a du pata bie ri nguo va yi.
Cakhutaata Joshua ta, “Lungkhue pakaa kha pahaw ung la, siepahruo papangaa tie kha kama'a luo kya papya tie ung,” a ta yi.
Cahaacata tue yi te, lungkhue chungtaata siepahruo papangaa, Jerusalem siepahruo, Hebron siepahruo, Jarmuth siepahruo, Lakhish siepahruo, Eglon siepahruo tie kha ama'a luo ama kya pyakhyi.

Siepahruo tie ca Joshua'a luo ama kya pyakhyi tiyta, Joshua ta Israel ming bangkhuo kha ku yi te, ama hneta a sihnepa riekabyilepa tie kha ku yi te, “Naa vya ngie tie ung la, hingpa siepahruo papangaa tie rue lie hing nama phyi ta tlaw tie ung,” a ta yi. Cakhutaata a vya ngie yi te ama phyi ta ama rue kha ama tlaw.

Cakhutaata Joshua ta iema kyihuo khata, “Ciy khah ung, nama palung caw khah se; cahra ung la nama rie pha se; tahematapakieca Abyipana namaa dupa nama carie tie bangkhuo cunglie kha hing haa hingta a tue aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata Joshua ta thie yi te, thingkungpa suopangaa cunglie kha a pathlie yi. Cahaacata thingkungpa cunglie ca zuoluo te ta a pathlie yi.

Ning a tla tiyta, Joshua ta bie pi yi te, thingkungpa cung taa khata pachung yi te, iemata tah amaa nunapa lungkhue chung luo kha ama thaw; lungkhue pakaa lie kha alung lesapa ama papung sue, ataning tepa hingta a aw kalie.

Joshua ta Makkedah ca capa ning lie ca ta la te, khy hne a siepahruo ca zueziy ta a thie yi; a chunglie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo kha a thie diy yi; pakha hmuo pangaa va yi. Cakhutaata Jeriko siepahruo a tuepa haa khata Makkedah siepahruo ca a tue.
Cakhutaata Joshua ca Israel ming bangkhuo hne khata Makkedah taata Libnah luo kha si yi te, Libnah kha amaa du.

Abyipata capa khy hne a siepahruo zaw ca Israel ming kuv luo kha a pi; a khy hne a chunglie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo kha zueziy ta a thie diy yi; pakha hmuo pangaa va yi; Jeriko siepahruo a tuepa haa khata ama siepahruo ca a tue.
Cakhutaata Joshua ca ama'a lie a awpa Israel ming bangkhuo hne khata Libnah taata Lakhish luo kha va caluo yi te, cadung yi te, ama tuv.
Abyipata Lakhish ca Israel ming kuv luo kha pi te, a ning hningna lieta a la, Libnah a tuepa haa khata a khy hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo kha zueziy ta a thie diy yi.
Cakhutaata Gezer siepahruo Horam ta a khaw te Lakhish kha aa bya; caacuonakawta Joshua ta ama hne a cawsaa zaw kha pakha hmuo amaa ngaa lina te ta a thie diy yi.
Joshua ca Israel ming bangkhuo hne khata Lakhish taata Eglon luo kha ama caluo; capa khy ca cadung yi te ama tuv.
Capa ning lie ca ta la yi te, khy hne a chunglie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo ca Lakhish a tuepa haa khata zueziy ta thie yi te ama para diy.
Cakhutaa cata Joshua ca Israel ming bangkhuo hne khata Eglon taata Hebron luo kha si yi te ama tuv,

khy kha la yi te, a khy hne a siepahruo hne a chunglie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo kha zueziy ta ama thie diy; Eglon a tuepa haa khata pakha hmuo pangaa va yi, a chunglie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo kha a para diy karue yi.
Cakhutaata Joshua hne Israel ming bangkhuo ca Debir luo kha vya kaa yi te ama tuv,

a siepahruo hne a khy zaw kha la yi te zueziy ta ama thie diy, a chunglie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo kha ama para diy karue; pakha hmuo pangaa va yi; Hebron a tuepa haa khata cuose, Libnah hne a siepahruo a tuepa haa khata cuose Debir hne a siepahruo ca a tue.

Cahaacata Joshua ta ruo ca a yalya ta, tluocung ruo cuose, Negeb hne aa ne ruo tluope cabung zaw kha a siepahruo bangkhuo hne a te diy yi; AbyipaIsrael Khazing ta bie a pipa haa khata, a huv a sungpa bangkhuo kha khaapahmuo pangaa li pata a para diy karue.
Cakhutaata Joshua ta iema kha Kadesh-barnea taata Gaza te, Goshen ruo bangkhuo zaw kha Gibeon te ta a te diy.
Joshua ta hingpa siepahruo bangkhuo hne ama ruo kha yi kha ta a la diy, tahematapakieca AbyipaIsrael Khazing ta Israel cuota a tuv nakawta a cuo.
Cakhutaata Joshua ca Israel ming bangkhuo hne khata arina hmang Gilgal luo kha ama kaa.
Capa kaw ca Hazor siepahruo Jabin ta a thyi tiyta, Madon siepahruo Jobab, Shimron siepahruo, Akhshaf siepahruo,
hne ningtla tluocung ruo lie a awpa siepahruo tie, hne Khinneroth sungluo Arabah, hne aa ne ruo, hne ningtlaluo Nafoth-dor siepahruo tie,
ningchiy hne ningtla Kanaan ming, Amor ming, Hit ming, Periz ming, hne tluocung ruo lie Jebus ming, hne Hermon raw Mizpah ruo chunglie a awpa Hiv ming zaw'a luo kha cawsaa a pathlie yi.
Iema ca ama riekaphuv lepa tie, aruo hne aruole a hluvsa hne khata kya pya yi te, riyliy kie lie viehnang zaa ama ta.
Capa siepahruo bangkhuo ca ta ama thaazuo kha pahlaw yi te, Israel tuv riypata Merom tiy lie kha arina hmang ama la.

Cakhutaata Abyipata Joshua kyihuo khata, “Iema kha ciy khah yi, tahematapakieca mawluo ata tiy hingta iema bangkhuo hing thie ciepa ta Israel ming kuv luo i pi'a yi; amaa ruo kha a cazaa ba'a ung cate, amaa ruole kha myi ta nama rue aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Joshua ca a rieka zaw bangkhuo hne khata Merom tiy athaa luo kha si yi te sungkha ta ama va tuv.

Cakhutaata Abyipata iema ca vaa tuvpa Israel ming kuv luo kha pi yi te, Sidon Lepa hne Misrefoth-maim te cuose, ningchiyluo Mizpeh bawphie te khata cuose amaa cade. Pakha hmuo amaa ngaa lina te khata ama thie.
Joshua ca iema cunglie kha Abyipata bie a pipa haa khata a tue; amaa ruo kha a cazaa thariy sapachung diy te amaa ruole kha myi ta a rue.
Capa cuo lie ca Joshua ca kaa te, Hazor kha la te a siepahruo kha zueziy ta a thie. Capa hluo ca ta Hazor ca capa pena bangkhuo lie ca a luv ce ta a cuo.
Capa lie a awpa bangkhuo kha zueziy ta thie yi te, ama para diy karue, a huv a sungpa pakha hmuo pangaa va yi; Hazor ca myi ta a rue.
Cakhutaata capa siepahruo tie khy bangkhuo hne ama siepahruo bangkhuo kha Joshua ta la te, Abyipachangtaapa Moses ta bie a pipa haa khata iema kha zueziy ta thie yi te, a para diy karue yi.
Cuorasala Joshua ta myi ta a ruepa Hazor ta li pata ca, tluo cunglie ama sapa khy khy kha hmuo Israel ta myi ta rue vyi.

Capa khy zaw hruosue bangkhuo, hne sahring zaw ca Israel ming ta iema huota amaa la; cuorasala ama para diy hluo li, cawsaa bangkhuo ca zueziy ta thie diy yi te, a huv a sungpa pakha hmuo pangaa va yi.
Abyipata a changtaapa Moses kha bie a pipa haata, Moses zaw ta Joshua kha bie pi te, capa haa cata Joshua ta a tue; Abyipata Moses bie a pipa kha hrie li pata a pangaapa suokha hmuo aw vyi.
Caacuonakawta Joshua ta ruo bangkhuo kha a la: tluocung ruo hne Negeb bangkhuo hne Goshen ruo bangkhuo hne aa ne ruo hne Arabah hne Israel tluocung ruo hne aa ne ruo,
Seir luo a kya kiepa Halak Tluo taata Hermon tluo raw Lebanon bawphie lie a awpa Baal-gad te khata a la diy. Ama siepahruo bangkhuo kha la diy te, tuv yi te a thie diy yi.
Joshua ca capa siepahruo bangkhuo hne cata cuo pasiypuv rie amaa du.
Gibeon lie khy a sapa Hiv ming ta li pata, Israel ming hne arena a tuepa khy khy kha hmuo aw va yi, rie a du pata lapa selaw tana ama cuo.
Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haata, nangduena aw li pata para diy pahli diy karuepa ama cuo riypata, Israel ming kha rie a du riypata ama palung a pacuo sapa ca Abyipatuepa tana a cuo.

Capa cuo lie ca ta Joshua ca a vaw te Anak cawsaa tie kha tluocung ruo ta a cuopa Hebron, Debir, Anab, hne Judah tluocung ruo bangkhuo taata cuose, Israel tluocung ruo bangkhuo taata cuose a paming diy yi; Joshua ta ama khy hne khata a para diy karue yi.
Israel ruo chunglie Anak ming pakha hmuo pangaa va yi. Gaza, Gath, hne Ashdod lie dyina chekha amaa ngaa.
Caacuonakawta Abyipata Moses'a lie a ripa haata Joshua ta ruo ca a yalya khata la diy te, ama phang cyicuo ta ama cu riypa haa khata ru ta a pi yi. Cakhutaata ruo chunglie ca rie a die.
Hingpa tie hing Israel ming ta te yi te ama ruo ama lapa tie, Jordan cavaa huesuo ningchiyluo kuo ruo, Arnon Bawphie taata Hermon Tluo te, hne Arabah ningchiyluo kuo siepahruo tie ta ama cuo.

Heshbon lie a awpa Amor Siepahruo Sihon, a uvna ruo ca Arnon Bawphie kie lie a awpa Aroer taata bawphie lie khingkhuo Jabbok cavaa Ammon ming ruoriy te ta cuo te, capa ca Gilead ruo khingkhuo ta a cuo,
cakhutaata Arabah ningchiy ruo, ningchiyluo kuo ta Khinneroth riyliy te, Beth-jeshimoth kuo luo ta Arabah riyliy te, Riyliy thiypa, sungluo kuo ta Pisgah cabung phyichaa te;
cakhutaata Refaim ming aa ngaapa chungtaata pakha ta a cuopa Bashan siepahruo Og, ama ca Ashtaroth hne Edrei lieta aw te,
Hermon Tluo hne Salekah hne Bashan yalya, Geshur hne Maakath ruoriy te ta, hne Gilead ruo khingkhuo Heshbon siepahruo Sihon ruoriy te ta a uv.
Abyipachangtaapa Moses hne Israel ming ta iema ca ama te; Abyipachangtaapa Moses ta ama ruo ca Reuben ming hne Gad ming hne Manasseh phang khingkhuo kha ru ta a pi yi.

A raw luo'apa tie hing Jordan cavaa ningtlaluo kuo lieta Joshua hne Israel ming ta ama tepa siepahruo tie hne ama ruo zaw ta ama cuo: Lebanon bawphie chung Baal-gad taata Seir luo kuo ta a kiethawpa Halak Tluo te (cakhutaata Joshua ta ama ruo ca Israel mingphang zaw kha ama rena haa khata ru ta a pi yi,
tluocung ruo, ase ruo, Arabah ruo, cabung ruo, ruocaapa, Negeb ruo, Hit ruo, Amor ruo, Kanaan ruo, Periz ruo, Hiv ruo, hne Jebus ruo):
Jeriko siepahruo, pakha; Bethel athaalie a awpa Ai siepahruo, pakha;
Jerusalem siepahruo, pakha; Hebron siepahruo, pakha;
Jarmuth siepahruo, pakha; Lakhish siepahruo, pakha;
Eglon siepahruo, pakha; Gezer siepahruo, pakha;
Debir siepahruo, pakha; Geder siepahruo, pakha;
Hormah siepahruo, pakha; Arad siepahruo, pakha;
Libnah siepahruo, pakha; Adullam siepahruo, pakha;
Makkedah siepahruo, pakha; Bethel siepahruo, pakha;
Tappuah siepahruo, pakha; Hefer siepahruo, pakha;
Afek siepahruo, pakha; Lasharon siepahruo, pakha;
Madon siepahruo, pakha; Hazor siepahruo, pakha;
Shimron-meron siepahruo, pakha; Akhshaf siepahruo, pakha;
Taanak siepahruo, pakha; Megiddo siepahruo, pakha;
Kedesh siepahruo, pakha; Karmel lie a awpa Jokneam siepahruo, pakha;
Nafath-dor lie a awpa Dor siepahruo, pakha; Galilee lie a awpa Goiim siepahruo, pakha;
Tirzah siepahruo, pakha; ama bangkhuo ta siepahruo sawthung pakha ta ama cuo.
Joshua ca macuo te a kung a hluvsa tli; Abyipata ama kyihuo khata, “Nama ca macuo cate na kung a hluvsa tli, cuorasala cu riypa ruo a hluvsa aa ngaa kalie.
Hingpa tie hing aa ngaa kaliepa ruo ta ama cuo: Filistin ming ruo a yalya ta hne Geshur ming ruo yalya ta

(Izipt ningchiyluo ta a awpa Shihor taata chaluo kuo Ekron ruoriy te, capa ca Kanaan ming ruo ta ri pata a cuo; Filistin byi papangaa aw yi te, Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath, hne Ekron), cakhutaata Avvim ming ruo,
sungluo kuo ta, Kanaan ming ruo bangkhuo, Sidon ming huopa ta a cuopa Mearah, Amor ming ruoriy Afek te,
Gebal ming ruo, hne ningchiyluo kuo ta Lebanon bangkhuo, Baal-gad taata Hermon Tluo raw Lebo-hamath te,

Lebanon taata Misrefoth-maim te ta tluocung ruo lie khy a sapa bangkhuo, Sidon ming bangkhuo te khata, kama hrahring ta Israel ming hmiekung taa khata a cade'a yi angte, bie ica pipa haa khata ruo ca Israel ming kha ru ta za che tie yi.
Caacuonakawta ata hingta hingpa ruo hing mingphang phang caky hne Manasseh mingphang khingkhuo kha ru ta che tie yi,” a ta.
A hrangpa Manasseh phang chekha hne Reuben ming hne Gad ming ca Moses ta a pipa yi Jordan cavaa ningchiyluo ruo kha, Abyipachangtaapa Moses ta a pipa haa yi khata ama cu:
Arnon Bawphie kie lie a awpa Aroer taata bawphie liekhingkhuo lie a awpa khy, hne ase ruo ta a cuopa Medeba taata Dibon te yalya;
Heshbon lie a awpa Amor ming siepahruo Sihon khypuv bangkhuo, Ammon ming ruoriy te ta;
cakhutaata Gilead, hne Geshur ming hne Maakath ming ruo, Hermon Tluo bangkhuo, Bashan taata Salekah te bangkhuo;
Ashtaroth hne Edrei lie a awpa Bashan siepahruo Og pena bangkhuo (Refaim ming a hringpa ta a ngaapa zaw hrawlie pakha dyi aa ngaapa); hingpa tie hing Moses ta te yi te aa cadepa tie ta ama cuo.
Cuorasala Geshur ming acuolikie Maakath ming ca Israel ming ta a cade va yi; Geshur hne Maakath ca ataning tepa hingta Israel ming hne tana ama aw.
Levi phang dyi kha Moses ta ru a pi lipa ta ama cuo; ama ta a chang tlipa haa yi khata Israel ming ta AbyipaKhazing'a luo myirue panaana ta ama pihluopa ca iema ru ta a cuo.
Moses ta Reuben phang kha a chung a chung ta ru a pi yi.
Ama ruo ca Arnon Bawphie kie lie a awpa Aroer taata bawphie liekhingkhuo lie a awpa khy te, hne Medeba cahriy ase ruo bangkhuo;
Heshbon hne ase ruo lie a awpa khy bangkhuo; Dibon, hne Bamoth-baal, hne Beth-baal-meon,
cakhutaata Jahaz, hne Kedemoth, hne Mefaath,
hne Kiriathaim, hne Sibmah, hne ase ruo tluo cunglie a awpa Zereth-shahar,
cakhutaata Beth-peor, hne Pisgah cabung ruo, hne Beth-jeshimoth,

capa ca ase ruo lie khy bangkhuo, hne Heshbon lie a awpa Amor ming Siepahruo Shihon pena bangkhuo ta a cuo. Moses ta ama ca Midian uvtuv tie ta a cuopa Evi hne Rekem hne Zur hne Hur hne Reba tapa Sihon kuv rawlie byi tie, a ruo chunglie a awpa tie hne khata a te yi.
Boer sacapaa Balaam, hmungdawluna a tuepa, zaw kha Israel ming ta aa ngaapa ama thiepa tie hne khata ama thie puo.
Reuben ming ama ruoriy ca Jordan cavaa hne cavaa kie khata a cuo. Hingpa hing Reuben ming ta ama ingchungkhue zaa hne aa ziy pata ama cupa ruo ta a cuo, a khypuv hne a khyta zaw hne khata.
Moses ta Gad phang zaw kha ama ingchungkhue zaa hne aa ziy pata ru a pi yi.
Ama ruo ca Jazer, hne Gilead ruo khy bangkhuo, hne Ammon ming ruo khingkhuo, Rabbah ningchiyluo ta a awpa Aroer te,
cakhutaata Heshbon taata Ramath-mizpeh hne Betonim, hne Mahanaim taata Debir ruo te,

cakhutaata bawphie chunglie Heshbon siepahruo Sihon pena chunglieta aa ngaapa, Beth-nimrah, Sukkoth, hne Zafon, Jordan cavaa hne a kiecahriy, aa ne luo ta Khinneroth Riyliy a chuonapa, Jordan cavaa huesuo ningchiy ruo te ta a cuo.
Hingpa hing Gad ming ta ama ingchungkhue zaa hne aa ziy pata a khypuv hne a khyta zaw hne yalya ta ama cupa ruo ta a cuo.
Moses ta Manasseh phang khingkhuo kha ru a pi yi; capa ca Manasseh ming khingkhuo tie kha ama ingchungkhue zaa hne aa ziy pata repa ama cuo.
Ama ruo ca Mahanaim taata Bashan ruo bangkhuo, Bashan Siepahruo Og pena yalya ta, hne Bashan ruo chunglie Jair tie khysanapa yalya, a khy ta khy sawcaruv,

cakhutaata Gilead ruo khingkhuo, hne Ashtaroth, hne Edrei, Bashan lie Og pena lie khy tie, hingpa hing Manasseh sacapaa Makhir cawsaa tie, Makhir ming khingkhuo kha ama ingchungkhue zaa hne aa ziy pata re pata ama cuo.
Hingpa hing Jordan cavaa huesuo Jeriko taata ningchiyluo Moab ase ruo chunglie Moses ta a repa yi ruo ta a cuo.
Cuorasala Levi phang tie kha Moses ta ru pi va yi; ama ta a changpa haa yi ta AbyipaIsrael Khazing ca ama ru ta a cuo.
Hingpa tie hing tluobyi Eleazar, hne Nun sacapaa Joshua, hne Israel ming ama phang luv a cuopa tie ta ama repa, Kanaan ruo chunglie Israel ming ta ama cupa ruo ta ama cuo.
Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haata phang caky hne phang che tie ru ama cupa ca vyisung a da pata ama cupa a cuo.
Tahematapakieca Moses ta Jordan cavaa ningchiyluo kha ru a pi tli yi; cuorasala Levi ming ca iema hrawlie kha ru pi ra va yi.

Josef ciypathla tie ca phang hning cuo yi te, Manasseh phang hne Efraim phang ta ama cuo; Levi ming ca ruo chunglie kha cuvu pipa cuo va yi, cuorasala ama awna riypa khy zaw hne ama cue hne ama sahring zaw tlena riypa ruo dyi kha pi pata ama cuo.
Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haa khata Israel ming ta ama tue; ruo kha amaa re.

Cakhutaata Judah phang cawsaa tie ca Gilgal lieta Joshua'a luo kha amaa vaw; Keniz ming Jefunneh sacapaa Kaleb ta ama kha, “Nama hne kama kawlieta Abyipata Khazing cawsaapa Moses kyihuo ta Kadesh-barnea lie bie a changpa kha na pachang.
Abyipachangtaapa Moses ta Kadesh-barnea taata ruo a ngiepatlie riypata ina pathlie ning kha kung sawliy na a ta ang; ama'a luo kha aa dangsa pata bie i phya.
Cuorasala kama hne a sipa i viesaa tie ta ca cawsaa palung kha ama para; cuorasala kama ca i pathiypalung hmisi ta AbyipaKhazing kha i ziy.

Cakhutaata khapa ning kha Moses ta chie a sa te, ‘Abyipai Khazing ca na pathiypalung hmisi ta na ziy nakawta, na phyi ta na tlawpa ruo ca nama hne na saata zaw cuota chuozaa ta ru ama cuo hrahring aa,” a ta.

Cakhutaata ata hing, na hmungpa haa hingta, Israel ming ruocaapa lie khy ama tlawle ning, Abyipata Moses'a lie hingpa bie a za ri ning taata kung sawliy chung hing a ripa haata Abyipata hringna ina pi; ataning hingpa lie hing, kama ca kung saw cari kung pangaa i ta mangtli.

Moses ta ina za pathlie ning i cahrapa tluv khata ataning hing i cahra kalie; rie tuv riypata cuose, vaa riypata cuose, a vaw riypata cuose, ataning i thaazuo hing kha ning i thaazuo haa kha tana a cuo thluo.

Caacuonakawta khapa ning lieta Abyipata a za ripa hingpa tluocung ruo hing ata hingta na pi tie; tahematapakieca Anakim ming ta khapa lie kha a cusa pata aa cadung khuopa khypuv zaw hneta tuokhaatama ama za aw tapa kha, khapa ning lie khata na za thyi mangtli. Abyipata a ripa haa khata, Abyipata na awpuo'a te, iema kha i cade khu ngiethie'a yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Joshua ta thluechiy pi te, Hebron ca Jefunneh sacapaa Kaleb kha ru ta a pi.
Caacuonakawta Hebron ca ataning tepa hingta Keniz phang Jefunneh sacapaa Kaleb ru ta aa li, tahematapakieca AbyipaIsrael Khazing kha pathiypalung hmisi ta a za ziy nakawta a cuo.
Hebron khy a ming ca a hluo ning ca Kiriath-arba tana a za cuo; hingpa Arba hing Anak ming hrawlie a lesyi cepa tana a za cuo. Cakhutaata ruo chunglie ca rie a die.
Judah phang cuota ama ingchungkhue zaa hne aa ziy pata ama cuvu ca sungluo kuo ta Edom ruoriy te, sungluo ce ta Zin ruocaapa te ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata sungluo kuo ama ruoriy ca Riyliy Thiypa a denapa, sungluo kuo ta a hyipa riyliy syipahya taata,

Akrabbim taata kya kienapa sungluo kuo khata si te Zin te ta a cuo, cakhutaata Kadesh-barnea sungluo kuo ta a kya kie, Hezron athaalie khata caluo te, Addar luo a kya kie, capa taa cata Karka luo aa maa.
Azmon luo kha tathlyalya caluo te, Izipt ruo cavaata luo pya te riyliy lie a va chuo. Hingpa hing sungluo kuo na ruoriy ta a cuo aa.
Cakhutaata ningchiyluo kuo ruoriy ca Riyliy Thiypa ta a cuo, Jordan cavaa a zaa tawna te ta.
Cakhutaata ruoriy ca Beth-hoglah luo sithaw te, Beth-arabah chaluo kuo kha a caluo; cakhutaata Reuben sacapaa Bohan Alung te a sithaw;

cakhutaata ruoriy ca Debir taata Akhor Bawphie luo sithaw te, sungluo kuo ta ca bawphie sungluo kuo ta a awpa Adummim luo sinapa a rie-e Gilgal luo kha aa maa, cakhutaata ruoriy ca En-shemesh tiy luo kha tathlyalya ta caluo te, En-rogel lieta a chuo.

Cakhutaata ruoriy ca Hinnom sacapaa bawphie athaalie Jebus ming awnapa (capa ca, Jerusalem) sungluo kuo cabung ruo lie kha a sithaw, cakhutaata ruoriy ca, ningtlaluo, Refaim bawphie chaluo kuo ta, Hinnom bawphie a rie-e lie a awpa tluo cung te a kya kiethaw;

Cakhutaata ruoriy ca tluodaw taa cata Nephtoah tiy a tiyhnaa te va si te, capa taa cata Efron Tluo lie a awpa khy zaw luo kha a va chiy, cakhutaata ruoriy ca Baalah (capa ca Kiriath-jearim); luo khata aa kyi,

capa taa cata ruoriy ca Baalah kha ningtlaluo kuo ta cahlung te Seir Tluo luo ava pya, Jearim Tluo (capa ca Khesalon) chaluo cabung ruo lie kha va caluo te Beth-shemesh luo a sibung, cakhutaata Timnah athaalie khata a caluo.
Ruoriy ca Ekron chaluo kuo tluo pachung luo kha pyathaw te, Shikkeron athaa luo khata aa vya kyi, cakhutaata Baalah Tluo luo kha caluo te Jabneel lie a pya; cakhutaata ruoriy ca riyliy lie a za chuo.
Cakhutaata ningtlaluo ruoriy ca Mediterranean riyliy hne a kie ta a cuo. Hingpa hing Judah ming ama ingchungkhue zaa hne aa ziy pata, a cadungpa yi ruoriy ta a cuo.
Abyipata Joshua'a lie a pipa nawbie haata, Jefunneh sacapaa Kaleb ca Judah ming hrawlieta a cuvu suokha ta a cuopa Kiriath-arba kha a pi, capa ca Hebron ta a cuo (Arba ca Anak paa ta a cuo).
Cakhutaata Kaleb ta Anak sacapaa pathung tie: Sheshai, Ahiman, hne Talmai, Anak ciypathla tie kha capa taa cata aa cade yi.
Capa taa cata Debir khy ming kha a du riypata a sithaw; ata lie Debir hing hluo ningta ca Kiriath-sefer ama za ta.
Cakhutaata Kaleb ta, “Ahung a cuo zaw Kiriath-sefer kha tuv te a lapa ca i sacanung Aksah na napuv ta i pi aa,” a ta.
Kaleb nuta Kenaz sacapaa Othniel ta la te, a sacanung Aksah ca napuv ta a pi.
Ama'a luo aa vaw tiyta, a paa kha lu suokha a hie riypata a chang. A laa cung taata a cungpa khata, Kaleb ta, “Khaapama na khing?” a ta.
Ama ta, “Lasaw suokha na pi tie; Negeb ruo chunglie ina chi nakaw ca ta, acaa zaw na pipuo tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Kaleb ta a cungluo acaa zaw hne a rawluo acaa zaw kha a pi.
Hingpa hing ama ingchungkhue zaa hne aa ziy pata Judah phang ta ama cupa ruo ta a cuo.
Judah phang ta ama cupa khy zaw ca, Sungluo kuo ce, Edom ruoriy kuo luo ta, Kabzeel, Eder, hne Jagur,
Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,
Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,
Zif, Telem, Bealoth,
Hazor-hadattah, Kerioth-hezron (capa ca Hazor)
Amam, Shema, Moladah,
Hazar-gaddah, Heshmon, Beth-pelet,
Hazaw-shual, Beer-sheba, Biziothiah,
Baalah, I-im, Ezem,
Eltolad, Khesil, Hormah,
Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,
Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, hne Rimmon: a bangkhuo ta khypuv suokiy suocaky a cuo, a khyta zaw hneta.
Cakhutaata ase ruo lieta, Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,
Zanoah, En-gannim, Tappuah, Enam,
Jarmuth, Adullam, Sokoh, Azekah,
Shaaraim, Adithaim, Gederah, Gederothaim: khypuv suohraa hlyipaliy a cuo, a khyta zaw hneta.
Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal-gad,
Dilan, Mizpeh, Jokthe-el,
Lakhish, Bozkath, Eglon,
Kabbon, Lahmam, Khitlish,
Gederoth, Beth-dagon, Naamah, hne Makkedah: khypuv suohraa hlyicaruv a cuo, a khyta zaw hneta.
Libnah, Ether, Ashan,
Iftah, Ashnah, Nezib,
Keilah, Akhzib, hne Mareshah: khypuv suo caky a cuo, a khyta zaw hneta.
Ekron, hne a cahriylie khypuv zaw hne khyta zaw;
Ekron taata riyliy te, Ashdod athaalie a awpa bangkhuo ta a cuo, a khyta zaw hneta.
Ashdod, a khypuv hne a khyta zaw: Gaza, a khypuv zaw hne a khyta zaw; Izipt lie cavaata te, hne Riyliy Lepa hne a kie te.
Tluocung ruo chunglie, Shamir, Jattir, Sokoh,
Dannah, Kiriath-sannah (capa ca Debir),
Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,
Goshen, Holon, hne Giloh: khypuv suohraa hlyikha ta a cuo, a khyta zaw hneta.
Arab, Dumah, Eshan,
Janim, Beth-tappuah, Afekah,
Humtah, Kiriath-arba (capa ca, Hebron), hne Zior: khypuv suocaky ta a cuo, a khyta zaw hneta.
Maon, Karmel, Zif, Juttah,
Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,
Kain, Gibeah, hne Timnah: khypuv suohraa ta a cuo, a khyta zaw hneta.
Halhul, Beth-zur, Gedor,
Maarath, Beth-anoth, hne Eltekon: khypuv suocaruv ta a cuo, a khyta zaw hneta.
Kiriath-baal (capa ca Kiriath-jearim), hne Rabbah: khypuv suohning ta a cuo, a khyta zaw hneta.
Ruocaapa chunglieta, Beth-arabah, Middin, Sekakah,
Nibshan, Paciy Khypuv, hne En-gedi: khypuv suocaruv ta a cuo, a khyta zaw hneta.
Cuorasala Judah ming ta Jerusalem lie khy a sapa Jebus ming kha a cade khu va yi; caacuonakawta Jebus ming ca Judah ming hneta Jerusalem lie ataning tepa hingta ama aw.
Josef ciypathla zaw cuvu ca Jeriko athaalie Jordan cavaa, Jeriko acaa ningchiyluo taa khata ruocaapa lieta si te, Jeriko taa khata sithaw te tluocung ruo Bethel te,
cakhutaata Bethel taata si te Luz te, Arki ming ruo Ataroth luo kha tathlyalya ta a cahraw;
Cakhutaata ningtlaluo kuo ta sibung te Jaflet ming ruo Beth-horon te, cakhutaata Gezer te pha te riyliy lie a chuo.
Josef ciypathla Manasseh hne Efraim ca ama cuvu ru kha ama cu.
Efraim ming ama ingchungkhue zaa hne aa ziy pata ama cupa ruo ca: ningchiyluo kuo ta ama cupa ruo ruoriy ca Ataroth-addar taata Cungluo Beth-horon te,

cakhutaata ruoriy ca capa taa cata si te riyliy te; chaluo kuo ca Mikhmethath te; cakhutaata ningchiyluo kuo ta ruoriy ca Taanath-shiloh luo kha a maa te, capa ca va law te Janoah ningchiyluo kuo te a chiy,
cakhutaata ruoriy ca Janoah taata sibung te Ataroth hne Naarah te, cakhutaata Jeriko va de te Jordan cavaa lie a chuo.
Ruoriy ca Tappuah taata ningtlaluo ta si te Kanah cavaata te chiy te riyliy lie a chuo. Efraim mingphang zaw ama ingchungkhue zaa ziy pata ama cupa ruo ca cahaacata a cuo.
Manasseh cuvu chungtaata Efraim ming cuota ama chipa khy zaw, khypuv bangkhuo hne a khyta zaw hneta a cuo.

Cuorasala iema ta Gezer lie a awpa Kanaan ming kha ca a cade va yi: caacuonakawta ataning tepa hingta Kanaan ming ca Efraim ming hrawlieta ama aw, cuorasala re pahrie sapa, rehrietuv tana ama cuo tli.

Cakhutaata Manasseh phang kha ru pi pata ama cuo, tahematapakieca ama ca Josef sa-uvthyi tana a cuo. Manasseh sa-uvthyi Makhir, Gilead a paa ca rieka a cuo nakawta Gilead ruo hne Bashan ruo kha pi pata a cuo.

Cakhutaata aa ngaapa Manasseh phang tie kha re pata ama cuo, ama ingchungkhue zaa hne aa ziy pata, Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shekhem, Hefer, hne Shemida; hingpa tie hing Josef sacapaa Manasseh ciypathla capaa luo kuo ta ama ingchungkhue zaw ta ama cuo.
Manasseh sacapaa Makhir sacapaa Gilead sacapaa Hefer sacapaa Zelofehad ca sacapaa hnyi vyi, sacanung dyi a hnyi yi; hingpa hing a sacanung tie ming ta a cuo: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah, hne Tirzah.

Iema ta tluobyi Eleazar hne Nun sacapaa Joshua hne luochiytuv tie'a luo kha a vaw yi te, “Abyipana Moses kha ma chungkha capaa zaw hneta ru ma cu ra riypata bie a pi,” ama ta. Caacuonakawta Abyipanawbie haa cata ama paa uvnu zaw hrawlie ca ru a pi ra yi.
Cahaacata Jordan huesuoluo ta a awpa Gilead hne Bashan ruo thang taa khata Manasseh ta cuvu suohraa a cu,
tahematapakieca Manasseh sacanung zaw ta a sacapaa zaw hneta ru ama cu ra nakawta a cuo. Gilead ruo ca Manasseh ming a hrangpa tie ta ama cu.
Manasseh ruo ca Asher taata Shekhem ningchiyluo a awpa Mikhmethath te a chiy, cakhutaata ruoriy ca sungluo kuo En-tappuah ming awnapa te ta a sibung.
Tappuah ruo ca Manasseh huopa ta a cuo, cuorasala Manasseh ruoriy lie a awpa Tappuah khy ca Efraim ming huopa ta a cuo.

Cakhutaata ruoriy ca Kanah cavaata luo ta a sibung. Cavaa sungluo kuo Manasseh khy zaw hrawlieta a awpa khy tie hing ca Efraim huopa tana a cuo. Cakhutaata Manasseh ruoriy ca capa cavaa chaluo kuo cata si te riyliy lieta a chuo.
