Sungluo kuo ruo ca Efraim ruo ta cuo te, chaluo kuo ruo ca Manasseh ruo ta a cuo, ruoriy ca riyliy ta cuo te, chaluo ta Asher te a pha, ningchiyluo ta Issakhar te a pha.

Issakhar hne Asher ruo chunglie zaw, Beth-shean hne a khyta zaw, Ibleam hne a khyta zaw, Dor lie khy a sapa tie hne a khyta zaw, En-dor lie khy a sapa tie hne a khyta zaw, Taanak lie khy a sapa tie hne a khyta zaw, Megiddo lie khy a sapa tie hne a khyta zaw ca Manasseh huopa ta a cuo; (Suothungnapa hing Nafath ta a cuo).
Cuorasala Manasseh ming ta capa khy ming ca a cade khu va yi; caacuonakawta Kanaan ming ca capa ruo lie ca ama aw pazue.
Cuorasala Israel ming ama kya cahra hryly tiyta, iema ta Kanaan ming ca rehrietuv ta hmuo yi te, a cade diy karue va yi.
Josef phang tie khata Joshua kyihuo ta, “Abyipata thluechiy malie pi te, cawsaa hluvpa ma cuo pata, khaapanakawma cuvu suokha hne hmang suokha dyi malie na pi?” ama ta.

Caacuonakawta Joshua ta, “Niema ca cawsaa hluvpa nama cuo kieca, atuv luo kha sithaw ung la, Periz ming hne Refaim ming zaw ruo lie khiy ruo kya pathe tie nie ung, Efraim tluocung ruo hing nama cuota a baa tuv kieca,” a ta.

Josef phang tie ta, “Tluocung ruo ca kiema cuota a de vyi; cuorasala ase ruo lie a awpa Kanaan ming bangkhuo ca Beth-shean hne a khyta lie a awpa tie cuose, Jezreel Bawphie lie a awpa tie cuose, thaa aruole ama hnyi kaluo,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Joshua ta Josef phang tie, Efraim hne Manasseh tie kyihuo khata, “Niema ca cawsaa hluvpa ta cuo hmisi ung cate, a cahrasa pata nama cuo; cuvu suokha dyi hnyi'a va ung ciy,

cuorasala tluocung ruo ca niema huopa ta a cuo aa, atuv tahmuo cuorasala pathe ung la aa hla cepa ruoriy te khata cu tie ung; Kanaan ming ca thaa aruole hnyi yi te cahra ra mang yi sala a cade tie ung,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata Israel ming cawsaazaapuv ca Shiloh lie kha a hmya yi te, atawna thluodaa kha capa lie ca ama padaa. Ruo ca te cie pata ama hmiekunglie a aw.
Israel ming hrawtaata phang sariy ca cuvu pi pata cuo valie yi.
Caacuonakawta Joshua ta, “Abyipa, nama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing ta aca pipa yi ruo chung luo hing a ngie pata cu riypa kha khacuo ma namaa awkhyi aa?

Phang kha chungtaata cawsaa pathung kaluo papya ung la i pathlie'a yi; a thu'a yi te, ruo kha a bangkhuo ta cahraw'a yi te, ama cuvu riypa ruepuo pata caa lie cape'a yi te kama'a luo kha ama vya kaa aa.
Capa ruo ca che sariy ta che'a yi te, Judah ming ca ama ruo lie, sungluo lie kha aw pazue'a yi te, Josef chung tie ca ama ruo lie, chaluo lie kha ama aw aa.
Che sariy ta chepa ruo kaw ca caa lie cape'a ung cate kama'a luo nama vya cyi aa; cakhutaata kama ta Abyipaima Khazing hmiekunglie kha vyisung ica pada sa'a yi.

Levi ming ca niema hrawlie cuvu hnyi va yi, tahematapakieca tluobyicuona ca iema cuvu ta a cuo; cakhutaata Gad hne Reuben hne Manasseh phang khingkhuo ca Abyipachangtaapa Moses ta a pipa haa yi ta Jordan cavaa ningchiyluo kuo ta cuvu ama hnyi tli,” a ta yi.

Caacuonakawta capa cawsaa tie ca amaa thu; ruo kaw caa cape riypata a sipa tie ca Joshua ta bie taa yi te, “Ruo ca va cahraw diy ung la a kaw kha caa lie cape tie ung; cakhutaata kama'a luo kha vya kaa ung la hingpa Shiloh lie Abyipahmiekunglie hing kama ta vyisung ica pada sa'a yi,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta cawsaa tie ca si yi te ruo ca ama va cahraw diy, a khy a khy ta che sariy ta ama chepa ruo kaw ca caa lie ama cape; cakhutaata Shiloh lie Joshua'a luo kha ama vya kaa.
Cakhutaata Shiloh lie Abyipahmiekunglie kha Joshua ta iema kha vyisung a pada sa yi; cahaacata Joshua ta ama cuvu cyicuo khata Israel ming kha ruo ca a re yi.
Benjamin phang ama ingchungkhue zaa hne aa ziy pata vyisung amaa dapa ca pya te, ama cupa ruo ca Judah phang hne Josef phang alalalieta a cuo.
Chaluo kuo ama ruoriy ca Jordan taata a patha; cakhutaata ruoriy ca Jeriko chaluo ningtlaluo kuo tluocung ruo luo kha a sithaw; cakhutaata Beth-aven ruocaapa lieta a chuo.

Capa taa cata ruoriy ca sungluo, Luz luo khata tathlyalya si te, Luz cabung ruo kha a pha (capa ca Bethel), cakhutaata ruoriy ca Ataroth-addar luo, Beth-horon aa ne ruo taata sungluo kuo ta a awpa tluo luo kha a pha.

Cakhutaata ruoriy ca a kuo hrang luo ta a si, sungluo kuo ta a laabungpa tluo taa cata ningtla sungluo kuo, Beth-horon a rie-e luo ta a maa te, Judah phang khy ta a cuopa Kiriath-baal lieta a chuo (capa ca Kiriat-jearim ta a cuo).
Sungluokuo ca Kiriath-jearim a chuona taata a patha; ruoriy ca capa taa cata Efron luo, Nephtoah Tiy acaa te khata a si;

cakhutaata ruoriy ca Refaim bawphie chaluo kuo a chuona lie a awpa Hinnom sacapaa bawphie a rie-e lie a awpa tluo thabaw lie khata a sibung; cakhutaata Hinnom bawphie lie khata a sibung, Jebus ming cabung ruo sungluo khata sibung te, En-rogel luo a chiy;
cakhutaata chaluo kuo ta a kyi te En-shemesh luo a si, cakhutaata Adummim luo kienapa a rie-e lie a awpa Geliloth luo ta a si; cakhutaata Reuben sacapaa Bohan Alung luo a sibung;
cakhutaata Beth-arabah cabung ruo kha cahraw te Arabah luo a sibung;
cakhutaata ruoriy ca Beth-hoglah cabung ruo chaluo lie khata si te, sungluo Jordan a chuonapa, Riyliy Thiypa chaluo a pazuenapa lie kha a chuo; capa ca sungluo kuo ruoriy ta a cuo.
Ningchiyluo kuo ruoriy ca Jordan ta a cuo. Capa ca Benjamin phang tie ama ingchungkhue zaa hne aa ziy pata ama cupa ruo, a kuo bangkhuo ta ama ruoriy ta a cuo.
Ama ingchungkhue pha zaa hne aa ziy pata Benjamin phang tie ama khy zaw ca Jeriko, Beth-hoglah, Emek-keziz,
Beth-arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,
Avvim, Parah, Ofrah,
Khefar-ammoni, Ofni, Geba, khypuv suohraa hlyihning hne a khyta zaw: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,
Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,
Mizpeh, Khephirah, Mozah,
Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,
Zela, Haeleph, Jebus (capa ca Jerusalem), Gibeah hne Kiriath-jearim, khypuv hlyipaliy hne a khyta zaw. Hingpa hing Benjamin phang tie ta ama ingchungkhue zaa hne aa ziy pata ama cupa ruo ta a cuo.
Vyisung suohningnapa ca Simeon cuota a pya, ama ingchungkhue zaa hne aa ziy pata Simeon phang cuota ama cupa vu ca Judah phang ta ama cupa chunglie khata a tla ra.
Ama ta a cupa tie ca Beer-sheba, Sheba, Moladah,
Hazar-shual, Balah, Ezem,
Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,
Ziklag, Beth-markaboth, Hazar-susah,
Beth-lebaoth, hne Sharuhen khy hraa hlyithung hne a khyta zaw;
Ain, Rimmon, Ether, hne Ashan khy paliy hne a khyta zaw;
capa khy zaw a cadung pata a awpa a khyta zaw bangkhuo hne Baalath-beer te, Negeb ruo Ramah te. Hingpa hing Simeon phang ta ama ingchungkhue zaa hne aa ziy pata ama cupa ta a cuo.

Simeon phang ta ama cupa ruo ca Judah phang ta ama cupa chekha chunglie khata a cuo; tahematapakieca Judah phang ta ama cupa ruo ca iema cuota a le tuv nakawta Simeon phang ta iema ama cupa ruo chunglie kha ru ama cu ra.
Vyisung suothungnapa ca ama ingchungkhue zaa hne aa ziy pata Zebulun cuota a pya. Iema ama cupa ruo ca Sarid te a pha.
Cakhutaata ama ruoriy ca ningtlaluo kuo ta a sithaw, cakhutaata Maralah luo ta si te Dabbesheth te a si, cakhutaata Jokneam ningchiy lie a awpa cavaata te a pha.
Sarid taata a kuo hrang luo, ningchiyluo ta si te Khisloth-tabor ruoriy luo a pha; capa taa cata Daberath luo si te cakhutaata Jafia luo a kiethaw.
Capa taa cata ningchiyluo kha tathlyalya ta si te Gath-hefer te a chiy, Eth-kazin te chiy te, cakhutaata Rimmon luo sithaw te Neah luo ta aa kyi.
Cakhutaata chaluo Hannathon luo khata ruoriy ca a maa te, Iftah-el bawphie lie kha a chuo;
cakhutaata Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, hne Bethlehem khypuv hlyihning hne a khyta zaw hneta.
Hingpa hing Zebulun phang ta ama ingchungkhue zaa hne aa ziy pata ama cupa ruo ta a cuo, hingpa khypuv tie hne a khyta zaw hneta.
Vyisung suopaliynapa ca ama ingchungkhue zaa hne aa ziy pata Issakhar phang cuota a pya.
Ama ruo ca Jezreel, Khesulloth, Shunem,
Hafaraim, Shion, Anaharath,
Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,
Remeth, En-gannim, En-haddah, Beth-pazzez zaw kha a ung;
ama ruoriy ca Tabor, Shahazumah, hne Beth-shemesh te va pha te, Jordan lie a chuo; khypuv hlyicaruv hne a khyta zaw hneta.
Hingpa hing Issakhar phang tie ama ingchungkhue zaa hne aa ziy pata ama cupa ruo ta a cuo, khypuv zaw hne a khyta zaw hneta.
Vyisung suopangaana ca ama ingchungkhue zaa hne aa ziy pata Asher phang cuota a pya.
Ama cupa ruo chunglie ca Helkath, Hali, Beten, Akhshaf,
Allammelek, Amad, hne Shihor-libnath,

cakhutaata ningchiyluo kuo ta a maa te, Beth-dagon luo kha a si, cakhutaata Zebulun hne Iftah-el bawphie va de te, chaluo kuo ta si te Beth-emek hne Neiel luo khata a si; cakhutaata chaluo kuo ta si pathla te Kabul,
Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, Kanah, hne Sidon Lepa te a chiy;
cakhutaata ruoriy ca Ramah luo a maa te dungkhuopa khypuv Tair luo a chiy; cakhutaata ruoriy ca Hosah luo ta a maa te riyliy lie a chuo; Mahalab, Akzib,
Ummah, Afek, hne Rehob khypuv suokiy suohning hne a khyta zaw hneta.
Hingpa hing ama ingchungkhue zaa hne aa ziy pata Asher phang ama cupa ruo ta a cuo, hingpa khypuv zaw hing hne a khyta zaw hneta.
Vyisung suocaruvnapa ca ama ingchungkhue zaa hne aa ziy pata Naftali phang cuota a pya.
A ruoriy ca Helef hne Zannannim lie a awpa mathliy kung, hne Adami-nekeb, hne Jabneel taata pathu te, Lakkum te a si; Jordan lieta a chuo.

Cakhutaata ruoriy ca ningtlaluo kuo Aznoth-tabor luo ta a maa te, capa taa cata Hukkok luo a si, sungluo kuo ta Zebulun za de te, cakhutaata ningtlaluo kuo ta Asher, hne ningchiyluo ta Judah va capie te Jordan a pha.
Dungkhuopa khypuv tie ca Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth,
Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,
Kedesh, Edrei, En-hazor,
Iron, Migdal-el, Horem, Beth-anath, hne Beth-shemesh khy hraa hlyicaky hne a khyta zaw hneta.
Hingpa hing Naftali phang tie ta ama ingchungkhue hne aa ziy pata ama cupa ruo ta a cuo, khypuv zaw hne a khyta zaw hneta.
Vyisung suosariynapa ca Dan phang cuota ama ingchungkhue zaa hne aa ziy pata a pya.
Ama cupa ruo ca Zorah, Eshtaol, Ir-shemesh,
Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,
Elon, Timnah, Ekron,
Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,
Jehud, Bene-berak, Gath-rimmon,
Me-jarkon, hne Joppa ruoriy a rie-e lie a awpa Rakkon zaw kha a ung.

Dan ming ta ama ruo kha amaa sung tiyta, Dan ming ca sithaw yi te Leshem kha ama tuv, te yi te zueziy ta ama thie diy khutaata la yi te a chunglie ama aw, ama mingchingmingvuo ta a cuopa Dan ming kha la pata Leshem kha Dan ta pata ama u.
Hingpa hing Dan phang tie ta ama ingchungkhue zaa hne aa ziy pata ama cupa ruo ta a cuo, hingpa khypuv tie hne a khyta zaw hne khata.
Ruo ca ama cuvu kaluo amaa re diy khutaata Israel ming ta Nun sacapaa Joshua kha iema hrawlie cuvu suokha ama pi.
Abyipabiepina haata ama ta aa hiepa yi khypuv kha ama pi, Efraim tluocung ruo lie a awpa Timnath-serah khy kha ama pi; khypuv kha sa pathiy te a chunglie khy a sa.

Hingpa tie hing tluobyi Eleazar hne Nun sacapaa Joshua hne Israel ming a phang kaluo ta luochiytuv tie ta Shiloh lie, Abyipahmiekung, atawna thluodaa thlake lie vyisung a da yi te amaa repa ama cuvu ta a cuo. Cahaacata ruo a renapa kha ama patlung.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Joshua kyihuo khata,
“Israel ming kha, ‘Moses'a taata niema'a lie i ripa canawna khypuv tie kha pasang tie ung,
tahematapakieca a ting paciena aw li pata hne rue li pata cawsaa a thie pathlyipa tie kha capa luo ca a ruo'a yi te, thiyse phuvlatuv'a taata nama lawna khypuv tie ta ama cuo aa.

Cawsaa a thiepa ca capa khypuv suokhakha luo kha a ruo'a te, capa khy a ngienapa thlake lie kha a daa'a te, capa khy uvthyi tie'a lie kha hmang chiycuona kha a chang'a yi; cakhutaata khy chung luo kha a ngiekhyi'a yi te, awna pi'a yi te iema'a lie kha a aw aa.
Thiyse phuvlatuv ta aa vya cadele kieca, cawsaa a thietuvpa kha a kuv luo pi'a va yi, tahematapakieca a ingpaa kha a thie pathlyi pata cuo te, ahluo ta ama pahning alalalie ahuena za aw vyi.

Cawsaa a thiepa ca cawsaazaapuv hmiekunglie bieripana a aw hluo li hne capa cuo ningta tluobyi lepa a cuopa a thiy hluo li capa khy lie ca a aw aa: cakhutaata cawsaa a thiepa ca aa ruosepa a khy lie ing luo kha a kaa aa,’ ta pata chang tie yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta iema ta Naftali tluocung ruo, Galilee ruo lie kha Kadesh, hne Efraim tluocung ruo lie kha Shekhem, hne Judah tluocung ruo lieta Kiriath-arba (capa ca Hebron) zaw kha amaa tlaw.

Cakhutaata Jordan cavaa huesuo Jeriko ningchiy ruo, Reuben phang tie taata ase ruo ruocaapa lie a awpa Bezer, hne Gad phang tie ruo taata Gilead lie a awpa Ramoth, hne Manasseh phang tie ruo taata Bashan lie a awpa Golan tapa tie kha amaa tlaw.

Hingpa khypuv tie hing Israel ming bangkhuo cuota cuose, iema'a lie khy a sapa mingpe tie cuota cuose, a tingpaciena aw li pata cawsaa a thie pathlyipa kha thiyse phuvlatuv kuv lie a thiy li riypata cawsaazaapuv hmiekunglie bieripana a aw hluo li a canawna riypata amaa tlawpa khypuv tie ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata Levi ming ingchungkhue luv a cuopa tie ta tluobyi Eleazar hne Nun sacapaa Joshua hne Israel mingphang ingchungkhue luv ta a cuopa tie'a luo kha a vaw yi te,
Kanaan ruo Shiloh lie kha iema kyihuo cata, “Abyipata kiema kha awna riypa khypuv zaw hne ma sahring zaw ama tlena riypa ruo pi riypata Moses'a lie bie a pi tli,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Abyipabiepina haata Israel ming ta Levi ming kha a rawlie khypuv tie hne sahring tlena ruo kha ama cupa ruo chung taa khata ama pi.
Vyisung ca Kohath ming ingchungkhue tie cuo khata a pya. Caacuonakawta tluobyi Aaron ciypathla ta a cuopa Levi ming ta Judah, Simeon, hne Benjamin phang tie'a taa khata khypuv hlyithung ama cu.
Aa ngaapa Kohath ming ta Efraim phang, Dan phang, hne Manasseh phang khingkhuo tie'a taa khata khypuv suohraa ama cu.
Gershon ming ta Issakhar phang ingchungkhue, Asher phang, Naftali phang, hne Bashan lie a awpa Manasseh phang khingkhuo tie'a taa khata khypuv hlyithung ama cu.
Merari tie ta ama ingchungkhue cawsaa zaa hne aa ziy pata Reuben phang, Gad phang, hne Zebulun phang tie'a taa khata khypuv hlyihning ama cu.
Abyipata Moses bie a pipa haa khata Israel ming ta Levi ming kha hingpa khypuv tie hne sahring tlena ruo kha vyisung a da yi te ama pi.
Judah phang hne Simeon phang chungtaata a ming ta ri pata a raw luo khypuv tie hing ama pi.
Vyisung suokhana lie a pyana haata Aaron ciypathla phang kha ta a cuopa Kohath chungkhue ta a cuopa Levi ming ta ama cu.
Judah tluocung ruo lie a awpa Hebron ca Kiriath-arba (Arba ca Anak paa tana a cuo) kha sahring tlena ruo zaw hneta ama pi.
Cuorasala khypuv athaalie lu zaw hne a khyta zaw ca Jefunneh sacapaa Kaleb kha ama pi.
Tluobyi Aaron ciypathla tie kha cawsaa a thiepa tie canawna khypuv Hebron hne sahring tlena ruo tie, Libnah hne sahring tlena ruo tie,
Jattir hne sahring tlena ruo tie, Eshtemoa hne sahring tlena ruo tie,
Holon hne sahring tlena ruo tie, Debir hne sahring tlena ruo tie,
Ain hne sahring tlena ruo tie, Juttah hne sahring tlena ruo tie, hne Beth-shemesh hne sahring tlena ruo tie; hingpa phang hning tie chung taa hingta khypuv suocaky kha pi pata ama cuo.
Benjamin phang chungtaata: Gibeon hne sahring tlena ruo tie, Geba hne sahring tlena ruo tie,
Anathoth hne sahring tlena ruo tie, Almon hne sahring tlena ruo tie, ta pata khypuv suopaliy.
Aaron ciypathla tie, tluobyi tie ama cupa khy tie ca a bangkhuo ta khypuv hlyithung hne sahring tlena ruo tie khata ama cuo.
Levi phang, Kohath ingchungkhue tie chungtaata aa ngaa kaliepa Kohath ming ama pacu pa khypuv tie ca Efraim phang tie ruo chungtaata a cuo.
Iema ca Efraim tluocung ruo lie a awpa cawsaa a thiepa tie canawna khypuv ta a cuopa Shekhem hne sahring tlena ruo tie, Gezer hne sahring tlena ruo tie,
Kipzaim hne sahring tlena ruo tie, hne Beth-horon hne sahring tlena ruo tie, khypuv suopaliy tie kha pi pata ama cuo.
Dan phang tie ruo chungtaata: Elteke hne sahring tlena ruo tie, Gibbethon hne sahring tlena ruo tie,
Aijalon hne sahring tlena ruo tie, Gath-rimmon hne sahring tlena ruo tie, khypuv suopaliy kha pi pata ama cuo.
Manasseh phang khingkhuo tie ruo chungtaata: Taanak hne sahring tlena ruo tie, Gath-rimmon hne sahring tlena ruo tie, khypuv suohning kha pi pata ama cuo.
Aa ngaapa Kohath ming ingchungkhue tie khypuv ca a bangkhuo ta suohraa hne sahring tlena ruo tie ta ama cuo.

Levi phang phang kha ta a cuopa Gershon ming kha Manasseh phang khingkhuo tie ruo chung taa khata pi pata ama cuo: Cawsaa a thiepa tie canawna khypuv ta a cuopa Bashan lie a awpa Golan hne sahring tlena ruo tie, hne Beeshterah hne sahring tlena ruo tie, khypuv suohning kha pi pata ama cuo.
Issakhar phang tie ruo chungtaata: Kishion hne sahring tlena ruo tie, Daberath hne sahring tlena ruo tie,
Jarmuth hne sahring tlena ruo tie, En-gannim hne sahring tlena ruo tie, khypuv suopaliy kha pi pata ama cuo.
Asher phang tie ruo chungtaata: Mishal hne sahring tlena ruo tie, Abdon hne sahring tlena ruo tie,
Helkath hne sahring tlena ruo tie, hne Rehob hne sahring tlena ruo tie, khypuv suopaliy kha pi pata ama cuo.

Naftali phang tie ruo chungtaata: Cawsaa a thiepa tie canawna khypuv ta a cuopa, Galilee lie a awpa Kedesh hne sahring tlena ruo tie, Hammoth-dor hne sahring tlena ruo tie, hne Kartan hne sahring tlena ruo tie, khypuv suothung kha pi pata ama cuo.
Gershon ingchungkhue tie ta ama cupa ca a bangkhuo ta khypuv hlyithung hne sahring tlena ruo tie ta ama cuo.
Aa ngaapa Levi ming, Merari ingchungkhue tie ca Zebulun chungkhue tie ruo chungtaata pipa ta ama cuo: Jokneam hne sahring tlena ruo tie, Kartah hne sahring tlena ruo tie,
Dimnah hne sahring tlena ruo tie, Nahalal hne sahring tlena ruo tie, khypuv suopaliy kha pi pata ama cuo.
Reuben phang tie ruo chungtaata: Bezer hne sahring tlena ruo tie, Jahzah hne sahring tlena ruo tie,
Kedemoth hne sahring tlena ruo tie, Mefaath hne sahring tlena ruo tie, khypuv suopaliy kha pi pata ama cuo.
Gad phang tie ruo chungtaata: Cawsaa a thiepa tie canawna khypuv ta a cuopa Gilead lie a awpa Ramoth hne sahring tlena ruo tie, Mahanaim hne sahring tlena ruo tie,
Heshbon hne sahring tlena ruo tie, Jazer hne sahring tlena ruo tie, a bangkhuo ta khypuv suopaliy kha pi pata ama cuo.
Levi ming aa ngaapa ingchungkhue ta a cuopa, Merari ming ingchungkhue tie pacu sapa khypuv tie ca a bangkhuo ta suohraa hlyihning ta a cuo.
Israel ming cuvu chungtaata Levi ming khypuv tie ca a bangkhuo ta khypuv sawliy suocari hne sahring tlena ruo tie ta ama cuo.
Hingpa khypuv tie hingta a cahriylie sahring tlena ruo tie kha ama hnyi; hingpa khypuv bangkhuo hing cahaacata ama cuo diy.
Cahaacata Abyipata Israel ming ca ama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie pi riypata chie aa sapa ruo bangkhuo kha a pi yi; a la yi te ama cu khutaata capa lie ca khy ama sa.

Cakhutaata Abyipata ama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie chie a zaa sapa haa khata khaapa hmang lie a cuo zaw a pahyna cuo kha a pi yi. Ama carie tie ahungtahmuo iema kha a daapuo nguo va yi, tahematapakieca Abyipata ama carie tie bangkhuo kha ama kuv chung luo a pi yi.
Abyipata Israel ming a pipa yi a phapa biekuona bangkhuo ca suokha hmuo a tlung lipa aw vyi; a bangkhuo ta a tlung diy.
Cakhutaata Joshua ta Reuben phang, Gad phang, hne Manasseh phang khingkhuo tie kha ku yi te,
iema kyihuo khata, “Abyipachangtaapa Moses ta bie aca pipa bangkhuo yi kha nama tue tli, cakhutaata kama ta ica pipa yi i bie zaw ina naathlie ung ciy;
hing zaa cuo chung bangkhuo hing nama uvnu zaw kha thaw lipa ung cata, Abyipanama Khazing ta aca changpa yi kha a phasa pata nama tue.

Cakhutaata ata hing ca bie a kuopa haa yi khata Abyipanama Khazing ta nama uvnu zaw kha a hyna cuo a pi tli yi; caacuonakawta Abyipachangtaapa Moses ta aca pipa yi Jordan cavaa huesuo luo kha kaa ung la, nama cuvu a awnapa ruo, nama ing luo kha si tie ung.

Abyipachangtaapa Moses ta aca pipa yi nawbie hne pacuvna kha a phasa pata ziy riypa hne tue riypa, Abyipanama Khazing due riypa, a luopuv lie ziy riypa, a nawbie ziy riypa, hne ama kha a cusa pata a patuv riypa, hne ama re kha nama pathiypalung yalya hne nama ruena yalya ta hrie riypa kha a raaringsa pata a zue tie ung,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta Joshua ta thluechiy pi yi te a pathlie yi; cakhutaata ama thluodaa luo kha ama cakuo.

Cakhutaata Moses ta Manasseh phang khingkhuo tie kha Bashan lie cuvu a pi yi; cuorasala a hrangpa khingkhuo tie kha ca Joshua ta ama phang kha Israel ming hne khata Jordan cavaa ningtla lie kha cuvu a pi yi. Cakhutaata Joshua ta thluechiy pi yi te ama thluodaa luo a pathlie ning yi kha iema kyihuo khata,

“Suethiy a hluvsa, sahring a hluvsa, siy hne ngu, daa hne thaa, caw hne sie a hluvsa hne khata nama thluodaa luo kha kaa ung la, nama carie tie'a taata nama lapa hruosue kha nama uvnu tie hneta vaa re tie ung,” a ta yi.

Caacuonakawta Reuben ming hne Gad ming hne Manasseh phang khingkhuo tie ca Kanaan ruo chunglie a awpa Shiloh lie kha Israel ming'a taata a che yi te, Abyipata Moses'a taata bie a pipa haa yi ta cuvu ta amaa lapa iema ruo, Gilead ruo luo, ama ing luo kha ama kaa.
Kanaan ruo chung, Jordan cavaa hne aa ngienapa ruo ama chiy tiyta, Reuben phang, Gad phang hne Manasseh phang khingkhuo tie ca Jordan cavaa kielie kha bienatluophie a lesapa suokha ama sa.
Israel ming ta Reuben phang hne Gad phang hne Manasseh phang khingkhuo tie na Kanaan ruo ruoriy, Jordan cavaa kie, Israel ming ruo kuo luo ta bienatluophie a sa yi tapa kha ama thyi.
Israel ming ta capa kaw ca ama thyi tiyta, Israel ming bangkhuo ca ta iema kha rie a du riypata Shiloh lie kha amaa hmya.
Cakhutaata Israel ming ta Eleazar sacapaa tluobyi Finehas kha Reuben ming, Gad ming hne Manasseh phang khingkhuo tie'a luo kha ama pathlie,
ama hne cata byi pahraa, Israel ming phang kha taata pakha kaluo, Israel ming phang cyicuo taata luv a cuopa tie kha ama pathlie.
Iema ca Reuben phang, Gad phang, hne Manasseh phang khingkhuo tie'a luo, Gilead ruo luo kha a vaw yi te, iema kyihuo khata,

“Abyipacawsaazaapuv ta, ‘Israel Khazing a du pata ataning nama tuepa rawna hing khaapatama a cuo? Abyipanama ziyna taata pie pata, Abyipaa du pata nama cuota bienatluophie namaa sapa hing khaapatama a cuo?
Peor kawlieta ma suenapa, capa kawlieta Abyipacawsaazaapuv cunglie a tlungpa puvtlung pasana taata hmuo maa pathe khu lipa hing ma cuota a de valie ma?
Cahaacata a cuo nguoluona lieta niema ca Abyipa'a taata nama pie kalie aa? Ataning niema ta Abyipa'a taata nama pie kieca, mawluo khiy Israel ming cawsaazaapuv cunglie Abyipaa hi a haa aa.

Cuorasala ata hing, nama ruo kha a pathe li kieca, Abyipabienathluodaa a awnapa Abyiparuo luo hing vya te pakhaa ung la, kiema hrawlie hing cuvu a la ra thluo tie nie ung; cadyiseca Abyipa ma Khazing bienatluophie ta li pata niema huota bienatluophie a sa pata Abyipakha a du li pata aw ung la, kiema zaw kha malie a du ra khah ung.

Zerah sacapaa Akhan ta pihluopa chechiy kawlie kha zang tluo a tla li pata a aw nakawta Israel ming cawsaazaapuv cunglie kha hihaana a za tlung cuo va ma? A pha lina kawlieta ama dyi thiy vyi cuo va ma kha!’” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Reuben phang, Gad phang hne Manasseh phang khingkhuo tie ta Israel ingchungkhue luv a cuopa tie kyihuo khata,
“Abyipa, khazing tie Khazing! Abyipa, khazing tie Khazing! Ama ta a pachang; cakhutaata Israel ama hrahring zaw ta pachang se! Hingpa hing Abyipaa duna hne ama'a lie zang tluo a tla lina ta cuo te,

Abyipaziyna taata malie a papie sa riypata bienatluophie kha kiema cuota maa sa pata a cuo kieca, ataning hing pakha hmuo malie pahring khah ung; acuolikie kiema cuota myirue panaana, sa ta panaana hne aviesaa panaana zaw kha a cunglie ma tue kieca Abyipata phuv malie la se.
Cuo vyi! Hingpa hmang ma tuenapa hing hmieluo cuo lie nama saata zaw ta ma saata zaw kha, ‘AbyipaIsrael Khazing'a lie hing khaapama nama tue?

Abyipata Jordan hing niema hne kiema alalalie ruoriy ta a tue, niema Reuben ming hne Gad ming ca Abyipa'a lie cuvu hnyi va ung ciy’ ama ta riypa kha ma ciy nakawta ma tuepa tana a cuo,’ ama ta. Cahaacata nama saata zaw khata ma saata zaw kha Abyipaabie kha ama pataw sa pathlyi aa.
Caacuonakawta kiema ta, ‘Ata hingta bienatluophie suokha sa'a ung puv ma ta tiyta, myirue panaana pihluona riypata cuo vyi, hriykhung arina riypata zaw cuo ra vyi,

cuorasala kiema hne niema alalalie, hne niema hne kiema hnang taata a vaw riypa chuo tie alalalie tehte cuo pata, Abyipahmiekunglieta a re hrie pate, myirue panaana hne hriykhungrina zaw hne aviesaa panaana zaw kha ma za pihluo ra tapa pahmung sana ta cuo'a te, a vaw riypa cuo lieta nama saata zaw ta ma saata zaw kha, “Niema ca Abyipa'a lieta cuvu hnyi va ung ciy,” ama ta li riypata a cuo, ama ta.

Cakhutaata kiema ta ma ruepa ca, a vaw riypa cuo lieta kiema hne ma ciypathla tie cunglie kha cahaacata malie ama ta kieca, kiema ta, ‘Mang tie ung, ma mingchingmingvuo tie ta Abyipabienatluophie dala haata ama sapa bienatluophie hing, myirue panaana pihluona riypata cuo vyi, hriykhungrina pihluona riypata zaw cuo ra vyi, cuorasala niema hne kiema alalalie tehte cuo riypa tana a cuo,’ tapa hingta a cuo.

Bienathluodaa hmielie a daapa Abyipaima Khazing bienathluodaa thang taata myirue panaana, sa ta panaana, acuolikie hriykhungrina riypata bienathluodaa hrangpa sa pata, ataning hing Abyipaziyna taata pie pata, Abyipaa du riypa ca kiema hneta a hla thi mang sue!” ama ta.
Tluobyi Phinehas hne ama'a lie a awpa cawsaazaapuv byi tie, Israel ingchungkhue luv a cuopa tie ta Reuben ming hne Gad ming hne Manasseh ming ta ama ripa bie kha ama thyi tiyta ama palung a tling.

Eleazar sacapaa tluobyi Phinehas ta Reuben ming hne Gad ming hne Manasseh ming kyihuo khata, “Abyipaa du pata a cunglie rawna nama tue li nakawta Abyipaca ataning hing kiema'a lie a aw tapa kha ma pachang; Israel ming kha Abyipakuv taata nama khuo mangtli,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata tluobyi Eleazar sacapaa Phinehas hne byi tie ca Gilead ruo lie Reuben ming hne Gad ming'a taa khata Kanaan ruo lie Israel ming'a luo kha kaa yi te bie ca ama phya.

Ama phyapa bie ca ta Israel ming palung kha a patluo, caacuonakawta Reuben ming hne Gad ming ama awnapa ruo kha para pata iema a du riypa kha ri li tlipa yi ta, Israel ming ca Khazing kha ama pathuosa.
Reuben ming hne Gad ming ta bienatluophie ca pachangkhyituv ta pata ama ku; tahematapakieca, “Abyipaca Khazing a cuopa kha iema hne kiema alalalie pachangkhyituv a cuopa tana a cuo,” ama ta.
Cuo pasiypuv khutaata, Abyipata Israel ming kha ama cahriylie ama carie tie'a taata a pahyna cuo a pi tiy yi ta, Joshua ca macuo te a kung a tluvsa mangtli.
Joshua ta Israel ming bangkhuo, ama uvthyi tie hne luv a cuopa tie, bieripatuv tie hne byi tie kha ku yi te, iema kyihuo khata, “Kama ca macuo angte i kung a tluvsa tli;
cakhutaata niema ta Abyipanama Khazing ta hingpa mingphang bangkhuo hing niema cuota tuokhaatama a tue yi tapa kha nama hmung tli, tahematapakieca Abyipanama Khazing khana niema cuota rie a tuv.
Jordan cavaa taata ningtlaluo Riyliy Lepa te, kama ta i te tlipa mingphang bangkhuo hne aa ngaa kaliepa mingphang bangkhuo kha niema cuota ru ta ica pi tli yi.
Abyipanama Khazing ta bie acaa kuopa yi haa khata, Abyipanama Khazing ta iema kha nama hmungna taata a cade'a yi te, ama ruo kha nama cu aa.
Caacuonakawta Moses phungbie caa-uv chunglie aa capepa bangkhuo kha ziy riypa hne tue riypata a cusa pata aw ung la, capa taa cata cacuoluo cuose, cavyiluo cuose pie khah ung.

Niema ca hingpa lie nama hrawlieta aa ngaapa mingphang tie hne hingta a pya li pata, ama khazing tie ming kha ri li pata, capa khazing tie ming cata chie a sa li pata, capa khazing tie re ca hrie li pata, hne capa khazing tie hmiekunglie ca a bung li pata,
ataning nama tuepa haa hingta Abyipanama Khazing kha a cusa pata a patuv tie ung.
Tahematapakieca Abyipata a lepa hne a cahrapa mingphang tie kha nama hmiekung taata aa cade yi, ataning hing ahungtahmuo caa daapuo nguo va yi.
Bie acaa kuopa haa yi khata, Abyipanama Khazing ta niema cuota rie aa du nakawta niema chungtaata pakha ta thawkha kha namaa cade.
Caacuonakawta Abyipanama Khazing kha due riypata a raaringsa tie ung.

Tahematapakieca a pali ung cate, niema hrawlie aa ngaapa mingphang tie hne hingta a viesaa ung cate, a chiyhie ung cate, niema ta ama canung tie kha chiyhie ung cate, iema zaw ta nama canung tie kha aca chiyhie kie yi ca,

Abyipanama Khazing ta hingpa mingphang tie hing nama hmiekung taata a cade'a va tli yi tapa kha a siesa pata pachang tie ung. Cuorasala Abyipata aca pipa yi hingpa ruo phapa chung taa hingta nama vie hluo li, iema ca nama cuota cuolung hne cyihyi ta cuo'a yi te, nama zaase lie tuvnapa sungpe hne nama ming lie mingbuo ta ama cuo aa.

Cakhutaata ata hing ca alyicung bangkhuo phung haata i si ra'a tli. Niema ta, nama bangkhuo ta, niema hne aa patuv pata Abyipanama Khazing ta bie acaa kuopa yi hmang phapa bangkhuo kha suokha hmuo tling li pata a aw lipa kha nama pathiypalung lie hne nama ruena lie nama pachang; suokha hmuo bu li pata nama cuota a tling diy.

Cuorasala Abyipanama Khazing ta niema kawlieta bie aa kuopa hmang phapa bangkhuo kha nama cuota a patling sapa haata, Abyipanama Khazing ta aca pipa yi hingpa ruo phapa chunglie hing aca para diy hluo li yi ta, hmang pha lipa bangkhuo kha Abyipata nama cunglie a patlung sa aa.

Niema ta Abyipanama Khazing biekuona kha para ung cate, khazing hrangpa re kha hrie ung cate a hmiekunglie namaa bung kieca, Abyipahihaana ca nama cunglie ie'a te, ama ta aca pipa yi ruo phapa taa hingta a catlisa pata nama lidie aa,” a ta yi.

Cakhutaata Joshua ta Israel ming mingphang bangkhuo kha Shekhem lie pahmya yi te, uvthyi tie, luv a cuopa tie, bieripatuv tie, hne Israel byi tie kha kupakiy yi te, Khazing hmiekung luo kha ama vya chiy.

Cakhutaata Joshua ta cawsaa bangkhuo kha, “Hing haa hingta Abyipa, Israel Khazing ta a ta: Hluo ningta nama mingchingmingvuo tie ta a cuopa Terah hne a sacapaa tie Abraham hne Nahor ca Zufrates cavaa huesuo lie kha khysa yi te, khazing hrangpa kha amaa bie.
Cakhutaata kama ta nama paa Abraham kha Cavaa huesuo taa cata la angte Kanaan ruocaapa lie kha tathlyalya ta a vya chiy angte, a samingsahlaa kha a hluvsa ta i tue yi. Ama kha Isak i pi;
cakhutaata Isak kha Jakob hne Esau i pi. Isak ca Seir tluocung ruo kha hnyi riypata pi angte, cuorasala Jakob hne a saata zaw ca Izipt luo ama sibung.
Cakhutaa cata Moses hne Aaron kha pathlie yi angte, Izipt ca a chunglie i tuepa hmang khata duo i te; capa khutaa cata niema kha ica pyakhyi yi.
Nama mingchingmingvuo tie Izipt taata i pyakhyi tiy yi ta, riyliy kha nama vya pha; Izipt ming ta nama mingchingmingvuo tie kha aruole hne aruo rieka ta Riyliy Sepa luo kha amaa vya cade.

Abyipa'a luo kha ama khi tiyta, ama ta niema hne Izipt ming alalalie kha zingna chi te, cakhutaata riyliy kha a pabuvkhung sa yi; nama ming ta Izipt cunglie i tuepa kha a hmung. Cakhutaata niema ca ruocaapa lie kha cuo a pasiypuv nama aw.

Cakhutaata Jordan cavaa huesuo lie a awpa tie Amor ming ruo luo kha caa chiy yi angte, niema kha acaa du yi. Iema ca nama kuv chung luo capi yi angte, ama ruo kha cu ung cate, iema ca nama hmiekunglie kha i para yi.
Cakhutaata Moab pa Zippor sacapaa siepahruo Balak ta Israel kha aa du. Ama ta Beor sacapaa Balaam kha niema chiesa riypata a pathlie,
cuorasala Balaam kha naathlie va ang; caacuonakawta niema kha thluechiy aca pi yi; cahaacata niema kha ama kuv chungtaata ica khuo yi.

Jordan cavaa kha te ung cate Jeriko luo namaa vaw tiyta, Jeriko khy ming ta niema kha acaa du yi, Amor ming, Periz ming, Kanaan ming, Hit ming, Girgash ming, Hiv ming hne Jebus ming zaw ta acaa du yi; iema kha nama kuv chung luo ica pi yi.
Khyi-ung kha nama hmieluo ta pathlie angte, capa ca ta Amor siepahruo pahning tie kha nama hmiekung taata aa cade yi; capa ca niema nama zueziy hne nama cuoti thueta cuo vyi.
Nama thavie ta nama hlue lipa ruo kha ca pi yi angte, nama sa lipa khypuv kha ica pi yi, cakhutaata a chunglie nama aw; niema ta namaa ling lipa mingsuv dung hne olif dung taata a thyi kha nama ning.

Caacuonakawta ata hing ca Abyipakha ciyzaa ung la, a re kha pathiypalung hmisi hne zang aa tlasa pata hrie tie ung; nama mingchingmingvuo tie ta cavaa huesuo Izipt ruo lie a re ama hriepa khazing tie kha thaw ung la, Abyipare kha hrie tie ung.

Abyipakha namaa bie khing li kieca, ataning hingta ahungma maa bie aa tapa kha a tlaw tie ung; nama mingchingmingvuo tie ta cavaa huesuo lie a re ama za hriepa khazing tie ma, acuolikie ama ruo lie nama awnapa Amor ming khazing tie ma namaa tlaw aa; cuorasala kama hne i ingchungkhue ca Abyipakhana imaa bie aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata cawsaa zaw khata palie yi te, “Abyipathuse pata khazing hrangpa tie abie riypa ca kiema hneta a hla mang sue;

tahematapakieca Abyipaima Khazing ca kiema hne ma mingchingmingvuo tie kha Izipt ruo siicuona taata malie a pyakhyipa tana a cuo, hingpa a lepa hmang rungnaapa hing ima hmungna lieta a tue. Ma sina luo tathlyalya lie hne, ma cahrawpaalepa mingphang hrawlie kha ama ta malie a mangchiy;

cakhutaata Abyipata ruo chunglie a awpa Amor ming, cawsaa bangkhuo kha ma hmiekung taata aa cade yi. Caacuonakawta kiema zaw Abyipana maa bie aa, tahematapakieca ama ca ma Khazing tana a cuo,” ama ta.

Cuorasala Joshua ta cawsaa zaw kha, “Abyipare kha hrie khu'a va ung ciy, tahematapakieca ama ca a pathepa Khazing tana a cuo. Ama ca hietlie a hmuopa Khazing tana a cuo; nama tuesuena hne nama suena kha caa ngiethe khu'a va yi.
Abyipakha thuse pata ruohrang khazing tie kha namaa bie kieca, niema'a lie phana a tue khutaa khata a pali'a te ruvnaana ca pi'a yi te, aca para diy'a yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata cawsaa tie ta Joshua kyihuo khata, “Cuo vyi, Abyipakhana maa bie aa!” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Joshua ta cawsaa zaw kyihuo khata, “Abyipakhana abie riypata namaa tlaw tli tapa ca niema mamaapa na tehte ta a cuo ung ciy,” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Kiema na tehte ta a cuo puv,” ama ta.
Ama ta, “Cata a cuo kieca nama hrawlie a awpa ruohrang khazing tie kha thaw ung la, Abyipa, Israel Khazing'a luo kha nama pathiypalung sang tie ung,” a ta yi.
Cawsaa zaw ca ta Joshua kyihuo khata, “Abyipaima Khazing khana maa bie aa, ama ri na maa ngie aa,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta capa ning lie ca ta Joshua ca cawsaa zaw hne cata biekuona tue te, iema cuo khata Shekhem lieta phungluo hne ziyphung kha a tuepa yi.
Joshua ta capa bie ca Khazing phungbie caa-uv lie kha a cape; cakhutaata alung lesapa kha la te, Abyipahmangpathepa chunglie a awpa mathliy kung rawlie kha a bang.

Joshua ta cawsaa bangkhuo'a lie kha, “Mang tie ung, hingpa alung hing kiema cuota tehte ta a cuo aa; tahematapakieca Abyipata kiema'a lie a ripa bie bangkhuo kha thyi pata a cuo tli; caacuonakawta nama Khazing'a lie kha hanghie pata nama aw kieca hingpa hing niema cuota tehte ta a cuo,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Joshua ta cawsaa zaw kha iema ama cupa ruo luo kha a pasi sa yi.
Hingpa hmang zaw khutaata Nun sacapaa Joshua, Abyipachangtaapa ca kung zakha kung hraa a ta pata a thiy.
Iema ta Efraim tluocung ruo, Gaash Tluo chaluo lie a awpa, ru ta a cupa Timnath-serah lie kha ama paby.

Israel ming ta Joshua a hring chung bangkhuo hne Joshua khutaata hring kalie yi te Abyipata Israel ming cuota a hriepa re bangkhuo a pachangpa uvthyi tie ama hring chung bangkhuo ca Abyipakha amaa bie.
Israel ming ta Izipt taata ama kya phyalepa Josef ruv kha Shekhem paa Hamor saata zaw'a lie Jakob ta tuokaa zakha ta a calyipa Shekhem lie kha ama paby; capa hmang ca Josef ciypathla zaw ru ta aa li.
Aaron sacapaa Eleazar ca thiy te a sacapaa Phinehas khy, Efraim tluocung ruo lieta ama ama pipa Gibeah lie kha ama paby.
Joshua a thiy khutaata, Israel ming ta Abyipakha bie hiehriy yi te, “Kanaan ming a du riypata kiema cuota ahungma hmaa a sa aa?” ama ta.
Abyipata, “Judah na a sithaw aa. Ruo ca a kuv luo kha i pi tli,” a ta.

Judah ta a uvnu Simeon kyihuo khata, “Kanaan ming a du riypata kama cuvu ruo luo kha na kya sikhyi tie; cakhutaata kama zaw nama cuvu ruo luo kha ica sikhyi ra aa,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Simeon ta a sikhyi.
Cakhutaata Judah ca sithaw te Abyipata Kanaan ming hne Periz ming kha a kuv luo pi yi te, iema ta Bezek lie kha cawsaa thawhraa ama te.
Bezek lie Adoni-bezek kha si hnue yi te, ama kha a du yi te, Kanaan ming hne Periz ming kha ama te.
Adoni-bezek ca aa ruo; cuorasala a cade yi te, patuv yi te, a kuvpuv hne a phyipuv kha ama te.

Adoni-bezek ta, “Ama kuvpuv hne ama phyipuv tepa siepahruo saw sariy ta i cabya raw luo a tlapa sa zungpepa kha amaa haa taw, i za tuepa haa tana Khazing ta ina thung tli,” a ta. Jerusalem luo a vya chiyle yi te capa lie ca a thiy.
Cakhutaata Judah ming ta Jerusalem ca a du yi te ama la. Zueziy ta thie diy yi te khypuv ca myi ta ama rue.
Cakhutaata Judah ming ca sibung yi te tluocung ruo, Negeb, hne aa ne ruo lie a awpa Kanaan ming kha amaa du.
Judah ming ta Hebron (Hebron ca hluo ning ca Kiriath-arba ama ta), lie a awpa Kanaan ming kha sihning yi te, Sheshai hne Ahiman hne Talmai kha ama te.
Capa taa cata Debir (Debir ca hluo ning ca Kiriath-sefer ama ta) khy ming kha ama sihning.
Cakhutaata Kaleb ta, “Ahung a cuo zaw Kiriath-sefer kha tuv te a lapa ca i sacanung Aksah na napuv ta i pi aa,” a ta.
Kaleb nuta Kenaz sacapaa Othniel khata Kiriath-sefer ca a la; caacuonakawta a sacanung Aksah ca napuv ta a pi.
Ama'a luo aa vaw tiyta, a paa kha lu suokha a hie riypata a chang. A laa cung taata a cungpa khata, Kaleb ta, “Khaapama na khing?” a ta.
Ama ta, “Lasaw suokha na pi tie; Negeb ruo chunglie ina chi nakaw ca ta acaa zaw na pipuo tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Kaleb ta a cungluo acaa hne a rawluo acaa kha a pi.
Hobab ciypathla, Ken ming, Moses puvpa ca Arad athaalie a awpa Negeb lie Judah ruocaapa tungkung khy taa khata Judah ming hne khata sithaw ra te, Amalek ming hneta khy ama sa.
Judah ca a nuta Simeon hne khata si yi te, Zefath lie khy a sapa Kanaan ming kha te yi te ama para diy. Caacuonakawta capa khypuv ca Hormah ta pata ama ku.
Judah ta Gaza hne a uvna ruo, Ashkelon hne a uvna ruo, Ekron hne a uvna ruo zaw kha a la.
Abyipata Judah kha awpuo te, tluocung ruo kha a la diy, cuorasala ase ruo lie a awpa tie ca thaa aruole zaw ama hnyi nakawta a cade khu va yi.
Moses ta a za ripa haata, Hebron ca Kaleb kha pi pata cuo te, capa hmang taa cata Anak sacapaa zaw pathung kha aa cade yi.
Cuorasala Benjamin phang tie ta ca Jerusalem lie a awpa Jebus ming kha a cade khu va yi; caacuonakawta Jebus ming ca Jerusalem lie, Benjamin phang hrawlie ca ataning tepa hingta ama aw.
Josef ciypathla zaw ta Bethel kha a du riypata sithaw ra yi te Abyipata a awpuo yi.
Josef ciypathla tie ta Bethel (hluo ningta ca khypuv ming ca Luz ama za ta) luo kha ngiepatlietuv tie ama pathlie.
Ngiepatlietuv tie ta khypuv chungtaata a kya pyapa capaa pakha kha hmung yi te, “Khypuv chung luo a ngienapa luopuv malie chang tie, nama ca a phasa pata na maca mangchiy aa,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta ama ta khypuv chung luo a ngienapa luopuv kha chang yi te, khypuv lie cawsaa bangkhuo ca zueziy ta ama naw diy, cuorasala cawsaapa hne a ingchungkhue ca ama palaw sa.
Caacuonakawta cawsaapa ca Hit ming ruo luo kha si te khypuv suokha a tla, capa khy ca Luz ta pata ming a paphya; capa ca ataning tepa hingta a ming ta a cuo.

Manasseh ta Beth-shean hne a khyta zaw lie khy a sapa cuo yi se, Taanak hne a khyta zaw lie a awpa cuo yi se, Dor hne a khyta zaw lie a awpa cuo yi se, Ibleam hne a khyta zaw lie a awpa cuo yi se, Megiddo hne a khyta zaw lie a awpa cuo yi se, a cade va yi, cuorasala Kanaan ming ca capa ruo lie ca ama aw pazue thluo.
Israel ming lethaw yi te ama kya cahra tiyta, Kanaan ming ca a cade diy va yi, cuorasala ama rehrietuv ta ama tue.
Cakhutaata Efraim ta Gezer lie a awpa Kanaan ming kha a cade va yi; cuorasala Kanaan ming ca Gezer lie, iema hrawlie kha ama aw thluo.
Zebulun ta Kitron lie a awpa tie, hne Nahalol lie a awpa tie kha a cade va yi, cuorasala Kanaan ming ca iema hrawlie kha aw yi te, re pahriesapa ta amaa li.
Asher ta Akko lie a awpa tie, Sidon lie a awpa tie, Ahlab lie a awpa tie, Akzib lie a awpa tie, Helbah lie a awpa tie, Afik lie a awpa tie, hne Rehob lie a awpa tie zaw kha a cade va yi,
cuorasala Asher ming ca zaa aw taapa Kanaan ming hrawlie kha aw yi te, iema kha a cade va yi.

Naftali ta Beth-shemesh lie a awpa tie, hne Beth-anath lie a awpa tie zaw kha a cade lipa yi ta, iema ca zaa aw taapa Kanaan ming hrawlie kha ama aw; cuorasala Beth-shemesh lie a awpa tie hne Beth-anath lie a awpa tie ca iema cuota rehriepatuv ta amaa li.
Amor ming ta Dan ming kha tluocung ruo luo a cade pakhaa yi te, ase ruo luo ama za cung riypa kha khing va yi.
Amor ming ca Har-heres lie, Aijalon lie hne Shaalbim lie kha ama aw pazue, cuorasala Josef ciypathla tie kuv ca ama cunglie kha aa riysa pata tla te, iema ca re pahriesapa ta amaa li.
Amor ming ruoriy ca Akrabbim taata kiethawna, Sela taata chaluo kuo khata a cuo.

Abyipaavuoming ca Gilgal taata Bochim luo kha sithaw te, “Izipt ruo taata ca pyakhyi yi angte, nama mingchingmingvuo tie bie i kuopa yi ruo luo kha icaa ngiekhyi tli yi. ‘Niema hne i biekuo kha para'a va ang,’ i ta.

Niema kuo luo taata, hingpa ruo lie a awpa tie hne hingta biekuona tue khah ung; ama bienatluophie kha phipatlaa diy tie ung,’ ica ta yi. Cuorasala bie ica pipa yi kha ziy va ung ciy. Khaapama nama tue tapa kha mang tie ung!
Caacuonakawta ata hing ca, iema hing niema hmiekung taata a cade'a va tli yi ang; cuorasala iema ca nama carie ta cuo'a yi te, ama khazing ca nama cuota cyihyi ta a cuo aa,” a ta yi.
Abyipaavuoming ta Israel ming bangkhuo'a luo kha hingpa bie a ri tiyta, cawsaa ca khuopuv ta khi yi te ama caa.
Caacuonakawta capa hmang ca Bochim ta pata ming ama sa, cakhutaata capa hmang lie ca Abyipa'a luo kha hriykhung amaa ri.
Joshua ta cawsaa kha a pathlie tiy yi ta, Israel ming ca ama cuvu ruo kha cu riypata ama si.

Cakhutaata cawsaa ca Joshua hring chung bangkhuo, hne Joshua khutaata a hring kaliepa uvthyi tie, Israel ming cuota Abyipata re lesapa a tuepa hmang a hmungpa tie hring chung bangkhuo khata Abyipakha amaa bie.
Abyipachangtaapa, Nun sacapaa Joshua ca kung zakha kung hraa a ta pata a thiy.
Caacuonakawta Gaash Tluo chaluo, Efraim tluocung ruo chung, ama cuvu ruo chunglie kha ama paby.

Ca hlyitaw taata, capa chuo cawsaa bangkhuo ca ama mingchingmingvuo tie'a luo kha pahmya diy pata cuo yi te, Abyipaa pachang lipa hne Abyipa ta Israel ming cuota a hriepa re a pachang lipa, chuo thaapa tie kha ama kya lethaw.
Cakhutaata Israel ming ca Abyipahmiekunglie kha hmang pha lipa hrie yi te, Baal kha amaa bie.
Izipt ruo taata a vya pyakhyipa yi, ama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing, Abyipakha thaw yi te, ama cahriylie a awpa khazing hrangpa tie kha ziy pata amaa bie nakawta Abyipakha a hi ama pahaa.
Iema ta Abyipakha thaw yi te, Baal hne Astartes kha amaa bie.

Caacuonakawta Abyipahihaana ca Israel ming'a lie kha a ie ta ie te, a chuvtuv tie kuv luo kha a pi yi. Cakhutaata iema ca ama cahriylie a awpa ama carie tie cahrana luo kha zaa yi te, ama carie tie kha a daapuo khu the va tli yi.
Rie tuv riypata ama pya kyry ta, Abyipata a raaringna za pi yi te chie a za sapa haa yi khata, Abyipakuv ta vuochina kha patlungsue yi te, ama palung a ra hringhruo.
Cakhutaata Abyipata bieripatuv tie kha papuv yi te, iema ca ta a chuvtuv tie kuv taa khata hya ama pazang.

Cuorasala bieripatuv tie bie zaw kha naathlie va yi; khazing hrangpa tie'a lie kha siyhraw yi te, amaa bie ngiethie. Abyipabiepina a ziypa ama mingchingmingvuo tie luopuv taa khata a catlisa pata amaa pali; iema mangpuo amaa tlanapa kha ziy va yi.

Abyipata iema cuota bieripatuv tie a papuv tiy yi ta, Abyipata bieripatuv ca awpuo te, ama ta bieripatuv chuo chung bangkhuo ca Israel ming kha ama carie tie kuv taata a palaw sa yi; tahematapakieca hrisaatuv tie ta ama hrisaa nakawta hne ama tuechie nakawta vuosuo pata amaa hrungnapa khata Abyipakha ama cunglie kawpacuona a pahnyi sa.

Cuorasala bieripatuv a thiy kyry ta, iema ca ama mingchingmingvuo tie laa khata ruv vie lawmaw yi te, khazing hrangpa tie kha ziy yi te, abie yi te ama hmiekunglie amaa bung. Iema ca ama tuepa hne ama palunglena kha thaw va yi.

Caacuonakawta Abyipahihaana ca Israel ming cunglie myi ie ta ie te, “Hingpa cawsaa tie hingta ama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie bie i pipa yi biekuona kha para yi te, i changpa yi kha ama ziy li nakawta,
Joshua ta a thiy ningta a pangaa siypa ama carie tie kha ama hmiekung taata a cadepa'a va tli yi ang,” a ta.
Ama mingchingmingvuo tie haa khata Abyipaluopuv kha ama ziy ma, ziy va yi ma ta pata Israel ming kha dyapasya riypata,
Abyipata khapa mingphang tie kha pangaa yi te, iema kha sungkha ta a cade diy va yi, Joshua kuv luo kha pi va yi.
Kanaan ruo chunglie rie a tuv buo li liepa Israel ming bangkhuo kha dyapasya riypata hingpa mingphang tie hing Abyipata a pangaapa ta ama cuo,
(hingpa hing Israel ming chuotliepa tie ta rietuvna tapa ama pachang riypa hne, rietuvna hne aa pazue pata hmungthyina a hnyi buo lipa tie pacuvna riypata a cuo).
Pangaapa mingphang tie ca: Filistin byi papangaa, Kanaan ming bangkhuo, Sidon ming, Lebanon Tluo, Baal-hermon taata Lebo-hamath te lie a awpa Hiv ming.
Iema ca Moses ta ama mingchingmingvuo tie bie a pipa yi, Abyipanawbie kha ama ziy ma, ziy va yi ma tapa pachangna riypata Israel ming dyapasyana riypa tie ta ama cuo.
Caacuonakawta Israel ming ca Kanaan ming, Hit ming, Amor ming, Periz ming Hiv ming hne Jebus ming hrawlie kha aw yi te,
ama sacanung zaw kha napuv ta a la yi te, iema sacanung zaw kha capa tie sacapaa zaw kha napuv ta ama pi; cakhutaata ama khazing tie kha amaa bie.
Israel ming ca Abyipahmungna lie kha hmang pha lipa ama tue, Abyipaama Khazing kha maw yi te, Baal hne Asherah tie kha amaa bie.
Caacuonakawta Abyipahihaana ca Israel ming cunglie myi ie ta ie te, Aram-naharaim Siepahruo Kushan-rishathaim kuv luo kha zaa yi te, Kushan-rishathaim re kha kung cari ama hrie.
Cuorasala Israel ming ta Abyipa'a luo kha ama khi tiyta, Abyipata Israel ming a khuo riypata Kaleb nuta Kenaz sacapaa Othniel kha papuv te, ama ta a khuo yi.

Abyipathlaapa ca ama cunglie kha tlung te, Israel ming kha ama ta bie a ripa yi. Rie tuv riypata a tha te, Abyipata Aram Siepahruo Kushan-rishathaim ca a kuv chung luo pi te Kushan-rishathaim ca a te.
Caacuonakawta ruo ca kung sawliy chung a die. Cakhutaata Kenaz sacapaa Othniel ca a thiy.

Israel ming ta Abyipahmiekunglie kha hmang pha lipa tue pakhaa yi te, Israel ming a du riypata Abyipata Moab Siepahruo Eglon kha thaa a patlung, tahematapakieca iema ta Abyipahmungna lie kha hmang pha lipa ama tue.
Ammon ming hne Amalek ming kha pahmya yi te, si te Israel kha a te; cakhutaata tungkung khypuv kha a la.
Caacuonakawta Israel ming ca Siepahruo Eglon re kha kung hraa hlyicari ama hrie.
Cuorasala Israel ming ta Abyipa'a luo kha ama khi tiyta, Abyipata iema khuotuv kha papuv te, ama ca Benjamin phang Gera sacapaa a cavyipa Ehud ta a cuo.
Ehud ca kuo hning ta a cahrepa, daw kha a syipa zueziy kha a tue te a caw rawlie a cacuoluo baw lie kha a ciypuo.
Cakhutaata Moab Siepahruo Eglon kha ngukhyi a pi. Eglon ca a thusapa cawsaa ta a cuo.
Ehud ta ngukhyi kha a pi khutaata, luopuv lie ngukhyi a vya phyalepa tie kha a pathlie yi.

Cuorasala ama ca Gilgal athaalie lungbang zaw taa khata kaa te, “Vya siepahruo, nama cuo tana bieparuv suokha i hnyi,” a ta. Caacuonakawta siepahruo ta, “Die ung,” ta yi te, a rehrietuv bangkhuo ca ale luo ama pya diy.
A cakaapa ingcung duo lie ama se ta aa tu ning kha Ehud ta aa thaa luo kha vaa te, “Nama cuo tana Khazing'a taata bie i hnyi,” a ta. Caacuonakawta aa tuna taata aa kya daa.
Cakhutaata Ehud ca a cacuoluo baw lie zueziy kha a cavyi kuv ta la te, Eglon pavaw kha a daw;
zueziy ca a su te khata a ngie diy te, a thupa ta zueziy haa ca a buvkhung, tahematapakieca a pavaw taata zueziy kha a da vyi, caacuonakawta a itiy zaw a pya.
Ehud ca ingle khuo luo kha pya te a khuo ingchiypakaa kha khaa te a hrekhung siy.
Ama a pya khutaata changtaapa tie ca amaa vaw. Ingcung duo siepahruo khuo aa khaapa kha ama hmung tiyta, “A cakaa siyliypa khuo liena a pazung nguoluo,” ta pata ama rue.
Caacuonakawta ama ngiemangna te ta ama huo. Ingchiypakaa kha a kya pahaw hluo li nakawta taw kha la yi te ama pahaw. Capa lie ca ama byipaapa ca a thiy pata dakhang cunglie ca a laa thluo.
Ehud ca ama haasaa chung cata aa ruo, lungbang tie kha va law te Seirah luo aa ruo.
A va pha tiyta, Efraim tluocung ruo lie kha hmyakaa a tung; Israel ming ca tluocung ruo taa cata ama'a luo kha sibung yi te, ama ca ama luochiytuv ta a cuo.

Ama ta iema kha, “Kama hing na ziy tie ung; tahematapakieca Abyipana nama carie tie Moab ming kha niema kuv luo caa pi yi,” a ta yi. Caacuonakawta ama kha ziybung yi te, Moab luo sinapa Jordan tiyhaa lie kha va bya yi te, cawsaa pakha hmuo pazang va yi.
Capa ning cata Moab ming thawhraa tluv ama thie, ama bangkhuo ca ta a thaaruvpa hne a riephapa selaw ta ama cuo, pakha hmuo law va yi.
Caacuonakawta capa ning lie ca Moab ca a sung te Israel kuv raw luo a tla. Cakhutaata ruo ca kung saw cari chung a die.
Capa paa khutaa cata Anath sacapaa Shamgar ta vya cuo te, ama ta Filistin ming za caruv kha cue tuvnapa asung ta a thie yi. Ama zaw ta Israel kha a khuo ra.
Ehud a thiy khutaata, Israel ming ca Abyipa hmungna lie kha hmang pha lipa ama tue pakhaa.
Caacuonakawta Abyipa ta iema kha Hazor lie siepahruo a cuopa Kanaan Siepahruo Jabin kuv luo kha a zaa yi.
Cakhutaata Israel ming ta Abyipa'a luo kha khi yi te abyana ama hie, tahematapakieca ama ca thaa aruole zacaky hnyi te, Israel ming kha kung kiy chung khuosa ta a hrisaa yi.
Capa cuo ning ca Lappidoth napuvnung profet Deborah ta Israel ming kha bie a ripa yi.
Efraim tluocung ruo chunglie Ramah hne Bethel alalalie a awpa Deborah tungkung rawlie kha a tu te Israel ming ca bieripa riypata ama'a luo kha amaa vaw taw.

Naftali ruo Kadesh taata Abinoam sacapaa Barak kha pa ku sa yi te, “Abyipa, Israel Khazing na bie caa pi, ‘Si la, Tabor Tluo lie kha a chuo la, Naftali phang hne Zebulun phang chung taa khata cawsaa thawhraa kha la tie yi.
Kama ta Jabin riekabyilepa Sisera ca aa ruole hne a rieka zaw hne khata Kishon cavaa athaa luo kha nama a du riypata a da'a angte, ama ca na kuv luo kha ica pi aa,” a ta.
Barak ta ama kyihuo khata, “Nama na naa sikhyi'a ciy tapa kieca i si aa; cuorasala nama na naa sikhyi vaciy tapa kieca si'a va ang,” a ta.

Cakhutaata ama ta, “Ica sikhyi hrahring aa; cadyiseca na sina riypa luo lie hing linghlaa hnyi'a vaciy, tahematapakieca Abyipana Sisera kha canung kuv luo a zaa aa,” a ta. Cakhutaata Deborah ca thu te Barak hne khata Kedesh luo a si.
Barak ta Zebulun hne Naftali kha Kedesh luo u yi te, rieka thawhraa ta ama paziy. Deborah ca ama hneta a si.
Ken ming Heber ca Ken hrangpa ta a cuopa Moses puvpa Hobab ciypathla tie'a taa khata a che te, Kedesh athaalie a awpa Elon-bezaanannim te khata thluodaa kha a va sa.
Abinoam sacapaa Barak na Tabor Tluo luo a sithaw tapa kha Sisera ca ama chang tiyta,
Sisera ca aa ruole bangkhuo, thaa aruole za caky, hne ama athaalie a awpa rieka bangkhuo kha Harosheth-ha-goiim taata Kishon cavaa te ta a papung yi.

Cakhutaata Deborah ta Barak kyihuo khata, “Thu tie, tahematapakieca ataning hing Abyipata Sisera kha na kuv chung luo aca pi ning tana a cuo. Abyipa ca nama hmieluo ta a si hmisi tli,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Barak ca rieka thawhraa khata ziy yi te Tabor Tluo luo kha a sibung.

Cakhutaata Abyipata Sisera hne aa ruole bangkhuo hne a rieka bangkhuo ca Barak hmiekunglie kha a pahlu a pada pata hne chungzing pata pa-aw sa yi te, Sisera ca aa ruole taa khata cung te a phyi ta aa ruo.
Barak ta aruole tie hne rieka tie kha Harosheth-ha-goiim te a cade yi te, rieka bangkhuo ca zueziy ta a thie diy yi; pakha hmuo pangaa va yi.
Sisera ca Ken ming Heber napuvnung Jael thluodaa luo kha a phyi ta aa ruo; tahematapakieca Hazor siepahruo Jabin hne Ken ming Heber chung tie alalalie ca diena a aw.

Jael ca Sisera a taw riypata kya pya te, “Vya pie tie, kama Abyipa, kama'a luo hing a vya ngie tie; ciy khah,” a ta. Caacuonakawta ama'a luo, thluodaa chung luo kha va pie te Jael ta pang chaasapa a buvkhung.
Cakhutaata ama ta, “Dang riypa tiy a cawta na pi tie; i tiy na a hrie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta cawsaanung ca ta savang ungthyi lie cuehnung kha pi te a buvkhung pakhaa.
Ama ta, “Thluodaa thlake lie kha a daa la, pakhakha a vaw te, ‘Hingpa lie hing cawsaa pakhakha a aw ma?’ aca ta kieca, ‘Aw vyi,’ na ta aa,” a ta.

Cuorasala Heber napuvnung Jael ta pang thluodaa khenapa sung hne khunglung kha a la te, a nang buosa te aa hmung nguoluo ning kha a paruvta tah vaa te, alyi luo zangpathla te aa cabangpuona te ta a naakhie lie kha khe te a thiy.

Cakhutaata Sisera huv riypata Barak kha a vya chiy ca, Jael ta a taw riypata kya pya te ama kyihuo khata, “A vaw tie, na huvpa paa kha ca pahmung'a ang,” a ta. Caacuonakawta thluodaa chung luo kha aa ngie ca, Sisera ca a naakhie lie thluodaa khenapa sung aa tipuo pata capa lie ca a thiy pata a za laa.
Caacuonakawta capa ning lie ca Khazing ta Kanaan Siepahruo Jabin kha Israel ming hmiekunglie a te.
Cakhutaata Kanaan Siepahruo Jabin kha ama parana te Israel ming kuv ca a cunglie a cahra vie hryly.
Capa ning lieta Deborah hne Abinoam sacapaa Barak ta ama sapa hlaa ca:
“Israel luochiytuv tie ta luochiy yi te, cawsaa zaw ta palung thusa pata amaa pi nakawta, Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung.
Vya siepahruo tie, thyi tie ung; Vya luochiytuv tie naathlie tie ung; Abyipa'a luona hlaa i sa aa, AbyipaIsrael Khazing na hlaa ta i pathuosa aa.
Abyipa, Seir taata na pya tiyta, Edom taata na si tiyta, alyi ca a cathang te, avuo ca a zuv, amyi ta khy a za pasaa.
Tluo zaw ca Abyipahmiekunglie kha a cahang yi te, AbyipaIsrael Khazing hmielie kha Sinai tluo ca aa cahang.
Anath sacapaa Shamgar chuo ning hne Jael chuo ning ca, a phuv ta khy a tlawpa tie duo yi te, khy a tlawpa tie ca luoruv ama ziy.
Israel ruo chunglie luthlutuv tie ca hnyirung yi te, hruosue ta ama le; tahematapakieca Israel ming hrawlie nung haata nama Deborah naa daa nakawta a cuo.
Cawsaa ta khazing thaapa tie kha amaa tlaw tiyta, rie a tuvna ca thlake lieta a aw. Israel ming thaw sawliy hrawlie kha, phya hne asyi hmung riypa a aw ma?
I pathiypalung ca cawsaa hrawtaata palung thusa pata a pipasepa tie, Israel luochiytuv riebyi tie khana aa kya thyi. Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung.
Niema laa ruopa a khangpa tie, niema a muo ruvpa pangphaa cunglie a tupa tie, niema luopuv lie a cakuopa tie, capa kaw ca ri tie ung.

Takhue zaw kie lieta hlaasatuv zaw ueryi ca naathlie tie ung, capa lie ca na iema ta Abyipatena kha ama canyi pakhaa, Israel chunglie luthlutuv tie tena kha. “Cakhutaata Abyipacawsaa zaw ca khypuv thlake luo kha ama zuvbung.
“Thu tie, thu tie, Deborah! Thu tie, thu tie, hlaa kha sa tie! Thu tie, Abinoam sacapaa Barak, na hruocawsaa zaw kha luochiy tie yi.
Cakhutaata byi a cuopa paa cawsaa aa ngaapa tie ca ama zuvbung; Abyipacawsaa tie ca a cahrapa tie kha a du riypata kama'a luo kha ama za cung.
Efraim taata a thu yi te bawphie luo ama si, Benjamin, nama hne na cawsaa tie khana aca ziy yi; Makhir taata riebyi tie, Zebulun taata riebyi khuecahryi a hnyipa tie kha ama sibung.

Isskhar byi tie ca Deborah hneta a vaw yi te, Isskhar ca Barak lie kha zang tluo a tla pata a aw; bawphie chung luo ca ama hneta ama sibung. Reuben phang tie chunglie ca palung a lu linapa na khuopuv ta a aw.
Khaapanakawma tuvrung tie cuota ramang tungpa naathlie riypata, tuvrung zaw hrawlie ca na aw pari? Reuben phang tie chunglie ca palung a lu linapa na khuopuv ta a aw.
Gilead ca Jordan huesuo liena a aw; cakhutaata Dan, khaapanakawma tiypalaw athaalie a aw? Asher ca ata tepa ta riyliy kieliena aa tu, a tiypalaw a dingnapa athaalie khana a aw.
Zebulun ca thiy a nguona te ta rie a du nguopa cuo te, Naftali zaw ruo chung aa suona lie kha cahaacata a tue ra.
Siepahruo tie a vaw yi te rie kha amaa du; cakhutaata Kanaan siepahruo tie kha amaa du, Megiddo tiy athaalie, Taanak lie kha a du yi te, ngu hruosue khaapahmuo hmung va yi.
Aasiy tie ta avuo taa khiyta zaa du yi te, ama luopuv taa khiyta Sisera kha amaa du.
Kishon cavaa tiy cahrasapa ta iema kha a phya yi, a cahrasa pata a langpa, a cahrasapa Kishon cavaa ta. Vya i hringna, cahrana hneta hmieluo tung tie!
Cakhutaata khuosa ta a ruolepa aruo caki pu, rietuvna aruo khuosa ta aa ruolepa pu kha a paring.

“Abyipaavuoming ta, Meroz kha chie sa tie, a chunglie khy a sapa tie kha khuosa ta chie sa tie, tahematapakieca iema ca Abyipakha a bya riypata a vaw va yi, a cahrapa tie a du riypa, Abyipaa bya riypata a vaw va yi.
Canung hrawlie thluechiy cepa ca Jael tana a cuo, Ken ming Heber napuvnung ca, thluodaa chunglie a awpa canung zaw hrawlieta thluechiy cepa tana a cuo.
Sisera ta tiy kha a hie te, ama ta cuehnung a pi, ama ta cuehnung a kaapa kha byi kuotung ta a pi.
Thluodaa khena tung kha a la te, a cacuoluo kuv ta re a hriepa tie khunglung kha aa la; Sisera kha sungkha ta a luv lie tuv te, a naakhie lie kha a zangpahli.
A nepakhuv te aa lie, a phyi thabaw lie kha a laa; a phyi thabaw lie kha a nepakhuv te aa lie, aa nepakhuvna lie ca a lie te a thiy.
Sisera nung ca thlaluo-aw taa khata hmiehmie pase te, pangzu raw taa khata: ‘Khaapanakawma aa ruole ca a vya haasa'a e?' khaapanakawma aa ruole ca a vya haasa'a e,’ ta pata a khi.
A sing cepa a canung tie khata ama palie, hmisi ta kieca, ama hne ama aa paliepa tana a cuo:

‘Iema ca hruosue kha hmung yi te a che va yi ma? capaa pakha cuota lesaa pakha acuolikie pahning; Sisera cuota siyy ta buvpa hne a paa dawpa pang hruosue, i rue lie i kalaa riypata siyy ta buvpa hne a paa dawpa pang hruosue zung hning,’ a ta.
“Caacuonakawta, Vya Abyipa, na carie bangkhuo kha para diy tie! Cuorasala na viesaa zaw ca cahrana hne a kya chiypa ning haata cuo yi se,” ama ta. Cakhutaata ruo ca kung sawliy chung a die.
Israel ming ta Abyipahmiekunglie kha a pha lipa ama tue nakawta Abyipata iema kha Midian tie kuv chung luo kung sariy a pi yi.
Midian kuv ca ta Israel kha a te; Midian kawlie ca ta Israel ming ca tluo cunglie kha a nunapa hmang, lungkhue hne cariekyikuo zaw kha amaa tue.
Israel ming ta khaapa lie ciy ama cyi zawta, Midian ming hne Amalek ming hne ningchiy cawsaa tie kha a khaw yi te iema ca amaa kya du.

Iema ca Israel ming a du riypata arina hmang kha a tue yi te, Gaza athaa te khata ama ciycyi kha ama para, Israel chunglie ning riypa pangaa siy va yi, tuv cuose, cuetungpa cuose, laa zaw cuose sakha hmuo pangaa siy va yi.

Tahematapakieca iema hne ama sahring hne khata kya sithaw yi te, ama thluodaa te kha a kya phyale yi te khawbyapa zaa ama ta; iema cuose, ama kala-uv cuose ri tie'a pata cuo va yi; caacuonakawta amaa vya ngie tlipa kieca ruo kha ama para thluo.
Cahaacata Midian kawlieta Israel ming ca khuopuv ta dawchie yi te, Israel ming ca Abyipa'a luo kha khi yi te abyana amaa hie.
Midian ming kawlieta Israel ming ca Abyipa'a luo kha ama khi tiyta,
Abyipata Israel ming kha profet a pathliepa yi; iema kyihuo khata, “AbyipaIsrael Khazing na hing haa hingta caa ta yi: Izipt ruo, siicuona taata ca pyakhyi yi angte, luo icaa chiy yi;
cakhutaata Izipt ming kuv taata hne niema caa tuechiepa tie kuv taata hya ica pazang yi, cakhutaata iema kha niema hmiekung taata i cade yi, cakhutaata ama ruo kha ica pi yi;
cakhutaata, ‘Kama ca niema Abyipatana i cuo, ama ruo lie nama awnapa Amor ming khazing tie kha pa-uvsathyina pi'a va ung ciy,’ ica ta yi. Cuorasala i ueryi kha naathlie va ung ciy,” a ta yi.

Abyipaavuoming kha a vaw te Abiezrit sacapaa Joash huopa ta a cuopa Ofrah lie mathliy kung rawlie kha aa tu. A sacapaa Gideon ca Midian ming hmung li riypata mingsuv aciyna chunglie kha jungsacuo aa ciy.
Abyipaavuoming kha ama'a lie zaa luo te, “Abyipaca nama'a liena a aw, a cahrapa riekapa,” a ta.

Gideon ta palie te, “Cuorasala abyipa, Abyipaca kiema'a lie a aw kieca, khaapanakawma hingpa hmang bangkhuo hing kiema'a lie a tlung? Ma mingchingmingvuo tie ta malie ama chang tawpa kharuehaa hmang a tuena bangkhuo kha khaapaliema a aw? Abyipata Izipt taata malie kya pyakhyi va ma? cuorasala ata hing ca Abyipana malie a thaw tli, cakhutaata Midian ming kuv chung luo malie a pi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipaca ama'a luo kha a pali te, “Hingpa na cahrana hne hingta cakuo la Israel kha Midian kuv taata hya pazang tie; Kama na caa pathlie ang,” a ta.

Ama ta palie te, “Cuorasala abyipa, tuokhaatama Israel ca hya i pazang aa? I phang hing Manasseh chungtaata a thaa caw cepa tana a cuo, cakhutaata kama hing i ingchungkhue lie a caw cepa tana i cuo,” a ta.
Abyipata ama kyihuo khata, “Cuorasala kama na caa awpuo'a ang, Midian ming mekaa ca na naw'a yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata ama ta, “Nama hmiephaa na i hmung ta pata a cuo kieca, kama hne bie a ripa nama ta pamangsana hmang na pahmung sa tie.
Kama i vawna te ta hingpa hmang taa hingta a hnyi thi khah, i lasaw kha va la'a angte na hmiekunglie hing i vya chi aa,” a ta. Cakhutaata ama ta, “Na vya kaana te ta i aw aa,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Gideon ca a ing chung luo a ngie te mietaata hne jungsacuo viedie ta tuepa thiynung phuv lipa viechuo kha a pachie; saa ca beke lie kha a pasuo, tiyhuo kha bi suokha ta vya cyi te, a awnapa mathliy kung raw luo kha cyile te a pihluo.
Abyipaavuoming ca ta ama kyihuo khata, “Saa hne thiynung phuv lipa viechuo kha la lah hingpa alung cunglie hing chi la tiyhuo kha bya tie,” a ta. Cahaacata ama ta a tue.

Cakhutaata Abyipaavuoming ca ta a kuv lie aa cyipa khuecahryi daw khata saa hne thiynung phuv lipa viechuo kha a daw; alung taa cata myi kya thu te saa hne thiynung phuv lipa viechuo kha a kuo; cakhutaata Abyipaavuoming ca a hmungna taa khata a vie.
Ca tiyta Gideon ta avuoming a cuopa kha pacie te, “Abyipa Khazing, naa bya tie! Tahematapakieca Abyipaavuoming na a hmiepachaw pata i hmung,” a ta.
Cuorasala Abyipata ama kyihuo khata, “Nama'a lie thlaalungna aw se; ciy khah, thiy'a vaciy,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Gideon ta capa lie ca Abyipahuota bienatluophie suokha sa te, ‘Abyipaca thlaalungna tana a cuo,’ ta pata ming a sa. Capa ca ataning tepa hingta Abiezer ming huopa ta a cuopa Ofrah lieta a aw kalie.
Capa zuo lie ca ta Abyipata, “Na paa cuetungpa, cuetungpa sahningnapa, kung sariy a tapa kha la lah, na paa huopa Baal bienatluophie kha pacing diy tie, athaalie a awpa Asherah tung kha hupatyi tie;

cakhutaata hingpa cariekyikuo chunglie hing Abyipana Khazing cuota bienatluophie suokha kha a phung haata sa la, cakhutaata cuetungpa sahningna kha la lah, na hupatyipa Asherah tung kha hmuo la myirue panaana pihluo tie,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Gideon ta a changtaapa pahraa kha ku yi te Abyipata a changpa haa khata a tue; cuorasala ningchung ta capa hmang tue riypa kha ca a ingchungkhue hne khy ming kha a ciy nakaw yi ta, zuo ta a tue.
Khy ming kha mawdiy ta ama thu tiyta, Baal bienatluophie kha a cing patlaa diy, aa thaalie a awpa Asherah tung ca a hupatyi te, bienatluophie sathaapa lie cuetungpa sahningna ca pihluo pata a za aw.
Caacuonakawta pakha hne pakha kha, “Ahungma hingpa hing a tue?” amaa ta. Bie amaa lecade tiyta, “Joash sacapaa Gideon na a tue,” tapa kha ama pachang.
Cakhutaata khy ming ta Joash kyihuo khata, “Na sacapaa kha thiy riypata kya papya tie, tahematapakieca Baal bienatluophie kha pacing te a thaalie a awpa Asherah tung kha a hupatyi tli,” ama ta.

Cuorasala Joash ta ama a vaw hnuepa cawsaa tie kyihuo khata, “Baal ca ma namaa daakhyi aa? A daakhuo ung cate ma nama mangchiy ciemuo? Ama a daakhyipa mekaa ca maw hing tana thie pata ama cuo aa. Ama ca khazing ta a cuo kieca a bienatluophie kha pacingpa pata a cuo nakawta a kaw kha amata tah a ri se,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta capa ning taa cata Gideon ca Jerubbaal ta pata ku pata a cuo, tahematapakieca ama ta Baal bienatluophie kha a pacing nakawta, “Baal ta ama ca a du se,” tanapa tana a cuo.
Cakhutaata Midian ming bangkhuo, hne Amalek ming bangkhuo hne ningchiyluo cawsaa tie kha a pahlaw pata a vaw yi te, Jordan cavaa kha te yi te, Jezreel bawphie lie kha amaa ri.
Cuorasala Abyipathlaapa ca Gideon cunglie kha tlung te, ama ta hmyakaa kha tung te, ama kha ama ziy riypata Abiezer ming ca a ku yi.
Biephyatuv kha pathlie yi te Manasseh ming bangkhuo kha ama ku. Asher ming, Zebulun ming hne Naftali ming'a luo zaw kha biephyatuv pathlie yi te, iema zaw kha ama a taw riypata ama sithaw.
Cakhutaata Gideon ta Khazing kyihuo khata, “Na ripa haata, Israel ming kha kama kuv tana na khuo'a yi tapa pahmungsana ta,

suo-aciyna cunglie kha tuvhming chi'a angte, tuvhming cunglie dyi kha aduo tla te, alyi bangkhuo kha a huv kieca, cakhutaa cata na ripa haa khata kama kuv tana Israel ming na khuo'a yi tapa kha i pachang aa,” a ta.
Cahaacata a cuo hmisi. Mawluo mawdiy ta thu te tuvhming kha a sue tiyta, aduo tiy ca kuotung zungkha a ta.

Cakhutaata Gideon ta Khazing kyihuo khata, “I cunglie na hi haa thi khah se, yi khata na pari sa vie thi tie; tuvhming hingta yi khata dyi dyapasyana tue thi'a ang; tuvhming dyi hing huv sala, alyi lie bangkhuo hing aduo tla se,” a ta.
Cahaacata Khazing ta capa zuo lie ca a tue hmisi. Tuvhming dyi ca huv te, alyi lie bangkhuo ca aduo a tla.

Cakhutaata Jerubbaal (capa ca Gideon) hne ama'a lie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo thu patang yi te, Harod acaa athaalie kha amaa ri; Midian ming arina hmang ca iema'a taata chaluo kuo, Moreh tluo raw bawphie chunglie khata a cuo.
Abyipata Gideon kyihuo khata, “Kama ta Midian ming ama kuv chung luo pi riypata nama'a lie a awpa rieka kha ama hluv tuv,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta cawsaazaapuv thyi pata, ‘Ciyna a hnyipa hne a thaa a cathangpa mekaa ca ing luo kaa yi se,’ ta pata a pathyi. Gideon ta che yi te, thawkiy thawpaliy ing luo ama kaa, thawhraa amaa ngaa.

Cakhutaata Abyipata Gideon kyihuo khata, “Cawsaa hing ama hluv tuv kalie; cavaa luo cungkhyi yi la kama ta ica pachepa'a yi. Kama ta, ‘Hingpa paa hing nama'a lie si ra se,’ i tapa ca nama'a lie si ra'a te, ‘Hingpa paa hing ca nama'a lie si ra'a vyi,’ i tapa ca si'a vyi,’ a ta.

Caacuonakawta cavaa luo kha cungkhyi yi te, Abyipata Gideon kyihuo khata, “Uv ta tiy a palipa haata a palyi ta tiy a palipa mekaa kha kuokhaluo ta na chi'a yi; tiy dang riypata a pakhuv pane te a pachung ta tiy a dangpa mekaa kha a hrangpa kuokhaluo ta na chi'a yi,” a ta.
A pali ta a palipa ca zathung ama ta; cuorasala a hrangpa bangkhuo ca tiy dang riypata ama pakhuv ama pane.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Gideon kyihuo khata, “A pali ta a palipa zathung kha tana niema ca ca khuo'a yi angte Midian ming kha nama kuv luo ica pi'a yi. A hrangpa bangkhuo kha ca ing luo kaa yi se,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta ama ungthyi hne ama hmyakaa zaw kha iema'a taa cata la te, aa ngaapa Israel ming bangkhuo ca ama thluodaa luo a pakaa diy yi, cuorasala zathung tie kha a pangaa yi. Midian tie arina hmang ca ama rawluo bawphie lieta a cuo.
Capa zuo lie ca ta Abyipata, “Thu la amaa rina hmang ca tuv tie; tahematapakieca na kuv luona ica pi.
Cuorasala tuv riypa kha na ciy kieca, na changtaapa Purah hne khata arina hmang luo kha zuv la,

khaapama ama ri tapa kha na thyi aa; cakhutaa cata na kuv ca tuv riypata cahrasapa a cuo aa,” a ta. Cakhutaata a changtaapa Purah hne cata cehre a cyipa arina hmang rie a vepa tie'a luo kha ama sibung.
Midian ming hne Amalek ming hne ningchiy cawsaa zaw bangkhuo ca bawphie kaakaapa khata laa yi te khawbyapa zaa ama ta; ama kala-uv ca ri tie riypata cuo vyi, riyliy kielie viehnang zaa a ta.

Gideon ca a chiy tiyta, cawsaapa pakha ta a viesaa pakha kha a muo za chang nguoluo te, a ripa ca, “Muo suokha sa angte, capa i muo chunglie ca jungsacuo ta tuepa viechuo tluo kha ca Midian ming arina hmang luo kha zaa hlangle te thluodaa kha a za phaw ca, aa lie; a thi kyalya te, thluodaa ca a ra,” a ta.
A viesaapa ca ta, “Hingpa hing a hrangpa cuo li pata Israel cawsaapa, Joash sacapaa Gideon zueziy tana a cuo aa; Khazing na Midian hne rieka bangkhuo hing ama kuv chung luo a pi,” a ta.

Gideon ta muo hne a siyluo amaa changpa kha a thyi tiyta, Khazing kha abie te, Israel ming arina hmang luo kha kaa te, “Thu tie ung; tahematapakieca Abyipana Midian rieka kha nama kuv luo caa pi yi,” a ta.
Cawsaa zathung kha phuv thung ta a che khutaa yi ta, cawsaa bangkhuo kuv luo kha hmyakaa hne a chunglie myi vuo ciepa ungthyi hripa kha pi yi te,
iema kyihuo khata, “Kama kha na mang ung la, i tuepa haata tue ra tie ung; carie tie arina hmang kie luo i chiy tiyta i tuepa haa khata nama tue ra aa.

Hmyakaa kha i tung tiyta, kama hne kama'a lie a awpa bangkhuo, hne niema bangkhuo ta arina hmang cahriy bangkhuo khata hmyakaa kha tung'a ung cate, ‘Abyipahuo hne Gideon huo ta!’ ta pata nama khi aa,’” a ta yi.

Caacuonakawta Gideon hne ama'a lie a awpa cawsaa zakha tie ca zuo ta rie a vepa a liela phuv rie ve amaa thle baata ning cuo lie kha thluodaa athaa luo kha chiy yi te, hmyakaa kha tung yi te ama kuv lie a awpa ungthyi kha ama dechi kaluo.

Cahaacata ama phuv thung cata hmyakaa kha tung yi te, ungthyi kha ama dechi kaluo, ama cavyi kuv ta myisaa kha a cyi yi te, ama cacuoluo kuv ta hmyakaa kha amaa cyi, cakhutaata, “Abyipahne Gideon cuota zueziy suokha!” ta pata ama khi.
Cawsaa mekaa ca arina hmang a chi aa dung pata amaa daa; arina hmang chunglie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo ca khile yi te amaa ruo.
Iema ta hmyakaa zathung kha ama tung tiyta, Abyipata carie tie kha iema hne iema padu sa yi te, rieka bangkhuo ca Zererah luo Beth-shittah te, hne Abel-meholah ruoriy Tabbath athaa te khata amaa ruo.
Cakhutaata Israel ming ca Naftali hne Asher hne Manasseh taa khata ku yi te, Midian tie kha amaa cade.

Cakhutaata Gideon ta biephyatuv tie kha Efraim tluocung ruo bangkhuo khata pathlie yi te, “Midian tie a du riypata za pya ung la, cavaata bangkhuo kha Beth-barah te ta cuose, Jordan cavaa kha cuose ama te khu li riypata a daakhuo diy tie ung,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Efraim capaa bangkhuo ca ku yi te, cavaata zaw ca Beth-barah te cuose, Jordan cavaa cuose ama te khu li riypata amaa daakhuo diy.

Midian riebyi pahning Oreb hne Zeeb kha patuv yi te, Oreb kha Oreb alung lie thie yi te, Zeeb kha Zeeb mingsuv aciyna lieta ama thie. Midian tie kha a cade pazue yi te, Oreb hne Zeeb ama luv kha Jordan huesuo luo, Gideon'a luo kha ama kya phya.
Cakhutaata Efraim ming ta ama kha, “Ma cunglie na tuepa hing khaapatama a cuo? Midian ming na tuv ning yi ta malie ku ra vaciy, ama ta. Ama kha khuosa ta ama chuo.
Caacuonakawta iema kyihuo khata, “Niema hne pakhingpuo riypata khaapama i tue? Efraim mingsuv mang thangpa ca Abiezer mingsuv lu liyciy ning laata a pha vie cuo va ma?
Khazing ta Midian riebyi Oreb hne Zeeb kha nama kuv chung luo aca pi tli yi; niema hne pakhingpuo riypata kama ta khaapama i tue khu?” a ta yi. Capa ca a ri tiyta, ama hihaana kha a die.
Cakhutaata Gideon hne ama'a lie a awpa zathung tie ca Jordan luo kha chiy yi te cavaa ca ama va te, ama thaa a buosa, cuorasala amaa cade pazue.

Caacuonakawta Sukkoth ming kyihuo khata, “Kama naa ziypa tie kha viechuo na pipa thi tie ung, tahematapakieca ama nang na a buosa tli, cakhutaata kama ta Midian siepahruo Zebah hne Zalmunna kha i cade nguoluo yi,” a ta.
Cuorasala Sukkoth khy lie uvthyi tie ta, “Kiema ta na rieka tie kha viechuo ma pi riypa yi ta, Zebah hne Zalmunna ca patuv ung cate nama kuv chunglie aw tli kanaa yi?” ama ta.
Gideon ta, “A pha, Abyipata Zebah hne Zalmunna kha i kuv chung luo ina pi thueta ca ruocaapa lie ruorahyi tana nama ke ica chi'a yi,” a ta.
Capa taa cata Penuel luo kha sithaw te cahaacata paa a kie pakhaa yi; cuorasala Penuel ming zaw ca ta Sukkoth ming haa khata ama palie.
Caacuonakawta Penuel ming kyihuo khata, “Tena hne i vaw pakhaa thueta ca hingpa ingsuo hingna i pacing aa,” a ta.

Zebah hne Zalmunna ca ama rieka thawhraa hlyipangaa hne khata Karkor lie ama aw, tahematapakieca ningchiy cawsaa cehre a cyipa chungtaata thawzakha thawkiy ama thiy tli nakawta aa ngaapa bangkhuo ca hingpa zaa hingta ama cuo.
Caacuonakawta Gideon ca Nobah hne Jogbehah ningchiyluo kuo a phuv ta khytlawnapa luopuv kha ziy te rie a ve li pata ama aw chung khata sungkha ta a tuv yi.
Zebah hne Zalmunna ca amaa ruo; cuorasala a cade yi te, Midian siepahruo Zebah hne Zalmunna ca a patuv yi, ama rieka bangkhuo ca amaa chepatlaa diy.
Joash sacapaa Gideon ca Heres cakhuo luo kha za ziy te rietuvnapa taa khata a za kaa.
Ama ta Sukkoth mingnu pakha kha patuv te bie a hiehriy; capa paa ca ta Sukkoth byi hne uvthyi tie sawsariy pasariy ming kha a cape pa diy.

Cakhutaata Sukkoth ming'a luo kha cakuo te, “Kiema ta na rieka tie kha viechuo ma pi riypa yi ta, Zebah hne Zalmunna ca patuv ung cate nama kuv chunglie aw tli kanaa yi? ta pata nama bieke ta ina za tapa ung ciy Zebah hne Zalmunna ca hingpa lie hing ama aw hing,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta khypuv uvthyi tie kha patuv yi te, ruorahyi kha a la te, Sukkoth khy ming ca ruocaapa lie ruorahyi cata a pasiypa-ya yi.
Penuel ingsuo zaw kha pacing te khypuv capaa tie kha a thie yi.

Cakhutaata Zebah hne Zalmunna kyihuo khata, “Tabor lie nama thiepa tie ca tuokhaapa cawsaa tama ama cuo?” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Nama haa hing tana ama cuo ra, ama bangkhuo ta siepahruo sacapaa na ama lu,” ama ta.
Ama ta, “Iema ca i uvnu tana ama cuo, i nung sacapaa zaw tana ama cuo; Abyipaa hringpa haata, iema kha za pahring ung la ca, ca thie'a va yi ang,” a ta yi.

Caacuonakawta a sacapaa uvthyi ta a cuopa Jether kyihuo khata, “Vaa la va thie tie yi!” a ta. Cuorasala satliepa ca ta a zueziy kha a baw taata a da vyi, tahematapakieca ama ca satlieta a cuo nakawta a ciy pata a cuo.

Zebah hne Zalmunna ca ta, “A vaw la nama ta malie vya thie tie; macuo ta hrie riypa re ca macuo dyina a hrie khu,” ama ta. Caacuonakawta Gideon ca Zebah hne Zalmunna kha a thie khutaa yi ta, ama kala-uv ruetung lie ama pa-yapa pachiy kha a la.
Cakhutaata Israel ming ta Gideon kyihuo khata, “Kiema kha malie uv tie, nama hne na sacapaa zaw, na samingta zaw te ta; tahematapakieca nama na Midian ming kuv chungtaata malie a khuo ciy,” ama ta.
Gideon ta, “Kama ta ca uv'a va yi ang; Abyipana caa uv'a yi,” a ta yi.

Cakhutaata Gideon ta iema kyihuo khata, “Niema kha suokha icaa hie khing yi; pakha cyicuo ta hruosue ta nama lapa ra-aw kha na pi kaluo tie ung,” a ta yi. (Tahematapakieca carie tie ca Ishmael ming ama cuo nakawta siy ra-aw kha amaa baa).
Iema ta, “Palung tluosa pata maca pi aa,” ama ta. Caacuonakawta pang kha phaa yi te, pakha cyicuo khata hruosue ta ama lapa ra-aw kha capa pang cunglie ca ama vya chi kaluo.
Aa hiepa yi siy ra-aw ca siy shekel thawkha zasariy ta a cuo (kukaw hne pachiy hne Midian siepahruo tie ta amaa buvpa pang a ciycaapa, hne kala-uv ruepakaw zaw ripuo li pata).

Capa siy ca ta Gideon ta tluobyi buohryi kha tue te, a khy lie, Ofrah lie kha a chi. Israel ming bangkhuo ca capa lie kuvtuezuv ca vaa bie yi te ama siyhraw. Capa ca ta Gideon hne a ingchungkhue cuota cyihyi lie a uona ta aa li.
Cahaacata Midian ca Israel ming hmiekunglie te pata cuo te, ama luv kya calang va tli yi. Caacuonakawta Gideon chuo ning kha ruo ca kung sawliy chung a die.
Joash sacapaa Jerubbaal ca ama ing lie kha a aw.
Gideon ca ama ta a sapa sacapaa sawsariy a hnyi, tahematapakieca napuv a hluvsa a hnyi.
Shekhem lie a awpa a nungthangnung zaw ta sacapaa pakha sapa te Abimelek ta pata ming a sa.
Cakhutaata Joash sacapaa Gideon ca a kung tluvsa pata thiy te, Abiezer ming khy Ofrah lie, a paa Joash thluo lie kha ama paby.
Gideon a thiy khu pahne ta, Israel ming ca ama rawrawpa luo kaa yi te, Baal hneta ama siyhraw, Baal-berith kha ama khazing ta amaa tue.
Israel ming ta a kuo bangkhuo ta a awpa ama carie tie kuv taata a khuopa yi Abyipaama Khazing kha a thyi va yi.
Cakhutaata Jerubbaal (capa ca Gideon ta a cuo) ingchungkhue cunglie zaw kha, Israel ming cunglie phana a tuepa bangkhuo cuo khata zang tluo atlana paluosa va yi.
Jerubbaal sacapaa Abimelek ca Shekhem khy lie a nung tieriy zaw'a luo kha si te iema hne a nung phang bangkhuo kyihuo khata,

“Shekhem byi zaw bangkhuo thyipa khata, ‘Khaapa hing ma nama cuota a pha vie aa, Jerubbaal sacapaa zaw sawsariy bangkhuo ta aca uvpa yi ma, acuolikie pakha ta aca uvpa yi ma?’ Kama ca nama thiy nama saa ta i cuopa zaw kha a thyi tie ung,” a ta yi.

Caacuonakawta a nung tieriy zaw ca ta Abimelek cuopa khata capa bie ca Shekhem byi zaw thyipa khata ama ripa; Abimelek ziy riypa khata ama palung a chiy vie, tahematapakieca, “Ama ca ma uvnu tana a cuo,” ama ta.
Iema ta Baal-berith biena-ing chungtaata ngu tluo sawsariy kha pi yi te, capa ca ta Abimelek ta khaapahmuo a thlahne lipa a vievuvpa tie kha a hluo yi te ama kha ama ziy.
Ama ca Ofrah lie a paa ing luo kha si te, Jerubbaal sacapaa, a uvnu cawsaa sawsariy kha alung suokha cunglie a thie yi; cuorasala Jerubbaal sacapaa a syi cepa Jotham ca a nu te a law.
Cakhutaata Shekhem ming bangkhuo hne Beth-millo ming bangkhuo ca a pahmya yi te, Shekhem khy lungbang athaalie a awpa mathliy kung rawlie kha Abimelek ca siepahruo ta ama pacuo sa.

Capa ca Jotham kha ama chang tiyta, Gerizim Tluodaw luo kha kie te, capa lie ca a daa te khuopuv ta khi te iema kha, “Niema Shekhem ming ta na naathlie tie ung, cata a cuo kie dyina Khazing ta niema zaw aca naathlie'a yi.
Yi kha ca thingkungpa zaw ta iema cuota siepahruo a tlaw riypata ama pya. Caacuonakawta iema ta olif kung kha, ‘Nama malie uv tie,’ ama ta.
Olif kung ta, ‘Cawsaa hne khazing zaw pa-uvsathyi pinapa i thu papya li tlipa ta ma thingkungpa zaw cunglie a canyi hyalya riypata i aw aa?’ a ta yi.
Cakhutaata thingkungpa zaw ta thyikuv kung kyihuo khata, ‘Nama a vaw la malie uv tie,’ ama ta.
Cuorasala thyikuv kung ta iema kha, ‘A thlungsapa hne a pahuosapa i thyi pathyi kha taw'a angte ma thingkungpa zaw cunglie a canyi hyalya riypata i aw aa?’ a ta yi.
Cakhutaata thingkungpa zaw khata mingsuv kung kyihuo khata, ‘Nama a vaw la malie uv tie,’ ama ta.
Cuorasala mingsuv kung ca ta iema kyihuo khata, ‘Cawsaa hne khazing zaw palung a patluopa i mingsuvtiy papya li tlipa ta ma thingkungpa zaw cunglie a canyi hyalya riypata i aw aa?’ a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta thingkungpa tie khata ahling kung kyihuo khata, ‘Nama a vaw la kiema hing malie uv tie,’ ama ta.

Cakhutaata ahling kung ca ta thingkungpa tie kyihuo khata, ‘Zangna hmisi hne nama cunglie siepahruo ta ina tuepa ung cata a cuo kieca, i ningdiy rawlie hing vya canaw tie ung; cuorasala cata a cuo li kieca, ahling kung chung taa hingta myi kya ie sala, Lebanon sidar thing khiy kuo diy yi se,’ a ta.

“Caacuonakawta ata hing, zangna hmisi hne pa-uvsathyina hmisi ta Abimelek hing siepahruo ta nama tue tiyta, Jerubbaal hne a ingchungkhue cunglie kha ama a tuepa hne aa phuv pata nama tuepa ta a cuo kieca,
tahematapakieca i paa ca niema cuo khata a hringna a pi pata rie zaa du te Midian ming kuv chung taa khata aca za khuo yi.

Cuorasala ataning hing niema ca i paa ingchungkhue kha a du ung cate, a sacapaa sawsariy kha alung suokha cunglie nama thie, a siicanung sacapaa Abimelek kha nama tieriy a cuo nakawta Shekhem ming cunglie siepahruo ta nama tue tli.

Ica ta yi, ataning hing Jerubbaal hne a ingchungkhue cunglie kha zangna hmisi hne pa-uvsathyina ta nama tuepa a cuo kieca, Abimelek cunglie kha nama palung tluo sala, ama zaw niema cunglie kha a palung tluo ra se.

Cuorasala cahaacata a cuo li kieca, Abimelek chungtaata myi pya sala, Shekhem ming hne Beth-millo ming kha kuo yi se; cakhutaata Shekhem ming hne Beth-millo ming chung taa khata myi pya sala, Abimelek kha kuo ra se,” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata Jotham ca a uvnu Abimelek kha a ciy nakawta Beer luo kha a ruo te capa lie ca a aw.
Abimelek ta Israel ca kung thung a uv.
Cuorasala Khazing ta Abimelek hne Shekhem ming amaa lalalie kha thlaapa pha lipa pathlie te Shekhem ming khata Abimelek ca ama raw.
Hingpa hing Jerubbaal sacapaa sawsariy tie a thiepa Abimelek hne thie riypata thaa a pipa Shekhem ming cunglie iema thiy kha tlung te phuvlana riypata a cuopa hmang tana a cuo.

Caacuonakawta, Abimelek kha ama hue nakawta Shekhem ming ta tluocung lie kha ngie a sapa tie ama chi. Iema ta capa luopuv a ziypa tie bangkhuo kha ama chechiy ama chuv; capa kaw ca Abimelek kha ama chang.
Ebed sacapaa Gaal ca a tieriy zaw hneta Shekhem luo aa palaw tiyta, Shekhem khy ming ta ama cunglie kha zangna ama hnyi.

Lu luo kha si yi te, ama mingsuv diedung chung taa khata mingsuv kha lu yi te, naw yi te pyi ama tue. Cakhutaata ama khazing tie biena-ing luo kha cakuo yi te, ning yi dang yi te, Abimelek kha ama tue hyalya.

Ebed sacapaa Gaal ca ta, “Abimelek ca ahung ta cuo te ma, kiema Shekhem ming ca ahung ta ma cuo nakaw ma a re ca ma hrie aa? Jerubbaal sacapaa hne a rehrietuv byi Zebul ta Shekhem ming paa Hamor re kha za hrie va yi ma? Khaapanakawma ama re ca ma hrie aa?
Hingpa cawsaa zaw hingna i kuv rawlie a aw yi ta pata cuo sala ca! Abimelek ca phe'a angte, ‘Na riekaphuv ca pahluv vie la, kya pya tie, i ta aa,’ a ta.
Khypuv uvtuv Zebul ta Ebed sacapaa Gaal bie kha a thyi tiyta, a hihaana kha myi ie ta a ie.
Arumah lie a awpa Abimelek'a luo kha biephyatuv pathlie te, “Mang tie, Ebed sacapaa Gaal hne a tieriy zaw ta Shekhem luo kha a vaw yi te, nama a du riypata khypuv kha ama pasu.
Caacuonakawta nama hne nama'a lie a awpa rieka tie kha zuo ta si ung la, ruo lie kha za bya tie ung.
