Cakhutaata mawdiy ning a kya chiy pahne khata thu ung la khypuv ca tlangkhy nuo tie ung; ama hne ama'a lie a awpa rieka tie kha niema a du riypata ama kya pya tiyta, nama thaa a aw zawdya khata a du tie ung,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Abimelek hne ama'a lie a awpa riekaphuv tie ca zuo ta sithaw yi te Shekhem a du riypa cata phuv paliy ta ama bya.
Ebed sacapaa Gaal ca kya pya te khypuv thlake lie kha aa tu tiyta, Abimelek hne a rieka tie ca ngie ama sanapa taa khata ama vya pya.
Gaal ta cawsaa kha a hmung tiy yi ta, Zebul kyihuo khata, “Mang tie, tluo cung taata cawsaa ama za cungle khiy,” a ta. Zebul ta, “Tluo zaw mingthlaapa na cawsaa ta na ri thlu aa,” a ta.
Gaal ta, “Mang tie, Tabbur-erez taa tana cawsaa zaw ama za cungle, cakhutaata phuv kha tie ca Elon-meonenim luo taa tana amaa vaw,” a ta pakhaa.

Cakhutaata Zebul ta ama kyihuo khata, “Naa palena kha khaapaliema a aw tli, ‘Abimelek ca ahung ta cuo te ma a re ca ma hriepa aa?’ ta va ca ma? Hingpa riekaphuv tie hing siysaa na ri lipa tana ama cuo, cuo va ma? Pya la tuv tie nie yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Gaal ca Shekhem ming hmieluo khata si te Abimelek hne cata amaa du.
Abimelek ta a cade te aa ruo. Hukaa thlake te ta a cade yi te, cawsaa hluvpuv kha hmaa a hmung yi te amaa lie.
Caacuonakawta Abimelek ca Arumah lie kha a aw; Zebul ta Gaal hne a tieriy tie kha Shekhem lie ama aw khu li tli riypata aa cade yi.
A mawluopa ta cawsaa ca ruo luo kha pya yi te, capa kaw ca Abimelek kha ama chang tiyta,
a cawsaa zaw kha phuv thung ta che yi te, ruo chung taa cata ama bya. Mang te khypuv chungtaata cawsaa ama pyapa kha a hmung tiy yi ta, thu te iema kha a thie yi.
Abimelek hne ama'a lie a awpa phuv kha hmieluo vaa ruo yi te hukaa thlake lie amaa daa ning kha, phuv hning tie khata a ruo yi te ruo lie a awpa bangkhuo kha ama thie.
Abimelek ta khypuv kha ning-aw ta aa du; khypuv kha la te, a chunglie a awpa cawsaa kha a thie yi; khypuv kha para te paciy a phuv.
Shekhem Ingsuo lie a awpa tie ta capa kaw ca ama thyi tiyta, El-berith biena-ing cariekyikuo luo kha amaa ngie.
Shekhem Ingsuo lie a awpa tie na suv kha lie a hmya yi tapa kha Abimelek ca ama chang.

Caacuonakawta Abimelek hne ama'a lie a awpa rieka tie ca Zalmon Tluo luo kha ama kie. Abimelek ta a hryi kha a la te, thingce kha hu te cataw te a letung lie aa puvle. Ama ta a rieka tie kyihuo khata, “Khaapama i tue tapa kha ina hmung ung ciy, i tuepa haa hingta a catli pata tue tie ung,” a ta yi.

Caacuonakawta rieka tie pakha cyicuo khata thingce kha hu yi te, Abimelek kha paziy yi te cariekyikuo kha ama papungsue, cakhutaata cariekyikuo kha myi ta ama rue, caacuonakawta Shekhem ingsuo lie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo kha thiy yi te, capaa hne canung hne thawkha tluv ama ta.
Cakhutaata Abimelek ca Thebez luo kha si te Thebez ca cadung te a la.
Cuorasala a khy chunglie kha ingsuo a cusapa suokha aw te, capaa hne canung bangkhuo hne khy ming bangkhuo ca capa luo ca a ruo yi te, a khaa khung yi te ingsuo thlungkhuv luo kha ama kie diy.
Abimelek ca ingsuo luo kha a du riypa yi ta a vaa, ingsuo kha myi ta rue riypata aa ngiena luo kha ava cadi.
Cuorasala canung pakha ta suo rienapa alung suokha kha Abimelek luv cung luo a za pathlasue ca a luv ruv kha a kyi.

A cehre a cyipatuv satliepa kha sungkha ta ku te, “Na zueziy kha a da la na thie tie, cawsaa ta canung na a thie ina ta li riypa yi ta,” a ta. Caacuonakawta satliepa ca ta a zangpahlina te ta daw te a thiy.
Israel ming ta Abimelek a thiypa kha ama hmung tiyta, ama bangkhuo ta ing luo kha amaa diy.
Cahaacata Abimelek ca a uvnu sawsariy kha thie pata a paa cunglie pha lina a tuepa kha Khazing ta a thung.
Cakhutaata Jerubbaal sacapaa Jotham ta chie a sapa haa yi khata, Khazing ta Shekhem ming ama pha lina zaw kha ama luv cung luo a pathla.
Abimelek khutaata Issakhar phang Dodo sacapaa Puah a sacapaa Tola ca Israel ming palaw sa riypata a vya puv; ama ca Efraim tluocung ruo Shamir lie a awpa ta a cuo.
Ama ta Israel ming kha kung kiy kung thung bie a ripa yi.
Ama khutaata Gilead ming Jair ca Israel ming kha kung kiy kung hning bie a ripa yi.
Ama ta laa sawthung a khangpa sacapaa sawthung a hnyi yi; cakhutaata iema ca Gilead ruo lie a awpa khy sawthung hnyi yi te, ataning tepa hingta Havvoth-jair ta pata ama ku.
Jair ca thiy te Kamon lie ama paby.

Israel ming ta Abyipahmungna lie kha a pha lipa tue pakhaa yi te, Baal hne Ashtaroth hne Aram khazing, Sidon khazing, Moab khazing, Ammon ming khazing, Filistin ming khazing zaw kha amaa bie. Cahaacata Abyipakha thaw yi te ama kha abie va yi.
Caacuonakawta Abyipahihaana ca myi ie ta ie te, iema kha Filistin ming hne Ammon ming kuv luo kha zaa yi te,
iema ta capa kung ning ca Israel ming kha khuopuv ta ama tuechie. Jordan cavaa huesuo, Gilead lie a awpa Amor ming ruo chunglie kha Israel ming ca kung hraa hlyicari chung bangkhuo ama hrisaa.
Ammon ming zaw ta Judah hne Benjamin hne Efraim chung tie zaw kha a du riypata Jordan kha ama te, caacuonakawta Israel ca khuopuv ta ama palung rie a thyi.
Caacuonakawta Israel ming ta Abyipa'a luo kha khi yi te, “Na cungliena ma sue tli, tahematapakieca ma Khazing kha thaw pate Baal kha maa bie,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Israel ming kyihuo khata, “Izipt ming, Amor ming, Ammon ming hne Filistin ming zaw'a taata ica khuo yi cuo va ma?
Sidon ming hne Amalek ming hne Maon ming zaw ta aca tuechie ra yi; cakhutaata kama'a luo kha kya khi ung cate, iema kuv chungtaata ica khuo yi.
Niema ta kama kha na thaw ung cate khazing hrangpa kha namaa bie; caacuonakawta ca khuo taw'a va tli yi ang.
Vaa ung la namaa tlawpa khazing tie'a luo kha va khi tie ung, nama palungriethyina chung taa khata cakhuo naase yi,” a ta.
Israel ming ta Abyipakyihuo khata, “Ma suesa tli; nama ta a pha na tapa haa khata malie tue tie, cuorasala ataning hing ca malie khuo tie!” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta ruohrang khazing tie kha thaw yi te, Abyipakha amaa bie; Israel ming ruvnaana ama angpa kha ama ta a mang he mang khu va yi.
Cakhutaata Amor ming kha ku yi te, cehre patuv sa yi te, Gilead lie amaa hmya; cakhutaata Israel ming kha a vya hmya yi te, Mizpah lie amaa ri.
Gilead luochiytuv tie khata pakha hne pakha kha, “Ammon ming a du a pathatuv ca ahungtama a cuo aa? Ama ca Gilead ming bangkhuo cunglie kha luv tana a cuo aa,” amaa ta.
Gilead ming Jepthah, siyhrawnung sacapaa ca a thaaruvpa rieka ta a cuo. Gilead ca Jepthah a paa ta a cuo.

Gilead a napuvnung ta ama kha sacapaa zaw a sapa ra yi; a napuvnung sacapaa zaw ca ama kya le tiyta, iema ta Jepthah kha a cade yi te, ama kyihuo khata, “Nama ca ma paa ing lie khaapa hing hmuota cu ra'a vaciy; tahematapakieca nama ca canung hrangpa sacapaa tana na cuo,” ama ta.
Cakhutaa cata Jepthah ca a ruo te Tob ruo lie kha a aw. Khaapa tluo a cuo lipa tie kha Jepthah'a luo ca a vya hmya yi te, ama hneta rie ama tuvle.
Cuo kha khutaata Ammon ming ta Israel ming kha rie amaa du.
Cahaacata Ammon ming ta Israel ming kha rie amaa du tiyta, Gilead uvthyi tie ca Tob ruo taata Jepthah kha la riypata ama si.
Jepthah kyihuo khata, “A vaw la kiema luochiytuv ta cuo tie, Ammon ming kha maa du khuna riypa yi ta,” ama ta.

Cuorasala Jepthah ta Gilead uvthyi tie kyihuo khata, “Niema hingna na thaw ung cate, i paa ing taata naa cade ung ciy cuo va ma? Caacuonakawta khaapanakawma ruvna namaa taw taata kama'a luo ca namaa vaw?” a ta yi.

Gilead uvthyi tie ta Jepthah kyihuo khata, “Tuokhaata a cuo zaw, nama'a luona maa pali pakhaa, caacuonakawta kiema hne hingta si'a cate, Ammon ming ca a du'a yi pate kiema Gilead lie a awpa bangkhuo tie ma luv ta cuo tie,” ama ta.
Jepthah ta Gilead uvthyi tie kyihuo khata, “Ammon ming hne rie a du riypata ing luo kha naa chiy ung cate, Abyipata iema kha ina pi kie yi ca, niema luv ta i cuo aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Gilead uvthyi tie ta Jepthah kyihuo khata, “Abyipaca maa lalalie pachangkhyituv ta cuo se; na ripa haa cata ima tue hrahring aa,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Jepthah ca Gilead uvthyi tie hne khata si te, cawsaa ta ama kha iema luv hne luochiytuv ta ama tue; cakhutaata Jepthah ta Mizpah lieta a bie bangkhuo kha Abyipa'a luo a ri diy.
Cakhutaata Jepthah ta Ammon siepahruo'a luo kha biephyatuv pathlie te, “Nama hne kama alalalie ta khaapa bie a aw nakaw ma a vaw cate i ruo ca na vya tuv?” a ta.

Ammon siepahruo ta Jepthah biephyatuv tie kyihuo khata, “Tahematapakieca Israel ming ta Izipt ruo taata ama vya si ning khana Arnon taata Jabbok hne Jordan te yalya ta i ruo kha amaa la, caacuonakawta ata hing ca a diesa pata na pi pakhaa tie,” a ta.
Jepthah ta Ammon siepahruo'a luo kha biephyatuv pathlie pakhaa te,
ama kyihuo khata, “Jepthah na caa ta: Israel ming ta Moab acuolikie Ammon ming ruo kha la va yi,
cuorasala Izipt taata ama kya sithaw tiyta, Israel ming ca ruocaapa taata Riyliy Sepa luo khata si yi te Kadesh te ama pha.

Israel ming ta Edom siepahruo'a luo kha biephyatuv pathlie yi te, ‘Na ruo hing cahraw thi'a puv,’ ama ta; cuorasala Edom siepahruo ta naathlie vyi. Iema ta Mob siepahruo'a luo zaw kha biephyatuv ama pathlie, cuorasala a naa tla vyi. Caacuonakawta Israel ming ca Kadesh lieta amaa tuo.

Cakhutaata iema ca ruocaapa kha cahraw yi te Edom ruo hne Moab ruo kha cahlung yi te ama si, Moab ruo ningchiyluo kuo ama chiypa khata Arnon kuokhaluo kuo lie kha amaa ri. Iema ca Moab ruoriy luo kha a ngie va yi, tahematapakieca Arnon ca Moab ruoriy tana a cuo.
Cakhutaata Israel ming ta Amor Siepahruo Sihon'a luo kha biephyatuv pathlie yi te, ama kyihuo khata, “Na ruo hing cahraw pata ma ruo luo malie pasi sa tie,” ama ta.
Cuorasala Sihon ta a ruo cahraw riypa khata Israel ming kha zang va yi; caacuonakawta Sihon ta a cawsaa bangkhuo kha pahmya yi te, Jahaz lie a ri yi te Israel ming kha amaa du.
Cakhutaata AbyipaIsrael Khazing ta Sihon ca Israel ming kuv luo pi te, iema ca ama te; caacuonakawta Israel ta capa ruo lie a awpa Amor ming ruo bangkhuo kha a la diy.
Iema ta Amor ming ruo ta a cuopa, Arnon taata Jabbok te hne ruocaapa taata Jordan te khata ama la diy.
Caacuonakawta AbyipaIsrael Khazing ta Amor ming kha a cawsaa Israel ming phana cuota a tepa tana a cuo. Iema ruo ca ma la ta naa ting?
Na khazing Khemosh ta cu riypata aca pipa khana na cu aa, cuo va ma? Abyipama Khazing ta kiema phana cuota a tepa ruo bangkhuo ca kiema hing a cu riypa cuo'a va pa ma?
Nama hing Moab ming Zippor sacapaa Siepahruo Balak laata na phavienapa suokha chuo a aw ma?

Israel ming Heshbon hne a khyta zaw lie, hne Aroer hne a khyta zaw lie, hne Arnon cavaa kie thlyalya ta a awpa khy zaw bangkhuo lie ama aw ning, kung zathung chunglie kha khaapanakawma zaa la pakhaa li pata na aw?

Kama hing nama cunglie a suepa cuo va ang, cuorasala nama na rie naa du cate naa pasue sapa ta a cuo ciy. Abyipa, bieripatuv ta Israel ming hne Ammon ming alalalie ataning hing bie chi mang sue,” a ta.
Cuorasala Ammon ming siepahruo ta Jepthah ta bie a taapa kha khaapatahmuo ri vyi.
Cakhutaata Abyipathlaapa ca Jepthah cunglie kha tlung te, Gilead hne Manasseh lie kha aa khie. Mizpah hne Gilead lie kha a khie te, Mizpah hne Gilead taa cata Ammon luo kha caluo te aa khie.
Cakhutaata Jepthah ca Abyipa'a lie kha biekuona tue te, “Ammon ming hingna i kuv luo ina pi ciy tapa kieca,
Ammon ming i te khutaa yi ta i kaa thueta kama daw riypata i ing chiypakaa chungtaata a kya pyapa khata myirue panaana ica pihluo aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Jepthah ca Ammon ming a du riypa khata si te, Abyipata iema ca a kuv luo a pi yi.
Aroer taata Minnith khy athaa te, khy kiy, Abel-keramim te khata iema kha khuosa ta te yi te a thie yi. Caacuonakawta Ammon ming ca Israel ming hmiekunglie kha amaa sung.

Cakhutaata Jepthah ca Mizpah lie a ing luo kha a tlung; a sacanung ca a khang hneta luopuo pata ama daw riypata a kya pya. Ama ca pakha dyipa a saata ta a cuo; ama ta li pata sacapaa sacanung hrangpa hnyi vyi.

A hmung tiyta, a caw kha thlaa te, “Vya i sacanung! ina pachung karue de ciy; kama cuota ruvna lepuv a tuepa tana na cuo de. Tahematapakieca kama ta Abyipa'a luo ri tli angte, i biekuo ca la pakhaa khu'a va ang,” a ta.

Ama ta a paa kyihuo khata, “Kama paa, Abyipa'a lie na ri tli pata a cuo kieca, na pakaa taata na ripa haa khata kama cunglie hing tue tie, Abyipamuo na carie tie Ammon ming cunglie phuv caa pala sa tli ta,” a ta.

Cakhutaata a paa kyihuo khata, “Hingpa hmang hing kama cuota na tuepa tie: tluo cung luo si'a angte, a khie'a angte lesaa i cuonapa hing i caa the riypata thla hning chung na pathlie tie, i viesaa zaw hne kama hne,” a ta.
“Si tie,” ta te thla hning chung a pathlie. Caacuonakawta ama hne a viesaa zaw hneta si yi te, lesaa a cuonapa kha ama caa.
Thla hning a chuo khutaata a paa'a luo kha za kaa te, biekuona a tue ciepa haa khata a tue. Ama ca capaa a pachang buo lipa ta a cuo. Caacuonakawta Israel ming chunglie phung ta a li te,
Israel sacanung zaw ta kung kha lie ning paliy ca pya yi te, Gilead ming Jepthah sacanung kha muochie ama sa taw.

Efraim ming ca cehre a cyi pata a pahmya yi te, Zafon luo kha vaa yi te Jepthah kyihuo khata, “Khaapanakawma cavaa va te ung cate Ammon ming a du riypata nama si ning kha niema hne si ra riypata malie nama u ra va? Na ing na maca ruepuo aa!” ama ta.
Jepthah ta iema kyihuo khata, “Kiema khuosa ta malie a tuechiepa Ammon ming hneta aduna ma za hnyi ning kha ca u yi angte iema kuv taata na za khuo va ung ciy.

Na khuo khing va ung ciy tapa kha i hmung tiyta, thiy kie thiy ta angte, Ammon ming a du riypata i si ca Abyipata iema kha i kuv luo ina pi. Khaapanakawma ataning hing kama a du riypata inaa khawchiy ung ciy?” a ta.

Cakhutaata Jepthah ta Gilead ming kha pahmya yi te Efraim ming hne cata amaa tuv ca Gilead ming ta Efraim ming ca ama te; tahematapakieca iema ta, “Niema Gilead ming ca Efraim hne Manasseh phang taata a ruo ung cate phang aa thlie lipa tana nama cuo, ama ta nakawta a cuo.”

Cakhutaata Gilead ming ta Efraim ming kha Jordan tiyhaa lie amaa daakhuo. Efraim ming aa ruopa pakha ta, “Na pate sa thi tie,” a ta tiyta, Gilead ming ta, “Efraim ming ta na cuo ma?” ama ta. Ama ta, “Cuo va ang,” a ta tiyta,

iema ta, “Shibboleth,” ta tie ama ta. A siesa pata ri the li pata “Sibboleth,” a ta. Cakhutaata ama kha patuv yi te Jordan cavaa tiyhaa lie kha ama thie. Capa cuo ning cata Efraim ming thawsawliy thawhning ama thiy.
Jepthah ta Israel ming kha kung caruv bie a ripa yi. Cakhutaata Gilead ming Jepthah ca thiy te, ama khy Gilead lie ama paby.
Ama khutaata Bethlehem khy ming Ibzan ta bie a ripa yi.

Ama ta sacapaa sawthung a hnyi yi. Ama ta a sacanung sawthung kha phang hrangpa luo navaa pahnyi sa yi te, a sacapaa zaw cuota phang hrangpa taata lesaa sawthung a chiyhie yi. Ama ta Israel ming kha kung sariy bie a ripa yi.
Cakhutaata Ibzan ca thiy te, Bethlehem lie ama paby.
Ama khutaata Zebulun ming Elon ta Israel ming kha bie a ripa yi; ama ta Israel ming kha kung hraa bie a ripa yi.
Cakhutaata Zebulun ming Elon ca thiy te Zebulun ruo Aijalon lie ama paby.
Ama khutaata Pirathon khy ming Hillel sacapaa Abdon ta Israel ming kha bie a ripa yi.
Ama ta laa sawsariy a khangpa sacapaa sawliy hne samingta capaa sawthung hnyi yi te, Israel ming kha kung cari bie a ripa yi.
Cakhutaata Pirathon ming Hillel sacapaa Abdon ca thiy te, Amalek ming tluocung ruo chunglie Efraim ruo Pirathon lie kha ama paby.
Israel ming ta Abyipahmungna lie kha a pha lipa kha tue pakhaa hyi yi te, Abyipata Filistin ming kuv chung luo kha kung sawliy a pi yi.
Zorah khy ming pakha, Dan phang ta a cuopa, a ming Manoah ama tapa a aw. A napuvnung ca cing te saata hnyi khu vyi.
Cakhutaata Abyipaavuoming ca cawsaanung'a lie kha a luo te, “Nama ca cing cate, saata na sa li raalaa pata, nu phya'a cate saata na sa aa.
A raaring la, mingsuvtiy hne sahmaa kha dang li pata a pathe lipa suokha hmuo ning'a vaciy,

tahematapakieca nu phya'a cate sacapaa na sa aa. A luv cunglie sephie haa tla'a vyi, tahematapakieca haatiypa ca a puv baataata Khazing cuota Nazir ming tana a cuo aa. Ama ca Israel ming kha Filistin tie kuv chungtaata palaw sa hruo a pathupa ta a cuo aa,” a ta.

Cakhutaata cawsaanung ca a vaw te a navaapa kyihuo khata, “Khazing cawsaapa pakha kama'a luo kha a vaw te, a hmingsuo ca Khazing avuoming na a lu, ciy aa chiysa; khaapa taata ma aa vaw tapa kha hiehriy lipa angta a ming na chang vyi.

Cuorasala kama kyihuo khata, ‘Nu phya'a cate sacapaa pakha na sa aa, caacuonakawta mingsuvtiy acuolikie sahmaa dang'a vaciy, a pathe lipa khaapahmuo ning'a vaciy, tehematapakieca haatiypa ca a puv baataata a thiyna te Khazing cuota Nazir ming tana a cuo aa,’ ina ta,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Manoah ta Abyipakha paakie pakhaa te, “Vya, Abyipa, kiema'a luo na za pathliepa Khazing cawsaapa kha kiema'a luo a vaw pakhaa sala, a puv riypa haatiypa hne aa patuv pata khaapama ma tue aa tapa kha malie pacuv thi se,” a ta.
Khazing ta Manoah bie kha naathlie te, Khazing avuoming ca cawsaanung lu lie aa tuna luo kha aa vaw pakhaa; cuorasala a navaapa Manoah ca ama'a lie kha aw vyi.
Caacuonakawta cawsaanung ca a ruo te a navaapa kha, “Ning hrang ning kama'a luo a vawpa cawsaapa khana a vaw pakhaa,” a ta.
Manoah ca thu te a napuvnung kha ziy te, cawsaapa'a luo ca chiy te, “Hingpa cawsaanung'a lie bie a ripa cawsaapa khata na cuo ma?” a ta. Ama ta, “I cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Manoah ta, “Na ripa a tling tiyta haatiypa hringzya ca tuokhaatama a cuo aa; khaapama a tue aa,” a ta.
Abyipaavuoming ta Manoah kyihuo khata, “Cawsaanung ta ama'a lie i ripa bangkhuo kha a cake mang sue.
Mingsuv kung taata a pyapa khaapahmuo ning'a vyi. Mingsuvtiy hne sahmaa kha dang'a vyi, a pathe lipa khaapahmuo ning'a vyi. Kama ta bie i pipa bangkhuo kha a ziy aa,” a ta.
Manoah ta Abyipaavuoming kyihuo khata, “Maca thlupa hing malie bu thi khah, na cuo tana mietaata ma thie thi aa,” a ta.

Abyipaavuoming ta Manoah kyihuo khata, “Ina thlu biephung zaw ca ma, na sa kha ning'a va ang; cuorasala kama cuota myirue panaana kha naa ting biephung kieca, Abyipakha pihluo tie,” a ta. (Tahematapakieca Manoah ta avuoming a cuopa kha pachang vyi.)
Cakhutaata Manoah ca Abyipaavuoming kyihuo khata, “Na bie kha a tling tiyta pa-uvsathyina maca pi the riypata, na ming ahung ma?” ata.
Cuorasala Abyipaavuoming ta ama kyihuo khata, “Khaapanakawma i ming ina hiehriy ciy? Kharuehaa na a chiy hringhruo,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Manoah ta mietaata hne sa ta panaana kha la te alung cunglie kha Abyipacuota a pihluo, kharuehaa hmang a tuetuv'a luo ca.
Bienatluophie taata myikhuv kha avuo luo a kiethaw tiyta, Monaoh hne a napuvnung ta ama mang nguoluopa khata, Abyipaavuoming ca bienatluophie myihlaa chunglie kha a kie; iema ca alyi lie kha amaa bu.
Abyipaavuoming ca Manoah hne a napuvnung'a lie kha a luo pakhaa va tli. Cakhutaata Manoah ta capa ca Abyipaavuoming a cuopa kha a pachang.
Manoah ta a napuvnung kyihuo khata, “Ma thiy hrahring aa, tahematapakieca Khazing na ma hmung,” a ta.

Cuorasala a napuvnung ta, “Abyipata malie thie khing hmisi sala ca, myirue panaana hne sa ta panaana kha ma kuv chung taa hingta cuhluo'a vyi, acuolikie hingpa hmang bangkhuo hing malie pahmung sa li'a pata hing haapa zaw hing malie chang'a vyi,” a ta.
Cawsaanung ca ta sacapaa sa te, Samson ta pata ming a paphya. Haatiypa ca kya le te Abyipata thluechiy a pi.
Zorah hne Eshtaol alalalie a awpa Mahaneh-dan lie kha Abyipathlaapa ta ama kha pahra hruo aa thu.
Samson ca Timnah khy luo kha sibung te Timnah lie ca Filistin canung pakha a hmung.
Kya kaa te a nung hne a paa kyihuo khata, “Timnah liena Filistin canung pakha i hmung; i napuv riypata na hiepa tie ung,” a ta.

Cuorasala a nung hne a paa ta, “Vangdaw a te lipa Filistin ming chungtaata nung na chiy riypa ca, na tieriy hne ma cawsaa zaw hrawlie canung pakha chuo aw va ma?” ama ta. Cuorasala Samson ta, “Na hiepa thluo tie, i khing hringhruo,” a ta.

A nung hne a paa ta capa ca Abyipa'a taa tana a cuo tapa kha pachang va yi; tahematapakieca Filistin ming a du riypa khana a tue tlarya pata a cuo. Capa cuo ning ca Filistin ming ta Israel ming kha ama uv.
Cakhutaata Samson ca a paa hne a nung hne khata Timnah luo kha ama sibung. Timnah mingsuv diedung luo ama chiypa khata chingde thuthawpa sakha ta aa hrungsue.
Abyipathlaapa kha Samson cunglie a cahrasa pata tlung te, chingde ca mietaata thlaachipa haa khata a thlaachi diy. Cuorasala a tuepa kha a nung hne a paa chang va yi.
Cakhutaata cawsaanung'a luo kha zuv te, bie rihne te cawsaanung ca ta a khing.
Cuo pachangta khutaata Samson ca capa nung ca chiyhie riypata si pakhaa te, chingde riyy kha mang riypata a pie paa ca chingde pangpa chunglie ca khyi a zaa bawpa kha a hmung.

Khyisaluv ca a kuv ta la te a cakuopuole pata a ningle. A nung hne a paa kha pha yi te a cawta law pibuo yi te ama ning ra. Cuorasala khyitiy ca chingde riyy chungtaata a lapa na a cuo tapa kha chang va yi.
A paa ca cawsaanung'a luo kha zuv te, mingnu tie ta ama tue tawpa haa khata Samson ta pyi suokha a tue.
Cawsaa ta ama hmung tiyta ama hne a khe riypata viesaa sawthung kha amaa vawkhyi.

Samson ta iema kyihuo khata, “Bienupa na ica hiehriy'a yi. Hingpa bie ta a ri khingna kha ning sariy chunglie ina chang khu kie ungca ca kama ta niema kha cawthang phapa pang zung sawthung hne pyi lie a hryipa buohryi zung sawthung ica pi'a yi,” a ta.

Cuorasala ina chang khu li kie ungca ca niema ta cawthang phapa pang zung sawthung hne pyi lie a hryipa buohryi zung sawthung ina pi'a ung ciy,” a ta yi. Caacuonakawta iema ta ama kyihuo khata, “Na bienupa ca malie hiehriy tie, naathlie pachiy'a puv,” ama ta.

Ama ta iema kyihuo khata, “A ningtuv chungtaata ning riypa a pya. A thaaruvsapa chungtaata a thlungpa a pya,” a ta. Cuorasala ning thung chunglie kha iema ta capa bienupa a ri khingnapa kha chang khu va yi.

A ning paliyna lie kha iema ta Samson napuvnung kyihuo khata, “Bienupa ta a ri khingna kha malie a chang riypata na navaapa kha ripasa tie, ca lipa kieca nama hne na paa ing hne kha tana myi ta maca ruepuo'a yi. Kiema kha siypasa pata aw naase yi ta pata ma hingpa luo hing malie na hry,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Samson napuvnung ca a hmiekunglie kha caa te, “Ina hue ciy; na due hmisi vaciy. I cawsaa zaw kha bienupa hiehriy yi cate, a ri khingna kha na chang vaciy,” a ta.
Ama pyi chung, ning sariy chung kha a hmiekunglie caa te, a hiehriy byalya nakawta, a ning sariyna lie kha a chang. Cakhutaata capa nung ca ta bienupa a ri khingna kha a cawsaa zaw ca a chang yi.

Capa khy ming ca ta a ning sariynapa ning a tla hluo khata, Khaapama khyitiy laata a thlung vie? Khaapama chingde laata a thaa a ruv vie?” ama ta. Cakhutaata ama ta, I cuelaanung hingta le na thawna li pata aw ung la, I bienupa a ri khingna hing pachang khu'a va ung ciy,” a ta yi.

Cakhutaata Abyipathlaapa kha a cunglie khuosa ta tlung te, Ashkelon luo a si. Khy ming sawthung kha thie yi te, ama cawsie kha chuv yi te, bienupa a ri khingna a changpa tie ca pang kha a pi yi. A hi haasa pata a paa ing luo kha a kaa.
Cakhutaata Samson napuvnung ca a viesaapa, chiyhiena lie a daakhyipa paa kha ama pi.

Cuo pachangta khutaata, Jungsacuo uo cuo ning kha Samson ca a napuvnung parie riypata si te mietaata kha a phyapale. Ama ta, “I napuvnung khuo chung luo na i ngie khing,” a ta. Cuorasala a paa ta pangie sa khing vyi.
A paa cata, “Ama ca na hue hrahring tapa tana i rue; caacuonakaw muo na viesaapa i pi ta,” a ta. A nutanung hing ama laata a puvthe vie cuo va ma? Ama hing naa la hriy thi va?” a ta.
Samson ta iema kyihuo khata, “Ata cuo lie hing, Filistin ming cunglie hmang chiepa i tue zawta sue pacupa cuo'a va ang,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Samson ca cakuo te, cahnie zathung kha a patuv khutaata ama lahmyi kha cakhiy te, myisaa taw kha la te, ama lahmyi suohning alalalie kha a ciypuo.
Myisaa taw tie kha myi vuo te, cahnie kha Filistin ming sa kung aa daapa chung luo kha a pathlie ca suopie hne aa daapa sa kung, hne mingsuv diedung hne olif diedung zaw kha a kuo diy.

Cakhutaata Filistin ming ta, “Hingpa hing ahungma a tue?” ama ta. Iema ta, “Timnah khypa paa, a tuvpaapa Samson na a tue, tahematapakieca ama ta Samson napuvnung kha la te a viesaapa a pi,” ama ta. Caacuonakawta Filistin ming kha a vaw yi te capa cawsaanung hne a paa hne khata myi ta ama rue.
Samson ta iema kyihuo khata, “Niema na hingpa hing a tue ung ciy ta pata a cuo kieca, niema cunglie phuv i la hluo li, taw'a va ang,” a ta yi.
Iema kha khuosa ta a du yi te a hluvsa a thie yi; cakhutaata sibung te Etam alung karaw chunglie kha a aw.
Cakhutaata Filistin ming ca sithaw yi te Judah lie kha a ri yi te, Lehi kha ama ching.
Judah cawsaa tie ta, “Khaapanakawma a khaw ung cate malie namaa du?” ama ta. Iema ta, “Samson ta malie a tuepa haata ama cunglie tue riypa hne ama kha ciypaki riypa tana maa khaw,” ama ta.

Cakhutaata Judah ming thaw thung ca Etam alung karaw luo ca sibung yi te, Samson kyihuo khata, “Filistin ming ca malie a uvpa ta ama cuopa kha pachang va ca ma? Kiema cunglie hing khaapama na tue?” ama ta. Ama ta, “Iema ta kama cunglie ama tuepa haa tana iema cunglie kha i tue ra,” a ta.
Iema ta, “Filistin ming kuv chung luo maca pi the riypata, nama kha ciypaki riypa tana maa zuv,” ama ta. Samson ta iema kha, “Niema ta na thie'a va ung ciy, tapa kha bie naa kuo tie ung,” a ta yi.
Iema ta, “Ca thie'a vapuv; nama kha ciypaki pata iema kuv luo pi riypa dyina a cuo,” ama ta. Caacuonakawta ama kha khuhriy thaapa suohning ta ciypaki yi te, alung taa cata ama kya pyakhyi.

Lehi luo a kya pha tiyta, Filistin ming ca vya khile yi te ama kha amaa vya taw; cakhutaata Abyipathlaapa ca a cunglie a cahrasa pata tlung te, a buo ama ciynapa khuhriy ca myi ta a kuopa hmiekhuv riy haata cipachung diy te a kuv taa khata a tla.
Cakhutaata ama ta laa hrakuo ruv thaapa kha hmung te, va paza te a la, capa ca ta cawsaa thawkha a thie yi.
Cakhutaata Samson ta, Laa hrakuo ruv tana, apung apung ta, laa hrakuo ruv tana, cawsaa thawkha i thie yi,” a ta.
A bieri a patlung tiyta, laa hrakuo kha pazu te, capa hmang ca Ramath-lehi ta pata kupa a cuo.

Capa khutaa cata a tiy hrie laalaw te, Abyipakha ku te, “Nama na hingpa tena lepuv hing na siicapaapa kuv ta naa pi ciy, ata hing tiyhrie pata thiy'a angte ma vangdaw te lipa tie kuv luo hing i tla aa?” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Khazing ta Lehi lie a karawnapa hmang kha papachi te capa taa cata tiy kha a pya. Tiy kha a dang taata a thlaapa kha vya kaa te a cahra pakhaa. Caacuonakawta capa hmang ca En-hakkore ta pata kupa cuo te ataning tepa hingta Lehi lie a aw.
Cakhutaata ama ta Filistin tie chuo chunglie kha Israel ming ca kung kiy chung bie a ripa yi.
Luo kha ca Samson kha Gaza luo si te, capa lie ca siyhrawnung kha hmung te aa ziekhyi.

Gaza ming ta, “Samson na hingpa luo hing a vaw,” amaa ta. Caacuonakawta cadung yi te, khypuv hukaa thlake taa khata zuokhydyi ama bya. Zuokhydyi a dieta tah aw yi te, “Mawdiy khydyi te ta huo'a pate ma thie aa,” ta pata ama rue.

Cuorasala Samson ca zuocang te dyi aa zie. Cakhutaata zuocang cata thu te, khypuv thlake ca a tung tung hning hne khata phie te, a letung luo kha khang te Hebron hmielie a awpa tluodaw luo kha a kiekhyi.
Cakhutaa cata Sorek bawphie lie a awpa, Delilah ama tapa nung kha a khing.

Filistin byi tie kha capa nung'a luo ca a vaw yi te, “Kiema ta ama kha hri'a pate ma ciypaki khu riypata, ama kha ripasa la khaapa hing ma hingpa tluv hingta a thaa a paruv sa tapa kha pachang a zue tie, kiema pakha cyicuo hingta ngu tuokaa thawkha zakha law maca pi aa,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Delilah ta Samson kyihuo khata, “Khaapama hingpa tluv hingta na thaa caa paruv sa tapa hne tuokhaata ca ciypaki'a yi te ma aca te khu'a yi tapa kha na chang thi tie,” a ta.
Samson ta ama kyihuo khata, “A caa li liepa liyriy thaapa suosariy ta ina ciy kie yi ca i thaa caw'a te cawsaa hrangpa haa tana i cuo thluo aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Filistin byi tie ta liyriy a thaapa suosariy vya cyipa yi te capa ca ta a ciy.

Cawsaa tie ta a ziena khuo chungtaata ama bya nguoluo ning kha ama ta, “Filistin ming na caa vawchiy yi, Samson! a ta. Cuorasala ama ta liyriy ca hmiekhuv riy myi ta kuo te a cipachung diypa haa khata a chi pachung diy. Caacuonakawta a thaaruvnapa bieparuv ca pachang khu va yi.
Cakhutaata Delilah ta Samson kyihuo khata, “Na tue hyalya cate na ina dung ciy; tuokhaatama aca ciypakang khu'a yi tapa kha na chang thi tie,” a ta.
Ama ta, “Khuhriycamaa a thaapa hmuo buo li liepa tie ta ina ciy kie yi ca i thaa caw'a te cawsaa hrangpa haa tana i cuo thluo aa,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Delilah ta khuhriycamaa a thaapa tie kha la te a ciy, cakhutaata ama kyihuo khata, “Filistin ming na caa vawchiy yi, Samson!” a ta. (Ama a byapa cawsaa tie ca aziena khuo chunglie kha ama aw.) Cuorasala a kuv ama ciynapa khuhriycamaa ca palaa riy haa khata a chipachung diy.

Cakhutaata Delilah ta Samson kyihuo khata, “Ata tepa hingta nama ca na tue hyalya cate ina dung ciy; tuokhaatama aca ciypakang khu'a yi tapa kha na chang tie,” a ta. Ama ta, “I luv lie i suo phiepa phie sariy hing the lie taapuo la thephie ta khuosa ta na chypuo kieca i thaa caw'a te cawsaa hrangpa haa tana i cuo thluo aa,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta aa hmung chung khata, a suo phiepa phie sariy kha the ta taapuo te, thephie ta khuosa ta a chypuo. Cakhutaata ama ta, “Filistin ming na caa vawchiy yi, Samson! a ta. Cuorasala aa hmungna taata a kya hra te, thephie hne thetluo hne the hneta a thukhyi diy.

Cakhutaa Delilah ta, “Tuokhaatama na pathiy na palung kama'a lie a aw tlung li pata, “Ica due,” ina ta the ciy? Yi thung te na tue hyalya cate ina dung tli ciy, khaapama hingpa tluv hingta na thaa caa paruv sa tapa kha na chang vaciy,” a ta.
Capa nung ca ta ning kha hnang ning kha hiehriy byalya te nangre pata a tue nakawta a thiy'a nangna te ta a palung rie a thyi.

Caacuonakawta capa nung kyihuo cata a bieparuv bangkhuo kha a chang. “I luv lie hing sephie tla buo vyi; tahematapakieca kama ca i nung riy chunglie i aw baataata Khazing cuota Nazir ming tana i cuo. I luv hing na ina ngu yi tapa kieca, i thaazuo hingta na pyase'a te, i thaa hing caw'a te cawsaa hrangpa haa hing tana i cuo thluo aa,” a ta.

A bieparuv bangkhuo na ina chang tapa kha Delilah ta a pasie tiyta, cawsaa kha pathlie yi te Filistin byi tie kha a paku sa yi; iema kyihuo khata, “Ata yi kha hing ca a khaw kalie tie ung, tahematapakieca a bieparuv kha ina chang diy tli,” a ta yi. Cakhutaata Filistin byi tie ca ama'a luo kha a khaw yi te, ama kuv lie kha tuokaa amaa kya cakele.
Capa nung ca ta a baw cunglie kha pahmung te, cawsaa pakha kha ku te, a luv lie a suo phiepa phie sariy kha a pangu sa. A tha cawle te, a thaa ta ama kha a pyase.

Cakhutaata ama ta, “Filistin ming na caa vawchiy yi, Samson!” a ta. Aa hmungnapa taata a kya hra te, “Yi hrang ning haa khata pya'a angte kama hne kama kha a palaw sa'a ang,” a ta. Cuorasala Abyipata a pyase tlipa kha a pachang vyi.
Caacuonakawta Filistin ming ta patuv yi te a ming kha ama cakhyi. Gaza luo kha sikhyi bung yi te, daa riy ta cakhiy yi te ama hre; thaw-ing chunglie kha sa rienapa alung ta sa ama parie sa.
Cuorasala a luv lie a suo ca ama ngu khutaa khata kya syi hruo a pathu pakhaa.
Filistin byi tie ca ama khazing Dagon kha hriykhungrina lepuv pihluo riypata hne a nuo riypata amaa hmya; tahematapakieca iema ta, “Ma khazing na ma cariepa Samson ca ma kuv luo malie a pi,” ama ta.
Cawsaa zaw ta ama kha ama hmung tiyta, ama khazing kha pathuosa yi te, “Ma khazing na ma ruo a paratuv hne kiema a hluvsa malie a thietuv ma cariepa kha ma kuv luo malie a pi,” ama ta.

Cakhutaata ama palung kha a vya tluo ciemuo tiyta, “Samson kha ku ung la ma palungtluona riypata kya cang se,” ama ta. Caacuonakawta Samson kha thaw-ing taata papya yi te, iema palungtluona riypata a cang. Ama ca atung zaw alalalie padaa yi te,
a kuv ta a patuvpa paa kyihuo khata, “Ing tung hing i hy thena riypata i kuv ta na pahrie sa thi tie,” a ta.
Ing ca canung hne capaa hneta ama bi; Filistin byi bangkhuo ca capa lie ca ama aw diy, cakhutaata thlungkhuv cung a duo lie kha Samson a cangpa a mangpa canung capaa ta thaw thung tluv ama aw.

Cakhutaata Samson ta Abyipakha ku te, “AbyipaKhazing ata yi kha hing naa thyi la thaa na patlung tie, Vya Khazing, tahematapakieca i ming suohning cuo hing tana Filistin ming hing hingpa phuvlana suokha hingta i thung khing yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata capa ing a patuv cepa a lie khingkhuo tung tung hning kha Samson ta a cacuoluo ta tung kha, a cavyiluo ta tung kha ta pata a cusa pata patuv te aa kyi.

Cakhutaata Samson ta, “Filistin ming hne hingta thiy ang se!” a ta khutaata a thaa a aw zawdya ta pachiy te aa kyi ca, ing ca a chunglie a awpa byi tie bangkhuo hne cawsaa zaw cunglie ca a za cing. Caacuonakawta a thiypuo pata a thiepa cawsaa ca a hring ningta a thiepa tie laa khata ama hluv vie.

Cakhutaata a uvnu tie hne a ingchungkhue tie kha a zuv yi te, la yi te kya sikhyi yi te, Zorah hne Eshtaol alalalie a awpa a paa Manoah thluo lie kha ama paby. Ama ta Israel ming kha kung kiy chung bie a ripa yi.
Efraim tluocung ruo lie Mikah ama tapa cawsaa pakha a za aw.

Ama ta a nung kyihuo khata, “Ngu tuokaa thawkha zakha aca paruvpa ning yi ta, capa kawlieta i thyi pata chie na sapa yi kha, khapa ngu kha kama'a liena a aw; kama na a la ang; cuorasala ica pi pakhaa aa,” a ta. Cakhutaata a nung ta, “I sacapaa hing Abyipata thluechiy ca pi se!” a ta.
Cakhutaata ama ta a nung kha ngu tuokaa thawkha zakha kha a pi pakhaa. A nung ta, “Kama na ngu ta patlepa kuvtuezuv tuena riypata i sacapaa cuota ngu tuokaa hing Abyipa'a luo a pihluo ang,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta a nung'a luo tuokaa a pi pakhaa tiyta, a nung ta ngu tuokaa zahning kha la te, ngu a patle thepa kha a pi, ama ta capa ca ta kuvtuezuv kha patle te, capa ca Mikah ing lie kha a aw.
Capa cawsaapa Mikah ca abiena hmang suokha hnyi te, tluobyi buohryi suokha hne kuvtuezuvtaata kha sa te, a sacapaa zaw chungtaata pakha kha a tluobyi ta a tue.
Capa cuo lie ca Israel ming chunglie siepahruo aw vyi; cawsaa bangkhuo ta iema ming hmungna lie a pha ama tapa kha ama tue.
Judah ruo chung Bethlehem lie kha Judah chung a cuopa satlie pakha a aw. Ama ca capa lie khy a sapa Levi ming pakha ta a cuo.
Capa cawsaapa ca awna a hmungnapa lie aw riypata Judah ruo Bethlehem khy kha a pyase. Khy tlaw pazue riypata a silepa khata Efraim tluocung ruo lie a awpa Mikah ing luo kha a chiy.

Mikah ta ama kyihuo khata, “Khaapa taata ma na vya chiy?” a ta. Ama ta palie te, “Kama ca Judah ruo Bethlehem lie a awpa Levi ming tana i cuo, awna riypata i hmung khunapa hmang khaapa lie a cuo zaw i aw aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Mikah ta, “Kama'a lie hing aw la, i paa hne i tluobyi ta cuo tie, kung kha ta ngu tuokaa phie hraa ca pi'a angte, cawsie hne sa zaw ica ring aa,” a ta.
Levi ming ca cawsaapa hneta aw riypa kha a palung a tling; cahaacata satliepa ca a sacapaa zaw hrawlie pakha haata a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Mikah ta Levi ming ca pathe sa te, satliepa ca a tluobyi ta cuo te Mikah ing lie kha a aw.
Cakhutaata Mikah ta, “Ata hing ca Levi ming kha tluobyi ta i hnyi nakawta Abyipata kama kha ina pahnyiparung sa aa tapa i pachang,” a ta.

Capa cuo ning ca Israel ming chunglie siepahruo aw vyi. Capa cuo ning cata Dan mingphang tie ca ama cu riypa ruo kha ama huv nguoluo; tahematapakieca capa te cata Israel mingphang chunglieta ama cu riypa ruo kha iema kha re pata cuo valie yi.

Caacuonakawta Dan ming ta iema chung bangkhuo taata, Zorah hne Eshtaol chung taa khata a riephapa cawsaa papangaa kha ruo a ngiepatlie riypata pathlie yi te, “Si ung la ruo kha a kya ngiepatlie tie ung,” ama ta. Cakhutaata Efraim tluocung ruo lie Mikah ing luo kha chiy yi te capa lie ca ama aw.
Mikah ing lie ama aw ningta Levi satliepa ueryi kha ama pachang nakawta, “Ahungma hingpa luo hing caa chiy? Hingpa hmang lie hing khaapama na tue? Hingpa lie hing khaapa re ma na hrie?” ama ta.
Ama ta iema kyihuo khata, “Mikah na kama cuota ca haa kha haa khata i cuota a tue, naa hluo te, a tluobyi ta i cuo,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata iema ta ama kyihuo khata, “Ma hrie nguoluopa ma re lie hing ma hlue a tling'a ma tling'a va ma tapa kha Khazing'a luo malie hiehriypa tie,” ama ta.
Tluobyi ta palie yi te, “Diena hneta si tie ung. Nama hrie nguoluopa re hing Abyipamangchiyna liena a aw,” a ta.

Cawsaa papangaa tie ca si yi te Laish luo ama pha tiyta, capa lie a awpa cawsaa tie ca Sidon ming khysa awzya haa khata palung hringna hnyi li pata hnaanguosa pata aw yi te, chuelyi chechiy khaapahmuo amaa hu amaa bupa aw li pata, hnyirungsa yi te aa bangsusa pata ama awpa kha ama hmung. Ca hlyitaw taata, Sidon ming hneta a hla yi te Aram ming hne a pazuena hnyi va yi.
Iema ca Zorah hne Eshtaol lie ama tieriy'a luo kha ama chiy tiyta, iema ta, “Khaapama malie nama pathyi sa aa?” ama ta.

Iema ta, “A vaw ung la iema a du riypata sithaw'a ung puv; tahematapakieca ruo kha hmung pate a pha hringhruo. Khaapahmuo tue'a va ung ca ma? Si riypata haasaa khah ung, ruo chung luo kha a kya ngie ung la kya cu tie ung.

Nama si tiyta, palung hringna a hnyi lipa cawsaa tie'a luo kha nama chiy aa. Ruo ca a ku, Khazing ta chuelyi cunglie aa hu aa bupa khaapahmuo a aw linapa ruo ca nama kuv chung luo aca pi hrahring tli yi,” ama ta.
Dan ming chungtaata capaa zacaruv, rietuvna cehre hneta Zorah hne Eshtaol taa khata a tha yi te,
sithaw yi te Judah ruo Kiriath-jearim lie kha amaa ri. Capa nakaw ca ta capa hmang ca ataning tepa hingta Mahaneh-dan ta pata ku pata a cuo; capa ca Kiriath-jearim ningtlaluo kuo tana a aw.
Capa taa cata Efraim tluocung ruo kha cahraw yi te Mikah ing luo kha ama chiy.

Cakhutaata ruo a ngiepatlie riypata a sipa cawsaa papangaa tie khata ama uvnu tie kyihuo khata, “Hingpa ing zaw chunglie hing tluobyi buohryi, kuvtuezuvtaata, hne patlepa kuvtuezuv a awpa kha nama pachang ma? Caacuonakawta khaapama ma tue aa tapa kha rue tie ung,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta capa luo, Levi satliepa a awnapa, Mikah ing luo ca cakuo yi te, ama ca bie amaa chang.
Dan ming rietuvnapa cehre a cyipa zacaruv tie thlake lie amaa daa ning kha,

ruo a ngiepatlie riypata a sipa cawsaa papangaa ca a ngie yi te, patlepa kuvtuezuv, tluobyi buohryi, hne kuvtuezuvtaata tie kha ama la. Tluobyi ca rietuvnapa cehre a cyipa cawsaa zacaruv tie hne khata thlake athaalie kha a daa.
Cawsaa tie ta Mikah ing chung luo kha a ngie yi te, patlepa kuvtuezuv, tluobyi buohryi, hne kuvtuezuvtaata kha ama la tiyta, tluobyi ca ta, “Khaapama nama tue?” a ta yi.

Iema ta, “A dieta tah aw thluo! Na pakaa kha na kuvpazaa ta a cahuv la, kiema'a luo hing a vaw la ma paa hne ma tluobyi ta cuo tie. Nama cuo hingta pakha ingchungkhue cuota tluobyi cuopa ma a pha vie, acuolikie Israel ming phang chunglie tluobyi cuopa ma a pha vie?” ama ta.
Cakhutaata ama ripa ca tluobyi ta a cuhluo. Ama ta tluobyi buohryi, kuvtuezuvtaata, hne kuvtuezuv kha la te cawsaa tie hne khata a si.
Caacuonakawta ama luopuv luo kha a pali yi te, haatiy, sahring, hne chechiy kha hmaa pasa yi te ama si.
Mikah ing taata aa hlapuona te ama chiy tlipa khata, Mikah ing athaalie a awpa, ing lie a awpa cawsaa tie khata a u yi te Dan ming ca ama vya pha.
Dan ming kha ama vya u ca, iema ta a palichiy yi te Mikah kyihuo khata, “Hing haapa cawsaa phuv hne malie naa vya cadepa hing khaapanakawma a cuo?” ama ta.
Ama ta palie yi te, “Niema ta i tuepa i khazing tie, hne i tluobyi kha la ung cate nama si, khaapama i hnyi tli? Tuokhaatama, “Khaapanakawma,” ina ta the ung ciy?” a ta yi.

Cakhutaata Dan ming ta ama kyihuo khata, “Na ryi maca thyi li pata na a pha vie aa, caacuolikieca a pathiy pachangpa tie ta ca naw tlamu'a yi te na na hringna hne na ingchungkhue hringna kha namaa sung pathlyi aa,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Dan ming ca ama si. Mikah ta iema ca ama cuota ama cahra tuv tapa kha a hmung tiyta, a pali te a ing luo kha a kaa.

Dan ming ta Mikah ta a tuepa chechiy hne a huopa ta a cuopa tluobyi kha la yi te, Laish luo, hnaanguosa pata hne palung hringna hnyi li pata a awpa cawsaa tie'a luo kha chiy yi te, iema kha zueziy ta thie yi te, khypuv kha myi ta ama rue.

Sidon taata aa hla nakawta hne ahung hneta hmuo a pazuena ama hnyi li nakawta pachatuv hne byatuv ahunghmuo aw va yi. Capa ca Beth-rehob huopa ta a cuopa bawphie chunglie khana a aw. Iema ta khypuv kha sa pathiy yi te a chunglie kha ama aw.
Iema ta capa khypuv ca Israel pathla ama mingpa Dan ming la pata Dan ta pata ming ama sa; cuorasala a hluota ca capa khypuv ming ca Laish ta pata a cuo.
Cakhutaata Dan ming ta kuvtuezuv kha iema cuota ama bang. Moses sacapaa Gershom sacapaa Jonathan hne a sacapaa zaw ca ruo kha siicuona luo a tlana te ta Dan mingphang cuota tluobyi ta ama cuo.
Caacuonakawta Mikah ta a tuepa kuvtuezuv ca Shiloh lie Khazing ing a aw chung bangkhuo ta iema huota a aw.
Capa cuo lie ca, Israel chungtaata siepahruo ama aw li ningta, Efraim tluocung ruo ruo cakiy lie kha Levi ming pakha aw te, Judah ruo Bethlehem taa khata nungthang pakha a la.
Cuorasala a nungthangnung ca ta ama cunglie kha a hi haa te, ama'a taata pya te, Judah ruo Bethlehem lie a paa ing luo kha si te, thla paliy hraw a aw.

Cakhutaata a navaapa ta ama kha bienepa ta chaw riypa hne a chiyle pakhaa riypata a tha te a si ra. A changtaapa pakha hne laa sahning aa chiyle. A paa ing luo kha a chiy tiyta, lesaanung a paa ta hmung te palung tluosa pata a daw.
A puvpa, lesaanung a paa ta a pahy riypata a chang nakawta ning thung aa pahy. Cahaacata ning dang yi te capa lie ca a aw.

A ning paliyna lie ca mawdiy ta thu yi te, si riypata aa pachie; cuorasala lesaanung a paa ta a tuvpaapa kyihuo khata, “Sa a cawta ning siy tie ung, nama nang diyle'a kie, cakhutaa cata si lavuo ung ciy,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta ama pahning ta a tu pakhaw yi te ama ning ama dang pakhaw; cakhutaata lesaanung a paa ta cawsaapa kyihuo khata, “Ata zuo ca a ri la aa nuosa pata aw tie?” a ta.
Cawsaapa ca si riypata aa pachie tiyta, a puvpa ca ta zuo kha chuo a ri caw riypata a thlu.
A ning pangaana lie ca si riypata mawdiy ta a thu; lesaanung a paa ta, “Sa a cawta ning siy tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta ama pahning ta ning aa maana te khata ama ning ama dang pakhaw.

Cawsaapa hne a nungthangnung hne a changtaapa ca si riypata amaa pachie tiyta, a puvpa, lesaanung paa ca ta, “Mang tie, ning a maa te zuoluo ta a cuo tli hing, a ri caw tie, ning a tla'a nang tli hing, a ri caw la hingpa lie hing aa nuosa pata aw tie, mawluo mawdiy ta thu'a cate si lavuo ciy,” a ta.

Cuorasala cawsaapa ca ta zuo a ri riypa ca khing li tli pata, thu te a si, Jebus (Jerusalem ama tapa) a rie-e luo kha a chiy. A kedie padiepa laa sahning hneta cuo te, a nungthangnung zaw ca ama'a lie a aw.
Jebus athaa luo ama chiypa khata ning a tla'a nang tli nakawta a changtaapa khata a byipaapa kyihuo khata, “A vaw tie, Jebus ming khypuv luo hing va pie ung sala vaa ri ung siy,” a ta.
Cuorasala a byipaapa ta, “Israel ming khypuv ta a cuo lipa, mingphang hrangpa tie khy luo a ngie riypata ca pie'a vapuv; cuorasala Gibeah luona ma caluo'a ung,” a ta.
Cakhutaata a changtaapa kyihuo khata, “A vaw tie, hingpa hmang zaw lie hingta suokhakha hing va pangie ung siy, Gibeah acuolikie Ramah liena maa ri'a ung,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta caluo yi te Benjamin huopa ta a cuopa Gibeah athaalie ama chiy pata ning ta a tlapuo pache yi.
Gibeah luo a ngie pata a ri riypata capa taa cata ama pie. Khy luo ca a ngie te khypuv ahmyana hmang lie kha aa tu, cuorasala zuo a ri riypata ahungtahmuo ama ing chung luo a ngie riypata hry va yi.

Cakhutaata zuo a zing baaning'a nangpa khata macuopa pakha kha lu lie a rehriena taata a vya chiy. Capa paa ca Efraim tluocung ruo taata cuo te Gibeah lie khy a sapa ta a cuo. (Capa lie a awpa cawsaa tie ca Benjamin mingphang tie ta ama cuo.)
Macuopa ca ta khy a tlawpa khypuv ahmyana hmang lie aa tupa kha a hmung tiyta, “Khaapa luo ma na si aa? Khaapa taata ma naa vaw?” a ta.

Ama ta, “Judah ruo Bethlehem taata na ma vya caluo, Efraim tluocung ruo khyta luo na ma si aa. Judah ruo Bethlehem khy luo va tlaw siy angte na i ing luo i si aa. Ing chungluo a ngie riypata naa hrypa aw va yi.

Kiema na changtaapa zaw hingta ma laa zaw cuota sacuokung hne a phuv caapa hnyi pate, kama hne cawsaanung hne kiema hne a awpa satliepa cuo hingta viechuo hne mingsuvtiy ma hnyi. Maa hu viepa aw va tli,” a ta.
Macuopa ca ta, “Nama cunglie thlaalungna aw mang sue. Namaa hupa bangkhuo ca kama na caa tuepa'a yi ang, khypuv ahmyana hmang lie hing ca a ri'a va ung ciy,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta ama ta a ing luo a chiyle yi te, laa zaw kha sa a pi yi; iema ca ama phyi kha a siy yi te, cakhutaata ama ning ama dang.

Iema ca aa nuosa pata ama aw ning kha, khypuv chunglie a laliy lipa cawsaa tie khata, ing kha cadung yi te, ingchiypakaa kha ama phawpuo. Macuopa kyihuo khata, “Na ing luo a ngiepa paa kha maa ziehne the riypata kya papya tie,” ama ta.

Cakhutaata cawsaapa, ing a hnyipa paa ca ta pya te iema kyihuo khata, “Cuo vyi, i uvnu zaw, a pha li hringhruo pata aw khah ung. Hingpa cawsaapa hing i khyche a cuo tli nakawta, hing hmang pha lipa hing tue thi khah ung.

Hingpa lie hing capaa a pachang buo li liepa i sacanung hne a nungthangnung ama aw; iema hingna i kya pyakhyi'a yi. Iema hing suekhyi ung la nama khingna haata tue tie ung, cuorasala hingpa cawsaapa cunglie hing ca hmang pha lipa kha tue khah ung,” a ta yi.

Cuorasala cawsaa tie ca ta ama kha naathlie va yi. Caacuonakawta cawsaapa ca ta a nungthangnung kha patuv te iema'a luo a kya chi. Iema ta hruohra ta a ziehne yi te, zuo khydyi hne mawdiy te khata ama khing ta ama tue. Khy a kya dyi taata ama pathlie.
Maw khy a dyi taata cawsaanung ca a vaw te, a byipaapa a awnapa cawsaapa ingchiypakaa lie kha khy a dyina te ta aa lie thluo.
A byipaapa ca maw ta kya thu te, ingchiypakaa kha pahaw te khy tlaw pazue riypata a pya ca ing chiypakaa lie chiypakaa tluo aa patuv pata a nungthangnung a laa thluopa kha a hmung.
Ama ta, “Thu tie, si'a ung puv,” a ta. Cuorasala palie vyi. Cakhutaata ama kha laa cungluo khang te, cawsaapa ca a ing luo kha a si.
A ing luo a pha tiyta, cizung kha a la te, a nungthangnung ca a kuv, a phyi ta pata che hraa hlyihning ta ca-uo te, Israel ruo bangkhuo khata a paphya.

Cakhutaata a pathliepa paa kha bie pi te, “Israel ming bangkhuo kha hing haa hingta na chang'a yi, ‘Israel ming Izipt ruo taata ama kya pya baataata ataning tepa hingta hing haapa hmang hing a puv buo ma? Hingpa hing rue tie ung, a rue pakhaw ung la, a kaw ri tie ung,’ na ta aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Israel ming bangkhuo ca Dan taata Beer-sheba te, Gilead zaw aa te ra pata, cawsaazaapuv ca Abyipahmiekunglie, Mizpah lie kha suv kha ta amaa hmya.
Israel mingphang bangkhuo taata byi tie kha Khazing cawsaa tie hmiekung luo ca pya yi te, cehre a cyipa rieka thaw za paliy ama ta.
(Israel ming na Mizpah luo a sithaw yi tapa kha Benjamin ming ta ama thyi.) Cakhutaata Israel ming ta, “Tuokhaatama hingpa pha lina hing a pya tapa kha malie chang tie,” ama ta.
Ama thiepa cawsaanung navaapa, Levi ming ca ta, “Benjamin ming huopa ta a cuopa Gibeah luo kha, capa lie ca a ri riypata kama hne i nungthangnung hneta ma chiy.
Gibeah ming ta zuo ta na vya pyahnue yi te ing kha ama cadung. Kama kha thie naa nang yi te, i nungthangnung kha a thiyna te ta hruohra ta amaa ziehne.
Cakhutaata i nungthangnung kha la angte, ca-uo angte Israel ruo chung bangkhuo khata i paphya.
Caacuonakawta ata hing niema Israel ming nama bangkhuo ta hingpa lie hing nama ruenapa pachiy ung la a rue pakhaw tie ung,” a ta yi.
Cawsaa bangkhuo ca cawsaa pakha haa khata a daa yi te, “Kiema pakha hinghmuo ma thluodaa luo cakuo'a vapuv, ma ing luo zaw kaa ra'a vapuv.
Cuorasala Gibeah cunglie ma tue riypa ca hingpa hing tana a cuo: vyisung a da'a pate na, khawchiy'a pate maa kya du aa.

Israel mingphang chung bangkhuo taata cawsaa zakha lie pahraa, thawkha lie zakha, thawhraa lie thawkha kha si'a pate, Benjamin huopa ta a cuopa Gibeah ta Israel cunglie a tuepa bangkhuo cuota phuv a la riypa rieka tie cuo khata sa phyatuv hne pituv ta ma cuo aa,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Israel ming bangkhuo ca palung a lusa pata capa khy a du riypa cata amaa hmya.
Israel mingphang tie ta Benjamin phang tie bangkhuo'a luo kha cawsaa pathlie yi te, “Niema hrawlie a puvpa hingpa pha lina hing tuokhaapa tama a cuo?

Cakhutaata, ata hingta Gibeah lieta cawsaa chiepa, cawsaa laliy lipa tie kha ma kuv chung luo malie pi tie ung, thie'a yi pate Israel chungtaata pha lina ma pathe sa the riypata,” ama ta. Cuorasala Benjamin ming ta ama tieriy ta a cuopa Israel ming bie kha naathlie va yi.
Benjamin ming ca Israel ming a du riypata Gibeah lie khy zaw chung taa cata ama pya.
Capa ning lieta, Gibeah lie a awpa tie ripuo li pata, Benjamin ming ta ama khy zaw taata ama pakiypa rietuvna cehre a cyipa cawsaa ca thawkiy thawcaruv ta ama cuo.
Hingpa rieka tie chung taa hingta a cavyipa ta a cuopa, suobuv suokha hmuo hla li pata cisie a sie thepa, a tlaw pa-ipa cawsaa zasariy ama aw.
Cakhutaata Israel ming ca, Benjamin ripuo li pata, cehre a cyipa cawsaa thaw zapaliy ta yi te, ama bangkhuo ta rietuv a thepa ta ama cuo.

Israel ming ca Bethel luo kha sithaw yi te, capa lie ca Khazing kha bie ama hiehriy, “Benjamin ming a du riypata kiema hrawlie ahung hing ma a sithaw taa'a puv? ama ta. Cakhutaata Abyipata, “Judah na a sithaw taa aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Israel ming ca maw ta sithaw yi te Gibeah khy kielie kha amaa ri.
Israel ming ca Benjamin a du riypa cata pya yi te, Gibeah tuv riypa cata hmang ama la.
Benjamin tie ca Gibeah taa cata pya yi te, capa ning lie ca ta Israel ming thawkiy thawhning kha ama thie.

Israel ming ca sithaw yi te, Abyipahmiekunglie kha zuoluo te ta ama caa; cakhutaata Abyipakha bie ama hiehriy, “Ma tieriy Israel ming kha a du riypata ma si hnue pakhaa'a yi ma?” ama ta. Abyipata, “Sithaw ung la a du tie ung,” a ta yi.
Israel ming ca ama rie a papha yi te a ning khanapa ning ta rie tuv riypata hmang ama lanapa lie kha hmang ama la pakhaa.
Caacuonakawta a ning hningnapa lie ca Israel ming ta Benjamin ming tuv riypata ama sihnue pakhaa.
A ning hningnapa lie ca Benjamin ta iema tuv riypata Gibeah taa cata pya te, Israel ming thawhraa hlyicari a thie yi, ama bangkhuo ta rietuvna cehre a cyipa ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata Israel ming rieka bangkhuo Bethel luo kha kaa yi te ama caa, capa lie Abyipahmiekunglie kha a tu yi te, capa ning zuoluo te khata sa amaa uv.
Israel ming ta Abyipakha bie hiehriy yi te (capa cuo lie ca Khazing biekuona thingkaw kha capa lie ca a aw.

Aaron sacapaa Eleazar sacapaa Finehas ta a hmielie re a hrie ningta a cuo), “Ma tieriy ta a cuopa Benjamin ming a du riypata ma pyahnue kalie'a yi ma?” ama ta. Abyipata palie yi te, “Sithaw tie ung, tahematapakieca mawluo ca nama kuv luo na iema kha ica pi'a yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Israel ming ta Gibeah cahriylie kha ngie a sapa tie ama chi.
Cakhutaata ning thungnapa lie kha Israel ming ta Benjamin ming a du riypata sithaw yi te, a hluo haa khata Gibeah athaalie kha a du riypata hmang ama la.

Benjamin ming ta a du riypata khy taata aa hlapuona te khata ama va pyahnue. A hluo haa khata rieka tie kha thie hyi yi te, Bethel luo a sipa hne Gibeah luo a sipa luopuv lepa tie lie cuose, ruo chunglie kha cuose Israel ming kha sawthung tluv ama thie.
Benjamin ming ta, “A hluo haa kha tana kiema hmiekunglie amaa ruo,” ta pata ama rue. Cuorasala Israel ming ta, “A ruo ung pa sala khy chung taa khata luopuv luo ta dung'a ung puv,” amaa ta.
Ngie a sapa Israel ming Geba ningtla taata ama vya pya ning kha, Israel ming riekaphuv le cepa tie ca Baal-tamar luo kha hnangluo amaa saw.
Israel ming bangkhuo chungtaata a tlawpa cawsaa thawhraa ta Gibeah ca thuhnue yi te, aduna ca a pasa ciemuo. Cuorasala Benjamin ming ta rana na malie a tlungsue tli tapa kha pachang va yi.
Abyipata Benjamin ca Israel hmiekunglie kha a te; Israel ming ta capa ning lie ca ta Benjamin ming thawkiy thawpangaa zakha ama thie, ama bangkhuo ta rietuvna cehre a cyipa ta ama cuo.

Cakhutaata Benjamin ming ta malie ama te tapa kha ama pachang. Israel ming ta Benjamin ming kha amaa ruopa pakhi, tahematapakieca Gibeah a du riypata ngie a sapa rieka tie kha amaa pacaw nakawta a cuo.
Ngie a sapa rieka tie ca ta Gibeah ca tlangkhy ta a ngiechiy yi te ama tuv. Khypuv yalya khata zueziy ta ama naw diy.
Israel ming riekaphuv le cepa tie hne ngie a sapa tie alalalieta palungtlingna ama hnyipa ca, ngie a sapa tie khypuv chungtaata myikhuv ama pakhuv pahne ta

Israel ming riekaphuv le cepa tie ta a vya palihnue pata tuv riypa ta pata a cuo. Cuorasala Benjamin ming ta Israel ming kha sawthung hraw ama thie tli; caacuonakawta iema ta, “Yikhanapa rie maa tuv ning haa kha tana ma hmiekunglie amaa sung tli,” ta pata ama rue.
Cuorasala khypuv chungtaata myikhuv taw kha a kya thu tiyta Benjamin ming ca hnangluo kha a pali yi te, khypuv yalya chungtaata myikhuv taw avuo luo te myikhuv a kya kiethawpa kha ama hmung!
Cakhutaata Israel riekaphuv le cepa tie kha amaa vya pali, Benjamin ming ca rana na malie a tlung tli tapa kha hmung yi te nangping vuosuo pata ama aw.
Caacuonakawta Israel ming'a taa cata ruocaapa luo kha amaa ruo; cuorasala rietuvna ta pha yi te, a ruopa tie hne khy chungtaata a pyapa tie hne khata ama thie.
Benjamin ming kha zueziy cata vale yi te, Nohah taata Gibeah ningchiyluo hmang te khata ama tlawpuole.
Benjamin ming thawhraa hlyicari ama thiy, ama bangkhuo ta a riephapa rieka ta ama cuo.
A maa yi te ruocaapa lie Rimmon alung luo kha amaa ruo tiyta luopuv lepa lie kha thawpangaa ama thie, cakhutaata Gidom te khata a cade yi te, thawhning ama thie.
Caacuonakawta capa ning lieta a thiypa Benjamin ming ca cehre a patuvpa thawkiy thawpangaa ta ama cuo, ama bangkhuo ta a riephapa rieka ta ama cuo.
Cuorasala zacaruv tie ca a maa yi te ruocaapa lie Rimmon alung luo kha a ruo yi te, Rimmon alung lie ca thla paliy chung ama aw.
Capa chung cata, Israel ming ca Benjamin ming kha kaa hnue pakhaa yi te, khypuv lie cawsaa, sahring, hne aa ngaapa bangkhuo kha zueziy ta ama thie. Aa ngaapa khy tie zaw kha myi ta ama rue.
Israel ming ta Mizpah lie kha, “Ahungtahmuo a sacanung kha Benjamin ming pahlaw'a va ung puv,” ta pata chie amaa sa.
Cawsaa ca Bethel luo kha a vaw yi te, capa lie ca zuoluo te khata Khazing hmiekunglie kha a tu yi te, khuopuv ta ama caa.
Iema ta, “Vya Abyipa, Israel Khazing, khaapanakawma Israel ming chunglie hingpa hmang hing tlung te, ataning hing Israel ming chungtaata phang kha ca a bu?” ama ta.
A mawluopa ta cawsaa kha thu patang yi te capa lie ca bienatluophie kha ama sa, cakhutaata myirue panaana hne aviesaa panaana kha ama pihluo.

Cakhutaata Israel ming ta, “Israel mingphang bangkhuo taata ahungma Abyipa'a lie a hmyana luo hing a chiy va?” ama ta. Tahematapakieca Mizpah lie Abyipa'a luo a chiy lipa kaw hne aa patuv pata a cusapa chiesana suokha tue yi te, “Capa cawsaa ca thie pata cuo se,” ama ta.
Cuorasala Israel ming ta ama tieriy Benjamin tie cunglie kha kawpacuona hnyi yi te, “Ataning hing Israel ming chungtaata phang kha ca pahlipa tana ama cuo.
Ma sacanung zaw pakha hmuo napuv riypata iema kha pi'a va yi puv ta pata chie maa sa tli nakawta iema aa ngaa kaliepa tie cuota ama napuv riypa hing tuokhaatama khue ma khuo aa?” ama ta.
Cakhutaata iema ta, “Israel mingphang chungtaata ahungma Mizpah lie Abyipa'a luo a khaw lipa a aw?” ama ta. Arina hmang ahmyana luo kha Jabesh-gilead taata pakha hmuo chiy va yi.
Tahematapakieca ming kha amaa u tiyta Jabesh-gilead lie a awpa tie kha capa lie ca pakha hmuo aw va yi.
Caacuonakawta cawsaazaapuv ta rieka thawhraa hlyihning pathlie yi te, “Si ung la, Jabesh-gilead lie a awpa tie kha canung hne haatiy ta li pata zueziy ta va thie tie ung.
Hingpa hingna nama tue riypata a cuo aa; capaa bangkhuo hne capaa hne a ziehne buo tlipa canung bangkhuo kha nama thie aa,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Jabesh-gilead lie a awpa tie hraw taa khata capaa hne a ziehne buo li liepa lesaa zapaliy hmung yi te, Kanaan ruo chunglie a awpa Shiloh arina hmang luo kha amaa chiyle.
Cakhutaata cawsaazaapuv ta Rimmon lie a awpa Benjamin ming'a luo kha bie taa yi te, arena bie kha ama pathyi sa.
Benjamin ming ca capa cuo lie ca ta vya kaa yi te, thie li pata ama chipa Jebesh-gilead canung tie kha ama pi; cuorasala iema kha a zu va yi.
Abyipata Israel mingphang zaw chunglie kha achena a tue nakawta cawsaa tie ca Benjamin ming cunglie kha kawpacuona ama hnyi.
Caacuonakawta cawsaazaapuv uvthyi tie khata, “Benjamin ming chunglie canung ama aw li tli nakawta, tuokhaatama aa ngaa kaliepa tie cuota napuv ma khuopa'a ung?” ama ta.
Cakhutaata iema ta, “Israel ming chungtaata mingphang phang kha a vie li riypata Benjamin ming aa ngaapa tie cuo hingta ru a aw hrahring aa hu.

Cuorasala kiema pakha tahmuo ma sacanung zaw kha iema cuota napuv ta pi khu va yi puv,” ama ta. Tahematapakieca Israel ming ta, “Benjamin ming napuv a pipa ca chie mang sue,” ta pata chie amaa sa tli.

Caacuonakawta iema ta, “Mang tie ung, Bethel taata Shekhem luo a sithawpa luopuv lepa taata ningchiyluo kuo, Lebonah sungluo kuo lie a awpa Shiloh lieta Abyipacuota kung tating ta tue tawpa pyi a aw ning tana a cuo,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata iema ta Benjamin ming kyihuo khata, “Si ung la mingsuv diedung chunglie kha a bu ung la bya tie ung,
Shiloh lesaa zaw ca pyi lie luo repata ama vya pya tiyta, mingsuv diedung taa khata pya ung la, Shiloh lesaa pakha cyicuo kha nama napuv riypata a patuv ung la Benjamin ruo luo kha sikhyi tie ung.

Cakhutaata ama paa tie acuolikie ama caapaapa tie ta kiema'a luo kha a vaw yi te hnaa ama vya pahnaw kieca, iema kyihuo khata, “Iema cuo khata pahya thi tie ung; tahematapakieca iema pakha cyicuo cuo khata rietuvna lieta ama napuv riypa kha patuvpa va yi puv. Iema kha nama sacanung zaw nama pi nakawta nama cunglie pha lina tlung ra'a vyi,’ ma ta'a yi,” ama ta.

Benjamin ming ta ama ripa haa cata ama tue; ama sikhyipa a luopa canung tie kha ama cyicuo ta napuv ta amaa tue. Cakhutaata ama ruo luo kha kaa yi te, khypuv zaw kha sa pathiy yi te a chunglie ama aw.
Caacuonakawta Israel ming ca capa cuo lie ca ta khapa hmang taa khata a phang a phang ta hne a chungkhue a chungkhue ta pya yi te, ama ruo luo kha ama si.
Capa ning ca Israel ming chunglie siepahruo aw vyi; cawsaa bangkhuo khata iema ming lie aa rawna haa khata ama tue.
Bieripatuv tie ta ama za uv ning kha ruo chunglieta cakuo tlung te, Judah ruo Bethlehem khy ming pakha ca a napuv hne a saata zaw pahning hneta Moab ruo luo pe riypata a si.

Cawsaapa a ming ca Elimelek ta a cuo, a napuvnung ming ca Naomi ta cuo te, a sacapaa zaw pahning tie ming ca Mahlon hne Chilion ta ama cuo; iema ca Judah ruo Bethlehem taata Efrath ming ta ama cuo. Moab ruo luo ca si yi te capa lie ca ama aw.
Cuorasala Naomi aa vaapa Elimelek ca thiy te, ama hne a sacapaa pahning tie kha a paru siy yi.
Capa tie ca ta Moab ming kha napuv ta la yi te, pakhanung a ming ca Orpah ta cuo te, a hrangpa pakhanung ming ca Ruth ta a cuo. Capa lie ca kung pangaa hraw ama aw pata,
Mahlon hne Chilion zaw ca ama pahning ta ama thiy ra. Caacuonakawta Naomi ca a sacapaa pahning hne a navaapa ta ama paru siy.
Cakhutaata a munung zaw pahning hne khata Moab ruo luo kaapakhaa riypata aa thu, tahematapakieca Abyipata a cawsaa zaw kha kawpacuo tli yi te sa a pi yi tapa kha Moab ruo taa khata a thyi.
Caacuonakawta a za awnapa hmang taa khata ama hne a munung zaw pahning hne khata a tha yi te Judah ruo luo kha ama kaa.

Cuorasala Naomi ta a munung zaw pahning tie kyihuo khata, “Niema'a na nama nung zaw ing cyicuo luo kha va kaa tie ung. A thiypa tie hne kama cunglie nama tuepa haa hingta Abyipata ca due ra mang yi sue.
Nama pahning hingta nama navaapa ing lie hnaanguosa pata khy nama sa thena riypata Abyipata thluechiy ca pi yi se,” a ta yi. Cakhutaata pahnuo yi te, khuosa ta ama caa.
Iema ta ama kyihuo khata, “Nama hne tana na mingphang tie'a luo kha ma kaa ra aa,” ama ta.
Cuorasala Naomi ta, “Kaa tie ung, i sacanung zaw, khaapanakawma kama hneta nama si aa? Nama navaapa cuo riypata i riy chunglie sacapaa hmuo i hnyi li tlipa puv.
Kaa tie ung, i sacanung zaw, cakuo tie ung, tahematapakieca navaa hnyi riypata i nungpuv tuv tli. I cuota anguopuona a aw kalie ta pata ata zuo hingta navaa hnyi ang sala sacapaa i sa kie zaw yi ma

ama satliena te nama huo khu'a ma? Navaa hnyi li pata ma nama aw aa? Cuo vyi, i sacanung zaw, Abyipakuv ta i cunglie vuochina a patlung sa nakawta niema laa hingta khuopuv vie karaa tana i palung rie a thyi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata khuosa ta ama caa pakhaa. Orpah ta a ningnung kha a pahnuo, cuorasala Ruth ta ca ama kha aa patuv pari.
Caacuonakawta ama ta, “Mang tie, na narungnung ca a mingphang tie hne a khazing'a luo a kaa tli hue; na narungnung paziy la kaa ra tie,” a ta.

Cuorasala Ruth ta, Nama thuse riypa hingta na hripuo khah, nama ziy li pata kaa riypata zaw na hripuo khah! Na sina luo, si ra'a angte, naa rina lie, i ri ra aa; na mingphang ca i mingphang ta cuo ra'a te, na Khazing ca i Khazing ta a cuo ra aa.
Na thiyna lie, thiy ra'a angte, capa lie ca ina paby ra'a yi. Thiyna ta li pata a hrangpa kawlie nama hne i che kieca Abyipata cahaacata i cunglie tue se la, a hluv vie tahmuo tue se, a ta.
Naomi ta ama'a lie si ra aa ting hrahringpa kha a hmung tiyta, khaapahmuo ri va tli.
Caacuonakawta ama pahning ta Bethlehem te ama si. Bethlehem ama pha tiyta, iema kawlieta ama khypuv yalya ta a cali patlaw yi te, canung tie ta, “Hingpa nung hing Naomi khata a cuo ma?” amaa ta.
Ama ta iema kyihuo khata, “Naomi na ta khah tie ung, Mara na ta tie ung, tahematapakieca Lesyice na a khasa pata naa tue.

A bi pata si angte, cuorasala Abyipata kuv cahri pata ina vya kaakhyi; Abyipata ang khu li riyna te ta na tue te, Lesyice ta i cunglie ruvnaana a patlung sa ning hing, khaapanakawma Naomi ina ta ung ciy?” a ta yi.
Cahaacata Naomi ca Moab ruo taata ama hne a vya si hne nung, a munung, Moab zaanung Ruth hne khata ama vya kaa. Jungsacuo uo hruo ama pathu baaningpa khata Bethlehem ama pha.
Naomi ta a navaapa tieriy, Elimelek chung, cawsaa hnyirungsapa tieriy pakha hnyi te, a ming ca Boaz ama ta.
Cakhutaata Moab zaanung Ruth ta Naomi kyihuo khata, “Lu luo si'a angte na, ngie naa chipa tie hnangkaa lie kha samang i va thang aa,” a ta. Ama ta, “Va si thluo tie, i sacanung,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta a si. Sa a uopa tie hnangkaa lie kha samang ca a thang. Cahaacata Elimelek chung ta a cuopa Boaz lu luo kha a va pha.
A ru hluota Boaz ca Bethlehem taa khata vya pha te, suo a uopa tie kyihuo khata, “Abyipaca niema'a lie aw mang sue,” a ta. Iema ta, “Abyipata thluechiy ca pi mang sue,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Boaz ta suo a uopa tie a uvpa a changtaapa kyihuo khata, “Hingpa nung hing tuokhaapa lesaa tama a cuo?” a ta.
Suo a uopa tie a uvpa changtaapa ta, “Ama ca Moab ruo taata Naomi hne a vya kaa rapa Moab zaanung tana a cuo.
Ama ta, ‘Ngiechinapa ta, suo a uopa tie hnangluo hingta samang na pathang sa thi la na papung sa thi tie,’ ina ta. A vaw te maw taata ata tepa hingta cuo khata hmuo a pahy li pata a hrie pari,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Boaz ta Ruth kyihuo khata, “Na naathlie tie, i sacanung, hingpa taa hingta pya pata lu hrang luo kha samang thang riypata si'a vaciy, cuorasala i lesaa tie athaalie hingta aw tie,” a ta.

Iema ama hrienapa kha mang la ama hnang taa khata paziy yi la hrie tie. Satlie zaw ta hnaa aca pahnaw li riypa yi ta bie i pi mangtli yi. Na tiy a hrie kieca tiy bi luo kha cakuo la satlie tie ta ama the ciepa kha va dang tie,” a ta.
Cakhutaata alyi luo kha a bung te ama kyihuo khata, “Ruohrang ming i cuo raalaa pata na pachang cate, khaapanakawma na hmiekunglie hmiephaa i hmung?” a ta.

Cuorasala Boaz ta ama kha palie te, “Na navaapa a thiy khutaata na ningnung cunglie na tuepa bangkhuo ca a bangkhuo ta ina chang diy tli yi. Cakhutaata tuokhaatama na nung hne na paa, hne na puvnapa ruo kha thuse cate, na pachang buo lipa mingphang tie'a luo na vya si tapa zaw kha a bangkhuo ta ina chang diy mangtli yi.
Na tuepa bangkhuo cuota Abyipata ca thung mang sue. Israel ming Khazing a mathlaa rawlie canaw riypata na vya pangiepa Abyipata a tlingsa pata lawmuo ca pi mang sue!” a ta.

Cakhutaata ama ta, “I byipaapa, na hmiekunglie hmiephaa hmung pazue law thi ang se, tahematapakieca na changtaapa tie chungtaata pakha i cuo li raalaa pata kama kha kawpacuona ta bie na rihne cate i hnaa ina panguo ciy,” a ta.

Sa ning cuo lie kha Boaz ta, “A vaw la viechuo zaw hing vya ning ra tie, mingsuvtiy chunglie kha naw la ning tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta suo a uopa tie athaalie kha a tu te, Boaz ta vierue kha pi te a riy bina te a ning khutaata a pangaa buo kalie.
Samang thang riypata aa thu tiyta, Boaz ta satlie tie kyihuo khata, “Sa-uv zaw hrawlie hing samang pathang sa thluo ung la a hmie pachi khah ung.
Sa-uv taw chung taa zaw khata a dapa ung la, pathlapa siy ung la samang thang thluo se, ama kha chuo'a va ung ciy,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta lu lie ca ningtlana te ta samang a thang; a thangpa ca a ciy te Jungsacuo ephah suokha a ta.
Capa ca phya te khy chung luo kha a ngie te, a ningnung ta khazaa ma a thang tapa kha a hmung. Cakhutaata ama a riy bina te a ning khutaata a hlyipa kha thue te a ningnung ca a pi.

A ningnung ta ama kyihuo khata, “Ataning khaapaliema samang na thang? Khaapaliema na hrie? Nama ngiechi caa tapa paa ca thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue,” a ta. Caacuonakawta ahung'a lie ma a hrie tapa kha chang te, “Ataning i hrienapa paa a ming ca Boaz tana a cuo,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Naomi ta a munung kyihuo khata, “A hringpa cunglie cuose, a thiypa cunglie cuose, a kawpacuona a ci buo lipa Abyipata ama ca thluechiy pi thi mang sue,” a ta. Naomi ta ama kyihuo khata, “Capa paa ca ma tieriy tana a cuo, maa ngie cepa ma tieriy tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Moab zaanung Ruth ca ta, “Ama ta, ‘I sa hrie riypa a chuona te ta i changtaapa tie'a lie hing aw ra thluo tie,’ ina tapuo kalie,” a ta.
Naomi ta a munung Ruth kyihuo khata, “I sacanung, a rehrietuv lesaa zaw hneta na sipa cana a pha vie, cata acuolikieca lu hrang lie ca aca daw dili'a yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Boaz lesaa zaw hne aa ngiepa cata aw te, jungsacuo uo a chuona te ta samang ca thang te a ningnung hne cata a aw.
A ningnung Naomi ta Ruth kyihuo khata, “I sacanung nama cuota a pha riypa hnaanguo pata khysatungtuv the riypa na ica huvpa aa hu.
A lesaa zaw hneta re na hrienapa Boaz hing ma tieriy tana a cuo. Mang tie, ama ca ata zuo hing suo-aciyna lie tana suo a zi aa.
Caacuonakawta a siy la sathu kha a thuv tie, na caw pha cepa kha a tue la suo-aciyna luo kha zuv tie; cuorasala cawsaapa a ning khu a dang khuna te khata a pachang sa khah.
Aa zie tiyta, aa zienapa hmang kha a ngiepatlie la, cakuo la a phyi luo ta pang kha haw la vaa zie ra tie; cakhutaa cata khaapama na tue aa tapa kha ama ta aca chang aa,” a ta.
Ama ta, “Ina changpa bangkhuo ca hing i tue aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta suo-aciyna luo ca zuv te a ningnung ta a changpa haa khata a tue.
Boaz ca a ning a dang khutaata a palung tluo te, suo papungna athaalie kha aa zie. Cakhutaata a paruvta tah vaa te a phyi luo ta pang kha haw te aa zie.
Zuocang khata cawsaapa ca a pahlu te, aa pali ca canung pakha ca a phyi thabaw lie aa zie thluo!
Ama ta, “Ahungtama na cuo?” a ta. Cawsaanung ta, “Na changtaanung Ruth tana i cuo, nama ca aa ngiepa ma tieriy ta na cuo nakawta na pang kha naa haw thi tie,” a ta.

Ama ta, “I sacanung, Abyipata thluechiy ca pi mang sue; nama ca a siypasapa cuose, a hnyirungpa satlie cuose, ama hnang kha ziy li pata aw cate, ata a hnang ta na tuepa hmang hing ahluo ta na za tuepa zang tluo naa tlana laa te kha tana a pha vie,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta, i sacanung, ciy khah, inaa hiepa bangkhuo ca hing ica tuepa aa, tahematapakieca i cawsaa zaw bangkhuo hingta nama ca cawsaa phapa na cuopa kha aca pachang yi,” a ta.
Cuorasala, ata hing, kama ca aa ngiepa nama tieriy i cuopa ca aa hmuo pata a cuo, cadyiseca kama laata namaa ngie viepa nama tieriy pakha a aw kalie.

Ata zuo ca hingpa lie hing aw thluo la, mawluo khiy capa paa ca ta aa ngie cepa tieriy ta tue riypa kha na cuota a tue kieca a pha; tue thluo se. Cuorasala ama ta aa ngie cepa tieriy ta tue riypa kha na cuota a tue li kieca, cakhutaa cata, Abyipaa hringpa haata kama ta aa ngie cepa tieriy ta tue riypa kha na cuota i tue aa. Mawdiy te ta a zie thluo,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta a phyi thabaw lie kha mawdiy te cata a zie te, cuorasala pakha hne pakha a pasie hluo cuo lie khata a thu. Cakhutaata Boaz ta, “Canung pakha na suo-aciyna luo a vaw tapa kha ahungtahmuo pachang khah yi se,” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata, “Naa buvpa na pang kha vya cyi la caw tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta caw te, jungsacuo kha hmang caruv rawpa te a paphya sa; cakhutaata ama ca khy chung luo kha a cakuo.
Cawsaanung ca a ningnung'a luo kha a va pha ca, “I sacanung, tuokhaatama a cuo?” a ta. Cakhutaata cawsaapa ta a cuota a tuepa bangkhuo kha a chang.
“Hingpa jungsacuo hmang caruv hing na pi te, ‘Na kuv cahri pata na ningnung'a luo kaa'a vaciy,” ina ta, a ta.
Ama ta, “Tuokhaatama hmang a vya chiy a vya cuo aa tapa na pachang hluo li, huo caw thluo tie, i sacanung, cawsaapa hing aw thluo'a vyi, ataning hingta hmang hing a pachiy a pacuo thluo aa,” a ta.
A ru hluota Boaz ca hukaa luo kha khaw te a kya tu, capa luo ca Boaz ta a ripa tieriy aa ngie cepa paa ca aa vaw. Caacuonakawta Boaz ta, “Liechung, a vaw la a vya tu tie,” ta te, aa vya tu.
Cakhutaata Boaz ta khy chung uvthyi pahraa kha ku yi te, “A vya tu tie ung,” ta yi te, amaa vya tu.
Cakhutaa cata aa ngie cepa tieriy kyihuo khata, “Moab ruo taata a vya kaapa Naomi ta ima phang ta a cuopa Elimelek lubung suokha kha a zaa.

Caacuonakawta capa kaw ca ica chang riypata cuo te, hingpa lie a tupa i cawsaa uvthyi zaw hmiekunglie hing lubung ca a thla la ica ta riypa tana a cuo ta pata i rue. Naa thla riypata a cuo kieca a thla tie; naa thla li riypata a cuo kieca, i pachang riypata na chang tie, tahematapakieca hingpa hmang a thla riypa hingta nama caa paziypa ca kama tana i cuo,” a ta. Caacuonakawta ama ta, “I thla aa,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Boaz ta, “Naomi kuv taata lubung naa thla ning hingta, a thiypa paa ta a thusesiypa nunghlyinung, Moab zaanung Ruth zaw kha naa thla pata a cuo, a thiypa paa ming kha a ru lie na pahmang sa riypata,” a ta.
Capa lie ca, tieriy aa ngie cepa paa ta, “Kama ru tlaku kha i para pathlyi'a nakawta a thla khu'a va ang,” a ta. Kama ta i thla khu li'a nakawta nama ta a thla khutuv i cuonapa kha a la tie,” a ta.

Hluo ningta Israel ming chunglie athlana hne athlena kawlieta phung ca hingpa hing tana a za cuo: bie pacusana ta pakha ta a phyipakaw kha thlie te a hrangpa pakha kha a pi; capa ca Israel ming ta bie ama za pacusana pata a cuo.
Caacuonakawta tieriy aa ngie cepa ta Boaz kyihuo ta, “Nama cuota a thla thluo tie,” a ta tiyta, a phyipakaw kha a thlie.

Cakhutaata Boaz ta uvthyi tie hne cawsaa bangkhuo kyihuo khata, “Ataning Naomi kuv chungtaata Elimelek huopa ta a cuopa bangkhuo hne Chilion hne Mahlon huopa ta a cuopa bangkhuo i thlana kawlie hing niema ca i tehte tana nama cuo.

Mahlon napuvnung, Moab zaanung Ruth zaw hing a thiypa paa ming a ru chunglie a hmang te, a uvnu zaw chunglie hne a puvnapa hmang taata a vie li riypata i napuv riypata i la tli, ataning niema ca i tehte tana nama cuo,” a ta.

Cakhutaata hukaa lie a tupa cawsaa bangkhuo hne uvthyi tie ta, “Kiema hing tehte ta ma cuo. Abyipata na ing chung luo a vya ngie riypa canung hing Israel chungkhue zaa padaa hnepa Rachel hne Leah haa khata thluechiy pi mang sue. Efrathah lie hing a lesyipa cuo la Bethlehem lieta na ming pathuo mang sue.
Abyipata hingpa cawsaanung'a taa hingta aca pipa saata zaw thue hingta na ing ca Tamar ta Judah a sapapa Perez ing haa khata cuo mang sue,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Boaz ta Ruth ca la te a napuv ta a cuo. Pang kha ama cuo tiyta, Abyipata nu pahnyi sa te sacapaa a sa.
Cakhutaata canung tie ta Naomi kyihuo khata, “Ataning tieriy aa ngie cepa li pata caa chi lipa Abyipaca pathuosa pata cuo mang sue; a ming ca Israel ming hrawlie pathuo mang sue!
Ama ca nama cuota caa pahring sa pakhaatuv hne na nungpuv caw ta caa mangchiytuv tana a cuo aa; nama caa duepa na munung, sacapaa pa sariy laata a pha viepa na sacapaa caa sapa tli,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Naomi ta haatiy ca la te, a paw te a mangchiy.
A ingpaa canung zaw ta ama kha ming pi yi te, “Naomi cuo tana sacapaa a puv,” ama ta. Obed ta pata ming paphya yi te, ama ca David paa Jesse a paa ta a vya cuo.
Perez ciypathla zaw ca hingpa zaw hingta ama cuo: Perez ca Hezron paa ta a cuo,
Hezron ca Ram paa ta a cuo, Ram ca Amminadab paa ta a cuo,
Amminadab ca Nahshon paa ta a cuo, Nahshon ca Salmon paa ta a cuo,
Salmon ca Boaz paa ta a cuo, Boaz ca Obed paa ta a cuo,
Obed ca Jesse paa ta a cuo, Jesse ca David paa ta a cuo.

Efraim tluocung ruo Ramathaim khy lieta Zuf ming cawsaa pakha aw te, a ming ca Elkanah ta a cuo; ama ca Jeroham sacapaa ta a cuo, Jeroham ca Elihu sacapaa ta a cuo, Elihu ca Tohu sacapaa ta a cuo, Tohu ca Efraim ming Zuf sacapaa ta a cuo.
Ama ca napuv pahning hnyi te, pakha ca Hannah cuo te a hrangpa pakha ming ca Penninah ta a cuo. Penninah ca saata hnyi te Hannah ca saata hnyi vyi.
Capa cawsaapa ca kung kha hnang kung kha ta Eli sacapaa pahning tie, Hofni hne Finehas Abyipatluobyi ama cuonapa Shiloh lieta cungnungce Abyipaabie riypata a khy taa khata a sithaw taw.
Elkanah ta hriykhungrina a tue ning kha a napuvnung Penninah hne a sacapaa hne a sacanung bangkhuo cuo khata cuvu a pi yi;
Cuorasala Hannah ca Abyipata a chiy a paping raalaa pata a due nakawta cuvu le hning ta a pi.
Abyipata a chiy a khaa nakaw khata ama a zuetietuv khata a hi pahaa riypata kyachya ta a tue taw.
Cahaacata kung kha hnang kung kha Abyipaing luo ama khaw kyry ta ama ca kyachya ta a tue pari taw.
A navaapa Elkanah ta ama kyihuo khata, “Hannah, khaapanakawma na caa? Khaapanakawma sa na ning va? Khaapanakawma na ngie a chi? Kama hing na cuota sacapaa pahraa laata suo vie va ang ma?” a ta.
Shiloh lieta ama ning ama dang khutaata, Hannah ca thu te Abyipahmiekung luo kha a vaa. Capa ning ca tluobyi Eli ca ing chiypakaa tung athaalie, Abyipabiena-ing lie kha aa tu nguoluo.
Ama ca a palung rie thyisa te, Abyipa'a luo kha thlaachuo te khuosa ta a caa.

Cakhutaata hingpa biekuona hing a tue, “Vya Cungnungce Abyipa, na changtaanung palungriethyina hing na hmungpa cate, na maw lipa cata, na changtaanung hing naa thyi cate sacapaa ina pi ca kieca, a hring chung bangkhuo a luv ngu li pata, hne mingsuvtiy hne pariy thepa khaapahmuo hmuo li pata nazir ming cuo'a te, na hmiekung luo kha ica pi aa,” a ta.
Abyipahmiekunglie thlaa a chuo nguoluo ning kha, Eli ta a hmya papaapa kha a hmung.
Hannah ca a dieta tah thlaa kha chuo te, a hmya dyi kha papaa te, a ueryi kha a thyi vyi; caacuonakawta Eli ta sahmaa na a pariy ta pata a rue.
Caacuonakawta Eli ta ama kyihuo khata, “Khacuo te tama na pariy aa? Na mingsuvtiy hing thaw buo tie,” a ta.

Cuorasala Hannah ta palie te, “Cuo vyi, i byipa, palung rie thyisa pata a awpa canung tana i cuo; kama ca mingsuvtiy cuose, zuvre cuose a pariy pata cuo va ang, cuorasala Abyipahmiekunglie na i pathiypalung i bung.
Na changtaanung hing canung pha lipa ta na ri khah, tahematapakieca i palung riethyivuosuona khana i ri pari pata a cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Eli ta palie ta, “Diena hneta cakuo tie; Israel Khazing ta naa hiepa ca pi mang sue,” a ta.

Cakhutaata ama ta, “Na changtaanung ta na hmiekunglie hmiephaa hmung thi ang se,” a ta. Cakhutaata cawsaanung ca a ing luo kha a cakuo, a navaapa hne khata ning yi dang yi te, ngiechinapa minghmie kha phya va tli.
Iema ca mawdiy khata thu yi te Abyipakha amaa bie; cakhutaata Ramah lie ama ing luo kha ama kaa. Elkanah ta a napuvnung Hannah kha pachang te, Abyipata ama kha aa thyi.
A cuo aa de tiyta Hannah ca nu kha phya te sacapaa a sa. Ama ta Samuel ta pata ming a sa, tahematapakieca, “Abyipai hiepa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Elkanah hne a ingchungkhue ca Abyipa'a luo kung tating ta abiena pihluo riypa hne a biekuona haata pihluona tue riypata Shiloh luo kha ama sithaw.

Cuorasala Hannah ca si ra vyi, a navaapa kyihuo khata, “Haatiy hing ahnung a pathliepa hneta ama'a luo a khawkhyi'a angte, Abyipahmiekung luo kha chiy'a te, capa lie ca cipari a aw riypata hne chuozaa ta nazir ming cuo riypata i pihluo aa,” a ta.

A navaapa Elkanah ta ama kyihuo khata, “A pha ce aa na tapa haa khata tue la, ahnung a pathliena te khata huo tie; Abyipata a bie kha pacusa mang sue,” a ta. Caacuonakawta a ngaa te, ahnung a pathliena te ta haatiy kha a hnung a pi.

Ahnung a pathlie khutaata, kung thung a tapa cuetungpa, jungsacuo viedie ephah suothung, hne mingsuvtiy savang ungthyi zung kha hne khata haatiypa kha a chiy te a sithaw. Shiloh lie Abyipaing luo kha aa chiythaw; haatiypa ca a panusa kalie.
Cakhutaata cue kha thie yi te, haatiypa kha Eli'a luo ama cakuokhyi.
Cakhutaata ama ta, “Vya i byipaapa! Nama na hringpa haata, i byipaapa, kama ca hingpa na hmiekunglie hing a daa pata Abyipa'a luo thlaa zaa chuopa cawsaanung kha tana i cuo.
Hingpa haatiy cuo hingta thlaa i za chuo; ama'a luo i hiepa kha Abyipata ina pi.
Caacuonakawta ama ca Abyipakhana i pahlie tli; a hring chung bangkhuo ta Abyipana i pi tli,” a ta. Abyipacuota ama kha capa lie ca a thuse.

Hannah ta thlaachuo te, “Abyipachungliena i palung a tluo hringhruo: Abyipachunglie na i pathiypalung ca cyicalang pata a cuo. I tena chunglie kha i palung a tluo nakawta, i carie tie kha i pakaa ta a pahnyisue hyalya yi.
“Abyipahaata a pathepa pakha hmuo aw va yi, nama ta li pata ahunghmuo aw va yi; ahunghmuota ma Khazing haapa Alungpuv aw va yi.
Hruotlesa pata bie ri tuv khah ung, nama pakaa taata hruotlena bie pya khah se; tahematapakieca Abyipaca pachangna Khazing ta cuo te, tuenapa tie kha ama ta cyi a pathlie yi.
A thaaruvpa tie liy ca thli te, cuorasala a thaacawpa tie kha thaazuo ta ama bi.

Ama riy a bisa tawpa tie kha sa vuota viehlue yi te, cuorasala a nang a diy tawpa tie kha hruosue ta ama thu. A cingpa ta saata pasariy sa tli te, cuorasala saata a hluvsa a hnyipa ca saata li pata a aw.
Abyipata thie te, a pahring pakhaa; Sheol luo kha pachung te a calang pakhaa.
Abyipata siypasana tue te hnyirungna zaw a tue; ama ta pathla te, ama ngiethie ta a cyicalang.

Siepahruo sacapaa zaw hne a tuhne riypata hne, pa-uvsathyina thude ru cu riypata, siypasa tie kha buvcingkhuv taata calang yi te, aa phahlapa tie kha buvcuo chungtaata a caba yi. Tahematapakieca alyi tung tie ca Abyipahuopa ta cuo yi te, capa zaw cunglie ca chuelyi kha a patu.
Ama ta zang tluo aa tlapa paa phyi kha mangchiy'a te, cadyiseca a pha lipa tie ca zingna chunglie thawpa ta ama cuo aa; tahematapakieca cawsaa pakha ca cahrana ta tena hmung'a vyi.

Abyipa! A carie tie ca ama kyipatlaa diy aa; Cungnungce na avuo taata khalung a pathysue'a yi. Abyipana alyi dena te ta bie a ripa'a yi; ama ta a siepahruo kha thaa patlung'a te, sathu a pathuvpa kha a cyicalang aa.
Cakhutaata Elkanah ca Ramah lie a ing luo kha a si. Haatiypa ca tluobyi Eli hmiekunglie kha a ngaa te Abyipa re ca a hrie.
Eli sacapaa zaw ca cawsaa laliy lipa ta cuo yi te, Abyipakha ciyzaa va yi.

Cawsaa zaw cuota tluobyi ta hrie riypa re zaw kha siysaa ri va yi. Cawsaa pakhakha ta hriykhungrina a pihluo ning kha, tluobyi changtaapa ca a vaw'a te, saa aa tla nguoluo ning kha, a kuv lie aa vya cyipa a daw suothung ta a cakaapa khazin lepa khata,

uvkuo chungluo kha cuose, rahung chungluo kha cuose, tawcaabi chungluo kha cuose, bi chungluo kha cuose khazin lepa ta daw'a te, a thue khupa zaa kha tluobyi ta ama huota aa la aa. Capa ca Shiloh luo a vawpa Israel ming cunglie ama tuepa ta a cuo.

Ca hlyitaw taata tluobyi changtaapa ca saa thupa ama ruena hmiekung luo kha a vaw'a te hriykhungrina a pihluo nguoluopa paa kyihuo khata, “Tluobyi cuota e riypata saa kha na pi tie; tahematapakieca ama ca pasupa saa kha cuhluo'a vyi, epa dyi khana a cuhluo aa,” a ta taw.

Cakhutaata cawsaapa khata, “a thupa kha rue diy taa yi se, cakhutaa cata na khingpa kha a la tie,” a ta kieca, ama ta, “Cuo vyi, ata hing tana ina pi'a ciy; cata a cuo li kieca, i lapuo pache aa,” a ta taw.
Cahaacata satlie tie suena ca Abyipahmiekunglie kha a lesa tli; tahematapakieca iema ta Abyipapihluona kha esena ta ama hmuo.
Haatiy Samuel ca palaa ta taapa cawthang phapa tluobyi buohryi kha a hryi te Abyipahmiekunglie re a hriepa ta a cuo.
A nung ta buohryi pasiypa kha tuepa te kung tating ta a navaapa hneta hriykhungrina pihluo riypata ama si ning kha a cyipa taw.

Cakhutaata Eli ta Elkanah hne a napuvnung kha thluechiy pi yi te, “Abyipa'a lie a tuepa lasaw thue hingta, hingpa cawsaanung'a taa hingta Abyipata saata ca pi sala ca thung mang sue,” a ta khutaa yi ta ing luo kha ama kaa taw.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Hannah kha thluechiy a pi; nu phya te sacapaa pathung hne sacanung pahning a sa. Haatiypa Samuel ca Abyipahmiekunglie kha a lethaw.
