Eli ca a macuosa tli. A sacapaa zaw ta Israel ming bangkhuo cunglie ama tuepa kha a thyi diy. Cakhutaata atawna thluodaa luo angiena lie re a hriepa canung tie hneta amaa ziehnepa zaw kha a thyi diy.
Ama ta iema kyihuo khata, “Khaapanakawma hing haapa hmang hing nama tue? Hmang pha lipa nama tuepa kha hingpa cawsaa tie bangkhuo'a taa hingta i thyi.
Cuo vyi, i sacapaa zaw, Abyipacawsaa zaw ta ama rilepa i thyipa hing a phapa bie ta cuo vyi.

Cawsaa ta cawsaa cunglie kha a sue kieca, Abyipata arena a tuepa aa; cuorasala pakhakha ta Abyipa'a lie kha a sue kieca ahungma arena a tuepa aa?” a ta yi. Cuorasala ama paa bie kha naathlie va yi; tahematapakieca iema thie riypa kha Abyipakhingna ta a cuo.
Haatiypa Samuel ca pangpa lieta kya lethaw te Abyipahmiekunglie hne cawsaa hmiekunglie kha hmiephaa a hmung.

Khazing cawsaapa pakha kha Eli'a luo a vaw te ama kyihuo khata, “Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri, ‘Izipt ruo chung, Faro ingchungkhue lieta na mingchingmingvuo ca sii ta a za cuo ning kha a ingchungkhue lie kha kamata tah i luo.

Kama ta ama ca i bienatluophie luo kie pata rangpa-ue pihluo riypa, hne i hmiekunglie tluobyi buohryi a hryi riypata Israel ming mingphang bangkhuo chungtaata i tluobyi cuo riypata i tlaw; cakhutaata na mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue ca Israel ming'a taata i hmungpa myi ta pihluopa bangkhuo kha i pi.

Khaapanakawma kama ta pihluo riypata bie i pipa hriykhungrina hne kama huo pihluopa ca karuo awna ming ta mang ung cate, i cawsaa Israel ming ta ama pihluopa taata a pha cenapa ca nama thukalyna te ta ce ung cate na sacapaa zaw ca kama laata na pa-uvsathyi vie yi?'

Caacuonakawta AbyipaIsrael Khazing ta, ‘Na ingchungkhue hne na mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue ca i hmiekunglie a ngie pari a pya pari riypata bie i za kuo yi'; cuorasala ata hing ca Abyipana a pathyi sa: ‘Capa ca kama hneta a hla se; tahematapakieca kama naa pa-uvsathyipa tie ca pa-uvsathyi'a yi angte, kama naa esepa tie ca siysaa ri'a va yi ang.
Mang tie, na ingchungkhue lie pakha hmuo chuo tlung pata ama hring li riypata na buo hne na mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue buo kha i sa pachungna riypa cuo ca a tlung tli.
Cakhutaata Israel ming cunglie pi riypa hnyirungna bangkhuo ca ngiechisa pata karuo-awna ming ta na mang aa.
I bienathluodaa taata i thaw li riypa na cawsaa ca na mingthliy caa palang riypa hne na ngie caa pachi riypa tana a cuo aa; na ingchungkhue cawsaa bangkhuo ca zueziy tana ama thiy aa.
Na sacapaa zaw pahning, Hofni hne Finehas cunglie a tlung riypa hing na cuota pamangsana ta a cuo aa, ama pahning ta ning kha chunglieta ama thiy aa.

Kama ta zang tluo aa tlapa, i palung chunglie a awpa hne i ruenapa haata a hrie riypa i tluobyi kha i padaa aa. Cakhutaata ama ca a cupa ingchungkhue kha padaapa'a angte, ama ca sathu i pathuvpa hmiekunglie kha chuozaa ta aa ngie a pya pari aa.

Na ingchungkhue lieta aa ngaapa ahung a cuo zaw, ngu phie kha acuolikie viechuo tluo kha ta capa paa kha paakie riypata a vaw'a yi te, ‘Viechuo a cawta chuo i ning the riypata, tluobyi hne aa patuvpa suv kha lie chuo na chi thi tie,’ ama ta aa,” a ta.
Haatiypa Samuel ca Eli kuv rawlie kha Abyipare ca a hrie. Capa cuo ning ca Abyipabie kha a cawsa; muocuo zaw a luo laliy vyi.
Capa cuo lie ca a ming a zingle tli nakawta a phata tah a hmung khu tuv li tlipa Eli ca a khuo lie kha aa zie.
Khazing myi-ing ca thiy li lie pata, Samuel ca Khazing biekuona thingkaw a awnapa Abyipabiena-ing lie kha aa zie.
Cakhutaata Abyipata, “Samuel! Samuel!” ta pata ku te, ama ta, “Hingpa lie hingna i aw! a ta.
Cakhutaata Eli'a luo kha a ruo te, “Ina ku ca ma? Hingpa lie hingna i aw,” a ta. Cuorasala ama ta, “Ca ku va ang; vaa zie pakhaa tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta cakuo te aa zie.
Abyipata, “Samuel! ta pata a ku pakhaa. Samuel ca thu te, Eli'a luo kha a ruo te, “Ina ku ca ma? Hingpa lie hingna i aw,” a ta. Cuorasala ama ta, “I sacapaa, ca ku va ang? vaa zie pakhaa tie,” a ta.
Samuel ta Abyipakha pachang li lie pata, Abyipabie zaw kha ama'a luo phu pata cuo valie.
Abyipata a yi thungnapa ta Samuel kha a ku pakhaa. Thu te, Eli'a luo kha vaa te, “Ina ku ca ma? Hingpa lie hingna i aw,” a ta. Cakhutaa dyi ca ta Eli ta haatiypa hing Abyipana a u tapa kha a pachang.

Caacuonakawta Eli ta Samuel kyihuo khata, “Cakuo la vaa zie tie; ama ta aca ku kieca, nama ta, “Abyipa, ri tie, na changtaapa ta ica naathlie thluo,” na ta aa, a ta. Caacuonakawta Samuel ca cakuo te a awna hmang lie kha a vaa zie.
Cakhutaata Abyipaca a vaw te, capa lie ca a daa te a hluo haa khata a u, “Samuel! Samuel! ta pata a u pakhaa. Samuel ta, “Na changtaapa ta ica naathlie nguoluo, ri tie,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Samuel kyihuo khata, “Mang tie, a thyipa bangkhuo ama naa lie khalung haata a thy riypa hmang suokha na i hrie aa.
Capa ning lie ca a ingchungkhue hne aa patuv pata i ripa a hruothu taata a chuona te ta Eli cunglie i patling sa aa.

Tahematapakieca a sacapaa zaw ta Khazing ming papyapalyi pata tue yi te ama pha lina kha a pachang thluo pata thlu lipa yi ta a aw nakawta na ingchungkhue na chuozaa ta duo ica te aa ta pata i chang tli.
Caacuonakawta Eli ingchungkhue pha lina ca hriykhungrina hne pihluona ta pathe sa khu aw buo hluo'a va tli ta pata Eli ingchungkhue kha chie i sa tli yi,” a ta.
Samuel ca capa lie ca maw te ta aa zie; cakhutaata Abyipaing ingchiypakaa zaw kha a pahaw. Samuel ta muocuo kha Eli chang nguo vyi.
Cuorasala Eli ta Samuel kha “I sacapaa, Samuel,” ta pata a ku. Ama ta, “Hingpa lie hingna i aw,” a ta.
Eli ta, “Aca changpa ca khaapatama a cuo? Kama'a taata nu khah. Aca changpa suokhakha kha kama'a taata na nu kieca Khazing ta na cunglie cahaacata hne a hluv vie ta tue mang sue,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Samuel ta khaapahmuo nu li pata a chang diy. Cakhutaata ama ta, “Capa ca Abyipatana a cuo; ama ta a pha a tapa kha tue mang sue,” a ta.
Samuel ca kya lethaw te, Abyipaca ama'a lie aw te, a bie suokha hmuota alyi luo patla sa vyi.
Cakhutaata Dan taata Beer-sheba te ta a awpa Israel ming bangkhuo ta Samuel ca zang tluo aa tlapa, Abyipaprofet a cuopa kha ama pachang.
Abyipaca Shiloh lie kha aa luo pazue, tahematapakieca Abyipaca Shiloh lie, Samuel'a lie kha Abyipabie ta aa luo.
Cakhutaata Samuel bie ca Israel ming bangkhuo'a luo kha a pha.
Capa cuo lie ca Filistin ming ta Israel ming a du riypata si yi te, Israel ming zaw ta iema a du riypa khata ama pyahnue. Iema ca Ebenezer lie a ri yi te Filistin ming ca Afek lie amaa ri.

Rieka tie arina hmang luo amaa vaw tiyta, Israel uvthyi tie ta, “Khaapanakawma ataning hing Abyipata Filistin ming hmiekunglie malie a pasung sa? Abyipabiekuona thingkaw kha Shiloh taata hingpa luo hing a vawkhyi'a ung puv, cakiedyina ama ca kiema hraw luo hing a vaw'a te ma carie tie kuv cahrana taa hingta malie a khuo aa,” ama ta.

Caacuonakawta Shiloh luo kha cawsaa pathlie yi te, cherubim alalalie a awpa Cungnungce Abyipabiekuona thingkaw ca capa taa cata ama vya cyi. Eli sacapaa pahning tie, Hofni hne Finehas ca capa lie ca Khazing biekuona thingkaw hneta ama aw.
Abyipabiekuona thingkaw kha arina hmang luo a pha tiyta, Israel ming bangkhuo ta khuopuv ta khi yi te alyi lie a hraw diy.

Filistin ming ta ama khipa ueryi kha ama thyi tiyta, “Hebru ming arina hmang lie khuosa ta ama khipa ca khaapatama a cuo aa?” ama ta. Abyipabiekuona thingkaw na arina hmang luo a vya pha tapa kha ama thyi tiyta,
Filistin ming ca ama ciy; caacuonakawta, “Khazing na arina hmang luo a vya pha,” ama ta. Iema ta, “Bawchie ciemuopa tana ma cuo! Hing haapa hing ahluo ta za aw buo vyi.
Bawchie ciemuopa tana ma cuo! Hingpa a cahrapa khazing tie cahrana taa hingta ahungma malie a khuo khu aa? Hingpa tie hing ruocaapa lie Izipt ming a zaa thiepa khazing tie kha tana ama cuo.
Thaazuo a la ung la a capaasa tie ung, Vya Filistin ming, niema'a lie sii ama cuopa haata Hebru ming sii cuo li riypata a capaasa ung la a du tie ung,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Filistin ming ta a du yi te Israel ming ca amaa sung, iema'a na ama ing luo kha amaa ruo. Capa lie ca a thiena lepuv a aw, tahematapakieca Israel rieka thawsawthung ama thiy.
Khazing biekuona thingkaw kha ama patuv; Eli sacapaa pahning Hofni hne Finehas zaw kha ama thiy.
Benjamin cawsaa pakhapa ca rietuvna hmang taa khata a ruo te, capa ningpa ca ta Shiloh luo a pha, a caw kha thlaa te a luv lie buvcing aa phuv.

A pha tiyta, Eli ca a thude cunglie kha a tu te luopuv luo kha a vaa hyi, tahematapakieca Khazing biekuona thingkaw kawlie khata a thlaa zang pata aa cathang. Cawsaapa ca khypuv chung luo a vya ngie te thuohlaa kha a chang tiy yi ta a khypuv yalya ta ama caa.
Khuopuv ta ama khipa kha Eli ta a thyi tiyta, “Capa puraa ca khaapatama a cuo?” a ta. Cakhutaata cawsaapa ca a catlisa pata a vaw te Eli kha a chang.
Eli ca kung sawcaky kung cari cuo tli te, a ming ca cue te hmung the va tli.
Cawsaapa ca ta Eli kyihuo khata, “Atabala hingna rietuvna taata i vya chiy; ataning hingna rietuvna taata i vya ruo,” a ta. Ama ta, “Khaapama a lu, i sacapaa?” a ta.

Biephyatuv ca ta palie te, “Israel ming ca Filistin ming hmiekung taata a ruo pate rieka tie hrawlie a thiena khuopuv ta a aw; na sacapaa pahning tie, Hofni hne Finehas zaw thiy yi te, Khazing biekuona thingkaw zaw ama patuv,” a ta.

Khazing biekuona thingkaw tapa a ri tiyta, Eli ca chiypakaa athaalie a thude cung taa khata a ya pathla te a ruetung tli te a thiy, tahematapakieca ama ca macuo ta cuo te aa riysa. Ama ta Israel ming kha kung sawliy bie a ripa yi.

A munung, Finehas napuvnung ca nu phya te saata a hnyi'a nang ningta a cuo. Ama ta Khazing biekuona thingkaw na ama patuv tapa, hne a cuopa hne a navaapa ama thiypa kha a thyi tiyta, a riy kha sungkha ta vya pasa te, a bung te nu kha a hnyi.
A thiy'a nang balapa khata aa thaalie a awpa canung tie khata, “Ciy khah, sacapaa na na hnyi,” ama ta. Cuorasala palie lipa yi ta siysaa zaw ri ra vyi.

Ama ta haatiypa kha Ikabod ta pata ming a sa. A siyluo ca, “Khazing rungnaana na Israel a thuse tli,” tana ta a cuo, tahematapakieca Khazing biekuona thingkaw ca patuvpa cuo te, a cuopa hne a navaapa zaw ama thiy tli.
Ama ta, “Rungnaana na Israel a thuse tli, tahematapakieca Khazing biekuona thingkaw ca patuvpa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Filistin ming ta Khazing biekuona thingkaw ama patuv tiyta, Ebenezer taa khata Ashdod luo kha ama sikhyi.
Cakhutaa cata Filistin ming ca ta Khazing biekuona thingkaw kha la yi te, Dagon ing chung luo kha a ngiekhyi yi te Dagon athaalie kha ama chi.

A mawluopa mawdiy ta Ashdod cawsaa tie ca ama thu tiyta, Dagon ca aa bu luo ta Abyipabiekuona thingkaw hmielie ca a zaa lie thluo. Caacuonakawta iema ta Dagon ca la yi te a aw tawnapa lie ca ama chi pakhaa.

Cuorasala a mawluopa mawdiy ta ama kya thu tiyta, Dagon ca Abyipabiekuona thingkaw hmielie kha aa liepatyi; a luv hne a buo hra hning ca a tepachung te ingchiypakaa athaalie kha a laa; Dagon ca a pangpa dyi aa ngaa.
Dagon tluobyi tie hne Dagon ing chung luo a ngiepa bangkhuo ta ataning tepa ta Dagon ing ingchiypakaa ama tlaw linapa ca capa nakaw ca tana a cuo.
Ashdod khy ming cunglie Abyipakuv ca a riy te, iema kha ama thlaa pazang sa yi te, ngesaa buna ta riethyi a pi yi.

Ashdod khy ming ta hmang a chiy a cuopa kha ama hmung tiyta, “Israel Khazing biekuona thingkaw hing kiema'a lie aw'a vyi; tahematapakieca a kuv ca kiema cunglie hne ma Khazing Dagon cunglieta aa riy,” ama ta.

Caacuonakawta cawsaa a pathlie yi te Filistin byi bangkhuo kha pahmya yi te, “Israel Khazing biekuona thingkaw hing tuokhaatama ma tue'a ung?” ama ta. Gath khy ming ta palie yi te, “Khazing biekuona thingkaw ca kiema'a luo palaw pata cuo se,” ama ta. Caacuonakawta Khazing biekuona thingkaw ca Gath luo ama palaw.
Cuorasala Gath luo ama palaw khutaata, Abyipakuv ta khypuv kha a du te, ama thlaa a pazang sa yi; khypuv lie khy a sapa haatiy hne uvthyi bangkhuo cunglie kha ngesaa buna ta riethyi a pi yi.

Caacuonakawta iema ta Khazing biekuona thingkaw kha Ekron luo ama paphya. Cuorasala Khazing biekuona thingkaw ca Ekron luo a pha tiyta, Ekron cawsaa tie ta khi yi te, “Khaapanakawma kiema hne ma cawsaa zaw thie riypata Khazing biekuona thingkaw ca kiema athaa luo ama vya sikhyi?” ama ta.

Caacuonakawta cawsaa pathlie yi te Filistin byi bangkhuo kha pahmya yi te, “Israel Khazing biekuona thingkaw hing pa si tie ung, kiema hne ma cawsaa zaw malie a thie li riypata, a awnapa luo kaa se,” ama ta. Tahematapakieca khypuv chung yalya khata thlaazangna a aw. Khazing kuv ca capa lie ca aa riysa.
A thiy lipa tie ca ama ngesaa bu diy te, khypuv caana ueryi ca avuo luo te a kie.
Abyipabiekuona thingkaw ca Filistin ruo lie thla sariy a aw.

Cakhutaata Filistin ming ta tluobyi tie hne hmungdawlutuv tie kha ku yi te, “Abyipabiekuona thingkaw hing tuokhaatama ma tue aa? Malie chang tie ung, a awna luo kha khaapa hneta ma ma paphya aa?” ama ta.

Iema ta, “Israel Khazing biekuona thingkaw kha nama paphya kieca a cahripa ta pakaa sa'a va ung ciy, sue a ngiethe panaana hne tana nama pakaa sa hrahring aa. Cakhutaata nama hnaa tluo'a te, khaapanakawma a kuv ca niema'a taata a kaa va tapa kha nama pachang aa,” ama ta.

Cakhutaata iema ta, “Ama ma pi pakhaa riypa sue a ngiethe panaana ca khaapatama a cuo aa?” ama ta. Iema ta, “Filistin byi tie mingluv zaa ta siy a butalupa zuv suopangaa hne siy pazuv suopangaa; tahematapakieca niema bangkhuo cunglie hne nama byi tie cunglie kha aa lupa pasana na caa tlung yi.

Caacuonakawta nama ngesaa bupa zuv hne nama ruo a parapa pazuv zuv kha tue'a ung cate Israel Khazing kha rungnaana nama pi aa; niema hne nama khazing tie hne nama ruo cunglie kha a kuv pahy vie ngiethie thlu'a va ma.

Khaapanakawma Faro hne Izipt ming hne ama palung a lepa haata nama palung namaa pale sa ra aa? Ama ta iema kha a pataw a pamuo diy khutaa yi ta, cawsaa kha pasi sa yi te Israel ming kha ama pya cuo va ma?
Caacuonakawta, cuele a thaapa suokha hne le a da buo lipa aa hnung suepa cuepuvnung sahning pachie ung la, cuepuvnung tie kha ruekhang khang ung la, a taata kha ca che ung la ing lie sang tie ung.

Abyipabiekuona thingkaw kha la ung la le cung luo kha khang ung la, sue a ngiethe panaana ta nama pakaakhyi sa riypa siy chechiy zaw kha thingkaw ta aa thaalie kha chi tie ung. Cakhutaata pathlie ung la, pasi sa tie ung.

Cakhutaata mang tie ung, ama ruo luo a sipa luopuv, Beth-shemesh luo kha a sithaw kieca, hingpa ruvnaana lepuv ma cunglie a tuepa hing ama ta a cuo, cuorasala cahaacata a cuo li kieca malie a tuvpa hing ama kuv ta cuo vyi; ma cunglie a tlung tlaryapa tana a cuo tapa kha ma pachang aa,” ama ta.
Cawsaa tie ta cahaacata ama tue; aa hnung suepa cuepuvnung sahning kha la yi te ruekhang ama khang, a taata tie kha ing lie ama hrekhung siy.
Abyipabiekuona thingkaw hne siy pazuv zuv hne ama ngesaa bupa zuv thingkaw kha le cunglie ca ama khang.
Cuepuvnung tie ca ama khipuole pata Beth-shemesh luo a sipa luopuv kha tathlyalya ta ama ziy; cavyiluo cuose cacuoluo cuose a maa va yi. Filistin byi tie ta Beth-shemesh ruoriy te ama ziy.
Capa ning ca Beth-shemesh khy ming ca bawphie chunglieta ama jungsacuo ama hrie nguoluo ningta a cuo. Hmiehmie pase yi te biekuona thingkaw kha ama hmung ca ama palung a tluosa.

Cuele ca Beth-shemesh lie Joshua lu chung luo kha a vya ngie te capa lie ca aa daa. Capa lie ca alung lesapa suokha a aw. Caacuonakawta cuele thing kha saa chi yi te cue tie ca Abyipa'a luo kha myirue panaana ta ama pihluo.

Levi ming ta Abyipabiekuona thingkaw hne athaalie a awpa, siy zuvta zaw ama chinapa thingkaw kha la yi te alung lesapa cunglie kha ama chi. Cakhutaata Beth-shemesh khy ming ta capa ning lie ca Abyipakha myirue panaana pihluo yi te hriykhungrina zaw ama tue.
Filistin byi papangaa tie ta capa ca hmung yi te, capa ningpa ca ta Ekron luo kha ama kaa.

Filistin ming ta Abyipa'a luo sue a ngiethe panaana ta pihluo yi te ama paphyapa, ama ngesaa bupa hne aa lu pata ama tuepa siy bupa zuv tie ca: Ashdod cuota suokha, Gaza cuota suokha, Ashkelon cuota suokha, Gath cuota suokha, Ekron cuota suokha ta a cuo.

Filistin byi papangaa ta ama hnyipa khypuv bangkhuo, a cusa pata ama dungkhuopa khypuv tie hne dungkhuo lipa khyta zaw a hluv a caw zaa khata siy pazuv zaw kha ama paphya. Aa thaalie Abyipabiekuona thingkaw ama pachungnapa, Beth-shemesh khy ming Joshua lu lie alungpuvnung ca ataning tepa hingta a aw kalie.

Jekoniah ciypathla tie ca Beth-shemesh khy ming cunglie kha ama palung tluo vyi, iema ta Abyipabiekuona thingkaw kha ama mang paruv nakawta cawsaa sawsariy a thie yi. Abyipata ama hrawlie thiena lepuv a tue nakawta cawsaa kha ama caa.
Cakhutaa cata Beth-shemesh khy ming ta, “Ahungma hingpa a pathepa Khazing, Abyipahmiekunglie hing a daa khu'a yi? Ama'a taata ma law riypa hingta ahung'a luo ma a cakuo aa?” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Kiriath-jearim khy ming'a luo kha biephyatuv pathlie yi te, “Filistin ming na Abyipabiekuona thingkaw kha a vya pakaa tli yi. A zuv ung la niema'a luo lathaw tie ung,” ama ta.

Cakhutaata Kiriath-jearim khy ming ca a zuv yi te, Abyipabiekuona thingkaw kha la yi te tluo cunglie Abinadab ing luo kha ama sikhyi. Iema ta a sacapaa Eleazar kha Abyipabiekuona thingkaw mangchiy riypata ama pathe sa.
Kiriath-jearim luo biekuona thingkaw pha te cuo pasiypuv, kung kiy hraw a aw ning khata Israel ingchungkhue bangkhuo ta Abyipakha vuo yi te amaa ngiy.

Cakhutaata Samuel ta Israel ingchungkhue bangkhuo kyihuo khata, “Nama pathiypalung hmisi tana Abyipa'a luo nama vya kaa ta pata a cuo kieca ruohrang khazing tie hne Astarter tie kha nama hrawtaata thaw tie ung. Nama pathiypalung kha Abyipa'a lie chi ung la, ama re dyi kha hrie ung la, ama ta Filistin ming kuv taata aca khuo'a yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Israel ming ta Baal hne Astarter tie kha thaw yi te, Khazing re dyi kha ama hrie.
Cakhutaata Samuel ta, “Israel ming bangkhuo kha Mizpah lie papung ung la, kama ta Abyipa'a luo kha nama cuota thlaa i chuo aa,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Mizpah lie kha a hmya yi te, tiy kha the yi te, Abyipahmiekunglie ama patle. Capa ning ca sa a uv yi te, “Abyipacunglie ma sue mangtli,” ama ta. Samuel ta Israel ming ca Mizpah lie kha bie a ripa yi.
Israel ming na Mizpah lie a hmya yi tapa kha Filistin ming ta ama thyi tiyta, Filistin byi tie ca Israel ming a du riypata ama sithaw. Israel ming ta capa ca ama thyi tiyta Filistin ming kha ama ciy.
Israel ming ta Samuel kyihuo khata, “Kiema cuota Abyipama Khazing'a luo na upa kha pa ci sa khah, Filistin ming kuv taata malie a khuo riypa khata thlaachuo tie,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Samuel ta ahnung a dang kaliepa tuvtaata kha la te a pangpa yalya ta myirue panaana ta a pihluo; Samuel ta Israel ming cuo khata Abyipa'a luo kha thlaachuo te, Abyipata a palie.

Samuel ta myirue panaana a pihluo nguoluo ning kha Filistin ming ta Israel ming tuv riypata amaa vya ngie; cuorasala capa ning lie ca ta Abyipata Filistin ming kha a pu paringsa pata khalung pathysue yi te, a kalaa diy yi te, Israel ming hmiekung taa khata amaa ruo.
Cakhutaata Israel ming ta Mizpah taa khata pyahnue yi te Filistin ming kha Beth-kar tluo khung te ta a cade yi te ama thie.
Cakhutaata Samuel ta alung suokha kha la te, Mizpah hne Jeshanah alalalie kha bang te, “Abyipana ata tepa hingta malie a bya,” ta te, Ebenezer ta pata ming a sa.
Filistin ming ca a sung yi te, Israel ming ruo chung luo kha a ngie pakhaa va tli yi. Samuel chuo chung bangkhuo ca Abyipakuv ta Filistin ming kha aa daakhuo yi.

Israel ming'a taata Filistin ming ta ama lapa khy tie kha Ekron taata Gath te ta Israel ming'a luo pi pakhaa pata a cuo; Israel ming ta ama ruo kha Filistin tie'a taata ama la pakhaa khu. Israel ming hne Amor ming alalalie zaw diena a aw.
Samuel ta a hring chung bangkhuo Israel ming kha bie a ripa yi.
Kung tating ta Bethel, Gilgal, hne Mizpah kha cahlung te a tlaw yi; capa hmang bangkhuo lie ca Israel ming kha bie a ripa yi.
Cakhutaa cata Ramah luo kha a vya kaa taw, tahematapakieca a ing ca capa lie ca na a aw; Israel ming kha capa lie ca biedangpa ta bie ripa yi te, Abyipacuota capa lie ca bienatluophie a sa.
Samuel ca a vya macuo tiyta, a sacapaa zaw kha Israel ming cunglie bieripatuv ta a tue yi.
A sacapaa uvthyi a ming ca Joel cuo te, a pahningnapa a ming ca Abijah ta a cuo; iema ta Beer-sheba lie kha bie ama ripa.
Cuorasala a sacapaa zaw ta ama luopuv kha ziy va yi; tuokaa luo khata a maa yi te, nawthuv ning yi te biedangpa kha ama para.
Cakhutaata Israel ming uvthyi bangkhuo kha a hmya yi te Ramah lie Samuel'a luo kha a vaw yi te,
ama kyihuo khata, “Nama ta na macuo tli, na sacapaa zaw ta nama luopuv ziy lipa yi ta ama aw; caacuonakawta mingphang hrangpa tie haa hingta, malie a uv riypa siepahruo malie pi tie,” ama ta.
Cuorasala, “Malie a uv riypata siepahruo malie pi tie,” ama tapa khata Samuel palung patluo vyi. Samuel ta Abyipa'a luo kha thlaachuo te,

Abyipata Samuel kyihuo khata, “Cawsaa bangkhuo ta nama'a lie ama ripa ama ueryi kha naathlie tie; tahematapakieca nama kha aca thawpa yi ta cuo li pata, ama cunglie siepahruo i cuona taa kha tana kama ina thaw yi.
Izipt taata i pyakhyinapa yi ning taata ataning tepa hingta, kama kha na thaw yi te khazing hrangpa tie kha amaa bie; kama cunglie ama tuepa haa hing tana nama cunglie zaw ama tue ra.
Caacuonakawta ata hing ca ama bie kha naathlie thluo tie yi; cuorasala a diesa pata iema kha a raaringna pi yi la, iema a uv riypa siepahruo sizya kha chang tie yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Samuel ta Abyipabie bangkhuo kha siepahruo a hiepa cawsaa tie kha a chang yi.

Ama ta, “Hingpa hing niema caa uv riypa yi siepahruo sizya ta a cuo aa: nama sacapaa zaw kha la'a yi te, a che kha aa ruole rieka riypa, a che kha aa ruo rieka riypa, hne a che kha hmieluo a sipa phyi rieka riypata re a pi'a yi.
Cakhutaata a thaw uvtuv zaw, sawngaa uvtuv zaw kha aa chi'a yi. Chekha kha a le a thaw riypa hne sa a hrie riypata chi'a yi te, chekha kha rie cehre satuv hne aa ruole chechiy satuv ta a chi'a yi.
Nama sacanung zaw ca ziyhmyi a tuetuv, sa changtuv hne chuore ruetuv ta a la'a yi.
Nama lu hne nama mingsuv diedung hne nama olif diedung zaw hrawtaata a pha cepa kha la'a te a rehrietuv tie kha a pi'a yi.
Nama sa hne nama mingsuv diedung che hraa che kha kha la'a te, aa byi tie hne a rehrietuv tie kha a pi'a yi.
Nama siicapaa hne nama siicanung, hne nama cue hne nama laa a pha cepa zaw kha la'a te a rehrietuv ta a tue'a yi.
Nama tuvrung chungtaata che hraa che kha kha la'a te, niema ca a sii ta nama cuo aa.
Capa ning lie ca niemata tah namaa tlawpa nama siepahruo kawlieta nama khi nama u aa; cuorasala Abyipata ca palie'a va yi.
Cuorasala cawsaa ta Samuel ripa kha naathlie va yi; iema ta, “Cuo vyi! ma cunglie siepahruo hnyi riypata bie maa chi mangtli,
kiema zaw mingphang hrangpa tie haata ma cuo ra riypata, ma siepahruo ta malie uv'a te, hmaa malie sa pa'a te ma carie tie kha malie aa dupa aa.
Samuel ta cawsaa zaw bie bangkhuo kha a thyi tiyta, Abyipa‘a luo kha a va ri pakhaa.
Abyipata Samuel kyihuo khata, “Ama ueryi kha naathlie la siepahruo pakha chipa tie yi,” a ta. Cakhutaata Samuel ta Israel ming kyihuo khata, “Nama ing cyicuo ta a diy tie ung,” a ta yi.
Benjamin phang cawsaa pakha a ming Kish ama tapa, a hnyirungsapa pakha a aw. Ama ca Abiel sacapaa ta a cuo, Abiel ca Zeror sacapaa, Zeror ca Bekorath sacapaa, Bekorath ca Afiah sacapaa ta a cuo.
Ama ta sacapaa pakha hnyi te a ming ca Saul ta a cuo, satlie chiythesapa ta a cuo. Israel ming chunglieta ama laata a chiythe viepa aw va yi; cawsaa mekaa laata a luv hne a letung cung ca aa suo vie.
Saul a paa, Kish laa tie kha ama vie. Caacuonakawta Kish ta a sacapaa Saul kyihuo khata, “Satlie pakha kha a chiy la, si ung la laa va huv tie ung,” a ta.

Ama ta Efraim tluocung ruo kha a cahraw, Shalishah ruo kha a cahraw, cuorasala hmung va yi. Cakhutaata Shaalim ruo kha ama cahraw, cuorasala capa lie ca aw va yi. Cakhutaata Benjamin ruo kha a cahraw, cuorasala hmung va yi.
Zuf ruo luo kha ama vya chiy tiyta, Saul ta satliepa kyihuo khata, “Kaa paatie'a puv, i paa ta laa kaw kha pacuo li tli pata kiema kawlie a palung rie thyi pali'a kie,” a ta.

Cuorasala ama ta, “Huepa khy lie hue Khazing cawsaa pakha aw te, cawsaa ta ama pa-uvsathyipa tana a cuo. A ripa bangkhuo kha a tling. Capa luo ca vaa ung siy; maa vya thahnue hnuochuopa ma khytlawna kaw zaw hing malie a chang khu ngiethie thlu aa,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Saul ta satliepa ca palie te, “Cuorasala ma vaa kieca, cawsaapa kha khaapama ma cyipa aa? Tahematapakieca ma sahrie chunglie viechuo ta a chuo tli, Khazing cawsaapa huota ma cyipa riypa lasaw aw vyi. Khaapama ma hnyi?” a ta.
Satliepa ta Saul kha palie pakhaa te, “Lie hing ngu shekel che paliy che kha i hnyi hing; ma luopuv malie a chang riypata Khazing cawsaapa ca kama ta hingpa hing pi lavuo ang,” a ta.

(Hluo ning ca Israel ming chunglieta, pakhakha ta Khazing kha a hiehriy khingpa a aw kieca, “A vaw tie, hmungtuvpa'a luo vaa puv,” ama ta; tahematapakieca ata lie profet tapa hing ahluo ta ca hmungtuvpa ama za ta.)
Saul ta satliepa kyihuo khata, “A pha, a vaw la vaa puv,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Khazing cawsaapa awna khy luo kha ama vaa.
Tluocung lie khy luo ama khawthawpa khata tiy the riypata a vawpa lesaa chekha kha a taw yi te, iema kyihuo khata, “Hingpa lie hing hmungtuvpa a aw ma?” ama ta.
Iema ta, “A aw, huepa nama hmiekungtalie huena a aw. Catli tie ung; cawsaa ta ataning hing abiena hmang lie hriykhungrina tue yi te, atabala khana khy chung luo aa vaw.

Khy chung luo kha a catli pata namaa ngie kieca abiena hmang luo sa ning repata a khaw hluota ama kha nama hmung aa. Tahematapakieca ama ta hriykhungrina kha thluechiy pi riypa a cuo nakawta ama aa vaw hluota ca cawsaa kha sa ning'a va yi, cakhutaa dyi ca tana kupa tie ca ama ning aa. Ata hingta khawthaw ung la ama kha namaa taw paluo aa,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta khy luo ca ama khaw. Khy chung luo ama vaa ngiepa khata abiena hmang luo khaw riypata iema kuo luota Samuel aa vawlepa kha ama hmung.
Saul aa vaw hluo, ning kha lie kha Abyipata Samuel'a lie kha phu te:

Mawluo ata tiy hingta Benjamin ruo taata cawsaa pakha vya pathlie'a angte, I cawsaa Israel ming uvtuv riypata sathu na pathuv aa. Ama ta i cawsaa zaw kha Filistin ming kuv chungtaata a khuo'a yi; tahematapakieca i cawsaa zaw ruvnaana ama angpa kha i hmung tli, tahematapakieca ama khina ueryi khana kama'a luo a chiy tli,” a ta.
Samuel ta Saul a hmung tiyta, Abyipata ama kha chang te, “Hingpa hingna nama ica changpa cawsaapa khata a cuo. Ama hingna i cawsaa zaw ca a uv'a yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata hukaa lie ca Saul ta Samuel kha vaa ngie te, “Khaapaliema hmungtuvpa ing a aw tapa kha na chang thi tie,” a ta.

Samuel ta Saul kha palie te, “Kama hingna hmungtuvpa ta a cuo ang. I hmiekung luo hingta abiena hmang luo kha cakuo tie, tahematapakieca ataning hing kama hne tana sa nama ning aa, mawluo khiy ca pasi'a angte, na pathiypalung lie a awpa bangkhuo kha ica chang aa.

Ma hnangluo ning thung lieta a viepa na laa kaw kha ca pacuo khing khah tie, ama hmung tli. Cakhutaata Israel ming bangkhuo ta ahungma ama khing, nama hne na ciypathlatuv ingchungkhue na a cuo, cuo va ma?” a ta.

Saul ta palie te, “Kama ca Israel mingphang hrawlieta a caw cepa Benjamin phang tana i cuo, cakhutaata i ingchungkhue ca Benjamin phang chungtaata aa ne cepa tana ma cuo. Khaapanakawma cahaacata ina ta the ciy?” a ta.
Cakhutaata Samuel ta Saul hne a changtaapa satliepa ca ing khuo chung luo a ngiekhyi yi te, kupa sawthung tie hrawlie kha a pha cepa lieta a patu sa yi.
Cakhutaata Samuel ta sachangtuv kyihuo khata, “A nanangta tah chi riypata ica pipa cuvu kha vya cyi tie,” a ta.

Sachangtuv ta a baw hne a lahmyi kha kya cyi te Saul hmiekunglie kha a chi. Samuel ta, “Mang tie, a nanang ta i za chipa ca na hmiekunglie pachie pata a cuo tli. Ning tie; kupa khyche tie hne nama ning pakhaw riypata ting ciepa cuo lieta na hmiekunglie pachie pata a cuo,” a ta. Caacuonakawta capa ning lie ca Saul ca Samuel hneta sa a ning.
Abiena hmang taata ing luo amaa zuv tiyta, Saul ca a cungduo lie kha pang phaapa yi te aa zie.

Khy a dyi baaning pata Samuel ta a cungduo lie a awpa Saul kha ku te, “Thu tie na sina riypa luopuv luo na ica pathlie aa,” a ta. Saul ca thu te Samuel hne khata ama pahning ta luopuv luo kha ama pya.

Khy lie luo ama chiypa khata, Samuel ta Saul kyihuo khata, “Satliepa hing ma hmieluo a silu riypata chang tie, malie a law khu pahne nama ca hingpa lie hing a daa caw tie, tahematapakieca Khazing bie na ica pachang sa khing,” a ta.

Samuel ta chiytiy ung kha la te a luv lie kha bya te, pahnuo te, “Abyipana a cawsaa Israel ming cunglie byi cuo riypata sathu caa pathuv. Nama ca Abyipacawsaa zaw cunglie kha siepahruo ta cuo'a cate ama cahriylie a awpa ama carie tie kuv chung taa khata na khuo'a yi. Cakhutaata Abyipata ama ru cunglie uvtuv cuo riypata sathu aca pathuv tli tapa pamangsana ca hingpa hing tana a cuo aa.

Ataning kama'a taata na si tiyta Benjamin ruo Zelzah lie, Rachel thluo athaalieta cawsaa pahning naa taw'a yi. Iema ta nama kyihuo khata, “Huv riypata naa tha hnuochuopa laa tie kha ama hmung tli, ata hing ca na paa ca laa cuo khata a palung rie thyi li tli pata nama cuo hing tana a palung rie a thyi, ‘I sacapaa kawlie hing khaapama i tue aa?’ a ta byalya, aca ta'a yi.

Cakhutaata capa taa cata si vie'a cate Tabor lie mathliy kung lie na chiypa khata Bethel lie Khazing'a luo a khawpa cawsaa pathung tie khata capa lie ca acaa taw'a yi; pakha ca mietaata sathung kha aa pawle aa, a hrangpa pakha ta viechuo tluo thung a phyale aa, cakhutaata a hrangpa pakha ta mingsuvtiy savang ungthyi zung kha a phyale aa.
Iema ta bie caa chang'a yi te, viechuo tluo hning ca pi'a yi te naa hluo'a yi.

Cakhutaata Gibeath-elohim luo kha na va chiy aa, Filistin riekaphuv tie awnapa lie, capa lie, khy luo na va phapa khata, abiena hmang taata zaa kaapa profet phuv kha ca tingtuolepa, karuv-akhang, ramang, hne tingtuo hneta profetbiephu ama za rile pata naa taw'a yi.
Cakhutaata Abyipathlaapa kha na cunglie tlung'a te, iema hne cata profetbiephu ri rale'a cate, cawsaa hrangpa ta naa li aa.
Capa pamangsana ca naa taw tiyta, a pha na tapa kha tue tie, tahematapakieca Khazing na caa awpuo.

Cakhutaata kama hmieluo khata Gilgal luo kha sibung la, cakhutaata myirue panaana hne aviesaa panaana pihluo riypata nama'a luo kha i zuv aa. Nama'a luo a zuv'a angte khaapama na tue aa tapa ica changna te ta ning sariy ina huo'a ciy,” a ta.
Saul ta Samuel kha thuse riypata aa pali ning kha Khazing ta pathiypalung hrangpa a pi; cakhutaata hingpa pamangsana bangkhuo hing capa ning lie ca a tling.
Capa taa cata si yi te Gibeah ama chiy tiyta, profet phuv tie khata amaa taw; Khazing thlaapa ta a vya hryi te iema hne khata profetbiephu a ri rale.
Ahluo ta ama zaa pachangpa tie khata profet tie hneta profetbiephu a rilepa kha ama hmung tiyta, “Kish sacapaa cunglie hing khaapama a tlung? Saul zaw hing profet tie hrawlie ma a aw ra?” amaa ta.
Capa lie a awpa cawsaa pakha ta, “Iema tie ama paa hing ahungtama a cuo?” a ta. Caacuonakawta, “Saul zaw hing profet tie hrawlie ma a aw ra? tapa ca ri phungpa ta aa li.
A profet bierina kha a chuo tiyta ing luo kha a cakuo.
Saul a paasyi ta ama hne satliepa kyihuo khata, “Khaapa luo ma nama vaa? a ta yi. Ama ta, “Laa huv riypa tana ma si; hmung khu aw va tli ima ta taata Samuel'a luo kha ma cakuo,” a ta
Saul a paasyi ta, “Samuel ta khaapama aca chang tapa kha na chang tie,” a ta.
Saul ta a paasyi kyihuo khata, “Ama ta laa ca ama hmung mangtli malie a ta,” a ta. Cuorasala siepahruo cuona kaw hne aa patuvpa Samuel ta a ripa kha ca khaapahmuo chang vyi.
Samuel ta cawsaa kha Mizpah lie, Abyipa'a luo kha kupahmya yi te,
iema kyihuo khata, “Israel ming Khazing, Abyipana, ‘Israel ming kha Izipt taata ca pyakhyi yi angte Izipt ming kuv taata hne niema caa tuechiepa pena bangkhuo tie kuv chungtaata ica khuo yi,’ a ta.

Cuorasala ataning hing niema ta, vuochina bangkhuo hne nama palungriethyina taata caa khuopa yi nama Khazing kha thaw ung cate, niema ta, “Cuo vyi! cuorasala ma cunglie hing siepahruo pakha chi tie,” nama ta. Caacuonakawta ata hing ca Abyipahmiekunglie kha nama phang cyicuo hne nama chung cyicuo khata vya pya tie ung,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Samuel ta Israel phang bangkhuo kha hmieluo papya yi te, Benjamin phang ca vyisung a da pata a tlawpa ama cuo.

Benjamin phang ca a chungkhue a chungkhue ta hmieluo papya yi te, Matri chungkhue ca vyisung a da pata a tlawpa ama cuo. A hnangcaw ce ta ca Matri ingchungkhue tie kha a mingpang a mingpang khata hmieluo papya yi te, Kish sacapaa Saul ca vyisung a da pata amaa tlaw. Cuorasala ama kha ama huv ca hmung khu va yi.
Caacuonakawta Abyipakha hiehriy pakhaa yi te, “Cawsaapa ca hingpa luo hing a vaw ma?” ama ta. Cakhutaata Abyipata, “Mang tie ung, chechiy zaw hrawlie tana aa nu,” a ta.
Cakhutaata a ruo yi te capa taa cata amaa vawkhyi. Cawsaa hrawlie aa daa tiyta, cawsaa mekaa laata a luv hne a letung cung ca aa suo vie.

Samuel ta cawsaa bangkhuo kyihuo khata, “Khazing ta aa tlawpa paa hing nama hmung ma? Cawsaa bangkhuo hrawlie ama haapa pakha hmuo aw va yi,” a ta. Cakhutaata cawsaa bangkhuo ta khi yi te, “Siepahruo ca a chuo pasiy se!” ama ta.
Samuel ta cawsaa kha siepahruo nawhnyina hne re kaw kha a chang yi; cakhutaata caa-uv chunglie cape te Abyipahmiekunglie kha a chi. Cakhutaata Samuel ta cawsaa bangkhuo kha ama ing luo a pakaa sa yi.
Saul zaw Gibeah lie a ing luo kha cakuo te, Khazing ta ama pathiypalung a tawpa rieka tie kha ama'a lie ama cakuo ra.

Cuorasala a laliy lipa cawsaa chekha ta, “Hingpa cawsaa hingta tuokhaatama malie a khuo khu aa?” ama ta. Iema ta ama ca nutaa yi te lasaw khaapahmuo cyipa va yi. Cuorasala ama ca a dieta tah a aw thluo. Ammon ming siepahruo Nahash ta Gad ming hne Reuben ming kha khuosa ta a tuechie yi. Jordan cahriy lie a awpa Israel ming ahunghmuo Ammon siepahruo Nahash ta a cacuoluo ming a cakhyi lipa aw vayi. Cuorasala Ammon ming'a taata a ruo yi te Jabesh-gilead luo a ngiepa cawsaa thawsariy ama aw.

Thla kha khutaata, Ammon ming Nahash ca sithaw te, Jabesh-gilead kha a cadung; cakhutaata Jabesh lie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo ta Nahash kha, “Kiema hneta biekuona caa mingthuvna tue la na re na ma hrie aa,” ama ta.

Cuorasala Ammon ming Nahash ta iema kyihuo khata, “Nama cacuoluo ming kha ca cakhyi diy'a yi angte, cahaacata Israel ming bangkhuo cunglie nangzaa hmiechina i patlung kie dyina niema hneta biekuona caa mingthuvna i tue aa,” a ta.

Jabesh uvthyi tie ta ama kyihuo khata, “Kiema ta Israel ruo chung bangkhuo ta biephyatuv ma pathlie the riypata ning sariy chung malie a ngie caw tie. Cakhutaata, kiema malie a khuo riypa pakha hmuo a aw li kieca, kiema hne kiema tah nama'a luo kha maacaa pi aa,” ama ta.
Biephyatuv tie kha Saul awnapa Gibeah luo chiy yi te, cawsaa thyi pata hmang a chiy a cuopa kha ama pathyi tiyta, cawsaa bangkhuo ca khuopuv ta ama caa.
Saul ca cuetungpa kha vya paziyle te lu taata a vya chiy; cakhutaata Saul ta, “Cawsaa zaw hing khaapanakawma ama caa?” a ta. Caacuonakawta Jabesh khy ming'a taata bie kha ama chang.
Capa bie ca Saul ta a thyi tiyta Khazing thlaapa cahrana ca Saul cunglie kha tlung te khuosa ta a hi a haa.

Ama ta cuetungpa tue kha la te aa ce diy khutaata biephyatuv tie'a taa khata Israel ruo bangkhuo khata paphya te, “Saul hne Samuel ziy riypata a pya lipa bangkhuo ca, a cuetungpa zaw cungliena hing haa hingta tue pata a cuo aa!” a ta. Cakhutaata Abyipaciyna kha cawsaa zaw cunglie tlung te, iema ta cawsaa pakha haa khata ama pya.
Bezek lie a pahmya tiy yi ta, Israel taata ting thung, Judah taata thaw sawsariy ama pha.

Iema'a luo a vawpa biephyatuv tie kyihuo khata, “Jabesh-gilead ming kyihuo khata hing haa hingta ri tie ung: ‘Mawluo ning a kya palingpa khiy ta khuona nama hmung aa,’ ta pata va chang tie ung,” ama ta. Biephyatuv tie ta ama chang tiyta khy ming ca ama palung a tluosa.
Caacuonakawta Jabesh ming ta, “Mawluo thue ta kiema'a na kiema ta niema'a luo kha maacaa pi'a yi, niema ta a pha nama tapa haa khata kiema kha malie tue tie ung,” ama ta.

A mawluopa ca Saul ta cawsaa kha phuv thung ta a chi yi. Mawdiy khata Ammon ming arina hmang luo kha a ngie yi te ning a palingna te khata ama thie; cakhutaata a hring kaliepa tie ca a chepatlaa diy yi te pahning ta a awhnepa aw va yi.
Cawsaa zaw ta, Samuel kyihuo khata, “Saul ca ma malie a uv aa, a tapa tie ca ahung zaw tama ama cuo? Iema kha malie pi tie, thie naase yi puv” ama ta.
Cuorasala Saul ta, “Ataning hing pakha hmuo thie pata cuo'a vyi, tahematapakieca Abyipana Israel ming kha hyazangna malie a pi,” a ta.
Samuel ta cawsaa zaw kyihuo khata, “A vaw tie ung, Gilgal luo si'a ung pate siepahruo cuona kha pathaa'a ung puv,” a ta yi.

Caacuonakawta Gilgal luo kha si yi te, capa Gilgal lie ca, Abyipahmiekunglieta Saul kha siepahruo ta ama pacuo sa. Capa lie ca Abyipahmiekunglie kha aviesaa panaana pihluo yi te hriykhungrina ama tue, capa lie ca Saul hne Israel ming bangkhuo ca khuosa ta ama palung a tluo.
Samuel ta Israel ming bangkhuo kyihuo khata, “Ina changpa ung ciy bie bangkhuo ca naathliepa yi angte, siepahruo ica padaapa mangtli yi.

Mang tie ung, ata hing ca siepahruo na luo caa chiy tli yi. Kama ca macuo angte i suo a paa tli, cuorasala i sacapaa zaw ca niema'a lieta ama aw. Mingnu i cuo baataata ata tepa hingta niema kha luo ica chiy tli yi.

Hingpa lie hing i aw hing; Abyipahmiekunglie hne chiytiy a thuvpa paa hmiekunglie kha na syisaa pachiy tie ung. Ahung cuetungpa ma i la buo? Acuolikie ahung laa ma i la buo? Acuolikie ahungma i dung buo? Ahungma i tuechie buo? I ming naa pacue riypata ahung kuv taata ma nawthuv i la buo? Ri tie ung, ica thung'a yi,” a ta.
Iema ta, “Malie dung buo vaciy, malie tuechie buo vaciy, ahung kuv taata khaapahmuo la buo vaciy,” ama ta.

Ama ta iema kyihuo khata, “Niema ta i kuv lie khaapahmuo hmung va ung ciy tapa kha Abyipaca nama cunglie bie pachangtuv cuo te a sathu pathuv pa ca ataning lie hing bie pachangtuv ta a cuo,” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Ama ca bie pachangtuv ta a cuo,” ama ta.
Samuel ta cawsaa zaw kyihuo khata, “Moses hne Aaron kha re pi yi te, nama mingchingmingvuo tie Izipt ruo taata a pyakhyipa yi Abyipana bie pachangtuv ta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Abyipahmiekunglie niema kha bieripa riypata a daa hmang kha la tie ung, Abyipata niema hne nama mingchingmingvuo tie cuota a tuepa khuona re bangkhuo kha niema'a lie phu naase ang.

Jakob ca Izipt ruo chung luo si te Izipt ming ta ama tuechie tiyta, nama mingchingmingvuo tie ta Abyipakha padang yi te, Abyipata Moses hne Aaron kha a za pathliepa yi. Iema ta nama mingchingmingvuo tie kha Izipt ruo taata pyakhyi yi te hingpa hmang lie hing khy ama pasa sa.

Cuorasala iema ta Abyipaama Khazing kha ama maw nakawta Hazor Siepahruo Jabin riekabyipa Sisera kuv chung luo, hne Filistin tie kuv chung luo hne Moab siepahruo tie kuv chung luo kha zaa yi te, iema ca ta a du yi te ama tuv.

Cakhutaata iema ta Abyipa'a luo kha khi yi te, ‘Abyipakha thaw pate Baal hne Astartes re kha ma hrie nakawta ma sue tli; cuorasala ata hing ca ma carie tie kuv chung taa hingta malie khuo la, na re kha ma hrie aa,’ ama ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Jerubbaal hne Barak, hne Jepthah, hne Samson kha vya pathlie yi te, nama carie tie kuv chung taa khata a kuo vyicuo taata ca palaw sa yi te aa bangsa pata nama aw.

Cuorasala Amor siepahruo Nahash acaa dupa yi kha nama hmung tiyta, Abyipanama Khazing ca nama siepahruo a cuo thluopa khata, niema ta kama kyihuo khata, ‘Cuo vyi, cuorasala siepahruo na malie a uv aa,’ ina ta ung ciy.
Mang tie ung, niema ta namaa tlawpa hne niema ta namaa hiepa siepahruo ca hingpa lie hing a aw hing, Abyipana niema nama cunglie siepahruo pakha a chi tli.

Abyipakha ciy ung cate, a re kha hrie pata a ueryi kha naathlie ung cate, Abyipanawbie kha namaa du li kieca, cakhutaata niema hne caa uvtuv siepahruo ta Abyipanama Khazing kha nama ziy kieca a pha aa.
Cuorasala Abyipaueryi kha naathlie lipa ung cata, Abyipanawbie kha namaa du kieca Abyipakuv ta niema hne nama siepahruo kha aa du aa.
Caacuonakawta ata hing ca a daa ung la nama hmungnapa lie Abyipata a tue riypa hingpa hmang lepa hing mang tie ung.

Ataning hing jungsacuo uo ning tana a cuo cuo va ma? Abyipakha u'a angte, ama ta khalung hne khytiy kha a pathlie aa; cakhutaa cata niema ta nama cuota siepahruo a hiena ta Abyipahmungna lie nama tuepa pha lina ca a le tapa kha pachang'a ung cate nama hmung aa,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta Samuel ta Abyipakha u te, Abyipata capa ning lie ca khalung hne khytiy kha a za pathlie; cawsaa bangkhuo ta Abyipahne Samuel kha ama ciy laalaw.

Cawsaa bangkhuo ca ta Samuel kyihuo ta, “Ma thiy li riypata na changtaapa zaw cuo hingta Abyipana Khazing'a luo kha thlaachuo tie; tahematapakieca ma suena bangkhuo cunglie kha kiema cuota siepahruo a hie pate pha lina ma be chiy tli,” ama ta.

Cakhutaata Samuel ta cawsaa zaw kyihuo khata, “Ciy khah ung; hingpa pha lina bangkhuo hing nama tue tli, cuorasala Abyipanama ziyna taa khata pie khah ung, nama pathiypalung yalya ta Abyipare kha hrie tie ung;
cakhutaata thlahnena a hnyi lipa hne caa khuo khu lipa yi a thlahne lipa hmang kha a maahnue khah ung.
Tahematapakieca a lepa a ming thueta Abyipata a cawsaa zaw kha thaw'a va yi, niema kha a cawsaa ta tue riypa khana Abyipapalung a patluo.
Ca hlyitaw taata, niema cuo thlaachuo li pata Abyipa'a lie i sue riypa ca kama hneta a hla se; a phapa hne aa hmuopa luopuv khana niema kha ica cawpa'a yi.
Abyipadyi kha ciy ung la, nama pathiypalung yalya ta Abyipare kha zang tluo aa tlasa pata hrie tie ung; nama cuota khaapa hmang lepa ma a tue tapa kha pacuo tie ung.
Cuorasala pha lina khana nama tue kalie tapa kieca, niema hne nama siepahruo hneta paviepa tana nama cuo aa,” a ta yi.
Saul ca pena hruo aa pathu ning kha kung . . . ta cuo te Israel ming kha kung . . . hne kung hning a uv yi.
Saul ta Israel ming thaw thung kha aa tlaw yi; thaw hning ca Mikmash hne Bethel tluocung ruo lie kha Saul hneta aw yi te, thaw kha ca Benjamin phang tie khy Gibeah lie kha Jonathan hneta ama aw.
Jonathan ta Geba lie a awpa Filistin riekaphuv kha te yi te, capa ca Filistin ming ta ama thyi. Cakhutaata Saul ta, “Hebru ming ta thyi yi se!” ta pata ruo chung bangkhuo luo kha hmyakaa a tung.

Saul ta Filistin riekaphuv a tepa kha Israel bangkhuo ta ama thyi tiyta, hne Israel ming ca Filistin ming cuota hue aa chiypa ama cuopa kha ama pachang tiyta, Gilgal lie Saul a pahlaw riypa khata cawsaa ca ama u.

Filistin ming ca Israel tuv riypa khata aruole thaw sawthung hne aruo rieka thaw caruv hne ngiekuo lie viehnang zaa a tapa rieka kha amaa pahmya; kya sithaw yi te Beth-aven ningchiyluo Mikmash lie kha arina hmang amaa tue.

Israel ming ta iema ca palungriethyina chungliena ma aw tapa kha ama hmung tiyta (rieka kha ama vya cadisa mangtli), cawsaa ca alung karaw hne khue chunglie hne alungpuvnung chunglie hne thluo chunglie hne tiy-ing chunglie zaw kha amaa nu.
Hebru ming chekha ca Jordan cavaa kha va te yi te Gad hne Gilead ruo luo kha amaa ruo. Saul ca Gilgal lie kha aw te, cawsaa bangkhuo ca ta thlaazangsapa hne amaa cathangsa pata ama ziy.
Samuel ta bie a kuo siypa ning, ning sariy te a huo; cuorasala Samuel ca Gilgal luo kha a vaw vyi, cakhutaata ca cawsaa ta Saul kha amaa pe se.
Caacuonakawta Saul ta, “Myirue panaana hne aviesaa panaana kha kama'a luo vya cyi tie ung,” a ta yi. Cakhutaata myirue panaana kha a pihluo.
Myirue panaana a pihluo khu pahne ta Samuel ca a vya chiy; Saul ca pya te ama kha a taw te saluo a pi.

Samuel ta, “Khaapama na tue,” a ta. Saul ta palie te, “Cawsaa ta inaa pesepa yi kha i hmung tiyta hne bie ina kuo siypa ning lieta na vya chiy li tiyta hne Filistin cawsaa kha Mikmash lieta amaa hmya ciemuo nakawta,
Kama ta Abyipa palungtluona i tue li liepa hingta ma Filistin ming ta Gilgal lie kama'a luo hing inaa zuvchiy'a yi,’ ta angte na i hripuosa pata myirue panaana hing i pihluo,” a ta.
Samuel ta, “Angaapa hmang tue tana na tue; Abyipana Khazing ta aca pipa nawbie kha ziy vaciy. Ziy la ca, Abyipata na pena hing Israel ming cunglie chuozaa ta a pahmang sa thluo aa,

cuorasala ata hing ca na pena kha a pazue'a vyi; Abyipata ama palung a hmungpa kha a huv tli; cakhutaata Abyipata a cawsaa cunglie uvtuv cuo riypata a pi tli, tahematapakieca Abyipata bie aca pipa kha ziy vaciy,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Samuel ta ama kha thuse te Gilgal taa khata Benjamin pe Gibeah luo kha a si. Aa ngaapa cawsaa tie ca rieka tie hne a pahlaw riypata Saul kha ziy yi te, Gilgal taata Benjamin pe Gibeah luo kha ama sithaw.
Saul, a sacapaa Jonathan, hne iema hneta a awpa cawsaa zaw ca Benjamin pe Geba lie kha ama aw; cuorasala Filistin ming ca Mikmash lie kha amaa ri.
Filistin ming ca rie tuv riypata arina hmang taa khata phuv thung ta pya yi te, phuv kha tie ca Shual ruo lie Ofrah luo khata ama si.
A hrangpa phuv tie ca Beth-horon luo khata si yi te, a hrangpa phuv tie ca Zeboim bawphie ruocaapa luo suonapa tluo luo khata ama si.
Israel ruo chung yalya lie kha su a sapa pakha hmuo hmung khu pata cuo vyi, Filistin ming ta, “Hebru ming ca iema cuota zueziy hne asyi kha a sa'a va yi,” ama ta nakawta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Israel ming bangkhuo ca the haa, pawzung, ahryi, tuokyi tapa tie chaa riypa khata Filistin luo kha ama zuv taw.
A muo ca the haa suokha hne pawzung suokha cuota shekel che thung che hning, ahryi suokha chaa riypata hne asyi suokha cahre riypata shekel che thung che kha ta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta rietuv cuo ning kha Saul hne Jonathan'a lie a awpa ahungtahmuo zueziy hne asyi hnyi va yi, cuorasala Saul hne a sacapaa Jonathan ca ama hnyi.
Cakhutaata Filistin rieka phuv kha tie ca Mikmash luopuv luo kha ama va si.
Ning kha ca Saul sacapaa Jonathan ta a cehre a cyituvpa satliepa kyihuo khata, “A vaw la huesuo luo Filistin riekaphuv tie'a luo hue vaa'a puv,” a ta. Cuorasala a paa kha chang vyi.
Saul ca Gibeah athaata lie Migron khy lie cale kung rawlie kha a aw. Ama hne a awpa rieka ca zacaruv hraw ta ama cuo.
Shiloh lie zaa awpa Abyipatluobyi Eli sacapaa Finehas a sacapaa Ikabod a nuta Ahitub sacapaa Ahijah zaw tluobyi buohryi kha a hryi te capa lie ca a aw ra.

Jonathan a vaapa kha cawsaa ta pachang va yi. Jonathan ta Filistin riekaphuv tie'a luo vaa riypata a tingpa luopuv lie ca a kuo hning ta lungkuo aw kaluo te, suokhapa a ming ca Bozez, ta yi te a hrangpa suokhapa a ming ca Seneh ama ta.
Suokha ca chaluo ta Mikmash khy luo kha cuose, a hrangpa suokha ca sungluo ta Geba luo kha cuose amaa hmie pachaw.

Jonathan ta a cehre a cyipa satliepa kyihuo khata, “A vaw tie, hingpa vangdaw a te lipa riekaphuv tie'a luo hing vaa'a puv; Abyipata kiema cuota re hrie ngiethie'a va ma, tahematapakieca Abyipata khuona a tue riypa hing cawsaa ma hluv ma caw cunglie hing a pahnie vyi,” a ta.
A cehre a cyituvpa ta, “Na palung khingna haa khata tue thluo tie. Nama'a liena i aw, na ruenapa haa ca tana i ruenapa a cuo ra,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Jonathan ta, “Ata hing ca huepa cawsaa tie'a luo hue vaa'a pate na maa pahmung sa'a yi.
Iema ta kiema kha, ‘Niema'a luo maa vawna te ta malie huo tie ung,’ malie ama ta kieca iema'a luo kha khaw'a valie puv.
Cuorasala iema ta, ‘A khaw tie ung,’ malie ama ta kieca Abyipata iema kha ma kuv chung luo malie a pi pata a cuo aa. Capa ca kiema cuota pamangsana ta a cuo aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta ama pahning ca ta Filistin riekaphuv tie kha amaa pahmung sa; cakhutaata Filistin ming khata, “Mang tie ung, Hebru ming na amaa nunapa khue chungtaata a khaw yi,” amaa ta.

Riekaphuv tie ca ta Jonathan hne a cehre a cyituv kha za u yi te, iema kyihuo khata, “Kiema'a luo hing a khaw tie ung, suokhakha ca pahmung'a yi puv,” ama ta. Jonathan ta a cehre a cyituvpa kyihuo khata, “Na kya ziy tie; Abyipana iema ca Israel ming kuv chung luo malie a pi tli,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Jonathan ca a vathaw te, a cehre a cyituvpa ta a paziy. Jonathan hmielie kha Filistin ming ca a lie yi te, a cehre a cyituvpa zaw ta a hnangluo taa khata a vya thie ra yi.
Jonathan hne a cehre a cyituvpa ta ama tuepa a yikhanapa thiena lie ca ekaah a che tluv a kupa chunglie kha Filistin ming cawsaa pakiy tluv ama thiy.
Arina hmang, lu, hne cawsaa bangkhuo hrawlie kha thlaazangna khuopuv ta tlung te riekaphuv tie hne hmaasa riekaphuv tie kha hmuota amaa cathang diy; aling a siy te thlaazangna lepuv a tlung.
Cakhutaata Benjamin pe Gibeah lie a awpa tie Saul rievetuv tie ta suo yi te cawsaazaapuv ca cavyi cacuo ta amaa ruo patlawpa kha ama hmung.

Cakhutaata Saul ta ama'a lie a awpa rieka tie kyihuo khata, “Ming u ung la ahungma kiema'a lie a aw va tapa kha pachang tie ung,” a ta. Ming ama u ca, Jonathan hne a cehre a cyituvpa kha aw li pata ama aw.
Saul ta Ahijah kyihuo khata, “Khazing biekuona thingkaw kha hingpa luo hing vya cyi tie,” a ta. Tahematapakieca capa cuo ning ca Khazing biekuona thingkaw ca Israel ming'a lieta a si ra.
Saul ta tluobyipa hne bie a ri nguoluo ning kha Filistin ming arina hmang lieta khi-una ca a le vie hryly, caacuonakawta Saul ta tluobyipa kyihuo khata, “Na kuv kha a da pakhaa tie a ta,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Saul hne ama'a lie a awpa tie ca a pakiy yi te rietuvna chung luo ca amaa ngie, Filistin ming ca iema hne iema kha zueziy ta a du yi te chungzing pata amaa kalaa diy.
Cakhutaata capa hluo cata Filistin ming'a luo khaw yi te iema hne a awpa tie kha a pali yi te Saul hne Jonathan tie'a lie a awpa Israel ming hne khata amaa pahlaw.
Cahaacata Efraim tluocung ruo lie aa nupa Israel ming bangkhuo khata Filistin ming na a ruo yi tapa ama thyi pahne khata, rietuvna luo kha a vya pahlaw yi te amaa cade ra.

Caacuonakawta capa ning lie ca Abyipata Israel kha tena a pi. Rie atuvna ca Beth-aven va law te khata ava pha, Saul hneta a awpa rieka ca ama bangkhuo ta thawhraa hraw ama ta. Rie atuvna ca Efraim tluocung ruo te khata a va pha.

Cakhutaata Saul ta Israel ming cunglie kha aa pahraasa pata hmang tue te, “Kama ta i carie tie i te hluo li yi, zuoluo te ta sa a ningpa ca chiesa pata cuose,” a ta. Caacuonakawta rieka pakha hmuo sa ning va yi.
Rieka bangkhuo ca khyitiy a awnapa ruo chung luo kha ama pha.
Rieka tie kha ruo chung luo ama pha tiyta, khyitiy ca a diy ta a ngie te a tla nguoluo raalaa pata ahungtahmuo ama pakaa luo a tuv va yi, tahematapakieca chiesana kha na ama ciy.

Cuorasala a paa ta rieka tie kha chiesana ta bie a kuopa yi ca Jonathan ta pachang vyi; caacuonakawta a kuv lie aa hriepa asung daw khata khyisaluv kha daw te a kuv ta khyitiy kha a pakaa luo aa tuv ca a ming kha a vya sing.
Cakhutaata rieka pakha ta ama kyihuo khata, “Na paa ta rieka tie kha chiesana ta biekuo yi te, ‘Ataning sa a ningpa ca chie se,’ a ta, a ta. Rieka tie ca ama hy diy tli.
Cakhutaata Jonathan ta, “I paa na ruo hing ruvna a pi; hingpa khyitiy a cawta i ning nakawta i ming a vuo viepa hing mang tie ung.
Rieka tie hingta ama carie tie'a taata ama lapa hruosue hing ama khing zaa ta ning yi sala kha tluv tama a pha vie aa; tahematapakieca Filistin ming hing muo a hluv vie ma thie khu'a yi ta,” a ta.
Capa ning lie ca Filistin ming kha Mikmash taata Aijalon te ta ama thie, rieka tie ca ama hy diy.
Caacuonakawta rieka tie ca hruosue kha a zuhnue yi te, tuv hne cuetungpa hne cuetaata zaw kha la yi te, alyi lie kha thie yi te, a thiy cangta ama ning.

Cakhutaata capa kaw ca Saul'a kha chang yi te, “Mang tie, rieka tie ca saa kha a thiy cangta ce yi te na Abyipa'a lie kha ama sue,” ama ta. Cakhutaata ama ta, “Biekuo na nama para tli; hingpa i hmiekunglie hing alung lepa kha vya pahlang tie ung,” a ta yi.

Saul ta, “Rieka chung bangkhuo khata a pathyi sa ung la iema kha chang tie ung, ‘Ama bangkhuo ta ama cuetungpa zaw acuolikie ama tuv zaw kha a vya cyi yi sala hingpa lie hing thie yi sala ning yi se, cuorasala a thiy hneta ningnapa ta Abyipa'a lie kha sue khah yi se,’” a ta. Caacuonakawta rieka bangkhuo ta capa zuo lie ca ama cuetungpa kha a vya cyi yi te capa lie ca ama thie.
Saul ta Abyipacuota bienatluophie kha a sa; capa ca ama ta Abyipacuota a sa taapa bienatluophie tana a cuo.

Cakhutaata Saul ta, “Filistin ming'a luo kha zuo ta zuv ung sala mawluo khydyina te ta para ung siy; cawsaa pakha hmuo pangaa khah ung siy,” a ta. Iema ta, “A pha na tapa kha tue tie,” ama ta. Cuorasala tluobyi ta, “Hingpa lie hing Abyipakha a ngie ung siy,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Saul ta Khazing kyihuo khata, “Filistin tie kha zuv pata i zaa cade'a yi ma? Iema kha Israel ming kuv chung luo na pi'a yi ma?” a ta. Cuorasala capa ning lie ca ta ama kha palie vyi.
Saul ta, “Cawsaazaapuv luochiytuv nama bangkhuo ta hingpa luo hing a vaw tie ung; hingpa suena hing tuokhaatama ataning hing a pya tapa kha huv'a ung puv.

Tahematapakieca Israel a khuotuv Abyipaa hringpa haata, hingpa hing i sacapaa Jonathan chunglie a cuo kie zawma, a thiy hrahring aa,” a ta. Cuorasala cawsaa bangkhuo hraw taa khata ahungtahmuo palie va yi.

Ama ta Israel ming bangkhuo kyihuo khata, “Niema kha kuokhaluo ta, hne kama hne i sacapaa Jonathan kha a hrangpa kuokhaluo ta ma cuo aa,” a ta. Cawsaa tie ta Saul kha, “A pha na tapa kha tue tie,” ama ta.

Cakhutaata Saul ta, “Vya AbyipaIsrael Khazing, khaapanakawma na changtaapa hing ataning ina palie vaciy? Hingpa suena hing kama acuolikie i sacapaa Jonathan cunglie a aw kie zawma, Vya AbyipaIsrael Khazing, Urim paluo sa la; cuorasala hingpa suena hing na cawsaa Israel ming cunglie a aw kieca Thummim paluo sa tie,” a ta. Cakhutaata Jonathan hne Saul cunglie kha tla te, cuorasala cawsaa zaw ca ama pathe.
Cakhutaata Saul ta, “Kama hne i sacapaa Jonathan alalalie kha vyisung ca a da tie,” a ta. Cakhutaata Jonathan cunglie kha a tla.

Cakhutaata Saul ta Jonathan kyihuo khata, “Khaapama na tue tapa kha na chang tie,” a ta. Jonathan ta, “I kuv lie a awpa asung daw tana khyitiy a cawta kha i ning; lie hing na i aw, i thiy thluo aa,” a ta.
Saul ta, “Jonathan, nama ca na thiy hrahring aa, Khazing ta i cunglie hing capa haa khata hne capa laa khata a ruv vie ta tue se; a ta.

Cakhutaata cawsaa tie ta Saul kyihuo khata, “Israel chunglie hingpa tena a tuetuv Jonathan ca ma a thiy aa? Abyipaa hringpa haata a suobuv buv kha hmuo alyi luo tla'a vyi; tahematapakieca ama ca ataning hing Khazing hneta muo a hrie ta,” ama ta. Caacuonakawta cawsaa ta Jonathan kha palawsa yi te, ama ca thiy vyi.
Cakhutaata Saul ca Filistin ming a cade riypa kha pathli te, Filistin ming ca ama awna hmang luo kha ama si.

Saul ta Israel ming cunglie siepahruo a cuo tiyta, a kuo bangkhuo ta a awpa a carie tie kha a tuv yi. Moab ming, Ammon ming, Edom ming, Zobah siepahruo tie, Filistin ming tapa tie kha aa du yi; aa dupa mekaa kha a te yi.
Rie phasa pata hrie te, Amalek ming kha thie yi te Israel ming kha a parapa tie kuv taata hya a pazang yi.
Saul a sacapaa zaw ca Jonathan, Ishvi hne Malkhishua ta ama cuo. Cakhutaata a sacanung pahning tie ama ming ca: a uvthyinung ming ca Merab ta cuo te, a syinung ming ca Mikhal ta a cuo.
Saul a napuvnung ming ca Ahinoam ta a cuo, Ahimaaz sacanung ta a cuo. Cakhutaata a riekabyi le cepa ca Abner ta cuo te Saul a paa uvta Ner sacapaa ta a cuo.
Saul a paa ca Kish ta cuo te, Abner a paa Ner ca Abiel sacapaa ta a cuo.
Saul a chuo lie bangkhuo ca Filistin ming kha khuopuv ta aa du yi; Saul ta a thaaruvpa hne a riephapa a hmung kie yi ca a re hrie riypata a la lawmaw yi.
Samuel ta Saul kyihuo khata, “Abyipana a cawsaa Israel ming cunglie siepahruo cuo riypata nama kha sathu pathuv riypata naa pathlie; caacuonakawta Abyipabie kha naathlie tie,” a ta.
Hing haa hing tana Cungnungce Abyipata a ri, ‘Israel ming Izipt taata ama pya ningta amaa duna kawlie kha Amalek ming ca kama ta duo i te'a yi.

Ata hingta si la Amalek kha a du la, ama hnyipa bangkhuo kha para diy karue tie; khaapahmuo pangaa'a vaciy, cuorasala canung capaa ta li, haatiyta hne haaseta ta li, kala-uv hne laa ta li pata na thie diy'a yi,’” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Saul ta cawsaa kha kupakiy yi te, Telaim lie kha mingluv a ri yi, phyi rieka ting hning, hne Judah rieka thawhraa ama ta.
Saul ca Amalek ming khypuv luo kha pha te bawphie chunglie kha arina hmang a la.

Saul ta Ken ming kyihuo khata, “Cakuo ung la pya tie ung! Amalek ming chung taa khata pya tie ung, caacuolikieca iema hne kha tana ica parapuo pathlyi'a yi; tahematapakieca niema ca Israel ming Izipt taata ama pya ning kha ama bangkhuo cunglie kawpacuona a paluo sapa tana nama cuo,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Ken ming ca Amalek ming'a taa khata ama pya.
Saul ta Amalek ming kha Havilah taata Izipt ningchiyluo ta a awpa Shur te khata a te yi.
Ama ta Amalek siepahruo Agag kha a hringpa ta patuv te, cuorasala cawsaa bangkhuo kha ca zueziy ta a thie diy karue yi.

Saul hne cawsaa tie khata Agag hne tuv hrawlieta a pha cepa hne sahring hrawlieta a pha cepa, hne a thupa tie, tuvtaata tie, hne a muo ruvpa bangkhuo kha para karue lipa yi ta; khing aa chiy lipa tie hne a muo a ruv lipa bangkhuo dyi kha ama para karue.
Abyipabie ca Samuel'a luo kha pha te:
“Saul kha siepahruo ta i za pacuosapa ca i ngiepachiy, tahematapakieca kama ziyna taa khata a pali te i nawbie kha ziy va tli,” a ta. Samuel ca a hi haa te Abyipakha zuokhydyi ta a ku.

Samuel ca Saul a taw riypata mawdiy ta a thu, cakhutaata Samuel kha hing haa hingta ama chang, “Saul ca Karmel luona a si, ama huota a thyi parina lungbang na aa bang, a kaa luo ta Gilgal luo kha a caluo,” ama ta.
Samuel ca Saul athaa luo kha a chiy tiyta, Saul ta ama kyihuo khata, “Nama ca Abyipata thluechiy ca pi se; Abyipabie biepina kha i tue tli,” a ta.
Cuorasala Samuel ta, “Cahaacata a cuo kie i naa lie tuv khipa ueryi, hne sahring khipa i thyipa ca khaapatama a cuo?” a ta.

Saul ta, “Amalek ming'a taata amaa vya chiypa tana a cuo; tahematapakieca cawsaa zaw na tuv hne sahring a pha cepa tie kha Abyipana Khazing'a luo hriykhungrina ta pihluo riypata a pangaa yi; cuorasala a hrangpa bangkhuo ca ma para karue diy,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Samuel ta Saul kyihuo khata, “Taw caw tie! Abyipata azuohnie ina changpa na ica chang aa,” a ta. Ama ta palie te, “Ri tie,” a ta.
Samuel ta, “Nama naa hmungna lieta cawsaa cawta tah cuo ra hmuo la, Israel ming mingphang zaw luv tana na cuo, cuo va ma? Abyipana Israel cunglie siepahruo ta sathu caa pathuv.
Cakhutaata Abyipata re suokha hrie riypata ca pathlie te, ‘Vaa la a suepa Amalek ming kha va para karue yi la, ama chuona te ta va tuv tie yi,’ aca ta.
Cata a cuo kieca khaapanakawma Abyipaueryi kha naathlie lipa cata na aw? Khaapanakawma hruosue kha a zuchiy cate Abyipahmiekunglie hmang pha lipa kha na tue?” a ta.
Saul ta Samuel kyihuo khata, “Abyipaueryi kha i ziy, Abyipata ina pathliepa re luo kha i si, Amalek siepahruo Agag kha i vya chiy, cakhutaata Amalek ming kha i para diy karue yi.
Cuorasala cawsaa ta hruosue taata tuv hne sahring, para riypa tapa chungtaata a pha cepa chechiy tapa tie kha Gilgal lie Abyipana Khazing'a luo hriykhungrina ta pihluo riypata ama la tli,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Samuel ta, “Abyipata a ueryi ziy riypa lie aa lawna a lepa tluv hingta myirue panaana hne hriykhungrina lie hing alawna a hnyi ra'a ma? A khingna ziypa ca hriykhungrina laata pha vie te, ri-angiena ca tuvtungpa thu laata a pha vie.

Tahematapakieca a duna ca hmungdawluna a tuepa laata a caw viepa suena cuo vyi, palunglena zaw hing pha lina hne kuvtuezuv a biepa haa tana a cuo. Tahematapakieca nama ta Abyipa bie kha thaw tli cate, Abyipazaw ta nama kha siepahruo cuona taata aca thaw tli,” a ta.
Saul ta Samuel kyihuo khata, “I sue mangtli; tahematapakieca cawsaa kha ciy yi angte ama bie kha i ziy nakawta Abyipanawbie hne nama bie kha i para mangtli.
Caacuonakawta, thlaa na i chuo, i suena kha naa ngiethe la, Abyipakha i bie the riypata kama hne hingta kaa'a puv,” a ta.
Samuel ta Saul kyihuo khata, “Nama hneta kaa'a va ang; tahematapakieca nama ca Abyipabie khana na thaw; cakhutaata Abyipata nama ca Israel ming cunglie siepahruo cuona taata aca thaw tli,” a ta.
Samuel ca a hrang luo cakuo riypata aa pali ca, Saul ta a buohryi pasiypa a daw kha patuv te a buohryi pasiypa ca a tlaa.
Cakhutaata Samuel ta ama kyihuo khata, “Ataning caci hing tana Abyipata Israel pena kha nama'a taata thlaachi tli te, nama laata a pha viepa na ingpaa kha a pi tli,” a ta.
Ca hlyitaw taata, Israel Rungnaana ta a cuopa ca hang vyi, a palung zaw thle'a vyi, ama ca a palung a thle riypata cawsaa ta hmuo a cuo lipa puv,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Saul ta, “I sue mangtli; cuorasala i cawsaa zaw ama uvthyi tie hne Israel ming hmiekunglie hing pa-uvsathyina na pi la kama hne hingta vya kaa ra tie, Abyipana Khazing ca i bie khu riypata,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Samuel ta Saul ca kaakhyi te Saul ta Abyipakha aa bie.
Cakhutaata Samuel ta, “Amalek ming siepahruo Agag kha hingpa kama'a luo hing a vawkhyi tie ung,” a ta. Agag ta thiyna taa tana i law tli ta pata rue te palung tluosa pata aa vaw.

Cuorasala Samuel ta, Na zueziy ta canung zaw kha saata li pata a tuepa haa yi ta, na nung zaw ca canung zaw hrawlie kha haatiy lipa tana a aw ra aa,” a ta. Cakhutaata Samuel ta Agag ca Gilgal lie Abyipahmiekunglie kha aa ce patlaa diy.
Cakhutaata Samuel ca Ramah luo kha a si; Saul ca a ing luo, Saul khy Gibeah luo kha a si.
Samuel ta Saul kha a thiy ning te ta hmung pakhaa va tli, cuorasala Samuel ca Saul kawlie kha a ngie a chisa. Cakhutaata Abyipaca Saul kha Israel cunglie siepahruo ta a tue nakawta aa ngie pachiy.

Abyipata Samuel kyihuo khata, “Saul kawlie hing khacuo ma ngiechi pata na aw aa? Ama ca Israel siepahruo cuona taata i thaw mangtli. Na sathu-ung lie kha olif thu raw la pya tie; Bethlehem lie Jesse'a luo khana ica pathlie aa, tahematapakieca a sacapaa zaw chungtaata siepahruo riypata i tlawpa na a aw,” a ta.
Samuel ta, “Tuokhaatama i si khu aa? Saul na a thyi tapa kieca ina thie aa,” a ta. Cakhutaata Abyipata, “Cuelaanung sakha kha la lah, ‘Abyipa'a luo hriykhung a ri riypa tana i vaw,’ na ta aa.
Jesse kha hriykhungrina luo ca hry la, na tue riypa kha ica chang aa; cakhutaata a ming ica changpa kha sathu na pathuv aa,” a ta.
Abyipata bie a pipa kha Samuel ta a tue, cakhutaata Bethlehem luo kha aa vaw. Khy uvthyi tie ta amaa cathangpuo pata ama kha a vya taw yi te, “Diena hneta a vaw ca ma?” ama ta.

Ama ta, “Diena hne tana Abyipa'a lie hriykhungrina tue riypata i vaw; niema'a na niema kha a pathe ung la hriykhungrina tue riypata kama'a luo kha a vaw tie ung,” a ta. Cakhutaata Jesse hne a sacapaa zaw kha pathe sa yi te, hriykhungrina luo kha a hry yi.
Iema ca amaa vaw tiyta, Eliab kha mang te, “Abyipasathu pathuvpa ca Abyipahmiekunglie a awpa hing tana a cuo hrahring tli,” a ta.

Cuorasala Abyipata Samuel kyihuo khata, “A hmingsuo hne a pangruepa ta mang khah, tahematapakieca ama ca i thaw tli; tahematapakieca Abyipaca cawsaapa ama mangnazya haa khata mang vyi; iema ca aleluo cuona khana ama mang, cuorasala Abyipaca pathiypalung khana a mang,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Jesse ta Abinadab kha ku te, Samuel hmiekunglie kha a cakuo sa. Ama ta, “Hingpa paa zaw hing Abyipata a tlaw vyi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Jesse ta Shamma kha ava cakuo sa. Ama ta, “Hingpa paa zaw hing Abyipata a tlaw vyi,” a ta.
Jesse ta a sacapaa zaw pasariy Samuel hmiekunglie ca a cakuo sa yi. Cakhutaata Samuel ta Jesse kyihuo khata, “Abyipata iema pakha hing hmuo a tlaw va yi,” a ta.

Samuel ta Jesse kyihuo ta, “Na sacapaa bangkhuo hingpa lie hing ama aw ma?” a ta. Cakhutaata ama ta, “A syi cepa a aw kalie raalaa, cuorasala ama ca tuv na a khie,” a ta. Cakhutaata Samuel ta Jesse kyihuo khata, “Va paku sa yi la hingpa luo hing a vawkhyi tie; tahematapakieca hingpa luo hing ama aa vaw hluo li ta a tu'a vapuv,” a ta.

Va paku sa yi te, a chung luo a zaa ngiekhyi. Ama ca a sapatiy se pinglingta khata a ming padyi puvthesapa, a chiythesapa ta a cuo. Abyipata, “Thu la sathu kha va pathuv tie; tahematapakieca ama hing tana a cuo,” a ta.

Samuel ta sathu-ung kha la te, a uvnu zaw hmiekunglie kha sathu a pathuv; cakhutaata capa ning taa cata Abyipathlaapa ca David cunglie kha cahrana hneta a tlung. Cakhutaa cata Samuel ca a tha te Ramah luo kha a si.
Abyipathlaapa ca Saul kha thuse te, Abyipa'a taata thlaapa pha lipa ta ama kha a rie a pathyi.
Cakhutaata Saul changtaapa tie ta ama kyihuo khata, “Mang tie, Khazing'a taata thlaapa pha lipa na rutla caa pazang.
Ma byipaapa ta nama caa mangsangpa na changtaapa zaw hing tingtuo a tung thepa huv riypata bie malie pi tie; thlaapa pha lipa na cunglie a aw tiyta, ama ta tung'a te na tluo aa,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Saul ta a changtaapa tie kyihuo khata, “A tung thepa pakha na hmungpa ung la, kama'a luo a vawkhyi tie ung,” a ta.

Satlie pakha ta vya palie te, “Bethlehem khy ming Jesse sacapaa, tingtuo a tung thesapa, cawsaa riephapa, rietuv a thepa, bieri thuori lie singna a hnyipa, a chiythesapa pakha na i hmung; cakhutaata Abyipaca ama'a lieta a aw,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Saul ta biephyatuv tie kha Jesse'a luo pathlie yi te, “Tuv hneta a awpa na sacapaa David kha kama'a luo na vya pathliepa tie,” a ta.
Jesse ta laa sakha kha la te, viechuo, mingsuvtiy savang ungthyi zung kha, hne mietaata sakha kha a sacapaa David'a taata Saul kha a paphya.
Cakhutaata David ca Saul'a luo kha a vaw te a re luo kha aa ngie. Saul ta duesa te, a cehre cyituv ta aa li.
Saul ta Jesse'a luo kha cawsaa pathlie te, “David ca i re lie hing aw thluo se, tahematapakieca i palung na ina hmungsa,” a ta.

Cakhutaata thlaapa pha lipa kha Saul cunglie a tlung kyry ta, David ta tingtuo kha la te a kuv ta a tung taw, ca tiyta Saul ca a thaa thu te a tluo vie taw, cakhutaata thlaapa pha lipa ta ama kha a pyase taw.
Filistin ming ta ama rieka tie kha rietuv riypata ama pahmya; Judah ruo Sokoh lieta a hmya yi te, Sokoh hne Azekah alala, Efes-dammim lie kha amaa ri.
Saul hne Israel ming ca a pahmya yi te, Elah bawphie lie kha a ri yi te Filistin ming tuv riypata hmang ama la.
Filistin ming kha kuokhaluo ta tluo cunglie kha a daa yi te, Israel ming kha a hrangpa kuokhaluo ta tluo cunglie kha amaa daa, amaa lalalieta bawphie a aw.
Cakhutaata Filistin ming arina hmang taata a thaaruv cepa a ming Goliath ama tapa Gath khy ming a dang daw caruv kha kha a suopa kha a vya pya.
A luv lie daa lakhuv a khuv te, thaa buohryi cungpakaw pakaw yi te, a thaa buohryi cungpakaw aa riyna ca shekel thawpangaa ta a cuo.
A phyi kha daa a pakaw te, a letung lie daa asyi aa ya.
Aa syi ca thetluo tie ta te, aa syi haa thaa ca shekel zacaruv aa riy. Cakhutaata aa phya a cyituv ca a hmieluo khata a si.

Ama ta a kya daa te Israel rieka kha, “Khaapanakawma rietuv riypata pya ung cate hmang nama la? Kama ca Filistin ming cuo angte, niema ca Saul a changtaapa ta cuo va ung ca ma? Cawsaa pakha a tlaw ung la, ama ca kama'a luo hing a zuv se.

Ama ta kama kha naa du sala ina thie kieca kiema ca niema sii ta cuo'a pate niema re kha ma hrie aa; cuorasala ama kha kama ta te angte i thie kieca, niema ca kiema sii ta cuo'a ung cate kiema re kha nama hrie aa,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata Filistin cawsaapa ca ta, “Ataning hing Israel rieka tie ca kama ta icaa zue icaa tie yi! Cawsaa pakha na pi ung la a tuv naase puv,” a ta.
Saul hne Israel ming bangkhuo ta Filistin cawsaapa ueryi ca ama thyi tiyta ama palung chuo te ama ciy hringhruo.
David ca Judah ruo, Bethlehem khy lieta Efrath chungpa Jesse ama tapa paa sacapaa ta a cuo, Jesse ca sacapaa pacari a hnyi. Saul chuo lie kha capa paa ca macuo tli te a kung a tluv tli.
Jesse sacapaa pathung tie ca Saul kha rietuvna luo ama ziy. Rietuvna luo a sipa a sacapaa zaw pathung tie ama ming ca, sa uvthyi Eliab, hne a paziypa Abinadab, hne a pathungnapa Shammah ta ama cuo.
David ca a syi cepa ta a cuo; a uvthyi tie pathung ca Saul kha ama ziy.
Cuorasala David ca Bethlehem lie a paa tuv khie riypa khata Saul'a taa khata a sibung a sithaw.
Filistin cawsaapa ca maw hne zuo hne ning sawliy chung kya pya te aa kya daacie taw yi.
Jesse ta a sacapaa David kyihuo khata, “Na uvta zaw cuo khata vierue ephah suokha hne viechuo tluo hraa a la lah, na uvta zaw arina hmang luo kha a catlisa pata si tie;
cakhutaata iema thawkha tie luo a chiytuv cuo khata cuehnungkaa tluo hraa phyapa tie yi. Na uvta zaw tuokhaatama ama aw tapa kha va mang yi la, iema'a taata pachangsana chekha vya phya mya,” a ta.
Saul hne a uvta zaw hne Israel ming bangkhuo ca Elah bawphie lie aw yi te, Filistin ming hneta amaa tuv ningta a cuo.

David ca mawdiy ta thu te, tuv kha a khietuv hneta thuse te, ning riypa kha phya te Jesse ta a changpa haa khata a si. Rieka tie kha rietuvna hmaa luo pya yi te rietuvna ue ta ama khi nguoluo ning khata arina hmang luo kha a pha.
Israel ming hne Filistin ming ca rie a tuv riypata rieka phuv kha hne phuv kha kha a mang pa-e pata ama aw.
David ta chechiy kha a mangchiytuv'a lie chi siy te, rieka tie'a luo kha vaa ruo te a uvta zaw kha bie avaa chang yi.

Iema hne bie ama ri nguoluopa khata Gath khy ming Goliath ama tapa, a thaaruv cepa Filistin cawsaapa ca Filistin rieka tie hmang lana taa khata kya pya te a hluo haa khata bie ca a ri. Capa ca David ta a thyi.
Israel ming bangkhuo ca cawsaapa kha ama hmung tiyta, ciysa yi te amaa ruo.

Israel ming ta, “A kya pyapa hingpa cawsaapa hing na hmung ma? Israel ming a zuetie riypa hrahring tana a kya pya. Ama a thiepa hing ca siepahruo ta lasaw a hluvsa pi'a te, a sacanung zaw kha pi'a te a ingchungkhue kha ngukhyi a payi'a yi,” ama ta.

David ta athaalie a daapa tie kyihuo khata, “Hingpa Filistin cawsaapa hing thie te Israel ming kha thuochina taata a palaw satuv ca a cuota khaapama tuepa pata a cuo aa? Hingpa vangdaw a te lipa Filistin cawsaapa hing a hringpa Khazing rieka tie a zuetie riypata ahungtama a cuo?” a ta.
Cawsaa zaw ta palie yi te, “Hingpa paa a thiepa hing ca ma ripa haa kha tana a cunglie tue pata a cuo aa,” ama ta.

A uvta a uvthyi cepa Eliab ta cawsaa tie'a lie a ripa kha thyi te David cunglie kha khuosa ta a hi a haa. Ama ta, “Hingpa luo hing khaapama na za tue? Ruocaapa lieta tuv a cawta kha ahung'a lie ma na chi siy? Na palung chiehruvpa hne naa zangtuvpa kha ica pachang; rietuvna mang riypa tana naa zuv,” a ta.
David ta, “Khaapama i tue e? Bie muo kaa kha i hiehriy lie,” a ta.
Ama'a taata a hrang luo kha a pali te a ri tawpa kha a ri pakhaa; cawsaa tie ta a hluo haa khata ama palie pakhaa.
David ta a ripa kha ama thyi tiyta, Saul kha ama va chang; cakhutaata ama kha a pa-u sa yi.
David ta Saul kyihuo khata, “Ama kawlie hingta ahunghmuo ama palung chuo khah se; na changtaapa hingna vaa'a angte hingpa Filistin cawsaapa hing vaa du'a ang,” a ta.
Saul ta David kyihuo ta, “Nama ca hingpa Filistin cawsaapa a du riypata vaa khu'a vaciy; tahematapakieca nama ca khuvthaata tah cuo cate, ama ca a satlieta baataa tana rieka ta a za cuo tli,” a ta.
Cuorasala David ta Saul kyihuo khata, “Na changtaapa hingta i paa cuota tuv khie taw angte, chingde acuolikie cavaw ta tuvtaata kha tuvrung chunglie a vya sie tiyta, a cade angte,
thie angte tuvtaata kha a pakaa taata i thue taw. Inaa vya palichiy kieca a hrakuo khata patuv angte, alyi china angte i thie taw.

Na changtaapa hingta chingde zaw cavaw zaw kha thie taw angte, hingpa vangdaw a te lipa Filistin cawsaapa hing ca a hringpa Khazing rieka tie aa zuetie nakaw yi hingta capa tie saruopa sakha haa cata na a cuo thluo aa,” a ta.

David ta, “Chingde pating taata hne cavaw pating taata naa khuopa Abyipana hingpa Filistin cawsaapa kuv taa hingta naa khuo aa,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Saul ta David kyihuo khata, “Vaa la, Abyipata ca awpuo mang sue!” a ta.
Saul ta David kha a rieka cawsie hne cehre kha a pahryi; a luv cunglieta thaalakhuv kha a pakhuv, thaa buohryi kha a pahryi.

David ta rieka cawsie hne cehre cunglie ca Saul a zueziy kha aa ya, a cakuo pachiy'a nang ca cakuo khu vyi, tahematapakieca cahaapa ca a hryi buo vyi. Cakhutaata David ta Saul kyihuo khata, “Hingpa zaw cang hingta ca cakuo the va ang; tahematapakieca i hryi buo li nakaw tana a cuo,” a ta. Caacuonakawta David ta a caw ca a thlie.

Cakhutaata ama ta a khuecahryi kha a la te, cavaa lie a mekalangpa alung aa pangkalangpa suopangaa kha a tlaw te, a tuvkhie sahrie chung luo kha a pasuo. A cisie kha a kuv lie a hrie te, Filistin cawsaapa'a luo kha a vaa ngie.
Filistin cawsaapa ca a vaw te a hmielie ta aa phya a cyipatuv hne khata David kha aa vya ngie.
Filistin cawsaapa ta David kha a hmung tiyta, a esesa, tahematapakieca David ca a sapatiy se pinglingta khata a chiythesapa satlieta tah a cuo.
Filistin cawsaapa ca ta David kyihuo khata, “Uv ta cuo angte ma asung hneta inaa vawchiy ciy?” a ta. Cakhutaata Filistin cawsaapa ca ta David kha a khazing tie ming ta chie a sa.
Filistin cawsaapa ca ta David kyihuo khata, “Kama'a luo ca a vaw la na saa kha avuo lie a zupa pavaa zaw, ruo lie saruopa zaw kha pi naase yi ang,” a ta.

Cuorasala David ta Filistin cawsaapa kyihuo cata, “Nama ca kama'a luo kha zueziy hne asyi hne asyipuv a vya cyi cate naa vaw; cuorasala kama ca nama ta naa zuetiepa, Israel rieka tie Khazing, Cungnungce Abyipaming tana i vaw.

Ataning hrahring hingta Abyipata nama kha kama kuv chung luo na pi'a te, ca thie'a angte na luv kha ica te aa; cakhutaata Filistin rieka a thiypa tie riyy kha avuo lie pavaa zaw hne alyi lie saruopa zaw kha i pi'a yi. Cahaacata chuelyi bangkhuo ta Israel ming hrawlie na Khazing a aw tapa kha ama pachang aa.

Cakhutaata hingpa lie aa pungpa bangkhuo hingta Abyipaca zueziy hne asyi ta khuona a tuepa cuo vyi, rietuvna hing Abyipahuopa tana a cuo tapa kha ama pachang aa; niema ca ma kuv luo pi pata nama cuo aa,” a ta.
Filistin cawsaapa khata David kha aa vya ngie vie tiyta, David ca Filistin cawsaapa hne a taw riypa khata hmieluo kha a catlisa pata aa ruo.
David ta a kuv kha a sahrie luo capya te, alung aa pangkalangpa suokha kha la te Filistin cawsaapa puocariy lie kha ava sie ca a hmieluo ta a nepakhuv te alyi lie kha aa lie.
Cahaacata David ta Filistin cawsaapa kha cisie hne alung aa pangkalangpa suokha ta a te, David ta a kuv lie zueziy a cyi li pata Filistin cawsaapa kha a thie.

Cakhutaata David ca vaa ruo te Filistin cawsaapa cunglie kha aa da; a zueziy kha patuv te, a baw taata a da te, a thie, cakhutaata a zueziy cata a luv kha a te. Filistin cawsaa tie ta ama thaaruv cepa paa na a thiy tli tapa kha ama hmung tiyta amaa ruo.

Israel ming hne Judah ming ta ama khipuo pata thu yi te, Filistin ming kha Gath hne Ekron hukaa te khata amaa cade, caacuonakawta hmaa a phyapa Filistin cawsaa tie ca Shaaraim taata Gath hne Ekron te khata luopuv lie kha ama laa patlawle.
Israel ming ca Filistin ming a cadena taa khata vya kaa yi te, amaa rina hmang kha ama hrue diy.
David ta Filistin cawsaapa luv kha la te Jerusalem luo a phya; cuorasala a rieka cawsie hne cehre ca a thluodaa lie kha a thuse.

Filistin ming a du riypata David a pyapa kha Saul ta a hmung tiyta, riekabyi le cepa Abner kyihuo khata, “Abner, hingpa paa hing ahung sacapaa tama a cuo?” a ta. Abner ta, “Vya siepahruo, nama na hringpa haata, pachang va ang,” a ta.
Siepahruo ta, “Satliepa ca ahung sacapaa ma tapa kha khieluo tie ung,” a ta.
Filistin cawsaapa a thiena taata David a vya kaa tiyta, Abner ta vaakhyi te a kuv lie Filistin cawsaapa luv hne khata Saul hmiekung luo a chiykhyi.
Saul ta ama kyihuo khata, “Satliepa, ahung sacapaa tama na cuo?” a ta. Cakhutaata David ta, “Kama ca Bethlehem khy ming na changtaapa Jesse sacapaa tana i cuo,” a ta.
David ta Saul'a lie a bie ripa a pachuo pahne ta, Jonathan hringna ca David hringna lie kha a biepuo te, Jonathan ta ama hringna aa duepa tluv khata a due.
Capa ning lie ca Saul ta ama kha la te a paa ing luo pakaa sa khing va tli.
Cakhutaata Jonathan ca David hne khata biekuona a tue, tehematapakieca ama hringna tluv tana a due.
Jonathan ta ama aa hryipa buohryi pasiypa kha thlie te David kha a pi, cakhutaata a rieka cawsie hne cehre, hne a zueziy hne a liy hne a tesaw te kha a pi.

David ca Saul ta a pathlienapa khaapa luo a cuo zaw si te hluetlingna a hmung; caacuonakawta Saul ta rieka tie uvtuv byi ta a chi. Capa ca cawsaa bangkhuo, Saul changtaapa tie te ta ama palung a tling.

David ta Filistin cawsaapa kha thie te ing luo ama vya kaale pata, Israel khy bangkhuo taata canung zaw ca Siepahruo Saul daw riypata hlaa sapuo luopuo pata karuv-akhang hne tungpa chechiy zaw hne khata ama pya.
Cakhutaata canung zaw ca alawna ama tuepuopa khata hlaa a palie yi te, “Saul ta a thaw thaw ta a thie yi, David ta a saa saa ta a thie yi,” ama ta.

Capa ama ripa ca ta Saul ca a palung patluo li pata khuopuv ta a hi a haa. Ama ta, “David ca a saa saa tana a thie ta yi te, kama tlaku ca a thaw thaw tana a thie ina ta yi; pena ta li pata ca khaapama a hnyi vie riypa a aw tli,” a ta.
Capa ning taa cata David ca aa ngiepatlie tli.

A mawluopa ta Khazing'a taata thlaapa chiepa kha Saul cunglie tlung te, ningting ta a tue tawpa haata David ta tingtuo a tungpa nguoluo ning kha a ing chunglie kha a mya a laa pata bie kha a ri nguoluo thluo. Saul ca asyi kha a kuv lieta a hrie te,
“David kha tlepie lie aa cathiypuona te ta cakha naase ang,” ta pata aa syi ta a cakha. Cuorasala David ta yi hning aa phe hmuo.
Saul ta David kha a ciy; tahematapakieca Abyipaca ama hne khata aw te, cuorasala Saul ca a pyase tli.
Caacuonakawta Saul ta David ca ama'a taata palaw te, thawkha uv riypata a tue; David ca rieka tie kha uv yi te cawsaa hmielie kha a pya aa ngie a ta pari.
David ca a hmang tuepa bangkhuo lie kha tena a hmung, tahematapakieca Abyipaca ama'a lie kha a aw.
Saul ta tena lepuv na a hmung tapa kha a hmung tiyta, a ciy hryly.
Cuorasala Judah hne Israel bangkhuo ta David ca a ma due; tahematapakieca ama ca iema kha luochiy yi te ama hmielie kha a pya aa ngie pari.

Cakhutaata Saul ta David kyihuo khata, “Hingpa lie hingna i sacanung uvthyi Merab a aw; ama hingna na napuv riypata ica pi aa; i cuota na rie pha sala Abyiparieduna ca a du tie,” a ta. Tahematapakieca Saul ta, “A cunglie i kuv pathlie'a va ang; Filistin ming kuv ta thiy lavuo,” ta pata a rue.
David ta Saul kyihuo khata, “Kama ca ahung ta cuo angte ma i tieriy Israel ming hrawlie i paa ingchungkhue ca ahung ama cuo nakawta ma siepahruo piepa ta i cuo aa?” a ta.
Cuorasala Saul sacanung Merab ca David hne a chiyhie riypa a cuo a phapa khata Meholah ming Adriel'a luo kha napuv ta a pi.
Cuorasala Saul sacanung Mikhal ta David kha a khing. Saul kha ama chang ca, capa ca ta a palung a patluo.
Saul ta, “I sacanung ca a cuota cyihyi a cuona riypata hne Filistin ming kuv ca a ma a dutuv a cuona riypata, ama hing i pi aa,” ta pata a rue.
Caacuonakawta Saul ta David kha a yihningnapa ta, “Ata hing ca nama ca i piepa tana na cuo aa,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Saul changtaapa tie ta capa bie ca David kha ama chang. Cakhutaata David ta, “Siepahruo piepa cuo riypa ca hmang taata tama nama rue? Kama ca siypasa saa ta cuo angte pachangtuv zaw a hluvsa hnyi va ang,” a ta.
Saul changtaapa tie ta, “David na cahaacata a ta,” ta pata ama chang.

Cakhutaata Saul ta, “Siepahruo ta a carie tie cunglie phuv a la riypata, Filistin tie vangdaw zakha ta li pata ca napuv muo khaapahmuo khing vyi, ta pata David ca va chang tie ung,” a ta. Filistin tie kuv ta David thiy naase, tapa kha Saul ta khue a khuo.
A changtaapa zaw ta David kha ama chang tiyta, David ca siepahruo piepa cuo riypa khata a palung a patluo. Cuo a chuo hluo khata,

David ca a cawsaa zaw hne khata thu te, si yi te Filistin ming zakha kha a thie yi. Ama vangdaw kha za phya te siepahruo piepa cuo riypata siepahruo'a luo ca a tlingsa pata a pi. Saul ta a sacanung Mikhal kha napuv ta a pi.
Cuorasala Saul ta Abyipana David'a lie a aw tapa hne a sacanung ta a khingpa kha hmung te a pachang tiyta,
Saul ca David kha a ciy hryly. Caacuonakawta Saul ca capa cuo taa cata David cariepa ta a cuo.

Cakhutaata Filistin riekabyi tie kha rietuv riypata ama vya pya tiyta; ama vya pya kyry khata David ta Saul changtaapa tie bangkhuo laa khata tena a hmung vie pari, caacuonakawta a ming ca khuosa ta a pathuo.
Saul ta a sacapaa Jonathan hne a changtaapa bangkhuo tie hne khata David thie riypa kaw kha a ri. Cuorasala Saul sacapaa Jonathan ta ca David kha a tlechuosa.
Jonathan ta David kyihuo khata, “I paa Saul na caa thie khing; caacuonakawta mawluo maw ta ca a raaring la, aa cakungna hmang lieta aw la a nu tie.
Nama na awnapa ruo lie, i paa athaalie kha a daa'a angte, nama kaw kha i paa ca i rue aa; suokhakha i pachangpa a aw kieca nama kha ica chang aa,” a ta.

Jonathan ta a paa Saul'a lie kha David thuophaa kha ri te, a paa kyihuo ta “Siepahruo ta a changtaapa David cunglie kha suena tue khah se, tahematapakieca na cunglie suena tue vyi, a tuepa hing na cuota a phapa se tana a cuo,

a hringna a pi pata Filistin ming kha tuv yi te, Abyipata Israel ming bangkhuo cuota tena lepuv a tue. Capa ca nama ta hmung cate na palung a tluo; caacuonakawta, khaapanakawma a kawluo aw li pata David thiena kawlieta suena a hnyi lipa thiena suena ca na tue aa?” a ta.
Saul ta Jonathan bie ripa kha thyi the te, “Abyipaa hringpa haata ama ca thie pata cuo'a vyi,” ta pata chie aa sa.
