Caacuonakawta Jonathan ta David kha u te hmang a cuopa bangkhuo ca a chang. Cakhutaata Jonathan ta David ca Saul'a luo kha a vawkhyi te, ama ca a hluo ning haa khata Saul hmiekunglie ta a aw.
Rie a duna aw pakhaa te, David ca Filistin ming tuv riypata aa tha pakhaa. Iema ca a hluvsa a thie nakaw yi ta a hmiekung taata amaa ruo.
Cakhutaata Saul ca asyi kha a kuv lie a hrie te ing chunglie aa tu nguoluo ning, David ta tingtuo a tung nguoluo ning kha Abyipa'a taata thlaapa chiepa ca Saul cunglie kha a tlung.
Saul ta David kha asyi ta tlepie lie aa tipuona te cakha aa zue; cuorasala Saul ta aa phe se hmuo nakawta asyi ca tlepie lie kha aa capang. Capa zuo ca David ca a ruo te a law.

Saul ta ama kha mawdiy ta a thie thena riypata David ing luo kha mangpathliy riypata cawsaa a pathlie yi. David napuvnung Mikhal ta ama kyihuo khata, “Ata zuo lie hing na hringna kha naa khuo li kieca, mawluo maw ta ca thie pata na cuo aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Mikhal ta David kha thlaluo-aw taata pachung te, a ruo te a law.
Mikhal ta kuvtuezuv kha la te, iehmang lie kha a pazie; mie hming lahya kha pahy te pang a buv.
Saul ta David kha patuv riypata cawsaa a pathlie tiy yi ta, ama ta, “A pasa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Saul ta iema hrahring ta David kha mang riypata cawsaa a pathlie yi. “A iehmang hne khata kama'a luo a kya sawle ung la ama kha thie naase ang,” a ta.
A pathliepa tie kha ing chung luo amaa ngie tiyta, kuvtuezuv ca iehmang cunglie kha a luv lie mie hming pang aa buv pata a za aw.

Saul ta Mikhal kyihuo khata, “Khaapanakawma hing haa hingta na dung cate, i cariepa ca a law riypata na paruo?” a ta. Mikhal ta Saul kyihuo khata, “Ama ta kama kyihuo khata, ‘Cakuo'a ang; khaapanakawma nama ca ica thie aa?’ ina ta,” a ta.
David ca a ruo te a law; Ramah lie Samuel'a luo kha a vaw te Saul ta a cunglie a tuena bangkhuo kha a chang. Ama hne Samuel ca Naioth luo kha si yi te capa lie ca ama aw.
Saul kha, “David na Ramah pe Naioth lieta a aw,” ta pata ama chang.

Cakhutaata Saul ta David kha la riypata cawsaa a pathlie yi. Iema ta profet phuv ca profet bie ama ri patlawpa hne Samuel kha iema luochiytuv ta a awpa kha ama hmung tiyta, Khazing thlaapa ca Saul ta a pathliepa cawsaa tie cunglie zaw kha zaa hryi te, iema zaw profet bie rina luo kha amaa phung ra.

Saul kha ama chang tiyta, cawsaa hrangpa a pathlie yi ca iema zaw profet bierina chung luo ca amaa phung ra. Saul ta a yithungna ta cawsaa kha a pathlie yi, cuorasala iema zaw ca profet bierina chung luo kha amaa phung ra ngiethie.

Cakhutaata ama hrahring kha Ramah luo ca a vaa. Seku ama tapa takhue lesapa luo a chiypa khata, “Samuel hne David ca khaapaliema ama aw?” ta pata a hiehriy yi. Cawsaa pakha ta, “Iema ca Ramah pe Naioth liena ama aw,” a ta.
Ramah pe Naioth luo kha a si ca Khazing thlaapa kha a cunglie a tlung. A silepa khata Ramah pe Naioth khy a phana te ta profet bie kha a rile.

Ama zaw a caw kha thlie ra te, Samuel hmiekunglie kha profet bie a ri ra. A cahripa khata ning kha hne zuo kha chung ca a laa. Caacuonakawta, “Saul zaw profet tie hrawlie ma a aw ra?” ta pata ripa a cuo.
David ca Ramah khy Naioth taa khata aa ruo. Jonathan'a luo kha vaa te, “Khaapama i tue? Khaapama i suena ta a cuo? Na paa cunglie khaapa sue angte ma i hringna ina la khingpa hingta a cuo?” a ta.

Ama ta, “Cuo hrahring vyi! Thiy'a vaciy. I paa hingta hmanglepa cuose, hmang cawta cuose kama pachang sa li pata khaapahmuo tue vyi. Khaapanakawma i paa ta capa ca kama'a taata a nu aa? Nu hrahring'a vyi,” a ta.

Cuorasala David zaw ta chie a sa te, “Na paa ta kama cunglie duena na hnyipa kha a phasa pata pachang te, ‘Jonathan ta hingpa hing ca pachang thathang khah se, a palung na a pasa aa,’ tapa tana a rue aa. Cuorasala hmisi ta ripa kieca, Abyipahring te nama zaw na hringpa haata kama hne thiyna alalalie hing kyi kha hliy dyina a aw,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Jonathan ta David kyihuo khata, “Na ripa bangkhuo ica tuepa aa,” a ta.

David ta Jonathan kyihuo khata, “Mawluo khiy thla thaapa ningta cuo te siepahruo hne saningna lie aw riypa kha i palaw riypata cuo vyi; cuorasala ruo chunglie kha a ning thungnapa zuo te ta i nu the riypata cakuo thi'a ang.
Na paa ta ina padang biephung kieca, ‘Ama ingchungkhue yalya ta hriykhungrina hnyi yi te na Bethlehem luo si riypata khuosa ta paa ina kie na ta aa.'
Ama ta, ‘A pha!’ a ta kieca na changtaapa cuota a pha; cuorasala a hi a haa kieca, pha lina tuena riypa na a rue tapa kha pachang tie.

Caacuonakawta na changtaapa cunglie hing kawpacuona hnyi thi tie, tahematapakieca nama ta na changtaapa hing a pathepa biekuona kha nama hneta ina tuekhyi tli ciy. Cuorasala tuechiepa i hnyi kieca nama hrahring ta na thie tie; khaapanakawma na paa'a luo ca ina cakuokhyi'a ciy?” a ta.
Jonathan ta, “Cahaapa hmang ca na cunglie tlung hrahring'a vyi! Nama'a lie a pha lipa hmang patlung riypa khana i paa ta bie aa chi ta pata a cuo kieca ca chang li pata i aw'a ma?” a ta.
Cakhutaata David ta Jonathan kyihuo khata, “Na paa ta ue a hruopa ta ca palie sala ahungma naa chang aa?” a ta.
Jonathan ta David kha palie te, “A vaw la ruo luo hue si'a puv,” a ta. Caacuonakawta ama pahning ta ruo luo kha ama si.

Jonathan ta David kyihuo khata, “Abyipa, Israel Khazing ca pachangkhyituv cuo mang sue! I paa kha mawluo ata tiy hing hne a ning thungnapa lieta dyapasya'a angte, David'a lie kha a palungphya aa dang thluo kieca, capa ca nama'a luo kha cawsaa pathlie pata ca pachang sa li pata i aw'a ma?

Cuorasala i paa ta nama kha ruvnaana pi riypata aa ting pata, aa bangsa pata na law riypata ica pachang sa li kieca, Abyipata capa laa cata a ruv vie ta Jonathan cunglie kha tue mang sue. Abyipata i paa a awpuopa haata ca awpuo mang sue.
I hring kalie pata a cuo kieca, Abyipaduena zang tluo aa tlapa ca i cunglie paluo sa thi tie; cuorasala i thiy pata a cuo kieca,
Abyipata David carie bangkhuo kha alyi cung taata a pahli diy tiyta, zang tluo naa tlanapa hing i ingchungkhue'a taata chipachung thi khah,” a ta.
Cahaacata Jonathan ta David ingchungkhue hneta biekuona tue te, “Abyipata David carie tie cunglie phuv la mang yi sue,” a ta.
Jonathan ta David a duena kawlie kha chie aa sa pakhaa; tahematapakieca ama hne ama aa duepa haa kha tana a due.
Jonathan ta ama kyihuo khata, “Mawluo khiy thla thaapa ningta a cuo; naa tuna hmang a hri'a nakawta maacaa thyisa aa.
Hezuoning ca za cungbung'a cate ahluo ta naa nuna lie kha a nu'a cate capa lie, lungpung kielie khata na aw aa.
Kama ta cuokaa a kapa haata capa athaalie kha cuoti yi thung i vya ka aa.

Cakhutaata kama ta satlie pakha kha vya pathlie'a angte, ‘Cakuo la cuoti kha vaa haa tie,’ i ta aa. Kama ta satliepa kyihuo khata, Mang tie, cuoti ca nama'a taata hingpa luo kuo hingta a aw kha, a haa tie yi,’ i ta kieca naa vaw riypata a cuo aa, tahematapakieca, Khazing a hringpa haata, na cuota abangna cuo te ciy riypa aw vyi.
Cuorasala kama ta satliepa kyihuo khata, ‘Mang tie, cuoti ca nama khung luo ta a aw kha,’ i ta kieca, cakuo mya, tahematapakieca Abyipana caa cakuo sa.
Nama hne kama ma ripa kawlie hingta ca, Abyipana nama hne kama alalalie hing chuozaa ta pachangkhyituv a cuo,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta David ca ruo chunglie kha aa nu. Thla thaapa a cuo tiyta, siepahruo ca pyisa ning riypata aa tu.
Siepahruo ca ning hrang haa khata tlepie kuo luo a thude lie kha aa tu. Abner ca Saul athaalie aa tu ning kha Jonathan ca aa daa; cuorasala David thude ca a hri.
Capa ning lie ca Saul ta khaapahmuo ri vyi; ama ta, “Khaapa hmang ma a cunglie a tlung; ama ca a pathe li pata na a cuo aa, a pathe li pata na a cuo hrahring aa,” ta pata a rue.

Cuorasala a ning hningnapa, thla thaapa ning a mawluo ning zaw kha David thude ca a hri. Caacuonakawta Saul ta a sacapaa Jonathan kyihuo khata, “Khaapanakawma Jesse sacapaa hing azuochaning hne ataning hne a aw va?” a ta.
Jonathan ta Saul kyihuo khata, “David ta Bethlehem luo a vaa siy riypata hruohra ta paa ina kie;

ama ta, ‘Na pasi sa thi tie; tahematapakieca ma ingchungkhue tana khypuv chunglieta hriykhungrina ma tue, i uvta na capa lie aw riypa ca ta bie naa taa. Caacuonakawta na hmiekunglie na hmiephaa i hmung tapa kieca si ang sala i uvta zaw kha hmung thi yi ang se,’ ina ta. Capa kawlie ca tana Siepahruo cabya luo hing aa vaw li pata a cuo,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Saul hihaana ca Jonathan cunglie kha myi ie ta a ie. Ama ta, “Nama, cawsaa lipa, a du a hmuopa canung sacapaa! Nama nangzaana riypa hne na nung nangzaana riypa tana Jesse sacapaa naa tlaw tapa hing pachang li pata ma i aw aa?

Tahematapakieca Jesse sacapaa alyi lie a hring chung bangkhuo hing ca nama cuose, na pena cuose a hmang buo'a vyi. Ata hingta cawsaa pathlie la kama'a luo a vawkhyi tie, tahematapakieca a thiy hrahring aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Jonathan ta a paa Saul kyihuo khata, “Khaapanakawma ama ca thie pata a cuo aa?” a ta.
Cuorasala Saul ta ama kha asyi ta a cakha; caacuonakawta Jonathan ta a paa ta David thie aa ting hrahringpa kha a pachang.
Jonathan ca a hi haasa pata cabya taa khata thu te thla thaa ning hningna lie ca sa ning li pata a aw, tahematapakieca a paa ta David kha thuochi a paphya nakawta a ngie a chikhyi.
Jonathan ca David hne a taw riypata ama ri paciepa hmang luo kha satlie thaata pakha a chiy te a vaa.
Ama ta satlie thaata kyihuo khata, “I kapa cuoti kha vaa haa tie,” a ta. Satliepa ca a vaa ruopa khata cuoti suokha kha ama khung luo kha a va ka.
Satliepa ca Jonathan cuoti a tlanapa hmang luo kha a vaa tiyta, Jonathan ta u te, “Cuoti ca nama khung luo tana a cuo cuo va ma?” a ta.
Jonathan ta satliepa ca u te, “A pahraa la catli tie, haasaa khah,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Jonathan ta a pathliepa satliepa ca cuoti kha a haa pahraa te a byipaapa'a luo ca aa vaw.
Cuorasala satliepa ca khaapahmuo pachang vyi; Jonathan hne David dyi khata hmang awtuvzya kha ama pachang.
Jonathan ta satliepa ca a cehre kha pi te, “Cakuo la khy chung luo kha phyale tie,” a ta.
Satliepa a cakuo pahne khata, David ca lungpung kie taa khata vya pya te, alyi luo kha aa bung. Yi thung a bung te a pahnuo yi te, pakha hne pakha kha amaa caa. David kha a pasiy vie a caa.

Cakhutaata Jonathan ta David kyihuo khata, “Abyipa ca kama hne nama alalalie aw sala, kama ciypathla hne nama ciypathla alalalie chuozaa ta aw mang sue,” ta pata Abyipaming ta chie maa sa tlipa haa khata, ‘Diena hneta cakuo tie,’” a ta. Ama ca thu te a cakuo; cakhutaata Jonathan ca khypuv chung luo kha a kaa.

David ca Nob khy lie tluobyi Ahimelek'a luo kha aa vaw. Ahimelek ca David a taw riypata aa cathangpuo pata a vaw te, ama kyihuo khata, “Khaapanakawma nama se ta naa vaw, pakha hmuo ca vya ziy lipa yi ta?” a ta.

David ta tluobyi Ahimelek kyihuo khata, “Siepahruo ta re suokha na chang te, ‘Ica pathliena kaw hing ahungtahmuo pachang khah yi se,’ naa ta. Capa hmang tie lie cana maa taw aa ta pata satlie tie hneta bie maa pi tli.
Cakhutaata ata hing, na kuv lieta khaapama na hnyi? Viechuo tluo pangaa na pi tie, acuolikie a aw thathiypa na pi tie,” a ta.
Tluobyi ta David kha palie te, “Viechuo cakhawpa ca hnyi va ang, viechuo pathepa dyina i hnyi, satlie zaw kha canung'a taata a maa pathe pata a cuo kieca,” a ta.

David ta tluobyi kha palie te, “Re suokhakha cuota i cakuo tiyta a cuo tawpa haata canung'a taata maa pathe; khy tlaw cakhaw ning hmuota satlie biphie hing a pathe taw thluo; ataning changchiy hing ca kha tluv tama ama biphie ca a pathe vie aa?” a ta.

Caacuonakawta tluobyi ta viechuo pathepa kha a pi; tahematapakieca Phuovaa viechuo ta li pata viechuo hrangpa aw vyi, capa viechuo ca Abyipahmiekung taata lapa a cuo ning viechuo lungpa ta thle tawpa ta a cuo.
Capa ning lie ca Saul changtaapa zaw chungtaata pakha, Abyipahmiekunglie pa-aw sapa, Saul tuvkhietuv tie hrawlie uvthyi ce ta a cuopa, Edom ming Doeg ama tapa a aw.

David ta Ahimelek kyihuo khata, “Asyi acuolikie zueziy nama'a lie aw va ma? Tahematapakieca siepahruo re hrie riypa kha a pahraa aa hu nakawta i zueziy cuose, i cehre zaw cuose a vya cyi va ang,” a ta.

Tluobyi ta, “Elah bawphie lie na thiepa Filistin cawsaapa Goliath zueziy kha pang ta cataw yi te tluobyi buohryi hnangkaa lieta a aw hue; naa la'a kie a la tie, huepa hue ta li pata a hrangpa aw vyi,” a ta. David ta, “Huepa laa hue ta a pha viepa aw vyi; na pi tie,” a ta.
Capa ning lie ca David ca thu te Saul'a taa khata aa ruo; Gath siepahruo Akhish'a luo kha a vaa.

Akhish changtaapa tie ta ama kyihuo khata, “Hingpa hing ama ruo siepahruo David khata cuo va ma? Ama luopuo pata, ‘Saul ta a thaw thaw ta a thie yi, David ta a saa saa ta a thie yi,’ ta pata pakha hne pakha hlaa ta a palie va yi ma kha?” ama ta.
David ta capa bie ca thyi te Gath siepahruo Akhish kha a ciy hringhruo.
Caacuonakawta iema hmiekunglie kha a awtuvzyazaa kha thle te ama hmungna lie kha aa pangaa sa. Thlake ingchiy lie zaw kha cariy cakhaw te, a cakha-ya hming taata a paciy diy a pangie.
Akhish ta a changtaapa zaw kyihuo khata, “Mang tie ung, cawsaapa a ngaapa hing nama hmung; khaapanakawma kama'a luo namaa vawkhyi?
A ngaapa i hnyi li nakawta ma hingpa cawsaa hing i hmiekung luo namaa vya chiy? Hingpa paa hing i ing chung luo aa ngie riypata a cuo'a ma?” a ta.
David ca capa taa cata pya te Adullam lungkhue luo kha aa ruo; a uvnu zaw hne a paa ingchungkhue tie ta capa kaw ca thyi yi te, capa luo ama'a luo kha ama zuv.
Palungriethyina a tawpa, hne lyibuo a hnyipa, hne palung tling lina a hnyipa tie kha ama'a luo amaa vya hmya; cakhutaata ama ca iema uvtuv ta aa li. Ama'a lie a awpa bangkhuo ca zapaliy hraw ama ta.

David ca Moab ruo Mizpeh luo kha a si. Ama ta Moab siepahruo kyihuo khata, “I cuo hingta Khazing ta khaapama a tue aa tapa i pachangna te ta i nung hne i paa kha nama'a luo vya pa-aw sa thi tie yi,” a ta.
Iema kha Moab siepahruo hne cata a thuse siy yi. Cariekyikuo chunglie David a aw chung bangkhuo kha cahaacata ama aw.
Cakhutaata profet Gad ta David kyihuo khata, “Cariekyikuo chunglie aw pari khah; pya la, Judah ruo luo kha si tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta David ca pya te Hereth atuv chungluo kha a si.

Saul ta David hne ama'a lie a awpa tie ama awnapa khana ama hmung tapa kha a thyi. Saul ca Gibeah lie, tluobu lie a awpa tamarisk kung rawlie kha aa syi kha a cyi te aa tu; a changtaapa zaw bangkhuo ca ama kha cadung yi te amaa daa.

Saul ta ama kha cadung yi te a daapa a changtaapa zaw kyihuo khata, “Niema Benjamin cawsaa zaw, na naathlie tie ung; Jesse sacapaa hingta niema pakha kaluo kha lu hne mingsuv diedung aca pi'a yi ma, niema bangkhuo kha a thaw uvtuv hne a za uvtuv zaw aca pi diy khu'a yi ma?

Khaapanakawma niema bangkhuo hingta kama ca ina raw ung ciy? I sacapaa ta Jesse sacapaa hne a daahne yi te biekuona ama tuepa zaw ahungtahmuo kama'a lie phu va ung ciy. Niema pakha hingta hmuo i cuo ta ngiechina hnyi lipa ung cata, i sacapaa ta ataning a tuepa haa hingta kama a du riypa hne kama a bawkhuo riypata i changtaapa a pasupa zaw hing kama'a lie phu va ung ciy.
Saul changtaapa zaw uvtuv Edom ming Doeg ta, “Jesse sacapaa ca Nob lie, Ahitub sacapaa Ahimelek'a luo aa vawpa kha i hmung;
ama ta Abyipa kha bie hiehriypa te, ning riypa pi te, Filistin cawsaapa Goliath zueziy zaw kha a pi,” a ta.
Siepahruo ta Ahitub sacapaa tluobyi Ahimelek hne a paa ingchungkhue tie, Nob lie a awpa tluobyi tie kha u riypata cawsaa pathlie yi te, ama bangkhuo ca ta siepahruo'a luo kha amaa vaw.
Saul ta, “Ahitub sacapaa, na naathlie tie,” a ta. Ama ta, “Hingpa lie hingna i aw i byipaapa,” a ta.

Saul ta ama kyihuo khata, “Khaapanakawma nama hne Jesse sacapaa ta ina raw ung ciy? Ama kha viechuo hne zueziy pi cate Khazing'a luo bie na hiehriypa, caacuonakawta ataning a tuepa haa hingta ama ta kama kha naa du te, inaa bawkhuo,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Ahimelek ta siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Na changtaapa zaw bangkhuo hrawlie hing David haapa ahungma a aw? Ama ca siepahruo piepa ta cuo te, na ri caa ngiesapa hne na ing chunglie pa-uvsathyipa ta a cuo.

Ama cuo ta Khazing'a luo bie i hiehriypa hing ataning hing a yikhanapa a cuo ma? Cuo vyi! Siepahruo hingta na changtaapa hne i paa ingchungkhue cawsaa pakha cunglie hing hmuo sue malie phaw thi khah; tahematapakieca na changtaapa hingta capa bangkhuo ca a hluv a caw ta suokha hmuo pachang va ang,” a ta.
Siepahruo ta, “Na thiy hrahring aa, Ahimelek, nama hne na paa ingchungkhue cawsaa bangkhuo ta,” a ta.

Siepahruo ta athaalie a daapa a rievetuv kyihuo khata, “A pali la Abyipatluobyi tie hing thie tie yi, tahematapakieca David kuo luo tana amaa daa, ama aa ruopa kha ama pachang, cuorasala kama'a lie phu va yi,” a ta. Cuorasala siepahruo changtaapa tie ta Abyipatluobyi tie thie riypata ama kuv papaa va yi.

Cakhutaata siepahruo ta Doeg kyihuo khata, “Nama, Doeg, a pali la tluobyi tie kha thie tie yi,” a ta. Adam ming Doeg ta a pali te tluobyi tie kha a thie yi; capa ning lie ca ta tluobyi buohryi a hryipa tluobyi sawcari papangaa a thie yi.
Tluobyi tie khy, Nob kha zueziy ta a tuv; canung hne capaa, haatiy hne haaseta, cuetungpa, laa, hne tuv, tapa tie kha zueziy ta a thie yi.
Cuorasala Ahitub sacapaa Ahimelek sacapaa zaw chungtaata pakha ca law te David'a luo kha aa ruo.
Abiathar ta David kha, Saul na Abyipatluobyi tie a thie yi tapa kha a chang.
David ta Abiathar kyihuo khata, “Edom ming Doeg ca khapa lie a aw ning khata i pachang tli, ama na Saul kha a chang ngiethie aa. Na paa ingchungkhue tie thiy riypata i tue tlamu tli cahaw!
Kama'a lie hing aw la, ciy khah; tahematapakieca i hringna naa huvpa ca na hringna na aca huv; kama'a lie hing aw la naa bang aa,” a ta.
“Filistin ming ta Keilah kha tuv yi te na suo-aciyna lie sa a ma paruv,” ta pata David kha ama chang.
David ta Abyipakha hiehriy te, “Hingpa Filistin ming hing vaa pata i va tuv'a yi ma?” a ta. Abyipata David kyihuo khata, “Vaa la Filistin ming kha va tuv yi la Keilah kha va khuo tie,” a ta.
Cuorasala David cawsaa tie khata, “Mang tie, hingpa Judah ruo chunglie hing hmuo ma ciysa hing; Keilah luo vaa pata Filistin ming va tuvpa ca kha tluv tama ciy aa chiy vie aa?” ama ta.
Cakhutaata David ta Abyipakha a hiehriy pakhaa. Abyipata ama kha palie te, “A cuo, Keilah luo kha sibung tie; kama na Filistin ming kha na kuv luo caa pi'a ang,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta David hne a cawsaa zaw ca Keilah luo kha si yi te, Filistin ming kha ama tuv, ama sahring kha chuv yi te, iema kha khuosa ta ama te. Cahaacata David ta Keilah lie khy a sapa tie kha a khuo yi.
Ahimelek sacapaa Abiathar kha David'a luo aa ruo tiyta, tluobyi buohryi kha a kuv lie zaa hriele te a za si.

Ata ca David na Keilah luo zaa chiy ta pata Saul kha ama chang. Cakhutaata Saul ta, “Khazing na ama ca i kuv chung luo naa pi; tahematapakieca a thlake hne hrenapa a hnyipa khypuv chung luo a ngie tena ama hne ama kha aa khaakhung,” a ta.
Saul ta Keilah luo si pata David hne a cawsaa zaw patuv riypata cawsaa bangkhuo kha rietuv riypata a u yi.
David ta Saul na a cunglie hmang pha lipa tue riypata naa raw tapa kha a pachang tiyta, tluobyi Abiathar kyihuo khata, “Tluobyi buohryi kha hingpa luo hing vya cyi tie,” a ta.
David ta, “Vya Abyipa, Israel ming Khazing, Saul na Keilah luo a zuv pata na changtaapa kama kawlieta khypuv a para khing tapa tana i thyi.
Na changtaapa ta i thyipa haata Saul ca aa zuv'a ma? Vya Abyipa, Israel Khazing, paa na ica kie, na changtaapa hing na chang tie,” a ta. Abyipata, “Aa zuv aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata David ta, “Keilah khy ming hingta kama hne i cawsaa zaw hing Saul kuv luo malie ama pi'a ma?” a ta. Abyipata, “Aca pi'a yi,” a ta.

Cakhutaata David hne a cawsaa zacaruv tie ca a thu yi te, Keilah taa khata pya yi te aa si thenapa luo kha ama si. Saul ca Keilah khy taata David aa ruo tapa kha ama chang tiyta, capa luo ca si li tli pata a aw.
David ca Zif Ruocaapa tluocung ruo lie, cariekyikuo lie kha a aw. Saul ta ama kha ningting ta a huv, cuorasala Abyipata David kha a kuv chung luo pi vyi.
David ca Zif Ruocaapa lie, Horesh lie a aw ning kha Saul na thie riypata caa huv tapa kha a thyi.
Saul sacapaa Jonathan ca a tha te, Horesh lie David'a luo kha si te Abyipaming ta thaazuo a pi.

Ama ta, “Ciy khah, i paa Saul kuv ta nama ca ca hmung khu'a vyi; Israel ming cunglie siepahruo ta cuo'a cate, kama ca nama caa paziy pata na i cuo aa; i paa Saul zaw ta capa ca a cuo ta pata a pachang,” a ta.
Cakhutaata iema pahning ca Abyipahmiekunglie kha biekuona tue yi te, David ca Horesh lie kha a ngaa te, Jonathan ca ing luo kha a si.
Cakhutaata Zif ming chekha ta Gibeah luo kha khaw yi te, Saul kyihuo khata, “David ca Jeshimon sungluo, Hachilah tluo cung, Horesh lie, cariekyikuo liena aa nu.
Vya siepahruo, naa zuv khing ning thiy ta a zuv la, kiema kuo luo taata ma hrie riypa ca ama kha siepahruo kuv luo pi riypata a cuo aa,” ama ta.
Saul ta, “Abyipata thluechiy ca pi yi se, tahematapakieca kama kha kawpacuona ina hnyi ung ciy!
Vaa pakhaa ung la va pacie tie ung; khaapaliema a aw tapa hne ahungma a hmung tapa kha; tahematapakieca ama ca a zyatesa tapa tana ina chang yi.

Aa nunapa hmang bangkhuo kha va pacie ung la aa hmuopa bie hneta kama'a luo kha vya kaa tie ung. Cakhutaa cata niema kha ca vya ziy'a yi angte, capa ruo lie cana a aw ta pata a cuo kieca, Judah ming a thawthaw hrawlie kha i huv aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta iema ca Saul hmieluo khata a tha yi te Zif luo ca ama si. David hne a cawsaa zaw ca Maon ruocaapa lie, Jeshimon sungluo lie a awpa Arabah lie kha ama aw.

Saul hne a cawsaa zaw ta si yi te ama kha ama huv. David kha ama chang tiyta, alung luo kha sibung te Maon ruocaapa lie kha a aw. Capa ca Saul ta a thyi tiyta, Maon ruocaapa lie kha David ca a cadele te a huv.

Saul ta tluo kuokhaluo khata a si, David hne a cawsaa zaw ta tluo kuokhaluo khata a ma si. Saul hne a cawsaa zaw ca David hne a cawsaa zaw kha patuv riypata amaa ngie hryly le nakawta David ca Saul'a taa khata a catlisa pata aa ruole.
Cakhutaata Saul'a luo kha biephyatuv a vaw te, “A pahraa la vya si tie, tahematapakieca Filistin ming na ruo kha a ching yi,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Saul ca David aa cadepa kha taw te Filistin ming a du riypa khata a si; caacuonakawta khapa hmang kha Lawna Lungpuv ta pata ming ama sa.
Cakhutaata David ca khapa taa khata sithaw te En-gedi cariekyikuo lie kha a aw.
Filistin ming a cadenapa taa yi ta Saul a vya kaa tiyta, “David na En-gedi ruocaapa lie a aw,” ta pata ama chang.
Cakhutaata Saul ta Israel ming chungtaata cawsaa thawthung kha a tlaw yi te, David hne a cawsaa zaw huv riypata Sathaa Lungkuo luo kha ama si.
Luopuv kielie a awpa tuvte luo ama vya phapa khata Saul ca pazung riypata capa lie a awpa lung karaw luo kha a vaa. David hne a cawsaa zaw ca capa lung karaw a chung ce lie kha amaa tu thluo.

A cawsaa zaw khata David kyihuo khata, Abyipa ta, “Na cariepa kha na kuv chung luo ca pi'a angte, nama ta a pha na tana haata a cunglie na tue aa, aca tapa ning ca ata hing tana a cuo,” ama ta. Cakhutaata David ca thu te a paruvta tah Saul buohryi pasiypa a pe kha dya a te.
Saul buohryi pasiypa a kiy kha a te khutaata David ca a palung pha li pata a aw.
A cawsaa zaw kyihuo khata, “Ama ca Abyipasathu pathuvpa a cuo nakawta, ama cunglie i kuv pathlie pata, Abyipasathu pathuvpa i byipaapa cunglie hingpa hmang i tuepa hing Abyipata na thlu ku se,” a ta.
Cahaacata hingpa bie hingta David ta a cawsaa zaw kha thlu yi te, Saul tuv riypa kha pa-aw va yi. Cakhutaata Saul ca thu te alung karaw taa khata pya te a cakuo.
Ca khu pahne ta David zaw alung karaw taa khata pya ra te Saul kha u te, “I byipaapa siepahruo!” a ta. Saul kha aa vya pali tiyta, David ca alyi luo kha a bung te pa-uvsathyina a pi.
David ta Saul kyihuo khata, “Khaapanakawma, ‘David na ruvnaana caa pi khing, caa tapa tie bie kha na naathlie'?

Tuokhaatama lung karaw lie kha Abyipata nama kha i kuv luo ina pi tapa ca ataning na ming hrahring ta na hmung tli; cawsaa chekha ta nama kha thie riypata ina chang yi, cuorasala kama ta ica palaw sa. Kama ta, ‘I byipaapa cunglie hing i kuv pathlie the'a va ang, tahematapakieca ama ca Abyipasathu pathuvpa tana a cuo,’ i ta yi.

Mang tie, i paa, i kuv lie na buohryi pasiypa pe hing mang tie; na buohryi pasiypa pe kha i te raalaa pata nama ica thie linapa hingta, i kuv lie hing pha lina cuose, rawna cuose a aw lipa kha pachang'a cate na hmung aa. Na cunglie pha lina i tuepa aw vyi, cuorasala nama ca thie riypata inaa cadele ciy.
Abyipata nama hne kama alalalie hing bie chi mang sue! Abyipata na cunglie phuv na lapa mang sue; cuorasala i kuv ta ca nama kha caa du'a vyi.
Hluoning phungthluv ta, ‘A pha lipa tie chung taa tana pha lina a pya', a ta; cuorasala i kuv ta nama kha caa du'a vyi.
Israel siepahruo hing ahung a du riypata ma a pyahnue? Ahungma naa cade? Uv thiypa ma? Biyhliy sakha ma?
Caacuonakawta Abyipata bie chi mang sue, nama hne kama alalalie bie chi mang sue. Ama ta hingpa hing hmung sala i bie hing na ripa se; nama kuv chung taa hingta na palaw sa se,” a ta.
David ta Saul kyihuo khata capa bie ca ri te a pachuo tiyta, Saul ta, “I sacapaa David, nama ueryi tama a cuo?” a ta. Saul ca khuopuv ta a caa.
Ama ta David kyihuo khata, “Nama ca kama laata naa dang vie; tahematapakieca kama ta chiena ta ica thung zawta, nama ta ca phana ta ina thung ciy.
Ataning hing i cunglie tuokhaapa phana ma na tue tapa kha ina changpasie ciy, Abyipata kama kha na kuv chung luo aca pi raalaa pata na thie vaciy.
Cawsaa pakha ta a cariepa kha a hmung kieca, aa bangsa pata a palaw sa'a ma? Caacuonakawta ataning i cunglie na tuepa kawlie hing Abyipata phana ta lawmuo ca pi mang sue.
Ata hing ca i pachang mangtli, nama ca siepahruo cuo hrahring'a cate, Israel pena ca na kuv chunglie pacusapa a cuo aa.
Caacuonakawta kama hnangluo hingta i ciypathla zaw kha na pahli li riypa yi hne i paa ing taata i ming kha na hruv li riypata kama'a lie hing chie a sa tie,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta capa ca David ta Saul'a lie chie aa sa. Cakhutaata Saul ca ing luo kha a si; cuorasala David hne a cawsaa zaw ca cariekyikuo luo kha ama sithaw.
Samuel ca thiy te Israel ming bangkhuo a hmya yi te ama kha ama caa. Ramah lie a ing lie kha ama paby. Cakhutaata David ca thu te Paran ruocaapa luo kha a sibung.
Maon lie cawsaa pakha aw te, a hnyi a chie ca Karmel lieta a aw. Cawsaapa ca a hnyirung hringhruo; ama ta tuv thawthung hne mie thawkha a hnyi. Ama ta Karmel lieta a tuv hming kha a ngu.

Cawsaapa a ming ca Nabal ta cuo te, a napuvnung ming ca Abigail ta a cuo. Cawsaanung ca sing hne puvthe a pakhepa ta cuo te, cuorasala capaapa ca a palung cuo khekhawpa hne a zya chiepa ta a cuo; ama ca Kaleb ming ta a cuo.
David ta ruocaapa lie ca Nabal na a tuv hming a ngu tapa kha a thyi.
Caacuonakawta David ta satlie pahraa pathlie yi te, satlie tie kyihuo cata, “Karmel luo kha sithaw tie ung; Nabal'a luo kha khaw ung la kama ming ta bie a kya chang tie ung.
Cahaacata ama kha pa-uvsathyina pi ung la; ‘Na cunglie thlaalungna aw se, na ing lie thlaalungna aw sala, na hnyipa bangkhuo cunglie thlaalungna aw se.
Nama ta tuv hming a ngupa na hnyi yi tapa kha i thyi; na tuvkhietuv tie ca kiema'a lie kha aw yi te, kiema ta ruvnaana pi va yi puv, Karmel lie ama aw chung bangkhuo khaapahmuo pavie va yi.

Na satlie tie kha hiehriy yi la iema ta aca chang'a yi. Caacuonakawta i satlie zaw hing na hmiekunglie hmiephaa hmung thi yi se; tahematapakieca kiema ca pyi ning tana ma vya chiy. Na changtaapa tie hne na sacapaa David kha na hnyipa tuokhaapa a cuo zaw, malie pi thi tie, a ta’ nama ta aa,” a ta yi.
David satlie tie ca ama va pha tiyta, capa bangkhuo ca David ming ta Nabal kha chang yi te ama huo.
Cuorasala Nabal ta David changtaapa tie kyihuo khata, “David ca ahungtama a cuo? Jesse sacapaa ca ahungtama a cuo? Ata lie hing a byipaapa a dupa changtaapa na a hluvsa yi.
I viechuo hne i tiy hne i tuv hming a ngupa tie cuota i thiepa saa kha la'a angte ma khaapa taata ma amaa vaw tapa i pachang lipa cawsaa tie kha i pi'a yi?” a ta.
Caacuonakawta David satlie tie ca a pali yi te kaa yi te capa bangkhuo ca ama kha ama chang.

David ta a cawsaa tie kyihuo khata, “Nama zueziy kha a ya diy ung! a ta yi. Cawsaa bangkhuo ta ama zueziy kha amaa ya diy; David zaw a zueziy kha aa ya ra. Cawsaa zapaliy ta David kha ziythaw yi te, cawsaa zahning ta ama chechiy kha ama huo.

Cuorasala satlie pakha ta Nabal napuvnung Abigail kyihuo khata, “David ta ima byipaapa kha pa-uvsathyina pi riypata ruocaapa taata biephyatuv tie kya pathlie yi te na, a hruosue yi te biechiepa ta a chaw yi.
Cuorasala cawsaa tie ca kiema cunglie kha pha hringhruo yi te ruvna khaapahmuo ang vapuv, ruocaapa lieta iema hne ma awhne chung bangkhuo ta khaapahmuo ma paviepa aw vyi;
Iema hne aw pate tuv ma khie chung bangkhuo ta iema ca chung hne zuo hne ma cuota ma lungruetlepie tana ama cuo.

Caacuonakawta capa ca ata hingta pachang la khaapama i tue aa tapa kha pacuo tie; tahematapakieca ma byipaapa hne a ingchungkhue bangkhuo cunglie pha lina tue riypa kha biechipa a cuo tli; ama hingta ahungtahmuo chaw khu lipa cawsaa chiehruvpa ta a cuo,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Abigail ca a pahraasa pata viechuo tluo zahning, mingsuvtiy savang ungthyi zung hning, pasu riypata ca-uo ciepa tuv sa pangaa, vie-aw hmang pangaa, mingsuv thyi caapa baw zakha, hne thyikuv caapa hlung zahning kha la te, laa cung luo a khang.
A satlie tie kyihuo khata, “I hmieluo khata si ung la, ica vya paziyle'a yi,” a ta. Cuorasala a navaapa Nabal ca chang vyi.
Laa kha a khang te, tluo thabaw lie a za cunglepa khata, David hne a cawsaa zaw ca ama'a luo khata za cungbung yi te aa taw yi.
David ta, “Hingpa cawsaapa a hnyipa bangkhuo kha ruocaapa lieta za mangchiy angte a hnyipa bangkhuo khaapahmuo vie li pata a awpa ca a hrihripa tana a cuo ing; ama ta phana kha chiena ta ina thung.
Mawluo thueta ama cawsaa ta a cuopa capaa pakhata hmuo i pangaa kieca, Khazing ta David cunglie cahaacata hne a ruv vie ta tue ra se,” a ta.
Abigail ta David kha a hmung tiyta, a laa cung taa khata cung pahraa te, David hmiekunglie kha alyi lie aa bu.
A phyi thabaw lie kha a bu te, “I byipaapa, kama cunglie dyi hingta suena aw thi se; na changtaanung hing na thyina lie bie pari sa la, na changtaanung bie hing na thyipa thi tie.

I byipaapa, hingpa cawsaa chiehruvpa Nabal hing khaapatahmuo ri thi khah; a ming haa hing tana a hringzya zaw a cuo; Nabal ca a ming ta cuo te, a ngaa hmisi; cuorasala kama na changtaanung hingta na kya pathliepa i byipaapa na satlie tie kha hmung va yi ang.

Cakhutaata, I byipaapa, Abyipata nama kha thiyse palang suena tue riypa hne nama kuv ta phuv la riypa kha ca thlu te, Abyipahring te nama hrahring zaw na hringpa haata, na carie tie hne i byipaapa cunglie chiena a tue khingpa tie ca Nabal haata cuo yi se.
Cakhutaata ata hing ca na changtaanung ta i byipaapa'a luo i za phyapa lasaw hing i byipaapa caa ziypa satlie tie kha re pata cuo thi se.

Na changtaanung i suena kha naa ngiethe thi tie; tahematapakieca i byipaapa ta Abyiparietuvna kha a tuv nakawta Abyipata i byipaapa ca a cupa ing kha sapa ngiethie'a te, na hring chung bangkhuo pha lina na hmung riypa aw'a vyi.

Cawsaa pakhakha ta nama kha aca thie khing nakawta thu te ca huv biephung sala, i byipaapa na hringna ca Abyipana Khazing mangchiyna rawlie a awpa hringna taw chunglie kha caa catawpuo aa; cuorasala na carie tie hringna kha ca cisie ta siepa cyicuo haa tana a vie aa.
Abyipata i byipaapa cunglie, nama kawlieta a ripa phana bangkhuo kha a tue tiyta hne nama kha Israel cunglie siepahruo ta aca tue tiyta,

i byipaapa ta nama naa khuo khing nakawta a kaw aw li pata thiyse palangna kawlieta palung pha lina hne a pacuopuona hnyi'a vaciy. Cakhutaata Abyipata i byipaapa kha phana aca pahmung sa thueta na changtaanung hing a thyi thi mya,” a ta.
David ta Abigail kyihuo khata, “Ataning kama hne a taw riypata nama caa vya pathlietuv Abyipa, Israel Khazing ca thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue!
Na ripa hing thluechiypa ta cuo se la ataning thiyse palang suena hne kama kuv hrahring ta kama cuota phuvlana taata naa khuopa nama zaw thluechiypa ta cuo mya.

Tahematapakieca nama tuechie riypa taata naa khuotuv Abyipa, Israel Khazing a hringpa haata, nama hing a pahraasa pata naa vya taw li aw la, mawluo maw ta ca Nabal cuota capaa pakha hmuo a ngaa'a va tli yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata David ta ama kuv ta ama huota a vya cyipa kha cuhluo te, ama kyihuo khata, “Na ing luo kha thlaalungna hneta si tie; na ueryi kha ica naathlie tli, inaa hiepa ca kha ica pi,” a ta.

Abigail ca Nabal'a luo kha pha te, ama ca a ing lie kha siepahruo pyi haata pyi suokha a za tue nguoluo. Nabal ca pariysa te a palung a za tluosa nguoluo ningta a cuo nakaw khata, mawluo khydyina te khata khaapahmuo chang vyi.
Mawluo maw, a mingsuv pariy a pe taa khata a napuvnung ta Nabal kha capa kaw ca a chang ca, a palung kha a chunglie thiy te alung haata a ta.
Ning hraa khutaata Abyipata Nabal kha tuv te a thiy.

David ta Nabal a thiypa kha a thyi tiyta, ama ta, “Nabal ta biechiepa ta ina vaapa kaw bie a chituv Abyipaca pathuosa pata aw mang sue. A changtaapa kha pha lina taata a khuotuv Abyipata Nabal a tuechiena kha a luv cunglie a patlung tli,” a ta. Cakhutaata David ta cawsaa pathlie yi te, Abigail kha a napuvnung riypata bie a pachang sa yi.
David changtaapa zaw ca Karmel lie Abigail'a luo kha ama chiy tiyta, ama kyihuo khata, “David na a napuvnung riypata nama kha la riypata malie a kya pathlie,” ama ta.
Thu te, alyi luo mang pata a bung te, “Nama changtaanung hing i byipaapa changtaapa tie phyi a pasiy riypa sii tana i cuo,” a ta.
Abigail ca a catli pata thu te laa kha a khang te, a changtaanung papangaa ta ama mangchiy. David ta a kya pathliepa tie hnang kha paziy te a napuvnung ta aa li.
David ta Jezreel zaanung Ahinoam zaw kha la te ama pahning ta a napuv ta amaa li.
Saul ta a sacanung, David napuvnung Mikhal kha Gallim taata Laish sacapaa Palti kha napuv ta a pi tli.
Cakhutaata Zif ming ta Saul'a luo kha vaa yi te, “David ca Jeshimon a rie-e Hachilah tluo liena aa nu,” ama va ta.
Caacuonakawta Saul ca Zif Ruocaapa chunglieta David huv riypata aa tlawpa a cawsaa thawthung hne khata Zif Ruocaapa chung luo kha a sibung.
Saul ca Jeshimon a rie-e Hakhilah tluo lie, luopuv athaalie kha aa ri. Cuorasala David ca ruocaapa lie kha a aw thluo. Saul na ruocaapa lie kha naa cade tapa a pachang tiyta,
David ta ngiepatlietuv tie kha pathlie yi te Saul na a vya pha sasaw tapa kha a pachang.
Cakhutaata David ca a tha te Saul aa rina luo kha aa vaw; A riebyi ta a cuopa Abner hne Saul ama laanapa kha a hmung. Saul ca amaa rina chunglie ca a zie te, rieka tie ta amaa zie cadung.
Cakhutaata David ta Hit pa Ahimelek hne Zeruiah sacapaa Abishai kyihuo khata, “Ahungma arina hmang lie Saul'a luo naa ziy'a ung ciy?” a ta. Abishai ta, “Kama na caa ziy'a ang,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta David hne Abishai ca zuo khata rieka tie awna luo kha amaa ngie; Saul ca capa arina chunglie ca zaa hmung nguoluo te aa syi ca a luv cunglie alyi lie kha aa caby thluo; Abner hne rieka tie ta ama kha amaa zie cahlung.

Abishai ta David kyihuo khata, “Abyipana ataning hing na cariepa ca na kuv chung luo caa pi tli; caacuonakawta i syi hingta yi kha i cakha ta alyi hne aa tipuona te ta cakha'a ang; yi hning cakha'a va ang,” a ta.
Cuorasala David ta Abishai kyihuo khata, “Ama kha para khah; tahematapakieca Abyipata sathu a pathuvpa cunglie a kuv a pathliepa ahungma sue li pata a aw aa?” a ta.
David ta, “Abyipaa hringpa haata, Abyipana ama ca a thie aa; acuolikie a thiy ning ca a vya tlung thluo aa; acuolikie rietuvna hmang luo si'a tena a ra a kyi thluo aa.
Abyipana Abyipasathu pathuvpa cunglie i kuv i pathlie riypa naa thlu; cuorasala ata khata a luv cunglie aa cabypa asyi kha la tie, cakhutaata a tiy ungthyi zaw kha la lah cakuo'a puv,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta David ta Saul luv cunglie asyi hne a tiy ungthyi kha la te ama cakuo. Ahungtahmuo hmung va yi, a pachang zaw pachang ra va yi, pakha hmuo a hra va yi; tahematapakieca Abyipata iema cunglie kha mingkuv thuvna a patlung nakawta iema bangkhuo ca amaa hmung diy.
Cakhutaata David ca huesuo luo, iema hne aa hlasanapa tluodaw luo kha vaa te aa daa.
David ta rieka tie hne Ner sacapaa Abner kyihuo khata, “Abner! na palie'a va ca ma?” a ta. Abner ta, “Siepahruo a upa ca ahungtama na cuo?” a ta.

David ta Abner kyihuo ca ta, “Capaa cuo va ca ma? Israel ming hrawlie nama haapa ahungma a aw? Khaapanakawma na byipaapa Siepahruo kha kingkaa li pata na aw? Tahematapakieca cawsaa pakha na na byipaapa siepahruo kha para riypata a vya ngiehnue.

Hingpa na tuepa hmang hing pha vyi. Abyipaa hringpa haata, nama ca thiy riypa tana naa tla, tahematapakieca Abyipata sathu a pathuvpa na byipaapa kha a phata tah kingkaa vaciy. Ata khata mang tie, a luv cunglie a awpa asyi hne tiy ungthyi kha khaapaliema a aw,” a ta.
Saul ta David ueryi kha pachang te, “I sacapaa David, capa ca nama ueryi ta a cuo ma?” a ta. David ta, “Vya, i byipaapa, i siepahruo, kama ueryi tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata ama ta, “Khaapanakawma i byipaapa hingta a changtaapa hing a cade nguoluo thluo? Khaapa hmang ma i tue? Khaapa suena ma i cunglie a aw?

Caacuonakawta ata hingta i byipaapa siepahruo hingta a changtaapa bie hing naathlie thi se. Kama a cade riypa hing Abyipana caa pasu ta pata a cuo kieca, pihluonapa hing cuhluo thi se; cuorasala cawsaa ta ama cuopa kieca, iema ca Abyipahmiekunglie chie sapa ta cuo yi se, tehematapakieca iema ta ataning hing Abyiparu chunglie cuvu i hnyi li riypata naa cade yi te, ‘Cakuo la, khazing hrangpa tie kha vaa bie tie,’ ina ta yi.

Caacuonakawta, ata hingta, i thiyse hing Abyipaa aw linapa alyi luo palang sa thi khah; tahematapakieca cawsaa pakha ta vacakaa ka riypata ruo aa khiepa haata Israel siepahruo na biyhliy sakha huv riypata a pyahnue,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Saul ta, “I sue tli; vya kaa tie, i sacapaa David, khatiy tahmuo ruvnaana ca pi pakhaa'a va tli ang, tahematapakieca i hringna ca ataning hing na hmiekunglieta a sungnaasa; i ngaa ciemuo, suena lepuv na i tue tli,” a ta.
David ta palie te, “Vya siepahruo, hingpa lie hingna asyi ca a aw! Satlie pakha a vaw he la vya la se.
Abyipata aa dangpa hne zang tluo aa tlapa cawsaa mekaa kha lawmuo a pi yi; ataning lie hing Abyipata nama ca i kuv luo ina pi, cuorasala Abyipasathu pathuvpa cunglie ca i kuv pathlie khing va ang.
Na hringna ca i hmungna lie muo sungnaapa a cuopa haata, kama i hringna zaw Abyipahmiekunglie muo sungnaapa cuo sala ruvnaana bangkhuo taata na khuo thi se,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Saul ta David kyihuo khata, “Na cunglie thluechiy aw mang sue, i sacapaa David! Nama ca hmang hluvpuv tue'a cate na patlung aa,” a ta. Caacuonakawta David ca cakuo te, Saul ca a awna luo kha a kaa.

David ta a palung chunglie, “Ning kha kha ca Saul kuv hingta i thiy aa; Filistin ruo luo a ruo riypa laata i cuota a pha viepa aw vyi; cakiedyina Saul ta Israel ruo chunglie kama huv riypa kha a palung chuo'a te, a kuv taata i law aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta David ca a thu te ama hne ama'a lie a awpa cawsaa zacaruv hne khata Gath lie Maok sacapaa siepahruo Akhish'a luo kha ama si.

David ca ama hne a cawsaa zaw, cawsaa mekaa ta ama ingchungkhue cyicuo hne, cakhutaata David zaw a napuv pahning ta a cuopa Jezreel zaanung Ahinoam, hne Karmel zaanung, Nabal ta apa nunghlyi siypa Abigail hne khata Gath lie Akhish'a lie kha ama aw.
Saul ta David ca Gath luo na aa ruo tapa kha a thyi tiyta ama kha huv va tli.

Cakhutaata David ta Akhish kyihuo khata, “Na hmiekunglie hmiephaa i hmung pata a cuo kieca, ruo chung khyta suokhakha lie awna hmang na pi thi tie; khaapanakawma na changtaapa hing siepahruo khy lie nama hneta i aw aa?” a ta.
Caacuonakawta capa ning lie ca ta Akhish ta Ziklag kha a pi; caacuonakawta ataning tepa hingta Ziklag ca Judah siepahruo huopa ta a cuo.
Filistin ming khyta lie David a awna cuo ca kung kha hne thla paliy ta a cuo.

David hne a cawsaa zaw ca sithaw yi te Geshur ming hne Girzi ming hne Amalek ming kha ama kya ching; tahematapakieca iema tie hing hluo ning taata hingpa ruo ming cuo yi te, Shur luopuv lie Telam taata Izipt ruo te ta a awpa tie ta ama cuo.
David ta ruo kha tuv te canung cuose, capaa cuose pakha hmuo pahring va yi, cuorasala tuv, cuetungpa, laa, kala-uv, hne cawsie tapa tie kha la te Akhish'a luo kha a kaa.
Akhish ta, “Ataning hing ahung a du cate ma rie na tuv?” a ta tiyta David ta, “Judah ruo Negeb,” acuolikie “Jerahmeel ming Negeb,” acuolikie “Ken ming Negeb,” na i tuv yi, a ta taw.

David ta, “Iema ta kiema kaw kha chang'a yi te, “David na hing haa hingta a tue,” ta pata ri'a kie yi a ta nakawta, canung cuose, capaa cuose a hringpa ta Gath luo zaa chiy buo va yi. Capa ca Filistin ruo lie a aw chung bangkhuo ta a tue tawpa ta a cuo.
Akhish ta David kha zang te, “Ama ta a cawsaa Israel ming kha aa pahue sa karue tli nakaw yi ta i changtaapa tana a cuo pari aa,” ta pata a rue.

Capa cuo ning ca Filistin ming ta Israel tuv riypa khata ama rieka kha ama pahmya. Akhish ta David kyihuo khata, “Na pachang thluo, nama hne na cawsaa zaw ca kama hne tana riekaphuv zaw chunglie kha nama si ra aa,” a ta.

David ta Akhish kyihuo khata, “A pha ciemuo, na changtaapa ta khaapama i tue khu tapa kha na pachang aa,” a ta. Akhish ta David kyihuo cata, “A phasa, nama ca kama pangpa rievetuv tana na hring chung ica chi aa,” a ta.
Samuel ca thiy te, Israel ming bangkhuo ta muochie sa yi te, a khy ta a cuopa Ramah lie kha ama paby. Saul ta apyipa hne khuevuo ta aa hryipa tie kha ruo chungtaata a papya diy yi.
Filistin ming ca a hmya yi te, vya si yi te Shunem lie kha amaa ri. Saul ta Israel ming bangkhuo kha pahmya yi te, Gilboa lie kha amaa ri.
Saul ta Filistin rieka tie kha a hmung tiy yi ta, a ciynapa ta a palung khuopuv ta aa cathlu.
Saul ta Abyipakha a hiehriy tiyta, Abyipata a muo ta cuose, Urim ta cuose, profet tie'a taata cuose ama kha palie vyi.

Cakhutaata Saul ta a changtaapa tie kyihuo khata, “Ama'a luo kha cakuo pata i hiehriy the riypata apyipa canung pakha na huvpa tie ung,” a ta. A changtaapa tie ta, “Endor liena apyipa pakha a aw,” ama ta.

Caacuonakawta Saul ca caw hrangpa kha a hryi te, cawsaa hrangpa haata a tue te, ama hne capaa pahning hne khata capa luo ca ama cakuo. Cawsaanung'a luo ca zuo ta ama pha. Cakhutaata ama ta, “Na pyipa la a ming ica changpa hing na pahmung sa tie,” a ta.

Cawsaanung ca ta, “Saul ta khaapama a tue tapa kha na pachang, tuokhaatama apyipa tie hne khuevuo ta aa hryipa tie kha ruo chungtaata aa cade yi tapa kha na pachang. Khaapanakawma i thiy riypata cyihyi ina thla khuo ciy,” a ta.
Cuorasala Saul ta Abyipaming ta ama kha chie a sa te, “Abyipaa hringpa haata, hingpa kawlie hingta na cunglie duotena tlung'a vyi,” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata cawsaanung ta, “Ahungma ica pahmung sa aa?” a ta. Ama ta palie te, “Samuel na pahmung sa tie,” a ta.
Cawsaanung ta Samuel kha a hmung tiyta, khuopuv ta khi te, cawsaanung ca ta Saul kyihuo khata, “Khaapanakawma ina dung ciy? Nama ca Saul tana na cuo!” a ta.
Siepahruo ta ama kyihuo khata, “Ciy khah, khaapama na hmung?” a ta. Cawsaanung ta Saul kyihuo khata, “Alyi chungtaata khazing pakha a kya pyapa na i hmung,” a ta.

Ama ta, “A hmingsuo khaapama a lu? a ta. Cawsaanung ta, “Macuopa na a kya pya; buohryi pasiypa na aa hryi,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Saul ta Samuel a cuopa kha pachang te, alyi luo kha a bung te pa-uvsathyina a pi.

Cakhutaata Samuel ta Saul kyihuo khata, “Khaapanakawma kya pya riypata na tue cate hnaa ina pahnaw ciy?” a ta. Saul ta palie te, “Palungriethyina lepuv na i taw, tahematapakieca Filistin ming ta inaa du yi, cakhutaata Khazing ta na thuse te profet ta cuose, muo ta cuose na palie vyi; caacuonakaw tana tuokhaatama i tue aa tapa hiehriy riypata nama kha ica ku,” a ta.
Samuel ta, “Abyipata hnang ca chaw tli te na cariepa ta aa li tlipa cata ma kama ca bie ina hiehriy ciy?
Kama'a taata a ripa haa khata muo na cunglie a hrie ta; Abyipata pena ca na kuv chungtaata ca chuv te, na ingpaapa David kha a pi tli.
Tahematapakieca nama ca Abyipaueryi kha naathlie vaciy, Amalek cunglie a hihaana ciy aa chiypa kha na patlingsa li nakawta, ataning hing Abyipa ta hingpa hmang hing na cunglie a tuepa tana a cuo.

Ca hlyitaw taata Abyipata nama hne Israel ming kha Filistin ming kuv luo aca pi'a yi; cakhutaata mawluo khiy nama hne na sacapaa kha kama'a lie nama aw aa; Abyipata Israel rieka zaw kha Filistin ming kuv chung luo aa pi'a yi,” a ta.
Samuel bie kawlie khata Saul ca ciyna ta bi te, alyi lie kha yi kha puv ta aa liepatyi; a thaa aw vyi, tahematapakieca ning-aw ningtlabu hne zuokhydyi ta khaapahmuo ning vyi.
Cawsaanung ca Saul'a luo kha a vaw te, a thlaa a zang hringhruopa kha a hmung tiyta, ama ta, “Na changtaanung ta na bie kha ica naathlie; thiy kie thiy ta angte ina changpa ca kha ica naathlie.
Caacuonakawta ata hing ca na changtaanung kha na naathlie ra tie; na hmiekunglie hing viechuo a cawta vya pachie'a ang. Na luopuv luo na si thueta thaazuo na hnyi riypata ning tie,” a ta.
“Ning'a va ang,” ta te a bu. Cuorasala a changtaapa tie hne cawsaanung khata ama hripuo nakawta ama bie kha a naathlie. Caacuonakawta alyi taa khata kya thu te iehmang cunglie kha aa tu.
Cawsaanung khata a ing lieta a thusapa cuetaata a hnyi. Capa ca a catlisa pata thie te, thiynung phuv lipa viechuo kha a e.
Ama ta capa ca Saul hne a changtaapa tie hmiekunglie kha pachie te ama ning. Cakhutaa cata thu yi te capa zuo ca ta ama si.
Filistin ming ta ama rieka bangkhuo kha Afek lieta ama pahmya ning kha Israel ming ca Jezreel lie a awpa acaa athaalie kha amaa ri.
Filistin byi tie ca a zaza hne a thawthaw ta ama caluole ning kha, David hne a cawsaa zaw ca a hnangluo taata Akhish hne ama va caluo ra le tiyta,

Filistin riekabyi tie khata, “Hingpa Hebru ming hing hingpa lie hing khaapama ama tue?” ama ta. Akhish ta Filistin riebyi tie kyihuo khata, “Ama hing Israel siepahruo Saul changtaapa David, kama'a lie a kung a chie ta a aw tlipa, kama'a luo a kya ruo baataata a suena khaapahmuo i hmung lipa khata cuo va ma?” a ta.

Cuorasala Filistin riebyi tie kha a cunglie ama hi haa te, “Cawsaapa ca nama ta na pipa re luo kha pakaa tie; ama ca kiema hneta rietuvna luo kha si ra khah se, rietuvna lie khana ma carie ta aa li pali aa. Tahematapakieca tuokhaatama hingpa cawsaapa hingta a byipaapa hne aa re pakhaa khu aa? Hingpa lie a awpa cawsaa zaw luv hingta cuo'a va ma?
Ama luopuo pata hlaa a palie yi ta, ‘Saul ta a thaw thaw ta thie te, David ta a saa saa ta a thie, amaa tapa David khata cuo va ma?” ama ta.

Cakhutaata Akhish ta David kyihuo khata, “Abyipaa hringpa haata, nama ca naa dang, hingpa rietuvna luo ma sina lie hing kama'a lieta naa ngie na pya riypa hing a pha ta pata i hmung; tahematapakieca kama'a luo naa vawna taata ataning tepa hingta na cunglie suena suokha hmuo hmung va ang. Cuorasala i byi tie ta nama na vya si ra riypa kha ama naa tla vyi.
Caacuonakawta ata hingta kaa la, Filistin byi tie palung pha li riypa khaapahmuo tue li pata a diesa pata cakuo tie,” a ta.

David ta Akhish kyihuo khata, “Cuorasala khaapama i tue? I byipaapa siepahruo carie tie tuvna luo si ra li riypa hingta, na re luo i vya ngie baataata ataning tepa hingta khaapama na changtaapa'a lie hing na hmung?” a ta.

Akhish ta David kha palie te, “Nama ca i ming hmungna lieta, Khazing avuoming haata sue be riy a aw lipa tana na cuo; cuorasala Filistin riekabyi tie ta, ‘Ama ca kiema hneta rietuvna luo si ra'a vyi,’ aca ta yi.

Caacuonakawta nama hne nama'a lie a vya si rapa na byipaapa changtaapa tie hne khata mawdiy ta thu ung la, kama ta ica pipa re luo kha kaa tie ung. Thuohlaa pha lipa kawlieta na palung chie khah se, i hmiekunglie hmang phapa na na tue. Mawdiy ta thu ung la khy a dyi pahne ta si tie ung,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Filistin ruo luo kaa riypata David ca a cawsaa zaw hne khata mawdiy ta amaa tha. Cuorasala Filistin ming ca Jezreel luo kha ama sithaw.
David hne a cawsaa zaw ca a ning thungnapa ning lieta Ziklag kha ama pha tiyta, Amalek ming ta Negeb hne Ziklag kha tlangkhy ta ama tuv, Ziklag kha myi ta rue yi te,
canung tie hne a chunglie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo kha a le a caw ta ama patuv diy; cuorasala pakha hmuo thie lipa yi ta a chiyle diy yi te ama za si tli.
David hne a cawsaa zaw khypuv chung ama pha tiyta, myi ta rue yi te, ama napuv zaw'a nata ama sacapaa hne ama sacanung zaw amaa chiyle diypa kha ama hmung.
Cakhutaata David hne ama'a lie a awpa a cawsaa zaw ca i tyalya khata ama caa.
David napuv pahning ta a cuopa Jezreel zaanung Ahinoam hne Karmel pa Nabal ta a panunghlyi siypa Abigail zaw kha amaa chiyle ra.

David ca nang-uo pata a aw; tahematapakieca ama sacapaa hne sacanung zaw kawlie kha ama ngie a chi tuv nakawta ama kha alung ta vaa riypata ama ri pakhaw. Cuorasala David ca Abyipaa Khazing'a lie kha ama hne amata tah thaazuo aa la.
David ta Ahimelek sacapaa tluobyi Abiathar kyihuo khata, “Tluobyi buohryi pasiypa kha na vya pi tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Abiathar ta David kha tluobyi buohryi pasiypa ca a va pi.
David ta Abyipakha bie hiehriy te, “Iema phuv hing i cade'a yi ma? I pha khu'a yi ma?” a ta. Ama ta palie te, “A cade yi; tahematapakieca pha hrahring'a yi cate na khuo khu hrahring'a yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta David ca ama'a lie a awpa capaa zacaruv hne khata aa tha. Besor cavaa ama phapa khata hnangluo ta ama thusepa tie kha ama pha.
Cuorasala David hne cawsaa zapaliy tie khata a cade pathlale yi te, Besor cavaa te riypata a thaa a buo tuv tlipa zahning tie kha hnangluo ta amaa zaa tuo.
Ruo chunglie kha Izipt cawsaa pakha hmung yi te David'a luo kha amaa vawkhyi. Viechuo pi yi te a ning, tiy dang riypa ama pi;

thyikuv caapa hlung kha hne mingsuv caapa baw hning zaw kha ama pi. A ning khutaata, a thaa a kya aw pakhaa, tahematapakieca ning thung hne zuo thung chung bangkhuo sa ning li pata hne tiy dang li pata a za aw.

Cakhutaata David ta ama kyihuo khata, “Ahung cawsaa tama na cuo? Khaapa taata ma naa vaw?” a ta. Ama ta, “Kama ca Izipt mingnu pakha tana i cuo, Amalek ming pakha a changtaapa tana i cuo. Ma hnangluo ning thung ning taa khata i pasa nakaw tana i byipaapa ta ina thuse.
Khereth ming Negeb, Judah huopa ta a cuopa Kaleb ming Negeb kha tuv pate na Ziklag kha myi ta ma rue,” a ta.

David ta ama kyihuo khata, “Capa cawsaa phuv tie'a luo ca luo malie naa chiy khu'a ma?” a ta. Ama ta, “Ca thie'a va ang, cakhutaata na byipaapa'a luo ca pi pakhaa'a va ang ta pata chie naa sa taa la iema'a luo kha ica zuvkhyi'a yi,” a ta.
Capa paa ta a zuvkhyi tiy yi ta, Filistin ming ruo taata hne Judah ming ruo taata hruosue a hluvsa ama la nakaw khata hmangting lie kha zaa chepatlaa yi te, ning dang yi te ama za luo.
David ta iema kha ningtla taata a mawluopa zuoluocaw te ta tuv yi te, kala-uv a khang yi te a ruopa satlie zapaliy ta li pata ca pakha hmuo zang va yi.
David ta Amalek ming ta ama lapa bangkhuo kha chuv pakhaa diy yi te, a napuvnung pahning zaw kha a khuo yi.
A cawpa cuose, a lepa cuose, sacapaa sacanung zaw cuose, hruosue ama lapa mekaa kha cuose khaapahmuo a viepa aw vyi.
David ta capa sahring zaw hmiekung luo ama tanglepa tuvrung bangkhuo hne cuerung bangkhuo kha patuv diy te, “Hingpa hing David huopa hruosue tana a cuo,” ama ta.

Cakhutaata ama thaa buo tuv te David a ziy khu lipa, Besor cavaa lie ama thusepa cawsaa zahning tie'a luo kha David ca aa vaw. Iema ta David hne ama'a lie a awpa cawsaa tie a taw riypa khata ama cakuo. David ta iema'a luo ava chiy'a nangpa khata pa-uvsathyina a pi yi.

Cakhutaata David'a lie a si rapa cawsaa pha lipa tie khata, “Iema ca kiema'a lie ama si ra li nakawta kiema ma la pakhaapa hruosue kha pi ra'a va yi puv, cadyiseca pakha cyicuo ta ama napuv hne ama saata kha a la yi sala cakuo yi se,” ama ta.
Cuorasala David ta, “Uv hne nu zaw, Abyipata malie a pipa hmang kawlie cahaacata tue'a va ung ciy; Abyipata ma hringna malie pabang te kiema malie a tuvpa tie kha ma kuv luo malie a pi.
Hingpa kawlie hingta ahungma nama bie caa naathlie'a yi? Tahematapakieca rietuvna hmang luo a sipa ta a cu a tingpa haa tana chechiy a huopa tie zaw aa khing pata ama cu ama ting ra aa,” a ta.
Capa ning taata a patha pata Israel ming cuota capa ca phungluo hne ziyphung ta tue te ataning tepa hingta aa hmang.
David ta Ziklag luo a pha tiyta, hruosue chekha kha a viesaa ta a cuopa Judah uvthyi tie'a luo kha paphya te, “Abyipacarie tie'a taata ma lapa hruosue chungtaata niema cuota lasaw tana a cuo,” a ta.
Capa ca Bethel lie a awpa tie, Negeb lie Ramoth khy lie a awpa tie, Jattir lie a awpa tie,
Aroer lie a awpa tie, Sifmoth lie a awpa tie, Eshtemoa lie a awpa tie,
Rakal lie a awpa tie, Jerahmeel ming khy lie a awpa tie, Ken ming khy lie a awpa tie,
Hormah lie a awpa tie, Bor-ashan lie a awpa tie hne Athak lie a awpa tie,
Hebron lie a awpa tie, David hne a cawsaa zaw amaa zaa khienapa hmang lie a awpa tie bangkhuo cuo tana a cuo.
Filistin ming ta Israel ming kha amaa du; Israel ming ca Filistin hmiekung taa khata a ruo yi te, Gilboa Tluo cunglie kha a hluvsa ama thiy.
Filistin ming ta Saul hne a sacapaa zaw kha pha yi te, a sacapaa ta a cuopa Jonathan hne Abinadab hne Malkhishua kha ama thie.
Saul ca rietuvna ca ta va cadesa tli te, thi ka a thepa tie ta hmung yi te khuosa ta hmaa aa hmung.

Cakhutaata Saul ta a cehre a cyipatuv kyihuo khata, “Na zueziy kha a da la a zangpahlina te ta na daw tie, vangdaw a te lipa tie hing a vaw'a yi te, a zangpahlina te ta na daw yi te cangna ta na hmuo'a kie yi,” a ta. Cuorasala a cehre a cyipatuv khata khing vyi; tahematapakieca a ciy hringhruo. Caacuonakawta Saul ta ama zueziy mamaapa kha la te, padaa te, a busue te aa dawsa.
A cehre a cyipatuv ta Saul a thiypa kha a hmung tiyta a zueziy kha a busue ra te ama'a lie kha a thiy ra.
Caacuonakawta Saul hne a sacapaa pathung hne a cehre a cyipatuv hne a cawsaa zaw bangkhuo ca ning kha chunglie ama thiy hne diy.

Bawphie kuokhaluo ta a awpa Israel ming hne Jordan cavaa huesuoluo ta a awpa Israel ming ta Israel ming ama carie tie hmiekung taata a ruo yi te, Saul hne a sacapaa zaw ama thiypa kha ama hmung tiyta, ama khy kha thuse yi te amaa ruo; cakhutaata Filistin ming kha a vaw yi te ama khy lie ca ama aw.
A mawluopa ta Filistin ming ta a thiypa tie cawsie thliepa riypata amaa vaw tiyta, Saul hne a sacapaa pathung tie Gilboa Tluo lie ama thiypa kha ama hmung.
A luv kha te yi te, a rieka cawsie kha thliepa yi te, ama kuvtuezuv tie hne cawsaa zaw'a luo kha capa thuohlaa phapa ca pathyi sa riypata Filistin ruo ting luo kha biephyatuv tie ama pathlie.
Iema ta a rieka cawsie hne cehre kha Ashtaroth biena-ing lie kha chi yi te, a pangpa ca Beth-shan lungrue tlepie lie kha ama pathlie.
Cuorasala Jabesh-gilead lie khy a sapa tie ta Filistin ming ta Saul cunglie ama tuepa kha ama thyi tiyta,

a riephapa capaa bangkhuo kha a tha yi te, zuo khydyi ta si yi te, Saul hne a sacapaa zaw ama riyy kha Beth-shan lungrue tlepie taa cata ama la. Jabesh luo kha sikhyi yi te capa lie ca myi ta ama rue.
Cakhutaata ama ruv kha la yi te, Jebesh lie tamarisk thingkung rawlie kha paby yi te, ning sariy chung sa amaa uv.
Saul a thiy khutaata, David ca Amalek ming a tena taa yi khata vya kaa te Ziklag lie ning hning aa pahy.
A ning thungna lieta Saul arina hmang taata cawsaa pakha ca a caw kha thlaa te, a luv lie buvcing a phuv te aa vaw. David'a luo a vya pha tiyta, alyi lie kha a bu te pa-uvsathyina a pi.
David ta ama kyihuo khata, “Khaapa taata ma naa vaw?” a ta. Ama ta, “Israel ming arina hmang taa tana i vya ruo,” a ta.

David ta ama kyihuo khata, “Khaapama a chiy a cuo? Na chang tie!” a ta. Ama ta palie te, “Rieka tie kha rietuvna taata a ruo yi te, cawsaa hluvpuv a lie yi te ama thiy; cakhutaata Saul hne a sacapaa Jonathan zaw ama thiy ra,” a ta.
Cakhutaata David ta ama'a luo thuohlaa a vya pipa satliepa kyihuo khata, “Saul hne a sacapaa Jonathan na a thiy yi tapa kha tuokhaatama na pachang?” a ta.
Thuohlaa a vya pipa satliepa ca ta, “Gilboa tluo lie i aw ning hneta a chuo caci tena, aruo le hne aruo le rieka tie ta ama vya cadile nguoluo ning kha Saul ca aa syi kha aa hy pata aa daa.
A hnangluo a vya pali pata kama kha na hmung te, ina ku. Kama ta palie angte, ‘Hingpa lie hingna i aw,’ i ta.
Cakhutaata ama ta, ‘Ahungtama na cuo?’ ina ta. Kama ta palie angte, ‘Amalek ming tana i cuo,’ i ta.
Ama ta kama kyihuo khata, ‘A vaw la, i thaalie hing a daa la na thie tie; tahematapakieca vuosuo pata na rutla ruse i khue tli, cuorasala i hring kalie tlung,’ ina ta.

Caacuonakawta athaalie ca a daa angte i thie, tahematapakieca aa lie khutaa hingta ca hring khu'a va tli tapa kha i pachang; cakhutaa cata a luv lie byi lakhuv hne a buo lie a buo pahryi kha la angte, hingpa lie abyipa'a luo hing i vya chiykhyi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata David ta a caw kha thlaa te ama'a lie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo khata cahaacata ama tue ra.
Saul hne a sacapaa Jonathan, hne Abyiparieka hne Israel ingchungkhue tie kha zueziy ta ama thiy nakawta muochie sa yi te ama caa, zuoluo te khata sa amaa uv.
David ta thuohlaa a vya pipa satliepa kyihuo khata, “Khaapa taata ma naa vaw?” a ta. Ama ta palie te, “Kama ca Amalek ming mingpepa sacapaa tana i cuo,” a ta.
David ta ama kyihuo khata, “Abyipasathu pathuvpa cunglie na kuv pathlie riypa kha ciy va ca ma?” a ta.
Cakhutaata David ta satlie pakha kha ku te, “A vaw la thie tie,” a ta. Ama ta a cesa te a thiy.
David ta, “Na thiyse ca nama luv cunglie tlung mang sue; tahematapakieca na pakaa hrahring ta, ‘Abyipasathu pathuvpa na i thie,’ ta pata tehte na khuo,” a ta.
David ta Saul hne a sacapaa Jonathan kha muochie a sanapa yi hlaa kha a phy.
(Ama ta capa, ‘Liy Hlaa,’ tapa ca Judah ming kha pacuv riypa yi ta bie a pi yi; capa hlaa ca Jashar Caa-uv chunglieta aa cape.) Ama ta:
Vya Israel, na rungnaana ca aa suopa na tluo cungliena ama thie! A riephapa tie zaw ca amaa lie tli!

Gath khy luo kha va pathyi sa khah ung, Ashkelon khychung luopuv lie zaw kha va pathyi sa khah ung; Filistin sacanung zaw na a law pathlyi'a yi, vangdaw te lipa sacanung zaw na ama palung a yi pathlyi aa.

Gilboa tluo zaw, nama cunglie khy saa khah se, aduo zaw tla khah se. Kung a pavyipa lu zaw aw khah se. Tahematapakieca a riephapa paa aphya ca papyapalyi pata cuo te, Saul aphya ca sathu pathuv pata cuo va tli.
Thiepa tie thiyse taata hne, a riephapa tie ama thupa taata, Jonathan liy kha vya kaa buo li pata, Saul zueziy zaw a cahri pata vya kaa buo vyi.
Saul hne Jonathan, duepa tie hne due aa chiypa tie, hringna chunglie hne thiyna chunglie zaw a che va yi; hmungthlu haata catli yi te, chingde haata ama thaa a ruv.
Vya Israel sacanung zaw, Saul ca caa tie ung, caw sedungpa caa pabuvpa yi, muo sungnaapa siy hne ngu ta caa pangipa yi tana a cuo.
Riephapa tie ca tuokhaatama rietuvna lie ama puo! Jonathan ca aa suopa na tluo cungliena a laa tli.
I nuta Jonathan, na cuo tana i palung a kyi; I cuota kha tluv due aa chiypa tama na cuo! Ina duenapa ca hing kharuehaa na a chiy, canung tie duena laa tana a thlung vie.
Tuokhaatama riephapa paa ca a puo, a rietuvnapa cehre ca a ra tli!

Capa khutaa cata David ta Abyipakha hiehriy te, “Judah pe chung khypuv suokhakha luo kha i khaw'a ma?” a ta. Abyipata ama kyihuo khata, “Khaw tie,” a ta. David ta, “Khaapa khy luo ma i khaw aa?” a ta. Ama ta, “Hebron luo,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta David ta capa luo ca a napuv pahning ta a cuopa Jezreel zaanung Ahinoam, hne Karmel khypa Nabal ta a panunghlyi siy nung Abigail hne khata ama sithaw.
David ta ama'a lie a awpa cawsaa tie kha ama ingchungkhue cyicuo hne khata sikhyi yi te, Hebron khy zaw lie kha ama aw.

Cakhutaata Judah cawsaa tie kha a vaw yi te, capa lie ca David kha Judah ming siepahruo riypata sathu ama pathuv. David kha, “Saul a pabypa tie ca Jabesh-gilead ming tana ama cuo,” ta pata ama chang tiyta,
Jebesh-gilead ming'a luo kha biephyatuv pathlie yi te, “Niema ta zang tluo a tlanapa kha nama byipaapa Saul cunglie paluo sa ung cate ama kha nama paby nakawta Abyipata thluechiy ca pi yi se.
Ata hing ca Abyipata aa hmangpa a duena hne zang tluo aa tlanapa kha ca pahmung sa yi se! Cakhutaata kama zaw ta hingpa hmang hing nama tue nakawta lawmuo ica pi'a yi.
Caacuonakawta nama kuv kha cahra yi sala nama rie pha se; tahematapakieca nama byipaapa Saul ca thiy tli te, Judah ming ta kama kha iema siepahruo cuo riypata sathu ina pathuv tli yi,” a ta.
Cuorasala Ner sacapaa Abner, Saul riebyi le cepa khata Saul sacapaa Ishbosheth kha la te Mahanaim luo a sikhyi.
Ama ta Ishbosheth kha Gilead, Asshur ming, Jezreel, Efraim, Benjamin, hne Israel ming siepahruo ta a tue.
Saul sacapaa Ishbosheth ca kung sawliy a ta pata Israel cunglie siepahruo cuo hruo a pathu. Cuorasala Judah ingchungkhue ta ca David kha ama ziy.
Hebron khy lie Judah phang tie cunglieta David siepahruo a cuona cuo ca kung sariy hne thla caruv chung ta a cuo.
Ner sacapaa Abner hne Saul sacapaa Ishbosheth changtaapa tie ca Mahanaim taa khata Gibeon luo ama si.
Zeruiah sacapaa Joab, hne David changtaapa tie kha pya yi te Gibeon tiy-ang lieta ama vaa taw. Tiy-ang kuokhaluo kuo ta phuv kha tie a tu yi te, tiy-ang kuokhaluo kuo ta phuv hrangpa tie amaa tu.
Abner ta Joab kyihuo khata, “Satlie tie hing hmieluo pya yi sala amaa zue pachiy va,” a ta. Joab ta, “Hmieluo pya yi se,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta hmieluo a pyapa tie kha a ri yi te, Benjamin hne Saul sacapaa Ishbosheth tie'a taata hlyihning, hne David changtaapa tie'a taa khata hlyihning ta pata ama pya.

Pakha hne pakha, iema ama carie cyicuo kha ama luv ta a patuv yi te, ama vuo lie kha zueziy ta a daw yi te, amaa liehne kaluo. Caacuonakawta Gibeon lie a awpa capa hmang ca Helkath-hazzurim,” ta pata ama u.
Capa ning lie rie amaa dupa ca a ruv suesaa; Abner hne Israel cawsaa tie ca David changtaapa tie ta ama te.
Zeruiah sacapaa zaw pathung, Joab, Abishai, hne Asahel tapa tie kha capa lie ca ama aw. Asahel ca ruo lie sasuv haata aa ruo a catlipa ta a cuo.
Asahel ta Abner kha cavyi cacuo pie li pata aa cade.
Cakhutaata Abner ta hnangluo kha a pali te, “Nama tama na cuo Asahel?” a ta. Ama ta palie te, “I cuo, kama tana i cuo,” a ta.
Abner ta ama kyihuo khata, “Na cacuoluo acuolikie na cavyiluo kha pie la, satlie pakha kha patuv la a hruosue kha la tie,” a ta. Cuorasala Asahel ta ama aa cadena taa khata pie vyi.
Abner ta Asahel kyihuo khata, “Kama ina ziyna taa khata pie tie; khaapanakawma alyi lie naa liepatyina te ta ica daw aa? Tuokhaatama na uvta Joab hmie kha i hmung nguo aa?” a ta.

Cuorasala ama ta piese khing vyi. Caacuonakawta Abner ta asyi ta a ke luo a zangpahlina te a cakha. Capa lie ca a lie te, aa liena hmang lie ca a thiy. Cakhutaata Asahel a lie te a thiynapa hmang luo a vya phapa bangkhuo ca amaa daa.
Cuorasala Joab hne Abishai ta Abner kha amaa cade. Ning a tla'a nang caw khiy ta Gibeon ruocaapa luo sinapa luopuv lie a awpa Giah khy a hmieluo lie a awpa Ammah tluo luo kha ama pha.
Benjamin ming kha Abner'a lie ca a pahmya pakhaa yi te phuv kha ta aw yi te tluo cunglie kha awna hmang ama tue.

Cakhutaata Abner ta Joab kha khisue te, “Hing haa hingta ma chuozaa ta maa du'a ung? A chuona lie ca palung pasa na a chiysa aa tapa hing pachang va ca ma? Na cawsaa zaw kha, ama uvnu zaw a cade hing taw buo tli ung la na ta'a yi?” a ta.
Joab ta, “Khazing a hringpa haata, nama ta bie ri li pata aw la ca, cawsaa zaw hingta ama uvnu tie a cade kha mawluo maw te ta taw'a va yi,” a ta.
Joab ta hmyakaa kha tung te cawsaa bangkhuo ca Israel ming a cade kha taw yi te, rie a tuvna kha pazue va tli yi.
Abner hne a cawsaa zaw ca zuokhydyi Arabah kha cahraw yi te Jordan kha ama te, cakhutaata a mawluopa ningchung hluo te khata si yi te Mahanaim ama pha.
Joab ca Abner aa cadena taa khata a kaa; cawsaa bangkhuo kha a pakiy pakhaa tiy yi ta, Asahel ripuo li pata David changtaapa zaw pahraa hlyicaky aw va yi.
Cuorasala David changtaapa tie ta Abner cawsaa Benjamin ming kha zathung sawcaruv ama thie.
Iema ta Asahel kha la yi te Bethlehem lie a awpa a paa thluo lie kha ama paby. Joab hne a cawsaa zaw ca zuokhydyi ta si yi te, Hebron ama phapa khata khy a dyi.
Saul ingchungkhue hne David ingchungkhue alalalie kha aduna a pasiypuv a aw. David kha kya cahra vie hryly te Saul ingchungkhue kha a thaa a caw vie hryly.
David ta Hebron lie kha sacapaa zaw a sa yi: a sacapaa taapa ca Jezreel zaanung Ahinoam ta a sapa Amnon,
a sacapaa pahningnapa ca Karmel pa Nabal ta a panunghlyi siypa Abigail ta a sapa Khileab, a pathungnapa ca Geshur ming Siepahruo Talmai sacanung Maakah ta a sapa Absalom,
a papangaanapa ca Abital ta a sapa Shefatiah,
A pacaruvnapa ca David napuvnung Eglah ta a sapa Ithream ta ama cuo. Hingpa tie hing David ta Hebron lie a sapa tie ta ama cuo.
Saul ingchungkhue tie hne David ingchungkhue tie alalalie aduna pasiypuv a aw chung kha Abner ca Saul ingchungkhue lie kha ama hne ama kha cawsaa cahrapa ta aa tue.
Saul ta Aiah sacanung Rizpah kha nungthang ta a zaa tue. Ishbosheth ta Abner kyihuo khata, “Khaapanakawma i paa nungthangnung'a luo kha naa ngie?” a ta.

Ishbosheth bie khata Abner ca a palung pasa sa hringhruo te, “Kama ca Judah ming cuota uv luv tama i cuo? Ataning hing kama ca na paa Saul cunglie, a uvnu cunglie hne a viesaa cunglie kha zang tluo a tla pata aw angte, nama kha David kuv luo ca pi va ang; cata a cuopa tama ataning nama ta hingpa canung hne hingta sue ina be ciy.
Caacuonakawta Khazing ta capa haa cata hne a hluv vie ta Abner cunglie hing tue mang sue! Tahematapakieca Abyipa ta David'a lie bie aa kuopa kha kama ta a cunglie i patling sa aa.
Pena kha Saul phang taata palaw riypata David byithude ca Israel hne Judah cunglie kha padaa'a angte, Dan taata Beer-sheba te ta pacu sa pata a cuo aa,” a ta.
Ishbosheth ca a ciy nakawta Abner kha bie hrangpa palie nguo va tli.
Abner ta Hebron lie David'a luo kha biephyatuv pathlie te, “Ruo hing ahung huopa tama a cuo? Kama hne hingta biekuona tue la Israel ming bangkhuo nama'a luo chiykhyi riypata icaa bya aa,” a ta.

Ama ta, “A pha; Nama hneta biekuona i tue aa. Cuorasala nama'a taa tana hmang suokha icaa hie: Kama a hmung riypata naa vaw thueta Saul sacanung Mikhal kha naa vya chiyle li kieca khatiy tahmuo i hmie na hmung'a vaciy,” a ta.
Cakhutaata David ta Saul sacapaa Ishbosheth'a luo kha biephyatuv pakha pathlie te, “Filistin ming vangdaw zakha ta i pahaapa i napuv Mikhal kha na pi tie,” a ta.
Ishbosheth ta cawsaa pathlie yi te Mikhal ca a navaapa, Laish sacapaa Paltiel'a taa khata a pala sa yi.
Cuorasala a navaapa ta paziyle te Bahurim te khata a caale. Cakhutaata Abner ta ama kyihuo khata, “Ing luo kaa tie!” a ta. Caacuonakawta a kaa.
Abner ta Israel ming uvthyi tie'a luo kha bie taa yi te, “Ma hnangluo hraw taa khata David ca nama siepahruo cuo riypata nama huv nguoluo tli.

Ata hing ca patling sa tie ung; tahematapakieca Abyipata David kha biekuo te: I changtaapa David hmuo pata i cawsaa Israel ming hing Filistin ming kuv taata hne ama carie tie bangkhuo'a taata i khuo'a yi, a ta,” a ta yi.
Abner ta Benjamin ming zaw kha a chang yi; cakhutaata Abner ca Israel ming hne Benjamin chung bangkhuo ta tue riypata a pha ta pata ama ruepa bangkhuo kha Hebron lieta David kha chang riypata a si.
Abner ta cawsaa pakiy hneta Hebron lie David'a luo kha aa vaw tiyta, David ta Abner hne ama'a lie a awpa tie cuo khata saduona a tue.

Abner ta David kyihuo khata, “Vaa'a angte Israel ming bangkhuo kha nama hne biekuona tue'a yi te, na palung khingna haata na uv riypa yi ta i byipaapa siepahruo nama cuota va pahmya'a yi ang,” a ta. Caacuonakawta David ta Abner ca pathlie te diena hneta a si.

Cakhutaata David changtaapa tie ca Joab hne khata rietuvna taata vya chiy yi te, hruosue a hluvsa amaa vya phya. Cuorasala Abner ca David'a lie Hebron lie kha za aw vyi, tahematapakieca David ta ama kha pathlie te diena hne a za si tli.
Joab hne ama'a lie a awpa rieka tie bangkhuo kha ama vya chiy tiyta, Joab kha, “Ner sacapaa Abner kha siepahruo'a luo a vaw te ama ta pasi sa te diena hneta a si tli,” ta pata ama chang.
Cakhutaata Joab ta siepahruo'a luo kha vaa te, “Khaapama na za tue? Nama'a luo Abner aa vaw pata khaapanakawma pathlie cate na pasi sa?
Ner sacapaa Abner ca nama kha dung riypa hne naa ngie hne na pya, hne na tuepa bangkhuo pachang riypa tana aa vaw tapa kha na pachang,” a ta.
Joab ca David'a taata a kya pya tiyta, Abner kha cawsaa cade sa yi te, Sirah takhue taa khata ama vya kaakhyi pakhaa; cuorasala David ta khapa kha pachang vyi.

Abner kha Hebron luo a vya kaa tiyta, Joab ta ama kha pangpa ta bie a rue riypata hukaa thlake athaa luo kha vaakhyi te, capa lie ca a riy lie kha a daw. Caacuonakawta ama ca Joab a nuta Asahel thiyse a palangna kawlie khata a thiy.
A hnang taata David ta capa ca thyi te, “Ner sacapaa Abner thiyse kawlie hingta kama hne i pena ca Abyipahmiekunglie chuozaa ta sue be pata cuo'a vapuv.

Suebena ca Joab luv cunglie hne a paa ingchungkhue cunglieta tlung mang sue; cakhutaata Joab chung zaw hrawlie hing a huopa taata a tiy a pyapa cuose, caahminghmaa pasana a hnyipa cuose, a ke bupa cuose, zueziy ta thiepa cuose, sa a cakuopa cuose, ci li pata aw mang yi sue!” a ta.
Cahaacata Gibeon lie rie a tuvna lie kha ama nuta Asahel kha a za thie nakawta Joab hne a nuta Abishai ta Abner ca ama thie pata a cuo.

Cakhutaata David ta Joab hne ama'a lie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo kyihuo khata, “Nama caw kha thlaa ung la, buri kha a buv ung la, Abner muochie ca sa tie ung,” a ta. Cakhutaata siepahruo David ca riyy thingkaw kha a ziy.
Iema ta Abner ca Hebron lie ama paby.
Siepahruo ta Abner kha muochie sa te, Abner hing angaapa thiy tama a thiy aa?
Na kuv ciy pata cuo vaciy, na phyi zaw hrakyi khe pata cuo vaciy; cawsaa pha lipa hmiekunglie a liepa haa tana naa lie thluo de,” a ta. Cakhutaata cawsaa bangkhuo ta ama kha ama caa pakhaa.

Cakhutaata cawsaa bangkhuo kha a vaw yi te, David ca ningchung a cuo kalie ning khata suokhakha ning riypata ama ripasa; cuorasala David ca chie a sa te, “Ning tla hluota viechuo acuolikie suokhakha i ning kieca Khazing ta hing haa hingta hne hingpa laa hingta a le vie ta i cunglie tue mang sue,” a ta.
Capa ca cawsaa bangkhuo ta ama hmung tiyta, siepahruo ta a tuepa bangkhuo ta ama palung a patluo tawpa haa yi khata, capa ca ta ama palung a patluo.
Caacuonakawta cawsaa bangkhuo hne Israel ming bangkhuo ta Ner sacapaa Abner thiena kawlie siepahruo a te ra vyi tapa kha ama pachang.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ta a changtaapa tie kha, “Ataning hing Israel ming chungtaata byi le cepa hne cawsaa lepa na a thiy tapa kha pachang va ung ca ma?

Ataning hing sathu pathuvpa siepahruo i cuo raalaa pata, i thaa na a caw ciemuo, hingpa cawsaa tie, Zeruiah sacapaa tie hing kama cuota ca a ang na a ruv tuv yi. Abyipata pha lina a tuetuv ca a pha lina haata thung mang sue!” a ta.
Saul sacapaa Ishbosheth ta Abner na Hebron lie a thiy tapa kha a thyi tiyta, a palung caw te Israel ming bangkhuo ca ama palung a chuo.

Saul sacapaa ta rie a tuvpa tie uvtuv riebyi pahning a hnyi yi; pakhapa a ming ca Baanah cuo te, a hrangpa pakhapa a ming ca Rekhab ta a cuo. Iema ca Beeroth taata Benjamin ming Rimmon sacapaa zaw ta ama cuo, tahematapakieca Beeroth ca Benjamin ruo tana a cuo ta pata ruepa a cuo.
(Beeroth cawsaa tie ca Gittaim luo a ruo yi te ataning tepa hingta capa lie ca ama aw).

Saul sacapaa Jonathan ta sacapaa pakha hnyi te ama ca a phyi a cabie. Ama ca Jezreel taata Saul hne Jonathan kaw a vya pathuo ning kha kung pangaa na a ta. Ama a kingnung ta yi kha ta la te aa ruokhyi ca pathla pathlyi te a phyi a cabie. Ama ming ca Mefibosheth ama ta.
Beeroth khy ming Rimmon sacapaa Rekhap hne Baanah ca a thu yi te Ishbosheth ing luo kha, ningchung aa pahy nguoluo ning kha, ama va pha.
Iema ca Jungsacuo a phuopa haa khata ing chung luo kha a ngie yi te, ama kha a riy lie daw yi te, cakhutaa cata Rekhab hne a nuta Baanah ca amaa ruo.

Ing chung luo amaa ngie ning kha ama ca aa ziena khuo iehmang cunglie kha a laa nguoluo ningta a cuo; thie yi te a luv kha ama te. Cakhutaata a luv ca la yi te Arabah luo sinapa luopuv kha ziy yi te zuokhydyi ta ama si.

Iema ta Ishbosheth luv ca Hebron lie a awpa David'a luo kha amaa vawkhyi. Siepahruo kyihuo cata, “Hingpa hingna caa thie khingpa, na cariepa Ishbosheth, Saul sacapaa luv ta a cuo; ataning hing Abyipana siepahruo i byipaapa cuo hingta Saul hne a ciypathla zaw cunglie phuv caa lapa tli,” ama ta.
David ta Beeroth ming Rimmon sacapaa tie Rekhab hne a nuta Baanah kyihuo khata, “Carie bangkhuo tie'a taata i hringna naa khuotuv Abyipaa hringpa haata,

cawsaa pakha ta, ‘Mang tie, Saul ca a thiy tli,’ ina ta tiyta, ama ta thuohlaa phapa ina phya raalaa pata, ama kha patuv angte Ziklag lieta i thie, capa ca a thuohlaa cuota i pipa a lawmuo tana a cuo.

Cawsaa aa dangpa ama ing lie, a iehmang cunglie a aw pata a thiepa cawsaa pha lipa changchiy ca! Nama kuv lie a thiyse muo kha ca hie li pata hne hing chuelyi taa hingta para li pata ica aw changchiy'a yi ma?” a ta yi.

Caacuonakawta David ta satlie tie kha bie pi yi te, iema ta ama thie, ama kuv ama phyi kha tepachung yi te, ama pangpa kha Hebron lie, tiyliy kielie kha ama pathlie. Cuorasala Ishbosheth luv ca la yi te, Hebron lie Abner thluo lie kha ama paby.
Cakhutaata Israel ming bangkhuo kha Hebron lie David'a luo kha a vaw yi te, “Mang tie, kiema ca na ruv hne na saa tana ma cuo.

Ma hnangluo cuo lie, Saul ma siepahruo ta a cuo ning kha Israel ming a pyakhyituv hne a ngiekhyituv ca nama tana na cuo. Abyipata nama kha: I cawsaa Israel ming tuv haata a khietuv hne Israel ming a uvtuv tana na cuo aa,” aca ta, ama ta.

Caacuonakawta Israel uvthyi tie bangkhuo ca Hebron lie siepahruo'a luo kha amaa vaw; cakhutaata siepahruo David ca Hebron lie Abyipahmiekunglie kha iema hneta biekuona tue te, David ca Israel ming cunglie siepahruo cuo riypata sathu ama pathuv.
David ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa pathu ning kha kung sawthung ta te, kung sawliy chung siepahruo a cuo.
Hebron taa khata Judah ming cunglie kung sariy hne thla caruv siepahruo a cuo; Jerusalem taa khata Israel ming hne Judah ming bangkhuo cunglie kha kung sawthung kung thung siepahruo a cuo.

Siepahruo hne a cawsaa zaw ca Jebus ming a du riypata Jerusalem luo ama si, iema ca capa ruo lie a awpa tie ta cuo yi te David kha, “Hingpa luo hing a ngie'a vaciy, mingcuepa hne phyi cabiepa tie ta hmuo aca pakaa yi,” ta yi te, “David ca hingpa luo hing a ngie khu'a vyi,” ta pata a ruepa tie ta ama cuo.
Cuorasala David ta Zion cariekyikuo ca a la, capa ca ata lie David khy hingta a cuo

David ta capa ning lie ca, “Jebus ming a thie khingpa ca tiy langnapa khue karaw taa khata kie sala David ta a huepa tie phyi cabiepa tie hne mingcuepa tie kha thie yi se,” a ta. Caacuonakawta, “Mingcuepa tie hne phyi cabiepa tie ca ing chung luo a ngie khah yi se,” ta pata ripa a cuo.
David ta cariekyikuo lie ca aw te, capa khy ca David khypuv ta pata ming a sa.
Cakhutaata David ca Abyipa, Cungnungce Khazing ta a awpuo nakawta a lesyi hryly.
Cakhutaata Tair siepahruo Hiram ta David kha biephyatuv tie hne sidar thing hne lettamaa tie hne pazan tie kha paphya te David ca ing suokha ama sapa.
Cakhutaata David ta Abyipana Israel ming cunglie siepahruo ta naa pacu sa tli tapa hne, a cawsaa Israel ming cuo tana a pena kha a cyicalang tli tapa kha a pachang.
Hebron taata a vya pha khutaata, Jerusalem lie kha David ta nungthang kha la vie te sacanung hne sacapaa kha a hnyi vie.
Jerusalem lieta a sa viepa a saata zaw ama ming ca hingpa tie hingta a cuo: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
Ibhar, Elishua, Nefeg, Jafia,
Elishama, Eliada, hne Elifelet.

Filistin ming ta Israel ming siepahruo cuo riypa tana David kha sathu ama pathuv tli tapa ama thyi tiyta, Filistin ming bangkhuo ca David huv riypa khata ama sithaw. Cuorasala David ta capa kaw ca a thyi tiyta cariekyikuo luo kha a sibung.
Filistin ming ca a vaw yi te Refaim bawphie lie kha ama bi.

David ta Abyipakha hiehriy te, “Filistin ming a du riypata i sithaw'a ma? Iema ca i kuv luo ina pi'a ca ma?” a ta. Abyipata David kyihuo khata, “Sithaw tie; tahematapakieca Filistin ming kha na kuv luo ica pi hrahring aa,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta David ca Baal-perazim luo kha a vaw te, capa lie ca iema kha a te yi. Ama ta, “Tiy le te a parapa haa tana Abyipata i carie tie kha i hmiekunglie a para yi,” a ta. Caacuonakawta capa hmang ca Baal-perazim,” ta pata ama ku.
Filistin ming ta capa lie ca ama kuvtuezuv kha thuse yi te, David hne a cawsaa tie ta ama phyale.
Filistin ming ca a khaw pakhaa yi te, Refaim bawphie lie kha ama kya bi diy pakhaa.
David ta Abyipakha a hiehriy tiyta, “Sithaw'a vaciy; ama hnangluo khata va cahlung la, puvkung a rie-e luo taa khata vya tlahnue tie yi.
Puvkung a daw luo taa khata carie pu kha na thyi tiyta, a pacung tie; tahematapakieca capa khutaa cata na Abyipaca Filistin rieka tie kha thie riypata na hmiekung luo khata a cakuo aa,” a ta.
David ta Abyipata bie a pipa dadang haa khata a tue; cakhutaata Filistin ming kha Geba taata Gezer te khata a thie yi.
David ta a tlawpa Israel ming cawsaa thawsawthung bangkhuo kha a pahmya pakhaa yi.
Cherubim cunglie a tupa cungnungce Abyipaming ta kupa Khazing biekuona thingkaw kha kya sikhyi riypata David hne ama'a lie a awpa a cawsaa zaw ca a tha yi te, Baale-judah luo kha ama si.

Iema ta Khazing biekuona thingkaw ca le thaapa cung luo kha khang yi te, tluo cunglie a awpa Abinadab ing taa khata ama pyakhyi. Abinadab sacapaa zaw ta a cuopa Uzzah hne Ahio ta biekuona thingkaw a phyapa le thaapa kha maw yi te,
Ahio ca biekuona thingkaw hmieluo kha a vaa.
David hne Israel ming bangkhuo ca Abyipahmiekunglie kha ama thaazuo a aw zawdya ta tingtuo hne tingtuolepa hne karuv-akhang hne chaaraa zaw kha tung yi te hlaa sa yi te ama luo.
Nakon suo-aciyna luo ama phapa khata cuetungpa tie ta ama cahang nakawta Uzzah ta Khazing biekuona thingkaw kha ava patuv.
Abyipahihaana ca Uzzah cunglie a ie ta ie; biekuona thingkaw kha a kuv ta a patuv nakawta capa lie ca Khazing ta ama kha a thie; cakhutaata ama ca Khazing biekuona thingkaw athaalie kha a thiy.
Abyipata Uzzah cunglie a hihaana a patlesue nakawta David ca a hi a haa hringhruo; caacuonakawta capa hmang ca ataning tepa hingta Perez-uzzah ama ta.
David ta capa ning lie ca Abyipakha ciy te, “Tuokhaatama Abyipathingkaw ca kama mangchiyna luo a vya pha the aa?” a ta.
Caacuonakawta David ta Abyipabiekuona thingkaw kha ama mangchiyna David khypuv chung luo kha a ngiekhyi khing vyi; capa luo a ngiekhyi cuopa cata David ta Git ming Obed-edom ing luo kha aa ngiekhyi.
Abyipabiekuona thingkaw ca Git ming Obed-edom ing lie kha thla thung chung a aw; Abyipata Obed-edom hne a ingchungkhue tie bangkhuo kha thluechiy a pi yi.

Siepahruo David kha chang yi te, “Abyipana Obed-edom ingchungkhue kha Khazing biekuona thingkaw thueta thluechiy a pi yi,” ama ta. Caacuonakawta David ta vaa te Khazing biekuona thingkaw ca Obed-edom ing taata David khypuv luo kha palung tluosa pata a phyathaw.
Abyipabiekuona thingkaw a puvpa tie ta kyi caruv ama hliypa khata cuetungpa hne tuvtaata thusa pata hriykhungrina a pihluo.
David ca palaa ta taapa tluobyi buohryi kha a hryi te, Abyipahmiekunglie kha a thaa a aw zawdya ta a luo.
Caacuonakawta David hne Israel ming bangkhuo ta Abyipabiekuona thingkaw kha khi-upuo pata hne hmyakaa tungpuo pata ama phyathaw.

Abyipabiekuona thingkaw David khypuv chung luo aa ngie ning kha, Saul sacanung Mikhal khata thlaluo-aw taata mang te, Siepahruo David ta Abyipahmiekunglie a cathlule te a luopa kha a hmung ca a palung chunglie esena cangta a pahnyisue.

Iema ta Abyipabiekuona thingkaw kha a ngiekhyi yi te David ta a za bangpa thluodaa chunglie, a awna riypa hmang lie kha ama chi. Cakhutaata David ta Abyipahmiekunglie kha myirue panaana hne aviesaa panaana kha a pihluo.
David ta myirue panaana hne aviesaa panaana a pihluo khutaata, cawsaa kha Cungnungce Abyipaming ta thluechiy a pi yi.

Cakhutaata cawsaa bangkhuo, Israel ming cawsaazaapuv, canung hne capaa khata pakha ta viechuo tluo kha, saa sie kha, hne mingsuv caapa hlung kha kaluo ta a re yi. Cakhutaata cawsaa bangkhuo ca ama ing luo kha amaa diy.

Cakhutaata David ca a ingchungkhue kha thluechiy pi riypata a kaa. Cuorasala Saul sacanung Mikhal kha David a taw riypata kya pya te, “Cawsaa laliy lipa pakha ta nangzaa pachang li pata a caw a thliepa haa tana ataning lie Israel siepahruo ca a changtaapa zaw siicanung tie hmiekunglie a caw thlie te aa pa-uvsathyi de!” a ta.

David ta Mikhal kyihuo cata, “Na paa hne a ingchungkhue cawsaa zaw bangkhuo cuopa ta kama kha naa tlaw te Abyipacawsaa Israel ming cunglie siepahruo ta naa tuepa Abyipahmiekunglie tana a cuo, Abyipahmiekunglie na i luo.
Hingpa laa hingta chiephu hryly pata a tue kalie'a angte, kama ming lieta hmuo zaakhyi riypata i cuo aa; cuorasala na ripa siicanung tie thue khata pa-uvsathyina pi pata i cuo aa,” a ta.
Saul sacanung Mikhal ca a thiy ning te ta saata hnyi vyi.
Siepahruo ca Abyipata ama cahriylie a awpa a carie tie bangkhuo tie'a taa khata a pahyna pi te a ing lie a aw tiyta,
