Siepahruo ta profet Nathan kyihuo khata, “Ata hingta mang tie, kama ca sidar ing chunglie aw angte, cuorasala Khazing biekuona thingkaw ca thluodaa chunglieta a aw,” a ta.
Nathan ta siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Vaa la, na palung chunglie a awpa haa khata tue tie; tahematapakieca Abyipaca nama'a liena a aw,” a ta.
Cuorasala capa zuo lie ca ta Abyipabie ca Nathan'a luo kha a zuv te:
Vaa la i changtaapa David kha chang tie: Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Nama ma i awna riypata ing naa sapa'a nang ciy?
Israel ming kha Izipt taata i pyakhyi ning taa yi ta ataning tepa hingta ing chunglie aw buo va ang, cuorasala thluodaa lie hne pang thluodaa liena i khie byalya.
Israel ming bangkhuo hrawlie, khaapa lie i khie zawta, Israel ming mangchiy riypata i changpa Israel ming bieripatuv ahung'a lie hmuo, “Khaapanakawma sidar ing ina sapa va ung ciy?” ta buo va ang.

Caacuonakawta ata hingta i changtaapa David kha hing haa hingta va chang tie: Cungnungce Abyipana: nama ca i cawsaa Israel ming cunglie siepahruo cuo riypa tana tuv na khienapa ruo chung taa khata ica la;
cakhutaata na cakuona mekaa lie kha ca awpuo angte, na carie tie bangkhuo kha na hmiekung taata i pahli diy yi; cakhutaata alyi lie cawsaa lesyipa pakha haata ming lesyipa ica sapa aa.

Cakhutaata i cawsaa Israel ming cuota hmang suokha tue'a angte, ahungtahmuo hnaa ama va pahnaw li riypa hne cawsaa chiepa tie ta riethyi ama pi li riypata capa iema hmangta lie ca chi'a yi angte ama aw aa.

A hluo ning, i cawsaa Israel ming cunglie bieripatuv tie i za chi ning haa yi khata nama carie tie bangkhuo taa khata a pahyna ica pi'a yi. Ca hlyitaw taata Abyipata nama ca Abyipana ing suokha caa sapa aa ta pata aca pathyi sa.
Na ning kha tling te na mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie naa zie tiyta, na lehnang taa khata na chungtaata a puvpa na samingsahlaa kha calang'a yi angte a pena kha i pacu sa aa.
Ama ta kama ming riypata ing suokha sa'a te, kama ta a pena byithude kha i pacu sa aa.
Kama ca a paa ta cuo'a angte, ama ca i sacapaa ta a cuo aa. Pha lina a tue tiyta cawsaa ta ama hmuopa sungpe ta tuv'a angte, i pasiypa-ya aa.
Cuorasala aa hmangpa i duena kha na hmiekung taata i thawpa Saul'a taata i lapa haata ama'a taata la'a va ang.
Na ing hne na pena ca i hmiekunglie chuozaa aa hmang pata sapa a cuo aa; na pena zaw chuozaa ta aa hmang aa.
Hingpa bie haata hne hingpa muocuo haa hingta Nathan ta David'a lie kha a ri.

Cakhutaata Siepahruo David ca a chung luo kha a ngie te, Abyipahmiekunglie kha a tu te, “Vya Abyipa Khazingkama hing ahung ta cuo angte ma, i ingchungkhue zaw hing khaapata ama cuo nakawta hingpa te hingta inaa chiy ciy?

Cuorasala Vya Abyipa Khazing, hingpa hing ca nama ming lie ca hmang cawta tana a cuo; na changtaapa ingchungkhue cuota hmieluo a vaw riypa a lepa hmang kaw zaw kha ina chang tli ciy. Hingpa hing cawsaa zaw pacuvna ta cuo mang sue, Vya Abyipa Khazing!
Cakhutaata David ta nama'a lie kha khaapa bie ma a ri vie the'a tli? Tahematapakieca nama ta na changtaapa kha na pachang, Vya Abyipa Khazing!
Nama palungphya hne na biekuona thueta na changtaapa pachang riypata hingpa lesyina bangkhuo hing nama ta na tue tli.
Caacuonakawta Vya AbyipaKhazing, nama ca na lesyi; tahematapakieca ma naa ta ma thyina bangkhuo lie hing nama haapa pakha hmuo aw va yi, nama hlyi taata Khazing hrangpa aw vyi.

Na cawsaa Israel ming haapa ahungma a aw? Hing chuelyi lie hing ama Khazing ta cawsaa haata sihning yi te a khuopa mingphang, a ming riypata a tuepa mingphang, a cawsaa zaw hmiekunglie mingphang hne ama khazing zaw a cade pata a lesyipa hmang hne nang-uo aa chiypa hmang zaw a tuepapa mingphang hrangpa ahungma a aw?
Cakhutaata na cawsaa Israel kha chuozaa ta nama cawsaa cuo riypata pacu sa yi cate, Vya Abyipa, nama ca ama Khazing ta na cuo.
Cakhutaata ata hing ca, Vya AbyipaKhazing, na changtaapa'a kawlie hne a ingchungkhue kawlieta na ripa bie kha chuozaa ta pacu sapa cuo sala, bie na kuopa haa khata tue tie.

‘Cungnungce Abyipaca Israel ming cunglie Khazing tana a cuo,’ ta pata na ming ca chuozaa ta pathuosa pata cuo sala, caacuonakawta na changtaapa David ingchungkhue ca na hmiekunglie pacu sa pata cuo se.

Vya cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing, nama ta hingpa biephu hing na changtaapa cunglieta, ‘Nama ca ingchungkhue suokha na ica tuepa aa,’ na ta; caacuonakawta na changtaapa ta hingpa thlaachuona hing nama'a luo riephasa pata a chuo nguo.
Cakhutaata ata hing, Vya Abyipa Khazing, nama ca Khazing ta cuo cate na bie ca biehmisipa ta a cuo; nama ta hingpa hmang phapa hing na changtaapa'a lie bie na kuo tli.

Caacuonakawta ata hing ca na changtaapa ingchungkhue hing na hmiekunglie aa hmang pari riypata thluechiy na pipa thi tie; tahematapakieca Vya Abyipa Khazingnama ta ri tli cate, na changtaapa ingchungkhue ca nama thluechiyna ta thluechiy pi pata cuo pari mang sue,” a ta.
Cuo pachangta khutaata David ta Filistin ming kha tuv yi te a te yi; David ta Metheg-ammah kha Filistin ming kuv chungtaata a la.

Cakhutaata Moab kha te yi te, taanapa ta taa yi te, alyi lie kha tluo thung ta a pahlaa yi. Tluo hning lie'apa tie yalya kha thie yi te, tluo thungna lie'apa tie dyi kha a pahring yi. Cakhutaa cata Moab tie ca David changtaapa ta a li yi te David'a luo kha ngukhyi ama pi.
David ta Zufrates cavaa kha uv pakhaa riypata a sipuole pata Zobah siepahruo Rehob sacapaa Hadadezer kha a te.
David ta ama'a taa cata aruo rieka thawkha zasariy, hne phyi rieka thawkiy a la. David ta le zakha cuota aa de riypa aruo zaw dyi kha pangaa te a hrangpa bangkhuo kha ama cazaa a sapachung diy.
Damaskas khy lie a awpa Siria ming ta Zobah siepahruo Hadadezer kha a bya riypata amaa vaw tiyta, David ta Siria ming ca thawkiy thawhning a thie yi.

Cakhutaata David ta Damaskas lie Siria ming hrawlie kha khy a huopa riekaphuv a chi yi; cakhutaa cata Siria ming ca David changtaapa ta a li yi te ngukhyi ama pi. Abyipata David ca a cakuona kyry lie tena a pi.
David ta Hadadezer changtaapa tie ta amaa cyipa siy ta tuepa phya zaw kha la te Jerusalem luo a phyale.
Hadadezer khy zaw ta a cuopa Betah hne Berothai taa khata David ta daa a hluvsa a la.
Hamath siepahruo Toi ta David na Hadadezer rieka bangkhuo kha a te diy yi tapa thuohlaa a thyi tiyta,

David ta Hadadezer kha tuv te a te nakawta ama kha bie a chang riypa hne vaa law riypata Toi ta a sacapaa Joram kha David'a luo a pathlie. Hadadezer ta Toi kha a zaa du taw. Joram ta ngu, siy, hne daa ta tuepa chechiy kha a vya phya.
David ta capa tie zaw ca a tepa mingphang tie bangkhuo'a taata a lapa siy zaw ngu zaw hne khata Abyipa'a luo kha hmangkha ta a pihluo pakhaw.
A tepa mingphang zaw ca, Edom ming, Moab ming, Ammon ming, Filistin ming, Amalek ming hne Zobah siepahruo Rehob sacapaa Hadadezer zaw khata ama cuo.
David ca a ming a pathuo ciemuo. A vya kaa pata Paciy Bawphie lie kha Edom ming thawhraa hlyicari a thie yi.

Ama ta Edom lie kha khy a huopa riekaphuv a chi yi; Edom ruo chung bangkhuo khata khy a huopa riekaphuv kha chi diy yi te, Edom ming bangkhuo ca David changtaapa ta amaa li diy. Cakhutaata Abyipata David ca a cakuona kyry lie kha tena a pi.
Caacuonakawta David ca Israel ming bangkhuo cunglie kha siepahruo cuo te a cawsaa zaw bangkhuo kha biedangpa hne aa khing aa nguosa pata a uv yi.
Zeruiah sacapaa Joab ca riekabyi le cepa ta a cuo; Ahilud sacapaa Jehoshafat ca cazing khungtuv ta a cuo;
Ahitub sacapaa Zadok hne Abiathar sacapaa Ahimelek ca tluobyi ta ama cuo; Seraiah ca caacapetuv ta a cuo.
Jehoiada sacapaa Benaiah ca Khereth ming hne Peleth ming uvtuv ta cuo te, David sacapaa zaw ca tluobyi ta ama cuo.
David ta, “Jonathan kawlieta ama cunglie kawpacuona i paluo sa khu riypata, Saul ingchungkhue cawsaa aa ngaapa pakha chuo ama aw ma?” a ta.

Saul ingchungkhue changtaapa ta a cuopa, a ming Ziba ama tapa kha capa lie ca aw te, David'a luo kha ama ku. Siepahruo ta ama kyihuo khata, “Ziba ta na cuo ma?” a ta. Ama ta, “Na siicapaapa tana i cuo!” a ta.

Siepahruo ta, “Khazing kawpacuona kha a cunglie i paluo sa khu riypata, Saul ingchungkhue cawsaa pakha chuo a ngaapa ama aw ma?” a ta. Ziba ta siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Jonathan sacapaa pakha aa ngaa; ama ca a phyi cabiepa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Siepahruo ta, “Khaapaliema a aw?” a ta. Ziba ta siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Lo-debar lie, Ammiel sacapaa Makhir ing liena a aw,” a ta.
Cakhutaata David ta cawsaa pathlie yi te, Lo-debar lie, Ammiel sacapaa Makhir ing taa khata a pala sa yi.
Saul sacapaa Jonathan sacapaa Mefibosheth ta a bu te pa-uvsathyina a pi. David ta, “Mefibosheth!” ta pata a ku. Ama ta chaw te, “Na changtaapa tana i cuo,” a ta.

David ta ama kyihuo khata, “Ciy khah, tahematapakieca na paa Jonathan kawlie tana nama cunglie kawpacuona ica hnyi khing; Kama ta na mingpa Saul ruo bangkhuo kha ca pi pakhaa'a angte, nama ca i cabya lieta sa na ning pari aa,” a ta.
Ama ta pa-uvsathyina pi te, “Na changtaapa hing khaapata cuo angte ma, uv thiypa haapa kama hing ina mangchiy ciy?” a ta.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ta Saul changtaapa Ziba kha ku te, “Saul ta a hnyipa bangkhuo hne a ing bangkhuo kha na byipaapa samingta hing i pi tli.

Nama hne na sacapaa zaw hne na changtaapa tie ta alyi hing thlupa'a ung cate na byipaapa samingta hingta ning riypa sa a hnyi riypata sa nama pavyi aa, cuorasala na byipaapa samingta Mefibosheth ca i cabya liena sa a ning pari aa,” a ta. Ziba ta sacapaa pahra hlyipangaa hne changtaapa pakiy a hnyi.

Cakhutaata Ziba ta siepahruo kyihuo khata, “I byipaapa siepahruo ta a changtaapa a changpa haa hing tana na changtaapa ta a tue aa,” a ta. Mefibosheth ca siepahruo sacapaa pakha haa khata David cabya lie kha sa a ning.
Mefibosheth ta sacapaa panuta pakha hnyi te a ming ca Mika ta a cuo. Ziba ing lie a awpa bangkhuo ca Mefibosheth changtaapa ta amaa li diy.
Mefibosheth ca Jerusalem lieta a aw, tahematapakieca siepahruo cabya lie kha sa a ning pari. Ama ca a phyi hra hning ta a cabie.
Cuo pachangta khutaata Ammon siepahruo ca thiy te a sacapaa Hanun ta aa thle.

David ta, “A paa ta i cunglie zang tluo aa tlasa pata a awpa haata Nahash sacapaa Hanun cunglie hing zang tluo aa tlasa pata na i aw ra aa,” a ta. Caacuonakawta a paa kawlieta hnaa panguo riypata David ta lucuotuv a pathlie yi. David lucuotuv tie kha Ammon ruo chung luo ama pha tiyta,

Ammon byi tie khata ama byipaapa Hanun kyihuo khata, “David ta nama'a luo biephyatuv tie a kya pathlie nakaw yi hingta na paa na a pa-uvsathyi hmisi ta pata na rue ma? David ta khypuv hing mangpacie pata a ngiepatlie riypa hne te riypa tana a kya pathlie cuo va ma?” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Hanun ta David lucuotuv tie kha patuv yi te, ama hmyahming khingkhuo law kha ngu yi te, ama buohryi kha ama lakaw lieta tepa pachung yi te ama pathlie.

David kha ama chang tiyta iema daw riypata cawsaa kha a pathlie yi; tahematapakieca ama nang a zaa hringhruo. Siepahruo ta, “Nama hmyahming a pu pakhaa hluo li Jeriko lie hing aw ungla vya kaa lavuo ung ciy,” a ta yi.

Ammon ming ta iema ca David na malie a hue tli tapa kha ama hmung tiyta, Ammon ming ca ta cawsaa kha pathlie yi te Beth-rehob lie Siria ming hne Zobah lie Siria ming phyi rieka thawkiy, hne Maakah ruo siepahruo hne a cawsaa thawkha, cakhutaata Tob ming thawhraa hlyihning kha amaa ku.
David ta capa ca a thyi tiyta, Joab hne a thaaruvpa rieka bangkhuo kha a pathlie yi.
Ammon ming ca pya yi te hukaa angiena lie kha rie tuv riypata awna hmang ama la; cuorasala Zobah hne Rehob cawsaa Siria ming, hne Maakah ming Tob cawsaa tie kha iemata tah ruo lie ca ama aw ra thluo.
Joab ta hmieluo hne hnangluo taa tana ina tuv'a yi tapa kha a hmung tiyta, Israel ming a tlaw pa-ipa chekha kha la yi te Siria ming a du riypa khata adaahmang a pala sa yi.
Aa ngaapa a cawsaa zaw kha a nuta Abishai kuv rawlie kha chi yi te Ammon ming tuv riypata awna hmang a pala sa yi.
Ama ta, “Siria ming hing i cuota ama cahra tuv kieca nama ta naa bya'a cate, cuorasala Ammon ming kha na cuota ama cahra tuv kieca a vaw'a angte icaa bya aa.
Cahra tie, ma cawsaa zaw cuo hne ma Khazing khypuv zaw cuo hingta ma rie pha se; Abyipa ta a pha a tapa kha tue thluo se,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Joab hne ama'a lie a awpa a cawsaa tie ca Siria ming a du riypata hmieluo ama tung ca Siria ming ca iema hmiekung taa khata amaa ruo.

Ammon ming ta Siria ming amaa ruopa kha ama hmung tiyta, iema zaw Abishai hmiekung taa khata a ruo ra yi te khypuv chung luo kha amaa ngie. Cakhutaata Joab ca Ammon ming tuvna taa khata Jerusalem luo a kaa.
Cuorasala Siria ming ta Israel ming na malie a te yi tapa kha ama hmung tiyta, iema ca amaa pahmya.
Hadadezer ta cawsaa pathlie yi te Eufrates cavaa huesuoluo a awpa Siria ming kha aa vya chiy yi; Hadadezer rieka tie ca riekabyilepa Shobak ta luochiy yi te Helam luo ama vya pha.

Capa ca David kha ama chang tiyta, Israel ming bangkhuo kha pahmya yi te, Jordan kha te te Helam luo kha a pha. Siria ming ta David a du riypata awna hmang kha a phata tah la yi te iema hne cata amaa tuv.

Siria ming ca Israel ming hmiekung taa cata amaa ruo; David ta aruole zasariy phuv tie hne aruo rieka thawsawliy kha a thie yi, cakhutaata ama riekabyilepa Shobak kha hmaa paphya te capa lie ca a thiy.

Hadadezer changtaapa siepahruo bangkhuo ta Israel ming na malie a te yi tapa kha ama hmung tiyta, Israel hne khata arena tue yi te uvpa ta amaa li. Caacuonakawta Siria ming ca Ammon ming kha a bya nguo va tli yi.

Cuovuo vya chiy te, siepahruo tie rietuv riypata ama pya taw cuo ning kha, David ta Joab hne aa byi tie hne Israel ming bangkhuo kha a pathlie yi; iema ta Ammon ming kha para diy yi te Rabbah kha ama cadung. Cuorasala David ca Jerusalem lie aa ngaa.

Ning kha ca zuoluocaw khata David ca a iehmang taa khata thu te siepahruo ingcung lie aa khiepa khata, ingcung taa cata canung pakha tiy aa siy nguoluopa kha a hmung; cawsaanung ca a puvthe hringhruo.
David ta cawsaanung kaw kha pachangpasie riypata cawsaa a pathlie. “Ama ca Hit ming Uriah napuvnung Eliam sacanung Bathsheba tana a cuo,” ta pata ama chang.
Caacuonakawta David ta cawsaa pathlie yi te ama kha va pala sa yi te aa ziehne. (Ama ca canung phung a pachangna taata aa pathe pata a cuo.) Cakhutaa cata a ing luo kha a kaa.
Cawsaanung ca nu a phya; cakhutaata ama ta David'a luo kha cawsaa pathlie te, “Nu na i phya,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta David ta Joab kha bie taa te, “Hit pa Uriah kha kama'a luo za paphya tie,” a ta.
Uriah kha ama'a luo a pha tiyta, David ta Joab hne cawsaa zaw ama tluo ma tapa hne rie atuvna kha khaapama a lu tapa kha a hiehriy.
Cakhutaata David ta Uriah kyihuo khata, “Na ing luo kha zuv la na phyi zaa siy tie,” a ta. Uriah ca siepahruo ing taa khata pya te, capa lie ca siepahruo lasaw ta a paziyle.
Cuorasala Uriah ca a byipaapa changtaapa tie bangkhuo hne khata siepahruo ing ingchiypakaa lie kha a zie te a ing luo kha zuv vyi.
David kha, “Uriah ca a ing luo zuv vyi,” ta pata ama chang tiyta, David ta Uriah kyihuo khata, “Khytlawna taa tana na vya chiy cuo va ma? Khaapanakawma na ing luo zuv li pata na aw?” a ta.

Uriah ta David kyihuo khata, “Biekuona thingkaw hne Israel hne Judah ca ruo chungliena ama aw; cakhutaata i byipaapa Joab hne i byipaapa changtaapa bangkhuo zaw ruo lie na amaa ri; cata a cuopa cata ma ning riy dang riypata hne i napuvnung hne a ziehne riypata ing luo ca i zuv aa? Nama hring cate na hringna a hringpa haata cahaapa hmang ca tue'a va ang,” a ta.
Cakhutaata David ta Uriah kyihuo khata, “Ataning ca hingpa lie hing aw caw la mawluo na ica paphya pakhaa aa,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Uriah ca capa ning lie ca Jerusalem lie a aw. A mawluopa ta,
David ta a hmiekunglie ning riypata hne dang riypata hry te a pariyna te ta a tue; zuoluo a vya chiy tiyta a byipaapa changtaapa tie hne a zie riypa khata a pya, cuorasala a ing luo kha zuv vyi.
Mawluo ca David ta Joab'a luo kha caa suokha cape te Uriah kha a paphya sa.
Caa chunglie ca, “Uriah ca rie a cahracenapa a hmieluo ce lie kha chi la ama kha tuv yi te a thiy riypata hnangluo namaa sawse aa,” a ta.
Joab ta khypuv a dung ning kha rie ama cahracenapa ta pata a pachangna hmang lie kha Uriah ca a pa-aw sa.
Khypuv cawsaa tie ca pya yi te Joab hne khata amaa tuv; David changtaapa chekha kha ama thiy. Hit ming Uriah zaw kha ama thie ra.
Cakhutaata Joab ta David'a luo kha cawsaa pathlie te rie atuvna thuohlaa kha a pachang sa yi.
Cakhutaata a biephyatuv kyihuo khata, “Siepahruo kha rietuvna kaw bangkhuo na chang diy khutaata,
siepahruo ca a hi haa'a te nama kyihuo khata, ‘Khaapanakawma a du riypata nama vaa tiyta khypuv ca nama va cadi? Lungruetlepie taa tana malie ama vya ka aa tapa kha pachang va ung ca ma?

Jerubbaal sacapaa Abimelek kha ahungma a thie? Canung pakha ta jungsacuo rienapa alung a cungluo'apa kha lungruetlepie taata za pathlasue te na Thebez lie a thiy cuo va ma?” Khaapanakawma lungruetlepie kha nama va cadi?’ aca ta kieca, ‘Hit pa Uriah zaw kha a thiy ra,’ na ta aa” a ta.
Caacuonakawta biephyatuv ca si te, David'a luo kha pha te Joab ta ri riypata a pathlie hnuochuopa kha a chang.
Biephyatuv ta David kyihuo khata, “Cawsaa tie khata malie te vie yi te ruo lie kha malie ama vya tuv; cuorasala kiema ta hukaa thlake te khata ma vaa cade yi.

Cakhutaata cuoti ka a thepa tie khata na changtaapa tie kha lungruetlepie taata malie ama vya ka; siepahruo changtaapa tie chekha kha thiy yi te na changtaapa, Hit ming Uriah zaw kha a thiy ra,” a ta.

David ta biephyatuv kyihuo khata, “Joab kha, ‘Hingpa kaw hingta na palung rie a pathyi khah, tahematapakieca zueziy ta ca ata hing pakha, cakhutaata a hrangpa pakha ta pata muo a thie thluo ta; khypuv na tuvnapa ca cahra sa vie la para diy tie,’ ta pata va chang tie. Cakhutaata ama kha thaa va pi tie,” a ta.
Uriah napuvnung ta a navaapa a thiypa kha a thyi tiyta, a navaapa muochie kha a sa.
A muochiesapa a chuo tiyta David ta cawsaa pathlie te a ing luo amaa vya chiy, cakhutaata a napuv ta a li te sacapaa pakha a sapa.
Caacuonakawta Abyipata Nathan kha David'a luo a pathlie. Ama'a luo ca a vaw te, “Khypuv suokha lie cawsaa pahning aw yi te, pakha ca a hnyirungpa ta cuo te pakha ca siypasapa ta a cuo.
A hnyirungpa paa ca tuvrung hne cuerung kha a hluvsa a hnyi.

Cuorasala siypasapa paa ca a calyipa tuvcanung sakha dyi kha a hnyi. Capa tuvcanung ca mangchiy te, ama hne a saata zaw hneta ama lethaw. Sa kha a hraw te a panuo chungtaata tiy a dang, a cacunghnaa lie a paw te a sacanung haa khata a cuo.

A hnyirungpa pakha ing luo kha khyche pakha a vya chiy. A hnyirungpa paa ta khyche saduona riypata a tuvrung acuolikie a cuerung chungtaata sa kha hmuo pahya li pata, cuorasala siypasapa paa tuvtaata kha la te a ing a tlungpa khyche kha a thiepa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata David hihaana ca cawsaapa cunglie ca myi ie ta a ie. Nathan kyihuo khata, “Abyipaa hringpa haata cawsaapa hing thiy aa phuv;
Hingpa hmang hing tue te ngiechina a hnyi li nakaw hingta tuvtaata kha le paliy ta a thung riypa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Nathan ta David kyihuo khata, “Capa paa ca nama tana na cuo! AbyipaIsrael Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Nama ca Israel siepahruo ta chiytiy ica pathuv, cakhutaata Saul kuv chungtaata ica khuo;

Na byipaapa ing kha capi angte na byipaapa napuv tie kha na cacunghnaa luo ica pi, cakhutaata Israel ingchungkhue hne Judah ingchungkhue kha ica pi; capa ca a caw tuv kieca, hingpa zaa hing ica pichiy vie aa.

Khaapanakawma ama ming hmungna lie hmang pha lipa tue riypata Abyipabie ca siysaa na ri va? Hit ming Uriah kha zueziy ta na thie, a napuv kha na napuv ta naa la, cakhutaata ama kha Ammon ming zueziy ta na thie.
Caacuonakawta kama kha na ese cate Hit ming Uriah napuvnung kha na napuv ta naa la nakawta na ingchungkhue ca zueziy ta thuse buo'a vyi.

Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Na ingchungkhue mamaa taata nama caa du riypa ruvna kha i papuv aa; na ming hmungna lieta na napuv zaw kha la'a yi angte na ingpaa kha i pi'a yi, cakhutaata ningchung saahraa puv ta na napuv zaw kha aa ziehne'a yi.
Tahematapakieca nama ta hingpa hing a paruv ta na tue; cuorasala kama ta ca hingpa hmang hing Israel ming bangkhuo hmiekunglie hne ningchung saahraa tana i tue aa,” a ta.
David ta Nathan kyihuo khata, “Abyipa'a liena i sue tli,” a ta. Nathan ta David kyihuo khata, “Abyipata na suena kha aca thawpa tli; thiy'a vaciy.
Cadyiseca, hingpa hmang na tuena thue hingta Abyipakha na esesa tli nakawta na sapa na saata ca a thiy aa,” a ta. Cakhutaata Nathan ca a ing luo a cakuo.
Uriah napuvnung ta David cuota a sapa saata ca Abyipata tuv te khuopuv ta a pasa.
Caacuonakawta David ta Khazing kha haatiy cuo ca ta paa a kie; David ca sa aa uv, ing chung luo a ngie te zuokhydyi alyi lie a laa.
A ing chunglie uvthyi tie ta aa thaalie kha a daa yi te, alyi taata thu riypa khata paa ama kie, cuorasala thu khing vyi, iema hrawlie kha sa zaw ning vyi.

A ning sariyna lieta haatiy kha a thiy. David changtaapa tie ta haatiy a thiypa kha ama ca chang nguo va yi; caacuonakawta iema ta, “Haatiy a hring kalie ning hmuota bie ma chang pata malie naathlie vyi; haatiy na a thiy tli tapa changchiy ca tuokhaatama ma chang nguo aa? Ama hne ama khana ruvna aa pi pathlyi aa,” ama ta.

Cuorasala David ta a changtaapa tie bieparuv ama ripa kha a hmung tiyta, haatiy na a thiy tli tapa kha a pachang; a changtaapa tie kyihuo khata, “Haatiy ca a thiy ma?” a ta. Iema ta, “A thiy tli,” ama ta.

Cakhutaata David ca alyi taa cata thu te, tiy a siy te, sathu a thuv te caw aa thle. Abyipaing chungluo kha a ngie te Khazing kha aa bie; cakhutaata a ing luo kha cakuo te, sa kha a hie yi te, pachiepa yi te a ning.

Cakhutaata a changtaapa tie ta ama kyihuo khata, “Na tuepa hmang hing khaapatama a cuo? Haatiy a hring ning kha a cuota sa a uv cate na caa; cuorasala haatiy a thiy taata thu cate sa na ning,” ama ta.
Ama ta, “Haatiy a hring kalie ning kha sa a uv angte i caa; tahematapakieca kama ta, ‘Ahungma a pachang aa? Abyipata na ngiechi'a te haatiy kha a pahring'a muo i ta,’ a ta.
Cuorasala ata hing ca a thiy tli; khaapanakawma sa ca i uv aa? Haatiy kha i pahring pakhaa the'a ma? Kama na ama'a luo a si'a ang, cuorasala ama ca kama'a luo vya kaa'a va tli,” a ta.
Cakhutaata David ta a napuvnung Bathsheba kha a hnaanguona ri te, ama'a luo kha a ngie te aa ziehne; ama ta sacapaa kha sa te Solomon ta pata ming a sa. Abyipata ama kha due te,
profet Nathan'a taa khata bie a taa; caacuonakawta Abyipanakawta a ming ca Jedidiah ta pata a sa.
Joab ta Ammon ming khypuv Rabbah kha tuv te a la.
Joab ta David'a luo kha biephyatuv pathlie yi te, “Rabbah kha i tuv tli; ca hlyitaw taata tiy hluvnapa khypuv zaw kha i la tli.
Cakhutaata, ata ca, aa ngaapa cawsaa tie kha pahmya yi la, khypuv kha a ripuo la la tie, caacuolikieca kama hrahring ta khypuv kha la'a angte i ming ta ama ku aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta David ta cawsaa bangkhuo kha pahmya yi te, Rabbah luo kha si te, tuv te a la.

Ama ta Milkom luv taata byilakhuv kha a la. Aa riyna ca siy talen suokha cuo te, capa chunglie ca alung muosungpa a aw; cakhutaata capa ca David kha ama pakhuv. Ama ta khypuv hruosue a hluvsa zaw kha a la.

A chunglie a awpa cawsaa zaw kha papya yi te, hluo hne thaa pawzung hne thaa ahryi ta re pahrie sa yi te lungrue a parue sa yi. Cahaacata Ammon khypuv bangkhuo lie kha a tue diy. Cakhutaata David hne a cawsaa zaw bangkhuo ca Jerusalem luo kha ama vya kaa.
Cuo ca vya sile te, David sacapaa Absalom ta Tamar ama tapa a puvthesapa sieta pakha a hnyi; capa nung ca David sacapaa Amnon ta a khing.
Amnon ca a sieta nung Tamar a khing tuvnapa ta ama hne ama kha aa pasa sa; tahematapakieca ama ca lesaa pathenung ta cuo te a cunglie hmang suokhakha tue riypata Amnon cuota cuo khu'a na a ngie vyi.
Cuorasala Amnon ta Jonadab ama tapa viesaa pakha a hnyi; ama ca David uvta Shimeah sacapaa ta cuo te, a zyatesa pata a cuo.
Ama ta, “Vya siepahruo sacapaa, khaapanakawma maw kha hnang maw kha ta na hmie pha li pata na aw pari? Na chang'a va ca ma?” a ta. Amnon ta, “I uvnupa Absalom sieta Tamar na i khing,” a ta.

Jonadab ta, “Na iehmang lie kha a zie la a pasa sa tie; cakhutaata na paa ta aca vya mang tiyta, ama kha chang la, ‘I sietanung Tamar kha a vaw pata ning riypa suokhakha na vya pi sala, i hmiekunglie hing pachie'a te, capa ca hmung angte a kuv taata i ning the riy'a pata’ ta tie,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Amnon ca a zie te, aa pasa sa; cakhutaata siepahruo ta a vya mang tiyta, Amnon ta siepahruo kyihuo cata, “I sietanung Tamar kha a vaw thi sala a kuv taata i ning the riypata i hmungna lie hing viechuo tluo hning na tuepa thi se,” a ta.
Cakhutaata David ta Tamar ing luo kha cawsaa pathlie yi te, “Na caapaapa Amnon ing luo kha vaa la a cuota sa va changpa tie,” a pata sa yi.
Caacuonakawta Tamar ca a caapaapa Amnon ing, aa zienapa luo kha a vaa. Jungsacuo viedie kha la te, ne te a hmiekunglie kha viechuo kha tue te a e.

Cakhutaata pakaa lie kha thue te a hmiekunglie kha a pachie, cuorasala ning khing li pata a aw. Amnon ta, “Cawsaa bangkhuo kha kama'a taata pya diy yi se,” a ta. Caacuonakawta cawsaa bangkhuo ca ama'a taata ama pya diy.

Cakhutaata Amnon ta Tamar kyihuo khata, “Na kuv taata i ning the riypata sa ca i ziena khuo luo hing za cyi tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Tamar ta a tuepa viechuo ca la te, a caapaapa Amnon a ziena khuo luo ca aa ngiekhyi.
Cuorasala ning riypata aa thaa luo a chiykhyi tiyta ama kha vya patuv te, “A vaw la kama'a lie hing a vya zie tie, i sietanung,” a ta.
Ama ta palie te, “Cuo vyi i caapaapa, na hripuo khah; hing haapa hmang hing Israel chunglie tue pata cuo vyi; hmang chie tuvpa hing tue khah!

Kama cuo ta, i nangzaana ca khaapa luo ma i phyale khu aa? Cakhutaata nama cuo zaw ta Israel ming chunglie cawsaa pha lipa tana naa li aa. Caacuonakawta paa na ica kie, ata hingta, siepahruo kha chang tie, nama a hlaw riypa hing na thlu'a vyi,” a ta.
Cuorasala ama bie kha naathlie vyi; ama laata a thaa a ruv viepa a cuopa haata, hruohra ta hripuo te aa ziehne.
Cakhutaata Amnon ta ama kha khuopuv ta hue te, a za khing ningta a duena laa khata a huena ca a le vie. Amnon ta ama kyihuo kha, “Thu la pya tie!” a ta.
Cuorasala ama ta, “Cuo vyi i caapaapa; inaa cadepa ca hingna i cunglie na tuepa a hrangpa laata a le vie aa,” a ta. Cuorasala naathlie vyi.
Ama a mangchiypa a changtaapa kha ku te, “Hingpa canung hing i hmiekung taa hingta papya la ingchiy hre khuo tie,” a ta.
(Ama ca a buo syipa buohryi pasiypa kha aa hryi; tahematapakieca hluo chuo ningta siepahruo sacanung tie amaa hryi pata a cuo.) Caacuonakawta a changtaapa ta ama kha papya te ingchiy a hre khuo.
Cuorasala Tamar ta a luv lie buvcuo a phuv te, aa hryipa buohryi pasiypa kha a thlaa; a kuv kha a luv lie khang te a cakuopuole pata khuosa ta a caale.

A caapaapa Absalom ta ama kyihuo khata, “Na caapaapa Amnon ta caa ziehne kanaa? I sieta, ata hing ca a dieta tah aw tie; ama ca na caapaapa tana a cuo; palung pasa tuv pata rue khah,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Tamar ca a caapaapa Absalom ing lie kha nangzaa ngiechi pata a aw.
Siepahruo David ta capa thuohlaa ca a thyi tiyta, khuopuv ta a hi a haa, cuorasala a sacapaa Amnon ca a sacapaa uvthyi ta a cuo nakawta due te duote vyi.
Cuorasala Absalom ta Amnon kha biephapa cuose, biechiepa cuose rihne vyi; tahematapakieca a sietanung Tamar kha hruohra ta aa ziehne nakawta Absalom ta Amnon kha a hue.
Kung hning a bi khutaata, Absalom ta Efraim athaalie Baal-hazor lie kha tuv hming a ngutuv tie hnyi yi te, Absalom ta siepahruo sacapaa bangkhuo kha a ku yi.
Absalom ta siepahruo'a luo kha vaa te, “Na changtaapa ta tuv hming a ngutuv tie i hnyi yi; siepahruo hne a changtaapa zaw ca na changtaapa'a lie hing si ra thi tie ung,” a ta.

Cuorasala siepahruo ta Absalom kyihuo khata, “Cuo vyi, i sacapaa, ima bangkhuo ta ca si khah se puv, caacuolikieca na cuo tana hmangriy ima cuo aa,” a ta. Ama ta a hripuo, cuorasala ama pangpa ca si li pata thluechiy kha a pi.
Cakhutaata Absalom ta, “Cata a cuo li kieca i uvta Amnon kha kiema'a lie pasi sa ra tie,” a ta. Siepahruo ta ama kyihuo khata, “Khaapanakawma nama'a lie ca a si ra aa?” a ta.
Cuorasala Absalom ta Amnon hne siepahruo sacapaa zaw bangkhuo a pasi sa ra hluo li yi ta a chang pari. Absalom ta siepahruo pyi haa khata pyi a tue.

Cakhutaata Absalom ta a changtaapa tie kha bie pi yi te, “Amnon kha mingsuvtiy ta a palung a patluona te huo ung la, ‘Amnon kha tuv tie ung,’ ica ta tiy yi ta ama kha nama thie aa. Ciy khah ung; kama pangpa tana ica chang yi cuo va ma? Nama palung cahra sala nama rie pha se,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta Absalom changtaapa zaw ta Absalom ta bie a pina haa yi khata Amnon kha ama thie. Cakhutaata siepahruo sacapaa bangkhuo ca thu yi te, ama laa cyicuo kha a khang yi te amaa ruo.
Luopuv lie ama aw kaliepa khata, Absalom ta siepahruo sacapaa bangkhuo kha thie diy yi te pakha hmuo a ngaa va yi, ta pata David'a luo kha thuohlaa a pha.
Siepahruo ca thu te a pang kha thlaa te alyi lie a laa; a thaalie a daapa a changtaapa bangkhuo ta ama pang kha ama thlaa ra.

Cuorasala David uvta Shimeah sacapaa Jonadab ta, “I byipaapa ta siepahruo sacapaa satlie bangkhuo kha ama thie ta pata rue pathlyi khah se; Amnon pakha dyina a thiy. Hingpa hing ca Amnon ta a sietanung Tamar hruohra ta aa ziehne ning taa khata Absalom ta bie aa chi ciepa tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta, i byipaapa siepahruo ta siepahruo sacapaa bangkhuo tana ama thiy diy ta pata rue khah se, tahematapakieca Amnon pakha dyina a thiy,” a ta.
Cuorasala Absalom ca aa ruo. Rievetuv satliepa ta luohlaa luo kha a suo tiyta, Horonaim luopuv tluope taata cawsaa hluvpuv ama vya sipa kha a hmung.
Jonadab ta siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Mang tie, siepahruo sacapaa zaw ca ama vya pha tli, na changtaapa ta i ripa haa khata a tling sasaw tli,” a ta.
A bie ripa a patlung pahne ta siepahruo sacapaa zaw ca vya chiy yi te, khuosa ta ama caa; siepahruo hne a changtaapa bangkhuo zaw khuosa ta ama caa ra.
Cuorasala Absalom ca a ruo te, Geshur siepahruo Ammihud sacapaa Talmai'a luo kha a si. David ca ning kha hnang ning kha ta a sacapaa muochie kha a sa.
Absalom ca Geshur luo kha a ruo te, capa lie ca kung thung a aw.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ta Absalom kha a vuo hringhruo; tahematapakieca Amnon ca a thiy tlipa tana a cuo, ta te a palung aa pape.
Zeruiah sacapaa Joab ta siepahruo pathiypalung na Absalom cunglie dyi a aw tapa kha a pachang.

Joab ta Tekoa luo kha cawsaa pathlie yi te a singpa canung pakha kha amaa vya chiy. Ama ta capa nung kyihuo cata, “Muochie a sapa haa khata a pa-aw sa la pangluv kha a khuv tie; sathu kha a thuv li pata aw la, ning hluvpuv chung a thiypa muochie a sapa canung haa khata aw tie.
Siepahruo'a luo kha vaa la hing haa hingta va ri tie,” a ta. Cakhutaata a ri riypa bie kha Joab ta a chang.
Tekoa cawsaanung ca siepahruo'a luo kha aa vaw tiyta, alyi luo a khuv te pa-uvsathyina kha pi te, “Vya siepahruo, naa bya thi tie!” a ta.
Siepahruo ta, “Khaapama na ruvnaana ca a cuo?” a ta. Ama ta palie te, “Vya siepahruo, nunghlyi ta cuo angte i navaapa ca a thiy tli.
Na changtaanung ta sacapaa pahning i hnyi; ruo lie kha pa kha hne pa kha a tuv yi te, a caphi riypa pakha hmuo ama aw li nakawta pa kha ta a hrangpa pa kha kha a thie.

Ata ca ama ingchungkhue yalya ta na changtaanung hing na thu hning yi te, ‘A uvnu a thiepa cawsaa ca malie pi tie, a thiepa a uvnu hringna cuo tana ama kha ma thie aa, rucutuv zaw kha ma para aa,’ ina ta yi. Cahaacata iema ta i myihyi aa ngaa tlakuopa ca pache'a yi te, hingpa chuelyi lie hing i navaapa cuota ming cuose, aa ngaapa cuose, khaapahmuo pangaa'a va yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ta cawsaanung kyihuo cata, “Na ing luo kha cakuo la na bie ca ica ripa aa,” a ta.
Tekoa cawsaanung ca ta siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Suebena ca kama cunglie hne i paa ingchungkhue cunglie cuo sala siepahruo hne a byilakhuv ca sue be pata cuo khah se,” a ta.
Siepahruo ta, “Pakhakha ta suokhakha aca ta kie yi ca, kama'a luo vya chiykhyi la nama kha ca de buo'a va tli,” a ta.

Cakhutaata ama ta, “Thiyse phuvlatuv tie ta ama thie li riypa hne i sacapaa kha ama para li riypata, siepahruo ta Abyipana Khazing kha na palung lie pari thi tie,” a ta. Ama ta, “Abyipaa hringpa haata, na sacapaa a luv cung taata a suobuv suokha hmuo alyi luo tla'a vyi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata cawsaanung ta, “I byipaapa siepahruo'a lie kha bie suokhata na pari sa thi tie,” a ta. Ama ta, “Ri tie,” a ta.

Cawsaanung ca ta, “Cata a cuo kieca, khaapanakawma ca haapa hmang ca Khazing cawsaa cunglieta tue naa nang? Hingpa biechina siepahruo ta a tue tiyta, siepahruo ta ruo chungtaata a papyapa kha ing luo a ku pakhaa li nakawta ama hne ama na sue aa phaw.

Kiema ca ma bangkhuo ta ma thiy hrahring aa; alyi lie lyi pata la pakhaa khu a aw lipa tiy hne tana maa lu. Cuorasala ruo chungtaata papyapa kha a hmiekung luo chuozaa ta chiy li tli pata a aw li riypata khue a khuopa ca Khazing ta a hringna la'a vyi.

Cawsaa ta ciy riypata ina tue nakaw yi ta, ata hing a vaw angte i byipaapa siepahruo'a luo hing ica vya chang. Na changtaanung ta, ‘Siepahruo'a liena i va ri aa; a changtaanung ta aa hiepa hing siepahruo ta tuepa ngiethie'a va ma.
Tahematapakieca siepahruo ta thyi'a te, Khazing ru chungtaata kama hne i sacapaa malie a para riypa tie kuv chungtaata a changtaanung ca ina palaw sa aa.'

Na changtaanung ta, ‘I byipaapa siepahruo bie ca a hyna ina pi khu aa ta pata i rue'; tahematapakieca i byipaapa siepahruo ca avuoming haata a chie hne a pha a thleduo khupa tana a cuo. Abyipana Khazing ta ca awpuo mang sue!” a ta.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ta cawsaanung kha palie te, “Ica hiehriypa bangkhuo hing kama'a lie khaapahmuo nu'a vaciy,” a ta. Cawsaanung ta, “I byipaapa siepahruo ta ri thluo se,” a ta.

Siepahruo ta, “Hingpa bangkhuo lie hing Joab kuv a tla ma?” a ta. Cawsaanung ta palie te, “I byipaapa siepahruo na hringpa haata, i byipaapa siepahruo na ripa taa hingta cavyiluo cuose, cacuoluo cuose ahungtahmuo hnyi khu vyi. Bie naa pipa hing na changtaapa Joab tana a cuo; hingpa bie bangkhuo na changtaanung pakaa luo naa hmyapa ca ama tana a cuo.

Hmang sizya kha thle riypata na changtaapa Joab na hingpa hing a tue. Cuorasala alyi cunglie a awpa bangkhuo hing pachang riypata i byipaapa ta Khazing avuoming ta ama hnyipa haapa singna kha na hnyi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ta Joab kyihuo khata, “A pha hringhruo, hingpa hing ica pi; si la satliepa Absalom kha va la pakhaa tie,” a ta.

Joab ca alyi lie kha a bu te pa-uvsathyina kha pi te, siepahruo kha thluechiy a pi; cakhutaata Joab ta, “I byipaapa siepahruo, siepahruo ta na changtaapa icaa hiepa kha ina pi nakaw ca ta, ataning hing na changtaapa ta hmiephaa i hmung tapa kha i pachang,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Joab ca thu te, Geshur luo kha si te Absalom kha Jerusalem luo aa vya chiy.
Siepahruo ta, “A ing luo kha cakuo se; i hmiekung luo vya chiy khah se,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Absalom ca a ing luo kha a cakuo, siepahruo hmiekung luo kha vya chiy vyi.
Israel ming bangkhuo hrawlie puvthena luo ta Absalom tluv ta pathuosa riypa pakha hmuo aw va yi; a phyidaw taata a luvsadiy te ta syisaa riy aw vyi.
A suo kha aa ngu tiyta, (kung chuo kyry ta a suo kha aa ngu taw; aa riy tuv tiyta) a luv cunglie a suo a riyna a pathlie ca siepahruo taana ta shekel zahning a ta.
Absalom ca sacapaa pathung hne sacanung pakha a hnyi, a sacanung ming ca Tamar ta yi te a puvthesapa canung ta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Absalom ca siepahruo hmiekung luo chiy li pata kung hning chung Jerusalem lie kha a aw.
Cakhutaata Absalom ta Joab kha siepahruo'a luo cakuokhyi riypata bie a taa; cuorasala Joab ca ama'a luo kha a vaw vyi. A yihningna a pathlie pakhaa, cuorasala Joab ca a vaw khing vyi.

Cakhutaata, ama ta a changtaapa tie kyihuo khata, “Mang tie Joab lu ca kama lu a vya phapa hingta cuo te, barli a hnyi hue; cakuo la myi ta va rue tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Absalom changtaapa tie ta lu ca myi ta ama rue.
Cakhutaata Joab ca thu te Absalom kha a ing luo vaahning te, “Khaapanakawma na changtaapa tie ta i lu kha myi ta ama rue?” a ta.

Absalom ta Joab kha palie te, “Mang tie, bie ca vya taa angte: Hingpa luo hing a vaw pata, ‘Khaapanakawma Geshur taata i vaw? Ata tepa hingta khapa lie kha aw ang sala i cuota pha vie'a va ma?’ ta pata siepahruo kha va hiehriy riypata ica pathlie aa, i ta. Caacuonakawta ata hing ca siepahruo hmiekung luo kha chang ang se; sue be pata i cuo kieca, na thie thluo se!” a ta.

Cakhutaata Joab ca siepahruo'a luo kha vaa te a chang; cakhutaata ama ta Absalom ca a ku. Caacuonakawta siepahruo'a luo kha a vaw te siepahruo hmiekunglie ca alyi luo a bung te pa-uvsathyina a pi; cakhutaata siepahruo ta Absalom kha a cakuv.
Capa khutaa cata Absalom ta aruole suokha hne aruo zaw, a hmieluo ta a ruo riypata cawsaa sawngaa aa chi.

Absalom ca mawdiy ta thu te hukaa luopuv kielie kha aa daa taw; siepahruo hmiekung luo bieripa riypata a vya chiypa mekaa kha Absalom ta ku yi te, “Khaapa khypuv taata ma nama cuo?” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Na changtaapa zaw hing capa phang khapa phang tana ma cuo,” ama ta.
Absalom ta, “Mang tie na bie ca pha te aa dang; cuorasala siepahruo ta na bie naathlie riypata a chipa pakha hmuo aw va yi,” a ta taw yi.
Ca hlyitaw taata Absalom ta, “Hingpa ruo lie hing kama na bieripatuv ta a cuo ang tapa kieca bie a hnyipa kama'a luo amaa vaw tiyta aa dangsa pata bie i chipa'a yi,” a ta.
Pa-uvsathyina pi riypata ama kha amaa vya ngie tiyta, a kuv kha va pazu te a patuv khutaa yi ta a pahnuo taw yi.
Siepahruo'a luo bieripa riypata a vawpa Israel ming mekaa cunglie kha Absalom ta cahaacata a tue taw. Caacuonakawta Absalom ta Israel ming pathiypalung kha a paruv yi.
Kung paliy a chuo khutaata Absalom ta siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Abyipa'a lie i tuepa biekuona patling sa riypata Hebron luo kha na pasi sa thi tie.
Tahematapakieca Aram ruo Geshur lie i aw ning kha na changtaapa ta biekuona tue angte: Abyipana Jerusalem luo naa pakaa sa hmisi tapa kieca, Hebron lie hing Abyipaca i bie aa, i za ta,” a ta.
Siepahruo ta ama kyihuo khata, “Diena hneta si tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta thu te Hebron luo kha a si.
Cuorasala Absalom ta Israel mingphang zaw bangkhuo'a luo kha biephyatuv pathlie te, “Hmyakaa pu nama thyi pahne khata khi ung la: Absalom na Hebron lie siepahruo a cuo tli! nama ta aa!” a ta.
Jerusalem taata cawsaa zahning kha Absalom'a lie ama si ra; iema ca hry pata cuo yi te, hmang cuozya khaapahmuo a pachang lipa ta ama cuo.

Absalom ta hriykhungrina a pihluo tiyta Giloh ming Ahithophel, David tluopuv ta a cuopa kha a khy Giloh taa khata a ku. Absalom hne a awpa cawsaa ca hluv hryly yi te, a paruv ta hriepa aduna re ca a thaa a ruv hryly.
David'a luo kha biephyatuv pakha a vaw te, “Israel ming pathiypalung ca Absalom'a luona a chiy diy tli,” a ta.

Cakhutaata David ta Jerusalem lie ama hne a awpa byi tie bangkhuo kyihuo khata, “Thu tie ung! A ruo'a ung puv, caacuolikieca Absalom'a taa hingta kiema cuota lawna luopuv aw li pata aw'a kie. A pahraa tie ung, caacuolikieca malie vya pha paluo'a te, khypuv kha zueziy ta tuv'a te ma cunglie rana a patlung sa aa,” a ta.
Siepahruo abyi tie khata, “Na changtaapa tie ca ma byipaapa siepahruo ta tue riypa ta pata bie na chipa khaapahmuo ma tue aa,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta siepahruo ca pya te, ing mangchiy riypata a chi siypa yi a nungthang pahraa tie ta li pata, a ingchungkhue tie ta ama paziy.
Siepahruo ca pya te, cawsaa bangkhuo ta ama paziy, cakhutaata ruobuo a chuo cepa ing lie kha amaa daa.

Aa byi tie bangkhuo ta aa thaalie khata ama caluo; cakhutaata Cheret ming bangkhuo hne Peleth ming bangkhuo, hne Gath taata ama a ziypa Git ming zacaruv bangkhuo kha siepahruo hmielie khata ama caluo.

Cakhutaata siepahruo ta Git ming Ittai kyihuo khata, “Khaapanakawma niema zaw hing kiema'a lie nama vya si ra? Kaa ung la siepahruo'a lie kha va aw tie ung; tahematapakieca nama ca ruohrang ming cuo cate, na ruo taata papyapa tana na cuo.

Azuochaning dyi a vya chiypa cuo cate, i si khu thiy ta i si ning hing i khiena bangkhuo tama icaa khiekhyi aa? Kaa la, na uvnu zaw hing kaakhyi tie yi; Khazing ta aa hmangpa duena hne zang tluo atlana ca na cunglie paluo sa mang sue,” a ta.

Cuorasala Ittai ta siepahruo kha palie te, “Abyipahring te i siepahruo na hringpa haata, i byipaapa siepahruo na awnapa khaapa lie hmuo cuo sala, thiyna lie a cuo zaw hringna lie a cuo zaw, capa lie ca na changtaapa i aw aa,” a ta.
David ta Ittai kyihuo khata, “A cuo kieca, si la caluo tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Git ming Ittai ta a cawsaa zaw bangkhuo hne ama'a lie a awpa haatiy zaw bangkhuo hne khata ama caluo.
Cawsaa bangkhuo ama caluole nakawta ruo ming bangkhuo ca khuopuv ta a caa. Siepahruo ta Kidron Bawphie kha te te cawsaa bangkhuo ca ruocaapa chung luo kha ama caluole.

Abiathar kha aa khaw, cakhutaata Zadok zaw Levi ming bangkhuo hne khata Khazing biekuona thingkaw kha a puv yi te aa khaw ra. Cawsaa bangkhuo khypuv taata ama pya diy hluo li biekuona thingkaw kha alyi lie ama chi.

Cakhutaata siepahruo ta Zadok kyihuo khata, “Khazing biekuona thingkaw hing khypuv chung luo kha kaakhyi pakhaa tie. Abyipahmiekunglie na hmiephaa i hmung tapa kieca na vya kaakhyi pakhaa'a te, hingpa thingkaw hne aa tunapa hing i hmung pakhaa aa.
Cuorasala, ‘Nama'a lie i palung tluo vyi,’ ina ta kieca, hingpa lie hing i aw thluo hing, ama ta a pha a tapa haata i cunglie hing tue thluo se,” a ta.

Siepahruo ta tluobyi Zadok kyihuo ta a ri kaliepa ca, “Mang tie, nama hne Abiathar hne nama sacapaa pahning, nama sacapaa Ahimaaz hne Abiathar sacapaa Jonathan hne khata khy chung luo kha diena hne kaa tie ung.
Mang tie, ruocaapa chunglie, tiyhaa tena lie kha niema'a taata bie ina pathyi hluo li ung ciy i za aw aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Zadok hne Abiathar ca Khazing biekuona thingkaw kha Jerusalem luo sikhyi pakhaa yi te, capa lie ca amaa ngaa.

Cuorasala David ca Olif Tluo cakhuo kha a caapuole pata a luv a khuv te a phyi cahri pata a kie; ama'a lie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo zaw kha ama luv a khuv yi te ama kiethaw ra, ama silepa khata ama caapuole.

David kha Absalom a hlaw yi te a paruv ta a dutuv tie hrawlie kha Ahithophel a aw ra ta pata ama chang. Cakhutaata David ta, “Vya Abyipa, nama'a luo na thlaa i chuo, Ahithophel ruena pipa kha ngaana ta pali thi mya,” a ta.
Cakhutaata David ca Khazing abienapa tluodaw luo a pha tiyta, Arkhi ming Hushai ca a buohryi cungpakaw tlaapa hne a luv lie buvcing hneta ama a taw riypata aa vaw.
David ta ama kyihuo khata, “Kama'a liena na si ra tapa kieca, i cuo ta hmangriy tana na cuo aa.

Cuorasala khypuv luo kha kaa cate Absalom kyihuo khata, ‘Vya siepahruo, a chuo ciepa cuo lieta na paa changtaapa i cuopa haata, ata zaw hing na changtaapa tana i cuo aa,’ na va ta kieca, Ahithophel khuekhuona kha ina tepa'a ciy.
Tluobyi Zadok hne Abiathar kha capa lie ca nama hneta ama aw aa. Caacuonakawta siepahruo ing taata na thyipa tuokhaapa a cuo zaw, tluobyi Zadok hne Abiathar kha chang tie yi.
Ama sacapaa pahning tie kha capa lie ca iema hneta aw yi te, Zadok sacapaa Ahimaaz hne Abiathar sacapaa Jonathan; iema'a taa cata na thyipa mekaa kha kama ina pathyi sa'a ciy,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta David viesaapa Hushai ca Absalom Jerusalem aa ngie ning khata khypuv chung luo kha aa ngie ra.

David ta tluodaw kha a cawta a law pata, Mefibosheth changtaapa Ziba ta kedie a padie te viechuo tluo zahning, mingsuv caapa baw zakha, cuovuo thingthyi zakha, hne mingsuvtiy savang ungthyi zung kha a phyapa laa sahning hneta ama kha aa taw.

Siepahruo ta Ziba kyihuo khata, “Khaapanakawma hingpa tie hing na vya phya?” a ta. Ziba ta palie te, “Laa tie hing siepahruo ingchungkhue a khang riypata a cuo, viechuo hne cuovuo thingthyi hing satlie zaw ning riypata cuo te, mingsuv hing ruocaapa lie a thaa a buopa tie dang riypata a cuo,” a ta.

Siepahruo ta, “Na byipaapa sacapaa haw khaapaliema a aw?,” a ta. Ziba ta siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Jerusalem liena aa ngaa; ‘Ataning hing Israel ming na i mingpa pena kha kama naa pi pakhaa'a yi,’ a ta,” a ta.

Cakhutaata siepahruo ta Ziba kyihuo khata, “Mefibosheth ta a hnyipa bangkhuo ca nama huopa tana a cuo tli,” a ta. Ziba ta, “Pa-uvsathyina na ica pi; Na hmiekunglie hmiephaa hmung thi ang se, i byipaapa siepahruo,” a ta.
Siepahruo David kha Bahurim luo a pha tiyta, Saul phang ta a cuopa ingchungkhue taata Gera sacapaa Shimei kha chiesapuo pata a kya pya.
Ama ta David hne Siepahruo David a changtaapa zaw bangkhuo kha alung ta a vaa yi. Capa ning ca cawsaa bangkhuo hne a thaaruvpa bangkhuo kha a cavyi a cacuo ta ama aw.
Shimei ta chie a sapuopa khata, “Pyale tie! Pyale tie! Lie a nawpa! Cawsaa chiepa!

Abyipata a pena na chuvpa Saul ingchungkhue bangkhuo thiyse cuo khata phuv ca la te, Abyipata pena kha na sacapaa Absalom kuv luo a pi tli. Mang tie, nama ca thiyse a palangtuv na cuo nakawta rana ta aca tlung hing,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Zeruiah sacapaa Abishai ta siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Khaapanakawma hingpa uv thiypa hingta i byipaapa siepahruo hing chie a sa? Vaa ang sala a rue hue va te ang se,” a ta.

Cuorasala siepahruo ta, “Zeruiah sacapaa zaw, khaapama namaa thla riypa a aw? Abyipata David hing chiesa tie a ta nakawta chie ina sa kieca ahungma, ‘Khaapanakawma hing haa hingta na tue?’ a ta khu aa,” a ta.

David ta Abishai hne a changtaapa bangkhuo kyihuo khata, “Kama sacapaa hrahring ta ina thie khing; hingpa Benjamin ming changchiy hing ta ca kha tluv tama ina thie khing vie aa! Tuokhaata hmuo ta khah ung, chie ca na sa thluo se; tahematapakieca Abyipata a changpa tana a cuo.
Abyipata i riethyina hing na hmungpa'a te, Abyipata ataning chie ina sana kawlie hing phana ta ina thung the biephung'a tli hing,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta David hne a cawsaa zaw ca luopuv lie kha ama sile. Capa ning ca Shimei ca iema hne aa rie-e tluope lie kha sile ra te a cakuopuolepa khata chie a sale; alung khata vaale yi te buvcing a hile yi.
Siepahruo hne cawsaa bangkhuo ca ama nangbuosa pata Jordan kha ama pha; capa lie ca thaazuo thaapa aa la.
Absalom hne Israel ming bangkhuo ca Jerusalem luo pha yi te, Ahithophel ca ama'a lie kha a aw.
Arki ming Hushai, David viesaapa kha Absalom'a luo ca vaa te, “Siepahruo ca na hring pasiy mang sue! Siepahruo ca na hring pasiy mang sue!,” a ta.
Absalom ta Hushai kyihuo khata, “Hingpa hing ma na viesaapa'a lie zang tluo naa tlana pata a cuo? Khaapanakawma na viesaapa'a lieta na si ra va?” a ta.
Hushai ta Absalom kyihuo khata, “Cuo vyi; cuorasala Abyipahne hingpa cawsaa tie hne Israel ming bangkhuo ta amaa tlawpa, capa paa huopa cata cuo'a angte, ama hne tana i aw aa.
Ca hlyitaw taata, ahung re ca ma i hrie hlyi aa? A sacapaa ta cuo'a va ma? Na paa re i hriepa haata, nama re na i hrie aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Absalom ta Ahithophel kyihuo khata, “Na ruena malie pi tie; khaapama ma tue aa?” a ta

Ahithophel ta Absalom kyihuo khata, “Ing huo riypata a chi siypa, na paa nungthang tie kha a ziehne tie yi; cata na tue kie dyina Israel ming bangkhuo khata na paa duvsa riypata nama hne nama naa tuepa kha thyi'a yi te, nama'a lie a awpa tie bangkhuo ca ama kuv a cahra aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta ingcung lie kha Absalom ca thluodaa sapa yi te, Israel ming bangkhuo hmungna lie kha Absalom ta a paa nungthang tie kha aa ziehne yi.
Capa cuo ning ca Ahithophel ta ruena a papyapa ca Khazing bie tluv ta ri pata a cuo; caacuonakawta Ahithophel ruena pipa bangkhuo ca David ta cuose, Absalom ta cuose ama ziy.
Ca hlyitaw taata Ahithophel ta Absalom kyihuo khata, “Cawsaa thawhning kha a tlaw'a yi angte, ata zuo hing ta a tha ang sala David kha a cade ang se.
A nangbuo ning hne a palung a chuo ningta pha'a angte, ama kha tuv'a angte aa pahlusa aa; cakhutaata ama'a lie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo kha amaa ruo diy aa. Siepahruo pakha dyi kha thie'a angte,

vaahnyituv lesaa ta a navaapa'a luo aa vawpa haa khata cawsaa bangkhuo kha nama'a luo i vya kaakhyi diy'a yi. Cawsaa pakha dyina thie riypata na huv, cawsaa bangkhuo kha ca a dieta tah na ama aw aa,” a ta.
Capa ruena pipa ca ta Absalom hne Israel uvthyi tie bangkhuo kha ama palung a patluo yi.
Absalom ta, “Arki ming Hushai zaw kha ku ung la, khaapama a ri aa tapa kha naathlie'a ung puv,” a ta.
Hushai kha Absalom'a luo aa vaw tiyta, Absalom ta ama kyihuo khata, “Hingpa hingna Ahithophel a ripa ta a cuo; ama ruena pipa haa hingta ma hrie'a ma? Cata a cuo li kieca nama malie chang tie,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Hushai ta Absalom kyihuo khata, “Ata lie Ahithophel ruena pipa hing ca pha vyi,” a ta.

Hushai ca ta pazue te, “Na paa hne a cawsaa zaw hing cawsaa thaaruvpa ama cuopa hne ruo lieta a taata lapapa cavaw haata ama hi a haa ning a cuopa kha nama pachang. Ca dyi ca cuo li pata na paa ca rietuv a the ciemuopa cuo te, zuo ta cawsaa zaw hrawlie a ri'a vyi.

Ata hingta hmuo khue chunglie ma, hmang hrangpa suokhakha luo ma na aa nu'a tli. Cakhutaata rie a tuv taana lie kha ima rieka tie chekha ama thiy tiyta, a thyipa bangkhuo ta, ‘Absalom a ziypa rieka tie ca amaa sung,’ ama ta aa.
Ca tiyta, a riephasa pa rieka, chingde palung a phyapa hmuota, ciyna a hnyi aa; tahematapakieca na paa ca a thaaruvpa a cuopa hne ama'a lie a awpa bangkhuo zaw a thaaruvpa ama cuopa kha ama pachang.
Cuorasala kama ruena chepa ca: Israel ming bangkhuo ca Dan taata Beer-sheba te, riyliykie lie viehnang zaa khata papung'a yi pate, nama zaw nama pangpa ta rietuvna luo na si ra aa.

Caacuonakawta ama ma hmung khunapa tuokhaapa hmang lie a cuo zaw, ama kha a buv ta buv'a pate, alyi lie a duo a tlapa haa khata ma tlasue aa; cahaacata ama cuose, ama'a lie a awpa cuo yi se pakha hmuo hring'a va yi.

Khypuv suokhakha chung luo na aa ngie ta pata a cuo kieca, Israel ming bangkhuo ta capa khypuv chung luo ca khuhriy kha vya cyi'a yi te, capa khy lieta lungcapang suokha hmuo hmung khu a aw lina te ta huekaw chung luo kha maa dapathla aa,” a ta.

Absalom hne Israel cawsaa bangkhuo ta, “Arki ming Hushai ruena pipa hingna Ahithophel ruena pipa laata a pha vie,” ama ta. Tahematapakieca Abyipata Absalom cunglie rana a patlung sa the riypata Abyipata Ahithophel ruena pipa a phapa kha pasung sa riypata a za rue pacie tli.
Cakhutaata Hushai ta tluobyi Zadok hne Abiathar kyihuo khata, “Ahithophel ta Absalom hne Israel uvthyi tie kha ca haa kha haa ta ruena a pi yi; cakhutaata kama ta ca haa kha haa ta ruena i pi yi.

Caacuonakawta cawsaa pathlie ung la David kha, ‘Ata zuo hing ruocaapa lie tiyhaa tena lie kha zaa ri khah, tuokhaata a cuo zaw za caluo mya; cata a cuo li kieca siepahruo hne ama'a lie a awpa bangkhuo ca paluopa tana nama cuo pathlyi aa,’ ta pata va chang tie ung,” a ta yi.

Jonathan hne Ahimaaz ta Enrogel lie ama za huo; changtaanung pakha ta vaa te a va chang taw yi, cakhutaata iema ta si yi te David kha ama va chang pachaa taw; tahematapakieca khy chung luo amaa ngiepa kha ahunghmuo a pahmung sa khing va yi.

Cuorasala satlie pakha ta hmung yi te Absalom kha a chang. Caacuonakawta ama pahning cata amaa ruo; Bahurim lieta cawsaa pakhapa ing luo kha chiy yi te a tlawhmie lie a awpa takhue chung luo kha amaa ngie.
Cawsaapa napuvnung khata takhue pakaa kha a pahruv ta pahruv te a cunglie kha suo a phu. Capa ca ahungtahmuo pachang va yi.

Absalom changtaapa tie ca ing lie cawsaanung'a luo kha vya pha yi te, “Khaapaliema Ahimaaz hne Jonathan kha ama aw?” ama ta. Cawsaanung ta iema kyihuo khata, “Cavaata khana ama va te,” a ta. Cakhutaata iema ta huv yi te ama hmung li taata Jerusalem luo kha ama kaa.

Iema ama kaa khutaa khata cawsaa tie ca takhue taa khata kya pya yi te, si yi te David kha ama va chang. Iema ta David kyihuo khata, “Si la cavaa kha a catli pata va te tie; tahematapakieca ca haa kha haa kha tana nama a du pata Ahithophel ta ruena a pi,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta David hne ama'a lie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo ca a thu yi te Jordan kha ama va te; ning a tlapa khata ca cavaa vaa te lipa pakha hmuo a ngaa va tli yi.

Ahithophel ta a ruena pipa kha ziy va yi tapa a hmung tiyta, a laa kha a kedie padie te a khy luo kha a si. A ingchungkhue khysazya riypa kha a phata tah patungpatie siy te ama hne ama kha khuhriy ta aa pa-uosa; thiy te a paa thluo lie kha ama paby.
Cakhutaata David ca Mahanaim luo kha a pha. Absalom zaw Israel ming bangkhuo hne khata Jordan cavaa kha a te.
Absalom ta Joab hmang lie kha Amasa ca riekabyilepa ta a chi. Amasa ca Ishmael ming Ithra ama tapa sacapaa ta a cuo. Ithra ca ta Joab a nung Zeruiah a nutanung Nahash sacanung Abigail kha aa hlaw.
Israel ming hne Absalom ca Gilead ruo lie kha amaa ri.
David ca Mahanaim luo kha a pha tiyta, Rabbah lie a awpa Ammon ming Nahash sacapaa, hne Lo-debar taata Ammiel sacapaa Makhir, hne Rogelim taata Gilead ming Barzillai zaw khata
iehmang zaw, rahung zaw, alyi bi zaw, hne jungsacuo chuo, barli, sa, vierue, khukhu zaw hne pe zaw,

khyitiy, cuehnungkaa zaw, tuv zaw, hne cuerung chungtaata hmungpa cuehnungkaa tie kha David hne ama'a lie a awpa tie ning riypa khata ama vya cyi, tahematapakieca iema ta, “Cawsaa ca ruocaapa chunglie kha ama nang a buo, ama nang diy te ama tiy a hrie,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata David ta ama'a lie a awpa cawsaa kha pahmya yi te, a thaw uvtuv tie hne a za uvtuv tie kha a chi yi.

Cakhutaata David ta rieka tie kha phuv thung ta a che yi: che thung che kha kha Joab kuv rawlie, che thung che kha kha Zeruiah sacapaa, Joab uvnu Abishai kuv rawlie, hne che thung che kha kha Git ming Ittai kuv rawlieta a chi yi. Siepahruo ta cawsaa zaw kyihuo khata, “Kama pangpa zaw niema'a lie i si ra aa,” a ta yi.

Cuorasala cawsaa zaw ta, “Nama ca pya'a vaciy. Tahematapakieca kiema ca maa ruo kie zawma siysaa malie ri'a va yi. Khingkhuo ma thiy kie zawma siysaa malie ri'a va yi. Cuorasala nama ca kiema thawhraa tluv tana na cuo; cata a cuo nakawta khy chungtaata byana malie pi lana a pha vie aa,” ama ta.
Siepahruo ta iema kyihuo khata, “Niema ta a pha ce nama tapa khaapa a cuo zaw i tue aa,” a ta. Caacuonakawta siepahruo ca hukaa athaalie kha a tu te, rieka tie ca a za za a thaw thaw ta ama caluo.

Siepahruo ta Joab hne Abishai hne Ittai kha bie pi yi te, “Kama hmiemang ta satliepa Absalom kha diy thi mya ung,” a ta yi. Cahaacata siepahruo ta Absalom kawlie riekabyilepa tie bie a pipa yi kha cawsaa bangkhuo ta ama thyi.
Caacuonakawta rieka ca Israel ming a du riypata ruo chung luo kha amaa ngie; amaa tuvna hmang ca Efraim atuv lieta a cuo.
David changtaapa tie khata Israel ming kha ama te, capa ning lieta capa hmang lie a thiena ca a le hringhruo, cawsaa thawkiy ama thiy.
Rie atuvna ca ruo chung bangkhuo ta a ze te, cawsaa ca a thie yi te a thiypa laata atuv chunglie a thiypa kha ama hluv vie.

Absalom ta David changtaapa tie kha aa taw pathlyi yi. Absalom ca a laa kha a khang te, laa ca a ce rungsapa mathliy kung rawlie khata aa ruo. A luv kha mathliy ce lieta a ti te alyi hne avuo alalalieta a pathlie te laa ca a caluo pathla.
Cawsaa pakha ta hmung te, Joab kha, “Absalom na mathliy kung cunglie aa pathlie pata i hmung,” ta pata a chang.
Joab ta ama a changpa paa kyihuo khata, “Khaapa na ta ma, na hmung sasaw ma? Khaapanakawma daw sa la alyi luo kha na pathla siy va? Ngu tuokaa phiehraa hne tesaw suokha ica pi'a pata,” a ta.

Cuorasala cawsaapa ca ta Joab kyihuo khata, “Tuokaa thawhraa hmuo i kuv luo pipa cuo ang sala, siepahruo sacapaa cunglie i kuv pathlie'a va ang; tahematapakieca ma thyinapa lieta siepahruo ta nama hne Abishai hne Ittai kyihuo ta: Kama hmiemang ta Absalom kha diy thi mya ung! ta pata bie aca pipa yi kha!
Thie biephung ang sala (khaapahmuo ta siepahruo'a taata nu khu a aw li nakawta) nama hrahring hmuota inaa phe se'a papuv ciy,” a ta.
Joab ta, “Nama hneta hing haa hingta i cuo pachuo'a va ang,” a ta. Asyi suothung kha a la te, Absalom ca mathliy kung lie a hring kaliepa khata a palung lie kha a cakha.
Joab cehre a cyipatuv satlie pahraa khata Absalom ca cadung yi te, tuv yi te ama thie.
Cakhutaata Joab ta hmyakaa kha tung te, Israel ming a cadepa rieka tie ca ama vya kaa, tahematapakieca Joab ta a thlu yi.

Iema ta Absalom kha la yi te, atuv chunglie khue lesapa chung luo kha ama thaw, cakhutaata alung kha a lesa ta ama papung sue. Cakhutaata Israel ming bangkhuo ca iema'a na ama ing luo kha amaa ruo diy.

Absalom ta a hring ning khata Siepahruo Bawphie lie kha lungbang suokha zaa tue te, “I ming a thyi paripa a cuo riypata sacapaa hnyi va ang,” a ta; lungbang kha ama ming a sa. Ataning tepa ta capa ca Absalom Lungbang ta pata kupa a cuo.
Cakhutaata Zadok sacapaa Ahimaaz ta, “Vaa ruo ang sala, Abyipana na carie tie cahrana taata caa khuo tli,” ta pata siepahruo ca thuohlaa va pathyi ang se,” a ta.

Joab ta ama kyihuo khata, “Ataning hingta ca thuohlaa kha va pathyi'a vaciy; ning hrang thue va pathyi lavuo ciy, ataning hingta ca cahaacata va pathyi'a vaciy, tahematapakieca siepahruo sacapaa na a thiy,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Joab ta Kush ming pakha kyihuo khata, “Cakuo la na hmungpa hing siepahruo kha va chang tie,” a ta. Kush ming ca ta Joab kha pa-uvsathyina pi te, aa ruo.

Cakhutaata Zadok sacapaa Ahimaaz ta Joab kyihuo khata, “Tuokhaata a cuo zaw, Kush pa hnangluo hingta a ruo ra thluo se ang,” a ta. Cakhutaata Joab ta, “Khaapanakawma naa ruo aa, i sacapaa, capa thuohlaa na va pathyina kawlie ca ta khaapa lawmuo hmuo hmung'a vaciy,” a ta.
Ama ta, “Tuokhaata a cuo zaw, i ruo aa,” a ta. Caacuonakawta ama ta, “A ruo tie,” a ta. Cakhutaata Ahimaaz ca Ase luo luopuv ziy pata aa ruo ca Kush pa kha a law.
David ca thlake suohning alalalie kha aa tu. Rievetuv ta tlepie athaalie thlake cunglie ing cungluo kha kie te a suo ca cawsaa pakha ama selaw ta a vya ruolepa kha a hmung.
Rievetuv ca ta khi te siepahruo kha a chang. Siepahruo ta, “Ama pakha se ta a cuo kieca, thuohlaa a vya phya aa,” a ta. A vya ruole te a vya ngie viele.

Cakhutaata rievetuv ca ta a hrangpa pakha a vya ruolepa kha a hmung; cakhutaata rievetuv ca ta thlake a huopa kha ku te, “Mang tie, cawsaa hrangpa na ama seta a vya ruole,” a ta. Siepahruo ta, “Ama zaw thuohlaa na a vya phya ra aa,” a ta.
Rievetuv ta, “A pakhanapa paa aa vya ruozya ca Zadok sacapaa Ahimaaz a ruopa na a lu,” a ta. Siepahruo ta, “Ama ca cawsaa phapa tana a cuo, thuohlaa phapa na a vya phya aa,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Ahimaaz ta siepahruo kha u te, “Zezaw bangkhuo ta a pha,” a ta. Cakhutaata siepahruo hmiekunglie ca a luv kha alyi luo a bung te, “I byipaapa siepahruo a du riypata a thupa tie kuv taata caa khuotuv Abyipana Khazing ca thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue,” a ta.

Siepahruo ta, “Satliepa Absalom ca tluo ma?” a ta. Ahimaaz ta palie te, “Joab ta na changtaapa ina vya pathlie ning hing a kalaa caa ta aa kalaa ning cuo te, khaapama a cuo tapa kha pachang va ang,” a ta.
Siepahruo ta, “A maa la, hingpa lie hing a daa tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta a maa te aa daa.

Cakhutaata Kush pa ca a vya pha; Kush pa ca ta, “I byipaapa siepahruo cuota thuohlaa phapa tana a cuo! Tahematapakieca Abyipata nama kuo taata bie chi te, nama caa dupa bangkhuo tie kuv taa khata aca khuo,” a ta.

Siepahruo ta Kush pa kyihuo khata, “Satliepa Absalom ca tluo ma?” a ta. Kush pa khata palie te, “I byipaapa siepahruo carie tie hne nama kha ruvnaana pi riypata caa dupa bangkhuo ca, khapa satliepa haa khata cuo mang yi se,” a ta.

Siepahruo ca a palung pasa hringhruo te khy hukaa thlake cunglie a awpa a khuo luo kha kie te, “Vya i sacapaa Absalom, i sacapaa, i sacapaa Absalom! Kama hing ma nama cuopa ta a thiy hriy hrue va ang, Vya Absalom, i sacapaa, i sacapaa!” ta pata a caa.
Joab kha, “Siepahruo ca caa byalya tena Absalom muochie kha a sa,” ta pata ama chang.
Caacuonakawta capa ning lieta tena ca cawsaa bangkhuo cuota muochiesana ta aa li; tahematapakieca cawsaa ta, “Siepahruo ca a sacapaa khana a caa nguoluo thluo,” ta pata ama thyi.
Rietuvna taata a ruopa rieka tie ca ama nang zaa te khy chung luo kha a paruvta tah amaa ngiepa haata, capa ning lie ca cawsaazaapuv ca a paruvta tah khy chung luo kha amaa ngie.
Siepahruo ca a hmie kha pangluv a khuv te ueryi aa suosapa khata, “Vya i sacapaa Absalom, Vya Absalom, i sacapaa, i sacapaa! ta pata a caa.

Cakhutaata Joab ca ing chunglie siepahruo'a luo kha a ngie te, “Ataning hing nama ta, ataning nama na hringna hne na sacapaa zaw hne na sacanung zaw ama hringna hne na napuv zaw hne na nungthang zaw ama hringna a khuotuv yi na changtaapa bangkhuo hmie ca nangzaana ta na buvkhung tli;

tahematapakieca nama ta caa duepa kha hue cate caa huepa kha na due. Ataning hing na riebyi tie hne na changtaapa tie ca na cuota khaapatahmuo cuo va yi tapa na a siesa pata na paluo sa; tahematapakieca ataning hing Absalom kha hring sala kiema bangkhuo hing ma thiy diy kieca na palung a tluo thlu aa tapa tana ica hmung.

Caacuonakawta ata hingta thu la, na changtaapa tie'a lie kha bienepa kya ri tie, tahematapakieca Abyipaming ta chie a sa angte, na cakuo li kieca, ata zuo hing nama'a lie cawsaa pakha hmuo aw'a va yi; capa ca na satlie ning taata a pathu pata ataning te ta na cunglie a tlungpa rana laa khata a ruv vie aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata siepahruo ca thu te, hukaa lie kha aa tu. Cawsaa bangkhuo kha chang yi te, “Mang tie ung, siepahruo na hukaa lie a tu,” ta yi te cawsaa bangkhuo ca siepahruo hmiekung luo kha amaa vaw.

Israel ming phang cawsaa bangkhuo hrawlie kha bie a ina aw te, “Siepahruo ta ma carie tie kuv taa khata malie a za khuo, Filistin ming kuv taata malie a za khuo, cakhutaata ata hing Absalom kawlieta ruo chung taa khata aa ruo.
Cuorasala kiema cuota sathu maa pathuvpa Absalom ca a thiy tli. Caacuonakawta khaapanakawma siepahruo kaakhyi pakhaa riypa kaw hing a ri hehmuo nama ri va?” amaa ta.

Siepahruo ta tluobyi Zadok hne Abiathar kha hingpa bie hing taa yi te, “Judah uvthyi tie kha chang tie ung, ‘Khaapanakawma niema ca a ing luo siepahruo kaakhyina lie kha hnang nama chuo aa? Israel ming bangkhuo ama bie ca siepahruo'a luo a pha tli.
Niema ca i tieriy, i ruv hne i saa tana nama cuo; caacuonakawta khaapanakawma siepahruo kaakhyi pakhaana lie kha hnang nama chuo aa?’ ta tie ung.

Cakhutaata Amasa kha chang ung la, ‘Nama ca i ruv hne i saa cuo va ca ma? Nama ta Joab hmang lie kha ata taa hingta i riekabyi le cepa na hrie li kieca, Khazing ta capa haa cata hne capa laa cata a hluv vie ta i cunglie tlung mang sue,’ a ta, ta pata chang tie ung,” a ta.
Amasa ta Judah ming bangkhuo palung kha cawsaa pakha palung haata la diy te, iema ta siepahruo kha bie taa yi te, “Nama hne na changtaapa bangkhuo hne khata vya kaa diy tie ung,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta siepahruo ca Jordan luo kha vya kaa te, siepahruo ca daw riypata hne ama kha Jordan tekhyi riypata Judah ming ca Gilgal luo kha ama si.
Bahurim taata Benjamin phang Gera sacapaa Shimei kha Judah ming hne khata David a taw riypa khata a catlisa pata ama za sibung;

ama hne khata Benjamin ming thawkha ama aw. Saul ing lieta changtaapa Ziba ca a sacapaa pahraa hlyipangaa hne a changtaapa pakiy hne khata siepahruo hmiekung luo khata Jordan luo kha amaa zaa ruobung.
Tiyhaa te ningta siepahruo ingchungkhue kha tekhyi pata a palung patluo riypa khata a cuo.

siepahruo kyihuo khata, “I siepahruo ta duo na te thi khah, acuolikie i byipaapa siepahruo ta Jerusalem na pyase ningta na changtaapa ta na cunglie suena i tuepa kha naa thyipa thi khah, siepahruo ta na palung chunglie na paripa thi khah.

Tahematapakieca na changtaapa ta i suepa kha i pachang; caacuonakawta, mang tie, i byipaapa siepahruo kha daw riypata ataning hing Josef ingchungkhue bangkhuo zaw hraw taata a pakhana ta i vaw hing,” a ta.
Zeruiah sacapaa Abishai ta palie te, “Abyipasathu pathuvpa kha chie a sa nakawta, capa kawlie ca ta Shimei hing thie riypata cuo va ma?” a ta.

Cuorasala David ta, “Niema Zeruiah sacapaa zaw, niema hing tuokhaatama ica tue'a yi, ataning hing kama cuo tana carie haata nama ta'a de? Ataning hing Israel ming ahunghmuo thie riypata ama cuo'a ma? Tahematapakieca ataning hing Israel ming cunglieta siepahruo i cuopa kha pachang li pata ma i aw?” a ta.
Siepahruo ta Shimei kyihuo khata, “Thiy'a vaciy,” a ta. Cakhutaata siepahruo ta chie a sa pata bie aa kuo.

Saul samingta Mefibosheth ta siepahruo a taw riypata aa zuv; siepahruo a si ningpa baataata aa bangsa pata a vya kaana te ta, a phyi zaw kha ysy vyi, a hmyahming zaw kha a ngu vyi, a caw zaw kha pasuv vyi.
Siepahruo a taw riypata Jerusalem luo kha aa vaw tiyta, siepahruo ta ama kyihuo khata, “Mefibosheth, khaapanakawma kama'a lie na vya si ra va?” a ta.

Ama ta palie te, “I byipaapa, Vya siepahruo, i changtaapa na naa dung; tahematapakieca na changtaapa ta ama kha chang angte, ‘A khang'a angte siepahruo'a lie kha i si ra khu riypata, i cuota laa kha kedie padie tie,’ i ta. Tahematapakieca na changtaapa ca i cabie.
Cakhutaata na changtaapa ca siepahruo'a lie kha i thuo ina pachi tli. Cuorasala i byipaapa siepahruo ca Khazing avuoming haa tana na cuo; caacuonakawta nama ta a pha na tana haata tue tie.

Tahematapakieca i paa ingchungkhue bangkhuo ca i byipaapa siepahruo hmiekunglie thiy riypata bie chipa paciepa tana ma cuo; cuorasala na changtaapa ca na cabya lie sa a ningpa tie hrawlie kha ina chi ciy. Cakhutaata siepahruo kha paakie riypa khaapama i hnyi'a tli,” a ta.
Siepahruo ta ama kyihuo khata, “Na kawluo ca khaapanakawma na ri kalie? Bie i chi tli, Nama hne Ziba ta ruo kha namaa che aa,” a ta.
Mefibosheth ta siepahruo kyihuo khata, “I byipaapa siepahruo ing luo aa bangsa pata na vya pha tli thluo taa hingta ca, ama ta a la diy thluo se,” a ta.
Gilead ming Barzillai ca Rogelim taa khata a zuv te, Jordan cavaa huesuo te pathlie riypa khata siepahruo'a lie ca Jordan te kha a si.
Barzillai ca a macuosa tlipa cawsaa ta cuo te, kung sawcari a ta tli. Ama ca a hnyirungsapa ta cuo te, Siepahruo Mahanaim lie a aw ningta sa a ringpa ta a cuo.
Siepahruo ta Barzillai kyihuo khata, “Kama'a lie hing vya si ra la, Jerusalem lie kama athaalieta ica mangsang aa,” a ta.
Cuorasala Barzillai ta siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Siepahruo hne Jerusalem luo si pakhaw riypata kama hing kung khazaa ma i hring kalie aa?

Ataning hing kung sawcari ta tli angte khaapa hing a nuo te ma khaapa hing a nuo li pata a aw tapa hmuo thleduo khuna hnyi va tli ang. Na changtaapa hingta i ningpa cuose, i dangpa cuose a pahuona hmuo pachang khu va tli ang. Hlaa a sapa capaa tie hne canung tie ueryi kha hmuo naathlie khu va tli ang. Khaapanakawma na changtaapa hing i byipaapa siepahruo cuota chachiypa hmangriy ta i cuo aa?
Na changtaapa hingta siepahruo ca Jordan huesuo te hue a cawta i sikhyi kalie aa. Khaapanakawma siepahruo ta cahaapa lawmuo ca ina pi aa?

Na changtaapa hing na pakaa sa thi la, i khy lie, i paa hne i nung thluo a thaatalie hing thiy naase ang. Cuorasala hingpa lie hing na changtaapa Chimham a aw hing, ama hing i byipaapa siepahruo hne hingta pasi sa ra thi la; ama cuo hingta nama ta a pha aa na tapa kha tuepa thi tie,” a ta.
Siepahruo ta palie te, “Chimham ca kama'a lie hing si ra sala nama ta a pha na tapa kha i tuepa aa; cakhutaata kama'a taata na khingpa bangkhuo kha ica tuepa aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata cawsaa bangkhuo ta Jordan kha va te yi te, siepahruo khata ava te. Siepahruo ta Barzillai kha pahnuo te thluechiy a pi, cakhutaa cata a ing luo kha a kaa.
Siepahruo ca Gilgal luo kha si te, Chimham kha ama'a lie ca a si ra; Judah ming bangkhuo hne Israel ming khingkhuo zaw khata siepahruo ca ama sikhyi.

Cakhutaata Israel ming bangkhuo khata siepahruo'a luo kha a vaw yi te, ama kyihuo khata, “Khaapanakawma ma uvnu Judah ming ta a paruv ta ca paruv yi te, siepahruo hne a ingchungkhue hne David cawsaa zaw bangkhuo kha Jordan huesuo luo aca sikhyi yi?” ama ta.

Judah cawsaa zaw bangkhuo khata Israel ming kyihuo cata, “Tahematapakieca siepahruo ca maa ngiepa ma tieriy a cuo nakaw tana a cuo. Khaapanakawma niema ca hingpa kawlie hing nama hi a haa? Siepahruo sa kha ning kanaa puv? Acuolikie lasaw suokhakha malie pi kanaa?” ama ta.

Cuorasala Israel cawsaa zaw ca ta Judah cawsaa tie kyihuo khata, “Siepahruo chunglie hing vu hraa muo ma hnyi ta, David chunglie zaw hing niema laata a hluv vie ma hnyi. Khaapanakawma malie nama ese? Ma siepahruo vya kaakhyi riypa hing kiema na a ri taa puv cuo va ma?” ama ta. Cuorasala Judah cawsaa tie bie ca Israel cawsaa zaw bie laata aa hruo vie.

Benjamin phang Bikhri sacapaa Sheba ama tapa a zyatepa cawsaa pakha a za aw. Ama ta hmyakaa kha tung te, “David chunglie cuvu khaapahmuo hnyi vapuv, Jesse sacapaa chunglie ru khaapahmuo hnyi vapuv, Vya Israel, nama thluodaa cyicuo luo kha kaa diy ung!” ta pata a khi.
Caacuonakawta Israel ming bangkhuo ca David kha thuse yi te Bikhri sacapaa Sheba kha ama ziy; cuorasala Judah ming khata ama siepahruo kha Jordan taata Jerusalem te ta pathlie li pata ama ziy.

David ca Jerusalem lie a ing luo kha a pha; ing huo riypata a chi siypa a nungthang pahraa tie kha la yi te, ing kha lie chi yi te rievetuv a pahuo sa yi. Iema kha a phasa pata a ring yi, cuorasala a ziehne va yi. Caacuonakawta iema ca khaakhung yi te ama thiyna te nunghlyi haata ama aw.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ta Amasa kyihuo khata, “Ning thung chunglieta Judah ming kha kama'a luo ku yi la, nama zaw aw ra tie,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Amasa ca Judah ming kha ku riypata a si; cuorasala a cuo thlipapa laa khata a vya ru vie.

David ta Abishai kyihuo khata, “Bikhri sacapaa Sheba hing ta Absalom laata ruvna a hluv vie malie a pi aa; na byipaapa changtaapa tie hing a la lah vaa cade tie, caacuolikieca dungkhuopa khy kha ama huota a hmung'a tena kiema'a taa hingta aa ruo aa,” a ta.
Joab cawsaa zaw khata, Cheret ming, Pelet ming, hne a thaaruvpa zaw hne khata Jerusalem taa khata pya yi te Bikhri sacapaa Sheba kha amaa cade.

Gibeon lie a awpa alung lesapa lie ama aw ning Amasa ta iema kha a vya daw yi. Joab ca rieka caw kha a tue, a se lie kha tesaw a saw te, a tesaw lieta a baw hneta aa pathliepa zueziy ca hmieluo a cakuopuole pata a tla.
Joab ta Amasa kyihuo khata, “Na tluo ma, i uvnupa,” a ta. Cakhutaata Joab ta Amasa kha pahnuo riypata a cacuoluo kuv ta a hmyahming kha a patuv.

Cuorasala Amasa ta Joab kuv lie zueziy kha hmung vyi; Joab ta a pawpya lie kha daw te a chungriy kha alyi luo tla te a thiy. Yi hning daw va tli. Cakhutaata Joab hne a nuta Abishai ca Bikhri sacapaa Sheba kha amaa cade.
Cakhutaata Joab cawsaa pakha ta Amasa athaalie kha a daa te, “Joab a khingpa hne David huota a cuopa mekaa ta Joab kha ziy tie ung,” a ta.

Amasa ca luopuv lepa chunglie kha a thiy lie ca laa thluo te, a hmungpa bangkhuo ca amaa daa diy. Aa thaa luo a vya chiypa mekaa ta amaa daa diypa kha cawsaapa ta a hmung tiyta, Amasa ca luopuv lepa kie luo kha palaw te pang a buvkhung.
Ama kha luopuv lepa taata ama palaw khutaata, Bikhri sacapaa Sheba a cade riypata Joab ca cawsaa bangkhuo ta ama ziy.
Sheba ca Israel phang awna bangkhuo, Beth-maakah lie Abel te khata aa khie. Bikhri ming bangkhuo ca a hmya yi te ama kha ama ziy.

Joab rieka tie khata Beth-maakah lie a awpa Abel lie kha ama ca ama cadung; khy dungkhuo kha aleluo taa khata riekhuocaaca kha ama sasue. Joab rieka tie ca ta lungruetlepie ca pacing riypata ama phawpuo.
Cakhutaata a singpa canung pakha ta khypuv chung taa cata, “Naathlie ung! naathlie ung! Joab kha, ‘A vaw la, biena ica chang khing, a ta,’ ta pata chang tie ung,” a ta.

Ama ta cawsaanung athaa luo ca a vaa. Cawsaanung ca ta, “Joab ta na cuo ma?” a ta. Ama ta palie te, “I cuo,” a ta. Cakhutaata ama ta, “Na changtaanung bie hing na naathlie tie,” a ta. Ama ta, “Ica naathlie,” a ta.
Cakhutaata ama ta, “Hluo ningta ca, ‘Abel luo kha va rihne ung la bie a ci aa,’ ama tapa haata bie a ci taw.

Kama hing Israel ming chunglieta diena a khingpa hne zang tluo aa tlapa pakha tana i cuo ra; Israel ruo chunglie nung cuota a cuopa khypuv suokha na na para khing; khaapanakawma Abyiparu ta a cuopa kha na paluo aa?” a ta.
Joab ta palie te, “Capa ca kama hneta a hla se, a hla se, paluo'a va ang, a para zaw para'a va ang!

Cahaacata cuo vyi! Efraim tluocung ruo taata cawsaa pakha, Bikhri sacapaa Sheba ama tapa khata David a du riypata a kuv a calang; ama pakha dyi kha na pi tie, khypuv hing i kaase aa,” a ta. Cawsaanung ta Joab kyihuo khata, “A luv kha lungruetlepie taa hingta ica za thaw aa,” a ta.

Cakhutaata cawsaanung ca singvaasa pata aa tingna hne khata cawsaa zaw'a luo kha a vaa. Cakhutaata Bikhri sacapaa Sheba luv kha te yi te Joab kha ama thaw. Caacuonakawta ama ta hmyakaa kha tung te, khypuv kha thuse yi te ama ing luo kha ama si. Joab ca Jerusalem lie siepahruo'a luo kha a kaa.
Joab ca Israel rieka bangkhuo uvtuv riekabyi le cepa ta a cuo; Jehoiada sacapaa Benaiah kha Cheret ming hne Pelet ming uvtuv byi ta a cuo;
Adoram ca re pahrie sapa tie uvtuv ta a cuo; Ahilud sacapaa Jehoshafat ca cazingkhungtuv ta a cuo;
Sheva ca caacapetuv ta a cuo; Zadok hne Abiathar ca tluobyi ta cuo yi te,
Jairi ming Ira zaw David tluobyi ta a cuo ra.

David chuo ning kha kung kha hnang kung kha ta kung thung chung cakuo a tlung. Caacuonakawta David ta Abyipakha a hiehriy. Abyipata, “Saul hne a ingchungkhue cungliena thiyse palang suena a aw, tahematapakieca Gibeon ming khana a thie yi,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta siepahruo ta Gibeon ming kha ku yi te bie a chang yi. (Gibeon ming ca Israel cawsaa ta cuo va yi, Amor ming aa ngaapa tie kha tana ama cuo; Israel ming ta iema kha pangaa riypata chie amaa sa raalaa pata, Israel ming hne Judah ming kaw a pacuotuvna lieta iema kha ama ciy paming aa tingpa a cuo).
David ta Gibeon ming kyihuo khata, “Khaapama ica tuepa'a yi? Abyiparu kha thluechiy nama pi khu riypata kama ta tuokhaatama arena ica tue'a yi,” a ta.

Gibeon ming ta ama kyihuo khata, “Saul hne a ingchungkhue hne kiema alalalieta hmang a awpa hing siy hne ngu kaw ta cuo vyi; Israel ming ahung hing hmuo ma thie riypa yi ta cuo ra vyi,” ama ta. Ama ta, “Khaapa malie tuepa se tapa ma nama khing?,” a ta yi.
Iema ta siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Kiema ta Israel ruo chung bangkhuo lie hing hmang ma hnyi li riypata malie pahli te para riypata khue a khuotuvpa
a sacapaa pasariy tie kha Abyipatluo cung, Gibeon lieta Abyipahmiekunglie kha ma thie thena riypa yi ta kiema kha malie pi tie,” ama ta. Siepahruo ta, “Ica pi'a yi,” a ta.
Cuorasala siepahruo ta Saul sacapaa Jonathan a sacapaa Mefibosheth kha a pahring, tahematapakieca David hne Saul sacapaa Jonathan alalalieta, Abyipahmiekunglie biekuona ama za hnyi nakawta a cuo.

Siepahruo ta Aiah sacanung Rizpah ta Saul hne ama sapa sacapaa pahning Armoni hne Mefibosheth; hne Saul sacanung Merab ta Meholah ming Barzillai sacapaa Adriel hne ama sapa sacapaa papangaa kha la yi te

Gibeon ming kuv luo kha a pi yi. Cakhutaata iema ta capa tie ca Abyipahmiekunglie tluocung lie kha thie yi te, ama pasariy cata ama thiy pakhaw. Iema ca jungsacuo hrie ama pathu a ning khanapa lie khata ama thie.

Cakhutaata Aiah sacanung Rizpah ta buri pang kha a la te, sahrie ama pathu taata avuo khytiy ta iema cunglie a za saana te khata, alung cunglie kha phaa te ama cunglie ca ningchung ta avuo lie a zupa pavaa kha cuose, zuo ta ruosaa kha cuose iema riyy cung luo kha pa hi sa va yi.
Aiah sacanung Rizpah, Saul nungthangnung ta a tuepa kha David ca ama chang tiyta,

David ca si te, Filistin ming ta Saul kha Gilboa tluo lie ama thie ningta, Filistin ming ta ama pathlienapa hmang, Beth-shan khy lie zaapuv a hmyanapa hmang taata iema a paruvpa yi Jebesh-gilead cawsaa tie'a taa khata Saul ruv hne a sacapaa Jonathan ruv kha a la.
Capa taa cata Saul ruv hne a sacapaa Jonathan ruv ca kya phyathaw te, pathlie yi te ama thiepa tie ruv zaw kha ama pahmya.

Iema ta Saul ruv hne a sacapaa Jonathan ruv kha Benjamin ruo Zela lie a awpa a paa Kish thluo lie kha ama paby; cakhutaata siepahruo ta bie a pipa yi bangkhuo haa khata ama tue. Cakhutaa cata, ruo cuota ama hiepa kha Khazing ta a thyipa yi.
Filistin ming ta Israel ming kha rie a du yi te, David ca a changtaapa tie hne khata ama sibung. Iema ta Filistin ming kha tuv yi te, David ca a thaa a buo hringhruo.
Cawsaalepa tie samingsahlaa pakha ta a cuopa Ishbi-benob, aa syi shekel zathung a riypa, rieka cehre thaapa a tuepa paa khata David ca i thie aa, a ta.

Cuorasala Zeruiah sacapaa Abishai ta a vya bya te, Filistin cawsaapa ca tuv te a thie. Cakhutaata David cawsaa tie khata chie a sa pata, “Israel myi-ing kha na pache li riypata, kiema hneta rietuvna luo kha si ra'a va tli ciy,” ama ta.
Capa khutaa cata Gob lie kha Filistin ming hneta rie atuvna aw te, Hushath ming Sibbekai ta cawsaalepa tie ciypathla pakha ta a cuopa Saf kha a thie.
Cakhutaata Gob lie ca Filistin ming hne a hrangpa rie atuvna aw pakhaa te, Bethlehem khy ming Jaare-oregim sacapaa Elhanan ta Git ming Goliath, aa syi sung thetluo tie a tapa kha a thie.

Gath lieta rieduna a aw pakhaa, capa lie ca a kuvdaw suocaruv kaluo hne a phyidaw suocaruv kaluo ta te, pahlaw pata suokiy suopaliy a hnyipa cawsaa lesapa pakha a aw, ama zaw hing cawsaalepa tie ciypathla tana a cuo.
Ama ta Israel ming kha thluhuv a sasue tiy yi ta, David uvta Shimei sacapaa Jonathan ta a thie.
Hingpa papaliy tie hing Gath lieta cawsaa lesapa tie ciypathla ta ama cuo; iema ca David hne a changtaapa tie kuv ta ama thiy.
Abyipata a carie bangkhuo tie kuv taata hne Saul kuv taata a palaw sa tiyta, capa ning lie ca David ta Abyipakha hingpa hlaa hingta a pathuosa.
Abyipaca i lungpuv, i riekhuopiehu hne naa thlatuv tana a cuo,
i Khazing, i lungpuv, i canawna tana a cuo, i phya hne kama khuona kiy, i cariekyikuo hne i canawnapa, naa khuotuv tana a cuo; nama ta tuechiena taata ina khuo ciy.
Kama ta Abyipakha i u, ama ca pathuosa tluo aa tlapa tana a cuo, i carie tie'a taa khata ina khuo.
Tahematapakieca thiyna tiylaw ta na cadung te, ranapa tiyse ta ina tlungsue;
Athiykhy khuhriycamaa ta na kalaa te, thiyna cyihyi ta ina pa-uo.
I palungriethyina chungtaata Abyipakha i u; i Khazing kha i u. A biena-ing chung taa khata i ueryi kha na thyi te, i khina ueryi ca a naa luo a pha.
Cakhutaata alyi kha a pahie te aa cahang; ama kha a hi a haa nakawta, avuo hruobangna tie kha a cahang te aling haata aa siy.
A hnaakhue taata myikhuv pya te, a pakaa taata myihlaa a pya; ama'a taata myihyi sekhalapa a pya.
Avuo kha a kyi te a za cung; a chaapa zingna ca a phyi rawlie a aw.
Cherub kha a khang te aa zu; thliy mathlaa cunglie kha ama ca ama hmung.
Zingna chaapa amyi hne aa pahmyapa tiy kha, a cahriylie aa cadung sa.
A hmiekunglie khena chung taa khata, myihyi kha aa kya hlaa khala.
Abyipata avuo taata khalung pathy sa te, Cungnungce ta a ueryi kha a pathlie.
A cuoti kha ka te, iema kha a chepatlaa diy yi, thinghlaa kha pathlie te aa cade diy yi.
Abyipata chuo yi te, a hnaakhue taata a huv ta a hmung nakaw yi ta, riyliy raw alyi hne alyi hruobangna zaw amaa luo.
Aa suona taata na za paza te ina la, aa thuvsapa tiy chungtaata ina thue.
A cahrapa i carie tie'a taata hne naa huepa tie'a taa khata ina khuo; tahematapakieca iema ca kama cuota ama cahra tuv.
Ruvnaana i taw ningta na vya pyahnue yi te, cuorasala Abyipaca i daana ta a cuo.
Ruo kupuv luo kha naa chiy te, kama kha ina tlechuo nakawta ina khuo.
Abyipata i dangna haa khata lawmuo ina pi; i kuv a pathena haa khata ina thung hriy.
Tahematapakieca Abyipaluopuv kha a patuv angte, i Khazing'a taa khata suena luopuv ziy pata a che va ang.
Tahematapakieca a ziyphung bangkhuo ca i hmiekunglie aw te, a phungluo taa khata a che va ang.
A hmiekunglie syisaa riy aw lipa angta, kama hne kama kha suena taata i ve.
Caacuonakawta Abyipata i dangna haa khata hne, a hmungna lie i pathena haa khata ina thung hriy.
Zang tluo aa tlapa tie'a lie kha zang tluo naa tlana paluo sa cate, risie riy a aw lipa tie'a lie kha risie riy na aw linazya na paluo sa.
A pathepa tie kha a pathepa ta a pahmung sa yi cate, a zyatepa tie kha a zyatepa ta naa pahmung sa yi.
Raw a canawpa tie kha khuo yi cate, cuorasala a hruotlepa tie pachung riypata ama cunglie na ming na khang.
A cuo, Vya Abyipa, nama ca i myi-ing tana na cuo, Abyipana i zingna kha a pakhe sa.
Nama thueta riekaphuv suokha kha para khu angte, i Khazing thueta lungruetlepie kha i zupakhung khu.
Hingpa Khazing, a luopuv ca tling te, Abyipabiekuona ta biehmisipa kha a pacu sa; ama chunglie a canawpa bangkhuo cuota phya tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca Abyipata li pata ahungma Khazing ta a cuo? Ima Khazing ta li pata ahungma alungpuvnung ta a cuo?
A cahrana ta naa cadungpa Abyipata, i luopuv kha a kusa pata ina pahawpa.
Ama ta i phyi kha sasuv phyi haata tue te, aa suona hmang lie kha aa bang pata ina chi.
I kuv kha rie a duna riypata pacuv te, caacuonakawta daa liy kha i kuv ta aa kyi khu.
Nama ta na khuona phya kha na pi cate, nama byana ta ina palesyi sa.
I kyi kha a kusa ta na pahliy sa hyalya cate, lang va ang.
I carie tie kha a cade yi angte i para yi, ama chuo hluo li kaase va yi ang.
I thie diy yi, i sa patyi diy yi, caacuonakawta kya thu va tli yi; i phyi thabaw lie khana amaa lie.
Tahematapakieca rietuvna cuo khata thaa na patlung cate, khuosa ta naa dupa tie kha i raw luo na patla sa yi.
Nama ta i carie tie kha paruo sa yi cate, naa huepa tie kha i para yi.
