Hmiehmie ama pase, cuorasala iema a khuo riypa pakha hmuo aw va yi; Abyipa'a luo kha ama khi, cuorasala ama ta palie va yi.
Alyi diypa haa khata carie yi angte, de yi angte luopuv lie caakaw haa khata i tlaw yi.
Nama ta cawsaa zaw hne ahruna taa khata na khuo cate, mingphang zaw luv ta ina chi ciy; i pachang lipa tie khata i re ama hrie,
Ruohrang ming ta i thaa luo a vaw yi te amaa bu; i bie ama thyi pahne ta i ri amaa ngie.
Ruohrang ming ca ama palung chuo te, ama cariekyikuo chung taa khata a cathangpuo pata ama kya pya.
Abyipaca a hring! I lungpuvnung ca thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue. I Khazing, i khuona alungpuvnung ca cyicalang pata cuo mang sue.
Phuv la khuna naa pituv Khazing, i rawlie cawsaa a chituv,
i carie tie chungtaata naa thuetuv; i carie tie cung luo ta naa cyicalangpa ca nama tana na cuo; esetuechiena taata ina khuo ciy.
Hingpa kawlie hingta mingphang zaw hrawlie kha ica cyicalang aa Vya Abyipa, hlaa ta na ming ica pathuosa aa.
Ama ca siepahruo cuota khuona ingsuo tana a cuo, sathu a pathuvpa David hne a ciypathla tie kha aa hmangpa duena ca chuozaa ta a pahmung sa yi.
Hingpa tie hing David bie a hnangcaw cepa tie ta ama cuo: Jesse sacapaa David bie, Khazing ta a cyicalangpa bie, Jacob Khazing ta sathu a pathuvpa, Israel ming Cahrapa Paa ta hmiephaa a pipa ca:
Abyipathlaapa ta kama'a taata bie a ri, a bie ca i palyi cunglie a aw.
Israel Khazing ta a ri tli, Israel alungpuvnung ta ina chang tli: Cawsaa zaw kha aa dangsa pata a uvpa, Khazing ciyzaana cangta a uvpa ca,
Mawdiy amyi aa pe ningta a kya chiypa ning haata hne, aphuv panuta cunglie a tlapa a kiriyliypa khydiy haa tana a cuo.

Khazing awkhyipa i ingchungkhue ca cahaaca tana a cuo cuo va ma? Tahematapakieca chuozaa ta aa hmangpa biekuona na kama hneta a tue, zezaw bangkhuo kha aa bangsa pata a tue. Kama byana hne i khingna ca tluo patling li pata a aw'a ma?
Cuorasala Khazing a pachang lipa bangkhuo ca thawpa ahling haa tana ama cuo aa; tahematapakieca iema ca kuv ta a haa khupa cuo'a va yi.
Iema kha taw riypata ca thaasung kha hmuo pata cuo te, acuolikie asyi sung kha hmuo pata a cuo. Iema ca myi ta rue diy paluo riypata ama cuo.

Hingpa tie hing David ta a hnyipa a thaaruvpa tie ming ta a cuo: Takhemon ming Josheb-basshebeth; ama ca pathung tie hrawlieta luv ce ta a cuo. Aa syi kha patuv te cawsaa zacari tie kha yi kha ta a du yi te a thiepa ta a cuo.

Capa a thaaruvpa pathung chunglieta ama a paziypa ca Ahohi sacapaa Dodo sacapaa Eleazar ta a cuo. Rietuv riypata aa hmyapa Filistin ming aa daacie ning yi ta David hneta a awpa paa khata a cuo. Israel ming ca hnangluo kha amaa saw,

cuorasala ama ca a daapahrang te a kuv thaa a buona te khata Filistin ming kha a thie yi, a kuv ta zueziy kha a cusa pata a patuv. Capa ning lie ca Abyipata tena lepuv kha a tue. Cakhutaata cawsaa ca ama'a luo kha ama vya kaa, cuorasala a thiypa tie cawsie thlie riypa dyi kha tana a cuo.
A paziypa ca Harar ming, Agi sacapaa Shammah ta a cuo. Filistin ming kha abie lyi a awnapa Lehi lie kha a hmya yi te, rieka tie ca iema'a taa khata amaa ruo.
Cuorasala capa hmang a lie khingkhuo lie kha a daapahrang te, a du yi te Filistin tie kha a thie yi; cakhutaata Abyipata tena lepuv kha a tue.
Sa hrie cuo a pha'a nang pata byi sawthung chung taapa pathung kha sibung yi te David kha Adullam lungkhue lieta amaa zaa hlaw, capa ning ca Filistin ming ca Refaim bawphie lie kha amaa hmya.
Capa ning ca David ca cariekyikuo chunglie kha aw te, khy a huopa Filistin rieka tie ca Bethlehem lieta ama aw.
David ta, “Bethlehem khy thlake athaalie a awpa takhue tiy kha dang riypata naa pi khupa aw yi sala ca!” ta te aa ngiy.

Cakhutaata a thaaruvpa pathung tie ca ta Filistin ming arina hmang lie kha va caluo yi te, thlake athaalie a awpa Bethlahem takhue tiy ca the yi te David'a luo kha ama vya cyi. Cuorasala David ta dang vyi; Abyipahmiekunglie kha lyi te,

“Hingpa hing i tue li riypata Abyipata ina thlu. Ama hringna a pi yi te a vaapa tie thiy tana a cuo cuo va ma? Caacuonakawta ama ta dang khing vyi. Hingpa hmang tie hing cawsaa thaaruvpa pathung tie ta ama tue pata a cuo.
Zeruiah sacapaa, Joab nuta Abishai ca sawthung tie hrawlie uvtuv cepa ta a cuo. Aa syi ta cawsaa zathung kha a du yi te a thie yi, cakhutaa cata pathung tie hrawlie kha ming a hnyi ra.
Ama ca sawthung tie hrawlie kha ming pathuo cepa ta cuo te iema uvtuv ta a cuo; cuorasala pathung tie kha ca pha khu va yi.

Jehoiada sacapaa Benaiah ca Kabzeel khy ming a riephapa rieka ta cuo te, hmang lepa a tuepa ta a cuo; ama ta Moab ming Ariel sacapaa pahning kha a thie yi. Cahue a tla ningta a khue chunglie a awpa chingde kha zuvchiy te a thie.

Cakhutaata a puvthesapa Izipt ming pakha kha a thie. Izipt cawsaapa ca asyi suokha kha a kuv lie aa cyi; cuorasala Benaiah ta khuecahryi suokha ta a du riypata a vaachiy, Izipt cawsaapa kuv taa khata aa syi kha chuv te aa syi mamaapa cata a thie.
Jehoiada sacapaa Benaiah ta a tuepa ca cahaapa zaw cata a cuo, cakhutaa cata a thaaruvpa pathung tie hrawlie kha ming a hnyi ra.
Ama ca Sawthung tie hrawlie kha a ming a pathuo ra, cuorasala Pathung tie kha ca pha khu va yi. Cakhutaata David ta ama pangpa rievetuv rieka tie byi cepa ta a chi.
Joab nuta Asahel kha Sawthung tie hrawlie pakha ta a cuo ra; Bethlehem khy pa Dodo sacapaa Elhanan;
Harod khy ming Shammah; Harod khy ming Elika;
Palti ming Helez; Tekoa khy ming Ikkesh sacapaa Ira;
Anathoth ming Abiezer; Hushath ming Mebunnai;
Ahohi ming Zalmon; Netofah ming Maharai;
Netofah ming Baanah sacapaa Heleb; Benjamin ming khy Gibeah taata Ribai sacapaa Ittai;
Pirathon ming Benaiah; Gaash cavaata zaw ruo ming Hiddai;
Arbath ming Abi-albon; Bahurim ming Azmaveth,
Shaalbon ming Eliahba; Jashen sacapaa zaw: Jonathan
Hara ming Sharar sacapaa Ahiam;
Maakah ming Ahasbai sacapaa Elifelet; Gilon ming Ahithophel sacapaa Eliam;
Karmel ming Hezro; Arbi ming Paarai;
Zobah ming Nathan sacapaa Igal; Gad ming Bani;
Ammon ming Zalek; Beeroth ming Naharai; Zeruiah sacapaa Joab cehre a cyituvpa;
Ithra ming Ira; Ithra ming Gareb;
Hit ming Uriah: ta pata ama bangkhuo ta sawthung pathung ama cuo.
Israel ming cunglie Abyipahihaana ca ie pakhaa te, David kha iema a du riypata tue te, “Vaa la Israel hne Judah kha mingluv ri tie yi,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta siepahruo ta Joab hne ama'a lie a awpa riekabyi tie kha ku yi te, “Israel ming mingphang bangkhuo zaw'a luo kha si ung la, Dan taata Beer-sheba te khata mingluv ri tie ung, khazaa ma a ta yi tapa kha i pachang riypata,” a ta yi.

Cuorasala Joab ta siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Na ming ta na hmung khu kalie ning hingta, AbyipaKhazing ta ata laa hingta le zakha ta cawsaa kha papungzaa sa yi se! Cuorasala khaapanakawma i byipaapa siepahruo ta hingpa hing na tue khing?” a ta.
Cuorasala siepahruo bie ta Joab hne riekabyi tie bie ca a te. Caacuonakawta Joab hne riekabyi tie ca Israel ming mingluv ri riypa khata siepahruo hmiekung taa cata ama pya.
Iema ta Jordan kha va te yi te, Aroer hne bawphie liekhingkhuo lieta a awpa khypuv taa khata patha yi te, Gad hne Jazer luo khata ama pazuele.
Cakhutaata Gilead hne Hit ming ruo lie a awpa Kadesh ama pha; cakhutaata Dan luo kha pha yi te, Dan taa khata Sidon cahriy kha ama pha.
Cakhutaata Tair riekhuopiehu hne Hiv ming hne Kanaan ming khypuv tie kha ama pha; cakhutaata Judah ruo Negeb lieta Beer-sheba te khata ama si.
Caacuonakawta ruo ting khata si yi te, Jerusalem luo kha thla caky hne ning kiy khutaata ama vya kaa.
Joab ta cazing a khungpa mingluv zaa kha siepahruo ca a pi: Israel ming chunglieta zueziy a cyi khu riypa rieka thaw zacari, hne Judah ming chungtaata thaw zapangaa ama ta.

Cuorasala capa khutaa cata, mingluv a ri nakawta David ca a palung a ra. David ta Abyipakyihuo khata, “I hriepa kawlieta khuosa ta i sue. Cuorasala, Vya Abyipa, ata hing nama'a luo kha thlaa i chuo, na changtaapa i suena hing na lapa thi tie, tahematapakieca ngaana lepuv hne tana i tue tli,” a ta.
David kha maw ta a kya thu tiyta, David profet ta a cuopa Gad'a luo kha Abyipabie ca a zuv te,
“Cakuo la David kha va chang tie: Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Hmang suothung ca pi angte capa chung taa cata suokha a tlaw tie, capa ca na cunglie i tue aa, a ta, va ta tie,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Gad ca David'a luo kha vaa te ava chang; Ama ta hiehriy te, “Cakuo ma kung thung chung na ruo chunglie a tlung aa? Acuolikie na carie tie hmiekunglie ma thla thung chung naa ruo aa? Acuolikie na ruo chunglie ning thung chung puv tlungpa ma? Ata hingta rue la, tuokhaapa biepaliena ma naa pathlietuv'a luo i chiykhyi aa,” a ta.

Cakhutaata David ta Gad kyihuo khata, “I palung rie na a thyi hringhruo; Abyipakuv chung luo kha tla thluo lavuo puv, tahematapakieca a nangduena ca a le hringhruo; cuorasala cawsaa kuv chung luo ca tla thi khah ang se,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Abyipata capa maw taa cata cuo thli ciepa te puvtlungna kha Israel ming cunglie patlung sa te, Dan taata Beer-sheba te khata cawsaa thaw sawsariy ama thiy.

Cuorasala avuoming ta para riypata Jerusalem luo kha a buo a vya pazuo tiyta, Abyipaca pha lina kawlie khata a ngiepachiy te, “A de se, na kuv kha pathla tie,” a ta. Abyipaavuoming ca Jebus ming Araunah suo-aciyna athaalie khana a aw.

David ta cawsaa zaw a paralepa avuoming kha a hmung tiyta, Abyipakyihuo khata, “Kama dyina a sue ang, kama dyina a pha lipa a tue ang; cuorasala hingpa tuv zaw hingta khaapama ama tue? Paa na ica kie, na kuv ca kama hne i paa ingchungkhue cunglie kha tlung thluo se,” a ta.
Capa ning lie ca ta Gad kha David'a luo a vaw te, ama kyihuo khata, “Khaw la Jebus ming Araunah suo-aciyna lie kha Abyipa'a luo bienathluodaa kya sa tie,” a ta.
Gad ta bie a pipa kha ziy te, Abyipabiepina haa khata David ca a sithaw.
Araunah ta ruo a suo ca, siepahruo hne a changtaapa tie ama'a luo amaa vawlepa kha a hmung; Araunah ca pya te, alyi luo kha a bung te siepahruo ca pa-uvsathyina a pi.

Araunah ta, “Khaapanakawma i byipaapa siepahruo ca kama'a luo naa vaw?” a ta. David ta, “Abyipa'a luo bienatluophie sana riypata na suo-aciyna hmang hing calyi riypa tana i vaw, tahematapakieca puvtlungna hing cawsaa zaw'a taata a pena riypa tana a cuo,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Araunah ta David kyihuo khata, “I byipaapa siepahruo ta a pha a tapa mekaa a la sala pihluo se, hingpa lie hing myirue panaana riypata cuetungpa a aw, thing riypata sa a hluonapa thing hne cuetungpa ruekhang zaw a aw.
Vya siepahruo, hingpa zaw bangkhuo hing Araunah na siepahruo a pi, Abyipana Khazing ta ca cuhluo thi mang sue,” a ta.

Cuorasala siepahruo ta Araunah kyihuo khata, “Cuo vyi, a muo tana ica calyi aa; Abyipai Khazing kha a muo khaapahmuo i pi lipa myirue panaana kha pihluo khing va ang,” a ta. Caacuonakawta David ta suo-aciyna hne cuetungpa kha ngu shekel sawngaa ta a calyi.

David ta capa lie ca Abyipacuota bienatluophie suokha sa te, myirue panaana hne aviesaa panaana kha a pihluo. Caacuonakawta ruo cuota paa a kiepa kha Abyipata cuhluo te, puvtlungna ca Israel ming'a taata aa pe.
Siepahruo David ca vya macuo te a kung a uvthyi tli; pang ama pabuv zawta lung khu the va tli.

Caacuonakawta a changtaapa tie ta ama kyihuo khata, “I byipaapa siepahruo na cuo hingta lesaa pakha ca huvpa se pala, siepahruo hing ca ysy ca mangsang sala; i byipaapa siepahruo hing aca lung riypata na cacunghnaa lie a zie sala,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Israel ruo chung bangkhuo lie kha lesaa puvthepa pakha ama huv. Shunam zaanung Abishag kha hmung yi te siepahruo'a luo ama vya chiykhyi.
Lesaanung ca a puvthe hringhruo. Ama ca siepahruo kha ysy te a mangsang, cuorasala siepahruo ta ama kha canungcapaa thiysaa anuona ta pachang vyi.

Haggith sacapaa Adonijah ta ama hne ama kha a cyicalang te, “Siepahruo tana i cuo aa,” ta te, ama huo khata aruole tie hne aruo rieka tie hne a hmiekunglie a ruo riypata cawsaa sawngaa kha a ting pacie.
A paa ta, “Khaapanakawma hing haa hingta na tue?” ta pata a palung pasana te ta hiehriy buo vyi. Ama ca a puvthe hringhruopa capaa pakha ta cuo ra te, Absalom a paziy pata a puvpa ta a cuo.
Zeruiah sacapaa Joab hne tluobyi Abiathar hne khata ri pakhaw yi te, iema ta Adonijah kha amaa bya.
Cuorasala tluobyi Zadok, hne Jehoiada sacapaa Benaiah, hne profet Nathan, hne Shimei, hne Rei, hne David pangpa rieka tie khata ca Adonijah kha a daakhyi va yi.

Adonijah ta En-rogel athaalie a awpa Zoheleth alung lie kha, tuv, cuetungpa, hne pathupa cuetaata tie khata hriykhungrina tue te, a uvnu bangkhuo, siepahruo sacapaa tie, hne Judah ming siepahruo abyi tie bangkhuo kha a ku yi.
Cuorasala profet Nathan, Benaiah, rieka tie, hne a uvnupa Solomon kha ku va yi.
Cakhutaata Nathan ta Solomon nung Bathsheba kyihuo khata, “Haggith sacapaa Adonijah kha siepahruo cuo te, ma byipaapa David ta a pachang lipa kaw hing thyi va ca ma?
Caacuonakawta ata hingta a vaw la nama hringna naa khuo khu riypa hne na sacapaa Solomon hringna na khuo khu riypata ruena ca pi'a ang.

Atabala hingta Siepahruo David'a luo kha a ngie la ama kyihuo khata, ‘Nama ca i byipaapa siepahruo cuo va ca ma, na changtaanung cunglie hing: Na sacapaa Solomon hingna siepahruo cuo'a te kama hing naa thle aa, ama hingna i byithude lieta a tu aa, ta pata na changtaanung'a lie chie naa sa va tli ca ma? Khaapanakawma Adonijah ca siepahruo a cuo khu aa?’ va ta tie.
Cakhutaata capa lie siepahruo hne bie nama ri nguoluopa khata na hnangluo taa khata zaa ngie'a angte na bie ca i pacu sa aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Bathsheba ca siepahruo khuo luo kha aa ngie. Siepahruo ca a macuo hringhruo tli; Shunam zaanung Abishag khata siepahruo ca a mangsang.
Bathsheba ta a bung te siepahruo kha pa-uvsathyina a pi ca siepahruo ta, “Khaapama na khing?” a ta.
Ama ta, “I byipaapa, na changtaanung hing Abyipana Khazing ming ta chie naa sa cate: Na sacapaa Solomon hingna siepahruo cuo'a te kama naa thle aa, i byithude lie hing a tu aa, ina ta ciy.
Cuorasala atabala hingta Adonijah ca siepahruo a vya cuo tli, cadyiseca nama i byipaapa siepahruo ta capa ca pachang vaciy.

Ama ta cuetungpa, pathupa cuetaata, hne tuv ri tie li khata hriykhungrina tue te, siepahruo saata bangkhuo, hne tluobyi Abiathar, hne riekabyi le cepa Joab kha a ku yi; cuorasala na changtaapa Solomon ca ku ra vyi.
Cuorasala nama, i byipaapa siepahruo, Israel ming bangkhuo ca i byipaapa siepahruo na byithude lie hing ama khutaata ahungma a tu aa tapa hing na chang riypa yi tana aca mangkhuo thluo yi.
Cata a cuo li kieca, i byipaapa siepahruo hing a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie aa zie tiyta, i sacapaa Solomon hne kama ca suena a tuetuv ta ripa tana ma cuo aa,” a ta.
Ama ca siepahruo hne bie ama ri nguoluopa khata profet Nathan kha a zaa ngie.
Siepahruo ca, “Profet Nathan na hingpa lie hing a aw,” ama ta. Siepahruo hmiekung luo kha a vaw te, alyi luo kha a khuv te pa-uvsathyina a pi.
Nathan ta, “I byipaapa siepahruo, nama ta, ‘Kama khutaa hingta Adonijah hing siepahruo cuo'a te i byithude lie hing aa tu aa,’ na za ta ma?

Tahematapakieca ataning hing sibung te cuetungpa, pathupa cuetaata, hne tuv ri tie li tapa tie khata hriykhungrina a tue tli. Ama ta siepahruo saata tie bangkhuo, riekabyi le cepa Joab, hne tluobyi Abiathar, tapa tie kha ku yi te, a hmiekunglie kha ning dang yi te, ‘Siepahruo Adonijah a chuo pasiy se!’ ta yi te ama khi.
Cuorasala ama ta na changtaapa kama, hne tluobyi Zadok, hne Jehoiada sacapaa Benaiah, hne na changtaapa Solomon kha malie ku vyi.
Hingpa hmang hing i byipaapa siepahruo ta na tuepa cuo te, nama hnang taa hingta i byipaapa siepahruo na byithude lie hing ahungma a tu aa tapa kha ina chang lipa cata a cuo ma?” a ta.
Siepahruo David ta palie te, “Bathsheba kha kama'a luo ku tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta ama ca siepahruo hmiekung luo kha a vaw te, a hmiekunglie kha aa daa.
Siepahruo ta chie a sa te, “I hringna kha i carie tie mekaa'a taata naa khuopa Abyipaa hringpa haata,

AbyipaIsrael ming Khazing ming ta nama'a lie chie i sa, ‘Na sacapaa Solomon ca siepahruo a cuo aa, kama kha naa thle'a te, i tunapa byithude lie kha aa tu aa,’ i tapa haa khata ataning hing i tue aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Bathsheba ca alyi luo kha a bung te, siepahruo kha pa-uvsathyina pi te, “I byipaapa Siepahruo David ca chuozaa ta hring mang sue!” a ta.
Siepahruo David ta, “Tluobyi Zadok, profet Nathan, hne Jehoiada sacapaa Benaiah kha kama'a luo ku tie yi,” a ta. Iema ca siepahruo hmiekung luo amaa zaa ngie tiyta,
siepahruo ta iema kyihuo khata, “Nama byipaapa changtaapa tie kha a chiy ung la, i sacapaa Solomon ca kama laa cunglie kha pakhang ung la, Gihon luo zuvkhyi tie ung.

Capa lie ca tluobyi Zadok hne profet Nathan ta Israel ming siepahruo riypata sathu pathuv yi se; cakhutaa cata hmyakaa kha tung ung la, ‘Siepahruo Solomon a hring pasiy mang sue!’ ta pata khi tie ung, a ta.
Ama kha ziythaw tie ung. A ngie sala i byithude lie kha a tu se; kama hmang lie kha siepahruo ta a cuo aa; tahematapakieca ama ca Israel ming hne Judah ming cunglie uvtuv riypa tana i tue tli,” a ta.
Jehoiada sacapaa Benaiah ta siepahruo kha palie te, “Amen! Abyipa, i byipaapa siepahruo Khazing ta cahaacata ri ra mang sue.
Abyipaca i byipaapa siepahruo'a lie a awpa haa khata, Solomon'a lie zaw aw ra mang sue, cakhutaata a byithude ca i byipaapa Siepahruo byithude laata pale sa vie mang sue,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta tluobyi Zadok, profet Nathan, hne Jehoiada sacapaa Benaiah, hne Khereth ming hne Peleth ming kha zuv yi te Solomon ca Siepahruo David laa kha pakhang yi te, Gihon luo amaa chiy.

Capa lie ca tluobyi Zadok ta thluodaa taa khata sathu chinapa kiy kha la te Solomon kha sathu a pathuv. Cakhutaata hmyakaa kha tung yi te cawsaa bangkhuo ta, “Siepahruo Solomon a hring pasiy mang sue!” ama ta.
Cawsaa bangkhuo ta ama kha ziythaw yi te, ramang kha tung yi te khuosa ta amaa nuo, iema puraa ca ta chuelyi a cahang.

Adonijah hne a kupa ama'a lie a awpa bangkhuo ca ama ning dang khupa khata capa thuohlaa ca ama thyi. Joab ta hmyakaa ueryi kha a thyi tiyta, ama ta, “Khypuv chunglie puraa ca khaapanakawma a cuo'a e?” a ta.

Bie a ri nguoluopa khata, tluobyi Abiathar sacapaa Jonathan kha iema'a luo a pha. Adonijah ta, “Zaa ngie tie, tahematapakieca nama ca cawsaa phapa pakha cuo cate thuohlaa phapa na za phya hrahring aa,” a ta.
Jonathan ta Adonijah kha palie te, “Cuo vyi, tahematapakieca ma byipaapa Siepahruo David na Solomon kha siepahruo ta a tue tli;
siepahruo ta ama hneta tluobyi Zadok, profet Nathan, hne Jehoiada sacapaa Benaiah hne Khereth ming hne Peleth ming kha pathlie yi te, iema ta siepahruo laa kha ama pakhang.

Tluobyi Zadok hne profet Nathan ta Gihon lie kha ama ca sathu pathuv yi te, capa taa cata iema ca anuona hneta ama sithaw nakawta khypuv ca puraa ta a bi pata a cuo. Capa thuohlaa cana nama thyi pata a cuo aa.
Solomon ca siepahruo byithude lieta aa tu.

Ca hlyitaw taata siepahruo changtaapa tie ta ma byipaapa Siepahruo David'a luo kha alawna bie hluo riypata a vaw yi te, ‘Khazing ta Solomon ming kha nama ming laata mingpathuo vie ta tue sala, a byithude ca nama byithude laata a le vie ta tue se,’ ama ta. Siepahruo ca iehmang cunglie kha a bung te,
‘Kama ciypathla pakha kha ataning i ming hmungpa hrahring ta i byithude lie a patupa AbyipaIsrael ming Khazing ca thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue,’ ta pata thlaa a chuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Adonijah ta a kupa bangkhuo ca a cathangsa yi te ama ing luo kha ama cakuo.
Adonijah ca Solomon kha a ciy nakawta thu te bienatluophie thingpazue tie kha a paw riypata a cakuo.

Solomon ca chang yi te, “Adonijah na siepahruo Solomon kha a ciysa; mang tie, ama ta bienatluophie thingpazue tie kha a paw te, ‘Siepahruo Solomon ta a changtaapa kha zueziy ta thie'a va ang ta pata chie naa sa taa se, a ta,” ama ta.

Caacuonakawta Solomon ta palie yi te, “Zang tluo a tlapa a cuona kha a paluo sa kieca, a suobuv suokha hmuo alyi luo tla'a vyi; cuorasala ama'a lieta pha lina kha hmung pata a cuo kieca a thiy aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Siepahruo Solomon ta cawsaa pathlie yi te bienatluophie taa khata amaa zuvkhyi. Ama ta Siepahruo Solomon kha pa-uvsathyina a pi; Solomon ta ama kyihuo khata, “Ing luo kha cakuo tie,” a ta.
David kha a thiyna riypa cuo aa ngie tiyta a sacapaa Solomon kha ru a huv te,
“Chuelyi phung haata kama ca i si cuo aa ngie tli. Cahra la na rie pha se,

cakhutaata na tuepa bangkhuo lie hne khaapa luo naa maa zawta na hlue a tlingna riypata, Moses phungbie lie aa capepa haata, Abyipana Khazing ta aca changpa kha a ngie la, a luopuv kha ziy la a phungluo hne a nawbie hne a ziyphung hne aca pachang sapa kha ziy tie.

Abyipata kama kawlieta, ‘Na sacapaa zaw ta ama sizya kha a cadang yi te, kama hmiekunglie zang tluo aa tla pata ama pathiypalung yalya hne ama hringna yalya ta ama si kieca Israel ming byithude lie a tu riypa ci'a va ung ciy,’ ta pata a ripa bie kha a pacu sa aa.

Ca hlyitaw taata Zeruiah sacapaa Joab ta i cunglie khaapama a tue tapa kha na pachang, ama ta Israel ming riekabyilepa pahning, Ner sacapaa Abner hne Jether sacapaa Amasa naw yi te, rie aduna cuo ningta za palangpa thiyse cuota diena cuo ningta phuv la yi te a sue lipa thiyse kha a se lie tesaw lie hne a phyi lieta phyipakaw lie kha a pahlaw yi.
Caacuonakawta na singna haa khata tue thluo, cuorasala a suo paapa a luv kha Sheol luo diena hne pasi sa'a vaciy.

Cadyiseca Gilead ming Barzillai sacapaa zaw kha ca zang tluo aa tla pata mangsang yi la, na cabya lie a ningpa tie'a lie kha pa-aw sa ra tie yi; tahematapakieca na uvta Absalom'a taata i ruo ning kha iema ta cahaapa zang tluo atlana hneta ina daw yi.

Bahurim taata Benjamin phang Gera sacapaa Shimei zaw kha a aw, Mahanaim luo i si ning kha ama ta khuosa ta chie ina sa; cuorasala Jordan lie kama'a luo aa zuv ning kha Abyipaming ta ama kha chie a sa angte, ‘Zueziy ta ca thie'a va ang i ta.'

Caacuonakawta ama ca suena a hnyi lipa haata chi'a vaciy, tahematapakieca nama ca a singpa ta na cuo; a cunglie tuokhaatama na tue riypata a cuo tapa kha na pachang, a suo paapa a luv kha Sheol luo thiyse hneta na sikhyi aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata David ca a mingchingmingvuo tie lie kha a pahy te David khypuv lie kha ama paby.
David ta Israel ming cunglie siepahruo a cuona cuo ca kung sawliy ta a cuo; Hebron lieta kung sariy siepahruo cuo te, Jerusalem lieta kung sawthung kung thung siepahruo a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Solomon ca a paa David byithude lie a tu te a pena ca a pacu sa.
Cakhutaata Haggith sacapaa Adonijah kha Solomon nung Bathsheba'a luo aa vaw. Ama ta, “Diena hneta a vaw ca ma?” a ta. Adonijah ta, “Diena hneta,” a ta.
Cakhutaata, “Nama hne bie ri khu'a ang ma?” a ta. Bathsheba ta, “Ri tie,” a ta.

Cakhutaata ama ta, “Pena hing kama huopa tana a cuo tapa kha na pachang, cakhutaata Israel ming bangkhuo ta kama kha siepahruo a cuo aa ta pata ina mangkhuo yi. Cadyiseca, pena ca a pali a pahnaa te i nuta huopa ta aa li, tahematapakieca Abyipata a pipa tana a cuo.
Ata hing kama ta nama'a lie icaa hie khingpa suokha aw te, na bu thi khah,” a ta. Bathsheba ta, “Ri pazue tie,” a ta.
Adonijah ca ta, “Shunam zaanung Abishag hing napuv ta ina pi riypata Siepahruo Solomon kha paa na kiepa thi tie, nama ca ca i'a vyi,” a ta.
Bathsheba ta, “A pha ciemuo; na cuota Siepahruo kha i chang aa,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Bathsheba ca Adonijah cuota changpa riypata Siepahruo Solomon'a luo kha a vaa. Siepahruo ca ama a taw riypa khata a daa te a hmiekunglie kha aa bung; cakhutaata a byithude lie kha aa tu, siepahruo a nung cuo khata byithude suokha pala sa yi te, a cacuoluo kuo khata aa tu.
Cakhutaata ama ta, “Hmang cawta suokha ca hie khing angte, na i thi'a vaciy,” a ta. Siepahruo ta ama kyihuo khata, “Naa hie tie, i nung, tahematapakieca ca i'a va ang,” a ta.
Ama ta, “Shunam zaanung Abishag hing na uvta Adonijah kha napuv ta pi pata cuo se,” a ta.

Siepahruo Solomon ta a nung kha palie te, “Khaapanakawma Shunam zaanung Abishag hing Adonijah huota ina hie ciy? Ama huo hingta pena zaw na hie tie nie! Tahematapakieca ama ca i uvta ta muo a cuo ta; ama huo dyi na hie li pata tluobyi Abiathar hne Zeruiah sacapaa Joab huo zaw kha na hie ra tie nie!” a ta.
Cakhutaata Siepahruo Solomon ca Abyipa'a lie kha chie a sa te, “Hingpa a hiepa cuo hingta Adonijah ta a hringna a pi li kieca, hingpa laa hingta hne a ruv vie ta Khazing ta i cunglie tue mang sue!

Caacuonakawta kama kha na pacu sa te, i paa David byithude lieta na chi te bie ina kuona haata hne ingchungkhue naa sapa tuv Abyipaa hringpa haata, ataning hingta Adonijah ca thie pata a cuo aa,” ata.
Caacuonakawta Siepahruo Solomon ta Jehoiada sacapaa Benaiah kha pathlie te, ama ca ta thie te a thiy.

Siepahruo ta tluobyi Abiathar kyihuo khata, “Anathoth khy na ing na lu luo kha si tie; tahematapakieca thiy riypa tana naa tla. Cuorasala AbyipaKhazing biekuona thingkaw kha i paa David hmiekunglieta a puv cate i paa ta ruvnaana a angpa bangkhuo kha na za angkhyi nakawta, ata hingta ca ca thie'a va ang,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Solomon ta Abiathar ca Abyipatluobyi cuona taa khata papya te, cahaacata Shiloh khy chunglie Eli ingchungkhue tie kaw Abyipata a za ripa kha a patling sa.

Capa thuohlaa ca Joab'a luo kha a pha tiyta, Joab ca Abyipathluodaa luo kha a ruo te bienatluophie thingpazue tie kha aa paw, tahematapakieca Joab ta Absalom kha a zaa bya li raalaa pata Adonijah kha aa zaa bya nakawta a cuo.

Siepahruo Solomon kha, “Joab ca Abyipathluodaa luo kha a ruo te bienatluophie athaalie na a aw,” ta pata ama chang tiyta, Solomon ta Jehoiada sacapaa Benaiah kha pathlie te,” Vaa la ama kha va thie tie,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Benaiah ca Abyipathluodaa luo kha vaa te, “Siepahruo na bie caa pi, ‘Kya pya tie,” a ta. Cuorasala ama ta, “Kya pya'a va ang, hingpa lie hingna i thiy aa,” a ta. Cakhutaata Benaiah ta siepahruo'a luo kha, “Joab ta hing haa hingta ri te, kama ta hing haa hingta i palie,” ta pata bie ca a chiykhyi pakhaa.

Siepahruo ta ama kha palie te, “A ripa haa khata tue tie, thie la paby tie; cahaacata kama'a taata hne i paa ingchungkhue taa khata, Joab ta a kawluo aw li pata a za palang pa thiyse kawlieta suena kha malie thawpa tie.

Tahematapakieca i paa David pachang li pata ama laata aa dang viepa hne a pha viepa cawsaa pahning, Ner sacapaa Abner, Israel ming riekabyilepa, hne Jether sacapaa Amasa, Judah ming riekabyilepa, tie thiyse a palangna yi kha Abyipata ama luv cunglie a patlung sa pakhaa aa.

Caacuonakawta iema thiyse ca Joab luv cunglie hne a ciypathla zaw luv cunglie kha chuozaa ta a tlung pakhaa aa; cuorasala David hne a ciypathla zaw luv cung luo cuose, a ingchungkhue hne a byithude cunglie ca Abyipa'a taata thlaalungna chuozaa ta a aw pari aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Jehoiada sacapaa Benaiah ta khawthaw te a thie; ruocaapa athaalie ama ing lie kha ama paby.
Siepahruo ta Jehoiada sacapaa Benaiah ca ama hmang lie kha rieka uvtuv ta chi te, tluobyi Zadok kha Abiathar hmang lie ca a chi.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ta Shimei kha cawsaa paku sa yi te, “Jerusalem lie kha na cuota ing a sa la, capa lie ca aw tie, capa hmang taa cata khaapa luo hmuo cakuo khah,” a ta.
Tahematapakieca pya cate Kidron cavaata na te ningpa ca na thiy ning pata a cuo aa tapa kha pachang tie; na thiyse ca nama luv cungliena a tlung aa,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Shimei ta siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Na biechina ca a pha; i byipaapa siepahruo na ripa haata, na changtaapa ta i tue aa,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Shimei ca ning hluvpuv chung Jerusalem lie kha a aw.

Cuorasala kung thung a chuona lieta Shimei sii zaw pahning ca Gath ming Maakah sacapaa Siepahruo Akhish'a luo kha amaa ruo. Capa ca Shimei kha chang yi te, “Na sii zaw na Gath lie a aw yi,” ama ta ca,
Shimei ca thu te laa kha kedie padie te, Gath lie Akhish'a luo kha a sii zaw huv riypa cata si te, a sii zaw ca Gath taa khata aa vya chiy pakhaa yi.
Solomon kha Shimei na Jerusalem taata Gath luo vaa te a vya kaa tapa kha ama chang ca,

siepahruo ta Shimei kha paku sa yi te, ama kyihuo khata, “Abyipaming ta chie ca pasa sa angte, ‘Pya cate suv kha kha luo na cakuo ningpa ca na thiy ning ta a cuo aa tapa kha pachang tie, ta pata a phasa pata ica chang cuo va ma'? Cakhutaa cata nama ta, ‘Na biechina ca a pha; i cuhluo,’ na ta.
Khaapanakawma Abyipa'a lie bie naa kuopa kha ziy lipa cata bie ica pipa kha na ziy va?” a ta.
Siepahruo ta Shimei kyihuo khata, “Nama ta i paa David cunglie pha lina na tuepa kha na palung chunglie na pachang; caacuonakawta Abyipana na pha lina kha na luv cung luo a patlung pakhaa aa.
Cuorasala siepahruo Solomon ca thluechiypa ta cuo sala, David byithude ca Abyipahmiekunglie chuozaa ta pacu sa pata cuo mang sue,” a ta.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ta Jehoiada sacapaa Benaiah kha bie pi te, ama ta pya te a thie. Caacuonakawta pena ca Solomon kuv chunglie kha pacu sa pata a cuo.

Solomon ta nungchiyna ta Izipt siepahruo Faro hne adaapakhawna a tue; Faro sacanung kha napuv ta chiy te ama ing hne Abyipaing hne Jerusalem dungkhuo lungruetlepie a patlungna te khata David khypuv lie kha a chi caw.
Abyipaming ta sapa ing a aw li lie nakawta cawsaa zaw ca khahrungtluobu lie kha hriykhungrina ama tue.
Solomon ta Abyipakha a due, a paa David phungluo kha a ziy; cadyiseca khahrungtluobu lie kha hriykhungrina hne rangpa-ue pihluona a tue.
Siepahruo ca Gibeon luo kha hriykhungrina tue riypata a si, tahematapakieca capa hmang ca khahrungtluobu lepa ta a cuo; Solomon ta capa bienatluophie lie ca myirue panaana thawkha a pihluo taw.
Gibeon lie ca Solomon'a lie kha zuo a muo ta Abyipaa luo te, Khazing ca ta, “Khaapama ica pi aa, naa hie tie,” a ta.

Solomon ta, “Nama ta na changtaapa i paa'a lie kha a lepa hne aa hmangpa duena na paluo sa, tahematapakieca ama ta na hmiekunglie kha zang tluo atlana, adangna, hne nama'a luo aa dangpa pathiypalung hnyina ta a hring; nama ta capa a lepa hne aa hmang paripa duena ca a cuota pahmang sa cate, a byithude cunglie a sacapaa a tu khuna zaw kha ataning hing na pi.
Cakhutaata Vya Abyipai Khazing, na changtaapa hing haatiyta tah i cuo raalaa pata i paa David hmang lie siepahruo ta na tue cate, tuokhaata pya'a angte ma tuokhaata i ngie aa tapa pachang va ang.
Cakhutaata na changtaapa hing nama ta naa tlawpa cawsaa zaw, a lepa mingphang, ri tie hne pasuv tie lipa, a hluvsapa zaw hrawlieta i aw.

Caacuonakawta na changtaapa hing na cawsaa zaw uvnazya pachangkhuna, a chie hne a pha thleduo khuna pathiypalung na za pi thi tie; tahematapakieca ahungma hingpa a lepa na mingphang hing a uv khu aa?” a ta.
Solomon ta aa hiepa hmang ca ta Abyipakha a palung a patluo.

Khazing ta ama kyihuo khata, “Nama ta hingpa hing naa hie cate, nama huota hring pasiyna hne hnyirungna cuose, na carie tie thiy riypa kha cuose naa hie lipa cata, cuorasala nama cuota aa dangpa hmang thleduo khuna kha inaa hie nakaw ca ta,
ata hing na bie haata i tue aa. Singna hne pachangkhuna pathiypalung ica pi hmisi, nama haapa ahunghmuo za aw buo li pata nama haapa hing ahunghmuo aw'a va tli.
Nama ta inaa hie lipa zaw kha ica pi, na chuo chunglie hnyirungna hne pa-uvsathyina ca pi angte, nama hne pakhingpuo riypa siepahruo ahunghmuo aw'a va yi.
Na paa ta a ziypa haata i luopuv hing ziy cate, i phungluo hne i nawbie hing na ziy kieca, na hring ica pasiy sa aa.

Cakhutaata Solomon ca a kya cha te, a muo ta a cuo. Jerusalem luo kha a vaw te Abyipabiekuona thingkaw hmiekunglie kha aa daa. Ama ta myirue panaana hne aviesaa panaana zaw kha pihluo te, a changtaapa zaw bangkhuo cuo khata saduona a tuepa yi.
Cakhutaa cata, siyhrawnung zaw pahning kha siepahruo'a luo a vaw yi te a hmiekunglie kha amaa daa.
Cawsaanung pakha ca ta, “Vya i byipaapa, hingpa cawsaanung hne kama ca ing kha lie a awhnepa tana ma cuo; ing lie a aw ning khata kama ta saata i sa.

Saata i sanapa ning thung a tapa khata hingpa cawsaanung zaw hing saata a sa ra. Kiema ca a aw pakhawpa ta ma cuo; ing chunglie kiema hneta a aw rapa cawsaa hrangpa aw va yi, kiema pahning dyina ing chunglie ca a aw puv.
Cakhutaata hingpa nung hingta a saata ca aa hnie nakawta a saata ca zuo ta a thiy.
Zuocang ta thu te na changtaanung i hmung chungta i thaa taa khata i saata kha a la. I saata ca a cacunghnaa lie pazie te ama saata a thiypa kha kama cacunghnaa lie a vya pazie.
Maw ta thu angte i saata kha meme i pazaw sa'a nang tiyta a thiypa kha i hmung; cuorasala maw cata a phata tah i mangpasie tiyta, kama ta i sapa i sacapaa ta cuo vyi,” a ta.

Cuorasala a hrangpa cawsaanung ca ta, “Cuo vyi, a hringpa haatiypa hing kama sacapaa ta cuo te, a thiypa haatiypa hing nama sacapaa ta a cuo,” a ta. A pakhana nung ca ta, “Cuo vyi, a thiypa haatiypa hing nama sacapaa ta cuo te, a hringpa haatiypa hing kama sacapaa ta a cuo,” a ta. Cahaacata siepahruo hmiekunglie ca bie amaa i.

Cakhutaata siepahruo ta, “Pakha ta, ‘A hringpa hing kama sacapaa ta cuo te, nama sacapaa na a thiy,’ nama ta; pakha ta, ‘Cahaacata cuo vyi! nama saata kha thiy te kama saata na a hring,’ nama ta,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta siepahruo ta, “Zueziy na vya pi tie ung,” ta te, siepahruo hmiekung luo kha zueziy suokha ama vya cyi.
Siepahruo ta, “A hringpa haatiy kha che hning ta che ung la khingkhuo kha pakha, a hrangpa khingkhuo kha pakha ta pata pi tie ung,” a ta.

Cuorasala a sacapaa a hringpa nung ca a palung chunglie a sacapaa kawpacuona kha a ie ta a ie nakawta siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Vya i byipaapa, a hringpa haatiypa kha ama ca pi tie; thie thi khah!” a ta. Pakha khata, “Hingpa hing kama huo zaw cuo'a vyi, nama huo zaw cuo'a vyi; chechi tie,” a ta.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ta palie yi te, “Pakhanapa nung kha a hringpa haatiypa kha pi tie ung; thie khah ung. Ama khana a nung ta a cuo,” a ta.
Israel ming bangkhuo ca siepahruo ta a tuepa biechipana kha ama thyi tiyta, aa dang pata biechi khu riypata Khazing singna a chunglie a awpa kha pachang yi te siepahruo cunglie kha ama kharue a haa.
Solomon ca Israel ming bangkhuo cunglieta siepahruo cuo te,
hingpa tie hing uvtuv byi lepa tie ta ama cuo: Zadok sacapaa Azariah ca tluobyi ta a cuo;
Shisha sacapaa tie Elihoref hne Ahijah kha caacapetuv cuo yi te,
Jehoiada sacapaa Benaiah kha riekabyi le cepa ta a cuo; Zadok hne Abiathar kha tluobyi ta ama cuo;
Nathan sacapaa Azariah kha abyi tie uvtuv ta cuo te, Nathan sacapaa Zabud kha tluobyi hne siepahruo viesaa ta a cuo;
Ahishar kha siepahruo ing mangchiytuv ta cuo te, Abda sacapaa Adoniram kha re pahrie sapa tie uvtuv ta a cuo.

Solomon ta Israel ming bangkhuo cunglie kha abyi pahraa hlyihning a hnyi yi, iema ca siepahruo hne a ingchungkhue cuota ning hne dang khue a khuotuv ta ama cuo; kung kha chunglie pakha ta thla kha law ning hne dang khue a khuotuv riypata ama cuo.
Hingpa tie hing ama ming ta a cuo: Efraim tluocung ruo lie Ben-hur,
Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth-shemesh, hne Elon-beth-hanan lie Ben-deker,
Arubboth lie Ben-hesed (Sokoh hne Hefer ruo bangkhuo ca ama huopa tana a cuo);
Nafath-dor bangkhuo lie Ben-abinadab (Solomon sacanung Tafath kha a napuv ta a cuo);
Taanak, Megiddo, hne Zarethan athaalie Jezreel rawlie a awpa Beth-shean bangkhuo, Beth-shean taata Abel-meholah te, Jokmeam huesuo luo te khata Ahilud sacapaa Baana,

Ramoth-gilead lie Ben-geber (ama ta Manasseh sacapaa Jair a khy tie, Gilead lie a awpa tie kha hnyi yi te, cakhutaata Bashan lie a awpa Argob pe khy lepa sawcaruv lungruetlepie dungkhuo hne daa thlake a hnyipa tie kha a hnyi);
Mahanaim lie Iddo sacapaa Ahinadab;
Naftali lie Ahimaaz (ama ta Solomon sacanung Basemath kha napuv ta a la);
Asher hne Bealoth lie Hushai sacapaa Baana;
Isskhar lie Paruah sacapaa Jehoshafat;
Benjamin lie Ela sacapaa Shimei;
Amor ming Siepahruo Sihon hne Bashan ming Siepahruo Og tie ruo, Gilead ruo lie Uri sacapaa Geber. Cakhutaata Judah ruo lieta abyi pakha a aw.
Judah hne Israel ming ca riyliy kielie viehnang zaa ta ama hluv; ning yi dang yi te ama palung a tluo.
Solomon ta Zufrates taata Filistin ruo te lie pena zaw bangkhuo kha a uv diy yi; a hring chung bangkhuo ngukhyi pi yi te a re ama hrie.
Solomon cuota ning kha a sa ca Jungsacuo viedie diyta kor sawthung hne jungsacuo kor sawcaruv,
a thupa cuetungpa sa hraa, ruo lie a tlepa cue sa kiy, hne tuv zakha ta a cuo; sakhiy, sasuv, cane, saazaa, hne pathupa aa tie ta ama cuo.
Tahematapakieca ama ta Zufrates cavaa taata ningtlaluo ruo bangkhuo Tifsah taata Gaza te, Zufrates cavaa ningtlaluo siepahruo bangkhuo kha uv yi te a cahriy ruo bangkhuo lie diena a aw.
Solomon a hring chung bangkhuo ca Judah hne Israel ming kha Dan taata Beer-sheba te ta iema hne ama mingsuv kung rawlie hne ama thyikuv kung rawlieta aa bangsa pata khy ama sa.
Solomon ta aa ruole a da riypa aruo china ta aruo-ing thaw sawliy hne aruo rieka thawhraa hlyihning a hnyi.
Capa abyi tie ca ta Siepahruo Solomon hne Siepahruo Solomon cabya luo a vawpa bangkhuo cuo khata pakha ta thla kha chung ning dang kha khue khuo yi te aa hupa khaapahmuo aw li riypata ama tue.
Iema ta iema hne ama re cyicuo haa khata aruo zaw, aa ruo a catlisapa rietuvna aruo zaw cuo khata aa huna hmang lie kha jungsacuo hne aphuv caapa zaw kha ama vya cyi.
Khazing ta Solomon kha singna lesapa, thleduo khuna, hne riyliy kielie viehnang zaa ta a kupa pachangna zaw kha a pi.
Caacuonakawta Solomon singna ca ningchiy cawsaa bangkhuo singna hne Izipt singna bangkhuo kha a law diy.
Ama ca cawsaa bangkhuo laa khata sing vie te, Ezarah ming Ethan, hne Mahol saata zaw ta a cuopa Heman, Kalkol hne Darda zaw laa khata a sing vie; a ming ca a cahriy ruo bangkhuo luo kha a pathuo.
Ama ta phungthluvbie thaw sawthung ri te a hlaa ca hla thawkha hla pangaa a cuo.
Thingkung zaw kaw, Lebanon lie a pupa sidar kung taata lungruetlepie alalalie a pupa hyssop kung kaw te ta a ri; ama ta saruopa kaw, pavaa kaw, aa va ta a vapa saruopa kaw hne ngaa kaw zaw kha a ri.
A singna kaw a thyipa ruo ting taata mingphang tie hne alyi cung siepahruo mekaa kha a vaw yi te Solomon singna kha ama vya naathlie.
Tair siepahruo Hiram ta Solomon ca a paa hmang liena siepahruo ta ama pacuo sa tli tapa kha a thyi tiyta, a changtaapa tie kha a pathlie yi; tahematapakieca Hiram ca cipari ta David viesaa ta a cuo.
Solomon ta Hiram'a luo kha bie taa te,
“Abyipata a phyipazaa rawlie a chi hluo li yi a carie tie ta a kuo bangkhuo taata ama cadung nakawta, i paa David ta Abyipaa Khazing ming cuota biena-ing sa khu vyi tapa kha na pachang.
Cuorasala ata hing ca Abyipai Khazing ta a kuo bangkhuo taata a pahyna ina pi; carie cuose, vuochina cuose hnyi va ang.

Caacuonakawta Abyipata i paa David kyihuo ta, ‘Na sacapaa, nama hmang lie na byithude lie i chipa ta i ming cuota biena-ing a sa aa,’ ta pata a ripa haata, Abyipai Khazing ming cuota biena-ing sa i ting.

Caacuonakawta Lebanon tluo lie sidar thing kha ina hupa riypa yi ta bie pi tie yi. I changtaapa tie ta na changtaapa tie kha a bya'a yi te, na changtaapa tie cuota nama ta na thlina haata a muo ica pi aa. Tahematapakieca Sidon ming tluv ta thing syi a thepa kiema hrawlieta aw va yi tapa kha na pachang,” a ta.

Hiram ta Solomon bie kha a thyi tiyta khuopuv ta a palung tluo te, “Hingpa a lepa mingphang cunglieta aw riypata David kha a singpa sacapaa a pituv Abyipaca ataning hing thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue,” a ta.
Hiram ta Solomon kha bie taa te, “Bie ina taapa ca kha i thyi; sidar thing hne saipres thing kawlieta na khingpa mekaa kha ca tuepa i nang.

I changtaapa tie ta Lebanon tluo taata riyliy luo ama sikhyi aa; phong ta tue'a angte nama na tingna hmang luo kha riyliy taata ma pasi aa. Capa lie ca pathluo sa'a yi angte nama ta na la aa. I ingchungkhue kha sa ring'a cate i hupa kha ina patling sa'a ciy,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Hiram ta Solomon ca sidar thing hne saipres thing a khingpa bangkhuo kha a pi.
Solomon ta Hiram ca a ingchungkhue tie cuota jungsacuo kor thawkiy hne chiytiy kor suokiy a pi hriy. Solomon ta capa ca Hiram kha a kung tating ta a pi.
Caacuonakawta Abyipata Solomon ca bie a kuopa haa khata singna a pi.
Siepahruo Solomon ta Israel ming bangkhuo chungtaata re pahrie sapa cawsaa thawsawthung a la yi.
Thla kha ta thawhraa ta aa paziy pata Lebanon luo kha a pathlie yi; Lebanon lie thla hning, ing lie thla kha ta pata ama aw. Adoniram ca re pahrie sapa tie uvtuv ta a cuo.
Solomon ta tluocung ruo lie alung a uopa thaw sawcari hne alung a palaw riypa re pahriesapa thaw sawsariy zaw kha a hnyi yi.
Iema hlyitaw taa cata Solomon ta re pahrie sapa tie tluo a tlapa riypa byi thawthung zathung a hnyi yi.
Siepahruo biepina haata, ing hruopatu ca parepa alung ta sa riypata alung lepa hne a muosungpa kha ama cakhy.
Caacuonakawta Solomon cawsaa ing satuv tie, Hiram cawsaa ing satuv tie hne Gebal ming ta ing sana riypa alung hne thing kha amaa ring pacie.

Israel ming Izipt ruo taata ama pya khutaata kung zapaliy kung sawcari kung, Solomon ta Israel ming a uvnapa yi kung paliyna kung, thla hningna thlaa ta a cuopa Ziv thlaa chunglie kha ama ta Abyipaing sa hruo ca a pathu.
Siepahruo Solomon ta Abyipahuota a sapa ing ca a syina daw sawcaruv, a kuna daw kiy, hne aa suona daw sawthung ta a cuo.
Khuolepa hmielie ingle khuo ca inghaa zaa ta daw kiy ku ra te a syina daw hraa a ta.
Cakhutaata biena-ing tlepie aa suo luo khata thlaluo-aw zaw a tue.
Ing tlepie a cadung diypa cata, a khuolepa hne chungching hmangpathepa a cadungpuo pata a kuo vyicuo hne a hnangluo kuo, bangkhuo a cadung diy pata, a khuo taata aa pazue pata a sa diy.

A raw ce khuo ca daw pangaa a ku, a liekhingkhuo khuo ca daw caruv ku te, a suothungnapa khuo ca daw sariy a ku. A tluo zaw kha tlepie chung luo pangie aa hu li riypata aleluo taata ing aa dungpa khata tlepie lie kha a pachuona a syipahyapa a tue diy.
Ing ca alung khue lie pare pacie diypa alung ta sapa a cuo nakawta biena-ing ama sa ningta khunglung pu cuose, ahryi pu cuose, thaa ta tuepa cehre pu khaapahmuo thyi pata cuo vyi.
Araw ce duo luo a ngienapa ca ing sungluo kuo ta aw te, alie duo ca hlyidaw ta kie pata a cuo; alie duo taata acung duo luo zaw hlyidaw ta kie pata a cuo ngiethie.
Cahaacata ing ca sa te a palang; cakhutaata siling kha sidar thing tluo hne thing phie ta a tue.
Ing a kuo bangkhuo ta a sapa a khuo tie ca aa suona daw pangaa ta cuo kaluo diy te sidar tluo kha ingpuv tlepie lie pachuo pata patuv sapa a cuo.
Cakhutaata Abyipabie ca Solomon'a luo kha a zuv te,
“Hingpa ing na sana kawlie hingta, i phungluo kha ziy cate, i ziyphung kha tue cate, i nawbie kha na ziy kieca na paa David'a lie i tuepa biekuona kha nama'a lie i pacu sa aa.
Israel ming hrawlie kha khysa'a angte, i cawsaa Israel ming kha thaw'a va yi ang,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Solomon ca ing kha sa te a palang.
Ing tlepie kha achungluo taata sidar thingphie a be diy; dakhang taata siling te khata achungluo taata thing a be diy; ing dakhang kha ca saipres thingphie a be.
Ing hnangluo daw kiy kha a khuo tue te, dakhang taata siling te khata sidar thing a be diy; capa ca chungching hmangpathepa, hmang pathe cepa ta a tue.
Chungching hmangpathepa a hmielie a awpa khuolepa ca daw sawliy a syi.
Ingchung lie sidar thing cunglie ca ungthyiriy hne paapaapa zaw kha cape yi te, a bangkhuo ta sidar thing ta a cuo, alung suokha hmuo a luo vyi.
Abyipabiekuona thingkaw china riypata ing a chung ce luo kha chungching hmangpathepa kha a tue.
Chungching hmangpathepa ca daw kiy a syi, daw kiy ku te daw kiy aa suo; siy pathepa a pakhuv diy. Sidar thing ta a tuepa bienatluophie zaw kha siy pathepa a pakhuv diy ngiethie.
Solomon ta ingchungluo kha siy pathepa ta pakhuv diy te chungching hmangpathepa hmielie kha siy riy pathlie te, siy a pakhuv diy.
Cakhutaata ing ca a yalya ta siy ta pakhuv diy te, chungching hmangpathepa lie a awpa bienatluophie zaw kha a yalya ta siy ta a pakhuv diy.
Chungching hmangpathepa lie kha cherubim suohning tue te daw hraa kaluo aa suo.
Cherub mathlaa hrakhaluo kha daw pangaa syi te, cherub mathlaa hrakhaluo zaw kha daw pangaa a syi; a mathlaa hrakhaluo a daw taata a hrangpa hrakhaluo a daw te ta daw hraa a syi.
Cherub a hrangpa zaw kha daw hraa ta te, cherubim a suohning khata a le a caw amaa khing.
Cherub suokha ca daw hraa aa suo, cahaacata a hrangpa cherub suokha zaw a cuo ra.

Ama ta cherubim ca ing a chungching khuo lie kha a chi; cherubim mathlaa tie ca suo kha mathlaa ta tlepie kuokhaluo, a hrangpa cherub suokha mathlaa ta tlepie kuokhaluo kha a de pata chi te, a mathlaa kuokhaluo kaluo ca ingkhuo khingkhuo lieta aa taw.
Ama ta cherubim zaw kha siy a pakhuv.
Ing tlepie bangkhuo ca a kuo bangkhuo ta cherubim zuv hne tungkung zuv hne paapaapa zuv kha achungluo taata hne aleluo taa hneta ama sa diy.
Ing dakhang ca achung hne ale hne siy a pakhuv diy.
Chungching hmangpathepa luo a ngienapa ingchiypakaa kha olif thing ta a tue; ingchiypakaa a tluo hne a tung ca a kiy kiy pangaa a aw.
Olif thing ta tuepa ingchiypakaa suohning ca cherubim zuv, tungkung, hne paapaapa zuv tapa tie kha sa te, siy ta a pakhuv, cherubim hne tungkung kha siy ta a pame.
Cahaa ngiethie cata khuolepa luo a ngienapa ingchiypakaa zaw kha olif thing ta tue te kiy paliy kaluo ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata ingchiypakaa suohning tie ca saipres thing ta a tue; ingchiypakaa suokha a chiypakaa ca kadiy khu pata cuo te a hrangpa ingchiypakaa a chiypakaa suohning zaw kadiy khu pata a cuo.
Ama ta cherubim zuv, tungkung, hne paapaapa zuv tapa tie kha sa te, a zuv cunglie kha siy ta a pakhuv.
Ama ta a chungching khuo kha pare ciepa alung tluo thung lieta sidar thing tluo kha ta pasi te a sa.
A kung paliyna, Ziv thlaa lie kha Abyipaing hruopatu ca pathu pata a cuo.
A kung hlyikhana, thla carina thlaa ta a cuopa Bul thlaa lie kha ing ca za tingtuopa haata a tling pata palang pata a cuo. Hingpa ing sa hing kung sariy chung aa rukhyi.
Solomon ta a ing ca kung hraa hlyithung chung sa te a yalya ta a palang.
Lebanon Atuv Ing tapa kha sa te, a syina daw zakha, a kuna daw sawngaa, aa suona daw sawthung ta a cuo; sidar thing tung aa patluo pata tluo paliy cunglie sidar thing pahriy pasi pata sapa a cuo.
Tluo kha lie hlyipangaa law ta a awpa atung zaw cunglie kha ingpasuv sawliy suopangaa khang pata capa cunglie ca sidar thing ta thlungkhuv tue pata a cuo.
A thlaluo-aw ca a kuo hning ta aa dadaw pata tluo thung ta tuepa a cuo.
Ingchiypakaa bangkhuo hne ingchiypakaa tung bangkhuo ca kiy paliy ta ama cuo diy, a tluo thung ta amaa hmiepachaw diy.
Atungpuv Khuo tapa kha sa te a syina daw sawngaa, a kuna daw sawthung ta a cuo. Atung zaw hmielie khata a hmyachung aw te a siling ca aa suosa pata tue pata a cuo.
Ama ta Byithude Khuo, bieripana riypata a hmuo riypa Bieripana Khuo kha sa te, dakhang taata siling te khata sidar thing ta a sa.
Ama awna riypa ama ing, capa khuo hnangluo ta a awpa ca cahaa ngiethie cata sa pata a cuo. Solomon ta capa khuo hne aa lupa cata a napuvnung Faro sacanung huo zaw kha ing suokha a sa.
A hruopatu taata a daw te, a hnang taata a hmie te, ale taata a khuo lepa te bangkhuo kha hluo ta aa de sungsiy ta uopa, a muosungpa alung ta sa pata a cuo.
A hruopatu ca alung lepa, daw cari hne daw caruv a tapa, alung muosungpa ta sa pata a cuo.
A cungluo ca aa de sungsiy ta uopa alung muosungpa hne sidar thing ta ama cuo.
A khuo lepa ca alung pangipa tluo thung lie sidar thing tluo kha ta a chi aa dung pata sa pata cuo te, Abyipaing chungching khuo hne a ingle khuo zaw kha cahaacata sa pata a cuo.
Solomon ta Tair taata Hiram kha bie a taa.

Ama ca Naftali phang taata nunghlyi pakha sacapaa ta cuo te a paa ca Tair ming daa re a thepa ta a cuo; ama ca daa re hriena luo ta ca a kuvzung phapa, a singpa hne pachangna a hnyipa ta a cuo. Siepahruo Solomon'a luo kha a vaw te a re bangkhuo kha a hriepa.
Ama ta daa atung suohning patle te, aa suona daw hraa hlyicari, a sung daw hraa hlyihning ta a cuo; atung suohningna zaw cahaacata a cuo.
Atung daw pakhuv suohning kha daa ta patle te a pakhuv suokha aa suona ca daw pangaa ta a cuo, a hrangpa a pakhuv suokha aa suona zaw daw pangaa ta a cuo.
Atung daw pakhuv lie ca asue khue haata tuepa daa tieky hne khuhriy camaapa haata tuepa daa tieky zaw kha a tue, tung kha daw lie suosariy hne a hrangpa tung kha daw lie suosariy ta a cuo.
Atung daw pakhuv cunglie tuepa asue khue haapa daa riy lie kha a chi aa dung pata tluo hning ta cale thyi a sa; a hrangpa suokha atung pakhuv cunglie zaw kha cahaacata a sa ra.
Ingle lie a awpa atung daw pakhuv ca daw paliy a suo te lili paa haata tue pata a cuo.

Atung daw pakhuv ca atung tung hning daw lie ca aw te capa cunglie a awpa asue khue haata a tapa cunglie ca cale thyi zuv zahning kha a chi aa dung pata a aw, a hrangpa tung kha luo zaw kha cahaacata a aw ra.
Biena-ing ingle khuo, sungluo kuo lie zaw kha atung bang te a ming ca Jachin a ta; chaluo kuo lie zaw kha bang ra te a ming ca Boaz a ta.
Atung zaw a daw ca lili paa zuv kha a tue. Cahaacata atung re ca a palang.
Cakhutaata rahung tiy-ing lesapa suokha a tue; a pungkalung te, kuokhaluo kie taata kuokhaluo kie te a kuna daw hraa cuo te, daw pangaa aa suo. A chi aa dung pata taapa kieca daw sawthung a ta.
A tluo rawlie ca tluo hning ta a sipa, daw hraa a syipa ungthyi riy zuv suohning ta aa tieky pata cadung te, capa ca rahunglepa ama patle ningta patlepuo pata a cuo.

Rahunglepa ca cuetungpa sahraa hlyihning cunglieta ama patu; sathung chaluo, sathung sungluo, sathung ningtlaluo, sathung ningchiyluo ta pata amaa hyi; rahung ca iema cunglie ca patu pata cuo te hnang amaa chaw kaluo.
Rahunglepa ca pazaa tie a chaa; a tluo ca panuo tluo haata tue pata cuo te, lili paa haa khata a ta; bath thawhning aa tlaw.
Cakhutaata daa ta tuepa patuna suohraa a sa. Suokha ca a syina daw paliy, a kuna daw paliy, aa suona daw thung ta a cuo.
Hingpa hing patuna ama sanazya ta a cuo; a tung zaw alalalie kha a tluo zaw ama pasi,
atung hne atung alala a tluo lie kha chingde zuv, cuetungpa zuv hne cherubim zuv zaw amaa luo. Atung zaw cunglie ca chingde hne cuetungpa zuv zaw a cung a raw khata paapaapa tieky zuv ama aw.

Patuna suokha kaluo lie kha daa tiekyphyi suopaliy hne a tiekyphyi pahryina daa tluo ama hnyi; a kiy kiy paliy lie kha rahung patuna riypata a padu zaw a aw. A padu tie a kuoluo vyicuo lieta paapaapa tieky zuv kha ama patlepuo.
Rahung patuna riypa atung daw tie ca a pungkalung te a khue aa aw; capa atung ca patuna cungluo kha daw kha kya pya te, patuna a rawluo kha daw kha hne a che a tla.
A tiekyphyi suopaliy ca a tluo raw luo khata aw yi te, a tiekyphyi tluo ca a tung lie kha a vaa pahryi diy; a tiekyphyi aa suona ca daw kha hne a che ta a cuo.
A tiekyphyi ca aruole tiekyphyi haa khata tue pata a cuo; a tluo, tieky tluo, a tieky sung hne a sung pate zaw ca a bangkhuo ta a patle ta patlepa selaw ta ama cuo.
A kiy kiy paliy lie a awpa a tung lie kha a padu suopaliy a aw; a padu tie ca a tung tie hne khata aa pazue diy.
A padu a daw lie kha aa pungkalungpa a tung daw kha hne a che a tapa aw te, capa ca hne a tung hne a tluo ca suokha ta aa pazue diy.
A tung hne a tluo zaw cunglie kha cherubim, chingde, hne tungkung zuv zaw kha sa yi te, a tlawna lie kha a chi aa dungna te ta paapaapa tieky zuv ama cadung sa diy.
Cahaacata ama ta patuna suohraa kha sa te, a bangkhuo ta aa lu pata patlepa ta a cuo, a lu diy te aa khing diy.
Ama ta daa rahung suohraa tue te, rahung suokha ta tiy bath sawliy kaluo aa tlaw. Patuna suohraa lie kha rahung suokha kaluo ta patu pata a cuo.
Ama ta patuna suopangaa kha ing sungluo kuo ta a chi, ing chaluo kuo khata patuna suopangaa kha chi te, ing taata ningchiy-sungluo kuo khata rahung kha a chi.
Hiram ta bi zaw, kawpia zaw, hne rahung zaw kha a tue. Caacuonakawta Hiram ta Abyipaing lie Siepahruo Solomon huota a tuepa re bangkhuo kha a patlung.
Atung tung hning, atung tung hning daw lie a awpa a daw pakhuv, atung dawlie a awpa asue khue a lupa ta ama tuepa daw pakhuv panginapa,
atung cunglie atung daw pakhuv suohning tie pakhuv riypata asue khue a lu pata pangipa tie cunglie tluo hning ta a sipa cale thyi zapaliy;
patuna suohraa, patuna cunglie rahung suohraa;
rahunglepa suokha, rahunglepa rawlieta cuetungpa sa hraa hlyihning.
Abyipaing lie huota Hiram ta Solomon cuota a tuepa bi zaw, kawpia zaw, rahung zaw hne biphie bangkhuo ca daa ngupa hmuo pata a tuepa ta ama cuo.
Jordan ase, Sukkoth hne Zarethan alalalie thingtlung lyi lie kha siepahruo ta a patle sa yi.
Capa biphie zaw ca a hluv tuv nakawta Solomon ta aa riyna kha pathlie sa va yi, caacuonakawta daa aa riyna zaa kha ahungtahmuo pachang va yi.
Cahaacata Solomon ta Abyipaing chunglie biphie bangkhuo kha a tue; siy bienatluophie, Phuovaa viechuo china siy cabya,

siy pathepa ta tuepa myi-ing tung, chungching hmangpathepa sungluo kuo ta suo pangaa, chaluo kuo ta suo pangaa, a hmieluo kuo ta suo pangaa; paapaapa zaw, myi-ing zaw, hne cecakie zaw, siy ta tuepa tie;

panuo zaw, myi pachenapa zaw, rahung zaw, rangpa-ue china pakaa aa thuvpa zaw, buvcuo liynapa zaw, buvcuo liyna phie zaw, siy pathepa ta tuepa tie; ingchung chungching khuo, hmang pathe cepa khuo ingchiypakaa kaazaa zaw, hne biena-ing khuolepa ingchiypakaa tie, siy ta tuepa tie.

Cahaacata Siepahruo Solomon ta Abyipaing lie a hriepa re bangkhuo ca a palang. Solomon ta a paa David ta a za pihluo siypa chechiy ta a cuopa, ngu, siy, hne biphie zaw kha a ngiekhyi te Abyipaing suethiy ing chunglie a chi diy.

Cakhutaata Solomon ta Israel uvthyi tie hne, phang tie luv a cuopa bangkhuo, hne Israel ming ciypathlatuv ingchungkhue tie luochiytuv tie kha Abyipabiekuona thingkaw kha David khypuv Zion taata Jerusalem lie a hmiekung luo kha phyathaw riypata a pahmya yi.
Israel ming bangkhuo ca thla sariynapa ta a cuopa Ethanim thlaa lie ama tuepa pyi lie kha Siepahruo Solomon'a lie amaa hmya.
Cakhutaata Israel ming uvthyi bangkhuo kha a vaw yi te tluobyi tie ta biekuona thingkaw ca amaa puv.
Caacuonakawta iema ta Abyipabiekuona thingkaw, atawna thluodaa, hne thluodaa chunglie a awpa a pathepa biphie bangkhuo ca ama kya phyathaw; tluobyi tie hne Levi ming ta ama kya phyathaw.

Siepahruo Solomon hne Israel ming cawsaazaapuv, a hmiekunglie a pungpa bangkhuo ca biekuona thingkaw hmiekunglie kha aw yi te, ri tie li hne pasuv tie li ta a cuopa tuv hne cuetungpa a hluv hringhruo ta hriykhungrina ama pihluo.
Cakhutaa cata tluobyi tie ta Abyipabiekuona thingkaw ca a awna hmang, ing chung chungching hmangpathepa, hmang pathe cepa chunglie cherubim mathlaa tie rawlie kha ama chi.
Tahematapakieca cherubim tie ta biekuona thingkaw awna hmang cunglie kha ama mathlaa ama pazu, caacuonakawta biekuona thingkaw hne a tluo tie ca a cungluo taa khata ama buv.

A tluo zaw ca ama syisa nakawta a tluo a dawluo kuo tie ca chungching hmangpathepa hmiekunglie hmang pathepa taa khata hmung khu pata a cuo; cuorasala aleluo taata ca hmung khu pata cuo vyi; capa lie ca na ataning tepa hingta ama aw thluo.
Israel ming Izipt taata ama pya tiyta, Abyipata iema hne biekuona a tuenapa Horeb lieta Moses ta a chunglie a khungpa lungphie suohning ta li pata biekuona thingkaw chunglie khaapahmuo aw vyi.
Cakhutaata tluobyi tie kha hmang pathepa taata ama kya pya tiyta Abyipaing kha amyi ta a pahlaw.
Abyiparungnaana ca Abyipaing lie kha a bi nakawta, amyi kawlie ca ta tluobyi tie ca ama re hrie riypata a daa khu va yi.
Cakhutaata Solomon ta, “Abyipana a chaapa zingna chungliena i aw aa, a ta.
Chuozaa ta na awna riypa tana, a rungnaapa ing ica sapa tli,” a ta.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ca a pali te Israel ming cawsaazaapuv ca amaa daa nguoluo ning kha thluechiy a pi yi.
Ama ta, “I paa David'a lieta a pakaa ta bie a kuopa kha a kuv ta a patling sapa Abyipa, Israel Khazing ca thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue.

Tahematapakieca ama ta, ‘I cawsaa Israel ming kha Izipt taata i pyakhyi ning taa yi ta, Israel ming phang chungtaata khaapa khypuv kha hmuo i ming awna ing sana riypata a tlaw va ang, cuorasala David kha i cawsaa Israel ming cunglie aw riypata i tlaw,’ a ta.
Israel Khazing, Abyipaming riypata ing sa riypa kha i paa David pathiypalung lie a za aw thluo.
Cuorasala Abyipata i paa David kyihuo khata, ‘I ming riypata ing sa riypa na ruepa hing a phapa tana a cuo;
cadyiseca nama ta ing kha sa'a vaciy, cuorasala nama ta na hnyi riypa na sacapaa na i ming riypata ing ca a sa aa,’ a ta.

Ata hing Abyipata a tuepa a biekuona kha a patling sa tli; tahematapakieca i paa David kha a thle tli angte, Abyipabiekuona haata Israel byithude lie kha i tu tli, Israel Khazing, Abyipaming riypata ing kha i sa tli.
Cakhutaata Izipt ruo taata a pyakhyi ning yi ta Abyipata ma mingchingmingvuo tie hne a za tuepa biekuo awnapa biekuona thingkaw china riypa hmang suokha zaw kha capa lie ca i tue,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Solomon ca Abyipabienatluophie hmielie, Israel ming aa pungpa bangkhuo tie hmungna lie kha a daa te, a buo kha avuo luo a pazu.

Ama ta, “Vya Abyipa, Israel Khazing, cungluo vuoruo lie cuose, rawluo alyi lie cuose nama haapa Khazing ahunghmuo aw va yi, nama ca ama pathiypalung yalya ta na hmiekunglie a hringpa na changtaapa zaw cunglie na biekuona hne aa hmangpa na duena a pacu sa paripa tana na cuo.
Ama'a lie na pakaa ta biekuo cate na pathyisapa na biekuona ca na changtaapa cuota pacu sa cate, ataning hing na kuv ta na patling sa.

Caacuonakawta, Vya Abyipa, Israel Khazing, i paa David'a lie bie na kuopa, ‘Nama ta i hmiekunglie na cakuopa haa khata, na saata zaw ta ama luopuv kha a mangpuo pata ama ziy kieca, ‘Israel ming byithude cunglie, i hmiekunglie a tu riypa ci buo'a va ung ciy,’ na tapa kha pacu sa thi tie.
Caacuonakawta, Vya Israel Khazing, na changtaapa i paa David bie na kuopa kha pacu sa thi tie.
“Cuorasala Khazing ca alyi lie hing khy a sa hmisi'a ma? Vuoruo hne aa suo cepa vuoruo lie hmuota naa tlaw'a ma, kama sapa ing lie changchiy ca!
Na changtaapa thlaachuona hne paakiena hing naathlie thi la, Vya Abyipai Khazing ataning na changtaapa una hne thlaachuona ca thyipa thi tie.
‘I ming ca hingpa lie hingna a aw aa,’ na tapa hingpa hmang luo a hyi pata na changtaapa thlaa i chuo tiyta na thyi thena riypata na ming ca chung hne zuo hne hingpa luo hing padyi thi tie.
Na changtaapa hne na cawsaa Israel ming ta hingpa luo a hyi pata paa aca kiepa yi kha thyi thi tie; na awnapa vuoruo taata za thyi la malie a ngiethe thi tie.
“Cawsaa pakhakha ta a ingpaa cunglie kha a sue nakawta biekuona chie pasa sa yi te, hingpa ing chunglie na biekuona thingkaw hmielie a vaw te chie aa sa kieca,

vuoruo taata za thyi la, tue la na changtaapa zaw kha bie za chipa tie yi, a suepa ca a suena kha ama luv cung mamaa lie patlung sa la, aa dangpa ca amaa dangna hne aa ziy pata lawmuo pina ta pacu tie.

“Na cawsaa Israel ming ta nama'a lie suena ama hnyi tiyta cuose, carie tie ta te yi te nama'a luo ama vya kaa tiyta hne ama suena a ngiepachiy yi te, hingpa ing chunglie hing nama'a luo thlaachuo yi te paa aca kie tiy yi ta,
vuoruo lie kha thyipa yi la, na cawsaa Israel ming suena kha a ngiethe yi la, ama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lieta na pipa yi ruo luo kha kaakhyi pakhaa thi tie yi.
Nama'a lie ama sue nakawta nama ta duote yi cate, avuo kha a khaa te khy a saa li tiyta, ama suena kha a ngiepachiy yi te, hingpa hmang luo hing a hyi pata na ming kha ri yi te thlaa ama chuo kieca,
vuoruo lieta thyipa yi la, na changtaapa na cawsaa Israel ming suena kha a ngiethe yi la, nama ta na cawsaa zaw ru ta na pipa yi ruo, na ruo lie kha khy pasaa sa thi tie.

“Ruo chunglie hing cakuo a tlung kie cuose, puvtlung pasana a tlung kie cuose, sakung ruokung cunglie rucaana hne myana a tlung kie cuose, khawbyapa hne lunghmingsyipa ta a tlung kie cuose, ama carie ta ama khypuv khy kha lalaa lie ama hre kie cuose; capa lie ca tuokhaapa puvtlungna hne tuokhaapa pasana a tlung kie cuose;

Israel ming pakha cyicuo ta cuose, ama bangkhuo ta cuose, ama te-angna hne ama palungriethyina kha pachang yi te, hingpa ing luo hing ama buo pazu yi te, tuokhaapa thlaachuona a cuo zaw, tuokhaapa paakiena a cuo zaw ama tue kieca,

na awna hmang vuoruo lieta thyi la, a ngiethe yi la, tue la, ama palung na pachangna haa hne ama ziypa luopuv haa khata pi tie yi, tahematapakieca nama dyina cawsaa pathiypalung lieta khaapama a aw tapa kha a pachang ciy.
Ma mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie na pipa yi ruo lie ama aw chung bangkhuo ta aca ciyzaa the riypa yi ta.
Cahaacata ruohrang ming, na cawsaa Israel ming ta a cuo lipa, na ming thueta luohlaa ruo taata a vawpa ruohrang ming ta,
(tahematapakieca na ming lesyipa, a cahrapa na kuv, hne na pazupa na kuv ama pachang thluo'a nakawta) a vaw pata hingpa ing luo a hyi pata thlaa ama chuo tiyta,

vuoruo na awna lieta thyipa yi la, ruohrang ming ta aca una haa yi khata tuepa thi tie yi, tahematapakieca alyi lie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo ta na cawsaa Israel ming haa hingta na ming kha pachang yi te aca ciyzaa riypa yi ta, hne kama ta i sapa hingpa ing hing na ming ta kupa a cuopa kha ama pachang riypata.

“Na cawsaa zaw kha ama carie a du riypata ama si kieca, tuokhaapa luopuv taata na pathlie zaw yi ta, nama ta naa tlawpa khypuv luo hne na ming riypata i sapa hingpa ing luo hing a hyi yi te Abyipa'a luo kha thlaa ama chuo kieca,
ama thlaachuona hne ama paakiena ca vuoruo taata za thyi la, ama re kha pabang sa tie.

“Iema ta na cunglie ama sue kieca, tahematapakieca ahunghmuo a sue lipa ama aw li nakawta, cakhutaata iema cunglie na hi haa te iema kha carie kuv luo pi yi cate, carie tie ruo aa hlapuv luo cuose, aa ngiena lie cuose sii ta a da yi te,
cuorasala sii ta amaa dana ruo lie kha ama palung kya vuo te, a ngiepachiy yi te, nama kha, ‘Ma sue tli, aa dang lipa re, a pha lipa re na ma hrie tli,’ ta pata paa ca kie yi te,

ama carie tie ruo lie kha ama pathiypalung yalya hne ama ruena yalya ta a ngiepachiy yi te, ama mingchingmingvuo tie na za pipa yi ama ruo hne nama ta naa tlawpa khypuv luo hne na ming cuota i sapa ing luo kha a hyi pata thlaa ama chuo kieca,
na awnapa vuoruo lieta ama thlaachuona hne ama paakiena kha thyipa yi la na cunglie a suepa na cawsaa tie kha pabang thi yi la,
nama'a lie a suepa na cawsaa zaw kha a ngiethe thi tie yi. Cakhutaata iema kha sii ta a dapa tie ta ama ngiechi the riypata ama ming hmungna lie kha kawpacuona hnyi thi tie yi.
(Tahematapakieca iema ca thaa sumyi, Izipt ruo chungtaata na pyakhyipa yi na cawsaa hne na ru tana ama cuo).
Na changtaapa paakiena lie hne na cawsaa Israel tie paakiena lie kha na ming ca padyi thi la, khatiy ningta aca ku zaw yi ta naathlie thi tie yi.

Tahematapakieca Vya Abyipa Khazing, nama ta ma mingchingmingvuo tie kha Izipt taata na pyakhyi tiy yi ta, Moses'a lie bie na kuo tlipa haata, na ru ta ama cuo riypata alyi cawsaa tie bangkhuo'a taata na za pananang tli yi,” a ta.
Solomon ta Abyipa'a luo kha hingpa thlaachuona hne paakiena bangkhuo kha a pihluo diy khutaata, Abyipabiekuona thingkaw luo aa hyi pata avuo luo a kuv pazu te a pakhuv a panenapa taa khata thu te,
a daa te, Israel ming a pungpa bangkhuo kha khuosa ta a ue pathlie te thluechiy a pi yi:
“Ama ta bie a kuopa haa yi ta, a cawsaa Israel ming kha a pahyna cuo a pipa yi Abyipaca thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue; a changtaapa Moses'a taata a ripa, a phapa a biekuo ca kaa kha hmuo patlyi vyi.
Abyipama Khazing ca ma mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie a awpa haa khata kiema'a lie aw sala, malie sise li pata malie thaw thi khah se.

Cuorasala ama ta ma mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie bie a za pipa yi haa khata ama nawbie, ama phungluo, hne ama ziyphung zaw kha ziy pata, a luopuv bangkhuo lie ma cakuo the riypata ma pathiypalung kha ama'a luo malie pachi sa thi se.
Abyipahmiekunglie paa i kienapa bie tie hing Abyipama Khazing athaalie chung zuo ta aw sala, a changtaapa re hne a cawsaa Israel ming re lie kha ningting aa huna haata pabang sa se;
tahematapakieca alyi cung cawsaa bangkhuo ta Abyipaca Khazing ta cuo te, a hrangpa ahunghmuo aw va yi tapa kha ama pachang riypata.
Caacuonakawta a phungluo hne a nawbie kha ziy ung la, ataning nama tuepa haa hingta niema hne niema kha Abyipama Khazing'a luo ca a pi karuv tie ung,” a ta.
Cakhutaata siepahruo hne Israel ming bangkhuo ta Abyipahmiekunglie kha hriykhungrina ama pihluo.
Solomon ta Abyipa'a lie kha aviesaa panaana ta cuetungpa thawkiy thawhning hne tuv thawzakha thawkiy a pihluo. Cahaacata siepahruo hne Israel ming bangkhuo ta Abyipaing kha ama pihluo.

Capa ning ngiethie lie ca Abyipaing hmielie a awpa tlawhmie kha a pathe sa; tahematapakieca Abyipahmiekunglie a awpa daa bienatluophie ca myirue panaana hne sa ta panaana hne aviesaa panaana saathupa zaw cuo khata a cawtuv nakawta, capa lie ca myirue panaana hne sa ta panaana hne aviesaa panaana saathupa zaw kha a pihluo.
Caacuonakawta Solomon hne Israel ming bangkhuo, Lebo-hamath taata Izipt cavaa te lie a awpa cawsaazaapuv khata ning sariy chung Abyipahmiekunglie kha pyi ama tue.

Ning carinapa lieta cawsaa kha a pathlie diy yi; iema ta siepahruo kha thluechiy pi yi te, Abyipata David hne a cawsaa Israel ming cunglie a tuepa phana kawlie khata palungtluo thaaphasa pata ama ing luo kha ama kaa.
Solomon ta Abyipaing hne siepahruo ing hne a sa khingpa bangkhuo kha a sa diy tiyta,
Gibeon lieta ama'a lie a zaa luopa haa khata Abyipaca Solomon'a lie kha a yihningna ta aa luo pakhaa.

Abyipata ama kyihuo khata, “Kama hmiekunglie na tuepa na thlaachuona hne na paakiena kha i thyi tli; na sapa ing kha kama ta pathe sa tli angte capa lie ca i ming kha chuozaa ta i chi tli; i ming hne i pathiypalung ca capa lie ca a aw pari aa.

Nama ta, na paa David a za cakuopa haa khata i hmiekunglie kha cakuo cate, aa dangsa pata hne pathiypalung pathesa pata bie ica pipa bangkhuo kha tue cate, i phungluo hne i ziyphung zaw kha na ziy pata na cakuo kieca,
‘Israel ming byithude cunglie a tu riypa ci buo'a va ung ciy,’ ta pata na paa David'a bie i kuopa haa khata Israel ming cunglie na byithude kha chuozaa ta i pacu sa aa.

“Nama cuose, na saata zaw cuose, kama kha na piese ung cate, nama hmiekunglie i chipa i nawbie hne i phungluo hne i ziyphung zaw kha ziy lipa ung cata, cuorasala khazing hrangpa tie'a luo kha cakuo ung cate, a re hrie ung cate namaa bie kieca,

Israel ming kha iema i pipa yi ruo taata i thaw'a yi; i ming cuota i pathe sapa ing hing i ming hmungna lieta i thaw aa; cakhutaata Israel ca cawsaa bangkhuo hrawlie phungthluvbie hne tue hyalyana bie ta aa li aa.

Hingpa ing hing lungrue chiepa papungpa ta a li'a te, athaalie a cakuopa bangkhuo ta ama nang-uo'a te, ama hmya maasue'a yi te, ‘Khaapanakawma Abyipata hingpa ruo hne hingpa cawsaa tie cunglie hing hing haapa hmang hing a tue'a e?’ ama ta aa.

Cakhutaata iema ta, ‘Tahematapakieca a mingchingmingvuo tie kha Izipt taata a pyakhyipa yi Abyipaama Khazing kha thaw pata, khazing hrangpa tie re kha hrie yi te amaa bie nakaw tana, Abyipata hingpa rana hing ama cunglie a patlung sa,’ amaa ta aa,” a ta.
Solomon ta Abyipaing hne siepahruo ing, ing hning a sanapa ca kung kiy aa rukhyi.
Tair siepahruo Hiram ta Solomon kha sidar thing, saipres thing hne siy a khing zaa ta a pi. Siepahruo Solomon ta Galilee ruo chunglie khy kiy kha a pi.
Cuorasala Tair taata Hiram ca Solomon ta a pipa khypuv khy kiy kha mang riypata aa vaw tiyta a palung tluo vyi.
Caacuonakawta ama ta, “I uvnupa, ina pipa ciy khy tie hing tuokhaapa khy tama ama cuo?” a ta. Caacuonakawta ataning tepa hingta, Kabul ta pata ama u.
Cuorasala Hiram ta siepahruo kha siy talen zakha suokiy a za pi.
Siepahruo Solomon ta Abyipaing hne ama ing hne Millo hne Jerusalem dungkhuo lungruetlepie hne Hazor hne Megiddo, hne Gezer
(Izipt siepahruo Faro ta Gezer kha sihnue te, la te myi ta a rue, khypuv chunglie a awpa Kanaan ming kha thie yi te, a sacanung, Solomon napuvnung kha thukhyi ta a pi;
caacuonakawta Solomon ta Gezer kha a sa hru), Aa ne Beth-horon,
Baalath, ruocaapa lie ruo lieta a awpa Tamar,

Solomon ta a hnyipa chechiy chinapa khypuv tie, aruole cuota khypuv tie, aruo rieka cuota khypuv tie kha a sa; Jerusalem, Lebanon hne ama ta a pepa ruo bangkhuo lie Solomon ta a sa khingpa tuokhaapa a cuo zaw a sa.
Amor ming, Hit ming, Periz ming, Hiv ming, hne Jebus ming chungtaata aa ngaapa, Israel cawsaa ta a cuo lipa bangkhuo,
Israel ming ta ama para diy khu lipa ruo chunglie aa ngaapa ama ciypathla tie, capa tie ca Solomon ta re pahriesapa sii phuv ta tue yi te, ataning tepa hingta cahaacata ama cuo.
Cuorasala Israel ming ca Solomon ta cahaacata tue va yi; iema ca rieka, abyi, riekabyilepa, riekabyi, hne aruole uvtuv hne aruo rieka uvtuv tie ta ama cuo.
Re a hriepa tie a uvtuv, Solomon re cunglieta byi cepa tie ca zapangaa sawngaa ta ama cuo.
Cuorasala Faro sacanung ca David khypuv taa khata ama cuota Solomon ta a sapapa a ing luo kha sithaw te, cakhutaata Millo kha a sa.
Abyipacuota a sapa bienatluophie lie kha Solomon ta myirue panaana hne aviesaa panaana kha kung kha ta yi thung pihluo taw te, Abyipahmiekunglie rangpa-ue kha a pihluo taw. Cahaacata ing ca a palang.
Solomon ta Edom ruo chunglie, Riyliy Sepa ngiekuo hne aa ngienapa Eloth athaalie, Ezion-geber lie kha tiypalaw a sa.
Hiram ta a changtaapa tie, riyliy kaw a pachangpa tie kha Solomon changtaapa tie hne re hrie hne riypata a paphya yi.
Iema ca Ofir luo kha si yi te, siy talen zapaliy suokiy kha Siepahruo Solomon'a luo ama phya.
Siepahruonung Sheba ta Solomon mingpathuona kha a thyi tiyta (Abyipaming kawlieta a ming a pathuo), a ruvsapa biehiehriyna ta dyapasya riypata aa vaw.

Ama ca Jerusalem luo kha rangpa-ue a phyapa kala-uv, hne siy a hluvsa, hne alung muosungpa tie, hne hnangziytuv a hluvsa hne khata aa vaw; Solomon'a luo a pha tiyta, a palung lie a awpa bangkhuo kha a chang.
Solomon ta a biehiehriyna bangkhuo kha a palie diy; siepahruo ta a pachang lipa hne a pasiepa khu lipa suokha hmuo aw vyi.
Siepahruonung Sheba ta Solomon singna bangkhuo, a sapa ing,

a cabya lie sa, aa byi tie amaa tuzya, a changtaapa tie cawsaa mangsangnazya, ama cawsie, panuo a cyituv tie, Abyipaing lie a pihluopa myirue panaana, tapa tie kha a hmung tiyta a nang a uo hringhruo.
Caacuonakawta siepahruo kyihuo khata, “I ruo chunglieta i thyipa na re patlungpa hne na singna hing a hmisipa tana a cuo,
cuorasala kama hrahring a vaw angte i ming ta i hmungpuo hluo li ca zang va ang. A che hmuo na za chang va yi; na singna hne na hnyirungna ta i thyipa kha a lawpakhung.
Na napuv zaw hing thluechiypa tana ama cuo! Naa thaalie aw pari yi te na singna bie a thyi paripa hingpa na changtaapa zaw hing thluechiypa tana ama cuo!

Nama kha ca tlechuo te Israel ming byithude cunglie caa patupa Abyipana Khazing ca thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue! Tahematapakieca Abyipata Israel ca chuozaa ta due te, nama ca biedangpa hne adangna ta a uv riypata siepahruo ta aca tue tli,” a ta.

Cakhutaata ama ta siepahruo kha siy talen zakha suokiy, rangpa-ue a hluvsa, hne alung muosungpa zaw tapa tie kha a pi. Sheba siepahruonung ta Solomon a pipa zaa ta a hluvpa rangpa-ue a ngie pakhaa buo va tli.
Ca hlyitaw taata, Hiram tiypalaw tie, Ofir taata siy a vya phyapa khata Ofir taa khata almuk thing a hluvsa hne alung muosungpa zaw kha ama vya phya.

Siepahruo ta almuk thing cata Abyipaing hne siepahruo ing dyina tung zaw kha a tue, hlaa a sapa tie cuota tingtuo hne tingtuolepa zaw kha a tue; almuk thing ca zaa nanaa ca ataning tepa hingta a ngie buo va tli, hmung buopa zaw ta cuo va tli.
Siepahruo Solomon ca ta a pahya thiy ta a pi hlyitaw taata Sheba siepahruonung a ripa, a khingpa bangkhuo kha a pi. Cakhutaata a changtaapa zaw hne khata a ruo luo kha a kaa.
Kung kha chunglie Solomon'a luo a vya chiypa siy aa riyna ca talen zacaruv sawcaruv suocaruv ta a cuo.
Capa hlyitaw taata sung a palina, hne sung a palipa tie'a taata cuose, Arabia siepahruo tie bangkhuo hne ruo-uvtuv tie'a taa zaw khata aa ngie kalie.
Siepahruo Solomon ta a de ta depa siy ta phya a lepa zahning a tue; phya a lepa suokha lieta siy shekel zacaruv a chuo.
Ama ta a de ta depa siy ta phya zathung a tue; capa phya suokha lie ca ta siy mina suothung a chuo.
Siepahruo ta byithude lesapa suokha zaw kha ale nue ta tue te siy pha cepa ta a pakhuv.
Byithude ca hlyidaw chuo caruv a hnyi. Byithude a hnangluo ca a pungkalung te, a tunapa a kuo vyicuo lie buo khangna tluo aw te, capa buo khangna athaalie ca ta chingde zuv suohning aa daa.
Hlyidaw chuo caruv lie, a daw vyicuo lie kha chingde sakha law ta a daa te, a bangkhuo ta chingde sahraa hlyihning aa daa. Khaapa pena lie hmuo cahaapa ca tue pata cuo vyi.

Siepahruo Solomon panuo bangkhuo ca siy ta tuepa cuo te, Lebanon Atuv Ing biphie bangkhuo ca siy pathepa ta tuepa a cuo, ngu ta tuepa suokha hmuo aw vyi, Solomon chuo ning ca ngu ca khaapatahmuo ri va yi.

Tahematapakieca Solomon ta riyliy lie kha Tarshish tiypalaw phuv hnyi te Hiram tiypalaw phuv hne khata a sihne taw. Tarshish tiypalaw ca kung thung ta yi kha vya chiy te siy, ngu, ale nue, hne awtaw kha ama vya phya taw.
Cahaacata Siepahruo Solomon ta hnyirungna hne singna lie kha alyi cung siepahruo bangkhuo a lawpakhung diy yi.
Alyicung cawsaa bangkhuo khata Khazing ta a palung chunglie a chipa singna kha naathlie riypata Solomon kha ama pangie.
Iema mekaa cata lasaw a vya phya yi te, siy hne ngu ta tuepa chechiy zaw, cawsie zaw, cehre zaw, rangpa-ue zaw, aruo zaw, hne laa kaapie zaw kha, kung kha hnang kung kha ta a hluvsa ama pi.
Solomon ta aruole hne aruo zaw ca a pahmya yi; ama ta aruole thawkha zapaliy hne aruo thawhraa hlyihning a hnyi. Capa tie ca aruole khypuv tie lie hne Jerusalem lie siepahruo'a lie kha a chi.
Siepahruo ta Jerusalem lie kha ngu ca alung zaa ta cuose, sidar thing ca Shefelah lieta saikamor thing zaa ta cuose a hluv pata a tue.
Solomon ta a calyipa aruo zaw ca Izipt hne Kue taata a cuo, siepahruo sungpalituv tie khata Kue lie kha a muo pi yi te ama calyi taw.

Izipt taa khata aruole suokha ca ngu shekel zacaruv ta cuose, aruo sakha ca zakha sawngaa ta cuose calyi yi te, siepahruo sungpalituv tie khata Hit siepahruo hne Aram siepahruo tie'a luo kha ama zaa pachaa.
Solomon ta Faro sacanung hne khata ruohrang canung a hluvsa kha a khing yi: Moab, Ammon, Edom, Sidon, hne Hit canung zaw kha a khing yi.

Abyipata Israel ming kyihuo ta, “Niema ca iema hne khata a chiy a hie'a va ung ciy, iema zaw niema kha ca chiy ca hie ra khah yi se; tahematapakieca iema ta nama pathiypalung kha ama khazing'a luo aca maa hrahring'a yi,” a tapa mingphang tie kha Solomon ta khing yi te aa patuv pari yi.
A napuv zaw ca siepahruo sacanung zasariy hne nungthang zathung ta ama cuo; a napuv zaw ca ta a pathiypalung kha luo ama papie sa.

Tahematapakieca Solomon kha a macuo tiyta, a napuv zaw khata a pathiypalung kha khazing hrangpa luo ama papie sa; a paa David pathiypalung haa khata Abyipaa Khazing'a luo kha a pathiypalung a hmang vyi.
Tahematapakieca Solomon ta Sidon ming khazingnung Astarte hne Ammon ming khazing duv aa chiypa Milkom kha a ziy yi.
Caacuonakawta Solomon ta Abyipahmiekunglie a pha lipa kha a tue, a paa David ta a za tuepa haa khata Abyipakha pathiypalung hmisi ta ziy vyi.
Cakhutaata Solomon ta Jerusalem ningchiyluo tluo lie kha Moab ming khazing duv aa chiypa Khemosh cuo hne Ammon ming khazing duv aa chiypa Molek cuo khata khahrungtluobu suokha a tuepa yi.
Ama ta ama khazing tie kha rangpa-ue pakhuv yi te hriykhungrina a pihluopa ruohrang ming a napuv zaw bangkhuo cuo khata cahaacata a tue.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Solomon cunglie kha a hi a haa, tahematapakieca a pathiypalung kha AbyipaIsrael Khazing'a taata a pie. Hingpa kaw hneta aa patuvpa hingta,
ama'a lie yi hning te ta a luo te, ama ta khazing hrangpa tie a ziy li riypa kha bie a pi raalaa pata Abyipata bie a pipa kha ziy vyi.

Caacuonakawta Abyipata Solomon kyihuo khata, “Hingpa hing na pathiypalung ta cuo te nama ta ica pipa biekuona hne i phungluo kha na ziy li nakawta nama'a taata pena hing thlaachi diy'a angte na changtaapa kha i pi aa.
Cuorasala na paa David kawlieta na hring chung ta ca hingpa hing tue'a va ang; na sacapaa chuo liena i thlaachi diy aa.
Cadyiseca pena yalya hingta ca thlaachi diy'a va ang; tahematapakieca kama ta i tlawpa Jerusalem hne i changtaapa David kawlieta na sacapaa kha mingphang phang kha ca i pi aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipa ta Edom ming Hadad kha Solomon a du riypata a pathu sa; ama ca Edom ruo siepahruo phang ta a cuo.
Tahematapakieca Edom lie David a aw ning kha, riekabyi le cepa Joab ta a thiypa paby riypata a khaw ning kha, Edom lie capaa mekaa kha a thie yi,
(Tahematapakieca Joab hne Israel ming ca Edom ming capaa bangkhuo a thie diy hluo li yi capa lie ca thla caruv ama aw);
cuorasala Hadad ca a paa changtaapa ta a cuopa Edom ming chekha hne khata Izipt luo amaa ruo. Capa cuo ning ca ama ca haatiyta tana a cuo kalie.
Iema ca Midian taata a tha yi te Paran luo ama pha; Aram taa khata cawsaa kha a chiyle yi te Izipt lie Izipt siepahruo Faro'a luo kha ama pha, ama ta ing a pi, sa a ring, ruo a pi.
Hadad ca Faro hmiephaa kha khuosa ta a hmung, caacuonakawta ama ta Siepahruonung Tahpenes nutanung kha napuv ta a pi.
Tahpenes nutanung ca ama hne cata sacapaa Genubath kha sa te, Tahpenes ta Faro ing lie kha ahnung pathlie sa te, Genubath ca Faro saata zaw hne khata Faro ing lie kha a aw ra.

Izipt lie kha Hadad ta David ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie a zie tli te riekabyi le cepa Joab zaw a thiy tlipa kha a thyi tiyta, Faro kyihuo khata, “I ruo luo i si the riypata, na pasi sa tie,” a ta.
Cuorasala Faro ta ama kyihuo khata, “Na ruo luo si riypa khue na vaapa hing kama'a lie na awpa hingta khaapama na cuota a bu?” a ta. Ama ta, “A bupa aw vyi, na pasi sa thi tie,” a ta.
Khazing ta Solomon cuota carie hrangpa pakha a pathu sa; ama ca a byipaapa, Zobah Siepahruo Hadadezer'a taata a ruopa Eliada sacapaa Rezon ta a cuo.

David ta cawsaa a thie khutaa yi khata, ama ta a cahriylie cawsaa kha pakiy yi te, damie tie luv ta a li te, Damaskas luo kha si yi te capa lie ca khy ama sa, cakhutaa cata Damaskas lie ca siepahruo ta ama pacuo sa.
Ama ca Solomon chuo chung bangkhuo kha Israel ming carie ta a cuo, Hadad ta a tuepa haa khata ama rie a pathyi yi, ama ca Siria ming cunglie kha siepahruo cuo te, Israel ming kha a hue yi.
Solomon changtaapa ta a cuopa Zeredah khy ming Efraim ming, Nebat sacapaa Jeroboam, Zeruah ama tapa nunghlyinung sacapaa khata siepahruo ca aa du.
Siepahruo aa duna kaw ca a rawluo haa hingta a cuo. Solomon ta Millo kha sa te a paa David khypuv lungruetlepie dungkhuo aa dung linapa kha a pahruv.
Jeroboam ca hmang a tue khu ciemuopa ta cuo te, Solomon ta satliepa ca cawsaa te a maapa tana a cuo tapa kha a hmung tiyta, Josef chung ta ama hrie riypa re pahrie sapa tie uvtuv khata a chi.
Capa cuo lie ca Jeroboam ca Jerusalem taata a pya tiyta luopuv lie kha Shilon ming profet Ahijah ta a hmung. Ahijah ca caw thaapa kha aa tue. Iema pahning ca ruo lie kha iema seta ama aw.
Ahijah ta aa hryipa caw thaapa kha patuv te che hraa hlyihning ta a thlaa.

Cakhutaata ama ta Jeroboam kha: Nama huota che hraa kha a la tie; tahematapakieca AbyipaIsrael Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri, “Mang tie, pena hing Solomon kuv taata thlaachi'a nang tli angte, nama kha mingphang phang hraa ica pi aa.
Israel ming mingphang bangkhuo chungtaata i tlawpa khypuv Jerusalem kawlie hne i changtaapa David kawlieta ama huota mingphang phang kha aa ngaa aa.

Capa ca ama ta kama kha na thaw te, Sidon ming khazingnung Astarte, Moab ming khazing Khemosh, hne Ammon ming khazing Milkom kha abie yi te, a paa David haata i luopuv kha ziy li pata hne i ming hmungna lie a phapa kha tue li pata i phungluo hne i ziyphung kha a ziy li nakaw tana a cuo.
Cuorasala pena ca ama'a taata a bangkhuo ta la'a va ang, tahematapakieca kama ta i tlawpa, i nawbie hne i phungluo kha a ziypa i changtaapa David kawlieta a hring chung bangkhuo ca uvtuv ta i tue aa.
Cuorasala a sacapaa'a taata pena kha la'a angte nama ica pi aa, mingphang phang hraa kha.
Cakhutaata i changtaapa David ta i ming china riypata i tlawpa khypuv Jerusalem lie i hmiekunglie myi-ing a hnyi pari the riypata a sacapaa kha mingphang phang kha ca i pi aa.
Nama kha ca la'a angte, na pathiypalung ta a khingpa bangkhuo cunglie kha uvna hnyi'a cate, Israel ming siepahruo ta na cuo aa.

Nama ta i changtaapa David ta a za tuepa haa khata ica pipa bie bangkhuo kha ziy cate, i luopuv kha ziy cate, i phungluo hne i nawbie zaw kha ziy pata i ming hmungna lie a phapa kha na tue kieca nama'a lie aw'a angte, David cuota i sapa haa khata a cupa ingchungkhue ca sapa'a angte Israel kha nama ica pi aa.
Tahematapakieca hingpa kawlie hingta kama ta David ciypathla kha duote'a yi angte, cuorasala chuozaa cuota cuo vyi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Solomon ta Jeroboam kha thie riypata a huv; cuorasala Jeroboam ca Izipt luo, Izipt siepahruo Shishak'a luo kha a catlisa pata a ruo te, Solomon a thiyna te khata Izipt lie a aw.
Solomon ta a tuepa, aa tuo kaliepa bangkhuo ca Solomon Rehriena Caa-uv liena ama cape cuo va ma?
Solomon ta Israel ming bangkhuo cunglie, Jerusalem lie siepahruo a cuona cuo ca kung sawliy ta a cuo.
Solomon ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a zie te a paa David khypuv lie kha ama paby; cakhutaata a sacapaa Rehoboam ta ama kha aa thle.
