Rehoboam ca Shekhem luo kha a si, tahematapakieca ama kha siepahruo ta tue riypata Israel ming bangkhuo ta Shekhem luo kha ama si nakawta a cuo.
Nebat sacapaa Jeroboam ta capa ca a thyi tiyta (tahematapakieca ama ca Solomon'a taata aa ruo yalya khata Izipt lie kha a aw kalie), Izipt taa khata a vya kaa.
Cakhutaata iema ta ama kha ama ku; cakhutaata Jeroboam hne Israel ming aa pungpa bangkhuo ca Rehoboam'a luo kha cakuo yi te,
“Na paa ta ma hmang malie a pariy. Caacuonakawta na paa ta re ruvpa hne hmangriypa ma cunglie a khangpa hing malie pahypa vie la na re ma hrie aa,” ama ta.
Ama ta iema kyihuo khata, “Va kaa caw ung la, ning thung khutaata a vaw pakhaa tie ung,” a ta yi. Caacuonakawta cawsaa ca ama kaa diy.

Cakhutaata Siepahruo Rehoboam ta a paa Solomon a za hring ningta aa thaalie re zaa hriepa macuo tie kha ruena hie yi te, “Hingpa cawsaa tie bie palie riypa hing tuokhaatama ruena ina pi'a ung ciy?” a ta yi.
Iema ta, “Ataning hing hingpa cawsaa tie changtaapa ta cuo la, ama re kha hrie la, ama bie na palie tiy yi ta bie phapa kha na ri kieca, iema ca chuozaa ta na changtaapa tana ama cuo aa,” ama ta.
Cuorasala macuo tie ta ama pipa ruena kha siysaa ri li pata a khuvhyi ama'a lie re a hriepa mingnu tie kha ruena aa hie yi.

Ama ta iema kyihuo khata, “Kama'a lie, ‘Na paa ta ma cunglie a khangpa hmangriypa hing malie pahypa vie tie,’ naa tapa hingpa cawsaa tie hing tuokhaatama ma palie'a ung tapa kha ruena na pi tie ung,” a ta yi.
Ama khuvhyi ta a cuopa mingnu tie ta, “'Na paa ta ma hmang malie a pariy, cuorasala nama ta malie pahypa vie tie,’ caa tapa cawsaa tie hing, ‘I kuvtie ca i paa sesie laata a chaa vie.

Caacuonakawta ata hing ca i paa ta hmangriy aca khangpa lie yi kha kama ta hmangriy ica khang chiy vie'a yi. I paa ta sungpe ta aca pasiypa-ya yi, cuorasala kama ta ca tluociekuo tana ica pasiypa-ya'a yi,’ ta tie yi,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta siepahruo ta, “Ning thungna lie kama'a luo a vaw pakhaa mya ung,” a tapa haata, Jeroboam hne cawsaa bangkhuo ca Rehoboam'a luo kha a ning thungna lieta amaa vaw.
Siepahruo ta cawsaa tie kha thyi khing a aw lipa bie ta a palie yi. Ama ta macuo tie ruena pipa kha siysaa ri li pata,

satlie tie ta ruena ama pipa, “I paa ta nama hmang aca pariy yi, cuorasala kama ta nama hmang kha ica chachiy'a yi; I paa ta sungpe ta aca pasiypa-ya yi, cuorasala kama ta ca tluociekuo tana ica pasiypa-ya'a yi,” tapa bie kha iema'a lie a ri.

Caacuonakawta siepahruo ta cawsaa tie bie kha naathlie vyi, tahematapakieca Abyipata Shilon ming Ahijah kha hmuo pata Nebat sacapaa Jeroboam'a lieta a ripa bie kha patling sa riypata Abyipata hing haa hingta a tue pata a cuo.

Israel ming ta siepahruo ta ima bie naathlie vyi tapa kha ama hmung tiyta, cawsaa ta siepahruo kha, David chunglie khaapa cuvu ma ma hnyi? Jesse sacapaa cunglie kiema ta ru hnyi vapuv Vya Israel, nama thluodaa luo kaa diy tie ung! Vya David, na ingchungkhue ca nama ta mangchiy tie,” ama ta. Caacuonakawta Israel ming ca ama thluodaa luo kha ama kaa.
Cuorasala Rehoboam ca Judah khy tie lieta a awpa Israel ming cunglie kha siepahruo a cuo.

Re pahrie sapa tie uvtuv ta a cuopa Adoram kha siepahruo ta a pathlie ca Israel ming bangkhuo ta alung ta ama vaasa. Cakhutaata siepahruo Rehoboam ca aruole kha a khang te Jerusalem luo kha a catlisa pata aa ruo.
Caacuonakawta Israel ming ta David ingchungkhue ca ataning tepa hingta amaa du.

Israel ming bangkhuo ta Jeroboam na a vya kaa tapa kha ama thyi tiyta ama kha amaa pungna luo ku yi te Israel ming bangkhuo cunglie siepahruo ta ama pacuo sa. Judah phang ta li pata David ingchungkhue kha a ziypa pakha hmuo aw va yi.

Rehoboam ca Jerusalem luo a pha tiyta, Israel ming ingchungkhue kha a du pata Solomon sacapaa Rehoboam pena kha padaa pakhaa riypata Judah phang bangkhuo hne Benjamin phang tie kha pahmya yi te, rieka tingkha thaw sawcari ama ta.
Cuorasala Khazing cawsaapa Shemaiah luo kha Khazing bie a zuv te:
Solomon sacapaa Judah Siepahruo Rehoboam, hne Judah hne Benjamin ingchungkhue bangkhuo hne aa ngaapa cawsaa tie kyihuo khata,

“Abyipana hing haa hingta a ta, nama tieriy ta a cuopa Israel ming kha tuv riypata sithaw'a va ung ciy. Nama ing cyicuo luo kha kaa diy tie ung, tahematapakieca hingpa hmang hing kama'a taa tana a cuo,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Abyipa bie ca naathlie yi te, Abyipabie haa khata ing luo ama kaa.
Cakhutaata Jeroboam ta Efraim tluocung ruo lieta Shekhem kha sa te capa lie ca a aw; cakhutaata capa taa cata pya te Penuel kha a sa.
Cakhutaata Jeroboam ta ama hne ama kha, “Ata hing ca pena hing David ingchungkhue luona a phasa pata a vya kaa pakhaa aa,” a ta.

Hingpa cawsaa tie hingta Jerusalem lie Abyipaing luo kha hriykhungrina pihluo riypata ama si kieca, hingpa cawsaa tie pathiypalung ca ama byipaapa Judah siepahruo Rehoboam'a luo kha a kaa pakhaa aa; kama kha na thie'a yi te, Judah siepahruo Rehoboam'a luo kha ama kaa pakhaa aa,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta siepahruo ta ruena hie yi te siy cuetaata sahning a tue. Cawsaa zaw kyihuo khata, “Niema ta luo pasiypuv si ung cate Jerusalem luo nama khaw. Vya Israel, hingpa lie hing Izipt ruo taata caa vya pyakhyipa yi nama khazing a aw hing,” a ta.
Ama ta suokha kha Bethel lie chi te, a hrangpa suo kha kha Dan lieta a chi.
Cakhutaata capa ca suena ta aa li, tahematapakieca cawsaa ta Bethel lie a awpa'a luo kha a bie riypata si yi te, a hrangpa Dan lie a awpa'a luo te khata ama si.
Ama ta khahrungtluobu tie cunglie zaw kha ing sa te, Levi ming ta a cuo lipa tie kha tluobyi a pahrie sa yi.

Jeroboam ta thla cari thlaa ning hraa hlyipangaana lie kha Judah ruo chunglie a awpa pyi haapa kha tue riypata khuekhuo te, bienatluophie lie kha pihluona a tue; cahaacata Bethel lie kha a tue, ama ta a tuepa cuetaata kha hriykhungrina a pihluo. Khahrung tluobu lie cuota tluobyi tie kha Bethel lieta a chi yi.
Bethel lie ama ta a tuepa bienatluophie luo kha amata tah a thlipa thla cari thlaa ning carina lieta khaw te Israel ming cuota pyi suokha kha pacusa te, bienatluophie lie kha rangpa-ue a pihluo.
Jeroboam ca rangpa-ue pihluo riypata bienatluophie athaalie aa daa ning kha Khazing cawsaa pakha ca Abyipabie haa khata Judah taata Bethel luo kha a vaw te,

Abyipabie ta bienatluophie kha a du pata u te, “Vya bienatluophie, bienatluophie, Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: ‘David ingchungkhue lieta sacapaa pakha, a ming Josiah ama tapa kha puv'a te, nama cunglie rangpa-ue caa pihluopa khahrungtluobu lie tluobyi tie kha nama cunglie kha hriykhungrina ta hmuo'a yi te, cawsaa ruv ca nama cunglie hing rue pata a cuo aa,’ a ta,” a ta.

Capa ning lie ca ta pamangsana suokha pi te, “Hingpa hingna Abyipata a ripa pamangsana ta a cuo: ‘Bienatluophie ca pacing pata cuo'a te, a cunglieta a awpa buvcuo ca lyi pata ama cuo aa,’ a ta,” a ta.

Khazing cawsaapa ta Bethel lie bienatluophie a du pata a upa kha siepahruo ta a thyi tiyta, Jeroboam ta bienatluophie taa cata a kuv va pazuo te, “Ama kha patuv tie ung!” a ta. Cuorasala a va pazuopa a kuv ca caa te a da pakhaa the va tli.
Khazing cawsaapa'a lie pipa Abyipabie ta pamangsana a ripa haata bienatluophie zaw ca cing te, bienatluophie lie buvcuo ca aa lyi diy.

Siepahruo ta Khazing cawsaapa kyihuo khata, “I kuv hing a tluo pakhaa riypata Abyipana Khazing ca paa na kiepa la, thlaa na chuopa tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Khazing cawsaapa ca ta Abyipakha paakiepa te, siepahruo kuv ca ahluo haa khata a tluo pakhaa.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ca ta Khazing cawsaapa kyihuo khata, “Kama'a luo, ing luo a vaw la sa vya ning tie, cakhutaata lasaw ica pi aa,” a ta.
Cuorasala Khazing cawsaapa ta siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Na pena khingkhuo ina pi zaw cata nama'a luo a vaw'a va ang; capa hmang lie ca sa zaw ning'a va ang, tiy zaw dang ra'a va ang.
Tahematapakieca Abyipabie ta cahaacata naw na pi te: Sa ning'a vaciy, tiy zaw dang'a vaciy, naa vawnapa luopuv taa zaw ta kaa'a vaciy, ina ta,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta luopuv hrangpa kha ziy pata kaa te, Bethel luo aa vawnapa luopuv kha ziy pata kaa vyi.

Bethel lieta profet macuopa pakha a aw. A sacapaa zaw chungtaata pakha ta a vaw te capa ning lieta Khazing cawsaapa ta Bethel lie a tuepa bangkhuo kha a chang; siepahruo'a lie a ripa bie zaw kha ama paa ca ama chang.
Ama paa ta iema kyihuo khata, “Khaapa luopuv kha ziy te ma a si?” a ta yi. Cakhutaata Judah taata a vawpa Khazing cawsaapa ta a ziypa luopuv kha a sacapaa zaw ca ta ama chang.
Cakhutaata ama ta a sacapaa zaw kyihuo khata, “Laa kha kedie na padiepa tie ung,” a ta yi. Caacuonakawta laa kha kedie padiepa yi te aa khang,
Khazing cawsaapa kha a cade te mathliy kung rawlie a zaa tupa khata a hmung. Capa paa kyihuo cata, “Judah taata a vawpa Khazing cawsaa ta na cuo ma?” a ta. Capa paa ca ta, “I cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata ama ta capa paa kyihuo cata, “Ing luo, kama'a luo kha a vaw la sa ning tie,” a ta.
Cuorasala capa paa ca ta, “Nama hneta kaa khu va ang, nama'a luo zaw a ngie khu va ang; hingpa hmang lie hing nama hneta sa ning pata tiy dang khu'a va ang;
tahematapakieca Abyipabie ta na chang te: Khapa lie kha sa ning li'apa cata tiy zaw dang'a vaciy, naa vawnapa luopuv taa zaw ta kaa'a vaciy, ina ta,” a ta.

Cakhutaata ama ta capa paa kyihuo cata, “Kama zaw hing nama haata profet tana i cuo ra, Abyipabie ta avuoming pakha ta na chang te: Sa kha ning te tiy a dang riypata na ing luo kha kaakhyi tie, ina ta,” a ta. Cuorasala ama kha a dung pata a cuo.
Cakhutaata Khazing cawsaapa ca ama hne cata kaa te, a ing lie kha sa ning te tiy a dang.
Cabya lie amaa tupa khata, a kaakhyipa profet'a luo kha Abyipabie a zuv te,
Judah taata a vawpa cawsaapa'a lie kha, “Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Nama ca Abyipa bie kha naathlie lipa cata Abyipana Khazing ta aca pipa Abyipanawbie kha ziy lipa cata,
cuorasala vya kaa cate, ‘Sa ning'a vaciy, tiy dang'a vaciy,’ aca tanapa hmang lie sa ning cate tiy na dang nakawta, na pangpa hing na mingchingmingvuo tie thluo luo pha'a vyi, a ta,” ta pata a u.
Khazing cawsaapa ta sa ning te tiy a dang khutaa khata ama huo ca ta a vya kaakhyipa profetpa laa kha kedie ama padiepa.
Cakhutaata luopuv lie a silepa khata chingde ta a taw te a sie. A pangpa ca luopuv kielie kha thaw te, laa ca capa lie ca aa daa; chingde zaw ca a riyy athaalie ca aa daa ra.
Luopuv kielie riyy ama thawpa hne a riyy athaalie chingde aa daapa kha luopuv lie a sipa tie ta ama hmung. Cakhutaata a vaw yi te, profet macuopa awnapa khy luo kha ama vya chang.

Luopuv taata a vya kaakhyipa profetpa ta capa ca a thyi tiyta, “Abyipabie a ziy lipa Khazing cawsaapa tana a cuo; caacuonakaw tana Abyipata ama kha chingde a pi, ama'a lie a changpa Abyipabie haa khata caphi te a thie,” a ta.
Cakhutaata a sacapaa zaw kyihuo khata, “Laa kha kedie na padiepa tie ung,” a ta yi. Caacuonakawta kedie ama padiepa.
Va si te, luopuv kielie ama thawpa a riyy hne a riyy kielie laa hne chingde amaa daapa kha a hmung. Chingde ta a riyy kha ce li pata laa zaw kha sie vyi.
Profetpa ta Khazing cawsaapa riyy ca la te, laa cungluo kha khang te, muochie sa riypa hne paby riypata khypuv luo kha a sikhyi.
A riyy ca ama huopa thluo lie kha paby te, muochie sa yi te, “Vya, i uvnupa!” a ta.
A paby khutaata, a sacapaa zaw kyihuo khata, “Kama i thiy tiyta, Khazing cawsaapa pabynapa thluo lie hing na paby ung la, i ruv kha ama ruv athaalie hing chi mya ung.
Tahematapakieca Abyipabie thueta Bethel bienatluophie hne Samaria ruo chung khy lie a awpa khahrungtluobu ing bangkhuo kaw a ripa bie bangkhuo kha a vya cuo hmisi aa,” a ta.

Capa hmang khutaa zaw ca ta Jeroboam ca hmang pha lipa a tuepa kha kaase hlyi vyi, cuorasala cawsaa zaw chung taa khata tluobyi a cuo khingpa tie kha khahrungtluobu lie tluobyi riypata a pathe sa tyly yi.
Hingpa hmang hing Jeroboam ingchungkhue cuota suena ta a li te, ama ciy a pahlituv hne chuelyi taata a parapa yi ta aa li.
Capa cuo ning kha Jeroboam sacapaa Abijah kha a pasa.

Jeroboam ta a napuvnung kyihuo khata, “Cakuo la Jeroboam napuv na cuopa kha aca pachang li riypa yi ta a cuo la Shiloh luo kha si tie; hingpa cawsaa zaw cunglie siepahruo tana na cuo aa naa tapa profet Ahijah khana capa lie ca a aw.
Viechuo tluo hraa, chuore chekha, hne khyitiy thyi kha kha a cyi la si tie; ama ta haatiypa cunglie khaapama a cuo aa tapa kha aca chang aa,” a ta.
Jeroboam napuvnung ta cahaacata a tue; a tha te Shiloh luo kha si te, Ahijah ing luo kha a pha. Ahijah ca a ming hmung va tli, tahematapakieca a macuo tli nakawta a ming a zing.

Cuorasala Abyipata Ahijah kha chang te, “Jeroboam napuvnung ca a sacapaa kawlieta na pachang li riypata a cuo te nama'a luo aa vaw, tahematapakieca a sacapaa a pasa nakawta a cuo. Hing haa hingta ama kha na chang aa,” a ta. A vya pha tiyta canung hrangpa haata aa cuo.

Cuorasala chiypakaa lie aa vawlepa pu kha Ahijah ta a thyi tiyta, “Jeroboam napuvnung a zaa ngie tie, khaapanakawma canung hrangpa haata naa cuo? Tahematapakieca nama kha thuohlaa chiepa chang riypa tana chang pata i cuo.
Si la Jeroboam kha chang tie, ‘Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ta: Nama ca cawsaa hrawtaata ca cyicalang angte, i cawsaa zaw luochiytuv ta ica tue.

Pena kha nama pi riypata David ingchungkhue'a taata i chechi; cuorasala nama ca i nawbie kha ziy te a pathiypalung yalya ta naa ziypa, i hmungna lieta hmang phapa dyi a tuepa i changtaapa David haata ta vaciy.
Cuorasala na hmiekunglie a awpa bangkhuo cunglie kha a pha lipa tue cate na cuota khazing hrangpa kha naa tue, kuvtuezuv tie kha patle cate, i hi na pahaa cate hnangluo ina chaw ciy.

Caacuonakawta Jeroboam ingchungkhue cunglie kha pha lina patlung sa'a angte, Jeroboam'a taa hingta capaa bangkhuo hya a zang lipa cuose, hya a zangpa cuose pahli diy'a yi angte cawsaa ta ii kha a tlung diyna te ama rue hyalyapa haata Jeroboam ingchungkhue kha i rue diy'a yi.
Jeroboam cawsaa ta a cuopa ca khypuv chunglie a thiy kieca uv ta ce'a yi te, ruo lie a thiypa kha pavaa ta a ning'a yi; tahematapakieca Abyipana a ri tli,’ a ta.
Caacuonakawta a thu la na ing luo si tie. Na phyi ta khypuv chung a tlawpa hneta haatiy kha a thiy aa.

Israel ming bangkhuo ta a muochie sa'a yi te ama paby aa; tahematapakieca Jeroboam ingchungkhue tie hrawlieta ama dyi hingna thluo lie paby pata a cuo aa; tahematapakieca Jeroboam ingchungkhue tie hrawlieta ama'a lie hing ca Abyipa, Israel Khazing a palung a patluopa suokhakha chuo hmung pata a cuo.
Ca hlyitaw taata Abyipata ama cuota Israel ming cunglie kha siepahruo padaa'a te, ama ta Jeroboam ingchungkhue kha ataning hingta a pahli diy'a yi, ata hingta hmuo!

“Tiy chunglie phiepahlaa kung aa canyipa haata Abyipata Israel ca tuv'a te, ama ta ama mingchingmingvuo tie a pipa yi ruo phapa taa hingta a phie pathla'a yi. Cakhutaa cata Zufrates huesuo luo te khata a cadaapatlaa diy'a yi, tahematapakieca iema cuota Ashera tung kha a sa yi te Abyipahi haa riypata ama tue.
Ama ta Jeroboam suenapa tie, ama a suenapa hne Israel a pasue sanapa kawlieta Israel kha a thaw aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Jeroboam napuvnung ca thu te, si te Tirzah luo a pha. Ing ingchiypakaa luo a chiypa hneta haatiy ca a thiy.
Abyipata a changtaapa profet Ahijah a changpa haa khata, Israel ming bangkhuo ta paby yi te, muochie ama sa.
Jeroboam tuesana aa ngaa kaliepa, tuokhaata rie tuv te ma, tuokhaata a pe yi tapa tie ca Israel Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv chunglieta cape pata a cuo,
Jeroboam pena cuo ca kung kiy kung hning chung ta a cuo; cakhutaata a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a zie te, a sacapaa Nadab ta aa thle.

Solomon sacapaa Rehoboam ta Judah ruo ca a pe. Pe hruo aa pathu ning kha kung sawliy kung kha ta a cuo. Abyipata Israel phang bangkhuo chungtaata a ming china riypata aa tlawpa Jerusalem lie kha kung hraa hlyisariy siepahruo a cuo. A nung ming ca Naamah ta cuo te Ammon ming ta a cuo.
Judah ta Abyipahmungna lie kha pha lina a tue; ama mingchingmingvuo tie tuepa laata a hluv vie ta ama tuepa suena ca ta Abyipahietliena kha ama pathu sa.
Tahematapakieca iema ta khahrungtluobu zaw, lungbang zaw, Ashera tung zaw kha tluo a suopa mekaa hne thingkung ningdiy mekaa lie kha a tue yi te,
ama ruo chunglie, capa hmang tie lie kha siyhrawpaa tie ama aw.
Siepahruo Rehoboam siepahruo a cuonapa kung pangaana lie kha Izipt Siepahruo Shishak ta Jerusalem a kya du.
Ama ta Abyipaing suethiy hne siepahruo ing suethiy, hne zezaw bangkhuo kha a la. Ama ta Solomon ta a tuepa siy aphya tie zaw kha a la.
Caacuonakawta siepahruo Rehoboam ta capa tie cuopa ca ta daa aphya kha a tue, cakhutaata rievetuv byi tie, siepahruo ing ingchiypakaa a huopa tie kuv luo kha a pi yi.
Siepahruo ta Abyipaing chung luo aa ngie kyry khata rie a vepa tie khata a cyi yi te rievetuv tie khuo lie kha ama chi pakhaa taw.
Rehoboam tuesana aa ngaapa a tuepa bangkhuo Judah Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv lie tana ama cape cuo va ma?
Rehoboam hne Jeroboam alalalie kha rie a tuvna a za aw pari.

Rehoboam ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a zie te David khy chunglie kha a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lieta ama paby. A nung ming ca Naamah ta cuo te Ammon ming ta a cuo. A sacapaa Abijam ta ama kha aa thle.
Nebat sacapaa Siepahruo Jeroboam a pena kung hraa hlyicari kung lie kha Abijam ta Judah ruo kha pe hruo aa pathu.
Ama ta Jerusalem lie kha kung thung siepahruo a cuo. A nung ming ca Maakah ta cuo te Abishalom sacanung ta a cuo.
Ama hluota a paa ta a za tuepa suena bangkhuo kha a tue. A paa David haa khata Abyipaa Khazing'a luo a pathiypalung a pi hmisi vyi.
Cuorasala David kawlie khata Abyipaa Khazing ta Jerusalem lie kha myi-ing suokha a pi, ama khutaata a sacapaa kha padaa te Jerusalem kha a pacu sa.
Tahematapakieca David ta Abyipahmungna lie kha aa dangpa kha tue te, Hit ming Uriah kawlie ta li pata ca bie a pipa bangkhuo kha a hring chung bangkhuo lie piese buo vyi.
A hring chung bangkhuo ca Rehoboam hne Jeroboam alalalie kha rie a duna aa pazue pari.
Abijam tuesana kaw a hrangpa, hne a tuepa bangkhuo ca Judah Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv liena aa cape cuo va ma? Abijam hne Jeroboam alalalie kha a duna a aw.
Abijam ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a zie te, David khypuv lie kha ama paby. Cakhutaata a sacapaa Asa ta ama kha aa thle.
Siepahruo Jeroboam ta Israel a pena kung kiy kung lieta Asa ta Judah ruo kha pe hruo aa pathu.
Ama ta Jerusalem lie kha kung sawliy kung kha siepahruo a cuo. A nung ming ca Maakah ta cuo te Abishalom sacanung ta a cuo.
A paa David ta a tuepa haata Asa ta Abyipahmungna lie a phapa kha a tue.
Ruo chung taa khata siyhrawpaa tie kha papya diy yi te, a mingchingmingvuo tie za tuepa kuvtuezuv bangkhuo kha a thaw diy.
Ama ta a nung Maakah kha siepahruo nung cuona taata a phie; tahematapakieca ama ta Asherah cuota duvsamakhiepa kuvtuezuv kha a tue. Asa ta capa zuv kha hupatyi te Kidron cavaata lie kha myi ta a rue.
Cuorasala khahrungtluobu tie kha para vyi. Cadyiseca Asa ca a chuo chung bangkhuo ta Abyipa'a lie a pathiypalung aa hmisi.
Ama ta a paa biekuona lasaw zaw, hne ama biekuona lasaw zaw ta a cuopa ngu, siy, hne biphie zaw kha Abyipaing chung luo a chi diy.
Asa hne Israel siepahruo Baasha alalalie kha ama chuo chung bangkhuo ta aduna a aw.
Israel siepahruo Baasha ca Judah a du riypa khata sithaw te, Judah Siepahruo Asha'a luo kha ahunghmuo amaa ngie khu li riypata hne ama pya khu li riypata Ramah khy kha a sa.

Cakhutaata Asa ta Abyipaing suethiy taata hne Siepahruo ing suethiy taata aa ngaapa ngu hne siy bangkhuo kha la te a changtaapa zaw kuv luo kha a pi yi. Siepahruo Asa ta capa zaw ca Damaskas lie a awpa Aram ming Hezion sacapaa Tabrimmon a sacapaa siepahruo Ben-hadad'a luo kha paphya te,

“I paa hne na paa alalalie adaapakhawna a za awpa haa khata, kama hne nama alalalie zaw adaapakhawna aw se; kama na siy hne ngu kha lasaw ta caa paphya ang; si la, kama kha inaa sawse riypata Israel siepahruo Baasha hne namaa daapakhawna kha para tie,” a ta.

Ben-hadad ta Siepahruo Asa bie kha naathlie te, Israel khypuv tie a du riypata a riekabyilepa tie kha a pathlie yi. Ama ta Ijon, Dan, Abel-beth-maakah, hne Khinneroth bangkhuo kha Naftali ruo yalya hne khata a te.
Capa ca Baasha ta a thyi tiyta, Ramah a sapa kha taw te Tirzah lieta a aw.

Cakhutaata Siepahruo Asa ta Judah ruo bangkhuo kha thuo a pathyi sa, pakha hmuo payipa cuo va yi; Baasha ta Ramah khysana riypata a hmuopa alung zaw thing zaw kha palaw yi te, capa ca ta Asa ta Benjamin ruo Mizpah lie kha Geba khy a sa.

Asa ta a tuesana, a cahrana bangkhuo, a tuepa bangkhuo, hne a sapa khypuv bangkhuo ca Judah Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv lie kha cape pata cuo va ma? Cuorasala a macuo luo ta ca a phyi lieta hmaa a hnyi.
Cakhutaata Asa ca a paa David khypuv lie kha a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lieta a zie te a sacapaa Jehoshafat ta ama kha aa thle.
Judah siepahruo Asa pena kung hning kung lie kha Jeroboam sacapaa Nadab ta Israel kha a pe; Israel ming ca kung hning a pe yi.
Ama ta Abyipahmungna lie kha a pha lipa a tue. A mingchingmingvuo tie luopuv kha ziy te Israel ming kha a pasue sa yi.

Issakhar ingchungkhue cawsaa, Ahijah sacapaa Baasha ta ama kha raw te Filistin ming khy Gibbethon lie kha a thie; tahematapakieca Nadab hne Israel ming bangkhuo khata Gibbethon ca ama cadung nguoluo ningta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Judah siepahruo Asa siepahruo cuonapa kung thung kung lie kha Baasha ta Nadab kha thie te a ma kha a thle te siepahruo a cuo.

Siepahruo a cuopa hneta Jeroboam ingchungkhue bangkhuo kha a thie diy yi; a changtaapa, Shilon ming Ahijah lieta Abyipata a ripa haa khata Jeroboam ingchungkhue tie kha a hringpa ta pakha hmuo pangaa va yi.
Capa ca, Jeroboam ama ta a tuepa suena, hne Israel ming a pasue sanapa yi suena zaw khata Abyipa, Israel Khazing a hi a pahaa nakaw tana a cuo.
Nadab ta a tuesana, a tuepa bangkhuo ca Israel Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv liena aa cape cuo va ma?
Asa hne Israel Siepahruo Baasha alalalie kha ama chuo chung bangkhuo ta aduna a aw.
Judah Siepahruo Asa pena kung thung kung lie kha Ahijah sacapaa Baasha ta Israel ming bangkhuo kha Tirzah khy taata uv hruo aa pathu te kung kiy kung paliy siepahruo a cuo.
Ama ta Abyipahmungna lie kha a pha lipa a tue, Jeroboam suena hne Israel ming a pasue sanapa yi suena luopuv kha a ziy ra.
Baasha kawlieta Hanani sacapaa Jehu'a lie kha Abyipabie a luo te,

“Nama ca buvcing chung taa khata ca cyicalang angte i cawsaa Israel ming luochiytuv riypata i ca tue raalaa pata, Jeroboam luopuv kha ziy cate, i cawsaa Israel ming kha pasue sa yi cate iema suena ta kama kha i hi ina pahaa ciy.
Caacuonakawta Baasha hne a ingchungkhue ca pahli'a yi angte, nama ingchungkhue ca Nebat sacapaa Jeroboam ingchungkhue haata ica tue aa.
Baasha cawsaa ta a cuopa mekaa ca khy chunglie a thiy kie uv ta ce'a yi te, ruocaapa lie a thiypa kha pavaa ta a ning'a yi,” a ta.
Baasha tuesana aa ngaapa, a tuepa, a cahrana zaw ca Israel Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv chunglie kha cape pata cuo va ma?
Baasha ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a zie te, Tirzah lie kha ama paby; cakhutaata a sacapaa Elah ta ama kha aa thle.

Ca hlyitaw taata Baasha hne a ingchungkhue tie kawlieta Hanani sacapaa Jehu'a lie kha Abyipabie aa luo. Capa ca Abyipahmungna lie a pha lipa a tuena kawlie hne a kuv ta a tuepa hmang ta Abyipahi pahaa te Jeroboam ingchungkhue haa khata a parana kawlieta a cuo.
Judah Siepahruo Asa pena kung kiy kung caruv kung lie kha Baasha sacapaa Elah ca Tirzah taa khata Israel ming uv yi te, siepahruo kung hning a cuo.
Cuorasala aa ruole khingkhuo a uvpa riekabyi Zimri ta ama kha a raw. Tirzah lie a aw ning, Tirzah lie siepahruo ing a mangchiytuv Arza ing lieta a pariyna te ta a dang ning kha,
Zimri kha zaa ngie te a thie. Judah siepahruo Asa a pena kung kiy kung sariy kung lie khata a cuo. Ama hmang lie ca Zimri ta siepahruo a cuo.
Siepahruo cuo hruo a pathu te a byithude lie aa tupa hneta Baasha ingchungkhue cawsaa bangkhuo kha a thie diy yi; a tieriy hne a viesaa capaa pakha hmuo a hringpa ta pangaa va yi.
Cahaacata Zimri ta Baasha ingchungkhue bangkhuo kha profet Jehu'a lieta Baasha kawlieta Abyipabie aa luona haa khata a para diy yi.
Baasha hne a sacapaa Elah ta ama tuepa suena bangkhuo kawlie hne Israel ming kha pasue sa yi te, ama kuvtuezuv ta Abyipa, Israel Khazing kha a hi ama pahaa nakawta a cuo.
Elah tuesana aa ngaapa bangkhuo, hne a tuepa bangkhuo ca Israel Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv chungliena aa cape cuo va ma?
Judah siepahruo Asa siepahruo a cuona kung kiy kung sariy kung lieta Zimri ca Tirzah lieta siepahruo ning sariy a cuo. Filistin tie huopa ta a cuopa Gibbethon kha rieka tie ta a du yi te amaa rihnue.

A rihnuepa rieka tie ta, “Zimri na siepahruo kha raw te a thie,” tapa kha ama thyi tiyta; Israel ming bangkhuo ta riekabyilepa Omri kha capa ning lie ca ta arina hmang lie kha siepahruo ta ama pacuo sa.
Caacuonakawta Omri ca Israel ming bangkhuo hne khata Gibbethon taa khata sithaw te Tirzah kha a kya ching.
Zimri ta khypuv ama lapa kha a hmung tiyta, siepahruo ingchung cariekyikuo luo kha a ngie te siepahruo ing hne khata myi ta a ruepuo te a thiy.
Capa ca ama ta a tuepa suena, Abyipahmiekunglieta a tuepa suena, Jeroboam luopuv a ziynapa, hne Israel ming a pasue sana kawlieta a cuo.
Zimri tuesana hrangpa, ama ta rawna a tuepa kaw zaw kha Israel Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv lieta aa cape cuo va ma?
Cakhutaata Israel ming ca che hning ta amaa che; cawsa khingkhuo khata Ginath sacapaa Tibni kha siepahruo pacuo sa riypata ziy yi te, khingkhuo ta Omri ama ziy.
Cuorasala Omri a ziypa tie khata Ginath sacapaa Tibni a ziypa tie kha ama te; caacuonakawta Tibni ca thiy te Omri ta siepahruo a cuo.

Judah siepahruo Asa siepahruo acuona kung sawthung kung kha kung lie kha Omri ta Israel ming cunglie siepahruo cuo hruo aa pathu. Ama ca kung hraa hlyihning chung siepahruo cuo te, kung caruv ca Tirzah taata a uv yi.
Ama ta Shemer huopa Samaria tluo kha ngu talen suohning ta a calyi; tluocung lie ca khypuv suokha sa te, tluo a hnyituvpa ming ziy pata Samaria ta pata ming a sa.
Omri ta Abyipahmungna lie kha a pha lipa tue te, ama hmielie'apa tie laa khata a pha li viepa kha a tue.
Tahematapakieca Nebat sacapaa Jeroboam luopuv kha ziy te, Israel ming kha pasue sa yi te, ama kuvtuezuv khata Abyipa, Israel Khazing hi kha ama pahaa.
Omri tuesana aa ngaapa bangkhuo, hne ama ta a paluo sapa a cahrana zaw ca Israel ming Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv lie khana ama cape cuo va ma?
Omri ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a zie te, Samaria lieta ama paby; a sacapaa Ahab ta aa thle.
Judah siepahruo Asa siepahruo acuona kung sawthung kung cari kung lie kha Omri sacapaa Ahab ta Israel ming cunglie siepahruo cuo hruo aa pathu.
Omri sacapaa Ahab ca Abyipahmungna lieta ama hmielie'apa tie bangkhuo laata pha lina a hluv vie a tue.
Nebat sacapaa Jeroboam suena luo lie a ziypa ca ama cuota aa hysapa hmang haata cuo te, Sidon ming siepahruo Ethbaal sacanung Jezebel kha napuv ta la te, Baal re kha hrie te aa bie.
Samaria lie, Baal ing lie kha Baal cuota bienatluophie suokha a sa.
Ahab ta Asherah tung suokha zaw kha a sa. Ahab ta ama hmielieta siepahruo bangkhuo laa khata Abyipa, Israel Khazing hi a pahaa riypa kha a hluv vie a tue.

Ama chuo lie ca ta Bethel khy ming Hiel ta Jeriko kha a sa; Nun sacapaa Joshua ta a za ripa bie haa khata, a sacapaa uvthyi Abiram hringna khata ing hruopatu ca bang te, cakhutaata a thlake kha a sacapaa a syi cepa Segub hringna ta a bang.

Gilead ruo chung Tishbe khy taata Tishbe ming Elijah ta Ahab kyihuo khata, “A hmiekunglie i daa tawpa Abyipa, Israel Khazing a hringpa haa khata kama bie ta ta li pata ca aduo cuose, khytiy cuose aw'a vyi,” a ta.
Abyipabie ca ama'a luo kha a zuv te,
“Hingpa taa hingta cakuo la ningchiyluo kha a maa tie, cakhutaata Jordan cavaa ningchiyluo Kherith cavaata lie kha vaa nu tie.
Cavaata taa khata tiy dang'a cate, capa lieta nama kha sa pi riypata ra-aa zaw kha bie i pi tli yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta cakuo te Abyipabie haa khata a tue; Jordan cavaa ningchiy lie Cherith cavaata luo kha vaa te a va aw.
Ra-aa zaw khata maw ta viechuo hne saa, zuoluo ta viechuo hne saa kha pi yi te, cavaata tiy kha a dang.
Cuorasala cuo pachangta a vya awpa khata khy a saa li nakawta cavaata tiy ca a ky.
Cakhutaata Abyipabie ca ama'a luo kha a zuv te,
“Ata hingta Sidon ruo Zarefath luo kha si la capa lie ca va aw tie; tahematapakieca capa lieta nunghlyinung khana nama sa pi riypata bie i pi tli,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta a tha te Zarefath luo kha a si. Khypuv hukaa luo a phapa khata nunghlyinung pakha ca thingpahri a za pakhaw nguoluo. Ama kha u te, “Seku ta dang riypa tiy na siy tie,” a ta.
Tiy a vya cyi'a nangpa khata u te, “Na kuv ta viechuo tluo kha na vya cyipa tie,” a ta.

Cuorasala nunghlyinung ca ta, “Abyipana Khazing a hringpa haata, rue ciepa suokha hmuo hnyi va ang, bi chunglieta jungsacuo viedie pazaa zungkhata dyi hnyi angte ungthyi lie chiytiy a cawta dyina i hnyi; ata hing thingpahri suohning pakhaw angte, ing luo pha'a angte i sacapaa hne kama cuota i rue aa, ma ning khutaata ca thiy riypata ma cuo aa,” a ta.
Elijah ta ama kyihuo khata, “Ciy khah; cakuo la na ripa haa cata tue tie; cuorasala kama cuota a cawta tah va tue taa la na kya pi tie, cakhutaa cata nama cuo hne na sacapaa cuo khata tue tie.
Tahematapakieca Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ta; Abyipata alyi luo khytiy a pasaa sana te ta jungsacuo viedie bi ca hri buo li'a pata, chiytiy ungthyi zaw ky buo'a vyi,” a ta.
Cakuo te Elijah a ripa haa cata a tue, ama hne Elijah hne a ingchungkhue tie ta ning hluvpuv chung ama ning.
Abyipata Elijah kyihuo ta a ripa haa khata jungsacuo viedie bi ca hri li pata chiytiy ungthyi zaw ky vyi.
Capa khutaa cata ing a hnyituv nung sacapaa ca a pasa; a pasa a ruvsa nakawta a huv a li.

Caacuonakaw ama ta Elijah kyihuo khata, “Vya Khazing cawsaapa i cunglie khaapa palung tling lina ma na hnyi? I suena pathyi sa pakhaa riypata hne i sacapaa pa thiy riypa tana kama'a luo hing naa vaw ing!” a ta.
Cuorasala ama ta, “Na sacapaa ca na hluo tie,” a ta. Ama ta a nung cacunghnaa taa khata la te, ama aa rina a cung duo luo kha kiekhyi te ama iehmang lie kha a pazie.
Abyipakha u te, “Vya Abyipai Khazing, i awnapa nunghlyinung cunglie te hing ma a sacapaa thiena ta ruvnaana na patlung sa?” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata haatiy cunglie ca yi thung a bu te, Abyipa'a luo kha khi te “Vya Abyipai Khazing, hingpa haatiy hing pahring pakhaa tie,” a ta.
Abyipata Elijah ueryi kha naathliepa te: haatiy ca a huv kya sung te a hring pakhaa.
Elijah ta haatiy ca la te, a cung duo taa cata ing chung luo kha za cungkhyi te a nung kha a pi; cakhutaata Elijah ta, “Mang tie na saata ca a hring hing,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta cawsaanung ca ta Elijah kyihuo khata, “Ata hing ca Khazing cawsaa na cuopa kha i pachang, cakhutaata na pakaa chunglie a awpa Abyipabie ca biehmisipa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cuo pasiypuv khutaata, a kung thungna lieta Abyipabie ca Elijah'a luo kha a zuv te, “Cakuo la Ahab'a luo kha vaa luo tie, alyi cung luo kha khy i pasaa sa aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Elijah ca Ahab'a luo kha a vaa luo. Samaria ruo lie cakuo tlungna ca a ruv hringhruo.
Ahab ta siepahruo ing mangchiytuv Obadiah kha a ku. (Obadiah ca Abyipakha khuopuv ta a pa-uvsathyipa ta a cuo.
Jezebel ta Abyipaprofet tie a thie ning yi kha, Obadiah ta profet zakha kha la yi te, sawngaa sawngaa ta lungkhue chunglie kha nu yi te sa hne tiy a pi yi.)

Cakhutaata Ahab ta Obadiah kyihuo khata, “Ruochung bangkhuo kha cahraw la acaa hne cavaata zaw awna luo kha si tie; maa ruo zaw ma laa kaapie zaw hringna riypa hne ma sahring zaw a sung li riypata aphuv zaw ma hmung the ri aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta ruocaapa ca cahraw riypata ruo kha amaa che; Ahab ca amata tah kuokhaluo kha si te, Obadiah ca a hrangpa kuokhaluo kha amata tah a si ra.
Obadiah ca luopuv lie a silepa khata Elijah ta aa taw; Obadiah ta ama kha pachang te a bu te, “I byipaapa Elijah ta cuo va ca ma?” a ta.
Ama ta palie te, “Kama tana i cuo. Cakuo la na byipaapa kha Elijah na hingpa lie hing a aw, va ta tie,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Obadiah ta, “Tuokhaata sue angte ma na changtaapa hing Ahab kuv luo thie riypata ina pi'a nang ciy?

Abyipana Khazing a hringpa haata, i byipaapa hingta nama huv riypata cawsaa a pathlie lina ruo hne mingphang aw va tli; cakhutaata iema ta, ‘Ama ca hingpa lie hing aw vyi,’ ama ta tiyta, capa ruo ca cuose, capa mingphang ca cuose, nama kha hmung vapuv ta pata chie a pasa sa yi.
Cuorasala ata ca nama ta, ‘Cakuo la na byipaapa kha Elijah na hingpa lie hing a aw, ta pata va chang tie,’ ina ta ciy.

Nama'a taata i cakuopa hne hingta Abyipathlaapa ta nama kha ca calang'a te khaapaliema na aw tapa kha pachang'a va ang. Caacuonakawta Ahab kha chang'a angte ama ta aca hmung li kieca kama kha ina thie aa, na changtaapa hing i cawta baataata Abyipakha a ciyzaapa tana i cuo.
Jezebel ta Abyipaprofet tie a thie ning yi kha tuokhaatama na changtaapa ta Abyipaprofet tie kha sawngaa sawngaa ta i nu yi tapa hne sa hne tiy i pi yi tapa kha i byipaapa hing ca chang va yi ma?
Ata ca nama ta, ‘Cakuo la, na byipaapa kha Elijah na hingpa lie hing a aw,’ va ta tie, ina ta ciy; ama ta ina thie hrahring aa,” a ta.
Elijah ta, “A hmiekunglie i daapa Cungnungce Abyipaa hringpa haata, ataning hing i pahmung sa hrahring aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Obadiah ta Ahab'a luo ca vaa te a chang. Cakhutaata Ahab ca Elijah a taw riypata a vaa.
Ahab ta Elijah kha a hmung tiyta, “Israel ming ruvnaana a pituvpa ca nama hingta ma na cuo?” a ta.
Ama ta palie te, “Kama ta Israel kha ruvnaana pi va yi ang; cuorasala nama, hne na paa ingchungkhue na a pi ung ciy, tahematapakieca Abyipanawbie kha thaw ung cate Baal kha nama ziy.
Caacuonakawta ata hingta Israel ming bangkhuo kha Baal profet zapaliy hne Jezebel cabya lie sa a ningpa Asherah profet tie zapaliy hne khata Karmel Tluo lie na pahmyapa tie yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Ahab ta Israel ming bangkhuo'a luo kha cawsaa pathlie te profet tie kha Karmel Tluo lie a pahmya yi.

Cakhutaata Elijah ca cawsaa zaw hraw luo kha a vya ngie te, “Khatiy cuo te khiy ma cabiele pata ruena suohning hneta nama si aa? Abyipahing Khazing ta a cuo kieca, ama kha ziy tie ung; cuorasala Baal hingna Khazing ta a cuo tapa kieca, ama kha ziy tie ung,” a ta. Cawsaa ta bie suokha hmuo palie va yi.
Cakhutaata Elijah ta cawsaa zaw kyihuo khata, “Kama, kama dyi hingna Abyipaprofet aa tuopa ta a cuo ang; cuorasala Baal profet ca zapaliy sawngaa ama ta.

Kiema hing cuetungpa sahning malie pi tie; iema ta sakha a tlaw yi sala, a ce diy yi sala, thing cunglie chi yi se, cuorasala myi ca patiy khah yi se. Kama ta sakha hing a ce diy ra'a angte thing cunglie i chi aa, cuorasala myi patiy'a va ang.

Cakhutaa cata niema ta nama khazing ming kha u'a ung cate kama ta Abyipaming kha i u aa; myi ta malie a paliepa khazing ca Khazing hmisi ta a cuo aa,” a ta yi. Cakhutaata cawsaa bangkhuo ta palie yi te, “Na ripa ca a pha,” ama ta.

Cakhutaata Elijah ta Baal profet tie kha ku yi te, “Cuetungpa sakha hing a tlaw taa ung la a ce tie ung, tahematapakieca niema ca nama hluv vie; cakhutaata nama khazing ming kha u ung la, cuorasala myi patiy'a va ung ciy,” a ta yi.

Cakhutaata iema ta ama pipa cuetungpa ca a la yi te, a ce yi te Baal ming ca maw taata ningchung te ta u yi te, “Vya Baal, malie palie tie,” ama ta. Cuorasala khaapa ueryi hmuo aw li pata khaapatahmuo palie va yi. Ama tuepa bienatluophie athaalie ca amaa cathlu patlaw.

Ningchung khiy ta ca Elijah ta pahnyisue yi te, “Khuopuv ta khi tie ung! Ama ca khazing ta muo a cuo ta; khue a rue nguoluo ningta ma a cuo, acuolikie khylie luo ma a vaa, acuolikie khy ma a tlaw, acuolikie a hmung te ma pathu aa hu,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaa cata khuopuv ta khi yi te, ama phung haata zueziy hne asyi ta iema hne iema kha ama thiy a lang duvluvna te ta a daw yi te amaa uo.
Ningchung a law tli, zuoluo panaa tiy te ta ama khi pari thluo, cuorasala khaapa ueryi hmuo aw li pata khaapatahmuo palie va yi.
Cakhutaata Elijah ta cawsaa bangkhuo kyihuo khata, “A vaw ung la naa vya ngie tie ung,” ta yi te cawsaa bangkhuo ca ta amaa vya ngie. Ama para tlipa Abyipabienatluophie kha a pare taa.
Ama'a luo Abyipabie a zuv te, “Na ming ca Israel tana a cuo aa,” a tapa Jakob sacapaa zaw ama phang zaa khata Elijah ta alung suohraa hlyihning la te,
capa alung zaw ca ta Abyipaming ta bienatluophie a sa. Cakhutaata bienatluophie aa dung pata, a lena luo ta saciy tuo hning tluv aa tlawpa tiyhawkaw kha a cu.
Cakhutaata thing kha a phasa pata chi te, cuetungpa ca a ce diy te thing cunglie ca a chi. Ama ta, “Tiy kha ruocuo zung paliy la ung la myirue panaana hne thing kha bya tie ung,” a ta.
Cakhutaata ama ta, “A yihningnapa bya vie tie ung,” a ta. Ri pakhaa te, “A yithungnapa tue pakhaa tie ung,” ta yi te ama tue pakhaa.
Caacuonakawta tiy ca bienatluophie aa dung pata lang te, tiyhawkaw lie zaw ca tiy a bi diy.

Zuoluo panaa tiy a tapa khiy ta, profet Elijah ca a vya ngie vie te, “Vya Abyipa, Abraham, Isak hne Israel Khazing, nama ca Israel ming chunglie Khazing na cuopa hne kama ca na changtaapa cuo angte hingpa hmang bangkhuo hing nama ri ta i tuepa kha ataning hing pachang pata cuo tli se.
Na palie tie, Vya Abyipa, na palie tie, tahematapakieca hingpa cawsaa tie hingta nama ca Abyipa, Khazing na cuopa hne nama ta iema palung na pakaa sa pakhaapa yi kha ca pachang yi se,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipamyi ca za tla te myirue panaana, thing, alung zaw, hne alyidiyta, hne tiyhawkaw lieta a awpa tiy zaw kha a kuo diy.
Cawsaa bangkhuo ta capa ca ama hmung tiyta, a bung yi te, “Abyipahingna Khazing ta a cuo hmisi; Abyipahingna Khazing ta a cuo hmisi,” ama ta.

Elijah ta iema kyihuo khata, “Baal profet tie hing patuv tie ung; pakha hmuota paruo khah ung,” a ta yi. Cakhutaata iema kha ama patuv; Elijah ta Kishon cavaata luo kha zuvkhyi yi te capa lie ca a thie yi.
Elijah ta Ahab kyihuo khata, “Khaw la kya ning kya dang tie; tahematapakieca khuosa ta khy saapa pu na a aw,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Ahab ca ning riy dang riypa cata a khaw. Elijah ca Karmel tluodaw luo kha kie te, capa lie ca alyi luo kha a bung te a hmie kha a pakhuv alalalieta a chi.
Ama ta a changtaapa kyihuo khata, “Khaw la riyliy luo kha suo tie,” a ta. A changtaapa ca khaw te, mang te, “Khaapahmuo aw vyi,” a ta. Cakhutaata, “Yi sariy khaw pakhaa tie,” a ta.

A yi sariyna lieta ca, “Cawsaa kuv tie a tapa amyi na riyliy taata a kya thu,” a ta. Cakhutaata ama ta, “Zuv la Ahab kha, ‘Naa ruole kha a ting la khy ta a cahre hluo hingta zuv tie,’ va ta tie,” a ta.
Cakhutaata a ru hluota avuo ca amyi hne thliy ta vya vaw karuv te, khuopuv ta khy a saa. Ahab ca aa ruole kha a khang te Jezreel luo a si.
Cuorasala Abyipakuv ca Elijah'a lie kha aw te, a pahriy kha a pasi te Ahab hmaaluo ta Jezreel hukaa luo kha aa ruo.
Ahab ta Jezebel kha Elijah ta a tuepa bangkhuo hne tuokhaatama profet tie kha a thie yi tapa bangkhuo kha a chang.

Cakhutaata Jezebel ta Elijah'a luo kha biephyatuv pathlie te, “Mawluo ata tiy cuo lie hingta na hringna ca iema hrawlie pakha hringnapa haa khata i tue li kieca, capa tluv hne capa laa cata a hluv vie zaw ta khazing tie ta na tue yi se,” a pata sa.
Cakhutaata ciy te, a daa te a hringna vuo ca ta aa ruo; Judah huopa ta a cuopa Beer-sheba luo kha pha te, capa lie ca a changtaapa kha a thuse siy.

Cuorasala ama ca ruocaapa luo kha ning kha luosi si te, vaa te ingphiy kung rawlie kha aa tu. A thiy riypata thlaachuo te, “Aa de tli, ata hing ca, Vya Abyipai hringna kha na la tie, tahematapakieca kama ca i mingchingmingvuo tie laa khata pha vie va ang,” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata ingphiy kung rawlie ca a zie te aa hmung. Ama kha avuoming pakha ta taw te, “Thu la ning tie,” a ta.
A mang ca, a luv cunglie alung lingpa ta ruepa chuore hlung kha, hne tiy thyi kha kha a hmung. Ama ta ning te a dang khutaata a laa pakhaa.
Abyipaavuoming ta a yihningnapa a vaw te ama kha taw te, “Thu la ning tie, cata acuolikieca na khytlawna luopuv hing na cuota a pasiy tuv aa,” a ta.
Thu te, a ning a dang; cakhutaata capa sa thaazuo cata Khazing tluo Horeb luo kha ning sawliy hne zuo sawliy a si.
Capa hmang lie ca lungkhue suokha luo kha pha te capa lie ca aa ri. Cakhutaata Abyipabie kha thyi te, “Elijah, hingpa lie hing khaapama na tue?” a ta.

Ama ta palie te, “Abyipa, Cungnungce Khazing na i daakhyi hringhruo, tahematapakieca Israel ming ta na biekuona kha thaw yi te, na bienatluophie kha ama phi, cakhutaata na profet tie kha zueziy ta ama thie. Kama dyi hingna aa ngaapa ta a cuo ang, kama zaw hing hmuo thie riypa tana ina huv nguoluo yi,” a ta.

Ama ta, “Pya la Abyipahmiekunglie tluo lie kha a daa tie, tahematapakieca Abyipana a vya cakuole aa,” a ta. Thliy ca khuosa ta a hruo te Abyipahmiekunglieta tluo kha che te alung zaw kha a pakyichi diy; cuorasala Abyipaca thliy chunglie kha aw vyi. Thliy khutaa cata aling aa siy; cuorasala Abyipaca aling chunglie kha aw vyi.
Aling khutaa khata myi; cuorasala Abyipaca myi chunglie zaw ca aw vyi; myi khutaa cata a nesapa ueryi chiekariyta a vya pya.

Capa ca Elijah ta a thyi tiyta, a buohryi pasiypa khata a pakaa a pahruv te, pya te lungkhue pakaa lie kha aa daa. Cakhutaata ueryi ca ama'a luo kha a vaw te, “Elijah, hingpa lie hing khaapama na tue?” a ta.

Ama ta palie te, “Abyipa, Cungnungce Khazing na i daakhyi hringhruo, tahematapakieca Israel ming ta na biekuona kha thaw yi te, na bienatluophie kha ama phi, cakhutaata na profet tie kha zueziy ta ama thie. Kama dyi hingna aa ngaapa ta a cuo ang, kama zaw hing hmuo thie riypa tana ina huv nguoluo yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipata ama kyihuo khata, “Na vya sinapa luo, Damaskas ruocaapa luo kha kaa tie; na va pha tiyta, Siria ming cunglie siepahruo cuo riypata Hazael kha sathu va pathuv tie.

Nimshi sacapaa Jehu zaw kha Israel ming cunglie siepahruo cuo riypata sathu pathuv ra tie; cakhutaata Abel-meholah ming Shafat sacapaa Elisha zaw kha nama hmang lie hing profet cuo riypata sathu na pathuv aa.
Hazael zueziy taata a ruopa kha Jehu ta a thie aa; Jehu zueziy taata a ruopa kha Elisha ta a thie aa.
Cuorasala Israel ming chunglie hing Baal hmiekunglie a pakhuv pane li pata ama a pahnuo lipa thaw sariy i pangaa'a yi,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta capa taa cata a tha te, Shafat sacapaa Elisha kha le a thaw nguoluo pata a hmung. A hmiekunglie kha cuetungpa tue hraa hlyihning aw te ama ca a tue hraa hlyihningna lie ca a aw. Elijah ta aa thaalie ta va caluole te a buohryi pasiypa kha a cunglie a thawsue.

A cuetungpa tie kha thuse te, Elijah'a luo kha a ruo te, “I paa hne i nung kha va pahnuo taa'a yi angte, cakhutaata nama kha ica ziy aa,” a ta. Cakhutaata Elijah ta, “Kaa pakhaa tie; tahematapakieca na cunglie khaapama i tue?” a ta.

Ama ziy riy'apa taa khata va kaa te, cuetungpa tue kha ca la te a thie; le a thawnapa thing cata cue saa ca pasu te, cawsaa kha pi yi te ama ning. Cakhutaata a tha te Elijah kha ziy te, a changtaapa ta aa li.
Siria siepahruo Ben-hadad ta a rieka tie bangkhuo kha a pahmya yi; siepahruo sawthung pahning kha aruo hne aruole hneta ama'a luo ta amaa daa. Samaria kha sichiy te cadung te a tuv.
Cakhutaata khypuv chunglie Israel siepahruo Ahab'a luo kha biephyatuv pathlie yi te, ama kyihuo khata, “Ben-hadad na hing haa hingta a ta:
Na ngu hne na siy ca kama huopa tana ama cuo; na napuvnung a puvthe cepa tie hne na saata zaw kha kama huopa tana ama cuo,” a pata sa yi.
Israel siepahruo ca ta palie te, “Na ripa haata, i byipaapa, Vya Siepahruo, kama hne i hnyipa bangkhuo ca nama huopa tana ima cuo,” a ta.
Biephyatuv tie ca a vaw pakhaa yi te, “Ben-hadad na hing haa hingta a ta: cawsaa vya pathlie yi angte, ‘Na ngu hne na siy kha kama ca na pi tie, na napuv zaw na saata zaw ca,’ a ta.

Cadyiseca mawluo ata cuo lie hingta nama'a luo kha i changtaapa zaw vya pathlie'a yi angte, iema ta na ing hne na changtaapa tie ing zaw kha huv'a yi te, ama khingpa mekaa kha a la'a yi te ama sikhyi aa,’ a ta,” ama ta.

Cakhutaata Israel siepahruo ta a ruo lie uvthyi tie bangkhuo kha ku yi te, “Mang tie ung! Hingpa paa hingta ruvnaana tue riypata tuokhaatama luo a huv tapa hing hmung tie ung; i napuv zaw, i saata zaw, i siy, hne i ngu repata cawsaa kha vya pathlie yi te, bu va ang,” a ta.
Cakhutaata uvthyi tie bangkhuo hne cawsaa bangkhuo ta ama kyihuo khata, “Naathlie khah, na naa zaw tla ra khah se,” ama ta.

Caacuonakawta Ben-hadad biephyatuv tie kyihuo cata, “I byipaapa siepahruo kha chang tie ung: Na changtaapa ina hie taapa bangkhuo kha i tue aa: cuorasala hingpa hmang hing ca tue khu'a va ang,” a ta yi. Biephyatuv tie si yi te bie ca ama phya.

Ben-hadad ta cawsaa kha pathlie te, “Cahaacata khazing tie ta i cunglie hing tue yi se la a hluv vie zaw ta tue yi se, Samaria alyidiyta hing ta kama naa ziypa cawsaa tie kha pachung zung kha law aa zu kie yi ca,” a ta.
Israel siepahruo ta, “Ama kha chang tie ung: Rieka cawsie hne cehre a tuepa ta ca, a thliepa haata thluhuv a sa riypata cuo vyi,” a ta.

Ben-hadad ta siepahruo tie hneta thluodaa lie ama dang ning khata capa bie ca a thyi tiyta, a cawsaa zaw kyihuo khata, “A daahmang la tie ung!” a ta yi. Cakhutaata iema ta khypuv a du riypata adaahmang kha ama la.

Cakhutaata profet pakha ta Israel siepahruo Ahab athaa luo kha a vaw te, “Abyipana hing haa hingta a ta, Hingpa cawsaa phuv hluvpuv hing na hmung cuo va ma? Mang tie, Ataning ta hingpa hing na kuv luo ica pi aa; cakhutaata kama kha Abyipai cuopa ina pachang'a ciy,” a ta.
Ahab ta, “Ahung hmuo pata ma?” a ta. Cakhutaata Abyipata, “Pe uvtuv tie re a hriepa mingnu pakha hmuo pata,” a ta. Cakhutaata ama ta, “Ahungma rie a pathu aa?” a ta. Ama ta palie te, “Nama,” a ta.
Cakhutaata pe uvtuv tie re a hriepa mingnu tie kha pakiy yi te zahning sawthung pahning ama ta; cakhutaata Israel ming bangkhuo kha pa kiy yi te, thaw sariy ama ta.
Ben-hadad hne a byatuv siepahruo sawthung pahning tie thluodaa chunglie ama pariyna te ta ama dang nguoluo ning, ningchung khata iema ca ama pya.
Pe uvtuv tie re a hrietuv mingnu zaw kha ama pya taa. Ben-hadad ta ngiepatlietuv tie kha pathlie yi te, capa tie ca ta ama kha, “Cawsaa na Samaria taata a vya pya yi,” ta pata ama chang.
Ama ta, “Diena repata amaa vaw kiema ama hringpa ta patuv ung la, rietuv riypata amaa vaw kiema ama hringpa ta patuv tie ung,” a ta.
Cuorasala pe uvtuv tie re a hrietuv mingnu tie ca khypuv taa cata vya pya tli yi te, rieka tie ta ama vya paziy.
Iema ta amaa dupa cawsaa cyicuo kha ama thie; Siria ming ca a ruo yi te Israel ming ta amaa cade, cuorasala Siria Siepahruo Ben-hadad ca aruo kha a khang te aruo rieka tie hneta amaa ruo.
Israel siepahruo ca pya te, aruo hne aruole zaw kha para yi te Siria ming kha a hluvsa a thie yi.

Cakhutaata profet ta Israel siepahruo'a luo kha vaa te, “Na thaa a pacu tie, khaapama i tue aa tapa kha a phasa pata rue tie; tahematapakieca cuovuo chunglieta Siria siepahruo ta acaa vya du'a tli hing,” a ta.

Siria siepahruo changtaapa tie ta ama kyihuo khata, “Iema khazing tie ca tluocung khazing tie tana ama cuo, caacuonakawta kiema laata ama cahra vie; cuorasala iema kha ase lieta a du'a ung puv, iema laata ma cahra vie hrahring aa.
Hingpa zaw hing tue tie: siepahruo tie hing ama re cyicuo taata pya yi sala, iema hmang lie hing riebyilepa tie chi tie yi;
cakhutaata naa sungpa rieka zaa khata rieka la pakhaa tie, aruo cuota a ruo, hne aruole cuota aruole; cakhutaata iema kha ase lieta maa du'a yi, iema laata ma cahra vie hrahring aa,” ama ta.
Cuovuo lie ca Ben-hadad ta Siria ming ca pahmya yi te, Israel ming a du riypata Afek luo kha a sithaw.

Cakhutaata Israel ming ca pahmya yi te ning riypa kha tingtuo yi te iema a du riypata ama pya. Israel ming ca iema a rie-e lie khata amaa ri; Siria ming ruo chunglie ama bi ning kha iema ca mie phuv taata phuv hning zaata haa khata ama cuo.

Khazing cawsaapa ta Israel siepahruo athaa luo kha vaa te, “Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Siria ming ta, ‘Abyipaca tluocung khazing ta cuo te ase khazing ta cuo vyi, ama ta.’ Caacuonakawta hingpa a hluv hringhruopa cawsaazaapuv hing na kuv luona ica pi aa, cakhutaata Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a ciy,” a ta.
Iema ca aa hmiepachawpa khata ning sariy chung amaa ri. A ning sariyna lieta rietuv hruo pathu yi te, Israel ming ta Siria ming phyi rieka ting kha kha ning kha chunglieta ama thie.
Aa ngaapa tie ca Afek khypuv chung luo kha a ruo yi te, aa ngaa kaliepa thawkiy thawsariy tie kha lungruetlepie ta a cingsue yi. Ben-hadad zaw ca a ruo ra te khypuv chung luo kha avaa nu.

A changtaapa tie ta, “Mang tie, Israel ingchungkhue siepahruo tie ca nangdue a thepa siepahruo tana ama cuo ta pata ma za thyi buo; ma se lie buri a paze pata, ma luv lie hing luoriy a se ung sala Israel siepahruo'a luo kha ma vaa kieca, ca pahring ngiethie thlu'a va ma?” a ma ta.

Caacuonakawta ama se lie kha buri a paze yi te, ama luv kha luoriy ta a se yi te, Israel siepahruo'a luo kha vaa yi te, “Na changtaapa Ben-hadad na, ‘Na pahring thi tie,’ caa ta,” ama ta. Ama ta, “A hring kalie ma? Ama ca i uvnu tana a cuo,” a ta.

Cawsaa zaw ca ta capa ca pamangsana tana a cuo ta yi te, a bie kha a la yi te, “A cuo, Ben-hadad ca na uvnu tana a cuo,” ama ta. Cakhutaata ama ta, “Vaa ung la a vawkhyi tie ung,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Ben-hadad ca ama'a luo kha a vaw te aa ruole kha ama vya pakhang sa.

Ben-hadad ta, “I paa ta na paa'a taata a lapa khy tie kha ica pi pakhaa aa; i paa ta Samaria lie a tuepa haa khata Damaskas lie kha chadaw naa tue ra aa,” a ta. Israel siepahruo khata palie te, “Hingpa biekuona thue hingta hya ica pazang aa,” a ta. Caacuonakawta biekuona tue yi te a pasi sa.
Profet sacapaa zaw chungtaata pakha ta Abyipabiepina haa khata a viesaa profet pakha kha, “Na tuv tie!” a ta. Cuorasala cawsaapa ca ta tuv khing vyi.
Cakhutaata ama ta, “Abyipaueryi kha na ziy li nakawta kama'a taata na cakuo pahne hingta chingde ta aca sie aa,” a ta. Cakhutaata ama'a taata a cakuo pahne chingde ta a sie.
Cakhutaata ama ta cawsaa hrangpa pakha kha hmung te, “Na tuv tie,’ a ta. Caacuonakawta cawsaapa ca ta a tuv, tuv te hmaa a paphya.
Cakhutaata profet ca cakuo te, a hmingsuo thle riypata a ming kha hmaa catawnapa ta a cataw te, luopuv taa khata siepahruo kha a huo.

Siepahruo ca aa vawlepa khata u te, “Na changtaapa hing rietuvna a ruvsana luo si angte, capa lie ca rieka pakha ta cawsaa pakha kha a vawkhyi te, ‘Hingpa cawsaapa hing mangchiy tie, a vie pathlyi kieca na hringna ca a hringna cuota pipa cuo'a te, acuolikie ngu talen suokha na lu aa,’ ina ta.
Na changtaapa ca hue lie hne hing lie hne i kalaa ning kha, ama ca a cakuo,” a ta. Israel siepahruo ca ta, “Na cunglie biechipana ca cahaaca tana a cuo thluo aa; namata tah bie naa chi tli,” a ta.
Cakhutaata a ming aa pahlawnapa kha a catlisa pata a la. Israel siepahruo ta profet pakha a cuopa kha a pachang.

Cakhutaata ama kyihuo khata, “Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri, ‘Para riypata ica pi ciepa cawsaa kha na kuv chungtaata na pathlie nakawta, na hringna ca ama hringna cuota cuo'a te, na cawsaa ca ama cawsaa cuota ama cuo aa,’ a ta,” a ta.
Israel siepahruo ca palung rasa pata hne minghmie chiesa pata a ing luo cakuo te, Samaria luo kha a pha.
Ahnang taata hingpa hmang hing a vya cuo: Jezreel ming Naboth ta Jezreel lie, Samaria siepahruo Ahab ing athaalie kha mingsuv diedung suokha a hnyi.

Ahab ta Naboth kyihuo khata, “Na mingsuv diedung hing kama ing athaalie a aw nakaw hingta, uohnaasiyyhnaa diedung ta i hnyi the riypata na pi tie, hingpa laa hingta a pha viepa mingsuv diedung na ica pi hriy aa; acuolikie nama ta a pha na tana haata tuokaa ta a muo ica pi aa,” a ta.
Cuorasala Naboth ta Ahab kyihuo khata, “I mingchingmingvuo tie ru ta a cuopa nama ica pi riypa ca Abyipata a thlupa tana a cuo,” a ta.

Ahab ca Jezreel ming Naboth ta, “I mingchingmingvuo tie ru ca ca pi khu va ang,” a tapa bie kawlie khata palung pha li pata hne minghmie pha li pata ing luo a cakuo. A iehmang lie kha laa te kuokhaluo kha a hyi te, sa ning li pata a aw.
A napuvnung Jezebel kha ama'a luo a vaw te, “Sa ning lina te ta khaapama na palung a ra? a ta.

Ama ta, “Jezreel ming Naboth kyihuo khata, ‘Na mingsuv diedung hing tuokaa ta ca calyi'a ang, acuolikie, na khing kieca mingsuv diedung hrangpa ica pi hriy aa,’ i ta ca ama ta, ‘I mingsuv diedung hing ca pi khu va ang, ina ta,’ a ta.
A napuvnung Jezebel ta ama kyihuo khata, “Ata hing Israel hing nama ta uv va ca ma? Thu la sa ning tie, cakhutaata a law tie, Jezreel ming Naboth mingsuv diedung ca kama na caa pi'a ang,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Ahab ming khata caa cape te, a ming caakhe kha a cung te, Naboth hne a khy lie a awpa uvthyi tie hne byi tie kha a paphya yi.
A caa chunglie ca, “Sa-uvna ning kha pathyi ung la, Naboth kha cawsaazaapuv hrawlie aa suo pata patu tie ung;

cawsaa laliy lipa pahning kha a hmiekunglie patu ung la, ‘Nama ta Khazing hne siepahruo kha chie na sa yi,’ ta pata pachie yi se. Cakhutaata ama kha pyakhyi ung la a thiyna te ta alung ta vaa yi se,” a ta.
A khypuv cawsaa, a khypuv lieta a awpa uvthyi tie hne byi tie ta Jezebel ta iema'a luo bie a taapa haa yi khata ama tue. Ama ta iema'a luo a paphyapa yi caa chunglie aa capepa haa khata
sa-uvna ning kha pathyi yi te, Naboth kha cawsaazaapuv hmielieta ama patu.

Cawsaa laliy lipa pahning kha a vaw yi te a hmiekunglie kha amaa tu; cakhutaata cawsaa laliy lipa tie ca ta cawsaa hmiekunglie kha, “Naboth na Khazing hne siepahruo kha chie a sa yi,” ama ta. Caacuonakawta khyle luo kha pyakhyi yi te a thiyna te ta alung ta ama vaa.
Cakhutaata iema ta Jezebel'a luo kha cawsaa pathlie yi te, “Naboth ca alung ta vaapa a cuo tli; a thiy tli,” ama ta.

Jezebel ta Naboth ca alung ta vaa yi te a thiy tli tapa kha a thyi pahne ta, Jezebel ta Ahab kyihuo khata, “Vaa la, Jezreel ming Naboth ta tuokaa ta aca zaa khing lipa mingsuv diedung ca a la tie; tahematapakieca Naboth ca hring va tli, a thiy tli,” a ta.
Ahab ta Jezreel ming Naboth ca a thiy tli tapa kha a thyi pahne ta, mingsuv diedung kha a la riypata a zuv.
Cakhutaata Abyipabie ca Tishbe ming Elijah'a luo kha a zuv te:
Samaria a uvpa, Israel Siepahruo Ahab a taw riypa khata sibung tie, ama ca a la riypata a sihnuepa Naboth mingsuv diedung lie khana a aw.

Nama ta ama kyihuo khata, “Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Thie tli cate, a ru zaw na cu tli ma?” a ta, ta tie. Nama ta, “Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Uvta Naboth thiy ama palinapa hmang lie khana, uv ta nama thiy zaw kha ama pali ra aa,” a ta, ta pata chang tie, a ta.
Ahab ta Elijah kyihuo khata, “Vya i cariepa, ina hmung ca ma?” a ta. Ama ta palie te, “Ica hmung. Abyipahmungna lie kha hmang pha lipa tue riypata nama hne nama kha naa zaa tli nakawta ica hmung.
Na cunglie kha rana patlung sa'a angte ica pahli aa; Israel ming chunglie Ahab huopa ta a cuopa capaa mekaa ca hya a zang lipa cuose hya a zangpa cuose i para diy'a yi.
Cakhutaata na ing ca Nebat sacapaa Jeroboam ing haa khata tue'a angte, Ahijah sacapaa Baasha ing haa khata i tue aa, tahematapakieca i hi na pahaa cate, Israel ming kha na pasue sa tli yi.
Cakhutaata Jezebel kawlie hing Abyipata, ‘Jezreel khy dungkhuo lie hingna Jezebel ca uv ta ama ce aa,’ a ta.
Ahab huopa ta a cuopa mekaa ca khy chunglie ama thiy kie uv ta ce'a yi te, ruo lie ama thiy kie avuo lie a zupa pavaa ta ama ning aa,” a ta.
(Ahab haapa cawsaa pakha hmuo aw va yi, a napuvnung Jezebel ta a pasu nakawta hmang pha lipa tue riypata Abyipahmungna lie ama hne ama a zaapa tana a cuo.
Abyipata Israel ming hmiekung taata aa cadepa yi Amor ming tuepa haa khata kuvtuezuv kha abie te duvsamakhie aa chiy ce pata hmang a tuepa tana a cuo.)
Ahab ta capa bie ca a thyi tiyta, a caw kha thlaa te buri kha aa hryi, sa a uv te, buri lie kha a zie te palung rasa pata aa khie.
Cakhutaata Tishbe ming Elijah'a luo kha Abyipabie a zuv te:

“I hmiekunglieta kha tluv tama Ahab ta ama hne ama aa pane tapa kha na hmung ma? I hmiekunglie kha aa pane nakawta ama chuo lieta ca rana kha patlung sa'a va ang, cuorasala a saata zaw chuolie na a ingchungkhue cunglie kha rana i patlung sa aa,” a ta.
Kung thung chung ca Siria hne Israel ca a du li pata ama aw.
Cuorasala a kung thungna lieta Judah Siepahruo Jehoshafat ca Israel siepahruo'a luo kha aa zuv.
Israel siepahruo ta a changtaapa zaw kyihuo khata, “Ramoth-gilead hing kiema huopa a cuopa kha nama pachang ma? Cuorasala Siria siepahruo kuv chungtaata chuv riypata khaapahmuo tue vapuv,” a ta.

Ama ta Jehoshafat kyihuo khata, “Ramoth-gilead lie rie a tuv riypata kama hneta na si ra'a ma?” a ta. Jehoshafat ta Israel siepahruo kha palie te, “Kama ca nama haa tana i cuo; i cawsaa hing na cawsaa ta cuo yi te, i ruo zaw hing naa ruo tana ama cuo,” a ta.
Cuorasala Jehoshafat ta Israel siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Abyipakha bie hiehriy taa tie,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Israel siepahruo ta profet tie pakiy yi te zapaliy hraw ama ta, iema kyihuo khata, “Ramoth-gilead a du riypata i si'a ma, acuolikie si'a va ang ma?” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Si tie; tahematapakieca Abyipata siepahruo na kuv chung luo kha aca pi aa,” ama ta.
Cuorasala Jehoshafat ta, “Hingpa lie hing ma hiehriy khu riypa Abyipaprofet hrangpa aw va tli yi ma?” a ta.

Israel siepahruo ta Jehoshafat kyihuo khata, “Abyipama pahiehriy sa khu riypa a hrangpa pakha a aw kalie, Imlah sacapaa Mikaiah ta a cuo, cuorasala kama kawlieta a phapa ri buo li pata a chiepa dyi a ri nakawta ama ca i hue,” a ta. Jehoshafat ta, “Siepahruo ta cahaapa ca ri khah se,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Israel siepahruo ta byi pakha kha ku te, “Imlah sacapaa Mikaiah kha a catli pata a vawkhyi tie,” a ta.

Israel siepahruo hne Judah siepahruo Jehoshafat ca Samaria khy luo a ngienapa lie, suo-aciyna lie kha ama caw kha a tue yi te, ama byithude lie kha amaa tu; profet bangkhuo ca iema hmiekunglie kha profetbiephu kha ama ri.
Khenaanah sacapaa Zedekiah ta thaa kiy kha a tue te, “Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Siria ming kha ama ra diy hluo li hingpa hingta de tie yi, a ta,” a ta.
Profet bangkhuo ta aa lu pata profetbiephu kha ri yi te, “Ramoth-gilead luo kha sithaw la kya te tie yi; Abyipana siepahruo na kuv chung luo kha caa pi aa,” ama ta.

Mikaiah ku riypata a sipa biephyatuv khata, “Mang tie, profet tie ta palung a lusa pata ama ripa bie ca siepahruo ta a tlechuo; nama bie zaw iema hrawlie pakha bie haa khata cuo sala tlechuo aa chiy pata ri ra tie,” a ta.
Cuorasala Mikaiah ta, “Abyipaa hringpa haata, Abyipata ina changpa bie khana i ri aa,” a ta.

Siepahruo'a luo kha aa vaw tiyta, siepahruo ta ama kyihuo khata, “Mikaiah, Ramoth-gilead luo kha rie tuv riypata ma si'a ma, acuolikie si'a va pa ma?” a ta. Ama ta, “Sithaw la kya te tie yi; Abyipata siepahruo kuv luo kha a pi aa,” a ta.
Cuorasala siepahruo ta ama kyihuo khata, “Biehmisipa ta li pata ca khaapahmuo na ri li riypata Abyipaming ta yi khazaa ma bie ica pakuo sa aa?” a ta.

Cakhutaata Mikaiah ta, “Israel ming bangkhuo ca khietuv a hnyi lipa tuv haata tluocung lie amaa chepatlaa diypa khana i hmung; cakhutaata Abyipata, ‘Hingpa tie hingta byi hnyi va yi; ama cyicuo hingta diena hne ing luo cakuo yi se,’ a ta,” a ta.
Israel siepahruo ta Jehoshafat kyihuo khata, “Hingpa paa hingta ca rana kaw ta li pata kama tlechuo riypa profetbiephu suokha hmuo ri'a vyi,’ ica ta cuo va ma?” a ta.
Cakhutaata Mikaiah ta, “Caacuonakawta Abyipa bie kha naathlie tie: A byithude cunglie Abyipaa tu te, a cavyi a cacuo ta vuoruo rieka zaw amaa tupa na i hmung.
Cakhutaata Abyipata, ‘Ramoth-gilead luo sithaw sala a thiy riypata Ahab ca ahungma a dungpahya'a ung ciy?’ a ta. Cakhutaata pakha ta bie suokha ri te a hrangpa pakha ta a hrangpa bie suokha a ri ra.
Thlaapa pakha a vaw te, Abyipahmiekunglie kha a daa te, ‘Kama na a dungpahya'a ang,’ a ta.

Abyipata, ‘Tuokhaatama?’ a ta. Ama ta palie te, ‘Pya'a angte na profet bangkhuo tie hmya lie kha hangna thlaapa i va cuo aa,’ a ta. Cakhutaata Abyipata, ‘Ama kha na dungpahya khu aa; pya la capa ca tue tie,’ a ta.
Caacuonakawta mang tie, Abyipana hingpa na profet bangkhuo tie hmya lie hing hangna thlaapa a chi tli, Abyipana nama cuota rana kha a chi tli,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Khenaanah sacapaa Zedekiah ca Mikaiah'a luo kha a khaw te, a be tung te, “Abyipathlaapa ca nama'a lie bie ri riypata tuokhaapa luopuv tama kama'a taata a pya?” a ta.
Mikaiah ta palie te, “Ingchung chungching khuo lie a nu riypata naa ngiena ning lie khana na pachang aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Israel siepahruo ta bie pi te, ‘Mikaiah kha la ung la, khypuv uvtuv Amon hne siepahruo sacapaa Joash'a luo kha pakaa tie ung.
Cakhutaata, ‘Siepahruo na hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa paa hing thaw pathla ung la, diena hne i vawna te ta sa hne tiy kha a caw vie ta za pi mya ung,’ a ta, ta pata va chang tie ung,” a ta.
Mikaiah ta, “Diena hne na za kaa riypa kieca, Abyipata kama hmuo pata bie ri'a vyi,” a ta. Cakhutaata ama ta, “Thyi tie ung, cawsaa zaw, nama bangkhuo ta thyi tie ung!” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Israel siepahruo hne Judah siepahruo Jehoshafat ca Ramoth-gilead luo kha ama sithaw.

Israel siepahruo ta Jehoshafat kyihuo khata, “Kama ca i hmingsuo a thle'a angte rietuvna luo kha i ngie aa, cuorasala nama ca na siepahruo caw kha a tue tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Israel siepahruo ca a hmingsuo kha a thle te rietuvna chung luo kha aa ngie.
Siria siepahruo ta aa ruole riekabyi sawthung pahning tie kha bie pi yi te, “Israel siepahruo ta li pata ca a le a caw ta ahunghmuo tuv'a va ung ciy,” a ta.
Aruole riekabyi tie ta Jehoshafat kha ama hmung tiyta, “Hingpa hingna Israel siepahruo ta a cuo,” ama ta. Caacuonakawta ama kha tuv riypata amaa maahnue ca Jehoshafat ca a khi.
Aruole riekabyi tie ta ama ca Israel siepahruo ta cuo vyi tapa kha ama pachang tiyta, amaa cadena taa khata ama kaase.

Cuorasala cawsaa pakha ta a cuoti kha a da te, e pawliy li pata a ka ca Israel siepahruo ca a thaa buohryi hne a cacunghnaapakaw aa tawna lie kha a khe; caacuonakawta aa ruole a mawtuvpa kyihuo khata, “A maa la rietuvna chung taa hingta na pyakhyi tie, hmaa na i hmung,” a ta.

Capa ning ca rie-atuvna kha a ruv hringhruo, siepahruo ca zuoluo a thiyna te khata Siria ming'a luo aa hyipa khata aa ruole cunglie ca ama dyile, a hmaa taata thiy ca aruole dakhang luo kha a lang pathla.
Zuoluo ning a tlapa khata rieka ming hrawlie kha, “Niema nama khy hne nama ruo cyicuo luo kha tlung diy ung luo!” ta pata ama u.
Cahaacata siepahruo ca thiy te Samaria luo ama sikhyi; iema ta siepahruo ca Samaria lie ama paby.
Aruole kha Samaria tiy-ang lieta ama pasiy; Abyipata a ripa bie haa khata uv ta a thiy kha pali yi te, siyhrawnung zaw kha a chunglie amaa siy.
Ahab tuesana aa ngaapa tie hne a tuepa bangkhuo, hne ale nue ta a sapa ing hne a sapa khypuv bangkhuo ca Israel Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv liena aa cape cuo va ma?
Cahaacata Ahab ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a zie te a sacapaa Ahaziah ta aa thle.
Israel siepahruo Ahab siepahruo a cuonapa a kung paliyna lieta Asa sacapaa Jehoshafat ca Judah ming cunglie siepahruo cuo hruo a pathu.
Jehoshafat ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa pathu ningta a kung sawthung kung pangaa cuo te, Jerusalem taata kung kiy kung pangaa a uv. A nung ming ca Azubah cuo te, Shili sacanung ta a cuo.

Ama ta a paa Asa luopuv bangkhuo kha a ziy diy; capa taa cata pie vyi, Abyipahmungna lieta a phapa kha a tue; cuorasala khahrungtluobu tie kha para vyi, cawsaa ta khahrungtluobu lie kha hriykhung a ri yi te rangpa-ue ama pihluo ngiethie kalie.
Jehoshafat ta Israel siepahruo hne arena zaw kha a tue.
Jehoshafat tuesana aa ngaapa tie, hne a cahrana a paluo sapa, hne tuokhaatama rie aa du tapa tie ca Judah Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv liena aa cape cuo va ma?
A paa Asa chuo ningta a zaa ngaapa siyhrawnung hne siyhrawpaa bangkhuo kha a ruo chungtaata a pahli diy yi.
Edom lieta siepahruo aw vyi; ama cuopa ta a uvpa khata siepahruo ta a cuo thluo.
Jehoshafat ta Ofir luo siy va phya riypata Tarshish tiypalaw kha a sa yi; cuorasala si va yi, tahematapakieca tiypalaw tie ca Ezion-geber lie kha ama ra diy.
Cakhutaata Ahab sacapaa Ahaziah ta Jehoshafat kyihuo khata, “I changtaapa tie kha na changtaapa tie hneta tiypalaw lie si ra yi se,” a ta. Cuorasala Jehoshafat ta khing vyi.
Jehoshafat ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a zie te, a paa David khypuv lie a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha ama paby. A sacapaa Jehoram ta ama kha aa thle.
Judah siepahruo Jehoshafat siepahruo a cuona kung hraa hlyisariyna lie kha Ahab sacapaa Ahaziah ta Israel ming kha Samaria taata uv hruo aa pathu; Israel ming cunglie kha kung hning siepahruo a cuo.
Abyipahmungna lie kha a pha lipa tue te, a paa hne a nung luopuv kha cuose, Israel ming a pasue satuv, Nebat sacapaa Jeroboam luopuv kha a ziy.
Baal re kha hrie te aa bie; a paa ta a tuepa haata Abyipa, Israel siepahruo kha a hi a pahaa.
Ahab a thiy khutaata Moab ta Israel kha aa du.

Ahaziah ca Samaria lie ing a cung duo aziena khuo thlaluo-aw taa khata tla te aa kung thluo. Caacuonakawta biephyatuv kha pathlie yi te, “Si ung la Ekron khy khazing Baal-zebub kha hingpa pasana taa hingta i tluo'a ma tluo'a va ang ma ta pata va hiehriy tie ung,” a ta yi.

Cuorasala Abyipaavuoming ta Tishbe ming Elijah kyihuo khata, “Thu la Samaria siepahruo biephyatuv tie kha a taw riypata si la iema kyihuo khata, ‘Israel lie Khazing a aw li nakawta ma Ekron khy khazing kha bie hiehriy riypata nama si'a nang? ta tie yi,’ a ta.
Caacuonakawta Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri, ‘Ata naa zienapa iehmang taa khata thu'a va tli ciy, na thiy hrahring aa,’ a ta, a ta.
Biephyatuv tie ca siepahruo'a luo kha vya kaa yi te, ama ta, ‘Khaapanakawma nama vya kaa?’ a ta yi.

Iema ta, “Kiema a taw riypata cawsaa pakha a vaw te, ama ta, ‘Niema caa pathlietuv yi siepahruo'a luo kha kaa ung la ama kyihuo khata: Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: ‘Israel lie Khazing a aw li nakawta ma Ekron khy Baal-zebub khazing kha bie hiehriy riypata cawsaa na pathlie yi? Caacuonakawta naa zienapa iehmang taa khata thu'a va tli ciy, na thiy hrahring aa, ta pata va chang tie ung,’ a ta, ama ta.
Ama ta iema kyihuo khata, “Tuokhaapa cawsaa ma niema a taw riypata a vaw te cahaapa ca caa chang yi,” a ta.
Iema ta ama kha palie yi te, “A hming rungsa te a se lie savang tesaw a sawpa tana a cuo,” ama ta. Ama ta, “Tishbe ming Elijah tana a cuo,” a ta.

Cakhutaata siepahruo ta ama'a luo kha a cawsaa sawngaa hneta riekabyi pakha a pathlie. Tluodaw lie a tupa Elijah'a luo kha khaw te, ama kyihuo khata, “Vya Khazing cawsaapa, siepahruo na, ‘Za cung tie,’ caa ta,” a ta.

Cuorasala Elijah ta sawngaa tie riekabyi kyihuo khata, “Kama hing Khazing cawsaa ta i cuo kieca, avuo taata myi za tla sala nama hne na sawngaa tie kha ca kuosa diy yi se,” a ta. Cakhutaata myi ca avuo taata za tla te ama hne a sawngaa tie kha a kuosa diy yi.

Siepahruo ta sawngaa uvtuv a hrangpa riekabyi pakha hne a cawsaa sawngaa tie kha a pathlie pakhaa yi. Sithaw te ama kyihuo khata, “Vya Khazing cawsaapa, hingpa hing siepahruo biepina tana a cuo: A catli pata za cung tie!” a ta.

Cuorasala Elijah ta palie te, “Kama hing Khazing cawsaa ta i cuo kieca avuo taata myi za tla sala nama hne na sawngaa tie kha ca kuosa diy yi se,” a ta. Cakhutaata myi ca avuo taata za tla te ama hne a sawngaa tie kha a kuosa diy yi.

Cakhutaata siepahruo ta sawngaa uvtuv a pathungnapa riekabyi pakha hne a cawsaa sawngaa tie kha a pathlie pakhaa yi. Caacuonakawta a pathungnapa riekabyi ca khaw te, Elijah hmiekunglie kha a pakhuv pane te, “Vya Khazing cawsaapa, kama hringna, hne hingpa changtaapa sawngaa tie hringna hing na hmiekunglieta muosungpa cuo thi se.
Mang tie, myi ca avuo taa khata za tla te rieka sawngaa uvtuv riekabyi tie kha ama cawsaa sawngaa tie hneta a kuo diy yi; cuorasala i hringna hing na hmiekunglieta muosungpa ta cuo thi se,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipaavuoming ta Elijah kyihuo khata, “Ama'a lie kha sibung tie, ama kha ciy khah,” a ta. Caacuonakawta a thu te ama hne cata siepahruo'a luo kha ama sibung.

Cakhutaata ama kyihuo khata, “Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Nama ta Baal-zebub bie hiehriy riypata biephyatuv na pathliepa yi ca Israel ruo lie hing bie hiehriy riypa Khazing a aw li nakawta ma a cuo? Caacuonakawta naa zienapa iehmang taa khata thu'a va tli ciy, na thiy hrahring aa,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Elijah ta a ripa Abyipabie haata ama ca a thiy. Ahaziah ca sacapaa a hnyi li nakawta, Judah siepahruo Jehoshafat sacapaa Jehoram siepahruo a hrienapa a kung hningna lie kha a nuta Jehoram ta aa thle.
Ahaziah tuesana hne a tuepa tie ca Israel Siepahruo tie Chuorina caa-uv liena aa cape cuo va ma?
Abyipata Elijah ca thliysung ta avuo luo a calang'a nang tiy khata, Elijah hne Elisha ca Gilgal luo ama si ningta a cuo.

Elijah ta Elisha kyihuo khata, “Hingpa lie hing za aw tie; tahematapakieca Abyipana Bethel te si riypata naa chang,” a ta. Cuorasala Elisha ta, “Abyipakha hring te nama hrahring zaw na hringpa haata, nama kha ca thuse'a va ang,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Bethel luo kha ama sibung.

Bethel lie a awpa profet tie kha Elisha'a luo a vaw yi te, “Ataning Abyipata na ziypaapa kha nama'a taata a la aa tapa kha na pachang ma?” ama ta. Ama ta, “A cuo, i pachang; a dieta tah aw tie ung,” a ta yi.

Elijah ta ama kyihuo khata, “Elisha, hingpa lie hing za aw tie; tahematapakieca Abyipana Jeriko te si riypata naa chang,” a ta. Cuorasala ama ta, “Abyipakha hring te nama hrahring zaw na hringpa haata, nama kha ca thuse'a va ang,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Jeriko luo kha ama pha.

Jeriko lie a awpa profet tie kha Elisha athaa luo ca a vaw yi te, ama kyihuo khata, “Ataning Abyipata na ziypaapa kha nama'a taata a la aa tapa kha na pachang ma?” ama ta. Ama ta, “A cuo, i pachang; a dieta tah aw tie ung,” a ta yi.

Cakhutaata Elijah ta ama kyihuo khata, “Hingpa lie hing za aw tie; tahematapakieca Abyipana Jordan luo si riypata naa chang,” a ta. Cuorasala ama ta, “Abyipakha hring te nama hrahring zaw na hringpa haata, nama kha ca thuse'a va ang,” a ta. Caacuonakawta ama pahning ta ama sile.
Sawngaa a tapa profet phuv tie zaw kha si ra yi te, Jordan cavaa kielie ama pahning ta amaa daa ning kha, iema'a taata aa hlapuonapa lie khata amaa daa.
Cakhutaata Elijah ta a buohryi pasiypa kha la te, kalang te tiy kha aa hluo; ama pahning ta alyi huvpa luo ama va chiyna te khata tiy ca kuokhaluo hne a hrangpa kuokhaluo khata aa che.

Ama va te khutaa khata, Elijah ta Elisha kyihuo khata, “Kama kha nama'a taata lapa i cuo hluo hingta khaapama ica tuepa aa tapa kha na chang tie,” a ta. Elisha ta, “Na thlaapa hing le hning ta cu thi ang se,” a ta.

Ama ta palie te, “A ruv ciemuopa na ina hie ciy; cuorasala, nama'a taata ina lathawpa yi hingna na hmung ta pata a cuo kieca, capa ca pi pata na cuo aa; cata a cuo li kieca, pi pata cuo'a vaciy,” a ta.
Cakuole yi te bie ama ripuolepa khata, myi aruole hne myi aruo ta iema pahning kha che yi te, cakhutaata Elijah ca thliysung ta avuo luo a kie.
Elisha ta capa ca hmung te, “I paa, i paa! Israel ming aruole hne aa ruo rieka tie! ta te a khi. Cuorasala a hmung khu li tli taa khata, ama a caw kha patuv te che hning ta a thlaa.
Ama ta zaa tlapa Elijah buohryi pasiypa kha a haa te, kaa te Jordan cavaa kielie kha aa daa.

Ama'a luo zaa tlapa Elijah buohryi pasiypa kha la te, tiy kha a hluo te, “Abyipa, Elijah Khazing ca khaapaliema a aw?” a ta. Tiy kha a tuv tiyta, tiy ca kuokhaluo hne a hrangpa kuokhaluo khata a che te, Elisha ca capa lie ca ta ava te.
Jeriko lie a awpa profet phuv tie khata luohlaa taata ama hmung tiyta, “Elijah thlaapa na Elisha cunglie a aw,” ama ta. A taw riypata a vaw yi te, a hmiekunglie, alyi lie kha amaa bu.

Iema ta, “Mang tie, na changtaapa zaw hrawlie hing cawsaa thaaruvpa sawngaa ma hnyi yi; vaa yi sala na byipaapa ca va huv yi se; Abyipathlaapa ta calang tena, tluo suokhakha cunglie ma, acuolikie bawphie suokhakha chunglie ma a pathla pata a cuo thlu aa,” ama ta. Ama ta palie yi te, “Cuo vyi, pathlie khah ung,” a ta yi.
Cuorasala iema ta ama kha a palung a pachungna te ta amaa nue tiyta, ama ta, “Pathlie tie ung,” a ta yi. Caacuonakawta cawsaa sawngaa kha pathlie yi te, ning thung chung huv yi te hmung va yi.
Ama'a luo kha ama vya kaa tiyta (ama ca Jeriko lie kha a aw kalie), iema kyihuo khata, “Vaa khah ung la ca ta va yi ang ma?” a ta yi.
Khypuv cawsaa tie ca ta Elisha kyihuo khata, “Hingpa khypuv a awnapa hmang hing a pha, ma byipaapa na hmungpa haa hingta; cuorasala tiy hing pha li pata, ruo chunglie hing kung vyi vyi,” ama ta.
Ama ta, kuotung thaapa suokha kha a chunglie paciy chi ung la na vya pi tie ung,” a ta. Caacuonakawta capa ca ama'a luo ama vya cyi.

Cakhutaata tiyhnaa luo kha vaa te, paciy kha va phuv te, “Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa tiy hing i pathe sa tli; Ata taa hingta ca thiyna cuose, nu rana cuose hingpa tiy taa hingta puv'a va tli,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Elisha ta a ripa bie haata tiy ca ataning tepa hingta a pathe.

Capa taa cata Bethel luo kha a sithaw; luopuv lie a sithawpa khata khypuv chungtaata capaasaata chekha kha kya pya yi te, ama kha pahnyisue yi te, “Luvtlawpaa, cakuo tie! Luvtlawpaa cakuo tie! ama ta.
A pali te a hmung yi ca, Abyipaming ta chie a sa yi. Cakhutaata cavawpuvnung sahning ca ruo chungtaata kya pya te, capaasaata sawliy pahning a sie yi.
Capa taa cata Karmel Tluo luo kha si te, cakhutaata Samaria luo kha a kaa.
Jehoshafat ta Judah siepahruo acuona kung hraa hlyicarina lieta Ahab sacapaa Jehoram ca Samaria lieta Israel siepahruo ta cuo te, kung hraa hlyihning a uv yi.
Ama ta Abyipahmungna lie a pha lipa hmang kha a tue, cuorasala a paa hne a nung haata ca cuo vyi, tahematapakieca a paa ta a tuepa Baal lungbang kha a thaw diy.
Cuorasala Nebat sacapaa Jeroboam ta Israel ming a pasue sanapa yi suena kha thuse vyi.
Moab ming siepahruo Mesha ca tuv a ziypa ta cuo te, Israel siepahruo kha tuvtaata tingkha, hne tuvtungpa tingkha hming kha pi pari riypata a cuo.
Cuorasala Ahab kha a thiy tiyta, Moab siepahruo ta Israel siepahruo kha aa du.
Caacuonakawta siepahruo Jehoram ca Samaria taata pya te Israel ming bangkhuo kha a pahmya yi.
Judah siepahruo Jehoshafat kha bie taa te, “Moab siepahruo na kama kha naa du, Moab kha tuv riypata kama kha ina ziy'a ca ma?” a ta.
Cakhutaata ama ta, “Khaapa luopuv taata ma ma si aa? ta te a hiehriy. Jehoram ta palie te, “Edom ruocaapa luopuv taata,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Israel siepahruo, Judah siepahruo hne Edom siepahruo ca amaa tha. Aa cahlung pata ning sariy chung ama si tiyta, iema hneta a awpa rieka tie cuota cuose, sahring cuota cuose tiy aw vyi.
Cakhutaata Israel siepahruo ta, “Ah! Abyipamuo kiema siepahruo pathung hing Moab kuv luo pi riypata malie a u ta,” a ta.

Cuorasala Jehoshafat ta, “Hingpa lie hing ama'a taata Abyipama hiehriy thena riypata Abyipaprofet aw va ma?” a ta. Cakhutaata Israel siepahruo changtaapa pakha ta palie te, “Shafat sacapaa Elisha, Elijah kuv lie tiy a bya tawpa kha hingpa lie hingna a aw,” a ta.
Jehoshafat ta, “Abyipabie ca ama'a lieta a aw,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Israel siepahruo hne Jehoshafat hne Edom siepahruo ca ama'a luo kha ama sibung.

Elisha ta Israel siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Nama hneta i tue riypa khaapama a aw? Na paa profet tie acuolikie na nung profet tie'a luo kha cakuo tie,” a ta. Cuorasala Israel siepahruo ta ama kyihuo khata, “Cuo vyi; Moab kuv chung luo pi riypata kiema siepahruo pathung tie malie a kupa hing Abyipatana a cuo,” a ta.

Elisha ta, “A re i hriepa Cungnungce Abyipaa hringpa haata, Judah siepahruo Jehoshafat hmie hing mang li pata aw ang sala ca nama hing ca a mang zaw ca mang ra'a va ang, a hmung zaw ca hmung ra'a va ang.
Cuorasala tingtuo a tung thepa kha a vawkhyi tie ung,” a ta. Cakhutaata tingtuo a tungpa ta a tung nguoluo ning kha, Abyipacahrana ca a cunglie kha a tlung.
Cakhutaata ama ta, “Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: ‘Kama na hingpa cavaata hing tiyliy ta a pabi'a ang,’ a ta.

Caacuonakawta Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri, ‘Niema ta thliy cuose, khytiy cuose hmung'a va ung ciy, cuorasala niema, nama cue, hne nama sahring zaw nama dang riypata cavaata ca tiy ta a bi aa,’ a ta.
Hingpa hing Abyipaming hmungna lie ca hmang cawta tana a cuo, tahematapakieca Moab zaw hing nama kuv cung luo na aca pi'a yi.
Niema ta dungkhuopa khypuv bangkhuo hne khy phapa mekaa kha nama te aa; thingkung phapa mekaa kha hu'a ung cate, acaa bangkhuo kha paping'a ung cate alyi phana mekaa kha alung ta nama para aa,” a ta.
A mawluopa maw hriykhung a ri tiyta sungkhabala ta Edom luo taa khata tiy za lang te, ruo chung bangkhuo tiy ta a bi.

Moab ming bangkhuo ta siepahruo tie na iema a du riypata a kya sithaw yi tapa kha ama thyi tiyta, cehre a cyi khupa bangkhuo, a syi ce taata a uvthyi ce te ta ku pathla yi te ruoriy lie kha hmang ama la.
Iema ca mawdiy ta ama kya thu tiyta, ning ta tiy kha khe te Moab ming ta iema a rie-e lie tiy kha thiy haata a se pata ama va hmung.
Iema ta, “Thiy tana a cuo; siepahruo tie kha pakha hne pakha a tuv yi te na amaa thie. Caacuonakawta Moab ming ta hruosue chuv'a ung puv!” ama ta.
Cuorasala Israel ming arina hmang luo kha ama vaa tiyta, Israel ming ta thu yi te Moab ming kha ama tuv; iema hmiekunglie kha a ruo yi te, Moab ruo chung luo amaa ngiena te ta ama thiele.

Khypuv zaw kha para yi te, alyi phanapa mekaa kha a buvna te ta alung ama thawsue, acaa bangkhuo kha ama paping, thingkung phapa bangkhuo kha ama hu. Kir-hareseth lie dyi kha alung tlepie kha pangaa yi te, alung pahie vaa a thepa tie ta cadung yi te ama tuv.
Moab siepahruo ta te khu'a va tli yi ang tapa kha a pachang tiyta, Edom siepahruo kuo luo khata chipachung riypata zueziy a cyipa zasariy a la yi te ama tuv, cuorasala te khu va yi.

Cakhutaata ama a thle riypata a sa taapa a sacapaa kha la te, khy dungkhuo lungrue tlepie lie kha myirue panaana ta a pihluo. Cakhutaata Israel ming ca ama hi haa hringhruo te, ama'a taa khata hnangluo a saw yi te, ama ruo luo ama kaa.

Profet phuv chungtaata pakhapa napuv ta Elisha kyihuo khata, “Na changtaapa i navaapa na a thiy; na pachangpa haata ama ca Abyipaa ciyzaapa ta a cuo, cuorasala lyibuo maa awkhyipa paa ta i sacapaa pahning tie kha sii ta a la riypata aa vaw mangtli,” a ta.
Elisha ta ama kyihuo khata, “Khaapama ica tuepa aa? Ing lie khaapama na hnyi tapa kha na chang tie,” a ta. Ama ta, “Na changtaanung hingta chiytiy bi kha ta li pata i hnyipa aw vyi,” a ta.
Ama ta, “Pya la, na ingpaa zaw bangkhuo kha bi vaa hluo tie yi, bi hripa kha, a cawta dyi cuo li pata,” a ta.
Cakhutaata a ngie la, nama hne na saata zaw hne khata ingchiy a khaakhung ung la hingpa bi bangkhuo hing chiytiy raw tie ung, suokha a bi pahne ta a hrang ta chi lawmaw mya ung,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta ama'a taa cata cakuo yi te, ama hne a saata zaw hne cata ingchiy a kya khaakhung yi te, iema ta bi ca vya cyi yi te ama ta a raw lawmaw.
Bi zaw kha a bi tiyta ama ta a saata zaw kyihuo khata, “Bi hrangpa kha vya cyi tie ung,” a ta. Cuorasala ama ta, “A hrangpa aw va tli,” a ta. Cakhutaa cata chiytiy ca za lang va tli.

Khazing cawsaapa'a luo kha a vaw te Khazing cawsaapa kha a chang, ama ta, “Cakuo la chiytiy kha va zaa la na lyibuo kha thung tie, aa ngaapa khata nama hne na saata zaw hneta khy va sana tie ung,” a ta.
Ning kha ca Elisha kha a hnyirungsapa cawsaanung awnapa Shunam luo vaa te, ama ta saning a ku. Caacuonakawta capa luo a capiepaa ning mekaa ca sa ning riypata aa ngiepaa taw.
Ama ta a navaapa kyihuo khata, “Mang tie, kiema'a luo a vya ngiepaa tawpa cawsaapa hing Khazing cawsaa pathepa tana a cuo tapa kha i pachang.

A cung duo lie tlepie chungkhuopa a khuo baata suokha sapa se pala, capa lie ca iehmang suokha, cabya suokha, thude suokha, hne myi-ing suokha chipa ung sala, kiema'a luo aa vaw kyry ta a awna riypata cuo se,” a ta.
Ning kha ca capa luo ca vya pha te a cungduo ingkhuo chunglie ca aa pahy.
A changtaapa Gehazi kyihuo khata, “Shunam cawsaanung kha ku tie,” a ta. A ku tiyta, a hmiekunglie kha a vya daa.

Ama ta a changtaapa kyihuo khata, “Hing tluv hingta malie na mangsang; khaapama na cuota maca tuepa aa? Siepahruo'a luo cuose, riekabyi le cepa'a luo cuose changpa riypa bie na hnyi ma? ta tie,” a ta. Ama ta, “I cawsaa zaw hrawlie tana khy i sa,” a ta.
Ama ta, “Caacuokieca hingpa nung cuo hingta khaapama ma tuepa aa?” a ta. Gehazi ta, “A pha, hingpa nung hing sacapaa hnyi vyi, a navaapa ta a macuo tli,” a ta.
Ama ta, “Ku tie,” a ta. Ama kha a ku tiyta, chiypakaa athaalie kha aa daa.
Ama ta, “Huokung, ata tiy, a cuo aa de ningta sacapaa naa paw aa,” a ta. Capa nung ca ta, “Cuo vyi, i byipaapa, Vya Khazing cawsaapa; na changtaanung hing na dung thi khah,” a ta.
Cawsaanung ca nu phya te a huokungpa capa cuo lie ca ta Elisha ta a ripa haata sacapaa a sa.
Haatiypa ca kya uvthyi viele te, ning kha ca a paa'a luo sa a hriepa tie'a luo kha a cakuo ra.
A paa kyihuo khata, “I luv na a pasa, i luv na a pasa,” a ta. A paa ta a changtaapa kyihuo khata, “A nung'a luo kha cabale tie,” a ta.
Ama ta a nung'a luo kha a cabale. Haatiypa ca a nung baw cunglie kha ningchung te a tu te a thiy.
Ama ta a cungduo luo kha kiekhyi te Khazing cawsaapa iehmang lie kha pazie te a thuse.
