Cakhutaata a navaapa kha ku te, “Khazing cawsaapa'a luo kha a catlisa pata cakuo'a angte i vya kaa pakhaa riypata changtaapa pakha hne laa sakha kha na vya paphya tie,” a ta.
Ama ta, “Khaapanakawma ataning cata ama'a luo ca na cakuo aa? Thla thaapa ning zaw cuo vyi, sabbath ning zaw ta cuo vyi,” a ta. A napuvnung ca ta, “I cakuo pata na a pha aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata laa kha a kedie padie te a changtaapa kyihuo khata, “Sahring kha pasi sa tie, ica changpa a aw li kieca pahaa sa khah,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta a tha te Karmel Tluo, Khazing cawsaapa'a luo kha a pha. Khazing cawsaapa ta ava hmung tiyta a changtaapa Gehazi kyihuo khata, “Shunam cawsaanung hue mang tie;
a ruo la va daw tie, Na tluo ma? Na navaapa a tluo ma? Haatiypa a tluo ma? va ta tie,” a ta. Ama ta, “Ma tluo diy,” ta pata a palie.

Tluo lie Khazing cawsaapa luo a pha tiyta, a phyi kha a patuv. Gehazi ta thlu riypata aa vaw ca, Khazing cawsaapa ta, “Aw thluo se, tahematapakieca a palung rie na a thyi hringhruo; Abyipata capa ca na nukhuo te na chang vyi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata ama ta, “I byipaapa kha sacapaa icaa hie ma? Na dung khah la ca za ta va ang ma?” a ta.

Ama ta Gehazi kyihuo khata, “Na pahriy kha a pasi la, na khuecahryi kha a la lah si tie. Pakhakha naa taw kie yi ma bie a chang khah yi, pakhakha ta bie acaa chang kie zaw yi ma palie khah yi; cakhutaata i khuecahryi kha haatiypa hmie cunglie kha va pahlaa tie,” a ta.
Cakhutaata haatiypa a nung ta, “Abyipahring te, nama hrahring zaw na hringpa haata, nama li pata ca si'a va ang,” a ta. Caacuonakawta thu te a paziy.
Gehazi kha hmaasa te haatiypa hmie cunglie kha khuecahryi ca a pahlaa, cuorasala ueryi hne a hringpa aa hnangnapa aw vyi. Kaa te Khazing cawsaapa kyihuo khata, “Haatiypa ca a kya hra vyi,” a ta.
Elisha kha ing chung luo aa ngie tiyta, haatiypa ca a thiy pata iehmang lie aa ziepa kha a hmung.
Caacuonakawta a ngie te, iema pahning dyi aw riypata ingchiy khaa te, Abyipa'a luo kha thlaa a chuo.
Cakhutaata haatiypa cunglie kha a bu te, a pakaa lie a pakaa, a ming lie a ming, a kuv lie a kuv ta pata chi te, a cunglie aa bu ca, haatiypa ngesaa ca a kya lung.
Thu te, a khuo lie kha a cakuo bungthaw khutaata a cunglie kha aa bu pakhaa; haatiypa ca yi sariy kya hachy te a ming a kya padyi.
Elisha ta Gehazi kha u te, “Shunam cawsaanung kha ku tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta a ku. Cawsaanung ca Elisha'a luo aa khaw tiyta, “Na sacapaa kha a la tie,” a ta.
A phyi thabaw lie, alyi lie kha a bu te, cakhutaa cata a sacapaa kha a la te a pya.

Elisha kha Gilgal luo a kaa tiyta, capa ruo lie ca cakuo a tlung ningta a cuo. Profet phuv tie kha a hmiekunglie a tu yi te, a changtaapa kyihuo khata, “Bi lesapa kha khang la, profet phuv tie cuo hingta tiyhuo chang tie,” a ta.

Iema hrawtaata pakha ca uohnaasiyyhnaa huv riypata ruo luo kha si te, ruo ungthyi riy suokha kha a hmung. Ungthyi kha lu te a phya khu thiy ta vya phya te, a ce te khaapatama a cuo tapa kha pachang li pata tiyhuo bi luo ca a thung.
Ning riypata ama pachie. Cuorasala ama ning tiyta, khi yi te, “Vya Khazing cawsaapa, bi chungliena thiyna a aw!” a ma ta. Ning khu va yi.
Ama ta, “Jungsacuo viedie kha vya cyi tie ung,” a ta. Capa ca tiyhuo bi chungluo kha thla te, “Pachie ung la ning yi se,” a ta. Bi chunglie ca riethyi a pi khupa suokha hmuo aw vyi.
Baal-shalishah taata cawsaapa pakha ta Khazing cawsaapa'a luo kha sathaapa sa, Jungsacuo viechuo tluo kiy hne sachuo kha chawkue ta a vya cyi. Elisha ta, “Cawsaa kha pi ung la ning yi se,” a ta.

Cuorasala a changtaapa ta, “Hingpa hing tuokhaatama cawsaa zakha hmielie i pachie the aa?” a ta. Caacuonakawta Elisha ta ri pakhaa te, “Cawsaa kha pi yi la ning yi se, Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: ‘Ning'a yi te chekha ca a hlyi kalie aa,’ a ta,” a ta.
Iema hmiekunglie kha pachie te, ama ning, cakhutaata Abyipabie haata, chekha a hlyi kalie.

Siria siepahruo riekabyi le cepa Naaman ca cawsaa lepa hne a byipaapa hmiekunglie hmiephaa a hmungpa ta a cuo, tahematapakieca Abyipata ama thueta Siria kha tena a pi nakawta a cuo. Ama ca a thaaruvpa riebyi a cuo raalaa pata caahminghmaa pasana a hnyipa ta a cuo.
Siria ming ta rietuvna luo ama si pata yi kha ca Israel ruo taata lesaanungta kha patuv yi te, Naaman napuvnung rehriepatuv ta aa li.
A ziynungnung kyihuo khata, “I byipaapa hing Samaria lie a awpa profet'a luo chiy khu sala ca! Caahminghmaa pasanapa hing a patluo sa aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Naaman ca a byipaapa'a luo kha a ngie te Israel ruo taata lesaanung ta a ripa kha a chang.
Siria siepahruo ca ta, “Si tie, Israel siepahruo kha caa i paphya aa,” a ta. Caacuonakawta si te, ngu talen suohraa, siy shekel thawcaruv, hne caw thang suohraa aa phya.

Israel siepahruo'a luo kha caa suokha a phyale te, a chunglie ca, “Hingpa caa hing nama'a luo a vya pha tiyta, i changtaapa Naaman kha caahminghmaa pasana taata na patluo sa riypa tana nama'a luo ica vya paphya tapa kha pachang mya,” ta pata a cuo.

Israel siepahruo ta caa ca a ri tiyta, a caw kha thlaa te, “Kama ca a pathiy khupa hne a pahring khupa Khazing tama i cuo, hingpa cawsaa hingta cawsaa pakha kha caahminghmaa pasana taata patluo sa riypata bie ina vya taa. Mang ung la hmung tie ung, kama hne a hru riypa a huvnazya hing,” a ta.

Cuorasala Israel siepahruo ta a caw a thlaapa kha Khazing cawsaapa Elisha ta a thyi tiyta, ama ta siepahruo'a luo kha biephyatuv pathlie te, “Khaapanakawma na caw ca na thlaa? Israel ming chunglie profet a aw tapa kha a pachang the riypata kama'a luo kha a vaw se,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Naaman ca aa ruo hne aa ruole hneta vya pha te Elisha ing thlake lie kha aa daa.
Elisha ta biephyatuv pakha kha ama'a luo pathlie te, “Cakuo la Jordan cavaa chunglie kha yi sariy a siy tie, na thiysaa kha a sa pathiy'a te na pathe aa, ta tie” a ta.

Cuorasala Naaman ca a hi haa pata cakuo te, “Kama'a luo kha kya pya'a tena, Abyipaa Khazing ming kha aa daa luo ta ku'a te, i hmaa lie hing a kuv khang'a te caahminghmaa hing a patluo sa thlu aa, ta pata muo i rue ta!
Damaskas lie Abana hne Pharpar cavaa tiy zaw kha Israel cavaa tiy bangkhuo laata pha vie va yi ma? Capa lie ca a siy pata pathe'a va ang ma?” a ta. A pali te a hi haasa pata a cakuo.

Cuorasala a changtaapa tie ta aa thaa luo kha vaa yi te, “Ima paa, profet hing ta a ruv viepa tue riypa suokhakha ca chang sala tue li pata na aw'a ma? ‘Vaa siy la pathe tie,’ tapa hing kha tluv tama tue vie riypata a cuo?” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta zuv te Khazing cawsaapa bie haa khata Jordan cavaa chunglie kha yi sariy aa naw; a thiysaa ca satlie panuta thiysaa haa khata a sa pathiy te a pathe.

Cakhutaata ama hne a cawsaa zaw hne khata Khazing cawsaapa'a luo kha kaa yi te, a vaw te a hmiekunglie kha a daa te, “Israel lie ta li pata alyi lie hing Khazing hrangpa aw vyi tapa kha i pachang; na changtaapa'a taata lasaw hing cuhluo thi tie,” a ta.
Cuorasala ama ta, “A re i hriepa Abyipaa hringpa haata, khaapahmuo cuhluo'a va ang!” a ta. Cuhluo riypata paa a kie ciemuo raalaa pata cuhluo vyi.

Cakhutaata Naaman ta, “Cahaacata a cuo li kieca, na changtaapa hing alyi pahning phya na pi tie; tahematapakieca na changtaapa hingta Abyipata li pata khaapa khazing hmuo myirue panaana acuolikie hriykhungrina pihluo'a va tli ang.

Cuorasala hingpa suokha kawlie hingta ca Abyipata naa ngiethe thi se: I byipaapa kha abie riypata Rimmon ing chung luo aa ngie tiyta i buo kha naa hy te Rimmon ing lie kha i bung ra, cahaacata Rimmon ing chunglie i bung ra tiyta Abyipata hingpa suokha kawlie hing ca naa ngiethe thi se,” a ta. Ama ta, “Diena hneta cakuo tie,” a ta.
Cuorasala Naaman ca ama'a taata a cawta a cakuopa khata,

Khazing cawsaapa Elisha changtaapa Gehazi ta, “I byipaapa ta Siria ming Naaman ca a pihluopa kha khaapahmuo cuhluo li pata a na tuv ta a pathlie tli. Abyipaa hringpa haa khata, vaa cade'a angte na ama'a taata chekha chuo i la buo aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Gehazi ta Naaman kha aa cade. Pakhakha ta aa vya cadepa kha Naaman ta a hmung tiyta, ama a taw riypa khata aruole taa khata cung te, “Zezaw bangkhuo pha diy ma?” a ta.

Ama ta, “A pha diy, cuorasala i byipaapa ta na pathlie te, ‘Profet tie phuv chungtaata pahning kha Efraim tluocung ruo taata kama'a luo atabala hing za pha yi te, ngu talen suokha hne caw zung hning pi thi tie yi, aca ta,’ a ta.

Naaman ta, “Talen suohning hing cuhluo thi tie,” a ta. Cakhutaata khuosa ta paakie te, ngu talen suohning ca chawkue lie kha ciypuo te, caw zung hning hne khata a changtaapa pahning tie kha pi yi te, Gehazi hmiekunglie kha capa ca ama phyale.
Khy dungkhuo te ama pha tiyta, chawkue kha iema'a taata la te, ing chunglie kha chi te, cawsaa kha a pakaa sa yi.

Ing chung luo kha a ngie te, a byipaapa hmiekunglie kha aa tu; cakhutaata Elisha ta ama kyihuo khata, “Khaapa luo ma na cakuo, Gehazi?” a ta. Ama ta, “Na changtaapa hing khaapa luo hmuo cakuo va ang,” a ta.

Cuorasala ama ta, “Nama a taw riypata cawsaapa aa ruole taata a cung ning kha i thlaapa ta nama'a lie si va ang ma? Ata cuo hing tuokaa hne caw, hne olif diedung zaw hne mingsuv diedung zaw, hne tuv hne cuetungpa zaw, hne siicapaa hne siicanung zaw cuhluona cuo ta a cuo ma?
Caacuonakawta Naaman caahminghmaa pasana ca nama hne na ciypathla cunglie chuozaa ta ca kie mang yi sue,” a ta. Caacuonakawta a hmiekung taata caahminghmaa pasana hneta a pya, cahue haata a ruo.
Profet phuv tie ta Elisha kyihuo khata, “Na hmungpa haa hingta, nama luochiyna rawlie ma awnapa hmang hing a caw tuv suesaa.
Jordan cavaa luo khuv zuv ung sala, pakha ta suokha kaluo ta thing a ring sala, ma awna riypa hmang suokha sa ung siy,” ama ta. Ama ta, “Tue tie ung,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata a changtaapa pakha ta, “Na changtaapa zaw'a lie hing a zuv ra tie,” a ta. Ama ta, “I zuv ra aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta iema'a lie kha a cakuo ra. Jordan luo ama pha tiyta thing kha ama hu.
Cuorasala pakhapa ta thing a hu nguoluopa khata, aa hryi thaa kha tiy luo a tla; ama ta khi te, “Ah! i byipaapa, i hluopa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Khazing cawsaapa ta, “Khaapaliema a tla?” a ta. A tlanapa hmang kha a pahmung tiyta, a sung kha thli te, capa luo ca a thaw ca ahryi thaa ca aa kya phang.
Ama ta, “A haa tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta capa paa ca ta a kuv ta za paza te a la.
Luo kha ca Siria siepahruo kha Israel ming hneta rie amaa tuv tiy khata, aa byi tie ruena kha a la. Ama ta, “Capa hmang, khapa hmang lie kha i rina hmang ca a cuo aa,” a ta.
Cuorasala Khazing cawsaapa ta Israel siepahruo'a luo kha bie taa te, “Hingpa hmang hing cahraw tlamu lie ung ciy, tahematapakieca Siria ming na khapa lie kha a sibung yi,” a ta.
Israel siepahruo ta Khazing cawsaapa a ripa hmang luo kha cawsaa a pathlie yi. Cahaacata yi kha yi hning dyi cuo li pata a raaringna pi yi te, a raaringsa pata ama si.

Capa kawlie ca ta Siria siepahruo ca khuopuv ta a palung hring te, aa byi tie kha ku yi te iema kyihuo khata, “Ata hingta na chang tie ung, kiema hrawlie hing ahungma Israel siepahruo kuo luo ta a aw,” a ta.
Cakhutaata aa byi tie hrawtaata pakha ta, “Pakha hmuo aw vapuv, i byipaapa siepahruo. Israel lie a awpa profet Elisha na naa ziena khuo lie na ripa bie kha Israel siepahruo kha a chang,” a ta.
Ama ta, “Vaa ung la khaapaliema a aw tapa kha pachang tie ung, cawsaa pathlie'a angte i patuv khu riypata,” a ta yi. “Dothan liena a aw, ta pata ama chang.
Caacuonakawta aruo hne aruole hne riekaphuv lepuv kha pathlie te, zuo ta va pha yi te khypuv kha ama cadung.
Khazing cawsaapa changtaapa ca mawdiy ta thu te a pya tiyta, aruo hne aruole hne riekaphuv ca khypuv cadung pata ama aw thluo. A changtaapa ca ta, “Ah! i byipaapa, tuokhaatama ma tue aa?” a ta.
Ama ta palie te, “Ciy khah, tahematapakieca iema hne a awpa tie laata kiema hne a awpa tie na a hluv vie yi,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Elisha ca thlaa a chuo: Vya Abyipa, a hmung the riypata a ming kha padyi sa tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Abyipata changtaapa ming kha padyi sa te, a hmung, Elisha cahriy bangkhuo, tluo lie ca aruo hne myi aruole ta a bi.

Siria ming kha ama a du riypata ama za sibung tiyta, Elisha ta Abyipa'a luo kha thlaachuo te, “Hingpa cawsaa tie hing ama ming pacue sa thi tie yi,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Elisha ta a hiepa haa khata ama ming a pacue sa yi.
Elisha ta iema kyihuo khata, “Hingpa hing luopuv, hne khypuv ta cuo vyi, kama hing na ziy tie ung, nama huvpa cawsaapa'a luo kha caa chiy'a yi ang,” a ta yi. Cakhutaata Samaria luo kha aa chiy yi.

Samaria luo amaa ngie pahne ta, Elisha ta, “Vya Abyipa, ama hmung the riypata hingpa cawsaa tie ming hing pahmung sa tie yi,” a ta. Abyipata ama ming kha a pahmung sa yi ca iema ca Samaria khychung lie kha ama aw pata a cuo.
Israel siepahruo ta iema kha a hmung tiy yi ta, “I paa, i thie'a yi ma? I thie'a yi ma?” a ta.

Elisha ta, “Thie'a va yi ciy! Na thie khingpa tie ca na zueziy hne na liy ta na patuv'a yi ma? Ama ning ama dang the riypata sa hne tiy kha ama hmiekunglie hing pachie tie ung; cakhutaa cata ama byipaapa'a luo kha si yi se,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta iema cuota pyi lesapa suokha a tuepa yi; ama ning ama dang khutaa khata ama luopuv luo kha pathlie yi te, ama byipaapa'a luo kha ama si. Cakhutaata Siria tie ca Israel ruo luo kha a du riypata pha buo va tli yi.
Cuo a vya ru vie khutaata Siria Siepahruo Ben-hadad ca a rieka bangkhuo kha pahmya yi te, Samaria kha a du riypata sihning te a cadung.
Aa pazue pata a cadung nakawta, Samaria lie ca khuopuv ta cakuo tlung te laa luv suokha ca ngu shekel sawcari ta zaa yi te, thuvruv ii kab kha ca ngu shekel suopangaa ta ama zaa.
Israel siepahruo ca khypuv lungruetlepie cunglie kha a cakuole ca, cawsaanung pakha ta khi te, “Naa bya tie, i byipaapa siepahruo!” a ta.
Ama ta, “Cuo vyi! Abyipata caa bya mang sue. Tuokhaatama kama ta icaa bya khu aa? Suo-aciyna taata cuose, mingsuv nawnapa taata cuose icaa bya khu'a ma?” a ta.
Cuorasala siepahruo ta, “Khaapama na ri khing?” a ta. Ama ta palie te, “Hingpa canung hingna, ‘na sacapaa hing pi la ataning ma ning aa, cakhutaata kama sacapaa hing mawluo ma ning aa, naa ta,’ a ta.
Caacuonakawta i sacapaa ca pasu pate ma ning. A mawluopa ta, ‘Na sacapaa kha pi la ning'a puv,’ i ta. Cuorasala a sacapaa kha a nu,” a ta.
Siepahruo ta cawsaanung bie a thyi tiyta a caw kha a thlaa, capa taa cata khypuv lungruetlepie cunglie a cakuo kieca a raw luo ta buri caw aa tuepa kha cawsaa ta hmung khu pata a cuo.
Cakhutaata ama ta, “Shafat sacapaa Elisha ca ataning hing a letung cunglie a luv a aw kalie pata a cuo kieca Khazing ta cahaacata hne capa laa cata a ruv vie ta i cunglie tue mang sue,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta a awna taata cawsaa pakha kha a pathlie. Elisha ca a ing lie kha a tu te, uvthyi tie zaw ama hne khata amaa tu. Biephyatuv a vya pha hluo khata Elisha ta uvthyi tie kyihuo khata, “Hingpa lienawtuv hing ta kama luv te riypata cawsaa pakha a pathliepa kha nama pachang ma?” a ta yi. Biephyatuv a vya pha tiyta, ingchiy khaa khuo ung la hre tie ung. A byipaapa phyi pu na a hnangkaalie a vya paringle cuo va ma?” a ta.
Iema hne bie a ri nguoluo ning kha siepahruo ca ama'a luo kha a zuv te, “Hingpa ruvnaana hing Abyipa‘a taa tana a cuo! Tuokhaatama Abyipa'a taa hingta anguopuona i hnyi khu kalie aa?” a ta.

Cuorasala Elisha ta, “Abyipabie hing naathlie tie: Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Mawluo ata tiy cuo lie hingta Samaria hukaa lieta jungsacuo viedie a pha cepa tung kha ca shekel suokha ta zaa pata cuo'a te, jungsacuo tung hning ca shekel suokha ta zaa pata a cuo aa,” a ta.

Cakhutaata siepahruo ta a kuv aa hypa riebyipa khata Khazing cawsaapa kyihuo cata, “Abyipata avuo lie thlaluo-aw a pahaw kie zawma, cahaapa hmang ca a cuo the'a ma?” a ta. Cuorasala ama ta, “Na ming ta na hmung aa, cuorasala a ning ca ning'a vaciy,” a ta.
Khypuv thlake lieta caahminghmaa pasana a hnyipa cawsaa pa paliy aw yi te, pakha hne pakha kha, “Khaapanakawma ma thiyna te ta hingpa lie hing maa tu aa?

‘Khypuv chung luo na maa ngie aa ta ung sala, khypuv chunglie ca cakuo ta a tlung, caacuonakawta capa lie ca ma thiy aa; cuorasala hingpa lie hing maa tu pari kiema ma thiy ngiethie aa. Caacuonakawta, Siria ming arina hmang luo kha vaa'a ung puv; malie ama pahring kie ma hring aa; cuorasala malie a ma thie kie thiy thluo pase,” amaa ta.
Caacuonakawta a zing baaningpa khiy ta thu yi te, Siria ming arina hmang luo ca ama vaa. Cuorasala Siria ming arina hmang a kie luo ama va pha ca, capa hmang lie ca cawsaa pakha hmuo za aw va yi.

Tahematapakieca Abyipata Siria rieka tie kha aruole, aruo hne riekaphuv lesapa puraa pathyi sa yi te, caacuonakawta pakha hne pakha kha, “Israel siepahruo na Hit siepahruo hne Izipt siepahruo kha kiema tuv riypata a hluo yi,” amaa ta.
Caacuonakawta a zing baaningpa khata a ruo yi te, ama thluodaa zaw, amaa ruo zaw, ama laa zaw hne khata amaa rina hmang kha a yalya ta thuse yi te, hringna vuota amaa ruo.

Capa caahminghmaa pasana a hnyipa cawsaa tie ca arina hmang a kie luo ama pha tiyta, thluodaa luo kha a ngie yi te, ning yi te ama dang, siy hne ngu hne cawsie kha la yi te ama nu. Vya kaa yi te, thluodaa hrangpa luo kha a ngie yi te, chechiy kha la yi te ama nu.

Cakhutaata iema pakha hne pakha kha, “Ma tuepa hing a dang vyi. Ataning hing thuohlaa phapa ning tana a cuo. Ryi li pata mawluo khy dyina te ma aw kieca, a suepa tana ma cuo aa. Caacuonakawta vaa ung sala siepahruo ingchungkhue kha va chang ung siy,” amaa ta.

Caacuonakawta vaa yi te khypuv thlake a huopa tie kha u yi te, “Siria ming arina hmang luo kha vaa pate, capa lie ca cawsaa pakha hmuo hmung vapuv, ama ryi zaw thyi ra vapuv, cuorasala aruo zaw laa zaw kha zaa hre thluo te, thluodaa zaw a aw yalyata khata a za aw thluo,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata thlake a huopa tie ta siepahruo ingchungkhue luo kha khi yi te thuo ama va pathyi.

Siepahruo ca zuo khata kya thu te a changtaapa zaw kyihuo khata, “Ca chang'a yi ang, Siria ming na kiema a du riypata a ting pacie tli yi. Iema ta ma nang a diypa kha ama pachang; caacuonakawta ruo lie a nu riypata amaa rina hmang kha thuse yi te, ama ruepa ca, ‘Khypuv chungtaata ama kya pya pahne ta ama hringpa ta patuv'a yi pate, khypuv chung luo kha a ngie lavuo puv ama tapa tana a cuo,’” a ta yi.

A changtaapa pakha ta, “Cawsaa chekha ta aa ngaapa aruo sa pangaa hing a la yi sala, pathlie ung sala va mang yi se, tahematapakieca hingpa lie a ngaapa tie zaw hing a bangkhuo ta a ra tlipa Israel ming cawsaazaapuv haa kha tana ama cuo ngiethie aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta aruole a khangpa cawsaa pahning kha la yi te, siepahruo ta Siria rieka tie hnangluo khata pathlie yi te, “Si ung la va mang tie ung,” a ta yi.

Caacuonakawta Jordan cavaa te amaa cade; Siria ming ca a catlisa pata amaa ruo nakawta ama thawsiypa cawsie hne chechiy ca luopuv lie kha aa zele. Caacuonakawta biephyatuv tie ca vya kaa yi te siepahruo kha ama chang.

Cakhutaata cawsaa ca pya yi te, Siria ming arina hmang kha ama va ching. Caacuonakawta Abyipacawsaapa bie haa khata, Jungsacuo viedie tung kha ca shekel suokha ta zaa pata cuo te, jungsacuo tung hning ca shekel suokha ta zaa pata a cuo.
Siepahruo ta a kuv aa hypa riebyipa kha thlake a huotuv pata chi te, siepahruo ta Khazing cawsaapa'a luo a zuv ningta a ripa haa khata, cawsaa ta thlake lie kha sisue yi te ama tlaw sa.
Tahematapakieca Khazing cawsaapa ta siepahruo kyihuo ta, “Mawluo ata tiy cuo lie hingta Jungsacuo tung hning ca shekel suokha ta zaa pata na a cuo aa,” ata tiyta,

riekabyipa ta Khazing cawsaapa kyihuo ta, “Abyipata avuo lie thlaluo-aw a pahaw kie zawma, cahaapa hmang ca a cuo the'a ma?” ta pata a palie. Ama ta palie te, “Na ming ta na hmung aa, cuorasala a ning ca ning'a vaciy,” a ta.
Capa ca a cunglieta a tlung hmisi; cawsaa ta thlake lie kha sisue yi te ama tlaw sa.

Elisha ta a sacapaa a pahring sa pakhaapa cawsaanung kyihuo khata, “Thu la, na ingchungkhue bangkhuo hne khata si tie ung, namaa pe khunapa luo kha a pe tie ung, tahematapakieca Abyipana cakuo a patlung sa aa, capa ca ruo chunglie hing kung sariy a tlung aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta cawsaanung ca thu te Khazing cawsaapa bie haa cata a tue. A ingchungkhue hne khata si te Filistin ruo luo kha pe yi te kung sariy ama aw.
Kung sariy a chuona lieta cawsaanung ca Filistin ruo taata a vya kaa tiyta a ingchungkhue hne a ruo cuo khata paakie riypata siepahruo'a luo kha a vaa.
Siepahruo ca Khazing cawsaapa changtaapa Gehazi hne khata bie zaa rue yi te, “Elisha ta a tuepa hmanglepa bangkhuo kha na chang tie,” a ta.

Tuokhaatama Elisha ta a thiypa a pahring pakhaa tapa kha siepahruo ca a chang nguoluopa khata, a sacapaa a pahring pakhaapa cawsaanung ca ta a ing hne a ruo kawlie kha siepahruo ca paa a vya kie. Gehazi ta, “I byipaapa siepahruo, cawsaanung ca hingpa hingta cuo te, Elisha ta a pahring pakhaapa a sacapaa ca ama hing tana a cuo,” a ta.

Siepahruo ta cawsaanung ca a hiehriy tiyta a chang. Caacuonakawta siepahruo ta ama cuo khata abyi pakha kha chang te, “A huopa ta a cuopa bangkhuo kha pi pakhaa tie, ruo a pyase taata ataning te ta a lu taata a pyapa bangkhuo hne khata pi pakhaa tie,” a ta.
Siria siepahruo Ben-hadad a pasa ning kha Elisha ca Damaskas luo kha a si. Capa kaw ca ama chang tiyta Khazing cawsaapa ca capa lie ca aa vaw.

Siepahruo ta Hazael kyihuo khata, “Lasaw kha a cyi la Khazing cawsaapa a taw riypata vaa tie. Ama'a taa khata hingpa pasana taa hingta i tluo'a ma tluo'a va ang ma ta pata Abyipakha hiehriy tie,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Hazael ta Damaskas chechiy a phangphang kha kala-uv sawliy ta phya te a vaa taw. A ngie te, a hmiekunglie kha a daa te, “Na sacapaa, Siria siepahruo Ben-hadad ta na vya pathlie te, ‘Hingpa i pasana taa hingta i tluo'a ma tluo'a va ang ma?’ a ta,” a ta.
Elisha ta ama kyihuo khata, “Cakuo la, ‘Na tluo hrahring aa,’ va ta tie; cuorasala Abyipata a thiy hrahring aa tapa tana ina pahmung sa,” a ta.
Ama kha taapuo pata a mang nakawta a nang te a zaa. Cakhutaata Khazing cawsaapa ca a caa.

Hazael ta, “Khaapanakawma i byipaapa ca na caa,” a ta. Ama ta, “Nama ta Israel ming cunglie na tue riypa hmang pha lipa khana i pachang; ama riekhuopiehu bangkhuo kha myi ta rue diy'a cate, ama mingnu tie kha zueziy ta na thie'a yi, ama haatiy tie kha dekary diy'a yi cate, nu a phyapa canung tie riy kha na thlaa aa,” a ta.

Hazael ta, “Uv tluv dyi a cuopa na changtaapa hing khaapata cuo angte ma hing tluv ta a lepa hmang ca i tue aa?” a ta. Elisha ta palie te, “Nama ca Siria siepahruo ta na cuo aa tapa tana Abyipata ina pahmung sa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Elisha'a taa khata cakuo te a byipaapa Ben-hadad'a luo kha a vaa ca, “Elisha ta khaapama aca chang,” a ta. Ama ta palie te, “Na tluo hrahring aa tapa tana ina chang,” a ta.
Cuorasala a mawluopa ta pangphaa buv kha la te, tiy lie paci te siepahruo hmie kha pahlaw te a thiy. Cakhutaata Hazael ta ama ca aa thle.
Israel siepahruo Ahab sacapaa Joram siepahruo a cuonapa a kung pangaana lieta Judah siepahruo Jehoshafat sacapaa Jehoram ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa pathu.
Ama ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu ning kha kung sawthung kung hning ta a cuo, Jerusalem lieta siepahruo kung cari a cuo.
Ama ta Ahab ingchungkhue tie ta ama tuepa haa khata Israel siepahruo tie luopuv kha a ziy, tahematapakieca a napuvnung ca Ahab sacanung ta a cuo. Ama ta Abyipahmungna lie kha a pha lipa a tue.
Cuorasala Judah ca Abyipata a changtaapa David kawlie khata para khing vyi, tahematapakieca ama hne a ciypathla tie kha chuozaa ta myi-ing pi riypata bie a za kuo tli yi.
Ama chuo chunglie ca ta Judah uvna kha Edom ta a du te iemata tah siepahruo amaa chi.
Cakhutaata Joram ca aa ruole bangkhuo hne khata Zair luo a si. Zuo ta a tha te ama a cadungpa Edom ming hne aruole uvtuv tie kha a tuv yi; cuorasala a rieka tie ca ing luo kha amaa ruo.
Caacuonakawta Edom ta Judah uvna ca ataning tepa hingta aa du.
Joram tuesana aa ngaapa hne a tuepa bangkhuo ca Judah Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv chunglie tana ama cape cuo va ma?
Cahaacata Joram ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie a zie te, David khypuv lie kha iema'a lie ca ama paby; a sacapaa Ahaziah ta ama kha aa thle.
Israel Siepahruo Ahab sacapaa Joram siepahruo a cuonapa kung hraa hlyihningna lieta Judah siepahruo Jehoram sacapaa Ahaziah ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu.
Ahaziah ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu ning kha kung kiy kung hning ta a cuo; Jerusalem lieta siepahruo kung kha a cuo. A nung ming ca Athaliah ta cuo te, Israel Siepahruo Omri samingta tah a cuo.
Ama ca Ahab ingchungkhue ama piepa a cuo nakawta Ahab ingchungkhue tie ama tuepa haata Ahab luopuv kha ziy te, Abyipahmiekunglieta a pha lipa kha a tue.
Ahab sacapaa Joram hne khata Siria siepahruo Hazael a du riypata si yi te, capa lie ca Siria ming ta Joram kha hmaa ama paphya.

Siria ming ta Ramah lie hmaa ama paphyapa kha a patluo riypata siepahruo Joram ca Jezreel luo kha a kaa. Jehoram sacapaa Judah siepahruo Ahaziah ca Ahab sacapaa Joram mang riypata Jezreel luo kha a zuv, tahematapakieca ama ca hmaa a phya nakawta a cuo.
Cakhutaata profet Elisha ta profet phuv lie pakha kha ku te, ama kyihuo khata, “Na tesaw kha a saw la hingpa chiytiy ung hing na kuv lie a cyi la Ramoth-gilead luo kha si tie.
Na va pha tiyta, Nimshi sacapaa Jehoshafat sacapaa Jehu kha huv la, a viesaa kha pathuse sa yi la, a ing chung aziena khuo luo kha a ngiekhyi tie.

Cakhutaata chiytiy ung kha la lah, a luv lie kha thuv la, ‘Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Israel ming siepahruo riypa tana chiytiy ica pathuv,’ ta tie. Cakhutaata ingchiypakaa kha pahaw la haasaa li pata a ruo tie,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta satliepa profet ca Ramoth-gilead luo kha a si.

Ama ca riekabyi tie amaa hmya ning khata pha te, “Riekabyilepa tie, niema cuo tana thuohlaa i hnyi,” ta pata a pathyi sa yi. Jehu ta, “Kiema hrawlieta ahung hing ma?” a ta. “Nama cuota, riebyilepa,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Jehu ca thu te ing chung luo aa ngie; satliepa ta chiytiy kha a luv lie thuv te, “Israel Khazing, Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Abyipacawsaa, Israel ming cunglie siepahruo cuo riypa tana sathu ica pathuv.
Abyipachangtaapa bangkhuo tie thiyse hne i changtaapa profet tie thiyse cuota Jezebel cunglie phuv i la the riypata na byipaapa Ahab ingchungkhue kha na thie'a yi.
Tahematapakieca Ahab ingchungkhue bangkhuo ca ama ra aa; Israel ruo chunglie Ahab cawsaa capaa, sii acuolikie hya a zangpa bangkhuo kha i thaw diy'a yi.
Ahab ingchungkhue ca Nebat sacapaa Jeroboam ingchungkhue, hne Ahijah sacapaa Baasha ingchungkhue haa tana i tue aa.
Jezreel ruo chunglie kha Jezebel ca uv ta ce'a yi te, ahungtahmuo paby'a va yi,” a ta. Cakhutaata ingchiypakaa kha pahaw te aa ruo.

Jehu ca a byipaapa byi tie'a luo a kya pya tiyta, iema ta, “A pha diy ma? Khapa a ngaapa paa kha khaapanakawma nama'a luo aa vaw?” ama ta. Ama ta palie yi te, “Ama ca pachang ung ciy, a ripa zaw pachang ung ciy nama tapa kha,” a ta yi.
Iema ta, “Na hang! malie chang tie,” ama ta. Caacuonakawta ama ta, “Hing haa hing tana ina chang: ‘Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri, Israel siepahruo cuo riypa tana sathu ica pathuv,’ ina ta,” a ta.
Cakhutaata iema bangkhuo ta a catlisa pata ama pang kha la yi te, hlyidaw a daw ce lie kha phaa yi te, hmyakaa kha tung yi te, “Jehu ca siepahruo tana a cuo,” ta pata ama u.
Cahaacata Nimshi sacapaa Jehoshafat sacapaa Jehu ta Joram ca a raw. Joram hne Israel ming bangkhuo ca Siria siepahruo Hazael kha a du riypata Ramoth-gilead lieta ama aw.

Cuorasala Siepahruo Joram ca Siria ming ta hmaa ama paphyapa a patluo sa riypata Jezreel luo kha a kaa. Caacuonakawta Jehu ta, “Hingpa hing nama khingpa ta a cuo kieca, Jezreel luo thuohlaa chang riypata hingpa khypuv chung taa hingta ahunghmuo pya khah yi se,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Jehu ta aa ruole kha a khang te, Joram pasa te aa zienapa Jezreel luo kha a si. Judah Siepahruo Ahaziah zaw ta sibung te Joram kha a za ve.

Jezreel khy ingsuo cunglie a daapa rie a vepa ta Jehu phuv amaa vawpa kha a hmung tiyta, “Cawsaa phuv phuv kha na i hmung,” a ta. Joram ta, “Aruo rieka pakha kha la lah, iema a taw riypata pathlie tie, cakhutaata ama ta, ‘Diena cuo ma?’ va ta se,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta aruo riekapa ca ta vaa taw yi te, siepahruo na hing haa hingta a ri, ‘Diena ta cuo ma?’ a ta,” a ta. Jehu ta palie te, “Diena kawlieta naa thla riypa khaapama a aw? I hnang hing na ziy tie,” a ta. Rievetuv khata, “Luosituv kha iema'a luo a va pha mangtli, cuorasala vya kaa vyi,” a ta.

Cakhutaata aruo rieka a pahningna kha pathlie pakhaa te iema'a luo kha ava chiy, ama ca ta, “Siepahruo na hing haa hingta a ri: ‘Diena ta cuo ma? a ta,” a ta. Jehu ta palie te, “Diena hne nama khaapama naa se? I hnang hing na ziy tie,” a ta.
Rievetuv ta, “Iema'a luo ava pha tli, cuorasala vya kaa vyi. A mawnazya ca Jehu sacapaa Nimshi a mawpa haa tana a maw, a catli hringhruopa tana a maw,” a ta.

Joram ta, “Pachie pacie tie ung,” a ta. Caacuonakawta aa ruole kha ama pachie pacie. Cakhutaata Israel Siepahruo Joram hne Judah Siepahruo Ahaziah ca amaa ruole cyicuo kha a khang yi te, Jehu a taw riypata si yi te, Jezreel ming Naboth diedung lie kha amaa taw.
Joram ta Jehu kha a hmung tiyta, “Diena cuo ma, Jehu?” a ta. Ama ta, “Na nung Jezebel siyhrawna hne ca-iena a aw chung bangkhuo tuokhaapa diena ma a aw the aa?” a ta.
Cakhutaata Joram ta thaatungriy kha maa te, Ahaziah kyihuo khata, “Rawna na a aw, Ahaziah!” ta te aa ruo.
Jehu ta a thaa a aw zawdya ta a liy kha a kyi te, Joram kha a letung hne a letung alalalie ta ka te, cuoti ta a palung kha a khe nakawta aa ruole chunglie ca a laa.

Jehu ta ama a byatuv riekabyi Bidkar kyihuo khata, “Ama kha a dale la Jezreel ming Naboth alyi lie kha va thaw tie; tahematapakieca nama hne kama hne a paa Ahab hnangluo taata aa patluo pata maa khang ning kha Abyipata hingpa bie a za ripa kha naa thyi thluo aa:

‘Azuochaning Naboth thiyse hne a saata zaw thiyse i hmungpa haa khata hingpa alyi lie hrahring hingta vieriy ica thung aa ta pata chie i sa, ta pata Abyipata a ripa kha,’ a ta. Caacuonakawta a dale la khapa hmang alyi lie kha va thaw tie, Abyipabie haa khata,” a ta.

Judah Siepahruo Ahaziah ta a hmung tiyta, Beth-haggan kuo luo khata aa ruo. Jehu ta a cade te, “Ama zaw kha ka tie ung,” a ta. Ibleam athaalie Gur luo kiena lieta aa ruole cunglie kha ama ka. Cakhutaata Megiddo luo kha a ruo te a thiy.
Aa byi tie khata aruole ta Jerusalem luo phyale yi te, David khypuv chunglie a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a thluo lieta ama paby.
Ahab sacapaa Joram siepahruo a cuonapa kung hraa hlyikha kung lie kha Ahaziah ca Judah siepahruo cuo hruo aa pathu.
Jehu kha Jezreel luo a vya pha tiyta, Jezebel ta khapa kaw kha a thyi; a mingtluo kha siyy a thuv te, a suo kha a tue te thlaluo-aw taa khata hmiehmie a pase.
Jehu kha thlake luo aa vya ngie pata, “Diena ta a cuo ma, na byipaapa Zimri a thiepa paa,” a ta.
Thlaluo-aw luo kha mangthaw te, “Kama'a luota ahungma a aw ung ciy? Ahungma?” a ta. Tiydiypa pahning pathung khata ama za mang.
Ama ta, “Za thawpathla tie ung,” a ta. Caacuonakawta iema ta za thawpathla yi te, a thiy ta tlepie hne aruo zaw kha aa pi yi.
Cakhutaata a ngie te a ning a dang khutaata, “Khapa chiesapa canung kha mang ung la paby tie ung; tahematapakieca ama ca siepahruo sacanung tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cuorasala paby riypata ama vaa tiyta, a luvruv hne a phyi hne a kuvpazaa ta li pata a khaapahmuo hmung va yi.
Vya kaa yi te ama chang tiyta, ama ta, “Hingpa hing Tishbe ming a changtaapa Elijah'a lie Abyipaa ripa bie, ‘Jezreel ruo chunglieta uv ta Jezebel saa kha a ce aa;
Jezebel riyy ca ruo chunglie ii haata a cuo'a nakawta, hingpa hingna Jezebel ta a cuo ta pata ahungtahmuo ri khu'a va yi,’ a tapa haa kha tana a cuo,” a ta.
Ahab ta Samaria lie sacapaa sawsariy a hnyi yi. Caacuonakawta Jehu ta caa cape te, Samaria lie Jezreel uvtuv tie, uvthyi tie, hne Ahab sacapaa zaw a mangchiytuv tie'a luo kha caa paphya yi te,
“Nama byipaapa sacapaa zaw kha niema'a lie aw yi te, niema ta aruole hne aruo zaw, hne dungkhuopa khypuv hne cehre zaw nama hnyi.
Nama byipaapa sacapaa zaw chung taa khata a the cepa kha a tlaw ung la, a paa byithude lie kha patu tie ung, cakhutaata nama byipaapa ingchungkhue cuo khata rie a du tie ung,” a ta yi.
Cuorasala iema ta ciy hringhruo yi te, “Mang tie ung, siepahruo pahning tahmuo a daapuo khu va yi, kiema ta tuokhaatama maa daapuo khu aa?” ama ta.

Caacuonakawta siepahruo ing lie re a hriepa tie, hne khypuv uvtuv tie hne, uvthyi tie hne siepahruo sacapaa zaw a mangchiytuv tie khata Jehu'a luo kha bie taa yi te, “Kiema ca na changtaapa zaw tana ma cuo; na ripa bangkhuo kha ima tue aa. Kiema ta pakha hing hmuo siepahruo ta tue'a va yi puv; a pha na tapa haa khata tue tie,” ama ta.

Cakhutaata a suohningnapa caa kha cape te, “Kama kuo luo ta aw ung cate, kama ri a ngie riypa kha namaa ting kieca, nama byipaapa sacapaa zaw luv kha vya phya ung la mawluo ata tiy hing ta kama'a luo, Jezreel luo kha a vaw tie ung,” a ta yi. Siepahruo sacapaa sawsariy tie ca iema a mangchiytuv khypuv uvthyi tie hne khata ama aw.
Caa ca iema'a luo a pha tiyta, iema ta siepahruo sacapaa sawsariy tie kha la yi te ama thie; ama luv kha pasyi lie khung yi te, ama'a luo, Jezreel luo kha ama paphya.
Biephyatuv kha a vaw te, “Siepahruo sacapaa tie luv khana ama vya cyi tli,” ta pata, ama vya chang tiyta, “Khy thlake a ngienapa lie kha suv hning ta papung ung la mawluo maw te aw se,” a ta.

Cakhutaata mawluo maw a pya tiyta, a daa te cawsaa bangkhuo kyihuo khata, “Niema ca suena hnyi va ung ciy. I byipaapa raw angte a thietuv ca kama tana i cuo, cuorasala hingpa tie zaw bangkhuo hing ahung zaw ma a thie yi?
Ahab ingchungkhue hne aa patuv pata Abyipata a ripa bie suokha hmuo alyi luo tla'a vyi tapa kha pachang tie ung; tahematapakieca Abyipana a changtaapa Elijah'a taata a ripa kha a tue tli,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Jehu ta Jezreel lie aa ngaapa Ahab ingchungkhue bangkhuo kha thie yi te, a uvthyi tie bangkhuo, a viesaa tie, hne tluobyi tie zaw kha pakha hmuo pahring li pata a thie diy yi.
Cakhutaata a tha te Samaria luo kha a si. Luopuv lie, tuvkhietuv tie awnapa Beth-eked luo kha a pha tiyta,

Jehu ta Judah Siepahruo Ahaziah tieriy tie kha a taw yi te, “Ahung zaw tama nama cuo?” a ta yi. Iema ta palie yi te, “Ahaziah tieriy zaw tana ma cuo; siepahruo sacapaa tie hne siepahruonung sacapaa tie kha tlaw riypa tana maa zuv,” ama ta.
Ama ta, “Iema hing ama hring pata patuv ung,” a ta yi. Iema ca ama hring pata patuv yi te, Beth-eked khue chunglie kha ama thie, ama bangkhuo ta sawliy pahning ama ta; pakha hmuo pahring va yi.

Capa taa cata a si tiyta, Rekhab sacapaa Jehonadab kha ama a taw riypata a vaw te aa taw; bie a chang te, ama kyihuo khata, “Na cunglie i pathiypalung zang tluo aa tlapa haa hingta i cunglie na pathiypalung zang tluo aa tla ma?” a ta. Jehonadab ta, “A cuo,” ta pata a palie. Jehu ta, “Cahaacata a cuo kieca, na kuv kha na hluo tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta a kuv kha a hluo. Jehu ta ama kha aa ruole chungluo aa da.
Ama ta, “Kama hing na ziy la, Abyipacuota i khingkhyinazya hing mang tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta aa ruole kha a pakhang sa.
Samaria luo kha a vya pha tiyta, Abyipata Elijah lie a ripa bie haa khata Ahab huopa aa ngaapa bangkhuo kha pakha hmuo pangaa li pata a thie diy yi.
Cakhutaata Jehu ta cawsaa bangkhuo kha pahmya yi te, “Ahab ta Baal re kha a cawta dyi a hrie, cuorasala Jehu ta ca ahluvsa a hrie aa.

Caacuonakawta Baal profet tie kha kama'a luo ku tie ung, cakhutaata a tluobyi tie bangkhuo kha, pakha hmuo bu li pata, tahematapakieca Baal khana hriykhungrina lesapa i pihluo khing; a bupa ahunghmuo hring'a vyi,” a ta. Cuorasala Jehu ta Baal abiepa tie kha a para khing nakaw yi ta hanghie pata a ripa tana a cuo.
Jehu ta, “Baal cuota a pathepa apungna tue tie ung,” a ta. Caacuonakawta capa ca tluo ama u.
Jehu ta Israel ruo chung bangkhuo kha bie pazu te, Baal abiepa bangkhuo ca amaa vaw diy, a vaw lipa pakha hmuo aw va yi. Baal biena-ing ama bikaluvna te ta Baal biena-ing luo ca amaa ngie.
Ama ta cawsie chinapa a huotuv kyihuo khata, “Baal abiepa bangkhuo cuo khata caw kha papya tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta iema cuo khata caw ca a kya papya.

Cakhutaata Jehu ca Rekhab sacapaa Jehonadab hne khata Baal biena-ing chung luo kha a ngie te Baal abiepa tie kyihuo khata, “Niema hrawlie hing Abyipaabiepa pakha hmuo ama aw li riypata huv tie ung, Baal abiepa tie dyi aw yi se,” a ta.

Cakhutaata hriykhungrina pihluo riypa hne myirue panaana pihluo riypata ama pazue. Jehu ta cawsaa sawcari kha ale lie chi yi te, “Hingpa cawsaa, nama kuv chung luo ica pipa tie hing pakha hmuo a pazangpa ca a hringna tana a thle aa,” a ta.

Myirue panaana pihluo kha a patlung pahne ta Jehu ta rievetuv tie hne byi tie kha, “Zaa ngie ung la iema hing thie tie ung, pakha hmuo zang khah yi se,” a ta. Caacuonakawta zueziy ta ama thie. Rievetuv tie hne byi tie khata ale luo thaw yi te, Baal biena-ing a chung khuo luo kha amaa ngie.
Baal biena-ing chunglie a awpa tungbang kha ale luo pyakhyi yi te myi ta ama rue.
Cakhutaata Baal tungbang kha para diy yi te Baal biena-ing kha ama para, pazungna ing ta tue yi te ataning te ta hmuo pathla pata a cuo.
Cahaacata Jehu ta Israel ruo taata Baal kha a pathe diy.
Cuorasala Nebat sacapaa Jeroboam ta Israel ming a za pasue sanapa yi siy cuetaata Bethel lie a awpa hne Dan lie a awpa kha piese vyi.

Abyipata Jehu kyihuo khata, “Kama ta a pha ta pata i ruepa kha a phasa pata tue cate, Ahab ingchungkhue hne aa patuv pata i palung lie a awpa haa khata na tue nakawta, na sacapaa zaw ta chuo paliy te ta Israel byithude lie amaa tu aa,” a ta.
Cuorasala Jehu ca a pathiypalung yalya ta Israel Khazing Abyipaphungbie ziy kha a raaring li pata Israel a pasue sapa Jeroboam suena taa khata a maa vyi.
Capa cuo lie kha Abyipata Israel ruo chekha kha pathe hruo aa pathu. Hazael ta Israel ruo chung kha a tele ciemuo:
Jordan ningchiyluo ruo taata, Gilead ruo bangkhuo, Gad ming, Reuben ming hne Manasseh ming tie ruo, Arnon cavaata kielie a awpa Aroer taata Gilead hne Bashan te.
Jehu tuesana aa ngaapa hne a tuepa bangkhuo, hne a cahrana bangkhuo ca Israel Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv chungliena aa cape diy cuo va ma?
Caacuonakawta Jehu ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a zie te Samaria lieta ama paby. A sacapaa Jehoahaz ta ama kha aa thle.
Jehu ta Israel ca Samaria taata kung kiy kung cari a pe.
Ahaziah a nung Athaliah ta a sacapaa thiypa kha a hmung tiyta, siepahruo ingchungkhue bangkhuo kha thie diy aa nang.

Cuorasala siepahruo Joram sacanung Jehosheba, Ahaziah sietanung khata Ahaziah sacapaa Joash kha thie riypata a cuopa siepahruo haatiy tie'a taa khata a paruvta tah la te, ama hne a mangchiynung hne khata aa ziena khuo chunglieta a nu yi. Cahaacata Athaliah'a taa khata a nu nakawta thie va yi.
Athaliah ta ruo chunglie siepahruo a cuo chung ca Abyipaing chunglie kha nu yi te, a ningnung hne ta kung caruv chung a aw.

Cuorasala a kung sariyna lie ca tluobyi Jehoiada ta Karet ming riebyi tie hne rievetuv tie kha Abyipaing chung luo, ama'a luo kha amaa vaw riypata a ku yi. Iema hneta biekuona tue te, Abyipaing chunglie ca chie sa yi te, cakhutaata siepahruo sacapaa kha a pahmung sa yi
Ama ta biepi yi te, “Hingpa hingna nama tue riypata a cuo: niema chungtaata che thung che kha sabbath ning ta re a pahypa, siepahruo ing rie a vepa tie khata siepahruo ing kha rieve ung la,
(a hrangpa che thung che kha ca Sur thlake lie kha aw'a ung cate, che thung che kha ca rievetuv tie hnangkaa lie thlake lie kha nama aw aa).
Cakhutaata niema phuv hning tie, sabbath ning ta re a hnyipa tie, Abyipaing rievetuv tie khata

siepahruo kha nama cadung aa, cehre kha namaa cyi kaluo aa; cakhutaata a cadungpa rieka a vya cadipa bangkhuo ca thie pata ama cuo aa. Siepahruo a pyana hne aa ngiena lie kha nama paziy pari aa,” a ta.

Riebyi tie ca ta tluobyi Jehoiada bie a pipa haa yi cata ama tue; ama cyicuo khata sabbath ning ta re a pahypa ama cawsaa tie kha sabbath ning ta re a hnyipa ama cawsaa tie hne khata tluobyi Jehoiada'a luo kha amaa vawkhyi.
Tluobyipa ta David siepahruo huopa ta zaa cuopa Abyipaing chunglie ama chipa asyi hne phya kha riekabyi tie ca a pi yi;

rievetuv tie ca ama mekaa ta ama cehre kha ama kuv lie a cyi kaluo yi te, ing sungluo kuo taata chaluo kuo te ta, bienatluophie hne ing ca cadung yi te, a kuo bangkhuo taata siepahruo kha rieve riypata amaa daa.

Cakhutaata ama ta siepahruo sacapaa ca kya pyakhyi te, byilakhuv kha pakhuv te biekuona a patue sa; siepahruo a cuo tli ta pata pathyi sa yi te, sathu a pathuv; ama kuv kha cabe yi te ama u, “Siepahruo ca a chuo pasiy mang sue!” ama ta.
Athaliah ta rievetuv tie hne cawsaa zaw puraa kha a thyi tiyta Abyipaing chunglie cawsaa zaw'a luo kha aa ngie.

Hmiehmie pase te siepahruo ca a phungpa haa khata atung athaalie khata a daa te, riekabyi tie hne hmyakaa a tungpa tie kha siepahruo athaalie ca amaa daa, ruo chunglie cawsaa bangkhuo ca ama palung tluo te hmyakaa kha ama tung. Athaliah ca a caw kha thlaa te, “Rawna! Rawna!” ta pata a khi.

Cakhutaata tluobyi Jehoiada ta rieka tie uvtuv ta a chipa riekabyi tie kha bie pi yi te, “Ama kha byi zaw hraw taa khata kya pyakhyi ung la, ama a ziypa mekaa kha zueziy ta thie tie ung,” a ta. Tahematapakieca tluobyipa ta, “Ama ca Abyipaing chunglieta thie pata cuo khah se,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta ama kha patuv yi te, siepahruo ing aruo thlake luo kha a chiyle yi te, capa lie ca ama thie.
Jehoiada ta Abyipa, hne siepahruo hne cawsaa zaw alalalie kha iema ca Abyipacawsaa cuo riypata biekuona a tue; siepahruo hne cawsaa zaw alalalie zaw kha a tue.

Cakhutaata ruo chunglie cawsaa bangkhuo ca Baal ing luo kha cakuo yi te ama phipatlaa diy; a bienatluophie hne a kuvtuezuv kha dekary diy yi te, cakhutaata Baal tluobyi ta a cuopa Mattan kha bienatluophie hmielie ca ama thie. Tluobyi ta Abyipaing lie kha rievetuv tie a chi yi.

Ama ta riekabyi tie, Karet ming hne rievetuv tie, ruo chunglie cawsaa bangkhuo kha a chiy yi te, iema ta siepahruo kha Abyipaing taata za cungkhyi yi te, rievetuv tie thlake taa khata siepahruo ing luo kha ama cakuokhyi. Cakhutaata ama ca siepahruo byithude lie kha aa tu.
Caacuonakawta ruo chunglie cawsaa bangkhuo ca ama palung a tluo; Athaliah kha siepahruo ing lie zueziy ta ama thie khutaata khypuv ca a die.
Jehoash ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa pathu ning kha kung sariy ta a cuo.
Jehu siepahruo a cuonapa kung sariyna lieta Jehoash kha siepahruo cuo hruo a pathu te, Jerusalem lieta kung sawliy siepahruo a cuo. A nung ming ca Zibiah ta a cuo, Beer-sheba khy ming ta a cuo.
Tluobyi Jehoiada ta a pacuv nakawta Jehoash ca a chuo chung bangkhuo ta Abyipahmiekunglie a phapa kha a tue.
Cuorasala khahrungtluobu tie kha para vyi; cawsaa ta khahrungtluobu lie kha hriykhungrina hne pihluona zaw ca ama tue ngiethie kalie.

Jehoash ta tluobyi tie kha, “Abyipaing chung luo ama vya cyipa a pathepa ahlu zaanapa tuokaa, ahunghmuo cuose ca zaa ca na pi aa ta pata thlipapa tuokaa, hne palung thuna ta Abyipaing luo ama vya pihluopa tuokaa kha,
a pipa tie cyicuo taa khata tluobyi ta cuhluo sala, ing kha pare aa hunapa mekaa ta pare yi se,” a ta.
Cuorasala Siepahruo Jehoash pena kung kiy kung thungna te ta, tluobyi ta ing kha pare va yi.

Caacuonakawta Siepahruo Jehoash ta tluobyi Jehoiada hne tluobyi hrangpa tie kha ku yi te, “Khaapanakawma ing kha nama pare va? Caacuonakawta ata hing ca caa vya hlupa tie'a taata tuokaa kha cuhluo khah tie ung, cuorasala ing parena cuo khata pi tie ung,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta tluobyi tie ta cawsaa tie'a taata tuokaa kha cuhluo li tli pata ing zaw kha pare li riypata palungtlingna ama hnyi.

Cakhutaata tluobyi Jehoiada ta thingkaw suo kha kha la te, a pahruv lie kha a khue suokha vaa te Abyipaing chung luo a ngienapa cacuoluo kuo bienatluophie athaalie kha a patu. Abyipaing chung luo ama vya cyipa tuokaa bangkhuo kha chiypakaa a huopa tluobyi tie khata capa chung luo ca ama pasuo.

Thingkaw chunglieta tuokaa a hluvsa a aw tli tapa ama hmung tiyta siepahruo caacapetuv hne tluobyi lepa kha khaw yi te, Abyipaing chunglie ama hmungpa tuokaa kha ri yi te, cataw yi te chawkue chung luo kha ama raw.
Ama pathlie ciepa tuokaa ca Abyipaing mangchiytuv tie kuv luo kha ama pi; iema ca ta Abyipaing lie ing a sapa tie hne lettamaa tie,
pazan tie hne alung a uopa tie kha pi yi te, Abyipaing parena lieta aa hupa thing hne alung calyina lieta cuose, ing parena cuota aa huna mekaa lie kha ama hmuo.

Cuorasala Abyipabiena-ing cuota ngu rahung, cecakie, kuotung, hmyakaa, hne siy ta tuepa bi phie bangkhuo, hne ngu ta tuepa bi phie bangkhuo ca Abyipaing chung luo vya cyipa tuokaa taata tuepa cuo vyi,
tahematapakieca capa ca Abyipaing a parepa rehrietuv tie khana pi pata a cuo.
Rehrietuv tie pi riypata ama kuv chung luo tuokaa ama pipa tie kha tuokhaatama tuokaa ama hmuo tapa kha hiehriy va tli yi, tahematapakieca iema ca aa dangsa pata na ama hrie.
Sue a ngiethe panaana taata tuokaa hne sue pathe sa panaana taata tuokaa tie kha ca Abyipaing chung luo a ngiekhyi va yi; tluobyi tie huopa tana a cuo.
Capa cuo ning ca Siria Siepahruo Hazael ta sithaw te Gath kha tuv te a la. Cuorasala Hazael ta Jerusalem kha a du riypata si aa ting tiyta,

Judah siepahruo Jehoash ta a mingchingmingvuo tie Judah siepahruo ta a cuopa Jehoshafat, Jehoram, hne Ahaziah zaw ta ama za pihluopa biekuo lasaw bangkhuo, ama ta a pihluopa biekuo lasaw bangkhuo, hne Abyipasue-ing chunglie hne siepahruo ing chunglie ama hmungpa siy bangkhuo kha la te Siria Siepahruo Hazael'a luo kha a paphya. Cakhutaata Hazael ta Jerusalem kha a kaase.
Joash tuesana aa ngaapa hne ama ta a tuepa bangkhuo ca Judah Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv lie khana aa cape diy cuo va ma?
A changtaapa tie kha thu yi te, raw yi te Silla luo sibungnapa luopuv lie Millo ing chunglie kha Joash ca ama thie.

Ama a thiepa tie ca a changtaapa Shimeath sacapaa Jozakar, hne Shomer sacapaa Jehozabad tana ama cuo. Ama ca David khypuv chunglie a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha ama paby. Cakhutaata a sacapaa Amaziah ta aa thle.

Judah siepahruo Ahaziah sacapaa Joash siepahruo acuona kung kiy kung thung kung lieta Jehu sacapaa Jehoahaz ca Israel ruo Samaria lieta siepahruo cuo hruo a thu te, kung hraa hlyisariy siepahruo a cuo.
Abyipahmungna lie kha a pha lipa tue te Nebat sacapaa Jeroboam ta Israel ming a pasuesanapa yi suena kha sise vyi.
Abyipahihaana ca Israel cunglie kha a ie nakawta Siria Siepahruo Hazael hne Hazael sacapaa Ben-hadad kuv cung luo kha a pi pakhaa lawmaw yi.
Cuorasala Jehoahaz ta Abyipakha a nue te, Abyipata a thyipa: tahematapakieca ama ta Israel ming tuechie ama angna hne Siria siepahruo ta tuokhaatama a tuechie yi tapa kha a hmung.
Caacuonakawta Abyipata Israel kha Siria ming kuv chungtaata amaa ruo the riypata khuotuv a pi; cakhutaata Israel cawsaa ca a hluo haa khata ama ing lie khy ama sa.
Cuorasala iema ta Jeroboam ta Israel ming a pasuesanapa yi Jeroboam ingchungkhue suena kha thuse li pata ziy yi te Asherah tung zaw kha Samaria lieta a aw ngiethie.

Caacuonakawta Jehoahaz rieka tie ca aruo rieka sawngaa hne aruole suohraa hne phyi rieka thawkha laata a hluv vie a ngaa va tli yi; tahematapakieca Siria siepahruo ta iema kha para yi te suo-aciyna lie alyi diypa haata a tue yi.
Jehoahaz tuesana aa ngaapa hne a tuepa bangkhuo hne a cahrana zaw ca Israel Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv liena ama cape diy cuo va ma?
Caacuonakawta Jehoahaz ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a zie te Samaria lieta ama paby; cakhutaata a sacapaa Joash ta aa thle.

Judah Siepahruo Joash ta siepahruo a cuona kung sawthung kung sariy kung lie kha Jehoahaz sacapaa Jehoash ca Samaria lieta siepahruo cuo hruo a thu te Israel ming cunglie kha kung hraa hlyicaruv siepahruo a cuo.
Ama zaw Abyipahmungna lie kha a pha lipa tue te, Nebat sacapaa Jeroboam ta Israel ming a pasuesanapa yi suena kha thuse li pata a ziy.
Joash tuesana aa ngaapa hne a tuepa bangkhuo, Judah Siepahruo Amaziah a duna lie a cahrana zaw kha Israel Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv chungliena ama cape cuo va ma?
Cahaacata Joash ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a zie te aa byithude cunglie kha Jeroboam ta aa tu; Joash ca Samaria lie Israel siepahruo tie'a lie kha ama paby.
Elisha ca thiykhyi khupa pasana ta a pasa tiyta, Israel Siepahruo Joash ca ama'a luo kha sibung te a hmiekunglie kha, “I paa, i paa! Israel ming aruole hne aruo rieka! ta pata a caa.
Elisha ta ama kyihuo khata, “Liy suokha hne cuoti zaw kha la tie,” a ta ca ama ta liy suokha hne cuoti zaw kha a la.
Cakhutaata ama ta Israel siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Cuoti kha a da tie,” a ta ca ama ta aa da. Elisha ta siepahruo kuv cunglie kha a kuv ca a chi.

Cakhutaata ama ta, “Ningchiyluo kuo'apa thlaluo-aw kha pahaw tie,” ta te a pahaw. Elisha ta, “Ka tie,” ta te a ka. Cakhutaata Elisha ta, “Abyipatena cuoti, Siria tena riypa cuoti! Tahematapakieca Siria ming kha Afek lieta ama chuona te ta na tuv'a yi,” a ta.
Pazue te, “Cuoti zaw kha la tie,” ta te a la. Israel Siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Khapa tie khata alyi kha tuv tie,” a ta; alyi kha yi thung tuv te aa pahy.

Cakhutaata Khazing cawsaapa ca ama cunglie kha a hi haa te, Yi pangaa yi caruv na tuv riypata muo a cuo ta; cahaacata na tue kieca Siria ming ca ama chuona te ta na te'a yi muo, cuorasala ata hing ca Siria ming kha yi thung dyina na te'a yi,” a ta.
Cahaacata Elisha ca thiy te ama paby. Moab ming a phuvphuv ta a awpa tie khata cuovuo cuo ning kha ruo ca ama ching taw.

Cawsaa pakha kha ama paby ningta ruo a chingpa tie phuv kha kha ama hmung nakawta cawsaapa ca Elisha thluo chung luo kha ama thaw; cawsaapa ta Elisha ruv kha a de khu pahne ta kya hring te a phyi ta aa daa.
Siria Siepahruo Hazael ta Jehoahaz chuo chung bangkhuo kha Israel ca a hrisaa.

Cuorasala Abyipata iema kha vihnyi yi te ama cunglieta kawpacuona a hnyi yi; Abraham, Isak hne Jakob zaw'a lie bie aa kuopa kawlie khata iema'a luo kha a pali te para li pata a aw yi, ata tepa ta thaw va yi.
Siria siepahruo Hazael kha a thiy tiyta a sacapaa Ben-hadad ta aa thle.

Cakhutaata Jehoahaz sacapaa Jehoash khata Hazael sacapaa Ben-hadad'a taa khata, a paa Jehoahaz'a taata Hazael ta rie ning a za lapa khy tie kha a la pakhaa. Joash ta ama kha yi thung te te, Israel khy tie kha a la pakhaa diy.
Israel Siepahruo Joahaz sacapaa Joash siepahruo a cuona kung hning kung lieta Judah siepahruo Joash sacapaa Amaziah kha siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu.
Ama ca kung kiy kung pangaa a ta pata siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu, Jerusalem lie kha kung kiy kung caky siepahruo a cuo. A nung ming ca Jehoaddin ta cuo te, Jerusalem khy ming ta a cuo.
Ama ca Abyipahmungna lieta a phapa kha a tue, cuorasala a mingchingmingvuo David haata ca cuo vyi; hmangting bangkhuo lie kha a paa Joash tuepa haata a tue.
Cuorasala khahrungtluobu zaw ca para pata cuo vyi; cawsaa ta khahrungtluobu lie kha hriykhung a ri yi te pihluona zaw kha ama tue ngiethie kalie.
Siepahruo nawhnyina kha a kuv cunglie a cusa pata a aw pahne ta siepahruo a cuopa a paa a thiepa a changtaapa tie kha a thie yi.

Cuorasala Moses phungbie caa-uv chunglieta aa capepa, “Paa tie ca saata zaw cuopa ta thiepa cuo li'apa yi ta, saata zaw kha paa zaw cuopa ta thiepa cuo'a va yi; cuorasala ahunghmuo cuose iema suena kawlie tana thiepa ama cuo aa,” tapa Abyipabiepina haata lienawtuv tie saata zaw kha thie va yi.
Ama ta Edom ming thawhraa kha Paciy Bawphie lie thie yi te Sela khy kha a la; Jokthe-el ta pata ming a sa, capa ca ataning tepa hingta a ming ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata Amaziah ta Israel siepahruo Jehu sacapaa, Jehoahaz sacapaa Jehoash'a luo kha biephyatuv pathlie te, “A vaw tie, pakha hne pakha a hmiepachaw pata a mang naase puv,” a ta.

Israel Siepahruo Jehoash ta Judah Siepahruo Amaziah kha bie taa te, “Lebanon tluo cunglie a awpa ahling kung ta Lebanon tluo cunglie a awpa sidar kung kha bie taa te, ‘Na sacanung kha i sacapaa napuv riypata na pi tie,’ a ta; cuorasala Lebanon lie saahruo sakha ta vya sisue te ahling kung kha a chaakabe diy.

Edom kha te sasaw cate na palung a le hing haw. Na rungnaana lie kha na palung tling sala, ing lie kha aw tie; khaapanakawma naa liena riypa hne nama hneta Judah kha a liekhyi riypata ruvnaana ca na pathu khing?” a ta.

Cuorasala Amaziah ta naathlie vyi. Caacuonakawta Israel Siepahruo Jehoash ca sithaw te, Judah ruo a cuopa Beth-shemesh lie kha ama hne Judah siepahruo Amaziah ca pakha hne pakha a hmiepachaw pata amaa du.
Israel ta Judah kha a te; ama cyicuo ta ing luo amaa ruo diy.

Israel Siepahruo Jehoash ta Jehoash sacapaa Judah Siepahruo Ahaziah kha Beth-shemesh lieta a patuv. Jerusalem luo kha a vaw te, Jerusalem dungkhuo lungruetlepie kha Efraim Thlake taata Dungkhuo Kiy Thlake te, daw zapaliy chung a pacing diy.
Ama ta Abyipaing chunglie a awpa hne siepahruo sue-ing lie a awpa siy hne ngu, hne biphie a hmungpa bangkhuo a la diy, cawsaa zaw kha patuv yi te Samaria luo a kaa.
Jehoash tuesana aa ngaapa, hne a cahrana, hne Judah Siepahruo Amaziah hneta tuokhaatama amaa tuv tapa tie ca Israel Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv liena ama cape cuo va ma?
Jehoash ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a zie te, Israel siepahruo tie hne khata Samaria lie ama paby; cakhutaata a sacapaa Jeroboam ta aa thle.
Judah siepahruo Joash sacapaa siepahruo Amaziah ca Israel Siepahruo Jehoahaz sacapaa Jehoash a thiy khutaata kung hraa hlyipangaa a hring.
Amaziah tuesana aa ngaapa ca Judah Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv chungliena ama cape cuo va ma?
Iema ta Jerusalem lie kha raw yi te, Lakhish luo kha aa ruo. Cuorasala Lakhish luo kha cawsaa cade sa yi te capa lie ca ama thie.
Aruo ta vya phya yi te, Jerusalem lie, David khypuv lie kha a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lieta ama paby.
Judah cawsaa bangkhuo khata kung hraa hlyicaruv a tapa Azariah kha la yi te a paa Amaziah a thle riypata siepahruo ta ama pacuo sa.
Siepahruo Amaziah kha a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie aa zie khutaata Azariah ta Elath khy kha sa pakhaa te Judah ruo chung luo a pahlaw pakhaa.

Judah Siepahruo Joash sacapaa Amaziah siepahruo a cuona kung hraa hlyipangaa kung lieta Israel Siepahruo Joash sacapaa Jeroboam kha Samaria lieta siepahruo cuo hruo a thu te, kung sawliy kung kha siepahruo a cuo.
Abyipaming hmungna lie kha a pha lipa tue te, Nebat sacapaa Jeroboam ta Israel ming a pasuesanapa suena kha sise vyi.
Israel Khazing, Abyipata Gath-hefer khy ming Amittai sacapaa, a changtaapa profet Jonah'a lie a ripa bie haa khata ama ta Israel ruoriy kha Lebo-hamath taata Arabah Riyliy te a pacuo sa pakhaa.

Tahematapakieca Abyipata Israel ming hrisaana ama angpa ca a pasa hringhruo tapa kha a hmung; capa lie ca pakha hmuo a ngaa va tli yi, ciypakipa acuolikie hya a zangpa, Israel ming a bya riypa pakha hmuo aw va tli yi.
Cuorasala Abyipata Israel a ming ca vuoruotyi taa hingta i pahli aa ta vyi, caacuonakawta iema ca Joash sacapaa Jeroboam kuv khata a khuo yi.

Jeroboam tuesana aa ngaapa, hne a tuepa bangkhuo, hne a cahrana, tuokhaatama rie a tuv tapa, hne Judah huopa ta a cuopa Damaskas hne Hamath kha Israel huota tuokhaatama a la pakhaa tapa zaw kha Israel Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv liena ama cape cuo va ma?
Jeroboam ca a mingchingmingvuo tie, Israel siepahruo tie'a lie kha a zie te, a sacapaa Zekhariah ta aa thle.
Jeroboam ta Israel siepahruo a cuonapa kung kiy kung sariyna lieta Judah siepahruo Amaziah sacapaa Azariah ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu.
Ama ca kung hraa hlyicaruv a ta pata siepahruo cuo hruo a thu te, Jerusalem lieta kung sawngaa kung hning siepahruo a cuo. A nung ming ca Jekoliah ta cuo te Jerusalem khy ming ta a cuo.
A paa Amaziah ta a za tuepa haa khata Abyipahmungna lie kha a phapa a tue.
Cuorasala khahrungtluobu ca para vyi; cawsaa ta khahrungtluobu lie ca hriykhungrina hne pihluona zaw ca ama tue ngiethie kalie.
Abyipata siepahruo kha tuv te, a thiy ning te ta caahminghmaa pasana hnyi te ing hrangpa lieta a aw. Siepahruo sacapaa Jotham kha siepahruo ing uvtuv cuo te ruo ming kha a uv yi.
Azariah tuesana aa ngaa kaliepa tie, hne a tuepa bangkhuo ca Judah Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv liena ama cape cuo va ma?
Azariah ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a zie te, a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie, David khypuv lie kha ama paby. A sacapaa Jotham ta ama kha aa thle.
Azariah ta Israel siepahruo a cuona kung sawthung kung carina lie kha Jeroboam sacapaa Zekhariah ta Israel ming cunglie kha siepahruo cuo te Samaria taata thla caruv a pe.
A mingchingmingvuo tie ama tuepa haa khata ama ta Abyipahmungna lie kha a pha lipa a tue. Nebat sacapaa Jeroboam ta Israel ming a pasuesanapa yi suena kha sise vyi.
Jebesh sacapaa Shallum ta ama kha raw te, cawsaazaapuv hmiekunglieta ama kha tuv te a thie; cakhutaata ama hmang lie kha siepahruo a cuo.
Zekhariah tuepa aa ngaapa ca Israel Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv liena ama cape cuo va ma?
Abyipa ta Jehu'a lie biekuona a za pipa ca: “Na saata zaw ta Israel byithude lie kha chuo paliyna te amaa tu aa,” ta pata a cuo. Cahaacata a cuo hmisi.
Jabesh sacapaa Shallum ca Uzziah ta Judah siepahruo a cuona kung sawthung kung caky kung ning kha siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu; Samaria lieta siepahruo thla kha a cuo.
Cakhutaata Gadi sacapaa Menahem kha Tirzah taata kya sithaw te Samaria a kya pha; ama ta Jabesh sacapaa Shallum kha Samaria lieta tuv te a thie; ama hmang lie kha siepahruo a cuo.
Shallum ta a tuepa aa ngaapa, ama ta a tuepa rawna tapa tie ca Israel Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv liena ama cape cuo va ma?

Capa cuo lie ca Menahem ta Tifsah khy kha a ruo chung Tirzah khy taata pathu pata a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo hne khata a para yi; tahematapakieca khy chung luo kha ama pangie khing li nakawta a para. Nu a phyapa canung riy te kha a thlaa diy yi.
Azariah ta Judah siepahruo a cuona kung sawthung kung caky kung lieta Gadi sacapaa Menahem kha Israel ming cunglie siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu; Samaria lieta kung hraa chung siepahruo a cuo.
Ama ta Abyipahmungna lie kha a pha lipa a tue; Nebat sacapaa Jeroboam ta Israel ming a pasuesanapa yi suena kha thuse vyi.
Assiria siepahruo Pul ta ruo kha a du te, Menahem ca ta siepahruo cahrana aa patuvpa kha a cu riypata Pul kha ngu talen thawkha a pi.

Menahem ta Israel ming'a taa khata tuokaa kha a khyi, a hnyirungpa tie bangkhuo'a taa khata Assiria siepahruo pi riypata pakha ta ngu shekel sawngaa law ta a khyi yi. Caacuonakawta Assiria siepahruo ca kaa te ruo chunglie ca aw vyi.
Menahem tuesana aa ngaapa bangkhuo, hne a tuepa bangkhuo ca Israel Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv liena ama cape cuo va ma?
Menahem ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a zie te, a sacapaa Pekahiah ta ama kha aa thle.
Azariah ta Judah siepahruo a cuona kung sawngaa kung lieta Menahem sacapaa Pekahiah ca Israel ming cunglie siepahruo cuo hruo a thu te Samaria lieta siepahruo kung hning a cuo.
Ama ta Abyipahmungna lie kha a pha lipa tue te, Nebat sacapaa Jeroboam ta Israel ming a pasuesanapa yi suena kha a maase vyi.

Remaliah sacapaa Pekah, a riekabyipa ta Argob hne Arieh ta pata Gilead ming sawngaa hne khata ama kha raw yi te, Samaria khy chunglie, siepahruo ing a chung khuo lieta ama kha thie te, ama hmang lie kha siepahruo a cuo.
Pekahiah tuesana aa ngaapa, hne a tuepa bangkhuo ca Israel Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv chungliena ama cape cuo va ma?
Azariah ta Judah siepahruo a cuona kung sawngaa kung hningna lieta Remaliah sacapaa Pekah ta Israel ming cunglie kha siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu; Samaria lieta kung kiy siepahruo a cuo.
Ama ta Abyipahmungna lie kha a pha lipa tue te, Nebat sacapaa Jeroboam ta Israel ming a pasuesanapa yi suena kha thuse vyi.

Israel Siepahruo Pekah chuo ning kha Assiria Siepahruo Tiglath-pileser kha a vaw te, Ijon, Abel-beth-maakah, Janoah, Kadesh, Hazor, Gilead hne Galilee, Naftali ruo bangkhuo kha a la; cakhutaata cawsaa kha Assiria ruo luo sii ta aa da yi.
Cakhutaata Elah sacapaa Hoshea ta Remaliah sacapaa Pekah ca raw te, tuv te, a thie; Uzziah sacapaa Jotham siepahruo a cuona kung kung kiyna lie kha ama hmang lieta siepahruo a cuo.
Pekah tuesana aa ngaapa, hne a tuepa bangkhuo ca Israel Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv chungliena ama cape cuo va ma?
Remaliah sacapaa Pekah ta Israel siepahruo cuona kung hningna lie kha Uzziah sacapaa Judah Siepahruo Jotham ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu.
Ama ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu ning kha kung kiy kung pangaa ta cuo te, Jerusalem lieta kung hraa hlyicaruv siepahruo a cuo. A nung ming ca Jerusha ta cuo te Zadok sacanung ta a cuo.
A paa Uzziah a tuepa haa khata Abyipahmungna lie kha a phapa a tue.
Cuorasala khahrungtluobu kha ca para vyi; cawsaa ta khahrungtluobu lie ca hriykhungrina hne pihluona zaw ca ama tue ngiethie kalie. Ama ta Abyipaing a cungluo thlake kha a tue.
Jotham tuesana aa ngaapa, hne a tuepa bangkhuo ca Judah Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv liena ama cape cuo va ma?
Capa cuo lie ca ta Abyipata Siria siepahruo Rezin hne Remaliah sacapaa Pekah kha Judah ruo a du riypata pathlie hruo aa thu.
Jotham ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a zie te, a mingchingmingvuo a cuopa David khypuv chunglie kha a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lieta ama paby; a sacapaa Ahaz ta ama kha aa thle.
Remaliah sacapaa Pekah siepahruo a cuona kung hraa hlyisariy kung lieta Jotham sacapaa Ahaz kha Judah siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu.

Ahaz ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu ning kha kung kiy ta a cuo; Jerusalem lieta siepahruo kung hraa hlyicaruv a cuo. A mingchingmingvuo ta a cuopa David ta a za tuepa haa khata Abyipaa Khazing hmungna lieta a phapa tue vyi.

Cuorasala Israel siepahruo tie luopuv kha a ziy. Israel ming hmiekung taata Abyipata a zaa cadepa mingphang tie ta duv aa chiypa hmang ama za tuepa haa khata ama ta a sacapaa kha hmuo hriykhungrina cuota myi ta a rue.
Khahrung tluobu cunglie, tluo cunglie, hne thingkung hringpa raw mekaa lie kha hriykhungrina hne pihluona a tue.
Cakhutaata Siria Siepahruo Rezin hne Remaliah sacapaa Israel siepahruo Pekah kha Jerusalem a du riypata a khaw yi te, Ahaz ca ama cadung; cuorasala te khu va yi.
Capa cuo lie ca Edom siepahruo ta Edom cuota Elath kha la pakhaa te Judah ming kha Elath taa cata aa cade yi; cakhutaata Edom ming ca Elath luo kha a vaw yi te ataning tepa hingta capa lie ca ama aw.

Ahaz ta Assiria Siepahruo Tiglath-pileser'a luo kha biephyatuv tie pathlie yi te, “Kama ca na changtaapa hne na saata tana i cuo. A khaw la naa tuv nguoluopa Siria siepahruo kuv taata hne Israel siepahruo kuv taa hingta na khuo tie,” a ta.
Ahaz ta Abyipaing chunglie a hmungpa siy hne ngu, hne siepahruo ing chunglie suethiy zaw kha la te Assiria siepahruo'a luo kha lasaw ta a paphya.
Assiria siepahruo ta a bie kha a naathliepa; Assiria siepahruo ca ta Damaskas kha si hning te a la, a cawsaa zaw kha Kir luo sii ta aa da yi; cakhutaata Rezin kha a thie.

Siepahruo Ahaz ta Damaskas luo kha Assiria Siepahruo Tiglath-pileser a taw riypata a si tiyta, Damaskas lie a awpa bienatluophie kha a hmung. Siepahruo Ahaz ta tluobyi Uriah'a luo kha bienatluophie a hmingsuo, a le a caw zaw kha a tlingsa pata a paphya.
Tluobyi Uriah ta siepahruo Ahaz ta Damaskas taata a paphyapa haa khata Siepahruo Ahaz Damaskas taata a za chiy hluota bienatluophie kha a sa.
Damaskas taata a za pha tiyta, siepahruo ta bienatluophie ca a mang. Cakhutaata siepahruo ta bienatluophie ca vaa ngie te, a cung luo kie te,
myirue panaana hne sa ta panaana zaw kha pihluo te, dangpa ta panaana kha bya te, aviesaa panaana ta a pihluopa thiy kha bienatluophie lie ca a hi.
Abyipahmiekunglie a awpa daa bienatluophie kha ing hmieluo, ama bienatluophie hne Abyipaing alala ing hmiekung taa khata palaw te ama bienatluophie chaluo kuo khata a chi.

Siepahruo Ahaz ta tluobyi Uriah kha biepi te, “Bienatluophie a lepa lie hing maw myirue panaana, hne zuoluo sa ta panaana, hne siepahruo myirue panaana, hne sa ta panaana kha hingpa ruo ming ama myirue panaana hne sa ta panaana, hne dangpa ta panaana zaw bangkhuo hne khata na rue aa; cakhutaata a cunglie kha myirue panaana ta pihluopa thiy bangkhuo, hne hriykhungrina lie pihluopa thiy bangkhuo kha na hi aa; cuorasala daa bienatluophie ca kama cuota bie i hiehriyna hmang ta a cuo aa,” a ta.
Tluobyi Uriah ta zezaw bangkhuo kha Siepahruo Ahaz ta bie a pina haa khata a tue.
Cakhutaata Siepahruo Ahaz ta aa tunapa a tung zaw kha te te, aa siynapa rahung kha a palaw; daa cuetungpa tie ta ama phyapa rahunglepa kha palaw te lungphie phaapa cunglieta a patu.

Siepahruo ing chunglieta sabbath ning hmuo riypata a cung thlungkhuv ama tuepa luopuv, hne siepahruo aleluo taata aa ngienapa zaw kha Abyipaing taa cata ama para. Hingpa hing Assiria siepahruo kawlieta a tuepa tana a cuo.
Ahaz tuesana aa ngaapa hne a tuepa tie ca Judah Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv liena ama cape cuo va ma?
Ahaz ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a zie te, David khypuv lie kha a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lieta ama paby; a sacapaa Hezekiah ta ama kha aa thle.
Ahaz ta Judah siepahruo a cuona kung hraa hlyihning kung lie kha, Elah sacapaa Hoshea ca Israel ming cunglie siepahruo cuo hruo a thu te, Samaria lieta kung caky siepahruo a cuo.
Ama ta Abyipahmungna lie kha a pha lipa tue te, ama hluo lie'apa Israel siepahruo tie haa khata cuo vyi.
Assiria Siepahruo Shalmaneser kha a khaw te ama kha aa du; Hoshea ca a kuv rawlie kha aw te ngukhyi a pi.

Cuorasala Assiria siepahruo ta Hoshea'a lieta raw khingna pathiypalung a awpa kha a hmung; tahematapakieca ama ta Izipt Siepahruo'a luo kha biephyatuv pathlie te kung tating ta a pi tawpa ngukhyi kha pi li pata a aw; caacuonakawta Assiria siepahruo ta ama kha patuv te thaw a pathla.
Cakhutaata Assiria siepahruo ta ruo bangkhuo kha tuv te, Samaria luo kha a vaw te kung thung chung a cadung.

Hoshea siepahruo a cuona kung caky kung lieta Assiria ta Samaria kha a la; ama ta Israel ming kha Assiria luo a sikhyi yi. Iema kha Gozan cavaa kie Halah ruo hne Habor ruo lie hne Medes khypuv tie lie kha a chi yi.

Hingpa hing Israel cawsaa ta Izipt ruo Izipt siepahruo Faro kuv raw taata a vya pyakhyipa yi ama Khazing, Abyipa'a lie kha ama sue nakawta a cuopa hmang ta a cuo. Iema ta khazing hrangpa tie kha abie yi te,
Abyipata Israel ming hmiekung taata aa cadepa yi mingphang tie phungluo hne Israel siepahruo tie ta ama lachawpa phungluo tie kha ama ziy.
Israel cawsaa tie ta a paruvta tah a pha lipa kha Abyipaama Khazing cunglie ama tue. Iema ta ama khypuv bangkhuo lie, rievena ingsuo taata dungkhuopa khypuv te ta khahrungtluobu kha amaa sa;
tluo aa suopa mekaa lie hne thingkung hringdiyliypa raw mekaa lie kha lungbang hne Ashera tung kha a tue yi te,
Abyipata iema hmiekunglie aa cadepa mingphang tie ama tuepa haa khata khahrungtluobu mekaa lie kha pihluona ama tue. Iema ta hmang pha lipa kha tue yi te, Abyipakha a hi ama pahaa;
Abyipata, “Hingpa hing tue'a va ung ciy,” a tapa kuvtuezuv kha amaa bie.

Cuorasala Abyipata Israel hne Judah kha profet bangkhuo hne hmungtuvpa bangkhuo hmuo pata a raaringna pi yi te, “A pha lipa nama luopuv taa hingta a vya maa ung la, nama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie i za pipa yi phungbie bangkhuo haa khata hne i changtaapa profet tie'a taata ica pipa yi haa khata i nawbie hne i phungluo kha ziy tie ung,” a ta.
Iema ta naathlie khing lipa yi ta Abyipaama Khazing a zang lipa ama mingchingmingvuo tie haa khata ama palung a cuo.

Iema ta a phungluo, hne ama mingchingmingvuo tie hne a tuepa biekuona hne a raaringna a pipa zaw yi kha siysaa ri va yi. Khaapahmuo a cuo lipa kuvtuezuv kha a bie yi te, khaapahmuo a cuo lipa ta amaa li; Abyipata iema ama tuepa haata tue'a va ung ciy a tapa ama cahriycake lie a awpa mingphang tie kha ama ziy.
Iema ta Abyipaama Khazing nawbie bangkhuo kha thaw yi te, cuetaata sahning kha iema cuota amaa patle; Asherah tung kha a tue yi te avuo lie a awpa hmang bangkhuo kha abie yi te Baal re kha ama hrie.

Iema ta ama sacapaa hne ama sacanung zaw kha myi ta rue yi te ama pihluo; hmungdawluna hne kuvcaa mangpa zaw kha hmuo yi te, Abyipahmungna lie a pha lipa tue riypata iema hne iema kha a zaa yi te, Abyipahi kha ama pahaa.
Caacuonakawta Abyipaca Israel ming cunglie kha a hi haa hringhruo te iema kha a hmungna taata a thaw yi; Judah phang ta li pata ca ahunghmuo a ngaa va yi.
Judah zaw ta Abyipaama Khazing nawbie kha ziy vyi, cuorasala Israel ta a chiykhyipa phungluo kha a ziy ra.
Abyipata Israel ciypathla bangkhuo kha thaw yi te, iema kha duote yi te a hmungna taata a papya hluo li yi paratuv tie kuv luo kha a pi yi.
Israel kha David ingchungkhue taata a thlaachi tiyta, Nebat sacapaa Jeroboam kha siepahruo ta ama pacuo sa. Jeroboam ta Israel kha Abyipaziyna taata piekhyi yi te suena lepuv a patue sa yi.
Israel ming ca Jeroboam ta a tuepa suena bangkhuo kha ama tuepazue.

Abyipata a changtaapa profet tie bangkhuo'a taata a rilupa haata Israel kha a hmungna taata a thaw hluo te iema ta capa ca sise va yi. Caacuonakawta Israel ca ama ruo taa khata Assiria ruo luo kha ataning tepa hingta papyapa ama cuo.
Assiria siepahruo ta Kuth, Avva, Hamath, hne Sefarvaim khy tie taata cawsaa kha Israel ming cuopa ta Samaria khypuv zaw lie kha a chi yi; iema ta Samaria kha cu yi te a khypuv tie lie kha khy ama sa.
Capa lie ama aw taa ning kha Abyipakha abie va yi; caacuonakawta Abyipata iema hraw luo kha chingde pathlie te cawsaa chekha kha a thie yi.

Caacuonakawta Assiria siepahruo kha chang yi te, “Nama ta sikhyi yi cate Samaria khypuv tie lieta na chipa mingphang tie khata capa ruo khazing phungbie kha pachang va yi; caacuonakawta ama hraw luo kha chingde pathlie te capa ca ta a thie yi; tahematapakieca iema ta ama ruo khazing phungbie kha pachang va yi,” ama ta.

Cakhutaata Assiria siepahruo ta bie pi yi te, “Capa ruo taata nama vya sikhyipa tluobyi pakha kha capa ruo luo ca paphya ung la; va si sala capa lie ca va aw se, cakhutaata capa ruo khazing phungbie kha va pacuv yi se,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta iema ta Samaria taata ama vya sikhyipa tluobyi pakha ca a vaw te Bethel lie kha aw te, ama ta tuokhaatama Abyipaamaa bie aa tapa kha a pacuv yi.
Cuorasala mingphang mekaa ca ta iema khazing kha a tue yi te Samaria cawsaa tie ta ama za tuepa abiena hmang lie kha ama chi.
Babilon ming ta Sukkoth-benoth amaa tue, Kuth ming ta Nergal amaa tue, Hamath ming ta Ashima amaa tue,
Avva ming ta Nibhaz hne Tartak amaa tue; Sefarvaim ming ta Sefarvaim khazing kha a tue yi te ama saata zaw kha Sefarvaim khazing ta a cuopa Adrammelek hne Anammelek abiena ta myi lie ama rue.

Abyipazaw kha abie ngiethie yi te, iema chungtaata cawsaa phangting kha khahrungtluobu abiena hmang lie kha tluobyi pahrie sa yi te, khahrungtluobu hmang pathe lie ca iema cuo khata hriykhungrina ama tue.
Caacuonakawta iema ta Abyipakha abie yi te, cuorasala ama vya pyanapa mingphang tie ama tuepa haa khata ama khazing re zaw kha ama hrie ngiethie.

Ataning tepa hingta a hluo ning ama za tuepa haa khata ama tuepazue. Iema ta Abyipakha abie lipa yi ta Abyipata Israel ta pata ming a sapa Jakob saata zaw a pipa yi phungluo, ziyphung, phungbie hne nawbie zaw kha ziy va yi.

Abyipata iema hne biekuona tue te nawbie a pipa yi ca, “Niema ta khazing hrangpa kha abie'a va ung ciy, a hmiekunglie kha a bung'a va ung ciy, a re hrie'a va ung ciy, iema'a lie kha hriykhungrina zaw pihluo'a va ung ciy;
cuorasala niema kha Izipt ruo taata a cahrana lepa hne a pazuopa a buo ta caa vya pyakhyipa yi Abyipakha namaa bie aa; a hmiekunglie kha a bung'a ung cate, ama kha hriykhungrina nama pihluo aa.
Niema cuota a capepa phungluo, hne ziyphung, hne phungbie hne nawbie zaw kha a raaringsa pata nama ziy aa, Khazing hrangpa kha abie'a va ung ciy;
niema hne i tuepa biekuona kha maw'a va ung ciy. Khazing hrangpa kha abie'a va ung ciy,
cuorasala Abyipanama Khazing kha abie'a ung cate, ama ta nama carie tie bangkhuo kuv taa khata aca khuo'a yi,” a ta.
Cuorasala iema ta naathlie va yi, ahluo ta ama tue tawpa haa khata ama tue pazue.

Caacuonakawta hingpa mingphang tie hingta Abyipakha abie yi te, cuorasala iema ama tuepa kuvtuezuv zaw kha amaa bie ngiethie; ataning tepa hingta ama saata zaw hne ama saata zaw saata tie zaw khata ama mingchingmingvuo tie haa khata ama tue pazue.
Elah sacapaa Hoshea ta Israel siepahruo a cuona kung thung kung lie ta Judah Siepahruo Ahaz sacapaa Hezekiah ta siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu.
Ama ca kung kiy kung pangaa a ta pata siepahruo cuo hruo a thu te, Jerusalem lieta kung kiy kung caky siepahruo a cuo. A nung ming ca Abi ta cuo te, Zekhariah sacanung ta a cuo.
Ama ca a mingchingmingvuo David ta a za tuepa haa khata Abyipahmungna lie a phapa a tue.

Ama ta khahrungtluobu kha a para, lungbang tie kha phie te Asherah tung zaw kha a hupatyi. Ama ta Moses ta a za tuepa daa pariy kha a dechi diy, tahematapakieca capa ning te khata Israel ming ta rangpa-ue pihluo pari yi te, Nehushtan ama ta.
Ama ta AbyipaIsrael Khazing kha a ringchuo te, caacuonakawta ama hnang taata a vawpa Judah siepahruo bangkhuo ta ama haapa pakha hmuo aw va yi.
Tahematapakieca ama ta Abyipa kha a cusa pata a patuv te, ama ziyna kha thuse vyi, cuorasala Abyipata Moses a pipa nawbie kha a ziy.
Abyipaca ama'a lie aw te, a awna mekaa lie tena a hmung. Assiria siepahruo kha a du te a re hrie vyi.
Ama ta Filistin ming kha Gaza hne a pena ruo te ta a du yi te, rievena ingsuo taata dungkhuopa khypuv te ta a te.

Siepahruo Hezekiah ta siepahruo acuona kung paliy kung lie, Elah sacapaa Hoshea ta Israel siepahruo a cuona kung sariy kung lie kha Assiria Siepahruo Shalmaneser ta Samaria kha a du riypata a khawchiy te a cadung,
kung thung a chuona lieta a la. Hezekiah siepahruo a cuona kung caruv kung lie, Israel Siepahruo Hoshea siepahruo a cuona kung caky kung lieta Samaria kha a la.
Assiria siepahruo ta Israel ming kha Assiria luo a chiy yi te, Gozan cavaa kie Halah, Habor hne Media ming khypuv tie lie kha khy a pasa sa yi,
tahematapakieca iema ta Abyipaama Khazing bie kha naathlie lipa yi ta a biekuo kha ama para, Abyipata a changtaapa Moses'a lie bie a pipa kha hmuo naathlie lipa yi ta ziy va yi.
Hezekiah ta siepahruo a cuona kung hraa hlyipaliy kung lieta Assiria Siepahruo Sennakherib kha a khaw te Judah ruo lie khy dungkhuo a hnyipa khypuv bangkhuo kha tuv te a la diy.

Judah siepahruo Hezekiah ta Lakhish lie Assiria siepahruo'a luo kha cawsaa pathlie yi te, “I tuechie tli; na kaase thi tie; i cunglie na khangpa khaapa a cuo zaw i ang aa,” a ta. Assiria siepahruo ta Judah siepahruo Hezekiah'a lie kha siy talen sawthung hne ngu talen zathung a hie.
Hezekiah ta Abyipaing chunglie hne siepahruo ing sue-ing lie ama hmungpa ngu bangkhuo kha a pi.
Capa cuo lie ca Hezekiah ta Abyipabiena-ing ingchiypakaa lie siy hne ingchiypakaa tung a pakawpa zaw kha khaw te Assiria siepahruo ca a pi.

Assiria siepahruo ta Tartan, Rabsaris, hne Rabshakeh tapa tie kha riekaphuv a lesapa hneta Lakhish taata Jerusalem luo, siepahruo Hezekiah'a luo kha a pathlie yi. Iema ca sithaw yi te Jerusalem luo kha ama pha. Iema ca ama kya pha tiyta, Cawpasuvtuv Lu luo sinapa luopuv lepa cunglie, cungluo tiyliy tiy papyanapa athaalie kha amaa daa.
Siepahruo kha ama ku tiyta, Hilkiah sacapaa ta a cuopa siepahruo ing uvtuv Eliakim, caacapetuv Shebnah hne Asaf sacapaa ta a cuopa cazing a patuvpa Joah kha iema'a luo ca ama kya pya.
Rabshakeh ta iema kyihuo khata, “Hezekiah kha chang tie ung: A lesyipa siepahruo, Assiria siepahruo na hing haa hingta a ri: Khaapa a pacaw cate ma hing tluv nanaa hingta naa zang?
Bie hing rietuv thena hne cahrana ta ri kanaa ciy? Ahung a buchuo cate ma kama hing inaa du ciy?
Mang tie, a hypa tie mekaa kuv a chungpa, phiepahlaa khuecahryi tlipa Izipt na naa ringchuo. Izipt siepahruo Faro ca ama a ringchuopa tie bangkhuo cuota cahaaca tana a cuo.

Cuorasala niema ta kama kha, Kiema ca ‘Abyipama Khazing na maa ringchuo,’ ina ta kie ungca ca, capa ca Hezekiah ta a khahrungtluobu hne a bienatluophie zaw kha para te, Judah hne Jerusalem kha, ‘Jerusalem lie a awpa hingpa bienatluophie hmiekunglie hingna namaa bie aa,’ a tapa kha cuo va ma?
Ata hingta a vaw la, i byipaapa Assiria siepahruo hneta biekuona tue tie ung: namaluo kuo taata a khangtuv riypa naa hmung khu kieca aruo thawhning ica pi aa.
Cakhutaata aruole hne aruo rieka cuota Izipt kha naa buchuo kieca tuokhaatama i byipaapa changtaapa tie chungtaata a caw cepa riekabyi pakha kha hmuo a du pata na pakaa khu aa?
Ca hlyitaw taata hingpa hmang luo para riypata icaa khawhnuepa yi hing Abyipali pata a tuepa ta na rue kanaa ung ciy? Abyipana khaw la, hingpa ruo hing kya para tie, naa ta,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Hilkiah sacapaa Eliakim, hne Shebnah, hne Joah ta Rabshakeh kyihuo khata, “Na changtaapa zaw hing Aramaik ryi ta malie chaw tie, tahematapakieca ma thyi thluo; lungrue tlepie cunglie a awpa tie thyina lie hing Judah ryi ta malie chaw thi khah,” ama ta.

Cuorasala Rabshakeh ta iema kyihuo khata, “Hingpa bie hing nama byipaapa hne niema'a lie dyi ri riypata ma i byipaapa ta kama hing ina pathlie? Khy dungkhuo lungrue tlepie cunglie a tupa tie, niema hneta duote hne pata iema ii mamaapa a ning riypa hne iema pazung mamaapa a dang riypa tie'a lie zaw ri ra riypata cuo ra va ma?” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata Rabshakeh ca a daa te, Judah ryi ta khuosa ta khi te, “A lesyipa siepahruo, Assiria siepahruo bie hing naathlie tie ung!
Siepahruo na hing haa hingta a ri: Hezekiah hing a padung sa khah ung, tahematapakieca ama ta niema kha kama kuv chungtaata ca khuo khu'a va yi.
Abyipata malie a khuo hrahring aa, hingpa khypuv hing Assiria siepahruo kuv chung luo pi'a vyi, a tapa Hezekiah bie khata Abyipaa ringchuo riypata ca tue khah yi se.

Hezekiah bie kha naathlie khah ung; tahematapakieca Assiria siepahruo na hing haa hingta a ri: ‘Kama hneta diena tue tie ung, kama'a luo kha kya pya tie ung; cawsaa mekaa ta niema mingsuv hne niema thyikuv kha ning'a ung cate, niema takhue taata tiy nama dang aa.

Kama kha a khaw pata nama ruo haata a tapa ruo, sa hne mingsuv a vyinapa ruo, viechuo hne mingsuv dung a hluvnapa ruo, olif thu hne khyitiy a hluvnapa ruo luo icaa chiyna te yi ta thiy li pata nama hringna riypata, Abyipana malie a khuo aa, tapa bie ta Hezekiah ta aca dungpa yi kha zang khah ung.
Mingphang tie khazing pakha chuo ta a ruo kha Assiria siepahruo kuv taata a khuo khupa a aw buo ma?
Hamath hne Arpad khazing tie ca khaapaliema ama aw? Sefarvaim, Hena, hne Ivvah khazing tie ca khaapaliema ama aw? Samaria ca i kuv chung taa hingta khuo khu yi ma?
Hingpa ruo tie khazing zaw chungtaa hingta khaapa khazing ma ama ruo kha kama kuv taata a khuo buo yi? Cata a cuo kieca Abyipa ta Jerusalem hing i kuv taata a khuo'a ma?” a ta.
Cuorasala cawsaa ca duokaring yi te, ama kha bie kaa kha hmuo palie va yi, tahematapakieca siepahruo biepina ca, “Ama kha palie khah ung,” ta pata a cuo.

Cakhutaata, Hilkiah sacapaa siepahruo ing uvtuv Eliakim, caacapetuv Shebna, hne Asaf sacapaa cazingkhungtuv Joah tapa tie ca Hezekiah'a luo kha a vaw yi te, ama caw kha thlaa yi te Rabshakeh bie kha ama chang.
Siepahruo Hezekiah ta capa ca a thyi tiyta, a caw kha a thlaa, buri kha a buv te Abyipaing chung luo kha aa ngie.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ing uvtuv Eliakim, hne caacapetuv Shebna, hne tluobyi uvthyi vie tie kha buri a buv pata Amoz sacapaa profet Isaiah'a luo kha a pathlie yi.
Iema ta, “Hezekiah na hing haa hingta a ri, ataning ca palungriethyina ning, a chuoraana ning, hne nangzaana ning tana a cuo; haatiy ca a za puv'a nang tli, cuorasala papuv sa khunapa thaazuo aw vyi.

A byipaapa Assiria siepahruo ta a hringpa Khazing kha tue hyalya riypata a vya pathliepa Rabshakeh bie bangkhuo ca Abyipana Khazing ta a thyi tli thlu aa. A ripa bie ca Abyipana Khazing ta thyi sala chuo mang sue; caacuonakawta aa ngaapa tie cuo khata thlaachuo tie,” ama ta.
Siepahruo Hezekiah changtaapa tie kha Isaiah'a luo ama pha tiyta,
Isaiah ta, “Nama byipaapa kha chang tie ung, ‘Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Assiria siepahruo changtaapa tie ta ina esenapa yi bie na thyipa kawlieta ciy khah.

Kama hrahring ta thlaapa kha a chunglie chi'a angte, caacuonakawta a khie cakhawpa bie kha thyi'a te a ruo luo kha a kaa aa; a ruo chung mamaapa lie kha zueziy ta a thiy riypata i tue aa, a ta,’ ta pata va chang tie ung,” a ta.
Assiria siepahruo na Lakhish a thuse tli tapa kha Rabshakeh ta a thyi tiyta, a kaa ca, siepahruo ta Libnah a tuv nguoluopa kha a hmung.
Siepahruo ta Ethiopia siepahruo Tirhakah kaw hne aa patuv pata, Hezekiah'a luo kha biephyatuv pathlie te, “Mang tie, ama ca nama a du riypata aa vya tha tli,” a pata sa yi.

Judah siepahruo Hezekiah'a lie nama ri riypa bie ca hing haa hingta a cuo aa: Naa buchuopa na Khazing ta ca dung te, Jerusalem ca Assiria siepahruo kuv chung luo pi pata cuo'a vyi, aca tapa kha zang khah.
Mang tie, Assiria siepahruo tie ta ruo bangkhuo cunglie ama tuepa, ama para diy karuepa kha na thyi tli. Nama ca khuo pata na cuo'a ma?
I mingchingmingvuo tie ta ama za parapa mingphang tie ta a cuopa Gozan, Haran, Rezef, hne Telassar lie a awpa Eden cawsaa zaw kha ama mingphang khazing tie ta ama khuo khu ma?
Hamath siepahruo, Arpad siepahruo, Sefarvaim khypuv siepahruo, Hena siepahruo acuolikie Ivvah siepahruo tie ca khaapaliema ama aw?” a ta.
