Hezekiah ta biephyatuv tie kuv taata caa kha hmung te a ri; cakhutaata Hezekiah ca Abyipaing luo kha khaw te capa caa ca Abyipahmiekunglie kha a pake.

Cakhutaata Hezekiah ta Abyipahmiekunglie kha thlaachuo te: “Vya Abyipa, Israel Khazing, cherubim cung byithude lie a tupa, alyi cung pena bangkhuo Khazing ca nama pakha kyalya dyi tana na cuo; nama na alyi hne avuo hing a tue ciy.
Vya Abyipa, na naathlie la thyi thi tie; Vya Abyipana ming kha padyi la hmung thi tie; a hringpa Khazing aca tue hyalyanapa Sennakherib bie kha thyi thi tie.
Vya Abyipa, Assiria siepahruo tie ta mingphang tie hne ama ruo zaw kha ama pahli diy tli,
ama khazing tie kha myi chung luo ama thaw diy tli, tahematapakieca iema ca khazing ta cuo lipa yi ta cawsaa kuv ta tuepa thing hne lung tana ama cuo, caacuonakawta para diy pata ama cuo.

Caacuonakawta, Vya Abyipakiema Khazing, alyi lie pena bangkhuo lie hing nama pakha dyina Abyipa, Khazing ta a cuo ciy tapa kha ama pachangna riypata, a kuv taa hingta malie khuo thi tie, ta pata thlaa i chuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Amoz sacapaa Isaiah ta Hezekiah'a luo kha cawsaa pathlie te, “Israel Khazing, Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Assiria siepahruo Sennakherib kaw kama'a luo thlaa na chuopa kha i thyi.
Ama hne aa patuv pata Abyipata a ripa bie ca hingpa hing tana a cuo: Zion sacanung lesaa pathenung na nama kha ca ese te caa manghnue; Jerusalem sacanung na na hnangluo taata a luv caa chysue.
Ahungma tue hyalya cate a kawchie na ri? Ahung a du pata na ryi pathlie cate ma, a mangkhangsa pata na ming na padyi? Israel Khazing Pathe na naa du!

Na biephyatuv tie hmuo pata Abyipakha tue hyalya cate, nama ta, “I ruole a hluvsa hne tana aa suopa tluo luo kha i sithaw, Lebanon tluodaw luo kha i kie tli; a sidar kung aa suo cepa hne a saipres kung a pha cepa kha i hu tli; aa hla cenapa a ruo chung hne a ping cenapa aa tuv chung luo kha i ngie tli;
Takhue kha cu angte, ruohrang ming tiy kha i dang, Izipt cavaata bangkhuo kha i phyipazaa ta i paky diy, na ta.

A hluo ning taata bie i za chi tli tapa kha thyi va ca ma? A hluo ning taa khata za tingtuo pacie angte, ata hing i vya chiykhyi. Dungkhuopa khypuv tie kha pacing pata a ranapa aa pungnapa ta tue riypata ica pa-aw,
a chunglie khy a sapa tie ca ama thaa chuo te, ama nang-uo te amaa kalaa; iema ca lu lie aphuv haata hne ing cunglie a pupa aphuv haata ama le hluota amaa uv.
Cuorasala naa daapa hne naa tupa, na pyapa hne naa ngiepa, i cunglie na hihaapa zaw kha i pachang.
I cunglie na hi haa te, na pyathuna kha i thyi nakawta, na hnacabuv kha i kyipa ica pasiy sa aa; na pakaa lie kha thaatungriy ca tuv'a angte, naa vawnapa luopuv taata ica pakaa sa aa.

“'Cakhutaata hingpa hing na cuota pamangsana ta a cuo aa: Ata kung hne huo kung ca sahliypa kha ning'a ung cate, cakhutaata a kung thungna lie ca saciy kha tuv ung la, sa kha hrie ung la, mingsuv diedung kha tue ung la a thyipaa kha ning tie ung.
Judah ingchungkhue taata a hringpa ta aa ngaapa tie ca aa thuvsa pata ama thariy thlabung'a yi te cungluo kha thyi ama kya pathyi aa.
Tahematapakieca Jerusalem taata aa ngaapa tie pya'a yi te, Zion Tluo taata a hringpa tie ama pya aa. Cungnungce Abyipakhingna ta hingpa hing a tue aa.

“'Caacuonakawta Assiria siepahruo hne aa patuv pata Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Ama ca hingpa khypuv chung luo hing a vaw'a vyi, cuoti kha vya ka'a vyi, hingpa khypuv hmie luo hing phya hneta a vaw'a vyi, riekhuocaaca zaw sasue'a vyi.
Aa vawnapa luopuv taa khata a kaa aa; hingpa khypuv chung luo hing a ngie'a vyi, Abyipana a ta.
Tahematapakieca kama cuota hne i changtaapa David cuota hingpa khypuv hing khuo riypata i daakhuo aa,’” a ta.
Capa zuo lie ca ta Abyipaavuoming kha a thu te Assiria ming arina hmang lie kha thawzakha thawsawcari thawpangaa a thie yi; mawluo khy a kya dyi ca athiypa riyy seta a cuo.
Cakhutaata Assiria Siepahruo Sennakherib ca pya te, ing luo kha si te, Nineveh lieta a aw.
A khazing Nisrok ing chunglieta khazing aa bie nguoluo ning khata a sacapaa tie Adrammelek hne Sharezer ta zueziy ta thie yi te, Ararat ruo luo kha amaa ruo. A sacapaa Esar-haddon ta ama kha aa thle.

Capa cuo lie ca Hezekiah ca pasa te vuotaa a thiy'a nang. Amoz sacapaa profet Isaiah kha ama'a luo a vaw te, “Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Na ingchungkhue kha aa chaw aa rawsa pata tue tie, tahematapakieca tluo pakhaa'a va tli ciy, na thiy aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Hezekiah ca tlepie luo kha a hyi te Abyipa'a luo kha thlaa a chuo:

Vya Abyipa, paa na ica kie, pathiypalung hmisi hne zang tluo aa tlasa pata na hmiekunglie tuokhaatama i hring tapa hne na hmungna lieta phana i tue tapa kha ata hingta naa thyipa thi tie,” ta te, khuosa ta a caa.
Isaiah kha a liekhingkhuo khuo taata a pya hluota, Abyipabie ca ama'a luo a zuv te:

“Kaa la i cawsaa zaw abyipa Hezekiah kyihuo khata, na mingchingmingvuo David Khazing, Abyipana: Na thlaachuona ca thyi tli angte, na mingthliy zaw i hmung tli, ica patluo sa aa; ning thungnapa lie Abyipaing luo kha na khaw aa.

Na hringna kha kung hraa hlyipangaa aca cha aa. Kama ta nama hne hingpa khypuv hing Assiria siepahruo kuv chungtaata ica khuo'a yi; kama kawlie hne i changtaapa David kawlieta hingpa khypuv hing i daakhuo aa, a ta, ta pata va chang tie,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Isaiah ta, “Thyikuv caapa hlung kha vya cyi tie ung. Cyile yi sala a hmaa lie kha va chi yi sala a tluo aa,” a ta.
Hezekiah ta Isaiah kyihuo khata, “Abyipata kama kha na patluo sa'a te, a ning thungna lie Abyipaing luo i khaw riypata pamangsana ca khaapatama a cuo aa?” a ta.
Isaiah ta, “Abyipata bie aca kuopa haata a tue aa a tapa, Abyipa'a taata pamangsana ca hingpa hing tana a cuo: ningdiy hing hmieluo tama kyi hraa a si aa, hnangluo tama kyi hraa aa saw aa?” a ta.
Hezekiah ta palie te, “Ningdiy hmieluo ta kyi hraa sipa ca a cuo tawpa tana a cuo; caacuonakawta ningdiy ca kyi hraa ta hnangluo a saw se,” a ta.
Profet Isaiah ca Abyipa'a luo u te, Ahaz ning-siymaluo kuv ningdiy kha hnangluo ky hraa a pakaa sa.
Capa cuo lie ca Babilon ming Baladan sacapaa Siepahruo Merodak-baladan ta Hezekiah na a pasa tapa kha a thyi nakawta luosituv tie kha vya pathlie yi te caa hne lasaw kha a vya paphya.

Hezekiah ta palung tluosa pata cuhluo yi te, a suethiy ing, ngu, siy, rangpa-ue, a muosungpa chiytiy, a cehre china ing, a chechiy china ing lie hmung khupa bangkhuo kha a pahmung diy yi. A ing chunglie a awpa hne a ruo chunglie a awpa bangkhuo kha Hezekiah ta a pahmung lipa yi suokha hmuo aw vyi.

Cakhutaata profet Isaiah ca siepahruo Hezekiah'a luo kha a vaw te, “Hingpa cawsaa tie hingta khaapama ama ri? Khaapa taata ma nama'a luo hing amaa vaw?” a ta. Hezekiah ta, “Iema ca aa luohlaasapa ruo, Babilon taa tana amaa vaw,” a ta.

Ama ta, “Na ing lie khaapama ama hmung?” a ta. Hezekiah ta palie te, “I ing chunglie a awpa bangkhuo kha ama hmung diy, i chechiy china ing chunglie a awpa suokha hmuo i pahmung lipa yi aw vyi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Isaiah ta Hezekiah kyihuo khata, “Abyipabie hing naathlie tie:

Na ing chunglie a awpa bangkhuo hne, na mingchingmingvuo tie ta ataning tepa ta ama za pacungpa bangkhuo kha Babilon luo ama sikhyi diyna cuo ca aa vawle nguoluo tli; suokha hmuo thuse pata cuo'a vyi, Abyipana a ta.
Na sapa na sacapaa chekha zaw kha sikhyi'a yi te, iema ca Babilon siepahruo ing lie kha tiydiypa, rehrietuv ta ama cuo aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Hezekiah ta Isaiah kyihuo khata, “Na ripa Abyipabie ca a pha thluo,” a ta. Tahematapakieca ama ta, “I chuo chunglie diena hne abangna a aw kieca pha tluo'a va ma?” ta pata a rue.
Hezekiah tuesana aa ngaapa, a cahrana bangkhuo, ama ta tiy-ang hne tiyluo kha tue te khypuv chung luo tiy a pachiyna zaw kha Judah Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv chungliena ama cape cuo va ma?
Hezekiah ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a zie te, a sacapaa Manasseh ta ama kha aa thle.
Manasseh ca kung hraa hlyihning a ta pata siepahruo cuo hruo a thu te, Jerusalem lieta kung sawngaa kung pangaa siepahruo a cuo. A nung ming ca Hefzibah ta a cuo.
Ama ta Abyipata Israel ming hmiekung taata aa cadepa mingphang tie ta ama tuepa duvsamakhie aa chiypa kha ziy te Abyipahmungna lieta a pha lipa kha a tue.

Tahematapakieca a paa Hezekiah ta a za para ciepa khahrungtluobu kha sa hru pakhaa te Israel Siepahruo Ahab ta a tuepa haa khata Baal bienatluophie hne Asherah tung zaw kha sa te, avuo lie a awpa bangkhuo kha abie te a re a hrie.
Abyipata, “Jerusalem liena i ming i chi aa,” a za tapa Abyipaing chunglie kha bienatluophie a sa.
Ama ta Abyipaing tlawhmie suohning chunglie kha avuo lie a awpa hmang bangkhuo cuo khata bienatluophie a sa.

A sacapaa kha myi ta rue te a pihluo; hmieluo kaw ridawluna hne kuvcaa mangna zaw kha hmuo te, apyipa hne khuevuo a hnyipa zaw kha aa pha yi. Abyipahmungna lie kha a pha lipa a hluvsa tue te a hi a pahaa.

Asherah kuvtuezuv kha sa te Khazing ing chunglie a chi. Kuvtuezuv hne aa patuv pata Abyipata David hne a sacapaa Solomon kyihuo ta a ripa ca, “Israel phang bangkhuo chungtaata i tlawpa Jerusalem lie hne hingpa ing chunglie hingna i ming ca chuozaa ta i sang aa.

Kama ta i pipa yi biepina haata hne i changtaapa Moses ta bie a pipa yi phungbie haata a raaringsa pata ama tue kieca Israel ming ca kama ta ama mingchingmingvuo tie i pipa yi ruo taa khata pavievuv sa'a va yi ang,” a ta.
Cuorasala iema ta naathlie va yi; Israel ming hmiekunglie Abyipata a parapa yi mingphang tie ta ama tuepa laa khata pha lina a hluv vie kha Manasseh ta a patue sa yi.
Abyipata a changtaapa profet tie'a taata,

“Tahematapakieca Judah siepahruo Manasseh ta hingpa duvsamakhie aa chiypa hmang hing tue te, ama hluota a zaa awpa Amor ming ta ama tuepa bangkhuo laata a pha li viepa kha tue te ama kuvtuezuv ta Judah ming kha a pasue sa yi.
Caacuonakawta Israel Khazing, Abyipata, a thyipa mekaa tie naa lieta kha te, ama nang a pa-uo riypa a pha li ciemuopa hmang kha Jerusalem hne Judah cunglie i patlung sa aa.
Samaria taanapa khuhriy hne Ahab ingchungkhue taanapa khuhriy kha Jerusalem cunglie pare'a angte, pakhakha ta pakaa kha hruv te a pakhuvpa haata Jerusalem kha i hruv aa.
I ru aa ngaapa tie kha thaw'a yi angte, ama carie tie kuv chung luo kha i pi'a yi; cakhutaata iema ca patuvpa carie hne hruosue ta ama cuo aa.
Tahematapakieca iema ta ama mingchingmingvuo tie Izipt taata ama kya pyana taata ataning tepa hingta kama hmungna lie kha a pha lipa tue yi te i hi ina pahaa yi,” a ta.

Ca hlyitaw taata Manasseh ta Abyipahmungna lie a pha lipa hmang a ma tue riypata Judah ming a pasuesanapa yi suena khutaa khata a sue lipa tie thiyse a hluvsa kha palang te, Jerusalem kiy kha taata kiy kha te ta a bi.
Manasseh tuesana aa ngaapa, ama ta a tuepa bangkhuo, hne suena a tuepa tie ca Judah Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv liena ama cape cuo va ma?
Manasseh ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a zie te, a ing diedung chung, Uzzah diedung chunglie kha ama paby. Ama kha a sacapaa Amon ta aa thle.
Amon ca kung kiy kung hning a ta pata siepahruo cuo hruo kha a thu te Jerusalem lieta kung hning siepahruo a cuo. A nung ming ca Meshullemeth ta cuo te, Jotbah ming Haruz sacanung ta a cuo.
A paa Manasseh ta a tuepa haa khata ama ta Abyipahmungna lie kha a pha lipa a tue.
A paa ta a ziypa luopuv bangkhuo kha ziy te, a paa ta aa biepa kuvtuezuv tie re kha hrie te aa bie yi.
Ama ta a mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing, Abyipakha thaw te, Abyipaluopuv kha ziy vyi.
Amon ca a changtaapa tie ta raw yi te siepahruo ing chunglie ama thie.
Cuorasala capa ruo cawsaa tie ca ta Siepahruo Amon a rawtuv bangkhuo kha thie yi te, capa ruo ming ca ta a sacapaa Josiah kha ama hmang lie ca siepahruo ta ama pacuo sa.
Amon ta a tuepa a tuesana aa ngaapa tie ca Judah Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv liena ama cape cuo va ma?
Ama ca a thluo lie, Uzza diedung lie kha ama paby; cakhutaata a sacapaa Josiah ta ama kha aa thle.
Josiah ca kung cari a ta pata siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu; Jerusalem lie kha kung sawthung kung kha siepahruo a cuo. A nung ming ca Jedidah ta cuo te, Bozkath ming Adaiah sacanung ta a cuo.
Ama ta Abyipahmungna lie kha a phapa hrie te, a paa David luopuv bangkhuo kha a ziy; cavyiluo cuose cacuoluo cuose pie vyi.
Siepahruo Josiah siepahruo a cuona kung hraa hlyicari kung lieta Meshullam sacapaa Azaliah sacapaa caacapetuv Shafan kha Abyipaing luo pathlie te,
“Tluobyi lepa Hilkiah'a luo kha khaw la ingchiypakaa a huotuv tie ta cawsaa tie'a taata ama khyipa tuokaa, Abyipaing chung luo a ngiekhyi pata a cuopa kha khazaa ma a ta ta pata ri sala;
Abyipaing mangchiytuv re a hrietuv tie'a luo kha pi se; Abyipaing lie a awpa re hrietuv tie, ing a pare nguoluopa tie,
lettamaa tie, ing satuv tie, hne pazan tie zaw kha pi yi se; cakhutaata ing parena riypata thing calyina lie hne uo ciepa alung calyina lie kha hmuo yi se.
Cuorasala iema ca aa dangsa pata ama hrie nakawta iema'a luo ama pipa tuokaa cazing kha hie pata cuo'a va yi,” a ta.
Tluobyi lepa Hilkiah ta caacapetuv Shafan kyihuo khata, “Abyipaing chungliena phungbie caa-uv i hmung,” a ta. Hilkiah ta Shafan kha caa-uv ca pi te a ri.
Cakhutaata caacapetuv Shafan ca siepahruo'a luo kha vaa te, “Ing chunglie a awpa tuokaa ca na changtaapa zaw ta bung yi te, Abyipaing a mangchiytuv re a hriepa tie'a luo kha ama pi mangtli,” a ta.
Caacapetuv Shafan ca ta siepahruo'a luo kha, “Tluobyi Hilkiah na caa-uv suokha naa pi,” ta te siepahruo kha aa thyisa pata a ripa.
Siepahruo ta phungbie caa-uv chunglie bie kha a thyi tiyta, a caw kha a thlaa.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ta tluobyi Hilkiah, Shafan sacapaa Ahikam, Mikaiah sacapaa Akbor, caacapetuv Shafan, hne siepahruo changtaapa Asaiah kha bie pi yi te,

“Vaa ung la kama cuota, hne cawsaa zaw cuota hne, Judah ming bangkhuo cuo khata Abyipakha bie hiehriy tie ung, tahematapakieca ma mingchingmingvuo tie ta hingpa caa-uv chunglie aa capepa bie, kiema cuota aa capepa bie bangkhuo haata ama za tue li nakawta Abyipahihaana ca kiema cunglie hing le hringhruo te a ie ta a ie,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta tluobyi Hilkiah, Ahikam, Akbor, Shafan, hne Asaiah tie ca cawsie chinapa a mangchiytuv Harhas sacapaa Tikvah sacapaa Shallum napuvnung, profet nung Huldah'a luo kha vaa yi te bie ama vaa rue, ama ca Jerusalem khy chunglie, khytluo suohningna lie khana a aw.
Ama ta iema'a lie kha, “AbyipaIsrael Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Kama'a luo caa vya pathliepa paa yi kha va chang tie ung,
Abyipata, Judah siepahruo ta caa-uv chunglie a ripa bie bangkhuo haa khata, hingpa hmang lie hne a chunglie khy a sapa tie cunglie hing rana i patlung sa hrahring aa.

Tahematapakieca iema ta kama kha na thaw yi te khazing hrangpa tie kha hriykhungrina ama pihluo, ama kuv ta ama hriepa re bangkhuo khata i hi ina pahaa tli nakaw yi ta, i hihaana ca hingpa hmang lie hing a ie ta ie te pache khu pata cuo'a vyi.
Cuorasala Abyipahiehriy riypata caa pathlietuv yi Judah siepahruo ca hing haa hingta va chang tie ung. AbyipaIsrael Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Na thyipa bie kawlieta,

Hingpa hmang hne a chunglie khy a sapa tie ca pahli diypa hne chiesapa tana ama cuo aa i tapa kha na thyi tiyta, na pathiypalung ca a ngiepachiy te, Abyipahmiekunglie kha a pane cate, na caw kha thlaa cate i hmiekunglie na caa nakawta, kama zaw ta na bie kha ica thyipa ra, Abyipata a ta.

Caacuonakawta nama ca na mingchingmingvuo tie'a luo kha ca pahmya'a angte, thlaalungna hneta thluokhue naa ngie aa; hingpa hmang cunglie i patlung sapa rana bangkhuo kha na ming ta hmung'a vyi,” a ta. Iema ta siepahruo'a luo kha bie ca ama phya pakhaa.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ta Judah hne Jerusalem uvthyi bangkhuo kha ama'a luo a hmya riypata bie a pi yi.

Siepahruo ca Abyipaing luo kha khaw te, ama'a lie ca Judah ming bangkhuo, Jerusalem lie khy a sapa bangkhuo, tluobyi tie, profet tie, hne cawsaa bangkhuo, a le a caw tie'a lie kha Abyipaing lie ama hmungpa biekuona caa-uv chunglie bie kha ama thyi pata a ripa yi.

Siepahruo ca asuvtung athaalie kha a daa te, Abyipaziy riypa, a nawbie ziy riypa, a biepipa hne a phungluo kha a pathiypalung yalya hne a hringna yalya ta ziy riypa hne hingpa caa-uv chunglie aa capepa biekuona bie zaw kha tue riypata Abyipahmiekunglie kha biekuona a tue. Cawsaa bangkhuo ta bie amaa kuo ra.

Siepahruo ta tluobyi lepa Hilkiah, a kuv rawlie a awpa tluobyi tie, hne chiypakaa a huopa tie kha Abyipabiena-ing chunglie Baal, hne Asherah hne avuo lie a awpa bangkhuo cuota ama tuepa biphie bangkhuo kha papya diy riypata bie pi yi te, Jerusalem khy thing luo Kidron lu chunglie kha myi ta rue te, a buvcuo kha Bethel luo a phya.

Judah hne Jerusalem cahriy khypuv tie lie khahrungtluobu lieta hriykhungrina pihluo riypata Judah siepahruo tie ta ama pacu sapa kuvtuezuv tluobyi tie kha ama re a phie diy yi. Baal'a luo, ning'a luo, thlaapa'a luo, aasiy zaw'a luo, hne avuo lie a awpa bangkhuo'a luo hriykhungrina a pihluopa tie zaw kha a phie diy yi.

Asherah kuvtuezuv kha Abyipaing taata papya te, Jerusalem khy thing luo Kidron Cavaata luo kha sikhyi te Kidron Cavaata lie kha myi ta a rue, a diykariyna te ta de diy te cawsaa cakhawpa tie thluo lie kha a patle.
Abyipaing chunglie a awpa canung tie ta Asherah cuota caw ama taanapa capaa siyhraw tie ing kha a para.

Judah ruo khy zaw taa khata tluobyi bangkhuo kha papya yi te, tluobyi ta hriykhungrina ama tuenapa khahrungtluobu bangkhuo kha, Geba taata Beer-sheba te ta a papya a palyi diy. Khypuv uvtuv Joshua thlake cavyiluo kuo ta a awpa khahrungtluobu zaw kha a para diy.
Khahrung tluobu tluobyi tie ca Jerusalem lie Abyipabienatluophie luo kha a khaw li pata ama tieriy hrawlie kha thiynung phuv lipa viechuo ama ning.
Ahungtahmuo ama sacapaa hne sacanung tie kha Molek'a luo myi ta rue pata ama pihluo li riypata Ben-hinnom bawphie lie a awpa Tofeth kha a papya a palyi.
Abyipaing thlake, biena-ing dungkhuo chunglieta tiydiypa Nathan-melekh ing athaalie a awpa Judah siepahruo tie ta ning ama pihluopa aruo zaw kha thie diy te ning aruole zaw kha myi ta a rue.

Judah siepahruo tie ta ama tuepa Ahaz ing a cungduo cunglie a awpa bienatluophie, hne Manasseh ta Abyipaing tlawhmie suohning lie a tuepa bienatluophie kha pacing te a dechi diy khutaata Kidron Cavaata luo kha a thaw.

Siepahruo Solomon ta a sapa Jerusalem ningchiyluo kuo, Parana tluo sungluo ta a awpa, duv aa chiypa Sidon ming khazing Astarte, duv aa chiypa Mob ming khazing Khemosh, hne duv aa chiypa Ammon ming khazing Milkom tapa tie khahrungtluobu zaw kha a papya a palyi yi.
A lungbang tie kha dekary diy te, Ashera tung kha hu yi te capa hmang ca cawsaa ruv a thawsue.

Ca hlyitaw taata, Israel ming a pasue sapa Nebat sacapaa Jeroboam ta Bethel lie a sapa khahrungtluobu bienatluophie tie kha a pacing diy. Khahrung tluobu tie kha myi ta rue te, dekary diy te, Asherah tung zaw kha myi ta a rue.

Josiah ca aa pali tiyta tluo cunglie thluo zaw kha a hmung; cakhutaata cawsaa kha pathlie yi te thluo chungtaata ruv kha papya yi te, Khazing cawsaapa ta a pathyipa Abyipabie haa khata bienatluophie cunglie kha myi ta rue yi te ama papyapalyi. Jeroboam ca biena pyi ning kha bienatluophie lieta a daa te, Khazing cawsaapa ta a za ri ciepa haa khata thluo luo kha a mang.

Cakhutaata ama ta, “I hmungpa lungbang hue khaapata ma a cuo?” a ta. Khypuv cawsaa tie khata, “Bethel bienatluophie lie na tuepa hmang kaw zaa rilupa, Judah taata a vawpa Khazing cawsaapa thluo tana a cuo,” ama ta.
Ama ta, “Ama ca a pahy se; ahungtahmuo a ruv kha palaw khah yi se,” a ta. Caacuonakawta iema ta a ruv kha Samaria taata a vawpa profetpa ruv hne khata khaapahmuo ta li pata ama aw.

Ca hlyitaw taata, Israel siepahruo tie ta za tue yi te, Abyipahi ama za pahaanapa Samaria khy tie lie a awpa khahrungtluobu abiena hmang tie kha Josiah ta a para diy. Bethel lie a tuepa haa khata a tue diy.
Ama ta capa lie a awpa khahrungtluobu tluobyi tie bangkhuo kha bienatluophie cunglie kha thie yi te a cunglieta cawsaa ruv kha a rue. Cakhutaata Jerusalem luo kha a kaa.
Siepahruo ta cawsaa bangkhuo kha, “Hingpa biekuona caa-uv lie aa capepa haa hingta niema ta Abyipanama Khazing'a lie kha lawsena pyi hing a uv tie ung,” ta pata bie a pi yi.
Cahaapa lawsena pyi ca Israel ming bieripatuv tie chuo taata, acuolikie Israel siepahruo tie hne Judah siepahruo tie chuo taa yalya ta a uv pata cuo buo vyi.
Cuorasala Siepahruo Josiah siepahruo a cuona kung hraa hlyicari kung lieta Jerusalem lie Abyipa'a luo kha lawsena pyi ca amaa uv.

Ca hlyitaw taata tluobyi Hilkiah ta Abyipaing chunglie a hmungpa caa-uv chunglie aa capepa phungbie zaw kha pacu sa riypata, Josiah ta apyipa tie, khuevuo a hnyipa tie, kuvtuezuvtaata, kuvtuezuv tie, hne Judah hne Jerusalem lieta hmung khupa duvsamakhie aa chiypa bangkhuo kha a pahli diy yi.

A pathiypalung yalya hne a hringna yalya hne a thaazuo yalya ta Moses phungbie yalya haata Abyipa'a luo aa maapa siepahruo ahunghmuo ama hluota aw va yi, ama hnang taa zaw ta ama haapa ahunghmuo aw va yi.
Manasseh ta a hi pahaa riypata a za tuepa bangkhuo kawlieta Judah cunglieta Abyipahihaana ca a ie ta ie te, Abyipaca a hihaana lesapa taa khata a maa vyi.
Abyipata, “Judah kha Israel i thawpa haata i hmungna taata thaw'a angte, i tlawpa hingpa khypuv Jerusalem, Hingpa lie hingna i ming a aw aa, i tapa ing zaw hing i thaw aa,” a ta.
Josiah tuesana aa ngaapa, hne a tuepa bangkhuo ca Judah Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv liena ama cape cuo va ma?

Ama chuo lie ta Izipt siepahruo Faro Neko ca Assiria siepahruo'a luo, Zufrates cavaa luo kha a khaw. Siepahruo Josiah ca ama a taw riypata a si; cuorasala Faro Neko ta Megiddo lieta a taw te ama kha a thie.

A changtaapa tie ta Megiddo taa khata a thiy pata aruole ta Jerusalem luo kha phya yi te, a thluo lie kha ama paby. Ruo ming khata Josiah sacapaa Jehoahaz kha la yi te, chiytiy pathuv yi te a paa hmang lie kha siepahruo ta ama pacuo sa.
Jehoahaz ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu ning kha kung kiy kung thung ta a cuo; Jerusalem lieta thla thung siepahruo a cuo. A nung ming ca Hamutal ta cuo te, Libnah ming Jeremiah sacanung ta a cuo.
Ama ta Abyipahmungna lie kha a mingchingmingvuo tie ama za tuepa haa khata a pha lipa a tue.
Jerusalem lie siepahruo a cuo li riypa khata Faro Neko ta Hamath ruo Riblah lie kha thaw pathla te, a ruo ca ngu talen zakha hne siy talen suokha ngukhyi a khyi.

Faro Neko ta siepahruo Josiah sacapaa Eliakim kha a paa Josiah hmang lie siepahruo ta tue te, a ming kha Jehoiakim ta pata a thle. Cuorasala ama ta Jehoahaz ca sikhyi te Izipt ruo a phapa khata a thiy.

Jehoiakim ta Faro kha siy hne ngu pi te, cuorasala Faro ta tuokaa a hiepa zaa patlingna riypata a ruo ming kha ngukhyi a khyi yi. Iema ta ama tue ciepa haa khata Faro Neko pi riypata a ruo cawsaa tie'a taata siy hne ngu kha a khyi yi.
Jehoiakim ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu ning kha kung kiy kung pangaa ta a cuo; Jerusalem lie kung hraa hlyikha siepahruo a cuo. A nung ming ca Zebidah ta cuo te Rumah ming Pedaiah sacanung ta a cuo.
Ama ta Abyipahmungna lie kha a mingchingmingvuo tie bangkhuo ama za tuepa haa khata a pha lipa a tue.
Ama chuo lie ta Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar kha a khaw te, Jehoiakim ca kung thung chung a changtaapa ta aa li; cuorasala a pali te ama kha aa du.
Abyipata a changtaapa profet tie'a taata a za ripa haa khata Abyipata Khaldi ming phuv, Aram ming phuv, Moab ming phuv Ammon ming phuv tapa tie kha Judah para riypa cata a pathliesue yi.
Manasseh ta a tuepa suena bangkhuo kawlie khata a hmungna taata pahli riypata Abyipabiepina haata capa hmang ca ta Judah kha a tlungsue sasaw pata a cuo.
Cakhutaata ama ta a palangpa a sue lipa tie thiyse ta Jerusalem a pabi nakawta Abyipata a ngiethe khing vyi.
Jehoiakim tuesana aa ngaapa, a tuepa bangkhuo ca Judah Siepahruo tie Chuorina Caa-uv chungliena ama cape cuo va ma?
Cahaacata Jehoiakim ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a zie te a sacapaa Jehoiachin ta ama kha aa thle.
Babilon siepahruo ta Izipt siepahruo ta a hnyipa bangkhuo, Izipt cavaata taata Zufrates cavaa te a la diy nakawta Izipt siepahruo ca a ruo chungtaata pya va tli.

Jehoiachin ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu ning kha kung hraa hlyicari ta te Jerusalem lieta kung thung chung siepahruo a cuo. A nung ming ca Nehushta ta cuo te Jerusalem ming Elnathan sacanung ta a cuo.
A paa ta a tuepa haa khata ama ta Abyipahmungna lie kha a pha lipa a tue.
Capa cuo ning ca ta Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar changtaapa tie ca Jerusalem khypuv kha kya sihnue yi te ama cadung.
A changtaapa zaw ta ama cadung nguoluo ning khata Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ca khypuv luo kha aa vaw;

Judah siepahruo Jehoiachin ca ama hne ama, a nung, a changtaapa tie, aa byi tie, hne a siepahruo ing byi tie hne khata Babilon siepahruo'a luo kha aa pi. Siepahruo a cuonapa kung cari a ta pata Babilon siepahruo ta ama kha thaw a pathla.

Abyipata a za rilupa haa khata, Abyipaing chunglie suethiy bangkhuo, hne siepahruo ing lie suethiy bangkhuo kha la te, Abyipabiena-ing chunglie a awpa, Israel siepahruo Solomon ta a za tuepa siy biphie bangkhuo kha a dechi diy.

Jerusalem ming bangkhuo, byi tie bangkhuo, a thaaruvpa bangkhuo, hruocawsaa thawhraa, kuvzung a thepa hne su a sapa bangkhuo ca a sikhyi diy yi; ruo chunglie a siy pasa cepa tie ta li pata ca ahunghmuo a ngaa va yi.
Jehoiachin kha Babilon luo a sikhyi; siepahruo a nung, siepahruo napuvnung, aa byi tie, hne ruo chunglie aa luo viepa tie kha Jerusalem taata Babilon luo kha sii ta aa da diy yi.
Babilon siepahruo ta a riephapa tie bangkhuo, thaw sariy, kuvzung a thepa tie hne su a sapa tie, thaw kha, a thaa ruv te rie a tuv khu riypa bangkhuo kha Babilon luo sii ta aa da diy yi.
Babilon siepahruo ta Jehoiachin a paasyi ta a cuopa Mattaniah kha ama hmang lie kha siepahruo ta tue te a ming kha Zedekiah ta pata a thle.

Zedekiah ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu ning kha kung kiy kung kha ta a cuo; Jerusalem lie kha kung hraa hlyikha siepahruo a cuo. A nung ming ca Hamutal ta cuo te Libnah ming Jeremiah sacanung ta a cuo.
Jehoiakim ta a tuepa haa khata ama ta Abyipahmungna lie kha a pha lipa a tue.
Jerusalem hne Judah ta Abyipakha khuosa ta a hi ama pahaa hmisi nakawta a hmungna taata aa cade yi.

Siepahruo a cuona kung caky kung, thla hraa thlaa, ning hraana lie kha Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ca a rieka tie bangkhuo hne khata Jerusalem kha a du riypata sihnue te, cadung yi te, riekhuocaaca kha ama cu cahlung.
Cahaacata Siepahruo Zedekiah siepahruo a cuona kung hraa hlyikha a tana te khata khypuv ca ama cadung.
A thla paliyna thlaa, ning cakyna lie ca khypuv chunglie kha cakuo a ruv hringhruo tli nakawta ruo chunglie cawsaa tie cuota sa aw va tli.

Khaldi ming ta khypuv kha ama cadung raalaa pata, khypuv dungkhuo lungruetlepie kha a khue vaa yi te, siepahruo diedung athaalie lungruetlepie suohning tie alala thlake athaalie luopuv taa khata siepahruo hne rieka tie bangkhuo ca zuo khata a ruo yi te, Arabah kuo luo khata ama si.
Cuorasala Khaldi rieka tie khata siepahruo ca a cade yi te Jeriko ase lie kha ama pha; a rieka tie bangkhuo ca a chepatlaa diy yi te ama kha amaa ruose.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ca patuv yi te Riblah lie Babilon siepahruo'a luo kha sikhyi yi te a cunglie biechipana a tue.
Iema ta Zedekiah a sacapaa zaw kha a hmiekunglieta thie yi te, Zedekiah kha a ming ama cakhyi; hrakyi khe yi te Babilon luo kha ama sikhyi.

Thla pangaana ning sariyna lie, Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar siepahruo acuona kung caky kung lieta Babilon siepahruo a changtaapa, ama pangpa rievetuv rieka tie riebyipa Nebuzaradan kha Jerusalem luo aa vaw.
Ama ta Abyipaing, siepahruo ing, hne Jerusalem lie ing bangkhuo kha myi ta a rue; ing lepa mekaa kha myi ta a rue diy.
Rievetuv riebyipa hne a awpa Khaldi rieka tie bangkhuo khata Jerusalem dungkhuo lungruetlepie kha ama pacing diy.
Rievetuv riekabyi Nebuzaradan ta khypuv chunglie ama thusepa cawsaa tie hne Babilon siepahruo'a luo a ruo lupa tie, hne aa ngaapa bangkhuo kha sii ta aa da diy yi.
Cuorasala rievetuv riebyipa khata a siy pasa cepa cawsaa chekha kha mingsuv mangchiytuv hne lu zaa thlu riypata a thuse siy yi.
Abyipaing chunglie daa tung zaw, Abyipaing chunglie daa rahunglepa zaw kha Khaldi ming ca ta dechi diy yi te daa ca Babilon luo kha ama sikhyi.
Iema ca ta bi zaw, kawpia zaw, cecakie zaw, rangpa-ue ruenapa pakaa aa thuvpa zaw, hne biena-ing lie hmuopa daa biphie bangkhuo kha ama la,
cahaacata buvcuo liyna phie hne rahung zaw kha la yi te ama sikhyi diy.
Solomon ta Abyipaing lie huota a tuepa atung suohning, rahunglepa suokha, hne a patunapa tie, hingpa daa biphie zaw bangkhuo aa riynapa ca a cyi pathlie tie'a pata cuo vyi.

Atung lepa suokha aa suonapa ca daw hraa hlyicari ta cuo te, a cunglie aa tung pakhuv suokha aw te, aa tung pakhuv suokha aa suona ca daw thung ta a cuo; asue khue a lu pata pangipa lie daa cale thyi tie ca, aa tung pakhuv a chi aa dung pata a aw. Aa tung suohningna zaw ca cahaacata cuo te, asue khue haata pangipa cata a cuo ra.
Rievetuv riekabyi ca ta tluobyi le cepa Seraiah, tluobyi le cepa a paziypa Zefaniah, hne chiypakaa a huopa pathung tie zaw kha a patuv yi.

Cakhutaata khypuv chung taa khata rieka tie a uvtuv byi pakha, khypuv chunglie hmungpa siepahruo tluopuv phuv chungtaata cawsaa papangaa; ruo chunglie cawsaa zaw a pakiytuv riekabyi le cepa caacapetuv; hne khypuv chunglie hmungpa cawsaa capaa sawcaruv zaw kha a la yi.
Rievetuv riekabyi Nebuzaradan ta iema kha la yi te, Riblah lieta Babilon siepahruo'a luo kha a sikhyi yi.
Babilon siepahruo ta iema kha Hamath ruo Riblah lieta tuv yi te a thie yi. Cahaacata Judah ca a ruo taa khata siicuona luo sikhyi pata a cuo.
Judah ruo lie aa ngaapa cawsaa, Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ta a thusepa tie cunglie kha Shafan sacapaa Ahikam sacapaa Gedaliah kha uvtuv ta a tue.

Rieka tie uvtuv riebyi tie bangkhuo hne ama rieka tie ta Babilon siepahruo na Gedaliah kha uvtuv ta a tue tapa kha ama thyi tiyta, Nethaniah sacapaa Ishmael, Kereah sacapaa Johanan, Netofah ming Tanhumeth sacapaa Seraiah, hne Maakah sacapaa Jaazaniah tie kha ama cawsaa tie hneta Mizpah lie Gedaliah luo kha amaa vaw.

Gedaliah ta iema hne ama cawsaa tie'a lie kha chie a sa te, “Khaldi ming abyi tie kawlie khata ciy khah ung; ruo chunglie hing aw ung la, Babilon siepahruo re hing hrie ung la nama cuota a pha aa,” a ta yi.
Cuorasala thla sariyna lie kha Elishama sacapaa Nethaniah sacapaa Ishmael kha a cawsaa pahraa hneta a vaw te Gedaliah kha ama hne Mizpah lie a awpa Judah ming hne Khaldi ming hne khata ama thie.
Cakhutaata cawsaa bangkhuo, a le hne a caw hne khata rieka uvtuv riekabyi tie ca a tha yi te Izipt luo kha ama si; tahematapakieca iema ta Khaldi ming kha ama ciy.

Judah siepahruo Jehoiachin sii ta amaa danapa kung sawthung kung sariy kung, thla hraa hlyihning thlaa ning kiy ning sariy ning, Babilon siepahruo Evil-merodak ta siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu kung lie kha Judah siepahruo Jehoiachin kha thaw taata a papya.
Duena hneta bie rihne te, Babilon lie ama hneta a awpa siepahruo hrangpa tie atuna a cung vie lie khata atuna a pi.
Caacuonakawta Jehoiachin ta a thaw tlanapa caw kha a thlie. Siepahruo cabya lie kha a chuo chung, ningting ta sa a ning ra pari.
Siepahruo ta aa huna lie ningting ta a hmuo riypa zaw kha a hring chung bangkhuo ta a pi.
Adam, Seth, Enosh;
Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared;
Enok, Methuselah, Lamek;
Noah, Shem, Ham, hne Jafeth.
Jafeth ciypathla tie: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek, hne Tiras.
Gomer ciypathla tie: Ashkenaz, Difath, hne Togarmah.
Javan ciypathla tie: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim hne Rodanim.
Ham ciypathla tie: Kush, Izipt, Put, hne Kanaan.
Kush ciypathla tie: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, hne Sabteka. Raamah ciypathla tie: Sheba hne Dedan.
Kush ca Nimrod paa ta a cuo; ama ca alyi cunglie a thaaruvpa pakhanapa ta a cuo.
Izipt ca Lud ming, Anam ming, Lehab ming, Naftuh ming,
Pathrus ming, Kasluh ming, hne Kaftor ming zaw ama paa ta a cuo. Kaftor ming chung taa hing tana Filistin ming ama puv.
Kanaan ca a sacapaa uvthyi Sidon, hne Heth,
hne Jebus ming, Amor ming, Girgash ming,
hne Hiv ming, Arki ming, Sin ming,
Arvad ming, Zemar ming, hne Hamath ming zaw ama paa ta a cuo.
Shem ciypathla tie: Elam, Asshur, Arpakshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether hne Meshek.
Arpakshad ca Shelah paa ta cuo te, Shelah ca Eber paa ta a cuo.
Eber ta sacapaa pahning a sa yi: pakhapa a ming ca Peleg (tahematapakieca ama chuo ning khata alyi ming kha amaa zaa che), hne a uvnupa a ming ca Joktan ta a cuo.
Joktan ca Almodad, Shelef, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,
Ofir, Havilah hne Jobab zaw ama paa ta a cuo; hingpa zaw bangkhuo hing Joktan ciypathla ta ama cuo.
Shem, Arpakshad, Shelah;
Eber, Peleg, Reu;
Serug, Nahor, Terah;
Abram, Abraham khata a cuo.
Abraham sacapaa zaw ca: Isak hne Ishmael ta ama cuo.
Hingpa hing iema ciyhruo ta a cuo: Ishmael ta a sa taapa ca Nebaioth; cakhutaata Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
Jetur, Nafish, hne Kedemah. Hingpa tie hing Ishmael sacapaa tie ta ama cuo.
Abraham a nungthangnung Keturah sacapaa tie: ama ta Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, hne Shuah a sa yi. Jokshan sacapaa tie: Sheba hne Dedan.
Midian sacapaa tie: Efah, Efer, Hanok, Abida, hne Eldaah. Hingpa tie bangkhuo hing Keturah ciypathla ta ama cuo.
Abraham ca Isak paa ta a cuo. Isak sacapaa tie: Esau hne Israel.
Esau sacapaa tie: Elifaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, hne Korah.
Elifaz sacapaa tie: Teman, Omar, Zefi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, hne Amalek.
Reuel sacapaa tie: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, hne Mizzah.
Seir sacapaa tie: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, hne Dishan.
Lotan sacapaa tie: Hori hne Homam; hne Lotan sietanung ca Timna ta a cuo.
Shobal sacapaa tie: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shefi, hne Onam. Zibeon sacapaa tie: Aiah hne Anah.
Anah sacapaa tie: Dishon. Dishon sacapaa tie: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, hne Cheran.
Ezer sacapaa tie: Bilhan, Zaavan, hne Jaakan. Dishan sacapaa tie: Uz hne Aran.
Israel ming cunglie ahunghmuo siepahruo ama cuo hluota Edom lie siepahruo zaa cuopa tie ca hingpa zaw hing tana ama cuo: Beor sacapaa Bela, a khypuv ca Dinhabah ta a za cuo.
Bela a thiy tiyta, Bozrah ming Zerah sacapaa Jobab ta ama kha aa thle.
Jobab a thiy tiyta, Teman ming Husham ta ama kha aa thle.
Husham kha a thiy tiyta Bedad sacapaa, Moab ruo lie Midian ming zaa tetuv Hadad ta a thle te, a khypuv ming ca Avith ta a cuo.
Hadad a thiy tiyta, Masrekah ming Samlah ta ama kha aa thle.
Samlah kha a thiy tiyta, Zufrates cavaa kielie a awpa Rehoboth ming Shaul ta ama kha aa thle.
Shaul kha a thiy tiyta, Akhbor sacapaa Baal-hanan ta ama kha aa thle.
Baal-hanan kha a thiy tiyta, Hadad ta ama kha aa thle; a khypuv ming ca Pai ta cuo te, a napuvnung ming ca Mahetabel ta a cuo, ama ca Matred sacanung ta a cuo, Matred ca Me-zahab sacanung ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata Hadad kha a thiy. Edom chung tie ca: Timna, Aliah, Jetheth,
Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
Magdiel, hne Iram; hingpa tie hing Edom chung tie ta ama cuo.
Israel sacapaa zaw ca hingpa tie hingta ama cuo: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issakhar, Zebulun,
Dan, Josef, Benjamin, Naftali, Gad, hne Asher.
Judah sacapaa tie: Er, Onan, hne Shelah; hingpa pathung tie hing Kanaan zaanung Bath-shua ta a sapa. Judah saata taapa Er ca Abyipahmungna lie cawsaa pha lipa a cuo nakawta ama ta a thie.
A munung Tamar zaw ta Perez hne Zerah, kha a sapa. Judah ta ama bangkhuo ta sacapaa papangaa a hnyi yi.
Perez sacapaa tie: Hezron hne Hamul.
Zerah sacapaa tie: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Kalkol, hne Dara, ama bangkhuo ta papangaa.
Karmi sacapaa tie: Akhar, Israel hnaa a pahnawtuv, pihluopa hmang lie suena a tuepa ta a cuo;
Cakhutaata Ethan sacapaa ca Azariah ta a cuo.
Hezron ta a sapa sacapaa tie ca: Jerahmeel, Ram, hne Khelubai.
Ram ca Amminadab paa ta a cuo. Amminadab ca Nahshon paa ta a cuo, Nahshon ca Judah sacapaa tie hrawlie ama byi ta a cuo.
Nahshon ca Salma paa ta a cuo, Salma ca Boaz paa ta a cuo,
Boaz ca Obed paa ta cuo te, Obed ca Jesse paa ta a cuo.
Jesse ca a sa taapa Eliab paa ta a cuo, Abinadab ca a pahningna ta cuo te, Shimea ca a pathungna ta a cuo,
Nethanel ca a papaliyna ta cuo te, Raddai ca a papangaana ta a cuo,
Ozem ca a pacaruvna ta cuo te, David ca a pasariyna ta a cuo.
Ama sieta zaw ca Zeruiah hne Abigail ta ama cuo. Zeruiah sacapaa tie: Abishai, Joab, hne Asahel, pathung ta ama cuo.
Abigail ta Amasa a sa, Amasa a paa ca Ishmael ming Jether ta a cuo.
Hezron sacapaa Kaleb ta a napuvnung Azubah hneta haatiy ama hnyi. Jerioth hneta Jesher, Shobab, hne Ardon tapa tie kha ama hnyi.
Azubah a thiy tiyta, Kaleb ta Efrath kha a hlaw te ama ta Hur kha a sapa.
Hur ca Uri paa ta a cuo, cakhutaata Uri ca Bezalel paa ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata Hezron ta kung sawcaruv a ta tli pata Gilead paa Makhir sacanung kha a hlaw te ama ta Segub kha a sapa;
cakhutaata Segub ca Jair paa ta cuo te, Gilead ruo chunglie kha khy kiy khy thung a hnyi.
Cuorasala Geshur hne Aram ta capa chung taa cata Havvoth-jair, Kenath hne a khyta sawcaruv kha ama la. Hingpa bangkhuo hing Gilead paa Makhir ciypathla tana ama cuo.
Hezron ca Kaleb-efrathah lie kha thiy te, cakhutaa cata Hezron napuvnung Abijah ta ama kha Ashhur sapa te, Ashhur ca Tekoa paa ta a cuo.
Hezron a sacapaa uvthyi Jerahmeel sacapaa tie ca: a sacapaa uvthyi Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, hne Ahijah.
Jerahmeel ta napuv hrangpa zaw kha hnyi te a ming ca Atarah ta a cuo; ama ca Onam nung ta a cuo.
Jerahmeel ta a sa taapa Ram sacapaa tie ca: Maaz, Jamin, hne Eker.
Onam sacapaa tie: Shammai hne Jada. Shammai sacapaa tie: Nadab hne Abishur.
Abishur napuvnung ming ca Abihail ta cuo te, ama ta Ahban hne Molid kha a sapa.
Nadab sacapaa tie ca: Seled hne Appaim ta cuo yi te, Seled ca saata hnyi li pata a thiy.
Appaim sacapaa ca: Ishi. Ishi sacapaa: Sheshan. Sheshan sacapaa: Ahlai.
Shammai uvnupa Jada sacapaa tie: Jether hne Jonathan ta cuo yi te, Jether ca saata hnyi li pata a thiy.
Jonathan sacapaa tie: Peleth hne Zaza. Hingpa tie hing Jerahmeel ciypathla tie ta ama cuo.
Sheson ta sacapaa hnyi vyi, sacanung dyi a hnyi yi; cuorasala Sheshan ta Izipt ming sii hnyi te a ming ca Jarha ta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Sheshan ta a sacanung kha a sii ta a cuopa Jarha hne khata pahlaw yi te, ama ta Attai kha a sapa.
Attai ca Nathan paa ta a cuo, Nathan ca Zabad paa ta a cuo.
Zabad ca Eflal paa ta cuo te, Eflal ca Obed paa ta a cuo.
Obed ca Jehu paa ta cuo te, Jehu ca Azariah paa ta a cuo.
Azariah ca Helez paa ta cuo te, Helez ca Eleasah paa ta a cuo.
Eleasah ca Sismai paa ta cuo te, Sismai ca Shallum paa ta a cuo.
Shallum ca Jekamiah paa ta cuo te, Jekamiah ca Elishama paa ta a cuo.
Jerahmeel uvnupa Kaleb sacapaa tie ca: a sa taapa Mesha, ama ca Zif paa ta a cuo. Mareshah sacapaa tie: Hebron.
Hebron sacapaa tie: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, hne Shema.
Shema ca Raham paa ta a cuo, Raham ca Jorkeam paa ta cuo te Rekem ca Shammai paa ta a cuo.
Shammai sacapaa tie: Maon; Maon ca Beth-zur paa ta a cuo.
Kaleb nungthangnung Efah zaw ta Haran, Moza, hne Gazez kha a sa yi; Haran ca Gazez paa ta a cuo.
Jahdai sacapaa tie: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Efah, hne Shaaf.
Kaleb nungthangnung Maakah ta Sheber hne Tirhanah kha a sa yi.
Ama ta Madmannah paa Shaaf, Makhbenah hne Gibea paa Sheva zaw kha a sa yi. Cakhutaata Kaleb sacanung a ming ca Akhsah ta a cuo.
Hingpa tie hing Kaleb ciypathla ta ama cuo. Efrathah ta a sa taapa Hur sacapaa tie ca: Kiriath-jearim a paa Shobal,
Bethlehem paa Salma, hne Beth-gader paa Haref.
Kiriath-jearim a paa Shobal ta sacapaa hrangpa zaw hnyi te: Haroeh, hne Menuhoth ming khingkhuo.
Cakhutaata Kiriath-jearim ingchungkhue tie: Ithri ming, Puth ming, Shumath ming, hne Mishra ming ta ama cuo; hingpa tie chung taa hingta Zorath ming hne Eshtaol ming kha ama puv.
Salma sacapaa tie: Bethlehem, Netofah ming, Atroth-beth-joab, hne Manahath ming khingkhuo, Zor ming.

Caa cape a thepa, hne caa palie a thepa chungkhue tie ta cuo yi te, Jabez lie a awpa ta ama cuo: Tirath ming, Shimeath ming, hne Sukath ming ta ama cuo. Hingpa tie hing Rekhab ingchungkhue tie ta ama paa, Hammath ciypathla Ken ming khata ama cuo.
Hingpa tie hing Hebron lieta a puvpa David sacapaa tie ta ama cuo: a sa taapa Amnon ca Jezreel ming Ahinoam ta a sapa; a pahningnapa Daniel ca Karmel ming Abigail ta a sapa;
a pathungnapa Absalom ca Geshur siepahruo Talmai sacanung Maakah sacapaa ta a cuo; a papaliynapa ca Adonijah ta a cuo, a nung ca Haggith ta a cuo.
A papangaanapa ca Shefatiah ta cuo te, Abital ta a sa; a pacaruvnapa ca Ithream ta cuo te a napuvnung Eglah ta a sa;
Kung sariy hne thla caruv siepahruo a cuonapa Hebron lieta pacaruv a sa yi. Cakhutaata Jerusalem lie kha kung sawthung kung thung siepahruo a cuo.
Hingpa tie hing Jerusalem lieta a sa yi: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, hne Solomon, tapa papaliy hing Ammiel sacanung Bath-shua ta a sa yi.
Cakhutaata sacapaa hrangpa pacaky hnyi yi te: Ibhar, Elishama, Elifelet,
Nogah, Nefeg, Jafia,
Elishama, Eliada, hne Elifelet ta ama cuo.
Hingpa tie bangkhuo hing David sacapaa ta ama cuo, a nungthangnung tie sacapaa zaw ta li pata, cakhutaata ama sietanung ca Tamar ta a cuo.
Solomon ciypathla tie: Rehoboam, Rehoboam sacapaa Abijah, Abijah sacapaa Asa, Asa sacapaa Jehoshafat, Jehoshafat sacapaa Joram,
Joram sacapaa Ahaziah, Ahaziah sacapaa Joash, Joash sacapaa Amaziah,
Amaziah sacapaa Azariah, Azariah sacapaa Jotham, Jotham sacapaa Ahaz,
Ahaz sacapaa Hezekiah, Hezekiah sacapaa Manasseh,
Manasseh sacapaa Amon, Amon sacapaa Josiah,
Josiah sacapaa tie: a sa taapa Johanan, a pahningnapa Jehoiakim, a pathungnapa Zedekiah, a papaliynapa Shallum.
Jehoiakim ciypathla tie: a sacapaa Jekoniah, Jekoniah sacapaa Zedekiah;
cakhutaata carie ta ama patuvpa Jekoniah sacapaa tie: a sacapaa Shealtiel,
Malkhiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, hne Nedabiah;
Pedaiah sacapaa tie: Zerubbabel hne Shimei; hne Zerubbabel sacapaa tie: Meshullam hne Hananiah, hne ama sietanung ca Shelomith ta a cuo;
cakhutaata Hashubah, Ohel, Berekhiah, Hasadiah, hne Jushab-hesed tapa tie papangaa.
Hananiah sacapaa tie: Pelatiah hne Jeshaiah, Jeshaiah sacapaa Refaiah, Refaiah sacapaa Arnan, Arnan sacapaa Obadiah, Obadiah sacapaa Shekaniah.
Shekaniah sacapaa tie: Shemaiah. Cakhutaata Shemaiah sacapaa tie: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, hne Shafat, pacaruv.
Neariah sacapaa tie: Elioenai, Hizkiah, hne Azrikam, pathung.
Elioenai sacapaa tie: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, hne Anani, pasariy.
Judah sacapaa tie: Perez, Hezron, Karmi, Hur, hne Shobal.
Shobal sacapaa Reaiah ca Jahath paa ta a cuo, Jahath ca Ahumai hne Lahad paa ta a cuo. Hingpa tie hing Zorath ingchungkhue tie ta ama cuo.
Hingpa tie hing Etam sacapaa tie ta ama cuo: Jezreel, Ishma, hne Idbash; hne ama sietanung ming ca Hazzelelponi ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata Penuel ca Gedor paa ta cuo te, Ezer ca Hushah paa ta a cuo. Hingpa tie hing Hur sacapaa zaw ta ama cuo, a sa taapa Efrath, Bethlehem paa ta a cuo.
Tekoa paa Ashhur ta napuv pahning a hnyi, Helah hne Naarah;
Naarah ta Ahuzzam, Hefer, Temeni, hne Haahashtari kha a sapa. Hingpa tie hing Naarah sacapaa zaw ta ama cuo.
Helah sacapaa tie: Zereth, Izhar, hne Ethnan.
Koz ca Anub, Zobebah, hne Harum sacapaa Aharhel ingchungkhue tie paa ta a cuo.
Jabez ca a uvnupa laa khata pa-uvsathyi vie pata a cuo; cakhutaata a nung ta, “A ruvsa pata i sapa a cuo nakawta,” ta te ama kha Jabez a ta.

Jabez ta Israel Khazing kha u te, “Nama ta thluechiy na pi la i ruoriy hing paku sa vie la, na kuv ca kama'a lie aw sala, kama hing ruvnaana ta ina tlung li riypata na khuo tie!” a ta. Aa hiepa kha Khazing ta a pi.
Shuhah uvnupa Khelub ca Eshton paa Mehir a paa khata a cuo.
Eshton ca Beth-rafa, Paseah, hne Ir-nahash a paa Tehinna paa ta a cuo. Hingpa tie hing Rekah ming ta ama cuo.
Kenaz sacapaa tie: Othniel hne Seraiah; hne Othniel sacapaa tie: Hathath hne Meonothai.
Meonothai ca Ofrah paa ta cuo te, cakhutaata Seraiah ca Ge-harashim a paa Joab paa ta a cuo, cahaacata ama kupa ca kuvzung a thepa ama cuo nakaw tana a cuo.
Jefunneh sacapaa Kaleb sacapaa tie: Iru, Elah, hne Naam; hne Elah sacapaa tie: Kenaz.
Jehallelel sacapaa tie: Zif, Zifah, Tiria, hne Asarel.

Ezrah sacapaa tie: Jether, Mered, Efer, hne Jalon. Hingpa tie hing Bithiah sacapaa tie ta ama cuo, Faraoh sacanung Mered hneta a chiyhiepa; hne ama ta nu phya te Miriam, Shammai, hne Eshtemoa paa Ishbah kha a sa yi.
Cakhutaata a napuvnung Judah zaanung khata Gedor paa Jered, Soko paa Heber, hne Zanoah paa Jekuthiel kha a sa yi.
Naham sietanung ta a cuopa Hodiah napuvnung sacapaa tie ca Gar ming Keilah hne Maakath ming Eshtemoa ta ama cuo.
Shimon sacapaa tie: Ammon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan, hne Tilon. Ishi sacapaa tie: Zoheth hne Ben-zoheth.
Judah sacapaa Shelah sacapaa tie ca: Lekah paa Er, Mareshah paa Laadah, hne Beth-ashbea lie palaa ta cawthang phapa a taapa ingchungkhue tie;
hne Jokim, hne Kozeba cawsaa tie, hne Joash, hne Saraf, Moab ruo luo napuv va hnyi te Lehem luo a vya kaapa (ama za capepa rucaa ca a hlung tli).
Hingpa tie hing bi vytuv hne Netaim hne Gederah lie khy a sapa tie ta ama cuo; capa lie ca siepahruo'a lieta a re hrie riypata a awpa tana ama cuo.
Simeon sacapaa tie: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;
Shallum ca a sacapaa ta a cuo, Mibsam ca a sacapaa ta a cuo, Mishma ca a sacapaa ta a cuo.
Mishma sacapaa tie: Hammuel ca a sacapaa ta a cuo, Zakkur ca a sacapaa ta a cuo, Shimei ca a sacapaa ta a cuo.
Shimei ta sacapaa pahraa hlyicaruv hne sacanung pacaruv a hnyi; cuorasala a uvnu tie ca saata a hluv hnyi va yi, ama ingchungkhue tie bangkhuo zaw Judah ming haa khata pung va yi.
Iema ca Beer-sheba, Moladah, Hazar-shual,
Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad,
Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,
Beth-markaboth, Hazar-susim, Beth-biri, hne Shaaraim lieta khy ama sa. Hingpa tie hing David siepahruo a cuona te ta ama khy tie ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata ama khyta tie ca Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tokhen, hne Ashan, khy pangaa,
hne hingpa khypuv cahriylie a awpa ama khyta bangkhuo, Baal te ta, a cuo. Hingpa hing ama khysana ta a cuo. Iema ta ama ciyhruo thukina rucaa kha ama hnyi.
Meshobab, Jamlekh, Amaziah sacapaa Joshah,
Joel, Joshibiah sacapaa Jehu, Joshibiah ca Seraiah sacapaa, Seraiah ca Asiel sacapaa,
Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,
Ziza paa Shifi, Shifi paa Allon, Allon pa Jedaiah, Jedaiah paa Shimri, Shimri paa Shemaiah,
hingpa ming ripa tie hing ama ingchungkhue lie luochiytuv tie ta ama cuo, cakhutaata iema phang hing khuopuv ta ama pungzaa.
Iema ta Gedor luo a ngienapa, bawphie ningchiyluo kuo kha ama sahring tlena ruo huv riypata ama si.
Capa ruo ca ruo panuta, ruo phapa, hne ruo kusapa, ruo duopa, ruo diepa a cuopa kha ama hmung; tahematapakieca capa lie zaa aw taapa tie ca Ham ming ta ama cuo.

Hingpa, ming ta capepa tie hing, Judah Siepahruo Hezekiah chuo ning khata a vaw yi te, ama thluodaa hne capa lie ama hmungpa Meunim ming kha tuv yi te, ataning tepa hingta pahli diy karue yi te, iema hmang lie kha khy ama sa, tahematapakieca capa lie ca ama sahring patlena riypa ruo a aw.
Cakhutaata iema chungtaata chekha, Simeon ming cawsaa zapangaa ca Seir Tluo luo kha si yi te, iema luochiytuv tie ca Ishi sacapaa tie Pelatiah, Neariah, Refaiah, hne Uzziel khata ama cuo.
Iema ta zaa ruopa tie Amalek ming aa ngaapa tie kha para yi te capa lie ca ataning tepa hingta khy ama sa.

Israel ta a sa taapa Reuben a sacapaa tie (Ama ca a sa taapa ta a cuo, cuorasala a paa iehmang kha a papya a palyi nakawta sa taapa a cuona ca Israel sacapaa Josef sacapaa tie'a luo kha pi pata a cuo, caacuonakawta chuorina lie kha sa taapa a cuona haa khata khung pata cuo vyi.
Judah ca a uvnu zaw hrawlieta a thaaruvpa kya cuo te ama chungtaata uvtuv a pya raalaa pata, sa taapa cuona ca Josef huopa ta a cuo thluo).
Israel ta a sa taapa Reuben sacapaa tie: Hanok, Pallu, Hezron, hne Karmi.
Joel sacapaa tie: Joel sacapaa Shemaiah, Shemaiah sacapaa Gog, Gog sacapaa Shimei,
Shimei sacapaa Mikah, Mikah sacapaa Reaiah, Reaiah sacapaa Baal,
Baal sacapaa Beerah, Beerah ca Assiria Siepahruo Tilgath-pilneser ta sii ta aa dapa; Reuben ming hrawtaata uvtuv ta a cuopa ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata a tieriy zaw ca ama ingchungkhue kaluo haa khata ama chuorina kha capepa a cuo tiyta hing haa hingta a cuo: uvtuv, Jeiel, hne Zekhariah,
hne Azaz sacapaa Bela, Azaz ca Shema sacapaa, Shema ca Joel sacapaa, Aroer lie Nebo hne Baal-meon te ta a awpa tie ta ama cuo.
Gilead ruo lieta ama sahring kha a pungzaa nakawta ningchiyluo ta Zufrates cavaa hingsuoluo kuo viehnangruo angiena te khata ama aw hyi.
Cakhutaata Saul chuo lie kha ama kuv raw luo a tlapa tie Hag ming hne rie a du yi te, cakhutaa cata Gilead ruo ningchiyluo bangkhuo lie ama thluodaa lie kha khy ama sa.
Gad sacapaa tie ca iema athaalie Bashan ruo chunglie kha Salekah te khata ama aw:
Joel ca uvtuv ta a cuo, a pahningna ta Shafam, Janai, hne Shafat ca Bashan ruo chunglieta ama aw.
Iema'a na ama chung kaluo ta ama tieriy ca: Mikhael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jakan, Zia, hne Eber, pasariy.

Hingpa tie hing Huri sacapaa Abihail sacapaa tie ta ama cuo, Abihail ca Huri sacapaa, Huri ca Jaroah sacapaa, Jaroah ca Gilead sacapaa, Gilead ca Mikhael sacapaa, Mikhael ca Jeshishai sacapaa, Jeshishai ca Jahdo sacapaa, Jahdo ca Buz sacapaa;
Guni sacapaa Abdiel sacapaa Ahi ca iema phang lieta uvtuv ta a cuo.
Iema ca Gilead lie hne Bashan hne a cahriy khy tie lie, hne Sharon ruo chung sahring tlenapa hmang bangkhuo lie kha a ruoriy te ta ama aw.
Hingpa tie bangkhuo hing Judah Siepahruo Jotham chuo ning hne Israel Siepahruo Jeroboam chuo ning kha ama thukina ciyhruo haata cazing khung pata ama cuo.
Reuben ming hne Gad ming hne Manasseh phang khingkhuo ca phya hne zueziy a cyipa, liy ka the yi te rietuv a thepa rieka ta cuo yi te, rie a tuv khu riypa thawsawliy thawpaliy zasariy sawcaruv ama ta.
Iema ta Hag ming, Jetur ming, Nafish ming, hne Nodab ming kha ama tuv;

iema aduna lie kha byana ama hmung nakawta Hag ming hne iema'a lie a awpa tie bangkhuo ca ama kuv luo pi pata ama cuo, tahematapakieca iema ta rietuvna taa khata Khazing'a luo khi yi te, ama kha amaa ringchuo nakawta ama hiepa kha a pi yi.
Iema ta ama sahring kha ama sikhyi: kala-uv thawsawngaa, tuv thawzahning thawsawngaa, laa thawhning, hne hruocawsaa thawzakha.
Rietuvna ca Khazing huopa a cuo nakawta a hluvsa ama thie. Cakhutaata iema ruo lie ca sii ta a dapa ama cuona te khata ama aw.
Manasseh phang khingkhuo ca ruo chunglie kha ama aw; iema ca hluvsa yi te Bashan taata Baal-hermon, Senir, hne Hermon Tluo te khata ama aw.
Hingpa tie hing ama phang luv ta a cuopa tie ta ama cuo: Efer, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Hermiah, Hodaviah, hne Jahdiel, a thaaruvpa rieka, ming pathuopa, ama phang luv ta a cuopa tie ta ama cuo.
Cuorasala ama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing'a lie kha sue yi te, Khazing ta iema hmiekunglie a parapa, ruo chunglie zaa awpa tie khazing'a lie kha ama siyhraw.

Caacuonakawta Israel Khazing khata Assiria Siepahruo Pul hne Assiria Siepahruo Tilgath-pilneser pathiypalung kha pathu sa te ama ca ta Reuben ming, Gad ming, hne Manasseh phang khingkhuo kha Halah, Habor, Hara, hne Gozan cavaa luo kha sikhyi yi te ataning tepa hingta ama aw.
Levi sacapaa tie: Gershom, Kohath, hne Merari.
Kohath sacapaa tie: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, hne Uzziel.
Amram saata tie: Aaron, Moses, hne Miriam. Aaron sacapaa tie: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, hne Ithamar.
Eleazar ca Finehas paa ta a cuo, Finehas ca Abishua paa ta a cuo,
Abishua ca Bukki paa ta a cuo, Bukki ca Uzzi paa ta a cuo,
Uzzi ca Zerahiah paa ta a cuo, Zerahiah ca Meraioth paa ta a cuo,
Meraioth ca Amariah paa ta a cuo, Amariah ca Ahitub paa ta a cuo,
Ahitub ca Zadok paa ta a cuo, Zadok ca Ahimaaz paa ta a cuo,
Ahimaaz ca Azariah paa ta a cuo, Azariah ca Johanan paa ta a cuo,
cakhutaata Johanan ca Azariah paa ta a cuo (ama ca Jerusalem lie Solomon ta a sapa ing chunglie tluobyi re a hriepa ta a cuo).
Azariah ca Amariah paa ta a cuo, Amariah ca Ahitub paa ta a cuo,
Ahitub ca Zadok paa ta a cuo, Zadok ca Shallum paa ta a cuo,
Shallum ca Hilkiah paa ta a cuo, Hilkiah ca Azariah paa ta a cuo,
Azariah ca Seraiah paa ta a cuo, Seraiah ca Jehozadak paa ta a cuo;
Nebukhadnezzar kuv ta Judah hne Jerusalem ca Abyipa ta siicuona chung luo a pathla tiy yi ta, Jehozadak ca sii ta a da pata a cuo.
Levi sacapaa zaw: Gershom, Kohath, hne Merari.
Hingpa tie hing Gershom sacapaa tie ama ming ta a cuo: Libni hne Shimei.
Kohath sacapaa tie: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, hne Uzziel.
Merari sacapaa tie: Mahli hne Mushi. Hingpa tie hing ama mingchingmingvuo taata Levi phang tie ta ama cuo.
Gershom sacapaa tie: Gershom sacapaa Libni, Libni sacapaa Jahath, Jahath sacapaa Zimmah,
Zimmah sacapaa Joah, Joah sacapaa Iddo, Iddo sacapaa Zerah, Zerah sacapaa Jeatherai.
Kohath sacapaa tie: Kohath sacapaa Amminadab, Amminadab sacapaa Korah, Korah sacapaa Assir,
Assir sacapaa Elkanah, Elkanah sacapaa Ebiasaf, Abiasaf sacapaa Assir,
Assir sacapaa Tahath, Tahath sacapaa Uriel, Uriel sacapaa Uzziah, Uzziah sacapaa Shaul.
Elkanah sacapaa tie: Amasai hne Ahimoth,
Ahimoth sacapaa Elkanah, Elkanah sacapaa Zofai, Zofai sacapaa Nahath,
Nahath sacapaa Eliab, Eliab sacapaa Jeroham, Jeroham sacapaa Elkanah.
Samuel sacapaa tie: a sa taapa Joel ta a cuo, a pahningnapa Abijah.
Merari sacapaa tie: Mahli, Mahli sacapaa Libni, Libni sacapaa Shimei, Shimei sacapaa Uzzah,
Uzzah sacapaa Shimea, Shemea sacapaa Haggiah, Haggiah sacapaa Asaiah.
Hingpa tie hing biekuona thingkaw aa vya pahy khutaata David ta Abyipaing lie hlaa sa re a patuv riypata a chipa tie ta ama cuo.
Solomon ta Jerusalem lie Abyipaing a sa hluo te khata atawna pang thluodaa biena-ing lie kha hlaa luo ta re ama hrie; ama re kha a paziy pata ama hrie.
Hingpa tie hing re a hriepa tie hne ama sacapaa tie ta ama cuo: Kohath ming chungtaata: Heman, hlaa satuv, Joel sacapaa ta a cuo, Joel ca Samuel sacapaa,
Samuel ca Elkanah sacapaa, Elkanah ca Jeroham sacapaa, Jeroham ca Eliel sacapaa, Eliel ca Toah sacapaa,
Toah ca Zuf sacapaa, Zuf ca Elanah sacapaa, Elkanah ca Mahath sacapaa, Mahath ca Amasai sacapaa,
Amasai ca Elkanah sacapaa, Elkanah ca Joel sacapaa, Joel ca Azariah sacapaa, Azariah ca Zefaniah sacapaa,
Zefaniah ca Tahath sacapaa, Tahath ca Assir sacapaa, Assir ca Ebiasaf sacapaa, Ebiasaf ca Korah sacapaa,
Korah ca Izhar sacapaa, Izhar ca Kohath sacapaa, Kohath ca Levi sacapaa, Levi ca Israel sacapaa;
hne a cacuoluo kuo ta a tupa a uvnupa, a ming ca, Asaf, Asaf ca Berekhiah sacapaa, Berekhiah ca Shimea sacapaa,
Shimea ca Mikhael sacapaa, Mikhael ca Baaseiah sacapaa, Baaseiah ca Malkhijah sacapaa,
Malkhijah ca Ethni sacapaa, Ethni ca Zerah sacapaa, Zerah ca Adaiah sacapaa,
Adaiah ca Ethan sacapaa, Ethan ca Zimmah sacapaa, Zimmah ca Shimei sacapaa,
Shimei ca Jahath sacapaa, Jahath ca Gershom sacapaa, Gershom ca Levi sacapaa.
Cavyiluo'apa tie ca ama tieriy Merari sacapaa zaw ta ama cuo: Ethan ca Kishi sacapaa, Kishi ca Abdi sacapaa, Abdi ca Malluk sacapaa,
Malluk ca Hashabiah sacapaa, Hashabiah ca Amaziah sacapaa, Amaziah ca Hilkiah sacapaa,
Hilkiah ca Amzi sacapaa, Amzi ca Bani sacapaa, Bani ca Shemer sacapaa,
Shemer ca Mahli sacapaa, Mahli ca Mushi sacapaa, Mushi ca Merari sacapaa, Merari ca Levi sacapaa;
cakhutaata ama tieriy Levi ming ca Abyipa ing pang thluodaa lie re bangkhuo hrie riypata hrievu pi pata ama cuo.

Cuorasala Aaron hne a sacapaa tie ca Khazing changtaapa Moses nawpina haa khata myirue panaana bienatluophie cunglie hne rangpa-ue bienatluophie cunglie kha pihluona tue yi te, Israel ming cuota sue angiethena hie yi te, hmang pathe cepa lieta re bangkhuo kha ama hrie.
Hingpa tie hing Aaron sacapaa tie ta ama cuo: Aaron sacapaa Eleazar, Eleazar sacapaa Finehas, Finehas sacapaa Abishua,
Abishua sacapaa Bukki, Bukki sacapaa Uzzi, Uzzi sacapaa Zerahiah,
Zerahiah sacapaa Meraioth, Meraioth sacapaa Amariah, Amariah sacapaa Ahitub,
Ahitub sacapaa Zadok, Zadok sacapaa Ahimaaz.
Hingpa hing ama ruoriy chunglieta ama awnapa kaluo haata, khy ama sana hmang zaw ta a cuo: Kohath ingchungkhue tie chungtaata Aaron sacapaa tie ta, vyisung a da yi te ama hmungpa a cuo nakawta,
Judah ruo chunglie Hebron hne a cahriylie a awpa sahring tlena ruo kha iema ca ama pi.
Cuorasala khypuv cahriy lu hne khyta tie kha ca Jefunneh sacapaa Kaleb kha ama pi.
Aaron sacapaa tie ca canawna khypuv tie kha ama pi: Hebron, Libnah hne a sahring tlenapa ruo ta a cuopa Jattir, Eshtemoa hne a sahring tlena ruo tie,
Hilen hne a sahring tlena ruo tie, Debir hne a sahring tlena ruo tie,
Ashan hne a sahring tlena ruo tie, hne Beth-shemesh hne a sahring tlena ruo tie kha ama pi.

Benjamin phang chungtaata, Geba hne a sahring tlena ruo tie, Alemeth hne a sahring tlena ruo tie, Anathoth hne a sahring tlena ruo tie kha ama pi. Ama ingchungkhue yalya ta ama hmungpa khy ca khy hraa hlyithung ta a cuo.
Kohath ming aa ngaa kaliepa tie ca vyisung a da yi te, phang che chung taa khata, Manasseh phang che chung taa khata, khy hraa ama pi.
Gershon ming kha, ama ingchungkhue ziy pata, Issakhar phang, Asher phang, Naftali phang, hne Bashan taata Manasseh phang tapa tie kha khy hraa hlyithung ama pi.
Merari ming kha, ama ingchungkhue ziy pata, Reuben phang, Gad phang, hne Zebulun phang tapa tie taa khata khy hraa hlyihning ama pi.
Cahaacata Israel ming ta Levi ming ca khypuv tie hne a sahring tlena ruo tie kha ama pi.
Judah phang hne Simeon phang hne Benjamin phang chung taa zaw khata ama ming ri pata khy kha vyisung a da yi te ama pi.
Cakhutaata Kohath sacapaa tie ingchungkhue chekha tie zaw ta ama cupa khy tie ca Efraim phang ama cupa ruo chung taa khata a cuo.
Iema ca canawna khypuv tie kha pi pata ama cuo: Efraim tluocung ruo taata Shekhem hne a sahring tlena ruo tie, Gezer hne a sahring tlena ruo tie,
Jokmeam hne a sahring tlena ruo tie, Beth-horon hne a sahring tlena ruo tie,
Aijalon hne a sahring tlena ruo tie, Gath-rimmon hne a sahring tlena ruo tie;

cakhutaata aa ngaapa Kohath ingchungkhue tie cuo khata Manasseh phang khingkhuo chungtaata Aner kha a sahring tlena ruo tie hneta cuose, cakhutaata Bileam hne a sahring tlena ruo zaw kha pi pata ama cuo.
Gershon ming kha hingpa ruo tie hing pi pata ama cuo: Bashan lie Golan kha a sahring tlena ruo tie hne, Ashtaroth kha a sahring tlena ruo tie hne;
Issakhar phang chungtaata: Kadesh hne a sahring tlena ruo tie, Daberath hne a sahring tlena ruo tie,
Ramoth hne a sahring tlena ruo tie, Anem hne a sahring tlena ruo tie;
Asher phang chungtaata: Mashal hne a sahring tlena ruo tie, Abdon hne a sahring tlena ruo tie,
Hukok hne a sahring tlena ruo tie, hne Rehob hne a sahring tlena ruo tie,
hne Naftali phang chungtaata: Galilee lie Kedesh hne a sahring tlena ruo tie, Hammon hne a sahring tlena ruo tie, hne Kiriathaim hne a sahring tlena ruo tie.
Zebulun phang chungtaata Merari ming aa ngaapa tie ca: Rimmono hne a sahring tlena ruo tie, Tabor hne a sahring tlena ruo tie,
hne Jeriko taata Jordan huesuo ruo tie, Jordan ningchiyluo kuo lie Reuben phang chungtaata: Bezer hne a sahring tlena ruo tie, Jahzah hne a sahring tlena ruo tie,
Kedemoth hne a sahring tlena ruo tie, hne Mefaath hne a sahring tlena ruo tie;
cakhutaata Gad phang chungtaata: Gilead lie Ramoth hne a sahring tlena ruo tie, Mahanaim hne a sahring tlena ruo tie,
Heshbon hne a sahring tlena ruo tie, hne Jazer hne a sahring tlena ruo tie.
Issakhar sacapaa tie: Tola, Puah, Jashub, hne Shimron, papaliy ta ama cuo.

Tola sacapaa tie: Uzzi, Refaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, hne Shemuel, ama mingchingmingvuo Tola ingchungkhue taata luv ta a cuopa tie, iema chuo lieta a thaaruvpa rieka tie ta cuo yi te, David chuo lie kha a mingluv ta thawkiy thawhning zacaruv ta ama cuo.
Uzzi sacapaa tie: Izrahiah, Joel, hne Isshiah, papangaa, ama bangkhuo hingta byi ta ama cuo.
Iema ca napuv a hluvsa hne sacapaa a hluvsa ama hnyi nakawta iema hne ama chuo chunglie kha ama ingchungkhue ziy pata, iema hne cata rie a tuv khupa riekabyi thawsawthung ama aw.
Ama tieriy Issakhar ingchungkhue ta a cuopa bangkhuo ca ama thukina cazing haata ama bangkhuo ta a thaaruvpa rieka thawsawcari thawsariy ama ta.
Benjamin sacapaa tie: Bela, Bekher, hne Jediael, pathung ta ama cuo.

Bela sacapaa tie: Ezbon, Uzzi, Izziel, Jerimoth, hne Iri, papangaa, a thaaruvpa rieka tie, mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue tie luv ta ama cuo kaluo, ama thukina cazing haata thawkiy thawhning sawthung papaliy ta ama cuo.
Bekher sacapaa tie: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, hne Alemeth. Ama bangkhuo hingta Bekher sacapaa zaw ta ama cuo.
Ama chuo lieta ama mingchingmingvuo tie ingchungkhue luv, a thaaruvpa rieka ta cuo yi te, ama thukina cazing ziy pata thawkiy zahning ta ama cuo.
Jediael sacapaa tie: Bilhan. Cakhutaata Bilhan sacapaa tie: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Khenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, hne Ahishahar.
Ama bangkhuo hingta Jediael sacapaa zaw ta ama cuo. Ama mingchingmingvuo tie ingchungkhue luv ta a cuopa, a thaaruvpa rieka ta cuo yi te, rie a tuv khu riypa thawhraa hlyisariy zahning ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata Shuppim hne Huppim ca Ir sacapaa zaw ta cuo yi te, Hushim ca Aher sacapaa ta a cuo.
Naftali ciypathla tie: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, hne Shallum, Bilhah ciypathla tie ta ama cuo.
Manasseh sacapaa tie: Asriel, a nungthangnung Aramean zaanung ta a sapa; ama ta Gilead paa Makhir kha a sa.
Cakhutaata Makhir ta Huppim hne Shuppim huo khata napuv a chiy. A sietanung a ming ca Maakah ta a cuo. Cakhutaata a pahningnapa a ming ca Zelofehad ta cuo te, Zelofehad ca ta sacanung zaw a hnyi yi.
Makhir napuvnung Maakah ta sacapaa sa te, Peresh ta pata ming a pi; a uvnupa ming ca Sheresh ta cuo te, a sacapaa tie ca Ulam hne Rekem ta ama cuo.
Ulam sacapaa tie: Bedan. Hingpa tie hing Manasseh sacapaa Makhir sacapaa Gilead a sacapaa tie ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata a sietanung Hammolekheth ta Ishhod, Abiezer hne Mahlah a sa yi.
Shemida sacapaa tie ca Ahian, Shekhem, Likhi, hne Aniam ta ama cuo.
Efraim sacapaa tie: Shuthelah, hne Shuthelah sacapaa Bered, Bered sacapaa Tahath, Tahath sacapaa Eleadah, Eleadah sacapaa Tahath,
Tahath sacapaa Zabad, Zabad sacapaa Shuthelah, Shuthelah sacapaa Ezer hne Elead ta ama cuo; Iema ca ama sahring paruv riypata ama ruo luo ama zuv nakawta capa ruo lie a puvpa Gath ming ta ama thie.
Cakhutaata ama paa Efraim ca ning hluvpuv chung ama muochie kha sa te, a uvnu tie ta ama kha a hnaa ama panguo.
Efraim ta a napuv nung kha a ziehne te, cakhutaata ama ta sacapaa pakha a sa; rana na i ing chunglie a tlung ta te, Beriah ta pata ming a sa.
A sacanung ca Sheerah ta cuo te, ama ca Sungluo Beth-horon hne Chaluo Beth-horon, hne Uzzen-sheerah a satuv ta a cuo.
A sacapaa ca Refah ta a cuo, Refah sacapaa Reshef, Reshef sacapaa Telah, Telah sacapaa Tahan,
Tahan sacapaa Ladan, Ladan sacapaa Ammihud, Ammihud sacapaa Elishama,
Elishama sacapaa Nun, Nun sacapaa Joshua.

Iema cuvu hne khy ama sanapa ca Bethel hne a cahriy khy tie, ningchiyluo ta Naaran, hne ningtlaluo ta Gezer hne a cahriy khy tie, Shekhem hne a cahriy khy tie, Ayyah hne a cahriy khy tie te khata a cuo.

Cakhutaata Manasseh ming ruoriy aa phapa zaw khata Beth-shean hne a cahriy khy tie, Taanak hne a cahriy khy tie, Megiddo hne a cahriy khy tie, Dor hne a cahriy khy tie khata ama cuo. Hingpa tie lie hing Israel sacapaa Josef a sacapaa tie kha khy ama sa.
Asher sacapaa tie: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, hne ama sietanung Serah.
Beriah sacapaa tie: Heber hne Malkhiel, ama ca Birzaith a paa ta a cuo.
Heber ca Jaflet, Shomer, Hotham, hne ama sietanung Shua ama paa ta a cuo.
Jaflet sacapaa tie: Pasakh, Bimhal, hne Ashvath. Hingpa tie hing Jaflet a sacapaa tie ta ama cuo.
Shemer sacapaa tie: Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, hne Aram.
A uvnu a cuopa Helem sacapaa tie: Zofah, Imna, Shelesh, hne Amal.
Zofah sacapaa tie: Suah, Harnefer, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, hne Beera.
Jether sacapaa tie: Jefunneh, Pispa, hne Ara.
Ulla sacapaa tie: Arah, Hanniel, hne Rizia.

Hingpa tie bangkhuo hing Asher cawsaa tie, ama mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue luv tie, a tlawpa a thaaruvpa rieka tie, ama phang byi tie ta ama cuo. Ama thukina haata rietuvna cuota mingluv amaa pasuv tiyta thawkiy thawcaruv ama cuo.
Benjamin ca a sa taapa Bela, a pahningnapa Ashbel, a pathungnapa Aharah,
a papaliynapa Nohah, hne a papangaanapa Rafa zaw ama paa ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata Bela ta sacapaa zaw hnyi yi te: Addar, Gera, Abihud,
Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
Gera, Shefufan, hne Huram.
Hingpa tie hing Ehud sacapaa tie ta ama cuo (iema ca Geba lie khy a sapa ama mingchingmingvuo tie ingchungkhue zaw luv a cuopa tie ta cuo yi te, Manahath luo sii ta sikhyi pata ama cuo):
Naaman, Ahijah, hne Gera, Gera ca Heglam khata a cuo, ama ca Uzza hne Ahihud paa ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata Shaharaim ta a napuv ta a cuopa Hushim hne Baara kha a ma khutaa yi ta Moab lie kha sacapaa zaw a hnyi yi.
Ama ta a napuvnung Hodesh hneta sacapaa zaw hnyi yi te: Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malkam,
Jeuz, Sakhia, hne Mirmah ta ama cuo.
Ama ta Hushim hne zaw khata sacapaa hnyi yi te: Abitub hne Elpaal.
Elpaal sacapaa tie: Eber, Misham, hne Shemed, ama ca Ono hne Lod hne a cahriy khy tie a sapa khata a cuo,
Beriah hne Shema (iema ca Gath lie a zaa awpa tie a cadetuv, Aijalon lie khy a sapa tie a mingchingmingvuo tie ingchungkhue zaw luv a cuopa tie ta ama cuo);
cakhutaata Ahio, Shashak, hne Jeremoth ta ama cuo.
Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,
Mikhael, Ishpah, hne Joha ca Beriah sacapaa tie ta ama cuo.
Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,
Ishmerai, Izliah, hne Jobab ca Elpaal sacapaa tie ta ama cuo.
Jakim, Zikhri, Zabdi,
Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,
Adaiah, Beraiah, hne Shimrath ca Shimei sacapaa tie ta ama cuo.
Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,
Abdon, Zikhri, Hanan,
Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,
Ifdeiah, hne Penuel ca Shashak sacapaa tie ta ama cuo.
Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,
Jaareshiah, Elijah, hne Zikhri ca Jeroham sacapaa tie ta ama cuo.
Hingpa tie hing mingchingmingvuo tie ingchungkhue luv a cuopa tie hne, iema hne ama chuo lieta byi ta ama cuo. Iema hing Jerusalem lie a awpa tana ama cuo.
Gibeon paa Jeiel ca Gibeon lieta aw te, a napuvnung ming ca Maakah ta a cuo.
A sa taapa sacapaa ca: Abdon, cakhutaata Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,
Gedor, Ahio, Zekher,
hne Mikloth, Mikloth ca Shimeah a paa ta a cuo. Iema zaw hing Jerusalem lie a awpa ama tieriy tie hne aa rie-epa khata khy ama sa.
Ner ca Kish paa ta a cuo, Kish ca Saul paa ta a cuo, Saul ca Jonathan, Malkhishua, Abinadab hne Esh-baal paa ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata Jonathan sacapaa ca Merib-baal ta a cuo; Merib-baal ca Mikah paa ta a cuo.
Mikah sacapaa tie: Pithon, Melek, Tarea, hne Ahaz.
Ahaz ca Jehoaddah paa ta a cuo, cakhutaata Jehoaddah ca Alemeth, Azmaveth, hne Zimri paa ta a cuo; Zimri ca Moza paa ta a cuo.
Moza ca Binea paa ta a cuo; a sacapaa ca Rafah, Rafah sacapaa ca Eleasah, Eleasah sacapaa ca Azel ta a cuo.
Azel ta sacapaa pacaruv hnyi te, hingpa hing ama ming ta a cuo: Azrikam, Bokheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, hne Hanan; hingpa tie bangkhuo hing Azel sacapaa tie ta ama cuo.
A uvnupa Eshek sacapaa tie: Ulam ca a sa taapa ta a cuo, a pahningnapa ta Jeush, hne a pathungnapa ta Elifelet.
Ulam sacapaa tie ca a thaaruvpa rieka, liy hne thi ka a thepa, saata hne samingta a hluvsa a hnyipa ta ama cuo, zakha sawngaa ta ama cuo. Hingpa tie hing Benjamin ming ta ama cuo.

Cahaacata Israel ming bangkhuo ca ama thukina haa khata ming khung pata ama cuo; capa ca Israel Siepahruo tie Caa-uv lie kha cape pata a cuo. Cakhutaata Judah ca zang tluo aa tla lina kawlie khata Babilon luo sii ta sikhyi pata a cuo.
Cakhutaata ama cuvu a cuopa ama khy zaw chunglieta a aw pakhaa taapa tie ca, Israel ming, tluobyi tie, Levi ming, hne biena-ing lie re a hriepa tie ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata Judah ming chekha, Benjamin ming chekha, Efraim ming chekha, hne Manasseh ming chekha tie ca Jerusalem lie kha ama aw:
Ammihud sacapaa Uthai, Uthai sacapaa Omri, Omri sacapaa Imri, Imri sacapaa Bani, Bani ca Judah sacapaa Perez sacapaa tie chung taa tana a cuo.
Cakhutaata Shilon ming chungtaata: a sa taapa Asaiah, hne a sacapaa tie ta ama cuo.
Zerah sacapaa tie: Jeuel hne a tieriy, zacaruv sawcaky ta ama cuo.
Benjamin ming chungtaata: Meshullam sacapaa Sallu, Meshullam ca Hodaviah sacapaa, Hodaviah ca Hassenuah sacapaa,
Jeroham sacapaa Ibneiah, Uzzi sacapaa Elah, Uzzi ca Mikhri sacapaa, hne Shefatiah sacapaa Meshullam, Shefatiah ca Reuel sacapaa, Reuel ca Ibnijah sacapaa;
hne iema chuo kaluo lie ama tieriy zaw ta cuo yi te, zacaky sawngaa pacaruv ta ama cuo. Iema bangkhuo hing ama mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue tie luv tana ama cuo.
Tluobyi tie chungtaata: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jakhin,
hne Hilkiah sacapaa Azariah, Hilkiah ca Meshullam sacapaa, Meshullam ca Zadok sacapaa, Zadok ca Meraioth sacapaa, Meraioth ca Ahitub sacapaa, Ahitub ca Khazing ingchungkhue lie byi le cepa ta a cuo;

cakhutaata Adaiah ca Jeroham sacapaa, Jeroham ca Pashhur sacapaa, Pashhur ca Malkhijah sacapaa, hne Adiel sacapaa Maasai, Adiel ca Jahzerah sacapaa, Jahzerah ca Meshullam sacapaa, Meshullam ca Meshillemith sacapaa, Meshillemith ca Immer sacapaa;
ama tieriy, ama mingchingmingvuo tie luv a cuopa tie ta li pata, thawkha zasariy sawcaruv ta ama cuo, Khazing ing lie re hrie riypata aa desapa tie ta ama cuo.
Levi ming chungtaata: Hasshub sacapaa Shemaiah, Shemaiah ca Azrikam sacapaa, Azrikam ca Merari sacapaa tie chungtaata Hashabiah sacapaa ta a cuo;
cakhutaata Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal hne Mattaniah, Mattaniah ca Mika sacapaa, Mikah ca Zikhri sacapaa, Zikhri ca Asaf sacapaa;
cakhutaata Shemaiah sacapaa Obadiah, Shemaiah ca Galal sacapaa, Galal ca Jeduthun sacapaa, hne Berekhiah ca Asa sacapaa, Asa ca Netofath khyta tie lie a awpa Elkanah sacapaa ta a cuo.
Thlake a huopa tie ca: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman; hne iema tieriy Shallum ca ama byi ta cuo te,
iema ca ahluo ta ca siepahruo thlake ningchiyluo kuo ta chipa tana ama cuo. Hingpa tie hing Levi ming arina hmang lie thlake a huopa tie ta ama cuo.

Shallum ca Kore sacapaa, Kore ca Ebiasaf sacapaa, Ebiasaf ca Korah sacapaa, hne a mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue tieriy ta a cuopa Korah ming ca ama mingchingmingvuo tie kha Abyipaarina hmang mangchiytuv hne thlake a huopa ama za cuopa haata biena-ing re mangchiytuv hne thlake a huotuv ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata Eleazar sacapaa Finehas ca a hluo ning taata iema byi a cuopa haata Abyipata ama kha a awpuo.
Meshelemiah sacapaa Zekhariah ca atawna thluodaa luo a ngienapa thlake a huotuv ta a cuo.
Hingpa tie bangkhuo, ingchiypakaa thabaw lie thlake a huotuv ta a tlawpa tie ca zahning pahraa hlyihning ta ama cuo.
Caacuonakawta iema hne ama ciypathla tie ca Abyipaing thlake a mangchiytuv ta ama cuo, capa ca, thluodaa ing khata a cuo, iema ca a huotuv ta ama cuo.
Thlake a huotuv tie ca kuo paliy lie kha aw yi te, ningchiy, ningtla, chaluo, hne sungluo khata ama aw;
ama khy tie lie a awpa ama tieriy tie ca ning sariy duo lie khata iema hne aw riypata iema'a luo cakuo riypa hrievu ama hnyi;
tahematapakieca Levi ming ta a cuopa thlake a huotuv byi papaliy tie ca Khazing ing khuo tie hne suethiy a mangchiytuv ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata iema ca Khazing ing athaalie kha amaa zie; tahematapakieca huo riypa hne a maw tating ta ingchiypakaa pahaw riypa kha iema hrievu ta a cuo.
Iema chungtaata chekha ca biphie mangchiy kha ama re ta a cuo, tahematapakieca ama la ning hne ama khung pakhaa ning kha ri riypa hrievu ama hnyi.

Iema chungtaata a hrangpa tie ca cabya thude mangchiytuv, a pathepa biphie mangchiytuv, jungsacuo viedie pha cepa, mingsuvtiy, chiytiy, rangpa-ue hne tiyhuo lie thlapa rangpa-ue mangchiytuv ta hrievu pipa ama cuo.
Tluobyi tie sacapaa a hrangpa tie ta tiyhuo lie thlapa rangpa-ue tie pya riypa kha hrievu ama la.
Cakhutaata Levi ming pakha ta a cuopa Mattithiah ta chuore aa phiepa tue riypa kha hrievu a hnyi, ama ca Korah ming Shallum ta a sa taapa sacapaa ta a cuo.
Kohath ming ama tieriy chekha zaw ca sabbath ning kyry ta pachie paripa viechuo tue riypa hrievu kha ama hnyi.

Hingpa tie hing hlaa a sapa ta ama cuo, iema ca Levi ming mingchingmingvuo tie ingchungkhue luv tie khata cuo yi te, biena-ing khuo chunglie kha aw yi te, re hrangpa hrie va yi, tahematapakieca iema ca chung zuo ta hrievu a hnyipa tana ama cuo.
Hingpa tie hing Levi ming mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue tie luv ta cuo yi te, ama chuo cyicuo lieta luochiytuv cuo yi te, Jerusalem lieta ama aw.
Gibeon lieta Gibeon paa Jeiel kha aw te, a napuvnung ming ca Maakah ta a cuo.
A sa taapa a sacapaa ca Abdon, cakhutaata Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab
Gedor, Ahio, Zekhariah, hne Mikloth ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata Mikloth ca Shimeam paa ta a cuo; cakhutaata hingpa tie zaw hing Jerusalem lie a awpa ama tieriy tie hne aa rie-ena lie kha ama tieriy hneta khy ama sa.
Ner ca Kish paa ta a cuo, Kish ca Saul paa ta a cuo, Saul ca Jonathan, Malkhishua, Abinadab, hne Esh-baal paa ta a cuo;
cakhutaata Jonathan sacapaa ca Merib-baal ta a cuo; Merib-baal ca Mikah paa ta a cuo.
Mikah sacapaa tie: Pithon, Melek, Tahrea, hne Ahaz;
cakhutaata Ahaz ca Jarah paa ta a cuo, Jarah ca Alemeth, Azmaveth, hne Zimri paa ta a cuo; cakhutaata Zimri ca Moza paa ta a cuo.
Moza ca Binea paa ta a cuo; Refaiah ca a sacapaa ta a cuo, Refaiah sacapaa ca Eleasah ta a cuo, Eleasah sacapaa ca Azel ta a cuo.
Azel ta sacapaa pacaruv hnyi te, hingpa tie hing ama ming ta a cuo: Azrikam, Bokheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, hne Hanan; hingpa tie hing Azel sacapaa tie ta ama cuo.
Filistin ming ta Israel ming kha amaa du; Israel ming ca Filistin ming hmiekung taa khata a ruo yi te, Gilboa tluo cunglie kha ama thiy patlaw thluo.
Filistin ming ta Saul hne a sacapaa zaw kha pha yi te, Filistin ming ca ta Saul sacapaa zaw ta a cuopa Jonathan hne Abinadab hne Malkhishua kha ama thie.
Saul ca rietuvna ca ta a vya cadesa tli; thi ka a thepa tie ta hmung yi te ama kha hmaa ama paphya.

Cakhutaata Saul ta a cehre a cyipatuv kyihuo khata, “Na zueziy kha a da la a zangpahlina te ta na daw tie, vangdaw a te lipa tie hing a vaw'a yi te cangna ta na hmuo'a kie yi,” a ta. Cuorasala a cehre a cyipatuv khata khing vyi, tahematapakieca a ciy hringhruo. Caacuonakawta Saul ta ama zueziy mamaapa kha la te, padaa te, a busue te aa dawsa.
A cehre a cyipatuv ta Saul a thiypa kha a hmung tiyta, a zueziy kha a busue ra te a thiy.
Cahaacata Saul ca a thiy; ama hne a sacapaa pathung hne a ingchungkhue bangkhuo ca suv kha lieta ama thiy.

Bawphie lie a awpa Israel ming bangkhuo ta rieka tie ca a ruo yi te, Saul hne a sacapaa zaw ama thiypa kha ama hmung tiyta, ama khy zaw kha thuse yi te amaa ruo; cakhutaata Filistin ming kha a vaw yi te ama khy lie kha ama aw.
A mawluopa ta Filistin ming ta a thiypa tie cawsie thliepa riypata amaa vaw tiyta, Saul hne a sacapaa tie Gilboa Tluo lie ama thiypa kha ama hmung.

Iema ta a cawsie kha thlie yi te, a luv hne a cehre kha la yi te, ama kuvtuezuv tie hne cawsaa zaw'a luo kha capa thuohlaa phapa ca pathyi sa riypata Filistin ruo ting luo kha biephyatuv tie ama pathlie.
A cehre kha ama khazing tie biena-ing lie chi yi te, a luv kha Dagon biena-ing chunglie ama taa.
Cuorasala Jabesh-gilead ming bangkhuo ta Filistin ming ta Saul cunglie ama tuepa kha ama thyi tiyta,

a rie a phapa rieka bangkhuo ta thu yi te Saul a riyy hne a sacapaa tie riyy kha va la yi te, Jabesh luo ama sikhyi. Cakhutaata ama ruv kha Jabesh lie mathliy kung rawlie kha paby yi te, ning sariy sa amaa uv.
Cahaacata Saul ca zang tluo aa tla lina kawlieta a thiy; Abyipa'a lie zang tluo aa tla lina ca Abyipari aa ngie linapa kha hne; ca hlyitaw taata, apyipa kha luochiyna repata bie hiehriy te,
Abyipa'a taata luochiyna kha huv li pata a aw. Caacuonakawta Abyipata ama kha thie te a pena kha Jesse sacapaa David kha a pi.
Cakhutaata Israel ming kha Hebron lieta David'a lie kha a hmya yi te, “Mang tie, kiema ca na ruv hne na saa tana ma cuo.

Ma hnangluo cuo, Saul siepahruo a cuo ning kha hmuo nama ca Israel rieka tie kha naw a pituv tana na cuo. Abyipana Khazing ta nama kha: I cawsaa Israel ming luochiytuv ca nama na a cuo'a ciy, nama na i cawsaa Israel ming uvtuv ta a cuo'a ciy,’ aca ta,” ama ta.

Caacuonakawta Israel ming uvthyi bangkhuo ca siepahruo awna Hebron luo ca a vaw yi te, cakhutaata David ta Abyipahmiekunglie Hebron lie kha iema hne cata biekuona a tue. Cakhutaata Abyipata Samuel'a lie a ripa bie haa khata Israel ming cunglie siepahruo cuo riypata David kha sathu ama pathuv.
David hne Israel ming bangkhuo ca Jerusalem luo kha ama si, capa ca Jebus khata a cuo, Jebus ming khy ama sanapa ruo khata a cuo.
Jebus lie khy a sapa tie ta David kyihuo khata, “Hingpa luo hing a ngie'a vaciy,” ama ta. Cuorasala David ta Zion cariekyikuo ca a la, capa ca David khy tapa cata a cuo.
David ta, “Jebus ming a tuv taapa ca riebyi le cepa tana nama cuo aa,” a ta. Cakhutaata Zeruiah sacapaa Joab kha khaw taa te, caacuonakawta riebyi le cepa ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata David ca cariekyikuo chunglie ca khy a sa; caacuonakawta capa ca David khypuv ama ta.
Cakhutaata khypuv ca Millo taata pathu pata khy dungkhuo kha a tlingsa pata a tue; cakhutaata Joab ta khy pare riypa aa tuo kaliepa kha a pare.
Cakhutaata David ca Cungnungce Abyipata a awpuo nakawta a lesyi hryly.

Hingpa tie hing David cawsaa a thaaruvpa byi tie ta ama cuo, Israel ming kawlieta Abyipabie haa khata, ama kha siepahruo ta tue riypata Israel ming bangkhuo hneta a pena chunglie kha khuosa ta amaa bya.
Hingpa hing David cawsaa a thaaruvpa tie kaw ta a cuo: Hakhmon sacapaa Jashobeam ca pathung tie hrawlie byi le cepa ta a cuo; ama ta aa syi ta cawsaa zathung kha a du yi te yi kha ta a thie yi.
Cakhutaata a thaaruvpa pathung chungtaata ama a paziypa ca Dodo sacapaa Eleazar ta a cuo.
Filistin ming ta rie thu riypata Pas-dammim lie amaa hmya ning kha David'a lieta a aw. Capa lie ca alyi hmang kha aw te barli ta a bi. Capa taa cata cawsaa ca Filistin ming'a taa khata amaa ruo.
Cuorasala ama hne David ca capa alyi hmang liekhingkhuo lie kha adaahmang la yi te Filistin ming kha a du yi te ama thie; capa khutaa cata Abyipata tena lepuv ta a khuo yi.
Byi sawthung chungtaata pathung tie ca Filistin rieka tie Refaim bawphie lie amaa ri ning kha Adullam lungkhue lie David'a luo kha ama zuv.
Capa ning ca David ca cariekyikuo chunglie kha aw te, khy a huopa Filistin rieka tie ca Bethlehem lieta ama aw.
David ta, “Bethlehem khy thlake athaalie a awpa takhue tiy kha dang riypata naa pi khupa aw yi sala ca!” ta te aa ngiy.

Cakhutaata capa pathung tie ca ta Filistin ming arina hmang lie kha va caluo yi te, thlake athaalie a awpa Bethlahem takhue tiy ca the yi te David'a luo kha ama vya cyi. Cuorasala David ta dang li pata Abyipahmiekunglie kha lyi te,

“I Khazing na hing hmang i tue riypa hing naa thlu. Hingpa tie thiy hing i dang khu'a ma? Tahematapakieca thiy kie thiy ta yi te ama vya cyipa tana a cuo,” a ta. Caacuonakawta dang khing vyi. Hingpa hing a thaaruvpa pathung tie khata ama tue.
Joab a nuta Abishai ca sawthung tie hrawlie uvtuv cepa ta a cuo. Aa syi ta cawsaa zathung kha a du yi te a thie yi, cakhutaa cata pathung tie hrawlie kha ming a hnyi ra.
Ama ca sawthung tie hrawlie kha ming pathuo cepa ta cuo te iema uvtuv ta a cuo; cuorasala pathung tie kha ca pha khu va yi.

Jehoiada sacapaa Benaiah ca Kabzeel khy ming a riephapa pakha ta a cuo, hmang lepa a tuepa ta a cuo; ama ta Moab ming Ariel sacapaa pahning kha a thie yi. Cahue a tla ningta a khue chunglie a awpa chingde kha zuvchiy te a thie.

Cakhutaata Izipt ming daw pangaa aa suopa cawsaa lesapa kha a thie. Izipt cawsaapa ca thetluo tie a tapa asyi lesapa suokha kha a kuv lie aa cyi; cuorasala Benaiah ta khuecahryi suokha ta a du riypata a vaachiy, Izipt cawsaapa kuv taa khata aa syi kha chuv te aa syi mamaapa cata a thie.
Jehoiada sacapaa Benaiah ta a tuepa ca cahaapa zaw cata a cuo, cakhutaa cata a thaaruvpa pathung tie hrawlie kha ming a hnyi ra.
Ama ca Sawthung tie hrawlie kha a ming a pathuo ra, cuorasala Pathung tie kha ca pha khu va yi. Cakhutaata David ta ama pangpa rievetuv rieka tie byi cepa ta a chi.
Rieka thaaruvpa tie ca Joab nuta Asahel, Bethlehem khy ming Dodo sacapaa Elhanan,
Harod ming Shammoth
Tekoa ming Ikkesh sacapaa Ira, Anathoth ming Abiezer,
Hushath ming Sibbekai, Ahohi ming Ilai,
Netofah ming Maharai, Netofah ming Baanah sacapaa Heled,
Benjamin phang Gibeah ming Ribai sacapaa Ithai, Pirathon ming Benaiah,
Gaash cavaata ruo ming Hurai, Arbath ming Abiel,
Baharum ming Azmaveth, Shaalbon ming Eliahba,
Gizon ming Hashem, Harari ming Shagee sacapaa Jonathan,
Harari ming Sakhar sacapaa Elifal,
Mekherath ming Hefer, Pelon ming Ahijah,
Karmel ming Hezro, Ezbai sacapaa Naarai,
Nathan nuta Joel, Hagri sacapaa Mibhar,
Ammon ming Zelek, Beeroth ming Naharai, Zeruiah sacapaa Joab cehre a cyituvpa,
Ithri ming Ira, Ithri ming Gareb,
Hit ming Uriah, Ahlai sacapaa Zabad,
Reuben phang Shiza ming sacapaa Adina, ama'a lie a awpa Reuben ming sawthung luochiytuv,
Maakah sacapaa Hanan, hne Mithni ming Joshafat,
Ashterath ming Uzzia, Aroer ming Hotham sacapaa tie Shama hne Jeiel,
Tiz ming Shimri sacapaa Jediael hne a nuta Joha,
