Mahav ming Eliel, hne Elnaam sacapaa tie Jeribai hne Joshaviah, hne Moab ming Ithmah,
Mezoba ming Eliel, hne Obed, hne Jaasiel zaw ta ama cuo.

Kish sacapaa Saul kawlieta duvkhing ta aa khie khu li ningta Ziklag lie David'a luo a vawpa tie ca a rawluo haa hing tana ama cuo; rietuvna chunglie ama a byatuv a thaaruvpa tie hrawlie a aw rapa tana ama cuo.
Iema ca liy hne thi ka cuose, pahie pata alung ka cuose, cavyi cacuo ta a thepa, Benjamin phang Saul tieriy ta ama cuo.
Byi ta a cuopa ca Ahiezer, cakhutaata Joash, ama pahning ta Gibeah ming Shemaah sacapaa tie ta ama cuo; Azmaveth sacapaa tie Jeziel hne Pelet zaw; Berakah, Anathoth ming Jehu,
Gibeon ming Ishmaiah, ama ca sawthung tie hrawlie a thaaruvpa ta cuo te, sawthung tie luochiytuv ta a cuo; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, Gederah ming Jozabad,
Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, Haruf ming Shefatiah,
Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, hne Korah ming Jashobeam,
cakhutaata Gedor ming Jeroham sacapaa Joelah hne Zebadiah.

Gad ming chungtaata a thaaruv te a thesapa rieka tie, phya hne asyi hmuo a thesapa, ama hmie ca chingde hmie lu te tluocung sasuv haata aa ruo a catlipa tie ca ruocaapa chung cariekyikuo chunglie David'a luo kha ama cakuo.
Byi a cuopa Ezer, a pahningnapa Obadiah, a pathungnapa Eliab,
a papaliynapa Mishmannah, a papangaanapa Jeremiah,
a pacaruvnapa Attai, a pasariynapa Eliel,
a pacarinapa Johanan, a pacakynapa Elzabad,
a pahraanapa Jeremiah, a hlyikhanapa Makbannai.
Hingpa Gad ming hing riekabyi tie ta cuo yi te, a cawpa ta cawsaa zakha, a le cepa ta cawsaa zahning ama uv.
Hingpa tie hing thla khana thlaa lie Jordan cavaa a kaw bangkhuo bikaluv khata a lang ningta vaa tepa tie, hne capa bawphie lie ningchiy ningtla ta a awpa tie bangkhuo a cade diytuv ta ama cuo.
Benjamin ming chekha hne Judah ming chekha kha cariekyikuo luo, David'a luo kha amaa vaw.

David ca iema a taw riypa khata pya te, “Kama'a luo kha viesaa cuona hne namaa vaw kieca, naa bya ung la, i palung ca niema hne biepuo pata a cuo aa; cuorasala i kuv ta a cuo lipa khaapahmuo a tue li raalaa pata i carie tie'a luo kama lyi riypata namaa vaw kieca, ma mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing ta ca hmung yi sala bie ca chipa mang yi sue,” a ta yi.

Cakhutaata Sawthung tie byi Amasai'a luo kha thlaapa a zuv te, “Kiema ca nama huopa tana ma cuo, Vya David; Vya Jesse sacapaa, nama hne tana ma cuo. Diena, diena ca nama'a lie aw mang sue, diena ca nama caa byatuv'a lie aw mang sue! Tahematapakieca na Khazing ca nama caa byatuv tana a cuo,” a ta. Cakhutaata David ta cuhluo yi te, iema ca a riekabyi ta a tue yi.

David ta Saul a du riypata Filistin ming hne ama vya si ning kha Manasseh ming chekha ta ama kha amaa vya hlaw. (Ama ta Filistin ming kha a bya va yi, tahematapakieca Filistin uvtuv tie kha bie a rue yi te, “A byipaapa Saul'a luo a ruo'a te kiema kha malie lyi'a kie,” ta yi te ama kha ama pakaa.)
Ziklag luo a si ning kha hingpa Manasseh tie hingta amaa vya hlaw pata na a cuo.
David ta ama a vya tuvpa tie aa dupa yi kha iema ca ta amaa bya, tahematapakieca iema ca rieka chunglie a thaaruvpa hne riekabyi ta ama cuo.
Ningting ta ama a bya riypa cawsaa kha David'a luo ca a vaw yi te, Khazing riekaphuv haa khata riekaphuv lesa pata amaa li.
Abyipabie haata, Saul pena ca David kha pi riypata David'a luo, Hebron luo a vawpa, cehre a patuvpa riekaphuv ca hing haa hing tana ama cuo.
Phya hne asyi a patuvpa Judah cawsaa riekaphuv ca thawcaruv zacari ta ama cuo.
Simeon ming, a thaaruvpa rieka, thawsariy zacaruv.
Levi ming thawpaliy zacaruv.
Aaron ingchungkhue luochiytuv Jehoiada hne ama hne a awpa thawthung zasariy.
Mingnuta a thaaruvpa Zadok hne a mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue taata riekabyi pakiy pahning.
Benjamin ming chungtaata, Saul tieriy tie, thawthung, ahluo ta ca a hluv vie ca Saul ingchungkhue khana amaa zaa daakhyi.
Efraim ming chungtaata, a thaaruvpa rieka, a mingchingmingvuo tie ingchungkhue lie a ming pathuopa tie thawkiy zacari.
Manasseh phang khingkhuo, David kha siepahruo ta tue riypata ming ripa tie thawhraa hlyicari.
Issakhar ming chungtaata, cuo a pachangpa hne Israel ta khaapama a tue riypata a cuo ta pata a pachangpa byi zahning hne iema ri a ngiepa ama tieriy tie.
Zebulun ming chungtaata, David a bya riypata atingna suokha hneta rietuvna cehre a cyi yi te, a pacaw pacie pata a awpa thawsawngaa.
Naftali chungtaata, riebyi thawkha, hne iema hneta a awpa phya hne asyi a cyipa thawsawthung thawsariy.
Dan ming chungtaata, rietuvna cehre a cyipa thawkiy thawcari zacaruv.
Asher chungtaata, rietuv riypata a pacaw pacie pata a awpa rieka thawsawliy,
Jordan huesuoluo kuo ta a awpa Reuben ming hne Gad ming hne Manasseh phang khingkhuo chungtaata, rietuvna cehre a tlingsa pata a cyipa thawzakha thawkiy.

Hingpa tie bangkhuo, rietuvna luo si riypata a pacaw pacie pata a awpa tie ca Israel ming cunglie David kha siepahruo ta tue riypata a tlingpa atingna hne Hebron luo kha amaa vaw; cahaa ngiethie cata aa ngaapa Israel ming bangkhuo zaw ca David kha siepahruo ta tue riypata palung a lusa pata ama aw.
Iema ca David'a lie kha ning thung aw yi te, ama ning ama dang, tahematapakieca ama tieriy tie khata ama ring.

Cakhutaata ama ingpaa tie zaw khata, Issakhar hne Zebulun hne Naftali ruo lie a awpa tie te khata, laa kaapie, kala-uv, aruo, cuetungpa zaw khata sa hne ning riypa phangting, a caapa thyikuv hlung, mingsuv baw caapa tie, mingsuvtiy, chiytiy, cuetungpa, hne tuv zaw kha ama vya phya, tahematapakieca Israel ruo chungliena alawna a aw.
David ta a thaw ta a uvpa riekabyi, a za ta a uvpa riekabyi hne luochiytuv mekaa kha bie aa rue yi.

David ta Israel ming aa hmyapa bangkhuo kyihuo khata, “Niema ta a pha ta pata rue ung cate, ma Khazing, Abyipakhingna ta a cuo kieca, Israel ruo chung bangkhuo lie aa ngaa kaliepa ma tieriy bangkhuo, hne sahring tlena ruo a hnyipa khypuv tie lieta tluobyi tie hne Levi ming bangkhuo kha kiema'a luo a vya hmya riypata u ung siy.
Cakhutaata ma Khazing biekuona thingkaw kha kiema'a luo vya phya pakhaa ung siy; tahematapakieca Saul chuo ning khata cahaacata za tue vapuv,” a ta yi.
Aa hmyapa bangkhuo ta cahaacata tue riypa ca ama palung a tling, tahematapakieca capa ca ta cawsaa bangkhuo kha ama palung a patluo yi.
Caacuonakawta David ta Izipt ruo Shihor cavaa taata Lebo-hamath te lie a awpa Israel ming bangkhuo kha Kiriath-jearim taata Abyipa biekuona thingkaw kha vya palaw riypata a pahmya yi.

Cakhutaata David hne Israel ming bangkhuo ca Baalah luo kha ama sithaw, capa ca Judah ming huopa ta a cuopa Kiriath-jearim khata a cuo; cherubim tie cunglie a tupa Abyipaming ta kupa Khazing biekuona thingkaw kha capa taa cata palaw riypata a cuo.
Iema ta Abinadab ing taa khata Khazing biekuona thingkaw ca cuele thaapa ta ama vya phya; Uzzah hne Ahio ta cuele thaapa ca ama maw.
David hne Israel ming bangkhuo ca hlaa sa yi te, tingtuo, tingtuolepa, hne karuv-akhang hne chaaraa hne hmyakaa tung yi te, Khazing hmiekunglie kha ama thaa a aw zawdya ta ama luo.
Khidon suo-aciyna ama va pha tiyta, cuetungpa tie ta ama cahang nakawta Uzzah ta biekuona thingkaw kha patuv riypata a kuv ta a va paza.
Abyipahihaana ca Uzzah cunglie kha ie te biekuona thingkaw kha a hrie nakawta thie te, capa lie ca Khazing hmiekunglieta a thiy.
Abyipata Uzzah cunglie a hihaana a paluo sa nakawta David ca a hi haa te, capa hmang ca ataning tepa hingta Perez-uzzah ta pata a cuo.
Capa ning lie ca David ta Khazing kha ciy te, “Tuokhaatama Khazing biekuona thingkaw hing kama'a luo i sikhyi khu aa?” a ta.
Caacuonakawta David ta biekuona thingkaw kha David khypuv chung luo a ngiekhyi cuo pata, Git ming Obed-edom ing luo kha a sikhyi.
Khazing biekuona thingkaw ca Obed-edom ingchungkhue hne khata a ing chunglie kha thla thung chung a aw; cakhutaata Abyipata Obed-edom ingchungkhue hne a hnyipa bangkhuo kha thluechiy a pi.
Tair siepahruo Hiram ta David'a luo kha biephyatuv pathlie te, a cuota ing sapa riypata sidar thing zaw, pazan tie zaw, lettamaa tie zaw kha a paphya.
Cakhutaata David ta Abyipata Israel ming cunglie siepahruo cuo riypata ina pacu sa tli tapa hne a cawsaa Israel ming thueta i pena ca cyicalang pata a cuo tli, tapa kha a pachang.
David ta Jerusalem lie kha napuv hnyi chiy vie te sacanung sacapaa a hluv vie hryly ta a hnyi.
Hingpa tie hing Jerusalem lieta a hnyipa a saata tie ming ta a cuo: Shammua, Shobab, hne Nathan; Solomon,
Ibhar, Elishua, hne Elpelet;
Nogah, Nefeg, hne Jafia;
Elishama, Beeliada, hne Elifelet.

Filistin ming ta Israel ming siepahruo cuo riypa tana David kha sathu ama pathuv tli tapa ama thyi tiyta, Filistin ming bangkhuo ca David huv riypa khata ama sithaw; David ta capa ca a thyi tiyta iema a du riypata a pya.
Filistin ming ta a vaw yi te, Refaim bawphie kha tlangkhy ama vya tuv.

David ta Khazing kyihuo khata, “Filistin ming a du riypata i sithaw'a ma? Iema kha i kuv chung luo ina pi'a ca ma?” ta pata a hiehriy. Abyipata, “Sithaw tie, iema kha na kuv chung luo ica pi aa,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta David ca Baal-perazim luo kha sithaw te capa lie ca iema kha a te yi. David ta, “Tiyle ta a suvpathla diypa haa tana Khazing ta kama kuv hmuo pata i carie tie kha a suvpathla diy yi,” a ta. Caacuonakawta capa hmang ca Baal-perazim ama ta.
Capa lie ca ama khazing tie kha ama thuse diy, David nawpina ta myi ta ama rue.
Filistin ming ta bawphie lie kha ama vya tuv pakhaa hyi.
David ta Khazing kha bie a hiehriy pakhaa tiyta, Khazing ta, “A kya cade'a va yi ciy; cahlung la balsam kung awnapa taa khata vya pyahnue tie yi.
Balsam kung zaw dawlie rieduna pu kha na thyi tiyta, rie du riypa khata pya tie, tahematapakieca Khazing na Filistin rieka tie thie riypata nama hmiekunglieta a pya tli,” a ta.
David ta Khazing nawpina haa khata a tue, cakhutaata Filistin rieka tie kha Gibeon taata Gezer te a thie yi.
David ca ruo bangkhuo khata a ming pathuo te, Abyipata mingphang bangkhuo cunglieta ama ciyna kha a patlung sa.
David ta ama cuota David khypuv lie kha ing sa te, Khazing biekuona thingkaw cuo khata hmang suokha a tlaw te thluodaa a daapa.

Cakhutaata David ta, Levi ming ta li pata ca ahungtahmuo Khazing biekuona thingkaw kha a puv khah yi se, tahematapakieca Abyipana iema kha Abyipabiekuona thingkaw a puv riypa hne chuozaa ta a re hrie riypata a tlaw yi, a ta.
Abyipabiekuona thingkaw ca a cuota a parepa hmang luo sikhyi riypata David ta Israel ming bangkhuo kha a pahmya yi.
Cakhutaata David ta Aaron ciypathla tie hne Levi ming kha pahmya yi te:
Kohath sacapaa zaw chungtaata, luv ta a cuopa Uriel hne a tieriy zakha pakiy;
Merari sacapaa zaw chungtaata luv ta a cuopa Asaiah hne a tieriy zakha sawthung;
Gershom sacapaa zaw chungtaata luv ta a cuopa Joel hne a tieriy zakha sawthung;
Elizafan sacapaa zaw chungtaata luv ta a cuopa Shemaiah hne a tieriy zahning;
Hebron sacapaa zaw chungtaata luv ta a cuopa Eliel hne a tieriy sawcari;
Uzziel sacapaa zaw chungtaata luv ta a cuopa Amminadab hne a tieriy zakha pahraa hlyihning.
David ta tluobyi Zadok hne Abiathar, hne Levi ming Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, hne Amminadab kha a ku yi.
Iema kyihuo khata, “Niema hing Levi ming ingchungkhue tie luv ta nama cuo; a cuota i parepa hmang luo Khazing biekuona thingkaw sikhyi riypata niema hne nama tieriy tie hne khata a pathe tie ung.
A yikhana lie kha namaa puv li nakawta hne a phasa pata nama ysy li nakawta Abyipaima Khazing kha kiema cunglie a hi a haa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Israel ming Khazing, Abyipabiekuona thingkaw kha sikhyi riypata tluobyi tie hne Levi ming ca amaa pathe.
Cakhutaata Moses ta Abyipabie haata naw a pina haa yi khata Levi ming ta Khazing biekuona thingkaw kha aluo ta, ama letung ta amaa puv.

David ta Levi ming luv a cuopa tie kha, tungpa chechiy ta a cuopa tingtuolepa hne tingtuo hne chaaraa a tung riypa, hne anuona hlaa khuosa ta a satuv riypata ama tieriy zaw kha re pi riypata naw a pi yi.
Caacuonakawta Levi ming ta Joel sacapaa Heman; a tieriy ta a cuopa Berekhiah sacapaa Asaf; ama tieriy ta a cuopa Merari sacapaa zaw chungtaata Kushaiah sacapaa Ethan;

cakhutaata iema hneta ama uvnu hyipa ta a cuopa, Zekhariah, Jaaziel Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Elifelehu, hne Mikneiah, hne thlake a huopa tie Obed-edom hne Jeiel zaw kha re ama pi ra.
Hlaa a satuv Heman, Asaf hne Ethan ca chaaraa a tung riypata ama cuo;
Zekhariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, hne Benaiah ca Alamoth ue ta tingtuolepa a tungtuv riypata ama cuo;
cuorasala Mattithiah, Elifelehu, Mikneiah, Abed-edom, Jeiel, hne Azaziah ca Sheminith ue ta tingtuo a tungtuv riypata ama cuo.
Hlaa luo ta Levi ming luochiytuv Chenaniah ca hlaa a the nakawta hlaahryituv ta a cuo.
Berekhiah hne Elkanah ca biekuona thingkaw thlake a huotuv ta ama cuo aa.
Shebaniah, Joshafat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zekhariah, Benaiah, hne Eliezer, tluobyi tie, ca Khazing biekuona thingkaw hmielie hmyakaa a tungtuv riypata ama cuo aa.
Caacuonakawta David hne Israel ming uvthyi tie hne a thaw uvtuv riekabyi tie ca Abyipabiekuona thingkaw kha Obed-edom ing taa khata palung tluosa pata phyathaw riypata ama si.
Cakhutaata Abyipabiekuona thingkaw a puvpa Levi ming kha Khazing ta aa bya nakaw yi ta, iema ta cuetungpa sa sariy hne tuvtungpa sa sariy ta hriykhungrina ama pihluo.

David ca palaa phapa ta taapa buohryi pasiypa kha aa hryi, biekuona thingkaw a puvpa Levi ming, hlaa a satuv tie, hlaahryituv Chenaniah zaw kha cahaacata amaa hryi ra; cakhutaata David ca palaa phapa ta taapa tluobyi buohryi kha aa hryi.
Caacuonakawta Israel ming bangkhuo ta Abyipabiekuona thingkaw ca saakiy, hmyakaa, chaaraa, tingtuolepa hne tingtuo tungpuo pata hlaasana hne khi-upuo pata ama kya sikhyi.

Abyipabiekuona thingkaw David khypuv luo a kya sithaw ning kha, Saul sacanung Mikhal ta thlaluo-aw taa khata mang te, siepahruo David a cathlule te a luolepa kha a hmung ca, a palung chunglieta a huesa.
Iema ta Khazing biekuona thingkaw ca David ta a sapapa thluodaa chung luo kha a ngiekhyi yi te ama chi; cakhutaa cata Abyipahmiekunglie kha myirue panaana hne aviesaa panaana ama pihluo.
David ta myirue panaana hne aviesaa panaana a pihluo khutaata cawsaa kha Abyipaming ta thluechiy a pi yi;
cakhutaata Israel cawsaa mekaa, capaa canung aa lu pata, pakha cyicuo kha viechuo tluo kha, saa sie kha, hne mingsuv caapa hlung kha kaluo ta a re yi.
Levi ming chekha kha Israel Khazing, Abyipapathuosa riypa, palungtluona bie hluo riypa hne paakie riypata Abyipabiekuona thingkaw hmiekunglie kha rehrietuv ta a chi yi.

Asaf ca luv ce ta cuo te, ama a paziypa ta Zekhariah, Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-edom, hne Jeiel, ta cuo yi te, iema ca tingtuolepa hne tingtuo a tung riypata ama cuo. Asaf ca chaaraa a tungpa ta cuo te,
cakhutaata tluobyi Benaiah hne Jahaziel ca Khazing biekuona thingkaw hmiekunglie hmyakaa a tung pari riypata ama cuo.
Cakhutaata capa ning lie ca ta David ta Abyipa'a lie pathuosana hlaa sa riypata Asaf hne a tieriy zaw kha re a pi yi.
Abyipakha palungtluona bie hluo tie ung, a ming kha ukhyi tie ung, A tuepa hmang kha cawsaa hraw luo pathyi tie ung.
Ama'a luo kha hlaa sa tie ung, ama kha hlaa ta pathuosa tie ung, kharuehaa hmang a tuepa bangkhuo ca ri tie ung.
A ming pathepa ca rungnaa mang sue; Abyipaa huvpa pathiypalung chunglie palungtluona aw mang sue.
Abyipahne a cahrana kha huv tie ung, ama minghmie kha huv pari tie ung.
Kharuehaa aa chiypa a hmang tuena kha a thyi ung la, a tuepa kharuehaa hmang hne a biechipana zaw kha a thyi tie ung.
Vya a changtaapa Israel samingsahlaa, aa tlawpa Jakob saata zaw.
Ama ca Abyipama Khazing ta cuo te, A biechipana ca alyi cung yalya cuota a cuo.
A biekuona kha chuozaa ta a thyi ung la, a biepina kha chuo thawkha te ta a thyi tie ung.
Abraham hneta a tuepa biekuona, Isak'a lieta chiesana ta bie aa kuopa,
Jakob'a lieta phungluo haata a pacu sapa ca, Israel'a lie kha chuozaa biekuona haata pacu sa te,
“Kanaan ruo ca nama na cuvu hne ru ta ica pi aa,” a ta.
Mingluv ta ama cawsa ning, ruo chunglie khyche ta ama za cuo ning,
ruo kha hnang ruo kha, pe kha hnang pe kha ta amaa zaa khie ning kha,
iema hrisaa riypa kha ahunghmuo pa-aw va yi; iema kawlieta siepahruo zaw kha chuo yi te,
“Kama ta sathu i pathuvpa tie hing taw khah ung; i profet tie hing ruvnaana pi khah ung,” a ta.
Alyi ming bangkhuo ta Abyipaca hlaa ta pathuosa tie ung, a khuona kaw kha ning kha hnang ning kha ta phu tie ung.
A rungnaana ca mingphang zaw hrawlie kha pathyi sa ung la, nang-uo aa chiypa a hmang tuena kha cawsaa bangkhuo'a luo pathyi sa tie ung.
Tahematapakieca Abyipaca a lesyipa ta cuo te, khuosa ta pathuosa riypa tana a cuo; khazing bangkhuo hrawlieta ciyzaa ce riypa tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca cawsaa zaw khazing bangkhuo ca kuvtuezuv ta cuo yi te, cuorasala Abyipata avuo kha a sa.
Pa-uvsathyina hne lesyina ca a hmiekunglie aw te, cahrana hne palungtluona ca ama'a liena a aw.
Vya cawsaa zaw chungkhue tie, Abyipakha pi tie ung, rungnaana hne cahrana ca Abyipakha pi tie ung.
Abyipaca a ming hne aa tlapa rungnaana kha pi ung la, pihluo riypa kha a vya cyi ung la a hmiekung luo kha a vaw tie ung. Abyipaca a pathe rungnaana chunglieta abie ung la,
alyi bangkhuo ta a hmiekunglie kha a cathang tie ung. Chuelyi ca a cusa pata patu pata a cuo; khatiy tahmuo hnyi pata cuo'a vyi.
Avuo zaw ca a law sala, alyi ca a palung tluo se, mingphang zaw hrawlie kha, “Abyipaca siepahruo tana a cuo,” ta yi se.
Riyliy hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo ta khi yi sala, ruo hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo ta cyicalang yi se.
Cakhutaata atuv chunglie thingkung zaw ta, Abyipahmiekunglie palungtluona hlaa sa yi se, tahematapakieca alyi bieripa riypa tana aa vaw.
Abyipakha palungtluona hluo tie ung, tahematapakieca ama ca a pha; a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.

“Vya malie a khuotuv Khazing, kiema hing malie khuo la, mingphang zaw hraw taa hingta malie pahmya la, na ming pathepa kha maca pathuosa riypa hne, na rungnaana kha maca pathuosa riypata malie khuo tie.
Abyipa, Israel ming Khazing ca, chuozaa taata chuozaa te thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue,” ta tie ung. Cakhutaata cawsaa bangkhuo ta, “Amen!” ta yi te Abyipakha ama pathuosa.
David ta Asaf hne a tieriy tie kha capa lie, Abyipabiekuona thingkaw hmiekunglie ca, ningting ta aa huna haata re hrie pari riypata a chisiy yi,
cakhutaata Obed-edom hne a tieriy sawcaruv pacari tie zaw kha a chisiy ra yi; Jeduthun sacapaa Obed-edom hne Hosah ca thlake a huo riypa tana ama cuo.
Cakhutaata tluobyi Zadok hne a tieriy tluobyi tie kha Gibeon lie a awpa khahrungtluobu cunglieta Abyipabienathluodaa lie kha a chisiy yi.

Abyipata Israel ming bie a pipa yi phungbie chunglie aa capepa bangkhuo haata, iema ta maw hne zuoluo ta bienatluophie cunglie kha Abyipa'a luo myirue panaana ama pihluo pari riypata a chisiypa yi ta a cuo.
Abyipaaa hmangpa a duena ca chuozaa cuota a cuo nakawta, iema hne cata Heman hne Jeduthun, hne Abyipa'a luo alawna bie hluo riypata a tlawpa hne ama ming ri pata pachipa aa ngaapa tie kha ama aw.
Heman hne Jeduthun ta hlaasana lie tung riypata hmyakaa hne chaaraa kha hnyi yi te, hlaa pathepa cuo khata hlaasana chechiy kha ama hnyi. Jeduthun sacapaa tie kha thlake huo riypata re ama pi.
Cakhutaata cawsaa bangkhuo ca ama ing luo kha a diy yi te, David ca a ingchungkhue tie thluechiy pi riypata a ing luo aa diy.
David ca a ing lie kha a aw, catiyta, David ta profet Nathan kyihuo khata, “Kama ca sidar thing ing chunglieta aw angte, cuorasala Abyipabiekuona thingkaw ca thluodaa rawlieta a aw,” a ta.
Nathan ta David kyihuo khata, “Na palung chunglie a awpa haa khata tue tie, tahematapakieca Khazing ca nama'a liena a aw,” a ta.
Cuorasala capa zuo lie ca ta Abyipabie ca Nathan'a luo kha a zuv te:
Cakuo la i changtaapa David kha chang tie: Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: I awna riypata ing na sapa'a vaciy.
Tahematapakieca Israel kha i vya pyakhyi taata ataning tepa hingta ing chunglie aw va ang, cuorasala suv kha taata suv kha luo a palawlepa thluodaa chunglie hne bienathluodaa liena i za aw.

Israel bangkhuo hne i khiena hmang bangkhuo lie kha, i cawsaa zaw mangchiy riypata bie i pipa Israel ming bieripatuv tie'a lie kha, “Khaapanakawma sidar ing ina sapa va ung ciy, ta pata bie kaa kha chuo i za ri buo ma?

Caacuonakawta ata hingta i changtaapa David kha hing haa hingta va chang tie: Cungnungce Abyipana: Nama ca i cawsaa Israel ming cunglie uvtuv cuo riypa tana tuv na khienapa ruo chung taa khata ica la;
cakhutaata na cakuona mekaa lie kha ca awpuo angte, na carie tie bangkhuo kha na hmiekung taata i pahli diy yi; cakhutaata alyi lie cawsaa lesyipa haata ming lesyipa ica sapa aa.
I cawsaa Israel ming cuota hmang suokha tue'a angte, ahungtahmuo hnaa ama va pahnaw li riypa hne cawsaa chiepa tie ta riethyi ama pi li riypata capa iema hmangta lie ca chi'a yi angte ama aw aa.

Hluo ning i cawsaa Israel ming cunglie bieripatuv i za chi ning haa yi khata nama carie tie bangkhuo kha nama kuv rawlie ica chipa diy'a yi. Ca hlyitaw taata Abyipata nama ca Abyipa na ing suokha caa sapa aa ta pata ica pathyi sa.
Na mingchingmingvuo tie'a luo aw riypata na ning kha a tling tiyta, nama lehnang khata na samingsahlaa, nama sacapaa zaw chungtaata pakha kha a chuo pathu sa'a angte a pena kha i pacu sa aa.
Ama ta kama cuota ing suokha sa'a te a byithude kha chuozaa ta i pacu sa aa.
Kama ca a paa ta cuo'a angte, ama ca i sacapaa ta a cuo aa. Nama hluota zaa awpa'a taata aa hmangpa i duena kha i za lapa haata ama'a taata la'a va ang.
Cuorasala i ing lie hne i pena lie ama kha chuozaa ta pacu sa'a angte, a byithude ca chuozaa ta i pacu sa aa.
Hingpa bie haata hne hingpa muocuo haa hingta, Nathan ta David'a lie kha a ri.

Cakhutaata Siepahruo David ca a chung luo kha a ngie te, Abyipahmiekunglie kha a tu te, “Vya AbyipaKhazing, kama hing ahung ta cuo angte ma i ingchungkhue zaw hing khaapata ama cuo nakawta hingpa te hingta inaa chiy ciy?

Cakhutaata nama hmungna lie ca hingpa hmang hing hmuo a cawta tana a cuo, Vya Khazing; na changtaapa ingchungkhue kaw zaw hing hmieluo cuo pasiypuv cuo te ta na rilu tli. Vya AbyipaKhazing, kama hing aa suopuv tana ina rue de ciy!
Na changtaapa pa-uvsathyina pi riypa hingta David ta nama'a lie kha khaapa bie ma a ri vie the'a tli?
Vya Khazing, na sacapaa cuota hne nama palung thu ta hingpa hmang lepuv bangkhuo pachang sa riypa hingta, nama ta hing hmang lepuv hing na tue tli.
Vya Abyipa, ma naa ta ma thyina bangkhuo lie hing nama haapa pakha hmuo aw va yi.

Khazing ta a cawsaa cuo riypa hne a thla riypata sihning yi te, a lepa hne ciy aa chiypa hmang kha na cuota paluo sa riypata, Izipt taata naa thlapa na cawsaa zaw hmiekung taata iema cuota mingphang tie naa cadepa yi na cawsaa Israel ming haapa hing, alyi lieta mingphang phang kha chuo ama aw ma?
Cakhutaata na cawsaa Israel ming hing chuozaa ta na cawsaa cuo riypata na tue yi; cakhutaata Vya Abyipa, nama ca iema Khazing ta na cuo.
Cakhutaata ata hing ca, Vya Abyipa, na changtaapa kawlie hne a ingchungkhue kawlieta na za ripa bie kha chuozaa ta pacu sapa cuo sala, bie na kuopa haa khata tue tie.

Cahaacata, ‘Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing ca Israel Khazing tana a cuo,’ tapa bie haa khata na ming ca chuozaa pacu sa pata cuo sala; na changtaapa David ingchungkhue ca na hmiekunglie pacu sa pata cuo mang sue.
Tahematapakieca nama, i Khazing ta ingchungkhue suokha sapa riypata na changtaapa'a lie kha naa luo tli, caacuonakawta na changtaapa ta na hmiekunglie thlaa a chuo nguo.
Cakhutaata ata hing, Vya Abyipa, nama ca Khazing ta cuo cate, nama ta hingpa hmang phapa hing na changtaapa'a lie bie na kuo tli.

Caacuonakawta na changtaapa ingchungkhue hing na hmiekunglie chuozaa aa hmang riypata thluechiy pi thi tie. Tahematapakieca Vya Abyipa, nama ta thluechiy na pi tlipa ca chuozaa ta thluechiypa tana ama cuo.
Cuo pachangta khutaata, David ta Filistin ming kha tuv yi te a te yi; Filistin tie'a taa khata Gath hne a khyta tie kha a la yi.
Moab kha a te, cakhutaata Moab ming ca a kuv raw cawsaa ta cuo yi te ngukhyi ama pi.
David ta Zufrates cavaa lie lungbang bang riypata a sipa khata Zobah Siepahruo Hadadezer zaw kha a te.
David ta ama'a taa khata aruole thawkha, aruo rieka thawsariy, hne phyi rieka thawkiy a la. David ta le a dapa aruo bangkhuo kha a cazaa thariy sapachung diy te, zakha dyi a pangaa.
Damaskas khy lie a awpa Siria ming ta Zobah siepahruo Hadadezer kha a bya riypata amaa vaw tiyta, David ta Siria ming ca thawkiy thawhning a thie yi.

Cakhutaata David ta Siria ruo Damaskas khy lie kha khy a huopa riekaphuv chi yi te, cakhutaa cata Siria ming ca David uvpa cawsaa ta cuo yi te ngukhyi ama pi. Abyipata David kha a sina bangkhuo lie thluechiy a pi.
David ta Hadadezer changtaapa tie ta amaa cyipa siy ta tuepa phya zaw kha la te, Jerusalem luo a phyale.
Hadadezer a khypuv ta a cuopa Tibhath hne Kun taa khata David ta daa a hluv hringhruo a la; capa ca hmuo pata Solomon ta daa rahunglepa hne a tung tie hne daa biphie zaw kha a tue.
David na Zobah siepahruo Hadadezer hne a rieka bangkhuo kha a te yi ta pata Hamath siepahruo Tou ta a thyi tiyta,

a sacapaa Hadoram kha bie a chang riypa hne palung tluokhyi riypata Siepahruo David'a luo kha a pathlie, tahematapakieca David ta Hadadezer kha a du te a te. Hadadezer ca Tou hne khata rie amaa zaa du taw pari. Ama ta siy ta tuepa chechiy phangting, ngu ta tuepa chechiy phangting hne daa ta tuepa chechiy phangting kha a paphya;

capa chechiy tie zaw ca Siepahruo David ta a tepa mingphang bangkhuo tie, Edom, Moab, Ammon ming, Filistin ming, hne Amalek taata a lapa siy hne ngu zaw hne khata suv kha ta Abyipa'a luo kha a pihluo.
Zeruiah sacapaa Abishai ta Edom ming thawhraa hlyicari kha Paciy bawphie lieta a thie yi.
Ama ta Edom lie kha khy a huopa riekaphuv a chi yi; cakhutaa cata Edom ming bangkhuo ca David uvpa cawsaa ta ama cuo. Cahaacata Abyipata David ca a sina bangkhuo lie kha thluechiy a pi.
Caacuonakawta David ca Israel ming bangkhuo cunglie kha siepahruo cuo te, a cawsaa zaw bangkhuo kha biedangpa hne aa khing aa nguosa pata a uv yi.
Zeruiah sacapaa Joab ca riekabyi le cepa ta a cuo; Ahilud sacapaa Jehoshafat ca cazing khungtuv ta a cuo;
Ahitub sacapaa Zadok hne Abiathar sacapaa Ahimelek ca tluobyi ta ama cuo; Shavsha ca caacapetuv ta a cuo.
Jehoiada sacapaa Benaiah ca Khereth ming hne Peleth ming uvtuv ta cuo te, David sacapaa zaw ca siepahruo re lieta byi ta ama cuo.
Cuo pachangta khutaata, Ammon siepahruo Nahash ca thiy te a sacapaa ta aa thle.

David ta, “Nahash sacapaa Hanun a paa ta kama cunglie zang tluo aa tlasa pata a za aw nakawta a cunglie zang tluo aa tlasa pata na i aw ra aa,” a ta. Caacuonakawta David ta a paa kawlieta ama kha hnaa panguo riypata biephyatuv a pathlie yi. David changtaapa tie kha Ammon ruo Hanun luo ama va pha tiyta,

Ammon byi tie ta Hanun kyihuo khata, “David hing na paa pa-uvsathyina tana nama'a luo hnaa panguotuv a vya pathlie yi ta pata na rue ma? A changtaapa tie hing ruo awtuvzya pachang riypa hne pahli riypa hne a ngiepatlie riypa tana nama'a luo amaa vaw cuo va ma?” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Hanun ta David changtaapa tie kha patuv yi te, ama hmyahming kha a ngu yi; ama caw kha ama lakaw a dadaw lieta tepa yi te a pathlie yi; cakhutaata ama si.

David kha a cawsaa zaw kaw ca ama chang tiyta, iema'a luo kha biephyatuv a pathlie yi, tahematapakieca iema ca khuosa ta ama nang a zaa. Siepahruo ta, “Na ma hmyahming a syi pakhana te Jeriko lie kha aw ung la, cakhutaa cata nama vya kaa aa,” a ta yi.

Ammon ming ta David tlechuo li riypa tana iema'a na iema kha maa tue tli tapa ama hmung tiyta, Hanun hne Ammon ming ca ta Mesopotamia hne Aram-maakah hne Zobah taata aruole hne aruo rieka tie a hluo riypata ngu talen thawkha ama paphya.

Iema ta aruole thawsawthung thawhning hne Maakah siepahruo kha a rieka tie hneta a hluo yi te, Medeba athaalie kha amaa ri. Cakhutaata Ammon ming ca ama khypuv tie taa khata a pahmya yi te rie tuv riypata ama pya.
David ta capa ca a thyi tiyta Joab hne a thaaruvpa rieka bangkhuo kha a pathlie yi.
Ammon ming ca pya yi te khypuv luo a ngienapa lie kha rietuv riypata adaahmang ama la, cakhutaata a bya riypata a vawpa siepahruo tie ca iemata tah ruo chunglie ca ama aw.
Joab ta hmieluo hne hnangluo taa tana ina tuv'a yi tapa kha a hmung tiyta, Israel ming a tlaw pa-ipa chekha kha la yi te Siria ming a du riypa khata adaahmang a pala sa yi.
Aa ngaapa rieka tie kha a nuta Abishai ta uv yi te, iema ca Ammon ming a du riypa khata adaahmang ama la.
Ama ta, “Siria ming hing i cuota ama cahra tuv kieca nama ta naa bya'a cate, cuorasala Ammon ming kha na cuota ama cahra tuv kieca kama ta icaa bya aa.
Cahra tie, ma cawsaa zaw cuo hne ma Khazing khypuv zaw cuo hingta ma rie pha se; Abyipata a pha a tapa kha tue thluo se,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Joab hne a rieka tie ca Siria ming kha tuv taa paluo yi te, iema ca ama hmiekung taa cata amaa ruo.
Ammon ming ta Siria ming amaa ruopa kha ama hmung tiyta, iema zaw Joab uvnupa Abishai hmiekung taa khata amaa ruo ra. Cakhutaata Joab ca Jerusalem luo kha aa ngie.

Cuorasala Siria ming ta Israel ming na malie a te yi tapa kha ama hmung tiyta, biephyatuv tie kha pathlie yi te, Zufrates cavaa huesuo ruo lie a awpa Siria ming, Hadadezer riekabyilepa Shofak ta a uvpa tie kha ama vya chiykhyi.

David kha thuo ama pathyi tiyta, Israel ming bangkhuo kha pahmya yi te, Jordan cavaa kha va te te, iema'a luo kha va pha te riedu riypata a rieka tie ca adaahmang a pala sa yi. David ta Siria ming ca a tuv tiy yi ta, iema ta ama tuv ra.
Siria ming ca Israel ming hmiekung taa khata amaa ruo; David ta Siria ming aruole rieka thawsariy hne phyi rieka thawsawliy thie yi te, ama riekabyilepa Shofak zaw kha a thie.

Hadadezer changtaapa tie ta Israel ming na malie a te yi tapa kha ama hmung tiyta, David hneta arena tue yi te a uvpa cawsaa ta amaa li. Caacuonakawta Siria ming ta Ammon ming kha a bya pakhaa khing va tli yi.

Cuovuo vya chiy te, siepahruo tie rietuv riypata ama pya taw cuo ning kha, Joab ca rieka tie kha sikhyi yi te, Ammon ming ruo kha para yi te, cakhutaata a vaw yi te Rabbah kha ama cadung. Cuorasala David ca Jerusalem lie kha a aw. Joab ta Rabbah kha tuv te a te.

David ta Milkom byilakhuv kha a luv cung taata a la; talen suokha a riy te a chunglie lungvaa muosungpa a awpa kha a hmung; cakhutaata capa ca David kha ama pakhuv. Cakhutaata ama ta khypuv hruosue zaw kha papya te, a hluv hringhruo.

A chunglie a awpa cawsaa zaw kha papya yi te, hluo hne atuv hne ahryi ta re a pahrie sa yi. Cahaacata David ta Ammon khypuv bangkhuo zaw kha a tue yi. Cakhutaata David hne a cawsaa bangkhuo ca Jerusalem luo kha ama kaa.
Capa khutaa cata, Filistin ming hneta Gezer lieta rie amaa tuv; cakhutaata Hushath ming Sibbekai ta cawsaa lesapa ciypathla ta a cuopa Sippai kha thie te Filistin ming ca ama te.
Filistin ming hne rie a duna vya aw pakhaa te, Jair sacapaa Elhanan ta Git ming Goliath uvnu Lahmi, aa syi sung thetluo tie a tapa kha a thie.

Gath lieta rieduna a aw pakhaa, capa lie ca a kuvdaw suocaruv hne a phyidaw suocaruv kaluo ta te, pahlaw pata suokiy suopaliy a hnyipa cawsaa lesapa pakha a aw; ama zaw hing cawsaa lesapa tie ciypathla tana a cuo.
Ama ta Israel ming kha thluhuv a sasue tiy yi ta, David uvta Shimea sacapaa Jonathan ta a thie.
Hingpa tie hing Gath lieta cawsaa lesapa tie ciypathla ta ama cuo; iema ca David hne a changtaapa tie kuv ta ama thiy.
Setaa ta Israel kha a du te David kha Israel cawsaa mingluv ri riypata a pasu.

Caacuonakawta David ta Joab hne riekabyilepa tie kyihuo khata, “Cakuo ung la Israel ming kha Dan taata Beer-sheba te ta va ri tie ung, cakhutaata khazaa ma a ta yi tapa kha na chang tie ung,” a ta yi.

Cuorasala Joab ta, “Abyipata a cawsaa tie kha le zakha ta papung sa yi se! I byipaapa siepahruo, iema bangkhuo ca i byipaapa changtaapa ta cuo va yi ma? Khaapanakawma i byipaapa ta hingpa hing a tue khing? Khaapanakawma Israel cunglie suena a patlung sa?” a ta.
Cuorasala siepahruo bie ta Joab kha a te. Caacuonakawta Joab ca a tha te Israel ruo kha cahraw te, Jerusalem luo kha a vya kaa.

Joab ta mingluv a ripa bangkhuo kha zaa ma a ta yi tapa kha David ca a pi. Israel ming bangkhuo chungtaata zueziy a patuv khupa tinghraa hlyikha, Judah bangkhuo chungtaata zueziy a patuv khupa tingpaliy thawsawsariy ama ta.
Cuorasala siepahruo naw pipa kha Joab ta a khing li nakawta mingluv rina lie kha Levi ming hne Benjamin ming ca ripuo va yi.
Cuorasala Khazing ca hingpa hmang cunglie hing a palung a tling li nakawta Israel ming kha a thie yi.
David ta Khazing kyihuo khata, “Hingpa hmang i tuena lie hing khuosa ta i sue tli. Cuorasala ngaa angte i tue tlipa i suena kha na lapa thi tie, tapa tana paa ica kie,” a ta.
Abyipata David profetpa Gad kyihuo khata,
“Cakuo la David kha va chang tie, ‘Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Hmang suothung ca pi angte, capa chung taa cata suokha a tlaw tie, capa ca na cunglie i tue aa, a ta,’ va ta tie,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Gad ca David'a luo kha cakuo te, “Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri, ‘Na khingpa kha a tlaw tie:

kung thung chung cakuotlungna ma, acuolikie na carie tie ta thla thung chung aca para patlaa riypa yi ma, capa chunglie ca na carie tie zueziy ta nama kha aca pha aa; acuolikie ruo chunglie kha Abyipazueziy ta ning thung chung aca hrisaapa yi ma, capa ca ruo chunglie puvtlungna, Abyipaavuoming ta Israel ruo chung bangkhuo cahraw pata parana ta a cuo aa.’ Kama naa pathliepa'a luo khaapa bie ma i phyale aa tapa kha ata hingta biechina tue tie,” a ta.

Cakhutaata David ta Gad kyihuo khata, “I palung rie na a thyi hringhruo; Abyipakuv chung luo ca tla thluo lavuo puv, tahematapakieca a nangduena ca a le hringhruo; cuorasala cawsaa kuv chung luo ca tla thi khah ang se,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Abyipata Israel ming cunglie kha puvtlung pasana patlung sa te cawsaa thawsawsariy ama thiy.

Cakhutaata Khazing ta Jerusalem kha para riypata avuoming kha a pathlie yi; cuorasala para aa nang tiyta, Abyipata mang te ruvnaana kawlie kha aa ngiepachiy; ama ta paratuv avuoming kyihuo khata, “A de tli, na kuv kha pachung tie,” a ta. Cakhutaa cata Abyipaavuoming ca Jebus ming Ornan suo-aciyna athaalie kha aa daa.

David ta vuopaa ang te alyi hne avuo alalalie Abyipaavuoming aa daapa, zueziy a da ciepa ta a cyi te Jerusalem luo a buo a pazuopa kha a hmung. Cakhutaata David hne uvthyi tie ca buri a buv yi te alyi lie amaa bu.

David ta Khazing kyihuo khata, “Cawsaa ri riypata naw a pipa ca kama ta cuo va ang ma? A suepa hne a pha lipa a tuepa ca kama tana i cuo. Cuorasala hingpa tuv tie hingta khaapama ama tue? Vya Abyipai Khazing, paa na ica kie, na kuv ta kama kha naa du sala, i paa ingchungkhue kha a du se; cuorasala na cawsaa zaw cunglie ca puv tlung thi khah se!” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipaavuoming ta, David ca sithaw sala Abyipabienatluophie kha Jebus ming Ornan suo-aciyna cunglie sa se, ta pata chang riypata Gad kha bie a pi.
Caacuonakawta Abyipaming ta Gad ta a changpa kha ziy te David ca a sithaw.
Ornan ca hnangluo kha a pali te avuoming kha a hmung; capa ningpa ca ta ama'a lie a awpa a sacapaa papaliy ca amaa nu, Ornan ca suo kha aa ciy pazue.
David ca Ornan awna luo kha a vya pha tiyta, Ornan ta mang te David kha a hmung ca, suo-aciyna taa khata pya te, alyi lie a bu te David kha pa-uvsathyina a pi.
David ta Ornan kyihuo khata, “Puvtlungna hing cawsaa zaw'a taata a pe the riypata, Abyipacuota bienatluophie sana riypata suo-aciyna hmang hing aa phuv pata a muo na hu la na pi tie,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Ornan ta David kyihuo khata, “A la tie; cakhutaata siepahruo i byipaapa ta a pha a tapa kha tue thluo se; mang tie, myirue panaana ta pihluo riypata cuetungpa zaw, suo denapa thing zaw, cakhutaata sa ta panaana riypata jungsacuo, a bangkhuo hingta ica pi,” a ta.

Cuorasala siepahruo David ta Ornan kyihuo khata, “Cuo vyi; a muo a tling pata ca pi'a angte na ica calyi aa. Abyipacuota nama huopa a cuopa kha a la'a va ang, a muo khaapahmuo pi lipa ta myirue panaana pihluo'a va ang,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta David ta Ornan kha capa hmang cuo ca ta siy shekel zacaruv kha pathlie te a pi.

David ta capa lie ca Abyipacuota bienatluophie suokha sa te, myirue panaana hne sa ta panaana kha a pihluo. Abyipa'aluo kha thlaa a chuo, ama ta avuo taata myi ta bienatluophie cung taa khata a palie.
Cakhutaata Abyipata avuoming kha naw pi te, a zueziy kha a baw chung luo a pasuo pakhaa.
Capa cuo lie ca, Jebus ming Ornan suo-aciyna liena Abyipata ina palie tapa kha David ta a hmung tiyta, capa lie ca hriykhungrina kha a tue.
Tahematapakieca Moses ta ruocaapa lie a sapa Abyipabienathluodaa, hne myirue panaana pihluonapa bienatluophie ca capa cuo ning ca Gibeon lie khahrungtluobu lie kha a aw thluo.
Cuorasala David ta Abyipahiehriy riypata capa hmiekung luo ca cakuo nguo vyi, tahematapakieca Abyipaavuoming zueziy khana a ciy.
Cakhutaata David ta, “Hingpa lie hing AbyipaKhazing ing ta cuo'a te, hingpa lie hing Israel ming myirue panaana bienatluophie ta a cuo aa,” a ta.
David ta Israel ruo chunglie khy a sapa ruohrang ming kha suv kha ta pahmya riypata naw pi yi te, Khazing ing sana riypata alung uo a thepa tie kha a lung a pa-uo sa yi.
David ta thlake chiypakaa hne a patuv sanapa zaw khepuona riypa thaakhe riypata thaa a hluvsa a chi, cakhutaata daa ca a cyi pathlie tie lina te ta chi te,
sidar thing zaw kha ri tie li ta a chi; tahematapakieca Sidon ming hne Tair ming ta David'a luo kha sidar thing a hluvsa ama za phya.

David ta, “I sacapaa Solomon ca a kung panu te a hmung a thyipa a cawsa kalie, Abyipacuota sa riypa ing ca a lesapa hne a linghlaa a aw ciemuopa, a ming pathuo te ruo ting ta ama pathuosapa a cuo riypata a cuo; caacuonakawta capa cuo ca ta kama ta i ting pacie aa,” a ta. Caacuonakawta David ta a thiy hluota capa cuo ca ta chechiy a hluv hringhruo ting pacie pata a chisiy.
Cakhutaata a sacapaa Solomon ca ku te Abyipa, Israel ming Khazing ing sa riypata bie a taa.
David ta Solomon kyihuo khata, “I sacapaa, Abyipai Khazing ming riypa ing sa riypata a tingna i hnyi.

Cuorasala Abyipa'a taata bie a zuv te, “Nama ca rie lepa a hluvsa a du cate thiyse a hluvsa na palang; i ming riypa ing kha nama ta sa'a vaciy, tahematapakieca i ming hmungnapa hingpa alyi lie hingna thiyse a hluv tuv na palang.

Mang tie, sacapaa pakha sa'a cate, ama ca diena a tuetuv ta a cuo aa. Ama ca a cahriylie a awpa a carie tie bangkhuo'a taa khata diena i pi aa; caacuonakawta a ming ca Solomon ta pata cuo'a te, ama chuo ning ca Israel kha diena hne arena i pi aa.
Ama na i ming riypa ing kha a sa aa. Ama ca kama sacapaa ta cuo'a te, kama ca a paa ta i cuo aa, cakhutaata a siepahruo byithude ca Israel ming chunglie chuozaa ta i pahmang sa aa,’ a ta.
Caacuonakawta I sacapaa, nama hne aa pazue pata a ripa haata, Abyipana Khazing ing na sana lie kha tena na hmung riypata Abyipata ca awpuo mang sue.
Nama kha Israel ming mangchiy riypata hrievu aca pi tiyta, Abyipana Khazing phungbie kha na ziy riypata Abyipata biechi thena hne pachangna ca pi mang sue.

Cakhutaata Abyipata Israel ming cuota Moses'a lie naw a pipa phungluo hne ziyphung kha a raaringsa pata na ziy kieca na hlue a tling aa. Thaaruvsa pata hne riephasa pata aw tie. Ciy khah, na palung chuo khah se.

A ruvsapa tana Abyipaing cuota siy talen thawzakha, ngu talen tinghraa, hne daa hne thaa cyi pathlie tie li i ting pacie tli, a hluv hringhruo tli; thing hne alung zaw kha i ting pacie ra tli. Hingpa tie lie hing na chachiy kalie aa.
Alung a uopa tie, pazan tie, lettamaa tie, hne kuv zung a thepa a phangphang ri tie li,
siy re a thepa, ngu, daa hne thaa re a thepa tie ta pata rehrietuv a hluvsa na hnyi. Re ca patha la Abyipata ca awpuo mang sue,” a ta.
David ta Israel ming luochiytuv bangkhuo kha a sacapaa Solomon re kha a bya riypata,

“Abyipanama Khazing na caa awpuo yi cuo va ma? Ama na a kuo ting lieta diena caa pi yi cuo va ma? Tahematapakieca hingpa ruo lie khy zaa sapa tie kha nama kuv chung luo ca pi yi te, Abyipahne a cawsaa zaw hmiekunglieta ruo ca te pata a cuo tli.

Ata hing ca Abyipanama Khazing kha nama ruena hne nama pathiypalung yalya ta huv tie ung. Abyipabiekuona thingkaw hne Khazing biphie pathepa tie kha Abyipaming riypata sapa ing chung luo a ngiekhyipa a cuo the riypata cakuo ung la AbyipaKhazing hmangpathepa kha sa tie ung,” a ta yi.
David ca macuo te a kung a tluv tli tiyta a sacapaa Solomon kha Israel ming cunglie siepahruo ta a pacuo sa.
David ta Israel ming luochiytuv tie hne tluobyi tie hne Levi ming kha a pahmya yi.
Levi ming kung sawthung taata a cungluo kha mingluv ama ri tiyta, ama bangkhuo ta thawsawthung thawcari ama ta.
David ta, “Hingpa tie chungtaa hingta thawkiy thawpaliy ca Abyipaing chunglie kha re hrie'a ung cate, thawcaruv ca byi hne bieripatuv ta nama cuo aa,
thawpaliy ca thlake a huotuv ta cuo'a ung cate, thawpaliy ca pathuosana riypata i tuepa hlaasana lie hmuopa chechiy khata Abyipakha nama pathuosa aa,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaa cata David ta iema kha Levi sacapaa tie Gershon, Kohath hne Merari tapa tie hne aa ziypa khata a phuv ta a che yi.
Gershon sacapaa zaw ca Ladan hne Shimei ta ama cuo.
Ladan sacapaa tie: a pakhana ta Jehiel, Zetham, hne Joel, pathung ta ama cuo.
Shimei sacapaa tie: Shelomoth, Haziel, hne Haran, pathung ta ama cuo. Hingpa tie hing Ladan ingchungkhue luv a cuopa tie ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata Shimei sacapaa tie: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, hne Beriah. Hingpa papaliy tie hing Shimei sacapaa zaw ta ama cuo.
Zahath ca uvthyi ce ta cuo te, cakhutaata Zizah ca a pahningna ta a cuo; cuorasala Jeush hne Beriah ca saata a hluv hnyi va yi, caacuonakawta iema ca ingchungkhue suokha ta ripa ama cuo.
Kohath sacapaa tie: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, hne Uzziel, papaliy.

Amram sacapaa tie: Aaron hne Moses. Aaron hne a sacapaa tie ca Abyipahmiekunglie chuozaa ta pihluona tue riypata cuose, a re hrie pata ama ming ta chuozaa ta thluechiy pi re kha ama hrie the riypata cuose, a nanang ta a tlawpa tana ama cuo.
Cuorasala Khazing cawsaapa Moses a sacapaa tie ca Levi phang cazing lieta khung pata ama cuo.
Moses sacapaa tie: Gershom hne Eliezer.
Gershom sacapaa tie: a uvthyipa Shebuel;
Eliezer sacapaa tie: a uvthyipa Rehabiah; Eliezer ta sacapaa hrangpa hnyi vyi, cuorasala Rehabiah sacapaa tie ca ama hluvsa.
Izhar sacapaa tie: a uvthyipa Shelomith.
Hebron sacapaa tie: a uvthyipa Jeriah, a pahningnapa Amariah, a pathungnapa Jahaziel, hne a papaliynapa Jekameam.
Uzziel sacapaa tie: a uvthyipa Mikah hne a pahningnapa Isshiah.
Merari sacapaa tie: Mahli hne Mushi. Mahli sacapaa tie: Eleazar hne Kish.
Eleazar ca sacapaa zaw hnyi li pata a thiy; cuorasala sacanung dyi a hnyi yi; ama tieriy ta a cuopa Kish sacapaa tie ta iema kha amaa hlaw.
Mushi sacapaa tie: Mahli, Eder, hne Jeremoth, pathung ta ama cuo.

Hingpa tie hing Levi sacapaa tie, ama mingchingmingvuo tie ingchungkhue ziy pata ming khungpa, ingchungkhue luv tie ta ama cuo. Kung kiy taata a cung luo tie ta cuo yi te, Abyipaing lie re hrie riypata ming lapa tie ta ama cuo.
Caacuonakawta David ta, “Israel ming Khazing, Abyipata a cawsaa tie kha thlaalungna a pi tli yi; cakhutaata Jerusalem lie kha chuozaa ta a aw.
Caacuonakawta Levi ming ca bienathluodaa acuolikie a re hriena riypa khaapa chechiy kha hmuo phyale a hu va tli,” a ta.
Tahematapakieca David ta a hnangcaw ce ta a ripa bie haata Levi ming kung kiy taata a cung luo ca hingpa zaa hing tana ama cuo.

“Cuorasala iema ama re ca Abyipaing rehriena lieta Aaron ciypathla zaw a bya riypa kha tana a cuo aa, iema ca tlawhmie hne ingchung khuo zaw kha ama mangchiy aa, a pathepa chechiy bangkhuo kha ama pasiypathe aa; Khazing ingchung lie re mekaa kha ama hrie aa.

Pachie paripa viechuo, sa ta panaana cuota jungsacuo viedie pha cepa, thiynung phuv lipa viechuo caapa, a e ta epa viechuo pihluona, chiytiy hne pya pata pihluopa, hne panangpa hne taapa re mekaa kha amaa bya aa.
Cakhutaata a maw tating hne a zuo tating ta a daa'a yi te Abyipakha a law'a yi te ama pathuosa aa.
Abyipa'a luo pihluopa myirue panaana tie kha sabbath ning, thla thaapa ning, ama'a na a cuo lieta tuepa pyi ning, tapa tie lie kha a yi thlipa zaa ta Abyipahmiekunglie ama pihluo pari aa.
Cahaacata iema ta atawna thluodaa hne hmangpathepa kha mangchiy'a yi te, ama tieriy ta a cuopa Aaron ciypathla tie kha Abyipaing rehriena lieta amaa bya aa.
Aaron ciypathla tie a phuv ta achena ca hing haa hingta a cuo. Aaron sacapaa tie: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, hne Ithamar.
Cuorasala Nadab hne Abihu ca ama paa hluo khata thiy yi te, sacapaa hnyi va yi; caacuonakawta Eleazar hne Ithamar ca tluobyi ta ama cuo.
Eleazar sacapaa zaw chungtaata Zadok, hne Ithamar sacapaa zaw chungtaata Ahimelek zaw hne khata David ta iema ama hrievu hne aa ziy pata a phuv ta a che yi.

Ithamar sacapaa zaw hrawlie laata Eleazar sacapaa zaw hrawlie kha uvthyi a hluv vie hmungpa a cuo nakawta, Eleazar sacapaa zaw chungtaata ingchungkhue luv a cuopa pahraa hlyi caruv, hne Ithamar sacapaa zaw chungtaata ingchungkhue luv pacari amaa tlaw.
Eleazar sacapaa zaw hne Ithamar sacapaa zaw chunglie kha hmangpathepa uvthyi hne thlaapa luo uvthyi ta pata ama aw kaluo nakawta iema ca ama bangkhuo ta aa lu pata vyisung a da pata chepa ama cuo.

Levi ming, Nethanel sacapaa, caacapetuv Shemaiah ta siepahruo, hne byi tie, hne tluobyi Zadok, hne Abiathar sacapaa Ahimelek, hne tluobyi tie hne Levi ming mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue luv ta a cuopa tie hmiekunglie kha cazing a khung; Eleazar cuota mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue suokha kha a tlaw pata cuo te, Ithamar cuo zaw ta suokha a tlaw pata a cuo.
Vyisung suokhana ca Jehoiarib cunglie tla te, suohningna ca Jedaiah cunglie a tla,
suothungna ca Harim cunglie a tla, suopaliyna ca Seorim cunglie a tla,
suopangaana ca Malkhijah cunglie a tla, suocaruvna ca Mijamin cunglie a tla,
suosariyna ca Hakkoz cunglie a tla, suocarina ca Abijah cunglie a tla,
suocakyna ca Jeshua cunglie a tla, suohraana ca Shekaniah cunglie a tla,
hlyikhana ca Eliashib cunglie a tla, hlyihningna ca Jakim cunglie a tla,
hlyithungna ca Huppah cunglie a tla, hlyipaliyna ca Jeshebeab cunglie a tla,
hlyipangaana ca Bilgah cunglie a tla, hlyicaruvna ca Immer cunglie a tla,
hlyisariyna ca Hezir cunglie a tla, hlyicarina ca Happizzez cunglie a tla,
hlyicakyna ca Pethahiah cunglie a tla, suokiyna ca Jehezkel cunglie a tla,
suokiy suokhana ca Jakhin cunglie a tla, suokiy suohningna ca Gamul cunglie a tla,
suokiy suothungna ca Delaiah cunglie a tla, suokiy suopaliyna ca Maaziah cunglie a tla.

Israel Khazing, Abyipata naw a pina haa yi ta hne ama mingchingmingvuo Aaron ta ama cuota rehriezya riypa a za chipana haa yi khata hingpa tie hingta Abyipaingchung luo a ngie pata ama hrie riypa hrievu ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata Levi sacapaa aa ngaapa tie: Amram sacapaa tie hrawtaata Shubael, Shubael sacapaa tie hrawtaata Jehdeiah.
Rehabiah sacapaa tie: Rehabiah sacapaa tie hrawtaata uvthyi ce ca Isshiah.
Izhar sacapaa tie hrawtaata Shelomoth; Shelomoth sacapaa tie hrawtaata Jahath.
Hebron sacapaa tie: uvthyi ce ca Jeriah, pahningnapa Amariah, pathungnapa Jahaziel, papaliynapa Jekameam.
Uzziel sacapaa tie hrawtaata Mikah; Mikah sacapaa tie hrawtaata Shamir.
Mikah uvnupa, Isshiah; Isshiah sacapaa tie hrawtaata Zekhariah.
Merari sacapaa tie: Mahli hne Mushi. Jaaziah sacapaa tie: Beno.
Merari sacapaa tie: Jaaziah sacapaa Beno, Shoham, Zakkur, hne Ibri.
Mahli sacapaa tie: Eleazar, sacapaa hnyi vyi.
Kish sacapaa tie: Kish sacapaa Jerahmeel.
Mushi sacapaa tie: Mahli, Eder, hne Jerimoth. Hingpa tie hing ama mingchingmingvuo tie ingchungkhue ziy pata Levi ming sacapaa tie ta ama cuo.

Siepahruo David, Zadok, Ahimelek, hne tluobyi tie hne Levi ming mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue luv tie hmiekunglie kha Aaron ciypathla, tieriy zaw ta a uvthyi a syi ta pata, aa lu pata vyisung kha amaa da kaluo.

Asaf sacapaa tie, hne Heman sacapaa tie, hne Jeduthun sacapaa tie chungtaata tingtuo, tingtuolepa, hne chaaraa tung pata re a hrie riypa tie kha David hne riekabyi tie ta a nanang ta amaa tlaw ra. Re a hriepa tie hne ama re cazing ca:
Asaf sacapaa tie chungtaata: Zakkur, Josef, Nethaniah, hne Asarelah, Asaf sacapaa tie, Asaf luochiypa tie, siepahruo patungpatiena haata bie a ripa tie ta ama cuo.

Jeduthun sacapaa tie: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, hne Mattithiah, pacaruv, ama paa Jeduthun ta luochiy yi te, Abyipa'a luo palungtluona bierina hne pathuosana chunglie tingtuo hne profetbiephu a ripa tie ta ama cuo.
Heman sacapaa tie: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, hne Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth.

Ama cyicalang riypata Khazing ta bie a kuopa haata hingpa bangkhuo hing siepahruo profet Heman sacapaa tie ta ama cuo, tahematapakieca Khazing ta Heman kha sacapaa pahraa hlyipaliy hne sacanung pathung a pi.
Iema ca ama bangkhuo ta a paa ta luochiy yi te, Abyipaingchung tungpa tungna lie kha chaaraa, tingtuolepa, hne tingtuo hneta Khazing ingchung abiena lie rehrietuv ta ama cuo.
Iema hne ama tieriy ca Abyipa'a lie hlaa sa riypata pacuvpa cuo yi te, ama bangkhuo ta a thesa pata ama cuo, a mingluv ta zahning sawcari pacari ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata iema ta a le a caw, pacuvtuv hne pacuvpa ta pata, aa lu pata, ama re cuo khata vyisung amaa da kaluo.
Asaf cuota vyisung suokhana ca Josef cunglieta a tla; suohningna ca Gedaliah hne a uvnu tie hne a sacapaa tie, pahraa hlyihning cunglieta a tla;
suothungna ca Zakkur, a sacapaa tie hne a uvnu tie, pahraa hlyihning cunglieta a tla;
suopaliyna ca Izri, a sacapaa tie hne a uvnu tie, pahraa hlyihning cunglieta a tla;
suopangaana ca Nethaniah, a sacapaa tie hne a uvnu tie, pahraa hlyihning cunglieta a tla;
suocaruvna ca Bukkiah, a sacapaa tie hne a uvnu tie, pahraa hlyihning cunglieta a tla;
suosariyna ca Jesarelah, a sacapaa tie hne a uvnu tie, pahraa hlyihning cunglieta a tla;
suocarina ca Jeshaiah, a sacapaa tie hne a uvnu tie, pahraa hlyihning cunglieta a tla;
suocakyna ca Mattaniah, a sacapaa tie hne a uvnu tie, pahraa hlyihning cunglieta a tla;
suohraana ca Shimei, a sacapaa tie hne a uvnu tie, pahraa hlyihning cunglieta a tla
suohraa hlyikhana ca Azarel, a sacapaa tie hne a uvnu tie, pahraa hlyihning cunglieta a tla
suohraa hlyihningna ca Hashabiah, a sacapaa tie hne a uvnu tie, pahraa hlyihning cunglieta a tla;
suohraa hlyithungna ca Shubael, a sacapaa tie hne a uvnu tie, pahraa hlyihning cunglieta a tla
suohraa hlyipaliyna ca Mattithiah, a sacapaa tie hne a uvnu tie, pahraa hlyihning cunglieta a tla;
suohraa hlyipangaana ca Jeremoth, a sacapaa tie hne a uvnu tie, pahraa hlyihning cunglieta a tla;
suohraa hlyicaruvna ca Hananiah, a sacapaa tie hne a uvnu tie, pahraa hlyihning cunglieta a tla;
suohraa hlyisariyna ca Joshbekashah, a sacapaa tie hne a uvnu tie, pahraa hlyihning cunglieta a tla;
suohraa hlyicarina ca Hanani, a sacapaa tie hne a uvnu tie, pahraa hlyihning cunglieta a tla;
suohraa hlyicakyna ca Mallothi, a sacapaa tie hne a uvnu tie, pahraa hlyihning cunglieta a tla;
suokiyna ca Eliathah, a sacapaa tie hne a uvnu tie, pahraa hlyihning cunglieta a tla;
suokiy suokhana ca Hothir, a sacapaa tie hne a uvnu tie, pahraa hlyihning cunglieta a tla;
suokiy suohningna ca Giddalti, a sacapaa tie hne a uvnu tie, pahraa hlyihning cunglieta a tla;
suokiy suothungna ca Mahazioth, a sacapaa tie hne a uvnu tie, pahraa hlyihning cunglieta a tla;
suokiy suopaliyna ca Romamti-ezer, a sacapaa tie hne a uvnu tie, pahraa hlyihning cunglieta a tla.
Thlake a huopa tie aphuv ta achena ca hing haa hing tana a cuo: Korah ing chungtaata, Meshelemiah, Kore sacapaa ta a cuo, Asaf sacapaa tie chungtaata pakha tana a cuo.
Meshelemiah ta sacapaa zaw a hnyi yi: uvthyi ce ta Zekhariah, pahningna ta Jediael, pathungna ta Zebadiah, papaliyna ta Jathniel,
papangaana ta Elam, pacaruvna ta Jehohanan, pasariyna ta Eliehoenai ta a cuo.
Obed-edom ta sacapaa zaw a hnyi yi: uvthyi ce ta Shemaiah, pahningna ta Jehozabad, pathungna ta Joah, papaliyna ta Sakhar, papangaana ta Nethanel,
pacaruvna ta Ammiel, pasariyna ta Issakhar, pacarina ta Peullethai ta ama cuo; tahematapakieca Khazing na thluechiy a pi.
A sacapaa Shemaiah zaw khata ama mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue lie uvtuv a cuo kaluopa sacapaa zaw kha a sa yi, tahematapakieca iema ca hmang a tue khusapa ta ama cuo.
Shemaiah sacapaa tie: Othni, Refael, Obed, hne Elzabad ta ama cuo, ama uvnu tie ca a thaaruvpa Elihu hne Semakhiah ta ama cuo.
Hingpa bangkhuo hing ama sacapaa tie hne ama uvnu tie, Obed-edom sacapaa tie ta ama cuo, iema ca hmang a tue khupa, rehriena cuota a tlingpa tana ama cuo.
Meshelemiah ta sacapaa tie hne uvnu tie hnyi yi te, hmang a tue khupa ta cuo yi te, hlyicari ama ta.
Merari sacapaa zaw chungtaata Hosah ta sacapaa zaw a hnyi yi: uvthyi ce ta Shimri (ama ca sa-uvthyi ta a cuo li raalaa pata a paa ta uvthyi ce ta a tue),
pahningna ta Hilkiah, pathungna ta Tebaliah, papaliyna ta Zekhariah: Hosah sacapaa tie hne uvnu tie ca ama bangkhuo ta pahraa hlyithung ta ama cuo.
Hingpa thlake a huopa phuv tie hing ama luochiytuv tie hne aa khing pata, Abyipaing chunglie re a hriepa ama uvnu tie zaa khata hrievu ama hnyi;
ama thlake cuo khata a le a caw aa lu pata ama mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue ziy pata vyisung amaa da kaluo.
Ningchiyluo cuota vyisung ca Shelemiah cunglieta a tla. A sacapaa, a singsapa ruenapituv Zekhariah cuo zaw khata vyisung a da yi te, chaluo thlake cuo khata a tla.
Obed-edom cuo khata sungluo thlake tla te a sacapaa tie cuota ca chechiy china ing kha a tla.
Shuppim hne Hosah cuota ca ningtlaluo thlake rieve riypa kha a da yi te, kya kiethawna luopuv cunglie Shallekheth thlake lie khata a cuo. Ama rievezya ca aa lu kaluo.
Ningchiyluo lie kha ningting ta Levi ming pacaruv, chaluo lie kha ningting ta papaliy, sungluo lie kha ningting ta papaliy, cakhutaata chechiy china ing lie kha pahning pahning ta;
ningtlaluo lie a awpa ing lie kha a luopuv lie papaliy, a ing lie pahning ta ama huo.
Hingpa tie hing Korah ming hne Merari sacapaa tie, thlake a huopa tie aphuv ta amaa chenazya ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata Levi ming chungtaata Ahijah ca Abyipaing chunglie suethiy ing mangchiytuv, hne pihluopa lasaw ing mangchiytuv ta a cuo.
Ladan sacapaa tie, Ladan huopa ta a cuopa Gershon sacapaa tie, Gershon ming Ladan huopa ta a cuopa ingchungkhue tie luv, Jehieli.
Jehieli sacapaa tie Zetham hne a uvnu Joel ca Abyipaing suethiy ing mangchiytuv ta ama cuo.
Amram ming, Izhar ming, hne Hebron ming, hne Uzziel ming chungtaata:
Moses sacapaa Gershom sacapaa Shebuel ca suethiy ing mangchiytuv byi le cepa ta a cuo.
A uvnu tie ca: Eliezer sacapaa zaw chungtaata a sacapaa Rehabiah, a sacapaa Jeshaiah, a sacapaa Joram, a sacapaa Zikhri, hne a sacapaa Shelomoth ta ama cuo.

Hingpa Shelomoth hne a uvnu tie hing Siepahruo David, hne ingchungkhue tie luv a cuopa tie, hne a thaw ta uvtuv tie hne a za ta uvtuv tie, hne riebyilepa tie ta ama pihluopa lasaw, ama pipa suethiy bangkhuo kha a mangchiytuv ta ama cuo.
Rietuvna hmang lie ama lapa hruosue chungtaata Abyipaing mangchiyna riypata lasaw kha ama pihluo.

Cakhutaata profet Samuel hne Kish sacapaa Saul hne Ner sacapaa Abner hne Zeruiah sacapaa Joab ta ama pihluopa bangkhuo, pihluopa lasaw bangkhuo ca Shelomoth hne a uvnu tie mangchiyna lieta chi pata a cuo.
Izhar ming chungtaata, Khenaniah hne a sacapaa tie ca Israel ruo ale luo re lieta byi hne bieripatuv ta re pi pata ama cuo.

Hebron ming chungtaata, Hashabiah hne a uvnu tie, hmang a tue khusapa thawkha zasariy tie ca, Israel ruo chung Jordan cavaa ningtlaluo lieta Abyipare bangkhuo hne siepahruo re bangkhuo mangchiytuv ta ama cuo.

Hebron ming chungtaata Jerijah ca Hebron ming byi ta a cuo. (David siepahruo a cuo chung kung sawliy chunglie kha tuokhaapa thukina taata hne tuokhaapa ingchungkhue taata a cuo zaw cawsaa kha huv yi te, Gilead ruo Jazer lie kha iema hrawtaata hmang a tue khusapa cawsaa tie kha ama hmung).

Siepahruo David ta ama hne a uvnu tie, hmang a tue khusapa cawsaa thawhning zasariy, ingchungkhue luv ta a cuopa tie kha Reuben ming, Gad ming, hne Manasseh phang a che tie cunglieta Khazing luo hne siepahruo re hne aa patuvpa zezaw bangkhuo kawlie mangchiytuv ta a chi yi.

Hingpa hing Israel cawsaa, ingchungkhue luv tie, a thaw ta a uvpa hne a za ta a uvpa tie, aa huna bangkhuo lie a pya a ngiepa phuv hne aa patuv pata thla kha hnang thla kha, kung kha chung siepahruo re a hriepa tie ca phuv kha cyicuo lieta thawkiy thawpaliy ama cuo.
Zabdiel sacapaa Jashobeam ca thla khana lieta a hriepa phuv khanapa tie luochiytuv ta a cuo; ama phuv chunglie ca thawkiy thawpaliy ta ama cuo.
Ama ca Perez ciypathla ta cuo te, thla khana lie riekabyi tie byi le cepa ta a cuo.
Aho ming Dodai ca thla hningnapa phuv tie luochiytuv ta cuo te, Mikloth ca capa phuv lie ca ta byi lepa ta a cuo. Capa phuv lie ca thawkiy thawpaliy ta ama cuo.
Thla thungna lieta riekabyi ca tluobyi Jehoiada sacapaa Benaiah ta a cuo; ama phuv lie ca thawkiy thawpaliy ta ama cuo.
Hingpa Benaiah hing a thaaruvpa sawthung tie chunglie ta pakha ta cuo te, sawthung tie luochiytuv khata a cuo.
Joab uvnu Asahel ca a papaliyna ta cuo te, thla paliyna cuota a cuo, a sacapaa Zebadiah ca ama a paziypa ta cuo te, ama phuv chunglie ca thawkiy thawpaliy ta ama cuo.
A papangaana riekabyi, a phuv pangaana ca Izrah ming Shamhuth ta a cuo, ama phuv chunglie ca thawkiy thawpaliy ta ama cuo.
Pacaruvna, thla caruvna cuota ca Tekoa ming Ikkesh sacapaa Ira ta a cuo; ama phuv chunglie ca thawkiy thawpaliy ama cuo.
Pasariyna, thla sariyna cuota ca Efraim phang Pelon ming Helez ta a cuo; ama phuv chunglie ca thawkiy thawpaliy ta a cuo.
Pacarina, thla carina cuota ca Zerah phang Hushath ming Sibbekai ta a cuo, ama phuv chunglie ca thawkiy thawpaliy ta ama cuo.
Pacakyna, thla cakyna cuota ca, Benjamin phang Anathoth ming Abiezer ta a cuo; ama phuv chunglie ca thawkiy thawpaliy ta ama cuo.
Pahraana, thla hraana cuota ca, Zerah phang Netofah ming Maharai ta a cuo; ama phuv chunglie ca thawkiy thawpaliy ta ama cuo.
Hlyikhana, hlyikha thlaa cuota ca, Efraim phang Pirathon ming Benaiah ta a cuo; ama phuv chunglie ca thawkiy thawpaliy ta ama cuo.
Hlyihningna, hlyihning thlaa cuota ca Othniel phang Netofah ming Heldai ta a cuo; ama phuv chunglie ca thawkiy thawpaliy ta ama cuo.
Israel ming phang ting cunglie ca, Reuben ming phang cuota Zikhri sacapaa Eliezer ca byi le cepa ta a cuo; Simeon ming cuota Maakah sacapaa Shefatiah ta a cuo.
Levi cuota Kemuel sacapaa Hashabiah ta a cuo; Aaron cuota Zadok ta a cuo;
Judah cuota Elihu ta a cuo, ama ca David uvnu pakha ta a cuo; Issakhar cuota Mikhael sacapaa Omri ta a cuo;
Zebulun cuota Obadiah sacapaa Ishmaiah ta a cuo; Naftali cuota, Azriel sacapaa Jerimoth ta a cuo;
Efraim ming cuota Azaziah sacapaa Hoshea ta a cuo; Manasseh phang khingkhuo cuota Pedaiah sacapaa Joel ta a cuo;
Gilead lie Manasseh phang khingkhuo cuota, Zekhariah sacapaa Iddo ta a cuo; Benjamin cuota, Abner sacapaa Jaasiel ta a cuo.
Dan cuota, Jeroham sacapaa Azarel ta a cuo. Hingpa tie hing Israel phang luochiytuv tie ta ama cuo.
David ta kung kiy raw tie kha ri va yi, tahematapakieca Abyipata Israel ca avuo lie aasiy zaa khiy tana ica papungpazaa sa'a yi a ta.

Zeruiah sacapaa Joab ta iema ri hruo kha aa pathu, cuorasala pachuo vyi; capa kawlie ca ta hihaana kha Israel ming cunglie tlung te, capa rina mingluv pha zaa ca David siepahruo Chuorina chunglie kha khung pata cuo vyi.

Siepahruo suethiy-ing a mangchiytuv ca Adiel sacapaa Azmaveth ta a cuo. Ruo chung, khypuv zaw chung, khyta zaw chunglie hne ingsuo zaw chunglie suethiy-ing tie mangchiytuv ca Uzziah sacapaa Jonathan ta a cuo.
Lu re, alyi pali re a hriepa tie a uvtuv ca Chelub sacapaa Ezri ta a cuo.
Mingsuv diedung a mangchiytuv ca Ramath ming Shimei ta a cuo; cakhutaata mingsuv diedung taata a pyapa mingsuvtiy pacungna khuo mangchiytuv ca Shifmot ming Zabdi ta a cuo.
Shefelah lie olif thing hne saikamor thing a mangchiytuv ca Geder ming Baal-hanan ta a cuo; chiytiy china khuo a mangchiytuv ca Joash ta a cuo.
Sharon lieta a tlepa sahring zaw a mangchiytuv ca Sharon ming Shitrai ta a cuo. Bawphie lie a tlepa sahring zaw a mangchiytuv ca Adlai sacapaa Shafat ta a cuo.
Kala-uv zaw a mangchiytuv ca Ishmael ming Obil ta a cuo. Laa zaw a mangchiytuv ca Meronoth ming Jehdeiah ta a cuo. Tuv zaw a mangchiytuv ca Hag ming Jaziz ta a cuo.
Hingpa tie bangkhuo hing Siepahruo David hnyipa a mangchiytuv ta ama cuo.
David a paasyi Jonathan ca ruenapituv hne a singpa hne caa a thepa ta a cuo; Hakhmon ta siepahruo sacapaa tie kha a mangchiy yi.
Ahithophel ca siepahruo ruena pituv ta cuo te, Arki ming Hushai ca siepahruo viesaa ta a cuo.
Ahithophel ca Benaiah sacapaa Jehoiada ta a paziy, cakhutaata Abiathar ta a paziy. Joab ca siepahruo rieka tie riekabyilepa ta a cuo.

David ta Israel byi bangkhuo, phang byi tie, siepahruo re a hriepa a phuv byi tie, a thaw ta uvtuv tie, a za ta uvtuv tie, siepahruo hne a sacapaa tie hnyipa bangkhuo hne sahring mangchiytuv tie kha, siepahruo ing byi tie, a thaaruvpa rieka tie, hne a riephapa rieka tie bangkhuo hne khata Jerusalem lie a pahmya yi.

Cakhutaata Siepahruo David ca a daa te: i uvnu tie hne i cawsaa zaw, na naathlie tie ung. Abyipabiekuona thingkaw aa pahyna riypa hne ma Khazing phyi china riypata ing suokha sa riypata i ting nguoluo tli.
Cuorasala Khazing ta kama kyihuo khata, ‘Nama ta i ming riypa ing kha sa'a vaciy, tahematapakieca nama ca rieka ta cuo cate, thiyse na na palang,’ ina ta.

Cuorasala Israel Khazing, Abyipata kama ca i mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue bangkhuo chung taa khata Israel cunglie chuozaa ta siepahruo cuo riypata inaa tlaw; tahematapakieca ama ta Judah ca luochiytuv cuo riypata a tlaw te, Judah ingchungkhue taa cata i paa ingchungkhue kha a tlaw; i paa sacapaa zaw chungtaata kama kha Israel ming bangkhuo cunglie siepahruo cuo riypata na tlechuo te inaa tlaw.
Abyipata sacapaa a hluvsa na pi te, i sacapaa zaw chung taa cata i sacapaa Solomon ca Israel cunglie Abyipapena byithude cunglie a tu riypata aa tlaw.
Ama ta kama kyihuo khata, ‘I ing hne i tlawhmie a satuv riypa ca na sacapaa Solomon hing tana a cuo aa, ca khutaa cata kama ca a paa ta i cuo aa.
Ataning a tuepa haa hingta i nawbie hne i ziyphung kha a cusa pata a ziy pari kieca, a pena ca chuozaa ta i pacu sa aa,’ ina ta.

Caacuonakawta, niema ta hingpa ruo phapa hing cu'a ung cate, niema hnang taata a vaw riypa nama saata zaw cuota chuozaa ru ta nama thupa se the riypata, Israel bangkhuo hmungna lie, aa hmyapa Abyipacawsaa zaw hmungna lie, hne ima Khazing thyina lie hing Abyipanama Khazing nawbie bangkhuo kha ziy ung la huv tie ung.

Cakhutaata nama, i sacapaa Solomon ta na paa Khazing hing pachang la, pathiypalung a che li pata hne khingna hmisi ta a re kha hrie tie; tahematapakieca Abyipata pathiypalung mekaa, hne pachangna mekaa hne atingna hne ruena mekaa kha a hmung diy. Na huv kieca hmung'a cate, cuorasala na thaw kieca nama kha chuozaa ta aca thaw aa.
A raaring tie, tahematapakieca Abyipana hmangpathepa riypa ing satuv riypata acaa tlaw tli; cahra la hrie tie,” a ta.

Cakhutaata David ta a sacapaa Solomon ca biena-ing luo a ngienapa tlawhmie hne a ing tie, suethiy ing tie, a cungduo khuo tie, a chung khuo tie, hne nangduena thude cuota a khuo tapa tie cuota ruedawlupa zuv kha a pi.
Cakhutaata a palung chunglie a tingna bangkhuo: Abyipaing tlawhmie tie, a cadungpa khuo bangkhuo, Khazing suethiy ing, hne pihluopa lasaw suethiy ing tie riypata ruedawlupa zuv zaw kha a pi.
Cakhutaata tluobyi tie hne Levi ming re chena, Abyipaing chunglie hrie riypa re bangkhuo; Abyipaing chung re hriena cuota biphie bangkhuo,
rehriena cyicuo cuota siy biphie a riyna zaa,
myi-ing tie hne myi-ing patuna tung cuota siy aa riyna zaa, myi-ing tie hne myi-ing patuna tung cuota ngu aa riyna zaa, re lie hmuopa zaa cyicuo haa khata,
pachie paripa viechuo china cabya cyicuo cuota siy aa riyna zaa, ngu cabya zaw cuota ngu,
khazin zaw cuota siy pathepa, rahung zaw, panuo zaw; siy kuotung zaw hne a cyicuo ta aa riyna zaa, ngu kuotung zaw hne a cyicuo ta aa riyna zaa;

pathe pakhaapa siy ta tuepa rangpa-ue bienatluophie cuota siy aa riyna zaa ruedawlupa zaw kha a pi; cakhutaata a mathlaa pake te Abyipabiekuona thingkaw a buvkhungpa siy cherubim aruole cuota a ruedawlupa zaw kha a pi.
David ta, “Hingpa bangkhuo hing, re bangkhuo cuota tingna, Abyipachangna haata capepa, kama ina pachang sapa tana a cuo,” a ta.

David ta a sacapaa Solomon ca chang vie te, “Cahra la na rie phasa pata hrie tie. Ciy khah, na rie zaw chie khah se; tahematapakieca AbyipaKhazing, kama Khazing na nama'a lie a aw. Abyipaing lie hrie riypa re bangkhuo a chuo hluo li nama kha ca pathlahla'a vyi, ca dung'a vyi.

Hingpa hing Khazing ing lie re bangkhuo cuota tluobyi tie hne Levi ming phuv re achena ta a cuo; re bangkhuo lieta, re phangting lie kuvzung a thepa mekaa ta nama kha aca hriekhyi'a yi; byi tie bangkhuo hne cawsaa bangkhuo zaw kha nama ri tana ama aw diy aa,” a ta.

Siepahruo David ta aa hmyapa bangkhuo tie kyihuo khata, “Khazing ta aa tlawpa i sacapaa Solomon ca panu kalie te a hmungthyina a cawsa kalie, cuorasala re ca a le hringhruo; tahematapakieca biena-ing hing cawsaa huopa ta cuo vyi, cuorasala AbyipaKhazing huopa tana a cuo.

Caacuonakawta i Khazing ing cuo hingta i cuo khu thiy ta atingna i hnyi. Siy chechiy huota siy, ngu chechiy huota ngu, daa chechiy huota daa, thaa chechiy huota thaa, thing chechiy huota thing kha i ring. Capa zaw khutaa cata oniks lungvaa hne alung hluvpuv, antimoni lungvaa, hmingciy a phangphang a hnyipa alung, alung muosungpa phangting, hne marbal alung a hluvsa kha i ring.
Ca hlyitaw taata, i Khazing ing kha i daakhyi tuv nakawta a pathepa ing cuota i ringpa bangkhuo thing taa hingta kama i hnyipa siy hne ngu kha i Khazing ing cuota i pi:
siy talen thawthung, Ofir siy talen thawthung, pathe sa ciepa ngu talen thawsariy kha ing tlepie lie be riypa cuota i pi.

Cakhutaata kuvzung a thepa tie ta re bangkhuo lie ama hmuo riypata siy chechiy cuota siy, ngu chechiy cuota ngu kha i pi. Ahungma ataning hing iema hne iema kha a pathe sa pata palung thusa pataAbyipa'a lie a pihluo'a ung ciy? a ta yi.
Cakhutaata mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue luochiytuv tie ta pahyasa pata ama pi, cahaacata phang luochiytuv tie, a thaw hne a za uvtuv tie, hne siepahruo re lie byi tie zaw khata ama pihluo ra.
Khazing ing rehriena cuo khata siy talen thawpangaa hne darik thawhraa, ngu talen thawhraa, daa talen thawhraa hlyicari, hne thaa talen thawzakha ama pi.
Alung muosung a hnyipa mekaa ta Abyipaing cuo khata Gershon ming Jehiel mangchiypa suethiy-ing luo kha ama pi.
Cakhutaata cawsaa ca amaa law, tahematapakieca pahyasa pata ama pi, pathiypalung yalya ta Abyipakha ama pi; Siepahruo David zaw khuosa ta a palung a tluo.
Cakhutaata David ta Abyipaca aa hmyapa cawsaa bangkhuo hmiekunglie kha a pathuosa; David ta: “Vya Abyipa, Israel ma mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing, nama ca chuozaa ta pathuosapa tana na cuo.

Vya Abyipa, lesyina, cahrana, rungnaana, tena, hne linghlaa-awna ca nama huopa tana a cuo; tahematapakieca avuo lie a awpa bangkhuo hne alyi lie a awpa bangkhuo hing nama huopa tana ama cuo; pena ca nama huopa ta cuo te, Vya Abyipa, nama ca zezaw bangkhuo cunglie cyicalangpa tana na cuo.
Hnyirungna hne pa-uvsathyina ca nama'a taata a vawpa cuo te, nama ta zezaw bangkhuo kha na uv diy.
Caacuonakawta ma Khazing, na cunglie ma palung tluo te a rungnaapa na ming kha maca pathuosa.

Cuorasala pahyasa pata maca pihluo khuna riypa hingta kiema ca ahung ta cuo pate ma i cawsaa zaw hing khaapata a ma cuo? Tahematapakieca zezaw bangkhuo hing nama'a taata a vawpa cuo te, nama huopa mamaa khana maca pi.

Tahematapakieca kiema ca ma mingchingmingvuo tie bangkhuo mingpe ama za cuopa haa khata na hmiekunglie hing khyche tana ma cuo; alyicung lie ma hringna ning zaw hing ningdiy haa tana a cuo, anguopuona khaapahmuo aw vyi.
Vya Abyipama Khazing, na ming pathepa cuota ing suokha sa riypata maa ringpa chechiy a hluv hringhruo hing na kuv taata a vawpa selaw ta cuo te, nama huopa tana ama cuo diy.

I Khazing, nama ta pathiypalung kha dyapasya cate, adangna kha na tlechuo tapa i pachang; palung adangna hneta hingpa chechiy bangkhuo hing pahyasa pata ca pi angte, hingpa lie a awpa na cawsaa zaw hingta pahyasa pata hne a lawsa pata aca pi yi tapa kha i hmung tli.

Vya Abyipa, ma mingchingmingvuo tie ta a cuopa Abraham, Isak hne Israel Khazing, hing haapa aruechuona hne ruena hing na cawsaa zaw chunglieta chi pari la, ama pathiypalung hing nama'a luo pahyi thi tie.
I sacapaa Solomon ta a pathiypalung yalya ta na nawbie a ziy riypata hne, na phungluo bangkhuo zaw tue pata i ting ciepa haa khata biena-ing a sa khuna riypata a bya tie.

Cakhutaata David ta aa hmyapa bangkhuo tie kyihuo khata, “Abyipa, nama Khazing kha pathuosa tie ung,” a ta yi. Cakhutaata aa hmyapa bangkhuo tie khata Abyipa, ama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing kha pathuosa yi te, Abyipahne siepahruo hmiekunglie kha a bu yi te pa-uvsathyina ama pi.

A mawluopa khata cuetungpa thawkha, tuvtungpa thawkha, hne tuvtaata thawkha taAbyipakha hriykhungrina hne myirue panaana pihluo yi te, dangpa ta panaana hne hriykhungrina a hluv hringhruo kha Israel ming bangkhuo cuota ama pihluo;
Abyipahmiekunglie kha ning yi dang yi te, capa ning lie ca khuopuv ta ama palung a tluo.
Cakhutaata Solomon ca Abyipabyithude cunglie kha a tu te, siepahruo cuo te a paa David kha aa thle, kiethaw te, Israel ming bangkhuo ta a bie kha ama naathlie.
Luochiytuv tie bangkhuo hne a thaaruvpa rieka tie, hne Siepahruo David sacapaa bangkhuo zaw khata Siepahruo Solomon'a lie kha zang tluo aa tla pata ma aw ta pata bie amaa kuo.
Israel ming hmungnapa lie kha Abyipata Solomon kha khuopuv ta cyicalang te, Israel siepahruo pakha hmuo a za pi buo lipa yi siepahruo linghlaa-awna kha a pi.
Cahaacata Jesse sacapaa David ca Israel ming cunglie siepahruo a cuo.
Israel ming cunglie siepahruo a cuona cuo ca kung sawliy ta a cuo; Hebron lieta kung sariy siepahruo cuo te, Jerusalem lieta kung sawthung kung thung siepahruo a cuo.
A macuosa pata, a kungtluvsa pata, a hnyirungsa pata, hne pa-uvsathyi aa chiysa pata thiy te a sacapaa Solomon ta aa thle.
Cakhutaata Siepahruo David tuesana a hruothu taata a chuona te ca profet Samuel caakhungna lie, profet Nathan caakhungna lie, profet Gad caakhungna lieta cape pata a cuo.
A uvna kaw, a lesyina kaw, hne Israel lie hne alyi cung pena bangkhuo lie a chiy a cuopa bangkhuo zaw kha cape pata a cuo.
David sacapaa Solomon ta a pena lie kha ama hne ama aa pacu hryly; Abyipaa Khazing ta ama kha awpuo te a lesyi hringhruopa ta a tue.
Solomon ta Israel ming bangkhuo, a thaw ta uvtuv hne a za ta uvtuv riekabyi tie, hne Israel ming luochiytuv bangkhuo, ingchungkhue luv bangkhuo kha a u diy yi.

Cakhutaata Solomon hne ama'a lie aa hmyapa bangkhuo hne khata Gibeon lie khahrungtluobu luo kha ama si; tahematapakieca Abyipachangtaapa Moses ta ruocaapa lieta a tuepa atawna hmang, Khazing thluodaa kha capa lie ca a aw.
(Cuorasala David ta Khazing biekuona thingkaw kha Kiriath-jearim luo, David ta a tue daw paciepa hmang, Jerusalem lie thluodaa suokha a tuv ciepa hmang luo kha aa khawkhyi.)
Ca hlyitaw taata Hur sacapaa Uri sacapaa Bezalel ta a tuepa daa bienatluophie ca capa lie Abyipabienathluodaa hmielie ca a aw. Solomon hne a pungpa tie ca ta capa lie ca amaa bie.
Solomon ta Abyipahmiekunglie a awpa capa daa bienatluophie, atawna thluodaa luo ca khaw te, capa cunglie ca myirue panaana thawkha a pihluo.
Capa zuo lie ca ta Khazing kha Solomon'a lie a luo te, “Khaapama ica pi aa, naa hie tie,” a ta.
Solomon ta Khazing kyihuo khata, “Nama ta i paa David kha a lepa hne aa hmangpa duena pahmung sa cate ama hmang lieta kama kha siepahruo ina pacuo sa ciy.
Vya AbyipaKhazing, i paa David'a lie bie na za kuopa ca ata hing patling sa tie, tahematapakieca kama kha hingpa chuelyi lie buvcing zaa ta a hluvpa cawsaa tie cunglie siepahruo ta ina tue ciy.
Hingpa cawsaa tie hmiekunglie pya riypa hne a ngie riypa hingta singna hne pachangna kha na pi tie, tahematapakieca hingpa a hluvpa na cawsaa tie hing ahungma a uv khu'a yi?” a ta.

Khazing ta Solomon kha palie te, “Hingpa hing na palung chunglie aw te, nama ta suethiy, hnyirungna, pa-uvsathyina, acuolikie nama caa huepa tie hringna, hne hring pasiyna hmuo naa hie lipa cata, cuorasala nama kha siepahruo ta ica tuenapa i cawsaa zaw uv khuna riypata nama cuota singna hne pachangna kha inaa hie ciy.

Singna hne pachangna kha ica pi. Nama hluota zaa awpa tie siepahruo ahungtahmuo ama za hnyi buo lipa hne nama khutaata a aw riypa ahungtahmuo ama hnyi buo li riypa hnyirungna, suethiy, hne pa-uvsathyina zaw kha ica pi aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Solomon ca Gibeon lie khahrungtluobu, atawna thluodaa taa khata Jerusalem luo kha aa vaw. Cakhutaata Israel ming cunglie kha siepahruo a cuo.
Solomon ta aruole hne aruo zaw kha a pahmya yi; aruole thawkha zapaliy hne aruo thawhraa hlyihning a hnyi. Ama ta capa tie ca aruole khypuv tie lie hne Jerusalem lie, siepahruo'a lie kha a chi.
Siepahruo ta Jerusalem lie kha siy hne ngu ca alung zaa ta cuose, sidar thing ca Shefelah lieta saikamor thing zaa ta cuose a hluv pata a tue.
Solomon aruo tie ca siepahruo huota sung a palipa tie khata Izipt hne Kue taata a muo aa lu pata ama calyi.

Izipt taa khata aruole suokha ca ngu shekel zacaruv ta cuose, aruo sakha ca ngu shekel zakha sawngaa ta cuose calyi yi te, iema'a taa cata Hit siepahruo tie hne Siria siepahruo tie'a luo kha ama zaa pachaa.
Solomon ta Abyipaming ta biena-ing sa riypa hne ama cuota siepahruo ing sa riypa kha bie a chi.
Solomon ta chechiy a phyatuv riypata cawsaa thawsariy, tluocung ruo lie alung a uotuv riypata cawsaa thawsariy hne iema a mangchiytuv riypata cawsaa thawthung kha re a chang yi.
Solomon ta Tair Siepahruo Huram kha bie taa te, “I paa David kha zaa bya cate, a awna riypa ing sana riypata sidar thing na za paphya.

Ata hing kama ta Abyipai Khazing cuota ing sa i ting. Capa ing ca Israel ming cuota za tue paripa haa khata Khazing hmiekunglie rangpa-ue pihluona riypata cuose, pachie paripa viechuo pihluona riypata cuose, sabbath ning hne thla thaapa ning hne ama'a na a cuo lieta tuepa Abyipama Khazing pyi ningta maw hne zuo ta myirue panaana pihluona riypata Abyipa kha i pihluo aa.
I sa riypa ing ca a lesa aa, tahematapakieca ma Khazing ta khazing hrangpa tie laata a le vie nakawta a cuo.

Cuorasala vuoruo, aa suo cepa vuoruo lie hmuo aa tlaw li nakawta ahungma ing a sapa khu aa? A hmiekunglie hriykhungrina pihluona riypa hmang ta li pata ama cuota ing sa riypata kama ca ahungtama i cuo?

Caacuonakawta i paa David ta re a za changpa tie, Judah ruo hne Jerusalem lieta kama'a lie a awpa kuvzung a thepa tie hneta hrie pakhaw riypata, siy, ngu, daa, hne thaariy, hne a ciycaapa, a sedungpa, hne a dungpa cawsie lie zaw ta kuvzung a thepa tie, cakhutaata kuv ta khena lie kuvzung a thepa pakha zaw na vya paphya tie.
Sidar thing, saipres thing hne algum thing zaw kha Lebanon taata na vya paphya tie, tahematapakieca na cawsaa zaw na thing uo a thesa yi tapa kha i pachang.
Kama cuota thing a hluvsa uo riypata i changtaapa tie kha na changtaapa tie hneta re ama hrie pakhaw aa, tahematapakieca i sa riypa ing ca a lesapa hne a pha hringhruopa ta a cuo aa.
Na changtaapa thing a uopa tie kha jungsacuo viedie kor thawkiy, barlisacuo viedie kor thawkha, mingsuvtiy bath thawhning, chiytiy bath thawhning i ring'a yi.
Cakhutaata Siepahruo Huram ta Solomon ca caa ta palie te, “Abyipata a cawsaa tie kha a due nakaw yi ta nama ca iema cunglie kha siepahruo ta aca tue tli,” a ta.

Huram ta a ri kaliepa ca, “Alyi hne avuo kha sa te, Abyipacuota biena-ing sa riypa hne ama cuota siepahruo ing sa riypata ruekhuna hne pachangkhuna a hnyipa sacapaa kha Siepahruo David a pituv Israel Khazing Abyipaca thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue.
“Ata hingta kuvzung a thesapa, pachangna hne thena a hnyipa Huram-abi kha ica paphya.

A nung ca Dan ming ta cuo te, a paa ca Tair ming ta a cuo. Ama ca siy, ngu, daa, thaa, alung hne thing luo re lie cuose, cakhutaata a ciycaapa, a dungpa, a sedungpa caw hne cawthang phapa tuena lie a thesapa hne kuv ta khepa phangting lie kuvzung a thesapa ta a cuo; ama ca kuvzung a thepa tie, i byipaapa na paa David kuvzung a thepa tie hneta a hrie pakhaw riypata a cuo aa.
Caacuonakawta i byipaapa ta na ripa jungsacuo, barli, chiytiy hne mingsuvtiy tie kha na changtaapa tie'a luo hing ama ta vya paphya se.
Lebanon lie na khingpa thing bangkhuo hing kiema ta uo'a pate, riyliy luopuv ta Joppa luo maca vya paphya aa; capa ca nama ta Jerusalem luo na phya thaw aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Solomon ta a paa David ta mingluv a za ri khutaata, Israel ruo lie khy a sapa ruohrang ming bangkhuo kha mingluv ri yi te, thawzakha thawsawngaa thawthung zacaruv ama ta.
Iema chungtaata thawsawsariy kha hmangphyatuv, thawsawcari kha tluocung ruo lie alung a uotuv, thawthung zacaruv kha re a hriepa tie a mangchiytuv ta a chi yi.
Solomon ta Jerusalem khy chung Moriah Tluo, a paa David'a lie Abyipaaa luonapa, David ta a za sapa suo-aciyna, Jebus ming Ornan huopa ta a cuopa lie kha Abyipaing ca sa hruo aa pathu.
Siepahruo acuona kung paliy, thla hning, ning hningna lieta sa hruo aa thu.
Solomon ta Khazing ing a sa riypa ca hingpa hingta a cuo: a syina luo taana hlungpa daw ta daw sawcaruv, a kuna luo daw kiy ta a cuo.
Khuolepa hmielie ingle khuo ca ing haa zaa ta daw kiy syi te, aa suona ca daw zakha daw kiy ta a cuo; capa ca achungluo taata siy pathepa ta a pakhuv diy.
Ing khuolepa ca saipres thing kha chung te siy pathepa ta a pakhuv diy, a cunglie kha tungkung hne buoliriy zuv a sa.
Ing ca alung muosungpa ta a pangi. Siy ca Parvaim siy ta a cuo.
Cahaacata ing ca a tluo, a ingchiypakaa tungtluo, a tlepie hne a ingchiypakaa tapa tie kha siy ta pakhuv te, a tlepie lie kha cherubim zuv a sa.
Ama ta hmang pathe cepa kha a tue; a syina luo ca ing haa hneta a khing te daw kiy ta a cuo, a kuna luo zaw daw kiy ta a cuo; capa ca siy phapa talen zacaruv ta a pakhuv.
Thaakhe ta hmuopa siy aa riyna ca shekel sawngaa ta a cuo. A cung duo a khuo tie ca siy ta a pakhuv.
Hmang pathe cepa lie ca thing ta cherubim suohning tue te siy ta a pakhuv.

Cherubim mathlaa tie ca daw kiy ama syi; sakha mathlaa suokha luo, daw pangaa a syipa khata ing tlepie kha va de te, capa mathlaa suokha luo, daw pangaa a syipa cata cherub a hrangpa mathlaa kha a va de,
cakhutaata capa cherub mathlaa suokha, daw pangaa a syipa ca ta ing tlepie kha va de te, a mathlaa hrangpa daw pangaa a syi rapa cata cherub hrangpa mathlaa kha avaa pazue.
Hingpa cherubim tie mathlaa zaw hingta daw kiy ava pake; cherubim tie ca ama phyi cunglie kha a daa yi te, khuolepa luo kha amaa hyi.
Cakhutaata Solomon ta a dungpa, a ciycaapa hne a sedungpa cawthang phapa ta cherubim zuv aa cangpa pangzu kha a tue.
Ing hmiekunglie kha daw sawngaa daw pangaa aa suo kaluopa atung suohning tue te, a daw lie kha daw pangaa a tapa atung daw pakhuv a tue kaluo.
Aa tiekypa buoliriy tue te atung daw tie lie ca a kalaa; cakhutaata cale thyi zakha tue te buoliriy tie lie ca a pathlie.
Atung tie ca biena-ing hmielie kha tung kha cacuoluo, a hrangpa tung kha kha cavyiluo ta pata bang te, cacuoluo'apa kha Jakhin ta te cavyiluo'apa kha Boaz a ta.
Ama ta a syina luo daw kiy, a kuna luo daw kiy, aa suona luo daw kiy a tapa bienatluophie suokha a sa.
Cakhutaata rahung tiy-ing lesapa suokha a tue; a pungkalung te, kuokhaluo tluo taata kuokhaluo tluo te a kuna daw hraa cuo te, daw pangaa aa suo. A chi aa dung pata ma taa kieca daw sawthung a ta.
Capa rawlie ca tluo hning ta a sipa daw hraa a syipa ungthyi riy zuv suohning ta aa tieky pata cadung te, capa ca rahunglepa ama patle ningta patlepuo pata a cuo.

Rahunglepa ca cuetungpa sahraa hlyihning cunglieta ama patu, sathung chaluo, sathung ningtlaluo, sathung sungluo, sathung ningchiyluo ta pata amaa hyi; rahung ca iema cunglie ca patu pata cuo te hnang amaa chaw kaluo.
Rahunglepa ca pazaa tie a chaa; a tluo ca panuo tluo haata tue pata cuo te, lili paa haa khata a ta; bath thawthung aa tlaw.

Ama ta kuv a siyna riypa rahung suohraa zaw kha tue te, cacuoluo kuo ta suopangaa, cavyiluo kuo ta suopangaa ta a patu. Hingpa tie chunglie hing myirue panaana cuota hmuopa tie kha ama pasiy. Rahunglepa ca tluobyi tie a siyna riypata a cuo.
Siy myi vuona tung suohraa kha ama za ri pacie tlipa haa khata tue te, biena-ing chunglie kha sungluo kuo ta suopangaa, chaluo kuo ta suopangaa ta pata a patu.
Cabya suohraa zaw kha tue te, biena-ing chunglie kha sungluo kuo ta suopangaa, chaluo kuo ta suopangaa ta pata a chi. Cakhutaata siy pakaa aa thuvpa zakha a tue.
Tluobyi tie tlawhmie hne tlawhmielepa kha tue te, tlawhmie ingchiypakaa kha a tue; a ingchiypakaa kha daa a pakhuv yi.
Rahunglepa ca ing chunglie, ningchiy sungluo kuo a kiy lie khata a patu.
