Cakhutaata Huram ta bi zaw, kawpia zaw, hne pakaa aa thuvpa zaw kha a tue. Cahaacata Huram ta Khazing ing cuota Siepahruo Solomon a tuepapa re ca a palang:
atung tung hning, pakaa aa thuvpa tie, atung tung hning cunglie atung daw pakhuv suohning tie; atung zaw daw lie a awpa atung daw pakhuv pakhuv riypata asue khue haata tuepa suohning;
atung cunglie atung daw pakhuv suohning tie pakhuv riypata asue khue a lu pata pangipa tie cunglie tluo hning ta a sipa cale thyi zapaliy;
Rahung zaw hne a patunapa tung zaw,
rahunglepa suokha, hne a rawlieta cuetungpa suohraa hlyihning kha a tue.
Abyipaing lie huota Huram-abi ta Siepahruo Solomon cuota a tuepa bi zaw, kawpia zaw, khazin zaw, hne chechiy tingby bangkhuo ca daa ngupa hmuo pata a tuepa ta ama cuo.
Jordan ase, Sukkoth hne Zeredah alalalie, thingtlung lyi lie kha siepahruo ta a patle sa yi.
Solomon ta capa hmangbya bangkhuo ca a hluvsa ta a tue, cata a cuo nakawta daa aa riyna ca khazaa ma a chuo tapa kha pachang khu pata za cuo vyi.
Cahaacata Solomon ta Khazing ing chunglie hmangbya bangkhuo kha a tue: siy bienatluophie, Phuovaa viechuo china cabya,
ziyphung lie ri ciepa haata chungching hmangpathepa hmiekunglie myi vuona riypa siy ta tuepa myi-ing zaw hne a tung zaw,
siy pathe cepa ta tuepa paapaapa zaw, myi-ing zaw, hne cecakie zaw;

siy pathepa ta tuepa myi pachenapa cecakie, pakaa aa thuvpa, phiethlalepa, buvcuo liyna phie tapa tie zaw kha a tue. Biena-ing chung luo angienapa chungching hmang pathe cepa ingchiypakaa tie hne biena-ing khuolepa a ngiena chiypakaa zaw kha siy ta a tue.

Cahaacata Solomon ta Abyipaing cuota a hriepa re bangkhuo ca a palang. Solomon ta a paa David ta a za pihluopa chechiy ta a cuopa, ngu, siy hne biphie bangkhuo kha Abyipa ing suethiy ing chunglie a chi diy.

Cakhutaata Solomon ta Israel ming uvthyi tie hne phang tie luv a cuopa bangkhuo, hne Israel ming mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue tie luochiytuv tie kha, Abyipabiekuona thingkaw kha David khypuv Zion taata Jerusalem lie kha phyathaw riypata Jerusalem lie a pahmya yi.
Cakhutaata Israel ming bangkhuo ca thla sariyna thlaa lie tuepa pyi lie kha siepahruo hmiekunglie amaa hmya.
Cakhutaata Israel ming uvthyi bangkhuo kha a vaw yi te, Levi ming ta biekuona thingkaw kha amaa puv.
Caacuonakawta iema ta biekuona thingkaw, atawna thluodaa, hne thluodaa chunglie a awpa a pathepa biphie bangkhuo ca ama kya phyathaw; tluobyi tie hne Levi ming ta ama kya phyathaw.

Siepahruo Solomon hne Israel ming cawsaazaapuv, a hmiekunglie a pungpa bangkhuo ca biekuona thingkaw hmiekunglie kha aw yi te, ri tie li hne pasuv tie li ta a cuopa tuv hne cuetungpa a hluv hringhruo ta hriykhungrina ama pihluo.
Cakhutaa cata tluobyi tie ta Abyipabiekuona thingkaw ca a awna hmang, ing chung chungching, hmangpathepa, hmang pathe cepa chunglie cherubim mathlaa tie rawlie kha ama chi.
Tahematapakieca cherubim tie ta biekuona thingkaw awna hmang cunglie kha ama mathlaa ama pazu, caacuonakawta biekuona thingkaw hne a tluo tie ca a cungluo taa khata ama buv.

A tluo zaw ca ama syisa nakawta a tluo a dawluo kuo tie ca chungching hmangpathepa hmiekunglie hmang pathepa taa khata hmung khu pata a cuo; cuorasala aleluo taata ca hmung khu pata cuo vyi; capa lie ca na ataning tepa hingta ama aw thluo.
Israel ming Izipt taata ama pya khutaata Abyipata iema hne biekuona a tuenapa Horeb lieta Moses ta a chunglie a khungpa lungphie suohning ta li pata biekuona thingkaw chunglie khaapahmuo aw vyi.
Cakhutaata tluobyi tie kha hmang pathepa chungtaata ama kya pya tiyta, (capa lie a awpa tluobyi tie ca iema hne iema kha amaa pathe sa diy tli, a phuv ta ama chenazya kha ca rue li pata,

cakhutaata Levi ming hlaasatuv bangkhuo, Asaf, Heman, hne Jeduthun, ama sacapaa tie hne ama tieriy tie ca cawthang phapa kha a hryi yi te, chaaraa, tingtuolepa, hne tingtuo zaw hne khata bienatluophie taata ningchiyluo kuo khata hmyakaa a tungpa zakha pakiy hne khata amaa daa).

Hmyakaa a tungtuv tie hne hlaasatuv tie ama re ca Abyipapathuosana hne palungtluona hlaa kha ue khata tah papya sa riypata a cuo; hmyakaa a tungtuv tie hne chaaraa a tungtuv tie hne tungpa phang a hrangpa tie hne khata: Tahematapakieca ama ca a pha, aa hmangpa a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang,” ta pata Abyipapathuosa pata hlaa kha ama sa tiyta, ing ca, Abyipaing ca amyi ta a bi,
Abyipa rungnaana ca Abyipa ing lie kha a bi nakawta, amyi kawlie ca ta tluobyi tie ca ama re hrie riypata a daa khu va yi; tahematapakieca Khazing ing ca Abyiparungnaana ta a bi.
Cakhutaata Solomon ta, “Abyipana a chaapa zingna chungliena i aw aa, a ta.
Chuozaa ta na awna riypa tana, a rungnaapa ing ica sapa tli,” a ta.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ca a pali te, Israel ming cawsaazaapuv ca amaa daa nguoluo ning kha thluechiy a pi yi
Cakhutaata, ama ta, “I paa David'a lieta a pakaa ta bie a kuopa kha a kuv ta a patling sapa Abyipa, Israel Khazing ca thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue. Tahematapakieca ama ta,

‘I cawsaa Israel ming kha Izipt taata i pyakhyi ning taa yi ta, Israel ming phang chungtaata khaapa khypuv kha hmuo i ming awna ing sana riypata a tlaw va ang, cakhutaata i cawsaa Israel ming uv riypata zaw cawsaa pakha hmuo a tlaw va ang;
cuorasala kama ta i ming awna riypata Jerusalem kha a tlaw angte, David kha i cawsaa Israel ming cunglie aw riypata i tlaw,’ a ta.
Israel Khazing, Abyipaming riypata ing sa riypa kha i paa David pathiypalung lie a za aw thluo.
Cuorasala Abyipata i paa David kyihuo khata, ‘I ming riypata ing sa riypa na ruepa hing a phapa tana a cuo;
cadyiseca nama ta ing kha sa'a vaciy, cuorasala nama ta na hnyi riypa na sacapaa na i ming riypata ing ca a sa aa,’ a ta.

Ata hing Abyipata a tuepa a biekuona kha a patling sa tli; tahematapakieca i paa David kha a thle tli angte, Abyipabiekuona haata Israel byithude lie kha a tu tli angte Israel Khazing, Abyipaming riypata ing kha i sa tli.
Israel ming hneta Abyipata a tuepa a biekuo khungnapa thingkaw kha capa lie ca i chi tli,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Solomon ca Abyipabienatluophie hmielie, Israel ming aa pungpa bangkhuo tie hmungna lie kha a daa te, a buo kha a pazu.

Solomon ta daw pangaa a syipa, daw pangaa ku te daw thung aa suopa daa a daana hlyidue kha sa te, tlawhmie lie kha patu te capa cunglie ca aa daa. Cakhutaata Israel ming aa hmyapa tie bangkhuo hmungna lie kha a pakhuv pane te, avuo luo kha a kuv a pazu.

Ama ta, “Vya Abyipa, Israel Khazing, avuo lie cuose, alyi lie cuose, nama haapa Khazing aw va yi, ama pathiypalung yalya ta na hmiekunglie a cakuopa na changtaapa tie cunglie kha aa hmangpa na duena ta na biekuona kha na pahmang sa;
na changtaapa i paa David'a lie bie na kuopa ca na ziy. Na pakaa ta bie kuo cate, ataning hing na kuv ta na patling sa hmisi.

Caacuonakawta, Vya Abyipa, Israel Khazing, i paa David'a lie bie na kuopa, ‘Nama ta i hmiekunglie, i phungbie chunglie na cakuopa haa khata na saata zaw ta ama luopuv kha a mangpuo pata ama ziy kieca, Israel ming byithude cunglie, i hmiekunglie a tu riypa ci buo'a va ung ciy,’ na tapa kha pacu sa thi tie.
Caacuonakawta, Vya Abyipa, Israel Khazing, na changtaapa David bie na kuopa kha pacu sa pata cuo mang sue.

“Cuorasala Khazing ta ca chuelyi lie, cawsaa zaw hne hingta khy na sa hmisi'a ma? Vuoruo hne aa suo cepa vuoruo ta hmuo aacaa tlaw li pata ca tuokhaatama kama sapa hingpa ing hing ta ca aacaa tlaw khu aa?
Na changtaapa thlaachuona hne paakiena hing naathlie thi la, Vya Abyipai Khazing, na changtaapa una hne thlaachuona ca thyipa thi tie.
Na ming china riypata bie na kuopa hmang, hingpa ing luo hing chung zuo ta na ming padyi thi la, hingpa ing luo a hyi pata na changtaapa ta thlaa a chuopa hing thyipa thi tie.
Na changtaapa hne na cawsaa Israel ming ta hingpa ing luo a hyi yi te paa aca kienapa yi kha na awnapa vuoruo taa khata naathlie thi la, thyi la a ngiethe thi tie yi.
Cawsaa pakhakha ta a ingpaa cunglie sue te, biekuona patue sa riypa hne a vaw pata hingpa ing nama bienatluophie hmiekunglie hing chie pasa sa pata a cuo kieca,

vuoruo taa khiyta za thyi la, re hrie tie, na changtaapa tie kha bie chipa thi tie yi, a suepa ca ama luv cung mamaa lie kha a suena ca patlung sa la, aa dangpa ca aa dangna haa khata lawmuo pina ta pacu sa tie.

Na cawsaa Israel ming ta nama'a lie suena ama hnyi tiyta cuose, carie tie ta te yi te, cuorasala nama'a luo ama vya kaa tiyta, hne ama suena a ngiepachiy yi te hingpa ing chunglie hing nama'a luo thlaachuo yi te paa aca kie tiy yi ta,
vuoruo taata za thyi thi tie yi, na cawsaa Israel ming suena kha a ngiethe yi la, ama mingchingmingvuo tie hne iema na pipa yi ruo luo kha sikhyi pakhaa thi tie yi.
Nama'a lie ama sue nakawta nama ta duote yi cate, avuo kha a khaa te khy a saa li tiyta, ama suena a ngiepachiy yi te, hingpa hmang luo hing a hyi pata na ming kha ri yi te thlaa ama chuo kieca,
vuoruo lieta thyipa yi la, na changtaapa na cawsaa Israel ming suena kha a ngiethe yi la, nama ta na cawsaa zaw ru ta na pipa yi ruo, na ruo lie kha khy pasaa sa thi tie.

Ruo chunglie hing cakuo a tlung kie cuose, puvtlung pasana a tlung kie cuose, sakung ruokung cunglie rucaana hne myana a tlung kie cuose, khawbyapa hne lunghmingsyi ta a tlung kie cuose, ama carie tie ta ama khy suokhakha lie ama hre kie cuose; capa lie ca tuokhaapa ruvnaana hne tuokhaapa pasana a tlung kie zaw;

Israel ming pakha cyicuo ta cuose, ama bangkhuo ta cuose, ama angpa te-angna hne palungriethyina kha pachang yi te, hingpa ing luo hing ama buo pazu yi te, tuokhaapa thlaachuona a cuo zaw, tuokhaapa paakiena a cuo zaw ama tue kieca,
ama ziypa luopuv cyicuo haa khata na awnapa hmang vuoruo taa khata za thyipa yi la a ngiethe thi tie yi, tahematapakieca nama dyina cawsaa pathiypalung kha a pachang diy ciy.
Cahaacata ma mingchingmingvuo tie na pipa yi ruo chunglie khy ama sa chung bangkhuo ta nama kha ca ciy'a yi te na luopuv kha ama ziy aa.
“Cahaacata ruohrang ming, na cawsaa Israel ming ta a cuo lipa tie ta a lesyipa na ming, a cahrapa na kuv, hne na pazuopa na buo thueta a vaw yi te hingpa ing luo hing a hyi pata thlaa ama chuo kieca,

alyi lie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo ta na cawsaa Israel ming haa hingta na ming kha pachang pata ama ciy riypata hne kama ta i sapa hingpa ing hing na ming ta kupa a cuopa kha ama pachang riypata, na awnapa vuoruo taa khata thyipa yi la, khaapa a cuo zaw, ruohrang ming ta aca hiepa yi kha tuepa tie yi.

“Na cawsaa zaw kha ama carie a du riypata ama si kieca, tuokhaapa luopuv taata na pathlie zaw yi ta, nama ta naa tlawpa hingpa khypuv hne na ming riypata i sapa hingpa ing luo hing a hyi yi te thlaa ama chuo kieca,
ama thlaachuona hne ama paakiena ca vuoruo taata za thyi la, ama re kha pabang sa tie.

“Iema ta na cunglie ama sue kieca, tahematapakieca ahunghmuo a sue lipa ama aw li nakawta, cakhutaata iema cunglie na hi haa te iema kha carie kuv luo pi yi cate, carie tie ruo aa hlapuv luo cuose, aa ngiena lie cuose sii ta a da yi te,

cakhutaata sii ta amaa dana ruo lie kha ama palung kya vuo te, a ngiepachiy yi te, ama siicuona ruo chunglie kha, ‘Ma sue tli, aa dang lipa re, a pha lipa re na ma hrie tli,’ ta pata paa ca kie yi te,

sii ama cuonapa ruo chunglie kha ama pathiypalung yalya hne ama ruena yalya ta a ngiepachiy yi te, ama mingchingmingvuo tie na za pipa yi ama ruo hne nama ta naa tlawpa khypuv, hne na ming riypata i sapa ing luo kha a hyi yi te thlaa ama chuo kieca,
na awnapa vuoruo taata ama thlaachuona hne ama paakiena kha za thyipa yi la na cunglie a suepa na cawsaa tie kha a ngiethe yi la pabang tie yi.
Vya, i Khazing, hingpa hmang taata thlaachuona hing za hmung la za thyi thi tie.

“Vya, Abyipa, Khazing, thu la na awna hmang luo ca si tie, nama hne na cahranapa thingkaw hneta. Vya, Abyipa, Khazing, na tluobyi tie ca khuona pabuv pata cuo yi sala, zang tluo aa tlapa na cawsaa tie ca na phana chunglie kha a law yi se.
Vya, Abyipa, Khazing, na sathu pathuvpa kha thaw khah. Aa hmangpa na duena kha, na changtaapa David cuo khata a thyi pakhaa thi tie,” a ta.
Solomon ta a thlaachuona a pachuo tiyta, avuo taata myi za tla te, myirue panaana hne hriykhungrina tie kha kuo yi te, Abyiparungnaana ca biena-ing lie kha a bi.
Abyiparungnaana ca Abyipaing chunglie kha a bi nakawta tluobyi tie ca Abyipaing chung luo kha a ngie khu va yi.

Cawsaa bangkhuo ca Abyipabiena-ing cunglie myi a za tlapa kha ama hmung tiyta, alung phaapa cunglie kha alyi luo a bung yi te, Abyipakha abie yi te palungtluona kha hluo yi te, “Tahematapakieca ama ca a pha, aa hmangpa a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata siepahruo hne cawsaa bangkhuo ta Abyipahmiekunglie kha hriykhungrina ama pihluo.
Siepahruo Solomon ta hriykhungrina ta cuetungpa thawkiy thawhning hne tuv thawzakha thawkiy kha a pihluo. Cahaacata siepahruo hne cawsaa bangkhuo ta Khazing ing pihluona kha ama tue.

Tluobyi tie ca ama awna hmang lie kha amaa daa. Levi ming zaw, Abyipapathuosana riypata David ta a za tuepa tungpa chechiy hne khata a daa ra yi te, David ta Abyipapathuosa riypa re a za ritepa haa yi khata, ‘Chuozaa ta aa hmangpa a duena,’ tapa hlaa kha ama sa. Tluobyi tie ta iema hne aa hmiepachawpa khata hmyakaa tung yi te, Israel ming bangkhuo ca amaa daa.

Solomon ta Abyipaing hmiekunglie a awpa tlawhmie liekhingkhuo kha a pathe sa; tahematapakieca Solomon ta a sapa daa bienatluophie lie kha myirue panaana hne sata panaana hne a thupa tie kha a tlaw the li nakawta myirue panaana hne aviesaa panaana taata a thupa tie kha capa lie ca a pihluo.
Capa cuo lie ca Solomon hne ama'a lie a awpa Israel ming bangkhuo, a hluv hringhruopa cawsaazaapuv, Lebo-hamath taata Izipt cavaata te lie a awpa tie ta ning sariy chung pyi ama tue.
A ning carina lie ca biena apungna ama tue; tahematapakieca bienatluophie pathesana kha ning sariy tue yi te, pyi kha ning sariy ama tue.

Thla sariyna ning kiy ning thung ning ta cawsaa kha ama ing luo a pathlie yi. Abyipata David hne Solomon hne a cawsaa Israel ming cunglie a paluopa phana thue khata palung tluosa pata hne thaaphasa pata ing luo kha amaa diy.
Cahaacata Solomon ta Abyipaing hne siepahruo ing kha a palang; Abyipaing chunglie hne ama ing chunglie tue riypata aa tingpa bangkhuo kha Solomon ta a tlingsa pata a palang.
Cakhutaata Abyipaca Solomon'a lie kha zuo ta a luo te, “Na thlaachuona kha thyi tli angte hingpa hmang hing kama cuota hriykhungrina ing ta i tlaw tli.
Avuo kha khaa angte khy a saa li tiyta cuose, khawbyapa kha alyi thyipaa ce diy riypata bie i pi tiyta cuose, i cawsaa zaw hraw luo puvtlung pasana i pathlie tiyta cuose,

i ming ta kupa i cawsaa tie ta rawcanawna hne thlaachuo yi te, i hmie kha na huv yi te a pha lipa ama luopuv taa khata amaa vya pali kieca, vuoruo taata za thyi'a yi angte, ama suena kha a ngiethe'a yi angte ama ruo kha i patluo sa aa.
Hingpa hmang lie thlaa ama chuopa hing i ming ta hmung'a angte i naa ta i thyi aa.
Tahematapakieca i ming ca hingpa lie hing chuozaa ta a awna riypata hingpa ing hing a tlaw angte i pathe sa tli; i ming hne i pathiypalung ca hingpa lie hing a aw pari aa.
Nama ta, na paa David a za cakuopa haa khata i hmiekunglie kha cakuo cate, kama bie ica pipa bangkhuo haata tue diy cate, i ziyphung hne i phungluo zaw kha na ziy kieca,
‘Israel uv riypata nama caa thle riypa kha ci buo'a va yi,’ ta pata na paa David bie i kuopa haa khata na siepahruo byithude kha i pacu sa aa.
“Cuorasala nama ta luo pie cate, na hmiekunglie i chipa i phungluo hne i nawbie zaw kha thaw cate, khazing hrangpa tie re kha hrie cate naa bie kie yi ca,
ica pipa ruo taa hingta ica phie'a yi; i ming riypata i pathe sapa hingpa ing hing i ming ta a hmung khu lina luo pazu'a angte, cawsaa zaw hrawlieta phungthluvbie hne sesung bie ta i tue aa.

Cakhutaata ata lie cyicalangpa hingpa ing hne aa patuvpa hingta, a kielie a cakuolepa tie ta ama nang uo'a te, ‘Khaapanakawma Abyipata hingpa ruo hne hingpa ing hing hing haa hingta a tue'a e?’ ama ta aa.

Cakhutaata iema ta, ‘Tahematapakieca Izipt ruo taata a vya pyakhyipa yi ama mingchingmingvuo tie AbyipaKhazing kha thuse yi te, khazing hrangpa tie kha a patuv yi te, abie yi te a re ama hrie nakaw tana a cuo; caacuonakaw tana hingpa rana bangkhuo hing ama cunglieta a patlung sa, ama ta aa,” a ta.
Solomon ta Abyipaing hne ama ing a sa chung kung kiy a chuona lie kha,
Huram ta a pipa khypuv tie kha sa pathiy yi te Israel cawsaa tie kha a pa-aw sa yi.
Solomon ta Hamath-zobah luo kha si te a la.
Ruocaapa chunglieta Tadmor khy hne Hamath lieta a sapa chechiy pacungnapa khy bangkhuo kha a sa.
Dungkhuopa khypuv tie kha a lungruetlepie zaw, a thlake zaw, a hrenapa zaw hne khata Acung Beth-horon hne Araw Beth-horon lie kha a sa.

Cakhutaata Baalath, Solomon chechiy pacungnapa khy tie, aa ruole tie cuota khy bangkhuo, aa ruo rieka tie cuota khy zaw, hne Solomon ta a sa khingpa tuokhaapa a cuo zawta, Jerusalem, Lebanon, hne a pepa ruo bangkhuo lie kha a sa.
Hit ming, Amor ming, Periz ming, Hiv ming, hne Jebus ming chungtaata aa ngaapa, Israel ta a cuo lipa bangkhuo,
Israel ming ta ama za para lipa, ruo chunglie aa ngaa kaliepa iema ciypathla tie kha Solomon ta re pahriesapa cawsaa ta tue yi te, ataning tepa hingta a cuo kalie.
Cuorasala Israel ming kha ca Solomon ta a re hrie riypata sii ta tue va yi; iema ca rieka, hne aa byi tie, aruole a mawpa hne aruo rieka uvtuv riebyi ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata hingpa tie hing Siepahruo Solomon aa byi lepa tie ta ama cuo, zahning sawngaa ta cuo yi te, cawsaa cunglie naw a hnyipa tie ta ama cuo.

Solomon ta Faro sacanung kha David khypuv taata ama cuota a sapa ing luo kha sikhyi te, ama kyihuo khata, “Abyipabiekuona thingkaw a phanapa hmang ca hmang pathepa a cuo nakawta i napuv ca Israel Siepahruo David ing chunglie kha aw'a vyi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata ingle khuo hmiekunglie ta a sapa Abyipabienatluophie cunglie kha Solomon ta Abyipa'a luo kha myirue panaana a pihluo.

Moses ta bie a pipa haata pihluo riypa, a ning cyicuo lie pihluo riypata a cuopa kha sabbath ning, thla thaa ning, kung kha ta luo kha tuepa pyi tie ning, thiynung phuv lipa viechuo pyi, sathaapa pyi, thluodaa pyi zaw ning kha a pihluo.

A paa David tuepa ziyphung haata tluobyi tie kha ama re cyicuo cuota a phuvphuv ta chi yi te, Levi ming zaw kha pathuosa riypa re, hne tluobyi tie hne ningting ta hrie pakhaw riypa re kha a pi yi. Cakhutaata thlake a huopa tie zaw kha thlake bangkhuo kha a phuvphuv ta a pahuo sa yi. Cahaacata Khazing cawsaa David ta bie a za pi yi.
Re ting kawlie cuose, suethiy kawlie cuose siepahruo ta tluobyi tie hne Levi ming kha bie pi yi te, iema ta piese va yi.
Cahaacata Solomon re bangkhuo ca Abyipaing hruopatu bangna taata Abyipaing tluotlingsa pata palangna te khata a phasa pata patlung pata a cuo.
Cakhutaata Solomon ca Edom ruo riyliy kielie a awpa Ezion-geber hne Eloth luo kha a si.

Huram ta a changtaapa tie hmuo pata, riyliy lie a si tawpa a changtaapa tie hne tiypalaw zaw kha ama'a luo a paphya. Iema ca Solomon changtaapa tie hne khata Ofir luo si yi te, capa taa cata siy talen zapaliy sawngaa vya phya yi te Siepahruo Solomon'a luo kha ama vya tlungkhyi.

Siepahruonung Sheba ta Solomon mingpathuona kha a thyi tiyta, a ziytuv a hluvsa, rangpa-ue hne siy a hluvsa hne alung muosungpa zaw a phyapa kala-uv tie, tapa kha a vya chiy yi te ama kha a ruv ciemuopa biehiehriyna ta dyapasya riypata Jerusalem luo aa vaw.
Solomon ta a biehiehriyna bangkhuo kha a palie diy; Solomon ta a pachang lipa hne a pasiepa khu lipa suokha hmuo aw vyi.
Siepahruonung Sheba ta Solomon singna, a sapa ing,

a cabya lie sa, aa byi tie amaa tuzya, a changtaapa tie cawsaa mangsangnazya, ama cawsie, panuo a cyituv tie hne ama cawsie, Abyipaing lie a pihluopa myirue panaana tapa tie kha a hmung tiyta a nang a uo hringhruo.
Caacuonakawta siepahruo kyihuo khata, “I ruo chunglieta i thyipa na re patlungpa hne na singna hing a hmisipa tana a cuo,

cuorasala ama ripa hing kama pangpa ta a vaw angte i ming hrahring ta i hmung hluota ca za zang va ang. Na singna aa suonazya kha khingkhuo hmuo na za chang va yi, i za thyipa bie ca na lawpakhung karue.
Na cawsaa zaw hing thluechiypa tana ama cuo! Naa thaalie aw pari yi te na singna bie a thyi paripa hingpa na changtaapa zaw hing thluechiypa tana ama cuo!

Nama kha ca tlechuo te siepahruo cuo riypata a byithude lie caa chipa Abyipana Khazing ca thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue. Na Khazing ta Israel ming ca due yi te chuozaa ta a pahmang khing nakaw yi te, nama ta biedangpa hne adangna kha na tue riypata iema cunglieta siepahruo ta aca chi tli,” a ta.
Cakhutaata ama ta siepahruo kha siy talen zakha suokiy, rangpa-ue a hluv hringhruo, hne alung muosungpa zaw kha a pi: siepahruonung Sheba ta Siepahruo Solomon a pipa rangpa-ue haapa ca aw buo va tli.
Ca hlyitaw taata Huram hne Solomon changtaapa tie, Ofir taata siy a vya phyapa tie khata algum thing hne lungvaa muosungpa zaw kha ama vya phya.

Siepahruo ta Abyipaing hne siepahruo ing hlyidaw zaw kha cuose, hlaasatuv tie cuota tingtuo hne tingtuolepa zaw kha cuose, algum thing ca hmuo te a tue; cahaapa ca Judah ruo chunglie za hmung buo pata cuo vyi.
Siepahruo Solomon ta siepahruonung Sheba ca a khingpa, a ripa bangkhuo kha, ama ta siepahruo'a luo a vya phyapa laata a hluv vie karaa ta a pi. Cakhutaata a changtaapa tie hne khata a ruo luo a si.
Solomon'a luo kung kha chunglie a vya chiypa siy aa riyna ca talen zacaruv sawcaruv suocaruv ta a cuo;
hingpa hing sung a palipa tie hne chadaw tie ta ama chiykhyipa hlyi taata a ngiepa ta a cuo; Arabia siepahruo bangkhuo hne ruo uvtuv byi tie zaw ta siy hne ngu kha ama vya pi kalie.
Siepahruo Solomon ta a de ta depa siy ta phya a lepa zahning a tue; phya a lepa suokha lieta siy shekel zacaruv a chuo.
Ama ta a de ta depa siy ta phya zathung a tue; capa phya suokha lie ca ta siy shekel zathung a chuo; siepahruo ta capa tie ca Lebanon Atuv Ing chunglie kha a chi yi.
Siepahruo ta byithude lesapa suokha zaw kha ale nue ta tue te siy pathepa a pakhuv.

Byithude ca hlyidaw chuo caruv hne siy ta tuepa phyi pachungna hnyi te, capa ca byithude hneta aa pazue. A tunapa a kuo vyicuo lie ca kuv khangnapa tluo aw te, capa kuv khangnapa tluo athaa kaluo lie ca chingde zuv suohning aa daa.
Hlyidaw chuo kha lie, a kuo vyicuo lie ca chingde zuv suokha kaluo ta aw te chuo caruv lie ca chingde zuv suohraa hlyihning aa daa. Ca haapa ca khaapa ruo lie hmuo tue va yi.
Siepahruo Solomon panuo bangkhuo ca siy ta tuepa cuo te, Lebanon Atuv Ing lie biphie bangkhuo zaw siy pathepa ta tuepa a cuo. Solomon chuo ning ca daa ca khaapatahmuo za ri va yi.
Tahematapakieca siepahruo tiypalaw kha kung thung luo kha ta pata Huram changtaapa tie hneta Tarshish luo si taw te, siy, ngu, ale nue, azaw hne awtaw zaw kha a vya phya taw.
Cahaacata Siepahruo Solomon ta hnyirungna hne singna lie kha alyi cung siepahruo bangkhuo a lawpakhung diy yi.
Alyi cung siepahruo bangkhuo khata Khazing ta a palung chunglie a chipa singna kha thyi riypata Solomon kha ama pangie.
Iema mekaa cata, lasaw a vya phya yi te, siy hne ngu ta tuepa chechiy zaw, cawsie zaw, cehre zaw, rangpa-ue zaw, aruo zaw, hne laa kaapie zaw kha kung kha hnang kung kha ta a hluvsa ama pi.
Solomon ta aruo hne aruole cuota aruo-ing thawpaliy hne aruo thawhraa hlyihning a hnyi, capa tie ca aruole khypuv tie lie hne Jerusalem lie siepahruo'a lie kha a chi yi.
Zufrates taata Filistin ruo te, hne Izipt ruoriy te yalya lie a awpa siepahruo bangkhuo kha a uv yi.
Siepahruo ta Jerusalem lie kha ngu ca alung zaa ta cuose, sidar thing ca Shefelah lieta saikamor thing zaa ta cuose a hluv pata a tue.
Solomon cuota aruo zaw ca Izipt ruo hne ruo ting taa khata ama calyi.

Cakhutaata Solomon tuehriepa aa ngaapa tie, a hruothu taata a chuona te ca profet Nathan chuobie caa-uv, Shilon ming Ahijah ta a ripa profet bie caa-uv, hne Nebat sacapaa Jeroboam kawlieta profet Iddo muocuo caa-uv lie khana ama cape cuo va ma?
Solomon ca Israel ming bangkhuo cunglie, Jerusalem lie kha kung sawliy siepahruo a cuo.
Solomon ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a zie te a paa David khypuv lie kha ama paby; cakhutaata a sacapaa Rehoboam ta ama kha aa thle.
Rehoboam ca Shekhem luo kha a si, tahematapakieca ama kha siepahruo ta tue riypata Israel ming bangkhuo ta Shekhem luo kha ama si nakawta a cuo.
Nebat sacapaa Jeroboam ta capa ca a thyi tiyta (tahematapakieca ama ca Siepahruo Solomon'a taata aa ruonapa Izipt lie khana a za aw) Izipt ruo taa khata a kaa.
Ama kha bie taa yi te ama ku; cakhutaata Jeroboam hne Israel ming bangkhuo ca a vaw yi te Rehoboam kyihuo khata,
“Na paa ta ma hmang malie a pariy. Caacuonakawta na paa ta ma cunglie a khangpa re ruvpa hne hmangriypa hing malie pahypa vie la na re ma hrie aa,” ama ta.
Ama ta iema kyihuo khata, “Ning thung khutaata a vaw pakhaa tie ung,” a ta yi. Caacuonakawta cawsaa ca amaa diy.

Cakhutaata Siepahruo Rehoboam ta a paa Solomon a za hring ningta aa thaalie re zaa hriepa macuo tie kha ruena hie yi te, “Hingpa cawsaa tie bie palie riypa hing tuokhaatama ruena ina pi'a ung ciy?” a ta yi.
Iema ta ama kha palie yi te, “Hingpa cawsaa tie hing due yi cate, ama palung patluo yi cate biephaa ta na chaw kie yi ca, chuozaa ta na changtaapa ama cuo aa,” ama ta.
Cuorasala macuo tie ta ama pipa ruena kha thaw te, a khuvhyi ama'a lie re a hriepa mingnu tie kha ruena aa hie yi.

Iema kyihuo khata, “Kama'a lie, ‘Na paa ta ma cunglie a khangpa hmangriypa hing malie pahypa vie tie,’ naa tapa hingpa cawsaa tie hing tuokhaatama ma palie'a ung tapa kha ruena na pi tie ung,” a ta yi.
A khuvhyi ta a cuopa mingnu tie ta, “'Na paa ta ma cunglie hmangriy malie a khang, cuorasala nama ta malie pahypa vie tie,’ caa tapa cawsaa tie hing, ‘I kuvtie ca i paa sesie laata a chaa vie.

Caacuonakawta ata hing ca i paa ta hmangriy aca khangpa lie yi kha kama ta hmangriy ica khang chiy vie'a yi. I paa ta sungpe ta aca pasiypa-ya yi, cuorasala kama ta ca tluociekuo tana ica pasiypa-ya'a yi,’ ta pata palie tie yi,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta siepahruo ta, “Ning thungna lie kama'a luo a vaw pakhaa tie ung,” a tapa haata, Jeroboam hne cawsaa bangkhuo ca Rehoboam'a luo kha a ning thungna lieta amaa vaw.
Siepahruo ta aa hruosa pata bie a palie yi. Siepahruo Rehoboam ta kung uvthyi tie ruena pipa kha thaw te,

mingnu tie ta ama pipa ruena haa khata iema'a lie kha bie a ri. “I paa ta nama cunglie hmangriy aca za khang yi, cuorasala kama ta capa lie ca ica khang chiy vie'a yi; I paa ta sungpe ta aca pasiypa-ya yi, cuorasala kama ta ca tluociekuo tana ica pasiypa-ya yi,” a ta yi.

Caacuonakawta siepahruo ta cawsaa tie bie kha naathlie vyi, tahematapakieca Abyipata Shilon ming Ahijah kha hmuo pata Nebat sacapaa Jeroboam'a lieta a ripa bie kha patling sa riypata Khazing ta hing haa hingta a tue pata a cuo.

Siepahruo ta ma bie naathlie vyi tapa kha Israel ming ta ama hmung tiyta, siepahruo kha hing haa hingta ama palie, David chunglie khaapa cuvu ma ma hnyi? Jesse sacapaa chunglie ru hnyi vapuv. Vya Israel, nama thluodaa luo kha kaa diy tie ung. Vya David, na ingchungkhue ca namata tah mangchiy tie,” ama ta. Caacuonakawta Israel ming bangkhuo ca ama thluodaa luo kha amaa diy.
Cuorasala Rehoboam ta Judah khypuv tie lie a awpa cawsaa tie cunglie kha siepahruo a cuo.

Cakhutaata Siepahruo Rehoboam ta re pahrie sapa tie uvtuv a cuopa Hadoram kha a pathlie tiyta Israel cawsaa tie ta alung ta ama vaasa. Siepahruo Rehoboam ca Jerusalem taata a ruo riypata aa ruole kha a catlisa pata aa khang.
Caacuonakawta Israel ming ta David ingchungkhue ca ataning tepa hingta amaa du.
Rehoboam kha Jerusalem luo aa vaw tiyta, Judah hne Benjamin ingchungkhue taata a tlaw pa-ipa rieka thawzakha thawsawcari kha Rehoboam pena padaa pakhaa riypa hne Israel ming tuv riypata a pahmya yi.
Cuorasala Abyipabie kha Khazing cawsaapa Shemaiah'a luo a zuv te:
Solomon sacapaa, Judah Siepahruo Rehoboam hne Judah hne Benjamin ruo chunglie a awpa Israel ming bangkhuo kha chang tie yi,

“Abyipana hing haa hingta a ta: Nama tieriy ta a cuopa tie kha kya tuv'a va ung ciy. Cawsaa bangkhuo ama ing luo kaa diy yi se, tahematapakieca hingpa hmang hing kama'a taa tana a cuo,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Abyipabie kha naathlie yi te Jeroboam a du riypa taa khata ama kaa.
Rehoboam ca Jerusalem lie kha aw te, rie vena riypa khypuv tie kha a sa.
Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,
Beth-zur, Soko, Adullam,
Gath, Mareshah, Zif,
Adoraim, Lakhish, Azekah,
Zorah, Aijalon, hne Hebron tapa tie, Judah hne Benjamin ruo lie a awpa dungkhuopa khypuv tie zaw kha a sa.
A riekhuopiehu kha a cusa pata tue te, capa tie lie ca riekabyi tie kha a chi yi, cakhutaata sa, chiytiy hne mingsuvtiy kha a pacung.
Khypuv bangkhuo lie kha phya hne asyi kha a hluvsa chi te a cahrasapa khypuv ta a tue yi.
Israel ruo bangkhuo lie a awpa tluobyi tie hne Levi ming ta ama awna hmang cyicuo taa khata ama kha ama vya pangie.

Levi ming ta ama hnyi pakhawpa ruo hne ama chechiy kha sise yi te Judah hne Jerusalem luo kha amaa vaw, tahematapakieca Jeroboam hne a sacapaa zaw khata Abyipatluobyi re ama hriena taa khata phie yi te,
a sapa khahrungtluobu, mie-khachie, hne cuetaata zaw cuo khata amata tah tluobyi aa chi yi.

Abyipa, Israel Khazing kha a palung yalya ta a huvpa tie ca Abyipa, ama mingchingmingvuo Khazing'a lie hriykhungrina pihluo riypa khata Israel ming phang bangkhuo taa khata Jerusalem luo a vaw yi te iema kha ama ziy.
Judah pena kha cahra sa yi te, Solomon sacapaa Rehoboam kha aa bangsa pata ama chi, tahematapakieca iema ta kung thung chung ca David hne Solomon luopuv kha ama ziy.
Rehoboam ta Mahalath kha napuv ta a chiy, ama ca David sacapaa Jerimoth hne Jesse sacapaa Eliab sacanung Abihail tie ama sacanung tana a cuo.
Sacapaa pathung sapa te: Jeush, Shemariah, hne Zaham ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata Absalom sacanung Maakah kha chiy te ama ta Abijah, Attai, Ziza, hne Shelomith kha a sapa yi.

Rehoboam ta Absalom sacanung Maakah kha a hrangpa a napuv tie hne a nungthang tie laa khata a due vie (ama ta napuv pahraa hlyicari hne nungthang sawcaruv hnyi te sacapaa pakiy pacari hne sacanung sawcaruv a hnyi).
Rehoboam ta Maakah sacapaa Abijah kha a uvnu zaw hraw taa khata ama a paziytuv riypata a tue, tahematapakieca ama kha siepahruo pacuo sa riypata tingna a hnyi.
Singvaasa pata khuekhuo te, Judah hne Benjamin pe chunglie dungkhuo a hnyipa khypuv tie luo kha a sacapaa chekha zaw kha a chi yi, sa hne tiy kha tluotlingsa pata pi yi te napuv a hluvsa a chiypa yi.
Rehoboam uvna ca cu te a cahrale tiyta, Abyipaphungluo kha a thaw, ama hne Israel ming bangkhuo ta ama thaw.
Rehoboam siepahruo a cuona kung pangaa a ta pata, Abyipa'a lie kha zang tluo amaa tla li nakawta, Izipt Siepahruo Shishak ca Jerusalem kha
aruole thawhraa hlyihning hne aruo rieka thawsawcaruv hne khata a kya sichiy. Izipt, Libia, Sukkiim, hne Ethiopia ming rieka ri tie li kha ama'a lie ama kya si ra.
Ama ta dungkhuo a hnyipa khypuv tie kha la te, Jerusalem te a chiy.

Cakhutaata profet Shemaiah ca Shishak kawlie khata Jerusalem lie a hmyapa Rehoboam hne Judah byi tie'a luo kha a vaw te, iema kyihuo khata, “Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Niema ta ina thaw nakaw ung cata Kama zaw ta Shishak kuv luo kha ica thaw ra yi, a ta,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata Israel byi tie hne siepahruo ca iema hne iema kha a pane yi te, “Abyipaca aa dang,” ama ta.

Iema hne Iema amaa panepa kha Abyipa ta a hmung tiyta, Abyipabie ca Shemaiah'a luo kha a zuv te, “Iema ca amaa pane mangtli; para'a va yi ang, cuorasala lawna a cawta pi'a yi angte, i hihaana kha Shishak kuv ta Jerusalem cunglie lyisue pata cuo'a vyi.
Cadyiseca iema ca ama sii tana ama cuo aa, cakiedyina kama re hriepa hne ruohrang pena re hriepa aa nanangnazya kha ama pachang the aa,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Izipt Siepahruo Shishak ca Jerusalem luo kha a khaw te Abyipaing chunglie suethiy hne siepahruo ing chunglie suethiy zaw kha a la; zezaw bangkhuo kha a la diy. Solomon ta siy ta a tuepa phya zaw kha a la;
cuorasala capa zaw cuopa ca ta Siepahruo Rehoboam ta daa ta phya zaw kha a tue, cakhutaata siepahruo ing rievetuv byi tie kuv luo kha a pi yi.
Siepahruo ta Abyipaing chung luo aa ngie kyry khata rievetuv tie ta capa phya tie ca vya cyi yi te, cakhutaata rievetuv khuo chung luo kha ama kaakhyi pakhaa taw.
Ama hne ama kha aa pane nakawta para diy karuepa a cuo li riypata Abyipahihaana ca ama'a taa khata a maa te, ca hlyitaw taata Judah ruo chunglie hmang awtuvzya zaw a pha.

Caacuonakawta Siepahruo Rehoboam ca Jerusalem lie ca a pacu te siepahruo a cuo. Rehoboam ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa pathu ning kha kung sawliy kung kha a ta tli; Abyipata Israel phang bangkhuo chungtaata a ming china riypata aa tlawpa Jerusalem lie kha kung hraa hlyisariy siepahruo a cuo.
Ama ta pha lina kha a tue, tahematapakieca Abyipahuv riypa kha a palung lieta chi vyi.

Rehoboam tuesana tie a hruothu taata a chuona te ca profet Shemaiah hne profet Iddo tie chuorina caa-uv lie khana cape pata a cuo, cuo va ma? Rehoboam hne Jeroboam alalalie kha rie a tuvna a zaa pazue pari.
Rehoboam ca a mingchingmingvuo tie hne khata a zie te David khypuv chunglie kha ama paby; cakhutaata a sacapaa Abijah ta ama kha aa thle.
Jeroboam siepahruo a cuonapa kung hraa hlyicari kung lie kha Abijah ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu.
Ama ca Jerusalem lie kha kung thung siepahruo a cuo. A nung ming ca Mikaiah ta cuo te Gibeah ming Uriel sacanung ta a cuo. Abijah hne Jeroboam alalalie kha rietuvna a za aw.
Abijah ta a tlaw pa-ipa a rie phapa rieka thaw zapaliy hne khata rieduna luo ca a tha te, Jeroboam zaw ta a thaaruvpa rieka thaw zacari ta aa daakhuo ra.
Cakhutaata Abijah ta Efraim tluocung ruo lie a awpa Zemaraim Tluo pachung lie kha a daa te, “Jeroboam hne Israel ming bangkhuo ta na naathlie tie ung!
AbyipaIsrael Khazing ta Israel ming cunglie siepahruo cuona ca David hne a sacapaa zaw cunglie kha chuozaa cuota paciy biekuona ta a pi tli yi tapa kha pachang va ung ca ma?
Ata ca David sacapaa Solomon a siipaapa ta a cuopa Nebat sacapaa Jeroboam ta thu te a byipaapa kha aa du tli;
Solomon sacapaa Rehoboam ca panu te a palung a cahra hluo hne aa daakhuo khu hluo yi ta, cawsaa chiepa hne du a tle lipa tie kha athaalie a hmya yi te Rehoboam kha amaa du.
“Ata ca cawsaa hluvsa ung cate Jeroboam ta niema cuota a tuepa siy cuetaata kha namaa chipuo nakawta Abyipapena kha maa du khu aa ta pata nama rue.

Niema ta Abyipatluobyi tie, Aaron ciypathla tie hne Levi ming kha a cade ung cate, ruohrang ming haata niema'a na niema ta tluobyi namaa tue cuo va ma? Cue atungnupa sakha acuolikie tuvtungpa sa sariy hneta pathe sa riypata a vawpa mekaa ca khazing a cuo lipa khazing tie tluobyi ta amaa li.
Cuorasala kiema cuota ca Abyipaca ma Khazing tana a cuo, ama kha thaw vapuv. Abyipare hrie riypata Aaron ciypathla tluobyi tie kha hnyi yi pate, iema re a bya riypata Levi ming kha ma hnyi yi.

Maw tating hne zuo tating ta myirue panaana hne rangpa-ue pakhuvna ta Abyipakha ama pihluo, siy pathepa cabya lieta pachie paripa viechuo zaw kha pachie yi te, a zuo tating ta myi vuo the riypata siy myi vuona tung tie zaw kha ama mangchiy, tahematapakieca Abyipama Khazing malie a changpa khana ma hrie, cuorasala niema ca ama kha nama thaw tli.

Mang tie ung, Khazing ca ma hmiekung taata luo malie a chiytuv cuo te, a tluobyi tie ca niema a duna thuo pathyi riypata hmyakaa kha ama hnyi. Vya Israel ming, Abyipa, nama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing kha a du khah ung; tahematapakieca te khu'a va ung ciy,” a ta yi.
Jeroboam ta ngie a sapa, ama hnangluo taata a vya tuv riypa tie kha pathlie yi te, a rieka tie ca Judah ming hmieluo khata aw yi te, ngie a sapa tie ca ama hnangluo khata ama aw.
Judah ming ta mang yi te rie tie kha ama hmie ama hnang ta ama awpa kha ama hmung. Abyipakha u yi te, tluobyi tie ta hmyakaa kha ama tung.
Cakhutaata Judah ming ca rieduna ueryi ta ama khi. Judah ming ama khi tiyta Abijah hne Judah hmiekunglie kha Khazing ta Jeroboam hne Israel ming bangkhuo kha rie a pasung sa yi.
Israel ming ca Judah ming hmiekung taa khata a ruo yi te, Khazing ta Judah ming kuv chung luo a pi yi.
Abijah hne a rieka tie ta a hluvsa ama thie; a tlaw pa-ipa cawsaa thaw zapangaa ama thie.
Cahaacata Israel ming ca capa cuo lie ca a sung yi te, Judah ming ta ama te, tahematapakieca iema ca Abyipa, ama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing kha amaa buchuo nakawta a cuo.
Abijah ta Jeroboam kha a cade te ama'a taata khypuv tie kha a la: Bethel hne a khyta tie, Jeshanah hne a khyta tie, hne Efron hne a khyta tie kha a la yi.
Abijah chuo ning kha ca Jeroboam ta a cahrana kha hmung pakhaa khu va tli, Abyipata ama kha tuv te a thiy.
Cuorasala Abijah ca a cahra hryly. Ama ta napuv pahraa hlyipaliy hnyi te, sacapaa pakiy pahning hne sacanung pahraa hlyicaruv a hnyi.
Abijah a tuehriepa aa ngaapa tie, a awtuvzya hne a tuepa tie ca profet Iddo kawluo caa-uv liena cape pata a cuo.
Abijah ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a zie te, David khypuv lie kha ama paby. A sacapaa Asa ta aa thle. Ama chuo lie ca ruo kha kung hraa chung a die.
Asa ta Abyipaa Khazing hmungna lie kha a phapa hne aa dangpa kha a tue.
Ama ta ruohrang bienatluophie hne khahrungtluobu zaw kha para te, lungbang zaw kha pacing te Asherah tung zaw kha a hu pachung diy.
Cakhutaata Judah ming kha Abyipa, ama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing kha huv riypa hne a phungbie hne a nawbie zaw kha ziy riypata bie a pi yi.
Judah ruo chung khypuv bangkhuo lie khahrungtluobu hne rangpa-ue bienatluophie bangkhuo kha a para diy. Cakhutaata ama kuv rawlie kha pena ca a die.
Ruo a die chung khata dungkhuo a hnyipa khypuv tie kha a sa. Capa kung zaw chung ca Abyipata diena a pi nakawta rie hnyi vyi.

Ama ta Judah ming kyihuo khata, “Hingpa khypuv tie hing sa ung sala a dungkhuo, rievena ing, thlake hne a thlake hrena zaw ta dungkhuo ung siy; Abyipama Khazing kha ma huv nakaw ung ta ruo ca kiema huopa tana a cuo kalie; kiema ta ama kha huv pate, ama ta a kuo ting taata diena kha malie a pi,” a ta yi. Caacuonakawta iema ta sa yi te ama kiethaw.

Asa ta Judah taata phyalepa hne asyi a cyipa rieka thaw zathung, Benjamin taata phya a cyi yi te cuoti a kapa thaw zahning sawcari a hnyi yi; iema bangkhuo hing a riephapa hne a thaaruvpa rieka ta ama cuo.
Ethiopia ming Zerah ta rieka thawzakha hne aruole zathung hne khata iema a du riypata Mareshah te a vya pha.
Asa ta a du riypata pya te Mareshah lie Zefathah bawphie lie kha a tuv riypata hmang ama la.

Asa ta Abyipaa Khazing kha u te, “Vya Abyipa, nama cuota ca a thaaruvpa hne a thaa naapa a byapa kha aa nanangnapa aw vyi. Vya Abyipama Khazing kiema kha malie a bya tie, tahematapakieca kiema ca nama kha caa buchuo pate na ming tana hingpa cawsaa buvpuv hing a du riypata ma pyahnue tli yi. Vya Abyipa, nama ca kiema Khazing tana na cuo; cawsaa ta nama ca ca te khah yi se,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Abyipata Ethiopia ming ca Asa hne Judah ming hmiekunglie kha te yi te, Ethiopia ming ca amaa ruo.

Asa hne ama'a lie a awpa a rieka tie ta iema kha Gerar te amaa cade, Ethiopia ming ca pakha hmuo amaa ngaa lina te ta ama thiy; tahematapakieca iema ca Abyipahne a rieka hmielie kha ama kyi diy. Judah ming ta hruosue a hluvsa la yi te ama sikhyi.
Gerar cahriylie a awpa khypuv bangkhuo kha ama te; tahematapakieca iema cunglie khana Abyipaciyna a tlung. Khypuv bangkhuo ca ching yi te hruosue a hluvsa ama la.
Sahring a awnapa thluodaa tie zaw kha tuv yi te, tuv hne mie, hne kala-uv zaw kha a hluvsa la yi te ama sikhyi. Cakhutaata Jerusalem luo kha ama kaa.
Khazing thlaapa kha Obed sacapaa Azariah cunglie a tlung.

Asa a taw riypa khata cakuo te, “Na naathlie tie ung, Asa, hne Judah ming hne Benjamin ming bangkhuo: Ama hne nama aw chung bangkhuo ca, Abyipaca niema'a liena a aw, ama kha hmung'a ung cate, cuorasala niema ta ama kha nama thaw kieca, ama zaw niema kha aca thaw ra'a yi.
Cuo pasiypuv chunglie kha Israel ca Khazing hmisipa, hne pacuvtuv tluobyi hnyi li pata phungbie li pata a aw.
Cuorasala ama palung rie thyi ningta Israel Khazing, Abyipa'a luo kha amaa yi te, ama kha huv yi te aa pahmung sa yi.
Capa cuo ning ca ahunghmuo hnaanguosa pata cakuocavaa nguo pata cuo vyi, tahematapakieca hnaahnawna lepuv ta ruocaapa cawsaa bangkhuo kha a tlung yi.
Khazing ta palungriethyina phang ting iema kha ruvnaana a pi nakaw yi ta phang kha hne phang kha, khypuv suokha hne suokha kha a du yi te ama ra ama kyi diy.
Cuorasala niema ca nama palung cahra se! Nama kuv thaa naa khah se, tahematapakieca nama re ca lawmuo pipa tana a cuo aa,” a ta yi.

Asa ta Obed sacapaa Azariah ripa profet bie kha a thyi tiyta a palung kya cahra te, Judah hne Benjamin ruo chung bangkhuo hne Efraim tluocung ruo chungtaata a lapa khy tie bangkhuo lie duv aa chiypa kuvtuezuv bangkhuo kha a thaw diy. Abyipaing ingle khuo hmiekunglie a awpa Abyipabienatluophie kha a pare.

Judah ming hne Benjamin ming bangkhuo, hne Efraim, Manasseh, hne Simeon ming chungtaata iema'a lie khyche haata a awpa tie bangkhuo kha a pahmya yi, tahematapakieca Abyipaa Khazing na a awpuo tapa kha ama pachang tiyta Israel ruo taata cawsaa hluvpuv kha ama'a luo amaa ruo.
Iema ca Asa siepahruo a cuonapa kung hraa hlyipangaa kung thla thungna lie kha Jerusalem lieta amaa hmya.
Hruosue ama lapa cuetungpa zasariy hne tuv thawsariy ta capa ning lie ca Abyipa'a luo kha hriykhungrina ama pihluo.
Ama pathiypalung yalya hne ama hringna yalya ta Abyipaama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing huv riypata biekuona chung luo kha amaa ngie.
Abyipa, Israel Khazing a huv khing lipa ca mingnu cuose, nungpuv macuo cuose, capaa cuose, canung cuose thie pata a cuo aa.
Abyipa'a lie kha ueryi paringsa pata, khi-una ta, hmyakaa tung pata hne saakiy tung pata biekuona ama tue.

Judah ming bangkhuo ca ama tuepa biekuona lie ca ama palung a tluo, tahematapakieca ama pathiypalung yalya ta chiesana ca tue yi te, ama khingna yalya ta ama kha ama huv, ama kha hmung yi te Abyipata ama cahriy bangkhuo lie kha a hyna a pi yi.

Siepahruo Asa ca a nung Maakah kha hmuo siepahruo nung cuona taa khata a phie, tahematapakieca ama ta Asherah cuota duvsamakhiepa kuvtuezuv kha a tue. Asa ta capa zuv ca hupatyi te, dechi diy te Kidron cavaata lie kha myi ta a rue.
Cuorasala khahrungtluobu kha ca Israel ruo taata thaw pata pahli va yi. Cadyiseca Asa pathiypalung ca a chuo chung bangkhuo ta aa hmisi.
Ama ta a paa biekuona lasaw zaw, hne ama biekuona lasaw zaw ta a cuopa siy, ngu hne biphie zaw kha Khazing ing chung luo a chi diy.
Cakhutaata Asa siepahruo a cuo chung, kung sawthung kung pangaa chung bangkhuo kha rie a tuvna aw vyi.

Asa ta siepahruo a cuonapa kung sawthung kung caruv a ta ning kha Israel Siepahruo Baasha ca Judah a du riypa khata sithaw te, Judah Siepahruo Asa ruo chung luo kha ahunghmuo amaa ngie khu li riypata hne ama pya khu li riypata Ramah khy kha a sa.
Cakhutaata Asa ta Abyipaing suethiy taata hne Siepahruo ing suethiy taata siy hne ngu kha la te, Damaskas lie a awpa Siria Siepahruo Ben-hadad kha paphya te,

“I paa hne na paa alalalie adaapakhawna a za awpa haa khata, kama hne nama alalalie zaw adaapakhawna aw se; kama ta siy hne ngu kha ica paphya; si la, kama kha inaa sawse riypata Israel siepahruo Baasha hne namaa daapakhawna kha para tie,” a ta.

Ben-hadad ta Siepahruo Asa bie kha naathlie te, Israel khypuv tie a du riypata a riekabyilepa tie kha a pathlie yi. Iema ta Ijon, Dan, Abel-maim, hne Naftali lie chechiy chinapa khy bangkhuo kha ama te.
Capa ca Baasha ta a thyi tiyta, Ramah a sapa kha a cung te a re kha a taw.
Cakhutaata Siepahruo Asa ta Judah ming bangkhuo kha a chiy yi te, Baasha ta Ramah a sanapa alung hne thing zaw bangkhuo kha palaw yi te, Geba hne Mizpah kha a sa.

Capa cuo ning ca ta Judah Siepahruo Asa'a luo kha profet Hanani ca a vaw te, ama kyihuo khata, “Abyipana Khazing kha a ringchuo lipa cata Siria siepahruo kha naa ringchuo nakawta Siria siepahruo rieka ca nama'a taata amaa ruo mangtli.
Ethiopia ming hne Libia ming ca a le ciemuopa riekaphuv, aruole a hluv hringhruo hne aruo rieka a hluv hringhruo a hnyipa cuo va yi ma?

Tahematapakieca ama'a lie hmisi ta a palung a chipa tie kha cahra sa riypata Abyipaming ca chuelyi cung yalya luo hing aa khie. Hingpa hmang na tuepa hing ca na ngaa ciemuo; ata taa hingta a pathu pata rie na hnyi'a tli,” a ta.
Cakhutaata capa kawlie ca ta Asa ca profet cunglie kha a hi haa te, hrakyi khe te thaw chunglie a khung. Asa ta capa cuo lie ca cawsaa chekha kha a hrisaa yi.
Asa tuesana a hruothu taata a chuona te kha Judah hne Israel Siepahruo tie caa-uv chunglie cape pata a cuo.

Asa ca siepahruo a cuonapa kung sawthung kung cakyna lie kha a kuv lieta pasana a hnyi; a pasana ca ruv hryly te, capa a pasana kawlie ca ta hmuo Abyipakha huv li pata siyybyi tie'a taa khata byana kha a huv vie.
Cakhutaata Asa ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha aa zie, siepahruo a cuonapa kung sawliy kung khana lie kha a thiy.

David khypuv chunglie ama hrahring ta aa cupa thluo lie kha ama paby. Ziyhmyi a tue thepa tie ta ama tuepa ziyhmyi phangting ama padiepa chuochuo lie kha pazie yi te, ama pa-uvsathyina ta myiphya lesapa kha ama thaw.
A sacapaa Jehoshafat ta ama kha a thle te Israel ming hne a du riypata a thaa aa pacu.
Judah ruo chunglieta dungkhuo a hnyipa khypuv bangkhuo lie kha rieka chi te, a paa Asa ta a lapa Efraim khypuv tie lie kha khy a huopa riekaphuv a chi yi.
Abyipata Jehoshafat kha a awpuo, tahematapakieca ama ta a paa a za ziypa luopuv kha ziy te, Baal kha abie vyi,
cuorasala a paa Khazing kha abie te Israel ming ta ama ziypa luopuv kha cuo li pata a nawbie kha a ziy.
Caacuonakawta Abyipata pena ca a kuv chunglie a pacu sa. Judah ming bangkhuo ta Jehoshafat'a luo kha ngukhyi pi yi te, ama ca hnyirungsa te pa-uvsathyina a hmung.
A pathiypalung ca Abyipaluopuv lie kha a thaa tlung te, khahrungtluobu hne Asherah tung zaw kha Judah ruo chungtaata a pahli diy.
Siepahruo a cuonapa kung thungna lieta aa byi tie ta a cuopa, Ben-hail, Obadiah, Zekhariah, Nethanel, hne Mikaiah kha Judah ruo khypuv tie luo kha pacuvtuv ta a pathlie yi.

Iema'a lie ca Levi ming ta a cuopa Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, hne Tob-adonijah tapa tie kha aw ra yi te, capa Levi ming hne cata tluobyi Elishama hne Jehoram zaw ama aw ra.
Abyipaphungbie caa-uv kha a cyi yi te, Judah ruo chunglie kha ama pacuv; Judah ruo chung khypuv ting khata sile yi te cawsaa kha ama pacuv.
Judah ruo cahriylie a awpa ruo ting lie kha Abyipaciyna ca tlung te Jehoshafat kha rie a du va yi.
Filistin ming chekha tie ta Jehoshafat kha lasaw phya yi te, ngukhyi cuota ngu ama pi; cakhutaata Arab ming zaw ta tuvtungpa thawsariy zasariy hne mietungpa thawsariy zasariy ama pi.
Jehoshafat ca duvsaa ta a lesyi hryly. Judah ruo lie kha riekhuopiehu tie hne chechiy pacungnapa khypuv tie zaw kha a sa yi.
Judah khypuv tie chunglie kha hmang lesapa a hrie. Jerusalem lie kha rieka a thaaruvpa tie a hnyi yi.

Hingpa hing mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue ziy pata amaa rinapa ta a cuo: Judah ingchungkhue taata, a thaw ta a uvpa riebyilepa tie ca: riebyilepa Adnah, hne a thaaruvpa hne a riephapa rieka thaw zathung,
ama a paziy pata, riekabyilepa Jehohanan, hne a thaaruvpa hne a riephapa rieka thaw zahning thaw sawcari,
ama a paziypa ca Zikhri sacapaa Amasiah ta a cuo, a thaaruvpa rieka thawzahning hnyi te Abyipare lie pang a pipa ta ama cuo.
Benjamin ming Eliada ca a thaaruvpa rieka pakha ta cuo te ama'a lie ca liy hne phya a cyipa thawzahning ama aw;
ama a paziypa ca Jehozabad ta cuo te, ama'a lie ca rie tuv riypata cehre a cyipa thawzakha sawcari ama aw.
Siepahruo ta Judah ruo chung dungkhuopa khypuv tie lieta a chipa tie ri li pata hingpa tie hing siepahruo re a hriepa tie ta ama cuo.
Jehoshafat ca hnyirung laalaw te pa-uvsathyina a hmung; cakhutaata Ahab hneta achiyhiena luo ta a pazuena ama hnyi.

Kung a cawta a vya ru khutaata Ahab'a luo, Samaria luo kha a sibung. Ama hne ama'a lie a awpa a cawsaa tie cuo khata Ahab ta tuv hne cuetungpa a hluv hringhruo thiepa yi te Ramoth-gilead a kya du riypata a hry yi.

Israel Siepahruo Ahab ta Judah Siepahruo Jehoshafat kyihuo khata, “Kama hneta Ramoth-gilead luo na kya si ra'a ma?” a ta. Ama ta palie te, “Nama'a liena i aw, i cawsaa ca na cawsaa tana ama cuo. Rie a duna lie ca nama'a taa tana ma cuo aa,” ta pata a palie.
Cuorasala Jehoshafat ta Israel siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Abyipakha bie hiehriy taa tie,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Israel siepahruo ta profet tie kha pakiy yi te zapaliy ama ta, iema kyihuo khata, “Ramoth-gilead a du riypata ma si'a ma, acuolikie si'a va ang ma?” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Si tie; tahematapakieca Khazing ta siepahruo na kuv chung luo kha aca pi aa,” ama ta.
Cuorasala Jehoshafat ta, “Hingpa lie hing ma hiehriy khu riypa Abyipaprofet hrangpa aw va tli yi ma?” a ta yi.

Israel siepahruo ta Jehoshafat kyihuo khata, “Abyipama pahiehriy sa khu riypa a hrangpa pakha a aw kalie, Imlah sacapaa Mikaiah ta a cuo; cuorasala kama kawlieta a phapa ri buo li pata a chiepa dyi a ri nakawta ama ca i hue,” a ta. Jehoshafat ta, “Siepahruo ta cahaapa ca ri khah se,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Israel siepahruo ta byi pakha kha ku te, “Imlah sacapaa Mikaiah kha a catli pata a vawkhyi tie,” a ta.

Israel siepahruo hne Judah Siepahruo Jehoshafat ca Samaria khy luo a ngienapa lie, suo-aciyna lie kha ama caw kha a tue yi te, ama byithude lie kha amaa tu; profet bangkhuo ca iema hmiekunglie kha profetbiephu kha ama ri.
Khenaanah sacapaa Zedekiah ta thaa kiy kha a tue te, “Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: ‘Siria ming kha ama ra diy hluo li hingpa hingta de tie yi,’ a ta,” a ta.
Profet bangkhuo ta aa lu pata profetbiephu kha ri yi te, “Ramoth-gilead luo kha sithaw la kya te tie yi; Abyipana siepahruo na kuv chung luo kha caa pi aa,” ama ta.

Mikaiah ku riypata a sipa biephyatuv khata, “Mang tie, profet tie ta palung a lusa pata ama ripa bie ca siepahruo ta a tlechuo; nama bie zaw iema hrawlie pakha bie haa khata cuo sala tlechuo aa chiy pata ri ra tie,” a ta.
Cuorasala Mikaiah ta, “Abyipaa hringpa haata, i Khazing ta a ripa khana i ri aa,” a ta.

Siepahruo'a luo aa vaw tiyta, siepahruo ta ama kyihuo khata, “Mikaiah, Ramoth-gilead luo kha rie tuv riypata ma si'a ma, acuolikie si'a va ang ma?” a ta. Ama ta palie te, “Sithaw la kya te tie yi; iema ca nama kuv chung luo na pi pata ama cuo aa,” a ta.
Cuorasala siepahruo ta ama kyihuo khata, “Biehmisipa ta li pata ca khaapahmuo na ri li riypata Abyipaming ta yi khazaa ma bie ica pakuo sa aa,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Mikaiah ta, “Israel ming bangkhuo ca khietuv a hnyi lipa tuv haata tluocung lie amaa chepatlaa diypa khana i hmung; cakhutaata Abyipata, ‘Hingpa tie hingta byi hnyi va yi; ama cyicuo hingta diena hne ing luo cakuo yi se,’ a ta,” a ta.
Israel siepahruo ta Jehoshafat kyihuo khata, “Hingpa paa hingta ca rana kaw ta li pata kama tlechuo riypa profetbiephu suokha hmuo ri'a vyi,’ ica ta cuo va ma?” a ta.
Cakhutaata Mikaiah ta, “Caacuonakawta Abyipabie kha naathlie tie: A byithude cunglie Abyipaa tu te a cavyi a cacuo ta vuoruo rieka zaw amaa tupa na i hmung.

Cakhutaata Abyipata ri te, “Ramoth-gilead luo sithaw sala a thiy riypata Israel siepahruo Ahab ca ahungma a dungpahya'a ung ciy?’ a ta. Cakhutaata pakha ta bie suokha ri te a hrangpa pakha ta bie hrangpa suokha a ri ra.
Thlaapa pakha a vaw te, Abyipahmiekunglie kha a daa te, ‘Kama na a dungpahya'a ang,’ a ta. Abyipata ama kha, ‘Tuokhaatama na dungpahya aa,’ a ta.
Ama ta palie te, ‘Pya'a angte na profet bangkhuo tie hmya lie kha hangna thlaapa i va cuo aa,’ a ta. Cakhutaata Abyipata, ‘Ama kha na dungpahya khu aa; pya la capa ca va tue tie,’ a ta.
Caacuonakawta, mang tie, Abyipana hingpa na profet tie hmya lie hing hangna thlaapa a chi mangtli; Abyipana nama cuota rana kha a chi tli,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Khenaanah sacapaa Zedekiah ca Mikaiah'a luo kha a khaw te, a be tung te, “Abyipathlaapa ca nama'a lie bie ri riypata tuokhaapa luopuv tama kama'a taata a pya?” a ta.
Mikaiah ta palie te, “Ingchung chungching khuo lie a nu riypata naa ngiena ning lie khana na pachang aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Israel siepahruo ta bie pi te, “Mikaiah kha la ung la khypuv uvtuv Amon hne siepahruo sacapaa Joash'a luo kha pakaa tie ung;

cakhutaata, ‘Siepahruo na hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa paa hing thaw pathla ung la, diena hne i vya kaa pakhaana te ta sa hne tiy kha a caw vie ta za pi mya ung, a ta, ta pata va chang tie ung,’ a ta.
Mikaiah ta, “Diena hne na za kaa riypa kieca, Abyipata kama hmuo pata bie ri'a vyi,” a ta. Cakhutaata ama ta, “Thyi tie ung, cawsaa zaw, nama bangkhuo ta thyi tie ung!” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Israel siepahruo hne Judah Siepahruo Jehoshafat ca Ramoth-gilead luo kha ama sithaw.

Israel siepahruo ta Jehoshafat kyihuo khata, “Kama ca i hmingsuo a thle'a angte rietuvna chung luo i ngie aa, cuorasala nama ca na siepahruo caw kha a tue tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Israel siepahruo ca a hmingsuo kha a thle te, rietuvna chung luo kha aa ngie.
Siria siepahruo ta aa ruole riekabyi tie kha bie pi yi te, “Israel siepahruo ta li pata ca a le a caw ta pata ahunghmuo tuv'a va ung ciy,” a ta yi.

Aruole riekabyi tie ta Jehoshafat kha ama hmung tiyta, “Hingpa hingna Israel siepahruo ta a cuo,” ama ta. Caacuonakawta ama kha tuv riypata amaa maahnue ca Jehoshafat ca khi te, Abyipata aa bya. Khazing ta iema kha ama'a taata luohlaa luo aa da yi,
tahematapakieca aruole riekabyi tie ta ama ca Israel siepahruo ta cuo vyi tapa kha ama pachang tiyta amaa cadena taa khata ama kaase.

Cuorasala cawsaa pakha ta a cuoti kha a da te, e pawliy li pata a ka ca, Israel siepahruo ca a thaa buohryi hne a cacunghnaapakaw aa tawna lie kha a khe; caacuonakawta aa ruole a mawtuvpa kyihuo khata, “A maa la rietuvna chung taa hingta na pyakhyi tie, hmaa na i hmung,” a ta.
Capa ning ca rie-atuvna kha a ruv hringhruo, Israel siepahruo ca Siria ming kuo luo aa hyi pata dyipuo chawpa ta zuoluo te aw te ningtla pata a thiy.
Judah Siepahruo Jehoshafat ca Jerusalem lie a ing luo kha aa bangsa pata a pha pakhaa.

Hanani sacapaa profet Jehu ta ama kha a taw riypata pya te Siepahruo Jehoshafat kyihuo khata, “Cawsaa pha lipa kha a bya pata Abyipaa huepa kha due riypata a cuo ma? Cahaacata a cuo nakaw tana Abyipa'a taata hihaana ca na cunglie a tlung.
Cuorasala Asherah tung kha ruo chungtaata pahli cate Khazing huv riypa kha na palung lie na chi nakawta nama chunglie phana a cawta ca hmung pata a cuo,” a ta.

Jehoshafat ca Jerusalem lie kha khy a sa; cakhutaata Beer-sheba taata Efraim tluocung ruo te lieta a awpa cawsaa tie hraw luo kha cakuo te ama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing, Abyipa'a luo kha a vya kaakhyi yi.
Judah ruo chunglie dungkhuo a hnyipa khypuv bangkhuo lie kha, khy kha hnang khy kha ta, bieripatuv tie chi yi te,

bieripatuv tie kyihuo cata, “Nama hriepa kha a phasa pata rue tie ung, tahematapakieca cawsaa huota bieripana nama tuepa ta cuo li pata Abyipa huota nama tuepa tana a cuo; nama bieripana lie hing Abyipaniema'a lie a aw ra pari.
Caacuonakawta Abyipaciyna ca nama cunglie aw se; nama tuepa kha a raaring tie ung, tahematapakieca Abyipa'a lie ca biedangpa maana cuose, kuo ta a daana cuose, nawthuv ningna cuose aw vyi,” a ta.
Ca hlyitaw taata Jerusalem lie kha Jehoshafat ta Levi ming hne tluobyi tie hne Israel ingchungkhue luv tie a cawta kha Abyipahuota bieripatuv riypa hne tazaa a cyipa tie bie chipa riypata a chi yi.
Bie pi yi te, “Abyipaciyna cangta, hne zang tluo aa tlapa ta, hne pathiypalung yalya ta nama hrie riypata a cuopa ca;

thiyse palangna hne aa patuv pata cuose, phungbie hne nawbie kawlieta cuose, phungluo hne ziyphung kawlieta cuose, ama khypuv tie lieta a awpa nama tieriy tie'a taata tuokhaapa bie aa vaw zawta, Abyipahmiekunglie suena ama tue li riypa hne niema hne nama tieriy cunglie Khazing hihaana a tlung li riypata niema ta iema kha nama cawpa aa.

Mang tie, Abyipahmang bangkhuo kawlieta tluobyi le cepa Amariah ca niema cunglie tana a aw; siepahruo kawlie bangkhuo ta Judah ingchungkhue uvtuv, Ishmael sacapaa Zebadiah hne Levi ming ca nama byi ta ama cuo aa. Rie phasa pata hrie ung la, Abyipaca cawsaa phapa tie'a lieta aw mang sue!” a ta.
Capa khutaa cata Mob ming hne Ammon ming zaw ca Meunim ming chekha hneta Jehoshafat kha rie amaa du.

Biephyatuv tie ca Jehoshafat'a luo kha a vaw yi te, Jehoshafat kyihuo khata, “Edom ruo, riyliy khung luo taata cawsaa buvpuv ca nama a du riypata ama vya si; iema ca Hazazon-tamar lieta ama aw nguoluo tli,” ama ta (capa ca En-gedi khata a cuo).
Jehoshafat ca a thlaa a zang; Abyipahuv riypa khata a pachie te, Judah ruo chung bangkhuo kha sa a uv riypata a pathyi sa yi.
Judah ming ca Abyipa'a taata byana hie riypata amaa hmya; Judah khy ting taa khata Abyipahuv riypata amaa vaw.
Jehoshafat ca tlawhmie thaapa hmiekunglie, Abyipaing chunglie a hmyapa Judah ming hne Jerusalem ming chunglie kha a tu te,

“Vya Abyipa, ma mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing, nama ca vuoruo lie Khazing ta cuo va ca ma? Mingphang zaw pena bangkhuo ca nama na a uv ciy cuo va ma? Na kuv chunglie cahrana hne lesyina a aw nakawta ahungtahmuo caa daapuo khu va yi.
Vya ma Khazing, hingpa ruo lie khy a sapa tie kha na cawsaa Israel ming zaw hmiekung taata papya yi cate, capa ca na viesaapa Abraham ciypathla tie kha chuozaa ta na pi yi cuo va ma?
Capa lie ca khysa yi te, capa chunglie ca na ming riypata hmangpathepa kha sa yi te,

‘Ma cunglieta rana ta a cuopa zueziy ma, bieripana ma, acuolikie puvtlungna ma, cakuo ma, a tlung pata a cuo kieca, hingpa ing hmiekunglie, nama hmiekunglie hing a daa'a pate, ma ngiechina chung taa khata kya khi'a pate, na ming ca hingpa ing chunglie hing a aw nakawta, nama ta malie thyi'a cate malie na khuo aa,’ ama ta.
Ata hing, Ammon ming hne Moab ming hne Sier Tluo ming tapa tie, Israel ming Izipt ruo chungtaata ama vya pya ningta nama ta la riypa kha na thlu nakaw yi ta cahriy yi te ama para lipa tie khata
nama ta ru ta malie na pipa na huopa chung taa khata kiema kha a cade riypata a vaw yi te, tuokhaatama vieriy thung malie amaa nang tapa kha mang tie.

Vya ma Khazing, ama cunglie hing bieripana tue'a va ca ma? Tahematapakieca a du riypata malie a vawhnuepa hingpa cawsaa buvpuv tuv riypa hingta kiema ca thaazuo hnyi vapuv. Tuokhaatama ma tue aa tapa pachang vapuv, cuorasala ma ming ca nama cungliena ma khang thluo,” a ta.
Capa ning ca Judah ming bangkhuo ca ama haatiy tie hne ama napuv hne ama saata zaw hne khata Abyipahmiekunglie kha amaa daa.

Cakhutaata Abyipathlaapa ca aa hmyapa tie chungtaata Zahaziel cunglie kha a tlung; ama ca Zekhariah sacapaa ta a cuo, Zekhariah ca Benaiah sacapaa ta a cuo, Benaiah ca Jeiel sacapaa ta a cuo, Jeiel ca Mattaniah sacapaa ta a cuo, Mattaniah ca Levi ming Asaf sacapaa ta a cuo.

Capa paa ca ta, “Judah ming bangkhuo hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie, hne Siepahruo Jehoshafat ta naathlie tie ung: Abyipana niema'a lie hing haa hingta a ri: ‘Hingpa cawsaa buvpuv hing ciy khah ung, nama palung zaw ra khah se; tahematapakieca rie a duna ca niema huopa ta cuo li pata Khazing huopa tana a cuo.
Mawluo lie khiy zuv ung la zaa du ung; Ziz luo kya kiena luopuv kie khata kya kie'a yi te, niema ta Jeruel ruocaapa luo chiy hluo lie, bawphie a chuona lie kha nama hmung aa.

Hingpa rieduna hing niema ta nama tuv riypata cuo vyi; adaahmang kha la ung la, a dieta tah a daa tie ung, niema cuopa ta Abyipata tena a lapa kha mang tie ung, Vya Judah ming hne Jerusalem ming.’ Ciy khah ung, nama thlaa zaw zang khah se; mawluo khiy pya ung la iema kha a du tie ung, Abyipata aca awpuo'a yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Jehoshafat ca alyi luo kha a bung te, Judah ming bangkhuo hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa bangkhuo zaw kha Abyipahmiekunglie ca a bung diy yi te, Abyipakha amaa bie.
Cakhutaata Levi ming, Kohath phang hne Korah phang tie ca Abyipa kha ueryi a thyisa pata pathuosa riypata amaa daa.

Iema ca mawdiy ta thu yi te Tekoa ruocaapa luo kha ama si; ama cakuopuo pa khata Jehoshafat kha a daa te, “Vya Judah ming hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa zaw na naathlie tie ung! Abyipanama Khazing kha zang ung la pacu sa pata nama cuo aa; a profet tie kha zang tie ung,” a ta.

Cawsaa zaw kha ruena a hie khutaa yi ta, lesyi rungnaana chunglie ama kha pathuosa riypata Abyipa'a luo hlaa a sa riypa tie kha pachi yi te, rieka tie hmiekunglie ama cakuopuo pa khata, “Abyipa'a lie kha palungtluona bie ri tie ung, tahematapakieca aa hmangpa a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang,” ama ta.
Iema ta hlaa sa hne pathuosa kha ama pathu tiyta, Abyipata ngie pasa sa yi te, Judah ming a du riypata a vawpa Ammon ming, Moab ming, hne Sier Tluo ming kha amaa sung.
Caacuonakawta Ammon ming hne Moab ming ta Seir Tluo lie khy a sapa tie kha a du yi te ama para diy karue; Seir lie khy a sapa tie kha ama pahli diy khutaata iema hne iema a du yi te amaa naw diy.
Judah ming ca ruocaapa lie rievena ingsuo kha ama pha tiyta, cawsaazaapuv luo kha ama suo ca, thiy diy yi te ama riyy ca alyi lie kha ama laa patlaw thluo; pakha hmuo hya a zangpa aw va yi.

Jehoshafat hne a cawsaa zaw ca hruosue la riypata amaa vaw tiyta, sahring a hluv hringhruo, chechiy, cawsie, a muo sungpa chechiy tapa tie kha hmung yi te, ama phya khu lina te ta amaa la. Hruosue lana lie ca ning thung ama ru, tahematapakieca a hluv hringhruo.
Ning paliyna lie ca Berakah Bawphie lie kha amaa hmya; tahematapakieca capa lie ca Abyipakha ama pathuosa; caacuonakawta capa hmang ca ataning tepa hingta Berakah Bawphie ta pata ama ku.
Cakhutaata Judah hne Jerusalem cawsaa bangkhuo ca, Abyipata ama carie tie cunglie palung tluo riypata a tue nakaw yi ta, Jehoshafat kha hmaa pasa pata Jerusalem luo kha palungtluona hneta ama kaa.
Iema ca Jerusalem lie, Abyipaing luo kha tingtuolepa hne tingtuo hne a khang zaw tung pata ama pha.
Abyipana Israel ming cuota ama carie a tuvpa yi tapa kha ruo ting pe ting ta thyi yi te Khazing kha ama ciy.
Cakhutaata a Khazing ta a cahriy bangkhuo kha adingna cuo a pi nakawta Jehoshafat pena ca a die.
Cahaacata Jehoshafat ta Judah ruo kha a uv. Ama ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu ning kha kung sawthung kung pangaa ta cuo te, Jerusalem lie kha kung kiy kung pangaa siepahruo a cuo.
Ama ca a paa Asa luopuv kha ziy te, capa taa cata pie vyi, Abyipahmungna lieta a phapa kha a tue.
Cuorasala khahrungtluobu kha para vyi; cawsaa ta ama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing'a lie kha ama palung chi valie yi.
Jehoshafat tuesana aa ngaapa tie, a hruothu taata a chuona te ca Hanani sacapaa Jehu Chuobie lieta cape pata cuo te, Israel Siepahruo tie Caa-uv chunglieta khung pata a cuo.
Capa khutaa cata Judah Siepahruo Jehoshafat ca pha lina a tuepa Israel Siepahruo Ahaziah hneta aa pazue.
Tarshish luo a si riypa tiypalaw sana lie kha a pazue yi te, Ezion-geber lie kha tiypalaw ama sa.

Cakhutaata Mareshah ming Dodavahu sacapaa Eliezer ta Jehoshafat a du pata profet bie kha ri te, “Ahaziah kha naa pazue nakawta Abyipata nama tuepa kha a para aa,” a ta. Tiypalaw zaw ca ra te Tarshish luo kha si khu vyi.
Jehoshafat ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a zie te a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie, David khypuv lie kha ama paby; a sacapaa Jehoram ta ama kha aa thle.

Jehoram ta Jehoshafat sacapaa zaw ta a cuopa uvnu a hnyi yi: Azariah, Jehiel, Zekhariah, Azariah, Mikhael, hne Shefatiah zaw ta ama cuo; ama bangkhuo hingta Judah Siepahruo Jehoshafat sacapaa zaw ta ama cuo.

Ama paa ta iema kha siy, ngu, a muosungpa chechiy zaw, hne Judah ruo chunglie dungkhuo a hnyipa khypuv tie ta pata lasaw a hluvsa a pi yi; cuorasala pena ca Jehoram kha a pi, tahematapakieca ama ca sacapaa uvthyi tana a cuo.
Jehoram ca a paa byithude luo kha kie te aa pacu khutaata, a uvnu bangkhuo ca zueziy ta thie yi te, Israel byi chekha zaw kha a thie ra yi.
Jehoram ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu ning kha kung sawthung kung hning ta a cuo; Jerusalem lieta siepahruo kung cari a cuo.
Ama ta Ahab ingchungkhue tie ta ama tuepa haa khata Israel siepahruo tie luopuv kha a ziy; tahematapakieca a napuvnung ca Ahab sacanung ta a cuo. Ama ta Abyipahmungna lie kha a pha lipa a tue.
Cuorasala David'a lieta biekuona za tue te ama hne a ciypathla zaw kha chuozaa tana myi-ing ica pi'a yi a za ta nakaw yi khata Abyipata David ingchungkhue kha para khing vyi.
Ama chuo chunglie ca ta Edom ta Judah uvna kha a du te iemata tah siepahruo amaa chi.
Cakhutaata Jehoram hne a riekabyi tie ta aruole bangkhuo hne khata amaa khie. Ama hne a riekabyi tie a cadungpa Edom ming kha zuo ta pyahnue yi te a tuv yi.
Caacuonakawta Edom ta Judah uvna ca ataning tepa hingta aa du. Capa cuo taa cata Libnah zaw ta ama kha aa du ra, tahematapakieca ama ta a mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing, Abyipakha a thaw nakawta a cuo.
Ca hlyitaw taata Judah tluocung ruo lie kha khahrungtluobu zaw sa te, Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie kha zang tluo a tla lina luo a chiy yi te Judah ming kha luo a papie sa yi.
Elijah'a taata caa suokha a vaw te, “Na paa David Khazing, Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Nama ca na paa Jehoshafat hne Judah Siepahruo Asa luopuv kha ziy lipa cata,

cuorasala Israel siepahruo tie luopuv kha ziy pata, Ahab ingchungkhue ta Israel ming luo ama papie sapa haa khata nama ta Judah ming hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie kha luo papie sa yi cate, nama laata a pha viepa na uvnu tie, na paa ingchungkhue tie kha na thie nakaw yi ta,
mang tie, Abyipata na cawsaa zaw, na saata zaw, na napuv zaw hne na hnyipa bangkhuo cunglie kha puvtlung pasana a patlung sa aa.
Cakhutaata nama hrahring kha chungriy pasana hnyi'a cate, capa pasanapa kawlie ca ta na riy ca a zuo aa, a ta,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Ethiopia tie athaalie a awpa Filistin ming hne Arab ming zaw hihaana ca Jehoram cunglie kha Abyipata a patlung sa.

Iema ta Judah ming ca a khawhnue yi te ama la, siepahruo ingchungkhue hnyipa tana a cuo ta pata ama hmungpa bangkhuo hne a sacapaa zaw hne a napuv zaw kha sikhyi diy yi te, a sacapaa a syi cepa Jehoahaz ta li pata ca sacapaa pakha hmuo pangaapa siy va yi.
Hingpa zaw bangkhuo khutaa hingta Abyipata a riy lie kha a tluo khu li tlipa pasana a patlung sa.
Kung hning khutaata pasanapa nakaw ca ta a riy ca kya le te, cuo pasasa pata a thiy. A cawsaa zaw ta, a mingchingmingvuo tie cuota ama za tuepa myipung haapa kha tuepa va yi.

Siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu ning kha kung sawthung kung cari cuo te Jerusalem taata kung cari a uv yi. Thiy te ahunghmuo ama ngie chi vyi. David khypuv chunglie kha ama paby, cuorasala siepahruo tie thluo lie paby va yi.

Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie ta ama a thle riypata a sacapaa a syi cepa Ahaziah kha siepahruo ta ama pacuo sa; tahematapakieca Arab ming hneta arina hmang luo a vawpa rieka tie khana a sacapaa uvthyi vie tie bangkhuo kha a thie yi.
Ahaziah ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu ning kha kung sawliy kung hning ta a cuo; Jerusalem lieta siepahruo kung kha a cuo. A nung ming ca Athaliah ta cuo te, Omri samingta tah a cuo.
Ama zaw Ahab ingchungkhue tie ziypa luopuv kha a ziy ra, tahematapakieca a nung ca pha lina tuena lieta ruena a chetuv ta a cuo.
Ahab ingchungkhue ta ama za tuepa haa khata ama ta Abyipahmungna lie kha pha lina a tue; tahematapakieca iema ca a paa thiy khutaata ama a ra riypata ruena a pituv ta ama cuo.
Ruena ama pipa kha ziy te, Ramoth-gilead lieta Siria Siepahruo Hazael kha a du riypata Israel siepahruo Ahab sacapaa Jehoram hne khata ama si. Siria ming ta Joram ca hmaa paphya yi te,

Siria siepahruo Hazael a tuv ningta aa hmungpa hmaa kha patluo riypata Jezreel luo kha a si. Cakhutaata Ahab sacapaa Joram ca a pasa nakawta Judah Siepahruo Jehoram sacapaa Ahaziah ca ama kha mang riypata Jezreel luo kha a si.

Cuorasala Ahaziah tlabung riypa ca Joram a za tlaw ning hingta a tlung riypata Khazing ta lieriy a uopuo pacie tlipa ta a cuo. Tahematapakieca capa luo ca chiy te Jehoram hneta ama pya ning khata Ahab ingchungkhue para riypata Abyipata sathu a pathuv ciepa Nimshi sacapaa Jehu kha aa taw.
Jehu ta Ahab ingchungkhue tie cunglie bieripana kha patlung riypata a tue nguoluo ningta Ahaziah a mangchiypa Ahaziah uvnupa a sacapaa tie hne Judah byi tie kha a taw yi te iema kha a thie yi.

Ahaziah ca huv te, Samaria lie aa nu nguoluopa khata patuv yi te, Jehu'a luo kha a vawkhyi yi te ama thie. Ama ca paby yi te, “Ama ca a pathiypalung yalya ta Abyipaa huvpa Jehoshafat samingta tana a cuo,” ama ta. Cakhutaata Ahaziah ingchungkhue tie chungtaata ruo a uv khupa pakha hmuo aw va tli yi.
Ahaziah a nung Athaliah ta a sacapaa thiypa kha a hmung tiyta Judah ingchungkhue siepahruo chungkha bangkhuo kha thie diy aa nang.

Cuorasala siepahruo sacanung Jehoshabeath ta Ahaziah sacapaa Joash kha la te thie riypata a cuopa siepahruo saata tie'a taa khata a ruokhyi te ama hne a mangchiytuvnung kha aziena khuo lieta a chi yi. Cahaacata Siepahruo Jehoram sacanung Jehoshabeath, tluobyi Jehoiada napuv ta a cuopa cata, ama ca Ahaziah sietanung a cuo nakawta, Athaliah'a taa khata nu te, cata a cuo nakawta thie vyi.
Athaliah ta ruo chunglie siepahruo a cuo chung ca Khazing ing chunglie kha nu yi te, iema hne cata kung caruv chung a aw.

Cuorasala a kung sariyna kung lieta Jehoiada ca a rie kya pha te a za ta a uvpa riekabyi tie ta a cuopa Jeroham sacapaa Azariah, Jehohanan sacapaa Ishmael, Obed sacapaa Azariah, Adaiah sacapaa Maaseiah, hne Zikhri sacapaa Elishafat tie hne khata biekuona ama tue.
Judah ruo chunglie kha a khie yi te, Judah khy bangkhuo taata Levi ming, hne Israel ingchungkhue luv a cuopa tie kha pakiy yi te Jerusalem luo amaa vaw.

Cakhutaata Khazing ing chunglie kha cawsaazaapuv ca siepahruo hne khata biekuona ama tue. Jehoiada ta iema kyihuo khata, “Hingpa lie hingna siepahruo sacapaa a aw! Abyipata David sacapaa zaw kawlie biekuona a tuepa haata ama hing ta uv se.
Niema ta nama tue riypa ca hingpa hing tana a cuo: Sabbath ning ta rehrie riypata a vawpa tluobyi tie hne Levi ming che thung che kha ta thlake kha nama huo aa,
che thung che kha ca siepahruo ing lie kha aw'a ung cate, che thung che kha ca Hruopatu Thlake lie khata nama aw aa; cakhutaata cawsaa bangkhuo kha ca Abyipaing tlawhmie lie kha nama aw aa.

Tluobyi tie hne Levi ming ta li pata pakha hmuota Abyipaing chung luo kha pangie sa'a va ung ciy; iema ca amaa ngie aa, tahematapakieca iema ca ama pathe, cuorasala cawsaa hrangpa bangkhuo ca Abyipari khana namaa ngie aa.
Levi ming ta ama cehre a cyipuo pata siepahruo kha cadung'a yi te, ing chung luo a ngiepa ahung a cuo zawta thie pata ama cuo aa. Siepahruo ca aa ngie zaw a pya zaw ama'a lieta nama aw aa,” a ta.

Levi ming hne Judah ming bangkhuo ta tluobyi Jehoiada bie a pipa yi haa khata ama tue: ama cawsaa cyicuo kha sabbath ning re a hnyipa cuose a hnyi lipa cuose amaa vawkhyi kaluo; tahematapakieca tluobyi Jehoiada ta ama rehrie cuo a pachuopa tie zaw kha padiy sa va yi.
Tluobyi Jehoiada ta Siepahruo David huopa ta a zaa cuopa, Khazing ing chunglie a awpa asyi hne phya a lepa hne a cawpa tie kha riekabyi tie kha a pi yi.

Cakhutaata cawsaa bangkhuo ca ama kuv lie cehre a cyi kaluo yi te, bienatluophie hne ing kha sungluo kuo taata pathu pata chaluo kuo te ta a chi aa dungna te cadung pata, siepahruo huo riypata a chi yi.

Cakhutaata siepahruo sacapaa ca kya pyakhyi te byilakhuv kha pakhuv te biekuona a patue sa; siepahruo a cuo tli ta pata pathyi sa yi te Jehoiada hne a sacapaa tie ta sathu ama pathuv; cakhutaata “Siepahruo ca a chuo pasiy mang sue!” ta pata ama u.
Athaliah ta cawsaa zaw kha a ruole yi te siepahruo ama pathuosapa kha a thyi tiyta, Abyipaing chunglie cawsaa zaw'a luo kha aa ngie.

Capa lie ca siepahruo ca a chung luo a ngienapa aa tung athaalie kha a daa te, siepahruo athaalie ca riebyi tie hne hmyakaa a tungpa tie aw yi te, ruo chung cawsaa bangkhuo ta a law yi te ama hmyakaa ama tungpa, hne hlaasatuv tie ta ama tungpa chechiy hneta pathuosana pyi ama hryipa kha a hmung. Athaliah ta a caw kha thlaa te, “Rawna! Rawna!” ta pata a khi.

Cakhutaata tluobyi Jehoiada ta rieka tie uvtuv ta a chipa riekabyi tie kha kya pyakhyi yi te, “Ama kha byi zaw hraw taa khata kya pyakhyi tie ung; ahunghmuo cuose ama a ziypa ca zueziy ta thie pata a cuo aa,” a ta yi. Tahematapakieca tluobyipa ta, “Ama kha Abyipaing chunglieta thie khah ung,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta patuv yi te, siepahruo ing Aruo Thlake angiena chung luo kha cakuo te, capa lie ca ama thie.
Jehoiada ta ama hrahring hne cawsaa bangkhuo hne siepahruo alalalie kha iema ca Abyipacawsaa cuo riypata biekuona a tue.

Cakhutaata cawsaa bangkhuo ca Baal ing luo kha cakuo yi te ama pacing; a bienatluophie hne a kuvtuezuv tie kha ama dechi diy, cakhutaata Baal tluobyi ta a cuopa Mattan kha bienatluophie hmielie ca ama thie.

Moses phungbie lie aa capepa haata, hne David bie pina haa khata, palungtluona hne hlaa sapuo pata Abyipa'a luo myirue panaana pihluo riypata, David ta Abyipaing mangchiy riypata a chipa Levi tluobyi tie kha Jehoiada ta Abyipaing mangchiytuv ta a chi yi.
Tuokhaapa pathe lina ta a pathe lipa ahunghmuo Abyipaing thlake luo amaa ngie li riypata Abyipaing thlake tie lie kha thlake a huotuv a chi yi.

Cakhutaata riekabyi tie, byi tie, uvtuv tie, hne ruo chunglie cawsaa bangkhuo kha la yi te, iema ta siepahruo ca Abyipaing taa khata a zuvkhyi yi te chaluo thlake taa khata siepahruo ing luo kha amaa ngiekhyi. Siepahruo kha byithude lie ama patu.
Caacuonakawta ruo chunglie cawsaa bangkhuo ca ama palung a tluo; Athaliah kha zueziy ta ama thie khutaata khypuv ca a die.
Joash ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu ning kha kung sariy ta a cuo; Jerusalem lie kung sawliy siepahruo a cuo. A nung ca Beer-sheba ming Zibiah ama ta pata a cuo.
Tluobyi Jehoiada chuo chung ca Joash ta Abyipahmungna lie kha a phapa a tue.
Jehoiada ta napuv pahning chiypa te sacapaa zaw sacanung zaw a hnyi yi.
Cuo pachangta khutaata Joash ta Abyipaing pare riypata aa ting.

Ama ta tluobyi tie hne Levi ming kha ku yi te, “Judah khypuv tie luo kha si ung la kung kha hnang kung kha ta Khazing ing parena riypata Israel ming bangkhuo'a taa khata tuokaa khyi tie ung; capa ca a catli pata hrie tie ung,” a ta yi.

Caacuonakawta siepahruo ta tluobyi le cepa Jehoiada kha ku te, “Abyipachangtaapa Moses ta Israel ming cawsaazaapuv kyihuo ta biekuona thluodaa cuota na nama thu aa a tapa yi ngukhyi kha, Judah ruo hne Jerusalem khy ming'a taata khyi riypata, khaapanakawma Levi ming kha nama chang va?” a ta yi.
Tahematapakieca a pha lipa canung Athaliah sacapaa tie khata Khazing ing kha phipuo yi te, Abyipaing chunglie a pathepa chechiy tie zaw kha Baal cuota ama hmuo diy.
Caacuonakawta siepahruo ta bie a pipa haa yi khata thingkaw suokha sa yi te Abyipaing thlake ale lie khata ama chi.
Khazing changtaapa Moses ta ruocaapa lie Israel ming kyihuo ta nama khyi aa a za tapa ngukhyi kha Abyipaing luo vya cyi riypata Judah ruo hne Jerusalem chunglie kha thuo ama pathyi.
Luochiytuv tie bangkhuo hne cawsaa bangkhuo kha ama palung tluosa te ama ngukhyi kha vya cyi yi te thingkaw a bina te ta ama pasuo.

Levi ming ta thingkaw ca siepahruo aa byi tie'a luo kha ama vya cyi kyry ta a chunglie tuokaa a hluvsa a awpa kha ama hmung. Siepahruo caacapetuv hne tluobyi le cepa pa rawlie byi pakha ta thingkaw ca patlaw yi te a awna hmang luo kha ama chi pakhaa. Ning kha hnang ning kha ta cahaacata tue yi te, tuokaa a hluvsa ama hmung.

Siepahruo hne Jehoiada ta capa ca Abyipaing rehrietuv uvthyi tie'a luo kha pi taw yi te, iema ta Abyipaing kha pare riypata pazan tie, lettamaa tie, hne thaa hne daa re a hriepa tie zaw kha amaa hluo.
Cahaacata re hrie changpa tie ca ta hrie yi te, ama kuv chunglieta re hmaa si te, Abyipaing ca a tawpa haa khata a cusa pata ama pare.

Ama palang tiyta aa ngaapa tuokaa kha siepahruo hne Jehoiada'a luo vya cyi yi te, capa ca ta Abyipaing cuota biphie, biena cuo hne myirue panaana cuota biphie, phiethlalepa, hne bi zaw kha siy hne ngu ta ama tue. Jehoiada chuo chunglie ca Abyipaing chunglie kha a cuo aa hmuosa pata myirue panaana ama pihluo pari.
Cuorasala Jehoiada ca macuo te a kung tluv pata a thiy; a thiy ningta kung zakha kung sawthung a ta.
Israel ming chunglie cuose, Khazing hne a ing cuota cuose phana a tuepa a cuo nakawta siepahruo tie hrawlie David khypuv lie kha ama paby.
Jehoiada a thiy khutaata Judah byi tie ca a vaw yi te, siepahruo kha pa-uvsathyina tue yi te siepahruo ta ama bie ca a naathlie yi.

Iema ta Abyipa, ama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing ing kha thaw yi te Asherah tung hne kuvtuezuv tie kha amaa bie. Cakhutaata hingpa ama suena kawlie hingta Judah hne Jerusalem cunglie kha hihaana a tlung.
Abyipa'a luo kaakhyi pakhaa riypata profet kha a pathliesue yi, cuorasala siysaa ri va yi.

Cakhutaata tluobyi Jehoiada sacapaa Zekhariah kha Khazing thlaapa ta tlungsue te, cawsaa zaw cunglie kha a daa te, “Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Khaapanakawma Abyipanawbie kha nama para? Capa nakaw ca tana nama hnyirung khu va. Abyipakha nama thaw nakawta ama ta aca thaw ra yi,” a ta.
Cuorasala raw yi te siepahruo bie pina ta ama ca Abyipaing tlawhmie lie kha alung ta ama vaa.
Siepahruo Joash ta Zekhariah a paa Jehoiada ta a cunglie a za tuepa duena kha a thyi li tli pata a sacapaa kha a thie. A thiy'a nangpa khata, “Abyipata hmung sala phuv la mang sue!” a ta.

Kung a chuona lie kha Siria rieka ta Joash kha amaa kya du. Judah hne Jerusalem luo kha a vaw yi te cawsaa zaw hraw taa khata byi tie bangkhuo kha thie diy yi te, ama lapa hruosue bangkhuo kha Damaskas siepahruo'a luo kha ama paphya.

Siria siepahruo ca rieka a cawta hneta dyi aa vaw raalaa pata Abyipata iema kuv chung luo ca riekabuv a lesapa kha a pi yi, tahematapakieca iema ta Abyipaama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing kha ama thaw nakawta a cuo. Cahaacata Joash cunglie kha bieripana ama hnyi.

Iema ta ama kha a ruvsa pata hmaa aa hmung pata ama sise, tluobyi Jehoiada sacapaa thiyse kawlie khata a changtaapa tie ta raw yi te a iehmang cunglieta ama thie. Caacuonakawta thiy te David khypuv chunglie kha ama paby, cuorasala siepahruo tie thluo lie kha paby va yi.
Ama a rawpa tie ca Ammon ming Shimeath sacapaa Zabad, hne Moab ming Shimrith sacapaa Jehozabad ta ama cuo.
A sacapaa zaw kaw, hne ama a du pata ama ripa bie tie, hne Khazing ing a sapakhaana kaw ca Siepahruo tie caa-uv Pasiesana lie tana ama cape. Cakhutaata a sacapaa Amaziah ta ama kha aa thle.
Amaziah ca kung kiy kung pangaa a ta pata siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu; Jerusalem lie kha kung kiy kung caky siepahruo a cuo. A nung ming ca Jehoaddan ta cuo te, Jerusalem khy ming ta a cuo.
Ama ca Abyipahmungna lieta a phapa kha a tue, cuorasala pathiypalung hmisi ta cuo vyi.
Siepahruo nawhnyina kha a kuv cunglie a cusa pata a aw pahne ta siepahruo a cuopa a paa a thiepa a changtaapa tie kha a thie yi.

Cuorasala Moses phungbie caa-uv chunglieta aa capepa, “Paa tie ca saata zaw cuopa ta thiepa cuo li'apa yi ta, saata zaw kha paa zaw cuopa ta thiepa cuo'a va yi, cuorasala ahunghmuo cuose iema suena kawlie tana thiepa ama cuo aa,” tapa Abyipabiepina haata, ama saata zaw kha thie va yi.

Amaziah ta Judah cawsaa kha pahmya yi te, Judah hne Benjamin bangkhuo kha a thaw ta a uvpa, hne a za ta a uvpa riekabyi tie rawlie kha ama mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue ziy pata a chi yi. Kung kiy taata a cung luo cawsaa kha pahmya yi te, asyi hne phya a hmuo khupa, rie a tuv khu riypa, a tlaw pa-ipa rieka thaw zathung ama awpa kha a hmung.
Cakhutaata ngu talen zakha ta Israel taata a thaaruvpa rieka ting kha aa hluo.

Cuorasala Khazing cawsaapa pakha kha a vaw te ama kyihuo khata, “Vya Siepahruo, Israel rieka tie hing nama'a lie pasi sa ra khah yi, tahematapakieca Abyipaca Israel ming a cuopa hingpa Efraim ming bangkhuo hne hingta aw vyi.

Capa laata ca, namata tah si la tuv tie yi; rietuvna lie kha cahra tie, caacuolikieca Khazing na na carie tie hmiekunglie kha caa thaw aa; tahematapakieca Khazing na a bya khuna hne thaw khuna cahrana a hnyi,” a ta.

Amaziah ta Khazing cawsaapa kyihuo khata, “Cuorasala Israel rieka tie i pipa yi talen zakha kha tuokhaatama ma tue aa?” a ta. Khazing cawsaapa ta, “Abyipaca hingpa laa hingta a hluv vie caa pi khupa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Amaziah ta Efraim taata ama'a luo a vawpa rieka tie kha ing luo a pakaa sa yi. Caacuonakawta iema ca Judah ming cunglie ama hi haa hringhruo cangta ing luo kha ama kaa.
Amaziah ca a rie a papha te, a cawsaa tie kha pyakhyi yi te, Paciy Bawphie luo kha si te Seir ming cawsaa thawkha kha a thie yi.
Judah ming ca ta a hrangpa thawhraa kha ama hringpa ta patuv yi te, lungkuo daw luo kha kiekhyi yi te, amaa phawchi diy riypata lungkuo daw taa cata ama nuopathla.
Cuorasala Amaziah ta ama'a lie pasi sa ra li pata a pakaa sapa rieka tie khata Judah khypuv tie kha Samaria taata Beth-horon te ching yi te, cawsaa thawthung thie yi te hruosue a hluvsa ama la.
Amaziah ca Edom ming thiena taata a vya kaana taa khata Sier ming khazing tie kha a vya phyale te a khazing ta aa chi yi, abie yi te a pihluo yi.

Abyipa ca Amaziah cunglie kha a hi haa te profet pakha kha pathlie te ama ca ta, “Khaapanakawma iema cawsaa tie hmuo nama kuv chungtaata a palaw sa khu lipa khazing, mingphang hrang tie khazing ca na pangie yi,” a ta.
