Bie a ri nguoluopa ca ta siepahruo ta, “Nama ca siepahruo ruena pituv ta ca tue kanaa puv? Duo tie! Khaapanakawma thie pata na cuo aa?” a ta. Caacuonakawta profet ca a duo, cuorasala, “Khazing ta nama para riypa kha bie a chi tli tapa i pachang, tahematapakieca nama ta hingpa hing tue cate ruena ica pipa kha naathlie vaciy,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Judah siepahruo Amaziah ta khuekhuona tue te Jehu sacapaa Jehoahaz a sacapaa Siepahruo Joash kyihuo khata, “A vaw la hmiedesuo ta a mang pachiy'a puv,” a ta.

Israel siepahruo Joash ta Judah siepahruo Amaziah kha bie taa te, “Lebanon tluo cunglie a awpa ahling kung ta Lebanon tluo cunglie a awpa sidar kung kha bie taa te, ‘Na sacanung kha i sacapaa napuv riypata na pi tie,’ a ta; cuorasala Lebanon lie saahruo sakha ta vya sisue te ahling kung ca a chaakabe diy.

Nama ta, ‘Mang tie, Edom ca i te tli,’ ta cate a pale cate ahruo na tle. Ata hing ca ing lie kha aw thluo tie; khaapanakawma naa liena riypa hne nama hneta Judah kha a liekhyi riypata ruvnaana ca na pathu khing?” a ta.
Cuorasala Amaziah ta naathlie vyi, tahematapakieca iema ta Edom ming khazing tie kha ama huv nakawta iema kha ama carie tie kuv cung luo pi riypata Khazing ta a tuepa tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Israel siepahruo Joash ca sithaw te, ama hne Judah Siepahruo Amaziah ca Judah ruo Beth-shemesh rie a duna lie kha a hmiepachaw pata ama aw.
Israel ta Judah kha a te; ama cyicuo ta ing luo amaa ruo.

Israel siepahruo Joash ta Ahaziah sacapaa Joash sacapaa Judah siepahruo Amaziah ca Beth-shemesh lieta a patuv; Jerusalem luo kha sikhyi te Jerusalem khypuv dungkhuo ca daw zapaliy, Efraim Thlake taata Akiy Thlake te, a pacing.

Ama ta Khazing ing chunglie a hmungpa siy hne ngu, hne biphie bangkhuo kha a la, Obed-edom kha a patuv puo; siepahruo ing lie suethiy bangkhuo zaw kha a la, cawsaa kha hruo ta a da yi te, ca khutaata Samaria luo kha a kaa.
Judah siepahruo Joash sacapaa siepahruo Amaziah ca Israel siepahruo Jehoahaz sacapaa siepahruo Joash a thiy khutaata kung hraa hlyipangaa a hring.
Amaziah tuesana aa ngaapa, a hruothu taata a chuona te ca Judah hne Israel Siepahruo tie Caa-uv chungliena ama cape cuo va ma?
Abyipa'a taata Amaziah aa pali taa khata Jerusalem lieta ama kha raw yi te Lakhish luo kha aa ruo. Cuorasala Lakhish luo kha cawsaa cade sa yi te capa lie ca ama thie.
Aruo ta vya phya pakhaa yi te, David khypuv lie, a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lieta ama paby.
Cakhutaata Judah cawsaa bangkhuo khata kung hraa hlyicaruv a tapa Uzziah kha la yi te a paa Amaziah a thle riypata siepahruo ta ama pacuo sa.
Siepahruo kha a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie aa zie khutaata Eloth kha sa hru te Judah huopa ta a tue pakhaa.
Uzziah ca kung hraa hlyicaruv a ta pata siepahruo cuo hruo a thu te, Jerusalem lieta kung sawngaa kung hning siepahruo a cuo. A nung ming ca Jekoliah ta cuo te Jerusalem khy ming ta a cuo.
A paa Amaziah ta a za tuepa haa khata Abyipahmungna lie a phapa kha a tue.
Khazing ciyna a pacuvtuv Zekhariah chuo lie kha ama hrahring ta Khazing huv te, Abyipaa huv chung palang kha Khazing ta a pahnyirung sa.

Pya te Filistin ming hneta rie amaa du, Gath dungkhuo lungruetlepie, hne Jabneh hne Ashdod dungkhuo lungruetlepie zaw kha a pacing diy; cakhutaata Ashdod ruo chunglie hne Filistin ming hrawlie, hmang hrang lie zaw kha khypuv a sale.
Khazing ta Filistin ming a duna lie, Gur-baal lie a awpa Arab ming a duna lie, hne Meun ming a duna lie zaw kha aa bya.
Ammon ming ta Uzziah luo kha ngukhyi ama pi; ama ca a cahrasa nakawta Izipt ruoriy te ta a ming a pathuo.
Ca hlyitaw taata Uzziah ta Jerusalem Akiy Thlake lie, Bawphie Thlake lie, hne khy dungkhuo aa kyinapa lie zaw kha ingsuo sa te a dungkhuo yi.

Shefelah hne ase ruo lie kha sahring a hluvsa a hnyi nakawta ruocaapa lie kha ingsuo zaw sa te takhue a hluvsa a cu, luthlu a khingsapa a cuo nakawta tluoruo lie hne alyi phana ruo lie kha luthlutuv hne mingsuv nawtuv zaw kha a hnyi yi.

Ca hlyitaw taata, Uzziah ca ta, siepahruo riebyilepa tie chungtaata pakha ta a cuopa Hananniah uvna rawlie kha caa capetuv Jeiel hne byi ta a cuopa Maaseiah ta a phuv ta che yi te ama chipa, rie a tuv khu riypa riekaphuv zaw kha a hnyi yi.
Mingchingmingvuo tie ingchungkhue cyicuo luv ta a cuopa, a thaaruvpa rieka ama bangkhuo ta thawhning zacaruv ama ta.
Iema kuv rawlie ca rie tuvna lie a cahrasapa, carie tie a du pata siepahruo a bya khu riypa rieka thawzathung sawsariy zapangaa ama aw.
Uzziah ta rieka tie bangkhuo kha phya, asyi, thaalakhuv, thaa buohryi, liy, sie riypa alungcyicuo kha a ring yi.

Kuvzung a thepa tie ta ama sapa, cuoti hne alung lesapa tie zaw kana riypa seh zaw kha Jerusalem ingsuo cung a kiy tie lie kha a chi yi. Cakhutaata ama ca a cahrasana te ta kharuehaa aa chiy pata a byapa a cuo nakawta a ming ca khy ting ta a pathuo.

Cuorasala a kya cahra vie le tiyta ama rana riypata a hruo a tle vie le. Tahematapakieca Abyipaa Khazing'a lie kha zang tluo aa tla li pata aw te, bienatluophie lie rangpa-ue pihluo riypata Abyipabiena-ing chung luo kha aa ngie.
Cuorasala tluobyi Azariah ta a riephapa tluobyi sawcari hne khata a hnang ama ziy;

siepahruo Uzziah ca a daakhuo yi te, “Uzziah, Abyipa'a luo pihluo riypa hing nama re ta cuo vyi, pihluona tue riypata pathe sapa, Aaron ciypathla tluobyi tie re tana a cuo. Hmangpathepa taa hingta pya tie, tahematapakieca a cuo lipa hmang na na tue tli, hingpa hingta AbyipaKhazing'a taata pa-uvsathyina ca phya'a vyi,” ama ta.

Ca tiyta Uzziah ca a hi a haa. Rangpa-ue pihluo na riypa daa pakaa kha a kuv lie a hrie te, tluobyi tie cunglie kha a hi a haa tiyta, Abyipaing chung, rangpa-ue bienathluodaa athaalie, tluobyi tie hmiekunglie kha a puo lieta caahminghmaa pasana a pya.

Tluobyi le cepa Azariah hne tluobyi bangkhuo ta ama kha ama mang tiyta a puo lie caahminghmaa pasana a hnyi thluo. Iema ta ama kha a catli pata papya yi te, ama zaw a catli pata a pya, tahematapakieca Abyipata ama kha a tuv tli.

Siepahruo Uzziah ca a thiyna te ta caahminghmaa pasana a hnyi, caahminghmaa pasana a hnyi nakawta Abyipaing taa khata che pata cuo te, ing hrang lieta a aw. A sacapaa Jotham ta siepahruo ing kha mangchiy te, Israel cawsaa kha a uv yi.
Uzziah tuesana aa ngaa kaliepa tie ca a hruothu taata a chuona te ta Amoz sacapaa profet Isaiah ta a cape.

Uzziah ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a zie te, “Ama ca caahminghmaa pasana a hnyipa tana a cuo,” ta pata ripa a cuo nakawta a mingchingmingvuo tie athaalie siepahruo tie ta ama hnyipa alyi lie kha ama paby. A sacapaa Jotham ta ama kha aa thle.
Jotham ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu ning kha kung kiy kung pangaa ta a cuo; Jerusalem lieta kung hraa hlyicaruv siepahruo a cuo. A nung ming ca Jerushah ta cuo te Zadok sacanung ta a cuo.
A paa Uzziah ta a za tuepa haa khata Abyipahmungna lie kha a phapa a tue, Abyipabiena-ing chung luo kha ca a ngie pata suena tue vyi. Cuorasala cawsaa ca pha lina kha ama tue pari thluo.
Abyipaing cunglie thlake kha sa te Ofel dungkhuo tlepie cunglie kha ing a sa chiy vie.
Ca hlyitaw taata Judah tluocung ruo chunglie kha khypuv zaw sa te, thing zingna khyhmuo ruo lie kha cariekyikuo hne ingsuo zaw a sa.

Ammon ming siepahruo tie hne khata a du yi te a te yi. Capa kung ning ca Ammon ming ta ama kha ngu talen zakha, jungsacuo kor thawhraa hne barli kor thawhraa ama pi. Ammon ming ta a kung hningna lie hne a kung thungna lie zaw kha capa zaa ca ama pi.
Jotham ca Abyipaa Khazing hmiekunglie a sina luo kha aa hmuo nakawta a cahrale.
Jotham tuesana aa ngaapa, hne a rieduna hne a sizya bangkhuo ca Israel hne Judah Siepahruo tie Caa-uv chunglieta cape pata a cuo.
Ama ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu ning kha kung kiy kung pangaa ta a cuo; Jerusalem lieta kung hraa hlyicaruv siepahruo a cuo.
Jotham ta a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a zie te David khypuv chunglie kha ama paby; cakhutaata a sacapaa Ahaz ta aa thle.

Ahaz ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu ning kha kung kiy ta a cuo; Jerusalem lieta siepahruo kung hraa hlyicaruv a cuo. A mingchingmingvuo a cuopa David ta a za tuepa haa khata Abyipahmungna lieta a phapa tue vyi.
Cuorasala Israel ming siepahruo tie luopuv kha a ziy. Baal tie cuota patlepa kuvtuezuv zaw kha a tue;

cakhutaata Hinnom sacapaa bawphie lie kha rangpa-ue pihluona tue te, Abyipata Israel ming hmiekung taata aa cadepa yi mingphang tie ta ama tuepa duvsamakhiepa hmang kha tue te, a sacapaa tie kha myi ta a rue yi.
Khahrung tluobu cunglie, tluo cunglie, hne thingkung hringpa raw mekaa lie kha hriykhungrina hne pihluona a tue.

Caacuonakawta Abyipaa Khazing ta ama kha Siria siepahruo kuv luo pi te, a te nakaw yi ta, a cawsaa hluvsa kha sii ta a da yi te Damaskas luo a sikhyi yi. Israel siepahruo kuv chung luo zaw kha pi pata cuo te Israel siepahruo ca ta te yi te a hluvsa a thie yi.
Abyipaama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing kha ama thaw nakawta Remaliah sacapaa Pekah ta Judah ruo chunglie kha ning kha ta ting kha thawkiy thie yi te, ama bangkhuo ta cawsaa riephapa selaw ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata Efraim cawsaa thaaruvpa Zikhri ta siepahruo sacapaa Maaseiah, siepahruo ing riekabyipa Azrikam, hne naw hnyina luo ta siepahruo a paziypa Elkanah zaw kha a thie yi.
Israel ming ta ama tieriy thaw zahning kha sii ta amaa da, canung tie, sacapaa tie, hne sacanung tie; hruosue zaw a hluvsa la yi te Samaria luo ama phyale.

Cuorasala Oded ama tapa Abyipaprofet pakha kha capa lie ca a aw; ama ta Samaria taata a vawpa rieka tie a taw riypa khata pya te, iema kyihuo khata, “Abyipanama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing kha Judah ming'a lieta a hi a haa nakawta iema kha nama kuv chung luo aca pi yi, cuorasala niema ta iema kha vuoruo te a phapa hihaana hneta nama thie.
Ata hing niema ta Judah ming hne Jerusalem ming ca, capaa hne canung hneta sii ta a ziy namaa ting. Niema haw Abyipanama Khazing cunglieta nama suenapa aw ra va ma?
Na naathlie tie ung, nama tieriy tie'a taata nama hruocawsaa tie hing paphya pakhaa tie ung, tahematapakieca Abyipahihaana na nama cunglie a tlung,” a ta.

Ca hlyitaw taata, Efraim byi ta a cuopa tie, Johanan sacapaa Azariah, Meshillemoth sacapaa Berekhiah, Shallum sacapaa Jehizkiah, hne Hadlai sacapaa Amasa zaw ta rietuvna taata a vawpa tie kha a daakhuo yi te,

iema kyihuo khata, “hruocawsaa tie kha hingpa luo hing vya chiykhyi khu va ung ciy, tahematapakieca ata lie ma suena hne ma phung parana cunglie hingna Abyipacunglie sue khang chiy vie malie namaa nang. Tahematapakieca ma suena hing a lesa mangtli, cakhutaata Israel ming cunglie ciy aa chiysapa hihaana na a aw,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta rieka tie ca ta hruocawsaa tie hne hruosue zaw ca byi tie hne cawsaazaapuv hmiekunglie kha ama thuse siy.

Cakhutaata ming ri pata re changpa tie ta a daa yi te hruocawsaa tie ca la yi te, caw li pata a awpa tie kha hruosue chung taa khata cawsie ama pi; caw ama tue, phanaah ama pi, sa hne tiy ama pi, chiytiy ama pathuv; iema hraw taata a thaa naapa tie kha laa ta phya yi te, iema ca ama tieriy tie awnapa tungkung khypuv ama tapa Jeriko khy luo kha ama sikhyi. Cakhutaata iema ca Samaria luo kha ama kaa.
Capa cuo ning ca Siepahruo Ahaz ta Assiria siepahruo'a luo kha byana a hie riypata cawsaa a pathlie yi.
Tahematapakieca Edom ming ta Judah ruo ca ching yi te, te yi te sii ta amaa da.

Cakhutaata Filistin ming ta ningchiyluo tluo thabaw ruo tie hne ningtlaluo Negeb ruo tie kha tuv yi te, Beth-shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Soko hne a khyta tie, Timnah hne a khyta tie, hne Gimzo hne a khyta tie zaw kha la yi te capa lie ca khy ama sa.
Abyipata Israel siepahruo Ahaz kawlie khata Judah ruo ca a pachung, tahematapakieca Judah ruo chunglie kha a cadangna aw li pata Abyipa'a lie kha zang tluo aa tla li pata a hring nakawta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Assiria siepahruo Tilgath-pilneser khata a vawhnue te a thaa patlung cuopa ta a hrisaa pali.
Ahaz ta Abyipaing hne siepahruo ing hne byi tie kha ching yi te ama hrue diy; Assiria siepahruo kha ngukhyi a pi raalaa pata capa ca ta ama kha a bya vyi.
Hingpa siepahruo Ahaz ngiethie hingta, a palung rie thyi ning kha Abyipa'a luo zang tluo aa tla li hryly pata a aw.

Tahematapakieca ama a tepa Damaskas khazing tie kha hriykhungrina pihluo te, “Siria siepahruo tie khazing tie khata iema kha amaa bya nakawta kama zaw inaa byana riypa yi ta hriykhungrina i pihluo aa,” a ta. Cuorasala capa tie ca ama rana hne Israel bangkhuo rana ta a cuo.

Ahaz ta Khazing ing lie biphie bangkhuo kha pakhaw te, Khazing ing lie biphie tie ca a dechi diy. Abyipaing lie ingchiypakaa tie kha khaa te Jerusalem khy a kiy bangkhuo lie kha ama cuota bienatluophie aa sa.
Judah ruo khypuv ting lie kha khazing hrangpa tie'a luo rangpa-ue pihluona riypata khahrungtluobu sa te Abyipamingchingmingvuo tie Khazing kha a hi a pahaa.
A tuesana aa ngaapa tie hne a luopuv ziypa bangkhuo, a hruothu taata a chuona te ca Judah hne Israel Siepahruo tie Caa-uv chunglieta cape pata a cuo.
Ahaz ta a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie a zie te khypuv chunglie, Jerusalem khypuv lie kha ama paby; cuorasala Israel siepahruo tie thluo lie kha ca paby va yi. A sacapaa Hezekiah ta ama kha aa thle.
Hezekiah ca kung kiy kung pangaa a ta pata siepahruo cuo hruo a thu te, Jerusalem lieta kung kiy kung caky siepahruo a cuo. A nung ming ca Abijah ta cuo te, Zekhariah sacanung ta a cuo.
A mingchingmingvuo David ta a za tuepa haa khata Abyipahmungna lie kha a phapa a tue.
Siepahruo a cuona kung khana, thla khana lieta Abyipaing ingchiypakaa tie kha pahaw te a pare.
Tluobyi tie hne Levi ming kha ningchiyluo kuo zapuv ahmyana hmang lie kha a pahmya yi.

Iema kyihuo khata, “Levi ming zaw, na naathlie tie ung! Niema hne niema kha a pathe sa ung la, Abyipanama mingchingmingvuo Khazing ing zaw kha pathe sa tie ung, cakhutaata hmang pathepa taata a pyapa kha pathe tie ung.

Tahematapakieca nama mingchingmingvuo tie hing zang tluo aa tla li pata aw yi te, Abyipama Khazing hmungna lieta pha lina kha ama tue tli; ama kha thaw yi te, Abyipaawna kha a palise yi te hnang ama chaw tli.
Iema ta ingle khuo ingchiypakaa zaw kha khaa yi te myi-ing zaw kha ama pache, cakhutaata Israel Khazing kha rangpa-ue pihluo lipa yi ta hmang pathepa lieta myirue panaana zaw pihluo va yi.
Caacuonakawta Abyipahihaana ca Judah hne Jerusalem cunglie tlung te, nama ming ta nama hmungpa haa hingta ciysabaraw aa chiypa, kharuehaa aa chiypa hne ese hyalya riypa hmang ta a tue yi.
Hingpa kawlie hingta ma paa tie kha zueziy ta za thiy yi te, ma sacapaa tie hne ma sacanung tie hne ma napuv zaw kha sii ta amaa zaa da.
Ciy aa chiypa a hihaana ca kiema'a taata aa maa riypata AbyipaIsrael Khazing hneta biekuona tue riypa na i palung lie a puv.
I sacapaa zaw, ata hing ca rawtlaw khah ung, tahematapakieca Abyipana niema hing a hmiekunglie re hrie riypata caa tlaw yi, a rehrietuv hne rangpa-ue a pihluotuv riypata caa tlaw yi,” a ta yi.

Cakhutaata Levi ming ca ama thu, Amasai sacapaa Mahath, Azariah sacapaa Joel, Kohath ming tie sacapaa zaw; cakhutaata Merari ming sacapaa tie, Abdi sacapaa Kish, Jehallelel sacapaa Azariah; cakhutaata Gershon ming chungtaata Zimmah sacapaa Joah, Joah sacapaa Eden;
Elizafan sacapaa zaw chungtaata, Shimri hne Jeuel; cakhutaata Asaf sacapaa tie chungtaata, Zekhariah hne Mattaniah;
Heman sacapaa zaw chungtaata, Jehuel hne Shimei; Jeduthun sacapaa tie chungtaata, Shemaiah hne Uzziel.
Ama uvnu zaw kha pahmya yi te iema kha ama pathe sa, cakhutaata Abyipabie ta siepahruo ta bie a pipa haa yi khata Abyipaing pathe riypata amaa ngie.

Tluobyi tie ca Abyipaing pathe riypa khata chungching khuo luo kha a ngie yi te, Abyipabiena-ing chunglieta a pathe lipa hmang ama hmungpa bangkhuo kha Abyipaing tlawhmie luo kha ama pyakhyi; cakhutaata Levi ming khata la yi te Kidron cavaata luo kha ama sikhyi.

Pathesana ca thla khana thlaa a ning kha ning ta pathu yi te capa thlaa ning cari ning ta Abyipaingle khuo kha ama pha; cakhutaata ning cari chung Abyipaing kha ama pathe, cakhutaata a thla khana thlaa ning hraa hlyicaruv ning ta ama pachuo.

Cakhutaata Siepahruo Hezekiah'a luo kha a ngie yi te, “Abyipaing kha ma pathe diy tli, myirue panaana bienatluophie hne a biphie bangkhuo, cakhutaata pachie paripa viechuo chinapa cabya hne a biphie bangkhuo zaw kha ma pathe diy mangtli.

Cakhutaata Siepahruo Ahaz siepahruo a cuo ningta zang tluo aa tla li pata a za aw ningta a thawpa biphie bangkhuo kha pathe pate pachie ciepa ta ma chi diy tli; mang tie, Abyipabienatluophie hmiekunglie khana ama aw,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Siepahruo Hezekiah ca mawdiy ta thu te, khypuv lie byi tie kha pahmya yi te, Abyipaing luo kha a khaw.

Pena cuota hne Judah ming cuo hne hmangpathepa cuo khata sue pathe sa panaana lie pihluo riypata cuetungpa sa sariy, tuvtungpa sa sariy, tuvtaata sa sariy, mietungpa sa sariy ama vya cyi. Ama ta Aaron ciypathla tluobyi tie kha Abyipabienatluophie cunglie pihluo riypata naw a pi yi.

Caacuonakawta cuetungpa kha thie yi te tluobyi tie ta a thiy kha la yi te bienatluophie kha ama hi; cakhutaata tuvtungpa kha thie yi te a thiy ta bienatluophie kha ama hi; cakhutaata tuvtaata kha thie yi te a thiy ta bienatluophie kha ama hi.
Cakhutaata sue pathe sa panaana cuota a cuopa mietungpa tie kha siepahruo hne aa hmyapa tie'a luo kha a vawkhyi yi te, ama cunglie kha ama kuv khang yi te,

tluobyi tie khata thie yi te a thiy khata Israel ming bangkhuo cuota sue angiethena riypata, bienatluophie cunglie kha a thiy ta sue a ngiethe panaana ama pihluo. Tahematapakieca siepahruo ta myirue panaana hne sue a ngiethe panaana kha Israel ming bangkhuo cuota nama tue aa ta pata bie a pi yi.

David hne siepahruo profet Gad hne profet Nathan biepina haa khata Levi ming ca Abyipaing chunglie kha chaaraa, tingtuolepa, hne tingtuo hne khata a chi yi; tahematapakieca nawbie ca Abyipa'a taa khata profet tie hmuo pata aa vaw.
Levi ming ca David chechiy hne khata a daa yi te tluobyi tie ca hmyakaa hne khata amaa daa.

Cakhutaata Hezekiah ta myirue panaana pihluo riypata bie a pi yi. Myirue panaana a patha tiyta, Abyipahlaa zaw kha a patha ra, cakhutaata Israel Siepahruo David chechiy hne aa chiy pata hmyakaa zaw kha ama patha.
Cawsaa bangkhuo ta amaa bie, hlaasatuv tie ta hlaa ama sa, hmyakaa kha tung pata a cuo; capa bangkhuo ca myirue panaana a chuona te khata aa pazue.
Pihluona kha a chuo tiyta, siepahruo hne ama hne a awpa bangkhuo kha a bung yi te amaa bie.

Siepahruo Hezekiah hne byi tie khata Levi ming kha David bie hne profet Asaf bie khata Abyipaca hlaa ta pathuosa tie ung ta pata bie ama pi. Iema ta palungtluona hne pathuosana hlaa sa yi te, a bung yi te amaa bie.
Cakhutaata Hezekiah ta, “Niema ca Abyipa'a lie kha namaa pathe mangtli; a vaw ung la hriykhungrina tie hne palungtluo panaana tie kha Abyipaing luo cyile tie ung,” a ta yi.
Aa hmyapa tie ta ama cyilepa myirue panaana ca cuetungpa sawsariy, tuvtungpa zakha, hne tuvtaata zahning ta cuo te, capa bangkhuo ca Abyipa'a luo myirue panaana pihluo pata a cuo.
Pathesapa pihluona ca cuetungpa zacaruv hne tuv thawthung ta a cuo.

Cuorasala tluobyi tie ca ama cawtuv nakawta myirue panaana tie kha a vang hle diy khu va yi, caacuonakawta, a hrangpa tluobyi tie amaa pathe sa diy khuna te ta, ama tieriy Levi ming ta re a chuona te ta amaa bya, tahematapakieca Levi ming ca tluobyi tie laata a pathesana lie ca a sungsiy ta ama tue vie.
Myirue panaana a hluvsa hlyi taata aviesaa panaana pihluopa taata a thupa, myirue panaana cuota dangpa ta panaana zaw a aw kalie. Cahaacata Abyipaing lie rehriena ca tue pakhaa pata a cuo.
Cakhutaata Hezekiah hne cawsaa bangkhuo ca cawsaa zaw cuota Khazing a tuepa kawlie khata ama palung a tluo; tahematapakieca capa hmang ca sungkha ta a vya awpa tana a cuo.

AbyipaIsrael Khazing Lawsena pyi a uv riypata Abyipaing, Jerusalem luo amaa vawna riypata Hezekiah ta Israel hne Judah bangkhuo'a luo kha bie a taa yi, cakhutaata Efraim hne Manasseh tie'a luo zaw kha caa a cape.
Tahematapakieca siepahruo hne aa byi tie ta Lawsena pyi ca thla hningna thlaa lie a uv riypata bie ama chi,
(tahematapakieca tluobyi tie kha cawsaa aa dena te ta a pathe khu lipa yi ta, cawsaa zaw kha Jerusalem lie amaa hmya li nakawta ama'a na a cuota lieta lawsena pyi kha a uv khu va yi).
Capa khuekhuona ca siepahruo hne aa hmyapa bangkhuo ta aa dang ta pata ama rue.

Caacuonakawta Israel ruo chung bangkhuo, Beer-sheba taata Dan te ta thuo pathyi pata, AbyipaIsrael Khazing Lawsena pyi ca Jerusalem lie tana nama hmuo aa ta pata cawsaazaapuv kha pathyi sa riypata bie ama chi; tahematapakieca ama ripa haa khata cawsaa hluvsa ta za hmuo va yi.

Caacuonakawta siepahruo biepina haa khata caa phyatuv tie ca siepahruo hne a byi tie'a taata caa kha phya yi te Israel hne Judah ruo bangkhuo khata ama sikhyi. A caa ca, “Vya Israel cawsaa zaw, Abraham, Isak, hne Israel Khazing Abyipa'a luo vya kaa ung la Assiria siepahruo kuv taata a lawpa niema aa ngaapa tie'a luo kha ama zaw a vya kaa ra aa.
Ama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing, Abyipa'a lie kha zang tluo aa tla li pata ama aw nakawta nama hmungpa haa hingta a parapa, nama mingchingmingvuo tie hne nama tieriy tie haa khata cuo khah ung.

Nama mingchingmingvuo tie haata nama palung le khah se, cuorasala Abyipa'a luo kha a pi ung la chuozaa cuota a pathe sapa a hmangpathepa luo kha a vaw tie ung, ciy aa chiypa a hihaana kha niema'a taata aa maa the riypata Abyipa re kha hrie tie ung.

Tehematapakieca niema ta Abyipa'a luo nama kaa pakhaa kieca nama tieriy hne nama saata tie kha iema a patuvpa tie'a taata kawpacuona hmung'a yi te hingpa ruo luo hing ama vya pakaa aa. Tahematapakieca Abyipanama Khazing ca vihnyi a thepa hne nangduena a hnyipa cuo te, ama'a luo nama kaa kieca a hrang luo caa hyise'a va yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta caa a phyatuv tie ca Efraim hne Manasseh ruo khypuv suo kha hnang suo kha ta si yi te, Zebulun ruo te ta ama si; cuorasala pahnyisue yi te, ese yi te ama tue hyalya.
Asher, Manasseh, hne Zebulun ming a cawta dyi kha rawcanawna hnyi yi te Jerusalem luo amaa vaw.
Siepahruo hne a byi tie ta Abyipabie ta naw ama pipa tie kha tue riypata palung lung kha ama phya the riypata Khazing kuv ca Judah ming cunglie zaw kha a aw ra.
Thiynung phuv lipa viechuo pyi kha hmuo riypata cawsaa a hluvsa ca thla hningna thlaa lie kha Jerusalem luo amaa vaw, a pungpa ca ama hluv hringhruo.
Re ca pathu yi te Jerusalem lie a awpa bienatluophie bangkhuo kha palaw yi te, rangpa-ue pihluonapa bienatluophie zaw kha la yi te Kidron cavaata luo kha ama va thaw diy.

Lawsena tuvtaata kha thla hningna thlaa ning hraa hlyipaliy ning ta ama thie. Tluobyi tie hne Levi ming ca ama nang ta zaa te, iema hne iema kha a pathe yi te myirue panaana kha Abyipaing luo ama vya cyi.
Khazing cawsaa Moses phungbie haa khata iema ca ama aw tawnapa hmang lie kha ama aw; Levi ming kuv taata ama hmungpa thiyse kha tluobyi tie ta ama hi.

Apungna chunglie kha iema hne iema a pathe lipa a hluvsa ama aw nakawta a pathe lipa tie mekaa cuo khata Levi ming ta Lawsena tuvtaata kha ama thie aa hu, tuvtaata ca Abyipa'a lie ama pathena riypa tana a cuo.

Tahematapakieca cawsaa hluvpuv, Efraim, Manasseh, Isskhar, hne Zebulun ming hluvpuv ca iema hne iema kha a pathe va yi, cuorasala a luopuv li pata lawsena pyi sa kha ama ning. Cuorasala Hezekiah ta iema cuo khata thlaachuo te, “A phapa Abyipa
ama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing, Abyipakha huv riypata biechina a hnyipa tie ca hmangpathepa lie a pathesana phung haata a cuo li kie zawma zaa ngiethe diy thi tie yi,” a ta.
Abyipata Hezekiah thlaachuona kha thyipa te cawsaa kha a patluo sa yi.

Jerusalem lie a awpa Israel ming ca thiynung phuv lipa viechuo pyi kha alawna hneta ning sariy chung ama hmuo; Levi ming hne tluobyi tie ta tungpa kha a paringsa pata tungpuona cangta Abyipakha ning kha hnang ning kha ta ama pathuosa.

Abyipare lieta thena phapa a paluosapa Levi ming kha Hezekiah ta thaapina bie a hluo yi. Caacuonakawta cawsaa ta pyi sa kha ning sariy chung ning yi te, aviesaa panaana kha pihluo yi te Abyipaama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing kha alawna bie ama hluo.
Cakhutaata aa pungpa bangkhuo khata a hrangpa ning sariy chung kha pyi tue pazue kalie riypata ama palung a tling; caacuonakawta a hrangpa ning sariy chung kha alawna hneta pyi ca ama tue pazue.

Tahematapakieca Judah siepahruo Hezekiah ta aa pungpa tie ca cuetungpa thawkha hne tuv thawsariy kha pihluo riypata pi yi te, byi tie ta aa pungpa tie kha cuetungpa thawkha hne tuv thawhraa ama pi. Tluobyi a hluvsa kha iema hne iema amaa pathe.

Judah ming a pungpa tie yalya, tluobyi tie hne Levi ming, hne Israel ming a pungpa yalya, hne Israel ruo chungtaata a vawpa Israel cawsaa khyche yalya, Judah lie a awpa Judah cawsaa khyche yalya ta ama palung a tluo.
Siepahruo David sacapaa Solomon chuo taa yalya ta Jerusalem lieta hing haapa hing a aw buo li tli nakawta Jerusalem lieta ca palungtluona a le hringhruo.
Cakhutaata tluobyi tie hne Levi ming ca a daa yi te cawsaa kha thluechiy ama pi; ama ueryi ca thyi pata cuo te ama thlaachuona ca a pathepa a awna vuoruo te a pha.

Capa bangkhuo ca a chuo tiyta, capa lie a awpa Israel ming bangkhuo ca Judah khypuv tie luo kha si yi te, Judah hne Benjamin, hne Efraim hne Manasseh ruo yalya lie a awpa lungbang tie kha thli pachung yi te, Asherah tung kha ama hu pachung, cakhutaata khahrungtluobu hne bienatluophie zaw kha ama pacing, ama pachuona te ta ama para. Cakhutaata Israel ming bangkhuo ca ama khypuv zaw luo, ama ruo luo kha ama kaa.

Hezekiah ta tluobyi tie hne Levi ming kha a phuvphuv ta che yi te, a phuvphuv khata ama cyicuo ta re a pi yi, tluobyi tie hne Levi ming kha myirue panaana hne aviesaa panaana, Abyipaarina hmang lie thlake huo riypata hne palungtluo bie hluo hne pathuosa riypata re a pi yi.

Siepahruo ta a hnyipa chungtaata a thupa ca Abyipaphungbie lieta aa capepa haata myirue panaana cuota a cuo aa: maw hne zuoluo ta myirue panaana, sabbath ning ta myirue panaana, thla thaa ning, ama'a na a cuo lieta tuepa pyi tie ning ta panaana cuota a cuo aa.
Tluobyi tie hne Levi ming kha Abyipaphungbie lie amaa pi khuna riypata, Jerusalem ming kyihuo khata, tluobyi tie hne Levi ming ta ama hmung riypata a cuopa kha nama pi aa ta pata bie a pi yi.

Bie ca aa thyi diy pahne ta, Israel cawsaa ta hmung taapa sathaapa, mingsuvtiy, chiytiy, khyitiy, hne lu taata a pyapa bangkhuo kha a hluv hringhruo ama pi, cakhutaata zezaw ting taata chehraachekha a hluv hringhruo kha ama pi.
Judah khypuv tie lieta a awpa Israel ming hne Judah ming zaw khata cue hne tuv chehraachekha, hne Abyipaama Khazing'a luo ama pihluopa ama pathe sapa tie kha vya chiykhyi yi te ama papung.
Thla thungna thlaa lie kha pahmya hruo pathu yi te thla sariyna thlaa lie kha ama patlung.
Hezekiah hne a byi tie kha a vaw yi te ama papungpa kha ama hmung tiyta Abyipakha pathuosa yi te a cawsaa Israel ming kha thluechiy ama pi.
Hezekiah ta tluobyi tie hne Levi ming kha ama papungpa kaw ca a hiehriy yi.

Zadok pathla ta a cuopa tluobyi le cepa Azariah ta palie te, “Ama pipa tie kha Abyipaing luo ama vya cyina taata aa pathu pata kiema ta ning riy aa desa pata hnyi pate, pacung riy a hluvsa ma hnyi; Abyipata a cawsaa kha thluechiy a pi nakaw yi ta, kiema ta a hlyipa a hluvsa ma hnyi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Hezekiah ta iema ca Abyipaing chunglie chechiy khuo kha pare riypata bie pi yi te ama pare.
Chehraachekha hne pihluopa kha zang tluo aa tlasa pata ama vya pi. Iema a mangchiytuv byi le cepa ca Levi ming Konaniah ta cuo te, a paziypa ca a nuta Shimei ta a cuo.

Siepahruo Hezekiah hne Khazing ing lie byi le cepa Azariah ta re ama pina haata, Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismakhiah, Mahath, hne Benaiah tapa tie ca Konaniah hne a nuta Shimei a byatuv hne mangchiytuv tie ta ama cuo.

Levi ming Imnah sacapaa Kore, ningchiyluo thlake a huotuvpa ca Khazing'a luo lungthe panaana ta pipa tie mangchiytuv ta cuo te, ama ca ama pipa ahlu khaAbyipacuota hne a pathe cepa pihluona cuota chi buo riypata a cuo.

Tluobyi tie khypuv tie lie kha ama tieriy tie kha macuo haatiy ta li pata, amaa chena haa khata, ama cuvu kaluo kha re riypata Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah hne Shekaniah tapa tie khata zang tluo aa tlasa pata amaa bya.
Ama thukina ziy pata ming khungpa, capaa kung thung taata a cungluo, ama zung lie ama re haata, hne ningting re lie aa huna haata Abyipaing chung luo a ngiepa tie kha ca re li pata ama cuo.
Tluobyi tie ama ming ama khungnazya ca ama mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue ziy pata cuo te, Levi ming kung kiy taata a cungluo tie ca ama re sizya ta a phuvphuv ta khung pata a cuo.

Tluobyi tie ca ama saata bangkhuo, ama napuv tie, ama sacapaa tie, hne ama sacanung tie, ama palang khata ming khung pata ama cuo, tahematapakieca iema hne iema a pathe pata awna lie kha zang tluo amaa tla nakawta a cuo.

Cakhutaata Aaron ciypathla tie, tluobyi tie, ama khy huopa ta a cuopa zaapuv alyi lie a awpa tie, tluobyi tie chungtaata capaa mekaa hne Levi ming hraw taata ming khungpa mekaa kha cuvu re riypata ming bang pata re pipa cawsaa tie khata a khy a khy ta ama re.
Hezekiah ta Judah ruo chung bangkhuo kha cahaacata a tue; Abyipaa Khazing hmiekunglie a phapa hne aa hmuopa hne zang tluo aa tlapa kha a tue.
Cakhutaata Abyipaing re hne phungbie hne nawbie hneta aa tla pata a hriepa re mekaa lie, a Khazing a huvna lie kha a pathiypalung yalya ta hrie te a hlue a tling.

Hingpa hmang bangkhuo hne hing haa hingta zang tluo aa tlasa pata a tue khutaata Assiria Siepahruo Sennakherib ca a vaw te Judah kha ching te khy dungkhuo a hnyipa khypuv tie kha a ripuo yi te i te'a yi ta pata a rue.
Sennakherib ca a vaw te Jerusalem kha tuv aa ting tli tapa kha Hezekiah ta a hmung tiyta,
aa byi tie hne a cawsaa thaaruvpa tie hne khata khypuv le lie a awpa acaatiy kha paping amaa ting, iema ca ta amaa bya.
Cawsaa a hluv hringhruo kha a hmya yi te, ruo chunglieta a langpa acaa hne cavaata bangkhuo kha paping yi te, “Khaapanakawma Assiria Siepahruo tie ca a vaw'a yi te tiy a hluvsa ama hmung aa?” ama ta.

Hezekiah ca re hrie riypa kha a cusa pata a ting te, a cingpa lungruetlepie bangkhuo kha pare te a cunglieta ingsuo a sa diy khutaata aleluo taa khata lungruetlepie a hrangpa a sa pakhaa; cakhutaata David khypuv chunglie Millo kha a cu vie ta a tue, cakhutaata cehre hne phya zaw kha a hluv hringhruo a sa.
Cawsaa zaw cunglie kha riebyi tie kha chi yi te, khypuv thlake ahmyana hmang lie kha pahmya yi te palung cahrasa pata a changpa yi ca,
“Cahra ung la nama rie pha se. Assiria siepahruo hne ama'a lie a awpa cawsaa phuv tie kha ciy khah ung, nama thlaa zang khah se; tahematapakieca ama'a lie a awpa laata kiema'a lie a awpa na a le vie.

Ama hne a awpa ca saapa ta cehre a patuvpa ta cuo te, cuorasala kiema hne a awpa ca Abyipama Khazing tana a cuo, kiema kha malie a bya'a te rie malie aa dupa aa,” a ta yi. Judah Siepahruo Hezekiah bie thueta cawsaa ca ama thaa a thu.
Capa khutaa cata Assiria Siepahruo Sennakherib hne a rieka bangkhuo ca Lakhish lie ama aw ningta kha Jerusalem lie a awpa Judah cawsaa bangkhuo tie'a luo kha a changtaapa tie pathlie yi te,
“Assiria Siepahruo Sennakherib na hing haa hingta a ri: Khaapa hing a buchuo ung cate ma Jerusalem hrena dungkhuo chunglie hing nama aw thluo?

Hezekiah ta, ‘Abyipama Khazing ta Assiria siepahruo kuv chungtaa hingta malie a khuo aa,’ aca ta tiy yi hingta a pali a pahnaa ta luo caa chiy yi te, nangdiy tiyhriena hneta na thiyna luo acaa chiy yi cuo va ma?

Hingpa Hezekiah ngiethie hingna a cuo cuo va ma, a khahrungtluobu tie hne a bienatluophie tie kha thaw te Judah hne Jerusalem ca, “Bienatluophie suokha lie kha abie'a ung cate capa cunglie ca tana hriykhungrina nama tue aa,” a tapa kha.
Kama hne i mingchingmingvuo tie ta ruohrang ming cawsaa bangkhuo cunglie ma tuepa kha pachang va ung ca ma? Capa ruo tie mingphang zaw ama khazing tie ta ama ruo kha i kuv chungtaata ama khuo khu ma?

Nama Khazing hingta i kuv chungtaata aca khuo khu riypa yi ta i mingchingmingvuo tie ta ama para karuepa mingphang tie ama khazing zaw hrawlie kha ahung chuo ma a mingphang kha i kuv chungtaata a khuo khu yi?

Caacuonakawta Hezekiah ca hing haa hingta a padung sa khah ung, a pali a pahnaa ta luo a pachiy sa khah ung, cakhutaata ama kha zang khah ung, tahematapakieca khaapa pena hne mingphang khazing ta hmuo kama kuv chungtaata hne i mingchingmingvuo tie kuv chungtaata a cawsaa kha khuo khu va yi. Nama Khazing changchiy ta ca tuokhaatama aca khuo khu'a yi! a ta,” ama ta.
A changtaapa tie ta Abyipa Khazinghne a changtaapa Hezekiah kha a du pata ama ri kalie.

Ama ta Abyipa, Israel Khazing kha ese pata hne a du pata caa zaw kha cape te, “Ruo hrang lie a awpa mingphang hrang tie khazing tie ta ama cawsaa tie kha i kuv chungtaata ama khuo khu lipa haata Hezekiah Khazing zaw hingta a cawsaa tie hing i kuv chungtaata khuo khu'a va yi,” a ta.
Khy dungkhuona lungruetlepie cunglie a awpa Jerusalem cawsaa tie kha paciy sa riypa hne ama thlaa pazang sa pata khypuv kha ama la khu riypata cahaacata Judah ryi ta khuosa ta ama khisue.
Cawsaa kuv ta tuepa alyi cung mingphang tie khazing tie ama tapa haa khata Jerusalem Khazing kha ama ta ra.
Cakhutaata Siepahruo Hezekiah hne profet Amoz sacapaa Isaiah ca capa kawlie ca ta thlaachuo yi te vuoruo luo kha ama khi.

Cakhutaata Abyipata avuoming pakha pathlie te Assiria siepahruo arina hmang lieta a thaaruvpa rieka tie hne byi tie bangkhuo kha a thie yi. Caacuonakawta a hmiechisa pata a ruo luo kha a kaa. A khazing ing luo a chiy tiyta a sacapaa chekha ta ama kha zueziy ta ama thie.
Cahaacata Abyipata Hezekiah hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie ca Assiria Siepahruo Sennakherib kuv chungtaata hne a carie tie kuv chungtaata khuo yi te hmangting lie kha a pahyna a pi yi.

Cawsaa hluvsa ta Abyipacuota lasaw hne Judah Siepahruo Hezekiah cuota a muosungpa hmang kha Jerusalem luo ama vya cyi, caacuonakawta capa cuo ning taa cata ama ca mingphang zaw hmungna lieta cyicalang pata a cuo.
Capa cuo lie ca Hezekiah ca pasa te vuotaa a thiy. Abyipa'a luo kha thlaachuo te, ama ca palie te pamangsana a pi.
Cuorasala Hezekiah ca a palung lie hruotlena a aw nakawta ama'a lie thlahnena a tuepa zaa khata a law vyi. Caacuonakawta ama hne Judah hne Jerusalem cunglie kha hihaana a tlung.

Cakhutaata Hezekiah ca a palung chunglie aa palena kawlie khata ama hne ama kha a pane te, ama hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie hneta amaa pane pakhaw nakawta Hezekiah chuo lie ca Abyipahihaana kha ama cunglieta tlung vyi.
Hezekiah ca hnyirung hringhruo te pa-uvsathyina lepuv a ting; cakhutaata siy, ngu, alung muosungpa, rangpa-ue, phya, hne a muosungpa phangtling cuo khata sue-ing a sa.
Sa, mingsuvtiy, hne chiytiy cuota chechiy china ing sa te, sahring phangting cuota sahring pasawna ing hne tuvte zaw kha a sa.
Cahaa ngiethie cata khypuv zaw kha a cuota sa te, tuvrung hne cuerung zaw kha a hluvsa a hnyi; tahematapakieca Khazing ta a hluvsa ta a pahnyi sa.
Hingpa Hezekiah ngiethie hing ta Gihon tiy a pyanapa a cungluo kha paping te David khypuv ningtlaluo kuo khata a palang sa. Hezekiah ca a re bangkhuo lie kha a hlue a tling.

Caacuonakawta Babilon byi tie ta, ruo chunglie a awpa pamangsana kha a ngiepatlie riypata ama'a luo luosituv tie ama pathlie ning kha, ama kha dyapasya riypa hne a palung chunglie a awpa bangkhuo kha pachang riypata Khazing ta amata tah a pathlie thluo.
Hezekiah tuesana aa ngaapa hne hmang pha a tuepa tie ca, Judah hne Israel Siepahruo tie Caa-uv chunglie a awpa Amoz sacapaa profet Isaiah muocuo a hmungpa tie chunglie khana aa cape.

Hezekiah ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a zie te, David ciypathla tie thluo luo kienapa lie kha ama paby; Judah bangkhuo hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa bangkhuo ta a thiyna lie kha pa-uvsathyina ama pi. A sacapaa Manasseh ta ama kha aa thle.
Manasseh ca kung hraa hlyihning a ta pata siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu; Jerusalem lieta kung sawngaa kung pangaa siepahruo a cuo.
Abyipata Israel ming hmiekung taata aa cadepa mingphang tie ta duvsamakhie aa chiypa hmang ama tuepa haa khata Abyipahmungna lie kha a pha lipa hmang a tue.

Tahematapakieca a paa Hezekiah ta a za parapa khahrungtluobu kha sa pakhaa te, Baal cuo khata bienatluophie a sa, Asherah tung zaw kha sa te avuo lie a awpa hmang bangkhuo kha abie te iema re kha a hrie.
Abyipata, “Jerusalem lie hingna i ming ca chuozaa ta a aw aa,” a za tapa, Abyipaing chunglie kha bienatluophie a sa.
Abyipaing tlawhmie suohning chunglie kha avuo lie a awpa hmang bangkhuo cuo khata bienatluophie a sa.

A sacapaa kha Hinnom bawphie lie myi ta rue te a pihluo. Hmieluo kaw ridawluna hne kuvcaa mangna zaw kha tue te, ca-ie a thepa tie kha hmuo yi te apyipa hne khuevuo a hnyipa zaw kha aa pha yi. Abyipahmungna lie kha a pha lipa a hluvsa tue te a hi a pahaa.

Asherah kuvtuezuv kha sa te Khazing ing chunglie a chi. Kuvtuezuv hne aa patuv pata Khazing ta David hne a sacapaa Solomon kyihuo ta a ripa ca, “Israel phang bangkhuo chungtaata i tlawpa Jerusalem hne hingpa ing chunglie hingna i ming ca chuozaa ta i sang aa.

Israel ming ta Moses'a taata bie i pipa yi bangkhuo hne phungbie bangkhuo, ziyphung hne phungluo bangkhuo kha a raaringsa pata ama tue kieca nama mingchingmingvuo tie huota i chi ciepa alyi taa hingta ama phyi kha hnyi pakhaa'a va tli ang,” a za ta yi.
Manasseh ta Judah hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie kha luo aa chiy chie nakaw yi ta, Abyipata Israel ming hmiekunglie a parapa yi mingphang tie laa khata a pha lipa a hluv vie ama tue.
Abyipata Manasseh hne a cawsaa tie'a lie kha bie a chang raalaa pa yi ta siysaa ri va yi.
Caacuonakawta Abyipata Assiria siepahruo riekaphuv riekabyi tie kha a vya chiy yi te iema ca ta Manasseh ca kyipa ta siy yi te, hrakyi khe yi te Babilon luo ama sikhyi.
Riethyivuosuo pata a aw tiyta Abyipaa Khazing, a mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing hmiekunglie kha khuopuv ta a pane te ngiechina aa hie.

Ama'a luo kha thlaachuo te, Khazing ta paa a kiena kha cuhluopa te a thyipa, cakhutaata a pena kha pi pakhaa te Jerusalem lieta a pa-aw sa pakhaa. Cakhutaata Abyipaca Khazing ta a cuo hmisipa kha a pachang.

Capa khutaa cata David khypuv ale luo, Gihon acaa ningtlaluo bawphie taata Ngaa Thlake a ngiena te, Ofel kha a cadung pata, aa suosa pata khy dungkhuo lungruetlepie kha a sa. Judah ruo chung dungkhuopa khypuv tie lie kha riekaphuv riekabyilepa tie kha a chi yi.
Ruohrang khazing tie hne kuvtuezuv tie kha Abyipaing taata a palaw, cakhutaata Jerusalem khy chunglie hne Abyipaing awnapa tluo cunglie a sapa bienatluophie bangkhuo kha khy le luo a thaw diy.
Abyipabienatluophie kha sa hru te capa cunglie ca aviesaa panaana hne palungtluo panaana kha a pihluo; cakhutaata Judah ming kha, Abyipa, Israel Khazing re na nama hrie aa ta pata bie a pi yi.
Cadyiseca cawsaa ta khahrungtluobu lie kha hriykhungrina ama tue ngiethie kalie, cuorasala Abyipaama Khazing'a luo dyi khana ama tue.

Manasseh tuesana aa ngaa kaliepa tie hne, a Khazing'a luo thlaa a chuonapa, hne Israel Khazing Abyipaming ta ama'a lie bie a ripa profet tie bie ca Israel ming Siepahruo tie chuorina chunglie tana a aw.

A thlaachuona hne tuokhaatama Khazing ta paa a kienapa kha a cuhluo tapa, a palung a pachung hluota a suenapa bangkhuo hne zang tluo aa tla lina, khahrungtluobu sa te Asherah tung hne kuvtuezuv a chinapa hmang tapa tie ca profet tie kaw khungnapa caa chungliena ama cape.
Cahaacata Manasseh ca a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a zie te, a ing lie kha ama paby. A sacapaa Amon ta ama kha aa thle.
Amon ca kung kiy kung hning a ta pata siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu; Jerusalem lieta kung hning siepahruo a cuo.
A paa Manasseh ta a tuepa haata Abyipahmungna lie a pha lipa a tue. A paa Manasseh ta a za sapa kuvtuezuv bangkhuo tie'a lie kha hriykhungrina tue te ama re a hrie.
A paa Manasseh aa panepa haa khata Abyipahmiekunglie a pane vyi, cuorasala hingpa Amon hingta ca suena kha a hluv vie hryly ta a tue.
A changtaapa tie ta raw yi te a ing chunglieta ama thie.
Cuorasala capa ruo cawsaa tie ca ta Siepahruo Amon a rawtuv bangkhuo kha thie yi te, capa ruo ming ca ta a sacapaa Josiah kha ama a thle riypata siepahruo ama pacuo sa.
Josiah ca kung cari a ta pata siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu; Jerusalem lie kha kung sawthung kung kha siepahruo a cuo.
Ama ta Abyipahmungna lie kha a phapa hrie te, a mingchingmingvuo David luopuv kha a ziy; cavyiluo cuose cacuoluo cuose pie vyi.

Tahematapakieca siepahruo a cuonapa kung cari a ta kung, mingnu a cuo kaliepa khata a mingchingmingvuo David Khazing kha huv hruo a thu te, kung hraa hlyihning a cuopa khata Judah ruo hne Jerusalem lie khahrungtluobu zaw, Asherah tung zaw, hne capepa hne patlepa kuvtuezuv zaw kha pathe hruo aa thu.

A ming hmungna lieta Baal bienatluophie kha pacing yi te, iema cunglie a daapa rangpa-ue bienatluophie kha a pacing. Asherah tung tie hne capepa hne patlepa kuvtuezuv tie kha a hu; a diykariyna te ta dekary diy te ama cunglie hriykhungrina zaa tuepa tie thluo cunglie kha a hipatlaa diy.
Tluobyi tie ruv zaw kha ama bienatluophie lie ca rue te Judah hne Jerusalem kha a pathe.
Manasseh khy tie, Efraim, hne Simeon, hne a cahriy bangkhuo lie kha
bienatluophie tie kha a pacing, Asherah tung tie hne kuvtuezuv tie kha a diykariyna te ta rie diy te, Israel ruo chung bangkhuo lieta rangpa-ue bienatluophie bangkhuo kha a pacing diy.

Siepahruo a cuona kung hraa hlyicari a ta kung, ruo hne ing zaw a pathe khutaata Azaliah sacapaa Shafan, khypuv uvtuv Maaseiah, hne Joahaz sacapaa Joah, caziy re a hriepa tapa tie kha Abyipaa Khazing ing pare riypata a pathlie yi.

Tluobyi lepa Hilkiah'a luo kha a vaw yi te Khazing ing luo ama vya cyipa tuokaa kha ama la. Capa tuokaa ca ingchiypakaa a huopa Levi ming ta Manasseh hne Efraim hne Israel ming aa ngaapa bangkhuo hne Judah ming hne Benjamin ming hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie'a taata ama khyipa tana a cuo.
Abyipaing mangchiytuv re a hriepa tie'a lie kha pi yi te, Abyipaing chunglie re a hriepa tie khata ing parena hne pangi pakhaana riypa khata ama hmuo.
Judah siepahruo tie ta ama parapa ing cuota cupa alung, patuvsana riypa thing, hne pahriy zaw calyina riypa khata lettamaa tie hne ing a sapa tie kha ama pi.

Cawsaa ta re kha zang tluo aa tlasa pata ama hrie. Iema cunglie ca a mangpa riypata Levi ming Merari sacapaa tie Jahath hne Obadiah cuose, Kohath ming sacapaa tie Zekhariah hne Meshullam zaw kha ama chi. Levi ming hrangpa, tungpa tungna luo ta a thepa bangkhuo ca
rehrietuv tie uvtuv hne re phangting lie kha tluo a tlapatuv ta ama cuo; cakhutaata Levi ming chekha tie ca caa cape a thepa, hne byi tie, hne thlake a huotuv ta ama cuo.
Abyipaing chung luo ama vya cyipa tuokaa ama kya pyakhyi ning kha, Moses'a taata pipa Abyipaphungbie caa-uv kha tluobyi Hilkiah ta a hmung.
Hilkiah ta caacapetuv Shafan kyihuo khata, “Abyipaing chungliena phungbie caa-uv i hmung, ta te, “Hilkiah ta Shafan kha a pi.
Shafan ta caa-uv kha siepahruo'a luo vya cyi te, siepahruo kyihuo ta a ri vie kaliepa ca, “Na changtaapa tie cunglie hrie riypata na pipa yi re ca ama hrie nguoluo.
Abyipaing chunglie a awpa tuokaa kha thue yi te re mangpatuv tie hne rehrietuv tie kha ama pi,” ta pata siepahruo kha a chang.
Caacapetuv Shafan ta siepahruo kha, “Tluobyi Hilkiah na caa-uv naa pi,” a ta. Cakhutaata Shafan ta siepahruo kha ueryi a thyisa pata a ripa.
Siepahruo ta phungbie chunglie bie kha a thyi tiyta a caw kha a thlaa.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ta Hilkiah, Shafan sacapaa Ahikam, Mikah sacapaa Abdon, caacapetuv Shafan, hne siepahruo changtaapa Asaiah tie kha bie pi yi te:

“Vaa ung la, kama hne Israel hne Judah ruo chunglieta aa ngaapa tie cuo khata ama hmungpa caa-uv chunglie bie kaw kha Abyipaca va hiehriy tie ung; ma mingchingmingvuo tie ta hingpa caa-uv chunglie aa capepa bangkhuo tue riypata Abyipabie kha ama ziy li nakawta ma cunglie a patlepa Abyipahihaana ca a le hringhruo,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Hilkiah hne siepahruo ta a pathliepa tie ca profet Huldah'a luo kha vaa yi te capa kaw ca ama va ri. Huldah ca biena-ing caw a huotuv Hasrah sacapaa Tokhath a sacapaa Shallum napuvnung ta a cuo (ama ca Jerusalem khytluo suohningna lieta a awpa ta a cuo).
Ama ta iema'a lie kha, “Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: kama'a luo caa vya pathliepa paa yi kha va chang tie ung,

Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa hmang hne a chunglie khy a sapa tie cunglie hing rana, Judah siepahruo hmiekunglie ama ripa caa-uv chunglie capepa chiesana bangkhuo kha i patlung sa hrahring aa.

Tahematapakieca iema ta kama kha na thaw yi te khazing hrangpa tie kha hriykhungrina ama pihluo, ama kuv ta ama hriepa re bangkhuo khata i hi ina pahaa tli nakaw yi ta, i hihaana ca hingpa hmang lie hing bya pata cuo'a te pache khu pata cuo'a vyi.
Cuorasala Abyipahiehriy riypata caa pathlietuv yi Judah siepahruo ca hing haa hingta va chang tie ung. Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Na thyipa bie kawlieta,

Hingpa hmang hne a chunglie khy a sapa tie cunglie a bie kha na thyi tiyta a ngiepachiy cate Khazing hmiekunglie kha naa pane kieca, cakhutaata kama hmiekunglie kha a pane cate na caw kha thlaa cate i hmiekunglie na caa kieca kama zaw na bie kha ica thyi pa aa, Abyipata a ta.

Na mingchingmingvuo tie'a luo kha ca pahmya'a angte thlaalungna hneta thluokhue naa ngie aa; hingpa hmang hne a chunglie a awpa tie cunglie i patlung sapa rana bangkhuo kha na ming ta hmung'a vyi,” a ta. Iema ta bie ca siepahruo'a luo ama phya pakhaa.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ta bie pathlie te Judah hne Jerusalem lieta uvthyi bangkhuo kha a pahmya yi.

Siepahruo ca Judah cawsaa bangkhuo, Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie, tluobyi tie hne Levi ming, cawsaa a le a caw bangkhuo hne khata Abyipaing luo kha khaw te, Abyipaing chunglie ama hmungpa caa-uv chunglie bie bangkhuo kha ama thyi pata a ripa yi.

Siepahruo ca ama hmang lie kha a daa te, Abyipaziy riypa, a nawbie ziy riypa, a phungluo hne a biepipa kha a pathiypalung yalya hne a hringna yalya ta ziy riypa hne hingpa caa-uv chunglie aa capepa biekuona bie zaw kha tue riypata Abyipahmiekunglie kha biekuona a tue.

Cakhutaata Jerusalem hne Benjamin ruo chunglie a awpa bangkhuo kha capa ca namaa patuv karue aa a ta yi. Cakhutaata Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie Khazing, ama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing biekuona haa khata ama tue.

Josiah ta duvsamakhie aa chiypa bangkhuo kha Israel cawsaa ta ama hnyipa ruo chung taa khata thaw diy te, Israel ruo chunglie a awpa bangkhuo ca Abyipaama Khazing kha a pabie sa diy yi. Ama chuo chung bangkhuo ca Abyipaama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing'a taa khata luo pie va yi.
Josiah ta Jerusalem lie kha Abyipacuota Lawsena Pyi ca tue te, Lawsena tuvtaata ca thla khana thlaa ning hraa hlyipaliy ning ta ama thie.
Tluobyi tie ca iema'a na ama re lie kha chi yi teAbyipaing rehriena lie kha a pasu yi.

Israel ming bangkhuo kha pacuv yi te Abyipa'a lieta a pathe sapa Levi ming kyihuo khata, “A pathepa nawbie thingkaw kha Israel siepahruo David sacapaa Solomon ta a sapa ing chunglie kha chi tie ung; nama letung lie a puvle pari a hu'a va tli. Abyipanama Khazing hne a cawsaa Israel ming re kha hrie tie ung.

Israel siepahruo David capepa pahmungsana hne a sacapaa Solomon cape pa pahmungsana kha ziy ung la, nama mingchingmingvuo tie ingchungkhue ziy pata hne a phuv namaa chena haa khata a tingtuona kha hnyi tie ung.

Nama tieriy cawsaa tie mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue ziy pata amaa chena haa khata hmang pathepa lie kha adaahmang la tie ung. Mingchingmingvuo tie ingchungkhue phuv cyicuo lie kha Levi ming ama aw kaluo aa.
Lawsena tuvtaata kha thie ung la niema hne niema kha a pathe tie ung, cakhutaata nama tieriy tie cuo khata a tingtuo tie ung. Moses'a taata pipa Abyipabie haa khata tue tie ung.

Cakhutaata Josiah ta capa lie a awpa cawsaa zaw ta Lawsena Pyi lie ama pihluo riypata tuvrung chungtaata tuvtaata hne mietaata thawsawthung, hne cuetungpa thawthung a hlu; capa ca siepahruo ta a hnyipa chungtaata a cuo.

Aa byi tie ta cawsaa zaw, tluobyi tie zaw, hne Levi ming zaw cuo khata pahyasa pata ama hlu ra. Khazing ing byi lepa tie ta a cuopa Hilkiah, Zekhariah, hne Jehiel zaw khata tluobyi tie kha Lawsena pyi lie pihluo riypata tuvtaata hne mietaata thawhning zacaruv hne cuetungpa zathung ama hlu.

Levi ming byi lepa Konaniah hne a uvnu ta a cuopa Shemaiah hne Nethanel, hne Hashabiah hne Jeiel hne Jozabad ta Levi ming ta Lawsena pyi lie a pihluo riypata tuvtaata hne mietaata thawpangaa hne cuetungpa zapangaa ama hlu.
Rehriena ca tingtuopa a cuo tiyta, siepahruo biepina haa khata tluobyi tie ca iema hmang lie kha a daa yi te, Levi ming ca amaa chena haa khata amaa daa.
Lawsena pyi tuvtaata kha thie yi te, Levi ming ta a vang ama hle nguoluo ning kha tluobyi tie ta iema'a taata ama lapa thiyse kha ama hi.

Moses caa-uv chunglie aa capepa haa khata, Abyipa'a luo pihluo riypata, cawsaa kha ama mingchingmingvuo tie ingchungkhue ziy pata ama chena haa khata re riypata, myirue panaana lie pihluopa tie kha ca a hrang ta ama chi. Cahaa ngiethie cata cuetungpa zaw kha ama tue.
Ziyphung haa khata Lawsena tuvtaata kha myi lie ama e; cakhutaata a pathepa pihluopa tie kha bi, daare, hne uvkuo lie kha chang yi te cawsaa bangkhuo kha a catli pata ama re.

Capa khutaa cata iema cuo hne tluobyi tie cuo khata ama pachie, tahematapakieca Aaron ciypathla tluobyi tie ca myirue panaana pihluona lie hne saa thupa pihluona lie kha zuo te amaa chiykhyi; caacuonakawta Levi ming ca iema huo hne Aaron ciypathla tluobyi tie huo khata ama pachie pata a cuo.

Cakhutaata David hne Asaf hne Heman hne siepahruo profet Jeduthun tie biepina haa khata hlaasatuv tie, Asaf ciypathla tie ca iema hmang lie kha ama aw. Thlake a huopa tie ca thlake lie ca ama aw kaluo; ama tieriy a cuopa Levi ming ta ama tingtuopa kawlieta ama re kha thuse a hu vyi.

Caacuonakawta Siepahruo Josiah bie pina haata Lawsena pyi tue riypa hne Abyipabienatluophie lieta myirue panaana pihluo riypata Abyiparehriena cuota hmang bangkhuo kha capa ning lie ca ta tingtuo pacie diy pata a cuo.
Israel cawsaa a awpa tie ca ta capa cuo lie ca ta Lawsena pyi ca tue yi te, thiynung phuv lipa viechuo pyi kha ning sariy ama tue.

Cahaapa Lawsena pyi ca profet Samuel chuo taa yalya khata tue buo pata cuo vyi; Josiah, hne tluobyi tie hne Levi ming, capa lie a awpa Judah ming hne Israel ming, hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie ta ama tuepa haapa Lawsena pyi ca Israel siepahruo pakha tahmuo tue buo va yi,
Josiah ta siepahruo a cuonapa kung hraa hlyicari kung lie kha tana hingpa pyi ca tue pata a cuo.

Hingpa bangkhuo khutaata, Josiah ta biena-ing kha a tingtuo diy khutaa khata, Izipt siepahruo Neko ca Zufrates cavaa lie a awpa Karkhemish khy lie a du riypata sithaw te, Josiah ta a daakhuo riypata a sihnue.

Cuorasala Neko ta luosituv tie kha pathlie yi te, “Judah siepahruo, Nama hne i tue riypa khaapama a aw? Ataning hing nama hne a du riypata a vaw va ang, cuorasala kama hne rie a dupa tie ingchungkhue tie a du riypa tana i vaw; cakhutaata Khazing na a pahraa riypata bie naa pi. Nama kha aca para li riypata kama'a lie a awpa Khazing a du riypa hing taw tie,” a ta.
Cuorasala Josiah ta cahriy khing li pata ama hne a du riypa khata a hmingsuo kha aa thle. Khazing pakaa taata a pyapa, Neko bie kha naathlie vyi, cuorasala Megiddo ase lie a tuv riypa khata a si.
Liykatuv tie ta siepahruo Josiah kha ama khe; cakhutaata siepahruo ta a changtaapa tie kha, “Naa ruokhyi tie ung, khuosa tana hmaa i hmung,” a ta yi.

Caacuonakawta a changtaapa tie ta aruole taa khata papya yi te aa ruole suohningna khata Jerusalem luo ama sikhyi. Capa lie ca thiy te a mingchingmingvuo tie thluo lie kha ama paby. Judah hne Jerusalem bangkhuo ta Josiah muochie ca ama sa.

Jeremiah zaw ta muochiesana hlaa vaa te, hlaa sa a thepa capaa hne canung hneta ataning tepa hingta Josiah ming ri pata muochie ama sa. Hingpa hing Israel ming chunglieta phungluo ta aa li; muochiesana hlaa lieta ama khung.
Josiah tuesana aa ngaapa hne Abyipaphungbie chunglie aa capepa haata zang tluo aa tlasa pata a tuepa tie,
hne a tuesana a hruothu taata a chuona te ca Israel hne Judah Siepahruo tie Caa-uv chunglieta cape pata a cuo.
Capa ruo cawsaa tie ca ta Josiah sacapaa Jehoahaz ca la yi te a paa a thle riypata Jerusalem lie kha siepahruo ta ama pacuo sa.
Jehoahaz ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu ning kha kung kiy kung thung ta a cuo; Jerusalem lieta thla thung siepahruo a cuo.
Cakhutaata Jerusalem lie kha Izipt siepahruo ta phie te ruo ca ngukhyi ngu talen zakha hne siy talen suokha a hie.
Izipt siepahruo ca ta a uvta Eliakim kha Judah hne Jerusalem cunglie siepahruo ta tue te, a ming kha Jehoiakim ta pata a thle; cuorasala Neko ta a nuta Jehoahaz kha Izipt luo a sikhyi.
Jehoiakim ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu ning kha kung kiy kung pangaa ta a cuo; Jerusalem lie kha kung hraa hlyikha siepahruo a cuo. Ama ta Abyipaa Khazing hmungna lie kha a pha lipa a tue.
Babilon siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ca ama kha a du riypata kya sithaw te, hrakyi khe te a sikhyi.
Nebukhadnezzar ta Abyipaing chunglie biphie chekha zaw kha Babilon luo sikhyi te Babilon lie siepahruo ing lie kha a chi.

Jehoiakim tuesana aa ngaapa, hne ama ta a tuepa duvsamakhie aa chiypa tie, hne hmang pha lipa a tuepa tie ca Israel hne Judah Siepahruo tie Caa-uv lie na cape pata a cuo; cakhutaata a sacapaa Jehoiachin ta ama kha aa thle.
Jehoiachin ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu ning kha kung cari ta a cuo; Jerusalem lie kha thla thung hne ning hraa siepahruo a cuo. Abyipahmungna lie kha a pha lipa a tue.

Capa kung cuovuo ningta Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ta Abyipaing lie muosungpa biphie zaw hne khata ama kha Babilon luo a sikhyi, cakhutaata a uvnu Zedekiah kha Judah hne Jerusalem cunglie siepahruo ta a tue.
Zedekiah ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu ning kha kung kiy kung kha ta a cuo; Jerusalem lie kha kung hraa hlyikha siepahruo a cuo.
Ama ta Abyipaa Khazing hmungna lie kha a pha lipa a tue. Abyipapakaa ta bie a ripa profet Jeremiah hmiekunglie kha a pane vyi.
Khazing ming ta chie a pasa sapa Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar zaw kha aa du; Abyipa, Israel Khazing'a luo a maa riypa khata a hningtarung kha kacu sa te a palung aa pacuo sa.

Tluobyi tie hrawlie luochiytuv vie tie hne cawsaa zaw kha zang tluo aa tla li ciemuo pata aw yi te, mingphang tie duvsamakhie aa chiypa bangkhuo kha ama ziy ra; cakhutaata Jerusalem lieta a pathe sapa Abyipaing kha ama papyapalyi.
Abyipa, ama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing ta a cawsaa hne a awna hmang cunglie kawpacuona a hnyi nakawta a biephyatuv tie kha ci li ta a pathliesue yi;
cuorasala Abyipahihaana ca a cawsaa zaw cunglie tlung te patluo khu a aw li tlina te ta Khazing biephyatuv tie kha tue hyalya yi te a bie kha siysaa ri va yi, profet tie kha ama pahnyi sue hyalya.

Caacuonakawta Khaldi ming siepahruo kha kya pathlie te, ama mingnu tie kha ama hmangpathepa ing chunglieta a thie yi, satlie thaata hne lesaa thaata, kung uvthyi tie hne thaazuo a hnyi lipa tie cunglie kha hmuo kawpacuona hnyi vyi; ama bangkhuo khata capa siepahruo kuv chung luo kha a pi diy yi.
Khazing ing lie biphie bangkhuo, hne Abyipaing lie suethiy bangkhuo, siepahruo suethiy bangkhuo hne a byi tie, capa tie bangkhuo ca Babilon luo a sikhyi diy.
Khazing ing kha myi ta rue yi te, Jerusalem dungkhuo kha ama pacing, a siepahruo ing bangkhuo kha myi ta ama rue, cakhutaata a muosungpa biphie bangkhuo ca ama para diy.
Zueziy taata a lawpa tie kha Babilon luo sii ta a da diy yi te, Persia pena a cusana te ta ama hne a sacapaa tie sii ta ama cuo;

hingpa hing Jeremiah pakaa taata Abyipabie, ruo ta a sabbath tie ca aa lawkhyi diy hluo li, a tapa a tlingna riypata a cuo. Kung sawsariy patling sa riypata cawsaa ama caking chung bangkhuo kha sabbath ca a uv thluo.

Jeremiah pakaa taata Abyipata a ripa bie a tlingna riypata Persia lie Sairas ta siepahruo a cuona kung khana lie kha Abyipata Persia Siepahruo Sairas pathiypalung kha a pathu sa. Caacuonakawta a pena ruo bangkhuo luo kha biephyatuv pathlie te caabie a papyapa zaw kha a pathyi sa:

“Persia Siepahruo Sairas na hing haa hingta a ri: Abyipa, vuoruo Khazing na alyi cunglie pena bangkhuo hing naa pi tli, cakhutaa cata Judah ruo chung, Jerusalem lie ing suokha sapa riypa khata naa chang. Niema hrawlie a awpa ama cawsaa bangkhuo ca sithaw yi se! Abyipanama Khazing ta ca awpuo yi se!” a ta.

Persia Siepahruo Sairas ta siepahruo a cuona kung khana lie, Jeremiah pakaa taata Abyipabie a tlingna riypata Abyipata Persia Siepahruo Sairas pathiypalung kha a pathu sa. Caacuonakawta a pena ruo bangkhuo luo kha biephyatuv pathlie te caabie a papyapa zaw kha a pathyi sa:

“Persia Siepahruo Sairas na hing haa hingta a ri: Abyipa, vuoruo Khazing na alyi cunglie pena bangkhuo hing naa pi tli, cakhutaa cata Judah ruo chung, Jerusalem lie ing suokha sapa riypa khata naa chang.

Niema hrawlie a awpa ama cawsaa bangkhuo ca ama Khazing ta awpuo yi se! Judah ruo Jerusalem luo si riypa hne Jerusalem lie Khazing a cuopa, AbyipaIsrael Khazing, ing kha sa pakhaa riypata pa-awpa tana ama cuo;

cakhutaata a hring kaliepa mekaa, khaapa hmang lie a aw zaw, capa lie a awpa cawsaa tie ca ta siy hne ngu, chechiy hne sahring ta a bya yi se, Jerusalem lie a awpa Khazing ing lie lungthe panaana cuota pipa hlyitaw taa khata,” a ta.
Judah hne Benjamin ingchungkhue luv a cuopa tie, hne tluobyi tie hne Levi ming, Khazing ta a pathiypalung a pathu sapa mekaa ca Jerusalem lie Abyipaing sa pakhaa riypata si amaa nang.
Ama ingpaa bangkhuo kha ta ngu biphie zaw, siy, chechiy, sahring, hne muosungpa lasaw ta amaa bya, iema lungthe ta ama pipa bangkhuo hlyitaw taa khata.
Nebukhadnezzar ta Jerusalem taata za sikhyi te a khazing tie ing chunglie a za chipa Abyipaing biphie tie zaw kha Siepahruo Sairas ama hrahring ta a vya papya.
Persia Siepahruo Sairas ta capa chechiy tie ca, sue caketuv Mithredath kha papya sa te, Judah uvtuv byi Sheshbazzar kuv luo kha ri te a papi sa.
Hingpa hing chechiy cazing ta a cuo: siy rahung sawthung, ngu rahung thawkha, cizung suokiy suothung,
siy kuotung sawthung, a hrangpa ngu kuotung zapaliy suohraa, biphie hrangpa thawkha;
siy hne ngu biphie bangkhuo ta thawpangaa zapaliy ta a cuo. Sii ta sikhyipa tie kha Babilon taata Jerusalem luo ama kya sikhyi tiyta, hingpa bangkhuo hing Sheshbazzar ta a kya phyathaw.
Babilon siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ta Babilon ruo luo sii ta a sikhyipa tie hrawtaata, siicuona chungtaata Jerusalem hne Judah luo, ama khy cyicuo luo a kaapa tie ca hingpa tie hing tana ama cuo.
Iema ca Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordekai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, hne Baanah tapa tie hneta a kaapa ta ama cuo. Israel cawsaa mingluv zaa ca:
Parosh ciypathla tie, thawhning zakha sawsariy pahning.
Shefatiah ciypathla tie, zathung sawsariy pahning.
Arah ciypathla tie, zasariy sawsariy papangaa.
Pahath-moab ciypathla tie chungtaata Jeshua hne Joab ciypathla tie, thawhning zacari hlyihning.
Elam ciypathla tie, thawkha zahning sawngaa papaliy.
Zattu ciypathla tie, zacaky sawliy papangaa.
Zakkai ciypathla tie, zasariy sawcaruv.
Bani ciypathla tie, zacaruv sawliy pahning.
Bebai ciypathla tie, zacaruv pakiy pathung.
Azgad ciypathla tie, thawkha zahning pakiy pahning.
Adonikam ciypathla tie, zacaruv sawcaruv pacaruv.
Bigvai ciypathla tie, thawhning sawngaa pacaruv.
Adin ciypathla tie, zapaliy sawngaa papaliy.
Ater ciypathla chungtaata Hezekiah ciypathla tie, sawcaky pacari.
Bezai ciypathla tie, zathung pakiy pathung.
Jorah ciypathla tie, zakha pahraa hlyihning.
Hashum ciypathla tie, zahning pakiy pathung.
Gibbar ciypathla tie, sawcaky papangaa.
Bethlehem ciypathla tie, zakha pakiy pathung.
Netofah khy ming, sawngaa pacaruv.
Anathoth ming, zakha sawcari.
Azmaveth ciypathla tie, sawliy pahning.
Kiriatharim, Khephirah, hne Beeroth ciypathla tie, zasariy sawliy pathung.
Ramah hne Geba ciypathla tie, zacaruv pakiy pakha.
Mikhmas cawsaa tie, zakha pakiy pahning.
Bethel hne Ai khy ming, zahning pakiy pathung.
Nebo ciypathla tie, sawngaa pahning.
Magbish ciypathla tie, zakha sawngaa pacaruv.
Elam phang hrangpa ciypathla tie, thawkha zahning sawngaa papaliy.
Harim ciypathla tie, zathung pakiy.
Lod, Hadid, hne Ono ciypathla tie, zasariy pakiy papangaa.
Jeriko ciypathla tie, zathung sawliy papangaa.
Senaah ciypathla tie, thawthung zacaruv sawthung.
Tluobyi tie: Jedaiah ciypathla chungtaata Jeshua chungkhue tie, zacaky sawsariy pathung.
Immer ciypathla tie, thawkha sawngaa pahning.
Pashhur ciypathla tie, thawkha zahning sawliy pasariy.
Harim ciypathla tie, thawkha hlyisariy.
Levi ming: Hodaviah ciypathla chungtaata Jeshua hne Kadmiel ciypathla tie, sawsariy papaliy.
Hla satuv tie: Asaf ciypathla tie, zakha pakiy pacari.

Thlake a huopa tie ciypathla tie: Shallum ciypathla tie, Ater ciypathla tie, Talmon ciypathla tie, Akkub ciypathla tie, Hatita ciypathla tie, hne Shobai ciypathla tie, ama bangkhuo ta zakha sawthung pacaky.
Biena-ing rehrietuv tie: Ziha ciypathla tie, Hasufa, Tabbaoth,
Keros, Siaha, Padon,
Lebanah, Hagabah, Akkub,
Hagab, Shamlai, Hanan,
Giddel, Gahar, Reaiah,
Rezin, Nekoda, Gazzam,
Uzza, Paseah, Besai,
Asnah, Meunim, Nefisim,
Bakbuk, Hakufa, Harhur,
Bazluth, Mehida, Harsha,
Barkos, Sisera, Temah,
Neziah, hne Hatifa ciypathla tie.
Solomon changtaapa tie ciypathla tie: Sotai, Hassofereth, Peruda,
Jaalah, Darkon, Giddel,
Shefatiah, Hattil, Pokhereth-hazzebaim, hne Ami ciypathla tie.
Biena-ing rehrietuv tie hne Solomon changtaapa tie ciypathla tie bangkhuo ca zathung sawcaky pahning ta ama cuo.

A rawluo'pa tie hing Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Kherub, Addan le Immer taata a khawpa tie, ahung ciypathla tama ama cuo ta pata ri khu a cuo lipa, Israel ming ama cuo hne cuo li pachangkhuna pata ama ingchungkhue cuose, ama ciypathla cuose ama paluo sa khu li raalaa pata:
Delaiah, Tobiah hne Nekoda ciypathla tie, zacaruv sawngaa pahning.
Tluobyi tie ciypathla zaw chungtaata: Habaiah, Hakkoz, hne Barzillai ciypathla tie (Gilead ming Barzillai sacanung zaw chungtaata pakha kha napuv ta a chiypa ta cuo te, iema ming cata ku pata a cuo).
Hingpa tie hingta ama ciyhruo thukina kha ciyhruo thukina khungna lieta ama huv raalaa pata hmung va yi, caacuonakawta iema ca pathe va yi ta pata tluobyi cuona taa khata papyapa ama cuo.
Uvtuv byi ta iema kha Urim hne Thummim hiehriy riypata tluobyi a aw hluo chung ca a pathe cepa sa kha ning'a va ung ciy, a ta yi.
Aa pungpa bangkhuo ca thawsawliy thawhning zathung sawcaruv ta ama cuo,
hingpa hlyitaw taa hingta ama changtaapa hne ama changtaanung zaw ca thawsariy zathung sawthung pasariy ama ta; cakhutaata hlaasatuv capaa hne canung zahning ama hnyi.
Iema ta aruo zasariy sawthung sa caruv, laa kaapie zahning sawliy sa pangaa,
kala-uv zapaliy sawthung sa pangaa, hne laa thawcaruv zasariy sa kiy ama hnyi.
Jerusalem lie Abyipaing luo ama chiy pahne khata ingchungkhue chekha taata luv a cuopa tie ta a hmang lie sa pakhaa riypata Khazing ing cuo khata lungthe panaana ama pihluo.
Iema'a na ama cuo khu thiy ta ing sana riypata tuokaa ama pipa ca, siy darik thawsawcaruv thawkha, ngu mina thawpangaa, hne tluobyi caw zakha ta a cuo.
Tluobyi tie, Levi ming, hne cawsaa chekha ca Jerusalem hne a cahriylie khata aw yi te, hlaasatuv tie, thlake a huopa tie, biena-ing rehrietuv tie, hne Israel ming bangkhuo ca ama khy lie kha ama aw.
Thla sariyna thlaa vya chiy te Israel ming ca ama khy lie ama aw ning kha, cawsaa kha Jerusalem lieta amaa hmya.

Cakhutaata Jozadak sacapaa Jeshua, a tluobyi viesaa tie hne Shealtiel sacapaa Zerubbabel hne a tieriy tie khata, Khazing cawsaapa Moses phungbie chunglie aa capepa haata, a cunglie myirue panaana pihluona riypata Israel Khazing bienatluophie kha sa hruo amaa thu.
Iema ta ama cahriylie cawsaa tie kha ama ciy nakawta, bienatluophie ca a hruopatu lie kha ama patu, cakhutaata capa cunglie ca maw hne zuoluo ta Abyipa'a luo kha myirue panaana ama pihluo.
Aa capepa haa cata thluodaa pyi kha tue yi te, a ning cyicuo ta aa huna haata ziyphung haa khata, capa zaa ca na pihluo riypata a cuo aa tapa haa khata ningting ta myirue panaana kha ama pihluo.

Capa khutaa cata pihluo paripa myirue panaana tie, thla thaapa ning ta pihluopa tie, hne a pathepa Abyipapyi bangkhuo lie, hne cawsaa ting ta ama tuepa Abyipa'a luo lungthe panaana zaw kha ama pihluo.
A thla sariyna, ning khana taa khata Abyipa'a luo myirue panaana pihluo kha ama pathu. Cuorasala Abyipabiena-ing hruopatu kha patha valie yi.

Caacuonakawta iema ta pazan tie hne lettamaa tie kha tuokaa pi yi te, Persia siepahruo Sairas ta a pa-awpa haa yi ta, sidar thing kha Lebanon tluo taata riyliy luo, Joppa khy luo, vya sikhyi riypata, Sidon ming hne Tair ming kha sa hne dang riypa hne chiytiy kha ama pi.

Jerusalem lie Khazing ing luo ama phanapa kung hningnapa, thla hningna thlaa lie kha, Shealtiel sacapaa Zerubbabel hne Jozadak sacapaa Jeshua ta ama uvnu tluobyi tie hne Levi ming, siicuona chungtaata Jerusalem luo a vya tlung tlipa bangkhuo hne khata, a hruo ama pathu. Levi ming kung kiy taata a cung luo tie kha Abyipaing lie re mangchiytuv ta amaa tlaw.

Cakhutaata Jeshua ca a sacapaa tie hne a tieriy hne, Kadmiel kha a sacapaa zaw hne, Binnui hne Hodaviah kha Henadad sacapaa tie hne, Levi ming kha iema sacapaa hne ama tieriy zaw hneta Abyipaing chunglie rehrietuv tie mangchiy kha hrievu ama la.

Ing satuv tie ta Abyipabiena-ing hruopatu kha ama pathla tiyta, Israel siepahruo David ta a chang siypa haa yi ta, Abyipakha pathuosa riypata, tluobyi tie ca ama cawsie hne hmyakaa hneta ama kya pya, cakhutaata Levi ming, Asaf sacapaa tie kha chaaraa hneta ama kya pya;

cakhutaata aa chaw pata hlaa sa yi te Abyipakha pathuosa yi te palungtluona ama hluo, “Tahematapakieca ama ca a pha, aa hmangpa a duena ca Israel ming cunglie chuozaa ta aa hmang,” ama ta. Iema ta Abyipaama pathuosa ning kha cawsaa bangkhuo ta khuosa ta khi yi te ama palie, tahematapakieca Abyipaing hruopatu kha ama pathla nakawta a cuo.

Cuorasala tluobyi a hluvsa tie hne Levi ming hne ingchungkhue luv a cuopa tie, ing taapa kha a hruopatu cunglie a zaa daapa a hmungpa macuo tie ca capa ing ama hmung tiyta khuosa ta ama caa, cuorasala cawsaa hluvsa ca palungtluona hneta ama khi,
caacuonakawta palungtluona ueryi hne cawsaa ama caana ueryi kha cawsaa ta thleduo khu va yi, tahematapakieca cawsaa kha khuosa ta khi yi te ama ueryi ca luohlaapuv taa khata aa thyi.
Judah ming hne Benjamin ming ama carie a cuopa tie ta siicuona taata a vya kaapa tie na Abyipa, Israel Khazing biena-ing kha a sa yi ta pata ama thyi tiyta,

Zerubbabel hne ingchungkhue luv ta a cuopa tie kha a pha yi te, “Ma ca sakhyi ra'a yi, tahematapakieca nama Khazing ca niema namaa biepa haata kiema zaw a bie ra pate Assiria siepahruo Esar-haddon ta hingpa luo malie a vya sikhyi taata a patha pata ataning te hing ama'a lieta hriykhungrina ma pihluo ra thluo,” ama ta.

Cuorasala Zerubbabel, Jeshua, hne aa ngaapa Israel ingchungkhue uvthyi tie ta, “Ma Khazing cuota ing ma sana lie namaa thla ra na riypa a luo aw vyi; cuorasala Persia siepahruo Sairas ta bie malie a pipa haata Abyipa, Israel Khazing ing ca kiema se tana ma sa aa,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata capa ruo ming ca ta Judah ming kha ama thaa pachi yi te ing sa riypa kha ama paciy sa,
ama re hmaa a si li riypata Persia Siepahruo Sairas chuo taata Persia Siepahruo Darius chuo te khata byi tie kha nawthuv ama pi.
Ahasuerus siepahruo a cuo chung, pe hruo aa thu kung lie kha, Judah hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie suebena caa kha iema ta ama cape.
Cakhutaata Artazaksis chuo lie kha Bishlam hne Mithredath hne Tabeel hne a viesaa tie ta Persia siepahruo Artazaksis'a luo kha caa ama cape; caa ca Aramaik ryi ta cape yi te ama palie.
Uvtuv byi Rehum hne caacapetuv Shimshai ta Jerusalem a du pata Siepahruo Artazaksis'a luo kha a rawluo haa hingta caa ama cape:

(Uvtuv byi Rehum hne caacapetuv Shimshai, hne aa ngaapa ama viesaa tie, bieripatuv tie, luosituv tie, byi tie, Persia ming, Erek ming, Babilon ming, Susa cawsaa tie, capa tie ca Elam ming tana ama cuo,

cakhutaata a lepa hne byi ta a cuopa Osnappar ta Samaria khypuv Cavaa Huesuo ruo chung luo sikhyi yi te a pa-aw sapa mingphang tie khata caa ca ama cape, iema ta ama paphyapa caa ca hing haa hingta a cuo):
“Artazaksis siepahruo'a luo: Cavaa Huesuo ruo lie na cawsaa zaw na bie acaa chang puv. Cakhutaata ata hing

nama'a taata kiema'a luo a kya sipa Judah ming kha na Jerusalem luo a si yi tapa kha siepahruo ta pachang tie. Iema ta capa a du a hmuopa hne a pha lipa khypuv kha ama sa pakhaa nguoluo; khy dungkhuo lungruetlepie kha palang puo tli yi te a hruopatu kha ca ama pare nguoluo.

Hing khypuv hing sa pakhaa yi te a dungkhuo lungruetlepie hing ama palang kieca, iema ca ngukhyi, chechiy hnyi muo, hne luopuv hmuona muo kha pi khing li'apa yi ta siepahruo tuokaa hmungna kha a tla vie aa.
Ata hing, kiema ca siepahruo ing paciy kha a pali rapa ma cuo nakawta, siepahruo ca pa-uvsathyi lipa a cuo riypa ma khing li nakawta hingpa caa hing ca paphya pate siepahruo kha maca pachang sa.

Na mingchingmingvuo tie chuorina caa-uv chunglie kha huv ung la hingpa khypuv hing a du a hmuopa khypuv, siepahruo tie hne ruo-uvbyi tie kha ruvna zaa pipa, hne hluo ning taata a pathu pata a duna a za pathunapa ta a cuo. Capa kawlie ca tana hingpa khypuv hing ama za pahlipa khata a cuo.
Hingpa khypuv hing sa pakhaa yi te a dungkhuona lungruetlepie hing ama patlung kieca, Cavaa Huesuo ruo lie hing ruo hnyi'a va tli ciy tapa kha siepahruo ca maca pachang sa,” ama ta.
Siepahruo ta bie a palie yi: Uvtuv byi Rehum hne khypuv caacapetuv Shimshai hne Samaria hne Cavaa Huesuo ruo lie a awpa ama viesaa tie, biena icaa chang yi.
Ata hing, kiema'a luo malie nama vya paphyapa caa kha i hmiekunglieta ri yi te a bie ama palie.
Bie pi yi angte, huv yi te, hluo ning taata hingpa khypuv hing siepahruo tie a du riypata rie thu te, a chunglie hing a duna hne a tuvna khue khuo pata a cuo taw tapa kha hmung pata a cuo.
Jerusalem hing ta a lesyipa siepahruo tie za hnyi yi te, Cavaa Huesuo ruo bangkhuo kha za uv yi te iema'a lie ca ngukhyi, chechiy hnyi muo hne luopuv hmuo muo zaw kha ama za pi taw.
Caacuonakawta kama ta bie i papya hluo li, hingpa cawsaa tie hing re pataw sa caw pata cuo yi sala khypuv hing a ma sa li riypata bie pi tie ung.
Capa hlyitaw taata, hingpa kawlie hingta nama dyathlaa li riypata a raaring mya ung, khaapanakawma siepahruo ca rana pi riypata ruvna ca a lethaw aa?” a ta.

Cakhutaata Siepahruo Artazaksis caa ca uvtuv byi Rehum hne khypuv caacapetuv Shimshai hne ama viesaa tie hmiekunglie kha ama ri tiyta Jerusalem lie a awpa Judah ming'a luo kha a catli pata vaa yi te hruohra li pata ama pa taw sa.
Capa cuo taa cata Jerusalem lie Khazing ing sa ca pa taw sa yi te Persia Siepahruo Darius siepahruo a cuona kung hningna te khata pazue va tli yi.
Profet Haggai hne Iddo sacapaa profet Zekhariah khata Judah hne Jerusalem lie a awpa Judah ming kyihuo khata ama cunglie a awpa Israel Khazing ming khata profet bie ama ri.
Cakhutaata Shealtiel sacapaa Zerubbabel hne Jozadak sacapaa Jeshua ta Jerusalem lie Abyipaing sa pakhaa kha ama pathu; iema'a lie a awpa Khazing profet tie khata amaa bya.

Capa cuo ning ca ta Cavaa Huesuo ruo uvtuv Tattenai hne Shethar-bozenai hne iema viesaa tie ca a vaw yi te, “Ahungma hingpa ing sa riypa hne hingpa khy dungkhuo patlung riypa hingta bie caa pi yi?” ama ta.
Iema zaw ta, “Hingpa ing a sapa tie hing ama ming ahung zaw tama ama cuo?” ta pata ama hiehriy ra.

Cuorasala iema Khazing ca Judah uvthyi tie cunglie kha a ming a khang nakawta, Darius cung luo capa bie pathyisana a pha hluo li hne capa kawlieta bie paliena a vya kaa hluo li iema ta ing sa kha taw va yi.
Cavaa Huesuo ruo uvtuv byi Tattenai hne Shethar-bozenai hne Cavaa Huesuo uvtuv byi tie ama viesaa tie ta Darius siepahruo'a luo ama paphyapa caa ca hing haa hingta a cuo;
Bie pathyina caa paphya yi te, capa chunglie ca hing haa hingta aa cape: Darius siepahruo cunglie diena bangkhuo aw mang sue.

Kiema ta Judah ruo lie, a lepa Khazing ing luo ma va chiypa kha siepahruo ta pachang tie. Ing ca ama uopa alung ta sa yi te, thing ca lungruetlepie zaw cunglie kha ama khang; hingpa re hing temaasa pata hrie yi te ama rehmaa a sisa.
Cakhutaata capa uvthyi tie ca bie rihne yi pate, ‘Ahungma hingpa ing sa riypa hne hingpa khy dungkhuo patlung riypa hingta bie caa pi yi?’ ma ta yi.
Nama pachang sa riypata iema luv ta a cuopa tie ming kha a cape naase puv ta pata ama ming zaw kha ma hiehriy yi.

Hingpa hing iema malie ama paliepa ta a cuo: ‘Kiema ca alyi hne avuo Khazing sii ta cuo pate, a lesyipa Israel siepahruo pakha ta ma hnangluo kung pasiypuv ningta za sa te a za palangpa ing khana ma pare pakhaa.

Cuorasala ma mingchingmingvuo tie ta vuoruo Khazing kha a hi ama pahaa nakawta iema kha Khaldi ming Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar kuv luo a za pi yi; ama ta hingpa ing hing para te cawsaa kha Babilon ruo luo a sikhyi yi.
Cuorasala Babilon Siepahruo Sairas ta siepahruo a cuona kung khana lie kha hingpa Khazing ing hing sa pakhaa riypata bie a papya.

Ca hlyitaw taata Nebukhadnezzar ta Jerusalem biena-ing chungtaata la te Babilon biena-ing chung luo a sikhyipa Khazing ing lie siy hne ngu biphie tie kha, capa siepahruo Sairas ca ta Babilon biena-ing chungtaata papya te uvtuv ta a chipa Sheshbazzar kuv luo kha a pi.
Ama ta, “Hingpa biphie tie hing la ung la, si ung la Jerusalem lie biena-ing chung luo kha va chi tie ung; cakhutaata Khazing ing ca a hmang lie kha sa pakhaa pata cuo se,” a ta.
Cakhutaata capa Sheshbazzar ca a vaw te Jerusalem lieta Khazing ing hruopatu ca a pathla; capa ning taa cata ata tepa hingta capa ing ca sa nguoluo pata cuo te palang pata cuo valie,’ ama ta.

Caacuonakawta siepahruo ta a pha a ta pata a cuo kieca Babilon lie siepahruo kaw khungna caa-uv lie kha huv yi sala hingpa Jerusalem lie a awpa Khazing ing sa pakhaa riypa kaw hing bie a papya ma papya va ma tapa kha mang yi se. Hingpa kawlieta a palungtlingna kha siepahruo ta caa malie paphya se,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Darius siepahruo ta bie papya te Babilon lieta siepahruo kaw khungna caa-uv lie ca ama huv.
Cuorasala Media pe khypuv ta a cuopa Ekbatana khy lie kha capa caataw ca hmung yi te hing haa hingta aa cape: “Khungpa bie.

Siepahruo a cuona kung khana lie Sairas Siepahruo ta bie a papya: Jerusalem lie a awpa Khazing ing hne aa patuv pata, hriykhungrina ama pihluonapa hne myirue panaana ama pihluonapa hmang, ing ca sa pakhaa pata cuo se; aa suona ca daw sawcaruv ta cuo'a te a kuna zaw daw sawcaruv ta a cuo aa,
uopa alung tluo thung hne thing tluo kha ta pata sa'a yi te, a muo ca siepahruo suethiy taata pi pata a cuo aa.

Ca hlyitaw taata, Nebukhadnezzar ta Jerusalem biena-ing chungtaata la te Babilon luo a sikhyipa Khazing ing siy hne ngu biphie tie kha pi pakhaa pata cuo sala Jerusalem biena-ing luo phya pakhaa pata cuo se, Khazing ing chunglie kha ama'a nata a hmang cyicuo lieta nama chi pakhaa aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta, nama, Tattenai, Cavaa Huesuo ruo uvtuv, cakhutaata nama, Shethar-bozenai, hne a viesaa tie, Cavaa Huesuo ruo uvtuv tie ta cadi khah ung;
Hingpa Khazing ing re hing pakhuopadyi khah ung: Judah uvtuv tie hne Judah uvthyi tie ta Khazing ing hing a hmang lieta sa pakhaa yi se.

Ca hlyitaw taata hingpa Khazing ing sa pakhaana kawlie hing Judah uvthyi tie cuota khaapama nama tuepa aa tapa kha bie ica pi yi: hingpa cawsaa tie hing Cavaa Huesuo ruo ngukhyi, siepahruo ngukhyi chung taa khata haasaa li pata a tlingsa pata a muo nama pi aa.

Vuoruo Khazing'a luo myirue panaana cuota aa hupa cuetungpa a panupa tie, tuvtungpa tie, acuolikie tuv cuose, Jerusalem lie tluobyi tie ta amaa hupa jungsacuo, paciy, mingsuvtiy, acuolikie chiytiy tapa tie kha ning kha hnang ning kha patlyi li pata pi pata a cuo aa.
Cahaacata iema ta vuoruo Khazing'a luo kha palung tluo hriykhungrina pihluo'a yi te, siepahruo hne a saata zaw hringna cuo khata thlaa ama chuo aa.

Hingpa i biepina hing pakhakha ta a thle kieca, capa suena a tuetuv ca, a ing chungtaata pahriy suokha kha a da pata cuo'a te capa cunglie ca pathlie pata a cuo aa. Ing ca sahring ii papungna ta a cuo aa.

Jerusalem lie Khazing ing hing para a tingpa hne thle riypata a kuv a pathliepa ca siepahruo acuolikie cawsaapa ahung a cuo zaw, capa lie a ming a pacu satuv Khazing ta para se. Kama, Darius na bie a papya ang; capa ca cawsaa bangkhuo ta temaana hneta hrie pata a cuo aa,” a ta.
Cahaacata Siepahruo Darius ta bie a taapa haa yi te Cavaa Huesuo ruo uvtuv byi Tattenai, Shethar-bozenai, hne ama viesaa tie ta Siepahruo Darius biepina haata temaasa pata ama tue.

Caacuonakawta profet Haggai hne Iddo sacapaa Zekhariah ta ama ripa profet bie haata Judah uvthyi tie ta rehmaa sisa pata ama hrie. Israel Khazing biepina hne Persia Siepahruo Sairas, Darius, hne Artazaksis biepina thueta,
Siepahruo Darius siepahruo a cuona kung kung caruvna, Adar thlaa ning thungna lieta hingpa ing hing ama za palang.
Israel ming, tluobyi tie hne Levi ming, hne aa ngaapa siicuona taata a vya kaapa tie ta Khazing ing pihluona ca palung tluosa pata ama tue.

Hingpa ing pihluona lie hing iema ta cuetungpa zakha, tuvtungpa zahning, tuvtaata zapaliy ama pihluo, cakhutaata Israel ming mingphang zaa hne aa ziy pata, Israel ming bangkhuo sue pathe sa panaana cuota mietungpa sahraa hlyihning ama pihluo.
Cakhutaata Moses caa-uv chunglie aa capepa haata Jerusalem lie Khazing rehriena cuo khata tluobyi tie ca amaa chena haata hne Levi ming ca a phuv a phuv ta ama chi.
Thla khana ning hraa hlyipaliy ning kha siicuona taata a vya kaapa tie ta Lawsena pyi ama tue.

Tluobyi tie hne Levi ming ca amaa pathe sa tli nakawta ama bangkhuo ta ama pathe. Caacuonakawta siicuona taata a vya kaapa bangkhuo cuo hne ama viesaa tluobyi tie hne iema cuo khata lawsena tuvtaata ca ama thie.
Siicuona taata a vya kaapa Israel ming, hne Abyipa, Israel Khazing abie riypata mingphang tie pyalyina taata a che yi te iema'a luo a vya pahlawpa tie khata ama ning.

Thiynung phuv lipa viechuo pyi kha palungtluona hneta ning sariy ama tue; tahematapakieca Abyipata iema kha ama palung a patluo yi, cakhutaata Assiria siepahruo palung kha iema'a luo a maa; cahaacata ama ta Israel Khazing, Khazing ing re lie kha iema ca aa bya yi.
Capa khutaa cata, Persia Siepahruo Artazaksis chuo lie kha Ezra ca Babilon taa khata a sithaw; Ezra ca Seraiah sacapaa ta a cuo, Seraiah ca Azariah sacapaa, Azariah ca Hilkiah sacapaa,
Hilkiah ca Shallum sacapaa, Shallum ca Zadok sacapaa, Zadok ca Ahitub sacapaa,
Ahitub ca Amariah sacapaa, Amariah ca Azariah sacapaa, Azariah ca Meraioth sacapaa,
Meraioth ca Zerahiah sacapaa, Zerahiah ca Uzzi sacapaa, Uzzi ca Bukki sacapaa,
Bukki cu Abishua sacapaa, Abishua ca Finehas sacapaa, Finehas ca Eleazar sacapaa ta cuo te, Eleazar ca tluobyi le cepa Aaron sacapaa ta a cuo.
Ama ca Abyipa, Israel Khazing ta a pipa yi Moses phungbie lie a thesapa ta a cuo; Abyipaa Khazing kuv ca a cunglie a aw nakawta aa hiepa bangkhuo kha siepahruo ta a pi.
Israel cawsaa chekha, hne tluobyi tie hne Levi ming chekha, hlaasatuv tie hne thlake a huotuv tie, hne biena-ing rehrietuv tie zaw kha Jerusalem luo ama sithaw.
Iema ca siepahruo ta a pena kung a kung sariyna, thla pangaa thlaa lie kha Jerusalem luo ama pha.
Thla khana a ning khana lie kha Babilon taata khy tlaw ca a pathu yi te, thla pangaa thlaa ning khana ning kha Jerusalem ama pha, tahematapakieca a Khazing vihnyina kuv ca a cunglie kha a aw.
Ezra ca Abyipaphungbie kha a cuv riypa, tue riypa, hne a ziyphung hne a phungluo kha Israel ming pacuv riypa kha a palung chunglie aa pari.
Hingpa hing Siepahruo Artazaksis ta Israel ming cuota caacapetuv, Abyipanawbie hne a phungluo a thesapa tluobyi Ezra a pipa caa ta a cuo.
Siepahruo tie siepahruo Artazaksis ta vuoruo Khazing phungbie lie phungbie saya tluobyi Ezra'a luo pipa: Diena. Ata hing

kama ta phungluo papya angte i pena chunglie a awpa Israel ming ahung a cuo zaw, ama tluobyi tie hne Levi ming ama cuo zaw, Jerusalem luo iema palung thu ta a si khingpa mekaa ca nama hneta ama si khu.
Tahematapakieca na kuv chunglie a awpa na Khazing phungbie haata Judah hne Jerusalem kaw kha va khieluo riypata nama ca siepahruo hne ruena a pituv pasariy tie khata maca pathlie,
cakhutaata siepahruo hne ruena a pituv tie ta Jerusalem lie a awpa Israel Khazing cuota palung thusa pata ama pipa siy hne ngu zaw,

capa bangkhuo hne cata Babilon ruo lie na hmung riypa siy hne ngu bangkhuo hne Jerusalem lie a awpa ama Khazing ing huota cawsaa zaw, tluobyi tie zaw ta iema palung thu ta ama pipa bangkhuo zaw kha na phyale aa.

Hingpa tuokaa hing ta cuetungpa zaw, tuvtungpa zaw, hne tuvtaata zaw, hne capa zaw cuo ca ta sata panaana riypa zaw, hne dangpa ta panaana riypa tie zaw kha temaasa pata calyi la Jerusalem lie, na Khazing ing lieta bienatluophie lie kha na pihluo aa.
