Cakhutaata siy hne ngu aa ngaapa tie kha ca nama hne na re hrie hnepa zaw ta a pha nama tana haata, nama Khazing khingna haa khata nama tue aa.
Na Khazing rehriena cuota aca pipa yi biphie tie ca Jerusalem Khazing hmiekunglie ca na va chi aa.
Cakhutaata na Khazing ing cuota aa hupa mekaa, pi riypata hrievu na hnyipa ca, siepahruo suethiy chung taa khata na pi'a yi.
Kama, Siepahruo Artazaksis ta Cavaa Huesuo ruo lie a awpa sue caketuv bangkhuo'a luo kha bie i papya: Vuoruo Khazing phungbie saya, tluobyi Ezra aca hiepa yi mekaa ca temaasa pata nama tue aa,
ngu talen zakha, jungsacuo kor zakha, mingsuvtiy bath zakha, chiytiy bath zakha hne paciy ca aa huna haata nama pi aa.
Vuoruo Khazing nawpipa tuokhaapa a cuo zaw, vuoruo Khazing ing cuota pathiypalung hmisi ta tue pata cuo se, caacuolikieca siepahruo hne a rucutuv zaw pena cunglie na hihaana a tlung aa.

Cakhutaata Khazing ing chunglie tluobyi tie, Levi ming, hlaasatuv tie, thlake a huotuv tie, biena-ing rehrietuv tie, hne rehrietuv a hrangpa tie'a taata ngukhyi cuose, chechiy hnyi muo cuose, luopuv hmuo muo cuose, nama khyi kieca phung haata cuo vyi tapa kha maca pathyi sa yi.

Cakhutaata nama, Ezra, Khazing pipa singna na hnyipa haa hingta, na Khazing phungbie a pachangpa, Cavaa Huesuo ruo lie a awpa bangkhuo kha bie ripa riypata uvtuv byi hne bieripatuv byi kha na chi'a yi; cakhutaata phungbie a pachang lipa tie kha nama pacuv aa.

Na Khazing phungbie hne siepahruo phungbie a ziy lipa bangkhuo ca thie riypata cuose, ruo chungtaata papya riypata cuose, a chechiy chuv riypata cuose, thaw tla riypata cuose, ama cunglieta bieripana kha a cusa pata tue pata a cuo aa,” a ta.
Jerusalem lie Abyipaing parungnaa riypata siepahruo pathiypalung lie hingpa hmang a chipa Abyipa, ma mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing,

cakhutaata siepahruo hne a ruena pituv tie, siepahruo byi lepa tie hmielieta aa hmangpa a duena naa pituv ca thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue. Abyipai Khazing kuv ca i cunglie a aw nakawta i rie pha te Israel ming chungtaata luochiytuv tie kha kama hne sithaw riypata i pahmya yi.
Siepahruo Artazaksis siepahruo cuo chunglie, Babilon taata kama hne a sithawpa ingchungkhue luv a cuopa tie hne ama thukina ca hingpa hing tana a cuo:
Finehas ciypathla tie chungtaata Gershom. Ithamar ciypathla tie chungtaata Daniel. David ciypathla tie chungtaata Shekaniah sacapaa Hattush,
Parosh ciypathla tie chungtaata Zekhariah, ama hneta ming pathlapa capaa zakha sawngaa ama ta.
Pahath-moab ciypathla tie chungtaata Zerahiah sacapaa Eliehoenai, ama hneta capaa zahning.
Zattu ciypathla tie chungtaata, Jahaziel sacapaa Shekaniah, cakhutaata ama hneta capaa zathung.
Adin ciypathla tie chungtaata, Jonathan sacapaa Ebed, cakhutaata ama hneta capaa sawngaa.
Elam ciypathla tie chungtaata, Athaliah sacapaa Jeshaiah, cakhutaata ama hneta capaa sawcari.
Shefatiah ciypathla tie chungtaata, Mikhael sacapaa Zebadiah, cakhutaata ama hneta capaa sawcari.
Joab ciypathla tie chungtaata, Jehiel sacapaa Obadiah, cakhutaata ama hneta capaa zahning pahraa hlyicari.
Bani ciypathla tie chungtaata, Josifiah sacapaa Shelomith, cakhutaata ama hneta capaa zakha sawcaruv.
Bebai ciypathla tie chungtaata, Bebai sacapaa Zekhariah, cakhutaata ama hneta capaa pakiy pacari.
Azgad ciypathla tie chungtaata Hakkatan sacapaa Johanan, cakhutaata ama hneta capaa zakha pahraa.
Adonikam ciypathla tie chungtaata, iema ca a hnang vie ta a kya sipa cuo yi te, ama ming ca Elifelet, Jeuel, hne Shemaiah ta ama cuo, cakhutaata iema hneta capaa sawcaruv.
Bigvai ciypathla tie chungtaata Uthai hne Zakkur, cakhutaata iema hneta capaa sawsariy.
Ahava khypuv luo a langpa cavaa kielie kha pahmya yi angte, capa lie ca ning thung maa ri. Cawsaa hne tluobyi tie kha i mang tiy yi ta, capa lie ca Levi ciypathla kha hmung va yi ang.
Cakhutaata cawsaa luochiytuv ta a cuopa Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zekhariah, hne Meshullam hne cawsaa singpa ta a cuopa Joiarib hne Elnathan kha bie taa yi angte,

Kasifia ama tapa hmang lieta luochiytuv a cuopa Iddo'a luo kha i paphya yi. Iema ca Kasifia lie a awpa Iddo hne a re hrie hnepa biena-ing rehrietuv tie'a lie khaapama nama ri aa tapa kha chang yi angte, capa ca ma Khazing ing cuota rehrietuv malie ama paphya riypa khata a cuo.

Ima Khazing vihnyina kuv ca kiema cunglie a aw nakawta Israel sacapaa Levi sacapaa Mahli ciypathla tie chungtaata cawsaa singpa a ming Sherebiah ama tapa hne a sacapaa zaw hne a tieriy pahraa hlyicari kha ama vya sikhyi.
Hashabiah zaw kha Merari ciypathla ta a cuopa Jeshaiah hne a sacapaa zaw hne a tieriy pakiy hneta ama vya sikhyi.
Capa tie hlyi taa cata David hne a byi tie ta Levi ming a bya riypata ama chi pathlyipa biena-ing rehrietuv zahning pakiy zaw kha ama vya sikhyi. Hingpa tie hing ama ming ta capepa ama cuo diy.

Cakhutaata ma Khazing hmiekunglie kiema hne kiema kha a pachung pata, kiema hne kiema, ma saata zaw, hne ma hnyipa bangkhuo hneta ama'a taata aa bangpa khytlawna ma hnyi the riypata Ahava cavaa lie kha sa-uvna tue riypata i pathyi.

Cakhutaata kiema ta, “Ma Khazing kuv ca ama a huvpa tie mekaa cunglie kha vihnyina ta aw te, cuorasala ama a thawpa bangkhuo cunglie ca a cahrana hne a hihaana ta a tlungsue yi,” ta pata siepahruo kha ma chang tli nakaw khata ma luopuv lie ma carie tie'a taata malie a vetuv riypa riekaphuv hne aruo rieka tie kha siepahruo ca a hie riypata i nang a zaa.
Caacuonakawta sa a uv pate ma Khazing kha maa hie ca, paa ma kie lawna kha naa malie a thliepa.
Cakhutaata luochiytuv vie ta a cuopa tluobyi pahraa hlyihning kha i tlaw yi: Sherebiah, Hashabiah, hne ama tieriy pahraa tie.

Cakhutaata siepahruo hne ruena a pituv tie, aa byi tie, hne capa lie a awpa Israel ming bangkhuo ta ma Khazing ing lie pihluo riypata ama pipa siy, ngu hne biphie tie kha iema'a lie ca pathlie angte i pi yi;
Pathlie angte ama kuv luo i pipa yi ca ngu talen za caruv sawngaa, hne ngu biphie zakha, siy talen zakha,
siy kuotung darik thawkha muo, a phasa pata ama hna ciepa siy haata a muosungpa daa biphie suohning.

Cakhutaata iema kyihuo khata, “Niema ca Abyipacuota pathe ung cate, biphie zaw hing a pathe; cakhutaata ngu hne siy zaw hing lungthe panaana ta Abyipa, nama mingchingmingvuo tie'a luo ama pipa ta a cuo.
Tluobyi lepa tie hne Levi tie hne Jerusalem lie Israel ingchungkhue luv a cuopa tie hmiekunglie, Abyipaing a khuo chunglieta nama pathlie hluo li te mangchiy'a ung cate nama cake aa,” i ta yi.
Caacuonakawta ama pathliepa siy, ngu, hne biphie zaw ca Jerusalem lie ma Khazing ing luo cyi riypata tluobyi tie hne Levi ming ta ama la.

Cakhutaata Jerusalem luo si riypa cata thla khana thlaa ning hraa hlyihning ning ta Ahava cavaa taa cata maa thu; Ma Khazing kuv ca kiema cunglie aw te, ma carie kuv taata hne luopuv tlungluo lie ngie malie a sapa tie'a taata malie a khuo.
Jerusalem luo pha pate capa lie ca ning thung ma aw.

A ning paliyna lie ca, ma Khazing ingchung lieta siy, ngu, hne biphie tie ca Uriah sacapaa tluobyi Meremoth hmiekunglie kha pathlie pate a kuv chung luo ma pi, ama'a lie ca Finehas sacapaa Eleazar kha aw ra te, iema hne cata Levi ming Jeshua sacapaa Jozabad hne Binnui sacapaa Noadiah zaw kha ama aw ra.
A bangkhuo cata ri pate ma pathlie diy, a cyicuo ta aa riyna kha cazing chunglie ma khung.

Capa cuo lie ca siicuona chungtaata a vya kaapa tie ta Israel Khazing'a luo kha myirue panaana pihluo yi te, Israel ming bangkhuo cuota cuetungpa sahraa hlyihning, tuvtungpa sawcaky sa caruv, tuvtaata sawsariy sa sariy, sue pathe sa panaana ta mietungpa sa hraa hlyihning; capa bangkhuo ca Abyipa'a luo myirue panaana ta pihluo pata a cuo.
Iema ta siepahruo nawbie zaw kha ruo uvtuv byi tie hne Cavaa Huesuo pe uvtuv byi tie'a luo kha pi yi te, iema cata cawsaa hne Khazing ing cuota abyana kha ama pi.

Hingpa hmang tie tue diypa a cuo khutaata byi tie ta kama kha naa ngie yi te, “Israel ming, tluobyi tie, hne Levi ming ta hingpa ruo mingphang tie ta a cuopa Kanaan ming, Hit ming, Periz ming, Jebus ming, Ammon ming, Moab ming, Izipt ming hne Amor ming hne ama duvsamakhiepa zaw hne hingta a che va yi, ina ta yi.

Tahematapakieca iema ta ama sacanung chekha kha iema napuv, hne ama sacapaa zaw napuv riypata ama la. Caacuonakawta a pathepa saciy ca ruohrang ming hneta pyapa cuo te, hingpa zang tluo a tla lina lie hing byi tie hne luochiytuv tie kha hmaa ama sa,” ama ta.
Hingpa hing i thyi tiyta i pang hne i buohryi kha thlaa angte, i suo hne i hmyahming kha phie diy angte lalilahie chiysa pata i tu.
Siicuona taata a vya kaapa tie zang tluo a tla lina kawlieta, Israel Khazing bie lieta aa cathangpa bangkhuo ca lalilahie chiy pata zuoluo hriykhungrina te ta i tuna lie kha na cadung yi te amaa tu.
Zuoluo hriykhungrina lie ca i pang hne i buohryi tlaapa hne cata sa i uvna taa cata a daa angte, i pakhuv pane angte, Abyipai Khazing'a luo ca i kuv pazuo angte, i ripa ca,
“Vya i Khazing, nama'a luo a hyi riypa hing i nang zaa te i hmie a chi, tahematapakieca ma suena hing ma luv laata a suo vie te vuoruo na a kya de.

Ma mingchingmingvuo tie chuo taata ataning tepa hingta ma sue hringhruo tli, ma suena cuo hingta kiema, ma siepahruo tie, hne ma tluobyi tie ca ruo hrang siepahruo tie kuv chung luo pi pata cuo pate, zueziy, siicuona, chuvpa cuona, hne nangzaana ca ataning tepa hingta ma ang pari.

Cuorasala ata cuo pachangta chunglie hing kiema malie a pangaapa Abyipama Khazing ta ma ming pavuo sa vie riypa hne ma siicuona chunglie hing hring pakhaana a cawta pi riypata hmiephaa malie pi te a hmang pathepa lieta abangna malie a pi.

Tahematapakieca kiema ca sii tana ma cuo; cuorasala ma Khazing ta ma siicuona lie kha malie thaw vyi. Keima kha hringna thaapa pi riypata cuose, Khazing ing ca padaa pata a ranapa kha pare riypata hne Judea hne Jerusalem lieta a cusa pata a daachue riypata Persia siepahruo hmiekunglie ta aa hmangpa a duena kha malie a pi.
Ma Khazing, ata hing, hingpa khutaa hingta khaapama ma ri aa? Tahematapakieca na nawbie,

na changtaapa profet tie'a taata malie na pipa, ‘Cu riypata namaa ngiehnue riypa ruo ca, capa ruo lie a awpa cawsaa tie duvsamakhie aa chiypa pyalyina kawlieta a pathe lipa ta cuo te, kuokhaluo taata kuokhaluo te iema pathe lina ta ama pabi.

Caacuonakawta nama sacanung tie kha ama sacapaa tie pi li pata, nama sacapaa tie cuota ama sacanung tie kha la khah ung, iema hneta diena hne hnyirungna kha huv khah ung, cahaacata niema ca nama thaa ruv'a te, ruo chungtaata a pyapa kha ning'a ung cate capa ca nama saata tie kha chuozaa ru ta ma chipa siy aa,’ na tapa kha ma thaw tli.

Capa bangkhuo khutaata hmang pha lipa ma tuena kawlie hne a lepa ma suena kawlieta ma cunglie a tlungpa bangkhuo khutaa hingta, ma Khazing, ma suena hne aa phuvpa laata a caw vie ta duo malie te cate, hingpa aa ngaapa hing malie na pi tapa kha ma hmung nakawta,
na nawbie kha para pata hingpa duvsamakhie aa chiypa a tuepa cawsaa tie hne hingta maa chiyhie pakhaa'a ma? Aa ngaapa hne a hringpa ma aw lina te ta ma cunglie na hi haa'a va ma?

Vya Abyipa, Israel Khazing, nama ca naa dang, cuorasala kiema ca hingpa kawlie hingta ma hya zang te aa ngaapa tana ma cuo. Hingpa nama hmiekunglie hing ma suena cangta na ma aw, cuorasala hingpa kawlie hingta caa mang nguopa aw vapuv,” i ta.

Ezra ca Khazing ing hmielieta sue a phu pata thlaachuo te, caa te a laa thluo ning kha, Israel ming chungtaata a hluvsapa cawsaazaapuv, capaa, canung, hne haatiy kha ama'a lie a hmya yi te cawsaa ca khuosa ta ama caa.

Elam ciypathla Jehiel sacapaa Shekaniah ta Ezra ca chaw te, “Kiema ta ma Khazing cunglie zangna kha para pate hingpa ruo hrang canung tie hing napuv ta maa tue tli yi, cuorasala ata hingta hmuo hing haa hingta hmang a cuo thluopa hingta Israel cuota aruechuona a aw kalie.

Caacuonakawta i byipaapa ruena pina hne ma Khazing nawbie lie ciyna a hnyipa tie ruena pina haata hingpa ma napuv bangkhuo hne ama saata bangkhuo hing thaw riypata ma Khazing'a lie hing biekuona tue ung siy; cakhutaata phungbie haata tue pata cuo se.
Capa ca na re ta a cuo, caacuonakawta a cahra sa la thu la hrie tie, nama hne tana ma aw,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Ezra ca thu te luochiytuv vie ta a cuopa tluobyi tie, Levi ming, hne Israel ming bangkhuo kha ama ripa haata tue riypata chie a pasa sa yi. Caacuonakawta chie amaa sa.

Cakhutaata Ezra ca Khazing ing hmiekung taa khata thu te Eliashib sacapaa Jehohanan ingkhuo chung luo kha vaa te siicuona taata a vya kaapa tie zang lina kawlie kha a ngie a chi hringhruo nakawta sa ning li tiy dang li pata capa lie ca aa ri.
Siicuona taata a vya kaapa tie kha Jerusalem lie amaa hmya riypata Judah ruo bangkhuo hne Jerusalem lie kha thuo ama pathyi.

Cakhutaata ning thung chunglie a vya hmya lipa mekaa ca byi tie hne uvthyi tie bie ta ama hnyipa bangkhuo kha chuv pata cuo'a yi te, iema ca siicuona taata a vya kaapa tie'a lie kha pa-aw sa li pata a cuo aa.

Cakhutaata Judah ming hne Benjamin ming bangkhuo ca ning thung chungta Jerusalem lie amaa hmya; capa ca thla cakyna thlaa ning kiy ning ta a cuo. Cawsaa bangkhuo ca Khazing ing ahmyana hmang lie kha a hmya yi te, capa kawlie ca hne khy khuosa ta a saa nakawta amaa cathangsa.
Cakhutaata tluobyi Ezra ta thu te iema kyihuo khata, “Niema ca tue tlamu tli ung cate, ruohrang canung kha hie ung cate Israel suena kha nama chachiy vie.

Ata hing ca Abyipa, nama mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing'a luo kha nama sue a phu ung la a khingna kha tue tie ung; niema hne niema kha ruohrang ming hne ruohrang canung tie'a taa khata a che tie ung,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata a hmyapa bangkhuo khata ueryi paringsa pata palie yi te, “A cuo hmisi saw; na ripa haa tana ma tue aa.

Cuorasala cawsaa ca hluvsa yi te, khy khuosa ta a saa ningta a cuo; ale lieta a daa khu vapuv. Cakhutaata hingpa re hing ning kha ning hning re zaw ta cuo vyi, tahematapakieca hingpa kawlie hingta kiema a hluvpuv hing ma sue tli.

Ma byi tie hingta aa hmyapa zaapuv cuopa hingta a daa yi se; cakhutaata ma khy bangkhuo taata ruohrang napuv a chiypa tie kha hingpa kawlieta myi ie ta a iepa ma Khazing hihaana kha kiema'a taata aa pe hluo li, khy mekaa taata uvthyi tie hne bieripatuv tie ca iema hne cata a cuo thli ciepa cuo lie ca vya pya yi se,” ama ta.
Asahel sacapaa Jonathan hne Tikvah sacapaa Jahzeiah dyi ta capa ca a du yi te, Levi ming Meshullam hne Shabbethai ta amaa daakhyi.
Cakhutaata siicuona taata a vya kaapa tie ta cahaacata ama tue. Tluobyi Ezra ta cawsaa ca ama phang ziy pata ingchungkhue luv tie kha ama ming ta aa tlaw yi.
Thla khana thlaa ning kha na lie kha ruohrang napuv a chiypa tie bangkhuo cuota a chuonapa ca a vya tlung.
Tluobyi tie ciypathla chungtaata ruohrang napuv a chiypa ca, Jozadak sacapaa Jeshua hne a uvnu zaw: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, hne Gedaliah.
Ama napuv tie kha thaw riypata bie a kuo yi te, ama suena cuota sue a ngiethe panaana ca tuvrung chungtaata tuvtungpa sakha ta a cuo.
Immer ciypathla tie chungtaata; Hanani hne Zebadiah.
Harim ciypathla tie chungtaata: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, hne Uzziah.
Pashhur ciypathla tie chungtaata: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad hne Elasah.
Levi ming chungtaata: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah, (Kelita ta pata zaw ama kupa), Pethahiah, Judah hne Eliezer.
Hlaasatuv tie chungtaata: Eliashib. Thlake a huotuv tie chungtaata: Shallum, Telem hne Uri.
Israel ming chungtaata: Parosh ciypathla tie chungtaata: Ramiah, Izziah, Malkhijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Hashabiah hne Benaiah.
Elam ciypathla tie chungtaata: Mattaniah, Zekhariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, hne Elijah.
Zattu ciypathla tie chungtaata: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad hne Aziza.
Bebai ciypathla tie chungtaata: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai hne Athlai ta ama cuo.
Bani ciypathla chungtaata Meshullam, Malluk, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal hne Jeremoth ta ama cuo.
Pahath-moab ciypathla tie chungtaata: Adna, Khelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, hne Manasseh.
Harim ciypathla tie chungtaata: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malkhijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,
Benjamin, Malluk, hne Shemariah.
Hashum ciypathla tie chungtaata: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Elifelet, Jeremai, Manasseh hne Shimei.
Bani ciypathla tie chungtaata: Maadai, Amram, Uel.
Benaiah, Bedeiah, Kheluhi,
Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,
Mattaniah, Mattenai, Jaasu.
Binnui ciypathla tie chungtaata: Shimei,
Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah,
Makhnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,
Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah,
Shallum, Amariah hne Josef.
Nebo ciypathla tie chungtaata: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel hne Benaiah.
Hingpa bangkhuo hingta ruohrang canung kha chiy yi te, ama napuv zaw ca ama saata zaw hne khata ama pasi sa.
Hakaliah sacapaa Nehemiah bie. Kung kiyna kung, Khislev thlaa lie, Susa khypuv lie i aw ning kha,
i uvnupa Hanani ca Judah ruo taata cawsaa chekha hneta amaa vaw; cakhutaata siicuona taata hya a zangpa a hring kaliepa Judah ming kaw hne Jerusalem khy kaw kha i hiehriy yi.

Iema ta, “Siicuona taata a lawpa, ama ruo lieta a hring kaliepa tie ca ruvnaana lesapa hne nangzaana chunglie tana ama aw; Jerusalem dungkhuo lungruetlepie ca cing te, a thlake zaw kha myi ta a para diy,” ina ta yi.
Capa bie ca i thyi tiyta a tu angte i caa, ning hluvpuv ngiechi pata aw angte, vuoruo Khazing hmiekunglie kha sa a uv angte thlaa i chuo.
Kama ta, “Vya Abyipavuoruo Khazing, aa hmangpa a duena hne a nawbie a pacu sa paripa a lesyipa hne ciy aa chiypa Khazing,

Israel cawsaa tie ta nama'a lie kha sue tli pate, capa suena ca phu pata na changtaapa Israel cawsaa zaw cuota na changtaapa ta chung hne zuo ta thlaa i chuona kha na naa ta na thyipa la na ming ta na hmungpa tie. Kama hne i ingchungkhue hneta ma sue tli.
Na cunglie khuosa ta sue tli pate, na changtaapa Moses'a lieta na changpa na nawbie, hne na phungluo hne na ziyphung kha ziy vapuv.
Na changtaapa Moses'a lieta bie pi cate, “Zang tluo namaa tla li kieca, mingphang zaw hrawlie khana ica chepatlaa diy'a yi,

cuorasala kama'a luo kha vya kaa ung cate i nawbie kha ziy ung cate nama tue kieca, nama cawsaa aa chepatlaapa tie ca aa hlacena avuo dena luo chiy hmuo ra yi sala, capa hmang taa cata i ming china riypata i tlaw tlipa hmang luo kha i pakiy'a yi,” na za tapa bie kha a thyi thi tie.
Iema ca a lesyipa na cahrana hne a thaaruvpa na kuv ta na khuopa na changtaapa hne na cawsaa tana ama cuo.

Vya Abyipa, na changtaapa i thlaachuona hne na ming caa pa-uvsathyipa na changtaapa thlaachuona ca na thyipa thi tie. Ataning hing, na changtaapa hing tena pi la, cawsaa zaw hmungna lie hing nangduena pi thi tie,” i ta. Capa cuo ning ca, kama ca siepahruo panuo a cyipa tana i cuo.
Nisan thlaa, Artazaksis Siepahruo ta siepahruo a hriena kung kung kiyna lie kha a hmiekunglie mingsuvtiy ca la angte siepahruo ca i pi. Capa hluota ca a hmiekunglie kha i ngie za chi buo vyi.

Caacuonakawta siepahruo ta, “Khaapanakawma na minghmie a pha va? A pasa ta na pasa tlung va? Na pathiypalung chunglie ngiechina a aw nakaw tana a cuo aa,” ina ta. Cakhutaata kama ca i thlaa a zang hringhruo.

Kama ta siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Siepahruo ca chuozaa ta hring mang sue! I mingchingmingvuo tie thluo awnapa khypuv ca ra te, a thlake zaw ca myi ta ruepa a cuo diy tiyta, tuokhaatama ngiechi li pata i aw khu aa?” i ta.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ta kama kyihuo khata, “Khaapama inaa hie khing ciy?” ina ta. Caacuonakawta vuoruo Khazing'a luo kha thlaa i chuo.

Cakhutaata siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Hingpa hingta na palung ca patluo te, na changtaapa hing na hmiekunglie hmiephaa i hmung kieca, i mingchingmingvuo tie thluo awnapa khypuv kha i pare pakhaa khu riypata Judah ruo luo kha na pathlie thi tie,” i ta.

Siepahruo ta kama kyihuo khata (siepahruonung zaw kha aa thaalieta aa tu ra), “Kha cuo ru'a cate ma khatiy thueta na vya kaa pakhaa aa?” ina ta. Cahaacata siepahruo ta kama pasi sa riypa ca a palung tluo te, kama ta a ningcuo kha i chang.

Cakhutaata siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Hingpa hingna siepahruo palung caa patluo ta pata a cuo kieca, Judah ruo i phana te ta ina caluo sa lawmaw riypa yi ta Cavaa Huesuo ruo uvtuv tie pi riypa caa kha na pi tie;
cakhutaata biena-ing dungkhuo thlake tie tluo riypa hne khy dungkhuo riypa hne kama awna riypa ing cuota thing ina pina riypata siepahruo atuv uvtuv Asaf pi riypa caa zaw kha na pi tie,” i ta.
Cakhutaata Cavaa Huesuo ruo uvtuv tie'a luo kha va pha angte siepahruo caa ca i pi yi. Siepahruo ta riekabyi tie hne aruo rieka tie kha kama hne cata a pasi sa yi.
Horon ming Sanballat hne byi pakha ta a cuopa Ammon ming Tobiah ca, Israel ming phana huv riypa tana cawsaa pakha a vya tlung tapa kha ama thyi tiyta khuopuv ta ama palung pha vyi.
Caacuonakawta Jerusalem luo ca pha angte capa lie ca ning thung i aw.

Cakhutaata kama hne kama'a lie a awpa cawsaa cawta hne khata zuo ta ma thu, cuorasala Jerusalem khy cuota tue riypata Khazing ta i palung chunglie a papuvpa kha ca ahunghmuo chang va yi ang. I khangpa sahring ta li pata sahring sakha hmuo a chiyle va ang.
Zuo ta pya angte Bawphie Thlake taata Riyhre Thlake te, cakhutaata Hnehnaw Thlake te, cakhutaata Jerusalem dungkhuo a cingpa tie hne myi ta a parapa thlake tie zaw kha i mangle.
Cakhutaata Acaa Thlake hne siepahruo tiyliy te kha i cakuo; cuorasala i khanglepa sahring cuota caluona riypa luopuv aw va tli.
Caacuonakawta zuo khata bawphie luopuv luo kha sithaw angte khypuv dungkhuo kha i mang. Cakhutaata hnangluo a pali angte Bawphie Thlake taa khata a ngie angte i kaa.

Byi tie ta khaapa luo ma i vaa tapa hne khaapama i tue tapa kha pachang va yi; tuokhaatama re hrie pata a cuo aa tapa kha Judah ming, tluobyi tie, uvthyi tie, byi tie hne a hrangpa tie zaw kha chang valie yi ang.

Cakhutaata iema kha chang yi angte, “Ima angpa ruvnaana hne Jerusalem ca a thlake zaw myi ta rue yi te a rapa kha nama hmung. A vaw tie ung, nangzaa hmiechi ta ma aw li tli riypata Jerusalem dungkhuo lungruetlepie ca sa pakhaa'a ung puv,” i ta yi.

I Khazing kuv ta i cunglie vi ina hnyina hne siepahruo ta kama ina changpa bie zaw kha i chang yi. Cakhutaata iema ta, “Thu ung sala sa ung siy,” ama ta. Caacuonakawta re pha hrie riypa cata iema'a na iema ca amaa pi.

Cuorasala Horon ming Sanballat hne byi pakha ta a cuopa Ammon ming Tobiah, hne Arab ming Geshem ta capa ca ama thyi tiyta malie pahnyisue malie ese yi te, “Nama tuepa hing khaapatama a cuo? Siepahruo ma namaa du?” malie ama ta.

Cakhutaata kama ta palie yi angte, “Vuoruo Khazing ca tena malie a pituv cuo'a te, kiema a changtaapa tie hingta thu'a pate ma sa aa; cuorasala niema ca Jerusalem lie hing cuvu cuose, khingpa a hie khuna, hne chuobie lie tla ra khuna hnyi va ung ciy,” i ta yi.

Cakhutaata tluobyi lepa Eliashib ca a uvnu tluobyi tie hneta a thu yi te Tuv Thlake kha ama pare. Pathe sa yi te a chiypakaa kha ama bang; Zakha Ingsuo tapa hne Hananel Ingsuo tapa te khata ama pathe sa.
Cakhutaata iema paziy khata Jeriko ming ta ama pare. Iema paziy khata Imri sacapaa Zakkur ta a pare.
Hassenaah sacapaa tie khata Ngaa Thlake kha ama pare; a tluo kha paruo yi te, a phie kha be yi te, a hrena hne a hekhuo zaw kha ama bang.
Iema paziy khata Hakkoz sacapaa Uriah sacapaa Meremoth ta a pare. Iema paziy khata Meshezabel sacapaa Berekhiah sacapaa Meshullam ta a pare. Iema paziy cata Baana sacapaa Zadok ta a pare.
Iema paziy khata Tekoa ming ta ama pare; cuorasala ama byi tie ca ama Byipaapa re lie kha hrie ra khing va yi.
Paseah sacapaa Joiada hne Besodeiah sacapaa Meshullam ta Thlake Hlungpa kha ama pare; a tluo kha ama paruo, a phie kha be yi te, a hrena hne a hekhuo zaw kha ama bang.
Iema paziy khata Gibeon ming Melatiah hne Meronoth ming Jadon hne Cavaa Huesuo ruo uvtuv uvna rawlie a awpa Gibeon ming hne Mizpah ming zaw ta ama pare.

Iema paziy ta Harhaiah sacapaa, siy susatuv pakha ta a cuopa Uzziel ta a pare. Ama paziy khata ziyhmyi a tuepa pakha ta a cuopa Hananiah ta a pare; cahaacata Jerusalem ca Lungruetlepie Kupa te khata ama pare.
Iema paziy khata Hur sacapaa, Jerusalem khingkhuo a uvtuv Refaiah ta a pare.
Iema paziy khata Harumaf sacapaa Jedaiah ta a ing a dadawlie kha a pare.
Harim sacapaa Malkhijah hne Pahath-moab sacapaa Hasshub ta aa ngaapa hne Chuore Ruena Ingsuo lie kha ama pare.
Iema paziy khata Hallohesh sacapaa, Jerusalem pe khingkhuo a uvtuv Shallum hne a sacanung zaw ta ama pare.

Hanun hne Zanoah khy ming ta Bawphie Thlake kha ama pare; a ingchiypakaa tie, a hrena tie hne a hekhuo tie zaw kha ama bang, cakhutaata lungruetlepie kha daw thawkha chung, Hnehnaw Thlake te khata ama pare.
Beth-hakkherem pe uvtuv Rekhab sacapaa Malkhijah ta Hnehnaw Thlake kha pare te, a ingchiypakaa tie, a hrena tie hne a hekhuo zaw kha a bang.

Cakhutaata Kol-hozeh sacapaa, Mizpah pe a uvtuv Shallum ta Acaa Thlake kha a pare; a thluvkhung due te a ingchiypakaa tie, a hrena tie hne a hekhuo zaw kha a bang; cakhutaata ama ta siepahruo diedung chunglie Shelah tiy-ang lungruetlepie kha David khypuv taata a sibungpa hlyidaw te khata a pare.
Cakhutaata Azbuk sacapaa, Beth-zur pe khingkhuo a uvtuv Nehemiah ta David thluo a dadaw te hne sachawpa tiy-ang hne rieka tie ing te khata a pare.
Ama paziy khata Levi ming ta ama pare: Bani sacapaa Rehum; ama paziy khata Keilah pe khingkhuo uvtuv Hashabiah khata ama pe cuo khata a pare.
Ama paziy khata iema tieriy tie ta ama pare: Henadad sacapaa, Keilah pe khingkhuo uvtuv Binnui ta a pare;
ama paziy khata Jeshua sacapaa, Mizpah uvtuv Ezer ta rieka cehre chinapa ing kienapa lie Aa kyina chung kha a pare.
Ama paziy khata Zabbai sacapaa Baruk ta aa kyina taata tluobyi lepa Eliashib ing ingchiypakaa te kha a pare.
Ama paziy khata Hakkoz sacapaa Uriah sacapaa Meremoth ta Eiashib ing ingchiypakaa taata Eiashib ing a chuona te kha a pare.
Ama paziy khata ca tluobyi tie, a cahriy cawsaa tie ta ama pare.
Iema paziy khata Benjamin hne Hasshub ta iema ing a dadaw kha ama pare.
Ama paziy khata Henadad sacapaa Binnui ta Azariah ing taata Aa kyina a kiy te kha a pare.
Uzai sacapaa Palal ta Aa kyina hraw hne rievetuv tie awna siepahruo cungluo ing hraw kha a pare. Ama paziy khata Parosh sacapaa Pedaiah
hne Ofel cunglie a awpa biena-ing rehrietuv tie ta ningchiyluo ta Tiy Thlake a dadaw hne a syipahyapa ingsuo hraw te kha ama pare.
Ama paziy khata a syipahyapa ingsuo lesapa a dadaw taa khata Ofel lungruetlepie te kha Tekoa ming ta ama pare.
Aruo Thlake kachaluo ca tluobyi tie ta iema'a na ama ing a dadaw kaluo khata ama pare.
Iema paziy khata Immer sacapaa Zadok ta a ing a dadaw kha a pare. Ama paziy khata Shekaniah sacapaa, Ningchiy Thlake a huotuv Shemaiah ta a pare.
Ama paziy khata Shelemiah sacapaa Hananiah hne Zalaf sacapaa a pacaruvnapa Hanun tapa tie ta ama pare. Ama paziy khata Berekhiah sacapaa Meshullam ta a awnapa ing tie a dadawlie kha a pare.
Ama paziy khata siy susatuv pakha ta a cuopa Malkhijah ta Ahmyana Thlake a dadaw lie a awpa biena-ing rehrietuv ing hne chadaw tie ing hne aa kyina lie ing a cungduo te khata a pare.
Cakhutaata aa kyina lie ing a cungduo hne Tuv Thlake alala kha siy susatuv tie hne sungpalituv tie ta ama pare.
Sanballat ta lungruetlepie ma sa nguoluopa kha a thyi tiyta, a hi haa hringhruo te Judah ming kha a tue hyalya yi.

A viesaa tie hne Samaria rieka tie kyihuo khata, “Hingpa khaapahmuo a thlahne lipa Judah ming hing khaapama ama tue? Hmang ma ama sa pathiy aa? Hriykhungrina ma ama tue aa? Hingpa hing ning kha ta ama palang'a ma? Hnehnaw pung rawlie alung zaw, myi ta za rue ciepa tie kha ama pahring pakhaa'a ma?
Ammon ming Tobiah kha a thaalie ca aw te, ama ta “Ama sa nguoluopa alung tlepie ca cahnie hmuo a cung luo kie sala a cing'a bya!” a ta.

Vya ma Khazing kiema ca malie ama ese hyalya nakawta ma thlaachuona hing malie thyipa thi tie; malie ama esenapa bie hing iema luv cung lalaa luo pathlasue yi la siicuona ruo lieta ama hnyipa bangkhuo chuvpa ta pacuo sa tie yi.
Tahematapakieca ama khy a parepa tie kha ama ese hyalya nakawta ama suena ca buvkhungpa thi khah yi, ama suena ca na hmungna taata hruvpa khah yi.
Caacuonakawta lungruetlepie ca ma sa pakhaa, cawsaa ca re khingna pathiypalung ama hnyi nakawta lungruetlepie ca aa suona khingkhuo te kha aa pazue diy pata ma palang.

Cuorasala Sanballat hne Tobiah hne Arab ming hne Ammon ming hne Ashdod ming ta, Jerusalem dungkhuo lungruetlepie parena re ca hmieluo tung te aa pazue lina bangkhuo ca aa tawle diy puo tli tapa kha ama thyi tiyta ama hi haa hringhruo te,
Jerusalem luo kha a vaw pata a du pata hnaahnawna patlung riypata ama bangkhuo ta khue ama khuo.
Caacuonakawta ma Khazing'a luo kha thlaachuo pate, iema'a taata chung hne zuo ta malie a vetuv riypata rievetuv pakha ma chi.
Cuorasala Judah ming ta, “Rehrietuv tie ca ama thaazuo cung te hnehnaw vaabuv a hluv tuv nakawta lungruetlepie hing pare khu thlu'a vapuv,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata ma carie tie ta, “Khaahmuo ama pachang li chung hne khaapahmuo ama hmung hluota va tlasue'a yi pate, thie'a yi pate ama re hing ma pataw sa'a yi,” ama ta.
Amaa thaalie a awpa Judah ming kha kiema'a luo amaa vaw tiyta, kiema kha yi hraa te malie chang yi te, “Ama awnapa hmang bangkhuo taa khata a vaw'a yi te malie amaa du aa,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta lungruetlepie hnangkaa lie a awpa a tlawna hmang aa ne cena lie kha cawsaa ca ama ingchungkhue ziy pata ama zueziy, ama'a syi, hne ama liy hne khata i chi yi.

Hmang chiycuozya kha mang angte, a daa angte byi tie hne aa ngaapa cawsaa tie kyihuo khata, “Iema kha ciy khah ung. A lesyipa hne ciy aa chiypa Abyipakha a thyi pari ung la nama tieriy, nama sacapaa tie, nama sacanung tie, nama napuv tie, hne nama ing cuo khata a du tie ung,” i ta yi.
Malie ama rawpa kha kiema ta ma pachang tapa kha ma carie tie ta thyi yi te, Khazing ta iema khuekhuona ca a para tiyta, kiema ca khy dungkhuo luo, ma re cyicuo luo kha ma kaa.

Capa ning taa cata a pathu pata i changtaapa khingkhuo kha re hrie yi te, khingkhuo ca thaa buohryi kha a hryi yi te, asyi, phya, hne liy kha amaa cyi; cakhutaata luochiytuv tie ca lungruetlepie a nepa Judah ming bangkhuo hnangkaa luo khata ama aw.
Chechiy a palawpa tie ca ama kuv hra kha luo taata chechiy kha calang yi te hra kha luo taa khata cehre kha amaa patuv.
Ing satuv tie pakha cyicuo zaw khata ama sapuo nguoluopa khata zueziy kha amaa pathliepuo. Hmyakaa a tungtuv kha i thaalie a aw.
Cakhutaata kama ta byi tie hne aa ngaapa cawsaa tie kha, “Re hing le te a kusa ta aa che diy, cakhutaata kiema zaw hing khy dungkhuo lie hing aa hlasa ta maa che diy.
Caacuonakawta hmyakaa ueryi nama thyina taa khata kiema'a luo hing namaa vya hmya aa. Ma Khazing ta kiema cuota malie aa dupa aa,” i ta yi.
Caacuonakawta re ca hrie pate, chekha ta khy dyi baaning taata aasiy a chiyna cuo te asyi kha amaa patuv.

Kama zaw ta capa ning cata cawsaa zaw kyihuo khata, “Kiema cuota zuo ta rievetuv cuo riypata hne ningchung ta re hrie riypata cawsaa mekaa ca ama changtaapa hne khata Jerusalem luo a vya ri yi se,” i ta yi.
Caacuonakawta kama cuose, i uvnu cuo yi se, ma changtaapa tie cuo yi se, rievetuv naa ziypa tie cuo yi se, ahunghmuo ma caw thlie vapuv; ma cehre kha ma cacuoluo kuv ta maa patuv kaluo.
Cakhutaata cawsaa ca canung capaa ta li pata ama uvnu Judah ming cunglie kha khuosa ta ama khi.
Chekha ta, “Kiema ca ma sacapaa ma sacanung zaw hneta ma hluvsa; ning pata ma hring thena riypata jungsacuo na maa hu,” ama ta.
Chekha zaw ta, “Cakuo ningta jungsacuo ma hmung thena riypata kiema ca ma lu, ma mingsuv diedung, hne ma ing zaw khana biekuona cuo ta ima za chi,” ama ta ra.
Chekha ta, “ma lu hne ma mingsuv diedung cuota siepahruo kha ngukhyi pi riypa tana tuokaa ducyi ma la.

Ata hing kiema pangpa ca ma tieriy pangpa haa tana a cuo; ma saata zaw hing iema saata haa tana ama cuo; cuorasala ma sacapaa hne ma sacanung zaw hing sii na ma pacuo sa'a nang tli yi, cakhutaata ma sacanung chekha zaw ca sii ta zaapa ama cuo tli, ma tue khupa khaapahmuo aw vyi, ma lu hne ma mingsuv diedung zaw ca malie huopa ta ama cuo tli,” ama ta.
Khi yi te pasuena bie ama ripa ca i thyi tiyta i hi a haasa.
Capa ca i pacuo syalya khutaata, byi tie kha chuo yi angte, “Nama bangkhuo ta nama uvnu tie'a taa tana amie nama ning,” i ta yi. Cakhutaata iema kha ahmyana lepuv tuepa yi angte,

“Malie mingphang luo zaapa Judah ming ma uvnu tie kha ma cuo khu chung ta ma calyi pakhaa yi; cuorasala niema ta nama uvnu kha nama zaa, ma calyi pakhaa yi na a hu aa!” i ta yi. Iema ca duokarue yi te, ri riypa bie hnyi va yi.
Caacuonakawta kama ta, “Nama tuepa hmang hing pha vyi. Ma carie a cuopa mingphang tie ta malie ama ese li riypata Khazing ciyzaa pata na nama hring aa hu.
Ca hlyitaw taata kama hne i uvnu tie hne i changtaapa zaw ta iema kha tuokaa hne jungsacuo ducyi ma pi yi. Hingpa amie lapa hing taw ung siy.

Ataning hrahring hingta iema'a taata nama lapa ama lu, ama mingsuv diedung, ama olif diedung, hne ama ing, hne tuokaa mie, jungsacuo, mingsuvtiy, hne chiytiy bangkhuo kha pakaa thluv tie ung,” i ta yi.

Cakhutaata iema ta, “Khaapa mekaa hing pakaa'a yi pate iema'a taata khaapahmuo la'a va tli puv. Na ripa haata ima tue aa,” ina ta yi. Cakhutaata tluobyi tie kha ku yi angte ama ripa haata ama tue riypata biekuona i patue sa yi.

I pang kha thy angte, “Hingpa biekuona a tue lipa mekaa ca hing haa hingta ama ing hne ama re kaluo taata Khazing ta thy pathla yi se. Cahaacata iema ca thy pathlapa cuo yi sala, ama hrikatlaw pata chipa cuo yi se,” i ta. Aa hmyapa bangkhuo ca ta, “Amen,” ta yi te Abyipaama pathuosa. Cakhutaata cawsaa ta ama biekuona haa cata ama tue.

Ca hlyitaw taata Judah ruo chunglie ama uvtuv byi ta re pipa i cuo baataata pathu pata, Siepahruo Artazaksis siepahruo a cuona kung kung kiyna taata kung sawthung hne kung hningna te, kung hraa hlyihning chung, kama ta cuose, i uvnu tie ta cuose, uvtuv byi cuota pipa sa kha ning vapuv.

Kama hluota zaa awpa uvtuv byi tie ta ca cawsaa cunglie kha hmangriy khang yi te, iema'a taa khata ngu shekel sawliy hlyitaw taa khata sa hne mingsuvtiy kha ama la. Cuorasala kama ca Khazing i ciy nakawta cahaacata tue va ang.
Hingpa khy dungkhuo lungruetlepie re lie hing kama hne kama kha a pi diy angte i cuota alyi a la va ang, i changtaapa bangkhuo zaw capa re ca na ama hmyasue diy.
Ca hlyitaw taata ma cahriy ruo taata a vawpa mingphang tie ta li pata i cabya lieta a tupa Judah byi tie zakha sawngaa ama ta.

Ning kha cuota ama changpa ca cuetungpa sakha, a tlawpa tuv sa caruv, hne aa zaw kha kama cuota ina changpa yi, ning hraa duo ta mingsuvtiy saphya ung hluvsa malie ama pi pari. Cuorasala cawsaa cunglie hmang aa riy nakaw khata uvtuv byi cuota pipa sa kha la va ang.
Vya i Khazing, hingpa cawsaa tie cuota i tuepa bangkhuo hing i phana cuota na pachangpa pari tie.

Sanballat hne Tobiah hne Arab ming Geshem hne aa ngaapa ma carie tie ta, khy dungkhuo lungruetlepie ca pare angte, aa taw linapa aw va tli tapa kha ama thyi tiyta (capa cuo te cata thlake lie kha ingchiypakaa i bang li lie raalaa pata),
Sanballat hne Geshem ta kama'a luo kha cawsaa vya pathlie yi te, “A vaw la Ono ase khyta suokha lieta a taw ung siy,” ina ta yi. Cuorasala kama kha ruvna pi riypata amaa ting pata a cuo.
Caacuonakawta biephyatuv kha iema'a luo pathlie angte, “Re lepa suokha i hrie nguoluo nakawta a zuv the'a va ang. Khaapanakawma niema'a luo i zuv chung ta re ca taw caw pata a cuo the aa?” i ta yi.
Iema ta cahaacata cawsaa kha yi paliy kya pathlie yi te, cahaacata yi paliy i palie yi.
Cahaa ngiethie cata a yi pangaanapa ta Sanballat ta a changtaapa kha a kuv chunglie pahaw ciepa caa suokha hneta a kya pathlie.

Capa chunglie ca, “Nama hne Judah ming ca rie thu namaa ting nakawta khy dungkhuo lungruetlepie kha nama pare, ta pata mingphang zaw hrawlie kha a pathuo, Geshem zaw ta capa ca a ri ra. Capa bie haa cata nama ca ama siepahruo cuo kha na khing.
‘Judah ruo chungliena siepahruo a aw,’ ta pata nama kaw a ri riypa profet tie zaw kha Jerusalem lieta na chi yi. Caacuonakawta a vaw la ri pakhaw'a ung puv,” a ta.
Cakhutaata kama ta ama'a luo kha cawsaa pathlie angte, “Na ripa haapa hing khaapahmuo tue pata cuo vyi; nama ta na ruenapa ta na tuechawpa tana a cuo,” i ta.
Tahematapakieca kiema kha pachiypahuo pata, “Re hrie kha ama kuv ta pathlie'a te re kha taw pata a cuo aa,” ta pata ama rue. Cuorasala, Vya Khazing, i kuv kha thaa patlung tie.

Ning kha ca, Mehetabel sacapaa Delaiah sacapaa Shemaiah, ing lie a be thluopa paa ing luo kha i cakuo pata, ama ta, “Khazing ing, biena-ing chunglie kha a taw se pala biena-ing chiypakaa tie kha khaa ung siy, tahematapakieca iema ca nama thie riypa kha tana amaa vaw; ata zuo hing nama thie riypata amaa vaw aa,” ina ta.
Cuorasala kama ta, “Kama haapa capaa pakha hing a ruo riypata i cuo'a ma? Kama haapa capaa pakha hing ta a hringna hya pazang riypata biena-ing chunglie i nu'a ma? Cakuo khu va ang,” i ta.
Khazing ta ama kha a vya pathliepa cuo li pata Tobiah hne Sanballat ta a muo pi yi te bie a vya ri pata a cuopa kha i kya pachang.
Kama kha pachiypahuo pata cahaacata tue pata pasue sa pata ming pachie pata pahnyisue riypata amaa hluopa ta a cuo.
Vya i Khazing, Tobiah hne Sanballat hing hingpa ama tuepa hmang haa hingta a thyipa pari yi la, profetnung Noadiah hne naa pachiypahuopa profet tie zaw hing a thyi pari tie yi.
Caacuonakawta khy dungkhuo lungruetlepie ca Elul thlaa ning kiy ning pangaa ning ta, ning sawngaa hne ning hning chunglie palang pata a cuo.

Cakhutaata ma carie tie bangkhuo ta capa ca ama thyi tiyta, ma cahriylie a awpa mingphang bangkhuo ca ama thlaa zang te iema hne iema amaa zangna kha a cungbung ciemuo; tahematapakieca hingpa re hing ma Khazing abyana tana palang pata a cuo tapa kha ama pachang.
Ca hlyitaw taata capa cuo chunglie ca Judah byi tie ta Tobiah kha caa a hluvsa paphya yi te, Tobiah caa zaw kha iema'a luo a pha ra.

Tahematapakieca ama ca Arah sacapaa Shekaniah piepa a cuo nakawta Judah ming hluvpuv ca ama hneta chiesana ta amaa daa pakhaw; cakhutaata a sacapaa Jehohanan ta Berekhiah sacapaa Meshullam sacanung kha napuv ta a chiy.
Hmang pha a tuepa zaw kha i hmiekunglie ri yi te, i bie kha ama ca ama pathyi sa. Cakhutaata Tobiah ta kama pachiypahuo riypata caa zaw kha a pathlie.
Khypuv dungkhuo lungruetlepie kha palang pate chiypakaa kha bang angte thlake a huotuv tie, hlaasatuv tie, hne Levi ming kha re pi pata ama cuo,
i uvnu Hanani hne rievena ing uvtuv Hananiah kha Jerusalem mangchiytuv re kha i pi yi, tahematapakieca ama ca cawsaa hluvpuv laata zang tluo aa tla viepa hne Khazing a ciypa ta a cuo.

Cakhutaata iema kyihuo khata, “Jerusalem thlake tie hing ning a paling hluota ca pahaw pata cuo khah se; thlake a huotuv tie amaa daa nguoluo ning kha ca thlake kha khaa yi sala hre pata cuo se. A huotuv kha Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie chungtaata a tlawpa cuo sala, iema ama huonapa hmang cyicuo hne ama ing a dadaw cyicuo lie khata ama aw aa,” i ta yi.
Khypuv ca ku te a le, cuorasala a chunglieta a awpa cawsaa ca cawta yi te ing zaw kha sa pata cuo valie.

Cakhutaata Khazing ta byi tie hne cawsaa zaw kha ama thukina ziy pata ming khung riypata pahmya riypa kha i palung chunglie ruena ina pi. Cakhutaata a kaa taapa tie thukina caa-uv kha hmung angte capa chunglie ca hing haa hingta aa capepa kha i hmung.

Hingpa ruo ming, Babilon siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ta siicuona chung luo a sikhyipa tie chungtaata siicuona taata hya a zangpa tie ca hingpa tie hing tana ama cuo; iema ca Jerusalem khy hne Judah ruo luo kha a kaapa tie ta cuo yi te iema ama khy cyicuo luo kha ama kaa.

Iema ca Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordekai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah tapa tie hne khata a vya sipa tana ama cuo. Israel ming ca hingpa zaa hing tana ama cuo:
Parosh ciypathla tie, thawhning zakha sawsariy pahning.
Shefatiah ciypathla tie, zathung sawsariy pahning.
Arah ciypathla tie, za caruv sawngaa pahning.
Pahath-moab ciypathla tie chungtaata, Jeshua hne Joab ciypathla tie, thawhning zacari hlyicari.
Elam ciypathla tie, thawkha zahning sawngaa papaliy.
Zattu ciypathla tie, zacari sawliy papangaa.
Zakkai ciypathla tie, zasariy sawcaruv.
Binnui ciypathla tie, zacaruv sawliy pacari.
Bebai ciypathla tie, zacaruv pakiy pacari.
Azgad ciypathla tie, thawhning zathung pakiy pahning.
Adonikam ciypathla tie, zacaruv sawcaruv pasariy.
Bigvai ciypathla tie, thawhning sawcaruv pasariy.
Adin ciypathla tie, zacaruv sawngaa papangaa.
Ater ciypathla tie chungtaata Hezekiah ciypathla tie, sawcaky pacari.
Hashum ciypathla tie, zathung pakiy pacari.
Bezai ciypathla tie, zathung pakiy papaliy.
Harif ciypathla tie, zakha hlyihning.
Gibeon ciypathla sawcaky papangaa.
Bethlehem le Netofah khy ming, zakha sawcari pacari.
Anathoth ming, zakha pakiy pacari.
Beth-azmaveth khy ming, sawliy pahning.
Kiriath-jearim, Khefirah hne Beeroth khy ming, zasariy sawliy pathung.
Ramah hne Geba khy ming, zacaruv pakiy pakha.
Mikmash khy ming, zakha pakiy pahning.
Bethel hne Ai khy ming zakha pakiy pathung.
Nebo hrangpa ciypathla tie sawngaa pahning.
Elam phang hrangpa ciypathla tie, thawkha zahning sawngaa papaliy.
Harim ciypathla tie zathung pakiy.
Jeriko ciypathla tie zathung sawliy papangaa.
Lod, Hadid hne Ono ciypathla tie, zasariy pakiy pakha.
Senaah ciypathla tie, thawthung zacaky sawthung.
Tluobyi tie: Jedaiah ciypathla chungtaata Jeshua chungkhue tie, zacaky sawsariy pathung.
Immer ciypathla tie thawkha sawngaa pahning.
Pashhur ciypathla tie thawkha zahning sawliy pasariy.
Harim ciypathla tie thawkha hlyisariy.
Levi ming: Hodevah ciypathla chungtaata Jeshua hne Kadmiel ciypathla tie, sawsariy papaliy.
Hlaa satuv tie: Asaf ciypathla tie zakha sawliy pacari.
Thlake a huotuv tie: Shallum ciypathla tie, Ater ciypathla tie, Talmon ciypathla tie, Akkub ciypathla tie, Hatita ciypathla tie, Shobai ciypathla tie, zakha sawthung pacari.
Biena-ing rehrietuv tie: Ziha ciypathla tie, Hasufa ciypathla tie, Tabbaoth ciypathla tie,
Keros ciypathla tie, Sia ciypathla tie, Padon ciypathla tie,
Lebana ciypathla tie, Hagaba ciypathla tie, Shalmai ciypathla tie,
Hanan ciypathla tie, Giddel ciypathla tie, Gahar ciypathla tie,
Reaiah ciypathla tie, Rezin ciypathla tie, Nekoda ciypathla tie,
Gazzam ciypathla tie, Uzza ciypathla tie, Paseah ciypathla tie,
Besai ciypathla tie, Meunim ciypathla tie, Nefushesim ciypathla tie,
Bakbuk ciypathla tie, Hakufa ciypathla tie, Harhur ciypathla tie,
Bazlith ciypathla tie, Mehida ciypathla tie, Harsha ciypathla tie,
Barkos ciypathla tie, Sisera ciypathla tie, Temah ciypathla tie,
Neziah ciypathla tie, Hatifa ciypathla tie.
Solomon changtaapa tie ciypathla tie: Sotai ciypathla tie, Sofereth ciypathla tie, Perida ciypathla tie,
Jaala ciypathla tie, Darkon ciypathla tie, Giddel ciypathla tie,
Shefatiah ciypathla tie, Hattil ciypathla tie, Pokhereth-hazzebaim ciypathla tie, Amon ciypathla tie.
Biena-ing rehrietuv tie bangkhuo hne Solomon changtaapa tie ciypathla bangkhuo ca zathung sawcaky pahning ta ama cuo.

A rawluo'apa tie hing ca Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Kherub; Addon hne Immer taata a khawpa, ahung ciypathla tama ama cuo ta pata ri khu a cuo lipa, Israel ming ta ama cuo hne ama cuo li pachangkhuna ta ama ingchungkhue cuose, ama ciypathla cuose ama paluo sa khu li raalaa pata:
Delaiah ciypathla tie, Tobiah ciypathla tie, Nekoda ciypathla tie, zacaruv sawliy pahning.

Tluobyi tie zaw chungtaata; Hobaiah ciypathla tie, Hakkoz ciypathla tie, Barzillai ciypathla tie (Gilead ming Barzillai sacanung tie chungtaata pakha kha napuv ta a chiypa ta cuo te, iema ming cata ku pata a cuo).
Hingpa tie hingta thukina cazing chunglie ming khungpa chunglie kha ama ming ca ama huv, cuorasala hmung va yi, caacuonakawta iema ca a pathe lipa haa khata tluobyi cuo thena adaahmang hnyi va yi;
uvtuv byi ta, Urim hne Thummim a hmuo khupa tluobyi a aw hluo li ca a pathe cepa sa kha ning'a va ung ciy, a ta yi.
Aa pungpa bangkhuo ca thawsawliy thawhning zathung sawcaruv ta ama cuo,
hingpa hlyitaw taa hingta ama siicapaa hne siicanung zaw ca thawsariy zathung sawthung pasariy ama ta; cakhutaata hlaasatuv capaa hne canung zahning sawliy papangaa ama hnyi.
Iema ta aruo zasariy sawthung sa caruv, laa kaapie zahning sawliy sa pangaa,
kala-uv zapaliy sawthung sa pangaa, laa thawcaruv zasariy sa kiy ama hnyi.
Mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue luv a cuopa tie chekha ta re hriena cuota ama pi. Ruo uvtuv byi ta suethiy ing luo kha siy darik thawkha, rahung sawngaa, tluobyi pang zapangaa sawthung a pi.
Cakhutaata mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue luv a cuopa chekha tie ta ing sana riypata siy darik thawkiy hne ngu mina thawhning zahning ama pi.
Cakhutaata cawsaa hrangpa tie ta ama pipa ca siy darik thawkiy, ngu mina thawhning, hne tluobyi buohryi pasiypa sawcaruv zung sariy ta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta tluobyi tie, Levi ming, thlake a huotuv tie, hlaasatuv tie, cawsaa chekha, biena-ing rehrietuv tie, hne Israel ming bangkhuo ca ama khy lie kha ama aw.
Cawsaa bangkhuo ca Tiy Thlake hmiekunglie zapuv ahmyana hmang lie kha amaa pung. Iema ta caacapetuv Ezra kha Abyipata Israel ming a pipa yi Moses phungbie caa-uv kha vya cyi riypata ama chang.
Ama changpa haa cata caacapetuv Ezra ta thyi te a pachang khu riypa aa hmyapa bangkhuo hmiekung luo kha a vya cyi. Capa ning ca thla sariy thlaa ning kha ning ta a cuo.

Ama ta Tiy Thlake hmiekunglie ahmyana hmang luo kha a hyi pata, maw taata ningchung khingkhuo te khata, a pachang khu riypa canung capaa zaw hmiekunglie kha phungbie caa-uv chung taa cata a ri; cawsaa bangkhuo ta phungbie caa-uv ca a phasa pata ama naathlie.

Caa rina riypata ama tue tlaryapa thing hlyidue lie ca caacapetuv Ezra ca a daa te, ama athaalie cacuoluo kuo ta Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah hne Maaseiah; cavyiluo kuo ta Pedaiah, Mishael, Malkhijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zekhariah hne Meshullam kha amaa daa.
Cakhutaata Ezra ca ta caa-uv ca cawsaa bangkhuo hmung pata pake te, ama ca cawsaa bangkhuo laata aa suo viena lie kha aa daa, a pake tiyta cawsaa bangkhuo ca amaa daa.

Cakhutaata Ezra ta Abyipaa lesyipa Khazing kha pathuosa te, cawsaa bangkhuo ta ama kuv kha calang yi te, “Amen, Amen,” ta pata ama palie. Cakhutaata ama luv kha alyi luo a bung yi te Abyipakha amaa bie.

Cawsaa ta phungbie ama pachangna riypa khata ama awna lie kha Levi ming Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah tapa tie khata amaa bya.
Caacuonakawta Abyipa phungbie caa-uv chung taa cata ri yi te a ri khingna kha ama paliepa nakawta cawsaa ta ama ripa ca ama pachang.

Cakhutaata ruo uvtuv Nehemiah hne caacapetuv tluobyi Ezra, hne cawsaa a pacuvtuv tie khata cawsaa bangkhuo kyihuo khata, “Hingpa ning hing Abyipanama Khazing cuota a pathepa tana a cuo; a ngiy khah ung, a caa zaw caa khah ung,” ama ta. Tahematapakieca cawsaa bangkhuo ca phungbie chungtaata biesuo kha ama thyi tiyta ama caa nakawta a cuo.

Cakhutaata iema kyihuo cata, “Cakuo ung la, sa pahuo daduo kha va ning ung la, mingsuvtiy thlungpa kha va dang tie ung, cakhutaata khaapahmuo a pachie khu lipa tie kha va pasung tie ung, tahematapakieca hingpa ning hing Abyipacuota a pathepa ning tana a cuo; cakhutaata nama ngie chi khah se, tahematapakieca Abyipa'a lie nama palungtluona ca nama thaazuo tana a cuo,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Levi ming ta cawsaa bangkhuo kha a dieta tah pa-aw sa yi te, “A dieta tah aw tie ung, tahematapakieca hingpa ning hing a pathepa tana a cuo; nama ngie chi khah se,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata cawsaa bangkhuo ca iema'a lieta ama pathyipa bie kha ama pachang pasie tli nakawta cakuo yi te, ning yi dang yi te, cawsaa kha pasung pachaa yi te ama palung a tluo hringhruo.
A ning hningna lie ca cawsaa bangkhuo mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue luv a cuopa tie ca tluobyi tie hne Levi ming hne khata phungbie chunglie bie kha a cuv riypata caacapetuv Ezra'a luo amaa vaw.
Thla sariy thlaa pyi chung ca Israel cawsaa ca thluodaa chunglie aw riypa tana a cuo ta pata phungbie chunglie aa capepa kha ama hmung,

cakhutaata, ‘Tluo cung luo khiy pya ung la olif nge, ruo olif nge, martal thing nge, tungkung nge zaw hne a hnaa a rungpa thing nge bangkhuo kha thluodaa sana riypa cata la tie ung,’ ta pata aa capepa haa khata ama khy bangkhuo hne Jerusalem khy lie kha thuo ama pathyi.

Caacuonakawta cawsaa ca pya yi te, thing nge ca vya cyi yi te, ama ing cunglie cuose, ama ing tlawhmie lie cuose, Khazing ing tlawhmie lie cuose, Tiy Thlake tlawhmie lie cuose, Efraim Thlake tlawhmie lie cuose thluodaa kha ama sa.

Siicuona taata hya a zangpa aa hmyapa cawsaa bangkhuo khata thluodaa ca sa yi te a chunglie kha ama aw; tahematapakieca Nun sacapaa Joshua chuo taata ataning tepa hingta Israel ming ta cahaacata ama tue buo li nakawta palungtluona a le hringhruopa kha a aw.

Cakhutaata ningting ta, a ning khana taata a chuona ning te ta, Khazing phungbie caa-uv chung taa khata a ri pari. Pyi ca ning cari chung tue yi te, a ning carina lie kha ama ziyphung haata a pathepa apungna a aw.
Cakhutaata hingpa thlaa ning kiy ning paliy ning ta Israel ming ca sa a uvna hne buri pang a buvna hne ama luv lie alyi diypa a phuvna hneta amaa hmya.
Cakhutaata capa Israel pathla tie ca ruohrang ming'a taa khata a pache yi te, iema suena hne ama mingchingmingvuo tie suena kha a daa yi te amaa phu.

Cakhutaata iema hmang kaluo lie kha a daa yi te Abyipaama Khazing phungbie caa-uv chung taa khata ning che paliy che kha kha ama ri, a hrangpa ning che paliy che kha kha ama sue a phu yi te Abyipaama Khazing kha amaa bie.
Levi ming hlyidaw lie kha Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani hne Khenani kha a daa yi te Abyipaama Khazing'a luo kha ueryi paringsa pata ama khi.

Cakhutaata Levi ming Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah hne Pethahiah tapa tie ta hing haa hingta ama pathuosa: “A daa ung la Abyipanama Khazing ca chuozaa ta chuozaa te pathuosa tie ung. Thluechiy bangkhuo hne pathuosana cungluo ta cyicalangpa na ming rungnaapa ca pathuosa pata cuo mang sue,” ama ta.

Cakhutaata Ezra ta: “Nama dyi hingna Abyipata a cuo ciy; nama ta vuoruo ca na sa, aa suo cepa vuoruo ca a chunglie a awpa hmang bangkhuo hneta cuose, riyliy hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo kha cuose na sa yi. Iema ca hringna pi yi cate, vuoruo lie a awpa hmang tie khata nama ca acaa bie yi.
Nama ca Abram kha a tlaw cate, Khaldi ming tie khy ta a cuopa Ur taa khata pyakhyi cate Abraham ta pata ming na pi.

Cakhutaata ama ca nama'a lieta zang tluo aa tlapa kha hmung cate a ciypathla tie ca Kanaan ming hne Hit ming hne Amor ming hne Periz ming hne Jebus ming hne Girgash ming ruo kha pi riypata ama hneta biekuona na tue; cakhutaata na biekuo ca na patling sa, tahematapakieca nama ca naa dang.
Cakhutaata ma mingchingmingvuo tie ta Izipt ruo lie palungriethyina ama angpa kha hmung cate Riyliy Sepa lie ama khipa kha na thyi.

Ma mingchingmingvuo tie cunglieta aa hruosa pata ama tapa kha na pachang nakawta Faro hne a changtaapa bangkhuo hne a ruo lie cawsaa bangkhuo cunglie kha pamangsana hne kharuehaa hmang kha na tue. Na cuota ming suokha tue cate, ataning tepa hingta aa hmang.

Cakhutaata ama hmiekunglie ta riyliy kha che cate, caacuonakawta riyliy chunglie kha alyi huvpa lieta ama cakuo; cuorasala iema a cadepa tie kha a cahrasapa tiy chunglie alung a tlapa haata aa thuvna luo na pathla yi.
Ca hlyitaw taata, ningchung ta amyi taw ta luo a chiy yi cate, zuo ta ama sinapa luopuv pakhe sa riypata myi taw ta luo naa chiy yi.
Sinai Tluo cunglie kha za cung cate vuoruo taa khiy ta iema ca na za chaw yi, aa hmuopa ziyphung hne phungbie, a phapa phungluo hne nawbie kha na pi yi.
Cakhutaata iema kha a pathepa na sabbath kha pachang sa yi cate, na changtaapa Moses'a taa khata nawbie hne phungluo hne phungbie kha na pi yi.
Ama nangdiyna pape riypata vuoruo taata viechuo za pi yi cate, ama tiyhrie pape riypata alungpuvnung chungtaata tiy na pi yi.
Cuorasala iema hne ma mingchingmingvuo tie ta hruotlena ta hmang tue yi te, ama hningtarung kha a kacu sa yi te nawbie kha ziy va yi.

Ri a ngie lipa yi ta, iema hrawlie na tuepa kharuehaa hmang kha ama palung lie pari va yi; cuorasala ama hningtarung kha a kacu sa yi te Izipt lie ama siicuona luo kha kaa riypata bie amaa chi. Cuorasala nama ca a ngiethe riypa, vihnyi riypata hne nangdue riypa a pacaw pacie pata a awpa, a palung pasiypa hne aa hmangpa duena a hnyipa Khazing na cuo nakawta iema kha thaw va yi ciy.
Iema ta cuetaata zuv kha a patle yi te, “Izipt ruo taata caa vya pyakhyipa na Khazing ca hingpa hing tana a cuo,” ta yi te duvsamakhie aa chiypa hmang ama tue zawta,

na nangduena a lesa nakawta ruocaapa lie kha thawsiy va yi ciy; iema kha luo a chiypa yi amyi taw ta ningchung ta thawsiy lipa yi ta, iema sina riypa luopuv a pakhepa myi taw zaw ta zuo ta thawsiy va yi.
Iema cawpa riypata a phapa na thlaapa kha pi yi cate, na manna kha pi li pata aw va yi ciy, cakhutaata ama tiyhrie pena riypata tiy kha na pi yi.
Kung sawliy chung ruocaapa lie kha caw yi cate khaapahmuo a phahla va yi; ama cawsie kha tlaa li pata ama phyi zaw thling vyi.
Cakhutaata iema ca pena hne mingphang kha pi yi cate, ruo a kiy ting khata na re yi, caacuonakawta Heshbon ming Siepahruo Sihon ruo hne Bashan ming Siepahruo Og ruo zaw kha ama la.
Ama ciypathla ca avuo lie aasiy zaa ta pa pungzaa sa cate, ama mingchingmingvuo tie kyihuo ta a ngie riypata hne cu riypata na changpa yi ruo chung luo kha naa ngiekhyi yi.

Caacuonakawta ama ciypathla tie ca a ngie yi te, ruo ca cu yi te iema hmiekunglie kha capa ruo lie zaa awpa Kanaan ming ca na te yi; duvkhing ta ama tue riypata ama siepahruo tie hne a cawsaa hneta iema kuv chung luo kha na pi yi.

Cakhutaata dungkhuopa khypuv tie hne a hnyirungpa ruo kha la yi te, hmang phapa phang bangkhuo ta a bipa ing zaw, cupa takhue zaw, mingsuv diedung zaw, olif diedung zaw, a pathyipa thingkung hluvpuv zaw kha ama cu; caacuonakawta ning yi te, ama riy bi te ama thu, cakhutaata a lepa na phana chunglie kha amaa law.
Cuorasala ri a ngie lipa yi ta nama kha caa du yi te na phungbie kha ama hnangluo thaw yi te nama'a luo a pali riypata a changpa na profet tie kha thie yi te duvsamakhie aa chiypa kha ama tue.

Caacuonakawta ama carie tie kuv chung luo kha pi yi cate iema ca ama te-ang. Cakhutaata te-angna ama ang ning kha nama'a luo kya khi yi te vuoruo taata na thyi yi; na nangduena a lepa haata ama carie tie kuv chungtaata a khuo riypa yi ta khuotuv kha na pi yi.

Cuorasala amaa pahy khutaata, na hmiekunglie kha pha lina ama tue pakhaa nakawta ama carie tie kuv lie kha thuse yi cate, caacuonakawta iema ta ama uv; cuorasala nama'a luo a vya pali yi te ama khi tiyta, vuoruo taata za thyi yi cate na nangduena thueta yi hluvpuv na khuo yi.

Cakhutaata na phungbie luo kha a pali riypata iema kha a raaringna na pi yi. Cuorasala hruotlesa pata hmang tue yi te na nawbie kha ziy va yi, cuorasala ziylawna thueta cawsaa hringna ta a cuopa na ziyphung kha ama para. Ama letung kha ama pahrang, ama hningtarung kha a kacu sa yi te na ri kha caa ngie va yi.
Kung pasiypuv chung kha iema'a lie na palung pasiy te, na profet tie hmuo pata a raaringna na pi yi; cuorasala naathlie va yi. Caacuonakawta ruohrang ming kuv luo kha na pi yi.
Cuorasala nama ca vihnyituv hne nangduetuv Khazing na cuo nakawta a lepa na duena chunglie kha a chuona luo pa pha sa lipa yi cata thaw va yi ciy.

“Caacuonakawta a lepa hne a cahrapa hne ciy aa chiypa Khazing, biekuona a patling satuv hne aa hmangparipa duena a pacu satuv, kiema cunglie, ma siepahruo tie cunglie, ma byi tie cunglie, ma tluobyi tie cunglie, ma profet tie cunglie, ma mingchingmingvuo tie cunglie, hne ma cawsaa zaw bangkhuo cunglieta, Assiria siepahruo tie chuo taata ataning te ta a tlungpa ruvnaana hing siysaa ri li pata aw thi khah.
Ma cunglie a tlungpa bangkhuo cunglie nama ca naa dang, tahematapakieca nama ca zang tluo aa tlasa pata tue cate, kiema ca a pha li pata ma tue.
Ma siepahruo tie, ma byi tie, ma tluobyi tie, hne ma mingchingmingvuo tie ta na phungbie ziy lipa yi ta nama ta na pipa yi nawbie hne a raaringna zaw kha naathlie va yi.
Ama cunglieta na phana lepa pi yi cate a ma hmiekunglie na chipa a lepa hne a hnyirungpa ruo, iema ruo lie hmuota na re kha hrie lipa yi ta ama tuepa pha lina taa khata nama'a luo a vya pali va yi.
Kiema ca hingpa lie hing ataning te sii tana ma cuo, a thyipaa hne a phana lasaw lie palung tluo riypata ma mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie na pipa yi ruo liena sii ma cuo thluo.

Kiema ma suena kawlieta a hnyirungna thyipaa zaw ca na cunglieta na chipa ma siepahruo tie'a luo kha a si diy; ma pangpa hne ma sahring zaw cunglie kha duvkhing ta naw hnyi yi te kiema ca ma palung rie a thyi hringhruo.
Hingpa zaw bangkhuo kawlie hingta a cupa biekuona kha caa ta cape pate, ma byi tie, ma Levi ming hne ma tluobyi tie ta ama ming kha caakhe ta ama khe.
Caakhena lie ama ming caa khepa tie ca: Hakaliah sacapaa ruo uvtuv byi Nehemiah, hne Zedekiah,
Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,
Pashhur, Amariah, Malkhijah,
Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluk,
Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,
Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruk,
Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,
Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah; iema hing tluobyi ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata Levi ming: Azaniah sacapaa Jeshua, Henadad sacapaa tie chungtaata Binnui le Kadmiel,
cakhutaata ama uvnu tie Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,
Mika, Rehob, Hashabiah,
Zakkur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,
Hodiah, Bani, Beninu.
Cawsaa zaw luochiytuv tie: Parosh, Pahath-moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,
Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,
Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,
Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,
Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai,
Harif, Anathoth, Nebai,
Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,
Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua,
Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,
Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub,
Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek,
Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,
Ahiah, Hanan, Anan,
Malluk, Harim, Baanah tapa tie ta ama cuo.

Aa ngaapa cawsaa tie, tluobyi tie, Levi ming, thlake a huotuv tie, hlaasatuv tie, biena-ing rehrietuv tie, Khazing phungbie kha ziy riypata capa ruo ming tie'a taata iema hne iema kha a nanang ta a chepa tie, ama napuv tie, ama sacapaa tie, ama sacanung tie, thesingna hne pachangna a hnyipa bangkhuo ta

ama tieriy, ama byi tie hne khata Khazing changtaapa Moses hmuo pata pipa Khazing phungbie ziy riypata cuose, cakhutaata ma Byipaapa Abyipanawpina bangkhuo, a ziyphung hne a phungluo zaw kha ziy riypa hne tue riypata chie a sa yi te bie amaa kuo.
Hingpa ruo ming hing ma sacanung tie kha pi li'apa yi pata, ama sacanung zaw kha ma sacapaa zaw cuo ta la'a va yi puv;

cakhutaata hingpa ruo ming hingta sabbath ning kha chechiy cuose, sa cuose zaa riypata ama vya cyi kieca sabbath ning acuolikie a pathepa ning lieta ca calyi'a va yi puv; kung sariyna kung lie ca thyipaa kha la li pata aw'a pate, lyibuo mekaa maa ngiethe diy'a yi.
Ma Khazing ing lie rehriena cuota kung tating ta shekel che thung che kha thu riypa re zaw kha kiema hne kiema maa pavy:

capa ca pachie paripa viechuo, tue paripa sa ta panaana, tue paripa myirue panaana, sabbath ning tie, ama'a na a cuo lieta tuepa pyi tie, a pathepa pihluopa hmang tie, Israel ming sue angiethena cuota sue pathe sa panaana, hne Khazing ing lie rehriena bangkhuo cuota a cuo.

Kiema tluobyi tie, Levi ming, hne cawsaa zaw ta thing pihluona cuota vyisung adana tue pate, mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue kaluo taata aa paziy pata, thlipapa cuo kaluo ningta, kung kha hnang kung kha ta, Abyipama Khazing bienatluophie cunglie ruena riypata, nawbie chunglie aa capepa haa khata Khazing ing chung luo kha ima vya ngie aa, ta pata a cuo.
Ma lu chungtaata la taapa sathaapa, thingkung mekaa taata lu taapa thyipaa tie kha kung tating ta Abyipaing luo chiykhyi riypata hrievu maa pi;

cakhutaata phungbie chunglie aa capepa haata ma sacapaa zaw chungtaata a puv taapa tie hne ma sahring a pachuo taapa tie hne ma cuerung hne tuvrung taata a pachuo taapa tie ca ma Khazing ing luo, ma Khazing ing lie rehrietuv tluobyi tie'a luo kha chiykhyi riypata bie maa kuo hyi;

cakhutaata ma naw taapa viedie, hne ma pihluopa tie, thingkung mekaa taata thingthyi tie, mingsuvtiy hne chiytiy tapa tie kha tluobyi tie'a luo, ma Khazing ing khuo chung luo kha vya chiykhyi riypata bie maa kuo; cakhutaata ma lu taata ma lapa chehraachekha kha ma khyta bangkhuo taata chehraachekha a pakiypa Levi ming'a luo chiykhyi riypata bie maa kuo.

Levi ming ta chehraachekha ama khyi ning kha Aaron ciypathla ta a cuopa tluobyi pakha kha iema'a lieta a aw ra aa; cakhutaata Levi ming ca ta chehraachekha chungtaata chehraachekha kha Khazing ing luo, chechiy china ing chung luo kha ama chi aa.

Israel ming hne Levi sacapaa zaw khata sa hlu, mingsuvtiy, hne chiytiy kha hmangpathepa biphie zaw, hne rehrietuv tluobyi tie, hne thlake a huotuv tie hne hlaasatuv tie awnapa, hmang chinapa khuo luo kha ama chi aa. Kiema ta ma Khazing ing kha hnang chaw'a vapuv.

Cawsaa luochiytuv tie ca Jerusalem lieta ama aw; aa ngaapa cawsaa tie khata pahraa chunglie pakha ca Jerusalem khypuv pathepa lie aw riypata vyisung amaa da, che hraa che caky ca khy hrangpa tie lie kha ama aw.
Cakhutaata Jerusalem lie aw riypata iema palung thuta tah a tingpa tie kha cawsaa ta amaa law.

Hingpa tie hing Jerusalem lie a awpa pe uvtuv tie ta ama cuo: cuorasala Israel ming, tluobyi tie, Levi ming, biena-ing rehrietuv tie, Solomon changtaapa tie ciypathla zaw ca Judah khy zaw lie, iema alyi lie kha ama aw.

Cakhutaata Jerusalem khy chunglie kha Judah ming chekha hne Benjamin ming chekha kha ama aw. Judah ming chungtaata: Athaiah, ama ca Uzziah sacapaa, Uzziah ca Zekhariah sacapaa, Zekhariah ca Amariah sacapaa, Amariah ca Shefatiah sacapaa, Shefatiah ca Mahalalel sacapaa, Mahalalel ca Perez ciypathla zaw chungtaata pakha;

cakhutaata Maaseiah, ama ca Baruk sacapaa, Baruk ca Kol-hozeh sacapaa, Kol-hozeh ca Hazaiah sacapaa, Hazaiah ca Adaiah sacapaa, Adaiah ca Joiarib sacapaa, Joiarib ca Zekhariah sacapaa, Zekhariah ca Shelah phang chungtaata a cuo.
Jerusalem lie a awpa Perez ciypathla tie ca ama bangkhuo ta zapaliy sawcaruv pacari ta cuo yi te ama bangkhuo ta cawsaa riephapa ta ama cuo.

Cakhutaata hingpa tie hing Benjamin ming ta ama cuo: Sallu ca Meshullam sacapaa ta a cuo, Meshullam ca Joed sacapaa ta a cuo, Joed ca Pedaiah sacapaa ta a cuo, Pedaiah ca Kolaiah sacapaa ta a cuo, Kolaiah ca Maaseiah sacapaa ta a cuo, Maaseiah ca Ithiel sacapaa ta a cuo, Ithiel ca Isaiah sacapaa ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata ama uvnu tie Gabbai, Sallai: zacaky pakiy pacari ta ama cuo.
Zikhri sacapaa Joel ca ama luochiytuv ta cuo te Hassenuah sacapaa Judah ca khy uvtuv byi a kya paziypa ta a cuo.
Tluobyi tie: Joiarib sacapaa Jedaiah, Jakhin,
Hilkiah ca Meshullam sacapaa, Meshullam ca Zadok sacapaa, Zadok ca Meraioth sacapaa, Meraioth ca Ahitub sacapaa, Ahitub ca Khazing ing mangchiytuv byi ta a cuo,

cakhutaata iema viesaa biena-ing re a hriepa tie ca, zacari pakiy pahning ta ama cuo; cakhutaata Jeroham sacapaa Adaiah, Jeroham ca Pelaliah sacapaa, Pelaliah ca Amzi sacapaa, Amzi ca Zekhariah sacapaa, Zekhariah ca Pashhur sacapaa, Pashhur ca Malkhijah sacapaa ta a cuo,

cakhutaata ama viesaa tie, mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue luv tie ca zahning sawliy pahning ta ama cuo; cakhutaata Amashsai ca Azarel sacapaa, Azarel ca Ahzai sacapaa, Ahzai ca Meshillemoth sacapaa, Meshillemoth ca Immer sacapaa ta a cuo,
cakhutaata iema viesaa, a thaa ruvpa rieka tie kha zakha pakiy pacari ta ama cuo; iema luochiytuv ca Haggedolim sacapaa Zabdiel ta a cuo.
Levi ming ca: Hasshub sacapaa Shemaiah, Hasshub ca Azrikam sacapa, Azrikam ca Hashabiah sacapaa, Hashabiah ca Bunni sacapaa;
cakhutaata Levi ming luochiytuv tie ta a cuopa Shabbethai hne Jozabad ca Khazing ing aleluo re mangchiytuv ta ama cuo.

Cakhutaata Mikah sacapaa Mattaniah, Mikah ca Zabdi sacapaa, Zabdi ca Asaf sacapaa, Asaf ca thlaachuo ningta palungtluona hlaa a thukhyituv ta a cuo, cakhutaata a viesaa zaw hrawlieta a pahningna ca Bakbukiah ta a cuo; cakhutaata Abda ca Shammua sacapaa, Shammua ca Galal sacapaa, Galal ca Jeduthun sacapaa ta a cuo.
Khypuv pathepa chunglie Levi ming bangkhuo ca zahning sawcari papaliy ta ama cuo.
Thlake a huotuv tie, Akkub, Talmon hne ama viesaa tie ca zakha sawsariy pahning ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata aa ngaapa Israel ming ca Judah ruo chung khy tie, iema ta ru ta ama cupa hmang lie kha ama aw.
Cuorasala biena-ing rehrietuv tie ca Ofel lie kha ama aw; biena-ing rehrietuv tie mangchiytuv ca Ziha hne Gishpa ta ama cuo.

Jerusalem lie Levi ming mangchiytuv tie ca Bani sacapaa Uzzi khata a cuo, Bani ca Hashabiah sacapaa, Hashabiah ca Mattaniah sacapaa, Mattaniah ca Mika sacapaa, Mika ca Asaf ciypathla ta cuo te, hingpa chung tie hing Khazing rehriena lie hlaasatuv khata ama cuo.
Ningting ta aa huna haata re ama hrie riypata hlaasatuv tie hneta aa patuv pata siepahruo'a taata biepina suokha a aw.
Judah sacapaa Zerah ciypathla Meshezabel sacapaa Pethahiah ca cawsaa zaw hne aa patuv pata hmangting kawlie siepahruo ta kuv hne phyi ta a hmuopa ta a cuo.
Khyta tie hne ama lu zaw kawlieta ca, Judah ming chekha ca Kiriath-arba hne a khyta zaw, Dibon hne a khyta zaw, Jekabzeel hne a khyta zaw,
Jeshua khy hne Moladah khy hne Beth-pelet khy hne,
Hazar-shual khy hne Beer-sheba khy hne a khyta tie lie, hne
Ziklag hne Mekonah hne a khyta tie lie,
Enrimmon hne Zorah hne Jarmuth lie,
Zanoah hne Adullam hne a khyta tie lie, hne Lakhish hne a lu tie lie hne Azekah hne a khyta tie lie khata ama aw. Cahaacata Beer-sheba taata Hinnom bawphie te ta khy ama sa.
Benjamin ming zaw kha Geba, Mikmash, Aija, Bethel hne a khyta tie,
Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
Hadid Zeboim, Neballat,
Lod, Ono hne Ge-harashim lie khata ama aw.
Judah ruo lie a awpa Levi ming chekha tie ca Benjamin ruo luo kha ama vaa pahlaw.
Shealtiel sacapaa Zerubbabel hne Jeshua hneta a kya sipa tluobyi tie hne Levi ming ca hingpa tie hing tana ama cuo: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
Amariah, Malluk, Hattush,
Shekaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,
Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abijah,
Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,
Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah,
Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah; Hingpa tie hing Jeshua chuo ningta tluobyi tie hne ama viesaa tie hrawlieta luochiytuv tie ta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata Levi ming: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah hne a uvnu zaw hneta pathuosana hlaa luo hrievu a lapa Mattaniah zaw hingta ama cuo.
Cakhutaata ama uvnu ta a cuopa tie Bakbukiah hne Unno hne ama viesaa tie ca hlaa ama sa tiyta iema hne aa hmiepachaw pata a daapa tie ta ama cuo.
Jeshua ca Joiakim paa ta a cuo, Joiakim ca Eliashib paa ta a cuo, Eliashib ca Joiada paa ta a cuo,
Joiada ca Jonathan paa ta a cuo, cakhutaata Jonathan ca Juddua paa ta a cuo.
Joiakim chuo ningta tluobyi a cuopa tie, ingchungkhue mingchingmingvuo tie ca: Seraiah ingchungkhue lieta Meraiah, Jeremiah ingchungkhue lieta Hananiah,
Ezra ingchungkhue lieta Meshullam, Amariah ingchungkhue lieta Jehohanan,
Mallukhi ingchungkhue lieta Jonathan, Shebaniah ingchungkhue lieta Josef,
Harim ingchungkhue lieta Adna, Meraioth ingchungkhue lieta Helkai,
Iddo ingchungkhue lieta Zekhariah, Ginnethon ingchungkhue lieta Meshullam,
Abijah ingchungkhue lieta Zikhri, Miniamin ingchungkhue lieta Moadiah, Piltai;
Bilgah ingchungkhue lieta Shammua, Shemaiah ingchungkhue lieta Jehonathan,
Joiarib ingchungkhue lieta Mattenai, Jedaiah ingchungkhue lieta Mattenai, Jedaiah ingchungkhue lieta Uzzi,
Sallai ingchungkhue lieta Kallai, Amok ingchungkhue lieta Eber,
Hilkiah ingchungkhue lieta Hashabiah, Jedaiah ingchungkhue lieta Nethanel.

Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, hne Jaddua chuo te khata Levi ming mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue luv a cuopa tie kha cazing lie khung pata cuo te, tluobyi tie zaw kha Persia ming siepahruo Darius chuo te ta cazing lie khung pata a cuo.
Levi ming mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue luv ta a cuopa tie kha Eliashib sacapaa Johanan chuo te kha chuorina caa-uv lie cazing khung pata a cuo.

Cakhutaata Khazing cawsaa David nawbie haata, phuv kha hnang phuv kha ta aa paziy lawmaw pata pathuosana hne alawna hluo riypata; ama uvnu zaw hneta hmie a pachaw pata a awpa Levi ming uvthyi vie tie ca Hashabiah, Sherebiah hne Kadmiel sacapaa Jeshua ta ama cuo.
Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon hne Akkub ca thlake lie, chechiy china ing lieta rie a vepa thlake a huopa tie ta ama cuo.
Jozadak sacapaa Jeshua sacapaa Joiakim hne ruo uvtuv byi Nehemiah hne tluobyi hne caziy cuo a pahlawpa Ezra zaw chuo ningta hmang awtuvzya ca hing haa hingta a za cuo.

Jerusalem khypuv dungkhuo ama pihluo ning kha chaaraa, tingtuolepa, tingtuo, hne hlaa sa pata palungtluona hne pathuosana hneta ama pihluo the riypata Levi ming kha huv yi te ama awna cyicuo taata Jerusalem luo amaa vya chiy.
Hlaasatuv tie phuv zaw kha Jerusalem cahriy taata hne Netofah khyta tie taa khata amaa vya hmya pakhaw;
Beth-gilgal hne Geba hne Azmaveth pe taa zaw khata hlaasatuv tie ca a vya hmya yi te Jerusalem khypuv cahriylie kha khy taata zaw amaa sa.
Cakhutaata tluobyi tie hne Levi ming khata iema hne iema kha a pathe sa yi te, cawsaa tie hne thlake zaw hne lungruetlepie kha ama pathe sa.
Cakhutaata Judah luochiytuv tie kha lungruetlepie luo ca a khawkhyi yi angte, alawna hlaa sa pazue riypata phuv hning ta i chi yi. Phuv kha ca cacuoluo kuo Hnehnaw Thlake luo khata ama si.
Iema khutaa cata Hoshaiah hne Judah uvthyi khingkhuo,
cakhutaata Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,
Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, hne Jeremiah,
hne tluobyi mingnu vie tie kha hmyakaa hneta ama si: Capa tie ca Asaf sacapaa Zakkur sacapaa Shemaiah sacapaa Jonathan sacapaa Zekhariah

hne a tieriy zaw ta a cuopa Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah le Hanani zaw ta ama cuo; Khazing cawsaapa David tungpa chechiy zaw hne khata si yi te, caacapetuv Ezra kha iema hmiekunglie ca ta a si.

Iema hmiekunglie a awpa Acaa Thlake taa khata David khypuv thlake hlyidaw kha ziythaw pata aa dangsa pata sithaw yi te, David ing kacha lie lungruetlepie luo kiena taa khata ningchiyluo Tiy Thlake luo khata ama si.
Cakhutaata pathuosana hlaasatuv phuv kha tie ca cavyiluo khata si yi te kama hne cawsaa khingkhuo khata lungruetlepie cung Chuore Ruena Ingsuo kacha taata Lungruetlepie Kupa te khata ma ziy yi.
Cakhutaata Efraim Thlake kacha, Thlake Hlungpa, Ngaa Thlake, Hananel Ingsuo, hne Zakha Ingsuo taa khata Tuv Thlake luo khata ziy yi pate Rievetuv Thlake lie kha amaa daa.
Caacuonakawta pathuosana hlaa a sapa phuv hning tie ca Khazing ing chunglie kha a daa yi te, byi khingkhuo tie ca kama hne khata ama aw.
Cakhutaata tluobyi ta a cuopa tie Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Mikaiah, Elioenai, Zekhariah, hne Hananiah tapa tie,
cakhutaata Maaseiah Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malkhijah, Elam hne Ezer tapa tie kha hmyakaa hneta ama aw.

Cakhutaata capa ning lie ca hriykhungrina lepuv kha pihluo yi te ama palung a tluo, tahematapakieca Khazing ta khuopuv ta ama palung patluo yi te, canung tie hne haatiy zaw kha ama palung a tluo ra. Jerusalem palungtluona ca luohlaapuv te ta aa thyi.

Capa ning lie ca chechiy china khuo tie hne cawsaa ta ama pihluopa hmang tie, sathaapa, chehraachekha zaw kha mangchiy riypata hne phungbie ta a ripa haata tluobyi tie hne Levi ming cuota thu riypata a cuopa kha, khy ting ama lu taata pahmya riypata cawsaa kha hrievu ma pi yi; tahematapakieca re a hriepa tluobyi tie hne Levi ming cunglie kha Judah ming ca ama palung a tluo.
David hne a sacapaa Solomon biepina haata, hlaasatuv tie hne thlake a huopa tie ta ama tuepa haa khata ama Khazing re hne a pathesana kha ama tue.
Tahematapakieca hluo ning David hne Asaf chuo ningta hlaasatuv tie luochiytuv za aw yi te, Khazing'a luo alawna hne pathuosana hlaa zaw a za aw.

Zerubbabel chuo ning hne Nehemiah chuo ning kha Israel ming bangkhuo ta hlaasatuv tie hne thlake a huopa tie kha ningting ta cuvu ama pi. Levi ming cuota a cuopa kha a hrangta tah chi yi te, cakhutaata Levi ming ta Aaron ciypathla cuota a cuopa kha a hrangta tah ama chi.
Capa ning lie ca cawsa zaapuv thyi riypata Moses caa-uv chung taa khata ama ri tiyta, Ammon ming hne Moab ming ahunghmuo Khazing cawsaa zaw hraw luo kha a ngie'a va yi ta pata ama hmung,
tahematapakieca iema ta Israel ming kha viechuo hne tiy ta daw lipa yi ta chiesa riypata Balaam kha amaa la, cuorasala ma Khazing ta chiesana kha thluechiy ta a pali.
Cawsaa ta phungbie kha ama thyi tiyta ruohrang ciypathla tie kha Israel ming'a taata ama pache.
Capa hluo cata ma Khazing ing chechiy china khuo tie mangchiytuv ta re pipa, Tobiah hneta a pazuena a hnyipa tluobyi Eliashib khata,

sa ta panaana, rangpa-ue zaw, biphie zaw, hne sa chehraachekha zaw, mingsuvtiy, hne chiytiy tapa tie za chinapa, Levi ming, hlaasatuv tie, hne thlake a huopa tie pi riypa tana a cuo ta pata nawbie ta a ripa tie chinapa khuo lepuv kha Tobiah cuota a tue daw.

Capa hmang a cuo ning ca kama kha Jerusalem lieta aw va ang, tahematapakieca Babilon siepahruo Artazaksis siepahruo a cuona kung sawthung kung hning kung lie kha siepahruo'a luo i si nakawta a cuo. Cakhutaata cuo pachangta a ru khutaata siepahruo kha akhaw a hie angte,
Jerusalem luo i kaa. Cakhutaata Eliashib ta a tuepa hmang pha lipa, Tobiah cuota Khazing ing chunglie a khuo suokha a tuepapa kha i hmung.
Cakhutaata kama ca i hi haa hringhruo te ing chunglie Tobiah huopa cabya thude bangkhuo kha a khuo le luo i thaw diy.
Cakhutaata bie pi yi angte ing khuo kha ama pathe sa, Khazing ing biphie tie kha sa ta panaana hne frankinsens zaw hne khata i vya cyi pakhaa.
Levi ming cuvu ama pi lipa zaw kha i hmung; caacuonakawta re a hriepa Levi ming hne hlaasatuv tie ca ama lu luo kha ama kaa.
Caacuonakawta byi tie kha khuosa ta chuo yi angte, “Khaapanakawma Khazing ing hing thaw pata a cuo?” i ta yi. Cakhutaata iema kha pahmya yi angte, ama awna lie kha i chi yi.
Cakhutaa cata Judah ming bangkhuo ta sa chehraachekha, mingsuvtiy, hne chiytiy kha chechiy china ing chung luo ama vya chiykhyi.

Cakhutaata tluobyi Shelemiah, caacapetuv Zadok, hne Levi ming Pedaiah tapa tie kha chechiy china ing lie suekingtuv re pi yi angte, iema ta zang tluo aa tla ama tapa Mattaniah sacapaa Zakkur sacapaa Hanan kha iema a byatuv ta re i pi; iema re ca ama viesaa tie kha chechiy re riypata a cuo.
Vya i Khazing, hingpa kawlie hingta kama kha naa thyi thi tie, I Khazing ing cuota hne a re cuota i tuepa hmang phapa kha na hruvpa diy thi khah.

Khapa cuo lie kha Judah ruo chunglieta sabbath ning ta mingsuv ama nepa, hne sa a hluvsa ta vya phya yi te laa cunglie ama khangpa kha i hmung; cakhutaata mingsuvtiy, mingsuv thyi, thyikuv, hne hmang phangting tapa tie kha sabbath ning ta Jerusalem luo ama vya phyapa i hmung hyi; caacuonakawta sabbath ning lieta sa zaa li riypa kha a raaringna i pi yi.
Tair ming, khypuv chunglie a awpa tie khata ngaa hne chechiy phangting kha vya phya yi te, Judah ming'a lie hne Jerusalem lie kha sabbath ning ta ama zaa.
Cakhutaata Judah byi tie kha khuosa ta chuo yi angte, “Hingpa hmang pha lipa tue ung cate sabbath ning nama papyapalyi sapa hing khaapatama a cuo?

Nama mingchingmingvuo tie ta hing haa hingta ama za tue nakaw tana ma Khazing ta hingpa rana bangkhuo hing kiema cunglie hne hingpa khypuv cunglie hing a patlung sa cuo va ma? Ata ca sabbath ning kha papyapalyi ung cate Israel ming cunglie Khazing hihaana a ruv vie ta nama patlung sa,” i ta yi.

Sabbath hluo lieta Jerusalem thlake lie khy a zing'a nangpa khata, ingchiypakaa tie kha khaa riypa hne sabbath ning a chuona te ta pahaw li riypata bie i pi yi. Cakhutaata sabbath ning lieta chechiy khaapahmuo amaa ngiekhyi li riypata i changtaapa chekha kha thlake i pahuo sa yi.
Cakhutaata sungpalituv tie hne chechiy phangting a zaapa tie kha Jerusalem khy le lieta yi kha yi hning ca amaa ri.

Cuorasala kama ta a raaringna pi yi angte, “Khaapanakawma lungruetlepie hmiekunglie kha namaa ri? Hing haa hingta nama tue pakhaa kieca, nama cungliena i kuv i pathlie pathlyi aa,” i ta yi. Capa cuo ning taa cata sabbath ning kha a vaw va tli yi.

Cakhutaata Levi ming ca sabbath ning kha a pathe pata chi riypata iema hne iema amaa pathe sa riypa hne thlake ama huo riypata bie i pi yi. Vya i Khazing, kama phana riypata hingpa hing a thyi pari la, aa hmangpa na duena a lepa haata kama kha na pahring thi tie.
Khapa cuo lie ngiethie ca ta Ashdod, Ammon hne Moab canung tie hneta a chiyhiepa Judah ming kha i hmung yi;
ama haatiy khingkhuo tie ca Ashdod ryi cyi yi te Judah ryi kha cyi the va yi, mingphang hrang tie ryi dyi kha ama cyi.

Cakhutaata iema kha thla yi angte chiesa yi angte a che ca tuv yi angte ama suo ta i da yi; cakhutaata Khazing ming ta chie pasa sa yi angte, “Nama sacanung tie kha ama sacapaa tie cuota pi li'apa ung cata, ama sacanung tie kha nama sacapaa tie hne niema cuota la'a va ung ciy.

Siepahruo Solomon kha cahaapa canung tie kawlie khana a sue cuo va ma? Mingphang hluvpuv hrawlieta ama haapa siepahruo aw va yi, ama kha a Khazing ta due te, Khazing ta Israel ming bangkhuo cunglie kha siepahruo ta a tue; cuorasala ruohrang canung tie ta ama kha hmuo ama pasue sa.
Kiema ta niema bie kha naathlie pata, hingpa pha lina a lepa bangkhuo hing tue pata ruohrang canung tie chiyhiena ta Khazing cunglie zang tluo aa tla li pata ma aw riypata a cuo'a ma?” i ta yi.
Cakhutaata tluobyi lepa Eliashib sacapaa, Jehoiada sacapaa zaw chungtaata pakha ca Horon ming Sanballat piepa ta a cuo; caacuonakawta kama'a taata i cade.
Vya i Khazing, iema ta tluobyi cuona hne tluobyi tie biekuona hne Levi ming biekuona ca ama papyapalyi nakawta iema ca zaa thyi pari tie yi.
Cahaacata ruohrang hmang tie taa khata iema ca pasiypathe diy yi angte, tluobyi tie hne Levi ming pakha cyicuo kha ama re cyicuo lieta hrievu i pi yi;
cakhutaata a cuo thli ciepa lieta tue riypa thing ta panaana hne sathaapa cuo khata kama ta i thu. Vya i Khazing, i cuota a phana riypata kama kha naa thyi pari thi tie.
Ahasuerus chuo, India ruo taata Ethiopia ruo te, ruo zakha hne ruo kiy ruo sariy a uvtuv Ahasuerus chuo lieta a cuopa ta a cuo.
Capa cuo ning, Siepahruo Ahasuerus kha Susa khypuv a byithude lie aa tu ning,
siepahruo a cuona kung thungna lie kha aa byi tie cuota pyi lesapa a tue. Persia hne Media riebyi tie hne byi tie hne pe uvtuv byi tie kha pyi luo ca ama chiy.
A ruo hnyirungna hne a lesyi rungnaana kha ning hluvpuv, ning zakha ning sawcari chung a pahmung sa yi.
Hingpa cuo a chuo tiyta, Susa khypuv chunglie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo, a le hne a caw hne, cuo khata siepahruo ing diedung tlawhmie lie kha ning sariy chung siepahruo ta pyi lepuv a tuepa yi.

Palaa ta taapa pangzu a ruopa hne aa pathliepa pangzu a dungpa kha palaa phapa hne a ciycaapa palaa ta lungruo tung lie kha ama ciypuo; cakhutaata alung cuopa hne alung ruopa hne lungvaa hne alung muosung ta ama tuepa hmyachung lie kha siy thude hne ngu thude kha ama chi.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ta a hnyipa zaa khata mingsuvtiy ca siy panuo a phangphang khata thu yi te ama dang.

Mingsuvtiy dang ca khazaa-ung ta a patupuopa tana a cuo, ahunghmuo hripuo pata cuo vyi; cawsaa kha ama khingna cyicuo haata aw kaluo riypata siepahruo ing lie byi tie bangkhuo kha siepahruo ta bie a pi yi.
Ca hlyitaw taata, Siepahruonung Vashti zaw khata Siepahruo Ahasuerus siepahruo ing chunglie kha canung tie cuota pyi lepuv a tuepa ra yi.

A ning sariyna ning, siepahruo ca mingsuvtiy ta a palung a patluo sa ning kha aa thaalie a awpa tiydiypa pasariy ta a cuopa tie Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha hne Abagtha, Zethar hne Karkas tapa tie kha,
siepahruonung Vashti ca a puvthena kha cawsaa hne byi tie kha pahmung sa riypata a byilakhuv kha a khuv pata siepahruo hmiekung luo pyakhyi riypata bie a pi yi.
Cuorasala tiydiy tie ta ama changpa siepahruo biepina kha siepahruonung Vashti ta i te, pya khing li pata a aw. Capa ca ta siepahruo kha a hi pahaa te a hihaana ca a ie ta a ie.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ta phungbie a pachangpa tie kha (tahematapakieca hingpa hing siepahruo ta a tue tawpa ta a cuo, phungbie hne hringphung a thepa,
cakhutaata Persia hne Media ming byi pa sariy, siepahruo athaalie a aw paripa hne pena chunglie byi ce ta a cuopa tie Karshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena hne Memukan kyihuo khata):
“Tiydiy tie ta ama changpa Siepahruo Ahasuerus biepina kha a tue khing li nakawta Siepahruonung Vashti kha phungbie haata tuokhaatama ma tue aa?” a ta yi.

Cakhutaata siepahruo hne byi tie hmiekunglie kha Memukan ta, “Siepahruonung Vashti hingta siepahruo cunglie dyi a tuesue pata cuo vyi, Siepahruo Ahasuerus pena chunglie a awpa byi tie bangkhuo hne cawsaa bangkhuo cunglie zaw ta a tuepa tana a cuo.

Tahematapakieca siepahruonung ta a tuepa hingpa hmang hing canung bangkhuo ta pachang'a yi te, ‘Siepahruo Ahasuerus ta Siepahruonung Vashti kha a hmiekung luo pya riypata bie pi te na, pya li pata a aw,’ ta'a yi te, ama navaapa tie kha ama ese aa.
