Ataning hrahring lie hingta, siepahruonung a tuepa kaw a thyipa Persia hne Media ruo byi napuv tie ta siepahruo aa byi tie kha siysaa ri li pata aw ra'a yi te, esena hne hihaana ca chuo the'a va tli.

Siepahruo na a palung a tling tapa kieca, Vashti hing Siepahruo Ahasuerus hmiekung luo pya khah tie se; ta pata bie papya sala, aa thle li tli riypata Persia hne Media phungbie chunglie kha cape pata cuo sala, cakhutaata siepahruonung cuona ca siepahruo ta ama laa hingta a pha viepa kha pi se.

Caacuonakawta siepahruo ta a papyapa biechina kha a ku laalawpa siepahruo pena bangkhuo lie kha ama pathyi tiyta, canung bangkhuo ta ama navaapa tie kha aa ne aa suo ta li pata ama pa-uvsathyi aa,” a ta.
Hingpa ruena pipa hingta siepahruo hne byi tie palung patling te, siepahruo ta Memukan ruena pipa haa khata a tue.

Siepahruo pena bangkhuo luo kha, capaa bangkhuo ca iema hne ama ingchungkhue lie ca byi tana ama cuo aa, ta pata pe bangkhuo hne mingphang bangkhuo kha ama caa hne ama ryi ta thuopathyina ama paphya diy.
Hingpa hmang zaw khutaa hingta, siepahruo ca a hihaana a die khutaa khata, siepahruo Vashti hne a hmang tuepa zaw kha a thyi te a cunglie biechina zaw kha aa thyi pakhaa.
Cakhutaata siepahruo changtaapa tie ama a ysypa tie khata, “Siepahruo cuo hingta a puvthesapa lesaa pathenung zaw kha ca huvpa yi se.

A puvthesapa lesaa thaata zaw kha pakiy pata, Susa khypuv siepahruo ing, lesaa tie awna khuo luo kha pahmya pata siepahruo cawsaa tiydiypa hne canung mangchiytuv Hegai kuv raw luo kha pi riypata ruo chung pe ting lie kha byi chi pata cuo se la rangpa-ue ta pangipasuo pata cuo yi se.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ta a tlechuopa kha Vashti hmang lie kha siepahruonung ta cuo se,” ama ta. Capa ca ta siepahruo palung kha patling te cahaacata a tue.
Susa khypuv chunglie ca Judah ming pakha, Benjamin phang Kish sacapaa Shimei sacapaa Jair sacapaa, a ming Mordekai ama tapa kha a aw.
Kish ca Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ta Judah Siepahruo Jekoniah hneta hruocawsaa ta a da yi te Jerusalem taata a sikhyipa tie hrawlie kha sikhyi pata a za cuo ra.

Mordekai ta a uvnu sacanung, Esther ama tapa Hadassah kha a chaw, tahematapakieca ama ca nung hne paa hnyi va tli; lesaanungta ca puvthesa te khing aa chiysapa ta a cuo, a nung hne a paa ama thiy tiyta, Mordekai khata a sacanung ta aa la.

Siepahruo bie papyapa kha pathyi sa pata a cuo tiyta, hne Susa khypuv siepahruo ing chung Hegai kuv raw luo kha lesaa thaata hluvpuv kha pahmya pata a cuo tiyta, Esther zaw ca siepahruo ing lie canung mangchiytuv Hegai kuv raw luo kha chiykhyi pata a cuo ra.

Lesaanung ca ta a palung hmung te a hmiephaa a hmung, cakhutaata siepahruo ing taata a tlawpa lesaa pa sariy hne khata rangpa-ue ta pangipasuona hne a cuvu sa zaw kha a catlisa pata pi yi te, ama hne a mangchiytuv tie kha lesaa ing a khuo pha cepa kha a pi yi.
Esther ta a mingphang hne a tieriy kha paluosa vyi; tahematapakieca Mordekai ta ri li riypata a changpa tana a cuo.
Esther kha khaapama a lu tapa hne tuokhaatama aa tu aa da tapa kha pachang riypata Mordekai ca lesaa ingkhuo tlawhmie lie kha ningting ta aa khie taw.

Rangpa-ue ta pangipasuona cuota a cuopa thla hraa hlyihning chung, thla caruv chung ca mura ziyhmyi, hne thla caruv chung ca rangpa-ue hne vang puvthenapa sathu ta pangipasuo khutaa khata Siepahruo Ahasuerus'a luo lesaa cyicuo ta a ngiena cuo kha a vya pha.
Lesaa ca lesaa ing taata siepahruo ing chung luo kha aa ngie tiyta a ngiekhyi riypata a khingpa kha pi pata a cuo.

Zuoluo ta a ngie yi te maw ta siepahruo cawsaa tiydiy pa Shaashgaz ta a mangchiypa canung khuo suohningna luo kha ama kya pya, ama ca nungthang tie mangchiytuv a cuo; siepahruo ta tlechuo li pata a ming ta a ku pakhaa li kieca siepahruo'a luo kha a ngie pakhaa va tli yi.

A sacanung hrahring haata a tuepa Mordekai a paa uvnupa Abihail sacanung Esther cuota siepahruo'a luo a ngiena cuo kha a pha tiyta, canung mangchiytuv tiydiypa Hegai ta ruena a pipa ta li pata khaapahmuo a hie vyi. Esther ca a hmungpa bangkhuo ming lie a puvthe hringhruo.
Siepahruo a cuona kung sariyna kung, thla hraana, Tebeth thlaa lie kha Esther ca Siepahruo Ahasuerus siepahruo ing chung luo a ngiekhyi pata a cuo.

Siepahruo ta Esther kha canung hrangpa bangkhuo laata due vie te, lesaa bangkhuo laa khata a palung hmung vie te hmiephaa a pi vie, caacuonakawta siepahruonung byilakhuv kha pakhuv te Vashti hmang lie kha siepahruonung ta a tue.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ta a byi tie hne rehrietuv bangkhuo cuo khata pyi lepuv, “Esther pyi lepuv,” kha a tuepa yi. Siepahruo ta a pena tie kha siepahruo pahyana zaa khata lasaw ta zung a khaapa yi.
Lesaa thaapa tie kha ama pahmya tiyta Mordekai ca siepahruo thlake lie kha aa tu.
Mordekai ta a changpa haa khata Esther ta a tieriy hne a mingphang kha paluo sa vyi; tahematapakieca Esther ta Mordekai kha a za mangsang ning haa khata a ri aa ngie.

Capa cuo ning, Mordekai ca siepahruo thlake lie aa tu ningta kha, siepahruo tiydiypa ta a cuopa pahning tie, ingchiypakaa a huopa Bigthan hne Teresh kha ama hi haa te Siepahruo Ahasuerus kha naw riypata khue ama khuo.
Cuorasala capa kaw ca Mordekai ta a pachang tiyta Esther kha a chang, cakhutaata Esther ta siepahruo kha Mordekai ming ta a chang.

Capa kaw ca hiehriy pasie te a cuo hmisi tapa kha a hmung tiyta, cawsaa pahning tie ca thiena thing tung cunglie a pathlie yi. Capa kaw ca siepahruo hmiekunglie kha chuorina caa-uv chunglie ama khung.

Hingpa zaw khutaa hingta Siepahruo Ahasuerus ta Agag ming Hammedatha sacapaa Haman ca a re a pakie, a viesaa tie hmieluo khata chi te ama'a lie a awpa byi tie bangkhuo laa khata a cunglieta a patu sa.

Cakhutaata siepahruo thlake luo a vawpa siepahruo changtaapa bangkhuo khata Haman ca a bung yi te pa-uvsathyina ama pi; tahematapakieca capa kaw ca siepahruo ta bie a pipa yi ta a cuo. Cuorasala Mordekai ta ca a bung li pata pa-uvsathyina zaw pi vyi.
Cakhutaata siepahruo thlake lie a awpa siepahruo changtaapa tie ta Mordekai kyihuo khata, “Khaapanakawma siepahruo nawbie kha na ziy va? ama ta.

Ama kha ning kha hnang ning kha chang yi te a naathlie li tiy yi ta, Mordekai bie hing a cuo khu'a ma cuo khu'a va ma tapa kha ama pachang riypata Haman kha ama chang; tahematapakieca iema kha Judah ming tana i cuo tapa kha a chang yi.
Mordekai ta a hmiekunglie a bung li pata pa-uvsathyina a pi lipa kha a hmung tiyta Haman ca a hi a haa hringhruo.

Cuorasala Mordekai dyi thiepa ca a palung tling khu vyi. Mordekai mingphang kha ama chang tli nakawta, Ahasuerus ruo chunglie a awpa Mordekai a mingphang, Judah ming bangkhuo khata para diy riypata a raw yi.

Thla khana thlaa, Nisan thlaa, Siepahruo Ahasuerus siepahruo a cuona kung hraa hlyihningna lie kha Haman hmiekunglieta Pur tapa vyisung kha a ning cuo hne a thla cuota amaa da ca vyisung ca thla hraa hlyihningna, Adar thlaa ning hraa hlyithung ning kha a tla.

Cakhutaata Haman ta Siepahruo Ahasuerus kyihuo khata, “Na uvna ruo pe bangkhuo lie, na cawsaa zaw hrawlie hing a che yi te aa zepa mingphang phang kha aw yi te, ama phungbie ca mingphang hrangpa tie phungbie hne khata a nanang te iema ta siepahruo phungbie kha ziy va yi, caacuonakawta siepahruo ta iema hing a ngiethe pari riypata a tla vyi.

Siepahruo ta na palung a tling pata a cuo kieca iema para riypata biechina papya la capa siepahruo re a hrie riypa tie ca kama ta siepahruo suethiy chung luo ama pasuo riypata ngu talen thawhraa ama kuv luo i pi'a yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta siepahruo ta a caakhenapa kuvpahryi ca a kuv taata la te Agag ming Hammedatha sacapaa Haman kuv luo kha a pi.
Siepahruo ta Haman kyihuo khata, “Nama ta a pha na tana haata tue riypata tuokaa hne cawsaa zaw nama na ica pi,” a ta.

Cakhutaata thla khana ning hraa hlyithung ning kha siepahruo caacapetuv tie kha ku yi te, Haman biepina haa khata siepahruo ruo uvtuv byi tie, pe uvtuv byi tie, siepahruo ing lie byi tie'a luo kha pe mekaa tie ama caa hne mingphang mekaa ama ryi ta biechina pipa ca ama cape; Siepahruo Ahasuerus ming ta cape pata cuo te siepahruo kuvpahryi ta caa ama khe.

Caa ca caaphyatuv tie ta siepahruo ruo chung pe bangkhuo khata ama paphya. Thla hraa hlyihningna thlaa, Adar thlaa, ning hraa hlyithung ning, ning kha chunglieta Judah ming mingnu hne macuo, canung hne haatiy bangkhuo kha para riypa, thie riypa hne ciy paming diy riypata bie ama pi.
Capa biechina caa ca capa ning cuo ca ta cawsaa bangkhuo kha a pacaw pacie pata aw riypata pe mekaa ta pathyi sa riypata a cuo tli.

Caaphyatuv tie ca siepahruo biepina haata a catlisa pata si yi te, biechina ca Susa siepahruo ing lie pathyi sa pata a cuo. Siepahruo hne Haman ca mingsuvtiy dang yi te amaa tu hyalya, cuorasala Susa khypuv ca aa kalaa hringhruo.
Mordekai ta ama tuepa bangkhuo kha a pachang tiyta a caw kha thlaa te buri pang kha a buv te buvcuo kha aa phuv, khypuv chunglie kha cakuo te khuopuv ta khi te a caa.
Siepahruo thlake a ngiena te dyi kha a khaw, tahematapakieca buri a hryi pata siepahruo thlake luo kha ahunghmuo a ngie phung ta cuo vyi.
Siepahruo biepina hne biechina a phanapa pe mekaa lie ca Judah ming hrawlie caana aw te, cawsaa hluv vie ca buri a buv pata buvcuo a phuv yi te, sa uv yi te caa yi te amaa ngiy.
A mangsangpa tie hne tiydiypa tie ta ama chang tiyta, siepahruonung Esther ca a ngie a chi hringhruo. Mordekai ca a buri kha hle pata pang a buv riypata caw kha a paphya; cuorasala a la khing vyi.

Cakhutaata Esther ta siepahruo tiydiypa pakha ta a cuopa, ama mangchiytuv ta re pipa Hathak kha ku te, Mordekai luo kha cakuo pata, khaapa hmang ma a cuo nguoluo tapa, hne khaapanakawma a cuo tapa kha pachang riypata bie a pi.
Hathak ca siepahruo thlake hmiekunglie khypuv ahmyana hmang lie, Mordekai'a luo kha pya te,

Mordekai ca ta a cunglie a tlungpa bangkhuo kha a chang, cakhutaata Judah ming para riypata siepahruo suethiy chung luo kha Haman ta tuokaa khazaa sungsiy pasuo riypata ma bie aa kuo tapa kha a chang.

Mordekai ta iema parana riypata Susa lie ama papyapa biechina caa zaw kha pi te, Esther kha va pahmung pata a siyluo va chang riypa, hne siepahruo’ luo vaa pata mingphang zaw cuota paa va kie riypa kha chang riypata, bie a taa.
Hathak ca cakuo te Mordekai ta a changpa kha Esther ca a va chang.
Cakhutaata Esther ta Hathak kha chaw te Mordekai kha hing haa hingta bie a taa,

“Siepahruo changtaapa bangkhuo hne siepahruo uvna chunglie cawsaa bangkhuo ta canung cuose, capaa cuose, ku li pata a chungching khuo lie siepahruo'a luo aa ngie kieca, phungbie suokha dyi aw te, siepahruo ta a byikhuecahryi kha a hluo kie dyi hring'a te, caacuolikieca thie pata a cuo aa, tapa kha ama pachang diy. Kama hing siepahruo'a luo a ngie riypata ning sawthung chung ku pata cuo va tli ang,” a ta.
Esther ta a ripa kha Mordekai ca ama va chang tiyta,
Mordekai ta Esther kha va chang riypata hing haa hingta bie a taa yi: “Siepahruo ing chunglie na aw nakawta kama ca Judah ming hrangpa laa hingta lawna i hmung vie aa ta pata a rue khah.

Hing haapa cuo ning hing a dieta tah na aw kieca, Judah ming cuo hingta abangna hne lawna ca hmang hrang taata hne kuo hrang taata a vya puv ngiethie aa, cuorasala nama hne na paa ingchungkhue ca nama ra aa. Ahungma a pachang? Hing haapa cuo ning cuo hingta siepahruonung cuona na hmung pata a cuo khu cuo va ma?” a ta.
Cakhutaata Esther ta Mordekai a paliepa ca,

“Cakuo la Judah ming bangkhuo kha Susa khypuv lie a taw riypata pahmya tie yi, cakhutaata kama huota sa a uv ung la, ning thung chung kha chung hne zuo hne sa ning li tiy dang li pata aw tie ung. Kama hne naa mangchiypa canung tie zaw niema haata ma tue ra aa. Capa khutaa cata phungbie hne aa carie raalaa pata siepahruo'a luo kha i ngie aa, i thiy kie zawma thiy thluo lavuo ang,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Mordekai ca pya te Esther ta a changpa bangkhuo haa khata a tue.
A ning thungna lie kha Esther ta siepahruonung caw kha a tue te siepahruo ing chungching khuo tlawhmie lie, siepahruo khuolepa a hmiepachaw lie kha aa daa.

Siepahruo ta siepahruonung Esther tlawhmie lie aa daapa kha a hmung pahne ta, Esther kha minghmie pha pi te a kuv lieta aa hriepa a siy byikhuecahryi kha a hluo. Cakhutaata Esther ta vaa ngie te byikhuecahryi daw kha aa buo.
Siepahruo ta ama kyihuo khata, “Khaapama a cuo, Siepahruonung Esther? Khaapama inaa hie khing ciy? I ruo khingkhuo hmuota pi pata na cuo aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Esther ta, “Siepahruo na palung a tling pata a cuo kieca siepahruo cuota i pachiepa zuosa ning riypata siepahruo hne Haman hneta paa ica kie yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ta, “Esther khingna haata ma tue riypata Haman kha a catli pata a vawkhyi ung,” a ta. Caacuonakawta siepahruo hne Haman ca Esther ta a pachiepa zuosa ning riypa cata ama cakuo.

Mingsuvtiy ama dang nguoluopa khata, Siepahruo ta Esther kyihuo khata, “Khaapama inaa hie khing ciy? Pi pata na cuo aa. Khaapama tuepa pata na khing? I ruo khingkhuo te hmuota pi pata na cuo aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Esther ta, “Icaa hiepa hne tuepa pata i khingpa ca:

Na palung ca hmung angte, icaa hiepa hne tuepa pata i khingpa kha pi riypata siepahruo a palung a tling pata a cuo kieca, mawluo khiy siepahruo hne Haman hneta niema cuota i pachiepa zuosa ning riypata a vaw ung la, capa thue cata siepahruo ta na ripa kha i tue aa,” a ta.

Capa ning lie ca Haman ca palung tluo pata hne thaathusa pata a cakuo. Cuorasala Haman ta siepahruo thlake lie Mordekai kha a hmung tiyta, a hmiekunglie kha a daa li pata aa cathang zaw aa cathang lipa kha a hmung tiyta, Mordekai cunglie kha a hi a haa hringhruo.
Cuorasala Haman ca a pathiy kha a cahna law te ing luo aa diy. Cakhutaata a viesaa zaw hne a napuvnung Zeresh kha paku sa yi te,
a hnyirungnazya, a sacapaa hnyi zaa, siepahruo ta a re a pakiena palang, siepahruo byi tie hne rehrietuv bangkhuo hrawlieta a hmieluo hne a cung ce ta a chinazya zaw kha ri te a pasuv ciemuo.
A ri kaliepa ca, “Esther Siepahruonung tahmuo a pachiepa zuosa ning riypata siepahruo hne cakuo hne riypa kha kama dyina ina ku. Mawluo zaw khiy siepahruo hneta ina kuhne ngiethie.
Cuorasala siepahruo thlake lie Judah ming Mordekai aa tupa i hmung chung bangkhuo ca hingpa bangkhuo hingta phana na pi khu vyi,” a ta.

Cakhutaata a napuvnung Zeresh hne a viesaa bangkhuo ta ama kyihuo khata, “Cawsaa pathliena tung daw sawngaa aa suopa suokha tue pata cuo sala, capa lie ca Mordekai kha pathlie riypata siepahruo kha chang tie; cakhutaa cata siepahruo hne khata palung tluosa pata zuosa ningna luo kha cakuo tie,” ama ta. Capa ruena pipa ca ta Haman ca a patlung patluo te, cawsaa pathliena tung kha a patue sa yi.
Capa zuo lie ca siepahruo kha a hmung khu vyi; caacuonakawta maw li riypa khungnapa caa-uv, chuorina caa-uv kha vya cyi ung ta pata bie pi yi te, siepahruo ca ama ripa.
Bigthan hne Teresh, siepahruo tiydiypa tie pahning, ingchiypakaa a huopa tie ta Siepahruo Ahasuerus thie riypata ama rawpa kha Mordekai ta tuokhaatama a phu tapa kaw ama capepa kha ama hmung.

Cakhutaata siepahruo ta, “Hingpa kawlie hingta Mordekai ca pa-uvsathyina acuolikie cyicalangna suokhakha pi pata a cuo ma,” a ta. Siepahruo a mangsangpa tie ta, “Khaapahmuo a cuota tuepa aw vyi,” ama ta.

Siepahruo ta, “Ahungma tlawhmie lie a aw?” a ta. Capa ning ca, Haman ca Mordekai pathliena riypata a tuepa pathliena lie Mordekai pathlie riypata siepahruo kha chang riypata siepahruo ing tlawhmie luo aa ngie baaning ning khata a cuo.
Caacuonakawta siepahruo changtaapa tie ta, “Haman na a aw, tlawhmie liena aa daa thluo,” ama ta. Siepahruo ta, “Zaa ngie se,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Haman ca a zaa ngie te, siepahruo ta, “Siepahruo ta pa-uvsathyina a pi khingpa ca khaapa tuepa pata ma a cuo aa?” a ta. Haman ta ama hne ama kha, “Kama ta lipa hingta siepahruo ta ahung hing ma pa-uvsathyina a pi khing aa?” aa ta.
Caacuonakawta Haman ta Siepahruo kha, “Siepahruo ta pa-uvsathyina pi a khingpa ca,
siepahruo caw, hne siepahruo ta aa khangpa aruo hne siepahruo ta aa khuv tawpa byilakhuv kha vya cyi yi sala,

siepahruo caw hne aruo kha siepahruo byi cepa kha pi pata cuo sala, ama ta siepahruo ta pa-uvsathyina a pi khingpa kha caw ca pahryi se, cakhutaata aruo kha pakhang sala khychung ahmyana hmang lie kha a khiekhyi sala a hmiekunglie kha, ‘Siepahruo ta pa-uvsathyina a pi khingpa cunglie ca hing haa hingta tue pata cuo se,’ ta pata u pata cuo se,” a ta.

Cakhutaata siepahruo ta Haman kyihuo khata, “A catli pata caw hne aruo kha la lah, na ripa haa khata siepahruo thlake lie a tupa Judah ming Mordekai cunglie kha tue tie. Na ripa kha suokha hmuo pangaa'a vaciy,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Haman ta siepahruo caw hne aruo kha la te Mordekai kha a pahryi khutaata aruo kha a pakhang, khypuv tlawhmie lie kha a dapuole te, “Siepahruo ta pa-uvsathyina a pi khingpa cunglie ca hing haa hingta tue pata cuo se,” ta pata a u.
Cakhutaata Mordekai ca siepahruo thlake luo kha kaa te, cuorasala Haman ca a caapuo pata a luv kha a khuv te a ing luo kha a catli pata aa diy.

Haman ta a napuvnung hne a viesaa zaw bangkhuo kha a cunglie a tlungpa mekaa kha a chang tiy yi ta, ruena a pituv tie hne a napuvnung Zeresh ta, “A hmiekunglie a lie hruo na pathupa paa Mordekai hing Judah ming ta a cuo kieca ama ca te'a vaciy, cuorasala nama pali kha a hmiekunglie naa lie hrahring aa,” ama ta.
Ama hne bie ama ri nguoluopa khata tiydiypa tie kha a vaw yi te, Esther ta a pachiepa saduona luo kha Haman ca a catli pata ama cakuokhyi.
Caacuonakawta siepahruo hne Haman ca Siepahruonung Esther saduona chung luo ca amaa ngie.

A ning hningna lie, mingsuvtiy ama dang nguoluopa khata, Siepahruo ta Esther kha thukhyi pakhaa te, “Siepahruonung Esther, Khaapama inaa hie khing ciy? Pi pata na cuo aa. Cakhutaata, khaapama tuepa pata na khing? I ruo khingkhuo te hmuota pi pata na cuo aa,” a ta.

Ca tiyta Esther Siepahruonung ta palie te, “Na minghmie pha na i hmung ta pata a cuo kieca, Vya siepahruo, cakhutaata hingpa hingna siepahruo palung a patling ta pata a cuo kieca, i hringna hing na pi la, tapa hing icaa hiepa ta cuo te, i mingphang hringna hing na pi tie, tapa hing tuepa pata i khingpa a cuo.

Kiema ca, kama hne i mingphang ca, para riypata, thie riypata, hne ciy paming riypata zaa pata ma cuo tli. Kiema ca canung hne capaa hne hingta sii cuo riypata zaapa cuo biephung pa sala, a dieta tana ma aw thluo aa, tahematapakieca kiema te-angna riypa ca siepahruo ta aa sung riypa hneta pakhingpuo tluo aa tla pata cuo vyi,” a ta.
Ca tiyta Siepahruo Ahasuerus ta Siepahruonung Esther kyihuo khata, “Capa paa ca ahungtama a cuo, khaapaliema a aw, hingpa hmang tue riypata a ruepa hing ahungtama a cuo?” a ta.

Esther ta, “Dutuv hne carie ta a cuopa, hingpa cawsaa pha lipa Haman hing tana a cuo!” a ta. Ca tiyta Haman ca siepahruo hne siepahruonung hmiekunglie ca a thlaa zang hringhruo te aa cathang ta aa cathang.

Siepahruo ca a hi haasa pata saduona taa cata thu te siepahruo diedung luo kha a cakuo, cuorasala Haman ca a hringna cuota siepahruonung Esther kha paakie riypata aa ngaa, tahematapakieca siepahruo na kama para riypata bie a chi tli tapa kha a hmung.

Siepahruo ca siepahruo diedung taata saduona khuolepa chung luo kha a vya kaa tiyta, Haman ca Esther a tunapa thude cunglie a zaa bupa kha a hmung; siepahruo ta, “I ing chunglie, i hmungna lieta hmuo ma siepahruo nung hing hruohra ta tue aa nang? a ta. Siepahruo pakaa taata bie a pyapa hneta, iema ta Haman hmie kha ama buvkhung.

Cakhutaata siepahruo a mangsangtuv tiydiypa Harbona ta, “Mang tie, a bie ta siepahruo a khuotuv Mordekai pathliena riypata Haman ta a tuepa, daw sawngaa aa suopa pathliena tung ca Haman ing lieta a aw thluo,” a ta. Cakhutaata Siepahruo ta, “Capa cunglie ca ama kha pathlie tie ung,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Mordekai cuota ama ta a tuepa pathliena tung lie ca Haman kha ama pathlie. Cakhutaata siepahruo hihaana ca a die.

Capa ning lie ca ta Siepahruo Ahasuerus ta Siepahruonung Esther ca Judah ming carie ta a cuopa Haman ing kha a pi. Cakhutaata Esther ta Mordekai ca a tuokhaapa tama a cuo tapa kha a chang nakawta Mordekai ca siepahruo hmiekung luo kha aa ngie.
Siepahruo ta Haman kuv taata a thluopa a caa khenapa kuvpahryi kha Mordekai ca a pi. Cakhutaata Esther ta Mordekai ca Haman ing mangchiytuv ta a chi.

Cakhutaa cata Esther ta siepahruo'a lie kha bie a ri pakhaa; a phyi thabaw lie kha a bu te, Agag ming Haman ta Judah ming cunglieta a pha lipa khuekhuona a tuepa hne rawna a tuepa kha pali pakhaa riypata caapuo pata paa a kie.
Siepahruo ta Esther ca a siy byikhuecahryi kha hluo te,

Esther ca thu te a hmiekunglie kha a daa te, “Hingpa hingta siepahruo palung kha patling te, na minghmie pha kha hmung angte, hingpa hmang hing siepahruo hmiekunglie aa hmuo pata cuo te na palung ina tlingkhyi ca kieca, Agag ming Hammedatha sacapaa Haman ta siepahruo pena bangkhuo chunglie a awpa Judah ming para riypata biepina caa a capepa kha para riypata biepina caa suokha cape thi tie.
Tuokhaatama i cawsaa zaw cunglie a tlungpa rana ca i ang khu aa? Acuolikie tuokhaatama i tieriy zaw para ama cuona ca i ang khu aa?” a ta.

Cakhutaata Siepahruo Ahasuerus ta Siepahruonung Esther hne Judah ming Mordekai kyihuo khata, “Mang tie ung, Esther kha Haman ing ca i pi tli, cakhutaata ama kha pathliena tung lieta ama pathlie tli, tehematapakieca ama ta Judah ming kha a thie khing nakaw yi ta a cuo.

Siepahruo ming ta Judah ming hne aa pazue pata nama cape khingpa kha cape ung la siepahruo kuvpahryi khata caakhe khe tie ung; tahematapakieca siepahruo ming ta capepa, siepahruo kuvpahryi ta caakhe khepa biepathyina ca pali khu pata cuo vyi,” a ta.

Thla thung thlaa, Sivan thlaa, a ning kiyna lie, capa cuo lie ca siepahruo caacapetuv tie ca ku yi te, Mordekai biepina haa khata biepathyina caa ca India taata Ethiopia te lie a awpa Judah ming, ruo uvtuv byi tie, uvtuv byi tie hne pe uvtuv byi tie'a luo kha ama cape; pe zakha suokiy suosariy ca pe cyicuo kha ama caa cyicuo ta, hne mingphang cyicuo kha ama ryi cyicuo ta paphya yi te Judah ming zaw kha iema caa hne ryi ta ama paphya ra.
Siepahruo Ahasuerus ming ta caa ca cape yi te, siepahruo kuvpahryi ta caakhe amaa cung, siepahruo aruo ing lie aa ruo catli laalawpa aruo a khangpa caaphyatuv tie khata ama paphya.

Capa caa lie ca siepahruo ta khy ting lie a awpa Judah ming kha a hmya pata ama hringna kha a ve riypa, hne tuokhaapa mingphang hne tuokhaapa pe a cuo zaw cehre a cyi pata a vya tuvpa tie ca iema hne ama haatiy zaw hne canung zaw kha para riypa, thie riypa, ciy paming riypa hne ama chechiy zaw chuv riypata a pa-aw yi.
Capa ca Ahasuerus pena bangkhuo lie kha thla hraa hlyihning thlaa, Adar thlaa ning kiy ning, ning kha chunglie khata tue riypata a cuo.
Capa biepathyina ca pe ting kha paphya pata cawsaa ting kha re riypata a cuo, cakhutaata Judah ming ca capa ning lieta ama carie tie cunglie phuv la riypata a ting pacie pata ama aw riypata a cuo.
Caacuonakawta aa ruo catli laalawpa aruo a khangpa caaphyatuv tie ca siepahruo biepina ta a changpa haa yi khata a catlisa pata pya yi te thuopathyina ca Susa khypuv chunglie ca ama pathyi.

Cakhutaata Susa khypuv ca palungtluona hne a khi nguoluo ning kha, Mordekai ca siepahruo buohryi pasiypa a dungpa hne a ruopa kha a hryi te, siy byilakhuv kha a khuv te, palaa phapa ta taapa a ciycaapa pang kha a buv te siepahruo hmiekung taa khata a pya.
Tahematapakieca capa lie a awpa Judah ming ca khena hne alawna, palungtluona hne pa-uvsathyina kha ama hmung.

Pe ting lie hne khypuv ting luo, siepahruo nawbie hne biepathyina a phana mekaa lie kha Judah ming chunglieta alawna hne palungtluona a aw, saduona tue yi te zung ama khaa. Ca hlyitaw taata, Judah ming ciyna kha ama cunglie a tlung nakawta capa ruo lie cawsaa hluvpuv ca Judah ming tana ma cuo amaa ta.

Thla hraa hlyihning thlaa, Adar thla ning hraa hlyithung ning, siepahruo nawbie hne biepathyina tue riypata a cuopa ning, Judah ming carie tie ta iema kha ma uv'a yi ta pata amaa nguopuona ning, cuorasala Judah ming pali ta iema a dutuv tie kha ama uvna ning ta aa thlenapa ning lie kha

Judah ming ca Siepahruo Ahasuerus pena bangkhuo lie ama khypuv tie lie kha iema rana riypa a huvpa tie kha tuv riypata amaa hmya; ahungtahmuo iema kha a daapuo nguo va yi, tahematapakieca cawsaa bangkhuo ta iema kha ama ciy.
Pe uvtuv byi bangkhuo, ruo uvtuv byi tie, siepahruo ing lie byi tie bangkhuo ta Judah ming kha amaa bya, tahematapakieca iema ta Mordekai kha ama ciy.
Tahematapakieca Mordekai ca siepahruo ing lie kha huvhaa hnyi te, pe bangkhuo lie kha a ming a pathuo, Mordekai ca a huvhaa hnyina a le hryly.
Caacuonakawta Judah ming ta iema carie tie kha zueziy ta ama naw, thie yi te ama para, cakhutaata iema a huepa tie kha ama khing thiy ta ama tue.
Susa khypuv chunglie kha cawsaa zapangaa thie yi te ama para.
Iema ta Parsandatha hne Dalfon hne Aspatha hne
Poratha hne Adalia hne Aridatha hne
Parmashta hne Arisai hne Aridai hne Vaizatha zaw kha ama thie,
iema Hammedatha sacapaa Haman, Judah ming cariepa a sacapaa pahraa ta ama cuo, cuorasala ama hnyipa kha chuv va yi.
Capa ning lieta Susa khypuv chunglie ama thiepa zaa kha siepahruo ca ama pathyi sa.

Siepahruo ta siepahruonung Esther kyihuo khata, “Susa khypuv chunglie kha Judah ming ta cawsaa zapangaa hne Haman sacapaa pahraa tie zaw kha ama thie. Aa ngaapa siepahruo uvna chung pe tie lie kha tuokhaatama ama tue'a tlaw? Ata ca haw khaapama inaa hie ciy? Pi pata na cuo aa. Khaapama na tuepa kalie se na ta? Patlingpa pata na cuo aa,” a ta.

Esther ta, “Hingpa hingna siepahruo palung a patling ta pata a cuo kieca, Susa khypuv chunglie a awpa Judah ming hing ataning tuena naw pa-aw pata ama cuopa haa hingta mawluo zaw pa-aw pata cuo yi se, cakhutaata Haman sacapaa pahraa tie hing pathliena tung lie pathlie pata cuo yi se,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta siepahruo ta capa ca tue riypata bie a pi yi; Susa khypuv chunglieta capa biepathyina ca papya pata cuo te, Haman sacapaa pahraa ca ama pathlie.
Susa lie a awpa Judah ming ca a hmya yi te Adar thlaa ning hraa hlyipaliy ning kha Susa khypuv chunglieta cawsaa za thung ama thie; cuorasala ama hnyipa kha chuv va yi.

Siepahruo pena hrangpa tie lie Judah ming zaw kha ama hringna a khuo riypata amaa hmya ra, ama carie tie'a taa khata lawna hmung yi te, iema a huepa tie kha thawsawsariy thawpangaa ama thie; cuorasala ama hnyipa kha chuv va yi.
Capa ca Adar thlaa ning hraa hlyithung ning ta a cuo, cakhutaata hlyi paliyna ning lie ca a pahy yi te ning kha chung pyi hne alawna ama tue.

Cuorasala Susa lie a awpa Judah ming ca ning hraa hlyithung ning hne ning hraa hlyipaliy ning kha a hmya yi te, ning hraa hlyi pangaa ning kha amaa pahy, capa ning ca pyi ning hne alawna ning ta ama tue.

Caacuonakawta khyta lie a awpa hne, dungkhuo a hnyi lipa khy lie a awpa Judah ming ca Adar thlaa ning hraa hlyipaliy ning kha alawna hne pyi ning ta hmuo yi te, pakha hne pakha kha sa amaa pasungna ning ta ama hmuo.
Mordekai ta hingpa hmang a chiy a cuopa hing caa chunglie khung te, Ahasuerus pena bangkhuo chunglie a awpa Judah ming kha aa hla aa ngie ta li pata a paphya yi.
Kung kha hnang kung kha Adar thlaa ning hraa hlyipaliy ning hne ning hraa hlyi pangaa ning hing a pahy'a ung cate,

Judah ming ta ama carie tie'a taata ama lawna ning, hne ngiechina taata alawna, hne caana taata a pahyna thlaa a cuopa haata; capa ning tie ca pyi ning hne alawna ning, pakha hne pakha sa a pasungna hne siypasa tie lasaw pina ning tue pata na a cuo aa, a ta.
Caacuonakawta Judah ming ta tue riypata ama za pathupa ca Mordekai ta iema'a luo a capepa haa khata ziypa hringphung ta ama tue.

Hammedatha sacapaa, Agag ming Haman, Judah ming bangkhuo cariepa ta Judah ming ca para riypata raw yi te, Pur kha a zaa da, capa ca “vyisung” ta a cuo; iema kha pahli diy riypa hne para riypata a cuo.

Cuorasala Esther kha siepahruo hmiekung luo aa vaw tiyta, a pha lipa khue khuo te Judah ming a rawpa yi ca ama luv cung luo tla sala ama hne a sacapaa zaw kha pathliena tung cunglie pathliepa ama cuo riypata caa cape te biepathyina a tue.

Caacuonakawta capa ning ca Pur tapa a biesuo ziy pata Purim ama ta. Cahaacata, capa caa chunglie aa capepa bangkhuo hne hingpa kawlieta iema ta amaa tawpa bangkhuo hne ama cunglie a tlungpa bangkhuo kawlie khata,

Judah ming ta pacu sa yi te, ama hringphung ta a tue yi te iema hne ama ciypathla tie hne iema'a luo a pahlawpa bangkhuo ta caa lie aa capepa haa khata kung tating ta, ama'a na a cuo ningta, pathli li pata, aa pazue pata amaa uv pari riypata a cuo aa.

Hingpa ning tie hing chuo mekaa, ingchungkhue mekaa, pe mekaa, hne khypuv mekaa lieta a thyi pari pata a uv riypata a cuo aa; cakhutaata hingpa Purim ning tie hing Judah ming hrawlie hmuo pari riypa, hingpa ning tie a thyi parina hing ama ciypathla tie hrawlieta chuo buo'a vyi, ama ta.
Abihail sacanung Siepahruonung Esther hne Judah ming Mordekai ta Purim kawlie caa suohningna hing nawhnyina hne a bipa a cusapa caa ta tue yi te ama pacu sa.
Ahasuerus ruo chung pena zakha suokiy suosariy luo, Judah ming bangkhuo'a luo kha diena hne abangna khingkhyina caa paphya yi te,

Judah ming Mordekai hne Siepahruonung Esther ta Judah ming kha a cusa pata bie ama taapa haata, ama sa-uvna hne ama caana kaw hne aa pazue pata iema hne ama ciypathla tie cuota ama tuepa phung haata Purim ning tie hing ama'a na a cuo thlipa lieta namaa uv aa, ta pata a cuo.
Siepahruonung Esther nawbie ta Purim tuenazya ca pacu sa te, capa ca caa chunglie ama khung.
Siepahruo Ahasuerus ta ruo cunglie hne riyliy chung parala ruo tie kha ngukhyi a la yi.
A cahrana hne a lesyina ta a tuesana bangkhuo, hne Mordekai ca siepahruo ta pa-uvsathyina aa suosapa lie a chinapa kaw ca Media hne Persia siepahruo tie chuorina caa-uv lieta na aa cape cuo va ma?

Judah ming Mordekai ca siepahruo Ahasuerus a paziypa ta cuo te a cawsaa zaw cuota phana a huvpa hne a phang cawsaa zaw cuota diena bie a ripa a cuo nakawta Judah ming hrawlieta huvhaa a hnyipa hne a tieriy a hluvsa hrawlieta cawsaa hluvpuv hmiephaa a hmungpa ta a cuo.
Uz ruo lieta a ming Job ama tapa cawsaa pakha a za aw.
Capa cawsaa ca syi riy a aw lipa, aa dangpa, hne Khazing kha ciy te pha lina a cahriypa ta a cuo.

Ama ta tuv thawthung, kala-uv thawsariy, cuetungpa tue zapangaa, laapuvnung zapangaa, changtaapa a hluv hringhruo a hnyi; caacuonakawta hingpa cawsaa hing ningchiyluo ruo cawsaa hrawlieta a lesyi cepa ta a cuo.
A sacapaa zaw ca ama ing lie kha aa pahlie pata pyi tue taw yi te, iema hne ning hne dang hne riypata ama sieta pathung zaw kha ama ku taw.

Pyi kha a chuo tiyta Job ta ku yi te a pathe sa taw yi, mawdiy ta thu te iema bangkhuo mingluv zaa ta myirue panaana a pihluopa taw yi; Job ta, “I saata zaw hing sue pathlyi'a yi te, ama palung chunglieta Khazing kha chie ama sa pathlyi the aa,” a ta. Capa ca Job ta a tue paripa ta a cuo.
Ning kha ca Khazing sacapaa tie kha Abyipahmiekung luo amaa luo ca, iema hrawlie kha Setaa zaw aa vaw ra.
Abyipata Setaa kyihuo khata, “Khaapa taata ma naa vaw?” a ta. Setaa ta Abyipaca palie te, “Chuelyi cung khyzaa luo i khiena taa tana i vaw,” a ta.

Abyipata Setaa kyihuo khata, “I changtaapa Job hing na rue buo ma? Alyi lie ama haapa pakha hmuo aw va yi, syi riy a aw lipa hne aa dangpa cawsaa, Khazing kha ciyzaa te pha lina a maasepa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Setaa ta Abyipakha palie te, “Job ta Khazing hing a selawpa tama a ciyzaa?
Ama hne a ing hne a hnyipa bangkhuo kha a kuo bangkhuo taa tana piehu na sa khuo cuo va ma? A kuv ta a tuepa kha thluechiy pi cate, ruo chunglie hing a hnyipa ca a pungzaa.
Cuorasala na kuv ta paza la a hnyipa bangkhuo kha taw tie, na hmiekunglie hrahring hingta chie aca sa aa,” a ta.
Abyipata Setaa kha, “A pha ciemuo, a hnyipa bangkhuo hing na kuv chungliena a aw; ama kyalya dyi kha na kuv ta taw khah!” a ta. Caacuonakawta Setaa ca Abyipahmiekung taa khata a pya.
Ning kha ca a sacapaa tie hne a sacanung tie ca ama uvta uvthyi cepa ing lie sa ning yi te mingsuvtiy ama dang nguoluo ning kha
Job'a luo kha biephyatuv pakha a vaw te, “Cuetungpa tie ca le kha thaw yi te, laa zaw ca aa thaalie ama tle nguoluo ning kha,
Seba ming ta vya tlachiy yi te, sahring kha la diy yi te na changtaapa tie kha zueziy ta ama thie; kama dyi hingna nama chang riypa hingta a law ang,” a ta.

Capa paa ta capa bie a ri nguoluopa cata a hrangpa pakha kha vya chiy te, “Khazing myi kha avuo taata za tla te tuv hne na changtaapa tie kha kuo yi te a thie diy yi, kama pakha dyi hingna nama chang riypata a law ang,” a ta.

Capa paa ta bie a ri nguoluo ning kha a hrangpa pakha a vaw te, “Khaldi ming kha phuv thung ta a tue yi te, kala-uv tie kha patuv yi te amaa chiyle diy, cakhutaata na changtaapa tie kha thie diy yi te, kama pakha kyalya hingna nama chang riypata a law ang,” a ta.
Capa paa ta bie a ri nguoluo kalie pata, a hrangpa pakha kha a vaw te, “Na sacapaa tie hne na sacanung tie kha ama uvta uvthyi cepa ing lie sa ning yi te mingsuvtiy ama dang nguoluopa khata,
ruocaapa taata thliychie a vya hruo te, ingkiy kiy paliy khata de te mingnu tie cunglie kha tlasue yi te ama thiy diy; kama pakha dyi kyalya hingna nama chang riypata a law ang,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Job ca thu te a pang kha thlaa te, a luv aa pamyi, alyi lie kha a bu te Khazing kha aa bie.
Ama ta, “I nung chungtaata i thliehripa ta i za puv; i thliehripa ta i kaa aa; Abyipata na pi te Abyipata a la pakhaa; Abyipaming ca thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue,” a ta.
Hingpa bangkhuo lie hing Job ta suena tue vyi, Khazing kha sue be vyi.
Ning kha ca Khazing sacapaa tie kha Abyipahmiekung luo amaa luo ca, iema hrawlie kha Abyipahmiekung luo a luo riypata Setaa zaw aa vaw ra.
Abyipata Setaa kyihuo khata, “Khaapa taata ma naa vaw?” a ta. Setaa ta Abyipaca palie te, “Chuelyi cung khyzaa luo i khiena taa tana i vaw,” a ta.

Abyipata Setaa kyihuo khata, “I changtaapa Job hing na rue buo ma? Alyi lie ama haapa pakha hmuo aw va yi, syi riy a aw lipa hne aa dangpa cawsaa, Khazing kha ciyzaa te pha lina a maasepa tana a cuo,” a ta. Ama kha a kaw aw li pata para riypata ina pasu raalaa pa cata a tlingna kha aa patuv pari thluo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Setaa ta Abyipakha palie te, “Vang cuota vang! Cawsaa ta a hnyipa bangkhuo kha a hringna cuota ca a pi thluo aa.
Cuorasala na kuv kha paza la a ruv hne a saa kha taw tie, na hmiekunglie tana chie aca sa aa,” a ta.
Abyipata Setaa kha, “A pha ciemuo, ama ca na kuv cungliena a aw; a hringna kha ca pangaa tie,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Setaa ca Abyipahmiekung taa khata pya te, Job kha duv aa chiypa hmaa ta a phyipazaa taata a luvsadiy te ta a pahlaw.
Job ca ama hne ama aa khuena riypata bi kyipa a phe-ipa kha a la te buvcuo lieta aa zie.
Cakhutaata a napuvnung ta, “Zang tluo naa tlana ca naa patuv pari kalie'a ma? Khazing kha chiesa la thiy tie,” a ta.

Cuorasala ama ta, “A ngaapa canung ta a ri riypa bie na na ri. Khazing'a taata a phapa ma cuhluopa haata a chiepa zaw cuhluo'a va pa ma?” a ta. Hingpa bangkhuo lie hing Job ta a pakaa ta suena bie ri vyi.

Cakhutaata hingpa pha lina bangkhuo Job cunglie a tlungpa kha a viesaa pathung tie, Teman ming Elifaz; Shuh ming Bildad hne Naamath ming Zofar tapa tie ta ama thyi tiyta, ama ing cyicuo taata vya pya yi te ama kha ngiechina a hraw riypa hne hnaa panguo riypata amaa taw pakhaw.
Ama kha luohlaapuv taata ama hmung tiyta, ama pachang li tli nakawta khuosa ta ama caa; ama pang kha thlaa yi te, buvcing kha thliy luo hi yi te ama luv cunglie amaa phuv.
Ama hneta alyi lie kha ning sariy hne zuo sariy chung amaa tu, a te-angna a ruv hringhruopa kha ama hmung nakawta pakha tahmuo bie rihne va yi.
Capa khutaa cata Job ta a pakaa kha uo te a puvna ning kha chie a sa.
Job ta:
“I puvna ning ca ra se, ‘Sacapaa na a phya,’ ama tana zuo zaw kha ra thluo se.
Capa ning ca zingna ta cuo se! Cung Khazing ta huv khah se, khena zaw ta khe khah se.
Zingna hne zingkaruvna ta ma huopa tana a cuo ta yi se. Amyi ta buv sala; ningchung vawpa khata pachiypahuo se.
Capa zuo ca zingna chaapuv ta patuv se! Kung kha chung ning zaw hrawlie palungtluona aw lina ning ta cuo se; thlaa rina chunglie zaw ripuo pata cuo khah se.
A cuo, capa zuo ca zuo duothlingpa ta cuo sala; palungtluona ue paring khah se.
Chie a sapa tie ta capa ning ca chie sa yi sala, Leviathan parapuv a pathu sa khupa tie khata chie sa yi se.
Capa ning khydyi cawta a chiypa aasiy zaw ca zing yi sala; aa ruechuo riypa khena kha aw li pata, mawdiy khypavuo kha hmung khah se.
Tahematapakieca i nung pavaw khaa li pata, i ming taata riethyivuosuona kha a nu li nakawta.
Khaapanakawma i za puvpa khata i thiy thluo va? a thiy ciepa khata i za puv thluo va?
Khaapanakawma ama baw cunglie naa paw yi te, a hnungdaw kha ina tuv yi?
Capa haa khata cuo li aw sala, ata hing ca a dieta tah i zie'a tli aa.
Alyi siepahruo tie hne byi tie, ama cuota khy rapa a parepa tie;
siy a hnyipa siepahruo sacapaa tie, ama ing ngu ta a pabipa tie hne khata, i pahy hyalya'a mangtli.
Khaapanakawma a thla tling li pata a puvpa haata hne khena a hmung buo lipa haatiy haa khata ina paby thluo va yi?
Capa lie ca cawsaa pha lipa tie ta pha lina tue kha taw yi te, riethyipa zaw kha amaa pahy.
Capa lie ca thaw a tlapa tie kha a pahy pakhaw yi te, re-uvtuv ueryi kha thyi va yi.
Capa lie ca a le a caw ta aw yi te, sii zaw kha ama byi tie'a taata hya ama zang.
Khaapanakawma palungriethyina chunglie a awpa hne, a palung chunglie a ngie a chipa ca khena pi pata a cuo?
Thiyna dyi a huo pata thiyna a hmung lipa, nupa suethiy laata thiyna a hmung khing viepa;
thluo a hmung tiyta a law te, a palung a tluo hringhruopa ca ahungtama a cuo?
A luopuv a hmung khu lipa, Khazing ta dungkhuo te a pakhuo diypa ca khaapanakawma khena pi pata a cuo?
I caana ca i sa ta cuo te, i hrungna ca tiy lang ta a lang.
I ciypa hmang, i ciy hringhruopa hmang ca i cungliena a tlung diy.
Aw hyalya khu va ang, a dieta tah aw khu va ang; A pahy cuo hnyi va ang; cuorasala riethyivuosuona dyina a vaw,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Teman ming Elifaz ta a palie:
“Nama'a lie bie suokha ri ang sala, na palung tling li pata na aw'a ma? Cuorasala ahungma ri li pata a aw khu aa?
Mang tie, nama ta cawsaa a hluvsa pacuv yi cate, a thaa naapa kuv tie kha na cahra sa yi.
Na bie ta aa liepa tie kha thaa pi yi te, a thaa naapa pakhuv zaw kha na pacu sa yi.
Cuorasala capa ca nama'a luo a vaw te, na palung a pachang; capa ca ta ca de te na palung a chuo.
Khazing na ciyzaana ca naa zangna cuo va ma? Zang tluo naa tlana ca naa nguopuona cuo va ma?
Ata hingta rue tie, suena a hnyi lipa ca a ra buo ma? Acuolikie khaapaliema aa dangpa ca pahli pata ama cuo buo?
Kama i hmungzya ta ca, pha lina lu thlu te riethyivuosuona saciy a tuvpa ca cahaapa thyipaa ca na ama pahriy taw.
Iema ca Khazing huv ta ra yi te, a hihaana ta a hmung nakaw yi ta a kuo diy yi.
A hihaapa chingde aa hrungna ca padie sa pata cuo te, chingde thuthawpa haa ca thli pata a cuo.
A cahrapa chingde ca saa a sie li nakawta thiy te, chingdepuvnung a saata zaw ca amaa chepatlaa.
A paruvta tah kama'a luo bie a vaw te, a paruvta tah ama ripa kha i thyi.
Cawsaa kha mingkuv thuvhunglung khata amaa hmung ningta, muocuo i hmungpa kha i rue tiyta,
Ciyna hne a cathangna ta na tlung te, i ruv bangkhuo kha aa cathang.
Thlaapa ta i hmie kha thliy haata na hmung te, i phuv aa hling.
Capa thlaapa ca aa daa thluo, cuorasala a hmie pasie khu va ang. A hmingsuo ca i ming lie aa luo; capa lie ca duokaring te, cakhutaata ueryi i thyi.
‘A thiy thepa cawsaa hingta Khazing hmiekunglie aa dang khu'a ma? Cawsaa hingta satuv hmiekunglie a pathe khu'a ma?
A changtaapa tie kha hmuo zang khu va yi, aa vuoming kha hmuo tling va ung ciy a ta yi.
Acyi ing lie khysa te a hruopatu kha buvcing ta a cuopa, cuobalipa haata a za thepa ca kha tluv tama a ta hryly'a yi?
Maw hne zuoluo alalalie kha para pata ama cuo, ahungtahmuo pachang li pata na ama vie pathla.
Ama thluodaa riy kha iema'a taata a dapachungpa cuo te, iema ca singna hnyi li pata ama thiy.'
“U tie; caa palie riypa pakha chuo aw'a yi ma? A pathepa ahung kha ma na pangie aa?
A cuo hmisi saw, hihaana ta a ngaapa kha thie te, hietliena ta pathiypalung cawpa kha a thie.
A ngaapa ta hnyi hruo aa pathupa kha i hmung, cuorasala ama awnapa kha chie i sa paluo.
Ama haatiy zaw ca a bangna hneta amaa hlasa, thlake lie kha chaapuo pata cuo yi te, iema a khuo riypa pakha hmuo aw va yi.
Ama la ciepa sa kha a nangdiypa tie ta ahling dungkhuopa chung taa khata la yi te ama ning; tiyhriepa tie ta dang khing hringhruo yi te ama hie a tlie.
Palungriethyina ca alyi taata a vaw vyi, riethyivuosuona zaw alyi taata kya pu vyi;
cuorasala myihliy ca cung luo aa zupa haata, cawsaa ca riethyivuosuona ang riypata sa pata a cuo.
“Kama ta i cuo kieca, Khazing na i huv aa, i kaw kha Khazing na i pihluo aa.
Ama ta a lepa hne pha khu lipa hmang kha a tue, nang-uo aa chiypa hmang kha ri tie li a tue.
Ama ta alyi luo khy pasaa sa te, lu kha khytiy a pi;
Nutaapa cawsaa kha aa suo luo ta chi te, ngiechi pata a awpa tie kha abangna luo a caba yi.
A zyatepa tie khuekhuona ca para te, caacuonakawta ama kuv ta amaa tingpa kha patling khu va yi.
A singpa tie kha ama zyatena mamaa ta pa-uo yi te, a zyatepa tie tingtuona ca a catlisa pata a chuo.
Ningchung ta zingna kha a taw yi te, ningchung lie kha zuo haata ama pathuole.
Cuorasala aa phahlapa tie kha a thaaruvpa tie zueziy taata a khuo yi.
Caacuonakawta siypasa tie ca anguopuona hnyi yi te, biedang lipa ca a pakaa aa paping.
“Khazing ta a pasiy a pa-yapa tie ca a palungtluopa tana ama cuo; caacuonakawta Lesyice pasiypa-yana kha siysaa ri li pata aw khah.
Tahematapakieca ama ta hmaa paphya te, cuorasala a bie; ama ta tuv te, cuorasala a kuv ta a patluo sa.
Ama ta riethyivuosuona suocaruv taata aca khuo aa; Suosariyna lie zaw pha lina khaapatahmuo ca de'a vyi.
Cakuo ningta thiyna taata ca khuo'a te, rie chunglie kha zueziy taata a cakhuo aa.
Kawrina taata nama kha ca nu'a te, rana aa vaw tiyta ciy'a vaciy.
Rana hne cakuo a tlung tiyta pahnyi thluo'a cate, alyi lie saahruo tie kha ciy'a vaciy.
Lu chung alung tie khata ruvna ca pi li'apa yi ta, ruo lie saahruo zaw hneta a dieta tah nama aw pakhaw aa.
Na thluodaa aa bangpa kha pachang'a cate, na tuvte kha na mang tiyta khaapahmuo vie'a vyi.
Na ciypathla zaw ama hluvsa riypa kha pachang'a cate, na samingsahlaa zaw ca alyi lie aphuv haata ama cuo aa.
Suopie ca ama'a na a cuota ningta suo-aciyna luo a chiypa haata, chuo tlungsa pata thluokhue luo naa ngie aa.
Mang tie, hingpa hing a phasa pata khieluo pate, aa hmuopa tana a cuo. Naathlie la na cuota pachang tie,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Job ta a palie:
“I palungriethyina hing aa riyna pathlie the pata cuo sala, i vuochina hing cyi pathlie the pata a cuo kieca,
Riyliy lie viehnang laata aa riy vie aa; cata a cuo nakaw tana i bie hing a cungbebung.
Tahematapakieca Lesyice cuoti ca i chunglie hing aw te, i thlaapa ta a ca-ie kha dang te, Khazing hmang ciy aa chiypa tie ta ina tlungsue.
Ruo laa ca aa phuv cunglie kha a khi buo ma? Acuolikie cuetungpa haw a la cunglie kha a khi buo ma?
A pahuo lipa kha paciy phuv li pata ning khu a cuo ma? aatiy haw ca pahuona a cawta chuo a hnyi ma?
Cahaapa sa ca ning khing lipa ang ta, i cuota duv aa chiypa tana a cuo.
“I hiepa kha hmung thi ang se, Khazing ta i khingpa kha na pi thi se;
Khazing ta na riekary diy sala, a kuv kha pathlie sala kama kha na pahli se!
Hingpa hing i hnaanguona ta cuo'a te, ang khu a aw lipa pasana chunglie hing i law hringhruo aa; tahematapakieca A Pathepa bie ca i buo va ang.
Huo khuna riypa thaazuo i hnyi kalie ma? Tuokhaapa a chuonapa a nguopuo pata ma i palung a pasiy aa?
I thaazuo hing alung thaazuo tama a cuo? i ngesaa hing haw daa ta cuo kanaa?
Hmisita tah i chunglie hing anguopuona aw vyi, thaazuo naa pi khupa bangkhuo i chungtaata papya pata a cuo tli.
“Viesaa cunglie kawpacuona a hnyi lipa ca Lesyice ciyna kha a thawpa tana a cuo.
I viesaa zaw ca huecaapa tiy a lepa haata naa dungpa ta cuo yi te, cavaata a lepa haa tana ama cuo.
Capa cavaata ca cahue hne cahue kaa ta a bi raalaa pata,
A lungna cuo a pha tiyta ama vie, a lingna cuo a pha tiyta ama awna taata ama vie.
A buv ta khy a tlawpa tie ta vya piehnue yi te, ruocaapa lie ca a ngiehnue yi te ama thiy taw.
Tema khytlawphuv tie ta ama huv, Sheba khytlawphuv tie ta amaa nguopuo.
Amaa zaa zang nakawta ama palung a chuo, capa luo ca pha yi te ama nang ta a uo.
Cahaapa ca tana i cuo hingta namaa li, I vuochina kha hmung ung cate nama ciy.
‘Lasaw na pi ung la’ ica ta yi ma? Acuolikie, ‘Nama hnyipa taa khata nawthuv caa hie kanaa yi ang'?
Acuolikie, ‘I carie tie kuv chungtaata na khuo ung la ica ta yi ma'? Acuolikie, ‘Naa tuechiepa tie kuv chungtaata naa thla ung la ica ta yi ma'?
“Na pacuv ung la, a dieta tana i aw aa; i sichiena kha na pachang sa tie ung.
Aa dangpa bie hing kha tluv tama a cahra! Cuorasala ina pasuenapa ungca hing a hripa tana a cuo.
I bie ca ina palie khing ung ca ma? a palung a chuo tlipa ta a ripa ca thliy se tana a cuo thluo.
Haaraa tie kha hmuo vyisung a da'a ung cate, nama viesaa pha cepa kha hmuo sung ta nama pali aa.
“Cuorasala kama hing na mang ung la, nama hmiekunglie hing hang'a va ang.
Pacuo tie ung, thlaa na i chuo, hmang pha lipa ca tue pata cuo khah se, ata hingta rue tie ung, i sue linapa i ripa hing zang va ung ciy.
I bie lie hing i richiepa a aw ma? aa dang hne aa dang li kha thleduo khu li pata ma i aw?
“Alyi cunglie hing cawsaa ta re ruvpa dyina a hrie cuo va ma? Ama ning zaw hing vie a hluepa tie ning haa tana a cuo, cuo va ma?
Ningdiy dyi a canaw khingpa sii hne ama ningthavie dyi a huopa rehrietuv haa tana ama cuo.
Cahaacata thla hluvpuv khaapahmuo a cuo lipa re hrie angte, palungriethyina zuo zaw ca i cuvu ta a cuo.
I zie nguoluopa khata, ‘Khatiythuema i thu aa?’ ta angte, cuorasala zuo ca pasiy te mawdiy te ta i pali i pathi dyina a chiy.
Thulung hne a pyapa ta i ngesaa kha pahlaw yi te, i vang ca caa te a pachi pakhaa taw.
I ning zaw ca thetaatuv thephyi sung laata catli vie yi te, aruechuona hnyi li pata ama chuo.
“I hringna ca huv ta a cuopa kha a thyi tie; i ming hingta phana hmung pakhaa buo'a vyi.
Naa hmungpa na ming hingta na hmung pakhaa'a va tli, ina mang nguoluopa cata i vie aa.
Amyi ca pe te a viepa haata, Sheol luo a sipa tie ca kya kaa va tli yi;
iema ing luo kha kaa pakhaa li tli'apa yi ta, ama awna hmang khata pachang'a va tli yi.
“Caacuonakawta i pakaa kha a cadang'a va ang; I palung rie thyi pata bie ri'a angte, palung pasasa pata i hrung i ie aa.
Kama ca riyliy ta cuo kanaa ang, acuolikie riyliy lie riyhre ta cuo kanaa ang? Khaapanakawma kama naa huo riypata rievetuv ca na chi?
‘I iehmang na ngie naa paraw aa ta angte, i pangphaa na i hrung i iepa hing naa padiepa aa,’ i ta tiyta;
i muo ta na pachiy cate, muocuo ta i thlaa ina pazang ciy.
Caacuonakawta i pangpa ta hringpa laa hingta, i rue hmi pata thiy kha i tlaw vie aa.
Hring khing va ang, chuozaa ta hring'a va ang, kama se ta aw thi'a ang, tahematapakieca i hringna hing huv tana a cuo.
Cawsaa hing khaapata cuo te ma hing tluv hingta a biepuv pata na ri? a cunglieta na palung chi cate,
maw tating ta ve cate, na dyapasya pari?
Cuo khata chuo hing a hrang luo naa hyise'a va ca ma? i paciy i padaw chung chuo hing kamata tah na pa-aw sa'a va ca ma?
I sue pata a cuo kie zawma, cawsaa palung a mangtuv nama cunglie khaapama i tue? Khaapanakawma na cuokaa ta inaa taa ciy? khaapanakawma na cuota hmang riypa ta i cuo?

Khaapanakawma i tuesuena ca inaa ngiethe vaciy? khaapanakawma i pha lina ca ina thawpa vaciy? Tahematapakieca ata hing ca alyi chungliena i zie'a tli; ina huv'a ciy, cuorasala za aw'a va tli ang,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Shuh ming Bildad ta a palie:
“Kha cuo te ma hingpa hmang hing ri pari'a cate, na hmya taata bie hing thliy haata aa hruo pari aa?
Lesyice ta biedangpa hing a maa buo ma?
Na saata zaw ta a cunglie ama sue kieca, ama tuesuena duotena kha na ama cunglie a patlung sa aa.
Khazing kha huv cate Lesyice kha paa na kie kieca,
nama ca pathe cate naa dang kieca, na cuota thu'a te, aa hmuopa adaahmang kha aca pi pakhaa aa.
Naa thunapa ca cawta ra mang sala, na chuona luo ca a lesa aa.
“Tahematapakieca a chuo ciepa chuo tie kha hiehriy yi la, ama mingchingmingvuo tie ta khaapama ama hmung tapa kha pacuo tie.
Kiema ca azuochaning cawsaa ta cuo pate khaapahmuo pachang vapuv, tahematapakieca chuelyi lieta ma ningcuo zaw hing ca ningdiy tana a cuo.
Iema ta nama ca ca pacuv, ca chang yi te, ama pachangna ca ca chang'a va yi ma?
“Tiypiy ca acaa aw lina lieta a le khu ma? phiepahlaa zaw tiy aw lina lieta a pha khu ma?
Ama paa nguoluo ning hne va tiy amaa de hluota, aphuv kung hrangpa hluo khata amaa uv.
Khazing a mawpa bangkhuo ca cahaaca tana ama cuo; Khazing kha siysaa a ri lipa tie nguopuona ca a ra aa.
Amaa zangna ca minghliypa palaa haata cuo te, amaa ringchuona ca minghliypa buv haa tana a cuo.
Pakhakha ta a ing kha aa hnie kieca, aa nyi aa, pakhakha ta aa patuv kieca cukhyi'a vyi.
Cawsaa pha lipa ca ningsaa lie kha lethaw te, a nge zaw ca diedung lie kha aa zuo.
Ama thariy ta lungpung kha kaze te, alung hrawlie kha ama hring.
Ama awna taa khata para pata ama cuo kieca, capa ama awna hmang khata, ‘Ca za hmung buo va ang,’ a ta aa.
Mang tie, capa ca aa nuopa ama hringzya ta cuo te, alyi taata a hrangpa kung kha ama kya pu aa.
“Mang tie, Khazing ta syisaa riy a hnyi lipa ca thaw'a vyi, pha lina a tuepa tie kuv kha cahra sa'a vyi.
Na pakaa ca pahnyina ta bi'a te, na hmya ca palungtluona hneta a pahnyi sa aa.
Nama caa huepa tie kha nangzaana ta pahlawpa cuo'a yi te, cawsaa pha lipa tie thluodaa ca hmung pata cuo'a va tli,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Job ta a palie:
“Hingpa hing a cuo hmisi ta pata i pachang; cuorasala tuokhaatama cawsaa ca Khazing hmiekunglie aa dang khu aa?
Pakhakha ta ama hne a zue khing biephung sala, yi zakha lie yi kha palie khu'a vyi.
Khazing ca sing hringhruo te a thaa a ruv hringhruo, ahung ta a daakhuo khu'a te ma, a te khu aa?
Tluo zaw kha palaw te a hihaana ta a pali a pathi tiy yi ta, capa ca pachang va yi.
Alyi kha a awna taata a cahang tiyta, a tung zaw kha aa cahang.
Ning kha bie a pi tiyta, kya chiy li pata aw te, aasiy kha a pakhuo yi.
Avuo hing ama dyi ta pake te, riyliy tiylaw tie kha a chaa yi.
Ama ta kawracungnung hne aasiycaruv, aasiythetluo hne sungluo aasiy tluo zaw kha a sa yi.
Ama ta pachangna khungthing luo hmang lesyipa hne, kharuehaa hmang ri tie li zaw kha a tue.
Mang tie, i thaalieta aa vawle pata hmung va ang; a sile, cuorasala pachang va ang.
Ama ta la te a sikhyi; ahungma a daakhuo khu?
“Khazing ta a hihaana kha pape vyi; a phyi thabaw lie Rahab byatuv zaw kha amaa bu.
Tuokhaapa biesuo a tlaw'a angte ma ama ca i palie khu aa?
A suepa i cuo li raalaa pata, ama kha palie khu va ang; ina nangdue riypa khana sue naa phawtuv'a luo kha i hie aa.
Ku ang sala ina palie zawta, i bie kha naa a thlie thlu'a mang ta pata zang va ang.
Tahematapakieca kama kha khysuv hmuo pata na de te, a kaw aw li pata i hmaa kha a papung.
I huv hmuo na pasung sa hmuo li pata, cuorasala a chiekhaasa pata ina pabi sa.
Thaazuo a zuenapa cuo sala, ama ca a cahrapa cuo te, biedangpa kawlie cuo sala, ahungma naathlie riypata a ku khu aa?
A suepa i cuo li raalaa pata, i pakaa mamaa ta sue ina phaw aa; Syisaa riy i aw li raalaa pata, na tuesue, ina ta aa.
Syisaa riy aw va ang; Kama hne kama a pachang va ang; hring na naa nangtuv tli.
Suokha tana a cuo thluo, caacuonakawta i ri aa; Syisaa riy a hnyi lipa hne a pha lipa hne a para kaluo thluo yi.
Rana ta thiyna tlangkhy a chiykhyi tiyta, suena a hnyi lipa tie rana kha a pahnyisue thluo.
Alyi ca a pha lipa tie kuv chung luo kha pi pata cuo te, bieripatuv tie ming kha a pahruv; Ama ta li pata ahungma a cuo aa?
“I ningkhue hing a ruolepa laata a lie a hy vie te, khung yi te phana khaapahmuo hmung va yi.
A catlisapa sawkawpalaw haata si te, aa a lapa hmungthlu haa tana a catli.
‘I hrung i iena hing maw'a angte, ngiechina minghmie i phyapa hing thaw pata pakiy syalya'a ang,’ i ta tiyta,
Te-angna i angpa hing i kya ciy, tahematapakieca a sue lipa ta na ri'a vaciy tapa kha i pachang.
Suebe pata i cuo thluo riypa kieca, khaapanakawma thavie li pata re ca i hrie ri aa?
Chaapie ta a siy pata, i kuv kha lung-ie tiy ta a siy ra ang sala,
Caakaw luo kha na thaw ngiethie'a cate, i caw mamaapa kha na naa duv aa.
Tahematapakieca bie i palie riypa hne bieripana luo chiykhyi riypata, kama haapa cawsaa hingta a cuo hyi tlung va.
Maa lalalie malie a aw khuo riypata bietluo a tlatuv aw va yi.
Cata cuo sala ca a sungpe hing kama'a taata la'a te, pachiypahuo pata na paciy sa'a vyi.
Cakhutaa cata ama kha ciy li pata bie i ri khu aa, tahematapakieca ina ruena haa khata cuo va ang tapa kha i pachang.
“I hring na naa nangsa tli; A cadang li pata na i cie aa; Palung pasasa pata na i ri aa.
Khazing kha chang'a angte, sue na phaw khah; khaapanakawma inaa carie ciy tapa hing na pachang sa tie.
Malie tuechie riypa hing na cuota a pha na ta ma? Nama kuv ta na tuepa kha duv cata, cawsaa pha lipa tie khuekhuona naa tlakhyipa ca na cuota a pha na ta ma?
Saapa ming hnyi kanaa ciy? Cawsaa hmung ta hmung kanaa ciy?
Na ning zaw hing cawsaa ning haata ma a cuo? Acuolikie na kung zaw hing cawsaa zaw kung haata ma a cuo?
Pha lina i hnyi lipa kha na pachang thluo cate, na kuv chungtaata naa khuo riypa aw va yi tapa kha ina pachang thluopa cata, i pha lina kha na huv cate, i suena kha ina huv ciy.
Na kuv ta na tue cate ina sa ciy; cakhutaata ata ca a pali cate ina para ciy.
Acyi ta ina sapa ca kha a thyi thi tie; Lyidiypa tama ina pali pakhaa'a ciy?
Kama kha cuehnung haata na lyi cate, cuehnungkaa haata ina pakaa sa ciy.
Nama ta vang hne saa ta na pahlaw cate, ruv hne thariy ta ina cakhiy ciy.
Nama ta hringna hne aa hmangpa duena ina pi ciy, na mangsangna ta i thlaapa a patluo.
Cuorasala hingpa hmang zaw hing na palung chunglie na nu; Hingpa hing naa ting tlaryapa tana a cuo tapa kha i pachang.
I sue pata a cuo kie, ina mang pathliy ciy, i pha lina kha na thawpa vaciy.
I pha li pata a cuo kieca, bawchie ciemuopa tana i cuo! I dang pata a cuo kieca, i luv hmuo calang khu va ang, tahematapakieca i riethyivuosuona kha i mang tiyta, nangzaana tana i bi.
Chingde haata riephasa pata naa zuhning cate, i cunglie kha ciy aa chiysapa na tue pakhaa.
Kama a du pata tehte kha pathaa pakhaa cate, palungriethyina ina pi hryly ciy.
“Khaapanakawma riy chungtaata ina papuv sa ciy? Ahunghmuo ina hmung hluo yi khata ma i thiy hrue va!
A aw buo lipa haa khata cuo thluo'a angte, riy chungtaata thluo luo sikhyipa haata i cuo thluo'apa kha.
I hringna ning hing cawsa va ma? A cawta chuo hnaanguona i hmung riypata,
vya kaa buo li tlina luo hne aa thuvsapa thiyna ningdiy hne zingna luo,
khena hmuo zingna a lunapa, zingna hnaahnawna ruo luo i si hluo hingta, kama seta na pa-aw sa tie,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Naamath ming Zofar ta palie te:
“Bie hluvpuv hing palie li pata ma a cuo aa? Bie a hluvsa a ripa hing ma duopacu pata a cuo aa?
A hluvsa na ripa bie hingta a hrangpa tie hing a dieta tah a pa-aw sa'a mang yi na ta ma? Na tue hyalya tiy yi ta malie kha ama nang zaa'a va ma?
Tahematapakieca nama ta, ‘I tuepa hing a pathe, Khazing hmungna lieta a pathe,’ na ta.
Cuorasala Khazing hing bie ri sala, ca palie sala na i khing.
Singna aa thuvnazya kha ca chang sala na i khing, tahematapakieca singna ca kuo hluvpuv a hnyi.
“Khazing hmang aa thuvpa tie hing na hmung khu ma? Lesyice kha riy thlipa pata a cuopa na hmung khu ma?
Avuo laata aa suo viepa tana a cuo, Khaapama na tue khu aa? Sheol laata aa thuv vie, khaapama na tue khu aa?
Alyi chicadung laata syi vie te, riyliy laata a ku vie.
Khazing ta patuv te thaw a pathlapa hne bieripana luo a chiykhyipa ca ahungma a thlu khu aa?
Tahematapakieca ama ta ahung hing ma a laliy lipa tapa kha a pachang; Pha lina kha a hmung tiyta, pacuo li pata a aw'a ma?
Cuorasala ruo lie laataata kha cawsaa ta a za puv thue dyi khiy tana, cawsaa ngaapa ca a sing aa.
“Na palung kha aa dangsa pata na chi kieca, na kuv kha ama'a luo na pazu khu aa.
Pha lina kha na kuv lie a aw kieca luohlaa luo kha thaw tie, pha lina ca na thluodaa lie pa-aw sa pari khah.
Cakhutaa cata syisaa riy a aw lipa hmie kha na pahmung aa; Aa bang pata aw'a cate ciy'a vaciy.
Na palungriethyina ca maw'a cate, tiy a lang pathlalepa haa dyi kha tana naa thyi aa.
Cakhutaata na hringna ca ningchung laata khe vie'a te, a zingna ca maw haa kha tana a cuo aa.
A nguopuona a aw nakawta anguona hnyi'a cate, mangchiypa na cuo nakawta aa bangna hmang lieta naa pahy aa.
A zie'a cate ahungtahmuo ca pachiy'a va yi; cawsaa hluvpuv ta paa aca kie'a yi.
Cuorasala a pha lipa tie ming ca vie'a te, a ruona riypa luopuv kha hmung'a va yi, Amaa nguopuona ca, a hnangcaw ce ama huvsungna kha tana a cuo aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Job ta a palie yi:
“Niema ca cawsaa ta cuo ung cate, niema hne hingta singna ca a thiy aa tapa kha zang li pata aw khah ung.
Cuorasala kama hing niema haa tana singna i hnyi ra; niema laata aa ne vie pata cuo va ang. Hing haapa kaw hing ahungma a pachang lipa a aw?
I viesaa zaw pahnyisue riypa tana i cuo; Khazing a upa kama hing ama ta ina palie, Aa dangpa hne syi riy a aw lipa kama ca pahnyisuepa tana i cuo.
Anata tah a hring khupa tie ca vuochina tapa kha amaa pasa sa, cuorasala a lie'a nangpa ta ca a pacaw pacie pata na a aw.
A ruvhangpa tie thluodaa ca a die, Khazing hi a pahaapa tie ca a bangna chunglie aw yi te, Khazing pipa hnyirungna hneta ama hring.
“Cuorasala saruopa tie kha hiehriy yi la aca pacuv'a yi; thliy lie a zupa pavaa zaw kha hiehriy yi la aca chang'a yi.
Alyi lie sakung zaw kha hiehriy yi la aca pacuv'a vyi; Riyliy lie ngaa zaw kha hiehriy yi la a siesa pata aca chang'a yi.
Abyipana hingpa hing a tue tapa kha niema hrawlie pakha chuo ta pachang va yi ma?
A kuv chunglieta a hringpa bangkhuo tie hringna kha aw te, cawsaa bangkhuo huv ca a kuv chungliena a aw.
Pakaa ta sa ca aa pacuopa haata, naa ta bie ca a naathlie pachiy aa cuo va ma?
Kung uvthyina lie hing ma singna a aw? Chuo pasiyna lie hing ma pachangna a aw?
“Khazing'a lie ca singna hne cahrana aw te, ruena pikhuna hne pachangna a aw.
Khazing ta a phi kieca, ahungtahmuo sa pakhaa khu va yi; Khazing ta a khaakhung kieca ahungtahmuo pahaw khu va yi.
Tiy kha a patuv kie yi ca ama ky; a pathlie kie yi ca chuelyi kha hmuo ama buvkhung.
Ama'a lie ca cahrana hne singna aw te, dungpa hne a dungtuv ca ama huopa tana ama cuo.
Ruena pituv tie kha a pali a pahnaa ta pasi sa yi te, bieripatuv tie kha a ngaapa haata a tue yi.
Siepahruo kha pathla yi te, thaw a tlapa ta a tue yi.
Tluobyi tie kha a pali a pahnaa ta pasi sa yi te, a lesyipa tie kha a nuopatyi yi.
Zang aa chiypa tie kha bie ri the li pata tue yi te, uvthyi tie thleduo khuna kha a chuv yi.
Siepahruo sacapaa tie kha ama nang pazaa yi te, a thaaruvpa tie tesaw kha a pahya.
Zingna chungtaata aa thuvpa kha paluo sa te, aa thuvpa zingna kha khena luo aa chiy.
Mingphang kha a lepa ta tue yi te a para yi; pale vie yi te, a chepatlaa diy yi.
Alyi luochiytuv tie'a taa khata pachangna kha a thawpa yi.
Khena aw li pata zingna chunglie kha pathuole yi te, a pariypa haata amaa viele.
“Mang tie, i ming ta hingpa zaw bangkhuo hing i hmung diy, i naa ta thyi te a pachang.
Na pachangpa kha i pachang ra; nama laata aa ne viepa ta cuo va ang.
Cuorasala Lesyice'a luo kha bie ri'a angte, Khazing hneta i kaw kha a ipa i khing.
Niema ca hangna ta a cungluo kha pame ung cate, hmuo tluo a tla lipa siyybyi tana nama cuo diy.
Ryi li pata aw ung la ca, capa ca nama singna ta a cuo aa.
Hmang a cuopa kaw i ripa hing thyi ung la, i hmya ta a ripa paakiena hing naathlie tie ung.
Khazing cuota hangna bie nama ri'a ma? Zyana ta bie nama ri'a ma?
Ama kuo luo tama namaa daa aa? Khazing cuota ma paa nama kie aa?
Niema kha aca hiehriy pasie tiy yi ta nama ngie aa raw'a ma? Cawsaa pakha ta a hrangpa pakha kha a dungpa haata nama dung khu'a ma?
A paruvta tah a kuo ta namaa daa kie zawma aca chuo hrahring'a yi.
A lesyina ta nama thlaa ca pazang'a va yi ma? Ama ciyna ca nama cunglie tlung'a va ma?
Nama phungthluv ca buvcuo phungthluvbie tana a cuo, namaa daakhuona bie ca a cyi piehu haa tana a cuo.
“A cunglie tuokhaapa a tlung zaw, a dieta tah na awpa ung la kama ri'a ang.
I saa kha i haa ta ce'a angte, i hringna kha i kuv lie chi'a ang.
Mang tie, ina thie'a hing; anguopuona hnyi va ang; cuorasala i bie ca a hmiekunglieta ri'a ang.
Khazing a pachang lipa tie ca i hmiekung luo kha a vaw'a va yi, capa ca i khuona ta a cuo aa.
I bie hing a raaringsa pata na naathliepa tie, i pasienapa hing na naa lie aw naase.
I bie ca a phasa pata i ting pacie; paduopa i cuo aa tapa kha i pachang.
Sue naa be riypa ca ahungtama a cuo? capa khutaata ca ryi li pata aw'a angte i thiy aa.
Hmang suohning dyi na pi tie, caacuokieca na hmiekung taa hingta a nu'a va ang.
Kama'a taa hingta na kuv ca la pakhaa la, ciy naa chiynapa hingta i thlaa na pazang khah se.
Cakhutaata na u la ica chaw aa, bie ri ang sala na palie tie.
I pha lina hne i suena ca khazaa ma a ta i tuesuena hne i suena ca na pachang sa tie.
Khaapanakawma na hmie ca nu cate, kama ca na carie ta ina ri ciy?
Thliy ta a pazupa chinghnaa ca naa cade'a ma? sacuovie haw naa cade'a ma?
Khuosa ta kama pasuena caa kha na cape, i satlie ning i pha lina muo kha ina pahriy sa ciy.
I phyi kha hrakyi khe cate, na dungkhuo diy; i luopuv bangkhuo kha na huo diy.
Cawsaa ca a hmupa cawsie haata cuo te, thanghmaa ta a cepa pang haa tana a cuo.
“Canung ta a sapa cawsaa mekaa ca a chuo pachang te ruvnaana ta a bi.
Paapaapa haata kya paa te aa uv pakhaa, ningdiy haata a hliyle te a khung paluo.
Cahaapa cawsaa cunglie ca ma na ming na chi? Bieripa riypata ma nama'a luo inaa chiy'a ciy?
A pathe lipa chungtaata a pathepa kha ahungma a papya khu aa? ahungtahmuo papya khu'a vyi.
Ama ning zaw kha ripa pata cuo yi te, ama thlaa zaw ca na pachang pa yi; Nama ta ama law khu lipa ruoriy kha na sapa yi.
A hrang luo kha a hyi la a maase tie yi, vie a hluepa haata ama ning zaw kha amaa nuokhyi aa.
“Thingkungpa cuota anguopuona a aw, ama hu kie zawma a chaw kya ka pakhaa te, a nge zaw ca chuo buo'a va yi.
Alyi chunglie a thariy ca nungpuv te, a caahming ca thiy ra sala,
Tiy rang a thyi pahne ta kya ka pakhaa'a te, thing panuta haata a ce zaw a vaa pakhaa aa.
Cuorasala cawsaa ca thiy te paby pata ama cuo; a huv a vie khutaata ca khaapa luo ma a chiy?
Tiy ca tiy-ang taata a kypa haata, cavaa ca ky te a caa.
Cahaacata cawsaa ca a zie te kya thu va tli; avuo khiy a aw li tli hluo li ca thu pakhaa'a va vyi, amaa hmungna taata a kya cha'a va yi.
Vya Khazing, Sheol chunglie na nu lana i khing; Na hihaana a diena te na buvkhung lana i khing, cuo kha na thlipa la naa thyi pakhaa tie.
Cawsaa ca thiy yi sala ama hring pakhaa'a ma? Riethyivuosuona taata i lawna te ta i rehriena cuo chung bangkhuo ta i huo aa.
Nama ta na u'a cate ica palie aa; na kuvzung ta a cuopa ca ina vuo'a ciy.
Cakhutaata ca i kyi hliypa kha ri li tli'apa cata, i suena kha mangchiy'a va tli ciy.
I tuesuena ca chawkue lie pasuo pata cuo'a te, i pha lina ca na buvkhung aa.
“Cuorasala tluo ca cing'a te a za aa, alungpuv ca a awna taata aa hnyi aa.
Tiy ta alung kha ning te, alyi phapa kha tiy cahruepa ta a sikhyi.
Cawsaa ca chuozaa ta te yi cate ama si lawmaw, ama hmingsuo kha thle yi cate na pasi yi.
Ama saata zaw ta pa-uvsathyina ama vya hmung, cuorasala pachang va tli yi; Iema ca pachung pata ama vya cuo, cuorasala pachang hlyi va tli yi.
Iema ta iema pangpa pasana dyi kha pachang yi te, iema cuo dyi khata caa yi te amaa hrung,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Teman ming Elifaz ta palie te:
“Cawsaa singpa ta thliy haata a hruo cakhawpa bie ta palie riypa a cuo ma? Ningchiy taata thliy a hruopa haata ma aa hruo cakhaw aa?
Aa thungna a aw lipa bie hne phana a tue khu lipa bie kha ma amaa i byalya aa?
Nama ca Khazing ciyna kha thuse cate, Khazing kaw pacuo kha na pakhuo.
Tahematapakieca na pha lina khata na hmya kha pacuv te, a zyatepa tie bie kha naa tlaw.
Kama cuo li pata, nama pakaa hrahring na nama kha sue caa be; nama hmya hrahring na sue caa pacu.
“Nama hing cawsaa bangkhuo lieta sa taapa na cuo ma? tluo zaw sapa ama cuo hluo hingta sapa ta na cuo ma?
Khazing hneta bie a rue buo kanaa ciy? Nama dyi hing ma singna a hnyi ciy?
Ma pachang lipa khaapama na pachang? ma pasie lipa khaapama na pasie hlyi?
Na paa laata a uvthyi viepa, A suo paapa hne macuo tie ca maa thaalie ta ama aw.
Khazing ta hnaa aca panguona ca a cawtuv ma? A neta tah aca changpa ca a cawtuv ma?
Khaapanakawma na palung vie te, na ming malie na pase sue?
Khaapanakawma na pathiypalung ca Khazing kha a du te, cahaapa bie ca na pakaa taata a pya?
Cawsaa ca tuokhaapa ta cuo te ma, a pathe khu the aa? Canung ta a sapa ca amaa dang khu the'a ma?
Ama cawsaa a pathepa kha hmuo Khazing ta zang vyi, vuoruo zaw kha a hmiekunglieta pathe vyi.
Pha lina kha tiy haata dang te, duvsamakhie aa chiypa hne a rapa cawsaa changchiy ta ca a pathe the aa!
“Na naathlie tie, ca pahmung'a ang: i hmungpa hmang kha i pathyi sa aa;
mingsing tie ta za ri yi te, ama mingchingmingvuo tie ta ama za nu lipa kha ca chang'a ang.
Iema kyalya dyi ruo kha za pi pata cuo yi te, iema hrawlieta cawsaa hrangpa kha za aw va yi.
A pha lipa tie ca ama chuo chung bangkhuo ta pasana ang yi te amaa tisa tyalya, capa ca kawpacuona a hnyi lipa tie cuota chipa pata na a cuo.
Ciyna pu ca ama naa lie aw'a te, hnyirungna chunglie ama aw ningta para tuv ta a tlahnue yi.
Zingna taata ama vya kaa riypa kha anguopuona aw vyi, zueziy ta thiy riypa kha na chipa pata a cuo yi.
‘Khaapaliema a aw,’ ta yi te, hmangting lie kha ning riypa ama huv; zingna ning na malie a tlung tapa kha ama pachang.
Palungriethyina hne ruvnaana ta pachiy yi te, riedu riypata a ting paciepa siepahruo haa khata iema kha a te yi.
Tahematapakieca iema ta Khazing a du pata ama kuv pazuo yi te, Lesyice kha siysaa ri li pata ama aw.
Phya chaasapa kha a cyi te, palung lesa pata ama kha aa ruohning.
Tahematapakieca ama thupa ta ama hmie kha buvkhung yi te ama sesie lie aa ting.
Iema ca a duothlingpa khypuv, ahunghmuo aw linapa hne aa nyi'a nangpa ing lie khana ama aw aa.
Iema ca hnyirung'a va yi, iema hnyirungna ca a pasiy a hmang'a vyi; alyi lieta a hruo thla'a vyi.
Iema ca zingna chung taa khata law'a va yi, ama chaw ca myihlaa ta uv diy'a te, ama paa pamang kha thliychie ta a de diy aa.
A hripa kha a ringchuo khah yi se, iema hne iema kha a dung khah yi se; tahematapakieca a hripa khana ama lasaw ta a cuo aa.
Ama cuo a tling hluota muo pi diy pata cuo'a yi te, ama nge kha hringsiyliy'a vyi.
Mingsuv thyi hipa haata hne olif thyi hipa haata, ama thyi kha cakhaw pata ama cuo aa.
Tahematapakieca Khazing a pachang lipa tie ca cing'a yi te, nawthuv ningpa ta ama sapa ing ca myi na a kuo aa.
Cawsaa rana riypa kha nu haata phya yi te, pha lina kha ama sa; Ama pathiypalung ta dungna dyi kha aa ting,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Job ta palie te:
“Cahaapa bie ca a hluvsa i thyi tli; khuosa ta i ngie naa pachipa hnaapanguotuv tana nama cuo diy.
Ci li tama nama ri pari aa? Khaapa ta ca pasu yi te ma nama ri pari?
Kama adaahmang lie hing niema aw ung la ca, kama zaw niema haa hingta i ri khu ra aa. Niema hing bie ca i khu ra'a yi angte, i luv zaw ica chysue ra'a yi.
I pakaa ta thaazuo ca pi'a yi angte, i hmya ta thaa ica pipa yi ta hnaa aca panguo'a yi.
“Bie i ri kiema, i pasana ca tluo vie hlyi vyi, i ang law kiema pha vie hlyi vyi.
Khazing na i thaa naa pabuo sa hrahring tli; i viesaa bangkhuo kha a pape patlaa yi.
A kangkachue khata na tue te, capa ca i tehte ta a cuo, zuekari khata ta angte, capa ca i hmielie aa luopa tehte ta a cuo.
A hihaana ta na thlaachi te ina hue, a haa kha na riesue te, i carie tie ta ama mingcakiy ta ina siy yi.
Iema ta ama pakaa kha na uosue yi te, i be kha esena cangta ina tung yi; kama a du riypata amaa hmya.
Khazing ta Khazing siysaa a ri lipa tie'a luo kha na pi te, cawsaa pha lipa tie kuv luo kha ina thaw.
A dieta tah aw angte buv hning ta ina te; i rue na hmi te a cipachung diy riypata ina cahang; Kama kha a cuokaa ta na chi te,
liy ka a thepa a cawsaa tie ta ina cadung yi. Nangduena hnyi li pata i bawkaw kha thue te, i mang kha alyi lie a pasaa.
A hihaana ta myi ie ta na iesue canyi te, a hihaapa rieka haata inaa zuhning.
I vang cunglie kha buri pang biepuo angte, i thaazuo kha buvcing lie i naw.
I caanapa ta i hmie se diy te, i mingtluo zaw a dungkaduv diy.
Cuorasala i kuv ta pha lina tue vyi, i thlaachuona ca a pathe.
“Vya alyi, i thiyse ca buvkhung khah; diena cuota i khina hing a hy thi khah se.
I tehte ca vuoruo lie khiy a aw, cungluo aa suona lie khiy naa daakhyituv ca a aw.
I viesaa zaw ta na ese hyalya yi te, Khazing'a lie kha i mingthliy i pathla.
Cawsaa pakha ta a ingpaa cuota a tuepa haa khata, cawsaa pakha ta Khazing hmiekunglie naa cuokhyi sala i khing hringhruo.
Tahematapakieca kha cuo hmuo a ta hluota, I vya kaa li tli riypa luopuv luo kha i si aa.
I palung ca kyichi te i ning ca aa ngie tli, thluo na naa huo tli.
I cahriy bangkhuo liena naa tue hyalyapa tie ama aw, i pathiy ina tawpa yi kha i ming ta a hmung pari thluo.
“Kama cuota naa daapacha tie, i ripa hing aa hmuo naa ta riypa ama aw'a ma?
Pachangna ama hnyi li riypata ama palung ca khaa yi cate, caacuonakawta tena kha pi'a va yi ciy.
Lawmuo hmung riypata a viesaa kha a lyipa ca, a saata zaw ming khana a cue aa.
“Kama kha malie ese riypata na tue te, cawsaa ta paciy pachapa pakha ta i cuo.
I ngiechituv pata i ming kha zing te, i kuv-phyi bangkhuo ca ningdiy haata ama ta.
I dang ta pata a ruepa tie ca ama kharue haa te, Khazing kha siysaa a ri lipa haata ina chi yi.
Aa dangpa tie ca ama luo kha a patuv pari yi te, ama kuv a pathepa tie ca ama cahra vie hryly.
Cuorasala, niema, niema bangkhuo ca vya kaa tie ung, niema hrawlie hing a singpa ca hmung'a va yi ang.
I ningkhue ca ama khung, i tingna zaw a ra diy, i palung khingpa zaw a ra diy.
Iema ta zuo kha ningchung ta tue yi te, ‘khena ca a zing'a nang tli', ama ta.
Kama ta Sheol kha i ing haata mang ang sala, i pangphaa kha zingna lie pake ang sala,
Kama ta khue aa thuvpa kha, ‘I paa tana na cuo,’ ta ang sala, thulung kha, ‘I nung,’ acuolikie ‘I sieta,’ i ta kieca,
I nguopuona ca khaapaliema a aw aa? Ahungma i nguopuona ca a hmung aa?
Sheol luo kha ma a sibung aa? Buvcing chung luo kha ma ima cung hne aa?” a ta.
Cakhutaata Shuh ming Bildad ta palie te:
“Kha cuo te ma bie ca na huv pari aa? Rue la, cakhutaata kiema ta ma ri aa.
Khaapanakawma kiema ca sahring haata malie na ri? Khaapanakawma na hmungna lie hing ma ngaasa hringhruo'a e?
Na hi a haa nakawta nama hne nama a thlaachipa, nama kawlieta ma alyi hing thaw pata cuo'a te, alungpuv hing hnyi pata a cuo aa?
“A pha lipa tie khena ca pachesa pata cuo'a te, iema myi a myihlaa ca khe'a vyi.
Ama thluodaa chunglie khena ca zing te, iema cunglie myi-ing ca pache pata a cuo.
A cahrapa ama kyi hliy ca a cathang te, iema khuekhuona mamaapa khata a vaapatyi yi.
Tahematapakieca ama phyi khata asue luo kha vaa uo yi te, cakuo yi te suphung luo kha ama tla.
Cyihyi ta ama lyidu khata pa-uo yi te, a cusa pata a patuv yi.
Alyi lie khuhriypa-uo thla khuo yi te, luopuv lieta cyihyi kha ama thla khuo.
A kuo ting taata ciy aa chiypa ta cadung yi te, ama hnangluo taata aa cade yi.
Sa kuo a maa nakawta a thaa caw te, amaa thaalie kha vuochina ta aa daapuo yi.
Pasana ta ama vang kha ning te, thiyna sa-uvthyi ta ama kuv-phyi kha a ning.
Aa bang pata a awnapa a ing taa khata a da yi te, ciy aa chiypa thiyna siepahruo hmiekung luo kha ama chiykhyi.
Ama thluodaa lie kha khaapahmuo a ngaa vyi; ama awna lie kha ke ama phuv.
Rawluo ta ama thariy kha caa te, cungluo ta ama ce kha a rue.
Iema maw lina ca alyi taata vie te, luopuv lieta ming hnyi va yi.
Iema ca khena taata zingna luo thaw pata cuo yi te, chuelyi taata a cade pata ama cuo.
Iema ca ama cawsaa zaw hrawlie kha ciypathla hne samingsahlaa hnyi va yi, ama za aw tawna lie kha a hringpa aw va yi.
Iema kaw kha ama thyi tiyta ningtlaluo ming ama phuv a hling te, ningchiyluo ming kha amaa pahlusa.
A pha lipa tie awna lie ca cahaapa hmang kha tlung hmisi te, Khazing a pachang lipa tie awna lie ca cahaaca tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Job ta palie te:
“Khatiy te khiy ma nama bie ta na caphichi diy'a ung cate, a pasasa pata ina tuechie'a ung ciy?
Yi hraa te tama ina pachie byalya'a ung ciy? a cuo li pata ina tuepa ungca hing nama nang zaa the va ma?
I tuesuepa ta hmuo cuo ra sala, kama cunglie ca muo a tla thluo'a ta.
Niema ta kama kha akuo ta na chi ung cate namaa pathuosa, sue na pacu ung cate ina mangbung ung ciy.
Khazing ta kama kha na pasue te, aa sue ta ina buvpa hing pachang tie ung.
‘Lienawna!’ ta angte i khi zawta, palie pata cuo va ang.
I luopuv kha na paping khuo te caluo khu va ang, I luopuv lieta zingna kha a chi.
i linghlaa kha na lapa diy te, i byilakhuv kha i luv cung taata a la.
A kuo bangkhuo taata na tuvchi te i chuo tli, i nguopuona kha thing thariy phie ta a phie.
A pathiylingna ca i cunglie a ie ta ie te, kama kha a carie lie ina pasuvpuo.
A rieka tie ca a vaw yi te kama a du riypata riekhuocaaca kha a cu yi te i thluodaa kha cadung yi te inaa ripuo yi.
“I ingchungkhue kha kama hne aa hlasana luo chi yi te, i pachangpa tie ta amaa malie karue.
I tieriy hne i viesaa phapa tie ta na thaw yi te,
i ing lie i khyche tie ta ina maw yi. I rehrietuv canung zaw ta maliepa ta na chi yi te, ama ming hmungna lie kha ruohrang ming ta i li.
I changtaapa tie kha ku yi angte, cuorasala na chaw va yi. Kama pali ta paa i kie yi.
I huvsung ca i napuvnung cuota hnaahnawna cuo te, i ingchungkhue cuota duv i chiy.
Haatiyta myarya ta hmuo na duv yi te, i thu tiyta ina pahnyisue yi.
I viesaa phapa bangkhuo ta na duv yi te, i duepa zaw bangkhuo ta inaa carie yi.
I ruv lie i vang a be hmisi te, a hring thluo ta riypa hmisi dyi ta i cuo.
I cunglie kawpacuona hnyi tie ung, i cunglie kawpacuona hnyi tie ung, Vya viesaa zaw, Abyipa kuv na naa dekhu!
Khaapanakawma Khazing ta inaa cadepa haata inaa cade ung ciy? i saa ta ca nang buo va yi ma?
“I bie hing cape pata cuo sala i khing hringhruo! caa-uv chunglie cape pata cuo sala na i khing hringhruo!
Chuozaa aa hmang riypata alung cunglie kha thaa caasung ta cape yi sala na i khing hringhruo!
Tahematapakieca naa thlatuv a hringpa kha i pachang, ning chuo ningpa lie kha alyi cunglie hing aa daa aa;
I vang hing parapa a cuo khutaata, i saapa hingta Khazing ca i hmung aa.
Ama ca i ming hrahring ta hmung'a angte, malie ta cuo li pata kama ming hrahring ta a hmung aa.
Niema ta, ‘Tuokhaatama ma hrisaa aa? Hingpa ruvna thariy hing ama chungliena ma hmung’ nama ta biephung kieca,
zueziy kha ciy mya ung, tahematapakieca hihaana na zueziy ta duotena kha a vya phya aa, ca tiy cata bieripana a awpa kha nama pachang aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Naamath ming Zofar ta palie te:
“I chunglie naa pasupa a aw nakaw hne, i ruena lie palie riypata a kya puv nakawta naathlie tie.
Ina pasuenapa ciy na bie kawlie i palung pha vyi, cuorasala tuokhaatama ica palie aa tapa kha i pachang ra thluo.
Hing haapa hing hluo ning taata cuo pari te, alyi lie cawsaa a aw baataata a cuo pari tapa kha pachang va ca ma?
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ta cawsaa ama esena hing cuo pachangta dyi cuo te, Khazing siysaa a ri lipa tie palungtluona hing cuo khata dyi tana a cuo.
Avuo tluv khiy ta a suo yi te, ama luv ca amyi kya de ra sala,
ama ii haa khata chuozaa ta ra'a yi te, a hmung buopa tie ta, ‘Khaapaliema ama aw?’ ama ta aa.
Ama muo haa khata vie'a yi te, hmung pata cuo'a va tli yi; zuo ta hmungpa muocuo haa tana ama vie aa.
Iema a hmungpa ming ta hmung pakhaa'a va tli yi; ama aw tawnapa hmang zawta hmung'a va tli yi.
Ama haatiy tie ta siypasa tie hmie mang kha a zue'a yi te, ama hnyirungna kha ama kuv ta malie ama pi aa.
Mingnu ama cuo ning ama pangrue phapa ca, alyi diypa liena a laa paluo aa.
“Pha lina ca ama pakaa lie thlungsa te, ama palyi lie ama nu,
pacha khing lipa yi ta ama pakaa lie ama pa-ung,
cuorasala ama sa ca ama riy chunglie a thle te, pariy ca-ie ta aa li.
Hnyirungna kha paluo yi te ama paliy pakhaa; Khazing na ama riy chungtaata a papya pakhaa.
Iema ta pariy ca-ie kha pazaw'a yi te, pariy palyi ta iema kha a thie'a yi.
Khyitiy hne cuehnung ta a langpa cavaa zaw kha, iema ta hmung'a va yi.
Ama rehrie muo thyipaa zaw kha, padaw hmuo li pata ama pi pakhaa aa; ama sungpalina mie kha ta, anuona khaapahmuo hmung'a va yi.
Tahematapakieca siypasa tie kha chaapuo yi te ama thaw, iema ta ama sa lipa ing kha ama chuv.
“Ama karuo-awna ca a lunghruo a tlung the li nakawta, ama khingpa kha khaapa hmuo pazang va yi.
Ama ning khutaata khaapahmuo pangaa va yi, caacuonakawta ama hnyirungna ca a pasiy a hmang'a vyi.
Ama chyachang aa ky liyciy ta palungriethyina a taw'a yi te, palungriethyina cahrana ta ama cunglie a tlasue'a yi.
Ama riy a bina riypata, Khazing ta a hihaana kha iema chung luo pathlie'a te, khy saa ta apa saa sue'a yi.
Thaa cehre taa khata amaa ruo raalaa zaw ta, daa cuoti ta a cathiy pahli'a yi.
Capa ca a da pathla yi te, aa li dyi a lipa a cuoti daw taa khata a mangkhaa tiy a za lang.
A chaasapa zingna ca ama suethiy cuota chipa pata cuo yi te, cawsaa ta patiy lipa myi ta a kuo diy'a yi.
Ama pha lina kha avuo khiy ta za phu diy'a te, alyi zaw ta iema a du riypata a thu aa.
Ama ing lie ama hnyipa hmang bangkhuo kha a vie diy aa, Khazing hihaana ning lie kha tiyse phya ta a phya diy aa.
Hingpa hing a pha lipa tie cuota Khazing'a taata cuvu tana a cuo, iema cuota Khazing ta a repa yi ru tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Job ta palie te:
“I bie hing a phasa pata naathlie tie, capa ca i hnaa ina panguona cata cuo se.
Na ang law thi la ri'a ang; i ri khutaata na pahnyisue lavuo ciy.
Kama i cienapa hing cawsaa cunglie tama a cuo? Khaapanakawma palung pachang li pata i aw aa?
Na mang la na kharue haa naase, cakhutaata na pakaa kha na kuv ta a pahruv tie.
Capa ca i rue tiyta i phuv dyi a hling te, aa cathang dyi i cathang.
Khaapanakawma cawsaa pha lipa tie hing ama chuo a pasiy? Ama nungpuv ama macuona te ta hring yi te, lesyi yi te ama cahra?
Ama saata zaw ta ing hne lu aa tle pata ama hringpa kha hmung yi te, ama samingta zaw ama hmiekunglie amaa tlepa kha ama hmung.
Ama ing ca ciyna chungtaata a bang te, Khazing khuecahryi ta pha va yi.
Ama cuetungpa ta a ciy pathlie khu pari te, ama cuepuvnung zaw pachuo pari te hruv buo vyi.
Ama saata zaw ca tuvrung haata pathlie yi te, a khie yi te ama luo.
Akhang hne tingtuo kha tung yi te, ramang ue lie kha amaa law.
Hnyirungna ta ama chuo ca hmuo yi te, A diesa pata Sheol luo ama sibung.
Khazing kha, ‘Kiema se ta malie thuse tie! Na luopuv kha pachang khing vapuv,’ ama ta.
Kiema ta a re ma hrie riypata, Lesyice ca ahungtama a cuo? Amaa'a luo thlaa ima chuo pata khaapa athungna ma ima hmung aa?
Ama hnyirungpa hing iema ama tue khuna thueta ma a cuo? Cawsaa pha lipa tie tingna ca kama hne a se vyi.
“Yi khazaa ma cawsaa pha lipa tie myi-ing ca pache pata a cuo buo? Yi khazaa ma ama cunglie rana a tlung buo? Yi khazaa ma Khazing a hi haa te ama cunglie pasana a tlung buo?
Yi khazaa ma thliy ta a pazupa sacuokung hne savie haata ama cuo buo?
Niema ta, ‘Khazing na ama saata zaw kha ama pha lina a pacungpa yi,’ nama ta. Capa ca iema kha ama pachang the riypata thung pata cuo yi se.
Iema ming ta iema rana kha a hmung yi sala, Lesyice hihaana kha dang yi se.
Cawsaa hingta a hringna a chuo khutaata a ingchungkhue hing a mangchiy the'a tli ma?
Aa suona lie a awpa tie bieripatuv Khazing ca, a pacuv riypa pakha chuo ama aw'a ma?
Cawsaa pakha ca a hnyirung liyciy, aa nuosa pata hne aa bangsa pata a aw ning,
a sesie ca a thupa ta bi te, a ruv ca a lathliy ta a bi ningta a thiy.
A hrangpa pakha ca phana kha a pacuo buo li pata ngiechisa pata a thiy.
Iema ca alyi diypa lie kha laa kaluo yi te, cuokarie ta a buv yi.
“Kama'a lie a pha lipa tue riypata nama tingna hne nama ruena zaw kha i pachang.
Niema ta, A lepa paa ing ca khaapaliema a aw? a pha lipa paa awnapa thluodaa ca khaapaliema a aw?
Khy a tlawpa tie kha hiehriy buo va yi ca ma? Ama tehte khuopa kha thyi buo va ca ma?
A pha lipa tie ca ranapa ning lie kha pangaa pata ama cuo'a ma? Hihaana ning lie kha khuo pata ama cuo'a ma?
Iema ama tuepa kha iema hmiekunglie ahungma a phu aa? Iema ama tuepa cuo khata ahungma a thung'a yi?
Thluo luo a puvlepa ama cuo tiyta, ama thluo lie kha a huotuv ama chipa.
Bawphie lie alyi tungtungpa ca iema cuota a thlung, cawsaa mekaa ta ziy'a yi te, a hmiekung luo ta a sipa ca ri tie pata cuo va yi.
Hnaanguona ina ripa ungca hing kha tluv tama a hripa ta a cuo? Ina paliepa ung ciy nama bie hing hangbie selaw tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Teman ming Elifaz ta a ri:
“Cawsaapa hing Khazing cuota a thlahnepa ama aw'a ma? A sing cepa hing hmuo Khazing cuota a thlahne'a ma?
A dang la, naa dangna hing ta Lesyice ca a palung a patluo'a ma? Na hringzya hing syisaa riy aw li pata aw sala, a cuota a thlahne'a ma?
