Ama ta aca pasiypa-yapa hing naa dang nakawta a cuo ma? bieripana luo acaa ngiekhyipa hing naa dang nakawta a cuo ma?
Na pha lina hing le hringhruo va ma? Na suena hing chuo the vyi.
Na uvnu tie ama biekuona sue kha a kaw aw li pata patuvpa yi cate, ama caw kha thliepa yi cate ama thliehripa ta na chi yi.
A thaa buopa kha tiy pi lipa cata, a nangdiypa cuota sa pahya vaciy.
A cahrapa tie ta luruo ama hnyi, hmiezaapa tie ta ama awna.
Nama ca nunghlyi zaw kha ama kuv cahripa ta pathlie yi cate, haaraa tie kuv kha na thli.
Caacuonakawta cyihyi ta ca cadung te, sungkha ta a tlungpa ciy aa chiypa hne zingna ta ca pahlaw te,
caacuonakawta na ming hmung vyi; tiylepa na acaa buvkhung.
“Khazing ca aa suona vuoruo liena a aw cuo va ma? Mang tie, aa suo cepa aasiy zaw khiy kha tluv tama amaa suo!
Caacuonakawta nama ta, ‘Khazing ta khaapama a pachang? A zing karuvpa chungtaata bieripana a tue khu'a ma?
A chaasapa amyi ta pahlaw te hmung khu vyi, a zaa pakhuvpa avuo lie khiy na a cakuole thluo,’ na ta.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ta ama chaalepa luopuv hlungpa ca ma na ziy thluo aa?
Ama cuo a tling hluota a dapathla pata cuo yi te, ama hruopatu ca tiyse na a phya.
Iema ta Khazing kha, ‘Kiema se ta malie thuse tie,’ ta yi te, ‘Lesyice ca tuokhaatama malie a tue khu aa?’ ama ta.
Khazing ta iema ing kha hmang phapa ta a pabi, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa tie ama tingna ca a pali a pahnaa tana a si.
Aa dangpa tie ta capa ca hmung yi te amaa law; suena a hnyi lipa tie ta pahnyisue yi te ama ese.
‘Ma carie tie ca para pata na ama cuo hmisi tli, ama hnyirungna zaw myi na a kuo diy,’ ama ta.
“Khazing khingna kha ziy la thlaalungna hneta aw tie; cahaacata na tue kie dyina nama'a luo phana aa vaw aa.
Pacuvna kha a pakaa taata a la lah, a bie kha na palung chunglie chi tie.
Lesyice'a luo na kaa kieca aca sa pathiy aa, na thluodaa taata a dang lina kha thaw cate,
Siy kha alyi diypa haata ri cate, Ofir siy kha cavaa lungcapang haata na ri kieca,
Lesyice ca na siy ta cuo te, a muo phapa ngu ta a cuo kieca,
Lesyice'a lie kha na hnaa nguosa'a te, Khazing hmiephaa hmungna cuo kha na hmung aa.
Ama'a luo kha thlaachuo'a cate, ama ta aca thyi aa.
Tue naa tingpa bangkhuo lie kha hluetlingna na hmung aa.
Cawsaa hrangpa tie pachung pata ama cuo ning kha nama ca calangthaw pata na cuo aa. Tahematapakieca ama ta aa panepa tie kha a khuo yi.
A suepa kha hmuo khuo'a yi te, na kuv a pathena thue khata iema ca ama law aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Job ta palie te:
“Ataning zaw khuo vie ta i cie, i cunglie a kuv aa riysa nakawta i hrung hryly.
Khaapaliema i hmung khu aa tapa kha pachang ang sala, a awna luo te na i cakuo aa.
A hmiekunglie i bie kha ri'a angte, i chiycuona bangkhuo kha i chang aa.
Ina palie riypa hne kama'a lie a ri riypa kha i pachang aa.
A lepa a cahrana ta kama ca inaa zue'a ma? Naa zue'a vyi; cuorasala i bie khana ina naathliepa aa.
Aa dangpa ca ama hne a i khuna aw'a te, i bie naa ripatuv ta chuozaa ta duo ina pacu aa.
“Hmieluo i si kiema capa lie ca aw vyi; hnangluo i kaa kiema hmung khu hyi va ang.
Cavyiluo kuo ta i maa kie zaw hmung khu li pa ang ta; cacuoluo i maa kie zaw hmung khu ngiethie va ang.
Cuorasala i ziypa luopuv kha pachang te, ina dyapasya tiyta, siy i cuopa kha aa luo aa.
A luopuv kha i phyi ta ziy pari te, a luopuv kha ziy angte piese va ang.
A hmya taata a pyapa a nawbie kha thaw va ang, a pakaa taata a pyapa bie kha i palung chunglie i pacung.
Cuorasala ama ca a khingna haata a tuepa ta cuo te, ahungma a maa khu aa?
Tahematapakieca i cuota a tingpa kha ama ta a patling sa aa; cahaapa hmang a hluvsa ca a chunglieta a aw.
Caacuonakawta a awna lie ca ciy angte, ama kaw i rue tiyta i thlaa a zang.
Khazing ta i palung thaa kha panaa sa te, Lesyice ta ina paciy sa.
Zingna chunglie hing vie the ang sala ca, a chaasapa zingna na i hmie hing a buvkhung aa.
“Khaapanakawma Lesyice ta cuo hing a thli va? Khaapanakawma ama a pachangpa tie ta a bieripana ning kha ama hmung va?
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ta luriy kha ama hnyi; sahring zaw kha paruv yi te iema huopa luo amaa pahlaw.
Haaraa tie laa kha chuv yi te, nunghlyi tie cuetungpa kha biekuona ta ama patuv.
Aa phahlapa tie kha luokie luo nuo yi te, siypasa tie bangkhuo ca amaa nu.
Ruochung lie laa haata, re hrie riypata ama pya, ama saata huo khata ruo utlawpa lie kha sa ama huv.
Ama lu ta a cuo lipa lie kha sa ama uo, cawsaa pha lipa tie mingsuv dung lie kha mingsuv samang ama thang.
Cawsie li pata hne ama thliehripa ta zuo khy dyi laa yi te, a kangna chunglie kha a buv riy hnyi va yi.
Tluo cung khy khata phaw yi te ama pacing diy, ama canaw khing nakawta alung kha amaa pe.
“Haaraata kha a nung a hnung taata a chupathlapa aw yi te, siypasa saata kha lyibuo ta a patuvpa ama aw.
Iema ca cawsie li pata hne ama thliehripa ta pya yi te, ama nang a diysa raalaa pata suopie kha amaa puv.
Malie ing lieta chiytiy rie yi te mingsuv ama sue, cuorasala iema ca ama tiy a hrie.
Khypuv chunglie a thiy nguoluopa tie a hrung yi te, hmaa a phyapa tie ta khi yi te abyana ama hie; cuorasala Khazing ta ama thlaachuona kha siysaa ri vyi.
“Khena kha a dupa aw yi te, a luopuv kha pachang lipa yi ta a ziy zaw ziy va yi.
Lie a nawpa ca siypasa hne aa phahlapa tie thie riypata khy dyi hluota a thu, zuo ta ca malie hmang kha a paruv.
Malie napuv a paruvpa ta ca khyzing kha a pachuo, ‘Ahungtahmuo na hmung'a vyi,’ ta te, pachang rie ciy ta a hmie kha aa pakhuo.
Aparuvpa tie ca zuo ta ing kha ama paruv, ningchung ta ca ing kha a khaakhung yi te, khena kha pachang va yi.
A zingpa zuo ca iema cuota mawdiy ta cuo te, zingna ciy-achiyna hne khata viesaa ta ama cuo.
“Iema ca tiy cunglie tiybuv haa kha tana ama cuo; alyi lieta ama cuvu ca chiesana ta cuo te, ama mingsuv dung kha vaa chaapa aw va yi.
Khykuona hne a palingna ta cahue kha ama paza diypa haata; cahaacata a suepa tie cunglie kha Shoel ta a tue ra.
A satuv ama nung ta maw yi te, cuokarie ta a pahuosa ciemuo yi; A thyipa ta cuo va tli yi; thingkungpa haa tana ama tli.
“Iema ta saata a hnyi lipa canung kha riethyi pi yi te, nunghlyi cuo khata hmang phapa tue va yi.
Khazing ta a cahrana ta a lesyipa tie kha para yi te, ama kya thuthaw pa khata ama hringna a vie.
Khazing ta a bya yi te aa bangta tah khy a pasa sa yi; cuorasala a mang pathliy pari yi.
Iema ca cuo pachang ta chung cyicalang pata cuo yi te ama vie; paapaapa haata a uv yi te ama lang; sa-uv haata pasiy pachung pata ama cuo.
Hingpa hing cuo vyi naa ta khutuv pakha chuo ama aw ma? I ripa hing a cuo lipa tana a cuo naa ta khutuv ahung chuo ama aw ma?” a ta.
Cakhutaata Shuh ming Bildad ta palie te:
“Khazing ca nawhnyina hne ciy-achiyna linghlaa hneta bi te, aa suopa a vuoruo lie khiy diena a sa.
A riekaphuv tie ca ahungma a ri khu aa? A khena ta a pakhe lipa ahungma a aw?
Khazing hmiekunglie ahungma aa dangpa a cuo khu aa? Canung ta sapa ahungma a pathe khu aa?
A ming hmungna lieta thlaapa khiy hmuo vaa li pata, aasiy zaw khiy hmuo ama sie li kieca,
lunglungpa haa dyi ta a cuopa cawsaapa hne cuokarie haa dyi ta a cuopa cawsaapa changchiy ca khaapama ri riy a aw aa?” a ta.
Cakhutaata Job ta palie te:
“Cahrana a hnyi lipa na naa bya de! Thaazuo a hnyi lipa kuvbuo na naa bya de!
Singna a hnyi lipa kha pasing sa cate na, a phasa hringhruopa ruena na pi de!
Ahung abyana tama hingpa bie hing na ri? Ahung thlaapa ma na chungtaa hingta a kya pya?
A rawluo lie ningdiy hne tiy hne a chunglie a awpa tie ca aa cathang ta amaa cathang.
Sheol ca Khazing hmiekunglie a thliehripa ta aw te, Abaddon ca a pahruv kha pahruv pata cuo vyi.
Ama ta chaluo avuo kha a hrihripa lie pake te, alyi kha khaapahmuo a aw lipa cunglie a pathlie.
A chaapa amyi khiy ta khytiy ca vyi te, amyi ca a pahaw vyi.
Thlaapa kha amyi ta pakhuo te, a hmie kha a buvkhung.
Tiy cunglieta khena hne a zingna aa tawna lie khata ruoriy a thlaa khuo.
Avuo atung tie ca a chuo nakaw yi ta a ca-ang ta ca-ang yi te amaa cathang.
A cahrana ta riyliy kha padie sa te, a singna ta Rahab kha a thie.
Ama a thliy ta avuo kha pathe sa te, aa ruopa pariy kha a kuv ta a thie.
Hingpa hing a tuepa a peta tana a cuo kalie, a bie ueryi a cawkariyta dyina ma thyi; Cuorasala a cahrana khalung pu ca ahungma a pachang khu aa?” a ta.
Job ta a bieripa kha thukhyi pakhaa te:
“Kama cuvu kha naa chuvpa Khazing, i hringna palungriethyi pata naa tuepa Lesyice a hringpa haata;
i huv kha i chunglie aw te, Khazing ta ina pipa huv kha i hnacabuv chunglie a aw chung bangkhuo ca,
I hmya ta hangna bie ri li'a pata, i palyi ta malie dungna bie kha ri'a vyi.
Na ripa ca aa dang ica ta riypa kha kama hneta a hla se; i thiyna te ta kama ripa na a hmuo i tapa kha pathlie buo hluo'a va ang.
I dangna kha khuosa ta a patuv'a angte, pathlie buo hluo'a va ang; i hring chung bangkhuo kha i pathiypalung ta na pasue'a vyi.
“I carie tie ca cawsaa pha lipa tie haa khata cuo yi se, kama naa dupa tie ca aa dang lipa tie haa khata cuo yi se.
Khazing ta ama huv la yi te a thie tiy yi ta, Khazing a zang lipa tie ca khaapa aruechuona ma ama hnyi?
Ruvnaana ta a tlung tiy yi ta ama khina ueryi kha Khazing ta a thyi'a yi ma?
Lesyice chunglie kha ama hnaa a nguo the'a ma? Khazing kha ama u pari the'a ma?
Khazing hmang tue khuna kha ca chang'a yi ang; Lesyice ta aa tingpa kha nu'a va ang.
Nama bangkhuo ta niema hrahring ta nama hmung tli; khaapanakawma a hrihripa ta namaa li pakhaw diy?
“Khazing ta cawsaa pha lipa cuvu ta a chipa ca hingpa hing tana a cuo, malie a tuechiepa tie ta Lesyice'a taata ama hmungpa ca:
Ama saata kha ama pungzaa kieca, zueziy cuota cuo'a yi te, ama ciypathla ca nangdiy pata khy ama sa aa.
A hring kaliepa tie ca puvtlung pasana ta thluo lie paby'a yi te, ama nunghlyi zaw ta caa'a va yi.
Ngu kha alyi diypa haata papung yi te, cawsie kha amaa pathluvsue zawta
capa cawsie ca aa dangpa ta a hryi'a te, suena a hnyi lipa tie ta ngu kha amaa re aa.
Iema ta ama ing kha pavaa buv haata hne, mingsuv diedung a huopa tie thluodaa haata ama sa.
Hnyirungna cangta amaa zie, cuorasala cahaacata cuo pakhaa buo va tli yi; ama ming kha kya padyi yi te, ama hnyirungna ca aw va tli.
Ciy aa chiysapa ta tiylepa haata sikhyi te, zuo ta thliychie ta a phya yi.
Ningchiyluo thliy ta a hruo te a phya yi, ama ing taa khata ingphiy phiy ta a phiy diy yi.
Ngiechina hnyi li pata phya diy yi te, a cahrana thliy taata a ruo riypa kha khuosa ta amaa zue.
A kuv cabesue yi te, a awna hmang taa khata thlaazang pata a tue yi.
“Ngu ama cuna khue aw te, siy ama pathe sana hmang a aw.
Thaa ca alyi chungtaata thue yi te, alung kha chang yi te daa ama papya.
A cupa tie ca a dena a zingna te, aa thuv cena te ta a ngie yi te, a zingkaruvna aa thuvna hmang te ta alung kha ama huv.
Cawsaa awna taata aa hlasana bawphie lie kha khue ca ama cu; iema ca khy a tlawpa tie ta maw yi te, cawsaa hne aa hlana lie kha a pathlie yi te, kuokha taata kuokha luo kha amaa pahe.
A cunglie alyi taata sa kung pu te, a rawluo alyi ca myi ta a kuopa haata aa pali diy.
Aa lung ca safaiar lungvaa pyanapa ta cuo te, aa lyi diypa lieta siy a aw.
“Capa khue luo a ngiena luopuv ca saa a cepa pavaa ta pachang vyi, hmungthlu ming zaw ta hmung vyi.
A hruotlepa saruopa tie ta tlaw lipa yi ta, chingde zaw ta capa cunglie ca ziy buo vyi.
“Cawsaa ta alung cunglie ca ama kuv khang yi te, tluo kha a thabaw te ta ama pali.
Alung chunglie kha khue ryi yi te, ama ming ta muosungpa mekaa kha ama hmung.
Cavaa kha ting yi te, aa nupa hmang tie kha ama kya papya.
“Cuorasala singna ca khaapaliema hmung khu pata a cuo aa? Pachangna awna hmang ca khaapa lieta ma a cuo?
Capa luo sina luopuv ca cawsaapa ta pachang vyi, capa ca a hringpa tie ruo lie hmung khu pata cuo vyi.
Aa thuvpa riyliy ta, ‘Kama chunglie aw vyi,’ a ta, riyliy ta, ‘Kama'a lie aw vyi,’ a ta.
Capa ca siy ta calyi khu aw li pata, ngu ta calyi khu'a pata cuo vyi.
Ofir siy ta a muo tue khu'a pata cuo li pata, a muo ruvpa oniks hne safaiar lungvaa ta a muo tue khu'a pata cuo vyi.
Siy hne thlaluo ta a khing khu va yi, siy phapa ta tuepa suethiy ta thle khu pata cuo'a vyi.
Koral lungvaa hne kristal lungvaa ca ri tluo'a pata cuo vyi, Singna ca lungvaa muosungpa laata a sungnaa vie.
Ethiopia lie khrisolait lungvaa hne pakhingpuo'a pata cuo vyi, siy pathepa ta a muo thli khu'a pata cuo vyi.
“Cata a cuo kie, singna ca khaapa taata ma aa vaw? pachangna ca khaapaliema a aw?
A hringpa bangkhuo tie ming ta hmung khu li pata, thliy chunglie a zupa pavaa zaw ta hmung khu vyi.
Abaddon hne thiyna ta, ‘Hingpa kaw hing ma naa ta dyina ma thyi,’ ama ta.
“Capa luo sinapa luopuv ca Khazing dyi ta pachang te, capa hmang ca ama dyina a pachang.
Tahematapakieca alyi dena te kha hmung khu te, avuo rawlie hmangting bangkhuo hing a hmung diy.
Thliy kha ariyna pi te, tiy kha a taanapa ta a taa yi;
Khy saanazya riypa kha tue pacie diy te, khalung hne thinghlaa kha luo a sapa pacie ning yi khata,
singna kha hmung te, a muo kha za tue tli te a za pathyi sa mangtli.
Cakhutaata cawsaapa kyihuo khata, ‘Abyipa ciyzaana hing na singna hmisi ta a cuo; pha lina cahriypa hing na pachangna hmisi ta a cuo,’” a ta.
Job ta a bieripa kha thukhyi pakhaa te:
“Vya, hluo ning thlaa chunglie i za aw ning haata hne Khazing ta ina za mangchiy ning haa khata aw ang sala i khing hringhruo.
I luv cunglie a myi-ing khe te, a khena thueta zingna chunglie i za cakuopa haa khata;
i chuo khingkhuo lieta i za cuona haa khata hne, Khazing a viesaana i thluodaa lie a aw ning haa khata;
Lesyice kama'a lie a aw ning haa khata hne i saata zaw ta kama na cadung yi te ama aw ning haa khata;
i luopuv lie cuehnung lang te, kama cuota alung taata chiytiy a lang ning haa khata cuo sala na i khing hringhruo!
Khypuv thlake luo kha pya angte, zapuv ahmyana hmang lie kha i vya tu tiyta,
mingnu tie ta kama kha ina hmung tiy yi ta na cahriy yi te, kung uvthyi tie ta a daa yi te ama cakuo.
Byi tie ta bie ri a cadang yi te, ama kuv ta ama pakaa kha amaa pahruv.
Byi tie ryi ca die te, ama palyi ca ama duo luo kha aa bepuo.
I kaw a thyipa tie ta i thuophaa ina ri yi, naa hmungpa tie khata pachangkhyituv ama cuo;
tahematapakieca siypasa tie hne, byatuv a hnyi lipa haaraa tie kha, byana vuota ama khi tiyta i bya yi.
Riethyivuosuopa tie ta na pathuosa yi te, nunghlyi tie palung tluosa pata hlaa a pasa satuv ca kama tana i cuo.
Adangna kha pang haata a buv angte, biedangpa ca i cuota i pang hne pawde haata ama cuo.
Kama ca mingcuepa cuota ming cuo angte, a cabiepa cuota phyi ta i za cuo.
Vuosuopa cuota paa ta za cuo angte, khyche ming kaw a ripa tawpa tana i cuo.
Aa dang lipa tie nue kha za thli angte, ama haata ama cepa tie kha i pathlie sa yi.
Cakhutaata i ruepa ca, ‘I buv chungliena i thiy aa,' i hringna ning hing viehnang haata na ama hluv aa i ta;
i thariy hruo ca tiy lie kha a phaa te, i nge cunglie kha aduotiy zuokhydyi ama tla aa;
i ling aw pari'a te, i liy ca i kuv lie a thaa pari aa,’ i ta.
“Iema ta na naathlie yi te ina huo yi, a dieta tah aw yi te i ruena pipa kha ama huo.
I ri khutaata ca ahungtahmuo ri pathiy va tli yi, i bie ca ama cunglie kha aduotiy haata a tla.
Khytiy ama huopa haa khata kama kha na huo yi te, khytiy taapa ama huopa haa khata ama pakaa uo yi te ina huo yi.
Anguona ama hnyi li tiyta pakiysue yi angte, i hmiephya thueta ama palung chuo vyi.
Ama luochiytuv ce ta aw angte, ama luopuv kha i tlawpa yi; ama hrawlie kha siepahruo haata aw angte, muochie a sapa tie hnaapanguotuv haata i cuo.
“Cuorasala ata ca kama laata a syi viepa tie na pahnyisesungna ta naa hmuo yi, ama paa tie ca i tuvrung a huopa uv hneta hmuo i chi khing lipa i nutaapa tie tana ama cuo.
Iema ca ama thaa bangkhuo cung tli te, ama kuv thaa taata khaapama i hmung aa?
Ama nang a diysa nakawta, ruocaapa hne a duothlingna lie kha na,
ahling kung hnaa kha lu yi te, iema hne iema a palung riypata ingphiykung thariy kha ama cu.
Cawsaa phuv taa khata a cade yi te, a ruvhangpa a cade yi te ama pahuepa haa khata ama pahue.
Ryihue lie hne huecaapa lie kha aw'a yi te, alyi khue lie hne alung karaw lie zaw kha amaa chuo aa.
Aphuv hrawlie kha khi yi te, ahling kung rawlie kha amaa pung.
Ruena a hnyi lipa, nutaa-esepa tie ta cuo yi te, ruo chungtaata papya pata ama cuo.
“Ata ca hlaa ta ina tue hyalya yi; iema tue hyalyapa ta i cuo.
Na duv yi te ina cahriy yi; i hmie lie ama paciy ta ina pacha riypa yi kha ama kuo chi vyi.
Khazing ta i liy riy kha na paduepa te ina pachung nakawta, i hmiekunglie kha a cadang va yi.
I cacuoluo kuo ta cawsaa laliy lipa tie kha amaa kya daa, nuopatyi riypata naa zue yi te, i rana riypa luopuv kha ina sakhuo yi.
I luopuv kha chipachung yi te, para riypata inaa zue hryly yi; ahungtahmuo thlu va yi.
Aa awnapa khue taa khata a vya ngie yi te, a cingnapa alala taa khata aa nuo ta inaa vya nuosue yi.
Ciy aa chiypa ta na vya kaahning te, i ling-awna kha thliy phya ta a phya; i hnyirungna ca amyi haata a pe.
“Caacuonakawta i palung rasa te, ningting ta ruvnaana ta ina patuv.
Zuo ta i ruv kha na ce te, naa ryi byalyapa pasana ca a pahy vyi.
I pang khata khuopuv ta na patuv te, i buohryi rawpatlung ruepakaw khata ina ripuo.
Caakaw chung luo na thaw te, kama ca buvcingkhuv hne buvcuo haa tana i cuo.
Nama ta ca u raalaa angte na chaw vaciy, i kya daa raalaa pata a mang he na mang vaciy.
I cunglie ruvna tue riypata naa vya palihning cate, a cahrapa na kuv ta ina hrisaa ciy.
Thliy chung luo kha na calang cate, na pakhang sa cate khuopuv ta ina pade sa ciy.
Cawsaa bangkhuo cuota na paraw ciepa ing luo kha thiy riypata inaa chiy'a ciy tapa kha i pachang.
“Ruvnaana chunglieta a khipa vuosuopa tie kha ahunghmuo a palihning va yi.
Ruvnaana a tawpa tie cuo khata za caa va ang ma? Siypasa tie cuo khata i ngie za chi taw va ma?
Cuorasala phana i huv tiyta, chiena a vaw te, khena i huo tiyta zingna ta aa vaw.
I pathiypalung ca a tawmuo hringhruo te die buo vyi; ruvnaana ning na naa chiyhnue.
Ning chiy linapa zingna chunglie kha i khie, cawsaazaapuv apungna lie kha a daa angte byana i hie.
Ruo-uv na i uvnu ta a cuo tli, kala-uvpavaa na i viesaa ta a cuo tli.
I vang ca vaw diy te a kaw, i ruv ca palingna ta a kuo.
I tingtuo ca ngiechinapa hlaa sana ta a li te, i ramang ca caana ueryi ta aa li.
“I ming hneta biekuona tue tli pate, tuokhaatama lesaa ca i mangpathliy the aa?
Cungluo Khazing'a taata i cuvu ca khaapatama a cuo aa? Aa suona lie Lesyice'a taata i ru ca khaapatama a cuo aa?
Vuochina hing ta aa dang lipa tie hing tlunghnue yi te, pha lina a tuepa tie kha rana ta tlunghnue va yi ma?
Ama ta i luopuv kha hmung te, i kyi hliypa zaw a ri diy cuo va ma?
“Hangna luopuv kha ziy pata i cakuo biephung kieca, i phyi hing hang riypata aa ruo pathlyi biephung kieca,
aa hmuopa cyipathliena lie pathlie pata cuo ang se, Khazing ta i dangna kha na pachang se!
Luopuv taata i kyi hliy kha a pie biephung kieca, i palung ta i ming hmungpa kha a ziy pathlyi kieca, i kuv lie hing a pyapa aa kaa pathlyi biephung kieca;
kama ta tuv ang sala a hrangpa ta ning yi se; i ciycyi ca phie pata cuo se.
“Canung pakha ta i pathiypalung kha na la biephung te, i ingpaa tie ingchiypakaa taata i huo biephung kieca;
i napuvnung ca malie ing lieta sacuo rie sala, capaa hrangpa ta a ziekhyi mang sue.
Tahematapakieca capa ca duv aa chiypa suena ta cuo te, phung hmielie suena,
Abaddon te ta a kuobungpa myi, i ciycyi bangkhuo kuo te a para diy riypa myi tana a cuo.
“I siicapaa cuose i siicanung cuose i cunglie palung tling li pata bie ama tuepa kha, siysaa ri li pata i aw kieca,
Khazing aa luo tiyta tuokhaatama i tue aa? Bie ina hiehriy tiyta tuokhaatama i palie aa?
Riy chunglieta kama naa sapa kha na iema zaw a sa ra yi cuo va ma? Riy chunglie ca ma cuona aa lu kaluo cuo va ma?
“Siypasa tie ama khingpa kha pahya li pata aw angte, nunghlyi tie ming kha pari angte,
i viechuo kha kama se ta ning angte, haaraa zaw ama ning ra li kieca,
Paa pakha haata mingnu i cuo ning taata i za mangsangpa haaraata, i puv baataata i za mangchiypa nunghlyi kha,
caw a hnyi li nakawta a thiypa hne a buv a se riy a hnyi lipa siypasa pakha i hmung thluo pata,
i tuvhming taata lungna hmung li pata, a sesie ta kama kha thluechiy ina pi li kieca,
zung lieta naa bya riypa kha i hmung nakawta haaraa cunglieta i kuv i caba pathlyi kieca,
i letung hing a thabaw taata tling sala, i buo ca a cakhiy taata a suv pathla se.
Khazing ciyzaana ca i cunglie aw te, a lesyina kha a hmiepachaw nguo va ang.
“Siy kha a ringchuo angte, siy phapa kha i pacaw kieca;
i hnyirungsa nakawta hne, i kuv ta a hluvsa a hmung nakawta i palung tluo te,
ning a pa-ie tiyta mang angte, thlapa kha a rungnaana hne a si tiyta mang angte,
i palung ca a paruvta tah iema'a luo tluv te, i hmya ta i kuv kha a pahnuo tlamu kieca;
hingpa tie zaw hing bieripatuv tie ta duote aa tlapa pha lina ta a cuo aa, tahematapakieca cungluo lie a awpa Khazing'a lie i sue nakawta a cuo.
“Kama naa huepa tie ama ra tiyta i law kieca, acuolikie pha lina ta a tlung tiy yi ta i palung a tluo kieca,
Thiy naase yi ta pata sie pina bie kha a pakaa ta ri buo vyi.
‘A saa hing ta ma lunghruo tlungsa se,’ ta pata i thluodaa tie hingta ama ri buo kieca,
Khy a tlawpa tie kha i ingchiypakaa i pahaw pari yi, khyche kha luopuv lieta pari buo va yi ang.
Malie ta ama tuepa haata i tuesuena kha buvkhung angte, i pha lina kha i palung lie i nu kieca,
cawsaazaapuv kha ciy yi angte, chungkhue zaw esena i ciy nakawta, ryi li pata aw angte ingle luo i pya li kieca,
Naa naathlietuv pakha i hnyi! I mingse na i thuv aa! Lesyice ta na palie se! I carie tie ta ama capepa tazaa ina cyinapa yi caa na a aw!
Capa ca i letung lie phyale hmisi'a angte, byilakhuv haata i khuv aa.
I za awtuvzya bangkhuo kha ama chang'a angte, byi haata aa thaa luo i vaa aa.
“I ruo ta kama kha na khisue te, aa riylepa lethawna tluo tie khata ama caakhyi kieca,
a chungtaata a vyipa kha a muo pi li pata ning angte, a hnyituv riethyi i pi kieca,
jungsacuo cuopa khata a hling pu hriy se la, barli cuopa khata lubi pu mang sue,” a ta. Job bie ca a chuo.
Job ta ama aa hmungna lie kha a dangpa tana i cuo aa ta nakawta hingpa cawsaa pathung tie hingta a bie kha palie va tli yi.
Ca tiyta Buz ming Barakhel sacapaa Elihu ca a hi a haa. Job ta Khazing laata ama kha aa dang vie ta aa rue nakawta a cunglie a hi a haa.
Job viesaa pathung tie cunglie zaw kha a hi a haa, tahematapakieca Job kha ama pasue raalaa pata a bie palie khu va yi.
Iema ca ama laata ama uvthyi vie nakaw khata Elihu ca Job'a lie bie ri riypa kha ri li pata a aw.
Cuorasala hingpa pathung tie hingta palie khu va tli yi tapa kha a hmung tiyta Elihu ca a hi a haa.
Buz ming Barakhel sacapaa Elihu ta a palie: “Kama ca kung nuta tah cuo angte, nama ca kung uvthyi ta na cuo; caacuonakawta nama'a lie i ruenapa ri riypa kha i rie chie te ica ciy.
‘Kungkhue ta bie ri thluo yi se, kungkhue hing na singna a pacuv yi,’ i ta.
Cuorasala thlaapa ca cawsaapa chunglie aw te, Lesyice huv hing na pachangna ta a cuo.
Kung uvthyi tie dyi hing a singpa ta cuo va yi, macuo tie dyi hing a pachangpa ta cuo va yi.
Caacuonakawta, ‘Na naathlie la, i ruenapa hing ri ra'a ang,’ ica ta.
“Mang tie ung, nama bie kha naa ica thlie yi, ri riypa kha huv ung cate nama ripa singna bie tie kha naa i thlie tli.
A phasa pata naa ica thlie yi, cuorasala Job bie kha palie pata a tepa pakha hmuo aw va ung ciy.
Caacuonakawta, ‘Ma sing ta khah ung; cawsaa ta cuo li pata Khazing na kha ama kha a pachung aa.
Ama ta bie kha kama'a lie a ri pata cuo vyi, niema ta nama paliepa haata zaw palie'a va ang.
“Iema ca ama nang ta uo te a palie vie khupa aw va yi; kaa kha hmuo ama ri riypa aw vyi.
Ri riypa ama hnyi li nakawta ryi li pata ma i aw thluo aa? A daa thluo yi te ama palie li nakawta ryi li pata ma i aw thluo aa?
Kama zaw i palie ra aa; kama zaw i ruenapa kha i ri ra aa.
Tahematapakieca ri riypa na a hluvsa i hnyi; i chunglie thlaapa na ri riypata naa hripuo.
I palung ca pyana khue a huvpa mingsuvtiy haata cuo te, a pachi'a nangpa savang ungchuo haa tana a cuo.
I thaa duo vie riypata i ri aa, I pakaa kha uo'a angte i palie aa.
Ahung'a luo hmuo a kuo ta a daa'a va ang, ahunghmuo patapaluo'a va ang.
Tahematapakieca patapaluo kha the lipa angta, naa Satuv ta i hringna kha a pachuo sa paluo pathlyi aa.
“Cuorasala ata hing ca, Vya Job, i bie kha thyi tie, i bie bangkhuo hing naathlie tie.
Mang tie, i pakaa uo angte, bie i ri.
I bie ta i pathiypalung aa hmuopa kha a paluo sa, i palyi ta aa hmuopa a ripa kha a pachang.
Thlaapa ta kama kha na sa te, Lesyice huv ta kama kha hringna ina pi.
Ina palie khu ca kieca na palie tie, i hmiekunglie hing na bie ca aa hmuosa pata patluo la adaahmang la tie.
Mang tie, Khazing hmiekunglie hing nama haa tana i cuo ra, kama zaw hing alyi taata tuepa tana i cuo ra.
Ina ciy nakaw ca ta na thlaa zang khah se; i ripa hing na cunglie hmangriy ta cuo'a vyi.
“I thyina lieta na ri diy mangtli, na bie kha i thyi diy mangtli.
Nama ta, ‘I pathe, tuesuena hnyi va ang, na ta; i pathe, i chunglie suena aw vyi, na ta.
Mang tie, Khazing ta kama pasue thena riypa kha huv te, a carie lieta ina pasuvpuo.
I phyi kha hrakyi khe te, i luopuv bangkhuo lie kha ina mangpathliy,’ na ta.
“Cuorasala capa lie ca a hmuo vaciy. Ica palie aa: Khazing ca cawsaa laata a le vie.
‘I bie hing suokha hmuo na palie'a vyi,’ ta pata tuokhaatama Khazing ca na pasue khu aa.
Tahematapakieca Khazing ca luo kha ri te, cawsaa ta ama pasie li kieca luo hning a ri.
Cawsaa zaw amaa hmung chung hne ama iehmang lie ama tluv chung khata muo chunglie, hne muocuo chunglieta a ri.
Cakhutaata ama naa kha pahawpa yi te, a raaringna pi yi te ama thlaa a pazang yi.
Ama tuepa hmang kha amaa palise riypa hne, ahruo ama tle li riypata a cuo.
Ama hringna kha Khue chung luo tla li riypata hne, thiyna Cavaa va te riypa taata a khuo yi.
Ama ke pasana taata hne ruv ryi byalyana ta zaw pasiypa-ya pata ama cuo.
Caacuonakawta viechuo kha ning khing lipa yi ta, ama pakaa lie sa pahuo vyi.
Ama thiysaa ca zuekari te, ama ruv kha aa capy diy.
Ama thlaapa ca Khue chung luo kha vuotaa pha te, ama hringna ca thiyna a phyatuv tie'a luo kha vuotaa a chiy.
Cakhutaata, avuoming pakha, thawkha lieta pakha ca arena a satuv aw te, cawsaa pakha a phana kaw a rituv a aw.
Ama ta capa cawsaa ca tlechuo te, ‘Hingpa cawsaa hing Khue chung luo tlana taata khuo tie; aa thlana muo ca i hmung tli;
a thiysaa ca mingnu thiysaa lu sala; a cahra liyciy ning haa khata cuo pakhaa se,’ a ta.
Cakhutaata Khazing'a luo kha thlaachuo te, cuhluo pata a cuo; alawna hne a hmiekung luo kha papha sa te, Khazing ta aa dangna cuo khata a muo a pi pakhaa.
Capa cawsaa ca ta a hrangpa tie'a lie kha hlaa sa te, ‘Sue tli angte, aa hmuopa kha a pali a pahnaa ta i tue tli, cuo ra sala thung pakhaa pata cuo va ang.
Ama ta Khue luo tla riypa taa khata na khuo te, i hringna ta khena a hmung aa,’ a ta.
“Khazing ta cawsaa cunglie kha hingpa bangkhuo hing yi hning yi thung a tue sasaw,
iema hringna ta khena a hmung riypata Khue chungtaata thue pakhaa riypata a cuo.
Vya Job, na naa pacung la, i bie hing naathlie tie; a dieta tah aw la, kama ta ri'a ang.
Ri riypa suokhakha na hnyi kieca na palie tie; ri tie, tahematapakieca nama na ica paduo khing.
Cata a cuo li kieca, na naathlie tie; a dieta tah aw la singna kha ca chang'a ang,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Elihu ta pazue te a ri:
“I bie hing thyi tie ung, niema mingsing tie, na naathlie tie ung, a pachangpa zaw;
tahematapakieca pakaa ta sa kha aa pacuopa haata, naa ta bie kha a dyapasya taw.
Aa hmuopa kha a tlaw'a ung puv; kiema hingta khaapama a pha tapa kha bie chi'a ung puv.
Tahematapakieca Job ta, ‘Kama ca suena hnyi va ang, Khazing na i dangna kha naa lapa;
aa dangpa i cuo thluo pata a hangpa ta pasuvpa i cuo; tuesuena i hnyi li raalaa pata i hmaa ca patluo khu'a pata cuo vyi,’ a ta.
Job haapa cawsaa ahungma a aw aa? Bie pha lipa kha tiy dang ta a dangpa,
hmang pha lipa a tuepa tie hneta a khe te, a pha lipa tie hneta a cakuo pakhawpa ta cuo va ma?
Tahematapakieca Khazing cunglie a lawpa hingta thlahnena suokha hmuo hnyi vyi a ta.
“Caacuonakawta, na thyi tie ung, niema pachangna a hnyipa tie, pha lina ca Khazing hneta a hla sala, Lesyice ca pha lina tuena taata a hla se.
Tahematapakieca cawsaa kha ama tuena haata a thung'a yi, ama hringzya haa khata ama cunglie a patlung aa.
Hmisi ta ripa kieca, Khazing ca pha lina kha tue'a vyi, Lesyice ta biedangpa kha a pali a pahnaa ta tue'a vyi.
Ahungma ama ca alyi hing mangchiy riypata bie pi te, a cunglieta chuelyi hing a khang?
A thlaapa kha ama'a luo la pakhaa te, a huv kha ama'a luo a ku pakhaa kieca,
saapa bangkhuo ca ra pakhaw diy'a yi te, cawsaa bangkhuo ca alyi diypa luona ama kaa aa.
“Pachangna na hnyi kieca, hingpa hing thyi tie; i ripa hing naathlie tie.
Biedangpa a huepa ca uvtuv a cuo khu buo'a ma? Aa dangpa hne a lesyipa kha na ripachie khu'a ma?
Ahungma siepahruo kha, ‘Thlahnena a hnyi lipa!’ a ta khu aa? Ahungma byi tie kha, ‘Cawsaa pha lipa tana nama cuo,’ a ta khu aa?
Ama ca byi tie'a lie kha hmiemang parung vyi, siypasa laata a hnyirungpa hmie kha mang vie hlyi vyi.
Cawsaa ca sungkhata lieta ama thiy; zuocang ta siy yi te ama thiy, a cahrapa tie zaw cawsaa kuv ta cuo li pata ama thiy.
“Tahematapakieca a ming ca cawsaa cunglie kha aw te, ama kyi hliypa bangkhuo kha a hmung diy.
Hmang pha lipa a tuepa tie amaa nuna riypata, thiyna ningdiy hne zingna aw vyi.
Bieripana luo kha Khazing hmielieta si riypata ahung cuota hmuo ting paciepa cuo aw vyi.
A cahrapa tie kha ama cuona pachang a zue li pata para yi te, iema hmang lie kha malie a chi yi.
Cahaacata ama hriepa kha pachang te, zuo khata a palichiy yi te, dechipatlaa pata ama cuo.
Ama pha li nakawta malie hmungna lie kha a tuv yi.
Ama kha ziy lipa yi ta amaa palise nakawta hne, a luopuv kha siysaa ama ri li nakawta,
siypasa tie khina ueryi kha ama'a luo papha sa yi te, tuechiepa tie khina ueryi kha a thyi.
A dieta tah a aw tiyta ahungma a kawchie a ri khu aa? Amingphang ta cuose, pakha cyicuo ta cuose, a hmie kha a nu tiyta ahungma a hmie a hmung khu aa?
Caacuonakawta Khazing a pachang lipa ca siepahruo cuo buo'a vyi, cawsaa kha cyihyi a thla khuopa ca byi cuo khu'a vyi.
“Caacuonakawta pakhakha ta Khazing kha, ‘Duotena na i ang tli; pha lina kha tue'a va tli ang;
I hmung lipa kha na pacuv tie; pha lina kha i tue kieca, ning hrang thue tue'a va tli ang,’ a ta the'a ma?
Ama kha na thaw nakawta, aca thung riypata a tla thluo va ca ma? Tahematapakieca kama cuo li pata nama na a tlaw'a ciy; caacuonakawta na pachangpa kha ri tie.
Pachangna a hnyipa ta kama'a lie hing ri se, naa thyipa a singpa ta ri se,
‘Job ta pachangna hnyi li pata a ri, a bie hing rue ciemuo riypa aw vyi,’ a ta.
A bie paliena ca a pha lipa tie bie haata a cuo nakawta, Job ca a dena te cadepa cuo se.
Tahematapakieca a suena liena riethuna a chachiy; kiema hrawlie a kuv cabe te, Khazing thuopachina bie kha a hluvsa a ri,” a ta.
Elihu ta a bie kha pazue te:
“Capa ca aa dang thlu aa na ta ma? ‘Khazing hmiekunglie i hmuo,’ na tapa hing.
Nama ta, ‘Khaapa thlahnena ma i hmung? za sue thluo ang sala ata hing capa laa cata thlahnena i hmung vie riypa a aw'a ma?’ na ta.
Nama hne nama'a lie a awpa na viesaa hne khata ica palie'a yi.
Avuo khiy mang la rue tie; nama laata aa suo viena lie a awpa amyi kaw khiy rue tie.
Na sue zawta ama kha tuokhaata na tue khu hlyi ma? Na tuesuena a hluvsa zawta ama kha tuokhaata na tue khu hlyi ma?
Naa dang zawta ama kha khaapama na pi khu? Nama kuv taata khaapama a hmung?
Na pha lina hing ta nama haapa cawsaa tie kha a para khu yi, naa dangna zawta cawsaa hrangpa dyi hing na a thlahne yi.
“Tuechiena a hluv tuv nakawta cawsaa ca ama khi ama u; a cahrapa tie buo kawlieta byana ama hie.
Cuorasala ahungtahmuo, ‘Naa satuv Khazing, zuo ta thaazuo naa pituv,
alyi lie saruopa tie laata a hluv vie ta malie a pacuvtuv, avuo lie pavaa laata a sing vie ta malie a satuv ca khaapaliema a aw?’ ta va yi.
Capa lie ca ama khi, cuorasala pha lina a tuepa tie ahruo ama tle nakawta palie va yi.
Khazing ta khi cakhawna ca thyi li pata, Lesyice ta siysaa ri vyi.
Ama ca hmung va ang na ta tiyta, na cuota pha hryly vyi; na bie ca a hmiekung luo a chiy nakawta, ama kha huo thluo tie.
Ata hing, a hihaana ta duote vyi, tuesuena zaw kha aa cake ciemuo li nakawta,
Job ca bie laliy lipa ri riypata a pakaa uo te, pachangna a cake lipa bie kha a hluvsa a ri,” a ta.
Elihu ta pazue te a ri:
“A cawta na ang caw la ca pahmung'a ang, tahematapakieca Khazing cuopa tana i ri khingpa a aw.
Luohlaa taa tana i pachangna kha i vya chiykhyi aa, naa satuv Khazing adangna khana i ri aa.
Tahematapakieca i bie hing hangbie ta cuo vyi, pachangna lie tlingna a hnyipa ca nama'a liena a aw.
“Khazing ca cahra te mang khing lipa hnyi vyi; ama ca pachangna lie kha a thaa a cahra.
Ama ca a pha lipa tie kha pahring va yi, cuorasala riethyivuosuopa tie kha cuvu a pi yi.
Siypasa tie kha siysaa ri li pata aw va yi, cuorasala byithude cunglie siepahruo tie ca ama ta chuozaa ta chi yi te, pathuosa pata ama cuo.
Iema ca hrakyi khe yi te, riethyivuosuona khuhriy ta cakhiypa ama cuo kieca,
cakhutaa cata ama tuepa hne ama tuesuena kha iema'a lie a phu.
A pacuvna kha naa pathlie sa yi te, ama pha lina taata vya kaa riypata naw a pi yi.
Iema ta naathlie yi te a re kha ama hrie kieca, ama ningcuo zaw kha hnyirungna hne anuona chunglieta ama a chuona te ama hmuo.
Cuorasala ama naathlie li kieca zueziy ta puo'a yi te, pachang lina kawlieta ama thiy aa.
“Khazing a pachang lipa ta ca hihaana kha a chunglie aa ziy; iema kha a ciypaki tiy yi ta byana a hie khing va yi.
Ama kung panuta ningta thiy yi te, ama hringna ca nangzaana hneta a chuo.
Ama ta riethyivuosuopa tie kha ama angpa riethyivuosuona taata khuo yi te, ruvnaana ta ama naa kha a pavuo sa yi.
Nama kha palungriethyina taata a ese pachaana a aw lina chung luo acaa chiy.
“Cuorasala pha lina hmang kha na palung lie a aw kieca, bieripana hne biedangpa na nama kha caa patuv.
Hihaana ta esena chung luo aca dungle lipa kha pachang la, a lesyipa athlana ta acaa maase li riypata aw tie.
Na khina hne na thaa cahrana zawta, na palungriethyina kha a pakhuo khu'a ma?
Cawsaa zaw ama awna hmang lie thie pata ama cuonapa zuo kha vuo khah.
Maw lie ciy! Pha lina luo kha a pali khah; riethyivuosuona na caa patuv aa.
Mang tie, Khazing ca a cahrana chungliena cyicalang pata a cuo; ahungma ama haata pacuvtuv a cuo?
Ahungma a luopuv kha a chang khu? Ahungma, ‘A cuo lipa na na tue,’ a ta khu?
“Cawsaa ta hlaa ta ama pathuosapa a re ca pathuosa maw lie ciy.
Cawsaa bangkhuo ta ama kha mang yi te, cawsaa ta luohlaapuv taata ama suo.
Khazing ca a lesyi hmisi, ama kha pachang khu vapuv; a kung khazaa ma a ta tapa kha ri khu vapuv.
Tiydiy zaw kha cungluo a da te, amyi ca khy ta a pasaa sa.
Capa ca avuo ta za lyi te, cawsaa zaw cung luo kha a hluvsa ta a zaa saa.
Ahungma amyi aa zupa hne khalung aa thypa khiy a pachang khu?
Mang tie, ama ta a cahriylie kha khena pathlie te, riyliy thabaw kha a buv diy.
Cahaacata cawsaa kha uv yi te, sa a hluvsa a pi yi.
A kuv ta thinghlaa kha patuv te, cuokaa kha khe riypata naw a pi.
A khalung pu cata ama kaw kha malie chang te, hietliena hneta pha lina cunglie hihaana a hnyipa tana a cuo.
“Hingpa zaw hingta i palung kha cathang sa te, a cathlu ta aa cathlu.
Naathlie tie, khalung pu haata a pakaa taata a pyapa ueryi ca naathlie tie.
Avuo raw bangkhuo khata pathlie te, a thinghlaa ca alyi kiy ting khata a pha.
Cakhutaata a ueryi ca a hrung ta aa hrung, a lesyina ueryi ca khalung haata a thy te, a ueryi aa thyi ningta ca thinghlaa kha a cawta hehmuo die vyi.
Khazing ta a ueryi ta khalung a pathy sa; kiema ta ma pachang khu lipa hmang lepa kha a tue.
Tahematapakieca cahue kha alyi cung luo tla la a ta, cakhutaata khy kha khuopuv ta a pasaa sa.
A sapa bangkhuo ta ama kha ama pachang riypata, cawsaa kuv kha re hrie li pata a pa-aw sa.
Cakhutaata saruopa tie ca amaa buna luo kha cakuo yi te, ama khue lie kha ama aw thluo.
Sungluo a awna taata thliychie a kya hruo te,
Khazing huv ta cahue kha pa-aw sa te, tiy kupuv ca a catlisa pata aa kaa.
Amyi chaasapa ca a chung luo tiy raw te, amyi ca ta hmangting lie kha thinghlaa a cakang sa.
Aw khuna chuelyi cunglie hing, ma ta naw a pipa bangkhuo kha tue khu riypata, ama luochiyna ta amaa pahie pari.
Pasiypa-ya riypata ma, acuolikie a ruo cuota ma, acuolikie duena cuota ma, ama ta capa ca a pa-aw sa.
“Vya Job, hingpa hing thyi tie; a daa caw la, nang-uo aa chiypa, Khazing hmang tuepa hing pacuo syalya tie.
Iema cunglie Khazing ta naw pi yi te, amyi chungtaata thinghlaa a cakang sapa kha na pachang ma?
Amyi ca tuokhaatama aa desa pata aa zu tapa kha na pachang ma? A thena a tlingpa paa kharuehaa aa chiypa a rehriena hing na pachang ma?
Sungluo thliy aa kya hruo tiyta, alyi ca paling te na mathle dyi aca lyipa kha na pachang ma?
Ama haata avuo khiy na pake khu ma? A tiy ta patlepa thlaluo haata a cuopa kaw khiy na pachang khu ma?
Ama'a luo kha tuokhaatama ma ri aa tapa ca malie pacuv tie; ma chung ta zing te ri riypa pachang vapuv.
I ri khingpa hing Khazing chang taa aa hu ma? Khazing ta a para khingna te ta a ngaapa ama aw'a ma?
Thliy ta amyi khiy phya diy te, avuo a khesa ning khiy, ahungtahmuo mang khu vyi.
Chaluo taata siy haapa khena za pya te, Khazing ca ciy aa chiypa lesyina ta a bi.
Lesyice ca kiema ta hmung khu vapuv; ama ca a lesyipa, cahrana hne biedangpa lie hne, adangna lieta kharuehaa aa chiypa cuo te, ahung kha hmuo tuechie vyi.
Caacuonakawta cawsaa ta ama kha ama ciy; ama hne ama i sing a tapa tie kha siysaa ri va yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipata thliysung chungtaata Job kha a palie:
“Pachangna a aw lipa bie ri te singna ta ruena pipa a ngie lipa hing ahungtama a cuo?
Na sesie a saw la capaa haata aw tie, bie ca hiehriy'a angte ina palie'a ciy.
“Chuelyi hruopatu i za sa ning kha khaapaliema na aw? na pachang pata a cuo kie na chang tie.
Kha tie ta cuo se tapa kha ahungma a thli tapa na pachang ma? Acuolikie taanapa khuhriy kha ahungma a cunglie a riy?
Chuelyi a kya dupa atung tie hing khaapaliema a thla? Acuolikie ahungma ingkiylung hing a pathla?
Mawdiy aasiy tie ta hmangkha ta hlaa sa yi te, avuoming bangkhuo ta alawna hne ama khi ning kha.
“Acuolikie alyi chungtaata riyliy tiy a kya phuv pathla ning hing, riyliy chunglie ingchiypakaa hing ahungma a khaa?
Riyliy ca amyi pabuv angte, a chaapa zingna ta i pahlaw ning kha,
a ruoriy kha sapa angte, ingchiypakaa hne a hrena kha chi yi angte,
‘Hingpa te hingna naa vaw aa, a vaw vie'a va tli ciy, hingpa lie hingna na hruotlena tiylaw ca a chuo aa,’ i ta.
“Na chuo aa patha baataata mawdiy hing naw na pi buo ma? Mawdiy ca a hmang aa pachang riypata na pahmung buo ma?
Alyi kha a tluo ta patuv te a pha lipa kha a thypathla riypata na chang buo ma?
Acyi ca ming khenapa ta a cungpa a cuo tiyta a cunglie a hnie aa hnangpa haata hne, pang kadiypa haata alyi ca acuona kha a siesa pata aa luo.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie khena ca viele te, ama calangpa buo zaw kha a tli.
“Riyliy a hnaa luo kha naa ngie buo ma? aa thuvna hmang luo haw na chiy buo ma?
Thiyna thlake zaw kha nama'a lie paluo sapa a cuo tli ma? acuolikie aa thuvpa zingna thlake kha na hmung buo ma?
Alyi a kuna hing na pachang ma? Hingpa zaw bangkhuo hing na pachang kie ri tie.
“Khaapaliema khena luo sina luopuv hing a aw? Zingna hmang hing haw khaapaliema a cuo?
Nama ta iema ca ama ruo luo na sikhyi khu'a yi ma? Ama ing luo sina luopuv kha na pachangpasie ma?
Na pachang ngiethie thlu aa, tahematapakieca capa hluo ca ta na puv tlipa kha, na chuo ca a pasiy hringhruo tli hing haw!
“Cahue pacungna khuo chung luo hing naa ngie buo ma? Ari pachungna khuo hing na hmung buo ma?
Capa ca ruvna ning cuota i pacungpa cuo yi te, a duna cuo hne a tuvna cuo tie huota i chipa tana ama cuo.
Khaapa luo taata ma khena ca hmangting luo pi pata a cuo? Khaapa taata ma ningchiy thliy hing alyi cunglie aa ze diy?
“Ahungma khytiy hing tiyluopuv a sapa? Ahungma pacihaa luopuv hing a sapa?
Cawsaa ama aw lina ruo lie khy pasaa sa riypata hne, cawsaa aw lina viehnangruo lie khy pasaa sa riypa cuose,
ruo utlawpa hne ruo duothlingpa lie kha aphuv panuta papu sa riypa hne, alyi caapa taata aphuv hringpa papu sa riypa hing ahungma a tue?
“Khytiy hing ta paa a hnyi ma? Acuolikie aduotiy hing haw ahungma a sa?
Ahung riy chungtaata ma avuo taata zaa tlapa cahue hing a puv?
Tiy ca alung haata cuokaraw te, riyliy cunglie ca cahue aa kaa.
“Aasiythetluo khiy na ciy paki khu'a yi ma? aasiycaruv khiy haw na pathluo khu'a ma?
Aasiy kha ama'a na a cuota tah pya riypata na chang khu'a yi ma? Kawracungnung hne a saata zaw kha luo na pahmung sa khu'a yi ma?
Avuo ziyphung zaw khiy na pachang ma? Alyi cunglie ama phung hing na pacu sa khu'a ma?
“Khuosa ta khy saa te khytiy ta nama aca vya riypata, amyi khiy bie na kya pi khu'a ma?
‘Hingpa lie hingna ma aw,’ aca ta the riypa yi ta, thinghlaa khiy na pathlie khu'a ma?
Ma pangpa chunglie singna a chipa hing ahungtama a cuo? Pathiypalung chunglie pachangna a pituv hing ahungtama a cuo?
Amyi khiy ri khu riypa singna ahungma a hnyi?
Alyi diyta kha a pahlung te alyi hlaw zaw kha aa patuv tiyta, vuoruo tiy ungthyi tie khiy ahungma zaa lyi khu?
“Chingdepuvnung cuota saa na huvpa khu ma? Acuolikie chingdetaata zaw kha ama riy na pabi khu yi ma?
Ama khue chunglieta amaa bu ning hne, ruohraw lie a nu yi te saa ama bya ning kha, saa huvpa yi cate ama riy na pabi khu yi ma?
Ra-aa ca a taata zaw sa vuota Khazing'a luo ama khi tiyta, ahungma sa a pi yi?
“Tluo cung sathaa zaw ama pachuona cuo kha na pachang ma? Sasuv zaw ama pachuopa kha na hmung buo ma?
Khacuo chung na ama vang tapa hne, ama pachuo cuo kha na pachang ma?
Khatiy ta a puvnung a bu te ma, a taata pachuo te a za pya tapa kha na pachang ma?
Ama taata ca kya cahra yi te ruo lie kha ama le, sile yi te iema'a luo kha kaa pakhaa va tli yi.
“Ruo laa kha a khing ta a pasi sapa ca ahungtama a cuo? ruo laa kha ahungma a khing ta a pathlie?
Ruo utlawpa a kusapa kha a ing riypata pi angte, paciy pyana ruo kha a awna hmang ta i pi.
Khypuv lie paringpasupa ueryi kha a re li pata,
tluothlue lie kha tle yi te, a hringpa kung hne hnaa bangkhuo kha ama huv.
“Calie ta na re a hrie khing'a ma? Na sahring ing lie aa ri khing'a ma?
Khuhriy ta pa-uo pata le na pathaw sa khu'a ma? Acuolikie na hnang paziy pata bawphie lie le na pathaw sa khu'a ma?
A thaa a ruv nakawta naa buchuo the'a ma? Na re kha a kuv luo na pi khu'a ma?
Ama ca vya kaa'a te na naa vuo lie sa kha a vya phya aa ta pata na zang ma?
“Kala-uv pavaa ca a mathlaa lie a hming a hluv li raalaa pata, hruotlesa pata ama thlaa a thy.
Alyi ta palung sa naase ta pata, a tiy kha alyi lie a thuse yi.
Phyi ta tlawchi'a kie tapa hne, ruosaa ta chaachi'a kie yi tapa kha a maw.
A taata zaw kha ama taata li haata, aa hruosa pata a tuv a de yi.
Tahematapakieca Khazing ta ama ca singna pi li pata, pachangna kha chebuo vyi.
Cuorasala a ruo riypata a mathlaa kha a pake tiyta, aruo hne a khangtuv kha hmuo a pahnyisue yi.
“Aruo a cahrana hing nama ma a pi ciy? A ruetung lie a bung hming hing nama ma a papuv sa ciy?
Nama ma khawbyapa haata a cathlu sa ciy? A hmya a tungpa pu ca ciy na aa chiy.
A caki ta alyi kha hue te, a palung a tluo, cehre hne a taw riypa khata a pya.
Ciyna kha pahnyisue thluo te, a palung chuo vyi; zueziy kha cahriy vyi.
A cunglieta lavaabya kha a pakhawle te, asyi hne asyipuv ca aa lile.
Hmyakaa pu a thyi tiyta, palung pyana hne hihaana hneta hmieluo kha a ruo te, a hmyakhe riy ta patuv khu aw va tli.
Hmyakaa pu a paring tiyta a hnaa tung te, riekabyipa nawpina ueryi hne ama khina kha thyi te, rietuvna rang zaw kha luohlaapuv taata a thyi khu.
“Pahmung ta cungluo aa zuthawpa hne, a mathlaa pake te sungluo ta aa zubungpa hing, nama singna thueta a cuo ma?
Hmungthlu ta cungluo a zuthaw te, aa suona lie buv aa tuepa hing nama ma naw a pi ciy?
Alung cunglie hne lungkuo daw lie aw te khy a sa.
Capa taa cata a la riypa kha a paruv ta mang te, luohlaapuv taa khata a ming ta a hmung khu.
A taata zaw ca thiyse kha pazaw the yi te, saa thiypa awna lie kha capa pavaa ca a aw the,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Job kyihuo khata:
“Malie suena a huvpa ta Lesyice hing aa zue the'a ma? Khazing hne bie a ipa hingta palie se” a ta.
Cakhutaata Job ta Abyipakha a palie:
“Mang tie, Kama ca siysaa ri tluo aa tlapa cuo va ang; khaapama ica palie aa? I kuv tana i pakaa kha i cahuv.
Yi kha ri tli angte, ri pakhaa'a va tli ang; yi hning i ri tli hing, ri pazue'a va tli ang.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Job kha thliysung chungtaata a palie:
“Na se kha a saw la capaa haata a daa tie, bie ca hiehriy'a angte ina palie'a ciy.
Kama hmisi hing ma aa dang lipa ta ina chi'a ciy? Nama duo a pacu riypata ma kama pali sue ina phaw'a ciy?
Khazing kuv haapa kuv na hnyi ma? Ama ueryi haata khalung a thy ta naa thy khu'a ma?
“Lesyina hne linghlaa kha a hryi la, rungnaana hne raarung awna kha a hryi tie.
Na hihaana kha paluo sa la, a hruotlepa tie bangkhuo kha mang yi la, araw luo pachung tie yi.
A hruotlepa tie bangkhuo kha mang yi la aa ne luo pachung tie yi, cawsaa pha lipa tie ca amaa daana hmang lie kha chaapuo tie yi.
Buvcing khuv lie kha suv kha ta nu yi la, ama hmie kha alyi rawlie khuv khaakhung tie yi.
Cakhutaata na cacuoluo kuv na tena caa pi tapa kha kama zaw ta ica pachang aa.
“Behemoth kha mang tie, nama ica tuepa haa tana i tue ra; ama ca cuetungpa haa tana aphuv kha a baa.
A sesie lieta a thaa kha aw te, a cahrana ca a pawpya saa lie khata a aw.
A lahmyi kha sidar thing haata cu te, a baw thaa ca a camaa tana aa camaa pakhaw.
A ruv ca daa sung haata cuo te, a ruv phiephiepa ca thaa haa tana a cuo.
“Khazing ta a tuepa hrawlieta a pakhana ta cuo te, ama a satuv kyalya na zueziy ta a vaachiy nguo.
Tahematapakieca saruopa bangkhuo ama cangnapa, tluo zaw ta ama cuota sa ama papya.
Tiy-angpaa kung rawlie kha a bu te, phiepahlaa kung rawlie hne acaa lie kha aa nu.
Tiy-angpaa kung ta ningdiy padiy te, cavaata paasung kung ta ama cadung.
Cavaa tiy a za le zawta a thlaa zang vyi, Jordan cavaa ta a pakaa te a chiy zawta a duv tana a aw thluo.
Kyipa ta a siy khupa ahung chuo ama aw ma? cyihyi ta a hnacabuv a pala sa khupa ahungma a aw yi?
“Leviathan parapuv kha kyipa ta naa da khu'a ma? Acuolikie a palyi kha khuhriy ta na cakhiy khu'a ma?
A hnacabuv kha hnaaphaa na vaa khu'a ma? Acuolikie a hrakuo kha kyipa ta na cathiy pahaw khu'a ma?
Ama ta nama kha paa aca kie'a ma? Bienepa ta aca chaw'a ma?
Ama ta chuozaa ta na sii cuo riypata nama hneta biekuona a tue'a ma?
Pavaa haata na cangkhyi khu'a ma? Acuolikie na canungsaata zaw cuota na hre khu'a ma?
Sung a palipa tie ta ama kha amaa chuv'a ma? Chadaw tie ta ama kha a che'a yi te amaa re'a ma?
A vang ca asyi ta na dawpahaw khu'a ma? A luv ca ngaa patuvnapa asyi ta na dawpahaw khu'a ma?
A cunglie kha na kuv khang pachiy; namaa tuv riypa kha rue tie; tue pakhaa khing'a va tli ciy.
Ama patuv a tingpa ca palung chuo na a chiysa, ama hmungna lie ca khazing tie hmuota ama kharue haa va ma?
Ama pasu riypata ca ahungtahmuo a nguo vyi. A hmiekunglie ahungma a daa nguo aa?
Vuoruotyi lie hing ama a du pata aa bangpa ahungma a aw aa?
“A kuv-phyi kawlie cuose, a thaaruvna kawlie cuose, a pangruepa kawlie cuose ri li pata aw khu'a va ang.
Ahungma a pang cungpakaw kha a haw nguo aa? A rieka caw thang hning kha ahungma a dawpahaw nguo aa?
Ahungma a hmie ingchiypakaa kha a pahaw nguo aa? A haa tluo ca ciy na a chiy hringhruo.
A ke ca a tluo ta aa patluopa phya ta tuepa, aa cadisa pata pabepuopa na a lu.
Suokha hne suokha ca aa ngiesa nakawta, aa lalalieta thliy hmuo a ngie khu vyi.
Suokha hne suokha a pazue te, aa cakhiypuo nakawta che khu aw vyi.
A hachy tiyta khena a kya pya, a ming ca mawdiy khena haa tana a cuo.
A pakaa taata a taw a taw ta myi iepa pya te, myihliy kha aa pi pathla.
Aa tla nguoluopa bi chungtaata tiykhuv haata hne, a kuo nguoluopa myi chungtaata myikhuv haata a hnacabuv taata myikhuv a pya.
A huv ta alung myihyi kha pa-ie khu te, a pakaa taata myihlaa a pya.
A ruekatung lie cahrana aw te, ciyna ca a hmiekunglie kha a luo.
A saa ca a hlie a hlie ta a cataw te,
A palung ca alung haata cuo te, sacuo riena a rawluo pachuopa alung haa tana a cuo.
Ama na a thu tli tapa kieca khazing tie hmuota ama ciy, a lahmyi a ti kieca awna'apa pachang va yi.
Zueziy ta a va pha zawta a thlahnena aw vyi, asyi, asyi pachangta hne asyipuv zaw a thlahnena aw vyi.
Ama ta thaa ca sacuokung tluv dyi ta ri te, daa ca thing hmupa tluv dyi tana a ri.
Cuoti ta ama kha paruo khu vyi; alung cyicuo ca ama cuota ca savie haa tana a cuo.
Tungbung ca phiepahlaa kung tluv dyi ta ri te, asyipuv aa vya zupa pu ca a pahnyisue hyalya.
A rawluo ca bi kyinapa a cahrepa haata cuo te, sa a hluonapa khunglung haata caakaw lie ca aa thiyle.
Tiy aa thuvpa ca bi haata patla sa te, riyliy ca ziyhmyi bi haata a tue.
A sile tiyta a hnangluo ta tiylaw khepa kha thuse te, riyliy ca suo paapa haata ri riypa tana a cuo.
Alyi lie hing ama tluvpa ahunghmuo aw va yi, ciyna a hnyi lipa tana a cuo.
Aa palepa bangkhuo kha siysaa ri lipa yi ta, ahruo a tlepa bangkhuo tie cunglie siepahruo ta a cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Job ta Khazingkha a palie:
“Nama ca hmangting zawdya na tue khu tapa kha i pachang, na tingpa bangkhuo ca a daakhuo khu aw vyi.
‘Singna hnyi li pata ruena a parapa ca ahungtama a cuo?' Caacuonakawta i pachang lipa, i cuota kharuehaa aa chiypa kha i ri.
‘Naathlie tie, kama na a ri'a ang; bie ca hiehriy'a angte ina palie'a ciy.'
Nama ca i naa dyi tana ica za thyi, cuorasala ata hing ca i ming tana ica hmungpuo tli.
Caacuonakawta kama hne kama kha a duv angte, buvcing hne buvcuo chunglie a tu angte i ngiepachiy,” a ta.

Abyipata Job kyihuo ta hingpa bie hing a ri khutaata, Abyipata Teman ming Elifaz kyihuo khata: “I hihaana ca nama hne na viesaa pahning tie cunglie kha a ie ta a ie; tahematapakieca i changtaapa Job ta ina changpa haata kama kha aa hmuopa bie na chang va ung ciy.

Caacuonakawta ata hingta cuetungpa sasariy hne tuvtungpa sasariy kha a la ung la Job'a luo kha cakuo tie ung, myirue panaana ta hriykhung a ri ung la Job ta thlaa ca chuopa yi se, tahematapakieca i changtaapa Job ta kama kawlie biedangpa a ripa haata niema ta nama ri li nakawta nama ngaanapa haata nama cunglie i tue li riypata ama thlaachuona ca i cuhluo aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Teman ming Elifaz hne Shuh ming Bildad hne Naamath ming Zofar ca vaa yi te Abyipata a changpa haa yi khata ama tue; cakhutaata Abyipata Job thlaachuona kha a cuhluo.
Job ta a viesaa zaw cuota thlaa a chuo khutaata Abyipata Job ca a vuophana kha a pi pakhaa; Abyipata ahluo ta a hnyipa le hning ta a pi.

Cakhutaata a uvnu hne a sieta zaw bangkhuo hne ahluo ta zaa pachangpa bangkhuo kha ama'a luo ca a vaw yi te, a ing lie kha sa ama ning pakhaw; cakhutaata Abyipata a cunglie pha lina a patlung sapa bangkhuo kawlie kha kawpacuona paluo sa yi te a hnaanguona ama ri; cakhutaata pakha cyicuo khata tuokaa pie kha kaluo hne siy kuvpahryi suokha kaluo ama pi.
Abyipata Job ca a chuo hnanghnangluo kha a chuo aa thunaluo laata thluechiy a hluv vie ta pi te, tuv thawhraa hlyipaliy, kala-uv thawcaruv, cuetungpa tue thawkha, hne laapuvnung thawkha a pi.
Sacapaa pasariy hne sacanung pathung zaw a hnyi yi.
A pakhanapa kha Jemimah, a pahningnapa kha Keziah, hne a pathungnapa kha Keren-happuk ta pata ming a sa yi.
Alyicung kaakaapa lie Job sacanung zaw haata a puvthepa canung aw va yi; cakhutaata ama paa ta iema kha a sacapaa zaw hneta ru a pi ra yi.
Cakhutaata Job ca kung zakha kung sawliy hring te, a saata zaw, a saata zaw saata tie zaw kha chuo paliyna te ta a hmung yi.
Cakhutaata Job ca chuo tlungsa pata hne a macuosa pata a thiy.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ruena pipa kha ziy li pata, a suepa tie luo zaw kha ziy li pata, cawsaa siysaa a ri lipa tie a tuna lie a tu ra lipa ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo.
Ama palungtluona ca Abyipaphungbie lie kha cuo te, capa phungbie ca chungzuo ta ama pacuo byalya.
Iema ca cuo aa de tiyta a thyi pathyi te a hnaa aa uv buo lipa, cavaa kielie amaa lingpa thingkung haa tana ama cuo. Ama tuepa bangkhuo lie kha-aw ama taw.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ca cahaacata cuo va yi; cuorasala thliy ta a phyapa savie haa kha tana ama cuo.
Caacuonakawta cawsaa pha lipa tie ca bieripana lie a daa khu li'apa yi ta, a suepa tie zaw aa dangpa tie hrawlie aw ra the'a va yi.
Tahematapakieca aa dangpa tie luopuv ca Abyipata mangchiy te, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa tie luo ca a ra aa.
Khaapanakawma mingphang zaw ta a duna khue khuo yi te, thlahnena a hnyi lipa rawna khue kha ama khuo?
Ama siepahruo tie hne uvtuv tie ta, Abyipahne a sathu pathuvpa paa kha a du riypata, a hmya yi te khue ama khuo.
“Malie ama ciypakinapa khuhriy kha chipachung diy ung sala thaw ung siy,” amaa ta.
Vuoruo lie a tupa paa ca pahnyi te, Abyipata iema kha a pahnyisue yi.
Cakhutaata a hihaa pata iema'a lie kha bie ri'a te, a hihaa tuvna khata ama thlaa a pazang yi.
“I tluo pathepa Zion lie i siepahruo kha i patu tli,” a ta.
Abyiparipa bie khana i pathyi sa aa: Ama ta, “Nama ca i sacapaa tana na cuo, ataning hing nama ca ica sa mangtli.
Kama kha naa hie la, mingphang zaw kha ru ta ca pi'a angte, alyi dena te nama huopa tana a i pacuosa aa.
Iema kha thaa khuecahryi ta uv'a yi cate, alyi bi haata na dechi diy'a yi.”
Caacuonakawta siepahruo tie, singvaasa tie ung; chuelyi uvtuv tie zaw, a raaring tie ung.
Abyipare kha ciyzaana hneta hrie ung la, A cathangsapuo pata

a phyi thabaw lie kha a bu tie ung, caacuolikieca a hi haa'a te luopuv liena para pata nama cuo aa; tahematapakieca a hihaana ca a catlipa tana a ie. Ama'a lie a canawpa bangkhuo ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo.
VyaAbyipai carie hing khazi ulu ma a ta yi! A dawsaw li ta naa du yi te,
Cawsaa a hluvsa ta, “Ama hing ca Khazing ta a bya'a vyi,” ina ta.
CuorasalaAbyipanama ca i bangnapa phya ta cuo cate, i rungnaana hne i luv zaw naa cyicalangtuv tana na cuo.
Abyipa'aluo kha khuopuv ta khi angte, a tluo pathepa taata ina za chaw.
A zie angte i hmung; Abyipata ina pabang nakawta i cha pakhaa.
Naa cadungpa i carie a thaw hluvpuv kha ciy va yi ang.
Abyipakya thu tie! Vya Khazing na khuo tie! Tahematapakieca i carie tie bangkhuo kha ama be tung yi cate, cawsaa pha lipa tie haa kha na thli.
Khuona ca Abyipahuopa tana a cuo. Na cawsaa zaw cunglie thluechiy aw mang sue!
Vya kama i dangnapa Khazing, ica ku tiyta na chaw tie! Ruvnaana chunglie i aw ningta hya ina pazang ciy. Ngie na chi la i thlaachuona hing na naathlie tie.
Cawsaa zaw, khacuo te khiy ma i ling ina pazue'a ung ciy? Kha tiy te khiy ma thlahnena a hnyi lipa bie hing tlechuo'a ung cate hangna bie hnang kha nama paziy kalie aa?
CuorasalaAbyipata ama cuota zang tluo aa tlapa tie aa chi pathlyipa yi kha pachang tie ung; i u tiyta, Abyipata ina thyi.
Nama hi a haa tiyta suena tue khah ung; namaa ziena cunglie kha pacuo syalya ung la a dieta tah aw tie ung.
Abyipaca aa hmuopa hriykhungrina kha pihluo ung la, ama ca a ringchuo tie ung.
Cawsaa hluvpuv ta, “Hmang phapa hmung se pala a pha'a pakha! Vya Abyipa,na hmie ling ca kiema'a luo za khe thi se!” ama ta.
Sa hne mingsuvtiy hnyisa yi te ama palung a tluopa tie laata i palung ina patluo vie ciy.
A dieta tah a zie'a angte i hmung aa; tahematapakieca Vya Abyipa, nama dyi hingna aa bangsa pata naa pa-aw sa ciy.
I bie hing na naathlie tie Abyipa, i hrungnapa hing na pachangpa thi tie.
I siepahruo hne i Khazing, i khina ueryi kha na naathlie tie, tahematapakieca nama'a luo na thlaa i chuo.
Abyipa, maw ta i ueryi kha na thyipa cate, maw ta nama'a luo thlaachuo angte ica huo.
Tahematapakieca nama ca pha lina kha a tlechuopa Khazing cuo vaciy. Pha lina ca nama hne awhne the vyi.
A hruotlepa ca na hmiekunglie a daa khu'a vyi; pha lina a tuepa tie ca na hue yi.
A hangthepa tie ca para yi cate, Abyipata cawsaa a thiepa hne a hanghiepa tie ca na hue yi.
Cuorasala khing a tlingpa hne aa hmangpa na duena thueta, kama ca na ing luo kha i ngie aa. Nama ciyzaana cangta na biena-ing pathepa luo kha a ngie'a angte icaa bie aa.
Vya Abyipai carie tie nakaw hingta naa dangna luo kha naa chiy la; na luopuv ca i hmiekunglie hing padang thi tie.
Tahematapakieca ama pakaa lieta biehmisipa aw vyi; ama pathiypalung ta para riypa dyi kha a khing; ama rawkariy ca aa awhawlawpa thluokhue kha lu te, ama palyi ta malie kha ama dung.
Abyipaama suena muo kha pa-ang sa yi la, iema khuekhuona mamaa lie kha a lie yi se. Ama tuesuena hluvpuv nakaw hne nama kha a caa du nakaw yi ta iema kha thaw tie yi.
Cuorasala nama'a lie caa canawpa ca ama palung tluo sala alawna hne hlaa sa pari yi se. Na cawchuena kha ama cunglie pazupa yi la, na ming caa duepa tie ca nama'a lie kha ama palung tluo se.
Tahematapakieca Abyipanama ta aa dangpa tie ca thluechiy pi yi cate, iema kha phya ta pakhuopa haata na duena ta na pakhuo yi.
Abyipa, na hihaa pata na chuo li pata, na hihaa pata na pasiy na pa-ya thi khah.
Vya Abyipa, i rie thyisa te aa uv ta i uv tli nakawta ngie na chi thi tie; Abyipa, na patluo sa tie, tahematapakieca i ruv i khy na khuopuv ta ina ryi.
I hringna na vuosuo a paza, Vya Abyipa, khacuo te khiy ma ica huo aa?
Vya Abyipa, a vya pali la i hringna hing na khuo tie; aa hmangpa na duena ta kama hing na khuo tie.
Tahematapakieca thiyna chung taa cata ahungma caa thyi the aa; Athiykhy taata ca ahungma caa pathuosa the aa?
I hrung i ienapa ta aa uv tana i uv tli; zuo tating ta i iehmang ca mingthliy ta pacing te, i pangphaa zaw a pacing diy tli.
I ngiechinapa ta i ming zing te, i carie tie nakawta i ming thaa a caw hryly.
Hmang pha lipa a hriepa bangkhuo hing i thaa taata pya tie ung, tahematapakieca Abyipana i caanapa ueryi hing naa thyi tli.
Abyipata bya i hienapa kha thyi tli te, i thlaachuona kha Abyipata ina thyipa tli.
I carie zaw bangkhuo ca vuosuo paza'a yi te ama nang a zaa aa; iema ca hnangluo a pali'a yi te nangzaana hneta amaa ruo aa.
Abyipai Khazing, nama chungliena icaa canaw; naa cadelepa tie'a taa hingta na khuo tie.
Caacuolikieca chingde haa tana ina caphi patlaa'a yi; luohlaa luo kha naa dapahriy'a yi te, ahungtahmuo na khuo khu'a va yi.
Abyipakama na hingpa hmang hing a hrie hmisi ang ta pata a cuo kieca, i kuv ta hmang pha lipa a hrie kieca,
i viesaa kha ruvnaana i pi kieca, a kaw aw laliy li pata i carie kha i ching kie yi ca,
i carie ta naa cade yi sala na patuv yi se, i hringna kha alyi lie tlawpuo pata thawpa cuo se.
Vya Abyipana hihaa pata kya thu la; i carie tie ama hihaana a du riypata a daa tie; Vya i Khazing a kya cha la, aa dang pata biechi tie.
Cawsaa bangkhuo kha na cahriylie a vya hmya yi sala, cungluo taa khiyta za uv tie yi.
Abyipacawsaa zaw hing bieripa yi la, Abyipai dangnapa hne i tluotlingnapa kha mang pata bie na ripa tie.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie chiena ca chuo sala, aa dangpa tie kha pacu tie yi. Aa dangpa Khazing, nama ca cawsaa zaw palungphya hne ama tingna zaw kha na pachang diy.
Khazing ca kama cuota phya ta cuo te, cawsaa phapa tie a khuotuv tana a cuo.
Khazing ca aa dangpa bieripatuv cuo te, cawsaa pha lipa tie kha sue a phaw pari yi.
Cawsaa ta amaa ngiepachiy li kieca, Khazing ca a zueziy kha cata te, liy kha a kyi te a e pacie.
Cawsaa a thie khupa cehre kha ting pacie te, myi haata a iepa cuoti kha a ting pacie.
Mang tie, hmang pha lipa nu haata ama phyanazya ca, ruvnaana kha nu phya ta phya yi te, hanghiena kha ama papuv.
Khue aa thuvsapa kha cu yi te, iema cupa khue mamaapa lie kha ama tla.
Ama tuepa ruvnaana kha ama luv cunglie vya tla pakhaa te, tuechiena khata ama lakiy lie a tlasue yi.
Abyipaca aa dang nakawta a ming pathuosa'a angte, Cungnungce Abyipaming ca hlaa ta i pathuosa aa.
Vya AbyipaLesyice, kha tluv tama na ming hing chuelyi lie a rungnaa! Na rungnaana hing cungluo vuoruo te tana a pha.
Na carie tie hne phuvlatuv tie pakaa paping riypata, haaseta hne haatiyta zaw pakaa taata pathuosana hlaa na pasa sa yi.
Na kuv ta na tuepa vuoruo, ama awna cyicuo lie na chipa yi thlaapa hne aasiy zaw i mang tiy yi ta,
cawsaa hing khaapata cuo te ma kaw na pacuo? Cawsaapa hing khaapata cuo te ma se na hie?
A cuo, iema kha Khazing laata a cawta dyi aa ne vie ta chi yi cate, rungnaana hne pa-uvsathyina byilakhuv kha na pakhuv yi.
Na sapa bangkhuo uvtuv ta chi yi cate, hmangting bangkhuo kha iema phyipazaa rawlie na chi.
Tuv hne cue hne ruo lie saruopa zaw,
avuo lie a zulepa pavaa hne riyliy lie ngaa hne a hringpa bang khuo zaw kha a phyipazaa rawlie ta na chi diy.
Vya AbyipaLesyice, kha tluv tama na ming hing chuelyi lie a rungnaa!
Abyipaca i pathiypalung yalya ta ica pathuosa aa; na tuepa kharuehaa hmang zaw bangkhuo kaw hing i ri aa.
Na cunglieta alawna hne palungtluona ta ica pathuosa aa; Vya Cungnungce, na ming ca hlaa ta ica pathuosa aa.
I carie zaw ca amaa pali tiyta, na hmiekunglie kha a pachiypatyi'a yi te ama ra aa.
Tahematapakieca kama kuoluo a daa pata biechina tue cate, na byithude lie a tu pata aa dangpa bieripana kha na tue.
Khazing a pachang lipa mingphang zaw kha chuo yi cate, cawsaa pha lipa tie kha na para yi; ama ming kha chuozaa ta na hruv yi.
Carie zaw ca chuozaa rana chunglie kha ama vie. Ama khypuv ca para karue pata cuo te, aa thyi he ta a thyi pakhaapa cuo'a va tli.
Cuorasala Abyipaca chuozaa ta siepahruo cuo te, a byithude kha bieripana riypata a patu.
Aa dangna ta chuelyi kha bie ripa te, cawsaa kha pahlyipale li pata bie a ripa yi.
Abyipaca tuechiepa tie cuota canawna cariekyikuo ta cuo te, ruvnaana cuo ningta abangna cariekyikuo tana a cuo.
Na ming caa pachangpa tie ta ca zang yi te, Vya Abyipanama caa huvpa ahunghmuo thaw buo va yi ciy.
Zion lie khy a sapa zaw Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung. A tuepa hmang kha cawsaa zaw hrawlie pathyi sa tie ung.
Tahematapakieca thiyse palang te phuv a lapa tie kha mang cakhaw va yi, hrisaana a angpa tie khina ueryi kha maw vyi.
Vya Abyipangie na chi thi la, naa huepa tie zaw'a lieta i te-angna hing na hmungpa thi tie. Nama ca thiyna thlake taata naa calang thawpa tana na cuo.
Cata a cuo nakawta Zion sacanung thlake lie kha nama pathuosana ca sa pakhaa'a angte, inaa thlana kawlie ca kha i palung a tluo aa.
Khazing a pachang lipa mingphang tie ca, iema cu ciepa khue lie kha tla yi te, iema ama thlapa cyihyi lie kha amaa uo.
Abyipaca aa dangpa bieripana ta ama hne ama kha a pachang sa yi te, cawsaa pha lipa tie ca ama kuv ta ama tue ciepa lie kha amaa uo.
Khazing a mawpa mingphang bangkhuo hne, cawsaa pha lipa tie ca Athiykhy luo khana ama si aa.
Tahematapakieca riethyivuosuopa tie ca maw pathlapa cuo li'apa yi ta, siypasa tie anguopuona zaw vie pathla'a vyi.
Vya Abyipakya thu tie! Cawsaapa kha a pate sa khah yi; Khazing a pachang lipa mingphang zaw hing na hmiekunglie bieripana ang yi se.
Vya Abyipaiema kha ama thlaa pazang yi la, cawsaapa cakhawpa ama cuopa kha mingphang zaw ta a pachang yi se.
VyaAbyipakhaapanakawma luohlaapuv luo ta naa daa? Khaapanakawma ruvnaana cuo ningta naa nu?
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ca a hruotle yi te, siypasa tie kha ama hrisaa. Iema ca iema ta ama thlapa cyihyi lie kha a uo yi se.
Tahematapakieca cawsaa pha lipa tie ca iema palung khingna kha a hruo tle khyi yi te, a karuo awpa tie ta Abyipakha thaw yi te chie ama sa.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ca a hruo ama tle nakawta “Khazing ta huv'a te hmung'a vyi”; “Khazing aw vyi,” ta pata ama rue.
Ama tuehriepa bangkhuo lie ama hlue a tling; aa suonapa lie a awpa nama bieripana kha hmung khu the va yi; ama carie tie kha ama pahnyisue hyalya.
Ama palungruv lie kha, “Tlahla buo'a va puv; ima samingsahlaa chuo te ta ruvnaana a taw buo'a vapuv,” ta pata ama rue.
Ama pakaa ca chiesana, dungviena hne tuechiena ta a bi; ama palyi ca parapakyina bie hne a pha lipa bie ta a bi.
Khyta lieta malie kha a bawkhuo yi te, aa nunapa hmang lieta a sue lipa kha ama thie.
Chingde ta a cakung taata malie a bawkhuopa haata, siypasa tie patuv riypata aa cakungna lie kha amaa bawkhuo. Siypasa tie kha a cyihyi lie kha pa-uo yi te aa dale yi.
Siypasa tie ca a bungle, a vale yi te, byatuv hnyi li pata iema kuv cata ama thiy.
Ama palungruv lie kha, “Khazing na a maw yi, a hmie na a nukhuo yi, hingpa hmang hing khatiy tahmuo hmung'a va tli,” ama ta.
Vya AbyipaKhazing, thu la na buo kya pazu tie; tuechiena a angpa tie kha maw thi khah yi.
Khaapanakawma cawsaa pha lipa tie ta Khazing kha thaw yi te, ama palungruv ta, “Khazing ta duo malie te'a vyi,” ama ta aa?

Cuorasala nama ca na hmung! A ruvnaapa tie hne a ngie a chipa tie kha na pachang thluo yi, na kuv ta paza yi cate naa bya yi. Byatuv a hnyi lipa tie ca na kuv chung luo kha caa vya pi yi te, Haaraa tie a byatuv tana na cuo.
Cawsaa pha lipa hne hmang pha lipa a tuepa tie kuv kha thlipachung la, ama tuepa hmang pha lipa bangkhuo kha phu tie.
Abyipaca chuozaa siepahruo tana a cuo; Khazing a pachang lipa mingphang zaw ca a ruo taa hingta vie yi se.

Haaraa tie hne tuechiepa tie cunglie aa dangpa hmang a tlung the riypa hne, alyi ming hingta ciy aa chiypa hmang ama patlung sa li riypata, Vya Abyipa,cawsaa nangnepa tie khingna kha thyipa'a yi cate, ama ueryi kha naathliepa'a yi cate, ama palung kha na cahra sa aa.
Abyipa'a liena i canaw; tuokhaatama niema ta, “Pavaa haata tluo luo khiy a zu tie;
tahematapakieca cawsaa pha lipa tie ta zingna chung taa khata, cawsaa phapa tie ka riypata ama liy kha a kyi yi te, cuoti kha ama pataw pacie.
A hruopatu taata hmang a ra diy ning hing cawsaa a dangpa ta khaapama a tue khu hlyi?” ina ta the ung ciy?
Abyipaca a biena-ing pathepa liena a aw; Abyipabyilakhuv ca vuoruo liena a aw. A ming ta cawsaa kha mang te a hmungpahli diy yi.
Abyipata aa dangpa tie hne cawsaa pha lipa tie kha dyapasya yi te, pha lina a tuepa tie kha a hue yi.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie cunglie kha myihyi sehunglungpa hne kemyi kha pasaa sa'a te, thliy sakalapa ca a ama cuvu panuo ta a cuo aa.
Tahematapakieca Abyipaca aa dangpa cuo te, aa dangpa tue kha a khingpa tana a cuo; aa dangpa na Abyipahmie ca a hmung'a yi.
Abyipanaa bya tie, tahematapakieca Khazing a pachangpa ahunghmuo aw va tli yi; cawsaa zaw hrawlie hing zang tluo aa tlapa aw va yi.
Pakha hne pakha kha a dung yi te, amaa pathuosa pakhi.
Abyipahanghiena bie a ripa hmya ca syipathla la, a palena bie a ripa palyi,
“Ma palyi hing tana tena ma hmung aa; ma palyi ca kiema huopa tana a cuo, ahungma malie a uv aa?” a tapa palyi ca tepachung tie.
“Siypasa tie kha esetuechiena ang yi te, vuosuo phahlapa tie amaa hrung nakawta, ata hing tana i thu aa, iema ama khingpa hne vuotiy ama hriepa abangna hmang lie khana i chi'a yi,” Abyipata a ta.
Abyipabiekuo ca a pathepa cuo te, yi sariy te ama rue pathiypa ngu haa tana a pathe.
Vya Abyipahingpa Khazing a pachang lipa mingphang taa hingta, chuozaa ta malie na khuo aa.
Pha lina ca cawsaa hrawlie cyicalangpa a cuo tiyta, cawsaa pha lipa tie ca hmangting lie amaa ze.
VyaAbyipakhacuo te khiy ma ina maw'a ciy? Chuozaa tama ina maw'a ciy? Khacuo te khiy ma na hmie ca kama'a taata na nu aa?
Khacuo te khiy ma palung pasana hing i ang a hu aa? Khacuo te khiy ma chung hne zuo hne i ang kalie aa? Khacuo te khiy ma i carie tie ta inaa palesue kalie'a yi?
Pacuo syalya la na palie tie, Vya Abyipa i ming hing khena pi tie, caacuolikieca i hmung pata a hmungsa'a angte,
i cahang nakawta i carie tie ta, “Ma te tli,” ta'a yi te ama palung tluo'a kie.
Cuorasala aa hmangpa na duena kha a ringchuo angte, na khuona chunglie kha i palung a tluo.
Abyipaca i cunglie a pha tuv nakawta, hlaa tana i pathuosa aa.
Cawsaa ngaapa tie ta ama palungruv lie kha, “Khazing aw vyi,” ama ta. Iema ca ra yi te, duvsamakhie aa chiypa hmang kha ama tue. Hmang pha a tuepa pakha hmuo aw va yi.
Abyipata cawsaapa hing a singpa hne Khazing a huvpa pakha chuo aw yi ma ta pata vuoruo taa khiy ta a za mang.
Iema bangkhuo ca ama sichie diy tli, ama bangkhuo tana aa lusa pata ama ra diy tli. Hmang pha a tuepa pakha hmuo aw va yi, pakhata hmuo aw va yi.
Pha lina a tuepa tie hing pachangna hnyi va yi ma? I cawsaa zaw kha viechuo ce haata ce diy yi te, Abyipakha u va yi.
Khazing ca aa dangpa tie'a lie kha a aw nakawta, iema ca ciyna thlaazangna hneta ama aw.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ta siypasa tie khuekhuona kha para hmuo ra ung la, Abyipaca iema ama canawna tana a cuo.
Israel ming athlana ca Zion taata a vaw se! Abyipata a cawsaa zaw kha vuophana a pi pakhaa tiy yi ta, Jakob ca a palung tluo'a te, Israel ca aa law aa.
Vya Abyipaahungma na biena-ing chung luo a ngie aa? Ahungma na tluo pathepa lie a aw aa?
Syisaa riy aw li pata hring te hmang pha a tuepa, a palungruv taata biehmisipa ri te,
malie a dung lipa, a viesaa'a lieta hmang pha lipa a tue lipa, a ingpaa kawchie a ri lipa,
cawsaa pha lipa tie kha duvsa yi te, Abyipaa ciyzaapa tie kha a pa-uvsathyipa, ama cuota ruvnaana aa taw zaw tahmuo a biekuo a pathli lipa,
amie la pata tuokaa a pahlie lipa, a sue lipa tie sue be riypata nawthuv a ning lipa, tie tana ama cuo aa. Hingpa hmang a tuepa tie ca khatiy tahmuo a cahang buo'a va yi.
Vya Khazing, na khuo thi tie, nama ca i canawna tana na cuo.
Abyipakha, “Nama ca i Byipaapa tana na cuo; nama li pata ca phana khaapahmuo hnyi va ang,” i ta.
Abyipamingpathepa tie ca ama pha hringhruo, iema'a lie awpa ca kha tluv tama khing aa chiy!
A hrangpa khazing kha a tlawpa tie ca ama ngiechina riypa khana ama chachiy vie. Thiyse ta abiena ama tuepa kha tuekhyi li'apa yi angta, ama ming zaw kha i pakaa taata ri'a va ang.
Abyipaca kama i ru hne i cuvu tana na cuo; kama cu riypa ca nama kuv chungliena a aw.
Kama cu riypa ruoriy ta khing aa chiysapa ruo zaw kha a chung patlung te, khing aa chiy hringhruopa ru na i cu.
Ruena pha naa pipa Abyipaca i pathuosa. Zuo cuo lie hmuo i pathiypalung ta luo ina pahmung sa.
Abyipakha ci li pata i mang pari; i cacuoluo kuo ta inaa daapuo pari nakawta a cahang'a va ang.
Caacuonakawta i pathiypalung ca a law te, i hringna ca a palung a tluo; i pangpa zaw huvlungsa pata aa pahy hyalya.
Caacuonakawta Athiykhy luo ca na pasi'a vaciy, na cuota zang tluo aa tlapa ca Thiyna Khue aa thuvpa kha na pahmung sa'a vaciy.
Nama ta hringna luopuv ca ina pahmung sa ciy. Nama awna lie awpa ca palungtluona a ky te, na cacuoluo kuv chunglie awpa ca chuozaa alawna tana a cuo.
Aa dangpa kawlie i khinapa hing naathlie tie, Abyipa; hanghiena a aw lipa pakaa taata thlaachuona hing naathlie tie.
Na ming ta aa hmuopa kha hmung sala, i sue lina kaw i paluo sapa kha na cuhluopa thi tie.
I pathiypalung kha na mangpasie la, zuo ta na za ve la, ina dyapasya ca kieca, a pha lipa hmang kha i chunglie hmung'a vaciy. I pakaa ta bie pha lipa ri vyi.
Malie zaw ama tuepa haata tue va ang, na pakaa taata a pyapa bie ta, esetuechiena luopuv kha i cahriy.
Na luopuv luo kha a pahraasa pata cakuo angte, i phyi a pachiy va ang.
Vya Khazing, nama kha ca u angte ina palie ciy; naa na thlie la, i bie hing na thyipa thi tie.
Vya Khuotuv Byi, ama carie tie'a taata na cacuoluo kuv lie a vya canawpa tie kha, kharuehaa aa chiypa aa hmangpa na duena ca pahmung sa tie yi.
Na mingpavaata na vepa haata kama hing na ve la, na mathlaa rawlie na za nu thi tie.
Kama naa parapa cawsaa pha lipa tie hne, naa cadungpa i carie tie kuv taa hingta na khuo thi tie.
Ama palungruv lie malie ngiechina aw lipa ta, hruotlena bie kha ama ri.
Na ziyparuvle yi te, ina cadung tli yi. Alyi vaana riypata ina mangpahring diy yi.
Iema ca caphipatlaa dyi a khingpa chingde kha lu yi te, saa a bawkhuopa a thuthawpa chingde na ama lu.
Vya Abyipakya thu la iema kha a du yi la te tie yi! Na zueziy khata cawsaa pha lipa tie kuv taa khata na khuo tie.

Vya Abyipachuelyi ru dyi cu riy a hnyipa, hing cawsaa zaw kuv taa hingta i hringna kha na kuv ta na khuo tie. Iema cuota na pacungpa ciepa yi ta ama riy bi sala, ama saata zaw cuota aa de hlyitaw taata, ama samingta zaw cuo te khata pangaa siy kalie yi se.
Cuorasala kama ca naa dangna hmie kha hmung ang sala, i kya cha tiyta nama ica hmung nakawta i palung a tling sa aa.
Vya Abyipai cahrana ta a cuopa nama kha ica due.
Abyipaca i lungpuv, i riekhuopiehu, hne naa thlatuv tana a cuo. I Khazing, i lungpuv hne i canawna, i phya, hne kama khuona kiy, i cariekyikuo tana a cuo.
Kama ta Abyipakha i u, ama ca pathuosa tluo aa tlapa tana a cuo, caacuonakawta i carie tie'a taa khata ina khuo aa.
Thiyna khuhriycamaa ta na kalaa te, rana tiylaw ta ina buvkhung.
Athiykhy khuhriycamaa ta na kalaa te, Thiyna cyihyi ta ina pa-uo.
I palungriethyina chungtaata Abyipakha i u; I Khazing'a luo kha byana i hie. A biena-ing chung taa khata i ueryi kha na thyi te, i khina ueryi ca a naa luo a pha.
Cakhutaata alyi kha a pahie te aa cahang; ama kha a hi a haa nakawta tluo thabaw tie kha aa cahang te aling haata aa siy.
A hnaakhue taata myikhuv pya te, A pakaa taata myihlaa a pya; ama'a taata myihyi sekhalapa a pya.
Avuo kha a kyi te a za cung, A chaapa zingna ca a phyi rawlie a aw.
Cherubim kha a khang te aa zu, thliy mathlaa kha a khang te a catlisa pata aa vaw.
Khyzingna kha a cadung sa te, tiyta a bipa amyi chaapuv ta ama kha a pakhuo.
A hmiekunglie khena chung taa khata aa myi hne ari hne myihyi sekhalapa kha a pya.
Abyipata avuo lie kha khalung pathy sa te, Cungnungce ta a ueryi a pathlie.
A cuoti kha ka te iema kha a chepatlaa yi; paci patla sa te aa cade diy yi.
Vya Abyipanama ta chuo yi cate, na hnaakhue taata thliychie na papyasue nakaw yi ta, riyliy raw alyi hne chuelyi hruobangna zaw aa luo.
Aa suona taata na za paza te ina la, aa thuvsapa tiy chungtaata ina thue.
A cahrapa i carie tie'a taata hne, naa huepa tie'a taa khata ina khuo; tahematapakieca iema ca kama cuota ama cahra tuv.
Iema ta ruvnaana i taw ning kha naa du yi te, cuorasala Abyipaca naa byatuv tana a cuo.
Ruo kupuv luo kha naa chiy te, kama kha ina tlechuo nakawta ina khuo.
Abyipata i dangna haa khata lawmuo ina pi, i kuv a pathena haa khata ina thung hriy.
Tahematapakieca Abyipaluopuv kha a patuv angte, i Khazing'a taa khata suena luopuv ziy pata a che va ang.
Tahematapakieca a ziyphung bangkhuo ca i hmiekunglie aw te, a phungluo bangkhuo zaw patlyi va ang.
A hmiekunglie syisaa riy aw lipa angta, kama hne kama kha suena taata i ve.
Caacuonakawta Abyipata i dangna haa khata hne, a hmungna lie i kuv a pathena haa khata ina thung hriy.
Zang tluo aa tlapa tie'a lie kha zang tluo naa tlana paluo sa cate, risie riy a aw lipa tie'a lie kha risie riy na aw linazya na paluo sa.
A pathepa tie kha a pathepa ta a pahmung sa yi cate, A zyatepa tie kha a zyatepa ta naa pahmung sa yi.
Raw a canawpa tie kha khuo yi cate, cuorasala a hruotlepa tie kha na pachung yi.
I myi-ing naa vuopapa ca nama tana na cuo; zingna kha i cuota na pakhe sa, Vya Abyipai Khazing.
Nama thueta riekaphuv suokha kha para khu angte, i Khazing thueta lungruetlepie kha i zupakhung khu.
Hingpa Khazing, a luopuv ca tling te, Abyipabiekuona ta biehmisipa kha a pacu sa; Ama chunglie a canawpa bangkhuo cuota phya tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca Abyipata li pata ahungma Khazing ta a cuo? Ima Khazing ta li pata ahungma alungpuvnung ta a cuo?
Khazing ca naa cahra sa tuv hne i luopuv kha a pabang tuv tana a cuo.
Ama ta i phyi kha sasuv phyi haata tue te, aa suona hmang lie kha aa bang pata ina chi.
I kuv kha rie a duna riypata pacuv te, caacuonakawta daa liy kha i kuv ta aa kyi khu.
Nama ta na khuona phya kha na pi cate, na cacuoluo kuv ta ina dyichaw ciy; na byana ta ina palesyi sa ciy.
I cakuona riypata hmang kusapa na pi cate, i phyi a pachiy vyi.
I carie tie kha a cade yi angte i pha yi, ama chuo hluo li kaa se va yi ang.
A hluopatyi yi angte thu khu va yi, i phyipazaa rawlie kha amaa lie.
Tahematapakieca rietuvna cuo khata thaa na patlung cate, khuosa ta naa dupa tie kha i raw luo na patla sa yi.
Nama ta i carie tie kha paruo sa yi cate, naa huepa tie kha i para yi.
Byana hmung riypata ama khi, cuorasala iema a khuo riypa pakha hmuo aw va yi. Abyipa'a luo kha ama khi, cuorasala ama ta palie va yi.
Thliy ta a phyapa alyi diypa haa khata de kary yi angte, luopuv lie caakaw haa khata i chaapuo yi.
Cawsaa zaw hne ahruna taa khata na khuo cate, mingphang zaw luv ta ina chi ciy; i pachang lipa tie khata i re ama hrie.
Ruohrang ming ta i thaa luo a vaw yi te amaa bu; i bie ama thyi pahne ta i ri amaa ngie.
Ruohrang ming ca ama palung chuo te, ama cariekyikuo chung taa khata a cathangpuo pata ama kya pya.
Abyipaca a hring! I lungpuvnung ca thluechiypa cuo mang sue. Naa khuotuv Khazing ca cyicalangpa cuo se.
I carie tie kha phuv la khuna na pi te, mingphang zaw kha i kuv rawlie a chipa Khazing;
i carie tie kuv taata naa khuopa, i carie tie cung luo ta naa cyicalangpa ca nama tana na cuo; esetuechiena taata ina khuo ciy.
Hingpa kawlie hingta mingphang zaw hrawlie kha ica cyicalang aa, Vya Abyipa. Hlaa ta na ming ica pathuosa aa.
Khazing ta a siepahruo kha tena lepuv a pi, sathu a pathuvpa David hne a ciypathla zaw cunglie kha, aa hmangpa a duena kha chuozaa ta a paluo sa.
Avuo khiy ta Khazing rungnaana hne a kuvzung a paluo sa.
Chung ta chung kha bie chang te, Zuo ta zuo kha pachangna a pathyi sa.
Bie ri va yi, biesuo hmuo va yi, ama ueryi zaw thyi pata cuo vyi.
Cuorasala ama ueryi ca alyi yalya lie kha a ze te, ama bie ca chuelyi dena te a pha. Ning cuota avuo lie khiy thluodaa sapa te,
nungchiytuv satlie haa khata a kya pya. A cahrapa a ruo a zuepa paa haa khata palungtluona hne a ruo te,
Avuo dena taa khata, kuokha luo a dena te ta a ruo te, a palingna taata a nu khupa suokha hmuo aw vyi.
Abyipaphungbie ca tling te, pathiypalung thaa kha a patlung pakhaa. Abyipaphungluo ca a ringchuo tluo a tla te, singna a hnyi lipa tie kha singna a pi yi.
Abyipaphungbie ca a pha nakawta, cawsaa palung kha a patluo. Abyipanawbie ca a siesa nakawta, cawsaa ming kha a pavuo sa.
Abyipaciyzaana ca a pathepa cuo te, chuozaa ta aa hmang. Abyipabiechina ca a hmuo te, aa dang.
Siy laata khing a chiy vie te, aa thlie cepa siy laata khing aa chiy vie. Khyitiy laata thlung vie te, khyisaluv tiy laata a thlung vie.
Ca hlyitaw taata capa tie hmuopa cata a raaringna na pi te, ziylawna lawmuo ca a le hringhruo.
Ahungma ama hne ama a tue pathlyipa kha a hmung khu? A paruvta tah i tuepa suena taata na pathe sa tie.
Riephasa pata suena i tue li riypata na thlu la, kha haapa hmang kha ta na uv khah yi se. Cata a cuo kieca syisaa riy a aw lipa cuo'a angte, tuesuena ciy aa chiypa taata i law aa.
I pakaa ta i ripa bie hne i palung lie i ruenapa ca, cuhluo tluo aa tlapa cuo thi se. Vya Abyipa, i lungpuvnung hne naa thlatuv.
Ruvnaana naa taw ning Abyipata ca palie sala, Jakob Khazing ta ca khuo thi mang sue!
A hmangpathepa taata byana ca pi sala, Zion taata ca dyichaw mang sue.
Hriykhungrina na pipa bangkhuo caa thyipa sala, myi ta ruepa hriykhungrina na pipa ta a palung patluo mang sue.
Na palung khingpa kha ca pi sala, naa tingna bangkhuo kha patling sa mang sue.
Tena na hmung tiyta palungtluona hne khi'a pate, ma Khazing ming ta tena pangtaa ma pathlie aa. Naa hiepa bangkhuo kha Abyipata patlingsa mang sue.
Abyipata sathu a pathuvpa paa kha a bya’ te, a pathepa vuoruo taa khiyta za chaw'a te, a cahrapa a kuv ta tena a za pi aa, tapa kha i pachang.
Chekha ta amaa ruo hne amaa ruole kha a palesakhyi yi te, cuorasala kiema ca Abyipama Khazing ming khana maa palesakhyi.
Iema ca ra'a yi te amaa lie aa, cuorasala kiema ca thu'a pate a cusa pata maa daa aa.
Vya Abyipa,siepahruo ca tena pi la, ma ca u tiyta malie palie tie.
Vya Abyipasiepahruo ca nama thaazuo chungliena a palung a tluo, nama byana thueta kha tluv ta cyicalangpa ma a cuo?
Nama ta a khingpa kha pi cate, acaa hiepa kha i vaciy.
Tahematapakieca thluechiy lepuv hne pataw sa cate, a luv lieta siy byilakhuv kha na pakhuv.
Hringna kha caa hie te na pi, hringtaa pasiyna kha na pi.
Naa byana thueta a rungnaana ca a le hringhruo, lesyina hne mingpathuona kha na pi.
Thluechiy kha chuozaa cuota pi cate, na awpuo nakawta palungtluona hne a bi.
Siepahruo ca Abyipakha aa ringchuo nakawta, Aa hmangpa a duena thueta Cungnungce ca hnyi khu pata cuo'a vyi.
Na carie bangkhuo kha na kuv ta patuv'a yi cate, nama caa huepa tie kha na cacuoluo kuv ta na patuv'a yi.
Naa vya luo tiyta iema kha sumyi iepa haata na tue'a yi. Abyipata a hihaana ta paluo'a yi te, myi ta iema kha a kuo diy'a yi.
Ama ciy ama hruo kha hingpa alyi taa hingta para'a yi cate, mingphang zaw chung taa hingta na pavie'a yi.
Na cunglie a pha lipa tue a ting yi te, a pha lipa khue ama khuo tiyta, tena hmung'a va yi.
Na liy ta ama hmie lie kha panang'a yi cate, a pali'a yi te amaa ruo aa.
Vya Abyipana cahrana hing cyicalangpa cuo sala, na lesyina ca hlaa ta ma pathuosa pari aa.
I Khazing, i Khazing, khaapanakawma ina thaw ciy? Khaapanakawma kama a bya riypa hne i hrungna ueryi taa hingta naa hlaasa?
Vya i Khazing, ningchung ta nama kha ca u angte na palie vaciy; zuo zaw ta a pahyna hmung hlyi va ang.
Cuorasala nama ca na pathe, byithude lie patupa, Israel ming pathuosapa tana na cuo.
Mingchingmingvuo tie ta nama kha a caa ringchuo yi; nama kha caa ringchuo yi te na khuo yi.
Nama'a luo kha kya khi yi te na khuo yi; nama aacaa ringchuo nakaw yi ta nangzaana a taw va yi.
Cuorasala kama ca cawsaa cuo va ang, cuokarie tana i cuo; malie ta na mangbung yi te, cawsaa ta ina duv yi.
