Naa hmungpa bangkhuo ta na tue hyalya yi te, ama hmya na maasue yi te, ama luv ina chysue yi.
“Na cuona kha Abyipaa pi la, ama ta caa thla se, ama ta a tlechuopa kha khuo se!”
Cuorasala i nung riy chungtaata naa papuv sapa ca nama cuo cate, i haaseta ning taata aa bangta tah naa mangchiytuv ca nama tana na cuo.
I puv baataata na kuv chunglie aw angte, i nung ta ina phya baataata i Khazing tana na cuo.
Kama kha naa hla thi khah, ruvnaana ta naa ngie te, naa bya riy ahunghmuo aw va yi.
Cuetungpa hluvpuv ta na cadung yi te, Bashan cuetungpa a cahrasapa tie ta ina cadung yi.
A khi nguoluopa chingde haa khata, ama pakaa kutalaa khata ina uosue yi.
Tiy haata lyipa cuo angte, i ruv cakhiycabuo bangkhuo ca aa suv diy. I pathiypalung ca khyihnue haata ta te, i chunglie a tiyta a lang.
I thaazuo ca bi kyichipa haa khata a caa, i palyi ca i duo luo kha a kya bepuo te, thiyna buvcing lie kha ina pahlaa siy ciy.
Caacuonakawta uv ta na cadung yi te, pha lina a tuepa tie ta ina cadung yi. I kuv hne i phyi kha caphichi diy yi te,
i ruv zaw kha aa luo diy. Na mangpahring yi te ama palung i yisa;
i caw kha a che yi te, i buohryi kha vyisung amaa da.
Cuorasala Abyipakama kha naa hla thi khah! Vya naa byatuv, a catli pata a vaw la naa bya tie.
I hringna kha zueziy taata na khuo la, uv zaw cahrana taa hingta na khuo tie.
Chingde zaw pakaa taa hingta na khuo tie. Cuetungpa aa hruopa kiy taa khata ina khuo tli ciy.
Na ming ca i uvnu hne i sieta zaw kha chang'a yi angte, cawsaazaapuv hrawlie kha ica pathuosa aa:
Abyipaa ciyzaapa tie zaw ama kha pathuosa tie ung! Jacob ciypathla zaw, ama kha rungnaana pi tie ung. Israel ciypathla zaw ama kha ciyzaa tie ung!
Tahematapakieca ama ca ruvnaana a tawpa tie kha hnangchaw va yi; kama'a taata a hmie kha nu buo li pata, ama'a luo i khi tiyta ina thyipa.
A pungpa cawsaa hluvpuv hrawlie kha ca pathuosa'a angte, nama caa ciypa zaw hmielie i biekuona kha i patling sa aa.
Siypasa tie ca ama ning khing zaa ning'a yi te, ama a huvpa tie ta Abyipaca ama pathuosa aa. Chuozaa ta nama palung a nuo pari mang sue!
Alyi dena te bangkhuo lie a awpa tie ta Abyipaca a thyi yi se; ama'a luo vya kaa yi sala, mingphang bangkhuo khata abie yi se.
Uvna ca Abyipahuopa tana a cuo, caacuonakawta mingphang zaw kha a uv yi.
Alyi cawsaa bangkhuo ta a hmielie kha a bu yi se; alyi luo a hlaw riypa bangkhuo ta ama kha pathuosa yi se. Cakhutaata kama ca ama cuota i hring aa.
Samingsahlaa zaw ta a re kha hrie'a yi te, a vaw riy'apa chuo cawsaa tie kha Abyipakaw ca ama chang aa.
A puv li liepa tie'a lie ama athlana kaw kha ukhyi'a yi te, a hmang tuepa kaw kha ama chang aa.
Abyipaca tuvkhie haata naa khietuv tana a cuo, i hu i bu hrangpa aw'a va tli.
Aphuv panuna lie kha ina pabu; neziyliy khata a langpa, a pasingkyalyapa cavaa kie luo kha naa chiy te,
thaazuo thaapa kha ina pi. A ming rungnaana riypata, aa hmuopa luopuv luo kha inaa chiy.
Aa thuv cepa thiyna huekaw lie cakuo ra ang sala ciy'a va ang, tahematapakieca nama ta na awpuo cate, na khuecahryi hne na tungbung ta i hnaa ina panguo.
I carie tie hmiekunglie kha, cabya cunglie sa ina duo ciy; i luv kha sathu na pathuv cate, i panuo ca a lepathla hyalya.
Phana hne duena ta i hring chung bangkhuo na ziy hmisi'a te, Abyipaing lie kha chuozaa ta i aw aa.
Alyi hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo hing Abyipahuopa cuo te, chuelyi hne a cunglie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo hing ama huopa tana ma cuo.
Tahematapakieca alyi ca riyliy chunglie kha a hruo bang te, tiy cunglie kha a cusa pata a padaa.
Abyipatluo luo ca ahungma a kie aa? A hmang pathepa lie ca ahungma a daa aa?
A kuv pathe te a palung a pathepa, aa hmuo lipa lieta a pathiypalung a chi lipa hne, hanghie pata chiesana a tue lipa tie na a daa'a yi.
Iema ca Abyipa'a taata thluechiy kha hmung'a yi te, iema khuotuv Khazing'a taata sue pathesana kha ama hmung aa.
Cahaapa cawsaa ca Khazing a huvpa, Jacob Khazing hmie a hmung khingpa tie tana ama cuo.
Vya thlake zaw a kupuv khata a pahaw ung la, Vya chuozaa ingchiypakaa zaw, a rungnaapa Siepahruo angiena riypa khata a pahaw tie ung.
Ahungma a rungnaapa Khazing ta a cuo? A cahrapa hne a lesyipa, rietuvna lie tena a hmungpa Abyipatana a cuo.
Vya thlake zaw a kupuv khata a pahaw tie ung! Vya chuozaa ingchiypakaa zaw a kupuv khata a pahaw tie ung! A rungnaapa Siepahruo kha a ngie naa se.
Ahungma a rungnaapa Khazing ta a cuo? Ama ca CungnungceAbyipa, A rungnaapa Khazing tana a cuo.
Vya Abyipa, namaa'a luo na thlaa i chuo.
Vya i Khazing, nama na icaa ringchuo; i nang na pazaa thi khah; i carie tie palung a yi riypata na chi thi khah.
Nama ca huo te caa nguopuopa tie kha ama nang paza thi khah yi; biekuo a pathli paripa tie ca nangzaana a taw yi se.
Vya Abyipana luopuv kha na pachang sa la, na ziypa luo kha na pacuv tie.
Na biehmisipa luo kha naa chiy la, na pacuv tie, tahematapakieca nama ca naa khuotuv Khazing cuo cate, ning-aw tana nama kha ica huo.
Vya Abyipahluo ning taata na za paluo sapa, aa hmangpa na duena hne na nangduena kha a thyi thi tie.
I kung panu ningta i za tuepa suena acuolikie tuesuena kha naa thyipa thi khah. Aa hmangpa na duena thue khata naa thyi la, na phana thue khata naa thyi tie, VyaAbyipa!
Abyipaca a dang te a pha, a suepa tie kha luophaa a pahmung sa yi.
Malie raw a canawpa tie kha luodangpa luo a chiy yi te, a luopuv kha a pacuv yi.
A nawbie hne a biekuo a ziypa bangkhuo kha, Abyipata aa hmangpa a duena hne zang tluo aa tlana ta luo aa chiy yi.
Vya Abyipai suena ca kha tluv tahmuo le ra sala, na ming thueta naa ngiethe thi tie.
Abyipaa ciyzaapa ca ahungtama a cuo? Ama na aa tlaw riypa luopuv kha a pacuv aa.
Iema ca hnyirungsa pata hring'a yi te, ama saata zaw ta ruo kha ama cu aa.
Abyipata ama a ciyzaapa tie kha a viesaa yi te, a nawbie kha a pachang sa yi.
Abyipa'a luo na i mang pari, tahematapakieca i phyi kha cyihyi taata ina pathluopa aa.
Kama'a luo a vya pali la vi na hnyi thi tie, tahematapakieca kamata seta aw angte i palung na a cawsa.
I palungriethyina kha na padiepa la, capa hmangriypa taa cata na palaw sa tie.
I palungriethyina hne i ruvnaana kha na pacuopa la, i suena bangkhuo kha naa ngiethe thi tie.
I carie khazaa aw yi te ma, kha tluv ta ina hue yi tapa kha rue thi tie.
I hringna kha na ve la na khuo thi tie, nama'a lie icaa canaw nakawta, i nang na pazaa thi khah.
Nama kha ica huo nakawta, adangna hne phana ta na mangchiy thi se.
Vya Khazing, Israel hing a ruvnaana chung bangkhuo taata khuo thi tie.
Vya Abyipaadangna chunglie kha cakuo angte, a cusa pata icaa ringchuo nakawta, i sue lina kaw kha pathyisa tie.
Vya Abyipai pathiypalung hing na dyapasya la, i khingna hne i ruena zaw hing pachang naa zue tie.
Tahematapakieca aa hmangpa na duena ca i hmiekunglie aw pari te, nama'a luo kha zang tluo aa tlapa ta i va cakuo.
A hanghiepa tie kha a khe lipa yi angta, phahruocuo tie zaw kha a viesaa va yi ang.
Pha lina a tuepa tie kha hue yi angte, cawsaa pha lipa tie'a lie a tu va ang.
Vya Abyipai sue lina paluosana ta i kuv kha a siy angte, bienatluophie kha i cakuo cahlung.
Palungtluona hlaa kha khuopuv ta sa angte, kharuehaa hmang na tuepa kaw kha i ri.
Vya Abyipa, na awna ing hne, na rungnaana a awna hmang kha i tlechuo.
A suepa tie hneta kama kha na thiepuo li pata, lie a nawpa tie hneta i hringna kha parapuo thi khah.
Ama kuv ca pha lina tuena ta hmuo yi te, ama cacuoluo kuv ca nawthuv tana a bi.
Cuorasala kama ca aa dang pata na i hring, vi na hnyi la na khuo tie.
I phyi ca aa rena lieta a daa te, a pungpa cawsaa hluvpuv hrawlie kha, Abyipaca i pathuosa aa.
Abyipaca i khena hne khuona tana a cuo; ahungma i ciy aa? Abyipaca i hring abangna cariekyikuo ta cuo te, ahung rie ma i ciy aa?
Pha lina a tuepa tie hne i carie tie ta, khuosa ta naa du yi te, i saa caphipatlaa diy ama khing ning kha, iema ca a pachiy'a yi te amaa lie aa.
Riekaphuv ta ina cadung raalaa zaw yi ta, i pathiypalung lieta ciyna aw vyi.
Abyipakha hmang suokha i hie; capa i khingpa hmang ca, i hring chung bangkhuo Abyipaing chunglie aw riypa hne, Abyipapuvthenazya kha hmung pata, A Biena-ing chunglie ama huv riypa kha tana a cuo.
Ruvnaana cuo ningta a ing chunglie kha ina nu aa; a thluodaa chunglieta kama kha na khaakhung'a te, aa suopa alung cunglie ina patu aa.
I luv kha naa cadungpa i carie tie laata ina pasuo vie; a thluodaa chunglie kha hriykhung a ri'a angte, palungtluosa pata u'a angte, Abyipakha hlaa ta i pathuosa aa.
Vya Abyipanama'a luo i kya khi tiyta naa na thlie la, vi na hnyi la na palie thi tie.
I palungruv lie, “A vaw la i minghmie hing huv tie,” ina tapa haa cata, Abyipana minghmie khana i huv.
Na hmie kha na nukhuo thi khah. Na changtaapa hing na pakaa thi khah, nama ca naa byatuv tana na cuo. Kama kha na thaw thi khah, na thuse thi khah, Vya i Khazing, kama naa khuotuv!
I nung hne i paa ta ina thaw zaw yi ta, Abyipata ca inaa haa aa.
VyaAbyipai carie ama aw nakawta, na luopuv kha na pacuv la, aa dangpa luopuv lie naa chiy tie.
I carie tie ta ama khing ta tue riypata, iema kuv luo kha na pi thi khah. Kama a du pata a cuo lipa tehte kha khuo yi te, pha lina kha ama chiykhyi.
A hringpa tie awna hmang lie kha, Abyipaphana ca i hmung aa ta pata i zang.
Abyipaca huo tie ung; thaazuo hne palung cahrasa pata aw ung la; Abyipaca huo tie ung.
Vya Abyipanama na ica u; i lungpuvnung, naathlie li pata na aw thi khah. Ina naathlie li ca kieca, Thiyna khue chung luo a cungpa haa tana i cuo aa.
Abyana caa hie angte, a pathe cepa na hmangpathepa luo i kuv i kya pazu ningta, ica una ueryi kha na naathlie thi tie.
Ama palung lie ihnyina a aw thluo pata, a ingpaa kha diena bie chang pakhi yi te, hmang pha lipa a tuepa tie, cawsaa pha lipa tie hne khata naa dapahriy rale khah.
Ama hriepa re hne, hmang pha lipa ama tuepa kawlie kha thung tie yi; ama kuv ta ama hriepa re kawlie kha, amaa phuvpa khata thung tie yi.
TahematapakiecaAbyipaa tuepa hne a hriepa re kha, siysaa ama ri li nakawta, iema kha pachung'a yi te, sathaw pakhaa'a va tli yi.
Abyipaca thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue, tahematapakieca paa i kiena ueryi khana a thyi.
Abyipaca i cahrana hne i phya tana a cuo; i pathiypalung ta ama kha aa ringchuo; caacuonakawta naa bya te, i palung a tluo hringhruo, hlaa sa angte ama kha i pathuosa.
Abyipaca a cawsaa zaw cahrana ta cuo te, sathu a pathuvpa zaw aa bangpa canawna ta a cuo.
Vya Abyipana cawsaa zaw kha khuo yi la na ru ta a cuopa tie kha thluechiy pi tie yi. Ama tuvkhietuv ta cuo la, chuozaa ta a chiy tie yi.
Vya avuoming zaw, Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung, Abyiparungnaana hne cahrana ca pathuosa tie ung.
Abyipaming rungnaapa ca pathuosa ung la; a pathe a rungnaapa Abyipaca abie tie ung.
Abyipaueryi ca riyliy cunglie kha a paring; rungnaana Khazing ca khalung haata a thy te, Abyipaca riyliy tiy cunglie kha a aw.
Abyipaueryi ca cahrana hne bi te, huvhaa a hnyi hringhruo.
Abyipaueryi ca sidar kung kha thli pachung te, Lebanon sidar kung kha hmuo a thlibaruv diy.
Ama ta Lebanon ca cuetaata haata cathlu sa te, Sirion ca a thuthawpa cuetungpa haata a cathlu sa.
Abyipaueryi ca thinghlaa kha a cakang sa.
Abyipaueryi ca Kadesh ruocaapa chung kha a cahang diy.
Abyipaueryi ca sakhiy kha saa pasa sa te, thinghnaa bangkhuo kha a pazung sa diy; cawsaa bangkhuo ta a biena-ing chunglie kha, “Khazing ca rungnaa se!” ama ta.
Abyipata riyliy tiylaw zaw kha uv diy te, Abyipaca chuozaa siepahruo tana a cuo.
Abyipata a cawsaa zaw kha cahrana pi yi sala, a cawsaa zaw kha thlaalungna thluechiy pi yi se.
Vya Abyipa, i carie tie kha, kama kawlieta ama palung a tluo li riypata, ina khuo nakaw ca ta ica pathuosa.
Vya Abyipai Khazing, nama'a luo kha, abyana caa hie angte i kya khi, nama ta ina patluo sa ciy.
VyaAbyipa, i thlaapa kha Athiykhy taata kya calang cate, Thiyna khue luo a cungpa tie chung taa khata hringna ina pi pakhaa ciy.
Zang tluo a tlapa a cawsaa pathepa zaw, Abyipaca hlaa ta pathuosa ung la, a ming pathepa ca pathuosa tie ung.
Tahematapakieca a hihaana ca cuo khata dyi cuo te, a phana ca chuo chung cuo tana a cuo. Zuo ta caana aw ra mang sala, palungtluona ca mawruo hneta amaa vya chiy.
I chyachang aa kysa ningta, “Ahungtahmuo na te'a va tli yi,” i ta.
Abyipana duena thueta, kama kha tluo haata ina pacu ciy; na hmie kha na nu tiyta, ciy angte i cathangsa.
Vya Abyipa, nama kha ca u angte, Abyipakha paa ica kie:
“Thiyna khue chung luo kha cung ang sala, i thiy pata khaapama a thlahne aa? Buvcing ta nama kha aca pathuosa'a ma? Zang tluo naa tlana ca a ri the'a ma?
Vya Abyipa, kama kha na naathlie la vi na hnyi thi tie! Vya Abyipa, kama kha naa bya thi tie!
I ngiy i phiena kha luona ta ina thlepa tli ciy, i buri pang kha na hlepa cate, palungtluona ina buv ciy,
caacuonakawta i thlaapa ta ca pathuosa'a te a dieta tah aw'a vyi. VyaAbyipa, i Khazing, chuozaa ta ica pathuosa aa.
Vya Abyipa, nama na icaa canaw; kama kha khatiy tahmuo i nang na pazaa thi khah; naa dangna chunglie kha na khuo tie. Kama kha na naathlie thi la, A catli pata na khuo tie.
I cuo ta i canawna alungpuvnung cuo la, kama khuo riypata a cupa riekhuopiehu cuo tie.
Nama ca i lungpuvnung hne i riekhuopiehu hmisi tana na cuo, na ming thueta naa chiy la na ca-ya tie.
Ina thlakhuopa yi cyihyi taa khata na palawsa tie, tahematapakieca nama ca i canawna tana na cuo.
I thlaapa ca na kuv chung luo kha ca pi angte, nama ta ina khuo ciy, Vya Abyipa, zang tluo aa tlapa i Khazing.
Thlahnena a hnyi lipa kuvtuezuv a biepa tie kha na hue yi, cuorasala kama ca Abyipana icaa ringchuo.
Aa hmangpa na duena chunglie kha a law'a angte i thaa a pha aa; tahematapakieca kama te-angna kha na hmung cate, i ruvnaana zaw ina pachang ciy.
I carie tie kuv luo kha na pi lipa cata, a tlawhaalaanapa hmang lie ina pa-awsa ciy.
Vya Abyipa, vi na hnyi tie, tahematapakieca i palung rie na a thyi hringhruo; i caa tuvna ta i ming ca thling diy tli te, i pangpa hne i thlaapa zaw a thaa a buo hringhruo tli.
I hringna ca ngiechina hne hmuo angte, ahrung-a-iena chunglie i aw; i palungriethyina kawlieta i thaa caw te, i ruv te a hmaw tli.
I carie tie ese hyalya riypata cuo angte, i ingpaa tie cuota ciysabaraw aa chiypa ta i cuo. I viesaa zaw ciysa riypata cuo angte, luopuv lie naa hmungpa tie ta ina cahriy yi.
Kama kha a thiypa haata na maw yi te, thawpa bikarue haa tana i cuo.
Tahematapakieca a paruv ta i kaw ina ripa yi thyi angte, ciy aa chiypa hmang ta ina cadung. Kama a du riypata khue khuo pakhaw yi te, i hringna la riypata ina raw yi.
Cuorasala Vya Abyipanama kha caa ringchuo angte, “Nama ca i Khazing tana na cuo,” ica ta.
I cuo ca nama kuv chungliena a aw; i carie tie hne naa hrisaapa tie kuv chung taa khata na khuo tie.
Na changtaapa hing hmiephaa na pi thi la, aa hmangpa na duena ta na khuo tie.
Vya Abyipa, nama kha ca u angte, nangzaa pata na chi thi khah; cawsaa pha lipa tie ca ama nang zaa sala, nang-uona hne ryi lipa ta Athiykhy luo si yi se.
Hruotlena hne malie esepuo pata, cawsaa phapa tie aduna biechie ri te, hangbie a ripa palyi ca die mang sue.
Nama caa ciyzaapa tie cuota na chipa phana ca kha tluv ta hluv te ma aa ky aa, cawsaa bangkhuo hmielie zaw, nama'a lie a canawpa tie cuota ca kha tluv tama tluo a tling.
Cawsaa rawna chungtaata ama lawna riypata nama awna chunglie kha nu yi cate, a hru kuo a phiepa bie taata ama lawna riypata na mathlaa rawlieta na ti yi.
Abyipaca thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue, carie ta cadungpa khypuv chunglie i aw ning kha aa hmangpa a duena ca kharuehaa aa chiy pata ina pahmung sa.
I pahlusa pata i ripa ca, “Na hmungna taa tana luohlaapuv luo ina papya ciy,” i ta. Cuorasala abyana caa hie angte i khi tiyta, paa ica kiena kha ina thyipa ciy.
A mingpathepa zaw bangkhuo ta Abyipaca due tie ung. Zang tluo aa tlapa tie kha Abyipata mangchiy cawchuele yi te, a palepatie pata a awpa tie kha khuopuv ta vieriy a thung yi.
Abyipaa huopa tie bangkhuo zaw, cahrasa ung la nama palung a pacu tie ung.
A tuesuena a ngiethe pata cuo te a suena buvkhungpa pata a cuopa ca thluechiypa tana a cuo.
Abyipata sue a be lipa hne a palung chunglie dungviena a hnyi lipa ca thluechiypa tana a cuo.
I suena phu li pata ning-aw ta i hrung nakawta i pangpa ca thaazuo hnyi li pata aa uv ta aa uv.
Na kuv ta chung hne zuo ta na vy te, i thaazuo ca cuovuo ningling caakarepa haata a caa.
Cakhutaa cata i suena kha nama ica pachang sa, i pha lipa zaw kha nu va tli ang; “I tuesuena kha Abyipana i pachang sa aa,” ta angte, kama i tuepa suena kha inaa ngiethe ciy.
Caacuonakawta zang tluo aa tlapa bangkhuo ta, ruvnaana cuo ning kha ama'a luo thlaachuo yi se; a cahrapa tiylepa ta iema kha pha'a va yi.
Nama ca i nuna hmang tana na cuo; ruvnaana taata na mangchiy cate ina cawchue ciy; alawna khuona ueryi hneta kama kha ina cadung ciy.
Nama kha ca pacuv'a angte, na cakuona riypa luopuv kha ica pahmung sa aa; nama kha ci li ta ca mang'a angte ruena ica che aa.
Hmyakhe tuv pata thaatungriy ta maa lipa kieca, naa thaa luo a vya daa lipa, pachangna a hnyi lipa aruo haa khata cuo khah.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ca chiena hluvpuv kha ama ang, cuorasala Abyipaa ringchuopa tie ca aa hmangpa a duena khata a cadung yi.
Vya aa dangpa tie zaw, Abyipa'a lie kha a law ung la nama palung tluo se. A palung pathepa tie zaw, palungtluona hne khuo ta khi tie ung.
Vya aa dangpa tie zaw Abyipa'a lie kha nama palung tluo se. Cawsaa phapa tie zaw aa phuv aa siysa pata pathuosa tie ung.
Abyipakha tingtuo ta pathuosa ung la, riy hraa a hnyipa tingtuo ta pathuosa tie ung.
Tingtuo kha naathlie aa nuosa pata tung ung la, Ama kha hlaa thaapa khuopuv ta sa ung la pathuosa tie ung.
Tahematapakieca Abyipabie ca a dang te, a re bangkhuo ca zang tluo aa tla pata a hrie.
Ama ca adangna hne aa hmuopa kha khing te, alyi ca aa hmangpa Abyipaduena ta a bi.
Abyipabie ta avuo ca sa pata cuo te, avuo hmang bangkhuo khiy a huv ta sapa ta ama cuo.
Ama ta riyliy tiy bangkhuo kha suv kha lie pahlaw te, aa thuvpa riyliy kha aa bangna lieta a chi.
Alyi ming bangkhuo Abyipaca ciyzaa yi se; chuelyi lie khy a sapa bangkhuo ta ama ca ciyzaa yi se.
Tahematapakieca bie ri te chuelyi a vya aw; naw pi te a cusa pata aa daa.
Abyipata mingphang hrangpa tie rue pakhawpa kha a hrihripa ta pacuo sa te, cawsaa zaw ta hrie amaa tingpa kha a para.
Abyipakhuekhuona ca chuozaa ta a hmang te, a palungruv lie a pacuopa ca chuo chung bangkhuo ta aa hmang.
Abyipakha ama Khazing ta a hnyipa mingphang ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo. Ama ta a ru cuo riypata aa tlawpa mingphang ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo.
Abyipata vuoruo taa khiy ta za mang te, cawsaapa bangkhuo kha a hmung diy yi.
Aa tunapa byithude taa khiyta chuelyi ming bangkhuo kha a za mang yi.
Ama ca ama pathiypalung a satuv cuo te, ama tuepa hmang bangkhuo kha pachang te aa cake diy.
Siepahruo hing a cahra ciemuopa a riekaphuv thueta rie te vyi; rieka pakha hing ama a thaaruvna ta khuo khu vyi.
Rietuvnapa aruo zaw tena hmung riypata khaapahmuo cuo vyi, a thaaruvna hne a cahrana ta khuo khu vyi.
Abyipata ama a ciyzaapa tie kha hmung yi te, aa hmangpa a duena lieta anguopuona a hnyipa tie kha a mangchiy yi.
Thiyna chungtaata khuo yi te, cakuo tlung ningta hringna a pi yi.
Kiema ca Abyipakha huo pate, ama ca malie a byatuv hne maa phya tana a cuo.
A ming pathepa kha a ringchuo pate, ama cunglie ma palung aa law.
Vya Abyipanama kha maacaa nguopuo nakawta, aa hmangpa na duena ca kiema cunglie tlung mang sue.
Abyipaca i pathuosa pari aa; ama pathuosa ca a taw he ta taw buo'a va ang.
A hmang tuepa kawlieta Abyipaca i pathuosa aa; hrisaana a angpa tie ta thyi ung la nama palung tluo se.
Abyiparungnaana ca ri pakhaw ung sala, a ming ca cyicalang pakhaw ung siy.
Abyipa'a luo kha thlaa i chuo tiyta na palie te, Ciynapa bangkhuo taata kama kha hya ina pazang.
Ama kha mang ung la nama palung tluo se; nama nang ca pazaa buo'a va yi.
Siypasa tie zaw ama khina ueryi kha Abyipata thyi te, ruvnaana phangting taa khata a khuo yi.
Abyipaa ciyzaapa tie kha aa vuoming ta cadungle, awpuole yi te, ruvnaana taata hya a pazang yi.
Abyipaphanazya kha a pacuo pachiy ung la pachang tie ung; ama'a lie a canawpa zaw ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo.
A cawsaapathepa tie zaw, Abyipaca ciyzaa tie ung, tahematapakieca ama a ciyzaapa tie ca tlahla buo'a va yi.
Chingde hmuota sa aa hmung li nakawta a nang diy taw te, cuorasala Abyipaa huvpa tie ca hmang phapa suokhata hmuo phahla'a va yi.
Mingnu zaw a vaw ung la na naathlie tie ung; Abyipaciyzaana kha ca pacuv'a yi ang.
Aa nuosa pata hring nama khing ma? Chuo pasiyna hne palung tluosa pata hring nama khing ma?
Biechiepa ri kha a cadang la, hangbie ri zaw kha cahriy tie.
Pha lina kha thuse la phana kha tue tie; thlaalungna kha huv la hmung a zue tie.
Abyipata aa dangpa tie kha mangchiy pari yi te, Ama khina ueryi kha a thyi yi.
Cuorasala pha lina a tuepa tie ca Abyipata hmiephaa pi lipa yi ta, alyi lie iema athyi pakhaana riypa a aw li riypata a tue yi.
Aa dangpa tie khina ueryi kha Abyipata thyi yi te, ama ruvnaana bangkhuo taa khata a khuo yi.
Abyipata a palung a chuopa tie kha a pha yi te, anguopuona a hnyi lipa tie kha a khuo yi.
Aa dangpa zaw ta ruvnaana a hluvsa a taw yi te, cuorasala Abyipata capa zaw bangkhuo taa cata a khuo yi.
A ruv bangkhuo kha a phasa pata a mangchiy nakawta, suokha hmuo tli'a vyi.
Cawsaa pha lipa ca pha lina ta thie te, aa dangpa tie a huepa ca sue duotena a ang aa.
Abyipata a changtaapa tie hringna kha a thla yi te, ama'a lie a canawpa ahunghmuo suebe pata cuo'a va yi.
Vya Abyipa, kama naa cariepa tie kha a carie ra yi la, kama naa dupa tie kha a du ra tie yi.
Aphya hne cehre kha a la lah, kama a bya riypa khata thu tie.
Asyi hne asyipuv zaw kha a la lah, kama naa cadelepa tie kha a daakhuo tie yi. Kama kha, “Nama caa khuotuv tana i cuo,” na ta tie.
Kama naa thie khingpa tie ca ama nang zaa sala ama hmie chi se. Kama a du pata a pha lipa khue a khuopa tie ca hnangluo kaa yi sala ama hmie chi se.
Abyipaavuoming khata a cade yi sala, thliy ta a phyapa savie haata cuo yi se.
Abyipaavuoming ta a cade yi sala, ama luopuv zaw zing sala pahnie se.
Tahematapakieca a luo li pata kama kha cyihyi na thla khuo yi te, a luo li pata kama kha suphung ina cu khuo yi.
Amaa thyi li chung ta ama cunglie rana tlung se. Ama cyihyi mamaapa lie kha a uo yi sala, iema cupa suphung lie kha tla yi sala ra yi se.
I thlaapa ca Abyipa'a lie kha a palung tluo sala, a thlapa a cuo nakawta a nuo se.

I pathiypalung hmisi ta, “Vya Abyipa, Nama haapa ahunghmuo aw? A thaazuo a cawpa tie kha a thaaruvpa tie kuv taata khuo yi cate, a thaazuo cawpa tie hne bya aa hupa tie kha iema a parapa tie kuv taata na khuo yi,” i ta aa.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie khata sue na phaw yi te, i pachang lipa suena kha ina be yi.
Phana kha chiena ta na thung yi te, i ngie a chi hringhruo.
Cuorasala kama ca iema ama pasa ning kha buri a buv angte, iema cuota sa i uv. I uvnu hne i viesaa cuota thlaa i chuo tawpa haa khata,
a bung angte thlaa i chuopa yi. A nung muochie a sapa haata a bung angte ngiechina hne i khie.
Cuorasala kama i lie tiyta iema ca ama palung tluo te, kama a du riypata inaa vya hmyasue yi; i pachang lipa cawsaa pha lipa tie zaw khata, ci li pata ina tuv yi.
Thlachie rue li pata na tue hyalya yi te, ama haa dyi ina rie sue yi.
Vya Abyipa, khacuo te khiy ma na mang thluo'a yi? Iema ina tuvna taa yi hingta na khuo la, chingde tie kuv chung taa hingta i hringna hing na khuo tie.
Cakhutaa cata aa hmya pakhawpa cawsaa hluvpuv hmielie, ama bangkhuo hmielie kha ica pathuosa aa.
A hanghiepa i carie tie kha i cunglie ama palung patluo sa khah yi. Naa huepa tie ta ama mingcakiy ta na siy khah yi se.
Tahematapakieca iema ca diena bie kha ri li pata, hanghiena bie kha ri yi te, a dieta tah a awpa tie kha bie ama pachie.
Ama pakaa kutalaa khata na pahnyisue yi te, “Haa, haa, ma ming ta maca hmungpuo kha,” ina ta yi.
Vya Abyipa, nama ta na hmung thluo yi; a dieta tah aw thi khah! Vya Abyipa, kama kha naa hla thi khah.
I Khazing hne Abyipa, thu la i dangna kaw kha bie na chipa tie.
Vya i Khazing hne Abyipa, nama ca aa dangpa na cuopa haata, i sue lina kaw kha pathyi sa thi la, i cunglie ama palung tluo khah se.
Iema kha, “Ma khingpa na a tlung tli,” pa ta sa thi khah yi. Iema kha, “Nama ca maca paluo tli,” pa ta sa thi khah yi.
Ruvnaana khuosa ta i tawpa cunglie ama palung a tluopa tie ca ama hmiechi sala ama nang zaa se. Kama kha naa du yi te iema hne iema a palepa tie ca hmiechi nangzaana ta pahlaw yi se.
Kama i dangpa kha naa daakhyipa tie ca palungtluona hne u yi sala a law yi se. “A changtaapa zaw khingtlingna lie a palung a tluopa Abyipaca a Lesyipa tana a cuo,” ta khu pari yi se.
Cakhutaa cata naa dangna kaw kha ri'a angte, ning-aw ningtlabu ta ica pathuosa aa.
Suena ta cawsaa pha lipa tie palung chunglie aa thuvpuv ta bie ri te, ama ming padyi lieta Khazing ciyzaana aw vyi.
Iema hne iema kha aa suosa pata a hmung yi te, ama pha lina kha a hmung pata a hue the va yi.
Ama pakaa taata a pyapa bie ca i-awna bie hne hanghiena bie selaw ta a cuo; singvaasa pata aw riypa hne hmang pha tue kha a taw tli.
Iehmang cunglie a laa ning hmuota hmang pha lipa kha rue te, a tuepa bangkhuo ca hmang pha lipa seta a cuo; suena suokha hmuo cahriy vyi.
Vya Abyipaaa hmangpa na duena ca avuo kya de te, zang tluo naa tlana ca amyi cung te a pha.
Naa dangna ca tluo haata a suo te, na biechipana ca riyliy haata aa thuv. Vya Abyipanama ta cawsaa hne saruopa zaw kha aa lu pata na khuo yi.
Vya Khazing aa hmangpa na duena ca kha tluv tama a sungnaa! Cawsaa bangkhuo ta na mathlaa rawlie kha ama canaw aa.
Na ing lie sa kha lunghruo tlungsa pata ning yi te, na palungtluona cavaa taata tiy na padang sa yi.
Tahematapakieca nama ca hringna tiyhnaa ta cuo cate, nama khena chunglie kha kiema ta khena ma hmung.
Aa hmangpa na duena ca nama caa pachangpa tie cunglie pahmang la, a palungphya a phapa tie cunglie na khuona tlung mang sue.
A hruotlepa tie phyi ta kama kha na tlaw li pata, cawsaa pha lipa tie kuv ta a ruo khah ang se.
Pha lina a tuepa tie ca a liekawlaw yi sala, amaa liepatyina taata kya thu khu khah yi se.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie kawlieta na palung ra khah se; hmang pha lipa a tuepa tie kha na hietlie khah se. Tahematapakieca iema ca aphuv haa khata a uv'a yi te,
lubi haata caa'a yi te ama thiy aa.
Abyipakha a ringchuo la phana kha tue tie; ruo chunglie hing aa nuosa pata hne aa bang aa susa pata nama aw aa.
Abyipakha tlechuo ung la nama palung khingpa kha a ca pi'a yi.
Na cuona bangkhuo kha Abyipapi tie; ama kha a ringchuo la, ama ta a tue aa.
Na phana hne naa dangna kaw ca ningchung ning khepa haa khata a pakhe sa aa.
Abyipakha huo la a hmiekunglie kha a dieta tah aw tie; a rehriena lie a hlue a tlingpa hne hmang pha lipa a hrie khu lawmawpa tie kha hietlie khah yi.
Hihaana kha cahriy la thuse tie. Na palung rie thyi khah se, a pha lipa luo na a caa chiy aa.
Tahematapakieca cawsaa pha lipa tie ca a cadepa cuo'a yi te, cuorasala Abyipaa huopa tie ca ruo hingna ru ta ama cu aa.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ca khacuo a ta hluota ama vie aa; ama awna lie kha temaasa pata na huv zaw yi ma hmung'a va tli yi ciy.
Cuorasala a nangnepa tie ca ruo kha cu'a yi te, hnyirungna hne lunghruo tlungsa pata hring'a yi te amaa law aa.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ta aa dangpa tie kha raw yi te, ama haa ama rie sue;
cuorasala a ru hluota ama vie'a tli tapa kha Abyipata pachang te a pahnyi sue yi.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ca siypasa tie thie riypa hne, aa dangta tah a hringpa tie kha naw riypata, ama zueziy kha a da yi te ama liy kha amaa kyi.
Cuorasala ama zueziy ta iema palung kha daw'a yi te, ama liy ca a tli aa.
Aa dangpa ta a hnyipa chechiy a cawta ca, cawsaa pha lipa ta a hnyipa chechiy hluvpuv laata muo a hnyi vie.
Tahematapakieca cawsaa pha lipa tie buo ca tli'a te, cawsaa phapa ca Abyipana a daakhyi'a yi.
Abyipata aa dangpa tie kha kawpacuo yi te, ama cupa ru ca chuozaa ta aa hmang aa.
Cuo chiepa chunglie nangzaa pata aw li'apa yi ta, cakuo tlung ning kha ning khang ama hnyi aa.
Cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa tie ca ra'a yi te, Abyipacarie tie ca aphuv paa haata ama li aa; myikhuv haa tana ama li diy aa.
Cawsaa pha lipa ca du a cyipa yi kha thung va tli, cuorasala cawsaa phapa ca pahyasa pata a pi yi.
Abyipata thluechiy a pipa tie ca ruo khana ru ta ama cu aa, cuorasala chiesapa tie ca a cadepa ta ama cuo aa.
Cawsaapa cakuona luo kha Abyipata pahmung sa te, a tlechuopa tie ca a mangchiy yi.
Amaa pachiy zawta a lie patyi'a va yi, tahematapakieca Abyipana a kuv ta a pathu yi.
I cawta baataata i macuona te hingta, Abyipana cawsaa phapa tie kha a thaw yi tapa hne, ama saata zaw na a hie chaw pata a hring yi tapa hmung buo valie ang.
Cawsaa kha pahyasa pata ducyi yi te ama pahlie pari, caacuonakawta ama saata zaw ca thluechiy ta ama cuo.
Pha lina kha thuse la phana kha tue tie; caacuokieca hingpa ruo lie hing chuozaa ta na aw aa.
Abyipaca biedangpa kha a khing; zang tluo aa tlapa a cawsaa kha thuse buo vyi. Aa dangpa tie ca chuozaa ta mangchiypa cuo'a yi te, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa saata zaw ca pahli pata ama cuo aa.
Cawsaa phapa tie ca ruo kha ru ta cu'a yi te, chuozaa ta ama awna aa.
Aa dangpa tie pakaa taata singna bie pya te, biedangpa kha ama ri.
Ama Khazing phungbie kha ama palung chunglie aw te, ama phyi hliy chie va yi.
Cawsaa pha lipa ta cawsaa phapa kha, mangpathliy te thie aa nang.
Cuorasala Abyipata a cariepa kuv lie kha thuse li pata, bieripana zung luo chiy pata suebie ripa va yi.
Abyipakha huo la a ri kha a ngie tie, ruo kha ru ta cu riypata ca cyicalang'a te, cawsaa pha lipa tie rana kha na ming ta na hmung aa.
Cawsaa pha lipa ta malie kha tlawpuo yi te, Lebanon sidar kung haata aa suosa pata aa chipa kha i hmung.
I va capiepaa pakhaa ca za aw va tli; i huv ciemuo raalaa pata hmung khu va tli ang.
Syi riy a aw lipa tie hne aa dangpa tie kha rue yi la pacuo pachiy yi, saata nuta hnyi yi te na thlaalungna ama hmung.
Cuorasala suena a tuepa tie ca para pakhawpa cuo'a yi te, ama saata nuta zaw ca pahlipa tana ama cuo aa.
Aa dangpa tie khuona ca Abyipa'a taa tana a cuo; ama ca ruvnaana cuo ningta amaa canawna ta a cuo.
Abyipata a bya yi te, cawsaa pha lipa tie kuv taa khata a khuo yi. Tahematapakieca ama'a lie amaa canaw nakawta a cuo.
Vya Abyipana hihaa pata na chuo thi khah, na hihaa pata duo na te thi khah.
Na cuoti ta naa tipuo tli te, na kuv ta ina cabe patyi tli ciy.
Na hi a haa nakawta i ngesaa bangkhuo pasa te, i sue nakawta i ruv i khy bangkhuo a pasa.
I pha lina ca i luv cung luo chiy te, hmang aa riysapa haata ina vy yi.
I ngaa nakawta i phyapa hmaa ca, a hnie dyi vya te a pahnuosa.
I ke dyi pakang angte i lie; ning-aw ningtlabu ta i hrung.
Tahematapakieca i sesie ca a ce dyi na ce te, i ngesaa bangkhuo a pasa diy.
I thaa aw bangby li pata i laa thluo; i palung rie thyi pata i hrung.
Vya Abyipai palung khingpa ca na pachang; i hrungna zaw ina thyi diy ciy.
I palung a cathlu, i thaa chuo te i ming a zing.
I hmaa i zung kawlieta i viesaa ta na cabaw li tlipa yi ta, i ingpaa zaw ta na cadi va tli yi.
Naa thie khingpa tie ta cyihyi ina thlakhuo yi; naa para khingpa tie ta biechiepa ta naa hru yi te, kama para riypa kha ning-aw ningtlabu ta ama rue.
Cuorasala kama ca a naaruepa haata, khaapahmuo thyi va ang; bie a ri the lipa, a ngaapa na i lu.
A naa a rue nakawta, malie bie a vielie the lipa na i lu hmisi.
Cuorasala VyaAbyipa, kama ca nama na ica huo; Vya Abyipai Khazing, nama na naa palie'a ciy.
“I phyi pahnie te i thaw ningta hruotlesa pata kama naa dupa tie kha ama palung tluo khah se,” i ta.
Vuotaa a lie'a nang angte, ci li ta pasana i ang.
I pha lina kha a phu angte, i ngie a chi hringhruo.
I carie tie ca ama hnaa tluo te ama thaa a ruvsa, hruohra li pata naa huepa tie ca a ma hluvsa.
Phana kha tue i zue nakawta, i carie tie ta phana ca chiena ta ina thung yi.
VyaAbyipa, kama kha na thaw thi khah. Vya i Khazing, kama kha naa hla thi khah.
Vya Abyipa, kama naa khuotuv, a catli pata naa bya thi tie.
“I hmang tuepa kha i cadang aa; i palyi ta suena bie ri khah se. Cawsaa pha lipa i thaalie ama aw chung bangkhuo, bie ri i cadang aa,” i ta.
A dieta tah aw angte, a phapa kaw kha hmuo ri va ang; i palung rie thyi hryly te,
i pathiypalung ca a ling dyi a ling. I pacuo syalya tiyta i palung kha myi ling ta ling te, I ripa ca:
“Abyipakha cuo te hring kalie'a angte ma, khatiy thueta i thiy aa? Kha tluv a catlipa tama i hringna hing a chuo aa? tapa kha na pachang sa tie.
I hringna hing sungtung cuo dyi pasiy sa cate, na hmiekunglie khaapahmuo cuo vyi; i hringna cuo hing yi kha huv sung tluv dyi hmisi tana a cuo.
Cawsaa bangkhuo hing ningdiy haa tana amaa hnyile. Khaapahmuo a cuo lipa kawlie kha amaa kalaa; sue hne thiy kha amaa pacung, cuorasala a cutuv riypa kha ahungtama a cuo tapa pachang va yi.
“Caacuokieca Vya Abyipa, khaapama ica huo hnuochuopa ta a cuo? I nguopuona ca nama'a liena a aw.
I tuesuena bangkhuo chung taa hingta na khuo la, a ngaapa zaw ese riypata na tue thi khah.
Nama tuepa hmang a cuo nakawta, a dieta tah aw angte i ryi hehmuo pathlie va ang.
Kama kha duo na te thi khah tie; ina tuv nakaw ca ta vuotaa i thiy'a nang.
Cawsaapa kha a sue nakawta chuo cate duo na te tiyta, alungpa ta a cepa haata a ling kha a zuele. Cawsaapa hing yi kha huv sung tluv hmisi dyi tana a cuo.

Vya Abyipa, i thlaachuona kha na thyi la i khinapa kha na naathlie thi tie. I mingthliy a lang ning hing na mangthluo thi khah, tahematapakieca i mingpa tie hne i paa tie zaw haata, kama ca cuo khata dyina na khyche ta i cuo.
I thiy i li hluo hingta, a cawta chuo i palung a tluo the riypata, a hrang luo kha naa hyise thi tie.”
Abyipakha palung pasiysa pata huo angte, i khina ueryi kha na naathlie te ina thyi.
Aa thuvsapa khuetlung, caakaw chung taa khata na thue te, Alung cunglie kha na patu te, aa bangsa pata hne a cusa pata ina chi.
Ma Khazing pathuosana hlaa thaapa kha ina pacuv. Cawsaa hluvsa ta hmung'a yi te ama ciy aa, cakhutaata Abyipakha ama zang aa.
Abyipakha a ringchuo te, hruotlena hnyi li pata, aa hmuo lipa khazing hrangpa abie lipa ca thluechiypa tana a cuo.
Vya Abyipai Khazing, ma cuota hmang pha na tuepa hne kaw malie na pacuona hing a hluv hringhruo; nama haapa ahunghmuo aw va yi. A bangkhuo ta ri pata phu khing ang sala, a chuo hehmuo chuo khu'a vyi.
Hriykhungrina hne pihluona kha khing lipa cata, cuorasala naavuona kha ina pi ciy. Myirue panaana sue pathe sa panaana kha na khingpa cuo vyi.
Cakhutaa cata, “Hingpa lie hingna i aw; caataw caa-uv chunglie ca kama kaw na a cape.
Vya i Khazing, na khingna tue ca i nuo khyisa, na phungbie ca i palung chungliena a aw,” i ta.
Vya Abyipa, aa pungpa cawsaa hluvpuv hmielie kha, a law aa chiypa khuona thuophaa ca ri angte, na pachangna haata a taw he taw buo va ang.

Malie na khuona byana hing i palung chunglie nu buo va ang, zang tluo naa tlana hne na khuona kaw ca i ri pari. Aa hmangpa na duena hne zang tluo naa tlana ca, a pungpa cawsaa hluvpuv hmielieta nu buo va ang.
Vya Abyipa, na nangduena kha kama'a taata la thi khah, aa hmangpa na duena hne zang tluo naa tlana ta aa bangta tah na chi pari se.
Pha lina ri tie li ta ina cadung, i pha lina ta na vya pha te, i hmung thepa aw va tli. I suena ca i luv cunglie i suo laata hluv vie te, i palung na a chuo hringhruo.
Vya Abyipa, ata hingta na khuo thi tie; Vya Abyipa, a catli pata naa bya thi tie.
Kama naa thie khingpa tie ca ama nang zaa sala a kalaa diy yi se. Naa para naa pakyi khingpa tie ca hnangluo a pali pata a ruo yi sala hmiechi nangzaa pata aw yi se.
“Haa! haa!” ta pata naa pahnyisuepa tie ca ama nang a zaa nakawta ama palung ra se.
Cuorasala nama caa huvpa tie ca, ama palung tluo sala a law yi se; na khuona a pasung a panaapa tie ta, “Lesyina ca Abyipahuopa tana a cuo!” ta pari yi se.
Kama ca i siy na a pasa, cuorasala Abyipata kaw ina pacuo. Nama ca naa byatuv hne naa khuotuv tana na cuo; haasaa thi khah, Vya i Khazing.
A siypasapa tie kaw a pacuopa ca aa lawpa tana ama cuo; ruvnaana chungtaata Abyipata a khuo yi.
Abyipata mangchiy yi te, ama hringna kha a pabang yi. Ruo chunglie kha palungtluo pata pa-awsa yi te, ama carie tie kuv chung luo pachiysa'a va yi.
Ama pasa ning kha Abyipata a bya yi te, ama tluo lina bangkhuo taata a patluo sa yi.
“Vya Abyipa, vi na hnyi la, na patluosa tie; tahematapakieca na cungliena i sue tli.” i ta.
I carie tie ta hietliena na hnyi yi te, khatiythuema thiy'a te a ming hing a li aa, ama ta.
Kama kha ina vya mang tiy yi ta, a cuo lipa bie kha ama ri, i thuochi ri riypa dyi kha ama palung lie ama pakiy; ama pyale tiyta hmangting lieta ama rile.
Naa huepa bangkhuo khata i kaw ca na ri paruv yi te, i cuota a chie ce riypa kha ama rue.
Thiypasa ta a pasa nakawta, aa ziena taata thu'a va tli, ina ta yi.
I viesaa pha cepa, i ringchuo cepa hne, i sa a ningpa na, hekhuo naa khuo.
Cuorasala VyaAbyipa, vieriy i thung khu riypa yi ta, vi na hnyi la na pathu thi tie.
I carie tie ta ina te li nakaw yi ta, i cunglie na palung a tluopa kha i pachang aa.
I dang nakawta naa bya cate, na hmiekunglieta ina pa-aw sa pari ciy.
Israel Khazing Abyipaca chuozaa ta chuozaa te thluechiypa cuo mang sue. Amen! Amen!
Sasuv ta cavaa tiy cakaa diyliypa kha a vuopa haata, Vya Khazing, nama kha ica vuo.
I hringna ta a hringpa Khazing kha, tiyhrie ta aca hrie. Khatiythuema naa thaa luo chiy'a angte na hmie ica hmung khu aa?
I mingthliy ca chung hne zuo ta i sa ta cuo te, I carie tie ta, “Na Khazing ca khaapaliema a aw?” ta pata ci li ta ina hiehriy yi.
Cawsaazaapuv hne a patluole pate, Khazing ing luo i cakuokhyinapa yi, alawna hne ule pate, pathuosana hlaa ma salepa kha i thyi pakhaa tiyta, i palung ca a kyi ta a kyi.
Khaapanakawma hing tluv ta i ngie a chi? Khaapanakawma hing tluv ta i palung rie a thyi? Naa byatuv hne i Khazing ca a nguopuo'a angte, i pathuosa pakhaa aa.
I palung rie na a thyi hringhruo, caacuonakawta Jordan ruo hne Hermon ruo, Mizar Tluo taa khata nama ca icaa thyi pakhaa.
Tiy aa thuvpa ta tiy aa thuv hrangpa kha a ku; tiysue pu ca khalung haata a thy te, na tiylaw pachipa ta kama kha i na vya.
Ningchung ca Abyipata aa hmangpa a duena kha malie a pahmung sa. Zuo ta ca ama pathuosana hlaa kha sa angte, i hringna ta a cuopa Khazing'a luo kha thlaa i chuo.
I lungpuvnung, i Khazing kha “Khaapanakawma ina maw ciy? Khaapanakawma i carie tie tuechienapa ca ngiechisa pata i ang byalya aa?”
I carie tie ta na tue hyalya yi te, “Na Khazing ca khaapaliema a aw?” ina ta paripa yi bie ca, i pangpa lie hing thiykhyi riypa hmaa haa tana a pasa,” i ta.
Vya i thlaapa, khaapanakawma hing tluv ta na ngie a chi? Khaapanakawma hing tluv ta na palung rie a thyi? Naa byatuv i Khazing ca a nguopuo'a angte, i pathuosa pakhaa aa.
Vya Khazing, i sue lina kaw kha na pathyipa la, naa dupa tie hmielie kha naa daakhyi la i bie na ripa tie. A hanghiepa hne aa hmuo lipa tie taa khata na khuo tie.
Nama ca i canawnapa i Khazing tana na cuo; khaapanakawma ina thaw ciy? Carie tie ina tuechiena kawlie yi ta khaapanakawma i ngiy pari aa?
Na khena hne biehmisipa ca za pathlie la, kama kha luo naa chiy se; iema ta na tluo pathepa hne na awna hmang luo kha naa chiy yi se.
Cakhutaata Khazing hriykhungrina tluophie luo kha vaa'a angte, Khazing kha tingtuo ta pathuosa'a angte, khuopuv ta i nuo aa. Vya Khazing, i Khazing.
Vya i thlaapa, khaapanakawma hing tluv ta na ngie a chi? Khaapanakawma hing tluv ta na palung rie a thyi? Naa byatuv i Khazing ca a nguopuo'a angte, i pathuosa pakhaa aa.
Vya Khazing, iema chuo, chuo hlung ningta, khaapama na za tue tapa kha ma mingchingmingvuo tie ta malie za chang yi te, ma naa ta ma za thyi tli:

Nama ta na kuv hrahring ta mingphang zaw kha zaa cade yi cate, cuorasala na mingphang zaw ca ama hruo na pacu yi, mingphang zaw ca duo za te yi cate, cuorasala na mingphang zaw ca hya na za pazang yi.

Na mingphang tie ta capa ruo ca ama zueziy ta ama za tepa cuo vyi, iema cahrana ta ama za tepa zaw cuo vyi; cuorasala nama ta na due nakaw yi ta, hmiephaa na pi parinapa yi hne, a cahrapa na cacuoluo kuv hne na buo thueta ama tepa tana a cuo.
Nama ca i Siepahruo hne i Khazing tana na cuo; Jakob ta tena a hmung riypata bie na pi.
Nama thueta ma carie tie kha te yi pate, khuopuv ta malie a dupa tie kha na ming ta ma te yi.
I liy hing a ringchuo va ang, i zueziy zaw ta na khuo khu vyi.
Cuorasala ma carie tie kuv taata malie khuo cate, malie a huepa tie kha ama nang na pazaa yi.
Khazing kha a palesakhyi pari'a pate, a ming kha chuozaa ta ma pathuosa pari aa.
Cuorasala ata hing nama ta malie thaw cate malie na pasung sa, ma rieka tie hne sihne va tli ciy.
Ma carie tie ta malie te yi te, ma chechiy bangkhuo kha malie ama chuv.
Thie riypa tuvtaata haata malie tue cate, ruo ting luo kha malie na chepatlaa.
Na cawsaa zaw ca chechiy saalipa haata zaa yi cate, ama muo kha aa suopuv ta hu vaciy.
Ma ingpaa zaw pahnyisue riypata malie tue cate, ma cahriylie a awpa tie ta malie ama ese hyalya.
Mingphang zaw hrawlie nutaapa ta malie tue cate, pahnyisuepa hne luv chysue hyalya riypata malie na tue.
Ma carie tie hne vieriy malie a thungpa tie, tue hyalyana bie i thyi nakawta,
Iema hmiekunglie kha ning-aw ningtlabu ta i nang zaa te i hmie a chi.
Capa zaw bangkhuo ca ma cunglie a tlung raalaa pata, nama kha ca maw lipa pata, na biekuo zaw kha para vapuv.
Ma palung zaw kaa li pata, na luopuv taata pie vapuv.
Cuorasala ruo-uv tie hrawlie kha malie thawsiy cate, zingna chaapuv ta malie a buvkhung.
Ma Khazing ming kha maw pate, khazing hrangpa kha maa bie kieca,
Khazing ta malie hmung'a va ma? Tahematapakieca ama ca palung chung bieparuv kha a pachang.
Nama kawlieta kiema ca ning-aw ningtlabu ta thiepa cuo pate, thie riypa tuv haata ruepa ta ma cuo.
Vya Abyipakhaapanakawma naa hmung? Kya thu tie, chuozaa ta malie thaw khah!
Khaapanakawma na hmie ca malie na nu khuo? Khaapanakawma malie ama tuechiena hne ma riethyina ca malie na mawpa?
Alyi lie a lie pate, buvcing liena maa naw.
Kya thu la malie a bya tie. Aa hmangpa na duena thueta kiema kha malie khuo tie.
I palung chunglie bie phapa ta bi te, hingpa hlaa hing siepahruo ca i phy; i palyi ca caa cape a thepa caasung hne tana aa lu.
Nama ca capaa hrawlie a puvthe cepa tana na cuo; na palyi na pakaa a thlungsa; caacuonakawta Khazing ta chuozaa ta thluechiy aca pi.
Vya a cahrapa siepahruo, na zueziy kha na se lie a pathlie tie; nama ca a cahrapa siepahruo tana na cuo.
Biehmisipa hne aa dangpa bie kawlie kha, na lesyina hne si la tena hmung tie; a cahrapa na buo ta tena lepuv ca pi se.
Na cuoti ca cahre te, na carie tie palung kha a daw pahli; cawsaa ca na phyi thabaw lie amaa lie.
Vya Khazing, na byithude ca chuozaa ta aa hmang. Na siepahruo khuecahryi ca a khing a nguona khuecahryi tana a cuo;
adangna kha tlechuo cate pha lina kha na hue. Caacuonakawta Khazing, na Khazing ta caa tlaw te, na viesaa tie laata ca cyicalang vie te, palungtluona sathu kha aca pathuv;
na cawsie bangkhuo ca mura ziyhmyi hne aloes ziyhmyi hne kassia ziyhmyi rang ta a pa-ue diy. Ale nue ta sapa siepahruo ing lie kha, hlaasana hne tungpa ueryi zaw ta na palung aca patluo.
Na ing lie a awpa pa-uvsathyipa a byinung zaw hrawlie kha siepahruo sacanung zaw aw ra yi te, Ofir siy pha cepa suethiy a tuepa siepahruonung ca na cacuoluo kuo lie kha a aw.
Vya sacanung, naathlie la pacuo tie, na cawsaa zaw hne na paa ing kha maw tie,
na puvthena kha siepahruo ta aca tlechuo aa. Na byipaapa ta a cuo nakawta a hmiekunglie kha a bung tie.
Tair cawsaa zaw ta lasaw a vya cyi'a yi te, na palung patluo amaa vya zue aa. A hnyirungpa tie zaw ta ama hnyipa phangting kha hmuo'a yi te, na palung patluo amaa zue aa.
Siepahruo sacanung ca aa ziena khuo lie kha siy taapuopa caw aa tue,
siepahruo'a luo kha cakuokhyi yi te, a lesaa pathenung tie hne a viesaa zaw ta ama paziy.
Alawna hne palungtluona hneta a chiy pakhawle yi te, siepahruo ing chung luo ca amaa ngie.
Vya siepahruo, sacapaa zaw hnyi'a yi cate, paa hne mingpa tie hmang lie kha chuelyi ting lieta siepahruo ama cuo aa.
Chuo bangkhuo lie na ming pathuosa riypata pacuo sa'a angte, cawsaa bangkhuo ta chuozaa ta aca pathuosa'a yi.
Khazing ca ma canawna hne ma thaazuo tana a cuo, malie awpuo pari te ruvnaana cuo ningta malie a byatuv tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta alyi ca a cahang te, tluo ca riyliy chung luo aa thaw zawta ciy'a va ang.
Riyliy tiylaw thu te aa hrung kie cuose, tluo zaw amaa cahang kie zaw ta ciy'a va ang.
Cungnungce awna a pathepa, Khazing khypuv palung a patluopa cavaa suokha a aw.
Ca khypuv chunglie ca Khazing a aw nakawta, khatiy tahmuo ra buo'a vyi; mawdiy ta Khazing kha a vaw'a te capa khypuv ca aa bya aa.
Mingphang zaw ca a cathangsa yi te, uvna ruo zaw amaa cahang; Khazing ta a ueryi ca khuosa ta pathlie te, alyi ca a tiyta aa li.
Cungnungce Abyipaca kiema'a liena a aw; Jakob Khazing ca ma canawna tana a cuo.
A vaw ung la Abyipahmang tuepa hing vya mang tie ung; alyi lie a tuepa nang-uo aa chiypa hmang hing mang tie ung.
Alyi dena te ta rie kha a padie sa; liy kha thli diy te, asyi kha a thlipachung diy; phya bangkhuo kha myi ta a rue diy.
“A diesa pata a thling ung la, Khazing i cuopa kha na pachang tie ung! Mingphang zaw hrawlie, Alyi cunglie cyicalangpa tana i cuo.”
Cungnungce Abyipaca kiema'a liena a aw; Jakob Khazing ca ma canawna tana a cuo.
Cawsaa bangkhuo nama kuv cabe ung la; Khazing kha palungtluona hlaa ta khuopuv ta pathuosa tie ung.
CungnungceAbyipaca ciy aa chiypa tana a cuo, alyi cung bangkhuo uvtuv, a lesyipa siepahruo tana a cuo.
Cawsaa zaw kha ma rawlie chi yi te, mingphang zaw kha ma phyi rawlie a chi yi.
Ma cuota ma awna riypa ruo kha malie a tlawpa te, a duepa Israel ming ta amaa palesakhyipa ruo khata a cuo.
Khazing ca tena ueryi hneta a kya kie, Abyipaca hmyakaa pu hne tana a kya kie.
Khazing pathuosana hlaa kha sa tie ung; ma siepahruo pathuosana hlaa kha sa tie ung.
Khazing ca alyicung siepahruo tana a cuo, Salm hlaa kha sa ung la pathuosa tie ung.
Khazing ca mingphang zaw cunglie siepahruo ta a cuo; Khazing ca a pathepa byithude liena aa tu.
Mingphang tie siepahruo zaw ca, Abraham Khazing cawsaa zaw haa kha tana suv kha lie amaa hmya. Chuelyi cahrana bangkhuo hing Khazing huopa tana a cuo; ama ca a hlyi ta cyicalangpa tana a cuo.
Abyipaca a lesyipa cuo te, ma Khazing khypuv lie kha khuopuv ta pathuosapa cuo mang sue.
A suo te a puvthepa, a pathepa a tluo ca alyicung bangkhuo ta amaa lawna tana a cuo. Chaluo luohlaapuv lie a awpa Zion ca Siepahruo lepa khypuv tana a cuo.
Khypuv cariekyikuo chunglie kha Khazing ama hrahring ca carie kuv taata iema a daapakhuotuv a cuonapa kha a paluo sa.
Cakhutaata siepahruo tie ca suv kha ta amaa hmya pakhaw.
Capa tluo ca ama hmung pahne ta ama nang ta uo te, a pahlusa yi te amaa ruo.
Ama ciy tuv pata a cathangsa yi te, nu a pazipa canung haata pasana ama ang,
ningchiyluo thliy ta Tarshish tiypalaw a para diypa haa tana ama cuo.
Ma za thyipa haata, CungnungceAbyipakhypuv, ima Khazing khypuv lie kha ma ming ta ma hmung tli.
Vya Khazing, aa hmangpa na duena ca, na biena-ing chunglie ma pacuo syalya.
Vya Khazing, na ming pathuosana ca alyi dena te tana a pha.
Na biechina thue khata, Zion Tluo ca a law sala, Judah sacanung zaw ca ama palung tluo se.
Zion kha cahlung ung la, a suopa a ing zaw kha ri tie ung,
a khypuv dungkhuo kaw kha pacuo ung la, ama riekhuopiehu kha mang tie ung.
Cakiedyina nama saa nama nu zaw kha Khazing ca chuozaa ta ma Khazing cuo te, chuozaa ta luo malie a chiytuv tana a cuo, tapa kha nama chang the aa.
Cawsaa bangkhuo zaw, hingpa hing thyi tie ung; chuelyi lie a awpa bangkhuo zaw naathlie tie ung.
Aa ne aa suo, dawphaapa hne dawchiepa tie zaw, naathlie pakhaw tie ung.
I pakaa ta singna kha ri'a angte, i palung lie pachangna kha i pacuo aa.
Phungthluvbie kha naathlie'a angte, tingtuo tungpuo pata a siyluo kha i ri aa.
Khaapanakawma ruvnaana cuo lie kha i ciy aa, kama naa hrisaapa tie pha lina ta ina cadung ning kha
ama hnyirungna kha a buchuo yi te a hruotlepa tie ta ina cadung ning yi kha khaapanakawma i ciy aa?
Cawsaa pakha hringna kha ahungtahmuo a thla khu vyi, Khazing kha capa cuo ca ta a thlana muo a pi khupa pakha hmuo aw va yi.
Tahematapakieca cawsaa hringna ca a muo ruv tuv te,
cawsaa pakha thiy lipa ta chuozaa hringna riypa ca a muo khazaa pi zawta a zu khu vyi.
A singpa tie zaw thiy yi te, a ngaapa hne pachangna a hnyi lipa tie zaw ama thiy, ama hnyirungna kha malie cuo tana ama thuse siy kaluo.
Alyi kha ama za hnyi zawta, ama thluo ca ama chuozaa ing ta cuo te, capa lie ca chuozaa ta ama aw aa.
Cawsaa ca ama lesyi hnyirungna lie kha a hmang'a va yi, saruopa haa kha tana ama thiy ra aa.
Capa ca a ngaapa tie hne a vuophana lie a palung a tluopa tie cuona tana a cuo.
Tuv haata a thiy riypata rue ciepa ta cuo yi te, thiyna ca iema tuvkhietuv ta a cuo aa; thluo luo kha a dangsa pata si'a yi te, ama hmingsuo ca a vie aa; Athiykhy kha ama ing ta a cuo aa.
Cuorasala Khazing ta i hringna kha athiykhy cahrana taata naa thla'a te inaa la aa.
Cawsaa pakha kya hnyirung te, a ing lie a hnyirungna a kiethaw hryly ning kha na kharuehaa khah se.
Ama thiy tiyta suo kha hmuo a phyale khu'a va yi; ama hnyirungna ta ziybung khu'a va yi.
Ama hring ning ca na cuota hmang pha ama tue ningta na pathuosa nakaw yi ta a law ra mang yi sala,
ama paa tie hne ama mingpa tie zaw hneta aw pakhaw riypa tana ama si aa, khena a hmung pakhaapa aw'a va yi.
Cawsaapa ca ama lesyi hnyirungna lie kha a hmang'a va yi; saruopa haa kha tana ama thiy ra aa.
Lesyice Khazing Abyipata bie ri te, alyi ca ningchiy taata ningtla te a u.
Puvthena a tlingnapa Zion taata, Khazing ca ning haata a vya khe.
Ma Khazing ca a vaw te, cuorasala a dieta tah aa vawpa cuo vyi, a hmiekunglie a hlaa nguoluopa myi aw te, a cahriylie thliysung a pakhie.
A cawsaa zaw bie ripa riypata alyi hne avuo kha a ku yi:
“I cuota zang tluo aa tlapa hne, hriykhungrina ta kama hne bie a kuopa zaw kama’ luo a vya hmya tie ung!”
Khazing ama hrahring ta bieripana a tue nakawta, avuo ta aa dangna kaw kha a pathyi sa.
“Vya i cawsaa zaw, naathlie tie ung, bie na i ri aa, Vya Israel, nama a dupa tana tehte i khuo aa. Kama ca Khazing, na Khazing tana i cuo.
Nama hriykhungrina kawlieta ca chuo va yi ang; nama myirue panaana ca i hmiekunglie aa pazue pari.
Nama ing lie nama cuetungpa hne, nama sahring zaw chungtaata mie zaw kha cuhluo'a va ang.
Ruo lie saruopa bangkhuo hing kama huopa cuo te, tluo thawkha cunglie a tlepa sahring bangkhuo hing, i huopa tana a cuo.
Avuo lie a zupa pavaa bangkhuo hne, ruo lie a awpa saruopa bangkhuo zaw hing, kama huopa tana ama cuo.
“I nang diy sala ca chang'a va yi ang, tahematapakieca chuelyi hne a cunglie a awpa bangkhuo hing kama huopa tana a cuo.
Cuetungpa saa kha i ce ma? mie thiy zaw kha i dang ma?
Khazing ca palungtluo hriykhungrina kha pihluo la, Cungnungce ca bie namaa kuopa bangkhuo kha pi tie ung.
Ruvnaana cuo ning kha na u ung la, ca khuo'a yi angte ina pathuosa'a ung ciy.
Cuorasala Khazing ta cawsaa pha lipa tie kha: “Khaapanakawma i phungbie kha cie ung cate, i biekuona ca nama ri?
Pasiypa-yana kha hue ung cate, i bie kha nama hnangluo nama thaw.
Aparuvpa kha nama hmung tiyta a viesaa ung cate, nungvaathingsuena a tuepa tie kha namaa viesaa.
“Na palyi ta bie pyalyipa kha ri pari cate, na palyi ta hangna bie kha na tuechaw.
A tu cate na tieta zaw kaw kha na ri, na puvhnepa zaw kawchie kha na ri.
Khapa hmang zaw kha na tue raalaa pata, a dieta tah i aw nakawta, nama haapa ta ina rue ciy. Cuorasala ata hing ca ca chuo angte, na suena kha na hmiekunglie i phu aa.
“Khazing a mawpa zaw, hingpa bie hing a cake tie ung, cata a cuo li kieca ca thlaapatlaa diy'a yi angte, ahungtahmuo ca khuo khu'a va yi.
Kama pa-uvsathyina ta palungtluo hriykhungrina a tuepa tie hne, luo dangpa a ziypa tie ca, Khazing khuona kha i pahmung sa hrahring'a yi,” a ta.
Vya Khazing aa hmangpa na duena thueta, ngie na chi thi tie; a lepa na nangduena thueta, i tuesuena kha pathe sa thi tie.
I pha lina bangkhuo taa hingta na pasiy la, i suena taa hingta na pathe sa tie.
I tuesuepa a pachang angte, i suena ca i thyi pari.
Nama cunglie, nama cunglie hrahring na i sue, na minghmungna liena hmang pha lipa i tue. Caacuonakawta na biechina ca a dang te, na bieripana ca risie riy aw vyi.
Hmisi ta ripa kieca, i puv baataata a sue a paapa tana i cuo, i nung ta a riy chunglie ina phya ning taata a suepa tana i cuo.
Nama ca biehmisipa a khingpa tana na cuo; caacuonakawta i pathiypalung hing singna ta na pabi tie.
Hissop ta na pathe sa la i pathe aa; na pasiy la cahue laata i ruo aa.
Palungtluona hne alawna ueryi ca na pathyi sa thi la, na thlibaruv diypa i ruv ca a law pakhaa thi se.
I suena kha na hmungpa thi li pata, i pha lina kha na thawpa thi tie.
Vya Khazing, i chunglie hing a pathepa pathiypalung sa thi la, a thaapa hne aa dangpa thlaapa kha khung thi tie.
Na awna hmang taata na thaw thi khah, na Thlaapa Pathe zaw kama'a taata na lapa thi khah.
Na khuona palungtluona kha na pi pakhaa la, ri-angiena pathiypalung kha i chunglie pahmang sa thi tie.
Cahaacata a suepa tie kha na luopuv pacuv'a yi angte, nama'a luo amaa vya pali pakhaa aa.
Vya Khazing, kama naa khuotuv, thiyse langna taata na khuo la, nama malie naa thlana hlaa kha khuopuv ta i sa aa.
Vya Abyipai hmya hing pahaw la, i pakaa ta nama pathuosana kha pathyi sa se.
Tahematapakieca nama ca hriykhungrina kha tlechuo vaciy; myirue panaana kha pi caa nang ang sala, na palung tluo'a vyi.
Khazing cuhluo tluo aa tlapa hriykhungrina ca pathiypalung kyichipa hing tana a cuo; pathiypalung kyichipa hne a ngiepachiypa ca nama ta da buo vaciy, Vya Khazing.
Vya Khazing, Zion ca ngiechi la a bya thi tie; Jerusalem khypuv lungruetlepie ca sa pakhaa thi tie,
ca tiyta aa hmuopa hriykhungrina hne, myirue panaana lie kha naa law aa. Cakhutaata na hriykhungrina tluophie lie kha cuetungpa hriykhungrina pi pata na cuo aa.
A cahrapa cawsaapa, khaapanakawma a hruo tle cate, Khazing a ciyzaapa tie kha ruvnaana na pi yi? Parapakyi riypa kha ning-aw ta khue na khuo.
Na palyi ca a cahrepa sephiecizung lu te, biekuo pathli pata hanghie re a hriepa tana na cuo.
Phana laata pha lina kha due vie cate, biehmisipa ripa laata hanghiena bie ri kha na khing vie.
Vya a hanghiepa palyi, malie a parapa bie bangkhuo kha na tlechuosa.
Cuorasala Khazing ta chuozaa ta aca para aa; ca patuv'a te na thluodaa chung taa khata aca papya aa.
Aa dangpa tie ta hmung'a yi te ama ciy aa, pha lina a tuepa tie kha pahnyisue'a yi te,
“Mang tie ung, Khazing'a lie a canaw li pata, ama hnyirungna kha a buchuo yi te, ama pha lina lie pali kha abangna a aw a tapa tie hing,” a ca ta'a yi.
Cuorasala kama ca Khazing ing lie a hringsiyliypa olif kung na i lu. Aa hmangpa Khazing duena kha chuozaa ta i ruechuo.
Na tuepa hmang kawlieta nama kha chuozaa ta icaa law aa. Na phana kaw kha zang tluo aa tlapa, na cawsaa zaw hmiekunglie i ukhyi pari aa.
Cawsaa ngaapa tie ta ama palungruv lie kha, “Khazing aw vyi,” ama ta. Iema ca ra yi te, duvsamakhie aa chiypa hmang kha ama tue; hmang pha a tuepa pakha hmuo aw va yi.
Khazing ta cawsaapa hing a singpa hne Khazing a huvpa pakha chuo aw yi ma ta pata vuoruo taa khiy ta a za mang.
Iema bangkhuo ca amaa lie diy tli, ama bangkhuo tana aa lusa pata ama ra diy tli; hmang pha a tuepa pakha hmuo aw va yi, pakhata hmuo aw va yi.
Pha lina a tuepa tie hing pachangna hnyi va yi ma? I cawsaa zaw kha viechuo ce haata ce diy yi te, Khazing kha u va yi.

Capa lie ca ciy aa chiypa hmanglepuv, ning hrang ningta a tlung buo lipa a tlung aa. Tahematapakieca Khazing ta ama a pachang lipa tie ruv kha a zepatlaa aa; Khazing ta a thaw nakaw yi ta nangzaana ama ang aa.
Israel ming athlana ca Zion taata a vaw se! Khazing ta a cawsaa zaw kha vuophana a pi pakhaa tiy yi ta, Jakob ca a palung tluo'a te, Israel ca aa law aa.
Vya Khazing na ming ta na khuo la, na cahrana ta i sue lina kha paluosa tie.
Vya Khazing i thlaachuona kha na thyipa la, i pakaa ta i ripa bie kha na naathlie thi tie.
Tahematapakieca aa hruopa tie kha kama a du riypata thu yi te, malie ngiechina a hnyi lipa tie ta thie inaa nang yi. Khazing hmie kha hmuo mang va yi.
Cuorasala Khazing ca naa byatuv ta a cuo hrahring; Abyipaca kama naa byatuv tana a cuo.
I carie tie pha lina kha thung'a yi te, zang tluo aa tlana ta a para diy'a yi.
Palung thusa pata nama kha hriykhungrina ca pi'a angte, Vya Abyipa, na ming kha ica pathuosa aa; tahematapakieca capa ca a pha.
Tahematapakieca ruvnaana phangting taata na khuo cate, i carie tie kha tena ming ta i mang yi.
Vya Khazing i thlaachuona hing na naathlie thi tie; ngiechi icaa hienapa hing naathlie li pata na aw thi khah.
Na naathlie la na palie thi tie; i hrungna tana i nang a buo hringhruo tli.
I carie tie hne cawsaa pha lipa tie ina khisuena yi ueryi kawlieta khaapama i tue aa tapa a pachang va ang. Tahematapakieca ruvnaana na pi yi te, inaa carie yi.
I palung rie thyi hringhruo te, ciy aa chiypa thiyna i cunglie a vya tla.
Ciyna hne thlaazangna ta bi angte, aa siy ta i siy.
“Thuvruv haa mathlaa hnyi ang sala, luohlaa luo a zu'a angte i pahy hyalya'apa kha!
Luohlaa luo kha a zu hmisi'a angte, ruocaapa lie i va aw'pa kha.
Khysuv hne thliychie taata law riypata, a catli pata awna hmang i hmung'apa kha,” i ta.
Vya Abyipa, ama ryi kha kalaa sa diy tie yi, tahematapakieca khypuv chunglie i hmungpa ca tuechiena hne a hru a ina tana a cuo.
Khypuv kha chung hne zuo ta cahlung yi te, pha lina hne ruvnaana ta a bi.
Rana ca khypuv liekhingkhuo lie kha aw te, hrisaana hne dungviena ca luopuv bangkhuo ta a bi.
Naa pasiy naa pasaapa hing i carie ta cuo va yi, cuo yi sala ca i ang khu thluo aa. Naa pahnyisuepa tie hing i carie tie ta cuo va yi, cuo yi sala i nuse khu thluo'a yi.
Cuorasala hing haa hingta naa tapa hing, nama, i khepa, i viesaa, i tlasapa viesaa;
pakha hne pakha bie ting zaa rue pate, zaapuv hneta biena-ing luo i za cakuohne tawpa tana na cuo.
I carie tie cunglie ca thiyna tlung sala, ama hringpa ta athiykhy luo si yi se; tahematapakieca ama ing chunglie hne ama palung chungliena pha lina a aw.
Kama ca Khazing kha u angte, Abyipata ina khuo aa.
Maw ta cuose, ningchung ta cuose, zuoluocaw ta cuose, a ngiy a phie byalya angte, i ueryi ca ina thyipa aa.
Naa dupa a hluvpuv hne rie maa duna taa khata, aa bangsa pata ina vya kaakhyi aa.
Chuozaa ta uvtuv byi a cuopa Khazing ta na thyi'a te iema kha a pachung'a yi. Tahematapakieca Khazing kha ciy pata a thle va yi.
I viesaapa ta a viesaa cunglie a kuv pathlie te, a biekuo kha a para.
A bie ca thawpat laata tlue vie te, cuorasala a palung chunglie ca huena na a aw.
Na hmang kha Abyipa'alie pachung la, ama ta acaa bya aa. Cawsaa aa dangpa kha, khatiy tahmuo pa sung sa'a vyi.
Vya Khazing, iema kha aa thuvsapa khue chung luo pathla'a yi cate, lie a nawpa hne a hanghiepa tie ca ama chuo khingkhuo hmuo palang'a va yi. Cuorasala kama ca nama na icaa ringchuo aa.
Vya Khazing vi na hnyi thi tie, cawsaa na na ese yi te naa tlawpuole yi. Ning-aw tana i carie tie ta ina hrisaa yi.
Ning aw tana i carie tie ta na chaapuole yi te, cawsaa hluvpuv ta inaa du yi.
Vya Cungnungce, i ciy tiyta, nama kha icaa ringchuo.
Khazing kha a ringchuo angte, a biekuo kha i pathuosa.
I re hriepa bangkhuo kha ning-aw ta para a ting yi te, ama ruena bangkhuo hing kama a duna ta a cuo.
A hru kuo na phie yi te, naa bawkhuo yi te, ina mangpathliy yi.
Thie inaa tingpa haa yi khata, ama suena kha thung yi la, Vya Khazing, na hihaana ta iema kha pathla tie yi.
Kha tluv tama i palung rie a thyi tapa kha na pachang; i mingthliy ca na ungthyi chunglie raw cate, na caa-uv chunglie na khung cuo va ma?
Khazing ca kama kuo luo ta a aw nakawta, Ama i u ningpa ca i carie tie kha amaa ruo diy aa, tapa i pachang.
Khazing biekuona kha i pathuosa, Abyipabiekuona kha i pathuosa.
Khazing kha a ringchuo angte, ahunghmuo ciy va ang, Cawsaapa ta ca tuokhaa hmuo na ta khu'a va yi.
Vya Khazing, nama'a lie bie i kuopa kha i tue hrahring aa; palungtluo hriykhungrina kha ica pihluo aa.
I hringna kha thiyna taata a thla cate, i lie li riypata i phyi kha ina cawchue ciy; caacuonakawta hringna luopuv khepa, Khazing hmiekunglie kha i cakuo aa.
Ngie na chi thi tie, Vya Khazing, ngie na chi thi tie, tahematapakieca i hringna na nama caa canaw. Paratuv khysuv aa pena te ta, na mathlaa ningdiy rawlie na i canaw aa.
I cuota aa tingna a patlingsatuv, Cungnungce Khazing kha i u.
Vuoruo taa khiyta na za chaw'a te ina khuo aa, kama naa tlawpuopa tie kha nangzaa pata a chi'a yi. Khazing ta aa hmangpa a duena hne, zang tluo aa tlana kha ina pahmung sa aa.
Cawsaa sie a hmuopa chingde zaw hrawlie na i laa; ama haa ca a syi hne cuoti lu te, ama palyi ca zueziy haa tana a cahre.
Vya Khazingavuo khung te khiy ta cyicalangpa cuo la, na rungnaana ca alyi cung yalya hing buv diy se.
I cakuona lie cyihyi na thlakhuo le yi te, i hring rie na a thyi hringhruo. I luopuv lie suphung na cu khuo yi te, cuorasala iema pali ama tla.
I palung ca aa hmang, Vya Khazing, i palung ca aa hmangsa. Hlaa sa'a angte na ica pathuosa aa.
I hringna, a hra tie! Vya tingtuolepa hne tingtuo zaw, a hra tie ung!
Vya Abyipa, cawsaa zaw hrawlie na ica pathuosa aa; mingphang zaw hrawlie na hlaa ta ica pathuosa aa.
Aa hmangpa na duena ca avuo haa khiyta a suo te, zang tluo naa tlana ca amyi te khiy tana a pha.
Vya Khazingavuo khung te khiy ta cyicalangpa cuo la, na rungnaana ca alyi cung yalya hing buv diy se.
Uvtuv zaw, aa dang pata biechina nama tue ma? Cawsaa kha aa dang pata bie nama ripa ma?
Ripa va ung ciy! Hmang pha lipa tue namaa tingpa dyi khana nama rue; alyi lie hing pha lina hne tuechiena nama patlung sa.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ca ama nung riy chungtaata a pha li ciepa ta za puv yi te hangbie a ripa ta ama cuo.
Iema ca pariy haata ca-ie hnyi yi te, A naa ruepa dawhyi haa tana ama cuo,
pamya a thepa hne pariy a dung thepa ueryi kha thyi va yi.
Vya Khazing, ama pakaa chunglie ama haa kha thli diy tie yi; Vya Abyipa, chingde tie ama nue kha thli diy tie!
Iema ca langle te a viepa tiy haata vie yi se; aphuv haa khata chaapuo yi sala caa yi se.
Cuokaruvpa a tiyta lang te a diemaduvpa ta aa lipa haata cuo yi se; nu ra te zaa puvpa haatiyta ningkhepa a hmung buo lipa haata cuo yi se.
A hling kung ta ama patiypa myi a lingpa kha bi ta a pachang hluota, a hringpa hne myi ta a kuo nguoluopa ahling kung zaw kha thliy ta phya sala pazu diy se!
Phuv amaa lapa kha a dangpa tie ta ama hmung tiyta ama palung tluo'a te, cawsaa pha lipa tie thiy lie kha ama phyi amaa siy aa.
Cawsaa zaw ta, “Cawsaa a dangpa zaw cuo ta lawmuo ca a aw hmisi; chuelyi bie a chipatuv Khazing ca a aw hmisi,” ama ta aa.
Vya i Khazing, i carie tie kuv taata na palawsa tie; kama naa dupa tie kuv taata na khuo tie.
A pha lipa tie kuv taata na palaw sa tie; cawsaa a thiepa tie kuv taata na khuo tie.
Kama ina thie khing nakaw yi ta inaa baw khuo yi; a thaaruvpa tie ca kama a du riypata amaa hmya. Vya Abyipa, i tuesuena kawlie hne i suena kawlieta cuo vyi,
i suena khaapahmuo a aw li raalaa pata a vya ruo yi te inaa bawkhuo yi. Kama a bya riypata kya thu la na mang tie!
Nama ca Cungnungce AbyipaKhazing, Israel ming Khazing tana na cuo. Mingphang zaw bangkhuo duote riypa khata thu tie; zyatena hne hmang pha lipa tue dyi a tingpa tie hing pakha hmuo pangaa khah yi.
Zuoluo kyry ta vya kaa yi te, uv haata ngale yi te, khypuv kha ama mang paruvle.
Ama pakaa taata pachiypahuona bie kha ama rile, Ama palyi taata a pyapa bie ca zueziy haata cahre te, “Ahungma malie a thyi aa?” ama ta.
Cuorasala Vya Abyipanama ta na pahnyisue yi; mingphang bangkhuo ca pahnyisue riypata na tue yi.
Vya i cahrana, nama na ica huo aa; Vya Khazing, nama ca i riekhuopiehu tana na cuo.
I Khazing ta aa hmangpa a duena hne naa taw'a te, i carie tie cunglie tena ina pahmung sa aa.
Iema kha thie khah yi, i cawsaa zaw na a maw pathlyi'a yi; na cahrana ta chepatlaa diy yi la para diy tie yi, Vya Abyipa, maa pakhuonapa phya.
Ama pakaa taata ama ripa bie hne ama suena kawlieta, ama hruotlena cyihyi lie kha a uo yi se. Ama ripa chiesana bie hne ama hanghiena kawlie khata,
na hihaana chunglieta ra diy yi se; pakha hmuo amaa ngaa lina te ta para diy karue tie yi. Cakhutaata Khazing ca Israel uvtuv a cuopa kha chuelyi dena te ta ama pachang aa.
Zuoluo kyry ta vya kaa yi te, uv haata ngale yi te, khypuv kha ama mang paruvle.
A la a huvpa uv haata a khiele yi te, ama riy a bi li nakawta ngale yi te ama khile.

Cuorasala kama ca na cahrana kha hlaa ta pathuosa'a angte, aa hmangpa na duena kha hlaa ta khuopuv ta i pathuosa aa. Tahematapakieca nama ca i riekhuopiehu cuo cate, i palung rie thyi ningta i canawna tana na cuo.
Vya i cahrana, nama ca ica pathuosa aa, Vya Khazing, nama ca i riekhuopiehu tana na cuo, aa hmangpa na duena naa pahmung sapa Khazing tana na cuo.
Vya Khazing, kiema kha malie thaw cate malie na para tli; ma cunglieta na hi a haa tli; ata hingta malie sa hru thi tie!
Chuelyi kha cahang cate, na ca-ang chi; a kyichinapa kha sapathiy tie, aa cahang nguoluo kalie.
Na cawsaa zaw kha ruvnaana khuopuv ta malie na pa-ang sa; dang riypa mingsuvtiy malie pi cate maa viele.
Cuoti rie taata capa luo ca amaa ruo the riypata nama caa ciyzaapa zaw cuota pangtaa na pathliepa yi.
Na duepa zaw hyazangna ama hmung the riypata, na cacuoluo kuv ta tena malie pi la, ma thlaachuona malie palie thi tie.
Khazing ta a hmangpathepa chunglie kha bie malie a kuo: “Palungtluona hneta Shekhem ca chechi'a angte, Sukkoth bawphie ca ica re'a yi.
Gilead ca kama huopa ta cuo te, Manasseh zaw kama huopa tana a cuo; Efraim ca i thaalakhuv ta cuo te, Judah ca i byikhuecahryi tana a cuo.
Moab ca i kuv a siynapa bikang ta cuo te, Edom ca i phyipakaw chinapa tana a cuo. Filistia kha te'a angte tena hneta i u aa,” a ta.
Ahungma dungkhuopa khypuv luo naa chiy aa? Ahungma Edom luo naa chiy aa?
Vya Khazing, malie na thaw tli cuo va ma? Vya Khazing, nama ca ma rieka tie hneta si vaciy.
Ma carie tie a du riypata malie a bya tie, tahematapakieca cawsaa abyana ca khaapahmuo thlahne vyi.
Khazing hne tana riephasa pata ma hrie aa, ama na ma carie tie a tetuv ta a cuo aa.
Vya Khazing, i khina ueryi kha na naathlie tie; i thlaachuona kha na naathlie tie.
Nangping vuosuopa tana, alyi dena taata ica u. Kama laata aa suo viepa alungpuvnung'a luo kha naa chiy tie;
tahematapakieca nama ca i canawnapa hne, a cupa i cariekyikuo tana na cuo.
Na thluodaa chunglie chuozaa ta na pa-aw sala, na mathlaa rawlie na canaw sa thi tie.
Vya i Khazing, i biekuona kha na thyi cate, nama caa ciyzaapa zaw na pipa yi ru kha ina pi ciy.
Siepahruo chuo kha pasiy sala, chuozaa ta a hmang se.
Khazing hmielie chuozaa ta siepahruo cuo sala, ama ta aa hmangpa duena hne zang tluo a tlanapa ta ca awpuo se!
Caacuonakawta na ming ca pathuosa pari'a angte, i biekuona ca ningting ta i patling sa aa.
I hringna ca Khazing pakha dyi khana a dieta tah a huo; kama khuona ca ama'a taa tana a cuo.
Ama pakha dyi hingna i lungpuvnung hne i khuona, i riekhuopiehu ta a cuo; Khatiy tahmuo a cahang'a va ang.
Lungruetlepie haata cing'a nang tli te, piehu haata a ra tlipa cawsaa pakha kha para karue riypata khatiy te ma nama bangkhuo hingta namaa du byalya aa?
Pa-uvsathyipa cawsaa kha thude taata pathla riypa dyina amaa ting, hanghiena lie hing ama palung a tluo; ama pakaa taata thluechiy ama pi pakhi, cuorasala ama chungraw lieta chie ama sa.
Khazing dyi khana i thlaapa ta a dieta tah a huo, i ruechuona ca ama'a taa tana a cuo.
Ama pakha dyi hingna i lungpuvnung hne i khuona, i riekhuopiehu ta a cuo; khatiy tahmuo a cahang'a va ang.
Kama a thlana hne pa-uvsathyina ca Khazing thue tana a cuo; ama ca i lungpuvnung hne i canawna tana a cuo.
Vya cawsaa zaw, ama kha a ringchuo pari tie ung; nama pathiypalung yalya kha pi tie ung; Khazing ca ma canawna tana a cuo.
A hringna aa nepa tie ca yi kha huv sungpa haata cuo yi te, a hringna aa suopa tie ca hangna tana ama cuo; cyi pathlie pata ama cuo kieca, yi kha huv sungpa laata amaa hy vie kaluo.
Hruohra ta hmang chuvpa kha a nguo tuv khah ung, paruvna lie kha a hrihripa anguopuona hnyi khah ung; na hnyirung hryly kie zaw, capa ca a ringchuo khah.
Khazing ta yi kha bie a ri; a yihningnapa lie i thyipa ca: cahrana ca Khazing huopa tana a cuo,
aa hmangpa duena ca Abyipahuopa tana a cuo. Nama ta cawsaa bangkhuo ca, iema ama tuehriena haata na thung yi.
Vya Khazing, nama ca i Khazing tana na cuo, nama na ica huv, tiy aw lipa ta a caavungpa ruo lie haa tana, i hringna ta tiy hrie ta ca hrie te, i saapa ta nama kha aca vuo.
Caacuonakawta hmangpathepa lie kha ca mangkhuo angte, na cahrana hne na rungnaana kha i hmung tli.
Aa hmangpa na duena ca hringna laata a pha vie nakawta, ica pathuosa pari aa.
I hring chung bangkhuo i kuv calang'a angte, na ming kha u'a angte ica pathuosa aa.
I hringna ca sa pahuopa a ningpa haata a palung tling'a te, nama kha palungtluona hne ica pathuosa.
I iehmang cung lieta nama kha zuokhydyi ica pacuo syalya.
Tahematapakieca nama ca kama naa byatuv cuo cate, na mathlaa rawlie alawna hne hlaa i sa.
I hringna ta nama kha caa be te, na cacuoluo kuv ta kama kha ina dyichaw.
Cuorasala i hringna naa para khingpa tie ca alyi khue aa thuvpa chung luo khana ama tla aa.
Zueziy ta thiy'a yi te, ama riyy kha ruo-uv ta a ce'a yi.
Cuorasala siepahruo ca Khazing'a lie kha aa law aa; Khazing ming ta biekuona a tuepa bangkhuo ca a law'a yi te, a hangpa tie pakaa ca paping pata a cuo aa.
Vya Khazing kama ahrungna ueryi kha na naathlie thi tie; ciy aa chiypa i carie tie kuv taata na khuo tie.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie rawna taata hne, hmang pha lipa a tuepa tie khuekhuona taata na khuo tie.
Ama palyi kha zueziy haata cata yi te, ama bie ca cuoti ka ta ama ka,
risie riy a aw lipa tie kha a bawkhuo yi te, ciyna hnyi bangby li pata ama ka.
Hmang pha lipa tue riypa kha a pasu yi te, a paruv ta cyihyi thlakhuo riypa kha ama ri pakhaw, “Ahungma malie a hmung aa?
Ma khuekhuopa na a pha ciemuo,” ama ta. Tahematapakieca cawsaa pathiypalung hne ruena hing aa thuvsapa tana a cuo.
Cuorasala Khazing ta a cuoti kha iema'a luo ka'a te, iema ca sungkha ta hmaa ama phya aa.
Ama palyi ta rana luo a chiy'a yi te, iema a hmungpa bangkhuo ta ciyna hne amaa cathang aa.
Cawsaa bangkhuo ama ciysa aa; Khazing ta a tuepa kaw kha ri'a yi te, ama pacuo syalya aa.
Aa dangpa tie ca Abyipachunglie kha ama palung tluo sala, ama'a lie kha canaw yi se. A palung pathepa bangkhuo ca ama kha pathuosa yi se.
Vya Khazing, nama ca Zion lieta pathuosa tluo aa tlapa tana na cuo; nama'a lieta ma biekuo zaw kha ma patling sa aa.
Nama ca thlaachuona malie a palietuv tana na cuo, saapa a cuopa bangkhuo nama'a luona amaa vaw aa.
Ma tuepa pha lina ta malie a vy hringhruo ning kha, ma tuesuena malie naa ngiethe.
Na biena-ing lie aw riypata naa tlawpa tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo. Na ing ta a cuopa a pathepa biena-ing lie hmang phapa khata ma palung malie a patling aa.

Kharuehaa aa chiypa hmang tuena ta ma thlaachuona kha malie palie cate malie naa thla. Vya Khazing, nama ca malie a khuotuv tana na cuo; aa hla cepa riyliy hne alyi dena lie a awpa bangkhuo zaw anguopuona tana na cuo.
Na cahrana ta tluo zaw hing patu yi cate, nama ca lesyina ta aca cadung.
Riyliy aa hrungna ueryi hne tiylaw pachipa pu zaw na padie sa, cawsaa khi-una zaw na padie sa.
Na tuepa kharuehaa hmang nakawta chuelyi aa hlacena lie a awpa zaw ama thlaa dyi a zang; ningchiy ningtla te ta a awpa cawsaa zaw ta palungtluona hne ama u.
Khy pasaa sa cate alyi kha na mangchiy, alyi papha sa cate na pathlung na pa-ie sa; na sapa cavaa zaw ca tiy rungsa pari te, na cawsaa zaw cuota kung na pavyi sa; capa ca nama tuepa tana a cuo.
Khy pasaa sa cate ama thawpa lelyi kha khytiy ta a paci, alyi kha pane sa te saciy kha a pale sa.
Na pahyana tluotlingpa ta khuopuv ta kung pavyi sa te, na cakuona bangkhuo lie hnyirungna a awle.
Sahring tlena tluo zaw ca hringdiyliy pari yi te, lawtluo zaw ca palungtluona hneta a bi.
Bawruo aphuv panuna lie ca sahring bi yi te, bawphie ca sacuo aa pame. Palungtluona hne khi yi te hlaa ama sa pakhaw.
Alyi ming bangkhuo ta Khazing'a luo kha palungtluona hne khi tie ung;
a rungnaapa a ming kha hlaa ta pathuosa tie ung.
Khazing kha, “Na hmang tuepa hing kha tluv tama nang-uo aa chiy! Na lesyina hne na cahrana nakawta na carie tie ca na hmiekunglie kha ciyna hneta amaa bungle.
Alyi ming bangkhuo ta nama kha acaa bie yi; nama pathuosana hlaa kha sa yi te, na ming kha ama pathuosa.”
A vaw ung la Khazing tuepa hmang kha vya mang tie ung, cawsaa zaw hrawlie a tuepa hmang hing kharuehaa na a chiy.
Riyliy kha alyi huvpa ta pali te, iema ca cavaa kha ama phyi ta ama te. Capa lie ca ama kha maa law,
a cahrana ta uv pari yi te, mingphang ting kha a mang pari yi. Ahunghmuo a pale pata ama kha a du khah yi se.
Vya cawsaa zaw ma Khazing kha pathuosa tie ung, ama pathuosana ueryi ca a thyi se.
Ama ta hringna tluona malie pi te, maa pachiy li riypata malie a mangchiy.
Vya Khazing nama ta malie na dyapasya tli; ngu ca sumyi ta ama pathepa haata, malie na dyapasya.
Cyihyi lie malie pa-uo sa cate, ma ke lie hmangriypa na khang.
Cawsaa kha ma luv cung luo pakie sa yi cate, myi chunglie hne tiy chunglieta malie na cakuo sa; cuorasala ata hing ca aa bangnapa hmang luo malie naa chiy.
Myirue panaana hneta na ing luo kha a vaw'a angte bie icaa kuopa kha ica pi aa.
Ruvna i taw ningta i pakaa ta ri angte bie icaa kuopa kha ica pi aa.
A thupa tuv ta myirue panaana hne tuvtungpa ta hriykhung a rina rangpa-ue myikhuv kha ica pihluo aa; cue hne mie zaw kha ica pihluo aa.
Khazing a ciypa zaw bangkhuo a vaw ung la naathlie tie ung, i cuota khaapama a tue tapa kha ica chang'a yi.
Ama'a luo kha khuosa ta u angte, i pakaa hne i palyi ta i pathuosa.
Pha lina kha i palung chunglie meming ang sala, Abyipata na naathlie'a vyi.
Cuorasala Khazing ta ina naathlie hmisi, i thlaachuona bie kha ina naathliepa.
Khazing ca thluechiypa cuo mang sue, tahematapakieca i thlaachuona kha na thawpa li pata aa hmangpa a duena zaw kama'a taata hnyi vyi.
Khazing ta vi malie hnyi sala, thlue malie chiy sala minghmie pha malie pi se.
Cahaacata chuelyi lie hing na khingna pachangpa cuo sala, mingphang zawdya ta na khuona hmung yi se.
Vya Khazing, cawsaa zaw ta ca pathuosa yi sala, cawsaa bangkhuo ta nama kha ca pathuosa yi se.
Mingphang zaw ca a law yi sala palungtluona hlaa sa yi se, tahematapakieca cawsaa kha pahlyipale li pata bie ripa yi cate, mingphang zaw kha luo naa chiy yi.
Vya Khazing, cawsaa zaw ta ca pathuosa yi sala, cawsaa bangkhuo ta nama kha ca pathuosa yi se.
Chuelyi ta kung pavyi te, Khazing, ma Khazing ta thluechiy malie a pi.
Khazing ta thluechiy malie pi pazue sala, chuelyi cawsaa bangkhuo ta ama kha ciyzaa yi se.
Khazing ca kya thu sala, a carie tie ca chepatlaa diy yi se; ama a huepa tie ca a hmiekung taa khata a ruo yi se.
Myikhuv ca thliy ta a pazulepa haata, iema zaw pazule pata cuo yi se; khyihnue ca myi ta a e tiyta a tiyta a langpa haata, cawsaa pha lipa zaw ca Khazing hmielie kha ra yi se.
Cuorasala cawsaa aa dangpa tie ca ama palung tluo se; Khazing hmiekunglie ama palung tluo se; palung tluosuesaana hne a law yi se.
Khazing'a luo kha hlaa sa ung la, hlaa sa ung la a ming kha pathuosa tie ung; amyi a khangpa paa ca hlaa ta pathuosa tie ung, a ming ca Abyipatana a cuo, a hmiekunglie kha a law tie ung.
Khazing ca a biena-ing pathepa lie aw te, haaraa tie hne nunghlyi zaw ama paa tana a cuo.
Khazing ta viesaa li pata a angbyalyapa tie kha chungkhue pi yi te, thaw a tlapa tie kha hnyirungna a pi yi; cuorasala rie a thupa tie ca ruocaapa lie na ama aw aa.
Vya Khazing na cawsaa zaw hmieluo ta pya cate ruocaapa lie na sikhyi tiy yi ta
Khazing, Sinai Khazing hmiekunglie hne, Khazing, Israel Khazing hmiekunglie kha aling a siy te a vuo taata khy a za saa.
Vya Khazing, khy kha khuopuv ta pasaa sa cate, a nungpuv tlipa ruo kha ruopanuta tah na pacuo sa;
capa lie ca na cawsaa zaw kha khy ama sa. Vya Khazing, na phana thueta aa phahlapa tie zaw kha ning riypa na pi yi.
Abyipata nawbie a pi yi; capa bie ca canung hluvpuv ta sikhyi yi te:
“Siepahruo tie hne ama rieka tie ca amaa ruo, amaa ruo!” ama ta. Ing lie a awpa canung tie ta carie tie'a taata ama lapa hruosue kha amaa re,
iema ca tuvte chunglie ama aw raalaa pata. Capa chechiy zaw ca thuvruv zuvta zaw ta ama cuo, a mathlaa ca ngu ta tue yi te, a hming zaw ca siy ta ama tue.
Lesyice ta siepahruo tie a chepatlaa diy ning yi kha, Zalmon lie ca cahue na a tla.
Vya Bashan tluo, vya tluo lepa; aa suopa tluodaw a hluvsa a hnyipa tluo!
Khazing ta a awna riypata a khingpa tluo kha, khaapanakawma hietliena hne na mang, vya tluodaw a hluvsa a hnyipa tluo. Capa tluo lie ca Abyipaca chuozaa ta aw'a va ma?
A cahrapa aruo le a thaw ri tie li hneta, Abyipaca Sinai tluo taata hmang pathepa luo kha aa vaw.

Aa suopa tluo cung luo kha kie cate, hruo cawsaa tie kha naa chiyle yi, cawsaa zaw'a taata lasaw na hmung, Abyipa a dupa cawsaa zaw'a taa khata hmuo lasaw a hluvsa na hmung, capa lie ca Khazing a aw aa.
Ningting ta ma hmangriy malie a pachapa Abyipaca thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue; Khazing ca ma khuona tana a cuo.
Ma Khazing ca khuotuv Khazing tana a cuo. Khazing, Abyipa thiyna taata malie a khuotuv tana a cuo.
Khazing ta a carie tie luv, ama suena hnang a ziypa tie pawtung kha a dechi patlaa diy aa.
Abyipata, “Iema ca Bashan taata i vya kaakhyi pakhaa'a yi, aa thuvpa riyliy taata vya kaakhyi pakhaa'a yi angte,
ama thiyse chunglie kha cakuole'a ung cate, nama uv zaw ta ama khing zaa ta ama pali aa,” a ta.
Vya Khazing, tena ta na cakuopa hne i Khazing, i siepahruo ta hmangpathepa luo na cakuopa ca cawsaa bangkhuo ta ama hmung tli.
Hlaasatuv tie hmaasa yi te, tungpa ue tling a tungpa tie ta hnang ama chuo, amaa lalalieta karuv-akhang a tungpa tie kha ama aw.
“Israel ming thukina hruopuv ta a cuopa AbyipaKhazing ca a pungpa cawsaa hluvpuv ta pathuosa tie ung!”

Iema zaw hrawlieta a caw cepa Benjamin phang kha hmaa vya sa yi te, Judah uvtuv tie hne ama phang cawsaa zaw ta ama vya paziy. Cakhutaata Zebulun hne Naftali uvtuv tie hne ama cawsaa zaw ta ama vya paziy.
Vya Khazing, na cahrana kha paluosa tie; kiema cuota na za paluosapa na cahrana kha paluo sa tie, Vya Khazing.
Jerusalem lie na biena-ing cuo khata siepahruo tie ta nama'a luo lasaw a vya cyi yi se.

Phiepahlaa hrawlie a awpa saruopa zaw kha chuo yi la, cue taata zaw hne a tlepa cuetungpa phuv kha chuo tie yi. Lasaw pipa dyi a tlechuopa tie kha na phyi ta chaapuo yi la, rie tuv dyi a khingpa tie kha chepatlaa diy tie yi.
Izipt ruo taata daa kha vya phya yi sala, Ethiopia tie ta a catli pata Khazing'a luo kha ama kuv pazu yi se.
Vya chuelyi pena zaw Khazing kha hlaa ta pathuosa tie ung; Abyipakha hlaa ta pathuosa tie ung.
Hluoning avuo, avuo a khangpa paa a pathliepa ueryi, a cahrapa a ueryi kha naathlie tie ung.
Khazing cahrana ca pathyi sa tie ung, a lesyina ca Israel cungliena a aw, a cahrana ca avuo lie khiy na a aw.
Khazing, Israel Khazing a hmangpathepa taata a vawpa ca kha tluv tama ciy aa chiy; ama ca a cawsaa zaw kha cahrana hne thaazuo a pituv tana a cuo. Khazing ca thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue!
Vya Khazing, na khuo tie, tiy na i rue te ta naa vya tli.
Chaana riy a aw lipa aa thuvpa caakaw luo na i tla. Aa thuvnapa tiy chung luo chiy angte, tiylaw ta ina buvkhung mangtli.
I khina pata i nang buo te, i duo zaw a caa diy tli. I Khazing i mangkhuona pata i ming zaw a ri diy tli.

A kawluo aw li pata naa huepa na i suobuv laata a hluv vie yi. Naa para riypa a hluvsa aw yi te, a cuo bangby li pata naa pachiepa i carie zaw ama hluvsa. I paruv lipa hmang kha i thung riypata a cuo'a ma?
Vya Khazing, i ngaapa ca ina pachang ciy; a cuo lipa hmang i tuepa ca na hmiekunglie nu khu aw vyi.
Nama'a lie anguopuona a hnyipa tie kha kama kawlieta nangzaa pata aw khah yi se, Vya Abyipa, Cungnungce Khazing; nama caa huvpa tie kha kama kawlieta esena a taw khah yi se, Vya Israel Khazing.
Nama cuota ripachiena khuopuv ta i ang tli, capa nangzaana ca ta i hmie ina pachi.
I tieriy zaw cuota khyche ta cuo angte, i nung saata zaw cuota ruohrang ming ta i cuo.
Na ing cuota i khingpasana ta myi haata na kuo te, nama aca esenapa yi kha kama cung luo a tla.
Sa a uv angte rawcanaw pata i aw tiyta, ina esena yi ta a cuo ngiethie.
Buri ta taapa caw kha i hryi tiyta ina tue hyalya yi.
Hukaa lie a tupa tie kawchie ri riypata a li angte, sahmaa a pariypa tie ta i kaw kha hlaa phy yi te ama sa.
Cuorasala Vya Abyipakama ca nama'a luo kha thlaa i chuo. Vya Khazing, a chuo the lipa aa hmangpa na duena thueta, aa raw na tapa cuo ning kha na palie thi tie.
Zang tluo aa tlapa na byana ta, caakaw chung taa khata na thue tie; i carie tie kuv chung taa khata na khuo la, aa thuvpa tiy chung taa khata na khuo tie.
Tiyle ta na phya thi khah sala, aa thuvpa tiy chung luo tla thi khah ang se, dena a hnyi lipa khue ta na pingsue thi khah se.
Vya Abyipana palie thi tie, tahematapakieca aa hmangpa na duena ca a pha. Aa hmangpa na nangduena thueta kama'a luo kha a vya pali thi tie.
Na changtaapa a cuopa hing na hmie na nukhuo thi khah, ruvna lepuv na i taw, na palie pahraa thi tie.
