Naa vya ngie la, na khuo thi tie, i carie tie kuv taa khata na papya sa thi tie.
Ina tue esepa yi kha na pachang, i nangzaanapa hne ina nutaanapa yi zaw na pachang; i carie tie zaw na pachang diy yi.

Ina esenapa yi ta i palung rasa te, anguopuona zaw hnyi khu va ang. Naa ngiechipa pakha chuo ama aw thlu'a mang i ta, cuorasala pakha hmuo aw va yi. I hnaanguona naa ripa pakha chuo ama aw thlu'a mang i ta, cuorasala pakha hmuo aw va yi.
Sa pi cuopa ta thiysiyy na pi yi te, i tiy a hrie tiyta tiy thuepa ina padang yi.
Ama cabya ca iema cuota sariy cuo sala ama viesaa zaw cuota cyihyi cuose.
Ama hmung the li riypata ama ming pacue pata cuo yi sala, ama sesie raw kha sawkhaw se.
Na hihaana kha za patlesue yi la, iema kha kuo yi se.
Ama awna hmang ca duothling sala, ama thluodaa lie kha pakha hmuo aw khah yi se.
Nama ta duo na te tlipa tie kha hrisaa yi te, na tuvpa tie pasanapa kaw kha ama ri khingsa.
Ama suena lie kha suena bechiy yi la, nama'a taata sue angiethena hmung khah yi se.
Ama ming ca hringna caa-uv chungtaata hruvpa cuo yi sala, aa dangpa tie ming lie pasuvpuopa cuo khah yi se.
Cuorasala kama ca riethyivuosuo pata pasana ang angte, Vya Khazing, na khuona ta na cawchue thi tie.
Khazing ming kha hlaa ta i pathuosa aa; palungtluona hne i pathuosa hryly aa.
Capa ca ta Abyipaca cuetungpa ta hriykhungrina laata a palung patluo vie'a te, a kung tlingpa cuetungpa kiy hne a caki zaw ta hriykhungrina laata a palung a patluo vie aa.
Capa hmang ca tuechiepa tie ta hmung yi sala ama palung tluo se; niema Khazing a huvpa tie, nama palung cahra pakhaa se.
Tahematapakieca siypasa tie zaw thlaachuona khaAbyipata a thyi; thaw pathlapa a cawsaa zaw kha thaw buo va yi.
Alyi hne avuo, riyliy hne a chunglie a awpa zaw ta ama ca pathuosa tie ung.
Khazing ta Zion ca khuo'a te, Judah khypuv zaw ca a sa pakhaa aa; a changtaapa zaw ta capa lie ca aw'a yi te ama cu aa.
A changtaapa samingsahlaa zaw ta cu'a yi te, a ming a duepa zaw kha capa lie ca ama aw aa.
Vya Khazing, ata hingta na khuo thi tie. Vya Abyipaa catli pata naa bya thi tie.
Kama naa thie khingpa tie ca ama nang zaa sala a kalaa diy yi se. Naa para naa pakyi khingpa tie ca hnangluo a pali pata a ruo yi sala, hmiechi nangzaa pata aw yi se.
“Haa! haa!” ta pata naa pahnyisuepa tie ca nangzaa pata kaa yi se.
Nama caa huvpa tie bangkhuo ca a law yi sala ama palung tluo se. Na khuona a khingpa bangkhuo ca, “Khazing ca a lesyice!” ta khu hryly pari yi se.
Cuorasala kama ca siypasapa hne phahlapa tana i aw; Vya Abyipa, kama'a luo kha a vaw pahraa tie. Nama ca naa byatuv hne naa khuotuv tana na cuo; Vya Abyipa, vya haa thi khah.
Vya Abyipanama na icaa canaw; nangzaa pata aw thi khah ang se.
Naa dangna chunglie kha naa thla la na khuo tie; na naathlie la na khuo tie.
Kama khuo riypata i canawnapa a lungpuvnung hne, a cupa i riekhuopiehu ta cuo thi tie, nama ca i lungpuvnung hne i riekhuopiehu tana na cuo.
Vya i Khazing, cawsaa pha lipa tie kuv taa khata na khuo thi la, cawsaa pyathupa hne aa hmuo lipa tie kuv chung taa khata na khuo thi tie.
Vya Abyipa, nama ca kama i nguopuona tana na cuo, Vya Abyipa, i cawta baataata i ringchuopa tana na cuo.
I za puv baataata nama na icaa ringchuo; i nung riy chungtaata naa papuv sapa ca nama tana na cuo.
Kama ca cawsaa hluvpuv cuota pahmungsana ta i cuo, cuorasala nama ca a cupa i canawna tana na cuo. Nama ca ica pathuosa pari aa.
Ning-aw ningtlabu ta na rungnaana kha ica pathuosa.
I macuo tiyta na hnaw thi khah, i thaa a aw li tli taata na thaw thi khah.
I carie tie ta ina thie khing nakaw yi ta, a hmya yi te i kaw kha amaa rue pakhaw.
“Khazing ta a thawpa cawsaapa kha a cade ung la patuv tie ung, a khuotuv riypa aw va yi,” ama ta.
Vya Khazing, naa hla thi khah; Vya Khazing a catli pata naa bya tie.
Kama naa pachiepa tie kha ama nang zaa sala ra yi se; kama naa pasa sapa tie ca nangzaa hmiechina ta buv yi se.
Cuorasala kama ca anguopuona kha hnyi pari'a angte, nama kha ica pathuosa pari aa.
Aa dangpa na hmang tuena kha ri pari'a angte, na tuepa khuona kaw kha i pachang diy khu li raalaa pata ning-aw ta i ri aa.
Abyipa Khazinghmang tuepa, a lepa kha pathuosa'a angte, nama naa dangna kyalya dyi kha i pathuosa aa.
Vya Khazing, mingnu i cuo baataata kama kha na pacuv cate, ata tepa hingta kharuehaa aa chiypa na hmang tuena kha i pathyisa.
Caacuonakawta macuo angte i suo a paana te ta na thaw thi khah, vya Khazing, A vaw riypa chuotliepa saa zaw bangkhuo'a lie na cahrana i pathyisana te ta na thaw thi khah.
Vya Khazing, na cahrana hne naa dangna ca aa suopa avuo na a de. Nama ca hmang lesapa kha tue cate, Vya Khazing, nama haapa ahungma a aw?
Ruvnaana hne vuochina kha na pahmung sa cate, cuorasala ina cahra sa pakhaa'a ciy; alyi khue aa thuvpa chung taa khata ina papya pakhaa'a ciy.
Kama kha ahluo laata na cyicalang vie'a cate, i hnaa ina panguo'a ciy.
Vya Khazing, kama zaw ta zang tluo naa tlanapa kha tingtuo ta ica pathuosa aa. Vya Israel Khazing Pathe, tingtuo tung'a angte nama pathuosana hlaa kha i sa aa.
Nama pathuosana hlaa i sapuo pata palungtluona hneta i u aa; na khuopa i thlaapa zaw palungtluona hneta a u aa.
Aa dangpa naa byana kaw kha ning-aw ta i ri aa, tahematapakieca kama naa pasa sa khingpa tie ca nangzaa hmiechi pata ama aw tli.
Vya Khazing, aa dangsa pata bieripana a tue the riypata siepahruo kha naa dangna pi thi tie.
Ama ta na cawsaa zaw kha adangna hne uv yi sala, siypasa tie kha aa dangsa pata bie ripa yi se.
Tluo hne tluothlue zaw hingta adangna chunglie kha na cawsaa zaw cuota hnyirungna chiykhyi yi se.
Siepahruo ca ta siypasapa cawsaa tie kha a daakhyi pata, riethyivuosuopa tie kha a bya yi sala, hrisaatuv tie kha te diy yi se.
Na cawsaa zaw ta ning pa-ie te thlaapa a vaa chung bangkhuo, chuozaa ta ca ciyzaa yi sala caa bie yi se.
Siepahruo ca aphuv cunglie a saapa khytiy haa cuo sala, alyi cunglie a saapa khytiy haata cuo thi se.
A chuo chung bangkhuo adangna pungzaa sala, thlaapa a vaa chung bangkhuo thlaalungna aw se.
A penapa ca riyliy suokha taata suokha te, Zufrates cavaa taata alyi dena te a cuo aa.
Ruocaapa chunglie khy a sapa cawsaa tie kha a hmiekunglie a bu'a yi te, a carie tie kha buvcing lie amaa bu aa.
Tarshish ruo siepahruo tie hne parala ruo siepahruo tie ta ngukhyi vya pi'a yi te, Sheba ruo siepahruo tie hne Seba ruo siepahruo tie zaw ta lasaw ama vya pi aa.
Siepahruo bangkhuo ta a hmiekunglie a vya bu'a yi te, mingphang bangkhuo ta a re ama hrie aa.
Tahematapakieca riethyivuosuopa tie hne, byatuv a hnyi lipa siypasa tie ta ama u tiyta a khuo yi.
A thaadyapa tie hne siypasa vuosuopa tie kha ngiechi yi te, riethyivuosuopa tie hringna kha a khuo yi.
Hrisaana hne pha lina taata ama hringna kha a khuo yi; ama hringna ca a hmungna lie a sungnaapa tana a cuo.
Siepahruo ca a hringtaa pasiy mang sue! Sheba ruo siy kha pi pata cuo se. A cuota thlaachuo pari pata cuo sala, ning-aw ningtlabu pathuosa pata cuo se.
Ruo chunglie kung vyi sala; Lebanon tluo cunglie a awpa sakung phapa haapa khata tluo cung bangkhuo kha buv diy se. Ruo chung kha aphuv ta a buv diypa haata, khypuv chung kha cawsaa ta bi yi se.
A ming ca chuozaa ta a hmang sala, A mingpathuona ca ning a aw chung bangkhuo ci li pata a pazue se. Mingphang bangkhuo ca ama thueta thluechiy hmung yi sala; ama palungtluona kha ama'a lie ri yi se.
Israel Khazing, Abyipaca thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue, ama pakha dyina hing haapa kharuehaa hmang hing a tue.
A rungnaapa a ming ca chuozaa ta pathuosa pata cuo mang sue; Amen, Amen.
Jesse sacapaa David thlaachuona ca a chuo tli.
Khazing ca aa dangpa Israel ming a palung pathepa tie cunglie a pha hmisi.
Cuorasala kama ca vuotaa a pachiy'a nang angte, vuotaa i tlaw chie'a nang.
Tahematapakieca cawsaa pha lipa tie ama hnyirungpa i hmung tiyta, capa a hruotlepa tie ca i hie ina tlie yi.
Iema ca pasapanaana a taw va yi; ama hnaa tluo te ama cahra.
Malie haata ruvnaana a taw va yi; malie haata puvtlung pasana zaw a taw va yi.
Caacuonakawta hruotlena kha pachiy haata a ya yi te, hruotlena khata pang haata a buv yi.
Ama thu tuv pata ama ming butaly te, ama pathiypalung ca ngaana ta bi te a lepathla.
Malie kha tue hyalya yi te malie rana riypa kaw kha ama ri; ama hinghuo a pa-aw sa yi te malie kha ama hrisaa.
Ama pakaa ta vuoruo khiy a du yi te, ama palyi ta chuelyi ama cahlung.
Caacuonakawta cawsaa ta iema'a luo kha a pali yi te ama pathuosa, ama suena kha hmung va yi.
Iema ta, “Tuokhaatama Khazing ta a pachang the aa? Cungnungce ta pachangna ca a hnyi ma?” ama ta.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ca cahaaca tana ama cuo; aa nuosa pata aw hyalya yi te ama hnyi hryly.
I pathiy i palung a pathesa pata chi angte, i kuv a siy angte suena i tue lipa hing a hrihripa tana a cuo.
Ning aw ta palungriethyina hne pasana ang angte, maw tating ta duotena i ang.
“Cahaacata na i ri aa,” ta ang sala, na cawsaa zaw hrawlie aa hmuo lipa a ripa ta i cuo aa.
Capa ca tuokhaatama i pachang khu aa tapa i rue tiyta, i cuota rue hang a aw lipa re ta a cuo.
Khazing hmangpathepa luo i vaa taa dyi tana, iema ama chuona riypa kha i pachang.
Iema kha luo pahniena lie chi yi cate, rana chung luo na pathla yi.
Sungkhata chunglie ra yi te, ciy aa chiysa pata na pavie karue yi.
Iema ca cawsaa pakha aa kya cha pahne a viepa muo haa kha tana ama cuo aa; amaa kya cha pahne ama ruenapa kha na pavie pa'a yi.
I palung rie thyi te, i palung a kyi tiyta, ngaa angte khaapahmuo rue the lipa angta,
na hmiekunglie hing pachangna a hnyi lipa saruopa haa tana i cuo.
Cuorasala nama'a lie aw pari angte, i cacuoluo kuv ta ina patuv pari ciy.
Ruena na pi cate luo inaa chiy ciy, ca khutaa cata pa-uvsathyina hneta ina cuhluo'a ciy.
Vuoruo lie khiy nama ta li pata ahungma i hnyi? Alyi lie zaw hing nama laata i khing viepa ahunghmuo aw va yi.
I pangpa hne i pathiypalung hing ca a cungbung aa, cuorasala Khazing ca i thaazuo hne chuozaa i cuvu tana a cuo.
Nama'a taata aa hlapa tie ca ama ra hmisi aa; nama'a taata a hla yi te a suepa tie ca ama vie hmisi aa.
Cuorasala Khazing a ngiepa ca kama cuota a pha; na hmang tuepa bangkhuo ri riypa hne pathyi riypata, Khazingca i canawna ta i tue tli.
Vya Khazing, khaapanakawma kiema hing cipari malie na thaw? Khaapanakawma na ruocaapa lie a awpa na tuv zaw cunglie na hi a haa?
Hluo ning taata na ru cu riypata naa zaa tlaw ciepa na mingphang hing maw thi khah. Na za awnapa Zion Tluo zaw kha maw thi khah.
Carie tie ta hmangpathepa chunglie a awpa hmang bangkhuo ama para; capa a ra pathla tlipa hmang luo ca a vaw la vya mang tie.
Carie tie ca na hmang pathepa chunglie kha khi yi u yi te, ama pangtaa kha ama pathlie.
Acung khuo a ngienapa chiypakaa lie azuv sapa thingphie kha ahryi ta ama saachi.
A cunglie zuv sapa thingphie bangkhuo kha hryisung hne khunglung ta ama dechi patlaa diy.
Na hmangpathepa kha myi ta ama rue; a pathepa na ming awna hmang kha papyapalyi yi te, alyi luo ama pathla.
Iema'a na iema kha, “Ma te karue'a tli yi,” amaa ta; ma ruo chunglie Khazing abiena hmang bangkhuo kha myi ta ama rue.
Kiema ca ma pangtaa kha hmung khu va tli puv; profet zaw aw va tli yi, khacuo te ma hing haa hingta ma aw aa tapa kha a pachangpa aw vapuv.
Vya Khazing, khacuo te ma ma carie tie ta malie ama pahnyisue hyalya aa? Na ming hing chuozaa ta aca ripachie'a yi ma?
Khaapanakawma na kuv ca naa da pakhaa? Khaapanakawma na kuv ca naa cakhiy pakhaa?
Cuorasala Khazing ca chuelyi khuona re a hriepa, hluo ning taata ma siepahruo tana a cuo.
Na cahrana ta riyliy kha na che; riyliy chunglie riyhre luv kha na dechi diy.
Leviathan parapuv luv kha dechi diy cate, ruocaapa lie saruopa tie sa ta na pi yi.
Nama ta acaa hne cavaata kha tiy palang sa yi cate, cavaapuv kha tiy na paky sa.
Chung hne zuo ca nama huopa ta cuo te, ning hne thlaa, aasiy zaw kha na sa yi.
Alyi ruoriy ca nama ta tue cate, cuovuo hne thlasiy zaw na tue.
Vya Abyipama carie tie ta tuokhaatama malie ama pahnyisue hyalya tapa hne, tuokhaatama na ming aca ripachie yi tapa kha maw thi khah.
A thaazuo dyapa na cawsaa zaw hringna kha aa hruopa saruopa tie kuv chungluo pi thi khah; a siy pasapa na cawsaa zaw hringna kha chuozaa ta maw thi khah.
Na biekuona kha a thyi thi tie, tahematapakieca ma ruo chung zingna hmang bangkhuo lie hing tuechiena nata a bi.
Esehrisaapa tie kha ama nang pazaa thi khah yi; siypasa tie hne vuosuopa tie khata na ming ca pathuosa yi se.
Vya Khazing, thu la na kawluo ca ri tie; ning-aw ta aca pahnyisue hyalyapa yi kha maw thi khah.
Na carie tie hihaa pata amaa ciena hne, ama khi-u parina puraa ca maw khah.
Vya Khazing, na ming na maca pathuosa; na ming na maca pathuosa. Cawsaa ta kharuehaa hmang na tuepa kaw kha ama ri.
Thli ciepa ning hne cuo a vya chiy tiyta, aa dangsa pata biechina i tue aa.
A cawsaa zaw bangkhuo hne alyi hing aa cahang tiyta, tungkaa a dyipa ca kama tana i cuo.
Ahruotlepa tie kha, “Ahruo tle khah ung,” ta yi angte, cawsaa pha lipa tie kha, “A mangkhang khah ung,
a mangkhang a pale pata, bie a hruopa ri khah ung,” i ta yi.
Biechina ca ningchiy ningtla hne, ruocaapa taata a vaw vyi;
cuorasala biechina a tuetuv ca Khazing tana a cuo, pakha kha pachung te pakha kha a calang.
Abyipakuv lie siyy pya ciepa, a cahrasapa a hihaana mingsuv panuo a aw; ama ta za lyisue'a yi te, alyi lie cawsaa pha lipa tie ta a haahaapa te kha sue'a yi te ama dang aa.
Cuorasala kama ca chuozaa ta a law'a angte, Jakob Khazing kha hlaa ta i pathuosa aa.
A hruotlepa tie kiy kha thlipachung'a angte, aa dangpa tie ca cyicalang pata ama cuo aa.
Khazing ca Judah ruo chunglie ama pachang diy, a ming ca Israel ruo chunglie a lesyi.
A ing ca Jerusalem lie aw te, Zion lieta khy a sa.
Capa lie ca cuoti, phya, zueziy hne carie cehre bangkhuo kha a thlipachung diy.
Nama ca na rungnaa, na carie na tenapa tluo taata na za kaa tiyta, kha tluv tama na linghlaa a aw!
A riephapa rieka tie ca ama hruosue bangkhuo kha chuvpa cuo yi te, ama thiy mangtli; ama cehre a hmuo khupa pakha hmuo aw va tli yi.
Jakob Khazing, nama ta na chuo nakaw yi ta, a khangtuv hne aruo ca a lie yi te ama thiy mangtli.
Cuorasala nama ca cawsaa bangkhuo ta aca ciy yi! Na hi a haa kieca ahungma na hmielie a daa nguo aa?
Alyi lie hrisaapa tie khuo riypata Khazing kha a daa te, bieripana kha vuoruo taata a za pathyi tiyta, chuelyi ca a ciy nakawta a dieta tah a aw.
Na hihaana kha naa ang tiyta, cawsaapa hihaana ca nama pathuosana pali kha a chiykhyi aa.
Abyipanama Khazing'a lie bie namaa kuo ciepa kha pi tie ung; a cahriylie a awpa bangkhuo ta ciyzaa aa chiypa'a luo kha lasaw vya pi tie ung.
A hruotlepa uvtuv tie pathiypalung kha pachung te, chuelyi siepahruo tie chunglie kha ciyna ta a pabi sa.
Na thyi naase ta pata Khazing'a luo kha khuosa ta, khuosa ta i u.
Ruvnaana i taw ningta Abyipakha huv angte, zuokhydyi a pahy li pata i kuv pazu angte thlaa i chuo; cadyiseca khaapatahmuo i hnaa na panguo khu vyi.
Khazing kha rue angte i hrung; khue rue angte i palung a chuo.
Mingsaa he ta pasing khu va ang; i palung rie a thyituv nakawta bie ri khu va ang.
A si ciepa ningkhue kaw kha pacuo angte, hluo ning kaw kha i thyi pakhaa.
Zuo ta i palung chunglie i hlaa zaw kha a kya thyi angte, kama hne kama kha i hiehriy.
Abyipata chuozaa malie a thaw'a ma? Khatiy tahmuo malie tlechuo pakhaa va tli ma?
Aa hmangpa a duena hing chuozaa ta a ci'a ma? A duena hing chuozaa ta a para'a ma?
Khazing ta vi malie a hnyi riypa hing a maw'a ma? A hihaana ta a kawpacuona hing a khaakhuo'a ma?
“Cungnungce cacuoluo kuv hing a tue khupa aw va tli,” tapa hing i palung pasa cena ta a cuo.
Abyipaa hriepa hmang kha i rue pakhaa aa; hluo ningta kharuehaa hmang na hriepa kha maw'a va ang.
Na hriepa bangkhuo kha rue syalya'a angte, na hriepa hmang lepuv kha i pacuo syalya aa.
Vya Khazing, na luopuv ca a pathe. Khaapa khazing ma kiema Khazing haa hingta a lesyi?
Nama ca kharuehaa hmang a tuepa Khazing cuo cate, mingphang zaw hrawlie kha na lesyina na paluo sa.
Na cahrana ta Jakob hne Josef ciypathla ta a cuopa, na cawsaa zaw kha na khuo yi.
Vya Khazing, tiyta nama aca hmung tiyta ca ciy yi te, riyliy rawkhie ca aa cahang.
Amyi ta khy za pasaa sa te, avuo ta khalung a pathy sa; a kuo bangkhuo ta thinghlaa aa cakang.
Khalung ca thliysung chunglie kha a thy te, thinghlaa aa cakangpa ca ta chuelyi kha a pakhe. Alyi ca aa cahang.
Nama ca riyliy cunglie kha cakuo cate, aa thuvsapa riyliy lie kha na vya si. Caacuonakawta na phyihnie kha hmung khupa cuo vyi.
Moses hne Aaron kuv ta na cawsaa zaw ca tuv haata luo naa chiy yi.
Vya i cawsaa zaw, ica pacuvpa yi kha naathlie tie ung; i pakaa taata a pyapa bie kha naathlie tie ung.
Pakhingpuona hmuo pata iema kha bie i chang'a yi; mingchingmingvuo tie ta malie ama changpa,
za thyi pate ma pachangpa, hluo ningta za nupa bieparuv kha ica chang'a yi.
Capa bie ca ma saata zaw kha chang li pata aw'a vapuv, a vaw riypa chuo cawsaa zaw kha ma chang'a yi, Abyipata a tuepa hmang rungnaapa, a cahrana hne kharuehaa hmang a tuepa tie kha ma chang'a yi.
Ama ta Jakob ciypathla Israel ming kha phungbie a pi yi. Nama saata zaw kha nama pacuv aa ta pata mingchingmingvuo tie kha a chang yi.
A puv li liepa a vaw riypa chuo cawsaa zaw ta capa phungbie ca ama pachang aa.
Cahaacata iema ca amaa nguopuona kha Khazing'a lie chi'a yi te, Khazing rehriena kha maw'a va yi. Cuorasala a phungbie kha ziy'a yi te,
a palung pangpa hne a du a hmuopa ama mingchingmingvuo tie kha lu'a va yi. Iema ca a palung a hmang lipa, Khazing'a lie zang tluo aa tla lipa tana ama cuo.
Liy hne thi a patuvpa Efraim ming kha rie a tuv hmisi ningta ca a pali yi te amaa ruo.
Khazing hne bie amaa kuopa kha ziy va yi, a phungbie kha ziy va yi.
A tuepa kha maw yi te, kharuehaa hmang a pahmung sapa yi kha a thyi va yi.
Izipt ruo Zoan bawphie lieta ama mingchingmingvuo tie hmungna lie kha kharuehaa hmang a tue.
Riyliy kha che te capa lie ca a pate sa yi, tiy ca tlepie a chungpa haata apa daa sa.
Ningchung cuo ning kha amyi ta luo chiy yi te, zuo cuo ning kha myi khepa ta luo a chiy yi.
Ruocaapa chunglie alungpuvnung kha dechi te, riyliy tiy zaa ta dang riypa tiy kha a pi yi.
Alungpuvnung taata tiy kha papya te, cavaa tiy haata a palang sa.
Cuorasala a cunglie kha suena tue ngiethie yi te, Cungnungce kha ruocaa chunglie ca amaa du ngiethie.
Ama ning khingpa sa kha a hie yi te, ama palung chungta Khazing kha ama dyapasya.
Khazing a du pata bie ri yi te, “Khazing ta ruocaapa lie hing sa malie a pi khu hmisi'a ma? ama ta.
Alungpuvnung kha tuvchi te tiy ca cavaa tiy haata a kya pya raalaa zawta, sa malie pi khu'a te, a cawsaa zaw hing saa malie a ring khu tange'a ma?” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta, Abyipata a thyi tiyta a hi a haa hringhruo; Jakob phang cunglie kha a pathiy myi haata ie te, Israel cunglie a hi a haa hryly.
Tahematapakieca Khazing kha zang lipa yi ta, a khuona zaw kha a ringchuo va yi.
Cakhutaata cungluo avuo kha naw pi te, vuoruo ingchiypakaa zaw kha a pahaw;
ama ning riypata manna kha khy haata a pasaa sa, iema ca vuoruo sa kha a pi yi.
Cawsaapa ta avuoming sa kha ning yi te, ama ta sa kha ama khing zaa ta a pi yi.
Ningchiyluo thliy kha avuo lie khiy vya pahruo sa te, a cahrana ta sungluo thliy kha a pahruo sa;
saa kha buvcing zaa ta za pathla yi te, a zulepa pavaa kha riyliy viehnang zaa ta a za pathla yi;
amaa rina hmang luo kha za pathla yi te, ama awna cahriy bangkhuo lie kha a za pathla yi.
Ama riy bisana te ta ama ning, tahematapakieca ama ning khing hringhruopa kha a pi yi.
Cuorasala ama rue cingna te ama ning hluota, sa kha ama pakaa lie a aw kalie pata,
Khazing hihaana kha ama cunglie za tlung te iema hrawlie a thaaruv cepa tie kha thie yi te, Israel satlie pha daduo kha a thie yi.
Cahaapa hmang amaa taw raalaa pata suena tue ngiethie kalie yi te, kharuehaa hmang a tuepa kha zang va yi.
Caacuonakawta ama hringna kha huv haata pavie sa te, ama hringna kha ciy aa chiysapa chunglie a chuo.
Iema kha a thie tiy yi ta, ama kha ama huv; a ngiepachiy yi te Khazing kha khuopuv ta ama huv.
Khazing ca amaa lungpuvnung ta a za cuopa kha a thyi yi te, Cungnungce Khazing ca iema khuotuv ta a za cuopa kha amaa thyi.
Cuorasala ama kha ama pakaa ta pathuosa pakhi yi te, ama palyi ta ama dung.
Ama palung kha ama'a lie a hmang li pata; a biekuona kha ziy va yi.
Cuorasala Khazing ca kawpacuona a hnyipa a cuopa haata, ama pha lina kha a ngiethe yi te, iema kha para va yi. A hihaana kha yi hluvpuv a ang te, a pathiylingna kha aa pache.
Iema ca saapa ta ama cuopa hne, a vya hruo te a viepa thliy haata ama cuopa kha aa thyi.
Ruocaapa chunglieta ama kha yi khazi ulu a du yi te ma viehnangruo lie kha yi khazi ulu a ngie ama pachi!
Khazing kha ata hne ata tah dyapasya yi te, Israel Khazing Pathe kha ata hne a ta tah a hi ama pahaa.
A cahrana kha a thyi lipa yi ta, ama cariepa'a taata a khuopa yi kha ama maw;
Izipt ruo lieta kharuehaa hmang a tuepa hne, Zoan bawphie lieta kharuehaa hmang a tuepa kha ama maw.
Iema ca tiy ama dang the li riypata, ama cavaa kha thiy ta a pali.
Iema a paratuv thuhring kha pathliesue yi te, iema a paratuv ca-uv kha a pathliesue yi.
Ama ciycyi kha cuongu pi te, ama hrie lawpa thyipaa kha khawbyapa a pi.
Ama mingsuv riy kha a ri pade sa te, ama saikamor kung kha cahue a paphaw sa.
Ama sahring kha ari pade sa diy te, ama tuv hne ama mie kha paci a paka sa diy.
Ciy aa chiypa a hihaana hne a pathiy iena kha ama cunglie za pathliesue yi te, paratuv avuoming zaw kha a za pathliesue yi.
A hihaana kha a ang li pata; ama hringna zaw kha ngie a buo vyi; puvtlung pasana ta a thie diy yi.
Izipt ruo chung ingchungkhue bangkhuo lie sacapaa uvthyi bangkhuo kha a za thie diy yi.
Cakhutaata a cawsaa zaw kha tuv haata pyakhyi yi te, ruocaapa lie kha luo aa chiy yi.
Aa bang aa susa pata aa chiy nakaw yi ta ciy va yi; cuorasala ama carie tie ca riyliy ta a buvkhung diy yi.
Iema kha a cacuo kuv ta tena a hmungnapa tluo, a tluocung pathepa luo kha aa chiy yi.
Mingphang zaw kha ama hmiekung taata papya yi te, ama cu riypa ruo kha re yi te, Israel mingphang ca ama thluodaa chunglie kha khy a pasa sa yi.
Cuorasala Cungnungce Khazing kha dyapasya yi te amaa du. A phungbie kha ziy lipa yi ta,
ama mingchingmingvuo tie haa khata zangna hnyi li pata hnangluo amaa pali; liy pha lipa ta kapa cuoti haata a kyikale pata ama si.
Ama khahrungtluobu taa khata a hihaana ri yi te, kuvtuezuv abie yi te a hietliena ama ri.
Khazing ta a thyi tiyta a hi haa hringhruo te, Israel ca a thaw karue.
Shiloh lie a awna hmang kha thuse te, cawsaa hrawlie a awnapa thluodaa kha a sise.
A cahrana hne a rungnaana kha ama carie tie kuv luo a pi yi.
Ama huopa, a cawsaa zaw cunglie kha a hi a haa tuv nakawta zueziy ta thiy riypata a pi yi.
Ama satlie tie kha myi chunglie thiy diy yi te, ama lesaa tie ca navaa riypa hnyi va yi.
Ama tluobyi tie kha zueziy ta thiy yi te, ama nunghlyi tie ta muochie sa va yi.
Cakhutaata Abyipaca aa hmungna taata a thupa haa khata kya thu te, mingsuvtiy ta a palung cahra te a khipa rietuv a thepa riekapa haa khata a cuo.
A carie tie kha a cade yi te, chuozaa ta ama nang a pazaa yi.
Josef ciypathla kha thaw yi te, Efraim phang kha a tlaw va yi.
Cuorasala Judah phang kha a tlaw yi te, a duepa Zion Tluo kha aa tlaw.
A suopa avuo haata hne chuozaa ta aa hmangpa alyi haata a hmangpathepa kha a sa.
A changtaapa David kha tuvtaata zaw a mangchiynapa
tuvte chungtaa khata a tlaw te, a huopa ta a cuopa Israel ming, Jakob phang zaw mangchiy riypata aa tlaw.
A pathiypalung yalya ta mangchiy yi te, iema kha thena hne a tlingpa a kuv ta luo aa chiy yi.
Vya Khazing, mingphang zaw ca nama huopa tana ama cuo; na biena-ing pathepa kha papyapalyi yi te, Jerusalem kha ama para.
Na changtaapa tie ama riyy kha avuo lie a zupa pavaa zaw sa ta pi yi te, zang tluo aa tlapa na cawsaa zaw saa kha alyi lie saa aa hruopa zaw ama pi.
Jerusalem khychung bangkhuo lie kha ama thiy ca tiy haa khata ama lyi, riyy a paby riypa ahunghmuo aw va yi.
Ma ingpaa mingphang hrangpa tie ripake riypa, tue hyalya riypa hne sesungpaalu ta tue riypata maa li.
Vya Abyipa, khacuo te ma ma cunglie na hi a haa aa? Chuozaa tama a haa aa? Naa hrakuona ca myi haa tama a ie thluo aa?
Na hihaana ca nama caa pachang lipa tie hne nama'a lie thlaa a chuo lipa ruo tie kha lyisue tie yi.
Tahematapakieca iema ta na mingphang kha thie yi te, ama awna hmang kha ama para.
Ma mingchingmingvuo tie pha lina kha malie a thyipa thi khah tie; minghmie pha malie pi la ma cunglie kawpacuona hnyi thi tie, tahematapakieca ma palung thaazuo na a caw hringhruo.
Vya malie a khuotuv Khazing, na ming rungnaana riypata kiema kha malie a bya thi tie.
Khaapanakawma mingphang hrangpa tie ta “Ama Khazing ca khaapaliema a aw,” malie ama ta aa? Na changtaapa zaw thiy ama palang nakawta mingphang hrang tie phuv na lanapa ca ma ming ta hmung se.
Thaw a tlapa tie amaa hrungna ca na hmiekung luo kya chiy thi se; thiy riypata biechipa ciepa tie kha na cahrana thueta lawna pi thi tie yi.
Vya Abyipanama aca ripake nakaw yi ta, ma ingpaa mingphang zaw kha le sariy ta vieriy thung tie yi.
Cakhutaa cata kiema na cawsaa, na tuvrung tie ta, chuozaa ta palungtluona bie ca hluo'a pate, chuo kha hnang chuo kha ta maca pathuosa pari aa.
Vya Israel Tuvkhietuv, malie naathlie thi tie, tuvrung haata Josef luo a chiytuv malie naathlie thi tie. Cherubim cung byithude lieta a tupa,
Efraim hne Benjamin hne Manasseh hmiekunglie kha na khena ca pathlie tie. Na cahrana kha pahra la, malie khuo tie!
Vya Khazing, malie padaa pakhaa tie; khuona ma hmung riypata minghmie pha malie pi tie.
Vya AbyipaCungnungce Khazing, Khatiy te ma na cawsaa zaw thlaachuona cunglie na hi a haa aa?
Ma mingthliy kha sa haata ning riypa hne, tiy haata dang riypata malie na pi.
Ma ingpaa zaw manghnue riypata malie tue cate, ma carie tie ta malie ama pahnyi sue hyalya.
Vya Cungnungce Khazing, malie padaa pakhaa tie; khuona ma hmung riypata minghmie pha malie pi tie.
Izipt taata mingsuv kung vya phya cate, mingphang hrang tie kha a cade diy yi cate naa ling.
Alyi kha thlupa cate, a thariy kha aa thuvsa ta thla te ruo chung kha a bi.
Tluo zaw kha a ningdiy padiy te, sidar kung lesapa a ce zaw kha a buvkhung diy;
a ce zaw ta riyliy te pha yi te, a daw zaw ca Cavaa te ama pha.
A kielie a cakuopa bangkhuo ta a thyi ama lu the riypata, khaapanakawma a dungkhuo ca na phi diy?
Ruo chunglie a awpa ngiehre ta para diy yi te, ruosaa zaw ta ama baa.
Vya Cungnungce Khazing, kiema'a luo a vya pali thi tie; vuoruo taa khiy ta malie za mang la, malie za hmung tie; na cacuoluo kuv ta naa lingpa
na mingsuv hing kaw za pacuo thi tie.
Myi ta ama rue, ama sapachung; na hi haa pata chuo yi la ra yi se.
Cuorasala naa tlawpa na mingphang, na cuo ta na cahra sapa tie ca za mangchiy za khaasie thi tie yi.
Nama ca khatiy tahmuo caa palise buo hluo'a vapuv; hringna malie pi la na ming maca pathuosa aa.
Vya AbyipaCungnungce Khazing; khuona ma hmung riypata hmiephaa malie pi tie.
Ma thaazuo ta a cuopa Khazing'a luo kha khuopuv ta hlaa sa tie ung; Jakob Khazing kha palungtluona hneta pathuosa tie ung.
Hlaa ca pathu ung la, karuv akhang kha tung tie ung, tingtuo hne tingtuolepa zaw kha tung tie ung.
Thlaa di ning hne thlaa punglung ning, ma pyi ning kha hmyakaa ca tung tie ung.
Tahematapakieca hingpa hing Israel ming phungluo ta cuo te, Jakob Khazing ta tue riypata bie a pipa yi tana a cuo.
Izipt ruo a du riypata aa thu ningta Israel ming cunglie bie a pipa yi tana a cuo. I thyi buo lipa ueryi suokha kha i thyi:
“Nama letung lie hmang kha ca cyi yi angte, nama rehrienapa baw kha nama kuv taata ica pachi sa tli yi.
Ngiechina namaa taw ningta na u ung cate kama ta ica khuo yi; khalung chunglie aa nupa hmang taata ica palie yi; Meribah acaa lieta niema kha ica dyapasya tli yi.
Vya i cawsaa zaw, a raaringna ica pi ning yi hingta na naathlie tie ung, Vya Israel, i bie hing naathlie thluo tie!
Mingphang hrangpa khazing kha nama hrawlie aw khah se; ruohrang khazing kha abie khah ung.
Kama ca Abyipanama Khazing, Izipt ruo taata caa vya pyakhyipa yi tana i cuo. Na pakaa kha khuosa ta uo la sa ca pi'a ang.
“Cuorasala i cawsaa zaw ta i ueryi kha naathlie va yi; Israel ta i ri naa ngie vyi.
Caacuonakawta ama palung pangna haa khata iema khingna tue riypa kha i pa-aw yi.
I cawsaa zaw hingta i bie hing naathlie yi sala, i luopuv hing ama ziy kieca!
Ama carie hing a catlisa pata tepa'a yi angte, ama cariepa kha i kuv i pathliesue'a yi.
Abyipaa huepa tie ca a hmiekunglie kha a bungle'a yi te, duotena ama angpa ca chuozaa ta aa hmang aa.
Jungsacuo pha cepa ta nama riy ca pabi'a yi angte, lungkuo khyipuv tiyta nama rue ica pacing sa'a yi.”
Khazing ca vuoruo ahmyana Byithude lie kha a tu te, khazing zaw hrawlie kha biechina a tue:
“Khacuo te ma aa dang li pata biechi'a ung cate, cawsaa pha lipa tie kha namaa cuo aa?
A thaacawpa hne haaraa tie kha aa hmuopa ta bie ripa ung la, esenutaapa hne siypasapa cuvu kha aa hmuota tah pahmung sa tie ung.
A thaacawpa hne riethyivuosuopa tie kha cawsaa pha lipa tie kuv chungtaata khuo tie ung.”
Iema ca singna cuose, pachangna cuose hnyi va yi, zingna chunglie khana ama cakuo; chuelyi cunglie hing adangna hetahmuo aw va tli.
“Niema ca khazing tie tana nama cuo, nama bangkhuo ta Cungnungce saata tana nama cuo.
Cuorasala cawsaapa haata thiy ra'a ung cate, siepahruo sacapaa ama thiypa haata nama thiy ra aa,” ica ta yi.
Vya Khazing, thu la alyi hing bieripa tie; mingphang bangkhuo hing nama huopa tana ama cuo.
Vya Khazing, ryi li pata aw thi khah; Vya Khazing, a dieta tah aw thi khah!
Ata zaw hing na carie tie ca thu yi te amaa tle patlaw; nama caa huepa tie ca ama luv na ama pada patlaw.
Na cawsaa zaw a du riypa tana a pha lipa khue kha ama khuo; nama ta a daakhyi yi cate na pakhuopa tie a du riypa tana khue ama khuo.
“A vaw ung la, a mingphang yalya hingta ama ciy paming'a ung puv; Israel tapa ming hing ahungtahmuo a thyi khah tie yi se,” ama ta.
A pha lipa khuekhuona lie kha ama palung a lusa te, nama a du riypata biekuona ama tue.
Capa biekuona a tuepa tie ca, Edom ming, Ishmael ming, Moab ming, Hagri ming,
Gebal ming, Ammon ming hne Amalek ming, Filistia ming hne Tair ming zaw ta ama cuo.
Assiria ming zaw ta iema kha amaa vya phuv ra, iema ca rietuv a cahrapa Lot samingsahlaa zaw tana ama cuo.
Midian ming cunglie na tuepa haa khata iema cunglie hing tue ra tie, Kishon cavaa lie Sisera hne Jabin cunglie na tuepa haa khata tue ra tie yi.
Iema ca Endor lie kha para yi cate, Alyi cuota aphuvlyi ta amaa li.
Ama riebyi tie ca Oreb hne Zeeb cunglie na tuepa haa khata tue yi cate, ama siepahruo sacapaa zaw ca “Khazing ruo a cuopa hing kiema cuota a la'a ung puv,” a tapa
Zebah hne Zalmunna na tuepa haa khata na tue yi.
Vya i Khazing, iema ca thliysung ta a phyapa buvcing haa khata pacuo sa yi la, thliy ta a phyapa savie haa khata tue tie yi.
Myi ta ruo kuo te, myihlaa ta lawtluo ting a la diypa haata,
iema kha na khysuv hne thliychie ta a cade tie yi.
Ama hmie pachi yi la, nama kha ca huv naase yi, Vya Abyipa
Iema ca chuozaa ta ama nang zaa sala aa dyi ta a dyi yi se; nangzaana hneta ra yi se.
Nama kyalya dyi hing Abyipacuo cate, alyi cung yalya lie Cungnungce na cuopa kha ca pachang yi se.
Vya Cungnungce Abyipa, na awna hmang ca kha tluv tama khing aa chiy!
Abyipaawna tlawhmie chunglie awpa na i vuo hringhruo; i pathiypalung hne i pangpa ta a hringpa Khazing kha a law angte i pathuosa.
Mingbaw hmuota awna hmang kha aa hmung, chiyvie zaw a cuota buv aa tue, ama changta kha na bienatluophie athaalie ama chi, Vya Cungnungce Abyipa, i Siepahruo hne i Khazing.
Na ing lie a awpa tie ca ama palung tluo te, nama pathuosana hlaa kha ama sa pari.
Nama chunglie thaazuo a hnyipa tie ca palungtluopa tana ama cuo, Zion luo a sipa luopuv lepa khana ama palung lie a aw.
Baka bawphie cahraw yi te ama si tiyta, capa bawphie ca acaatiy pyana ta ama pali; cuovuo khytiy a tla taapa ta tiy a hluvpuv a pa ang.
Ama thaa ruv hryly te, khazing tie Khazing kha Zion lie ama hmung aa.
Vya AbyipaCungnungce Khazing, i thlaachuona kha naathlie tie; Vya Jakob Khazing, na naathlie tie!
Vya Khazing, ma siepahruo hing malie za mangpa la, na sathu pathuvpa hing hmiephaa pi tie.
Nama tlawhmie chunglie ning kha awpa ca hmang hrang lie ning thawkha awpa laata a pha vie. Cawsaa pha lipa tie ing lie awpa laata ca Khazing ing lie ingchiypakaa huopa na i khing vie.

Tahematapakieca AbyipaKhazing ca ning ta cuo te, malie a pakhuopatuv phya zaw ta a cuo; ama ta minghmie pha hne pa-uvsathyina malie a pi. Aa dang pata a hringpa cunglie hmang pha pi riypa kha pahya li pata aw buo vyi.
Vya CungnungceAbyipa, nama caa ringchuopa bangkhuo ca palungtluopa tana ama cuo.
Vya Abyipana ruo kha tlechuo vie cate, Jakob kha pathu cate na padaa pakhaa.
Na cawsaa zaw pha lina hne ama suena kha naa ngiethe yi.
Na hihaana kha a ang cate, na pathiylingna kha naa cahna.
Vya Khazing kiema khuotuv, kiema kha malie pathu la malie padaa pakhaa tie, kiema cunglie palung tling li pata aw thi khah tie.
Chuozaa tama ma cunglie na hi a haa pari aa? Chuo bangkhuo tama na hihaana ca aa pazue pari aa?
Na cawsaa zaw nama'a lie ma palung tluo riypata malie pahra pakhaa'a va ca ma?
Vya Abyipaaa hmangpa na duena ca malie pahmung sa la, na khuona ca malie pi tie.
Khazing Abyipata a ri riypa bie kha i naathlie aa, a ma'a luo ama palung vya kaa te zangtluo aa tlapa a cawsaa zaw'a lie khana diena bie a ri aa.
Ama a ciyzaapa tie khuo riypa kha hmisi ta a ting pari te, a rungnaana ca ma ruo chunglie a aw pari aa.
Aa hmangpa duena hne zang tluo a tlana ca a taw'a yi te, adangna hne thlaalungna ca amaa pahnuo aa.
Zang tluo a tlana ca alyi taata kya pu'a te, adangna ta avuo taa khiyta a za mang aa.
Abyipata hmang phapa kha malie pi'a te, ma ruo ta a papung a pazaa sa aa.
Adangna ca a hmiekung luo kha sile'a te, luopuv kha a sapale aa.
Vya Abyipana naathlie la na palie thi tie, kama ca siypasapa hne riethyivuosuopa tana i cuo.
Nama kha icaa pi nakawta i hringna kha na khuo tie; nama caa ringchuopa na changtaapa kha na khuo tie.
Vya Abyipa, vi na hnyi thi tie, nama ca i Khazing tana na cuo, ning-aw ningtlabu tana nama'a luo kha i kya khi.
Na changtaapa thlaapa kha a palung patluo tie, Vya Abyipa, ica vuo hringhruo.
Vya Abyipa, nama ca a phapa hne angiethena a hnyipa cuo cate, nama caa upa bangkhuo kha aa hmangpa duena ta na due yi.
Vya Abyipai thlaachuona kha na naathlie la; kya khi angte icaa nuenapa kha na naathlie tie.
I thlaachuona kha ina palie'a nakaw ca ta, ruvnaana i taw ningta nama kha ica u.
Vya Abyipa, nama haapa khazing hrangpa aw va yi, nama na tuepa haata a tuepa pakha hmuo aw va yi.
Vya Abyipa, nama ta na sapa mingphang bangkhuo ta a vaw'a yi te na hmiekunglie kha a vya bung'a yi te, na ming kha aca parungnaa sa'a yi.
Tahematapakieca nama dyina a lesyipa hne kharuehaa hmang a tuetuv Khazing ta a cuo ciy.
Vya Abyipa, nama biehmisipa lie i cakuo the riypata na luopuv kha na pacuv tie.
Vya Abyipai Khazing, i pathiypalung yalya ta ca pathuosa angte, chuozaa ta na ming ica parungnaa sa aa.
Tahematapakieca i cunglie aa hmangpa na duena ca le hringhruo te, i hringna kha aa thuvpa Shoel taata ina khuo ciy.
Vya Khazing, a hruotlepa tie ca kama a du riypata thu yi te, cawsaa pha lipa phuv ta thie inaa nang yi.
Cuorasala, Vya Abyipa, nama ca nangduetuv hne vihnyituv Khazing cuo cate, a palung pasiypa, aa hmangpa duena a hnyituv hne zang tluo aa tlapa tana na cuo.
Kama'a luo a vya pali la vi na hnyi thi tie; na changtaapa hing thaazuo na pi la; na changtaanung saata hing khuo tie.
Hmiephaa ina pipa ca kha paluo sa la, naa huepa tie ta hmung'a yi te ama nang a zaa aa, tahematapakieca Abyipanama ta naa bya cate hnaa ina panguo ciy.
Khazing ta khypuv kha a pathepa tluo cunglie a sa;
Abyipata Israel khy hrang bangkhuo laa khata Jerusalem ca a due vie.
A rungnaapa hmang bangkhuo ta nama kaw kha ama ri, Vya Khazing khypuv.
Kama naa pachangpa tie hrawlie kha Izipt hne Babilon i ripuo aa; Filistia hne Tair hne Ethiopia zaw kha i ripuo ra'a yi, “Zion saa zaw tana ama cuo,” ama ta.
Zion kawlieta, “Mingphang bangkhuo hing Zion lie a puvpa tana ama cuo,” tahematapakieca Cungnungce ama hrahring ta a pacusapa tana a cuo.
Abyipata cawsaa zaw cazing a khung ning kha, “Zion liena a puv,” ta pata a khung.
Hlaasatuv tie hne a luotuv tie ta, “I samingsahlaa zaw ca nama chunglie hingna a ma aw,” ama ta.
Vya Abyipanaa khuotuv Khazing, zuo ta na hmiekunglie khi angte,
i thlaachuona kha nama'a luo kya chiy thi se; i khina ueryi kha na naathlie thi tie.
I hringna lie ruvnaana bi te, Shoel luona vuotaa i chiy tli.
Dena a hnyi lipa khue chung luo a tlapa tie'a lie ripuopa cuo angte, byatuv a hnyi lipa na i lusa;
a thiypa tie hrawlie mawpa, thie yi te thluo lie pahlaapa, nama ta naa thyi li tlipa, a cahrapa na kuv ta naa bya li tlipa tie haa tana i cuo.
Aa thuvpa khue chunglie, aa thuvsapa zingna hmang liena ina chi ciy.
Na hihaana ta na vy hringhruo te, na hihaana tiylaw ta ina buvkhung ciy.
I viesaa kha na cahriy sa yi cate, iema cuota ciysabaraw aa chiypa ta ina tue ciy. Ale luo i pya khu li riypata khaakhungpa cuo angte,
riethyi i angtuvnapa ta i ming te a zing. Vya Abyipa, nama kha i buo ta ca paza angte, ningting ta ica u.
Athiypa zaw cuota kharuehaa hmang ca na tue'a ma? Iema ca kya thu'a yi te aca pathuosa'a yi ma?
Aa hmangpa na duena ca thluo chunglie ripa a cuo ma? Zang tluo naa tlanapa kha Abaddon lie ca ri pata a cuo ma?
Kharuehaa hmang na tuepa ca zingna hmang lie cuose, na khuona ca mawnapa hmang lie cuose pachangpa a cuo ma?
Cuorasala Vya Abyipanama'a luo kha kya khi angte, maw ta i thlaachuona ca nama'a luo a kya chiy.
Vya Abyipa, khaapanakawma ina thaw ciy? khaapanakawma na hmie ina nukhuo ciy?
I cawta baataata riethyi ang angte vuotaa i thiy'a nang, ca ciy hringhruo angte aruechuona hnyi va ang.
Na hihaana ta kama kha na buvkhung te, ciy aa chiypa na hmang tuepa ta ina para.
Tiy le ta le te ning-aw ta ina cadung yi; akuo bangkhuo taata ina khaakhung yi.
Viesaa hne ingpaa kha na cahriy sa diy yi cate, i viesaa zaw ca zingna chungliena ama aw.
VyaAbyipaaa hmangpa na duena ca hla ta i sa pari aa; zang tluo naa tlanapa kha i ri pari aa.
Aa hmangpa na duena ca chuozaa ta cu te, zang tluo naa tlanapa ca vuoruo haata a cupa kha i pathyi sa aa.
Nama ta, “I tlawpa paa hne biekuona tue tli angte, i changtaapa David'a lie bie i kuo tli:
‘Na ciypathla tie kha chuozaa ta pacu sa'a yi angte, chuo bangkhuo ta siepahruo i pacuo sa'a yi,’ i ta,” na ta.
Vya Abyipakharuehaa hmang na tuepa kha vuoruo ta pathuosa sela, zang tluo naa tlana ca mingpathepa tie ahmyana lie pathuosa pata cuo se.
Avuo lie a awpa ahung khiy ma Abyipahne pakhingpuo riypa a aw'a yi? Avuo lie ahung khiy ma Abyipaa lu aa?
Mingpathepa tie ahmyana lie Khazing ca ciyzaa yi te, ama a cadungpa zaw hrawlie kha ama ca lesyi te ciy aa chiypa ta a cuo.
Vya AbyipaCungnungce Khazing, ahungma nama haata a cahra? Vya Abyipazang tluo naa tlana ta nama ca aca cadung.
Riyliy ca nama ta uv cate, a tiylaw ca na padie sa.
Rahab ca a thiyciepa saruopa haata chaapuo cate na para; na carie tie ca a cahrapa na kuv ta na chepatlaa diy yi.
Avuo ca nama huopa cuo te, alyi zaw nama huopa tana a cuo; chuelyi hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo hing nama na a sa ciy.
Chaluo hne sungluo hing nama ta sa cate, Tabor Tluo hne Hermon Tluo ta na ming ca palung tluosa pata ama pathuosa.
Nama ca a lesyipa hne a cahrapa tana na cuo.
Adangna hne biedangpa ca naa byithude hruopatu ta cuo te, aa hmangpa na duena hne zang tluo naa tlana ca na hmiekung luota ama sile.
Vya Abyipa, nama caa pathuosa thepa hne na hmiekung khena chunglie a cakuopa ca thluechiypa ta cuo yi te,
na ming kha ning-aw ta a lawkhyi yi te, naa dangna kha ama pathuosa.
Nama ca ama thaazuo hne ama rungnaana cuo cate, minghmie pha malie na pina thueta tena ma hmung.
Nama ca malie a khuotuv Abyipacuo cate, Israel Khazing Pathe ca ma siepahruo tana na cuo.
Hluo ningta zang tluo aa tlapa na cawsaa zaw kha muocuo ta bie chang yi cate, “A cahrapa paa cunglie byilakhuv kha pi tli angte, cawsaa zaw hrawtaata i tlawpa kha i cyicalang tli.
I changtaapa David kha i hmung tli; i sathu pathepa i pathuv tli;
i kuv ca ama'a lie chi pari'a angte, i buo ta ama kha i cahra sa pari aa.
A carie tie ta te buo'a va yi, cawsaa pha lipa tie ta te buo'a va yi.
A carie tie ca a hmiekunglie kha chaapuo'a yi angte, ama a huepa tie kha a hmiekunglie i thie'a yi.
Zang tluo i tlana hne aa hmangpa i duena ca ama'a lie aw pari'a te, ama ca i ming ta cyicalangpa a cuo aa.
A cavyi kuv ta riyliy kha pha'a te, a cacuo kuv ta cavaa zaw kha a pha aa.
Ama ta, ‘Nama ca i Paa, i Khazing, hne i khuona Lungpuv tana na cuo!’ ta'a te ina u aa.
Ama ca i sacapaa uvthyi hne alyi lie aa suo cepa siepahruo ta i tue aa.
Aa hmangpa i duena ca a cuota chuozaa chi'a angte, ama hne i tuepa biekuo ca chuozaa ta aa hmang aa.
A samingsahlaa ta siepahruo cuo pari'a te, a uvna ca vuoruo aa hmang chung bangkhuo aa hmang aa.
A saata zaw na kama biechina kha ziy li pata, kama phungbie kha a patlyi yi tapa kieca,
kama phungluo kha para yi te na i nawbie kha ama ziy va tapa kieca,
ama tuesuena kawlie hne ama pha lina kawlie kha sungpe ta chi'a yi angte duo i te'a yi.
Cuorasala aa hmangpa i duena ca ama'a taata hnyi'a va ang; zang tluo i tlana zaw kha a cunglie patlyi'a va ang.
I biekuo kha para li'apa angta, i pakaa taata a pyapa bie kha thle'a va ang.
A pathepa i cuona khata yi kha ta chuozaa cuota biekuo tli angte, David ca dung'a va ang.
A samingsahlaa ca chuozaa ta a hmang'a te, a uvna ca ning haata i hmiekunglie kha aa hmang aa.
Thlaapa ca tehte riypata avuo lie aa hmangpa haa khiyta chuozaa ta aa hmang aa.
Cuorasala ata hing ca sathu na thuvpa cunglie kha na hi haa te ama kha na thaw tli.
Na changtaapa hne na tuepa na biekuo kha para cate, a byilakhuv kha buvcing lie na thaw.
A lungruetlepie kha pacing diy cate, a cariekyikuo kha na para patlaa diy.
A thaalie a cakuopa bangkhuo ta a hmang kha chuv yi te, a ingpaa zaw ta ama tue hyalya.
A carie tie kha tena pi yi cate, ama palung na patluo yi.
Ca hlyitaw taata, a zueziy haa kha pamiy cate, rietuvna lie kha a daakhyi vaciy.
A byikhuecahryi kha a kuv taata chuv cate, a byithude kha alyi na vaana.
Macuo tiy a ta li pata macuo sa cate, nangzaana ta na buvkhung.
Vya Abyipakhacuo te ma naa nu aa? Chuozaa tama naa nu aa? Khacuo te ma na hihaana ca myi ie ta a ie aa?
Kha tluv tama i chuo a pachang tapa hing maw thi khah, cawsaa bangkhuo a thiy riypata na sapa hing maw thi khah.
Ahungma thiy li pata a hring pari khu aa? Ahungma Shoel cahrana hing a ruose khu aa?
Abyipa, hluo ningta aa hmangpa na duena kha khaapaliema a aw? zang tluo naa tlana hneta David bie naa kuopa kha khaapaliema a aw?
Vya Abyipa, na changtaapa ta tue hyalyana i angpa kha maw thi kha; kha tluv tama cawsaa tue hyalyana kha i ang.
Vya Abyipa, cahaacata na carie tie ta ina tue hyalya yi, sathu na pathuv ciepa paa ca cahaaca tana a cakuona mekaa ta ama tue hyalya.
Abyipaca chuozaa ta thluechiypa cuo mang sue. Amen! Amen!
Abyipa, nama ca chuo bangkhuo ta ma canawna hmang tana na cuo.
Tluo zaw na sa hluo hne, alyi hne chuelyi cung zaw na sa hluota nama ca chuozaa taata chuozaa te Khazing ta na cuo.
Cawsaa ca alyidiypa luo pakaa sa pakhaa cate, “Cawsaa zaw, kaa pakhaa ung la,” na ta yi.
Nama hmiekunglie kung thawkha ca azuochaning a chuo ciepa ning kha hne zuo kha haa kha tana ama cuo.
Nama ta phiy pathla diy yi cate, iema ca muo haa tana ama cuo; aphuv haa khata maw ta ama kya thuthaw.
Maw ta kya pu te lethaw te a paapa, zuoluo ta a uv te a caapa aphuv haa kha tana ama cuo.
Na hihaana ta malie kuo te, na pathiylingna ta ma thlaa dyi malie a pazang.
Ma pha lina kha na hmiekunglie chi cate, a paruvta tah ma suena zaw na hmung diy.
Ma cuo bangkhuo ca na hihaana rawlie ama khung diy; huv yi kha sungpa haa tana ma ningkhue zaw ca a chuo.
Ma chuo ca kung sawsariy tana a cuo, ma cahra vie pata a cuo kie kung sawcari ta a cuo; capa ma chuo chunglieta ma hluepa ca riethyina hne ruvnaana dyi tana a cuo; ma hringna ca chuo paluo te ma vie.
Na hihaana a cahranapa kaw ca ahungma a rue buo? na pathiylingna kha ciy tluo aa tlana zaa ta ahungma a ciy?
Ma hringna hing kha tluv tama a pachang tapa kha malie pachang sa la, ma sing vie thi aa.
Vya Abyipa, khacuo te khiy ma ma cunglie na hi a haa aa? na changtaapa zaw hing kawpacuona hnyi thi tie!
Maw tating ta aa hmangpa na duena ta ma palung malie patling la, ma palung tluo'a te ma hring chung bangkhuo maa law aa.
Riethyivuosuo ma za angpa zaa hne pha lina maa zaa tawpa zaa ta alawna malie pi tie.
Na rehriena ca na changtaapa zaw cunglie hing zaa luo sala, na cahrana rungnaana ca ama saata zaw cunglie hing zaa luo se.
Abyipama Khazing, na hmiephaa ca ma cunglie aw thi sala, ma hmang tuepa bangkhuo lie kha-aw malie pataw sa thi tie. Ma hmang tuepa bangkhuo lie hluetlingna malie pi thi tie.
Cungnungce cawchuena chunglie aw te, Lesyice ningdiy a canawpa ta ca,
Abyipakha, “I canawna hne i riekhuopiehu; i ringchuopa i Khazing,” ama ta aa.
Aa nupa, ciy aa chiypa hmang taa hne puvtlung pasana taata aca khuo aa;
a mathlaa ca buvkhung'a te, zang tluo aa tlana chunglie kha aa bang aa susa pata na aw aa.
Zuo ta ciy aa chiypa hmang kha ciy li'apa cata, ningchung zaw ta rue lina taata a vya zupa cuoti kha ciy'a vaciy.
Zingna chunglie a khiepa puvtlung pasana hne, ningchung ta cawsaa para te a nawlepa zaw kha ciy'a vaciy.
Naa thaalie cawsa thawkha thiy'a yi te, na cacuoluo ta cawsaa thawhraa ama thiy zawta, nama ca khaapatahmuo ca cadi'a vyi.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie duotena ama angpa kha, na ming ta hmung'a cate na mang aa.
Abyipaca na canawna ta tue cate, Cungnungce ca na awna hmang ta na tue nakawta,
pha lina kha na cunglie tlung li'a pata, ruvnaana ta ca cadi'a vyi.
Tahematapakieca Khazing ta na luopuv bangkhuo lie nama mangchiy riypata aa vuoming kha naw pi'a yi te,
iema ta ama kuv ta aca caba'a nakaw yi ta, na phyi kha alung lie a phaw'a vaciy.
Chingde hne pariy kha na tlaw'a yi, ciy aa chiypa chingde hne pariy chiepa tie kha na tlawpuo'a yi.
Naa duepa ca i khuo'a yi; i ming a pachangpa ca i cawchuele'a yi.
Ina u tiy yi ta i chaw'a yi; ruvnaana chunglie zaw awkhyi'a yi angte, palaw sa'a yi angte pa-uvsathyina i pi'a yi.
Hringtaa pasiyna ta ama palung patling sa'a yi angte, khuona kha i pahmung sa'a yi.
Abyipa'a luo palung tluo bie hluopa ca kha tluv tama a pha, Cungnungce a ming kha hlaa ta pathuosapa ca kha tluv tama a pha.
Aa hmangpa na duena kha maw ta cuose, zang tluo naa tlana kha zuo ta cuose pathuosa pata,
riy a hluvsa a hnyipa tingtuolepa hne tingtuo, ramang ue puvthesapa zaw ta na ming pathuosapa ca kha tluv tama a pha.
Vya Abyipa, na hmang tuepa na i palung naa patluo; na kuv ta na tuepa hmang nakawta i palung tluo tena hlaa i sa.
Vya Abyipa, na hmang tuepa ca kha tluv tama a le! Na khueruena ca aa thuv hringhruo.
Capa hmang ca a palung a ky lipa hne a ngaapa ta pachang khu va yi.
Cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa ca aphuv haata kya pu te, hmang pha lipa a tuepa ca a lethaw. Iema ca duote pata chuozaa parapa ama cuo,
cuorasala vya Abyipa, nama ca chuozaa ta naa suo ce pari.
Na carie tie ca ama ra aa tapa hne, hmang pha li a tuepa bangkhuo ca chepatlaa pata na ama cuo aa tapa kha ma pachang.
Cuorasala kama kha calie haata na cahra sa cate, chiytiy thaapa ina pathuv ciy.
I carie tie amaa sungpa kha i ming ta hmung angte, a chiepa i carie tie duote ama angpa kha i naa ta a thyi.
Aa dangpa tie ca tungkung haata hringdiyliy'a yi te, Lebanon tluo lie sidar kung haa tana ama le aa.
Iema ca Abyipaing lie kha a lingpa cuo yi te, ma Khazing hmang dungkhuo chunglie kha hringdiyliy khata ama aw aa.
Ama nungpuv khutaa zaw ta ama thyi pathyi'a yi te, hringdiyliy khata ama panu pari aa.
Capa ca ta Abyipaca aa dang tapa hne; ama ca i lungpuvnung a cuopa hne, ama chunglie ca a dang lina khaapahmuo aw vyi tapa kha a paluo sa.
Abyipaca siepahruo tana a cuo, rungnaana huvhaa na aa buv; Abyipaca rungnaana huvhaa pabuvpa cuo te, cahrana hne tana a bi. Ama ta chuelyi kha sa te, hnyi khupa ta cuo'a vyi.
Naa byithude ca hluo ning taata za padaapa cuo te, nama ca chuozaa taata zaa awpa tana na cuo.
Abyipariyliy tiylaw na a pachi, riyliy tiylaw pu na a paring; tiylaw na aa hrung ta a hrung.
Abyipaca riyliy khalung pu laa tana rungnaana huvhaa a hnyi vie, riyliy tiylaw zaw laata rungnaana huvhaa a hnyi vie, Abyipaca aa suona hmang lie khiy na rungnaana huvhaa hneta a aw.
Vya Abyipa, na phungluo ca chuozaa ta a hmang te, pathena ta na ing ca chuozaa ta a pangi.
Vya Abyipanama ca phuvlatuv tana na cuo, phuvlatuv Khazing, na khena kha pathlie tie!
Alyi bie a ripatuv Abyipa, thu la a hruotlepa tie ca iema hne amaa phuvpa kha pi tie yi.
Vya Abyipa, a hruotlepa tie ca khatiy te khiy ma amaa law aa?
Hmang pha lipa a tuepa tie ca hruotlena bie kha ri yi te, amaa pale.
Vya Abyipa, na cawsaa zaw kha chaapuo yi te, na rucutuv kha ama tuechie.
Iema ta nunghlyi hne haaraa kha thie yi te, khyche zaw kha ama naw.
“Abyipata malie hmung vyi; Jacob Khazing ta malie pachang vyi,” ama ta.
A ngaa cepa zaw, pachang the tie ung; a ngaapa tie zaw, khatiythuema nama sing aa?
Naa a tuetuv hing thyi li pata a aw'a ma? ming a tuetuv hing hmung li pata a aw'a ma?
Mingphang bangkhuo a pasiy a pa-yatuv, cawsaa kha thesingna a pacuvtuv ca the li sing li pata a aw the'a ma?
Abyipata ma ruena kha malie a pachang, ma ruena khaapahmuo a cuo linazya kha a pachang.
Vya Abyipa, nama ta na pasiy na pa-yapa tie hne na phungbie na pacuvpa tie ca a palung tluopa tana ama cuo.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie cuota dena a hnyi lipa khue ama cu hluo te, ruvnaana ningcuo taata lawna na pi yi.
Abyipata a cawsaa zaw kha thaw'a va yi; a rucutuv tie kha thuse'a va yi.
Biedangpa ca aa dangpa tie'a luo kha vya kaa'a te, pathiypalung a dangpa bangkhuo ta ama ca ama ziy aa.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie a du riypata ahungma i cuota a daa ung ciy? pha lina a tuetuv tie a du riypata ahungma kama'a luo ta a daa ung ciy?
Abyipana naa bya va tapa cuo sala a dieta tah awna ruo luo kha a catli pata i chiy'a tli.
“I thaw tli,” ta pata i rue ning kha Vya Abyipa, aa hmangpa na duena ta ina padaa.
Nang-uo vuosuo pata i aw tiyta, i hnaanguona ina ri nakaw ca ta i palung a tluo.
Phungluo kha a pali a pahnaa ta maa te, malie parana ta a hmuopa a pha lipa uvtuv tie ca nama kha acaa phuv the'a yi ma?
Iema ca aa dangpa tie kha a du riypata phuv kha ta aw yi te, suena a hnyi lipa tie kha thie riypata khue ama khuo.
Cuorasala Abyipaca i cariekyikuo ta cuo te, i Khazing ca i canawna alungpuv tana a cuo.
Ama pha lina muo kha Abyipa ta thung'a yi te, ama pha lina kawlieta a paviepatlaa diy'a yi; Abyipata iema kha a paviepatlaa diy'a yi.
A vaw tie ung, Abyipaca hlaa ta pathuosa'a ung puv; malie a khuotuv lungpuv ca palungtluona ueryi hneta pathuosa'a ung puv.
Palungtluona hne a hmiekung luo kha cakuo ung sala; pathuosana hlaa ca palung tluosa pata sa ung siy.
Tahematapakieca Abyipaca a lesyipa Khazing, khazing bangkhuo hrawlie a lesyipa Khazing tana a cuo.
Alyicung aa thuv aa suo bangkhuo hing a kuv cunglie aw te, ama huopa tana a cuo diy.
Riyliy hing ama ta tue te a huopa tana a cuo; alyi zaw hing ama kuvzung tana a cuo.
A vaw tie ung, a hmiekunglie a bung ung sala abie ung siy, Malie a Satuv Abyipahmiekunglie ma pakhuv pane ung siy!
Ama ca ma Khazing tana a cuo, kiema ca ama ta a mangchiypa a cawsaa tana ma cuo.
Meribah lie hne ruocaapa lie Massah lieta nama mingchingmingvuo tie ama palung a za cuopa haata nama palung cuo khah se.
I hriepa re kha ama hmung thluo pata kama kha ina za dyapasya yi.
Kung sawliy chung, hingpa mingphang tie hingta ina nangsa nakaw yi ta, “Iema ca i phungluo kha siysaa ri lipa yi ta ama palungruv a si chiepa tie tana ama cuo,” i ta.
Caacuonakawta i hihaa pata chie sa yi angte, “I pahyna luo kha a ngie'a va yi, i ta,” a ta.
Abyipakha hlaa thaapa ta pathuosa tie ung; alyi ming bangkhuo ta Abyipaca hlaa ta pathuosa tie ung.
Abyipaming ca thluechiy pi ung la hlaa ta pathuosa tie ung; a khuona kaw kha ning kha hnang ning kha ta phu tie ung.
A rungnaana ca mingphang zaw hrawlie kha pathyi sa ung la, nang-uo aa chiypa a hmang tuena kha cawsaa bangkhuo'a luo pathyi sa tie ung.
Tahematapakieca Abyipaca a lesyipa ta cuo te, khuosa ta pathuosa riypa tana a cuo; khazing bangkhuo hrawlieta ciyzaa ce riypa tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca cawsaa zaw khazing bangkhuo ca kuvtuezuv ta cuo yi te, cuorasala Abyipata avuo kha a sa.
Pa-uvsathyina hne lesyina ca na hmiekunglie na a aw; cahrana hne puvthena ca a hmangpathepa chungliena a aw.
Vya cawsaa zaw chungkhue tie, Abyipakha pi tie ung; rungnaana hne cahrana ca Abyipakha pi tie ung.
Abyipaca a ming hne aa tlapa rungnaana kha pi tie ung; pihluo riypa kha a vya cyi ung la a tlawhmie luo kha a vaw tie ung.
Abyipaca a pathe rungnaana chunglieta abie ung la, alyi ming bangkhuo ta a hmiekunglie ca a cathang tie ung.

Mingphang zaw hrawlie kha “Abyipaca siepahruo tana a cuo! Chuelyi ca a cusa pata patupa a cuo; kha tiyta hmuo a hnyi buo hluo'a vyi. Ama ta cawsaa kha aa khing aa nguo pata bie a ripa'a yi,” ta tie ung.
Avuo ca a law sala alyi ca a palung tluo se; riyliy ca a ue sala, a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo zaw khi yi se.
Lu hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo zaw a lawsa yi se. Atuv lie a awpa thingkungpa bangkhuo zaw
Abyipahmielie kha palungtluona hlaa sa yi se, ama ca aa vaw tli, alyi bie ripa riypa tana aa vaw tli. Chuelyi ca adangna ta bie ripa'a te, cawsaa kha aa hmisina ta bie a ripa'a yi.
Abyipaca siepahruo tana a cuo! Alyi ca a palung tluo sala parala ruo zaw ca a law yi se!
A chaakaluvpa zingna hne amyi ta ama ca a cadung; adangna hne biedangpa ca aa byithude hruopatu ta a cuo.
Myi ca a hmieluo ta si te, a cahriylie a awpa a carie tie bangkhuo kha a kuo diy yi.
A thinghlaa ta chuelyi kha pakhe te, alyi ta hmung te aa cathang.
Abyipahmiekunglie ca tluo zaw kha khyihnue haa tana a tiy ta ama lang, Abyipahmiekunglie ca alyi cung bangkhuo khyihnue haa tana a tiy ta ama lang.
Avuo ta ama aa dangnapa kha a phu; cawsaa bangkhuo ta a rungnaana kha hmung yi se.
Kuvtuezuv abiepa tie bangkhuo ca ama nang zaa se; muo a hnyi lipa kuvtuezuv a palesakhyipa bangkhuo ca ama nang zaa se; khazing bangkhuo ca a hmiekunglie kha a bung yi se.
Vya Khazing, nama biechinapa a thyipa Zion ming ca a law yi te, Judah khypuv zaw ta ama palung a tluo.
Vya Abyipa, nama ca alyi ming bangkhuo cunglie naa suo ce; khazing bangkhuo cung luo karaa ta cyicalangpa tana na cuo.
Pha lina a huepa tie kha Abyipata due yi te, a cuota zang tluo a tlapa tie hringna kha a mangchiy yi; cawsaa pha lipa tie kuv chung taa khata a khuo yi.
Khena ca aa dangpa tie cunglie kha khe te, palungtluona ca a palung a pathepa tie cuo tana a cuo.
Vya aa dangpa paa, Abyipacunglie kha na palung tluo sala, a ming pathepa kha pathuosa tie.
Abyipakha hlaa thaapa sa ung la pathuosa tie ung, nang-uo aa chiypa hmang khana a tue. A pathepa a cacuoluo kuv ta tena a hmung.
Abyipata a tena kaw kha a pathyi sa; a khuona kaw kha mingphang zaw hrawlie a pathyi sa.
Israel ming cunglie aa hmangpa a duena hne zang tluo aa tlanapa kha aa thyi. Alyi ming bangkhuo ta ma Khazing tena kha ama hmung diy.
Alyi ming bangkhuo ta Abyipakha palungtluona hne hlaa ta pathuosa tie ung; palung tluo aa chiypa hlaa kha sa ung la pathuosa tie ung.
Abyipakha tingtuo ta pathuosa ung la, tingtuo hne naathlie khing aa chiysapa ueryi ta pathuosa tie ung.
Hmyakaa hne saakiy kha tung ung la, Khazing Abyipaca palung tluosa pata hlaa ta pathuosa tie ung.
Riyliy ca a ue sala, a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo zaw khi yi se; chuelyi hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo zaw a ue yi se.
Cavaa zaw ta ama kuvpazaa tung yi sala; Abyipahmiekunglie kha tluo zaw ta palungtluona hne hlaa sa yi se,
ama ca alyi bieripa riypata aa vawle nguoluo. Ama ta chuelyi kha adangna hneta bie ripa'a te, cawsaa zaw kha aa dangsa pata bie a ripa'a yi.
Abyipaca siepahruo tana a cuo; cawsaa bangkhuo ca a cathang diy yi se! Cherubim cunglie byithude cunglie khana aa tu; alyi lie aling a siy se!
Abyipaca Zion lie kha a lesyi; cawsaa bangkhuo cunglie kha cyicalang pata a cuo.
A lesyipa hne ciy aa chiypa na ming ca pathuosa yi se. Ama ca a pathepa tana a cuo!
A lesyipa Siepahruo, biedangpa a duepa, nama ta akhing-anguona kha na pacu sa. Israel ming chunglie kha biedangpa hne adangna na hrie.
Abyipama Khazing kha pathuosa ung la; a phyi china thude thabaw lie kha abie tie ung. Ama ca a pathepa tana a cuo.
Moses hne Aaron ca a tluobyi za cuo yi te, Samuel zaw ama'a luo thlaa zaa chuopa tie hrawlie pakha tana a cuo ra. Abyipakha za u yi te a chaw yi.
Amyi taw chung taa khata bie a za chang yi; a biechina kha za ziy yi te, a pipa yi phungluo kha ama ziy.
Vya Abyipama Khazing, iema kha na chaw yi; nama ca iema a ngiethetuv Khazing tana na cuo, cuorasala ama tuesuepa kawlie phuvlatuv tana na cuo.
Abyipama Khazing kha pathuosa ung la, a tluo pathepa lie kha pathuosa tie ung; Abyipama Khazing ca a pathepa tana a cuo.
Alyi ming bangkhuo ta palungtluona hneta Abyipakha hlaa ta pathuosa tie ung!
Palungtluona hneta Abyipakha abie ung la; hlaa sa ung la a hmiekung luo ca vya pya tie ung.
Abyipaca Khazing a cuopa kha pachang tie ung. Malie a satuv ca ama ta cuo te, kiema ca ama huopa tana ma cuo; a cawsaa ta cuo pate, a tuvrung tana ma cuo.
A thlake luo ca palung tluo pata a ngie ung la, a tlawhmie luo kha pathuosana hneta a ngie tie ung. Ama kha pathuosa ung la, a ming kha thluechiy pi tie ung.
Abyipaca a pha; aa hmangpa a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang, zang tluo aa tlana ca chuo bangkhuo aa hmang.
Zang tluo atlana hne biedangpa kaw ca hlaa ta i sa aa; Vya Abyipanama'a luo kha hlaa ta i sa aa.
Syisaa riy a aw lipa hring kha i cuv aa. Khatiythuema i pha khu aa. I ing lie hing palung pathesa pata na i aw aa;
i hmiekunglieta hmang pha lipa kha chi'a va ang.
A pha lipa pathiypalung ca kama hneta a hla'a te, a pha lipa hmang kha suokha hmuo pachang'a va ang.
A ingpaa kawchie a paruvta tah a ripa kha i para aa. A palung lepa hne a hruotlepa ca a ngiethe khu'a va ang.
Zang tluo aa tla pata a hringpa tie kha kama hne ama aw thena riypata hmiephaa i pi'a yi. Syisaa riy aw li pata a hringpa tie ca kama re khana ama hrie aa.
Hanghie pata a hring lipa na i ing lie a aw aa; hangbie a ri lipa na i hmiekunglie kha a aw patlung aa.
Ruochung lie cawsaa pha lipa tie kha ning kha hnang ning kha ta para'a yi angte, hmang pha lipa a tuepa bangkhuo ca Abyipakhypuv chungtaata i papya diy'a yi.
Vya Abyipa, i thlaachuona kha na naathlie tie; ica una ueryi ca nama'a luo kya pha thi se.
Palungriethyina i taw tiyta na hmie na nukhuo thi khah. Ica una ca na naathliepa la; a catli pata na chaw thi tie.
I ningcuo ca myikhuv haata vie te, i ruv ca sumyi haa tana a kuo.
I pathiypalung ca ruvna angte a phuv haata aa uv; i saning thaa hmuo hang va tli.
Khuopuv ta i hrung nakawta i ruv hne i vang dyina a aw.
Ruocaapa chunglie a awpa tutaru haa khata cuo angte, utlaw lie a awpa tutaru haa kha tana i cuo.
A hmung the li pata aw angte, thlungkhuv daw lie sakha dyi ta a awpa pavaa haa tana i cuo.
I carie tie ta ning-aw ningtlabu ta na tapake hyalya yi te, i ming kha siepina ta ama hmuo.
Buvcuo kha sa haata ning angte, i dangpa zaw ca mingthliy hneta aa pya.
Na hi a haa hringhruo nakawta; na calang cate ina thaw ciy.
I ningkhue ca zuoluocaw ningdiy haa kha tana a cuo; aphuv haa kha tana i caa.
Cuorasala Vya Abyipa, nama ca chuozaa siepahruo tana na cuo; na ming ca chuo bangkhuo aa hmang.
Thu'a cate Zion cunglie kawpacuona na hnyi aa, capa khy ngie na china riypa cuo cana a pha tli; thli ciepa cuo na a vya chiy tli.
Na changtaapa zaw ta aa lung kha duena hne a hrie yi te, a buvcing cunglie kha hmuo ngiechina ama hnyi.
Mingphang zaw ta Abyipaming kha ciyzaa'a yi te, alyi siepahruo bangkhuo ta na rungnaana kha ama ciyzaa aa.
Abyipata Zion kha sa'a te, a rungnaana hneta aa luo aa.
Siypasa tie thlaachuona kha naathliepa yi te, siysaa ri li pata aw'a vyi.
Capa kaw ca a vaw riypa chuo cuo khata cape pata cuo se, ata lie a puv li liepa cawsaa ta Abyipakha ama pathuosa the riypata.
Abyipata aa suopa hmang pathepa taata a za suo, vuoruo taa khiyta alyi luo a za suo,
capa ca thaw a tlapa tie a hrungna ue thyi riypa hne, thie riypata bie chipa ciepa tie hya pazang riypa tana a cuo.
Cahaacata Abyipaming ca Zion lie pathyisa pata cuo'a te, Jerusalem lie pathuosa pata a cuo aa.
Abyipapathuosa riypata ruo ting taata cawsaa kha amaa hmya aa.
I chuo khingkhuo hmuo i vaa li lie pata Abyipata i thaazuo kha pachung te, i chuo kha a pachang sa.
Kama ta, “Vya i Khazing, i chuo khingkhuo ta i hringna kha na la thi khah, nama ca chuozaa ta a hringpa tana na cuo,” i ta.
Hluo ning taa khata alyi hruo hing patu cate, avuo ca nama kuvzung tana a cuo.
Alyi hne avuo ca ra'a yi te, nama ca naa hmang aa; iema ca pang haata ama caw diy aa. Caw haata thle'a yi cate ama vie diy aa;
cuorasala nama ca na hmanghmangpa ta cuo'a cate, na hringna kungkhue kha khatiy tahmuo chuo'a vyi.
Na changtaapa saata zaw ca aa bangpa ta aw'a yi te, ama samingsahlaa zaw ca na hmiekunglieta amaa hmang aa.
Vya i hringna, Abyipaca pathuosa tie, i cuona bangkhuo, a ming pathepa ca pathuosa tie.
Vya i hringna, Abyipaca pathuosa tie, kha tluv tama a pha tapa kha maw khah.
Na pha lina bangkhuo kha caa ngiethe te, na pasana bangkhuo kha aca patluo sa,
thiyna khue chungtaata ca khuo te, aa hmangpa a duena hne malie a ngiechina byilakhuv kha aca pakhuv,
na hring chung bangkhuo hmang phapa ta na palung ca patling te, caacuonakawta hmungthlu haata panu pakhaa cate na cahra.
Abyipaca tuechiena a angpa tie cuota ama sue lina haata biedangpa ta bie a chi.
Moses ca aa tingpa kha chang te, Israel ming ca a hmang tuepa kha a chang yi.
Abyipaca nangduena hne vihnyina ta bi te, a palung pasiy te aa hmangpa duena a hnyi pari.
Sue malie phaw pari li'a pata, chuozaa ta a hi haa pari'a vyi.
Ma suena hne aa phuv pata ma cunglie tue vyi, ma pha lina hne aa phuv pata zaw malie thung vyi.
Avuo ca alyi laata aa suo vie karaapa haata, aa hmangpa a duena ca ama a ciyzaapa zaw cunglie a le hringhruo.
Ningchiy ca ningtla hne aa hlapa haata, ma suena ca kiema hne aa hlasana luo malie a chipa.
Paa ta saata zaw kawpacuona a hnyipa haata, Abyipata ama a ciyzaapa zaw cunglie kha kawpacuona a hnyi yi.
Khaapa taata tuepa tama ma cuo tapa kha pachang te, buvcing khuv ma cuopa kha a pachang.
Cawsaapa hringna hing aphuv haa tana a cuo, kya le te ruo lie paapaapa haata a paa;
thliy a vya hruo te, phyale te a vie, a awna hmang khata khatiy tahmuo hmung pakhaa va tli.
Cuorasala ama a ciyzaapa zaw cunglie Abyipaduena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
A biekuo a ziypa hne a nawbie a tuepa tie cunglie zaw a duena ca samingsahlaa chuo te aa hmang.
Abyipata a Byithude ca vuoruo lie khiy patu te, a pena ta ruo ting kha a uv.
Vya aa vuoming zaw, niema, a lesyipa, a ri a ngiepa hne a bie a ngiepa tie, Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung.
A khingna haata a rehrietuv ama avuoming zaw, Abyipaca aa cungnungce pata pathuosa tie ung.
A sapa hmang bangkhuo ta, a pena chung ruo ting lie kha, Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung. Vya i hringna, Abyipaca pathuosa tie.
Vya i hringna, Abyipaca pathuosa tie! Vya Abyipai Khazing, nama ca na lesyi hringhruo. Pa-uvsathyina hne lesyina ta pabuvpa cuo cate,
khena kha pang haata naa buv. Avuo khiy pangthluodaa haata pake cate,
tiy cunglie khiy na ing ca na sa. Amyi khiy naa ruole ta tue cate, thliy mathlaa khiy naa khangle.
Thliy khiy na biephyatuv ta tue cate, myi hne myihlaa ca na rehrietuv ta na hmuo yi.
Khatiy tahmuo aa cahang khu li riypata alyi ca a hruopatu lie kha a cusa pata na bang.
Pang pabuvpa haa khata alyi ca riyliy ta pabuv cate, tluo zaw kha tiyta a buvkhung.
Tiy ca na chuo tiyta a ruole yi te, na khalung pu ama thyi tiyta a catlisa pata ama langle.
Capa tiy zaw ca tluocung hne bawphie luo zaw kha langle yi te, na rite paciepa hmang luo kha ama pangie.
Alyi kha ama vya pakhaa li riypata ama law khu li riypa ruoriy kha na chi khuo yi.
Bawphie lie kha acaa patling sa cate, tiy ca tluo hne tluo alalalie kha ama lang.
Saruo phangting kha dang riypa tiy pi yi te, ruo chunglie laa zaw kha ama tiyhrie a cing.
Cavaa kie thingkung cunglie kha pavaa zaw ta buv a tue yi te, hlaa ama sa.
Avuo taata tluo cung luo kha khy za pasaa sa cate, alyi ca na thluechiy ta a bi.
Saruopa cuo ta aphuv na papu sa, alyi ta kung a pavyi riypata, cawsaapa cuota sakung pi yi cate,
cawsaa palung a patluo riypata mingsuvtiy, ama hmiephya a papha riypata olif chiytiy hne, ama thaazuo a cahra sa riypata sa na pi yi.
Abyipaaa lingpa Lebanon tluo cunglie sidar kung zaw ta lunghruo tlungsa pata tiy ama hmung.
Capa lie ca pavaa ta ama buv a tue yi te, aathlaruo zaw ta myisaa kung hraw kha ama ing ta amaa ri.
Tluo aa suopa cunglie kha sathaa zaw khysa yi te, lungkuo lie kha savilepa tie amaa nu.
Ningcuo pasuvna riypata thlaapa kha sa cate, ning zaw ta a tlana cuo kha a pachang.
Nama ta zuo kha sa cate, capa zingna chunglie kha ruo saruopa bangkhuo ta amaa khie.
Chingde thuthawpa zaw ca saa ama sie khing nakawta khi yi te, Khazing ta a pipa yi sa kha amaa huv.
Ning a kya chiy taata ama khue luo kha kaa yi te amaa bu.
Cawsaa zaw ca re hrie riypata pya yi te ningtlana te ta re ama hrie.
Vya Abyipa, na tuepa hmang hing a hluv hringhruo! Hingpa zaw bangkhuo hing singna ta na tue; alyi hing na sapa hmang ta a bi.
A lesapa hne a kusapa riyliy kha na sa, a valepa saruopa hne, a hringpa saruopa a le a caw ta ri tie li ama aw.
A cunglie tiypalaw zaw si yi te, a chunglie a cang riypata na sapa Leviathan parapuv zaw a aw.
Capa bangkhuo ca ta iema'a na a cuota sa na pi riypa kha aca mangkhuo yi.
Sa na pi tiy yi ta ning yi te, na pasaa tiy yi ta ama palung a tluo.
Na hmie na nukhuo tiy yi ta rutla zang yi te ama thlaa a zang; ama hringna na la tiyta thiy yi te alyi diypa ta amaa li pakhaa.
Na huv kha na pi tiy yi ta iema ca sapa ta cuo yi te, alyi ca na pathaa pakhaa.
Abyiparungnaana ca chuozaa ta a hmang sala; Abyipaca a tuepa hmang cunglie kha a law mang sue.
Alyi ca a mang tiyta a cathang te, tluo ca a hrie tiy yi ta myikhuv ama papya.
I hring chung bangkhuo Abyipaca hlaa ta pathuosa'a angte, i hringna a aw chung bangkhuo i Khazing'a luo kha pathuosana hlaa i sa aa.
Kama ca Abyipachunglie i lawpa haata, i ruena hne i pacuona hing ta a palung patluo thi mang yi se.
A suepa tie ca alyi lie hing vie yi sala, cawsaa pha lipa tie ca aw khah tie yi se. Vya i hringna, Abyipaca pathuosa tie. Abyipaca pathuosa tie!
Abyipakha palungtluona bie hluo tie ung, a ming kha ukhyi tie ung, a tuepa hmang kha cawsaa hraw luo pathyi tie ung.
Ama'a luo kha hlaa sa tie ung, ama kha hlaa ta pathuosa tie ung; kharuehaa hmang a tuepa bangkhuo ca ri tie ung.
A ming pathepa ca rungnaa mang sue; Abyipaa huvpa pathiypalung chunglie palungtluona aw mang sue.
Abyipahne a cahrana kha huv tie ung; ama minghmie kha huv pari tie ung.
Vya a changtaapa Abraham samingsahlaa, aa tlawpa Jakob saata zaw, kharuehaa aa chiypa a hmang tuena kha a thyi ung la, a tuepa kharuehaa hmang hne a biechipana zaw kha a thyi tie ung.
Ama ca Abyipama Khazing ta cuo te, a biechipana ca alyi cung yalya cuota a cuo.
A biekuona kha chuozaa ta a thyi te, a biepina kha chuo thawkha te ta aa thyi.
Abraham hneta a tuepa biekuona, Isak'a lieta chiesana ta bie aa kuopa,
Jakob'a lieta phungluo haata a pacu sapa hne, Israel'a lieta chuozaa biekuona a tuepa,
“Kanaan ruo ca nama na cuvu hne ru ta ica pi aa,” a tapa ca chuozaa ta a pacu sa aa.
Mingluv ta ama cawsa ning, khyche ta ama za cuo ning,
ruo kha hnang ruo kha, pe kha hnang pe kha ta amaa zaa khie ning kha
iema hrisaa riypata ahunghmuo pa-aw va yi, iema kawlieta siepahruo zaw kha chuo yi te,
“Kama ta sathu i pathuvpa tie hing taw khah ung; i profet tie hing ruvnaana pi khah ung,” a ta.
Ruo chunglie cakuo patlung sa te, sa hmung khunapa luo bangkhuo a chipachung diy ningta,
sii ta ama za zaapa Josef kha ama hmieluo ta a pathlie lu.
A phyi kha hrakyi khe yi te, a rue lie kha thaa akyi ama pa-ya;
a rilupa a vya tling hluo li, Abyipabie ta ama kha a dyapasya.
Siepahruo ta thaw-ing taata papya te, mingphang zaw uvtuv ta a pathlie.
A ing chung uvtuv hne, a hnyipa bangkhuo uvtuv ta a tue.
Siepahruo kuv rawlie byi zaw kha changpachaana naw hnyi te, a uvthyi tie kha singna a pacuv yi.
Jakob ca Izipt ruo luo kha va chiy te, Ham lie kha khy a sa.
Abyipata a cawsaa zaw ca khuopuv ta papungpazaa sa yi te, ama carie tie laata a cahra sa vie yi.
Izipt ming ca a cawsaa zaw kha pahue sa yi te, iema cunglie kha dungvie pata re a pahrie sa yi.
Ama ta a sii Moses hne, aa tlawpa Aaron kha a pathlie yi.
Iema hrawlie kha pamangsana hmang tue yi te, Ham lie kha kharuehaa hmang ama tue.
Zingna pathlie te khy a pazing sa; cuorasala Izipt ming ta a bie kha amaa du.
Ama tiy kha thiy ta pali te, ama ngaa kha a pathiy diy.
Ama ruo lie ca-uv bi te, siepahruo a ziena khuo te ta a bi.
Khazing ta naw pi te ama ruo chung bangkhuo ca mathu hne macing ta a bi.
Khy saa cuopa ta ari kha pasaa sa te, ama ruo chung bangkhuo thinghlaa aa cakang.
Ama mingsuv hne thyikuv kung kha para te, ama ruo chunglie thingkung bangkhuo kha a thlibaruv diy.
Bie pi te, ri tie lipa khawbyapa kha vya pya yi te,
ruo chunglie uohnaasiyyhnaa bangkhuo hne, thingthyi-uosa bangkhuo kha ama ce paming diy.
Ama ruo chunglie ama thaazuo taapa ta a cuopa sa-uvthyi bangkhuo kha a thie diy yi.
Cakhutaata Israel ming kha siy hne ngu hneta papya sa yi te, ama mingphang hrawlie a thaacawpa pakha hmuo aw va yi.
Israel ming ama si tiyta Izipt ming ca ama palung a tluo, tahematapakieca ama za ciy nakawta a cuo.
A cawsaa zaw cunglie kha amyi pazupa yi te, zuo ta khena a pi riypata myi a pi yi.
Amaa hie tiyta mamang kha pi yi te, ama riy bisana te ta ama ning riypata vuoruo taata sa a pi yi.
Alung kha tuvchi te tiy a pya, ruocaa lie kha cavaa haata tiy a lang.
Tahematapakieca a pathepa a biekuona hne, a changtaapa Abraham kha aa thyi nakawta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta a cawsaa zaw ca palungtluona hne pyakhyi yi te, aa tlawpa tie ca hlaasana hne aa chiy yi.
Mingphang hrangpa tie zaw ruo kha pi yi te, ama hnyirungna zaw kha amaa la.
Capa ca iema ta a phungluo patling sa pata, a phungbie kha ama ziyna riypa tana a cuo. Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung!
Abyipakha pathuosa tie ung! Abyipakha palungtluona hluo tie ung, tahematapakieca ama ca a pha; a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Abyipata a tuepa hmang lepa hing ahungma a ri tie aa? Ama ca ahungma tluotling pata a pathuosa khu aa?
Biedangpa a hringkhyipa tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo, adangna a tue paripa tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo.
Vya Abyipa, na cawsaa zaw hmiephaa na pi tiy yi ta, kama zaw naa thyi thi mya.
Naa tlawpa tie ama hnyirungpa kha i hmung riypa, na mingphang zaw ama palungtluona lie i law ra riypa hne, na ru chunglie rungnaana i hmung riypata naa thyi thi mya.
Kiema hne mingchingmingvuo tie hne ma sue mangtli; pha lina kha a chiehruv ciemuo pata ma tue mangtli.

Ma mingchingmingvuo tie Izipt lie ama za aw ningta, na kharuehaa hmang tuepa kha za pachang the va yi, a chuo buo lipa na duena tluotlingpa zaw kha za pachang the va yi. Cuorasala Cungnungce ca Riyliy Sepa lie kha amaa zaa du.
Cuorasala a cahrana hne a ming ama pachangna riypata iema kha a khuo yi.
Riyliy Sepa kha chuo te a ky; capa aa thuvpa chunglie ca viehnangruo lie sipa haata a pasi sa yi.
A huepa tie kuv chung taa khata khuo yi te, carie kuv taa khata a palaw sa yi.
Ama carie tie ca tiy ta buvkhung yi te, pakha hmuota a ngaa va yi.
Cakhutaa dyi ta a bie kha zang yi te, hlaa ta ama pathuosa.
Cuorasala a tuepa kha maw paluo yi te, a ruena kha hie pata huo va yi.
Cuorasala ruocaapa lie kha ama khingna ta a za tetuv nakaw yi ta, ruocaapa chunglie kha Khazing ama za dyapasya.
Ama khingpa kha a pi yi, cuorasala pasa chiepa kha ama hrawlie a patlung sa.
Ruocaapa arina hmang lie kha Moses hne, Abyipacawsaa pathepa Aaron cunglie hietliena ama za hnyi.
Alyi a cakang te Dathan kha a paluo, Abiram phuv tie zaw kha a buvkhung diy yi.
Iema a ziytuv tie kha myi ta za tlasue yi te, cawsaa pha lipa tie kha a kuo diy yi.
Horeb lie kha cuetaata zuv sa yi te, kuvtuezuv kha amaa bie.
Iema ta Khazing rungnaana kha aphuv a cepa cuetungpa kuvtuezuv ta ama thle.
Izipt lieta hmang lesyi a tuetuv khuotuv Khazing kha ama maw.
Ham lie hne Riyliy Sepa lieta kharuehaa hmang a tuetuv kha ama maw.
Caacuonakawta aa tlawpa Moses ta, parana hmang, Khazing hmiekunglie kha a daa pata, iema para riypa kha a thlu li kieca, Khazing ta iema kha i para'a yi, a ta.
Aw khing aa chiysapa ruo kha siysaa ri li pata aw yi te, a biekuo kha zang va yi.
Ama thluodaa chunglie kha a cie yi te, Abyipabie kha a ngie va yi.
Caacuonakawta a buo kha pazu te ruocaapa chunglie amaa lie riypata hne
ama ciypathla zaw kha mingphang zaw hrawlieta ruo ting ta amaa chepatlaa diy riypata chie a sa yi.
Peor lieta Baal kha abie ra yi te, a thiypa khazing'a lie hriykhung amaa rinapa saa kha ama ce ra.
Ama hmang tuepa ta Abyipapathiy kha pa-ie te, puvtlung pasana ta a tlung yi.
Cuorasala Finehas ta tluotla te a suepa tie kha duo a te tiy yi ta, puvtlung pasana ca aa pe.
Capa ca adangna ta ripa pata cuo te, chuo kha hnang chuo kha, chuozaa ta ripa pata a cuo aa.
Meribah acaa lie kha Abyipahi pahaa yi te, iema kawlie ca ta Moses kha riethyi a ang.
A hi ama pahaa tuv nakawta, ri li riypa te kha a ri.
Abyipata bie a pipa haa yi ta, cawsaa kha thie diy va yi,
cuorasala iema hne kha ta a pya yi te iema hringzya kha amaa cuv.
Ama kuvtuezuv kha abie yi te, iema a pa-uotuv cyihyi ta aa li.
Ama sacapaa hne sacanung zaw kha khuevuo amaa biena.
Suena a hnyi lipa thiyse, ama sacapaa hne sacanung thiyse kha ama palang. Kanaan ruo kuvtuezuv amaa bienapa thiyse ca ta ruo ca a papya a palyi.
Ama hmang tuepa ca ta iema kha papyapalyi yi te, iema'a na iema kha siyhrawnung ta amaa tue.
Caacuonakawta Abyipaca a cawsaa zaw'a lie kha a hi haa te, a ru ta a cuopa zaw kha a duvsa yi.
Mingphang hrang zaw kuv luo kha pi yi te, iema a huepa tie khata ama uv.
Ama carie tie ta hrisaa yi te, ama uvna rawlie ama chi.
Iema kha yi hluvpuv a palaw sa raalaa pa yi ta, a du riypa dyi kha amaa ting nakawta ama pha lina chunglie kha aa thuv vie ta ama tla tyly.
Cuorasala ama caana ueryi kha a thyi tiyta, ama palungriethyina kha a pachangpa yi.
A biekuona kha a thyipa yi te, aa hmangpa a duena thueta ama cunglie kawpacuona a hnyi yi.
Sii ta a ziypa tie bangkhuo ta iema kha ngie ama chi riypata a tue yi.
Vya Abyipama Khazing, malie khuo tie, nama pathuosa pata, na ming pathepa hne na rungnaana lie maa law riypata mingphang zaw chung taa khata malie pakiy tie.
Abyipa, Israel ming Khazing ca chuozaa taata chuozaa te thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue. Cawsaa bangkhuo ta, “Amen” ta diy yi se. Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung!
Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung, tahematapakieca ama ca a pha; aa hmangpa a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Abyipaca ama ta a khuopa tie ta pathuosa yi se; ruvnaana chungtaata a khuopa tie,
ningchiy, ningtla, sungluo hne chaluo taata pakiy yi te, ruo chung luo a vya pahmya pakhaapa tie ta ama ca pathuosa yi se.
A che ca viehnangruo chunglie kha vie yi te, ama awna riypa khy luo sinapa luopuv kha hmung khu va yi;
nangdiy tiyhrie pata aw yi te, ama palung a chuo.
Ama ruvnaana chungtaata Abyipa'a luo kha khi yi te, ama palungriethyina taa khata a khuo yi.
Ama awna riypa khy ama phana te ta luo a dangpa paziy sa yi te aa chiy yi.
Aa hmangpa a duena kawlie hne, cawsaa zaw cunglie a tuepa kharuehaa hmang kawlieta, Abyipaca pathuosa yi se.
Tahematapakieca ama tiy a hriepa tie kha ama tiyhrie a pacing sa yi, ama nang a diypa tie kha hmang phapa ta ama riy a pabi yi.
A che ca palungrana hne khyzingna chunglie kha aw yi te, palungriethyina thaariy ta a cakhiy yi,
tahematapakieca Khazing bie kha a du yi te, Cungnungce ruena pipa kha siysaa ama ri li nakawta a cuo.
Re ruvpa pahrie sa yi te ama pathiypalung kha a cahna yi; a lie yi te a pathu riy aw va yi.
Ama ruvnaana chungtaata Abyipa'a luo kha khi yi te, ama palungriethyina taa khata a khuo yi.
Zingna hne ngiechina chungtaata thue yi te, a ciypakinapa yi thaabuoliriy ca a chipa pachung diy yi.
Aa hmangpa a duena kawlie hne, cawsaa zaw cunglie a tuepa kharuehaa hmang kawlieta Abyipaca pathuosa yi se.
Daa ta tuepa chiypakaa zaw kha phawchi diy te, pakhuo khuopa thaariy ca a hluo pachung diy.
Chekha ca ama sue nakawta pasa yi te, ama pha li nakawta ruvnaana ama ang;
sa bangkhuo kha duv yi te, vuotaa ama thiy.
Ama ruvnaana chungtaata Abyipa'aluo kha khi yi te, ama palungriethyina taa khata a khuo yi;
a bie kha pathlie te iema kha a khuo yi, rana chungtaata iema kha hya a pazang yi.
Aa hmangpa a duena kawlie hne, cawsaa zaw cunglie a tuepa kharuehaa hmang kawlieta Abyipaca pathuosa yi se.
Alawna hriykhungrina kha pi yi sala, palungtluona hlaa ta a hmang tuena kha ri yi se.
Chekha ca tiypalaw ta riyliy luo kha si yi te, riyliy tiy cunglie kha sung ama pali;
Abyipata a tuepa hmang, tiy aa thuvpa chunglie kharuehaa hmang zaw kha ama hmung.
Naw pi te thliychie aa hruo nakawta riyliy tiylaw kha a thu.
Tiypalaw ca vuoruo te ta caba te, aa thuvpuv luo a pachung; cahaapa vuochina chunglie ca ama palung a chuo hringhruo;
sahmaa a pariypa haata a viele yi te amaa lie, ama thesingna zaw khaapahmuo thlahne vyi.
Ama ruvnaana chungtaata Abyipa'aluo kha khi yi te, ama palungriethyina taa khata a khuo yi;
thliychie kha padie sa te, riyliy tiylaw ca a die.
Cahaacata a die nakawta a law yi te, ama si khingnapa palaw adingna hmang kha a papha sa yi.
Aa hmangpa a duena kawlie hne, cawsaa zaw cunglie a tuepa kharuehaa hmang kawlieta Abyipaca pathuosa yi se.
Cawsaa zaw amaa hmyanapa lie kha ama ca pathuosa yi sala, uvthyi zaw amaa hmyanapa lie kha pathuosa yi se.
Abyipata cavaa zaw kha paky te, acaa zaw kha ruo caavungpa ta a tue;
khy ming ruo ming ama pha li nakawta ruo phapa kha ruo chiepa ta a pali.
Viehnangruo ca tiy-ang zaw awnapa ruo ta pali te, a caavungpa ruo ca acaa zaw awnapa ruo ta a pali;
capa lie ca a nangdiypa tie kha khy pasa sa yi te, ama awna riypata khypuv suokha kha a ma sa.
Lu ama tue, mingsuv diedung zaw tue yi te, kung ama pavyi.
Thluechiy pi yi te cawsaa ama pungzaa, ama sahring zaw a pungzaa.
Carie tie ta te yi te, hrisaana ruvnaana hne ngiechina ama ang tiyta,
a hrisaatuv tie kha ama nang pazaa yi te, viehnangruo chunglie kha a pavievuv sa yi;
cuorasala riethyivuosuopa tie kha ama ngiechina chungtaata calang yi te, ama chungkhue kha tuvrung haata a papungzaa sa yi.
Cawsaa phapa tie ta hmung yi te amaa law, cawsaa pha lipa tie ta ama hmya amaa paping.
Singna a hnyipa tie ta hingpa hmang hing rue syalya yi sala, aa hmangpa Abyipaduena kha pacuo syalya pari yi se.
I palung ca aa hmang, Vya Khazing, i palung ca aa hmangsa; hlaa sa'a angte na ica pathuosa aa. I hringna, a hra tie!
Vya tingtuolepa hne tingtuo zaw, a hra tie ung! Kama zaw mawdiy tana i hra aa.
Vya Abyipa, cawsaa zaw hrawlie na ica pathuosa aa, mingphang zaw hrawlie na hlaa ta ica pathuosa aa.
Tahematapakieca aa hmangpa na duena ca avuo laata a suo vie te, zang tluo naa tlana ca amyi te khiy a kya pha.
Vya Khazing, avuo khung te khiy ta cyicalangpa cuo la, na rungnaana ca alyi cung yalya hing buv diy se.
Na duepa zaw hyazangna ama hmung the riypata, na cacuoluo kuv ta tena malie pi la, i thlaachuona na palie thi tie.
Khazing ta a hmangpathepa chunglie kha bie malie a kuo: “Palungtluona hneta Shekhem ca chechi'a angte, Sukkoth Bawphie ca ica re'a yi.
Gilead ca kama huopa ta cuo te, Manasseh zaw kama huopa tana a cuo; Efraim ca i thaalakhuv ta cuo te, Judah ca i byikhuecahryi tana a cuo.
Moab ca i kuv a siynapa bikang ta cuo te, Edom ca i phyipakaw chinapa tana a cuo; Filistia kha te'a angte tena hneta i u aa,” a ta.
Ahungma dungkhuopa khypuv luo naa chiy aa? Ahungma Edom luo naa chiy aa?
Vya Khazing, malie na thaw tli cuo va ma? Vya Khazing, nama ca ma rieka tie hneta si vaciy.
Ma carie tie a du riypata malie a bya tie, tahematapakieca cawsaa abyana ca khaapahmuo thlahne vyi.
Khazing hne tana riephasa pata ma hrie aa, ama na ma carie tie a tetuv ta a cuo aa.
Vya Khazing, I pathuosapa, a dieta tah aw khah.
Tahematapakieca cawsaa pha lipa tie hne a hangpa tie na naa pachie yi, hangbie tana inaa du yi.
Huena bie ta naa du yi te, a kaw aw li pata inaa du yi.
Iema cuota thlaa te chuo angte i duena yi kha, suebena ta ina thung yi.
Phana kha pha lina ta na thung yi te, i duena kha huena ta ina thung yi.
Iema ta, “Ama a du riypata cawsaa pha lipa kha chipa tie ung; a cacuoluo kuo ta a dutuv kha a daa se.
Bie a ri tiyta a suena kha hmung sala; a thlaachuona kha suena ta ripa se.
A chuo pachang sala, aa daahmang kha malie ta la yi se.
A saata zaw haaraa yi sala, a napuv kha nunghlyi se.
A saata zaw kha a khiele pata a hiele yi sala, ama awnapa ing chiepa taata a cadepa cuo yi se.
Ducyi a pipa kha ta a hnyipa bangkhuo kha chuv sala, a hrie muo kha khyche ming ta chuv yi se.
Ahungtahmuo a cunglie duena hnyi khah yi sala, a haaraapa a saata zaw kha ahungtahmuo ngiechi khah yi se.
A ciyhruo kha chuo sala; chuohningna lie ca a ming kha maw pathla pata cuo se.
