A paa pha lina kha Abyipahmielie a thyipa cuo sala, a nung suena ca maw pata cuo khah se.
Ama suena ca Abyipahmiekunglie a hmang sala, cuorasala iema ca alyi lie hing a thyipa ta cuo khah yi se.
Tahematapakieca ama ca kawpacuona za hnyi khu hrahring vyi, cuorasala siypasa tie hne riethyivuosuopa tie hne, a palung rapa tie kha a hrisaa yi.
Malie chiesa kha a khingsa; chiesana ca a cunglie tlung se. Malie thluechiy pi kha khing the vyi, thluechiy ca ama'a taata a hlasa se.
Chiesana ca buohryi cungpakaw haata aa hryi, capa ca ta a pangpa kha tiy haata paci sala, chiytiy haa ta a ruv chungluo a ngie diy se.
A chiesana bie ca ta ama kha pang haata pahlaw sala, ningting ta aa sawpa tesaw haata a saw se.”
Capa ca kama sue naa phawpa tie hne bie pha lipa ta naa tapa tie zaw Abyipa'a taata ama lawmuo ta cuo se.
Cuorasala, Vya Abyipa, kama Byipaapa, na ming phana riypata kama cuopa ta re hrie la, aa hmangpa na duena ca a pha nakawta kama kha hyazangna na pi tie.
Kama ca siypasa hne riethyivuosuopa tana i cuo, i palung na a ra hringhruo.
Zuoluocaw ningdiy haa tana vuotaa i vie'a nang tli, thliy ta a phyapa khawbyapa haa tana i cuo.
Sa i ning li nakawta i pakhuv ca aa cathang ta a cathang te, i pangpa ca zuekari khata a ta.
Sue naa phawtuv tie ese hyalya riypata cuo angte, ina hmung tiy yi ta ama hning dyi ina tisue yi.
Vya Abyipai Khazing, naa bya tie! Aa hmangpa na duena thueta kama kha na khuo tie.
Hingpa hmang hing nama na a hrie ciy tapa kha iema ta pachang yi se, Vya Abyipa.
Iema ta chie na sa yi sala, nama ta thluechiy ina pi'a ciy. Khuosa ta kama naa dupa tie ca ama nang zaa sala, na changtaapa tuv ca a law ang se.
Sue naa phawtuv tie ca lingzuena ta pahlaw yi sala, ama nangzaana khata a pahlaw ta pahlaw yi se.
I pakaa taa hingta Abyipaca khuopuv ta i pathuosa aa, cawsa a hluvsa hrawlie hing i pathuosa aa.
Tahematapakieca ama ca riethyivuosuopa tie cacuoluo kuo ta a daa te, iema a thie khingpa tie kuv taa khata a khuo yi.
Abyipata siepahruo i Byipaapa kha, “Na carie tie kha na phyipazaa rawlie chaapuo riypata i tue hluo li yi, i cacuoluo kuo hingta a tu tie,” a ta.
Abyipata a cahrapa a byikhuecahryi ca Zion taata a vya pathlie. Na carie tie hing uv tie yi.
Tluo pathepa lie rie na tuv ningta na cawsaa zaw ca iema palung thu ta amaa vya aa. Mawdiychie aduotiy haa khata na mingnu zaw ca nama'a luo kha ama vya pya aa.
Abyipaca bie aa kuo tli nakawta a palung a thle'a vyi, “Nama ca Melkhizedek tluobyi phung haata chuozaa tluobyi tana na cuo aa,” a ta.
Abyipaca na cacuoluo kuo tana a aw; a hihaanapa ning lieta ca siepahruo tie kha a chepatlaa diy'a yi.
Mingphang zaw kha bieripa'a yi te, capa hmang ca a thiypa riyy ta a bi aa; luv zaw ca a kusapa chuelyi lieta a dechi diy'a yi.
Ama ca luopuv kielie a langpa cavaa tiy kha dang'a te, a thaa a tlung aa.
Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung! Abyipaca aa dangpa a cawsaa zaw amaa hmyanapa lieta i pathiypalung hmisi ta i pathuosa aa.
Abyipahmang tuepa ca kharuehaa aa chiy, a tuepa hmang cunglie a lawpa ta ca capa ca ama pacuo syalya.
A hmang tuepa ca pa-uvsathyina hne lesyina ta bi te, Aa dangna ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Kharuehaa aa chiypa a hmang tuepa thueta mingpathuona hmung te, Abyipavihnyina hne nangduena ta a bi.
Ama a ciyzaapa tie kha sa ring yi te, a biekuona kha aa thyi pari.
A re hrie khu cahrana kha a cawsaa zaw ca pahmung sa yi te, mingphang hrang tie chuelyi kha iema ca a pi yi.
A kuv ta a tuepa hmang ca zang tluo a tla te aa dang; a phungluo bangkhuo ca a ringchuo tluo aa tla.
Zang tluo a tlana hne adangna tue riypata chuozaa ta a pahmang sa yi.
A cawsaa zaw kha a thla yi te, a biekuona kha chuozaa cuota a pi yi. A ming ca pathe te nang-uo aa chiy.
Abyipaciyzaana ca singna hruothuna tana a cuo; cahaacata a tuepa tie ca a phapa pachangna kha ama hnyi. Ama pathuosana ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung! Abyipaa ciyzaapa tie hne a nawbie ziy kha a tlechuopa tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo.
Ama ciypathla zaw ca ruo chunglieta cawsaa lesyipa tana ama cuo aa; cawsaa phapa samingsahlaa zaw ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo aa.
Ama chungkhue ca a siyphapa hne a hnyirungpa cuo'a yi te, amaa dangna ca chuozaa ta aa hmang aa.
Aa dangpa tie ca zingna chunglie hmuo khena haa tana ama cuo, iema ca vihnyina, nangduena hne adangna tana ama hring.
Pahyasa pata malie kha pahlie yi te, iema kawlie aa dang pata re a hriepa ca kha-aw na a taw.
Tahematapakieca cawsaa phapa ca khatiy tahmuo tlahla buo'a vyi; cipari a thyipa tana ama cuo aa.
Thuohlaa chiepa thyi kha ciy va yi; Abyipa'a lie kha ama palung cu te amaa hmang.
A palung die hyalya khata ciyna hnyi va yi; a chuona ta ca ama carie tie amaa sungpa kha ama ming hrahring ta ama hmung aa.
Siypasa tie kha pahyasa pata ama pi; amaa dangna ca chuozaa ta a hmang te, pa-uvsathyina hne cyicalang pata ama cuo.
Capa ca cawsaa pha lipa tie ta hmung yi te ama hi a haa; ama haa dyi ama rie; ama khingna hne amaa ruechuopa zaw a vie.
Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung! Vya changtaapa zaw, Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung; Abyipaming ca pathuosa tie ung.
Abyipaming ca ata taa hingta chuozaa ta pathuosa pata aw mang sue.
Ning a chiy taata ning a tlana te Abyipaming ca pathuosa riypa tana a cuo.
Abyipata mingphang bangkhuo kha a uv, a rungnaana ca avuo laata aa suo vie.
Abyipama Khazing haapa ahung ma a aw? ama ca aa suona lie khiy a tu te,
luohlaapuv taata avuo hne alyi hing a za mangbung.
Siypasa tie kha buvcing taata a caba yi, riethyivuosuopa tie kha buvcuo chungtaata a calang yi te,
siepahruo saata zaw, a cawsaa zaw a uvtuv siepahruo saata zaw hne khata a patu pakhaw yi.
Saa a sa khu lipa nung kha, a ing lieta, haatiy zaw hneta a palung a tluopa nung ta a tue. Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung!
Israel ming Izipt taata ama pya tiyta, Jacob phang zaw ryi hrang a cyipa mingphang tie taata ama pya tiyta,
Judah ca Khazing hmangpathepa ta a li te, Israel ca uvna hmang ta aa li.
Riyliy ta hmung te aa ruo; Jordan cavaa ta aa daa.
Tluo lepa zaw ca tuvtungpa haata a cathlu yi te, tluo cawta zaw ca tuvtaata haata amaa cathlu.
Vya riyliy, khaapanakawma naa ruo? Vya Jordan, khaapanakawma naa daa?
Vya tluo lepa, tuvtungpa haata ma naa cathlu? Vya tluo cawta, tuvtaata haata ma naa cathlu?
Vya Alyi, Abyipahmiekunglie, Jacob Khazing hmiekunglie hing a cathang tie.
Alungpuvnung kha tiy-ang ta pali te, vuokhaw lung ca acaa ta a pali.
Vya Abyipa, kiema cuo li pata nama ming dyi hing rungnaana pi pata cuo se, tahematapakieca aa hmangpa na duena hne zang tluo naa tlana kawlie tana a cuo.
Khaapanakawma mingphang zaw ta “Ama Khazing ca khaapaliema a aw?” ama ta aa.
Ma Khazing ca vuoruo lie aw te, a tue khingpa kha a tue.
Iema kuvtuezuv ca ngu hne siy ta cuo te, cawsaa kuv ta tuepa tana a cuo.
Pakaa ca ama hnyi, cuorasala bie ri the va yi; ming ca ama hnyi, cuorasala hmung khu va yi.
Naa ama hnyi raalaa pata thyi khu va yi, hnaakhue ama hnyi raalaa pata a rang thyi khu va yi.
Kuv ama hnyi, cuorasala khaapahmuo hrie khu va yi; phyi ama hnyi raalaa pata cakuo khu va yi; ama rawkariy ta ue papya the va yi.
Capa kuvtuezuv a satuv tie zaw ama sapa kuvtuezuv cana ama lu; iema a ringchuopa tie zaw iema ca ama lu ra ngiethie.
Vya Israel, Abyipaca a ringchuo tie! Ama ca Israel ming a byatuv hne a cawchuetuv tana a cuo.
Vya Aaron phang zaw Abyipaca a ringchuo tie ung! Ama ca Aaron phang a byatuv hne amaa phya tana a cuo.
Abyipaa ciyzaapa zaw, Abyipaca a ringchuo tie ung! Ama ca a ciyzaatuv hne a ringchuotuv zaw a byatuv hne amaa phya tana a cuo.
Abyipa ta malie a thyi pari te, thlue malie a chiy aa; Israel phang kha thlue chiy'a te, Aaron phang kha thlue a chiy aa.
Ama ta Abyipaa ciyzaapa tie kha a le a caw ta thlue a chiy'a yi.
Abyipata niema hne nama saa nama nu zaw ca, ca papungpazaa sa yi se.
Alyi hne avuo a satuv Abyipata thlue ca chiy yi se.
Vuoruo ca Abyipavuoruo ta cuo te, cuorasala alyi ca cawsaapa zaw na malie a pi.
A dieta tah awna luo a si tlipa athiypa tie ta ca Abyipakha pathuosa va yi.
Cuorasala kiema ca Abyipakha ata taa hingta chuozaa ta ma pathuosa aa. Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung!
Abyipaca i due, tahematapakieca i thlaachuona hne i ueryi kha ina thyipa.
Kama kha ina naathlie nakawta, i hring chung bangkhuo ama kha i u pari aa.
Thiyna ta cyihyi lie na pa-uo te, Sheol ta a kuv lie ina cahuv nakawta, palungriethyina hne ruvnaana khuopuv ta i ang.
Ca tiyta Abyipakha u angte: “Vya Abyipa, nama'a luo na thlaa i chuo, i hringna hing na khuo tie,” i ta.
Abyipaca vihnyituv hne aa dangpa tana a cuo; ma Khazing ca nang malie a duepa tana a cuo.
Abyipaca a palung pathepa tie kha a daapakhuo yi te, aa ne luo pachungpa i cuo tiyta ina khuo.
Vya i hringna, hnaanguosa pata aw tie, tahematapakieca Abyipana na cunglie a pha hringhruo.
Abyipanama ta i hringna kha thiyna taata na khuo, i ming kha mingthliy langna taata khuo cate, i phyi a pachiy sa vaciy.
Abyipahmiekunglie, a hringpa tie ruo lie kha i khie.
“Khuopuv tana siypasa riethyi i ang,” i ta ning hmuota, i zang ngiethie kalie.
I ciy tuv suesaa nakawta, “Cawsaa bangkhuo hing a hanghiepa selaw,” i ta ning zaw ta i zang ngiethie kalie.
I cunglie Abyipaa phana hing, tuokhaatama i thung khu aa?
Khuona panuo kha calang'a angte, Abyipaming kha i u aa.
A cawsaa zaw bangkhuo hmiekunglieta, Abyipaca bie i kuopa kha i pi aa.
Zang tluo aa tlapa a cawsaa pakhakha ama thiypa ca, Abyipacuota kha tluv tama a muo a sung?
Vya Abyipa, kama ca na changtaapa tana i cuo; na re a hrienung saata, na changtaapa tana i cuo. Kama naa ciypakipa kha ina pathluopa ciy.
Palung tluo hriykhungrina kha ca pi'a angte, Abyipaming ca i u aa.
Jerusalem liekhingkhuo, Abyipaing tlawhmie, a cawsaa zaw bangkhuo hmiekunglie kha,
Abyipaca bie i kuopa kha i pi aa. Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung!
Mingphang bangkhuo zaw, Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung! Cawsaa bangkhuo zaw ama ca pathuosa tie ung!
Aa hmangpa a duena ca ma cuota le hringhruo te, Abyipazang tluo aa tlana ca chuozaa ta aa hmang! Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung!
Abyipakha palungtluona hluo tie ung, tahematapakieca ama ca a pha; a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang!
Israel ming ta, “A duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang,” ta yi se.
Aaron phang ta, “A duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang,” ta yi se.
Abyipaa ciyzaapa tie ta, “A duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang,” ta yi se.
I palungriethyina chungtaata Abyipaca i u; Abyipata na palie te a kusapa hmang lie ina chi.
Kama kuo luota Abyipaa aw nakawta khaapahmuo ciy va ang. Cawsaapa ta ca i cunglie khaapama a tue khu aa?
Abyipata inaa daakhyi nakawta, naa huepa tie ca tena hne tana i mang'a yi.
Cawsaapa a ringchuopa laata, Abyipa'a luo vaa canawpa na a pha vie.
Siepahruo tie a ringchuopa laata, Abyipa'a luo vaa canawpa na a pha vie.
Mingphang bangkhuo ta ina cadung raalaa pa yi ta, Abyipaming ta i te diy yi.
Iema ta ina cadung yi, a kuo ting taata ina cadung yi; Abyipaming ta i te diy yi.
Khyi haata ina baw raalaa pa yi te, ahling kung a kuopa myi haata ama die diy paluo; Abyipaming ta i te diy yi.
A lie naase ta pata khuosa ta ina nuo yi, cuorasala Abyipata inaa bya.
Abyipaca i thaazuo hne i cahrana ta a cuo, i khuona tana a cuo.
Aa dangpa tie thluodaa chungliena palungtluona tena ueryi a paring: “A cahrapa Abyipacacuoluo kuv na a te,
Abyipacacuoluo kuv ca cyicalangpa tana a cuo; Abyipacacuoluo kuv na cahrana ta a te.”
Thiy'a valie ang, cadyiseca hring'a angte na, Abyipahmang tuepa kaw hing i ri aa.
Abyipata khuosa ta duo ina te, cuorasala thiy riypata ca na pahya vyi.
Adangna thlake kha na pahawpa ung la, a ngie'a angte, Abyipakha i pathuosa aa.
Hingpa hingna Abyipathlake ta a cuo; hingpa taa hing tana aa dangpa tie ca amaa ngie aa.
I thlaachuona kha na palie cate, naa khuotuv na cuo nakawta ica pathuosa.
Ing satuv tie ta ama thawpa alung ca, ingkiylung le cepa tana aa li.
Hingpa hing Abyipata a tuepa tana a cuo; ma hmungna lieta nang-uo aa chiysa.
Ataning hing Abyipata a tuepa ning tana a cuo; hingpa ning lie hing a nuo ung sala a law ung siy.
Vya Abyipa, paa na maca kie, malie khuo thi tie! Vya Abyipa, paa na maca kie, hluetlingna malie pi thi tie!
Abyipaming ta a vawpa ca thluechiypa tana a cuo. Abyipabiena-ing taa tana thluechiy maca pi.
Abyipaca Khazing ta cuo te, khena malie a pituv tana a cuo. Nama kuv lie thingnge kha a cyi ung la, pyi ca pathu ung la bienatluophie kha cahlung tie ung.
Nama ca i Khazing ta cuo cate, ica pathuosa aa; nama ca i Khazing ta cuo cate, ica cyicalang aa.
Abyipakha palungtluona hluo tie ung, tahematapakieca ama ca a pha, a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Abyipaphungbie kha ziy te, a hringzya syisaa riy a aw lipa tie ca, thluechiypa tana ama cuo.
A pathiypalung yalya ta ama kha huv te, a biechina a ziypa tie ca, thluechiypa tana ama cuo.
Hmang pha lipa kha tue li pa yi ta, Abyipaluo kha ama ziy.
Na phungluo kha a phasa pata ziy riypata, bie malie na pi.
Na phungluo hing ziy khu ang sala, i luopuv hing aa dangsa aa.
Na nawbie bangkhuo hing ci li ta a mangpuo khu ang sala, nangzaa pata aw'a va ang.
Aa dangpa na biechina i pachang tiyta, palung pathesa pata ica pathuosa aa.
Na phungluo kha i ziy aa; na thaw pathla thi khah.
Tuokhaatama mingnu tie ta hring pathe pata ama aw khu aa? nama bie ziyna thue tana ama aw khu aa.
I pathiypalung yalya ta nama kha ica huv; na nawbie kha i piese li riypata naa bya tie.
Nama'a lie i sue li riypata, na bie ca i pathiypalung chunglie i khung.
Vya Abyipanama ca thluechiypa tana na cuo; na phungluo kha na pacuv tie.
Na pakaa ta na ripa na biechina bangkhuo kha, i pakaa ta ri'a angte i pathyi sa aa.
Suethiy a hluvsa laata, na biechina na i tlechuo vie.
Na phungluo kha pacuo syalya'a angte, na luopuv kha i mangpuo pari aa.
Na phungluo kha tlechuo'a angte, na bie kha maw'a va ang.
Na bie kha ziy'a angte i hring riypata, na changtaapa hing thluechiy na pi thi tie.
Na phungbie lie a awpa kharuehaa hmang kha i hmung khu riypata, i ming hing pavuo sa thi tie.
Hingpa alyi lie hing khyche haa tana i cuo, na nawbie kha na nukhuo thi khah.
Na biechina khana i hringna ta, chungzuo ta a vuo pari.
A hruotlepa tie kha chuo yi cate na nawbie a piesepa tie kha chie na sa yi;
na phungluo kha i ziy nakawta, ina manghnuena yi hne ina esena taa yi khata na palaw sa tie.
Siepahruo tie zaw ta kama raw riypata khuekhuo pakhaw ra mang yi sala, na changtaapa ca na phungluo khana i pacuo byalya aa.
Na ziyphung ca tlechuo angte, sing naa changtuv tana a cuo.
I hringna ca buvcing liena a laa; na bie haata na pahring pakhaa tie.
I hringzya ica chang tiyta ina palie ciy; na phungluo kha na pacuv tie.
Na phungluo ziyzya kha na pachang sa la, kharuehaa aa chiypa na hmang tuena kha i pacuo syalya aa.
I ngiechituv te i palung a za; na bie ta thaa na patlung tie.
Luo chie i ziy li riypata naa bya la, vi na hnyi la na phungbie kha na pacuv tie.
Zang tluo aa tla pata hring kha a tlaw tli angte, na phungluo kha i hmiekunglie chi angte i mangpuo pari.
Vya Abyipana biechina kha i ziy tli, nangzaa pata na chi thi khah.
Nama ta pachangna ina pi tyly'a nakaw ca ta, na nawbie ca thaathusa pata i ziy.
Vya Abyipana phungluo kha na pacuv tie, a chuona te ta ziy i zue aa.
Na phungbie i ziy khu riypata, pachangna kha na pi la, i pathiypalung yalya ta i ziy aa.
Na nawbie kha i tlechuosa nakawta, capa luo lie ca naa chiy tie.
Kama cuo dyi i rue li riypata, i pathiypalung kha na phungbie luo kuo ta maa tie.
Khaahmuo a thlahne lipa hmang luo dyi i ming i padyi li riypata, nama hringzya kha na pahnyi sa tie.
Na sii a cuopa cunglie hing na biekuona ca pacu sa tie, capa ca nama caa ciypa zaw cuo tana a cuo.
I ciysapa nangzaa aa chiypa hmang taa khata na palaw sa tie, tahematapakieca na biechina ca a pha.
Na phungluo na i ziy khing hringhruo, naa dangna chunglie kha na pahring sa tie.
Vya Abyipaaa hmangpa na duena ca i cunglie tlung sala, na biekuona haata khuona zaw i cunglie tlung se.
Cahaacata na bie kha i buchuo nakawta, naa tue hyalyapa tie zaw bie kha i palie khu'a yi.
A hmisipa bie kha i pakaa taata na lapa thi khah, tahematapakieca na biechina chunglie khana i ruechuona ca a aw.
Na phungbie ca chuozaa ta, i ziy pazue pari aa.
Na phungluo ziy kha i zue nakawta, hyazangsa pata na i aw aa.
Na biechina ca siepahruo tie hmiekunglie zaw ri'a angte, nangzaa pata cuo'a va ang.
Na nawbie ca i due nakawta, na nawbie ziy ca i tlechuo hringhruo.
Na nawbie ca due angte i pa-uvsathyi, na phungluo ca i pacuo byalya aa.
Na changtaapa'a lie ina pipa ciy na bie kha maw thi khah, capa ca i nguopuona tana a cuo.
Palungriethyina chunglie hmuo i hnaa a nguo, tahematapakieca na biekuona na hringna naa pi.
A hruotlepa tie ta ina ese hyalya yi, cuorasala kama ca na phungbie taata pie va ang.
Hluo ningta na biechina kha i rue pakhaa tiyta, Vya Abyipacapa ca ta i hnaa ina panguo.
Na phungbie a thawpa cawsaa pha lipa tie kawlieta, i hi a haa.
I awna bangkhuo lieta, na phungluo ca i hlaa tana a cuole pari.
Vya Abyipa, zuo zaw ta nama kha caa thyi angte, na phungbie kha i ziy.
Na phungluo kha i ziy nakawta, i palung a tluo.
Vya Abyipanama ca kama huopa tana na cuo, na bie ca i ziy aa ta pata bie i kuo.
I pathiypalung yalya tana icaa nue, na biekuona haata vi na hnyi thi tie.
Na luopuv hing i rue syalya tiyta, na biechina luo kha i vya pali pakhaa.
Na nawbie ziy riypa kha, haasaa li pata i pahraa.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie khuhriy ta ina pa-uo zawta, na phungbie ca maw'a va ang.
Na biechina ca aa dang nakawta, zuocang ta thu angte ica pathuosa.
Kama ca nama caa ciyzaapa hne, na phungluo a ziypa tie viesaa tana i cuo.
Vya Abyipaalyi ca aa hmangpa na duena tana a bi, na phungluo kha na pacuv tie.
Vya Abyipana bie haata, na changtaapa cunglie hing na pha hringhruo.
Na nawbie kha i zang nakawta, a phapa biechi khuna hne thesingna kha na pi tie.
Duotepa i cuo hluota ca luo na i za paa, cuorasala ata hing ca na bie na i ziy.
Nama ca pha cate hmang phapa na tue, na phungluo kha na pacuv tie.
A hruotlepa tie ta hanghie pata bie ina pachie yi, cuorasala i pathiypalung yalya tana na phungluo kha i ziy.
Ama palung le te ama chiesa, cuorasala kama ca na phungbie khana i tlechuo.
Duotepa i cuopa ca a pha, tahematapakieca na phungbie i cuvna riypa tana a cuo.
Na pakaa taata a pyapa na phungbie ca, i cuo hingta siy hne ngu a hluvsa laata a pha vie.
Na kuv ta ina sa ciy, na nawbie i cuv the riypata pachangna na pi tie.
Nama caa ciyzaapa tie ta kama kha na hmung'a yi te ama palung a tluo aa, tahematapakieca na bie lieta anguopuona i hnyi nakawta a cuo.
Vya Abyipana biechina ca aa hmuo tapa kha i pachang, zang tluo naa tlana chungliena duo ina te ciy tapa i pachang.
Na changtaapa kha bie inaa kuopa haa cata, aa hmangpa na duena ca i hnaanguona ta cuo se.
Na phungbie kha i tlechuo nakawta, i hringna riypata na nangduena ca i cunglie tlung se.
Zyatena hneta kama kha ina para nakaw yi ta, a hruotlepa tie ca nangzaana ang yi sala, kama ca na phungluo khana i pacuo syalya aa.
Na biechina kha ama pachang riypata, nama caa ciyzaapa tie ca kama'a luo a vya maa yi se.
I nang a zaa li riypata, i pathiypalung ca na phungluo kawlie sue be riypa aw khah se.
I hringna ca na khuona vuo tana aa uv, na bie na i nguopuopa ta a cuo.
“Khatiythuema hnaa ina panguo'a ciy?” ta angte na biekuo i mangkhuona lie i ming zaw a risa tli.
Kama ca myikhuv chunglie savang ungchuo haa tana i cuo, cuorasala na phungluo kha maw va ang.
Na changtaapa hing khacuo ma i te-ang aa? Kama naa hrisaapa tie hing khatiythuema bie na ripa'a yi?
A hruotlepa tie, na phungbie a dupa tie na kama pathlana riypata suphung a cu yi.
Na nawbie bangkhuo ca aa hmang; a kaw aw li pata na ina hrisaa yi; naa bya tie!
Alyi taa hingta ina pahli ina padie'a nang tli yi, cuorasala na phungluo ca thuse va ang.
Na biechina kha i ziy riypata, aa hmangpa na duena chunglie i hringna kha chi thi tie.
Vya Abyipa, na bie ca chuozaa ta aa hmang, vuoruo lie khiy a cusa pata a aw.
Zang tluo naa tlana ca chuo kha hnang chuo kha ta aa hmang, alyi hing sa cate, a awna liena a aw pari.
Na china haa yi ta ataning te ama aw, tahematapakieca hmangting bangkhuo hing na changtaapa tana ama cuo.
Na phungbie hing tlechuo li pata aw ang sala, palungriethyina cangta na i ra aa.
Na phungluo hing maw hluo'a va ang, iema thue hing tana hringna ina pi ciy.
Kama ca nama huopa tana i cuo; na khuo tie, tahematapakieca na phungluo ziy khana i zue pari pata a cuo.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ta thie riypata ina bya yi, cuorasala kama ca na biechina khana i rue pari.
Khaapa hing hmuo a tlingpa aw vyi tapa hing i pachang, cuorasala na nawbie ca chuona hnyi li pata a ku hringhruo.
Kha tluv tama na phungbie hing i khing! Hingpa hingna ning-aw ta i pacuo syalya.
Na nawbie kha i hringkhyi pari nakawta, i carie tie laata ina pasing sa vie.
Na biechina kha i rue byalya nakawta, i saya tie bangkhuo laata i the vie.
Na phungluo kha i ziy nakawta, nungpuv macuo tie laata i pachang vie.
Na bie kha i ziy khing nakawta, hmang pha lipa bangkhuo kha i cahriy.
Nama ta ina pacuv nakaw ca ta, na biechina kha piese va ang.
Na bie ca kha tluv tama a thlung, khyitiy laa tana a thlung vie.
Na phungluo taata pachangna i hnyi, caacuonakawta luo aa hmuo lipa bangkhuo ca i hue.
Na bie ca i phyi cuota myi-ing ta cuo te, i luopuv lie khena ta a cuo.
Aa dangpa na biechina ziy riypata, bie a kuo angte i pacu sa.
I rie na a thyi hringhruo, Vya Abyipa, na bie haata hringna na pi tie.
Vya Abyipaica pathuosana hriykhungrina ca na cuhluo thi la, na biechina kha na pacuv thi tie.
Ningting thlaazang pata i aw pari, cuorasala na phungbie kha maw va ang.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ta cyihyi ina thlakhuo yi, cuorasala na phungluo taata pie va ang.
Na biechina ca chuozaa i ru tana a cuo, i palungtluona tana a cuo.
Na phungluo ziy riypa ca i palung ta a khingsa, chuozaa, cuo chuona te ta.
Palung kuo hning ta a vaapa tie kha i hue yi, cuorasala kama ca na phungbie khana i khing.
Nama ca kama i canawnapa, kama i pakhuonapa phya tana na cuo, na bie lie tana anguopuona i hnyi.
Niema hmang pha lipa a tuepa tie zaw, i Khazing nawbie kha i ziy thena riypata, kama'a taa hingta cakuo tie ung.
Bie ina kuopa haa cata thaazuo na pi la i hring aa, i nguopuona lie kha nangzaa pata na chi thi khah.
I bang thena riypata na calang tie, na phungluo kha cipari ta i rue aa.
Na phungluo taata a piepa bangkhuo kha na thaw yi, ama zyatena ca a hripa tana a cuo.
Alyi cawsaa pha lipa bangkhuo hing hnehnawvaabuv haa tana na rue yi, caacuonakawta na biechina hing i khing.
Nama ica ciy pata a cathang angte, na biechina ca i ciy.
Aa dangpa hne a phapa ca i tue tli, naa tuechiepa tie'a lie kha na thuse thi khah.
Na changtaapa i phana kawlieta bie naa kuo la, Khazing a pachang lipa tie tuechie riypata na thuse thi khah.
Na khuona hne aa dangpa na biekuona i mangkhuona lieta, i ming a risa mangtli.
Aa hmangpa na duena haata na changtaapa cunglie hing hrie la, na phungbie kha na pacuv tie.
Na biechina kha i pachang riypata, pachangna kha na pi tie, na changtaapa tana i cuo.
Vya Abyiparehrie na pathu cuo tana a cuo tli, tahematapakieca na phungbie khana ama para.
Na nawbie ca siy laata i khing vie hmisi, siy phapa laata i khing vie.
Na phungluo kha ziy hmisi angte, aa hmuo lipa luo bangkhuo kha i hue.
Na biechina ca kharuehaa a chiy te, caacuonakawta i hringna ta a ziy.
Na bie pasiesana ta khena malie a pi, singna a hnyi lipa tie kha singna a pi yi.
Na nawbie kha i khing tuv nakawta, i pakaa uo angte i huv a chuosa.
Na ming a tlechuopa tie zaw'a lie na tue tawpa haa khata kama'a luo a vya pali la vi na hnyi tie.
Na biekuona haata i kuorakuo hing mangchiy la, pha lina ta na uv thi khah se.
Cawsaa ina tuechiena taa yi ta hya na pazang la, na biechina kha i ziy aa.
Na changtaapa hing hmiephaa na pi la, na phungluo kha na pacuv tie.
Na phungbie kha ama ziy li nakawta, i mingthliy na cavaa tiy haata a lang.
Vya Abyipa, nama ca naa dang, na biechina zaw aa dang.
Nama pipa biechina ca a dang te zang tluo aa tla.
I carie tie ta na bie kha siysaa ama ri li nakawta, i pathiy ca myi ie ta a ie.
Na biekuona ca kha tluv tama a ringchuo aa tla! na changtaapa ta i khing hringhruo.
Kama ca khaapahmuo a thlahne lipa hne siysaa ri lipa tana i cuo, cuorasala na phungluo kha maw va ang.
Naa dangna ca chuozaa ta aa hmang, na phungbie ca biehmisipa tana a cuo.
Ruvnaana ta khuopuv ta ina tlungsue, cuorasala na nawbie ca i tlechuo.
Na biechina ca chuozaa ta aa dang, pachangna kha na pi la i hring aa.
Vya Abyipa, i pathiypalung yalya ta ica u; na chaw tie, na phungbie kha i ziy aa.
Nama khana ica u; na khuo la, na biechina kha i ziy aa.
Khy dyi hluota ca u angte byana icaa hie, na bie ca i nguopuona tana a cuo.
Na biekuona kha i pacuo syalya nakawta, zuo khydyi mingsaa pasing va ang.
Aa hmangpa na duena thueta i ueryi kha na thyi la, Vya Abyipa, naa dangna chunglie i hringna kha na mangchiy tie.
Kama naa hrisaapa tie ta atingna chiepa hneta inaa vya ngie yi; iema ca na phungbie hneta amaa hlasa.
Vya Abyipa, kama hne aa ngieta lie aw cate, na nawbie bangkhuo ca aa hmuo.
Na biechina ca hluo ning taa khata i za pachang tli, chuozaa cuota na tuepa tana ama cuo.
I riethyivuosuona hing mang la na khuo tie, tahematapakieca na phungbie kha maw va ang.
Na rikuo la na khuo tie; na biekuona haata hringna na pi tie.
Khuona ca cawsaa pha lipa tie'a taata aa hla, tahematapakieca na phungluo kha huv va yi.
Vya Abyipa, na nangduena ca a le hringhruo, naa dang nakawta hringna na pi tie.
Hrisaatuv hne cariepa hluvsa i hnyi, cuorasala na biechina taata pie va ang.
Zangna a hnyi lipa tie ca i ming hne a raw va yi, tahematapakieca na nawbie kha ziy va yi.
Kha tluv tama na phungluo i khing tapa kha rue la, aa hmangpa na duena ta i hringna kha cake tie.
Na bie bangkhuo ca biehmisipa tana a cuo, aa hmuopa na biechina bangkhuo ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Siepahruo tie ta a kawluo aw li pata ina hrisaa yi, cuorasala kama ca na bie kha i ciyzaasa.
Hruosue muo ruvsapa a hmungpa haata, na bie lieta i palung a tluo.
Hangpa ca hue angte i duv, cuorasala na phungbie ca i khing.
Aa dangpa na biechina kawlieta, ning kha ta yi sariy ica pathuosa.
Na phungbie a tlechuopa tie ca thlaalungna lepuv hnyi yi te, khaapatahmuo ruvnaana pi khu'a va yi.
Vya Abyipa, na khuona ca a nguopuo angte, na nawbie ca i ziy diy pari.
Na biechina ca i hringna ta ziy te, i khing hringhruo.
Na phungluo hne na biechina ca ziy angte, i tuepa bangkhuo ca na hmung diy.
Vya Abyipaica una ca na hmiekung luo chiy sala, na bie haata pachangna kha na pi tie.
Paa ica kienapa ueryi ca na hmiekung luo chiy sala, na biekuona haata kama kha na khuo tie.
Na phungluo kha ina pacuv nakaw ca ta, i pakaa ta ica pathuosa aa.
Na nawbie bangkhuo ca a pha nakawta, i palyi ta aca pathuosa aa.
Na phungluo kha i tlaw tli nakawta, na kuv ca kama a bya riypata a pacaw pacie pata aw thi se.
Vya Abyipana khuona ca vuo angte, na phungbie ca i tlechuopa tana a cuo.
Hring ang sala nama kha ca pathuosa ang se, na biechina ta kama kha naa bya se.
Tuv viepa haata luo i pie mangtli; na changtaapa hing na huv thi tie, tahematapakieca na phungbie kha maw va ang.
I palungriethyina chungtaata Abyipakha u angte ina palie.
“Vya Abyipa, a hanghiepa hne dung a hmuopa tie'a taa khata na khuo tie.”
Niema dung a hmuopa tie, niema ca khaapa pi pata ma nama cuo aa? niema cuota khaapama tuepa vie pata a cuo aa?
A cahresapa rieka cuoti hne, thingcuopa myihyi sekhalapa na a cuo aa.
Bawchie ciemuopa tana i cuo, kama ca Meshek ruo lie kha khyche ta cuo angte, Kedar tie thluodaa zaw hrawlie tana i aw aa.
Diena a huepa tie'a liena a pasiy tuv i aw tli.
Kama ca diena kuo luo ta cuo angte, cuorasala diena kaw i ri tiyta, iema ta rie a du riypa kaw dyi kha ama ri.
Tluo cung luo khiy suo angte, khaapa taata ma byana i hmung aa? i ta.
Byana ca Abyipa'a taa tana aa vaw aa, alyi hne avuo a satuv'a taa tana aa vaw aa.
Ama ta naa lie riypata ca pahya'a vyi, nama caa mangchiytuv ca tluv buo vyi.
Israel a mangchiytuv ca tluv buo li pata, aa hmung zaw a hmung buo vyi.
Abyipaca nama caa mangchiytuv tana a cuo; Abyipaca na cacuo kuo luo ta a awpa na canawna ningdiy tana a cuo.
Ningchung ta ning ta cuose, zuo ta thlaapa ta cuose ruvnaana ca pi'a vyi.
Abyipata pha lina bangkhuo chungtaata ca khuo'a te, na hringna kha aca ve aa.
Abyipata na pya luo cuose, naa ngie luo cuose, ata taa hingta chuozaa ta ca ve'a te aca mangchiy aa.
“Abyipaing luo cakuo ung siy,” ina ta ning yi kha i law.
Vya Jerusalem, ata hing na thlake chungliena maa daa nguoluo.
Jerusalem khypuv ca a puvthesa pata hne aa chikakysa pata, sa pakhaapa khy tana a cuo.
Abyipaming kha pathuosa riypata, Israel ming ca changpa ama cuopa haa khata, Abyipamingphang tie ca capa khypuv luo ca ama cakuo taw.
Capa khypuv lie ca biechinapa byithude, David phang byithude ca patu pata a cuo.
Jerusalem diena cuota thlaachuo tie ung, “Nama caa duepa tie ca thluechiypa ta cuo yi se.
Na lungruetlepie dungkhuo chunglie ca diena aw sala, na rievena ingsuo lie abangna aw mang sue.”
I tieta hne i viesaa kawlieta Jerusalem ca, “Na cunglie diena aw mang sue,” ica ta aa.
Abyipama Khazing ing kawlieta, nama phana kha i huv aa.
Vya Khazing, vuoruo lie byi a cuopa, nama'a luo dyina i kya suo!
Changtaapa tie ta, ama byipaapa kuv ama mangkhuopa haata hne changtaanung ta a byinung kuv a mangkhuopa haata, nangduena malie a hnyi hluo li, Abyipa, ma Khazing kha ma mangkhuo.
Nang malie due tie, vya Abyipa, nang malie due tie, tahematapakieca esena khana a hlyi ta ma ang.
A palunglepa tie manghnuena hne a hruotlepa tie esena na khana, ma hringna ta a hlyi ta ma ang tli.
Abyipakha kiema malie zaa cuo li pata aw sala, Israel ta ata hingta ri se,
Abyipakha kiema malie zaa cuo li pata aw sala, carie tie ta malie ama tuv ning kha,
ama hi haa suesaa te ama pathiy a ling dyi a ling ning kha, ma hring thluopa hing tana malie ama za paluo diy aa.
Cakhutaata zaa lepa tiy khata malie phya diy'a te, a cahrasapa tiy khata malie a buvkhung diy'a mangtli;
a pachikhalapa tiy khata malie a za langpakhung diy'a tli.
Ma carie tie ta malie ama caphipatlaa riypata malie a pahya lipa Abyipaca thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue.
Cyihyi a thlapa paa cyihyi taata a zangpa pavaa haata, cyihyi taata ma law ung. Cyihyi ca cipachung te, kiema kha ma zang.
Alyi hne avuo a satuv Abyipaming tana kiema ca abyana hing ma hmung ung.
Abyipaa buchuopa tie ca Zion Tluo haa tana ama cuo, Zion Tluo ca cahang khu zaw aw li pata, hnyi khu zaw aw vyi.
Tluo ta Jerusalem kha a cadungpa haata, Abyipata a cawsaa zaw kha a cadung yi, ata taa hingta chuozaa ta.
Aa dangpa tie kuv ta suena a tue pathlyi li riypata, cawsaa pha lipa tie byikhuecahryi ta aa dangpa tie ruo ca uv pari'a va yi.
Vya Abyipaa phapa tie hne, a palung pathepa tie cunglie kha hmang phapa tue thi tie.
Cuorasala iema zyatena luopuv a ziypa tie ca, Abyipata hmang pha lipa a tuepa tie hne khata ruo chungtaata a papya hne'a yi.
Abyipata Zion luo malie a vya kaakhyi pakhaa ning kha, ima muo na a za lusa.
Ma pahnyi dyi za chiy te, palungtluona hne ma za khi. Mingphang hrangpa tie ta, “Abyipana iema cuota hmang lepa a tue,” ama ta.
Abyipata kiema cuota hmang lepa tue hmisi te, ma palung a tluo hringhruo.
Vya Abyipa, khy pasaa sa cate, Negeb cavaa lie tiy na palang sa pakhaapa haata, hnyirungna malie pi pakhaa thi tie.
Mingthliy hneta saciy a vaapa ca, palungtluona hne tana sa a hrie aa.
Caana cangta a vaa riypa saciy kha phyale te a pyapa ca, suopie kha vya phyale'a te palungtluona hlaa sapuo pata ing luo kha aa vya diy aa.
Abyipata ing kha a sa li kieca, a satuv tie rehriena ca khaapahmuo thlahne vyi. Abyipata khypuv kha a ve li kieca, a vetuv tie huona ca khaapahmuo thlahne vyi.

Khysatungbangna cuota, palungriethyina hne khuosa ta re hrie pata, mawdiy ta thu patangsapa hne, zuo a zie haasapa zaw hing, khaapahmuo thlahne vyi; tahematapakieca Abyipa ta a duepa zaw ca amaa hmung chung tana, amaa hupa kha a pi thluo yi.
Saata zaw hing Abyipa'a taata ma hmungpa ru tana ama cuo, thluechiy malie a pipa tana ama cuo.
Kung panu ningta hnyipa saata zaw ca, rieka kuv chunglie cuoti hne tana amaa lu.
A lavaabya lie cuoti zungkha ta a hnyipa ca, thluechiypa tana a cuo. A carie tie hne biechina lie bie ama ri tiyta, nangzaana a taw'a vyi.
Abyipakha ciyzaa te, a luopuv a ziypa ca, a palungtluopa tana a cuo.
Na kuv ta na hrie muo kha ning khang'a cate, kha-aw taw'a cate na palung a tluo aa.
Na napuv ca na ing chunglie kha, a pathyisapa mingsuv kung haata a cuo aa; na saata zaw ca na cabya kha cadung'a yi te, olif tyi panuta haata ama cuo aa.
Abyipaa ciyzaapa ca cahaaca tana thluechiy a hmung aa.
Abyipata Zion taata thluechiy ca pi yi sala, nama hring chung bangkhuo ta, Jerusalem thluechiy kha hmung tie ung.
Nama samingta zaw a hmungpa cuo tie ung, Israel cunglie thlaalungna aw mang sue!
“I cawta baataata inaa du pari yi,” Israel ata hingta ri se,
“I cawta baataata inaa du pari yi, cuorasala na te va yi.
The ama kapa lekaw haata, i ke lie kha aa cariy pata i hmaa ina pa-aw yi,” ta se.
Abyipaca aa dang; cawsaa pha lipa tie khuhriy ca a chipachung diy.
Zion a huepa tie ca ama nangzaa pata hnangluo kaa yi se.
Iema ca thlungkhuv lieta a pupa aphuv, a le lunghruo a tlung hluota a caapa haa khata cuo yi se.
Capa aphuv ca cataw khang zaw ta li pata, a paw khang zaw ta vyi.
A kielie a cakuopa ahungtahmuo, “Abyipathluechiy ca na cunglie aw mang sue! ta'a va yi. Abyipaming tana thluechiy maca pi,” ta'a va yi.
Vya Abyipa, aa thuvsana chung taa tana ica u.
Abyipa, i ueryi hing na thyipa thi tie! Icaa nuenapa ueryi hing naa na pacungpa thi tie.
Vya Abyipa, nama ta suena cazing hing chi biephung la, ahungma a daakhyi khu aa?
Cuorasala nama ca ciyzaapa na cuo riypata, angiethena kha na hnyi.
Abyipana a ngietie li pata i huo, i nguopuona ca a bie chunglie tana a cuo.
Rievetuv ta mawluo khy dyi riypa aa ngietie lipa haa tana, i hringna ta Abyipakha a ngietie li pata a huo.
Vya Israel, Abyipaca a nguopuo tie! Tahematapakieca Abyipa'a lie ca aa hmangpa duena aw te, ama'a lie ca malie a khuo khupa a lepa cahrana na a aw.
Israel ming kha ama suenapa bangkhuo taata a khuo'a yi.
Vya Abyipa, i pathiypalung hing a suo vyi, i ming zaw aa suotuvna luo mang vyi. I cuota a le tuvpa hne kharuehaa pata pathuosa riypa hmang kha hrie riypa hne hnyi riypata a ting va ang.
A nung ta ahnung a phiepa haatiyta haa khata, i pathiypalung kha i padie sa; i pathiypalung ca ahnung phiepa haatiyta pathiypalung haa kha tana a cuo.
Vya Israel, ata taa hingta chuozaa ta, naa nguopuona ca Abyipa'a lie kha cuo mang sue.
Vya AbyipaDavid kha a thyi la, ruvnaana a angpa bangkhuo zaw kha a thyi thi tie;
Cungnungce Jacob Khazing, Abyipa'a luo kha, tuokhaatama chie a sa te bie aa kuo tapa kha a thyi thi tie.
“I ing chungluo a ngie li pa angta, i iehmang lie a zie'a va ang;
i ming vy li'apa angta, aa hmung zaw a hmung'a va ang;
Cungnungce Jacob Khazing, Abyipaawna riypa hmang i hmung hluo li ta,” a tapa kha!
Biekuona thingkaw ca Efrathah liena a aw tapa kha thyi pate, Jaar lu chunglie kha ma hmung.
“A awna hmang luo ca vaa ung sala, a phyi thabaw lieta vaa bie ung siy,” ma ta.
Vya Abyipa, thu la na cahrana a paluo satuv biekuona thingkaw hne khata, naa pahyna hmang luo ca vaa tie.
Na tluobyi tie ca adangna kha a buv yi sala, zang tluo aa tlapa na cawsaa zaw ca palungtluona hne khi yi se.
Na changtaapa David thue khata, na sathu pathuvpa kha thaw thi khah.
Abyipata David kyihuo ta caa maase hrahring'a va ang ta pata chie a sa te biekuona hmisi a pipa ca: “Na sacapaa zaw chungtaata pakha ca siepahruo ta i tue aa.
Na sacapaa zaw ta i biekuona hne i biechina hing ama ziy kieca, iema kha pacuv'a yi angte, ama sacapaa zaw te, chuozaa ta siepahruo ama cuo aa.”
Tahematapakieca Abyipata Zion ca, a aw parina riypata a tlaw tli te:
“Hingpa hmang hing chuozaa i pahyna hmang ta a cuo aa; hingpa lie hing chuozaa ta i aw aa, tahematapakieca i tlechuo nakawta a cuo.
A ning a dang riypa kawlie thluechiy a hluvsa pi'a angte, a cawsaa siypasa tie kha riy bisana te sa i pi'a yi.
Ama tluobyi tie ca khuona kha pabuv'a yi angte, zang tluo aa tlapa a cawsaa zaw ca palungtluona hne ama khi aa.
Capa lie ca David samingsahlaa pakha kha a cahrapa siepahruo ta tue'a angte, sathu i pathuvpa paa uvna ca i pacu sa aa.
A carie tie kha ngiechina i pabuv'a yi, cuorasala a byilakhuv ca a luv cunglie a kitliyliy aa.”
Uvnu zaw palung a lusa pata khysa pakhawpa hing, kha tluv ta pha te ma palungtluo aa chiy!
Aaron luv cung taata a cakha-ya hming, a cakha-ya hming taata a buohryi pasiypa ruepakaw luo zaa lang pathlapa a sungnaapa olif chiytiy haa tana aa cuo.
Hermon aduotiy, Zion tluocung lie a tlapa haa tana a cuo. Capa lie cana Abyipata a thluechiy kha bie malie a kuo, chuozaa hringna ca.
Abyipachangtaapa bangkhuo zaw, zuo ta Abyipaing lie re a hriepa bangkhuo zaw, a vaw ung la Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung.
Hmang pathepa luo kha nama kuv pazu ung la, Abyipakha pathuosa tie ung.
Alyi hne avuo a satuv Abyipata Zion taata thluechiy ca pi mang yi sue.
Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung! Abyipaming ca pathuosa tie ung; Vya Abyipachangtaapa zaw, pathuosa tie ung,
Abyipaing chunglie a daapa zaw, Khazing ing tlawhmie lie a daapa zaw.
Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung, tahematapakieca Abyipaca a pha; vi malie a hnyituv a cuo nakawta a ming ca hlaa ta pathuosa tie ung.
Tahematapakieca Abyipata Jakob ca ama huota aa tlaw tli, Israel ca ama huopa ta aa tlaw tli.
Abyipaca a lesyipa a cuopa kha i pachang; kiema Abyipaca khazing bangkhuo laata a le vie.
Abyipaca vuoruo lie hne alyi lie, riyliy lie hne aa thuvna chunglie zaw kha a khingpa a tue thluo.
Alyi dena taata amyi a pathu sapa ca ama tana a cuo; khy saa riypata thinghlaa cakang sa te, a chechiy china ing chungtaata thliy kha a papya.
Izipt ming sa-uvthyi hne sahring sahrangta a thiepa ca ama tana a cuo.
Vya Izipt, ama ta niema hraw luo kha kharuehaa hmang za pathlie te, Faro hne a changtaapa bangkhuo kha aa du yi.
Ama ta mingphang hluvpuv kha para yi te, siepahruo cahra daduo kha a thie yi.
Amor ming siepahruo Sihon, Bashan siepahruo Og hne Kanaan pena ruo bangkhuo zaw kha.
Cakhutaata ama ruo ca iema kha ru ta a pi yi, a cawsaa Israel ming kha ru ta a pi yi.
Vya Abyipa, na ming ca chuozaa ta a hmang mang sue, Vya Abyipa, na mingpathuona ca chuo bangkhuo ta a hmang mang sue.
Tahematapakieca Abyipata a cawsaa tie kha a daakhyi'a yi te, a changtaapa tie cunglie kha kawpacuona a hnyi'a yi.
Mingphang zaw amaa biepa kuvtuezuv ca ngu hne siy ta cuo te, cawsaa kuv ta tuepa tana a cuo.
Pakaa ca ama hnyi, cuorasala bie ri the va yi; ming ca ama hnyi, cuorasala hmung khu va yi;
naa ca ama hnyi, cuorasala thyi the va yi, ama pakaa lie huv sung riypa hnyi va yi.
Kuvtuezuv a tuepa tie hne a ringchuopa tie ca kuvtuezuv khana ama lu aa.
Vya Israel ming zaw, Abyipaca thluechiy pi tie ung! Vya Aaron chungkhue zaw, Abyipaca thluechiy pi tie ung.
Vya Levi chungkhue zaw, Abyipaca thluechiy pi tie ung! Niema Abyipaa ciypa zaw, Abyipaca thluechiy pi tie ung.
Jerusalem lie a awpa Abyipaca Zion lie kha thluechiy pi pata cuo mang sue. Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung!
Abyipa'a luo kha palungtluona bie hluo tie ung, tahematapakieca ama ca a pha, a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Palungtluona bie hluo tie ung, khazing zaw bangkhuo Khazing ca, tahematapakieca a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Abyi zaw bangkhuo Abyipaca palungtluona bie hluo tie ung, tahematapakieca a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Ama dyina a lepa kharuehaa hmang ca a tue, a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
A singna ta avuo khiy a sa, a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Aa thuvsapa tiy cunglie alyi kha a phaa, a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Khena lepuv kha a sa, a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Ning ca ningchung a uv riypata a sa, a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Thlaapa hne aasiy ca zuo a uv riypata a sa, a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Izipt ming sacapaa uvthyi bangkhuo kha a thie diy yi, a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Israel ming kha Izipt ruo chungtaata a pyakhyi yi, a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
A cahrapa kuv hne a buo ta a pyakhyi yi, a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Riyliy Sepa kha che hning ta a che, a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Israel kha capa chunglie ca a pate sa, aa hmangpa a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Cuorasala Faro hne a rieka tie kha Riyliy Sepa chunglie ca a thawpatyi yi, a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
A cawsaa zaw kha ruocaapa chunglieta aa chiy yi, a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Siepahruo le daduo kha a thie yi, a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Siepahruo mingpathuo daduo kha a thie yi, a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Amor ming siepahruo Sihon kha a thie, a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Bashan siepahruo Og kha a thie, a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Ama ruo ca a cawsaa zaw kha ru ta a pi yi, a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
A changtaapa Israel kha ru ta a pi, a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Aa nepa maa daahmang lie ma awpa kha malie a thyituv tana a cuo, a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Ma carie tie kuv chungtaata malie a khuo, a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
A hringpa sapa bangkhuo kha sa a pi yi, a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Vuoruo Khazing khiy palungtluona bie hluo tie ung, tahematapakieca a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Zion maa thyi kyry khata, Babilon cavaa zaw kielie kha a tu pate, ma caa taw.
Ma tingtuo zaw ca paasung kung ce lie kha ma buo.
Capa lie ca malie a patuvpa tie hne malie a tuechiepa tie khata, maa nuona riypata, “Zion hlaa malie sapa tie ung,” malie ama ta.
Abyipahlaa ca mingphang hrang tie ruo lie hing tuokhaatama ma sa khu aa?
Vya Jerusalem, nama kha ica maw kieca, i cacuoluo kuv hing caa mang sue!
Nama kha ca maw angte, Jerusalem kha i palungtluona aa suo cepa ta ica chi li kieca, i palyi hing i duo lie a kya bepuo mang sue.

Vya AbyipaJerusalem aa liena ning lie kha Edom ming ta khaapama ama tue tapa kha a thyi thi tie, “Para patlaa ung! Para patlaa ung! A hruopatu te carypuo ung la para patlaa ung!” ama tapa kha a thyi thi tie.
Vya sacanung Babilon, Paratuv! Kiema cunglie na tuepa haata, nama cunglie phuv caa latuv ca thluechiypa tana a cuo aa!
Na saata panuta kha patuv te, alung lie a vaanapa ca thluechiypa tana a cuo aa!
Vya Abyipa, i pathiypalung yalya tana icaa law; khazing zaw hmiekunglie na nama pathuosana hlaa i sa.

Na biena-ing pathepa luo kha a hyi pata a bung angte, aa hmangpa na duena hne zang tluo naa tlana kawlieta, na ming kha ica pathuosa; tahematapakieca na ming hne na bie ca, hmangting zaw cung luo kha na cyicalang tli.
Ica u ning kha na palie cate, i hringna kha thaa na patlung.
Vya Abyipaalyi siepahruo bangkhuo ta na ming aca pathuosa'a yi, tahematapakieca na pakaa taata a pyapa bie kha ama thyi mangtli.
Abyipata a tuepa hmang kaw kha hlaa ta ama sa aa, tahematapakieca Abyipaca a rungnaa hringhruo.
Abyipaca aa suosa raalaa pata, nutaapa zaw kaw kha a pacuo; cuorasala a hruotlepa tie kha luohlaapuv taata a pachang yi.
Ruvnaana chunglie i cakuo raalaa pata, i carie tie hihaana chunglie kha ina mangchiy ciy; na kuv vya pazuo cate, na cacuoluo kuv ta ina khuo ciy.
Abyipata i cuo ta a tingna kha a patling sa aa; Vya Abyipa, na duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang. Na kuv ta na hrie pa re ca thuse thi khah.
Vya Abyipa, na mangpaky diy cate ina pachang diy karue ciy.
I tu tiyta hne i daa tiyta zaw na pachang cate, i ruepa bangkhuo zaw kha luohlaapuv taata ina pachangpasie ciy.
I luopuv hne i laana lie zaw na mangpaky diy cate, i tuepa bangkhuo kha na pachang diy.
Vya Abyipa, i pakaa taata bie a pya hluota, i ri riypa bangkhuo kha na pachang pacie diy.
I hnang i hmie ta na cadung diy cate, i cunglie na kuv na khang.
Cahaapa pachangna ca i cuota kharuehaa a chiytuv te, aa suotuv nakawta pha khu va ang.
Na thlaapa'a taa hingta khaapa luo ma i ruo aa? Na hmiekung taa hingta khaapa luo ma i ruo aa?
Vuoruo luo kie ang sala, capa lie ca nama na za aw aa; Shoel lie zaa zie ang sala, capa lie ca nama na za aw ngiethie aa.
Mawdiy mathlaa kha a bang pata, aa hla cena riyliy dena luo va aw ang sala,
capa lie zaw ca na kuv ta luo naa chiy ngiethie'a cate, na cacuoluo kuv ta a cusa pata ina patuv ngiethie'a ciy.
“Zingna ta na buvkhung sala, i cahriylie khena hing zuo ta a li la,” i ta zaw ta,
zingna ca na cuota zingna cuo li pata; zuo zaw ningchung haa tana a khe thluo, tahematapakieca zingna ca na cuota khena haa tana a cuo.
I chungriy bangkhuo hing nama tuepa cuo diy te, i nung riy chunglie naa pavyi satuv zaw nama tana na cuo.
Ciy aa chiypa hne kharuehaapa ta ina tue nakaw ca ta, na ming ica pathuosa. Na hmang tuepa ca kharuehaa aa chiysa tapa kha, i pachang pasie.
I nung riy chunglie pahlyipa cuo angte, a paruvta tah i lethaw nguoluo ning kha, i pangpa tungtluo kha ina hmung pacie diy ciy.
Tluotling pata sapa a cuo li liepa i cuona kha na hmung pacie diy. I cuota thli paciepa ningkhue bangkhuo kha, ning kha hmuo a vya chiy a vya cuo hluota, na caa-uv lie khung ciepa a cuo diy tli.
Vya Khazing, na ruenapa ca i cuota kha tluv muosungpa tama a cuo! Kha tluv tama a hluv!
Ri i zue pachiy tiyta viehnang laata ama hluv vie; i kya cha tiyta nama'a lie ngiethie na i aw.
Vya Khazing, cawsaa pha lipa tie kha thie yi la tapa na i khing, cakiedyina thiyse tiy a hriepa tie hing inaa kuose'a yi.
Atingna pha lipa hneta na kaw kha ri yi te, pha lina hneta nama a du riypata amaa pipase.
Vya Abyipa, nama caa huepa tie kha i hue ra yi cuo va ma? Nama caa dupa tie kha i duvsa ra yi cuo va ma?
Hue hringhruo yi angte, i cariepa tana i ri yi.
Vya Khazing, na mangpaky la i pathiypalung hing pachang tie; na dyapasya la, i ruenapa hing pachang tie.
I chunglie pha lina a aw kieca hmung la, chuozaa hringna luopuv luo naa chiy tie.
Vya Abyipa, cawsaa pha lipa tie kuv chung taa khata na palaw sa tie; tuechie a hmuopa tie kuv taa khata na khuo tie;
a pha lipa khue dyi khuo yi te, rie pathu riypa dyi amaa ting pari.
Ama palyi ca pariy palyi haata cahre te, ama hmya lie hing pariy ca-ie na a aw.
Vya Abyipa, cawsaa pha lipa tie kuv taa khata naa daakhuo la; kama tlabung riypa dyi khue a khuopa, tuechie a hmuopa tie kuv taa khata na khuo tie.
A hruotlepa tie ta cyihyi na thla khuo yi te, khuhriy ta hre yi te asue kha ina pake khuo yi, luopuv lie kha cyihyi tathlyalya ina thla khuo yi.
Abyipakha, “Nama ca i Khazing tana na cuo, vya Abyipa, paa ica kienapa ueryi hing na naathlie thi tie,” i ta.
Vya Abyipa, i Byipaapa, a cahrapa naa khuotuv, rie a tuvna ning lieta i luv kha na kuv ina pakhuo ciy.
Vya Abyipa, cawsaa pha lipa tie khingna kha pi khah yi, cawsaa ama rawpa kha ama hlue patling sa thi khah yi.
Ama luv a kya pada patlawpa naa cadungpa tie ca, ama pakaa ta ama hangna khata buvkhung diy yi se.
Myihyi sekhalapa khata tlasue yi se! aa thuvsapa khue luo kha tla yi sala, thu khu khah tie yi se!
Cawsaa kawchie a ri thepa tie kha ruo chunglie khy pasa sa khah yi; tuechie a hmuopa tie ca pha lina kha ta a cade yi se!
Abyipata riethyivuosuopa tie kaw ca pacuo pari te, siypasa tie kuo taata aa hmuo pata bie a chi tapa kha i pachang.
Aa dangpa tie ca na ming kha acaa law hmisi'a yi te, na hmiekunglieta ama aw aa.
Vya Abyipa, nama na ica u, a catlisa pata a vaw thi ti; ica unapa ueryi hing naa na thlie tie.
I thlaachuona ca rangpa-ue haata na ripa sala, i kuv pazupa hing zuoluo hriykhungrina haata cuose, na hmiekung luo kya chiy thi mang sue.
Vya Abyipa, i pakaa cuota rievetuv chi la, i hmya cuo hingta a huotuv chi thi tie.
Pha lina a tuepa tie hne a khe pata, hmang pha lipa i tue li riypata, i pathiypalung hing hmang pha lipa luo pamaa sa thi khah; iema huopa a pahuopa ning riypa kha, na paning sa thi khah.

Aa dangpa tie ta na chuo yi sala, zang tluo aa tlapa tie ta na pasiy na pa-ya yi se. Cawsaa pha lipa tie sathu ca i luv lie pathuv pata cuo thi khah se, tahematapakieca i thlaachuona ca a pha lipa hmang ama tuepa khana ci li ta aa du.
Iema ca sue a phaw riypa tie'a luo chiykhyipa ama cuo thue tana, i bie khing aa chiypa kha ama pachang aa.
Dechipatlaa yi te alyi lie ama chipa alung haata, ama ruv zaw ca Shoel thluokhue pakaa lie kha zepatlaa pata a cuo aa.
Cuorasala Vya Abyipai Khazing, kama ca nama na ica mang; nama'a lie vya canaw angte, naa pakhuopa aw li pata na thuse thi khah.
Ina thlakhuopa yi cyihyi taa khata na palaw sa la, hmang pha lipa a tuepa tie cyihyi taa khata na palaw sa tie.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ca iema cyihyi lie mamaa kha a uo yi sala, kama dyi kha law ang se.
Abyipa'a luo kha i ue pachiy angte i khi; i ue pachiy angte Abyipakha paa i kie.
I palung tling lina kha a hmiekunglie i ri, i ruvnaana kha a hmiekung luo i chiykhyi.
I palung a ra ningta, I sinapa luo a pachangpa ca nama tana na cuo. I cakuona luo lie kha cyihyi ina thla khuo yi.
I cacuoluo kuo hmiehmie i pase tiyta, siysaa naa ripa aw va yi; i canawna riypa pakha hmuo aw va yi, naa mangchiy riypa pakha hmuo aw va yi.
Vya Abyipanama'a luona i kya khi; “Nama ca a hringpa tie awna lieta, kama huopa i canawna tana na cuo.”
I khina hing naa na thliepa thi tie, tahematapakieca anguopuona he ta hnyi khu va tli ang. Hrisaatuv tie kuv taa khata na khuo thi tie tahematapakieca iema ca i cuota ama cahra tuv hringhruo.
Na ming kha icaa law khu riypata, thaw-ing taa hingta na papya tie. Kama kha kawpacuona ina hnyi nakaw ca ta, aa dangpa tie ta ina cadung'a yi.
Vya Abyipa, i thlaachuona hing na thyi thi la zang tluo aa tlapa hne aa dangpa na cuona haata, paa ica kienapa hing naa na thliepa thi tie.
Na changtaapa hing tazaa naa cyi thi khah, tahematapakieca ahung hing hmuo na hmiekunglie aa dangpa aw va yi.
I carie ta na cade te ina pha, alyi lie na chaapuo karue te, zingna chunglie na patu te hluo ningta zaa thiypa tie haa kha tana i cuo.
Caacuonakawta i palung a vie ta vie te, tuena caw khaapahmuo pachang li pata i aw.
A khung cie tlipa ning hne thlaa zaw kha i kya thyi pakhaa, na tuepa bangkhuo kha a kya thyi angte, na kuv ta na hriepa re kha i kya pacuo syalya.
Nama'a luo kha i kuv i kya pazu; alyi caapa ta tiy a khingpa haa kha tana i hringna ta nama kha tiyhrie ta aca hrie.
Vya Abyipa, ata hingta na palie thi tie, i palung na a ra hringhruo. Na hmie kha na nukhuo thi khah, caacuolikieca dena a hnyi lipa khue chung luo a tlapa haa tana i cuo aa.
Aa hmangpa na duena ueryi kha maw ta thyi ang se, tahematapakieca i ringchuona ca nama chungliena i chi. I cakuona riypa luo kha na pacuv tie, tahematapakieca nama na icaa mangkhuo.
Vya Abyipa, i carie tie'a taa khata na khuo tie, tahematapakieca nama'a lie canaw riypa tana i vya ruo.
Na khingna tue riypata na pacuv tie, tahematapakieca nama ca i Khazing tana na cuo. A phapa na thlaapa ta aa dangpa luo lie kha naa chiy thi mang sue.
Vya Abyipa, na ming thueta i hringna kha na mangchiy thi la, naa dangna thueta ruvnaana taa khata na papya thi tie.
Aa hmangpa na duena thueta i carie tie kha thie diy tie yi, tahematapakieca kama ca na changtaapa tana i cuo.
Abyipai lungpuvnung ca thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue, rietuvzya hne rieduzya ca ama na naa chang.
I lungpuvnung hne i riekhuopiehu, i cariekyikuo hne naa khuotuv, i canawna hne kama phya, cawsaa zaw kha i kuv raw luo a vya chituv tana a cuo.
Vya Abyipa, cawsaa hing khaapata cuo te ma a kaw na pacuo? a thiy thepa cawsaapa ku hing khaapanakawma a kaw na pacuo?
Cawsaa ca huv haa tana a cuo; ama hring chung ningkhue ca aa hnyile paluopa ningdiy haa tana a cuo.
Vya Abyipa, avuo khiy za pachung la za cung tie, tluo kha hrie la myikhuv khuv yi se.
Thinghlaa kha cakang sa la iema kha chepatlaa tie yi; na cuoti kha za pathlie la a ruo diy yi se.
Aa suona taa khata na buo ta na za paza la, aa thuvpa tiy chungtaata hne ruohrang ming kuv chungtaata, na za thue la na khuo tie;
iema ca ama pakaa ta hangbie ri yi te, chie amaa sa ciepa kawlie hmuo a hang pakhaa ngiethiepa tana ama cuo.
Vya Khazing, nama ca hlaa thaapa tana ica pathuosa aa, riy hraapa tingtuo tung'a angte na ica pathuosa aa;
siepahruo tie tena a pituv hne, a changtaapa David a khuotuv tana na cuo.
Zueziy haa taa khata na za khuo la, ruohrang ming kuv chung taa khata na khuo tie; iema ca ama pakaa ta hangbie ri yi te, chie amaa sa ciepa kawlie hmuo a hang pakhaa ngiethiepa tana ama cuo.
Ma sacapaa zaw ca ama panuta ning hingta, a le phasapa thingkungpa haata cuo yi sala, ma sacanung zaw ca siepahruo ing sana riypata te yi te ama pangipa ingkiy tung haata cuo yi se.
Ma sa chinapa avuo ca sa phangphang ta bi se, ma lu lie a awpa tuv zaw ca a thaw thaw ta pung sala,
ma cue zaw ta a taata a hluvsa pachuo yi se. Carie ta malie vya la li pata, patuv pata a dalepa zaw aw khah pase, ma khychung luopuv lie palung pasasa pata caana ueryi aw khah se.
Cahaapa thluechiy a za tlungnapa mingphang ca, thluechiypa tana ama cuo. Abyipakha ama Khazing ta a hnyipa mingphang ca, thluechiypa tana ama cuo.
Vya i Khazing hne Siepahruo, nama ca ica pathuosa aa; na ming ca chuozaa ta ica pathuosa aa.
Ningting ta icaa law aa, na ming ca chuozaa ta ica pathuosa aa.
Abyipaca a Lesyipa cuo te, khuopuv ta pathuosa riypata a cuo; a lesyina ca pachang khu'a pata cuo vyi.
Na hmang tuepa kha chuo kha hnang chuo kha ta aca pathuosa'a yi; a rungnaapa na hmang tuepa ca ama pathyi sa aa.
Na rungnaa lesyina, na linghlaa-awna hne, kharuehaa aa chiypa na hmang tuepa kha i pacuo syalya pari aa.
Kharuehaa aa chiypa na hmang tuepa a cahrazya kha pathyi sapa cuo'a te, na lesyina kha i u khyi aa.
Iema ta a chuo the lipa na phana a pathuona kaw kha ri'a yi te, naa dangna kha hlaa ta khuosa ta ama pathuosa aa.
Abyipaca vi malie a hnyituv hne nang malie a duetuv ta cuo te, a hi haa paluo li pata aa hmangpa duena a hnyi paripa tana a cuo.
Abyipaca cawsaa bangkhuo cuota pha te, a sapa bangkhuo cunglieta kawpacuona a hnyi.
Vya Abyipa, na hmang tuepa bangkhuo ta nama kha ca pathuosa'a yi te, na huopa zang tluo aa tlapa bangkhuo ta thluechiy aca pi'a yi.
Na pena a rungnaana kaw kha ri'a yi te, na cahrana kaw kha ama ri aa;
cawsaa zaw'a luo kha a cahrapa na hmang tuena kha pathyi sa'a yi te, na pena rungnaana kaw kha ama pathyi sa aa.
Na pena ca chuozaa pena cuo te, na uvna ca chuo bangkhuo ta aa hmang. Abyipaca a bie bangkhuo cunglie kha zang tluo a tla te, hmang bangkhuo kha vihnyina ta a tue.
Abyipata aa liepa bangkhuo kha pathu yi te, a panepa bangkhuo kha a calang yi.
Nama caa mangkhuopa bangkhuo kha, ama'a na a cuo ta sa na pi yi.
Nama ca pahya cate, a hringpa mekaa ta ama khingna kha na patling.
Abyipaca a luopuv bangkhuo lieta a dang te, a tuepa bangkhuo lieta duena a hnyi.
Abyipaca biehmisi ta ama a upa bangkhuo kha aa ngie yi.
Ama a ciypa zaw khingna kha patling sa te, ama khina ueryi zaw kha thyi te a khuo yi.
Abyipaca ama a duepa zaw bangkhuo kha mangchiy yi te, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa tie ca a para yi.
I pakaa ta Abyipapathuosana kha ri'a te, cawsaa bangkhuo ta a ming pathepa kha chuozaa ta ama pathuosa aa.
Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung! Vya i hringna Abyipaca pathuosa tie!
I hring chung bangkhuo ta Abyipaca i pathuosa aa; I hring chung bangkhuo i Khazing ca hlaa ta i pathuosa aa.
Siepahruo tie kha a ringchuo khah ung, caa khuo khu lipa cawsaapa kha a ringchuo khah ung.
Ama huv a ci tiyta, alyi luo kha kaa yi te, capa ning lie caci ca ta amaa tingna kha a ra.
Jacob Khazing kha ama byatuv ta a hnyipa tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo, ama Khazing, Abyipacunglie anguopuona a hnyipa tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo.
Alyi hne avuo a satuv, riyliy hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo a satuv cunglie, anguopuona a hnyipa ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo. Zangna kha chuozaa ta aa patuv;
tuechiepa tie cuota aa dangpa ta bie chi te, a nangdiypa tie kha sa a pi yi. Abyipata thaw a tlapa tie kha papya yi te,
mingcuepa tie kha ama ming a pahmung sa yi. Abyipata aa panepa tie kha calang yi te, aa dangpa tie kha a due yi.
Abyipata mingpe tie kha mangchiy yi te, haaraa hne nunghlyi kha a calang yi; cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa tie luopuv kha a para.
Abyipaca chuozaa tana siepahruo a cuo aa. Vya Zion, na Khazing ca chuo chung bangkhuo cuo tana a cuo. Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung!
Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung! Hlaa ta ima Khazing pathuosapa ca kha tluv tama a pha; vi malie a hnyituv ta cuo te, hlaa ta pathuosa aa tlapa tana a cuo.
Abyipata Jerusalem ca sa te, thaw pata a cuopa a cawsaa zaw kha a pakiy pakhaa yi.
A palung kyipa tie kha patluosa yi te, ama hmaa kha a catawpa yi.
Aasiy khazaa aw se tapa kha Abyipata thli te, a bangkhuo khata ming a sa diy yi.
Abyipaca lesyi te cahrana hne a tling; a pachangna ca taa khu riypata cuo vyi.
Abyipa ta esehrisaapa tie kha calang yi te, cawsaa pha lipa tie kha alyi luo a thaw yi.
Abyipa'a luo kha pathuosana hlaa sa tie ung; ma Khazing ca tingtuo tung ung la pathuosa tie ung.
Avuo kha amyi ta buvkhung te, alyi luo kha khy a pasaa sa.
Saruopa kha sa pi yi te, ra-aa changta zaw kha ama khi tiyta sa a pi yi.
A palungtlingna ca aruo thaazuo lie kha cuo li pata, a palungtluona zaw aa ruo khusapa paa cunglie kha cuo vyi;
cuorasala Abyipaca ama a ciyzaapa cunglie hne, aa hmangpa a duena a ringchuopa cunglie khana a palung a tluo.
Vya Jerusalem, Abyipaca pathuosa tie! Vya Zion, na Khazing ca pathuosa tie!
Tahematapakieca ama ta na thlake kha pacusa te, na chunglie na saata zaw kha thluechiy a pi yi.
Na ruo chunglie kha diena ca pi te, a pha cepa jungsacuo ta na riy aca pabi.
Alyi luo kha a nawbie pathlie te, a catlisa pata a pha.
Tuv hming haata cahue kha patla sa te, buvcuo haata cahue ca aa zecadaa.
Ari kha sa zungpepa haata hipatlaa te, a cakaanazya kha ahunghmuo ang khu va yi.
A bie kha pathlie te ari ca a tiyta a palang sa diy yi; thliy kha pahruo sa te tiy kha a palang sa.
Jacob'a luo kha a bie ca pathyi sa te, a phungluo hne a biechina ca Israel'a luo kha a pathyi sa.
Ming phang hrangpa cuota ca hing haa hingta tue vyi; a biechina kha pachang va yi. Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung!
Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung! Abyipaca vuoruo taa khiyta pathuosa tie ung; aa suona taa khiyta pathuosa tie ung!
Avuoming ta pathuosa ung la, avuoming phuv yalya ta pathuosa tie ung!
Ning hne thlaapa ta ama ca pathuosa tie ung; a khepa aasiy zaw, ama ca pathuosa tie ung!
Aa suo cepa avuo, ama ca pathuosa la, cungluo vuoruo lie a awpa tiy zaw ta ama ca pathuosa tie ung!
Iema ta Abyipaming ca pathuosa yi se, tahematapakieca ama ta naw pi yi te sapa tana ama cuo.
Ama ta iema kha chuozaa ta chuozaa te a pahmang yi; iema ciypuona riy kha pathluo khu aw li riypata a pacu.
Alyi taata Abyipakha pathuosa tie ung, riyliy chunglie ciy aa chiysapa zaw hne aa thuvpa riyliy zaw,
thinghlaa hne ari, cahue hne, thliychie zaw ta a nawpipa kha ama patling sa!
Tluo hne tluothlue zaw, a pathyipa thingkung zaw hne sidar kung zaw,
saruopa zaw hne ing lie a ziypa sahring zaw, aa valepa saruopa zaw hne aa zulepa pavaa zaw!
Alyi siepahruo zaw hne cawsaa bangkhuo, alyi siepahruo zaw hne uvtuv zaw!
satlie hne lesaa, nungpuv macuo hne mingnu zaw!
Iema ta Abyipaca pathuosa yi se, tahematapakieca ama ming kyalya dyi hingna cyicalang pata a cuo; a rungnaana ca alyi hne avuo laata aa suo vie.
A cawsaa zaw kha cahra sa yi te, zang tluo aa tlapa a cawsaa, ama hne aa ngiepa Israel ming bangkhuo ta ama pathuosa. Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung!
Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung! Ama a zangpa tie a hmya yi te ama pathuosana lie kha, Abyipaca hlaa thaapa ta pathuosa tie ung.
Israel ca a satuv cunglie kha a law sala, Zion saata zaw ca ama Siepahruo cunglie kha ama palung tluo se.
Luo pata a ming ca pathuosa yi sala, ama ca karuv-akhang hne tingtuo ta pathuosa tie ung.
Tahematapakieca Abyipaca a cawsaa zaw cunglie kha a law te, aa panepa tie kha tena ta a pangi yi.
Zang tluo aa tlapa tie ca a rungnaana chunglie kha cyicalang pata cuo yi sala, ama iehmang cunglie kha palungtluona hlaa sa yi se.
Khazing pathuosana ca ama pakaa lie ci li pata aw sala, kuo vyicuo ta a cahrepa zueziy ca ama kuv lie a hrie yi se,
mingphang zaw cunglie phuv la khu riypa hne, cawsaa zaw kha duote khu riypata cuose,
ama siepahruo tie kha hrakyi khe pata, ama byi tie kha thaabuoliriy ta cakhiy riypa hne,
iema kha duote biechipana tue khu riypa tana a cuo. Capa ca Abyipacuota zang tluo aa tlapa tie rungnaana tana a cuo. Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung!
Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung! Khazing ca a hmangpathepa chunglie kha pathuosa tie ung; ama ca vuoruo lie khiy pathuosa tie ung!
Hmang lesyipa a tuena kawlieta ama ca pathuosa tie ung; a lesyi hringhruo nakawta pathuosa tie ung!
Hmyakaa ta pathuosa tie ung; tazaw hne vietingtuo ta pathuosa tie ung!
Karuv-akhang hne luona ta pathuosa tie ung; tingtuo hne ramang ta pathuosa tie ung!
Chaaraa ta pathuosa tie ung; a paringsapa chaaraa ta pathuosa tie ung!
A huv a sungpa bangkhuo ta Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung! Abyipaca pathuosa tie ung!
Israel siepahruo, David sacapaa Solomon phungthluvbie ca:
Singna kaw hne pacuvna kaw kha na pachang the riypa hne aa thuvpa bie kha na pachang the riypata cuose,
singvaasa pata hmang na patungpatie thena riypa hne adangna, biedangpa hne aa khing aa nguo pata aw thena riypata cuose,
Ruena cawpa ama singvaa thena riypa hne mingnu tie ta thesingna hne nangvuona ama hnyi riypata cuose,
mingsing tie zaw ta thyi yi sala singna amaa chana riypa hne thleduothena singna a hnyipa tie ta thena amaa chana riypata cuose,
phungthluvbie hne a ri khingna pachang khu riypa hne mingsing tie bie hne bienupa zaw pachangkhuna riypata ripa tana a cuo.
Abyipaciyzaana ca singna hruothuna tana a cuo; a ngaapa ca singna hne pacuvna kha siysaa ri va yi.
I saata, na paa pacuvna kha naathlie la, na nung aca pacuvna zaw kha thaw khah;
tahematapakieca na luv cuota a puvthepa paapaapa lakhuv, na rue cuota a puvthepa pachiy tana a cuo aa.
I saata, a suepa tie ta aca dung kie yi ca zang lie yi ciy.
“Kiema'a luo hing a vaw ra la, cawsaa thie riypata va bya'a ung puv; a sue lipa tie kha thlachie rue li pata a bawkhuo'a ung puv,
Sheol haata ama hring thluopa hingta ama pangpa yalya hingta paluo'a ung puv, khue chung luo a tlapa haata cuo naase yi.
A muo ruvpa hmang bangkhuo kha la'a ung pate, rie kuv taata ma lapa hruosue cata ma ing kha ma pabi aa.
Kiema'a lie ca a vya phuv ra thluo, tuokaa baw na maa hraw'a ung,” ama ta tiyta,
I saata, iema kha ziy lie yi ciy, ama luopuv kha cahriy mya;
tahematapakieca ama phyi ca pha lina luo kha a ruo te, thiyse palang riypata amaa pahraa.
Pavaa a hmung thluo pata thlapa cyihyi ca khaapahmuo thlahne vyi.
Cuorasala iema ca iema mamaa kha a thie riypata huo yi te, iema hringna mamaa kha a thie riypata amaa bawkhuo.
A karuo a awpa tie ama chuona ca cahaacata cuo te, ama hmungpa chechiy mamaapa khata ama hringna kha a la.
Luopuv lieta singna ca a u; zapuv ahmyana hmang lieta a ueryi kha a pathlie.
Zaapuv a tawna hmang taata khuopuv ta a u; khypuv chung luo a ngiena thlake lieta khuopuv ta a khi:

“Vya a ruena cawpa zaw, khatiy te khiy ma nama ruena a caw kalie aa? Malie a tue hyalyapa zaw ta khatiy te khiy ma malie tue hyalya kha tlechuo kalie'a ung cate, a ngaapa ta singna kha nama hue kalie aa?
Ica pasiypa-ya ning yi hing naathlie tie ung; i ruenapa hing ca chang'a yi ang; i bie hing ca pachang sa'a yi ang.
Tahematapakieca ca u yi angte na chaw va ung ciy, i buo kha ca vya pazupa yi angte siysaa ri va ung ciy.
Ruena pha ica pipa bangkhuo yi kha thaw ung cate, ica pasiypa-yana bangkhuo kha suokha hmuo a la va ung ciy.
Kama zaw ruvnaana namaa taw thueta ca pahnyisue ra'a yi angte, pahlupadana namaa taw ningta ica tue hyalya ra'a yi.

Pahlupadana ta khysuv haata aca vya de tiy yi hne, ruvnaana ta thliysung haata aca vya pakhie tiy yi ta cuose, palungriethyina hne riethyivuosuona ta aca tlung tiy yi ta, ca pahnyisue'a yi angte ica tue hyalya ra'a yi.
Cakhutaata iema ta na u'a yi te, cuorasala chaw'a va yi ang; temaasa pata na huv'a yi te na hmung'a va yi.
Tahematapakieca iema ca singna thena kha hue yi te, Abyipaciyzaana kha a tlaw va yi.
Ruena pha i pipa yi kha suokha hmuo a la lipa yi ta, i pasiypa-yana kha siysaa ri va yi.
Caacuonakawta iema ca ama tuena muo kha ning'a yi te, amaa tingna thyipaa khata ama riy a bi aa.
Tahematapakieca a ruena cawpa tie ca ama ngaa riephana hne, iema khingpa dyi tuena khata a thie yi.
Cuorasala kama bie naa a thliepa ca a bangta tah aw'a yi te, rana khaapahmuo a taw li pata hyazangsa pata ama aw aa.
I saata, i bie kha a la cate i nawbie kha na chunglie naa pari kieca,
singna luo kha na naa pacung cate pachang khingna pathiypalung na hnyi kieca,
pachangpasie thena kha u hmisi cate, pachangkhuna kha khuosa ta na u kieca,
capa ca ngu haata huv cate, nupa suethiy haata na huv kieca,
Abyipaciyzaana kha pachang'a cate, Khazing thesingna kha na hmung aa.
Tahematapakieca Abyipata singna hing malie pi te, ama pakaa taa tana thesingna hne pachangkhuna ca aa vaw.
A dangpa zaw cuota singna phapa kha pacungpa yi te, syisaa riy aw li pata a hringpa tie cuota phya tana a cuo.
Biedangpa lie a hringpa tie luopuv kha ve te, cawsaa aa dangpa tie luopuv kha a mangchiy.
Cakhutaata adangna hne biedangpa kha pachang'a cate, a khing a nguona hne luo phapa bangkhuo kha na pachang aa.
Tahematapakieca na pathiypalung chung luo kha singna a vaw'a te, thesingna ca ta na hringna kha a palung a patluo aa;
nangvuona ta ca ve'a te, pachangkhuna ta aca awpuo aa.
Capa ca ta a pha lipa luo taata cuose, bie chiepa a ripa tie'a taata cuose,
aa hmuopa luopuv kha thuse te, zingna luopuv a ziypa tie'a taata cuose,
hmang pha lipa tue kha a palung tluokhyisa te, dungviena kha a tlechuopa tie,
aa dang lipa luo a ziypa tie hne, a zyatepa tie'a taa khata aca khuo aa.
Nama ca a siyhrawpa canung'a taata hne, a bie pahniesa te nungvaathingsuena a tuepa canung'a taata cuose,
a kung panu ningta a hnyipa a viesaa kha thuse te, Khazing'a luo bie aa kuopa a maw nung'a taa khata aca khuo aa.
Tahematapakieca a luopuv ta thiyna luo hne, athiykhy luo kha aa chiy.
Ama'a luo a vaapa tie ca khatiy tahmuo vya kaa buo va tli yi, hringna luopuv zaw hmung pakhaa va tli yi.
Cata a cuo nakawta cawsaa phapa tie luo kha ziy la, hmang dangpa lie a daapa tie luopuv kha a patuv tie.
Tahematapakieca aa dangpa tie ca hingpa ruo lie hing khysa'a yi te, suena a hnyi lipa tie zaw ca hingpa ruo lie hing amaa ngaa aa.
Cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa tie ca ruo chung taa hingta thaw pata cuo'a yi te, cawsaa raw a hmuopa tie ca hingpa ruo taa hingta phiepathla pata ama cuo aa.
I saata, ica pacuvnapa kha maw khah, cuorasala i nawbie kha na pathiypalung chunglie pari tie;
tahematapakieca hringtaa pasiyna hne, lunghruo tlungsa pata hringkhuna kha aca pi aa.
Aa dang pata hringna hne zang tluo atlana kha a pathuse sa khah; hingpa tie hing na rue lie kha a kaze la, na pathiypalung lie kha a cape tie.
Cakiedyina Khazing hne cawsaa hmiekunglie, minghmie pha hne mingphana na hmung aa.
Na pathiypalung yalya ta Abyipakha a ringchuo la, nama singna kha a ring khah.
Na luopuv bangkhuo lie kha ama ca pachang la, na luopuv kha aca padangpa aa.
Nama hne nama kha a singpa ta a hmung khah, Abyipakha ciyzaa la pha lina kha cahriy tie.
Capa ca na saapa cuota hnaatluona caa pipa hne, na pangpa thaa caa patlungpa tana a cuo aa.
Abyipaca na hnyipa hne na luthlu na rehrie taata na hmung taapa thyipaa ta pa-uvsathyi tie.
Caacuokieca na sa-ing ca bituvluv pari'a te, na mingsuvtiy rawna ruocuo ca mingsuvtiy ta a lepala pari aa.
I saata, Abyipaaca pasiypa-yana kha a ngie li pata aw khah, aca chuo tiyta na palung ra khah se.
Tahematapakieca paa ta a duepa a saata zaw kha a pasiy a pa-yapa haa yi ta, Abyipaca a duepa tie khana a pasiy a pa-ya yi.
Singna a hmungpa tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo, pachangkhuna a hmungpa tie zaw thluechiypa tana ama cuo;
tahematapakieca singna ca ngu laata pha vie te, a chiykhyipa amie zaw siy laata a pha vie.
Singna ca lungvaa laata a muo sung vie te, na khingpa hmang khaapa hneta hmuo pakhingpuo the'a pata cuo vyi.
Chuo pasiyna ca a cacuoluo kuv lie aw te, a cavyiluo kuv lieta hnyirungna hne pa-uvsathyina a aw.
A luopuv ca hnaanguona hne, thlaalungna luopuv tana a cuo.
Ama a patuvpa tie cuota hringna thingkung cuo te, ama kha a cusa pata a patuvpa tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo.
Abyipata singna ta alyi kha sa te, pachangkhuna ta avuo kha a padaa;
a thesingna ta tiy aa thuvpa zaw kha pasaa yi te, myiching ta aduo a patla sa.
I saata singna hne nangvuona kha a phasa pata a patuv la caa ruose khah se,
iema ca na thlaapa cuota hringna cuo'a yi te, na ruetung cuota a pangi a pasuona ama cuo aa.
Na luopuv lie kha aa bangta tah cakuo'a cate, na phyi ca a pachiy'a vyi.
Naa tu kie zaw ciy li'apa cata, naa zie tiyta na mingkuv a pahuo aa.
Sungkhabala ta a pahlu a pada a puv kie zaw ciy li'apa cata, cawsaa pha lipa tie a depa khysuv kha ciy'a vaciy;
tahematapakieca Abyipaca na hnaanguona cuo'a te, na phyi aa pa-uo li riypata aca mangchiy aa.
Phana tue khuna naw kha na hnyi tiyta, cu tluo aa tlapa tie cuota pahya li pata aw khah.
Pi riypa na hnyi thluo pata nama'a luo a vawpa na ingpaa kha, “Cakuo caw la a vaw pakhaa tie, mawluo ca pi lavuo ang,” ta khah.
Nama a ringchuosa pata naa thaalie a awpa na ingpaa kha, riethyi pi riypata a ting khah.
Na cunglie riethyi khaapahmuo caa pi lipa kha a kaw khaapahmuo aw li pata vaa hru khah.
Malie tuechie a hmuopa tie kha hietlie khah yi, ama luopuv zaw kha vaa tlaw khah;
a zyatepa tie ca Abyipacuota duv aa chiypa cuo yi te, cuorasala aa dangpa tie ca a cuota zang aa chiypa tie ta ama cuo.
Abyipachiesana ca cawsaa pha lipa tie ing cung luo kha tlung te, cuorasala aa dangpa tie ing kha thlue a chiy.
Cawsaa a esepa tie kha ese ra yi te, aa panepa tie kha hmiephaa a pi yi.
A singpa tie ca pa-uvsathyina kha cu'a yi te, cuorasala a palunglepa tie ca hmiechina khana ama ang aa.
I saata zaw, nama paa pasiypa-yana kha naathlie ung la, pachangkhuna nama hnyi riypata a phasa pata naathlie tie ung;
tahematapakieca phungluo phapa kha ca pi yi angte, ica pacuvpa yi kha maw khah ung.
I paa sacapaa, i nung due cepa hne, tlechuo cepa i za cuo ningta,
i paa ta na pacuv te ina chang, “I bie hing na pathiypalung lie pari la, i nawbie hing ziy la hring tie.
Singna hne pachangkhuna kha a la lah, i pakaa taata a pyapa bie kha maw pata thuse khah.
Singna kha thaw khah, aca mangchiy aa; due la aca awpuo aa.
Singna hruothuna ca hingpa hing tana a cuo: Singna ca a la lah, a la thepa bangkhuo chung taa khata pachangkhuna kha a la tie.
Singna kha pasungpanaa la, aca cyicalang aa; a paw la aca pa-uvsathyi aa.
A puvthesapa paapaapa luvpaze kha na luv lie ca paze'a te, a puvthesapa byilakhuv kha aca pakhuv aa,” a ta.
I saata, i bie hing naathlie la a la tie, na hringkhue a pasiy aa.
Singna luo kha ca pacuv angte, aa dangpa luopuv luo kha icaa chiy.
Na cakuo tiyta khaapatahmuo ca pakhuo li'a pata, naa ruo kie zaw a pachiy'a vaciy.
Pacuvna kha a cusa pata a patuv la pathlie khah; mangchiy tie, na hringna tana a cuo.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie luopuv kha ziy khah, hmang pha lipa a tuepa tie luopuv zaw kha ziy khah.
Cahriy la a ziy hehmuo ziy khah; kaase la sise tie.
Tahematapakieca hmang pha lipa ama tue li kieca a hmung khu va yi; pakha chuo aa pachiy riypata ama tue li kieca a hmung the va yi.
Tahematapakieca pha lina viechuo kha ning yi te, tuechiena mingsuvtiy kha ama dang.
Cuorasala aa dangpa tie luopuv ca mawdiy ning khepa haa khata cuo te, ning-aw ta a khe hryly.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie luopuv ca aa thuvpa zingna haata cuo te, khaapaliema amaa pachiy tapa kha a pachang va yi.
I saata, i bie hing a phata tah naathlie la, i ripa hing a phasa pata naathlie tie.
Na hmungnapa taata ca viese khah se, na palung chunglie kha pari tie.
Tahematapakieca a hmungpa tie cuota hringna cuo te, ama saapa hnaatluona tana a cuo.
A padiypavuosa pata khue rue tie, tahematapakieca capa taa ca tana hringna acaatiy a pya aa.
Zyate pata bie ri khah, cahaapa bie ca nama hne a hla se.
Na ming ca hmieluo kha aa dangsa pata, taapuo pata mang se.
A mangpuo pata cakuo la, na luo kha aa dang aa.
Cacuoluo a cuo zaw cavyiluo a cuo zaw luoke i khah, pha lina bangkhuo kha cahriy tie.
I saata, i singna hne i pachangkhuna hing a phasa pata pacuo la na naathlie tie;
cakiedyina nangvuona hnyi'a cate, na pakaa taata thesingna bie kha a pya aa.
A calaanung palyipakaa ca khyitiy haata thlung te, a bie ca chiytiy laata a tlue vie;
cuorasala a chuona luo ta ca uocuokhaa haata kha te, kuo hning ta a cahre pa zueziy haa tana a cuo.
A phyi ca thiyna luo kha cakuo te, a kuorakuo ca Sheol luo na a caluo.
Hringna luopuv kha aa dangta tah ziy li pata, luo a viepa kha a pachang vyi.
I saata, ata hing ca na naathlie tie, i pakaa taata a pyapa bie zaw hing thaw khah.
A calaanung kha cahriy la, a chiypakaa kha va cadi khah;
caacuolikieca pa-uvsathyipa na cuona kha malie pi'a yi cate, na hringna zaw kha nangdue a the lipa tie na na pi pathlyi'a yi.
Mingphang hrang tie ta na hnyirungna cunglie kha ama lunghruo tlung'a te, na rehriena muo ca ruohrang ming chungkhue luo kha a chiy aa.
Na thiy caw khata a hrung'a cate, na thiy na saa chuo te na ruv dyi aa tuo tiyta,
“Vya a pasa!, khaapanakawma pasiypa-yana kha za hue angte, suebena kha i za khing'a va e!
I saya tie ueryi kha za naathlie va ang, naa pacuvtuv tie bie zaw za naathlie va ang.
Zaapuv ahmyana chunglieta rana ta ina tlung hmisi tli hing haw,” na ta aa.
Nama na sawkaw taata tiy kha dang la, na takhue taata a tlingpa tiy kha dang tie.
Na tiyhnaa ca hmangting ta palang sa li pata, na cavaa tiy zaw luopuv lie lang khah se.
Capa zaw ca nama selaw cuota cuo sala, mingphang hrang tie kha pi ra khah yi.
Na tiyhnaa lie thluechiy aw sala, na kung panu ningta na hnyipa na napuvnung hne khata a nuo tie,
ama ca tlechuo aa chiysapa sakhiy, khing aa chiysapa sasuvlaanung haa tana a cuo. Aa hnung ta cipari na palung ca patling sala, a duena khata na palung ca patluo pari se.
Vya i sacapaa, khaapanakawma canung hrang cunglieta na palung tling te, nungvaathingsuena a tue nung ca naa paw?
Tahematapakieca cawsaapa luopuv ca Abyipaming rawlie aw thluo te, ama luopuv bangkhuo kha a hmung diy.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ca ama zya chiepa khata pa-uo yi te, iema sue rehriena mamaa lie kha tana amaa uo.
Pasiypa-yana a aw li nakawta thiy yi te, ama ngaa tuv nakawta ama vie.
I saata, na ingpaa hneta biekuona tue cate, malie cuota aamahkhanna na tue kieca,
na pakaa taata na ripa bie ta cyihyi lie ca pa-uo te aca patuv tli.
Caacuonakawta, i saata, hingpa hing tue la nama hne nama kha a khuo tie, tahematapakieca na ingpaapa kuv lie tana na aw tli: a catli pata cakuo la na ingpaa kha paa va kie tie.
A hmung li pata aw la, mingsaa pasing li pata aw tie;
saa a ka thepa kuv taata sasuv a lawpa haata hne, pavaa a siethepa kuv taata pavaa a lawpa haata, nama hne nama kha a khuo tie.
Niema a thaathuvpa tie zaw, hninghnaa'a luo kha vaa tie ung; a hringzya kha rue syalya ung la sing tie ung.
Nawpituv, uvthyi hne uvtuv byi zaw a hnyi li raalaa pata
cuovuo ning hne sa hrie cuo ningta, sa kha a pakhaw te aa pacung pacie.
Vya a thaathuvpa tie, khacuo ma namaa zie kalie aa? Khatiythuema nama thu aa?
Kaakhata a hmung caw'a ang, kaakhata pasing caw'a ang, kaakhata i kuv a cakhiy'a angte a pahy caw'a ang, na ta ning khata,
siypasana ca aparuvpa haa khata a vaw'a te, aphahlana ca cehre a cyipa aparuvpa haa khata acaa vawhning aa.
A zya chiepa hne aa hmuo li pata a hringpa ca, hangbie ri riypa khata a khie te,
a ming vy te, a phyi ta pachangsana zaw a tue, a kuvdaw ta a daw,
a zyate nakawta pha lina khue kha khuo pari te, are lina saciy kha a vaa pari.
Cahaapa cawsaa ca vuochina ta tlangkhy tlungsue'a te, sungkhabala ta pare khu aw lina te ta a ra aa.
Abyipata a huepa hmang suocaruv aw te, a duepa hmang suosariy a aw:
Hruotlena hne padyipa ming, a hanghiepa palyi, a sue lipa tie thiyse a palangpa kuv,
pha lina khue a khuopa pathiypalung, hmang pha lipa luo a pahraasa pata a ruopa phyi,
aa hmuo lipa ta tehte a khuopa hne, uvnu zaw hrawlie are lina a chiykhyituv.
I saata, na paa nawpina hing ziy la, na nung pacuvna hing thaw khah.
Na palung lie hrepuo la pari tie, na rue lie kha ciypuo tie.
Na cakuo tiyta luo acaa chiy aa; naa zie tiyta ca awpuo'a te, naa kya cha tiyta bie acaa chang aa.
Tahematapakieca phungbie ca myi-ing ta cuo te, pacuvna ca khena tana a cuo, zyazaa a parena riypata suebena ca hringna luopuv ta a cuo.
Canung pha lipa'a taata caa palawsa riypa hne, ripasa a thesapa nungvaathingsuena a tue nung'a taata caa palaw sa riypata a cuo.
A puvthena kha hietlie pathlyi khah, a mingcakiy ta aca siypa kha a patuv sa khah.
Siyhrawnung ca viechuo tluo kha muo ta a hluo khu a aw, cuorasala nungvaathingsuena a khing nung ta ca capaapa hringna khana a patuv.
Cawsaa ta a cawsie kuo li pata a cacunghnaa lie myihyi aa paw khu'a ma?
Acuolikie a phyipazaa kuo li pata myihyi sekhalapa cunglie a cakuo the'a ma?
Caacuonakawta a ingpaapa napuv hne a ziehnepa ca duotena ang li pata law the'a vyi.
Ama nang a diy nakawta ning riypata a paruvpa ca cawsaa ta nutaa va yi.
Cuorasala ama patuv kieca le sariy ta palie sapa cuo'a yi te, a chechiy bangkhuo kha ama patuvpa diy aa.
Cuorasala nungvaathingsuena a tuepa ca ruena a hnyi lipa ta cuo te, ama hne ama a parapa tana a cuo.
Hmaa phya'a te mingchiena aa taw aa, a thuochina kha vie the'a va tli.
A napuvnung aa hrakuona khata a navaapa pathiy pa-ie sa te, vieriy a thung tiyta ca taw khu the va tli.
Suethiy kha tluv ama lu zaw ta cu khing li pata, khazaa ta ingcung ama va kie zaw a pakaa yi.
I saata, i bie hing a cake la, i phungbie hing a pacung tie.
I phungbie hing a cake pata hring la, ica pacuvna hing na mingpavaata haata a cake tie.
Na kuvdaw lie a ciypuo la, na palung chunglie a cape tie.
Singna kha, “I sieta tana na cuo,” ta la, thesingna ca, “I viesaa pha,” ta tie.
Cahaacata na ta kieca iema ca ta a calaanung'a taa cata ca khuo'a yi te, bie a thesapa nungvaathingsuena a tue nung'a taa cata aca palaw sa'a yi.
I ing thlaluo-aw taata, aleluo i mang ca,
mingnu lungmyata zaw hrawlieta, ruena a hnyi lipa mingnu pakha kha i hmung,
canung pha lipa awna luopuv a kiy luo, cawsaanung ing luo ca tathlyalya ta a cakuo.
Zuoluo ning tla tyalya caw, zuo a zingna cuo a vya pha.
Siyhrawnung caw a tuepa, cawsaanung ta dung khingna pathiypalung hne ama kha aa vya hladaw.
Ama ca a rie phasa te, ing lie a tuo buo vyi;
atabala hing luopuv lie, atabala hing zapuv ahmyana hmang lie aw te, a cakiy taa khata malie kha dya a huo paruvle.
Satliepa ca patuv te a pahnuo, a hmiesusa pata ama kha,
“Hriykhungrina tue riypa tana i cuo, ataning hing i biekuona ca i patling sa'a tli;
caacuonakawta nama a taw riypata i kya pya, a ngietie li pata ca huv angte ica hmung tli!
I iehmang kha pangphaa phasapa phaa angte, Izipt pangphaabuv a puvthesa pata i buv tli;
i iehmang ca mura ziyhmyi, aloes ziyhmyi hne, sinnamon ziyhmyi ta i ka tli.
A vaw la, khydyi te ta maa duena ca patling sa'a puv; duena hneta a nuo'a puv.
Tahematapakieca i navaapa ca ing lie aw vyi, luohlaa luo na khy a tlaw.
Tuokaa chawkue zungkha ta a phya te, thlaapa a punglung hluo li ca vya tlung'a vyi,” a ta.
Sawlena bie ta ama ca kalaa te, a bie pahniepa ta ama ca a patuv.
Cuetungpa ta thiena luo amaa dalepa a paziylepa haa yi ta cuose, sasuv ta, cuoti ta a chungriy a kapahlina te ta sariy a sisuepa haata cuose,
pavaa ta cyihyi luo a catlisa pata aa vya cangpa haata, i hringna naa pahli riypa tana a cuo tapa kha pachang li pata cawsaanung ca a ziy.
Caacuonakawta i saata zaw, na naathlie ung la, i pakaa taata a pyapa bie hing a phata tah naathlie tie ung.
Ama'a luo kha nama palung chiy khah se; a luopuv luo kha luoke va i pathlyi lie ung ciy.
Tahematapakieca cawsaa hluvpuv kha pathla yi te, a dawsaw li a naw yi.
A ing ca Shoel luo sina luopuv cuo te, thiyna ingkhuo chung luo sibungna tana a cuo.
Singna ca u te pachangkhuna ca a ue a suopuv tana a khi cuo va ma?
Luopuv kie aa suonapa lie hne, luo aa tawna lie tana aa daa;
khy hukaa thlake athaalie, a chung luo a ngienapa thlake lie kha khi te:
“Vya cawsaa zaw, niema na ica u yi, cawsaa bangkhuo tana ica u yi.
Vya a ngaapa zaw, nangvuona kha a cuv ung la, pachangkhuna a hnyi lipa zaw, pachangkhuna kha hmung a zue tie ung.
Naathlie tie ung, bie sungnaapa na i ri aa; i hmya taa hingta aa hmuopa bie pya'a te,
i pakaa ta biehmisipa a ri aa; pha lina ca i hmya cuota duvsamakhiepa tana a cuo.
I pakaa taata a pyapa bie bangkhuo ca aa dangpa cuo te, aa cakhiy aa cakhiepa hne zyatena aw vyi.
A pachangthepa cuota ca aa dangpa cuo diy te, thesingna a hnyipa cuota ca aa hmuopa tana a cuo.
Ngu laata kama pacuvna hing a la hriy la, siy laata thesingna hing a tlaw vie tie;
tahematapakieca singna ca lungvaa laata pha vie te, na khingpa bangkhuo hneta pakhingpuo the'a pata cuo vyi.
Kama, singna ca nangvuona hneta awhne angte, thesingna hne ruekhuna kha i hnyi.
Abyipaciyzaana ca pha lina huepa kha tana a cuo. Kama ca hruotlena, palunglena, pha lina luo hne biepha lipa kha i hue.
Ruena pha hne singna pha i hnyi; pachangkhuna hne thaazuo zaw i hnyi.
Kama thueta siepahruo ca byithude lie a tu te, uvtuv tie ta aa dangpa phungluo kha ama sa.
kama thueta uvtuv tie ca uv khu yi te, uvtuv byi a cuopa bangkhuo ta aa dang pata ama uv khu.
Naa duepa kha due yi angte, temaasa pata naa huvpa tie ta ina hmung yi.
Hnyirungna hne pa-uvsathyina ca kama'a lie aw te, dawphaana hne chyachang a kyna zaw kama'a liena aa hmang.
