I thyipaa ca siy laata a pha vie, siy pathepa laata pha vie te, a tlaw pa-ipa ngu pathepa laata a pha vie.
Adangna luo lie kha cakuo angte, biedangpa luo kha tathlyalya i ziy;
naa duepa kha hnyirungna pi yi angte, ama sue-ing ca suethiy ta a bi aa.
Abyipata a re hruothuna lie na sa te, hluo ningta a tuepa zaw hrawlie tue taapa tana i cuo.
Hluo ning taata na pahmang te, alyi hruothu hluota a sa taapa ta i cuo.
Tiy a thuvsapa a aw hluota kama kha na pa-aw sa te, tiy a rungsapa acaa a aw hluota ina sa mangtli.
Tluo aa suopa hne tluothlue zaw a aw hluota kama kha ina pa-aw sa tli.
Alyi hne lu zaw a tue hluo, chuelyi alyi diydiypa a aw hluota ina sa tli.
Avuo a sa ning kha za aw tli angte, riyliy tiy hmie zaw aa tieky pata a cariy ningta i za aw tli;
a cung luo avuo khiy a cusa pata a tue ning, tiy a thuvsapa rawlie tiyhnaa zaw a tue ning,
tiy ta a biepina kha a law li riypata riyliy kha a ruoriy a thlipa ning, alyi hruo a patu ning zaw kha
re a thesapa haa khata a thaalie i za aw; ningting ta ama tlechuopa za cuo angte, a hmiekunglie kha i palung a tluo pari.
A awnapa chuelyi lie hing palungtluona cuo angte, cawsaa phang ta tlechuopa i cuo.
“I saata zaw, na naathlie tie ung: i luopuv a ziypa ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo.
Pacuvna kha naathlie ung la singsa tie ung, siysaa ri li pata aw khah ung.
I bie kha naathlie te, i thlake lie kha ningting aw te, i chiypakaa kielie naa huopa ca thluechiypa tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca kama kha naa hmungpa ca hringna kha hmung te, Abyipa'a taata minghmie pha a hmung;
cuorasala kama naa hmung lipa tie ca iema hne iema kha hmaa a paphya yi te, naa huepa tie ca a thiy khingpa tana ama cuo.”
Singna ta a ing kha sa tli te, a tung suosariy a thla.
A sahring kha a thie, mingsuvtiy kha pya ciepa ta chi te, cabya zaw a patu pacie tli.
A changtaapa canung zaw kha pathlie yi te, khypuv chung aa suo cepa hmang taa khata,
“A ruena a cawpa zaw, hingpa luo hing a vaw ung!” ta pata ama u. Ruena a hnyi lipa tie kha,
“A vaw ung la, i viechuo hing ce ung la, i pya ciepa mingsuvtiy hing dang tie ung.
Ruena a ky lina kha sise ung la hring tie ung, singna luo kha ziy tie ung,” ama ta.
Cawsaa hruotlepa a pasiy a pa-yapa ca pahnyisuena ang te, cawsaa pha lipa a chuopa ca hmaa na a ang taw.
A hruotlepa kha na chuo kieca ca hue'a te, cawsaa singpa kha na chuo kieca aca due aa.
A singpa kha cawpa la, sing vie'a te, aa dangpa kha na pacuv kieca thena kha aa cha aa.
Abyipaciyzaana ca singna hruothuna tana a cuo, A Pathepa Paa pachangna ca aa thuvpa hmang pachangkhuna tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca kama thue hingta na ningcuo ca a le ta pahluv viepa cuo'a cate, na hringna kung zaw chachiy pata na cuo aa.
Na sing kie nama cuota sing cate, a hruo na tle kie nama selaw tana na ang aa.
Canung ngaapa ca khi khusa te, a ruena cawsa te a pachangpa aw vyi.
A ing chiypakaa lie kha aa tu, khypuv chung aa suona hmang a tuna lie kha a tu te,
aa thaalie a vya cakuolepa, iema luopuv lie aa dangta tah a vya cakuolepa tie kha,
“A ruena a cawpa zaw, hingpa luo hing a vaw ung!” a ta yi. Ruena a hnyi lipa tie kha,
“Paruvpa tiy ca thlung te, a paruv ta ningpa viechuo ca a pahuo,” a ta yi.
Cuorasala iema ta khapa lie kha thiyna na a aw ta pata pachang va yi, a khyche zaw ca aa thuvsapa Sheol khue chungliena ama aw tapa zaw kha pachang va yi.
Solomon phungthluvbie: Sacapaa singpa ta a paa palung patluo te, sacapaa ngaapa ca a nung ngiechina tana a cuo.
Pha lina ta hmungpa suethiy ca khaapahmuo thlahne vyi, cuorasala adangna ca thiyna taa tana aca khuo aa.
Abyipata aa dangpa tie kha ama nang padiy va yi, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa tie khingna kha ca a para.
A thaathuvpa kuv ca dawchiena kha chiykhyi te, cuorasala te a maapa kuv ca dawphaana kha a chiykhyi.
Cuovuo ningta sa a pahmyapa ca saata singpa cuo te, sa hrie cuo ning a zie thluopa saata ca nangzaana na a vya chiykhyi.
Thluechiy ca aa dangpa luv cunglie kha aw te, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa pakaa ca tuechiena khana a nu.
Aa dangpa tie a thyi pakhaapa ca thluechiy ta cuo te, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa tie ming ca a thuv a za aa.
A singpa ca nawbie kha a palung chunglie a cake te, cuorasala a khi cakhawpa a ngaapa ca rana na aa taw aa.
Hmangdangpa chunglie a cakuopa ca aa bangta tah cakuo te, zyatena luo a ziypa ca a tuepa kha aa luo aa.
A pachang li hruo a cuopa ca ruvnaana chiykhyi te, riephasa pata cawsaa a chuopa ca diena a chiykhyipa tana a cuo.
Cawsaa a dangpa pakaa ca hringna tiyhnaa ta cuo te, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa pakaa ca tuechiena khana a pa-ung.
Huena ca are lina kha chiykhyi te, cuorasala duena ca suena bangkhuo kha a buvkhung.
Pachangkhuna a hnyipa hmya lie ca singna kha hmung pata cuo te, cuorasala sungpe ca ruena a hnyi lipa ke cuo tana a cuo.
A singpa ca thesingna kha a pacung te, cuorasala a khi cakhawpa a ngaapa ca aa thaa luo na rana a vya chiykhyi.
A dawphaapa tie ama hnyirungna ca amaa bangna riekhuopiehu ta cuo te, siypasa tie ama dawchiena ca ama rana ta a cuo.
Aa dangpa tie thavie muo ca hringna luo kha a chiy yi te, cawsaa pha lipa tie thavie muo ca suena luo khana aa chiy yi.
Pacuvna kha a cakepa ca hringna luopuv a ziypa cuo te, pasiypa-yana kha siysaa a ri lipa ca luoke na a pie tli.
A hanghiepa palyi ca huena kha pa-ung te, malie kawchie a ripa ca a ngaapa tana a cuo.
Bie ripa a hluv vie tiyta, ri chiepa a hluv vie, caacuonakawta a singpa tie ca bie ri amaa cadang.
Aa dangpa tie palyi ca ngu pathepa hne tana aa lu, cawsaa pha lipa palungphya ca muo hnyi vyi.
Aa dangpa tie bie ca cawsaa hluvpuv kha thlahne yi te, cuorasala a ngaapa tie ca ruena ama hnyi li nakawta ama thiy.
Abyipathluechiy ca hnyirungna chiykhyi te, ngiechina vya chiykhyipuo vyi.
Hmang pha lipa tue hing a ngaapa cuota ca cang-iena haata cuo te, cuorasala pachangkhuna a hnyipa cuota ca singvaasa pata hmang tuepa hingna palungtluona ta a cuo.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ca ama ciypa hmang kha ama cunglie tlung'a te, cuorasala aa dangpa zaw ca ama khingna kha pipa ama cuo aa.
Cawsaa pha lipa ca thliysung a vya hruopa khata phya yi te ama vie, cuorasala aa dangpa tie ca chuozaa ta amaa bang.
A thaathuvpa ca re a pituv cuota ca haa cuota a thuepa hne ming cuota myikhuv haa kha tana a cuo.
Abyipaciyzaana ca chuo pasiyna cuo te, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa tie ca ama chuo a pachang aa.
Aa dangpa tie anguopuona ca palungtluona ta cuo te, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa tie a mangkhuona ca a hripa tana a cuo aa.
Abyipaca cawsaa phapa cuota abangna cariekyikuo ta cuo te, cuorasala hmang pha lipa a tuepa tie cuota ca rana tana a cuo.
Aa dangpa ca a daahmang cu'a te, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa ca alyi lie awna hmang hmuo hnyi'a vyi.
Aa dangpa tie pakaa ta singna kha ri te, cuorasala a hanghiepa palyi ca te pata a cuo aa.
Aa dangpa tie hmya ca cuhluo tluo aa tlapa kha chiykhyi te, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa tie pakaa ca malie dungna bie khana a ri.
Aa hmuo lipa cyilung ca Abyipacuota duvsamakhie aa chiypa tana a cuo, cuorasala aa hmuopa cyilung kha a tlechuo.
Ahruo na tle kieca na hmie na a chi aa, cuorasala rawcanawna ca singna hne tana aa khe.
Cawsaa a dangpa tie ca hmangdangpa ta luo aa chiy yi, cuorasala a biekuo a parapa tie ca ama zyatena khata a para yi.
Thiyna ta aca pha ning ca hnyirungna hing khaapahmuo thlahne vyi, cuorasala adangna ca cawsaa kha thiyna taata a khuo.
Syisaa riy a aw lipa tie ca amaa dangna khata ama luo kha padang sa te, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa tie ca ama pha lina kawlie kha amaa lie.
Cawsaa phapa tie ca amaa dangna khata khuo yi te, malie kha a rawpa tie ca iema tingna mamaa ta thaw a pathla yi.
Cawsaa pha lipa ama thiy tiyta, amaa nguopuona kha ra te, Khazing a pachang lipa tie amangkhuona zaw a hripa ta aa li.
Aa dangpa tie ca ruvnaana taata khuopa cuo yi te, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa tie ca khapa chung luo khana ama va tla.
Khazing a pachang lipa tie ca ama pakaa ta ama ingpaa zaw kha para yi te, cuorasala aa dangpa tie ca ama thesingna thueta lawna ama hmung.
Aa dangpa tie ama lethaw ningta khypuv ca a palung tluo te, cawsaa pha lipa tie ama thiy ning ca khypuv ta ama khi ama u.
Cawsaa phapa tie thluechiy ta khypuv kha cyicalang te, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa tie pakaa ta khypuv kha a para.
Malie kha a mangbungpa ca ruena a hnyi lipa ta cuo te, cuorasala pachangkhuna a hnyipa ca a dieta tah na a aw.
Malie kawchie a ripa ca bieparuv kha rile te, cuorasala zang tluo aa tlapa cawsaa ta ca a palung lieta a pari.
Luochiyna a aw li kieca mingphang kha a lie te, ruena phapa a pituv ama hluvna lieta ca abangna a aw.
Na pachang lipa cuota lyibuo thungpa riypata bie naa kuo kieca ruvnaana naa taw aa, cuorasala na bu kieca na cuota a pha vie.
Vihnyina a hnyipa canung ca pa-uvsathyipa cuo te, cuorasala zyazaa pha a huepa canung ca nangzaana na a ang. A riechiepa ca dawchie'a te, a thaahangpa ca a dawphaa aa.
Malie kaw a pacuo thepa ca ama hne ama lawmuo a pipa cuo te, malie kaw a pacuo the lipa ca ama hne ama kha ruvnaana aa pi.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ca athungna hmisi hmung the va yi, cuorasala adangna hne na hring kieca lawmuo na hmung hmisi aa.
Adangna kha a cusa pata a patuvpa ca a hring aa, cuorasala pha lina a tue pazuepa ca a thiy aa.
Zyatena palungphya a hnyipa tie ca Abyipacuota duvsamakhie a chiy yi te, cuorasala syisaa riy aw li pata a hringpa tie kha a tlechuo yi.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ca duotena ang li pata aw'a va yi tapa kha pachang tie, cuorasala aa dangpa tie ca ama law aa.
A puvthesa raalaa pata ruena a hnyi lipa canung ca, va hnacabuv lie bapa siy ra-aw hne tana aa lu.
Cawsaa a dangpa khingna ca phana kha chiykhyi te, cawsaa pha lipa tie amangkhuona a tling tiyta cawsaa bangkhuo ama hi a haa.
Cawsaa chekha ta pahyasa pata pi yi te ama hnyi hryly, chekha ca pasiysa yi te, amaa phahla pari.
A pahyapa ca a hnyirung aa, malie kha tiy a byapa ca ama zaw tiy bya pata a cuo aa.
A sa kha zaa riypata a pahya lipa ca cawsaa ta chie sa yi te, cuorasala pahya te a zaapa luv cunglie ca thluechiy na a aw.
Phana kha temaasa pata a huvpa ca hmiephaa hmung'a te, hmiephaa dyi a huvpa ca pha lina khana aa taw aa.
A hnyirungna kha a ringchuopa ca caa'a te a zung aa, cuorasala aa dangpa tie ca thinghnaa hringpa haata ama hringdiyliy aa.
A ingchungkhue kha ruvnaana a pipa ca a cu riypa aw'a vyi, a ngaapa ca a singpa chungkhue lie changtaapa tana a cuo aa.
Adangna thyipaa ca hringna thingkung cuo te, cuorasala tuechiena ca thiyna na a chiykhyi.
Aa dangpa tie ta phana muo kha ama hmung kieca, cawsaa pha lipa hne a suepa changchiy ca pha lina muo kha kha tluv tama ama hmung vie aa!
Zyazaa pha a khingpa ca thesingna a duepa tana a cuo, cuorasala chuoraapa a huepa ca a ngaapa tana a cuo.
Abyipata cawsaa phapa kha aa law yi, cuorasala pha lina khue a khuopa ca sue a phaw yi.
Pha lina ta abangna a hmungpa aw va yi, cuorasala aa dangpa tie thabaw ca hnyi khu pata cuo vyi.
Napuv pha ca a navaapa cuota byilakhuv cuo te, cuorasala nangzaana a chiykhyipa napuv ca a navaapa cuota ruv hmawna tana a cuo.
Aa dangpa tie khueruena ca biedangpa cuo te, cawsaa pha lipa tie ta ruena chepa ca hanghiena tana a cuo.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie bie ca thiyse palang riypa kha bya te, cuorasala cawsaa phapa tie bie ca cawsaa kha a pacha yi.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ca thawpa cuo yi te aw va tli yi, cuorasala aa dangpa tie ing ca cu te aa hmang.
A singpa ca pathuosapa cuo yi te, cuorasala zyatena palungphya ca duvsamakhie na aa chiy.
Ama riyvaw cuota re a hrie byalyapa cawsaa cakhawpa cuopa ca, cawsaa ciemuopa haata aw pata nangdiypa laata a pha vie.
Aa dangpa tie ca ama sahring cunglie kawpacuona ama hnyi, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa tie ta ama sahring kha ama tuechie.
Lu thlu te a maapa ca a kung vyi'a te, cuorasala a thlahne lipa re lie a vie cakhawpa ca a ngaapa tana a cuo.
Cawsaa pha lipa ca pha lina kha khing hryly te, cuorasala aa dangpa tie thabaw ca thyipaa a hluvsa a hnyi.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ca iema bie mamaapa kha ta cyihyi lie pa-uo yi te, cuorasala aa dangpa tie ca ruvnaana chungtaata ama law.
Cawsaa chekha ta ama ripa bie thueta hluetlingna hmung yi te, chekha ca ama kuv ta rehriena lawmuo kha aa khuopa ta ama hmung ra.
A ngaapa ca i dang ta pata aa rue, cuorasala a singpa ca ruena pipa kha a naathlie.
A ngaapa ta ama hihaana kha paluo sa paluo yi te, cuorasala nangvuona a hnyipa ta ca esena kha a pachang li hruo aa cuo.
Biehmisipa a ripa ca adangna kha paluo sa te, cuorasala a hangpa tehte ca hihaapuo pata na bie a ri.
Rue taa li pata ripa bie ca zueziy haata malie kha aa thuvsana te ta chung te, cuorasala a singpa bie ca tluona na a chiykhyi.
Aa hmuopa bie ca chuozaa ta aa hmang, cuorasala hangbie ca cuo pachangta dyina aa hmang.
Hangna ca a pha lipa khue a khuopa tie palung lie aw te, cuorasala diena khue a khuopa tie ca ama palung a tluo.
Aa dangpa tie ca ruvnaana ta tlung va yi, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa tie ca ruvnaana dyina amaa taw.
Hanghiena bie ca Abyipacuota duv a chiy te, cuorasala zang tluo aa tlapa tie ca a tlechuo yi.
A singpa ta ca a thesingna kha nu te, cuorasala a ngaapa ca a ngaana khana tluo a u.
Te a maapa ca uvtuv cuo'a te, cawsaa thaathuvpa ca re hrie changpa tana a cuo aa.
Palungriethyina ca cawsaa palung kha pachuo sa te, cuorasala bie phapa ca cawsaa palung a pathu sa.
Aa dangpa ta a viesaa tie kha ruena pha pi yi te, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa luopuv ca luoke pa i satuv tana a cuo.
Cawsaa thaathuvpa ca saa ka ciepa hmuo rue hang vyi, cuorasala te a maapa ca a sungnaapa suethiy na a pakhaw.
Aa dangpa tie luopuv lie ca hringna aw te, capa luopuv ca na ziy kieca thiyna a taw'a vaciy.
Saata singpa ca a paa pasiypa-yana kha naathlie te, cuorasala a palung lepa ta ca chuopa kha naathlie vyi.
Cawsaa phapa ca ama bie thyipaa taa khata hmang phapa kha ning yi te, cuorasala cawsaa a raw thepa tie ca hmang pha lipa dyi khana ama tue khing.
A bieri a cadangpa ca a hringna a vepa tana a cuo; bie a ri cakhawpa ca rana na aa taw aa.
A thaathuvpa ca a khingpa kha khaapahmuo hmung khu vyi, te a maapa ca a khingpa bangkhuo kha a hmung diy.
Aa dangpa ca hangna kha a hue, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa ca nangzaa hmiechi aa chiypa khana a ma hrie.
Hmang pha a tuepa luopuv ca adangna ta ve te, cuorasala suena ca cawsaa pha lipa tie aliena tana a cuo.
Cawsaa chekha ca a hnyisapa haata aw yi te khaapahmuo hnyi va yi; cawsaa chekha ca a siy pasasapa haata aw yi te ama hnyirungsa.
A hnyirungpa a hnyirungna ca a hringna a thlana ta cuo te, cuorasala siypasapa ca ahungtahmuo pachiypahuo va yi.
Aa dangpa tie khena ca a khe pacuopa lu te, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa tie myi-ing ca a thiy paluo.
Hruotlena hing ca a hru a ina dyi chiykhyi te, cuorasala ruena pipa a cuhluopa ca a singpa tana a cuo.
A catli tuv pata hmungpa hnyirungna ca cungbungle paluo te, cuorasala a cawta, a cawta tah pacung byalyapa ca a kiethawle.
A nguopuopa hmung haa tuv tiyta pathiypalung pasa te, cuorasala khingtlingna ca hringna thingkung tana a cuo.
Bie kha siysaa a ri lipa ca ama hne ama a parapa cuo te, nawbie kha a pa-uvsathyipa ca lawmuo kha pi pata a cuo aa.
Cawsaa singpa pacuvna ca hringna tiyhnaa cuo te, thiyna cyihyi cahriy thena tana a cuo.
A phapa pachangna ca due a hlue te, zangna hnyi lipa ca rana tana a cuo.
A singpa ca hmang bangkhuo kha singvaasa pata tue te, cuorasala a ngaapa ca a ngaana khana a phu ta a phu.
A pha lipa biephyatuv ta ruvnaana chiykhyi te, cuorasala zang tluo aa tlapa luosituv ca tluona na a chiykhyi.
Siypasana hne nangzaana ca pacuvna a khing lipa cuota cuo te, cuorasala pasiypa-yana a ngiepa ca pa-uvsathyipa ta a cuo.
Khing tlingna ca a thlung hringhruo, cuorasala a ngaapa tie ca pha lina kha cahriy khing va yi.
A singpa hne a khe la na sing ra aa, cuorasala a ngaapa naa khe kieca ruvnaana na naa taw aa.
A suepa tie ca vuochina ta paziy yi te, cuorasala aa dangpa tie ca hnyirungna lawmuo na ama hmung aa.
Cawsaa phapa tie ca saata hne samingta cuo te ta ru chi siy yi te, cuorasala a suepa tie hnyirungna ca aa dangpa tie kuv cung luona a chiy.
Siypasa tie lu taata kung vyisa'a te, cuorasala biedang lipa ta a pape patlaa diy aa.
Sungpe na hmuo li kieca na saata a huepa tana na cuo, cuorasala a saata a duepa ca palung pasiysa pata a pasiy a pa-ya.
Aa dangpa tie ca ning riy aa desa pata hnyi yi te, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa ca a nang na a diy aa.
Canung singpa ta a ing kha a sa, cuorasala canung ngaapa ta ca ama kuv mamaapa ta a phipatlaa diy.
Luodangpa a ziypa ta ca Khazing kha a ciy, cuorasala a zya pha lipa tie ta ca siysaa ri va yi.
A ngaapa bie ca ama ke cuota sungpe cuo te, cuorasala a singpa tie bie ca amaa bangna tana a cuo.
Cuetungpa a aw li kieca sa cakuo'a cate, a cahrapa cuetungpa a aw kieca sa na hnyisa aa.
Zang tluo aa tlapa tehte ca hang vyi, cuorasala aa hmuo lipa tehte ca hangbie khana a huv ta aa sungpuo.
Cawsaa hruotlepa ca singna kha huv te hmung vyi, cuorasala pachangkhuna a hnyipa cuota ca thesingna kha a nata tah ama hmung.
A ngaapa kha cahriy tie ung, tahematapakieca ama'a taata thesingna kha hmung'a vaciy.
A singpa tie singna ca ama ziypa luo pachangna kha tana a cuo, cuorasala a ngaapa tie ngaana ca viena luo na aa chiy yi.
A ngaapa tie ca ama sue zawta siysaa ri va yi, cuorasala cawsaa phapa tie ca Khazing duena lie khana ama palung a tluo.
Pathiypalung ca a riethyina kha aa pachang, a palungtluona kha cawsaa hrangpa ta a vya hraw khu vyi.
Cawsaa pha lipa ing ca parapa cuo te, cuorasala cawsaa phapa thluodaa ca a le viele.
Cawsaa ta aa hmuopa luopuv thlu'a mang ama ta pata, a dena lie thiyna luo a chiypa luopuv a aw.
A pahnyi nguoluopa hmuo a ngie chi te, palungtluona a chuonapa ca ngiechina tana a cuo.
Cawsaa zyatepa ca ama aa phuvpa kha hmung te, cawsaa phapa tie ta iema amaa phuvpa kha ama hmung.
A ruena a cawpa tie ca hmangting kha ama zang, cuorasala a singpa tie ca ama cakuona luopuv kha ama mang pasie.
A singpa tie ca pavuopathlu yi te pha lina kha ama cahriy, cuorasala a ngaapa ca a cadang li pata a tue paluo.
Cawsaa pathiy pachangpa ta ngaana re kha hrie te, hmang pha lipa hrie a tingpa ca cawsaa ta ama hue.
A ruena a cawpa ca ngaana ru kha cu te, a singpa ca thesingna lakhuv kha pakhuvpa ama cuo.
Cawsaa chiepa ca cawsaa phapa hmiekunglie kha a bung te, cawsaa pha lipa ca aa dangpa tie thlake lie kha ama vaa bung.
Dawchiepa tie ca ama ingpaa tahmuo khing lipa yi ta, cuorasala a hnyirungpa tie ca viesaa hluvpuv ama hnyi.
A ingpaa kha siysaa a ri lipa ca a suepa ta cuo yi te, cuorasala dawchiepa tie kaw a pacuopa tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo.
Hmang pha lipa hrie a tingpa tie ca ama rue chie sa cuo va ma? Hmang phapa hrie a tingpa tie ca pa-uvsathyina hne zang tluo atlana ama hmung aa.
Re bangkhuo ca thlahnena a hnyi diy, cuorasala bie dyi pung cakhawpa ca siypasana tana a cuo.
Cawsaa singpa tie byilakhuv ca ama singna ta cuo te, cuorasala a ngaapa tie paapaapa pachiy ca ama ngaana ta a cuo.
Zang tluo aa tlapa tehte ta hringna kha khuo te, cuorasala hangbie a ripa ca malie a lyipa tana a cuo.
Abyipaciyzaana ca a cahrapa anguona hnyina ta cuo te, cahaapaapa tie saata zaw ca canawna ama hnyi aa.
Abyipaciyzaana ca thiyna cyihyi cahriy thenapa hringna tiyhnaa tana a cuo.
Siepahruo tie rungnaana ca uvpa cawsaa hluvpuv khata cuo te, uvpa cawsaa a aw li kieca siepahruo ca a ra.
A catli pata a hi a haa lipa ca pachangkhuna lepuv a hnyipa ta cuo te, cuorasala a pathiy a pachangpa ca a ngaapa tana a cuo.
Pathiypalung nepa ca pangpa tluona cuo te, cuorasala hietliena ca ruv hmawna tana a cuo.
Siypasa tie a hrisaapa ca iema a satuv a esepa cuo te, cuorasala riethyivuosuopa tie kawpacuona a hnyipa ca Khazing a pa-uvsathyipa tana a cuo.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ca iema tuepa pha lina kha ta thawpatyi yi te, cuorasala aa dangpa tie ca hmangdangpa chunglie kha canawna ama hmung.
Pachangkhuna a hnyipa tie palung chunglie singna aw te, cuorasala a ngaapa tie palung chunglie ca awna hmang hnyi vyi.
Adangna ta mingphang kha cyicalang te, cuorasala suena ca mingphang bangkhuo cuota nangzaana tana a cuo.
Singvaasa pata hmang a tuepa changtaapa ca siepahruo hmiephaa kha hmung te, cuorasala nangzaa aa chiypa ta a awpa tie cunglie ca siepahruo hihaana na a tlung.
Ueryi nesa pata bie paliena ta hihaana padie sa te, cuorasala bie aa hruopa ta cawsaa hi a pahaa.
Cawsaa singpa tie palyi ta thesingna pa pungzaa sa te, cuorasala a ngaapa pakaa ta ngaana kha a papya.
Abyipaca hmangting bangkhuo kha hmung diy te, chiena hne phana bangkhuo kha a hmung diy.
Bie nepa ca hringna thingkung ta cuo te, cuorasala zyatena bie ta ca pathiypalung kha a phawchi.
A ngaapa ca nungpaa pasiypa-yana kha siysaa ri li pata, cuorasala pasiypa-yana a ngiepa ca a singpa tana a cuo.
Aa dangpa tie ing chunglie ca suethiy a hluvsa aw te, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa tie hnyina ca ruvnaana na a chiykhyi.
A singpa palyipakaa ca thesingna kha saciy haata vaa te, a ngaapa tie pathiypalung ca cahaacata cuo vyi.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie hriykhungrina ca Abyipacuota duv a chiy te, cuorasala cawsaa phapa tie thlaachuona ca a tlechuo.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie hringzya ca Abyipacuota duv a chiy te, cuorasala adangna a huvpa ca a due yi.
Luo phaa kha a piesepa ca khuopuv ta duotepa cuo'a te, cuorasala chuona kha a huepa ca a thiy aa.
Sheol hne Abaddon hmuo Abyipahmiekunglie aa luohuo thluo, cawsaa pathiypalung changchiy ca!
Cawsaa hruotlepa ca pasiypa-yana kha khing vyi; a singpa tie'a luo zaw cakuo'a vyi.
Palungtluona ta hmiephya papha sa te, cuorasala ngiechina ta cawsaa palung a pakyichi.
A singpa pathiypalung ta thesingna kha huv te, cuorasala a ngaapa pakaa ca ngaana ta a bi.
Siypasa tie ca ningting ta ama palung rie thyi pari te, cuorasala a palung tluopa tie ca ama hring aa nuo pari.
Abyipaciyzaana cangta a cawta hnyipa ca, suethiy a hluvsa hnyi pata palung rie thyipa laata a pha vie.
Duena cangta pachiepa zuosa ca uohnaasiyyhnaa hne hmuo cuo sala a huepuo cangta a thupa cue saa hne pachiepa zuosa laata a pahuo vie.
A pathiy pachangpa ca ahruna kha chiykhyi te, cuorasala palungpasiyna ca ahruna kha a padie.
A thaathuvpa luopuv ca a hling ta lesue te, cuorasala cawsaa phapa luopuv ca aa resale.
Saata singpa ca a paa palung patluo te, cuorasala a ngaapa saata ta a nung ngie a pachi.
Ruena a hnyi lipa ca a ngaana lie kha a nuosa cakhaw te, cuorasala a singpa ca aa dangpa luopuv liena a silule.
Ruena a pina a aw li kieca a tingpa hmang kha sichie te, ruena pituv a hluv vie tiyta a hlue a tling.
Aa chawsa pata paliepa bie ca cawsaa palung patluo te, hmang awzya hneta aa rawsa pata ripa bie ca kha tluv tama a pha!
A singpa tie ta a raw luo a awpa Sheol kha cahriy riypata, cung luo a sipa hringna luopuv kha ama ziy.
A hruotlepa tie ing kha Abyipata phipatlaa te, cuorasala nunghlyi tie awna hmang kha a pacu sa.
Cawsaa chiepa tie tingtuona kha Abyipata duv te, cawsaa palung pathepa tie cunglie kha a palung a tluo.
Aa dang lipa ta hmung riypa kha a karuo a awpa ca a chungkhue luo kha ruvnaana chiykhyi te, cuorasala nawthuv a huepa ca a hringkhue a pasiy aa.
Aa dangpa tie ca tuokhaatama i palie'a yi tapa kha rue taa yi te, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa tie pakaa ca biechiepa kha na a bung ta a bung.
Abyipaca cawsaa pha lipa tie hne a hlasa te, cuorasala aa dangpa tie thlaachuona kha a thyipa yi.
Hmiephya pha ta cawsaa palung patluo te, thuohlaa phapa ta cawsaa thaa a patlung sa.
Pasiypa-yana a ngiepa ca a singpa tie hrawlie na a aw ra aa.
Pasiypa-yana kha siysaa a ri lipa ca iema hne iema siysaa a ri lipa ta cuo yi te, cuorasala pasiypa-yana a ngiepa ca a singpa tana ama cuo.
Abyipaciyzaana ca sing a cuvna tana a cuo, pa-uvsathyina na khing kieca raw canaw taa tie.
Cawsaa hingta khue ca ama khuo aa, cuorasala a chuona bie a hnyituv ca Abyipatana a cuo.
Cawsaa pakha ta a tuepa bangkhuo kha a pha ta pata a rue aa, cuorasala Abyipaca pathiypalung ta a tingna bangkhuo kha cyi a pathlietuv tana a cuo.
Na tuepa bangkhuo kha Abyipa'a luo hluo la, na khuekhuona kha a tling aa.
Abyipata hmangting bangkhuo hing ama cyicuo ta tingna hneta a sa, cawsaa pha lipa tie hing hmuota ruvnaana ning cuo tana a sa yi.
A hruotlepa bangkhuo hing Abyipacuota duvsamakhiepa tana ama cuo, duotena ang li pata aw hrahring'a va yi.
Dangna hne zang tluo aa tlana thueta pha lina ca a ngiethepa cuo te, Abyipaciyzaana thueta a pha lipa kha cahriy khu pata a cuo.
Cawsaa hringzya ta Abyipapalung kha a patluo kieca, ama carie tie kha hmuo iema hneta a patla a pare sa yi.
Adangna cangta hmungpa suethiy a cawta ca, a dang lina cangta hmungpa suethiy a hluvsa laata a pha vie.
Cawsaa ta a sina riypa luopuv kha khue a khuo aa, cuorasala a kuorakuo luo a chiytuv ca Abyipatana a cuo.
Khazing ripa biechina kha siepahruo hmya lieta a aw, bieripana a tue tiyta a pakaa ta suena bie ri vyi.
Aa dangpa panangna hne cyilung ca Abyipahuopa tana a cuo, sahrie chunglie a awpa cyilung bangkhuo zaw ama tuepa tana a cuo.
Siepahruo tie cuota ca hmang pha lipa tue hing duvsamakhiepa tana a cuo, tahematapakieca byithude ca adangna thue tana aa hmang.
Aa dangpa bie kha siepahruo ta tlechuo te, aa hmuopa bie a ripa tie kha a due yi.
Siepahruo hihaana ca thiyna na a vya phya, caacuonakawta a singpa ta ca a palung patluo kha aa zue.
Siepahruo hmiephya pha ca hringna tana a cuo, ama hmiephaa hmungnapa ca cuovuo khy a vya phyapa amyi hne tana aa lu.
Singna hnyipa hing siy laata kha tluv tama a pha vie! Pachangkhuna hnyi riypa hingna ngu laata a tlaw vie riypata a cuo.
Cawsaa phapa luopuv ca pha lina kha a cahriy; capa luopuv kha a mangpuo pata a ziypa tie ca ama hringna kha aa bang.
A palena ca rana hmielie kha sile te, a mangkhangna ca a liena hmielie kha a sile.
Siypasa tie hrawlie a panena pathiypalung hneta awpa ca, a hruotlepa tie hne hruosue a chepa laata a pha vie.
Aca changpa yi kha a phasa pata naathlie la na hlue a tling aa, Abyipakha a ringchuopa ca ama palung a tluo.
A singpa tie ca hmungpasiena a hnyipa tana ama cuo ta yi te, ryi thlungpa ta ca cawsaa palung a la khu hryly.
Singna ca a hnyituv cuota hringna tiyhnaa cuo te, cuorasala a ngaapa ca a ngaa muo ta duotena kha a ang.
A singpa ca bie kha a ri hluota rue taa te, caacuonakawta a bie luhmaa si te cawsaa a sawle khu.
Bie thlungpa ca khyisaluv haa tana a cuo, pathiypalung lie kha thlung te pangpa hnaatluona tana a cuo.
Aa hmuopa luopuv a lusa pata, a chuona lie thiyna luo malie a chiykhyipa luopuv a aw.
Re a hriepa ca sa a ning khingnapa khata khuo vie ta re a pahrie sa, a nangdiy khana aa pape khing.
Cawsaa pha lipa ta a pha lipa khue kha ama khuo, ama bie ca myi haa tana malie kha a kuo.
A zyatepa ca ahruna kha papuv sa te, bieparuv a ri thepa ta viesaa kha a pache sa yi.
Tuechie a hmuopa tie ta ama ingpaa kha dung yi te, luo pha lipa luo kha amaa chiy.
A ming a vy paruvpa ca zyatena hmang kha tue a tingpa cuo te, a hmya malie a maasuepa ca hmang pha lipa a tue khingpa tana a cuo.
Suo paapa ca rungnaana byilakhuv cuo te, aa dangpa hring a hnyipa tie na a cu yi.
Palung pasiyna ca thaaruvna laata pha vie te, ama hne ama a uv khupa ca khypuv a te khupa laata a pha vie.
Vyisung ca baw cunglie pahlang pata a dapa a cuo, cuorasala biechina ca Abyipahuopa tana a cuo.
A hrupuo pata ing ta a bipa pyisa ningpa laata, a diesa pata muomuo chingpa pazaa zung kha baapa a pha vie.
A singpa sii ca nangzaa aa chiypa hmang a tuepa a byipaapa saata kha uv'a te, uvnu pakha haata ru zaw a cu ra aa.
Siy hne ngu ca sumyi ta khuosa ta dyapasya pata a cuo, cuorasala Abyipaca pathiypalung khana a dyapasya.
Hmang pha lipa a tuepa ca biechiepa kha naathlie te, a hanghiepa ta dungviena bie kha a naathlie.
Siypasa tie a esepa ca iema a Satuv kha ese te, malie tie vuochina amaa taw ning a palung a tluopa ca duotena ang li pata aw'a vyi.
Samingsahlaa hing nungpuv macuo tie byilakhuv cuo te, saata zaw rungnaana ca nung hne paa ta ama cuo.
Biephapa ca a ngaapa hne a tla vyi, hanghiena bie hne uvtuv changchiy ca aa tla he a tla vyi.
A pituv tie ta nawthuv ca pacuo alung haa tana re a hrie khu ta pata rue yi te, ma tuepa bangkhuo liena hluetlingna malie a pi ta pata ama zang.
Malie suena kha a meming khupa ca amaa viesaana kha pacu sa te, vieriy a thungpa ca viesaa kha aa sung.
A ngaapa yi zakha tuvpuopa laata, thleduothena a hnyipa pasiypa-yapa na a thlahne vie.
Cawsaa pha lipa ca a duna dyi kha huv te, cuorasala ama ca a pha lipa biephyatuv pathliesuepa tana a cuo aa.
A ngaapa a ngaahriy chiy ning a tawpa laata, a taata chuvpa cavawpuvnung a tawpa na a pha vie.
Phana kha chiena ta a thungpa tie ca, a pha lipa hmang ta ama ing kha a pe se buo'a vyi.
A hru hruo thupa ca, tiy ama pa-angnapa tluo zuv hruo aa thupa hne aa lu nakawta; namaa hru hluota duo tie ung.
Cawsaa pha lipa duo a pacupa hne cawsaa aa dangpa sue a phawpa ca, Abyipahmielie duvsamakhie aa chiypa tana ama cuo.
A ngaapa ca singna a cuv riypa pathiypalung a hnyi li tiyta, khaapanakawma singna calyina riypata tuokaa ca a kuv luo pi pata a cuo aa?
Viesaa ca khatiy ning hmuota amaa due pari, uvnu ca ruvnaana a hraw riypata a puvpa tana ama cuo.
Ruena a hnyi lipa a ngaapa dyina, malie lyibuo thungpa riypata bie a kuo.
A pha lipa hmang a tue khingpa ca ruvnaana a khingpa ta cuo te, a mangkhang pata bie a ripa ca rana kha a khingpa tana a cuo.
A zyatepa ca kha-aw taw vyi, zyatena bie a ripa ca vuochina chung luo na a tla taw.
Saata ngaapa a sapa ca ruvnaana a taw te, saata ngaapa nungpaa ca ama palung tluo vyi.
Palungtluona ca siyy phapa tana a cuo, cuorasala palungrana ca ruv na a pahmaw sa.
Cawsaa pha lipa ca a paruv ta pipa nawthuv kha la te, biedangpa kha a para.
Thleduo thena a hnyipa ca singna kha mang te, cuorasala a ngaapa ming ca alyi dena luo khana a mang.
Saata ngaapa tie ca a paa ngiechina ta cuo yi te, iema a sapa ama nung palungriethyina tana ama cuo.
Suena a hnyi lipa duotepa ca pha vyi, hmangdangpa ama tuena kawlieta cawsaa phapa tie tuvpa zaw pha vyi.
Bie a chibuopa ca thesingna a hnyipa cuo te, palung diesa pata a aw thepa ca pachangkhuna a hnyipa tana a cuo.
A ngaapa hmuo a dieta tah a aw kieca a singpa ta ripa cuo te, a hmya a papingpa ca a singpa ta ripa a cuo.
Malie hne a viesaa the lipa ca ama khingna dyi a ziy khingpa tana a cuo, malie ta a pha ama tapa bangkhuo kha naa a tlakhyipa yi aw vyi.
A ngaapa tie ca pachangpasie a zue khing va yi, iema ruenapa ripa hne paluosapa dyina amaa zue.
Pha lina hne nangzaana ca amaa vaw pakhaw, pa-uvsathyi tluo a tlana kha na pavie kieca nangzaana na na ang aa.
Pakaa taata ripa bie hing aa thuvpa tiy haata cuo te, singna tiyhnaa ca a lang paripa cavaa haa tana a cuo.
Bieripana lie a suepa tie a daakhyipa ca a phapa cuo vyi, a sue lipa pasung sapa zaw a phapa cuo vyi.
A ngaapa hmya ta ahruna chiykhyi te, a pakaa ta sungpe ta tuvna kha aa ku.
A ngaapa tie pakaa ca ama rana cuo te, ama hmya ca iema cuota cyihyi ta a cuo.
A paruv ta malie kaw ripa ca pahuo hringhruo te, ma chung luo kha aa ngie bung.
Re lie a thaathiypa ca, paratuv hne uvnu a cuopa tana a cuo.
Abyipaming ca aa suosapa a cupa ing tana a cuo, aa dangpa tie kha capa luo ca a ruo yi te amaa bang.
A hnyirungpa ta a hnyirungna ca a cupa khypuv ta rue te, aa suopa lungruetlepie haa tana a cuo ta pata a rue.
Cawsaa pakha ca a hruo a tle kieca rana a taw te, aa pane kieca pa-uvsathyina aa taw.
Bie naathlie taa li pata bie paliepa ca, ngaana hne nangzaana tana a cuo.
Cawsaa pathiypalung ta pasana kha a ang khu, cuorasala palungrana ca ahungma a ang khu aa?
Pachangkhuna a hnyipa ca thesingna kha aa la, a singpa naa ta thesingna kha a huv.
Lasaw ca a pituv cuota chiypakaa pahaw te, cawsaa lepa kha a pataw sa.
Cawsaa hrangpa ta bie hiehriyna a tue hluota ca, bieripana zung lie bie a ri taapa ca aa hmuosapa na a lu.
A singsapa tie pahning bie a inapa ca, vyisung adana dyina a padie khu.
Uvnu zaw a daa pakhawpa ca a cupa khypuv laata a cahra vie, cuorasala a hrupa ca cariekyikuo a khaakhuopa hne tana aa lu.
Cawsaa ca a pakaa taata a pyapa bie ta a riy bi taw te, a hmya taata a pyapa thyipaa ta a riy aa caw taw.
Ripa bie ta thiyna cuose hringna cuose a chiykhyi the, caacuonakawta ma bie ripa thyipaa ca ma cu aa hu.
Napuv a hmungpa ca hmang phapa na aa hmung, Abyipahmiephaa na a hmung.
Siypasa tie bie ama ri tiyta paakiena bie ri yi te, a hnyirungpa tie ta bie aa hruopa ta ama palie.
Viesaa chekha ca pahnyisesungna lie dyi thlahne yi te, cuorasala viesaa hmisipa ta ca uvnu laa te tana a viesaa kha a ringchuo vie.
Bie a maa thepa a ngaapa laata, aa dangta tah a hringpa siypasapa a pha vie.
Thesingna aw li pata a khing dyi khingpa ca pha vyi, aa pahraatuv pata a sipa ca luo a vie.
Cawsaa pakha ca a ngaanapa ta rana luo aa chiy, ca tiyta Abyipacunglie kha a hi a haa.
Hnyirungna ta viesaa hluvpuv aa vya chiy, cuorasala siypasapa tie ca viesaa li pata thuse pata ama cuo.
Aa hmuo lipa tehte ca duotena ang li pata aw'a vyi, a hanghiepa zaw law ra'a vyi.
Cawsaa hluvpuv ta a pahyasapa hmiephaa hmung kha a zue yi te, cawsaa bangkhuo ta lasaw a pituv kha amaa viesaa.
Ama tieriy tahmuo siypasa tie kha ama hue kieca, ama viesaa changchiy ta ca thuse li pata ama aw'a ma! Iema ta ama u tiyta, capa lie ca aw va yi.
Singna a hnyipa ca iema hne iema kha amaa due, pachangkhuna hnyipa ca hnyirungna tana a cuo.
Aa hmuo lipa tehte ca duotena ang li pata aw'a vyi, a hanghiepa zaw ra li pata aw'a vyi.
A ngaapa ca lunghruo tlungsa pata hring riypata a tla vyi, sii ta siepahruo tie uv riypa changchiy ca a tla vyi.
A phapa ruena a hnyipa tie ca ama palung pasiy te, suena memingpa ca cawsaa rungnaana ta a cuo.
Siepahruo hihaana ca chingde aa hrungpa haata cuo te, cuorasala ama hmiephaa hmungnapa ca aphuv cunglie aduotiy haa tana a cuo.
A ngaapa saata ca a paa cuota rana cuo te, aa cie paripa napuv ca a huo the lipa khynepa haa tana a cuo.
Ing hne suethiy ca nungpaa taata cupa ru ta cuo te, cuorasala nangvuona a hnyipa napuv ca Abyipa'a taa tana a cuo.
Thaathiynapa ta mingkuv thuvna a chiykhyi, na thaa a thiy kieca na nang na a diy aa.
Nawbie a ziypa ca a hring aa, a hringna luopuv kha siysaa a ri lipa ca a thiy aa.
Siypasa tie kha a duepa ca Abyipakha ducyi a pipa cuo te, a tlingsa pata thungpa a cuo aa.
Na saata ca anguopuona a aw ning kha pasiypa-ya tie, na pasiypa-ya li kieca ama rana riypata a byatuv tana na cuo.
A hihaa a chiepa ca duotena kha a ang aa, na pacha zawta, na pacha pakhaa na a hu aa.
Ruena pipa kha naathlie la pacuvna kha cuhluo tie, hmieluo cuota singna na na hmung aa.
Cawsaa pathiypalung chunglie khuekhuona a hluvsa a aw aa, cuorasala Abyipatingna dyina a hmang aa.
Cawsaa pakha khing aa chiyna ca zang tluo aa tlana ta a cuo, a hanghiepa cuopa laata siypasapa cuo a pha vie.
Abyipaciyzaana ca hringna tana a cuo; cahaacata na hring kieca ruvnaana a taw li'apa cata na hnaa a nguo aa.
Cawsaa thaathiypa ca pakaa lie sa kha a kuv ta la pata, a pakaa luo a tuv riypa hmuo a thaa hang vyi.
A hruotlepa kha na tuv kieca, a ruena a cawpa ta singna a hmung aa, pachangkhuna a hnyipa kha na pasiypa-ya kieca thesingna a hmung aa.
A paa kha tuv te a nung a cadepa ca, nangzaana a chiykhyituv hne hmiechina a phyatuv tana a cuo.
I saata, pacuvna na thyi riypata thesingna bie kha piese khah.
Thlahnena a hnyi lipa tehte ca biedangpa kha siysaa ri vyi, a pha lipa tie pakaa ta pha lina kha a baa ta a baa.
A hruotlepa tie cuota suebena ca chi paciepa cuo te, a ngaapa tie ke china ta sungpe ca chi paciepa a cuo ra.
Mingsuvtiy ca malie a dungviepa tana a cuo, zuvre pariypa ca ahruna ta a cuo, cahaacata a sichiepa ca a singpa cuo vyi.
Siepahruo hihaapa ca aa hrung nguoluopa chingde haa tana a cuo; a hi a pahaa sapa ca ama hne ama a thiepa haa tana a cuo.
A hru riypa a cahriy thepa ca pa-uvsathyi aa tlapa tana a cuo, cuorasala a ngaapa ca ahruna luo kha a catli.
A thaathiypa ca a cuo ningta lu thlu vyi; sa hrie tiy aa de tiyta a la riy aw vyi.
Cawsaa ta pathiypalung chunglie atingna ca aa thuvpa tiy hne tana aa lu, cuorasala pachangkhuna a hnyipa ta ca a pachang khu ngiethie.
Cawsaa hluvpuv ta zang tluo aa tlapa tana i cuo amaa ta, cuorasala a ringchuo aa tla hmisipa ca ahungma a hmung khu?
Aa dangpa ca hmangdangpa lie kha a hring, a saa a nu zaw ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo.
Bieripana byithude lie a tupa siepahruo ca pha lina bangkhuo kha a hmung paky diy.
Ahungma, “I pathiypalung kha pathe sa angte, suena taata i pathe,” a ta khu aa?
A tling lipa cyilung hne a tling lipa panangna ca Abyipacuota duvsamakhiepa tana a cuo.
Haatiyta tahmuo a tuepa kha a pathepa hne aa hmuopa a cuo a cuo li ca a tuenapa mamaapa ta a paluo sa.
Thyinapa naa hne hmungnapa ming zaw hing Abyipatuepa tana ama cuo.
A ziepa hing tlechuo tuv khah, na dawchie pathlyi aa; na ming kha padyi la, sa a hluvsa na hnyi aa.
Chechiy a calyituv ta, “Pha vyi, pha vyi,” a ta taw, cuorasala luohlaa luo a chiy taata i calyipa hing a phasa a ta.
Siy a aw, a muo ruvsapa lungvaa zaw a hluvpuv a aw, cuorasala thesingna bie a ripa hmya ca a muo sungpa suethiy tana a cuo.
A pachang lipa hne ruohrang ming cuota biekuona a tuepa ca; a biekuona cuo khata bie aa kuopa chechiy kha patuvpa tie ung.
Dungvie pata hmungpa sa ca a thlung, cuorasala a ning khu pahne a pakaa ca lungcaring ta a bi aa.
Ruena a hie la naa tingpa hmang kha tluo a tling aa, a tingtuo ciemuo li pata rie tuv khah.
Malie kawchie a ripa ta bieparuv kha a phu taw, caacuonakawta bie a rangpa kha a khe khah.
Na nung hne na paa kha chie na sa kie yi ca, khyzingna chungliena na myi-ing a thiy aa.
A catli tuv pata hmungpa suethiy ca, a chuona luo ca a thluechiy'a vyi.
“Pha lina kha kama na a thung'a ang,” ta khah, Abyipakha huo la acaa bya aa.
A tling lipa cyilung ca Abyipacuota duvsamakhiepa tana a cuo, aa hmuo lipa panangna zaw pha vyi.
Cawsaa luo malie a chiytuv ca Abyipatana a cuo; tuokhaatama ma sina luopuv ca kiema ta ma pachang the aa?
Khazing'a luo lasaw pi riypa kha bie naa kuo hluota rue taa tie, a hnang taata a ngiepachiy pathlyi'a kie ciy.
A singpa siepahruo ca cawsaa pha lipa tie kha hmung paky diy yi te, ngiechi lipa yi ta duo a te yi.
Cawsaa pathiypalung ca ma chunglie a awpa bangkhuo a hmung paky diypa Abyipamyi-ing tana a cuo.
Aa dang pata hringna hne zang tluo a tlana ta siepahruo kha pahmang te, adangna ta aa byilakhuv ca a pabang.
Mingnu tie rungnaana ca ama thaazuo ta cuo te, nungpuv macuo tie ama puvthena ca ama suo paapa hing tana a cuo.
Sungpe ta china hmaa ta ma pha lina kha pathe sa te, tuvna maa tawpa ta ma chung luo pha lina kha a pathe sa.
Siepahruo pathiypalung ca cavaa tiy haata ta te, Abyipakuv chungliena a aw; khaapa luo kuo a cuo zaw a khing thiy ta a pa lang sa.
Tuepa bangkhuo hing a tuetuv ming hmungna lie ca a pha, cuorasala Abyipaca pathiypalung hingna cyi a pathlie.
Abyipata adangna hne biedangpa tuepa ca hriykhungrina laata a khing vie.
Aa mangkhangpa minghmie, a hruotlepa pathiypalung hne, cawsaa pha lipa tie myi-ing ca suena tana a cuo.
A phasa pata rue paciena hne temaana ta re a hriepa aa tingna ca hluetlingna chiykhyi te, rue taa li pata a tuepuo pache cakhawpa ca ahubuna dyina aa taw aa.
Hanghiena ta hmungpa suethiy ca a zulepa tiykhuv hne thiyna cyihyi tana a cuo.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ca biedangpa kha ama tue khing li nakawta, iema tuepa tuechiena kha ta iema kha a para'a yi.
A suepa luopuv ca a kyi te, cuorasala a pathepa tie tuepa ca aa hmuo.
A cie thesapa napuv hne ing kha chunglie awpa laata ca, thlungkhuv cung a kiyta lie awpa na a pha vie.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ta ca pha lina kha tlechuo yi te, ama ingpaa cunglie nangduena hnyi va yi.
A hruotlepa tie duotepa ama cuo tiyta a ruena a cawpa tie ama palung vya sing te, a singpa tie ca cawpapa ama cuo tiyta, thesingna amaa cha.
A dangpa Khazing ta cawsaa pha lipa tie ing kha mangpathliy te, iema ca rana chung luo kha a thaw yi.
Siypasa tie ama khipa kha na naa naa parue kieca, nama na khi thueta ahungtahmuo ca thyi'a va yi.
A paruv ta pipa lasaw ta hihaana kha padie sa te, pang raw ta cyilepa nawthuv ta pathiylingna kha a padie sa.
Biedangpa kha tuepa a cuo tiyta, aa dangpa tie ama palung tluo te, cuorasala pha lina a tuepa tie nangrena ta a cuo.
Pachang thena luopuv taata a viepa ca, a thiypa tie a hmyana liena aa pahy aa.
Anuona a khingpa ca a siy pasa'a te, mingsuvtiy hne chiytiy a khingpa ca hnyirung the'a vyi.
Cawsaa pha lipa ca aa dangpa cuota athlana cuo te, zang tluo aa tla lipa ca a phapa cuo tana ama ang aa.
A cie thesapa hne malie a chuo thepa napuv hne aw pakhawpa laata ca ruo duothlingna lie awpa na a pha vie.
A singpa ing lie suethiy aw te, cuorasala a ngaapa ta ca a pahli diy.
Adangna hne kawpacuona kha a huvpa ca hringna hne pa-uvsathyina khana a hmung aa.
A singpa ta ca a riephapa rieka khypuv kha a du te, cing khu'a vyi ta pata amaa ringchuopa cariekyikuo kha a pacing.
A palyi a pakaa a ve khupa ca ruvnaana taata a law aa.
A palung le te a hruotle aa mangkhangpa ca “Malie a esepa” ta pata a cuo.
A kuv ta re a hrie khing lipa cawsaa thaathiypa ta malie hie a tlienapa ca a thiynapa tana a cuo.
Cawsaa pha lipa ca ning-aw ta malie hie a tliena dyi kha rue te, cuorasala aa dangpa ta ca pahyasa pata a pi yi.
Cawsaa pha lipa hriykhungrina ca duvsamakhie a chiy te, a tingna pha lipa hne a tue kie changchiy ca kha tluv tama duv aa chiy hryly.
Aa hmuo lipa tehte ca a ra aa, cuorasala a phasa pata bie naa a thliepa ca a phata tah tehte a khuo khu aa.
Cawsaa pha lipa ca a pha hruo a cuo te, cawsaa phapa ca ama hne ama kha aa zang.
Singna, pachangna hne ruena pipa zaw hing Abyipaaduna ta hmuo thepa suokha hmuo aw va yi.
Rie a tuvnapa ning cuota aruo ca tingtuopa cuo te, cuorasala tena ca Abyipahuopa tana a cuo.
Mingphana ca hnyirungna laata a tlaw vie riypa tana a cuo, malie ta hmiephaa pipa ca siy hne ngu laata a pha vie.
A hnyirungpa hne a siypasapa amaa lunapa a aw: Abyipaca iema zaw bangkhuo a satuv tana a cuo.
A singpa ca aa nupa ruvnaana kha hmung the te, cuorasala a ruena a cawpa ta ca sisue te ruvnaana kha a ang.
Rawcanawna hne Abyipaciyzaana lawmuo ca, hnyirungna hne malie ta pa-uvsathyina hne hringpasiyna ta a cuo.
A zyatepa luo lie ca ahling hne cyihyi aw te, a raaring thepa tie ta ca a cahriy ta ama cahriy.
Haatiy kha hringzya phapa pacuv tie, a vya le tiyta luo pie'a vyi.
A hnyirungpa ta siypasa tie kha a uv yi, ducyi a lapa ca a pituv sii tana a cuo.
Biedang lipa saciy a vaapa ca ruvnaana kha pahriy'a te, a hihaana sungpe ca a tlipachung aa.
A pahyasapa tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo, tahematapakieca a sa khana siypasa tie a pibuo yi.
Malie a esepa kha a cade ung la a dawre lina a vie aa, ahruna hne bie pha lipa zaw a die aa.
Palung pathena kha khing te ryine a cyi thepa ca, siepahruo kha viesaa ta a hnyi aa.
Abyipaming ca thesingna kha mangchiy te, cuorasala zang tluo aa tla lipa tie bie kha a thaw.
A thaathiypa ta, “Ale liena chingde a aw! Luopuv luo i pya kieca na sie'a te i thiy aa!” a ta.
Siyhrawnung bie ca aa thuvpa khue haata a cuo; ama hne nungvaa cuo te Abyipahihaana a angpa ca capa khue chung luo cana a tla aa.
Haatiy pathiypalung lie ngaana a aw phung ta a cuo, cuorasala pasiypa-yana sungpe ta luohlaa luo aa cade.
Hnyirungpa a khing nakawta siypasa tie a hrisaapa hne a hnyirungpa tie a pipa ca a siy na a pasa aa.
Na naathlie la i bie hing thyi tie, ica pacuvnapa hing na pathiypalung lie pari tie;
na pathiypalung chunglie pari cate na palyi na pakaa lie a aw pacie kieca na palung a tluo aa.
Abyipakha naa ringchuo the riypata hingpa zaw hing ataning nama kha ica pachang sa.
Ruena chena hne thesingna bie sawthung kha a chie a pha pachang pata
nama caa pathliepa tie'a luo aa hmuo pata na palie khu riypa yi ta ica capepa cuo va ma?
Siypasa tie kha ama siy a pasa nakawta ama huopa va chuv khah yi; khypuv thlake lie zaw kha va ese va tuechie khah yi;
tahematapakieca Abyipata a daakhyi'a yi te, iema a paratuv tie ama hringna kha a para'a yi.
A hi a haa thepa kha viesaa ta vaa tue khah, a pathiy pachangpa kha vaa khe khah;
ama zya kha a la'a cate na, nama hne nama kha cyihyi lie naa pa-uo aa.
Malie lyibuo kha thungpa riypata bie vaa kuo khah.
Lyibuo kha na thung khu li kieca, khaapanakawma na iehmang kha na raw taata amaa dapathla aa?
Mingchingmingvuo tie ama za bangpa ruoriy tung kha hnyi khah.
Ama re lie a thesapa tie kha na hmung yi ma? Iema ca siepahruo re khana ama hrie aa; cawsaa cakhawpa re ca hrie'a va yi.
Uvtuv tie hne sa ning riypata namaa tu pakhaw tiyta, na hmiekunglie ahungma a tu tapa kha a phata tah rue tie,
na pakaa a pahuosa kie zawma sa ning kha a ang vie tie.
Aca pipa sa pahuopa kha karuo aw tuv pata ning khah, tahematapakieca aca dungnapa sa ta a cuo khu.
Na hringna parapuo'a nangna te ta hnyirungna huv khah; taw thenapa singna hnyi tie.
Chuelyi hmang luo dyi na ming na padyi kieca aca sise aa; sungkhabala ta a mathlaa a bang'a te na, hmungthlu haata avuo luo acaa zu se aa.
A pasiysapa tie sa kha ning khah; a pahuosapa aca pipa yi kha ning khing khah;
rue lie a kalaapa suobuv haa tana a cuo aa. “Ning buvluv tie, dang buvluv tie,” aca ta'a yi; cuorasala ama ri khing tangepa ca khapa kha ta cuo vyi.
A cawta na ningpa kha paliy pakhaa'a cate, naa lawnapa bie bangkhuo kha a puohriesa aa.
A ngaapa thyina lie bie ri khah, singna bie na ripa kha siysaa ri the'a vyi.
Hluoning ruoriy tung kha hnyi khah, haaraata lu zaw kha va chuv khah,
tahematapakieca iema a daakhyituv ca a cahrapa ta cuo te, nama kha a du pata iema kha a daakhyi'a yi.
Pacuvna kha na pathiypalung lie pari tie, thesingna bie kha naathlie tie.
Haatiy kha pasiypa-ya li pata aw khah; sungpe ta na chipa yi khata thiy'a va yi.
Sungpe ta na chi kie yi ca, ama hringna kha Sheol taata na khuo khu'a yi.
I saata, na palung a sing kieca, i palung a tluosa ra aa.
Na pakaa ta aa hmuopa a ri tiyta, i palung a tluosa aa.
A suepa tie kha hietlie khing khah yi, cuorasala Abyipakha ciyzaa pari tie.
Hmieluo tapa hing a aw hmisi saw tli hing, naa nguopuona kha chipachungpa cuo'a vyi.
I saata, naathlie la singsa tie, luodangpa kha ziy a zue pari tie.
Mingsuvtiy a pariypa tie hne a khe khah, saa a rangpa tie zaw kha a khe khah yi,
tahematapakieca mingsuvtiy a pariypa tie hne saa a rangpa tie ca ama dawchie aa, a tluv byalyapa tie zaw pangbie thlapa caw na amaa hryi aa.
Caa satuv na paa bie kha naathlie la, na nung kha a nungpuv tiyta siysaa ri li pata aw khah.
Biehmisipa kha calyi la zaa khah tie, singna hne pacuvna hne pachangkhuna kha calyi tie.
Aa dangpa saata a paa ca khuopuv ta a palung tluo'a te, sacapaa singpa a sapa ca a sacapaa cunglie kha a palung a tluo aa.
Na nung hne na paa kha ama palung patluo tie yi; nama caa sa nung kha a palung tluo se.
I saata, na pathiypalung kha na pi la, i hringzya hing a mangpuo tie.
Tahematapakieca siyhrawnung ca aa thuvsapa khue tana a cuo; nungvaathingsuena a tue nung ca takhue baata haa tana a cuo.
Aparuvpa haata cawsaa kha bya yi te, capaa hluvpuv kha zang tluo a tla lipa ta a tue yi.
Ahungma bawchie ciemuopa ta a cuo taw? Ahungma a ngie a chi taw? Ahungma cawsaa hne a hru taw? Ahungma a cie the taw? Ahungma a kaw aw li pata hmaa a hmung taw? Ahungma a ming a se rieruv taw?
Zuo pasiypuv te ta mingsuvtiy a dangpa hne, siyy hne pyapa mingsuvtiy a dangpa tana ama cuo.
Panuo chunglie mingsuvtiy a se viyvaapa hne a pasing kyalyapa, dang tiyta aa rawsa pata rue lie a khung riypa a lupa kha mang khah.
A chuona lie ca pariy haata cawsaa kha daw te, a ca-ie ruvsapa pariy haa tana cawsaa a daw.
Na ming ta hmang kha a phanghrang ta hmung'a te, na palung ta a cuo lipa zaw a rue aa.
Riyliy khingkhuo lie a ziepa hne, tiypalaw pangzunapa atung daw lie a ziepa haa tana a cuo aa.
“Na tuv yi te pasa vyi, na chi yi te a pachang va ang. Khatiythuema i cha aa? I dang pakhaa kie dyi'a ing,” na ta aa.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie kha hietlie khah yi, iema kha a khe khing khah yi;
tahematapakieca ama pathiypalung ca tuechiena dyi kha khuekhuo te, malie para riypa bie kyalya khana ama ri.
Ing ca singna ta sapa cuo te, pachangkhuna ta pacu sapa a cuo.
Thesingna ta ing khuo bangkhuo ca a muosungpa hne khing aa chiysapa hmang ta a pabi.
A singpa riebyi tie ca a thaaruvpa tie laata ama cahra vie, a thaaruvpa laata thesingna a hnyipa zaw ama cahra vie;
tahematapakieca singna luochiyna ta rie ca tuvpa cuo te, ruena pituv hluvpuv ama aw kieca tena hmung pata a cuo.
Singna ca a ngaapa zaw cuota ca aa suo tuv; khypuv thlake bierina hmang lie ca ama pakaa uo nguo va yi.
Hmang pha lipa tue a tingpa ahunghmuo parana a tuetuv ta pata kupa a cuo aa.
A ngaapa khuekhuona ca suena cuo te, malie a esepa ca duv aa chiypa tana a cuo.
Ruvnaana cuo ningta na palung a ra kieca, na thaa a caw hrahring tanapa tana a cuo.
Thie riypata ama sikhyipa tie hne amaa dalepa tie khuo lipa yi cata,

“Mang tie ung, hingpa hmang hing pachang vapuv,” nama ta kieca, pathiypalung cyi a pathlietuv ta pachang'a va ma? Na hringna caa hmung diypa paa ta pachang'a va ma? Iema'a na ama tuepa hne aa phuvpa ta thung li pata a aw'a ma?
I saata, khyitiy kha ning tie, tahematapakieca a pahuo, khyisaluv taata zaa langpa khyitiy ca a thlung.
Singna ca na hringna cuota cahaaca tana a cuo; singna na hmung kieca na hmieluo cuota a pha, naa nguopuona ca chipachung pata cuo'a vyi.
Cawsaa phapa kha cawsaa pha lipa ta a ing lie a byapa haata va bya khah; aa dangpa a awna hmang kha va para khah;
tahematapakieca yi sariy amaa lie zawta ama thu pakhaa aa; cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa tie ca ruvnaana na a vaapatyi'a yi.
Na carie tie amaa lie ningta na palung tluo khah se, amaa pachiy ning zaw a law khah,
cahaacata na aw kieca Abyipata pachang'a te a palung tluo li pata, iema'a taata a hihaana kha a palaw aa.
Pha lina a tuepa tie kawlieta na palung rie thyi khah se. A pha lipa tie kha hietlie khah yi;
tahematapakieca cawsaa pha lipa tie ca hmieluo cuo kha hnyi va yi; a pha lipa tie myi-ing ca pachesa pata a cuo aa.
I saata, Abyipahne siepahruo kha ciy tie, iema pakhakha kha ciyzaa li pata aw khah;
tahematapakieca iema'a taata rana kha sungkha ta a vaw the te, iema pahning'a taata a vaw khupa rakyina ca ahungma a pachang?
Hingpa tie zaw hing mingsing tie bie tana a cuo: Bieripana lie a kuo ta a daapa ca pha vyi.
Cawsaa pha lipa kha, “Nama ca sue vaciy,” a tatuv ca, cawsaa ta sie pi'a yi te, mingphang ta ama hue aa;
cuorasala cawsaa chiepa kha a chuo a raapa tie ca tlechuopa cuo'a yi te, thluechiy na ama cunglie a tlung aa.
Aa hmuosa pata bie a paliepa ca, duepa pakha ta pahnuopa haa kha tana alawna a chiykhyi.
Na hringna riypa kha huv taa la, ningbaa riypa aa ky khutaata, ing kha sa tie.
Bie pacie li pata na ingpaa a du pata tehte cuo khah, na hmya ta malie kha va dung khah.
“Kama cunglie ina tuepa haa yi tana iema cunglie i tue ra aa, ama tuepa haa tana i thung'a yi,” ta khah.
A thaathiypa lu hne a ngaapa mingsuv dung kha cahraw angte i sile;
lu ca ahling ta syisue te, uvtamyi ta a buv diypa hne, a caaca zaw a cing diypa kha i hmung.
Cakhutaata pacuo syalya angte, i hmungpa pacuvna ca:
Kaakhata a hmung caw'a ang, kaakhata pasing caw'a ang, kaakhata i kuv a cakhiy'a angte a pahy caw'a ang, na ta ning khata,
siypasana ca aparuvpa haa khata a vaw'a te, a phahlana ca cehre a cyipa aparuvpa haa khata acaa vawhning aa.
Hingpa zaw hing Solomon ta a ripa phungthluv bie cuo te, Judah Siepahruo Hezekiah rehrietuv tie ta ama capepa ta a cuo.
Khazing rungnaana ca hmang a nupa hingta cuo te, cuorasala siepahruo rungnaana ca hmang a phupa hingta a cuo.
Avuo ca a suo te, alyi ca aa thuvpa haata, siepahruo pathiypalung ca pachang khu pata cuo vyi.
Ngu ca a i kha thaw la, susatuv ta hmang puvthesa pata a sa aa.
Cawsaa pha lipa kha siepahruo hmiekung taata phe tie ung, a byithude ca adangna ta pacu sa pata a cuo aa.
Siepahruo hmiekung luo chiy kha vaa pachie khah, cawsaa lepa zaw hrawlie kha vaa daa khah;
tahematapakieca byi hmiekunglie a raw luo pacungpa laata ca, “Hingpa luo hing a kya tu tie,” tapa ca a pha vie.
Bie na hnyi pahne ta bieripana zung luo chiykhyi paluo khah, na ingpaapa ta na hmie aca vya pachi kie, a chuona lie tuokhaatama naa tue aa?
Nama bie kha na ingpaapa hneta patla pakhaw tie ung, cakhutaata malie bieparuv kha phu khah;
na phu kieca caa thyipa ta na hmie ca pachi'a te, na thuochina ca chuo the'a vyi.
A cuota ningta ripa bie ca, ngu cunglie siy thyithyipa ama sapa haa tana a cuo.
Cawsaa singpa ta chuopa ca, a naathlie khingpa cuota ca, siy kuvpahryi hne siy chechiy sungnaapa haa tana a cuo.
Zang tluo aa tlapa biephyatuv ca a pathlietuv cuota, sahrie cuo ningta aduotiy cakaapa haa kha tana a cuo, a pathlietuv palung khana a padie sa.
Lasaw na ica pi aa ta raalaa te a pi buo lipa ca, khy a pasaa sa tlung lipa amyi hne thliy haa tana a cuo.
Na palung a pasiysa kieca uvtuv byi kha hmuo ripasa khu a cuo, bie thlungpa ca ruv hmuo a thlipachung khu.
Khyitiy kha na hmung kieca aa dena te dyi ning tie, a hluv tuv na ning kieca naa paliysue aa.
Na ingpaa kha parie pari khah, nang'a cate na aca hue aa.
A ingpaa a du pata aa hmuo lipa tehte a cuopa ca, tungbung, viehnuo hne cuoti haa tana a cuo.
Ruvnaana cuo ningta zang tluo aa tla lipa zangpa ca, haa pha lipa acuolikie phyi cabiepa hne tana aa lu.

A palung rie a thyisapa hmiekunglie hlaa va sapa ca, hmaa cunglie a thuepa tiy byapa haa tana a cuo. Caw cunglie ahmupa hne thing chunglie alungpa haa khata cawsaa pathiypalung ca ngiechina ta a ningle taw.
Na carie tie kha ama nang a diy kieca, ning riypa sa pi yi la; ama tiy a hrie kieca, dang riypa tiy pi tie yi.
Cahaacata na tue kieca ama luv cunglie myihyi sekhalapa a papungpa ta cuo'a cate, Abyipata lawmuo aca pi aa.
Chaluo thliy ca khytiy za phya te, malie kawchie rina ta hihaana a chiykhyi.
A cie thesapa napuv hne ing kha chunglie awpa laata ca, thlungkhuv cung a kiyta lie awpa na a pha vie.
Ruo luohlaapuv taata thyipa thuohlaa phapa ca, a tiy a hriepa cuota tiy cakaapa haa tana a cuo.
Cawsaa pha lipa hya a pazang satuv aa dangpa ca, a pahnangpa tiyhnaa acuolikie a pyalyipa acaa haa tana a cuo.
Khyitiy a hluv tuv ningpa ca pha vyi, cahaacata pa-uvsathyina hmung khing tuvpa zaw pha vyi.
Ama hne ama a uv khu lipa ca, a dungkhuo cing diypa khypuv hne tana aa lu.
Cuovuo ningta a tlapa cahue hne, sa hrie cuo ningta a saapa khytiy haata Pa-uvsathyina ca a ngaapa hneta a tla vyi.
A kawluo aw li pata chiesapa ca aa zu malapa mingbaw haata hne aa zu byalyapa chiyvie haata, chiesapa cung luo kha tlung the vyi.
Asung ca aruo huo cuo te, hmyakhe ca laa huota a cuo, cahaacata sungpe ca a ngaapa ke cuo tana a cuo.
A ngaapa ca a ngaana haata bie vielie khah, na vielie kieca nama hrahring khana a ngaapa ta a cuo'a ciy.
A ngaapa kha a ngaana haata bie va palie tie, na palie li kieca ama hne ama khana a singpa ta aa ri aa.
A ngaapa kha biephyatuv ta a hmuopa ca, ama hne ama a phyi a thlipa hne tuechiena a hrypa hne tana aa lu.
A ngaapa pakaa lie phungthluvbie ca, a phyi pakyapa paa phyi aa pathlie cakhawpa haa tana a cuo.
A ngaapa pa-uvsathyipa ca, cisie lie alung ciypuopa hne tana aa lu.
A ngaapa pakaa lie phungthluvbie ca, sahmaa a pariypa ta a kuv lie ahling cakhyi aa zuepa hne tana aa lu.
A ngaapa hne a pariypa rehrie a changpa ca, a hmungpa bangkhuo hmaa a paphyapa liykatuv hne tana aa lu.
A ngaanapa a kaachiy pakhaa lawmawpa a ngaapa ca, a paliy a ning pakhaapa uv hne tana aa lu.
Ama hne ama ta i sing a tapa laata ca, a ngaapa cuo tana anguopuona a aw vie.
A thaathiypa ta, “Luopuv liena chingde a aw! Ale liena chingde a aw!” a ta.
Cawsaa thaathiypa ca ingchiypakaa a kaazaa lie aa pahiepa haata, a iehmang cungliena aa pahlang pari.
Cawsaa thaathiypa ca pakaa chunglie sa kha a kuv ta la pata, a pakaa luo a tuv riypa hmuo a thaa hang vyi.
Cawsaa thaathiypa ca, ruepacuo pata bie a palie thepa mingsing pasariy laata, a sing viepa tana aa ri.
Malie tie amaa hruna lie vaa thla rapa ca, a cakuolepa uv naakue vaa dapa hne tana aa lu.
A ingpaa kha dung te, “Se na ica sung,” a tapa ca, myi iepa hne cuoti ta cawsaa a kapa hne tana amaa lu.
Thing a aw li kieca myi ca a thiy, a paruv ta malie kaw a rituv ama aw li kieca ahruna a die.
Myihyi ta myi kha sekhala khata pa-ie sa te thing ta myi a pahlaa sapa haata, cawsaa pha lipa ta ahruna a chiykhyi.
A paruv ta malie kaw ripa ca pahuo hringhruo te, ma chung luo kha aa ngie bung.
Alyi bi kha ngu ama pakhuvpa haata, a pahniepa hmya ta a pha lipa pathiypalung kha a buvkhung.
Cariepa ca bie phapa ri pakhi te, a palung chunglie ca dungviena na a aw.
Cariepa ca khing hne tlechuo aa chiysa pata bie a ri raalaa pata, va zang khah, a chungliena duv aa chiypa hmang suosariy a vyi.
Huena a hnyipa kha hang te a nu zaw ta, zaapuv ahmyana lie kha aa luo aa.
Malie tlana riypata khue a cupa ca capa chung luo cana a tla aa, malie alung a paliesuepa ca ama na aa liesue aa.
A hangpa palyi ca ama ta a dungpa tie kha a hue yi, malie a pata thepa pakaa ca rana na a chiykhyi.
Mawluo kawlie kha a pale khah, ning kha chunglieta khaapama a vya cuo aa tapa kha pachang vaciy.
Nama hne nama kha a pathuosa khah, malie acuolikie khyche ta ca pathuosa yi se.
Alung ca a riy te viehnang ca a cyi a tlie, cuorasala a ngaapa hihaana ca capa suohning laa cata aa riy vie.
Hihaana hne pathiylingna ca a chiehruv ciemuo, cuorasala malie hietlienapa ca a chiehruv vie.
Nupa duenapa laata a luohuo ta chuopa a pha vie.
Ma viesaa ta hmaa malie a paphya pathlyi zawta ma cuota phana ama khing nakaw cuo te, cuorasala carie ta malie a pahnuopa ca malie a raw khing nakaw tana a cuo.
A rue me a nguopa ca khyitiy kha hmuo siysaa ri va tli, cuorasala a nang a diysapa ca a khapa kha hmuo a thlungpa tana a ri.
A ing taata a viepa cawsaa ca a buv taata a viepa pavaa hne tana aa lu.
Ziyhmyi hne rangpa-uetiy ta palung a patluo sa, cuorasala ruvnaana ta hringna kha a para taw.
Na viesaa acuolikie na paa viesaa kha thaw khah, vuochina naa taw ningta na tieriy ing luo cakuo khah. Maa thaalie a awpa viesaa ca luohlaa luo a awpa tieriy laata a pha vie.
Vya i saata, singvaasa la i palung na patluo tie, tahematapakieca sue naa phawpa kha bie palie khu naase yi ang.
A singpa ca aa nupa ruvnaana kha hmung the te, cuorasala a ruena a cawpa ta ca sisue te ruvnaana a ang.
A pachang lipa hne ruohrang ming cuota biekuona a tuepa ca a biekuona cuo khata bie aa kuopa chechiy kha patuvpa tie ung.
Mawdiy ta thu te, khuosa ta khi te a ingpaa kha thluechiy a pipa ca, chiesapa haa tana ripa pata a cuo aa.
A cie paripa napuv ca, khyne ningta a saa byalyapa khytiy hne tana aa lu;
capa nung padie sa riypa ca thliy padie sa riypa hne a lu te, cacuoluo kuvpazaa ta chiytiy cahuvpa haa tana a cuo.
Thaa ta thaa kha a cahre sa, cawsaa zaw ta cawsaa hrangpa singna kha a cahre sa ra.
Thyikuv kung a mangchiytuv ca a thyi ce riypa hnyi te, a ziypaapa a mangchiytuv zaw pa-uvsathyina a hmung aa.
Tiy chunglie hmie aa luopa haata, cawsaa pakha pathiypalung ca a hmiephya liena aa luo.
Shoel hne Abaddon ca aa de buo ta the va yi, cawsaapa ming zaw ta aa de buo ta the vyi.
Siy hne ngu ca sumyi ta khuosa ta dyapasya pata a cuo, cahaacata cawsaa hing pathuosana ta dyapasya khu pata a cuo.
A ngaapa ca suosuvpa haa khata sungcuo lie kha sungkhe ta suvpuo hmuo rala, a ngaanapa ca thaw the'a vyi.
Na tuvrung a awtuvzya kha a phasa pata pachang la, na cue zaw kha a phasa pata mangchiy tie;
tahematapakieca hnyirungna ca chuozaa ta a hmang vyi, byilakhuv zaw chuo bangkhuo cuota cuo vyi.
Aphuv a thiy tiyta kuotyi a kya ka, tluocung lie aphuv zaw ca pakhawpa a cuo tiyta,
tuvtaata tah na cawsie kha ca ring'a te, mie ta na lu muo kha aca ring aa;
mie ahnungtiy ca nama hne na ingchungkhue dang riypa hne, na changtaanung zaw dang riypata acaa de'a yi.
Cawsaa pha lipa ca ahungtahmuo amaa cade li pata a ruo te, cuorasala aa dangpa tie ca chingde haata ama rie a pha.
Ruo chunglie a duna a aw tiyta, uvtuv a hluvsa ama aw; cuorasala pachangkhuna a hnyipa uvtuv ta luo a chiypa ruo ca cahra te a pasiypuv aa hmang.
Siypasa tie a hrisaapa uvtuv ca sakung a thie diypa khytiy chiepa hne tana aa lu.
Phungbie a ziy lipa tie ta cawsaa pha lipa kha pathuosa yi te, cuorasala phungbie a ziypa tie ta cawsaa pha lipa kha amaa du.
Cawsaa chiepa ca biedangpa kha pachang vyi, cuorasala Abyipakha a huvpa ta ca a tlingsa pata a pachang.
Aa dangta tah hring pata siypasapa ca hmang pha lipa hrie pata hnyirungpa laata a pha vie.
Phungbie a ziypa ca a singpa saata tah cuo yi te, cuorasala a ningbaapa hneta a khepa saata ca nungpaa nangzaana tana ama cuo.
A hlyi ta amie ning te a hnyirungpa ca siypasa tie kaw a pacuopa cuo tana a pacung.
Phungbie kha naathlie li pata a awpa a thlaachuona ca duv na a chiy.
Cawsaa phapa kha luo chiepa luo a chiypa tie ca iema ama cupa khue luo khana ama tla aa, cuorasala syisaa riy a hnyi lipa tie ca, ru phapa na ama cu aa.
A hnyirungpa tie ca ma sing ta pata amaa rue, cuorasala pachangkhuna a hnyipa siypasapa ta ca a cuonapa kha aa pachang.
Aa dangpa ta tena a hmungpa ca rungnaa hringhruo te, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa ta tena a hmung kieca cawsaa kha amaa nu.
A tuesuena kha a nupa ca hluetlingna hmung the'a vyi, cuorasala a suena kha phu te a thawpa ca nangduena a hmung aa.
Abyipakha a ciyzaa paripa ca thluechiypa tana a cuo, cuorasala a palung a cuokaruvpa ca vuochina chung luo na a tla aa.
Siypasa tie a uvpa uvtuv pha lipa ca a nang diypa chingde hne sa a huvlepa cavaw hne tana aa lu.
Pachangkhuna a hnyi lipa uvtuv ca hrisaatuv ta cuo te, cuorasala aa hmuo lipa taata hmungpa kha a huepa ca a chuo a pasiy aa.
Cawsaa thiyse a palangpa ca a thiyna te ta a ruole sala a nule pari se, ahungtahmuo thlu khah yi se.
Hmangdangpa lie a sipa ca a bang'a te, cuorasala zyatena luo lie a sipa ca khue chung luo na a tla aa.
Lu thlu te a maapa ca a kung vyi'a te, cuorasala a thlahne lipa re lie a vie cakhawpa ca a dawchie aa.
Zang tluo aa tlapa ca thluechiy a hluvsa hmung'a te, cuorasala a catli pata hnyirung a zuepa ca duotena kha ang li pata aw'a vyi.
Pahlyipalena hnyipa ca pha vyi, cadyiseca viechuo te kha kawlieta cawsaa ta hmang pha lipa kha ama tue.
A pasiysapa ca hnyirung riypa kha aa pahraa, cuorasala a sungna na naa tlungsue aa tapa kha pachang vyi.
A pakaa ta malie a patapa laata ca malie a chuopa khana a hnang taata due a hlue vie yi.
A nung hne a paa chechiy hruohra ta la te, “Suena cuo vyi,” a tapa ca aparuvpa viesaa tana a cuo.
A karuo awpa ca ahruna kha chiykhyi te, cuorasala Abyipakha a ringchuopa ca a hnyirung aa.
Ama ruenapa dyi a ringchuopa ca a ngaapa tana a cuo, cuorasala singna luo a ziypa ca amaa bang.
Siypasa tie kha a pi a hluopa ca a vuo a suo buo'a vyi, cuorasala a hmung li hruo a cuopa ca chiesana na a ang aa.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ta tena ama hmung kieca cawsaa kha a nu yi te, cuorasala ama ra kieca aa dangpa tie kha ama pungzaa.
Pasiypa-ya kyry ta a palung a lepa ca, tluo khu li tlina te tana sungkha ta a tlipachung aa.
Aa dangpa tie ta ruo ama uv tiyta cawsaa palung tluo te, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa tie ta ruo ama uv tiyta, cawsaa kha amaa hrung.
Singna a khingpa saata tah nungpaa palung kha patluo te, siyhrawnung hne a viesaapa ca a suethiy khana a pavie patlaa.
Siepahruo ca adangna ta ruo kha pacu sa te, cuorasala a karuo aw te nawthuv a ningpa ta ruo kha a para.
A ingpaa kha a patapa ca a ingpaa tie phyi khana asue a re khuo.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie tuesuena lie ca cyihyi aw te, cuorasala aa dangpa tie ca hlaa sa yi te ama palung a tluo.
Aa dangpa tie ta khaapa kha ma siypasa tie cuvu ta a cuo tapa kha pachang yi te, cawsaa pha lipa tie ca cahaapa ruena ca hnyi va yi.
Malie siysaa a ri lipa tie ta khypuv kha myi ta pahlaa yi te, a singpa tie ta cawsaa pathiylingna kha ama padie.
A singpa ta a ngaapa kha lyi bie rina luo a chiykhyi kieca, hihaana hne pahnyisuena dyi aw'a te diena aw'a vyi.
Thiyse a palang khingpa tie ca risie riy a aw lipa tie kha hue yi te, cawsaa phapa tie hringna kha hie ama tlie.
A ngaapa ta a hihaana kha sungkha ta paluo sa te, cuorasala a singpa ta ca a ang te a dieta tah a aw.
Uvtuv ta hangbie kha aa ngie kieca, a kuv raw rehrietuv bangkhuo ca cawsaa pha lipa ta ama cuo aa.
Siypasa tie hne iema a tuechietuv tie ta aa lupa ta ama hnyipa ca: Abyipata hmungna riypata ming a pi kaluopa yi hing tana a cuo.
Siepahruo ta siypasa tie bie zaw kha aa nguo pata a ripa kie yi ca, a uvna ca chuozaa ta aa hmang aa.
Sungpe hne pasiypa-yana ta singna malie pi te, cuorasala pathlie cakhawpa saata tah a nung kha a nang a pazaa.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie uvna chunglie ama aw tiyta tuesuena a cha te, cuorasala aa dangpa tie ta iema ama tlabungpa kha ama hmung aa.
Na saata kha pasiypa-ya la hnaanguona hne palungtluona aca pi aa.
Khazing luochiyna a aw lina lie ca cawsaa kha a cadangna hnyi li pata khysa yi te, cuorasala phungbie a ziypa tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo.
Changtaapa ca bie dyi ta hringzya chang khupa cuo vyi, ama pachang thluo raalaa pata siysaa ri'a va yi.
Rue taa li pata bie a ripa laata ca, a ngaapa cuo tana anguopuona a aw vie.
A cawta baataata a nang ziy paripa sii ca, a chuona lie ca na hnyipa khana aca chuv diy aa.
A hi a haa thepa ta a hru a ina kha chiykhyi te, a pathiy pachangpa ta tuesuena a hluvsa a chiykhyi.
Cawsaa hing a hruotlena ta mangbungpa pacuo sa te, cuorasala malie raw a canawpa ca pa-uvsathyina na a hmung aa.
Aparuvpa a khepa ca ama hne ama hringna a huepa tana a cuo, chie a sa pata bie aa kuo raalaa pata biedangpa kha paluo sa vyi.
Cawsaa ciynapa ca cyihyi a thla khuopa haa tana a cuo, cuorasala Abyipaa ringchuopa ca abangna a hmung aa.
Cawsaa hluvpuv ta uvtuv hmiephaa kha ama hmung khing, cuorasala cawsaa ca Abyipa'a taa tana biedangpa kha a hmung.
Aa dang lipa tie kha aa dangpa tie ta duvsa yi te, aa dangpa tie kha aa dang lipa tie ta ama duvsa ra.
Jakeh sacapaa Agur ripa bie. Biephu. Cawsaapa ca ta a ri: I thaa na a buo, Vya Khazing, I thaa na a buo, Vya Khazing. Tuokhaatama i te khu aa?
Cawsaa cuo a tla va ang; cawsaa pachangnapa hnyi va ang.
Singna zaa cuv va ang, a pathepa thesingna zaw hnyi va ang.

Ahungma vuoruo luo kie te zaa cung pakhaa buo? Ahungma a kuvpazaa lie thliy a cahuv the? Ahungma a pang ta tiy a vyi the? Chuelyi kiy zaw kha ahungma a pacu sa? Capa paa ming ca ahungma? Capa paa a sacapaa ming haw ahungma? Na pachang tange ma?
Khazing bie bangkhuo ca aa hmuo; ama'a lie a canawpa tie cuota amaa pakhuona phya tana a cuo.
Hingpa bie hing be chiy khah, ca chuo'a tena a hangpa na cuopa kha aa luo aa.
Hmang suohning na icaa hie; I thiy hluota na bu thi lie ciy:
Hanghiena hne dungviena hing kama'a taa hingta luohlaa luo na thawpa thi tie, siypasa tuv pata hne hnyirung tuv pata na chi khah; i cuota aa hupa sa kha na pi tie,
acuolikie ca a hluv tuv hnyi'a angte na, “Abyipaca ahungma?” ta'a angte ica thaw pathlyi aa. I siy a pasa tuv hyi kieca paruv'a angte, i Khazing ming kha i papyapalyi pathlyi aa.
Changtaapa kha a ziypaapa hmielieta va caw-yi khah, changtaapa ta chie ca sa'a tena muo na phu aa.
Ama paa kha chiesa yi te, ama nung thluechiy a pi the lipa ama aw.
Iema amaa hmungna lieta i pathe a tapa aw yi te, cuorasala ama pyalyina taata a pathe sa lipa ama aw.
Iema hne iema kha i desa ta pata a rue yi te, aa suosa ta a mangpa ama aw hyi!
Ama haa ca zueziy haata hne cizung haata ta te, siypasa tie kha alyi taa hingta cuose, vuosuopa tie kha a hringpa tie chung taa hingta cuose, ce diy riypata a awpa zaw ama aw.
Cava ta sacanung pahning hnyi te, “Na pi, na pi,” ta pata ama khi. A rue a ciing the lipa hmang suothung ama aw; “Aa de tli,” a ta buo lipa hmang suopaliy ama aw:
Sheol, a cingnung chiy, tiy dyi a khingpa alyi, “Aa de tli,” a ta the lipa myi ta ama cuo.
A paa kha a pahnyisuepa hne a nung kha mangbung te a esepa ca a ming kha bawphie ra-aa ta thue'a yi te luotaa ta ama ning aa.
I cuota kharuehaa aa chiysapa hmang suothung aw te, i pachang lipa hmang suopaliy a aw:
Avuo lie hmungthlu a sinapa luopuv, alung cunglie pariy aa thiylenapa luopuv, riyliy cunglie a sipa tiypalaw luopuv hne, capaa ta lesaa hne ama sinapa luopuv ta ama cuo.
Siyhrawnung luopuv ca hing haa hing tana a cuo: a ning khutaata a hmya kha a hruv te, “Suena khaapahmuo tue va ang,” a ta.
Chuelyi ta aa cathangkhyipa hmang suothung aw te, a ang khu lipa hmang suopaliy a aw:
Sii ta siepahruo a kya cuopa, a khing thiy ta ning riy a hnyipa a ngaapa,
due aa chiy li pata navaa a hnyipa canung, a ziynungnung ru a cupa changtaanung zaw hingta ama cuo.
Alyi cunglie hing a taasapa hmang suopaliy ama aw, cadyiseca ama sing hringhruo:
Thaa cahrapa a cuo li raalaa pata, cuovuo chung ta sa a pacungpa hninghnaa;
cahrana a hnyipa a cuo li raalaa pata, alung karaw lie ing a tuepa savi,
siepahruo a ma hnyi li raalaa pata, a phuv a phuv ta a sipa khawbyapa,
kuvpazaa lie cahuv khupa a cuo raalaa pata, siepahruo ing lie khy a sapa lilita zaw ta ama cuo.
Hmang suothung ca ama kyi hliy pa a ngiecuo ciemuo te, suopaliy ca ama cakuozya aa ngiecuo ciemuo:
Saruopa hrawlie a thaa ruv cepa hne khaapahmuo a ciy lipa chingde,
aa mangkhangsapa aakhawpa, mietungpa hne, a cawsaa zaw hrawlie aa ngie aa cuo ciemuo pata a cakuopa siepahruo zaw ta ama cuo.
Ngaa cate, nama hne nama kha a cyicalang cate, hmang pha lipa kha tue naa ting kieca, na pakaa kha na kuv ta a paping tie.
Tahematapakieca ahnungtiy kha cahryi byalyapa kieca thawpaat pya te, hnacabuv kha na phaw kieca thiy a pya, cahaacata cawsaa hi na pahaa kieca ahruna a pya.
Siepahruo Lemuel bie. A nung ta a pacuvpa:
Cuo vyi, i sacapaa! Cuo vyi, i sapa i sacapaa! Cuo vyi, i biekuona sacapaa!
Na thaazuo kha canung'a luo va pi khah, siepahruo tie a paratuv tie'a luo kha vaa pi khah.
Vya Lemuel, hingpa hing ca siepahruo tie cuota cuo vyi, mingsuvtiy ca siepahruo tie ta dang riypa cuo vyi, uvtuv tie ca zuvre dang riypata cuo vyi;
ama dang kieca biechina kha maw'a yi te, riethyivuosuopa tie cuvu khana ama para pathlyi aa.
A thiy'a nang tlipa tie kha zuvre ca pi ung la, a palung rie a thyisapa tie kha mingsuvtiy ca pi tie ung;
dang yi sala ama siypasana kha maw naase yi, ama palungriethyina kha a thyi li pata aw naase yi.
Iemata tah ama bie a ri khu lipa tie cuo khata ripa tie yi, siypasa tie cuvu cuo khata ripa tie yi.
Iema cuo khata ripa yi la aa dang pata bie kha chipa tie yi, siypasa tie hne riethyivuosuopa tie kha a daakhyi tie yi.
Ahungma napuv pha ca a hmung khu aa? Napuv pha ca lungvaa muo sungpa laa tana a muo a ruv vie.
A vaapa ta a palung chung ta a ringchuo te, a siy pasa buo'a vyi.
A napuvnung ca ta a hring chung bangkhuo a vaapa cuo khata chiena cuo li pata phana kha a tue.
Tuvhming hne palaa ta thaa thusa pata pang kha a taa.
Ama ca sung a palipa tie tiypalaw haa khata cuo te, luohlaapuv taata sa kha a vya phya.
A ingchungkhue tie cuota sa chang riypa hne, a changtaapa lesaa zaw re chang riypata, khydyi hluota a thu.
A phata tah rue te luruo kha a calyi; a hmung ciepa tuokaa ta mingsuv diedung kha a tue.
Thaathusa pata hne temaasa pata re kha a hrie.
A rehriepa kha muo a hnyisa tapa pachang te, zuo ta a myi-ing kha thiy buo vyi.
Amata tah palaa kha thlue te, amata tah pang kha a taa.
Siypasa tie'a luo kha pahyasa te, riethyivuosuopa tie kha aa bya yi.
Cahue a tla tiyta a ingchungkhue tie cuota a palung rie thyi vyi, tahematapakieca a ingchungkhue tie ca caw lungpa kha amaa hryi diy.
Ama hrahring ta pangphaabuv kha taa te, palaa phapa ta taapa a ciycaapa caw kha aa tue.
A navaapa ca ruo chung uvthyi tie hne amaa tu pakhaw tiyta, zaapuv pachangpa pakha ta a cuo.
Palaa phapa ta caw kha taa te tesaw zaw kha tue te, sung a palipa tie'a luo kha a zaa.
Ama ca a cahrapa hne pa-uvsathyipa cuo te, a vaw riypa cuo kawlie a palung rie thyi vyi.
Singna cangta bie ri te, kawpacuona bie kha a pakaa taata a pya.
A ingchungkhue kha a phasa pata mangchiy te, thaathuvna sa kha ning buo vyi.
A saata zaw ta thluechiy nung ta yi te, a navaapa zaw ta pathuosa te:
“Napuv pha a hluvsa ama aw, cuorasala nama na a law diy yi ciy,” a ta.
Khing a chiyna hing malie dung the te, puvthena zaw a lang the, cuorasala Abyipaa ciyzaapa canung ca pathuosa aa tlapa tana a cuo.
A kuv ta a tuehriepa re kawlie kha pa-uvsathyi ung la, zaapuv hmielie kha pathuosa tie ung.
David sacapaa, Jerusalem lie siepahruo a cuopa phungrituv bie:
A hrihripa se, a hrihripa se! zezaw bangkhuo hing a hrihripa se tana a cuo, ta pata Phungrituv ta a ta.
Cawsaa hingta ningsaa rawlie a hriepa bangkhuo taata khaapa thlahnena ma a hmung?
Chuo kha ca khung te, a hrangpa chuo kha aa vaw, cuorasala alyi ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.
Ning ca chiy te a tla, cakhutaata a chiyna luo kha kaa te a kya chiy pakhaa.
Thliy ca sungluo ta aa hruo, cakhutaata chaluo ta aa kya hruo pakhaa; cahlungle cahlungle te, aa hruo ciena luo kha a kaa pakhaa.
Cavaa bangkhuo ca riyliy chung luo ama lang, cuorasala riyliy ca bi vyi; cavaa ca aa thuna luo kha kaa pakhaa te, a lang tawpa haata a lang pazue.
Zezaw bangkhuo hing thaabuo zungbuo na a chiysa, cawsaa pakaa ta ri khu'a pata cuo vyi; ming ta hmung ngiemang vyi, naa ta thyi ngiemang vyi.
Zaa cuo ciepa khana a cuo pakhaa aa, za tue ciepa khana tue riypata a cuo thluo hyi aa; alyi cunglie hing a thaapa suokha hmuo aw vyi.
“Mang tie, a thaapa ta a cuo hing,” ta riypa a aw ma? Kiema chuo hluota zaa aw ciepa se tana a cuo.
Hluo chuo cawsaa kha a thyi pata cuo va tli yi, ata chuo cawsaa zaw hing iema hnang taata a puvpa chuotliepa tie ta a thyi pachaa hyi'a va yi.
Kama Phungrituv Jerusalem lie Israel ming siepahruo i cuo ningta,
vuoruotyi lieta ama tuepa bangkhuo hing singna ta huv pata pachang riypata palungruv i hnyi; Khazing ta cawsaa zaw cunglie hmang a khangpa hing palung tluokhyi a chiy vyi.
Vuoruotyi lie ama tuepa bangkhuo hing hmung angte, a bangkhuo hingta a hrihripa se ta cuo te thliy a cadepa haa tana a cuo.
Aa kyipa ca padang khu pata cuo vyi, a aw lipa ca ri khu pata cuo vyi.
Kama hne kama kha, “Kama hluota Jerusalem zaa uvpa tie bangkhuo laata i sing vie karaa; singna hne pachangna hing khaapatama a cuo tapa kha i pachang,” i ta.
Cakhutaata singna hne ngaana hne ruena cawpa cuona kha pachang i zue. Hingpa zaw hing thliy a cadepa haa tana a cuo ngiethie tapa kha i pachang.
Tahematapakieca singna a hluv vie kie palungriethyina a hluv vie; pachangna a hluv vie kie ngiechina a hluv vie.
Kama hne kama kha, “Ata hingta a vaw la a nuo pachiy'a ang; namata tah a nuo pachiy tie,” i ta. Cuorasala hingpa zaw hing a hrihripa tana a cuo ngiethie.
Pahnyina hing “Ngaapa tana a cuo,” ta angte a nuopa zaw hing “Khaapama a thlahne aa,” i ta.

I pangpa hing mingsuvtiy ta palaw sa a zue angte, ngaana zaw i tue; i pathiypalung ta ca singna ta luo inaa chiy thluo. Cawsaa ta chuelyi cunglie cuo pachangta a aw chung ta a tue khupa hmang pha cepa hing khaapatama a cuo aa tapa kha i pachang khing.
Re lesapa zaw kha i palang, ing zaw kha sa angte i cuota mingsuv diedung zaw i tue.
Diedung zaw a tue angte, a pahyna diedung zaw kha i tue, cakhutaata capa chunglie ca thingthyi-uothyi phangting kha i ling.
A lethawpa thingkung zaw tiy byana riypata tiy-ang i tue.
Siicanung siicapaa zaw kha calyi angte, i ingchungkhue lieta a puvpa sii zaw i hnyi yi; kama hluota Jerusalem lie zaa awpa tie bangkhuo laa khata cuerung hne tuvrung zaw kha a hluv vie karaa i hnyi.
Cakhutaata i uvpa tie ruo siepahruo tie suethiy chung taa khata siy hne ngu kha i pakhaw; hlaasatuv canung capaa ta hnyi yi angte, saapa ta a khing thepa tie, hne nungthang a hluvsa zaw kha i hnyi.
Caacuonakawta kama hluota Jerusalem lie zaa awpa bangkhuo laa khata le vie angte i law diy yi; singna kha i hnyipuo hyi.
I ming ta hmung te a khingpa mekaa kha i tue; anuona kha a cadang va ang, i tuepa bangkhuo lie kha anuona hnyi angte capa ca i lawmuo tana a cuo.
Cakhutaata cuo pachuo ciemuo pata i kuv ta a tuepa bangkhuo kha i rue tiyta, hingpa bangkhuo hing a hrihripa hne thliy a cadepa haata cuo te, thlahnena khaapahmuo hnyi vyi.

Caacuonakawta singna, palung a kylina hne ngaana kaw kha i rue pakhaa; tahematapakieca a hnang taata a vawpa siepahruo ta a tue khupa ca ama hluota a awpa siepahruo tie ama tue ciepa kha tana a cuo thluo.
Cakhutaata singna ca ngaana laata pha vie te, khena ca zingna laata a pha vie tapa kha i hmung.
A singpa tie ca ama luv lie ming ama hnyi, cuorasala a ngaapa ca zingna chunglie khana ama cakuo. Cadyiseca iema bangkhuo ca ta aa lupa suokha na amaa taw aa tapa kha i pachang.

Cakhutaa cata kama hne kama kha, “A ngaapa'a lie a tlungpa kha kama cunglie zaw a tlung ra aa; i sing ciemuopa hing khaapa thlahnena ma a aw hlyi?” i ta. Cakhutaata kama hne kama kha, ‘Hingpa zaw hing a hrihripa,’ i ta.
A singpa a cuo zaw, a ngaapa a cuo zaw ahungtahmuo a thyi pari va yi, a vaw riypa cuo lie ca a bangkhuo hingta maw diy pata na ama cuo aa. Tuokhaatama a singpa ca a ngaapa tie haata a thiy thluo aa?
Caacuonakawta hringna hing i hue, tahematapakieca vuoruotyi lieta a cuopa hmang hing i cuota a ang na a ruvsa; zezaw bangkhuo hing a hrihripa hne thliy a cadepa haa tana a cuo.
Ning rawlieta i tuepa i re bangkhuo hing i hue, kama khutaata a vaw riypa tie cuo tana i thuse aa tapa kha i pachang.

Cakhutaata iema ca ama sing'a ma ama ngaa'a ma tapa kha ahungma a pachang? Iema ca ta i singna hmuo angte ning rawlie i hriepa bangkhuo cunglie kha byi ama cuo thluo aa. Hingpa zaw hing a hrihripa ngiethie tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta ning rawlieta i hriepa re bangkhuo kawlie khata i palung a rasa,

tahematapakieca singna pachangna hne thena ta tuepa bangkhuo kha capa cuo ca ta a hrie bangby lipa cawsaa hrangpa anuona riypata thuse pata a cuo aa. Hingpa zaw hing a hrihripa ta cuo te, a pha li ciemuopa tana a cuo.
Cawsaa hingta a thaa zawdya pachiy pata ning rawlie a hriepa zaw taa hingta khaapa thlahnena ma a hmung?
Tahematapakieca ama ningkhue bangkhuo ca cuopasana ta bi te, ama hriepa re zaw palungriethyina tana a cuo; zuo ta hmuo ama palung kha a pahy buo vyi. Hingpa zaw hing a hrihripa tana a cuo.
Cawsaa cuota ca ning, dang, hne ama re lie a nuokhyipa laata a pha viepa aw vyi. Hingpa zaw hing Khazing kuv taa tana a cuo ta pata i hmung;
tahematapakieca ama li pata ahung ta ning khu te ma, ahung ta anuona a hmung khu?

Khazing ta ama a palung a patluopa kha singna hne pachangna hne anuona kha a pi; cuorasala a palung a patluopa pi riypa khata a suepa ca pahmya hne papung re kha a pi. Hingpa zaw hing a hrihripa hne thliy a cadepa haa tana a cuo ngiethie.
Zezaw mekaa cuo hingta cuo a aw kaluo, avuo rawlie a awpa hmang bangkhuo cuo hingta cuo a aw:
Puv cuo aw te, thiy cuo a aw; aling cuo aw te, phie cuo a aw;
thie cuo aw te, patluo sa cuo a aw; phi cuo aw te sa cuo a aw;
caa cuo aw te, pahnyi cuo a aw; muochiesa cuo aw te, luo cuo a aw;
alung thaw cuo aw te, alung pahmya cuo a aw; a cakuv cuo aw te, a cakuv li cuo a aw;
huv cuo aw te, pavie cuo a aw; cake cuo aw te, thaw cuo a aw;
thlaachi cuo aw te, bie cuo a aw; a dieta tah aw cuo aw te, bie ri cuo a aw;
a due cuo aw te, a hue cuo a aw; a du cuo aw te, a re cuo a aw.
Rehrietuv tie ta ama re taata khaapama ama hmung?
Khazing ta cawsaa bangkhuo hing hrie riypa re malie a pipa kha i pachang.

Ama ta zezaw mekaa hing a cuo hne aa tla pata a sa; ca hlyitaw taata ama pathiypalung lie kha a chuo ciepa hne a vya chiy riypa pachangna kha chi te, cadyiseca Khazing ta a hruothu taata a chuona te a tuepa hmang kha hmung khu va yi.
Iema cuota ama hring chung bangkhuo a law riypa hne a nuo riypa laa hingta a pha viepa aw vyi tapa kha i pachang;
ca hlyitaw taata, cawsaa bangkhuo ta ning, dang, hne ama re a nuokhyi riypa khana Khazing lasaw ta a cuo.
Khazing ta a tuepa bangkhuo ca chuozaa ta aa hmang tapa kha i pachang; bechiy riy aw vyi, thaw buo riy aw vyi; ama hmiekunglie nang-uo pata ama aw diy riypata Khazing tuepa tana a cuo. Caacuonakawta
Ata lie a awpa hing zaa aw ciepa kha tana ama cuo; a vya aw riypa zaw hing zaa aw ciepa kha tana a cuo ngiethie; Khazing na a aw ciepa kha a pa-aw sa pakhaa pari.
Ca hlyitaw taata ning rawlie bieripana hmang lieta pha lina a awpa kha cuose, adangna hmang lieta pha lina a awpa kha cuose i hmung.
I palung chungta lieta, Khazing ta aa dangpa hne a pha lipa tie kha bieripana a hnyi'a yi, tahematapakieca ama ta hmangting bangkhuo hne re ting bangkhuo cuota cuo a chi, i ta.
I palung chungta lieta, Khazing na cawsaa hing saruopa hne tana namaa lu thluo ta pata a dyapasya yi ing, i ta.

Tahematapakieca cawsaa hne saruopa ama chuonapa ca aa lu thluo; pakha a thiypa haa khata, a hrangpa zaw a thiy ra. Ama bangkhuo ta huv hnyi kaluo yi te, cawsaa hing saruopa laata aa suo vienapa aw vyi; a bangkhuo hingta a hrihripa tana a cuo.
Ama bangkhuo ta suv kha luo ama si; ama bangkhuo ta alyi diypa taata ama cuo, alyi diypa luo kha ama kaa pakhaa diy.
Cawsaa thlaapa ca cungluo si te, saruopa thlaapa ca a rawluo alyi luo a sipa kha ahungma a pachang?

Caacuonakawta cawsaa bangkhuo ca ama re a nuokhyipa laa hingta a pha viepa aw vyi tapa kha i pachang, tahematapakieca capa ca a hrievu tana a cuo; iema hnang taa hingta khaapama a cuo aa tapa kha ahungma a pachang khu yi?

Cakhutaata ning rawlieta tuepa hrisaana kha i hmung pakhaa. Mang tie, hrisaapa tie mingthliy ca, ama hnaanguona a ripa pakha hmuo aw va yi. A hrisaatuv tie ca hmang tue khuna cahrana ama hnyi nakawta hrisaapa tie ca ama hnaanguona a ripa pakha hmuo aw va yi.
