Cakhutaata a thiypa tie kaw kha i rue, a thiy ciepa tie ca a hring kaliepa tie laata ama vuo a pha vie;
cuorasala iema pahning laata a vuo pha viepa tie ca a aw li liepa tie, ning rawlieta ama tuepa pha lina hing a hmung lipa tie tana ama cuo.

Cakhutaata re bangkhuo lieta rehriena bangkhuo hne thena bangkhuo hing pakha ta a hrangpa pakha hie a tliena taata a vawpa tana a cuo tapa kha i hmung. Capa zaw ca a hrihripa hne thliy a cadepa haa tana a cuo.
A ngaapa tie ta ama kuv kha a cakhiy yi te, iemata tah amaa para.
Kuvpazaa zung kha ta dyi hnyi pata a dieta tah awpa hing, kuv hra hning ta re hrie pata thliy a cadepa laata a pha vie, i ta.
Ning rawlieta a hrihripa i hmung pakhaa:

cawsaa pakha dyi ta khy a sapa tie, sacapaa li uvnu li pata a awpa tie; cuorasala re hrie pari te a hnyipa lieta a palung a tling khu buo lipa tie kha i hmung yi. “Ahung huota re hrie angte ma, aa nuo hmuo a nuo hmuo li pata i aw?” ta the va yi. Hingpa zaw hing a hrihripa hne a law aa chiy li ciemuopa tana a cuo.
Pahning ca pakha laata a pha vie, tahematapakieca ama re liena lawmuo phapa ama hmung.
Amaa lie kieca, pakha ta a hrangpa pakha kha a pathu aa; cuorasala ama se ta a awpa ca bawchie ciemuopa tana a cuo, aa lie tiyta byatuv hnyi vyi.
Cawsaa pahning amaa ziehne kieca ama nangkhy a lung yi; cuorasala pakha dyi ta aa zie kie tuokhaatama a nangkhy a lung the aa?
Pakha dyipa a tepa carie kha pahning ta kieca amaa du khu aa. A chungchapa khuhriy ca ci khu paluo vyi.
Ruena pipa a la khing lipa a macuosapa a ngaapa siepahruo laata a siypasa te a singpa mingnu a pha vie.
A ruo chunglie siypasa pata a puvpa cuo ra mang sala, cawsaa pakha ca thaw-ing taata pya te siepahruo a cuo khu.
Ning rawlie a awpa a hringpa bangkhuo ta capa mingnu, siepahruo a thlepa hnang ama paziypa kha i hmung;
ama ta a uvpa cawsaa ca ri pata chuo khu va yi. Cuorasala a hnang ta a vawpa tie ta a cunglie ama palung tluo'a vyi. Hingpa zaw hing a hrihripa ta cuo te thliy a cadepa haa tana a cuo.

Biena-ing luo na cakuo ning kha a raaring tie; a ngaapa tie ta hriykhungrina ama pihluopa laata Khazing bie naathliepa kha a pha vie; tahematapakieca iema ca a pha lipa tuena taa khata tuokhaatama maa ve aa tapa kha pachang va yi.
Bie ri a pahraa khah, Khazing hmiekunglie bie ri riypata na pathiypalung caruo khah se; tahematapakieca Khazing ca vuoruo lie aw te, nama ca alyi lieta na aw; caacuonakawta na bie hluv khah se.
Khueruepa a hluv tiyta muo sa the pata a cuo, a ngaapa ta bie a hluvsa a ri.
Khazing'a lie bie naa kuo tiyta, patling sa kha palaw lie ciy; tahematapakieca ama ca angaapa zaw cunglie kha a palung tluo vyi. Na biekuona kha patling sa tie.
Bie a kuo cate na patling sa lipa laata ca bie a kuo li pata aw la a pha vie.

Na pakaa ta suena chung luo caa chiy khah se, biephyatuv hmiekunglie kha hingpa hing ca i ri chie ta pata ri khah; khaapanakawma na bie lieta Khazing a hi haa'a te na kuv ta na hriepa re kha a para aa?
Muo hluv tuvpa hne bie hluv tuvpa ta a hrihripa a chiykhyi; cuorasala Khazing kha ciy tie.

Ruo suokhakha lieta siypasa tie hrisaana hne biedangpa hne aa hmuopa a aw li tiyta; capa kawlie ca ta na kharue haa khah se; tahematapakieca byi lepa ca aa suo viepa byi ta mangchiy yi te, iema tie cunglie ca byi le viepa a aw kalie.
Alyi taata a pyapa ca cawsaa bangkhuo cuo tana a cuo. Siepahruo ta hmuo lelyi taata a pyapa thlahnena kha a hmung.
Tuokaa a khing tuvpa ca tuokaa lie a palung tling buo'a vyi; a hnyirung khingsapa zaw a hnyipa lieta a palung tling buo'a vyi. Hingpa zaw hing a hrihripa tana a cuo.
Hnyirung vie pata a cuo kie, a ningpa ama hluv vie aa; a hnyituv ta a ming ta a hmungpa ta li pata khaapa thlahnena ma a hmung?
Re a hriepa ca a cawta a ning zaw, a hluv a ning zawta a mingkuv a pahuo; cuorasala a hnyirungpa hnyirungna ca iema kha ama mingkuv pahuo sa vyi.
Ning rawlieta hmang pha lipa i hmungpa suokha ca: cawsaa ta iema a para riypata suethiy amaa pacungpa hingta a cuo,
capa ama hnyirungna ca hmang chiepa a taw yi te a vie diy; saata zaw nung paa ta ama cuo raalaa pata ama kuv chunglie khaapahmuo a tuo vyi.
Ama nung riy chungtaata ama thliehripa ta ama za puv ning haa kha tana ama thliehripa ta ama kaa pakhaa aa, ama rehrie muo khaapahmuo a phyale the'a va yi.
Hingpa zaw hing hmang pha lipa tana a cuo: aa vaw ning haa tana a kaa aa; thliy kha patuv riypata re a hriepa ta khaapa thlahnena ma a hmung aa?
Ca hlyitaw taata, ama chuo chung bangkhuo ta zingna chunglie kha sa ning yi te, palungriethyina hne pasapanaana hne palung tling lina ta khy ama sa.

A pha ta pata i hmungpa ca hingpa hingta a cuo: Cawsaa ta a pha cepa a tue khupa ca Khazing ta cuo pachangta a pipa chunglie hing ning dang pata a hriepa chungtaata a hmungpa kha aa nuokhyi riypa hingta a cuo. Capa ca a cuvu tana a cuo.

Cahaacata Khazing ta cawsaa bangkhuo kha hnyirungna hne chechiy, hne capa tie a nuokhyi thena riypa cuona a pi tiy yi ta, capa ama cuvu ca cuhluo pata ama re lie a nuokhyi riypa ca Khazing'a taata lasaw tana a cuo.
Khazing ta palung anuona a pi nakaw yi ta ama hringna kaw kha ama palung rie thyi laliy'a vyi.
Ning rawlieta a awpa cawsaa cunglie kha aa riysa pata a vypa a pha lipa suokha i hmung:

Khazing ta cawsaa pakhakha ca a khingpa suokha hmuo bu li riypata hnyirungna, chechiy, hne pa-uvsathyina a pi; cuorasala capa zaw hne cata a nuokhyi riypa kha pi li pata cawsaa hrangpa pakha ta aa nuokhyi. Hingpa hing a hrihripa tana a cuo; hmang pha lipa suokha tana a cuo.

Cawsaa pakha ca kung hluvsa hring te saata zakha hmuo hnyi ra sala a hring chunglie hmang phapa hne a nuo li pata, a thiy ningta hmuo pabytuv a hnyi li kieca, ama laata ca a thiy ciepa ta zaa puvpa khana a pha vie.
Tahematapakieca a thiy ciepa ta zaa puvpa ca thlahnena aw li pata zingna luo kha a si, cakhutaata a ming ca zingna ta a buvkhung;
ca hlyitaw taata ama ta ning kha hmung li pata khaapahmuo pachang vyi; cadyiseca a dingna cuo chuo ca a hmung.
Cawsaa pakhakha ca kung thawhning te a hring raalaa pata a hring aa nuo li kieca khaapama a thlahne? Cawsaa bangkhuo ta suv kha luo khana ama si diy thluo cuo va ma?
Cawsaa ta ma hriepa bangkhuo hing ma ning riy tana a cuo, cuorasala pakaa ta aa de tli se tapa hnyi vyi.
A singpa ca a ngaapa laata khaapa thlahnena ma a hmung vie? Cawsaa hmiekunglie tuokhaatama i aw aa tapa pachangna hing ta a siypasapa cawsaa ca khaapama a thlahne?
Ma khingpa a cadepa laata ming ta hmungpuopa lie hingna thlahnena a aw vie; hingpa zaw hing a hrihripa hne thliy a cadepa haa tana a cuo.

A vaw riypa hmang bangkhuo hing ming paphya ciepa selaw ta cuo te, cawsaapa hing tuokhaapa tana a cuo tapa kha pachang paciepa ta a cuo, cakhutaata ahunghmuota ama laata a thaa ruv viepa kha a du khu'a vyi.
Bie a hluv vie kie, a hrihripa a hluv hryly, tuokhaatama a pha viepa ca a aw the aa?

Caacuonakawta cawsaa cuota khaapama a pha tapa ca ningdiy haata a silepa a hrihripa ta a cuopa, ama hring pachangta chunglie hing ahungma a pachang aa? Ning rawlie hing ama thiy khutaata khaapama a vaw aa tapa kha ahungma a chang the'a yi?
Ming phapa hing a sungnaapa ziyhmyi laata a pha vyi, thiy ning hing puv ning laata a pha vie.
Riykung kiena ing luo cakuopa hing pyi tuena ing luo cakuopa laata a pha vie; tahematapakieca capa ca cawsaa mekaa cuota a chuona tana a cuo, a hringpa ta ca palungruv lie pari riypata a cuo.
Ngiechina hing palungtluona laata a pha vie, ngiechina hmiephya ta pathiypalung kha a palaw sa.
A singpa pathiypalung ca a thiypa ing lieta a aw, cuorasala a ngaapa pathiypalung ca pahnyisesungna ing liena a aw.
A singpa chuona ueryi thyipa ca, a ngaapa hlaa sana ueryi thyipa laata a pha vie.
A ngaapa pahnyina ueryi ca, bi rawlie ahling kung a kuopa pu hne tana aa lu, capa zaw ca a hrihripa tana a cuo.
Hrisaana ca a singpa kha a ngaapa ta tue te, nawthuv ta cawsaa pathiypalung kha a para.
Hmang a chuona hing a hruothuna laata a pha vie, palung pasiypa hing a palena laata a pha vie.
Na hi haa paluo khah se, tahematapakieca hihaana ca a ngaapa pathiypalung liena ing a tlung.
“Khaapanakawma hluo ning kha ata laa hingta a za pha vie?” ta khah, capa ca singna biehiehriyna ta cuo vyi.
Singna ca ru haata a pha pata cuo te, ning a hmungpa zaw cuota aa thungna tana a cuo.
Singna ta malie a vena ca tuokaa ta malie a vena tluv ta cuo te, pachangna a phana ca singna na a hnyituv kha hringna a pi tapa tana a cuo.
Khazing rehriepa hing pacuo tie; a pakyi tlipa kha ahungma a padang khu?

Phana na hmung cuo ning kha na palung tluo se, ruvnaana cuo lie kha khue rue tie; cawsaa ta iema khutaata a vya chiy riypa kha ama pachang li riypata Khazing ta pakha kha a sapa haata a hrangpa zaw kha a sa.

A hrihripa ta a cuopa i hring chunglie hing zezaw bangkhuo i hmung diy, aa dangpa cawsaa tie ta amaa dangna chunglie kha ama ra, a pha lipa cawsaa ta a pha lipa hmang ama tuena lie kha ama chuo a pasiy.
A dang zaw a dang tuv khah, sing tuv pata zaw re hrie khah; khaapanakawma nama hne nama kha naa para aa?
Pha li tuv hringhruo khah; a ngaapa zaw cuo khah; khaapanakawma na chuo cangkuv ta na thiy aa?
Hingpa hing naa patuv kieca a pha, a hrangpa zaw kha pathlie li pata; Khazing a ciypa ta na cuo kieca a suohning lieta na hlue a tling aa.
Uvtuv pahraa ta khy suokha cuota phana ama tuepa laata singna ta a singpa pakha cuota a tuepa na a hluv vie.
Suena tue buo li pata phana a tue paripa, aa dangpa cawsaa pakha hmuo hingpa chuelyi lie hing aw vyi.
Cawsaa ta ama ripa bangkhuo kha naathlie khah, na changtaapa ta chie aca sapa khana na thyi aa;
nama hrahring ta malie kha yi hluvpuv chie na sapa yi kha na pathiypalung ta a pachang.
Hingpa bangkhuo hing singna ta i dyapasya; kama ta, “I sing'a tli,” i ta, cuorasala singna ca kama hneta aa hlasa.
Capa ca aa hla, aa thuv, aa thuv hringhruo; ahungma a hmung khu aa?
Singna hne a phana kaw kha cuose, pha lina ca ruena cawpa a cuonazya hne a raaring lina ca ngaana a cuonazya kha pachang riypa hne huv pata hmung riypa kha bie i chi.

Thiyna laata a kha viepa hmang i hmungpa ca a pathiypalung kha cyihyi hne asue cuo te, a kuv kha thaa buoliriy ta a cuopa canung tana a cuo. Khazing a ciyzaapa ca ama'a taata law te, a suepa ca ama ta a patuv.
Phungrituv ta, mang tie hingpa hing i hmungpa ta a cuo, a chiycuona kha hmung riypata hmang suokha kha a hrangpa suokha hneta i pataw,
ata hne ata tah i huv, cuorasala hmung va ang. Capaa thawkha lie pakha i hmung, cuorasala hingpa bangkhuo taa hingta canung pakha hmuo hmung va ang.
Mang tie, hingpa dyi hingna i hmung, Khazing ta cawsaa hing aa dangpa ta a tue, cuorasala cawsaa ta ca tingna a phangphang hnyi pata hmang ama tue.
Ahungma a singpa haata a cuo? Hmang awzya kha ahungma a pachang? Singna ta cawsaa hmie kha pakhe sa te, minghmie chiepa kha a pathle sa.
A pathepa na biekuona kawlie khata siepahruo biekuona kha ziy tie.
Ciy khah; hmang awtuvzya a pha li kieca a hmiekung taa khata haasaa li pata pya tie, tahematapakieca siepahruo ca a khingpa mekaa kha a tue khu.
Tahematapakieca siepahruo bie ca hmang tue khuna hnyi te, ahungma, “Khaapama na tue?” a ta khu.
A naw pipa a ziypa mekaa ca ruvna a taw'a va yi, mingsing pathiypalung ta ca a cuo hne a luopuv kha a pachang aa.
Cawsaa riethyina ca ama cunglie aa riysa pata a laa raalaa pata hmang mekaa hingta a cuo hne a luopuv ama hnyi.
Hmisi ta kieca, iema ta khaapama a vya cuo aa tapa kha pachang va yi, tahematapakieca capa ca tuokhaa tana a vya cuo aa tapa kha iema ca ahungma a chang khu yi?
Ahungtahmuo thliy kha thlu khu riypata cahrana hnyi va yi, acuolikie thiyna ning cunglie kha cahrana hnyi va yi; rietuvna chungtaata law khuna aw vyi, pha lina ta a tuetuv tie kha palaw sa khu va yi.
Hingpa bangkhuo hing i hmung tli, ning rawlie tuepa bangkhuo hing i rue syalya. Cawsaa pakha ta a hmang tue khuna kha hmuo te a hrangpa pakha rana kha a tue.
Cakhutaata cawsaa pha lipa ama pabypa kha i hmung; cahaapa hmang ama tuenapa khypuv chung hmang pathepa lie ca iema ca a ngie yi pya yi te cawsaa ta ama pathuosa. Capa zaw ca a hrihripa tana a cuo.
Pha lina ama tuepa kawlie kha duo ama te paluo lawmaw li nakawta cawsaa ca pha lina tue riypa palung kha khuopuv ta ama hnyi.

A suepa tie ta a pha lipa kha yi zakha ama tue raalaa pata ama chuo a pasiy, cuorasala Khazing a ciyzaapa tie ta Khazing hmiekunglie kha ciyzaana hne ama aw nakawta ama cuota a pha tapa kha i pachang,
cuorasala a pha lipa tie ca Khazing hmiekunglie kha ciyzaana hne ama aw li nakawta ama cuota pha'a vyi, ningdiy a lupa ama hringna zaw pasiy'a vyi.

Alyi cunglie hmang a cuopa hing a hrihripa tana a cuo, aa dangpa cawsaa ta a pha lipa cawsaa tie ang riypa kha ang yi te, a pha lipa tie ta aa dangpa tie hmung riypa kha ama hmung. Hingpa zaw hing a hrihripa tana a cuo, i ta.

Caacuonakawta anuona kha i pathuosa, ning rawlieta a awpa cawsaa cuo hingta ca ning, dang, hne ama hne ama a nuo riypa laa hingta a pha viepa aw vyi, hingpa ning rawlie Khazing ta hringna a pi chunglie hingta re a hriena lie hing hingpa dyi hing muo a tue khupa ta a cuo ta, i ta.
Singna kha pachang riypata a zue angte, alyi cunglie ama tuepa rehriena kha pachang i zue tiyta, chung hne zuo ta a hmung li pata i aw,

cakhutaata ning rawlie a awpa ahungtahmuo ama hmung buo lipa Khazing rehriena bangkhuo kha i hmung. Kha tluv ta hmuo hmung riypata a zue ra yi sala hmung khu'a va yi; a singpa tie ta i pachang ta ra yi sala, capa ca hmung khu'a va yi.

Hingpa zaw bangkhuo hing i palung chunglie chi angte i rue, aa dangpa hne a singpa tie ama rehriena ca Khazing kuv cungliena a aw; capa ca duena ma huena ma tapa kha ahunghmuo pachang va yi. Iema amaa tawpa bangkhuo zaw hing

a hrihripa tana a cuo, tahematapakieca aa dangpa hne a zyatepa, a phapa hne a pha lipa, a pathepa hne a pathe lipa, hriykhung a ripa hne hriykhung a ri lipa bangkhuo cunglie hing aa lupa hmang na a tlung thluo. A phapa cunglie a tlungpa kha a suepa cunglie zaw a tlung, biekuona a tuepa cunglie a tlungpa kha biekuona a tue lipa cunglie zaw a tlung.

Ning rawlie a cuopa bangkhuo hing pha lina tana a cuo, tahematapakieca cawsaa bangkhuo cunglie hing aa lupa hmang na a tlung thluo. Ca hlyitaw taata, cawsaa bangkhuo pathiypalung lie hing pha lina tana a bi; ama hring chung khata ngaana ca ama pathiypalung lie aw te, cakhutaa cata ama thiy.
Cuorasala a hringpa bangkhuo hneta a pazuena a hnyipa ca anguopuona a hnyi, tahematapakieca a hringpa uv ca a thiypa chingde laata a pha vie.
A hringpa tie ta ma thiy aa tapa kha ama pachang, cuorasala a thiypa ca khaapahmuo pachang vyi; iema ca lawmuo hmung riypa khaapahmuo hnyi va tli yi, aa thyi hmuo a thyipa ta cuo va tli yi.
Iema duena hne huena hne hietliena ca a ra tli; ning rawlie a cuopa bangkhuo chunglie hing iema cuvu suokha hmuo aw va tli.
Cakuo la anuona hneta na sa kha ning tie, cakhutaata palungtluona hneta na mingsuvtiy kha dang tie; na tuepa bangkhuo ca Khazing naatlapa tana a cuo.
Na caw kha ruo pari se, na luv lie sathu huv buo khah se.

Ning rawlie nama aca pipa, a hrihripa ta a cuopa na hring chunglie hing na duepa na napuv hne khata aa nuosa pata hring tie ung, tahematapakieca capa ca na ning rawlie na hriepa bangkhuo taa hingta na cuvu ta a cuo.
Na kuv ta hrie riy a hmungpa mekaa kha a pha khu chungta hrie tie; tahematapakieca na sina riypa Sheol lie ca re, khueruena, pachangna, hne singna aw vyi.

Ning rawlie hing hmang suokha i hmung pakhaa: a ruo a zuena lie hing a lie a hy cepa ta tena hmung hlyi vyi, rietuvna lie zaw a cahrapa ta tena hmung pari vyi, a singpa dyi ta ning riy hnyi li pata, a lathliy a phapa dyi ta hnyirung vyi, thena a hnyipa dyi ta hmiephaa hmung li pata; cuorasala cuo hne athlena ca iema zaw bangkhuo cunglie kha a tlung ngiethie.

Tahematapakieca ahungtahmuo a thiyna riypa cuo kha pachanglu khu vyi. Asue lie a uopa ngaa haata hne cyihyi lie a uopa pavaa haata cawsaa zaw hing iema cunglieta sungkha ta a tlungpa rana lie kha amaa uo thluo.
Ning rawlieta singna a mangpuo aa tlanapa zaw kha hmung angte, kama cuota a biepuvsa ta pata i rue.
A chunglie cawsaa cawta dyi a awpa khypuv cawta suokha a za aw. A lesyipa siepahruo pakha ta a vaw te, riekhuocaaca lesapa kha sacahlung te a cadung.
Capa khy lie ca a siypasapa a singpa pakha aw te, ama ca ta a singna ta khypuv ca a khuo. Cuorasala ahungtahmuo capa siypasapa ca a thyi va yi.
Caacuonakawta, “Singna ca thaaruvna laata a pha vie; cuorasala a siypasapa singna ca siysaa ri li pata cuo te, a bie zaw naathlie pata cuo vyi.”
Uvtuv a cuopa ta a ngaapa zaw hrawlie a khipa ueryi laata, a singpa ta dyadyata tah a ripa ueryi kha naathlie vie pata a cuo.
Singna ca rietuvna cehre laata a pha vie, cuorasala pha lina a tuetuv pakha ta a phapa a hluvsa kha a para.
Mathu thiypa ta ziyhmyi kha a pathuv sa khu; ngaana a cawta tah singna hne pa-uvsathyina kha a para khu.
A singpa pathiypalung ca cacuoluo ta a si, cuorasala a ngaapa pathiypalung ca cavyiluo ta a si.
A ngaapa ca luopuv lie ama cakuo pata hmuo ruena hnyi lipa yi ta, cawsaa mekaa'a lie kha ama ngaana ama paluo sa.
Uvtuv byi ta na cunglie a hi a haa kieca, naa daahmang kha thuse khah; Tahematapakieca a dieta tah awna ta suena lepa kha a padie.
Ning rawlieta i hmungpa pha lina suokha aw te, capa ca uvtuv byi ta hmang a pacuo sapa ta a cuo:
a ngaapa tie kha aa suona hmang hluvsa lie a tu yi te, a hnyirungpa kha aa nena lieta amaa tu.
Sii ta aruo a khang yi te, byi ta sii haata ama phyi ta ama cakuopa kha i hmung.
Khue a cupa ca capa chung luo cana a tla aa; lungruetlepie kha a phaw pahawpa ca pariy na a daw aa.
Alung a cakhypa ca alung ta hmaa paphya'a te, thing a saapa ca thing ta ruvnaana a pi aa.
Ahryi a mya tiyta cata lipa kieca, thaazuo a hluv vie pachiy aa hu; cuorasala singna ta cawsaa pakha tena hmung riypa kha aa bya.
Pariy ta na pacuo hluota aca daw kieca, pacuo na thepa ca thlahnena aw vyi.
Mingsing tie ripa bie ta iema kha pa-uvsathyina a pi yi, cuorasala a ngaapa ca iema bie mamaapa ta a para yi.
Ama pakaa ta ama ripa bie ca ngaana ta patha te, ama bie ca a pha lipa ngaana ta a chuo;
cuorasala a ngaapa ca taw li pata bie kha a ri. Ahungtahmuo khaapama a vya cuo aa tapa kha pachang va yi, hmieluo thue khaapama a vya cuo aa tapa zaw kha ahungtahmuo ri khu vyi.
A ngaapa tie ca ama rehriena lieta ama mathle dyi a lyi yi, iema ca khypuv luo sinapa luopuv hmuota pachang va yi.
Na siepahruo ca haatiyta tah a cuo, naa byi tie kha maw ta pyi ama tue, cata a cuo kieca ruo cuota ca a ruv thluo!
Siepahruo ca a hringcuo phapa cuo te, byi tie ca ama'a na a cuota tah pyi tue yi te, pariy li pata thaazuo cuota dangzya a thepa ama cuo kieca, ruo cuota ca palung tluo aa chiy.
Thaathuvna kawlieta ing caw te, a zawkhawna kawlieta ing a zuv.
Alawna riypata pyi tue pata a cuo, mingsuvtiy ta cawsaa palung kha a panuo sa; tuokaa ta aa hupa mekaa kha a tue khu.

Siepahruo ca na palungruv ta hmuo chiesa khah, a hnyirungpa kha naa ziena khuo lieta hmuo chie sa khah; tahematapakieca avuo lie a zupa pavaa ta na ryi kha phyale'a te, aa zu thepa saruopa tie ta capa kaw ca ama ri aa.
Na viechuo kha tiy chung luo thaw tie, ning hluvpuv khutaata na hmung pakhaa aa.
Na hnyipa kha che sariy acuolikie che cari ta che tie, alyi lie hing tuokhaapa rana ma a tlung aa tapa pachang vaciy.
Amyi ca khytiy ta a bi tiyta, alyi luo khy a za saa; thingkung ca sungluo ta a pya zaw, chaluo ta a pya zaw, a pyana lie khana a laa thluo.
Thliy aa hruopa dyi a huopa ta ca saciy vaa buo hluo'a vyi, amyi dyi a mangpa ta ca sa hrie buo hluo'a vyi.
A nung riy chunglieta nuta ruv kha tuokhaatama a le tapa na pachang lipa haata, zezaw hmangting a tuetuv Khazing rehriena zaw kha pachang khu'a vaciy.
Maw ta saciy vaa la, zuoluo zaw ta vaa li pata aw khah; tahematapakieca a suohning lieta khaapa kha ma a pha aa, acuolikie a suohning tama a pha aa tapa kha pachang vaciy.
Khena ca a pha, ningsaa hmungpa hing a law aa chiy.
Kung pasiypuv a hringpa ta a hring chung bangkhuo kha a nuo se; cuorasala zingna cuo zaw a hluvsa aa tapa kha pachang se. A vaw riypa bangkhuo zaw hing a hrihripa tana a cuo.

A nuo tie, mingnu, mingnu na cuo ning hing, mingnu na cuo taning hing na palung a nuo se. Na palung khingpa hne na ming ta a hmung khingpa kha ziy tie, cuorasala capa zaw bangkhuo cuo khata Khazing ta bieripana aca hnyi aa tapa kha pachang tie.
Na palung chungtaata thlaazangna, hne na pangpa chungtaata pasana zaw kha thaw tie; tahematapakieca mingnu cuona hne thuthaw cuona hing a hrihripa tana a cuo.
Mingnu na cuo ning, “Hingpa zaw chunglie hing anuona hnyi khu va ang,” na tana kung zaw a vya chiy hluo, ruvnaana aa vaw hluo hingta caa satuv kha a thyi tie.
Ning hne khena hne thlaapa hne aasiy zaw zing yi te amyi kha khytiy hne a vya kaa hluo hingta.

Capa ning lie ca ing a huopa kha a cathang'a te, a thaaruvpa tie ca ama thaa a naa aa, cakhutaata suo a riepa canung kha ama caw nakawta re kha ama taw aa, thlaluo-aw taata hmiehmie a pasepa tie ta hmungpasie'a va yi.
Luopuv lie ingchiypakaa aa khaa tiyta hne sariena pu kha aa nele tiyta, cawsaa pakha ta pavaa a khipa kha thyi te a thu tiyta, hne hlaa a sapa lesaa tie ueryi aa nele tiyta;

cawsaa pakha ta aa suopa kha a ciy tiyta, hne ciy aa chiysapa kha luopuv chunglie a aw tiyta; almond kung kha paa te, khawbyapa kha a siypahriy te khingna palung kha aw khu va tli; tahematapakieca cawsaa bangkhuo ca ama chuozaa ing luo kha si'a yi te, muochie a sapa tie ca luopuv luo kha ama pya aa;
capa hluo cata ngu buoliriy kha a ci aa, siy kuotung kha a kyi aa, seku kha takhue lie a kyi aa, takhue lie tiy a danapa aa pahienapa kha a kyi aa;
cakhutaata alyi diypa ca a aw tawnapa alyi luo kha kaa'a te, hringna ca a pituv Khazing'a luo kha a kaa aa.
Phungrituv ta, a hrihripa selaw, a hrihripa selaw, a hrihripa selaw tana a cuo, a ta.
Phungrituv ca a sing nakawta cawsaa kha pachangna pacuv yi te, phungthluvbie a hluvsa kha a cuv te, ruepacuo te a phasa pata a dyapasya taw.
Phungrituv ta hnaanguona bie kha huv te, a hmisipa bie kha a siesa pata a cape.
A singpa ta a ripa bie ca tuvkhietuv ta tuvkhiena ta a hmuopa asung cahrepa haata cuo te, pahmya pakhawpa singna bie ca a cusa pata khepuopa thaakhe hne tana aa lu.
Hingpa zaw khutaa hingta, vya i sacapaa, a raaring tie. Caa-uv a hluvsa capepa hing chuona hnyi the li pata a cuv paripa zaw hing saapa thaabuona cakhaw tana a cuo.
A chuona bie ca: Khazing kha ciyzaa la a nawbie zaw kha ziy tie; tahematapakieca hingpa hing cawsaa mekaa hrievu hrahring tana a cuo.
Khazing ta ma tuepa bangkhuo hing, a paruv ta ma tuepa mekaa, a phapa cuose, a chiepa cuose, bieripana a hnyi aa.
Solomon phypa, hlaa puvthe cepa.
Na vya pahnuo la na i khing! Na duena ca mingsuvtiy laata a thlung vie,
na ziyhmyi ca a pa-ue hringhruo, na ming ca ziyhmyi bungpa haata a pa-ue, caacuonakawta lesaa zaw ta aca khing yi.

Naa chiyle la, a catli pata ca paziy'a ang. Siepahruo na aa ziena khuo chung luo naa ngiekhyi. Nama'a lie kha ma palung tluo pata a nuo'a puv; na duena ca mingsuvtiy laata pathuosa vie'a puv; nama aca duepa yi hing a cuo riypa hrahring tana a cuo.
Vya Jerusalem sacanung zaw, kama ca Kedar thluodaa hne Solomon cawthang zaw haa khata, vaw angte i puvthe.
Ningsaa ta na la te i vang a vaw nakaw hingta na mang khah ung. I caapaapa zaw ta i cunglie ama hi haa te, mingsuv diedung kha ina pahuo sa yi; cuorasala kama mingsuv diedung kha huo va ang!
Vuotiy i hriepa paadue aw, na chang tie, Khaapaliema na tuvrung ca na khie, ningchung ta khaapaliema na pabu yi; khaapanakawma na viesaa tie tuvrung athaalieta i viele aa?
Lesaa hrawlie khing a chiy ce nung, na pachang lipa kieca, tuvrung sina kaw kha paziy la, tuvkhietuv thluodaa athaalie kha na tuvtaata zaw ca khie tie.
I duepa, Faro aruole a dapa aruolaanung hne tana ica pakhingpuo.
Na be lie naa pangipa hne na rue lie lungvaa muosung pachiy riy ca naa ngie hringhruo.
Ngu pacipa siy pachiy ta ca pangi pa se.
Siepahruo ca iehmang cunglie a laa ning kha, i ziyhmyi rangpa-ue ta a ze.
I duepa ca mura haata a rang a pa-ue, i cacunghnaa lie aa hy ning kha.
I duepa ca En-gedi mingsuv diedung chunglie, henna paa na a lu, kama cuota ca.
I duepa, na puvthesa, na puvthe hringhruo; na ming ca thuvruv ming na a lu.
I duepa na puvthe hringhruo, khing na a chiy hringhruo ciy. Ma pangphaa ca a hringpa hmingciy ta a cuo.
Ma ing pahriy ca sidar paruo pate, ingpasuv ca myisaa ta a cuo.
Kama ca Sharon lieta rose paa, bawphie ruo lieta lili paa tana i cuo.
Ahling kung hrawlie lili paa aa calyapa haata, i nungdue ca lesaa hrang hrawlie aa calya.
Ruochung thingkung hrawlie epal kung haata, i paadue ca satlie hrang hrawlie aa calya. Tlechuona hneta a ningdiy rawlie a tu angte, a thyi ca kama cuota a thlung hringhruo.
Du tuena ing luo kha naa chiy te, duena hneta kama kha ina ve.
Duena ta i thaa ina pazi nakawta mingsuv thyi caapa ta i thaa na patlung te, epal thyi ta thaa thaapa ina pi.
A cavyi kuv kha na pahy te, a cacuo kuv ta ina ripuo!
Vya Jerusalem sacanung zaw, i nungdue kha amata tah aa cha hluo li, pa thu thi khah ung ta pata ruocaapa lie sasuv cane ming lapuo pata bie ica taa yi.
I paadue ueryi na i thyi! Mang tie, aa vawle hue, tluothlue kha za thangle te, tluo cunglie a zaa cathlule hue.
I paadue ca canepa thuthawpa hne tana aa lu. Mang tie, lungruetlepie hnangkaa lieta aa daa hue, thlaluo-aw taata hmiehmie pase te, malie a vya mangparuv hue.
I paadue ta bie ina chang: I nungdue, puvthenung, thu la, a vaw tie;
ata hing ca thlasiy cuo chuo tli te, khytiy zaw a chuo tli.
Alyi lieta paapaapa paa yi te, pavaa hlaasana cuo na a tlung tli, ruo chungliena thuvruv ueryi aa thyi tli.
Thyikuv zaw pathyi tli te, mingsuv zaw a paa tli, rangpa-ue kha ama pathlie. I nungdue, puvthenung, thu la, a vaw tie.
Vya i thuvruv, alung daw caku lieta a nu nung, na hmie kha ca hmung ang se, na ueryi kha ca thyi ang se; na ueryi ca thlung te, na hmie ca khing na a chiy hringhruo.
Mingsuv diedung a parapa tie cahnie zaw cahnietaata zaw kha malie patuvpa tie, tahematapakieca mingsuv na a paa ciemuo tli.
I paadue ca kama huopa ta cuo te, kama ca ama huopa tana i cuo; A tuvrung kha lili paa hrawlie a khie.
Zuoluo thliy cakaana te hne, zuoluo ningtlana te khata. Vya i paadue, tluodaw lie a awpa canepa thuthawpa haa khata, kama'a luo vya kaapakhaa tie.
Zuo tating ta i ziena lie kha i vuo-iepaa kha pacuo byalya angte, huv angte hmung va ang; ku angte na chaw hyi vyi.
“Thu'a angte, khy chung luo kha vaa khie'a angte, luopuv lie hne khypuv ahmyana hmang lie zaw kha i huv aa, i paadue ca,” i ta. Kama ta i huv, cadyiseca hmung va ang.
Khychung a huopa tie ta amaa khiele pata ina hmung yi. “I paadue kha nama hmung ma?” i ta yi.
Iema kha i lawpa hne yi ta, i duepa i lungkhaw kha i hmung. Patuv angte pathlie va tli ang, naa sapa i nung ing, a ziena khuo chung luo i chiykhyina te pathlie va tli ang.
Vya Jerusalem sacanung zaw, i nungdue kha amata tah aa cha hluo li, pa thu thi khah ung ta pata ruocaapa lie sasuv cane ming lapuo pata bie ica taa yi.
Ruocaapa chungtaata myikhuv haata a kya thupa, frankinsens hne mura rangpa-ue, sungpalituv tie phawdaa rangpa-ue bangkhuo haata a pa-uepa ca khaapatama a cuo?
Mang tie, Solomon siepahruo-ingta hue! a cahriylie hue a thaaruvpa Israel riepha tie sawcaruv,
zueziy a cyi diy kaluo yi te, rietuv a thepa tie selaw, zuo ta pahlupada a aw nakawta ama se lie kha zueziy amaa pathlie kaluo.
Solomon ca Lebanon thing ta siepahruo-ingta kha aa sa.
A tung tie kha ngu ta tue te, a hnangluo kuo kha siy ta tue te, aa tunapa kha a ciycaapa cawthang ta a tue; a chungluo ca duena ta ama pangi. Jerusalem sacanung zaw,
kya pya tie ung. Vya Zion sacanung zaw, Siepahruo Solomon kha mang tie ung, a nung ta a pakhuvpa byilakhuv hneta a nungchiyna pyi ningta, a palung tluosa ning kha.
Kha tluv tama na puvthe, nungdue, tuokhaatama hing tluv ta na puvthe! Na hmiepakhuv rawlieta na ming ca thuvruv ming na a lu. Na suo ca Gilead tluope lieta zaa cungbungpa mie phuv na a lu.
Na haa ca a hming ngu yi te tiy ama pasiyna taata a kya kiethawpa tuvrung hne tana aa lu, sa kha hmuo bu li pata mingphie ama pachuo diy.
Na hmyataw ca palaa sepa lu te, khing na a chiy hringhruo. Na hmiepakhuv rawlie na be ca cale thyi khechipa haata a puvthe.
Na ruetung ca rieka tie ta ama hmuopa phya thawkha aa pathlienapa David ingsuo hne tana aa lu.
Na meme suohning ca lili kung hrawlie a tle hyalyapa sasuvtaata mingphie tie na ama lu.
Mawdiy thliy cakaapa a hruona te, hne mawdiy khy a kya vuona te ta, kama ca mura tluo hne frankinsens tluo luo na a pahraasa pata i kie aa.
Nungdue aw, na puvthe hringhruo, na cunglie syisaa riypa suokha hmuo aw vyi.
Vya i lesaanung, Lebanon luo; kama'a luo hing a vaw tie. Chingde khue hne kyiching tluo ta a cuopa, Amana tluodaw, Senir tluodaw, Harmon tluodaw taa khata vya pya tie.
I lesaanung, i sietanung i pathiypalung na ina latuv ciy, na mingcakiy ta ina siypa ca hne na ruetung lie na pachiy tana i pathiypalung ina la diy ciy.
I sietanung, i lesaanung, na duena ca kha tluv tama a thlung! mingsuvtiy laata thlung vie te, na rangpa-ue ca rangpa-ue phangting laata a pa-ue vie.
I lesaanung, na hmya ca khyitiy haata thlung te, na palyi rawlie ca khyitiy hne cuehnung na a aw; na caw rangpa-uepa ca Lebanon rangpa-uepa haa tana a pa-ue.
I sietanung, i lesaanung ca piehu padungpa diedung tana a cuo, a thlake khaapa diedung, caakhe khepa takhue tana a cuo.
Na diedung lieta cale thyi, hne thingthyi pahuo cepa tie aw te, henna thing hne nard thing rangpa-ue tie zaw ama aw,
nard hne saffron, kalamus hne cinnamon zaw, frankinsens thingkung bangkhuo zaw ama aw. mura hne aloes, hne rangpa-ue daduo ta ama aw.
Diedung lie ca tiyhnaa, tiy a tlingpa takhue hne, Lebanon taata zaa langpa cavaa ama aw.

Vya chaluo thliy, a hra buo tie, sungluo thliy zaw a kya hruo tie! I diedung luo hing a hruo tie ung, rangpa-ue ca a ze se. I duepa ca a diedung luo hing a vaw sala, a pahuo cepa thingthyi tie hing ning naase.

I sietanung hne i lesaanung, i diedung luona i vaw; mura hne rangpa-ue na i pakhaw, i khyisaluv hne i khyitiy na i ning, i mingsuvtiy hne i cuehnung na i dang. Viesaa zaw ning ung la dang tie ung, duena hneta pariy ung siy.

I zie raalaa pata i pathiypalung ca aa hra. Naathlie tie, paadue na ingchiy a cakhaw. “Na kya pahaw tie, i sietanung i nungdue, i thuvruv, kama tluotling diy nung; i luv ca aduo ta pacing te, i suo ca aduo diy tana a pacing,” a ta.
I caw kha i thlie tli, tuokhaatama i hryi pakhaa the aa? I phyi kha i siy tli; tuokhaatama i papya pakhaa the aa?
I paadue na ingchiypakaa luo a kuv a paza tli, i palung ca ama'a lie dyina a aw tli.
I paadue kha pahaw riypata thu angte, i kuv kha mura i thuv, i kuvdaw kha mura tiy a thuv angte, capa ca ta ingchiypakaa tluo kha i va patuv.
I paadue ca i va pahaw, cuorasala paadue ca kaa te a cakuo tli. Ama ta bie a ri tiyta, i zung ta a ci hringhruo. Huv angte, hmung khu va ang; u angte, na chaw va tli.
A khielepa khychung a huopa tie ta kama kha ina hmung yi; na tuv yi te, hmaa ina paphya yi, lungruetlepie a huopa tie khata i buohryi cungpakaw kha ina chuv yi.
Paa na ica kie yi, Vya Jerusalem sacanung zaw, i paadue kha nama hmung kieca, hingpa hing chang tie ung: Duena kawlie na aa uv ta i uv tli.
Vya canung bangkhuo hrawlie a puvthe ce nung, malie na changpa na paadue hing a hrangpa tie laata khaapa hing ma due aa chiy vienapa ta a cuo?
I paadue ca setunglung te ling a hnyi, capaa thawkha hrawlieta a puv pa-ipa tana a cuo.
A luv ca siy pha cepa haa tana a cuo; a suo kha vaw diyliy te, vazung vawpa na a lu.
A ming ca cavaa kielie, cuehnung lieta a siypa, thuvruv ming na a lu.
A be ca rangpa-ue ta a bipa diedung haa khata cuo te, a hmya ca lili paa haata mura ziyhmyi diy ta a pace.
A kuvbuo ca siy buotung lu te, lungvaa ta pangipa a cuo. A pangpa ca safaiar lungvaa muosung bepa ale nue kha a lu.
A phyi ca siy cunglie patupa lungvaa muosungpa haata a ngu. A hmingsuo ca sidar thing pha cepa zaw punapa Lebanon tluo na a lu.
A ryi ca thlung hringhruo te, a cuona bangkhuo kha tlechuo aa chiy hringhruo. I paadue hne i viesaa ca cahaaca tana a cuo, Vya Jerusalem sacanung zaw.
Vya canung zaw hrawlie a puvthecenung, na paadue ca khaapa luo ma a vaa? Maca huvkhyi the riypata na paadue ca khaapa luopuv luo ma a pie?
I paadue ca a diedung luona a zuv, rangpa-ue ta a bipa diedung luona a zuv. Diedung chunglie a tuv khie riypa hne, lili paa lu riypa tana a zuv.
Kama ca paadue huopa ta cuo angte, paadue ca kama huopa tana a cuo; a tuv khana lili paa hrawlieta a khie.
Nungdue, nama ca Tirzah haa tana na puvthe, Jerusalem haa tana linghlaa na hnyi, tena pangtaa cangpa rieka tie haa tana ciy naa chiy.
Na ming kha a hrang luo na maase tie, tahematapakieca ina tesa yi! Na suo ca Gilead cabung lie zaa cunglepa mie phuv hne tana aa lu.
Na haa ca tiy ama pasiyna taata a kya kiethawpa tuvrung hne tana aa lu; sa kha hmuo bu li pata mingphie ama pachuo diy.
Na hmiepakhuv rawlie na be ca cale thyi khechipa haa tana a puvthe.
Siepahruonung sawcaruv, nungthang sawcari, hne mangchiytuv lesaa ri tie li ta ama aw.

I thuvruv, kama tluotling diy nung ca ama pakha dyi hing tana a cuo, a nung ta a due hringhruopa tana a cuo, a sapa a nung ta syi riy a hnyi lipa tana a cuo. Mangchiytuv lesaa zaw ta ama hmung kie, palungtluosa pata ku yi te, siepahruonung hne nungthang zaw ta cahaacata ama pathuosa.
“Mawdiy khy dyipa haata a tapa ca ahungtama a cuo? Thlaapa haata a puvthe, ning haata khe te, tena pangtaa cangpa rieka tie haa tana a cuo.
Bawphie chunglie thingthyi diedung kha mang riypata i zuv, mingsuv kha a paa pamang tli ma ta pata mang riypa, hne cale thyi kha a pamang tli ma ta pata mang riypata i zuv.
I pachang hluo khata i duepa ta aruole chunglie, i siepahruo kielie kha ina patu.
Vya kaa tie, vya kaa tie, Vya Shulam cawsaanung! vya kaa tie, vya kaa tie, maca mang the riypata. Khaapanakawma rieka phuv hning alalalie a luopa haata Shunam cawsaanung ca nama mang aa?
Vya siepahruo sacanung, na phyi ca phyipakaw hne kha tluv tama aa ngie! Na sesie ca kuvzung a thepa tie ta ama pangipa lungvaa muosungpa haa tana a cuo.
Na palie ca mingsuvtiy pahuopa a hri buo lipa kuotung a pungkalungpa haa tana a cuo. Na pawpya ca lili paa ta a cadungpa jungsacuo papungpa haa tana a cuo.
Na meme suohning ca sasuvtaata mingphie tie na ama lu.
Na ruetung ca ale nue ingsuo na a lu. Na ming ca Heshbon khy Bath-rabbim thlake athaalie a awpa tiy-ang khana a lu. Na hnacabuv ca Damaskas luo a hyipa Lebanon ingsuo haa tana a cuo.
Na luv ta Karmel tluo haata a suo vie te, zaa tliepa na suo ca seviyvaa te siepahruo ming na a lasa.
Kha tluv tama puvthe cate tlechuo naa chiy, Vya i duepa, khing a chiysapa lesaanung!
Na tung na buo ca tungkung kha lu te, na meme ca tungkung zawbya na ama lu.
Kama ta tungkung kha kie'a angte na a ce zaw kha i buo aa i ta. Na meme ca mingsuv thyi sue hneta a lu te, na huv sungpa rang ca epal hmingpa rang haata a pa-ue.
Ina pahnuo pahne cata mingsuvtiy thlung cepa haata i hmyataw hne i haa luo kha neziyliy khata duvsaa ta a langbung.
Kama ca i duepa huopa ta cuo angte, ama khingpa ca kama huo tana a cuo.
A vaw tie, i duepa, ruo luo kha sipa sala, zuo cuo ca khyta lie kha hmuo pase.
Mingsuv diedung luo kha mawdiy ta si ung sala, mingsuv a paa hne a paa li, a thyi a pamang hne a pamang li, cale zaw a paa tli ma paa valie ma mang naase puv. Capa lie ca i duena kha ica pi aa.
Lesaa pamyana kung ca pa-uesa te ma ingchiypakaa lieta thingthyi pahuo cepa, a thaapa cuose, a hlungpa cuose a aw; Vya i duepa, capa ca nama cuota ica chipapa tana a cuo.
I nung ta meme a pazaw sapa i caapaapa ta cuo la a pha'apa kha! Ale lie icaa taw ningta ca pahnuo'a angte ahungtahmuo na caw-yi'a va yi.
Caa chiyle'a angte naa sapa i nung aziena khuo chung luo kha icaa ngiekhyi aa. Mingsuvtiy rangpa-ue, hne i cale tiy kha dang riyta ica pi aa.
A cavyi kuv kha na pahy te, a cacuo kuv ta ina ripuo!
Vya Jerusalem sacanung zaw, i nungdue kha amata tah aa cha hluo li, pa thu thi khah ung tapa tana bie ica taa yi.
A duepa a vya hyle te ruocaapa chungtaata a vawlepa hue ahungtama a cuo? Na nung ta aca sanapa epal kung rawlie na nama kha ica pahra.
Na pathiypalung chunglie kha caakhe haata na khe la, na buotung lie kha caakhe haata na khe tie; duena ca thiyna haata a thaaruv te, khingna ca thiyna tluv ta a cahra. Myi hlaa haata ie te a khe.
Tiy hluvpuv ta duena kha pache khu vyi, tiy lepa zaw ta phya khu vyi. Pakhakha ta a ing lie a hnyirungna bangkhuo kha duena cuota pi khing sala pahnyisue na aa ang aa.
Kiema ta sietanung pakha hnyi pate, a meme hmuo bu nuo valie. Pakhakha ta khingna bie vya chang sala, ma sietanung ca tuokhaatama ma tue aa?
Ama ca lungruetlepie ta cuo sala ca, a cunglieta ngu ingsuo na ma sa aa; ingchiypakaa ta cuo sala ca, sidar thingphie tana ma bechiy aa.
Kama ca lungruetlepie ta cuo angte, i meme ca ingsuo haa tana ama cuo; cakhutaata kama ca, a ming lieta diena a phyapa haa tana i cuo.
Solomon ta Baal-hamon lie mingsuv diedung a hnyi; diedung mangchiytuv tie kuv luo kha pi yi te, a thyi ama luna muo ta ngu tuokaa thawkha ama pi.
Kama hnyipa, i mingsuv diedung ca kama huopa tana a cuo; Vya Solomon, thawkha kha nama huopa ta cuo'a te, zahning kha diedung mangchiytuv tie huopa ta a cuo aa.
Vya diedung lie a awpa tie, i lungkhawviesaa zaw na nama ueryi caa naathlie yi; kama zaw thyi ra ang se.
I duepa, sasuv cane haata vya catli tie, rangpa-ue ta a bipa tluocung lie hing!
Amos sacapaa Isaiah ta Judah siepahruo Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz hne Hezekiah tie chuo lieta, Judah hne Jerusalem kawlieta a hmungpa muocuo ca hing haa hingta a cuo.
Abyipata a ripa ca: Vya alyi hne avuo zaw, thyi tie ung; i mangsang ciepa hne i caw ciepa saata zaw na naa du yi.
Cue ta a hnyituv pachang te, laa zaw ta a ziypaapa ta sa a pinapa hraky kha a pachang; cuorasala Israel ca pachang vyi, i cawsaa zaw ca pachang va yi.

Ah! a suepa mingphang, pha lina hmangriy a phyapa cawsaa tie, a pha lipa a tuepa ciypathla tie, zya pha lipa a tuepa saata zaw, Abyipaa thawpa tie, Israel Khazing Pathe kha a thawpa tie, hnang a chawpa tie!
Sungpe ta chi riypa ma nama huv pakhaa? Khaapanakawma a du riypa ca nama pazue? Na luv yalya ca hmaa ta bi te, na pathiypalung ca aa uv.

Na phyipazaa taata na luvsadiy te ta, a tluonapa suv kha hmuo aw vyi, a kyinapa hne a thiy a vyipa hne a thiy a langpa hmaa selaw tana a bi; capa hmaa zaw ca pasiypa hne cataw pata cuo valie, siyy zaw thuv pata cuo valie.
Na ruo ca a duokaring, na khypuv zaw kha myi ta rue pata a cuo; na ming hmungna lie hrahring ta, ruohrang ming ta na ruo kha ama la ama para diy; ruohrang ming ta la tlipa haata a duokaring.
Mingsuv diedung lie thluodaa thusepa a cuopa haata, sacanung Zion ca thuse pata a cuo tli, paziy lu lie thluodaa haata hne, rie ta cadungpa khypuv haa khata.
Cungnungce Abyipata cawsaa a cawta malie pangaapa buo li pata aw sala, Sodom haa khata cuo'a pate, Gomorrah khana ma lu aa.
Niema Sodom uvtuv tie, Abyipabie kha thyi tie ung. Gomorrah cawsaa zaw, ma Khazing pacuvna kha naathlie tie ung.

Abyipata, nama hriykhungrina tie hing kama hne khaapama aa se? Tuvtungpa ta myirue panaana hne nama pathupa sahring thu hing inaa desa tli; nama cuetungpa tie hne nama tuv tie hne nama mie tie thiy hing khing va ang.
I hmiekung luo namaa vaw tiyta, hingpa hing nama kuv taata ahungma caa hie yi? I tlawhmie hing vya tlaw khah tie ung;

hriykhungrina ta nama vya cyipa hmang hing a thlahnena aw vyi; rangpa-ue hing i cuota duvsamakhiepa tana a cuo. Thla thaapa hne sabbath hne ahmyana nama tuepa, pha lina hne nama tuepa ahmyana zaw hing, ang khu va tli ang.
Nama thla thaapa hne ama'a na a cuo lieta tuepa nama pyi zaw hing i huesa; kama cuota hmangriy ta cuo te, phya hang va tli ang.
Nama kuv nama pazu tiyta, caa hmung li hruo icaa cuo'a yi; thlaa a hluvsa nama chuo zaw ta, naathlie'a va ang; nama kuv na thiyse ta a bi.
Niema hne niema kha a pasiy tie ung; a pathe sa tie ung; nama tuena pha lipa kha i ming hmungna taa hingta thaw tie ung; hmang pha lipa tue kha taw ung la,
hmang pha tue kha a cuv tie ung; hmangdangpa kha huv ung la, hrisaapa tie kha hya pazang tie ung, haaraa kha a daakhyi ung la, nunghlyi kha a cuokhyi tie ung.
Abyipata, ata hingta a vaw ung la a rue pakhaw'a ung puv: Nama suena ca a se ta se ra sala, cahue haa tana a ngu aa; a se ta sedung ra sala, tuv hming haa tana a ruo aa.
Niema ta i ri inaa ngie kie ungca ca, ruo chungtaata a pyapa kha nama ning aa;
cuorasala i ri na i ung cate inaa du kie ungca ca, zueziy tana nama thiy aa; tahematapakieca Abyipana a ri.

Zang tluo zaa tlasapa khypuv kha ata ca siyhrawnung tana a cuo tli. Hluo ning ca biedangpa lie na a za hring, a chunglie kha adangna ta ing za tlung te, cuorasala ata hing ca cawsaa a thiepa tie na a tlung yi.
Na ngu ca saa a tle lipa tana aa li, na mingsuvtiy ca tiy hneta pya pata a cuo.
Na byi tie ca rie thu a hmuopa hne aparuvpa viesaa tana ama cuo. Cawsaa bangkhuo ta lasaw khing yi te, nawthuv ama ning. Haaraa kha a daakhyi lipa yi ta, nunghlyi kawpacuona zaw hnyi va yi.
Caacuonakawta Lesyice, Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing ta: Ah! I carie tie cungliena i hihaana i bya'a yi, i carie tie na phuv i la'a yi!
I kuv na niema'a lie i pathlie aa; ngu ama pathepa haata ca pathe sa'a yi angte, nama pyapa bangkhuo kha i pathe sa diy aa.

Nama bieripatuv tie kha a hluo ning haa khata chi pakhaa yi angte, ruena pituv tie kha a hruothu ning haa khata i chi pakhaa'a yi. Cakhutaa cata nama ca adangna khypuv, zang tluo aa tlapa khypuv aca ta'a yi.
Zion ca biedangpa ta khuo pata cuo'a te, a chunglie a awpa aa ngiepachiypa tie ca adangna ta khuo pata ama cuo aa.
Cuorasala du a hmuopa tie hne a suepa tie ca para pakhaw pata cuo'a yi te, Abyipaa thawpa tie ca thie pata ama cuo aa.
Nama za tlechuosapa mathliy kung kawlieta nama nang a zaa aa; namaa zaa tlawpa diedung kawlieta nama hmie a chi aa.
Tahematapakieca a hnaa a uvpa mathliy kung kha lu'a ung cate, tiy a hnyi lipa diedung haa khata nama cuo aa.
A thaaruvpa tie ca hnehnaw caapa haa khata cuo'a yi te, ama re ca myihliy haa khata a cuo aa; iema hne ama re hne khata myi ta rue hne pata cuo'a yi te, ahungtahmuo pache khu pata cuo'a vyi.
Amoz sacapaa Isaiah ta Judah hne Jerusalem kawlieta a hmungpa muocuo ca:

Hmieluo cuo lie ca Abyipaing aa daanapa tluo ca tluo zaw hrawlie aa suo cepa tluo ta tue pata cuo'a te, tluothlue zaw cung luo calangthaw pata a cuo aa; mingphang bangkhuo kha capa luo ca amaa vya hmya aa.

I cawsaa zaw kha a vaw'a yi te, “A vaw tie ung, Abyipatluo luo kha kie'a ung puv; Jacob Khazing ing luo kha kie'a ung puv, a luopuv kha malie pacuv sala, ziy ung siy,” ama ta aa. Tahematapakieca pacuvna ca Zion taata pya'a te, Abyipabie ca Jerusalem taata a pya aa.

Ama ta mingphang zaw alalalie kha bieripana hnyi'a te, cawsaa hluvsa cuota bie a chipa'a yi; iema ta ama zueziy zaw kha atuv ta pali'a yi te, amaa syi zaw kha thingnge tenapa cere ta ama pali aa; mingphang phang kha hne phang kha alalalie kha zueziy cabapa aw'a va tli, rietuv acuvna zaw aw'a va tli yi.
Vya Jacob ingchungkhue zaw, a vaw ung la Abyipakhena chunglie kha cakuo'a ung puv.
Na cawsaa Jacob ingchungkhue ca na thaw tli yi. Ningchiyluo taata a vawpa hmungdawlutuv tie hne Filistin tie haapa ridawlutuv tie haa khata cuo yi te, ruohrang ming hneta amaa khe.
Ama ruo ca siy hne ngu ta bi te, sue hne thiy chuo the vyi; ama ruo ca aruo ta bi te, aruole ca ri tie aw vyi.
Ama ruo ca kuvtuezuv ta bi te, ama kuv ta ama sa ciepa kha amaa bie.
Caacuonakawta cawsaa ca pane pata cuo'a yi te, pakha cyicuo ca pachung pata ama cuo aa; iema kha a ngiethe khah yi!
Abyipalesyi rungnaana hne ciy aa chiy hringhruona taa khata, lungkaraw luo kha a ngie la, buvcing hrawlie kha a nu tie.
A hruotlepa cawsaa tie kha aa nena luo pacung pata cuo'a yi te, a hruotlepa cawsaa bangkhuo ca pachung pata ama cuo aa; capa ning lie ca Abyipapakha kyalya kha cyicalang pata a cuo aa.
Tahematapakieca Cungnungce Abyipaca a hruotlepa hne aa palepa tie, hne aa suo luo calangpa tie kha a duna riypa ning na a hnyi.
Lebanon sidar bangkhuo, aa palepa hne aa pasuopa tie, hne Bashan mathliy bangkhuo kha aa du yi.
Tluo aa suopa bangkhuo kha a du te, a palepa tluothlue bangkhuo kha aa du;
aa suopa ingsuo bangkhuo kha a du te, khy cupa khy dungkhuona carie piehu zaw kha aa du.
Tarshish tiypalaw bangkhuo kha a du te, a puvthepa tiypalaw bangkhuo kha aa du.
Cawsaa a palena bangkhuo, hne hruotlena bangkhuo ca aa nena luo pachung pata a cuo aa; capa ning lie ca Abyipapakha kyalya kha cyicalang pata a cuo aa.
Kuvtuezuv ca ama vie karue aa.
Abyipata alyi kha cahang riypata aa vaw thue ca, a lesyi rungnaana hne ciy aa chiy hringhruona taa khata, lungkaraw luo kha a saw'a yi te alyi khue luo kha amaa ngie aa.
Capa ning thue ca cawsaa ta iema abie riypata amaa tuepa, siy kuvtuezuv tie hne ngu kuvtuezuv tie ca pataa hne bahla kha ama thawsue aa.
Abyipata alyi kha cahang riypata aa vaw thue ca, a lesyi rungnaana hne ciy aa chiy hringhruona taa khata, lungkaraw lepa chung luo kha a saw'a yi te, caku daw alung kyina karaw luo kha amaa ngie aa.
Ama hnaakhue taata ama huv sung yi te, a thiy thepa cawsaa tie'a taa khata a vya pali tie, Iema ca khaapatama ama cuo?
Ata ca Lesyice, Cungnungce Abyipata Judah hne Jerusalem taata, abyana bangkhuo, abyanapa sa bangkhuo, abyanapa tiy bangkhuo;
a riephapa hne rieka, bieripatuv hne profet, hmungdawlutuv tie hne luochiytuv tie,
sawngaa a uvpa riebyi tie, hne a re lepa a re a suopa tie, ruena pituv hne pacuo a thesapa tie, hne pamya a thepa tie kha a pathe sa patlaa diy.
Satlie panuta tie kha ama siepahruo ta tue'a yi angte, haatiy tie ta iema kha ama uv aa.

Cawsaa kha pakha hne pakha, ingpaa hne ingpaa zaw kha amaa hrisaa aa; mingnu ta macuo tie kha siysaa ri li pata aw'a yi te, a laliy lipa cawsaa ta pa-uvsathyi aa tlapa tie kha siysaa ri li pata ama aw aa.
Cawsaa chekha ta ama tieta, hne ama chungkha cawsaa kha patuv'a yi te, “Nama ca cawsie na hnyi kalie, hingpa rana chunglie hing na uvna rawlie aw se puv, ma luochiytuv ta cuo tie,” ama ta aa.
Cuorasala capa ning lie ca ama ta khi'a te, “Kama ca patluo satuv ta cuo'a va ang; i ing lieta viechuo cuose, cawsie cuose aw vyi, cawsaa uvtuv ta na tue khu va ung ciy,” a ta aa.
Tahematapakieca Jerusalem ca a pachiy te Judah ca aa lie tli, ama bie hne ama tuesana ta Abyipa a rungnaapa a awpuona kha aa du tli.

Ama hmiephya ca iema a dutuv tehte ta a cuo; Sodom haa tana ama suena kha nu khu li pata ama pathyi sa. Iema ca bawchie ciemuopa tana ama cuo! tahematapakieca iemata tana pha lina kha iema cung luo amaa patlungsue.
Suena a hnyi lipa tie ca kha tluv ta vuophapa tama ama cuo tapa kha chang tie yi, tahematapakieca iema ca ama hrie muo kha ama ning aa.
Suena a hnyipa tie ca bawchie ciemuopa tana ama cuo, tahematapakieca ama kuv ta ama tuepa khana ama cunglie tue pata a cuo aa.
Haatiy tie ta i cawsaa zaw kha ama hrisaa, canung tie ta iema kha ama uv. Vya i cawsaa zaw nama luochiytuv tie na luo caa chiy chie yi, luo na aca viekhyi yi.
Abyipata a bie kha ri aa ting tli, cawsaa kha bieripa riypata aa daa tli.
Abyipana bieripana luo kha uvthyi tie hne siepahruo tie hne khata a ngie: I mingsuv diedung a ning diypa ca niema tana nama cuo; siypasa tie nama chuvpa chechiy ca nama ing chungliena a aw.
Khaapa nama khingna tama i cawsaa tie hing chaapuo ung cate, siypasa tie ama hmie ca nama cariypuole? Cungnungce Khazing Abyipata a ta.

Abyipata: Zion sacanung zaw ca a hruotlesa yi te, avuo luo ang yi te ama cakuo, capaa cung luo dyi ama ming khang yi te, ama lakaw maale yi te ama cakuo, ama kuv lie amaa cakhiypa karuv kha ama paring sale.
Zion sacanung zaw luv lie kha Abyipata retha pakie sa'a te, ama cahripa ta a chi'a yi.
Capa ning lie ca Abyipata ama cakhaw lie amaa kupa, ama luvciy, thlaapa dipa zuv ama bapa pachiy;
ra-aw, kukaw, ruekalaa pavya;
luv lie a khuvpa tie, buocakhiy, se lie a kazepa puv pavya, rangpa-ue bya, vuochina taata malie a khuo khu ta pata zangpa chechiy;
caakhe kuvpahryi hne hnacabuv ra-aw,
pyi lie hmuopa khuhriy, aa paapa cungpakaw buohryi pasiypa, buohryi pasiypa, kuv sahrie;
a paasapa caw, pahiepa palaa ta taapa caw, pawde, hne hmiepakhuv zaw kha a thawpa diy'a yi.
Rangpa-ue cuopata a thuvpa rang, sepaze cuopata maheriy, suophiepa cuopata luv pamyina, hnyirungna paluosanapa khuhriy cuopata buri, puvthena cuopata nangzaana ta a cuo aa.
Na capaa zaw ca zueziy ta thiy'a yi te, na rieka riephapa tie ca rie kuv ta ama thiy aa.
A thlake ca caana hne muochiesana ta cuo'a te, vuosuo paza pata alyi lie a tu aa.

Capa cuo thue ca canung pasariy ta capaa pakha kha patuv'a yi te, “Kiemata tah sa a ring'a pate, kiemata tah caw maa ring aa; na ming ta kupa malie pacuo sa thi la, ma nangzaana hing malie lapa thi tie,” ama ta aa.
Capa ning thue ca Abyipaa ce ca puvthe'a te a rungnaa aa, ruo a thyipaa ca a hringpa Israel ming cuota amaa palena hne ama rungnaana ta a cuo aa.
Zion lie thuse siypa tie hne Jerusalem lie pangaa siypa tie, hne Jerusalem lieta hringna cazing lie khungpa tie ca a pathepa ta pata kupa ama cuo aa.
Zion sacanung tie kha Abyipata ama pyalyina taata pasiy'a yi te, Jerusalem cunglie aa kaapa thiy kha bieripana thlaapa hne myikuona thlaapa ta a pathe sa yi.

Cakhutaata Zion Tluo cung hne capa apungna hmang lieta a pungpa zaw cunglie kha Abyipata ningchung ta amyi pazu sa'a te, zuo ta myikhuv hne myihlaa a pa-aw sa aa. Capa rungnaana zaw bangkhuo cunglie ca aa suosapa a pakhuv a aw aa.
Capa ca ta ningchung ning lingna taata ningdiy padiy'a te, khysuv hne khytiy taata canawna a cuo aa.
I duepa cuota hlaa sa'a ang, a mingsuv diedung hne aa patuvpa duena hlaa; i duepa ta chuelyi a phasanapa tluo lie mingsuv diedung a hnyi.

Alyi kha pali te alung kha a pathe, a pha cepa mingsuv kung kha aa ling; capa liekhingkhuo lie kha vena ingsuo sa te, mingsuv a ciyna khue zaw kha a cu; mingsuv thyi a pathyi aa ta pata aa nguopuo, cuorasala a thuepa kha a pathyi diy.
Ata hing ca, Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie hne Judah cawsaa tie ta i mingsuv diedung hne kama alalalie kha bie malie ama ripa.
I mingsuv diedung cuo hingta i tue li liepa khaapama i tue vie riypa a aw kalie? Mingsuv thyi vya pathyi aa i ta pata, khaapanakawma a thuepa thyi dyi a pathyi?

Caacuonakawta i mingsuv diedung cunglieta khaapama i tue aa tapa kha ata hingta ica chang'a yi. A piehu kha phi diy'a angte, sahring ta ama ce diy aa; a dungkhuo kha pacing diy'a angte, tlawpuo diy pata a cuo aa.
Hnaw'a angte, a nge kha tepa'a va tli ang; ahling kung hne aphuv na a syisue aa; amyi kha naw pi'a angte, a cunglie khytiy pasaa sa'a vyi.

Tahematapakieca Cungnungce Abyipamingsuv diedung ca Israel ingchungkhue hing tana a cuo, Judah cawsaa tie ca palungtluona hneta aa lingpa tie hing tana ama cuo; biedangpa kha aa nguopuo, cuorasala a hmungpa ca thiyse palangna khata a cuo; adangna kha aa mangkhuo, cuorasala caana kha a thyi!
Alyi lie hing niema selaw ta aw riypata, hne ahunghmuo hmang ama hnyi li riypata, niema ing kha hne ing kha kha pazue ung cate, lu kha hne lu kha a pahlawpa tie ca thluechiy lipa tana nama cuo!
Cungnungce Abyipana kama thyina lieta chie caa sa yi: A lesapa hne a puvthesapa ing a hluvsa ca a aw riypa aw'a va yi.
Tahematapakieca ekaah suohraa lie ama cyipa mingsuv ta mingsuvtiy bath suokha dyi papya khu'a te, saciy homer suokha ta ephah suokha dyi a vyi aa.
Sahmaa dang riypata mawdiy ta thu te, zuo pasiypuv te ta pariy kathluv khata a dangpa ca thluechiy lipa tana nama cuo.
Ama pyi lie kha tingtuo hne tingtuolepa, akhang hne ramang hne mingsuvtiy ama hmuo; cuorasala Abyipahmang tuepa kha rue lipa yi ta, a kuv ta a tuepa kha hmung the va yi.
Caacuonakawta i cawsaa zaw ta singna hnyi va yi, sii tana amaa da aa; ama byi tie kha sa li pata thiy'a yi te, ama cawsaa zaw ca ama tiy hrie'a te ama duo a caa aa.
Caacuonakawta Sheol ca a nang paruo te, a pakaa kha a kukalaa pata a uo; Jerusalem lesyina hne a cawsaa zaw, a cawsaazaapuv hne ama'a lie a palung a tluopa zaw ca ama tlabung.
Cawsaa ca a bung yi te, cawsaa mekaa ca pachung pata cuo yi te, a hruotle pata a ming a padyipa tie ca aa ne luo pacung pata ama cuo.
Cuorasala Cungnungce Abyipaca biedangpa ta cyicalang pata cuo te, cakhutaata a Pathepa Khazing ca adangna ta aa luo.
Cakhutaata tuvtaata zaw ca aphuv panuna lie kha tle yi te, khypuv rana chunglie ca mietaata zaw ta aphuv kha ama buo aa.
Pha lina kha hanghiena khuhriy ta a tliepuo byalyapa tie, suena kha khuhriy ta le a dapa haata a tliepuo byalyapa tie;
“A pahraa se, ima hmung riypata a re kha a catli pata hrie se; Israel Khazing Pathe aa tingna ca ma pachang riypata a catli pata tling se” a tapa tie ca thluechiy lipa tana ama cuo!

Niema a pha lipa kha a pha, a phapa kha pha vyi a tapa tie, zingna kha khena, khena kha zingna ta pata cuose, a khapa kha a thlung, a thlungpa kha a kha ta pata a pali ta a chipa tie ca, thluechiy lipa tana nama cuo!
Niema hne niema kha kama na a sing ang ta pata a hmungpa, i sing ciemuo ta pata a hmungpa tie ca, thluechiy lipa tana nama cuo!
Niema, mingsuvtiy a dang khusapa tie, siyy pyapa sahmaa dang a cahrasapa tie,
nawthuv ning khing nakawta a suepa tie kha pathlie ung cate, suena a hnyi lipa tie bie kha aa dang pata a ripa khing lipa tie ca thluechiy lipa tana nama cuo!

Caacuonakawta myi palyi ta sacuo kung a kuo diy paluopa haa khata, hne aphuv caapa myihlaa ta a la paluopa haata, ama thariy ca hmaw'a te, ama paa ca buvcing khuv haata aa zu aa; tahematapakieca iema ca Cungnungce Abyipapacuvna kha thaw yi te, Israel Khazing Pathe bie kha ama duv.

Caacuonakawta Abyipaca a cawsaa zaw cunglie kha a hi haa te, a kuv kha pazuo te iema kha a tuv yi; tluo kha a cahang te, ama riyy ca luopuv lie kha a haa riy aw va yi. Cata a cuo khutaa zaw ca ta a hihaana ca die vyi, a kuv ca a pazuo kalie thluo.
Abyipata luohlaa luo a awpa mingphang tie kha, a vaw ung, ta pata pachangsana pi yi te, chuelyi dena lie a awpa cawsaa tie kha a pahyi ta a ku yi; Lie a hysa pata, a catlisa pata amaa vaw!
Iema chunglie pakha hmuo ama nang buo vyi, a pachiypa aw va yi, a tluvpa hne a hmungpa aw va yi; ama pahriy aa hyapa aw va yi, ama phyipakaw riy a cipa aw va yi.
Ama cuoti kha a cahre, ama liy kha a kacu, ama aruo caki ca vuokhawlung haata ta te, amaa ruole phyi ca thliysung haata aa pahie.
Ama puraa ca chingde thuthawpa a hrungpa haa tana a cuo; iema ta saa kha cadiy yi te ama patuv, a dale yi te ahungtahmuo pacha khu va yi.

Capa ning thueta ca iema ta Israel kha riyliy aa hrungpa haa khata amaa hrunghnue aa. Capa ruocaapa luo ca mang pata a cuo kieca, zingna hne riethyivuosuona dyina a aw; khena ca amyi ta pahlaw te a zingkaruv.
Siepahruo Uzziah a thiy kung lie kha a suo te aa calyapa byithude lieta Abyipa aa tupa kha i hmung; a pang ca biena-ing kha a bi.

A cunglie ca myipalyi haata a tapa hmanghring tie kha ama aw; sa kha ta mathlaa suocaruv kaluo ama hnyi: suohning khata ama hmie kha buvkhung yi te, a hrangpa suohning khata ama phyi kha ama buvkhung.
Pakha ta a hrangpa pakha kha: “A pathe, a pathe, a pathe, Cungnungce Abyipa ca a pathe; a lesyina ca alyi cung yalya ta a bi,” a ta.
Capa a khina ueryi cata ingchiypakaa tung kha cahang te, ing ca myikhuv ta a bi.

Cakhutaata kama ta: “Bawchie ciemuopa tana i cuo! I li tli, tahematapakieca kama ca i hmya pathe vyi, cakhutaata a hmya pathe lipa tie hrawlieta i aw; cuorasala Siepahruo, Cungnungce Abyipakha i ming ta a hmung mangtli!” i ta.
Cakhutaata serafim pakha ca bienatluophie taata cecakie ta a cakipa myihyi hringpa suokha aa cyipuo pata kama'a luo kha a vya zu.
Serafim ca ta i hmya kha myihyi hringpa cata na pade sa te: “Myihyi ta na hmya kha aca taw tli, na suena kha thawpa pata cuo cate, paviepa pata na cuo tli,” ina ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipata, “Ahungma i pathlie aa, kiema cuo hingta ahungma a si aa?” a tapa ueryi kha i thyi. Cakhutaata kama ta, “Hingpa lie hingna i aw, kama na pathlie tie!” i ta.

Cakhutaata ama ta, “Si la hingpa cawsaa tie hing chang tie yi: ‘Naa ca nama thlie, cuorasala a siyluo pachang va ung ciy; a mang ca nama mang, cuorasala khaapatama a cuo tapa kha pachang va ung ciy,’ na ta'a yi, a ta.

Hingpa cawsaa tie ta ama ming ta mang lipa yi ta, ama naa ta naathlie lipa yi ta, ama pathiypalung ta pachang lipa yi ta, a vya pali'a yi te patluo sapa ama cuo li riypata, ama pathiypalung kha paping tie, ama naa kha parue la, ama ming kha pahruv tie yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata kama ta, “Vya Abyipakhacuo te ma?” i ta. Cakhutaata ama ta: “Khypuv chunglie ahunghmuo aw li pata a ruena te, ing chunglie ahunghmuo aw li pata ruo kha a duokaringna te,
Abyipata cawsaa mekaa kha luohlaa luo a pasi diyna te yi, ruo hing a cakingna te, ina ta.

Capa ruo lie ca cawsaa pahraa lie pakha amaa ngaa zawta, myi ta rue pakhaa pata a cuo aa, Ama hupatyipa mathliy kung a caahming thabaw aa ngaapa haa khata a cuo aa.” Capa caahming ca na pathepa saciy cata a cuo.

Uzziah sacapaa Jotham sacapaa Ahaz ta Judah siepahruo a hrie ning kha Siria siepahruo Rezin hne Israel ming Remaliah sacapaa Israel siepahruo Pekah ta Jerusalem a du riypata ama sithaw. Cuorasala te khu va yi.
Siria ca Efraim hne tana amaa daahne tapa kha David ingchungkhue ta ama thyi tiyta Ahaz pathiypalung hne a cawsaa zaw pathiypalung ca thliy ta atuv thingkung a cahangpa haa khata aa cahang.

Cakhutaata Abyipata Isaiah kyihuo khata, nama hne na sacapaa Shear-jashub hne khata Ahaz a taw riypata si tie ung. Cawpasuv re a hriepa paa lu luo sinapa luopuv lepa, cungluo tiy-ang tiyluopuv a chuona lie kha namaa taw aa.

Cakhutaata ama kyihuo khata, a khuv a khuvpa thingthuv tlungpa suohning ta a cuopa Rezin hne Siria hne Remaliah sacapaa kawlie hingta a raaring pata a dieta tah aw tie, ciy khah, na thlaa zaw zang khah se.
Tahematapakieca Siria hne Efraim hne Remaliah sacapaa hingta ca raw yi te,
Sithaw ung sala Judah kha a du pata Jerusalem kha te ung sala, Tabeel sacapaa kha siepahruo ta tue ung siy ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingta: Hingpa hing ca a hmang'a vyi, vya cuo khu'a vyi.
Tahematapakieca Siria luv ca Damaskas ta cuo te, Damaskas luv ca Rezin ta a cuo. (Kung sawcaruv chunglie hing Efraim ca a chepatlaa diy'a te, mingphang ta tluo hmuo a tla'a vyi.)
Efraim luv ca Samaria ta cuo te, Samaria luv ca Remaliah ta a cuo. Zangna lie a cusa pata naa daa li kieca, a daa patlung khu'a vaciy.
Abyipata Ahaz kyihuo khata bie a ri pakhaa,
Abyipana Khazing kha pamangsana a hie tie, a ta.
Cuorasala Ahaz ta, a hie'a va ang, Abyipakha dyapasya'a va ang, a ta.
Cakhutaata Isaiah ta: “Vya David ingchungkhue, naathlie tie! Cawsaa palung na pachuo hlyitaw taata ma Khazing palung zaw na pachuo kalie aa?
Caacuonakawta Khazing ama hrahring na pamangsana caa pi aa. Mang tie, Lesaanung ta nu hnyi'a te sacapaa pakha a sa aa, a ma ca Immanuel ta pata ming a paphya aa.
Ama ca a pha lipa kha thaw te a phapa kha aa tlaw thena te ta cuehnung hne khyitiy kha a ning aa.
Tahematapakieca haatiypa ta a pha lipa thaw riypa hne a phapa a tlaw riypa kha a pachang hluota nama ta na ciypa siepahruo pahning tie ta ama uvpa ruo hing pyasepa ruo ta a cuo aa.

Efraim taata Judah aa chena te ta a tlung buo li liepa cahaapa ningkhue ca Abyipata nama hne na cawsaa zaw hne na ciypathla zaw cunglie kha a patlung sa aa. Hingpa ruvnaana hing Assiria siepahruo hmuo pata na a patlung sa aa,” a ta.
Capa cuo lie ca Abyipata Izipt cavaa hnaa luo a awpa mathu hne Assiria ruo lie a awpa khyi kha a pahyi ta a ku'a yi.
Iema bangkhuo ca a vaw'a yi te, cakucadaa lie hne alung karaw lie, ahling kung bangkhuo lie hne sahring tlena ruo bangkhuo lie kha ama aw diy aa.
Capa ning lie ca Cavaa huesuoluo taata aa hluopa suongutuv ta a cuopa Assiria siepahruo kha hmuo pata Abyipa ta nama luv lie suo, nama phyi hming hne nama hmya hming zaw kha aca ngu diy'a yi.
Capa cuo lie ca cawsaa pakha ta cuelaanung sakha hne tuv sahning a hnyi zaw ta,
cuehnung kha a hluvsa a papya nakawta ruo chunglieta aa ngaapa cawsaa mekaa khata cuehnung hne khyitiy kha lunghruo tlungsa pata ama dang aa.
Capa cuo lie ca ngu shekel thawkha a muopa mingsuv kung thawkha a awnapa hmang ca aphuv hne ahling ta ama bi aa.
Liy hne thi kha a phya'a yi te capa luo ca ama si aa, tahematapakieca ruo ca aphuv hne ahling ta a bi nakawta a cuo.
Atuv ta thlu tawnapa tluo bangkhuo ca aphuv hne ahling ta a bi nakawta capa luo ca ahunghmuo cakuo khing'a va ung ciy; cuorasala capa hmang ca cue zaw tuv zaw tlena hmang ta aa li aa.
Cakhutaata Abyipata, Lungphie kupa suokha kha la lah capa cunglie ca, “Maher-shalal-hash-baz,” ta pata cape tie.
Cakhutaata tehte riypata zang tluo aa tlapa, tluobyi Uriah hne Jeberekhiah sacapaa Zekhariah kha a la tie yi, ina ta.
Cakhutaata profet napuvnung kha awkhyi angte nu phya te sacapaa a sa. Abyipata kama kyihuo khata, Maher-shalal-hash-baz ta pata ming sa tie;
tahematapakieca haatiypa hingta “I paa” acuolikie “I nung” tapa a ri the hluota Damaskas hnyirungna hne Samaria hruosue bangkhuo ca Assiria siepahruo ta a sikhyi diy aa, ina ta.
Abyipata kama kha na chang pakhaa te:
Tahematapakieca hingpa cawsaa tie hingta duvsaa ta a langpa Shiloah cavaa kha khing lipa yi ta, Rezin hne Remaliah sacapaa hmiekunglie ciy yi te amaa cathang nakawta;
Abyipata Cavaa tiyselepa ta a cuopa, Assiria siepahruo hne a rungnaana kha nama cunglie patlung sa'a te, capa tiy ca a luopuv bangkhuo lie lang'a te, a tiykaw bangkhuo kha a lepakhung diy aa;
Judah ruo chung kha vya diy'a te, le hryly'a te nama rue te aca vya'a yi. Cakhutaata a pakepa a mathlaa khata ruo a ku a baa khata a buv diy aa, Vya Immanuel.

Niema, cawsaa zaw, nama palung a pakha ung la, ciyna ta a cathang tie ung; luohlaa ruo ming, naathlie tie ung; rie tuv riypata a ting pacie pata aw ung la, ciyna hne a cathang tie ung; rie tuv riypata a ting pacie pata aw ung la, ciyna hne a cathang tie ung!
Khue khuo pakhaw tie ung, cuorasala a hripa tana a cuo aa; bie kha ri tie ung, cuorasala a hmang'a vyi, tahematapakieca Khazing ca kiema'a liena a aw.
Abyipakuv ca kama cunglie cahra te, hingpa cawsaa tie luopuv kha i ziy li riypata a raaringna kha ina pi. A ripa ca:
Hingpa cawsaa tie ta khuekhuopakhawna ama tapa bangkhuo kha khuekhuopakhawna ta ra khah, cakhutaata a ciypa kha ciy ra khah, na thlaa zang khah se.
Cuorasala Cungnungce Abyipakha a pathe ta pata a paw tie; na ciypa ca ama ta cuo se, na thlaa a zang kie ama kawlieta cuo se.
Ama ca hmangpathepa ta cuo'a te, cawsaa ta amaa dupa alung, Israel ingchungkhue suohning cuota amaa pachiyna lung, Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie cuota sariy hne cyihyi tana a cuo aa.
Iema hrawlie cawsaa hluvpuv ca a pachiy'a yi te, a lie'a yi te ama kyi aa; cyihyi lie pa-uo'a yi te ama sikhyi aa.
I ziytuv tie zaw hrawlie kha hingpa tehtekhuona hing cataw la, pacuvna hing caakhe khe tie.
Kama ca Jakob ingchungkhue'a taata a hmie a nupa Abyipakha huo'a angte ama kha i nguopuo aa.
Mang tie, kama hne Abyipata ina pipa i saata zaw ca Zion Tluo lie a awpa Cungnungce Abyipa'a taata Israel ruo chunglie pamangsana hne kharuehaa hmang tana ama cuo.
Cawsaa ta nama kyihuo khata, “Thlaapa tie hne apyipa tie, a khi a upa tie kha hiehriy tie ung; cawsaa hingta, a hringpa cuopa hingta a thiypa ama khazing tie khana
pacuvna hne cawpana cuota ama hiehriy riypata a cuo, cuo va ma?” aca ta'a yi. Hing haa hingta a ripa tie ca mawdiy kha hmung hrahring'a va yi!
Iema ta capa ca palungriethyina hne nangdiy cangta ama law aa; ama nang a diy tiyta ama siepahruo tie hne ama khazing tie cunglie kha ama hi haa te chie ama sa. Avuo luo ama ang kie cuose,
alyi luo amaa bung kie cuose palungriethyina hne zingna, hne riethyivuosuona dyi kha hmung'a yi te, a chaapa zingna chung luo pangie pata na ama cuo aa.

Cuorasala riethyivuosuona chunglie a zaa awpa tie'a lie kha zingna aw'a va tli. Hluo ning ca Zebulun ruo hne Naftali ruo ca nangzaana na ama za ang, cuorasala a vaw riypa cuo lie ca hingpa riyliy kie ruo, Jordan huesuo ruo luo sina luopuv bangkhuo, hne ruohrang ming awna Galilee te khata pa-uvsathyina pi pata a cuo aa.
Zingna chunglie zaa cakuopa tie ta khena lepa hmung tli yi te, aa thuvpa zingna chunglie zaa awpa tie ta khena kha ama hmung tli.

Nama ta mingphang kha papungzaa sa yi cate, ama palung na patluosa hryly yi; sa la yi te ama palung a tluopa haata hne hruosue a re yi te ama palung a tluopa haa khata na hmiekunglie kha ama palung a tluo.
Tahematapakieca Midian ming chuo ning na za tuepa ruekhang haata ama phyapa, syihnaa haata ama letung lie amaa yapa, iema a hrisaapa sungpe kha na thlipa yi.
A dutuv a riephapa rieka tie phyipakaw bangkhuo hne thiyse aa hniepa caw bangkhuo ca myi ta rue pata ama cuo aa.

Tahematapakieca ma cuota haatiy pakha a puv; sacapaa pakha pi pata ma cuo; Ama ca malie a uvtuv byi ta a cuo aa; Ama ca kharuehaa Sing Changtuv, A Cahrapa Khazing, Chuozaa Paa, Thlaalungna Byi, ta pata a cuo aa.

A nawhnyina ca a le hryly aa, David byithude hne a pena chunglie ca diena a aw pari aa. Ama ta ata taa hingta cuo chuona te a pena ca biedangpa hne adangna ta pacu sa'a te aa daakhyi pari aa. Cungnungce Abyipata hingpa hing khingpasana hneta a tue aa.
Abyipata a bie kha Jacob cunglie pathlie te, capa ca Israel cunglie kha a tla;
Efraim hne Samaria lieta a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo ta capa ca ama pachang. Cuorasala iema ta hruotlena hne pyathuna pathiypalung hneta,
“Lungrue ing ca a cing, cuorasala uopa alung tana ma sa pakhaa aa; saikamor kung ca hu pata a cuo, cuorasala capa hmang lie ca sidar kung khana maa ling pakhaa aa,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Abyipata ama carie tie kha pasu yi te rie a pathu sa yi.
Ningchiyluo taata Siria ming hne ningtlaluo taata Filistin ming ta ama pakaa uo yi te Israel ca ama sie. Cuorasala a hihaana ca die vyi, a kuv ca a pazuo ngiethie kalie.
Cawsaa ca iema a tuvpa Abyipa'a luo kha a pali va yi, Cungnungce Abyipakha huv va yi.
Caacuonakawta Abyipata Israel ca ning kha chunglieta, a luv hne a lahmyi kha a cepachung diy'a te, tungkung ce hne phiepahlaa kung zaw kha a tepachung diy aa.
Uvthyi tie hne pa-uvsathyi tluo aa tlapa tie ca luv ta cuo yi te, lahmyi tapa ca hang a pacuvpa profet tie khata ama cuo.
Hingpa cawsaa tie luo ama pie riypata luo a chiytuv tie hne, iema ta luo ama chiypa tie ca ataw-amuona chungliena thuse pata ama cuo aa.

Capa ca Abyipata ama mingnu zaw cunglieta ngiechina a hnyi li nakaw hne, ama haaraa tie hne nunghlyi tie cunglie, kawpacuona a hnyi li nakaw tana a cuo. Tahematapakieca cawsaa mekaa hing Khazing a pachang lipa, hmang pha lipa a tuepa hne, bie pha lipa a ripa se tana ama cuo. Cuorasala a hihaana ca die vyi, a kuv ca a pazuo ngiethie kalie.
Tahematapakieca pha lina ca myi haata ie te, aphuv hne ahling zaw a kuo diy; ruo a chaa cenapa kha kuo te, myikhuv hneta cungluo kha aa cariythaw.
Ruo ca Cungnungce Abyipahihaana ta kuo te, cawsaa ca myi kuo riypa thing haata ama cuo; pakha hne pakha kha hietliena a chiysa a ta va yi.
Ama hmungpa bangkhuo kha karuo awsa pata ama ning, cuorasala ama nang diy kalie ngiethie te, ama rue me nguo the vyi; ama uvnu tie saa kha ama ce.
Manasseh ta Efraim kha cuose, Efraim ta Manasseh kha cuose amaa du, a pahlaw yi te Judah kha amaa du. Cuorasala a hihaana ca die vyi, a kuv ca a pazuo ngiethie kalie.
Phung pha lipa a tuepa, malie hrisaana phungluo a capepa niema ca thluechiy lipa tana nama cuo.

Riethyivuosuopa tie kha biedangpa taata hnang ama chaw riypa hne, siypasapa i cawsaa zaw ama cuvu paruvpa riypata cuose, nunghlyi tie hne haaraa tie kha ama chechiy chuv riypata a tuepa tana nama cuo.
Duotenapa ning, luohlaa taata rana aa vaw thueta, tuokhaatama namaa tue aa? Abyana hmung riypata ahung'a luo ma namaa ruo aa? Nama hnyirungna hing ahung'a lie ma nama chisiy aa?
Thaw a tlapa tie hrawlie kha a bung'a ung cate, thiepa tie hrawlie kha namaa lie aa. Cuorasala a hihaana ca die vyi, a kuv ca a pazuo ngiethie kalie.
Assiria ca thluechiy lipa tana a cuo, ama ca i hihaana sungpe, iema kuv lieta khuecahryi ca i hihaana tana a cuo.

Khazing a pachang lipa mingphang hne i hi naa pahaapa cawsaa tie kha a du riypata cuose; chuv riypa hne hruosue la riypata cuose, luopuv lie caakaw haata tlawpuo riypata cuose, bie pi yi angte i pathlie yi.
Cuorasala capa ca ama aa tingna ta cuo vyi, a palung lie a ruepa ta zaw cuo vyi. Cuorasala a palung lie kha para riypa hne, mingphang hluvpuv pahli riypata aa ting.
Caacuonakawta ama ta: “I riebyi tie ca ama bangkhuo ta siepahruo cuo va yi ma?
Kalno khy ca Karkhemish khy haata cuo va ma? Hamath khy ca Arpad khy haata cuo va ma? Samaria ca Damaskas khy haata cuo va ma?
Jerusalem hne Samaria laata a le viepa kuvtuezuv a hnyipa pena tie kha i kuv ta a tepa haata,
Samaria hne a kuvtuezuv tie i tuepa haa khata, Jerusalem hne a kuvtuezuv tie kha tue li pata aw'a va ang,” a ta.
Abyipata Zion Tluo hne Jerusalem lieta a re kha a patlung tiyta, a pyathupa hne a hruotlepa Assiria siepahruo hne aa palena hne a hruotlena kha duo a te aa.

Ama ta: “I kuv thaazuo ta hingpa hing i tue, i singna ta i pachang; mingphang zaw ruoriy kha i hnyi, cakhutaata ama suethiy kha i chuv yi; byithude lie a tupa tie kha cuetungpa haata i depatyi diy yi.

I kuv ta mingphang zaw hnyirungna kha pavaa buv haata a hmung; thusepa pavaa tiy liypa haata, alyi cung bangkhuo lie kha liy angte, a mathlaa a thy nguopa, a pakaa a uo nguopa, hne a khi a u nguopa pakha hmuo aw va yi,” a ta.

Sungpe ta ama a patuvpa kha a cahangpa haata cuose, khuecahryi ta a hnyituv kha a calangpa haata cuose, ahryi ca ama a hmuopa cunglie kha aa pale the'a ma? Hluo ca a hmuotuv laata aa rithe vie the'a ma?
Caacuonakawta Lesyice, Cungnungce Abyipata a riephapa a rieka tie'a luo kha pasana a patlung sa aa, a rungnaana rawlie kha myi patiy'a te a kuo byalya aa.
Israel khena ca myi ta a li'a te, a Pathepa Khazing ca myihlaa ta aa li aa. Capa ca ta aa phuv hne aa hling tie kha ning kha chungta kuo'a te a paluo diy aa.
Aa tuvpuv hne a hnyirungsapa aa lyi rungnaana kha a pangpa hne a thlaapa hne khata Abyipata a para aa. Pasana ta cawsaa a parapa haa khata a para aa.
Aa tuvpuv lie aa ngaapa thingkungpa ca a cawsa nakawta haatiy pakha ta a ri diy khu aa.
Capa ning lie ca Israel ming aa ngaapa tie hne Jakob ingchungkhue tie ta iema a tuechiepa cunglie kha a buchuo'a va tli yi, cuorasala Israel Khazing Pathe, Abyipakha amaa buchuo hmisi'a tli.
Aa ngaapa tie, aa ngaapa Jakob phang tie ca a cahrapa Khazing'a luo kha ama vya kaa aa.
Na cawsaa Israel tie ca riyliy viehnang zaa ama ta raalaa pata, aa ngaapa tie dyina a vya kaa'a yi. Nama rana riypa ca biechina tue ciepa ta cuo te, aa dangpa tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca Abyipa, Cungnungce Khazingta biechina a tue ciepa haata alyi cung bangkhuo lieta rana ca a tlung aa.

Caacuonakawta Abyipa, Cungnungce Khazingta: Vya Zion lie a awpa i cawsaa zaw, Izipt ming ta aca za tuepa haa yi ta, Assiria ming ta ama sungpe hne khuecahryi kha caba yi te aca tuv tiy yi ta ciy lie ung ciy.
Tahematapakieca a ru hluota i hihaana ca chuo'a te, iema kha i para'a yi.
Cungnungce Abyipata a sungpe kha pahiesue'a yi te, Oreb lungpuv lie Midian tie a tuvpa haa yi khata, Izipt ming a tuepa haa yi khata a khuecahryi kha riyliy cunglie a calang aa.
Capa ning lie ca a hmangriy kha nama letung taata pachung pata cuo'a te, a ruekhang kha nama ruetung taata pachung pata a cuo aa. Rimmon taata sithaw te,
Ai luo a vya tlung tli; Migron lie kha va caluo yi te, a hmang kha Mikmash lie aa chi;
tluo alala luopuv lie kha va te yi te, Geba lieta zuo kha amaa ri. Ramah ca aa cathangsa, Gibeah ming Saul ca aa ruo.
Vya Gallim sacanung, khuosa ta khi tie! Vya Laishah, naathlie tie! Vya Anathoth, palie tie!
Madmenah ca aa ruo! Gebim khy ming ca abangna hmung vuo tana amaa ruo.
Hingpa ning lie hing Nob lie a pahy'a te, Jerusalem tluothlue, Zion Sacanung tluo kha maathung ta a panang aa.
Mang tie, Lesyice, Cungnungce Abyipata, ciy aa chiypa a cahrana ta thingce lepa kha a paching diy aa, aa suo cepa thingkungpa ca hu pata cuo'a te, aa pasuopa tie ca aa ne luo pachung pata ama cuo aa.
A chaa cepa tuvpuv thingkungpa ca a hryi ta hu'a te, Lebanon ca nang-uo aa chiypa a thingkungpa hne khata aa lie aa.
Jesse caahming taa khata thingchaw a kya thue aa, a thariy taata a ce a kya le aa.
Abyipathlaapa ta a cuopa, singna hne pachangna thlaapa, ruena pituv hne a cahrapa thlaapa, thesingna hne Abyipaciyzaana thlaapa kha a cunglieta a aw aa.
Abyipaciyzaa kha a tlechuo pata a cuo aa. A ming hmungna cakhawpa dyi ta bieripana tue li pata, a naa ta a thyina dyi ta bie chi'a vyi.

Cuorasala siypasa tie kha adangna hneta bieripa'a yi te, aa panepa alyi ming cuo khata aa khing aa nguosa pata bie a chipa'a yi; a pakaa taata a pyapa sungpe ta alyi kha chi'a te, a hmya taata a pyapa a huv ta a pha lipa tie kha a thie'a yi.
Adangna hne zang tluo atlana ca a se lieta aa saw aa.
Cahnie ca tuvtaata hneta aw hne'a yi te, kyiching ca mietaata hneta amaa bu hne aa; cuetaata hne chingdetaata kha aw pakhaw'a yi te, haatiyta khata a khie'a yi.
Cue hne cavaw ca tle hne'a yi te, ama taata kha amaa bu pakhaw aa; cue haa khata chingde ta sacuo kung a baa aa.
Ahnung a pazaw kaliepa haatiyta ca, a ca-ie cahrasapa pariy khue cunglie kha cang'a te, ahnung a pathlie baaningpa haatiyta ta calyize khue kha a capya aa.
I tluo pathepa bangkhuo cunglie ca, a para a pakyina aw'a va tli, tahematapakieca tiy ta riyliy a buvpa haata, alyi ca Abyipapachangna ta a bi aa.
Capa ning lie ca Jesse thariy ca cawsaa zaw cuota pamangsana ta aa daa aa; mingphang zaw ta ama kaw kha hiehriy'a yi te, a awna hmang ca a rungnaa aa.

Capa ning lie ca Assiria ruo, Izipt ruo, Pathros ruo, Ethiopia ruo, Elam ruo, Shinar ruo, Hamath ruo, hne riyliy kie ruo tie taata aa ngaapa a cawsaa tie kha khuo riypata Abyipata a kuv kha a pazu vie aa.
Ama ta mingphang zaw cuota pamangsana kha taa'a te, Israel ming, thawpa tie kha a pahmya'a yi, aa chepatlaapa Judah ming kha chuelyi kiy paliy taata a pakiy'a yi.
Efraim ta a hnyipa hietliena kha aw'a va tli, Judah ta a hnyipa a carie khingna kha thaw pata a cuo aa; Efraim ta Judah kha hietlie li tli'a pata, Judah ta Efraim kha a carie'a va tli.

Ningtlaluo ta a awpa Filistin ming kha tuv pakhaw'a yi te, ningtlaluo ta a awpa cawsaa tie hmang kha ama chuv pakhaw aa. Edom ming hne Moab ming kha a du'a yi te, Ammon ming ta iema ri kha amaa ngie aa.
Cakhutaata Abyipata Izipt riyliy palyi kha a para aa; a lingpa thliy hneta a kuv kha Cavaa cunglie a ti aa; cakhutaata capa ca che sariy ta che'a te, phyi ta te khu riypata a tue aa.
Caacuonakawta Israel ming Izipt ruo taata ama kya pya ning haa khata, aa ngaapa a cawsaa zaw cuo khata Assiria ruo taata luopuv lepa suokha a aw aa.
Capa cuo lie ca nama ta, Vya Abyipa, palungtluona bie na ica hluo aa, tahematapakieca kama'a lie na hi a haa raalaa pata, na hihaana ca die te, i hnaa ina panguo ciy.
Khazing ca kama naa khuotuv cuo te, ama kha a buchuo'a angte, ciy'a va ang, tahematapakieca AbyipaKhazing ca, i thaazuo hne i cahrana ta a cuo; ama ca naa khuotuv tana a cuo.
Nama ta khuona takhue taata tiy kha palungtluona hneta na the aa.

Cakhutaata capa cuo lie ca nama ta: Abyipakha palungtluona hluo ung la, a ming kha u tie ung; mingphang zaw hrawlieta a hmang tuepa kha pachang sa ung la, a ming cyicalang a cuopa kha pathyi sa tie ung.
Abyipapathuosana hlaa kha sa tie ung, tahematapakieca ama ta rungnaasa pata a hrie tli; alyi cung yalya ta ama ca pachang yi se.
Vya Zion, khuosa ta khi la palungtluona hlaa kha sa tie, Israel Khazing Pathe ca niema hrawlie aw te, a lesyipa tana a cuo.
Babilon hne aa patuv pata Amoz sacapaa Isaiah ta a hmungpa muocuo:
Tluo utlawpa suokha cunglie kha pangtaa suokha taa tie ung; byi tie thlake luo a ngie riypata ama kuv kha ti yi se.
Kama hrahring na i pathe sapa tie hne i palesakhyipa i rieka tie kha i hihaana re kha hrie riypata bie pi yi angte a ku yi ang.

Naathlie tie ung, cawsaa hluvsa puraa haata a tapa, tluo cunglie puraa ca! Naathlie tie ung, mingphang zaw'a nata pe ting ta a hmya pakhawna puraa puv ca! Cungnungce Abyipana rie a tuv riypa rieka tie kha a mangpasiele yi.
Chuelyi kha para riypata, Abyipahne a hihaanapa cehre ca luohlaa ruo, avuo dena taa tana amaa vaw.
Cuopasana hneta caa tie ung, tahematapakieca Abyipaning ca aa ngie mangtli; Lesyice'a taata parana haa tana aa vaw aa.
Caacuonakawta kuv bangkhuo ca a kanaa aa, pathiypalung bangkhuo ca a tiy ta lang'a te,

aa dyi ta a dyi'a yi te ama ciysa diy aa. Pangpa hne pathiypalung pasana ta patuv'a yi te, nupazi pasana a angpa canung haa khata ama cuo aa. Pakha hne pakha kha ciyna hneta kharuehaasa pata a mang'a yi te, ama hmie kha a setunglung diy aa.
Mang tie, Abyipaning ca hihaana hne pathiylingna hne tana aa hruosa pata aa vaw.
Avuo lie aasiy hne a aasiy phuv ta khena pi'a va yi; ning ca a kya chiy pata zing'a te, thlaapa ta a vaana kha pathlie'a vyi.

Chuelyi kha a pha lina kawlie duo te'a angte, cawsaa chiepa tie kha ama pha lina kawlieta duo i te'a yi; a pyathupa tie hruotlena kha pachuo sa'a angte, aa hruopa tie esetuechiena kha aa ne luo i pachung aa.
Cawsaa kha siy phapa laata ama sung vie riypa hne, Ofir siy laata ama sung vie riypata i tue aa.
Caacuonakawta Cungnungce Abyipahihaana ning lie hne, a ie ta a iepa a hihaana ning lie ca, avuo kha a cathang'a te, alyi ca a awna taata aa cahang pathla aa.
Saa a kapa a ciy nakawta a ruopa sasuv, acuolikie a pahmyatuv riypa a aw lipa tuv haata, cawsaa ca ama cawsaa piy luo kha kaa'a yi te, ama ruo luo kha amaa ruo diy aa.
Hmungpa cawsaa mekaa ca dawsa pata cuo'a yi te, patuvpa mekaa ca zueziy ta thie pata ama cuo aa.
Ama haaseta zaw ca ama ming hmungna lie kha, alyi lie vaachi pata ama cuo aa. Ama ing lie chechiy kha chuv diy pata cuo'a yi te, ama napuv zaw kha hruohra ta ama awhne aa.
Mang tie, iema a du riypata, ngu kha siysaa a ri lipa hne siy zaw a tlechuo lipa, Medes ming kha i patle sa'a yi.
Ama liy ta satlie tie kha ka paming'a yi te, haaseta cunglie kha nangduena hnyi li pata, haatiyta cunglie zaw kha ngiechina hnyi'a va yi.
Ruo ting zaw rungnaana, Khaldi ming ta amaa palesakhyipa, Babilon ca, Sodom hne Gomorrah khypuv, Khazing ta a za thaw ning haa kha tana a cuo aa.
Capa lie ca khysa pata cuo'a va tli, chuo bangkhuo ta ahunghmuo aw'a va tli yi. Capa hmang lie ca Arab ming ta ama thluodaa kha sa li'apa yi ta, tuvkhietuv tie ta ama tuv kha pabu'a va yi.
Cuorasala capa lie ca saruopa tie kha a bu'a yi te, ing chunglie ca a khi thepa saruopa zaw ama bi aa. Capa lie ca kala-uvpavaa zaw aw'a yi te, mie-khachie tie kha ama luo aa.
Ingsuo zaw lie kha hainaacahnie zaw khi'a yi te, Anuona ta za hmuopa ing tie lie kha cahnie zaw ama khi aa. A cuo ca aa ngiesa tli, a ning ca ru'a va tli.

Cuorasala Abyipa ta Jakob cunglie kawpacuona hnyi'a te Israel kha aa tlaw pakhaa aa, cakhutaata iema ruo lie kha a chi pakhaa'a yi; ruohrang ming ta vya pangie'a yi te Jakob ingchungkhue lie ca amaa vya pahlaw aa.

Mingphang hrangpa tie khata a bya'a yi te ama ruo luo kha ama paphya aa; Abyiparuo lie ca Israel ingchungkhue ca ta mingphang hrang tie kha siicanung hne siicapaa haa khata ama hnyi aa; iema kha sii ta a zaa da buopa tie ca iema ta sii ta a da'a yi te, iema a hrisaapa tie kha iema ta ama uv aa.
Abyipata niema kha pasana hne riethyi angna hne a ruvsa pata re aca pahrie sana taa yi ta adingna aca pi tiyta,
Babilon siepahruo kha nama bieke ta hing haa hingta nama ta aa: Hrisaatuv ca aa lie tli! ama pyathu esena ca a chuo tli!
Abyipana a pha lipa paa khuecahryi, uvtuv tie byikhuecahryi ca a thlipachung tli.
Capa ca ta cawsaa kha hihaana hneta, a huv pa-y te taw li pata a tuv yi. Mingphang zaw kha hihaana cangta a cadang li pata hrisaa yi te a uv yi.
Alyi cunglie ruo mekaa ca diena hneta aa pahy; alawna hne hlaa sa yi te ama khi.
Lebanon tluo lie saipres thing hne sidar thing ta: “Niema namaa lie taa yalya khata, kiema hu riypata ahunghmuo a vaw va tli yi,” ama ta.

Nama na tlung thue daw riypata Sheol ca aa lu. Nama bie a chang riypata athiykhy ming, chuelyi byi zaa cuopa bangkhuo kha a pathu yi. Mingphang tie siepahruo zaa cuopa bangkhuo kha, iema byithude taa khata a pathu yi.
Iema bangkhuo ta nama kha: “Ata ca nama zaw kiema haa tana na thaa a naa ra tli! kiema na malie na lu tli!” aca ta'a yi.
Na rungnaana hne tingtuolepa ueryi zaw ca, Sheol luo na pathla pata a cuo tli; thulung ca na rawlie a padie cate, na cung taata cuokarie ta aca buv.
Vya Dyivaa Aasiy, Mawdiy sacapaa! tuokhaatama vuoruo taata na za tla? Nama, mingphang zaw aa ne luo a pathlapa! tuokhaatama alyi luo aca za thaw yi?
Na palungruv lieta na ripa ca, “Vuoruo luo khiy i kie aa; Khazing aasiy zaw cungluo khiy ta i byithude hing i calang aa; Zafon tluodaw, ahmyana tluo cunglie khiy i tu aa;
Amyi daw luo khiy kie'a angte, kama hne kama kha Cungnungce haata i tue aa,” na ta.
Cuorasala nama ca dena a hnyi lipa khue, Sheol luo na aca pachung yi.
Nama caa hmungpa tie ta ca mang'a yi te ama rue syalya khutaata: Hingpa cawsaa hing alyi kha cahang te, pena zaw a cathang sapa kha cuo va ma?
