Chuelyi kha viehnangruo haata tue te, a khypuv zaw a para diypa, thaw a pathlapa tie kha ing luo a pathlie pakhaa buo li tlipa paa kha cuo va ma?” aca ta'a yi.
Mingphang tie ama siepahruo bangkhuo ca, ama thluo cyicuo lie kha rungnaana hneta ama laa aa;

cuorasala nama ca, duv aa chiysapa, a thiyciepa a thuvpa haa khata, na thluo taata thaw pata na cuo aa. Zueziy ta dawsapa, alung khue luo pathlapa, riyy zaw khata ca pahlaw yi te, phyi ta tlawpuopa riyy tana na cuo.
Nama ca iema hneta paby hne pata cuo'a vaciy, tahematapakieca na ruo kha para cate, na cawsaa kha na thie yi. Hmang pha lipa a tuepa ciypathla ca, khatiy tahmuo a ming ri pata cuo'a va tli!
A paa suena kawlie khata a sacapaa zaw thiena riypa kha tingtuo tie ung, alyi a hnyipa pakha hmuo aw khah tli yi se, khypuv zaw sa pata chuelyi kha bi khah tli yi se.
Cungnungce Abyipana, thu'a angte na iema kha i du'a yi, Babilon ca a ming hne aa ngaapa tie kha cuose, a samingsahlaa zaw kha cuose i pahli diy'a yi, a ta.
Cungnungce Abyipana, a awna hmang kha saakuv zaw awna hmang ta tue'a angte, tiy-ang zaw awna hmang ta a cuo aa, cakhutaata parana ingphiy ta i phiy diy aa, a ta.
Cungnungce Abyipata chie a sapa ca: I rue paciepa haa khata a cuo aa; I khuekhuo paciepa haa khata a vya cuo aa:
I ruo lie hingna Assiria ca i thlipachung aa, i tluo cunglie hingna i phyi ta i chaapuo aa; a ruekhang kha iema'a taata la pata cuo'a te, ama letung lie hmangriy zaw kha lapa pata ama cuo aa.
Hingpa hing chuelyicung yalya cuota tingtuo pata a cuo; mingphang zaw bangkhuo cung luo, pazuopa kuv tana a cuo.
Cungnungce Abyipata a tingtuopa ca, ahungma a para khu aa? A kuv kha a pazuo mangtli, ahungma a da pakhaa khu aa?
Siepahruo Ahaz a thiynapa kung lieta a hmungpa bie ta a cuo.

Niema caa tuvpa yi sungpe kha a tli nakawta Filistin ming bangkhuo ta nama palung tluo khah se, tahematapakieca khapa pariy phang chung taa kha tana calyize a kya pya aa, a chungtaata a kipa ca aa zu thepa myi pariy tana a cuo.
A siy pasa cepa tie kha ning riypa hnyi'a yi te, a vuosuopa tie kha aa bangsa pata amaa zie aa; cuorasala na ciyhruo kha cakuo ta thiy'a yi te, na cawsaa aa ngaapa tie kha i thie diy'a yi.

Vya thlake, cuopasana hneta caa tie, Vya khypuv, khi la caa tie, Vya Filistin ming bangkhuo, ciyna chunglie a cathang tie ung! Tahematapakieca chaluo taata myikhuv za khuv te, iema phuv lieta luo a viepa aw va yi.
Filistin ruo taata biephyatuv ca tuokhaatama palie pata a cuo aa? “Abyipata Zion kha a padaa, a cawsaa hrawlie vuosuopa tie ca, a chunglieta canawna ama hmung aa.”
Moab hneta aa patuvpa bie ta a cuo.
Dibon ca aa suona hmang, biena-ing luo khana caa riypata a khaw, Moab ming ca Nebo khy hne Medeba khy khana ama caa. Ama luv bangkhuo kha a pamyi yi te, ama hmyahming kha amaa ngu diy;
luopuv lie kha buri pang a buv yi te, ing cunglie hne cawsaa zapuv ahmyana hmang lie kha caa yi te mingthliy hneta amaa paci.
Heshbon hne Elealeh ca khi yi te, ama ueryi ca Jahaz te aa thyi; caacuonakawta Moab rieka tie zaw, ama thlaazang te amaa cathang.

Moab cuota i palung a pasa hringhruo, Zoar luo kha amaa ruo, Eglath-shelishiyah luo khana amaa ruo. Luhith luo kha ama caapuole pata ama sithaw; Horonaim luopuv cunglie kha ama rana kaw kha muochie ama sale;
Nimrim tiy ca ky te, aphuv ca a caa, a kya pu thaapa aw vyi, aphuv hringpa aw va tli.
Caacuonakawta ama hnyipa bangkhuo kha phyale pata, paasung kung cavaa kha te amaa nang.
Caana ueryi ca Moab ruo chung kha aa thyi diy; Eglaim te, hne Beer-elim te khata aa thyi.
Tahematapakieca Dibon tiy ca thiy ta a bi; Dibon cunglie ca capa laa cata a hluv vie tana i patlung kalie aa, aa ruopa Moab ming hne aa ngaapa ruo ming cunglie kha chingde na i patlung sa aa.
Ruo uvtuv'a luo kha tuvtaata zaw kha paphya tie ung, Sela taa khata, viehnangruo luopuv khata, Sacanung Zion tluo luo ca paphya tie ung.
Arnon cavaa kielie a awpa Moab sacanung zaw ca a buv parapa pata pazupa pavaa haa tana ama cuo.
“Ruena malie pi tie, biedangpa kha pa-aw sa tie; ningchung ningling lie kha, zuo haata na ningdiy padiy tie yi; thawpa tie kha nu yi la, ruvna taata a ruopa tie kha dung khah yi;

thaw pata a cuopa Moab ming kha, nama hrawlie pa-aw sa tie ung; paratuv kuv taa khata, canawna pi tie ung,” ama ta. Hrisaatuv a aw li tli taata hne parana kha die'a te, a paruvpa tie kha ruo chung taata ama vievuv diy taata;

cakhutaa cata David thluodaa chunglie, aa hmangpa duena chunglie kha, byithude kha patu pata cuo'a te, aa hmuopa tue riypata a catlipa a phapa, biedangpa a huvpa uvtuv ca, zang tluo atlana hneta aa tu aa.
Moab hruotlena kaw kha ma thyi tli, kha tluv tama a hruo a tle! A pyathuna, a hruotlena, malie a esena hne, aa palena tie ca aa lie tli.
Caacuonakawta Moab ca caa se, cawsaa bangkhuo ta Moab muochie kha sa yi se. Niema malie ta te karuepa Moab ming, Kir-hareseth mingsuv thyi caapa namaa sung tli nakawta caa tie ung.

Tahematapakieca Heshbon lie lu zaw ca caavung diy tli te, Sibmah mingsuv kung ca aa uv diy tli; mingphang zaw byi tie ta ama pariy tawpa ca aa uv diy tli, luo kha ca a mingsuv kung ca viehnangruo chunglie kha zaa zuo te, Jazer te a za chiy, ruohrang te ta zaa zuo taw te, riyliy kha a si pakhung.

Caacuonakawta Jazer kha caakhyi angte, Sibmah mingsuv kung kawlie kha i caa; Vya Heshbon hne Elealeh, i mingthliy tana ica paci yi, tahematapakieca na thingthyi luna kawlie hne, na sa lana kawlieta na khina ca a die tli.

Palungtluona hne alawna ca, thingthyi diedung taata thaw pata cuo te, mingsuv diedung lieta hlaa sa va tli yi, ueryi paring va tli; mingsuv aciyna lie a ciytuv aw va tli yi; mingsuv lu cuo ning khina pu zaw a duo tli.
Caacuonakawta i palung ca Moab cuota cuose, i hringna ca Kir-heres cuota tingtuolepa haata a paring aa.
Moab ta ama hne ama riethyi a pi te, thlaachuo riypata aa suona hmang, hmangpathepa luo aa ngie tiyta a hlue tling'a vyi.
Hingpa hing Moab kawlieta Abyipaa za ripa bie tana a cuo.

Cuorasala ata hing ca Abyipata, aa hluopa rehrietuv tie kung ripa haata, kung thung chunglieta, Moab rungnaana ca pachung pata a cuo aa. A cawsaa hluvsa chung taa khata a cawta dyi a ngaa'a yi te, ama thaa a cawsa aa.
Damaskas hneta aa patuvpa bie ta a cuo. Mang tie, Damaskas ca khypuv ta cuo'a va tli, chechiy rapa papungna tana a cuo aa.
A khy tie ca chuozaa ta pyase pata ama cuo aa; iema ca sahring tlena hmang ta cuo'a yi te, a bu'a yi te ahungtahmuo a cade'a va yi.
A riekhuopiehu zaw ca Efraim taata ama vie aa, pena zaw kha Damaskas taata ama vie aa; aa ngaapa Siria ming kha, Israel ming saata zaw rungnaana haata ama cuo aa, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.
Capa ning lie ca Jakob rungnaana ca pachung pata cuo'a te, a thuna zaw kha a zue aa.
Aa daapa sakung kha a uotuv ta uo te a pahmyapa haata hne, Refaim Bawphie lieta samang ama thangpa haa kha tana a cuo aa.

Samang thangpa ca a cawta dyi a ngaa'a te, olif thyi kha ama cakhaw tiyta, a ce daw lie thyi hning thyi thung aa tuopa haata, a ce lepa daw lie thyi paliy thyi pangaa aa tuopa haata a cuo aa, ta pata, Israel Khazing, Abyipata a ri.
Capa ning lie ca cawsaa ta iema a Satuv kha a thyi'a yi te, ama ming ta Israel Khazing Pathe'a luo kha ama mang aa.
Iema ta bienatluophie kha a thyi'a va tli yi, iema kuv ta ama tuepa, iema kuvdaw ta ama tuepa, Asherah tung hne rangpa-ue bienatluophie kha mang'a va tli yi.
Capa ning lie ca a cahrapa ama khypuv tie ca Israel ming kawlieta Hiv ming hne Amor ming ta amaa ruosepa hmang haa khata a utlaw diy aa.

Tahematapakieca caa khuotuv yi Khazing kha thaw ung cate, nama canawna Lungpuv kha a thyi va tli ung ciy; caacuonakawta, nama ta khing aa chiypa kung kha a ling cate, ruohrang ming khazing kha naa tue raalaa pata;
naa ling ningpa ta pale sa cate, na tuv ningpa ta na papaa sa raalaa pata; a thyipaa kha na la riy aw li'a pata, ngiechina hne patluo khu lipa pasana na na ang aa.
Thluechiy lipa tana a cuo. Cawsaa hluvsa puraa paringpa, ama puraa ca riyliy khalung a thy tana amaa thy! Thluechiy lipa tana a cuo. A cahrapa tiy a hrungpa haa tana amaa hrung!

Mingphang zaw ca tiylaw lepa a hrung tana amaa hrung, cuorasala ama ta chuo'a yi te, luohlaa luo kha amaa ruo aa, tluo cunglie thliy ta a phyapa savie haata hne, thliysung ta a pahiepa buvcing khuv haa tana ama cuo.
Zuoluo ta, ciy aa chiy hringhruopa! Maw aa vaw hluo ta ca aw va tli yi. Hingpa hing ca kiema malie tuv yi te, malie a chuvpa tie cuvu tana a cuo.
Thluechiy lipa tana a cuo. Ethiopia cavaa zaw huesuo lie ama thlaa a cakhawpa ruo,

tiy cunglie phiepahlaa ta sapa tiypalaw ta, luosituv zaw a pathlie nguoluopa ruo! A catlisapa biephyatuv zaw, cakuo tie ung, a dang a suo te a vang a tluepa, luohlaa luongie cawsaa ta ama ciypa, a thaaruv te tena a hmungpa, cavaa zaw ta a chepa ruo lie a awpa tie'a luo kha cakuo tie ung.
Chuelyi lie a awpa bangkhuo, niema, alyi lie a awpa bangkhuo, tluocung lie pamangsana aa daa tiyta, mang tie ung! Hmyakaa kha ama tung tiyta, naathlie tie ung!
Abyipana hing haa hingta naa chang: avuo pathepa lie a palingpa ning, sa hrie cuo ning ling chunglie amyi taata aduo haata, i awna taata a paruv ta ica za mang yi.
Mingsuv paa lang te a thyi lu hluo, a thyi a hming ciemuo ning khata, a ce vanapa cizung ta a nge kha vapachung'a te aa zepa a ce tie kha a hrang luo a palaw aa.

Tluocung lie a la a huvpa pavaa hne, alyi lie saruopa zaw cuo khata thuse pata ama cuo aa. A la a huvpa pavaa tie kha cuovuo ningta cuose, alyi lie saruopa bangkhuo ca thlasiy ningta cuose, iema cunglie ca ama aw aa.

Capa cuo lie ca Cungnungce Abyipa'a luo kha, lasaw ama vya cyi aa; a dang a suo te a vang a tluepa, luohlaa luongie cawsaa ta ama ciypa, a thaaruv te tena a hmungpa mingphang, cavaa zaw ta a chepa ruo lie a awpa, Zion Tluo, Cungnungce Abyipaawna hmang luo kha ama vya cyi aa.

Izipt hneta aa patuvpa bie tana a cuo. Mang tie, Abyipaca a catlisapa amyi kha a khang te na, Izipt ruo luo aa vaw. Izipt kuvtuezuv tie ca a awna lie kha a cathang yi te, Izipt ming pathiypalung ca ama chunglie kha a tiy ta a lang.

Izipt ming ta Izipt ming amaa du riypa khata pasu'a yi angte, pakha ta a hrangpa pakha kha cuose, ingpaa ta ingpaa kha cuose, khypuv suokha ta khypuv suokha kha cuose, pena suokha ta pena suokha kha aa du aa.
Izipt ming ama thlaapa ca iema chunglie kha vie'a te, ama tingtuona kha i kalaa sa diy aa. Iema ta kuvtuezuv hne a thiypa thlaapa kha cuose, a pyi thepa hne pacuo a thepa tie zaw kha bie amaa rue aa.
Izipt ming ca a tuechiesapa siepahruo kuv luo kha pi'a yi angte, a palung chiesapa siepahruo ta a uv'a yi, ta pata Lesyice, Cungnungce Abyipata a ri.
Nail cavaa lie tiy ca ama ky aa, cavaa ca ky'a te a caa aa;
a cavaata tiy ca thuv'a yi te ama pahnuo aa. Izipt lie Nail vaapie tie ca cawle'a yi te ama ky aa, phiepahlaa kung hne aphuv zaw kha ama hmaw diy aa.
Nail cavaa athaalie hne Nail cavaa kie lie ca a hrinapa hmang a aw patlaw aa. Nail cavaa kie lie ciy cyina hmang bangkhuo ca caa diy'a te, thliy ta phya'a te a vie aa.
Nail cavaa lie ngaa vaa pata hne kyipa pathla pata, a riy a cawpa tie ca amaa ngiy aa; tiy lieta asue a repa tie zaw ama palung a rasa aa.
Palaa papyana lie re a hriepa tie ca ama palung rasa'a te, pangtaana lie re a hriepa tie ca ama nang a uo aa.
Pang a taatuv tie ca ama nang uo'a te, vie a hluepa tie ca ama ngie a chisa aa.

Zoan byi tie ca a ngaa suesaapa tana ama cuo; Faro ruenapituv tie ta ruena ngaapa kha ama pi. Tuokhaatama Faro kyihuo khata, “Kama ca mingsing pakha tana i cuo, hluo ning siepahruo tie ciypathla tana i cuo,” na ta the?
Mingsing tie ca ata hing khaapaliema ama aw? Cungnungce Abyipata Izipt a du pata, tuokhaapa tingtuona ma a hnyi tapa kha, ca chang yi sala ca pachang sa yi se.
Zoan byi tie ca ama ngaa ciemuo, Memfis byi tie zaw cawsaa a dungpa tana ama cuo; iema mingphang luochiytuv tie na, Izipt a pasi sa chie yi.
Abyipana iema hraw luo kha, a tawmuona thlaapa a bya yi; caacuonakawta iema ta Izipt kha a pariypa ta a viele te a paliylepa haata, a tuepa mekaa kha ama patue sa chie diy.
A luv cuose, a lahmyi cuose, tungkung acuolikie phiepahlaa kung ta, Izipt cuota khaapahmuo tue khu'a vyi.
Capa ning lie ca Izipt ming ca canung haa khata cuo'a yi te, Cungnungce Abyipata iema a du pata a kuv a cabapa kha ama hmung tiyta, aa cathang ta amaa cathang aa.
Cungnungce Abyipata Izipt ruo a du pata a tingtuopa kawlie khata Judah ruo ca Izipt ming cuota ciy aa chiy pata a cuo aa.
Capa ning lie ca Izipt ruo lieta Kanaan ryi a cyipa khypuv suopangaa aw'a yi te, Cungnungce Abyipari a ngie riypata chie amaa sa aa. Capa tie hrawlie khypuv suokha ca Ning Khypuv ta pata a cuo aa.
Capa ning lie ca Izipt ruo liekhingkhuo lieta bienatluophie suokha aw'a te ruoriy lieta Abyipacuota lungbang suokha a aw aa.

Capa ca Izipt ruo chunglie Cungnungce Abyipacuota pamangsana hne pachangkhyina ta a cuo aa; hrisaana kawlieta Abyipa'a luo kha ama khi tiyta khuotuv kha pathliepa'a yi te ama cuota a daa'a te a palaw sa'a yi.

Abyipata ama hne ama kha Izipt ming ca a pachang sa'a yi te, Izipt ming zaw ta ama kha ama pachang aa, hriykhungrina hne myirue panaana ta amaa bie aa, Abyipa'a lie kha biekuona tue'a yi te, ama biekuona haata ama hrie aa.
Abyipata Izipt kha a tuv aa, tuv'a te a patluo sa aa; iema ta Abyipa'a luo kha vya kaa'a yi te, paa ama kiepa kha naathlie'a yi te a patluo sa'a yi.

Capa ning lie ca Izipt taata Assiria luo kha luopuv lepa suokha a aw aa. Assiria tie ta Izipt luo kha a vaw'a yi te, Izipt ming ta Assiria luo kha ama vaa aa. Izipt ming ca Assiria ming hne khata abiena ama tuehne aa.
Capa cuo lie ca Israel ca Izipt hne Assiria tie'a lie kha a pahlaw'a yi te, alyi ming hrawlie thluechiy ta a cuo aa.
Cungnungce Abyipata thluechiy a pipa ta cuo'a te, “I cawsaa Izipt, hne i kuv ta i sapa Assiria, hne i ru ta a cuopa Israel ca thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue,” a ta'a yi.
Assiria Siepahruo Sargon ta a pathliepa Assiria riekabyi le cepa ca Ashdod luo kha a vaw te, a du te a lanapa kung lie,

capa cuo lie ca Abyipata Amoz sacapaa Isaiah kyihuo khata, “Si la, na sesie lieta na buri pang kha thlie la, na phyi lieta phyipakaw kha thlie tie,” a ta. A ripa haata tue te, a thliehripa ta hne a phyi hri pata aa khie.
Cakhutaata Abyipata, “I sacapaa Isaiah ta Izipt hne Ethiopia a duna pamangsana hne pahmungsana ta a thliehripa ta hne a phyi hri pata kung thung chung aa khiepa haa hingta,
Izipt ming nang pazaa riypata Assiria siepahruo ca Izipt ming hne Ethiopia ming kha a le a caw ta li pata ama thliehripa ta hne ama phyi hri pata, ama lakaw hmuo pahruv li pata aa chiyle'a yi.
Cakhutaata amaa nguopuona ta a cuopa Ethiopia hne ama hruotlekhyipa Izipt kawlie kha ama nang ta uo'a te amaa kalaa aa.

Capa cuo lie ca riyliy kie ruo lie a awpa tie ta, ‘Mang tie ung, maa nguopuopa hne Assiria siepahruo kuv taata law riypata abyana ma hiepa tie cungliena hing haapa hing a tlung de! Khaapa luo ma maa ruo aa?’” ama ta aa.
Riyliy ruocaapa hne aa patuvpa bie. Negeb a phiy diypa thliysung haata, ruocaapa taata aa vaw, ciy aa chiypa ruo taata.

Ciy aa chiypa muocuo na ina pahmung sa; malie a dungpa ta malie kha ama dung, paratuv tie ta ama para. Vya Elam, sithaw tie, Vya Media cadung tie; ama ta a papuvpa ahrungna bangkhuo ca i pachuo sa aa.
Caacuonakawta i sesie na a pasa; khuosa tana a pasa, nupazi pasana a angpa canung haa tana a pasa. I thyi khu li riypata i bung, i hmung khu lina te ta i zingmaa.
I luv na ina pahie, i ciy tuv pata na i cathang; zuoluo ningtlacaw i vuopa khana i cuota ciyna ta a vya li.
Iema ta cabya kha ama pachie, cabya khuv kha ama phaa, ama ning, ama dang. Riebyi tie zaw, thu ung la phya kha hna tie ung.
Hing haa hingta Abyipata ina chang: “Cakuo la, rievetuv pakha va chi tie, a hmungpa kha pathyi sa se.
Aa phie pata aruo a khangpa tie, laa a khangpa tie, kala-uv a khangpa tie, palung pasiysa pata naathlie yi se, palung pasiy ciemuo pata,” a ta.
Cakhutaata rievetuv ta khi te: “Vya Abyipa, rievena ingsuo liena i aw, chung zuo tana, ina chinapa yi re lieta, aa pazue pata i aw.

Mang tie, amaa vaw hue, aa phie pata a ruo a khangpa tie hue!” a ta. Cakhutaata ama ta palie te, “Aa lie tli, Babilon ca aa lie tli; a kuvtuezuv khazing bangkhuo ca alyi lie a lie tena aa zepatlaa diy,” a ta.
Vya i cawsaa, sacuo aciyna lieta zipa tie, Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing'a taata i thyipa khana niema kha ica pathyi sa yi.
Dumah hneta aa patuvpa bie. Cawsaa pakha na Sier taata naa u, “Rievetuv, zuo ca khaapama a lu? Rievetuv, zuo ca khaapama a lu?” ina ta.
Rievetuv ta: “Maw ca aa vaw tli, zuo zaw aa vaw aa. Na hiehriy khing kieca, hiehriy tie; a vaw pakhaa tie,” a ta.
Ase Ruochung hneta aa patuvpa bie. Khy a tlawpa, Vya Dedan ming, a cahruosapa viehnangruo lie khana namaa ri aa.
A tiy a hriepa tie cuo khata tiy vya cyi tie ung, Tema lie khy a sapa tie, rie ciy pata a ruopa tie kha sa pi tie ung.
Tahematapakieca iema ca zueziy, a baw taata amaa dapa zueziy taata cuose, amaa kyi tlipa liy taata hne, rie a tuvna taata a ruopa tana ama cuo.
Cakhutaata Abyipata ina changpa ca: Vie a hluepa tie rina haata, kung kha chunglieta Kedar rungnaana bangkhuo ca a chuo aa.
Liy ka a thepa Kedar rieka tie ca a cawta dyina a ngaa yi, Israel Khazing, Abyipata ina ta.
Muocuo bawphie hne aa patuvpa bie. Nama bangkhuo ta ing thlungkhuv luo kie riypa ca khaapatama a cuo?
A paringpasupa khypuv, aa nuo aa paapa khy, puraa hneta a bi pa khy. Thiepa na cawsaa tie ca zueziy ta thiepa cuo va yi, rietuvna lie a thiypa zaw cuo va yi.
Na uvtuv tie ca ama mekaa ta a ruo diy yi te, liy hne thi hmuo li pata patuv pata ama cuo. Aca hmungpa yi bangkhuo ca, luohlaa luo namaa ruo raalaa pata, patuv pata nama cuo.
Caacuonakawta, Luohlaa luo naa hyise tie ung, mingthliy hneta caa naase ang; i duepa cawsaa zaw parapa ama cuona kawlie hing, hnaa panguo naa zue khah ung.

Tahematapakieca Abyipa, Cungnungce Khazingta a hnyipa, muocuo bawphie lieta, a cali patlawna hne a chaapuo patlawna ning hne, a kalaa patlawna ning, khy dungkhuo lungruetlepie pacingna cuo hne, tluo zaw kha abyana hie pata khina cuo tana a cuo.
Elam ca lavaabya kha a vya yale te, aruole hne aruo rieka hneta a vya si, Kir ta aa phya kha pathla vyi.
A pha cepa na bawphie tie lie ca aruole na a bi, aruo rieka tie na a thlake lie kha adaahmang a la yi.
Judah khana a pahruv a pahaw. Capa ning lie ca Tuvpuv Ing lie cehre kha mang ung cate,
David khypuv lie dungkhuo a ra a kyi patlawpa kha nama hmung; cakhutaata aa ne tiy-ang lie tiy kha namaa pacung.
Jerusalem lie ing kha ri diy ung cate, khy dungkhuo pare riypata ing kha nama phi.

Tiy-ing hlungpa lie tiy kha pacungna riypata khy dungkhuo suohning tie alalalie kha tiy pacungna nama sa. Cuorasala capa hmang a tuepa kha mang va ung ciy, hluo ning taata capa hmang zaa tingtuotuv kha siysaa ri va ung ciy.
Capa cuo lie ca Abyipa, Cungnungce Khazingta, caa riypa hne a ngiy riypa, luv a pamyi pata buri pang a khuv riypata aca u yi;
cuorasala nama palung tluo te pyi nama tue pali, cue hne tuv kha thie ung cate, sa ning ung cate mingsuv nama dang. “Ning ung sala dang ung siy, tahematapakieca mawluo ca ma thiy aa,” nama ta.
Cungnungce Abyipana i naa lie naa chang: Hingpa nama pha lina hing ca nama thiyna te ta a ngiethe pata cuo'a va ung ciy, Abyipa Cungnungce Khazing, na a ta.
Abyipa, Cungnungce Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: A vaw la siepahruo ingchungkhue uvtuv Shebna'a luo kha cakuo tie, ama kha chang tie:
Hingpa lie hing khaapa tuena naw ma na hnyi? Hingpa aa suona lungkuo cunglie hing nama cuota thluo suokha naa ryi, hingpa lie hing ahung zaw ma na tieriy ta a cuo yi?
Abyipana khuosa ta ca pahe te luohlaa luo caa thaw'a nang. Khuosa ta ca patuv'a te,
ca pahe ca pahe'a te, hmang kupuv luo kha pungpalung haata ca pazu'a te, capa lie ca na thiy aa. Naa palesakhyipa naa ruole ca capa lie ca a lie'a te, na byipaapa ingchungkhue nangzaana ta a cuo aa.
Na zung taata ca papya'a angte, na re taata ica phie aa.
Capa ning lie ca Hilkiah sacapaa i changtaapa Eliakim kha ku'a angte,
na pang kha pabuv'a angte na tesaw kha i pasaw aa. Na nawhnyina kha ama kuv cung luo pi'a angte, ama ca Jerusalem lie a awpa tie hne Judah ingchungkhue tie cuota ama paa ta a cuo aa.
David ingchungkhue taw kha a letung cunglie chi'a angte, ama ta pahaw'a te ahungtahmuo khaa khu'a va yi; ama ta khaa'a te ahungtahmuo pahaw khu'a va yi.
A liy ta patuv sapa haata aa bangna hmang lie kha a cusa pata chi'a angte, ama ca a mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue pa-uvsathyipa byithude ta aa li aa.
Cakhutaata a mingchingmingvuo ingchungkhue hmangriy ta a cuopa bangkhuo, a samingsahlaa tie kaw, biphie cawta zaw mekaa, panuo taata a patha pata khazaa-ung te ta ama pathlie aa.
Capa ning lie ca aa bangna hmang lie khepuopa a liy kha a phi'a te a tla aa; cakhutaata a cunglie aa pathliepa bangkhuo ca ama ra diy aa; ta pata CungnungceAbyipata a ri.
Tair hneta aa patuvpa bie. Vya Tarshish tiypalaw zaw, caa tie ung, tahematapakieca nama riekhuopiehu ca parapa tana a cuo tli. Saipras taata amaa vya ngie tiyta, capa ca ama thyi.
Vya riyliy kielieta khy a sapa zaw, A dieta tah aw tie ung, Vya Sidon sungpalituv tie, nama biephyatuv tie ca riyliy kha te yi te,
riyliy lesapa cunglie kha ama aw; na ngukhyi ca Shihor a thyipaa tie hne, Nail ta a pavyipa sa kha tana a cuo; niema ca mingphang zaw sungpalituv tie tana nama za cuo.
Vya Sidon na nang zaa se, tahematapakieca riyliy na a ri, riyliy riekhuopiehu na a ri: “Kama ca nu phya buo va ang, saata zaw sa buo va ang, sacanung sacapaa zaw caw buo va yi ang,” a ta.
Izipt luo kha thuohlaa aa vya thyi tiyta, Tair kaw thuohlaa ama thyipa kawlieta ama thlaa a zangsa aa.
Tarshish luo kha va te tie ung, Vya riyliy kielie a awpa ruo tie, caa tie ung!
Hluo ning taata a zaa awpa palungtluona khypuv ta cuo va ma? Luohlaa luo khysa riypata a phyi ta a sikhyipa kha cuo va ma?
Byilakhuv zaw a pituv Tair a du pata ahungma khue a khuo? A sungpalituv tie ca siepahruo sacapaa tie, alyi ta a pa-uvsathyipa tie ta cuo va yi ma?
A rungnaana kha a ling pazue riypa hne, alyi ta a pa-uvsathyipa tie kha ama nang pazaa riypa tana, Cungnungce Abyipata hingpa hing a tingtuo.
Vya Tarshish tiypalaw zaw, nama ruo luo kha si tie ung, tiypalaw a dingna hmang tlaw va tli.
Ama ta riyliy cung luo kha a kuv va pazuo te, pena zaw kha a cahang yi; Abyipata Kanaan hne aa patuv pata a riekhuopiehu zaw para riypata bie a pi yi.
Ama ta: Vya tuechiepa Sidon lesaa pathenung, na palung tluo'a va tli, thu la Saipras luo kha si tie; capa lie ca hmuo a pahy'a vaciy.

Khaldi ming ruo kha mang tie! Assiria ming ta cuo va yi; Babilon ming tana ama cuo. Iema na Tair kha saruopa awna ta a tue yi. Iema ta ama ingsuo kha sahnue yi te, a siepahruo ing kha ama pacingpa, iema na ama kha a para yi.
Vya Tarshish tiypalaw zaw, caa tie ung, tahematapakieca na riekhuopiehu ca para pata na a cuo tli.
Capa cuo lie ca Tair ca kung sawsariy chung, pakha siepahruo cuo chung maw pata a cuo aa. Kung sawsariy a chuona lieta Tair ca siyhrawna hlaa lie haa hingta a cuo aa.
Tingtuolepa kha a la lah, khy chung lie kha a khie tie, nama, maw tlipa siyhrawnung! A thyi pakhaapa na cuo riypata, hlaa kha sala tingtuo hneta patla tie.
Kung sawsariy a chuona lie kha, Abyipata Tair kha a vya parie aa. A sungpalina luo kha kaa'a te, chuelyi ruo ting lie pena bangkhuo hne khata a siyhraw pakhaa aa.

A sungpalipa chechiy bangkhuo hne a muo kha Abyipa'a luo pihluo'a te, a hmungpa a mie kha a pacung'a vyi. Cuorasala Abyipahmiekunglie a awpa tie kha a sungpalina taa khata sa hne caw phapa kha lunghruo tlungsa pata a ring'a yi.
Abyipata alyi ca a hripa ta chi'a te a paduothling aa, alyi a cung kha para diy'a te, a cawsaa tie kha a chepatlaa'a yi.

Capa ca cawsaa cunglie kha cuo'a te, tluobyi cunglie zaw a cuo ra aa; sii cunglie kha cuo'a te, a ziypaapa cunglie zaw kha a cuo ra aa; lesaanung cunglie kha cuo'a te, a ziynungnung cunglie zaw kha a cuo ra aa; a calyipa cunglie kha cuo'a te, a zaapa cunglie zaw kha a cuo ra aa; ducyi a pipa cunglie kha cuo'a te, ducyi a lapa cunglie zaw kha a cuo ra aa; amie a ningpa cunglie kha cuo'a te, amie a pipa cunglie zaw kha a cuo ra aa.
Alyi ca a hri karue pata chi pata cuo'a te, chuv diy karue pata a cuo aa; Abyipana hingpa bie hing a ri.
Alyi ca caa te aa uv, chuelyi ca a nang buosa te aa uv; avuo ca alyi hneta a nang a buo pakhaw.
Alyi ca a cunglie khy a sapa tie rawlie kha a pyalyi; tahematapakieca iema ta phungbie kha ama para, ziyphung kha para yi te, chuozaa biekuona kha ama para.
Caacuonakawta chiesana ta alyi kha buv te, a cawsaa tie ca ama suena muo kha ama ang; caacuonakawta alyi lie khy a sapa tie ca cungbung yi te, cawsaa cawta dyi amaa ngaa.
Mingsuvtiy ca ky te, mingsuv kung ca aa uv, a palung a tluopa bangkhuo ca ama huv dyi ama pa-y.
A phasapa akhangtaata ueryi ca die te, jubilee puraa zaw a die, a phasapa tingtuo ueryi zaw a die.
Hlaa sapuo pata mingsuvtiy kha dang'a va tli yi; zuvre ca a dangpa cuota a kha aa.
Khypuv rapa ca a duokaring, ing mekaa lie ingchiypakaa bangkhuo ca aa hre diy.
Mingsuvtiy a aw li nakawta luopuv lie ama khi, palungtluona ca a li tli, alyi alawna ca pavie pata na a cuo tli.
Khypuv ca a duokaring pata thuse pata a cuo tli, thlake bangkhuo ca phawpahaw diy pata na a cuo.
Tahematapakieca alyi lie hne, mingphang zaw hrawlie kha, olif thyi ama cakhaw ning haata hne, mingsuv thyi chuo te a mang ama thang ning haa tana a cuo aa.
Ama ue pachiy yi te, palungtluona hneta hlaa ama sa; ningtlaluo taata Abyipalesyina kaw kha ama khi.
Caacuonakawta ningchiyluo lie kha Abyipaama parungnaa sa; riyliy kie ruo tie lie kha, Israel Khazing Abyipakha ama parungnaa sa.

Alyi dena luo taata pathuosana hlaa ma thyi, aa Dangpa Khazing pathuosana kha ma thyi. Cuorasala kama ta, i tlingkaduv tli, i tlingkaduv tli, bawchie ciemuopa tana i cuo! i ta. Cawsaa a lyipa tie ta cawsaa lyina re kha ama hrie, cawsaa ama lyina kha a ruv vie hryly.
Vya chuelyi cawsaa zaw, ciy aa chiypa, khue, hne cyihyi na caa huo thluo yi!
Ciy aa chiypa taata a ruopa ca khue luo kha tla'a te, khue chungtaata a kya pyapa kha cyihyi lieta aa uo aa. Tahematapakieca avuo thlaluo-aw tie ca a pahaw te, alyi hruopatu ca aa cahang.
Alyi ca kyichi te, a kepatlaa diy, alyi ca khuosa ta aa cahang.
Alyi ca sahmaa a pariypa haata a viele te, thluodaa haata aa cahang; a tuesuena ca a cunglie a riysa te, a lie'a te thu pakhaa khu'a va tli.
Capa ning lie ca Abyipata vuoruo lieta vuoruo cahrana a hnyipa tie hne, alyi lieta alyi siepahruo tie kha duo a te'a yi.
Iema ca khue chunglieta thaw a tlapa tie haa khata pahmya pata cuo'a yi te, thaw chunglieta ning hluvpuv khaakhung pata ama cuo khutaata, duo te pata ama cuo aa.

Cakhutaata thlaapa ca pathla pata cuo'a te, ning ca a nang a zaa aa; tahematapakieca Cungnungce Abyipaca Zion Tluo hne Jerusalem lie kha siepahruo cuo'a te, a uvthyi tie hrawlie kha a rungnaana a paluo sa aa.
Vya Abyipanama ca i Khazing tana na cuo; ica cyicalang aa, ica pathuosa aa; tahematapakieca nama ta kharuehaa hmang na tue, hluo ning taata na za tingtuopa kha zang tluo aa tla pata na patling sa.
Niema ta khypuv kha hnehnaw papungna hmang ta pali ung cate, khypuv dungkhuo kha nama para; ruohrang ming awna hmang ca khypuv ta cuo va tli, kha tiyta hmuo sa pakhaa pata cuo'a va tli.
Caacuonakawta a thaaruvpa cawsaa tie ta ca pathuosa'a yi te, malie ngiechi a the lipa tie ta aca ciy'a yi.

Tahematapakieca nama ca siypasa tie canawna ta cuo cate, riethyivuosuopa tie ama palung rie thyi ningta aca canaw yi, ama khysuv canawna hne, ama canawna ningdiy ta na cuo. Malie ngiechi a the lipa tie ca thlasiy thliychie haata cuo yi te,
ruohrang ming khi-una ueryi ca a caavungna hmang lie ning lingpa haa tana a cuo; amyi ningdiy ta ning lingna kha te cate, malie ngie chi a the lipa tie hlaasana ueryi ca a die.
Hingpa tluo cunglie hing Cungnungce Abyipata cawsaa bangkhuo cuota, sa pahuosapa hne a pathesa pata suepa mingsuvtiy hlungpa ta pyi a tue aa.
Cawsaa bangkhuo cunglieta pakhuvpa pang hne, mingphang bangkhuo cunglieta phaa pa pangphaa kha, hingpa tluo cunglie hing para'a te, thiyna kha chuozaa ta a paluo aa.
Cakhutaata Abyipa Khazingta, cawsaa bangkhuo mingthliy kha hruv'a te, a cawsaa zaw nangzaana kha alyi cung taa hingta a thaw aa; capa ca Abyiparipa tana a cuo.

Capa ning lie ca, Ama ca kiema Khazing tana a cuo; malie a khuo riypata ama khana ma huo, ta pata a cuo aa. Ama hingna kiema ta ma huopa Abyipata a cuo; ama khuona chunglie ca a lawpa hne palung tluo pata cuo mang sue.
Tahematapakieca Abyipakuv ca hingpa tluo cunglie hingna aa pahy aa. Sacuo kung ca caakaw lie chaapuopa a cuopa haata, Moab ming ca ama awna hmang lie kha chaapuo pata ama cuo aa.
Tiy a zupa ta tiy a zu riypata a kuv a pazuopa haata, ama ruo liekhingkhuo lie kha ama kuv ama pazuo raalaa pata, amaa palena ca a raw luo pachung pata a cuo aa.
A cusapa a lungruetlepie dungkhuo zaw ca pacing pata cuo'a te, alyi luo, buvcing luo kha pachung pata a cuo aa.
Capa ning lie ca Judah ruo lieta hingpa hlaa hing sa pata a cuo aa: A cahrapa khypuv ma hnyi; Khazing na dungkhuo thang hning sa khuopa haata tena malie a pi.
Thlake kha pahaw ung la, zangna lie a daapa aa dangpa mingphang zaw kha a ngie naase yi.
A palung aa hmangpa kha diena na pi, nama acaa ringchuo nakawta thlaalungna na pi.
Abyipakha chuozaa ta a ringchuo tie, Abyipa Khazingca chuozaa ta canawna lungpuv tana a cuo.
Aa suona lie a awpa tie kha aa ne luo a pachung yi; aa pasuopa khypuv kha aa ne lie a chi. Ama ta alyi te ta pachung yi te, buvcing luo a thaw yi.
Siypasa tie phyi, riethyivuosuopa tie phyi ta chaapuo pata na a cuo.
Aa dangpa tie luopuv ca aa phyi; Vya Khazing, nama ta aa dangpa tie luopuv kha na pame.
Vya Abyipa, na bieripana luopuv lie khana maca huo; na ming hne na mingpathuona ca ma palung ta a khing.
Zuo ta i palung ta aca vuo, i chunglie i hringna ta nama kha hmisi ta ica huv; tahematapakieca alyi lie bieripana na tue tiyta, alyi cawsaa tie hingta adangna kha ama pachang aa.
Cawsaa pha lipa tie kaw na pacuo tiy yi ta, adangna kha a cuv tlung va yi; adangna ruo lie hing hmuota pha lina khana ama tue ngiethie, Abyipalesyina kha hmung khu the va yi.
Vya Abyipa, na kuv kha na caba raalaa pata, iema ta hmung va yi. Na cawsaa zaw naa khingkhyina yi kha hmung yi sala, ama nang zaa se; na carie tie cuota na chipa myi khata iema ca kuo yi se.
Vya Abyipa, nama ta thlaalungna kha malie chipa'a cate, ma tue khupa bangkhuo hing, nama malie na tuepapa tana a cuo.
Vya Abyipa, ma Khazing, nama ri li pata na a hrangpa byi tie ta malie ama uv, cuorasala nama ming dyina ma pachang.
A thiypa ca hring pakhaa'a vyi; ningdiy zaw a diy pakhaa'a vyi; tahematapakieca nama ta para tli yi cate, iema a thyina riypa bangkhuo kha na paviepa diy tli yi.
Cuorasala Vya Abyipa, na mingphang kha na papungpazaa sa, na mingphang kha papungpazaa sa cate, pathuosa pata na cuo; na ruo kha a kuo bangkhuo ta na paku.
Vya Abyipa, palungriethyina chunglieta nama kha aca huv yi, na pasiypa-ya tiy yi ta, khuopuv ta thlaa ama chuo.
Nu a phyapa canung ta, a ningkhue aa ngie tiyta, tlangkhy ta pasa te, a thli a zuo te a caapa haata, Vya Abyipa, cahaaca tana na hmiekunglieta ma cuo.
Kiema ca nu phya pate, maa thli maa zuo, cuorasala thliy saata dyina ma sa. Alyi lie hing tena hmung lipa pata, chuelyi cu riypa hingta pakha hmuo puv va yi.

Na cawsaa a thiypa tie ca ama hring aa, ama riyy ca a thu pakhaa aa. Vya buvcing lie khy a sapa tie, thu ung la palungtluona hlaa sa tie ung! Tahematapakieca naa duodiy ca aphuv a papu sapa aduotiy haata cuo te, hluo ningta zaa thiypa tie kha alyi ta a pathu pakhaa'a yi.
A vaw tie ung, i cawsaa zaw, nama ingchung luo kha a ngie ung la, ingchiypakaa kha a khaakhung tie ung; Khazing hihaana a khungna te khata, cuo kha chung kha a nu tie ung.
Tahematapakieca Abyipana alyi cawsaa tie kha ama pha lina cuota duote riypata a awna taata a pya; a cunglie thiyse ama palangpa kha alyi ta paluosa'a te, ama thiepa tie kha nu'a va tli.
Capa ning lie ca Abyipata a camaale te a zulepa pariy Leviathan parapuv kha a lepa hne a thaaruvpa a zueziy ta duote'a te riyliy lie a awpa riyhre kha a thie aa.
Capa ning lie ca: Aa nuopa mingsuv diedung kawlie kha hing haa hingta hlaa a sa.
Kama, Abyipana a huotuv ta a cuo ang; tiy i bya pari. Ahungtahmuo ama para li riypata, chung hne zuo ta i huo.
I hi haa'a vyi. Ahling hne aphuv hmuo aw ra sala, rietuv riypata sihnue'a angte, myi ta i rue diy aa.
Aa bangta tah na chi naase tapa tana inaa ngie tapa kieca, kama hneta arena tue se, kama hneta arena tue se.
A vaw riypa cuo lieta, Jakob ca a thariy bang'a te, Israel ca pamang'a te a paa aa, cakhutaata chuelyi lie kha a thyi a bi aa.
Iema a tuvpa tie a tuvpa yi haa khata ama ta a tuv yi ma? Iema a thiepa tie ta ama thiepa haa khata iema ca thie pata ama cuo ma?
Hruohra ta papyana, ruo hrang luo papyana ta iema kha naa du yi; ningchiy thliy aa hruo cuo ning kha, a hihaana thliy kha a papha sa yi.

Caacuonakawta capa ca ta Jakob suena ca a pape sa aa, capa ca a suena thawpana a thyipaa ta a cuo aa: Bienatluophie tung zaw bangkhuo kha pacalung a diykariypa ta ama riechipa haata a tue thue ca, Asherah tung acuolikie rangpa-ue bienatluophie suokha hmuo a ngaa'a vyi.
Tahematapakieca dungkhuopa khypuv ca a duosa tli, a cawsaa tie ta thaw yi te ama pyase nakawta, ruocaapa na a lu tli; capa lie ca cuetaata zaw tle yi te, thinghnaa kha ce yi te amaa bu.

A ce lepa kha a rue tiyta, a cepachung pata cuo te, canung tie kha a vaw yi te, myi lie ama tiy. Tahematapakieca hingpa cawsaa tie hing pachangna a hnyi lipa tana ama cuo; caacuonakawta iema a tuetuv ta ama cunglie kha kawpacuona hnyi'a va yi, iema a satuv ta duena hnyi'a va yi.
Vya Israel cawsaa zaw, capa ning lie ca Abyipata Zufrates cavaa taata Izipt cavaata te khata sa hriepa haata niema kha pakha hnang pakha ta aca pahmya'a yi.
Capa ning lie ca hmyakaa lesapa kha tung'a yi te, Assiria ruo lie a viepa tie hne Izipt ruo luo a cadepa tie kha a vaw'a yi te, Jerusalem tluo pathepa lieta Abyipakha amaa bie aa.

Efraim pariyna hne hruotlena paapaapa pachiy, a puvthena hne a linghlaa-awna a uvle nguoluopa paapaapa, sa pahuopa ta a thupa tie, hne mingsuvtiy a pariypa tie luv cunglieta a awpa ca, thluechiy lipa tana a cuo!
Mang tie, Abyipata a lesyipa hne a thaaruvpa a hnyi; khysuv ari a lupa, paratuv thliychie, a cahrapa thliychie a lupa, a lepa tiy a lupa, a kuv tana alyi luo kha khuosa ta a za pazu'a yi.
Efraim pariyna hne hruotlena paapaapa pachiy ca phyi ta tlawpuopa tana a cuo aa.

A puvthena hne a linghlaa-awna a uvle nguoluopa paapaapa, sa pahuopa ta a thupa tie, hne mingsuvtiy a pariypa tie luv cunglieta a awpa ca, cuovuo hluo lie a hming taapa thyikuv haa tana a cuo aa; capa thyi a hmungpa ahung a cuo zaw, a kuv luo a chiy pahne ta a ning.
Capa cuo lie ca Cungnungce Abyipaca rungnaana paapaapa pachiy ta cuo'a te, aa ngaapa a cawsaa zaw cuota puvthena byilakhuv ta a cuo aa;
cakhutaata bieripana lie a tupa biedangpa thlaapa ta cuo'a te, khypuv thlake taata rie a du yi te carie a pakaa sapa tie thaazuo ta a cuo aa.

Iema zaw hing mingsuvtiy pariy pata ama luv zing te, zuvre a pariypa tana ama cuo; tluobyi hne profet zaw hing zuvre pariy pata ama luv zing te, mingsuvtiy ta a pamyapa tana ama cuo, zuvre a pariypa tana ama cuo; muocuo ama hmung ning zaw pariy yi te, bieripana lie kha bie ama ri chie.
Ama cabya ca paliy ta bi te, a pathenapa suv kha hmuo aw vyi.
“Ahung kha pachangna pacuv'a te ma, ahung kha bie ca a pasiepa aa? Ahnung a pathlie baaningpa hne, ahnung che baaningpa ta cuo kanaa puv?
Tahematapakieca ziy riypa khutaata ziy riypa, ziy riypa khutaata ziy riypa, caatluo suokha khutaata suokha, caatluo suokha khutaata suokha, hingpa lie hing a cawta, huepa lie hue a cawta” ama ta.
A pha, a ryi sie lipa hmya taata hne, ruohrang ming ryi tana, hingpa cawsaa tie'a lie hing bie a ri aa.
Ama ta iema'a lie kha, “A pahyna tana a cuo; a nang buopa tie ca a pahy yi se, a pahy hyalyana tana a cuo,” a ta. Cuorasala iema ta thyi'a va yi.

Caacuonakawta Abyipabie ca iema'a luo kha, “Ziy riypa khutaata ziy riypa, ziy riypa khutaata ziy riypa, caatluo suokha khutaata suokha, caatluo suokha khutaata suokha, hingpa lie hing a cawta, huepa lie hue a cawta,” a ta. Caacuonakawta cakuo'a yi te, ama hnangluo ta amaa yapatyi aa, hmaa phya'a yi te, cyihyi ta a pa-uo'a yi, sii ta a da pata ama cuo aa.
Caacuonakawta niema malie a esepa tie, Jerusalem lieta hingpa cawsaa zaw a uvpa tie, Abyipabie kha thyi tie ung.

Tahematapakieca niema ta, “Thiyna hne tana biekuona ma tue, Sheol hne tana palungtlingna ma tue; ruvna kha a tlung tiyta malie si pakhung'a te, kiema'a luo vya tlung'a vyi; tahematapakieca dungviena na kiema canawna riypata ma tue, hangna lie tana ma canaw,” nama ta.

Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri, Mang tie, Zion lie hing na ing hruopatu lung i bang aa, dyapasyana alung, a muo sungnaapa ingkiylung, ing hruopatu hmisipa: “Ama a ringchuopa ca thlaazangna hnyi'a vyi,” a ta.

Cakhutaata a phyi luo ta taanapa riy ca biedangpa ta cuo'a te, a tung luo ta taanapa ca adangna ta a cuo aa; hangna canawna hmang kha khysuv hne ari ta phya pathla diy'a te, a nunapa hmang kha tiy ta a buv diy aa.
Cakhutaata thiyna hneta na biekuona ca para pata cuo'a te, Sheol hneta nama tuepa palungtlingna ca a vie aa; ruvna kha a tlung tiyta, capa ca ta nama kha aca de patyi aa.
Ata hne ata tah vya tlung'a te, nama kha aca de aa; maw kha hnang maw kha ta vya tlung'a te, chung hne zuo ta a vya tlung aa; capa bie nama thyi tiyta ciyna nama hnyi aa.
Tahematapakieca iehmang ca a ziena riypata pachang tuv te, pang ca a buv riypata a baa tuv.
Tahematapakieca Abyipaca Perazim Tluo cunglie haa khata kya thu'a te, Gibeon bawphie lie haa khata a hi a haa aa; a tue riypa ca a tue buo lipa tana a cuo, a hrie riypa ca a hrie buo lipa tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta malie kha ese khah ung, cata a cuo li kieca khuo vie ta ciypakipa tana nama cuo aa; tahematapakieca ruo yalya lieta rana biechina khana, Cungnungce Khazing, Abyipa'a taata i thyi.
I ueryi hing naathlie ung la thyi tie ung; a phasa pata naathlie ung la, i bie hing thyi tie ung.
Lu a thlupa tie ta ciycyi riypata ama lu kha a thlu dyi ama thlu pari'a ma? Le a thawpa tie ta ama le kha a thaw dyi ama thaw pari'a ma?
Ama thlu khutaata, nannan kha vaa yi te, kummin ciy kha ama tuv, jungsacuo kha a tluo ta ama cyi, barli kha aa chawna haata cyi yi te, jungsacuo a pyapangpa tie kha luriy luo ta ama cyi.
Tahematapakieca iema ca a phasa pata pacuvpa tana ama cuo, ama Khazing na a pacuv yi.

Nannan ciy la tiyta thingtung lepa ta a hluo pata cuo vyi, kummin ciy la tiy ta suo-aciynapa le tiekyphyi kha pahlangsue pata cuo vyi, cuorasala nannan ciy la ning ca asung ta chi pata cuo te, kummin ciy la ning ca khuecahryi ta a hluo pata a cuo.
Jungsacuo chuo ca viechuo riypata phaw pata a cuo, pakha ta cipari a ciy vyi; suo-aciynapa le tiekyphyi kha pahlangsue pata a cuo aa, cuorasala a diyna te ta rie vyi.
Hingpa zaw hing Cungnungce Abyipa'a taata a vawpa tana a cuo; ama ca ruenapituv pha ce ta cuo te, a sing cepa tana a cuo.
Ariel, Ariel, David aa zaa rinapa khypuv ca, thluechiy lipa tana a cuo! Kung kha hnang kung kha ta; pyi zaw kha a chi aa dung pata tue pata cuo se.
Ariel kha a palung rie pathyi'a angte, capa lie ca caana hne angiyna a aw aa, Jerusalem ca kama cuota Ariel haa kha tana a cuo aa.
Nama a du riypata caa ripuo'a angte, ingsuo ta ca cadung khuo'a angte, riekhuocaaca kha sa'a angte ica cadung aa.

Alyi aa thuvna taata hne, aa nena lie buvcing chung taa khata bie na ri aa, na ueryi ca a thlaa ueryi haa khata alyi chungtaata a kya pya aa; na bie ripa ca buvcing chungtaata dyadyata tah aa kya thyi aa.
Cuorasala na carie tie bangkhuo ca buvcingkhuv haata a zu diy'a yi te, caa hrisaa caa tuechiepa tie ca sacuovie haa tana a maa zu aa. Sungkhabala ta, a catlisa pata,
Cungnungce Abyipata khalung, aling, hne ueryi lesa pata cuose, thliysung, thliychie, hne myihlaa ta nama kha aca parie aa.
Ariel a dupa mingphang riekaphuv, ama hne a cariekyikuo zaw a dupa tie hne a palung rie a pathyi sapa tie ca, muo hne zuo ta hmungpa muocuo haata ama cuo aa.
A nang a diypa pakha ta a muo ta sa ning te, aa kya cha ca a nang a diy ngiethiepa haata hne, a tiy a hrie ngiethie kaliepa haa tana, Zion Tluo a dupa mingphang tie riekaphuv ca ama cuo aa.
A riy-uvluv ung la myarieruv tie ung, niema hne niema ta nama ming kha a pacue ung la hmung the li pata aw tie ung! Mingsuvtiy dang li pata pariy tie ung; zuvre dang tlung li pata a viele tie ung.
Tahematapakieca Abyipana nama cunglie kha mingkuv thuvna thlaapa caa bya yi; Profet tie nama ming kha ca pahruv yi te, nama luv zaw kha caa buvkhung yi.

Hingpa muocuo bangkhuo hing niema cuota caakhe khepa bie haata a cuo aa. A ri thepa tie'a luo kha naw pi pata, “Hingpa hing ri tie,” ama ta kiema, “Ri the vapuv, tahematapakieca caakhe na ama khe,” ama ta aa.
Caa a ri the lipa tie kha, “Hingpa hing ri tie, “ama ta kiema, “Ri the vapuv,” ama ta aa.

Abyipata: Hingpa cawsaa zaw hingta ama pakaa ta inaa ngie yi, ama pakaa ta na pa-uvsathyi yi te, ama pathiypalung ca kama hneta aa hlasa, kama inaa biepa yi ca phung haata amaa cuvpa cawsaa nawbie tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta hingpa cawsaa tie'a lie hing, nang-uo aa chiypa hmang khana i tue pakhaa aa. Ama mingsing tie singna ca ra'a te, thleduothena a hnyipa tie thleduo khuna zaw nupa pata ama cuo aa.
A khuekhuona kha aa thuvsa ta Abyipaa nu khuopa, zingna chunglieta hmang a tuepa, “Ahungma malie a hmung? Ahungma malie a pachang?” a tapa tie ca, Thluechiy lipa tana ama cuo!

Hmang kha a cung a raw nama pali! Bi a satuv ca acyi haata ri the a aw'a ma? Hmang suokhakha ta a satuv kha, “Ama ta na sa vyi” a ta khu'a ma? Tuepa hmang khata a tuetuv kha, “Ama ca pachangna hnyi vyi,” a ta khu'a ma?
Lebanon ca cuo pachangta chunglieta kungvyisanapa lu haata cuo'a te, kungvyisanapa lu ca atuv haata rue pata a cuo'a ma?
Capa ning lie ca a naaruepa ta caataw lieta bie kha thyi'a te, mingcuepa tie ming ta pasie lipa hne zingna aw li tli pata a hmung aa.
A nang a nepa tie ca Abyipachunglie kha palungtluona hnyi'a yi te, riethyivuosuopa tie ta Israel Khazing Pathe chunglieta cyicalangna ama hmung aa.
Tahematapakieca hrisaatuv pha lipa tie kha aw li tli'apa yi ta, cawsaa a pahnyisuepa tie ca ama chuo aa; pha lina tue riypata a pasutuv tie zaw thaw pata ama cuo aa.

Aa hmuo li pata tazaacyina lie malie a pasungpa tie, bie a chikhutuv byi kha thlake lie cyihyi a thlakhuopa tie, aa hmuopa lie a awpa hne biedangpa kha adaahmang hnyi li pata a ipa tie ca thaw pata ama cuo aa.
Caacuonakawta Jakob ingchungkhue hneta aa patuv pata Abraham a khuopa Abyipata: Jakob ca a nang zaa'a va tli, a hmie zaw chi'a va tli.
Ama ta i kuvzung a cuopa a saata zaw kha a hmung tiy yi ta, i ming pathe kha a pa-uvsathyi aa; Jakob Khazing Pathe kha ciyzaa'a te, Israel Khazing cunglie a nang a uosa aa.
Thlaapa lie luopuv a paapa tie ta pachangna hnyi'a yi te, a cie byalyapa ta pacuvna kha aa paw aa.

Abyipata, Vya a du a hmuopa saata zaw, ahungma khue a khuo, cuorasala kama ta khuo va ang; ahungma malie a buchuo pata a hrie, cuorasala kama khingna hne tana aa carie, suena suokha cunglie suokha aa chachiy;
Faro a daakhyina rawlie canaw riypa hne, Izipt ing ningdiy canaw riypata ahungma kama ruena hiehriy li pata Izipt luo sibung riypata a tha?
Faro a daakhyina ca nama nangzaana ta cuo'a te, Izipt ing ningdiy canawna ca nama tlana tana a cuo aa.
A byi tie ca Zoan lie ama aw raalaa pata hne, a luosituv tie ca Hanes lie ama aw raalaa pata,
iema cuota a thlahne lipa cawsaa tie kawlie khata ama nang a zaa aa, capa ca ta byana hne thlahnena phya va yi, cuorasala nangzaana hne hmiechina dyina a chiykhyi.

Negeb saruopa tie hne aa patuvpa bie. Ruvnaana hne palungriethyina ruo taata, chingdepuvnung hne chingde, a ca-ie ruvsapa pariy hne aa zu thepa pariy tapa tie ta, thlahnena a pi khu lipa cawsaa tie'a luo kha ama hnyirungna ca laa ke cunglie phyale yi te, ama suethiy kha kala-uv ke cunglie ama phyale.
Tahematapakieca Izipt byana ca muo hnyi li pata a hrihripa tana a cuo, caacuonakawta ama kha, “Ata tepa ta a tupa Rahab,” ta pata i ku.
Ata hingta cakuo la, a vaw riypa cuo lie chuozaa ta tehte ta a cuo riypata, iema hmiekunglie kha lungphie cunglie khe la cape tie, caa-uv chunglie zaw kha khung tie.
Tahematapakieca iema ca du a hmuopa cawsaa, zang tluo aa tla lipa saata, Abyipapacuvna kha a thyi li riypa saata;
profet tie kha, “Muocuo hmung khah ung”; “Kiema cuota aa hmuopa profet bie kha ri khah ung; ma palung malie a patluo riypa bie kha ri ung la, malie a dungviepa bie kha ri tie ung;
luopuv kha thuse ung la, a maase tie ung, Israel Khazing Pathe tapa kha thyi khah tli se puv,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Israel Khazing Pathe ta hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa bie hing nama thaw nakawta hne, nama zangna kha hrisaana hne hangna lieta chi ung cate, capa tie'a lie ca ta namaa daa.
Caacuonakawta hingpa pha lina hing niema huopa ta cuo'a te, a cing'a nangpa lungrue tlepie aa suosapa lie ama za nepa lungrue haa tana nama cuo aa; capa ca a catlisa pata, sungkhabala ta a cing the.
A cingnazya ca, bivytuv ta a bi kha khuosa ta phawchi te, buvsading taata myihyi lana riypa hne, takhue taata tiy siyna riypata, a bikarue hmuo hmung khu lipa haa tana a cuo aa.

Cakhutaata Abyipa, Israel KhazingPathe ta hing haa hingta a ri: Vya kaa pata namaa pahyna chunglie kha khuo pata nama cuo aa; a dieta tah nama awna hne nama zangna ca nama thaazuo ta a cuo aa. Cuorasala khing lipa ung cate,
“Cuo vyi! aruo a khang'a pate na maa ruo aa” nama ta nakawta, namaa ruo'a tle! “A catlisapa rietuvna aruo na maa khang aa,” nama ta, caacuonakawta caa cadepa tie zaw ama catlisa ra aa!
Pakha ta aca pachiypa yi ta thawkha namaa ruo aa, pa pangaa ta aca pachiy tiy yi ta, tluo cunglie pangtaa pathlienapa tung hne, tluo lieta pamangsana tung dyi aa tuona te ta namaa ruo aa.

Cuorasala Abyipata niema kha vi aca hnyi khing nakaw yi ta aca huo yi; niema kha vihnyi riypata a thu aa. Tahematapakieca Abyipaca biedangpa Khazing ta cuo te, ama a huopa zaw bangkhuo ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo.
Vya Zion cawsaa, Jerusalem lie a awpa tie zaw, caa'a va tli ung ciy. Nama caana ueryi kha a thyi tiyta niema kha vi ca hnyi'a yi te aca palie'a yi.
Abyipata ciy-achiyna viechuo hne ruvnaana tiy kha aca pi zawta, na Pacuvtuv ca a nu'a va tli, cuorasala na ming tana na Pacuvtuv kha na hmung aa.
Cakhutaata cacuoluo na pie kie cuose, cavyiluo na pie kie cuose, na hnangkaa taata, “Hingpa hingna luopuv ta a cuo, hingpa luopuv hing ziy tie,” tapa bie kha na naa ta a thyi aa.
Cakhutaata ngu pakhuvpa na kuvtuezuv hne siy ta pakhuvpa na kuvtuezuv kha siysaa ri li pata a pyapa pangcaw haata thaw'a cate, “Ca hmung khing va tli puv!” nama ta aa.
Ama ta alyi lie na vaapa saciy cuo khata khytiy ca pi'a te, a thyipaa a hluvsa'a te kung a vyi sa aa. Capa cuo lie ca na sahring ca ruo a kusapa lie kha ama tle aa.
Le a thawpa cuetungpa hne re a hriepa laa zaw ca kawpia hne khazin lepa ta ama pathesapa, pacung ciepa aphuv khana ama ning aa.
A ruvsapa a thiena ning lie, ingsuo zaw ama cing ning kha tluo aa suopa mekaa hne tluothlue aa suopa mekaa lieta cavaata tie lie kha tiy a rungsa pata ama lang aa.

Ca hlyitaw taata Abyipata a cawsaa zaw hmaa kha pahlawpa yi te, tlangkhy tuv yi te hmaa a paphyapa kha a patluo sa tiy yi ta, thlaavaana ca ningkhena tluv ta khe'a te ningkhena ca le sariy ta a kie aa.
Mang tie, Abyipaming ca luohlaapuv taa tana aa vaw, a hihaana ca a kuo dyi kuo te, myikhuv ca a chaasa pata a thu; a hmya ca hihaana ta bi te, a palyi ca a kuo nguoluopa myi haa tana a cuo.
Mingphang zaw kha parana syry ta ry riypata, a huv ca tiy a lepa cavaa haa khata cawsaa ruetung te a chiy; iema a pasi sa chie riypa thaatungriy kha ama hrakuo lie tuv pata a cuo.
A pathepa pyi ama tue zuo haata, hne Israel Lungpuv, Abyipatluo luo kha ramang tung pata nama kie ning haata nama palung tluo'a te hlaa nama sa aa.
Cakhutaata Abyipata a suesaapa a ueryi kha thyi riypata pathlie'a te, a hihaana hne a kuo nguoluopa myihlaa, a patle ta a patlepa khy hne thliychie hne ari ta a kuv kha hmung riypata a paluo sa aa.
Assiria ming ca a khuecahryi ta aa hluo tiy yi ta, Abyipaueryi kha ama ciy suesaa aa.
Abyipata a cunglie a patlungpa duotena sungpe ta a chi kyry khata akhang pu hne tingtuo pu ta a ziy aa. Abyipata ama kha khuosa ta rie aa du aa.

Tahematapakieca myi aa hlaa nguoluopa hmang ca hluo ning taa khata ama cuota za tingtuo pacie pata a cuo tli, capa myikhue ca a thuv te a ku, thing a bi pata ama chi, Abyipahuv taata a pyapa cavaata tiy haata a langpa ke khata myi ca a pa-ie sa aa.

Abyana hie riypata Izipt luo a sibungpa hne, aruo zaw a buchuopa, a hluvsapa aruole tie hne, a cahrasapa a ruo rieka tie a ringchuo yi te, cuorasala Israel Khazing Pathe kha a mang lipa hne, Abyipakha bie a hiehriy lipa tie ca, thluechiy lipa tana ama cuo!
Ama zaw singsa ra te riethyivuosuona kha a patlung sa aa; a bie kha a da pakhaa'a vyi, cuorasala pha lina a tuepa ingchungkhue kha a du'a yi te, suena a tuepa tie a byapa tie kha aa du'a yi.

Izipt ming ca cawsaapa ta cuo yi te, Khazing ta cuo va yi; amaa ruo ca saapa ta cuo te, thlaapa ta cuo vyi. Abyipata a kuv a pazuo tiyta, a byatuv kha a pachiy'a te, amaa byapa zaw aa lie aa, cakhutaata ama bangkhuo ta ama ra pakhaw aa.

Tahematapakieca Abyipata hing haa hingta ina chang, saa a siepa chingde ca, tuv a khiepa phuv ta, kha tluv ta pahue yi te ama pachiy zawta ciy vyi. Caacuonakawta Cungnungce Abyipaca Zion Tluo hne a tluothlue kha tuv riypata a za cung aa.
Pavaa ca a cunglie aa pathlaapa haa khata, Cungnungce Abyipata Jerusalem kha a khuo aa; ama ta khuo'a te aa thla aa, ama ta pahya'a te aa bang pata a chi aa.
Vya Israel cawsaa zaw, khuosa ta nama dungpa'a luo kha kaa tie ung.
Capa ning lie ca nama kuv ta suena cangta a tuepa ngu kuvtuezuv hne siy kuvtuezuv tie kha nama thaw aa.
“Cakhutaata Assiria ca zueziy ta aa lie aa, cawsaa kuv ta cuo'a vyi; cawsaa kuv ta a cuo lipa, zueziy ta a para aa; zueziy taa khata a ruo'a te, a mingnu tie ca sii ta a da pata ama cuo aa.
Aa lungpuv ca rana taa khata a ruo'a te, a byi tie ta amaa daahmang taa khata amaa ruo aa,” ta pata, Zion lie a myi aw te, Jerusalem lieta a myiphya a awpa Abyipata a ta.
Mang tie, adangna ta ruo a uvpa siepahruo pakha vya aw'a te, byi tie ta biedangpa ta ruo ama uv aa.

Pakha cyicuo ca thliychie aa hruo ning a nunapa hmang haata cuo'a yi te, khysuv a chiy ning canawna hmang haata ama cuo aa, ruocaapa hmang lie a langpa cavaa haata hne, ning lingna ruo lie alungpuv ningdiy haa khata ama cuo aa.
A ming a hmungpa tie ta ama ming kha vy li'apa yi ta, thyina naa a hnyipa tie ta ama naathlie aa.
A catlipa dyi ta a tue cakhaw thepa pathiypalung ta biechina phapa tue'a te, a kaa-aapa palyi ta a nasa pata hne a siesa pata bie a ri aa.
A ngaapa kha hmiezaa aa chiypa ta pata cuo li tli'a pata, a chiehruvpa kha pa-uvsathyi aa tlapa ta pata cuo'a va tli.

Tahematapakieca a ngaapa ta ruena hnyi li pata bie ri te, ama pathiypalung ta aa tingpa pha lina tie ca: Khazing ciyzaa lina re hrie riypa, Abyipahne aa patuv pata aa hmuo lipa ri riypa, nangdiy pata a hiepa tie kha thuse riypa, a tiy a hriepa kha tiy padang li riypa, tapa tie hingta a cuo.
A chiehruvpa tie ta a chiehruvpa hmang kha ama tue; a vuosuopa tie ripa kha aa hmuo thluo zawta, hanghiena bie ta para riypata, a pha lipa ruena dyi kha ama rue.
Cuorasala hmiezaa aa chiypa tie ca hmang phapa kha tingtuo yi te, capa hmang phapa cata amaa daa.
A nata tah a aw cakhawpa canung zaw, thu ung la i ueryi hing thyi tie ung, a hnaanguo cakhawpa sacanung zaw i bie hing naathlie tie ung.
Niema a hnaanguo cakhawpa zaw, kung kha hlyi a tapa khiy tana namaa cathangsa aa; tahematapakieca mingsuv thyi la riypa aw'a vyi, sa lana cuo kha vya tlung'a vyi.
A nata tah a aw cakhawpa zaw, a cathang tie ung, a cathang tie ung, a hnaanguo cakhawpa zaw; nama caw kha thlie ung la, buri kha nama se lie a paze tie ung.
Kung a vyisapa lu cuota hne a pathyisapa mingsuv kung cuo khata, nama cacunghnaa kha a cung tie ung,
tahematapakieca i cawsaa zaw chuelyi, tena hne zaa nuopa khypuv lie aa nuosapa ing zaw ca, ahling hne aphuv na a pahlaw diy tli.

Tahematapakieca capa hmang ca maw pata cuo'a te, cawsaa chaasanapa khypuv ca thuse pata a cuo aa; tluothlue hne rievena ingsuo ca, chuozaa tana cawsaa chiepa tie khue ta aa li aa, ruo lie a awpa laa tie anuona hmang hne, tuv zaw ama tlenapa hmang tana aa li aa.
Aa suona lie thlaapa kha kiema cung luo za byapa a cuona te hne, ruocaapa kha kung a pavyipa lu a cuona te, kung a vyisapa lu ca atuv ta ripa a cuona te ta cahaacata a cuo aa.
Cakhutaata biedangpa ca ruocaapa lie kha aw'a te, kung a vyisapa lu lie kha adangna a aw aa.
Adangna ta a chiykhyipa ca thlaalungna ta cuo'a te, adangna a thyipaa ca thlaalungna hne a ringchuona tana a cuo.
I cawsaa zaw ca thlaalungsa pata khysa'a yi te, aa bang pata, hne a dieta tah amaa pahy aa.
Atuv ca vie karue'a te, khypuv ca pachung karue pata a cuo aa.
Cavaata kie bangkhuo lie sa a cyipa hne, nama cue hne laa zaw a pathlie hyalyapa ca Thluechiypa tana nama cuo.

Malie ta aca para lipa yi ta, malie a parapa, ahungtahmuo aca raw lipa yi ta, malie a rawpa ca, Thluechiy lipa tana na cuo! Malie para kha na taw pahne ta, nama kha para pata na cuo aa; malie raw kha na taw pahne ta, nama kha raw pata na cuo aa.
Vya Abyipa, vi malie hnyi thi tie; nama na maca huo. Maw tating ta ma buo ta cuo tie, ruvnaana cuo ningta malie a khuotuv ta cuo tie.
Ama khi patlawnapa ueryi nakawta, cawsaa kha amaa ruo; na lesyina hmiekunglieta, mingphang kha amaa chepatlaa.
Hruosue kha cuongu pakhaw ta ama pakhaw; khawbyapa aa zupa haata amaa zu hning.
Abyipaca cyicalang pata na a cuo, aa suona lie tana a aw; Zion kha biedangpa hne adangna ta a pabi sa.
Ama ca a cusa pata naa hmangna cuo'a te, na khuona, na singna hne na pachangna ta a cuo aa; Abyipaciyna hingna Zion suethiy ta a cuo.
Naathlie tie! a riephapa tie na luopuv chunglie a caa yi; diena luosituv tie na khuosa ta a caa yi.
Luopuv lepa ca thuse pata na a cuo, khy a tlawpa tie na luopuv a cahriy yi. Biekuona ca a ra, naatlana ca ama duvsa tli, ahungtahmuo siysaa ri va tli yi.
Ruo ca a ngiy te aa uv, Lebanon ca a kalaa te aa uv. Sharon ca ruocaapa kha lu te, Bashan hne Karmel ca ama hnaa kha a zung.
Abyipata, “Ata hing ca i thu'a tli,” “ata hing ca kamata tah thu'a angte, pathuosa pata i cuo aa.
Niema ca savie kha nu ta phya ung cate, sacuo kung caahming kha saata ta nama sa; nama huv ca caa kuo riypa yi myi ta a cuo.
Cawsaa ca thung ama ruepa haa khata hne, hu yi te myi lie ama ruepa ahling kung haa kha tana ama cuo aa,” a ta.
Khaapama i tue tapa kha, niema luohlaa luo a awpa tie ta thyi tie ung; cakhutaata niema luongie lie a awpa tie ta i thaaruvna kha pachang tie ung.

Zion lie a suepa tie ca ama ciysa, Khazing a pachang lipa tie ca amaa cathangsa; “Kiema hrawlie ahung hing ma aa hlaa nguoluopa myi hne a aw khu aa? Kiema hrawlie ahung hing ma chuozaa myipalyi lieta a aw khu aa?”

Aa dangsa pata cakuo te aa hmuosa pata bie a ripa, malie hrisaa pata hmungpa kha a duvpa, nawthuv kha cuhluo li pata a cahriypa, thiyse palangna kaw kha a naathlie khing lipa tie, pha lina kha a mang khing lipa tie ca,
aa suona lie khana ama aw aa; ama canawna ca alung ta sapa riekhuopiehu chunglie khata cuo'a te, sa kha ama ring aa, tiy zaw ci buo'a vyi.
Na ming ta siepahruo kha a rungnaana chunglieta nama hmung aa; aa hlasana luo vaa phaapa ruo zaw kha na hmung aa.
Ciy aa chiy hringhruona lie kha na palung tluo'a te: “Tuokaa a ripa kha khaapaliema a aw? Ngukhyi aa riyna zaa a pathlietuv kha khaapaliema a aw? Ingsuo a rituv kha khaapaliema a aw?” na ta aa.
A pupa hne aa hruopa cawsaa tie kha hmung'a va tli yi ciy, a sie lipa hne na thyi khu lipa ryi a cyipa cawsaa tie kha hmung'a va tli yi ciy.

Ama'a na a cuo lieta tuepa pyi zaw ma tue tawnapa Zion khypuv khiy mang tie! A dieta tah awnapa, hnyi khu a aw lipa thluodaa, aa tung phie khu a aw lipa, a khuhriy suokha hmuo chi khu a aw lipa, Jerusalem khypuv kha na ming ta na hmung aa.
Cuorasala cavaa kusapa hne cavaata zaw a awnapa hmang, sawkaw palaw hne a mawtuv zaw ama si khu linapa, tiypalaw lepa a si khu linapa lie ca, a lesyipa Abyipaca kiema huota a cuo aa.
Tahematapakieca Abyipaca ma bieripatuv, Abyipaca malie a uvtuv, Abyipaca ma siepahruo ta cuo'a te ama ta malie a khuo aa.
Na tiypalaw khuhriy na a thluo; a pang pathlie kha a cu pata pa tuv khu vyi, a pangzu zaw pake khu vyi. Cakhutaata hruosue a hluvsa kha a che pata a cuo aa; a phyi cabiepa ta hmuo aa chuv ra khu aa.
Capa lie khy a sapa ca, “I pasa,” ta li tli'a pata, ama pha lina kha a ngiethe pata ama cuo aa.

Vya mingphang zaw, thyi riypata naa vya ngie tie ung, Vya cawsaa zaw, naathlie tie ung! Alyi ta thyi sala, a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo ta thyi yi se; chuelyi hne, a chungtaata a pyapa bangkhuo ta thyi yi se.
Tahematapakieca Abyipana mingphang bangkhuo cunglie hne, iema phuv tie cunglie kha a hi a haa tli; ama ta duote yi te, cawsaa a thiepa tie'a luo kha a pi yi.
Ama thiepa iema cawsaa tie ca thaw pata cuo'a yi te, ama riyy ca thuv'a te a pahnuosa aa; tluo zaw cunglie kha thiyse ca cavaa haata a lang aa.

Avuo lie ning hne thlaapa aasiy bangkhuo ca zung'a yi te, avuo ca caataw haata aa kalang aa. Avuo lie hmangting bangkhuo khiy, mingsuv kung lie mingsuv hnaa ama caapa haata hne, thyikuv kung lie a thyi ama caapa haata ama caa diy aa.
I zueziy ca avuo lie a re a patlung khutaata, bieripana ta duote riypa, Edom lie a cawsaa tie'a luo kha a za cung aa.

Abyipaca thiy dang lunghruo a tlungsapa hne, a thupa ta a nangsa tlipa, tuv thiy hne mie thiy ta a lunghruo a tlungsapa, mietungpa lungsarue thupa ta a nangsa tlipa zueziy kha a hnyi. Tahematapakieca Abyipata Bozrah lie hriykhungrina hnyi te, Edom ruo lieta a lesapa thiena kha a hnyi.
Ruo lie cuetungpa kha iema hne cata a lie'a te, cue tungnupa ca cue tunglepa tie hne khata aa lie aa. Ama ruo ca thiy ta paci'a te, amaa lyi ca a thupa ta a bi aa.
Tahematapakieca Abyipata phuvlana ning kha hnyi te, Zion kawlieta suena a hnyi lina kaw paluosana kung kha a hnyi.
Cakhutaata Edom cavaata tie ca kattazaa ta a li'a yi te, aa lyi ca ke ta a li'a te, a ruo ca myi a hlaa nguoluopa kattazaa ta aa li aa.

Chung hne zuo ta pache khu aw'a vyi; a khuv ca chuozaa ta a khuvthaw pari aa. Chuo kha hnang chuo kha ta hmuo tluo a tla li tli pata aw'a te, chuozaa ta, ahungtahmuo ama ruo chung ziy pata khy tlaw'a va yi.
Cuorasala hmungchiy hne saakuv ta cu'a yi te, tutaru hne ra-aa ta ama awna aa. Ama ta a kalaanapa riy kha a cunglie pare'a te, a byi zaw cunglie kha a pathliebung aa.
Iema ta Capa Lie Ca Pena Aw Vyi ta pata ming ama pi aa, ama byi tie bangkhuo ca khaapatahmuo cuo va yi.
Cariekyikuo chunglie kha ahling ta bi'a te, ama riekhuopiehu ca uvtamyi hne ahling kung ta a buv aa. Ruo-uv hne kala-uvpavaa awna hmang ta a cuo aa.
Ruoziekuo hne hainaacahnie kha a taw'a yi te, mie-khachie kha pakha hne pakha a chaw'a yi te, Lilith pavaa zaw amaa pahyna hmang ta a cuo aa.
Tutaru kha a buv a tue'a te, a tiy kha thla'a te, tlung'a te, a mathlaa rawlieta a changta zaw a mangsang aa. Capa lie ngiethie cata pahmung zaw kha nungvaa nungvaa ta amaa hmya aa.

Abyipacaa-uv taa khata huv la ri tie: Hingpa zaw suokha hing hmuo vie'a vyi; sakha hmuo a canung a capaa ta a ba tling lipa aw'a va yi. Tahematapakieca Abyipapakaa ta bie pi yi te, a thlaapa ta a pahmya yi.
Ama ta iema huota vyisung a da te, ama a kuv ta cuvu a re yi; iema ta capa ruo ca chuozaa ta hnyi'a yi te, chuo kha hnang chuo kha ta capa lie ca ama aw aa.
Ruocaapa ca aa law aa, viehnangruo ca a palung tluo'a te a paa aa;

a hluvsa ta paa'a te, palungtluona hneta hlaa a sa aa. Lebanon rungnaana kha ama ca pi pata cuo'a te, Karmel hne Sharon lesyina kha pi pata a cuo aa. Iema ca Abyiparungnaana kha hmung'a yi te, Khazing lesyina kha ama hmung aa.
A thaazuo cawpa kuv kha thaa patlung ung la, thaazuo a hnyi lipa phyi kha pa cu tie ung.

A riechiepa pathiypalung kha, “Cahra tie ung, ciy khah ung! ta tie ung. Nama Khazing ca hingpa lie hing a aw hing. Ama ca phuvlana hne ciy aa chiypa vieriy thung riypa tana aa vaw. A vaw'a te aca khuo'a yi.
Cakhutaata mingcuepa tie ming ca a pahaw'a te, naaruepa tie naa kha a thyi aa;
a pakyapa ca sasuv haata a cathlu'a te, bie a ri lipa palyi ca alawna hneta hlaa a sa aa. Tahematapakieca ruocaapa lie kha tiy pya'a te, viehnangruo lie kha cavaa ama lang aa;
a kuo ta a kuopa viehnang ca tiy-ang ta a li'a te, a caavungpa alyi taata acaatiy a pya aa; ruo-uv zaw amaa zaa khiena hmang ca tiy zaw aa angnapa hmang ta a li'a te, paling hne phiepahlaa ama pu aa.

Capa lie ca luopuv lepa suokha aw'a te, Luo Pathepa ta pata ama ku aa; a pathe lipa ca capa luopuv ca ziy'a va yi, cuorasala Khazing cawsaa tie ziy riypata a cuo aa, khy a tlaw buo lipa hne a ngaapa hmuo luo vie'a va yi.
Capa lie ca chingde aw'a vyi, a nang diysapa saahruo sakha hmuo, a awpa kha hmung pata cuo'a vyi, cadyiseca capa lie ca khuo ciepa zaw na a khie'a yi.

Cakhutaata Abyipata aa thlapa tie ca vya kaa'a yi te, Zion luo kha hlaasana cangta amaa vaw aa; chuozaa palungtluona kha ama luv cunglie a aw aa; iema ca palungtluona hne alawna kha hnyi'a yi te, ngiechina hne palungriethyina ta aa ruose'a yi.
Hezekiah ta siepahruo a cuona kung hraa hlyipaliy kung lieta Assiria siepahruo Sennakherib kha a khaw te Judah ruo lie khy dungkhuo a hnyipa khypuv bangkhuo kha tuv te a la diy.

Assiria siepahruo ta Rabshakeh kha riekaphuv a lesapa hneta Lakhish taata Jerusalem luo, Siepahruo Hezekiah'a luo kha a pathlie. Rabshakeh ca caw pasuvnapa hmang luo a sipa luopuv lepa kielie, cungluo tiy-ang tiyluopuv athaalie kha aa tu.
Hilkiah sacapaa, siepahruo ing uvtuv Eliakim, zung caa capetuv Shebna, hne Asaf sacapaa, cazing a khungtuv Joah tapa tie khata capa luo ca amaa kya taw.
Rabshakeh ta iema kyihuo khata, “Hezekiah kha chang tie ung: A lesyipa siepahruo, Assiria siepahruo na: Khaapa a pacaw cate ma hing tluv nanaa hingta naa zang?
Bie hing rietuv thena hne cahrana ta ri kanaa ciy? Ahung a buchuo cate ma kama hing inaa du ciy?
Mang tie, ama a hypa tie mekaa kuv a chungpa phiepahlaa khuecahryi tlipa Izipt na naa ringchuo. Izipt siepahruo Faro ca ama a ringchuopa tie bangkhuo cuota cahaaca tana a cuo.

Cuorasala niema ta kama kha, ‘Kiema ca Abyipama Khazing na maa ringchuo,’ nama ta kieca, capa ca Hezekiah ta a khahrungtluobu tie hne a bienatluophie zaw kha para te, Judah hne Jerusalem kha, ‘Hingpa bienatluophie hmiekunglie hingna namaa bie aa,’ a tapa kha cuo va ma?
Ata hingta a vaw la, i byipaapa Assiria siepahruo hneta biekuona tue tie ung: Namaluo kuo taata a khangtuv riypa naa hmung khu kieca, aruo thawhning ica pi aa.
Cakhutaata aruole hne aruo rieka cuota Izipt kha naa buchuo kieca tuokhaatama i byipaapa changtaapa tie chungtaata a caw cepa riekabyi pakha kha hmuo a du pata na pakaa khu aa?
Ca hlyitaw taata, hingpa ruo luo para riypata icaa khawhnuepa yi hing Abyipali pata a tuepa ta na rue kanaa ung ciy? Abyipana khaw la, hingpa ruo hing kya para tie, naa ta,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Eliakim, Shebna, hne Joah ta Rabshakeh kyihuo khata, “Na changtaapa zaw hing Aramaik ryi ta malie chaw tie, tahematapakieca ma thyi thluo; lungrue tlepie cunglie a awpa tie thyina lie hing Judah ryi ta malie chaw thi khah,” ama ta.

Cuorasala Rabshakeh ta, “Hingpa bie hing nama byipaapa hne niema'a lie dyi ri riypata ma i byipaapa ta kama hing ina pathlie? Khy dungkhuo lungruetlepie cunglie a tupa tie, niema hneta duote hne pata iema ii mamaapa a ning riypa hne iema pazung mamaapa a dang riypa tie'a lie zaw ri ra riypata cuo ra va ma?” a ta.
Cakhutaata Rabshakeh ca a daa te, Judah ryi ta khuosa ta khi te, “A lesyipa siepahruo, Assiria siepahruo bie hing naathlie tie ung!
Siepahruo na hing haa hingta a ri: ‘Hezekiah hing a padung sa khah ung, tahematapakieca ama ta niema kha kama kuv chungtaata ca khuo khu'a va yi.
Abyipata malie a khuo hrahring aa; hingpa khypuv hing Assiria siepahruo kuv chung luo pi'a vyi, a tapa Hezekiah bie khata Abyipaa ringchuo riypata ca tue khah yi se.'

Hezekiah bie kha naathlie khah ung; tahematapakieca Assiria siepahruo na hing haa hingta a ri: ‘Kama hneta diena tue tie ung; kama'a luo kha kya pya tie ung; cawsaa mekaa ta niema mingsuv hne niema thyikuv kha ning'a ung cate, niema takhue taata tiy nama dang aa,
kama kha a vaw'a angte, niema ruo haata a tapa ruo, sa hne mingsuvtiy awnapa ruo, viechuo hne mingsuv diedung awnapa ruo luo kha ica sikhyi hluo li yi ca.
Abyipana malie a khuo aa, tapa bie ta Hezekiah kha a padung sa khah ung. Mingphang tie khazing pakha chuo ta ama ruo kha Assiria siepahruo kuv taata ama khuo ma?
Hamath hne Arpad khazing tie ca khaapaliema ama aw? Sefarvaim khazing tie ca khaapaliema ama aw? Iema ca ta Samaria kha i kuv taata ama khuo ma?
Hingpa ruo tie khazing zaw chungtaa hingta khaapa khazing hing ma ama ruo kha kama kuv taata a khuo buo yi? Cata a cuo kieca Abyipata Jerusalem hing i kuv taata a khuo'a ma?’” a ta.
Cuorasala iema ca duokaring yi te, ama kha bie kaa kha hmuo palie va yi, tahematapakieca siepahruo biepina ca, “Ama kha palie khah ung,” ta pata a cuo.

Cakhutaata Hilkiah sacapaa, siepahruo ing uvtuv Eliakim, caacapetuv Shebna, hne Asaf sacapaa, cazingkhungtuv Joah tapa tie ca Hezekiah'a luo kha a vaw yi te, ama caw kha thlaa yi te Rabshakeh bie kha ama chang.
Siepahruo Hezekiah ta capa ca a thyi tiyta, a caw kha a thlaa, buri kha a buv te Abyipaing chung luo kha aa ngie.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ing uvtuv Eliakim, hne caacapetuv Shebna, hne tluobyi uvthyi vie tie kha buri a buv pata Amoz sacapaa profet Isaiah'a luo kha a pathlie yi.
Iema ta, “Hezekiah na hing haa hingta a ri, ataning ca palungriethyina ning, a chuoraana ning, hne nangzaana ning tana a cuo; haatiy ca a za puv'a nang tli, cuorasala papuv sa khunapa thaazuo aw vyi.

A byipaapa Assiria siepahruo ta a hringpa Khazing kha tue hyalya riypata a vya pathliepa Rabshakeh bie kha Abyipa na Khazing ta a thyi tli thlu aa. A ripa bie ca Abyipana Khazing ta thyi sala chuo mang sue; caacuonakawta aa ngaapa tie cuo khata thlaachuo tie,” ama ta.
Siepahruo Hezekiah changtaapa tie kha Isaiah'a luo ama pha tiyta,
Isaiah ta, “Nama byipaapa kha chang tie ung, ‘Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Assiria siepahruo changtaapa tie ta ina esenapa yi bie na thyipa kawlieta ciy khah.

Kama hrahring ta thlaapa kha a chunglie chi'a angte, caacuonakawta a khie cakhawpa bie kha thyi'a te a ruo luo a kaa aa; a ruo chung mamaapa lie kha zueziy ta a thiy riypata i tue aa, a ta,’ ta pata va chang tie ung,” a ta.
Assiria siepahruo na Lakhish a thuse tli tapa kha Rabshakeh ta a thyi tiyta, a kaa ca, siepahruo ta Libnah a tuv nguoluopa kha a hmung.

Siepahruo ta Ethiopia Siepahruo Tirhakah kaw hne aa patuv pata, “Ama ca nama tuv riypa tana a vya tha tli,” tapa kha a thyi. Capa ca a thyi tiyta, ama ta Siepahruo Hezekiah'a luo kha biephyatuv pathlie te,

“Judah Siepahruo Hezekiah'a lie nama ri riypa bie ca hing haa hingta a cuo aa: Naa buchuopa na Khazing ta ca dung te, Jerusalem ca Assiria siepahruo kuv chung luo pi pata cuo'a vyi, aca tapa kha zang khah.
Mang tie, Assiria siepahruo tie ta ruo bangkhuo cunglie ama tuepa, ama para diy karuepa kha na thyi tli. Nama ca khuo pata na cuo'a ma?
I mingchingmingvuo tie ta ama za parapa mingphang tie ta a cuopa Gozan, Haran, Rezef, hne Telassar lie a awpa Eden cawsaa zaw kha ama mingphang khazing tie ta ama khuo khu ma?
Hamath siepahruo, Arpad siepahruo, Sefarvaim khypuv siepahruo, Hena siepahruo, acuolikie Ivvah siepahruo tie ca khaapaliema ama aw?” a ta.
Hezekiah ta biephyatuv tie kuv taata caa kha hmung te a ri; cakhutaata Hezekiah ca Abyipaing luo kha khaw te capa caa ca Abyipahmiekunglie kha a pake.
Cakhutaata Hezekiah ta Abyipa'a luo kha thlaachuo te:
“Vya Cungnungce, Israel Khazing, cherubim cung byithude lie a tupa, alyi cung pena bangkhuo Khazing ca nama pakha kyalya dyi tana na cuo; nama na alyi hne avuo hing a tue ciy.
Vya Abyipa, na naathlie la thyi thi tie; Vya Abyipana ming kha padyi la hmung thi tie; a hringpa Khazing aca tue hyalyanapa Sennakherib bie bangkhuo kha thyi thi tie.
Vya AbyipaAssiria siepahruo tie ta mingphang bangkhuo hne ama ruo zaw kha ama pahli diy tli,
ama khazing tie kha myi chung luo ama thaw diy tli; tahematapakieca iema ca khazing ta cuo lipa yi ta, cawsaa kuv ta tuepa, thing hne lung tana ama cuo, caacuonakawta para diy pata ama cuo.
Caacuonakawta, Vya Abyipakiema Khazing, alyi lie pena bangkhuo lie hing nama dyina Abyipata a cuo ciy tapa hing ama pachang riypata a kuv taa hingta malie khuo thi tie,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Amoz sacapaa Isaiah ta Hezekiah'a luo kha cawsaa pathlie yi te, “Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Assiria Siepahruo Sennakherib hne aa patuv pata kama'a luo thlaa na kya chuo nakawta,
ama hne aa patuv pata Abyipata a ripa bie ca hingpa hing tana a cuo: ‘Zion sacanung lesaa pathenung na, nama kha ca ese te caa manghnue; Jerusalem sacanung na na hnangluo taata, a luv caa chysue.
‘Ahungma tue hyalya cate, a kawchie na ri? Ahung a du pata na ryi pathlie cate ma, a mangkhangsa pata na ming na padyi? Israel Khazing Pathe na naa du!

Na changtaapa tie hmuo pata Abyipakha tue hyalya cate, nama ta, “I ruole a hluvsa hne tana, aa suopa tluo luo kha i sithaw, Lebanon tluodaw luo kha i kie tli, a sidar kung aa suo cepa tie hne, a myisaa kung a pha cepa tie kha i hu tli; aa hla cenapa aa suona luo, a ping cenapa aa tuv chung luo kha i chiy tli.
Takhue kha cu angte, tiy kha i dang, Izipt cavaata bangkhuo kha i phyipazaa ta i paky diy,” na ta.

‘A hluo ning taata bie i za chi tli tapa kha, thyi va ca ma? A hluo ning taa khata za tingtuo pacie angte, ata hing i vya chiykhyi. Dungkhuopa khypuv tie kha, pacing pata a rapa aa pungnapa ta tue riypata ica pa-aw.
A chunglie khy a sapa tie ca ama thaa chuo te, ama nang-uo te amaa kalaa; iema ca lu lie aphuv haata hne, ing cunglie a pupa aphuv haata ama le hluota amaa uv.
‘Naa daapa hne naa tupa, na pyapa hne naa ngiepa, i cunglie na hihaapa zaw kha i pachang.
I cunglie na hi haa te, na pyathuna kha i thyi nakawta, na hnacabuv kha i kyipa ica pasiy sa aa; na pakaa lie kha thaatungriy ca tuv'a angte, naa vawnapa luopuv taata, ica pakaa sa aa.

“'Cakhutaata hingpa hing na cuota pamangsana ta a cuo aa: Ata kung hne huo kung ca sahliypa kha ning'a ung cate, cakhutaata a kung thungna lie ca, saciy kha tuv ung la, sa kha hrie ung la, mingsuv diedung kha tue ung la a thyipaa kha ning tie ung.
Judah ingchungkhue taata a hringpa ta aa ngaapa tie ca aa thuvsa pata ama thariy thlabung'a yi te, cungluo kha thyi ama kya pathyi aa.
Tahematapakieca Jerusalem taata aa ngaapa tie pya'a yi te, Zion Tluo taata a hringpa tie ama pya aa. Cungnungce Abyipakhingna ta hingpa hing a tue aa.

“'Caacuonakawta Assiria siepahruo hne aa patuv pata Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Ama ca hingpa khypuv chung luo hing a vaw'a vyi, cuoti kha vya ka'a vyi, hingpa khypuv hmie luo hing phya hneta a vaw'a vyi, riekhuocaaca zaw ca sasue'a vyi.
Aa vawnapa luopuv taa khata a kaa aa; hingpa khypuv chung luo hing a ngie'a vyi, Abyipana a ta.
Tahematapakieca kama cuota hne i changtaapa David cuota hingpa khypuv hing khuo riypata i daakhuo aa,’” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipaavuoming kha a thu te Assiria ming arina hmang lie kha thawzakha thawsawcari thawpangaa a thie yi; mawluo khy a kya dyi ca athiypa riyy seta a cuo.
Cakhutaata Assiria Siepahruo Sennakherib ca pya te, ing luo kha si te Nineveh lie kha a aw.
A khazing Nisrok ing chunglieta khazing aa bie nguoluo ning khata a sacapaa tie Adrammelek hne Sharezer ta zueziy ta thie yi te, Ararat ruo luo kha amaa ruo. A sacapaa Esar-haddon ta ama kha aa thle.

Capa cuo lie ca Hezekiah ca pasa te vuotaa a thiy'a nang. Amoz sacapaa profet Isaiah kha ama'a luo a vaw te, “Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Na ingchungkhue kha aa chaw aa rawsa pata tue tie, tahematapakieca tluo pakhaa'a va tli ciy, na thiy aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Hezekiah ca tlepie luo kha a hyi te Abyipa'a luo kha thlaa a chuo:

“Vya Abyipa, paa na ica kie, pathiypalung hmisi hne zang tluo aa tlasa pata na hmiekunglie tuokhaatama i hring tapa hne, na hmungna lieta phana i tue tapa kha ata hingta naa thyipa thi tie,” a ta. Cakhutaata Hezekiah ca khuosa ta a caa.
Cakhutaata Abyipabie ca Isaiah'a luo kha aa vaw:

“Cakuo la Hezekiah kha va chang tie, Na mingchingmingvuo a cuopa David Khazing, Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Na thlaachuona kha i thyi tli, na mingthliy kha i hmung tli; na hringna kha kung hraa hlyipangaa ica bechiy aa.
Nama hne hingpa khypuv hing Assiria siepahruo kuv chungtaata ca khuo'a yi angte hingpa khypuv hing i daakhuo aa.
“Hingpa hing Abyipa'a taata pamangsana ta a cuo, Abyipata a biekuona haata hingpa hmang tie hing a tue aa:
Mang tie, Ahaz ta a tuepa ning-siymaluo kuv ningdiy kha hnangluo kyi hraa i pakaa sa aa,” a ta. Caacuonakawta ning thlaapa ca hnangluo kha kyi hraa a kaa.
A pasa khutaata hne a pasana taata a tluo pakhaa khutaata Judah Siepahruo Hezekiah ta a capepa ca:
I chuo cangkuv tana i thiy aa, i ta; aa ngaapa i hringna kung tie kha Athiykhy thlake luo pipa tana i cuo.
A hringpa tie ruo lie hing Abyipakha hmung'a va tli ang, i ta. Chuelyi lie khy a sapa tie hrawlieta, cawsaa kha hmung'a va tli yi ang.

Tuvkhietuv thluodaa haa khata, i awnapa kha a dapathla pata kama'a taata thaw pata a cuo; thetaatuv ta a tuepa haata, the haata na lang te, thetluo taata ina pachung; ning kha chunglie hingta i hringna ca a pachuo sa'a tli, i ta.
Maw te ta khi angte abyana i hie; chingde haa khata i ruv bangkhuo ina thli diy; ning kha chunglie hingta i hringna ca a pachuo sa'a tli, i ta.
Chiyvie hne tiypavaa haa khata khi angte, thuvruv haata i hrung. Cungluo i mangnapa ta i ming a ri. Vya Abyipa, tuechie pata na i cuo, i bangna ta cuo thi tie!
Cuorasala khaapama i ri the aa? Tahematapakieca ama na kama'a lie kha a ri, ama hrahring na hingpa hing a tue. I hring rie a thyituv nakawta, i mingkuv hruv te a hmung the va ang.
Vya Abyipa, hingpa hmang thue hing tana cawsaa ama hring, hingpa zaw chunglie'apa bangkhuo hingna i thlaapa hringna ta a cuo. Vya Abyipa, na patluo sa la na pahring sa thi!
Pasana khuopuv ta i za angpa kha kama phana cuo tana a cuo hmisi; ranapa khue chung taa tana i hringna kha na papya pakhaa, tahematapakieca i suena bangkhuo khana na hnangluo na thaw.
Tahematapakieca Athiykhy ta caa law the'a vyi, thiyna ta ca pathuosa the'a vyi; khue chungluo a tlapa ca zang tluo naa tlana cuo khata anguopuona hnyi vyi.
A hringpa, a hringpa, iema na caa pathuosa yi, ataning kama ica pathuosapa haa hingta; zang tluo naa tlana kha paa tie ta saata zaw kha ama pachang sa.
Abyipata kama kha ina khuo aa, cakhutaata kiema ca tingtuo kha tung'a pate hlaa ma sa aa.
Isaiah ta, “Thyikuv caapa hlung kha vya cyi tie ung. A hmaa lie kha va chi yi sala a tluo aa,” a ta.
Hezekiah zaw ta, “Abyipaing luo i khaw riypata khaapama pahmungsana ta a cuo?” a ta.

Capa cuo lie ca Babilon ming Baladan sacapaa siepahruo Merodak-baladan ta Hezekiah ca pasa tena a tluo pakhaa tapa kha a thyi nakawta luosituv tie kha vya pathlie yi te caa hne lasaw kha a vya paphya.

Hezekiah ta palung tluosa pata cuhluo yi te, a suethiy ing, ngu, siy, rangpa-ue, a muosungpa chiytiy, a cehre china ing bangkhuo, hne a chechiy china ing chunglie hmung khupa bangkhuo kha a pahmung diy yi. A ing chunglie a awpa hne a ruo chunglie a awpa bangkhuo kha Hezekiah ta a pahmung lipa yi suokha hmuo aw vyi.

Cakhutaata profet Isaiah ca siepahruo Hezekiah'a luo kha a vaw te, “Hingpa cawsaa tie hingta khaapama ama ri? Khaapa taata ma nama'a luo hing amaa vaw?” a ta. Hezekiah ta, “Iema ca aa luohlaasapa ruo Babilon taa tana amaa vaw,” a ta.

Isaiah ta, “Na ing lie khaapama ama hmung?” a ta. Hezekiah ta palie te, “I ing chunglie a awpa bangkhuo kha ama hmung diy; i chechiy china ing chunglie a awpa suokha hmuo i pahmung lipa yi aw vyi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Isaiah ta Hezekiah kyihuo khata, “Cungnungce Abyipabie hing naathlie tie:

Na ing chunglie a awpa bangkhuo, hne na mingchingmingvuo tie ta ataning tepa ta ama za pacungpa bangkhuo kha Babilon luo ama sikhyi diyna cuo ca aa vawle nguoluo tli; suokha hmuo thuse pata cuo'a vyi, Abyipana a ta.
Na sapa na sacapaa chekha zaw kha sikhyi'a yi te, iema ca Babilon siepahruo ing lie kha tiydiypa, rehrietuv ta ama cuo aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Hezekiah ta Isaiah kyihuo khata, “Na ripa Abyipabie ca a pha,” a ta. Tahematapakieca ama ta, “I chuo chunglie diena hne abangna a aw kieca a pha thluo aa,” ta pata a rue.
I cawsaa zaw kha hnaa panguo tie ung, hnaa panguo tie ung, Khazing ta a ta.

Khi ung la Jerusalem kha hnaapanguona bie chang tie ung, ama hne a cuo chunglie kha a hrie riypa ca a hrie tli, a suena muo zaw pipa pata a cuo tli, a suena bangkhuo cuo khata Abyipakuv taata, le hning ta a hmung tli.
Ueryi suokha ta: “Ruocaapa chunglie kha Abyipaluopuv kha sa tie ung, viehnangruo chunglie kha ma Khazing cuota aa dangpa luopuv lepa suokha sa tie ung.
Huekaw mekaa ca pabi pata cuo'a te, tluo hne tluothlue mekaa ca pacing pata ama cuo aa; aa nguo lina mekaa kha aa nguosa pata tue pata cuo'a te, a bu hliehluvna mekaa kha pame pata a cuo aa.
Cakhutaata Abyiparungnaana ca a luo'a te, cawsaa bangkhuo ta ama hmung pakhaw aa, tahematapakieca Abyipana a pakaa taata a ri,” a ta.
Ueryi suokha ta, “Khi tie!” ina ta. Kama ta, “Khaapama i khi aa?” i ta. Cawsaa bangkhuo hing aphuv tana ama cuo, ama hringna cuo hing ruo lie paapaapa haa tana a cuo.
Abyipata a huv a sungsue tiy yi ta, aphuv ca caa te, paapaapa ca a lang, cawsaa hing aphuv tana ama cuo hmisi.
Aphuv ca a caa, paapaapa ca a lang; cuorasala Khazing bie ca chuozaa ta aa hmang.

Vya Zion, thuohlaa phapa a vya phyatuv, tluo aa suopa luo kha kie tie; Vya Jerusalem, thuo hlaa pha a vya phyatuv, khuosa ta khi tie, khi tie, ciy khah; Judah khypuv tie kha, “Hingpa lie hingna nama Khazing a aw!” ta tie.
Mang tie, Khazing, Abyipaca cahrana hne tana aa vaw, a kuvbuo tana a uv'a yi, a lawmuo ca ama'a lie ta aw te, a lasaw ca a hmiekunglie tana a aw.
Ama ta tuvkhietuv haata a tuvrung kha sa a pi aa; a tuvtaata tie kha a buo lie cabale'a yi te, a cacunghnaa lie aa paw'a yi, tuvpuvnung tie zaw kha a neta tah luo aa chiyle'a yi.

Ahungma riyliy tiy hing a kuvpazaa ta a patang khu aa? Ahungma avuo khiy a kha ta a panang khu aa? Ahungma buvcing hing panangna suokha chunglie a khung diy khu aa? Ahungma tluo hne tluothlue zaw hing cyi pathliena ta a pathlie khu aa?
Ruena pituv ta cawsaa pakha kha ruena a pipa haata, ahungma Abyipathlaapa kha ruena a pi khu aa?
A cuona kawlie kha ahungma ruena aa hie buo? Biedangpa luopuv kha ahungma a chang? Ahungma ama kha thesingna a pacuv? Ahungma pachangna luopuv kha a chang?

Mingphang zaw hing hmuo tiypung taata a tlapa tiydiy suokha haata cuo yi te, cyipathliena cunglie buvcing suokha haa tana ri pata na ama cuo; mang tie, parala tie hue alyi diypa tluv dyi tana a ri yi.
Lebanon ta tiy riypa thing ring khu'a vyi, a chunglie saruopa tie ta myirue panaana cuo khata a zu'a va yi.
Mingphang bangkhuo hing a hmiekunglie ca khaapatahmuo cuo va yi; ama ta ca iema hing khaapahmuo a cuo lipa hne a hripa laata a caw vie tana a ri yi.
Khazing ca ahung hneta ma na palu sa aa? Tuokhaapa hmingsuo ma ama hne hingta na pakhingpuo aa?
Kuvtuezuv ca rehrietuv ta patle te, siy patletuv ta siy ta a pakaw, cahaacata ngu buoliriy zaw kha a patle.
Cawsaa pakha ta ahlu pi riypata a hmaw li riypa thing, puvlung thing kha aa tlaw. cakhutaata a ra li riypa kuvtuezuv kha tue riypata, kuvzung a thepa kha a huv taw.
Pachang va ca ma? Thyi buo va ca ma? A hruothu taata ca chang va yi ma? Alyi hruothu baataa khata za pachang the va ung ca ma?
Alyi a pahiena cunglie a tupa ca ama ta cuo te, alyi ming ca khawbyapa haa tana ama cuo; avuo kha pangzu haata pake te, a chunglie awna riypa thluodaa haa khata a pake.
Byi tie kha a hrihripa ta tue yi te, uvtuv tie kha khaapahmuo a cuo lipa ta a tue yi.
Amaa ling cakhaw raalaa, ama tuv cakhaw raalaa, a thariy kha alyi lieta a thla cakhaw raalaa, a huv ta a hmung tiy yi ta caa yi te, thliychie ta sacuo kung caapa haata a phya yi.
Khazing Pathe ta, ahung hneta ma ina pakhing'a ciy, acuolikie ahung hneta ma maa khing? a ta.

Na ming kha aa suona luo padyi la hmung tie; hingpa zaw hing ahungma a sa? Cawsaa hluvsa kha kya pyakhyi yi te a ri diypa ca ama tana a cuo, iema bangkhuo kha ama ming ta a ku the diy yi; tahematapakieca ama ca a thaa ruv te, cahra te a lesyi, pakha hmuo vie va yi.
Vya Jakob, khaapanakawma, “I sina luopuv kha Abyipata hmung vyi, na ta? Vya Israel, khaapanakawma, Abyipata kama cuo kha na pacuo vyi,” na ta?

Pachang va ung ca ma? Thyi va ung ca ma? Abyipaca chuozaa ta aa hmangpa Khazing tana a cuo, ama ca alyi dena te ta a sapa tana a cuo. Ama ca a thaa ri buo li pata a nang buo buo vyi; a singna kha ahungtahmuo pachang khu pata cuo vyi.
