A thaa chuopa kha cahrana pi te, cahrana a hnyi lipa kha thaazuo a pi.
Mingnu zaw hmuota ama thaa ri the te ama nang a buo the, mingnu tie zaw ama nang buo tuv pata amaa lie aa;
cuorasala Abyipaa huopa tie ca ama thaa na a tlung pakhaa aa, hmungthlu haa tana ama mathlaa ta amaa zu aa, a ruo'a yi te ama nang buo'a vyi, cakuo'a yi te ama thaa ri'a vyi.
Vya riyliy kie ruo zaw a dieta tah na naathlie tie ung; cawsaa zaw ta ama thaa a patlung yi se; vaa ngie yi sala ri yi se; bieripana luo kha vaa ngie pakhaw'a ung puv.

Ningchiyluo taata tetuv kha ahungma a pathu? A re hrie riypata ama kha ahungma a ku? Mingphang zaw kha khuo yi te, siepahruo zaw kha a kuv rawlieta a chaapuo yi; ama ta a zueziy khata iema kha buvcing haata a tue yi, thliy ta savie a phyapa haata a liy khata a pazu yi.
Iema kha a cade yi te aa bangsa pata a law yi, a phyi ta luopuv kha a de tlaku.
A hruothu taata mingphang zaw kha ku pata, hingpa hmang a tuepa hing ahungtama a cuo? Kama, Abyipaca a pakhana, hne a chuona zaw ta i cuo aa.
Riyliy kie ruo tie ta hmung yi te ama ciy, alyi dena tie ta amaa cathang; iema ca a vya ngie yi te amaa vaw.
Pakha hne pakha kha amaa bya, pakha hne pakha kha, “Na palung cahra se!” a maa ta.

Kuv zung a thepa ta siy patletuv kha thaazuo pi te, khunglung ta a pamepa khata a de nguoluo kaliepa kha thaazuo pi te, thaa a pabiepa kawlieta, “A pha,” a ta; cakhutaata kuvtuezuv ca aa hnyi the li riypata thaakhe ta ama khepuo.
Cuorasala, nama, Israel, i changtaapa, Jakob, kama ta i tlawpa, i viesaapa Abraham ciypathla;
alyi dena taata ca la angte, aa hlacenapa a kiy taata i kupa, “Nama ca i changtaapa tana na cuo, nama ca caa tlaw angte, ca thaw'a va ang,” ica ta.
Ciy khah, tahematapakieca nama'a liena i aw, ciy'a vaciy, tahematapakieca kama ca na Khazing tana i cuo, kama na thaa caa patlung'a ang, kama na caa bya'a ang, i tena i cacuo kuv tana ica dyichaw aa.
A cuo, niema caa dupa bangkhuo ca nangzaa hmiechina na ama ang aa; nama a du riypata a zuepa ca ra'a te khaapatahmuo cuo'a vyi.
Nama caa dupa kha huv'a yi cate, cuorasala hmung'a va yi ciy; nama hneta rie a dupa ca khaapatahmuo cuo'a vyi.
Tahematapakieca Kama, Abyipana Khazing na na cacuo kuv ta caa patuv ang; nama kyihuo ta, “Ciy khah, icaa bya aa,” caa tapa ca kama tana i cuo.
Ciy khah, a cawkariyta Jakob hne a thaa dyapa Israel! Abyipana, kama na caa bya'a ang, caa ta; nama caa khuotuv ca Israel Khazing Pathe tana a cuo.
Kama na sacuo a ciynapa a thaapa, a cahresapa haa a hnyipa ta caa tue'a ang, tluo zaw kha carie'a cate naa ciy aa, tluothlue zaw kha savie haata na tue aa.
Nama ta pathlaa'a yi cate thliy ta a phya'a yi, thliychie ta a phya patlaa diy'a yi. Cakhutaata Abyipa'a lie kha na palung tluo'a te, Israel Khazing Pathe kha na parungnaa sa aa.
Siypasa hne vuosuopa tie ta tiy ama huv tiyta, tiy aw li pata, ama tiy a hrie nakawta ama duo a caa, Abyipakama ta chaw'a yi angte, Israel Khazing kama ta thaw'a va yi ang.
Tluocaapa lieta cavaa palang sa'a angte, bawphie lie kha acaa i patling sa aa; ruocaapa chunglie kha tiy-ang aw le'a te, viehnangruo taata tiy a pya aa.
Ruocaapa chunglie kha sidar thing, akasia, tlieseta kung, hne olif zaw i papu sa aa; viehnangruo lie kha saipres thing, ahre thing hne myisaa thing zaw kha i papu sa pakhaw'a yi.
Caacuonakawta Abyipakuv na a tue tapa kha, cawsaa bangkhuo ta, mang'a yi te ama hmung aa, rue'a yi te ama pachang aa, Israel Khazing Pathe na a tue.
Abyipata, nama kaw ca vya chiykhyi tie ung, namaa daakhyipa bie ca ri tie ung, Israel Siepahruo zaw, a ta.

Vya chiykhyi yi sala khaapama a vya cuo aa tapa kha malie chang yi se. Kiema ta ma rue the riypata, hluo ning hmang tie kha khaapatama ama cuo tapa kha malie chang yi se, capa taa cata a vya chiy a vya cuo riypa kha ma rue the riypata, a vaw riypa hmang kha malie pathyi sa yi se.

Hingpa khutaa hingta khaapama a vaw aa tapa kha malie chang tie ung, khazing nama cuopa kha ca pachang naase yi puv; kiema ta ciy pate maa cathangsa riypata, a phapa acuolikie a chiepa suokhakha kha tue tie ung.
Niema ca khaapatahmuo cuo hmisi va ung ciy, nama re hriepa zaw hing khaapatahmuo cuo vyi, niema caa tlawpa mekaa ca duvsamakhiepa tana ama cuo.
Chaluo cawsaa pakha kha a tlaw angte, ningchiyna taa khata a ming ta i ku. Bivytuv ta acyi aa ciypa haata, uvtuv tie kha aa ciy'a yi.
Kiema ta a hruothu taa khata ma pachang the riypata hne, pachanglu pate, “Ama hingna a cuo,” ma ta the riypata ahungma zaa pathyi sa? Zaa pathyi sapa ahunghmuo aw va yi, pakha hmuo aw va yi.
Zion a pathyi sa taapa ca kama tana i cuo, Jerusalem luo thuohlaa phapa a phyatuv kha kama na a pathlie ang.
Cuorasala i mang tiyta, iema hrawlieta ruenapituv pakha hmuo aw va yi, bie i hiehriy tiy yi ta, naa palie thepa pakha hmuo aw va yi.
Iema bangkhuo hing a hanghiepa tana ama cuo; ama hrie khupa khaapahmuo aw vyi; ama kuvtuezuv tie hing a hrihripa tana ama cuo.
Abyipana, “Hingpa lie hingna i changtaapa, i daakhyipa, i tlawpa, hne i tlechuopa ca a aw; i thlaapa kha a cunglie chi angte, mingphang zaw'a luo kha biedangpa a tlungkhyi aa.
A ueryi pasuo pata khi'a vyi, luopuv chunglie a ueryi thyi riypata tue'a vyi;
chaapuo cie tlipa phiepahlaa kung kha thli lue'a vyi, dyadyata tah a iepa myi kha pache'a vyi; biedangpa khana zang tluo aa tlasa pata a vya tlungkhyi aa.
Alyi cunglie biedangpa kha a cusa pata aa daa hluo li ta, a nang buo li'a pata a thaa chi'a vyi; riyliy kie ruo zaw na a pacuvna kha a huo yi.
Abyipa, Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Ahungma avuo hing sa te a pake? Ahungma alyi hne a chunglie a awpa tie hing a sa? Ahungma cawsaa hing huvsungna pi te, a chunglie thlaapa zaw hing a pi?

Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo, kama na nama kha adangna chunglie caa ku ang, kama na na kuv ta ca la angte caa mangsang ang; kama na cawsaa zaw'a luo kha biekuona haata caa pi ang, mingphang zaw'a luo kha khena ta caa pi ang.
Kama na mingcuepa tie ming pahmung sa riypata, thaw a tlapa tie kha thaw-ing chungtaata papya riypata, zingna chunglie a tupa thaw a tlapa tie kha zingna thaw-ing chungtaata papya riypata caa ku ang.
Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo, capa ca kama ming ta a cuo; i rungnaana hing a hrangpa kha cuose, i pathuosana hing kuvtuezuv kha cuose pi khing va yi ang.
Mang tie ung, i za ri ciepa khana a vya tlung tli, ata zaw hing hmang thaapa kha i pathyi sa aa, amaa vya luo hluo tana ica chang pacie yi.

Abyipa'a luo kha hlaa thaapa sa tie ung, pathuosana hlaa kha alyi dena te ta sa tie ung! Riyliy hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo ta pathuosa ung la, riyliy kie ruo tie hne a cawsaa zaw ta pathuosa tie ung.
Viehnangruo hne a khy tie ta ama ueryi pasuo yi sala, Kedar ming zaw ta khuosa ta khi yi sala pathuosa yi se; Sela cawsaa tie ta palungtluona hlaa sa yi sala, tluodaw taa khata khi yi se.
Abyipakha rungnaana pi yi sala, riyliy kie ruo tie luo kha ama pathuosana pathyi sa yi se.
Abyipaca rieka haa khata pya te, a riephapa rieka tie haa khata a hi aa pahaa; khi te, khuosa ta a u, a carie tie a du riypata a thaaruvpa a cuopa kha aa pahmung sa yi.
Cuo pasiy puv chung a dieta tah i za aw, a cadang angte a diesa pata i za aw, ata hing ca nu ta a pazipa canung haata, i huv pa-y'a angte i khi aa.
Tluo hne tluothlue tie kha para diy'a angte, thinghnaaruohnaa bangkhuo i pacaa sa diy aa; cavaa zaw kha parala ta pali'a angte, tiy-ang zaw kha i paky sa diy aa.

Mingcuepa tie kha ama pachang lipa hne, ama pachang buo lipa luopuv kha ziykhyi'a yi angte, Iema kha luo i chiyle'a yi. Ama hmiekunglieta zingna kha khena ta pali'a angte, a bu hliehluvpa luopuv kha i pame aa. Hingpa tie hing kama ta i tue aa, iema kha thaw'a va yi ang.
Kuv ta khepa kuvtuezuv kha a ringchuopa tie, patlepa kuvtuezuv kha, “Ma khazing tana na cuo,” a tapa tie ca, hnangluo kha kaa'a yi te nangzaa pata ama aw aa.
Niema, naaruepa tie naathlie tie ung; niema mingcuepa tie mang ung la hmung tie ung!
I changtaapa ta li pata ahungma a ming a cue? I pathliepa i biephyatuv ta li pata ahungma a naa a rue? Kama cawsaa aa pipasepa, Abyipachangtaapa haa hingta a mingcuepa ama aw ma?
Ama ta hmang a hluvsa kha a hmung, cuorasala a cuota saa a tlepa aw vyi; a naathlie thluo, cuorasala thyi vyi.
A pacuvna kha paku vie riypa hne parungnaa riypata, aa dangpa a cawsaa zaw kawlie kha Abyipaca aa law.

Cuorasala hingpa cawsaa tie hing ca malie ta paruvpa hne chuvpa tana ama cuo, iema bangkhuo ca khue chunglie pahruv khuo pata cuo yi te, thaw chunglie nupa tana ama cuo; iema ca ahungtahmuo khuo li pa, paruvpa hne chuvpa ta ama cuo. “Pi pakhaa tie ung,” a ta riy aw li pata chuvpa tana ama cuo.
Capa ca niema hrawlie ahungma a naathlie'a ung ciy? A vaw riypa cuo lie ahungma a phata tah a naathlie'a ung ciy?

Ahungma Jakob kha hruosue a chuvtuv tie'a luo a pi ung ciy? Ahungma Israel kha aparuvpa kuv luo a pi ung ciy? A cunglie ma suepa Abyipata cuo va ma? Iema ta a luopuv ama ziy lipa, iema ta a phungluo ama pa-uvsathyi lipa khata cuo va ma?

Caacuonakawta a lingsapa a hihaana hne, a pathiy iena rietuvna kha a cunglieta a za bya, capa ca ta a cahriy bangkhuo kha a kuo, cuorasala ama ta pachang vyi; capa ca ta a ma kha a kuo, cuorasala ina kuo ing tapa hmuo pachang vyi.

Cuorasala Vya Jakob, Vya Israel, nama caa satuv hne nama caa tuetuv Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Ciy khah, tahematapakieca kama na caa khuo ang; kama na na ming ta caa ku ang, nama ca kama huopa tana na cuo.
Tiy na te tiyta nama'a lie i aw aa; cavaa tiy ta nama kha ca phya'a vyi; myi chunglie na cakuo zawta ca kuo'a vyi, myihlaa ta ca la'a vyi.
Tahematapakieca kama ca Abyipana Khazing tana i cuo, Israel Khazing Pathe, caa khuotuv tana i cuo. Nama caa thla riypata Izipt kha ca pi angte, Ethiopia hne Seba kha nama caa riy riypata ica pi.
Tahematapakieca nama ca kama hmungna lie muosung pata cuo cate, ca pa-uvsathyi angte, ica due, nama cuopa ta cawsaa kha pi angte, nama hringna cuota mingphang zaw kha i pi yi.
Ciy khah, tahematapakieca nama'a liena i aw; na ciypathla kha ningchiy taata vya tlungkhyi'a yi angte, ningtla taa zaw ta ica pahmya'a yi.

Chaluo ruo kyihuo khata, “Iema kha na pi tie yi,” ta'a angte, sungluo ruo kyihuo khata, “Patuv khah yi,” i ta aa. I sacapaa zaw kha luohlaa taata vya tlungkhyi ung la, i sacanung zaw kha alyi dena taata vya tlungkhyi tie ung.
I ming ta kupa bangkhuo hing, i rungnaana cuota i sapa ta cuo yi te, i sapa hne i tuepa tana ama cuo.
Ming a hnyi thluo pata a mingcuepa tie, naa a hnyi thluo pata, a naa ruepa tie kha a vawkhyi tie ung!

Mingphang bangkhuo kha a vya hmya yi se, cawsaa zaw kha a vya pung yi se. Iema hraw taata ahungma hingpa hing pathyisa'a te, a vya cuo taa riypa kaw kha malie a changlu aa? Iema hing aa hmuopa tana ama cuo a tapa tehte kha vya chiykhyi yi se, malie khata thyi yi sala “Hingpa hing a hmisipa tana a cuo,” tapa kha ri yi se.

Abyipana, niema ta kama hing na pachang'a ung cate, ina zang riypa ung ca hne, kama hingna Khazing ta a cuo ang tapa kha nama pachang riypata, niema ca i tehte ta cuo ung cate, i tlawpa i changtaapa tana nama cuo, a ta.
Kama dyi hing Abyipata cuo angte, kama ta li pata khuotuv hrang aw vyi.
Za ri tli angte, ca khuo yi angte, i pathyi sa tli, ruohrang khazing ahungtahmuo niema hrawlie cahaapa ca tue vyi; niema ca kama tehte tana nama cuo, Abyipata a ta.
Ning hne cuo a za patha hluo taata, kama ca Khazing tana i cuo; kama kuv chungtaata ahungtahmuo ca khuo khu'a va yi; kama ta i tuepa hing ahungma a daakhuo khu aa?

Abyipa, nama caa Khuotuv, Israel Khazing Pathe na hing haa hingta a ri: Niema cuo hingta Babilon luo kha pathlie'a yi angte, amaa dungkhuona kha i pacing diy aa, cakhutaata Khaldi ming khi-una ca caana ta aa li aa.
Kama ca Abyipa, nama Khazing Pathe tana i cuo, Israel ming a satuv nama Siepahruo tana i cuo.
Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Ahungma riyliy chunglie luopuv hing a sa? Ahungma a cahrapa tiy chunglie luopuv hing a tue?
Ahungma aruole hne aruo, rieka riephapa tie kha a vya tlungkhyi yi? Iema ca a lie yi te thu khu va yi, pachesa pata na ama cuo, myisaa haata pache pata na ama cuo.
Hluo ning zaa cuopa kaw kha a thyi khah tie ung, a hlungpa kaw kha rue khah tie ung.
Hmang thaapa na i tue aa; ata hing a kya pya aa, hmung the, pachang the'a va ung ca ma? Ruocaapa chunglie kha luopuv suokha pasi sa'a angte, ruocaapa chunglie kha cavaa zaw i palang sa'a yi.
Saruopa zaw ta na pa-uvsathyi'a yi te, ruo-uv hne kala-uvpavaa zaw ta ina pa-uvsathyi'a yi; tahematapakieca i tlawpa i cawsaa zaw hne, kama cuota i sapa cawsaa zaw ta kama ina pathuosa riypa yi ta,
ruocaapa lie kha tiy pi yi angte, viehnangruo chunglie kha cavaa i palang sa.
Cuorasala Vya Jakob, kama kha na u vaciy; Vya Israel, kama ca ica nang yi!

Myirue panaana ta abie riypata na tuv kha kama'a luo vya cyi vaciy, kama kha hriykhungrina ta na pa-uvsathyi vaciy. Pihluona na hnyi ung ta pata nama hmang ca pariy va yi ang, rangpa-ue na pihluo ung ta pata riethyi ca pi va yi ang.

Kama cuota a thlungpa pasuv kha tuokaa ta calyi vaciy, hriykhungrinapa saa thupa zaw ta i palung na patling vaciy. Cuorasala na suena ta i hmang na pariy cate, hmang pha lipa tuena ta riethyi ina pi ciy.
Kama hingna, kama i cuona ta, nama tuesuena kha caa hruvpa diypa yi ta a cuo ang, nama suena kha caa thyipa'a va tli yi ang.
Tazaa na cyi ung la bieripana zung luo ca cakuo ung siy; a pha ta pata acaa paw riypa yi ta, nama bie ca ri tie ung.
Na mingchingmingvuo taapa ca a za sue, nama luochiytuv tie ta i cunglie suena ama za tue.
Caacuonakawta hmangpathepa lie byi tie kha i thaw yi, Jakob ca para karue pata cuo'a te, Israel ca ese pata a cuo aa.
Cuorasala, Vya i changtaapa Jakob, i tlawpa Israel, naathlie tie!
Na nung riy chunglie nama caa tuepa hne caa bya riypa, nama caa sapa Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Vya i changtaapa Jakob, kama ta i tlawpa Jeshurun, ciy khah.

Tahematapakieca a tiyhriepa ruo khana kama ta tiy i bya aa, ruocaapa lie khana cavaa i palang sa aa; Kama ta nama ciypathla tie cunglie kha i thlaapa bya'a yi angte, nama samingsahlaa tie cunglie kha thluechiy i pi'a yi.
Bawphie lie aphuv haata kya le'a yi te, cavaa kielie a pupa paasung kung khana ama lu aa.

Pakha ta, “Abyipacawsaa tana i cuo,” a ta aa, a hrangpa pakha ca Jakob ming ta kupa a cuo aa, a hrangpa tie ta ama buotung lie kha, “Abyipahuopa tana i cuo,” tapa kha cape'a yi te, Israel ming kha amaa la ra aa.
Abyipa, Israel Siepahruo hne, ama Khuotuv, Cungnungce Abyipata: Kama ca a hmietaa ce hne a hnangcaw ce tana i cuo; kama ta li pata khazing hrangpa aw vyi.

Ahungma kama haapa a aw? Khi yi sala pathyi sa yi se, zaapuv thyi ta ri yi sala kama hmiekung luo vya pyakhyi yi se. Ahungma hluo ning taa khata a vaw riypa hmang kaw kha a pathyi sa? Khaapama ma tue aa tapa kha malie chang yi se.

Ciy khah ung, nama rie chie khah se; hluo ning taata ri angte, ca chang va yi ang ma? Niema ca kama tehte tana nama cuo. Kama ta li pata khazing hrangpa a aw ma? Lungpuv hrangpa aw vyi; pakha hmuo pachang va ang.

A cuota kuvtuezuv a tuepa bangkhuo ca khaapahmuo a cuo lipa tana ama cuo, ama tlechuopa hmang ta thlahnena pi'a va yi; ama tehtekhuona ca hmungpa hne pachang pata cuo'a vyi. Caacuonakawta iema ca ama nang a zaasa aa.
Ahungma phana a tue khu lipa khazing kha tue te, kuvtuezuv kha a patle?

Mang tie ung, a zangpa tie zaw hing ama nang na a zaa aa; a satuv kuvzung a thepa tie zaw hing cawsaa cakhawpa tana ama cuo. Ama bangkhuo ta a hmya yi sala, a daa yi se; iema ca ama ciy pata a cathang'a yi te, ama nang a zaa aa.
Susatuv ta a sa, sumyi lie kha paling te, a cahrapa a kuv khata khunglung ta de te hmingsuo kha a pahnyi sa; a nang diy, a tiy hrie te a thaa a buo.
Lettamaa ta thing kha taa te, khedaa ta aa hnangna a tue, cakhutaata a cehre khata a syi, a khe, a zi khutaata abiena hmang lie chi riypata cawsaa a puvthesapa zuv haa khata a tue.
Sidar thing kha a hu, acuolikie atuv lieta thingkung lepa ta a cuopa asie thing hne mathliy thing zaw kha aa tlaw. Sidar thing kha a ling te khytiy ta a pale sa.

Cakhutaata thing ca myitiy riypata hmuo khu pata a cuo. Chekha kha la te myi a e riypata a tiy, chekha kha myi lie ca tiy te viechuo a rue. Cakhutaata chekha khata khazing ta tue te aa bie, kuvtuezuv kha tue te a hmiekunglie aa bung.
Thing chekha kha myi lie tiy riypata a hmuo; capa myi lie ca saa kha pasu te, ning te a palung a tling. Myi zaw kha a e te, “Ah, ina lung, aa nuo ciemuo!” a ta.
Capa thing aa ngaapa cata a kuvtuezuv, khazing kha tue te, a hmiekunglie kha a bung te aa bie, ama'a lie kha thlaachuo te, “Na khuo tie, tahematapakieca i khazing tana na cuo!” a ta.
Iema ca pachang va yi, pachangna hnyi va yi; tahematapakieca ama ming ca pasing yi te, caacuonakawta hmung the va yi, ama palung zaw zing te, caacuonakawta pachang the va yi.

Ahungtahmuo khue rue va yi, thesingna hne thleduo khuna hnyi lipa yi ta, “Hingpa thing a che hing myi ta tiy angte, a myihyi cunglieta viechuo i rue, sa kha changna angte i ning. Aa ngaapa hingta duvsamakhie aa chiypa kha i tue'a ma? Thing tungpa hmiekunglie hing ma a bu'a angte i bie aa?” ta the va yi.

Ama ca buvcuo a ningpa haa tana a cuo; ruena ngaapa pathiypalung a hnyipa khata luo a papie sa, ama hne ama zaw kha a khuo khu li tli pata, “I cacuoluo kuv chunglie a awpa hing dungna hne hangna tana a cuo,” ta the va tli.
Vya Jakob, Vya Israel, hingpa hmang tie hing maw khah, tahematapakieca nama ca i changtaapa tana na cuo; kama na caa sa ang, i changtaapa tana na cuo; Vya Israel, nama kha ca maw'a va ang.
Na tuesuena kha amyi haata hne, myiching haa tana ica hmungpa pathla diy aa; kama'a luo vya kaa tie, tahematapakieca kama na caa thla ang.

Vya avuo, hlaa sa tie, tahematapakieca Abyipana hingpa hing a tue; Vya alyi khue aa thuvpa, khi tie, Vya tluo zaw, khuopuv ta hlaa sa tie ung, Vya atuv, hne a chunglie thingkung mekaa tie! Tahematapakieca Abyipata Jakob kha khuo te, Israel chunglieta a parungnaa sa aa.

Abyipa, nama caa Khuotuv, na nung riy chunglie nama caa tuetuv na hing haa hingta a ri: Kama ca hmangting bangkhuo a sapa Abyipatana i cuo, kama pakha dyi tana avuo hing i pakhuv, kama thue hing tana alyi hing aa pake;

kama na kuvcaa a mangpa a hangpa hing khaapahmuo a thlahne li pata a tue ang, hmungdawlutuv tie hing a ngaapa ta a tue yi ang; a singpa tie kha a pali a pahnaa ta tue yi angte, ama thesingna kha a pangaa sa ang.

Kama ca a changtaapa tie bie kha a pacu sapa, a biephyatuv tie riluna kha a patling sapa; Jerusalem kha, “Na chunglie khy ama sa pakhaa aa,” a tapa, Judah khypuv tie kha, “Sa pakhaapa tana nama cuo aa, kama na a rapa kha a pare'a ang,” a tapa,
Riyliy kha, “Ky tie, na cavaa zaw hingna i paky diy aa,” a tapa,

Sairas kha, “Ama ca i tuvkhietuv tana a cuo, i tingpa bangkhuo kha ama na a hrie diy aa,” a tapa; Jerusalem kyihuo khata, “Sa pakhaapa tana a cuo aa,” a tapa hne, biena-ing kha, “Na hruopatu ca bangpa tana a cuo aa,” a tapa tana i cuo.

Abyipata sathu a pathuvpa hne, a cacuoluo kuv ta a patuvpa Sairas kyihuo khata, a hmiekunglie mingphang tie te riypata, siepahruo tie ama siepahruo cawsie kha thliepa riypata, a hmiekunglie ingchiypakaa pahaw riypata Thlake kha khaa li tli riypata:
Kama kha na hmiekunglie ta si'a angte, tluo zaw kha i pame diy aa, daa ingchiypakaa zaw kha i thlibaruv diy aa, thaa tingkhuo zaw kha i thli pachung diy aa,
Kama ta zingna suethiy zaw kha ca pi'a angte, aa nuna hmang lie hnyirungna zaw kha ica pi aa, Cahaacata kama ca AbyipaIsrael Khazing, na ming ta caa kupa i cuopa kha ina pachang'a ciy.
I changtaapa Jakob cuota hne, i tlawpa Israel cuota, kama ta nama kha na ming ta ica ku, ina pachang li raalaa pa cata cahaacata ica tue.
Kama ca Abyipata cuo angte, khazing hrangpa aw vyi; kama ta li pata khazing hrangpa aw vyi. Ina pachang li raalaa pa cata cehre kha ica pahrie aa.
Caacuonakawta ningchiy taata ningtla te ta, kama ta li pata a hrangpa khazing aw vyi tapa kha ama pachang aa; kama ca Abyipata cuo angte, a hrangpa khazing aw vyi.
Kama ta khena kha tue angte zingna zaw i sa, kama ta hnyirungna kha tue angte, bawchiena zaw kha i tue; kama Abyipana hingpa zaw bangkhuo hing a tue ang.

Vya avuo zaw, a cung taata za zuv tie ung, avuo taata adangna kha za saa se; alyi kha a pahaw sala, khuona kha pathyi se, capa ca ta adangna zaw kha pathyi sa ra se; Abyipakama na hingpa hing a tue ang.
Nama caa satuv kha a dupa ca bawchie ciemuopa ta cuo mang sue, alyi bi ta bivytuv kha aa du the'a ma? Acyi ta bivytuv kha, “Khaapama na tue? acuolikie, “Na vy the vaciy,” a ta the'a ma?
A paa kha, “Tuokhaatama ina pacuo sa ciy?” a tapa hne, a nung kha, “tuokhaatama ina sa ciy?” a tapa ca bawchie ciemuopa tana ama cuo.
Abyipa, Israel Khazing Pathe, hne ama a satuv na hing haa hingta a ri: I saata zaw kaw kha ina hiehriy'a ca ma? I kuv ta i tuepa kawlie hingta naw ina pi'a ca ma?
Kama na alyi hing a sa ang, a cunglieta cawsaa zaw hing i sa yi; avuo a pakhuvpa zaw hing kama kuv tana a cuo, a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo hing kama na naw a pi yi ang.

Kama ta Sairas hing adangna chunglie i padaa, kama ta a luopuv bangkhuo kha i padang aa; i khypuv kha sa'a te, sii ta a dapa i cawsaa tie kha hyazangna a pi'a yi, capa ca a themuo hmung repata cuo li pata lawmuo hmung repata zaw cuo vyi, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.

Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Izipt hnyirungna hne Ethiopia hne, a dang syipa Seba ming sungpalinapa suethiy ca nama'a luo vya chiy'a te nama huopa ta a cuo aa; iema ca nama kha aca paziy'a yi, thaabuoliriy ta pa-uo pata nama'a luo a vaw'a yi te, na hmiekunglie kha amaa vya bung aa. Nama kha paa cakie'a yi te, “Khazing ca nama hne dyi ta aw te, a hrangpa khazing aw vyi; ama ta li pata khazing hrangpa aw vyi,” aca ta'a yi.
Vya Israel Khazing, Khuotuv Byi, hmisi ta ripa kieca, nama ca namata tah aa nupa Khazing tana na cuo.
Iema bangkhuo ca nangzaa pata aw yi te amaa kalaa diy, kuvtuezuv a tuetuv tie ca amaa kalaa pakhaw diy tli.
Cuorasala Abyipata Israel kha chuozaa huota a khuo, nama ca chuozaa ta na nang zaa li'a pata a kalaa'a vaciy.

Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri, avuo zaw a sapa ca (Khazing tana a cuo!) alyi kha vy te a sa, (ama ta a pacu sa; capa ca athiykhy riypata a sapa cuo vyi, cawsaa zaw khysana riypa tana a sa!): Kama ca Khazing ta cuo angte, khazing hrangpa aw vyi.

Kama ca a paruvta tah bie ri va ang, zingna ruo chunglieta bie ri va ang; Jakob samingsahlaa zaw kyihuo khata, “Athiykhy chunglie kha na huv ung,” ta va ang. Kama, Abyipaca biehmisipa kha ri angte, aa hmuopa khana i phu.

A pahmya ung la a vaw pakhaw tie ung, mingphang zaw chungtaata a hring kaliepa tie, naa vya ngie tie ung! Thing ta ama tuepa kuvtuezuv kha a pawlepa tie, a khuo khu lipa yi khazing'a luo thlaa a chuopa tie ca thesingna a hnyi lipa tana ama cuo.

Nama bie kha vya chiykhyi tie ung; a rue pakhaw naase yi! Ahungma hingpa hing hluo ning taata zaa ri? Ahungma hingpa hing hluo ning taata zaa pathyi sa? Abyipa, kama ta cuo va ang ma? Kama ta li pata khazing hrangpa aw vyi, aa dangpa Khazing hne Khuotuv; kama ta li pata khazing hrangpa aw vyi.
Alyi dena te lie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo, kama'a luo a vya pali ung la khuona kha hmung tie ung! Tahematapakieca Kama ca Khazing tana i cuo, kama ta li pata khazing hrangpa aw vyi.
Kama hne kama tana chie i sa, i pakaa tana a vya kaa li tli riypa bie kha adangna chunglie i ri: “Kama'a luo kha pakhuv bangkhuo ta vya pane'a te, palyi bangkhuo ta chie aa vya sa aa,” i ta.
Kama kaw kha ri'a yi te, Abyipachunglie dyina, adangna hne cahrana a aw; ama kha khuosa ta a hi a pahaapa mekaa ca, ama'a luo kha a vaw'a yi te nangzaana ama ang aa.
Israel samingsahlaa bangkhuo ca Abyipachunglie kha, tena hne rungnaana ama hmung aa.
Bel ca aa khuv pathla tli, Nebo ca aa nyi bung tli, ama kuvtuezuv ca saahruo hne sahring cunglie khata ama khang; hingpa hmangriy tie hing, a nang a buopa saruopa tie cunglieta hmangriy tana ama cuo.
Iema ca a nyi bung pakhaw yi te, amaa khuv pathla pakhaw; ama phyapa hmangriy kha khuo khu va yi, iema hrahring zaw kha sii ta amaa li.
Vya Jakob ingchungkhue, kama kha na naathlie tie ung, Israel ingchungkhue aa ngaapa bangkhuo, nama za puv hluo baataata caa paw yi angte, nama za puv baataata ica mangchiy yi;
nama nungpuv macuona te ta cahaa ngiethie tana i cuo, nama suo a paana te ta icaa paw ngiethie'a yi. Kama ta i tue, kama ta i ang aa; caa paw'a yi angte ica khuo'a yi.
Ahung kha na palu sa'a cate ma ahung hneta ina pakhingpuo'a ciy? Aa lupa haa khata ma ina pakhingpuo'a ciy?
Ama tuokaa baw taata siy kha ama khing zaa ta papya yi te, ngu kha cyi pathliena lie ama pathlie, siy patletuv kha a hluo yi te siy ca khazing ta a sa; cakhutaata iema ta a bu yi te amaa bie!

Ama letung luo kha khang yi te, ama phyale, a hmang lie kha patu yi te capa lie ca aa tu; a hmang taa khata a hnyi the vyi. Pakhakha ta a khisue kiema palie the vyi, ahung kha hmuo ruvnaana taata khuo the va yi.
Hingpa hing a thyi ung la rue syalya tie ung, nama palung lie kha chi pakhaa tie ung, a suepa tie zaw,
hluo ning hmang tie kha a thyi tie ung; tahematapakieca Kama ca Khazing tana i cuo, kama li pata khazing hrangpa aw vyi, kama ca Khazing tana i cuo, kama haapa ahunghmuo aw va yi.
Hmang zaw sapa a cuo hluo a hluo ning taata cuose, a hruothu taata a chuona te kha, “I tingnapa ca aa hmang aa, tue i tingpa ca i patling sa aa,” ta pata i phu tli.
Pavaa saahruo kha ningchiyluo taata ku angte, i tingna a patling sa riypa cawsaa kha luohlaapuv taata i ku. Kama ta za ri tli angte, i patlung sa aa; i za ting tlipa haata, capa ca i tue aa.
Niema, a palung pangpa tie, na naathlie tie ung, niema, a thlana taata aa hlasapa tie:
Kama huopa, athlana khana aa ngieta luo i vya tlungkhyi, a hlasa vyi, cakhutaata i khuona ca haa'a vyi; Zion lieta khuona kha i chi aa, Israel kha i rungnaana i pi aa.

Lesaa pathenung Babilon, za cung la buvcing lie kha a tu tie! Byithude li pata alyi lie kha a tu tie, Khaldi sacanung! Tahematapakieca nama ca a nesiyliypa hne khing aa chiysapa ta pata kupa cuo'a va tli ciy.
Sarienapa kha la lah sa kha rie tie, na hmiepakhuv kha hle tie, na buohryi pasiypa kha thlie la, naa hning kha a pachang la, cavaa kha va te tie.
Na thliehripa ta aw'a cate, nang pazaa pata na cuo aa. Kama ta phuv la'a angte, pakha hmuo pangaa va ang.
Kiema Khuotuv a ming ca Cungnungce Abyipatana a cuo, Israel Khazing Pathe tana a cuo.
A dieta tah a tu la zingna chung luo kha cakuo tie, sacanung Khaldi! Tahematapakieca nama ca pena tie zaw siepahruonung ta pata kupa cuo'a va tli ciy.

Kama ca i cawsaa zaw cunglie kha i hi za haa te, i ru kha i za papyapalyi tli; iema kha na kuv chung luo ca pi angte, ama cunglie kawpacuona hnyi vaciy; kung macuo tie cunglie kha aa riy hringhruopa hmang na khang.
Nama ta, “Kama ca siepahruonung ta i cuo pari aa,” na ta, caacuonakawta hingpa hmang zaw hing na palung lieta za chi vaciy, ama chuona riypa zaw rue the vaciy.

Caacuonakawta anuona dyi a khingpa, na naathlie tie, aa bangta tah a tu cate, na palung chunglieta, “Kama, kama lipa hingta ahunghmuo aw va yi; kama ca nunghlyi ta cuo buo'a va ang, i saata zaw ama thiy nakawta i cuo pasa buo'a vyi,” na ta.

Sungkhabala ta, ning kha chunglie, hingpa suohning hing na cunglieta a tlung aa: Ca-ie a thepa a hluvsa hne, na ca-iena kha kha tluv ta a cahra zawta, saata zaw thiyna hne nunghlyi cuona kha na cunglieta aca tlungsue aa.

Na pha lina chunglie kha i bang thluo ta pata naa rue; “Ahungtahmuo na hmung va yi,” na ta. Na singna hne na thesingna ta luo aca papie sa, cakhutaata na palung chunglie kha, “Kama, kama li pata a hrangpa pakha hmuo aw va yi,” na ta.

Cuorasala pacuo pata na phe khu lipa, pha lina ta na cunglie aca tlung aa; nama ta na khuo khu lipa, ruvnaana na na cunglieta a tlung aa; nama ta khaapahmuo na pachang lipa, rana na na cunglie sungkhabala ta a tlung aa.
Na panuta ning taata na za hmuopa, ca-ie a thepa a hluvsa hne na ca-iena lie kha a pacu la a daa tie; tena kha a hmung te na hmung the aa, ciy aa chiysapa zaw kha na papuv the ri aa.

Nama ca bie patlapakhawna a hluvsa lie kha na nang a buosa mangtli; avuo kaw a cuvpa tie, aasiy kaw a cuvpa tie hne, na cunglie a tlung riypata thlaapa awtuvzya mang pata, a ri thepa tie khata, a daa yi sala ca khuo yi se.

Mang tie, iema ca sacuo kung pachungpasaapa haata cuo yi te, myi na a kuo diy'a yi; myihlaa cahrana chungtaata, iema hne iema kha a khuo khu'a va yi. Cawsaa a palung riypa myihyi suokha hmuo aw'a vyi, aa thaalie a tu pata aa e riypa myi zaw aw'a vyi!

Iema hneta hmang na za tuehnepa tie, na panuta ning taata sung na za palihnepa tie ta, nama'a lie ama tue khupa ca, ama luopuv cyicuo khata a ruo patlaa diy'a yi te, nama caa khuo riypa pakha hmuo aw'a va yi.

Vya Jakob ingchungkhue, Israel ming ta kupa tie, Judah chungtaata a puvpa tie, Abyipaming ta chie a sapa tie, Israel Khazing kha paa a kiepa tie, cuorasala biehmisipa hne aa hmuopa lieta a hring lipa tie, hingpa hing naathlie tie ung.
Cuorasala iema hne iema kha khypuv pathepa ming ta a ku yi te, Israel Khazing, Cungnungce Abyipakha zang pata a ringchuopa tana ma cuo amaa ta.
Hluo ning taa khata hluo ning hmang kaw kha i za phu mangtli, i pakaa taata pya yi te, i pachang sa tli yi; sungkhabala ta tue yi angte, ama vya aw tli.
Tahematapakieca niema ca a palung lepa, a rue kacupa hne, a hmiesupa tana nama cuo.

Hingpa hing hluo ning taata niema'a lie za phu angte, ama vya aw hluota niema'a lie kha ica pathyi sa tli yi, caacuonakawta niema ta, “I kuvtuezuv na khapa tie kha a tue yi, nama khepa kuvtuezuv hne nama patlepa kuvtuezuv tie na naw a pi yi,” nama ta khu li riypa tana a cuo.
Nama za thyi tli; ata hing nama hmung diy tli; caacuokieca capa ca phu'a va ung ca ma? Ata taata hmieluo ca hmang thaapa, nama pachang li liepa, aa nupa hmang kaw na ica pathyi sa'a yi.
Iema ca hluo ning taata cuo li pata, ata hingna sa pata ama cuo; ataning hluo hingta ca thyi buo va ung ciy, caacuonakawta niema ta, “I za pachang pacie tli,” ta khu'a va ung ciy.

Za thyi buo vaciy, za pachang buo vaciy, hluo ning taata na naa kha zaa pahaw vyi. A ringchuo tluo aa tla pata aw'a vaciy tapa kha ica pachang, tahematapakieca na za puv baataata dutuv ta pata kupa tana na cuo.
Nama kha ica thaw li riypata, i ming kawlieta i hihaana kha a ang law angte, i ming pathuosa a cuo riypata i hihaana ca nama cuota i cahna law.
Mang tie, nama kha ica pathe sa, cuorasala ngu haata cuo vyi, ciy aa chiypa riethyivuosuona sumyi liena ica dyapasya.
Kama cuo tana, kama cuo tana hingpa hing i tue, khaapanakawma i ming ca mangbung pata a cuo aa? I rungnaana ca a hrangpa kha pi khu'a va yi ang.
Vya Jakob, hne Israel, i kupa zaw, naathlie tie ung; kama ca Khazing tana i cuo; a hmietaa ce hne a hnangcaw ce tana i cuo.
I kuv ta alyi hruopatu kha bang te, i cacuoluo kuv ta avuo kha a pake, i ku tiy yi ta, a daa yi te ama naathlie.

Nama bangkhuo ta a hmya ung la, naathlie tie ung! Niema hrawlie ahungma hingpa hmang hing a pathyisa'a ung ciy? Abyipana ama ca a due; a tingna kha Babilon lieta a patling sa aa, a kuvbuo tana Khaldi ming kha aa du'a yi.
Kama, Kama ta hmuo ama kha ku angte i ri, kama ta vya tlungkhyi angte, a luopuv lieta hluetlingna a hmung aa.
Naa vya ngie la, hingpa hing naathlie tie! Hluo ning taa khata a paruv ta za ri va ang, A hruothu baataata i za aw tli. Ata hing ca AbyipaKhazing hne a thlaapa ta kama kha ina pathlie yi.
Abyipa, caa Khuotuv, Israel Khazing Pathe na hing haa hingta a ri: Kama ca Abyipana Khazing tana i cuo, na phana riypata caa pacuvpa, na ziy riypa luo lie caa chiylepa tana i cuo.
I nawbie kha naathlie la tapa na i khing hringhruo! Na thluechiy ca cavaa tiy haata lang'a te, na tena ca riyliy tiylaw haa tana a cuo aa.
Na samingsahlaa ca riyliy kielie viehnang haata hne na ciypathla ca riyliy lungcapang haata cuo'a yi te, ama ming ca kha tiyta hmuo kama hmiekung taata, thawpa hne para pata cuo'a vyi.
Babilon taa khata pya tie, Khaldi taa khata a ruo tie, palungtluo khina ueryi hneta phu tie, “Abyipana a changtaapa Jakob kha a khuo tli!” ta pata, alyi dena te khata pathyisa tie.
Ama ta ruocaapa chunglie luo a chiy ning yi kha ama tiy hrie vyi; iema cuota alungpuv chungtaata tiy a pya riypata a tue; ama ta alungpuv kha khechi te a chungtaata tiy a pya.
Abyipana, “Cawsaa pha lipa tie cuota ca diena aw vyi,” a ta.
Vya riyliy kie ruo zaw, na naathlie tie ung, ruo luohlaa luo a awpa zaw, naathlie tie ung! Abyipata i za puv hluota na ku tli te, i nung riy chunglie i aw kalie ningta ming ina sa tli.
I pakaa hing a cahrepa zueziy haata tue te, a kuv ningdiy rawlieta ina nu; cuoti haata na tue te, a lavaabya lie ina pasuo.
Cakhutaata kama kyihuo khata, “Israel, nama ca i changtaapa tana na cuo, nama thue hing tana i rungnaana aa luo aa,” ina ta.

Cuorasala kama ta, “A thlahnena a aw lipa na i hrie, khaapahmuo a cuo lipa lie hne a laliy lipa liena i thaazuo i hmuo; cuorasala kama hneta aa tlapa hmang ca Abyipakuv liena a aw, i lawmuo ca Khazing'a liena a aw,” i ta.

Jakob kha ama'a luo tlungkhyi pakhaa riypa hne, Israel ming kha ama'a lie amaa hmya riypata cuose, Abyipahmiekunglieta pa-uvsathyipa i cuo riypa hne, i Khazing kha kama thaazuo ta a cuo riypata, i nung riy chungtaata changtaapa ta na tuepa Abyipata a ripa ca,

“I changtaapa cuo pata, Jakob phang kha pa daa riypa hne, aa ngaapa Israel ming padaa pakhaa riypa ca, aa hy tuvpa hmang tana a cuo; nama ca mingphang zaw cuota khena ta ca tue'a angte, i khuona ca alyi dena te ta a pha aa,” a ta.

Abyipa, Israel ming khuotuv hne Khazing Pathe, mingphang zaw ta khuosa ta duvpa, uvtuv tie sii ta hing haa hingta a ri, “Siepahruo tie ta ca hmung'a yi te amaa daa aa, byi tie zaw ta pa-uvsathyina ta na hmiekunglie amaa bu aa, tahematapakieca zang tluo aa tlapa Abyipa, Israel Khazing Pathe ta acaa tlaw nakaw tana a cuo,” a ta.

Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Tlechuo aa chiypa cuo lie hing ica palie, khuona ning cuo lie hingta icaa bya; nama kha ca mangchiy angte, ruo kha pacu riypa hne, cawsaa aw linapa ruo kha ru ta re riypata, mingphang zaw'a luo kha biekuona ta ica pi aa.
Thaw a tlapa tie hne zingna chunglie a awpa tie kha, “Kya pya ung la, niemata tah a kya pahmung sa ung,” na ta'a yi. Luopuv lie kha ningle'a yi te, aa suonapa utlaw ca ama tlena ta a cuo aa.
Iema ca ama nang diy li'a pata ama tiy zaw hrie'a vyi, thliy ta hmung'a va yi, ning ta e'a va yi, iema kha ngie a chipa ta luochiy'a yi te, tiyhnaa athaa luo kha aa chiy'a yi.
I tluo bangkhuo kha luopuv ta pali'a angte, i luopuv lepa kha sa pata a cuo aa.
Mang tie, capa zaw ca luohlaapuv taa khata a vaw'a te, chaluo taata hne ningtlaluo taata aa vaw aa, cakhutaata Sinim taa zaw khata amaa vaw aa.

Vya avuo, palungtluona hlaa kha sa tie; Vya alyi, palungtluona hneta khi tie, Vya tluo zaw, hlaa kha khuopuv ta sa tie ung! Tahematapakieca Abyipana a cawsaa zaw kha ama hnaa a panguo yi, a cawsaa ruvnaana a angpa tie'a lie kha kawpacuona a hnyi yi.
Cuorasala Zion ta, “Abyipa na naa thaw tli, kama Abyipana naa maw tli,” a ta.
Canung ta a hnung a pazaw sa kaliepa a saata kha a maw khu'a ma? A sapa a saata kha kawpacuo li pata a aw khu'a ma? A maw zaw a maw khu the aa, cuorasala kama ta ca ca maw'a va yi ang.
Mang tie, i kuv pazaa chungliena na ming ica cape tli; na khy dungkhuo ca i hmiekunglieta a aw pari.
Na sacapaa zaw na a catlisa pata a vya kaa yi, nama caa parapa tie ca nama'a taata ama pya aa.

Na cahriy bangkhuo kha mang la hmung tie, ama bangkhuo ta a pahmya yi te, nama'a luo amaa vaw. Abyipata, kama i hringpa haata, iema bangkhuo hing a panginapa cawsie haata naa hryi'a yi, vaahnyituv lesaa aa pangipa haa tana naa pangi na'a yi.
A rapa na ruo hne cawsaa aw linapa hmang tie, hne para karuepa na ruo ca, khy a sapa cawsaa ta nama bi aa, niema caa paluopa tie ca aa hlasana luo na ama aw aa.
Na ngie a za chisa ningta na sapa na saata tie ta, na thyina lie kha: “Hingpa hmang hing i cuota aa cadi tuv; awna riypa hmang na pi tie,” aca ta'a yi.

Cakhutaata nama ta na pathiypalung chunglie kha, “Hingpa zaw hing i cuota ahungma a sa yi? Kama ca a saata zaw a thiy diy tlipa, a hri pata a awpa tana i cuo, sii ta a da pata luohlaa luo a awpa tana i cuo, caacuonakawta hingpa zaw hing ahungma zaa mangsang yi? Kama dyi pangaapa tana i cuo, hingpa zaw hing khaapa taata ma amaa vaw?” na ta aa.

Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Kama ta mingphang tie'a luo kha i kuv caba'a angte, cawsaa tie'a luo kha i pangzu i calang aa, cakhutaata iema ta na sacapaa zaw kha ama buo lie vya khangle'a yi te, na sacanung zaw kha ama letung lie ama vya khangle aa.

Siepahruo zaw ca nama paa haata cuo'a yi te, siepahruonung zaw ca niema caa mangchiypa nung haata ama cuo aa. Nama hmiekunglie kha alyi luo a bung'a yi te, na phyipazaa lie buvcing kha ama pali aa. Cakhutaata kama ca Abyipai cuopa hne, kama naa huopa tie ca nangzaa pata ama cuo li'apa kha na pachang aa.
Hruosue ca a thaaruvpa kuv taata la khu a aw'a ma? Sii ta a dapa tie kha siepahruo chiepa kuv taata la khu ama aw'a ma?

Cuorasala Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: a thaaruvpa kuv taata sii ta a dapa tie kha hmuo la pata ama cuo aa, siepahruo chiepa'a taata hruosue zaw kha la pata a cuo aa; tahematapakieca nama caa zuepa tie kha kama ta i zue'a yi, na saata zaw kha kama ta i khuo'a yi.

Nama caa tuechiepa tie kha iema saa mamaapa kha pace sa'a yi angte, iema thiy mamaapa kha mingsuvtiy haata ama dang aa. Cakhutaata cawsaa bangkhuo ta kama ca Abyipacaa Khuotuv i cuopa hne, caa Thlatuv, a Thaaruvpa Jakob Khazing i cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi.

Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Khaapaliema na nung luohlaa luo i thawnapa manapa caa ca a aw? Ahung kha lyibuo i pi riypa aw te ma, ama'a luo kha ica zaa yi? Cuo vyi, nama suena kawlie tana zaa pata nama cuo, nama tuesuena kawlie tana na nung kha luohlaa luo thaw pata a cuo.

Khaapanakawma i vaw ning kha pakha hmuo ama aw va? Khaapanakawma i khi ning kha ahungtahmuo ina palie va yi? Khuo riypa hingta i kuv a pachang tuv ma? A thla riypata cahrana hnyi va ang ma? Chuo angte riyliy kha ama ky, cavaa zaw kha viehnangruo ta i tue yi; tiy a aw li nakawta ngaa ca thiy yi te ama thuv.
Avuo kha a vawkaruvpa pahryi angte, buri ta i buvkhung yi.
Abyipa Khazingna a nangbuopa tie kha bie ta a bya the riypata, kama kha pacuvtuv palyi naa pi. Maw kha hnang maw kha ta ina pathu, pacuvpa tie haa khata naathlie riypata, inaa kha a pathu.
Abyipa Khazingta i naa kha pavuo sa te, dutuv ta cuo va ang, hnangluo kha kaa va ang.
Naa tuvpa tie kha i ke chawpa yi angte, i hmyahming ta naa siypa tie kha i be i chaw yi; naa ripachiepa tie hne a paciy ta naa pachapa tie'a taa khata, i hmie kha nu va ang.
Abyipa Khazingta inaa bya, caacuonakawta nangzaa ang va ang; caacuonakawta i hmie kha a cuosa pata chi angte, nangzaana ang'a va ang tapa kha i pachang;
i sue lina a paluosatuv ca aa ngieta liena a aw. Ahungma naa zue aa? A daahne pachiy'a ung puv. Ahungma i carie ta a cuo? Naa du pachiy yi se.
Kama naa byatuv ca Abyipa Khazingtana a cuo; ahungma a sue, naa ta aa? Iema bangkhuo ca pang haa tana ama caw aa; alungpa na a ryile diy'a yi.

Niema hrawlie hing ahungma Abyipakha ciy te, a changtaapa ueryi kha a ziy? Ahungma zingna chunglie cakuo te, khena hnyi li pata a aw? Ahungma Abyipaming kha a ringchuo te, a Khazing cunglie kha zangna a hnyi?

Cuorasala niema bangkhuo ca myi a patiypa hne, myisaa a vuopa tana nama cuo. Nama myihlaa chunglie kha cakuo tie ung, nama vuopa myisaa hrawlie kha cakuo tie ung! I kuv taata nama hmung riypa ca capa ca tana a cuo aa: niema ca a ruvsapa tuechiena chunglie khana nama laa aa.
Niema, adangna a huvpa tie hne Abyipaa huvpa tie zaw, na naathlie tie ung, niema aca syi pathlanapa alungpuv hne, niema aca cunapa yi alung khue kha mang tie ung.
Nama paa Abraham hne caa sapa yi Sarah kha mang tie ung; ama i ku ningta ca pakha dyi ta a cuo, cuorasala kama ta thluechiy pi angte a hluvsa ta i tue yi.

Tahematapakieca Abyipata Zion kha hnaa panguo'a te, ama ta a rapa hmang tie kha hnaa a panguo'a yi; a ruocaapa kha Eden haata tue'a te, a ruocaapa kha Abyipadiedung haata a tue aa; palungtluona hne alawna kha a chunglie hmung pata cuo'a te, pathuosana hlaa ueryi kha thyi pata a cuo aa.
I cawsaa zaw, na naathlie ung la, i mingphang ta kama kha na naathlie tie ung; i pacuvna ca kama'a taa hingta pya'a te, biedangpa lie i daana ca cawsaa zaw cuota khena a cuo aa.
I thlana kha a catlisa pata aa ngieta luo vya tlungkhyi'a angte, i khuona ca pya'a te, i kuvbuo ta cawsaa kha a uv'a yi; riyliy kie ruo tie ta kama kha ina huo yi, a cahrapa i kuv kha amaa nguopuo.

Avuo luo khiy nama ming padyi ung la, a raw luo alyi zaw khuv mang tie ung; avuo ca myikhuv haata vie'a te, alyi ca pang haata a caw aa, a cunglie a awpa zaw kha macing haata thiy'a yi te, cuorasala i khuona ca chuozaa ta aa hmang aa, i thlana zaw chuo buo'a vyi.

Adangna kha a pachangpa zaw, na naathlie tie ung, i pacuvna kha a palung lie a chipa tie zaw na naathlie tie ung; malie ta sue aca phaw riypa yi kha ciy khah ung, malie ta aca caw-yi riypa yi kha ciysa khah ung.
Tahematapakieca iema ca a pang haata hne, tuvhming haa tana alungpa ta a ce'a yi; cuorasala kama athlana ca chuozaa cuota cuo'a te, i khuona ca chuo bangkhuo cuota a cuo aa.

Vya Abyipacahrana, a cha tie, a cha la thaa pahrang tie! Hluo ning cuo lie haa khata, a cha tie, hluo ning chuo tie lie haa khata a cha tie! Rahab kha a diykariyna te ta a cepachung diypa hne riyhre a daw pahawpa kha nama cuo va ca ma?
Aa thuvsapa riyliy tiy a paky diypa kha nama cuo va ca ma? A thlapa tie ta ama va te the riypata, riyliy chunglie luopuv a sapa kha nama cuo va ca ma?

Caacuonakawta Abyipata aa thlapa tie ca vya kaa'a yi te, Zion luo kha hlaasana cangta amaa vaw aa; chuozaa palungtluona kha ama luv cunglie a aw aa; iema ca palungtluona hne alawna kha hnyi'a yi te, ngiechina hne palungriethyina ta aa ruose'a yi.
Kama, kama hingna na hnaa caa panguotuv ta a cuo ang; khaapanakawma a thiy thepa cawsaa, paapaapa haata a lang thepa ca na ciy aa?

Abyipanama caa Satuv kha maw cate, avuo a pakepa hne, alyi hruopatu a bangpa kha na maw. Hluo ning taata aa pazue pata, para a khingpa caa tuechietuv hihaana kha na za ciy. Cuorasala hrisaatuv hihaana ca khaapaliema a aw?
Tuechiepa tie ca a catlisa pata pathlie pata ama cuo aa; iema ca thiy'a va yi, khue chung luo kha tla'a va yi, ning riypa ci li ta ama hnyi aa.
Tahematapakieca kama ca Abyipanama Khazing tana i cuo, riyliy kha pasu te tiylaw a pachi sapa, a ming ca Cungnungce Abyipatapa tana i cuo.
Na pakaa lie kha i bie chi'a angte, i kuv ningdiy rawlie kha ica nu aa, avuo kha i pake, alyi hruopatu kha bang angte, Zion kyihuo khata, “Nama ca i cawsaa tana na cuo,” i ta.
Abyipakuv lie a hihaana kha a dangpa, a hihaana panuo lieta a haa te a dangpuopa, thu tie, thu tie! Vya Jerusalem, a daa tie!
A sapa a saata zaw bangkhuo hrawlieta, ama kha luo a chiy riypa pakha hmuo aw va yi; a mangsangpa a saata zaw bangkhuo chungtaata, a kuv ta a ca-ya riypa pakha hmuo aw va yi.
Hingpa hmang suohning hingta ca tlungsue tli te, ahungma a ngie caa chikhyi aa? Zueziy ta parana hne cakuotlungna ta nama kha ca tlungsue te, ahungma hnaa caa panguo aa?
Na saata zaw ca thaazuo hnyi va tli yi, sariy ta a pa-uopa atuv sakhiy haata luo a tawnapa mekaa lie kha ama laale; Abyipahihaana hne chuona khana, khuosa ta ama ang hmisi.
Caacuonakawta hmaa a phyapa, mingsuvtiy dang li pata a pariypa, naathlie tie:
Nama LesyiceAbyipa, na Khazing, a cawsaa zaw kaw a daakhyituv na hing haa hingta a ri: Mang tie, kama ta pariynapa panuo taata na kuv kha la angte, i hihaana kuotung taa khata dang'a va tli ciy.

“Na cunglie luo ma cakuo the riypata a bung tie,” ca ta te, nama ta iema ama cakuo the riypata, na ke kha alyi haata hne luopuv haata tue cate, nama caa tuechietuv tie kuv chung luo khana capa ca i pi aa.

A hra tie, a hra tie, Vya Zion, na thaa pahrang tie! A puvthepa na caw kha a tue tie, Vya Jerusalem, khypuv pathepa; tahematapakieca vangdaw te lipa hne a pathe lipa ca na chung luo kha a ngie'a va tli yi.
Na cunglie buvcing kha thy la, thu tie, Vya sii ta a dapa Jerusalem; na rue lieta aca ciynapa yi kha pathluo tie, Vya sii ta a dapa sacanung Zion!
Tahematapakieca Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: A muo li pata zaapa tana nama cuo, caacuonakawta niema ca tuokaa lipa tana a thlapa nama cuo aa.
Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Hluo ningta, i cawsaa zaw ca Izipt luo kha ruohrang ming cuo riypata ama sibung; Assiria ming zaw ta hruohra li pata ama hrisaa.

Abyipana, i cawsaa zaw ca hruohra li pata sikhyipa ama cuopa kha i hmung thluo nakawta, khaapama i tue aa? a ta. Abyipana, ama uvtuv tie ca kama esena cangta na ning-aw ta aa pazue pata ama ming amaa chaa, a ta.
Caacuonakawta i cawsaa tie ta i ming kha ama pachang aa; hingpa lie hingna i aw, ta pata a ripa ca kama ta i cuopa kha capa ning thue ca ama pachang aa.
Thlaalungna ukhyi te, thuophaa a vya phyapa, Zion kyihuo ta, “Na Khazing ca siepahruo tana a cuo,” a tapa tluo cunglieta biephyatuv phyi ca kha tluv tama a puvthe.
Naathlie tie, khypuv a huopa tie ta khuopuv ta palungtluona hlaa ama sa pakhaw. Tahematapakieca AbyipaZion luo a vya kaapa khana a siesa pata ama hmung.
Jerusalem khypuv lieta a rapa hmang zaw, hlaa kha khuopuv ta sa pakhaw tie ung. Tahematapakieca Abyipata a cawsaa zaw kha hnaa panguo yi te, Jerusalem kha aa thla tli.
Abyipaca mingphang bangkhuo hmungna lie kha a kuv pathepa pazu te, alyi kiy ting lie a awpa tie ta Khazing khuona kha ama hmung aa.
Pya tie ung, pya tie ung, hingpa taa hingta pya tie ung! a pathe lipa kha taw khah ung; Abyipabi zaw a cabalepa tie, hingpa chung taa hingta pya tie ung.
A pahraasa pata nama pya a hu'a vyi, namaa ruo pahraa a hu'a vyi; tahematapakieca Abyipakha nama hmieluo ta sile'a te, Israel Khazing ta nama hnang taata aca kingle'a yi.
I changtaapa ca a re lie kha tena a hmung aa; ama ca cyicalang pata aa suona lie chi pata a cuo aa, aa suo hringhruo aa.
Cawsaa hluvpuv ta ama kha ama hmung pahne ta ama nang a uo, a hminghmie ca cawsaa hminghmie hmuo lu li pata, a pangpa zaw cawsaa pangpa lu vyi.

Caacuonakawta ama ta mingphang hluvpuv kha pahlu sa'a yi te, ama kawlieta siepahruo tie kha ama pakaa amaa paping aa; tahematapakieca iema ama za chang lipa kha hmung'a yi te, iema ta ama za thyi lipa kha ama pachang aa.
Ata ima thyipa hing ahungma a zang aa? Abyipakuv hing ahung'a luo ma a zaa luo?
Tahematapakieca alyi caapa lie a thariy a thlapa thingkung panuta haata a hmiekunglie kha a lethaw. Mang khing riypata puvthena hne linghlaa hnyi vyi, a hminghmie lieta tlechuo riypa aw vyi.
Ama ca a hrangpa tie ta duv yi te ama thaw; te-angna hne cuopasana a angpa tana a cuo; malie ta ama hmie ama nusepa pakha haata a cuo, duvsa pata cuo te, siysaa ri vapuv.
Hmisi ta ca ama ta kiema ma tluo lina hne, ma pasana kha malie a phyapa; kiema ta ama kha pasana a angpa, Khazing ta a tuvpa, riethyivuosuona a angpa ta ma ri.

Cuorasala hmaa a phyapa ca kiema ma suena kawlie tana a cuo, chaapuopa a cuopa ca kiema pha lina kawlie tana a cuo; kiema kha thlaalungna luo malie a tlungkhyipa duotena ca ama cunglie khang te, a phyapa hmaa thueta patluo sa pata ma cuo.
Ma bangkhuo hingta luo a piepa tuv haa tana ma cuo; ma bangkhuo ta ma pienapa luopuv cyicuo kha ma ziy, kiema bangkhuo pha lina kha Abyipata a cunglie khang te a phya.

Ama ca tuechie yi te, riethyivuosuona a ang, cuorasala a pakaa hehmuo uo vyi; thie riypata amaa chiylepa tuvtaata hne, a hming a ngutuv hmiekunglie a dieta tah a awpa tuv haa khata, a pakaa uo li pata a aw.

Biedangpa kha a pali a pahnaa ta tue yi te, ama sikhyi. Hmieluo a chiycuona riypa kha ahungma a ri khu aa? Tahematapakieca ama ca a hringpa tie ruo taa khata thaw pata cuo tli te, i cawsaa zaw tuesuena cuo khata pasana a ang.
Pha lina khaapahmuo tue buo li pata, a pakaa lie hangna a aw li raalaa pata, a pha lipa tie hneta paby pakhaw yi te, a hnyirungpa tie'a lie kha ama paby.

Pasana ang riypa hne chaapuopa cuo riypa kha Abyipakhingna ta a cuo. A hringna kha suena cuota na pihluo tiyta, ama ta a samingsahlaa zaw kha hmung'a yi te, a chuo a pasiy aa; ama thueta Abyipa khingna ca a tling aa.
A angpa pasana chung taa khata khena a hmung aa; a thesingna taa khata palungtlingna a hmung aa. Aa dangpa, i changtaapa ta, adangna a hluvsa tue'a te, iema suena kha a phya aa.

Caacuonakawta cuvu kha a lesyipa tie hneta re hne'a angte, hruosue kha a thaaruvpa tie hneta amaa che aa; tahematapakieca ama hne ama kha thiyna luo a lyi te, a suepa tie'a lie ripuo pata a cuo; cahaacata cawsaa hluvsa suena kha phya te, a suepa tie cuota paakiepana kha a tue.

Vya saata a sa lipa a cingnung, hlaa sa tie; nu-aw pasana a ang buo li nung, khuosa ta khi la hlaa sa tie! Tahematapakieca Abyipana, thusepa canung a saata zaw na, navaa a hnyipa canung a saata zaw laata a hluv vie'a yi, a ta.
Na thluodaa kha pale vie tie, na awnapa pangzu kha paku vie tie; a paluolue khah, a khuhriy tie kha pa syi vie tie, a tung tie kha pacu vie tie.
Tahematapakieca nama ca cavyi cacuo ta na pungzaa aa, na ciypathla zaw ta ruo zaw hing cu'a yi te, a duothlingpa khy tie lie hing ama aw aa.
Ciy khah, na nang zaa'a va tli, na thaa chi khah se, nangzaa ang'a va tli ciy; na panu ningta na nangzaana kha maw'a cate, nunghlyi na cuo ningta na nangzaana kha a thyi'a va tli ciy.

Tahematapakieca nama caa satuv ca na navaapa tana a cuo, a ming ca Cungnungce Abyipatana a cuo; Israel Khazing Pathe ca nama caa Thlatuv ta cuo te, ama ca alyi cung bangkhuo Khazing ta pata kupa a cuo.
Tahematapakieca Abyipana, ma yi te a ngie a chisapa napuvnung, mingnuta napuv a cuo pata ama manung haa khata ica ku pakhaa aa, caa ta.
Cuo pachangta chunglie dyi nama kha ca thuse angte, cuorasala kawpacuona lepuv hne ica la pakhaa aa.
Cuo pachangta chung i hihaana ta, i hmie kha ica nukhuo, cuorasala chuozaa aa hmangpa duena ta kaw ica pacuo aa, Abyipacaa Thlatuv na a ta.

Hingpa hing kama cuota ca Noah chuo ning haa kha tana a cuo: tiy ta alyi hing a buv pakhaa li tli riypata Noah bie i za kuopa haata, na cunglie i hi haa li tli'a pata, a chuo zaw ca chuo'a va tli ang.

Tahematapakieca tluo hne, tluothlue zaw ca a hnyi'a yi te, cuorasala chuozaa ta aa hmangpa i duena hne, i biekuona ta a cuopa thlaalungna ca nama'a taata a hnyi buo'a vyi, ta pata, na cunglie kawpacuona caa hnyituv Abyipata a ri.
Vya riethyivuosuona a angpa, tiylaw ta a depa hne hnaanguona a hmung lipa, naa lung tie kha alung muosung ta pazue'a angte, na ing hruopatu kha safaiar lungvaa ta i bang aa,
na ingsuo a daw ca rubi lungvaa ta sa'a angte, na thlake tie kha lungvaa muosung ta i sa'a yi, khy dungkhuo lungruetlepie bangkhuo ca a muo sungnaapa alung ta i sa diy aa.
Na saata zaw bangkhuo ca Abyipata pacuv'a yi te, ama hnyirung hringhruo aa.
Nama ca adangna ta hring'a cate, hrisaana hneta a hla'a cate, ciy'a vaciy, ciy aa chiysapa taa zaw ta naa hla aa, ca vya cadi'a vyi.
Pakhakha ta acaa du kie ma, capa ca kama'a taata cuo vyi; acaa dutuv ca ahung a cuo zaw, aa sung aa.
Myihyi kha patiy te a zipa susatuv, a tuepa ca kama ta cuo angte, a khingna lie hmuo riypata cehre kha a sa; kama ngiethie ta paratuv zaw kha para riypata i sa.

Nama a duna riypata sapa khaapa cehre ta hmuo ca te'a vyi, bieripana lie nama suebena bie bangkhuo kha na i khu diy aa. Hingpa hing Abyipachangtaapa tie ru ta cuo te, kama'a taata ama sue lina paluosana tana a cuo, Abyipata a ta.

A tiy a hriepa bangkhuo, tiy awna luo hing a vaw tie ung; niema, tuokaa a hnyi lipa tie, a vaw ung la, calyi ung la ning tie ung! A vaw ung la, tuokaa li pata hne muo pi li pata, mingsuvtiy hne cuehnung kha calyi tie ung.

Khaapanakawma nama tuokaa kha viechuo a cuo lipa lieta hmuo ung cate, nama thavie kha nama me caa panguo lipa lieta nama hmuo? I bie hing a raaringsa pata naathlie ung la a phapa kha ning tie ung, sa pahuopa ta nama rue a pacing tie ung.
Na naathlie ung la, kama'a luo a vaw tie ung, na naathlie ung la nama hring aa. Niema hne khata aa hmangparipa biekuona tue'a angte, David'a lie i paluosapa aa hmangpa duena kha ica pi'a yi.
Mang tie, ama ca mingphang zaw'a luo kha tehte ta tue tli angte, iema luochiytuv hne iema uvtuv ta i tue tli.

Mang tie, na pachang lipa mingphang tie kha u'a yi cate, nama caa pachang lipa mingphang tie kha nama'a luo amaa vya ruo aa, tahematapakieca Abyipana Khazing, Israel Khazing Pathe ta, nama kha aca parungnaa sa mangtli.
Abyipaca hmung khu a cuo ning khata huv ung la, aa ngiena lie a aw ning khata u tie ung.

Cawsaa pha lipa tie ta ama luopuv kha thuse yi sala, aa dang lipa tie ta ama ruena kha thuse yi se; ama cunglie nangduena a hnyi riypa yi ta, Abyipa'a luo kha vya kaa yi se; Khazing'a luo kha vya kaa yi se, tahematapakieca aa ngiethe karue'a yi.
Abyipata, “I ruena ca niema ruena haata cuo vyi, I hringzya zaw niema hringzya haata cuo vyi.
Avuo ca alyi laata aa suo viepa haata, I hringzya ca niema hringzya laata a suo vie te, i ruena zaw niema ruena laata aa suo vie.
Khytiy hne cahue ca avuo taata za tla te, kaa pakhaa li pata alyi kha tiy a bya, saciy kha papu sa te, saciy a vaapa kha saciy pi te, sa a ningpa kha sa a pipa haata,
i pakaa taata a pyapa bie ca; kama'a luo kha a hripa ta vya kaa'a vyi, cuorasala i tingpa kha patling sa'a te, i pathlie hnuochuopa hmang kha a patlung aa.

Tahematapakieca palungtluona hne pya'a ung cate, diena hneta nama vya kaa aa; nama hmielieta sing hne tluo zaw hing hlaa sa'a yi te, ruo lie a awpa thingkungpa bangkhuo hingta ama kuvpazaa ama cabe aa.
Ahling kung ama punapa lie hing saipres kung pu'a yi te, ahling hraw a awnapa lie hing martal thing ama pu aa. Capa ca Abyipacuota athyiparina cuo'a te, aa hmangpa pamangsana ta a cuo aa.
Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Biedangpa kha a patuv ung la aa dangpa kha hrie tie ung, a ru hluota i khuona ca a vaw'a te, i thlana ca aa luo aa.
Sabbath ning kha para li pata a uvpa hne, a pha lipa tue kha a cahriypa, hingpa tie hing a tuepa hne a cusa pata a patuvpa ca a palungtluopa cawsaa tana a cuo.
Abyipahne a pazuepa ruohrang ming ta, “Abyipata a cawsaa tie hneta ina che hrahring aa,” ta khah se. Tiydiypa ta, “Kama ca thingkung a ruepa tana i cuo,” ta khah se.
Tahematapakieca Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: I sabbath kha a uv te, i palung naa patluopa hmang kha a tlawpa hne, i biekuona kha a cusa pata a patuvpa tiydiypa tie ca,

sacapaa zaw hne sacanung zaw laata a pha viepa, pachangparina hne mingphana khana, i ing hne a dungkhuo chunglie kha i pi'a yi; chuozaa ta aa hmangpa ming kha pi'a yi angte, capa ca thaw pata cuo'a vyi.

Cakhutaata a re hrie riypata, Abyipaming kha due riypata hne, a changtaapa cuo riypata Abyipa'a luo a pazuepa ruohrang ming, sabbath kha a uv te a para lipa bangkhuo hne, i biekuo kha a cusa pata a patuvpa,

hingpa tie hing i tluo pathepa luo kha a chiy'a yi angte, i thlaachuona ing chunglie kha ama palung i patluo'a yi; ama myirue panaana hne ama hriykhungrina kha i bienatluophie cunglieta i cuhluo'a yi; tahematapakieca kama ing ca cawsaa bangkhuo cuota thlaachuona ing ta pata kupa a cuo aa.
Israel ming, thaw pata a cuopa tie a pahmyatuv, Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri, Kama ta i pahmya ciepa tie khutaa khata, a hrangpa tie zaw kha iema'a luo i vya pahmya chiy'a yi, a ta.
Ruo saa aa hruopa tie bangkhuo, atuv chunglieta ruosaa aa hruopa tie bangkhuo, sie riypata a vaw tie ung!
Israel rievetuv tie ca ama ming na a cue, ama bangkhuo ta thesingna hnyi va yi; iema ca a nga the lipa uv, muo dyi sa te, a laa cakhawpa, a zie byalya khingpa uv tana ama cuo.
Uv ca ning karuo aw sa te, aa de tapa hnyi the vyi. Tuvkhietuv tie zaw ta thesingna hnyi va yi; ama luopuv cyicuo luo kha ama pie diy, ama bangkhuo tana iema a miena cyicuo kha ama huv.

Iema ta, “A vaw tie ung, mingsuvtiy dang'a ung puv, mingsuvtiy cahrapa kha ma lunghruo tlungna te dang'a ung puv; mawluo zaw ataning haa hing tana a cuo aa, a pha hmuo a pha vie hryly aa,” amaa ta, a ta.
Aa dangpa tie ama rapa kha ahungtahmuo siysaa ri va yi; Khazing a tlechuopa tie kha ahunghmuo ama pachang li pata ama sikhyi. Tahematapakieca aa dangpa tie ca rana taata la pata cuo yi te,
diena chung luo na amaa ngie; aa dangsa pata a hringpa tie ca a pahyna na ama hmung aa.
Cuorasala niema a pyinung saata zaw, siyhrawnung hne nungvaathingsuena a tuenung samingsahlaa zaw, hing luo hing a vaw tie ung.
Ahungma nama tue hyalya? Ahungma nama pakaa kukalaa khata nama palyi nama pachasue? Niema ca a suepa saata zaw, a hanghiepa samingsahlaa zaw cuo va ung ca ma?
A hringdiyliypa thingkung bangkhuo rawlie, mathliy kung zaw rawlieta nama thiysaa khingna lunghruo a patlungpa; bawphie zaw lie hne, alung karaw lieta nama saata a thiepa cuo va ung ca ma?

Bawphie piypiylung zaw hrawlie khana niema cuvu ta a cuo; iema, iema, khana nama vu ta a cuo yi; dangpa ta panaana kha iema'a lie bya ung cate, sa ta panaana kha nama pihluo. Khapa zaw cuo khata aa law thlu'a mang ina ta ung ca ma?
Aa suosapa tluo cunglie kha nama iehmang chi ung cate, capa luo ca hriykhungrina tue riypata nama kie.

Ingchiypakaa hne ingchiypakaa tung hnangkaalie kha, nama kuvtuezuv ca nama chi. Kama kha na thaw ung cate, a hrangpa tie huota nama caw kha thlie ung cate, iehmang cung luo nama kie, nama iehmang kusapa cunglie ca, namaa nuokhyina muo ca khazaa ma tapa kha nama palung tling pata bie nama chi. Ama iehmang lie kha nama ngie a rawsa te, thliehripa ta ama awpa kha lunghruo tlungsa pata nama mang.
Molek khazing'a luo kha rangpa-ue hneta nama cakuo, rangpa-ue kha namaa thuv; nama luosituv tie kha luohlaasa te nama pathlie, Sheol te ta nama pathlie.
Hmang hluvpuv luo namaa khie nakawta nama nang a buosa, cuorasala, “A thlahnena aw vyi,” ta va ung ciy. Nama thaa kha kya aw pakhaa te, nama nang buo the vyi.
Kama kha rue li tli pata hne, a thyi li tli pata, dungna te nguocuo hingta, ahungma hing tluv hingta nama ciy? A dieta tah a pasiysa i aw nakaw hing ma, na ciy li pata nama aw?
Namaa dangna hne nama hriepa re kha i ri diy aa, cuorasala capa zaw ca ta caa bya khu'a va yi.
Nama khi tiyta, nama kuvtuezuv tie khata ca khuo yi se! Thliy na a phya diy'a yi, yi kha huvsung na a phya diy'a yi. Cuorasala kama naa canawpa ca ruo kha hnyi'a te, i tluo pathepa kha ru ta a cu aa.
“Sa tie ung, sa tie ung, luopuv kha pare tie ung, a pakhuopa bangkhuo kha i cawsaa zaw luopuv taa khata phe diy tie ung,” ta pata a cuo aa.

Tahematapakieca a Pathepa ta pata kupa, chuozaa ta a hringpa, aa suona lie hne a pathepa hmang lie a awpa na hing haa hingta a ri: Kama ca aa suona lie hne hmang pathepa liena i aw, ngiechina hneta aa ngiepachiypa hne aa panepa tie'a lie zaw kha, pathiypalung cahra sa pakhaa riypa tana i aw.

Tahematapakieca aa pazue pata sue ca phaw'a va tli ang, i hi zaw haa pari'a va tli; tahematapakieca ama thlaapa kha kama hmiekunglieta a thaa a caw aa, kama ca iema a satuv hne hringna a pituv tana i cuo.
Ama pha lina hne ama karuo-awna kawlie khata i hi za haa te, i hihaa pata i tuv yi; cuorasala ama piena luopuv kha ama ziy ngiethie.
Ama hringzya kha i hmung, cuorasala i patluo'a yi; luochiy'a yi angte, hnaa i panguo'a yi, muochie a sapa tie hmya lie kha pathuosa thena i pi'a yi.
Abyipata, luohlaa luongie a awpa tie cuota thlaalungna pi'a yi angte, i patluo sa'a yi, a ta.
Cuorasala a pha lipa tie ca hnehnaw hne caakaw a phyalepa, a die khu the lipa riyliy tiylaw haa tana ama cuo.
A pha lipa tie cuota ca diena aw vyi, Abyipana a ta.
Khuosa ta khi tie, na ueryi pachung khah, hmyakaa ueryi haa khata na ueryi kha pathlie tie! Inaa dunapa yi hne ama suenapa kha, i cawsaa Jakob ingchungkhue'a luo kha pathyisa tie.

Iema ca adangna kha a hringkhyipa mingphang haata hne, ama Khazing ziyphung kha a thaw lipa haata, ning kha hnang ning kha ta kama kha na huv yi te, i luopuv kha ama pachang khing; aa dangpa bieripana kha kama'a lie na hie yi te, Khazing'a luo a ngie kha ama khing.

“Nama ta malie na hmung tlung li kieca khaapanakawma sa ca maa uv aa? Nama ta malie na pachang tlung li kieca khaapanakawma maa pane aa?” ama ta. Mang tie ung, sa namaa uv ning khana niema khingna kha nama tue, nama rehrietuv tie kha nama hrisaa.

Mang tie ung, niema ca a hru riypa hne a tuv riypa, hne nama pha lina maathung ta a phaw riypa dyi tana sa namaa uv. Ataning nama tuepa, hing haapa sa-uvna hingta ca, aa suona hmang lie nama ueryi thyi riypata tue khu'a vyi.

Kama ta i khingpa sa-uvna ca, ning kha a pane riypa khata ma a cuo? Paling kung haata a luv a bungpa hne, buri a buv pata buvcuo lie laapa khata ma a cuo? Hingpa hing ma sa-uvna nama ta aa? Hingpa hing ma Abyipakhingpa ning tana a cuo nama ta aa?

Kama i tlechuopa sa-uvna ca: biedang lipa lie ciypakina kha pathluo riypa, aa riypa hmang kha pachung riypa, hrisaapa tie kha hya pazang riypa hne, hmangriy syihnaa bangkhuo kha chi diy riypata cuo va ma?
A nang diypa tie kha sa pi riypa hne awna a hnyi lipa siypasa tie kha awna pi riypa; a buv a se riy a hnyi lipa kha cawsie pi riypa hne, nama tieriy zaw kha hnang chaw li riypata cuo va ma?

Cahaacata nama tue kiena nama khena ca mawdiy ning khepa haa khata cuo'a te, a catlisa pata nama hnaa a tluo aa; namaa dangna ca nama hmiekung luo ta si'a te, Abyiparungnaana ca niema caa vetuv yi ta a cuo aa.

Cakhutaata Abyipakha ku'a ung cate aca chaw'a yi; byana a hie pata khi'a ung cate, Hingpa lie hingna i aw, aca ta'a yi. Niema hraw taata hmangriy kha cuose, kuvdaw ta aca dawpa yi kha cuose, bie pha lipa kha cuose, nama thaw kieca;
A nang a diypa kha sa pi ung cate, riethyivuosuopa tie a hunapa kha namaa bya kieca, nama khena kha zingna chunglie khe'a te, nama zingna ca ningchung khena haata a cuo aa.

Abyipata aa pazue pata luo caa chiy'a yi te, a caavungna hmang lie kha namaa hupa a patling sa aa, cakhutaata nama ruv kha a pacu sa aa; tiy bya paripa diedung kha lu'a ung cate, tiy a ky buo lipa acaa haa khata nama cuo aa.

Nama cawsaa tie ta hluoning zaa rapa tie kha ama sa pakhaa aa; chuo hluvsa lie hruopatu tie cunglie kha pazue'a ung cate nama sa aa. Niema ca khy dungkhuo a paretuv, luopuv hne ing zaw a tuepathiytuv ta pata kupa nama cuo aa.

Sabbath ning para kha cahriy ung cate, a pathepa kama ning lieta nama khingpa tue kha nama cahriy kieca; sabbath ning kha khing aa chiypa ning, pa-uvsathyi aa chiypa Abyipaa pathepa ning; capa ning ca pa-uvsathyi ung cate, nama khingna luopuv kha ziy li pata hne, nama khingpa kha tue li pata, nama re kha namaa hrie li kieca;
Abyipachunglie palungtluona nama hmung aa; alyi lieta aa suona hmang cunglie kha ca pakhang'a yi angte, na mingchingmingvuo Jakob ru ta nama riy ica pabi'a yi; ta pata, Abyipapakaa taata a ri.
Mang tie, niema khuo riypata Abyipakuv ca pachang tuv vyi, thyi the lina te ta a naa zaw rue vyi.
Nama suena khana nama Khazing hne niema alalalieta caa pakhuo yi, nama sue nakaw tana aca thyi the li riypa yi ta a hmie aca nukhuo yi.
Tahematapakieca nama kuv ca thiy ta pyalyi te, nama kuvdaw ca pha lina ta a pyalyi; nama hmya ta hangbie ri te, nama palyi ta a pha lipa a ri.

Pakha hmuo aa dangpa bie ri va ung ciy, pakha hmuo phungbie haata aa dang pata si va ung ciy, hang ung cate a cuo lipa bie nama ri, ciy aa chiypa kha nu haata phya ung cate, pha lina kha saata haata nama sa.
A ca-ie ruvsapa pariy tiy kha tlung ung cate, minghliypa palaa kha nama ze; iema tiy a ningpa mekaa ca ama thiy, a tiy kha dechi pata a cuo kieca, a ca-ie ruvsapa pariy sakha a ki.
Iema ama zepa minghliypa palaa ca cawsie ta cuo the'a vyi, ama tuepa ca amaa buv hlie ta vyi. Ama re ca pha lina re ta cuo te, ama kuv chunglieta a tuv a thiena a aw.
Ama phyi ca pha lina luo hne, suena a hnyi lipa tie thiy palang riypata a catlisa pata aa ruo; ama ruepa ca pha lina khata cuo te, ama luopuv lepa lie ca duothlingna hne rana na a aw.
Iema ta diena luopuv kha pachang va yi, ama luopuv lieta biedangpa aw vyi. Ama luopuv ca aa dang lipa luopuv ta cuo te, a ziypa ahunghmuo diena kha pachang va yi.
Caacuonakawta biedangpa ca kiema hneta a hlasa te, adangna ta kiema kha malie pha khu vyi; khena kha ma huo, zingna ta a cuo; khy vuopa kha ma huo, cuorasala zingna chunglie kha ma cakuo.
Mingcuepa haata tlepie kha ma pathuole, ming a hnyi lipa haa khata ma pathuole; khy zing baaning ning haata ningchung ta maa pachiy, a thaaruvpa zaw hrawlie kha a thiypa haata ma cuo.
Cavaw haata a hrungle pate, thuvruv haata ngiechisa pata maa ngiy. Biedangpa kha ma huo, cuorasala aw vyi; khuona kha ma huo, cuorasala kiema hneta aa hlasa.
Na hmiekunglieta ma tuesuena ca a hluv hringhruo, ma suena ta sue malie a phaw. Ma tuesuena ca malie a bepuo te, ma pha lina kha maa pachang.
Abyipacunglie ma sue, ama kha thaw pate, ma Khazing ziyna taata ma pie, hrisaana hne aduna kaw kha ma ri, hanghiena kha nu haata phya pate, ma palung chungtaata ma ri.
Biedangpa ca kaa te, adangna ca kiema'a taata aa hlapuv lieta aa daa; cawsaa zapuv ahmyana hmang lie kha biehmisipa ca a pachiy te, adangna ca a ngie khu vyi.
Biehmisipa aw vyi, pha lina a cahriypa mekaa ca chuv pata ama cuo. Abyipata capa ca a hmung, biedangpa a aw li nakawta a hi a haa.
Pakha hmuo ama aw lipa kha a hmung, a ripatiypa ama aw li nakawta a nang a uo hringhruo; caacuonakawta ama kuv ta a cuota tena tlungkhyi te, aa dangna ta a caba aa.
Ama ta cacunghnaapakaw haata adangna kha a pakaw te, a luv lieta khuona thaalakhuv kha aa khuv; phuvlana pang kha a buv'a te, hihaana kha buohryi pasiypa haata a hryi te aa ciypuo.
Iema tuena haa khata a carie tie cunglie kha hihaana hneta a thung'a yi.

Caacuonakawta ningtlaluo a awpa tie ta Abyipaming kha ciy'a yi te, ningchiyluo a awpa tie ta a rungnaana kha ama ciy aa; tahematapakieca Abyipathliy ta a nuolepa cavaa, aa thaw ta zaa thawlepa haa tana aa vaw aa.
Cakhutaata ama ca Athlatuv cuona ta Zion luo kha a vaw'a te, tuesuena a piesepa Jakob khypuv chung luo kha aa vaw aa, Abyipata a ta.

Cakhutaata Abyipata, hingpa hingna iema hneta i tuepa biekuona ta a cuo, niema cunglie i chipa i thlaapa, hne nama pakaa lie i chipa i bie ca niema hne nama saata zaw hmya taata cuose, nama samingsahlaa zaw hmya taata cuose, pya pata vie'a vyi, ata taata chuozaa te ta, Abyipata a ta.
Thu la, khe tie; tahematapakieca na khena na a vaw tli, Abyiparungnaana na na cunglie a khe tli.
Zingna ta alyi kha buvkhung'a te, a chaasapa zingna ta cawsaa tie kha a buvkhung'a yi; cuorasala nama cunglie ca Abyipakhena kha tlung'a te, a rungnaana kha na cunglie aa luo aa.
Mingphang zaw ca na khena luo kha a vaw'a yi te, siepahruo zaw ca na mawdiy ningkhepa luo khana amaa vaw aa.
A kuo ting khata suo tie, ama bangkhuo ta a hmya yi te na nama'a luo amaa vaw; na sacapaa zaw ca luohlaa taa khata a vaw'a yi te, na sacanung zaw ca haatiyta haa khata amaa vya pawle aa.

Cakhutaata nama ta capa ca hmung'a cate na palung a tluo hringhruo aa, na palung aa cathluna te ta naa law aa; tahematapakieca riyliy hnyirungna ca nama'a luo kha vya tlungkhyi'a yi te, mingphang zaw hnyirungna ca nama'a luo kha aa vaw aa.
Midian hne Efah taata kala-uv kha a phuv a phuv ta vya tlung'a yi te, Sheba taapa bangkhuo zaw a vya tlung aa. Iema ta siy hne ziyhmyi kha vya phya'a yi te, Abyipakha khuosa ta ama pathuosa aa.

Kedar taata tuv bangkhuo kha nama'a luo a vya hmya diy'a te, Nebaioth taata mietungpa bangkhuo kha nama hmuo riypata a cuo aa; iema ca i bienatluophie lie kha cuhluo pata cuo'a yi te, kama ta a rungnaapa i ing kha i parungnaa sa aa.
Amyi haata a vya zulepa khiy khaapatama a cuo? Thuvruv zaw a buv luo a pangiepa haata a vya zulepa khiy khaapatama a cuo?

Na haatiy zaw kha luohlaapuv taata vya tlungkhyi riypa hne, ama siy hne ama ngu zaw kha iema hneta vya tlungkhyi riypata, Tarshish tiypalaw kha hmaa vya sa'a te, riyliy kie ruo tie ta kama kha ina huo'a yi; iema ta Abyipana Khazing hne Israel Khazing Pathe ming kha ama pathuosa aa, tahematapakieca nama kha aca parungnaa tli nakawta a cuo.
Ruohrang ming ta na khy dungkhuo lungruetlepie kha sa'a yi te, ama siepahruo tie ta na cuota re ama hrie aa; i hi a haa nakawta ca tuv angte, cuorasala ica due nakawta kawpacuona ica hnyi.
Ama siepahruo tie luochiyna ta, mingphang tie ta ama hnyirungna kha nama'a luo ama vya cyi the riypata, na thlake zaw ca cipari a pahaw'a te, chung hne zuo ta khaa pata cuo'a vyi.
Tahematapakieca na re a hrie khing lipa ruo hne pena tie ca duote pata na ama cuo aa; a mingphang tie zaw kha para pata ama cuo aa.
I hmangpathepa kha pa puvthe sa riypata, saipres thing, atuv myisaa thing, hne myisaa thing tapa tie, Lebanon rungnaana tie kha nama'a luo aa vaw aa; i phyi china hmang kha a rungnaa pata i tue aa.

Nama caa tuechiepa ciypathla tie kha, a vaw'a yi te, na hmiekunglie amaa vya bung aa, nama caa duvpa bangkhuo kha na phyi thabaw lie a vya bu'a yi te, nama kha AbyipaKhypuv, Israel Khazing Pathe Zion khypuv ta pata aca ku'a yi.
Nama ca ahungtahmuo capiepaa li pata thawpa hne huepa ta na cuo raalaa pata, a chuo a chuo ta palungtluona hne chuozaa a lesyi pata ica tue aa.

Nama ca mingphang hrangpa tie ahnungtiy kha dang'a cate, siepahruo tie meme khana na pazaw aa; cakhutaa cata kama ca, Abyipa, nama caa Khuotuv hne, nama caa Thlatuv, a Lesyipa Jakob Khazing i cuopa kha na pachang aa.
Daa cuopa ta siy, thaa cuopa ta ngu; thing cuopa ta daa, alung cuopa ta thaa kha ica pi aa. Diena hne Adangna kha caa uvtuvbyi ta ica tuepa aa.
A tuv a thiena thuohlaa hne, calicadaa pata parana thuohlaa kha na ruo lie thyi pata cuo'a vyi; na khy dungkhuo lungruetlepie kha Khuona ta'a cate, na thlake tie kha Pathuosana na ta aa.
Ning ca ningchung ta na khena cuo li tli'a pata, thlaapa ca zuo ta na khena cuo'a va tli; cuorasala Abyipaca na cuota chuozaa khena cuo'a te, na Khazing ca na rungnaana ta a cuo aa.
Na ning ca tla'a va tli, na thlaapa zaw hnangluo a saw'a vyi; tahematapakieca Abyipaca na cuota chuozaa khena cuo'a te, na ngiechinapa ning ca a chuo aa.
Na cawsaa bangkhuo ca a dang'a yi te, ruo kha chuozaa ta ama cu aa. Iema a rungnaa pata chi riypata, kama ta i lingpa thingdaa, i kuv ta i mangsangpa tana ama cuo.
Iema hrawlie a caw cepa ca chung kha ta a li'a yi te, siysaa ri li cepa ca mingphang phang kha ta amaa li aa. Kama ca Abyipatana i cuo, ama'a na a cuo lieta capa ca i patling sa aa.

Abyipa Khazingthlaapa na i cunglie a aw, tahematapakieca Abyipana sathu naa pathuv. Ama ta hrisaapa tie'a luo thuophaa phya riypa hne, a palung kyipa tie patluo sa riypata cuose, sii ta a dapa tie hya pazang riypa hne, thaw a tlapa tie papya riypa kaw pathyisa riypa kama kha ina pathlie tli.
Abyipathluechiy kung kha pathyi riypata hne, ma Khazing phuvlana ning kha pathyi riypata cuose; ngiechi pata a ngiypa kha hnaa panguo riypata cuose;

Zion lie ngiechi pata a awpa tie kha, buvcuo cuopa ta paapaapa pachiy, ngiechina cuopa ta alawna chiytiy, thaachina cuopa ta pathuosana pathiypalung kha pi riypata ina pathlie tli. Iema ta a rungnaana paluo sa riypata Abyipata aa lingpa, adangna mathliy kung ta pata aca ku'a yi.
Hluoning a rapa tie kha ama sa aa, hluo ningta parapatlaapa tie kha ama padaa pakhaa aa; a rapa khypuv tie kha pare'a yi te, chuo hluvpuv lieta za parapatlaapa tie kha ama pare aa.
Ruohrang ming ta a daa'a yi te, na sahring zaw kha sa ama pi aa, na lu hne na mingsuv diedung kha aca thlupa'a yi.
Cuorasala niema ca Abyipatluobyi tie ca ta'a yi te, ma Khazing rehrietuv tie ta pata ming aca pi'a yi; mingphang zaw hnyirungna kha nama palung tluokhyi'a te, ama hnyirungna lie kha nama rungnaa aa.

Tahematapakieca iema nangzaana ca le hning ta tli te, lingzuena kha iema cuvu ta pathyi sa pata a cuo tli, caacuonakawta iema ca cuvu le hning hmung'a yi te, chuozaa palungtluona ca iema cuota a cuo aa.

Tahematapakieca Abyipakama ca biedangpa kha khing angte, malie huopa chuvpa hne suena kha i hue; kama ta zang tluo aa tlasa pata amaa pipasena muo kha pi'a yi angte, iema hneta chuozaa biekuona kha i tue aa.

Ama ciypathla tie ca mingphang zaw hrawlie kha pachang pata cuo'a yi te, ama samingsahlaa zaw ca cawsaa zaw hrawlie pachang pata ama cuo aa; iema ca Abyipathluechiy pipa cawsaa ta ama cuopa kha a hmungpa bangkhuo ta ama pachang aa.

Kama ca Abyipa'a lie kha khuopuv ta i palung a tluo aa, i hringna yalya ta i Khazing'a lie i law aa; tahematapakieca nungchiytuv satlie ca cawphapa aa hryipa haata hne, vaahnyituv lesaa ta suethiy ta aa pangipa haata, kama kha khuona caw na pahryi te, adangna pang kha ina pabuv.
Alyi ta saciy a papu sapa haata hne, diedung ta saciy a pale sapa haata, AbyipaKhazing ta adangna hne pathuosana kha, mingphang bangkhuo zaw hmiekunglieta a palethaw sa aa.

Zion kawlie hing a dieta tah aw'a va ang, Jerusalem kawlie zaw hing a pahy'a va ang, a sue lina hing mawdiy ningkhepa haata a khe hluo li hne, a khuona hing myi khepa haata a khe hluo li a dieta tah aw'a va ang.
Mingphang zaw ta na sue lina kha hmung'a yi te, siepahruo bangkhuo ta na rungnaana kha ama hmung aa. Nama ca Abyipapakaa ta aca pipa, na ming thaapa ta aca ku'a yi.
Nama ca Abyipana Khazing kuv lieta, a puvthepa byilakhuv ta na cuo aa.

Nama kha Thusepa ta pata hne, na ruo zaw kha Ruo duothlingpa ta pata ku pata cuo'a va tli; cuorasala nama ca i Tlechuopa ta pata ku pata cuo'a cate, na ruo ca Navaa a hnyipa ruo ta pata ku pata a cuo aa; tahematapakieca ca nama ca Abyipata ca tlechuo te, na ruo ca navaa a hnyi aa.

Satlie pakha ta lesaa pakha kha napuv ta a chiypa haata, nama caa satuv ta nama kha napuv ta aca chiy aa. Nungchiytuv satlie ta vaahnyituv lesaa cunglie a palung a tluopa haata, na Khazing kha nama cunglie a palung a tluo aa.
Vya Jerusalem, na khy dungkhuo cungliena, rievetuv tie i chi yi; ning tlabu hne zuo khydyi a dieta tah aw'a va yi. Abyipakha a pathyisa pakhaapa tie zaw, a pahy va yi.
Jerusalem kha a pacu sana te ta hne, alyi cung yalya ta ama pachangna te ta a tue hluo li ama kha pahy sa khah ung.
Abyipata a cahrapa a cacuoluo kuv ta chie aa sa tli: Kama ta nama sa kha nama carie tie'a luo, ning riypata pi pakhaa va tli yi ang, cakhutaata na mingsuvtiy kha ruohrang ming ta dang'a va tli yi;
cuorasala mingsuv re a hriepa tie ta dang'a yi te, Abyipakha ama pathuosa aa; cakhutaata mingsuv thyi a lupa tie ta, a pathepa i tlawhmie lie kha ama dang aa.

Pya tie ung, thlake taa khata pya tie ung, cawsaa zaw cuo khata luopuv kha sa tie ung; sa tie ung, luopuv lepa kha sa tie ung, alung zaw kha phe diy tie ung, cawsaa zaw cuo khata pangtaa ca pathlie tie ung.
Abyipana alyi dena te khata a pathyi sa: Zion sacanung kha, “Mang tie, na khuona ca aa vaw nguoluo; a lawmuo ca ama'a lie aw te, a lasaw ca a hmiekunglie ta a aw,” ta pata chang tie ung.
Iema ca, “Mingphang Pathe, AbyipaKhuopa Mingphang” ta pata kupa ama cuo aa. Cakhutaata niema ca, “Huv Pata Hmungpa, Thaw Lipa Khypuv,” ta pata kupa nama cuo aa.

“Edom taata a vawpa ca ahungtama a cuo? A sedungpa pang a buv te Bozrah taata a vawpa ca ahungtama a cuo? “A rungnaapa pang kha a buv te a lesyipa cahrana hne a pale pata a vawpa ca ahungtama a cuo?” Nama sue lina kha pathyi sa angte, khuo riypata cahrana hneta a vawpa ca Kama tana i cuo.
“Khaapanakawma na cawsie ca mingsuv a ciypa tie buohryi haata a se?” a ta.
“Kama selaw tana mingsuv kha i ciy, cawsaa zaw chungtaata pakha hmuo kama'a lie aw va yi. I hihaasa pata i tlaw, i hihaasa pata i ciy; a tiy ta i cawsie luo kha naa pi te, i buohryi kha aa kaa diy.
Tahematapakieca phuvlana ning kha i palung lie aw te, kama ta i thlanapa yi kung ca a vya tlung tli.
Hmiehmie i pase, cuorasala byatuv aw vyi; i mang pasie, cuorasala naa bya riypa aw va yi; caacuonakawta kama kuv ta tena na pi te, i hihaana ta inaa bya.
I hihaasa pata cawsaa kha i chaapuo yi, i hihaana ta iema kha i ciy yi, cahaacata ama hringna thiyse kha alyi lie i palang,” a ta.

Abyipata vihnyina ta a tuepa ca i pasuv aa, pathuosa tluo aa tlapa Abyipaa tuepa ca i pasuv aa, Abyipata kiema cuota a tuepa bangkhuo hne, a nangduena ta iema a pahmung sapa yi ca, Israel ingchungkhue a due tuv nakawta hne aa hmangpa a duena a le hringhruopa nakaw tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca ama ta, “Iema ca i cawsaa ta ama cuo hrahring, naa dung li riypa i saata tana ama cuo,” a ta. Cakhutaata ama ruvnaanapa bangkhuo chunglieta, iema kha a khuo yi.

Biephyatuv ta cuo vyi, avuoming zaw cuo ra vyi, cuorasala a awpuona na a khuo yi. A duena hne a kawpacuona chunglie khana iema kha aa thla yi, a khung ciepa chuo bangkhuo lie kha iema ca za calang yi te a zaa paw yi.
Cuorasala iema ta zaa du yi te, a pathepa a thlaapa kha a ngie ama pachi, caacuonakawta iema carie ta a li te, ama hrahring ta aa du yi.

Cakhutaata iema ca a hluo chuo, a changtaapa Moses chuo kha amaa thyi pakhaa. A tuvrung kha tuvkhietuv hneta, riyliy chungtaata a pyakhyipa ca khaapaliema a aw? Iema chunglie a pathepa a thlaapa a chipa ca khaapaliema a aw?
A rungnaapa a buo ta Moses a cacuo kuv cahra sa te, a cuota chuozaa ta a ming aa hmang riypata, iema hmiekunglieta riyliy tiy kha che te,
riyliy chunglie luo a cakuo sapa yi kha khaapaliema a aw? Viehnangruo lie aruo haata, ama phyi a pachiy va yi.
Sahring zaw bawphie luo ama sibungpa haata, Abyipathlaapa ta a pahyna a pi yi. Cahaacata na ming a rungnaana riypata, na cawsaa tie kha luo naa chiy yi.

Vuoruo taa khata mangbung tie, a pathepa hne a rungnaapa na awnapa taa khata mangbung tie. Malie naa khingkhyina hne na cahrana ca khaapaliema a aw? Malie na vuonapa hne na kawpacuona ca khaapaliema ama aw? Kiema'a taa tana na la pakhaa.

Abraham ta malie pachang li pata, Israel ta malie a pachang li zawta, nama ca kiema paa tana na cuo. Vya Abyipa, nama ca kiema paa tana na cuo; hluo ning taata nama ca kiema malie a Thlatuv tana na cuo.

Vya Abyipa, khaapanakawma na luopuv taata malie papie sa cate, maca ciy li riypata ma palung kha malie na cahra sa? Na changtaapa zaw cuo hingta vya kaa tie, na ru ta a cuopa na mingphang zaw cuo hingta vya kaa tie.
A pathepa na mingphang ta hmangpathepa ca cuo khata dyi hnyi pate, cuorasala ata hing ca ma carie tie na ama khing ta a tue yi.
Kiema ca nama ta na uv lipa na ima lu, na ming ta ku lipa na ima lu.
Vya Abyipa, avuo kha pahaw la za cung tie, na hmiekunglieta tluo zaw kha a cahang naase yi.
Myi ta hnehnaw a kuopa haata hne, tiy kha a patla sapa haata, na carie tie ta na ming kha pachang'a yi te, mingphang zaw ca na hmiekunglie kha amaa cathang aa.
Nama ta kiema maa nguopuo lipa ciy aa chiypa hmang kha na tue tiyta, za cung cate tluo zaw kha na hmiekunglieta amaa cathang.
Hluo ning taata a pathu pata, ama a huopa tie cuota re a hriepa Khazing nama ta li pata, khaapa khazing hmuota naa ta za thyi buopa cuo vyi, ming ta za hmung buopa cuo vyi.
Alawna hneta aa hmuopa a tuepa, na luopuv ziy te nama caa thyipa tie kha nama ta naa taw yi. Cuorasala nama a du pata ma sue pazue tiyta na hi a haa, tuokhaatama khuo pata ma cuo khu aa?

Kiema bangkhuo hing a pathe lipa haa tana ma cuo diy, ma tuepa a pha cepa bangkhuo hing pangcaw chiepa haa tana a cuo. Ma bangkhuo hingta chinghnaa haata a uv pate, ma suena ta thliy haata luohlaa luo malie a phya.
Na ming caa upa pakha hmuo aw va yi, nama a patuv riypata a zuepa pakha hmuo aw va yi; tahematapakieca nama ta na hmie kha malie nukhuo cate, ma pha lina kuv chung luo kha malie na thaw.
Cuorasala Vya Abyipa, nama ca ma paa tana na cuo; kiema ca a cyi ta cuo pate, nama ca bi haata malie a vytuv ta na cuo, kiema bangkhuo ca na kuv ta na tuepa tana ma cuo.
Vya Abyipakhuosa ta na hi haa thi khah se, ma pha lina kha chuozaa ta a thyi thi khah, malie mang tie, kiema bangkhuo ca na cawsaa tana ma cuo.
Na khypuv pathepa ca ruocaapa tana aa li, Zion ca ruocaapa tana aa li, Jerusalem ca ruo duothlingpa tana aa li.
A pathepa hne a puvthepa ma ing, mingchingmingvuo tie ta nama aca pathuosanapa yi ca, myi ta rue yi te, maa lawnapa hmang bangkhuo ca a ra diy.
Capa bangkhuo khutaa cata, siysaa ri li pata ma na aw kalie aa, Vya Abyipa? A dieta tah aw'a cate ma, khuosa ta duo malie na te kalie aa?

Kama ca naa padang lipa tie a pahmung sa riypa tana a ting pacie pata i aw, naa huv lipa tie hmung riypa tana i aw. I ming ta thlaa a chuo lipa mingphang kha “Hingpa lie hingna i aw, hingpa lie hingna i aw,” i ta yi.
A pha lipa luopuv kha ziy yi te, iema khing ta a awpa tie, a du a hmuopa cawsaa tie kha, ning-aw ta i kuv i hluo pari yi.
I hi pahaa pari riypata, i hmiekunglie hrahring kha, diedung chunglieta hriykhungrina pihluo yi te, lungrue bienatluophie lie kha rangpa-ue ama rue.
Thluo lie kha a tu yi te, aa nunapa hmang lieta amaa ri, va saa kha ce yi te, ama bi chunglie ca duv aa chiypa saa tiyhuo kha a aw.
“Namata tah aw, kama'a luo a vaw khah, kama ca nama laata i pathe vie karaa,” ama ta. Hingpa tie hing i hnaakhue lie myikhuv ta cuo yi te, ning-aw ta a kuopa myi tana ama cuo.
Mang tie, i hmiekunglie na aa cape: A dieta tah aw'a va ang, cuorasala i thung'a yi; ama tuena haata i thung hrahring'a yi;
