iema suena hne ama mingchingmingvuo tie suena hneta, i thung hrahring'a yi, Abyipata a ta. Tahematapakieca iema ta tluocung lie kha rangpa-ue rue yi te, tluothlue cunglie kha i kawchie ina ri yi, ama tuena haata a tlingsa pata thung riypata, ama tuena muo kha i pasuv aa.

Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Mingsuv baw lie mingsuv thyi na hmung tiyta, iema ta, “Para khah, tahematapakieca thluechiy na a chunglie a aw,” ama tapa haata, I changtaapa kawlieta iema bangkhuo kha para'a va yi ang.
Jakob chungtaata ciypathla tie kha papya sa'a yi angte, Judah taa khata i tluo zaw a cu riypa kha i papya sa'a yi; i tlawpa tie ta capa ca cu'a yi te, i changtaapa tie kha capa lie ca khy ama sa aa.
Kama naa huvpa i cawsaa zaw cuota, Sharon ca sahring zaw tlena ta a li'a te, Akhor Bawphie ca ama sahring zaw amaa bunapa ta a cuo aa.
Cuorasala niema Abyipaa thawpa, i tluo pathepa a mawpa tie, vuophana khazing, Gad kha sa a pihluopa tie, Meni kha dangpa ta panaana a pihluopa tie ca;

Kama ta zueziy kuv luo ca pi'a yi angte, cawsaa a thietuv hmiekunglie kha namaa bung aa; tahematapakieca ica u tiy yi ta na chaw va ung ciy, bie i ri tiyta naathlie va ung ciy, cuorasala i hmungna lieta a pha lipa kha tue ung cate, i khing lipa kha namaa tlaw.

Caacuonakawta AbyipaKhazing ta hing haa hingta a ri: I changtaapa ca ning'a te, cuorasala niema ca nama nang a diy aa; i changtaapa ca dang'a te, cuorasala niema ca nama tiy a hrie aa; i changtaapa ca a palung tluo'a te, cuorasala niema ca nama nang a zaa aa;
i changtaapa ca palungtluona hlaa sa'a te, cuorasala niema ca nama palung pasa pata nama khi aa, nama ngiechi pata nama caa aa.
I tlawpa tie ta chiesana lieta ama hmuo riypata, nama ming kha thuse siy'a ung cate, Abyipa Khazingta aca thie'a yi; cuorasala a changtaapa tie ca, ama ta aa nanangpa ming a pi'a yi.

Cakhutaata ruo chunglieta thluechiy a hiepa tie ca, zang tluo aa tlapa Khazing ta thluechiy a pi'a yi; cakhutaata ruo chunglieta biekuona a tuepa ca, zang tluo aa tlapa Khazing ming ta chie amaa sa aa; tahematapakieca ruvnaana taapa kha maw pata cuo'a te, i hmiekung taata nu pata a cuo aa.
Tahematapakieca kama ta avuo thaapa hne, alyi thaapa kha i sa aa; hluo ning hmang tie kha a thyi pata cuo'a va tli.
Cuorasala i sa thaapa cunglie kha, chuozaa ta palung tluo pata a cuo aa; tahematapakieca Jerusalem kha palungtluona riypata sa'a angte, a cawsaa zaw kha tlechuo riypata i sa'a yi.
Jerusalem hne i cawsaa zaw kawlie kha, i palung a tluo aa; a chunglieta caana ueryi kha thyi pata cuo li tli'a pata, ngiechina ueryi zaw kha thyi pata cuo'a va tli.

A haatiy ningta a thiypa aw li'apa yi ta, chuo tlung li pata a thiypa cawsaa aw'a va yi; tahematapakieca kung zakha ta a thiypa kha mingnu ta rue pata cuo'a te, kung zakha a tling li pata a thiypa ca chiesapa ta ripa a cuo aa.
Iema ta ing kha sa'a yi te, ama cu aa; mingsuv kha a ling'a yi te a thyipaa kha ama ning aa.

Iema ta sa'a yi te, a hrangpa ta cu'a va yi, iema ta a ling'a yi te a hrangpa ta ning'a va yi; I cawsaa zaw chuo ca thingkung zaw chuo haa khata cuo'a te, iema ta ama hriepa kha cuo pasiypuv amaa nuokhyi aa.
Ama hriepa kha a hrihripa cuo li'a pata, a thiy a li riypa saata sa'a va yi; iema ca Abyipata thlue a chiypa samingsahlaa ta cuo'a yi te, ama ciypathla tie zaw cahaacata ama cuo aa.
Ina u hluo yi ta chaw'a yi angte, ama ri nguoluo ning kha i thyipa'a yi.

Cahnie hne tuvtaata kha sa pi pakhaw pata cuo'a yi te, chingde ca cue haata a phuv a buo aa; cuorasala pariy a sa ca buvcing ta a cuo aa! I tluo pathepa bangkhuo cunglie ca, a para a pakyi'a va yi, Abyipata a ta.
Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Vuoruo ca i byithude ta cuo te, alyi ca i phyi pachungna tana a cuo; tuokhaapa ing na sapa'a ung cate ma, tuokhaapa a pahyna hmang ina tuepa'a ung ciy?

Hingpa hmang bangkhuo hing i kuv ta i tue pata cuo yi te, caacuonakawta hingpa hmang bangkhuo hing kama huopa tana a cuo, Abyipata a ta. Cuorasala i bie lie kha a cathang te, a pane te a ngiepachiyna pathiypalung a hnyipa ca, kama ta i mang'a yi.

Cuetungpa a thiepa ca cawsaa a thiepa haa tana a cuo; tuvtaata tah hriykhungrina a pihluopa ca uv ruetung a thlipa haa tana a cuo; sa ta panaana a pihluopa ca, va thiy a pihluopa haa tana a cuo; a thyi parina ta rangpa-ue a pihluopa ca kuvtuezuv thluechiy a pipa haa tana a cuo. Capa tie ca iema luopuv kaluo kha a tlaw yi te, duv aa chiysapa iema huopa lie kha ama palung a tling.

Kama zaw iema tue hyalya riypa kha a tlaw'a angte, iema ta ama ciypa kha ama cunglie i patlung sa aa; tahematapakieca i u ning yi kha ahungtahmuo na chaw lipa yi ta, bie i ri tiyta, naathlie va yi; cuorasala i hmungna lie kha a pha lipa tue yi te, i palung naa patluo lipa kha amaa tlaw.

Abyipabie lieta aa cathangpa tie, Abyipabie kha naathlie tie ung: I ming kawlieta nama caa huepa hne caa thawpa tie ta, “Nama palungtluona kha ma hmung the riypata, Abyipaming ca pa rungnaa pata cuo mang sue,” ama ta; cuorasala iema khana ama nang pazaa pata a cuo'a yi.
Naathlie tie ung, khypuv taata khi-una puraa ca! Biena-ing taata ueryi! A carie tie kha vieriy a thungnapa yi, Abyipaueryi tana a cuo!
A riy a pasa hluo tana saata a sa: a cunglie a pasapa a aw hluo tana, sacapaa a sa.

Cahaapaapa kaw ca ahungma a thyi? Cahaapaapa hmang ca ahungma a hmung? Ruo ruo kha ca ning kha tama a puv aa? Mingphang phang kha ca sungkha tama a thla pata a cuo aa? Cuorasala Zion ca a riy a pasa pahne tana a saata zaw a sa yi.
I riy lie phya angte ma, sa li pata i aw aa? Abyipata a ta; a thlatuv ta a cuopa kama ma, pavaw kha a khaa'a ang? Na Khazing ta a ta.
Ama a duepa bangkhuo zaw, Jerusalem hne khata nama palung tluo sala ama cuo khata a law tie ung; ama kha muochie a sapa bangkhuo, ama hne khata nama palung tluo pakhaw se.
Hnaa caa panguopa yi aa hnung kha pazaw'a ung cate, nama me a nguo aa; palung tlingsa pata dang'a cate, a rungnaapa a cacunghnaa lie kha na hnaa a nguo aa.

Tahematapakieca Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Hnyirungna ca ama'a luo kha cavaa haata palang'a angte, mingphang hnyirungna ca tiy a rungsapa cavaa haata a cuo aa. Ca mangsang'a te a buo lieta acaa paw aa, a pakhuv lie ca patu'a te acaa du aa.
A nung ta a saata hnaa a panguopa haata, kama ta hnaa ica panguo'a yi; nama ca Jerusalem lie hnaa panguo pata na cuo aa.

Hmung'a cate na palung a tluo aa; na pangpa ca aphuv haata na panu diyliy aa; cakhutaata Abyipakuv ca a changtaapa tie'a liena a aw tapa hne, a hihaana ta a carie tie aa dupa yi kha pachang pata a cuo aa.
Tahematapakieca hihaasa pata thung riypa hne, myi palyi ta cawsaa chuo riypata, Abyipaca myi chunglie kha a vaw'a te, aa ruole ca thliysung na a lu aa.
Tahematapakieca Abyipaca cawsaa bangkhuo kha, myi hne zueziy tana bieripana a tue'a yi; Abyipata a thiepa ca ama hluvsa aa.

Va saa, pazuv, hne duv aa chiypa saruopa saa kha ce yi te, a liechunglie a awpa kha paziy pata, diedung chung luo cakuo riypata iema hne iema a pathe sapa tie ca a chuona luo na ama tlung pakhaw aa, Abyipata a ta.
Tahematapakieca ama hriepa hne ama ruena kha i pachang, mingphang bangkhuo hne ryi bangkhuo kha pahmya riypata a vaw'a angte, a vaw'a yi te i rungnaana kha ama hmung aa,

cakhutaata iema hrawlie kha pamangsana suokha i chi aa. Iema'a taa khata aa ngaapa tie kha Tarshish, Put, hne Lud luo cuose, liy a hmuopa ta a cuopa, i mingpathuona a thyi buo lipa hne a hmung buo lipa, riyliy kie ruo tie ta a cuopa Tubal hne Javan luo kha paphya'a yi angte, iema ta i rungnaana kha mingphang zaw hraw luo ama pathyi sa aa.

Israel ming ta a pathepa bi chunglie sa ta panaana kha Abyipaing luo amaa vawkhyipa haata, iema ta na tieriy zaw bangkhuo kha mingphang zaw bangkhuo hraw taa khata Abyipa'a luo pihluo riypata aruo zaw, aruole zaw, laa zaw, cawsaa a puvnapa zaw khata Abyipa'a luo, a pathepa tluo Jerusalem luo kha amaa vawkhyi aa, Abyipata a ta.
Cakhutaata kama zaw ta iema chekha kha la'a yi angte, tluobyi zaw, Levi ming zaw haa khata i tue'a yi, Abyipata a ta.
Tahematapakieca kama ta i tue riypa avuo thaapa hne alyi thaapa ca, kama hmiekunglie aa hmangpa haa khata; na ciypathla hne na ming ca aa hmang aa, Abyipata a ta.
Thla thaapa taata thla thaapa, sabbath taata sabbath ta pata, cawsaa bangkhuo kha kama hmiekung luo abie riypata amaa vaw aa, Abyipata a ta.

Cakhutaata iema ca pya'a yi te kama naa dupa cawsaa tie ama riyy kha ama mang aa; tahematapakieca ama lung ca thiy'a vyi, ama myi ca pache khu pata cuo'a vyi, cawsaa bangkhuo cuota duvsamakhiepa ta ama cuo aa.
Benjamin ruo Anathoth lieta tluobyi a cuopa Hilkiah sacapaa Jeremiah bie ca hing haa hingta a cuo.
Judah ming Amon sacapaa Siepahruo Josiah ta siepahruo a cuonapa kung hraa hlyithungna kung lie kha Abyipabie ca ama'a luo kha a pha.

Judah ming Josiah sacapaa Siepahruo Jehoiakim chuo ning zaw kha pha te, Judah ming Josiah sacapaa Siepahruo Zedekiah chuo kung hraa hlyikha te, Jerusalem sii ta amaa danapa thla hraa hlyipangaa te khata Abyipabie ca ama'a luo kha a pha.
Cakhutaata Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha vya tlung te,
“Riy chunglie ica sa hluota ica pachang tli, na puv hluo khata ica pathe sa tli; mingphang zaw cuota profet ta ica tue tli,” a ta.
Cakhutaata kama ta, “Ah, Abyipa Khazing! Tuokhaatama bie i ri aa tapa kha pachang va ang, tahematapakieca kama ca mingnuta tana i cuo,” i ta.
Cuorasala Abyipata kama kyihuo khata, “'Mingnuta tana i cuo ta khah'; tahematapakieca ica pathliena bangkhuo luo kha si'a cate, bie ica pipa mekaa kha na ri aa,
Iema kha ciy khah yi, tahematapakieca nama kha khuo riypata nama'a liena i aw, Abyipata ina ta.”
Abyipata a kuv kha pazuo te i hmya kha a taw; cakhutaata Abyipata kama kyihuo khata, “I bie khana na pakaa luo i chi tli.
Mang tie, ataning hing mingphang zaw cunglie hne pena zaw cunglieta, phiepathla riypa hne phipatlaa riypa, para riypa hne thaw riypa, sa riypa hne a ling riypa tana ica chi tli,” a ta.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha a vaw te, “Jeremiah, khaapama na hmung?” i na ta. Kama ta, “Almond thingce na i hmung,” i ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipata, “A pha pata na na hmung, tahematapakieca i bie haata hrie riypa tana i huo nguoluo,” i na ta.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha a yihningna pata a vaw pakhaa te, “Khaapama na hmung,” ina ta. Kama ta, “Sungluo ta a zaa kiepa aa tla nguoluopa bi suokha na i hmung,” i ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipata kama kyihuo khata: Rana ca chaluo taa tana ruo chunglie khy a sapa zaw bangkhuo cung luo kha a za tlung aa.

Tahematapakieca Abyipata, chaluo pena taata mingphang bangkhuo kha ata hingta ku yi angte, iema ca a vaw'a yi te, ama bangkhuo khata ama byithude zaw kha Jerusalem thlake angienapa tie lie, a cadungpa yi khy dungkhuo bangkhuo lie, hne Judah khypuv bangkhuo lie kha ama vya chi aa.
Kama thawna ta ama tuepa pha lina bangkhuo, khazing hrangpa tie'a lie hriykhung amaa rina bangkhuo, iema kuv ta ama tuepa amaa biena zaw bangkhuo cuo khata ama cunglie bieripana i tue aa.

Cuorasala nama ca na pahriy kha a pasi la, a daa la nama'a lie bie ica pipa bangkhuo kha chang tie yi. Iema hmiekunglie kha na palung chuo khah se, acuolikie iema hmiekunglie khana na palung ica pachuo sa aa.
Ataning hing ruo yalya ta a du riypa, Judah siepahruo tie, byi tie, tluobyi tie, hne ruo cawsaa tie kha a du riypata, nama ca dungkhuopa khypuv, thaa atung, hne daa tlepie tana ica tue tli.
Iema ta acaa du'a yi; cuorasala ca te'a va yi, tahematapakieca kama ta ca awpuo'a angte ica khuo aa, Abyipata ina ta.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha a vaw te:

Cakuo la Jerusalem thyipa khata tluo va u tie, Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Na lesaa ningta inaa pi ciy, vaahnyituv lesaa adaahmang taata kha tluv ma ina due ciy tapa hne, ciy cyi linapa ruo, ruocaapa lieta tuokhaatama ina paziyle ciy tapa kha maw va ang.
Israel ca Abyipa'a lieta a za pathe, a sa lana taata thyipaa taapa tana a cuo. Ama a zaa ningpa bangkhuo ca suena ama hnyi; iema cunglie ca rana na a tlung, Abyipata a ta.
Abyipabie kha thyi tie ung, vya Jakob ingchungkhue, hne Israel ingchungkhue bangkhuo tie.

Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Na mingchingmingvuo tie ta i cunglie khaapa i paana ma ama hmung? kama'a taata luohlaa luo kha cakuo yi te, khaapahmuo a thlahne lipa hnang kha ama ziy, cakhutaata iema hrahring zaw kha khaapahmuo a thlahne li pata amaa li.

Iema ta, Izipt taata malie a kya chiypa Abyipakha, khaapaliema a aw ta va yi; ruocaapa chunglieta malie a chiylepa, viehnangruo hne khue zaw hrawlie, a pyalyipa hne a zingkaruvna lie, ahungtahmuo ama cahraw lipa ruo, pakha hmuo ama aw linapa ruo lieta, malie a chiylepa kha khaapaliema a aw ta va yi.
Kama ta a thyipaa hne hmang phapa kha ning riypata, a hnyirungsapa ruo luo kha icaa chiy yi. Cuorasala a chung luo namaa ngie taata i ru kha papyapalyi ung cate, i ru kha duvsamakhie pata nama tue.

Tluobyi tie ta, “Khaapaliema Abyipaa aw? ta va yi. Phungbie a patuvpa tie ta kama kha na pachang va yi; uvtuv tie ta kama a du pata suena tue yi te, profet tie ta Baal ming ta profetbiephu ama ri; a thlahnena a aw lipa hmang hnang luo kha ama ziy.
Caacuonakawta niema hne, nama samingta te ta sue ica be pakhaa'a yi, Abyipata a ta.
Saipras riyliy kie kha va te ung la mang tie ung, cawsaa kha Kedar luo paphya ung la, hing haa hingta a cuo buo ma ta pata a phata tah mang ung la rue tie ung.
Mingphang suokha ta a khazing kha khazing a cuo li zawta a thle buo ma? Cuorasala i cawsaa tie ca iema rungnaana kha, khaapahmuo a thlahne lipa ta ama thle tli.
Vya avuo zaw, hingpa kawlie hing a cathang tie ung, a pahlu ung la, nama kharue haa se, Abyipata a ta.
Tahematapakieca i cawsaa zaw ta pha lina suo hning tue yi te: hringna tiy a pyanapa acaa, kama kha ina thaw yi, iema'a na iema ta a zuvpa takhue, tiy a pa-ang khu lipa takhue kha amaa cu.
Israel ca sii tama a cuo? Ingchungkhue sii ta cuo kanaa? Khaapanakawma chuvpa ta a cuo?
Chingde zaw na a hrungsue yi, khuosa tana amaa hrung. A ruo khana utlawpa ta ama tue; khypuv zaw ca ra yi te, cawsaa pakha hmuo aw va yi.
Ca hlyitaw taata, Memfis ming hne Tahpanhes ming na, na luv lie na byilakhuv kha a dechi yi.
Luopuv lie acaa chiyle ningta, Abyipana Khazing kha na thaw nakawta, hingpa hing nama ta na cung luo na patlungpa cuo va ma?
Nail cavaa tiy dang riypata Izipt luo na vaapa ca khaapama aca thlahne? Zufrates cavaa tiy dang riypata Assiria luo na sipa ca haw khaapama aca thlahne?

Na pha lina na nama kha duo caa te, naa daahmang na thawnapa khana bie caa chipa aa. AbyipaCungnungce Khazing na thawpa ca na cuo ta pha lina hne khana ta a cuopa kha hmung la pachang tie, kha tluv tama a kha tapa kha hmung la pachang tie. Kama ciyna kha na chunglie aw vyi, Cungnungce Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Hluo ning taa khata na syihnaa kha chi cate, “Na re kha hrie'a va ang,” na ta. Aa suona tluothlue mekaa hne, a hringsiyliypa thingkung raw mekaa lieta, a zie cate na siyhraw.
A pathe cepa a kungpuvnung taata, a pha cepa mingsuv kung haata icaa ling. Tuokhaatama a phang pha lipa hne ruo mingsuv ta naa li?
Chaapie a hluvsa hmuo cate lung-ie tiy ta naa siy raalaa pata, na suena ta acaa kaapa ca i hmiekunglie aa luo pari, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Tuokhaatama, “A papya a palyi va ang, Baal kha ziy va ang,” na ta khu aa? Bawphie lie na luopuv kha mang la, na tuepa kha pachang tie.

Hri khu lipa laalaanung, a pali a pahnaa ta a ruopa, ruocaapa lie a awpa ruotle laa, a hnaakhue ta thliy a sawlepa ca, a sapaa khingna kha ahungma a thlu khu aa? A khingna huvpa riypata ahungtahmuo a thaa a pabuo khah se, a hue thlaa ning ca ama hmung aa.
Na phyi a buona te hne, na tiy a hriena te ta cakuo kha a ang tie. Cuorasala nama ta, “A nguopuona aw vyi, tahematapakieca ruohrang ming kha khing yi angte, iema hnang na i ziy aa,” na ta.
Aparuvpa ca ama patuv tiyta a nang a zaapa haata, Israel ingchungkhue ca a nang a zaa aa; iema, ama siepahruo tie, ama byi tie, ama tluobyi tie, hne ama profet tie,

thingkungpa kha, “Nama ca i paa tana na cuo,” ta yi te, alung kha, “Nama na naa sa ciy,” a tapa tana ama cuo. Tahematapakieca iema ta ama hnang na chaw yi te, ama hmie na pi va yi. Cuorasala ama ruvnaana cuo lie kha, “A vaw la malie khuo tie,” ina ta yi.

Niema cuota namaa tuepa nama khazing tie ca, khaapaliema ama aw? Aca khuo khu kie yi ca, nama ruvnaana cuo lie ca, a vaw yi sala ca khuo yi se; tahematapakieca khy a hluvsa nama hnyipa haata, khazing zaw a hluvsa nama hnyi, Vya Judah ming.
Khaapanakawma naa du ung cate namaa cie? Kama kha inaa du tli ung ciy, Abyipata a ta.
Khaapahmuo a cuo lipa lie nama saata zaw kha i tuv yi; pasiypa-yana kha cuhluo khing va yi. Nama zueziy na aa hruopa chingde haata, nama profet tie kha a sie yi.

Vya ata chuo cawsaa tie, Abyipabie kha pacuo syalya tie ung! Kama hing Israel cuota ruocaapa ta cuo kanaa ang, acuolikie ruo zing hringhruopa ta cuo kanaa ang? Khaapanakawma i cawsaa zaw ta, “Kiema ca hyazangpa ta cuopa te, nama'a luo a vaw'a va tli puv” ina ta yi?
Lesaa ta aa tuepa suethiy kha a maw khu'a ma? acuolikie vaahnyituv lesaa ta aa hryipa caw kha a maw khu'a ma? Cuorasala i cawsaa zaw ta kama kha ning chachaa ta ina maw yi.
Khingpa huvnazya ca na va the hringhruo ing! Na luopuv ca canung pha lipa kha hmuo na pacuv yi.
Ing ama paruvna lieta na patuv li raalaa pa yi ta, na cawsie lieta a sue lipa siypasa tie thiy aa kaapa kha, cawsaa ta ama hmung. Hingpa hmang zaw bangkhuo a cuo thluo raalaa pata,
Nama ta, “Sue va ang; a hihaana ca inaa palise tli,” na ta. “Sue va ang,” na ta nakawta bieripana na ica hnyi aa.”
Tuokhaatama na luopuv ca hing tluv ta a catli pata na thle e! Assiria ta na nang aca pazaapa haa khata, Izipt zaw ta na nang aca pazaa aa.
Na luv cunglie na kuv khang'a cate, khapa taa khata na pya aa; tahematapakieca Abyipana naa buchuopa tie kha a thaw tli yi, iema'a taata khaapa phana hmuo hmung'a va tli ciy.

Capaa pakha ta a napuv kha ma te, a napuv ta pyase te, capaa hrangpa napuv a cuo tiyta, a navaapa taapa ta capa nung ca aa hlaw pakhaa'a ma? Cahaapaapa ca na ruo kha khuosa ta a papya a palyi aa cuo va ma? Na khingpa a hluvsa hne tana na siyhraw tli; kama'a luo ca na vya kaa'a ma? Abyipata a ta.

Aa suopa tluo cung utlawpa khiy, suo ung la mang tie ung! Siyhraw pata na laa linapa hmang a aw ma? Ruocaapa chunglie aa palawlepa mingphang tie haata, luopuv kie lieta na khingpa huo yi cate naa tule; na siyhrawna hne na pha lina ta ruo kha na papya na palyi tli.
Caacuonakawta khytiy kha hre angte, cuovuo khytiy a vaw vyi; cuorasala nama ca siyhrawnung puo kha hnyi cate, na nang zaa the vyi.
Ata taata a patha pata kama kha, “I paa, nama ca mingnuta i cuo baataata i viesaa tana na cuo, na ta.
Chuozaa ta ca a hi a haa'a ma? A chuona te ta ca a palung a pasa'a ma?” na ta. Cahaacata na ri raalaa pata, na tue khu thathiypa pha lina bangkhuo ca na tue diy tli.
Siepahruo Josiah chuo lieta Abyipata kama kha ina chang: Zang tluo aa tla lipa Israel ta a tuepa, tluo aa suopa mekaa luo kha kie te, thingkung hringpa raw mekaa lieta a siyhrawpa kha na hmung ma?
“Hingpa bangkhuo hing a tue khutaata kama'a luo a vya kaa thlu aa,” ta pata i rue; cuorasala vya kaa vyi, capa ca a hanghienung a sietanung Judah ta a hmung.

Zang tluo aa tla lipa Israel ca nungvaathingsuena a tuena kawlieta achena caa pi angte i papyapa kha a hmung thluo pata, a hanghienung a sietanung Judah ta ciy vyi, cuorasala ama zaw vaa te siyhrawna kha a tue.
A nasa pata siyhraw te ruo kha a papya a palyi, alung hne thing hne khata nungvaathingsuena kha a tue.
Hingpa zaw bangkhuo khutaa hingta a hanghienung a sietanung Judah ca a pathiypalung yalya ta kama'a luo kha vya kaa vyi, cuorasala Abyipaina ta pakhi.
Cakhutaata Abyipata kama kyihuo khata: Zang tluo aa tla lipa Israel ca a hanghienung Judah laata a suena a caw viepa kha ina pahmung sa.

Cakuo la, hingpa bie hing chaluo kha kya pathyi sa tie: Zang tluo aa tla lipa Israel, vya kaa tie, Abyipata a ta. Hihaana hneta ca mang'a va ang, tahematapakieca kama ca nangduena a hnyipa tana i cuo, Abyipata a ta; Chuozaa ta i hi haa'a vyi.
Abyipana Khazing a du cate na suenapa cuose, thingkung hringpa mekaa rawlieta ruohrang ming na khinglepa yi hne, i ueryi na naathlie lipa kha, a cuo sasaw, ta tie; Abyipata a ta.

Vya kaa tie ung, Vya zang tluo aa tla lipa saata zaw, Abyipata a ta, tahematapakieca kama ca nama byipaapa tana i cuo; pakha kha khypuv taata hne, pahning kha ingchungkhue taata ca la'a yi angte, Zion luo kha icaa chiy'a yi.
I palung naa lupa tuvkhietuv kha ca pi'a yi angte, ama ca ta thesingna hne pachangna kha aca pi'a yi.

Cakhutaata capa cuo lie ca, niema kha ruo chunglieta vya pung ung cate nama vya hluv le tiyta, iema ta, “Abyipabiekuona thingkaw,” ta'a va tli yi. Ama palung lie puv'a va tli, a thyi'a va tli yi, vuo'a va tli yi; a hrangpa zaw tue'a va tli yi.

Capa cuo lie ca Jerusalem kha Abyipabyithude ta pata ama ku aa, cakhutaata mingphang bangkhuo kha ama'a luo, Jerusalem lie Abyipahmiekung luo kha a vya hmya'a yi te, a pha lipa iema luopuv luo kha palunglena hneta ziy'a va tli yi.
Capa cuo thue ca Judah ingchungkhue ca Israel ingchungkhue luo kha a pahlaw'a te, chaluo ruo taa khata nama mingchingmingvuo tie'a luo ru ta i pipa yi ruo luo kha amaa vaw pakhaw aa.

Tuokhaatama niema ca i saata zaw hrawlie ca chi'a yi angte, mingphang zaw bangkhuo tie a puvthepa ru, aa nuopa ruo kha ica pi'a yi, ta pata i rue. Niema ta i paa na ta'a ung cate, kama kha na ziy'a ung cate kaa'a va tli ung ciy, ta pata i rue.
Cadyiseca, zang tluo aa tla lipa napuv ta a navaapa a thusepa haa khata, i cuota zang tluo a tla va ung ciy, Vya Israel ingchungkhue, Abyipata a ta.
Aa suopa utlawpa taata, Israel saata zaw ngiechina caa ryi kha aa thyi, tahematapakieca iema ta ama luopuv kha paa yi te, Abyipaama Khazing kha ama maw:
Vya kaa tie ung, Vya zang tluo aa tla lipa saata zaw, Zang tluo namaa tla lina khana ica patluo sa'a yi. “Nama'a luo na maa vaw; tahematapakieca nama ca Abyipama Khazing tana na cuo.
Hmisi ta ca, tluothlue zaw hne, tluocung lie abiena zaw khiy dungna tana ama cuo. Abyipama Khazing chunglie hmisi ta hringna dyina, Israel khuona ta a cuo.

“Cuorasala ma mingchingmingvuo tie ta ama za hriepa bangkhuo, ama sahring zaw, ama tuv zaw, ama sacanung ama sacapaa tie zaw kha nangzaa a chiypa hmang khata mingnuta ma za cuo baataa khata a za ning a za baa diy tli yi.

Ma nangzaana chunglie hing laa ung sala, maa dang lina khata malie buvkhung se; tahematapakieca kiema, mingnuta ma za cuo baataata ataning tepa hingta, kiema hne ma mingchingmingvuo tie ta Abyipama Khazing cunglie kha sue pate, Abyipama Khazing ueryi kha za ziy vapuv,” nama ta.
Abyipata, Vya Israel, na vya kaa pata a cuo kieca, kama'a luo na vya kaa pata a cuo kieca, i hmiekunglie hing duvsamakhie naa chiyna kha thuse cate, naa cahang li kieca,
“Abyipaa hringpa haa hingta,” biehmisipa, biedangpa, hne adangna chunglie kha chie naa sa kieca, mingphang zaw ca ama thueta thluechiypa ta cuo'a yi te, ama thueta amaa pale aa.
Tahematapakieca Abyipata Judah cawsaa tie hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie kyihuo khata; Ciy nama cyi linapa nama'a lyi kha pali ung la, ahling hrawlie kha saciy vaa khah ung.

Abyipa'a lie kha vangdaw a te tie ung, nama pathiypalung vangdaw kha te tie ung, Vya Judah cawsaa tie hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie, caacuolikieca nama tuepa pha lina kawlie khata, i hihaana kha myi haata pya'a te, pache khu a aw lina te ta a kuo aa.
Judah hne Jerusalem lie kha pathyi sa tie ung: Ruo ting lie kha hmyakaa tung ung la; khuosa ta khi ung la, “A hmya pakhaw ung la, dungkhuopa khypuv chungluo kha vaa'a ung puv!” ta tie ung.
Zion luo pamangsana tung kha bang tie ung, namaa bangna riypata haasaa li pata a ruo tie ung, tahematapakieca kama ta pha lina hne rana kha, chaluo taata i za patlung sa.
Chingde ca ruocuo hraw taata vya pya te, mingphang zaw a paratuv ca aa vya tha tli; Ama ca na ruo kha parue riypata, a awna hmang taa khata pya te, na khypuv tie ca khy a sapa aw li pata ama ra aa.
Capa kawlie ca ta buri kha a buv la, a ngiy la caa tie: A ie ta a iepa Abyipahihaana ca kiema'a taata malie piese valie,” ta tie ung.
Capa ning lie ca Abyipata, siepahruo hne byi tie ca ama palung a ra aa; tluobyi tie kha ama kharue haa'a te profet tie kha ama nang a uo aa, a ta.
Cakhutaata kama ta, “Ah, Abyipa Khazing, tuokhaatama hingpa cawsaa tie hne Jerusalem ca zueziy kha ama rawkariy lie a aw nguoluopa puv ta, ‘Diena nama hmung aa,’ ta yi cate na dung karue yi?” i ta.

Capa cuo lie ca hingpa cawsaa tie hne Jerusalem kyihuo khata: A lingpa thliy ca aa suopa utlaw taa khata ruocaa chunglie a siypasapa i cawsaa tie'a luo kha aa vya hruo, suo zi riypa hne pathe sa riypata ca cuo vyi.
Capa cuota ca a cahra laalawpa thliy tana a cuo. Ata lie iema a du pata bieripana a tuepa ca kama tana i cuo.
Mang tie, amyi haa tana a kya kiethaw, aa ruole ca thliysung na a lu; aa ruo zaw ca hmungthlu laata ama catli vie, bawchie ciemuopa tana ma cuo, tahematapakieca para pata na ma cuo!
Vya Jerusalem, khuo pata na cuo riypata, a pha lipa na pathiypalung kha a pathe la pasiy tie,
Tahematapakieca Dan taata pathyisa pata cuo te, Efraim Tluo taa tana rana pathyisa pata a cuo.
Mingphang zaw kyihuo khata, “Iema ca hingpa lie hingna ama aw!” ta tie ung. Jerusalem rana ca pathyisa tie ung, “A cadungtuv tie ca luohlaa ruo taata a vaw yi te, Judah khypuv tie kha ama khisue.
Iema ta lu a huopa tie haa khata, ama kha ama cadung diy, tahematapakieca ama ca kama khana inaa du, Abyipata a ta.
Na awzya hne na tuepa na, hingpa hing nama'a luo a vya tlungkhyi yi. Hingpa hingna nama duotena ta a cuo; kha tluv tama a kha! kha tluv tama na pathiypalung aca khe.”

Vya i pathiy, vya i pathiy! A pasa tuv pata na aa camaa dyi i camaa! I palung na a pasa hringhruo! I palung aa cathlu ta a cathlu te, a dieta tah aw khu va ang; tahematapakieca rie pahluna ueryi, hmyakaa tungna ueryi na i thyi.
Rana kha rana ta a vya paziy paluo, ruo yalya tana a ra tli. Sungkhabala ta i thluodaa zaw ca para pata a cuo, i pangzu zaw ca sungkha ta a ra.
Khacuo te ma pangtaa kha hmung pari'a angte, hmyakaa ueryi ca i thyi pari aa?

“Tahematapakieca i cawsaa zaw ca ama ngaasa, kama kha na pachang va yi; Iema ca a ngaapa saata zaw ta cuo yi te, pachangna hnyi va yi. Hmang pha lipa tue kha thesa yi te, cuorasala hmang phapa tue ca pachang va yi,” a ta.
Alyi luo kha i mang, a rapa a hripa ta a cuo; cakhutaata avuo luo mang angte, khena kha hnyi vyi.
Tluo cung luo kha i mang ca a siy patlaw yi te, tluothlue zaw ca amaa cahang patlaw.
Hmiehmie i pase ca pavaa zaw kha a zu diy yi te, sakha hmuo aw va tli.
Sa a vyisapa ruo ca ruocaapa ta aa li, Abyipahmiekunglie, a ie ta a iepa a hihaana hmiekunglie kha, a khypuv bangkhuo ca a ra diy tli.
Tahematapakieca Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Ruo bangkhuo hing a duothling aa; cuorasala a chuona ta ca cuo'a valie.
Hingpa kawlie hingta alyi ca a ngiy'a te, cungluo avuo ca ama vaw diy aa; Tahematapakieca i ri tlipa haata hne i ting tlipa haata; a ngiepachiy li'apa angta, a pali pakhaa'a va ang.

Aruo rieka tie hne liy ka a thepa tie puraa nakawta, khy ting ta amaa ruo diy tli; ruohraw luo kha a nu yi te, lungkuo luo kha ama kie. Khy ting kha a ruose pata cuo te, a chunglie pakha hmuo aw va yi.

Vya nama, a duothlingpa, caw a sedungpa kha a tue cate, siy a tue cate naa pangi, na ming kha siyy thuv cate naa paku viepa hing khaapa na khingna tama a cuo? Naa pangi naa pasuopa ca a hripa tana a cuo, na khingpa tie khata ca duvsa yi te, aca thie khing yi.

Nupazi pasana a angpa canung a khipa haapa ueryi kha i thyi, Zion sacanung ta a huv pa-y te, a kuv paza te a khipa kha i thyi, “Kama ca bawchie ciemuopa tana i cuo! Cawsaa a thiepa tie hmiekunglie ca i cuonapa he hmuo aw va tli,” a ta.

Jerusalem khychung luopuv mekaa luo kha, vaa ruole ung la, mangle tie ung! Khypuv ahmyana hmang lie kha biedangpa lie a hringpa pakha chuo, hmung khu ung cate, biehmisipa a huvpa pakha chuo nama hmung khu kieca, Jerusalem kha i ngiethe aa.
“Abyipaa hringpa haata,” ama ta raalaa pata, a pali a pahnaa ta chie amaa sa.

Vya Abyipa, na ming na biehmisipa a huv cuo va ma? Nama ta na tuv yi, cuorasala ama ze pyi vyi; nama ta na pasiy na pa-ya yi, cuorasala a pare hlyi va yi. Ama hmie ca alung laata cuo vie te, vya kaa riypa kha khing va yi.
Cakhutaata kama ta, “Iema ca a siypasapa selaw tana ama cuo, ruena hnyi va yi; tahematapakieca iema ta Abyipaluopuv kha pachang va yi, Khazing phungbie kha.

A hnyirungpa tie'a luo kha vaa ang sala, bie va chang'a yi ang; iema ca Abyipaluopuv kha ama pachang hrahring aa, ama Khazing phungbie kha,” i ta. Cuorasala iema bangkhuo ca ama syihnaa kha chi yi te, a patuvnapa kha ama para.

Caacuonakawta atuv lie chingde ta iema kha thie'a yi te, ruocaapa lie cahnie ta iema kha a para'a yi. Kyiching ta ama khypuv tie kha a bawkhuo te, a pyapa mekaa ca a caphipatlaa diy'a yi. Tahematapakieca ama tuesuena ca hluvsa te, zangna taata a lesa ta ama sichie.

Tuokhaatama icaa ngiethe khu aa? Na saata zaw ta na thaw yi te, khazing a cuo lipa tie ming khata chie amaa sa. Ama riy bi pata sa i pi tiy yi ta, nungvaathingsuena kha tue yi te, siyhrawnung ing luo kha ama vaa pari.
A la a pahuosa pata pipa laatungpa haata, ama ingpaa napuv kha hie ama tlie.
Hingpa hmang kawlie hingta iema kha duo te'a va yi ang ma? Abyipata a ta; cakhutaata hing haapa mingphang cunglie hing, ruvnaana ta thung'a va yi ang ma?
Ama mingsuv diedung kha cahraw ung la para tie ung, cuorasala a chuona ca pacuo sa khah vie; a ce kha sa pachung diy tie ung, tahematapakieca Abyipahuopa ta cuo va yi.
Israel ingchungkhue hne Judah ingchungkhue ca, i cuota zang tluo a tla hrahring va yi, Abyipata a ta.
Abyipacunglie kha suena bie ri yi te, “Ama ca khaapahmuo tue'a vyi. Pha lina khaapahmuo ma cunglie tlung'a vyi, ama ta zueziy hne cakuotlungna zaw kha hmung'a vyi,” ama ta.
Profet tie ca khaapatahmuo cuo va yi, thliy tana ama cuo, tahematapakieca ama chunglie bie aw vyi. Ama ripa haa tana ama cunglie tue pata a cuo aa!
Caacuonakawta Abyipa, Cungnungce Khazing ta hing haa hingta a ri:

Vya Israel ingchungkhue, luohlaapuv taa tana mingphang phang kha kha, nama'a luo i vya tlungkhyi aa, Abyipata a ta. Capa ca mingphang cahrapa, hluo ning taata zaa aw tlipa, ama ryi na thyi lipa mingphang, ama ripa na thyi the lipa mingphang ta a cuo aa.
Ama lavaabya ca aa pahawpa thluo haata cuo te, iema bangkhuo ca a riephapa rieka haata ama cuo.

Iema ta kung na pavyipa hne na sa kha ama ning diy aa; na sacapaa hne na sacanung kha ama ning diy aa; na sahring hne na tuv zaw kha ama ning diy aa; na mingsuvtiy hne na thyikuv kung zaw kha ama ning diy aa; naa ringchuopa dungkhuo a hnyipa na khypuv tie kha, zueziy ta ama para diy aa.
Cuorasala capa cuo lie zaw ca ta, na cuota a chuona ning cuo'a valie, Abyipa ta a ta.

Cakhutaata na cawsaa tie ta, “Khaapanakawma Abyipama Khazing ta hingpa hmang zaw hing ma cunglieta a tue?” ama ta tiyta, nama ta iema kyihuo khata, “Niema ta kama kha ina thawpa haa ung hing cata nama ruo a cuo lipa ruo lie ruohrang ming re kha nama hrie aa,” na ta'a yi.
Hingpa hing Jakob ingchungkhue lie hne, Judah ingchungkhue lie kha pathyisa tie:
Vya a ngaapa hne ruena a hnyi lipa cawsaa zaw, hingpa hing thyi tie ung, ming hnyi ung cate, a hmung lipa tie, naa hnyi ung cate, a thyi lipa tie tana nama cuo.

Kama kha na ciy va ung ca ma? Abyipata a ta; I hmiekunglie hing a cathang va ung ca ma? Kama ta viehnang kha riyliy cuota a ruoriy riypa hne, a law khu buo li riypata i chi; tiylaw a hrung te vya pachi ra sala law pata a zu pakhung khu va yi.
Cuorasala hingpa cawsaa tie ca ama palung le te a du ama hmuo; a pali yi te luohlaa luo amaa ruo.
Ama pathiypalung chunglie kha, “Ama hne a cuota lie khytiy malie pi te, cuovuo khytiy hne suepuv khytiy malie a pipa, sa lana cuo malie a pipa, Abyipama Khazing kha ciy ung siy,” ta va yi.
Nama suena ta capa zaw ca a pali a pahnaa ta tue te, a phapa kha niema'a taata a phe.
Tahematapakieca cawsaa chiepa zaw na i cawsaa tie hrawlie hing a aw yi; iema ca na a hrangpa tie chechiy kha a lapa yi. Pavaa a patuvpa tie haata cyihyi kha thla yi te, cawsaa kha ama pa-uo.
Pavaa ing ca pavaa ta a bipa haata, ama ing ca hanghiena ta a bi; caacuonakawta khuopuv ta vya hnyirung yi te,
thu yi te ama tluesiyliy. Pha lina tue kha taw pachang lipa yi ta; biedangpa ta biechipana tue va yi. Haaraa ta kha-aw ama taw the riypata, riethyivuosuopa tie cuvu kha a daakhyi va yi.
Hingpa hmang zaw kawlie hingta iema kha duote'a va yi ang ma? Cakhutaata hing haapa mingphang cunglie hing, ruvnaana ta thung'a va yi ang ma? Abyipata a ta.
Ciy aa chiy hringhruopa hne a pha li hringhruopa hmang na, ruo chunglie a tlung:
Profet tie ta hang pata bie phu yi te, tluobyi tie ta profet tie ripa haata ama uv; capa ca i cawsaa zaw ta ama tlechuozya ta a cuo, cuorasala a chuona cuo aa vaw tiyta tuokhaatama namaa tue aa?

Vya Benjamin saata zaw, abangna hmung riypata, Jerusalem taa hingta a ruo tie ung! Tekoa lie kha hmyakaa tung ung la, Beth-hakkerem lie kha pangtaa pathlie tie ung; tahematapakieca chaluo taa tana, pha lina hne parana lepuv kha a zaa luole nguoluo.
Zion sacanung ca khing aa chiysapa ruopanuta hne tana i pakhingpuo.
Tuvkhietuv tie kha ama tuvrung hneta a vaw'a yi te, ama cahriylie kha ama thluodaa zaw ca ama sa aa; ama awna hmang bangkhuo lie kha ama sahring ca ama pathlie.
“Ama a du riypa khata a ting tie ung; thu ung la, ningchung ta tuv'a ung puv!” “Bawchie ciemuopa tana ma cuo, tahematapakieca ning na a maa tli, zuoluo ningdiy zaw na a syi tli yi!”
“Thu tie ung, zuo ta tuv'a ung puv, cakhutaata ama siepahruo ing zaw kha para'a ung puv!”

Tahematapakieca Cungnungce Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: A thingkung zaw kha hu ung la; Jerusalem ca a duna riekhuocaaca kha sasue tie ung. Duote riypa khypuv suokha tana a cuo; a chunglie ca hrisaanapa selaw tana a cuo.

Takhue ta tiy thaapa a papya paripa haata, hingpa khy hingta a pha lina kha a pathaa pari; a chunglieta a tuv a thiena hne parana ca thyi pata cuo te, pasana hne hmaaphyana ca a hmiekunglieta a aw pari.
Vya Jerusalem, a raaring tie, caacuolikieca ica duvsa aa, caa palise'a angte, a duothlingpa ruo hne cawsaa khysa lina ruo tana ica tue aa.
Cungnungce Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Aa ngaapa Israel ming kha, mingsuv mang thang khata thang tie yi; mingsuv thyi a lupa haa khata, na kuv khata a ce zaw kha pazale pakhaa tie.

Ina thyi the riypa yi ta, ahung kha ma bie chang'a angte a raaringna i pi aa? Mang tie, ama naa ca a paping yi te, naathlie va yi. Abyipabie ca iema cuota tue hyalya riypata cuo te, tlechuo the va yi.

Cuorasala kama ca Abyipahihaana kha i chunglie bi te, i chunglieta a chi he chi khu va tli ang. I hihaana ca luopuv chunglie haatiy zaw cung luo kha lyisue la, aa hmya nguoluopa mingnu tie cung luo zaw kha lyisue tie; nung hne vaa zaw cuo yi se, kung hluvsapa nungpuv macuo zaw kha byapuo pata ama cuo aa.
Ama ing zaw ca cawsaa hrangpa tie kha pi pata cuo'a yi te, ama lu hne ama napuv zaw pi pata ama cuo aa; tahematapakieca ruo chunglieta khy a sapa tie kha a du pata na i kuv i pazuo aa, Abyipata a ta.
Iema ca a caw cepa taata a le cepa te ta, ama mekaa ta ama karuo aw te, profet taata tluobyi te ta, ama mekaa ta ama hang the.
Diena a aw li ning kha, “Diena, diena,” ta yi te, I cawsaa tie ama hmaa kha a cuo li pata ama tuepa.

Nangzaa aa chiysa pata aw yi te, duvsamakhiepa kha ama tue; cuorasala ama nang zaa li pata, hmiechi tapa kha pachang va yi. Caacuonakawta iema ca aa liepa tie hrawlie kha amaa lie ra aa; duo i te ningpa yi ca amaa vaapatyi aa, Abyipata a ta.

Cakhutaata Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Luo atawna lie kha a daa ung la, mang ung la, hluoning luopuv kha hiehriy tie ung, luopuv phapa ta a cuopa kha ziy ung la, nama thlaapa cuota a pahyna kha hmung tie ung, a ta. Cuorasala iema ta, “Ziy'a vapuv,” ama ta.
Rievetuv tie zaw kha ica chipa yi: “Hmyakaa pu kha naathlie tie ung!” a ta. Cuorasala iema ta, “Naathlie'a vapuv,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Vya mingphang zaw, thyi tie ung, Vya mingphang zaw, iema cunglie khaapa hmang ma a tlung aa tapa kha pachang tie ung.
Vya alyi, thyi tie; hingpa cawsaa tie cunglie hing, iema khuekhuona thyipaa ta a cuopa rana na i patlung sa aa, tahematapakieca iema ca i bie kha naathlie va yi; i pacuvna zaw kha ama thaw.
Sheba'a taata a vawpa rangpa-ue tie hne, luohlaa taata a vawpa pasuv thlungpa tie ca khaapama i tuena aa? Nama myirue panaana ca cuhluo the'a va ang, nama hriykhungrina ta i palung na patluo vyi.
Caacuonakawta Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa cawsaa zaw hmiekunglie hing a pachiyna riypa kha chikhuo'a yi angte, nungpaa hne saata zaw, ingpaa hne viesaa zaw kha suv kha ta ama ra hne aa.
Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Mang tie, chaluo ruo taa tana mingphang phang kha amaa zuv, mingphang lepa phang kha na aa hla cenapa ruo taata zaa thubung yi.

Liy hne asyi kha amaa cyi, a pyathupa ta cuo yi te, nangduena hnyi va yi, ama puraa ca riyliy tiylaw pu na a lu; aruo kha a khang yi te, rie a tuv riypa rieka tie amaa pachiepa haa khata amaa pachie, Vya Zion sacanung, nama kha a du riypata!
Kiema ta capa thuohlaa ca thyi pate, ma kuv ca thaazuo hnyi vyi; nu ta a pazipa canung pasana a angpa haata, khuosa ta pasana ta malie a tlung.
Lu luo si riypata pya khah ung, luopuv lie zaw a khie khah ung; tahematapakieca carie ca zueziy hnyi te, ciy aa chiy hringhruopa na malie a cadung,” a ta.

Vya a bawchiepa i cawsaa, buri kha a hryi la, buvcuo lie kha a pahlang tie; pakha dyipa sacapaa thiy te ama caapa haata khuosa ta caa tie; tahematapakieca paratuv ca kiema cung luo kha sungkha ta aa vaw aa.
Kama ta nama ca i cawsaa zaw hrawlie kha, dyapasya pata ama luopuv a pachang riypata, dyapasyatuv hne pathesatuv ta ica tue.
Iema bangkhuo ca a palung lepa hne a du a hmuopa, malie kawchie a rituv ta ama cuo; daa hne thaa ta cuo yi te, iema bangkhuo ca a pha lipa dyina ama tue.
Sumyi ta khuosa ta a zi, kawthuv ca myi ta a ning diy tli; pathesana ca a thlahnena aw vyi, tahematapakieca a pha lipa tie kha papya khu vyi.
Iema ca, “Thawpa daa,” ta pata ama cuo, tahematapakieca Abyipana a thaw yi.
Abyipa'a taata Jeremiah'a luo a zuvpa bie:
Abyipaing thlake lie kha a daa la, capa lie ca, Abyipaabie riypata hingpa thlake luo a ngiepa Judah ming bangkhuo ta Abyipabie hing naathlie tie ung, ta pata pathyisa tie.
Cungnungce AbyipaIsrael Khazing ta hing haa hingta a ri: Nama luopuv hne nama tuepa kha a pare ung la, hingpa hmang lie hing niema hneta aw ang se.
Hingpa dung a hmuopa bie, “Hingpa hing ca Abyipabiena-ing, Abyipabiena-ing, Abyipabiena-ing,” tapa bie hing zang khah ung.
Nama luopuv hne nama tuepa hing namaa pare hmisi kieca, pakha hne pakha hing biedangpa lie nama hring kieca,

ruohrang ming, haaraa, nunghlyi tapa tie hing nama hrisaa li kieca, acuolikie hingpa lie hing a sue lipa tie thiy nama palang li kieca, niema pasa angna riypata khazing hrangpa tie hnang kha nama ziy li kieca,
hluo ning nama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lieta chuozaa cuota i za pipa yi, hingpa hmang lie hing niema hneta i aw aa.
Niema ta, a thlahnena a aw lipa dungviena bie hing namaa ringchuo.
Niema ca nama paruv, cawsaa nama thie, nungvaathingsuena nama tue, nama hangpa ta chie namaa sa, Baal kha hriykhungrina nama pihluo,

nama pachang lipa khazing tie hnang kha nama ziy, cakhutaata i ming ta kupa hingpa ing chung luo hing a vaw pata, i hmiekunglie kha a daa ung cate, hingpa duvsamakhiepa bangkhuo hing tue pazue riypata “Maa bang thluo,” nama ta.
Hingpa ing kama ming ta kupa ing hing, i hmungna lie ma aparuvpa tie khue ta aa li aa? Kama zaw ica mang nguoluo yi, Abyipata a ta.
I ming i za pa-aw sa taanapa Shiloh lie a awpa kama awna hmang luo kha vaa ung la, i cawsaa Israel ming pha lina kawlieta khapa hmang kha tuokhaatama i tue tapa kha va mang tie ung.
Ata hing ca Abyipata, hingpa bangkhuo hing nama tue nakawta cuose, niema'a lie kha ci li pata bie i ri tiyta naathlie lipa ung cata, ica ku tiy yi ta ina chaw li nakaw ung cata,
niema ta namaa ringchuopa ing, i ming ta kupa ing, hne niema hne nama mingchingmingvuo tie ica pipa yi hmang kha Shiloh i tuepa haa kha tana i tue aa.
Cakhutaata kama ta Efraim samingsahlaa bangkhuo ta a cuopa nama tieriy bangkhuo haa khata niema ca i hmiekung taa hingta ica thaw'a yi.
Nama ta hingpa cawsaa tie cuo hingta thlaachuo khah, iema cuopa hingta thlaachuo pata kya khi khah, kama kha paa na kie khah, tahematapakieca ca naathlie'a va ang.
Judah khy zaw lie hne Jerusalem luopuv zaw lieta khaapama ama tue tapa kha hmung va ca ma?

Haatiy tie ta thing ama pakhaw, paa tie ta myi ama patiy, nung tie ta viedie kha naw yi te, vuoruo siepahruonung cuota viechuo ama tue; cakhutaata khazing hrangpa tie'a luo kha dangpa ta panaana pihluo yi te i hi ina pahaa yi.
Ama hi a pahaapa ca kama tama i cuo? Abyipata a ta. Iema pasa angna riypata iema na a tue yi cuo va ma?

Caacuonakawta AbyipaKhazing ta hing haa hingta a ri: I hihaana ca hingpa zaw cunglie hing lyi pata a cuo aa, cawsaa hne sahring cunglie, ruocaapa lie thingkung hne alyi thyipaa zaw cunglie, capa ca ta kuo'a yi te pache khu aw'a vyi.
Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Nama hriykhungrina lie kha myirue panaana pihluo chiy vie ung la a saa kha ce tie ung.
Tahematapakieca nama mingchingmingvuo tie Izipt ruo taata i pyakhyi ning yi kha, myirue panaana hne hriykhungrina kaw hne aa patuv pata bie za pi va yi ang.

Cuorasala hingpa bie hing i pi yi, “I bie hing naathlie ung la nama Khazing ta i cuo aa, niema zaw kama cawsaa ta nama cuo aa; kama ta naw ica pipa yi luopuv dyi kha ziy'a ung cate, niema cuota a pha aa,” i ta yi.
Cuorasala ri a ngie lipa yi ta naathlie va yi, a pha lipa iema khingna hne palunglena chunglie kha iema ruena ta ama si, hmieluo mang cuopa ta hnangluo kha ama mang.
Izipt ruo taata nama mingchingmingvuo tie ama pya taata ataning tepa hingta, i changtaapa profet tie kha taw li pata ning kha hnang ning kha iema'a luo i pathlie yi;
cuorasala na naathlie va yi, siysaa na ri lipa yi ta ama ruetung kha a pacu yi te, ama mingchingmingvuo tie tuepa laata a chie viepa kha ama tue.
Caacuonakawta hingpa bie bangkhuo hing iema'a lieta na ri aa, cuorasala iema ta ca naathlie'a va yi. Nama ta na u'a yi, cuorasala ca palie'a va yi.
Nama ta iema kyihuo khata: Hingpa hingna Abyipaama Khazing bie a ziy lipa mingphang ta a cuo yi, pasiypa-yana kha ziy lipa yi ta, biehmisipa kha a ra, ama hmyataw taata thaw pata na a cuo tli.
Na suo kha a ngu la thaw tie; aa suona ruo utlawpa lie kha caa tie, tahematapakieca Abyipana a hi a pahaapa mingphang kha a thaw tli yi.
Tahematapakieca Judah cawsaa tie na i hmungna lie kha a pha lipa a tue yi, Abyipata a ta. Iema huopa duvsamakhie aa chiypa kha i ming ta kupa ing chunglie kha chi yi te ama papyapalyi tli.

Cakhutaata Hinnom sacapaa bawphie lie kha ama sacapaa hne ama sacanung zaw myi ta ruena riypata Tofeth khahrungtluobu kha ama sa, capa ca i palung lie zaw a puv lipa hne tue riypata bie i pi lipa yi tana a cuo.

Caacuonakawta Abyipata, capa hmang ca Tofeth acuolikie Hinnom sacapaa bawphie ta pata kupa cuo li tli'a pata, Thiena bawphie ta pata kupa a cuona riypa cuo ca a vya tlung hmisi tli a ta, tahematapakieca Tofeth lie khana aa tlaw lina te ta amaa paby aa.
Hingpa cawsaa tie ama riyy ca pavaa zaw ama sa ta cuo'a te, alyi lie a awpa saruopa zaw ama sa ta a cuo aa; ahungtahmuo a cade'a va yi.

Cakhutaata Judah khypuv zaw lie hne Jerusalem luopuv zaw lie kha nungchiytuv satlie hne vaahnyituv lesaa thaaphana hne alawna ueryi kha i pachuo sa aa; tahematapakieca ruo ca a duothlingpa ta aa li aa.
Capa cuo lie ca, Judah siepahruo tie ruv, byi tie ruv, tluobyi tie ruv, profet tie ruv hne Jerusalem lie khy ming ruv zaw ca ama thluo taata thue pata a cuo aa, Abyipata a ta.

Iema ca ama duepa hne a re ama hriepa, a hnang ama ziypa, za huv yi te amaa zaa biepa, ning hne thlaapa hne vuoruo lie a awpa tie bangkhuo hmiekunglie kha cadaapatlaa pata ama cuo aa, pahmyapa hne paby pata cuo'a va yi, alyi lie ii haa kha tana ama cuo thluo aa.
Hingpa aa ngaapa, a pha lipa mingphang tie hingta iema i cadenapa yi hmang bangkhuo lie kha hringpa laata thiypa kha ama khing vie aa, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.
Iema kyihuo khata, Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri ta tie ung: Cawsaa kha amaa lie tiyta, thu pakhaa va yi ma? Luo ama vie tiyta vya kaa pakhaa va yi ma?
Khaapanakawma hingpa mingphang tie hingta chuozaa ta ama sichie thluo aa? Dungviena kha a cusa pata a patuv yi te, vya kaa khing va yi.

A phasa pata i naathlie yi, cuorasala adangna hneta bie ri va yi; “Khaapama i tue!” ta pata ama pha lina kha ahungtahmuo a ngiepachiy va yi. Rietuvna chung luo aruotungpa aa ngielepa haa khata, ama bangkhuo ta iema khingna luo kha ama pie diy.

Avuo lie a zupa aathlaruo khiy hmuo, ama aa ri cuo kha pachang te, thuvruv, chiyvie, hne tiypavaa zaw ta iema hne ama kie cuota kha ama pachang; cuorasala i cawsaa zaw ca Abyipaziyphung kha pachang va yi.
Tuokhaatama niema ta, “Kiema ca ma sing, Abyipaphungluo kha ma chunglie a aw,” nama ta the? Caa cape a thepa tie hangna caasung na hangna kha a cape.
A singpa tie kha nang pazaa pata ama cuo aa, iema ca pachiypahuopa hne sikhyi pata ama cuo aa; tahematapakieca Abyipabie khana ama thaw, ama chunglie a awpa ca tuokhaapa singna ma a cuo?

Caacuonakawta ama napuv kha cawsaa hrangpa tie pi'a yi angte, ama lu kha malie i pi'a yi, tahematapakieca a caw cepa taata a le cepa te ta, aa dang li pata hmungna lie khana ama karuo a awsa diy; profet taata tluobyi tie bangkhuo te khata cawsaa ama dung.
Diena a aw li ning kha, “Diena, diena,” ta yi te, i cawsaa tie ama hmaa kha a cuo li pata ama tuepa.

Nangzaa aa chiysa pata aw yi te, duvsamakhiepa kha ama tue, cuorasala ama nang zaa li pata, hmiechi tapa kha pachang va yi. Caacuonakawta iema ca aa liepa tie hrawlie kha ama lie ra aa; duo i te ningpa yi ca amaa vaapatyi aa, Abyipata a ta.
Abyipata, iema kha i pahmya khing tiy yi ta, mingsuv kung cunglie mingsuv thyi aw vyi, thyikuv kung cunglieta thyikuv aw vyi; a hnaa kha hmuo a uv diy te, i pipa yi kha iema'a lieta aw va tli.

Khaapanakawma ata tepa hingta amaa tu? A hmya tie ung, dungkhuo a hnyipa khypuv zaw luo kha cakuo ung sala, capa lie ca va thiy'a ung puv; Abyipaima Khazing na kiema kha thiy riypata duo malie a te, cakhutaata ca-ie thlapa tiy kha dang riypata malie a pi, tahematapakieca Abyipa'a lie khana ma sue tli.
Diena kha ma huv, cuorasala phana kha hmung vapuv, patluosana cuo lie kha, ciy aa chiy hringhruopa maa taw pali.

Dan taata amaa ruo ta a hnaa a tungpa pu kha aa thyi; amaa ruotungpa paruo pata a khina pu ta ruo kha a cahang. Iema kha a vaw yi te, ruo hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo kha ama paluo diy, khypuv hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo kha ama paluo diy.
Mang tie ung, pariy kha nama hraw luo ca vya pathliesue yi angte, pacuo khu a cuo lipa a ca-ie ruvsapa pariy kha ca pathliesue yi angte, niema kha aca daw'a yi, Abyipata a ta.
I palungtluona khana a vie, ngiechina na i cunglie a tlung, i palung na a rasa.

Naathlie tie ung, ruo luohlaa lie a awpa i cawsaa zaw khina ca: “Abyipaca Zion lieta aw va ma? a chunglieta Siepahruo aw va ma?” ama ta. (“Khaapanakawma ama kuvtuezuv hne ama ruohrang khazing ta i hihaana ina ri yi?”)
“Sa hriena cuo ca a khung tli, cuovuo cuo kha a chuo tli, cadyiseca kiema ca khuo pata cuo vapuv,” ama ta.
Tahematapakieca i cawsaa kha pasa ama ang tiyta, kama kha i pasa, caa angte, ciyna ta ina patuv.
Gilead lieta tluona siyy aw va ma? Capa lie ca siyybyi pakha chuo aw va ma? Khaapanakawma i cawsaa zaw hing patluo sa pakhaa pata ama cuo va?
Ama thiepa i cawsaa zaw cuo khata chung hne zuo ta i caa khu riypata, i luv hing takhue cuo sala, i ming hing mingthliy tiyhnaa ta cuo se tapa na i khing hringhruo!

I cawsaa zaw kha thuse pata, iema'a taata luohlaa luo si riypata, ruocaapa chunglie khiy khy a tlawpa tie tlungna riypa hmang, hnyi ang sala na i khing hringhruo! Tahematapakieca iema bangkhuo ca nungvaathingsuena a tuepa ta cuo yi te, biekuo a pathlipa phuv tana ama cuo.

Ama palyi kha liy haata a kyi yi te, hangna ruo lie kha ama lethaw, biehmisipa cuo ta cuo va yi; tahematapakieca iema ca pha lina cunglie kha pha lina bechiy yi te, kama kha na pachang va yi, Abyipata a ta.
Nama ingpaa tie kha a raaring ung la, nama tieriy tie kha zang khah ung; tahematapakieca tieriy bangkhuo ca caa dungtuv ta cuo yi te, ingpaa bangkhuo malie kawchie a rituv tana ama cuo.
Iema bangkhuo ta ama ingpaa kha dung yi te, biehmisipa a ripa pakha hmuo aw va yi; ama palyi kha hang riypata pacuv yi te, pha lina kha tue yi te, a ngiepachiy hang va yi.
Hrisaana cunglie hrisaana, dungna cunglie dungna ta aa cha! Kama kha na pachang khing va yi, Abyipata a ta.
Caacuonakawta Cungnungce Abyipa ta hing haa hingta a ri: Kama ta iema kha pathe sa'a yi angte, i dyapasya'a yi, a suepa i cawsaa zaw cuo hingta khaapa chuo ma i tue khu aa?
Ama palyi ca thiyna cuoti ta cuo te, ama pakaa taa khata hangna bie a ri. Ama ingpaa tie'a lie kha a viesaana bie ri yi te, cuorasala ama chunglie ca a bawkhuo riypa khue dyina ama khuo.
Hingpa zaw kawlie hingta duote'a va yi ang ma? Hing haapa mingphang cunglie hing phuvlana tue'a va ang ma? Abyipata a ta.

Tluo zaw cuo khiy ta caa'a angte i ngiy aa, ruocaapa sahring tlena cuo tana i caa aa; tahematapakieca ahungtahmuo cahraw lipa yi ta a duothlingpa ta chipa ama cuo, sahring khipa kha thyi pata cuo vyi; pavaa hne saruopa zaw kha amaa pe diy tli.
Kama ta Jerusalem kha hnehnaw papungnapa hne ruo-uv zaw aa chuonapa khue ta i tue aa; cakhutaata Judah khy tie kha a duothlingpa ta tue'a angte, khy a sapa aw'a va yi.

Capa ca pachang riypata aa depa singna a hnyipa ahungma a aw? Iema ta ama phu khu riypata Abyipata a changpa ahungma a aw? Khaapanakawma ahungtahmuo ama cahrawpaa li riypata ruo ca ruocaapa haata ra te a duothling?
Cakhutaata Abyipata: Tahematapakieca kama ta ama hmiekunglie i chipa phungbie kha ama maw, i ueryi kha naathlie lipa yi ta ziy va yi,
cuorasala palung lesa pata iema khingna kha ziy yi te ama mingchingmingvuo tie pacuvna haata Baal kha ama paziy.
Caacuonakawta Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing ta: Kama ta hingpa cawsaa tie hing ning riypata uocuokhaa kha pi'a yi angte, dang riyta ca-ie pyapa tiy kha i pi'a yi.
Ama mingchingmingvuo tie hne iema ta ama za pachang buo lipa mingphang zaw hraw luo kha i chepatlaa diy'a yi, cakhutaata i para diy hluo li yi ta zueziy kha i pathliesue'a yi, a ta.
Cungnungce Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Pacuo syalya ung la, muochiesa a thepa canung tie kha ku tie ung; muochiesa a thesapa canung tie kha va paku sa tie ung;
a catlisa pata muochie malie sa yi se, ma mingthliy kha lang sala a tlana riypata.
Tahematapakieca caana ueryi ca Zion taata aa thyi, “Kha tluv tama ma ra! Ima nang na a zaa hringhruo, tahematapakieca ruo kha thuse tli pate, ma awna hmang zaw kha ama pacing diy tli.”
Vya canung zaw, Abyipabie kha naathlie tie ung, a pakaa ta a ripa bie kha thyi tie ung; nama sacanung zaw kha muochiesa pacuv ung la, ama ingpaa zaw kha muochiesa ca pacuv yi se.
“Thiyna ca ma thlaluo-aw luo kha aa kya zu, ima ingpuv zaw luo kha a ngie yi te, haatiy zaw kha luopuv lieta thie yi te, mingnu tie kha cawsaa ahmyana hmang lieta ama thie,” a ta.
Ri tie! Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: “Cawsaa riyy ca lu lie kha ii haata ama laa patlaw aa, a uotuv tie hnanglie thuse siypa suopie haa khata, ahungtahmuo pahmya'a va yi,” a ta.
Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: A singpa ta a singna kha ahruo tlekhyi khah se, a thaa a ruvpa ta a thaaruvna kha ahruo tlekhyi khah se, a hnyirungpa ta a hnyirungna kha ahruo tle khyi khah se;

cuorasala ahruo a tlepa ca hingpa lie hing ahruo tle se: Kama ina pachangna lie yi kha. Tahematapakieca kama ca Abyipatana i cuo; Kama ca hingpa chuelyi lie hing aa hmangpa duena, biedangpa, hne adangna kha i tue, tahematapakieca hingpa zaw chunglie hingna i law, Abyipata a ta.
A cuo ca a vya tlung hmisi aa, Abyipata a ta, ama vangdaw dyi a tepa tie kha duo i te tiy yi ta:

Izipt ming, Judah ming, Edom ming, Ammon ming, Moab ming, hne ama luv a pamyipa, viehnangruo lie khy a sapa cawsaa tie bangkhuo kha. Tahematapakieca hingpa mingphang tie bangkhuo ca vangdaw a te va yi, cakhutaata Israel ingchungkhue bangkhuo ca ama pathiypalung vangdaw kha a te va yi.
Vya Israel ingchungkhue, Abyipata nama'a lie a ripa bie kha naathlie tie.

Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Mingphang hrangpa tie hringzya kha a cuv khah ung, acuolikie avuo pamangsana zaw khiy ciysa khah ung; tahematapakieca mingphang hrang tie na khapa zaw kha ca a ciysa yi.
Mingphang hrangpa tie hringzya ca muo hnyi vyi: Atuv chunglie thingkungpa ca hu pata cuo te, kuvzung a thepa ta ahryi ta syi te,
capa ca cawsaa ta siy hne ngu ta ama pangi; cakhutaata aa hnyi khu li riypata, thaariy kha khunglung ta ama khepuo.

Ama kuvtuezuv tie ca paziy lu lie rihuozuv haa khata cuo te, bie ri the va yi. Ama cakuo the li nakawta, phyale amaa hu. Iema kha ciy khah ung, tahematapakieca a pha lipa kha tue khu va yi, a phapa zaw tue khu va yi.
Vya Abyipa, nama haapa ahunghmuo aw va yi; nama ca na lesyi, nama ming ca lesyi te a cahra.
Vya mingphang zaw Siepahruo, ahungma nama kha ca ciy li pata a aw aa? Tahematapakieca naa phuvpa tana a cuo; mingphang zaw hne ama pena zaw lie a sing cepa hmuo, nama haapa aw va yi.
Iema ca ngaa yi te pachangna hnyi va yi; kuvtuezuv pacuvna ca thing laata pha vie vyi!

Ama depa ngu ca Tarshish taata vya phya yi te, siy ca Ufaz taata vya phyapa a cuo. Iema ca kuvzung a thepa tie hne siy a patle thepa tie tuepa ta cuo te, ama cawsie ca a dungpa hne a ciycaapa ta a cuo; a bangkhuo hingta kuvzung a thepa tie tuepa tana a cuo.
Cuorasala Abyipaca Khazing hmisi ta cuo te, ama ca a hringpa Khazing hne chuozaa Siepahruo ta a cuo. A hihaana ta alyi kha cahang te, mingphang zaw ta a hihaana kha ang khu va yi.
Iema kha hing haa hingta chang tie yi: Alyi hne avuo a sa lipa khazing ca avuo raw alyi taa hing tana a ra aa.
Khazing ca a cahrana ta alyi a sapa tana a cuo, a singna ta chuelyi a pacu sa, a pachangna ta avuo khiy a pake.
A ueryi a pathlie tiyta, avuo lieta khytiy puraa aa thyi, alyi dena taata myiching kha a pathu sa. Khytiy huo khata thinghlaa cakang sa te, a chechiy china ing taata thliy kha a papya.

Cawsaa mekaa ca ngaa yi te thesingna hnyi va yi; siy a patlepa bangkhuo ca ama kuvtuezuv ta ama nang a pazaa yi; tahematapakieca ama kuvtuezuv tie ca dungna ta cuo yi te, ama chunglie hringna huv aw vyi.
Iema ca muo a hnyi lipa, dungna re tana ama cuo; iema duotena ning lie kha ama ra aa.
Jakob cuvu ta a cuopa Abyipaca cahaacata cuo vyi, tahematapakieca ama ca hmangting bangkhuo a satuv tana a cuo, Israel ca a ru hne a mingphang tana a cuo; a ming ca Cungnungce Abyipatana a cuo.
Vya hrena chunglie a awpa zaw! Nama hmangbya ca alyi lie kha pahmya tie ung.
Tahematapakieca Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Ata lie hing ca, ruo chunglie khy a sapa bangkhuo hing i pazu patlaa diy'a yi, iema cunglie kha riethyivuosuona patlung sa'a angte, capa ca ama ang aa.
I hmaa kawlie hingta kama ca bawchie ciemuopa tana i cuo, i phyapa hmaa ca a ruv ciemuo. Cuorasala kama ta, “Hmisi ta ripa kieca i ang riypa, duotena tana a cuo,” i ta.

I thluodaa ca phi diypa tana a cuo; a riy zaw ama chipachung diy; i saata zaw ca kama'a taata a ruo diy yi te, iema ca aw va tli yi; i thluodaa a pake pakhaa riypa hne, i pangzu a zu riypa pakha hmuo aw va tli yi.
Tahematapakieca tuvkhietuv tie ca ngaasa yi te, Abyipakha ruena hie va yi; caacuonakawta kha-aw taw va yi, ama tuvrung ca chepatlaa pata a cuo.

Puraa ca naathlie tie, Naathlie tie, aa vawle nguoluo cuv, chaluo ruo taata a paapungna puraa lepa ca. Judah khypuv tie kha a duothlingpa ta tue riypa hne, ruo-uv zaw aa chuona khue ta tue riypata aa vawle nguoluo cuv.
Vya Abyipa, cawsaapa luopuv hing iemata tah amaa tlawpa cuo vyi, iema khing ta kyi ama hliy pata cuo vyi.
Vya Abyipa, kama kha na pasiy na pa-ya tie, cuorasala khaahmuolipa ta ina pacuo sa li riypa cata, na hihaana lie cuo li pata, aa hmuopa panangna ta na pasiy na pa-ya thi tie.

Nama caa pachang lipa mingphang tie hne, na ming caa u lipa mingphang zaw cung luo kha na hihaana ca patle tie, tahematapakieca iema ta Jakob kha ce yi te ama pachuo tli, a awna hmang zaw kha a duothlingpa tana ama tue tli.
Abyipa'ataata Jeremiah'a luo a zuvpa bie:
Hingpa biekuona bie hing naathlie la Judah cawsaa tie hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie'a lie kha ri tie.
Nama ta iema kha, AbyipaIsrael Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa biekuona bie hing a phasa pata a naathlie lipa ca chiesapa tana a cuo aa.

Thaa a tiy ta palangnapa Izipt ruo taata i kya pyakhyi ning yi ta nama mingchingmingvuo tie i za pipa yi bie ca, I bie hing naathlie ung la a bangkhuo hingta ziy tie ung. Cahaacata niema ca i cawsaa ta cuo'a ung cate kama ca nama Khazing ta i cuo aa,

nama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lieta cuehnung hne khyitiy a langnapa ruo na ica pi'a yi i za tapa i biekuo kha i patling sa aa, capa ca ataning nama cupa ruo hing tana a cuo, a ta. Cakhutaata kama ta, “Cahaacata cuo thluo se, Abyipa,” i ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipata kama kyihuo khata: Hingpa bie bangkhuo hing Judah khypuv zaw hne Jerusalem luopuv zaw lie kha pathyisa tie ung: Hingpa biekuona bie zaw hing thyi ung la tue tie ung.
Tahematapakieca nama mingchingmingvuo tie ca Izipt ruo taata i kya pyakhyi yalya yi ta ataning tepa hingta, ‘I ri kha a ngie ung,’ ta pata phung haata a raaringna i pi pari yi.

Cuorasala i ri kha a ngie lipa yi ta, i bie kha naathlie va yi, cawsaa mekaa ta palunglena hneta a pha lipa ama khingna kha ama ziy diy. Caacuonakawta tue riypata bie i pipa yi, hingpa biekuona bie bangkhuo hing ama cunglie i patlung sa, cuorasala tue va yi.
Cakhutaata Abyipata kama kyihuo khata: Judah ming chunglie hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie chungliena a pha lipa khuekhuona a aw.

I bie a naathlie khing lipa, hluo ning ama mingchingmingvuo tie suena luo khana ama kaa; khazing hrangpa tie kha na ama re hrie riypata ama ziy; Israel chungkhue hne Judah chungkhue ca ama mingchingmingvuo tie hneta i za tuepa biekuona khana ama para tli.
Caacuonakawta Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Ama law khu li riypa rana khana ama cunglieta i patlung sa aa; ina u zaw yi ta naathlie'a va yi ang.
Cakhutaata Judah khypuv tie hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie ca iema ta hriykhungrina ama pihluopa tie'a luo kha vaa yi te ama va u aa, cuorasala ruvnaana amaa taw ning kha pacha buo hluo'a va yi.
Tahematapakieca, Vya Judah, na khazing tie ca na khy zaa ta hluv yi te, na nangzaana riypata Baal'a luo hriykhungrina bienatluophie na tuepa tie ca Jerusalem lie luopuv zaa ama ta.
Caacuonakawta nama ca, hingpa cawsaa tie cuo hingta thlaachuo khah, iema cuopa hingta khi pata thlaachuo khah, tahematapakieca ama ruvnaana cuo ningta ina u zaw yi ta naathlie'a va yi ang.
I duepa ta a chiesapa a tue tiyta, i ing chunglie hing khaapa naw ma a hnyi? Bie-akuona hne hriykhungrina saa hingta bieripana hing a pakhuo khu'a ma? Cakhutaata naa lawsa khu'a ma?
Ahluo ta ca Abyipata ca ku te, “Thyi pha a pathyipa olif kung hring diyliypa,” aca ta; cuorasala khuosa ta a hrung'a te myi ta a rue aa, a ce zaw kha myi ta a kuo diy aa.

I hi pahaa riypata Baal'a luo kha panaana pihluo yi te, Israel ingchungkhue hne Judah ingchungkhue ta ama tuepa pha lina kawlieta nama caa lingpa, Cungnungce Abyipata na cunglie a tlung riypa pha lina kha a pathyi sa tli.
Kama naa pachang satuv ca Abyipata cuo te, i pachang; cakhutaata nama ta ama tuepa pha lina tie kha ina pahmung sa ciy.

Cuorasala kama ca thie riypata amaa chiylepa, a nangnepa tuvtaata haa kha tana i cuo. Iema ta kama a du riypata a pha lipa ama tingtuona kha za pachang va ang. “Thingkungpa hing a thyi hne hingta para'a ung puv, a ming kha a thyipa a cuo li tli riypata, a hringpa tie ruo taa hingta hu'a ung pate thaw'a ung puv!” ama ta.
Cuorasala Vya Cungnungce Abyipa, pathiypalung hne ruena zaw hmung diy cate, a dangsa pata bieripana a tuetuv, na thung hriynapa yi kha hmung thi ang se, tahematapakieca i cuona kha nama na ica pi.
Caacuonakawta na hringna caa rawpa, “Abyipaming ta profetbiephu ri'a vaciy, na ri kieca ma kuv tana na thiy aa,” caa tapa Anathoth cawsaa tie hne aa patuv pata Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri.
Cungnungce Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Kama ta iema ca duo i te'a yi; mingnu tie kha zueziy ta ama thiy aa; ama sacapaa hne ama sacanung tie kha cakuo ta ama thiy aa;
iema hrawlieta aa ngaapa tie kha hmuo thuse pata cuo'a va yi. Tahematapakieca iema duotena kung lie khana Anathoth cawsaa tie cunglie kha rana i patlung sa aa.

Vya Abyipanama kha bie ica i tiyta, nama ca naa dang; cuorasala i bie ca na hmiekung luo i vya chiykhyi thluo aa. Khaapanakawma cawsaa pha lipa tie hing ama hlue a tling? Khaapanakawma biekuo a parapa tie kha ama hnyirung hryly?
Nama ta a ling yi cate a thariy ama thla; lethaw yi te a thyi ama pathyi. Ama pakaa hneta ca naa ngie, cuorasala iema pathiypalung hneta ca naa hla.
Vya Abyipa, nama ta ina pachang ciy; na hmung cate ina dyapasya ciy, i pathiypalung ca nama'a lie tana a aw. Thie riypata tuv haata iema kha naa dale yi, thiena ning lie huota a nanang ta na chi yi.

Ruo hing kha cuo te khiy a ngiy'a te ma, aphuv bangkhuo hing kha cuo te amaa uv aa? A chunglie a awpa tie pha lina kawlieta, cawsaa ta, “Ma tuepa kha Khazing ta hmung vyi,” ama ta nakawta, saruopa hne pavaa zaw ca ama chuo mangtli.
Cawsaa hneta a ruo a zue cate na nang a buo kieca, tuokhaatama aruo hneta ca naa zue khu aa? Cakhutaata aa bangsanapa ruo lie kha naa lie kieca, tuokhaatama Jordan ruohraw ca na catung khu aa?
Tahematapakieca na tieriy hne na chungkhue cawsaa hrahring ta aca raw tli yi; na hnang taa tana khuosa ta aca khisue yi; a viesaana bie ama ri zaw ta, iema kha zang khah yi.
I ing kha thuse angte, i ru kha i thawsiy tli; i due hringhruopa khana a carie tie kuv chung luo i pi tli.
I ru ca ruo chunglie a awpa chingde haata a li te, kama kha ina khisue; caacuonakawta i hue.

I ru ta a cuopa i cawsaa zaw ca saa a cepa pavaa ta ama cadungpa, a karuo a awsapa hainaacahnie haa khata cuo yi te i huesa yi. Vaa la, saa a cepa saruopa tie kha pakiy yi la, ama kha ce riypata a vya chiy tie yi.
Tuvkhietuv a hluvpuv na i mingsuv diedung kha a para yi, i cuvu kha chaapuo yi te a ciy diy yi, i tlechuopa i cuvu khana a duothlingpa ruocaapa ta ama tue.
Iema ta a duothlingpa ta ama tue; i hmiekunglie kha caavung te a duothling. Ruo ca a yalya khata a duothling tli, cuorasala ahungtahmuo ama palung lie chi va yi.
Ruocaapa, aa suopa tluo cung utlaw lie kha, paratuv tie ca amaa vawle tli; tahematapakieca Abyipazueziy ta ruo dena taata kuokhaluo ruo dena te khata a para diy; pakha hmuo a bang'a va yi.
Iema ta jungsacuo kha cyi yi te ahling kha ama pahriy, ama nang amaa pabuo raalaa pata a thlahnena aw vyi. Abyipakha a hi a haa nakawta, ama sa lapa ca nangzaa na a chiy aa.

I cawsaa Israel tie'a luo cu riypata i pipa ru kha a parapa i ingpaa pha lipa tie kaw hne aa pazue pata Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Kama ta iema hing ama ruo taata phiepathla'a yi angte, Judah ingchungkhue kha iema hraw taata i phiepathla'a yi.
Iema kha i phiepathla khutaa yi ta, iema kha kawpacuo pakhaa'a yi angte, ama ru hne ama ruo luo kha i vya chiy pakhaa'a yi, ama bangkhuo khata.

Cakhutaata, “Abyipaca a hringpa haata,” iema ta i cawsaa zaw kha Baal ming ta chiesa ama za pacuvpa haa khata, kama ming ta chie a sa pata i cawsaa zaw luopuv kha pathiypalung hmisi ta amaa cuv kieca, i cawsaa zaw hrawlie kha sathaw pata ma cuo aa.
Cuorasala naathlie lipa ca khaapa mingphang a cuo zaw, kama ta a thariy hneta phiepathla'a angte i para aa, Abyipata a ta.
Abyipata hing haa hingta ina ta, “Cakuo la lahaw pahriy kha a calyi la na sesie lie kha a paze tie, cuorasala tiy pa desa'a vaciy.”
Caacuonakawta Abyipabie haa khata lahaw pahriy ca a calyi angte i sesie lie ca i paze.
Cakhutaata Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha a yihningna ta a zuv te,
“Vya cyi cate naa hryi nguoluopa pahriy kha la lah, ata hingta Zufrates cavaa luo kha vaa la, alung hrawlie kha va nu tie,” ina ta.
Caacuonakawta Zufrates luo kha vaa angte, Abyipaina changna haa khata i tue.
Ning hluvpuv khutaa khata Abyipata kama kyihuo khata, “Zufrates luo kha ata hingta vaa la khapa lieta nu riypata bie ica pipa pahriy kha va la tie,” ina ta.
Zufrates luo ca vaa angte, i nunapa lie kha cupuo angte pahriy ca i la. Cuorasala pahriy ca a za ra tli; hmuotluo a tla va tli.
Cakhutaata Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha a zuv pakhaa te:
Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Hing haa hing tana Judah hruotlena hne Jerusalem hruotlena ca i para aa.

Hingpa cawsaa pha lipa, i bie a naathlie khing lipa, palunglena hneta iema khingna luo kha ziy yi te, abie riypata hne a re hrie riypata khazing hrangpa tie hnang a ziypa ca hmuotluo a tla lipa pahriy haa hing tana i para'a yi.

Pahriy ca sesie lieta aa bepuopa haa khata Israel ingchungkhue bangkhuo hne Judah ingchungkhue bangkhuo kha kama cuota a cuopa cawsaa, ming, pathuosana hne rungnaana ta ama cuo riypata kama'a lie kha i pabepuo'a yi, Abyipata a ta; cuorasala iema ta naathlie'a va yi.

Iema'a lie kha hingpa bie hing ri tie: Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Mingsuv ruocuo mekaa kha mingsuvtiy ta pabi pata ama cuo aa. Cakhutaata iema ta nama kyihuo khata, “Mingsuv ruocuo bangkhuo mingsuvtiy ta pabi riypa kha pachang'a va yi ta pata ma malie na rue?” aca ta'a yi.

Cakhutaata nama ta iema kha: Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa ruo lie khy a sapa bangkhuo, David byithude lie a tupa siepahruo tie, tluobyi tie, profet tie, hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa bangkhuo kha i pariy sa diy'a yi.
Cakhutaata nungpaa hne saata tie zaw kha pakha hne pakha khuosa ta amaa pakhaw aa, Abyipata a ta. I para thue yi ca iema cunglie kha ngiechina, diyna hne kawpacuona hnyi'a va ang.
Naathlie ung la thyi tie ung; nama palung le khah se, tahematapakieca Abyipana a ri.

Khy a pazing sa hluo, tluo cunglie a zing hmehmawna lieta nama phyi aa pachiy hluo; khena nama huv nguoluo ning, ama ta khena kha zingna chaasa pata a pali hluo hingta, Abyipanama Khazing ca rungnaana kha pi tie ung.
Cuorasala nama naathlie li kieca, niema hruotlena kawlieta a paruvta tah i caa aa; Abyipatuvrung kha sii ta amaa da nakawta, caa'a angte i mingthliy dyina a tla aa.
Siepahruo hne siepahruonung kyihuo khata, “Nama byilakhuv puvthepa ca nama luv cung taata a tla tli nakawta, aa nena lie kha a tu tie ung,” va ta tie.
Negeb lie khy zaw ca khaa diy pata cuo te, ahungtahmuo pahaw khu va yi; Judah ming bangkhuo ca sii ta a dapa cuo yi te, ama bangkhuo ta sikhyipa ama cuo.
Chaluo ruo taata a zuvpa tie khiy, suo la mang tie yi. Khaapaliema nama aca pipa yi tuvrung, a puvthepa na tuvrung ca a aw?
Na viesaa pha riypata na pacuvpa tie kha, na cunglie uvtuv ta chipa ama cuo tiyta, khaapa bie ma na ri aa? Nu a hnyipa canung nu aa zipa haa kha tana, pasana na ang aa, cuo va ma?
Na palung chunglieta, “Khaapanakawma hingpa hmang hing i cunglie a tlung?” na ta kieca, na pha lina a le tuv nakawta cuo te, naa hning kha ca tawpa yi te, suekhyi pata na cuo.
Ethiopia ming ta ama vang kha ama thle khu'a ma? Kyiching zaw ta a pi kha a thle khu'a ma? Pha lina tue aa zisa tlipa tie zaw ta phana kha tue khu'a va ung ciy.
Savie haa khata ca pazu'a yi angte, ruocaapa taata a vawpa thliy kha ica pahruo sue'a yi.
Hingpa hing na cuvu ta cuo te, ica repa yi nama cuvu tana a cuo, Abyipata a ta, tahematapakieca kama kha na maw ung cate, hangna kha namaa pacaw.
Kama hrahring ta namaa hning kha ca tawpa'a yi angte, nama nangzaana ca hmung pata a cuo aa.

Ruo chung tluothlue zaw cunglieta, duvsamakhie namaa chiyna, nungvaathingsuena nama tuepa hne nama huena, nangzaana hnyi li pata nama siyhrawna bangkhuo kha i hmung diy tli. Vya Jerusalem, bawchie ciemuopa tana na cuo! Khacuo te khiy ma pathe li pata na aw aa?
Khytiy kuona kawlieta Jeremiah'a luo a zuvpa Abyipabie ca:
Judah ca a ngiy te, a thlake zaw ca amaa uv; iema ca a zingna chunglie alyi lie kha laa yi te, Jerusalem caana ueryi ca cung luo a kie.
Aa byi tie ta ama changtaapa tie kha tiy huv riypata ama pathlie, takhue luo kha chiy yi te, tiy hmung va yi, ama bi hri pata ama vya kaa. Ama nang zaa te ama nang a uo, ama luv kha amaa buvkhung,
tahematapakieca alyi ca a pachi diy. Ruo chunglie kha khy a saa li nakawta, lu a thlupa tie ca ama nang uo te, ama luv kha amaa buvkhung.
Aphuv kha a aw li nakawta, sasuv ta hmuo a taata kha ruo lieta a thuse.
Ruo lie aruo zaw ca aa suona utlaw lie kha a daa yi te, ruo-uv haata thliy kha ama saw; ama tlena riypa ruo a aw li nakawta, ama ming ca a zing.
Ma pha lina ta sue malie phaw ra sala, Vya Abyipa, na ming thueta suokhakha chuo hrie thi tie; ma sichiena ca hluvsa te, nama'a lie kha ma suesa tli.
Vya Israel anguopuona, ruvnaana cuo ningta iema a khuotuv, khaapanakawma nama ca ma ruo lie kha khyche haata na cuo aa? Zuo kha dyi a ripa khyche haata na cuo aa?
Khaapanakawma nama ca a nang pa-uopa haata hne, byana a pi khu lipa rieka riephapa haata na cuo aa? Vya Abyipa, nama ca kiema hrawlie na na aw, na ming tana maca ku, malie thaw thi khah!

Hingpa cawsaa tie hne aa pazue pata Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Iema ca a khiepa na ama tlechuosa, ama phyi kha a ang khu va yi; caacuonakawta Abyipata cuhluo va yi, ama pha lina kha a thyi'a te, duo a te'a yi.
Abyipata kama kyihuo khata: Hingpa cawsaa tie cuo hingta thlaachuo khah.
Sa amaa uv zawta, ama khipa kha naathlie'a va yi ang, myirue panaana ina pihluo kie zaw yi ma cuhluo'a va yi ang; cuorasala zueziy, cakuona, hne puvtlung pasana tana i thie diy'a yi.

Cakhutaata kama ta: “Vya AbyipaKhazing! Iema kyihuo khata, ‘Zueziy kha a taw'a va ung ciy, cakuo zaw ca tlungsue'a va yi, cuorasala kama na hingpa hmang lie hing diena hmisipa caa pi'a yi ang,’ a tapa profet na a aw yi,” i ta.

Cakhutaata Abyipata kama kyihuo khata: Profet tie na hang pata profetbiephu kha i ming ta a phu yi; kama ta pathlie va yi ang, naw pi pata bie pari sa ra va yi ang. Iema ta hangna muocuo, profetbiephu kha niema'a lie phu yi te, muo a hnyi lipa hmungdawluna, iema palung chungtaata dungna bie kha a ri yi.

Caacuonakawta kama ta i pathlie li pata, i ming ta profetbiephu ri yi te, “Hingpa ruo luo hing zueziy hne cakuo a vaw'a vyi,” a tapa profet tie hne aa pazue pata Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Capa profet tie ca zueziy hne cakuo tana ama thiy aa.

Cakhutaata profetbiephu ama changpa, cakuo hne zueziy ta a thiepa tie ca Jerusalem luopuv zaw lie kha thaw pata ama cuo aa. Iema, ama napuv, ama sacapaa hne ama sacanung zaw kha a paby riypa aw'a va yi. Tahematapakieca kama na ama pha lina kha ama cunglie a lyisue'a yi ang.
Hingpa bie hing iema kha chang tie yi: I mingthliy ca chung zuo ta lang sala, a pahy khah se, tahematapakieca i sacanung pathepa, i cawsaa ca a kyichina te ta tuvpa cuo te, khuosa tana hmaa a phya.

Ruo chung luo kha i va pya tiyta, mang tie ung, zueziy ta thiepa tie hing! Khypuv chung luo kha i ngie kiema, mang tie ung, sakuo maa yi te a pasapa tie hing! Profet tie hne tluobyi tie ca ama pachang lipa ruo luo kha temaa yi te amaa khie.

Judah ca na thaw karue ma? Zion ca na duvsa tli ma? Khaapanakawma tluona ma hmung khu li tlina te ta malie na tuv? Diena kha ma huv, cuorasala phana hmung vapuv; tluona cuo ning kha ciy aa chiypa maa taw pali.
Vya Abyipa, ma pha lina kha maa pachang, mingchingmingvuo tie pha lina zaw kha ma pachang, tahematapakieca nama'a liena ma sue tli.
Na ming thue khata kiema kha malie thaw thi khah; a rungnaapa na byilakhuv kha pa-uvsathyi li pata aw thi khah; malie a thyi la kiema hneta na biekuona kha pathli thi khah.

Mingphang tie kuvtuezuv tie chungtaata khy a pasaa sa khupa ama aw ma? Avuo khiy ta haw, khy a pasaa sa khu ma? Nama na a cuo ciy cuo va ma, Vya Abyipaima Khazing? Nama na maacaa nguopuo, tahematapakieca hingpa bangkhuo a tuetuv ca nama tana na cuo.
Cakhutaata Abyipata kama kyihuo khata: Moses hne Samuel hmuo i hmiekunglie a daa ra yi sala hingpa cawsaa tie'a luo kha i palung chi khu va ang. I hmungna taa hingta papya yi la cakuo yi se!

Nama kyihuo khata, “Khaapa luo ma ma cakuo aa?” aca ta kie yi ca, iema kyihuo khata: Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Puvtlungna cuota a cuopa tie ca, puvtlungna luo, zueziy cuota a cuopa tie ca, zueziy luo, cakuona cuota a cuopa tie ca, cakuona luo, sii ta a da riypata a cuopa tie ca, siicuona luo, na ta'a yi, ina ta.
Cakhutaata iema cunglie kha paratuv phang paliy i chi'a yi, Abyipata ina ta: thietuv ta zueziy, a daletuv ta uv, a ning riypata hne a para riypata avuo lie a zupa pavaa hne saruopa tie ta ama cuo aa.
Judah siepahruo Hezekiah sacapaa Manasseh ta Jerusalem lie a tuepa suena kawlie khata alyicung ruo bangkhuo tie'a lie kha ciysabaraw aa chiypa ta i tue'a yi.
Vya Jerusalem, ahungma na cunglie ngiechina caa hnyi aa? Acuolikie ahungma caa ngiy caa phie khyi aa?
Abyipata, na thaw cate, hnang ina chaw tli ciy; caacuonakawta i kuv kha pazuo'a angte ica para aa, a ngiepachiy'a va ang, a ta.
Ruo thlake zaw lie kha suo zinapa ta i zi yi; Ama cunglie ngiechina patlung sa angte, i cawsaa zaw kha i para yi; ama luopuv taata vya kaa va yi.

Ama nunghlyi zaw ca riyliy viehnang laata ama hluv vie; mingnu nunghlyi zaw para riypata, paratuv kha ningchung ta i vya chiy; pasana ruvsapa hne ciy aa chiypa kha sungkhabala ta a cunglie i patlung sa.

Saata pasariy a sa nung ca a thaa chuo te, a thiy thluo; ningchung puv tana a ning ca a tla thluo; nangzaa hmiechi pata na a cuo. Iema aa ngaapa tie kha ama carie tie hmiekunglieta, zueziy'a luo kha i pi'a yi, Abyipata a ta.
Kama nung, bawchie ciemuopa tana ina sa ciy, hnaa pahnawtuv hne ruo yalya lie a i a chuena chiykhyituv tana i cuo. Ducyi pi va yi ang, ducyi la buo va ang, cuorasala ama bangkhuo ta chie ina sa yi.
Abyipana a ri: Phana cuo tana na hringna lie kha icaa thla ra aa, ruvnaana hne riethyivuosuona amaa taw ningta abyana hmung riypata, na carie tie ta nama kha paa aca kie riypa yi tana i tue'a yi.
Thaa hne daa ta chaluo taata thaa kha ama thli khu'a ma?
Na suena bangkhuo kawlie khata na ruo chung yalya lieta na hnyirungna hne na suethiy kha a muo li pata hruosue ta i pi'a yi.
Na pachang lipa ruo lie kha na carie tie re hrie riypata ica tue aa, tahematapakieca i hihaana chunglie kha myi a patiy te chuozaa ta a kuo aa.

Vya Abyipa, nama ta na pachang; naa thyi la na parie tie, naa hrisaatuv cunglie kha phuv na lapa tie. Naa ngiethena thueta kama kha na thaw thi khah; nama kawlieta esena i angpa kha na pachang thi tie.
Na bie kha hmung angte i ning, na bie ca kama cuota palungtluona hne i tlechuopa tana a cuo; tahematapakieca kama ca na ming ta kupa tana i cuo, Vya Abyipa, Cungnungce Khazing.
Kama ca pahnyisesungna lie kha a tu va ang, khapa lie kha i palung tluo vyi; Na kuv rawlie kha kama se ta a tu angte, hihaana ta ina pabi ciy.
Khaapanakawma i pasana hing die buo li pata, i hmaa hing a tluo khu va? Nama ca kama cuota zang tluo aa tla lipa, tiy a ky tawpa cavaata haa tana na cuo.

Caacuonakawta Abyipata: Kama'a luo na vya kaa kieca, caa la pakhaa'a angte, i hmiekunglieta naa daa aa. Muo a hnyipa bie kha ri cate, a thlahne lipa bie kha na ri li kieca, i bie a ripa na cuo aa. Nama'a luo a vya kaa riypa ca iema ta cuo yi te, nama ca iema'a luo a kaa riypata cuo vaciy.

Nama ca hingpa cawsaa tie cuo hingta, khy dungkhuona daa tlepie haa tana ica tue aa; nama kha caa du'a yi te, cuorasala ca te'a va yi, tahematapakieca khuo riypa hne a thla riypa tana kama ta ica awpuo, Abyipata a ta.
A pha lipa tie kuv chung taa khata ca thue'a angte, thlachie a rue lipa tie kuv taa khata ica khuo aa.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo a vaw te:
Nama ca napuv hnyi'a vaciy, hingpa hmang lie hing sacapaa hne sacanung zaw hnyi'a vaciy.
Hingpa hmang lieta a puvpa sacapaa zaw sacanung zaw, iema a sapa nung tie hne paa tie zaw hneta aa patuv pata Abyipata a ripa ca:

Pasana chiepa ta ama thiy aa. Muochie sa pata cuo'a va yi, paby pata zaw cuo'a va yi; iema ca alyi lie ii haa kha tana ama cuo aa. Iema ca zueziy hne cakuona ta thiy'a yi te, ama riyy ca avuo lie pavaa hne alyi lie saruopa zaw sa tana ama cuo aa.

Caacuonakawta Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Muochie sanapa ing chung luo kha a ngie khah, a ngiy a phie riypa zaw ta cakuo khah, tahematapakieca i thlaalungna, aa hmangpa i duena hne i kawpacuona khana hingpa cawsaa tie'a taa hingta i la tli, Abyipata a ta.
Hingpa ruo lie hing a le a caw ta thiy'a yi te, paby pata cuo'a va yi, ahungtahmuo muochie sa'a va yi; iema hne iema a uochipa hne luv a pamyipa zaw aw'a va yi.
Muochie a sapa tie kha ama hnaa panguo riypata ahungtahmuo sa pachiepa'a va yi; ama nung hne ama paa ta ama thiysepa tie kha hmuo hnaapanguona panuo a pipa aw'a va yi.
Saduona ing luo kha iema hne a tu pakhaw riypata cuose, ning riypa hne dang riypata a ngie'a vaciy.

Tahematapakieca Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa hmang lieta palungtluona ueryi hne alawna ueryi cuose, nungchiytuv satlie hne vaahnyituv lesaa ueryi kha nama chuo lie hne na ming hmungna lieta i padie sa aa.

Hingpa cawsaa tie hing hingpa bie na chang tiy yi ta, iema ta, “Khaapanakawma Abyipata hingpa a lesapa pha lina hing ma cunglie a patlung sa? Khaapama ma sue? Abyipama Khazing'a lie ma tuepa pha lina ca khaapatama a cuo?, aca ta'a yi.

Cakhutaata nama ta na palie riypa yi ca: Abyipata, nama mingchingmingvuo tie ta ina thaw nakaw yi tana a cuo, khazing hrangpa hnang kha ziy yi te, a re hrie yi te amaa bie, kama kha na thaw yi te i phungbie kha ziy va yi;

cakhutaata niema ta nama mingchingmingvuo tie laata a chie vie ta nama hring, hingpa lie hing niema ta, niema pakha cyicuo ta, palung lesa pata nama khingpa pha lina luopuv kha ziy ung cate, kama bie kha naathlie khing va ung ciy.

Caacuonakawta hingpa ruo taa hingta niema hne nama mingchingmingvuo tie ta nama pachang buo lipa ruo luo kha ca pazu'a yi angte, capa lie ca khazing hrangpa re kha chung zuo ta hrie'a ung cate, i minghmie ca pi'a va yi ang.
Caacuonakawta “Izipt ruo taata Israel ming a kya pyakhyituv Abyipaa hringpa haata,” ta pata cuo li tli pata,
“Chaluo ruo hne aa cadenapa yi ruo zaw bangkhuo taata Israel ming a pakiy pakhaapa yi Khazing a hringpa haata,” tanapa ning kha a vya tlung hrahring aa, Abyipata a ta.

Abyipata, kama ta ngaa a patuvpa a hluvsa kha pathlie yi angte, iema kha ama patuv aa; cakhutaa cata ruo a khiepa a hluvsa kha pathlie'a yi angte, iema ca ta tluo ting, tluothlue ting, hne alung hraw bangkhuo kha saa a huo ta amaa huo aa.
Tahematapakieca i ming ta ama luopuv kha hmung diy te, kama'a taata a nu khu va yi, iema pha lina zaw kha i hmungna taata nu khu'a va yi.

Iema ta i ruo kha a thiypa riyy haata hringna a hnyi lipa, duv aa chiypa ama kuvtuezuv pabi yi te, i ru ca duvsamakhie aa chiypa ta ama pabi nakawta ama pha lina hne ama suena kha le hning ta i thung'a yi.

Vya Abyipa, i thaazuo hne i cariekyikuo, ruvnaana ning hne cuo lieta i canawna, alyi dena taata mingphang zaw ca nama'a luo kha a vaw'a yi te: ‘Ma mingchingmingvuo tie ca ru cupa hnyi va yi, hanghiena, muo a hnyi lipa, hne thlahnena a hnyi lipa dyina ama cu.
Cawsaapa ta iema huota khazing amaa tue khu'a ma? cahaapaapa ca khazing ta cuo va yi!’ ama ta aa.
“Caacuonakawta iema kha i va pacuv hrahring'a yi, ata cuo lie hing i cahrana hne i hmang tue khuna kha va pacuv'a yi angte, i ming ca Abyipaa cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi.”
Judah suena ca thaa caasung tana cape pata a cuo, ama pathiypalung lungphie cunglie kha lungvaa cahrepa ta khe pata cuo te, ama bienatluophie kiy lie zaw kha khe pata a cuo.
Bienatluophie hne Asherah tung zaw ca thingkung hringpa raw bangkhuo, tluothlue aa suopa cung bangkhuo hne
ruo chunglie tluo cung bangkhuo lie ama awpa kha ama saata zaw ta hmuo amaa thyi. Na ruo chung yalya lieta na hnyirungna hne na suethiy bangkhuo kha na suena muo ta hruosue ta i pi'a yi.
Ica pipa ru kha na tuena muo ta naa sung aa, cakhutaata na pachang lipa ruo lieta na carie tie re kha ica pahrie sa aa, tahematapakieca i hihaana chunglie kha myi a patiy te chuozaa ta a kuo aa.
Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Cawsaa kha a ringchuo te, saapa kha ama thaazuo ta a tuepa, Abyipa'a taata ama pathiypalung a kaapa tie ca, chiesa pata na ama cuo.
Iema ca ruocaapa chunglie ruohraw haata cuo'a yi te, phana aa vaw tiyta khaapahmuo hmung'a va yi. Iema ca ruocaapa a caavungna lie, khysa linapa paciy ruo lie kha tana ama aw aa.
Abyipakha a ringchuopa, Abyipakha aa ringchuona ta a tuepa ca thluechiypa tana a cuo.

Ama ca tiy kielie a lingpa thingkung, cavaa kie luo a thariy a thlapa haa tana a cuo. Cuovuo ning lingpa kha ciy li pata, a hnaa ca hringsiyliy khata a aw pari aa. Khytiy kuo kung a tlung tiyta siysaa ri li pata, a thyi pathyi kha pala vyi.
Pathiypalung hing khaapa bangkhuo laata a zya vie; a zya hringhruo, pathiypalung awzya ca ahungma a pachang khu?
Cawsaa bangkhuo kha ama hringzya hne, ama tuepa thyipaa haa khata thung riypata, Kama Abyipata pathiypalung kha dyapasya angte, i capya diy.
