Aa dang lipa luopuv taata hnyirungna a hmungpa ca, ama tiy lipa a tlungpa pavaa haa tana a cuo. A chuo khingkhuo lieta a hnyirungna ta thuse'a te, a chuona lie ca a ngaapa a cuopa khana a paluo sa aa.
Vya a rungnaapa byithude, a hruothu taata cyicalangpa, ima hmangpathepa abiena hmang!

Vya Israel anguopuona, Vya Abyipa! Nama caa thawpa bangkhuo ca nang pazaapa tana ama cuo aa; nama'a taata a kaapa tie ca pha lina chuelyi cazing lie cape pata na ama cuo aa, tahematapakieca Abyipa, hringna tiyhnaa kha ama thaw nakawta a cuo.
Vya Abyipa, na patluo sa la, i tluo aa; na khuo la, khuo pata i cuo aa; tahematapakieca i pathuosapa ca nama tana na cuo.
Tuokhaatama ina ta yi tapa kha hmung tie, “Abyipabie ca khaapaliema a aw? A vaw se!” ama ta.

Cuorasala kama ca na re lie tuvkhietuv i cuona taa khata a ruo va ang, a pha lipa ning a tlung riypa kha khing va ang. I hmya taata khaapama a pya tapa kha na pachang, na hmungna lie tana a cuo thluo.
I cuota ciy aa chiypa cuo thi khah; nama ca rana cuo lieta i canawna tana na cuo;

naa hrisaatuv tie ca ama nang zaa se, cuorasala kama ca i nang na pazaa khah; iema ca ama nang uo se, cuorasala kama ca i nang na pa-uo khah; iema cunglie kha rana ning patlung sala, parana le hning ta para tie yi!
Abyipana hing haa hingta naa chang: Cakuo la Judah siepahruo tie hne amaa ngiena hne ama pyanapa Cawsaa Thlake, hne Jerusalem thlake bangkhuo lie kha vaa daa tie.
Cakhutaata iema kyihuo khata: Niema Judah siepahruo tie, Judah ming bangkhuo, hne hingpa thlake taata a ngiepa Jerusalem lie khy a sapa bangkhuo ta Abyipabie ca thyi tie ung, va ta tie yi.
Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Nama hringna kha nama due kieca, sabbath ning ta hmang nama phya li riypa hne Jerusalem thlake taa zaw ta namaa ngiekhyi li riypata a raaring tie ung.

Nama mingchingmingvuo tie bie i za pipa haa yi khata sabbath ning ta nama ing chungtaata khaapa hmang hmuo pyakhyi li pata hne khaapa re hmuo hrie li pata, cuorasala sabbath ning kha a pathe pata namaa uv aa.
Cuorasala iema ta naathlie lipa yi ta, ama ruetung kha a kacusa pata chi yi te, pacuvna kha naathlie pata cuhluo va yi.
Abyipata, cuorasala i bie kha naathlie ung cate, sabbath ning ta thlake taata khaapa hmang hmuo a ngiekhyi li pata, sabbath ning kha pathe sa ung cate re nama hrie li kieca,

hingpa thlake taa hingta David byithude lie a tupa aruole a khangpa hne a ruo a khangpa hingpa khypuv siepahruo tie, iema hne ama byi tie, Judah cawsaa tie hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie kha a ngie'a yi te, hingpa khypuv hing chuozaa khysana khypuv ta a cuo aa.

Cakhutaata Judah khy zaw hne Jerusalem khy cahriy zaw taata cuose, Benjamin ruo, Shefelah, tluocung ruo khyta zaw, hne Negeb taata cawsaa tie kha a vaw'a yi te, myirue panaana hne hriykhungrina zaw, sa ta panaana, rangpa-ue zaw, hne palungtluo panaana zaw kha Abyipaing luo ca ama vya cyi aa.

Cuorasala sabbath ning pathe sa riypa, hne sabbath ning ta Jerusalem thlake zaw taata hmang a ngiekhyi li riypa tapa tie kha nama ziy li kieca, kama ta a thlake zaw kha myi ta rue'a angte, capa ca ta Jerusalem lie siepahruo ing zaw kha kuo'a te, pache khu pata cuo'a vyi.
Abyipa'a taata Jeremiah'a luo a zuvpa bie:
“A vaw la, bivytuv ing luo kha zuv la, capa lie ca i bie kha ica chang aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta bivytuv ing luo kha zuv angte, capa lie ca bivyna seh ta re a za hrie nguoluo.
Acyi ta a tuepa bi ca bivytuv kuv lie kha a ra tiyta, ama ta a pha a tana haa khata a hrangpa bi kha a tue pakhaa.
Cakhutaata Abyipabie kha kama'a luo a zuv te:

Vya Israel ingchungkhue, bivytuv ta a tuepa haa hingta ca tue khu va yi ang ma? Abyipata a ta. Vya Israel ingchungkhue, acyi ca bivytuv kuv lie a awpa haa hingta, niema ca kama kuv liena nama aw cuo va ma?
Khaapa cuo lie a cuo zaw, mingphang suokha acuolikie pena suokha hing phie pathla riypa hne pacing riypa hne para riypata bie i pathyi khu.
Cuorasala capa mingphang ca ta kama ripa bie hne aa pazue pata a pha lina kha aa maase kieca, a cunglie rana patlung sa riypa i tapa i ruena kha i thle pakhaa aa.
A hrangpa khaapa cuo lie a cuo zaw, mingphang suokha hne pena suokha sa'a angte i ling aa ta pata i pathyi khu.
Cuorasala capa ca i hmungna lie pha li pata, i bie kha a naathlie li kieca, ama cunglie phana na i tue aa i tapa i ruena kha i thle pakhaa khu.

Caacuonakawta, ata hingta, Judah cawsaa tie hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie kyihuo khata: Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Mang tie ung, kama ca nama cunglie a tlung riypa hmang pha lipa kha ting nguoluo angte khue i khuo nguoluo ning tana a cuo. Ata hing, nama bangkhuo ta nama pha lina taa khata vya kaa tie ung, nama hringzya hne nama tuepa kha a pare tie ung.
Cuorasala iema ta, “Khaahmuo thlahne'a vyi! Kiema ma tingna haa tana ma ziy aa, palung lesa pata ma khingpa pha lina khana ma tue kaluo thluo aa,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Mingphang zaw kha hiehriy tie ung: ahungma hing haapa hing a thyi buo? Lesaa pathenung Israel na ciy aa chiysapa hmang hing a tue.
Lebanon lie a tlapa cahue ta Sirion lungkuo daw kha a thuse'a ma? Tluo cunglie cakaa diyliy khata a langpa cavaa tiy ca a ky buo'a ma?
Cuorasala i cawsaa zaw na naa maw yi, hanghiena luo khana myirue panaana ama pihluo; hluoning luopuv ta a cuopa, ama luopuv lie kha amaa pachiy, luopuv lepa kha ziy lipa yi ta, luopie kha ziy yi te,
ama ruo kha ciy aa chiysapa hne, chuozaa ta a paruv ta a kawchie ri riypata ama tue. A thaalie a cakuopa bangkhuo ca ama thlaa zang te, ama luv kha ama ti.
Ningchiyluo taata thliy haa khata, carie tie hmiekunglie kha i cadaapatlaa diy'a yi. Ama ranapa ning lie kha, hnang chaw'a yi angte, i hmie na hmung'a va yi.

Cakhutaata iema ta, “A vaw tie ung, Jeremiah hing raw'a ung puv, tahematapakieca malie a cawpa riypa ama aw kalie thluo aa, ruena malie a pi riypa mingsing ama aw kalie thluo aa, profet tie zaw ta malie ama chang the kalie thluo aa. A vaw tie ung, a cung luo bie chiykhyi'a ung puv, a bie kha suokha hmuo naathlie li pata aw'a ung puv,” ama ta.
Vya Abyipa, na naathlie la, i carie tie ama ripa kha naathlie tie!

Phana hing pha lina tama thung pata a cuo aa? Kama pabyna riypa khue na ama cu. Iema'a taata na hihaana na palaw riypata, iema cuota a phapa ri angte, tuokhaatama na hmiekunglie i daa tapa kha a thyi thi tie.

Caacuonakawta ama saata zaw kha cakuo patlungsue yi la, zueziy cahrana luo kha pazu tie yi, ama napuv zaw kha saata li pata nunghlyi naase yi. Ama capaa tie kha puvtlung pasana ta thiy yi sala, ama mingnu tie kha rie lieta zueziy ta thiy yi se.
Chechiy a chuvpa tie sungkha ta na patlungsue ning yi kha, caana ueryi ca ama ing taata thyi pata cuo se! Tahematapakieca kama patuvna riypata khue cu yi te, i phyi kha cyihyi ama thla khuo.

Vya Abyipa, kama thie riypata ina rawpa yi kha na pachang. Ama pha lina kha a ngiethe pata, na hmungna taata hruvpa khah yi. Na hmiekunglie kha a pachiy yi sala, na hihaa ning khata ama cunglie rehrie tie.
Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Cakuo la bivytuv'a lie kha alyi bire suokha va calyi tie. Uvthyi tie chekha hne tluobyi chekha kha a chiy yi la,
Hinnom sacapaa bawphie lie, Bikue Thlake luo kha vaa ung la kama ta ica changpa yi bie hing va pathyi tie ung.

Niema ta: Vya Judah siepahruo tie hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie, Abyipabie hing naathlie tie ung. Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa hmang lie hing ranapa patlung sa'a angte, a thyipa bangkhuo ca ama naa kha a khe ta a khe'a yi.

Tahematapakieca cawsaa ta kama kha na thaw yi te, iema hne ama mingchingmingvuo tie hne ama siepahruo tie ta ama pachang lipa khazing hrangpa tie kha panaana pihluo yi te, hingpa hmang hing ama papyapalyi; cakhutaata hingpa hmang hing suena a hnyi lipa thiyse ta ama pabi.
Cakhutaata ama saata zaw kha Baal cuota myirue panaana ta pihluona riypata khahrungtluobu kha ama sa. Capa ca kama ta naw i pipa yi ta cuo vyi, a rue hmuo rue buo va ang.
Hingpa hmang hing Tofeth acuolikie Hinnom sacapaa bawphie ta pata cuo li tli pata Thiena Bawphie ta pata kupa a cuona cuo ca a vya tlung nguoluo, Abyipata a ta.

Cakhutaata hingpa hmang lie hing Judah hne Jerusalem khuekhuona ca a hripa ta pacuo sa'a angte, ama carie tie hmiekunglie hne a thie khingpa tie kuv lie kha zueziy ta ama thiy aa. Ama riyy kha avuo lie a zupa pavaa hne alyi lie a awpa saruopa zaw kha ama la ta i pi'a yi.
Cakhutaata hingpa khypuv hing ciy aa chiypa hne duv aa chiypa ta i pacuo sa aa; a thaalie a cakuopa bangkhuo ca ruvna aa tawpa kawlie khata ama thlaa zang'a te a paruv ta a kawchie ama ri aa.
A thie khingpa ama carie tie ta ama cadungna chunglie kha amaa tuena aw li tli pata ama sacanung hne ama sacapaa zaw saa kha ce'a yi te, ama ingpaa tie saa zaw kha ama ce riypata i tue'a yi.
Cakhutaata nama hne a si rapa tie hmungna lie kha na bire ca dechi'a cate,

iema kyihuo khata: Cungnungce Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Hing haa hing tana hingpa cawsaa hne hingpa khypuv hing i dechi aa, cawsaa pakha ta bivytuv bi kha a dechipa haata; caacuonakawta pare khu aw'a va tli. Tofeth lie kha pabyna thluo aa tlaw lina te ta ama paby aa.
Cahaaca tana hingpa hmang hne a chunglie khy a sapa tie ca i tue'a yi, hingpa khypuv hing Tofeth haa kha tana i tue aa, Abyipata a ta.

Jerusalem ing zaw, Judah siepahruo tie ing zaw, a thlungkhuv cunglieta avuo lie a awpa bangkhuo zaw'a luo biena pihluona ama tuenapa, hne khazing hrangpa tie'a luo dangpa ta panaana ama pihluonapa ing bangkhuo ca Tofeth haa tana a pathe lipa ta ama cuo aa.
Jeremiah ca profetbiephu ri riypata Abyipata a pathlienapa Tofeth taata vya kaa te, Abyipaing tlawhmie lie kha a daa te cawsaa bangkhuo kyihuo khata:

Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa khypuv cunglie hne a khy zaw bangkhuo cunglie kha kama ta i za pathyisa ciepa ruvna kha i patlung sa tli; tahematapakieca iema ca ama ruetung kacu te i bie kha thyi khing va yi, ta pata a pathyisa.
Abyipaing lieta tluobyi le cepa Immer sacapaa tluobyi Pashhur ta Jeremiah ta hingpa profetbiephu a ripa hing a thyi.
Caacuonakawta Pashhur ta Jeremiah kha tuv te chaluo Benjamin Thlake Abyipaing chunglie kha hrakyi a khe.

A mawluo maw, Pashhur ta Jeremiah kha hrakyi khena taata a pathlie tiyta, Jeremiah ta Pashhur kyihuo khata, Abyipata nama kha Pashhur ca ta va tli, cuorasala, “Zezaw ting lie ciy-achiypa,” aca ta, a ta.

Caacuonakawta Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Nama ca nama cuota ciy aa chiysapa hne na viesaa bangkhuo cuota ciy aa chiysapa tana ica tue aa; na hmungna lie hrahring kha ama carie tie zueziy ta ama thiy aa. Cakhutaata Judah bangkhuo kha Babilon siepahruo kuv chung luo i pi aa; ama ta Babilon luo kha sii ta a da'a yi te, zueziy ta a thie'a yi.

Hingpa khypuv a hnyirungna bangkhuo, a chechiy bangkhuo, rie lie a lapa bangkhuo, hne Judah siepahruo suethiy bangkhuo kha ama carie tie kuv chungluo i pi aa; iema ta chuv'a yi te, patuv'a yi te, Babilon luo ama sikhyi aa.

Cakhutaata nama, Pashhur hne na ing lie a awpa bangkhuo ca sii ta a dapa cuo'a ung cate, Babilon luo nama si aa; profetbiephu kha a cuo li pata a ripa, nama hne na viesaa bangkhuo ca capa lie ca thiy'a ung cate, capa lie ca aca paby'a yi.
Vya Abyipanama ta na dung cate, dungpa ta i cuo thluo; kama laata cahra vie cate, ina te ciy. Kama ca ningting ta pahnyisuepa ta cuo angte, cawsaa bangkhuo ta ina tue hyalya yi.
Bie i ri kyry ta, a khi ta khi angte, “A tuv a dena hne parana!” ta pata i khi. Tahematapakieca Abyipabie ca kama cuota suebena hne tue hyalyana ta a cuo.

Kama ta, “Ama kaw kha ri'a va ang, a ming ta khaapahmuo ri'a va ang,” i ta tiyta, a bie ca i chunglie hing myi kuo ta kuo te, i ruv chunglie hing myi lingpa haata aa khung, i chunglie kha patuv pari khu va tli ang, patuv khu va ang.

Tahematapakieca a paruvta tah ripa bie a hluvsa i thyi: “Zezaw ting lie ciy aa chiypa tana a cuo! A thuo pachi tie ung! A thuo pachi'a ung puv!” ama ta. I viesaa phapa bangkhuo ta i pachiy riypa kha ina mangkhuo yi. Ma dung khu ngiethie thlu aa, ama kha te'a pate, a cunglie phuv ma la aa,” ama ta.

Cuorasala Abyipaca a thaaruvpa rieka haata kama'a lie aw te, kama naa hrisaatuv tie ca a lie'a yi te, na te'a va yi. Tena ama hmung li nakawta, khuosa ta ama nang a zaa aa, ama mingchiena ca chuozaa ta maw pata cuo'a vyi.
Vya Cungnungce Abyipa, nama ca aa dangpa tie kha dyapasya yi cate, pathiypalung hne ruena kha na hmung. I cuona hing nama'a lie icaa pi diy tli nakawta, iema'a lie phuv na lapa kha hmung thi ang se.
Abyipa'a lie kha hlaasa tie ung; Abyipakha pathuosa tie ung! Tahematapakieca ama ca pha lina a tuetuv tie kuv taa khata riethyivuosuopa tie hringna kha a khuo yi.
I za puvnapa ning kha chiesa pata cuo mang sue! I nung ta ina sanapa ning ca thluechiypa ta cuo khah se!
I paa kha, “Sacapaa na na sa,” ta pata chang te, khuosa ta a palung a patluosapa ca chiesa pata cuo mang sue.
Capa cawsaa ca Abyipata kawpacuona hnyi li pata a thawpa khypuv haa khata cuo mang sue; maw ta caana ueryi kha thyi sala, ningchung ta a pahluna ueryi kha thyi mang sue.
Tahematapakieca i nung riy chunglie kha na thie vyi, na thie sala ca, i nung riy ca i thluo ta cuo'a te, i nung riy chunglie i aw pari thluo'apa kha.
Khaapanakawma ruvnaana hne ngiechina dyi hmung riypa hne, i chuo chung nangzaana ang riypa hingta, i nung riy chungtaata i za puv?
Siepahruo Zedekiah ta Malkhiah sacapaa Pashhur hne Maaseiah sacapaa tluobyi Zefaniah kha Jeremiah'a luo a pathlie ning yi ta, Abyipa'a taata Jeremiah luo a zuvpa bie ca,

Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ta rie malie aa duna kawlie hingta, “Kiema cuopa ta Abyipa kha malie hiehriypa tie; Abyipaca a za tue tawpa haa khata kiema cuota kharuehaa re hrie'a te, Nebukhadnezzar hing kiema'a taata a pakaa ngiethie thlu aa,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Jeremiah ta iema kyihuo khata:

Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Khy dungkhuo ale luo taata caa cadungpa yi Babilon siepahruo hne Khaldi ming namaa duna lieta nama kuv lie namaa cyipa cehre kha ica pakaasue'a yi; cakhutaata iema kha khypuv liekhingkhuo luo hing i ngiekhyi'a yi.
Kama hrahring ta niema ca i kuv pazuo'a angte hihaana, a ie ta a iepa pathiylingna hneta icaa du'a yi.
Cakhutaata hingpa khypuv lie khy a sapa cawsaa hne saruopa hing tuv'a yi angte puvtlung pasana ta ama thiy aa.

Abyipata, cakhutaata puvtlung pasana, zueziy, hne cakuona taata a lawpa, Judah Siepahruo Zedekiah, hne a changtaapa tie, hne hingpa khypuv chunglie cawsaa tie kha Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar hne iema a thie khingpa ama carie tie kuv chung luo kha i pi'a yi. Ama ta iema kha ngiechina, kawpacuona, hne kuv thliyzaana hnyi li pata zueziy ta a thie'a yi.
Cakhutaata hingpa cawsaa tie kyihuo hingta: Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Mang tie ung, Hringna luopuv hne thiyna luopuv na nama hmiekunglieta i chi.

Hingpa khypuv chunglie a awpa tie ca zueziy, cakuona, hne puvtlung pasana tana ama thiy aa; cuorasala niema caa cadungpa yi Khaldi ming'a luo kha pya te ama hne ama a pipa ca hring'a te, hruosue haa khata hringna ama hmung aa.
Tahematapakieca hingpa khypuv hing ama cuota phana cuo li pata chiena riypata i hmie nukhuo angte, Babilon siepahruo kuv chung luo kha pi'a angte myi ta a rue aa, Abyipata a ta.
Judah siepahruo ingchungkhue luo ripa bie: Abyipabie hing naathlie tie ung,

Vya David ingchungkhue! Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Biedangpa ca mawdiy taakhata aw paluo tli se, paruvpa pata a cuopa tie kha tuechietuv tie kuv taakhata palaw sa tie ung, acuolikieca nama tuepa pha lina kaw lie khata i hihaana ca myi haata ie'a te, ahunghmuo pache khu'a va yi.
Mang tie, kama na caa carie ang, Vya bawphie lie khy a sapa, Vya ase lung puv, Abyipata a ta. “Ahungma kiema a du riypata a zuv khu aa? Ahungma kiema awna luo hing a ngie khu aa?” nama ta.
Na tuena haa kha tana duo ica te aa, Abyipata a ta. Kama ta a ruo kha myi ta rue'a angte, a cahriy ruo bangkhuo kha a kuo diy aa.
Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Judah siepahruo ingchungkhue luo kha zuv la capa lie ca hingpa bie hing za ri tie:
Vya Judah Siepahruo, David byithude lieta a tupa, nama, na changtaapa tie hne hingpa thlake zaw taata a ngiepa na cawsaa tie hne khata Abyipabie hing naathlie tie ung.

Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Biedangpa hne adangna hneta hrie tie ung, paruvpa pata a cuopa bangkhuo kha tuechietuv tie kuv taa khata khuo tie ung. Cakhutaata ruohrang ming, haaraa, hne nunghlyi cunglie kha a cuo lipa ta hne esetuechiena tue'a va ung ciy.

Hingpa bie hing na ziy hmisi kieca, David byithude lie a tupa siepahruo tie, aruole hne aruo a khangpa pa tie, iema, hne ama changtaapa tie, hne ama cawsaa tie kha hingpa ing thlake zaw taa hingta amaa ngie aa.
Cuorasala hingpa bie hing nama naathlie li kieca, chie ca sa'a yi angte, hingpa ing hing a duothlingpa ta aa li aa, Abyipata a ta.

Judah siepahruo ing hneta aa patuv pata Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Nama ca kama cuota Gilead haata cuo cate, Lebanon tluodaw haa tana na cuo; cuorasala ruocaapa ta ca tue'a angte, khysa linapa khypuv tana ica tue aa.
Nama paratuv riypa kha pachie'a angte, cehre hneta ama aw diy aa. A pha cepa na sidar kung zaw kha hu diy'a yi te, myi ta ama rue aa.
Cakhutaata mingphang hluvpuv ca capa khypuv athaalie ziy pata cakuo'a yi te, iema bangkhuo ta pakha hne pakha kha, “Khaapanakawma hingpa khypuv hing Abyipa ta hing haa hingta a tue?” amaa ta aa.
Cakhutaata iema ta, “Iema ta Abyipaama Khazing biekuona kha thaw yi te, khazing hrangpa tie kha abie yi te a re ama hrie nakaw tana a cuo,” ama ta.
A thiypa cuo khata caa khah ung, muochie zaw sa khah ung; a hrang luo a sipa cuo khata caa tie ung, tahematapakieca a puvna ruo kha hmung riypata, vya kaa pakhaa'a va tli.
Judah Siepahruo Josiah sacapaa Shallum, a paa Josiah re a thlepa, hingpa hmang taata a hrangpa hmang luo a sipa hneta aa patuv pata Abyipata a ripa ca: Ama ca hingpa luo hing vya kaa pakhaa'a va tli,
cuorasala sii ta ama sikhyina hmang lie khana a thiy aa, cakhutaata hingpa ruo hing hmung pakhaa buo'a va tli.

A ing kha a dang lina hneta a sapa hne, a cungduo khuo zaw kha a dang lina hneta a sapa cuose, a ingpaa tie kha khaapahmuo pi li pata re a pahrie sapa hne, thavie muo a pi lipa ca bawchie ciemuopa tana a cuo.
“I cuota a cungduo khuo lesapa tie a hnyipa ing lesapa suokha na i sa aa,” ta te, thlaluo-aw zaw kha a tue, sidar thing ta pangi te, siyy sepa a thuv.
Capa ca sidar thing ta na sa nakawta, siepahruo na cuo ma? Na paa kha za ning khu za dang khu te, biedangpa hne adangna tana re a za hrie cuo va ma? Cakhutaata a cuota a phasa diy.
Siypasa tie hne riethyivuosuopa tie kha bie ripa yi te, a za pha hringhruo. Ina pachang nakaw tana a cuo, cuo va ma? Abyipata a ta.
Cuorasala na ming hne na pathiypalung ca aa dang lipa hmungna cunglie hne, a sue lipa tie thiyse palang riypa hne, hrisaana hne tuechiena lie dyina a aw.

Caacuonakawta Judah ming Josiah sacapaa Siepahruo Jehoiakim hne aa patuv pata Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: “Vya i nuta!” acuolikie “Vya i sieta!” ta pata, iema ta ama kha caa'a va yi. “Vya abyipa!” acuolikie “Vya i siepahruo!” ta pata, iema ta ama kha muochie sa'a va yi.
Laa pabypa haa khata ama ca paby pata cuo'a te, Jerusalem thlake khungthing luo kha a dale'a yi te thaw pata a cuo aa.
Lebanon luo kha sithaw la kya khi tie, Bashan lie kha na ueryi aa suosa pata khi la, Abarim taa khata khi tie, tahematapakieca na duepa zaw bangkhuo ca para diypa tana ama cuo.
Na chyachang aa ky ningta ica chaw, cuorasala, “Ca naathlie'a va ang,” ina ta ciy. Hingpa hing mingnu na cuo ning baataata na zya ta a cuo, i bie kha za ziy vaciy.
Na pha lina kawlie khata, na tuvkhietuv bangkhuo kha thliy ta phya'a yi te, na duepa zaw kha sii ta sikhyipa ama cuo aa; cakhutaata nama ca na nang zaa'a te na nang ta a uo aa.
Vya Lebanon lie khy a sapa tie, sidar kung lie a buv a tuepa tie, nupazi pasana haata pasana kha nama cunglie a tlung tiyta, tuokhaatama namaa hrung aa!
Abyipata, Kama i hringpa haata, Judah ming Jehoiakim sacapaa Siepahruo Koniah ca i cacuoluo kuv lie caakhe khenapa kuvpahryi ta a cuo raalaa pata, capa taa cata ca thlaachi'a angte,
nama caa thie khingpa tie, na ciysapa tie hne Babilon siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar hne Khaldi ming kuv chung luo kha ica pi aa.
Nama hne caa sapa na nung hne khata nama puvnapa ruo ta a cuo lipa luo kha ca pazu'a yi angte, capa lie ca nama thiy aa.
Kaa pakhaa riypata ama vuosapa ruo luo kha kaa pakhaa va tli yi.
Hingpa Koniah hing ahungtahmuo ama khing lipa bi, duv aa chiypa bi kyipa kha cuo va ma? Khaapanakawma ama hne a samingsahlaa zaw hing ama pachang lipa ruo luo ama pazu?
Vya ruo, ruo, ruo, Abyipabie hing thyi tie!

Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa cawsaa hing saata a hnyi lipa, a chuo chunglieta tena a hmung li riypa ta pata cape tie ung. Tahematapakieca a samingsahlaa pakha hmuo tena hmung'a va yi, David byithude lie kha a tu'a va yi, Judah ruo chunglie hing uvtuv cuo'a va yi.
I tuvrung chunglie tuv kha para te a chepatlaapa tuvkhietuv ca bawchie ciemuopa tana a cuo, Abyipata a ta.

Caacuonakawta i cawsaa zaw a mangchiytuv tuvkhietuv tie kawlieta Abyipa, Israel Khazing ta hing haa hingta a ri: niema ta i tuvrung kha che ung cate, namaa cade, iema kha mangchiy va ung ciy. Caacuonakawta a pha lipa nama tuena kawlieta niema kha ica mangpathliy'a yi, Abyipata a ta.
Cakhutaata kama hrahring ta aa ngaapa i tuvrung tie kha i cadenapa yi hmang taa khata pahmya'a yi angte, tuvte luo kha a vya chiy pakhaa'a yi angte capa lie ca saata sa'a yi te ama pungzaa aa.
Iema a khie riypa yi tuvkhietuv kha chipa'a yi angte, khaapahmuo ciy'a va tli yi, ama nang uo li'a tli pata a viepa aw'a va tli yi, Abyipata a ta.
David ce aa dangpa suokha i papusana cuo ca a vya tlung hmisi aa, Abyipata a ta. Ama ca siepahruo cuo'a te singvaasa pata hmang a tue aa, ruo chunglie kha biedangpa hne adangna kha a tue aa.
Ama chuo lie kha Judah ca khuo pata cuo'a te Israel ca aa bangsa pata a aw aa. Ama ama kuna riypa ming ca: “Abyipaca maa dangna tana a cuo,” ta pata a cuo aa.
Caacuonakawta, “Israel ming Izipt ruo taata a kya pyakhyituv yi Abyipaa hringpa haata,” ta pata cuo li pata,

cuorasala iema ta, “Israel ingchungkhue samingsahlaa zaw kha chaluo ruo taata hne aa cadenapa yi ruo ting taa khata a vya chiy pakhaapa yi Abyipaa hringpa haata,” ama tana riypa cuo ca aa vaw nguoluo tli. Cakhutaata iema ca ama ruo lie kha khy ama sa aa.

I profet tie hneta aa patuv pata: Abyipahne a pathepa a bie kawlieta i chunglieta i pathiypalung ca zachi diy te, i ruv bangkhuo aa thang; kama ca a pariypa haa tana i cuo, mingsuvtiy a paruvpa haa tana i cuo.
Tahematapakieca ruo ca nungvaathingsuena tana a bi; chiesapa a cuo nakawta ruo ca a ngiy te, sahring tlena ruo zaw ca a caa. Ama luopuv kha a dang li pata, ama cahrana ca aa hmuopa lieta cuo vyi.
Profet hne tluobyi ca ama phuv hning ta khazing pachang va yi; i ing chunglieta hmuota ama pha lina kha i hmung yi, Abyipata a ta.

Caacuonakawta ama luopuv ca iema cuota, zingna chunglie a pahniepa luo haata a cuo aa, capa chung luo ca a cade pata cuo'a yi te amaa lie aa. Tahematapakieca iema duotena kung lie kha, iema cunglie ca ruvnaana i patlung sa aa, Abyipata a ta.
Cuorasala Samaria profet tie chunglie kha hue aa chiysapa hmang i hmung: Baal ming ta profetbiephu ri yi te, i cawsaa Israel ming kha a pali a pahnaa ta luo amaa chiy.

Cuorasala Jerusalem profet tie chunglie kha a pahlupa hryly riypa hmang kha i hmung: iema ca nungvaathingsuena kha tue yi te hangbie kha ama ri; pha lina a tuepa tie kha thaa pi yi te, caacuonakawta ahunghmuo pha lina kha a maase va yi; kama cuota ca iema bangkhuo ca Sodom ming haa khata cuo yi te, a chunglie khy a sapa bangkhuo ca Gomorrah ming haa tana ama cuo.

Caacuonakawta profet tie hne aa patuv pata Cungnungce Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: “Kama ta uocuokhaa kha paning sa'a yi angte, ca-ie thlapa tiy kha dang riypata i pi'a yi: Jerusalem profet tie'a taa hing tana Khazing pachang lina kha ruo ting ta aa ze” a ta.

Cungnungce Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Niema'a lie profetbiephu a ripa profet tie bie kha naathlie khah ung; iema ca niema khana aca dung yi. Abyipapakaa taata a cuo lipa, iema pathiypalung lie a awpa khana ama ri.
Abyipabie siysaa a ri lipa tie kha, “Diena nama hmung aa,” ta pari yi te, palung lesa pata ama palunglena luopuv a ziypa tie kha, “Ruvnaana kha nama cunglie tlung'a vyi,” ama ta.
Ahungma a bie thyi riypata Abyipakhuekhuona lie a tu ra? Ahungma phu pachaa riypata a bie kha a naathlie?
Mang tie ung Abyipathliychie! Thliysung aa pahiepa hihaana ca a pya tli hue; capa ca ta a pha lipa luv cunglie kha aa hruosue aa.
Abyipahihaana ca a palung chunglie aa tingpa kha hrie te, a patlung hluo li kaa'a vyi. Hmieluo cuo lieta hingpa hing a siesa pata nama pachang aa.
Profet tie ca i pathlie lipa yi ta amaa ruo; bie i chang lipa yi ta profetbiephu ama ri.
Cuorasala i khuekhuona chunglie kha amaa zaa tu ra kieca, i bie kha i cawsaa zaw'a luo ama phu aa, iema kha a pha lipa ama luopuv taata pakaa'a yi te, a pha lipa rehriena taata ama pakaa aa.
Abyipata Kama ca aa ngieta lie a awpa Khazing dyi tama i cuo, luohlaa luo a awpa Khazing zaw cuo va ang ma?
I hmung li riypa yi ta ahungma a cakung lie a nu khu aa? Kama ca alyi hne avuo lie bi va ang ma? a ta.
I ming ta hang pata profetbiephu a ripa profet tie ta, “Muo na i sa, muo na i sa,” ama tapa kha i thyi.
Hangna profetbiephu a ripa, iema khingna ta hang yi te profetbiephu a ripa tie pathiypalung hing khatiythuema aa thle aa?
Ama mingchingmingvuo tie ta Baal ming kawlieta i ming ama za mawpa haa khata, pakha hne pakha amaa chang pachaapa ama muo khata i cawsaa zaw ta kama ming ama maw riypata khue ama khuo.
Muo a hmungpa profet ca a muo kha ri thluo se, cuorasala i bie a hnyipa cawsaa ca i bie kha zang tluo aa tlasa pata ri se. Sasiypa ca sahang hneta aa lu the'a ma? Abyipata a ta.
I bie ca myi haata cuo te, alungpuvnung a dechi diypa khunglung haa tana a cuo, cuo va ma?
I bie kha pakha hne pakha a paruvpa yi te a ripa profet tie kha i du yi, Abyipata a ta.
Caacuonakawta iema bie ama hmuo thluo pata, “Abyipana a ri,” a tapa profet tie kha i du yi, Abyipata a ta.

Kama ta re pi yi angte i pathlie lipa yi ta, dungviena muo kha chang yi te profetbiephu a ripa, ama hanghiena hne a hrihripa bie ta i cawsaa zaw luo a papie sapa profet tie kha i du yi, Abyipata a ta; caacuonakawta iema ca hingpa cawsaa tie hing thlahnena pi va yi, Abyipata a ta.

Hingpa cawsaa, acuolikie profet pakha, acuolikie tluobyi pakha ta, “Abyipaca khaapama a hmang a pariy sa? aca ta kie yi ca, iema kyihuo khata, “Niema hingna hmangriy ta a cuo ung ciy, ica thaw'a yi, Abyipata a ta,” nama ta aa.
Cakhutaata, “Abyipahmangriy,” a tapa profet, tluobyi, acuolikie cawsaa tie kha iema hne ama ingchungkhue hneta duo i te'a yi.
“Abyipata tuokhaatama a palie?” acuolikie “Abyipata khaapama a ri?” ta pata pakha hne pakha kha namaa hiehriy'a ma?

Cuorasala niema ta, “Abyipahmangriy,” ta'a va tli ung ciy, tahematapakieca hmangriy ca pakha cyicuo ma bie hingta cuo te, niema ta a hringpa Khazing, Cungnungce Abyipa, ima Khazing bie kha a pali a pahnaa ta nama maa.
Profet tie kha, “Abyipata khaapama aca palie? acuolikie “Abyipata khaapama a ri?” ta pata nama hiehriy aa.

Cuorasala niema ta, “Abyipahmangriy,” nama ta kieca Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Ica pathlie ning yi ta, “Abyipahmangriy,” ta'a va ung ciy ica ta raalaa pa yi ta, Hingpa bie hing, “Abyipahmangriy,” nama ta kieca,
kama ta niema, hne niema hne nama mingchingmingvuo tie ica pipa yi khypuv hne hingta ca caba'a yi angte i hmungna taa hingta ica thaw'a yi.
Cakhutaata maw khu li riypa chuozaa nangzaana hne hmiechina kha nama cunglie i patlung sa aa.

Abyipata Abyipabiena-ing hmiekunglieta chipa thyikuv pasyi zung hning kha ina pahmung sa. Hingpa hing Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ta Judah ming Jehoiakim sacapaa siepahruo Jekoniah kha Judah byi tie, kuvzung a thepa tie, su a sapa tie, tapa zaw hneta Babilon luo sii ta a da yi te a sikhyi khutaata a cuo.
Pasyi suokha lie thyikuv ca a thyi phasapa, a pathyi taapa haata cuo te, cuorasala a hrangpa pasyi lie thyikuv ca a chiesapa, ning the a aw lipa thyikuv ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata Abyipata, “Jeremiah, khaapama na hmung?” ina ta. Kama ta, “Thyikuv, a phapa thyikuv, a phasapa, hne a chiepa thyikuv, a chiesapa, ning the a aw lipa,” i ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipabie ca kama'a luo aa zuv:
Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa thyikuv phapa haa hingta, Judah taata sii ta sikhyipa, hingpa ruo taa hingta Khaldi ming ruo luo i paphyapa tie kha a phapa ta i rue'a yi.
Phana riypata ama cunglie i ming chi'a angte, hingpa ruo luo hing i vya chiy pakhaa'a yi. Sathaw'a yi angte, thlaachi'a va tli yi ang; a ling'a yi angte, khaa va tli yi ang.
Kama ca Khazing ta i cuopa kha pachang khuna pathiypalung pi'a yi angte, ama pathiypalung yalya ta kama'a luo kha ama vya kaa pakhaa aa.

Cuorasala Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Judah Siepahruo Zedekiah, aa byi tie, hingpa ruo lieta aa ngaapa Jerusalem lie aa ngaapa tie, hne Izipt ruo lieta a awpa tie kha, a chiepa thyikuv, a chie tuv nakawta ning the a aw lipa haa khata i tue'a yi.

Iema kha alyi cunglie pena bangkhuo cuota ciy aa chiysapa, a pha lipa hmang ta i tue'a yi. I cadena riypa yi ruo bangkhuo lie kha nangzaa aa chiypa, pakhingpuona ta ripa, ese riypa, hne chiesa riypata i tue'a yi.
Cakhutaata iema hne ama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie i pipa yi ruo taata para diy karuepa ama cuona te ta iema cunglie kha zueziy, cakuona, hne puvtlung pasana i patlung sa aa.

Judah ming Josiah sacapaa Jehoiakim siepahruo a cuonapa kung paliyna lieta Judah cawsaa bangkhuo hne aa patuv pata Jeremiah luo a zuvpa bie (capa ca Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar siepahruo a cuonapa a kung khana lieta a cuo),
profet Jeremiah ta Judah cawsaa bangkhuo hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie bangkhuo'a lieta a ripa bie ca:
Judah ming Amon sacapaa Josiah siepahruo a cuonapa kung, kung kiy kung thung taata ata tepa ta Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha a zuv te, niema'a lie kha ci li pata i ri, cuorasala naathlie va ung ciy.
Cakhutaata Abyipata a changtaapa profet tie bangkhuo kha ci li pata niema'a luo a pathlie raalaa pa yi ta, ama bie thyi riypata naathlie va ung ciy.

Iema ta, “Nama bangkhuo hingta a pha lipa nama luopuv taata hne hmang pha lipa nama tuena taa khata a vya maa tie ung, cata a cuo kieca Abyipata niema hne nama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie aca pipa yi ruo lie kha chuozaa ta nama aw aa;
iema re hrie riypa hne abie riypata khazing hrangpa kha ziy khah ung, nama kuv ta nama tuepa kuvtuezuv ta i hi na pahaa khah ung. Cata a cuo kieca nama cunglie ruvnaana tue'a va ang,” aca ta yi.
Cuorasala kama kha na naathlie va ung ciy, ruvnaana namaa taw the riypata nama kuv ta nama tuepa kuvtuezuv khata i hi ina pahaa ung ciy, Abyipata a ta.
Caacuonakawta Cungnungce Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Niema ta i bie kha nama naathlie li nakawta,

chaluo taata mingphang tie kha cuose, i changtaapa Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar zaw kha hingpa ruo hne a chunglie a awpa tie, hne hingpa cahriylie a awpa pena bangkhuo hing a du riypata vya tlungkhyi'a yi angte i para diy karue'a yi. Iema ca ciy aa chiyna hne riparuvpa hmang, hne chuozaa nangzaa riypa tana i tue'a yi, Abyipata a ta.
Cakhutaata palungtluona ueryi hne alawna ueryi, nung chituv satlie ueryi hne vaahnyituv lesaa ueryi, suoriena pu hne myi-ing khepa zaw kha iema'a lieta pa-aw sa'a va ang.
Hingpa ruo yalya hingta a rapa hne a duothlingpa ta a li'a te, hingpa mingphang tie hingta Babilon siepahruo re kha kung sawsariy chung ama hrie aa.
Kung sawsariy a tling khutaata, Babilon siepahruo hne mingphang, Khaldi ming ruo kha iema pha lina cuota duo te'a yi angte, ama ruo ca chuozaa a duothlingpa ta i tue aa, Abyipata a ta.
Capa ruo cunglie kha i ripa bie bangkhuo, hingpa caa-uv lie aa capepa bangkhuo, mingphang bangkhuo cunglie Jeremiah ta profetbiephu a ripa zaw bangkhuo kha i patlung sa aa.
Tahematapakieca mingphang hluvsa hne siepahruo lepa tie zaw khata iema ca sii ta tue ra'a yi te, iema ama tuepa hne ama kuv ta ama hriepa haa khata i thung'a yi.
Abyipa, Israel Khazing ta kama'a lie kha hing haa hingta a ri: I kuv taa hingta hingpa hihaana mingsuvtiy panuo hing la la, ica pathlienapa mingphang bangkhuo kha va padang sa tie yi.
Iema hraw luo i pathliepa zueziy kawlie khata iema ta dang'a yi te, a vie'a yi te ama palung a vie aa.
Caacuonakawta Abyipakuv taata panuo kha la angte, Abyipata ina pathlienapa mingphang tie kha i padang sa yi:
Jerusalem hne Judah khy zaw, a siepahruo tie hne aa byi tie, ataning ama cuopa haa hingta iema ca utlawpa hne a duothlingpa, kawchie riparuvpa hne chiesapa ta tue riypa;
Izipt siepahruo Faro, a changtaapa tie, aa byi tie, hne a cawsaa bangkhuo;
aa pyapa mingphang tie bangkhuo; Uz ruo lie siepahruo tie bangkhuo, Filistin ruo lie siepahruo tie bangkhuo, Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, hne Ashdod aa ngaapa tie;
Edom, Moab, hne Ammon ming;
Tair siepahruo bangkhuo, Sidon siepahruo bangkhuo, hne riyliy huesuo ruo siepahruo bangkhuo;
Dedan, Tema, Buz, hne ama luv a pamyi thepa tie;
Arabia siepahruo tie bangkhuo hne ruocaa lie khy a sapa aa pyapa mingphang tie siepahruo zaw;
Zimri siepahruo tie bangkhuo, Elam siepahruo tie bangkhuo, Media siepahruo tie bangkhuo;
chaluo ruo siepahruo tie bangkhuo, aa hla aa ngie ta a awpa pakha hnang pakha hne alyi lie a awpa chuelyi pena tie bangkhuo ta ama dang aa. Iema khutaa cata Babilon ta a dang aa.

Cakhutaata nama ta iema kha, Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Niema hraw luo i pathliepa zueziy kawlie khata dang ung la, pariy ung la paliy tie ung, a lie ung la kya thu khah tie ung.
Cakhutaata iema ta nama kuv taata panuo kha ama dang khing li kieca, iema kyihuo khata: Cungnungce Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Nama dang aa!

Mang tie ung, kama ming ta kupa khypuv cunglieta ruvnaana patlung riypa kha i patha nguoluo tli, tuokhaatama duotena kha nama cahriy khu aa? Duotena ang li pata aw'a va ung ciy, tahematapakieca alyi lie khy a sapa bangkhuo cuo khata zueziy kha i ku tli, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.

Caacuonakawta hingpa bie hingta iema'a lie kha profetbiephu ri la, iema kyihuo khata: Abyipaca aa suona taa khiyta a hrung'a te, a pathepa a awna taa khata a ryi a pathlie aa; a cawsaa zaw'a lie kha khuosa ta a hrung'a te, alyi lie khy a sapa tie bangkhuo'a lie kha, mingsuv a ciypa tie ama khipa haa khata a khi aa.

A khina ueryi ca alyi dena te ta a hraw aa, tahematapakieca Abyipaca mingphang zaw cunglie kha bie hnyi te, cawsaa bangkhuo kha tazaa a cyi'a yi; a suepa ca zueziy ta thie riypata pipa a cuo aa, Abyipata a ta.
Cungnungce Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Mang tie ung, ruvnaana ca ruo kha taata ruo kha luo aa ze aa, vuoruo dena taata khuopuv ta thliychie aa vya hruo aa!
Capa ning lieta Abyipata a thiepa tie ca alyi kiy kha taata kiy kha te khata amaa pazue aa. Iema ca caa pata cuo'a va yi, papung'a va yi, paby'a va yi; iema ca alyi lie kha ii ta amaa li aa.

Caa tie ung, tuvkhietuv tie, khi tie ung, buvcuo chunglie kha a pahlang tie ung, tuvrung byi zaw, tahematapakieca niema caa thietuv aa vawna ning ca a vya tlung tli, niema kepatlaana ning ca, niema ca bi pha cepa haa kha tana namaa lie aa.
Tuvkhietuv tie ca amaa ruona aw'a vyi, tuvrung byi tie zaw amaa ruona aw'a vyi.
Tuvkhietuv tie khina ueryi kha naathlie tie, tuvrung byi tie caana ueryi ca. Tahematapakieca Abyipakha a hi a haa hringhruo nakawta, ama sahring tlena ruo kha chuv yi te,
a ie ta a iepa Abyipahihaana khata a dieta tah ama awnapa ing kha a para patlaa.
Aa nuna hmang kha chingde haata a thuse tli; aa hruopa zueziy hne a ie ta a iepa a hihaana kawlieta, ama ruo ca a duothlingpa ta aa li.
Judah ming Josiah sacapaa Jehoiakim siepahruo cuo hruo a pathu ningta hingpa bie hing Abyipa'a taata aa zuv:

Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Abyipaing tlawhmie lie kha a daa la, Abyipaing chung luo abie riypata a vawpa Judah khypuv ming bangkhuo'a lie kha bie ri tie; kama ta ica changpa bie bangkhuo kha iema'a lie ca ri tie; biesuo suokha hmuo nu khah.
Iema ta, iema bangkhuo ta naathlie yi te, ama luopuv pha lipa taa khata amaa vya maa kieca, hmang pha lipa ama tuena kawlieta ama cunglie ruvnaana patlung sa riypata i tingpa i ruena kha i thle aa.
Nama ta hing haa hingta na chang'a yi: Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: I bie kha naathlie lipa ung cata, ziy riypata nama hmiekunglie i chipa i phungbie hing ziy li pata,
ama bie naathlie riypata niema'a luo i vya pathliepa i changtaapa profet tie bie kha nama naathlie li nakawta
hingpa ing hing Shiloh haa khata tue'a angte, hingpa khypuv hing alyi lie mingphang bangkhuo cuota chiesana ta i tue aa.
Tluobyi tie hne profet tie hne cawsaa bangkhuo ta Abyipaing chunglie Jeremiah ta hingpa bie a ripa kha ama thyi diy.
Abyipata cawsaa bangkhuo'a lie ri riypata a pipa bie kha Jeremiah ta a ri diy khutaata, tluobyi tie hne profet tie hne cawsaa bangkhuo ta ama kha patuv yi te, “Na thiy aa!

Khaapanakawma Abyipaming ta profetbiephu ri cate, ‘Hingpa ing hing Shiloh haata cuo'a te, hingpa khypuv hing a chunglie khy a sapa aw li pata a duothling aa’ na ta? ama ta. Cakhutaata cawsaa bangkhuo ca Abyipaing chunglie kha Jeremiah ca a hmyasue yi te ama cadung.
Judah byi tie ta hingpa kaw hing ama thyi tiyta, siepahruo ing taa khata Abyipaing luo ca a khaw yi te, Abyipaing Thlake Thaapa luo a ngiena lie kha amaa tu.

Cakhutaata tluobyi tie hne profet tie ta byi tie hne cawsaa bangkhuo kyihuo khata, “Hingpa cawsaa hing thiy aa phuv, tahematapakieca nama naa ta nama thyipa haa khata hingpa khypuv hing a du pata na profetbiephu a ri,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Jeremiah ta byi tie bangkhuo hne cawsaa bangkhuo kyihuo khata, “Hingpa ing hne hingpa khypuv a du pata nama thyipa profetbiephu ri riypata naa pathliepa hing Abyipatana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta nama hringzya hne nama hmang tuepa kha a pare ung la Abyipa nama Khazing bie kha ziy tie ung, caacuokieca Abyipata niema rana riypata a ripa a palungphya kha a thle aa.
Cuorasala kama ca, nama kuv chunglie i aw thluo hing. A pha, aa hmuo nama tapa haata na tue tie ung.

Cuorasala ina thiepa ung cata a cuo kieca, niema cunglie hne hingpa khypuv chunglie khy a sapa tie cunglie hingna a sue lipa thiyse ma chiykhyi tapa kha pachang tie ung, tahematapakieca Abyipana hingpa bie hing niema kha pathyi sa riypata naa vya pathlie,” a ta.

Cakhutaata byi tie hne cawsaa bangkhuo ta tluobyi tie hne profet tie kyihuo khata, “Hingpa cawsaa hing thie riypata cuo vyi, tahematapakieca AbyipaKhazing ming ta kiema'a lie bie a ripa tana a cuo,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata uvthyi chekha kha a daa yi te, a hmyapa tie bangkhuo kyihuo khata,

“Judah ming Siepahruo Hezekiah chuo ningta profetbiephu zaa ripa Moresheth ming Mikah ta Judah ming bangkhuo kyihuo khata a za ri: ‘Cungnungce Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Zion ca lelyi haata thaw pata a cuo aa; Jerusalem ca a rapa hnehnaw papungna ta a li'a te, biena-ing tluo ca ahling ta a buvpa tluo ta aa li aa,’ a ta.

Judah ming Siepahruo Hezekiah hne Judah ming bangkhuo ta ama kha ama thie hmisi ma? Siepahruo ta Abyipakha ciy te, Abyipakha paa kie te, Abyipazaw ta iema cunglie rana patlung sa riypa a pathiypalung kha a thle cuo va ma? Cuorasala kiema ta kiema mamaa cunglie kha rana ma patlung sa'a nang!” ama ta.

Abyipaming ta profetbiephu a ripa a hrangpa pakha za aw ra te, ama ca Kiriath-jearim taata Shemaiah sacapaa Uriah ta a cuo. Hingpa khypuv hne hingpa ruo hneta aa patuv pata profet Jeremiah ta a ripa profetbiephu haa dadang khata a ri ra.
Siepahruo Jehoiakim, a rieka bangkhuo hne byi tie bangkhuo ta a bie kha ama thyi tiyta, siepahruo ta thie riypata a huv; cuorasala Uriah ta capa ca a thyi tiyta, ciy te Izipt luo kha aa ruo.
Cakhutaata Siepahruo Jehoiakim ta Akbor sacapaa Elnathan hne cawsaa hrangpa tie kha Izipt luo a pathlie yi.
Iema ta Uriah kha Izipt taa khata Siepahruo Jehoiakim'a luo kha ama vya sikhyi, ama ta Uriah kha zueziy ta thie te a riyy ca cawsaa cakhawpa tie pabyna hmang lie kha a thaw.
Cuorasala Shafan sacapaa Ahikam ta Jeremiah kha aa daakhyi nakawta cawsaa tie kuv luo kha thie riypata pi pata cuo vyi.
Judah ming Josiah sacapaa Zedekiah siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu ningta, hingpa bie hing Abyipa'a taata Jeremiah luo aa zuv.
Abyipata kama'a lie kha hing haa hingta a ri: Na cuota ruekhang hne savang khuhriy kha a tue la na ruetung lie kha khang tie.
Edom siepahruo, Moab siepahruo, Ammon siepahruo, Tair siepahruo, hne Sidon siepahruo tie kha, Judah Siepahruo Zedekiah'a luo, Jerusalem luo a vawpa luosituv tie'a taa khata bie taa tie yi.
Ama byi tie cuota ama ri riypa bie ca: Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa hing nama byi tie'a luo nama va ri riypa bie tana a cuo:
A lepa i cahrana hne i pazuopa i buo ta alyi hne a cunglie a awpa cawsaa hne saruopa zaw kha a sapa ca kama tana i cuo, cakhutaata i pi khingpa kha i pi yi.
Hingpa ruo bangkhuo hing i changtaapa, Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar kha pi angte, ruo chunglie saruopa zaw kha hmuota a re a hrietuv riypata i pi.
A ruo ta a chuona cuo a pha hluo li, ama hne a sacapaa hne a samingta re kha mingphang bangkhuo ta ama hrie aa; cakhutaata mingphang hluvpuv hne siepahruo lepa tie ta ama kha sii ta amaa tue aa.

Cuorasala hingpa mingphang hne ruo suokhakha hingta hingpa Nebukhadnezzar, Babilon siepahruo re hing ama hrie li kieca, Babilon siepahruo ruekhang rawlie kha ama ruetung ama chi khing li kieca, a kuv ta iema rana kha i patlung hluo li, capa mingphang ca zueziy, cakuona, hne puvtlung pasana ta duo i te'a yi, Abyipata a ta.
Caacuonakawta, “Babilon siepahruo re kha hrie khah ung,” caa tapa yi nama profet tie, hmungdawlutuv tie, muo a sapa tie, ridawlutuv tie, hne ca-ie a thepa tie bie kha naathlie'a va ung ciy.
Tahematapakieca iema ta niema'a lie kha hangna profetbiephu kha ama ri, caacuonakawta nama ruo taa khata luohlaapuv luo papya pata nama cuo aa; kama ta caa cade'a yi angte, nama ra aa.
Cuorasala Babilon siepahruo ruekhang raw luo kha a ruetung vya chi te a re a hriepa mingphang ca, iema'a na ama ruo lie kha ama hring chung bangkhuo ta i chi'a yi, Abyipata a ta.
Kama ta Judah Siepahruo Zedekiah kha cahaacata i chang aa: Babilon siepahruo ruekhang raw luo kha na ruetung vya chi la, ama hne a cawsaa tie re kha hrie la hring tie.
Khaapanakawma, Babilon siepahruo re a hrie lipa tie hne aa patuv pata Abyipata a ripa haata nama hne na cawsaa zaw ca zueziy, cakuona, hne puvtlung pasana ta nama thiy aa?
Babilon siepahruo re kha hrie khah ung caa tapa profet tie bie kha naathlie khah ung, tahematapakieca iema ca hangna profetbiephu khana aca chang yi.

Abyipata, kama ta pathlie va yi ang, a ta, cuorasala a cuo lipa profetbiephu kha kama ming ta ama ri, caacuonakawta kama ta caa cade'a yi angte niema hne profetbiephu caa changpa tie hne khata nama ra aa.

Cakhutaata tluobyi tie hne cawsaa bangkhuo kyihuo khata kama ta, Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Niema'a lie profetbiephu a ripa nama profet tie ta, “Abyipaing biphie zaw ca a ru hluota Babilon taata vya tlungkhyi pakhaa pata a cuo aa,” ama tapa bie kha naathlie khah ung, tahematapakieca hangna profetbiephu na ama ri.
Iema bie kha naathlie khah ung, Babilon siepahruo re kha hrie ung la hring tie ung. Khaapanakawma hingpa khypuv hing a duothlingpa ta aa li aa?

Iema ca profet ta cuo hmisi yi te, Abyipabie kha ama chunglie a aw hmisi kieca, Abyipaing chunglie hne Judah siepahruo ing chunglie hne Jerusalem lie thusepa biphie zaw kha Babilon luo a si li riypata, Cungnungce Abyipahne khata ri pakhaw yi se.
Tahematapakieca Cungnungce Abyipata lungbang zaw, rahunglepa, a tung zaw, hne khypuv lieta aa ngaa siypa biphie zaw,
Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ta Judah ming Jehoiakim sacapaa Siepahruo Jekoniah, hne Judah hne Jerusalem byi tie kha Jerusalem taata Babilon luo sii ta a sikhyi ning yi ta a sikhyi lipa tie,
Abyipaing lie, Judah siepahruo ing lie, hne Jerusalem lie aa ngaapa biphie zaw hneta aa patuv pata Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing ta hing haa hingta a ri:
Iema ca Babilon luo kha sikhyi pata cuo'a yi te, kama ta aa de i ta hluo li capa lie ca ama aw aa, Abyipata a ta. Cakhutaata kama ta kya phyathaw pakhaa'a yi angte hingpa hmang lie hing i chi'a yi.

Capa kung lie, Judah Siepahruo Zedekiah siepahruo cuo hruo aa pathu ning, kung paliyna thla pangaana thlaa lie khata, Gibeon taata, Azzur sacapaa profet Hananiah taAbyipaing lie, tluobyi tie hmiekunglie hne cawsaa bangkhuo hmiekunglieta kama'a lie a ripa bie ca,
“Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Kama ta Babilon siepahruo ruekhang kha i thli tli.
Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ta hingpa hmang taa hing ta Babilon luo a sikhyipa Abyipaing lieta biphie bangkhuo kha hingpa hmang luo hing i kya sikhyi pakhaa aa.

Kama ta Judah ming Jehoiakim sacapaa Siepahruo Jekoniah, hne Babilon luo a sipa sii ta sikhyipa bangkhuo kha hingpa hmang luo hing i vya sikhyi pakhaa'a yi, Abyipa taa ta, tahematapakieca kama ta Babilon siepahruo ruekhang kha i thli'a mangtli,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipaing lie a daapa tluobyi tie hne cawsaa bangkhuo hmiekunglie kha profet Jeremiah ta profet Hananiah kyihuo khata:

“Amen! Abyipata cahaacata tue thi se; Abyipata profetbiephu na ripa kha patling sa se, Abyipaing lie biphie zaw hne sii ta sikhyipa bangkhuo kha Babilon taata hingpa hmang luo hing vya sikhyi pakhaa thi yi se.
Cuorasala ata hingta nama thyina lie hne cawsaa bangkhuo thyina lieta i ripa bie hing naathlie tie.
Nama hne kama aw hluota, hluoning taata zaa awpa profet tie ta rietuvna, cakuona, hne puvtlung pasana zaw ruo hluvpuv lie hne pena lesapa lieta a tlung aa tapa kha profetbiephu ama za ri tli.
Diena kaw profetbiephu a ripa profet kha a aw kieca, a ripa profetbiephu a tling taa dyi khata, Abyipana profet hing a pathlie hmisi tapa kha ama pachang aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata profet Hananiah ta profet Jeremiah ruetung lie ruekhang kha la te a thli.

Cakhutaata profet Hananiah ta cawsaa bangkhuo hmiekunglie kha, “Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Mingphang bangkhuo ruetung cunglieta Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ruekhang kha kung hning chunglieta i thli aa,” a ta, ta te, ca khu pahne cata a cakuo.
Profet Hananiah ta profet Jeremiah ruetung cunglie ruekhang kha a thli khutaata a ru hluota, Abyipabie kha Jeremiah luo aa zuv:
Vaa la Hananiah kha va chang tie, Abyipa na hing haa hingta a ri: Nama ta thing ruekhang kha na thlipachung, cuorasala khapa cuopa khata thaa ruekhang na tue aa!

Tahematapakieca Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar re ama hrie riypa tana hingpa mingphang tie ruetung cunglie hing thaa ruekhang i khang aa, a re kha ama hrie hmisi aa; ama re hrie riypata ruo chung saruopa kha hmuo i pi tli, a ta.
Cakhutaata profet Jeremiah ta profet Hananiah kyihuo khata, “Naathlie tie, Hananiah, Abyipata nama kha ca pathlie vyi, nama ta hingpa cawsaa tie hing hanghiena kha na pazang sa yi.
Caacuonakawta Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Nama kha alyi cung taa hingta ica pasi sa aa. Abyipakha a du cate bie na ri nakawta, kung hning chunglie hingta na thiy aa,” a ta, a ta.
Capa kung, thla sariyna lieta profet Hananiah ca a thiy.

Profet Jeremiah ta Jerusalem taata sii ta sikhyipa tie hraw taata aa ngaapa uvthyi tie, hne tluobyi tie, profet tie, hne cawsaa bangkhuo, Nebukhadnezzar ta Jerusalem taata Babilon luo sii ta a sikhyipa tie'a luo a paphyapa caa lieta a bie ca hing haa hingta a cuo.

Capa ca siepahruo Jekoniah hne siepahruo a nung, bieripana zung byi tie, Judah hne Jerusalem luochiytuv tie, kuvzung a thepa tie, hne susatuv tie kha Jerusalem taata ama pya khutaata a capepa tana a cuo.
Caapaphya ca Shafan sacapaa Elasah hne Hilkiah sacapaa Gemariah tie kuv ta Judah Siepahruo Zedekiah ta Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar luo a paphyapa ta a cuo. Capa caa lie a ripa ca:
Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing na Jerusalem taata Babilon luo sii ta sikhyipa tie kyihuo khata hing haa hingta a ri:
Ing kha sa ung la a chunglie aw tie ung; diedung kha tue ung la a thyipaa kha ning tie ung.

Napuv kha chiy ung la sacapaa hne sacanung zaw kha sa tie ung; nama sacapaa cuota napuv chiy ung la, nama sacanung kha navaa pahnyi sa tie ung, sacapaa hne sacanung zaw kha sa yi se; khapa lie kha pungzaa ung la, a cungbung luo ta cuo khah ung.
Cuorasala niema kha sii ta ica sikhyinapa yi khypuv phana riypa kha huv ung la, a cuo khata Abyipa'a luo thlaachuo tie ung, capa ca a pha kieca niema zaw phana nama hmung aa.

Tahematapakieca Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Nama hrawlie a awpa profet tie hne hmungdawlutuv tie kha a padung sa khah ung, iema ta a ma sapa muo zaw kha naathlie khah ung.
Tahematapakieca capa ca i ming ta niema'a lie hangna profetbiephu ama ripa tana a cuo; iema kha pathlie va yi ang, Abyipata a ta.

Tahematapakieca Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Babilon lie kung sawsariy a tling thue dyi tana kama ta ca parie'a yi angte, niema'a lie i biekuona kha patling sa'a angte hingpa hmang luo hing ica vya kaakhyi pakhaa'a yi.
Niema cuota i khuotyipa ca kama dyina a pachang ang, niema phana cuota cuo te, nama rakyina cuo li pata hmieluo cuo lie anguopuona nama hnyina riypa tana a cuo, Abyipata a ta.
Cakhutaata kama'a luo kha a vaw ung cate, na ku ung cate thlaa nama chuo tiyta ica thyi'a yi.
Ina huv tiy ung cata ina hmung'a ung ciy; pathiypalung hmisi tana ina huv ung ciy tapa kieca,

icaa pahmung sa'a yi, Abyipata a ta. Cakhutaata vuophana ica pi'a yi, icaa cadenapa yi ruo hne hmang zaw taa khata ca pakiy'a yi angte, sii ta ica sikhyinapa yi hmang taa khata ica vya kaakhyi pakhaa'a yi, Abyipata a ta.
Niema ta, “Babilon lie Abyipata profet malie a pi thluo,” nama ta.
David byithude lie a tupa siepahruo, hingpa khypuv lie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo hne, niema hneta sii ta sikhyina luo a si ra lipa nama tieriy zaw hne aa patuv pata, Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri:
Cungnungce Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri, kama ta zueziy, cakuona, hne puvtlung pasana kha ama cunglie patlung sa'a angte, ning the a aw lipa thyikuv haa khata i tue'a yi.

Zueziy, cakuona, hne puvtlung pasana ca ama cunglie patlung sa pazue'a angte, alyi cunglie pena bangkhuo cuota ciy aa chiysapa ta i tue'a yi, i bie kha ama naathlie li nakawta, ica denapa yi mingphang zaw hrawlie kha chiesa riypa, ciysa riypa, hne a paruv ta kawchie ri riypa, hne pahnyisue hyalya riypata i tue'a yi, Abyipata a ta.
I changtaapa profet tie kha niema'a luo ci li pata i vya pathlie raalaa pa yi ta, i bie kha naathlie'a va yi, Abyipata a ta.
Cuorasala niema, Jerusalem taata Babilon luo sii ta sikhyipa tie ta Abyipabie hing naathlie tie ung:

I ming ta niema'a lie hangna profetbiephu a ripa Kolaiah sacapaa Ahab hne Maaseiah sacapaa Zedekiah zaw hneta aa patuv pata Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing ta hing haa hingta a ri: Iema ca Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar kuv chung luo kha pi'a yi angte, ama ta nama ming hmungna lie kha a thie'a yi.
Iema kawlie hingta Judah taata Babilon luo sii ta a dapa bangkhuo ta “Babilon Siepahruo ta myi lie a catipa Zedekiah hne Ahab haa khata Abyipata ca tue se,” tapa chiesana hing ama hmuo aa.

Tahematapakieca iema ta Israel chunglie kha hmang pha li suesaapa tue yi te, ama ingpaa napuv hneta nungvaathingsuena ama tue, kama ta i chang lipa yi hangna bie kha ama ri; kama ca capa zaw kaw ca a pachangpa hne tehte tana i cuo, Abyipata a ta.
Nehelam ming Shemaiah kyihuo khata:
Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Nama ming ta Israel lie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo, hne Maaseiah sacapaa tluobyi Zefaniah hne tluobyi bangkhuo kha caa paphya yi cate,

Abyipaama hrahring ta nama kha tluobyi Jehoiada cuopata tluobyi ta ca tue tli te, caacuonakawta profet a hriepa aa ngaapa mekaa kha hrakyi khe riypa hne ruepakaw pa-ya riypata Abyipaing lie kha byi ta na cuo aa.
Caacuonakawta khaapanakawma niema'a lie profet a hriepa Anathoth ming Jeremiah kha na chuo va?

Tahematapakieca ama ta Babilon lie kiema'a luo kha caa malie paphya te, “Hingpa hing cuo pasiypuv a vya ru aa; ing kha sa ung la a chunglie aw tie ung, cakhutaata diedung zaw kha tue ung la a thyipaa kha ning tie ung,” a ta.
Tluobyi Zefaniah ta hingpa caapaphya hing profet Jeremiah thyina lieta a ri.
Cakhutaata Abyipabie ca Jeremiah'a luo kha aa zuv:

Sii ta sikhyipa tie bangkhuo kha caa paphya yi la, Nehelam ming Shemaiah hne aa patuv pata Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Ama kha pathlie lipa angta, niema zaw hangna profetbiephu zang riypata ca pahya va yi ang,

caacuonakawta Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Kama ta Nehelam ming Shemaiah hne a ciypathla tie kha duo i te'a yi; i cawsaa zaw cunglie i tuepa phana a hmungpa cawsaa pakha hmuo ama ta hingpa cawsaa zaw hrawlie hing hnyi'a vyi, Abyipata a ta, tahematapakieca ama ca Abyipaa duna bie khana a ri.
Abyipa'a taata Jeremiah'a luo a zuvpa bie:
Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Nama'a lie i ripa bie bangkhuo hing caa-uv chunglie cape tie.

I cawsaa Israel ming hne Judah ming hmieluo cuo lie ama phana riypata i sa pakhaana cuo kha aa vaw nguoluo tli, ama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie i za pipa yi ruo luo kha kaakhyi'a yi angte iema ta ama cu aa, Abyipata a ta.
Abyipata Israel hne Judah hneta aa patuv pata a ripa bie ca hingpa hingta a cuo:
Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Kiema ta a pahlu a padana ueryi kha ma thiy, ciy aa chiypa ta cuo te, diena ta cuo vyi.
A hiehriy ung la rue tie ung, capaa ta saata a sa khu ma? Khaapanakawma nupazi pasana a angpa canung haata capaa ta ama riy dyi amaa dyi? Khaapanakawma ama hmie phya a pha va?
Capa ning ca a lesyi hringhruo cahaapa ning ca aw buo vyi; Jakob cuota palungriethyina ning tana a cuo; cuorasala ama ca capa taa cata khuo pata a cuo aa.
Cungnungce Abyipata, capa ning thue ca a ruetung taata ruekhang kha thlipachung'a angte, ama ciynapa kha i chipachung diy aa, ruohrang ming ta ama kha sii ta tue khu'a va tli yi, a ta.
Cuorasala kama ta i padaapa riypa yi ama siepahruo David hne Abyipaama Khazing re kha ama hrie aa.

Cuorasala i changtaapa Jakob, ciy khah, Abyipata a ta, Vya Israel, na nang uo khah se; tahematapakieca kama ta nama kha luohlaa ruo taata ica khuo aa, na samingsahlaa tie kha siicuona ruo taata i khuo'a yi. Jakob ca kaa'a te a dieta tah a aw aa, ahungtahmuo ama kha pachiypahuo'a vyi.
Tahematapakieca nama khuo riypa khata ica awpuo, Abyipata a ta. Ama hraw luo ica thawnapa mingphang tie kha ama chuona cuo patlung sa'a angte, cuorasala nama ca na chuona cuo patlung sa'a va ang.
Tahematapakieca Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Na hmaa ca patluo sa khu pata cuo vyi, na hmaa phyapa ca a pasa hringhruo.
Caa mangchiy riypa ahunghmuo aw va yi, na hmaa cuota siyy aw vyi, na cuota tluona aw vyi.
Na duepa zaw bangkhuo ta ca maw yi te, siysaa ta ca ri va yi; kawpacuona a hnyi lipa carie tie duotena haata, khuosa ta duo ica te, tahematapakieca na suena ca le te, a hluv hringhruo.
Khaapanakawma na hmaa kawlieta na caa? Na pasana ca patluo khu pata cuo vyi. Tahematapakieca na suena ca le te, a hluv hringhruo; kama na hingpa hmang hing na cunglie a tue ang.

Caacuonakawta nama caa cepa bangkhuo ca ce pata cuo ra'a yi te, na carie tie bangkhuo ca sii ta a dapa ama cuo aa; nama caa chuvpa ca chuv pata cuo ra'a yi te, nama kha rie lie caa patuvpa ca rie lie patuvpa tana i tue ra'a yi.
Nama kha tluona ca pi pakhaa'a angte, na hmaa kha i patluo sa aa, Abyipata a ta, tahematapakieca nama kha thawpa tana a cuo ca ta yi te, “Ahungtahmuo siysaa ama ri lipa; Zion tana a cuo,” aca ta yi.

Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Kama ta Jakob thluodaa kha vuophana pi pakhaa'a angte, a awna hmang kha kaw i pacuo aa; a tluocung lie kha khypuv ca sa pakhaa pata cuo'a te, siepahruo ing ca a aw tawna hmang lie kha aa daa pakhaa aa.
Capa zaw chung taa cata pathuosana hne, palungtluona ueryi a pya aa. Iema ca a hluvsa ta tue'a yi angte, a cawta tah cuo'a va yi; pa-uvsathyipa ta tue'a yi angte, esepa ta cuo'a va yi.
Ama haatiy zaw ca hluo ning haa khata cuo'a yi te, ama cawsaazaapuv ca kama hmiekunglie ama cusa aa; iema a tuechiepa tie kha duo i te'a yi.

Ama siepahruo ca iema chungtaata pakha ta cuo'a te, ama luochiytuv ca iema hrawtaata a pya aa; kama ta aa ngiena luo a vya chiy'a angte, ama ta inaa ngie aa, caacuolikieca ahungma kama kha naa ngie nguo aa? Abyipata a ta.
Niema ca kama cawsaa ta cuo'a ung cate, kama ca niema Khazing ta i cuo aa.
Mang tie ung, Abyipakhysuv! A hihaana na a pya, khysuv thliychie; cawsaa pha lipa tie luv cungliena a hruosue'a yi.
A ie ta a iepa Abyipahihaana ca a palung chunglie aa tingnapa kha a patlungna te ta a hrie hluo li kaa'a vyi. Hmieluo thueta hingpa hing na pachang aa.
Abyipata, capa cuo thue ca, kama ca Israel ingchungkhue bangkhuo cuota ama Khazing ta cuo'a angte, iema ca i cawsaa ta ama cuo aa, a ta.
Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Zueziy taata a lawpa tie khata ruocaapa lie kha vihnyina ama hmung; Israel ming ta a pahyna kha ama huv tiyta,
Abyipaca luohlaa taa khata kama'a lie aa vya luo aa. Kama ta nama ca chuozaa duena ta ica due; caacuonakawta zang tluo i tlanapa kha nama'a lieta i pazue.
Kama ta ca sa pakhaa'a angte, nama ca sa pata na cuo aa, Vya lesaa pathenung Israel! Naa khang kha a la pakhaa'a cate, palungtluona hneta na luo aa.
Mingsuv diedung kha Samaria tluo cunglieta na tue pakhaa aa; a lingtuv tie ta a ling'a yi te, a thyi kha ama ning aa.
Efraim tluocung ruo lieta rievetuv tie ta, “A vaw ung la, Zion luo, Abyipama Khazing'a luo kha sithaw'a ung puv,” ta pata ama khina cuo kha a vya tlung aa.

Tahematapakieca Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Jakob cuota alawna hneta khuosa ta hlaa sa tie, mingphang tie phang le cepa cuo khata khi tie; pathyi sa ung, pathuosa ung la, ri tie ung, “Vya Abyipa, na cawsaa, Israel ming aa ngaapa tie hing khuo tie yi,” ta tie ung.

Mang tie ung, Iema ca chaluo ruo taa khata a zuvkhyi'a yi angte, alyi aa hlacena taa khata i pahmya'a yi, iema hraw taa cata mingcuepa hne naaruepa, nu a phyapa hne nupazi nguoluopa, yalya ta; a phuv lesa pata, hingpa luo hing ama vya kaa aa.

Caapuo pata vya tlung'a yi te, kama ta hnaapanguona hneta i vya chiy pakhaa'a yi, Cavaa kha hrawkhyi'a yi angte, amaa pachiy lina riypata aa dangpa luopuv kha i ziykhyi'a yi; tahematapakieca kama ca Israel ming paa ta cuo'a angte, Efraim ca i sacapaa uvthyi ta a cuo aa.

Vya mingphang zaw, Abyipabie hing naathlie tie ung, hingpa hing riyliy kie ruo zaw luo, luohlaa luo kha pathyi sa tie ung; “Israel a cadaapatlaatuv khata pahmya'a te, ama kha tuvkhietuv ta a tue aa,” ta tie ung.
Tahematapakieca Abyipata Jakob kha a thla te, a cuota a cahra tuvpa kuv taa khata a khuo.

Zion tluodaw cung luo kha a vaw'a yi te khuosa ta hlaa ama sa aa, Abyipaphana cunglie kha aa li ta amaa li aa, sa, mingsuvtiy, hne chiytiy zaw cunglie hne tuvrung lie tuvtaata hne cuerung lie cuetaata zaw cunglie kha.
Cakhutaata lesaa zaw ta palungtluona hneta ama luo aa, satlie tie hne macuo tie zaw kha amaa law aa. Ama caana kha palungtluona ta thle'a angte, hnaa panguo'a yi angte, mawluo huota alawna i pi'a yi.
Tluobyi tie kha ama riy bisa pata a thupa pi'a yi angte, i cawsaa zaw ca i phana ta ama palung a tling aa, Abyipata a ta.
Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Muochiesana hne khuosa ta caana ueryi ca Ramah lieta thyi pata a cuo, Rachel ta a saata zaw kha a caa yi; ama thiy diy nakawta hnaa panguo khu'apa ta cuo vyi.
Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Caa kha a ang la na mingthliy pathla khah tie; tahematapakieca na hriena cuota lawmuo na hmung aa, Abyipata a ta: Iema ca carie tie ruo taa khata ama vya kaa aa;
nama hmieluo cuota anguopuona a aw, Abyipata a ta.

Efraim ta a ripa kha i thyi: “Nama ta na pasiypa-ya cate, i pha tli, kama ca hri lipa cuetungpa na i za lu. Naa chiy pakhaa la i vya kaa pakhaa aa, tahematapakieca nama ca Abyipai Khazing tana na cuo.
Luo i pie khutaata i ngiepachiy; hmung pakhaapa i cuo khutaata, i baw dyi kha i cung; mingnu i cuo ning i za tuepa nangzaa aa chiypa kawlie khata, I nang zaa te, i hmie a chi.

Efraim hing i duepa i sacapaa ta a cuo ma? i tlechuopa i saata ta a cuo ma? A kaw i ri kyry ta, i thyi pari. Caacuonakawta i palung lie aw pari te, a cunglie kawpacuona i hnyi hrahring aa, Abyipata a ta.

Na cuota luopuv lie aa hnangna kha tue la, pachangna tung kha a ling tie. Na ziypa luopuv, luopuv lepa kha a phasa pata rue tie. Vya lesaa pathenung Israel, vya kaa tie, hingpa na khypuv zaw luo hing vya kaa tie.
Vya zang tluo aa tla lipa sacanung, khacuo te ma naa khie cakhaw aa? Tahematapakieca alyi lie hing Abyipata hmang thaapa sa te: canung ta capaa kha ama cadung aa.

Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing ta hing haa hingta a ri: Kama ta vuophana i pi pakhaa tiy yi ta Judah ruo hne i khy zaw lie kha hingpa bie hing ama hmuo pakhaa aa: “Abyipata thluechiy ca pi se, Vya adangna a awnapa hmang, Vya tluo pathepa!”
Cakhutaata Judah hne a khy bangkhuo zaw lie ca lu a thlupa tie hne ama tuv hneta a khielepa tie zaw kha ama aw pakhaw aa.
Riethyi thaabuopa kha thaazuo thaapa pi'a yi angte, a thaa a cawpa tie kha ama thaa i pabi'a yi.
Capa lie ca a kya cha angte hmiehmie i pase, i mingkuv cing te i palung aa pysa.
Kama ta Israel ingchungkhue hne Judah ingchungkhue tie lieta cawsaa saciy hne sahring saciy i vaana cuo kha aa vaw nguoluo tli, Abyipata a ta.
Iema kha phie pathla riypa hne pa cing riypa, nuopatyi riypa hne para riypata, hne rana patlungsue riypata i za huopa haa yi khata, sa riypata hne a ling riypa tana i huo yi, Abyipata a ta.
Capa thueta ca iema ta: Paa tie ta mingsuv thyi thuepa kha ce yi te, saata zaw ama haa a zaa,” ta'a va tli yi.
Cuorasala cawsaa bangkhuo ca ama suena kawlieta thiy'a yi te, mingsuv thyi thuepa a cepa mekaa tie haa ca a zaa aa.
Israel ingchungkhue hne Judah ingchungkhue tie hneta biekuona thaapa i tuena riypa ning ca aa vaw nguoluo tli, Abyipata a ta.

Izipt ruo chungtaata pyakhyi riypata ama kuv ta ca-ya yi angte luo i chiy ning yi ta ama mingchingmingvuo tie hneta i za tuepa biekuona haa khata cuo'a vyi. Ama navaapa ta i cuo raalaa pata capa biekuona ca ama za para, Abyipata a ta.

Cuorasala capa cuo khutaata Israel ingchungkhue hneta i tue riypa biekuona ca: Kama ta i phungbie kha ama chunglieta chi'a angte ama palung cunglie kha i cape aa; cakhutaata kama ca ama Khazing cuo'a angte, iema ca i cawsaa ta ama cuo aa, Abyipata a ta.

“Abyipakha pachang tie ung,” ta pata pakha hne pakha kha a pacuv pata a chang'a va tli yi, tahematapakieca iema bangkhuo, a caw cepa taata a le cepa te khata ina pachang'a yi, caacuonakawta ama pha lina kha a ngiethe'a yi angte, ama suena kha a thyipa'a va tli yi ang, Abyipata a ta.

Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: ahungma ning hing ningchung ta khe riypata hne, thlaapa hne aasiy zaw hing zuo ta khe riypata bie a pi yi? Ahungma riyliy hing tiylaw pathu riypata bie a pi? A ming ca Cungnungce Abyipatana a cuo:
Hingpa biepina tie hing i hmiekung taata a ra biephung kieca, Israel samingsahlaa zaw hing, i hmiekunglie mingphang cuo parina taa hingta ama ra ra aa, Abyipata a ta.

Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Cungluo avuo khiy taa khu pata a cuo kieca, cakhutaata rawluo alyi hruo patuna tie zaw hing pachang khu pata a cuo kieca, ama tuepa bangkhuo kawlieta Israel samingsahlaa tie kha i thaw'a yi, Abyipata a ta.
Abyipacuota khypuv kha Hananel ingsuo taata Akiy Thlake te sa pakhaa riypa cuo ca aa vaw nguoluo tli, Abyipata a ta.
A ruoriy ca va si vie'a te, Gareb tluothlue luo kha aa dangsa pata a si aa, cakhutaata Goah luo kha aa kyi aa.

A thiypa riyy bawphie hne buvcuo bawphie zaw, hne Kidron cavaata te yalya ta ruo zaw, capa taa cata Aruo Thlake ningchiyluo te ca Abyipacuota a pathepa ta a cuo aa. Hingpa hing khatiy tahmuo pacing pata parapa cuo'a va tli.
Nebukhadnezzar siepahruo a cuonapa kung hraa hlyicari kung lie, Judah siepahruo Zedekiah siepahruo a cuonapa kung hraana lieta Abyipa'a taata Jeremiah'a luo bie aa zuv.

Capa cuo lie ca Babilon siepahruo rieka tie ta Jerusalem kha cadung yi te, profet Jeremiah ca Judah siepahruo rievetuv tie tlawhmie lie, siepahruo Zedekiah ta thaw a pathlana lie kha thaw a tla ningta a cuo.
Zedekiah ta, “Khaapanakawma profet biephu ca na ri: Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Kama ta hingpa khypuv hing Babilon siepahruo kuv chung luo pi'a angte, ama ta a la aa;

Judah Siepahruo Zedekiah ca Khaldi ming kuv chungtaata law'a vyi, cuorasala Babilon siepahruo kuv chung luo kha pi pata cuo'a te, ama hne a hmiepachaw pata bie ri'a te, ama kha a hmiepachaw pata a hmung aa;
cakhutaata Zedekiah kha Babilon luo sikhyi'a te, kama ta a cunglie re i hriena te ta capa lie ca a aw aa, Khaldi ming kha nama tuv raalaa pata te'a va ung ciy, Abyipana a ta,” a ta.
Jeremiah ta, Abyipabie na kama'a luo a zuv:
Na paasyi Shallum sacapaa Hanamel kha nama'a luo a vaw'a te, “Anathoth lieta i lu kha na calyi tie, tahematapakieca calyi pata a thla khuna adaahmang lie a awpa tana na cuo,” aca ta aa, a ta.

Cakhutaata i uvnu Hanamel ca Abyipabie haa khata rievetuv tie tlawhmie, kama'a luo kha a vaw te, “Benjamin ruo chung Anathoth lie a awpa i lu kha na calyi tie, tahematapakieca a thla pata hnyi khuna adaahmang lie tana na aw, nama huota na calyi tie” ina ta. Cakhutaata kama ta hingpa hing Abyipabie tana a cuo tapa kha i pachang.
Caacuonakawta Anathoth lie a awpa lu ca i uvnupa Hanamel'a lie kha calyi angte, tuokaa shekel suohraa hlyisariy kha pathliepa angte i pi.
Biekuona caa kha ming thuv angte, caakhe i khe, tehte tie kha ku yi angte, tuokaa kha cyipathliena lie i pathlie.
Cakhutaata ming thuv ciepa biekuona caa hne caabaw lie pasuopuo lipa a hrangpa suokha kha la angte,
i uvnupa Hanamel, ming a thuvpa tehte tie, hne rievetuv tie tlawhmie lie a tupa Judah ming bangkhuo hmiekunglie kha Mahseiah sacapaa Neriah sacapaa Baruk ca i pi.
Iema hmungna lie ca Baruk kyihuo cata,
Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa caa khepa biekuona caa hne a hrangpa suokha kha la lah, cuo pasiypuv a cu riypata alyi bire lie kha pasuo tie.
Tahematapakieca Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Ing zaw, lu zaw, mingsuv diedung zaw kha hingpa ruo chunglie hing calyi pata cuo'a va tli.
Biekuona caa kha Neriah sacapaa Baruk kha i pi khutaata Abyipa'a luo kha thlaa i chuo:
Vya AbyipaKhazing! Alyi hne avuo kha a lepa na cahrana hne na pazuopa na buo ta a sapa ca nama tana na cuo. Na cuota a ruv tuvpa suokha hmuo aw vyi.

Nama ta aa hmangpa duena kha cawsaa thaw hluvpuv cung te ta na paluo sa, cuorasala ama paa tie suena kha a vaw riypa ama saata zaw cunglieta na thung yi, Cungnungce Abyipata pata a ming a cuopa, Vya a lesyipa hne a cahrapa Khazing.
Naa tingpa ca le te na tuepa ca kharuehaapa tana a cuo; cawsaa bangkhuo luopuv kha hmung cate, ama hringzya cyicuo haata hne ama tuepa thyipaa cyicuo haa khata lawmuo na pi yi.
Izipt ruo lie kha pamangsana hne kharuehaa hmang na paluo sa, ataning tepa hingta Israel ming chunglie hne cawsaa bangkhuo hrawlieta aa pazue riypa ming pathuopa kha naa tue.
Na cawsaa Israel ming kha Izipt ruo taata pamangsana hne kharuehaa hmang, a cahrapa na kuv hne na pazupa na buo, hne ciy aa chiysa pata na pyakhyi yi.
Cakhutaata hingpa cuehnung hne khyitiy a langnapa ruo hing pi yi cate,

a ngie yi te ama cu. Cuorasala iema ta na ri caa ngie lipa yi ta na phungbie kha ziy va yi; tue riypata na changpa bangkhuo kha suokha hmuo tue va yi. Caacuonakawta hingpa riethyivuosuona bangkhuo hing ama cunglie na patlung sa.

Mang tie, hingpa khy la riypata riekhuocaaca kha sasue yi te ama cadung, khypuv ca zueziy, cakuona, hne puvtlung pasana ta ama a du nguoluopa Khaldi ming kuv chung luo kha pi pata a cuo. Na ripa a tlungpa kha nama hrahring ta na hmung.
Vya Abyipa Khazing, “Tehte tie hmielieta alyi kha tuokaa ta na calyi aa,” ina ta ciy, cuorasala khypuv ca Khaldi ming kuv chung luo na pi pata a cuo tli.
Abyipabie kha Jeremiah'a luo aa zuv:
Mang tie, kama ca cawsaa bangkhuo Khazing, Abyipatana i cuo; kama cuota a ruv tuvpa a aw ma?
Caacuonakawta Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Kama ta hingpa khypuv hing Khaldi ming kuv chung luo hne Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar kuv chung luo kha pi'a angte, ama ta a la aa.

Hingpa khypuv a dutuv Khaldi ming ca a vaw'a yi te, khypuv ca myi ta ama rue aa; kama hihaana riypata ing tluokhang cunglie kha Baal huota rangpa-ue rue'a yi te, khazing hrangpa tie'a luo kha dangpa ta panaana kha ama pihluo aa.
Israel ming hne Judah ming ca mingnu ama cuo baataata i hmungna lie kha pha lina dyina ama tue; Israel ming ca ama kuv ta ama hriepa re kha tana i hi ina pahaa yi, Abyipata a ta.
Hingpa khypuv hingta ama sa baataata ataning tepa hingta i hi dyi ina pahaa. Caacuonakawta hingpa khypuv ca i hmungna taa tana i thaw aa,

Israel ming hne Judah ming ta kama hihaana riypata ama tuepa pha lina bangkhuo, iema, ama siepahruo tie hne ama byi tie, ama tluobyi tie hne ama profet tie, Judah khypuv cawsaa tie hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie kawlieta i thaw aa.
Iema ta hnang ina chaw yi, ama hmie na pi va yi; iema kha i pacuv pari thluopa yi ta naathlie lipa yi ta i parepa yi kha cuhluo va yi.
Kama ming awnapa ing lie kha duvsamakhie aa chiypa kha chi yi te, ama papyapalyi.

Iema ta Hinnom sacapaa bawphie chunglie kha ama sacapaa hne ama sacanung zaw kha Molek'a luo pihluo riypata Baal biena khahrungtluobu kha ama sa; Judah ming suena chung luo a pangie sa riypata hingpa duvsamakhie aa chiypa hmang hing ama tue aa ta pata i palung lie zaw aw vyi, a pacuv zaw pacuv ra va yi ang.

Caacuonakawta nama na ripa hingpa khypuv hne aa patuv pata Abyipa, Israel Khazing ta hing haa hingta a ri, “Hingpa khypuv hing zueziy, cakuona, hne puvtlung pasana tana Babilon siepahruo kuv chung luo pi pata a cuo aa,” a ta.
Mang tie, i hihaana hne i pathiy a lingtuv pata i zaa cadenapa yi ruo ting taa khata i pakiy'a yi; hingpa hmang luo hing a chiy pakhaa'a yi angte, aa bangsa pata i chi'a yi.
Iema ca i cawsaa ta cuo'a yi te, kama ca ama Khazing ta i cuo aa.
Iema ca pathiypalung suokha hne hringzya suokha kha pi'a yi angte, iema phana cuota hne iema khutaata a vaw riypa ama saata zaw phana cuota cipari ta ina ciyzaa'a yi.
Chuozaa ta aa hmangpa biekuona kha iema hneta tue'a angte, iema'a lieta phana tue kha pathli'a va ang; ama pathiypalung lieta kama ciynapa kha chi'a angte, kama'a taata luo pie'a va tli yi.
Iema'a lieta phana tue kha i palung tluokhyisa'a te, i pathiypalung yalya hne i ruena yalya ta hingpa ruo chunglie hing zang tluo aa tlasa pata i pa-awsa'a yi.

Caacuonakawta Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa cawsaa tie cunglieta hingpa rana lepa bangkhuo i patlung sapa haa hingta ata lieta iema bie i kuopa yi vuophana bangkhuo hing ama cunglieta i patlung sa aa.
Cawsaa aw li, saruopa aw li pata a duothlingpa ruo tana a cuo nama tapa ruo lie ca lu kha amaa calyi aa.

Benjamin ruo chunglie, Jerusalem cahriycake lie, Judah khypuv zaw chunglie, tluocung ruo lie, Shefelah lie, hne Negeb lie zaw kha lu kha tuokaa ta calyi'a yi te, biekuona caa kha ming ama thuv aa, tehte kha ku'a yi te caakhe ama khe aa; tahematapakieca kama na vuophana a pi pakhaa'a yi ang, Abyipata a ta.
Jeremiah ca rievetuv tie tlawhmie lieta thaw a tla kaliepa khata Abyipabie ca a yihningna ta ama'a luo kha aa zuv:
A ming Abyipata pata a cuopa, alyi a sapa Abyipa, sa te a pacusapa Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri:
Na ku ung la ica palie'a yi, cakhutaata a lepa hne aa nupa, nama pachang buo lipa hmang kha ica chang'a yi.

Tahematapakieca riekhuocaaca sasuena taata hne zueziy taata a pakhuona riypata ama pacingpa khypuv chunglie ing zaw hne Judah siepahruo ing zaw hneta aa patuv pata Abyipa, Israel Khazing ta hing haa hingta a ri:

Khaldi ming ca rietuv riypa hne i hihaana hne i pathiy lingna ta i thiepa tie riyy ta hingpa khypuv zaw hing pabi riypa tana amaa vaw, tahematapakieca iema pha lina bangkhuo kawlieta hingpa khypuv hing i hmie i nuse tli.
Kama ta tluo pakhaana hne tluona kha patlung sa'a angte, iema kha patluo sa'a yi angte, lunghruo tlung hnyirungna hne abangna kha i pahmung sa'a yi.
Judah hne Israel ca ama vuophana kha pi pakhaa'a yi angte, ahluo ta ama za cuona haa khata i sa pakhaa'a yi.
Kama a du pata ama suena bangkhuo taa khata pathe sa'a yi angte, ama suena bangkhuo hne kama inaa dunapa yi kha i ngiethe'a yi.
Cakhutaata hingpa khypuv ca iema cuota i tuepa phana bangkhuo a thyipa alyi cung mingphang bangkhuo hmiekunglie pathuosana hne rungnaana, kama cuota palungtluona ming tana a cuo aa.

Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa hmang kawlieta, “Cawsaa aw li pata hne saruopa aw li pata a duothlingpa tana a cuo,” Judah khy zaw lieta cuose, Jerusalem luopuv zaw cunglieta cuose, khy a sapa aw li pata, cawsaa hne saruopa aw li pata a duothling diy tli, nama ta.

Palungtluona ueryi hne alawna ueryi, nungchiytuv satlie ueryi hne vaahnyituv lesaa ueryi, hlaasana ueryi, palungtluona pihluona kha Abyipaing luo vya cyi yi te: “Cungnungce Abyipakha palungtluona hluo tie ung, tahematapakieca Abyipaca a pha, aa hmangpa a duena ca chuozaa ta aa hmang!” tanapa ueryi zaw kha thyi pakhaa pata a cuo aa.
Cungnungce Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Cawsaa aw li, a duothlingpa ruo lie hne khy bangkhuo lie hing tuvkhietuv tie ta ama tuvrung ama pathlienapa sahring tlena hmang a aw pakhaa aa.
Tluocung ruo khy zaw lie, Shefelah lie, Negeb lie, Benjamin ruo lie, Jerusalem cahriylie, hne Judah khy zaw lie kha tuvrung zaw ca iema a rituvpa kuv rawlieta ama tle pakhaa aa, Abyipata a ta.
Israel ingchungkhue hne Judah ingchungkhue tie hneta i tuepa biekuona kha i patling sanapa cuo kha a vya tlung nguoluo tli, Abyipata a ta.
Capa cuo lie hne capa ning lie ca aa dangpa Thingce kha David cuota papu sa'a angte, ama ta ruo chunglie ca biedangpa hne adangna kha a hrie aa.
Capa cuo lie ca Judah ca khuo pata cuo'a te Jerusalem ca aa bang pata a aw aa. Ama ama kuna riypa ming ca: “Abyipaca maa dangna tana a cuo,” ta pata a cuo aa.
Tahematapakieca Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Israel ingchungkhue byithude lie a tu riypa cawsaa kha David'a lieta ci buo'a vyi,
cakhutaata Levi tluobyi tie'a lieta i hmiekunglie myirue panaana zaw, sa ta panaana zaw, hriykhungrina zaw a tue pari riypa cawsaa kha ci buo'a va yi.
Abyipa'a taata Jeremiah'a luo kha bie aa zuv:
Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Niema hrawlie pakhakha ta chung hne zuo kha amaa vaw li riypata chung hne i biekuona hne zuo hne i biekuona hing nama para khu pata a cuo kieca,
i changtaapa David hneta i tuepa biekuona kha ra'a te, a byithude lieta a tu riypa sacapaa kha hnyi li pata a aw aa, Levi ming i rehrietuv tie hneta i tuepa biekuona zaw kha a ra aa.
Avuo lie a awpa zawdya ca ri tie a aw lipa haata hne riyliy viehnang ca ri tie a aw lipa haata, i changtaapa David samingsahlaa hne i re a hrie riypa Levi ming kha i papungpazaa sa'a yi.
Abyipabie ca Jeremiah'a luo kha aa zuv:

“Abyipata aa tlawpa ingchungkhue suohning khana ama ta a thaw,” ta pata hingpa cawsaa tie ta ama ripa kha na pacuo taw ma? I cawsaa tie kha cahaacata nutaa yi te mingphang phang kha haata hmuo ri va yi.
Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Kama ta chung hne zuo, hne alyi hne avuo ziyphung kha pa cusa li pata aw biephung ang sala,

Jakob hne i changtaapa David samingsahlaa tie kha thaw pata Abraham, Isak, hne Jakob samingsahlaa tie cunglie uvtuv riypata ama samingsahlaa tie kha a tlaw li pata i aw'a yi ma? Tahematapakieca ama vuophana kha pi pakhaa yi angte, ama cunglieta kawpacuona i hnyi aa.

Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar hne a rieka bangkhuo hne alyi cung pena bangkhuo hne a pena lie cawsaa bangkhuo ta Jerusalem hne a khypuv tie kha ama tuv nguoluo ningta Abyipa'a taata Jeremiah luo a zuvpa bie ca:

“Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Judah Siepahruo Zedekiah'a luo kha vaa la va ri tie: Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa khypuv hing Babilon siepahruo kuv chung luo pi'a angte, myi ta a rue aa.
Cakhutaata nama ca ama kuv taata naa ruo aa, cuorasala ca patuv'a yi te ama'a luo aca pi'a yi: Babilon siepahruo kha a hmiepachaw pata hmung'a cate bie nama ri aa; cakhutaata Babilon luo na si aa.
Cuorasala Abyipabie hing naathlie tie, Vya Judah siepahruo Zedekiah! Abyipana nama hne aa patuv pata hing haa hingta a ri:

A dieta tana na thiy aa. Na mingchingmingvuo tie, nama hluota zaa awpa siepahruo tie cuota rangpa-ue ama za ruepa haa khata nama cuo zaw ta rangpa-ue kha rue'a yi te, muochie ca sa'a yi te, ‘Vya abyipa!’ aca ta'a yi. Tahematapakieca kama ta bie i ri tli, Abyipata a ta.”
Profet Jeremiah ta hingpa bie bangkhuo hing Judah siepahruo Zedekiah kha Jerusalem lie,
Babilon siepahruo hne a rieka tie ta Jerusalem hne a khypuv bangkhuo, Judah ruo chunglieta aa tuo kaliepa dungkhuo a hnyipa khypuv suohning ta a cuopa Lakhish hne Azekah zaw amaa du ning kha a ri.
Siepahruo Zedekiah ta sii tie hyazangna pathyi sa riypata Jerusalem lie a awpa bangkhuo hneta biekuona a tue khutaata Abyipa'a taata Jeremiah luo a zuvpa bie ca,
cawsaa bangkhuo ta Hebru sii tie, canung hne capaa kha nama palaw sa aa, tahematapakieca ahungtahmuo Judah cawsaa hrangpa kha sii ta a ziy khu'a vyi.

Cakhutaata sii tie, canung capaa bangkhuo kha pathlie pata, sii ta a ziy pakhaa li tli riypa tapa biekuona a tuepa byi tie bangkhuo hne cawsaa bangkhuo khata biekuona kha ziy yi te, sii tie kha ama pathlie.
Cuorasala capa khutaa cata ama palung a pali pakhaa te ama pathlie ciepa siicanung siicapaa tie kha sii ta amaa ziy pakhaa.
Abyipabie ca Jeremiah'a luo kha aa zuv pakhaa:
Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Kama hrahring Izipt ruo chung, siicuona ing chungtaata nama mingchingmingvuo tie i kya pyakhyi ning yi kha,

“Niema'a luo vya zaa yi te kung caruv chung re caa hriepa tlipa yi Hebru cawsaa ca kung sariy ta yi kha nama pathlie aa; iema kha nama re ama hriena taata nama pathlie aa,” a ta. Cuorasala nama mingchingmingvuo tie ta na naathlie lipa yi ta ama naa amaa parue.

Niema ca atabala lie kha nama palung a thle ung cate, pakha hne pakha a palaw sa riypa kha pathyi ung cate i hmiekunglieta re phapa nama hrie, i ming ta kupa ing chunglie, kama hmiekunglie kha biekuona nama tue.
Cuorasala capa khutaa cata nama palung a thle ung cate, iema khingna haata nama palawsa ciepa nama siicanung hne siicapaa zaw kha sii ta a ziy pakhaa ung cate i ming kha ina papyapalyi ung ciy.

Caacuonakawta, Abyipa na hing haa hingta a ri: Nama ingpaa tie hne viesaa tie kha palaw sa riypata kama ri kha naa ngie va ung ciy; kama ta lawna ica pi'a yi, zueziy'a luo lawna, cakuona'a luo lawna, hne puvtlung pasana'a luo lawna zaw ta ama cuo aa, Abyipata a ta. Alyi cunglie pena bangkhuo cuota a pahlupa riypata nama cuo aa.
I biekuona kha para yi te i hmiekunglieta ama tuepa biekuona kha a ziy lipa tie ca buv hning ta tepachung yi te, alalalieta ama cakuopa cuetaata haa tana ica tue'a yi:
Judah byi tie, Jerusalem byi tie, tiydiypa tie, tluobyi tie, hne tepachungpa cuetaata buv hning alalalieta a cakuopa ruo chung cawsaa bangkhuo ca
ama carie tie hne iema a thie khingpa tie kuv chung luo khana pi pata ama cuo aa. Ama riyy ca avuo lie a zupa pavaa zaw hne alyi lie saruopa zaw sa tana amaa li aa.
Judah siepahruo Zedekiah hne a byi tie kha ca iema a thie khingpa ama carie tie kuv luo kha i pi'a yi; iema'a taata a kaa tlipa Babilon siepahruo rieka tie'a luo kha i pi'a yi.

Kama ta bie pi'a yi angte hingpa khypuv luo hing i vya tlungkhyi pakhaa'a yi; tuv'a yi te, ama la aa, cakhutaata myi ta ama rue aa, Judah khy zaw ca khy a sapa aw li pata a duothlingpa ta i tue aa, Abyipa ta a ta.
Judah ming Josiah sacapaa Siepahruo Jehoiakim chuo ningta Abyipa'a taata Jeremiah luo a zuvpa bie ca:
Rekhab ming ingchungkhue luo kha cakuo la iema'a lie kha bie ri la, Abyipaing, a khuo khuo kha luo kha a vya chiy yi la mingsuvtiy hne dang riypa kha pi tie yi, a ta.
Caacuonakawta kama ta Habazziniah sacapaa Jeremiah sacapaa Jaazaniah, hne a uvnu tie, hne a sacapaa bangkhuo, hne Rekhab ingchungkhue ming bangkhuo kha i la yi.
Iema kha Abyipaing, ingchiypakaa a huotuv Shallum sacapaa Maaseiah khuo a cung luo, abyi tie khuo athaalie, Khazing cawsaapa, Igdaliah sacapaa Hanan sacapaa khuo chung luo kha i chiy yi.
Cakhutaata mingsuvtiy a bi ta a awpa Rekhab bire ruesyipa hne panuo zaw kha ama hmiekunglie patu angte, “Mingsuvtiy kha dang tie ung,” i ta yi.

Cuorasala iema ta na palie yi te, “Mingsuvtiy kha dang'a vapuv, tahematapakieca ma mingchingmingvuo a cuopa Rekhab sacapaa Jonadab ta, ‘Niema nama cuo zaw, nama saata tie ama cuo zaw mingsuvtiy kha khatiy ning hmuota dang'a va ung ciy, malie a ta.

Nama awnapa ruo lie hing cuo pasiypuv nama aw the riypata ing a sa'a va ung ciy, saciy cyi'a va ung ciy; mingsuv diedung a tue'a va ung ciy, acuolikie hnyi'a va ung ciy; cuorasala niema ca nama chuo chung bangkhuo ta thluodaa chunglieta nama aw aa,’ malie a ta.
