Kiema ca ma mingchingmingvuo a cuopa Rekhab sacapaa Jonadab bie malie a taapa bangkhuo kha a ngie pate, kiema, ma napuv zaw, ma sacapaa zaw, acuolikie ma sacanung zaw ta pata ma chuo chung bangkhuo mingsuvtiy dang vapuv,
awna riypata ing zaw a sa vapuv. Kiema ta mingsuv diedung zaw hnyi vapuv, saciy zaw tuv vapuv.
Cuorasala kiema ca thluodaa lie kha aw pate, ma mingchingmingvuo Jonadab ta bie malie a pipa bangkhuo kha ziy pate ma tue.

Cuorasala Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ta ruo a du riypata a kya sithaw tiyta, ‘A vaw tie ung, Khaldi rieka tie hne Aramean rieka tie kha ma ciy nakaw yi ta Jerusalem luo kha si'a ung puv,’ ma ta. Capa ca na Jerusalem lie ma awnapa hingta a cuo,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipabie ca Jeremiah luo kha aa zuv:

Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Cakuo la Judah ming hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie kha, “Kama'a taa hingta a cuv khu lipa ung cata i bie hing naathlie khu va ung ca ma? Abyipata a ta.

Rekhab sacapaa Jonadab ta a ciypathla zaw kha mingsuvtiy dang li riypata bie a pipa yi ca ziy yi te, ataning tepa hingta khaapahmuo dang va yi, tahematapakieca iema ta ama mingchingmingvuo tie biepina kha ama ziy. Cuorasala kama hrahring ta niema'a lie kha i ri canyi pari, cadyiseca i ri naa ngie va ung ciy.

I changtaapa profet tie kha niema'a luo pathlie canyi pari yi angte, ‘Niema pakha cyicuo ta nama hringzya pha lipa taa khata a vya maa tie ung, nama zya kha a pare ung la khazing hrangpa tie kha ama re hrie riypata ziy khah ung, cata a cuo kie dyina niema hne nama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lieta ica pipa yi ruo lie kha nama aw aa,’ ica ta yi. Cuorasala na naathlie va ung ciy, i ri naa ngie va ung ciy.
Rekhab sacapaa Jonadab ciypathla tie ca ama mingchingmingvuo tie biepina kha ama ziy, cuorasala hingpa cawsaa tie hingta i ri kha naa ngie va yi.

Caacuonakawta, Cungnungce Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Judah hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa bangkhuo cunglie kha i patlung sa aa i tapa rana mekaa i patlung sa aa, tahematapakieca iema'a lie kha ri tli angte, naathlie va yi, ku yi angte na chaw va yi.”

Cuorasala Abyipa ta Rekhab ingchungkhue kyihuo khata: Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Nama mingchingmingvuo Jonadab biepina kha nama ziy nakawta, hne a phungluo kha ziy ung cate, a biepipa kha nama tue nakawta,
Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Rekhab sacapaa Jonadab ca khatiy tahmuo i hmiekunglie a daa riypa a ciypathla ci buo hluo'a vyi, a ta.
Judah ming Josiah sacapaa Jehoiakim siepahruo a cuona kung paliyna lie kha, hingpa bie hing Abyipa'a taata Jeremiah luo aa zuv:
Caataw kha la lah Israel hne Judah hne mingphang bangkhuo kawlieta ica changpa bie kha nama ica chang ning taa khata, Josiah chuo taata ataning tepa hingta cape tie.
Judah ingchungkhue ta iema cunglie tue riypata i tingpa rana kha ama thyi tiyta a pha lipa ama hringzya taa khata a vya maa yi te, ama pha lina hne ama suena kha i ngiethe'a yi.
Cakhutaata Neriah sacapaa Baruk kha Nehemiah ta ku te, Abyipata ama'a lie a changpa bie, Jeremiah ta a upa bangkhuo kha Baruk ta caataw lie kha a cape.
Cakhutaata Jeremiah ta Baruk kha biepi te, “Kama ca Abyipaing chung luo a ngie riypa kha thlu pata i cuo;

caacuonakawta sa a uvna ning lie kha namata tah cakuo la, Abyipaing chunglie cawsaa zaw thyina lie kha kama ta ca u angte na capepa, caataw lie'apa Abyipabie kha na ri aa. Ama khy zaw taata a khawpa Judah ming bangkhuo thyina lie zaw kha na ri aa.

Tahematapakieca hingpa cawsaa tie cunglieta Abyipahihaana hne pathiylingna ca a lesa nakawta, ama hringzya pha lipa taa khata a vya pali'a yi te Abyipahmiekung luo kha a vaw pata paa ama vya kie ngiethie thlu aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Neriah sacapaa Baruk ca profet Jeremiah ta bie a pipa bangkhuo, Abyipaing chunglie, caataw taata Abyipabie ri riypa kha a tue.

Judah ming Josiah sacapaa Jehoiakim siepahruo a cuona kung pangaa kung, thla cakyna thlaa lie kha Jerusalem lie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo hne Judah khy zaw taata Jerusalem luo a vawpa bangkhuo khata Abyipahmiekunglie kha sa-uvna ama tue.

Cakhutaata cawsaa bangkhuo thyina lie kha Baruk ta caataw taata Jeremiah bie kha a ri. Capa caa a rinapa hmang ca chaluo tlawhmie, Abyipaing Thlake Thaapa luo a ngienapa, Abyipaing chunglie, caacapetuv Shafan sacapaa Gemariah khuo chunglie khata a cuo.
Shafan sacapaa Gemariah sacapaa Mikaiah ta Abyipabie kha a thyi tiyta,
siepahruo ing, caacapetuv khuo luo kha a zuv ca; caacapetuv Elishama, Shemaiah sacapaa Delaiah, Akhbor sacapaa Elnathan, Shafan sacapaa Hananiah, hne byi tie bangkhuo ca capa lie ca amaa zaa tu.
Cakhutaata Mikaiah ta cawsaa zaw thyina lieta caataw chungtaata Baruk ta a ripa bie bangkhuo ca a chang yi.

Caacuonakawta byi tie ca ta Kushi sacapaa Shelemiah sacapaa Nethaniah sacapaa Jehudi kha, “Cawsaa zaw thyina lieta na ripa caataw kha a vya cyi la a vaw tie,” ta riypata ama pathlie. Cahaacata Neriah sacapaa Baruk ca caataw kha a kuv lie vya cyile te iema'a luo ca aa vaw.
Iema ta, “A tu la malie ripa tie,” ama ta. Caacuonakawta Baruk ta a ripa yi.
Bie bangkhuo kha ama thyi tiyta, thlaazang pata pakha hne pakha kha a mang yi te, Baruk kyihuo khata, “Hingpa bie bangkhuo hing siepahruo ma pathyi sa hrahring na a hu,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Baruk kha, “Malie chang tie, tuokhaatama hingpa bie bangkhuo hing na cape? Ama ma caa u?” ta pata ama hiehriy.
Baruk ta palie yi te, “Hingpa bie bangkhuo hing ama ta na u te, kama ta caataw chunglie hing caatiy ta i cape,” a ta.
Cakhutaata byi tie ta Baruk kha, “Cakuo la nama hne Jeremiah hne khata a nu tie ung, khaapaliema nama aw tapa kha pakha tahmuo ca pachang khah yi se,” ama ta.
Caataw kha caacapetuv Elishama khuo chunglie chi siy yi te, siepahruo'a luo kha cakuo yi te bie bangkhuo kha ama chang.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ta caataw la riypata Jehudi kha a pathlie, caacapetuv Elishama khuo chung taa cata va la te, siepahruo hne a thaalie a tupa byi tie bangkhuo kha a ripa yi.
Siepahruo ca thlasiy thlaa ningta a awnapa khuo lie kha aw te (thla caky thlaa ningta a cuo) a hmiekunglieta myipung a aw.
Jehudi ta ri te tluo thung tluo paliy a chiy kyry ta, siepahruo ta caahnaa tenapa cizung ta te te, myipung lie myi chung luo kha a thaw chaw, caataw a chuona te khata myipung lie myi khata a rue.
Siepahruo hne hingpa bie bangkhuo a thyipa a changtaapa tie ahungtahmuo thlaazang pata a pang a thlaapa aw va yi.
Elnathan hne Delaiah hne Gemariah ta siepahruo kha caataw rue li riypa kha paa ama kie raalaa pata khing vyi.

Cakhutaata siepahruo ta siepahruo sacapaa Jerahmeel hne Azriel sacapaa Seraiah hne Abdeel sacapaa Shelemiah kha caacapetuv Baruk hne profet Jeremiah kha patuv riypata a pathlie yi. Cuorasala Abyipata iema kha a nu yi.
Jeremiah ta u te Baruk ta a capepa caataw chunglie bie kha siepahruo ta myi ta a rue khutaata, Abyipabie ca Jeremiah'a luo kha aa zuv:
Caataw hrangpa kha la lah, Judah Siepahruo Jehoiakim ta myi ta a ruepa caataw taapa lie a awpa bie bangkhuo kha cape tie.

Judah Siepahruo Jehoiakim hne aa patuv pata na ri riypa ca: Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa caataw hing rue nguo cate, khaapanakawma hingpa chunglie hing Babilon siepahruo ca a vaw hrahring'a te, hingpa ruo hing a para aa, cakhutaata cawsaa cuose, saruopa cuose a thie diy'a yi, ta pata na cape? na ta.

Caacuonakawta Judah Siepahruo Jehoiakim hneta aa patuv pata Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Ama ca David byithude lie a tu riypa pakha hmuo hnyi'a vyi, cakhutaata a riyy ca ningchung ta ningling luo hne zuo ta cahue luo kha thaw pata a cuo aa.

Cakhutaata a samingsahlaa hne a changtaapa tie kha ama pha lina cuota duo i te'a yi; iema hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie, hne Judah cawsaa tie cunglie kha iema kha pachiyna yi angte ama naathlie lipa rana bangkhuo kha i patlungsue'a yi.

Cakhutaata Jeremiah ta caataw hrangpa kha la te, Neriah sacapaa caacapetuv Baruk kha a pi, Judah Siepahruo Jehoiakim ta myi lie a ruepa caataw chunglie a awpa bie bangkhuo kha Jeremiah ta u te a cape; aa lupa bie a hluvsa zaw kha capa lie ca a bechiy.
Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ta Judah ruo lie siepahruo ta a tuepa Jehoiakim sacapaa Koniah kha Josiah sacapaa Zedekiah ta aa thle.
Cuorasala profet Jeremiah'a taata a ripa Abyipabie kha ama ta cuose, a changtaapa zaw ta cuo yi se, ruo chung cawsaa tie zaw ta cuo yi se naathlie va yi.
Siepahruo Zedekiah ta Shelemiah sacapaa Jehukal hne Maaseiah sacapaa tluobyi Zefaniah kha profet Jeremiah'a luo ca pathlie yi te, “Abyipama Khazing'a luo kha thlaa malie chuopa tie,” ama ta.
Jeremiah ca cawsaa hrawlie a ngie a pya a ta kalie, tahematapakieca thaw pathla pata cuo valie.
Capa cuo lie ca Faro rieka tie kha Izipt taata ama kya pya, capa thuohlaa ca Jerusalem a cadung nguoluopa Khaldi ming ta ama thyi tiyta Jerusalem taata hnang luo amaa saw.
Cakhutaata Abyipabie ca Jeremiah'a luo kha aa zuv:

Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Niema pahning ta kama kha bie hiehriy riypata caa pathlietuv yi Judah siepahruo nama chang riypa ca hingpa hing tana a cuo, niema a bya riypata a kya pyapa Faro rieka tie ca ama ruo luo, Izipt luo khana ama kaa aa.
Cakhutaata Khaldi ming kha vya kaa'a yi te, hingpa khypuv hing tuv'a yi te myi ta ama rue aa.
Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Niema hne niema kha, “Khaldi ming ca kiema'a taata ama pya hrahring aa,” ta pata a dung khah ung, tahematapakieca ca sise'a va yi.
Niema caa du nguoluopa Khaldi rieka yalya hing nama te zawta, hmaa a hmung yi te ama thluodaa lie a ngaapa tie khata, vya thu'a yi te hingpa khypuv hing myi ta ama rue aa.
Faro rieka tie amaa kya ngiele nakawta Khaldi ming ca Jerusalem taa khata amaa saw.
Jeremiah ca Benjamin ruo luo si pata capa cawsaa tie'a taata a cuvu kha hmung riypata Jerusalem taa khata aa tha.
Benjamin Thlake luo a chiypa khata capa lie rievetuv ta a cuopa Hananiah sacapaa Shelemiah sacapaa Irijah ta, “Nama ca Khaldi ming'a luona naa hlaw yi,” ta te a patuv.
Jeremiah ta, “Hangbie tana a cuo, Khaldi ming'a luo a hlaw va yi ang,” a ta. Cuorasala Irijah ta naathlie vyi, Jeremiah kha patuv te byi tie'a luo kha a chiykhyi.
Byi tie ca ama hi haa laalaw te, ama kha tuv yi te caacapetuv Jonathan ing lie kha thaw ama pathla; capa ing ca thaw-ing ta ama za tue tlipa ta a cuo.
Cahaacata Jeremiah ca alyi raw a khuo chunglie kha ning hluvpuv a aw.

Cakhutaata Siepahruo Zedekiah ta ama kha paku sa yi te aa taw. Siepahruo ta a ing lie kha a paruvta tah bie hiehriy te, “Abyipa'a taata bie suokhakha a aw ma?” a ta. Jeremiah ta, “A aw!” a ta. Cakhutaata, “Nama ca Babilon siepahruo kuv luo na pi pata na cuo aa,” a ta.
Jeremiah ta Siepahruo Zedekiah kyihuo khata, “Nama cunglie cuose, na changtaapa tie cunglie hne hingpa cawsaa tie cunglie hing khaapa tue chie angte ma thaw ina pathla ciy? a ta.
‘Babilon siepahruo ca a vaw pata hingpa ruo hing a du'a va tli,’ caa tapa nama'a lie profetbiephu a ripa profet ca khaapaliema a aw?
Na naathlie tie, i byipaapa siepahruo: paa ica kiena hing na naathlie thi tie, caacapetuv Jonathan ing luo kha thiy riypata na pathlie pakhaa thi khah,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Zedekiah ta bie pi yi te, Jeremiah ca rievetuv tie tlawhmie lie kha ama chi. Khypuv chunglie viechuo a chuona te ta, viechuo tuetuv tie luopuv taata viechuo tluo kha kha ningting ta ama pi. Cahaacata Jeremiah ca rievetuv tlawhmie lie ca a aw.
Mattan sacapaa Shefatiah, Pashhur sacapaa Gedaliah, Shelemiah sacapaa Jukal, hne Pashhur sacapaa Malkhiah tapa tie ta Jeremiah ta cawsaa bangkhuo lieta a ripa bie kha ama thyi.

Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri, Hingpa khypuv lie a awpa tie ca zueziy, cakuona, hne puvtlung pasana tana ama thiy aa; cuorasala Khaldi ming'a luo a pyapa tie ca ama hring aa; hruosue ta patuvpa haa khata ama hring aa.
Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa khypuv hing Babilon siepahruo rieka tie kuv chung luo kha pi pata cuo hrahring'a te ama la aa,” a ta, a ta.

Cakhutaata byi pakha ta siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Hingpa cawsaa hing thie riypa tana a cuo, tahematapakieca hing haapa bie hing a ri nakawta khypuv chunglie aa ngaapa rieka tie hne cawsaa bangkhuo tie thaa na a pachi. Hingpa cawsaapa hing cawsaa phana a huvpa cuo li pata cawsaa chiena a huvpa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Siepahruo Zedekiah ta, “Hinglie hing a aw hing; niema kuv chungliena a aw; siepahruo ca niema khingna kha ca thlu khu va yi,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Jeremiah kha la yi te rievetuv tie tlawhmie lieta a awpa Malkhiah takhue chung luo kha ama thaw, khuhriy ta ama pathla. Capa takhue lie ca tiy aw vyi, caakaw dyina a aw, Jeremiah ca caakaw chung luo ca a tla.
Siepahruo ing lie a awpa Ethiopia tiydiypa Ebed-melek ta Jeremiah na takhue chung luo ama pathla tapa kha a thyi. Siepahruo ca Benjamin Thlake lie kha aa tu ningta a cuo,
caacuonakawta Ebed-melek ca siepahruo ing taa khata pya te siepahruo kyihuo khata,

“I byipaapa siepahruo, hingpa cawsaa tie ta profet Jeremiah'a lieta ama tuepa bangkhuo hing pha hrahring vyi, nangdiy pata a thiy riypa tana takhue chung luo ama thaw, tahematapakieca khypuv chunglie viechuo aw va tli,” a ta.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ta Ethiopia cawsaapa Ebed-melek kha bie pi te, “Hingpa taa hingta cawsaa pathung kha a la yi la profet Jeremiah ca a thiy hluo khata takhue chung taa khata vaa da tie ung,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Ebed-melek ca cawsaa tie hne cata siepahruo ing luo kha cakuo yi te, chechiy china ing, caw chinapa taa khata caw hlungpa a tlaa tlipa tie kha la yi te khue chunglie Jeremiah'a luo kha khuhriy ta ama pathla.
Cakhutaata Ethiopia cawsaapa Ebed-melek ta Jeremiah kha, “Pangcaw kha na zaakali hne khuhriy alalalie kha a padie tie,” a ta. Jeremiah ta cahaacata a tue.
Cakhutaa cata Jeremiah ca khuhriy cata a da yi te takhue taa cata ama papya. Jeremiah ca rievetuv tie tlawhmie lie ca a aw.

Siepahruo Zedekiah ta profet Jeremiah'a luo kha cawsaa pathlie yi te, Abyipabiena-ing luo a ngienapa a suothungna lie kha aa taw. Siepahruo ta Jeremiah kyihuo khata, “Bie hiehriy riypa chekha na ica hnyi; kama'a lieta na nupa suokha hmuo zaw khah se” a ta.
Jeremiah ta Zedekiah kyihuo khata, “Ica chang kieca, ina thie'a ciy cuo va ma? Ruena ica pi kiema na naathlie'a vaciy,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta siepahruo Zedekiah ta Jeremiah'a lie kha a paruvta tah chie a sa te, “Hringna malie a pipa Abyipaa hringpa haata, nama kha ca thie'a va ang, caa thie khingpa hingpa cawsaa tie kuv chung luo zaw hing ca pi'a va ang,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Jeremiah ta Zedekiah kyihuo khata, “Abyipa, Cungnungce Khazing, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri, Babilon siepahruo byi tie'a lie kha naa pi kieca, na hringna kha aa bang aa, hingpa khypuv hing myi ta rue pata cuo'a vyi, nama hne na ingchungkhue kha nama hring aa.
Cuorasala Babilon siepahruo byi tie'a lie kha naa pi li kieca, hingpa khypuv hing Khaldi ming kuv chung luo pi pata cuo'a te, myi ta ama rue aa, nama zaw iema kuv taata law'a vaciy,” a ta.
Siepahruo Zedekiah ta Jeremiah kyihuo khata, “Khaldi ming'a luo a ruopa Judah ming khana i ciy yi, tahematapakieca iema kuv chung luo kha na pi'a yi te ina ese hyalya'a yi,” a ta.
Jeremiah ta, “Cahaacata cuo'a vyi. Kama ta nama'a lie i ripa Abyipabie hing ziy thluo tie, na cuota a pha aa, na hringna zaw aa bang aa.
Cuorasala a pi li riypata bie naa chi kieca, Abyipata ina pahmung sapa ca hingpa hing tana a cuo.

Judah siepahruo ing chunglieta aa ngaapa canung bangkhuo kha Babilon siepahruo abyi tie'a luo kha sikhyi'a yi te, iema ta, ‘Naa ringchuosapa na viesaa tie ta ca te yi te na ling aca pazue yi; na phyi ca caakaw chunglie a taa te, aca thuse yi,’ aca ta'a yi.

Na napuv hne na saata zaw bangkhuo kha Khaldi ming ta sikhyi diy'a yi te, nama hrahring zaw iema kuv taata law'a vaciy, cuorasala Babilon siepahruo ta ca patuv'a te, hingpa khypuv zaw hing myi ta a rue aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Zedekiah ta Jeremiah kyihuo khata, “Hingpa bie-aruenapa hing ahunghmuo pachang sa'a vaciy, caacuolikieca na thiy aa.

Nama hne ma ripa hing byi tie ta ama pachang kieca nama'a luo kha a vaw'a yi te, ‘Siepahruo'a lie na ripa kha malie chang tie; kiema'a lieta bie nu khah, caacuolikieca maca thie aa. Siepahruo ta nama'a lie khaapama a ri?’ aca ta'a yi, a ta.
Cakhutaata nama ta iema kha, ‘I thiyna riypata Jonathan ing luo kha ina paphya pakhaa li riypa tana siepahruo kha paa i kie,’ na ta aa,” a ta.

Byi tie bangkhuo khata Jeremiah'a luo kha a vaw yi te ama kha bie ama hiehriy; ama ta siepahruo ta bie a pina dadang khata bie suohning a palie yi. Caacuonakawta iema ta bie hiehriy va tli yi, tahematapakieca capa bie-aruenapa ca ahungtahmuo pachang va yi.
Cakhutaata Jeremiah ca Jerusalem ama lana te khata rievetuv tlawhmie lie ca a aw.
Judah Siepahruo Zedekiah siepahruo a cuona kung caky kung, thla hraa thlaa lie kha Babilon siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar hne a rieka zaw bangkhuo ta a vaw yi te Jerusalem kha ama cadung.
Zedekiah siepahruo a cuona kung hraa hlyikha kung, thla paliyna, ning cakyna lie kha khypuv dungkhuo ca ama phawpahaw.

Jerusalem kha ama la tiyta, Babilon siepahruo byi tie bangkhuo ca a vaw yi te a liekhingkhuo thlake lie kha amaa tu: Nergal-sharezer, Samgar-nebo, Rabsaris ming Sarsekhim, Rabmag ming Nergal-sharezer, hne a hrangpa Babilon siepahruo byi tie bangkhuo ta ama cuo.

Judah Siepahruo Zedekiah hne rieka tie bangkhuo ta iema kha ama hmung tiyta, amaa ruo, siepahruo diedung taata khy dungkhuo lungruetlepie suohning alalalie thlake luo kha ziy yi te khypuv chung taa khata amaa ruo; Arabah luo kha amaa ruo.

Cuorasala Khaldi rieka tie khata a cade yi te, Zedekiah ca Jeriko ase lie kha ama pha; ama patuv khutaata Hamath ruo chung, Riblah lieta Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar'a luo kha sikhyi yi te a cunglie biechipana a tue.
Babilon siepahruo ta Zedekiah sacapaa zaw kha Riblah lieta a ming hmungna lie kha a thie yi. Babilon siepahruo ca ta Judah byi bangkhuo zaw kha a thie yi.
Zedekiah ca a mingpalung kha thue te Babilon luo sikhyi riypata hrakyi a khe.
Khaldi ming ta siepahruo ing hne cawsaa ing zaw kha myi ta rue yi te, Jerusalem dungkhuo kha ama pacing.
Cakhutaata rievetuv tie riekabyi Nebuzaradan ta cawsaa aa ngaapa, khychung lieta thusepa tie, hne iema'a luo a ruopa tie, aa ngaapa cawsaa tie kha Babilon luo sii ta a sikhyi yi.
Rievetuv tie riekabyi Nebuzaradan ta khaapahmuo a hnyi lipa siypasa tie kha Judah ruo lie ca thuse yi te, mingsuv diedung hne lu zaw kha a pi yi.
Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ta Jeremiah hne aa patuv pata rievetuv tie riekabyi Nebuzaradan kha bie pi te,
“Ama kha va la lah, a phata tah mangsang tie, a cunglie ruvna tue'a vaciy, cuorasala aca changpa haa khata a cunglie na tue aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta rievetuv tie riekabyi Nebuzaradan, Rabsaris ming Nebushazban, Rabmag ming Nergal-sharezer, hne Babilon siepahruo byi lepa tie bangkhuo ta

cawsaa pathlie yi te Jeremiah ca rievetuv tie tlawhmie taa khata ama va la. Iema ta ing luo a chiyle riypata Shafan sacapaa Ahikam sacapaa Gedaliah kuv lie kha ama pi. Caacuonakawta ama ca a cawsaa tie hne khata a aw.
Rievetuv tie tlawhmie lie a aw ning khata Abyipabie ca Jeremiah'a luo kha aa zuv:

Cakuo la Ethiopia cawsaapa Ebed-melek kha va chang tie: Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa khypuv kawlieta i ripa bie, phana cuo li pata pha lina kha i patling sa aa, capa ning thue ca na hmungna lieta iema cunglie a tling aa.
Cuorasala capa ning lie ca nama kha ca khuo'a angte, na ciypa tie kuv luo kha pi pata cuo'a vaciy, Abyipata a ta.
Tahematapakieca nama kha ca khuo hmisi'a angte, zueziy ta thiy'a vaciy; cuorasala kama kha inaa ringchuo nakaw ca ta hruosue haa khata na hringna aa bang aa, Abyipata a ta.
Rievetuv tie riekabyi Nebuzaradan ta Jeremiah kha Jerusalem hne Judah ming sii ta sikhyipa bangkhuo hne khata hrakyi khe te Ramah taata a sikhyi ningta Abyipa'a taata ama'a luo bie aa zuv.
Rievetuv tie riebyipa ta Jeremiah kha la te, “Abyipana Khazing ta hingpa hmang lie hing, hingpa ranapa hingna i patlungsue aa a za ta tli;

tahematapakieca nama bangkhuo ta Abyipa'a lie kha sue ung cate, a ueryi kha nama naathlie li nakawta, ata hing Abyipata vya patlung'a nang hmisi te a ripa haata a tue tli. Caacuonakawta hingpa hmang hing nama cunglieta a tlung tli.

Mang tie, ataning hing kama ta hrakyi khepa na cuona taata ica palaw sa tli. Kama hneta Babilon luo na si ra khing kieca, vya si ra tie, a phasa pata ica mangsang aa; cuorasala Babilon luo kha kama hneta na si ra khing li kieca, na vya si ra a hu vyi. Mang tie, ruo yalya ca na hmiekunglieta a aw hing, a pha na tanapa khaapa luo a cuo zaw ta na si khu.

Naa zaa ngaa kieca, Babilon siepahruo ta Judah khy zaw uvtuv ta re a pipa tie Shafan sacapaa Ahikam sacapaa Gedaliah'a luo kha kaa la, ama'a lie cawsaa zaw hrawlie kha aw tie; acuolikie na khingna luo kha si tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta rievetuv tie riekabyi ta ning riypa hne lasaw zaw kha pi te a pathlie.
Cakhutaata Jeremiah ca Mizpah lieta Ahikam sacapaa Gedaliah'a luo kha vaa te ama'a lie, ruo lieta thusepa cawsaa zaw hrawlie kha a aw.

Ruo chunglie a awpa riedutuv tie luochiytuv zaw hne iema phuv tie khata, Babilon siepahruo ta Gedaliah kha ruo uvtuv ta tue siy te na, Babilon luo sii ta sikhyi lipa ruo chunglie siypasa cepa tie, capaa, canung, haatiy, tapa tie kha ama'a luo amaa pi diy tapa kha ama thyi tiyta,

Mizpah lie Gedaliah'a luo kha ama vaa. Iema ca Nethaniah sacapaa Ishmael, Kareah sacapaa Johanan, Tanhumeth sacapaa Seraiah, Netofah ming Efai sacapaa tie, Maakath sacapaa Jezaniah, iema hne ama phuv tie ta ama cuo.

Shafan sacapaa Ahikam sacapaa Gedaliah ta iema hne ama phuv tie kha chiesana patue sa yi te, “Khaldi ming re hrie riypa kha ciy khah ung. Ruo chunglie hing aw ung la Babilon siepahruo re kha hrie tie ung, nama cuo ta a pha aa.

Kama ca kiema'a luo a vawpa Khaldi ming hmiekunglie kha niema cuopa ta bie ri riypata Mizpah lie hing i aw aa. Cuorasala niema ca mingsuvtiy hne, cuovuo thingthyi hne chiytiy kha pakhaw ung la nama bi zaw chunglie kha a pacung tie ung, cakhutaata nama lapa khy tie lie kha aw tie ung,” a ta yi.

Cahaacata Moab hne Ammon ming hrawlie hne Edom hne a hrangpa ruo lie a awpa Judah ming bangkhuo ta Babilon siepahruo na Judah ming aa ngaapa tie kha thuse yi te Shafan sacapaa Ahikam sacapaa Gedaliah kha iema cunglie uvtuv ta a tue tapa kha ama thyi tiyta,
Judah ming bangkhuo ca amaa chepatlaanapa hmang zaw taa khata Judah ruo luo, Mizpah lieta Gedaliah'a luo kha ama vya kaa; cakhutaata mingsuvtiy hne cuovuo thingthyi kha a hluvsa ta ama pakhaw.
Kareah sacapaa Johanan hne ruo chunglie a awpa riedutuv tie luochiytuv tie ca Mizpah lieta Gedaliah'a luo kha a vaw yi te,
ama kyihuo khata, “Ammon ming siepahruo Baalis ta nama thie riypata Nethaniah sacapaa Ishmael a vya pathliepa kha na pachang ma?” ama ta. Cuorasala Ahikam sacapaa Gedaliah ta iema kha zang va yi.

Cakhutaata Kareah sacapaa Johanan ta Mizpah lieta Gedaliah kha a paruvta tah, “Nethaniah sacapaa Ishmael thie riypata kama kha na pathlie tie, pakha tahmuo pachang'a va yi. Khaapanakawma nama'a lie aa hmyapa Judah ming bangkhuo ca a chepatlaa'a pate, aa ngaapa Judah ming ra riypata nama ca aca thie aa?” a ta.
Cuorasala Ahikam sacapaa Gedaliah ta Kareah sacapaa Johanan kyihuo khata, “Cahaapa ca tue khah, tahematapakieca Ishmael kawlie na ripa ca hangbie tana a cuo,” a ta.

Thla sariy thlaa lie kha, siepahruo chungkha ta cuo te, siepahruo byi lepa pakha ta a cuopa, Elishama sacapaa Nethaniah sacapaa Ishmael ca cawsaa pahraa hneta Mizpah lieta Ahikam sacapaa Gedaliah'a luo kha amaa vaw. Mizpah lie ca viechuo ama ning hnepa khata,
Nethaniah sacapaa Ishmael hne cawsaa pahraa tie ca thu yi te Ahikam sacapaa Gedaliah kha zueziy ta ama thie, tahematapakieca Babilon siepahruo ta ruo uvtuv ta a chi nakawta a cuo.
Ishmael ta Mizpah lie Gedaliah hneta a awpa Judah ming bangkhuo zaw kha thie yi te, capa lie a awpa Khaldi rieka tie zaw kha a thie yi.
Gedaliah ama thie khutaata ning khanapa, ahungtahmuo ama pachang hluo khata,

caw tlaapa a hryi yi te ama hmyahming a ngupa, ama pangpa lie amaa uochinapa a awpa cawsaa saw cari ca Abyipabiena-ing chunglie sa ta panaana hne rangpa-ue pihluo riypata Shekhem hne Shiloh hne Samaria taa khata ama vya chiy.
Cakhutaata Nethaniah sacapaa Ishmael ca iema a taw riypata a caapuo pata Mizpah taa khata a vya pya. Iema kha aa taw tiy yi ta ama ta, “Ahikam sacapaa Gedaliah'a luo kha a vaw tie ung,” a ta yi.
Khypuv liekhingkhuo hraw ama chiypa khata Nethaniah sacapaa Ishmael hne cawsaa pahraa cata iema kha thie yi te, takhue chung luo ama thaw.

Cuorasala Ishmael kyihuo khata, “Kiema kha malie thie khah, tahematapakieca jungsacuo, barli, chiytiy, hne khyitiy pacung pate lu lieta ma nupa na a aw,” ama ta. Caacuonakawta a kuv a cadang te, iema kha ama viesaa tie hrawlieta thie va yi.

Ishmael ta a thiepa cawsaa tie riyy bangkhuo a thawnapa takhue ca takhue lesa pata cuo te, Siepahruo Asa ta Israel Siepahruo Baasha a duna riypata a za cupa ta a cuo; Nethaniah sacapaa Ishmael ta capa takhue ca a thiepa tie riyy ta a pabi.

Cakhutaata Mizpah lieta aa ngaapa cawsaa bangkhuo, Mizpah lieta ama thusepa siepahruo sacanung tie hne cawsaa bangkhuo, rievetuv tie riekabyi Nebuzaradan ta Ahikam sacapaa Gedaliah'a lie a pi siypa tie kha Ishmael ta sii ta aa da diy yi. Nethaniah sacapaa Ishmael ta iema kha sii ta a da yi te Ammon ruo luo kha aa chiy yi.
Cuorasala Kareah sacapaa Johanan hne riedutuv tie luochiytuv bangkhuo ta Nethaniah sacapaa Ishmael ta a tuepa pha lina kaw kha ama thyi tiyta,
ama cawsaa bangkhuo kha la yi te, Nethaniah sacapaa Ishmael kha tuv riypata amaa tha. Ama kha Gibeon lie a awpa tiy-ang lesapa lie kha ama pha.
Ishmael hneta a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo khata Kareah sacapaa Johanan hne riedutuv tie luochiytuv bangkhuo kha ama hmung tiyta amaa lawsa.
Caacuonakawta Ishmael ta Mizpah taata sii ta aa dapa cawsaa bangkhuo ca a vya pali yi te Kareah sacapaa Johanan luo kha ama vya kaa.
Cuorasala Nethaniah sacapaa Ishmael hne a cawsaa pacari ca Johanan'a taa khata law yi te, Ammon ming'a luo kha ama si.

Cakhutaata Nethaniah sacapaa Ishmael ta Ahikam sacapaa Gedaliah kha a thie khutaata Mizpah taata sii ta a sikhyipa, aa ngaapa cawsaa bangkhuo, rieka tie, canung tie, haatiy tie, hne tiydiypa tie kha Kareah sacapaa Johanan hne riedutuv tie luochiytuv bangkhuo cata la yi te Gibeon taa cata a sikhyi pakhaa yi.
Cakhutaata a tha yi te, Izipt luo si riypa atingna hneta Bethlehem athaalie Geruth Chimham lie kha amaa ri.
Tahematapakieca Nethaniah sacapaa Ishmael ta Babilon siepahruo ta ruo uvtuv ta a chipa, Ahikam sacapaa Gedaliah kha a thie nakawta Khaldi ming kha ama ciy.
Riedutuv tie riekabyi bangkhuo hne Kareah sacapaa Johanan hne Hoshaiah sacapaa Azariah, hne cawsaa bangkhuo a caw cepa taata a le cepa te ta

profet Jeremiah kha a vya ngie yi te, “Paa maca kiena hing malie naathliepa thi la kiema aa ngaapa bangkhuo cuo hingta na Abyipa'a luo kha thlaa malie chuopa thi tie. Tahematapakieca na ming ta malie na hmungpa haa hingta a hluvsa chungtaata kiema a cawta dyi hing malie ama thuse.
Khaapa luo cakuo'a pate ma khaapa ma tue aa tapa kha Abyipana Khazing ta malie pahmung sa thi se,” ama ta.

Profet Jeremiah ta iema kyihuo khata, “A pha ciemuo: Inaa hiepa haa ung cata Abyipanama Khazing'a luo kha thlaa i chuo aa, Abyipata ina paliepa haa khata ica chang'a yi; niema'a taata khaapahmuo nu'a va ang,” a ta yi.

Iema zaw ta Jeremiah kyihuo khata, “Abyipana Khazing ta nama hmuo pata kiema malie a changpa haa khata ma tue li pata a cuo kieca, Abyipaca ma cunglie hing a hmisipa hne zang tluo aa tlapa tehte ta cuo mang se.
Capa ca a pha kie cuose, a pha li kie cuose, nama ima ca pathlienapa Abyipama Khazing ri kha maa ngie aa. Kiema cuota a phana riypata Abyipaima Khazing ri kha maa ngie aa,” ama ta.
Ning hraa a chuona lie kha Abyipabie ca Jeremiah'a luo kha aa zuv.
Cakhutaata Kareah sacapaa Johanan hne ama'a lie a awpa riedutuv tie riekabyi bangkhuo hne cawsaa a caw cepa taata a le cepa bangkhuo kha ku yi te,
“Niema paakiena chang riypata a hmiekung luo ina pathliepa ung ciy Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri:

A ruo lie hing nama aw thluo pata a cuo kieca ca sathaw'a yi angte, ca pacungbung'a va yi ang; caa ling'a yi angte, ca phie'a va yi ang, tahematapakieca niema ica patlungsuepa yi rana kawlie khata i ngie a chi.
Babilon siepahruo kha nama za ciy tawpa haa khata ciy khah ung, ciy khah ung, Abyipata a ta, tahematapakieca niema kha a kuv chungtaata khuo riy hne papya riypa tana niema'a lieta i aw.
Niema kha kaw ca pacuo'a yi angte, ama ta nama cunglie kha kawpacuona hnyi'a te nama'a lyi lie hing aca padaa pakhaa'a yi.
Cuorasala niema ta, ‘Hingpa ruo lie hing aw'a vapuv,’ ta ung cate, Abyipanama Khazing ueryi kha naathlie lipa ung cata,
‘Cuo vyi, rie atuvna ma hmung lina hmang, hmyakaa pu ma thyi lina hmang, ma nang a diy lina hmang Izipt ruo luo na ma si aa,’ nama ta kieca,
Vya aa ngaapa Judah ming, Abyipabie kha naathlie tie ung. Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Izipt luo kha a ngie pata capa lie ca nama aw pata a cuo kieca,
nama ciysapa zueziy khana capa Izipt ruo chunglie ca caa naw'a yi, nama ciysapa cakuona khata capa Izipt ruo chung luo ca aa ngiesa pata ca paziyle'a yi te, capa lie ca nama thiy aa.
Izipt luo si pata capa lie ca khysa riypata bie a chipa bangkhuo ca zueziy, cakuona hne puvtlung pasana ta thiy'a yi te, iema cunglie i patlungsue riypa yi rana taata hring pata a lawpa aw'a va yi.

Tahematapakieca Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Izipt luo nama si kieca, Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie cunglie i hihaana hne i pathiylingna i byapa haa yi khata, niema cunglie zaw kha i hihaana ica bya'a yi. Niema ca cawsaa ta suebepa hne ciy aa chiysapa, chiesapa hne pahnyisuepa tana nama cuo aa. Hingpa hmang hing hmung pakhaa va tli ung ciy.
Vya aa ngaapa Judah ming, Abyipana, Izipt luo si khah ung la, caa ta yi. Nama tuechie karue tli nakawta ataning a raaringna ica pipa yi hing a phasa pata pachang the tie ung.

Tahematapakieca niema hrahring ta Abyipaima Khazing'a luo kha na pathlie ung cate, ‘Abyipaima Khazing'a luo kha thlaa malie chuopa tie, cakhutaata Abyipaima Khazing ta malie a changpa tuokhaapa a cuo zawta malie chang la ma tue aa,’ nama ta.
Caacuonakawta ataning hing ica chang tli yi, cuorasala kama kha na pathlie te ica changpa yi, Abyipanama khazing ueryi kha ziy va ung ciy.
A phasa pata pachang tie ung, nama si khingna hne khy nama sa khingnapa hmang lie khana zueziy, cakuona, hne puvtlung pasana ta nama thiy aa,” a ta yi.
Jeremiah ta Abyipaama Khazing ta iema'a luo a pathliepuo hnuochuopa Abyipaama Khazing bie bangkhuo kha cawsaa bangkhuo'a luo a ri khutaata,
Hoshaiah sacapaa Azariah hne Kareah sacapaa Johanan ta Jeremiah kyihuo khata, “Hangbie na na ri. Abyipama Khazing ta, ‘Izipt luo kha si pata khysa khah ung,’ ta riypata ca pathlie vyi.
Cuorasala kiema kha thie riypa hne Babilon luo sii ta sikhyi riypata Khaldi ming kuv chung luo pi riypata Neriah sacapaa Baruk ta nama kha aca pasu,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Judah ruo lie aw riypata Kareah sacapaa Johanan hne riedutuv tie riekabyi bangkhuo, hne cawsaa bangkhuo khata Abyipaueryi kha naathlie va yi.
Cuorasala Kareah sacapaa Johanan hne riedutuv tie riekabyi bangkhuo khata Judah ruo lie aw riypata amaa cade patlaanapa ruo bangkhuo taata a vya kaapa Judah ming bang khuo,

capaa, canung, haatiy, siepahruo sacanung tie, hne rievetuv tie riekabyi Nebuzaradan ta Shafan sacapaa Ahikam sacapaa Gedaliah hneta a thusepa mekaa; profet Jeremiah hne Neriah sacapaa Baruk zaw kha la yi te,
Izipt ruo chung luo kha ama si, tahematapakieca Abyipaueryi kha naathlie va yi. Cakhutaata Tahpanhes kha ama pha.
Cakhutaata Abyipabie ca Tahpanhes lieta Jeremiah'a luo kha aa zuv:
Alung lepa chekha kha la lah, Tahpanhes lie a awpa Faro siepahruo ing luo angiena lie kha paby tie. Na tuepa kha Judah ming ta hmung yi sala,

iema kyihuo khata, Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Kama ta cawsaa kha pathlie'a yi angte, i changtaapa Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar kha i va pala sa'a yi, ama ta a byithude kha kama ta i pabypa alung zaw cunglie kha patu'a te, a cunglie kha a byi thluodaa kha a pake aa.

Ama ca a vaw'a te Izipt ruo kha phuv a la aa, puvtlung pasana rite ciepa tie kha puvtlung pasana, sii ta sikhyi riypata rite ciepa tie kha sii ta sikhyina, zueziy ta thiy riypata rite ciepa tie kha zueziy luo a pi'a yi.

Izipt khazing tie biena-ing kha myi ta a rue aa; capa tie ca myi ta rue'a te iema kha sii ta a sikhyi'a yi. Tuvkhietuv ta a caw lie achaa a awpa kha aa mangpa haata Izipt ruo kha a mang aa. Cakhutaata capa taa cata aa bangsa pata a pya aa.
Izipt ruo lie a awpa, Heliopolis lie alung tung zaw kha a thlipachung diy aa; cakhutaata Izipt khazing tie biena-ing zaw kha myi ta a rue aa.
Izipt ruo chung Migdol, Tahpanhes, Memfis hne Pathros ruo chunglie a awpa Judah ming bangkhuo cuota Jeremiah'a luo a zuvpa bie:

Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing ta hing haa hingta a ri: Niema hrahring ta Jerusalem cunglie hne Judah khy zaw cunglieta i patlung sapa rana kha nama hmung mangtli. Iema kha mang tie ung; ataning hing iema ca a chunglie khy a sapa aw li pata a duothling tli.

Tahematapakieca iema ta, iema ta ama pachang lipa, niema hne nama mingchingmingvuo tie ta pachang lipa khazing hrangpa re hrie riypata hne panaana pihluo riypata cakuo yi te, kama hi pahaa riypata ama tuepa pha lina kawlie kha tana a cuo.
Kama ta i changtaapa profet tie kha niema'a luo ca pathliepa pari yi angte, “I huesapa hingpa duv aa chiypa hmang hing tue thi khah ung,” ica ta yi.
Cuorasala iema ta, ama pha lina taata a vya pali pata khazing hrangpa panaana pihluo li riypata kama bie kha naathlie va yi.
Caacuonakawta i hihaana hne i pathiy iena ca Judah khy zaw hne Jerusalem luopuv zaw lie kha i bya; cakhutaata ataning te a cuopa haa hingta iema ca hmuo lipa hmang ta a li yi te ama duothling.

Ata ca AbyipaCungnungce Khazing, Israel Khazing ta hing haa hingta a ri: Khaapanakawma niema mamaapa cunglieta hing haapa ruvna lepa hing nama tue? Khaapanakawma Judah ming hrawlieta capaa hne canung, haatiy hne haaseta, aa ngaapa aw lina te ta namaa tue?
Khaapanakawma vya si ung cate nama awnapa Izipt ruo chunglie khazing hrangpa tie kha panaana pihluo ung cate, nama kuv ta nama tuepa re ta i hi ina pahaa ung ciy?

Nama mingchingmingvuo tie ama tuepa pha lina, Judah siepahruo tie hne ama napuv zaw pha lina, niema pha lina hne nama napuv zaw pha lina, Judah ruo chunglie hne Jerusalem luopuv lieta ama tuepa pha lina kha nama maw ma?
Ataning tepa hingta ngiechina pathiypalung hne ciyna paluo sa va yi, niema hne nama mingchingmingvuo tie hmiekunglie i chipa i phungbie hne i phungluo zaw kha ziy va yi.
Caacuonakawta Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Nama cunglie rana patlung sa riypa hne Judah bangkhuo para riypa tana biechina i hnyi tli.

Izipt ruo luo khysa riypata si aa tingpa Judah ming aa ngaapa tie kha la'a yi angte, ama bangkhuo ta ama ra aa; Izipt ruo chunglie kha ama thiy aa; zueziy hne cakuona ta ama thiy aa; a caw cepa taata a le cepa te ta zueziy hne cakuona ta ama thiy aa; cakhutaata iema ca cawsaa ta suebepa hne ciy aa chiysapa, chiesapa hne pahnyisuepa ta ama cuo aa.
Jerusalem kha zueziy, cakuona, hne puvtlung pasana ta duo i tepa haata, Izipt ruo lie a awpa tie kha duo i te'a yi.

Iema ca Judah ruo luo kha ama kaa khingsa raalaa pata, ruvna taata a lawpa chekha ri li pata, kaa khu'a va yi. Izipt ruo chung luo khysa riypata a sipa aa ngaapa Judah ming pakha hmuo a lawpa, a hringpa hne Judah ruo luo a kaapa aw'a va yi.

Cakhutaata ama napuv zaw na khazing hrangpa'a luo kha panaana a pihluo yi tapa a pachang pa bangkhuo, hne a thaalie a daapa canung bangkhuo, aa hmyapa cawsaa hluvsa, Izipt ruo chung Pathros lieta a awpa bangkhuo khata, Jeremiah kha palie yi te:
“Abyipaming ta malie na changpa na bie hne aa pazue pata, kiema ta ca naathlie'a vapuv.

Hmang bangkhuo kha bie maa kuo tlipa haa khata ma tue aa, kiema hne ma mingchingmingvuo tie, ma siepahruo tie hne ma byi tie ta Judah khy zaw hne Jerusalem luopuv zaw lieta ma tue tawpa haa khata, vuoruo siepahruo nung kha rangpa-ue pihluona tue'a pate, ama'a luo kha dangpa ta panaana ma pihluo pari aa. Sa za hnyisa pate, ma za dawphaasa, vuochina zaa taw buo vapuv.
Cuorasala vuoruo siepahruonung kha rangpa-ue pihluona hne dangpa ta panaana ma pihluopa kha ma tue li tli pahne ta zezaw bangkhuo lie kha a phahla pate zueziy hne cakuona ta ma thiy,” ama ta.

Cakhutaata canung tie ta, “Vuoruo siepahruonung'a luo kha rangpa-ue pihluona tue'a pate, dangpa ta panaana ma pihluo hrahring aa; a cuota ama hmingsuo a lu pata viechuo tue pata, dangpa ta panaana kha ma navaapa zaw aw li pata a pihluopa tama malie na ri?” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Jeremiah ta cawsaa bangkhuo, canung hne capaa, hingpa biepaliena a ripa cawsaa bangkhuo kyihuo khata:

“Niema hne nama mingchingmingvuo tie, nama siepahruo tie hne nama byi tie, hne ruo chunglieta cawsaa tie ta Judah khy zaw lie hne Jerusalem luopuv zaw chunglie nama tuepa pihluona kha Abyipata a maw aa ta pata ri kanaa ung ciy? A ruena lie aw'a vyi nama ta ma?

Nama tuepa pha lina, duv aa chiypa nama suena zaw kha Abyipata hmung hang va tli; caacuonakawta ataning a cuopa haa hingta, nama ruo ca a duothlingpa, awna ta a pha lipa hmang hne chiesapa, cawsaa zaw khysa linapa ruo ta aa li.

Tahematapakieca myirue panaana nama tue, Abyipa'a lie kha sue ung cate, Abyipaueryi kha naathlie li pata, a phungbie, a phungluo, hne a ziyphung zaw kha ziy li pata nama aw nakawta ataning te ta ma hmung khupa haa hingta rana ta aca tlungsue yi,” a ta.
Jeremiah ta cawsaa bangkhuo hne canung bangkhuo kyihuo khata, “Izipt ruo chunglieta a awpa Judah ming bangkhuo ta Abyipabie hing naathlie tie ung,

Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Niema hne nama napuv zaw ta bie ta nama pathyi sapa, ‘Kiema ca ma tue ciepa biekuona ta a cuopa, vuoruo siepahruonung'a luo kha rangpa-ue pihluona tue'a pate, dangpa ta panaana ma pihluo aa, ma tapa biekuona kha ma patling sa aa,’ nama tapa kha tuena ta nama patling sa tli. Cuo thluo se, nama biekuo kha patling sa ung la dangpa ta panaana ca tue tie ung!

Caacuonakawta Izipt ruo chunglie a awpa Judah ming bangkhuo ta Abyipabie ca naathlie tie ung: A lesyipa i ming tana chie i sa, Abyipata a ta, ‘AbyipaKhazing a hringpa haata,’ ta pata Izipt ruo chung bangkhuo lie a awpa Judah ming hmya taata i ming kha ri buo'a va tli yi.
Ama cunglie phana cuo li pata ruvna patlung sa riypa tana i mang yi; Izipt ruo chunglie a awpa Judah ming bangkhuo ca pakha hmuo amaa ngaa lina te tana zueziy hne cakuona ta ama thiy aa.

Cakhutaata zueziy taata a lawpa tie ca Izipt ruo taa khata Judah ruo luo kya kaa'a yi te, mingluv ta ama cawsa aa; khysa riypata Izipt ruo luo a sipa, aa ngaapa Judah ming bangkhuo khata ahung bie ma a daa, kama bie ma iema bie ma, tapa kha ama pachang aa.
Abyipata, hingpa hingna niema cuota pamangsana ta a cuo aa, i bie ta niema acaa dupa yi hing aa pazue pathla hrahring aa tapa kha nama pachangna riypata hingpa hmang lie hing kama ta duo ica te'a yi:

Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri, Kama ta Judah Siepahruo Zedekiah kha ama a thie khingpa a cariepa Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar kuv chung luo i pipa haata, Izipt siepahruo, Faro Hofra kha ama a thie khingpa a carie tie kuv luo i pi aa,” a ta.
Judah ming Josiah sacapaa Jehoiakim siepahruo a cuona kung paliy kung lie, profet Jeremiah ta Neriah sacapaa Baruk'a lieta a ripa bie, Jeremiah ta u te caataw chunglie a capepa bie ca:
Vya Baruk, AbyipaIsrael Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri:
Nama ta, “Bawchie ciemuopa tana i cuo! I pasana cungliena Abyipata ngiechina ina bechiy; i hrungna hingta na nangsa tli te, thaaduo na hmung va ang,” a ta.
Ama kha hing haa hingta chang tie, “Abyipa na hing haa hingta a ri: I sa ciepa khana i pacing aa, i ling ciepa khana i phie aa, cahaacata ruo yalya khata a cuo aa.

Na cuota hmang lesapa kha huv kanaa ciy? Capa zaw ca huv khah yi; tahematapakieca cawsaa bangkhuo cung luo khana rana i patlung sa aa, Abyipata a ta; cuorasala nama ca na cakuona hmang mekaa lie kha hruosue ta patuvpa haata hringna ica pi aa,” a ta.
Mingphang zaw hneta aa patuv pata profet Jeremiah'a luo a zuvpa Abyipabie.

Izipt hneta aa patuv pata, Judah Siepahruo Jehoiakim siepahruo a cuona kung paliy kung lie, Zufrates cavaa kie Karkhemish lieta Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ta a tepa Izipt siepahruo Faro Neko rieka tie kaw:
Phyataata hne phyalepa kha pachie la rietuvna luo kha hmaasa tie!
Aruo kha kedie padie ung la, rietuvna aruo kha a khang tie ung. Thaa lakhuv kha a khuv tie ung, asyi kha cahre ung la, thaa buohryi kha a hryi tie ung.
Khaapanakawma ama ciysapa kha i hmung? Hnangluo na amaa saw; ama rieka tie ca hri pata cuo yi te, a catlisa pata amaa ruo. Hnangluo a pali va yi, ciyna na a cadung diy yi! Abyipata a ta.
A lie a hysapa zaw law khu vyi, rieka zaw law khu ra vyi; chaluo ta Zufrates cavaa kielie, a pachiy yi te amaa lie.
Ahungma Nail cavaa haata le te, cavaa tiy pa-aa haata a pa-aa?
Izipt na Nail cavaa haata a le, cavaa tiy pa-aa haata a pa-aa.
Vya aruo zaw, hmieluo tung tie ung, vya aruole zaw, hmieluo kha khuosa ta a ruo pahraa tie ung! Riekaphuv, hmieluo tung tie ung, phya a cyipa Ethiopia ming hne Put ming, Liy a kyipa Ludim ming.

Capa ning ca Cungnungce Abyipa Khazingning tana a cuo, phuvlana ning, a carie tie'a taata a sue lina paluo sana ning tana a cuo. Zueziy ta ning'a yi te a rue a cing aa, a thiy kha a riy bina te a dang aa. Tahematapakieca Cungnungce Abyipata chaluo ruo Zufrates cavaa kielie kha hriykhungrina a tue aa.
Gilead luo kha sithaw la, tluona siyy kha kya la tie, Vya lesaa pathenung Izipt! Siyy hluvpuv kha a cakhawpa lie na hmuo tli; na cuota tluona aw vyi.
Mingphang zaw ta na nangzaana kha thyi yi te, alyi ca na caana ueryi ta a bi; tahematapakieca rieka tie ca pakha hne pakha kha a suv yi te, ama pahning ta amaa lie hne.
Izipt ruo tuv riypata Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar a vaw riypa kawlieta Abyipata Jeremiah'a lie a ripa bie:

Izipt lie hne Migdol lie kha ukhyi ung la; Memfis hne Tahpanhes lie kha pathyi tie ung. “A daahmang kha la lah a pacung tie; tahematapakieca zueziy na na cahriylie a awpa tie kha a ce'a yi,” ta pata ri tie.
Khaapanakawma Apis ca aa ruo? Khaapanakawma aa daapahrang va? Abyipana a tuv pathla.
Na cawsaazaapuv ca a pachiy yi te amaa lie, pakha hne pakha kha, “A vaw tie, ma cawsaa zaw'a luo kha kaa'a puv, paratuv zueziy kawlie khata ma puvna ruo luo kha kaa'a puv,” amaa ta.
Izipt siepahruo Faro kha, “Pakaa dyi ku, cuophaa hla,” ta pata ming pi tie ung.
A ming Cungnungce Abyipaa cuopa ta, kama i hringpa haata, tluo zaw hrawlie Tabor haapa hne, riyliy athaalie Karmel haapa pakha na a vaw nguoluo.
Vya awna a hnyipa Izipt sacanung, Sii cuo riypata na hmang kha a pachie tie. Memfis ca aw tluo aa tla lina hmang ta a li'a te, khysa lina, a rapa hmang ta aa li aa.
Izipt ca a puvthesapa cuelaanung tana a cuo, cuorasala chaluo taata matling na a baw tli.

A muo pi pata a hluopa rieka tie ca pathupa cuetaata haata ama cuo raalaa pata, a pali yi te suv kha ta amaa ruo, a daa he ta a daa va yi; tahematapakieca iema rana ning, iema duotena ning ca ama cunglie a tlung tli.
A carie tie ta ama vya buv nakawta, pariy a thiyle te a khipa haa khata a khi. Ahryi a cyi pata a vawhnue yi te, thingkungpa hu ta ama hu.
A ngie khu hmuo a aw li raalaa pata, aa tuvpuv kha ama paching diy aa, Abyipata a ta. Iema ca khawbyapa laata ama hluv vie, ri tie'a pata cuo va yi.
Sacanung Izipt ca a nang pazaa pata cuo'a te, chaluo taata cawsaa tie kuv luo kha pi pata a cuo aa.

Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing na a ri: Mang tie, Thebes khazing Amon, hne Faro, hne Izipt hne a khazing tie hne a siepahruo tie, Faro cunglie hne ama a ringchuopa tie cunglie kha duotena i patlung sa aa.
Iema a thie khingpa yi Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar hne a byi tie kuv chung luo kha i pi'a yi. Cakhutaata Izipt lie ca a hluo ning haa khata khy ama sa pakhaa aa, Abyipata a ta.

Cuorasala nama ca, ciyna hnyi khah, i changtaapa Jakob, cakhutaata, Vya Israel, na nang uo khah se. Tahematapakieca ruo luohlaapuv taa khata ca khuo'a angte, na samingsahlaa tie kha sii ama cuona taata i khuo'a yi. Jakob ca vya kaa'a te, a dieta hne thaaduo pata a aw aa, ahungtahmuo pachiypahuo'a vyi.

Nama ca, ciyna hnyi khah, i changtaapa Jakob, Abyipata a ta, tahematapakieca kama na caa awpuo ang. Niema icaa cadenapa yi mingphang tie ca ama chuona cuo i patlung sa aa, cuorasala niema ca nama chuona cuo patlung sa'a va ang. Aa de aa khawna te ta ica pasiypa-ya aa, pasiypa-ya bangby li pata ca ca chi'a va ang.
Faro ta Gaza a tuv hluo, Filistin ming hneta aa patuv pata Jeremiah'a luo a zuvpa Abyipabie ca:

Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Mang tie, chaluo taata tiy za le te, cavaa kuo yalya khata bi'a te a lepathla diy aa; ruo hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo kha vya diy'a te, khypuv zaw hne a chunglie a awpa kha a vya diy'a yi. Cawsaa kha khi'a yi te, ruo chunglie khy a sapa bangkhuo ca ama caa aa.
Aruotungpa caki cakhawpa pu hne, aruole pu hne a phyi a pahiena pu kawlie kha, nungpaa tie ca ama buo thaa aw valaa te, ama saata zaw kha a pali pata mang va yi.

Filistin tie para diyna riypa ning, Tair hne Sidon taata, aa ngaa tlakuopa byatuv mekaa kha thie riypa ning ca aa vaw tli nakawta a cuo. Tahematapakieca Abyipata Filistin ming, Kaftor riyliy kie ruo lie aa ngaapa tie kha a para nguoluo tli yi.
Gaza ca a suo pamyi pata cuo tli te, Ashkelon ca a ryi lipa tana a aw. Vya iema cahrana aa ngaapa! Khacuo te khiy ma nama ngesaa kha namaa uo pari aa?
Vya, Abyipazueziy! Khacuo te khiy ma a dieta tah na aw aa? Na bya luo kha vaa saw la, vaa pahy la a dieta tah aw tie.
Abyipata bie a pi nakawta, tuokhaatama a dieta tah a aw khu aa? Ama ca Ashkelon hne riyliy kie ruo zaw a du riypa tana, re pi pata a cuo.

Moab hne aa patuv pata, Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing ta hing haa hingta a ri: Nebo khy ca a duothling tli! Kiriathaim ca a nang pazaa pata na a cuo, la pata na a cuo tli; a riekhuopiehu ca pacing yi te nangzaa pata na a cuo;

Moab mingpathuona ca aw va tli. Heshbon lieta ama a du riypata pha lina khue kha khuo yi te: “A vaw tie ung, mingphang cuona taata ama kha thaw'a ung puv!” ama ta. Vya Madmen, nama zaw a dieta tah pa-aw sa pata na na cuo aa; zueziy na caa cade aa.
Horonaim lie khina ueryi kha naathlie tie, “A duothlingpa hne khuosa ta rana!”
“Moab ca parapa tana a cuo tli!” Haatiy caana ueryi ca naathlie tie.
Tahematapakieca Luhith luo kiena lie khana, caale yi te ama sithaw. Horonaim luo cungbungna lie kha, ruvnaana hne thlaazangna khi ryi kha ama thyi.
A ruo tie! Nama hne nama kha a khuo tie! Viehnangruo lie a awpa laa haa khata a ruo tie!
Cariekyikuo hne na suethiy kha naa buchuo nakawta, nama zaw hing la pata na na cuo aa. Khemosh ca a tluobyi tie hne a byi tie hneta, sii ta sikhyi pata a cuo aa.
Paratuv tie ca khy ting luo kha a vaw'a yi te, khaapa khy hmuota law'a vyi. Abyipata a ri tlipa haa khata, Bawphie ca ra'a te, ase ruo ca para pata a cuo aa.
Moab cuota thluolung kha bang tie ung, tahematapakieca aa lie hrahring aa; a khy zaw ca duothling'a te, a chunglie khy a sapa aw'a va yi.
Abyipare lie he a phiypa ca chiesa pata cuo se; cawsaa thie li pata a zueziy kha a chi pakhaapa ca chiesa pata cuo se.

Mingsuvtiy ca a haa chunglie a awpa haa kha tana, Moab ca mingnu a cuo baataata a dieta tah a aw pari; ama ca bi kha hnang bi kha luo patlaw pata cuo vyi, sii ta a dapa zaw cuo vyi; caacuonakawta pahuo pari te, a rang pa-uena zaw ra vyi.
Caacuonakawta Abyipata, kama ta duvsaata tah a patlawtuv kha patlaw riypata hne a bi kha pahri pata a bire kha dechi diy riypata i vya pathliena cuo ca aa vaw nguoluo tli.
Israel ca aa buchuopa Bethel kawlieta a nang a zaapa haa khata, Moab ca aa buchuopa Khemosh kawlieta a nang a zaa aa.
Tuokhaatama, “Kiema ca a riephapa tie hne rieka tie tana ma cuo,” namaa ta khu?
Moab hne a khy zaw a paratuv ca aa khaw nguoluo tli, a mingnu pha cepa tie ca thiena ang riypata ama cungbungle tli, ta pata, Cungnungce Abyipata pata a ming a cuopa, Siepahruo ta a ri.
Moab a rana riypa ca a ngiesa tli te, a bieripana riypa ca a catlisa pata aa vaw tli.
A ingpaa zaw bangkhuo hne, a ming a pachangpa bangkhuo ta ama kha muochie sa tie ung. “Tuokhaatama a cahrapa byikhuecahryi, a rungnaapa khuecahryi ca a tlipachung!” ta tie ung.
Rungnaana taa khata za cung la, a caakaruepa alyi lie kha a tu tie, byi pacuo sapa, sacanung Dibon! Tahematapakieca Moab paratuv ca nama a du riypata a khaw te, ama ta na cariekyikuo tie kha a para.
Luopuv kielie kha a daa ung la huo tie ung, niema, Aroer lie khy a sapa tie! Aa ruolepa cawsaapa hne aa ruolepa cawsaanung kha, “Khaapama a cuo?” ta pata hiehriy tie ung.
Moab ca a nang pazaa pata cuo te, thlipachung pata a cuo; khi te a caa! Moab ca a duothlingpa tana a laa tli, ta pata, Arnon cavaa kie lie kha pathyi sa tie ung.
Bieripana ca ase ruo zaw cunglie kha a tlung tli, Holon, Jahzah, Mefaath,
Dibon, Nebo, Beth-diblathaim,
Kiriathaim, Beth-gamul, Beth-meon,
Kerioth hne Bozrah, hne Moab ruo khy zaw bangkhuo, aa hla aa ngie cunglie kha a tlung tli.
Moab a kiy ca thli pata a cuo tli, a kuv ca a tli mangtli, Abyipata a ta.
Abyipaa du pata ama hne ama kha aa pathuosa nakawta Moab ca a pariyna te ta padang sa ung la, a paliy lie kha a naw sala; pahnyisue pata cuo se.
Israel ca na cuota pahnyisue pata a za cuo, cuorasala aparuvpa tie hrawlie patuv pata za cuo vyi; cadyiseca a kaw na ri kyry ta na hning na ti!
Vya Moab lie khy a sapa tie, khy zaw kha thuse ung la alung cunglie kha va aw tie ung; alung karaw daw lie buv a tuepa thuvruv haa khata cuo tie ung.
Moab a hruotlena kaw kha ma thyi tli, a hruo a tle hringhruo, aa pasuona, a hruotlena, a palunglena, aa palena zaw kha ma thyi.
Kama hrahring ta cawsaa siysaa a ri lina kha i pachang, Abyipata a ta; a hruotlena ca a hrihripa tana a cuo, a tuepa ca a hrihripa tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Moab cuo khata i caa; Moab ming bangkhuo cuo khata i caa; Kir-heres cawsaa tie cuo khata muochie i sa.
Jazer cuo laa khata nama cuota a hluv vie i caa, Vya Sibmah mingsuv kung! Na ce zaw ca riyliy kha va law te, Jazer te khata a pha; na cuovuo thyi hne khycuo cunglie kha paratuv ca aa lie tli.

Alawna hne palungtluona ca, thyi a hluvsa a pathyipa Moab ruo taata la pata a cuo tli. Mingsuv a ciyna taata mingsuvtiy ca i pachuo sa tli; ahungtahmuo palungtluona hneta a ciy va tli yi; ama khipa ca palungtluona khina ta cuo vyi.
Heshbon hne Elealeh ta ama khi, a khina ueryi ca Jahaz te khata avaa thyi, Zoar taata Horonaim hne Eglath-shelishiyah te ta avaa thyi. Tehematapakieca Nimrim cavaa tiy te na a ky diy.
Cakhutaata khahrungtluobu lie hriykhungrina a pihluopa hne ama khazing'a luo rangpa-ue a ruepa Moab ming kha ama chuona i patlung sa aa, Abyipata a ta.
Caacuonakawta i pathiypalung ca Moab cuo khata ramang haata aa ngiy, cakhutaata i pathiypalung ca Kir-heres cuo khata ramang haata aa ngiy; tahematapakieca ama hnyirungna kha a ra diy tli.
Tahematapakieca cawsaa bangkhuo ama luv ca pamyi pata cuo te, cawsaa bangkhuo ama hmyahming ca ngu pata a cuo tli; ama kuv kha a uo yi te, ama sesie lie buri amaa paze.
Moab ruo ama ingcung bangkhuo lie hne cawsaa a hmyana hmang bangkhuo lie ca caana hlaa dyina a thyi; tahematapakieca kama ta Moab kha ahunghmuo ama khing lipa bi haata i dechi tli, Abyipata a ta.
Tuokhaatama dechi pata a cuo? Tuokhaatama ama caa? Caacuonakawta Moab ca a ingpaa bangkhuo cuota pahnyisue riypa hne ciy aa chiy hringhruopa tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Mang tie, ama ca hmungthlu haata a zubung'a te, Moab kha a du pata a mathlaa a pake aa.
Khy zaw ca la pata cuo'a te, cariekyikuo zaw ca la pata ama cuo aa. Capa ning lieta Moab rieka tie pathiypalung ca, nupazina ta a pasapa canung pathiypalung na a lu aa.
Abyipaa du pata aa pathuosa nakawta, Moab ca mingphang cuona taata para pata a cuo aa.
Ciy aa chiysapa, khue, hne cyihyi zaw na na hmiekunglie a aw, Vya Moab lie khy a sapa zaw! Abyipata a ta.

Ciy aa chiysapa taata a ruopa mekaa ca khue chung luo kha ama tla aa, khue chungtaata a pyapa mekaa ca cyihyi lieta amaa uo aa. Hingpa hmang zaw hing iema duotena kung lie kha, Moab cunglieta i patlung sa aa, Abyipata a ta.

A ruopa tie ca ama thaa buo te Heshbon ningdiy rawlie kha amaa pahy, tahematapakieca Heshbon taata myi kuo te, Shihon taata myihlaa a thu; capa ca ta Moab puo kha para te, aa cali patlawpa cawsaa tie luv ruv kha a para.
Vya Moab, nama ca bawchie ciemuopa tana na cuo! Khemosh cawsaa tie ca ama ra tli, tahematapakieca na sacapaa tie ca sii ta sikhyi pata ama cuo tli, na sacanung tie zaw sikhyi pata ama cuo ra.
Cuorasala a vaw riypa cuo lieta Moab ca vuophana kha i pi pakhaa aa, Abyipata a ta. Hingpa zaa hing Moab bieripana ta a cuo.

Ammon ming hne aa patuv pata Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Israel ta sacapaa hnyi va ma? Rucutuv hnyi va ma? Khaapanakawma Milkom ta Gad kha a cade te, a cawsaa zaw ta hingpa khy zaw lie hing khy ama sa?

Caacuonakawta, Ammon ming khy Rabbah lie kha rietuvna riypa ue kha i paring sa tiyta, capa hmang ca a rapa aa pungna hmang ta a li'a te, a khy zaw ca myi ta rue pata a cuona cuo ca aa vaw nguoluo tli, Abyipata a ta.

Vya Heshbon, caa tie, tahematapakieca Ai ca a duothling mangtli! Vya Rabbah sacanung zaw, khi tie ung! Buri kha a buv ung la, ngiechina hne caa ung la, nama ngesaa kha a uo tie ung! Tahematapakieca Milkom ca a tluobyi tie hne a byi zaw hne khata sii ta sikhyi pata a cuo aa.
Khaapanakawma na thaazuo kha a hruo na tlekhyi? Vya zang tluo aa tla lipa sacanung, na thaazuo ca a chuole. “Ahungma naa tuv aa?” ta cate, na suethiy kha naa buchuo.

Ciy aa chiysapa khana nama ingpaa bangkhuo tie'a taa khata nama cung luo i patlung sa aa, Abyipa, Cungnungce Khazingna a ta, namaa ruona luo cyicuo kha a cadepatlaa pata cuo'a ung cate, ahungtahmuo aa chepatlaapa tie kha pakiy'a va yi.
Cuorasala cakhutaa cata Ammon ming ca ama vuophana kha i pi pakhaa'a yi, Abyipata a ta.
Edom hne aa patuv pata, Cungnungce Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Teman lie singna aw va tli ma? Ama mingsing tie ta ruena che khu va tli yi ma? Ama singna ma a vie tli?
A ruo ung, a pali ung, aa nena luo khuv cung ung, Dedan lie khy a sapa tie! Tahematapakieca duo i te thueta ca, Esau ruvna khana a cunglieta i patlung sa aa.
Mingsuv thyi a lupa tie kha nama'a luo amaa vaw tiyta, samang thang riypa kha ama thuse cuo va ma? Aparuvpa kha zuo ta aa vaw kieca, iema khingpa dyi khana ama la aa cuo va ma?

Cuorasala kama ca, Esau kha a sasepa tana i chi, a nangzaa kha hmuo pahruv va ang, khaapalie hmuota a nu khu'a vyi. A samingsahlaa tie, a uvnu hne a ingpaa tie kha para pata cuo yi te, a ngaapa aw va tli yi.
Haaraa tie kha chisiy tie yi, kama ta mangchiy lavuo yi ang; na nunghlyi tie ta kama kha naa ringchuo yi se.
Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Panuo kha dang tluo aa tla lipa tie ta hmuo ama dang kieca, nama ca duo te pata cuo'a va ca ma? Duo te li pata law'a vaciy; na dang hrahring aa.
Tahematapakieca kamata tah chie a sa angte, Bozrah ca ciy aa chiysapa hne pahnyisuepa, a duothlingpa hne chiesapa ta a cuo aa; a khy bangkhuo ca chuozaa ta a duothling aa, Abyipata a ta.
Abyipa'a taa tana thuohlaa i thyi, biephyatuv kha mingphang zaw hraw luo pathlie pata cuo tli te, “Niema hne niema kha a pahmya ung la ama kha tuv tie ung, rie a du tie ung!” a ta.
Tahematapakieca nama ca mingphang zaw hrawlie a caw cepa ta ca tue'a angte, cawsaa ta aca duvsa'a yi.

Lungkuo daw karaw lie hne tluo aa suopa cunglieta aw cate, ciy naa chiysana hne na hruotlena ta nama kha aca dung tli. Na buv kha hmungthlu haata aa suo khu thiy ta aa suona lie na tue raalaa pata, capa taa cata ica pachung aa, Abyipata a ta.
Edom ca ciy aa chiysa pata aa li aa; aa thaalie a cakuopa bangkhuo ca ciysa'a yi te, a rana bangkhuo kaw kha a kawchie ama ri paruvle aa.
Sodom hne Gomorrah hne a cahriy khy zaw ama ra ning haa khata, capa lie ca pakha hmuo aw'a va yi, a chunglieta ahunghmuo khysa'a va yi, Abyipa ta a ta.

Jordan cavaa kie tuvpuv chungtaata a hringdiyliy paripa sahring tlena ruo luo a vya pyapa chingde haata, Edom kha a cade paluo'a angte, i tlawpa pakha kha a cunglieta i chi aa. Tahematapakieca kama haapa ahungma a aw? Kama tluvpa ahungma a aw? Kama hmiekunglie a daa khupa tuvkhietuv ca ahungtama a cuo?

Caacuonakawta Abyipata Edom a du pata a tuepa tingtuona hne Teman lie khy a sapa tie a du pata a tuepa tingtuona kha thyi tie ung. Tuvrung chunglie tuvtaata zaw ca a dale pata ama cuo hmisi aa; ama tuvte ca amaa tawpa hmang kawlie ca ta phuvhling dyina a chiy aa.
Amaa lienapa pu ta alyi ca a cathang'a te, ama caana ueryi ca Riyliy Sepa te ta aa thyi aa.

Mang tie, hmungthlu haa khata a mathlaa pasaw'a te a tlachiy aa, a mathlaa pake'a te Bozrah kha aa du aa, capa ning lieta Edom rieka tie pathiypalung ca nupazi pasana a angpa canung pathiypalung haa kha tana a cuo aa.
Damaskas hneta aa patuvpa bie. Hamath hne Arpad ca ama palung a chuo, tahematapakieca thuohlaa pha lipa na ama thyi; A die khu lipa riyliy haata ama ciy hringhruo nakawta ama rie a thyi.
Damaskas ca a thaa dya te, aa ruo, a thlaazangna na a te hringhruo. Riethyina lesapa hne ngiechina ta nupazi pasana a angpa canung haata ama kha ama patuv.
A palung tluosapa khy, a ming pathuopa khypuv ca tuokhaatama thaw pata a cuo?
Caacuonakawta a mingnu tie ca a tlawhmie lie kha a lie'a yi te, a rieka tie bangkhuo ca capa ning lie ca ta para diy pata ama cuo aa, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.
Cakhutaata Damaskas dungkhuo lungruetlepie kha myi patiysue'a angte, capa ca ta Ben-hadad siepahruo cariekyikuo kha a kuo diy aa.
Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ta a lapa Kedar hne Hazor pena zaw hneta aa patuvpa bie. Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Thu tie ung, Kedar ca tuv tie ung! Ningchiy cawsaa tie kha para tie ung!
Ama thluodaa hne ama tuvrung zaw kha la tie ung, ama pangzu hne ama chechiy bangkhuo kha; ama kala-uv kha sikhyi ung la, “Cahriycake bangkhuo liena ciy aa chiypa a aw,” ta pata khi yi se.

Vya Hazor lie khy a sapa tie, a ruo tie ung, luohlaa luo kha a ruo ung la a nu tie ung, Abyipata a ta. Tahematapakieca Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ta, niema a du riypata a ting te, khue a khuo nguoluo tli.
Thu tie ung, hnaanguo pata a aw cakhawpa mingphang, aa bang pata a awpa tie, thlake hne a hrenapa zaw a hnyi lipa, iema aw ta a awpa tie kha tuv tie ung, Abyipata a ta.
Ama kala-uv hne ama sahring zaw ca hruosue ta amaa li aa. Ama hmya hming a ngupa tie kha a kuo ting ta i chepatlaa diy'a yi. Ruvna kha a kuo ting taata, i patlungsue'a yi, Abyipata a ta.
Hazar ca ruo-uv a buna hmang ta tue'a angte, chuozaa a duothlingpa ta i tue aa. Capa lie ca pakha hmuo aw'a va yi, pakha hmuo khy sa'a va yi.
Judah Siepahruo Zedekiah ta siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu ningta Elam hne aa patuv pata Jeremiah'a luo a zuvpa Abyipabie.
Cungnungce Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Ama cahrana cepa ta a cuopa Elam liy kha kama ta i thli aa;
cakhutaata avuo kiy paliy taata thliy phang paliy kha i vya chiy aa. Hingpa thliy hingta i pazupatlaa diy'a yi. Elam taata sii ta sikhyipa tie ama pha linapa ruo suokha hmuo aw'a vyi.

Elam ca a carie tie hmiekunglie hne iema a thie khingpa tie hmiekunglie kha paciy sa'a angte, ama cunglieta rana, i hihaana kha i patlung sa aa, Abyipata a ta. I thie diyna te yi ta, zueziy i pathliesue'a yi.
Cakhutaata i byithude kha Elam lie ca patu'a angte, ama siepahruo hne ama byi tie kha i para diy'a yi, Abyipata a ta.
Cuorasala a vaw riypa cuo lie ca Elam kha vuophana i pi pakhaa aa, Abyipata a ta.
Babilon hne aa patuv pata cuose, Khaldi ming ruo hne aa patuv pata cuose, profet Jeremiah'a taata Abyipata a ripa bie:

Mingphang tie hrawlie kha pathyisa tie, pangtaa kha pathlie la pathyisa tie, capa ca nu khah. Babilon ca ama la tli, Bel ca nang pazaa pata a cuo tli, Merodakh ca a nang na a uo tli. A kuvtuezuv ca a nang pazaa pata cuo te, ama nang na a uo tli.

Tahematapakieca chaluo taa khata ama a du riypa mingphang phang kha a pya tli; capa ca ta ama kha a duothlingpa ta tue'a te, a chunglie kha ahunghmuo aw'a va yi; cawsaa hne saruopa hne khata amaa ruo diy aa.
Capa ning hne cuo lie ca, Israel ming kha a vaw'a yi te, iema hne Judah ming kha a vaw pakhaw'a yi te, Abyipaama Khazing kha ama caapuo pata ama huv aa, Abyipata a ta.
Zion luo sinapa luopuv kha hiehriy'a yi te, capa luo ca ama hmie kha pachaw'a yi te, khatiy tahmuo maw li riypa chuozaa biekuona ta Abyipa'a luo kha a vaw'a yi te iemata tah amaa vya pazue aa.
I cawsaa zaw ca a viepa tuv tana ama cuo tli; ama tuvkhietuv ta luo a viekhyi tli yi, tluo cunglie luohlaa luo kha pie yi te, tluo kha hnang tluo kha ta si yi te ama tuvte kha ama maw.

Iema a hmungpa bangkhuo khata iema kha ce yi te, ama carie tie ta, “Kiema ca sue vapuv, tahematapakieca, iema ta Abyipa, a hmisipa sahring tlena ruo, Abyipa, ama mingchingmingvuo tie anguopuona a cuopa cunglie kha ama sue nakawta a cuo,” ama ta.
Babilon taa khata a ruo tie ung, Khaldi ming ruo taa khata pya ung la, mie phuv luo a chiypa mietungpa haa khata cuo tie ung.

Tahematapakieca chaluo ruo lieta ruo lepa phuv zaw kha ama a du riypata pasu'a yi angte, iema ta Babilon kha a du'a yi te a awna hmang taa khata ama la aa. Ama cuoti ca a ka khingpa a hla lipa cuoti ka a thepa riekapa cuoti haa khata a cuo aa.
Khaldi ca ching pata cuo'a te, a chingtuv tie ca ama khing a tling aa, Abyipata a ta.
Vya i ru a parapa tie, nama palung a tluo hringhruo raalaa pata, cuelaanung haata aphuv cunglie kha naa cathlule raalaa pata, a ruotungpa haata na khi raalaa pata,
na nung ca nangzaana khuopuv ta a ang aa, nama caa sapa ca a hmie a chi hringhruo aa. Ama ca mingphang zaw hrawlie a caw cepa, ruocaapa, a caapa ruo, viehnangruo ta a cuo aa.

Abyipahihaana kawlieta a chunglie kha cawsaa ta khysa'a va yi, a duothling karuepa ruo ta a cuo aa. Babilon athaalie a cakuopa bangkhuo ca ama phuv a hling'a te, a hmaa phyapa kawlie khata a paruv ta a kawchie kha ama rile aa.
Liy a patuvpa bangkhuo zaw, Babilon cahriy lie kha adaahmang la ung la, nama thi kha a diy li pata ama kha ka tie ung, tahematapakieca ama ca Abyipacunglie khana a sue.

A cahriy bangkhuo taa khata khisue tie ung, “A kuv a caba tli; a cariekyikuo ca a cing tli, a lungruetlepie dungkhuo ca a cing tli.” Tahematapakieca hingpa hing Abyipaphuvlana tana a cuo: ama cunglie phuv la te, ama a za tuepa haa khata a cunglie a tue.

Babilon lie kha saciy a tuvpa aw khah se, sa la cuo ningta tuokyi a patuvpa aw khah se; tahematapakieca paratuv zueziy kawlieta, iema bangkhuo ca ama cawsaa tie'a luo khana ama kaa aa, ama ruo luo khana amaa ruo diy aa.
Israel ca chingde ta amaa cadepa tuv tana a cuo. Assiria siepahruo ta sie taa te, ata hing ca Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ta a ruv a patling.
Caacuonakawta Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing ta hing haa hingta a ri: Kama ta Assiria siepahruo duo i tepa haa khata Babilon siepahruo kha duo i te ra aa.
Israel kha a tle tawna luo i chiy pakhaa aa; Karmel tluo cunglie hne Bashan lie kha a la tle'a te, Efraim tluothlue cunglie hne Gilead lie kha a nangdiy a pe aa.

Capa ning hne cuo lie ca Israel pha lina kha huv pata cuo'a te, suokha hmuo hmung'a va yi; Judah suena zaw kha suokha hmuo hmung'a va yi; tahematapakieca kama ta i pangaapa tie kha i ngiethe'a yi, Abyipata a ta.

Merathaim luo kha sithaw tie ung, ama a du riypata sithaw tie ung, Pekod lie khy a sapa tie kha a du ung la, pakha hmuo pangaa li pata para diy karue tie ung, kama ta bie ica pipa yi bangkhuo kha tue tie ung, Abyipata a ta.
Ruo chunglie rietuvna pu, hne rana lepuv!
Alyi cung yalya a depa khunglung ca tuokhaatama a tlipachung! Tuokhaatama Babilon ca mingphang zaw hrawlieta ciy aa chiysa pata aa li!
Vya Babilon, nama hne nama cyihyi a thla khuo cate na naa uo, cuorasala nama ta pachang vaciy; Abyipakha naa zue nakawta, nama ca ca hmung yi te aca patuv yi.
Abyipata a cehre cahawnapa ca pahaw te a hihaana cehre kha a papya, tahematapakieca Cungnungce Abyipa Khazingna Khaldi ming ruo lie kha a tue khingpa a aw.
A kuo ting taa khata ama kha tuv tie ung, a sa-ing kha pahaw ung la; sa papungpa haa khata papung ung la, pakha hmuo pangaa li pata para diy karue tie ung.
A rieka bangkhuo ca thie tie ung, thiena hmang luo kha zuvkhyi tie ung. Bawchie ciemuopa tana ama cuo, iema ningcuo ca aa vaw tli, iema duotena cuo ca!
Naathlie tie ung! Babilon ruo taata riecanaw tie ca Abyipama Khazing phuvlana, a biena-ing cuota phuvlana kaw kha pathyisa riypata amaa vaw nguoluo.

Liy ka a thepa tie kha Babilon a du riypata ku pakhaw tie ung. A cahriy bangkhuo khata arina hmang la tie ung; pakha hmuo pa zang khah ung. A tuena haata thung tie ung; ama ta a za tuepa haa khata. Tahematapakieca Abyipa, Israel Khazing Pathe khana palung lesa pata a papya a palyi.
Caacuonakawta a mingnu tie ca cawsaa a hmyana hmang lie kha a lie'a yi te, a rieka zaw bangkhuo kha capa ning lie ca para pata ama cuo aa, Abyipata a ta.
Abyipa, Cungnungce Khazingta Kama na caa du ang, Vya a palung lepa, a ta. Tahematapakieca kama ta duo ica tena riypa na ningcuo ca aa vaw tli.
A palung lepa ca a pachiy'a te aa lie aa, pakha tahmuo pathu'a va yi. Cakhutaata a khypuv kha myi ta rue'a angte, a cahriylie a awpa bangkhuo kha a kuo diy aa.
Cungnungce Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Israel cawsaa tie hne Judah cawsaa zaw ca hrisaa pata na ama cuo; iema a patuvpa tie khata a cusa pata hre yi te, pathlie khing va tli yi.
Iema a khuotuv ca a cahra; a ming ca Cungnungce Abyipatana a cuo. Ama ta iema kaw kha ri'a te, alyi kha a pahyna pi'a te, cuorasala Babilon lie khy a sapa tie ca a pahyna pi'a va yi.
Zueziy ta Khaldi ming kha a du yi te, Babilon lie khy a sapa tie kha aa du yi, a byi tie kha a du yi te, a mingsing tie kha aa du yi, Abyipata a ta.
Zueziy ta hmungdawlutuv tie kha a du yi te, caacuonakawta ama ngaa diy aa! Zueziy ta a rieka tie kha a du yi te, iema ca para pata ama cuo aa!

Zueziy ta aa ruo hne aa ruole zaw, a hrawlieta ruohrang rieka tie zaw kha a du yi te, iema ca canung haa khata ama cuo aa. Zueziy ta a suethiy zaw kha a du yi te, iema ca chuv pa suethiy ta ama cuo aa.
Khykuona ta a khytiy kha aa du, iema ca ama ky diy aa. Tahematapakieca hingpa ruo hing kuvtuezuv ta a bipa ruo ta cuo te, iema ca kuvtuezuv khana amaa ngaakhyi.
Caacuonakawta Babilon lieta saa aa hruopa tie ca hainaacahnie hne khata aw'a yi te, kala-uvpavaa kha khy a sa aa; cawsaa aw pakhaa va tli yi, chuo bangkhuo ta khysa'a va tli yi.
Sodom hne Gomorrah hne a cahriy khy zaw Khazing ta a para ning haa khata, capa lie ca pakha hmuo aw'a va yi, a chunglieta ahunghmuo khysa'a va yi, Abyipata a ta.
Mang tie, chaluo taa tana mingphang suokha aa zuv; a thaaruvpa mingphang hne siepahruo a hluvsa tie na chuelyi aa hlacena taata a vya thu yi.

Iema ca liy hne asyi kha patuv yi te, a chiepa hne kawpacuona a hnyi lipa tana ama cuo. Ama pu ca riyliy aa hrungpa pu khana a lu; aruo kha a khang yi te, rie a tuv'a nangpa rieka tie haa kha tana ama aw, nama na acaa du yi, Vya Babilon sacanung!
Babilon siepahruo ta iema thuohlaa kha thyi te, a kuv thaa a ne; nupazi pasana a angpa canung haata, ruvna lepuv ta ama kha a patuv.

Jordan cavaa kie tuvpuv chungtaata a hringdiyliy paripa sahring tlena ruo luo a vya pyapa chingde haata, iema kha a cade paluo'a yi angte, i tlawpa pakha kha a cunglieta i chi aa. Tahematapakieca kama haapa ahungma a aw? Kama tluvpa ahungma a aw? Kama hmiekunglie a daa khupa tuvkhietuv ca ahungtama a cuo?

Caacuonakawta Abyipata Babilon a du pata a tuepa tingtuona hne Khaldi ming ruo a du pata a tuepa tingtuona kha thyi tie ung: Tuvrung chunglie tuvtaata zaw ca a dale pata ama cuo hmisi aa; ama tuvte ca amaa tawpa hmang kawlie ca ta phuvhling dyina a chiy aa.
Babilon ama lana pu khata alyi ca a cathang'a te, a khina ueryi ca mingphang zaw hrawlie kha aa thyi aa.
Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Babilon para riypata paratuv thliy kha pasu'a angte, Leb-qamai lie khy a sapa tie kha aa du'a yi;
Babilon luo kha pahraa ta suo a pasiy tuv ku'a yi angte, iema ta ama pasiy aa. Ruvnaana ning lie kha ama a du riypata a kuo ting taata a vaw'a yi te, a kuv cahri pata ama chi aa.
Liy ka a thepa ta a liy kha a kyi khah sala, rietuvna buohryi kha a hryi pata a pachie khah se. A mingnu tie kha pakha hmuo pangaa khah ung, a rieka bangkhuo kha para diy karue tie ung.
Khaldi ming ruo lie kha thie yi sala a lie yi se, ama luopuv zaw lie kha hmaa phya yi se.
Israel Khazing Pathe hmiekunglieta ama ruo ca suena ta a bi raalaa pata, Israel hne Judah ca ama Khazing, Cungnungce Abyipata maw va yi.

Babilon ming chung taa khata a ruo tie ung, nama cyicuo ta nama hringna kha a khuo tie ung. Ama suena kawlieta ra khah, tahematapakieca ata cuo hing Abyipaphuvlana cuo tana a cuo, ama hne aa phuv pata na a thung.
Babilon ca Abyipakuv chunglie siy panuo tana a cuo, chuelyi yalya ta a pariysatuv tana a cuo. Mingphang zaw ta a mingsuvtiy kha dang yi te, ama ngaa diy.
Babilon ca sungkha ta tla te a kyichi diy, a cuo khata caa tie ung! A hmaa cuo khata siyy va la tie ung, a tluo ngiethie aa.

Babilon patluo riypa na maa zue, cuorasala patluo khu aw'a vyi. Ama kha maw tie ung, ma ruo cyicuo luo kha si'a ung puv; tahematapakieca ama bieripana ca vuoruo luo kha pha te, avuo te tana calang pata a cuo.
Abyipana ma sue lina kha a paluo sa, a vaw tie ung, Abyipama Khazing rehriena kha Zion lieta phu'a ung puv.

Na cuoti kha cata tie! Lavaabya kha pabi tie! Abyipana Medes siepahruo tie kha a pasu yi, tahematapakieca Babilon hne aa pazue pata aa tingna ca para riypata a cuo, Abyipaphuvlana, a biena-ing cuota phuvlana tana a cuo.

Babilon dungkhuo lungruetlepie hmielie kha pangtaa pathlie tie ung; a huotuv tie kha cahra sa ung la, rievetuv kha chi tie ung; ngiesatuv tie kha tingtuo pacie tie ung; tahematapakieca Abyipata Babilon lie khy a sapa tie hneta aa pazuepa ca tingtuo pacie te a hrie tli.
Tiy lepuv athaalie kha aw cate, suethiy a hnyirungpa, na chuona na a vya tlung tli, na hringna riy na a ci tli.
Cungnungce Abyipata ama ming mamaapa ta chie aa sa tli: A phuv ta a awpa khawbyapa zaa a tapa cawsaa hluvsa kha nama'a luo vya pathlie'a angte, na cunglie kha tena ueryi hne khuosa ta ama khi aa.
Khazing ca a cahrana ta alyi a sapa tana a cuo, a singna ta chuelyi a pacu sa, a pachangna ta avuo khiy a pake.
A ueryi a pathlie tiyta, avuo lieta khytiy puraa aa thyi, alyi dena taata myiching a pathu sa. Khytiy huo khata thinghlaa cakang sa te, a chechiy china ing taata thliy kha a papya.

Cawsaa mekaa ca ngaa yi te thesingna hnyi va yi; siy a patlepa bangkhuo ca ama kuvtuezuv ta ama nang a pazaa yi; tahematapakieca ama kuvtuezuv tie ca dungna ta cuo yi te, ama chunglie hringna huv aw vyi.
Iema ca muo a hnyi lipa, dungna re tana ama cuo; iema duotena ning lie kha ama ra aa.
Jakob cuvu ta a cuopa Abyipaca cahaacata cuo vyi, tahematapakieca ama ca hmangting bangkhuo a satuv tana a cuo, Israel ca a ru hne a mingphang tana a cuo; a ming ca Cungnungce Abyipatana a cuo.

Nama ca i rietuvnapa tungbung, i rietuvnapa cehre tana na cuo: nama hing tana mingphang tie kha i dechi diy'a yi; nama hing tana pena tie kha i para'a yi; nama hing tana aruo hne a khangtuv tie kha i dechi diy'a yi;
nama hing tana aruole hne a khangtuv tie kha i dechi diy'a yi;
nama hing tana capaa hne canung kha i dechi diy'a yi; nama hing tana macuo hne mingnu kha i dechi diy'a yi; nama hing tana satlie hne lesaa kha i dechi diy'a yi;

nama hing tana tuvkhietuv hne a tuvrung zaw kha i dechi diy'a yi; nama hing tana luthlutuv tie hne a phuv tie kha i dechi diy'a yi; nama hing tana uvtuv tie hne luosituv byi tie zaw kha i dechi diy'a yi.
Babilon hne a chunglie khy a sapa Khaldi ming bangkhuo kha Zion cunglie ama tuepa pha lina kawlieta na ming hmungna lie hrahring ta i thung'a yi, Abyipata a ta.
Vya paratuv tluo, kama na caa du ung, alyi cung a paratuv, Abyipata a ta. Nama a du pata i kuv hing pazuo'a angte, lungkuo daw taata ca pahlang pathla'a angte, myi ta a kuopa tluo ta ica tue aa.
Ingkiylung riypata nama'a taata alung suokha hmuo la pata cuo'a vyi, ing hruopatu riypata zaw la pata cuo'a vyi, cuorasala nama ca chuozaa ta na duothling aa, Abyipata a ta.

Ruo chunglie kha pangtaa pathlie ung la, mingphang zaw hrawlie kha hmyakaa tung tie ung; ama a du riypata mingphang zaw kha tingtuo ung la, ama a du riypata pena zaw kha pathu tie ung, Ararat, Minni, hne Ashkenaz; ama a du riypata riebyilepa pakha kha chi tie ung, khawbyapa phuv lepuv haata aruo kha a vawkhyi tie ung.
Ama kha rie a du riypata mingphang zaw kha tingtuo ung la, Medes siepahruo tie, ama uvtuv tie hne ama luosituv byi tie, iema uvna chung ruo mekaa kha ama a du riypata tingtuo pacie tie ung.
Ruo ca a cathang te aa cahang, tahematapakieca Babilon ruo kha pa duothling riypa hne, a chunglie ahunghmuo khy pasa sa li riypa tingna hneta, Abyipata Babilon kha aa du tli.
Babilon rieka tie ca rietuv ama taw tli, ama cariekyikuo chunglie khana ama aw; ama thaa naa te, canung haata ama cuo. A ing kha myi ta rue yi te, a thlake hrenapa ca ama tli diy tli.

Babilon siepahruo ca a khypuv kha kuo kha taata a chuona kuo kha te ta, ama la diy tli tapa kha chang riypata, paruopa pakha ta a hrangpa pakha vaa taw riypata cuose, biephyatuv pakha ta a hrangpa pakha vaa taw riypata amaa ruo.
Tiyhaa kha carie tie ta la yi te, baw ruo kha myi ta ama rue, rieka ca ama thlaa dyi a zang.
Cungnungce AbyipaIsrael Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Babilon sacanung ca suo-aciyna lie suo a ciy ning haa tana a cuo; a ru hluota lieta sa lana cuo ta a cuo'a tli.
“Babilon siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar na naa ce tli, ama na naa tlawpuo tli; bi hripa haa tana ina tue tli, phaazuv haa tana ina paluo tli; i saa pahuo daduo khata a riy a pabi te ina paliy pakhaa.
Zion lie khy a sapa tie ta, “Caphichi diypa i saa ta Babilon kha phuv la mang sue,” ama ta aa. Jerusalem ta, “I thiyse ta Khaldi lie khy a sapa tie kha phuv la mang yi sue,” a ta aa.
Caacuonakawta Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Na bie ca ca ripa'a angte, na cuota phuv i la aa. A riyliy kha paky diy'a angte, a tiyhnaa ca a ky aa.
Cakhutaata Babilon ca hnehnaw papungnapa, ruo-uv aa chuona hmang, ciy aa chiyna hne riparuvpa hmang, ahunghmuo khysa lina hmang ta a cuo aa.
Chingde haata a hrung pakhaw'a yi te, chingdetaata haata ama khi aa.
Ama rue ta a khingsa ning kha, dang riypa pi'a yi angte, pariy'a yi te amaa nuo aa; cakhutaata chuozaa ta a hmung'a yi te, a kya cha buo'a va tli yi, Abyipata a ta.
Thie riypata a dalepa tuvtaata, tuvtungpa hne mietungpa haa khata i dale'a yi.
Tuokhaatama Sheshak ca la pata cuo te, alyi cung hruotlena ca patuv pata a cuo! Tuokhaatama Babilon ca mingphang zaw cuota ciy aa chiysapa ta aa li!
Babilon ca riyliy tiy na a vya tli; a pachi khalapa tiylaw na a buvkhung tli.
A khypuv zaw ca ciy aa chiysana hmang ta a li yi te, hmuo the a aw lipa ruocaapa, ahunghmuo khysa linapa hmang, cawsaa ta ama capiepaa linapa hmang ta aa li aa.
Bel hne Babilon ca duote'a angte, a paluo ciepa kha i paliy sa pakhaa aa. Mingphang zaw ta ama kha vya pangie'a va tli yi, Babilon dungkhuo lungruetlepie ca a cing mangtli.
I cawsaa zaw, ama chung taa khata kya pya tie ung! a ie ta a iepa Abyipahihaana taa khata, nama cyicuo ta, nama hringna kha a khuo tie ung!

Ruo chunglie thuohlaa nama thyipa kawlieta nama palung ra khah sala, a ciy zaw ciy khah ung, kung kha ta thuohlaa suokha a aw, kung pakhaapa lie a hrangpa a aw pakhaa, ruo chunglieta a tuv a thienapa thuohlaa, uvtuv pakha ta uvtuv pakha aa dunapa thuohlaa na a aw.
Babilon kuvtuezuv zaw kha duo i tena cuo ca aa vaw hmisi tli; a ruo yalya lie nangzaana tlung'a te, a cawsaa ama thiepa tie ca a chunglie kha ama laa patlaw thluo aa.

Cakhutaata alyi hne avuo, a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo ca, Babilon cuona cunglie kha ama palung tluo pata ama khi aa; tahematapakieca paratuv ca iema a du riypata chaluo taata aa zuv tli, Abyipata a ta.
Babilon ta alyi cung yalya lie a thiepa tie amaa liepa haata, Israel kha a thie nakawta Babilon ca aa lie aa.
Zueziy taata a lawpa tie, cakuo tie ung, haasaa khah ung! Luohlaa ruo chunglie kha Abyipaca a thyi tie ung, Jerusalem kha nama palung chunglie a thyi tie ung.
Kiema ca esena bie kha ma thyi nakawta ma nang a zaa; ruohrang ming kha Abyipaing, hmang pathepa tie chungluo amaa ngie tli nakawta ma hmie a chi.
Caacuonakawta a kuvtuezuv tie kha duo te'a angte, ruo chung bangkhuo lieta hmaa a phyapa tie amaa hrungna cuo ca aa vaw hmisi tli, Abyipata a ta.
Babilon ca avuo a dena te a suo te, aa dungkhuonapa kha kha tluv ta a pasuo zawta, kama'a taata paratuv kha i patlungsue aa, Abyipata a ta.
Naathlie tie ung! Babilon taata khina ueryi ca! Khaldi ming ruo taata rana lepa pu ca!
Tahematapakieca Abyipana Babilon ca a para, ci li pata a khi-una pu kha a padie.

Tahematapakieca paratuv ca ama a du riypata aa vaw tli, Babilon a du riypata aa vaw tli; a rieka tie ca la pata cuo yi te, ama liy zaw kha ama thlipa diy; tahematapakieca Abyipaca vieriy a thungpa ta cuo te, a tlingpa tana a thung aa.

A byi tie hne a mingsing tie, uvtuv tie, luosituv byi tie, hne rieka tie zaw kha i pariy sa'a yi; iema ca chuozaa a hmungna ta a hmung'a yi te, a cha pakhaa buo'a va tli yi, ta pata Siepahruo, a ming Cungnungce Abyipaa cuopa ta a ta.

Cungnungce Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: A chaasapa Babilon dungkhuo lungruetlepie ca alyi hne aa ciymie pata pacing'a yi te, aa suopa a thlake zaw kha myi ta ama rue aa. Cawsaa ca a hrihripa lie kha ama thaa a pachuo yi te, mingphang tie ca myi lie iema hne iema ama thaa amaa pabuo.

Judah Siepahruo Zedekiah siepahruo a cuonapa kung paliy kung lie, Babilon luo ama hneta ama si ningta, Mahseiah sacapaa Neriah sacapaa Seraiah'a kha profet Jeremiah ta bie a pipa ca hing haa hingta a cuo.
Babilon cunglieta a vya tlung riypa rana bangkhuo kha Jeremiah ta caataw lie kha a cape, capa bie bangkhuo ca Babilon hne aa pazue pata capepa a cuo.
Jeremiah ta Seraiah kyihuo khata: “Babilon luo na tlung tiyta, hingpa bie bangkhuo hing ri'a cate,
‘Vya Abyipa, nama ta, hingpa hmang hing para'a angte, cawsaa cuose, saruopa cuose aw'a va yi, hingpa hmang hing chuozaa ta a duothlingpa hmang tana a cuo aa,’ na ta, na ta aa.
Caataw kha na ri diy khutaata, alung hneta ciypuo la, Zufrates cavaa liekhingkhuo luo kha na thaw khutaata,
‘Kama ta a cunglie i patlung sapa rana kawlieta Babilon ca hing haa hing tana tiy chung luo a tla aa, a kya phang pakhaa'a va tli,’ na ta aa,” a ta. Hingpa te hing Jeremiah bie ta a cuo.

Zedekiah ca siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu ning kha kung kiy kung kha ta a cuo; Jerusalem lie kha kung hraa hlyikha siepahruo a cuo. A nung ming ca Hamutal ta cuo te, Libnah ming Jeremiah sacanung ta a cuo.
Jehoiakim ta a tuepa haa khata ama ta Abyipahmungna lie kha a pha lipa a tue.
Jerusalem hne Judah ta Abyipakha khuosa ta a hi ama pahaa hmisi nakawta a hmungna taata aa cade yi. Zedekiah ta Babilon siepahruo kha aa du.

Caacuonakawta siepahruo a cuona kung caky kung, thla hraa thlaa, ning hraana lie kha Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ca a rieka bangkhuo hne khata Jerusalem kha a du riypata sihnue te, cadung yi te, riekhuocaaca kha ama sa cahlung.
Cahaacata Siepahruo Zedekiah siepahruo a cuona kung hraa hlyikha a tana te khata khypuv ca ama cadung.
A thla paliyna thlaa, ning cakyna lie ca khypuv chunglie kha cakuo a ruv hringhruo tli nakawta ruo chunglie cawsaa tie cuota sa aw va tli.

Khaldi ming ta khypuv kha ama cadung raalaa pata khypuv dungkhuo lungruetlepie kha a khue vaa yi te, siepahruo diedung athaalie lungruetlepie suohning tie alala thlake athaalie luopuv taa khata rieka bangkhuo ca zuo khata khypuv taata pya yi te amaa ruo, Arabah kuo luo khata ama si.
Cuorasala Khaldi rieka tie khata siepahruo ca a cade yi te, Jeriko ase lie kha ama pha; a rieka tie bangkhuo ca a chepatlaa diy yi te, ama kha amaa ruose.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ca patuv yi te, Hamath ruo chung, Riblah lie Babilon siepahruo'a luo kha sikhyi yi te a cunglie biechipana a tue.
Babilon siepahruo ca ta Zedekiah sacapaa zaw kha a ming hmungna lieta thie yi te, Judah byi bangkhuo zaw kha Riblah lie ca a thie yi.
Zedekiah ca a ming kha cakhyi te hrakyi a khe, cakhutaata Babilon siepahruo ca ta Babilon luo sikhyi te a thiyna ning te ta thaw a pathla.

A thla pangaana, a ning hraana, Babilon siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar siepahruo a cuona kung hraa hlyicakyna lie kha, siepahruo rehrietuv ama pangpa rievetuv riebyipa Nebuzaradan ca Jerusalem luo kha aa ngie.
Ama ta Abyipaing, siepahruo ing, hne Jerusalem lie ing bangkhuo kha myi ta a rue; ing lepa bangkhuo kha myi ta a rue diy.
Rievetuv riebyipa hne a awpa Khaldi rieka tie bangkhuo khata Jerusalem dungkhuo lungruetlepie bangkhuo kha ama pacing diy.
