Rievetuv riekabyi Nebuzaradan ta a siy pasa cepa cawsaa chekha hne khypuv chunglie ama thusepa cawsaa tie hne Babilon siepahruo'a luo a ruo lupa tie, hne aa ngaapa kuvzung a thepa tie kha sii ta aa da diy yi.
Cuorasala rievetuv riebyipa Nebuzaradan ta ruo chunglie a siy pasa cepa cawsaa chekha tie kha mingsuv mangchiytuv hne lu zaa thlu riypata a thuse siy yi.
Abyipaing chunglie daa tung zaw, hne Abyipaing chunglie daa rahunglepa hne a tung zaw kha Khaldi ming ca ta dechi diy yi te, daa bangkhuo ca Babilon luo ama sikhyi diy.
Biena-ing chung abiena lie hmuopa bi zaw, kawpia zaw, cecakie zaw, pakaa a thuvpa zaw, phiethlalepa zaw, hne biena-ing abiena lie hmuopa daa bi bangkhuo zaw kha ama sikhyi diy.

Rievetuv riekabyi ca ta kuotung cawta, buvcuo liyna phie, pakaa aa thuvpa, bi, myi-ing tung, phiethlalepa, dangpa ta panaana lie hmuopa kuotung cawta, siy ta tuepa hne ngu ta tuepa tie zaw kha a sikhyi diy.

Siepahruo Solomon ta Abyipaing lie huota a tuepa atung suohning, rahunglepa suokha, rahunglepa rawlie daa cuetungpa sa hraa hlyihning, hne a tung zaw, hingpa daa biphie zaw bangkhuo aa riynapa ca a cyi pathlie tie'a pata cuo vyi.
Atung lepa suokha ca tung kha ta daw hraa hlyicari a suo te, a sung ta daw hraa hlyihning a ta, a karaw pata cuo te a thaa ca zung paliy a chaa.

A daw lie ca daa ta tuepa aa tung daw pakhuv aw te, aa tung daw lakhuv suokha aa suona ca daw pangaa ta a cuo; a sue khue haata sapa hne cale thyi kha daa ta tue ngiethie yi te a daw pakhuv cunglie kha ama cadung sa. A tung suohningna zaw ca cahaa ngiethie cata cale thyi hneta a cuo.
A kuo luo ta cale thyi saw caky suosariy a aw; cale thyi zakha bangkhuo ca ta a sue khue a lupa kha a cadung.
Rievetuv riekabyi ca ta tluobyi le cepa Seraiah, tluobyi le cepa a paziypa Zefaniah, hne chiypakaa a huopa pathung tie zaw kha a patuv yi.

Khypuv chung taa khata rieka tie a uvtuv byi pakha, khypuv chunglieta hmungpa siepahruo tluopuv phuv chungtaata cawsaa pasariy, ruo chunglie cawsaa zaw a pakiytuv riekabyi le cepa caacapetuv; hne khypuv chunglie hmungpa cawsaa capaa sawcaruv zaw kha a la yi.
Cakhutaata rievetuv riekabyi Nebuzaradan ta iema kha la yi te, Riblah lieta Babilon siepahruo'a luo kha a sikhyi yi.
Cakhutaata Babilon siepahruo ta iema kha Hamath ruo Riblah lieta tuv yi te a thie yi. Cahaacata Judah ca a ruo taa khata siicuona luo sikhyi pata a cuo.
Hingpa tie hing Nebukhadnezzar ta sii ta a sikhyipa tie ta ama cuo: kung sariyna lieta, Judah ming thawthung pakiy pathung;
Nebukhadnezzar siepahruo a cuona kung hraa hlyi carina lieta Jerusalem taata sii ta a sikhyipa tie ca zacari sawthung pahning;
Nebukhadnezzar siepahruo a cuona kung kiy kung thungna lieta, rievetuv riekabyi Nebuzaradan ta sii ta a sikhyipa Judah ming ca zasariy sawliy papangaa; a bangkhuo ta thawpaliy zapaliy ta a cuo.

Judah siepahruo Jehoiachin sii ta amaa danapa kung sawthung kung sariy kung, thla hraa hlyihning, ning kiy ning paliy ning, Babilon Siepahruo Evil-merodak siepahruo cuo hruo aa thu kung lie kha Judah Siepahruo Jehoiachin kha hmiephaa pi te thaw taata a papya.
Duena hneta bie rihne te, Babilon lie ama hneta a awpa siepahruo hrangpa tie atuna a cung vie lie khata atuna a pi.
Caacuonakawta Jehoiachin ta a thaw tlanapa caw kha thlie te, siepahruo cabya lie kha a chuo chung, ningting ta sa a ning ra pari.
Babilon siepahruo ta aa huna lie ningting ta a hmuo riypa zaw kha a hring chung bangkhuo, a thiyna ning te ta a pi.

Ahluo ning cawsaa ama za binapa khypuv ca ama se tana aa tu thluo de! Mingphang zaw hrawlie a lesyipa ta zaa cuopa ca tuokhaatama nunghlyi haata aa li! Pena zaw hrawlie siepahruonung zaa cuopa ca chang pachaapa rehrietuv tana aa li.
Zuo ta khuosa ta a caa, a be lie mingthliy a za lang; ama a duepa zaw hrawlie, a hnaa a panguotuv riypa pakha hmuo aw va yi; a viesaa bangkhuo ca a rawtuv ta a li yi te, a carie ta amaa li diy.
Judah ca te-angna hne re ruvpa hriena hne tana siicuona chung luo aa ngie; mingphang zaw hrawlieta aw te, a hyna hmang kha hnyi vyi; a palungriethyina chunglie kha a cadepa tie ta ama pha.

Pyi luo kha ahunghmuo amaa vaw li nakawta, Zion luo sinapa luopuv ca aa ngiy; a thlake bangkhuo ca duothling te, a tluobyi tie ca amaa hrung; a lesaa thaata zaw ca ama ngiechi te, ama zaw khuosa ta a ang.
A carie tie ca byi ta a li yi te, a carie tie ca ama chiythaw. A tuesuena a hluv tuv nakawta, Abyipata ruvna a pataw sa; a saata zaw ca a carie tie hmiekunglie kha sii ta sikhyi pata ama cuo.
Sacanung Zion ca a sungnaana bangkhuo na a thuse diy. A siepahruo sacapaa zaw ca tlena a hnyi lipa sasuv haa khata; a cadepa tie hmielie kha thaazuo hnyi li pata amaa ruo.

Jerusalem ta a riethyivuosuona hne a vievuvlena chungtaata, hluo ning a za hnyipa a sungnaapa hmang bangkhuo kha aa thyi thluo. A cawsaa zaw kha carie tie kuv chung luo tla yi te, ama a byatuv riypa pakha hmuo ama aw li ning kha, a carie tie ta a tlabungpa kha esena hneta ama mang.

Jerusalem ca a sue tuv hringhruo nakawta, ese hyalya riypa tana aa li; a thliehripa ta a awpa kha ama hmung nakawta, ama a pa-uvsathyipa bangkhuo ta ama kha ama duvsa; ama hrahring kha a hrung te, malie cung luo a hmie khang nguo vyi.

A pathe lina kha aa hning lie a luo te, a hmieluo kaw kha rue vyi; a tlabungzya ca ciy a chiysa te, ahungtahmuo a hnaanguona ri va yi. “Vya Abyipai riethyivuosuona hing na za mangpa tie, tehematapakieca i cariepa na naa te!”
Carie tie na a muo sungnaapa a hmang bangkhuo kha ama kuv ta a paza yi; nama ta na cawsaa zaw hraw luo a ngie riypata na thlupa tie ta a hmangpathepa ama lapa kha ama ta a ming ta a hmung.

A cawsaa zaw bangkhuo ca a hrung yi te, viechuo kha ama huv; ama thaa patlung pakhaa riypata ama suethiy kha viechuo calyina ta ama zaa. Muo a hnyi lipa tana i li, na mang tie, Vya Abyipana mang la na hmung tie.

I thaalie a vya cakuolepa bangkhuo, niema cuota khaapahmuo cuo va ma? Na mang tie ung, kama ngiechipa haa hingta a ngie a chipa ama aw'a ma? Abyipata a hihaana ning lieta i cunglie a patlungpa duotena tana a cuo.
Aa suona taata myi kha a za pathlie, i ruv chung luo kha aa ngie; i phyi kha asue pare khuo te, hnangluo ina pakaa sa; i luv zing pata na thuse te, ning-aw ta thaazuo hnyi va ang.
I tuesuena kha ruekhang lie ciypuo te, a kuv ta a thuopuo diy yi; i rue lie kha a pathlie te, i thaa kha ina pachuo; I daapuo khu lipa tie kuv chung luo kha, Abyipata ina pi.
Kama chunglie i rieka tie bangkhuo kha, Abyipata a thaw tli yi; i mingnu tie kha hrisaa riypata kama a duna cuo kha a pathyi sa; Abyipata Judah lesaa pathenung ca, mingsuv aciyna lie kha aa ciy tli.
Hingpa zaw kawlie hingta caa angte, i mingthliy ca a tla; i rie naa papha riypa hne, i hnaa naa panguo riypa ca aa hlasa; carie ta ina te nakawta, i saata zaw ca ama duothling.

Zion ta a buo a pazuo, cuorasala a hnaanguona a ri riypa aw va yi; Abyipata Jakob a du riypa hne, a ingpaa tie kha a carie ta amaa li riypata naw a papya; Jerusalem ca iema hrawlie kha duv aa chiypa ta aa li tli.
Abyipaca aa dang pari, kama na a bie a i ang; cuorasala, cawsaa bangkhuo zaw, naathlie tie ung, i te-angna hing na hmung tie ung; i lesaa hne i satlie zaw na, siicuona luo ama sikhyi.
Naa duepa tie kha i u yi, cuorasala ina dung yi; ama thaa a patlung riypata sa ama huvna lieta kha i tluobyi tie hne i uvthyi zaw ca khypuv chunglie kha ama thiy mangtli.
Mang tie, Vya Abyipa, kha tluv tama i palung rie a thyi, i lalilahie na a chiy; i chunglieta i palung aa cathlu, khuosa ta i caa du nakaw tana a cuo.

Iema ta ahungtahmuo hnaa panguo li pata i zaa hrung nguoluopa kha ina thyi yi, i ruvnaana kha i carie tie bangkhuo ta i na thyi yi; hingpa hmang na tuepa kha amaa law. Na pathyisa ciepa ning kha vya patlung sa tie, kama haa hingta cuo naase yi.

Ama tuena pha lipa kha na hmiekung luo kya chiy sala, i tuesuena bangkhuo cuota kama cunglie na tuepa haa khata iema cunglie kha tue tie; tahematapakieca i zaa hrungpa kha hluvsa tli te, i palung rie a thyisa tli.
Abyipahihaana na Sacanung Zion ca a pachung! Israel rungnaana ca avuo taata alyi luo pathla te, a hihaa ningta a phyi chinapa a cuopa kha a thyi va tli.

Abyipata nangduena aw li pata Jakob awna bangkhuo ca a para diy! A hihaana ta sacanung Judah a cariekyikuo bangkhuo kha a pacing diy; pena hne a uvthyi tie kha pa-uvsathyi li pata alyi te ta a pachung yi.
Israel cahrana bangkhuo kha a hihaana ta a tepachung diy; a carie tie hmiekunglieta a cacuoluo kuv kha a da se yi te, Jakob chunglie ca myihlaa haata ie te, a cahriy bangkhuo kha a kuo diy.
Carie haata a liy kha a kyi te, a cacuoluo kuv kha aa pacaw pacie. Sacanung Zion thluodaa chunglie kha maa palesakhyipa tie bangkhuo ca a thie yi; a hihaana kha myi haata a bung diy.

Abyipaca carie haa tana aa li; Israel ca a para diy tli; a siepahruo ing bangkhuo kha para diy te, a cariekyikuo bangkhuo kha a para diy tli, caana hne angiyna khana Sacanung Judah cunglie a cha chiy hryly.
Diedung lie a awpa thluodaa haa khata, bienathluodaa kha a para, Abyipata Zion lie biena pyi hne sabbath kha a para diy, a hi a haa hringhruo nakawta siepahruo hne tluobyi kha siysaa hehmuo ri va yi.

Abyipata a bienatluophie kha siysaa ri li pata, a hmangpathepa kha a thaw tli; a siepahruo ing dungkhuo lungruetlepie kha a cariepa kuv chung luo a pi; Abyipaing chunglie kha pyi ning ama khipa haa khata ama khi.

Abyipata sacanung Zion dungkhuo lungruetlepie kha para riypata bie aa chi; khuhriy pasi te a taa pacie diy, para riypata a kuv kha a diy vyi; khypuv dungkhuo hne lungruetlepie ca a pacaa sa pakhaw yi.

A thlake zaw ca alyi raw luo tla yi te, a thlake tluo zaw kha a thlipachung diy; a siepahruo hne a uvtuv byi tie ca mingphang hrang tie hrawlie kha aw yi te, ziy riypa phung kha aw va tli; a profet tie zaw ta Abyipa'a taata muocuo hmung va tli yi.
Sacanung Zion uvthyi tie ca alyi lie kha a dieta tah amaa tu; ama luv kha buvcuo a phuv yi te, buri kha amaa buv; Jerusalem lesaa zaw ca alyi luo kha amaa bung.

I caanapa ta i ming ca thling te, i lalilahie ta a chiy; i cawsaa zaw parana kawlieta i palung rie a thyi hringhruo, haatiyta hne haaseta zaw ca khypuv chung luopuv cunglie kha nangdiy tiyhrie pata ama aw.

Iema ta ama nung zaw'a lie kha “Khaapaliema viechuo hne mingsuvtiy kha a aw?” ama ta. Khypuv chung luopuv cunglie ca hmaa a phyapa tie haa khata ama aw, ama nung zaw cacunghnaa chunglie ca ama huv sung riy hmuo aw va tli.

Khaapama i ri khu aa, khaapa hneta ma ica pakhingpuo aa? Vya sacanung Jerusalem. Nama hnaapanguo riypa hingta khaapama ica pakhingpuo aa? Vya lesaapathepa, sacanung Zion. Na ranapa ca riyliy zaa ta a ku nakawta, ahungma caa patluo khu aa?
Na profet tie ta hangna hne dungna muocuo kha aca hmungpa yi; nama a sapathiy riypata na pha lina kha phu va yi, cuorasala aa hmuo lipa hne caa sikhyi chie riypata bie kha aca hmungpa yi.

Luopuv lie a vya cakuopa bangkhuo ta ama kuv aca cabesue yi; sacanung Jerusalem kha a paruv ta a kawchie rina cangta ama luv aca tisue yi; “Hingpa hing ma puvthe a patlingpa, chuelyicung bangkhuo alawna ama tapa cata a cuo?” ama ta.

Na carie tie bangkhuo ta ama pakaa aca uosue yi; a paruv ta na kawchie ca ri yi te ama haa aca riesue yi, “Ama ca ima paluo tli hing! ta pata ama khi. Ah, hingpa hing muo imaa zaa ngietie lipa ning ta a cuo ta; a chuona lie ca ima hmung tli hing!” ama ta.

Abyipana aa tingnapa ca a tue tli, a paciy sanapa yi khana a tue hmisi; hluo ningta a za rue ciepa haa khata ngiechina hnyi li pata ca para te, na carie tie kha na cunglieta ama palung patluo sa te, ca hra sa yi te a calang yi.
Vya sacanung Zion dungkhuo lungruetlepie! Abyipa'a luo kha khuosa ta khi tie! Na mingthliy ca chung zuo ta cavaa tiy haata lang se! A cawta hehmuo a pahy khah, na mingthliy zaw huv khah se!

Thu la zuo rieve aa pathuna cuo lie kyry khata khuosa ta khi tie! Abyipa hmiekunglie kha na palung ca tiy haa khata bung tie! Luopuv atawna bangkhuo lieta nangdiy pata a laalepa na saata zaw hringna cuo khata Abyipa'a luo kha na kuv caba tie.
Vya Abyipamang la khuerue tie! Hingpa hing ahung'a lie ma na tue? Canung ta ama sapa ama saata ca ama ning thluo'a ma? Tluobyi hne profet ca Abyipahmangpathepa lie ma thie pata ama cuo aa?
Mingnu hne macuo hne tana luopuv lie, alyi lie kha ama laa thluo; i lesaa hne i satlie zaw ca zueziy tana ama thiy; na hihaanapa ning lie khana nama ta na thie yi, nangduena hnyi li pata na thie yi.
Nama ta i carie tie kha pyi ning haa khata hmangting taata na ku yi, Abyipahihaa ning ca pakha hmuo a ruo pata a lawpa aw va yi; sa yi angte i mangsangpa tie kha i carie ta a para diy yi.
Khazing hihaana rawlieta te-angna a hmungpa ca kama tana i cuo.
Kama kha na sikhyi te khena a aw linapa zingna chung luo inaa chiy.
Kama kha a kuv ta ning-aw ningtlabu ina tuv pakhaa pari.
Ama ta i vang hne i saa kha pacaw diy te, i ruv kha a thli diy.
Kama kha na cadung te, a khapa hne riethyivuosuona ta ina pahlaw.
A thiyna a pasiysa tlipa haa khata khyzingna lie ina patu.
I ruo khu li riypata na cadung khuo diy te, aa riysapa thaabuoliriy ta ina pa-uo.
Khi angte byana i hie raalaa pata, i thlaachuona kha naathlie vyi.
I luopuv lie kha lungtung na chikhuo te, i sina luopuv a dang khu vyi.
Ama ca kama naa daakhuopa cavaw haata hne, naa bawkhuopa chingde haa tana a cuo.
Luopuv lipa luo na sikhyi te, ina thlaapatlaa diy; a duothlingpa ta ina tue.
A liy kha a kyi te ina e, a cuoti cuota cuokaa ta ina chi.
A lavaabya lie cuoti khata, i thihmaa lie ina ka.
I cawsaa zaw bangkhuo pahnyisue riypata cuo angte, ning-aw ning tlabu ta hlake ina sasue yi.
Kama kha a khapa ta na pabi te, uocuokhaa ta ina pariy sa.
Lungcaring lie kha i haa na cata sa te, buvcuo lie kha ina cabuv sa.
I hringna ta diena kha thuse te, khaapa kha ma alawna tapa kha i maw tli.
Caacuonakawta, “I rungnaana hne Abyipa'a taata i nguopuona bangkhuo ca a vie tli,” i ta.
Ing li lu li pata i te-angna kaw ruepa ca uocuokhaa hne mangkhaa na a lu!
I hringna ta capa ca rue pari te, i palung a cawsale.
Cuorasala capa ca ruepathiy angte, anguopuona kha i hnyi:
Aa hmangparipa Abyipaduena ca ci buo hluo vyi, a nangduena ca chuo buo hluo vyi;
a maw tating ta a thaa pari; zang tluo naa tlana ca a le hringhruo.
“Abyipaca kama cuvu tana a cuo,” i hringna ta a ta, “Caacuonakawta ama kha i nguopuo aa.”
Abyipaca ama a huopa tie hne, ama a huvpa tie cuota a pha.
Abyipakhuona ca a dieta tah huo pata na a pha.
Mingnu cuo ningta palung pasiy a cuv pata a pha.
Abyipata capa palungpasiyna aca pacuv ning ca pakha dyi ta a dieta tah a tu riypata a cuo,
a panena hneta buvcing luo a hmie a naw riypa tana a cuo, tahematapakieca aruechuona a aw kalie khu.
Na be caa tungpa kha kuokhaluo chawpa kalie riypata a cuo, ca ese hyalya thluo yi se.
Tahematapakieca Abyipaca chuozaa ta ca thaw'a vyi.
Ama ngie a pachi raalaa pa yi ta, aa hmangpa a duena a le nakawta kawpacuona a hnyi'a yi;
tahematapakieca a khingsa pata cawsaa pakha kha te-angna hne ngiechina a pataw sa pata cuo vyi.
Ruo chunglie thaw a tlapa bangkhuo kha phyi ta chaapuopa ama cuo tiyta,
Cungnungce hmiekunglieta puvkhyipa cuvu kha chuvpa ama cuo tiyta,
cawsaa pakha bie kha a luo li pata pasungpa a cuo tiyta, Abyipata hmung va ma?
Abyipata cuo se, a ta lipa ca ahungma bie pi'a te a patue sa khu aa?
A phapa hne a chiepa aa vawnapa hing, Cungnungce pakaa taa tana a cuo, cuo va ma?
Khaapanakawma a huv a sungpa cawsaa hingta iema sue duotena kawlieta bie a pahluv khu aa?
Ma luopuv kha dyapasya pata mangpasie ung sala, Abyipa'a luo kaa ung siy.
Vuoruo lie a awpa Khazing'a luo kha ma palung hne ma kuv kha calang ung siy.
Kiema ta sue pate maacaa du, nama ta malie a ngiethe vaciy.
Na hihaana ta a pahlaw cate kiema kha malie naa cade, ngiechina hnyi li pata malie na thie.
Amyi ta naa pahlaw nakawta ma thlaachuona ta ca pha khu vyi.
Mingphang zaw hrawlie kha apyapa hne hnehnaw ta malie na tue.
Ma carie tie bangkhuo khata ama pakaa malie ama uosue.
Kiema ca ciy aa chiypa hne khue chung luo tlana, chiena hne rana ta malie a tlungsue.
I cawsaa zaw parana kawlie khata i mingthliy ca cavaa tiy haata a lang.
I mingthliy ca a hy li pata a lang.
Vuoruo taata Abyipata na za mang te ina za hmungna te ta.
Khypuv chunglie lesaa tie amaa tawpa hmang kawlieta, i mingthliy ta i ngie ina pachi.
I carie tie khata a kaw aw li pata pavaa bya ta ina bya yi.
I hringpa ta khue chung luo na pahlang pathla yi te, alung ina thawsue yi.
Tiy ta i luv te na vya te, “I vie tli,” i ta.
Aa thuvpa khue chung taa kha tana na ming ta ica ku, Vya Abyipa;
Paa ica kiena kha ina thyi ciy, “Byana vuota i khipa kha, na naa a parue thi khah, cuorasala hya na pazang thi tie!” i ta.
Ica u tiyta naa vya ngie cate, “Ciy khah!” ina ta ciy.
Vya Abyipa, nama ta i bie ca na ripa cate, i hringna kha ina khuo ciy.
Vya Abyipa, i cunglie pha lina ama tuepa kha na hmung, i bie ca na ripa tie.
I-aw ina hnyipa yi hne i cunglie rawna ama tuepa bangkhuo kha na hmung.
Vya Abyipa, bieke ina risuepa yi hne ina rawna bangkhuo yi kha na thyi.
I carie tie ta ning-aw ningtlabu ta na caw-yi yi te i kawchie ina ri yi.
Mang tie, i tu kie cuose, i daa kie cuose, hlake ta kepa tana i cuo.
Vya Abyipa, ama kuv ta ama tuena haa khata thung tie yi.
Khuopuv ta palung pasana kha pi yi la, na chiesana kha ama cunglie tlung se!
Hihaana ta iema kha a cade yi la, Abyipaavuo raw taa khata para tie yi.
Siy ca a thiysa tli de, siy pathepa ca tuokhaatama hingpa tluv hingta aa thle khu? Alung pathepa tie ca luopuv aa tawna bangkhuo lie tana ama laale patlaw.
Zion saata muosungpa tie ca, siy pathepa tluv tana ama za sungnaa; khaapanakawma bivytuv kuv ta a tuepa alyi bi tluv dyi ta ri pata ama cuo?
Ruo-uv ta hmuo a saata zaw kha mangchiy te meme a pazaw sa yi, cuorasala i cawsaa zaw ca ruocaapa lie kala-uvpavaa haa tana amaa hruo.
Meme a pazaw kaliepa haaseta ca a tiy a hrie nakawta a duo lie a palyi aa bepuo; haatiy ta sa a hie yi te, cuorasala ahungtahmuo pi va yi.
A pahuosa pata zaa ning tawpa tie ca luopuv liena ama thiy thluo; caw ciycaapa zaa buv yi te a zaa lethawpa tie ca hnehnaw cungliena amaa tu thluo.
I cawsaa tie duotena ca cawsaa kuv kuv kha hmuo pathlie li pata sungkha ta parapa Sodom duotena laata a le vie.
Aa byi tie ca cahue laata ngu vie yi te, cuehnung laata ama ruo vie; ama pangpa ca koral lungvaa laata setunglung vie yi te, ama suo ca safaiar lungvaa na a lu.
Ata hing ca ama hmie ca cungcing laata vaw vie te, luopuv lie pachang khu'a pata cuo va yi. Ama vang ca ama ruv lie a bepuo te, thing ruepa haa tana a caa.
Sa kuo maa pata a thiypa tie laata zueziy ta a thiypa tie kha ama vuo a pha vie; lu taata a vyipa kha ama hmung li nakawta ama hringna ca tiy zuv tana a zuv.
A palung nesapa canung zaw ta iema saata kha ama pasu; i cawsaa zaw parana chunglie ca saata zaw ca nung tie sa ta amaa li.
Abyipata a pathiylingna kha palung a yisa pata pathlie te, a hihaana kha a bung; Zion kha myi ta rue te, a hruopatu te ta a kuo.
Khaapa carie ta hmuo Jerusalem thlake chung luo amaa ngie khu aa ta pata, alyi cung siepahruo tie ta zang va yi, chuelyi cung ming bangkhuo ta zaw zang va yi.
Jerusalem khychung lieta aa dangpa tie thiyse a palangpa profet tie hne tluobyi tie suena kawlie tana a cuo.
Iema ca mingcuepa haa khata luopuv mekaa kha a khie yi te, thiyse amaa pahlaw nakawta ahungtahmuo ama pang kha de nguo va yi.

Cawsaa ta, “Cakuo ung! A pathe lipa tie!” “Cakuo ung! Cakuo ung! De khu khah ung!” ta pata ama khisue. Caacuonakawta iema ca a vievuvpa hne aa khielepa ta a li yi te, mingphang zaw hrawlie kha hing haa hingta ama za ri, “Iema ca hingpa lie hing a pasiy aw'a va yi.”
Abyipahrahring ta iema kha chepatlaa yi te, iema kaw kha pacuo'a va tli, tluobyi tie kha pa-uvsathyi va tli yi, uvthyi tie hmie kha mang va tli yi.
Byana a vaw'a ma ta pata ma suona lie ma ming a ri diy tli, tahematapakieca malie a khuo khu lipa mingphang khana a nguopuosa pata ma za huo ung.
Ma luopuv lie ma ziy khu li riypata ma cakuona mekaa kha malie ama mangpathliyle ma chuona ca a vya ngie tli, ma ning ca pasuv pata a cuo tli; tahematapakieca ma chuona ca aa vaw tli.
Malie a cadepa tie ca avuo lie hmungthlu laa tana ama catli vie; tluocung lie kha malie a cade yi te, ruocaapa lieta malie ama bya.
Abyipasathu pathuvpa, ma hringna huv ta a cuopa, “Ama ningdiy rawlie hingna mingphang zaw hrawlie ima hring aa,” ma tapa khana ama khue chunglie ama patuv.

Vya sacanung Edom, Uz ruo lieta a awpa, na palung tluo sala a law tie; cuorasala nama'a luo zaw panuo ca a vya tlung ra aa; pariy'a cate nama hrahring ta na caw kha thlie'a cate na thliehripa ta na aw aa.

Vya sacanung Zion, na pha lina duotena ca patlung pata a cuo tli, siicuona luo sikhyi pata cuo buo'a va tli ciy; cuorasala Vya sacanung Edom, na pha lina kha duote pata cuo'a te, na suena kha paluohuo pata na cuo aa.
Vya Abyipa, khaapama malie a tlasue tapa kha maw thi khah; malie mang la, ma nangzaana kha hmung thi tie!
Ma cupa ru khana khyche'a luo pi pata a cuo tli, ma ing khana ruohrang ming'a luo pi pata a cuo tli.
Kiema ca haaraapa hne paa a hnyi lipa ta a li pate, ma nung tie ca nunghlyi haata ama cuo.
Ma dangpa tiy kha a muo pi pate, thing kha maa calyi aa hu.
Ruekhang kha ma rue lie khang yi te, re ruvsapa malie ama pahrie sa; ma nang a buo, a pahyna cuo malie pi va yi.
Riy bi pata sa ma hmungna riypata, Izipt ming hne Assiria ming'a lie kha biekuona ma tue.
Ma mingchingmingvuo tie khana zaa sue yi; iema ca aw va tli yi, cuorasala kiema ta ama suena muo kha ma ang.
Sii ta kiema kha malie uv yi te, iema kuv chungtaata malie a khuo riypa pakha hmuo aw va yi.
Ruocaapa chunglie zueziy rie nakawta, ma hringna pi pata na sa maa hmung.
Sakuo ma maanapa ta ma vang ca lungpathuv haa tana a vaw.
Zion lie canung zaw ca hruohra ta a ziekhyipa cuo yi te, lesaa pathepa tie zaw kha Judah khy zaw lieta cahaacata tue pata ama cuo.
Byi tie ca ama kuv ta pathlie pata cuo yi te, uvthyi tie ca pa-uvsathyi pata cuo va yi.
Satlie tie ca hruohra ta sa parie sa yi te, mingnuta zaw ca thing ama phyapa ta a vy yi.
Kung uvthyi tie ta khypuv thlake kha thuse yi te, mingnu tie ta hlaasa khangtung kha ama thuse.
Ma palungtluona hehmuo aw va tli, ma luona ca maa ngiyna ta aa li.
Byilakhuv ca ma luv taata a tla tli; bawchie ciemuopa tana ma cuo, tahematapakieca ma sue tli!
Hingpa kawlie hingta ma palung pasa te, hingpa zaw kawlie hingta ma ming a zing:
Tahematapakieca Zion Tluo ca duothling tli te, ruo-uv na a cunglie a bu yi.
Cuorasala, Vya Abyipa, nama ca chuozaa siepahruo tana na cuo; na byithude ca chuo bangkhuo ta aa hmang.
Khaapanakawma kiema ca malie na maw karue? Khaapanakawma kiema ca hing cuo ningkhue ta malie na thaw?
Vya Abyipa, nama hrahring ta malie sapathiy tie, cata a cuo kieca sapathiy pata ma cuo aa; hluo ning haa khata ma ningkhue kha malie pathaapa pakhaa tie.
Cata a cuo li kieca malie na thaw karue pata na a cuo tli, ma cunglie chuo the li pata na hi a haa pata na a cuo.
Kung sawthung kung, thla paliy thlaa, ning khana lie kha, Khebar cavaa kie lie, sii ta sikhyipa tie'a lie i aw nguoluopa khata, avuo kha a pahaw te, Khazing muocuo kha i hmung.
Capa thlaa ning pangaa ning kha (Siepahruo Jehoiachin sii ta ama sikhyinapa kung pangaana lie),
Khaldi ming ruo lie, Khebar cavaa kie lie kha Buzi sacapaa tluobyi Ezekiel'a luo kha Abyipabie ca aa zuv; cakhutaata capa lie ca Abyipakuv kha a cunglieta a aw.
I kya mang ca, chaluo taata thliychie a za thupa kha i hmung: a cahriylie khena a awpa amyi lesapa, hne aa hlaa nguoluopa myi aw te, myi chunglie ca aa li nguoluopa lungvaa suethiy suokha a aw.
Capa chunglie, a lie khingkhuo lie ca sahringpa suopaliy hne aa lusapa i hmung. Ama hmingsuo ca cawsaa hmingsuo ama lu.
Hmie suopaliy kaluo hne mathlaa suopaliy kaluo ama hnyi.
Ama phyi ca a dang ruoluo te, ama phyipazaa ca cuetaata caki haata cuo te, ama hnapa daa haata aa li.
A kuo suopaliy lieta ama mathlaa zaw rawlie ca cawsaa kuv ama hnyi. Hmie hne mathlaa kha cahaacata ama hnyi kaluo:
Ama mathlaa ca suokha hne suokha amaa taw; ama cyicuo khata hmie luo ama si, ama si tiyta a maa va yi.
Ama hmie awtuvzya ca: ama hmieluo kuo hmie ca cawsaa hmie, ama cacuoluo kuo hmie ca chingde hmie, ama cavyiluo kuo hmie ca cuetungpa hmie, ama hnangluo kuo hmie ca hmungthlu hmie ta ama cuo.
Ama mathlaa ca cungluo khata ama pake; suohning ta ama viesaa mathlaa kha vaa pataw te suohning ta ama pangpa kha ama buv.
Ama cyicuo ca ta hmieluo kha aa dangsa pata ama si; thlaapa a sina luo kha a maa li pata ama si.
Sahringpa tie liekhingkhuo lie ca myihyi sehunglungpa a lupa a aw, myitaw haa khata sahringpa zaw hrawlie kha hingluo hueluo ta aa khie; myi ca a khesa te capa myi chung taa cata thinghlaa aa cakang.
Sahringpa ca thinghlaa aa cakangpa haata aa ruo bung aa ruo thaw patlaw.
Sahringpa tie kha i mang ca sahringpa tie athaalie alyi lie kha le tiekyphyi suokha i hmung, ama papaliy huota suokha kaluo ta a cuo.
Le tiekyphyi ama hmingsuo hne ama tungbuo ca: beril lungvaa haata amaa li; ama suopaliy cata amaa lu diy, le tiekyphyi suokha chunglieta le tiekyphyi suokha bangpa haata ama cuo.
Ama si tiyta, iema hne ama hmie cyicuo khata si yi te luo pie va yi.
Ama le tieky ca a suo te cahycaba na a chiy, tahematapakieca tieky suopaliy yalya cata a chi aa dung pata ming ta a bi diy.
Sahringpa tie ama cakuo tiyta, le tiekyphyi tie ca amaa thaalie khata ama cakuo ra; sahringpa tie kha alyi taata ama thu tiyta le tiekyphyi tie zaw ca ama thu ra.
Thlaapa ama sina luo mekaa kha ama si ra, le tiekyphyi tie zaw ca iema hneta ama thu ra; tahematapakieca sahringpa tie thlaapa ca le tiekyphyi tie chunglie khana ama aw.

Iema kha ama si tiyta, a hrangpa tie kha ama si; iema kha amaa daa tiyta, a hrangpa tie kha amaa daa; alyi taata ama thu kie, le tiekyphyi tie zaw kha iema hneta ama thu ra; tahematapakieca sahringpa tie thlaapa ca le tiekyphyi tie chunglie khana ama aw.
Sahringpa tie luv cunglie kha a cungkhuv haapa aw te thlaluo lung haata ta te ama luv cunglie ca aa zu.
A cungkhuv rawlie ca ama mathlaa ca aa dangsa pata pake yi te, suokha hne suokha kha amaa taw, sahringpa sakha kaluo ta ama pangpa a buv riypa mathlaa suohning ama hnyi.
Ama si tiyta, ama mathlaa pu ca tiy lesapa pu, Lesyice khalung pu, rieka tie pu haata cawsaa hluvsa khipatlawpa pu haapa kha i thyi; amaa daa tiyta ama mathlaa kha ama pasaw.
Cakhutaata ama luv cunglie a awpa a cung pakhuv taa cata pu suokha a za paring.
Cakhutaata ama luv cunglie a awpa a cung pakhuv cunglie ca safaiar lungvaa a lupa byithude suokha aw te, capa byithude a lupa cunglie ca cawsaa a lupa aa tu.

Chingde a lupa a sesie taata a cungluo lie kha aa li nguoluopa lungvaa suethiy, myi ta a cadung diypa kha i hmung; chingde a lupa a sesie taata a rawluo lie kha myi a lupa hmung angte, a cahriy bangkhuo ca a khe hunglung diy.

Cahaacata a cahriy bangkhuo a khe hunglung diypa ca khy a saa ning amyi chunglie buvtuvruoriy khana a lu. Capa ca Abyiparungnaana hmingsuo a lupa cata a cuo. Capa ca i hmung tiyta, a bung angte, ueryi suokha ta bie a ri nguoluopa kha i thyi.
Ama ta kama kyihuo khata: Vya Cawsaapa, a daa tie, bie na icaa rue aa, ina ta.
Ama ta bie ina chang ning kha thlaapa kha i chungluo a ngie te, i phyi ta na padaa te bie a ripa kha i thyi.

Ama ta kama kyihuo khata, Cawsaapa, Israel ming'a luona ica pathlie aa, iema ca kama naa dupa, rie thu a hmuopa mingphang ta cuo yi te, iema hne ama mingchingmingvuo tie hneta ataning tepa hingta kama naa dupa tana ama cuo.
Hingpa ciypathla tie hing nangzaa a pachang lipa hne a palung lesapa tana ama cuo. Iema'a luo kha ca pathlie'a angte, “Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ta,” ta pata na va ri aa.
Ama thyi khing zaw ama thyi khing li zaw ta (tahematapakieca iema ca a du a hmuopa mingphang tana ama cuo) iema hrawlie na profet a aw tapa kha pa chang naase yi.

Cakhutaata, Vya Cawsaapa, iema kha ciy khah yi, ama bie zaw kha ciy khah, ahling ta ca cadung te tluociekuo hrawlie na aw zawta, ama bie kha ciy khah, ama ming ta aca mangpa zaw yi kha ciy khah, tahematapakieca iema ca rie thu a hmuopa mingphang tana ama cuo.
Ama thyi khing zaw ama thyi khing li zawta i bie kha iema'a lie na ri aa; tahematapakieca iema ca rie thu a hmuopa mingphang tana ama cuo.
Cuorasala, cawsaapa, ica changpa hing naathlie tie; iema haa hingta rie thu a hmuopa cuo ra khah; na pakaa kha uo la ica pipa hing ning tie, ina ta.
I mang ca, caataw suokha a cyipa kuv suokha kama'a luo a vya pazuopa kha i hmung.
Kama hmiekunglieta capa caataw ca a pathluo, a hmie hne a hnang hneta caa a cape te, aa capepa caa ca muochiesanapa hlaa hne caana hlaa hne bawchiena tie ta a cuo.
Ama ta kama kyihuo khata, Vya Cawsaapa, aca pipa yi kha ning tie, hingpa caataw hing ning la, cakuo la Israel ming'a lie kha bie va ri tie, ina ta.
Caacuonakawta i pakaa ca uo angte, caataw ca ning riypata ina pi.
Kama kyihuo cata, Cawsaapa, ica pipa caataw hing ning la na riy a pabi tie, ina ta. Cakhutaa cata i ning; i pakaa lie ca khyitiy haata a thlung.
Kama kyihuo cata: Cawsaapa, Israel ming'a luo kha cakuo la nama ica changpa bie bangkhuo kha va ri tie.
Tahematapakieca ama ryi ruvsa te na thyi lipa tie'a luo kha pathlie pata cuo vaciy, cuorasala Israel ming'a luona pathlie pata na cuo.
Ama ryi ruvsa te na thyi lipa cawsaa a hluvsa tie'a luo cuo vyi. Cahaapa tie'a luo ca ca pathlie ang sala aca naathlie'a yi.
Cuorasala Israel ming ta ca ca naathlie'a va yi, iema ca kama kha na naathlie khing va yi; tahematapakieca Israel ming bangkhuo ca a puo cuopa hne a palung lepa tana ama cuo.
Mang tie, na hmie kha iema hmie tluv ta ca pacuo'a angte, na puo kha iema puo tluv ta ica pacuo aa.
Na puo kha a cuo cepa alung, vuokhawlung laata a cuo vie ta ica tue aa; iema kha ciy khah yi, aca mang tiy yi ta zaw ciy khah yi, tahematapakieca iema ca rie thu a hmuopa tana ama cuo.
Kama kyihuo khata: Cawsaapa, ica chang riypa i bie bangkhuo hing na naa ta thyi la na pathiypalung chunglie chi tie;
cakhutaa cata sii ta sikhyipa tie'a luo, na cawsaa tie'a luo kha cakuo la ri tie. Ama thyi zaw ama thyi li zawta, iema kyihuo khata, “Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri,” ta tie.
Cakhutaa cata thlaapa ta na calang te, Abyiparungnaana ca a awna hmang taata a thu tiyta, i hnangluo ta aa thy ta a thypa pu suokha i thyi.
Capa ca sahringpa tie ama mathlaa ama cakhawpa pu hne, iema kielie a awpa le tiekyphyi pu aa thy ta a thypa pu khata a cuo.
Thlaapa ta na calang te luohlaa luo ina phyale; palung pasana hne hihaana hneta i si, Abyipakuv ca i cunglie a cahra.
Khebar cavaa kie, Tel-abib lie sii ta sikhyipa tie'a luo kha i pha. Cakhutaata capa lie iema hrawlie ca a tu angte, ning sariy chung ca a ca-ang ta i ca-ang thluo.
Ning sariy a chuona lieta, Abyipabie ca kama'a luo a vaw te:
Cawsaapa, nama ca Israel ming rievetuv tana ica chi tli; i pakaa taata bie na thyi kyry ta, iema kha a raaringna na pi'a yi.

A pha lipa cawsaa kha, “Na thiy hrahring aa,” i ta tiyta, a raaringna pi lipa yi cata, ama hringna kha na khuo khing nakaw yi ta, cawsaa pha lipa kha a hringzya a thuse riypata a raaringna na pi li kieca, capa a pha lipa cawsaa tie ca ama pha lina kawlie khata ama thiy aa; cuorasala ama thiyse muo ca nama na ica hie aa.

Cuorasala a pha lipa cawsaa tie kha a raaringna pi yi cate, ama pha lina taata amaa thle li kieca, a pha lipa hringzya taata amaa thle li kieca, iema pha lina kawlieta ama thiy aa; cuorasala nama ca na hringna aa bang aa.

Cawsaa aa dangpa ta amaa dangna kha sise yi te pha lina ama tue kieca, cakhutaata kama ta iema hmiekunglie kha aliena i chikhuo kie yi ca, iema ca ama thiy aa; a raaringna na pi li nakaw yi ta ama suena kawlieta ama thiy aa, ama za tuepa adangna kha a thyipa pata cuo'a va yi; cuorasala ama thiyse muo ca nama na ica hie aa.
Cadyiseca, aa dangpa cawsaa kha ama sue li riypata a raaringna pi yi cate, suena ama tue li kieca, a raaringna na pipa yi kha amaa la nakawta ama hring hrahring aa; nama zaw na hringna aa bang aa.
Cakhutaata capa lie ca Abyipakuv kha i cunglie aw te, kama kyihuo khata, Thu tie, bawphie luo kha si la capa lie ca bie ica chang aa, ina ta.
Caacuonakawta thu angte bawphie luo ca i si; Khebar cavaa kielieta i hmungpa rungnaana haapa, Abyiparungnaana ca capa lie ca zaa daa te, alyi lie kha i bu.
Thlaapa ca i chung luo kha a ngie te ina padaa; bie na rihne te, Cakuo la na ing lie kha ingchiy vaa khaakhung tie, ina ta.
Cawsaapa, nama ca, khuhriy ta ciypa cuo'a cate, cawsaa hraw luo kha pya khu'a vaciy;
cakhutaata bie ri li pata aw'a cate sue na phaw khu li riypa yi ta, kama ta na palyi kha na duo luo ica pabepuo aa, tahematapakieca iema ca rie thu a hmuopa tana ama cuo.

Cuorasala nama kha bie ica chang thueta na pakaa kha ca pahaw'a angte, iema kha, “Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri,” ta pata na chang'a yi; a thyi riypa tie ta thyi yi se; a thyi khing lipa tie ta thyi khah yi se; tahematapakieca iema ca rie thu a hmuopa tana ama cuo.
Cakhutaata, Vya Cawsaapa, lungrue kha la lah na hmiekunglie kha chi tie. A cunglie kha Jerusalem khy zuv kha sa la,
riekhuocaaca kha cu cadung la, caaca kha ne la, pasuo khuo tie; rievena ing kha sa la, riekhuopiehu pacingnapa thingtung zaw kha a cahriylie kha chi tie.

Cakhutaata thaaphie kha la lah thaa tlepie haa khata nama hne khypuv alalalie kha chi la; khypuv luo kha a hyi tie; khypuv ca cadung pata cuo te, nama ca a cadungtuv ta na cuo. Capa ca Israel ming cuota pamangsana ta a cuo aa.
Cakhutaata na cavyiluo taa khata a zie la, Israel ming duotena kha na cunglie na chi aa; capa lie naa ziena cuo a ning zaa khata Israel ming duotena kha na ang aa.
Tahematapakieca iema duotena kung zaa hne aa khing pata a ning kha ica thlipa, ning zathung ning sawcaky; cahaacata Israel ming duotena ca na ang aa.
Capa ca na patlung khutaata, a yihningnapa a zie pakhaa'a cate, cuorasala na cacuoluo kuo taata cuo'a te, Judah ming duotena kha ning sawliy na ang aa; ning kha ca kung kha cuota a cuo aa.
Cadungpa Jerusalem luo ca a hyi'a cate, na buo thaa paruv la profetbiephu ca na ri aa.
Mang tie, khy na cadungna ning na patlung hluo li, kuokha taata kuokha luo naa pali the li riypata khuhriy ta ica ciy tli.

Cakhutaata Jungsacuo hne barli, bahlawthupa hne pepangkalang, satung hne samathyi tapa tie kha bi chunglie pya patlaw la na cuota viechuo ta tue tie. A saapa ta naa zie chung, ning zathung ning sawcaky chung kha capa ca na ning aa.
Na sa ningpa ca ning kha ta shekel suokiy ta cuo'a te a cuo thlipa lieta na ning aa.
Tiy zaw kha panang pata na dang aa, hin che caruv che kha kha a cuo thlipa lieta na dang aa.
Capa na sa ca barli vierue haata na ning aa; ama hmungna lie kha cawsaa ii ta na rue aa.
Abyipata, “Hing haa hingta i papyanapa yi mingphang zaw hrawlie kha na Israel ming ta a pathe lipa ama viechuo kha ama ning aa,” a ta.

Cakhutaata kama ta, “Vya Abyipa Khazing! Kama hne kama kha a papya a palyi buo va ang; mingnu i cuona taata ata tepa hingta, a thiypa hne saa ta a siepa kha ning buo va ang, a thuvpa saa kha i pakaa luo khung buo va ang,” i ta.
Cakhutaata ama ta, “Mang tie, cawsaa ii cuopa ta cue ii kha ica pi, capa ca ta na viechuo kha na rue aa,” ina ta.
Cakhutaata ama ta, Cawsaapa, Jerusalem ama pi tawpa sa ca i pachung aa; sa kha panang'a yi te ciyna cangta ama ning aa; tiy zaw kha panang'a yi te ciyna cangta ama dang aa.
Sa hne tiy ta aa de li nakaw yi ta, pakha hne pakha kha nang-uosa pata a mang'a yi te, ama duotena rawlie kha vievuv'a yi te ama ra diy aa.
Cakhutaata, Vya Cawsaapa, a cahresapa zueziy suokha kha la tie; capa ca suo a ngupa sephie haa khata hmuo la na suo hne na hmyahming kha a ngu tie; aa khingpa khata pathlie la na suo ca che tie.

Che thung che kha ca khy na cadungnapa ning a tling tiyta, khypuv chunglie kha myi ta na rue aa, che thung che kha ca khypuv chunglie kha zueziy ta na tepachungle aa; cakhutaata che thung che kha kha thliy na paphya aa, cakhutaata kama ta iema kha zueziy a da pacie pata i cade'a yi.
Cakhutaata capa chung taa cata a cawta kha la lah na buohryi pasiypa pe lie kha catawpuo tie.
Capa chung taa cata a cawta la pakhaa la myi chung luo kha thaw la rue tie; capa taa cata myi ca Israel ming bangkhuo'a luo kha aa ze aa.
AbyipaKhazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa hing Jerusalem tana a cuo; mingphang zaw liekhingkhuo lieta chi angte, ruo bangkhuo ta ama cadung.
Cuorasala ama ta i ziyphung hne i phungluo kha a du te a cahriylie a awpa mingphang hne ruo tie laata a chie viepa ta aa li, i ziyphung kha thaw te i phungluo kha ziy vyi.

Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Nama ca na cahriylie a awpa mingphang tie laata khuo vie ta naa du cate, i phungluo hne i ziyphung zaw kha ziy li pata, cuorasala na cahriylie a awpa mingphang tie ziyphung haata na hring.
Caacuonakawta AbyipaKhazing ta hing haa hingta a ri: Kama, Kama hrahring ta nama kha icaa du aa; Mingphang zaw hmungna lie kha bieripana ica hnyi aa.
Cakhutaata duv naa chiyna bangkhuo kawlie khata i tue buo li liepa hne khatiy tahmuo i tue buo li tli riypa kha na cunglieta i tue aa.

Nung hne paa tie ta iema ama saata zaw kha nama hrawlie ning hmisi'a yi te, saata zaw ta nung hne paa tie kha ama ning aa; nama cunglie kha bieripana ca hnyi'a yi angte, aa ngaapa mekaa kha ica chepatlaa diy'a yi.

Caacuonakawta AbyipaKhazing ta, Kama i hringpa haata, duvsamakhie naa chiyna hne palung pasa aa chiysapa hmang ta i hmangpathepa kha na papya na palyi nakawta, nama kha ica thaw aa; i ming ta ngie caa buo'a vyi, ngiechina ca hnyi'a va ang.

Niema che thung che kha ca puvtlung pasana ta ca thie'a yi te, che thung che kha ca nama cahriylie zueziy ta nama thiy aa, che thung che kha ca ruo ting ta ca chepatlaa'a yi angte, a baw taata zueziy a da cie pata a cade pata ama cuo aa.

I hihaana ca amata tah pe'a te, i pathiylingna ca iema cunglie kha cahaw'a angte i palung i pape aa; cakhutaa cata i pathiylingna kha iema cunglie i hmuo tiyta, iema ta Kama, Abyipana hrakuona ta bie a ri ang tapa kha ama pachang aa.
Ca hlyitaw taata niema kha a duothlingpa ta hne, nama cahriylie mingphang tie tue hyalya riypata ica tue'a yi.

Kama, Abyipana a ri ang, niema kha hihaana hne pathiylingna cangta bieripana ica tue thue yi hne a ruvsa pata duo ica te thue yi ca, nama cahriylie a awpa mingphang tie cuota tue hyalya riypa hne ke hyalya riypa, a raaringna riypa hne ciy aa chiysapa ta nama cuo aa.

Kama ta thiyna cuoti ta a cuopa cakuona hne parana kha ica vya pathliesue tiy yi ta, hne nama cunglie kha cakuona patlung sa hryly'a angte ningting ning riypa sa kha ica pacawpa vie tiy yi ta, cahaacata nama cuo aa.

Cakuona hne saa aa hruopa kha niema a du riypata vya pathlie'a angte, iema ta nama saata kha aca chuv'a yi. Cakuona hne thiyse langna ta ca vya tlungsue'a yi te, kama ta zueziy ica patlungsue'a yi. Kama, Abyipana a ri ang.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:
Vya Cawsaapa, Israel tluo zaw kha mang la profetbiephu kha rihnuo tie yi.

Cakhutaata, Vya Israel tluo zaw, Abyipa Khazingbie hing thyi tie ung! Abyipa Khazingna tluo tie hne tluothlue tie, cavaata hne bawphie zaw kha hing haa hingta caa ta yi: Kama hrahring ta niema cunglie kha zueziy ca patlungsue'a yi angte, nama khahrungtluobu tie kha i para diy aa.
Nama bienatluophie ca duothling'a te, nama rangpa-ue pakhuvnapa tung ca a tli aa; cakhutaa cata nama cawsaa i thiepa tie kha nama kuvtuezuv tie hmielieta i thaw'a yi.
Israel cawsaa tie ama riyy kha iema kuvtuezuv hmiekunglieta i pahlaa'a yi; cakhutaata ama ruv kha bienatluophie cahriylie kha i ze patlaa aa.
Nama awnapa mekaa lie kha nama khy ca duothling'a te nama khahrungtluobu ca a ra aa.
Thiepa tie ca nama hrawlie kha amaa lie patlaw aa; cakhutaa cata kama ca Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy.
Cuorasala chekha kha i pangaa'a yi. Niema chekha ca mingphang tie zaw zueziy hraw taa khata law'a ung cate ruo ting luo kha namaa ruo patlaa diy aa.

Cakhutaata sii ta ama cuonapa mingphang tie hrawlie kha, hya a zangpa tie khata inaa thyi'a yi; kama naa maasepa, a siyhrawpa ama pathiypalung, hne kuvtuezuv hie a tliepa ama ming khata kama kha kha tluv tama i ngie ina pachi tapa kha amaa thyi aa. Pha lina ama tuepa hne, duvsamakhiepa ama tuepa bangkhuo kawlie khata iema hne iema kha amaa duvsa aa.
Cakhutaata iema ta Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi; iema cunglie rana i patlung sa aa i ta tiyta i pachiypahuo cakhawpa yi ta cuo vyi tapa kha ama pachang aa.

Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Nama kuv cabe ung la nama phyi pachi tie ung, cakhutaata, Israel ingchungkhue duvsamakhie aa chiynapa ca thluechiy lipa tana a cuo! ta tie ung. Tahematapakieca iema ca zueziy, cakuona, hne puvtlung pasana tana amaa thiy aa.

Luohlaa luo'apa tie kha puvtlung pasana ta ama thiy aa; luongie lie'apa tie ca zueziy ta thiy'a yi te, capa taa cata law yi te aa ngaapa tie ca cakuona ta ama thiy aa. Cahaacata i hihaana kha iema cunglie ca i hmuo aa.

Cakhutaa cata carie ta ama thiepa tie ca ama bienatluophie athaalie ama kuvtuezuv zaw hrawlie cuose, tluothlue aa suopa cunglie, tluodaw bangkhuo cunglie, thingkung hringpa raw bangkhuo lie, a hnaa rungsapa mathliy kung raw bangkhuo lie, hne rangpa-ue ama pihluonapa hmang bangkhuo lie zaw kha ama laa patlaw tiyta, niema ta Abyipai cuopa kha nama pachang aa.

Kama ta iema cungluo kha i kuv pazuo'a angte, ama awnapa ruo bangkhuo, ruocaapa taata Riblah te khata a duothlingpa hne khy sa linapa ruo ta i tue aa. Cakhutaata iema ta Abyipai cuopa kha ama pachang aa.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo a zuv te:
Vya Cawsaapa, Abyipa Khazingna Israel ruo kawlie kha hing haa hingta bie a ri: A chuonapa! A chuonapa na ruo kiy paliy luo a tlung tli.
A chuonapa ca ata hing nama cunglie a tlung tli, i hihaana na ica pathliesue'a yi; nama hringzya hne aa ziypa tana bieripana ica hnyi'a yi, duvsamakhie namaa chiyna cuo kha tana duo ica te'a yi.

Pakha hmuo ca pangaa'a va yi ang, ngiechina ca hnyi'a va yi ang. Duvsamakhie namaa chiynapa kha nama cunglie a aw ningta, nama hringzya haa khata duo ica te'a yi. Cakhutaata Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy.
Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Rana khutaata rana! Mang tie, a vya tlung hing.
A chuona ca aa vaw tli, a chuona ca aa vaw tli. A vaw te aca pathu tli yi hing; mang tie ung, aa vaw tli hing!
Nama ranapa ca aa vaw tli, Vya ruo chunglie khy a sapa tie zaw. A cuo ca aa vaw tli, a ning ca aa ngie tli, tluo cunglie alawna ueryi aw li pata, hnaahnawna ueryi ta a bi.

Atabala hingta i hihaana kha nama cunglie i za lyi aa; i hihaana kha nama cunglieta i hmuo aa. Nama hringzya hne aa ziypa ta bieripana ica hnyi'a yi, duvsamakhie namaa chiyna bangkhuo cuo khata duo ica te'a yi.

Pakha hmuo ca pangaa'a va yi ang, ngiechina ca hnyi'a va yi ang. Duvsamakhie namaa chiynapa kha nama cunglie a aw ningta, nama hringzya haa khata duo ica te'a yi. Cakhutaata caa tuvpa yi hing Kama, Abyipata i cuopa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy.
Mang tie ung, ningkhue hing! Mang tie ung, aa vaw tli hing! Nama sue duotena ca a pya pathla tli. Khuecahryi ca a kya paa tli, hruotlena ca a daw a pamang tli.
Esetuechiena taa tana pha lina a kya lethaw. Iema pakha hing hmuo a ngaa'a va yi, iema lunghruotlungna hne iema hnyirungna zaw a ngaa'a vyi; iema hrawlie ama muo hnyi cena bangkhuo zaw a ngaa'a vyi.
A cuo ca aa vaw tli, a ning ca aa ngie tli; a calyituv kha a palung tluo khah se, a zaatuv zaw a ngie chi khah se, tahematapakieca i hihaana ca iema cawsaazaapuv cunglie tana a cuo.

Iema ama hring chung bangkhuo ca a zaatuv ta a zaapa kha hmung pakhaa khu'a vyi. Tahematapakieca cawsaazaapuv hne aa patuvpa capa muocuo ca para pata cuo'a vyi. Ama pha lina kawlie khata, ama hringna kha a pabang khu'a va yi.
Saa kiy kha tung yi te, zezaw bangkhuo ca a ting pacie pata a aw tli; cuorasala rietuvna luo pakha hmuo si va yi, tahematapakieca i hihaana ca cawsaazaapuv cunglie kha na a tlung.
Lekaa lieta zueziy a aw, achung lieta puvtlung pasana hne cakuona a aw; ruocaapa lie a awpa tie ca zueziy ta ama thiy; khypuv chunglie a awpa tie ca cakuona hne puvtlung pasana ta a thie yi.
A hring tlakuopa kha amaa ruo kieca, bawphie lie thuvruv hmung pata a cuopa haa khata, iema ca tluo cunglieta hmung pata ama cuo aa; Ama bangkhuo ta iema pha lina kha amaa caa aa.
Kuv bangkhuo kha a thaa ne'a te, pakhuv bangkhuo ca aa cathang aa.
Buri pang kha a buv'a yi te, thlaazangna ta a buvkhung'a yi. Cawsaa bangkhuo ama hmie chi'a te, ama luv amaa pamyi diy aa.

Ama ngu kha luopuv lie thaw'a yi te, ama siy kha a pathe lipa ta ama rue aa. Abyipahihaanapa ning lie ca ama siy hne ama ngu ta iema kha khuo khu'a va yi. Capa ca ta ama nangdiy a pape khu li'apa yi ta ama riy a pabi khu'a va yi. Tahematapakieca ama pha lina khana amaa pachiyna ta a cuo.
Amaa palesakhyipa a puvthepa amaa panginapa suethiy, duvsamakhiepa kuvtuezuv, duv aa chiysapa kha ama sa; caacuonakawta capa ca iema cuota a pathe li pata i tue aa.
Mingphang hrang tie kuv luo kha hruosue ta pi'a yi angte, alyi cunglie a pha lipa tie kha chuvpa sue ta i pi'a yi; capa ca iema ta ama papyapalyi aa.
Iema ca i maase'a yi, caacuonakawta i suethiy chinapa hmang kha ama papyapalyi aa; capa chung luo ca esetuechietuv tie kha a ngie'a yi te, iema ca ta ama papyapalyi aa.
Thaabuoliriy kha tue tie! Tahematapakieca ruo ca thiyse palangna tana a bi; khypuv ca esetuechiena tana a bi.
Kama ta ama ing lie ama hnyipa kha la riypata a chie cepa mingphang tie kha i vya tlungkhyi'a yi. Kama ta a thaaruvpa tie hruotlena kha pachuo sa'a angte, ama hmang pathepa ca duv aa chiysa aa.
Ruvnaana lepuv aa vaw tiyta, diena kha ama huv aa, cuorasala hmung'a va yi.

Riethyivuosuona cunglie riethyivuosuona aa vaw aa, thuohlaa chiepa kha thuohlaa chiepa ta a vya paziy aa; iema ta profet'a taata muocuo hmung riypata amaa zue aa; tluobyi tie'a taata pacuvna aw li'a pata, uvthyi tie'a taata ruena pinapa aw'a vyi.

Siepahruo ca caa'a te aa ngiy aa, byi tie ca anguopuona hnyi lina ta pahlaw'a yi te, ruo ming kuv ca aa cathang aa. Iema hringzya hne aa ziypa ta bieripana i hnyi'a yi, iema ta bieripana ama tuepa haa khata bieripana i hnyi'a yi. Cakhutaata iema ta kama ca Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi.

Kung caruv kung, thla caruv thlaa, ning pangaana lieta, ing chunglie i tu nguoluo ning, Judah uvthyi tie zaw i hmiekunglie amaa tu nguoluo ning khata, capa lie ca Abyipa Khazingkuv kha i cunglie a za tlung.
I mang ca, capa lie ca cawsaa a lupa pakha kha i hmung; a sesie a lupa a rawluo ca myi ta cuo te, a sesie a lupa a cungluo ca aa li nguoluopa lungvaa suethiy a khepa haa khata a cuo.

Kuv a lupa ca vya pazuo te i suo taw khata ina patuv; cakhutaata thlaapa ta alyi hne avuo alala luo kha na caba te, muocuo ta Jerusalem luo kha ina sikhyi; chaluo kuo ta a hyipa chungching thlake a ngienapa, hietliena a pathu sapa hietliena kuvtuezuv a tuna lie kha ina chi.
Bawphie lie i za hmungpa muocuo lie haa khata Israel Khazing rungnaana ca capa lie ca a aw.

Cakhutaata Khazing ta kama kyihuo khata, “Vya cawsaapa, chaluo khiy mang tie,” ina ta. Caacuonakawta chaluo kha i mang ca, capa lie, bienatluophie a ngienapa thlake chaluo kuo lie ca hietliena kuvtuezuv ca a aw.

Ama ta kama kha, “Cawsaapa, khaapama ama tue tapa kha na hmung ma, i hmangpathepa taata kama kha luohlaa luo a cade riypata Israel ingchungkhue ta hingpa lie ama tuepa duvsamakhie aa chiy hringhruopa hing na hmung ma? A ruv vie ta duvsamakhie aa chiypa kha na hmung kalie aa,” ina ta.
Cakhutaata kama kha tlawhmie luo a ngienapa luo inaa chiyle; i mang ca, tlepie lieta a khue suokha a aw.
Cakhutaata kama kyihuo khata, “Cawsaapa, lungrue tlepie kha cupuo tie,” ina ta; i cu ca ingchiypakaa kha i hmung.
Kama kyihuo khata, “A ngie la, a pha li ciemuopa duvsamakhiepa suena ama tuepa kha mang tie,” ina ta.

Caacuonakawta a ngie angte i mang; capa lie ca; tlepie cunglie bangkhuo ca ta aa valepa saruopa tie zuv, duv aa chiypa saruopa tie zuv, hne Israel ming kuvtuezuv bangkhuo tie zuv tapa tie kha i hmung.
Capa tie hmiekunglie ca Israel uvthyi tie saw sariy tie ca ama hrawlieta Shafan sacapaa Jaazaniah hne khata amaa daa. Ama kuv lieta daa pakaa kha a cyi kaluo yi te, rangpa-ue khuv ca a khuvthaw.

Cakhutaata kama kyihuo khata, “Cawsaapa, Israel uvthyi tie ta zingna chunglie, ama khuo cyicuo kuvtuezuv tie hneta ama tuepa kha na hmung ma? Tahematapakieca iema ta, ‘Abyipata kiema kha malie hmung vyi, Abyipata ruo ca a maw tli,’” ama ta.
Hingpa zaw hing ina chang kalie, “Iema ta ama tuepa a le viepa duvsamakhiepa kha na hmung kalie aa,” ina ta.
Cakhutaa cata Abyipaing chaluo ingchiypakaa luo kha inaa chiy; canung tie ca capa lie ca zaa tu yi te, Tammuz kha ama caa nguoluo.
Cakhutaa cata kama kyihuo khata, “Vya cawsaapa, hingpa hing na hmung ma? Hingpa laa hingta a le viepa duvsamakhiepa tie kha na hmung kalie aa,” ina ta.

Cakhutaata Abyipaing chung chungching khuo tlawhmie luo kha inaa chiy; capa lie, Abyipabiena-ing luo angienapa lie, hmyachung hne bienatluophie alalalie kha capaa pakiy papangaa hraw ca Abyipabiena-ing kha hnang chaw pata ningchiyluo kha a hyi yi te, a bu yi te ning kha amaa bie nguoluo.

Cakhutaata kama kyihuo khata, “Vya cawsaapa, hmung ca ma? Judah ingchungkhue ta hingpa lie ama tuepa duvsamakhiepa hing a nata tah a cuo ma? Iema ta esetuechiena ta ruo hing pabi pata, i hi ina pahaa hryly'a yi ma? Mang tie, thing nge zaw kha ama hnacabuv athaalie ama chi hue!

Caacuonakawta i hi haasa pata hmang i tue aa; ahunghmuo ngie a buo li pata hne ahung cunglie hmuo ngiechina hnyi li'apa angta, i thyina lieta khuosa ta ama caa zawta, iema kha naathlie'a va yi ang,” a ta.
Cakhutaata kama thyi pata khuosa ta khi te, “Khypuv kha para riypata re changpa zaw, nama cehre cyicuo hne khata naa vya ngie tie ung,” a ta.

Cakhutaa cata cawsaa pacaruv ca rieduna cehre a cyi kaluo pata cungluo thlake kuo luo taa khata amaa vaw; iema hraw taata pakha ca cawthang phapa kha a hryi te a sesie lieta caa capena riypa chechiy kha a hnyi. Iema ca a chung luo kha a ngie yi te daa bienatluophie athaalie kha amaa daa.
Israel Khazing rungnaana ca Cherub cung taa khata pya te ingchiypakaa tluo luo kha a kie. Abyipata cawthang phapa a hryi te a sesie lie caa capenapa chechiy a hnyipa cawsaapa kha ku te,
ama kyihuo khata, “Khypuv chung luo, Jerusalem khypuv chung luo kha vaa khie la, khypuv chunglie ama tuepa duvsamakhiepa kawlieta caa te a hna nguoluopa tie puo lie kha aa hnangna va tue tie,” a ta.
A hrangpa tie kha i thyina lieta, “Khypuv kha va cahraw ung la, ahung cunglie hmuo ngiechina hnyi li pata hne pakha hmuo pangaa li pata va thie tie ung.

Macuo, satlie, lesaa, haatiy hne canung bangkhuo kha thie ung la, cuorasala aa hnangna tuepa tie kha taw'a va ung ciy. I hmangpathepa taa khata va pathu tie ung,” a ta. Caacuonakawta iema ta ing hmiekunglie a awpa uvthyi tie taa khata ama pathu.
Cakhutaata iema kyihuo khata, “Ing kha papyapalyi tie ung, tlawhmie kha riyy ta pabi diy tie ung. Cakuo tie ung!” a ta yi.
Iema ta ama thie nguoluo ning kha kama se ta ina thuse yi, a bu angte, “Ah Abyipa Khazing! Jerusalem luo na hihaana na byapa haa khata ma Israel ming aa ngaapa bangkhuo kha na para diy'a yi” i ta.

Ama ta kama kyihuo khata, “Israel ingchungkhue hne Judah ingchungkhue suena ca a le hringhruo; ruo ca thiyse palangna ta bi te, khypuv ca zang tluo a tla lina ta a bi; tahematapakieca iema ta, ‘Abyipana ruo hing a thaw tli, Abyipata hmung vyi,’ ama ta.
Kama ta ca, pakha hmuo pangaa'a va yi ang, ama cunglie ngiechina hnyi'a va ang, cuorasala ama tuena khana ama luv cunglie i patlungsue'a yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata cawthang phapa a buv te a sesie lie caa capenapa chechiy a hnyipa khata a vya phya pakhaapa bie kha ri te, “Bie ina pipa haa ca khata i tue tli,” a ta.
Cakhutaata i mang ca, cherubim tie luv zaw cungluo taata zaa pakhuvpa cungkhuv lie kha safaiar lungvaa byithude a lupa kha i hmung.

Ama ta cawthang phapa a hryipa cawsaa kyihuo khata, “Cherubim rawlie tiekyphyi alala luo kha a ngie tie; cherubim hrawlie a awpa myihyi sekhalapa kha na pachung zung kha ta phuo la khypuv chung luo kha thaw tie,” a ta. I ming hmungpa khata a cakuo.
Cawsaapa a chung luo aa ngie ning kha cherubim ca ing taata sungluo kuo khata a daa te chungching tlawhmie lie ca amyi ta a bi.
Cakhutaata Abyiparungnaana ca cherub taa cata kya thu te ingchiypakaa tluo luo kha a kya kie; ing ca amyi ta bi te, tlawhmie ca Abyiparungnaana khena ta a bi.
Cherubim mathlaa pu ca a le tlawhmie taata thyi khu pata cuo te, bie a ri tiyta Lesyice Khazing ueryi haa khata a cuo.
Cawthang phapa a hryipa kha, “Cherubim hrawlie tiekyphyi taata myi kha la tie,” ta pata bie a pi tiyta, a ngie te tiekyphyi athaalie kha aa tu.

Cakhutaata cherubim zaw hrawtaata cherub sakha ta cherubim zaw hrawlie myi luo kha a kuv pazuo te, myi chekha kha la te cawthang phapa a hryipa cawsaa kuv chung luo kha a pi, ama ta capa ca la te a pya.
Cherubim mathlaa zaw rawlie ca cawsaa kuv hneta aa lupa kha aa luo.
I mang ca, cherubim tie athaalie kha tiekyphyi suopaliy i hmung, cherub sakha cyicuo athaalie kha suokha ta cuo te, tiekyphyi tie ca beril lungvaa aa lipa hne tana amaa lu.
Ama suopaliy cata amaa lu. Tiekyphyi suokha chunglie kha tiekyphyi suokha a awpa haata a ta.
Ama si tiyta, iema hne ama hmie cyicuo khata si yi te luo pie va yi; cuorasala khaapa luo ama si zawta, a hmie tiekyphyi aa hyina luo kha a hrangpa tie ta luo pie li pata ama ziy.
Ama pangpa bangkhuo, ama tieky zaw, amaa sung zaw, ama mathlaa zaw, hne a tiekyphyi a suopaliy bangkhuo ca ming ta a bi.
Le tiekyphyi zaw ca i thyinapa lieta “Aa pahiepa tiekyphyi,” ta pata ama ku.
Suokha cyicuo ta hmie suopaliy ama hnyi: suokhana ca cherub hmie, suohningna ca cawsaa hmie, suothungna ca chingde hmie, hne suopaliyna ca hmungthlu hmie ama hnyi.
Cherubim ca ama kya thu. Capa tie ca Khebar cavaa kielieta i za hmungpa sahringpa tie khata ama cuo.

Cherubim ca aa hnyi tiyta, a tiekyphyi zaw ca amaa thaalie ca ta amaa hnyi; cherubim tie ca alyi taata kiethaw riypata ama mathlaa kha ama pake tiyta, ama kuo luo ta tiekyphyi zaw ca a pali ta a pahlang va yi.
Iema ca amaa daa tiyta, a hrangpa tie zaw kha amaa daa ra, iema kha ama thu tiyta, a hrangpa tie kha iema hne cata ama thu ra; tahematapakieca sahringpa thlaapa ca iema chunglie a aw nakawta a cuo.
Cakhutaata Abyiparungnaana ca ingchiypakaa tluo taa cata pya te cherubim a cungluo lie kha aa daa.

Cherubim ca i hmungna lieta a mathlaa kha pake te alyi taa cata a thu; ama kuo lieta tiekyphyi zaw iema hne cata ama si ra. Iema ca Abyipaing ningchiy thlake luo a ngienapa lie kha amaa daa; Israel Khazing rungnaana ca iema cunglie ca a aw.
Capa tie ca Israel Khazing rawlie, Khebar cavaa kielieta i za hmungpa sahringpa tie khata ama cuo; cherubim ta ama cuopa kha i pachang.
Ama cyicuo ta hmie suopaliy, mathlaa suopaliy, ama mathlaa rawlieta cawsaa kuv a lupa ama hnyi.
Ama hmie ca Khebar cavaa kielieta i za hmungpa hmie haa kha tana ama cuo. Ama cyicuo ca ta hmie luo kha aa dangsa pata ama si.

Thlaapa ta na caba te ningchiyluo a hyipa Abyipaing ningchiy thlake luo kha inaa chiy. Capa lie, thlake luo a ngienapa lie ca capaa pakiy papangaa ama aw; iema hrawlie ca byi ta a cuopa Azzur sacapaa Jaazaniah, hne Benaiah sacapaa Pelatiah kha i hmung yi.
Ama ta kama kyihuo khata, “Cawsaapa, hingpa cawsaa tie hing hingpa khypuv chunglieta pha lina a papuvpa hne ruena pha lipa a pituv tana ama cuo.
Iema ta, ‘Ing sa riypa cuo ca a ngie valie; hingpa khypuv hing bi ta cuo te, kiema ca saa tana ma cuo,’ ama ta.
Caacuonakawta iema a dupa ta profetbiephu kha ri tie; biephu kha ri tie, Vya Cawsaapa,” ina ta.

Cakhutaata Abyipathlaapa ca i cunglie kha tlung te, kama kyihuo khata, “Ri tie, Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa hingna nama rue pata a cuo, Vya Israel ingchungkhue tie; Nama palung lie a puvpa kha i pachang.
Niema ta hingpa khypuv chunglie hing cawsaa a hluvsa nama thie, luopuv zaw ca riyy ta nama pabi.
Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: A chunglie nama chipa riyy zaw ca saa ta cuo te, hingpa khypuv hing ca bi tana a cuo; cuorasala niema ca hingpa taa hingta ica papya'a yi.
Niema ta zueziy kha nama ciy; cuorasala kama ta zueziy kha nama cunglie i patlung sa aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Hingpa taa hingta ca papya'a yi angte, ruohrang ming kuv luo kha ca pi'a yi angte bieripana ica hnyi'a yi.
Niema ca zueziy ta thiy'a ung cate, Israel ruoriy lie kha bie ica ripa'a yi. Cakhutaa cata Abyipata i cuopa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy.
Hingpa khypuv hing niema bi ta cuo'a vyi; niema zaw a chunglieta saa ta cuo'a va ung ciy; kama na Israel ruoriy lieta bie caa ripa'a yi ang.

Cakhutaata niema ta a ziyphung nama ziy lipa, hne a phungluo nama ziy lipa Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy. Cuorasala nama cahriylie a awpa mingphang hrangpa tie phung tlaku kha nama ziy,” a ta.

Profetbiephu i ri nguoluo pata Benaiah sacapaa Pelatiah ca a thiy. Cakhutaata a bu angte khuopuv ta caa angte, “Vya Abyipa Khazing! Israel ming aa ngaapa bangkhuo hing na para diy hmisi'a yi ma?” i ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipa'a taata kama'a luo kha bie aa zuv:

Cawsaapa, na tieriy, nama tieriy, nama hne siicuona luo sikhyi pakhawpa tie, Israel ming bangkhuo, Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie bangkhuo ta, “Iema ca Abyipa'a taata luohlaasa luo khana ama si tli; hingpa ruo hing ca kiema'a luo na ru ta pipa a cuo tli,” ama ta.

Caacuonakawta ri tie: Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Iema ca mingphang zaw hraw taata luohlaa luo kha thaw pata ama cuo raalaa pata, cakhutaata ruo ting luo kha i cadaapatlaa raalaa pa yi ta, iema ama sinapa ruo lie kha iema cuota cuo khata ca ama hmangpathepa ta i za cuo.

Caacuonakawta ri tie: Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Cawsaa zaw hraw taa khata ca pakiy'a yi angte, ica chepatlaanapa yi ruo taa khata ica pahmya pakhaa'a yi, cakhutaata Israel ruo kha ica pi'a yi.
Capa luo ca ama vya si tiyta, capa chung taa cata duv aa chiypa hne duvsamakhiepa bangkhuo kha ama thaw diy aa.
Kama ta iema kha pathiypalung thaapa suokha pi'a yi angte, ama chunglieta thlaapa thaapa i khung aa; iema pangpa chungtaata alung pathiypalung kha thaw'a angte, saasaapa pathiypalung kha i pi'a yi.
Caacuonakawta iema ta i ziyphung hne i phungluo kha ama ziy aa. Cakhutaata iema ca i cawsaa ta cuo'a yi te, kama ca ama Khazing ta i cuo aa.
Cuorasala duv aa chiysapa luo hne duvsamakhiepa luo kha a pathiypalung a sipa tie ca iema tuenapa kha iema luv cunglieta i patlungsue'a yi, Abyipata a ta.
Cakhutaata cherubim tie ca ama mathlaa kha ama pake, amaa thaalie ca tiekyphyi tie kha aw yi te, Israel Khazing rungnaana ca iema cunglie kha a aw.
Abyiparungnaana ca khypuv liekhingkhuo taa khata thu te, khypuv ningchiyluo tluo cunglie kha aa daa.
Thlaapa ta na caba te Khazing thlaapa muocuo chunglie ca Khaldi ruo luo, sii ta sikhyipa tie'a luo kha ina sikhyi.
Cakhutaata i hmungpa muocuo ca ta ina thuse. Abyipata ina pahmungsapa bangkhuo kha sii ta sikhyipa tie ca i chang yi.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:
Cawsaapa, nama ca rie thu a hmuopa tie hrawlie na na aw. Iema ca hmungna riypa ming ama hnyi, cuorasala hmung va yi, thyina riypa naa ama hnyi, cuorasala thyi va yi.

Tahematapakieca rie thu a hmuopa tie tana ama cuo. Caacuonakawta, cawsaapa, na hmang kha a pachie la iema hmungna lie kha siicuona luo ca si tie; na awna hmang taa khata hmang hrang luo kha sii ta sikhyipa haata ama hmungna lie kha si tie. Rie thu a hmuopa ama cuo raalaa pata ama pachang the ngiethie aa.
Iema hmungna lie, ningchung cata sii ta sikhyina luo phyale riypa hmang ca a cyi la, ama hmungna lie ca zuoluocaw ta sii ta sikhyipa tie haa khata na pya aa.
Iema hmungna lie kha tlepie kha ryipahaw la capa taa cata na hmang kha pyakhyi tie.

Iema hmungna lie ca na hmang kha na letung luo khang la a zingna luo kha phyale tie; alyi kha na hmung li riypata na hmie kha naa pahruv aa; tahematapakieca Israel ingchungkhue cuota pamangsana tana ica tue.

Bie ina pina haa cata i tue. Ningchung ta i hmang kha pyakhyi angte, zuoluocaw ta kama kuv hrahring ta tlepie kha i ryipahaw; iema hmungna lie ca i hmang kha i letung luo khang angte a zingna luo ca i pya.
Abyipabie ca mawdiy khata kama'a luo aa zuv:
Cawsaapa, Israel chungkhue, rie thu a hmuopa tie ta, “Khaapama na tue?” ca ta va yi ma?
Iema'a lie kha, “Abyipa Khazingna a ri: Hingpa biephu hing Jerusalem lie byi tie hne a chunglie Israel ming bangkhuo hne tana aa patuv,” ta tie.
“Kama ca niema cuota pamangsana tana i cuo: Kama i tuepa haa hingta, iema'a luo zaw kha tue pata a cuo aa; iema ca sii ta sikhyipa ama cuo aa, siicuona luona ama si aa.”

Iema hrawlie a awpa byi a cuopa ta a hmang kha a letung luo khang'a te a pya aa; ama ta tlepie kha ryipahaw'a te capa taa cata a pyakhyi aa; a ming ta alyi kha a hmung the li riypata a hmie kha aa pahruv aa.
A cunglieta i sue kha vaa'a angte, i cyihyi lie pa-uo'a angte, Babilon luo, Khaldi ming ruo luo kha i sikhyi aa; capa ruo ca hmung'a vyi, cuorasala capa lie ca a thiy aa.
A cahriylie a awpa bangkhuo, ama a byapa hne a rieka bangkhuo kha hmangting luo cadaapatlaa'a yi angte, a bya taata phie ciepa zueziy ta i paziy'a yi.
Mingphang zaw hraw luo hne ruo ting luo i cadaapatlaa tiy yi ta, Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi.

Cuorasala iema a cawta kha zueziy, cakuona hne puvtlung pasana taata hya pazang'a yi angte, ama sinapa mingphang tie hrawlie kha ama za tuepa duvsamakhiepa bangkhuo kha ama ri aa; cakhutaa cata kama ca Abyipai cuopa kha ama pachang aa.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:
Cawsaapa, sa kha naa cathangpuo pata ning la, tiy kha naa cathangsa pata hne na ciyna cangta dang tie.

Cakhutaata ruo chunglie cawsaa tie kha, Israel ruo chung Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie hneta aa patuv pata na Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Iema ta sa kha ciyna cangta ning'a yi te, tiy kha thlaazangna cangta ama dang aa, tahematapakieca a chunglie a awpa tie ta ama tuepa esetuechiena kawlieta ama ruo ca a hrihripa tana a aw aa.
Cawsaa khysa tawnapa khypuv tie ca hri'a te, ruo ca a duothling aa; cakhutaa cata niema ta Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:
Cawsaapa, Israel ruo lieta “Cuo ca a si lawmaw, muocuo mekaa zaw khaapa ta hmuo cuo vyi,” nama tapa phungbie hing tuokhaatama a cuo?

Caacuonakawta iema kha chang tie yi, “Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Kama ta hingpa phungbie hing i pachuo sa aa, iema ta hingpa phungbie hing Israel ruo chunglie hmuo'a va tli yi.” Cuorasala iema kha chang tie yi, Cuo ca aa ngie tli, muocuo mekaa a tlingna riypa cuo ca aa ngie tli.
Tahematapakieca Israel ming chunglieta a cuo lipa muocuo hne tuechawpa hmungdawluna kha aw'a va tli.

Cuorasala Abyipakama ta i ripa kha ri'a angte, capa ca patling sa pata a cuo aa. Capa ca palawle pata cuo'a vyi; cuorasala, Vya rie thu a hmuopa tie, niema chuo lie hing kama ta ri'a angte i patling sa aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:
Cawsaapa, Israel ming ta, “Ama ta a hmungpa muocuo ca hmieluo kung hluvpuv cuo tana a cuo; aa hlasapa cuo huo kha tana profetbiephu a ri,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta iema kha chang tie yi, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: I bie suokha hing hmuo palawle pata cuo'a vyi, cuorasala i ripa bie ca patling sa pata a cuo aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:
Cawsaapa, Israel profet tie kha profetbiephu rihnue tie yi; iema khing thiy ta profetbiephu a ripa tie kyihuo khata, “Abyipabie hing naathlie tie ung!”
Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri, Ruena hnyi li pata iema khingna dyi a ziypa profet tie, khaapahmuo a hmung lipa tie!
Vya Israel, na profet tie ca khy ruepa lie a bupa ruo-uv haa tana ama cuo.
Abyiparietuvna ning lieta a daa khu riypata, niema ca khypuv dungkhuo rapa luo kha khaw lipa ung cata, Israel ming cuota lungruetlepie kha pare va ung ciy.
Iema ta hanghie pata muocuo hmung yi te hang pata hmungdawluna kha ama tue; iema ta, Abyipata a pathlie lipa yi ta, “Abyipana a ri,” ta yi te, iema bie tluotling riypa kha ama huo!
Kama tahmuo i ri li pata, niema ta, “Abyipana a ri,” nama ta tiyta, hanghie pata muocuo kha hmung ung cate hang pata hmungdawluna nama tue cuo va ma?
Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingna a ri: Niema ca hanghiena bie ri ung cate hanghiepa muocuo kha nama hmung nakawta, kama ta icaa du yi, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.

Hanghiepa muocuo a hmungpa hne a hang pata hmungdawluna a tuepa profet tie ca kama kuv na a du'a yi; iema ca kama cawsaa zaw khuekhuona lie kha a tu ra li'apa yi ta, Israel ming ming cazing khungna lie zaw khung pata cuo'a va yi, acuolikie Israel ruo chung luo kha a ngie'a va yi; cakhutaata Kama ca Abyipa Khazingi cuopa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy.

Tahematapakieca diena a aw li tiyta, “Diena,” ta yi te, i cawsaa zaw kha luo ama papie sa nakawta hne cawsaa ta khy dungkhuo lungruetlepie ama sa ning kha hingpa profet tie hingta thung ruopa ama thuv nakawta a cuo.
Lungruetlepie lie thung ruopa a thuvpa tie kha hingpa hing ca a cing aa, ta pata chang tie yi. Tiy le'a te, ari kha a pangkatu pata tla'a te, thliychie ta de'a te a cing aa.
Lungruetlepie kha a cing tiyta, “A cunglie nama thuvpa thung ruopa ca khaapaliema a aw?” aca ta'a yi.
Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: I hihaana thliychie i pahruo sa aa, i hihaana khy pane sa'a angte, i hihaana ari kha i patla sa aa.

Thung ruopa nama thuvpa khy dungkhuo lungruetlepie kha pa cing'a angte, alyi lie laa diy'a te a hruopatu kha aa luo diy aa; a cing tiyta capa hne cata a ra pakhaw aa; cakhutaata kama ca Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy.
Cahaacata lungruetlepie cunglie hne capa cunglie thung ruopa a thuvpa tie cunglie ca i hihaana kha hmuo'a angte, niema kyihuo khata, lungruetlepie ca aw va tli, thung ruopa a thuvpa tie,
Jerusalem hne aa patuv pata profetbiephu a ripa Israel profet tie hne diena a aw li ningta capa cuo ca ta diena muocuo a hmungpa tie zaw kha aw va tli yi, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Cawsaapa, ata hing ca, na cawsaa zaw sacanung tie, ima khing thiy ta profetbiephu a ripa tie'a luo kha a hyi la, iema a du pata profetbiephu kha ri tie.

Cakhutaata, iema kyihuo khata, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Cawsaa hringna kha patuv riypata buo lie a cakhiypa kuv cakhiy a biepa tie hne, ama kung hne aa ziy pata cawsaa ting ta a khuv the kaluo riypa hmiepakhuv a biepa canung zaw ca bawchie ciemuopa tana ama cuo. Nama hringna lie thlahnena hmung riypata ma i cawsaa zaw cunglie kha naw hnyi namaa zue?

Barli kuvpazaa zungkha hne viechuo hlung kha vuota na i cawsaa zaw hrawlie kha ina papyapalyi ung ciy. Hangna bie a naathliepa tie i cawsaa tie kha dung ung cate, a thiy li riypa tie kha pathiy ung cate, a hring li riypa tie kha nama pahring.

Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Cawsaa hringna nama patuvnapa nama kuv lie namaa cakhiypa pacuona kha i du; nama buo taa khata thlaa patla'a angte, hringna zaw, pavaa haata nama byapa hringna zaw kha hya i pazang'a yi.
Nama hmiepakhuv kha thlaa'a angte, i cawsaa tie kha nama kuv taata i khuo'a yi; cakhutaata Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy.

Tahematapakieca kama ta iema kha ama palung i pachuo li raalaa pa yi ta, aa dangpa tie kha hangna ta ama palung nama pachuo; a pha lipa tie kha ama pha lina taata ama vya kaa riypa hne ama hringna khuo khu riypata thaazuo pi va ung ciy.

Caacuonakawta niema ca hanghie pata muocuo hmung li tli'apa ung cata, hang pata hmungdawluna tue'a va tli ung ciy; kama na i cawsaa tie kha niema kuv taata a khuo'a yi ang. Cakhutaata niema ta Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy.
Israel uvthyi chekha tie ca kama'a luo kha a vaw yi te i hmiekunglie kha amaa tu.
Cakhutaata Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:
Cawsaapa, hingpa cawsaa tie hing ama pathiypalung lieta ama kuvtuezuv kha a chi yi te, ama pha lina ca ama hmiekunglie kha a pachiyna riypata amaa pahlaa khuo. Iema hne khata bie i rue'a ma?

Caacuonakawta iema'a lie kha bie ri la iema kha chang tie yi, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Ama pathiypalung lieta ama kuvtuezuv kha a chi yi te, ama pha lina kha ama hmiekunglieta a pachiyna riypata a chi khuopa tie, kuvtuezuv a hluvsa hneta profet'a luo a vawpa tie,
ama kuvtuezuv kawlieta kama'a taata aa hlapa tie ahung a cuo zaw, Israel ingchungkhue tie pathiypalung i patuv khu riypata kama Abyipata i palie'a yi.

Caacuonakawta Israel ingchungkhue tie kha chang tie yi, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: A ngiepachiy ung la nama kuvtuezuv taa khata vya kaa tie ung; nama tuepa duvsamakhiepa bangkhuo taa khata a vya pali tie ung.

Tahematapakieca Israel ming ama cuo zaw, Israel ming hrawlieta a awpa ruohrang ming ama cuo zaw, kama'a taata a che yi te, ama kuvtuezuv kha ama pathiypalung lie a chi yi te, ama pha lina kha a pachiyna riypata ama hmiekunglie a chi khuo pata, kama khingna kha hiehriy riypata profet'a luo a vawpa ca kama Abyipahrahring na iema kha a palie'a yi ang.
Kama ta hmiephaa pi'a va yi ang; kama ta iema kha pamangsana hne rile riypata tue'a yi angte, i cawsaa tie'a taata i thaw'a yi; cakhutaata Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy.
Profet pakha ca dung pata cuo te profetbiephu kha a ri kieca, Kama, Abyipana capa profet ca a dung ang, ama a du pata i kuv kha pazuo'a angte, i cawsaa Israel ming hraw taa khata i para aa.
Cakhutaata iema ca ama duotena kha ama ang aa; bie a hiehriypasietuv duotena hne profet duotena ca aa lu aa.

Cata a cuo kie dyina Israel ming ca kama'a taata luo pie li tli'apa yi ta, iema hne iema kha ama tuesuena ta a papya a palyi li tli pata ama aw aa. Cakhutaata iema ca kama cawsaa ta cuo'a yi te, kama ca iema Khazingta i cuo aa, Abyipa ta a ta.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:

Cawsaapa, ruo ruo kha ta, zang tluo aa tla li pata aw te kama'a lie a sue tiyta, i kuv kha pazuo angte, byanapa sa kha chipachung angte a cunglie cakuona i patlung, a cawsaa hne sahring zaw kha i thie yi.
Noah, Daniel, hne Job, hingpa cawsaa tie pathung hing hmuo iema hrawlie aw yi sala, amaa dangnapa khata iema hringna dyina amaa khuo khu aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Saa aa hruopa tie kha para riypata ruo chung luo pathlie ang sala, iema ca ta a duothlingpa ta tue yi te, capa saa a hruopa zaw kawlie ca ta ahungtahmuo ama cahraw nguo li tiyta;

iema hrawlieta hingpa cawsaa pathung tie hinghmuo aw biephung yi sala, kama i hringpa haata, iema ta ama sacapaa tie hne ama sacanung tie hmuota khuo khu'a va yi; iema dyina amaa khuo khu aa, cuorasala ruo ca a duothling ngiethie aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Acuolikie, capa ruo cunglie ca zueziy patlung sa pata, “Zueziy ta hingpa ruo hing cahraw se,” ta pata cawsaa hne sahring zaw kha thie yi ang sala,
hingpa cawsaa pathung tie hing ruo chunglie ca ama aw zawta, kama i hringpa haata, iema ta sacapaa hne sacanung zaw kha khuo khu'a va yi, iema dyina amaa khuo khu aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Acuolikie, capa taa cata cawsaa hne sahring zaw kha thie riypata, puvtlung pasana kha capa ruo chung luo ca patlung sa pata, i hihaana kha thiyse ta bung ang sala;

capa ruo chunglie ca Noah, Daniel, hne Job kha ama aw zawta, kama i hringpa haata, iema ta sacapaa hne sacanung zaw kha khuo khu'a va yi, amaa dangnapa khata iema dyina amaa khuo khu aa: Abyipa Khazingta a ta.

Tahematapakieca Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Jerusalem taata cawsaa hne sahring zaw kha thie diy riypata thiyna rehriena suopaliy ta a cuopa zueziy, cakuona, saa aa hruopa tie, hne puvtlung pasana tapa tie kha pathliesue yi ang sala, kha tluv tama a ruv vie aa!

Cuorasala a hringpa kha a chunglieta thuse pata ama cuo aa, sacapaa hne sacanung zaw kha pyakhyi pata cuo'a yi te, nama'a luo ama vya pya aa. Ama hringzya hne ama tuepa kha na hmung tiy yi ta, Jerusalem lie i patlung sapa pha lina, a cunglieta i patlung sapa bangkhuo cuo khata na palung thaa a duo aa.

Iema hringzya hne ama tuepa kha na hmung tiyta, iema ta na palung thaa kha aca paduo'a yi, hingpa chunglie i tuepa bangkhuo hing a kawluo aw li pata i tuepa a cuo linazya kha na pachang aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:
Vya Cawsaapa, tuokhaatama mingsuv kung hne mingsuv ce hing ta tuvpuv lie a awpa thing hrangpa a law diy yi?
Mingsuv kung taata suokhakha tuena riypa thing kha la pata a cuo ma? Suokhakha pathliena riypata thingkhe riypa kha mingsuv kung ta tue pata a cuo buo ma?
Myi luo ruepa tana a cuo; myi ta a daw vyicuo kha kuo te, a liekhingkhuo ca a uv karue tiyta, khaapa cuota hmuo thlahne vyi.
A yalya ta a aw kie ma, khaapahmuo thlahne vyi; myi ta kuo te a uv karue khutaata changchiy ca khaapa cuota hmuo thlahne va tli!
Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Tuvpuv chunglie a awpa thing zaw hrawlieta myi ta i ruepa mingsuv kung haa khata, Jerusalem lie a awpa tie kha myi ta rue riypa tana i pi'a yi.
I hmie kha i nukhuo'a yi; myi taata amaa ruo raalaa pata, myi ta kuo ngiethie kalie'a yi te, i hmie kha i nukhuo tiy yi ta, Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy.
Zang tluo aa tla li pata ama aw nakawta ruo kha a duothlingpa tana i chi aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:
Cawsaapa, Jerusalem ca duvsamakhiepa a cuonapa kha pachang sa tie.
Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri, ta tie. Na thukinapa hne na puvnapa ruo ca Kanaan ming ruo chunglie tana a cuo; na paa ca Amor ming ta cuo te, na nung ca Hit ming tana a cuo.
Na puvna kawlieta, na za puvna ning lie kha na palie riy te pata cuo vaciy, na pathe riypata tiy ta ca pasiy va yi, paciy ta pazuv pata cuo vaciy, caw ta ca pahlaw va yi.
Kawpacuona hneta hingpa zaw tuepa riypa hingta ahungtahmuo siysaa ca ri va yi; cuorasala nama ca alyi lie kha thaw pata na cuo, tahematapakieca na za puv ning ca duv aa chiysapa tana na cuo.
Naa thaalie vya cakuole angte, na thiy chunglie na phyi na za capi nguoluo pata ica hmung. Na thiy chunglie na laapa cata, nama kyihuo khata, “Hring tie!
Lu lie thingkung haa khata le tie,” ica ta. Kya lethaw cate, a kya suo cate na lesaa; na meme a kya pabu, na suo a kya syi; cuorasala na thliehripa ta aw cate naa luo kalie.

Naa thaalie vya cakuole pakhaa angte ica mang; malie vuo a ie the riypata na cuo tli. I pang kha ca pabuv angte na thliehripa ta na cuopa kha ica pahruv: chie a sa pata nama hne biekuona tue angte kama huopa ta naa li, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Cakhutaata tiy ta ca pasiy angte, na thiy kha ca hruv angte sathu ica pathuv.
Kiykie zepa pang kha ca pabuv angte, savang phapa phyipakaw kha ica pakaw; cawthang phapa kha ca tue angte puv pang ica pabuv.
Suethiy ta ica pangi: Na kuv lie kuvkaw ica paku, na rue lie pachiy ica pa-ya,
na hnacabuv hne na naa lie ra-aw ca pabaa angte na luv lie a puvthesapa byilakhuv ica pakhuv.

Siy hne ngu ta pangi pata cuo cate, na caw ca cawthang phapa, puv, hne kiykie zepa caw ta a cuo. Na sa ca jungsacuo viedie phapa hne khyitiy hne chiytiy ta a cuo. Puvthe hringhruo cate siepahruonung ta na cuo.
Na puvthenapa kaw ca ruo ting ta a pathuo, tahematapakieca kama ta ica pipa linghlaa ca na cunglie a tling nakaw tana a cuo, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Cuorasala na puvthena kha naa ringchuo, na ming a pathuo nakawta siyhraw cate khy a tlawpa bangkhuo kha a cadangna hnyi li pata naa khing yi.
Na cawsie chekha kha a la cate na cuota hmingciy a phangphang a hnyipa abiena hmang kha a tue cate capa lie ca na siyhraw; cahaapa ca za aw buo li pata aw buo'a va tli.
Kama ta ica pipa a puvthesapa suethiy ta a cuopa siy hne ngu zaw kha la cate, capa ca ta na siyhraw.
Cakhutaata a kiykie zepa i pang zaw kha la cate, i chiytiy hne ziyhmyi kha iema hmiekunglie na chi.
Kama ta ica pipa viechuo, ica ringpa jungsacuo viedie phapa, chiytiy hne khyitiy zaw kha la cate, iema hmiekunglie kha rangpa-ue pihluona ta na pihluo; capa zaw ca, Abyipa Khazinga ripa tana a cuo.
Nama ta kama hneta ma sapa na sacapaa hne na sacanung zaw kha la yi cate, iema ning riypata hriykhungrina ta na pihluo yi.
I saata zaw kha thie yi cate, myi ta rue yi cate na pihluo yi.
Duvsamakhie naa chiyna hne na siyhrawna lie khata na thliehripa ta za aw cate naa luo diypa hne, na thiy lie na phyi na za capipa, na cawta ning ningcuo kha a thyi va tli ciy.
Na pha lina bangkhuo khutaa khata (bawchie ciemuopa, bawchie ciemuopa tana na cuo! Abyipa Khazingta a ta),
zaapuv ahmyana mekaa lie kha atuna duele cate aa suopa hmang na sale.
Luo a tawna mekaa lie kha aa suopa hmang ca a sale cate, na puvthena kha phusaale cate, naa thaalie a vya cakuolepa mekaa kha na pangpa ca a pi yi cate na siyhraw.
Thiysaa khingna dyi a ruepa na ingpaa Izipt ming hneta a hluv tuv siyhraw cate i hi ina pahaa ciy.
Caacuonakawta nama a du pata i kuv kha pazuo angte, na sa kha ica pachungpa, na carie pha lipa tie, na siyhrawna kawlieta ama nang na pazaapa Filistin sacanung tie'a luo kha ica pi aa.
Na siyhraw lunghruo a tlung the li nakawta Assiria ming hne khata na sue pakhaa kalie; iema hne cata siyhraw cate, na palung tling ngiethie valie.
Sungpalina ruo Khaldi ruo lie zaw kha na siyhraw; capa zaw ca ta na palung tling ngiethie vyi.
Hmiesusa pata siyhraw cate hingpa bangkhuo hing na tue, na pathiypalung riebya ca a ruv hringhruo, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Luo a tawna mekaa lie kha aa suopa hmang ca a sale cate, zaapuv ahmyana mekaa lie kha atuna duele cate aa suopa hmang na sale! A muo na la li nakawta siyhrawnung hneta a lu vaciy.
Nungvaathingsuena a tuepa napuv, a navaapa thing ta capaa hrang a khingpa!
Siyhrawnung bangkhuo ca lasaw pi pata ama cuo; cuorasala nama ca naa khingpa bangkhuo kha lasaw na pi yi, na siyhrawkhyi riypata hmangting taata amaa vaw riypata nawthuv na pi yi.

Caacuonakawta nama ca na siyhrawna lie kha canung hrangpa tie hneta a lu vaciy: nama hne siyhraw riypata ahungtahmuo ca ripasa va yi; a muo ca pi va yi, nama ta a muo na pi pali yi; nama ca naa nanang.
Caacuonakawta, Vya siyhrawnung, Abyipabie hing naathlie tie:
Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Na duepa zaw hne na siyhrawna lieta na thiysaa khingna ca lyi tli cate na thliehripa ta na awpa ca aa luo diy tli.

Caacuonakawta duvsamakhie aa chiypa na kuvtuezuv hne iema na pipa yi na saata zaw thiyse kawlie khata naa nuokhyipa na duepa zaw bangkhuo kha cuose, na duepa hne na huepa zaw bangkhuo kha cuose i pahmya diy'a yi; iema ca ruo ting taa khata pakiy diy'a yi angte, ama hmiekunglie kha na caw ca thliepa diy'a angte, na thliehripa ta na awpa kha aca hmung'a yi.
Nungvaathingsuena a tuepa hne thiyse a palang sapa canung haata bieripana ca hnyi'a angte, hihaana hne hietliena ta na cunglie thiyse phuvlana i patlung sa aa.

Iema kuv luo kha ca pi'a angte, iema ta atuna na duelepa kha para'a yi te aa suopa hmang na salepa kha ama phi diy aa. Na caw kha ca thliepa diy'a yi te, a puvthepa na chechiy zaw kha ama la diy aa; cakhutaata na thliehripa ta hne naa luo diy pata aca thuse siy'a yi.
Cawsaa hluvsa kha ca vya pahmyasue'a yi te, alung ta ca vaa'a yi te ama zueziy ta a diykariyna te ta acaa ce'a yi.
Na ing zaw kha myi ta rue'a yi te, canung hluvpuv hmiekunglie kha bieripana aca hnyi'a yi. Na siyhrawna kha ca pataw sa'a angte, a muo zaw pi'a va tli yi ciy.
Caacuonakawta i pathiy myi ie ta a iepa kha pachung'a angte, i hietliena kha na cung taata aa maa aa; a dieta tah aw'a angte, i hi haa'a va tli.

Mingnu na za cuo ning ningcuo kha a thyi lipa cata capa bangkhuo kawlie ca ta i hi ina pahaa ciy; caacuonakawta, na tuepa kha na luv cungluo ica pakaasue, Abyipa Khazingta a ta. Duvsamakhie naa chiyna bangkhuo khungthing lie kha thiysaa khingna na tue cuo va ma?
Mang tie, phungthluv a hmuopa bangkhuo ta nama kaw kha hingpa phungthluv hing hmuo'a yi te, “A nung a lupa sacanung,” aca ta'a yi.

Nama ca a navaapa hne a saata zaw a huepa na nung sacanung ta cuo cate, ama navaapa hne ama saata zaw a huepa na uvnunung tie uvnu tana na cuo. Na nung ca Hit ming ta cuo te na paa ca Amor ming tana a cuo.
Na uvtanung ca a sacanung tie hneta nama chaluo kuo ta a awpa Samaria ta cuo te, na nutanung ca nama sungluo kuo ta a sacanung tie hneta a awpa Sodom ta a cuo.
Iema duvsamakhie a chiyna haa khata aw cate iema hringzya na ziypa dyi cuo vyi; cuo khata chung ca iema laata na hringzya a chie vie.
Abyipa Khazingta, kama i hringpa haata, nama hne na sacanung tie nama tuepa haa khata Sodom hne a sacanung tie ta tue va yi.

Hingpa hingna na narungnung Sodom a suenapa ta a cuo: Ama hne a sacanung tie ca a hruo ama tle, a hlyi ta ama ning, hnaanguosa pata hne aa nuosa pata aw yi te, cuorasala siypasa tie hne a phahlapa tie kha a bya va yi.
Iema ca a pale yi te kama hmiekunglie kha duvsamakhiepa ama tue; caacuonakawta i hmung tiy yi ta i thaw yi.
Samaria ta nama suenapa khingkhuo hmuo tue vyi; iema laata duvsamakhiepa a hluv vie tue cate, nama na tuepa duvsamakhiepa thueta na uvnunung tie ca aa dangpa haata na tue yi.

Nama zaw, na nangzaana kha ang tie, tahematapakieca iema laata duvsamakhiepa a hluv vie tue cate na sue nakawta iema ca nama laata amaa dang vie. Caacuonakawta nama zaw na nang zaa se, tahematapakieca nama ta na uvnunung tie kha a dangpa na palu sa yi.
