Sodom hne a sacanung tie vuophana hne Samaria hne a sacanung tie vuophana kha pi pakhaa'a yi angte, iema hne cata niema zaw kha vuophana ica pi'a yi.
Nama ca na nangzaana kha ang'a cate, na tuepa bangkhuo kawlie kha na hmie a chi'a nakawta iema cuota ca hnaanguona ta a cuo aa.

Na uvnunung tie cuota ca, Sodom hne a sacanung tie hluo ning ama cuona luo kha ama kaa pakhaa aa, Samaria hne a sacanung tie ca hluo ning ama cuona luo kha ama kaa pakhaa aa, cakhutaata nama hne na sacanung tie zaw hluo ning nama cuona luo kha nama kaa pakhaa aa.
A hruo na za tlesa ning hne na pha lina kha phu pata a cuo hluota ca na uvnunung Sodom ca a kaw na za rile cuo va ma?
Ata hing ca Edom sacanung tie hne a ingpaa bangkhuo, hne Filistin hne a sacanung tie hne a cahriylie a awpa nama caa duvsapa bangkhuo cuo khata tue hyalya riypa tana na cuo.
Na siyhrawna hne duvsamakhie naa chiynapa duotena khana na ang aa, Abyipata a ta.
A cuo, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Chiesana a duvpa, biekuona a parapa nama na tuepa haa kha tana na cunglie i tue aa;
Mingnu na cuo ning nama hneta i tuepa biekuona kha a thyi'a angte, nama hneta chuozaa biekuona kha i pacu sa aa.

Cakhutaata nama hne biekuona ma tuepa kawlie a cuo li raalaa pata na uvnunung tie, a uvthyinung hne a syinung ama pahning khata la yi angte, nama kha na sacanung zaw cuo riypata ica pi tiyta na hringzya kha a thyi pakhaa'a cate na nang a zaa aa.
Nama hne biekuona i tuepa kha pacu sa'a angte, cakhutaa cata Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a ciy.
Na tuepa bangkhuo cuo khata icaa ngiethe tiyta, nama ta a thyi pakhaa'a cate a cang ta na ca-ang aa, na nang a zaa nakawta na pakaa uo pakhaa'a va tli ciy, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:
Vya cawsaapa, Israel ming kha bienupa hne phungpa chang tie yi.

Chang tie yi, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: A mathlaa lesapa, hmingciy a hluvsa ta a cape te a hming puvthesapa hmungthlu lesapa sakha ca Lebanon luo a vya chiy. Sidar kung a daw lie kha a cang te,
aa suocenapa lie a ziydaw kha thli te, Sungpalina ruo luo kha a zukhyi te, chadaw a dawpa tie khypuv lie kha a chi.
Cakhutaata ruo chung taa cata saciy kha la te, alyi phasana lie kha a chi. Tiy a rungsanapa athaalie kha a ling te, paasung kung taata haa khata a chi.

Mingsuv kung ca kya le te aa neta tah a kusa ta aa zuo. A thariy ca a puna lie kha aa thuvsa pata thla te, a ce ca hmungthlu awna luo kha a vaa zuo. Mingsuv kung lepa ta a li te, a ce rungsa te a hnaa ta a buv diy.

A mathlaa lesa te a hming rungsapa hmungthlu hrangpa sakha zaw a aw ra. Cakhutaata mang tie! Capa mingsuv kung ca ta ama ta tiy na pi naase ta pata capa hmungthlu kuo luo cata a thariy va pazuo te, a ce zaw ava pazuo.
A ce rungsa te, a thyi a hluvsa a pathyipa mingsuv kung phapa cuo naase ta pata amaa zaa ling taanapa taa khata alyi phanapa hmang, tiy a rungsanapa luo kha ama palaw.

Chang tie yi: Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa mingsuv kung hing rungsa'a te a pathyisa'a ma? A hnaa caa'a te a thyi a thuv riypa hne, a pakiy thaapa a hnaa ca a uv'a te a vie riypata a thariy taata phie pata cuo'a va ma? Capa ca a thariy taata phie riypata a thaaruvpa buo hne a cahrapa rieka zaw a hu'a vyi.
Palaw yi te amaa ling tiyta, rungsa'a te a pathyisa'a ma? Ningchiy thliy ta a de tiyta, a caa diy aa cuo va ma? A puna hmang lie khana a caa aa cuo va ma?
Cakhutaata Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:

Rie thu a hmuopa tie kyihuo khata: Hingpa hmang tie hingta khaapama a ri khing tapa kha pachang va ung ca ma? Chang tie yi: Babilon siepahruo kha Jerusalem luo a vaw te, a siepahruo hne a byi tie kha la yi te, Babilon luo a sikhyi yi.
Siepahruo samingsahlaa chung taa khata pakha kha la te, ama hne cata biekuona tue te, capa biekuona rawlie ca a pa-aw sa (ama ta ruo ming uvtuv tie kha la yi te a sikhyi yi).
Pena ca a pane te ama hne ama aa pasuo li riypa hne biekuona kha ziy te a aw riypata cahaacata a tue.
Cuorasala siepahruo ta ama kha a du te aruo hne rieka a hluvsa ama pi riypata Izipt luo kha luosituv a pathlie. Biekuona kha para pata aa ruo khu'a ma?
Abyipa Khazingna a ri, kama i hringpa haata, ama hneta bie amaa kuopa kha para te a chiesana a duvpa paa ca ama kha siepahruo ta a pacuosapa siepahruo a awna hmang lie, Babilon lie khana a thiy aa.
Cawsaa a hluvsa thie riypata riekhuocaaca kha sa khuo yi te, a dungkhuopa tie kuv taa khata Faro hne a cahrapa a riekaphuv lepa tie ta hmuo a bya yi sala khuo khu'a va yi.
Tahematapakieca chie a sa te biekuona a tuepa kha para te, a kuv ta hingpa hmang bangkhuo hing a tue nakawta, ama ca law'a vyi.
Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Kama i hringpa haata, kama chiesana duv te i biekuo kha a para nakawta a luv cung luo kha i pakaasue hrahring aa.
A luv cunglie i sue kha pake'a angte, i cyihyi lieta aa uo aa. Ruo hne aa patuv pata i cunglie a sue nakawta Babilon luo kha sikhyi'a angte capa lie ca a cunglie bieripana i hnyi aa.
A rieka pha cepa bangkhuo ca zueziy ta thiy'a yi te, aa ngaapa tie ca ruo ting luo amaa chepatlaa diy aa; cakhutaata Kama, Abyipana a ri ang tapa kha nama pachang aa.
Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Kama hrahring ta sidar thing a daw ce kha la'a angte i ling aa. A daw lie a ce panuta kha thli'a angte, aa suosapa tluodaw lie kha kama hrahring ta i ling aa.

A ce kha lesa te a thyi a pathyi riypa hne sidar kung phapa a cuo riypa tana Israel tluo aa suopa lie kha kama ta i ling aa. Capa sidar kung rawlie ca pavaa phangting kha aw'a yi te, a mathlaa a hnyipa saruopa phangting ta a ce ningdiy lie kha ama buv amaa tue aa.

Ruo chung thingkung bangkhuo khata Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi. Thingkung aa suopa kha pane'a angte, aa nepa kha i pasuo aa. Thingkung hringpa kha parue'a angte, a ruepa thingkung kha i pahring aa. AbyipaKama na a ri ang, hingpa hing i patlung sa aa.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:
Israel ruo hneta aa patuv pata na ri pakhaa paripa hingpa phungthluvbie “Nungpaa ta mingsuv thyi thuepa ce yi te na ama saata zaw haa a zaa,” tapa hing khaapama na ri khing?
Abyipa Khazingta, kama i hringpa haata, hingpa phungthluvbie hing niema ta Israel ruo chunglie hmuo'a va tli ung ciy.
A hringpa bangkhuo ca kama huopa tana a cuo diy tapa kha pachang tie ung; nungpaa tie hringna cuose, saata tie hringna cuose kama huopa tana a cuo: a suepa cawsaa dyina a thiy aa.
Cawsaa phapa pakha ca aa dangpa hne aa hmuopa kha tue te,
khahrungtluobu lie kha sa ning li, Israel ming kuvtuezuv kha mangthaw buo li, malie napuv kha papyapalyi buo li pata, a hning a awpa canung kha cadi buo vyi.

Pakha hmuo hrisaa li pata aw te, cuorasala lyibuo a hnyi nakawta biekuona ta a chi cawpa chechiy kha pakaa te, malie hmang kha chuv pata la buo li pata, a nang a diypa kha sa pi yi te, caw a hnyi lipa kha caw a tue yi.
A mie la pata tuokaa ducyi pi va yi. Pha lina tue li riypata a kuv kha a cadang te, phuv hning alalalie kha aa hmuo pata bie a chi.
I phungluo kha ziy te, i ziyphung kha a raaringsa pata hne zang tluo aa tlasa pata a tue, cahaapa cawsaa ca aa dangpa ta cuo te, a hring hrahring aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Ama ta malie a ese a tuechiepa, lie a nawpa,
capa hmang suokhakha a tuepa (a paa ta hingpa tie suokha hing hmuo a tue li raalaa pata), khahrungtluobu lie kha sa a ningpa, malie napuv kha a papya a palyipa,
siypasa tie hne a phahlapa tie kha a tuechiepa, malie hmang kha chuv yi te a lapa, biekuona ta a chi cawpa kha a pakaa lipa, kuvtuezuv kha mangthaw te duvsamakhiepa kha a tuepa,
amie ta ducyi a pipa sacapaa kha a hnyi kieca; ama ca a hring'a ma? Hring'a vyi. Ama ta hingpa duvsamakhiepa bangkhuo hing a tue tli; a thiy hrahring aa; a thiyse ca a luv cungliena a tlung aa.
Cuorasala hingpa cawsaa hingta a paa tuepa suena bangkhuo a hmungpa sacapaa pakha hnyi sala, rue syalya te, capa haa cata tue li pata,
khahrungtluobu lie kha sa ning vyi, Israel ming kuvtuezuv kha mangthaw vyi, a ingpaa napuv kha papyapalyi vyi,
pakha cunglie hmuo suena tue vyi, biekuona ta chi riypa kha hie va yi, malie hmang kha chuv pata la vyi, cuorasala a nang a diypa tie kha sa pi yi te, caw a hnyi lipa tie kha caw a tue yi,
pha lina tue li riypata a kuv aa cadang, amie la vyi, i ziyphung hne i phungluo kha ziy te a tue; ama ca a paa pha lina kawlieta thiy'a vyi, a hring hrahring aa.
A paa ca malie huopa kha hruohra ta a la, a uvnu huopa kha chuv yi te a la, a cawsaa tie hrawlie kha a pha lipa a tue, ama ca a pha lina kawlie kha a thiy aa.

Niema ta, “Khaapanakawma a paa pha lina kha a sacapaa ta a ang va?” nama ta. Sacapaa ta aa dangpa hne aa hmuopa kha tue te, i phungluo kha a raaringsa pata a tue diy tiyta, ama ca a hring hrahring aa.

A suepa cawsaa khana a thiy aa. Saata a cuopa ta nungpaa pha lina kha ang'a vyi; nungpaa zaw ta saata pha lina kha ang ra'a va yi; aa dangpa adangna ca ama huota cuo'a te, a pha lipa pha lina ca ama huota a cuo aa.
Cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa ca a za tuepa suena kha thaw te, i phungluo bangkhuo kha ziy te aa dangpa hne aa hmuopa kha a tue kieca a hring hrahring aa; thiy'a vyi.
A tuesuena suokha hmuo a thyipa pata cuo'a vyi, aa hmuopa a tuepa thue khata a hring aa.
Abyipa Khazingta, cawsaa pha lipa a thiypa kha i khing'a ma? A luopuv taa khata a vya maa sala a hringpa kha khing vie'a va ang ma? a ta.

Cuorasala cawsaa aa dangpa ta adangna thuse pata pha lina kha tue te, cawsaa pha lipa ta ama tuepa duvsamakhiepa kha a tue kieca, a hring'a ma? Adangna a za tuepa suokha kha hmuota a thyipa pata cuo'a vyi; biekuo pathli pata a tuepa suena cuo khata a thiy aa.
Niema ta, “Abyipaluopuv ca a dang vyi,” nama ta. Naathlie tie ung, Vya Israel ming: I luopuv ca a dang va ma? Aa dang lipa ca niema luopuv ta cuo va ma?
Aa dangpa ta adangna kha thaw te pha lina a tue kieca, capa kawlie ca ta a thiy aa; a tuepa pha lina kawlie khata a thiy aa.
Cakhutaata a pha lipa cawsaa pakha ca pha lina kha thaw te, aa dangpa hne aa hmuopa kha a tue kieca, a hringna aa bang aa.
Tahematapakieca ama ta rue syalya te a suena bangkhuo kha a thaw nakawta a hring hrahring aa; thiy'a vyi.
Caacuonakawta Israel ming ta, “Abyipaluopuv ca a dang vyi,” ama ta. Vya Israel ming, i luopuv a dang va ma? Aa dang lipa ca niema luopuv khata cuo va ma?

Caacuonakawta Vya Israel ming, nama luopuv cyicuo haa kha tana bieripana ica hnyi'a yi, Abyipa Khazingta a ta. A ngiepachiy ung la nama suena bangkhuo taa khata a vya maa tie ung; cata acuolikieca pha lina khana nama rana ta a cuo aa.
Kama a du pata nama tuepa tuesuena bangkhuo kha thaw ung la pathiypalung thaapa hne ruena thaapa kha hnyi tie ung! Vya Israel ming, khaapanakawma nama thiy aa?
Tahematapakieca ahunghmuo thiy ung la i palung tluo vyi, Abyipa Khazingta a ta. A thle ung la hring tie ung.
Nama ca Israel byi tie kha muochie sa yi la,
hing haa hingta ri tie: Na nung ca chingde zaw hrawlie chingdepuvnung tana a za cuo! Chingde thuthawpa zaw hrawlieta laa te, a taata zaw kha a mangchiy yi.
A taata zaw hrawlie sakha kha kya le te, chingde thuthawpa ta a kya cuo, saa sie kha kya the te, cawsaa zaw kha a sie yi.
Mingphang zaw ta ama kawlie kha a pahlu yi te, ama suphung chunglie kha ama patuv; cakhutaata Izipt ruo luo kha kyipa ta amaa dale.
A nung ta a saata kha a sung te aa nguopuona a viepa kha a hmung tiyta, a taata sakha kha la pakhaa te chingde thuthawpa ta a pacuo sa pakhaa.
Chingde zaw hrawlie kha a khie ra te, chingde thuthawpa ta aa li. Saa sie kha the te, cawsaa zaw kha a sie.
Ama cariekyikuo kha para te, ama khy kha a duothlingpa ta a tue; ruo hne a chunglie a awpa tie ca aa hrungnapa ueryi kha thyi yi te amaa cathang.
Capa ruo cahriylie a awpa mingphang zaw ca ta ama kha vya pyahnue yi te, asue khata buv yi te, khue chunglieta ama patuv.
Kyipa ta siy yi te baw chunglieta ama pasaw, cakhutaata Babilon siepahruo'a luo kha ama sikhyi. Israel tluo zaw cunglieta a ueryi aa thyi li tli riypata thaw chunglie kha ama khung.
Na nung ca mingsuv diedung chunglie mingsuv kung suokha ta za cuo te, tiy kielie a lingpa tana a za cuo, tiy ta a tungsa nakawta, a ce rungsa te a pathyisa.
A ce ca kya cahrasa yi te, uvtuv khuecahryi ta aa li; a ce ca rungsa te a chaasa, aa suosa ta a zuo te aa calyasa.
Cuorasala hihaa pata sapachung pata cuo te, alyi lie thaw pata a cuo. Ningchiy thliy ta a hruosue te a caa diy, a thyi kha cakhaw pathla diy te, myi ta a kuo diy.
Ata hing ca ruocaapa luo, a caavungna ruo luo kha palaw yi te a ling pata a cuo.

A ce suokha taa khata myi pya te, a ce hne a thyi kha a kuo diy yi, caacuonakawta uvtuv byi tie khuecahryi riypata a cahrapa ce kha aw va tli. Hingpa hing caana hlaa ta cuo te, muochiesana ta ama hmuopa tana a cuo.
A kung sariyna, thla pangaa thlaa, ning hraana lie kha Israel uvthyi tie ca Abyipahne bie a rue riypata a vaw yi te i hmiekunglie kha amaa tu.
Cakhutaata Abyipabie kha kama'a luo ca a zuv te:

Cawsaapa, Israel uvthyi tie'a lie kha ri tie; Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Khaapa repata ma namaa vaw? Kama hneta bie a rue riypata ma? Abyipa Khazingta, kama i hringpa haata, niema ta bie naa rue khu va ung ciy.
Iema kha bie na ripa'a yi ma, cawsaapa, iema kha bie na ripa'a yi ma? Cakhutaata iema ta ama mingchingmingvuo tie duvsamakhie amaa chiyna kha pachang yi se.

Cakhutaata iema'a lie kha: Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Israel kha i zaa tlaw tiyta, Jakob ingchungkhue samingsahlaa tie kha chie a sa pata bie zaa kuo yi angte, Izipt ruo chunglie kha i zaa pachang sa yi, iema kha chie a sa pata bie zaa kuo yi angte, Kama ca Abyipanama Khazing tana i cuo, i za ta yi.

Capa ning lie ca ta iema ca Izipt ruo chungtaata pyakhyi'a yi angte, iema cuota i huvpa ruo, cuehnung hne khyitiy a langnapa ruo, ruo bangkhuo hrawlie a rungnaa cepa ruo luo kha icaa ngiekhyi'a yi, i za ta yi.

Cakhutaata iema kyihuo khata, niema nama cyicuo hingta, nama ming lunghruo tlungsa pata nama mangpa duv aa chiypa kha thaw ung la, Izipt kuvtuezuv hing ta a papya a palyi khah ung; Kama ca Abyipanama Khazing tana i cuo, i ta yi.

Cuorasala kama kha naa du yi te, na naathlie va yi; ahungtahmuo ama ming lunghruo tlung pata ama mangpa duvsamakhie aa chiypa kha thaw va yi, Izipt kuvtuezuv zaw kha thaw va yi. Cakhutaata i pathiylingna hing ama cunglie lyisue'a yi angte na, Izipt ruo lie, iema hrawlie hing i hihaana i hmuo aa ta pata i rue.

Cuorasala iema ama awnapa mingphang zaw hmungna lieta i ming kha papyapalyi pata a cuo li riypata i ming vuo khata re hrie angte, capa tie hmungna lie ca iema kha Izipt ruo chungtaata i pyakhyina yi khata i pachang sa yi.
Caacuonakawta Izipt taata pyakhyi yi angte, ruocaapa luo kha i sikhyi yi.
A ziypa bangkhuo ama hring riypata i phungluo kha pi yi angte i ziyphung kha i pahmung sa yi.
Ca hlyitaw taata kama hne iema alalalie pamangsana riypa hne Abyipakama na a pathe sa yi ang tapa kha ama pachang riypata i sabbath kha i pi yi.

Cuorasala Israel ming ta ruocaapa lieta kama kha inaa du yi; i phungluo kha ziy va yi, a ziypa bangkhuo ta ama hringna riypata a cuopa i ziyphung zaw kha thaw yi te, i sabbath kha khuosa ta ama papyapalyi. Cakhutaata iema kha chuo naase yi ta pata ruocaapa lie ca i hihaana kha lyisue'a kanaa yi ang, ta pata i rue.
Cuorasala i vya pyakhyipa yi a hmungpa mingphang tie hmungna lieta i ming kha papyapalyipa a cuo li riypata i ming vuo khata re i hrie pakhaa.

Ca hlyitaw taata ruocaapa lie kha chie a sa pata bie a kuo angte, iema i pipa yi ruo, cuehnung hne khyitiy a langnapa ruo, ruo bangkhuo hrawlie a rungnaa cepa ruo chung luo kha a ngiekhyi'a va yi ang i ta.
Tahematapakieca ama pathiypalung ca kuvtuezuv kha a ziy nakawta i ziyphung kha thaw yi te, i phungluo kha ziy lipa yi ta i sabbath kha ama papyapalyi.
Cuorasala ngie a buo yi angte ruocaapa lie kha para diy pata a chuona pa pha sa va yi ang.
Ama saata zaw kha, nama nungpaa ta ama ziypa phungbie kha ziy khah ung, ama ziyphung zaw kha ziy khah ung, ama kuvtuezuv ta a papya a palyi khah ung ta pata ruocaapa lie kha i chang yi.
Kama hingna nama Khazing ta a cuo ang; i phungluo kha ziy tie ung, i ziyphung kha a cadangsa pata tue tie ung,
cakhutaata kama hne niema alalalie pamangsana cuo riypata i sabbath kha pathe sa tie ung, cahaacata Kama ca Abyipanama Khazing i cuopa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy, i ta yi

Cuorasala ama saata zaw ta kama kha inaa du yi; i phungluo kha ziy va yi; a ziypa bangkhuo ta ama tluona riypata a cuopa i ziyphung zaw kha a cadangsa pata tue va yi; i sabbath kha ama papyapalyi. Cakhutaata ruocaapa lie ca i hihaana kha iema cunglie hmuo pata lyisue'a kanaa yi ang ta pata i rue.
Cuorasala ama hmiekunglieta i vya pyakhyipa yi a hmungpa mingphang tie hmungna lieta i ming kha papyapalyipa a cuo li riypata i kuv kha a ang angte, i ming kaw pacuo pata re i hrie.
Ca hlyitaw taata ruocaapa lie kha chie a sa angte, mingphang zaw hrawlie hne ruo ting luo na i chepatlaa diy'a yi i ta.
Tahematapakieca i ziyphung kha tue lipa yi ta i phungluo kha thaw yi te, i sabbath kha ama papyapalyi, cakhutaata ama mingchingmingvuo tie kuvtuezuv cunglie kha ama ming ama khang.
Caacuonakawta a pha lipa phungluo kha pi yi angte, hringna hmungnapa ta a cuo lipa ziyphung kha i pi yi.
Iema ca ama thlaa zangsa te kama kha Abyipai cuopa ina pachang riypa yi ta iema lasaw mamaapa ta a cuopa ama sa-uvthyi pihluona ama tuepa khata i papya i palyi yi.

Caacuonakawta, cawsaapa, Israel ming'a lie kha hing haa hingta ri la chang tie yi, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Nama mingchingmingvuo tie ca kama'a liena zang tluo aa tla li pata hne duv aa chiy pata ama aw pakhaa hyi.

Tahematapakieca iema pi riypata chie i sapa ruo chung luo i sikhyi tiy yi ta, tluo bupa hne thingkung hnaa phapa ama hmungna mekaa lieta hriykhungrina pihluo yi te, i hi naa pahaapa pihluona kha ama tue; rangpa-ue pihluona hne dangpa ta panaana zaw kha ama pihluo.
(Iema kyihuo khata, nama cakuonapa khahrungtluobu ca khaapatama a cuo? Capa ca ataning tepa hingta Bamah ta pata ama ku.)

Caacuonakawta Israel ming kha chang tie yi, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Nama mingchingmingvuo tie palungphya kha hnyi pata, ama tuepa duvsamakhie aa chiypa hmang hnang luo kha ziy pata hne luo pie pata niema hne niema kha namaa papyapalyi'a ma?

Nama lasaw kha pihluo ung cate, nama saata zaw myi chunglie ama thiy tiyta, ataning hing nama kuvtuezuv bangkhuo tana niema hne niema namaa papyapalyi pata a cuo. Kama ca niema hneta bie i rue the'a ma? Vya Israel ming, kama i hringpa haata, kama ca niema hneta bie a rue the'a va ang, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.

“Kiema ca mingphang hrang tie, chuelyi mingphang hrang tie haa hingta cuo ung sala, thing hne lung kha a bie ung siy,” nama tapa, nama palung chunglie a awpa hne nama ruepa kha vya cuo buo hluo'a vyi, a ta.
Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri, kama i hringpa haata, a cahrapa i kuv hne i pazuopa i buo, i za lyipa i hihaana ta niema cunglie siepahruo i cuo aa.
Namaa chepatlaanapa ruo ting taata hne mingphang zaw hraw taa khata a cahrapa i kuv, i pazuopa i buo hne i za lyipa i hihaana ta ica pakiy'a yi.
Mingphang hrang tie ruocaapa luo kha caa chiy'a yi angte, capa lie ca hmie desuo ta bieripana ica hnyi'a yi.
Izipt ruo ruocaapa lieta nama mingchingmingvuo tie kha bieripana i hnyipa haa yi ta niema zaw bieripana ica hnyi ra'a yi, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
I sungpe rawlie kha cakuo'a ung cate nama caluo aa, cakhutaata biekuona chung luo kha icaa ngiekhyi'a yi.

Kama naa dupa tie hne kama'a lie a suepa tie kha niema hraw taata i papya'a yi; mingpe ta ama awnapa ruo chung taa hingta papya'a yi angte, Israel ruo chung luo hing a ngie pakhaa'a va tli yi. Cakhutaata Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy.

Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Vya Israel ming, Niema ta i ri kha inaa ngie li kie ungca ca, nama mekaa khata cakuo ung la, ata lie hing hne ata khutaa zaw hingta nama kuvtuezuv kha abie tie ung; cuorasala nama lasaw hne nama kuvtuezuv khata i ming pathe ca papyapalyi'a va tli ung ciy.

Cuorasala i tluo pathe cunglie, Israel tluo aa suopa cunglie kha Israel ingchungkhue bangkhuo ta, iema yalya ta, i re kha ama hrie aa. Capa lie ca kama ta cuhluo'a yi angte, niema ta nama thu riypa hne nama lasaw pha cepa tie kha cuose, nama pi riypa a pathepa bangkhuo kha ica hie'a yi, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.

Namaa chepatlaanapa ruo hne mingphang zaw chungtaata ca pyakhyi yi angte ica pahmya tiy yi ta, rangpa-ue pihluopa haata niema kha ica cuhluo'a yi. Mingphang zaw hmungna lie kha i pathena ca i paluo sa aa.
Nama mingchingmingvuo tie pi riypata bie i kuopa yi ruo, Israel ruo chung luo kha icaa ngiekhyi tiy yi ta Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy.
Capa lie ca nama hringzya hne niema hne niema a papya a palyi pata nama tuepa bangkhuo kha namaa thyi aa; cakhutaata nama za tuepa a pha lipa bangkhuo kawlie kha niema hne niema kha namaa duv aa.
Vya Israel ming, nama hringzya pha lipa hne a pha lipa nama tuepa haa khata cuo li pata, i ming a daakhyi pata nama cunglie i tue tiyta Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:
Cawsaapa, sungluo kha na hmie pahyi la, sungluo ruo, Negeb ruo chunglie atuv ruo kha profetbiephu ca rihnuo tie.

Negeb atuv kha, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Abyipabie hing naathlie tie, nama chunglie kha myi patiy'a angte, capa ca ta na chunglie thing hringpa hne thing ruepa bangkhuo kha a kuo diy aa; myihlaa ca die li'a pata capa ruo sungluo taata chaluo te yalya ca a kuo diy aa.
Cawsaa bangkhuo ta capa ca kama Abyipana a tue ang tapa kha pachang'a yi te, capa ca pache khu pata cuo'a vyi.
Cakhutaata kama ta, “Ah Abyipa Khazing! Iema na, ‘Ama ca pakhingpuona bie dyi a ripa ta cuo va ma?’ naa ta yi,” i ta.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:
Cawsaapa, Jerusalem luo kha a hyi la hmangpathepa hne Israel ruo kha profetbiephu risue tie.
Cakhutaata Israel ruo kha, Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Nama a du riypa tana i vaw nguoluo, i zueziy ca a baw taata a da'a angte niema aa dangpa hne a pha lipa tie kha ica sapachung diy'a yi.
Na cawsaa aa dangpa hne a pha lipa tie kha i sapachung diy'a nakaw yi ta sungluo taata chaluo te cawsaa bangkhuo a du pata i zueziy ca a baw taata a da pata a cuo aa.
Cakhutaata cawsaa bangkhuo khata kama Abyipana i zueziy kha a baw taata a da ang tapa kha ina pachang'a yi; a baw luo pasaw pakhaa pata cuo'a vyi.
Caacuonakawta a hrung a ie tie, cawsaapa, iema hmungna lie kha palung kyi pata a hrung a ie tie.

Iema ta, “Khaapanakawma naa hrung naa ie?” aca ta tiy yi ta, nama ta, “Thuohlaa i thyipa kawlie tana a cuo. Pathiypalung mekaa ca zachi'a te kuv mekaa zaw kha a thaa a naa aa, cawsaa mekaa ama rie chie'a te ama pakhuv kha a kanaa diy aa. Mang tie, capa ca a vaw te a tling aa,” na ta'a yi, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:
Cawsaapa, profetbiephu kha ri tie: Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri; ta la ri tie: Zueziy, zueziy ca cata nguoluo pata cuo te, a tluesiyliy pata tue pata a cuo.
Cawsaa thiena riypata cata pata cuo te, thinghlaa haata aa li riypata cata pata a cuo. Tuokhaatama maa nuo khu aa? Nama ta sungpe hne pasiypa-yana kha na duv.
Zueziy ca cata riypata pi pata a cuo tli, kuv lie patuv riypata pi pata a cuo tli. Cata yi te tluesiyliy khata chi pata a cuo tli, cawsaa a thiepa kuv luo kha chi pata a cuo tli.

Vya cawsaapa, khi la caa tie, tahematapakieca hingpa hing kama cawsaa zaw na aa du yi, Israel byi tie khana aa du yi; iema ca i cawsaa zaw hne kha tana zueziy luo kha thaw pata ama cuo. Ah! na baw kha a cung tie!
Rue riypa ca: Khaapama? Sungpe kha na duv kieca, capa ca vya cuo li pata a aw'a ma? Abyipa Khazingta a ta.

Cakhutaata nama, cawsaapa, profetbiephu kha ri tie; na kuvpazaa kha cabe tie. Zueziy ca yi hning yi thung pahie tie; capa ca thienapa zueziy tana a cuo. Thiena lepuv zueziy tana a cuo, capa ca na iema kha a cadung yi;
Caacuonakawta pathiypalung zaw ca zachi diy te, cawsaa hluvpuv amaa pachiy. Ama thlake bangkhuo lie kha zueziy ca i chikhuo diy yi. Ah! aa li dyi aa li pata tue yi te, thiena riypa tana ama ca ta.
Vya zueziy, cacuoluo kha sa la, cavyiluo zaw kha sa tie! Na daw ta aa hyina luo mekaa kha sa tie.
Kama zaw i kuv kha cabe'a angte, i hihaana kha i pachung aa; Abyipakama na a ri ang.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:

Cawsaapa, Babilon siepahruo zueziy aa vawna riypa luopuv suohning kha aa hnangna tue tie; ama suohning cata ruo kha taata a pathu yi se. Cakhutaata luo a pienapa lie, khypuv luo a sipa lie kha pachangsanapa atung kha bang tie.
Ammon ming khy Rabbah luo cuose, Judah ming khy a cu ciemuopa Jerusalem luo cuose zueziy aa vawna riypa luopuv kha aa hnangna tue tie.
Tahematapakieca Babilon siepahruo ca luopuv aa chena lie kha a daa te, hmungdawluna a hnyi the riypata; cuoti cathang te a mang, kuvtuezuvtaata kha bie a hiehriy, saa pathiy kha a mang.

A cacuoluo kuv chunglie kha Jerusalem cuota vyisung ca tla te, khypuv dungkhuo pacingnapa sa riypa, thie diy riypata khisue riypa, rietuvna ueryi ta khisue riypata, thlake pacingnapa sa riypa, riekhuocaaca sasue riypa, rievena ingsuo sasue riypa, tapa tie ta a cuo.
Cuorasala capa ca ama hneta biekuona a tuepa iema cuota hanghie pata tuepa hmungdawluna na a lu aa; ama ta iema ama suena kha pathyi sa pakhaa'a yi te sii ta a sikhyi'a yi.

Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Nama tuesuena kha a thyi pari riypata vya chiykhyi ung cate, nama tuepa bangkhuo lieta nama suena ca aa luo; a thyi pari riypata namaa vaw tli nakawta, sii ta sikhyi pata nama cuo aa.
Nama cawsaa chiepa, a pha lipa Israel uvtuv byi, a hnangcaw ce ta nama duotena ning ca aa vaw tli.
Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Na pawde hne na byilakhuv ca thaw tie; khaapa hing hmuo ama za cuona haa khata a hmang'a vyi. Aa nepa kha cyicalang la, aa suopa kha pachung tie.
Rana, Rana, Rana! capa ca kama na a tue'a ang! (Cahaapa ca za aw buo vyi.) Tue khuna naw a hnyipa aa vaw taata capa ca a kuv chungluo kha i pi aa.

Cawsaapa, nama ca profetbiephu kha ri tie, Abyipa Khazingna Israel ming a esepa Ammon ming hne aa patuv pata hing haa hingta a ri; ta pata ri tie: Zueziy, zueziy! thiena riypata a baw taata a dapa, thiena riypata aa li dyi aa lina te ta catapa.

Na cuota a cuo lipa muocuo pahmung sa pata cuo te, hmieluo kaw hmunglupa kha hangpa tana a cuo. Nama ca cawsaa chiepa, a pha lipa tie, a hnangcaw ce duotena ang riypata ama ningcuo a vaw tlipa tie rue cunglie khana aca chi yi.
Zueziy ca a baw chungluo kha pasaw pakhaa tie! Sa pata na za cuonapa hmang, na za puvnapa hmang lie khana bie ica ripa aa.
Na cunglie khana i hihaana ica lyisue aa, i hihaana myi tana nama kha ica hmung aa. Para a thesapa hne pachangna a hnyi lipa tie kuv chungluo na ica pi aa.
Nama ca myi lie tiy riypata cuo'a cate, na thiy ca alyi chung luo khana aa ngie aa. Nama ca a thyi pata cuo'a va tli ciy, tahematapakieca Abyipakama na a ri ang.
Abyipabie kha kama'a luo a zuv te:
Cawsaapa, thiyse a palangpa khypuv hing bie na ripa'a ma, bie na ripa'a ma? Cakhutaata a tuepa duvsamakhiepa bangkhuo kha pachang sa tie.
Nama ta, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Khypuv! Ama chung mamaapa lieta thiyse a palangpa; kuvtuezuv a tue te ama hne ama a papya a palyipa; a cuo ca aa vaw tli.

Na palangpa thiyse kawlieta na sue mangtli, cakhutaata na tuepa kuvtuezuv kawlieta na pyalyi tli; na ningkhue kha pangie sa vie cate, na cuota thli paciepa kung ca aa vaw tli. Caacuonakawta mingphang zaw hrawlie kha na nang ca pazaa'a angte, ruo ting ta ese riypata ica tue tli.
Nama, a thuochipa hne aa ngie aa cuo li pata khy a sapa, nama hneta aa ngiepa hne aa hlapa tie ta aca tue hyalya'a yi.
Na chunglieta a awpa Israel byi mekaa ta ama hmang tue khuna cyicuo haata thiyse ama palang kaluo.
Na hmiekunglie ta nung hne paa kha ama ese; ruohrang ming kha ama hrisaa, nunghlyi hne haaraa cunglie kha pha lina ama tue.
Niema ca i cuota a pathepa tie kha duv ung cate, i sabbath kha nama papya nama palyi.
Na chunglieta thiyse palang khing pata lyina bie a ripa, khahrungtluobu cunglie sa a ningpa, thiysaa khingna lie a siyhrawpa zaw ama aw.
Na chunglie hing ama paa zaw thliehripa ta ama awpa a pahruv lipa aw yi te, canung phungpa a vaw nguoluopa canung a ziekhyipa zaw ama aw.
Chekha ca a ingpaa napuv hne duvsamakhie pata awhne yi te, a hrangpa tie ta ama munung tie kha ama papyapalyi, a hrangpa tie ta ama sietanung, ama paa sacanung kha ama papyapalyi.

Na chunglieta thiyse palang riypata nawthuv a ningpa ama aw; a mie la yi te tuokaa ducyi ama pi, nama ingpaa taata hruohra ta hmungna luopuv a sa ung cate, kama kha ina maw ung ciy, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Mang tie ung, aa dang li pata hmungna khue nama khuopa hne niema hrawlie thiyse nama palangpa kawlie kha i pazaa i cabe aa.
Nama cuona kaw kha ica ri tiy yi ta nama palung cahra'a te nama kuv a cahra khu'a ma? Abyipakama na a ri ang, capa ca kama ta i tue aa.
Mingphang zaw hraw luo kha ca chepatlaa diy'a yi angte, ruo ting ta ica cadaapatlaa diy'a yi, nama pyalyina zaw kha ica pasiy'a yi.
Cakhutaata mingphang zaw ta a pyalyipa ta ca hmung'a yi te, Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:
Cawsaapa, Israel ming ca kama cuota thaa-ii tana ama cuo; capa tie bangkhuo ca ngu, daa, cuophiy, thaa, hne kawthuv ta ama cuo. Iema ca thaa tiy palangnapa chunglieta thaa-ii ta amaa li.
Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Niema bangkhuo ca thaa-ii ta namaa li nakawta Jerusalem khychung liena ica pahmya'a yi.

Cawsaa pakha ta ngu, daa, thaariy, kawthuv, hne cuophiy kha thaa tiy palangnapa chunglie pahlaw yi te, a tiy ta palang riypata myi ta a paling; capa haa cata niema kha i hihaana chunglie ca pahlaw'a yi angte, a tiy ta ica palang'a yi.
Niema kha ca pahlaw'a yi angte i hihaana myi ta ica paling'a yi, cakhutaata capa chunglie ca a tiy ta nama lang aa.
Ngu ca thaa tiy palangnapa chunglie a tiy ta a langpa haata capa chunglie ca a tiy ta nama lang aa; cakhutaata Abyipakama ta i hihaana ica byapa yi kha nama pachang aa.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:
Cawsaapa, hingpa hing ri tie: Niema ca pasiypathe lipa, hihaana ning lieta a cunglie khy ta a saa lipa tana nama cuo.

A chunglie a awpa byi tie ca ama saa siepa ama ce pata aa hrungpuo nguoluopa chingde haa tana ama cuo; cawsaa kha ama sie; ama suethiy hne muosungpa zaw kha la yi te, ama ruo chunglie canung a hluvsa kha nunghlyi ta ama tue.

Ama tluobyi tie ta i pacuvna kha para yi te, i hmang pathepa tie kha ama papyapalyi. Iema ta a pathepa hne a cakhawpa kha thleduo lipa yi ta, a pathepa hne a pyapa amaa nanangnapa kha pacuv va yi. I sabbath kha siysaa ri lipa yi ta kama kha ama hrawlie ca ina papyapalyi yi.
A chunglie byi tie ca ama saa siepa a ce nguoluopa cahnie haa khata cuo yi te, aa dang li pata a mie hmung khingna kawlie cawsaa thiyse kha palang yi te ama thie.
Ama profet tie ta hang pata muocuo ama hmung, hang pata kuvcaa mang yi te thung ruopa kha ama thuv, Abyipata a ri lipa kha, “Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri,” ama ta.
Ruo chunglie cawsaa tie ca malie hmang kha chuv yi te ama paruv; siypasa tie hne phahlavuosuopa tie kha hrisaa yi te, ruohrang ming cunglie amie ama huv.
Kama ta ruo kha i para li riypata khypuv dungkhuo lungruetlepie a pare riypa hne a cingnapa lie, kama hmiekunglie kha ruo cuota a daa nguopa i huv raalaa pata pakha hmuo hmung va yi ang.
Caacuonakawta iema ca i pathiylingna kha lyisue yi angte, i hihaana myi ta i thie yi; iema tuenapa kha ama luv cung luo i patlungsue yi, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:
Cawsaapa, Nung pakha ta a sapa yi canung pahning ama za aw.
Izipt lie kha siyhrawnung ta zaa tue yi te, ama meme daw kha a pahrie sa yi te, lesaa pathepa ama cuona ca amaa para.
Oholah ca a uvthyinung ta cuo te, Oholibah ca a syinung ta a cuo. Iema ca kama huopa ta a li yi te sacapaa hne sacanung ama sa. Oholah ca Samaria ta cuo te Oholibah ca Jerusalem ta a cuo.
Oholah ca kama huopa a cuo nguoluo thluo pata siyhrawnung ta a tue te, a duepa Assiria ming,
caw dungpa a hryipa rieka tie, uvtuv tie hne riekabyi tie, iema bangkhuo ca a chiythesapa aruo rieka ta cuo yi te, iema ca aa khing yi.
Assiria capaa puvthe cepa tie hne khata thiysaa khingna lunghruo ca a patlung te, a khingpa tie kuvtuezuv tie hne khata aa papya aa palyi.
Izipt ruo taata patha pata a tue tlipa siyhrawna ca pathlie vyi; a lesaa thaata ning khata capaa ta a ziekhyi yi te a meme kha za hmipa yi te ama khing lunghruo amaa patlung.
Caacuonakawta a khingpa tie kuv chunglie, Assiria ming kuv chunglie kha i thuse.

Iema ca ta a caw kha thliepa yi te, a sacapaa hne a sacanung tie kha ama patuv; cakhutaata ama kha zueziy ta ama thie. A cunglieta bieripana kha tue pata cuo te, canung tie hrawlie a kaw rile pata aa li.
A nutanung Oholibah ta capa ca a hmung; ama ca a thiysaa khingna hne a siyhrawna lie kha a uvtanung laata a ruv vie.
Assiria ming, uvtuv tie hne riekabyi tie, caw dungpa a hryipa rieka tie, iema bangkhuo ca a chiythesapa aruo rieka tie ta cuo yi te, iema ca aa khing yi.
Ama zaw aa papya aa palyi tlipa kha i hmung; ama pahning ta ama ziypa luopuv ca aa lu.
Cuorasala ama ca a siyhraw vie hryly. Ama ta tlepie lie ama sapa capaa hmaathla, tlepie lieta ama sapa Khaldi capaa tie zuv,
ama sesie lie tesaw a sawpa, ama luv lie a pe pathliepa pawde a pawpa, ama bangkhuo ta byi a lupa tie; Khaldi ruo lie a puvpa Babilon ming hmaathla kha a hmung tiyta,
iema kha khing paluo yi te Khaldi luo kha biephyatuv a pathlie yi.
Cakhutaata Babilon ming ca ama hne iehmang lie a ziehne riypata a vaw yi te, iema khingna ca ta ama kha ama papyapalyi. Iema khata nang yi te a duv te a duvna te yi ta ama ca ama papyapalyi.
A thliehripa ta aw te a luohuo ta a siyhraw pari tiyta a uvtanung kha i duvpa haata ama zaw kha i duv ra.
A lesaa thaata ning Izipt ruo lieta a za siyhrawpa kha a thyi te,
capa lie ca ama chiepha kha laatungpa chiepha haata a tapa, ama ciytiy kha aruotungpa ciytiy haata a pyapa tie, capaa siyhrawpa tie kha aa khing yi.
Cahaacata Izipt ming ta na meme ca hriepa yi te naa hnungdaw aca za tawpa ning yi, na lesaa thaa ning na khing ta na za siyhrawpa kha na vuo.
Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Vya Oholibah, na khingpa tie, aca nangna te yi ta caa ziehnepa tie kha pathu'a yi angte nama a du riypata hmangting taa khata i vya pavaw sa'a yi:

Babilon ming hne Khaldi ming bangkhuo, Pekod hne Shoa hne Koa, hne iema hne cata Assiria ming bangkhuo, satlie puvthepa tie, uvtuv tie hne riekabyi tie bangkhuo, byi tie hne aruo rieka tie ta pata ama cuo.

Iema ta aruole hne hmang phyanapa le hne cawsaa a hluvsa ta chaluo ruo taa khata acaa zuvchiy'a yi; phyataata, phyalepa, thaalakhuv tapa tie kha a tue'a yi te nama a du riypata a kuo ting taa khata acaa vawchiy'a yi. Iema ca bieripana naw kha pi'a yi angte iema ziyphung haata bie aca ripa'a yi.

Nama kha hihaasa pata aca tue the riypa yi ta, i pathiylingna kha na cunglie ica papyasue aa. Na hnacabuv hne na naakue zaw kha ca te'a yi te zueziy ta aca thie'a yi. Na sacanung hne na sacapaa tie kha patuv'a yi te, nama kha myi ta ca rue'a yi te aca thie'a yi.
Na caw kha ca thliepa diy'a yi te na sue muosungpa kha aca lapa diy'a yi.
Cahaacata Izipt ruo taata naa vya phyalepa na thiysaa khingna hne na siyhrawna kha pachuo sa'a angte, capa tie ca vuo li tli'apa cata Izipt zaw kha a thyi'a va tli ciy.
Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Kama ta na huepa tie, aca nangna te yi ta caa ziehnepa tie kuv chung luo kha ica pi aa.
Nama kha ca hue'a yi te na hrie muo bangkhuo kha ama la diy aa, na thliehripa ta aca thuse'a yi, na thliehripa ta na cuopa hne na siyhrawna ca aa phu diy aa. Na thiysaa khingna hne na siyhrawna ca
na cungluo a tlung tli, tahematapakieca mingphang zaw hne khata siyhraw cate, ama kuvtuezuv zaw hne khata naa papya naa palyi tli.
Na uvtanung luopuv kha na ziy tli, caacuonakawta a panuo kha na kuv chung luo ica pi tli.
Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Na uvtanung panuo khana na dang aa, a thuv te a kupa panuo kha; ca ese'a yi te aca tue hyalya'a yi, capa panuo ca a hluvsa aa tlaw.
Khuosa ta pariy'a cate na ngie a chi aa. Ciy aa chiysapa hne rakyina panuo ca na uvtanung Samaria panuo tana a cuo.
Capa ca dang'a cate na saw aa, panuo kha dechi'a cate na meme kha naa uochi diy aa; tahematapakieca kama na a ri ang, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Nama ta na maw cate hnangluo ina thaw nakaw cata na thiysaa khingna hne na siyhrawna muo ca nama na a ang'a ciy.
Abyipata kama kyihuo khata: Cawsaapa Oholah hne Oholibah kha bie na ripa'a yi ma? Cakhutaata duvsamakhie amaa chiyna kha pathyisa tie.

Tahematapakieca iema ca nungvaathingsuena kha tue yi te, ama kuv cungliena thiy a aw; ama kuvtuezuv hne khata nungvaathingsuena ama tue; cakhutaata ama kuvtuezuv zaw sa riypa khata kama cuota ama sapa saata zaw kha ama pihluo.
Ca hlyitaw taata hingpa hing kama'a lie ama tue kalie: i hmangpathepa kha papyapalyi yi te i sabbath kha ama para.
Ama saata zaw kha ama kuvtuezuv zaw cuo ca ta thie yi te, capa ning lie ngiethie ca ta i hmangpathepa chung luo kha papyapalyi riypata amaa ngie. Hingpa hingna i ing chunglie ama tuepa ta a cuo.
Luohlaapuv taata capaa tie amaa vaw riypata biephyatuv tie kha pathlie yi te ama paku sa nakawta iema ca amaa vaw. Iema cuo ca ta na nge a siy cate, na ming kha siyy a thuv cate suethiy ta naa pangi.
Thude phasapa lie kha a tu cate, a hmielie ca cabya kha patu yi te, capa cunglie ca i ziyhmyi hne i sathu kha na chi.

Malie naa te a ruepa cawsaazaapuv ueryi ca a cahriylie aa thyi, cawsaa cakhawpa tie hne khata ruocaapa taata amaa vawkhyipa a pariypa tie zaw kha aw yi te, canung tie kuv lie kha kukaw paku yi te, ama luv lie kha a puvthesapa byilakhuv ama pakhuv.
Cakhutaata kama ta, Ah, ama ca a siyhrawna tana a nungpuv tli, i ta, cuorasala iema ta capa nung hne cata thiysaa khingna kha ama tuehne.
Cawsaa pakha ta siyhrawnung'a luo aa ngiepa haa khata iema ta ama'a luo kha amaa ngie. Cahaacata iema ta siyhrawnung Oholah hne Oholibah tie'a luo kha amaa ngie.

Cuorasala aa dangpa bieripatuv ta iema ca nungvaathingsuena a tuepa hne thiyse a palangpa ama cuopa kha a pathyisa aa; tahematapakieca iema ca nungvaathingsuena a tuepa ta cuo yi te ama kuv chunglieta thiyse a aw.
Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Iema a du pata cawsaazaapuv kha pahmya ung la, iema ca ciyna hne a chuvtuv kuv luo kha pi tie ung.
Cawsaazaapuv ca ta alung ta vaa yi sala ama zueziy ta thie yi se; iema ca ta ama sacapaa tie hne ama sacanung tie kha thie yi sala ama ing kha myi ta rue yi se.
Cahaacata ruo chunglie siyhrawna kha pachuo sa'a angte, canung bangkhuo a raaringna hnyi'a yi te niema haa hingta siyhraw'a va yi.
Iema ta nama siyhrawna muo kha ca thung'a yi te, niema ta nungvaathingsuena nama tuena kawlie duotena kha nama ang aa; cakhutaata kama ca Abyipa Khazingi cuopa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy.
A kung cakyna kung, thla hraana, ning hraana lieta Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:
Cawsaapa, hingpa ning, hingpa ning hrahring hing a ming cape tie. Babilon siepahruo na hingpa ning lie hrahring hingta Jerusalem a cadung.

Cakhutaata rie thu a hmuopa chung hing pakhingpuona chang yi la, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri, ta pata chang tie yi: Bi kha myi cunglie khang tie, bi kha khang tie, a chung luo kha tiy chang tie;
saa ca-uo ciepa tie kha bi chung luo pasuo tie, a pha cepa savuo zaw bangkhuo kha, a baw hne a pale; a ruvbaw a phapa tie zaw kha a bina te ta pasuo tie.
Tuvrung chungtaata a pha cepa sakha kha la lah, bi rawlie ca thing kha tiy la, patlapuo la a ruvbaw ca pasu tie.

Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Thiyse a palangpa khypuv ca bawchie ciemuopa tana a cuo, ase ta a cepa bi, ase a kaw khu lipa bi! Saa kha suokha hnang suokha ta thue tie, suokha hmuo aa ngaa lina te ta.
Tahematapakieca a palangpa thiyse ca a chunglie kha aw te, alung cunglie a hrina lie kha a patle; alyi ta buvkhung'a kie ta pata alyi lie kha lyi vyi.
I hihaana kha a kya ie riypa hne phuv i la the riypa khata, ama ta a palangpa thiyse ca khaapa ta hmuo a buvkhung li riypata alung cunglie a hrina lie kha i chi tli.
Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Thiyse a palangpa khypuv ca bawchie ciemuopa tana a cuo! Kama na a lesa pata thing a papungsue'a ang.
Thing kha tiy'a angte, myi i patiy aa; saa kha a susa pata pasu'a angte, a ruvbaw zaw ca uv diy se.
Myi cunglie ca a hripa ta khang ung la, daa ca a lingtuv pata se diy'a te, aa bepuopa a pyapa bangkhuo kha kuo diy'a te ase kha chuo se.
A hrihripa lieta i thaa i pabuo; a chaasapa ase ca kaw khu vyi, myi ta hmuo pakaw khu vyi!
Cahaacata na siyhrawna hne na pyalyina taata ica pathe tiyta na pyalyina taa cata pathe khu vaciy; Na cunglie i hihaana i palungtlingna te a tlung hluo li, pathe pakhaa'a va tli ciy.

Abyipakama na a ri ang: A cuo ca aa vaw nguoluo, kama na a hrie'a ang. A cangkuo'a va ang, pangaa buo'a va ang, a ngiepachiy'a va ang. Na hringzya hne na tuepa haa tana bie ica ripa aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:
Cawsaapa, na mang ngie caa mang lipa kha sungkha ta ica lapa aa; cuorasala a muochiesa'a vaciy, caa'a vaciy, na mingthliy zaw lang'a vyi.
Aa hna ta a hna tie, khuosa ta caa khah; a thiypa kha muochie sa khah. Na pawde kha a paw la, na phyipakaw ca a pakaw tie; na chaluo hmyataw kha a pahruv khah, muochie sanapa sa zaw kha ning khah.
Caacuonakawta cawsaa zaw'a lie kha maw ta bie i ri, zuoluocaw ta i napuvnung a thiy. A mawluopa ta bie ina pipa haa khata i tue.
Cakhutaata cawsaa ta, “Hing haa hingta na tuepa hing khaapama a ri khingna ta a cuo tapa malie chang'a va ca ma?” ina ta yi.
Cakhutaata kama ta: Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:

Israel ming kha chang tie yi, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: A hruo nama tlekhyipa nama cahrana, nama mang khing hringhruopa, nama palung khingsapa i hmangpathepa kha i papyapalyi aa; cakhutaata hnangluo ta nama pangaa siypa nama sacapaa hne sacanung zaw kha zueziy ta ama thiy aa.
Kama i tuepa haa khata na tue aa; na chaluo hmyataw kha a pahruv khah, muochie sanapa sa zaw kha ning khah.
Na pawde kha a paw'a cate, na phyipakaw kha naa pakaw aa; muochie sa'a vaciy, caa'a vaciy, cuorasala na suena kawlieta zuele'a cate pakha hne pakha namaa hrungsue aa.
Cahaacata Ezekiel ca niema cuota pamangsana cuo'a te, niema ta ama a tuepa haa khata nama tue aa. Capa ca a vya tlung tiyta, kama ca Abyipa Khazingi cuopa kha nama pachang aa.
Cakhutaata, cawsaapa, kama ta ima cariekyikuo, ama palungtluona hne rungnaana, ama mang khingsapa hne ama palung khingsapa, hne ama sacapaa hne sacanung zaw kha i lapa tiy yi ta,
capa ning lieta hya a zangpa pakha ta nama'a luo kha a vaw'a te thuohlaa aca pathyi aa.
Capa ning lie ca na pakaa ca hya a zangpa'a lie ca a pahaw'a te, bie ri'a cate duo'a va tli ciy. Caacuonakawta nama ca iema cuota pamangsana ta cuo'a cate, iema ta Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:
Cawsaapa, Ammon ming'a luo kha a hyi la profetbiephu kha ri tie.

Ammon ming kyihuo khata, Abyipa Khazingbie hing naathlie tie ung: Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Tahematapakieca, i hmangpathepa kha papyapalyi pata a cuo tiyta, Israel ruo kha a duothlingpa ta tuepa a cuo tiyta, hne Judah ming kha sii ta sikhyipa ama cuo tiyta, nama ta, “A ning yi se!” na ta yi.
Caacuonakawta nama ca ningchiy cawsaa tie'a luo khana ica pi aa. Iema ta nama chunglie kha awna hmang a tue'a yi te thluodaa amaa tuv aa; nama thyipaa kha ning'a yi te nama cuehnung kha ama dang aa.
Kama ta Rabbah kha kala-uv tlena ta tue'a angte, Ammon kha tuvrung te ta i tue aa. Cakhutaata Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy.
Tahematapakieca Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Israel ruo cunglie kha na palung hriy aw te, na kuv cabe cate na phyi a chaw pata na palung a tluo,

caacuonakawta i kuv kha nama'a luo pazuo tli angte mingphang tie'a luo kha hruosue ta ica pi aa. Mingphang zaw taa khata ca thaw'a angte ruo ting zaw taa khata ica para aa; Kama na caa para'a ang. Cakhutaata Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy.
Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Tahematapakieca Moab ta, Judah ming ca mingphang hrangpa tie haa tana ama cuo thluo, a ta.
Caacuonakawta aa dungkhuonapa kha ruoriy lie a awpa khy, a ruo rungnaana ta a cuopa Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, hne Kiriathaim zaw taa khata i pahaw aa.
Capa khy tie ca Ammon hne khata ningchiy cawsaa tie kha i pi'a yi. Cahaacata Ammon ca mingphang zaw hrawlieta pachang pata cuo'a va tli.
Cakhutaata Moab cunglie kha bie i ripa aa. Cakhutaa cata, iema ta Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi.
Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Edom ta phuvlakhingna hneta Judah ming kha aa du nakaw yi ta,
Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri, Edom a du pata i kuv pazuo'a angte, cawsaa hne saruopa kha pahli'a yi angte a duothlingpa ta i tue aa; Teman taata Dedan te khata zueziy ta ama thiy aa.
I cawsaa Israel ming kuv ta Edom ca phuv la'a angte, i hihaana hne i pathiylingna haa khata Edom cunglie ca ama tue aa; cakhutaata iema ta i phuvlana kha ama pachang aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Filistin ta huena hneta phuv la te a para;
Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri, Filistin a du pata i kuv kha pazuo'a angte, Kereth ming ca pahli'a yi angte, cakhutaata aa ngaapa riyliy kie ruo tie kha i para'a yi.
Iema ca khuosa ta phuv la'a yi angte, i hihaasa pata duo i te'a yi. Iema kha duo i te tiy yi ta, Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi.
Kung hraa hlyikha kung, thla kha thlaa, ning khanapa lie, Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:
Cawsaapa, Tair ta Jerusalem hne aa patuv pata, “Ah! mingphang zaw thlake khana a thli tli; kama'a luo tana aa pahaw; Kama ca pabichiypa tana i cuo aa, ama ca paduothlingpa tana a cuo tli,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta, Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Mang tie, kama na caa du ang, Vya Tair! Riyliy ta tiylaw a pathupa haata, mingphang hluvpuv kha nama a du pata ama vya thu aa.
Iema ta Tair dungkhuo lungruetlepie kha para'a yi te, a ingsuo kha ama pacing aa. Aa bepuopa alyi kha khuepathla diy'a angte, aa lung selaw ta i pangaa aa.
Riyliy chunglie asue phuna hmang ta aa li aa. Kama na a ri ang, Abyipa Khazingta a ta. Ama ca mingphang zaw hruosue ta a li'a te,
a ruo chunglie a khypuv cawta tie ca zueziy ta thiepa ama cuo aa. Cakhutaata Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi.

Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Siepahruo tie siepahruo ta a cuopa Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar kha aa ruo zaw, aa ruole zaw, aruo rieka zaw, a lepa hne a cahrapa riekaphuv hne khata Tair a du riypa khata chaluo taata i zuvkhyi aa.
Na ruo chunglie na khypuv cawta tie ca zueziy ta a thie'a yi. Ama ta riekhuopiehu kha ca sakhuo'a te, cariekyikuo aca sasue aa, phya ca tlepie a chung ta aa vya chung aa.
Na khy dungkhuo lungruetlepie ca pacingnapa thingtung ta pacing'a yi te, na ingsuo kha ahryi ta ama hu aa.

Aa ruo zaw ca hluv hringhruo'a te, a buvcingkhuv ta nama kha aca buvkhung aa. A dungkhuo a cingpa khypuv luo a ngiepa haata na thlake luo aa ngie tiyta, aa ruo rieka tie, le tiekyphyi tie, hne aruole tie pu ta na khy dungkhuo lungruetlepie ca aa cahang aa.
Aa ruo caki ta na luopuv bangkhuo kha aa vya ciy paale diy aa. Na cawsaa zaw kha a zueziy ta thie'a yi te, a cusapa naa tung zaw kha alyi luona amaa liepatyi diy aa.

Na hnyirungpa bangkhuo kha ca chuv diy'a yi te, na chechiy bangkhuo kha aca lapa diy'a yi; na ing dungkhuo kha pacing'a yi te, na ing a pha daduo kha ama para aa. Naa lung zaw, na thing zaw, alyi zaw kha tiy chung luo ama thaw diy aa.
Na hlaa ueryi ca padie sa'a angte, na tingtuo ueryi ca thyi pata cuo'a va tli.
Nama ca alung haahaapa ta ca tue'a angte, asue phunapa tana na cuo aa. Nama ca sa pakhaa pata cuo buo'a va tli ciy, Abyipakama na a ri ang, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Abyipa Khazingta Tair kyihuo khata hing haa hingta a ri: Hmaa a phyapa tie a hrungna hne na chunglie a thiena aw te, nama naa lienapa pu khata riyliy kie ruo zaw ca a cahang'a va yi ma?

Cakhutaata riyliy siepahruo tie bangkhuo ca ama byithude taa khata ama cung aa; pangipa ama pang kha hle'a yi te ama buohryi pasiypa kha ama thlie aa. Thlaazang pata a cathangna caw kha a hryi'a yi te, alyi lie kha amaa tu aa; na cunglie a tlungpa kawlie khata amaa cathang lawmaw aa.

Cakhutaata iema ta nama kha ca caa'a yi te: Vya khypuv ming pathuopa, tuokhaatama riyliy taa hingta na vie? Ahluo ta ca nama hne na chunglie khy a sapa tie hneta, riyliy cunglie hing na za lesyi. Ahungma ciy aa chiypa ca na cawsaa zaw'a luo hruohra ta a vya pangie?
Nama naa liena ning lie ca riyliy kie ruo zaw ca amaa cathang; riyliy kie ruo zaw ca na rana kawlieta ama nang dyina a uo.
Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Nama kha ahunghmuo khy ama sa linapa khy, a duothlingpa khy ta ca tue angte, na cunglie riyliy kha patlung sa angte tiy ta aca buvkhung tiyta,

nama ca a hringpa tie ruo lie hing khysana acuolikie awna hmang na hnyi li nakawta Khue chung luo a cungpa hluo ning cawsaa tie'a lie kha ca nuopuole'a angte, samaliethie chuo ningta zaa ra tlipa, rawluo chuelyi Khue chung luo a sibungpa tie'a lie kha ica pa-aw sa aa.
Nama ca ciy aa chiysa pata ca pachuo sa'a angte, aw'a va tli ciy; aca huv zaw yi ta, hmung pakhaa pata cuo'a va tli ciy, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha a zuv te:
Cawsaapa, Tair kha caa tie,
Tair kyihuo khata, riyliy kie ruo hluvpuv tie lie sung a palipa tie riyliy luo a ngienapa lie a tupa, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Vya Tair, nama ta “Puvthena lie ca i tling,” naa ta.
Na ruoriy zaw ca riyliy aa thuv cena chunglie tana ama aw; nama caa sapa tie ta na puvthena kha ama patlingsa.
Senir taata a pyapa myisaa thing kha na thingphie bangkhuo huo khata hmuo yi te, Lebanon taata sidar thing kha na hmiechueluo huo ta ama la.
Bashan mathliy thing khata na tiypalaw mawnapa thing kha ama tue. Na tiypalaw ingle ca Saipras riyliy kie myisaa thing, ale nue ta ama pangipa ta ama tue.

Na palaw pangzu hne pangtaa ca a puvthesa pata kiykie zepa Izipt ruo taata cawthang ta tuepa ta ama cuo; na tiypalaw thlungkhuv ca Elishah riyliy kie tie taata a vawpa a dungpa hne a ciycaapa cawthang ta ama tue.
Na tiypalaw a zipa tie ca Sidon hne Arvad lie khy a sapa tie khata cuo yi te, na tiypalaw a mawpa tie ca, niema hrawlie a awpa, a thesapa Zemer ming khata ama cuo.

Gebal uvthyi tie hne kuvzung a thepa tie ca niema hrawlie kha aw yi te, palaw kha aca parepa yi. Riyliy chunglie a awpa tiypalaw bangkhuo ca a huotuv tie hne khata niema hrawlie aw yi te, na chechiy caa zaapatuv ta ama cuo.
Rieka riephapa tie, Paras ming hne Lud ming hne Put ming kha na rieka chunglie ama aw. Na chunglie kha phya hne thaalakhuv kha pathlie yi te, ling-awna aca pi yi.

Arvad hne Helekh cawsaa tie ta na khy dungkhuo cunglie kha a chi aa dung pata ca huopa yi te, Gamad cawsaa tie ta na ingsuo cunglie kha ama huo. Na tlepie cunglie kha ama liy ca aa tieky pata buo diy yi te, na puvthena kha ama patling sa.
Na hnyirung hringhruo nakawta Tarshish ta nama hne sungpalina a tue; ngu, thaariy, cuophiy, hne kawthuv kha ca pi te na hnyirungpa chechiy zaw kha aca thle.
Javan, Tubal, hne Meshek zaw nama hneta sungpalina tue ra yi te, cawsaa hne daa bi kha ca pi yi te na hnyirungpa chechiy zaw kha aca thle yi.
Beth-togarmah ta aruo, rietuvnapa aruo, hne laa khata na hnyirungpa chechiy zaw ca aca thle.
Rhod ming zaw ta nama hneta sungpalina ama tue; riyliy kie ruo hluvpuv tie ca sung na pali hnepa tie ta ama cuo; iema ta ale nue hne eboni thing kha na hmung riypa cuo khata aca pi yi.

Na hnyirungsa nakawta Edom zaw nama hneta sungpalina a tue; lungvaa hringpa, a ciycaapa cawthang, kiykie zepa cawthang, palaa phapa ta taapa cawthang, koral lungvaa, hne lungvaa sepa kha na hnyirungpa chechiy cuota aca pi yi.
Judah hne Israel ruo zaw ta nama hne sungpalina ama tue; iema ta na hnyirungpa chechiy cuo khata Minnith taata Jungsacuo, sahang, khyitiy, chiytiy hne thing cathliy tapa tie kha aca pi yi.
Na hnyirungsa nakawta Damaskas ca nama hneta sungpalina a tue; Helbon mingsuvtiy, hne tuvhming zaw kha aca pi.
Uzal taata Vedan hne Javan kha nama hne sungpalina vya tue yi te na zaapa chechiy cuo khata thaariy, kassia thing hne pasuv kha aca pi yi.
Dedan ta aruo kedie lie padie riypa cawthang cahruopa kha aca zaa.
Arabia hne Kedar siepahruo tie bangkhuo ca sungpalina lie na tlechuopa tie ta cuo yi te, na hnyipa chechiy calyina riypata tuvtaata, tuvtungpa, mietungpa hne mie ca pi yi te, sungpalina nama tue.

Sheba hne Raamah taata chadaw tie zaw nama hneta sungpalina nama tue; na hnyirungpa chechiy cuo khata rangpa-ue phangting hrawlieta a pha cepa rangpa-ue tie, alung muosung bangkhuo, hne siy kha aca pi yi.
Haran, Kanneh, Eden, Sheba, Asshur, hne Khilmad chadaw tie kha nama hneta sungpalina ama tue.

Iema ta cawsie pha cepa tie, a dungpa cawthang, hne kiykie zepa cawthang, hmingciy phangphang a hnyipa pangphaa, a cusa pata ama camaapa khuhriy tapa zaw kha vya phya yi te nama hneta sung namaa pali.
Na sungpalina cuota Tarshish tiypalaw tie ca hmang a phyatuv ta ama cuo. Caacuonakawta riyliy cunglieta na tiypalaw tie ca a bina te ta hmang phya yi te ama hmang aa riysa.
Na palaw a zipa tie ta riyliy cunglie aca sikhyi yi. Ningchiy thliy ta nama kha riyliy chunglie aca para.

Na hnyirungpa, na zaapa hmang hne chechiy, na calyipa hmang hne chechiy, na tiypalaw a huotuv tie hne na tiypalaw mawtuv tie, tiypalaw a parepa tie, sung a palipa tie, niema hne a awpa rieka tie, hne niema'a lie a awpa bangkhuo ca nama na ranapa ning lie kha nama hneta riyliy chung luo ama tla ra diy.
Na palaw mawtuv tie khina pu khata, a cahriy khyta bangkhuo ca aa cahang.
Tiypalaw a zipa bangkhuo ca palaw cung taata ama cung. Tiypalaw a huopa tie hne a mawpa tie bangkhuo ca ngiekuo lieta a daa yi te,
khuopuv ta khi yi te, nama kha aca caa yi.
Nama kawlie khata ama luv a pamyi yi te, buri kha amaa khuv, ngiechisa pata nama kha ca caa yi te, palung kyityalya khata ama caa.
Nama kha aca caa yi, a ngiy yi te, muochie aca sa yi: “Ahungma Tair haa hingta riyliy chunglieta para pata a cuo buo?
Na zaapa chechiy kha riyliy chungtaata aa vaw tiyta, cawsaa hluvpuv palung na patluo; Na hnyirungna a hluv hringhruopa hne na zaapa chechiy ta alyi siepahruo tie kha na pahnyirung sa yi.
Ata ca aa thuvpa tiy chungliena riyliy ta aca para. Na chechiy bangkhuo hne na cawsaa phuv bangkhuo ca nama hne tana tiy chungluo ama tla tli.
Riyliy kie ruo lie khy a sapa tie bangkhuo ca nama kawlie kha ciy yi te ama nang a uo. Ama siepahruo tie ca ama ciy hringhruo, ama hmiephya hetahmuo pha vyi.
Mingphang zaw hrawlie kha chadaw tie ta na kawchie ca ri paruvle yi te, nama ca ciy aa chiysa pata na na chuo, chuozaa ta vya aw pakhaa'a va tli ciy.”
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:

Cawsaapa, Tair byi tie kha chang tie yi, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Ahruo tle cate, “Kama ca khazing tana i cuo; khazing tie a tuna lie, riyliy chunglie khana i tu,” na ta. Cawsaapa ta cuo cate, khazing na cuo li raalaa pata, na pathiypalung lieta khazing hneta naa pakhing.
Daniel laa tana na sing vie hmisi de; nama'a taata nupa bieparuv aw vyi.
Na singna hne na pachangna thueta, na cuota suethiy a hluvsa naa pacung, na sue-ing lie siy hne ngu kha naa pacung.
Sungpalina lie na singna thueta hnyirung hryly cate, na hnyirungna cunglie kha a hruo na tle.
Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Na pathiypalung lie khazing hneta naa pakhing nakawta,

na cunglie kha mingphang tie hrawlie ciy aa chiypa mingphang, mingphang hrang tie kha ca vya pathliesue'a angte, na singna a puvthena kha zueziy ta ama sapachung aa, na linghlaa-awna kha ama papyapalyi aa.
Nama kha Khue chung luo ca nuopathla'a yi te, riyliy chunglie kha saathiy ta na thiy aa.
Nama ca thiepa tie awna lie kha “Khazing tana i cuo,” na ta kalie'a ma? Nama caa thiepa tie kuv chunglie ca khazing cuo vaciy, cuorasala cawsaa tana na cuo thluo.
Ruohrang ming kuv kha tana vangdaw a te lipa tie thiypa haata na thiy aa; tahematapakieca Abyipa Khazingkama na a ri ang.
Ca hlyitaw taata Abyipa bie ca kama'a luo aa zuv:
Cawsaapa, Tair siepahruo kha muochie sa la, chang tie, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Nama ca tlingna luo ta a mangpuo riypata na za cuo, singna ta bi cate puvthena lie na tling.

Nama ca Khazing diedung, Eden liena na za aw; alung muosung bangkhuo ta aca pangi, karnelian, khrisolait, hne daimon, beril lungvaa, oniks lungvaa, jasper lungvaa, safaiar lungvaa, lungvaa hringpa, emerald lungvaa; siy ta tuepa na pachiy hne naa panginapa suethiy zaw hing nama aca sa ning yi ta aca sapapa yi tana a cuo.
Nama ca sathu pathuvpa mangchiytuv cherub hne tana ica chi, tahematapakieca kama na caa tlaw pa-i ang. Nama ca Khazing tluo pathepa lie kha za aw cate, myi alung cunglie kha na za cakuo.
Na puv baataata na pha lina aa luona cuo te khata na hringzya lie syisaa riypa za aw vyi.

Na sungpalina a le hringhruopa chunglie kha, a pha lipa hmang a hluvsa tue cate na sue; Khazing tluocung taa khata duv aa chiypa hmang haata ica thaw, cakhutaata myi alung zaw hraw taa khata mangchiytuv cherub ta aca thaw.
Na puvthe nakawta ahruo tle cate, na linghlaa-awna cuo khata na singna kha na para. Alyi luo kha ca thaw angte, ama ming lunghruo na tlung riypata siepahruo hmiekunglie kha ica phusaa.

Aa dang lipa sungpalina ta na suena ca hluvsa te, na hmangpathepa kha na papya na palyi. Caacuonakawta na chunglie kha myi patiy'a angte, nama kha aca kuo aa, caa mangpa tie zaw bangkhuo hmungna lie kha alyi cunglie buvcuo khata ica pali aa.
Cawsaa zaw hrawlie nama caa pachangpa tie khata aca ciysa hringhruo'a yi; ciy aa chiysapa a chuona luo pangie'a cate, khatiy tahmuo vya aw pakhaa buo'a va tli ciy.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo aa zuv:
Cawsaapa, Sidon luo kha a hyi la, profet bie kha ri tie,

cakhutaata, AbyipaKhazingna hing haa hingta a ri, ta tie. Vya Sidon, kama na caa du ang, nama chunglie kha rungnaana i hmung aa. Kama ta bie i ripa tiyta hne i pathena kha i paluosa tiyta, Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi.

Tahematapakieca kama ta a chung luo kha puvtlung pasana patlung sa'a angte, a luopuv zaw lie kha thiyse a lang aa; a chunglie kha a thiypa laa'a yi te, a kuo ting lie kha zueziy ta aa du'a yi. Cakhutaata Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi.
Israel ming ta iema a esepa ama ingpaa bangkhuo hrawlie kha ahling cahrienapa hne ahling chungnapa kha ang buo'a va tli yi. Cakhutaata Abyipa Khazingi cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi.

Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Israel ming kha amaa chepatlaanapa mingphang zaw hraw taata i pakiy tiy yi ta hne mingphang zaw hmungna lieta iema hrawlie i pathena i paluosa tiyta, i changtaapa Jacob i pipa iema alyi lie kha khy ama sa aa.

Capa lie ca aa bangsa pata aw'a yi te, ing a sa'a yi te mingsuv diedung amaa tue aa. Iema a esepa yi ama ingpaa bangkhuo cunglie bieripana i hnyi thue yi ta, aa bangsa pata ama aw aa. Cakhutaata Abyipaiema Khazing i cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi.
Kung hraana, thla hraa thlaa, ning hraa hlyihning ning ta Abyipabie ca kama'a luo aa zuv:
Cawsaapa, Izipt siepahruo Faro'a luo kha a hyi la, profetbiephu kha ri tie;

Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri, ta la ri tie. A cavaa chunglieta aa valepa riyhre lesapa, Izipt siepahruo Faro, Kama na caa du ang. “Nail cavaa ca kama huopa tana a cuo, kamata tah i tuepa tana a cuo,” na ta.
Na hrakuo ruv lie kha kyipa ta ca siy'a angte, na cavaa lieta a awpa ngaa zaw kha na phuvhling lie i pabe aa. Na cavaa taa khata na phuvhling lie ngaa aa bepa khata icaa dapathla aa.

Na cavaa chunglie ngaa bangkhuo hne khata ruocaapa luo kha ica thaw'a yi. Ruo chunglie kha va tla'a ung cate, ca pahmya'a va yi, ca paby'a va yi. Alyi lie saruopa tie sa hne thliy lie a zupa pavaa zaw sa ta ica tue'a yi.
Cakhutaata Izipt lie khy a sapa bangkhuo ta Kama ca Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi. Tahematapakieca nama ca Israel ming cuota phiepahlaa khuecahryi tana na cuo.
Ama kuv ta aca patuv tiy yi ta tli cate, ama letung kha na uo yi. Acaa hnie tiy yi ta tli cate, na zawpakhi yi.
Caacuonakawta, Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Zueziy kha niema cung luo vya patlung sa'a angte, cawsaa hne saruopa kha ica thie diy'a yi.

Izipt ruo ca a duothlingpa hne khy sa linapa hmang ta i tue aa. Cakhutaata iema ta Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi. Tahematapakieca nama ta, “Nail ca kama huopa ta cuo te, kama na a tue ang,” na ta.
Caacuonakawta kama ta icaa du, na cavaa zaw kha i du, cakhutaata Izipt ruo kha, Migdol taata Syene te, Ethiopia ruoriy te yalya khata a duothlingpa khy sa lina ruo ta i tue aa.
Cawsaa phyi ta tlaw li'a pata, saruopa phyi zaw ta tlaw ra'a vyi, kung sawliy chung khy sa li pata a cuo aa.

Izipt ruo ca a duothlingpa ruo zaw hrawlie a duothlingpa ta i tue aa; cahaacata khypuv zaw hrawlie kha a khypuv zaw ca kung sawliy chung a duothlingpa ta i tue'a yi. Izipt ming ca mingphang ting luo chepatlaa'a yi angte, ruo ting luo kha amaa ze diy aa.
Ca hlyitaw taata, Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Kung sawliy a chuona lieta Izipt ming kha amaa chepatlaanapa mingphang tie'a taata i pakiy'a yi;
Izipt ca vuophana i pi pakhaa aa, iema ruo ta a cuopa Pathros ruo luo kha i vya chiy pakhaa'a yi; capa lie ca a thaa cawsapa pena ta ama cuo aa.
Pena zaw hrawlie aa ne cepa pena ta cuo'a te, mingphang zaw hrawlie kha a pale nguo buo'a va tli; mingphang zaw kha ama uv pakhaa buo li tli riypata a cawsa pata i tue'a yi.
Izipt ming ca Israel ming a buchuo riypata cuo pakhaa buo'a va yi; iema'a luo kha byana amaa hie tiyta, ama pha lina kha amaa thyi pakhaa aa. Cakhutaata Abyipa Khazingi cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi.
Kung kiy kung sariy kung, thla khana, ning khana lie kha Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:

Cawsaapa, Babilon siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar na Tair a du riypata a rieka tie kha rietuv a pacuv nguoluo yi; rieka mekaa ca ama luv tlaw diy tli te ama letung zaw a kaw diy tli; cuorasala capa cuota a pachuopa pakaana riypata ama cuose, a rieka tie cuo yi se, Tair taata ama hmungpa khaapahmuo aw vyi.

Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Izipt ruo ca Babilon siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar na i pi aa; a hnyirungpa kha sikhyi diy'a te, hrue diy'a te a para diy aa, capa ca a rieka tie rehrie muo ta a cuo aa.
Kama ta a thavie muo ta Izipt ca i pi tli, tahematapakieca iema ca kama cuo tana ama hrie, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Capa cuo lie ca Israel ming kiy kha papu sa'a angte, iema hrawlie kha bie ri khuna cuo ica pi aa. Cakhutaata Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha a zuv te:
Cawsaapa, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri ta la profetbiephu kha ri tie. Ah! “Bawchiena ning!”
Capa ning ca aa ngie tli, Abyipaning ca aa ngie tli; capa ning ca amyi zingna ning, mingphang zaw cuota duotena ning tana a cuo.

Izipt cunglieta zueziy tlung'a te, Ethiopia cunglieta ruvna lepuv a tlung aa. Thiepa tie kha Izipt ruo chunglie ca amaa lie aa, a hnyipa zaw kha sikhyi diy'a yi te, a hruopatu zaw kha ama pacing diy aa.
Ethiopia, Put, Lud, Arabia bangkhuo hne Libia hne aa daa pakhawpa mingphang tie ruo ca iema hneta zueziy ta ama thiy diy aa.
Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Izipt a byapa ca amaa lie aa, Izipt hruotlena zaw a tlabung aa. Migdol taata Syene te khata iema ca zueziy ta ama thiy aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
A duothlingpa ruo zaw hrawlie kha duothling ra'a yi te, a khyruepa zaw hrawlie kha a rue ra aa.
Izipt kha myi ta i rue thueta hne ama a byapa tie kha ama tli diy tiyta, Abyipai cuopa kha iema ta ina pachang'a yi.

Capa ning lie ca, khaapahmuo siysaa ri li pata a awpa Ethiopia ming kha paciy sa riypata biephyatuv tie kha kama'a taata tiypalaw ta pya'a yi te, Izipt duotena ning lie kha ama cunglieta ruvnaana lepuv a tlung ra aa; capa cuo ca aa vaw nguoluo tli!
Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Babilon siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar kuv tana Izipt ming ca i pachuo sa'a yi.
Ama hne ama'a lie a awpa, ciy aa chiy cepa mingphang zaw ta ruo kha ama para aa.

Cavaa zaw kha paky diy'a angte, ruo kha hmang pha lipa a tuepa tie'a luo i zaa aa. Ruo hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo cunglie kha ruohrang ming kuv ta duothlingna i patlung sa aa; Abyipakama na a ri ang.

Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Kuvtuezuv zaw kha i para aa, Memfis lieta kuv ta tuechawpa zuv kha i para diy aa. Izipt ruo lieta siepahruo pya pakhaa'a va tli, Izipt ruo lie kha ciyna na i chi aa.
Pathros kha a duothlingpa ta tue'a angte, Zoan kha myi ta i rue aa, Thebes cunglie kha bieripana i hnyi aa.
Izipt cariekyikuo ta a cuopa Pelusium cunglie kha i hihaana bya'a angte, Thebes kha i thaw aa.
Izipt kha myi ta rue'a angte, Pelusium ca pasana khuosa ta a ang aa; Memfis ca ningchung ta carie a taw'a te, Thebes ca pahli pata a cuo aa.
On hne Pi-beseth mingnu tie ca zueziy ta thiy'a yi te, khypuv zaw kha sii ta sikhyi pata ama cuo aa.
Izipt uvna i chipachung ning kha Tehafnehes kha khy zing'a te, a hruotlena ca a chuo aa; khypuv ca amyi ta buv'a te, a khyta zaw ca siicuona luo sikhyi pata ama cuo aa.
Cahaacata Izipt ca a bie i ripa aa. Cakhutaata Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi.
Kung hraa hlyikha kung, thla khana, ning sariy ning ta Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:
Cawsaapa, Izipt siepahruo Faro kuv ca i thli tli; zueziy patuvna te ta a cahra pakhaa riypata mangsang pata siyy catawpuo'a va yi.

Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Izipt siepahruo Faro ca a du angte, a kuv kha a suohning ta, a phana luo hne a tlina luo hneta thli'a angte a kuv taata zueziy a tla riypa khata i tue aa.
Izipt ming ca mingphang zaw hraw luo kha chepatlaa diy'a yi angte, ruo ting khata i ze'a yi.

Babilon siepahruo kuv kha cahra sa'a angte, i zueziy ca a kuv lieta i chi aa; cuorasala Faro kuv ca thli'a angte, hmaa phya te a thiy'a nangpa aa hrungpa haa khata Babilon siepahruo hmielie ca aa hrung aa.

Babilon siepahruo kuv ca cahra sa'a angte, cuorasala Faro kuv ca a naa aa. Babilon siepahruo kuv luo kha i zueziy i pi tiyta iema ta Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi. Izipt ruo a du riypata a zueziy kha aa da aa.
Cakhutaata Izipt ming ca mingphang zaw hraw luo kha chepatlaa'a yi angte, ruo ting khata i cadaa diy'a yi. Cakhutaata Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi.
Kung hraa hlyikha kung, thla thungna, ning khana lieta Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:
Cawsaapa, Izipt siepahruo Faro hne a cawsaa tie kha chang tie yi: Na lesyina hing ahung haa tama na cuo?
Lebanon sidar ta a cuopa Assiria kha pacuo tie, a puvthesapa a ce ta atuv thing hrangpa tie kha law diy yi te, a daw amyi a dena te ta aa suopa thingkung ta a cuo.
Tiy a phasa pata hmung te, alyi raw aa thuvna lie'apa tiy ta a kung kha a pasuo sa, a punapa cahriylie kha cavaa ca lang yi te, ruo chunglie thingkung bangkhuo luo te khata cavaa ca a lang.
Caacuonakawta ruo chunglie thingkung bangkhuo laata aa suo vie; tiy a rungsa nakawta, a nge rungsa te a ce a syisa.
A nge lie kha pavaa bangkhuo ta ama buv a tue yi te, a ce rawlie kha ruo chunglie saruopa bangkhuo ta ama taata ama pachuo; A ningdiy lie ca mingphang lepa bangkhuo ama aw.
A thariy kha tiy rungsana luo thla te, a ce zaw a syisa nakawta, a lesyipa hne a puvthepa thingkung ta a cuo.

Khazing diedung chunglie sidar kung tie ta hmuo ama ca a zue khu va yi, myisaa kung zaw ta a nge kha a khing khu ra vyi; a ce ca ase ruo thingkung tie hneta zaw pakhingpuo riypata cuo vyi; Khazing diedung chunglie a awpa tuokhaapa thingkung ta hmuo a puvthena ca a khing khu va yi.
Kama ta capa thingkung ca a ce parung sa angte i papuvthe sa, Khazing diedung chunglie a awpa, Eden diedung lie thingkung bangkhuo ta ama kha ama hietlie.
Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Ama ca a suo hringhruo te, a daw kha amyi a de nakawta a hruo a tle hringhruo.
Caacuonakawta mingphang tie siepahruo kuv luo kha pi angte, ama ta a pha lina hne aa phuv pata a tue aa. Kama ta i thaw tli.

Ciy aa chiy cepa ruohrang ming ta ama kha hu yi te ama thuse tli. Tluo cunglie hne bawphie bangkhuo lie kha a ce ca laa patlaw te ruo chung cavaa kie ting khata a nge ca amaa pungle; cakhutaata alyi cung cawsaa bangkhuo ca a ningdiy taa khata pya yi te ama kha ama thuse.
Pavaa bangkhuo ca a tlipa thingkung cunglie kha a cang yi te, saruopa bangkhuo ta a nge zaw hrawlie kha ama aw.

Caacuonakawta tiy kielie a pupa tuokhaapa thingkung hmuota aa suosa pata a daw kha amyi de'a va tli, a thariy ta tiy a lapa tuokhaapa thingkung hmuota iema tluv cata a suo'a va tli. Tahematapakieca sidar kung bangkhuo ca cawsaapa bangkhuo hne khata alyi raw, thiyna luo pi pata cuo yi te, iema hne ca tana Khue chung luo ama tlabung aa.

Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Capa sidar kung ca Sheol luo a sibung tiyta riyliy ta pahruv'a angte i khaakhung aa; a cavaa zaw kha tiy palang sa li'apa angta a hluvsapa tiy zaw kha i paky sa aa. Lebanon ca duotena ta pahlaw'a angte, ama kawlie khata ruo chunglie thingkung bangkhuo ca amaa uv diy aa.

Khue chungluo a tlabungpa tie hne khata Sheol luo i thaw thueta ca ama aa lienapa pu khata mingphang zaw kha aling a siy ta i pasiy sa'a yi. Cahaacata tiy a phasa pata a hmungpa, Lebanon lieta khing cepa hne a pha cepa Eden lie thingkung bangkhuo ca alyi rawlie ca hnaa panguo pata a ma cuo aa.
Iema zaw ca ama hne a daa pakhawpa tie, a ningdiy rawlie mingphang zaw hrawlie a awpa tie hne cata Sheol luo kha ama sibung aa.

Eden thingkung zaw hrawlieta khaapa kha ma nama haata rungnaa te a lesyi? Nama ca Eden thingkung zaw hne kha tana chuelyi raw luo pacung pata na cuo aa; zueziy ta thiepa vangdaw te lipa tie hrawlie khana na laa aa. Hingpa hing Faro hne a cawsaa phuv tie kha tana ama cuo, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Kung hraa hlyihning kung, thla hraa hlyihning thlaa, ning khana lieta Abyipabie kha kama'a luo aa zuv:

Cawsaapa, Izipt siepahruo Faro kha hing haa hingta muochiesa tie: Mingphang zaw hrawlieta nama hne nama kha chingde ta a ri cate, cuorasala nama ca riyliy lieta riyhre haa tana na cuo; cavaa kha na phyi ta khuosa ta tuv cate, tiy kha na pahnang sa.
Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Cawsaa a hluvsa a hmyana lie kha asue ta ca vaa'a angte ica pa-uo aa.
Alyi lie kha ca thaw'a angte, alyi tlawpa lie kha ica vaana aa. Avuo lie pavaa zaw kha na cunglie pacang sa'a angte, alyi lie a awpa ruosaa tie ta na saa kha aca ce'a yi.
Na saa ca tluo cunglie kha ze'a angte, a thuvpa na riyy ta bawphie zaw kha i pabi'a yi.
A langpa na thiy ta ruo kha tluo cung te ta paci'a angte, cavaa zaw ca na thiy ta a bi aa.
Na myi kha i pache tiyta, avuo kha buvkhung'a angte, a aasiy zaw ca ama zing aa; ning kha amyi ta buvkhung'a angte, thlaapa kha vaa'a vyi.
Na cungluo avuo lieta khena bangkhuo kha pazing'a angte, na ruo lieta zingna a tlung aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Na pachang lipa ruo chung luo mingphang zaw hraw luo kha sii ta ca sikhyi'a yi angte, cawsaa hluvpuv kha ama palung rie i pathyi'a yi.

Cawsaa hluvpuv kha na cunglie ama nang-uo'a te ama ciysa aa, nama kawlie ca ta ama siepahruo tie zaw khuosa ta amaa cathang aa. I zueziy kha iema hmiekunglie i pahie tiyta, ama thlaa zang'a te amaa cathang aa. Nama naa liena ning lie kha ama hringna cuo cyicuo khata ama thlaa zang pata amaa cathang aa.
Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Babilon siepahruo zueziy ca nama a du riypata aa vaw aa.
Mingphang zaw hrawlieta ciy aa chiy cepa, a thaaruvpa tie zueziy khata na cawsaa phuv kha i thie'a yi. Iema ta Izipt hruotlena kha para'a yi te, a cawsaa phuv ca ama thiy diy aa.
A sahring bangkhuo kha cavaa kielieta i thie diy'a yi; capa hmang zaw ca cawsaa phyi ta tlaw'a va tli, sahring phyi zaw ta tlaw'a va tli.
Cakhutaata kama ta ama tiy kha pasing sa'a angte, ama cavaa ca chiytiy haa khata i palang sa aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Izipt kha a duothlingpa ta i tue tiyta hne, a chunglie a bipa zaw bangkhuo kha pahli diy yi angte i tuvsa diy tiy yi ta iema ta Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi.

Hingpa hing muochiesanapa hlaa ta cuo te, canyi pata sa riypa a cuo aa; mingphang tie canung zaw khata canyi pata sa riypa a cuo aa. Izipt hne a cawsaa phuv tie cunglie kha canyi pata sa riypa a cuo aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Kung hraa hlyihning kung, thla khana, ning hraa hlyipangaa lieta Abyipabie kha kama'a luo a zuv te:
Cawsaapa, Izipt hne a cawsaa phuv tie kha caa tie yi, cakhutaata Izipt hne ruo lesyipa taata sacanung tie kha Khue chung luo a tlabungpa tie hne khata chuelyi raw luo kha paphya tie yi.
“Nama ca malie laata na puvthe vie ma? Sibung tie! Vangdaw te lipa tie hne aw riypa khata!”
Iema ca zueziy ta thiepa tie hne khata ama thiy aa. Izipt ca zueziy'a luo pi pata a cuo tli; ama hne a cawsaa phuv tie hne khata luohlaa luo kha a dale tie ung.
Sheol chungtaata a cahra cepa riebyi tie khata Izipt hne a byatuv tie kha: “Ama sibung tli, vangdaw te lipa tie ca amaa lie thluo, zueziy na a thie yi,” ama ta aa.
Assiria hne a cawsaa phuv bangkhuo ca capa lie ca ama aw ra, ama ta zueziy ta a thiepa tie thluo khata ama ca a cadung.

Iema thluo ca Khue chunglie aa thuv cena hmang lie khata a aw. A phuv tie, a hringpa tie hrawlieta ciy aa chiysapa hmang zaa tuepa tie, zueziy ta za thie yi te a thiypa tie thluo bangkhuo khata ama thluo kha ama cadung.

Capa lie ca Elam zaw kha a aw ra, zueziy ta za thie yi te a thiypa a cawsaa phuv tie thluo khata a cadung. Iema ca a hringpa tie hrawlieta ciy aa chiysapa hmang zaa tuepa tie, vangdaw te lipa, chuelyi raw luo a sibungpa tie khata ama cuo. Iema ca ama nangzaana kha Khue chung luo a sibungpa tie hne khata ama ang ra.

Elam ca a cawsaa phuv, za thiepa tie hrawlie kha thluo ama tuepa, zueziy ta za thiepa vangdaw te lipa tie thluo khata ama cadung; tahematapakieca a hringpa tie hrawlieta ciy aa chiysapa hmang zaa tuepa tie ca iema nangzaana kha Khue chung luo a sibungpa tie hne khata ama ang pakhaw; iema ca thiepa tie hrawlie kha chi pata ama cuo.

Meshek hne Tubal zaw ama cawsaa phuv tie bangkhuo hne khata capa lie ca aw ra yi te, zueziy ta za thiepa vangdaw te lipa tie thluo khata ama cadung; tahematapakieca a hringpa tie hrawlieta ciy aa chiysapa hmang zaa tuepa tie tana ama za cuo.

Iema ca hluo ningta zaa thiy tlipa rieka tie, ama carie cehre hneta Sheol luo a sibung tlipa tie, ama luv rawlie ama zueziy pahlaapa tie, ama ruv cunglie ama phya chipa tie hne khata laa pakhaw va yi; tahematapakieca a hringpa tie hrawlie ciy aa chiysapa hmang zaa tuepa tie tana ama za cuo.
Caacuonakawta nama zaw thlipachung pata cuo'a cate, zueziy ta za thiepa vangdaw te lipa tie hrawlie khana na laa ra aa.

Capa lie ca Edom zaw kha a siepahruo tie hne aa byi tie zaw hne khata ama aw ra, iema ca a riephapa ama za cuo raalaa pata vangdaw a te lipa zueziy ta thiepa tie, Khue chung luo a sibungpa tie hne khata ama laa pakhaw.

Capa lie ca chaluo taata byi tie hne Sidon ming bangkhuo zaw kha ama aw ra, iema ca ama cahrana ta ciy aa chiysapa ama patlung sapa kawlie khata nangzaasa pata thiepa tie hne khata ama sibung; vangdaw te lipa zueziy ta thiepa tie hne khata laa pakhaw yi te, Khue chung luo a sibungpa tie hne khata iema nangzaana kha ama ang.
Faro hne a rieka tie ta iema kha a hmung tiy yi ta, zueziy ta ama za thiepa a cawsaa phuv tie cuo khata hnaa amaa panguo aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.

Tahematapakieca ama ca a hringpa tie ruo lie kha ciy aa chiysapa zaa tuepa tana a cuo; caacuonakawta ama ca vangdaw te lipa, zueziy ta za thiepa tie hrawlie kha pahlaa pata a cuo aa, Faro hne a cawsaazaapuv bangkhuo ca; Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Abyipabie kha kama'a luo aa zuv:

Vya Cawsaapa, na cawsaa zaw'a lie kha bie ri la chang tie yi, ruo ruo kha cunglie kha zueziy patlungsue biephung yi ang sala, cakhutaata ruo chunglie cawsaa tie khata iema chungtaata pakha kha iema rievetuv ta a la yi sala;
cakhutaata rievetuv ca ta ruo chung luo zueziy a vya tlungpa kha hmung te hmyakaa kha tung sala,
cadyiseca hmyakaa pu a thyipa mekaa khata a raaring lipa yi ta, zueziy ca vya tlung te a thie diy kie yi ca, iema ama thiy ca iema luv cungliena a tlung aa.
Iema ta hmyakaa pu kha ama thyi raalaa pata a raaring va yi, iema thiyse ca iema cungliena a tlung aa. Iema kha zaa raaring yi sala ca iema hringna kha amaa zaa khuo khu thluo aa.

Cuorasala rievetuv ta zueziy aa vawpa kha a hmung thluo pata hmyakaa tung li pata a raaringna a pi li nakaw yi ta zueziy ta pakha lalaa kha a thie kieca, ama pha lina chunglie thiepa ama cuo raalaa pata, ama thiyse muo ca rievetuv'a lie hie pata a cuo aa.
Caacuonakawta, cawsaapa, nama ca Israel ming rievetuv tana ica chi tli; i pakaa taata bie na thyi kyry ta, iema kha a raaringna na pi'a yi.

Kama ta a pha lipa cawsaa kha, “Vya cawsaa pha lipa, na thiy hrahring aa,” ta biephung ang sala, a pha lipa cawsaa tie kha ama hringzya taata amaa vya thle riypata a raaringna na pi li kie yi ca, a pha lipa tie ca ama pha lina chunglie kha ama thiy aa, cuorasala ama thiyse muo ca nama kuv lie khana ica hie aa.

Cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa tie kha ama hringzya taata amaa vya thle riypata a raaringna pi yi cate, ama hringzya kha amaa thle li kieca, a pha lipa tie ca ama pha lina chunglie kha ama thiy aa, cuorasala nama ca na hringna kha naa khuo pata a cuo.
Cawsaapa, Israel ming kha chang tie yi: Niema ta, “Kiema ca ma tuesuena hne ma suena ta malie vy te, iema kawlieta ma thaa a chuo tli nakawta tuokhaatama ma hring khu aa?” nama ta, ta tie yi.

Iema kha, Abyipa Khazingta, Kama i hringpa haata, cawsaa pha lipa tie ama thiyna kawlie kha i palung tluo vyi, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa tie ta ama hringzya a thle yi te ama hringna lie khana i palung a tluo; vya kaa tie ung, nama hringzya pha lipa taa khata vya kaa tie ung; Vya Israel ming, khaapanakawma nama thiy aa?

Cakhutaata, cawsaapa, na cawsaa zaw kha chang tie yi, Aa dangpa tie ama sue tiyta amaa dangna ta iema kha khuo khu'a va yi; cakhutaata a pha lipa tie ama pha lina taata ama vya kaa tiyta ama pha lina kha amaa pachiyna cuo ra vyi. Aa dangpa tie ca ama sue tiyta amaa dangna ta hringna pi khu'a va yi.

Aa dangpa tie kha nama hring hrahring aa i ta raalaa pa yi ta iema ta amaa dangna kha a ringchuo yi te pha lina ama tue kieca adangna ama tuepa kha suokha hmuo a thyipa pata cuo'a va yi; cuorasala ama tuepa pha lina chunglie khana ama thiy aa.
Cakhutaata cawsaa pha lipa tie kha, “Nama thiy hrahring aa,” i ta raalaa pa yi ta, ama suena taa khata vya kaa yi te aa dangpa hne a phapa kha ama tue kieca,

cawsaa pha lipa tie ca ta biekuona cuo ta chipa sue kha pi pakhaa yi te, ama paruvpa kha ama pi pakhaa kieca, cakhutaata phungluo ziy pata hring yi te pha lina ama tue li kieca, iema ca ama hring hrahring aa, thiy'a va yi.
Ama tuepa suena kha suokha hmuo a thyipa pata cuo'a va yi; iema ta aa dangpa hne a phapa kha ama tue nakawta ama hring hrahring aa.
Na cawsaa tie ta iema hmang tuepa kha aa dang li tiyta “Abyipa hmang tuezya ca a dang vyi,” ama ta.
Aa dangpa tie kha amaa dangna taata vya kaa yi te pha lina ama tue kieca capa kawlie ca ta ama thiy aa.
Cakhutaata cawsaa pha lipa tie kha ama pha lina taata vya kaa yi te, aa dangpa hne a phapa kha ama tue kieca, capa kawlie ca ta ama hring aa.
Cuorasala niema ta, “Abyipa hmang tuezya ca a dang vyi,” nama ta. Vya Israel ming, niema bangkhuo ca nama hringzya hne aa ziypa tana bieripana ica hnyi'a yi!
Sii ta malie ama sikhyinapa a kung kiyna, thla hraa thlaa, ning pangaana lie kha Jerusalem taata a ruopa cawsaa pakha ca kama'a luo kha a vaw te, “Khypuv ca a ra tli,” ina ta.

Capa paa a vya chiy hluo zuoluocaw lie kha Abyipakuv ca kama'a lie kha aa luo; cuorasala capa paa a vya chiy ningpa maw khata i pakaa kha ina pahaw; i pakaa ca a pahaw te bie ri khu li pata aw va tli ang.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha aa zuv:
Cawsaapa, Israel ruo a duothling tlipa lie a awpa tie ta, “Abraham ta ruo a za cu ning kha pakha dyi tana a za cuo, cuorasala kiema ca hluvsa tli pate, ruo ca ru riypata pi pata ma cuo tli,” ama ta.

Caacuonakawta iema kha chang tie yi, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Niema ta saa kha a thiy cangta nama ce, kuvtuezuv luo kha nama ming padyi thaw ung cate thiyse nama palang; cahaacata ruo ca ru ta nama cu'a ma?
Nama zueziy kha a buchuo ung cate, duvsamakhiepa kha nama tue, nama ingpaa napuv kha namaa papya namaa palyipa; cahaacata ruo ca ru ta nama cu the'a ma?

Iema kha hingpa hing chang tie yi, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Kama i hringpa haata, a duothlingna hmang lie a awpa tie kha zueziy ta ama thiy hrahring aa; ruo chunglie a awpa tie kha ruosaa'a luo pi'a yi angte ruosaa ta a sie'a yi; cariekyikuo chunglie hne lungkaraw lie a awpa tie kha puvtlung pasana ta ama thiy aa.
Kama ta ruo kha utlawpa ta hne a duothlingpa ta tue'a angte, a hruotlenapa a thaazuo ca a hripa ta aa li aa; cakhutaata Israel tluo zaw ca a utlaw pata a li'a te ahungtahmuo cahrawpaa'a va yi.
