Iema ta ama tuepa duvsamakhiepa kawlie khata ama ruo kha a utlawpa hne a duothlingpa ta i tue tiyta, Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi.
Cawsaapa, khy dungkhuo lungruetlepie athaalie hne ingchiypakaa lie na kaw caa ri pakhawpa na cawsaa tie ta pakha hne pakha kha, “Abyipa'a taata a zuvpa bie ca a vaw ung la naathlie tie ung,” amaa ta.

Cawsaa amaa vawpa haa khata nama'a luo ca a vaw yi te, i cawsaa zaw haa khata na hmiekunglie kha amaa tu, cakhutaata na bie kha thyi yi te, cuorasala ziy'a va yi. Tahematapakieca patapaluo pata bie ri yi te, cuorasala ama pathiypalung lie ca karuo-awna dyina a aw.
Iema cuota ca nama ca a ue phasa te tingtuo a tung thesapa lesaa satlie a khingna hlaa a sapa haa tana na cuo; na ripa kha thyi yi te, cuorasala tue'a va yi.
Hingpa bangkhuo hing a vya cuo hmisi tiyta, iema ta profet pakha na kiema'a lie a aw ta, tapa kha ama pachang aa.
Abyipabie kha kama'a luo aa zuv:

Cawsaapa, Israel tuvkhietuv tie'a lie kha profetbiephu ri tie: profetbiephu kha tuvkhietuv tie'a lie ca ri tie: Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Ah, niema riybina dyi a huvpa Israel tuvkhietuv tie! Tuvkhietuv ca tuv khana sa ama pi aa cuo va ma?
Niema ta tuv ahnungtiy kha dang ung cate a hming kha caw ta namaa tue, a thupa tuv kha a thie ung cate, cuorasala tuv kha a la pi va ung ciy.

A thaa cawpa kha thaazuo pi lipa ung cata a pasapa kha patluo sa va ung ciy, hmaa a phyapa kha a hmaa catawpa lipa ung cata, luo a piepa kha a vya chiy pakhaa va ung ciy, a viepa tie kha huv lipa ung cata, cuorasala hruohra ta hne ue a hruosa pata nama uv.
Caacuonakawta iema ca tuvkhietuv a aw li nakawta amaa chepatlaa diy, ruosaa tie sa ta amaa li.

I tuv zaw ca a chepatlaa diy yi te, tluo cung bangkhuo hne aa suopa tluothlue bangkhuo lie kha amaa khie; i tuv zaw ca alyi cung ting khata amaa chepatlaa diy, a huv khingpa hne a huv riypa pakha hmuo aw va yi.
Caacuonakawta niema tuvkhietuv tie, Abyipabie kha naathlie tie ung:

Abyipa Khazingta, kama i hringpa haa tana i ri, a ta. Tuvkhietuv ama aw li nakawta i tuv zaw ca ruosaa ta sie riypata cuo yi te, aa hruopa ruosaa sa ta amaa li; cakhutaata i tuvkhietuv tie ta i tuv kha huv lipa yi ta iema riybina dyi huv yi te i tuv zaw kha sa pi va yi.
Caacuonakawta niema, tuvkhietuv tie, Abyipabie kha naathlie tie ung:

Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Kama ta tuvkhietuv tie kha i du yi; cakhutaata ama kuv taata i tuv zaw kha i hie'a yi, tuv zaw sa pina re taa khata phie'a yi angte, iema riy bina dyi a huvpa tuvkhietuv ta zaw cuo'a va tli yi. I tuv tie kha iema pakaa taata thue'a yi angte, iema sa ta cuo'a va tli yi.
Tahematapakieca Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Kama hrahring na i tuv kha huv'a yi angte a mangchiy'a tli yi ang.
Tuvkhietuv tie ta aa chepatlaapa ama tuv kha ama huvpa haata kama ta i tuv zaw kha i huv'a yi. Amyi chaasa te a zingsa ningta amaa chepatlaanapa hmang bangkhuo taa khata kama ta i khuo'a yi.
Mingphang hne ruo ting taa khata pakiy'a yi angte iema ruo luo kha i vya chiy pakhaa'a yi. Israel tluo cunglie, cavaa kie lie, hne cawsaa khy ama sanapa hmangting lie kha i patle'a yi.

Tlena a phapa lie kha patle'a yi angte, Israel tluo aa suopa zaw ca ama tlenapa ruo phapa ta ama cuo aa. Capa lie, ama tlena ruo phapa lie ca a bu'a yi te, Israel tluo zaw lie a phuv panusana lie kha ama tle aa.
Kama hrahring kha i tuv zaw a khietuv ta cuo'a angte, iema kha i pabu sa hyalya'a yi, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.

A viepa kha huv'a angte, luo a piepa kha i vya tlungkhyi pakhaa aa, hmaa a phyapa kha a hmaa tuepa'a angte, a thaazuo a cawpa kha thaa i patlung aa, cuorasala a thupa hne a thaaruvpa kha i para aa. Tuvrung kha biedangpa ta i khie aa.
Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: I tuvrung chunglie tuv sakha hne sakha alalalie hne tuvtungpa hne mietungpa tie alalalie kha kama ta bie i ripa'a yi:

Aphuv panusana lie nama tlepa ca niema cuota a de va ma? Cuorasala a hrangpa aphuv panuna hmang kha nama phyi ta nama tlawle. Tiy pasingpa na dangpa khata a hrangpa tie kha nama phyi ta nama pahnang sale'a ma?
I tuvrung ca niema nama tlawlepa kha ning'a yi te ma, nama phyi ta nama pahnang salepa tiy kha ama dang aa?
Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingta iema kyihuo khata hing haa hingta a ri: Kama hrahring na tuv a thupa tie hne tuv a zuepa tie alalalie kha bie a ripa'a yi ang.
Tahematapakieca niema ta nuopuo ung cate nama letung ta nama ne, a thaa naapa tuv zaw kha nama kiy ta de ung cate luohlaa luo kha nama chepatlaa diy.
Kama ta i tuvrung kha khuo'a angte iema ca para pata cuo'a va tli yi; tuv hne tuv alalalie kha kama ta bie i ripa'a yi.
Kama ta iema cunglie kha tuvkhietuv pakha i chipa'a yi, ama ca i changtaapa David ta cuo'a te, ama ta khie'a yi te iema tuvkhietuv ta a cuo aa.
Cakhutaata Abyipakama ca iema Khazing ta cuo'a angte, i changtaapa David ca iema hrawlie kha siepahruo ta a cuo aa; Abyipakama na a ri ang.
Kama ta iema hne khata diena biekuona tue'a angte ruo chunglie hne thing hrawlie kha aa bangsa pata aw yi te amaa hmung the riypata ruosaa aa hruopa tie kha i cade diy'a yi.
Kama ta iema hne i tluothlue cahriy ruo kha thluechiy i pi aa; ama'a na a cuo lieta khy pasaa sa'a angte, capa ca thluechiy khytiy ta a cuo aa.

Ruo chunglie thingkung zaw ta ama thyi pathyi'a yi te, alyi ta kung a pavyi aa. Iema ca amaa lyi lie kha aa bangsa pata hne palung a nuosa pata aw'a yi te, kama ta ama letung lie ruekhang kha thli'a angte sii ta a ziypa tie kuv chungtaata i palaw sa tiy yi ta Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi.
Iema ca ruohrang ming ta tuv pata chuv'a va tli yi, ruo chunglie ruosaa zaw ta sie'a va tli yi; aa bangsa pata aw'a yi te ahungtahmuo pachiypahuo'a va tli yi.
Kama ta uohnaasiyyhnaa a phasapa tie kha pi'a yi angte ruo chunglie kha sakuo maa'a va tli yi, ruohrang ming esena zaw kha ang'a va tli yi.
Iema ta Abyipa iema Khazingca iema'a lie i awpa hne Israel ming ca i cawsaa ta ama cuopa kha ama pachang aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Niema ca i tuv, i khiepa i tuv ta cuo ung cate, kama ca nama Khazing tana i cuo, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Abyipabie kha kama'a luo aa zuv:
Cawsaapa, Seir Tluo luo kha a hyi la profetbiephu kha hing haa hingta ri tie,
Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Sier Tluo, kama na caa du ang; i kuv kha pazuo'a angte utlawpa hne a duothlingpa ta ica tue aa.
Na khy kha para'a angte, a duothlingpa ta naa li aa, cakhutaata Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a ciy.
Nama ta Israel kha na palung chunglie a carie pari cate, iema ama ranapa ning, a hnangcaw ce ta iema duotena ning lie kha zueziy cahrana luo kha na pi yi.
Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingta, kama i hringpa haata, thiyse kha na cuota tingtuo pacie'a angte, thiyse ta acaa cade aa, thiyse palang kha na hue li nakawta, thiyse langna ta nama kha acaa cade aa.
Kama ta Seir Tluo ca a duothlingpa hne utlawpa ta i tue aa; ama'a luo kha a vawpa hne a vaapa aw'a va yi.
A tluo zaw kha ama thiepa tie riyy ta i pabi aa; na tluothlue cunglie, na bawphie chunglie hne na cavaa kie zaw lie kha zueziy ta thiepa tie ta ama bi aa.
Chuozaa ta a duothlingpa ta ca tue'a angte, na khypuv zaw lie kha khatiy tahmuo khy sa pata cuo'a vyi. Cakhutaata Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a ciy, a ta.
Abyipakha iema'a lie i aw thluo pata, “Hingpa Judah hne Israel hne ama ruo tie ca kama huopa tana a cuo,” na ta.

Caacuonakawta, Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri, kama i hringpa haata, iema na hue nakaw yi ta na paluo sapa na hihaana hne na hietliena haa kha tana niema'a lie kha i tue aa; niema kha bie ica ripa tiy yi ta, kamata tah icaa pachang sa'a yi.

Israel tluo a du pata nama ripa bie, “Iema ca a duothlingpa ta chipa tana ama cuo, kiema ning riypata pipa tana ama cuo,” nama tapa esena bie bangkhuo kha kama Abyipata i thyi diypa kha nama pachang aa.
Cakhutaata na pakaa ta nama hne nama a pathuosa cate, kama a duna bie a hluvsa na ripa kha ica thyi thluo.
Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Alyi cung kaakaapa ta aa law ning kha, nama ca a duothlingpa ta ica tue aa.

Israel ca a duothlingpa a za cuo nakawta, i ru ta a cuopa Israel cunglieta na palung a zaa yipa haata, nama kha ica tue ra aa. Seir Tluo, hne Edom bangkhuo, a bangkhuo ta, niema ca nama duothling diy ra aa. Cakhutaata Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy.
Cakhutaata cawsaapa, Israel tluo zaw kyihuo khata, Vya Israel tluo zaw, Abyipabie hing naathlie tie ung, ta la profetbiephu kha ri tie.
Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Carie tie ta niema kaw kha, “Ah! khahluo tluo zaw ca kiema huopa tana ama cuo tli,” ama ta.

Caacuonakawta profetbiephu kha ri la: Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Iema ta a duothlingpa ta ca tue hmisi yi te a kuo ting taata aca cariepuo tiy yi ta, niema ca aa ngaapa tie mingphang zaw ru ta a li ung cate cawsaa zaw hrawlieta pachiepa hne kawchie ripa ta namaa li.

Caacuonakawta, Vya Israel tluo zaw, Abyipa Khazingbie kha naathlie tie ung: Abyipa Khazingna a cahriy bangkhuo lieta aa ngaapa mingphang tie ta tuv yi te chuv pata aa lipa tluo zaw, cavaa kie zaw, bawphie zaw, a duothlingpa hne a utlawpa thusepa khy zaw kyihuo ta hing haa hingta a ri.

Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Sahring tlena ruo panupa a cuo nakawta esena hneta a palung tluosa pata i ruo kha na chuv te ru ta a lapa aa ngaapa mingphang tie hne Edom ming bangkhuo kha a du pata Abyipa Khazingta hihaasa pata bie i ri.

Caacuonakawta Israel ruo hne tluo zaw, tluothlue zaw cavaa zaw bawphie zaw hneta aa patuv pata profetbiephu kha ri tie, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Mingphang tie esena kha nama ang nakawta kama ta hihaasa pata hne a hrakuo pata bie i ri.
Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Nama cahriy bangkhuo lieta a awpa mingphang tie ca iemata tah nangzaana ama ang aa, ta pata chie i sa.
Cuorasala niema Israel tluo zaw ca i cawsaa Israel tie cuo khata nama ce rung'a te nama thyi nama pathyi aa; tahematapakieca iema ca a catli pata na ing luo ama vya tlung aa.
Mang tie ung, ata ca niema cuo tana i cuo tli; niema'a luo kha a vya pali'a angte, niema ca thlu pata cuo'a ung cate saciy tuv pata nama cuo aa.
Cakhutaata Israel ming bangkhuo kha ca papungpazaa'a yi angte, khy zaw lie kha khysa pata cuo'a te a rapa hmang zaw kha sa pakhaa pata a cuo aa;

cakhutaata cawsaa hne saruopa kha ica papung ica pazaa sa'a yi, a hluo ning haa khata khy ca pasa sa'a yi angte, a hluo ning laa khata a pha vie ta ica tue'a yi. Cakhutaata Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy.
Nama'a luo kha i cawsaa Israel ming ca a vya chiy'a yi angte, iema ta aca cu'a yi, nama ca ama ru ta na cuo aa. Ama saata kha nama ta pathiypa buo'a va tli yi ciy.
Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Iema ta, “Nama ca cawsaa kha ce yi cate na mingphang saata zaw kha na pathiy yi,” aca ta nakaw yi ta,
nama ta cawsaa kha khatiy tahmuo ce li'a tlipa yi cata na mingphang saata zaw kha pathiy'a va tli yi ciy, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.

Cakhutaata mingphang zaw esena bie kha khatiy tahmuo ca pathyi sa'a va tli ang, khatiy tahmuo cawsaa tie ta na nang ca pazaa'a va tli yi; cakhutaata khatiy tahmuo na mingphang a pachiy riypa zaw kha tue'a va tli ciy, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Abyipabie kha kama'a luo aa zuv:

Cawsaapa, Israel ming ta iema alyi lie khy ama sa tiyta, ama hringzya hne ama tuepa khata amaa lyi ca ama papyapalyi; i hmungna lieta ama hmang tuepa ca canung tie ta canung phung ama pachang ningta a pathe lipa ta ruepa haa khata ama cuo.
Caacuonakawta ruo chunglie ama palangpa thiyse kawlie hne ruo ama papyanapa kuvtuezuv kawlie khata iema cunglie kha i hihaana kha i lyisue yi.
Mingphang zaw hraw luo kha chepatlaa yi angte, ruo ting ta amaa ze; ama hringzya hne ama tuepa hne aa ziy pata bie i ripa yi.

Cuorasala mingphang zaw'a luo kha ama tlung tiyta, khaapa luo ama pha zaw, iema kaw kha, “Hingpa tie hing Abyipacawsaa tana ama cuo, ata hing a ruo taata na ama pya,” ta pata ri yi te i ming pathe kha ina papyapalyi yi.
Cuorasala ama phanapa mingphang zaw hrawlieta Israel ming ta ama papyapalyipa i ming pathe cuo khata i palung hnaanguo khu vyi.

Caacuonakawta Israel ming kha, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri, ta la chang tie yi. Vya Israel ming, hingpa i tue riypa hing niema kawlieta cuo vyi, nama phanapa mingphang zaw hrawlieta nama papyapalyipa i ming pathe kawlie tana a cuo.

Mingphang zaw hrawlieta papyapalyi pata a cuopa, niema ta iema hrawlie nama papyapalyipa a lesyipa i ming kha i pathe sa aa; niema hmuo pata i pathena kha i paluo sa khutaa cata mingphang zaw ta Abyipai cuopa kha ama pachang aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Mingphang zaw'a taa cata ca la'a yi angte, ruo ting taata ica pakiy'a yi; cakhutaata nama ruo chung luo kha icaa chiyle'a yi.
Tiy pathepa kha ca hi'a yi angte, nama pyalyina taa khata nama pathe aa, nama kuvtuezuv bangkhuo taa khata ica pathe sa'a yi.
Pathiypalung thaapa kha ca pi'a yi angte, thlaapa thaapa kha nama chunglie i khung aa; cakhutaata alung pathiypalung kha la'a angte saapa pathiypalung kha ica pi'a yi.
Kama thlaapa kha nama chunglie khung'a angte, i phungluo kha ca paziy sa'a yi angte i ziyphung haata a raaringsa pata ica pahring sa'a yi.
Cakhutaata nama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie i za pipa yi ruo chunglie kha aw'a ung cate, Kama ca nama Khazing ta i cuo aa.
Nama pathe lina bangkhuo taa khata ca pathe sa'a yi angte, kung pavyi sa'a angte cakuo ta ca tlungsue'a va tli yi.
Thingkung kha thyi a hluvsa ta pathyi sa'a angte lu kha kung i pavyi sa aa; caacuonakawta mingphang zaw hrawlie kha te-ang li tli'apa ung cata nama nang zaw zaa'a va tli.
Cakhutaata nama hringzya pha lipa, hne nama tuepa pha lipa kha a thyi'a ung cate nama suena hne duvsamakhiepa nama tuepa kawlie khata niema hne niema kha namaa duv aa.
Hingpa i tue riypa hing niema kawlieta cuo vyi tapa kha a sieta tah pachang tie ung, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Nama suenapa bangkhuo taata ica pasiy ning yi ca khy chunglie cawsaa khy sa pakhaa'a yi te, khyruepa kha sa pakhaa pata a cuo aa.
A duothlingpa ruo, a cahrawpaapa zaw bangkhuo hmungna lieta a duothlingpa ruo ca thlu pakhaa pata a cuo aa.

Cakhutaata iema ta, “A duothlingpa hingpa ruo ca Eden diedung haata a cuo pakhaa aa, khy ruepa, a duothlingpa hne a rapa khy zaw lie kha cawsaa ta khy sa pakhaa tli yi te ama dungkhuo diy tli,” ama ta aa.

Cakhutaata aa ngaapa nama cahriylie mingphang tie khata, Abyipakama na para ciepa kha a sa pakhaa ang, tapa hne a duothlingpa ruo lie kha ciy a cyi ang, tapa kha ina pachang'a yi; Abyipakama na a ri ang, capa ca kama ta i tue aa.
Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Tuv haata mingluv ama hluv riypata, Israel ming ta, iema cuota ina hie riypa yi ta i tue'a yi.
Hriykhungrinapa tuv haata, Jerusalem lie ama'a na a cuo lieta tuepa pyi ning tuv haa khata, cahaacata a rapa khy tie lie kha cawsaa ta ama bi aa. Cakhutaata Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi.
Abyipakuv ca i cunglie za tlung te, Abyipathlaapa ta na sikhyi te ruv ta a bipa bawphie liekhingkhuo lie kha ina chi.
Capa zaw cahriy bangkhuo khata naa chiyle te, a caakarepa ruv ca bawphie kha ama bi.
Kama kyihuo cata, “Cawsaapa, hingpa ruv tie hing ama hring pakhaa khu'a ma?” ina ta. Kama ta palie angte, “Vya Abyipa Khazing, nama na a pachang ciy,” i ta.
Cakhutaata ama ta, “Hingpa ruv zaw'a lie hing profetbiephu kha ri la: Vya ruv caapa zaw, Abyipabie hing naathlie tie ung.
Abyipa Khazingna hingpa ruv tie'a lie hing hing haa hingta a ri: Niema chung luo hing huv pathlie'a angte, nama kya hring aa.
Thariy kha ca pi'a yi angte, saa ta ica pabile'a yi, vang ta ica pahlaw'a yi, nama chung luo kha huv ca pi'a yi angte nama hring aa; cakhutaata Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy.”
Biepipa i cuopa haata profetbiephu ca i ri; profetbiephu i ri khu pahne cata aa pakhaw patlawpa pu kya paring te, ruv suokha hne suokha kha amaa pataw.
I mang nguoluopa khata ama cunglie thariy a vya aw, saa khata pahlaw yi te vang ta a vya buv yi, cuorasala ama cunglie huv aw vyi.

Cakhutaata ama ta kama kyihuo khata, “Huv'a luo kha profetbiephu ri tie, profetbiephu kha ri tie, cawsaapa, huv kyihuo khata, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Vya huv, chuelyi kiy paliy taa khata a vaw la hingpa thiepa tie cunglie hing a ngie la kya hring yi se,” a ta.
Naw ina pipa haa cata profetbiephu ca i ri, cakhutaata huv ca iema chung luo kha a ngie te ama hring, ama phyi ta a daa yi te riekaphuv lesapa zaa ama ta.

Cakhutaata kama kyihuo khata, “Cawsaapa, hingpa ruv tie hing Israel ming ingchungkhue yalya tana ama cuo. Iema ta, ‘Ma ruv zaw ca ama caa diy, maa nguopuona kha a vie, kiema ca thawkaruepa tana ma cuo,’ ama ta.
Caacuonakawta iema'a lie kha profetbiephu ri tie, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Vya i cawsaa tie, kama ta nama thluo kha pahaw'a yi angte, Israel ruo luo kha icaa chiy'a yi.
Vya i cawsaa zaw, nama thluo kha pahaw'a angte, ica pyakhyi tiy yi ta, Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy.

I thlaapa kha nama chunglie chi'a angte, nama hring aa, cakhutaata niema ca nama'a lyi lie kha ica chi'a yi; cakhutaata niema ta, Abyipakama ta ri angte, a tue zaw i tue aa, tapa kha nama pachang aa,” Abyipata a ta.
Abyipabie kha kama'a luo aa zuv:

Cawsaapa, asung kha la lah, “Judah hne ama hneta a viesaapa Israel ming cuota,” ta pata cape tie; cakhutaata asung hrangpa kha la lah a cunglie kha, “Josef (Efraim asung) hne ama hne a viesaapa Israel ingchungkhue cuota,” ta pata cape tie;
cakhutaata iema kha a sung suokha a cuo riypata patue la, na kuv lie kha suokha ta ama cuo aa.
Cakhutaata na cawsaa tie ta, “Hingpa na tuepa hing khaapa malie na pahmung sa khingnapa tama a cuo?” aca ta tiy yi ta,

iema kyihuo khata, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Josef asung (Efraim kuv chunglie a awpa kha) hne ama hne a viesaapa Israel asung kha la'a angte, Judah asung kha capa cunglie ca i chi aa, iema kha kama kuv chunglie suokha ta ama cuo riypata asung suokha ta i tue'a yi.
A cunglie caa na capepa asung suohning kha na kuv lie ama hmung tiyta,

iema kyihuo khata, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Israel ming kha ama chiynapa mingphang tie hraw taa khata la'a yi angte, ama awnapa hmangting taa khata i pakiy'a yi, cakhutaata ama ruo luo kha i sikhyi'a yi.

Ruo chunglie, Israel tluocung zaw lie kha mingphang phang kha ta tue'a yi angte, iema bangkhuo cunglie kha siepahruo pakha ta a pe'a yi. Mingphang phang hning ta a che buo li tli'apa yi ta; ruo hning ta a che pakhaa buo'a va tli yi.

Iema ca ama kuvtuezuv hne duv aa chiypa hmang tie hne ama tuesuena khata papyapalyi'a va tli yi. Amaa lie tawnapa ama zangna hne amaa daahmang chung taa khata khuo'a yi angte, i pathe sa'a yi. Cakhutaata iema ca kama cawsaa ta cuo'a yi te, kama ca ama Khazingta i cuo aa.
I changtaapa David ca ama siepahruo ta a cuo aa; iema bangkhuo ta tuvkhietuv pakha ama hnyi aa. Iema ta i ziyphung kha ziy'a yi te i phungluo kha a raaringsa pata ama tue aa.
Kama ta i changtaapa Jakob i pipa ruo, nama mingchingmingvuo tie za awnapa ruo chunglie kha aw'a yi te, iema hne ama saata zaw, hne ama samingsahlaa zaw kha capa lie ca chuozaa ta ama aw aa.

Iema hne cata diena biekuona kha tue'a angte, capa ca chuozaa ta aa hmangpa biekuona ta a cuo aa; kama ta thluechiy pi'a yi angte i papungpazaa'a yi, cakhutaata iema hrawlie ca i hmangpathepa kha chuozaa ta i chi aa.
Iema'a lie kha i aw aa; kama ca iema Khazing ta cuo'a angte, iema ca kama cawsaa ta ama cuo aa.
I hmangpathepa kha iema hrawlie chuozaa ta a aw tiyta, mingphang tie khata Abyipakama ta Israel i pathe sapa yi kha ama pachang aa.
Abyipabie ca kama'a luo aa zuv:
Cawsaapa, Meshek hne Tubal siepahruo, Magog ruo lieta Gog siepahruo'a luo kha a hyi la, profetbiephu kha rihnue tie:
Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Vya Gog, Meshek hne Tubal siepahruo, kama na caa du ang.

Nama kha caa vya palihning'a angte, na hrakuo ruv lie kha kyipa ta ca pasiy sa'a angte, na rieka bangkhuo, naa ruo hne naa ruo rieka tie hne khata ica sikhyi aa, rieka cawsie hne cehre a tling pata a tuepa tie, ama bangkhuo ta phyalepa hne phyataata a cyi yi te zueziy a yapa riekaphuv a lesapa bangkhuo tie hne khata ica sikhyi aa.
Iema hne cata Persia, Ethiopia, hne Put ming, ama bangkhuo ta phyataata a cyi yi te thaalakhuv a khuvpa tie kha iema'a lie ca ama aw ra.
Gomer hne a rieka bangkhuo, aa hlacenapa chaluo ruo lie a awpa Beth-togarmah hne a rieka bangkhuo zaw kha nama hneta ama aw.
A raaring la a ting pacie pata aw tie, nama hne naa thaalie a hmyapa bangkhuo hne khata iema cuo cata a ting pacie pata aw tie ung.

Ning hluvpuv khutaata nama ca cehre pi pata na cuo aa; kung hluvpuv khutaata, rieduna khutaata sa pakhaapa ruo suokha kha a du riypata na si aa, capa ruo lie a cawsaa zaw ca mingphang hluvpuv zaw hraw taata pakhaw pata Israel ruo tluo cunglie vya pahmyapa ruo khata a cuo. Capa ca cuo pasiypuv chung a duothlingpa ta za chipa cuo te, a cawsaa zaw ca mingphang zaw taata vya sikhyipa, ata hing ama bangkhuo ta aa bangsa pata a awpa tie ta ama cuo.
Nama hne na rieka tie bangkhuo, nama hne cawsaa a hluvsa ca khysuv haa khata a vaw'a ung cate, ruo ca amyi ta a buvkhungpa haa khata nama buvkhung aa.
Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Capa ning lie ca ruena suokha na palung chung luo a ngie'a te a pha lipa khue na khuo aa.

Nama ta, “Dungkhuo a hnyi lipa khyta zaw awnapa ruo luo na i sithaw aa; khy dungkhuo a hnyi lipa, thlake hne thlake hrena tluo zaw a hnyi lipa, a diesa pata hne aa bangsa pata a awpa tie khana i tuv'a yi,” na ta aa.

A duothlingpa ta za cuo te khy tla thaanapa lie a awpa tie kha tuv pata, hruosue kha chuv pa yi ta phyale riypata naa ting. Iema ca mingphang zaw taata pahmyapa ta cuo yi te, sahring hne chechiy zaw a hnyipa, alyi khingkhuo luopuv a tawna lieta a awpa tana ama cuo.

Sheba hne Dedan hne Tarshish chadaw tie ta, “Hruosue patuv riypata ma naa vaw? Na cawsaa phuv tie kha pahmya yi cate ma, hruosue, siy hne ngu, sahring hne chechiy tapa, hruosue a hluvsa chuv riypata naa vaw?” aca ta'a yi.
Caacuonakawta, cawsaapa, profetbiephu kha ri la, Gog kha chang tie: Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: I cawsaa Israel ming aa bangsa pata ama aw ningta
aa hlacenapa chaluo ruo taata naa zaa thu aa. Nama hneta cawsaa a hluvsa zaa chiy'a yi cate iema bangkhuo ca aruo rieka, cawsaa phuv lesapa, a cahrasapa rieka ta ama cuo.

I cawsaa Israel ming kha a du'a yi cate amyi ta alyi a buvpa haata na buv'a yi. Hmieluo cuo thueta i ruo a du riypata kama ta ca sikhyi'a angte, cahaacata mingphang zaw ta nama, Gog kha hmuo pata ama hmiekunglie i pathena i paluosana taa khata kama kha ina pachang'a yi.

Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Hluo ningta Israel ming i profet tie hmuo pata bie i za ri tiyta, iema a du riypa tana ica sikhyi aa ta pata hluo ningta profetbiephu za ri hnuochuopa ca nama hingta na cuo ma?
Gog ta Israel ruo aa du ning ca i hihaana kha a ie tana a ie aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Tahematapakieca i hrakuona hne hihaasa pata bie i pathyi sa: Capa ning lie ca Israel ruo chunglieta aling khuopuv ta aa siy aa.

Riyliy ngaa zaw, avuo lie pavaa zaw, ruo chunglie saruopa zaw alyi lie aa valepa saruopa zaw, alyi cunglie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo zaw kha i awna lieta aa cathang ta amaa cathang aa. Tluo kha amaa lie aa, lungkuo kha ama cing aa, dungkhuo mekaa kha a cakhypatyi'a yi te alyi lie ama laa diy aa.
I tluo zaw bangkhuo luo kha Gog a du riypata zueziy kha ku'a yi angte, ama rieka tie ca iema hne iema mamaapa kha zueziy ta amaa du aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.

Puvtlung pasana hne thiyse palangna cangta ama kha bieripana luo i ngiekhyi aa; ama hne a rieka tie hne ama hneta a awpa cawsaa hluvsa cunglie kha khytiy kha a bya ta bya'a yi angte, ari pangkatupa hne, myi hne kemyi zaw kha a lyi ta i lyisue'a yi.
Cahaacata i lesyina hne i pathena kha paluo sa'a angte, mingphang hluvsa kha i pahmung sa'a yi. Cakhutaata iema ta Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi.
Cakhutaata, Cawsaapa, Gog a du pata profetbiephu kha ri la ama kyihuo khata: Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Vya Gog, Meshek hne Tubal siepahruo, kama na caa du ang!
Na hnang na hmie ta ca pahie'a angte hmieluo ta ica nuopuole aa, aa hlacenapa chaluo ruo taa khata ca la'a angte, Israel tluo luo kha ica sikhyi aa.
Na cavyiluo kuv lie liy kha tuv'a angte, na cacuoluo kuv lie cuoti zaw kha ica cabepa pathla diy aa.
Israel tluo cunglie kha nama hne na rieka tie bangkhuo hne nama'a lie a awpa cawsaa tie kha nama thiy diy aa. Saa a ningpa pavaa hne ruo chunglie aa hruopa saa zaw la ta ica pi'a yi.
Ruo chunglie khana nama thiy aa; tahematapakieca kama na a ri tli ang, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Kama ta Magog hne riyliy kie ruo tie lie aa bangsa pata a awpa tie cunglie kha myi pathliesue'a yi angte, cakhutaata Abyipai cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi.
I ming pathepa ca i cawsaa Israel ming kha pachang sa'a yi angte, papyapalyi pata cuo'a va tli. Cakhutaata mingphang zaw ta Abyipa, Israel Khazing Pathe i cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi.
Capa ca a vya tlung hrahring aa! Abyipa Khazingta a ta. Capa ca na kama ta i ripa ning cata a cuo.

Cakhutaata Israel khypuv zaw lie a awpa tie kha pya'a yi te carie tie ama thuse siypa cehre zaw kha myi lie tiy riypa thing ta ama hmuo aa: phyataata hne phyalepa zaw, liy hne thi zaw, asyi pachangta hne asyi zaw, kung sariy chung thing ta ama hmuo aa.

Ruo chung luo si pata thing phya a hu'a vyi, atuv lieta khaapa thing hmuo hu a hu'a vyi, carie tie cehre kha myi lie tiy riypata thing ta ama hmuo aa; cahaacata iema a vya chingpa tie kha ching ra'a yi te hruocawsaa ta a tuepa tie kha hruocawsaa ta ama tue ra aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.

Capa ning lie ca Gog pabyna riypata Israel ruo chunglie, riyliy taata ningchiyluo kuo Khytlawtuv Bawphie lie kha hmang i pi aa; capa ca ta khytlawtuv tie kha luopuv a pakhuo'a yi, tahematapakieca Gog hne a cawsaa phuv tie kha paby pata ama cuo nakawta a cuo: capa hmang ca Hamon-gog Bawphie ta pata ku pata a cuo aa.
Ruo pasiypathe riypata Israel ming ca iema ama pabyna lie kha thla sariy ama ru aa.
Capa ruo lie a awpa bangkhuo ca ta paby'a yi te, i rungnaana aa luona ning lie kha pa-uvsathyina ama hmung aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Ruo pathe sa riypa cata ruo chunglie a khie pata alyi cunglie aa ngaa kaliepa a thiypa riyy zaw paby riypata cawsaa kha a tlaw yi te, thla sariy chung capa re ca ama hrie aa.
Riyy a huvpa tie ca ruo chung bangkhuo kha a khie yi te, cawsaa ruv ama hmungna lie kha a pabytuv tie ta Hamon-gog Bawphie lie ama pabyna te khata aa hnangna kha ama tuele aa.
(Khypuv Hamonah zaw kha capa lie ca na a aw.) Cahaacata ruo kha ama pathe sa aa.

Cawsaapa, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Avuo lie pavaa phangting hne saruopa bangkhuo'a lie kha hing haa hingta ri tie: A vaw ung la a vya hmya tie ung, niema cuota i pachiepa hriykhungrina sa kha ning riypata hmangting taa khata a vya hmya tie ung, Israel tluo zaw cunglieta a lepa hriykhungrina pyi ta cuo te, saa kha ce'a ung cate thiyse kha nama dang aa.
A thaaruvpa tie saa kha ce'a ung cate, alyi siepahruo tie thiy kha nama dang aa; iema bangkhuo ca Bashan ta a thusa pata aa ziypa mietungpa zaw, tuvtaata zaw, mie zaw, cuetungpa zaw ta ama cuo.
Niema cuota ica tingtuopa yi hriykhungrina pyi lie ca a thupa kha nama riy bina te ta ning'a ung cate, thiyse kha nama pariyna te ta nama dang aa.
I cabya ca aruo zaw, aruole a mawpa tie zaw, rieka phangting tie zaw saa khata pabi tie ung, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Kama ta i rungnaana kha mingphang zaw hrawlie i paluo sa aa; mingphang bangkhuo ta kama i tuepa bieripana hne i kuv ta iema cunglie i chipa kha ama hmung aa.
Capa ning taata hmieluo ca Israel ming ta Abyipaiema Khazing i cuopa kha ama pachang aa.

Cakhutaata mingphang zaw khata Israel ming ca ama pha lina kawlieta sii ama cuopa kha ama pachang aa, tahematapakieca kama khana ina dung yi. Caacuonakawta i hmie kha iema'a taata i nu aa, iema ca ama carie tie'a luo kha pi'a yi angte zueziy ta ama thiy aa.
Ama pathe lina hne ama suena haa khata iema cunglie kha re hrie'a angte, iema'a taata i hmie kha i nu aa.
Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Jakob vuophana kha pi pakhaa'a angte, Israel ming bangkhuo cunglie kha nangduena i hnyi'a yi; cakhutaata i mingpathepa kha i daakhyi aa.
Ama ruo lie aa bangsa pata aw yi te, pakha tahmuo ama pachiypahuo li tiyta cuose,

ama carie tie ruo taata pahmya yi angte mingphang zaw'a taata i kaakhyi tiy yi ta cuose, iema hmuo pata mingphang zaw hmungna lieta i pathena kha i paluo sa tiyta kama dung pata ama tuepa hanghiena bangkhuo hne ama nangzaana kha ama maw aa.

Cakhutaata iema ta Abyipaiema Khazing i cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi, tahematapakieca kama ta mingphang zaw'a luo kha sii ta paphya yi angte, cakhutaata ama ruo chung luo kha i pahmya pakhaa yi. Pakha hmuo hnangluo lie pangaa siy'a va yi ang.
Israel ming cunglie i thlaapa i bya thue yi ta ca i hmie kha iema'a taata nu buo'a va tli ang, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.

Sii ta malie ama sikhyinapa kung kiy kung pangaana, kung hruothu thlaa, ning hraanapa lie, khypuv para khutaata kung hraa hlyipangaa a tlingna ning lie, capa ning lie ca Abyipakuv ca i cunglie za tlung te capa luo ca ina sikhyi.
Muocuo chunglie ca Khazing ta Israel ruo luo kha na sikhyi te tluo aa suosapa cunglie kha ina pachung, capa taata sungluo kuo lie kha khypuv suokha hneta aa lupa zaw kha a aw.
Capa luo ina sikhyi tiy cata, a hmingsuo daa a lupa, cawsaa pakha kha za aw te, cawthang phapa ta ama camaapa khuhriy hne taanapa a sung suokha kha a hrie te thlake lie kha a zaa daa.

Cawsaapa ca ta kama kyihuo khata, “Cawsaapa, na mang la a phasa pata naathlie tie, cakhutaata ica pahmung sa riypa hing a phasa pata a cake tie, tahematapakieca hingpa hing pahmung sa riypa tana hingpa luo hing icaa vawkhyi pata a cuo; na hmungpa bangkhuo hing Israel ming'a lie kha ri diy tie,” ina ta.

Capa lie ca lungrue tlepie ta cadung diypa biena-ing suokha a aw. Cawsaapa kuv lie a awpa taanapa asung ca daw caruv a syi. Capa daw ca daw syipa ta cuo te daw kha lieta daw kha hne pazaa tie ta a cuo. Lungrue tlepie a chaana kha taa te taanapa asung suokha, aa suona luo kha taa te asung suokha ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata ningchiyluo a hyipa thlake luo kha vaa te, hlyidaw kha kie te, thlake tungtluo kha a taa ca pe taanapa asung suokha ta a cuo ra.

Capa lie ca a khuo zaw aw yi te, a khuo suokha a tung ca pe taana asung suokha ta cuo te, ahaa zaw pe taanapa a sung suokha ta a cuo. A khuo zaw alalalieta a hrina hmang ca daw pangaa ta a cuo. Ing le khuo thlake athaa a kunapa ca pe taanapa asung suokha ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata thlake taata a vawlenapa luopuv kha a taa ca daw kha ta a cuo.
Ing chung a khuolepa luo a ngielenapa khuo kha a taa ca daw cari cuo te, aa tung tie ca daw hning ama chaa. Thlake taata a vawlenapa ca a chung luo a chuona te ta a chiy.
Ningchiy thlake a kuo suohning vyicuo lie ca a khuo khuo thung kaluo aw te a suothung cata amaa khing diy; a kuo hning lieta a awpa atung zaw kha a le a caw amaa khing.
Thlake taata angienapa kha a taa ca a kuna luo daw hraa ta cuo te a syina luo daw hraa hlyithung ta a cuo.
A khuo tie hmielie kha a riykhuonapa aw te a kuo hning khata daw kha kaluo aa suo, a khuo tie ca a kuo hning khata daw caruv ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata thlake luopuv kha a khuo hnangluo tlepie taata a hrangpa khuo a hnangluo tlepie te khata a taa ca a kunapa daw kiy daw pangaa ta a cuo.
Thlake taata a chung luo angienapa zaw kha kuo kha taata kuo kha te a taa ca daw kiy ta a cuo; atung a vya paziypa thlake taa khata tlawhmie a kuo bangkhuo zaw kha a taa.
A ngienapa thlake hmie taata a chung khuo a chuonapa te ca daw sawngaa ta a cuo.
A khuo tie hne atung tie khata a kuo bangkhuo khata thlaluo-aw hnyi yi te, ing chung luo angienapa khuo zaw khata a kuo bangkhuo ta luopuv ama hnyi; atung cunglie ca tungkung zuv kha ama sa.
Cakhutaata ale luo ta a awpa tlawhmie luo kha inaa chiy; tlawhmie aa dung pata a khuo sawthung aw yi te alung phaapa luopuv luo kha amaa hyi diy.
Alung phaapa luopuv ca thlake zaw kie lie khata si te, thlake zaw a va syina zaa haa khata a va syi ra. Capa ca aa ne luo'apa alung phaapa luopuv ta a cuo.
Tlawhmie a kuna ca aa ne viepa thlake luopuv taa khata a chung vie lie thlake luopuv ale luo te khata taa te daw zakha a ta.
Cakhutaata chaluo ta a hyipa ale luo tlawhmie thlake ca a syina hne a kuna kha a taa.

A khuo ca kuokhaluo khuo thung kaluo ta a aw, atung zaw hne ing chung luo a ngienapa khuo zaw ca thlake suokhana lie'apa tie hne khata a le a caw aa khing diy, a syina luo daw sawngaa hne a kuna luo daw kiy daw pangaa ta a cuo.

A thlaluo-aw tie, ing chung luo a ngienapa khuo, hne tungkung zuv zaw ca ningchiyluo a hyipa thlake lie'apa tie hne khata a le a caw amaa khing diy. Capa luo kienapa ca chuo sariy ta cuo te, ing chung luo a ngienapa khuo ca a kieluo kuo khata a aw.
Ningchiyluo kuo haa khata, chaluo kuo thlake hne aa rie-epa khata a chung tlawhmie luo a ngienapa thlake a aw; thlake taata thlake te kha a taa ca daw zakha ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata sungluo kuo kha inaa chiyle, capa lie ca sungluo kuo khata thlake a aw; aa tung hne ing chung luo a ngienapa khuo kha a taa ca a hrangpa tie hne khata a le a caw amaa lu.

Ing chung luo a ngienapa lie hne a khuo tie lie ca a kuo bangkhuo ta thlaluo-aw aw yi te, a hrang lie thlaluo-aw zaw hneta amaa lu, a syina luo daw sawngaa, hne a kuna luo daw kiy daw pangaa ta a cuo.
Capa luo kienapa ca chuo sariy ta cuo te, ing chung luo a ngienapa khuo ca a kieluo kuo khata a aw. A kuo hning lieta aa tung tie cunglie kha tungkung zuv suokha law a aw.
Sungluo kuo, a chung tlawhmie cunglie ca thlake suokha a aw; thlake taata sungluo kuo thlake te kha a taa ca, daw zakha ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata sungluo thlake taa khata a chung tlawhmie luo kha naa chiyle te, sungluo thlake kha a taa; a hrangpa tie hne khata a le a caw aa khing.

A khuo zaw, aa tung zaw, ing chung luo a ngienapa khuo zaw ca a hrangpa tie hne khata a le a caw aa khing; a khuo lie hne ing chung luo a ngienapa khuo ca a syina daw sawngaa, a kuna daw kiy daw pangaa ta cuo te a kuo bangkhuo ta thlaluo-aw a aw.
A kuo bangkhuo lie kha ing chung luo a ngienapa khuo aw te a syina daw kiy daw pangaa hne a kuna daw pangaa ta a cuo.
Ing chung luo a ngiena khuo ca a le tlawhmie luo kha a hyi te, tungkung zuv zaw ca aa tung cunglieta ama aw, capa luo a kienapa ca chuo cari ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata ningchiyluo kuo ta a awpa a chung tlawhmie luo kha inaa chiyle, thlake kha a taa ca a hrang lie'apa tie hne khata a le a caw aa lu.

A khuo zaw, aa tung zaw, ing chung luo a ngienapa khuo zaw ca a hrang luo'apa tie hne khata a le a caw aa khing; a khuo lie hne ing chung luo a ngienapa khuo ca a syina daw sawngaa, a kuna daw kiy daw pangaa ta cuo te a kuo bangkhuo ta thlaluo-aw a aw.
Ing chung luo a ngiena khuo ca a le tlawhmie luo kha a hyi te, tungkung zuv zaw ca a kuo hning lieta aa tung cunglieta ama aw, capa luo a kienapa ca chuo cari ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata chaluo kuo ta a awpa thlake luo kha inaa chiyle, thlake kha a taa ca a hrang lie'apa tie hne khata a le a caw aa lu.

A khuo zaw, aa tung zaw, ing chung luo a ngienapa khuo zaw ca a hrang luo'apa tie hne khata a le a caw aa khing; a kuo bangkhuo ta thlaluo-aw a hnyi. A syina daw sawngaa hne a kuna daw kiy daw pangaa ta a cuo.
Ing chung luo a ngiena khuo ca a le tlawhmie luo kha a hyi te, tungkung zuv zaw ca a kuo hning lie, aa tung cunglieta ama aw; capa luo a kienapa ca chuo cari ta a cuo.
Myirue panaana ama tuenapa pasiyna riypata thlake taata ing chung luo a ngiena lie kha a thlaluo-aw cangpa a khuo khuo kha a aw.
Thlake taata ing chung luo a ngienapa chunglie ca a kuo hning lieta cabya suohning aw te, capa lie ca myirue panaana hne sue pathe sa panaana hne sue a ngiethe panaana sahring zaw kha ama thie.
Chaluo thlake taata a ngiena lie ing chung luo a ngienapa a le lie khata cabya suohning aw te a kuokhaluo ing chung luo a ngienapa lie kha cabya suohning a aw ra.
A chunglieta cabya suopaliy aw te, aleluo thlake kielieta cabya suopaliy a aw, capa cunglie ca hriykhungrina sahring kha ama thie.

Myirue panaana tuena riypata uopa alung ta tuepa cabya suopaliy aw te, a syina daw kha ang kha daw che, a kuna daw kha ang kha daw che, aa suona daw kha ta a cuo. Capa cunglie ca aa hupa chechiy kha chi yi te myirue panaana hne hriykhungrina sahring zaw kha ama thie.
Cabya ca a kuo bangkhuo ta a tingkhuo tue yi te capa lie ca sungtung a syipa thingkhe kha a chi aa dung pata ama khe diy. Capa lie ca pihluopa sahring saa ca ama pathlie.

A chung khuo luo a ngienapa thlake a le lie, a chung tlawhmie chunglie kha a khuo zaw aw te, suokha ca chaluo thlake athaalieta cuo te sungluo kuo ta aa hyi, a hrangpa suokha ca ningchiy thlake athaalieta cuo te, chaluo kuo ta aa hyi.
Ama ta kama kyihuo khata, “Hingpa sungluo kuo a hyipa khuo hing ca biena-ing re a hriepa tluobyi tie cuo tana a cuo,

chaluo kuo ta a hyipa khuo hing ca bienatluophie lie re a hriepa tluobyi tie cuota a cuo; iema ca Zadok ciypathla tie ta cuo yi te, Levi ciypathla chungtaata iema kyalya hing Abyipare hrie riypata aa thaa luo a vaw riypata ama cuo.”
Ama ta tlawhmie ca a taa, daw zakha syi te daw zakha a ku, a tung a phyi aa khingpa ta a cuo; bienatluophie ca biena-ing hmiekunglie ta a aw.

Cakhutaata biena-ing chung luo a ngienapa khuo luo kha naa chiyle te, capa khuo lie atung zaw kha a taa, a kuo hning khata daw pangaa ta a cuo; thlake a kuna ca daw hraa hlyipaliy ta cuo te, thlake kuo vyicuo lie tlepie ca daw thung a chaa.

Ing chung luo angienapa khuo a syina ca daw kiy ta cuo te, a kuna ca daw hraa hlyihning ta a cuo; capa luo ca kuorakuo suo hraa kie pata cuo te tlepie lie atung zaw athaalie, a kuo hning lie kha atung lesapa ama aw.
Cakhutaata a pungnapa a khuolepa chung luo kha naa ngiekhyi te atung tie kha a taa; a chaana ca daw caruv kaluo ta a cuo.
A ngienapa ca daw hraa a ku; a ngienapa kuo vyicuo lie tlepie tie ca a kuo hning ta daw pangaa kaluo ta ama cuo. A pungnapa a khuolepa ca a taa, a syina daw sawliy ta cuo te, a kuna daw kiy ta a cuo.

Cakhutaata a chung khuo luo kha a ngie te, a ngienapa lieta atung zaw kha a taa ca daw hning ta a cuo; cakhutaata a ngienapa a kuna ca daw caruv ta cuo te, a ngienapa kuo vyicuo lie tlepie ca daw sariy ta a cuo.
Ama ta a pungnapa a khuolepa va law lieta a khuo kha a taa ca a syina luo daw kiy, a kuna luo daw kiy ta a cuo. Cakhutaata kama kyihuo khata, Hingpa hingna hmang pathe cepa ta a cuo, ina ta.
Cakhutaata biena-ing tlepie kha a taa ca daw caruv a chaa; biena-ing cadung pata a awpa a khuo tie ca daw paliy a ku.

A kieluo kuo ta a awpa khuo tie ca duo thung ta cuo te, duo kha cyicuo lieta a khuo cawta sawthung law ama aw. Biena-ing a cadungpa tlepie lie ca a khuo zaw a dyithaw riypa khata a pachuona a syipahyapa chi yi te, caacuonakawta biena-ing tlepie khata a dyi a hu vyi.

Biena-ing a cadungpa khuo tie ca duo kha hnang duo kha aa paziy pata ama ku viele; tahematapakieca a pachuona a syipahyapa pachuo pata sapa a cuo nakawta a cuo. Caacuonakawta ing ca duo kha hnang duo kha a le viele pata a cuo. A raw duo taata a cung duo luo kie khing tiyta, aa lala duo a ngiepaa pata kie aa hu.
Biena-ing a cadungpa cata a khuo tie hruopatu hne aa ne aa suo aa khing pata ama tuepa ama pasuo viepa luopuv a aw; a khuo tie hruopatu ca taanapa asung suokha sungsiy, daw caruv ta a cuo.
A khuo tie aleluo tlepie ca daw pangaa a chaa; biena-ing a cadungpa khuo tie hne
tlawhmie lie a khuo tie aa lala ca biena-ing a cadungpa cata daw kiy ta a cuo.
A khuo tie taata a tlawnapa luo a ngienapa zaw aw te, suokha ca chaluo kuo ta cuo te, a hrangpa suokha ca sungluo kuo ta a cuo; biena-ing a cadung pata patlawpa luopuv a kuna ca daw pangaa ta a cuo.
Biena-ing tlawhmie luo a hyipa ing, ningtlaluo kuo ta a awpa ing ca daw sawsariy ku te, a syina ca daw sawcaky ta a cuo, a tlepie ca daw pangaa a chaa.
Cakhutaata biena-ing kha taa te, a syina daw zakha ta cuo te, a tlawhmie hne a ing hne a tlepie ca daw zakha ta a cuo;
biena-ing hmiekung hne tlawhmie zaw kha a taa ca daw zakha ta a cuo ra.

Ningtlaluo kuo ta a awpa tlawhmie luo a hyipa ing kha a kuo hning lieta cakuona luopuv hne khata a taa ca daw zakha ngiethie ta a cuo. Biena-ing apungna khuolepa hne chungching khuo hne ing chung luo a ngienapa khuo tie ca
thingphie ta tue pata ama cuo, a cadung pata a awpa thlaluo-aw a suothung khata thing ta tue pata a cuo. Biena-ing ca thlaluo-aw tluo, dakhang taata thlaluo-aw te (thlaluo-aw ca khaa pata a cuo),
ingchiypakaa cung, chungching khuo te hne aleluo bangkhuo kha thing ta tuepa selaw ta a cuo. Cakhutaata tlepie cung bangkhuo, chungching khuo hne apungna khuolepa lie kha zuv ama sa.
Cherubim hne tungkung ta a cuo, cherub hne cherub alalalie tungkung suokha lawmaw ta a cuo. Cherub sakha ta hmie suohning lawmaw a hnyi:
cawsaa hmie ca kuokhaluo ta a awpa tungkung luo kha a hyi te, chingde hmie ca kuokhaluo ta a awpa tungkung luo kha aa hyi. Biena-ing chung bangkhuo ca a zuv ama sa diy.
Dakhang taata chiypakaa cung te yalya khata, cherubim hne tungkung ca tlepie cunglie kha ama sa.
Apungna khuolepa chiypakaa tung ca a kuna hne a chaana amaa khing diy. Hmang pathepa hmiekunglie kha

thing bienatluophie hneta aa lupa aw te, aa suona daw thung, a syina daw hning, a kuna daw hning ta a cuo; a kiy tung, a patuna hne a tlepie ca thing ta a cuo. Kama kyihuo khata, “Hingpa hing Abyipahmiekunglie patupa cabya tana a cuo,” ina ta.
Apungna khuolepa hne hmang pathepa ca chiypakaa suohning ama hnyi.
Ingchiypakaa ca phie hning ta te a lielie taata pahawpa ta a cuo.
Apungna khuolepa lie chiypakaa tie lie kha cherubim hne tungkung zuv kha ama sa, cahaacata tlepie lie zaw kha ama sa; ing chung luo a ngienapa khuo hmiekung a le lie kha thing ta tuepa siling a aw.
Ing chung luo a ngienapa khuo, kuo vyicuo lie ca thlaluo-aw zaw aw te tlepie lie ca tungkung zuv ama sa.

Cakhutaata chaluo kuo ta a awpa a le tlawhmie luo kha na pyakhyi te, biena-ing tlawhmie hne aa hmiepachawpa khuo luo kha ina cakuokhyi. Capa khuo tie ca chaluo kuo ta a awpa ing hne khata amaa hmiepachaw.
Chaluo kuo ta a awpa ing a syina ca daw zakha ta cuo te, a kuna ca daw sawngaa ta a cuo.
A chung tlawhmie huopa ta a cuopa hmang daw kiy lie kha a le tlawhmie huopa ta a cuopa alung phaapa luopuv luo aa hyipa khata ing khuo duo thung a aw.
Capa khuo zaw hmielie ca a chungluo kuo ta luopuv suokha a aw, daw hraa ku te daw zakha a syi, aa ngienapa ca chaluo kuo ta a aw.
A cung duo khuo tie ca a raw duo hne a lielie duo khuo tie laata a baa vie, tahematapakieca a hnangluo aa saw vie pata sapa tana a cuo.

Capa khuo zaw ca duo thung ta aw yi te, a le tlawhmie lie atung zaw haa khata atung hnyi va yi; tahematapakieca a cung luo khuo tie ca aa ne khuo hne a lielie khuo tie laata hnangluo pasaw vie pata ama cuo.
Aleluo tlepie ca a khuo zaw hne a le tlawhmie hne a sihnepa khata chung yi te, a syina daw sawngaa a cuo.
Ale tlawhmie lie a khuo zaw ca daw sawngaa syi yi te, capa hne aa hmiepachawpa biena-ing ca daw zakha a syi.
Hingpa khuo tie a phyichaa tliehle lieta luopuv suokha si te capa luo ca ningchiy luo taata a ngie pata a cuo, a le tlawhmie taata ing khuo luo a ngienapa luopuv ta a cuo.
Luopuv a kuna ca tlawhmie tlepie tie khata a cuo. Sungluo kuo lie zaw a tlawnapa hne aa hmiepachaw pata hne, ing hne aa hmiepachawpa khata a khuo zaw aw yi te,
ama hmiekunglie luopuv ama hnyi; iema ca chaluo kuo a khuo zaw hne khata amaa lu, a syina hne a kuna amaa khing, aa ngienapa zaw a lu yi te a khuo awtuvzya hne a ingchiypakaa zaw amaa lu.
Caacuonakawta sungluo kuo ta a awpa khuo zaw chung luo a ngiena riypata luopuv a chuonapa chaluo tlepie lie kha ingchiypakaa suokha a aw.

Cakhutaata kama kyihuo khata, “A tlawnapa hmang hne aa hmiepachawpa chaluo khuo zaw hne sungluo khuo zaw hing ca a khuo pathepa tana a cuo, hingpa lie hingna Abyipahmiekung luo a ngiepa tluobyi tie kha a pathe cepa pihluopa sa kha ama ning aa; capa lie ca na a pathe cepa pihluopa ta a cuopa, sa ta panaana, sue pathe sa panaana, sue a ngiethe panaana tapa tie kha ama tue aa, tahematapakieca hmangpathepa tana a cuo.

Tluobyi tie kha hmang pathepa luo amaa ngie tiyta, capa lie amaa tuepa cawsie zaw kha capa lie ca ama chisiy li kieca, ale tlawhmie luo kha pya'a va yi, tahematapakieca capa cawsie tie ca a pathepa ta cuo te, zaapuv hraw luo ama va pya hluo khata cawsie hrangpa ta amaa thle riypa tana a cuo,” ina ta.
Biena-ing a chungluo hmang kha a taa diy khutaata ningchiyluo a hyipa thlake taa khata na pyakhyi te biena-ing hmang bangkhuo kha a taa diy.
A taanapa asung khata ningchiyluo kuo kha taa te, taanapa asung khata daw zapangaa ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata a maa te chaluo kuo kha a taa ca, taanapa asung khata daw zapangaa ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata a pali te sungluo kuo kha a taa ca, taanapa asung ta daw zapangaa ta a cuo.
Ningtlaluo kuo kha a maa te a taa ca, taanapa asung ta daw zapangaa ta a cuo.

A kuo paliy khata a taa diy. Capa ca a chi aa dung pata lungruetlepie dungkhuo hnyi te, a syina daw zapangaa hne a kuna daw zapangaa ta a cuo. Capa dungkhuo ca a pathepa hne a pathe lipa pachena riypa tana a cuo.
Cakhutaata ningchiyluo a hyipa thlake luo kha inaa chiyle.
Capa lie ca Israel ming Khazing rungnaana ca ningchiyluo taa khata aa vaw; a pu ca tiy lesapa pu haa khata cuo te alyi ca a rungnaana cata a khe.
I hmungpa muocuo ca khypuv para riypata aa vaw ning i za hmungpa haa khata hne Khebar cavaa kielie i za hmungpa haa khata cuo te, alyi lie kha i bu.
Abyiparungnaana ca biena-ing chung luo kha ningchiyluo a hyipa thlake taa khata aa ngie.
Thlaapa ta kama kha na caba te a chung tlawhmie luo kha inaa chiy; cakhutaata Abyiparungnaana ca biena-ing chunglie kha a bi.
Cawsaa pakha kama athaalie aa daa nguoluopa khata biena-ing chungtaa cata pakhakha ta bie ina rihnepa kha i thyi.

Kama kyihuo khata: Cawsaapa, hingpa hmang hing i byithude china hmang, i phyi pachungna hmang, Israel ming'a lie chuozaa ta i awna riypa hmang tana a cuo. Israel ming, iema acuolikie ama siepahruo tie ta i ming pathepa kha siyhrawna ta cuose, ama thiy tiyta ama siepahruo tie riyy ta cuose, na papyapalyi'a va tli yi.

Siepahruo tie ta ama ingchiypakaa tluo hne ama ingchiypakaa tung kha kama ingchiypakaa tluo hne ingchiypakaa tung athaalie ama chi tiyta cuose, kama hne iema alalalie kha tlepie suokha dyi a aw tiyta cuose, duvsamakhie aa chiypa ama tuepa khata i ming pathepa kha ina papyapalyi yi; caacuonakawta i hihaana myi ta a kuo yi.
Ata hing ca, kuvtuezuv amaa biena hne ama siepahruo tie riyy kha kama'a taata luohlaasa luo thaw yi sala, iema'a lie kha chuozaa ta i aw aa.
Caacuonakawta cawsaapa, biena-ing kaw kha Israel ming'a lie ca ri tie, a le a caw kha taa yi sala, ama suena cuo khata ama nang zaa se.

Ama tuepa bangkhuo cuo khata ama nang a zaa tiyta, biena-ing cuota tingna, biena-ing hne a chunglie pachiepazuzya, a ngiena hne pyana ingchiypakaa tie, aa suona hne le a caw tapa bangkhuo, a ziyphung hne a phungbie bangkhuo hne tingtuona bangkhuo; capa bangkhuo kha ama tue the riypa hne ama ziy the riypata ama hmungna lieta cape tie.
Hingpa hing biena-ing ziyphung ta a cuo: biena-ing ama sanapa tluodaw hne a cahriy ruoriy chung bangkhuo ca a pathe cepa tana a cuo. Hingpa hing biena-ing phungbie ta a cuo.

Hingpa tie hing bienatluophie kha daw ta taanapa ta a cuo (daw kha ca daw kha ang kha pazaa tie ta a cuo): a hruopatu ca daw kha aa suo aa, a kuna daw kha ta cuo'a te, a chi aa dung pata a tluo ca kha kha ta a cuo aa. Bienatluophie aa suona ca hingpa hingta a cuo aa:

Alyi lie a hruopatu taata aa ne cepa duo a tluo te ca daw hning ta cuo'a te, a kuna ca daw kha ta a cuo aa; cakhutaata a caw cepa duo a tluo taata a le cepa duo a tluo te ca daw paliy ta cuo'a te, a kuna daw kha ta a cuo aa.
Bienatluophie buvca ca daw paliy a suo'a te, buvca taa cata a kiy suopaliy aa daa aa.
Bienatluophie buvca ca a tung a haa aa khing aa, a syina daw hraa hlyihning, a kuna daw hraa hlyihning ta a cuo aa.

A duo zaw ca a tung a haa aa khing aa, daw hraa hlyipaliy syi'a te daw hraa hlyipaliy a ku aa, a chi aa dung pata pasipa a tluo ca daw che a chaa aa, cakhutaata a hruopatu ca daw kha chaa'a te a kienapa hlyidaw ca ningchiyluo kha aa hyi aa.

Cakhutaata kama kyihuo khata: Cawsaapa, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa tie hing bienatluophie ziyphung ta ama cuo aa: Bienatluophie sa palang pata cuo te a cunglie myirue panaana pihluo tiyta hne thiyse hi tiyta,
Levi tluobyi Zadok ingchungkhue khana i thaa luo a vaw pata i re a hrie'a yi; Abyipa Khazingta a ta. Iema kha sue pathe sa panaana lie hmuo riypata cuetungpa sakha na pi'a yi.

A thiy chekha kha la'a cate, bienatluophie cunglie padaapa kiy kiy paliy cunglie, a tluo kiy paliy cunglie hne a chi aa dung pata paze pa a tluo cung bangkhuo lie kha na chi aa; cahaacata pathe sa'a cate sue angiethena kha na tuepa aa.
Sue pathe sa panaana cuetungpa zaw kha la'a cate biena-ing dungkhuo chung, rite ciepa hmang lie kha myi rue pata a cuo aa; cuorasala a pathepa hmang ale luo lie kha tana a cuo aa.
A ning hningna lie kha sue pathe sa panaana cuota a dutlapa mietungpa kha la'a cate, cuetungpa ta pathe sa pata a cuopa haa khata bienatluophie ca na pathe sa aa.
Pathesana kha na patlung khutaata sahring zaw chungtaata a dutlapa cuetungpa hne tuvtungpa kha na pihluo aa.
Abyipahmiekunglie kha na pihluo'a yi, tluobyi tie ta a cunglie kha paciy phuv'a yi te, Abyipa'a luo kha myirue panaana ta ama pihluo aa.
Ning sariy chung kha ningting ta sue pathe sa panaana cuota mie sakha, sahring zaw chungtaata a dutlapa cuetungpa sakha hne tuvtungpa sakha pi pari pata a cuo aa.
Ning sariy chung kha bienatluophie cuo cata sue angiethena tue'a yi te, ama pathe aa, cakhutaata Khazing'a luo pihluo pata a cuo aa.

Capa ning zaw a chuo khutaata, ning carinapa taa khata tluobyi tie ta bienatluophie cunglie ca nama myirue panaana hne aviesaa panaana zaw kha ama pihluo aa; cakhutaata kama ta ica cuhluo'a yi, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Cakhutaata hmangpathepa aleluo thlake, ningchiyluo a hyipa luo kha na cakuokhyi pakhaa te thlake ca a zaa khaa.

Abyipata kama kyihuo khata: Hingpa thlake hing ca aa khaa pari aa; pahaw pata cuo buo'a vyi, ahunghmuo hingpa taa hingta a ngie'a va yi; tahematapakieca Abyipa, Israel Khazing na hingpa taa hingta a ngie; caacuonakawta hingpa hing ca khaa pari pata na a cuo aa.

Siepahruo dyina, siepahruo a cuo nakawta Abyipahmiekunglie sa ning riypata hingpa chunglie hing a tu aa; ama ca ing chung luo a ngienapa khuo thlake taa khata a ngie'a te, capa taa cata a pya pakhaa aa.
Cakhutaata chaluo thlake taata biena-ing hmiekung luo kha inaa chiyle pakhaa; Abyiparungnaana ta Abyipabiena-ing chunglie a za bipa kha hmung angte i bu.

Abyipata kama kyihuo khata, Cawsaapa, a phata tah a cake tie, a phata tah na mang la ica changpa Abyipa biena-ing hne aa patuvpa ziyphung hne phungbie zaw hing a phasa pata naathlie tie; cakhutaata biena-ing chung luo a ngie riypata a pathepa hne a pathe lipa hing ahung zaw tama ama cuo aa tapa zaw kha a phasa pata naathlie tie.
Rie thu a hmuopa mingphang, Israel ming'a lie kha, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Vya Israel ming, nama tuepa duvsamakhiepa kha pachuo sa tie ung.
Sa hne a thupa hne thiy ina pihluo ning ung cata pathiypalung hne saapa lieta vangdaw a te lipa ruohrang ming kha i hmangpathepa luo pangie ung cate, i biena-ing kha nama papyapalyi.
Niema ta a pathepa pihluona re kha hrie lipa ung cata, cuorasala i hmangpathepa lie kha niema cuota re hrie riypata ruohrang ming kha nama chi.
Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Israel cawsaa hrawlieta a awpa ruohrang ming bangkhuo, pathiypalung hne saapa lieta vangdaw a te lipa ruohrang ming ca i hmangpathepa luo kha a ngie'a va yi.
Cuorasala Israel ming luo ama pie ningta, kama'a taata luohlaa luo a sipa, ama kuvtuezuv hnang ziy yi te luo a piepa Levi ming ca duotena kha ama ang aa.

Iema ca i hmangpathepa lie kha re hrie'a yi te, biena-ing thlake kha ama mangchiy aa, biena-ing chunglie kha re ama hrie aa; myirue panaana hne hriykhungrina sahring kha cawsaa zaw cuota thie'a yi te re ama hrie aa.

Iema ta ama kuvtuezuv zaw hmiekunglie kha ama re za hriepa yi te, Israel ming kha pha lina chunglie amaa pachiy riypata ama za tue, caacuonakawta iema ca duotena khana ama ang aa ta pata iema kawlie kha chie i zaa sa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.

Iema ca tluobyi re hrie pata kama kha naa ngie'a va yi, kama huopa a pathepa pihluona khaapa luo kha hmuo a vaw li'apa yi ta, a pathe cepa luo kha a vaw'a va yi; cuorasala ama tuepa duvsamakhiepa hne aa pazue pata nangzaana kha ama ang aa.
Cuorasala biena-ing re hrie riypata chi'a yi angte, capa chunglie hrie riypa bangkhuo kha iema ca i pi'a yi.

Cuorasala Levi tluobyi tie, Zadok ciypathla tie, kama'a taata Israel ming luo ama pie ningta i hmangpathepa re a hriepa tie ca i re hrie riypa khata kama'a luo a vaw'a yi te, kama kha na mangsang'a yi te a thupa hne thiy zaw kha ina pihluo'a yi, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Iema ca kama hmangpathepa luo kha i re hrie riypata a ngie'a yi te, i changpa yi kha inaa ngie'a yi.
Iema ta a chung tlawhmie thlake taata amaa ngie tiyta, cawthang phapa kha amaa tue aa; a chung tlawhmie lie hne a chunglie re ama hrie tiyta ama cunglie saahming ta taapa caw a hryi'a va yi.
Cawthang phapa pawde kha ama luv lie a paw'a yi te, cawthang phapa ta taapa tawhryi kha amaa hryi aa; ama mathle a palyi sa riypa tesaw a saw'a va yi.

A le tlawhmie lie cawsaa tie'a luo ama pya tiyta, re ama hrienapa cawsie kha thlie'a yi te a pathepa khuo chunglie kha ama chisiy aa; tahematapakieca ama cawsie khata pathena kha cawsaa zaw'a luo cakuokhyi pathlyi'a kie yi tana ta a cuo.
Ama luv a pamyi'a va yi, ama suo zaw a pasyi'a va yi; ama suo kha aa te dyina amaa te aa.
Tluobyi ca a chung tlawhmie luo a ngie ning kha mingsuvtiy dang'a vyi.
Nunghlyi cuose, a navaapa hne a chepa cuose, napuv ta hnyi'a vyi, cuorasala Israel ming sacanung lesaata a cuopa cuose, tluobyi ta a thiysepa nunghlyi dyi kha napuv ta a hnyi aa.
Iema ta i cawsaa zaw kha a pathepa hne a cakhawpa aa nanangnazya kha ama pacuv aa, cakhutaata a pyapa hne a pathepa kha tuokhaatama ma thleduo aa tapa zaw kha ama pahmung sa aa.

Bie a ina a aw tiyta bieripatuv cuo'a yi te, kama biechipana phung haata bie ama chipa aa. Ama'a na a cuo lieta tuepa biena pyi lie kha i phungbie hne i phungluo kha ziy'a yi te, i sabbath zaw kha ama pathe sa aa.
Nung hne paa, sacapaa hne sacanung, uvnu hne navaa a hnyi lipa sieta, ta li pata ca a thiypa riyy luo kha cakuo pata a papya a palyi'a va yi.
Amaa pathe sa khutaata ning sariy kha huo'a yi te cakhutaa cata ama pathe aa.
Hmang pathepa lie re hrie riypata, hmang pathepa a chung tlawhmie chung luo aa ngie ning ca ama cuota sue pathe sa panaana kha a pihluo aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Hingpa zaw hingna iema ama cupa ru ta a cuo aa: Kama ca ama cupa ru ta i cuo; Israel ruo chunglieta cuvu khaapahmuo pi'a va ung ciy; kama hingna ama cuvu ta a cuo ang.
Iema ca sa ta panaana, sue pathe sa panaana, hne sue a ngiethe panaana lie pihluopa kha ning'a yi te, Israel ming ta Khazing'a luo ama pipa mekaa khana ama ning aa.

Sathaapa tie chungtaata a pha cepa tie phangting, nama pihluopa phangting bangkhuo khana tluobyi ta ama cu aa; nama ingchungkhue lie thluechiy nama ting riypata nama pasu taapa viechuo tluo kha kha tluobyi nama pi aa.
Tluobyi ca amata tah a thiypa hne saa ta a siepa pavaa acuolikie saruopa mekaa kha ning'a va yi.

Ruo kha ru ta nama re tiyta Abyipacuota a pathepa ruo cuo riypata a syina daw thawkiy thawpangaa hne a kuna daw thawkiy a tapa ruo suokha kha a nanang ta nama chi aa; capa ruo ca a yalya ta a pathepa ta a cuo aa.
Capa chungtaa cata daw zapangaa daw zapangaa ta a tung a haa aa khingpa ca hmangpathepa cuo'a te, capa ca a chi aa dung pata daw sawngaa a kupa alyi kha nama patlaw aa.

Hingpa hmang chunglie hing suv kha kha taa'a ung cate, capa hmang ca a syina daw thawkiy thawpangaa, a kuna daw thawhraa ta cuo'a te, capa chunglie ca hmangpathepa, hmang pathe cepa hmang ta a cuo aa.

Capa ca a pathepa cuvu alyi ta cuo'a te, a re hrie riypata Abyipa'a luo a ngie pata hmangpathepa lie re a hriepa tluobyi tie cuota a cuo aa; cakhutaata tluobyi tie ama ing cuota hne hmangpathepa cuota a pathepa hmang ta a cuo aa.
Aa ngaapa alyi chunglieta a syina daw thawkiy thawpangaa hne a kuna daw thawhraa ca biena-ing lie re a hriepa Levi ming ama awna khypuv cuota a cuo aa.

Khypuv khy kha sana riypata a syina daw thawkiy thawpangaa, a kuna daw thawpangaa a tapa hmang kha rite ung la, capa ca a pathepa hmang cuota ritepa hneta aa phapa khata cuo'a te, Israel ming bangkhuo cuota a cuo aa.

Cakhutaata a pathepa hmang hne khypuv sanapa a kuo vyicuo lie, a pathepa hmang hne khypuv sanapa tathlyalya lie khata siepahruo ta ruo a hnyi aa, Israel ming phang kha ta ama cupa zaa a syipa khata ningtlaluo kuo hne ningchiyluo kuo ta a cuo aa, ningtlaluo ca ningtlaluo kuo ritepa ruo a chuona te ta cuo'a te ningchiyluo zaw ningchiyluo kuo ritepa ruo a chuona te ta a cuo aa.
Capa ca Israel ruo chunglie ama cuvu ta a cuo aa. I siepahruo ca ta i cawsaa zaw kha hrisaa'a va tli yi; cuorasala Israel ming kha ama phang cyicuo ta ruo hnyina naw ama pi aa.

Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: A de buo se, Israel siepahruo tie! Tuechiena hne hrisaana kha thaw ung la, biedangpa hne aa hmuopa kha tue tie ung. I cawsaa tie kha ruo chungtaata papya khah tie ung, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Nama cyilung ca aa hmuopa cuo se, nama ephah zaw aa hmuopa cuo se, nama bath zaw aa hmuopa cuo se.

Sa nama panangnapa ephah hne chiytiy nama taanapa bath ca a khing yi se, bath suokha ca homer che hraa che kha ta cuo'a te, ephah suokha ca homer che hraa che kha ta a cuo aa; homer ca a suohning cuota aa hmuopa a mangpuona taana ta hmuo pata a cuo aa.
Shekel suokha ca gerah suokiy ta a cuo aa. Nama mina ca shekel suokiy aa riypa a aw aa, shekel suokiy suopangaa aa riypa a aw aa, shekel suohraa hlyipangaa aa riypa a aw aa.
Hingpa hing nama tue riypa panaana ta ama cuo aa: Jungsacuo homer suokha taata ephah che caruv che kha, barli homer suokha taata ephah che caruv che kha,
chiytiy kor kha taata bath che hraa che kha (kor kha ca bath suohraa ta a cuo);
Israel phang chungtaata zahning a tapa tuvrung suokha taata tuv sakha. Capa ca sa ta panaana, myirue panaana, hne aviesaa panaana, iema cuota sue angiethena cuo ta a cuo aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Ruo chunglie cawsaa bangkhuo ta hingpa panaana zaw tuena riypa hingta Israel siepahruo'a luo kha ama va pi aa.

Cuorasala Israel ming ta ama'a na a cuo lieta tuepa pyi tie ta a cuopa myirue panaana, sa ta panaana, hne dangpa ta panaana pyi tie lie kha siepahruo ta pihluo riypa hrievu a hnyi. Israel ming cuota sue angiethena tue riypata sue pathe sa panaana, sa ta panaana, myirue panaana hne aviesaa panaana cuota aa hupa tie kha ama ta a thu aa.
Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Thla khana ning khana lieta a dutlapa cue atungnupa sakha kha la'a ung cate hmangpathepa kha nama pathe sa aa.

Tluobyi ta sue pathesana lie pihluopa sahring a thiy chekha kha la'a te chiypakaa tung lie cuose, bienatluophie tluo a kiy suopaliy lie kha cuose, a chung tlawhmie thlake tung lie kha cuose a hnie'a yi.
Thlaa ning sariyna lie zaw kha tue tlamuna hne pachang lina kawlieta a suepa mekaa cuo khata cahaa ngiethie cata tue'a ung cate, biena-ing cuota sue angiethena nama hie aa.
Thla khana, ning hraa hlyipaliy ning kha lawsena pyi tue'a ung cate, cakhutaata ning sariy chung kha thiynung phuv lipa viechuo kha nama ning aa.
Capa ning lie ca siepahruo ta ama huo hne ruo cawsaa bangkhuo cuo khata sue pathe sa panaana cuota cue atungnupa sakha kha a pi aa.

Pyi chung ning sariy chung kha ningting ta a dutlapa cuetungpa sa sariy hne tuvtungpa sa sariy kha Abyipa'a luo pihluo riypa myirue panaana cuota a pi aa; cakhutaata mietungpa zaw kha sue pathe sa panaana cuota ningting ta a pi aa.
Siepahruo ta sa ta panaana cuota cuetungpa sakha cyicuo huo khata ephah suokha, tuvtungpa sakha cyicuo huo khata ephah suokha, sa ephah suokha cyicuo huo khata chiytiy hin kha a thu aa.
Thla sariy thlaa, ning hraa hlyipangaa ning hne pyi ning ning sariy lie zaw kha sue pathe sa panaana, myirue panaana, sa ta panaana, hne chiytiy cuo zaw khata ama ta a thu ngiethie aa.

Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Ningchiyluo ta a hyipa a chung tlawhmie thlake ca re hrie ning ning caruv chung ca khaa pari pata a cuo aa; cuorasala sabbath ning ca pahaw pata cuo'a te thla thaapa ning lie zaw kha pahaw pata a cuo aa.

Siepahruo ca a chung luo a ngienapa khuo thlake taa khata a ngie'a te, thlake tung athaalie khata aa daa aa. Tluobyi ta myirue panaana hne aviesaa panaana pihluo'a te, thlake a ngiena lie ca aa bung aa. Cakhutaa cata ama ca pya'a te cuorasala thlake ca zuoluocaw te ta khaa pata cuo'a vyi.
Sabbath ning hne thla thaapa ning lie ca ruo chunglie cawsaa zaw ca capa thlake a ngienapa, Abyipahmiekunglie kha amaa bung aa.
Sabbath ning ta siepahruo ta Abyipa'a luo a pihluopa ca a dutlapa tuvtaata sa caruv hne a dutlapa tuvtungpa sakha ta a cuo aa.
Tuvtungpa hneta pihluohne riypa sa ca ephah suokha ta a cuo aa, tuv zaw hneta pi pakhaw riypa sa ca a pi khing zaa ta cuo'a te, ephah suokha kyry lie kha chiytiy hin kha a pakhe aa.
Thla thaapa ning lie ca a dutlapa cue atungnupa sakha, a dutlapa tuvtaata sa caruv hne tuvtungpa sakha kha a pihluo aa.
Sa ta panaana cuo khata cuetungpa hneta ephah suokha, tuvtungpa hneta ephah suokha hne tuvtaata zaw hne khata a khing zaa ta a pihluo aa; ephah suokha cyicuo lie kha chiytiy hin kha a pakhe aa.
Siepahruo ca aa ngie tiyta a khuo chung luo angiena taa khata a ngie'a te capa luopuv taa ngiethie cata a pya aa.

Ama'a na a cuo lieta tuepa pyi ningta cawsaa tie Abyipahmiekung luo ama vya chiy tiyta, chaluo thlake taata a ngiepa tie ca sungluo thlake taata pya'a yi te, sungluo thlake taata a ngiepa tie ca chaluo thlake taata ama pya aa; amaa ngienapa thlake taa khata pya'a va yi, cuorasala caluo pathla'a yi te na ama pya aa.
Siepahruo ca a zaa ngie tiy khata iema hne cata zaa ngie ra'a te ama pya tiyta a pya ra aa.

Pyi ning hne ama'a na a cuo ta tuepa pyi ning kha cue atungnupa sakha hneta pi hne riypa sa ta panaana ca ephah suokha ta a cuo aa, tuvtungpa hneta ephah suokha ta a cuo aa, tuv zaw hneta a pi khing zaa ta a cuo aa, ephah suokha lie chiytiy hin kha a pakhe lawmaw aa.

Siepahruo ta myirue panaana cuose, aviesaa panaana cuose, ama palung thu ta Abyipa'a luo pihluona a tue khing tiyta, ningchiyluo a hyipa thlake ca pahawpa pata a cuo aa; cakhutaata myirue panaana hne aviesaa panaana kha sabbath ning a tuepa haa khata a tue aa. Cakhutaata pya'a te, a pya khutaata thlake ca khaa pata a cuo aa.
Ning tating ta Abyipa'a luo myirue panaana lie pihluo riypata kung kha a tapa a dutlapa tuv kha a pi aa; maw kha hnang maw kha ta a pi aa.

Cakhutaata capa maw tating cata sa ta panaana zaw kha pihluo pari'a te, ephah che caruv che kha, hne chiytiy hin che thung che kha kha jungsacuo viedie phapa hne pya ciepa ta Abyipa'a luo myirue panaana cuota a pihluo aa; capa ca cipari ziy riypa ziyphung ta a cuo aa.
Cahaacata tuv hne sa ta panaana hne chiytiy ca pi pata cuo'a te, myirue panaana cuota maw kha hnang maw kha ta pi pari pata a cuo aa.

Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Siepahruo ta a rucutuv a sacapaa zaw chungtaata pakhakha kha lasaw suokhakha a pi khing biephung kieca, capa ca a sacapaa zaw cuota cuo'a te, ru ta amaa hnyi riypata a cuo aa.

Cuorasala a changtaapa tie kha lasaw ta a ru chungtaata suokhakha a pi kie yi ca, capa ca changtaapa taata hyazangna a hmung kung te kha ama huopa ta cuo'a te, ca khutaata ca siepahruo'a huopa tana a cuo pakhaa aa; a sacapaa zaw dyi khana ru ta a hnyi pathla khu'a yi.

Siepahruo ta cawsaa tie ama hnyipa ama ru suokhakha kha hruohra ta lapa'a va yi; a sacapaa zaw kha ama a hnyipa chung taa dyi ta pi'a yi te, i cawsaa pakha hmuota ama hnyipa kha chuv pata cuo'a va yi.
Cakhutaata kama kha thlake athaalie a ngienapa taata na pyakhyi te, chaluo kuo ta aa patluopa tluobyi tie a pathepa khuo luo kha ina cakuokhyi; ningtlaluo kuo a denapa kha ina pahmung.

Kama kyihuo khata, “Hingpa hmang hing ca a le tlawhmie luo pyakhyipa a cuo li riypa hne pathena kha cawsaa zaw'a luo pa pha sapa a cuo li riypata tluobyi tie ta sue a ngiethe panaana hne sue pathe sa panaana saa ama pasunapa hmang hne sa ta panaana viechuo ama tuenapa hmang tana a cuo,” ina ta.
Cakhutaata a le tlawhmie luo kha na pyakhyi te, tlawhmie kiy paliy luo kha ina cakuokhyi, capa a kiy cyicuo lie ca aa pazue pata tlawhmie taata kha ama aw kaluo.
A kiy paliy lieta tlawhmie ca tlawhmie a taata ta cuo yi te, a syina daw sawliy ta cuo te a kuna daw sawthung ta a cuo; a suopaliy cata a le a caw amaa khing diy.
Capa tlawhmie taata a chungluo a chi aa dungpa cata alung parepa ta nepa caaca kha a tluo ta aw te myi patiyna riypata buvca a aw diy.
Cakhutaata kama kyihuo khata, “Hingpa tie hing ca cawkaa ta cuo te biena-ing lie re a hriepa tie ta cawsaa ta hriykhung amaa rinapa saa ama pasunapa hmang tana a cuo,” ina ta.

Cakhutaata biena-ing thlake luo kha inaa chiy pakhaa; capa lie ca, biena-ing thlake a ngiena raw taa cata ningchiyluo ta tiy a langpa kha i hmung (biena-ing ca ningchiyluo kuo ta aa hyi); tiy ca biena-ing sungluo kuo a rawlie, bienatluophie sungluo kuo khata a za lang bung.
Cakhutaata chaluo thlake luopuv taa khata na pyakhyi te ningchiyluo a hyipa a le thlake athaa luo kha inaa chiy; tiy ca sungluo kuo lie ca a kya pya pathla ciemuo.
Cawsaapa ca a kuv lieta taanapa asung suokha kha a hrie te, daw thawkha a taa, cakhutaata tiy ca na va pate sa te, cakhaw te aa thuv.
Daw thawkha taa pakhaa te, tiy ca ina va pate sa pakhaa; pakhuv cuo aa thuv. Daw thawkha taa pakhaa hyi te, tiy ca ina va pate sa pakhaa; se te aa thuv tli.
Daw thawkha taa pakhaa te, cavaa ca te khu va tli ang, tahematapakieca tiy ca le tuv tli te, aa zu ta a zu khang ta aa thuv tli, te khu lipa cavaa ta a cuo tli.
Ama ta, “Cawsaapa, hingpa hing na hmung cuo ma?” ina ta. Cakhutaata cavaa kie khata tathlyalya inaa chiyle.
I kya kaa pakhaa ca, cavaa kie a kuo hning lie kha thingkungpa a hluvsa a awpa kha i hmung.
Kama kyihuo khata, “Hingpa tiy hing ningchiyluo ta lang te Arabah luo khana a lang bung; riyliy luo aa ngie tiyta, tiy thiypa riyliy ca tiy thlungpa ta a pali aa.

Capa cavaa a langnapa lie ca sapa a hringpa phang mekaa ca ama hring aa, capa cavaa lie ca ngaa a hluv hringhruo aa. Tiy thlungpa a cuo nakawta, capa cavaa a langna bangkhuo lie ca zezaw ting kha ama hring aa.

Engedi taata En-eglaim te riyliy kie lie ca cawsaa kha a daa'a yi te ngaa ama patuv aa; capa hmang ca asue ama phunapa hmang ta a cuo aa; Riyliy Lepa lie haa khata ngaa phangting kha a phuv lesa pata ama aw.
Cuorasala aa caa hne a tiy-ang cawta tie ca a tiy kha thlung'a vyi; paciy pyana riypata ama cuo aa.

Cavaa kie a kuo hning lie ca ningsa a phapa thingkung phangting ama pu aa. Ama hnaa kha a uv'a vyi, ama thyi zaw zung'a vyi, cuorasala a pahuosapa thyi kha thla tating ta ama pathyi aa, tahematapakieca capa tiy ca biena-ing taata zaa langpa tiy tana a cuo. A thyi ca sa cuota cuo'a te a hnaa ca tluona siyy cuo tana a cuo aa,” ina ta.
Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Israel ming phang hraa hlyihning tie kha ru ta na che riypa yi ruo a ruoriy ca hing haa hingta a cuo. Josef ca vu suohning a cu aa.
Aa khingsa pata na re'a yi, vyisung a da pata nama cupa alyi ca nama ru ta a cuo aa.
Ruoriy ca hing haa hingta a cuo aa: Chaluo kuo ta, Riyliy Lepa taata patha pata Hethlon hne Lebo-hamath hne Zedad te,
Berothah, Sibraim (hingpa hing Damaskas hne Hamath ruoriy alalalieta a awpa tana a cuo), taata patha pata Hauran ruoriy lie a awpa Hazer-hatticon te khata a caluo aa.
Caacuonakawta ruoriy ca riyliy taata Damaskas ruoriy chaluo kuo ta a cuopa Hazar-enon te khata chaluo ta a sithaw aa. Capa ca chaluo kuo ruoriy ta a cuo aa.
Ningchiyluo kuo, Hauran hne Damaskas, Gilead hne Israel ruo alalalie Jordan cavaa kha tathlyalya ta ruoriy ta a cuo aa; ningchiy riyliy hne Tamar te khata. Capa ca ningchiyluo kuo ruoriy ta a cuo aa.
Sungluo kuo ca, Tamar taata patha'a te Meribath-kadesh tiy te, capa taa cata Izipt cavaata taata Riyliy Lepa te ta a cuo aa. Capa ca sungluo kuo ruoriy ta a cuo aa.
Ningtlaluo kuo ca, Riyliy Lepa kha ruoriy ta cuo'a te Lebo-hamath a rie-e te khata a cuo aa. Capa ca sungluo kuo ruoriy ta a cuo aa.
Caacuonakawta hingpa ruo hing Israel ming mingphang pha zaa hne aa ziy pata na che'a yi.

Nama ta vyisung pada sa'a yi cate niema cuota hne ruohrang ming niema'a lie a awpa tie hne niema hrawlie sacapaa a sapa tie kha ru ta na che'a yi. Iema ca nama cuo ta Israel ming haa khata ama cuo aa; niema hneta Israel ming mingphang zaw hrawlie kha ruo ca nama re ra aa.
Ruohrang ming ca khaapa mingphang hrawlie ama aw zawta, capa lie ca ama ru kha nama pi ra aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.

Israel mingphang tie ming ca hingpa hingta a cuo: Chaluo kuo ruoriy taata pathu pata, Hethlon luopuv lie Lebo-hamath taata Hazar-enon (Damaskas ruoriy lie chaluo kuo ta Hamath) te, ningchiyluo kuo taata ningtlaluo kuo te kha Dan cuvu ta a cuo aa.
Dan ruoriy a kya paziy pata, ningtlaluo taata ningchiyluo te khata Asher cuvu ta a cuo aa.
Asher ruoriy a kya paziy pata, ningtlaluo taata ningchiyluo te khata Naftali cuvu ta a cuo aa.
Naftali ruoriy a kya paziy pata, ningtlaluo taata ningchiyluo te khata Manasseh cuvu ta a cuo aa.
Manasseh ruoriy a kya paziy pata, ningtlaluo taata ningchiyluo te khata Efraim cuvu ta a cuo aa.
Efraim ruoriy a kya paziy pata, ningtlaluo taata ningchiyluo te khata Reuben cuvu ta a cuo aa.
Reuben ruoriy a kya paziy pata, ningtlaluo taata ningchiyluo te khata Judah cuvu ta a cuo aa.

Judah ruoriy a kya paziy pata, ningtlaluo taata ningchiyluo te khata a hrangta tah nama chi riypa vu ta a cuo aa, a kuna daw thawkiy thawpangaa, a syina ca mingphang phang kha ta a cupa a syina zaa kha, ningchiyluo kuo taata ningtlaluo kuo te ta cuo'a te a liekhingkhuo lieta hmangpathepa a aw aa.
Abyipa cuota na chi pathlyi riypa cuvu ca a syina daw thawkiy thawpangaa, a kuna daw thawkiy ta a cuo aa.

Hingpa hing a pathepa cuvu ta a cuo aa: tluobyi tie ta cuvu ama hnyi aa, chaluo kuo ta daw thawkiy thawpangaa, ningtlaluo kuo ta a kuna daw thawhraa, ningchiyluo kuo ta a kuna daw thawhraa, cakhutaata sungluo kuo ta a syina daw thawkiy thawpangaa, Abyipahmangpathepa ca a liekhingkhuo lieta a aw aa.
Capa hmangpathepa ca Israel ming luo ama za pie ningta Levi ming ta ama za pie rapa haata luo zaa pie lipa tie, pathe sapa tluobyi, i re a hriepa Zadok ciypathla tie cuo tana a cuo aa.
Capa ca a pathepa cuvu ruo chungtaata iema ta a hlyi ta ama cupa cuvu ta cuo'a te, hmang pathe cepa ta a cuo aa; Levi ming ruoriy kha a kya paziy aa.

Tluobyi tie ruoriy tathlyalya cata Levi cuvu ta a cuo aa. A syina daw thawkiy thawpangaa hne a kuna daw thawhraa ta a cuo aa. A syina luo bangkhuo ca daw thawkiy thawpangaa hne a kuna daw thawkiy ta a cuo aa.
Capa mekaa ca iema ta zaa'a va yi, a thle zaw thle'a va yi; hingpa a pha cepa cuvu, ruo hing malie'a luo pi pachaa khu pata cuo'a vyi, tahematapakieca Abyipacuo ta a pathepa tana a cuo.
Aa ngaapa, a kuna daw thawpangaa hne a syina daw thawkiy thawpangaa hing ca khypuv cuota cuo'a te, awna riypa hne ruo tlawpa ta a cuo aa. Capa a liekhingkhuo lie ca khypuv ta a cuo aa.

A le a caw ca hing haa hingta a cuo aa: chaluo kuo daw thawpaliy zapangaa, sungluo kuo daw thawpaliy zapangaa, ningchiyluo kuo daw thawpaliy zapangaa, ningtlaluo kuo daw thawpaliy zapangaa ta a cuo aa.
Khypuv ca ruo tlawpa hnyi'a te, chaluo kuo ta daw zahning sawngaa, sungluo kuo ta daw zahning sawngaa, ningchiyluo kuo ta daw zahning sawngaa, ningtlaluo kuo ta daw zahning sawngaa ta a cuo aa.

A pathepa cuvu ta chipa a kie vyicuo bangkhuo ta a awpa pangaapa ruo ca ningchiyluo ta daw thawhraa, ningtlaluo ta daw thawhraa, sungluo ta daw thawhraa, chaluo ta daw thawhraa ta a cuo aa. A chungtaata a vyipa ca khypuv cuota ning riypa sa ta a cuo aa.
Israel phang bangkhuo taata rehrietuv tie ta capa ca ama thlu aa.
A nanang ta nama chi riypa ruo yalya ca a tung a haa aa khing pata a kuo cyicuo ta daw thawkiy thawpangaa ta a cuo aa, capa ca khypuv sana riypa alyi hne khata a pathepa ta a cuo aa.

A pathepa cuvu hne khypuv alyi a kuo vyicuo ca siepahruo alyi ta a cuo aa. A pathepa cuvu taata ningchiy ruoriy te daw thawkiy thawpangaa, ningtlaluo kuo kha ningtla ruoriy te ta daw thawkiy thawpangaa, mingphang tie ruo kie tathlyalya khata siepahruo ruo ta a cuo aa. A pathepa cuvu hne biena-ing hmangpathepa ca capa a liekhingkhuo lie ca ta a aw aa.
Levi ming huopa hne khypuv huopa ca siepahruo ta a hnyipa ruo khata lielie a patlung aa. Siepahruo cuvu ca Judah ruoriy hne Benjamin ruoriy alalalie khata a cuo aa.
Aa ngaapa Israel phang tie cuo ta ca: ningchiyluo kuo taata ningtlaluo kuo te kha Benjamin cuvu ta a cuo aa.
Benjamin ruoriy a paziy pata ningchiyluo kuo taata ningtlaluo kuo te kha Simeon cuvu ta a cuo aa.
Simeon ruoriy a paziy pata ningchiyluo kuo taata ningtlaluo kuo te ta Issakhar cuvu ta a cuo aa.
Issakhar ruoriy a paziy pata ningchiyluo kuo taata ningtlaluo kuo te kha Zebulun cuvu ta a cuo aa.
Zebulun ruoriy a paziy pata ningchiyluo kuo taata ningtlaluo kuo te kha Gad cuvu ta a cuo aa.
Gad cuvu a paziy pata sungluo kuo ruoriy ca Tamar taa khata si'a te, Meribath-kadesh tiy te, capa taa cata Izipt Cavaata tathlyalya khata Riyliy lepa te khata a cuo aa.
Hingpa hing ca Israel mingphang tie ru ta na re riypa yi ruo ta a cuo aa, capa ca iema cuvu ta a cuo aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Khypuv chungtaata pyanapa luopuv tie ca hing haa hingta a cuo aa: Chaluo kuo ca daw thawpaliy zapangaa ta cuo'a te,
thlake suothung, Reuben thlake, Judah thlake, hne Levi thlake ta pata khypuv thlake ming tie ca Israel phang ming paphya pata a cuo aa.
Ningchiyluo kuo ca daw thawpaliy zapangaa ta cuo'a te, thlake suothung, Josef thlake, Benjamin thlake, hne Dan thlake zaw ta ama cuo aa.
Sungluo kuo ca daw thawpaliy zapangaa ta cuo'a te, thlake suothung, Simeon thlake, Issakhar thlake, hne Zebulun thlake zaw ta ama cuo aa.
Ningtlaluo kuo ca daw thawpaliy zapangaa ta cuo'a te, thlake suothung, Gad thlake, Asher thlake, hne Naftali thlake zaw ta ama cuo aa.
A kuo bangkhuo ta khypuv cadung a syina ca daw thawhraa hlyicari ta a cuo aa. Capa cuo taa cata a patha pata khypuv ming ca, AbyipaAwna Hmang ta pata a cuo aa.
Judah Siepahruo Jehoiakim siepahruo a cuonapa kung thungna lieta Babilon Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ca Jerusalem kha a du te a cadung.

Abyipa ta Nebukhadnezzar ca Judah siepahruo Jehoiakim kha patuv sa te Khazing ing chunglieta biphie chekha kha a pala sa. Capa tie ca Shinar ruo luo kha sikhyi te khazing tie suethiy ing lie kha a chi.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ca ta a siepahruo ing uvtuv Ashpenaz kha bie pi te, Israel ming byi tie chungkhue taata

a pangpa cunglie tling lina a hnyi lipa, a puvthepa, a kuo ting lie singna a hnyipa, thesingna hne pachangkhuna a hnyipa satlie tie kha siepahruo ing lie re hrie riypata a patlaw sa. Iema ca Khaldi ming caa hne ryi kha a cuv riypata ama cuo.

Siepahruo ta iema ca siepahruo cabya lie sa hne mingsuvtiy khana nama pi aa, ta pata naw a pi yi. Iema ca kung thung chung singna a cuv'a yi te, capa cuo a chuo khutaa cata siepahruo re luo ca a ngie riypata a cuo aa.
Iema hrawlie ca Judah phang chungtaata Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, hne Azariah kha ama aw ra.
Siepahruo ing uvtuv ta iema ca ming hrangpa pi yi te: Daniel kha Belteshazzar, Hananiah kha Shadrak, Mishael kha Meshak, hne Azariah kha Abednego ta pata a ku yi.
Daniel ta siepahruo ta ina pipa siepahruo cabya sa hne mingsuvtiy hingta a papya a palyi'a va ang ta te, siepahruo ing uvtuv ca paa a kie.
Khazing ta Daniel ca siepahruo ing uvtuv'a taa khata tlechuona hne kawpacuona a pahmung sa.

Siepahruo ing uvtuv cata Daniel kyihuo khata, “Kama ca i byipaapa siepahruo khana i ciy; ama ta na ning riypa hne na dang riypa kha a ri pacie diy. Ama ta nama hne na khuvkha tie laata na zue viepa kha a hmung kieca i luv na ina sung'a ciy,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Daniel ta siepahruo ing uvtuv ta Daniel, Hananniah, Mishael, hne Azariah mangchiy riypata a chipa mangchiytuv'a luo kha vaa te:
“Ning hraa chung malie dyapasya thi tie. Ning riypata uohnaasiyyhnaa kha malie pi la, dang riypata tiy malie pi thi tie.
Kiema hmingsuo kha siepahruo cabya lie sa ning yi te mingsuvtiy a dangpa tie hmingsuo hne khata malie mangpakhing la malie na hmungna cunglie kha na khingna haata hrie tie,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta ama changpa ca a palung tling te ning hraa chung a dyapasya yi.
Ning hraa a chuo ningpa lieta iema hmingsuo ca siepahruo cabya lie sa ning yi te mingsuvtiy a dangpa tie hmingsuo laata a pha viepa kha a hmung.
Caacuonakawta mangchiytuv cata ama ning riypa siepahruo cabya sa hne mingsuvtiy ca a la te uohnaasiyyhnaa kha a pi yi.

Capa satlie papaliy tie ca Khazing ta thesingna hne caa luo hne singna lieta a kuo ting ta thena singna hne pachangna kha a pi yi; Daniel ca pachangkhuna hne muocuo hne muo palie khuna zaw kha a hnyi.
Siepahruo ta ama'a luo a ngiekhyi riypata a thlipa cuo a tling tiyta, siepahruo ing uvtuv ta iema ca Nebukhadnezzar hmiekung luo kha a ngiekhyi yi te,

siepahruo ca ta bie a rihne yi. Iema hrawlie ca Daniel, Hananniah, Mishael, Azariah tapa tie hneta pakhingpuo riypa pakha hmuo aw va yi; caacuonakawta iema ca siepahruo ing lie re hrie riypa khata ama chi.

Khaapa kawlieta hmuo cuose, siepahruo ta a hiehriypa yi hne a pachang khingpa kawlieta iema ca a pena chunglieta pacuo a thepa tie hne pamya a thepa bangkhuo laata le hraa ta ama the viepa kha a hmung yi.
Daniel ca capa lie ca Sairas Siepahruo ta siepahruo a cuonapa kung khana te khata a aw.
Nebukhadnezzar ca siepahruo a cuonapa kung hningna lie kha muo suokha sa te a palung rie a thyi tuv nakawta a hmung khu vyi.
Caacuonakawta siepahruo ta pacuo a thepa tie, pamya a thepa tie, ca-ie a thepa tie, hne Khaldi ming kha ku yi te a muo kha a hiehriy yi. Siepahruo'a luo kha a vaw yi te a hmiekunglie amaa tu tiyta,
iema kyihuo khata, “Muo suokha sa angte, i siyluo pachang khingnapa ta i palung rie a thyi hringhruo,” a ta yi.

Khaldi ming ta siepahruo kha Aramaik ryi ta palie yi te,” Vya siepahruo, na chuo pasiy thi mang sue! Na changtaapa zaw hing na muo ca malie chang thi tie, cakhutaata na a siyluo kha maca chang aa,” ama ta.

Siepahruo ta Khaldi ming ca palie yi te, “Hingpa hing cawsaazaapuv hne aa patuv pata i papyapa bie tana a cuo: niema ta i muo hne a siyluo kha a suohning ta ina chang khu li cakie ungca ca, nama kuv nama phyi kha ca suv pathla diy'a yi angte, nama ing ca para pata a cuo aa.

Cuorasala niema ta i muo hne a siyluo kha ina chang khu cakie ungca ca kama'a taata lasaw hne lawmuo hne pa-uvsathyina kha nama hmung aa. Caacuonakawta i muo hne a siyluo kha na chang tie ung,” a ta yi.
Iema ta palie pakhaa yi te, “Siepahruo ta na muo kha malie chang taa tie, cakhutaata na a siyluo kha maca chang khu aa,” ama ta.
Siepahruo ta palie yi te, “A cusa pata biechina i tue tli tapa kha nama pachang nakaw tana cuo nama paru vie cakhaw tapa kha a siesa pata i pachang:

I muo kha nama ri khu li kieca niema cuota duotena suokha dyina a aw. Niema ca hmang aa vya thlena te ta kama'a lie hangbie ri riypa hne a cuo lipa bie ri riypa tana palungtlingna nama hnyi. Caacuonakawta i muo ca na chang ung la, cakhutaata a siyluo kha ina chang khu'a ung ciy tapa kha i pachang aa,” a ta yi.

Khaldi ming ta siepahruo kha ama palie, “Siepahruo ta malie na hiehriypa hing alyi cunglieta a ri khupa aw'a va yi! Kha tluv ta a lesyipa hne a cahrapa siepahruo ta hmuo pacuo a thepa, pamya a thepa hne Khaldi ming kha hing haapa hing hiehriy buo va yi.
Siepahruo ta malie na hiehriypa hing a ruv tuv hringhruo, cawsaapa'a lie a aw lipa khazing tie ta li pata ca ahungtahmuo ca chang khu'a va yi,” ama ta.
Capa kawlie ca ta siepahruo ca a hi haa hringhruo te Babilon mingsing tie bangkhuo kha thie riypata bie a pi yi.
Nawbie ca papya pata cuo tli te, mingsing tie ca thie riypata a cuo tli; caacuonakawta Daniel hne a viesaa tie kha thie riypata ama cuo ra.
Cakhutaata Babilon mingsing tie kha thie riypata a thupa, siepahruo pangpa rievetuv riekabyipa Ariok kha Daniel ta a raaringsa pata hne singvaasa pata paa a va kie.
Ama ta Ariok kyihuo khata, “Siepahruo biechina ca khaapanakawma ca tluv nanaa cata a caruo?” a ta. Cakhutaata Ariok ta Daniel ca bie chiycuona kha a chang.
Caacuonakawta Daniel ta siepahruo hmiekung luo ca a ngie te, siepahruo ta cuo a pi riypa hne ama ta a muo siyluo a paliepa riypata paa a kie.
Cakhutaata Daniel ca a ing luo kha a diy te hmang a cuonazya kha a viesaa tie ta a cuopa Hananiah, Mishael, hne Azariah kha a pathyi sa yi.
