Cakhutaata ama Daniel hne a viesaa tie hne Babilon mingsing tie kha thie pata ama cuo li riypata capa pachang khu a ruvsapa hmang kawlie ca ta vuoruo Khazing'a taata nangduena hie riypata a chang yi.
Cakhutaata pachang khu a ruvsapa hmang ca zuo ta Daniel'a luo kha muocuo ta a luo te, Daniel ta vuoruo Khazing kha a pathuosa.
Daniel ta: “Chuo kha hnang chuo kha ta Khazing ming ca pathuosa pata cuo mang sue, tahematapakieca singna hne cahrana ca ama huopa tana a cuo.
Ama ta cuo hne khycuo zaw kha thle khu te, siepahruo kha pachung khu te a pakie khu; A singpa tie kha singna pi yi te, pachangna a hnyipa tie kha thesingna a pi yi.
Aa thuvpa hne aa nupa hmang kha a paluohuo khu; zingna chunglie khaapama a aw tapa kha pachang te, khena ca ama hne tana a aw.

Vya i mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing, nama ca caa law angte ica pathuosa, tahematapakieca nama ta singna hne cahrana kha na pi cate, kiema maacaa hiepa kha kama'a lie na paluohuo, siepahruo ta a pachang khingpa kha kiema'a lie na paluohuo.

Caacuonakawta Daniel ca siepahruo ta Babilon mingsing tie thie riypata re a pipa Ariok'a luo kha cakuo te, “Babilon mingsing tie kha thie khah yi; kama hing siepahruo hmiekung luo naa chiyle la, kama ta siepahruo muo kha i palie aa,” a ta.
Ariok ta Daniel kha siepahruo hmiekung luo ca a catli pata cakuokhyi te: “Judah ming sii ta vya sikhyipa tie hrawlie na siepahruo muo a siyluo a ri khu riypa kha i hmung,” a ta.
Siepahruo ta Daniel (Belteshazzar ta pata zaw kupa) kyihuo khata, “Nama ta i muo kha na chang khu'a cate, a siyluo zaw ina chang khu'a ca ma?” a ta.
Daniel ta siepahruo kha palie te, “Mingsing tie, pamya a thepa tie, pacuo a thepa tie, acuolikie hmungdawlutuv tie ahungtahmuo siepahruo ta na pachang khingpa hing ca chang khu'a va yi.

Cuorasala vuoruo lie a awpa Khazing dyina aa nupa hmang a phu khutuv ta a cuo, ama na hmieluo lieta khaapama a vya tlung aa tapa kha Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar hing caa chang. Naa hmung ningta na hmungpa na muo hne muocuo ca hingpa hing tana ama cuo:
Vya Siepahruo, ata taata hmieluo lie khaapa hmang ma a vya cuo aa tapa khana aa nupa hmang zaw a phu khutuv ta na iehmang cunglie naa zie nguoluo ning kha aca pahmung sa.

Hingpa aa nupa hmang kama'a lie phu pata a cuopa ca, kama hing cawsaa bangkhuo hrawlie i singce nakawta cuo vyi, cuorasala siepahruo ta na muo a siyluo kha na pachang khu riypa hne na palung chunglie na pacuopa tie kha na pachangkhuna riypa tana a cuo.

“Vya siepahruo, hmiehmie na pase nguoluo ning khata, kuvtuezuv a lesapa suokha kha na hmung. Capa kuvtuezuv ca a le hringhruopa ta cuo te, a kitliyliypa hne nang-uo aa chiysa pata a cuo; capa ca na hmiekunglie kha a daa te, a hmingsuo ca ciy aa chiysa pata a cuo.
Capa kuvtuezuv a luv ca siy aa thliepa ta a cuo, a cacunghnaa hne a buo zaw ca ngu ta a cuo, a pawpya hne a baw ca daa ta a cuo,
a phyi ca thaa ta cuo te, a phyipazaa chekha ca thaa ta cuo te chekha ca acyi ta a cuo.
Na mang nguoluopa khata amata tah alung suokha ca a cakhy te a zaa liebung, capa ca ta kuvtuezuv a phyipazaa, thaa hne acyi kha za phaw te a kepatlaa diy.

Cakhutaa cata thaa, acyi, daa, ngu, hne siy tie ca zapatlaa diy te, cuovuo ning suo-aciyna lie savie haa khata thliy ta luohlaa luo a phya diy, a zungpepa hmuo hmung khu pata cuo vyi. Cuorasala capa kuvtuezuv zaa phawpa alung ca tluo lesapa ta a li te alyi lie a bi.
“Hingpa hingna na muo ta a cuo; ata hing siepahruo kha a siyluo maca chang aa.
Vya siepahruo, nama ca siepahruo tie siepahruo ta cuo cate, vuoruo Khazing ta pena, cahrana, thaaruvna, rungnaana a pipa,
khaapa lie a awpa cawsaa a cuo zaw a kuv chung luo a pipa, saruopa zaw hne ruo, avuo lie a zupa pavaa zaw a pipa, capa zaw bangkhuo cunglie uvna naw a pipa, nama ca siy ta tuepa luv cata na cuo.
Nama khutaata nama tluv a lesyi lipa pena a vaw'a te, cakhutaata pena a suothungnapa, daa penapa a vaw aa, capa ca ta alyi cung bangkhuo kha a uv aa.
Cakhutaata pena suopaliynapa a vaw'a te, thaa haata a thaa a ruv aa; thaa ta zezaw ting kha a para a pakyipa haata capa pena cata pena hrangpa tie kha a pakyi a para'a yi.

A phyi hne a kuv daw tie ca a che kha bivytuv acyi ta cuo te, a che kha thaa ta a cuopa na hmungpa haata, capa pena ca aa chepa pena ta a cuo aa; cuorasala thaa ca acyi hne aa pyapa na hmungpa haa khata thaa cahrana chekha ca a chunglieta a aw aa.
A phyi hne a phyidaw zaw ca a che thaa ta cuo te, a che ca acyi ta a cuopa haata pena ca a che cahra'a te a che ca a baby aa.
Thaa ca acyi hne aa pyapa na hmungpa haa khata achiyhiena ta ruo kha hne ruo kha kha a pahlaw amaa zue aa, cuorasala thaa ca acyi hne aa pahlaw the lipa haa khata a pahlaw khu the'a va yi.

Capa siepahruo tie chuo lie ca ta vuoruo Khazing ta pena suokha padaa'a te, para khupa ta cuo li'a pata mingphang hrangpa tie kuv chung luo tla buo'a vyi. Capa pena cata pena hrangpa bangkhuo kha para diy'a te, chuozaa ta aa hmang aa.

Alung ca tluo cung taata amata tah cing te, thaa, daa, hne acyi, ngu, hne siy kha a dechipatlaa diypa yi na hmung. A lesyipa Khazing na siepahruo kha hmieluo khaapama a vya cuo aa tapa kha caa chang. Na muo ca capa ca ta cuo te, zang tluo aa tlapa a siyluo zaw ica chang tli,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ca alyi lie kha a bu te Daniel kha aa bie, sa ta panaana hne rangpa-ue pihluo riypata naw a pi yi.
Siepahruo ca ta Daniel kyihuo khata, “Na Khazing ca khazing tie Khazing, siepahruo tie Abyipa hne bieparuv a phupa tana a cuo, tahematapakieca nama ta hingpa bieparuv hing na phu tli!” a ta.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ta Daniel kha a re a pakie, lasaw muosung a hluvsa a pi, Babilon ruo yalya uvtuv hne Babilon mingsing bangkhuo luochiytuv ta a tue.
Daniel ta aa hiepa haa khata Shadrak, Meshak, hne Abednego kha Babilon ruo uvtuv byi ta a chi yi. Cuorasala Daniel ca siepahruo ing lie kha a aw.
Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ta siy kuvtuezuv suokha, aa suona daw sawcaruv hne a kuna daw caruv a tapa sa te, Babilon ruo Dura ase lie kha a padaa.

Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ta muokiy, ziype, vuothaw, ruena pituv, tuokaa caketuv, bieripatuv, upadi byi hne pe chunglie byi tie bangkhuo kha a tuepa kuvtuezuv pihluona luo vya chiy diy riypata a ku yi.
Caacuonakawta muokiy, ziype, vuothaw, ruena pituv, tuokaa caketuv, bieripatuv, upadi byi hne pe chunglie byi tie bangkhuo ca Nebukhadnezzar ta a tuepa kuvtuezuv pihluona luo ca amaa vya hmya kaluo.
Tluo-utuv ta khuopuv ta u te, “Vya mingphang ting, ruo ting, hne ryi ting a cyipa cawsaa zaw, niema ca naw pipa tana nama cuo,

niema ta saakiy, ramang, tingtuo, tingtuolepa, akhang, tungpa phangting ue hne hlaasana ue kha nama thyi tiyta, a bu'a ung cate Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ta a tuepa kuvtuezuv kha namaa bie aa, a ta yi.
A bung pata a bie lipa bangkhuo kha aa hlaa nguoluopa myipung chung luo kha thaw pata nama cuo aa,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta cawsaa ta saakiy, ramang, tingtuo, tingtuolepa, akhang, tungpa phangting ue hne hlaasana ue kha ama thyi tiyta, mingphang ting, ruo ting, hne ryi ting a cyipa cawsaa bangkhuo ca a bu yi te Nebukhadnezzar ta a tuepa siy kuvtuezuv ca amaa bie kaluo.
Capa cuo ning kha Khaldi ming chekha ta a vaw yi te Judah ming kha sue ama phaw.
Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar kyihuo khata, “Vya siepahruo, na hring pasiy thi mang sue!

Siepahruo ta naw papya cate, saakiy, ramang, tingtuo, tingtuolepa, akhang, tungpa phangting ue hne hlaasana ue kha nama thyi tiyta, mingphang ting, ruo ting, hne ryi ting a cyipa cawsaa bangkhuo ca a bu yi te Nebukhadnezzar ta a tuepa siy kuvtuezuv ca amaa bie diy aa,
a bung pata a bie lipa bangkhuo ca aa hlaa nguoluopa myipung chung luo na thaw pata nama cuo aa, na ta.

Nama ta Babilon ruo uvna mangchiy riypata re na pipa tie ca Judah ming Shadrak, Meshak, hne Abednego tana ama cuo. Vya siepahruo, iema ta nama kha siysaa ca ri va yi. Na khazing tie re kha hrie lipa yi ta, nama ta na chipa kuvtuezuv zaw kha abie va yi,” ama ta.
Ca tiyta Nebukhadnezzar ta a hihaasa pata Shadrak, Meshak, hne Abednego kha a paku sa yi; caacuonakawta capa tie ca siepahruo hmiekung luo kha ama chiykhyi.

Nebukhadnezzar ta iema kyihuo khata, “Shadrak, Meshak hne Abednego, niema ta i khazing tie re kha hrie li pata kama ta i chipa kuvtuezuv zaw kha abie khing va ung ciy, ama tapa ca biehmisi ta a cuo ma?

Ata hingta, niema ta saakiy, ramang, tingtuo, tingtuolepa, akhang, tungpa phangting ue hne hlaasana ue kha nama thyi tiyta kama ta i chipa kuvtuezuv kha a bung ung cate namaa bie kieca a pha thluo aa. Cuorasala namaa bie li kieca aa hlaa nguoluopa myipung chung luo kha thaw pata nama cuo aa, i kuv chung taa hingta caa khuo khupa yi khazing a aw'a mang nama ta ma?” a ta yi.
Shadrak, Meshak, hne Abednego ta siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Vya Nebukhadnezzar, hingpa kawlie hingta maca palie aa hupa khaapahmuo aw vyi.
Vya siepahruo, maa biepa Khazing hingta kiema hing aa hlaa nguoluopa myipung chung taa hingta malie a khuo kieca malie khuo se.
Malie a khuo khu li kie zawma na khazing tie re kha hrie li'apa pata na chipa kuvtuezuv zaw kha abie ra'a vapuv tapa kha, Vya siepahruo, nama ta pachang tie,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Nebukhadnezzar ca Shadrak hne Meshak hne Abednego cunglie kha a hi a haa hringhruo nakawta a hmie zaw a se diy.

Myipung kha ning hrang laata le sariy a ling vie riypata a patue sa yi. A rieka tie hrawlieta a thaa ruv cepa tie kha, Shadrak hne Meshak hne Abednego kha ciypaki'a ung cate aa hlaa nguoluopa myipung luo ca nama thaw aa ta pata naw a pi yi.
Caacuonakawta ama buohryi rawpatlung, ama tawhryi, ama lakhuv hne ama cawsie hrangpa zaw hne cata ciypaki yi te aa hlaa nguoluopa myipung chung luo ca ama thaw.
Siepahruo naw papyapa haata amaa pahraa tuv nakawta hne myipung ca a ling tuv nakawta Shadrak hne Meshak hne Abednego a calangpa cawsaa tie ca myihlaa ta la yi te ama thiy.
Cuorasala cawsaa pathung tie, Shadrak hne Meshak hne Abednego ca ciypaki ciepa cata myipung chung luo ca ama tla.

Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ca a nang ta uo te sungkha ta aa daa. Ruena a pituv tie kyihuo khata, “Ciypaki yi pate myipung chung luo ma thawpa tie kha pathung ta cuo va yi ma?” a ta yi. Iema ta siepahruo ca palie yi te, “Vya siepahruo, a cuo,” ama ta.
Ama ta palie yi te, “Cuorasala ciypaki li pata myipung chunglie cawsaa papaliy amaa khiepa na i hmung, myi zaw ta kuo va yi; a papaliynapa ca khazing hmingsuo na a lu,” a ta.

Nebukhadnezzar ta khuosa ta aa hlaa nguoluopa myipung pakaa luo ca vaa ngie vie te, “Shadrak hne Meshak hne Abednego, Cungnungce Khazing rehrietuv tie, vya pya tie ung, hingpa luo hing a vaw tie ung!” a ta. Caacuonakawta Shadrak hne Meshak hne Abednego ca myi chung taa cata ama vya pya.

Cakhutaata aa hmya pakhawpa ziype, vuothaw, upadi a thepa, hne siepahruo ruena a pituv tie ta hingpa cawsaa tie ama pangpa cunglie kha myi ta pha lina khaapahmuo tue khu vyi tapa ama hmung; ama suobuv buv kha hmuo kuo li pata, ama buohryi rawpatlung zaw suokha hmuo kuo vyi, iema zaw kha myikhuv rang hmuo pahnuo va yi.

Nebukhadnezzar ta, “Aa vuo ming kha za pathlie te ama a zangpa tie a khuotuv Shadrak hne Meshak hne Abednego Khazing ca thluechiypa ta cuo mang sue. Iema ca iema Khazing ta li pata khazing hrangpa re kha hrie khing li pata hne abie khing li pata siepahruo naw kha i yi te, iema pangpa kha amaa pi hriy.

Caacuonakawta hingpa naw hing i papya: Shadrak hne Meshak hne Abednego tie Khazing cunglie a ming ripachiena bie a ripa tuokhaapa cawsaa, tuokhaapa mingphang, hne tuokhaapa ryi a cyipa a cuo zaw nama kuv nama phyi kha suv pathla diy pata cuo'a ung cate nama ing ca para pata a cuo aa; tahematapakieca hing haa hingta cawsaa a khuo khupa khazing hrangpa aw vyi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ta Babilon ruo chunglie kha Shadrak hne Meshak hne Abednego ca ama re a pakie yi.
Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar na alyi cung mingphang bangkhuo, ruo bangkhuo hne ryi phang ting luo kha thuo caa pathyi yi ang: Nama cunglie thluechiyna aw se!
Kama cunglie Cungnungce Khazing ta a tuepa pamangsana hne kharuehaa hmang khana i ri pakhaa khing.

A tuepa pamangsana tie ca kha tluv tama ama le, a tuepa kharuehaa hmang tie ca kha tluv tama ama cahra! A uvna ca chuozaa ta aa hmangpa pena ta cuo te, a nawhnyina ca chuo kha hnang chuo kha ta aa hmang.
Kama, Nebukhadnezzar ca i ing lie kha hnaanguosa pata aw angte i siepahruo ing lie kha hnyi lunghruo tlungsa pata i aw.
I iehmang lie i zie nguoluo pata i sapa muo suokha hne i hmungpa muocuo khata i thlaa ina pazang.
Caacuonakawta Babilon mingsing tie bangkhuo ca i hmiekung luo a vya hmya yi sala i muo siyluo kha ina chang riypa yi ta naw suokha i papya.
Cakhutaata pacuo a thepa, pamya a thepa, Khaldi ming hne hmungdawlutuv tie ca a vaw yi te i muo kha i chang yi, cuorasala a siyluo kha na chang khu va yi.
A hnangcaw ce ta Daniel kha i hmiekung luo vya chiy te i muo ca i chang, ama ca i khazing ming ziy pata Belteshazzar ta pata ming paphyapa ta a cuo.

“Vya Belteshazzar, pacuo a thepa tie cunglie a the cepa, nama ca khazing pathepa tie thlaapa ta ca awpuo te khaapa bieparuv hmuo na cuo ta a ruv tuvpa aw vyi tapa kha i pachang. I hmungpa muocuo ca na naathliepa la a siyluo kha na chang tie.
I iehmang cunglieta i hmungpa ca hingpa hing tana a cuo; alyi liekhingkhuo lie kha thingkungpa suokha aw te, aa suo hringhruo.
Thingkungpa ca le hringhruo te, a daw ca avuo kya de te, a lyi dena taata hmuo hmung khu pata a cuo.

A nge hne a hnaa ca a puvthe hringhruo, a thyi a pathyisa nakawta, zezaw bangkhuo kha a ring khu yi. Ruo chunglie saruopa zaw ta a ningdiy lie canaw yi te, pavaa ta a ce lie kha ama buv amaa tue, capa taa cata a hringpa bangkhuo ca ama riy a bi.
Iehmang lie a zie angte i hmungpa muocuo kaw kha pacuo angte i mang nguoluopa cata, vuoruo taata a pathepa mangchiytuv pakha a za cungpa kha i hmung.

Ama ta khuosa ta khi te a ripa ca: ‘Thingkungpa kha hu ung la a ce kha pase diy tie ung, a hnaa kha cadaa diy ung la a thyi kha zepatlaa tie ung. Saruopa zaw kha a raw taa cata a ruo diy yi sala, a ce lieta pavaa zaw kha a zu diy yi se.

Cuorasala a caahming hne a thariy kha ca thaa buoliriy hne daa buoliriy ta ciy ung la, alyi lie aphuv hrawlie kha thuse tie ung. Avuo duotiy ta a pacingna te ta tlasue se. Alyi lie aphuv hrawlieta a awpa ruo chunglie saruopa haa khata cuo ra se.
A pathiypalung ca cawsaa pathiypalung ta cuo li tli pata, saruopa pathiypalung kha kung sariy chung phya se.

A hringpa bangkhuo ta ama pachangna riypa hne, Cungnungce ca cawsaapa pena a uvtuv tana a cuo tapa kha ama pachangna riypa tana, hingpa duotena hne biechina hing a pathepa mangchiytuv ta a pathepa nawpina ta a tue pata a cuo. Hingpa hing ama ta a khingpa kha pi khu te, aa ne cepa cawsaa cunglie kha hmuo a patlung sa khu,’ a ta.

Hingpa hingna kama, Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ta i hmungpa muo cata a cuo. I pena chunglie mingsing tie ta a siyluo kha ina chang khu li nakaw yi ta, nama, Belteshazzar ta a siyluo ca na chang tie. Tuokhaata a cuo zaw, tahematapakieca na chunglieta a pathepa khazing thlaapa a aw nakawta nama ta ca ina chang khu'a ciy,” a ta.

Belteshazzar ta pata zaw kupa ta a cuopa Daniel ca khuosa ta a thlaa zang te khaapahmuo ri khu paluo vyi. Kya rue te a kya ciysa. Cuorasala siepahruo ta, “Belteshazzar, i muo hne a siyluo ta na thlaa ca pazang khah se,” a ta. Daniel ta palie te, “I byipaapa, na muo hing nama caa huepa tie cuo ta cuo thi sala, a siyluo zaw hing na carie tie cuota cuo thi se!
Na hmungpa thingkungpa, a le hringhruopa, a daw kha avuo luo a chiy nakawta alyi dena taa te ta hmung khupa,

a nge hne a hnaa a puvthesapa hne a thyi a pathyisapa, zezaw bangkhuo kha a ring khupa, a ningdiy lieta ruo chung saruopa phang ting aw yi te, a ce lieta avuo lie a zupa pavaa zaw ta buv amaa tuenapa thingkungpa ca,
Vya siepahruo, nama tana na cuo. Nama ca kya lethaw cate na cahra hringhruo. Na lesyina ca lethaw te avuo te a pha, na uvna zaw alyi dena te a pha.

Nama ta na hmungpa, vuoruo taata zaa cungpa a pathepa mangchiytuv ta, ‘Thingkungpa hing hu ung la para tie ung, cuorasala a caahming hne a thariy kha alyi lie thuse ung la, thaa buoliriy hne daa buoliriy ta ciy ung la, alyi lie aphuv hrawlie kha thuse tie ung. Avuo duotiy ta a pacingna te ta tlasue se. Alyi lie aphuv hrawlieta a awpa ruo chunglie saruopa haa khata cuo ra sala, saruopa pathiypalung kha kung sariy chung phya se,’ a ta.
Vya siepahruo, a siyluo ca hing haa hing tana a cuo, i byipaapa siepahruo cunglieta zaa tlungpa Cungnungce duotena tana a cuo:

Nama ca cawsaa zaw hraw taa hingta a cade pata cuo'a cate, saruopa zaw hrawlieta na aw aa. Cuetungpa haata a phuv kha na buo aa, avuo taata aduo ta ca tlasue'a te, cahaacata kung sariy chung na aw aa. Cakhutaa cata Cungnungce ca cawsaa tie pena a uvtuv ta cuo te, capa pena ca a pi khingpa khana a pi yi, tapa kha na vya pachang aa.
Thingkungpa a caahming hne a thariy ca thuse riypata bie pipa a cuopa haa khata, uvna hing Vuoruo taa tana aa zuv tapa na pachang cuo ning taa khata na pena ca padaa pakhaa pata a cuo aa.

Caacuonakawta, Vya siepahruo, ruena ica chepa hing a paw the thi tie: adangna hneta sue angiethena kha a hie tie, tuechiepa tie nangduena ta na suena kha a pathe sa tie, cakiedyina na cunglieta thluechiy aa hmang aa,” a ta.
Hingpa bangkhuo hing Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar cunglie a tlung.
Thla hraa hlyihning thlaa a chuopa khata siepahruo ca Babilon siepahruo ing cunglie kha aa khiepuo pata,
“Hingpa hing a rungnaapa Babilon, kama ta siepahruo khypuv riypata kama cahrana a lepa ta i sapa hne i rungnaa lesyina cuota i sapa ta cuo va ma?” a ta.

Capa bie ca siepahruo pakaa lie a aw kaliepa khata vuoruo taata ueryi a zuv te: “Vya Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar, hingpa hing nama'a luo pathyi sapa tana a cuo: Na pena ca nama'a taata la pata a cuo tli!

Nama ca cawsaa hraw taata a cade pata cuo'a cate, ruo lieta a awpa saruopa zaw hne kha tana na aw aa. Nama ca cuetungpa haa khata aphuv buo'a cate, cahaacata kung sariy na aw aa. Cungnungce ca cawsaa tie pena a uvtuv ta cuo te, capa pena ca a pi khingpa khana a pi yi, tapa kha na pachangna te ta cahaacata na aw aa,” a ta.

Capa cuo lie hrahring ca ta capa duotena ca Nebukhadnezzar cunglie kha a tling. Ama ca cawsaa awna taa khata a cade pata cuo te, cuetungpa haa khata aphuv a buo, a pangpa cunglie kha aduo ta tlasue te, a suo ca hmungthlu hming haata syi te a pating ca pavaa pating haa khata a syi.

Capa cuo a chuo tiyta, kama Nebukhadnezzar ca avuo luo kha mang angte i pathiypalung tawpa kha i hnyi pakhaa. Cungnungce ca i pathuosa, chuozaa ta a hringpa kha pathuosana hne pa-uvsathyina ca i pi. A uvna ca chuozaa ta aa hmangpa uvna ta a cuo, a pena ca chuo kha hnang chuo kha ta aa hmang.

Alyi lie khy a sapa bangkhuo hing khaapatahmuo cuo va yi, avuo rieka tie kha a khing thiy ta tue yi te, alyi ming zaw kha a khing thiy ta a tue yi. A kuv a patuv khupa ahunghmuo aw va yi, “Khaapama na tue,” a ta nguopa pakha hmuo aw va yi.

Capa cuo lie ca i tawtawpa haata i cuo pakhaa; cakhutaata i linghlaa hne i rungnaana hne i pena rungnaana kha pi pakhaa pata i cuo. Ruena naa pituv tie hne i byi tie khata naa ngie pakhaa yi te, i pena ca pacu sa pakhaa pata cuo te, lesyina zaw kha pichiy vie pata i cuo.

Ata hing ca kama Nebukhadnezzar ta vuoruo Siepahruo kha i pathuosa, cyicalang angte pa-uvsathyi na i pi, tahematapakieca a tuepa bangkhuo ca a hmisipa ta cuo te, a luopuv ca aa dang; hruotlena hne a hringpa tie kha a pachung khupa tana a cuo.
Siepahruo Belshazzar ta a byi zaw thawkha tie cuo khata saduona pyi a lesa ta tue te, iema hne cata mingsuvtiy ama dang.

Mingsuvtiy a memaw pata Belshazzar cata a paa Nebukhadnezzar ta Jerusalem biena-ing taata a za lapa siy panuo hne ngu panuo zaw kha va la ung la, capa panuo zaw cata i byi tie, i napuv tie hne i nungthang tie ta mingsuvtiy ima dangna aa, ta pata naw a pi yi.

Caacuonakawta Jerusalem khypuv Khazing ing, biena-ing chung lie ama za lapa siy panuo hne ngu panuo zaw ca la yi te, siepahruo hne aa byi tie, a napuv tie, hne a nungthang tie ca ta mingsuvtiy ca ama dangna.
Mingsuvtiy ca dang yi te siy, ngu, daa, thaa, thing hne alung ta tuepa khazing tie ca ama pathuosa.
Sungkhapuv ta siepahruo ing lungrue tlepie palastaa cunglie, myi a khe cenapa lie kha cawsaa kuv suokha taata kuvdaw zaw a vya luo te caa a cape. Siepahruo ta caa a capepa kuv kha a hmung.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ca a hmie duokaduv te a thlaa a zangsa. A kuv a phyi kha siy te a pakhuv aa cathang.

Siepahruo ca khuosa ta khi te, pamya a thepa tie, Khaldi ming, hne hmungdawlutuv tie kha a paku sa yi; cakhutaata siepahruo ta Babilon mingsing tie kyihuo khata, “Hingpa caa aa capepa hing ri khu te a siyluo naa chang khupa ca pang ciycaapa kha pahryi pata a cuo aa, a ruetung lie siy pachiy pa-ya pata cuo'a te, i pena chunglie byi lepa pathungna ta a cuo aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata siepahruo mingsing tie bangkhuo ca zaa ngie yi te, cuorasala caa a ri khupa hne siepahruo kha a siyluo a chang khupa aw va yi.
Siepahruo Belshazzar ca khuopuv ta a thlaa zang te a hmie a duokaduv, aa byi tie zaw kharuehaa pata ama aw.

Siepahruo hne aa byi tie bie amaa ruepa kha a thyi tiyta, siepahruonung ca saduona khuo luo kha a zaa ngie. Siepahruonung ta, “Vya siepahruo, na hring pasiy thi se! Na thlaa zang khah sala na minghmie chie khah se.

Na pena chunglie hing a pathepa khazing tie thlaapa a hnyipa cawsaa pakha na a aw. Na paa chuo lie ta hmungkhuna hne pachangkhuna a hnyipa, khazing tie haata singna a hnyipa ta a za cuo. Na paa, Siepahruo Nebukhadnezzar ta ama kha pacuo a thepa tie, pamya a thepa tie, Khaldi ming, hne hmungdawlutuv tie lieta a le cepa ta a za chipa ta a cuo.

Capa Daniel, siepahruo ta Belteshazzar ta pata ming a sapa ca muo siyluo ri khu riypa, bienupa a ri khingna pachang khu riypa, hne hnaahnawna zaw padie khu riypata a pha cepa ruena, thesingna, hne pachangna a hnyipa tana a cuo. Ata hingta Daniel ca ku pata cuo sala, ama ta a siyluo kha a ri khu aa,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Daniel ca siepahruo hmiekung luo kha amaa ngiekhyi. Siepahruo ta Daniel kyihuo khata, “Nama ca siepahruo a cuopa i paa ta Judah ruo taata sii ta a vya sikhyipa tie chungtaata Daniel ca ta na cuo ma?
Nama ca a pathepa khazing tie thlaapa kha hnyi cate, hmungkhuna hne pachangkhuna a hnyipa, khazing tie haata singna a hnyipa ta na cuopa kha i thyi tli.
Mingsing tie hne pamya a thepa tie kha hingpa caa hing ri riypa hne a siyluo ri riypata i hmiekung luo zaa ngiekhyi yi te, cuorasala i muo a siyluo kha na chang khu va yi.

Cuorasala nama ca muo a siyluo kha ri khu cate hnaahnawna zaw na padie khu ta pata i thyi. Caa hing ri khu cate a siyluo zaw na pali khu kieca pang ciycaapa kha pabuv pata cuo'a cate, siy pachiy kha na ruetung lie pa-ya pata na cuo aa, cakhutaata pena chunglie hing a le cepa pathungna ta na cuo aa,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Daniel ta siepahruo kha palie tie, “Na lasaw ca nama cuota a chi thluo tie, acuolikie lawmuo ca cawsaa hrangpa kha pi thluo tie yi! Cadyiseca siepahruo ca caa kha ca ripa'a angte a siyluo zaw ica chang aa.
Vya siepahruo, Cungnungce Khazing ta na paa ca siepahruo cuona, lesyina, rungnaana kha a pi.

Capa lesyina a pipa thue cata cawsaa bangkhuo, mingphang bangkhuo hne ryi phang ting a cyipa tie ca ciy yi te a hmiekunglie kha amaa cathang. A thie khingpa kha thie yi te, a pahring khingpa kha a pahring yi, pa-uvsathyina a pi khingpa kha pa-uvsathyina pi yi te, a pachung khingpa tie kha a pachung yi.
Cuorasala a hruotle te a palung a le tiyta hne hruotlena hneta hmang a tue tiyta a siepahruo byithude taata pachung pata cuo te, a rungnaana kha chuv pata a cuo.

Cungnungce Khazing ca cawsaa tie pena cunglie uvtuv ta cuo te, capa pena ca a pi khingpa khana a pi yi, tapa kha a pachangna te ta, ama ca cawsaa tie hraw taa khata a cade pata cuo te, saruopa pathiypalung kha paphya sa pata a cuo. Ruo lie laa zaw hne khata aw hne te, cuetungpa haa khata aphuv a buo, a pangpa ca aduo diy khata a tlasue.
Nama Belshazzar a sacapaa, hingpa zaw bangkhuo hing na pachang thluo pata na pathiypalung pachung vaciy!

Nama hne nama kha a cyicalang cate Vuoruo Khazing kha naa du! A biena-ing biphie kha na hmiekung luo pala sa yi cate, nama hne naa byi tie, na napuv tie hne na nungthang tie ta mingsuv dangna ta nama hmuo. Siy, ngu, daa, thaa, thing hne alung ta tuepa khazing tie, khaapahmuo a hmung the lipa, a thyi the lipa hne a pachang lipa kha nama pathuosa. Cuorasala na huv caa pasung sapa, na cuona bangkhuo a hnyipa ca pa-uvsathyi lipa cata na aw.
Caacuonakawta Khazing ta hingpa kuv hing za pathlie te caa hing a cape.
Hingpa a capepa caa ca hing haa hingta a cuo: MENE, MENE, TEKEL, PARSIN.
Hingpa hing caa a siyluo ta a cuo: MENE ca Khazing ta na pena ningcuo zaw ca ri tli te, a pachuo sa tli;
TEKEL, cyipathliena lie ca pathlie te a cyi tling vaciy;
PERES, na pena ca chechi pata cuo te, Media ming hne Persia ming kha pi pata ama cuo tli,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Belshazzar ta naw pi yi te, Daniel ca a ciycaapa pang kha pabuv yi te a rue lieta siy pachiy ama pa-ya, pena chunglie a le cepa pathungna ta a cuo tli tapa zaw ama pathyi sa.
Capa zuo lie hrahring cata Khaldi siepahruo Belshazzar ca ama thie.
Cakhutaata Media ming Darius ta pena ca a la, Darius ca kung sawcaruv kung hning ta a cuo.
Darius ta ruo uvtuv riypata muokiy byi zakha pakiy kha a pena chung bangkhuo lieta chi yi te, iema cunglie ca Daniel ripuo pata vuanci pathung a chi yi;
siepahruo ta ruvnaana aa taw li riypata capa muokiy byi tie ca ta ruo chiycuona kha vuanci tie'a luo ca thuo pathyisa lawmaw riypata a cuo.
A ru hluota Daniel ca vuanci hrangpa tie hne muokiy byi tie laata re a hrie khu viepa kha a luo te, siepahruo ta pena bangkhuo uvtuv ta chi riypata ruena a hnyi.

Caacuonakawta vuanci tie hne muokiy byi tie ta pena hne aa pazue pata Daniel suebe khu riypa kha amaa zue. Cuorasala suebe khuna riypa hne hmang pha lipa a hriepa kha hmung va yi, tahematapakieca ama ca zang tluo aa tlapa ta cuo te, a hrie chiepa hne hmang pha lipa a tuepa kha hmung khu va yi.
Iema ta, “A Khazing phungbie hne aa patuv pata ta li pata ca Daniel suebe riypa hing hmung khu'a vapuv,” amaa ta.
Caacuonakawta vuanci tie hne muokiy byi tie ca siepahruo'a luo kha a vaw yi te, “Vya Siepahruo Darius, na hring pasiy thi mang sue!

Pena chunglie vuanci tie, muokiy tie hne ziype tie, ruena pituv tie hne uvtuv tie bangkhuo palung tling pata ma ri pakhawpa ca, Vya siepahruo, ahung a cuo zawta, ma hmieluo ning sawthung chunglie hing, nama'a luo ta li pata khazing'a luo cuose, cawsaa'a luo cuose thlaa a chuo kieca, capa cawsaa ca chingde kahre chung luo thaw pata cuo se; capa ca siepahruo ta ziyphung ta tue sala pacu sa se, tapa tana ma naa a tla.
Vya siepahruo, capa ziyphung ca papya la, Media hne Persia phungbie haata aa thle khu li riypa hne para khu li riypata mingse thuv tie,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Siepahruo Darius ta capa ca mingse thuv te a pacu sa.

Daniel ta ziyphung ca mingse thuv tlipa a cuopa kha a pachang raalaa pata, a tue tawpa haa khata a cung duo lieta Jerusalem luo aa hyi pata thlaluo-aw a hnyipa a ing luo kha cakuo pari thluo te, ning kha ta yi thung a pakhuv pane te a Khazing kha abie te a pathuosa pari.
A rawtuv tie ca a vaw yi te, Daniel ta a Khazing'a luo thlaachuo te nangduena aa hiepa kha ama hmung.

Cakhutaata siepahruo'a luo kha cakuo yi te, nawbie a tuepa kaw kha ama pachang sa pakhaa. “Vya siepahruo! nama ta ma hmieluo ning sawthung chunglieta nama'a luo ta li pata khazing hrangpa tie'a luo cuose, cawsaa'a luo cuose thlaa a chuopa ca chingde kahre chung luo na thaw pata a cuo aa ta pata ziyphung kha mingse thuv va ca ma?” ama ta. Siepahruo ta palie yi te, “Capa ziyphung ca aa hmang thluo, Media ming hne Persia ming phungbie haata para khu pata cuo vyi,” a ta.

Cakhutaata iema ta siepahruo kha palie yi te, “Judah ming sii ta vya sikhyipa tie chungtaata pakha ta a cuopa Daniel ta nama kha siysaa ta cari vyi, Vya siepahruo, nama ta mingse na thuvpa ziyphung zaw kha siysaa ri vyi, cuorasala ama ta ning kha ta yi thung thlaa a chuo,” ama ta.
Siepahruo ta capa ca a thyi tiyta khuopuv ta a palung rie a thyi. Daniel khuo riypata a palung lie bie aa chi, ningtlana te ta a tue khu thathiypa kha tue te khuo aa zue.
Cakhutaata a rawtuv tie ca siepahruo'a luo kha a vaw yi te, “Vya siepahruo, Media ming hne Persia ming phungbie, ziyphung pacu sa ciepa ca thle khu pata cuo vyi tapa kha na pachang,” ama ta.

Cakhutaa cata siepahruo ta naw pi yi te, Daniel ca a vawkhyi yi te chingde kahre chung luo kha ama thaw. Siepahruo ta Daniel kyihuo khata, “Zang tluo aa tlasa pata a re na hriepa na Khazing ta ca khuo mang sue!” a ta.
Chingde kahre a pakaa ca alung lesapa suokha ta ama khaa, cakhutaata Daniel hne aa patuv pata khaapahmuo thle khu a aw li riypata siepahruo ta ama caakhe hne aa byi tie caakhe khata a khe.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ca a siepahruo ing luo kha cakuo te zuo ca sa aa uv; khaapa sa hmuo a hmiekung luo chiykhyi va yi, zuokhydyi ta a hmung khu vyi.
Khy a dyi tiyta, siepahruo ca thu te chingde kahre luo kha a catlisa pata a cakuo.

Daniel a awnapa chingde kahre luo kha a vya pha tiyta, “Vya Daniel, a hringpa Khazing changtaapa, zang tluo aa tlasa pata a re na hriepa na Khazing ta chingde zaw taa khata aca khuo khu ma?” ta te, khuosa ta a khi.
Daniel ta siepahruo kyihuo khata, “Vya siepahruo, na hring pasiy thi mang sue!

Chingde tie ta kama kha hmaa ina paphya li riypa yi ta, i Khazing ta aa vuoming kha chingde pakaa paping riypata a za pathlie tli yi; tahematapakieca kama ca a hmiekunglie risie riy hnyi lipa angta, Vya siepahruo, nama'a lie zaw tuesuepa suokha hmuo i hnyi li nakawta a cuo,” a ta.

Siepahruo ca a palung tluo hringhruo te Daniel kha chingde kahre chungtaata ama papya riypata naw a pi yi. Caacuonakawta Daniel ca chingde kahre chungtaata ale luo kha caba pathla yi te, a pangpa cunglieta hmaa suokha hmuo aw vyi, tahematapakieca a Khazing kha aa ringchuo nakawta a cuo.

Siepahruo ta, Daniel kha chingde kahre chung luo pathla riypata a rawpa tie kha, iema, ama saata tie, hne ama napuv tie hne khata chingde kahre chung luo pathla riypata naw a pi yi. Alyi luo hmuo ama chiy hluo khata chingde ta a vya zuchiy yi te ama ruv zaw bangkhuo te kha a thlibaruv diy yi.
Cakhutaata Siepahruo Darius ta chuelyi cung ting lie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo hne ryi phangting a cyipa mingphang bangkhuo'a luo kha caa cape te: “Nama thluechiy ca a ky hryly mang sue!

I siepahruo uvna rawlie cawsaa bangkhuo ta Daniel Khazing hing ciy yi sala a hmiekunglie a cathang yi se: Tahematapakieca ama ca chuozaa ta aa hmangpa, a hringpa Khazing tana a cuo. A pena ca khatiy tahmuo para pata cuo'a vyi, a uvna zaw chuo buo'a vyi.
Ama ta palaw sa yi te a khuo yi, pamangsana hne kharuehaa hmang zaw kha alyi hne avuo lie kha a tue; tahematapakieca Daniel kha chingde zaw cahrana chungtaata a khuo,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Daniel ca Darius uv chung hne Persia ming Sairas uv chung ca thluechiy hneta a hring.
Babilon Siepahruo Belshazzar siepahruo a cuonapa kung khana lie kha Daniel ca a iehmang lie aa ziepa khata muo hne muocuo a hmung. Cakhutaata a muo kha a cape:
Kama, Daniel ta zuo ta muocuo lie i hmungpa ca, a lesapa riyliy lieta avuo thliy suopaliy ta tiylaw ama pathu sapa kha i hmung.
Riyliy taa cata saahruo lesapa sapaliy kya pya yi te, sakha hne sakha amaa nanang diy.

A sakhana ca chingde haata cuo te hmungthlu mathlaa a hnyi. I mang ca, a mathlaa ca phie pata cuo te, alyi taa cata kya calang yi te cawsaa haa khata a phyi suohning ta aa daa; cawsaa pathiypalung kha pi pata a cuo.

Saahruo hrangpa, sahningna kha a vya luo te cavaw haata a cuo. Capa ca kuokhaluo ta padaa yi te, a pakaa lie, a haa zaw khata vuoruv suothung kha a ce. Ama kha, “Thu la, saa kha na ce khu thiy ta ce tie,” ama ta.
Capa khutaa cata i mang ca, a hrangpa sakha a luo te, kyiching haata a cuo. A ke lieta pavaa mathlaa haapa suopaliy hnyi te luv suopaliy a hnyi; ama ca uvna kha pi pata a cuo.

Cakhutaata muocuo chunglie ca a sapaliynapa saahruo kha i hmung, ciy aa chiypa hne cawsaa phuv a pahlingpa a cahra ciemuopa ta a cuo. Thaa haa a lesapa kha hnyi te khaapa mekaa kha a diykariyna te ta a ca-yi diy yi; aa ngaapa kha a phyi ta a chaapuo diy. Ama hluota a awpa saahruo tie bangkhuo hne khata a nanang te kiy suohraa a hnyi.

A kiy kaw kha i rue nguoluo pata, amaa lalalie kha kiy cawta suokha kya pu te, aa tlaw thena riypata a aw ciepa kiy suothung tie kha a thabaw taata a phie yi. A kiy lie ca cawsaa ming haapa ming hnyi te, a pakaa ta pyathusa pata bie a ri.

I mang ca, Byithude zaw kha a patu te, capa lie ca Chuozaa Cawsaapa ta aa tu. A cawsie ca cahue haata ruo te, a luv lie a suo ca tuvhming pathepa haata a ngu. Aa byithude ca myihlaa haa khata cuo te, a tieky phyi ca myihyi sekhalapa kha a lu.
A awnapa taa cata myi ca cavaa haata a lang. A thaw thaw ta a re kha hrie yi te, athaalie a awpa ca ting thawkha ama ta. Bieripana cuo pathu riypata cuo tli te, caa-uv zaw ca pake pata a cuo.
Kiy ta a palena hne hruotlena bie a ri nguoluo nakawta i mang. I mangpa cata, saahruo ca ama thie, a pangpa ca myi ta rue yi te ama para.
A hrangpa saahruo tie ca ama uvna kha ama lapa, cuorasala khycuo cuo kha chung hringna cuo ama pi kalie.
Zuo ta i hmungpa muocuo lie ca, Cawsaa a lupa pakha kha avuo amyi hne aa vawpa kha i hmung. Chuozaa Paa'a luo kha a vaw te, a hmiekunglie kha a vaa daa.

Ama ca uvna naw hne rungnaana hne siepahruo cuona kha pi pata cuo te, cawsaa bangkhuo, mingphang bangkhuo, hne ryi ting a cyipa bangkhuo ta a re a ma hrie aa. A uvna ca chuozaa ta a hmang'a te, khatiy tahmuo chuo buo'a vyi; a siepahruo cuona zaw khatiy tahmuo parapa cuo buo'a vyi.
Kama ca muocuo i hmungpa tie ca ta i kharue na pahaa te i palung rie a thyi hringhruo.
Capa lie a awpa pakha kha vaa ngie angte, hingpa bangkhuo hneta aa patuvpa a siyluo hing khaapatama a cuo tapa kha i hiehriy. Caacuonakawta ama ta muocuo a siyluo kha ina chang.
“Hingpa saahruo sapaliy tie hing ca, alyi cunglieta a vya pya riypa siepahruo tie ta ama cuo.
Cuorasala a pathepa Cungnungce ta pena kha hmung'a te chuozaa ta a hnyi aa, chuozaa taata chuozaa te,” ina ta.

Cakhutaata sapaliynapa saahruo a cuona hmisi zaw kha i pachang khing. Capa saahruo ca a hrangpa tie bangkhuo hne khata amaa nanang, thaa haa hne daa pating a hnyi, khaapa mekaa kha a diykariyna te ta ca-yi diy te, aa ngaapa kha a phyi ta a chaapuo diy; ciy aa chiy hringhruo pata a cuo.

Cakhutaata a luv cunglie a awpa kiy suohraa hne a hrangpa kiy suokha, a kya pu pahne ta ama aa tlaw thena riypata a hrangpa kiy suohning tie a thlingpa kaw zaw kha i pachang khing. Capa kiy ca ming hne pakaa hnyi te hruotlesa pata bie a ri hyalya, a hrangpa zaw laata a le viepa na a lu.
I mang nguoluopa khata capa kiy ca ta a pathepa tie kha a du yi te, chuozaa ta a hringpa aa vawna cuo te khata a te yi.
Cakhutaata Cungnungce mingpathepa tie cuo khata bieripana a tue, cahaacata mingpathepa tie ta pena cahrana ama hmungna cuo kha a vya tlung.

Ama ta hing haa hingta a ri: “A sapaliynapa saahruo ca, alyi cunglie hing pena suopaliynapa vya aw'a te, pena hrangpa tie bangkhuo hne khata aa nanang aa; alyi cung yalya kha a ning diy aa, a phyi ta chaapuo'a te a dekary diy aa.

Kiy suohraa ca, capa pena chung taa cata siepahruo pahraa pya'a yi te, iema khutaa cata a hrangpa siepahruo pakha a pya aa. Capa siepahruo ca a hrangpa tie hne khata a nanang'a yi te, siepahruo pathung kha a te'a yi.

Ama ta Cungnungce a du pata bie ri'a te, Cungnungce mingpathepa tie kha a du'a yi. A pathepa ningcuo tie hne phungbie zaw kha thle riypata aa zue aa. Mingpathepa tie ca a cahrana chung luo kha kung thung hne a che chung pi pata ama cuo aa.
Cakhutaata bieripana kha a vya aw aa, a uvna ca chuv pata cuo'a te, para pata pahli diy pata a cuo aa.

Siepahruo cuona hne uvna, avuo rawlie pena lesyina ca Cungnungce mingpathepa tie kha pi pata ama cuo aa. Iema pena ca chuozaa ta aa hmangpa pena ta cuo'a te, uvpa tie bangkhuo ta pa-uvsathyi'a yi te iema re kha ama hrie aa,” a ta.
Hingpa lie hingta capa kaw ca a chuo. Kama, Daniel ca i khueruena ta rutla na pazang te, i hmie zaw a duokaduv diy; cuorasala capa kaw ca i palung chunglieta i chi.
Belshazzar siepahruo a cuonapa kung thungna lie kha kama Daniel'a luo zaa luo taapa muocuo khu taa khata muocuo suokha a zaa luo pakhaa.
Muocuo chunglie ca kama ca Elam pe, Susa khypuv lie, Ulai cavaa kielie kha i aw.

I mang ca cavaa kielieta tuvtungpa aa daapa kha i hmung. Capa tuvtungpa ca kiy suohning a hnyi. A kiy suohning cata a syisa, cuorasala a hnang vie ta a kya thuepa suokha ca a hrangpa suokha laa khata a syi vie.

Tuvtungpa ca ta ningtlaluo kuo, chaluo kuo hne sungluo kuo kha a kiy ta a de nguoluo thluopa kha i hmung. Saahruo bangkhuo ca ama a daapuo khupa aw va yi, a cahranapa taata pacha khutuv ahunghmuo aw va yi; a khingna haa khata tue thluo te a kya cahra hryly.
I mang nguoluopa khata, ningtlaluo kuo taata mietungpa a vya pya, alyi de lipa ta a cunglieta a vya si. Capa mie ca a ming hne a ming alalalieta kiy suokha a hnyi.
Capa mietungpa ca ta cavaa kielie aa daa nguoluo pata i hmungpa a kiy suohning a hnyipa tuvtungpa ca khuosa ta a va suv.

Tuvtungpa ca vaa ngiele te, a hihaasa pata va de te a kiy suohning a thlipa kha i hmung. Tuvtungpa ta ama a daapuo khuna thaazuo hnyi vyi; alyi lie kha depatyi te a phyi ta aa cangpuo, ama cahrana taata tuvtungpa a khuo khupa pakha hmuo aw va yi.
Cakhutaata mietungpa ca a kya le hringhruo; cuorasala a cahra liyciypa khata a kiy lepa ca a tli. Capa hmang lie ca a kiy hrangpa suopaliy kya thue te kuo paliy luo kha amaa hyi cyicuo.
Capa a kiy suopaliy chung taa cata suokha taa khata a kiy taata suokha a kya thue. Capa a kiy ca sungluo, ningchiyluo, hne ruo puvthepa luo kha khuosa ta a lesue yi.
Avuo aasiy a phana te khata aa suo. Capa ca ta avuo aasiy chekha kha alyi luo thawpathla te a phyi ta a chaapuo yi.
Avuo aasiy tie siepahruo kha hmuo a du te aa hruosa pata hmang a tue; tue tawpa myirue panaana kha para te hmangpathepa chunglie abiena hmang zaw kha a para.
Pha lina kawlie ca ta avuo aasiy ca tue tawpa myirue panaana hne khata ama'a luo pi pata a cuo. Biehmisipa kha alyi luo thaw te, a tuepa bangkhuo lieta a hlue a tling.

Cakhutaata a pathepa pakha ta bie a ripa kha i thyi, a hrangpa a pathepa pakha ta bie a ripa pakha ca palie te, “Tue tawpa myirue panaana, rana a chiykhyipa tuesuena, hne hmangpathepa hne avuo riekaphuv kha phyi ta chaapuo riypata pipa muocuo hing khacuo te khiy ma a ru kalie aa?” a ta.
Cakhutaata ama ta palie te, “Maw hne zuo thawhning zathung; cakhutaa cata hmangpathepa ca ahluo ta a cuo tawpa haa khata a cuo pakhaa aa,” a ta.
Kama, Daniel ta muocuo i hmung tiyta, capa siyluo ca i pachang khing. Cawsaa hmingsuo a lupa pakha kha i hmiekunglie a vya luo te,
Ulai cavaa kie taata cawsaa ueryi kha i thyi, “Gabriel, khapa cawsaa kha muocuo siyluo a pachang khu riypata a bya tie,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Gabriel ca i tuna athaa luo kha aa vaw ca, kama ca i ciy tuv nakawta i liepatyi. Cuorasala ama ta, “Vya cawsaapa, muocuo hing cuo chuona kaw tana a cuo tapa kha pachang tie,” ina ta.
Kama'a lie bie a ri nguoluo ning ca, khaapahmuo a thyi lipa angta alyi lie i bu thluo; cakhutaata ama ta na hrie te ina padaa.
Ama ta, “Naathlie tie, hihaana cuo khutaa khata khaapama a vaw aa tapa kha ca chang'a ang; tahematapakieca na muocuo hing cuo chuona kaw na a ri.
Kiy suohning a hnyipa na hmungpa tuvtungpa ca Media hne Persia siepahruo tie kha tana ama cuo.
Mietungpa ca Grik siepahruo ta cuo te, a ming hne a ming alalalieta a kiy ca siepahruo taapa ta a cuo.
A tlipa a kiy khutaata a kya thuepa a kiy suopaliy ca a ruo chunglieta a kya pya riypa pena suopaliy ta cuo te, cuorasala cahrana hnyi'a va yi.
Iema uvna a chuona lie, tuesuena ta a dawpaa te a chiy ningta kha a palung lesa te a zyatesapa siepahruo a vya aw aa.
Ama ca a kya cahrasa aa, a tuepa khata ciy aa chiypa rana chiykhyi'a te, a tuepa lie kha a hlue a tling aa. Ama ta a thaaruvsapa hne a pathepa cawsaa tie kha a para'a yi.

Zyatena ta a khuekhuona lie kha a hlue tling'a te, ama pathiypalung lie ca a lesyipa ta aa hmung aa. A raaring pina aw li pata cawsaa a hluvsa a thie aa, siepahruo tie Siepahruo kha hmuo thu'a te aa du aa. Cuorasala cawsaa kuv ta cuo li'a pata thlipachung pata a cuo aa.
Ica changpa zuoluo hne maw muocuo ca aa hmuo pata a cuo. Na muocuo ca na nu caw aa, tahematapakieca ata taa hingta cuo pasiypuv a ru kalie aa,” ina ta.
Caacuonakawta kama, Daniel ca i thaa chuo te ning hluvpuv chung i pasa; cakhutaa cata thu angte siepahruo a re kha i hrie. Cuorasala muocuo ca ta i nang na pa-uo te a siyluo pachang khu va ang.
Ahasuerus sacapaa Darius, a thukina kuo luo ta Media ming ta a cuopa, Khaldi ming ruo lieta siepahruo ta a cuopa
siepahruo a cuona kung khana lieta kama Daniel ta caa pathepa kha ri angte, Abyipata profet Jeremiah'a lieta a ripa bie haata Jerusalem khypuv ca kung sawsariy chung a ra aa tapa kha i pacuo nguoluo.
Cakhutaata Abyipa Khazing'a luo kha a pali angte, thlaachuona hne sa-uvna hne buri pang hne buvcuo a phuv pata ama kha paa i kie.

Abyipai Khazing'a luo kha thlaachuo angte sue a phunapa i hnyi. “Vya Abyipa, a lesyipa hne kharuehaa aa chiypa Khazing, nama ca na biekuona hne na nawbie a ziypa tie kha aa hmangpa na duena ta due yi cate na biekuo a ziypa tana na cuo.
Kiema ca a suepa hne a pha lipa a tuepa, a du a hmuopa, na nawbie hne na ziyphung taata a piepa tana ma cuo.
Na changtaapa profet tie bie, na ming ta siepahruo tie'a lie bie a ripa, ma byi tie, ma mingchingmingvuo tie, hne alyi cung cawsaa bangkhuo tie'a lieta bie a ripa tie ama bie kha naathlie vapuv.

“Vya Abyipa, adangna ca nama huopa tana a cuo, cuorasala Judah ming, Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie, hne Israel ming bangkhuo, luongie lie a awpa hne luohlaa lie a awpa bangkhuo, naa cadenapa yi ruo bangkhuo chunglieta a awpa tie ta nama a du pata zang tluo aa tla lipa ama tuena kawlieta ataning hing nangzaana na malie a buv.
Vya Abyipa, ma siepahruo tie, ma byi tie, ma mingchingmingvuo tie cunglie kha nangzaana na a tlung, tehematapakieca nama cunglie khana ma sue tli.
Nangduena hne sue angiethena a hnyipa Abyipa ma Khazing khana maa du tli.
Abyipama Khazing a ripa kha ziy vapuv, changtaapa profet tie thueta kiema hmiekunglie a chipa phungbie zaw kha ziy vapuv.

“Israel ming bangkhuo ca na phungbie lie kha sue pate luo ma pie diy tli, na ueryi kha ca naathlie khing vapuv. Caacuonakawta Khazing changtaapa Moses phungbie lieta aa capepa chiesana ca kiema cunglieta lyisue pata ma cuo, tahematapakieca nama cungliena ma sue tli.
Kiema kawlieta cuose, malie a uvtuv tie kawlieta cuose a ripa bie kha pacu sa te, Jerusalem cunglie dyi za tlung te chuelyi cunglieta a tlung buo lipa rana lesapa kha kiema cunglie a patlung sa tli.

Moses phungbie lie aa capepa haa khata hingpa rana lesapa bangkhuo ca kiema cunglieta a tlung tli. Ma suena a ngiepachiy pata, hne zang tluo aa tlana kha paluosa pata Abyipama Khazing tlechuopa cuo riypata paakie vapuv.

Caacuonakawta kiema cung luo a patlung sana te khata capa rana ca Abyipata a mang thluo. Hmisi ta ripa kieca, Abyipama Khazing ca a tuepa bangkhuo lieta aa dang; tehematapakieca kiema ta a bie kha ziy vapuv.

“Vya Abyipa ma Khazing, ahungma na cawsaa zaw kha Izipt ruo chungtaata a kuv cahrapa ta pyakhyi yi te, ataning tepa hingta na ming a pathuo riypata a tue? Kiema ca ma sue tli, kiema ca a pha li ciemuopa na ma tue tli.

Vya Abyipa, thlaa na ma chuo, naa dangna thue khata na hihaana ca na khypuv, hne na tluo pathepa Jerusalem taa khata phe thi tie; kiema suena hne ma mingchingmingvuo tie suena kawlie khata Jerusalem hne ma cawsaa tie ca ma ingpaa zaw hrawlie kha nangzaana na ma ang.

Caacuonakawta Vya kiema Khazing, na changtaapa thlaachuona hne paakiena ca naathlie thi tie, Abyipa, nama cuo ngiethie khata a duothlingpa na hmangpathepa cunglie kha na hmie ca ning haata pa-ie thi se.

Vya ma Khazing, naathlie la thyi thi tie, ruo duothlingpa ta ma cuona hne na ming a phyapa na khypuv kha malie hmung thi tie. Kiema adangna a pacaw pata cuo li pata, nama nangduena a pacaw pata na paa maca kie.

Vya Abyipa, thyi thi tie; Vya Abyipa, malie a ngiethe thi tie; Vya Abyipa naathlie la hrie paluo la palawle thi khah! Tahematapakieca Vya i Khazing, hingpa khypuv hne hingpa cawsaa tie hing nama huopa tana ama cuo.”
Kama ca bie ri angte, thlaachuo angte kama suena hne i cawsaa Israel ming suena kha phu angte, i Khazing a pathepa tluo cuo khata Abyipai Khazing hmiekunglie paa i kie nguoluo ning kha
muocuo lieta i za hmungpa cawsaapa, Gabriel ca zuoluocaw hriykhungrina tue tiy khata kama'a luo a vya zule te aa vaw.
A vaw te ina changpa ca, “Daniel, nama kha singna hne pachangna pi riypa tana i vaw.

Paakie hruo naa pathu ning khata Abyipa ta na bie kha aca thyi, nama kha aca duesa nakawta aca palienapa kha pasiepa riypata nama'a luo ca i vaw tli. Caacuonakawta i bie hing pacuo syalya la muocuo siyluo ca pachang tie:

“Ningzaa sawsariy ca na cawsaa hne a pathepa na khy cuota, tuesuena a chuona riypa, suena cuota angiethena hie riypa, chuozaa adangna patlung sa riypa, profetbiephu hne muocuo tlingna riypa, hne hmang pathe cepa kha pihluona tue riypata chipa tana a cuo.

Caacuonakawta thyi la pachang tie: Jerusalem kha sa pakhaa riypata naw papya pata a cuo ning taa khata Khazing sathu pathuvpa siepahruo a pyana cuo te ta zaa sariy a ru aa; cakhutaata zaa sawcaruv zaa hning ca luopuv hne tiy ta khypuv dungkhuona kha ama sa aa, cuorasala a ruvnaasapa cuo chung ta a cuo aa.

Zaa sawcaruv zaa hning khutaata, sathu pathuvpa ca thie'a yi te a thlepa aw'a va yi. Cakhutaata a vya tuvpa siepahruo rieka tie ta khypuv hne hmangpathepa kha ama para aa. A chuona cuo ca tiylepa haa khata vya tlung'a te rie a tuvna hne rana a aw aa.

Capa siepahruo ca ta zaa kha chung kha cawsaa hluvpuv hneta biekuona tue'a te, zaa che chung kha hriykhungrina hne pihluona patue sa'a va yi; Paratuv cunglieta a chuonapa biechina kha patlesue pata a cuona te ta iema hmang lie ca rana a chiykhyipa duvsamakhiepa ca a aw aa.”

Persia Siepahruo Sairas siepahruo a cuonapa kung thungna lieta Belteshazzar ta pata ming sapa Daniel'a luo kha bie suokha phu pata a cuo. Bie ca a hmisipa ta cuo te, hnaahnawna lepuv kaw ta a cuo. Ama ta a hmungpa muocuo thue khata a thyipa bie kha a siyluo a pachang khu.
Capa cuo lie ca kama Daniel ca zaa thung chung muochie sa pata i aw.
Zaa thung chung bangkhuo ca sa pahuopa ning va ang, saa hne mingsuvtiy i pakaa pa de sa va ang, sathu a thuv va ang.
Thla khana thlaa ning kiy ning thung ning ta cavaa lesapa Tigris kielie kha a daa angte,
i mangthaw ca cawthang phapa a tuepa cawsaa pakha kha i hmung, a sesie lie ca Uphaz taata a pyapa siy tesaw kha aa saw.

A pangpa ca beril lungvaa haata cuo te, a hmie ca thinghlaa haata a khe, a ming ca daamyi pakhepa lu te, a buotung hne a phyi ca hna paripa daa haa khata a tlue, a ueryi ca cawsaazaapuv khi patlawpa pu haa khata a ta.
Muocuo ca kama Daniel dyi ta i hmung; i thaalie a awpa cawsaa tie ta hmung ra va yi, cuorasala a cathangsa yi te, a ruo yi te amaa nu diy.
Caacuonakawta na thuse yi te kama se ta nang-uo aa chiypa muocuo ca i hmung. I thaa aw li pata i hmie zaw a ruopadya diy.
Cakhutaata a bie ca i thyi; a bie i thyi tiyta i palung sing li pata alyi lie kha i bu.
Cuorasala kuv suokha ta na vya hrie te, i kuv ta na patuv te ina padaa.

Ama ta, “Daniel, due hringhruo pata a cuopa, ica chang riypa bie hing a phasa pata naathlie tie. A daa tie, tahematapakieca kama ca nama'a luo pathliepa tana i cuo,” ina ta. Caacuonakawta kama'a lie capa bie a ri nguoluo ning cata, i cathangsa pata i daa.

Ama ta, “Daniel, ciy khah, tahematapakieca pachang riypata na palung chunglie bie naa chi ning hne na Khazing hmiekunglie naa pane ning taa khata, na bie ca thyipa pata cuo cate, kama zaw na bie kawlie hingta i vaw pata a cuo.

Cuorasala Persia pena mangchiytuv avuoming pakha ta ning kiy ning kha chung inaa daakhuo. Caacuonakawta avuoming lepa Mikhael ta naa bya te, capa lie ca Persia pena mangchiytuv avuoming hne cata ama ca i thuse siy.

Cakhutaa cata ata nama a bya riypata i vawpa hing ca ning chuona lieta na cawsaa zaw cunglie khaapama a tlung aa tapa pachang sa riypata a cuo. Hingpa muocuo hing hmieluo kaw hneta aa patuvpa tana a cuo,” ina ta.
Hingpa bie ina chang nguoluo ning hing i ryi pathlie lipa angta alyi luo kha i bung.

Cakhutaata cawsaa haata a tapa pakha ta i hmyataw kha ina hrie. I pakaa kha kya uo angte i hmiekunglie a tupa kha, “I byipaapa, muocuo kawlie hingta hing haapa pasana hing i cunglieta tlung te i thaa aw vyi.
Tuokhaatama i byipaapa changtaapa hingta i byipaapa ca bie i rihne khu aa? Tahematapakieca i thaa aw valaa te i cathangsa, i huv sung riy hmuo aw vyi,” i ta.
Cawsaa hmingsuo haata a tapa cata na taw te thaazuo ina pi pakhaa.

Ama ta, “Ciy khah, Khazing na caa duesa, naa bang. Na palung cahra sala na rie pha se!” ina ta. Kama'a lie bie a ri nguoluopa cata, kama ca i thaa kya aw te, “I byipaapa ta ina chang khingpa ca kha ri tie, tahematapakieca nama ta thaazuo ina pi tli ciy,” i ta.

Cakhutaa cata ama ta, “Khaapanakawma nama'a luo i vaw tapa hing na pachang ma? Ata hing kama ca Persia ruo mangchiytuv avuoming a du riypata i kaa aa, ama hne maa du khutaata Grik ruo a mangchiytuv avuoming kha aa vaw kalie aa.

Cuorasala biehmisipa caa-uv lieta khaapama a cape tapa kha ica chang aa. Hingpa mangchiytuv avuoming a du riypa hingta nama mangchiytuv avuoming Mikhael ta li pata kama naa bya pa pakha hmuo aw va yi.
Kama ca Media ming Darius siepahruo a cuona kung khana lie kha ama a bya riypa hne thaazuo pi riypata i daa tli.

“Ata hing ca biehmisipa na nama'a lie ica pathyisa'a tli. Persia ruo lie hing a hrangpa siepahruo pathung ama pya kalie aa. Papaliynapa ca a hrangpa tie laa khata khuopuv ta hnyirung vie'a te, a hnyirungna ta a kya cahra sa tiyta Grik pena a du riypata ruo bangkhuo kha a pasu'a yi.
Cakhutaata rie atuv khingsapa siepahruo kha pya'a te, pena kusapa kha uv'a te a khingpa haa khata a tue aa.

A uvna a cahrasa nguoluopa khata a pena ca kyichi'a te che paliy ta aa che aa. Cuorasala a pena ca a ciypathla tie'a luo kha chiy'a vyi, cawsaa hrangpa ta cu'a yi te ama a za uv ning haata zaw cahra'a vyi.
“Cakhutaata sungluo siepahruo ca kya cahra'a te, cuorasala aa byi tie hrawlie pakha ta ama laa khata a cahra vie aa, a uvna zaw kha ama uvna laata a le vie aa.

Kung hluvpuv khutaata adaapakhawna tue'a yi te, ama palungtlingna pacusana ta sungluo siepahruo ta a sacanung ca chaluo siepahruo kha a pahlaw aa. Cuorasala capa adaapakhawna ca a syi cu'a vyi, siepahruo sacanung hne ama'a lie a si rapa a rehrietuv tie, a saata tie hne ama a daakhyipa zaw kha ama thie diy aa.

Capa cuo lie ca ta siepahruo sacanung hneta chungkha a cuopa pakha ta ama hmang lie ca aa kya daa aa. Ama ca ta chaluo siepahruo rieka kha tuv'a yi te, riekhuopiehu chung luo kha a ngiehnue'a yi te a te'a yi.
Ama khazing zaw, ama kuvtuezuv zaw hne a muosungpa siy hne ngu biphie zaw kha hruosue ta la'a te Izipt luo a za sikhyi diy aa. Kung hluvpuv chung ca chaluo ruo kha tuv li pata a aw aa.
Cakhutaa cata sungluo siepahruo uvna ca la pata a cuo aa, cuo ra sala a ruo luo kha a kaa pakhaa aa.
“A saata zaw ta rietuv riypa kha a pachie'a yi te, rieka hluvsa kha ama pahmya aa, capa rieka tie ca ta tiy le ta za lesue'a yi te ama riekhuopiehu te khata ama za pha aa.
A hi a haasa nakawta, sungluo siepahruo ca pya'a te chaluo siepahruo kha aa du aa, cahaacata chaluo rieka a hluvsapa tie ca te pata ama cuo aa.
Rieka hluvpuv kha a patuv tiy yi ta, a kya pale te, rieka ca a hluvsa a thie yi, cuorasala rie kha te pathla'a vyi.
Tahematapakieca chaluo siepahruo ta cawsaa kha a hluo laata a hluv vie ta pahmya pakhaa'a te, cehre hne aa hu hrangpa a tlingsa pata rieka a hluvsa ta a za tuv aa.

“Capa cuo chunglie ca sungluo siepahruo ca cawsaa a hluvsa ta amaa du aa. Muocuo a tling thena riypata na cawsaa tie hrawlieta a khing ta a awpa tie zaw khata thu'a yi te amaa du aa, cuorasala amaa sung aa.

Cakhutaata chaluo siepahruo ca za si'a te, riekhuocaaca kha pacing diy'a te a cusa pata cadungkhuopa khypuv kha a la aa. Sungluo rieka tie, a tlaw pa-ipa riekaphuv ta hmuo a daakhuo khu'a va yi, tahematapakieca a daakhuo pata tuv hriy khuna riypa thaazuo hnyi'a va yi.
Cuorasala ama a du riypata a zuvpa ca ta a khing thiy ta tue'a te, ahungtahmuo a daakhuo khu'a va yi. Ama ta a puvthepa ruo lie kha adaahmang la'a te zezaw bangkhuo ca ama cahrana rawlieta a chi aa.

Ama ta a pena chunglie thaazuo a awpa bangkhuo hmuo pata tuv riypata a palung chunglie bie aa chi, cakhutaata arena tue riypata re a hrie. Pena kha para riypata canung pakha kha napuv ta a pi aa; cuorasala aa tingnapa tluotling li'a pata tena hmung'a vyi.

Cakhutaata riyliy kie ruo tie luo kha a maa'a te cawsaa hluvsa kha a patuv'a yi. Cuorasala riekabyilepa pakha ta pha lina a tuepa kha a pachuo sa aa; hmisi ta ripa kieca, a pha lina kha ama cung luo mamaa kha a patlung sa aa.
Cakhutaata a ruo lie a riekhuopiehu chung luo kha kaa'a te, capa lie ca a pachiy'a te aa lie aa, hmung pata cuo'a va tli.

“Cakhutaata ama ca pakha ta a thle'a te, capa ca ta pena a lesyina riypata byi pakha kha ngukhyi khyi riypata a pathlie aa; cuorasala ning cawta chunglieta ama thie aa, rietuvna lieta cuo li pata a paruv ta thie pata a cuo aa.
Ama hmang lie ca siepahruo cuo tluo aa tla lipa cawsaa chiesapa pakha siepahruo a cuo aa; rue lipa ta vya pya te pena kha hanghie pata a la aa.
A ma ta a tepa rieka tie ca a hmiekunglie kha pahli diy pata cuo yi te, Khazing tluobyi tie kha hmuo pahli pata ama cuo aa.
A hrangpa ruo tie hne khata adaapakhawna tue'a te, zyatesa pata re a hrie nakawta cawsaa hluvsa kha a uv li raalaa pata a vya cahra vie hryly aa.

Rue li pata a hnyirungsapa pe tie kha te'a yi te, ama hmielie'apa tie ta ama tue khu lipa kha a tue khu aa, ama a ziypa tie kha rietuvna lieta ama chuvpa chechiy hne hruosue zaw kha a pi'a yi. Cariekyikuo cangpa khy zaw kha la riypata khue a khuo aa, cuorasala cuo pachangta chung dyi ta a cuo aa.

A cahrana kha pachiy'a te sungluo siepahruo kha rieka a hluvsa ta a du riypata bie aa chi aa. Sungluo siepahruo zaw khata a le vie karaapa hne a cahra vie karaapa rieka hmuo pata aa du aa. Cuorasala te'a vyi, tehematapakieca siepahruo sa a ningpa tie mamaapa khata ama raw aa.
Iema ta te'a yi te a rieka tie ca pahli diy pata ama cuo aa, cawsaa a hluvsa kha thie pata ama cuo aa.
Siepahruo pahning tie ca hmang pha lipa tue kha a ting pari yi te, cabya suokha lie kha a tu'a yi te amaa dung aa. A cuo aa de li lie nakawta a tepa aw'a va yi.
Ama ca a ruo luo kha hnyirungna a hluvsa hneta kaa'a te, cuorasala a pathiypalung lie kha a Khazing cawsaa tie abiena kha para riypata aa ting. A khingpa kha hrie'a te, a ruo luo kha a kaa aa.
“A cuo a tling tiyta sungluo ruo luo kha za kaa pakhaa'a te, cuorasala ata cuo lie hing ca a hluo haa khata cuo'a vyi.

Tahematapakieca ama a du riypata Rom ming kha tiypalaw ta a vaw'a yi te, a thlaa zangsa'a te a kaa aa. A palung vie'a te a kaa aa. A hi haasa'a te a pathepa biekuona kha aa hyicie aa. Kaa'a te a pathepa biekuona a thawpa tie ruena kha aa la aa.
Ama ta a pathliepa rieka tie khata biena-ing hne a dungkhuo kha para'a yi te ama papyapalyi aa. Iema ta pihluo tawpa myirue panaana kha para'a yi te capa lie ca duvsamakhiepa paratuv kha ama chi aa.
Biekuona a parapa tie kha hanghie pata a dung'a yi, cuorasala a Khazing'a lie zang tluo aa tlasa pata a awpa tie ta a cusa pata a daa'a yi te ama tuv hriy aa.
Cawsaa hrawtaata a singpa tie ta cawsaa hluvpuv kha singna ama pi aa; cadyiseca, cuo kha chung ca zueziy hne myi ta thie pata ama cuo aa, chuv pata cuo'a yi te sii ta sikhyipa ama cuo aa.
Amaa sung tiyta, byana a cawta hmung'a yi te, zang tluo aa tla lipa a hluvsa ta ama vaa phuv aa.

Mingsing chekha ca thie pata cuo'a yi te capa nakaw ca ta cuo chuona te lie kha cawsaa ca ama pathe vie aa, amaa thlie vie aa, tahematapakieca cuo kha chung khutaa dyi tana thli ciepa cuo ca a vya tlung aa.

“Siepahruo ta a khingpa kha a tue thluo aa. Ama hne ama kha a cyicalang'a te khazing tie mekaa laata a le vie ta aa rue aa, khazing tie Khazing kha a du pata bie chie hringhruopa zaw kha a ri aa. Hihaana cuo a tling hluo te kha ca a hlue a tling kalie aa, tahematapakieca Khazing ca aa ting ciepa kha a patling sa aa.

Ama ca a mingchingmingvuo tie khazing zaw kha siysaa ri'a vyi, canung zaw ta ama duesapa zaw kha siysaa ri'a vyi, tuokhaapa khazing kha hmuo pa-uvsathyi'a vyi, tahematapakieca ama hne ama kha zezaw bangkhuo laata a le vie ta aa rue aa.
Capa zaw laa cata riekhuopiehu khazing, a mingchingmingvuo zaw ta ama za pachang buo lipa khazing kha siy hne ngu, lungvaa hne lasaw muo ruvsapa zaw ta pa-uvsathyina a pi aa.

A riekhuopiehu a cu cepa tie kha ruohrang khazing a biepa tie kha a pahuo sa'a yi. Ama uvna a cuhluopa tie kha ama hnyirung vie riypata a tue'a yi, cawsaa hluvpuv cunglie uvtuv ta chi'a yi te, alyi kha lasaw ta a pi'a yi.

“A chuonapa cuo lie kha sungluo siepahruo ta ama kha aa du aa. Cuorasala chaluo siepahruo ta aruole hne aruo rieka hne tiypalaw zaw khata thliysung haata pahiesue'a te a tuv hriy aa. Khyta zaw kha la'a te tiy le ta a lesue aa.
Ruo puvthepa luo kha a ngiehnue'a yi te cawsaa thaw hluvsa kha a thie'a yi, cuorasala Edom hne Moab hne Ammon ming tapa tie ca a kuv taata amaa ruo hmuo aa.
Ruo kha hnang ruo kha ta tuvle'a te Izipt ruo zaw kha zang'a vyi.
Ama ca Izipt hnyirungna ta a cuopa siy hne ngu suethiy bangkhuo uvtuv ta aa li aa; Libia hne Ethiopia zaw kha a kuv raw luo amaa vya pi aa.
Cuorasala ningchiyluo hne chaluo taata a pathuopa thuohlaa khata ama kha pahlu sa te, cawsaa a hluvsa para riypa hne pahli riypata hihaasa pata a si aa.
A siepahruo thluodaa kha riyliy hne a pathepa tluo alalalie kha a sa aa. Cuorasala byatuv ahunghmuo hnyi li pata a chuona kha a pha aa.

“Capa cuo lie ca na cawsaa zaw a mangchiypa, a lepa avuoming Mikhael kha a vya pya aa. Capa cuo ca ruvnaana khuosa ta a tlungnapa cuo, mingphang zaw a za aw taa baataata a aw buo lipa ruvnaana cuo ta a cuo aa. Cuorasala capa cuo lie ca Khazing caa-uv chunglie ming capepa na mingphang zaw ca khuo pata ama cuo aa.
A thiy cie tlipa a hluvsa kha a kya cha pakhaa'a yi te, chekha ca chuozaa hringna luo, chekha ca nangzaana hne huena luo kha amaa kya cha aa.
A singpa tie ca avuo khepa haa khata khe'a yi te, cawsaa hluvsa kha adangna luo a chiypa tie ca chuozaa ta aasiy haata ama cuo aa.
Cuorasala nama Daniel ca bie pathepa hne caakhe khepa caa-uv hing cuo chuona te ta cake tie. Cawsaa hluvpuv ca hueluo hingluo ta pata a ruo'a yi te, pha lina kha a hluv hryly aa.”
Cakhutaata kama Daniel ta i mang ca a hrangpa cawsaa pahning amaa luo, pakha ca cavaa hingsuo lie hing a daa te a hrangpa pakha ca cavaa huesuoluo ta aa daa.
Iema chungtaata pakha ta cawthang phapa a hryipa, cavaa hnaaluo vie ta a daapa kyihuo khata, “Hingpa nang-uo aa chiypa a chuona riypa hing khacuo ma a ru kalie aa?” a ta.

Cawthang phapa a hryipa, cavaa hnaaluo vie ta a daapa ca ta a cacuo kuv hne a cavyi kuv kha avuo luo a caba. Cakhutaata, capa ca cuo kha, cuo hning hne cuo che chung tana a cuo aa, cawsaa pathepa cahrana kha dechipatlaa diy pata a cuo thueta na hingpa hmang bangkhuo hing a chuo aa,” ta pata chuozaa ta a hringpa'a lie chie aa sapa kha i thyi.
Kama ta i thyi, cuorasala a siyluo pachang va ang; caacuonakawta, “I byipaapa, hingpa hmang zaw ama chuona hing tuokhaatama a cuo aa?” i ta.
Ama ta, “Daniel, cakuo tie, tahematapakieca bie ca nu pata cuo kalie'a te, cuo chuona te ta caakhe khe pata chipa tana a cuo kalie aa.

Cawsaa hluvsa ca pathe sa pata cuo'a yi te amaa thlie aa, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa tie ca pha lina khana ama tue pazue kalie thluo aa. Cawsaa pha lipa pakha tahmuo pachang the'a va yi, cuorasala a singpa tie ta ca ama pachang aa.
Tue tawpa myirue panaana kha para pata cuo te, paratuv duvsamakhiepa ama china te khata, ning thawkha zahning sawcaky a ru aa.
Ning thawkha ning zathung sawthung ning pangaa a tlingna te ta palung pasiysa pata a aw khupa tie ca thluechiypa ta ama cuo aa.
Cuorasala nama ca na luopuv kha a chuona te ziy la a pahy tie; ning chuo ningpa liena na lawmuo cu riypata na thu pakhaa aa,” a ta.
Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz hne Hezekiah ta Judah siepahruo ama cuo ning, Joash sacapaa Jeroboam ta Israel siepahruo a cuo ningta kha Beeri sacapaa Hosea'a luo a zuvpa Abyipabie ca hing haa hingta a cuo.

Abyipata Hosea'a lie a yikhana bie a ri tiyta, Abyipata Hosea kyihuo khata, “Cakuo la, siyhrawnung kha napuv ta a la lah, siyhrawnung hne cata saa ta sa tie ung, tahematapakieca ruo ca Abyipakha thuse te na khuopuv ta a siyhraw tli,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta cakuo te Diblaim sacanung Gomer kha napuv ta aa la, cakhutaata nu phya te sacapaa pakha a sa.
Cakhutaata Abyipata, “Jezreel ta pata ming va sa tie; tahematapakieca cuo pachangta chunglieta Jehu ingchungkhue kha duote'a yi angte, Israel pena ca i pachuo sa aa.
Capa ning lie ca Jezreel bawphie lieta Israel liy kha i thli aa,” a ta.
Nu phya pakhaa te sacanung a sa. Cakhutaata Abyipata, “Lo-ruhamah ta pata ming sa tie, tahematapakieca Israel cunglie kha kawpacuona hne angiethena hnyi'a va tli ang.
Cuorasala Judah cunglie ca kawpacuona hnyi'a angte, liy hne zueziy, rietuvna, aruo, hne aruo rieka hmuo pata cuo li pata Abyipaiema Khazing tana i khuo'a yi,” a ta.
Gomer ta Lo-ruhamah kha ahnung a che khutaata nu phya pakhaa te sacapaa a sa.
Cakhutaata Abyipata, “Ama kha Lo-ammi ta pata ming sa tie, tahematapakieca nama ca i cawsaa ta cuo vaciy, kama zaw na Khazing ta cuo va ang,” a ta.

Cuorasala Israel ming ca ri tie a aw lipa riyliy viehnang zaa ama ta aa; cakhutaata, “Niema ca i cawsaa ta cuo va ung ciy,” i tanapa hmang lie yi kha, “A hringpa Khazing saata zaw,” ta pata ama cuo aa.
Judah ming hne Israel ming ca pahmya pakhaw pata cuo'a yi te, iema ta ama luochiytuv riypa kha amaa tlaw aa; cakhutaata iema ta ruo kha ama cu aa, Jezreel ning ca a lesyi aa.
Na caapaapa Ammi, hne na sietanung Ruhamah kha chang tie yi.

Na nung kha paakie tie, paakie tie, tahematapakieca ama ca i napuv ta cuo va ma? Kama zaw a navaapa ta cuo va ang ma? A siyhrawna hmiephya kha thaw sala, nungvaathingsuena a tuepa kha a cacunghnaa taata a thaw riypata paakie tie ung.
Caacuolikieca a caw kha thliepa diy'a angte, a za puv ning haa kha tana a thliehripa ta i chi aa. Ruocaapa haata hne kuo-uvpa ruo haata tue'a angte tiyhrie pata na a thiy aa.
A saata tie cunglie zaw kha kawpacuona hnyi'a va ang, tahematapakieca iema ca siyhrawnung saata tana ama cuo.

Ama nung ta siyhraw te, nangzaa aa chiy pata a awna taata a phyapa yi tana ama cuo. Tahematapakieca, “I khingpa tie khana i ziy'a yi; iema ta i sa hne i tiy kha ina pi yi, i tuvhming hne i palaa hne i chiytiy hne i tiy kha ina pi yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta a luopuv kha ahling siy khuo'a angte, a luopuv kha a hmung the li riypata lungruetlepie kha i chung khuo aa.

A khingpa tie kha a cade'a yi te, cuorasala pha khu'a va yi; iema kha huv'a yi te, cuorasala hmung khu'a va yi. Cakhutaata, “I navaapa taapa'a luo khana i kaa pakhaa aa, tahematapakieca ama'a lie i za aw ning kha ata laa hingta a pha vie,” a ta aa.
Ama ta sa, mingsuvtiy, hne chiytiy a pituv ca kama ta i cuopa kha pachang vyi, Baal cuota ama hmuopa siy hne ngu pahyasa pata a pituv zaw kha pachang vyi.
Caacuonakawta sa la cuo ning kha i sa ca la pakhaa angte, i mingsuvtiy zaw kha ama'a na a cuo ningta i la pakhaa diy aa; ama pabuv riypata i pipa i tuvhming hne i palaa zaw kha i la pakhaa diy aa.
Aa khingpa tie zaw hmungna lie kha a caw thliepa diy'a angte, ahungtahmuo i kuv taata khuo khu'a va yi.
Aa nuona, abiena pyi tie, a thla thaapa, a sabbath, ama'a na a cuo lieta tuepa pyi tie bangkhuo kha i pachuo sa diy aa.
“I khingpa tie ta ina pipa yi i hluepa tana a cuo,” a tapa a mingsuv kung hne a thyikuv kung zaw kha i para diy aa; saruopa zaw ta ce diy'a yi te ruopahriypa ta i pali aa.
Kama kha na maw te, a kuvpahryi hne a suethiy zaw kha a tue te, a khingpa tie zaw a ziy ning yi, Baal abiena pyi ning, rangpa-ue a pihluo nguoluo ning khata duo i te aa, Abyipata a ta.
Caacuonakawta ama kha dungpahya'a angte, ruocaapa luo sikhyi'a angte, i ripasa aa.
Capa lie ca a mingsuv diedung kha i pi pakhaa aa, Ruvnaana Bawphie ca anguopuona thlake ta i tue aa. Capa lie ca Izipt ruo taata a kya pya ning, a lesaa ning haa khata ina palie aa.
Capa ning lie ca nama ta, “I navaapa,” ina ta'a ciy, “I Baal,” na ta'a va tli ciy, Abyipata a ta.
Tahematapakieca Baal tapa kha a pakaa taata thawpa'a angte, iema ta ming haata ri'a va tli yi.

Capa ning thue ca niema cuo ta saruopa zaw, avuo lieta a zupa pavaa zaw, alyi lie a valepa saruopa tie zaw hneta biekuona i tue aa; liy, zueziy, hne rietuvna ta hmuopa tie ca ruo chung taa hingta pahli diy'a yi angte, niema ca aa bangsa pata ica pa-aw sa'a yi.
Cakhutaata nama ca chuozaa i napuv riypata icaa la aa; adangna, biedangpa, aa hmangpa duena hne nangduena hneta i napuv ta icaa la aa.
Kama ta zang tluo atlana hneta i napuv ta caa la'a angte, Abyipakha na pachang aa.
Capa ning lie ca kama ta ica palie aa, Abyipata a ta. Avuo zaw kha palie'a yi angte, iema ta alyi kha ama palie aa;
Alyi ta sa, mingsuvtiy hne chiytiy kha palie'a yi te, iema ta Jezreel kha ama palie aa.

Cakhutaata ama kha kama cuo ta alyi lie i ling aa. Lo-ruhamah cunglie kha kawpacuona hnyi'a angte, Lo-ammi kyihuo khata, “Nama ca i cawsaa tana na cuo,” i ta aa; cakhutaata ama ta, “Nama ca i Khazing tana na cuo,” ina ta aa.

Abyipata kama kha ina chang pakhaa, “Cakuo la khazing hrangpa'a luo a maa yi te mingsuv caapa viechuo a ningpa Israel ming kha Abyipata a duepa haa yi hingta a khingpa aw te nungvaathingsuena a tue nung kha va due tie,” ina ta.
Caacuonakawta ngu tuokaa shekel suohraa hlyipangaa hne barli homer suokha hne mingsuvtiy thyi kha ta i va calyi.
Cakhutaata ama kyihuo khata, “Cuo pasiysa kama'a lie na aw aa; siyhraw'a va tli ciy, capaa hneta nung hne vaa cuo'a va ung ciy, kama hneta zaw cuo'a vapuv,” i ta.
Tahematapakieca Israel ming ca cuo pasiypuv chung siepahruo cuose byi cuose hnyi li pata ama aw aa, hriykhungrina hne lungbang, tluobyi buohryi hne ingchungkhue khazing zaw hnyi li pata ama aw aa.
Cakhutaata Israel ming ca Abyipaama Khazing, hne ama siepahruo David huv riypa khata ama kaa pakhaa aa. Cuo chuona lie ca Abyipahne a phana luo kha ciyzaana hneta ama vya kaa aa.

Vya Israel cawsaa zaw, Abyipabie kha thyi tie ung; tahematapakieca Abyipana hingpa ruo lie khy a sapa tie cunglie hing bie suokha a hnyi. Ruo chunglie hing adangna hne zang tluo atlana, hne Khazing pachangna zaw aw vyi.
Chiesana, hanghiena, a thiena, paruvna hne nungvaathingsuena a hluvsa; thiyse palangna suokha hnang suokha ta aa paziy.
Caacuonakawta ruo ca muochie dyi sa te, a chunglie a awpa tie ca aa uv ta amaa uv; saruopa zaw, avuo lie a zupa pavaa zaw, riyliy lie a awpa ngaa zaw kha ama lidie diy aa.
Ahungtahmuo zaapuv kha pasue pata pasiypa-yana bie chang khah yi se, tahematapakieca i pasue khingpa yi ca niema tluobyi tie hing tana nama cuo.
Nama ca ningchung ta a pachiy'a cate, profet tie ta nama hne khata zuo ta amaa pachiy aa, cakhutaata kama ta na nung kha i para aa.

I cawsaa zaw ca thesingna amaa bu nakawta para pata ama cuo; nama ta thesingna kha na khing li nakawta, kama ta i tluobyi cuo riypa khata ca khing ra va ang. Khazing phungbie na maw ning taa khata, kama zaw ta na saata zaw kha i maw ra'a yi.
Tluobyi ama hluv vie aa, kama'a lie ama sue vie aa; iema ta ama rungnaana kha nangzaana ta ama thle.
I cawsaa tie suena thueta hnyirung yi te, pha lina ama tue hryly riypa kha ama khing.
Cawsaa zaw'a lie i tuepa haa khata tluobyi tie'a lie zaw i tue ra aa, iema ca ama suena cuo khata duote'a yi angte, ama tuena muo kha i thung'a yi.
Iema ca ning'a yi te, cuorasala ama rue cing the'a vyi, siyhraw'a yi te, cuorasala pungzaa'a va yi; tahematapakieca ama hringna kha siyhrawna lie ta hmuo yi te,
Abyipakha ama maw.

I cawsaa tie ta thing pachungpasaapa kha bie ama hiehriy, asung ca ta iema ca ama pachang khingpa kha a chang yi. Tahematapakieca siyhrawna thlaapa khata luo papie sa yi te, siyhraw yi te ama Khazing kha ama maw.

Iema ta tluodaw lie kha hriykhungrina tue yi te, tluothlue zaw cunglie a ningdiy phapa thingkung zaw rawlie kha ama panaa. Caacuonakawta na sacanung zaw ca siyhrawnung ta cuo yi te, na munung zaw ta nungvaathingsuena ama tue.

Na sacanung zaw kha ama siyhraw nakawta duo te'a va yi ang, na munung zaw kha ma nungvaathingsuena ama tue nakawta duo te'a va yi ang; tahematapakieca capaa tie hrahring zaw kha siyhrawnung hne awhne yi te, biena-ing siyhrawnung tie hne khata hriykhungrina ama tue; cahaacata pachangna a hnyi lipa cawsaa tie kha ama ra.
Vya Israel, nama ca na siyhrawle raalaa pata, Judah ming ca sue ra thi khah yi se. “Abyipaa hringpa haata,” Gilgal luo cuose, Beth-aven luo cuose, khaw pata chie a kya sa khah yi se.
A palung lepa cuelaanung haata, Israel ca a palung na a le; Abyipata a kusapa ruopanuna hmang lie tuvtaata sa a pipa haata tuokhaatama a pi khu aa?
Israel ca kuvtuezuv ta pamya tli te, ama aw khata aw se.
Ama dang riypa a chuo tiyta, thiysaa khingna lie kha amaa nuo; saapa lunghruo tlungna khana iema rungnaana laata ama khing vie.
Thliy a vya hruopa khata phya'a yi te, ama lawki hriykhungrina zaw kawlie khata ama nang a zaa aa.

Vya tluobyi tie, hingpa hing thyi tie ung! Vya Israel ming, naathlie tie ung! Vya siepahruo chungkhue zaw, naathlie tie ung! Bieripana ca niema ang riypa tana a cuo; niema ca Mizpah lie kha cyihyi ta cuo ung cate, Tabor lieta pakepa asue tana nama cuo,
Shittim lieta aa thuvsa pata cupa khue ta cuo ung cate, cuorasala capa zaw bangkhuo ca kama ta duo i te'a yi.
Kama ta Efraim kha i pachang, Israel ca kama'a taata a nu vyi; tahematapakieca ata hing, Vya Efraim, nama ca na siyhraw; Israel ca a pyalyi.
Ama tuepa khata Khazing'a luo vya kaa riypata luo pa-aw va yi. Tahematapakieca siyhrawna thlaapa kha ama chunglie aw te, Abyipakha pachang va yi.
Israel ming hruotlena khata ama a du pata tehte khuo te, Efraim ca a suena lie aa pachiy; Judah zaw iema hne cata aa pachiy ra.
Ama sahring hne ama tuvrung zaw hne khata Abyipahuv riypata ama si aa, cuorasala ama kha hmung'a va yi; ama ca iema kha a cakuose tli yi.
Iema ca Abyipa'a lie kha zang tluo hetahmuo a tla va yi, tahematapakieca riesaa na ama sa. Ama thla thaapa pyi na iema hne ama lu hne khata a para'a yi.
Gibeah lie kha saa kiy ca tung ung la, Ramah lieta hmyakaa kha tung tie ung. Beth-aven lie kha rietuvna tluo u tie ung; nama Benjamin, na hnangkaa luo kha mang tie!
Duotena ning lieta Efraim ca a duothling aa; a cuo hmisi riypa khana Israel phang hrawlie kha i pathyi sa.
Judah siepahruo tie ca luriy a hnyipa khana ama lu aa; i hihaana ca tiy haa tana iema cunglie kha i lyi aa.
Efraim ca bieripana lieta tuechiepa hne chaapuopa ta a cuo, tahematapakieca ama ca a hrihripa hnang luo khana a ziy.
Caacuonakawta Efraim cuota a ngaapa haata cuo angte, Judah ingchungkhue cuota zang tluo a tla lipa haata i cuo.

Efraim ta a pasana kha aa hmung tiyta hne, Judah ta hmaa a phyapa kha aa hmung tiyta, Efraim ta Assiria luo cakuo te, a lepa siepahruo'a luo kha byana a hie. Cuorasala ca patluo sa khu'a va yi, nama hmaa kha ca patluo sa'a va yi.
Tahematapakieca Efraim cuo ta hne, Judah ingchungkhue cuo khata chingde haa tana i cuo aa. Kama hrahring ta caphipatlaa'a yi angte i thuse'a yi; a dale'a yi angte, ahungtahmuo khuo khu'a va yi.
Iema ta ama suena kha a pachang pata i hmie ina huvna te yi, i awna luo kha i kaase'a yi. Palung rie thyisa pata i hmiephaa kha ama huv aa:
“A vaw ung la Abyipa'a luo kaa ung siy; Tahematapakieca malie a caphipatlaapa ca ama ta cuo te, ama ta malie a patluo aa; malie tuv tli te, ama ta ma hmaa kha malie a catawpa aa.
Ning hning khutaata malie pahring pakhaa'a te, a hmiekunglie ma hring riypata ning thungna lieta malie a pathu pakhaa aa.

Pachang ung siy, Abyipapachang riypa kha a zue ung siy; khy a kya dyi hrahring riypa haa khata ama ca aa vaw hrahring aa; kiema'a luo kha saciy a vaapa haata a vaw'a te, alyi a pacing sapa cuovuo khytiy haa khata aa vaw hrahring aa.”
Vya Efraim, tuokhaatama ica tue aa? Vya Judah tuokhaatama ica tue aa? Na duena ca maw ta a pyapa amyi haata cuo te, a pe paluopa aduo haa tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta profet tie khata hupatyi tli yi te, i pakaa taata a pyapa bie ta i thie yi, cahaacata i bieripana ca khena haa khata hmie luo a si.
Kama ca hriykhungrina laata, aa hmangpa duena khana i khing vie, Myirue panaana laata Khazing pachangna khana i khing vie.
Cuorasala Adam haa khata i biekuona ama para, capa lie ca kama kha ina dung yi.
Gilead ca pha lina a tuepa tie khypuv tana a cuo, thiyse langna luopuv tana a bi.
Ama thie khingpa cawsaa kha damie tie ta ama byapa haata, tluobyi tie ca a phuv ta aw yi te, Shekhem luo sinapa luopuv lie kha cawsaa ama thie, suena lesapa na ama tue.
Israel ingchungkhue liena ciy aa chiysapa i hmung; Efraim siyhrawna ca capa lie ca aw te, Israel ca papyapalyi pata na a cuo.
Vya Judah, nama zaw, bieripana cuo ca chipa pata na na cuo. Kama ta i cawsaa zaw vuophana i pi pakhaa thue yi ta ca.

Kama ta Israel kha patluo sa i nang tiyta, Efraim a za ranapa hne, Samaria ta pha lina a tuepa kha aa luo; Pakha hne pakha amaa dung, ing chungluo a ngie yi te ama paruv, ale lie zaw kha cawsaa hmang ama chuv.
Cuorasala ama pha lina bangkhuo i thyi diypa kha pachang va yi. Ama pha lina ta cadung yi te, iema ca i hmiekunglie na ama aw thluo.
Ama pha lina khata siepahruo palung kha patluo yi te, byi tie zaw kha dung yi te ama palung ama patluo.

Iema bangkhuo ca nungvaathingsuena a tuepa tana ama cuo; Viedie ama naw cuo taata e tiy a tana te ta, viechuo a tuepa ta myi kha taw bungthaw li pata aw te, a lingsapa viechuo enapa haa kha tana ama cuo.
Ma siepahruo pyi ning kha byi tie ca mingsuvtiy ama pariy diy; cawsaa a tue hyalyapa tie hne kha tana a kuv a pazuo pakhaw ra.
Viechuo enapa haa khata myi thluv pata cuo yi te, ama palung chunglie ca a ling dyi a ling; ama hihaana ca zuokhydyi ling te, maw khy a dyi tiyta myi haata aa hlaa.
Iema bangkhuo ca viechuo enapa haata ling yi te, iema a uvtuv tie kha ama kuo. Ama siepahruo tie bangkhuo ca thiy yi te, kama kha u pata byana naa hiepa ahunghmuo aw va yi.
Efraim ca ruohrang ming hne tana aa pya, Efraim ca pali lipa viechuo tana a cuo.
Ruohrang ming ta a thaazuo kha ning diy yi te, cuorasala ama ta capa ca pachang vyi;
Israel ca a hruotlena ta ama a du pata tehte khuo te, cuorasala iema ta Abyipaama Khazing'a luo kha kaa va yi.
Efraim ca thuvruv na a lu, ngaasa te khueruena hnyi vyi; Izipt kha a ku te, Assiria luo kha a cakuo.
Khaapa luo ama cakuo zaw ta, i sue ta buv'a yi angte, avuo lie pavaa haata i patuv'a yi; Iema amaa pungna taata i thyipa haata i pasiypa-ya'a yi.
Bawchie ciemuopa tana ama cuo, tahematapakieca kama'a taa tana luo ama pie tli! Parapa tana ama cuo aa, tahematapakieca kama na inaa du yi! A thla naase yi ang i ta, cuorasala kama kha ina dung yi.
Ama pathiypalung hmisi ta kama'a luo kha khi va yi, cuorasala ama iehmang lieta ama caa; Sa hne mingsuvtiy hmung khingna vuota, iema hne iema kha amaa uo chi; Kama inaa dupa yi tana a cuo.
Pacuv yi angte ama buo a cahrasapa ca kama tana i cuo, cuorasala kama kha na raw yi te inaa du yi.

Thlahnena a hnyi lipa luo kha a maa yi te, a pha lipa liy ta amaa li; ama palyi ta a ripa bie pha lipa kawlie khata, ama byi tie ca zueziy ta ama thiy aa. Hingpa kawlie hingta Izipt ruo chunglie pahnyisue pata ama cuo aa.
Hmyakaa kha tung tie! Carie ca luotaa haa tana Abyipaing cunglie a vya zu aa, tahematapakieca i biekuona kha para yi te, i phungbie lie kha ama sue tli.
Israel ming ta kama'a luo kha khi yi te, “Ma Khazing, kiema, Israel ta maca pachang!” ina ta yi.
Israel ca a phapa kha khing vyi; carie ta amaa cade aa.
Kama ruena hie li pata siepahruo kha ama padaa; kama pachang sa li pata byi tie kha ama padaa. Iema mamaa rana riypa khata ama siy hne ama ngu khata kuvtuezuv amaa sa.
Vya Samaria, na cuetaata ca thawpa tana a cuo, iema cungliena i hi a haa hringhruo.
Tahematapakieca hingpa hing Israel taa tana a cuo, kuvzung a thepa na a tue, Khazing ta cuo vyi. Samaria cuetaata ca dekary diy pata na a cuo aa.
Tahematapakieca thliy kha tuv yi te, thliysung khana ama pahriy aa. Aa daapa sa kung ca a uv aw valaa te, sa pavyi'a vyi; a vyi kie zawma, ruohrang ming na a ning diy'a yi.
Israel ca paluo pata na a cuo; ata hing iema ca mingphang zaw hrawlie kha hmuo the a aw lipa biphie haa tana ama cuo.
Tahematapakieca iema ta Assiria luo kha ama se ta a vielepa laa haata sithaw yi te, Efraim ca a khingpa tie'a luo khana amata tah aa zaa tli.
Mingphang hrang tie'a luo kha aa zaa raalaa pata, kama ta i kya pakhaw'a yi. Iema ca a ru hluota siepahruo tie hne byi tie hmangriypa kha amaa nangkhyi aa.
Efraim ta sue pathe sa panaana cuota bienatluophie kha a hluvsa a sa raalaa pata, iema cuota ca suena bienatluophie tana amaa li diy.
Iema cuota pacuvna kha caa ta a hluvsa i capepa raalaa yi ca, a zi lipa yi ta ruohrang ming huopa ta ama ri.
Hriykhungrina ta a pha cepa kha pi yi te, saa kha ama ce raalaa pata, Abyipata cuhluo va yi. Ama pha lina kha a thyipa'a yi te, duo a te'a yi; Izipt ruo luo na i pakaa sa pakhaa'a yi.

Israel ta ama Satuv kha maw tli te, ing pha daduo kha aa sa. Judah ta dungkhuo a hnyipa khypuv kha sa hryly te, cuorasala a khypuv tie kha myi tana i rue aa, capa ca ta a cariekyikuo kha a kuo diy aa.

Vya Israel, na palung tluo khah se! Mingphang hrangpa tie ama tuepa haata a lawsa khah; tahematapakieca nama ca siyhraw cate, na Khazing kha na pyase tli. Suo-aciyna bangkhuo lieta na siyhrawna muo aca pipa yi kha naa lawkhyi.
Suo-aciyna hne mingsuvtiy ruocuo ta iema kha sa pi'a va yi, mingsuvtiy thaapa hnyi'a va yi.
Iema ca Abyiparuo lie kha aw li'apa yi ta, cuorasala Efraim ca Izipt luo khana a kaa aa, Assiria lie khana a pathe lipa sa ama ning aa.

Iema ta Abyipa'a luo mingsuvtiy ta dangpa ta panaana zaw kha tue'a va tli yi, iema pihluopa hriykhungrina ta a palung patluo vyi. Cahaapa hriykhungrina ca muochie a sapa tie sa hne kha tana aa lu aa; capa sa a ningpa bangkhuo ca a pathe lipa ta amaa li aa; ama sa ca ama nangdiy papena dyi ta cuo'a te, Abyipa ing luo chiykhyi pata cuo'a vyi.
Ama'a na a cuo lieta tuepa pyi tie lie hne, Abyipapyi ning lie kha khaapama nama tue aa?
Rana chungtaata ama law zaw ta, Izipt ta pahmya'a yi te, Memfis lieta paby pata ama cuo aa. A muosungpa ngu suethiy zaw kha uvtamyi ta pahlaw'a te, ama thluodaa chunglie kha ahling kung ta a bi aa.

Duotena ning ca aa vaw nguoluo, amaa phuvna haata thungna cuo ca aa vaw nguoluo; Israel ta khi te, “Profet ca a ngaa tli, thlaapa cawsaapa ca a mya tli!” a ta. A lepa na pha lina kawlieta, cawsaa naa cariena ca a lesa.
Profet ca i Khazing hne khata Efraim cunglie rievetuv tana ama cuo, cuorasala a luopuv bangkhuo lie tana pavaa cyihyi a awle, Khazing ing chunglie hmuota cawsaa tie hing profet carie tana ama cuo.
Iema ca Gibeah chuo ning haa kha tana iema hne iema kha khuosa ta amaa para; Khazing ta ama pha lina kha thyipa'a yi te, duo a te'a yi.

Ruocaapa chunglie a awpa mingsuv haa kha tana Israel hing i za hmung. A pathyi taa cuo ningta, zaa pathyi taapa thyikuv haa kha tana, na mingchingmingvuo tie kha i za hmung yi. Cuorasala Baal-peor ama pha tiyta, nangzaa aa chiysapa luo kha iema hne iema ca a pi yi te, ama duepa hmang tie haa khata duv aa chiysa pata amaa li.
Efraim rungnaana ca pavaa haata a zu'a te, nu phya'a va tli yi, saata sa'a va tli yi!
Saata ama sa kie zawma, pakha hmuo amaa ngaa lina te ta i lapa diy'a yi. Kama ta i pyase tiy yi ta ca, bawchie ciemuopa tana ama cuo hmisi!
Efraim ca aphuv panuna ruo lie a lingpa tungkung haa tana i za hmung, cuorasala Efraim ta a saata zaw kha thie riypata a pyakhyi'a yi.
Pi tie yi, Vya Abyipa, khaapama na pi'a yi? Nu a phya the lipa nu-ing hne ahnungtiy caapa meme kha pi tie yi.

Ama pha lina mekaa ca Gilgal taa tana aa patha; capa lie ca na iema kha i hue yi. Ama tuepa a pha lipa kawlieta, i ing taa khata i cade'a yi. Iema kha due'a va tli yi ang; ama byi tie bangkhuo ca dutuv tana ama cuo.
Efraim ca hmaa a phyapa ta cuo te, ama thariy na a caa, a thyi kha pathyi'a va yi. Saata ama sa kie zawma, kama na ama duesapa ama saata zaw ca a thie'a yi ang.
A bie kha ama naathlie li nakawta, i Khazing na a thaw'a yi, iema ca mingphang zaw hrawlie a vievuvpa tana ama cuo aa.
Israel ca a rungsapa mingsuv kung tana a cuo, amata tah a thyi kha a pathyi. A pathyi hryly tiyta, bienatluophie a hluv vie ta a sa, a ruo a kiethaw hryly tiyta, a lungbang kha a pahluv vie hryly.
Ama pathiypalung ca a sue; ama suena kha ama ang aa. Abyipata ama bienatluophie kha phipatlaa'a te, ama lungbang zaw kha a thlipachung aa.
