Iema ta, “Abyipakha ma ciy li nakawta siepahruo hnyi vapuv, siepahruo ta khaapama malie a tuepa khu aa?” ama ta aa.
Bie kha ri cakhawsa yi te, siyluo a hnyi lipa chiesana hne biekuona kha ama tue, caacuonakawta tazaa a cyina ca ca-ie a hnyipa lubi, lekaw aa hnuena lie a pupa haata ama pu.

Samaria lie khy a sapa tie ca Beth-aven cuetaata kawlie khata aa cathang dyi ama cathang. A cawsaa tie ta muochie sa'a yi te, nungvaathingsuena a tuepa a tluobyi tie kha ama caa aa, a rungnaana kha chuv'a yi te ama sikhyi aa.
Cuetaata hrahring ca a lesyipa siepahruo lasaw pi riypata Assiria luo ama sikhyi aa. Efraim ca a hmie pachi pata cuo'a te, Israel ca a kuvtuezuv kawlieta a nang a zaa aa.
Samaria siepahruo ca tiy cunglie a phangpa thing pepieta haa khata a vie aa.

Aven lie khahrungtluobu, Israel suena ca para pata a cuo aa. Ama bienatluophie lie kha ahling hne aphuv dyina a pu aa. Iema ta tluo zaw kha, ‘Malie za buvkhung la,’ ta'a yi te, tluothlue kha, ‘Malie za cingsue la,’ ama ta aa.
Vya Israel, Gibeah chuo taa khata za sue cate, capa lie ca aa pazue pata ama sue. Gibeah lie kha rie ta pha'a va yi ma?
Chang khu a aw lipa tie duote riypa hingta i vaw aa; ama pha lina thang hning kawlieta duotepa ama cuo tiyta, mingphang zaw kha iema a du riypata amaa hmya aa.
Efraim ca hri tlipa cuelaanung, sacuo a ciy the tlipa tana a za cuo, a puvthepa a ruetung lie kha ruekhang khang'a angte, a lyi a pali aa; Judah ta the ka'a te, Jacob ta le a thaw aa.

Adangna kha niema cuo ta tuv tie ung; aa hmangpa duena kha pahriy ung la, nama'a lyi kha pali tie ung; tahematapakieca Abyipahuvna cuo tana a cuo, cahaacata ama kha a vaw'a te nama cunglie adangna khy kha a pasaa sa aa.
Niema ta pha lina kha tuv ung cate, a thyipaa kha nama pahriy, hanghiena thyi zaw kha nama ning. Niema cahrana kha a ringchuo ung cate, a hluvsapa nama rieka tie kha namaa ringchuo.

Caacuonakawta rietuvna ca nama cawsaa zaw cunglie kha tlung'a te, nama riekhuopiehu bangkhuo ca para pata a cuo aa. Rietuv ningta Shalman siepahruo ta Beth-arbel a za parapa haa khata nung tie hne saata zaw a za thie ning haa khata a cuo aa.
Vya Bethel, a lepa na pha lina kawlie khata nama ca cahaaca tana tue pata na cuo aa. Khy a kya vuo baaningpa kha tana Israel siepahruo ca para pata a cuo aa.
Israel a za haatiyta ning kha i za duesa, i sacapaa ca Izipt taata pya riypata i u.
I u vie yi, inaa hla vie yi; Baal'a lie kha hriykhungrina pihluo yi te, kuvtuezuv'a lie kha rangpa-ue ama pihluo.
Efraim kha luo cakuo a pacuvpa ca kama tana i cuo, calang yi angte i pawle yi, cuorasala i patluo sapa yi kha pachang va yi.
Iema kha cawsaa ngiechina khuhriy ta pa-uo yi angte, duena riy ta i ciypuo yi. Iema cuota haatiy kha caba te a be lie a pabepuopa haata i cuo, a bungchiy yi angte sa i pi yi.
Iema ca Izipt luo na ama kaa aa, kama'a luo ama vya kaa khing li nakawta Assiria khana ama siepahruo ta a cuo aa.
Zueziy kha ama khypuv cunglie tlung'a te, biephu a pipa tluobyi tie kha a thie'a yi, iema ama ting paruvpa kawlie khata ama thiy aa.
I cawsaa zaw ca kama a ruose riypa khata inaa maase yi. Cungnungce kha ama u, cuorasala ama ta cyicalang'a va yi.

Tuokhaatama ica thaw khu aa, Efraim? Tuokhaatama ica pathlie khu aa, Israel? Tuokhaatama Admah haata ica tue khu aa? Tuokhaatama Zeboiim cunglie i tuepa haata ica tue khu aa? I palung a thle angte, kaw ica pacuo yi.

I hihaa pata re hrie'a va ang; Efraim ca para pakhaa'a va ang; tahematapakieca kama ca Khazing ta cuo angte, cawsaa ta cuo va ang, nama hrawlie hing Khazing Pathe na a aw, caacuonakawta hihaana hneta a vaw'a va ang.
Iema ta chingde haata a hrungpa Abyipakha ama paziy aa; Ama kha aa hrung tiyta, a saata zaw ca ningchiyluo taa khata a cathangsa pata amaa vaw aa.
Izipt taa khata pavaa haata a cathangsa pata a kya zu'a yi te, Assiria ruo taata thuvruv zaw haata amaa vya zu aa; cakhutaata iema kha ama ing luo i pakaa sa'a yi, Abyipata a ta.
Efraim ta kama kha hanghiena ta na cadung te, Israel ta dungviena ta ina cadung; cuorasala Judah ca ata tepa hingta Khazing hneta cakuo te, Khazing Pathe'a lie kha zang tluo aa tla kalie.
Efraim ca thliy na a khie, ning-aw tana ningchiy thliy kha aa cade; iema ta hanghiena hne tuechiena kha a hluvsa ama tue; Assiria hneta biekuona va tue yi te, Izipt luo kha chiytiy ama paphya.
Abyipana Judah ming cunglie bie a hnyi, Jacob ca a hringzya hne aa ziy pata duo a te aa, a tuena haa khata a thung aa.
A nung riy chunglie kha a uvta hmaachue a zue te, a kya uvthyi taata Khazing kha aa zue.
Avuoming hneta a pie yi te a te, caa te thluechiyna aa hie; Bethel lie kha avuoming hne a taw yi te, capa lie ca avuoming hneta bie amaa chaw.
AbyipaCungnungce Khazing, Abyipaca a ming ta a cuo!
Caacuonakawta nama ca Khazing'a luo kha kaa tie, duena hne biedangpa kha a patuv taa la, na Khazing kha aa pazue pata huo tie.
Sungpalituv pakha, a kuv chungliena aa hmuo lipa cyipathliena a aw, ama ca cawsaa na a hrisaa khingsa.
Efraim ta, “Ah, kama ca i hnyirung, i hnyirungsa mangtli; i hmungpa hnyirungna lie hing suena ta a cuo riypa tuesuena khaapahmuo aw vyi,” a ta.
Kama ca Izipt ruo chungtaata caa pyakhyipa Abyipanama Khazing tana i cuo; Ama'a na a cuo lieta tuepa pyi ning haa kha tana thluodaa chunglie ica pa-aw sa pakhaa'a yi.
Profet'a luo kha bie ri angte, muocuo a hluvsa a pipa ca kama tana i cuo, cakhutaata profet tie'a taa khata rana i patlung sa aa.
Gilead liena pha lina a aw, a hrihripa ta amaa li hrahring aa. Gilead lie kha cuetungpa ta hriykhungrina ama tue, caacuonakawta iema bienatluophie ca lu lieta lungpung haata a cuo aa.
Jakob ca Aram ruo luo kha a ruo te, capa lie ca napuv kha a hlue, napuv chiy khu riypata tuv kha a khie.
Abyipata profet hmuo pata Israel kha Izipt taata kya pyakhyi te, profet pakha hmuo pata a mangchiy.
Efraim ta Abyipakha khuopuv ta a hi a pahaa, caacuonakawta a Byipaapa ta a ling a pazuena kawlie kha thung hriy'a te, a cunglie duotena a patlung sa aa.
Efraim ta bie a ri tiyta, cawsaa kha amaa cathang; ama ca Israel hrawlie cyicalang pata a cuo; cuorasala Baal aa bie nakawta sue te a thiy.

Ata zaw hing ama sue hryly, kuvtuezuv kha iema cuota amaa patle, ama thena thiy ta ngu kuvtuezuv kha a tue yi te a bangkhuo ta kuv zung a thepa tie tuepa tana a cuo. Iema ta, “Hingpa zaw hing hriykhungrina pihluo tie ung,” ama ta. Cawsaa ta cuetaata zuv ca ama pahnuo!
Caacuonakawta iema ca a vie paluopa mawdiy amyi hne aduo haa kha tana ama cuo aa, suo-aciyna lie a zupa savie haata hne thlaluo aw taata a vya ngiepa myikhuv haa tana ama cuo aa.
Cuorasala kama ca Izipt ruo taata caa pyakhyipa yi Abyipanama Khazing tana i cuo; kama ta li pata khazing hrangpa za pachang va ung ciy, kama ta li pata khuotuv hrangpa aw vyi.
Ruo chunglie, ruocaapa lieta sa caa ringpa yi kha kama tana i cuo.
Kama ta ama riy i pabi ning yi ca ama me a nguo; ama me nguo te, a hruo ama tle; caacuonakawta kama kha ina maw yi.
Caacuonakawta iema'a lie kha chingde haata na i cuo aa, kyiching haa tana luopuv kielie i daakhuo'a yi.
A taata ama chuvpa cavaw haata a zuchiy'a yi angte, caphi'a yi angte ama khaa kha i pahaw'a yi. Capa lie ca chingde haa khata ica ce diy'a yi, aa hruopa saa haa khata ica hlechi diy'a yi.
Vya Israel, nama ca ica para aa; ahungma caa bya khu aa?
Caa khuo khu riypa yi nama siepahruo ca khaapaliema a aw? Nama khypuv bangkhuo lieta nama uvtuv tie ca khaapaliema ama aw? Nama ta, “Siepahruo hne uvtuv tie kha na pi tie,” na ta.
I hihaa pata siepahruo kha ca pi angte, i pathiy ling pata iema kha i la pakhaa yi.
Efraim pha lina ca catawpuo pata cuo te, a suena ca i pacung tli.
Nupazina a angna riypa ca aa ngie tli, cuorasala ama ca a sing lipa sacapaa tana a cuo; Tahematapakieca a cuo aa de ning khata nu-ing pakaa luo kha za tung vyi.

Iema kha Sheol cahrana taata i khuo'a yi ma? Iema kha Thiyna taata i thla'a yi ma? Vya Thiyna, na puvtlung pasana ca khaapaliema a aw? Vya Sheol, na parana ca khaapaliema a aw? Kawpacuona ca kama ming taa tana aa nu.

Ama ca a uvnu hrawlieta a lethaw raalaa pata, Abyipa'a taata ningchiy thliy ca ruocaapa taa khata thu'a te a vya hruo aa; cakhutaata a cavaa zaw ca caa'a te, a takhue zaw ca a ky aa. A suethiy muosungpa mekaa kha aa sung diy aa.

Samaria ta ama a suena kha a ang aa, tahematapakieca ama ca a Khazing na aa du; iema ca zueziy ta thiy'a yi te, ama haatiyta tie ca alyi vaana'a yi te ama kyichi diy aa, nu a phyapa ama canung tie ca ama riy thlaa pata ama cuo aa.
Vya Israel, Abyipana Khazing'a luo kha vya kaa pakhaa tie; tahematapakieca nama ca na pha lina kawlieta naa lie tli.
Bie zaw hing a la lah, Abyipa'a luo kha kaa pakhaa tie; Ama kyihuo khata, “I suena hing na thawpa la; a phapa kha naa lapa thi tie, cakhutaata kiema ta maca pathuosa aa.
Assiria ta kiema kha malie khuo'a vyi; kiema ca aruo kha a khang'a vapuv; ma kuv ta ma tuepa kha, ‘Ma Khazing,’ ta'a va tli puv. Nama chungliena haaraa zaw ta nangduena ama hmung,” ta tie.
Kama ta zang tluo amaa tla lina kha i patluo sa aa; iema kha i due hmisi'a yi, tahematapakieca iema cunglie kha i hi haa va tli.
Kama ca Israel cuo khata aduo haata cuo'a angte, ama ca lili paa haata a paa aa, Lebanon atuv lie thingkung tie haa khata a thariy aa thuvsa pata a thla aa.
A nge zaw kha a rungsa aa, a puvthena ca olif kung kha lu'a te, Lebanon tluo lie thing haata a rang a pa-ue aa.
Iema ca i ningdiy rawlie kha aw'a yi te, diedung phapa haata ama cuo aa; mingsuv kung haata rung'a yi te, Lebanon mingsuvtiy haa khata ama rang a pa-ue aa.

Vya Efraim, kuvtuezuv hne aa patuv pata khaapama i tue aa? acaa paliepa hne niema caa mangchiypa yi ca kama tana i cuo. Kama ca a hringsiyliy paripa saipres thing haa tana i cuo, zang tluo namaa tlanapa ca kama'a taa tana aa vaw.

A singpa ta ca hingpa hmang hing ama pachang, thleduo khuna a hnyipa ta ca capa zaw ca ama pachang. Tahematapakieca Abyipaluopuv ca a dang te, aa dangpa tie khata ama ziy, cuorasala a suepa tie ca a pachiy yi te amaa lie.
Pethuel sacapaa Joel cunglie a tlungpa Abyipabie:
Vya uvthyi zaw, hingpa hing thyi tie ung, ruo chunglie khy a sapa bangkhuo ta naathlie tie ung! Hing haapa hmang hing nama chuo lieta a tlung buo ma?
Hingpa kaw hing nama saata zaw kha chang tie ung, nama saata zaw ta ama saata zaw kha chang yi se, ama saata zaw ta chuo hrangpa tie kha chang yi se.

Khawbyapa a lesapa tie ta ama pangaapa kha, a phuv ta a zupa khawbyapa khata ama ning, a phuv ta a zupa khawbyapa tie ta ama pangaapa kha aa tyilepa khawbyapa tie khana ama ning, aa tyilepa khawbyapa tie ta ama pangaapa kha, paratuv khawbyapa ta a ning.
Niema a pariypa tie, thu ung la caa tie ung, caa tie ung, mingsuvtiy a pariypa tie, nama dang riy a aw li tli nakawta, a thlungpa mingsuvtiy kawlie khata caa tie ung.
Tahematapakieca a thaaruvpa hne a ri tie a aw lipa mingphang suokha ta i ruo ca la te, a haa zaw ca chingde haa lu te, a nue ca chingdepuvnung nue a lupa kha a hnyi.
I mingsuv kung kha paming te, i thyikuv kung kha a pati diy; a haw kha khaw diy te alyi luo a pathla diy; a ce zaw ca ama ruo diy.
A lesaa ningta aa hlawpa a navaapa ta a thiysepa canung ta, buri a buv te muochie a sapa haa khata caa tie ung.
Sa ta panaana hne dangpa ta panaana zaw kha Abyipaing lie aw'a va tli. Abyipare a hriepa tluobyi tie ca ama caa.
Lu ca para diy pata cuo te, alyi ca ngiechisa pata ama caa, tahematapakieca sa ca para diy pata cuo te mingsuv kung ca a caa diy, chiytiy zaw pya vyi.
Nama nang-uo se, niema lu a thlupa zaw, caa tie ung, niema mingsuv diedung a tuepa zaw, Jungsacuo hne barli cuo khata caa tie ung, tahematapakieca lu chunglie sa ca a ra diy tli.

Mingsuv kung ca aa uv, thyikuv kung ca a caa, Cale kung, tungkung, epal kung, hne diedung chunglie thingkung hrangpa bangkhuo ca ama rue diy; cawsaa zaw hrawlie palungtluona zaw kha, aa uv tana aa uv diy hmisi ra.

Niema tluobyi tie, buri kha a buv ung la caa tie ung, niema bienatluophie lie re a hriepa tie, caa tie ung. A vaw ung la, buri a buv pata khy padyi tie ung, niema Khazing re a hriepa tie zaw! Sa ta panaana hne dangpa ta panaana ca Abyipa ing lieta a ci mangtli.

A pathepa sa-uvna tue riypa kha pathyi ung la, a pathepa zaapuv apungna kha pahry tie ung. Uvthyi tie hne ruo chunglie khy a sapa bangkhuo kha Abyipanama Khazing ing luo kha pahmya tie ung, Abyipa'a luo kha khi tie ung.
Ah, bawchiena ning! Abyipaning ca aa ngie tli, Lesyice taata parana ca aa vaw tli.
Na hmiekunglieta sa ca a ci tli cuo va ma? Ma Khazing ing lieta palungtluona hne alawna ca a ci tli cuo va ma?
Alyi hlaw rawlieta saciy ca thiy te, sa-ing ca a hri; kung a vyi li nakawta sa-ing ca a ra.
Sahring zaw ca ama khi patlaw! Cue hne tuv zaw ca amaa khie cakhaw patlaw, ama tlena a aw li nakawta, tuvrung zaw hmuota ama te-ang hringhruo.
Vya Abyipa, nama'a luona i kya caa. Tahematapakieca ruocaapa lie sahring tlena ruo ca myi ta kuo diy te, ruo chunglie thingkung bangkhuo ca myi na a uv diy.
Tiyhnaa zaw a ky diy nakawta hne ruocaapa lie sahring tlena ruo ca myi ta a kuo diy nakawta saruopa zaw ta hmuo nama'a luo kha ama kya khi.

Zion lie kha hmyakaa tung tie ung, I tluo pathepa cunglie kha a pahlu a padana kha pathyi tie ung! Ruo chunglie khy a sapa bangkhuo ta a cathang tie ung, tahematapakieca Abyipaning ca a vaw nguoluo te a vya tlung'a nang tli.

Capa ning ca zingna hne a camaw ning, amyi hne myiching chaasa te a zingkaruv ning tana a cuo! Tluo cung kha a zingkaruvpa ta a buv diypa haata, a lepa hne a thaaruvpa rieka kha amaa vaw; iema haapa ca hluo chuo ning taata za aw buo vyi, iema khutaata a vaw riypa chuo lie zaw aw'a vyi.
Ama hmieluo ta myi kuo te, ama hnangluo ta myihlaa a thu. Iema hluo khata ruo ca Eden diedung na a za lu, iema khutaata ca a duothlingpa ruocaapa na a lu, iema kuv taata khaapahmuo law khu vyi.
Iema hmingsuo ca aruo na ama lu, rietuvnapa a ruo haa tana amaa ruo.
Aruole pu a lupa khata tluo daw zaw lie kha amaa cathlu, myi ta aphuv ruepa a kuopa pu haata hne, a cahrasapa riekaphuv rietuvna luo ama sipa haa kha tana a ta.
Iema hmielie ca cawsaa kha ama palung rie thyi hringhruo te, ama hmie a ching diy.
Rieka haa khata a ruo yi te, rieka haa khata khy dungkhuo lungruetlepie ca ama kie, hmieluo kha a ruo yi te, ama luopuv taata pie va yi.
Pakha hne pakha kha a suv va yi, ama luopuv cyicuo kha ama ziy; cehre kha tungpuole yi te a daa va yi.
Dungkhuo lungruetlepie kha a zupakhung yi te, khypuv chung luo kha amaa ngie; aparuvpa haata thlaluo-aw taa khata ing chung luo kha amaa ngie.
Iema hmielie kha alyi ca a cahang te, avuo ca aa cathang. Ning hne thlaa ca zing yi te, aasiy zaw khe va tli.

Abyipata a rieka tie hmielie kha khuosa ta a khi; a rieka ca kha tluv tama ama hluv! a naw a ziypa ca ri tie li tana ama cuo. Abyipaning ca a le hmisi; ciy aa chiy hringhruo hmisi, ahungma a ang khu aa?
Ata hingta hmuo, nama pathiypalung hmisi ta, sa-uvna, caana, a ngiyna hneta kama'a luo vya kaa tie ung, Abyipata a ta.

Nama caw kha cuo li pata nama palung kha thlaachi ung la, Abyipanama Khazing'a luo kha vya kaa tie ung, tahematapakieca ama ca vihnyituv hne nangduetuv, tana a cuo, a nang pasiypa, aa hmangpa duena a hnyipa hne duote riypa hmuo thlachie a rue pakhaapa tana a cuo.
Abyipanama Khazing kha sa ta panaana hne dangpa ta panaana kha nama pihluo the riypata, Ama ca a vya pali vyi, thlachie rue'a yi, thluechiy malie chipa siy'a vyi tapa kha ahungma a pachang?
Zion lie ca hmyakaa kha tung tie ung; sa a uvna kha pathyisa tie ung; a pathepa zaapuv a hmyana kha u tie ung;

cawsaa kha pahmya tie yi. Cawsaazaapuv kha pathe sa yi la, kung uvthyi tie kha pahmya tie yi; haatiy kha pakiy yi la, ahnung a pathlie li liepa haaseta zaw kha pakiy tie yi. Nungchiytuv satlie ca a khuo kha pyase sala, vaahnyituv lesaa ta a iehmang kha pyase se.

Ing le khuo hne bienatluophie alalalie kha, tluobyi tie, hne Abyipare a hriepa tie ca caa yi se. Iema ta, “Vya Abyipa, na cawsaa zaw hing malie pangaa thi tie, na ru ta a cuopa zaw hing mingphang zaw hrawlie tue hyalya riypata malie chi thi khah. Khaapanakawma cawsaa zaw hrawlieta, ‘Ama Khazing ca khaapaliema a aw?’ malie ama tale aa,” ta yi se.
Cakhutaata Abyipaca a ruo kha a hrakuo te, a cawsaa zaw cunglie ngiechina a hnyi.

Abyipata a cawsaa zaw bie kha palie yi te: Kama ta sa, mingsuvtiy, hne chiytiy hing ca pi'a yi angte, nama hnaa a nguo aa; cakhutaata kama ta mingphang zaw hrawlie kha tue hyalya riypata ca chi'a va tli yi ang.

Kama ta chaluo rieka tie kha niema'a taata luohlaa luo kha i hnyi'a yi, cakhutaata ruocaapa luo hne a duothlingna luo kha i cade'a yi, hmaa a sapa tie kha ningchiy riyliy chung luo cuose, hnang a chuopa tie kha ningtla riyliy chung luo cuose i cadepathla'a yi; ama thuv rang kha a kya pahnuo aa. Ama na hmang lepa kha a tue hmisi!
Vya alyi, ciy khah; a law la na palung tluo se, tahematapakieca Abyipana hmanglepa kha a tue tli!
Ruo chunglie saruopa zaw, ciy khah ung, tahematapakieca ruocaapa lie sahring tlena ruo ca a hringsiyliy; thingkung ta a thyi pathyi te, thyikuv kung hne mingsuv kung zaw ama pathyisa.

Vya Zion saata zaw, Abyipa'a lie kha a law ung la nama palung tluo se; tahematapakieca ama ta suena nama hnyi lipa kha paluosa riypata khytiy taapa kha aca pi tli yi, suepuv khytiy ca phasa te, khytiy taapa hne khytiy tliepa zaw a hluo ning haata aca pi yi.
Suo-aciyna ca sa ta bi'a te, nama mingsuv nawna khue hne chiytiy riena khue ca mingsuvtiy hne chiytiy ta ama bi diy aa.

Niema ica pathliesuepa yi i rieka lesapa ta a cuopa, a phuv ta a zupa khawbyapa, aa tyilepa khawbyapa, paratuv khawbyapa hne khawbyapa a lesapa tie ta sa ama za ning diy kung zaw lieta namaa sungpa kha ica pakaa'a yi.

Ahluvsa ning'a ung cate nama hnaa a nguo aa, nang-uo aa chiy pata niema'a lie hmang a tuepa Abyipanama Khazing ming kha pathuosa tie ung. Cakhutaata i cawsaa tie ca nangzaa pata chi pakhaa'a va tli yi ang.

Israel ming hrawlie i awpa kha na pachang'a ung cate, Kama, Abyipahing na nama Khazing ta a cuo ang tapa hne khazing hrangpa aw vyi tapa kha nama pachang aa. Cakhutaata i cawsaa zaw ca nangzaa pata chi pakhaa'a va tli yi ang.

Cakhutaata saapa ta a cuopa bangkhuo cunglie kha i thlaapa i bya'a yi; nama sacapaa hne nama sacanung zaw ta profetbiephu ama ri aa, nama nungpuv macuo tie ta muo sa'a yi te, nama mingnu tie ta muocuo ama hmung aa.
Capa ning lie ca, nama siicapaa hne siicanung cunglie zaw te kha i thlaapa i bya'a yi.
Kama ta avuo lie hne alyi lie kha kharuehaa hmang ta a cuopa, thiyse hne myi hne myikhuv tung zaw kha i paluo sa aa.
A lepa hne ciy aa chiypa Abyipaning aa vaw hluo khata ning ca zing'a te thlaapa ca thiyse haata a se aa.
Cakhutaata Abyipaming a upa mekaa ca khuo pata ama cuo aa; Abyipata a ripa haa khata, Zion Tluo hne Jerusalem lie, Abyipata a kupa tie chunglie kha a lawpa hne a hringpa zaw ama aw buo aa.
Capa ning hne cuo lie, Judah hne Jerusalem kha vuophana i pi pakhaa tiy yi ta,

mingphang zaw bangkhuo kha pahmya'a yi angte Jehoshafat bawphie luo i zaa chiy'a yi. I cawsaa hne i ru ta a cuopa Israel tie kha mingphang zaw hraw luo ama chepatlaana kawlieta capa lie ca bieripana i hnyi'a yi. Iema ta i ruo kha ama chepatlaa,
i cawsaa zaw kha vyisung ta amaa da, capaasaata kha siyhrawnung ta ama thle, canungsaata kha mingsuvtiy calyina ta zaa yi te ama dang.

Vya Tair hne Sidon, hne Filistia ruo bangkhuo, niema ca kama cuota khaapatama nama cuo? Suokhakha cuota na thung hriy nguoluo kanaa ung ciy? Ina thung hriy kie ungca ca, nama tuena muo khana niema luv cunglie a catlisa pata ica patlungsue'a yi.
Tahematapakieca niema ta i siy hne i ngu kha la ung cate, i hnyirungpa suethiy kha nama biena-ing luo nama sikhyi.
Judah cawsaa hne Jerusalem cawsaa tie kha Grik luo zaa ung cate iema ruo taata luohlaasa luo nama paphya.
Cuorasala kama ta iema ca nama zaanapa ruo taa khata papya sa'a yi angte, nama tuena muo kha nama luv cung luo ica pakaasue'a yi.
Kama ta nama sacapaa hne nama sacanung zaw kha Judah ming'a luo zaa'a yi angte, iema ta luohlaasa luo a awpa Sabean ming'a luo kha ama zaa aa; tahematapakieca Abyipana a ri tli.
Hingpa hing mingphang zaw hrawlie kha pathyi sa tie ung: Rietuv riypata a ting tie ung, rieka tie kha pasu tie ung. Rieka tie kha a vaw yi sala kya pya yi se.
Namaa tuv kha zueziy ta sa ung la, nama tuokyi ca asyi ta pali tie ung; A thaa a naapa ta, “I thaa a ruvsa ta se.”
I thaalie a awpa mingphang bangkhuo, a catli pata a vaw ung la, a vya hmya tie ung. Vya Abyipa, na rieka tie ca zaa chiybung tie yi.
Mingphang zaw kha iemata tah thu yi sala, Jehoshafat bawphie luo kha a khaw yi se; capa lie ca ingpaa mingphang bangkhuo kha bieripa riypata i tu aa.

Tuokyi kha a hrie tie ung, tahematapakieca sa ca a hming mangtli. Mingsuv nenapa ca a bi nakawta, a ngie ung la, mingsuv ca ne tie ung. Ama pha lina ca a le hringhruo nakawta, mingsuv nena khue ca a bi.
Ama hluv hringhruo, ama hluv hringhruo, biechipana bawphie chunglie ca! Tahematapakieca biechipana bawphie chunglieta Abyipaning ca aa ngie tli.
Ning hne thlaapa ca ama zing, aasiy zaw khe va tli yi.
Abyipaca Zion taata aa hrung, Jerusalem taata khuosa ta khi te, alyi hne avuo aa cahang. Cuorasala Abyipaca a cawsaa zaw cuota canawna ta cuo te, Israel cawsaa zaw cuota cariekyikuo ta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Kama, Abyipaca i tluo pathepa Zion lieta a awpa nama Khazing ta i cuopa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy. Jerusalem ca a pathe aa, ruohrang ming ta cahrawpaa buo'a va tli yi.

Capa ning lie ca tluo zaw taata mingsuvtiy thlungpa a lang aa, tluothlue zaw taata cuehnung a lang aa, Judah huecaapa bangkhuo lie tiy a lang aa; Abyipaing taa khata cavaa suokha lang'a te, Shittim bawphie kha tiy a pi aa.
Judah cawsaa zaw cunglie ama tuepa tuechiena hne, a ruo chunglie thiyse ama palang nakawta, Izipt ca ruo duothlingpa ta a li'a te, Edom ca a duothlingpa ruocaapa ta aa li aa.
Cuorasala Judah hne Jerusalem lie ca cawsaa kha chuozaa ta khy ama sa aa.
Iema thiyse cuo khata phuv la'a angte, ama carie tie suena kha a ngiethe'a va yi ang, tahematapakieca Abyipaca Zion liena a aw.

Hingpa bie hing Tekoa khy ming tuvkhie pakha ta a cuo rapa Amos ta a ripa bie ta a cuo. Judah ruo lie Uzziah ta siepahruo a cuo ning hne Israel ruo lie Joash sacapaa Jeroboam ta siepahruo a cuo ning, aling aa siy hluo kung hning lieta Israel kaw hne aa patuv pata Khazing ta Amos'a lie a paluosapa tana a cuo.
Cakhutaata ama ta: Abyipaca Zion Tluo taata a hrung te, Jerusalem taata khuosa ta a khi; tuvkhietuv tie ruo panupa ca aa uv diy, Karmel tluodaw ca a caa diy tli.
Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Damaskas ca Gilead kha thaa haa bangpa sa a ciynapa thingtung ta aa ciy nakawta, capa a tuesuena suothung suopaliy kawlie ca ta duote riypa kha palaw'a va ang.
Caacuonakawta Hazael ing cung luo kha myi pathlie'a angte, capa myi ca ta siepahruo Ben-hadad cariekyikuo kha a kuo diy aa.

Damaskas thlake tluo tie kha thli'a yi angte, Aven Bawphie lie khy a sapa tie hne Beth-eden taata thaa sungpe a hriepa kha i pahli diy'a yi. Cakhutaata Aram cawsaa tie ca Kir luo kha sii ta sikhyi pata ama cuo aa, Abyipata a ta.
Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Gaza ca sii a cuopa bangkhuo kha sikhyi yi te Edom kuv luo a pi nakawta, capa a tuesuena suothung suopaliy kawlie ca ta duote riypa kha palaw'a va ang.
Caacuonakawta Gaza dungkhuo lungruetlepie luo kha myi pathlie'a angte, myi ca ta a cariekyikuo kha a kuo diy aa.
Ashdod lie khy a sapa tie hne Ashkelon lie thaa sungpe a hriepa kha i pahli diy'a yi. Ekron kha i kuv maasue'a angte, Filistin ming aa ngaapa tie ca ama ra aa, Abyipa Khazingta a ta.

Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Tair ca tieriy cuonapa biekuo hmuo a thyi li pata, sii ta a cuopa tie kha ama bangkhuo ta Edom'a luo a pina nakawta, capa a tuesuena suothung suopaliy kawlie ca ta, duote riypa kha palaw'a va ang.
Caacuonakawta Tair dungkhuo lungruetlepie luo kha myi pathlie'a angte, myi ca ta a cariekyikuo kha a kuo diy aa.

Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Edom ta ngiechina hnyi bangby li pata a uvnu kha zueziy ta aa cade, cipari ta a hi haa te, a pathiylingna ca chuozaa ta a chaw nakawta, capa a tuesuena suothung suopaliy kawlie ca ta, duote riypata kha palaw'a va ang.
Caacuonakawta Teman'a luo kha myi pathlie'a angte, myi ca ta Bozrah cariekyikuo kha a kuo diy aa.

Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Ammon ta a ruo a paku khing nakawta Gilead lie nu a phyapa canung zaw riy kha a khy diy nakawta, capa a tuesuena suothung suopaliy kawlie ca ta duote riypa kha palaw'a va ang.

Caacuonakawta Rabbah dungkhuo lungruetlepie ca myi patiysue'a angte, capa myi ca ta a cariekyikuo kha a kuo diy aa, rietuv ningta khina ueryi hne, thliychie a thu ning thliysung pakhiepa haa khata a cuo aa.
Cakhutaata ama siepahruo ca a ingchungkhue hne khata sii ta sikhyi pata ama cuo aa, Abyipata a ta.
Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Moab ca Edom siepahruo ruv kha buvcuo ta a cuona te ta myi ta a rue nakawta capa a tuesuena suothung suopaliy kawlie ca ta duote riypa kha palaw'a va ang.
Caacuonakawta Moab cung luo kha myi pathlie'a angte, capa myi ca ta Kerioth cariekyikuo kha a kuo diy aa. Moab ca amaa tawhrie patlawna lie, khi-una hne hmyakaa pu hrawlie kha a thiy aa.
A chunglieta uvtuv byi tie kha thie'a yi angte, aa byi tie kha ama hneta i thiehne'a yi, Abyipata a ta.

Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Judah ming ca Abyipaphungbie kha thaw yi te, a phungluo kha ziy va yi; ama mingchingmingvuo tie ta ama za ziypa khazing pakhipa kha ziy yi te luo ama pie nakawta, capa a tuesuena suothung suopaliy kawlie ca ta duote riypa kha palaw'a va ang.
Caacuonakawta Judah cung luo kha myi pathlie'a angte, capa myi ca ta Jerusalem cariekyikuo kha a kuo diy aa.

Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Israel ming ca adangna kha ngu ta zaa yi te, riethyivuosuopa tie kha phyipakaw ryi kha ta ama zaa. Capa a tuesuena suothung suopaliy kawlie cata duote riypa kha palaw'a va ang; tahematapakieca aa dangpa tie kha ngu ta zaa yi te, riethyivuosuopa tie kha phanaah ryi kha ta ama zaa.
Siypasa tie luv kha alyi lie chaapuo yi te, nutaapa tie kha luokie luo ama nungpathla; paa hne saa ta lesaa pakha kha suehne yi te, a ming pathe kha ama papyapalyi;

biekuona cuota ama lapa pang kha a phaa yi te, bienatluophie mekaa a thaalie kha ama laa. Duotena ta ama lapa mingsuvtiy kha ama Khazing ing chunglie kha ama dang. Capa a suenapa suothung suopaliy kawlie ca ta, duote riypa kha palaw'a va ang.
Ama dang ca sidar kung haata a suo te, mathliy kung haata a cupa Amor ming ca iema hmiekunglie kha i para yi; Kama ta a cungluo a thyi hne a rawluo ta a thariy kha i para yi.
Izipt ruo chungtaata caa kya pyakhyipa yi ca kama tana i cuo, Amor ming ruo kha nama cu the riypata, ruocaapa lie kha kung sawliy icaa chiy yi.
Cakhutaata nama saata chekha zaw kha profet ta tue yi angte, nama mingnu tie chekha zaw kha Nazir ta i tue yi. Vya Israel cawsaa zaw, cahaaca tana a cuo sasaw cuo va ma? Abyipata a ta.
Cuorasala niema ta Nazir tie kha mingsuvtiy nama padang sa, profet tie zaw kha, “Profetbiephu ri'a va ung ciy,” nama ta.
Caacuonakawta a bina te ta hmang a phyapa le ca hmang ta a vysapa haa khata, niema ca nama awna hmang lie khana aca vysa ra'a yi.
A catliphasapa kha aa ruo zaw ta law hlyi'a vyi, a thaaruvpa zaw ta a thaaruvna kha hmuo khu'a vyi, a cahrapa zaw ta a hringna kha a khuo khu'a vyi;
Liy ka a thepa zaw kha a daa khu'a vyi, a lie a hysapa zaw iema hne iema kha a khuo khu li'apa yi ta, aruo rieka tie zaw ta iema hne iema kha a khuo khu'a va yi.
Cakhutaata a thaaruvpa hne a palung a cahra ciemuopa tie zaw kha capa ning thue ca ama thliehripa ta na amaa ruo aa, Abyipata a ta.
Vya Israel cawsaa zaw, Izipt ruo taata nama phang yalya ta ica kya pyakhyipa tie, Abyipata niema'a lie a ripa hingpa bie hing naathlie tie ung:
Alyi cunglieta a awpa mingphang bangkhuo hrawlie hing niema dyi hingna ica pachang yi; caacuonakawta nama suena bangkhuo cuo hing tana duo ica te'a yi.
Palung tlingsa pata rihne taa li pata cawsaa pahning khy ama tlawhne the'a ma?
Chingde ca saa a sie li pata, atuv chunglie aa hrung buo ma? chingde thuthawpa ca a patuvpa a aw li pata a khue chunglie aa hrung buo ma?
Pavaa ca cyihyi ama thla khuo li pata alyi lie cyihyi lie kha aa uo the'a ma? Cyihyi ca khaapahmuo a pa-uo hluota lang pata a cuo ma?
Khypuv chunglie hmyakaa a paring kieca, cawsaa kha ama ciy cuo va ma? Abyipata a tue li pata riethyivuosuona kha khypuv chunglie a tlung ma?
A cuo hmisi, Abyipa Khazingta a changtaapa profet tie'a luo kha a bieparuv kha paluo sa taa li pata khaapahmuo tue vyi.
Chingde aa hrung pata ahungma ciy li pata a aw aa? Abyipa Khazingta bie a ri; ahungma profet bie phu li pata a aw khu aa?

Ashdod siepahruo ing chunglie a awpa tie hne Izipt ruo siepahruo ing chunglie a awpa tie'a lie kha “Samaria Tluo cunglie kha a pung ung la, kha tluv ta a tawhrienapa ma a chunglie a aw tapa hne, kha tluv ta hrisaanapa ma a hrawlie a aw tapa kha mang tie ung,” ta pata pathyi sa tie ung.
Ama siepahruo ing lieta tuechiena hne paruvna a pacungpa tie ca tuokhaatama aa hmuopa ma tue aa tapa kha pachang va yi, Abyipata a ta.
Caacuonakawta Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Carie tie ta ruo hing cadung'a yi te, nama khy dungkhuo zaw kha aca caphipuo diy'a yi, nama cariekyikuo zaw kha ama para diy aa.

Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Tuvkhietuv pakha ta chingde pakaa chungtaata a phyi suohning, acuolikie a tlaachipa a naakue suokha kha a chuv pakhaa khupa haa khata Samaria lie iehmang hne pangphaa lieta a awpa Israel ming a cawta dyi khana hyapazang pata a cuo'a yi.
Thyi ung la, Jakob ingchungkhue kha a raaringna bie chang tie ung, Cungnungce, Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri:
A tuesuena cuota Israel duo i te ning kha, kama ta Bethel bienatluophie kha duo i te aa, bienatluophie thingpazue zaw kha tepachung'a angte, alyi luo a tla aa.
Kama ta thlasiy ing kha i phi diypa haata cuovuo ing zaw kha i phi diy aa; ale nue ta sapa ing zaw kha ra diy'a te, ing lepa zaw ca ama chuo aa, Abyipata a ta.

Niema, Samaria Tluo cunglie a tlepa Bashan cue zaw, siypasa tie kha hrisaa ung cate, vuosuopa tie kha a tlawpuopa, ama navaapa tie kyihuo ta, “Zuvre vya cyi ung,” a tapa tie, hingpa bie hing thyi tie ung.
Abyipa Khazingna a pathena khata chie a sa pata bie a ri: Iema ta niema kha, nama saata nuta bangkhuo te khata kyipa ta aca siyna cuo yi ca a vya tlung hrahring aa.
Khy dungkhuo lungruetlepie a kyinapa khue nama hmungpa cyicuo taa khata pya'a ung cate, Harmon tluo luo kha namaa ruo aa. Abyipata a ta.
Bethel luo kha a vaw ung la sue tie ung, Gilgal luo kha a vaw ung la sue hryly tie ung; maw tating ta nama hriykhungrina kha vya cyi ung, ning thung duo ta nama chehraachekha kha vya cyi tie ung;

thiynung phuvpa palungtluo panaana viechuo kha vya cyi ung la, lungthe panaana kha pihluo ung, ta pata zaapuv kha pathyi sa tie ung; tahematapakieca, Vya Israel ming, cahaacata tue riypa ca niema ta nama khingpa tana a cuo thluo! Abyipa Khazingta a ta.
Nama khypuv bangkhuo lie kha haa pathena cuose, nama awna hmang mekaa lieta viechuo a aw li tli riypata cuose ica tue yi, cuorasala kama'a luo kha vya kaa va ung ciy, Abyipata a ta.

Sa hriena cuo thla thung a bu kalie pata, niema'a lie kha khy pasaa sa lipa angta i aw; Khypuv suokha lie kha khy pasaa sa'a angte, a hrangpa khypuv suokha lie kha pasaa sa li pata i aw thluo aa; lu suokha lie kha khy saa'a te, cuorasala lu suokha lie ca khy saa li pata a aw thluo aa.
Caacuonakawta khy hning khy thung taata khy ming ca khy kha luo kha tiy repa ta vaa yi te, ama tiyhrie cing vyi, cuorasala niema ca kama'a luo kha vya kaa hlyi va ung ciy, Abyipata a ta.

Sa kung thiyna hne sa kung thuvna ta niema kha duo ica te yi; nama diedung hne nama mingsuv diedung kha i para, nama thyikuv kung hne nama olif kung kha khawbyapa ta ama ce diy; cuorasala niema ca kama'a luo kha vya kaa va ung ciy, Abyipata a ta.

Izipt cunglie i patlung sapa puvtlung pasana kha niema hraw luo ica pathliesue yi; nama mingnu tie kha zueziy ta i thie yi, namaa ruo kha i sikhyi diy; namaa rina hmang lie kha sathuv rang ta aca tungsa yi; cuorasala kama'a luo kha vya kaa hlyi va ung ciy, Abyipata a ta.

Khazing ta Sodom hne Gomorrah kha a thawpa haa yi ta, niema chekha kha ca thaw yi angte, niema ca myi chungtaata a dapa thingthuv haa khata nama cuo; cuorasala kama'a luo kha vya kaa va ung ciy, Abyipata a ta.
Caacuonakawta Vya Israel, cahaaca tana na cunglie i tue aa; Vya Israel, na Khazing a taw riypa a ting paciena tana, na cunglieta hingpa hing i tue aa!

Tluo kha tue te amyi a pa-aw sapa, a ruena kha cawsaa a pachang sapa, mawdiy khena kha khyzing ta a tuepa, alyi aa suona hmang lie a phyi a chaalepa ca ama tana a cuo. A ming ca, Abyipa, Cungnungce Khazing tana a cuo!
Vya Israel ingchungkhue, ica caanapa yi hlaa hing naathlie tie ung:
Israel lesaa pathe ca thu pakhaa li riypa tana aa lie tli; a kuv ta patuv pata a pathu riypa pakha hmuo aw va yi.
Tahematapakieca Abyipa Khazingna hing haa hingta a ri: Rietuv riypata thawkha a thupa khypuv ca zakha dyi pangaa pata cuo'a te, zakha a thupa khypuv ca pahraa dyi pangaa pata a cuo aa.
Tahematapakieca Abyipana Israel ingchungkhue tie'a lie kha hing haa hingta a ri: Kama kha na huv ung la hring tie ung;

cuorasala Bethel kha huv khah ung, Gilgal luo zaw a ngie khah ung, acuolikie Beer-sheba luo zaw kha cahrawpaa khah ung; tahematapakieca Gilgal ca sii ta sikhyi pata a cuo aa, Bethel ca khaahmuolipa tana aa li aa.
Abyipakha huv ung la hring tie ung, ca ta acuolikie ca Josef ingchungkhue kha myi haata kuo'a te, capa ca ta Bethel kha a kuo aa, ahungtahmuo pache khu'a va yi.
Ah, niema ca biedangpa kha a palung a pasa sapa, adangna kha alyi luo a thawpa tana nama cuo!
Ama ca aasiycaruv hne aasiythetluo zaw a sapa, khyzingsapa kha mawdiy ta a tuepa, ningchung kha zuo ta a tuepa, riyliy tiy kha ku te, alyi cunglie a patlepa, Abyipatapa ming a hnyipa,
a thaaruvpa tie kha rana a patlungsuepa, riekhuopiehu zaw a parapa tana a cuo.
Cawsaa ta thlake lie malie sue a phaw thepa kha hue yi te, biehmisipa a ripa zaw kha ama hue.

Niema ta siypasa tie kha chaapuo ung cate, sa kha ngukhyi cuota nama patuvpa; niema ca uopa alung ta ing a sa ung cate, cuorasala capa ing zaw chunglie ca aw'a va ung ciy; niema ta khing aa chiysapa mingsuv diedung kha tue ung cate, cuorasala mingsuvtiy kha dang'a va ung ciy.

Tahematapakieca nama tuesuena kha kha tluv ta hluv te ma, nama suena kha tluv ta a le; niema ta aa dangpa tie kha tuechie ung cate, nawthuv nama ning, cakhutaata riethyivuosuopa tie kha thlake lieta a kie luo ta nama phe siy.
Caacuonakawta capa cuo lieta mingsing tie ca a dieta tah ama aw, tahematapakieca capa cuo ca cuo chiepa tana a cuo.
Chiena cuo li pata phana kha huv tie ung, cata a cuopa kieca nama hring aa; niema ta nama ripa haa khata Abyipa, Cungnungce ta aca awpuo'a yi.
Pha lina kha hue ung la phana kha khing tie ung, nama thlake lieta biedangpa aw se; cata a cuo kieca AbyipaCungnungce ta aa ngaapa Josef ciypathla kha vi a hnyi the biephung aa.

Caacuonakawta AbyipaCungnungce Khazing ta hing haa hingta a ri: Zapuv ahmyana hmang bangkhuo lie kha caana a aw aa; luopuv bangkhuo lie zaw kha, “Vya nung! Vya paa!” ta pata ama khi aa. Lu a thlupa kha muochiesa riypata cuose, muochiesa a thesapa tie kha caa riypata cuose ama u aa;
mingsuv diedung bangkhuo lie kha ama caa aa, tahematapakieca niema hrawlie khana kama ta i vya cahrawle aa, Abyipata a ta.
Abyipaning a huopa niema ca bawchie ciemuopa tana nama cuo! Khaapanakawma Abyipaning ca nama khing? Capa ning ca zingna tana a cuo, khena ta cuo vyi.
Cawsaa ta chingde kha aa ruose khu zawma, cavaw kha aa tawpa haata cuose, ing chung luo a ngie te tlepie kha aa hy pata pariy ta a dawpa haa tana a cuo aa.
Abyipaning ca khena a aw lipa zingna ning ta cuo va ma? khena aw li pata a zingkaruvpa ning ta cuo va ma?
Nama pyi zaw kha hue angte i duv, a pathepa namaa pungna zaw kha tlechuo va ang.
Nama myirue panaana hne sa ta panaana zaw kha ina pihluo raalaa pa ung cata ca cuhluo'a va yi ang, a thusapa sahring ta nama tuepa aviesaa panaana zaw kha, a mang hmuo mang'a va ang.
Nama hlaa ueryi kha thyi thi khah tli ang se; nama tingtuolepa ue zaw kha naathlie'a va ang.
Cuorasala biedangpa kha tiy haata lang sala, adangna ca ci li ta a langpa cavaa haa khata palang sa tie ung.
Vya Israel ingchungkhue tie, ruocaapa lieta kung sawliy chung nama za aw ning kha hriykhungrina hne panaana ina za pihluo ung ca ma?
Niema cuota namaa tuepa nama kuvtuezuv nama siepahruo Sakkuth hne nama aasiy-khazing Kaiwan ca a phyale tie ung;
caacuonakawta Damaskas khung luo khana sii ta ica sikhyi'a yi, a ming ta AbyipaCungnungce a cuopa ta a ta.

Zion lieta aa nuosa pata a awpa tie hne Samaria Tluo cunglieta aa bangpa tana i aw a tapa tie, mingphang zaw hrawlieta pachangtluo aa tlapa tie, Israel ingchungkhue ta ama pangiepa tie ca bawchie ciemuopa tana ama cuo.

Kalneh luo kha cakuo ung la mang tie ung; capa taa cata a lepa Hamath luo kha cakuo tie ung; cakhutaata Filistin ruo Gath luo kha sibung tie ung. Capa pena tie zaw laa cata nama pha vie ma? Nama ruo haw iema ruo laata a ku vie ma?
Ning pha lipa kha luohlaa luo thaw ung cate ma, tuechiena kha luongie lie namaa chipuo?
Ale nue iehmang lie a ziepa tie, pangphaa lie a laapa tie hne tuvrung chunglie'apa tuvtaata a ningpa tie, cue ing chunglie'apa cuetaata a ningpa tie;
tingtuo hneta hlaa a ngiypa tie hne David haata tungpa chechiy a tue the paluopa tie;
mingsuvtiy kha kuotung ta a dangpa tie hne chiytiy pha cepa a cahnungpa tie, cuorasala Josef rana kawlieta a ngie a chi lipa tie ca bawchie ciemuopa tana nama cuo.
Caacuonakawta iema ca ata hingta sii ta sikhyi taapa tana ama cuo aa, cakhutaata amaa nuona hne ama laa hyalyapa ca a chuo aa.

Abyipa Khazingta ama hne ama kha chie a sa te, (Abyipa Cungnungce Khazing ta hing haa hingta a ri): Jacob hruotlena hing i duv hringhruo, a cariekyikuo zaw kha i duv; caacuonakawta khypuv ca a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo hne khata carie kuv luo kha i hluo aa.
Ing kha chunglie cawsaa pahraa amaa ngaa kieca, iema ca ama thiy aa.

Cakhutaata a thiypa a pabypa a tieriy pakha ta ing chungtaata riyy a pyakhyipa khata, ing chunglie a awpa pakha kyihuo khata, “Nama'a lieta pakhakha ama aw kalie ma?” a ta aa. “Aw va yi,” ta pata a palie aa. Cakhutaata a tieriy a cuopa ca ta, “Khi khah! Abyipaming ca ma ri riypata cuo vyi,” a ta aa.
Mang tie ung, Abyipata naw papya te, ing lepa ca kyipatlaa diy'a te, ing cawta ca a diykariy pata na aa li aa.
Aruo ca alung zaw cunglie aa ruo the ma? riyliy ca cuetungpa ta le thawpa haata thaw the a aw ma?
Lo-debar lie kha a nuo ung cate, Karnaim ca kiema thaazuo tana ma la cuo va ma?” nama ta.
Vya Israel, niema a du riypata mingphang phang kha kha padaa'a angte, iema ta Lebo-hamath taata Arabah Cavaata te khata aca hrisaa'a yi, Abyipa, Cungnungce Khazing ta a ta.

Abyipa Khazingta ina pahmung sapa ca hingpa hing tana a cuo: A hnang ta cyi pakhaapa sa kung a kya pu baaningpa khata (Siepahruo hmung riypa a vyi taapa sa ama la diy khutaata) a phuv ta a zupa khawbyapa kha a vya pya ra.
Iema ta ruo chunglie aphuv kha ama ce diy tiyta, kama ta, “Vya Abyipa Khazingnaa ngiethe thi tie, paa na ica kie! Tuokhaatama Jacob ca aa daa khu aa? A cawtuv kalie!” i ta.
Abyipata capa kawlie cata thlachie rue te, “Hingpa hing cuo pakhaa'a vyi,” a ta.
Hingpa hing Abyipa Khazingta ina pahmung sapa tana a cuo: Abyipa Khazingta myi kha ku te, capa ca ta riyliy hne alyi kha a kuo diy.
Cakhutaata kama ta, “Vya Abyipa Khazing, padie sa tie, paa na ica kie! Tuokhaatama Jacob ca aa daa khu aa? A cawtuv kalie!” i ta.
Abyipa Khazingta capa kawlie cata thlachie rue te, “Hingpa zaw hing cuo pakhaa'a vyi,” a ta.
Hingpa hing ina pahmungsapa ta a cuo: Abyipa ca taanapa khuhriy kha a cyi te lungruetlepie athaalie aa daapa kha i hmung.

Cakhutaata Abyipata kama kyihuo khata, “Amos, khaapama na hmung?” ina ta. Kama ta, “Taanapa khuhriy,” i ta. Cakhutaata Abyipa ta, “Mang tie, i cawsaa Israel tie khana taanapa khuhriy ta i taa'a yi; iema kha a ngiethe pakhaa'a va tli yi ang.
Isak khahrungtluobu tie ca ama duothling aa, Israel hmangpathepa ca a duothling aa, cakhutaata Jeroboam ingchungkhue kha zueziy ta i du aa,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Bethel khy lie a awpa tluobyi Amaziah ta Israel Siepahruo Jeroboam'a luo kha cawsaa pathlie yi te, “Israel mingphang hrawlieta nama a du riypata Amos ta khue a khuo nguoluo; a ripa bie hing ruo ta ang khu va tli.
Tahematapakieca Amos ta hing haa hingta a ri: ‘Jeroboam ca zueziy tana a thiy aa, cakhutaata Jerusalem ca a ruo taa hingta luohlaa luo kha sii ta sikhyi pata a cuo aa,’ a ta” a ta.
Cakhutaata Amaziah ta Amos kyihuo khata, “Vya profet, cakuo tie, Judah ruo luo kha a ruo tie, capa lie ca profetbiephu kha ri la na riy vaa caw tie;
cuorasala Bethel lie ca khatiy tahmuo profetbiephu ri pakhaa khah tie, tahematapakieca Bethel ca siepahruo hmangpathepa tana a cuo, pena biena-ing tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Amos ta Amaziah kha palie te, “Kama ca profet ta cuo va ang, profet sacapaa zaw ta cuo va ang; cuorasala kama ca sahring a khiepa hne saikamor thingthyi a lupa tana i cuo.
Abyipata sahring i khie nguoluopa khata na la te, ‘Cakuo la i cawsaa Israel tie'a luo kha profetbiephu va ri tie,’ ina ta.
“Caacuonakawta ata hing Abyipabie ca naathlie tie. Nama ta, ‘Israel kha a du pata profetbiephu ri'a vaciy, Isak ingchungkhue a dupa ta zaw phung ri'a vaciy,’ ina ta ciy.

Caacuonakawta Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: ‘Na napuvnung ca khypuv chunglie hing siyhrawnung ta a li'a te, cakhutaata na sacapaa tie hne na sacanung tie kha zueziy ta ama thiy aa, na ruo ca taanapa khuhriy ta taa'a yi te amaa re aa, nama ca a pathe lipa ruo lie kha thiy'a cate, Israel ca a ruo taata luohlaa luo kha sii ta sikhyi pata a cuo aa,’” a ta.
Abyipa Khazingta ina pahmung sapa ca cuovuo thingthyi pasyi zungkha ta a cuo.

Ama ta, “Amos, khaapama na hmung?” ina ta. Kama ta, “Cuovuo thingthyi pasyi zung kha,” i ta. Cakhutaata Abyipata kama kyihuo khata, “I cawsaa Israel cung luo kha cuo chuona ca a tlung tli; iema kha a ngiethe pakhaa'a va tli yi ang,
Capa ning lie ca biena-ing lie hlaa kha caana ta aa li aa,” Abyipa Khazingta a ta. “A thiypa riyy hluvpuv ca hmangting lie kha thaw pata a cuo aa. A dieta tah aw ung!” ama ta aa.
Niema, riethyivuosuopa zaw a chaapuopa tie, ruo chunglie siypasa zaw a parapa tie,

niema ta, “Khatiythuema sa ma zaa the riypata thla thaapa ca a chuo aa; Jungsacuo kha ma zaa the riypata khatiy tama Sabbath kha a chuo aa? Khatiy thueta ma ephah kha pacaw vie'a pate, shekel kha ma pale vie aa,
khatiy thue tama siypasapa kha ngu ta calyi'a pate, riethyivuosuopa kha phyipakaw ryi kha ta ma calyi aa? Khatiy thue tama a pha lipa jungsacuo kha ma zaa aa,” nama ta.
Abyipana Jacob lesyina khata chie a sa tli: Ama tuepa mekaa kha maw'a va ang,

hingpa kawlie hingta alyi hing a cahang li pata a aw'a ma? a chunglie a awpa mekaa muochie sa li pata ama aw'a ma? Nail cavaa haa khata le'a yi te, Izipt ruo Nail cavaa lie a kya phang te a tla pakhaapa haa khata cuo va yi ma?
Khazingta, capa ning thue ca, ningchung ta ning patla sa'a angte, alyi kha ningchung ning khe kaliepa puv ta i pazing sa aa.

Nama pyi kha muochiesana ta pali'a angte, nama hlaa bangkhuo kha angiyna ta i pali aa; buri kha nama sesie lie ca paze diy'a yi ung angte, nama bangkhuo ta nama luv ica pamyi diy'a yi; capa ning ca sacapaa pakha dyipa thiy te ama caa ning haa khata pacuo sa'a angte, a chuona ca a khasapa ning ta i pacuo sa aa.

Abyipa Khazingta, ruo chunglie cakuo i patlung sana cuo ca aa vawle hmisi tli; capa cakuo tlungna ca sa cakuo tlungna cuo li pata, tiy cakuo tlungna zaw cuo vyi, cuorasala Abyipabie thyi khu lina cakuo tlungna tana a cuo aa.
Cawsaa ta Abyipabie huv riypata, riyliy suokha taata riyliy suokha luo, chaluo taata ningchiyluo ta pata, amaa ruobung amaa ruothaw aa; cuorasala hmung'a va yi.
Capa ning thue ca, a hming phasapa lesaa hne satlie ca ama tiy hrie pata ama hy aa.
Samaria Ashimah ming ta chie a sapa tie, “Vya Dan, na khazing a hringpa haata,” a tapa tie hne “Beer-sheba biena a hringpa haata,” a tapa tie; Iema ca a lie'a yi te, thu pakhaa buo'a va tli yi.

Abyipaca bienatluophie athaalie aa daapa kha hmung angte, hing haa hingta a ri: Ingle aa cahangna te ta, atung luv zaw kha tuv tie, dechi la cawsaa bangkhuo luv lie kha tlasue yi se; Aa ngaapa tie ca kama ta zueziy ta i thie'a yi; a ruopathla khupa aw'a va yi, a zang khupa aw'a va yi.
Sheol te khuv ta ama cungbung zaw ta, capa taa cata i kuv ta i thue'a yi; avuo te khiy ta ama kie zaw ta, capa taa cata i dapathla'a yi.
Karmel tluodaw lie amaa nu zaw ta, capa lie ca huv'a yi angte i patuv'a yi; riyliy rawkhie luo khuv amaa zaa nu zaw ta, capa lie zaw ca riyliy chung parapuv kha naw pi'a angte, capa ca ta a ce'a yi.

Cakhutaata ama carie tie ta sii ta ama sikhyi zaw ta, capa lie ca zueziy kha naw pi'a angte, zueziy cata a thie'a yi; ama phana riypata cuo li pata ama chiena riypa khata, ama cunglie kha i ming i khang pari aa.
Abyipa Cungnungce Khazingta alyi kha taw te a tiy ta aa li diy, a cunglie a awpa bangkhuo ca ama caa, Nail haata a kya thupa tie bangkhuo ca Izipt lieta a awpa Nail haa khata ama tla pakhaa diy.
Avuo lieta cungluo aa ziena khuo kha sa te, alyi cunglieta a rawluo khuo kha a sa; Riyliy tiy tie kha ku te, alyi cunglie kha a lyi, a ming ca Abyipatana a cuo.

Vya Israel cawsaa zaw, kama cuota Ethiopia ming haata cuo va ung ca ma? Abyipata a ta. Kama na Israel ming kha Izipt taata acaa pyakhyi yi ang cuo va ma? Filistin ming kha Kaftor taata cuose, Aramean ming kha Kir taata cuose, kama na a pyakhyi yi ang cuo va ma?
AbyipaKhazing ming ca a suepa pena cunglie khana a aw, capa ca alyi cung taa hingta i para aa, cuorasala Jacob ingchungkhue kha ca para diy karue'a va ang, Abyipata a ta.
Tahematapakieca kama ta naw pi'a yi angte, mingphang bangkhuo hrawlieta Israel ming kha syry ta rypa haata i ry'a yi, cuorasala lungcapang suokha hmuo alyi luo tla'a vyi.
“Pha lina ta malie pha khah sala malie a taw khah se,” a tapa a suepa i cawsaa bangkhuo ca zueziy tana ama thiy aa, a ta.
Capa ning lie ca aa liepa David thluodaa kha i pathu pakhaa aa, a tlepie khue aa awnapa tie kha paping'a angte, a ranapa kha i pare aa, a hluo ning haa khata i sa pakhaa aa;
Edom ruo aa ngaapa hne i ming ta kupa mingphang bangkhuo kha ama cu aa, ta pata hingpa hmang a tuepa Abyipata a ta.

Le a thawpa ta sa a lapa a phana cuo hne mingsuv thyi a nepa ta a ciy a tuvpa a phana cuo ca aa vaw nguoluo tli, Abyipata a ta. Tluo cung taata mingsuvtiy thlungpa za lang'a te, tluothlue bangkhuo lie kha a langle diy aa.

Kama ta i cawsaa Israel ming kha vuophana pi pakhaa'a yi angte, iema ta a rapa khypuv tie kha sa pakhaa'a yi te khy ama sa aa, mingsuv diedung kha tue'a yi te mingsuvtiy kha ama dang aa, diedung kha tue'a yi te a thyipaa kha ama ning aa.
Kama ta iema ca ama ruo lie kha a ling pakhaa'a yi angte, kama ta i pipa yi ruo taa khata phie pakhaa pata cuo'a va tli yi, Abyipanama Khazing ta a ta.

Obadiah muocuo. Edom hne aa patuv pata Abyipa Khazingta hing haa hingta a ri: Abyipa'a taa tana bie ma thyi, mingphang zaw hraw luo khana biephyatuv pathlie pata a cuo tli: Thu tie ung! Edom kha a du riypata thu tie ung!
Kama ta nama ca mingphang zaw hrawlie a caw cepa ta ica tue aa, nama ca duvsa hringhruo pata na cuo aa.
Alung karaw lieta aw cate, aa suona lieta a awpa, na hruotlena pathiypalung na caa dung tli. Nama ta na pathiypalung chunglie kha, “Kama ca ahungma alyi luo naa pachung khu aa?” na ta.
Nama ca hmungthlu haata a pathlaa cate, aasiy hrawlie na buv naa tue raalaa pata, capa taa cata kama ta ica pachung aa, Abyipata a ta.

Aparuvpa hne damie kha nama'a luo zuo ta amaa vaw kieca, tuokhaata parapa tama na cuo aa! Ama khingpa dyi khana ama paruv aa cuo va ma? Mingsuv thyi a lupa kha nama'a luo aa vaw kieca, a mangthang riypa chuo ca pangaa siy'a va ma?
Esau ca a suethiy kha hmungpa diy yi te, ama chuv diy tli!

Nama hne a daahnepa bangkhuo na caa dung yi, iema na ruoriy luo caa cade yi. Nama hne a daahnepa tie na caa te tli yi; na viechuo a ningpa tie khana cyihyi caa thla khuo yi, capa ca pachang khu pata cuo vyi.
Capa ning thue ca, Edom ming chungtaata a singpa tie hne Esau tluo taata pachangna zaw kha i para aa, Abyipata a ta.
Vya Teman, na rieka tie ca ama rapatlaa aa, Esau tluo lieta a awpa mekaa ca thie diy pata ama cuo aa.
Cawsaa a thiepa tie ta na uvnu Jakob kha ama tuechie tuv nakawta, nangzaana ta nama kha caa buvkhung'a te, chuozaa ta para pata na cuo aa.

Nama kha a kieluo ta naa daa ning, ruohrang ming ta a hnyirungna ama sikhyi ning, ruohrang ming kha a thlake chung luo a ngie yi te, Jerusalem kha vyisung ta amaa da ning kha nama ca iema hrawlie pakha tana na cuo ra.
Na uvnu vuochina aa taw ning kha na palung aa yi riypata cuo vyi; Judah ming ama ranapa ning lie kha na palung a tluo riypata cuo vyi; ama ngie a chi ningta a hruo na tlesue riypa yi ta cuo vyi.
I cawsaa zaw ama ra ning kha ama thlake luo naa ngie riypata cuo vyi; Judah ming ama rana cunglie kha na palung aa yi riypata cuo vyi; ama rana ning lie kha ama hmangbya na chuv riypa yi ta cuo vyi.
Law riypata a ruopa tie kha luopuv taata naa daakhuo riypa yi ta cuo vyi, palung rie thyi ningta ca a cawsaa a lawpa tie kha carie kuv luo na pi riypa yi ta cuo vyi.
Tahematapakieca mingphang bangkhuo a du riypata Abyipaning ca aa ngie tli. Nama na tuepa haa kha tana na cunglie tue pata a cuo ra aa; na tuepa khana na luv cung luo caa kaachiy aa.
I tluo pathepa lie niema nama dangpa haa khata, nama cahriylie mingphang tie bangkhuo khata ama dang ra aa; iema ta ama dang aa, padaw diy'a yi te, a dang buo lipa haa khata ama aw aa.
Cuorasala Zion Tluo lie ca rie taata a lawpa kha ama aw aa, capa hmang ca a pathepa ta a cuo aa. Jakob ingchungkhue khata iema ruo a chuvpa tie ruo kha a cu aa.

Jakob ingchungkhue ca myi ta cuo'a te, Josef ingchungkhue ca myihlaa ta ama cuo aa, Esau ingchungkhue ca sacuo kung ta ama cuo aa; iema ta kuo diy'a yi te, Esau ingchungkhue ca a hringpa pakha hmuo aw'a va yi; Abyipata a ta.
Negeb lie a awpa tie ta Esau Tluo kha cu'a yi te, Shefelah lie a awpa tie ta Filistin ruo kha ama cu aa; Iema ca ta Efraim ruo hne Samaria ruo kha cu'a yi te, Benjamin ta Gilead kha a cu aa.
Halah lie a awpa sii ta sikhyipa Israel ming khata Foenisia taata Zarefath te kha ama cu aa; Sefarad lie a awpa sii ta sikhyipa Jerusalem ming khata Negeb ruo lie khy tie kha ama cu aa.
Khuo pata a cuopa tie ca Esau Tluo kha uv riypata Zion Tluo luo kha ama sithaw aa; pena ca Abyipahuopa ta a cuo aa.
Abyipabie ca Amittai sacapaa Jonah'a luo pha te,
“Thu la khypuv lesapa Nineveh luo kha ata hingta si la ama pha lina kaw kha va khi tie; tahematapakieca iema pha lina ca i hmiekunglie na aa luo diy,” a ta.

Cuorasala Jonah ta Abyipahmiekung taa khata Tarshish luo aa ruo. Joppa luo kha sibung te Tarshish luo a sipa tiypalaw kha a hmung. Caacuonakawta a muo kha pi te tiypalaw cung luo ca a kie, Abyipahmiekung taata a ruo riypata iema hne cata a si.
Cuorasala Abyipata riyliy lie kha thliychie pahruo sa te, cahaacata a ruvpa thliychie nakaw ca ta tiypalaw ca kyi diy aa nang.

Tiypalaw lie rehrietuv tie ca ama thlaa zangsa te ama khazing cyicuo'a luo kha ama khi. Tiypalaw kha a hy vie naase ta pata a chunglie a awpa hmang bangkhuo kha riyliy chung luo ama thaw diy. Capa cuo ning cata Jonah ca tiypalaw a raw khuo luo kha cung te a zie te aa hmung thluo.
Tiypalaw uvtuv byi ta, “Tuokhaatama na mingkuv pahuosa pata naa hmung? Thu tie, na khazing'a luo kha thlaachuo tie! Ma ra li riypata khazing ta malie a palaw sa biephung'a muo,” a ta.

Tiypalaw lie re a hriepa tie ta pakha hne pakha kha, “A vaw tie ung, ahung kawlie ma hingpa ruvnaana hing kiema cung luo a tlung tapa kha ma pachangna riypata vyisung a da'a ung puv,” ama ta. Caacuonakawta vyisung ca a da yi te Jonah cunglie a tla.

Cakhutaata iema ta, “Khaapanakawma hingpa ruvnaana hing kiema cunglie a tlung tapa kha malie chang tie. Khaapa re ma na hrie? Khaapa taata ma naa vaw? Khaapa ruo taata ma na cuo? Khaapa mingphang tama na cuo?” ta pata ama hiehriy.
“Kama ca Hebru mingphang tana i cuo, Abyipavuoruo Khazing, riyliy hne alyi a sapa na i bie,” ta pata a palie yi.
Cawsaa ca ciy vie hryly yi te ama kyihuo khata, “Na tuepa hing khaapatama a cuo!” ama ta. Tahematapakieca ama ta a chang nakaw yi khata, cawsaa ta Abyipa'a taa tana aa ruo tapa kha ama pachang.
Cakhutaata iema ta ama kyihuo khata, “Riyliy a die the riypa hingta tuokhaatama maca tue aa?” ama ta. Tahematapakieca riyliy lie thliychie ca a ruv vie hryly.
Ama ta iema kha, “Na la ung la riyliy luo na thaw tie ung; cakhutaata riyliy kha a die aa; tahematapakieca kama kawlie hing tana nama cunglie thliychie a tlung tapa kha i pachang,” a ta yi.
Tuokhaata a cuo zaw cawsaa tie ca ta tiy kie luo chiykhyi khu'apa ma ta pata khuopuv ta amaa zue, cuo ra sala cuo khu vyi, thliychie ca a ruv vie hryly.

Cakhutaata iema ta Abyipa'a luo kha khi yi te, “Vya Abyipa, thlaa na ma chuo, hingpa cawsaapa hringna kawlie hingta kiema ca ra thi pa khah se. A sue lipa thiyse kawlie hingta sue malie phaw thi khah; tahematapakieca Vya Abyipa, nama ca na khingna haa tana na tue,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Jonah ca la yi te riyliy chung luo kha ama thaw ca riyliy tiylaw ca a die.
Cakhutaata cawsaa ta Abyipakha ciy hryly yi te, Abyipa'a luo kha hriykhungrina pihluo yi te biekuona ama tue.
Cuorasala Abyipata Jonah paluo riypata ngaa lesapa sakha kha a pathlie; cahaacata Jonah ca ngaa riy chunglie kha ning thung hne zuo thung a aw.
Cakhutaata Jonah ta ngaa lesapa riy chung taa khata Abyipaa Khazing'a luo kha thlaa a chuo.
Palungriethyina chungtaata Abyipa'a luo kha thlaachuo angte, ama ta ina palie; Sheol riy chung taa khata khi angte, i ueryi ina thyi ciy.
Nama ta aa thuvna luo, riyliy rawkhie luo kha na thaw cate, tiy ta ina cadung; na tiylaw a pahiepa ta i cunglie kha ina sisue.
Cakhutaata kama ta, ‘Kama ca na hmungna taata thawpa tana i cuo; tuokhaatama na biena-ing pathepa ca i mang pakhaa khu aa?’ i ta.
I cung taata tiyta na buvkhung te, riyliy ta ina cadung; riyliy chunglie aphuv ta i luv kha ina kaze,
Riyliy raw tluo phyichaa te khata tlabung angte, Khue chung taa khata ina thue ciy, Vya Abyipai Khazing.
I hringna ca a chuole nguoluopa haata, Abyipakha i thyi; i thlaachuona ca nama'a luo pha te, na biena-ing pathe luo kha a pha.
Thlahnena a hnyi lipa kuvtuezuv a biepa tie ta, zang tluo amaa tlana kha ama thaw.
Cuorasala kama ca alawna ueryi hneta, hriykhungrina ica pihluo aa; bie i kuopa kha i kuona haata ica pi aa, khuona ca Abyipahuopa tana a cuo!” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipata ngaa lesapa'a lie kha bie ri te, ngaa cata Jonah ca alyi huvpa cunglie kha a kya paliy.
Abyipabie ca Jonah'a luo kha a yihningna ta pha pakhaa te,
“Thu la, Nineveh khypuv luo kha si tie, cakhutaata ica changpa bie kha phu tie,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Jonah ca Abyipabie haa khata a tha te Nineveh luo kha a si. Nineveh ca a le hringhruopa khypuv ta cuo te, ning thung luosi ta a cuo.
Jonah ca khypuv chung luo kha a ngie te ning kha chung a si. Cakhutaata khi te, “Ning sawthung khu pahne ta Nineveh ca para pata a cuo aa!” a ta.
Nineveh cawsaa tie ca Khazing kha ama zang; a le a caw, ama bangkhuo ta, buri kha amaa buv.
Capa thuohlaa ca Nineveh siepahruo'a luo kha a chiy tiyta, aa byithude taa khata thu te, a siepahruo caw kha a thlie, buri kha a buv te, buvcuo chunglie kha aa tu.

Cakhutaata Nineveh khypuv chunglie kha thuo pathyisana a tue: “Siepahruo hne aa byi tie ta ama papyapa biechina ca: Cawsaa cuose, sahring cuose, cuerung ta cuose, tuvrung ta cuose, sa ning pata cuo'a vyi. Sa pi'a va ung ciy, tiy dang'a va yi.
Cawsaa hne sahring hne khata buri a buv pata Khazing'a luo kha khuosa ta thlaachuo yi se. Ama bangkhuo ta ama hringzya pha lipa hne tuechiena taa khata a maa yi se.
Ahungma a pachang? Khazing ca thlachie rue pata a palung kha a thle'a te, kiema ma ra lina riypata a hihaana kha a die the ri'a muo,” a ta.

Khazing ta iema ama tuepa kha hmung te, ama hringzya pha lipa taata amaa maapa kha a hmung tiyta, a palung kha a thle te iema cungliena i patlung sa aa, a tapa rana kha patlung sa pakhaa li pata a aw.
Cuorasala Jonah ca hingpa kawlie hing a palung tluo li pata a hi a haa.

Abyipa'a luo kha thlaachuo te, “Vya Abyipa! I ruo lie i aw kalie ningta hingpa hingna i za ri cuo va ma? A hruothu lieta Tarshish luo i ruopa kha capa kawlie ca tana a cuo; tahematapakieca nama ca vihnyituv hne kawpacuotuv Khazing, a catli pata a hi a haa lipa, aa hmangpa duena a hnyipa, cawsaa kha duote riypata naa ting zaw ta thlachie a rue pakhaa thepa na cuopa khana i pachang.
Caacuonakawta Vya Abyipa, ata hingta i hringna hing na la tie, tahematapakieca kama cuota ca i hringpa laata i thiypa na a pha vie,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipata palie te, “Hing haa hingta hihaa riypa hing a pha na ta ma?” a ta.
Cakhutaata Jonah ca khypuv chung taa cata pya te khypuv ningchiyluo kuo lie kha thluodaa a sa te aa tu. Ningdiy rawlie kha a tu te, khypuv cunglie kha khaapama a tlung aa ta pata a huo.
AbyipaKhazing ta ungthyi kung papu sa te, Jonah kha ningdiy pi pata a palung panuo sa riypata a cunglie kha a pazu sa; caacuonakawta Jonah ca ungthyi kung kawlie cata a palung a tluo hringhruo.
Cuorasala a mawluopa khy a kya vuo tiyta, Khazing ta ungthyi kung ca lunglungpa pace sa te aa uv.

Ning a kya chiy tiyta, Khazing ta a ling suesaapa ningchiy thliy kha a pahruo sa. Jonah ca ning ta a luv kha a e nakawta a luv zing te vuotaa a thiy. Ama ta, “Kama cuota ca i hringpa laata i thiypa na a pha vie,” a ta.
Cuorasala Khazing ta Jonah kyihuo khata, “Ungthyi kung kawlieta na hihaa riypa hing a pha na ta ma?” a ta. Ama ta, “A cuo, i thiy'a nangna te tana i hi a haa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipata, “Nama ta naa ling lipa hne na mangchiy lipa, zuo kha ta kya pu te zuo kha ta a thiypa ungthyi riy kawlie hing kawpacuona na hnyi.

Cata a cuo kieca hingpa Nineveh khypuv, a chunglieta cavyi cacuo hmuota a pachang li liepa cawsaa thawzakha hne thawkiy ama awnapa hne sahring ri tie li ama awnapa hing kawpacuo li pata i aw the'a ma?” a ta.
Judah siepahruo Jotham, Ahaz, hne Hezekiah tie zaw chuo ningta Moresheth khy ming Mikah ta Samaria hne Jerusalem kawlieta Abyipa bie a thyipa ca hing haa hingta a cuo.
Cawsaa zaw, nama bangkhuo ta thyi tie ung, Vya alyi hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo, naathlie tie ung; Abyipa Khazingca a biena-ing pathepa taa khata tehte cuo mang sue.
Abyipaca a awna hmang taa khata a pya aa, za cung'a te, alyi aa suona hmang zaw lie kha a chaa aa.
Myi athaalie a awpa khyihnue ca a tiy ta lang te, caku lie tiy a langbungpa haata, ama rawlieta tluo zaw ca a tiy ta lang'a te, bawphie zaw ca ama kya pachi aa.

Capa bangkhuo ca Jakob tuesuena kawlieta cuo te, Israel ingchungkhue suena kawlieta a cuo. Jakob tuesuena ca khaapatama a cuo? Samaria ta cuo va ma? Judah khahrungtluobu ca khaapatama a cuo? Jerusalem ta cuo va ma?
Caacuonakawta Samaria ca ruo chunglie hnehnaw thawna hmang, mingsuv diedung tuena hmang ta i tue aa. Aa lung zaw kha bawphie chung luo patle diy'a angte, a hruopatu kha aa luo riypata i tue aa.

A kuvtuezuv bangkhuo kha a diykariy pata phawchi diy'a angte, a ningthavie tuokaa bangkhuo kha myi ta i rue aa, cakhutaata a kuvtuezuv zaw kha i dechi diy aa; siyhrawnung muo aa pacungpa kha siyhrawnung'a liena a hmuo pakhaa diy aa.
Hingpa kawlie hingta a ngiy'a angte i caa aa; i phyi cahripa ta cakuo'a angte, i thliehripa ta i aw aa; Ruo-uv haa khata khi'a angte, kala-uvpavaa haa khata i caa aa.
Tahematapakieca hmaa a phyapa ca tluo khu'a va tli. Capa ca Judah luo na aa vaw; capa ca i cawsaa tie thlake, Jerusalem luona a vya pha tli.
Gath kha va chang khah vie ung, caa khah vie ung; Beth-leafrah lie kha, buvcing chunglie a pahlang tie ung.
Shafir lie khy a sapa zaw nama thliehripa ta hne nangzaa pata cakuo tie ung. Zaanan lie khy a sapa tie ta hmieluo vya tung khah ung; Beth-ezel ca a caa nguoluo, niema kha byana ca pi khu'a va tli yi.
Tahematapakieca Maroth lie khy a sapa tie ca a ngietie li pata na phana kha ama huo, Abyipa'a taata rana ca Jerusalem thlake luo kha a za cung tli.

Lakhish lie khy a sapa zaw, rietuvnapa aruole lie kha rie a pakhuonapa kha bang tie ung; sacanung Zion a sue taanapa ca capa ca tana a cuo, tahematapakieca Israel tuesuena ca nama chunglie khana hmung pata a cuo.
Caacuonakawta niema ta Moresheth-gath kha lasaw nama pi aa, Akhzib ingchungkhue tie ca Israel siepahruo tie a dungpa tana ama cuo aa.
Mareshah lie khy a sapa tie, kama na niema cung luo kha tetuv a vya tlungkhyi'a ang, Israel rungnaana ca Adullam luo kha aa vaw aa.
Nama tlechuosapa nama saata zaw kawlie khata niema hne niema kha nama luv a pamyi ung la, iema ca sii ta sikhyipa ama cuo nakaw khata hmungthlu haa khata nama luv kha a pamyi tie ung.
A iehmang cunglieta pha lina hne hmang pha lipa tue riypata khue a khuopa tie ca thluechiy lipa tana ama cuo! Iema cahrana ta ama tue khupa a cuo nakawta mawluo khy a dyi pahne ta capa ca ama tue.
Lu kha ama hietlie kieca amaa la thluo; ing kha ama hietlie kiema amaa la thluo; cawsaa kha tuechie yi te ama ru zaw te kha ama chuv thluo.

Caacuonakawta Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Ata hing ca, kama ta hingpa ingchungkhue cunglie hing a pha lipa patlung sa'a angte, nama luv hmuo haw khu'a va ung ciy; hruotlesa pata cakuo the'a va tli ung ciy, tahematapakieca capa cuo ca cuo pha lipa tana a cuo aa.

Capa ning lie ca hlake kha ca phy'a yi te, khuosa ta caa ngiy'a yi te aca caa'a yi, “Para karuepa tana ma cuo tli; Abyipana i cawsaa tie ama cupa ru kha la te, kama'a taata a palaw tli de! Kiema malie a patuvpa tie khana ma lu kha a pi tli yi,” ama ta aa.
Caacuonakawta Abyipacawsaa tie a hmyana lieta niema nama cuvu riypa kha caa taapa riypa aw'a va yi.
“Phung ri khah, cahaapa kaw ca na ri riypata cuo vyi; ngiechina ta kiema kha malie vya pha'a vyi,” ama ta.

Vya Jakob ingchungkhue zaw, capa ca ri riypata a cuo'a ma? Abyipapalungpasiyna ca a chuo tli ma? Hingpa zaw hing ma ama tuepa ta a cuo yi? Aa dangsa pata a hringpa cuota ca i bie hing ta thlahnena a pi yi cuo va ma?
Cuorasala niema ca i cawsaa tie carie tana nama cuo; rie kaw rue li pata hnaanguosa pata a vawlepa tie kha ama ke cung lie'apa ama buohryi cungpakaw nama paruvpa.
I cawsaa canung tie kha ama ngie a rawsanapa ama ing taata namaa cade; ama saata tie'a taata kama rungnaana kha chuozaa ta nama lapa.
Thu ung la cakuo tie ung; tahematapakieca hingpa hing ca a hyna hmang ta cuo vyi, hingpa hmang ca a pathe lipa a cuo nakawta a ruvsa pata parapa tana a cuo aa.
A hangpa hne dung a hmuopa pakha kha a vaw te, “Mingsuvtiy hne zuvre kaw na phung ica chang'a yi,” a ta kieca, cahaapa cawsaa ca hingpa cawsaa tie phungchangtuv ta a cuo aa!

Vya Jakob, kama ta ica pahmya diy hrahring'a yi, Israel ming aa ngaapa tie kha i pakiy diy'a yi. Tuvte suokha lie tuv haa khata hne ruo kha lie a tlepa tuvrung haata hmang kha lieta chi hne'a yi angte, nama ruo lie ca cawsaa puraa a ruvsa aa.
Kaw a tungpa pakha kha ama hmie luo ta a si aa; khypuv thlake kha thli'a yi te capa taa cata ama pya aa. Ama siepahruo ca iema hmie luo khata si'a te, Abyipaca iema luochiytuv ta a cuo aa.
Cakhutaata kama ta: Naathlie tie ung, niema Jakob luochiytuv tie hne Israel ingchungkhue uvtuv tie! Biedangpa a pachang riypa cuo va ung ca ma?
Niema, phana kha hue ung cate pha lina kha a duepa tie, i cawsaa tie vang a hlepa tie hne ama ruv lie a bepa saa zaw a khawpa tie;
I cawsaa zaw saa kha a cepa tie, ama vang a hlepa tie, ama ruv kha thlipachung diy ung cate, bi lie chang riypa saa haata a tuepa tie tana nama cuo.
Cakhutaata iema ta Abyipa'a luo kha khi'a yi te, cuorasala ama ta palie'a va yi; a pha lipa ta hmang ama tue nakawta, capa cuo lie ca ama ta a hmie kha a nukhuo'a yi.

I cawsaa tie kha luo a papie sapa profet tie hne aa patuv pata Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri, Ning riypa chekha ama hnyi tiyta, “Diena” aw se ta yi te, ning riy khaapahmuo a pi lipa tie kha nama cunglie rie na a tlung aa a tapa tie tana nama cuo.
Caacuonakawta niema ca zuo ta muocuo hmung'a va ung ciy, zingna cuo lie zaw kha biephu hmung'a va ung ciy. Profet tie cuota ca ning tla'a te, ningchung zaw kha a zing aa.
Profet tie ca ama nang zaa'a te, hmungdawlutuv tie zaw nang pazaa pata ama cuo aa. Khazing'a taata paliena a aw li nakawta ama bangkhuo ta ama hmya kha amaa pahruv aa.
Cuorasala kama ca, Jakob hne Israel kha ama tuesuena pathyi sa riypata, cahrana hneta i bi, Abyipathlaapa hneta bi angte, biedangpa hne thaazuo zaw ta i bi.
Thyi tie ung, niema Jakob ingchungkhue uvtuv tie hne Israel byi le cepa tie, Biedangpa a duvpa tie hne a khing a nguona bangkhuo luo a papie sapa tie,
Zion kha thiyse palangna hneta sa ung cate, Jerusalem kha pha lina hneta nama sa!

A uvthyi tie ta nawthuv vuota bieripana ama tue, tluobyi tie ca lasaw vuota pacuv yi te, profet tie ta tuokaa vuota biephu ama hmung. Cuorasala Abyipa'a lie anguopuona hneta, “Abyipaca kiema'a lie a aw hmisi! Khaapa ruvnaana hmuota ma cunglie tlung'a vyi,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta niema kawlie hingta, Zion ca le haata thawpa ta a cuo aa, Jerusalem ca hnehnaw thawnapa ta a li'a te, biena-ing tluo ca atuv ta aa li aa.
Hmieluo cuo lie ca Abyipaing aa daanapa tluo ca tluo zaw hrawlie aa suo cepa tluo ta tue pata cuo'a te, tluothlue zaw cung luo calangthaw pata a cuo aa. Cawsaa kha a vya hmya'a yi te,

mingphang hluvpuv kha a vaw'a yi te, “A vaw tie ung, Abyipatluo luo kha kie'a ung puv, Jakob Khazing ing luo kha kie'a ung puv; a luopuv kha malie pacuv sala, ziy ung siy,” ama ta aa. Tahematapakieca pacuvna ca Zion taata pya'a te, Abyipabie ca Jerusalem taata a pya aa.

Ama ta cawsaa hluvpuv alalalie kha bieripana hnyi'a te, luohlaapuv luo a awpa a cahrasapa mingphang zaw alalalie kha biechina a tue aa. Iema ta ama zueziy zaw kha atuv ta pali'a yi te, amaa syi zaw kha thingnge tenapa cere ta ama pali aa; mingphang phang kha hne phang kha alalalie kha zueziy cabapa aw'a va tli, rietuv acuvna zaw aw'a va tli.
Cuorasala ama mingsuv diedung cyicuo hne ama thyikuv kung raw cyicuo lie kha a tu'a yi te, ahunghmuo a paciy sa tapa aw'a va tli, tahematapakieca Cungnungce Abyipana a ri.
Cawsaa bangkhuo ca iema hne ama khazing ming ta ama si kaluo aa, cuorasala kiema ca Abyipama Khazing ming tana chuozaa ta ma si aa.
Abyipata, capa ning thue ca a kuv a phyi a pakyapa tie, luohlaa luo a cadepa tie hne kama ta i ruvnaana i pi buopa tie kha i pakiy'a yi.
A pakyapa tie ca aa ngaapa ta tue'a yi angte, a cadepa tie kha mingphang cahrapa ta i tue'a yi; Abyipata Zion Tluo cunglie kha iema ca ata taa hingta chuozaa ta a uv'a yi.
Cakhutaata nama, Vya tuvrung mangchiynapa ingsuo, Zion sacanung tluothlue, nama'a luo na hingpa hing aa vaw aa, hluo ningta na uvnapa, Jerusalem sacanung uvna ca nama'a luo kha aa vaw pakhaa aa.
Khaapanakawma ata ca khuosa ta nama caa? niema hrawlieta siepahruo aw va ma? niema cuota ruenapituv zaw aw va tli yi ma? capa pasana ca ta nupazipa canung haata ca patuv kanaa yi?

Vya sacanung Zion, saata a hnyipa canung haa khata, aa camaa ta a camaa la khuosa ta a hrung tie; tahematapakieca nama ca khypuv taa hingta na pya aa, ruo chunglieta a ri'a cate, Babilon luo na si aa. Capa lie ca khuo pata na cuo aa, capa lie ca Abyipata na carie tie kuv taa khata acaa thla aa.
Ata hing mingphang hluvpuv ca nama a du pata a hmya yi te, “Zion ca papyapalyi pata cuo se, a cunglie kha ma ming lunghruo tlungsa se,” ama ta.
Cuorasala iema ta Abyiparuena kha pachang va yi, aa tingnapa kha pachang khu va yi, suopie ca suo-aciyna luo pahmyapa a cuopa haapa iema kha a pahmya yi.

Vya sacanung Zion, thu la suo kha a ciy tie, tahematapakieca na kiy kha thaa ta pali'a angte, na pating kha daa ta i pali aa, nama ta cawsaa hluvpuv kha a diykariyna te ta carie'a yi cate, ama hnyipa kha Abyipa'a luo na pi aa, ama hnyirungna kha alyi cung yalya ta a uvpa Abyipakha na pi aa.
Ata hing niema ca khypuv suokha kha a dungkhuo ta a cadungpa haa tana aca cadung tli yi; kiema ca cadung diypa tana ma cuo tli; Israel uvtuv be khana asung ta ama chi.

Cuorasala nama, Vya Bethlehem Efrath, Judah ming chunglie mingphang cawta suo kha ta a cuopa, kama cuota Israel ming uvtuv riypa ca nama chung taa tana a pya aa. Ama a hruo ca ma hnangluo chuo a chuo ciepa cuo chunglieta a zaa aw tlipa tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta nu ta a pazi nguoluopa canung ta a saata a puvna te cuose, aa ngaapa a tieriy tie ta Israel cawsaa tie'a luo ama vya kaana te cuose, ama ta a thuse caw'a yi.
Cakhutaata ama ca a daa'a te, Abyipacahrana thueta hne Abyipaa Khazing lesyi rungnaana thueta a tuv kha sa a pi aa. Iema ca aa bangta tah aw'a yi te, a lesyina ca alyi dena te a pha aa;

cakhutaata ama ca ma thlaalungna ta a cuo aa. Assiria tie kha ma ruo luo a vaw yi te, maa lyi lie kha ama phyi amaa cang kieca, Kiema ta iema a du riypa tuvkhie pa sariy hne uvtuv pa cari ma padaa'a yi.

Iema ta Assiria ruo kha zueziy ta uv'a yi te, Nimrod ruo kha a bya taata zueziy a da paciepa ta ama uv aa. Assiria tie kha ma ruo luo a vaw yi te, ma ruoriy kha hnaa ama vya pahnaw kieca, iema ta malie ama khuo aa.
Cakhutaata mingphang hluvsa ta ama cadungpa Jakob phang aa ngaapa tie ca Abyipata aphuv cunglie a patla sapa aduo haa khata ama cuo aa. Iema ca cawsaa kha a buchuo li pata cawsaapa kha huo'a va yi.

Mingphang zaw hrawlie Jakob phang aa ngaapa tie, cawsaa hluvsa ta ama cadungpa tie ca atuv chunglie saruopa a hluvsa hrawlieta chingde haata hne tuvrung chunglie chingdetaata haa tana ama cuo aa. Chingde kha ama hraw luo a ngie te, caphipatlaa diy yi te a khuo riypa ahunghmuo aw va yi.
Nama kuv ca nama carie tie cunglie pathlie'a ung cate, iema bangkhuo ca nama thie diy aa.
Abyipata ri te, capa ning thue ca, niema hrawlieta namaa ruo kha thie'a angte, nama aruole kha i para aa.
Nama ruo chunglie khypuv zaw kha para'a angte, nama cariekyikuo kha i pacing diy aa.
Kama ta ca-ie a thepa tie kha nama kuv taata i pahli diy'a yi, ridawlutuv tie kha hnyi'a va tli ung ciy.
Nama kuvtuezuv zaw kha pahli diy'a angte, niema kuv ta nama tuepa kha abie'a va tli ung ciy.
Cakhutaata Asherah tung kha niema hraw taata hne nama khy taata i para aa.
Cakhutaata ri a ngie lipa mingphang tie cunglie kha hihaana hne pathiy lingna hneta phuv i la'a yi.
Abyipata khaapama a ri tapa hing naathlie tie ung: Thu la, tluo zaw hmiekunglie kha na kaw hne aa patuv pata paakie tie, tluothlue zaw ta na ueryi kha thyi yi se.
Niema tluo zaw hne alyi hruopatu zaw, Abyipata a cawsaa zaw cunglie bie a tuepa hing thyi tie ung; tahematapakieca Abyipaca a cawsaa zaw hne kha tana bie a hnyi, Israel hne kha tana bie amaa i aa.
“Vya i cawsaa, na cunglieta khaapama i tue? Khaapa riethyi ma ica pi? Na palie tie!
Izipt taata ca kya pyakhyi angte, siicuona taa khata icaa thla. Nama'a luo kha Moses, Aaron, hne Miriam kha i pathlie yi.

Vya kama cawsaa, Moab Siepahruo Balak ta a tingpa hne Beor sacapaa Balaam ta tuokhaatama a palie tapa kha cuose, Shittim taata Gilgal te khaapama a cuo tapa zaw kha a thyi tie, Naa thyi kieca, Abyipakhuona re hriepa kha na pachang aa.”
“Khaapa hneta ma Abyipahmiekung luo kha i vaw aa? Aa suona lie Abyipa hmiekunglie kha tuokhaatama i bung aa? A hmiekung luo kha kung kha a tapa cuetaata, myirue panaana hneta ma i vaw aa?
Abyipaca tuvtungpa a thawthaw ta hne chiytiy cavaa thawhraa ta a langpa kha pihluo ang sala a palung a tluo'a ma? I tuesuena cuo khata i pangpa thyipaa ta a cuopa sa uvthyi kha ma i pihluo aa?”

Vya cawsaapa, khaapama a pha tapa hne, Abyipata khaapama a khing tapa kha aca chang tli thluo, capa tie ca, biedangpa lie hring riypa, duena hne kawpacuona hnyi riypa, Khazing hmiekunglie rawcanawna hne ta hring riypa zaw hingta cuo va ma?
Abyipaueryi ca khypuv luo kha a u, (na ming ciyzaana ca singna tana a cuo): Vya khypuv chunglie a awpa cawsaazaapuv zaw, naathlie tie ung!
Cawsaa pha lipa tie ing chunglie, pha lina ta ama lapa suethiy hne chiesapa a tling lipa taana kha i maw khu'a ma?
Aa hmuo lipa taana tie, aa hmuo lipa cyilung hne panangna tie kha i ngiethe khu'a ma?
A hnyirungpa tie ta tuechiena hneta nama bi, khy ming ta hangbie nama ri, ama pakaa lie palyi ca dungviena tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta nama tuv riypa kha i patha tli, na suena kawlie khata ica pahli aa.
Ning'a cate, na riy bi'a vyi, na nang a diy ngiethie aa; naa pacung aa, cuorasala suokha hmuo a bang'a vyi, tahematapakieca naa pacungpa khana zueziy ta i para aa.
Saciy na tuv aa, cuorasala a thyipaa la'a vaciy, olif kha na rie aa, cuorasala nama hne nama kha a thuv'a vaciy; mingsuv thyi kha na ne aa, cuorasala mingsuvtiy ca dang'a vaciy.

Tahematapakieca siepahruo Omri phungluo kha ziy pari cate, Ahab ingchungkhue tuepa bangkhuo kha na tue, iema ruena pipa kha na ziy. Caacuonakawta nama ca a duothlingpa ta ca tue'a angte, na chunglie khy a sapa tie kha a paruv ta kawchie ri riypata i tue'a yi; caacuonakawta nama ca i cawsaa tie esena khana na ang aa.

Bawchie ciemuopa tana i cuo! Kama ca ning riypa a thyi hmung khu a aw lipa, cuovuo ningta lupa cuovuo thingthyi hne lu diy tlipa mingsuv kung haa tana i cuo; thyikuv a hming taapa kha i nangdiy ningta aw va tli.
Zang tluo aa tlapa tie ca ruo chungtaata vie yi te, aa dangpa ahunghmuo aw va tli yi; iema bangkhuo ta thiyse palang riypata a bu yi te ama huo, pakha hne pakha kha cyihyi amaa thla khuo.
Ama kuv ca pha lina hrie kha thesa te, byi tie hne bieripatuv tie ta nawthuv ama hie, naw a hnyipa ta a khingpa kha naw pi yi te a hie yi, cahaacata biedangpa kha ama para.
Iema hrawlie a pha cepa hne aa dang cepa ca ahling hraw haa tana ama cuo. Na rievetuv tie amaa pahluna cuo hne nama duotena cuo ca aa vaw tli, ata hing iema amaa kalaana cuo ca aa ngiesa tli.
Na viesaa kha zang khah, na duepa pakhakha zaw kha zang khah; Naa paw nguoluo pa na napuv'a lie na ripa bie kha hmuo a raaring tie.
Tahematapakieca a sacapaa ta a paa kha siysaa ri li pata aa du aa, sacanung ta a nung kha a du'a te, munung ta ningnung kha aa du aa; nama carie ca nama ingchungkhue cawsaa kha tana ama cuo aa.
Cuorasala kama ca Abyipakhana i mang aa, kama naa khuotuv Khazing khana i huo aa; i Khazing ta ina thyi aa.
Vya i carie zaw, kama cunglie kha nama palung tluo khah se; i lie tiyta, i thu pakhaa aa; zingna lie i tu tiyta, Abyipaca kama cuota khena ta a cuo aa.
Kama ca ama'a lieta i sue nakawta, Abyipahihaana kha i ang aa, kama cuota bieripana tue te inaa daakhyina te ta i ang aa. Ama ta a khena luo kha na pyakhyi'a te, aa dangnazya kha i hmung aa.

Kama kyihuo ta, “Abyipana Khazing ca khaapaliema a aw? naa tapa ca nangzaana ta a buvkhungpa kha i carie tie ta ama hmung aa. Ama aa liepa kha i ming ta hmung'a te, ama ca luopuv lie caakaw haata chaapuopa ta a cuo aa.
Na khypuv dungkhuo lungruetlepie sa pakhaana cuo tana a cuo! Capa ning thue ca ruoriy ca paku pata a cuo aa.
Capa ning thue ca Assiria taata Izipt te, Izipt taata Cavaa lepa alala ruo zaw taa khata nama'a luo kha amaa vaw aa.
Cuorasala a chunglie khy a sapa tie ama tuena thyipaa kawlie khata alyi ca a duothling aa.
Diedung ruo a liekhingkhuo atuv chunglie ama seta a awpa nama huopa tuvrung, na cawsaa tie kha na khuecahryi ta khie tie yi. Hluo ning haa khata Bashan hne Gilead lie kha patle pata cuo yi se.
Izipt ruo taata na kya pya ning haa khata, nang-uo a chiypa hmang kha malie pahmung sa tie.
Mingphang zaw ta hmung yi sala, ama cahrana bangkhuo cunglie kha ama nang zaa se; ama kuv ta ama pakaa kha a paping yi sala, ama naa rue se.

Pariy haata hne alyi lie a valepa saruopa zaw haa khata alyi diypa kha ama pali aa; ama riekhuopiehu chung taa khata amaa cathangsa pata ama kya pya aa; Abyipama Khazing kha ciysa pakhaa'a yi te, ciyna hneta nama hmiekunglie kha amaa daa aa.

Nama haapa Khazing ahungma a aw? Nama ca aa ngaapa na ru ta a cuopa, na cawsaa tie tuesuena kha a ngiethe cate, a lawpakhungpa tana na cuo. Ama ca a hi haa pata aw pari vyi, nangdue na a paluo sa khingpa tana na cuo.
Ama ta ma cunglie kha kawpacuona hnyi pakhaa'a te, ma suena kha a phyipazaa rawlie a chi aa. Nama ta ma suena kha aa thuvpa riyliy luo malie na thawpa aa.
Hluo ning taata ma mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie chie naa zaa sapa haa khata, Nama ta Jakob kha zang tluo atlana pahmung sa'a cate, Abraham kha a tlyi lipa zang tluo atlana kha na pahmung sa aa.
Nineveh hne aa patuv pata profetbiephu tana a cuo. Elkosh khy ming Nahum ta muocuo a hmungpa capenapa caa-uv.
Abyipa ca hietlie a hmuopa hne phuv la a hmuopa Khazing tana a cuo, Abyipaca phuv la te a hihaana a le; Abyipa ca a carie tie cunglie kha phuv la te a hi a haa.
Abyipaca a hi haa paluo vyi, cuorasala lesyi te a cahra, Abyipaca a suepa kha duote li pata pathlie buo vyi.
Riyliy kha chuo te a ky, cavaa bangkhuo kha a pacaa diy. Bashan hne Karmel kha a uv yi te, Lebanon thingdaw panuta zaw ca ama caa.
A hmiekunglie kha tluo zaw ca a siy yi te, tluothlue zaw ca a tiy ta ama lang. A hmiekunglieta alyi kha a cahang te, chuelyi hne a chunglie a awpa zaw kha amaa cathang.
Ahungma a pathiylingna hmielie ca a daa khu aa? Ahungma a ie ta a iepa a hihaana kha a ang khu aa? A hihaana ca myi haata lyi te, ama kawlieta alung ca a kyichi diy.
Abyipaca a pha, ruvnaana cuo ningta cariekyikuo tana a cuo; ama a canawpa kha khuo yi te, a cahrasapa tiylena taa khata hmuo a khuo yi.
A carie tie kha zingna luo a cade'a yi te, ama lidie pathla diy riypata a tue'a yi.
Khaapanakawma Abyipakha na raw? A carie tie ca yi hning kya thu'a va tli yi, a pahli karue diy'a yi.
Ahling haata a kalaa diy yi te, a pariypa haata ama dang, iema ca sacuo kung caapa haata a kuo diy yi.
Abyipakha raw te a dupa pakha niema chungtaata pya te, pha lina khue kha a khuo.
Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: “Iema ca ama thaa ruv te ama hluvsa zaw ta, para pata cuo'a yi te ama vie aa. Ruvnaana ica za pi zaw yi ma, ca pi vie'a va tli yi ang.
Na cunglie a khangpa ruekhang kha thlipachung'a angte, aca ciynapa yi thaa buoliriy kha i chipachung aa,” a ta.

Abyipana nama hne aa patuv pata naw a pi yi: “Na ming ca chuozaa ta a pazue'a vyi, na khazing tie ing taa khata sata tah khepa kuvtuezuv hne patlepa kuvtuezuv zaw kha i thaw diy aa. Nama ca hring naa tla li nakawta, na cuo tana thluo i sa aa.”

Mang tie ung! Thuophaa a vya phyapa hne thlaalungna thuo a pathyipa phyi khiy mang tie ung. Vya Judah, na pyi zaw kha tue la, na biekuo kha patling sa tie, tahematapakieca khatiy tahmuo a pha lipa tie ta ca la'a va tli yi, iema ca pahli karuepa tana ama cuo tli.
Caa para riypa na caa vawchiy. Na khypuv dungkhuo kha huo tie; na luopuv kha mangchiy tie; na sesie kha a pacu tie; na thaazuo kha khuosa ta pachiy tie.
(Tahematapakieca Abyipana Jakob rungnaana kha a padaa pakhaa, Israel rungnaana zaw kha a padaa pakhaa, cuorasala paratuv tie ta iema kha para yi te ama ce zaw kha ama paching diy.)
A rieka tie phya ca a se; a rieka tie ca a sedungpa kha amaa hryi. Pachiepazu yi te ama patluo ciemuo tiyta, aruole lie thaa ca a khe patlaw, rietuvna aruo ca a phyi dyi a cakhaw.
Aruole ca luopuv lie kha thi ka ta ka te, zapuv ahmyana hmang lie kha ama kaa bungthaw ciemuo; daamyi pakhepa kha lu yi te, thinghlaa a cakang ta amaa cakang.
A riekabyi tie kha a ku yi, hmieluo ama vya pyapa khata amaa pachiypuo, khypuv cadung khuopa lungruetlepie luo kha amaa ruo, a khuona phya kha amaa chungkhuo.
Cavaa lie thlake tie ca a pahaw te, siepahruo ing ca aa cahang.
Khypuv ca sii ta sikhyi pata a cuo aa ta pata bie papya pata a cuo, a siicanung zaw ca sikhyi pata cuo yi te, ama cacunghnaa kha a cung yi te, thuvruv haata amaa ngiy.
Nineveh ca tiy-ang haa khata cuo te, a tiy ca a zuvpathla nguoluo. “A daa! A daa!” ta pata ama khi, cuorasala pakha hmuo a pali va yi.
“Ngu kha ama chuv, siy kha ama chuv! Suethiy ca chuo the vyi, A muosungpa suethiy ri tie li tana a cuo!”
A ra diy karue, ama cali ama cadaa, a duo a thling! Pathiypalung ra te pakhuv aa cathang, sesie bangkhuo aa cahang, hmie bangkhuo a ruopadya diy.
Chingde khue kha khaapaliema a aw? Chingdepuvnung hne chingdetungpa zaw ama cakuona khue, chingdetaata zaw ciyna khaapahmuo hnyi li pata amaa khiena khue ca khaapaliema a aw?
Capa chingde ca ta a taata zaw cuo khata saa ca sie te, a puvnung cuo khata a ruekatung kha a thli; a khue kha a saa siepa hne a caphipa khata a pabi.

Mang tie, nama ca i caa du, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta, cakhutaata naa ruole zaw kha myi ta rue diy'a angte a khuv dyi a khuv aa, na rieka tie kha zueziy ta ama thiy aa; na chuvlepa yi suethiy bangkhuo kha alyi taa hingta i pahli diy aa, na biephyatuv tie ueryi ca thyi pata cuo'a va tli.
Ah! Thiyse a palangpa khypuv, hanghiena ta a bipa, chuvpa hruosue ta a bipa, hruosue lapa kha taw a pachang lipa!
Aruo chinapa sungpe hne aruole tiekyphyi aa pahlangna pu, aruo aa ruolepa pu hne aruole aa ruopa pu ca!
Aruo rieka tie ta aa li lepa zueziy hne asyi, aa pung ta a punglepa, a chuo the lipa a thiypa riyy, a thiypa riyy ca amaa pachiyna le!
