Siyhrawnung ta ri tie li ta a siyhrawna kawlie, thiysaa khingna lie palung a pala sana kawlie hne ca-ie a thepa canung tie kawlie, a siyhrawna ta mingphang zaw sii ta a tuepa nung kawlie hne, a ca-ie ta cawsaa zaw sii ta a tuena kawlieta,
Kama ta nama kha icaa du ta pata, Cungnungce Abyipata a ri, naa hning kha na hmie luo kya taw'a angte, na thliehripa ta na awpa kha mingphang hne pena zaw kha na nangzaana riypata i pamang sa'a yi.
A pyapa kha ca thawsue'a angte, duv aa chiypa ta ica tue aa.
Nama caa hmungpa mekaa ta ca duv'a yi te, “Nineveh ca a ra diy hmisi tli; ahungma ngiechi pata a ngiy a phie aa?” ama ta aa. Khaapaliema hnaapanguotuv kha ica huvpa aa?
Nail cavaa kielie a awpa Thebes laata na pha vie ma? Ama ca tiy ta a cadung, a khypuv dungkhuo ca riyliy ta a cuo, tiy khana a khy dungkhuo lungruetlepie ta a cuo.
Ethiopia hne Izipt ca a thaazuo ta ama cuo, ama cahrana chuo the vyi; Put hne Libia zaw kha ama byatuv ta ama cuo.

Cuorasala ama ca sii ta sikhyi pata a cuo, siicuona luo na a si; a haatiyta zaw kha luopuv mekaa lie alyi ama vaana. Aa byi tie kha vyisung a da yi te ama che, linghlaa a hnyipa tie kha thaa buoliriy ta ama cakhiy.
Nama zaw na zing na maa chiy'a te naa nu aa, na carie tie'a taata canawna kha na huv aa.
Na riekhuopiehu tie ca thyikuv kung lie a hming taapa thyikuv haa khata cuo'a yi te, ama cahang kieca a ningtuv zaw pakaa luo khana ama tla aa.
Na rieka tie kha mang tie yi, niema hrawlie kha canung na a aw ra yi. Nama ruo thlake ca nama carie tie cuo kha tana a kusa ta aa pahaw; myi na nama thlake tluo zaw kha a kuopachung diy.
Aca cadung'a nakaw yi ta tiy kha a the pacie tie, na cariekyikuo kha a pacu tie; acyi kha naw la, thung kha pyapuo tie, lungrue vyna kaw zaw kha tue pacie tie.

Capa lie ca myi ta aca kuo aa, zueziy ta aca sapachung aa. Khawbyapa haa kha tana aca kuosa aa. Niema hne niema kha khawbyapa haata a papung a pazaa tie ung, a phuv ta a awpa khawbyapa haa khata a papung a pazaa tie ung!
Nama ta na sungpalituv tie kha avuo lie aasiy laata na a hluv vie ta na tue yi. Khawbyapa ca a zaa yi te amaa zu diy.

Na rievetuv tie ca a phuv ta a zulepa khawbyapa phuv haa khata cuo yi te, na siepahruo rehrietuv tie ca thlasiy a siysa ningta tlepie lie a bepuo te a canawpa, a phuv ta a zulepa khawbyapa haa kha tana ama cuo. Ning a kya chiy tiyta, amaa zu diy, khaapa luo ma ama chiy tapa kha ahungtahmuo pachang va yi.
Vya Assiria siepahruo, na tuvkhietuv tie ca a hmung yi te, na byi tie ca ama tluv. Na cawsaa tie ca tluo zaw cunglie kha ahunghmuo a pahmya riy aw li pata amaa chepatlaa diy.
Na hmaa ca patluo khu pata cuo vyi, hmaa na phyapa ca thiykhyi phuv tana a cuo. Na kaw caa thyipa bangkhuo ta, ama kuvpazaa aca cabesue'a yi. Ahungma ri tie lipa na pha lina chungtaata a law buo?
Profet Habakkuk ta profetbiephu a hmungpa:
Vya Abyipa, khacuo ma byana vuota ca u'a angte, na naathlie lipa cata na aw aa? Khacuo ma “Tuechiena,” ta angte nama'a luo i khi pata, na khuo lipa cata na aw aa?
Khaapanakawma hmang pha lipa ama tuepa hing na pahmung sa cate, ruvnaana hing i mang thluo aa? Parana hne tuechiena ca i hmiekunglie na a aw; ahruna hne a-ina na naa tlungsue.
Caacuonakawta phungbie ca a thaa naale te, biedangpa ta tena hmung va tli. Aa dangpa tie kha a pha lipa tie ta cadung yi te, caacuonakawta bieripana ca maa lawmaw pata a cuo.
Mingphang zaw kha mang ung la, hmung tie ung! Nama nang uo se! Nama nang uo se! Niema chuolie hing hmang suokha tue pata cuo'a te, aca chang zaw yi ta zang'a va ung ciy.
Tahematapakieca a palung chiehruvpa hne a pathiy pachangpa mingphang ta a cuopa Khaldi ming kha pa thu'a yi angte, iema ing ta a cuo lipa kha patuv pata awna riypata alyi cung ting ta ama si aa.
Iema ca ciy aa chiypa hne mang nguo hmuo a aw lipa tana ama cuo, biedangpa hne linghlaa-awna ta aa ruose tli yi.

Amaa ruo ca kyiching laa tana a catli vie, zuo ta a khiepa cahnie laa tana ciy amaa chiy vie. Amaa ruo rieka tie ca luohlaa taata a vaw yi te, hmungthlu ta a la khingpa sa a tlahningpa haa khata amaa vya zu aa.
Iema ca tuechie riypa khata a vaw yi te, hmieluo kha ama tung lawmaw; sii ta sikhyipa tie kha viehnang zaa ta ama pahmya.
Siepahruo kha ese hyalya yi te, uvtuv tie kha pahnyisesungna ta ama hmuo. Riekhuopiehu mekaa kha pahnyisue yi te, la riypata alyi ama papungsue.
Thliy haa khata a ruo yi te ama caluo, a pha lipa kha tue yi te ama sue; ama cahrana khana ama khazing ta a cuo!

Vya Abyipai Khazing, Khazing Pathe, nama ca hluo ning taa khata ma Khazing ta za cuo va ca ma? Nama ca thiy'a vaciy. Vya Abyipa, iema ca bieripa riypa tana aa hnangna na tue yi, cakhutaata, Vya Alungpuv, iema ca duote riypa yi tana na sa yi.

Na ming ca a pha lipa tie mang riypa khata pathe tuv te, hmang pha lipa ama tuepa kha mang cakhaw khu vaciy. Khaapanakawma biekuona siysaa a ri lipa tie ca na mang thluo yi? Khaapanakawma iema laata aa dang viepa tie kha a pha lipa tie ta ama pahli tiyta a dieta tah na aw thluo?
Nama ta cawsaa hing riyliy ngaa haata sa yi cate, uvtuv a hnyi lipa aa thiylepa saruopa haata na sa yi.
Carie ta iema bangkhuo kha kyipa ta patuv yi te, asue ta aa da diy yi; caacuonakawta a palung a tluo hringhruo.
Aa sue hne a ngasiy thue khata khysatungbang aa re vie karaa nakawta, aa sue hne a ngasiy kha hriykhungrina ta a pihluo yi.
Ama zueziy kha chuozaa ta hmuo'a yi te ma kawpacuona hnyi li pata mingphang zaw kha a para pari'a yi?
Rievena ingsuo lie kha a daa'a angte, khypuv dungkhuo lie kha i aw aa; Ama ta khaapama ina chang aa tapa hne, i ciena hne aa patuv pata tuokhaatama ina palie aa tapa khana i huo aa.
Cakhutaata Abyipata kama kha na palie te: Muocuo hing cape tie; a rituv ta aa ruopuole pata a ri khu riypata, lungphie cunglie kha cape tie.
Tahematapakieca thli paciepa cuo huota muocuo tana a cuo, cuo chuona kaw na a ri, a vya cuo hrahring aa. A vya haa kieca, huo tie; aa vaw hrahring aa, palaw'a vyi.
A hruotlepa tie kha mang tie yi! Ama pathiypalung kha a hmuo vyi, cuorasala aa dangpa tie ca ama zangna tana ama hring.

Ca hlyitaw taata, hnyirungna ca malie a dung the; palunglena ca cuo pasiy a hmang vyi. Thiyna ca aa de tapa hnyi vyi, Sheol haa kha tana a pakaa kha a kusa ta a uo pari. Iema cuota mingphang bangkhuo kha pahmya yi te, cawsaa bangkhuo kha iema cawsaa haata ama pakiy.

Cahaapa cawsaa tie ca cawsaa mekaa ta ama cunglie bieke ri'a yi te ama ese hyalya aa, iema kha, “Niema huopa a cuo lipa na a la ung cate nama papung de!” ama ta. Lyibuo cuota nama patuvpa hing khacuo te ma namaa papungsue aa?
Niema'a taata lyibuo hmung riy a hnyipa tie kha sungkha ta thu'a yi te, nama thlaa caa pazangpa tie kha amaa kya cha aa, cakhutaata iema cuota hruosue ta nama cuo aa.
Nama ta mingphang hluvsa kha na ching nakaw yi ta, aa ngaapa tie khata nama kha aca ching'a yi, cawsaa thiyse palangna, alyi, khypuv tie hne a chunglie a awpa tie kha na tuechie nakawta a cuo.
Hruohra ta cawsaa kha chuv te a ingchungkhue cuota hnyirungna a huvpa, rana ta pha khu'a kie ta pata, aa suoluo ta buv a tuepa ca bawchie ciemuopa tana a cuo!
Na ingchungkhue cuo tana nangzaana na chiykhyi, cawsaa hluvsa kha na pahli yi; cuorasala na hringna kha naa sung.
Lungruetlepie lie alung hrahring kha khi'a te, thing zaw taa khata pahriy ta a vya palie aa.
“Thiyse palang pata khy a tlapa, pha lina ta khypuv a sapa ca bawchie ciemuopa tana a cuo!”
Cawsaa zaw ninghlue kha myi ta a uv riypa hne, mingphang zaw riethyina bangkhuo a hrihripa ta a cuo diy riypa ca, Cungnungce Abyipa'a taa tana a cuo cuo va ma?
Cuorasala tiy ta riyliy a buvpa haata, alyi ca a rungnaapa Abyipathesingna ta a bi aa.
“Ama thliehripa ta ama awpa kha mang riypata, a hihaana kha lyisue te a pariyna te ta a padang sapa ca, bawchie ciemuopa tana na cuo.”

Nama ca rungnaana cuo li pata nangzaana tana na riy a bi aa. Dang la namata khata a viele tie! Abyipacacuoluo kuv cunglie panuo kha na cahriy luo vya chiy'a te, na rungnaana kha nangzaana ta a buv aa.

Tahematapakieca Lebanon cunglie tuechiena na tuepa khata ca buv'a te, saruopa zaw na paranapa khata aca pachiy aa, cawsaa thiyse na palangnapa hne, alyi hne khypuv zaw hne a chunglie a awpa tie na tuechienapa khata ca buv'a te aca pachiy aa.

Kuvtuezuv ca khaapama ama tuena aa? A tuetuv ta a chaw aa raw riypata a tuepa kuvtuezuv hne, patlepa kuvtuezuv ca a hangpa pacuvtuv tana a cuo. Tahematapakieca a tuetuv ta a tuepa kha a zang, cuorasala tuepa ca kuvtuezuv khata cuo thluo te bie ri the vyi!
Nama, thing kyihuo ta, “Thu tie!” ta cate, alung kyihuo ta, “Namata tah kya thu tie!” a tapa ca bawchie ciemuopa tana na cuo! Capa ca ta aca pacuv the yi ma?
Cuorasala Abyipaca a biena-ing pathepa liena a aw; Alyi ming bangkhuo ca a hmiekunglie kha a dieta tah aw yi se!
Shigionorth ue ta profet Habakkuk thlaachuona.

Vya Abyipana mingpathuona kha thyi angte, na re hriepa kha i nang-uo te i daa thluo, Vya Abyipa. Kiema ma cuo lie kha pahra pakhaa la, nama na cuo lie kha malie pachang sa tie; na hihaana chunglie kha na nangduena ca a thyi thi tie.
Khazing ca Teman taata a vaw te, Khazing Pathe ca Paran Tluo taata aa vaw. A rungnaana ta avuo zaw ca buv te, alyi ca ama pathuosana ta a bi.
A khena ca ning haata cuo te, a kuv taata khena a pya, capa lie ca a cahrana ca aa nu.
Ama hmiekunglieta a pakie thepa pasana si te, a hnang taata puvtlung pasana ta a ziy.
A daa te alyi kha a cahang, mang yi te mingphang zaw kha amaa cathang.
Kushan thluodaa ca riethyivuosuona rawlie a awpa kha i hmung, Midian ruo thluodaa pangzu ca aa cathang.
Vya Abyipa, cavaa zaw cunglie kha na hi a haa ma? tena hmung riypata naa ruo hne naa ruole kha na maw tiyta, cavaa zaw cunglie kha na hi a haa ma? riyliy cunglie kha na hi a haa ma?
Na liy kha a hripa ta pahie cate, nama nawpina ta cuoti ca a lunghruo a tlung, alyi kha cavaa ta na che diy.
Tluo ta nama kha ca hmung te amaa camaa, tiy ta le te a buvle diy, aa thuvsapa riyliy ta aa hrung.
Ning ta a kuv kha aa suo pata calang te, thlaapa ca aa daana hmang lie kha a daa pari, iema khena chunglie ca cuoti kha a zu te, asyi ca a lile te a si.
Na pathiy iena ta alyi hing naa cang, na hihaana ta mingphang zaw kha naa ciy yi.
Na cawsaa zaw hne na sathu pathuvpa zaw, khuo riypata naa vaw. A pha lipa ingchungkhue tie luv kha alyi lie chaapuo cate, a hruopatu taata a thluvkhung te na hlepatlaa diy.
Ama cuoti mamaapa khata a rieka tie luv kha kapahli cate, iema ca kiema chepatlaa riypa khata thliysung haata a vya hruo yi te, aa nu nguoluopa siypasa tie kha paluo khingna cangta ama mang.
Riyliy kha naa ruo ta va te cate, a cahrapa tiy kha na calile.

Kama ta thyi angte i palung ca aa cathlu, i hmyataw zaw kha aa siy. I ruv kha hmaw te, i cakuo tiyta i phyi kha aa cathang. Kiema malie a tuvpa, cawsaa cung luo a vya tlung riypa riethyivuosuona ning kha a dieta tah i huo.

Thyikuv kung ca pamang li pata, mingsuv kung lie a thyi a aw li kie zaw; olif kung ca pathyi li pata, lu taata sa a vyi li kie zaw, tuv zaw kha thiy diy te, sahring ing chunglie sahring a aw li kie zaw,
Abyipa'a lie kha i palung tluo ngiethie'a te, naa khuotuv Khazing cunglie i law ngiethie aa.
Abyipa Khazingca i cahrana tana a cuo; i phyi kha sasuv phyi haata tue te, aa suopa tluo cunglie kha hnaanguosa pata ina cakuo sa.

Judah ming Amon sacapaa Siepahruo Josiah chuo ningta Zefaniah'a luo a phapa Abyipabie ca hing haa hing tana a cuo. Zefaniah ca Kushi sacapaa ta a cuo, Kushi ca Gedaliah sacapaa ta a cuo, Gedaliah ca Amariah sacapaa ta a cuo, Amariah ca Hezekiah sacapaa ta a cuo.
Alyi lie a awpa bangkhuo hing a pathesa pata i phiy diy aa, Abyipata a ta.

Cawsaa hne saruopa kha i phiy diy aa; avuo lieta a zupa pavaa hne riyliy lieta a awpa ngaa zaw kha i phiy diy'a yi. A pha lipa tie kha amaa pachiy riypata i tue'a yi. Alyi cunglieta cawsaa zaw hing i pahli diy'a yi, Abyipata a ta.
Judah a du pata i kuv kha pazuo'a angte, Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie kha i du'a yi; Aa ngaapa Baal mekaa hne kuvtuezuv tluobyi tie ming kha hingpa hmang taa hingta i pahli diy aa.
Avuo lie ning, aasiy, thlaapa zaw a bie pata ing cunglie a bungpa tie; Abyipahmiekunglie a bung yi te chie amaa sa raalaa pata, Milkom khazing'a lie zaw kha chie a sapuopa tie;
Abyipaa ziyna taata a pali te Abyipahne a khingna kha a huv lipa tie ca i pahli diy'a yi.
Abyipa Khazinghmiekunglie kha a dieta tah aw tie ung! Tahematapakieca Abyipaning ca aa ngie tli; Abyipaca hriykhungrina kha tingtuo te, a khyche zaw kha a pathe sa yi.
Abyipahriykhungrina ning lie ca byi tie hne siepahruo sacapaa tie hne ruohrang ming caw a tuepa bangkhuo kha duo i te'a yi.
Capa ning lie ca ama ziypaapa ing kha tuechiena hne hanghiena ta pabi riypata ingchiypakaa a zupakhungpa bangkhuo kha duo i te'a yi.
Capa ning lie ca Ngaa Thlake taa khata khina ueryi thyi pata cuo'a te, Khytluo Suohningna taa khata caana ueryi hne, tluothlue zaw taata a paringsapa rana pu kha thyi pata a cuo aa, Abyipata a ta.
Sungpalituv tie kha ama ra diy nakawta, Mortar lie khy a sapa tie ca ama caa; ngu a pathlie tawpa bangkhuo kha ama thiy diy tli.

Capa cuo lie ca Jerusalem kha myi-ing ta huv'a angte, ama palung chunglieta, “Abyipaca a phapa kha tue'a vyi, a chiepa zaw tue hlyi'a vyi,” ta yi te, ama aw tawpa haata hnaanguosa pata a awpa tie bangkhuo kha duo i te'a yi.
Ama hnyirungna bangkhuo ca chuv pata cuo'a yi te, ama ing ca a duothling aa. Ing kha ama sa aa, cuorasala iema ta awna'a va yi; mingsuv diedung kha ama tue aa, cuorasala mingsuvtiy kha dang'a va yi.
Abyipaning rungnaapa ca aa ngie tli, a catlisa pata na aa vaw nguoluo; Abyipaning puraa ca a kha tana a kha, riekapa na capa lie ca a khi.
Capa ning ca hihaana ning, palungriethyina hne riethyivuosuona ning, rana hne ngiechina ning, zingna hne khena aw lina ning, amyi a chaakaluv ning hne khyne ning tana a cuo.
Hmyakaa tung pata rie a duna ueryi thyi ning, aa suosa ta dungkhuopa khypuv amaa duna ning ta a cuo.

Cawsaa cunglie kha cahaapa palungriethyina ca patlung sa'a angte, mingcuepa haata luo ama cakuo aa; tahematapakieca Abyipa'a lie khana ama sue. Ama thiy ca buvcing haata lyi pata cuo'a te, ama saa ca ii haata thaw pata a cuo aa.

Abyipahihaana ning lie ca, ama siy hne ama ngu zaw ta iema kha khuo khu'a va yi. A hietliena myi chunglie ca alyi yalya hingta kuo diy'a te, alyi cunglie khy a sapa bangkhuo kha ciy aa chiysapa chuona ta sungkha ta a chuona a papha sa'a yi.
A hmya tie ung, a hmya tie ung, nang zaa a pachang lipa mingphang,
luohlaa luo thawpa cuo ung cate, savie haata namaa zu hluo hingta, a ie ta a iepa Abyipahihaana kha nama cung luo a pha hluo hne, Abyipahihaana ning kha nama cung luo a pha hluo khata a hmya tie ung.
Ruo chunglieta a panena hneta a nawpipa a tuepa tie, Abyipakha huv tie ung; adangna kha huv ung la, rawcanawna kha huv tie ung; Abyipahihaanapa ning lie kha nu pata nama cuo the biephung aa.
Tahematapakieca Gaza ca pyase pata cuo'a te, Ashkelon ca a duothlingpa hmang ta aa li aa, Ashdod ming ca ningchung ta a cade pata cuo'a yi te, Ekron ca a thariy ta cakhypa a cuo aa.

Ah, riyliy kie ruo lie khy a sapa tie, niema, Khereth mingphang tie! Vya Kanaan, Filistin ming ruo, Abyipabie na niema kha caa du yi; na chunglie khy a sapa ahunghmuo ama aw lina te tana i ca para aa.
Cakhutaata Vya riyliy kie ruo, nama ca sahring tlena ruo, tuvkhietuv tie cuota aphuv rungsanapa ruo hne, tuvte sanapa ruo tana na cuo aa.

Riyliy kie ruo ca aa ngaapa Judah ingchungkhue cuvu tana aa li aa, capa lie ca na sahring ama patle aa, cakhutaa cata zuo ta ca Ashkelon khy ing chunglie kha amaa ri aa. Tahematapakieca Abyipaiema Khazing ta iema kha kawpacuo'a yi te, vuophana kha a pi pakhaa'a yi.

Moab ming ta ama cunglie bieke ama ripa kha thyi angte, Ammon ming ta ama mangbungpa kha i pachang, i cawsaa zaw cunglie kha tuokhaatama bieke ama ri tapa hne tuokhaatama ama ruoriy ama caka tapa kha i pachang.

Caacuonakawta, Cungnungce Abyipa, Israel Khazing ta hing haa hingta a ri, Kama i hringpa haata, Moab ca Sodom haa khata a li'a te, Ammon ming ca Gomorrah haa khata amaa li aa, uvtamyi a punapa hne paciy khue cunapa ruo, chuozaa ta a duothlingpa ruo ta aa li aa. Aa ngaapa i cawsaa zaw ta iema kha ching'a yi te, aa ngaapa i mingphang zaw ta iema ruo kha ama cu aa.
Cungnungce Abyipacawsaa tie kha a du pata, tue hyalya yi te ahruo ama tle nakawta, ama hruotlena muo ta ama hmung riypa ca capa ca tana a cuo aa.
Abyipaca iema cuota ciy aa chiypa cuo'a te, alyi khazing bangkhuo kha a para diy aa, riyliy kie ruo bangkhuo hne parala lie a awpa mingphang tie ta, ama awna cyicuo taata, ama kha amaa bie kaluo aa.
Vya Ethiopia, nama zaw, i zueziy ta thie pata na cuo aa.
Cakhutaata a kuv kha chaluo ruo a du pata pazuo'a te, Assiria kha a para aa; Nineveh zaw kha a duothlingpa hne a caavungpa viehnangruo ta a tue aa.

Sahring zaw hne saruopa mekaa kha amaa bu aa; ruocaatutaru hne aa hrung ta a hrungpa tutaru kha a khypuv chunglie ca khy ama sa aa; tutaru ca thlaluo-aw lie kha khi'a te, ra-aa ca chiypakaa tung lie kha a khi aa; sidar thing ta tuepa tie ca ama khaw diy aa.

Aa nuo aa paasa pata hne aa bang aa susa pata a awpa khypuv, ama hne ama kha, “Kama hlyitaw taata a hrangpa ahungma a aw?” a tapa tana a cuo. A duothling suesaapa hmang, saruopa zaw arina hmang tana aa li de! Aa thaalie a cakuopa mekaa ta a kaw riparuvpa hne kuv tisue siypa tana a cuo tli.
Ah, paratuv, a pyalyipa, tuechie a hmuopa khypuv!
Khaapa bie hmuo a naathlie lipa, pasiypa-yana khaapahmuo a ziy lipa tana a cuo. Abyipakha a ringchuo li pata, A Khazing kha a ngie khing vyi.
A chunglie a byi tie ca aa hrung nguoluopa chingde balapa tana ama cuo; bieripatuv tie ca mawluo maw huo khaapahmuo a pangaa lipa cahnie balapa tana ama cuo.
A profet tie ca a tue cakhawpa hne zang tluo aa tla lipa tana ama cuo; a tluobyi tie ca a pathepa kha a papya a palyipa ta cuo yi te, phungbie a parapa tana ama cuo.

A chunglie a awpa Abyipaca aa dangpa ta a cuo; ama ca a pha lipa kha tue vyi. Maw tating ta pathli li pata khy a dyi pahne khata a biechipana kha a paluo sa pari; cuorasala aa dang lipa tie ca nangzaa hmuo pachang va yi.

Mingphang zaw kha i pahli diy tli yi; ama rie a nunapa zaw kha a ra diy tli; ama luopuv kha paduothling sa angte, caacuonakawta a chunglie ahunghmuo cakuo va yi; ama khypuv zaw kha paduothlingpa ta cuo te, cawsaa aw va yi, khy a sapa aw va yi.

Kama ta, “Khypuv hingta kama hing ina ciy hmisi aa, pasiypa-yana hing a ziy aa; a cunglie i patlung sapa bangkhuo hing hmung li pata aw'a vyi,” i ta. Cuorasala a hluo laata hmuo pha lina tue kha ama khing vie hryly.

Caacuonakawta Abyipata, na huo tie, tehte haata kama i daana riypa ning kha huo tie. Tahematapakieca i biechina ca mingphang hne pena zaw pahmya pata, i hihaana kha iema cunglie patlesue riypa hne i hihaana myi ta iema rue riypa khata a cuo; alyi cung yalya kha i hihaana myi na a kuo diy aa.
Capa cuo thue ca cawsaa zaw bie ca a pathepa bie ta thle'a angte, ama bangkhuo ta Abyipaming kha u'a yi te, palung a lusa pata a re ama hrie aa.
Ethiopia cavaa zaw huesuo lieta i chepatlaapa tie zaw chung taa khata ngiechina a hie pata thlaa a chuopa tie khata, kama'a luo kha ama lasaw ca ama vya cyi aa.

Capa ning lie ca niema ca kama naa du ung cate nama tuepa bangkhuo kawlie khata nang pazaa pata cuo'a va ung ciy; tahematapakieca niema hraw taa khata nama cawsaa a hruotlepa tie bangkhuo kha niema'a taa hingta pahli diy'a yi angte, i tluo pathepa cunglie hing a palung lepa aw'a va tli ung ciy.
Tahematapakieca niema hrawlie hing raw a canawpa hne aa panepa tie khana i pangaa'a yi. Iema ca Abyipaming tana canawna kha ama huv aa.
Israel ming aa ngaapa tie ca pha lina kha tue'a va yi, hang'a va yi, ama pakaa taata zyatena bie pya'a vyi. Aphuv panuna lie kha a khie hyalya'a yi te, ahungtahmuo pachiypahuo'a va yi.
Vya sacanung Zion, khuosa ta hlaa sa tie; Vya Israel, palungtluosa pata khi tie!
Abyipana nama cunglie bieripana kha a thaw tli, ama na na carie tie kha a cade tli yi. Israel siepahruo, Abyipaca niema hrawlie na a aw; niema ca rana kha ciy'a va tli ung ciy.
Capa ning thue ca Jerusalem kyihuo khata: Vya Zion, Ciy khah; na kuv thaa kha naa khah se.
Tena caa pituv yi riebyi le cepa, Abyipa, niema Khazing ca nama hrawlie na a aw; ama ca niema cunglie kha a palung tluo'a te, a duena ta aca sa pathiy'a yi; niema cunglie kha alawna hneta
pyi ning haa khata khuosa ta hlaa a sa aa. Nama'a taa khata ciy aa chiypa rana kha la'a angte, capa cuo ca ta suebena kha ang'a va tli ciy.

Capa cuo lie ca nama caa tuechiepa tie bangkhuo cunglie kha kama ta re i hrie aa. A pakyapa tie kha khuo'a yi angte, pa-iypa tie kha i pakiy'a yi, ama nangzaana kha pathuosana ta thlepa'a yi angte, alyi cung yalya lieta ama ming a pathuo aa.

Niema ica pakiy thue yi ca kama ta ing luo kha icaa chiy'a yi; alyi cung cawsaa bangkhuo hrawlie kha nama ming pathuo'a te aca pathuosa riypa yi ta ica tue'a yi, vuophana ica pi pakhaapa yi ca nama ming ta nama hmung aa, Abyipata a ta.

Darius siepahruo a cuona kung hning kung, thla caruv thlaa, ning khana lieta profet Haggai'a taata Shealtiel sacapaa Zerubbabel, Judah ruo uvtuv byi, hne tluobyi lepa Jehozadak sacapaa Joshua'a luo kha Abyipabie ca a pha:
Cungnungce Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa cawsaa tie hingta Abyipaing sa pakhaana cuo ta cuo valie ama ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipabie ca profet Haggai'a taa khata a vaw te:
Hingpa ing rakathluv khata a aw ningta niema tlaku a cungkhuv thang hning a hnyipa ing chunglie nama awpa hing a pha nama ta ma?
Caacuonakawta Cungnungce Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Nama awzya hing rue tie ung.

Saciy a hluvsa nama tuv, cuorasala a cawta dyi nama pahriy, a ning ca ning raalaa ung cate nama riy bi buo vyi; caw ca namaa tue, nama nangkhy ca lung buo va yi; re hrie ung cate thavie muo nama hmung raalaa pata chawkue tlaapa lieta nama pasuo.
Cungnungce Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: Nama awzya hing pacuo syalya tie ung.
Tluothlue luo khiy kie ung la thing kha kya la ung la i palung tluo'a te pa-uvsathyipa i cuo riypata ing kha sa tie ung, Abyipata a ta.

Nama huvpa ca a hluvsa, cuorasala nama hmungpa ca a cawta; ing luo nama vya chiykhyi tiyta i huv ta i hmung pathla diy. Cungnungce Abyipata, khaapanakawma a ta. Tahematapakieca niema bangkhuo ta nama ing sa namaa pahraa ning kha i ing ca a rakathluv nakawta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta avuo ta aduo patla sa khing li pata alyi ta kung a pavyi khing li pata a cuo.

Cakhutaata ruo cunglie hne tluothlue zaw cunglie, sa cunglie, mingsuvtiy thaapa cunglie hne chiytiy cunglie, alyi ta a pavyipa zaw cunglie, cawsaa hne sahring cunglie, hne nama kuv ta hrie ung cate a pyapa bangkhuo cunglie kha caavungna i patlung sa aa,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Shealtiel sacapaa Zerubbabel, Jehozadak sacapaa Joshua, tluobyi lepa, hne aa ngaapa cawsaa bangkhuo khata Abyipaama Khazing ta a ripa kha ama ziy; Abyipaama Khazing ta a pathliepa haa khata profet Haggai bie kha ziy yi te, cawsaa ta Khazing kha ama ciy.
Abyipabiephyatuv Haggai ta cawsaa zaw'a luo kha Abyipabie ca ri te, “Abyipana Kama na caa awpuo yi ang, a ta,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Abyipata Shealtiel sacapaa Zerubbabel, Judah uvtuv byi, hne Jehozadak sacapaa Joshua, tluobyi lepa, hne aa ngaapa cawsaa bangkhuo tie kha ama pathiypalung kha pathu sa te, a vaw yi te Cungnungce Abyipa, ama Khazing ing ca ama sa.
Capa ca thla caruv thlaa ning kiy ning paliy ning ta a cuo.
thla sariy thlaa, ning kiy ning khana lieta Abyipabie ca profet Haggai'a luo kha pha te, hing haa hingta a ri:
Shealtiel sacapaa Zerubbabel, Judah uvtuv byi, hne Jehozadak sacapaa Joshua, tluobyi lepa, hne aa ngaapa cawsaa bangkhuo tie'a lie kha ri tie,
Hluo ning a linghlaa a awsa ningta hingpa ing hing a zaa hmungpa pakha chuo namaa ngaa kalie ma? Ataning hing haw khaapama a lu? Nama hmungna lie khaapahmuo cuo vyi, cuo va ma?

Cuorasala ata hing ca, Vya Zerubbabel, na palung cahra se, Abyipana a ta; Vya Joshua, Jehozadak sacapaa, tluobyi lepa; na palung cahra se, ruo chunglieta cawsaa bangkhuo, hrie tie ung, Abyipata a ta; tahematapakieca kama na caa awpuo yi ang, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.
Izipt ruo chungtaata nama kya pya ningta niema'a lie i tuepa biekuona haa khata ica awpuo thluo yi. I thlaapa ca niema'a liena a aw, ciy khah ung.
Cungnungce Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: A ru hluota, kama ta alyi hne avuo hne riyliy hne alyi huvpa kha i cahang pakhaa aa,
cakhutaata mingphang bangkhuo kha cahang'a angte, mingphang bangkhuo ama suethiy kha a vaw diy'a te, hingpa ing hing rungnaana ta i pabi aa, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.
Siy ca kama huopa tana a cuo, ngu zaw kama huopa tana a cuo, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.
Hingpa ing ca hluo ning laa khata a rungnaa vie aa, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta; cakhutaata hingpa hmang lie hing kama ta hnyirungna i pi aa, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.
Darius siepahruo a cuona kung hningna, thla caky thlaa, ning kiy ning paliyna lieta Abyipabie ca profet Haggai'a luo kha pha te, hing haa hingta a ri:
Cungnungce Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Phungbie ca tluobyi tie kha hiehriy tie ung:

Cawsaa pakhakha ta pathe sapa saa kha a pangpe lie a cataw sala, a pangpe ca ta viechuo ma, saa pasu ciepa ma, mingsuvtiy ma, chiytiy ma, sa phangkhakha ma, kha a dekhu kieca, a pathepa ta a li va ma? Tluobyi tie ta palie yi te, “A li vyi,” ama ta.

Cakhutaata Haggai ta, “A thiypa riyy a taw nakawta a pathe lipa ta a cuopa pakha ta hingpa suokhakha hing a de khu kieca, capa ca a pathe lipa ta a li va ma?” a ta. Tluobyi tie ta palie yi te, “A cuo, a pathe lipa tana aa li,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Haggai ta, “Abyipana, Hingpa cawsaa tie hne i hmiekunglieta a awpa hingpa mingphang hne ama kuv ta ama hriepa re mekaa, hne iema ta ina pihluopa zaw hing pathe vyi, a ta,” a ta.
Cuorasala ataning taa hingta, khaapama a vya cuo aa tapa kha rue tie ung. Abyipabiena-ing chunglie alung suokha cunglie suokha nama pacang hluo kha tuokhaatama nama za aw?
Sa phya kiy papungna luo kha naa vaw tiyta, phya hraa dyi a za aw; mingsuv nena khue luo kha ungchuo sawngaa la riypata naa vaw tiyta, ungchuo suokiy dyi a za aw.
Niema hne nama rehriena taata a vyipa bangkhuo kha sa kung caana hne sakung thuvna hne a ri ta i desa diy; cuorasala kama'a luo kha vya kaa hlyi va ung ciy, Abyipata a ta.
Ataning taa hingta rue tie ung, thla caky thlaa ning kiy ning paliy taa hingta. Abyipabiena-ing a hruopatu ma pathla ning taa hingta rue tie ung.
Be chunglie sahang hang kha chuo aa ngaa ma? Mingsuv kung, thyikuv kung, cale kung, olif kung zaw a thyi pathyi valie. Ataning taa hing tana thluechiy ica pi'a yi.
Abyipabie ca Haggai'a luo kha thlaa ning kiy ning paliy ning ta a yihningna ta a pha pakhaa:
Judah uvtuv byi Zerubbabel kyihuo khata, alyi hne avuo kha cahang'a angte na,

pena tie byithude kha i pazu diy aa; mingphang zaw pena cahrana khana i para aa, aruole hne a khangtuv tie khana i pazupatlaa diy'a yi; aruo hne a khangtuv tie ca ama viesaa tie zueziy tana ama thiy aa.

Vya i changtaapa Zerubbabel, Shealtiel sacapaa, capa ning thue ca nama kha ca la'a angte, ming khenapa kuvpahryi haata ica tue aa, tahematapakieca nama ca kama na caa tlaw tli ang, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.
Darius siepahruo a cuona kung hning kung, thla cari thlaa lie kha Iddo sacapaa Berekhiah sacapaa Zekhariah'a luo kha Abyipabie a pha:
Abyipaca nama mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha a hi a haa hringhruo.
Caacuonakawta iema kyihuo khata, Cungnungce Abyipana a ri: Kama'a luo vya kaa tie ung, kama zaw niema'a luo na i vya kaa aa, Cungnungce Abyipana a ta.

Hluo ning profet tie ta, “Cungnungce Abyipana a ri, nama hringzya pha lipa hne nama tuepa pha lipa taa khata vya kaa tie ung,” ama za tapa nama mingchingmingvuo tie haa khata cuo khah ung. Iema ca i bie kha thyi va yi, na naathlie va yi, Abyipata a ta.
Nama mingchingmingvuo tie ca khaapaliema ama aw? Profet tie haw, chuozaa ta ama hring ma?

Cuorasala i changtaapa profet tie naw i pipa yi i bie hne i phungluo ta nama mingchingmingvuo tie hing a pha yi cuo va ma? Caacuonakawta a ngiepachiy yi te, “Cungnungce Abyipaca a ting ciepa haa khata ma hringzya hne ma tuena aa tlapa tana ma cunglie re a hrie,” ama ta.

Darius siepahruo a cuona kung hning kung, thla hraa hlyikha thlaa ta a cuopa Shebat thlaa ning kiy ning paliy ning kha Abyipabie ca Iddo sacapaa Berekhiah sacapaa profet Zekhariah'a luo kha a pha: Zekhariah ta,
Zuo ta muocuo chunglie kha aruo sepa a khangpa cawsaa pakha i hmung! Ama ca huekaw lie tlieseta kung hrawlie kha aa daa; a hnangkaa lie ca aruo sepa, aruo pyipa hne aruo ruopa zaw ama aw.
Cakhutaata, “Hingpa zaw hing tuokhaapa tama ama cuo, i byipaapa,” i ta. Kama hne bie a ripa avuoming ta, “Tuokhaapa tama ama cuo tapa kha ca chang lavuo ang,” ina ta.
Caacuonakawta tlieseta kung hrawlie a daapa paa khata na palie te, “Iema ca alyi cung bangkhuo a khie diy riypata Abyipata a pathliepa tana ama cuo,” ina ta.
Cakhutaata iema ca ta thingkungpa hrawlie a daapa Abyipaavuoming'a luo ca vaa yi te, “Alyi cung bangkhuo kha a khie pate, alyi ca diena hne tana a aw thluo,” ama ta.

Cakhutaata Abyipaavuoming ca ta, “Vya Cungnungce Abyipa, kung saw sariy chung ama cunglie na hi a haapa Jerusalem hne Judah khypuv tie hing khatiy te khiy ma ama cunglie kawpacuona hnyi li pata na aw aa?” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipata kama hneta bie a ripa avuoming'a lie kha vihnyina hne hnaapanguona bie a chang.
Caacuonakawta kama hne bie a ripa avuoming ca ta kama kyihuo khata, Hingpa bie hing pathyi sa tie: Cungnungce Abyipana a ri: Jerusalem hne Zion i hrakuona ca a le hringhruo.
Cakhutaata thaa duosa pata a aw thluopa mingphang zaw cunglie i hihaana a le hringhruo; tahematapakieca a cawta dyi i hi a haa ning kha, iema ta rana kha khuo vie ta ama tue.

Caacuonakawta, Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri, kama ca Jerusalem luo kha kawpacuona hneta i kaa aa; a chunglieta i ing kha sa pata cuo'a te, taanapa khuhriy ta Jerusalem ca taa pata a cuo aa, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.
Pathyi sa vie tie: Cungnungce Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: I khypuv zaw ca hnyirungna hneta ama bi pakhaa aa; Abyipata Zion kha hnaa panguo pakhaa'a te, Jerusalem kha aa tlaw pakhaa aa.
Cakhutaata i mangthaw ca saakiy suopaliy i hmung.

Kama hneta bie a ripa avuoming kha i hiehriy, “Hingpa zaw hing tuokhaapa tama ama cuo?” i ta. Ama ta, “Hingpa zaw hing saakiy ta cuo yi te, Judah, Israel, hne Jerusalem a chepatlaapa tana ama cuo,” ina ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipata susabuv suopaliy ina pahmung sa.

Kama ta, “Khaapa tue riypata ma amaa vaw? ta pata bie i hiehriy. Ama ta, “Iema tie hing ca ahungtahmuo ama luv ama calang khu li riypata Judah a chepatlaa diypa tie tana ama cuo; cuorasala a cawsaa zaw chepatlaa riypata Judah ruo a du yi te ama kiy a padaapa mingphang tie kiy kha tuv pathla diy riypata hne iema paciy sa riypata hingpa tie hing amaa vaw tli,” ina ta.
I mangthaw ca a kuv lie taanapa khuhriy a hriepa cawsaa pakha i hmung.
Cakhutaata, “Khaaluoma na cakuo?” ta pata bie i hiehriy. Ama ta na palie te, “Jerusalem kha a kuna hne a syina khazaa tama a cuo tapa taa riypa tana i cuo,” ina ta.
Cakhutaata kama hneta bie a rihnepa avuoming ca hmieluo kha tungle te a hrangpa avuoming pakha kha ama a taw riypata hmieluo a vya pya; ama kyihuo khata,
“A ruo la, huepa satliepa hue va chang tie: Jerusalem ca a chunglie cawsaa hne saruopa ama hluvsa nakawta dungkhuo a hnyi lipa khyta haa kha tana ama aw aa.
Tahematapakieca Abyipana kama ama a cadungpa myi dungkhuo ta cuo'a angte, a chunglie a rungnaana tana i cuo aa,” a ta.
Thu tie ung, thu tie ung! Chaluo ruo taa khata a ruo tie ung, Abyipata a ta; tahematapakieca kama na avuo lie thliy suopaliy tie haa khiy ta caa zepatlaa tli yi ang, Abyipata a ta.
Thu tie ung! Niema Babilon sacanung hneta a awpa tie, Zion luo kha a ruo tie ung.

Tahematapakieca Cungnungce Abyipana nama caa chingpa mingphang tie hne aa patuv pata hing haa hingta a ri (kama'a luo a rungnaana ina pi khutaata): Hmisi tana ica chang, niema caa tawpa tie ca kama mingpavaata naa tawpa tana ama cuo.
Mang tie ung, iema a du riypata i buo kha caba'a angte iema ca ama sii zaw cuo khata hruosue ta ama cuo aa. Cakhutaa cata Cungnungce Abyipana naa pathlie tapa kha nama pachang aa.
Hlaa sa la na palung tluo se, Vya sacanung Zion! Tahematapakieca a vaw'a angte na nama hrawlie i aw aa, Abyipata a ta.

Capa ning lie ca mingphang hluvpuv ca Abyipa'a luo kha a vaw'a yi te, kama cawsaa ta cuo'a yi te kama zaw niema hrawlie kha i aw aa. Cakhutaata Cungnungce Abyipa na naa pathlie tapa kha nama pachang aa.
Abyipa ta a ruo pathepa lie kha Judah ca ru ta a la'a te, Jerusalem kha aa tlaw pakhaa aa.
Abyipahmiekunglie kha cawsaa bangkhuo ta a dieta tah aw tie ung; tahematapakieca ama ca a pathepa a awna hmang taa kha tana aa daa tli.
Cakhutaata Abyipaavuoming hmiekunglieta tluobyi lepa Joshua aa daapa kha cuose, Setaa ca ama suebe riypata a cacuoluo kuo ta aa daapa kha cuose i hmung.
Abyipata Setaa kyihuo khata, “Vya Setaa, Abyipana caa chuo! Jerusalem a tlawpa Abyipana caa chuo! Hingpa paa hing myi chungtaata a dapa thingthuv ta cuo va ma?” a ta.
Joshua ca avuoming hmiekunglie aa daa ning kha caw pyapa kha aa hryi.
Avuoming khata a hmiekunglie a daapa tie kyihuo khata, “A caw pyapa kha thliepa tie ung,” a ta. Ama kyihuo khata, “Mang tie, na suena kha nama'a taata la angte, caw phapa kha ica pahryi aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata kama ta, “Iema ta a luv lie kha pawde papaw yi se,” i ta. Caacuonakawta a luv lie kha pawde papaw yi te, caw phapa ama pahryi, Abyipaavuoming ca aa thaalie kha aa daa.
Cakhutaata Abyipaavuoming ta Joshua'a lie kha a cusa pata bie a taa,

“Cungnungce Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: I luopuv kha ziy cate, ica changpa hing na tue kieca, i ing hing uv'a cate, i bieripana lie hing naw na hnyi aa, cakhutaata hingpa lie a daapa tie hrawlie hing a ngiena hne pyana naw na hnyi aa.
Naathlie tie, Joshua, tluobyi lepa, nama hne na hmiekunglie a tupa viesaa tie hne khata! Tahematapakieca hingpa tie hing a vaw riypa pamangsana tana ama cuo: I changtaapa Thingce khana i vawkhyi aa.
Joshua hmiekunglie i chipa alung, lung kha lie hmie sariy a hnyipa lie khana khe'a angte i cape aa, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta, cakhutaata hingpa ruo a suena hing ning kha chunglieta i thawpa diy aa.
Capa ning lie ca niema pakha hne pakha kha nama mingsuv kung rawlie hne nama thyikuv kung rawlieta a vaw riypata namaa hry aa, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.”
Kama hneta bie a ripa avuoming kha a vaw pakhaa te, cawsaa pakha aa hmungna taata ama pachapa haa khata ina pacha.

Ama ta, “Khaapama na hmung?” ina ta. Kama ta, “Siy selaw ta tuepa myi-ingtung suokha na i hmung; capa cunglie ca a kuotung suokha a aw; capa a kuotung cunglie ca a tung suosariy hne a tung dawlie ta myi-ing suosariy kaluo ama aw.
Myi-ingtung athaalie kha a cavyi a cacuo ta olif kung suohning a aw,” i ta.
I thaalie ta aw te kama hne bie a rihnepa avuoming kyihuo cata, “Hingpa tie hing khaapatama ama cuo, i byipaapa?” i ta.
Cakhutaata kama hneta bie a rihnepa avuoming cata, “Hingpa tie hing khaapatama a cuo tapa pachang va ca ma?” ina ta. Kama ta, “Pachang va ang, i byipaapa,” i ta.

Ama ta kama kyihuo khata, “Zerubbabel'a luo a phapa Abyipabie tana a cuo: rieka cahrana ta cuo'a vyi, nama cahrana ta zaw cuo'a vyi, cuorasala kama thlaapa thueta na na hlue a tling aa, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.
Vya tluolepa, khaapatama na cuo? Zerubbabel hmiekunglie ca ase tana naa li aa; cakhutaata ama ta, ‘Vihnyina, vihnyina!’ ta pata ama khina hrawlie kha biena-ing a daw ce alung kha a ne aa.”
Ca hlyitaw taata Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha vya pha te,
“Zerubbabel na hingpa ing hruopatu hing a bang tli; ama kuv tana a palang aa. Cakhutaata Cungnungce Abyipata ina pathliepa kha nama pachang aa.

Tahematapakieca ahung a cuo zaw re a cawta dyi palangna lieta a palung a yi lipa ca Zerubbabel ta biena-ing a sa nguoluo thluopa kha a hmung tiyta a palung a tluo aa. “Hingpa suosariy tie hing chuelyi ting ta a khiepa Abyipaming suosariy tana ama cuo,” ina ta.
Cakhutaata kama ta, “Myi-ingtung cavyi cacuo lie olif kung tie hing haw tuokhaapa tama ama cuo?” i ta.
Cakhutaata hiehriy pakhaa angte, “Olif thu a langpathlanapa siy tiysaw suohning tie athaalie a awpa olif ce suohning tie hing haw tuokhaapa tama ama cuo?” i ta.
Ama ta kama kyihuo khata, “Hingpa tie hing tuokhaapa tama ama cuo tapa pachang va ca ma?” ina ta. Kama ta, “Pachang va ang, i byipaapa,” i ta.
Cakhutaata ama ta, “Hingpa tie hing ca alyi cung yalya Abyipa ta a cuopa athaalie a daapa sathu pathuvpa pahning tana ama cuo,” ina ta.
Cungluo kha i mang ca aa zulepa caataw suokha i hmung.
Cakhutaata ama ta, “Khaapama na hmung?” ina ta. Kama ta palie angte, “Aa zulepa caataw suokha, a syina daw kiy, a kuna daw hraa a tapa na i hmung,” i ta.

Cakhutaata ama ta kama kyihuo khata, “Ruo ting luo a chiy diypa chiesana tana a cuo, aparuvpa mekaa kha kuokhaluo aa capepa haa khata pahli diy pata cuo'a yi te, a hanghie pata chie a sapa mekaa ca a hrangpa kuokhaluo aa capepa haa khata pahli diy pata ama cuo aa,” ina ta.

Cungnungce Abyipata, Kama ta pathlie tli angte, aparuvpa tie hne hanghie pata i ming ta chie a sapa tie ing chung luo kha a ngie'a te, capa ing chunglie ca aw'a te a thing hne aa lung zaw hne khata a para diy'a yi,” ina ta.
Cakhutaata kama hneta bie a rihnepa avuoming kha hmieluo vya pya te kama kyihuo khata, “A vya pyapa khiy khaapatama a cuo tapa kha mang tie,” ina ta.
Kama ta, “Tuokhaapa tama a cuo?” i ta. Ama ta, “Beke suokha na a vya pya,” ina ta. Cakhutaata, “Hingpa hing ruo ting lie ama suena tana a cuo,” ina ta.
Cakhutaata kawthuv ta tuepa a pahruv kha ama caba ca beke chunglie canung pakha aa tupa kha i hmung!
Cakhutaata ama ta, “Hingpa hing ca pha lina tana a cuo,” ina ta. Caacuonakawta beke chunglie kha va nuopuo te a kawthuv pahruv kha beke pakaa luo a pathla.
I mangthaw ca canung pahning kha hmieluo ama vya pya. Iema ca aathlaruo mathlaa haapa kha hnyi yi te ama mathlaa lie kha thliy a aw; iema ca ta beke ca alyi hne avuo alala luo kha ama caba.
Cakhutaata kama hne bie a rihnepa avuoming kyihuo khata, “Beke ca khaapa luo ma ama sikhyi aa?” i ta.
Ama ta, “Ama cuota ing sapa riypa tana Shinar ruo luo ama sikhyi; ama palang tiyta beke kha a raw luo a thude cunglie kha ama patu aa,” ina ta.
Cakhutaata i mangthaw ca tluo suohning alala taata aruole suopaliy a vya pyapa kha i hmung, tluo ca daa ta sapa tluo ta a cuo.
Aruole suokhana ca aruo sepa ta aa da, aruole suohningna ca aruo vawpa ta aa da,
aruole suothungna ca aruo ruopa ta a da te, aruole suopaliyna ca aruo pyipa ta aa da.
Kama hneta bie a rihnepa avuoming kyihuo khata, “Hingpa tie hing tuokhaapa tama ama cuo, i byipaapa? i ta.
Avuoming ta kama kha na palie te, “Alyi cung yalya uvtuv Abyipahmiekung luo ama vaa luo khutaata a pyalepa avuo thliy suopaliy tie tana ama cuo.
Aruo vawpa ta aa dapa aruole ca chaluo ruo luo kha a si, a ruo ruopa ta aa dapa aruole ca ningtla ruo luo kha si te, aruo pyipa ta aa dapa aruole ca sungluo ruo luo kha a si,” ina ta.

Rietuvna aruo tie ca ama kya pya tiyta, alyi cung yalya ta a khie diy riypa kha a ngietie va yi. Cakhutaata ama ta, “Cakuo ung la alyi cung kha va cahraw tie ung,” a ta. Caacuonakawta alyi cung yalya khata amaa khie.
Cakhutaata avuoming ca ta kama kha na u te, “Chaluo ruo luo a sipa tie na i thlaapa kha chaluo ruo chunglie a pading sa yi,” ina ta.
Abyipabie kha kama'a luo a vaw te:
Sii ta sikhyi pata cuo yi te Babilon taata a vya kaa pakhaapa Heldai, Tobijah, hne Jedaiah tie'a taa khata siy hne ngu kha pakhaw tie; capa ning lie ca ta Zefaniah sacapaa Josiah luo kha cakuo tie.
Siy hne ngu kha la lah byilakhuv kha tue tie, cakhutaata Jehozadak sacapaa tluobyi lepa Joshua luv lie kha pakhuv tie.

Ama kyihuo khata, “Cungnungce Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Cawsaa pakha, a ming ta Thingce ama tapa na hingpa lie hing a aw: tahematapakieca a awna lie kha a ce kya ka'a te Abyipabiena-ing kha a sa aa.

Abyipabiena-ing a sa riypa ca ama tana a cuo aa; siepahruo rungnaana kha cu'a te, a byithude lie kha a tu'a te ruo kha a uv aa. A byithude athaalie kha tluobyi tie a tu'a yi te, amaa lalalieta diena hne a thyithena a aw aa.
Byilakhuv ca Abyipabiena-ing lie pachang parina cuo riypata Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah, hne Zefaniah sacapaa Josiah tie mangchiyna rawlie kha a aw aa.

Luohlaa luo a awpa tie zaw khata a vaw'a yi te Abyipabiena-ing sa riypa kha amaa vya bya aa; cakhutaata Cungnungce Abyipata ina pathliepa kha nama pachang aa. Niema ta Abyipanama Khazing bie kha a phasa pata nama ziy kieca hingpa zaw hing a vya cuo aa.
Darius siepahruo a cuona kung paliy kung, Khislev thlaa tapa thla caky thlaa, ning paliy ning ta Abyipabie ca Zekhariah'a luo kha a pha.
Bethel cawsaa tie ta Sharezer hne Regem-melekh hne ama cawsaa tie kha Abyipapaakie riypata ama pathlie.
Cungnungce Abyipaing chunglie a awpa tluobyi tie hne profet tie kha, “Kung hluvpuv i za tue tlipa haa khata ma, thla pangaa thlaa lie hing caa'a angte sa i uv aa?” ta pata hiehriy riypata a cuo.
Cakhutaata Cungnungce Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha a vaw te:

Ruo chunglie cawsaa bangkhuo hne tluobyi tie kyihuo khata: Hingpa kung sawsariy chung, thla pangaa thlaa hne thla sariy thlaa lie sa a uv ung cate nama caa tawpa hing kama cuota nama tuepa ta a cuo ma?
Nama ning tiyta hne nama dang tiyta, niema cuo dyi tana nama ning nama dang cuo va ma?

Jerusalem lie cawsaa a hluvsa khy za sa yi te ama za hnyirung ning, a cahriy khy tie zaw cahaacata za cuo yi te, Negeb hne Shefelah lie zaw cahaacata a za cuo ningta Abyipata hluo ning profet tie'a taata a za pathyisapa ca hingpa hingta cuo va ma?
Abyipabie ca Zekhariah'a luo kha a vaw te:
Cungnungce Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri:
Nunghlyi, haaraa, ruohrang ming, siypasa tapa kha hrisaa khah ung; pakha hne pakha kha a raw khah ung.
Cuorasala naathlie khing va yi, palunglesa pata hnang amaa chaw, ama thyi li riypata ama naa amaa paping.

Hluo ning profet tie'a taata Cungnungce Abyipathlaapa ta a za pathliepa phungbie hne a bie zaw kha ama thyi li riypata iema ta ama pathiypalung kha a cuosapa alung haata amaa pacuo sa. Caacuonakawta Cungnungce Abyipa'a taata a lepa hihaana ca aa vaw.
I ku tiy yi ta ama thyi li'apa haa khata ina u tiy yi ta zaw thyi ra'a va yi ang, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.

Caacuonakawta ama pachang buo lipa mingphang tie hraw luo kha i thliysung ta i pazupatlaa diy'a yi. Cahaacata ama thusepa ruo ca duothling'a te, a sibung a sithawpa ahunghmuo aw'a va yi, aa nuosapa ruo ca a duothling aa.
Cungnungce Abyipabie ca kama'a luo a vaw te:
Cungnungce Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Zion ca hietliena lepuv hneta khuosa ta i hrakuo, i hrakuo tuvnapa tana i hi a haa hringhruo.

Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Zion luo kha vya kaa'a angte, Jerusalem lie kha i aw aa; Jerusalem ca zang tluo aa tlapa khypuv ta pata kupa cuo'a te, Cungnungce Abyipatluo ca a pathepa tluo ta pata kupa a cuo aa.
Cungnungce Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Nungpuv macuo tie ca Jerusalem luopuv lie kha a tu pakhaa'a yi te, ama kung a hluvsa tli nakawta ama kuv lie kha khuecahryi amaa cyi aa.
Cakhutaata khypuv luopuv zaw chunglie kha capaa haatiy hne canung haatiy zaw ama bi aa.

Cungnungce Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Hingpa hing aa ngaapa hingpa cawsaa tie cuo hingta a cuo khu li riypa hmuo lu ra sala, kama cuo zaw ta a cuo khu li riypa ma a lu ra aa? Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.
Cungnungce Abyipata hing haa hingta a ri: I cawsaa zaw hing ningchiy ruo taata hne ningtla ruo taata khuo'a yi angte,
Jerusalem lie aw riypata i sikhyi'a yi. Zang tluo a tlana hne adangna chunglie kha iema ca i cawsaa ta cuo'a yi te, kama ca iema Khazing ta i cuo aa.

Cungnungce Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Cungnungce Abyipaing, biena-ing sa pakhaa riypata a hruopatu pathla ningta zaa awpa profet tie pakaa taata ama za ripa hingpa bie hing ata lieta a thyipa niema ca nama kuv cahra se.

Tahematapakieca capa cuo hluota ca cawsaa thavie muo hne sahring a hluona muo za aw vyi, carie a aw nakawta capa lieta a sibung a sithawpa zaw cuota abangna aw vyi, kama ta pakha hne pakha kha i padu sa yi.
Cuorasala hingpa aa ngaapa cawsaa tie hing ca a hluo ning haa khata tue'a va yi ang, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.
Thlaalungna hneta saciy ama cyi aa; mingsuv kung ta a thyi pathyi'a te, alyi ta kung a pavyi aa; avuo ta aduo patla sa'a te, hingpa zaw bangkhuo hing aa ngaapa cawsaa tie kha i pi'a yi.

Vya Judah ingchungkhue hne Israel ingchungkhue zaw, niema ca mingphang zaw hrawlieta chiesapa nama za cuopa haa khata, kama ta niema kha ca khuo'a yi angte thluechiy ica pi'a yi. Ciy khah ung, cuorasala nama kuv kha cahra se.
Cungnungce Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Nama mingchingmingvuo tie ta i hi ina za pahaa ning yi ta, nama cunglie rana patlung sa i ting ning kha thlachie za rue va ang, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.
Caacuonakawta ata cuo lie hing Jerusalem hne Judah ingchungkhue cuota phana tue kha a ting pakhaa angte, ciy khah ung.
Hingpa tie hing nama tue riypata a cuo aa: Pakha hne pakha kha biehmisipa ta a chaw tie ung, khypuv hukaa bieripana lie kha aa dang pata bie chi ung la diena tue tie ung.
Pakha hne pakha kha nama pathiypalung chunglieta i-aw a hnyi khah ung, hanghie pata bie a kuo khah ung; tahematapakieca hingpa zaw bangkhuo hing kama ta i huepa tana ama cuo, Abyipata a ta.
Cungnungce Abyipabie ca kama'a luo kha a vaw te:

Cungnungce Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Thla paliy thlaa sa-uvna, thla pangaa thlaa sa-uvna, thla sariy thlaa sa-uvna, hne thla hraa thlaa sa-uvna tie ca palungtluona hne alawna ningcuo ta cuo'a te, Judah ingchungkhue cuota a law thaaphana pyi tana ama cuo aa: caacuonakawta biehmisipa hne diena kha khing tie ung.
Cungnungce Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Khypuv hluvsa lie khy a sapa tie cawsaa zaw kha amaa vaw aa;
khypuv suokha lie a awpa tie kha a hrangpa khypuv suokha luo kha vaa'a yi te, “A vaw tie ung, Abyipakhingna huv riypata hne Cungnungce Abyipahuv riypata si ung siy; kama zaw i si ra aa,” amaa ta aa.
Cawsaa hluvsa hne a cahrasapa mingphang zaw kha Cungnungce Abyipahuv riypata Jerusalem luo a vaw'a yi te, Abyipakhingna kha ama huv aa.

Cungnungce Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri: Capa cuo lie ca ryi phangting a hmuopa mingphang zaw chungtaata cawsaa pahraa ca Judah ming pakha kha a pang ta patuv'a yi te, “Nama'a lieta cakuo ra thi'a puv, tahematapakieca Khazing ca nama'a lie na a aw tapa tana ma thyi,” ama ta aa.
Profetbiephu. Abyipabie ca Hadrak ruo kha a du te, Damaskas cunglie a tlung aa. Tahematapakieca Israel phang bangkhuo a hnyipa haa yi khata, Assiria khypuv ca Abyipana a hnyi.
Ruoriy lie a awpa Hamath zaw kha ama na a hnyi, Tair hne Sidon zaw kha, ama singsa thluo raalaa pa khata ama na a hnyi.
Tair ca amata tah khypuv dungkhuo kha a sa te, alyi diypa zaa ta ngu kha a papung, siy zaw kha luopuv lie caakaw zaa ta a papung.
Cuorasala Abyipa ta a hnyipa bangkhuo kha lapa diy'a te, a hnyirungna kha riyliy luo a pazu diy aa, cakhutaata ama kha myi ta a kuo aa.

Ashkelon ta ama kha hmung'a te a ciy aa; Gaza zaw ta hmung'a te, aa cathangsa aa. Ekron zaw ta hmung ra'a te, aa nguopuona kha a vie aa. Gaza siepahruo kha a thiy aa; Ashkelon lie kha ahunghmuo khy a sapa aw'a va yi.
Ashdod lie ca kaapie tie kha aw'a yi te, Filistin hruotlena kha i pachuo sa aa.

A pakaa taata a thiy kha thaw'a angte, a haa zaw alalalieta duvsamakhiepa kha i thaw aa. Iema chungtaata aa ngaapa tie ca Khazing huopa ta cuo'a yi te, Judah ming phang kha haa khata ama cuo aa; cakhutaata Ekron ca Jebus ming haa khata a cuo aa.
Ahunghmuo ama sibungsithaw li riypata, i ing lie kha aw'a angte rie i ve aa. Tahematapakieca ata hing ca i ming ta i hmung nakaw yi khata, a hrisaapa tie ta chaapuo'a va tli yi.

Vya sacanung Zion, khuosa ta na palung tluo se! Vya sacanung Jerusalem, khuosa ta khi tie! Na siepahruo na nama'a luo a vaw; ama ca tetuv ta cuo te tena ca ama huopa tana a cuo, rawcanaw cangta laa kha aa khang, laataata a khang te na aa vaw.

Efraim taata aruole kha pahli diy'a te, Jerusalem taata rietuvna aruo kha a pahli diy aa; rietuvnapa liy kha chipachung'a te, mingphang diena riypata naw a pi aa; a uvnapa ca riyliy taata riyliy te a pha aa, Cavaa taata alyi dena te ta a cuo aa.
Nama cuo ta ca, nama hneta i biekuona thiyse thue khata, thaw a tlapa na cawsaa tie kha tiy aw linapa khue chung taa khata i pathlie'a yi.
Vya nguopuona cangta thaw a tlapa tie, nama cariekyikuo luo kha kaa tie ung; le hning tana ica pi pakhaa'a yi tapa tana ataning hing i pathyi sa.
Tahematapakieca Judah kha i liy haata a da tli angte, Efraim kha a cuoti ta i tue tli. Vya Zion, na sacapaa zaw kha Grik ming a du riypata pathu'a yi angte, nama kha rieka zueziy haata ica hmuo aa.
Cakhutaata Abyipakha iema cunglie a luo'a te, a cuoti ca thinghlaa haata aa zu aa. Abyipa Khazingta hmyakaa tung'a te, sungluo thliysung chunglie kha a si aa.

Cungnungce Abyipata iema kha khuo'a yi te, iema ta ama carie kha te'a yi te, pahiepa cisie ta ama siepa alung kha ama chaale aa. Iema ta ama thiy ca mingsuvtiy haa khata dang'a yi te, kuotung haa khata ama bi aa, bienatluophie a kiy lie haa khata ama pacing aa.
Capa ning lie ca Abyipaama Khazing ta iema kha a khuo'a yi, tahematapakieca iema ca a cawsaa hne a tuvrung tana ama cuo; a muo sungnaapa suethiy byilakhuv haa khata, a ruo cunglie kha ama khe aa.
Ama huopa ca kha tluv ta pha te ma, kha tluv ta a puvthe! Sa ta satlie tie thaazuo kha cahra sa'a te, mingsuvtiy thaapa ta lesaa tie kha thaazuo a pahnyi sa'a yi.

Cuovuo khytiy kha Abyipa'a lieta hie tie ung, amyi hne khysuv a tuetuv Abyipakha hie tie ung; ama ca niema'a luo khy a pasaasapa hne, lu lieta uohnaasiyyhnaa zaw cawsaa mekaa'a luo a pituv tana a cuo.

Ingchungkhue khazing ta ca a cuo lipa kha ri te, hmungdawlutuv tie ta hang pata ama hmung, muo a sa thepa tie ta aa hmuo lipa muo kha sa yi te, a hrihripa hnaapanguona kha ama pi. Caacuonakawta cawsaa ca tuv haata vie yi te, tuvkhietuv a aw li nakawta ruvnaana amaa taw.
Tuvkhietuv tie cunglie kha i hi haa te, luochiytuv tie kha duo i te'a yi; tahematapakieca Cungnungce Abyipaca a tuvrung, Judah ingchungkhue kha a due, aa palesakhyipa rietuvna aruo tana a tue'a yi.

Iema chung taa hingta ingkiylung pya'a yi te, iema chung taa hingta thluodaa hrena thingkhe ama pya aa, iema chung taa hingta rietuvna liy pya'a yi te, uvtuv byi bangkhuo ca iema chung taa hing tana ama pya aa.

Iema ca rietuvna lie rieka haa khata cuo'a yi te, luopuv caakaw lie kha ama carie tie ca ama chaapuole aa. Rie tuv'a yi te aruo rieka tie kha nangzaa pata ama chi aa, tahematapakieca Abyipana a awpuo yi.

Judah ingchungkhue kha thaa patlung'a angte, Josef ingchungkhue kha i khuo aa. Kama ta kaw i pacuo nakaw yi ta vya kaakhyi pakhaa'a yi angte, kama ta i za thaw buo lipa haa khata ama cuo aa; tahematapakieca kama ca Abyipaiema Khazing ta cuo angte, ama thlaachuona kha i palie'a yi.

Cakhutaata Efraim cawsaa tie ca rieka haata cuo'a yi te, ama pathiypalung ca mingsuvtiy a dangpa aa lawpa haata ama cuo aa. Ama saata zaw ta capa ca hmung'a yi te ama palung a tluo aa, ama pathiypalung ca Abyipa'a lie kha aa law aa.
Iema cuota pachangsana tue'a yi angte i pahmya'a yi, tahematapakieca iema ca i khuo tli yi, a hluo ning haa khata ama pungzaa pakhaa aa.
Mingphang zaw hrawlie kha i cadaapatlaa raalaa pa yi ta, ruo luohlaapuv lie zaw kha na pachang ngiethie'a yi te, ama saata kha mangsang'a yi te ama vya kaa aa.
Izipt ruo taa khata ing luo sikhyi'a yi angte, Assiria ruo taa khata i pahmya'a yi. Iema kha Gilead ruo luo hne Lebanon ruo luo kha i sikhyi'a yi, ama cuo ta awna aa tlaw lina te khata.

Ruvnaana riyliy kha cahrawle pata si'a yi te, riyliy tiylaw zaw ca i tuv'a yi, aa thuvpa Nail cavaa tiy kha ama ky diy aa. Assiria hruotlena ca pachung pata cuo'a te, Izipt uvna thaa sungpe ca thaw pata a cuo aa.
Kama ta Israel ming ca Abyipachunglie cahra sa'a yi angte, iema ca a ming ciyzaana hne a phungbie ziyna cangta ama hring aa, Abyipata a ta.
Vya Lebanon, na sidar thing kha myi ta a kuo the riypata na ingchiypakaa kha pahaw tie!
Vya atuv myisaa kung, sidar kung ca aa lie tli, a rungnaapa thingkung zaw ca ama ra tli!
Tuvkhietuv tie ama caana ueryi ca naathlie tie, tahematapakieca Jordan ruohraw ca para pata na a cuo tli!
Abyipai Khazing na hing haa hingta a ri: Thie riypata chipa tuvrung a khietuv haa khata aw tie.

A calyipa tie ta thie'a yi te duotena ang'a va yi; cakhutaata a zaapa tie ta, “Abyipaca pathuosa pata cuo mang sue, tahematapakieca kama ca i hnyirung tli,” ama ta aa; iema a khietuv khata ama cunglie kawpacuona hnyi'a va yi.

Tahematapakieca alyi cunglie khy a sapa tie cunglie hing kawpacuona hnyi'a va ang, Abyipata a ta. Ama mekaa khata ama ingpaa kuv chung luo cuose, siepahruo kuv chung luo cuose, patla sa'a yi angte, iema kuv taa khata pakha hmuo khuo'a va yi ang.

Caacuonakawta tuv ta sung a palipa cuo cuopa khata kama ca thie riypa tuv zaw a khietuv ta i li. Khuecahryi suohning kha i la; suokha kha Tlechuona, i ta, a hrangpa suokha kha Pangkhacuona ta angte tuv kha i khie.
Thla kha chunglieta tuvkhietuv pathung ca ama re i phie yi, tahematapakieca iema cunglie kha i palung tling khu va tli, iema zaw ta ina huesa yi.

Caacuonakawta kama ta, “Nama tuvkhietuv ta cuo'a va ang. A thiy riypa ca thiy thluo se; para riypata a cuopa ca para pata cuo thluo se; pangaapa ta a cuopa tie ca sakha hne sakha kha a ning thluo yi se!” i ta.
I khuecahryi Tlechuona kha la angte i thlipachung, cawsaa bangkhuo hneta i tuepa biekuona kha i para.
Caacuonakawta biekuona ca capa ning lie ca para pata cuo te, kama naa huo nguoluopa tuv ta sung a palipa tie ta capa ca Abyipabie a cuopa kha ama pachang.

Cakhutaata kama ta iema kyihuo khata, “Aa chaw thluo nama ta kieca, i hmung riypa kha na pi tie ung; cuorasala a chaw vyi nama ta kieca niema ta a chi thluo tie ung,” i ta yi. Caacuonakawta i hmung riypa ngu tuokaa shekel sawthung kha ina pi yi.

Cakhutaata Abyipata kama kyihuo khata, “Suethiy ing luo kha thaw tie,” ina ta. Iema ta hingpa zaa hingta i muo kha ina thli yi. Caacuonakawta ngu tuokaa shekel sawthung kha la angte, Abyipaing chunglie suethiy ing luo kha i thaw.
Cakhutaa cata i khuecahryi suohningna Pangkhacuona kha thlipachung angte Judah hne Israel alalalie chungkhue a pazuena kha i para.
Cakhutaata Abyipata kama kyihuo khata: Thlahnena a hnyi lipa tuvkhietuv haa khata a tue pakhaa tie.

Tahematapakieca ruo chunglie hing a rapa tie kha siysaa a ri lipa, a viepa kha a huv lipa, tuvkhietuv pakha padaa'a angte, a kuv a phyi a tlipa kha a patluo sa lipa, a tluopa tie zaw kha sa a pi lipa, cuorasala a thupa tie saa kha ce te ama caki te a khawpa tuvkhietuv kha i padaa aa.
Vya thlahnena a hnyi lipa kama tuvkhietuv, tuvrung a ruosepa! Zueziy ta a buo kha sa pachung sala a ming kha dawchi se! A buo ca caa sala a cacuoluo ming ca cue se!
Profetbiephu. Israel hne aa patuv pata Abyipabie ca: Abyipana hing haa hingta a ri, ama ca avuo khiy pake te alyi a sapa hne cawsaa chunglie thlaapa a sapa tana a cuo.
Jerusalem ca a cahriycake lie a awpa cawsaa tie ta ama pariypa panuo tana i tue aa; Jerusalem ama cadung ning kha Judah zaw ama cadungpuo aa.

Capa ning lie ca Jerusalem kha cawsaa bangkhuo cuota alung aa riysapa ta i tue aa; a calangpa bangkhuo ca iema hne iema kha khuosa ta hmaa amaa paphya aa. Cakhutaata alyi lie mingphang bangkhuo ta ama kha a du pakhaw riypata amaa vaw aa.

Abyipata, capa ning lie ca kama ta aruo mekaa kha pahlu sa'a angte, a khangpa mekaa kha i pangaa sa'a yi. Cuorasala cawsaa mekaa aruo zaw ming i pacue ning kha Judah ingchungkhue cunglie ca a mangchiypa ming na i chi aa.
Cakhutaata Judah phang tie ca iema hne iema kha, “Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie ca ama Khazing, Cungnungce Abyipa'a taa tana cahrana ama hmung,” amaa ta aa.

Capa ning lie ca kama ta Judah phang tie kha myiphya lie myipung haa khata tue'a yi angte, sacuo kung a kuopa myihlaa haata i tue'a yi; iema ta cavyi cacuo ta a cadungpa cawsaa tie kha kuo diy'a yi te, Jerusalem ca ama'a na a hmang lie, Jerusalem khypuv hlungpa lie kha sa pakhaa pata a cuo aa.
Abyipata Judah thluodaa kha tena pi taa'a te, David ingchungkhue rungnaana hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie rungnaana ta Judah rungnaana kha law khu'a vyi.

Capa ning lie ca Abyipata Jerusalem lie a awpa tie kha aa phya ta pakhuo'a yi te iema hrawlie a thaa naa cepa ca David haa khata cuo'a te, David ingchungkhue ca Khazing haa khata ama cuo aa, ama hmie luo ta a sipa Abyipaavuoming haa khata ama cuo aa.
Capa ning lieta Jerusalem a du riypata a vawpa mingphang bangkhuo ca kama ta i para diy'a yi.

David ingchungkhue hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie cunglie kha kawpacuona hne malie ngiechina thlaapa kha bya'a yi angte, caacuonakawta, iema ta ina dawpahlipa yi kama kha ina mang tiy yi ta, cawsaa pakha ta saata pakha dyipa a caapa haata hne ama sa uvthyi ama caapa haa khata khuosa ta ina caa'a yi.
Capa ning lie ca Jerusalem lieta caana ca Megiddo ase ruo chung, Hadad-rimmon lie khuosa ta ama caapa haa khata a cuo aa.

Ruo ca a caa aa, ingchungkhue cyicuo ca iema'a na ama ingchungkhue cyicuo lie kha ama caa aa; David ingchungkhue ca ama'a na a ingchungkhue lie kha caa'a yi te, ama napuv zaw kha iema cyicuo ta ama caa kaluo aa; Nathan ingchungkhue ca ama'a na a ingchungkhue lie kha caa'a yi te, ama napuv zaw kha iema cyicuo ta ama caa kaluo aa;

Levi ingchungkhue ca ama'a na a ingchungkhue lie kha caa'a yi te, ama napuv zaw kha iema cyicuo ta ama caa kaluo aa; Shimei ingchungkhue ca ama'a na a ingchungkhue lie kha caa'a yi te, ama napuv zaw kha iema cyicuo ta ama caa kaluo aa;
cakhutaata aa ngaapa ingchungkhue bangkhuo zaw iema'a na ama ingchungkhue cyicuo lie kha caa'a yi te, ama napuv zaw kha iema cyicuo ta ama caa kaluo aa.
Capa ning lie ca David ingchungkhue hne Jerusalem lie khy a sapa tie kha ama suena hne ama pyalyina taata pathe sa riypata acaatiy suokha a pya aa.
Cungnungce Abyipata, capa ning lie ca kuvtuezuv ming kha ruo chungtaata pahli'a angte a thyi pata cuo'a va tli; profet tie hne a pathe lipa thlaapa tie zaw kha ruo chungtaata i pahli aa.

A vya pya pakhaapa profet a aw kieca ama a sapa a nung hne a paa ta, “Nama ca Abyipaming ta hangbie na ri nakawta hring'a vaciy,” ta'a yi te, iema a sapa ama nung hne ama paa khata profetbiephu ama ri ning kha ama dawsa aa.
Capa ning lie ca profet mekaa ca profetbiephu ama ri tiyta ama muocuo kha ama nang zaakhyi'a te, malie kha dung riypata saahming buohryi pasiypa zaw kha a hryi'a va yi.
Cuorasala iema pakha cyicuo khata, “Kama ca profet ta cuo va ang, lu a thlupa tana i cuo; tahematapakieca i cawta baataata alyi hingna i riy a cawnapa ta a cuo,” ama ta aa.
Cakhutaata pakhakha ta iema kha, “Na cacunghnaa lie hmaa hing tuokhaapa tama a cuo?” ta pata ama hiehriy tiyta, a palienapa ca, “I viesaa tie ing lieta i hmungpa hmaa tana ama cuo,” a ta aa.

“Vya zueziy, thu la i tuvkhietuv tie hing a du tie yi, i re hrie hnepa tie hing a du tie yi,” Cungnungce Abyipata a ta. Tuvkhietuv kha tuv la, tuv kha a chepatlaa naase yi; tuvtaata tie cung luo kha hmuo i kuv i maasue kalie'a yi.
Abyipata, alyi cung yalya lie hing che thung che hning ca thie pata cuo'a yi te, che thung che kha ca ama hringpa ta pangaa pata ama cuo aa.

Cakhutaata capa che thung che kha ca myi chunglie chi'a yi angte, ngu ama pathe sapa haa khata i pathe sa'a yi, siy ama dyapasyapa haa khata i dyapasya'a yi. Iema ta i ming ta na ku'a yi te, i chaw'a yi. Kama ta, “Iema ca i cawsaa tana ama cuo,” ta'a yi angte, iema ta, “Abyipaca ma Khazing tana a cuo,” ina ta'a yi.
Mang tie, Abyipaning ca aa vaw tli, nama'a taata ama lapa hruosue kha niema hrawlie amaa rena cuo ca aa vaw tli.

Tahematapakieca Jerusalem kha a du riypata mingphang bangkhuo kha pahmya'a yi angte, khypuv ca ama la aa, ing kha catla'a yi te chechiy ama la aa, canung kha hruohra ta ama awkhyi aa; khypuv khingkhuo yalya ca sii ta sikhyi pata ama cuo aa, cuorasala aa ngaapa cawsaa tie ca pahli pata cuo'a va yi.
Cakhutaata Abyipaca rietuv ning haa khata capa mingphang tie ca a tuv'a yi.

Capa ning lie ca Jerusalem ningchiyluo kuo ta a awpa Olif Tluo cunglie kha aa daa aa; Olif Tluo ca ningchiy taata ningtla te khata suohning ta a chechi'a te, a kusapa bawphie ta aa li aa; caacuonakawta Tluo chekha ca chaluo ta a hnyi'a te, a hrangpa chekha ca sungluo ta aa hnyi aa.

Niema ca Abyipatluo bawphie luopuv lie ca ta namaa ruo aa, tahematapakieca tluo zaw aa lalalieta bawphie ca Azal te kha a pha aa; niema ca Judah Siepahruo Uzziah chuo ning aling a siypa taata namaa ruo ning haa khata namaa ruo aa. Cakhutaata Abyipai Khazing ca a cawsaa pathepa tie hne khata aa vaw aa.
Capa ning lie ca a kangpa acuolikie cahue aw'a vyi.
Ning ca a pazue'a te (capa ca Abyipa dyina a pachang), ning chung cuo vyi, zuo cuo vyi, tahematapakieca zuoluo cuo lie khana khena a aw thluo aa.
Capa ning lie ca Jerusalem taata hringna tiy pya'a te, khingkhuo ca ningchiyluo riyliy luo kha cuose, a che ta ningtlaluo riyliy luo kha cuose, cuovuo hne thlasiy ta li pata ama lang aa.
Cakhutaata Abyipaca alyi cung yalya lie siepahruo ta a cuo aa; capa ning lie ca Abyipapakha, a ming suokha ta a cuo aa.

Geba taata Jerusalem sungluo kuo Rimmon te khata ruo yalya ca ase ruo ta aa li aa. Cuorasala Jerusalem ca ama a hmang lie kha aa suo yalya khata a aw aa; Benjamin thlake taata hluo ning thlake awnapa Akiy Thlake te, cakhutaata Hananel Ingsuo taata siepahruo mingsuv nena te khata
khy ama sa aa, tahematapakieca Jerusalem ca para pata cuo pakhaa buo'a va tli, aa bangsa pata na a aw aa.

Jerusalem a dupa mingphang bangkhuo kha Abyipata tuv'a yi te, puvtlung pasana ama ang riypa ca hingpa hingta a cuo aa: amaa daa thluo pata ama saa kha a thuv aa; ama ming khue lieta ama ming a thuv aa, ama pakaa chunglieta ama palyi a thuv aa.
Capa ning lie ca Abyipata a pathliepa ciy aa chiysapa ta ama cunglie tlung'a te, ingpaa kha ama kuv amaa patuv raalaa pata pakha ta a hrangpa pakha kha aa du aa,
Judah ming kha hmuo Jerusalem lieta amaa tuv aa. A cahriylie a awpa mingphang tie hnyirungna kha pakhaw'a yi te, siy, ngu, hne cawthang zaw ca a pung ta aa pung aa.
Cakhutaata aruo, laa hne aruo kaapie, kala-uv, laa, hne saruopa bangkhuo zaw cunglie kha hingpa puvtlung pasana haapa hing a tlung aa.

Jerusalem a du riypata a vawpa mingphang zaw chungtaata aa ngaapa bangkhuo ca Cungnungce Abyipa, Siepahruo kha abie riypata hne thluodaa pyi tue riypa khata kung kha hnang kung kha ta khypuv luo kha ama si taw aa.
Cungnungce Abyipa, Khazing kha abie riypata khypuv luo a si lipa alyi cung ingchungkhue ama aw kieca ama cunglieta khy saa'a vyi.

Cakhutaata Izipt lie a awpa ingchungkhue tie zaw kha sithaw pata pyi luo ama chiy li kieca, thluodaa pyi tue riypata a sithaw lipa mingphang tie cunglie Abyipata a patlung sa pa puvtlung pasana kha ama cunglieta a tlung aa.
Capa ca Izipt cunglie duotena hne thluodaa pyi tue riypata a sithaw khing lipa mingphang tie cunglie duotena ta a cuo aa.
Capa ning lie ca aruo tawkalaw zaw cunglie kha, “Abyipacuota a pathe,” ta pata ama cape aa. Cakhutaata Abyipaing chunglie sa changnapa bi ca bienatluophie hmiekunglie kuotung haa khata a pathe aa;

Jerusalem hne Judah lie a awpa sa changnapa bi mekaa ca Cungnungce Abyipahuota a pathe aa, tahematapakieca hriykhungrina a tuepa bangkhuo khata a vaw'a yi te hriykhungrina saa changna riypata ama hmuo aa. Cakhutaata capa ning lie ca Cungnungce Abyipaing chunglie ca sung a palipa pakha hmuo aw'a va tli yi.
Profetbiephu. Malakhi hmuo pata Israel ming'a luo Abyiparipa bie.
Abyipata niema ca ica due yi, a ta. Cuorasala niema ta, “Tuokhaatama kiema ca malie na due?” nama ta. Abyipata, Esau ca Jakob uvnu cuo va ma? a ta.
Cuorasala Jakob ca due angte, Esau ca i hue; a tluocung ruo kha a duothlingpa ta tue angte, a cupa ruo kha ruo-uv zaw awnapa ruocaapa ta i tue.

Edom ta, “Kiema ca ma ra tli, a rapa ma ing ca ma sa pakhaa aa,” ta sala, Cungnungce Abyipata: Iema ta ama sa aa, cuorasala kama ta i pacing aa. Cawsaa ta, a pha lipa ruo, chuozaa ta Abyipaa hihaanapa mingphang tana ama cuo, ama ta aa.
Nama ming ta capa ca hmung'a ung cate, “AbyipaLesyina ca Israel ruoriy khung te tana a cuo,” nama ta aa.

Sacapaa ta a paa kha pa-uvsathyi te, changtaapa ta a byipaapa kha a pa-uvsathyi. Paa ta i cuo kie, khaapaliema ina pa-uvsathyi ung ciy? Byi ta i cuo kie, khaapaliema ina pa-uvsathyi ung ciy? Vya tluobyi tie, ahungma i ming hing a papya a palyi? Cungnungce Abyipata a ta. Niema ta, “Tuokhaatama na ming ca ma papya ma palyi?” nama ta.

Kama bienatluophie lieta a pyalyipa sa pihluona tana ina papyapalyi ung ciy. Cakhutaata niema ta, “Tuokhaatama ma papyapalyi?” nama ta. Abyipacabya ca duv aa chiysapa tana a cuo tapa ruena tana nama papyapalyi.

Hriykhungrina lie a mingcuepa sahring nama pihluopa ca suena tana a cuo cuo va ma? A phyi cabiepa hne a pasapa sahring nama pihluopa ca nama sue cuo va ma? Nama uvtuv byi kha pi ung la nama cunglie a palung a tluo'a ma? Hmiephaa haw aca pi'a yi ma? Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.
Ama ta vi malie a hnyi riypata Abyipahmiephaa kha huv tie ung. Nama tue chie sa tli. Pakha chuo hmiephaa aca pi'a yi ma? Cungnungce Abyipa ta a ta.

I bienatluophie lieta a hrihripa ta myi nama patiy li riypata niema hrawlie pakha chuo ta biena-ing ingchiypakaa kha khaa ung la a phasa aa! Nama cunglie i palung tluo vyi, pihluona kha nama kuv taata cuhluo'a va ang, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.

Ning kya chiy te a tlana te ta i ming ca mingphang zaw hrawlieta a lesyi, hmangting mekaa lie kha rangpa-ue hne a pathepa pihluona ina pihluo yi; tahematapakieca i ming ca mingphang zaw hrawlie kha a lesyi, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.
Cuorasala niema ta, Abyipacabya ca papyapalyi pata na a cuo, capa lie pihluopa sa zaw ca duv aa chiypa tana a cuo, ta ung cate nama papyapalyi tli.

“Nangbuo na a chiysa,” ta ung cate ina ese ung ciy, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta. Malie nama chuvpa acuolikie a cabiepa acuolikie a pasapa kha pihluo riypata nama vya cyi! Capa ca nama kuv taata ica cuhluo'a yi ma? Abyipa ta a ta.

A tuvrung chunglie tuvtungpa a awpa kha i pihluo aa ta pata biekuona a tue thluo pata Abyipakha dung te a dutla lipa sahring a pihluopa ca chiesa pata cuo mang sue; tahematapakieca kama ca a lesyipa Siepahruo ta cuo angte, i ming ca mingphang zaw hrawlie pa-uvsathyina pipa tana a cuo, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.
Vya tluobyi tie, hingpa biepina hing niema huo tana a cuo.

Niema ta naathlie li, thyi khing li pa ung cata i ming kha rungnaana nama pi khing li kieca niema cunglie kha chiesana patlung sa'a angte, nama thluechiy kha chie i sa aa, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta. Nama thyi khing li nakawta, nama thluechiy ca chie i sa hmisi tli.
Nama ciypathla tie kha chuo'a yi angte, nama hmie kha nama pihluopa sahring ii ta ica hi'a yi, cakhutaata i awna taata ica papya'a yi.
Kama na hingpa biepina hing caa pi yi ang tapa kha nama pachang aa, cahaacata Levi hne ma tuepa biekuona ca pacu sa pata a cuo aa, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.
Ama i pipa, ama hne i tuepa biekuona ca hringna hne hring anuona biekuona ta cuo te, hingpa hingta pa-uvsathyina chiykhyi te, kama kha na pa-uvsathyi te i ming kha a ciyzaa.
A pakaa lieta a hmisipa pacuvna aw te, a hmyataw taata a cuo lipa bie ri buo vyi. Ama ca kama hneta adangna hne a resa pata si te, cawsaa hluvsa kha pha lina taata a pakaa sa yi.
Tluobyi tie bie ca thesingna kha kingkaa'a te, cawsaa ta a pakaa taata pacuvna amaa la aa, tahematapakieca ama ca Cungnungce Abyipabiephyatuv tana a cuo.
Cuorasala niema ca capa luopuv taa cata pie ung cate, Levi biekuona kha nama para, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.
Cahaacata niema ta i luopuv kha ziy li pata nama pacuvna lieta pahlyipalena nama tuepa zaa khata cawsaa bangkhuo ta ese riypa hne duvsa riypata ica tue ra yi.
Ma bangkhuo ta paa pakha na ma hnyi cuo va ma? Khazing pakha na malie a sa cuo va ma? Khaapanakawma pakha hne pakha a zang lipa pata ma mingchingmingvuo tie biekuona ca ma para ung?
Judah ca zang tluo a tla vyi, cakhutaata Israel lie hne Jerusalem lieta duvsamakhiepa ama tue. Judah ta Abyipata a duepa hmangpathepa kha papyapalyi te ruohrang khazing sacanung kha aa hlaw.
Hingpa hmang a tuepa saya hne siengaachie mekaa, hne Cungnungce Abyipa'a luo pihluona a vya cyipa mekaa ca Abyipata Jakob thluodaa taata pahli yi se.

Cakhutaata hingpa hing nama tue kalie: Abyipabienatluophie kha mingthliy ta nama paci, ama ta nama pihluopa kha palungtlingna hne mang li pata nama kuv taata palungtluona hneta a cuhluo li nakawta caa ung cate namaa hrung.

Niema ta, “Khaapanakawma a cuhluo va?” nama ta. Tahematapakieca Abyipaca nama hne na thuthaw ningta na napuvnung alalalieta tehte tana a cuo, ama ca biekuona chunglieta na viesaa hne na napuv ta a cuo thluo pata ama cunglie kha zang tluo zaa tla vaciy.

Ama kha Khazing ngiethie na a sa cuo va ma? Saapa hne thlaapa a hnyi ra cuo va ma? Khazing ta khaapama a khing? Khazing a ciyzaapa saata hnyi riypa kha tana a cuo. Caacuonakawta niema hne niema kha a mang ung la, ahungtahmuo a thuthaw ningta a hnyipa napuv cunglie kha zang tluo aa tla li pata aw khah se.

Israel Khazing Abyipata, nung hne vaa a chepa ca i hue a ta. Cungnungce Abyipata napuv cunglie pha lipa tue pata buvkhungpa ca i hue a ta. Caacuonakawta a cadang ung la zang tluo aa tla li pata aw khah ung.

Nama bie tana Abyipakha nama nangsa tli. Niema ta, “Tuokhaatama ama ca ma nang?” nama ta. “Pha lina a tuepa bangkhuo ca Abyipahmungna lie ama pha, ama ta a tlechuo yi,” nama tanapa hne, “Biedangpa Khazing ca khaapaliema a aw?” nama tanapa kha tana nama nang.

Mang tie, nama luo caa sa daw riypa tana i biephyatuv kha na hmieluo ta i pathlie aa. Na huvpa Abyipaca sungkhabala ta a biena-ing luo aa vaw aa. Nama tlechuopa, biekuona biephyatuv ca aa vaw hmisi aa, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.
Cuorasala ama aa vawna ca ahungma a ang khu aa? Ama aa luo tiyta ahungma a daa khu aa? Tahematapakieca ama ca pathesatuv myi hne caw a pasuvtuv chaapie haa tana a cuo.
Ama ca ngu a pathe satuv haa khata a tu'a te, Levi ciypathla tie kha adangna hneta Abyipa'a luo pihluona ama tuena te siy hne ngu haata a pathe sa'a yi.
Cakhutaata Judah hne Jerusalem ta ama tuepa pihluona ca a hluo ning haa khata Abyipatlechuopa ta a cuo aa.

Cakhutaata bieripana zung luo kha icaa chiy'a yi; ca-ie a thepa tie, nungvaathingsuena a tuepa tie, hanghie pata chie a sapa tie, vie a hluepa tie hne nunghlyi hne haaraa kha hrisaa yi te thavie muo a dungpa te, ruohrang ming kha luo kie luo a nungpa tie, hne kama naa ciyzaa lipa tie kha a du pata a catlisa pata tehte i cuo aa, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.
Abyipakama ca a thle va ang; caacuonakawta, Vya Jakob saata zaw, niema ca ra va ung ciy.

Nama mingchingmingvuo tie chuo taata aa pathu pata kama phungluo kha ziy li pa ung cata luo nama pie. Kama'a luo vya kaa ung la, kama zaw niema'a luo i vya kaa aa, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta. Cuorasala, niema ta, “Tuokhaatama ma vya kaa khu aa?” nama ta.

Cawsaa pakha ta Khazing huopa paruvpa hing a pha ma? Cuorasala niema ca kama huopa na nama paruv! Cuorasala niema ta, “Tuokhaatama kiema ta nama huopa ca ma paruv? nama ta. Chehraachekha hne pihluona zaw lie hing na nama paruv!
Nama mingphang yalya ta kama huopa kha nama paruv nakawta nama cungliena chiesana i patlung sa.

I ing chunglie sa a bi riypata chehraachekha ca a yalya ta sa pacungna ing luo vya cyi ung la, kama kha na dyapasya tie ung; vuoruo thlaluo-aw zaw hing nama cuota pahaw'a angte, thluechiy ri tie li ica za patlesue yi ma, ca za patlesue va yi ang ma tapa kha mang tie ung, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.
Namaa lyi taata a vyipa sa a parapa kha a para li riypata cuose, nama mingsuv kung a caana te ta a tuepa kha a tue li riypata cuose kama ta i chuo aa, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.
Tahematapakieca niema ca tlechuopa ruo ta cuo'a ung cate, mingphang bangkhuo ta a palungtluopa tie aca ta'a yi, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.
Niema ca kama a du pata na bie aa hruosapa nama ri, Abyipata a ta. Cuorasala niema ta, “Nama a du pata tuokhaapa bie ma ma ri?” nama ta.

Niema ta, “Khazing re hriepa hing khaapahmuo thlahne vyi nama ta. A bie pipa ma ziypa hing khaapama malie a thlahne, acuolikie Cungnungce Abyipahmiekunglie muochie a sapa tie haata vaapa hing khaapama malie a thlahne?” nama ta.
Aa palepa tie hing a palungtluopa tana ama cuo ma ta yi; a pha lipa a tuepa tie hing ama hring aa nuopa dyi cuo li pata, Khazing ama dyapasya zaw ta ama law le thluo,” ma ta yi.

Cakhutaata Abyipaa ciyzaapa tie ta pakha hne pakha bie amaa rue. Abyipata ama bie ca thyi te a palung chunglie aa chi. Cakhutaata a ming ta pacuvpa hne ama a ciyzaapa tie kha a hmiekunglieta a thyi parina caa-uv lie kha ama ming a khung yi.

Cungnungce Abyipata, “Iema ca kama huopa tana ama cuo aa, kama ta hmang i tuena ning thue ca iema ca kama cuvu pa-ipa tana ama cuo aa, nungpaa tie ta ama re a hriepa saata tie kha nangduena ama hnyipa haata kama ta ama cunglie nangduena i hnyi aa.
Cakhutaata aa dangpa hne a pha lipa kha cuose, Khazing re a hriepa hne a hrie lipa kha nama thleduo khu pakhaa aa.

Mang tie ung, sumyi haata a kuo nguoluopa ning ca aa vaw nguoluo, ca tiyta capa a palunglepa hne hmang pha lipa a tuepa tie ca hnehnaw caapa tana ama cuo aa, a vaw nguoluopa capa ning cata a ce hne a thariy zaw kha pangaa li pata a kuo diy'a yi, Cungnungce Abyipa ta a ta.
Cuorasala i ming a pa-uvsathyipa niema cuota ca a mathlaa lie tluona a vya zukhyipa adangna ning kha a chiy aa. Acahriy taata pazangpa sitaata haata pya'a ung cate cuokiy namaa zang aa.
Cakhutaata kama re i vya hrie ning lie ca, niema ta a pha lipa tie kha nama chaapuo aa, tahematapakieca niema phyipazaa rawlie khana buvcuo haata ama cuo thluo aa, Cungnungce Abyipata a ta.
I changtaapa Moses pacuvna kha a thyi tie ung, Israel ming bangkhuo cuota Horeb lie bie i pipa phungluo hne ziyphung zaw kha a thyi tie ung.
A lepa hne ciy aa chiypa Abyipaning aa vaw hluo lie khata niema'a luo kha profet Elijah i vya pathlie aa.
Ruo kha chiesana ta i tuv li riypata ama ta nungpaa tie pathiypalung kha saata zaw'a luo maa'a te, saata zaw pathiypalung kha nungpaa tie'a luo a maa aa.
Abraham samingsahlaa, David samingsahlaa ta a cuopa Messiah Zingsuv thukina ca hing haa hing tana a cuo.
Abraham ca Isak paa ta a cuo, Isak ca Jakob paa ta a cuo, Jakob ca Judah hne a nuta zaw paa ta a cuo,
Judah ca Perez hne Zerah paa ta a cuo (Ama nung ca Tamar ta a cuo), Perez ca Hezron paa ta a cuo, Hezron ca Aram paa ta a cuo,
Aram ca Amminadab paa ta a cuo, Amminadab ca Nahshon paa ta a cuo, Nahshon ca Salmon paa ta a cuo,
Salmon ca Boaz paa ta a cuo (A nung ca Rahab ta a cuo), Boaz ca Obed paa ta a cuo (a nung ca Ruth ta a cuo), Obed ca Jesse paa ta a cuo,
Jesse ca Siepahruo David paa ta a cuo. David ca Solomon paa ta a cuo (a nung ca Uriah napuvnung kha tana a cuo),
Solomon ca Rehoboam paa ta a cuo, Rehoboam ca Abijah paa ta a cuo, Abijah ca Asaph paa ta a cuo,
Asaph ca Jehoshafat paa ta a cuo, Jehoshafat ca Joram paa ta a cuo, Joram ca Uzziah paa ta a cuo,
Uzziah ca Jotham paa ta a cuo, Jotham ca Ahaz paa ta a cuo, Ahaz ca Hezekiah paa ta a cuo,
Hezekiah ca Manasseh paa ta a cuo, Manasseh ca Amos paa ta a cuo, Amos ca Josiah paa ta a cuo,
Josiah ca Jekhoniah hne a nuta zaw ama paa ta a cuo, capa cuo lie ca Israel ming ca Babilon ruo luo sii ta amaa da.
Babilon luo sii ta amaa da khutaata: Jekhoniah ca Salathiel paa ta a cuo, Salathiel ca Zerubbabel paa ta a cuo,
Zerubbabel ca Abiud paa ta a cuo, Abiud ca Eliakim paa ta a cuo, Eliakim ca Azor paa ta a cuo,
Azor ca Zadok paa ta a cuo, Zadok ca Akhim paa ta a cuo, Akhim ca Eliud paa ta a cuo,
Eliud ca Eleazar paa ta a cuo, Eleazar ca Matthan paa ta a cuo, Matthan ca Jakob paa ta a cuo,
Jakob ca Josef paa ta a cuo, Josef ca Mary navaapa ta a cuo, Mary ca Messiah tapa Zingsuv nung khata a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Abraham taata David te chuo hraa hlyipaliy, David taata Babilon luo sii ta amaa dana te ta chuo hraa hlyipaliy, sii ta amaa dana taata Messiah puvna te ta chuo hraa hlyipaliy ta a cuo.
Zingsuv Khrih a puvnazya ca hing haa hingta a cuo. A nung Mary ca Josef ta pahaa te cuorasala amaa hlaw hluo khata Thlaapa Pathe ta nu a hnyi aa tapa kha pachang sa pata a cuo.
A navaapa Josef ca aa dangsapa ta cuo te, Mary kha zaapuv pachang ta thuo pachipa a khing li nakawta a paruvta tah a che riypata khue a khuo.

Cahaacata tue riypa a pacuo nguoluoning kha Abyipa avuoming pakha ta a muo lie zaa luo te, “David saming Josef, Mary hing napuv ta a la riypata ciy khah, tahematapakieca nu a phyapa hing Thlaapa Pathe taa tana a cuo.
Ama ta sacapaa hnyi'a te a ming ca Zingsuv ta pata na paphya aa, tahematapakieca ama ta a cawsaa zaw kha ama suena taata a khuo'a yi,” a ta.
Hingpa bangkhuo a cuopa hing Abyipa ta profet pakaa taata a ripa a tlingna riypa tana a cuo:
“Mang tie, Lesaa pathenung pakha ta nu phya'a te sacapaa pakha a sa aa, ama ca Immanuel ta pata ming ama paphya aa,” a ri khingna ca, “Khazing ca kiema'a liena a aw,” tana pata a cuo.
Josef ca aa hmungna taata aa kya cha tiyta Abyipa avuoming ta ama changpa haa khata Mary ca napuv ta aa la.
Cuorasala sacapaa a sa hluo li ca nung hne vaa cuokhyi vyi. Sacapaa ca Zingsuv ta pata ming a sa.
Herod siepahruo a cuo nguoluo ning, Judea pe Bethlehem khy lie Zingsuv a puv khutaa khata ningchiyluo taata mingsing tie kha Jerusalem luo vya chiy yi te,
“Judah siepahruo, zaa puv thaapa haatiyta ca khaapaliema a aw? Tahematapakieca a aasiy aa luopa kha hmung pate na ama kha abie riypata ma vya chiy,” ama ta.
Siepahruo Herod ca capa bie a thyi tiyta a thlaa zang laalaw te Jerusalem khy ming bangkhuo zaw ama thlaa a zangsa ra.
Ama ta tluobyi lepa tie hne phungbie saya tie zaw kha pakiy yi te, “Messiah ca khaapaliema a puv aa?” ta pata a hiehriy yi.
Iema ta, “Judea pe Bethlehem khy liena a puv aa; Profet ta a cape siypa ca:

‘Judah ruo chunglie a awpa Bethlehem, nama ca Judah pe khypuv zaw hrawlie hing a caw cepa ta cuo changchiy vaciy, tahematapakieca na chung taa tana i cawsaa Israel ming luochiytuv pakha a pya aa,’” a ta.
Cakhutaata Herod ta mingsing tie kha a paruvta tah ku yi te khaapa cuo lie kha tama aasiy aa luo tapa kha a hiehriy yi.

Cakhutaata Bethlehem luo kha pathlie yi te, “Si ung la haatiy kha a phasa pata va huv tie ung, ama kha nama hmung tiyta, vaa'a angte i bie ra khu riypata, kama kha ina pachang sa'a ung ciy,” ta pata bie a taa yi.
Siepahruo bie kha ama naathlie khutaata amaa thu ca aa kya luo ningta ama hmungpa aasiy ca haatiy awna hmang a dadaw lie aa daana te ta ama hmielie kha a sile.
Aasiy aa daapa ama hmung tiyta ama palung a tluo hringhruo.

Ingchung luo kha amaa ngie ca haatiy kha a nung Mary hne ama hmung; ama pakhuv pane yi te ama kha amaa bie. Cakhutaata, ama suethiy thingkaw kha pahaw yi te, ama lasaw: siy, frankinsens ziyhmyi, hne mura ziyhmyi kha ama pihluo.
Herod'a luo kaa li riypata ama muo lie a raaringna pipa ama cuo nakawta, luo hrang ziy yi te ama ruo luo kha ama kaa.

Iema ama si khutaata Abyipa avuoming pakha ca Josef muo lie kha a luo te, “Thu la, haatiy hne a nung kha la yi la Izipt ruo luo a ruokhyi tie yi, tahematapakieca Herod na haatiypa hing thie riypata a huv aa, kama ta kaa riypata ica chang hluo li capa lie ca nama aw caw aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Josef ca thu te haatiy hne a nung kha zuo ta la yi te Izipt ruo luo a ruokhyi yi te,
capa lie ca Herod a thiyna te ama aw. Hingpa hing Abyipa ta profet pakaa taata, “I sacapaa ca Izipt taata pya riypa tana i u,” a tapa bie a tlingna riypa tana a cuo.

Herod ta mingsing tie na naa dung yi tapa kha a pachang tiyta a hi haa suesaa te, mingsing tie'a taata a pachangpa cuo hne tuepuo pata Bethlehem hne a cahriylie a awpa khy zaw lieta haatiy kung hning raw bangkhuo kha thie riypata naw a pi yi.
Cahaacata profet Jeremiah ta a za ripa bie ca a vya tling:
“Ramah khy chunglie ueryi aa thyi. Caana hne muochiesana ueryi ta a cuo. Rachel ta a saata zaw kha a caa yi; ama thiy diy nakawta, panguo khu pata cuo vyi,” ta pata a cuo.
Herod a thiy khutaata Izipt ruo lie ca Abyipa avuoming pakha ca Josef muo lie kha a luo te,
“Thu la, haatiy hne a nung kha la yi la Israel ruo luo si tie ung, tahematapakieca haatiy a thie khingpa tie kha ama thiy tli,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Josef ca thu te, haatiy hne a nung kha la yi te Israel ruo luo ama si.

Cuorasala Arkhelaus na a paa Herod kha a thle te Judea ruo lie siepahruo a cuo tapa kha Josef ta a thyi tiyta, capa luo ca si nguo vyi. A muo lie a raaringna bie ama changpa haata Galilee pe luo kha a si.
Profet tie ta ama za ri ciepa, “Ama ca Nazarethpa ta pata a cuo aa,” tapa bie a tling thena riypata Nazareth khy lie kha khy a sa.
Capa cuo ning ca tiynawtuv Johan ca Judea ruocaapa lie kha a vya luo te,
“Nama suena kha a ngiepachiy tie ung, tahematapakieca Vuoruo Pena ca aa ngie tli,” ta pata phung ri hruo a pathu.

Hingpa hing profet Isaiah a ripa bie suokha ta a cuo, “Ueryi suokha ca ruocaapa lie kha u te: ‘Abyipa luopuv kha sapa tie ung, a luopuv kha padang tie ung’” ta pata a za ri tiyta a za ri khing hnuochuopa ca Johan hing tana a cuo.
