Johan ca kala-uv hming ta taapa caw kha a tue te a se lie kha savang tesaw aa saw, a sa ca khawbyapa hne khyitiy ta a cuo.
Jerusalem taata hne Judea pe bangkhuo taata cuose, Jordan cavaa kie khy bangkhuo taata cuose, cawsaa zaw ca ama'a luo kha pya yi te,
ama suena kha a phu yi te Jordan cavaa lie kha tiy a naw yi.

Cuorasala Farasi ming hne Sadusi ming a hluvsa tiy a naw riypata amaa vawpa kha a hmung tiyta, “Pariy ciypathla zaw! A vya tlung riypa Khazing hihaana chungtaata a ruo riypata ahung ma a raaringna caa pi yi? a ta yi.
Sue a ngiepachiyna hne aa phuvpa hringzya kha hnyi tie ung.
Niema hne niema kha, ‘Abraham samingsahlaa tana ma cuo a ta khah ung'; ica chang yi, Khazing ca hingpa alung taa hingta Abraham samingsahlaa zaw kha a sa khu yi.
Ahryi ca thingkung thabaw lie pahlaa pacie pata cuo te thyiphaa a pathyi lipa thingkung bangkhuo ca hu pata myi chung luo thaw pata ama cuo aa.

“Kama ca nama sue a ngiepachiyna paluosana ta tiy ta tiy ica naw yi, cuorasala kama laata a le viepa paa ca i hnang taata aa vawle nguoluo tli; kama hing ca a phyipakaw a cyipale riypata hmuo a tla va ang. Ama ta Thlaapa Pathe hne myi ta tiynawna aca pi'a yi.
A kuv lie suo zinapa pahraa kha a cyi te sa kha a zi diy aa, sahang ca be luo kha raw'a te, cuorasala a siypa ca a thiy buo lipa myi chunglie kha a rue aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ca Galilee taa khata Jordan cavaa luo kha Johan kuv ta tiy a naw riypata aa vaw.
Cuorasala Johan ta, “Kama hingna nama kuv ta tiy a naw riypata a cuo ang, nama tlaku ma kama'a luo a vaw ciy?” a ta.

Cuorasala Zingsuv ta, “Ata hing ca hing haa hingta cuo thluo se; tahematapakieca adangna bangkhuo a tlingna riypata hing haa hingta ma tue riypa hing a phapa tana a cuo,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Johan ca a naa a tla.
Zingsuv ca tiynawna ang te tiy chungtaata a kya thu pahne ta, avuo kha sungkha ta a pahaw te Khazing Thlaapa kha thuvruv haata zaa zu te a cunglie a zaa cangpa kha a hmung.
Vuoruo taata ueryi suokha ta, “Hingpa paa hing i duepa i Sacapaa tana a cuo, a cunglie hing i palung a tling,” a ta.
Cakhutaa Zingsuv ca khachie ta a pasupaliy riypata Thlaapa ta ruocaapa luo kha a sikhyi.
Zingsuv ca ning sawliy hne zuo sawliy chung sa uv te a nang a diy hringhruo.
Pasupaliytuv ca a vaw te, “Khazing Sacapaa na cuo kieca, hingpa alung zaw hing viechuo ta aa li riypata naw pi tie,” a ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta palie te, “Caapathe ta, ‘Cawsaapa hing sa dyi ta hring vyi, cuorasala Khazing ta a ripa bie mekaa kha tana a hring aa,’” a ta.
Cakhutaata khachie ta Zingsuv kha khypuv pathepa luo sikhyi te biena-ing dawthlue lie kha a chi khutaata,

“Khazing Sacapaa ta na cuo kieca hingpa taa hingta a thawpathla tie, tahematapakieca Caapathe ta, ‘Khazing ta nama cuo hingta aa vuoming kha naw pi'a yi te, iema ta ama kuv ta aca caba'a nakaw yi ta, na phyi kha alung lie a phaw'a vaciy,’ a ta,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Caapathe ta, ‘Abyipa na Khazing kha dyapasya khah,’ a ta,” ta pata a palie.
Cakhutaata khachie ta Zingsuv kha aa suosapa tluocung luo kiekhyi te chuelyi pena bangkhuo hne a rungnaana bangkhuo kha a pahmung sa;
Cakhutaata, “A bung la inaa bie kieca ca hingpa bangkhuo hing ica pi aa,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Setaa, cakuo buo! Caapathe lieta, ‘Abyipa na Khazing kha abie la, ama re dyi kha hrie tie,’ ta pata aa capepa kha,” a ta.
Cakhutaata khachie ta pyase te, avuoming ta sungkha ta a zuv yi te ama mangsang.
Zingsuv ca Johan na ama patuv tapa kha a thyi tiyta Galilee luo kha a si.
Ama ta Nazareth kha thuse te Zebulun hne Naftali pe, riyliy kielie a awpa Kapernaum khy lie kha a aw.
Profet Isaiah ta,
“Zebulun ruo hne Naftali ruo, riyliy kie luopuv, Jordan cavaa huesuo, Jentail ming ruo Galilee,
zingna chunglie a awpa cawsaa zaw ta khena lepuv kha hmung tli yi te, thiyna ruo ningdiy rawlie a awpa tie cunglie, khena ca aa kya luo tli,” a za tapa kha a tlingna riypa tana a cuo.
Capa cuo taa cata Zingsuv ta, “Nama suena kha a ngiepachiy tie ung, tahematapakieca vuoruo pena ca aa ngie tli!” ta pata phung ri hruo a pathu.

Zingsuv ca Galilee riyliy kielie a cakuolepa khata, uvcanu pahning tie, Simon (Piter ama tapuopa) hne a nuta Andru riyliy lie asue ama vaa nguoluopa kha a hmung yi, tahematapakieca iema ca ngaa a vaapa tana ama cuo.
Zingsuv ta iema kyihuo khata, “Kama hing na ziy tie ung, cawsaa a patuvpa tana ica tue'a yi,” a ta.
Amaa sue kha thuse paluo yi te ama kha ama ziy.

Capa hmang taa cata a va cakuo vie pata a hrangpa uvcanu pahning, Zebedi sacapaa Jeim hne a nuta Johan kha ama paa Zebedi hneta sawkawpalaw chunglie amaa sue ama thyi nguoluopa khata hmung yi te a u yi.
Ama sawkawpalaw hne ama paa kha thuse paluo yi te ama kha ama ziy.
Zingsuv ca Galilee ruocaapa bangkhuo kha tlaw te, apungna-ing chunglie kha pacuv yi te, vuoruo pena thuophaa kha phu te, pasanapa phangphang a angpa tie hne a pasapa tie kha a patluo sa yi.

Caacuonakawta a thuohlaa ca Siria ruocaapa ting khata pathuo te, a pasapa bangkhuo kha ama'a luo ama vya chiykhyi, pasana phangphang ta a pasapa tie, khuevuo ta a tuepa tie, a siy thepa tie, hne a pakyapa tie bangkhuo kha a patluo sa yi.
Galilee, Dekhapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, hne Jordan cavaa huesuo ruo taata cawsaazaapuv khata ama ca ama ziy.
Zingsuv ta cawsaazaapuv kha a hmung tiy yi ta tluocung luo kha kie te aa tu khutaata ziytuv tie kha ama'a luo amaa vaw.
Bie ri kha pathu te a pacuv yi:
“Thlaapa luota aa phahlapa tana i cuo ta pata a pachangpa tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo, tahematapakieca vuoruo pena ca iema huopa tana a cuo.
“Ngiechi pacuorung pata a caapa tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo, tahematapakieca Khazing ta ama hnaa a panguo'a yi.
“A nang a nepa tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo, tahematapakieca alyi ru na ama cu aa.
“Adangna kha nangdiy tiyhriepa haata a khingpa ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo, tahematapakieca ama khingna kha patling sa pata ama cuo aa.
“Nangduena a hnyipa tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo, tahematapakieca Khazing ta iema kha a nangdue ra'a yi.
“A palung a pathepa tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo, tahematapakieca Khazing na ama hmung aa.
“Arena a tuepa tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo, tahematapakieca Khazing saata tapa tana kupa ama cuo aa.
“Adangna kawlieta hrisaana a angpa tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo, tahematapakieca vuoruo pena ca iema huopa tana a cuo.
“Kama kawlieta cawsaa ta ca pachie yi te, ca hrisaa yi te a pha lipa a phangphang kha aa hmuo lipa ta aca thawsue kie yi ca thluechiypa tana nama cuo.
Nama palung tluo sala nama thaa pha se, tahematapakieca vuoruo lieta nama cuota lawmuo ca a le hringhruo. Hing haa hing tana niema hluo ta zaw awpa profet tie zaw kha ama za hrisaa.

“Niema ca chuelyi paciy tana nama cuo. Cuorasala paciy ca a iena kha a vie kieca tuokhaatama pa-ie sa pakhaa khu pata a cuo aa? Thlahnena suokha hmuo hnyi va tli, thaw pata tlawpuo riypa dyi tana a cuo tli.
“Niema ca chuelyi khena tana nama cuo. Tluocung lie tlapa khypuv ca khaapatahmuo pakhuo khu vyi.
Ahunghmuota myi-ing ama vuo tiyta beke khaakhung buo va yi, cuorasala myi-ing vuona tung cunglie kha khang yi te ingchung bangkhuo kha a khe diy.
Cahaacata malie ta hmang pha nama tuepa kha hmung'a yi te, vuoruo lie nama Paa ming kha ama pathuosa the riypata malie hmiekunglie kha nama khena ca pakhe tie ung.
“Moses phungbie hne profet tie pacuvna kha para riypa tana aa vaw ta pata na rue khah ung. Para riypata a vaw va ang, patling sa riypa tana i vaw.
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi: Alyi hne avuo a ra hluo li phungbie lie a caw cepa caasuo suokhata hmuo phungbie chungtaata ra'a va yi, a bangkhuo ta a tling diy hluo li ra'a va yi.

Caacuonakawta ahungtahmuo cuose phungbie chunglie a caw cepa suokha kha ziy li pata para te malie zaw kha cahaacata a pacuv kie yi ca ama ca vuoruo pena chunglie a caw cepa tana a cuo aa. Cuorasala ahunghmuo cuose phungbie kha ziy te malie zaw kha cahaacata a pacuv kie yi ca vuoruo pena chunglie cawsaa lepa tana a cuo aa.
Ica chang yi: phungbie saya tie hne Farasi ming laa hingta namaa dang vie li kieca vuoruo pena chung luo a ngie khu'a va ung ciy.
“Hluoning ca, ‘Lie va naw khah; lie a nawpa ca bieripana na a ang aa,’ ama za tapa kha nama thyi tli.

Cuorasala kama ta ca a uvnu acuolikie a sieta zaw cunglie a hi a haapa ca bieripana kha nama ang aa; a uvnu acuolikie a sieta zaw kha siysaa ri li pata a esepa ca bieripana zung luo chiykhyi pata cuo'a ung cate, a uvnu hne a sieta zaw kha, ‘A ngaapa,’ a tapa ca hell myi chung luo tla riypata aa tlapa tana nama cuo aa,” ica ta yi.
Caacuonakawta nama lasaw kha bienatluophie lie nama pihluo tiyta, na uvnu acuolikie na sieta pakhakha ta na cunglie a palung a tling lipa kha naa thyi kieca,
na lasaw kha bienatluophie hmielie chi siy la a catli pata cakuo la na uvnu acuolikie na sieta hne khata arena va tue taa tie. Cakhutaa cata vya kaa la na lasaw kha Khazing ca pihluo tie.

Tazaa caa cyipa hneta bieripana zung luo nama vaale ning khata ama kha arena tue tie. Ca ta a cuo li kieca tazaa caa cyi pata bieripatuv kuv cung luo, bieripatuv ta paliy zung luo ca chiykhyi'a te thaw pathla pata na cuo aa.
Biehmisi tana ica chang: na lu riypa tuokaa a chuopatlienapa pie kha te ta na pi diy hluo li thaw chungtaata pya'a vaciy.
“'Nungvaathingsuena tue khah,’ ama za tapa kha nama thyi tli.
Cuorasala kama ta ca, canung pakha kha suehne khingna pathiypalung hneta a mangpa ca a palung chunglieta nungvaathingsuena kha capa nung hne cata a tue tli.
Caacuonakawta na cacuo ming ta aca pasue sa kieca, cakhyi la thaw tie; na pangpa yalya ta hell luo tlapa laata ca na pangpa chebuo suokhakha naa sungpa ca a pha vie.
Na cacuo kuv ta aca pasue sa kieca, te la thaw tie; na pangpa yalya ta hell luo tlapa laata ca na kuv na phyi suokhakha a sungpa ca a pha vie.
“'Ahunghmuo cuose a napuv a ma kieca manapa caa pi se,’ ta pata ripa a cuo hyi.

Cuorasala kama ta ca niema kha, capaa hrangpa hne suena kawlie ta li pata a hrangpa kawlieta a napuv a mapa ca, ama kha nungvaathingsuena a patue sapa tana a cuo; capa nung a hlawpa paa zaw ca nungvaathingsuena a tuetuv ta a cuo ra, ica ta yi.
“'Aa hmuo li pata chie a sa'a va ung ciy, cuorasala Abyipa'a lie nama tue ciepa biekuona kha patling sa tie ung,’ ta pata hluoning ama za ripa kha nama thyi.
Cuorasala ica chang yi, chie a sa khah ung, vuoruo ming caba pata chie a sa khah ung, tahematapakieca Khazing a tuna tana a cuo.
Alyi ming caba pata chie a sa khah ung, tahematapakieca Khazing phyi pathlana tana a cuo. Jerusalem ming caba pata zaw chie a sa khah ung, tahematapakieca a lesyipa siepahruo awna khypuv tana a cuo.
Nama luv nama puo caba pata zaw chie a sa khah ung, tahematapakieca nama suobuv buv kha hmuota nama paruo sa khu lipa haata pavaw sa khu va ung ciy.
‘A cuo,’ ‘Cuo vyi,’ tapa dyi kha ri tie ung, hingpa laa hingta a hlyipa bangkhuo ca a pha lipa paa'a taata a vawpa tana a cuo.
“'Ming cuota ming, haa cuota haa,’ ta pata ama ripa kha nama thyi.
Cuorasala ica chang yi, pha lina a tuepa kha thlu ri khah ung. Cuorasala cawsaa pakhakha ta na cacuoluo be aca cabe kieca, kuokhaluo kha va chawpa vie tie.
Na buohryi a khing nakawta tazaa aca cyi kieca, na buohryicungle zaw kha pi chiy vie tie.
Cakhutaata pakhakha ta hruohra li pata me kha aca cakuo sa kieca, me hning te khata va cakuo tie.
Chechiy caa hiepa kha va pi la, du caa cyipa kha pakaa khah.
“'Nama viesaa kha due ung la nama carie kha hue tie ung,’ ama za ta tawpa kha nama thyi.
Cuorasala kama ta ca hing haa hingta ica chang yi, Nama carie tie kha due ung la caa hrisaapa tie cuo khata thlaachuo tie ung,

cahaaca tana vuoruo lie a awpa nama Paa saata ta nama cuo aa. Tahematapakieca ama ca cawsaa chiepa hne cawsaa phapa cunglieta ning kha pachiy sa kaluo te, aa dangpa hne aa dang lipa cunglieta khy a pasaa sa kaluo.
Niema caa duepa dyi nama due kieca khaapa lawmuo ma nama hmung aa? Ngukhyituv tie tahmuo cahaacata ama tue ra cuo va ma?
Na uvnu hne na sieta zaw dyi kha bie naa chang kie yi ca, malie laata namaa nanang vienapa a aw ma? Khazing a bie lipa tie hmuo cahaacata ama tue ra cuo va ma?
Caacuonakawta vuoruo lie a awpa nama Paa a tlingpa haata niema zaw a tlingpa cuo ra tie ung.
“Hmang pha nama tuepa kha malie ta na hmung naase yi ta pata zaapuv hmielieta va tue khah ung. Cahaacata nama tue kieca vuoruo lieta a awpa nama Paa'a taata lawmuo khaapahmuo hmung'a va ung ciy.

“Caacuonakawta malie kha abyana nama pi tiyta phahruocuo tie ta cawsaa malie pathuosa naase yi ta pata apungna-ing hne azaa luopuv lie hmyakaa tung yi te ama tuepa haata tue khah ung. Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, iema ca ama lawmuo kha ama hmung diy tli.
Cuorasala niema ca malie kha abyana nama pi tiyta, nama cacuoluo kuv ta a tuepa kha nama cavyiluo kuv tahmuo a pachang li riypata va tue tie ung.
Cahaacata a paruv ta nama tuepa a hmungtuv nama Paa khata nama lawmuo kha aca pi'a yi.

“Thlaa nama chuo tiyta phahruocuo tie haa khata chuo khah ung. Iema ca cawsaa ta malie hmung naase yi ta pata luopuv a tawna lie hne apungna-ing lie a daa pata thlaachuo kha ama tlechuosa. Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, iema ca ama lawmuo kha ama hmung diy tli.

Cuorasala niema ca thlaa nama chuo tiyta, nama khuo luo a ngie ung la, ingchiy kha khaa ung la, ming ta hmung khu a aw lipa nama Paa'a luo kha chuo tie ung. A paruv ta nama tuepa a hmungtuv nama Paa ta nama lawmuo kha aca pi'a yi.
“Thlaa nama chuo tiyta, Jentail ming haa khata siyluo a hnyi lipa bie a hluvsa ri pata thlaachuo khah ung; tahematapakieca iema ta bie a hluvsa ma ri kieca malie a thyi thlu aa ta pata ama rue.
Iema haata cuo khah ung, tahematapakieca nama Paa ta khaapama namaa hu tapa kha nama hie hluota a pachang diy tli.
“Caacuonakawta hing haa hingta thlaachuo tie ung: Vuoruo lie a awpa ma Paa, Na mingpathepa ca pa-uvsathyi pata aw mang sue.
Na pena tlung paatie se. Vuoruo lie haata alyi cunglie na khingnapa tling paatie se.
Ningting ta maa hupa sa ca ataning zaw malie pi tie.
Malie ta ima cunglie ama sue ningta maa ngiethepa haa yi ta, ma suenapa kha malie a ngiethe ra tie.
Pasupaliyna luo malie papha sa li pata, a pha lipa chungtaata malie khuo tie.
Malie ta nama cunglie ama tuepa suena kha namaa ngiethe kieca, vuoruo lie a awpa nama Paa ta niema nama suena zaw acaa ngiethe ra'a yi.
Cuorasala malie kha namaa ngiethe li kieca nama Paa ta niema nama suena zaw kha caa ngiethe ra'a va yi.

“Sa namaa uv tiyta phahruocuo tie haata nama hmiephya a pachie sa khah ung, tahematapakieca iema ca sa amaa uvpa kha cawsaa ta malie pachang naase yi ta pata ama hmiephya kha amaa pachie sa. Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, iema ca ama lawmuo kha ama hmung diy tli.
Cuorasala niema ca sa namaa uv tiyta nama hmie kha a siy ung la nama luv zaw kha sathu a thuv tie ung,

tahematapakieca sa namaa uvpa kha malie ta ca pachang lipa yi ta hmung khu lipa nama Paa kyalya ta aca pachang'a yi. Cahaacata a paruv ta nama tuepa a hmungtuv nama Paa ta nama lawmuo kha aca pi'a yi.
“Thanghmaa ta ning te a pabung khunapa hne a se ta ce te a ra khunapa, a ruvhangpa ta a paruv khunapa alyi lieta nama suethiy kha pacung khah ung.
Cuorasala thanghmaa ta ning te a pabung khu linapa hne a se ta ce te a ra khu linapa, a ruvhangpa ta a paruv khu linapa vuoruo lieta nama suethiy kha pacung tie ung.
Tahematapakieca nama sue a awna lie khana nama pathiypalung zaw a aw ra aa.
“Ming ca pangpa cuota myi-ing tana a cuo. Caacuonakawta na ming a tluo kieca, na pangpa yalya ta a khe diy aa.
Cuorasala na ming a tluo li kieca, na pangpa yalya ta a zing diy aa. Na chunglie a awpa khena ca zingna ta a cuo pathlyi kieca, capa zingna ca a zing suesaapa a cuo aa!

“Ahungtahmuo byi pahning re kha hrie khu'a vyi; pakha kha hue'a te a hrangpa pakha kha a due aa, pakha'a lie kha zang tluo aa tlasa pata aw'a te a hrangpa pakha kha siysaa ri li pata a aw aa. Khazing re hne hnyirungna re kha hrie pakhe khu'a va ung ciy.

“Caacuonakawta ica chang yi, khaapama nama ning aa, khaapama nama dang aa, khaapa caw ma namaa tue aa ta pata nama pangpa kawlie hne nama hringna kawlie kha nama palung rie thyi khah se. Hringna ca sa laata biepuv vie te, pangpa ca cawsie laata a biepuv vie cuo va ma?

Avuo lie a zulepa pavaa zaw hing mang tie ung; saciy vaa va yi, sa zaw la pata be luo raw va yi, cuorasala vuoruo lie a awpa nama Paa ta ama riy a pabi thluo yi. Niema ca pavaa laata nama sungnaa vie karaa cuo va ma?
Nama palung rie a thyi nakawta nama hringna siymaluo pakha chuo a pasiy sa vie khupa nama aw ma?
Caacuonakawta khaapanakawma cawsie kawlie nama palung rie a thyi? Ruo lie lili paa khiy rue syalya tie ung, tuokhaatama ama le; re hrie va yi, palaa zaw pahie ra va yi.
Cuorasala ica chang yi, Solomon rungnaana bangkhuo ta hmuo, hingpa paapaapa paa kha puvthena tluv hing ta vyi.

Cuorasala ataning hring te mawluo myi chung luo hmaw riypa, ruo lie aphuv hing Khazing ta hing tluv ta a tuepangi kieca, niema changchiy ca ca tuepangi li pata aca aw'a yi ma? Nama zangna hing a caw hringhruo de!
Caacuonakawta, ‘Khaapama ma ning aa? Khaapama ma dang aa? Khaapama maa tue aa?’ ta pata nama palung rie thyi khah se.
Tahematapakieca hingpa hing ca Khazing a zang lipa tie ta ama palung rie a thyikhyi tawpa tana a cuo. Vuoruo lie a awpa nama Paa ta hingpa bangkhuo hing namaa hu diy tapa kha a pachang.
Cuorasala Khazing pena hne aa dangna kha huv taa ung la, hingpa hmang bangkhuo zaw hing pipuo pata nama cuo aa.
“Caacuonakawta mawluo cuota nama palung rie thyi khah se, mawluo ta amata tah palung rie thyina aa hnyi ra thluo aa. Ataning'apa ruvnaana hing ataning cuota aa de.
“Nama zaw bie ripapa na cuo li riypata malie bie kha va ripa khah.
Tahematapakieca malie bie na ripapa haa khata nama zaw bie ripa pata na cuo aa. Malie cuota na hmuopa panangna khata na nama zaw panangpa pata na cuo aa.
Na ming chunglie thingtung kha hmuo rue li pata tuokhaatama na uvnu ming chunglie mingbuo kha na mang?
Na ming chunglie thingtung a aw pata tuokhaatama na uvnu ca, ‘Na ming chunglie mingbuo kha ca lapa'a ang,’ na ta the?
Nama, phahruocuo, nama ming chunglie thingtung kha la taa la muo na uvnu ming chunglie mingbuo kha a siesa pata hmung'a cate na la the'a ta.

“A pathepa kha uv va pi khah ung; nama palelungvaa kha va hmiekunglie va thaw khah ung. Cahaacata nama tue kieca ama phyi ta ama chaapuo khutaata caa vya palichiy'a yi te, niema pali kha a ca sie'a yi.
“Hie ung la pi pata nama cuo aa; huv ung la nama hmung aa; cakhaw ung la ingchiy kha aca pahaw'a yi.
Tahematapakieca a hiepa bangkhuo ca pi pata cuo'a yi te, a huvpa bangkhuo ca ama hmung aa, a cakhawpa bangkhuo ca ingchiy kha pahawpa pata ama cuo aa.
Niema hrawlie hing nama saata tah viechuo caa hie yi sala alung a pipa pakha chuo nama aw'a ma?
Ngaa acaa hiepa yi ta pariy a pipa pakha chuo nama aw'a ma?

Niema a pha lipa tie ta nama saata zaw kha tuokhaatama hmang phapa i pi aa tapa nama pachang kieca, vuoruo lie a awpa nama paa changchiy ta ca ama'a lie a hiepa tie kha hmang phapa kha tluv tama a pi tyly'a yi?
“Malie ta ima cunglie vya tue yi se ta pata nama khingpa haa khata malie cunglie kha va tue tie ung; tahematapakieca hingpa hingna phungbie hne profet tie pacuvna ta a cuo.
“Chiypakaa baata taa khata a ngie tie ung. Tahematapakieca rana luo a sipa chiypakaa ca ku te a luopuv zaw a na, a ziypa zaw ama hluvsa.
Cuorasala hringna luo a sipa chiypakaa ca baa te a luopuv zaw a ruv, a hmungpa cawsaa zaw ama cawta.
“Tuv vang a buv yi te ama chung luo cahnie a hruopa a lupa, niema'a luo a vawpa profet pakhipa tie kha a raaring tie ung.
Iema ca ama thyipaa ta nama pachang aa. Ahling kung taata mingsuv thyi ama lu buo ma? Sahming kung taata thyikuv ama lu buo ma?
Cahaacata thingkung phapa ta thyi phapa pathyi te, cuorasala thingkung chiepa ta thyi chiepa a pathyi.
Thingkung phapa ta thyi chiepa pathyi vyi, thingkung chiepa ta thyi phapa pathyi ra vyi.
Thyi phapa a pathyi lipa thingkung bangkhuo ca hu pata myi luo thawpa a cuo aa.
Cahaacata profet pakhipa tie ca ama thyipaa khata nama pachang aa.
“'Abyipa, Abyipa,’ naa tapa mekaa ta vuoruo pena chung luo a ngie diy'a va yi, cuorasala vuoruo lie a awpa i Paa khingna a tuepa dyina a ngie aa.

Capa ning thue ca cawsaa hluvpuv ta kama kha, ‘Abyipa, Abyipa, na ming ta profetbiephu ma za ri, na ming ta khuevuo zaw za papya yi pate, na ming ta kharuehaa hmang zaw ma za tue cuo va ma?’ ina ta'a yi.
Cakhutaata kama ta iema kha, ‘Ca pachang buo va yi ang; cakuo ung, pha lina a tuepa zaw, i ta'a yi,’ a ta.
“Cakhutaata i bie hing thyi te cahaacata a tuepa ca alung cunglie ing a sapa cawsaa singpa haa tana a cuo.
Khy a saa, tiy a le, thliy khuopuv ta a vya hruo te capa ing ca a nuo tiyta, alung cunglie sapa a cuo nakawta a lie vyi.
I bie thyi raalaa te cahaacata a tue lipa ca viehnang cunglie ing a sapa a ngaapa haa tana a cuo.
Khy a saa, tiy a le, thliy khuopuv ta a vya hruo te a nuo ca, capa ing ca a lie te a ra patlaa diy!” a ta.
Zingsuv ta hing bie bangkhuo hing a ri khutaata cawsaazaapuv ca a pacuvnazya kha ama kharue a haasa,
tahematapakieca phungbie saya tie haata cuo li pata nawhnyituv pakha haata a pacuv nakaw yi ta a cuo.
Zingsuv ca tluocung taa khata za cung te cawsaa hluvpuv ta ama ziy.
Caahminghmaa a phyapa pakha a vaw te a hmielie a pakhuv pane te, “Abyipa, na khing pata a cuo kieca ina pathe sa khu ciy,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta a kuv pazuo te a hrie, “I khing. Pathe tie!” a ta. Capa paa a caahminghmaa ca sungkha ta a tluo.

Zingsuv ta, “Ahunghmuo chang'a va yi ciy; cadyiseca tluobyipa'a luo kha vaa la vaa pamang sa tie, cakhutaata cawsaa hmiekunglie i pathe tli tapa paluosana ta Moses ta tue riypa a za tapa hriykhungrina kha pihluo tie,,” a ta.
Zingsuv ca Kapernaum khy luo a vaa ngie ning kha riebyi pakha ta a vya taw te,
“Abyipa, i changtaapa pakha ca pakya te a pasa a ruv hringhruo nakawta ing liena a laa thluo,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “A vaw'a angte i patluo sa aa,” a ta.
Riebyipa ta, “Abyipa, kama ca i ingchung luo naa ngie riypata a tla va ang. Cuorasala na ryi kaa kha na pathlie kieca i changtaapa ca a tluo aa.

Tahematapakieca kama zaw hing i rieka tie hneta byi le viepa kuv rawlie a awpa tana i cuo. Pakha kha, ‘Cakuo,’ i ta kie cakuo te, a hrangpa pakha kha, ‘A vaw,’ i ta kie aa vaw; cakhutaata i sii a cuopa kha, ‘Hingpa hing tue,’ i ta kie a tue,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta capa bie ca a thyi tiyta a nang-uosa te ama a ziypa tie kha, “Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, hing haapa zangna a hnyipa Israel ming pakha hmuo hmung buo va ang.
Ica chang yi, ningchiy hne ningtla taata cawsaa hluvpuv ca a vaw'a yi te, vuoruo pena chunglie kha Abraham, Isak, Jakob zaw hneta sa ama ning aa,
capa ning ca vuoruo pena a cu riypa tie tlaku kha ale khyzingna luo thaw pata cuo'a yi te, capa lie ca caa'a yi te ama haa ama rie aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta riebyipa kha, “Cakuo tie; na zangna haata na cuota tuepa cuose,” a ta. Riebyipa changtaapa ca capa cuo lie ca ta a tluo.
Zingsuv ta Piter ing chung luo kha aa ngie tiyta, Piter piynung ca a luv ce te iehmang lie aa ziepa kha a hmung.
A kuv kha hrie te, a nge lingpa kha tluo te, thu te ama kha a mangsang.
Capa zuoluo lie ca khuevuo ta a tuepa cawsaa a hluvpuv kha ama'a luo ama vya chiykhyi. A bie kaa kha ta thlaapa zaw kha papya te a pasapa bangkhuo kha a patluo sa yi.
Hingpa hing profet Isaiah ta, “Ama ta ma tluo lina kha la te ma pasana zaw kha phya te a sikhyi,” a tapa a tlingna riypata a cuo.
Zingsuv ta a thaalie cawsaazaapuv kha a hmung tiy yi ta, riyliy huesuo luo vaa riypata a chang yi.
Phungbie saya pakha a vaw te, “Saya, na sina mekaa tana ica ziy aa,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Cahnie zaw ta khue hnyi yi te, avuo lie a zulepa pavaa zaw ta buv ama hnyi; cuorasala Cawsaa Sacapaa ca a luv china hmang hmuota hnyi vyi,” a ta.
Ama a ziytuv a cuopa a hrangpa pakha ta, “Abyipa, cakuo'a angte i paa kha va paby taa thi'a ang,” a ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta, “Na ziy tie, a thiypa tie ta amaa thiypa ca paby yi se,” a ta.
Zingsuv ca sawkawpalaw luo kie te ziytuv tie ta ama paziy.
Thliychie khuopuv ta a vya hruo te sawkawpalaw ca tiylaw ta buvkhung aa nang, cuorasala Zingsuv ca aa hmung.
Ziytuv tie ta vaa yi te ama pathu. “Malie khuo tie, Abyipa, vuotaa ma thiy diy'a nang hing!” ama ta.
Cakhutaata iema kyihuo khata, “A zangna diydyapa zaw, khaapanakawma nama thlaa a zang?” a ta yi. Cakhutaata thu te thliychie hne riyliy kha a chuo ca nesiyliy khata ama die.
Ama kharue ta haa te, “Tuokhaapa cawsaa tama a cuo? Thliychie hne riyliy tahmuo a ri amaa ngie,” ama ta.

Zingsuv ca riyliy huesuo Gadarenes pe luo kha a va chiy tiyta khuevuo ta aa hryipa cawsaa pahning ca thluo taata vya pya yi te ama kha amaa taw. Iema ca ciy amaa chiysa nakawta capa luopuv ca ahungtahmuo ziy nguo va yi.
Sungkhapuv ta khi yi te, “Khazing Sacapaa, tuokhaatama malie na tue khing? A cuo aa de hluo tama kiema riethyi pi riypata naa vaw,” ama ta.
Iema'a taata aa hlapuona lieta va a hluvpuv kha ama tle nguoluo.
Khuevuo tie ta Zingsuv kha paakie yi te, “Malie na papya kieca va chung luo hue malie pangie sa thi tie,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Cakuo tie ung!” a ta yi. Caacuonakawta pya yi te va chung luo ca ama vaa ngie; va bangkhuo ca sungkhabala ta lungkuo taata riyliy chung luo kha a zupathla yi te tiy lieta ama thiy diy.
Va a khiepa tie ca khy chung luo kha a ruo yi te, khuevuo a hnyipa cunglie a cuopa bangkhuo kha ama va chang.
Caacuonakawta khy chung cawsaa bangkhuo ca Zingsuv a taw riypata pya yi te, ama hmung ca, ama ruo taata pya riypata paa ama kie.
Zingsuv ca sawkawpalaw chung luo kha kie te riyliy kha va te pakhaa te a khy luo kha a pha.

A pakyapa pakha kha a pangphaa hne a vya puvle yi te amaa luo amaa vawkhyi. Zingsuv ta ama zangna kha a hmung tiyta a pakyapa paa kha, “I sacapaa, na palung a cahra sa, na suena ca a ngiethe pata na cuo tli,” a ta.
Cakhutaata phungbie saya tie chekha ta iema hne iema kha, “Hingpa cawsaa hing Khazing esepa tana bie a ri,” amaa ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta ama ruenapa kha a pachang nakawta, “Khaapanakawma hmang pha lipa ca nama rue?
‘Na suenapa ca a ngiethe pata na cuo tli,’ tapa ma a na vie, acuolikie ‘Thu la cakuo tie,’ tapa ma?

Cuorasala Cawsaa Sacapaa ta chuelyi lie hing sue a ngiethe khuna naw a hnyi tapa kha nama pachangna riypa tana a cuo,” ta te a pakyapa paa kha, “Thu la, na pangphaa kha a la lah ing luo cakuo tie,” a ta.
Cawsaapa ca thu te ing luo a cakuo.
Cawsaazaapuv ca ama kha ama hmung tiyta, ama nang uosa te, cawsaapa zaw'a lieta hing haapa nawhnyina a pipa Khazing kha ama pathuosa.
Zingsuv ca a vya cakuolepa khata Matthai ama tapa paa ngukhyina zung lie aa tu nguoluopa kha hmung te, “Na ziy tie,” a ta. Matthai ca thu te ama kha a ziy.
Cakhutaata sa ning riypata ing chunglie aa tu ning kha, ngukhyituv hluvpuv hne a suepa tie kha a vaw yi te, Zingsuv hne ziytuv tie'a lie kha amaa tu ra.
Farasi tie ta capa ca ama hmung tiyta, ziytuv tie kyihuo khata, “Khaapanakawma nama sayapa hing ngukhyituv tie'a nata a suepa zaw hneta sa a ning?” ama ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta a thyi tiyta, “A tluopa tie ta ca siyybyi a hu va yi, cuorasala a pasapa tie dyina a hu, a ta.

Cakuo ung la, ‘Hriykhungrina laata nangduena khana i khing vie,’ a tapa hingta khaapama a ri khing tapa kha va rue tie ung. Tahematapakieca kama ca aa dangpa tie ku riypata a vaw va ang, a suepa tie ku riypa tana i vaw,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Johan ziytuv tie kha Zingsuv'a luo a vaw yi te, “Khaapanakawma kiema hne Farasi ming hing sa maa uv lawmaw pata nama caa ziytuv tie hing sa a uv li pata ama aw?” ama ta.

Zingsuv ta, “Nung chiyna pyi luo kupa tie ca nungchiytuv satlie iema'a lie a aw kalie chung ca ngiechi pata ama aw the'a ma? Nungchiytuv satlie iema'a taata ama lana cuo kha vya tlung'a te, capa thue cata sa amaa uv aa.
Ahungtahmuo caw hlungpa kha caw thaapa ta a bie thla buo va yi, tahematapakieca caw thaapa khata thlaa lue hryly'a te a tlaa hryly aa.

Cahaacata savang ungchuo hlungpa lie kha mingsuvtiy ahrang raw buo va yi, ama raw kieca savang kha kyi'a te mingsuvtiy kha a zuv diy aa, savang ungchuo zaw a ra aa. Cuorasala savang thaapa chung luo kha mingsuvtiy ahrang ama raw kieca a suohning ta amaa bang aa,” a ta.

Zingsuv ta capa bie iema'a lie a ri nguoluo ning kha, apungna-ing uvthyi pakha a vaw te a hmiekunglie kha a pakhuv pane te, “Atabala hingna i sacanung ca a thiy; cuorasala a vaw la a cunglie na kuv na khang kieca a tluo aa,” a ta.
Zingsuv ca thu te ziytuv tie hne khata ama kha ama paziy.
Capa ning ca ta kung hraa hlyihning chung thiylang pasana ta a pasapa cawsaanung pakha ca Zingsuv hnangluo taa khata a vaw te a pangpeta kha a hrie.
Ama hne ama kha, “A pang chuo hing i hrie kieca i tluo aa,” aa ta.
Zingsuv ca a vya pali te, capa nung ca hmung te, “I sacanung, na palung a cahra sa, na zangnapa na caa patluo,” a ta. Ca khu pahne ta cawsaanung ca a tluo.
Zingsuv ca uvthyipa paa ingchung luo kha aa ngie tiyta, ramang a tungpa tie hne cawsaazaapuv amaa kalaa patlawpa kha a hmung ca,
“Pya diy ung, hingpa haatiynung hing thiy vyi, aa hmung nguoluo,” a ta. Iema ta ama pahnyisue.
Cuorasala cawsaazaapuv ama pya diy pahne ta, Zingsuv ca haatiynung khuo luo kha a ngie te, a buo ta va patuv te a kya thu.
Capa thuohlaa ca capa pe chung bangkhuo lie ca a pathuo diy.
Zingsuv ca capa taa cata pya te a cakuolepa khata mingcuepa pahning ta vya paziyle yi te, “David Sacapaa, ngie malie chi thi tie,” ta pata khuosa ta ama khi.
Zingsuv ca ing chung luo aa ngie tiyta mingcuepa pahning ca ama'a luo kha amaa vaw. Zingsuv ta, “Kama hingta ica patluo sa khu yi ta pata nama zang ma?” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Abyipa, ima zang,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta ama ming kha hrie te, “Nama zangna haata cuose,” ta yi te,
ama ming ca a vuo. Zingsuv ta, “Hingpa kaw hing ahunghmuo pachang khah yi se,” ta te iema kha a cusa pata a thlu yi.
Cuorasala cakuo yi te Zingsuv thuohlaa kha capa pe bangkhuo lie ca ama pathyi sa.
Iema ama cakuo khutaata khuevuo a hnyi nakawta bie a ri the lipa pakha kha Zingsuv'a luo amaa vawkhyi.
Khuevuo a papya khu pahne ta, cawsaapa ca ta bie a ri ca cawsaazaapuv ca ama nang ta uosa te, “Israel ming chunglie hing haapa hmang hing hmung buo vapuv,” ama ta.
Cuorasala Farasi ming ta, “Khuevuo tie byipa ming tana khuevuo tie a papya yi,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ca khypuv khyta bangkhuo kha tlawle te, apungna-ing chunglie kha a pacuv yi, pena thuophaa kha phu te, pasana phangting hne a pasapa zaw kha a patluo sa yi.
Cawsaazaapuv kha a hmung tiy yi ta, iema cunglie kha kawpacuona a hnyi, tahematapakieca iema ca khietuv a hnyi lipa tuv haata riethyivuosuo pata ama aw nakawta a cuo.
Cakhutaata ziytuv tie kha, “Sa hrie riypa a hluvsa a aw raalaa pata a hrietuv ca a cawta dyina a aw yi;
caacuonakawta sa hrie riypa a hnyituv Abyipa ta sa a hrietuv zaw a za pathlie riypa yi ta thlaachuo tie ung,” a ta yi.
Zingsuv ta ziytuv hlyihning tie kha ku yi te a pyalyipa thlaapa tie papya khuna hne pasana mekaa hne a pasapa tie patluo sa khuna kha a pi yi.
Hingpa hing lucuotuv hlyihning tie ming ta a cuo: pakhana ta Simon (Piter ama tapa paa) hne a nuta Andru; Zebedi sacapaa Jeim hne a nuta Johan;
Filip hne Bartholomew; Thomas hne ngukhyituv Matthai, Alfeas sacapaa Jeim, hne Tadias;
Kanaan ming Simon hne Zingsuv a lyituv Judas Iskariot ta ama cuo.
Zingsuv ta pahraa hlyihning tie kha pathlie yi te a raw luo haa hingta bie a taa yi: “Jentail ming ruo luo cuose, Samaria ming khy luo cuose a ngie khah ung.
Cuorasala Israel mingphang chungtaata a viepa tuv zaw'a luo kha vaa tie ung.
Vaa ung la thuo hlaa phapa kha va pathyi tie ung, ‘Vuoruo pena ca aa ngie tli.'

A pasapa kha patluo sa tie ung, a thiypa kha pathu pakhaa tie ung, caahminghmaa a phyapa kha pathe sa ung la, khuevuo kha papya tie ung. Niema ca a selawpa ta nama hmung, caacuonakawta a selawpa ta pi tie ung.
Siy, ngu hne daa tuokaa kha a cake khah ung.
Khytlawna riypa sahrie, buohryi zung hning, phyipakaw hne khuecahryi zaw kha a phya khah ung; rehrietuv ca amaa hupa kha ring riypa ama cuo.
Tuokhaapa khypuv cuose, khyta cuose namaa ngie tiyta palung tluosa pata ing tlung caa pa-awpa tie'a luo kha a ngie ung la, capa lie ca nama pya hluo li aw tie ung.
Ing luo namaa ngie tiyta bie a chang tie ung.
Capa ing ca aa phuv kieca ama cunglie diena tlung sala, aa phuv li kieca diena ca niema'a luo vya kaa se.
Pakhakha ta niema kha ca cuhluo lipa yi ta, nama bie zaw kha a naathlie li kieca, khapa ing acuolikie khapa khy kha nama sise tiyta nama phyipazaa lie buvcing kha cakhawsue siy tie ung.
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi: Bieripana ning thue ca capa khy laa cata Sodom hne Gomorrah ruo cuo tana nangduena a aw vie aa.
“Mang tie ung, Cahnie hraw luo pathliepa tuv zaw haa tana niema kha ica pathlie yi; caacuonakawta pariy haata sing ung la thuvruv haata nama nang ne se.
Iema kha a raaring tie ung, zung luo ca chiykhyi'a yi te apungna-ing lie kha asung ta aca tuv'a yi.
Kama kawlieta iema hne Jentail ming cunglie tehte cuo riypata uvtuv byi hne siepahruo hmieluo kha aca chiykhyi'a yi.
Bieripana zung luo aca chiykhyi tiy yi ta, tuokhaatama i ri aa tapa hne khaapama i ri aa tapa kha nama palung rie thyi khah se. Na ri riypa ca khapa cuo lie kha pi pata nama cuo aa.
Bie a rituv ca niema cuo va ung ciy, cuorasala nama Paa'a taata Thlaapa ta niema hmuo pata bie a ripa tana a cuo.
Uvta hne nuta kha thiyna phana te ta a lyi'a yi te, paa ta saata zaw, saata zaw ta nung hne paa kha thiyna phana te ta ama lyi aa.
Kama kawlieta cawsaa bangkhuo ta aca hue'a yi. Cuorasala a chuona te ta a ang pathla khupa ca khuo pata a cuo aa.
Khy kha lieta hrisaana nama ang kieca, khy hrang luo kha a ruo tie ung. Biehmisi tana ica chang yi: Cawsaa Sacapaa aa zuv hluota Israel ruo khy bangkhuo hing cahraw diy hmuo'a va ung ciy.
“Siengaachie ca a saya laata a suo vie vyi, sii zaw a byipaapa laata a suo vie vyi.

Siengaachie pakha ca a saya tluv a ta kieca aa de, sii pakha zaw a byipaapa tluv a ta kieca aa de. Ingchungkhue lie a luv ce a cuopa kha Beelzebul ama ta kieca, ingchungkhue ming changchiy ca kha tluv tama thuo pachi pata ama cuo aa! a ta.
“Caacuonakawta iema kha ciy khah ung; Buvkhungpa bangkhuo kha pahawpa cuo'a te, a paruv ta tuepa bangkhuo kha pachang pata a cuo aa.
A zingna chunglie ica changpa yi hing a khena chunglie va ri ung la, a paruv ta nama thyipa kha thlungkhuv daw taata phu tie ung.
Pangpa dyi thie khu te thlaapa a thie khu lipa kha ciy khah ung, pangpa hne thlaapa a suohning ta hell chunglie a thie khupa kha ciy vie tie ung.
Mingbaw sahning ca piesepa suokha tana ama zaa cuo va ma? Cuorasala khapa mingbaw sakha kha hmuo nama Paa pachang li pata alyi luo tla'a vyi.
Nama luv lie nama suobuv hmuota a ri diy.
Caacuonakawta nama thlaa zang khah se, niema ca mingbaw a hluvpuv laata nama sungnaa vie.
“Caacuonakawta malie hmiekunglie naa daakhyipa ahunghmuo cuose, kama zaw ta vuoruo i Paa hmiekunglie i daakhyi ra aa.
Cuorasala malie hmielie naa thawpa ca kama zaw ta vuoruo i Paa hmiekunglie i thaw ra aa,” a ta.
“Alyi luo diena phya riypa tana aa vaw ta pata na rue khah ung. Diena phya riypata a vaw va ang, cuorasala zueziy phya riypa tana i vaw.
I vaw hnuochuopa ca sacapaa kha paa padu sa riypa, sacanung kha nung padu sa riypa hne, munung kha ningnung padu sa riypa tana a cuo.
Nama carie ca nama ingchungkhue cawsaa mamaapa kha tana ama cuo aa.
Kama laata a paa acuolikie a nung a due viepa ca kama hneta a phuv vyi; a sacapaa acuolikie a sacanung a due viepa ca kama hneta a phuv vyi.
Ahunghmuo cuose vieluotung kha a puv pata kama hnang naa ziy lipa ca kama hneta a phuv vyi.
A hringna aa bangpa a khingpa tie ca ama hringna kha a sung'a yi te, cuorasala kama kawlieta a hringna a sungpa tie ca hringna kha ama hmung aa.
“Ahunghmuo cuose niema caa cuhluopa ca kama naa cuhluopa ta cuo te, kama naa cuhluopa ca kama naa pathlietuv a cuhluopa tana a cuo.
Profet kha profet a cuo nakawta a cuhluopa ca profet lawmuo kha hmung'a te, aa dangpa cawsaa kha aa dang nakawta a cuhluopa ca adangna lawmuo kha a hmung aa.
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, ahunghmuo cuose hing lieta a caw cepa pakha hing kama naa ziytuv a cuo nakawta tiy cakaapa nuo kha a pipa ca lawmuo kha hmung li pata aw'a vyi,” a ta.
Zingsuv ca ziytuv hlyihning kha bietaana a hnyi khutaa yi ta, iema khypuv zaw lieta pacuv riypa hne a bie phu riypata capa taa cata a cakuo.
Tiynawtuv Johan ca Khrih ta a tuepa hmang kaw kha thaw-ing chungtaata a thyi tiyta, a hnangziytuv tie'a taa khata
bie taa te, “Nama hing a vaw riypa paa cata na cuo ma, acuolikie cawsaa hrangpa kha ma huo kalie'a ma?” a pata sa yi.
Zingsuv ta, “Vaa ung la nama thyipa hne nama hmungpa hing Johan ca va chang tie ung:

a ming cuepa tie ta ama hmung, a phyi cabiepa tie ta ama cakuo, caahminghmaa a phyapa tie ama pathe, a naa ruepa tie ta ama thyi, a thiypa tie thu pakhaa yi te, a siypasapa tie kha thuophaa chang pata ama cuo.
Kama naa du lipa tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo,” a ta.
Johan ziytuv tie ama kaa taata Zingsuv ta cawsaazaapuv kha Johan kaw a chang yi: “Khaapa mang riypata ma ruocaapa luo ca nama pya? Thliy ta a canyipa phiepahlaa kung ma?
Khaapa mang riypata ma nama pya? Cawsie phasapa a tuepa pakhakha mang riypata ma? Cawsie phasapa a tuepa tie ca siepahruo ing lie muo ama aw ta.
Khaapa mang riypata ma nama pya? Profet ma? A cuo, ica chang yi, profet laata a le viepa tana a cuo.
Caapathe lie a kaw a capepa ca, ‘Mang tie, nama luo caa sa daw riypa tana i biephyatuv kha na hmieluo ta i pathlie aa,' a ta.
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, canung ta ama sapa zaw hrawlieta Tiynawtuv Johan laata a le viepa ahunghmuo aw va yi; cuorasala vuoruo pena chunglie a caw cepa ca Johan laata a le vie.
Tiynawtuv Johan chuo taata ataning tepa hingta vuoruo pena ca a duna khuopuv ta ang te, a dutuv tie ta hruohra ta la amaa ting.
Johan aa vawna te khata profet bangkhuo hne Moses phungbie ta vuoruo pena kaw hing profetbiephu ama rilu;
capa bie ca nama zang khing kieca, Johan hing a vaw riypa Elijah kha tana a cuo.
Thyina naa a hnyipa ca thyi tie ung!
“Ata chuo cawsaa zaw hing khaapa hneta ma i pakhingpuo'a yi? Chadawtluo lie a tu yi te phuv kha hne phuv kha a khisue pata,
‘Ramang maca tungpa yi, cuorasala luo va ung ciy; caana hlaa maacaa ngiypa yi, cuorasala caa va ung ciy,’ a tapa haatiy tie hne tana amaa lu.
Johan ca ning li dang li pata aa vaw tiyta, ‘Khuevuo na a hnyi'; ama ta.

Cawsaa Sacapaa ca ningpuo dangpuo pata aa vaw tiyta, ‘Mang tie ung, ning a rangpa hne sahmaa a rangpa, ngukhyituv tie hne a suepa tie viesaa tana a cuo!’ ama ta. Cuorasala, singna ca a thyipaa na a paluo sa,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta kharuehaa hmang hluv vie bangkhuo a tuenapa khypuv lie cawsaa tie kha ama suena amaa ngiepachiy li nakawta a mawchie yi.

“Khorazin, bawchie ciemuopa tana na cuo! Bethsaida, bawchie ciemuopa tana na cuo! Niema'a lie tuepa kharuehaa hmang hing Tair hne Sidon lie tue pata za cuo sala, buri a buv pata, buvcuo a phuv'a yi te amaa ngiepachiynapa a za pasiysa'a mangtli.
Cuorasala ica chang yi: Bieripana ning thue ca niema laa hingta Tair hne Sidon cuo tana nangduena a aw vie aa.

Cakhutaa, nama Kapernaum, Vuoruo te cyicalangpa tama na cuo aa? Cuo'a vyi, hell luo thawpa tana na cuo aa. Nama'a lie tuepa kharuehaa hmang bangkhuo hing Sodom lie tue pata za cuo sala, ataning te hingta aa hmang kalie aa.
Cuorasala ica chang, bieripana ning thue ca nama laa hingta Sodom cuo tana nangduena a aw vie aa,” a ta.
Capa cuo ning kha, Zingsuv ta, “I Paa, alyi hne avuo Byipa, a singpa hne a thepa tie'a taata na nupa kha haatiy tie'a lie na paluo sa nakawta icaa law;
a cuo, i Paa, capa ca na vihnyina cangta na khingpa tana a cuo.

I Paa ta hmangting bangkhuo ina pi diy tli. Paa ta li pata Sacapaa kha ahungtahmuo pachang va yi, cakhutaata Sacapaa hne Sacapaa ta a tlaw yi te iema'a lie a phupa tie ta li pata ca a hungtahmuo Paa kha pachang va yi.
“A rie a thyipa hne hmangriy a phyapa bangkhuo kama'a luo a vaw tie ung, ica pahy sa'a yi.
I syihnaa kha a la pata phya ung la, kama'a taa hingta a cuv tie ung; tahematapakieca kama ca a nangnepa hne raw a canawpa ta cuo angte, apahyna kha nama hmung aa.
Tahematapakieca i syihnaa phya ca na te, i hmang ca aa hy,” a ta.
Capa cuo ning, sabbath ning kha Zingsuv ca lu kha cahrawpaale te a si. Ziytuv tie ca ama nang a diy nakawta sa-uv kha pahriy paale yi te a chuo kha ama baale.
Farasi ming ta ama hmung tiyta, Zingsuv kha, “Mang tie, caa ziytuv tie na phungbie ta a thlupa kha Sabbath ning ta a tue yi,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Ama hne a cawsaa zaw ama nang a diy ning kha David ta khaapama a za tue tapa kha ri buo va ung ca ma?
Khazing ing chung luo kha a ngie te ama cuose, a cawsaa zaw cuose, ning phung a cuo lipa, tluobyi tie dyi ta ning riypa, Phuovaa viechuo a ningpa kha.
Cakhutaata Sabbath ning ta tluobyi tie ta Biena-ing chunglie Sabbath phung kha ama para thluo pata a sue ta pata ama cuo lipa kha phungbie caa-uv chunglie ri buo va ung ca ma?
Ica chang yi, biena-ing laata a le viepa na hingpa lie hing a aw.
Caapathe ta, ‘Hriykhungrina laata nangduena khana i khing vie,’ a tapa hingta khaapama a ri khing tapa kha pachang ung la ca, a sue lipa kha sue be'a va ung ciy.
Tahematapakieca Cawsaa Sacapaa ca sabbath byi tana a cuo,” a ta.
Zingsuv ca khapa hmang taa khata pya te apungna-ing luo kha aa ngie. Capa lie ca a kuv a pakyapa paa kha a za aw.
Ama kha ama pachie khing nakawta, “Sabbath ning ta cawsaa patluo sa phung a cuo ma?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta iema kha, “Abiephungpa ta niema chung taa pakhakha hingta tuv sakhata dyi hnyi ung la, capa nama tuv ca Sabbath ning ta khue chung luo a tla kieca, thue li pata nama aw'a ma?
Cawsaa ca tuv laata kha tluv tama muo a hnyi vie! Caacuonakawta Sabbath ning ta hmang phapa tue ca a phung ta a cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata cawsaapa paa kha, “Na kuv pazuo,” a ta. Pazuo te a kuv ca hra kha luo haa khata a tluo.
Farasi ming ca cakuo yi te, Zingsuv para khuna riypa kha khue ama khuo.
Zingsuv ta capa kaw ca a pachang tiyta, capa taa cata a pya. Cawsaazaapuv ta ziy yi te, ama bangkhuo khata a patluo sa yi,
a kaw kha ahunghmuo pachang sa li riypata bie a pi yi.
Hing haa hingta a tuepa ca profet Isaiah pakaa taata Khazing ta:
“Hingpa lie hingna i changtaapa, i tlawpa, i duepa, i tlechuopa ca a aw. A cunglie i Thlaapa chi'a angte, ama ta adangna bie kha Jentail ming'a luo a pathyi sa aa.
Ama ca bie i li'apa yi ta khuopuv ta khi'a vyi, a hungtahmuo a ueryi kha luopuv lie thyi'a va yi.
Adangna kha tena a pacuo sa hluo li chaapuo cie tlipa phiepahlaa kung kha thli lue li'a pata, a thiy'a nangpa myi-ing kha pache'a vyi.
Ama ming ta Jentail ming kha anguopuona ama hnyi aa,” a tapa patling sa riypa tana a cuo.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv'a luo kha khuevuo ta aa hryi nakawta a ming cue te bie a ri khu lipa kha amaa vawkhyi. Zingsuv ta patluo sa te, bie ri khu te a ming zaw a vuo pakhaa.
Cawsaazaapuv ca ama nang ta uosa te, “Hingpa paa hing David sacapaa ta a cuo'a ma?” ama ta.
Cuorasala Farasi ming ta capa bie ca ama thyi tiyta, “Hingpa paa ta khuevuo a papya khupa ca khuevuo byipa Beelzebul ta naw a pi nakaw tana a cuo,” ama ta.

Zingsuv ta khaapama ama rue tapa kha pachang te, iema kha, “Khaapa pena hmuo cuose iema hne iema a che yi te a dupa tie ca rana luo na ama chiy aa. Cakhutaata khypuv khy kha acuolikie ingchungkhue khue kha ca a che te iema hne iema amaa du kieca a daa khu'a va yi.
Cahaacata Setaa ta Setaa kha a papya kieca ama hne ama a dupa cuo te, a pena ca tuokhaatama a daa khu aa?
Kama na Beelzebul ming ta khuevuo a papya ang tapa kieca khuevuo papyatuv nama cawsaa tie kha haw ahung ming ta ma khuevuo kha ama papya? Caacuonakawta iema khana niema cuota bieripatuv a cuo'a yi.
Cuorasala kama na Khazing Thlaapa Pathe ming ta khuevuo kha a papya ang ta pata a cuo kieca, Khazing pena ca niema'a luo a vya pha tli.
Cawsaa thaaruvpa paa kha ciypaki taa li pata ahungma a ingchung luo a ngie pata a chechiy kha a lapa khu aa? A ciypaki taa kie dyina a la khu aa.
Kama naa daakhyi lipa ca naa dutuv tana a cuo; pahmya pakhaw naa bya lipa ca a cadaapatlaatuv tana a cuo.

Caacuonakawta, ica chang yi: cawsaa hing ama suena mekaa hne Khazing ming ripachiena bie ama ripa mekaa ca a ngiethe pata ama cuo aa, cuorasala Thlaapa ripachiena bie ama ripa ca a ngiethe pata cuo'a va yi.
Cawsaa Sacapaa a du pata bie a ripa ca a ngiethe pata ama cuo aa, cuorasala Thlaapa Pathe a du pata bie a ripa ca ata chuo lie cuose, hmieluo chuo lie cuose a ngiethe pata cuo'a va yi.
“Thingkung phapa ca a thyi zaw a pha, thingkung chiepa ca a thyi zaw a chie; thingkung ca a thyi ta pachang khupa tana a cuo.
Pariy ciypathla tie zaw! Cawsaa chiepa nama cuo pata ca tuokhaatama bie phapa ca nama ri the aa? Pakaa ca pathiypalung chunglie a bipa khana a ri.
Cawsaa phapa ta ca hmang phapa a pacungpa chung taa khata hmang phapa pachiy te, cawsaa chiepa ta ca hmang pha lipa a pacungpa chung taa khata hmang pha lipa kha a papya.
Ica chang yi, nama pakaa taata biesiysapawpa nama ripa bangkhuo cuo khata khaapanakawma i za ri tapa kha bieripana ning thueta ca nama pasie sa a hu aa.
Niema bie mamaapa khata duopacupa cuo'a ung cate, niema bie mamaapa khata sue bieripa pata nama cuo aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Phungbie saya tie hne Farasi tie chekha ta, “Saya, na tuepa pamangsana suokha na ma hmung khing,” ama ta.

Cuorasala Zingsuv ta, “A pha lipa hne Khazing hmiekunglie zang tluo aa tla lipa mingphang na pamangsana a hie ung ciy, cuorasala Profet Jonah pamangsana ta li pata pamangsana suokha hmuo tuepa pata cuo'a va ung ciy.
Jonah ta ngapuv riy chunglie ning thung hne zuo thung a awpa haa khata Cawsaa Sacapaa zaw alyi chunglie ning thung hne zuo thung a aw ra aa.

Bieripana ning thueta Nineveh khy ming kha a daa'a yi te ata chuo cawsaa zaw kha sue ama phaw aa, tahematapakieca iema ca Jonah phupa bie tana sue amaa zaa ngiepachiy; mang tie ung, Jonah laata a le viepa na hingpa lie hing a aw!

Bieripana ning thueta Sungluo ruo siepahruonung kha a daa'a te ata chuo cawsaa zaw kha sue a phaw yi, tahematapakieca Solomon singna naathlie riypa tana alyi dena taata a kya tlaw, cakhutaata mang tie ung, Solomon laata a le viepa na hingpa lie hing a aw!
“A pyalyipa thlaapa ca cawsaa chungtaa khata pya te, tiy aw linapa ruocaapa chunglie kha a pahyna hmang huv riypata aa khie, cuorasala suv kha hmuo hmung vyi.
Caacuonakawta ama ta, ‘I pyase ciepa i ing luo khana i kaa pakhaa aa,’ a ta. A kaa ca a ing kha a hripa, a pathesa pata hne aa chikaky pata a za awpa kha a hmung.

Cakhutaata vaa te ama laata a chie viepa thlaapa chiepa pasariy kha a vya chiy yi te, a ngie yi te capa lie ca ama aw. Capa cawsaapa a chuona lie aa daahmang ca a za cuo taana laa khata a chie vie. Cahaapa cana ata chuo cawsaa pha lipa zaw cunglie hing a tlung aa,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta cawsaazaapuv'a lie bie a ri nguoluo ning kha a nung hne a nuta zaw ca ama kha bie ama rihne khing nakawta ale lie a daa yi te ama huo.
Cawsaa pakha ta, “Mang tie, na nung hne na nuta zaw na bie rihne riypata ale lie caa huo yi,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta capa paa kyihuo cata, “Ahung zaw kha ma i nung hne i nuta zaw ta a cuo yi?” a ta.
Cakhutaata ziytuv tie kha a kuvdaw ta daw yi te, “Iema hingna i nung hne i nuta zaw ta a cuo yi!
Ahunghmuo cuo sala vuoruo lie a awpa i Paa khingna a tuepa ca i nuta, i sieta hne i nung tana ama cuo,” a ta.
Capa ning ngiethie ca ta Zingsuv ca ing taa khata pya te riyliy kielie kha aa tu.
A vya hmyasuepa cawsaazaapuv kha ama hluv tuv nakawta sawkawpalaw chung luo kha kie te aa tu, zaapuv ca ngiekuo lie kha amaa tu.
Pakhingpuona a hluvsa kha hmuo te a pacuv yi: “Naathlie tie ung! Saciy vaatuv pakha ca saciy vaa riypata a si.
Saciy kha a vaa tiyta, chekha ca luopuv lie kha tla te pavaa ta amaa haa.
Chekha ca lungdaapa, alyi aa paana lieta ama tla. Alyi kha a chaa li nakawta saciy ca a pu paluo.
Ning kya chiy te sadaa kha a e ca a thariy aa thuv li nakawta a caa diy paluo.
Saciy chekha ca ahling hrawlie kha ama tla. Ahling khata kya le te a kalaa.
Saciy chekha ca alyi phana lie kha tla te a che ta le zakha, a che ta le sawcaruv, a che ta le sawthung ama vyi.
Thyina naa a hnyipa ca thyi tie ung!” a ta.
Cakhutaata ziytuv tie ca Zingsuv'a luo kha a vaw yi te, “Khaapanakawma cawsaa kha pakhingpuona hmuo pata bie na chang yi?” ta pata ama hiehriy.
Zingsuv ta, “Niema ca vuoruo pena kaw bieparuv pachang khuna kha pi pata nama cuo, cuorasala iema ca cuo va yi.
A hnyipa tie kha a hluv vie ta pipa cuo'a yi te a hlyikhungna te ta ama hnyi aa; cuorasala khaapahmuo a hnyi lipa tie kha a hnyi tlakuopa kha hmuo lapa pata ama cuo aa.
Iema'a lie pakhingpuona i hmuonapa siyluo ca, ‘A mang ca mang raalaa yi te hmung va yi, naathlie raalaa yi te thyi va yi, a pachang zaw pachang ra va yi,’ tanapa tana a cuo.

Profet Isaiah ta a ripa profetbiephu ca iema cunglie a tling hmisi. A ripa ca: ‘Naa ca nama thlie aa, cuorasala a siyluo pachang'a va ung ciy, A mang ca nama mang raalaa aa, cuorasala hmungpasie the'a va ung ciy.

Tahematapakieca hingpa cawsaa tie palung ca ping te, ama naa ta thyi khu li pata, ama ming kha ama pasing. Capa ca ama ming ta mang li'apa yi ta, ama naa ta thyi li'apa yi ta, ama palung ta pachang the li'apa yi ta, kama'a luo amaa vya pali li riypa hne, kama ta i patluosa li riypa yi kha tana a cuo,’ a ta.
Cuorasala nama ming zaw ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo, tahematapakieca a hmung, nama naa zaw thluechiypa tana a cuo, tahematapakieca a thyi.

Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, profet hluvpuv hne cawsaa aa dangpa tie hluvpuv zaw ta niema nama hmungpa hing ama za hmung khing hringhruo, cuorasala za hmung va yi, ama za thyi khing hringhruo, cuorasala za thyi va yi.
“Cakhutaata, saciy a vaatuv pakhingpuona siyluo hing naathlie tie ung.
Cawsaa pakha ta vuoruo pena kaw kha thyi raalaa te a siyluo a pachang li tiyta, a pha lipa paa kha a vaw te pathiypalung chunglie tuvpa saciy ca a lapa yi; capa ca luopuv lie a tlapa saciy ta a cuo.
Khazing bie kha ama thyi pahne ta palung tluosa pata a cuhluopa tie ca, lungdaa cunglie a tlapa saciy khata ama cuo.
Cahaapaapa cawsaa zaw chunglie ca aa thuvpuv ta hruo a thla li nakawta cuo pachangta dyi hring te, capa bie kawlieta ruvnaana hne hrisaana aa vaw tiyta amaa lie paluo.
Ahling hrawlie a tlapa saciy tapa ca, Khazing bie kha thyi raalaa te, cuorasala hingpa chuelyi khysatungbangna kaw, hne hnyirung khingnapa ta capa bie ca kalaa yi te thyipaa hnyi khu va yi.

Cuorasala alyi phana lie a tlapa saciy tapa ca, Khazing bie kha thyi te a siyluo zaw a pachangpa khata ama cuo. Thyipaa kha hnyi te chekha ta le zakha, chekha ta le sawcaruv, chekha ta le sawthung ama vyi,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta pakhingpuona hrangpa kha a chang yi: “Vuoruo pena ca a lu chunglie saciy phapa a vaapa paa haa kha tana a cuo.
Cawsaa mekaa amaa hmung chung khata, cariepa pakha a vaw te saciy hrawlie kha lubi ciy vaa te aa ruose.
Caacuonakawta sakung ca kya le te a uv tiyta lubi kung ca aa kya luo ra.
Ingziypa a sii zaw kha a vaw yi te, ‘Abyipa, na lu lie kha saciy phapa na na vaa cuo va ma? Khaapa taata ma lubi hing ama kya pu?’ ama ta.
Ama ta, ‘Hingpa hmang hing ma cariepa na a tue,’ a ta yi. Iema ta, ‘Lubi ca va phiepa sala na khing'a ma?’ ama ta.
Ama ta, ‘Phie'a va ung ciy; tahematapakieca lubi nama phie pata sakung kha phiepuo pathlyi'a kie ung ciy.

Sa hrie tiy a tana te ta lehne thluo yi se. Sa hrie cuo thueta sa a hriepa tie kha, lubi kha pakhaw taa ung la myipung luo thaw riypata cataw tie ung, cuorasala sa ca i sa-ing luo kha raw tie ung, i ta'a yi,’ a ta,” a ta yi.
Zingsuv ta pakhingpuona hrangpa kha a chang yi: “Vuoruo pena ca cawsaa pakha ta uotuo hmung kha la te a lu lie a vaapa hne tana aa lu.
Saciy hrawlieta a caw cepa saciy ta a cuo, cuorasala a kya le tiyta sakung hrawlie a le cepa ta a cuo, caacuonakawta pavaa zaw kha a vaw yi te a ce lieta buv amaa vya tue,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta pakhingpuona hrangpa suokha a chang kalie yi: “Vuoruo pena ca canung pakha ta viedie beke zung thung lie a pyapa, capa viedie a pathu sapa thiynung hne tana aa lu,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta hingpa hmang bangkhuo hing zaapuv kha a chang tiy yi ta pakhingpuona kha a hmuo, pakhingpuona hmuo li pata suokha hmuo chang va yi.
Hingpa hing profet ta a za ripa a tlingna riypa tana a cuo: “Pakhingpuona hmuo pata iema kha bie i chang'a yi; Chuelyi sa hruothu baataata za nupa hmang kha i phu aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata, Zingsuv ca cawsaazaapuv kha thuse yi te ingchung luo aa ngie. Ca tiyta ziytuv tie kha ama'a luo a vaw yi te, “Lu chunglie lubi pakhingpuona a siyluo kha malie chang tie,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Saciy phapa a vaatuv ca Cawsaa Sacapaa ta a cuo.
Lu ca chuelyicung ta a cuo; saciy phapa ca vuoruo pena a cuhluopa tie ta ama cuo. Lubi ca cawsaa pha lipa paa saata zaw ta ama cuo.
Saciy pha lipa a vaatuv cariepa ca khachie ta a cuo. Sa hrie cuo ca chuelyi cuo chuona cuota cuo te sa a hrietuv tie ca avuoming ta ama cuo.
Lubi ca pakhaw yi te myipung luo ama hmawpa haa khata chuelyi cuo chuo thue ca a cuo ra aa.
Cawsaa Sacapaa ta aa vuoming kha za pathlie'a yi te, a pena chunglie pha lina a tuetuv bangkhuo hne cawsaa a pasue satuv bangkhuo kha pahmya'a yi te,
iema ta capa tie ca caana hne haa riena a awnapa myipung chung luo kha ama thaw aa.
Cakhutaata aa dangpa tie ca ama Paa pena chunglie kha ning haata ama khe aa. Thyina naa a hnyipa ca thyi tie ung!

“Vuoruo pena ca lu chunglie ama nupa sue sungnaapa haa tana a cuo. Cawsaa pakha ta a hmung tiyta nu siy te, ing luo kha kaa te, palung tluosa pata a hnyipa bangkhuo kha zaa te capa lu ca a calyi,” a ta.
“Vuoruo pena ca palelungvaa phapa a huvpa sung a palipa pakha haa tana a cuo.
Palelungvaa muosung ciemuopa kha a hmung tiyta a hnyipa bangkhuo kha zaa te capa palelungvaa ca a calyi.
“Vuoruo pena ca tiyliy chung luo vaa yi te ngaa phangtling a pa-uopa asue haa tana a cuo.
Asue lie ngaa a bi pahne ta ngiekuo luo a da pathla yi te, a tu yi te ngaa kha ama che, a phapa tie kha ama sawpaa chung luo pasuo yi te, a chiepa tie ca ama thaw.
Cuo chuonapa ning thueta ca capa haa ca tana a cuo aa. Avuoming kha vaale'a yi te cawsaa phapa hraw taata cawsaa chiepa kha pache'a yi te,
caana hne haa riena a awnapa myipung chung luo kha ama thaw aa.
“Hingpa bangkhuo hing nama thyi the ma?” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Ma thyi the,” ama ta.

Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta iema kyihuo khata, “Vuoruo pena cuota pacuv tlipa phungbie saya ca, a suethiy china ing chungtaata suethiy thaapa hne suethiy hlungpa a papyapa ingziypa haa tana a cuo,” a ta yi.
Zingsuv ca pakhingpuona bangkhuo a chang khutaa yi ta capa hmang taa cata a pya.
A khy luo kha vaa te apungna-ing lie kha a pacuv yi ca ama kharue ta haasa te, “Hingpa cawsaa hingta hingpa singna hne hmang tue khuna hing khaapa taata ma a hmung?
Lettamaapa sacapaa khata cuo va ma? A nung kha Mary ama ta cuo va ma? Jeim, Josef, Simon hne Judas kha a nuta zaw ta cuo va yi ma?
A sieta zaw bangkhuo kiema'a lie hingna ama aw diy cuo va ma? Khaapa taata ma hingpa bangkhuo hing a hmung aa?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ca cuhluo khu va yi. Cuorasala Zingsuv ta, “Profet ca a khy lie hne a ingchungkhue lie ta li pata hmangting lieta ama pa-uvsathyi,” a ta.
Zangna ama hnyi li nakawta capa lie ca kharuehaa hmang a hluvsa tue vyi.
Capa cuo ning ca uvtuv Herod ta Zingsuv kaw kha thyi te,
a changtaapa zaw kyihuo khata, “Hingpa paa hing tiynawtuv Johan tana a cuo, thiyna taa tana a thu pakhaa, caacuonakaw tana hingpa kharuehaa hmang hing a tue khu” a ta yi.
Herod ta a nuta Filip napuv Herodias kawlieta Johan kha patuv te, a cakhiy sa khutaa yi ta thaw a pathla.
Tahematapakieca tiynawtuv Johan ta Herod kha, “Herodias naa hlawpa hing a phung ta cuo vyi,” a za ta nakawta a cuo.
Herod ta a thie khing raalaa pata cawsaazaapuv kha a ciy yi, tahematapakieca iema ta Johan kha profet tana a cuo ta pata ama rue.
Cuorasala Herod puvnapa ning a vya chiy tiyta, Herodias sacanung ca zaapuv hmielie kha luo te, Herod ca a palung a tluo hringhruo nakawta
ama kha khaapa aa hie zaw pi riypata chie a sa te bie aa kuo.
A nung ta a pasupa haata, “Tiynawtuv Johan luv kha hingpa daa pakhue hingta na pi tie,” a ta.
Siepahruo ca a ngie a chi, cuorasala chie a sa te bie aa kuo nakawta hne a khyche tie hmie a mang nakaw yi ta pi riypata naw pi yi te,
thaw-ing chunglie Johan luv kha a pate sa yi.
Johan luv ca daa pakhue ta vya cyi yi te lesaanung kha ama pi, ama ta a nung'a luo kha a cyile.
Johan a ziytuv tie kha a vaw yi te a riyy ca la yi te ama paby; cakhutaata vaa yi te Zingsuv kha ama va chang.

Zingsuv ca Johan thuohlaa a thyi tiyta capa hmang taa cata pya te sawkawpalaw ta ruocakung luo kha ama seta a vaa. Cuorasala cawsaazaapuv ta capa thuo ca ama thyi tiyta, khy taa khata ama phyi ta cakuo yi te ama kha ama ziy.
Zingsuv ca ngiekuo luo a pya tiyta, cawsaazaapuv kha a hmung yi; iema kha ngiechi hringhruo yi te, a pasapa kha a patluo sa yi.

Zuoluo a vya cuo tiyta, ziytuv tie ca ama'a luo kha a vaw yi te, “Ruocakung na lieta a cuo, ning zaw aa ngiesa tli. Cawsaa hing pathlie yi la, hingpa cahriylie a awpa khy luo hing iemata tah ning riypa vaa calyi yi se,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Iema cakuo a hu vyi, niema ta ning riypa suokha chuo pi tie ung,” a ta yi.
Iema ta, “Ma hnyipa bangkhuo ca viechuo tluo pangaa hne ngaa sahning hing tana a cuo,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Capa viechuo hne ngaa ca ama'a luo hing vya cyi tie ung,” a ta yi.

Cakhutaata cawsaazaapuv ca aphuv cunglie a patu sa yi. Viechuo tluo pangaa hne ngaa sahning kha la te, avuo luo kha ang te, Khazing'a luo alawna bie a hluo khutaata viechuo kha chechi te ziytuv tie kha a pi yi, ziytuv tie ta cawsaazaapuv kha ama re.
Ama bangkhuo ta ning yi te ama riy a bi; ziytuv tie ta ama ning buopa a zungpepa kha pahmya yi te beke zung hraa hlyihning a ta.
A ningpa ca canung hne haatiy ri li pata capaa seta thawpangaa hraw ama ta.
Ca khu pahne ta Zingsuv ta cawsaazaapuv a pathlie nguoluo ning yi khata ziytuv tie ca sawkawpalaw luo kha pakie sa yi te riyliy huesuo luo kha a pasi sa lu yi.
Cawsaazaapuv a pathlie diy khutaa yi khata, tluocung luo kha thlaachuo riypata ama se ta a kie. Zingsuv ca khy a zingna te khata capa lie ca ama se ta a aw.
Sawkawpalaw ca ngiekuo taata aa hlapuv a chiy tli pata hmiepachaw ta a vya hruopa thliy aa taw nakawta tiylaw ta a cathlule ciemuo.
Zingsuv ca mawdiy khata tiy cunglie vya cakuole te ziytuv tie'a luo kha aa vaw.
Cuorasala ziytuv tie ta riyliy cunglie a cakuopa kha ama hmung tiyta ama thlaa zang hringhruo te, “Athlaa!” ta pata ama khi.
Zingsuv ta sungkhabala ta iema kha, “Nama thlaa zang khah se, Kama tana i cuo, ciy khah ung,” a ta yi.
Piter ta, “Abyipa, nama ta na cuo kieca tiy cunglie vya cakuo pata nama'a luo kha na pavaw sa tie,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “A vaw tie,” a ta. Caacuonakawta Piter ca sawkawpalaw chung taa cata cung te tiy cunglie ca a phyi ta cakuo te Zingsuv'a luo ca a vaa.
Cuorasala khuopuv ta thliy aa hruopa kha a hmung tiyta ciy te tiy chung luo kha a tlale ca, “Abyipa, na khuo tie!” ta pata a khi.
Zingsuv ta yi kha ta va paza te a va patuv khutaata, “Na zangnapa na a caw hringhruo de, khaapanakawma palung luolue pata na aw?” a ta.
Ama pahning ta sawkawpalaw luo kha kie yi te thliy ca a die.
Cakhutaata sawkawpalaw chunglie a awpa tie ta abie yi te, “Nama ca Khazing Sacapaa hmisi tana na cuo,” ama ta.
Riyliy kha va te yi te, Genesaret ruo luo kha ama va chiy.
Capa hmang lie cawsaa zaw khata Zingsuv ca ama pachang. Caacuonakawta a kiecahriy khy bangkhuo kha bie pathyi sa yi te a pasapa bangkhuo kha Zingsuv'a luo ca amaa vawkhyi.
A pangpeta chuo ama hrie the riypata Zingsuv ca paakie yi te, a pangpe a hriepa bangkhuo ca ama tluo.
Cakhutaata Farasi tie hne phungbie saya tie ca Jerusalem taa khata Zingsuv'a luo a vaw yi te,
“Khaapanakawma caa ziytuv tie ta mingnungmingpa tie phungluo kha ama para? Tahematapakieca sa ning hluota ama kuv a siy va yi,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Khaapanakawma niema zaw hing niema phungluo kawlieta Khazing nawbie kha nama para? a ta yi.
Khazing ta, ‘Na nung hne na paa va ciyzaa yi, a nung acuolikie a paa kawchie a ripa ca a thiy hrahring aa,’ a ta.
Cuorasala niema ta, cawsaa pakhakha ta a nung ma, a paa ma bya riypata chechiy a hnyipa kha, ‘Hingpa hing ca Khazing huopa tana a cuo,’ a ta kieca a nung cuose a paa cuose bya a hu va tli, nama ta.
Caacuonakawta nama phungluo kawlieta Khazing bie kha nama pavie nama pavuvle.
Niema, phahruocuo tie! Profet Isaiah ta niema kaw profetbiephu a ripa hing aa hmuopa tana a cuo:
‘Hingpa cawsaa zaw hingta ama pakaa ta na pa-uvsathyi yi te, cuorasala ama pathiypalung ca kama hneta aa hlasa.
Cawsaa ta tuechawpa phung kha ziy riypata ama pacuv, kama inaa biepa yi hing thlahnena khaapahmuo hnyi vyi,’ a za ta,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta cawsaazaapuv kha ama'a luo ku yi te, “Naathlie ung la pachang tie ung:
cawsaa a papya a palyituv hing a pakaa taata a ngiepa cuo li pata, a pakaa taata a pyapa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata ziytuv tie kha ama'a luo a vaw yi te, “Na ripa hingta Farasi tie palung a pasa sa yi tapa pachang va ca ma?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Vuoruo lie a awpa i Paa ta aa ling lipa kung ca phie pata ama cuo aa.
Iemata tah aw thluo yi se; iema ca mingcue tie luochiytuv a mingcuepa tana ama cuo. Mingcuepa ta mingcuepa kha luo a chiy kieca ama pahning tana khue luo kha ama thlahne aa,” a ta.
Cuorasala Piter ta, “Capa pakhingpuona ca a siesa pata a siyluo malie chang tie,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Niema zaw hing ata tepa ta pachang the tang va ung ca ma?
Cawsaa pakaa chungtaata a ngiepa hmang ca a riy chung luo kha chiy te ale luo a pya pakhaa cuo va ma?
Cuorasala pakaa taata a pyapa ca palung chungtaata a pyapa a cuo nakawta cawsaa kha a papya a palyi.
A pha lipa ruena, lienawna, nungvaathingsuena, aparuvsuena, paruvna, aa hmuo lipa tehte cuona, cawsaa thuochi rina tapa bangkhuo ca pathiypalung chungtaata a pyapa tana ama cuo.
Hingpa tie hingna cawsaa ca a papya a palyi yi, kuv a siy li pata sa ningnapa ta cawsaa kha papyapalyi vyi,” a ta.
Zingsuv ca capa hmang taa cata pya te Tair hne Sidon pe luo kha a vaa.

Ca khupa hneta capa ruo lieta a awpa Kanaan cawsaanung pakha ca vya pya te, “David Sacapaa, Abyipa, ngie na chi thi tie. I sacanung kha khuevuo ta a hryi te a lalilahie dyina a chiy thluo,” ta pata a khi.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta kaa kha hmuo palie vyi. Ziytuv tie ta, “Hingpa nung hing cakuo sa tie, malie paziyle te malie a khisue byalya,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Kama ca Israel ming hraw taata a viepa tuv tie'a luo kyalya dyi pathliepa tana i cuo,” a ta.
Cuorasala cawsaanung ca Zingsuv phyi thabaw lie kha a vya bu te, “Abyipa naa bya thi tie,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Haatiy sa kha la pata uv thawpa ca a hmuo vyi,” a ta.
Cawsaanung ta, “A cuo, Abyipa, cuorasala a byipaapa cabya taata a tlapa sa diydya ca uv zaw ta hmuo ama ning ra taw thluo muo,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Zingsuv ta, “Cawsaanung, na zangnapa na a le hringhruo! Na khingpa ca tuepa pata cuose,” a ta. Capa cuota lie ca ta a sacanung ca a tluo.
Zingsuv ta capa hmang ca a thuse khutaata Galilee riyliy kie hraw kha cahraw te tluo luo kha kie te aa tu.
Cawsaa hluvpuv ta ama kha vya pangie yi te, a phyi cabiepa, a mingcuepa, a pakyapa, bie a ri the lipa hne a hrangpa a pasapa hluvpuv kha amaa vawkhyi. A phyi thabaw lie kha chi yi te a patluo sa yi.

Bie a ri the lipa tie ta bie ama ri the, a pakyapa tie ama tluo, a phyi cabiepa tie ama cakuopa hne mingcuepa tie ta ama hmung pakhaapa kha ama hmung tiyta cawsaazaapuv ca ama kharue haasa te Israel Khazing kha ama pathuosa.

Zingsuv ta a ziytuv tie kha ku yi te, “Cawsaazaapuv na i ngiechisa yi, tahematapakieca kama'a lie ning thung aw tli yi te ning riypa khaapahmuo hnyi va yi; ama nangdiy pata pathlie khing va yi ang, luopuv liena ama hyle pathlyi aa,” a ta.
Ziytuv tie ta, “Hing viehnangruo lie hing tuokhaatama hing zi cawsaa ning riypa sa ma hmung khu aa?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Viechuo tluo khazaa ma nama hnyi?” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Tluo sariy hne ngaa diyta a cawta,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata cawsaazaapuv kha alyi lie patu sa yi te,
viechuo tluo sariy hne ngaa kha la te, palungtluona bie a hluo khu taata, viechuo kha chechi te, ziytuv tie kha pi yi te ziytuv tie ta cawsaazaapuv kha ama re.
Ama bangkhuo ta ning yi te ama riy a bi; ziytuv tie ta aa ngaapa a zungpepa kha pakhaw yi te beke zung sariy a bi.
Canung hne haatiy ri li pata a ningpa capaa thawpaliy ama ta.
Cawsaazaapuv kha a pathlie khutaa yi ta, Zingsuv ca sawkawpalaw luo kha kie te, Magadan ruo luo kha a si.
Farasi tie hne Sadusi tie kha Zingsuv'a luo a vaw yi te, ama kha ama dyapasya khing nakawta, vuoruo taata a cuopa pamangsana malie pahmung sa tie, ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Ning a tla caw ta avuo a se kieca, ‘Ningkhue na a pha aa,’ nama ta.

Mawdiy ta avuo se te khy a paning kieca, ‘Khysuv na a chiy aa,’ nama ta. Avuo kha mang ung cate ningkhue khaapama a lu aa tapa nama ridaw khu, cuorasala ata chuo pamangsana ca a siyluo pachang khu va ung ciy,” a ta.

A pha lipa hne Khazing hmiekunglie zang tluo aa tla lipa mingphang na pamangsana a hie ung ciy, cuorasala Jonah pamangsana ta li pata pamangsana suokha hmuo tuepa pata cuo'a va ung ciy,” a ta yi. Cakhutaata iema kha thuse yi te pya te a cakuo.
Ziytuv tie ca huesuo luo ama va pha tiyta viechuo a phyale kha ama maw.
Zingsuv ta, “Farasi tie hne Sadusi tie thiynung kha a raaring tie ung,” a ta yi.
Ziytuv tie ta pakha hne pakha kha, “Viechuo ma vya phyale li nakaw tana a cuo,” amaa ta.
Zingsuv ta khaapama ama ri tapa kha a pachang nakawta, “Zangna a cawpa zaw, khaapanakawma viechuo nama hnyi lina kaw ca nama ri nguoluo thluo?
Ata tepa hingta pachang the tang va ung ca ma? Viechuo tluo pangaa ta cawsaa thawpangaa duo yi angte, a hlyipa beke zung khazaa ma nama pakhaw tapa kha a thyi va ung ca ma?
Viechuo tluo sariy ta cawsaa thawpaliy i duo ning yi kha haw a hlyipa beke zung khazaa ma nama pakhaw?
Viechuo kaw ri vyi tapa kha tuokhaatama pachang li pata nama aw the? Farasi ming hne Sadusi ming thiynung kha a raaring tie ung!” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata ziytuv tie ta, a raaringna malie a pipa hing viechuo lie ama hmuopa thiynung cuo li pata Farasi ming hne Sadusi ming pacuvnapa tana a cuo tapa kha ama pachang.
Zingsuv ca Sisaria Filipi pe luo kha si te capa lie ca ziytuv tie kha, “Cawsaa zaw ta Cawsaa Sacapaa hing ahung ama ta ma?” ta pata a hiehriy yi.
Iema ta, “Chekha ta tiynawtuv Johan aca ta yi, chekha ta Elijah ca ta yi te, chekha ta Jeremiah acuolikie profet pakhakha tana a cuo, aca ta yi,” ama ta.
“Niema haw, kama hing ahung ina ta ung ca ma?” a ta yi.
Simon Piter ta, “Nama ca a hringpa Khazing Sacapaa, Messiah tana na cuo,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Jonah sacapaa Simon, thluechiypa tana na cuo! Tahematapakieca hingpa hing thiy hne saa taata aca pachang sapa ta cuo vyi, cuorasala vuoruo lie a awpa i Paa'a taa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta ica chang, nama ca Piter tana na cuo, hingpa alungpuvnung cunglie hing i Khrihsaabuv kha padaa'a angte thiyna tahmuo te khu buo hluo'a vyi.
Vuoruo Pena taw kha ca pi'a angte, alyi lie na khaapa ca vuoruo lie zaw khaa pata cuo ra'a te, alyi lie na pahawpa ca vuoruo lie zaw pahaw pata a cuo ra aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta Messiah a cuopa kha ahunghmuo chang li riypata ziytuv tie kha khuopuv ta bie a cung yi.

Capa cuo taa cata Zingsuv ta ziytuv tie kha, Jerusalem luo vaa'a angte uvthyi tie, tluobyi lepa tie hne phungbie saya tie kuv lie te-angna khuopuv ta i taw aa, ina thie'a yi, cuorasala ning thungna lieta pathu pakhaa pata a cuo aa,” tapa kha a chang yi.
Piter ta Zingsuv kha a kie luo cakuokhyi te a chuo. “Abyipa, hingpa hmang hing khatiy tahmuo Khazing ta na cunglie patlung sa khah se,” a ta.

Cuorasala Zingsuv ta a vya pali te Piter kha, “Setaa, i thaa taa hingta cakuo! Luo naa khuotuv tana na cuo, tahematapakieca na ruenapa hing Khazing'a taata cuo vyi, cawsaa cuona taata a vawpa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta ziytuv tie kha, “Ahunghmuo cuose kama naa ziytuv a cuo khingpa ca iema khingna kha thuse yi sala ama vieluotung kha a puv pata na ziy yi se.
Tahematapakieca a hringna aa bangpa a khingpa tie ca ama hringna kha a sung'a yi te, kama kawlieta a hringna a sungpa tie ca hringna kha ama hmung aa.
Cawsaa hingta chuelyi hing a yalya ta cu ra hmuo sala a hringna aa sung kie khaapama a thlahne aa? A hringna kha khaapatahmuo ta calyi pakhaa khu'a va tli.
“Cawsaa Sacapaa ca a Paa rungnaana cangta avuoming hneta a vaw'a te, cawsaa bangkhuo kha iema rehriena haa khata a thung'a yi.
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, hingpa lie a daapa chekha hing Cawsaa Sacapaa ta a pena luo aa vawpa ama hmung hluo li a thiy li riypa ama aw,” a ta yi.
Ning caruv khutaata Zingsuv ta Piter hne Jeim hne a nuta Johan kha aa suosapa tluocung luo kiekhyi yi te iema selaw ta ama aw.
Ama ming hmungna lie kha Zingsuv ca a hminghmie aa thle; a hmie ca ning haata khe te, a caw ca a ruona luo ta aa li ta aa li.
Sungkhabala ta Moses hne Elijah kha iema'a lie ca zaa luo yi te Zingsuv hne bie ama rihne.

Caacuonakawta Piter ta Zingsuv kha, “Abyipa, hingpa lie ma awpa hing kiema cuota a pha hringhruo; na khing pata a cuo kieca, nama cuota suokha, Moses cuota suokha, Elijah cuota suokha ta pata thluodaa suothung ica sapa'a yi,” a ta.

Cahaacata bie a ri nguoluo ning kha, sungkhabala ta amyi khepa ta buv yi te, amyi chung taa ueryi suokha ta, “Hingpa hing i Duepa i Sacapaa, i palung naa hmungsapa tana a cuo, a ri kha a ngie tie ung,” a ta.
Capa ueryi ca ziytuv tie ta ama thyi tiyta, ama thlaa zang suesaa te alyi lie kha a maa bu.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta a vaw te a hrie khu taa yi ta, “Thu tie ung, nama thlaa zang khah se,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata ama kya mang ca ahunghmuo hmung lipa yi ta Zingsuv dyi ama hmung.
Tluocung taata ama za cungpuo pata Zingsuv ta, “Cawsaa Sacapaa hing thiyna taata pathu pakhaapa ta a cuo hluo li nama hmungpa muocuo hing ahunghmuo chang'a va ung ciy,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata ziytuv tie ta Zingsuv kha, “Khaapanakawma phungbie saya tie ta Elijah na a vaw taa aa ama ta?” ta pata ama hiehriy.
Zingsuv ta, “Elijah ca a vaw taa sasaw'a te hmangting bangkhuo kha a ting pacie diy aa.
Cuorasala ica chang yi, Elijah ca aa vaw mangtli, cadyiseca cawsaa ta pachang va laa yi te ama khing ta ama tue. Cahaacata Cawsaa Sacapaa zaw hing iema kuv chunglie ruvnaana a ang ra aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata ziytuv tie ta tiynawtuv Johan kaw muo malie a chang ta tapa kha ama pachang.
Cawsaazaapuv'a luo ama vya kaa tiyta, cawsaa pakha ca Zingsuv'a luo kha a vaw te a hmiekunglie kha a pakhuv vya pane te,
“Abyipa, i sacapaa hing ngiechi thi tie, ama ca siypatyi the te a rie a thyi hringhruo, myi chung luo cuose, tiy chung luo cuose aa lie taw.
Caa ziytuv tie'a luo a vawkhyi raalaa angte patluo khu va yi,” a ta.

Zingsuv ta, “Niema zangna a hnyi lipa, a pali a pahnaa ta a hringpa phang, khacuo ma niema'a lie hing i aw kalie a hu aa? Khacuo ma ica awpuo kalie yi a hu aa? Haatiypa ca kama'a luo a vawkhyi tie ung,” a ta yi.
Zingsuv ta khuevuo ca chuo te haatiypa chungtaata a pya, capa cuo taa cata haatiypa ca a tluo.
Cakhutaata ziytuv tie ca Zingsuv'a luo kha iema se ta a vaw yi te, “Khaapanakawma khuevuo kha ma papya khu va,” ta pata ama hiehriy.

Zingsuv ta, “Nama zangnapa a caw nakaw tana a cuo. Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, uotuo hmung tie zangna nama hnyi kieca, hingpa tluo hing, ‘Hingpa taa hingta a hnyi,’ ta ung la aa hnyi thluo aa; niema cuota a cuo khu lipa aw'a vyi,” a ta yi.
Cuorasala hingpa phang hing ca thlaachuona hne sa-uvna tah ta li pata ca khaapatahmuo papya khu vyi,” a ta.
Ziytuv tie Galilee lie amaa taw pakhaw tiyta Zingsuv ta, “Cawsaa Sacapaa hing cawsaa kuv luo pi pata cuo'a te,
ama thie aa; cakhutaata ning thungna lieta pathu pakhaapa ta a cuo aa,” a ta yi. Ziytuv tie ca ama ngie a chi hringhruo.
Kapernaum khy ama vya pha tiyta, biena-ing ngukhyituv pakha ca Piter'a luo a vaw te, “Na sayapa hing biena-ing ngukhyi pi va ma?” a ta.

Piter ta, “A pi,” a ta. Piter ingchung luo a zaa ngie pahne ta Zingsuv ta vya thukhyi taa te, “Simon, tuokhaatama na rue? Chuelyi siepahruo tie ta ruohrang chechiy a ngiekhyi muo hne ngukhyi hing ahung'a taata ma ama la? Ama saata zaw'a taata ma, acuolikie cawsaa hrangpa tie'a taata ma?” a ta.
Piter ta, “Cawsaa hrangpa tie'a taata,” a ta. Zingsuv ta, “Caacuokieca Saata zaw ca pi a hu vyi.

Cadyiseca hing cawsaa zaw ama palung pasa sa li riypata riyliy luo kha vaa la kyipa va pathla tie; na thue taapa ngaa a pakaa kha cakang la ngu tuokaa phiekha na hmung aa; capa ca la lah nama hne kama cuota va pi tie yi,” a ta.
Capa cuo ning ca ziytuv tie kha Zingsuv'a luo a vaw yi te, “Vuoruo pena lie ahungma a le ce?” ta pata ama hiehriy.
Zingsuv ta haatiyta pakha kha ku te iema hrawlie a padaa khutaata,
“Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, a thle ung cate haatiyta haa hingta nama cuo li kieca vuoruo pena luo a ngie khu buo hluo'a va ung ciy.
Cawsaa raw canaw te hingpa haatiyta haa hingta a cuopa na vuoruo pena chunglie a le cepa ta a cuo.
Ahunghmuo cuose kama ming ta hing haapa haatiy a cuhluopa ca kama naa cuhluopa tana a cuo.

“Ahunghmuo cuo sala, hingpa haatiyta zaw pakhakha hing kama ina zangna taata luo a papie sapa ca nama rue lie sacuo rienapa alungtung ciypuo pata riyliy luo pathla pata cuo sala nama cuota a pha vie aa.
A pachiyna zaw kawlie hingta chuelyi ca bawchie ciemuopa tana a cuo! A pachiyna cuo hing a aw pari aa, cuorasala a pachiyna a pacuosatuv ca bawchie ciemuopa tana a cuo.

“Na kuv acuolikie na phyi ta na zangna taata aca papie sa kieca, te la thaw tie! Kuv hra hning acuolikie phyi hra hning hneta chuozaa myi chung luo tlapa laata kuv tling li acuolikie phyi tling li pata hringna luo a ngiepa na a pha vie aa.
Cakhutaata na ming ta na zangna taata aca papie sa kieca, thue la thaw tie; ming hra hning hneta hell myi chung luo tlapa laata ca ming hra kha dyi ta hringna luo a ngiepa ca a pha vie.
“Hingpa haatiyta a ahung hing hmuota mangbung khah ung. Ica chang yi, iema a vetuv avuoming kha vuoruo i Paa hmiekunglie ama aw pari.
Cawsaa Sacapaa ca a viepa khuo riypa tana aa vaw.
Tuokhaatama nama rue? Tuv khietuv pakha ta tuv zakha hnyi sala, sakha a vie kieca, sawcaky sacaky kha tluocung lie thuse'a te, a viepa sakha kha a va huv aa cuo va ma?
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, a hmung tiyta a vie lipa sawcaky sacaky tie cunglie laa khata a viepa sakha cunglie kha a palung a tluo vie.
Cahaacata vuoruo lie a awpa nama Paa ta hingpa haatiyta zaw pakha hing hmuo vie riypata pahya vyi.
“Na uvnu pakha lalaa ta na cunglie suena a tue kieca, vaa la niema seta nama awna lie kha a suenapa kha va chang tie. Na ri a caa ngie kieca na uvnu ta na pacuo sa khu pakhaa tana ta a cuo.

Cuorasala na ri a caa ngie khing li kieca, bie bangkhuo ca pachangkhyituv pahning acuolikie pathung hmielie ta pacu sapa a cuo riypata, caa thyikhyi riypata pakha acuolikie pahning kha a chiyle tie yi.

Iema bie zaw kha a cuhluo khu li kieca, bie kha Khrihsaabuv luo chiykhyi tie. Khrihsaabuv bie kha hmuo a cuhluo khu li kieca, cahaapa cawsaa ca Jentail ming acuolikie ngukhyituv pakha haa khata va rue tie.
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, alyi lie nama hrepa ca vuoruo lie zaw hre pata cuo ra'a te, alyi lie nama pathluopa ca vuoruo lie zaw pathluo pata a cuo ra aa.
“Biehmisi tana ica chang pakhaa yi, hing alyi lie hing pahning ta palung a lusa pata nama hie kieca, nama hiepa hmang ca vuoruo lie a awpa i Paa ta aca pi'a yi.
I ming ta pahning acuolikie pathung amaa hmyana lie ca, ama hrawlieta kama i aw ra” a ta.
Cakhutaata Piter ca Zingsuv'a luo kha a vaw te, “Abyipa, i uvnu pakhakha ta i cunglie suena a tue kieca, yi khazaa ma i ngiethe aa? Yi sariy te ma?” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Yi sariy cuo vyi, cuorasala ica chang, yi sawsariy le sariy, a ta.
“Caacuonakawta vuoruo pena ca a sii zaw rehriena cazing kha mang a tingpa siepahruo pakha hne tana aa lu.
Re a pathu pahne ta tuokaa talen thawhraa a uopa a sii pakha kha ama'a luo ca a maa vawkhyi.
Lyibuo kha a thung khu li nakawta a byipaapa ca ta, ama, a napuv, a saata zaw hne a hnyipa bangkhuo kha zaa diy pata, lyibuo thung riypata bie a pi.
Caacuonakawta a siipaapa ca a phyi thabaw lie kha a pakhuv pane te, ‘Na ngiechi la naa ngie caw thi tie, ica thung diy aa,’ ta pata paa a kie.
A byipaapa ta a ngiechi nakawta a lyibuo kha a ngiethe te a pathlie.
Cuorasala a pya pahne ta tuokaa denarii zakha a uopa, sii ta a cuo rapa a viesaa pakha'a luo kha vaa te, a rue kha hmi te, ‘Inaa uopa ca kha na pi tie,’ a ta.
Sii a cuo rapa a viesaapa ca ta a pakhuv pane te, ‘Ngie na chi thi tie, ica thung aa’ a ta.
Cuorasala khing li pata, a lyibuo a thung diy hluo li thaw a pathla.
Sii a cuo rapa a viesaa tie ta khapa hmang a cuopa bangkhuo kha ama hmung tiyta, ama palung pha li pata ama byipaapa'a luo kha vaa yi te ama va chang diy.
Caacuonakawta a byipaapa ca ta ku te, ‘Sii pha lipa! Paa ina kie nakaw ca ta inaa uopa bangkhuo icaa ngiethe diy.
Kama nang ica duepa haa khata na viesaa sii cunglie kha nangduena na hnyi ra riypata cuo va ma?’ a ta.
A byipaapa ca a hi a haa laalaw nakawta a lyibuo bangkhuo a thung diy hluo li hrisaa riypata thaw a pathla.
Caacuonakawta nama uvnu acuolikie nama sieta kha pathiypalung hmisi ta namaa ngiethe li pata a cuo kieca vuoruo lie a awpa i Paa ta niema zaw kha cahaacata a ca tue ra'a yi,” a ta.
Capa kaw a ri diy khutaata Zingsuv ca Galilee taa khata pya te Jordan cavaa huesuo Judea pe luo kha a si.
Cawsaazaapuv ta ziy yi te capa lie ca a patluo sa yi.
Farasi tie chekha ca ama'a luo kha dyapasya riypata a vaw yi te, “Suokhakha kawlieta, capaa pakha ta napuv ma riypa kha phungbie ta a pa-aw ma?” ta pata ama hiehriy.
Zingsuv ta, “A hruothu ningta iema a satuv ta, ‘capaa hne canung a sa yi,'
‘Caacuonakawta capaa ta a paa hne a nung kha thuse'a yi te a napuv hneta amaa hlaw aa, pahning ca pang kha ta ama cuo aa,’ tapa kha ri buo va ung ca ma?
Caacuonakawta iema ca pahning cuo va tli yi, pang kha tana ama cuo. Khazing ta a pahlawpa yi ca ahungtahmuo che khah yi se,” a ta.
Farasi ming ta, “Caacuokieca khaapanakawma Moses ta, ‘Capaa ta a napuv kha manapa caa pi sala a che se,’ ta pata bie malie a pi?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Nama palung a ruv tuv nakaw tana Moses ta napuv ma khu riypata aca pa-aw yi, cuorasala a hruothu ta ca cahaacata za cuo vyi.
Ica chang yi, ahunghmuota cuose, zang tluo a tla lina kawlie ta li pata a napuv kha ma te canung hrangpa hne a hlawpa ca nungvaathingsuena a tuepa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Ziytuv tie ta, “Nung hne vaa kawlie hing haa hingta a cuo riypa a cuo kieca, a chiyhie lipa tana a pha vie,” ama ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta, “Hing pacuvnapa hing ca cawsaa mekaa ta ziy khu'a va yi, Khazing ta aa tlawpa tie cuo kyalya tana a cuo.

Cawsaa chekha ca amaa zaa puvkhyipa ta cuo te, chekha ca cawsaa ta ama tuechaw nakawta napuv a chiy lipa ta ama cuo, chekha ca vuoruo pena kawlieta napuv chiy li pata ama aw. Hing pacuvnapa a ziy khupa ca ziy thluo yi se,” a ta.
Cakhutaata haatiy zaw kha ama luv cunglie a kuv khang pata thlaachuopa naase yi ta pata Zingsuv'a luo amaa vawkhyi. Cuorasala ziytuv tie ta a vawkhyipa tie kha ama chuo.
Caacuonakawta Zingsuv ta, “Haatiy kha i thaa luo a vaw yi se, thlu khah ung, tahematapakieca vuoruo pena ca hing haapa haatiy zaw cuo hing tana a cuo,” a ta.
A kuv kha ama luv cunglie khang te a cakuo.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv'a luo kha cawsaa pakha a vaw te, “Saya, chuozaa hringna hmung riypata khaapa hmang phapa ma i tue aa?” a ta.
Zingsuv ta “Khaapanakawma khaapama a pha tapa kaw ca ina hiehriy ciy? A phapa ca pakha kyalya dyina a aw. Hringna luo naa ngie khing kieca phungbie kha ziy tie,” a ta.
Satliepa ca ta, “Khaapa phungbie ma,” a ta. Zingsuv ta, “Lie va naw khah; Nungvaathingsuena tue khah; Paruv khah; A cuo li pata malie vaa daakhyi khah;
Na nung hne na paa va ciyzaa yi; Nama naa duepa haata na ingpaa kha va due tie,” a ta.
Satliepa ta, “Hing phungbie bangkhuo hing i ziy diy tli, khaapama i tue lipa a aw kalie?” a ta.

Zingsuv ta, “Cawsaa tlingpa na cuo khing kieca na hnyipa bangkhuo kha zaa la na hmungpa tuokaa kha siypasa tie pi tie yi, caacuokieca vuoruo lie suethiy na hnyi aa; cakhutaata a vaw la na ziy tie,” a ta.
Satliepa ta capa bie ca a thyi tiyta, a ngiechisa pata a cakuo, tahematapakieca ama ca a hnyirungsapa tana a cuo.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta ziytuv tie kha, “Biehmisipa tana ica chang yi, a hnyirungpa tie vuoruo pena chung luo a ngie riypa ca a ruv hringhruo aa.
Ica chang pakhaa yi, a hnyirungpa vuoruo pena luo a ngiepa laata kala-uv sakha ciphang khue luo a ngiepa na a na vie,” a ta.
Ziytuv tie ta capa ca ama thyi tiyta ama kharue haasa te, “Ahung ma khuona ca a hmung khu aa?” amaa ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta iema kha mang yi te, “Hingpa hing cawsaa cuota ca cuo khu vyi, cuorasala Khazing cuota ca zezaw bangkhuo hing a cuo khu,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Piter ta, “Mang tie, zezaw bangkhuo thuse pate nama maca ziy tli. Khaapama ma cu aa?” a ta.

Zingsuv ta, “Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, hmangting pathaa pakhaapa a cuo ning, Cawsaa Sacapaa hing i byithude cunglie patupa i cuo thueta, niema naa ziytuv tie zaw hing byithude hlyihning cunglie a tu'a ung cate, Israel ming phang hraa hlyihning kha bie nama ripa aa.
