Cakhutaata ahunghmuo cuose kama vuolieta ing zaw cuose, a uvnu zaw cuose, a sieta zaw cuose, a paa cuose, a nung cuose, a saata zaw cuose, a lu zaw cuose a thusepa ca ale zakha ta hmung pakhaa'a te, chuozaa hringna ru zaw a cu aa.
Cuorasala hmaa a sapa a hluvpuv ca hnang chuo'a yi te, hnang a chuopa a hluvpuv ca hmaa ama sa aa.
“Vuoruo Pena ca mawdiy ta pya te a mingsuv diedung chunglie re a hrie riypa tie a huvpa luruo a hnyituv pakha hne tana aa lu.
Ning kha ninghlue pi riypata a palung a tlingpa rehrietuv tie kha a mingsuv diedung luo a pathlie yi.
Maw siymaluo pacaky ta chadawtluo luo kha a pya tiyta cawsaa chekha ca khaapahmuo hrie li pata amaa daa thluopa kha a hmung yi.
Iema kyihuo khata, ‘Niema zaw hing i mingsuv diedung luo kha vaa ung la re va hrie tie ung, aa de pata ninghlue ica pi'a yi,’ a ta. Caacuonakawta ama vaa.
Ningchung siymaluo hlyihning hne zuoluo siymaluo pathung lie zaw kha pya pakhaa te, cahaa ngiethie cata a tue.
Zuoluo siymaluo papangaa hraw ta a pya pakhaa ca cawsaa chekha amaa zaa daa thluopa kha hmung yi te, ‘Khaapanakawma khaapahmuo hrie li pata ning-aw ta hingpa lie hing namaa daa cakhaw?’ a ta yi.
‘Ahungtahmuo rehrie malie ama chang li nakaw tana a cuo,’ ama ta. Ama ta, ‘I mingsuv diedung luo kha vaa ung la re va hrie tie ung,’ a ta yi.

Zuoluo a vya chiy tiyta, diedung a hnyituv ca ta tluotlatuv kha u te, ‘Rehrietuv tie kha ku yi la a hnangcaw ce ta re changpa tie taa khata patha la a patang ce ta re changpa tie te khata ama ninghlue kha pi tie yi,’ a ta.
Zuoluo siymaluo papangaa hraw ta rehrie a pathupa tie kha a vaw yi te, ning kha ninghlue kha amaa la.
Caacuonakawta a patang ce ta re changpa tie kha ninghlue thu riypata amaa vaw ra tiyta a hluv vie ma hmung thlu aa ta pata ama rue; cuorasala iema zaw kha ning kha ninghlue a pi ra yi.
Ama ninghlue kha a la yi te luruo a hnyituv cunglie kha amaa cie.
‘A hnangcaw ce ta re changpa tie ca siymaluo pakha chung dyina re ama hrie, ninghlue malie na pi tiyta ningling lie ning-aw ta re a hriepa kiema hneta aa khing pata na pi yi,’ ama ta.
Cuorasala ama ta iema hrawlie pakha kha, ‘Viesaa, na cunglie a cuo lipa tue vade ang. Ning kha ninghlue hmung riypa tana na palung a za tling cuo va ma?
Na huopa hing a la lah ing luo cakuo tie. A hnangcaw ce ta rehrie changpa paa hing nama zaa tana i pi ra khing.
I tuokaa cieciepa lie hing kama khingna haata tue khuna i hnyi cuo va ma? Acuolikie i pahyasa nakawta na hie tlie kanaa?’ a ta.
Caacuonakawta, hnang a chuopa ca hmaa sa'a yi te, hmaa a sapa ca hnang ama chuo aa,” a ta.
Zingsuv Jerusalem luo a khaw ningta a ziytuv hlyihning kha a hrangta tah ku yi te ama cakuopuole pata bie aa rue yi.
“Mang tie ung, Jerusalem luo ma sithaw nguoluo ung hing, Cawsaa Sacapaa hing tluobyi lepa tie hne phungbie saya tie kuv luo pi pata cuo'a te thie riypata bie ama chi aa.
Cakhutaata eseluelaa pata tue riypa, tuv riypa hne vieluo lie thie riypata Jentail ming kuv luo kha ama pi aa. Cuorasala ning thungna lieta pathu pakhaa pata a cuo aa,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata Zebedi sacapaa tie ama nung ca Zingsuv'a luo kha a sacapaa zaw hneta a vaw yi te, a hmiekunglie kha a pakhuv pane te hmang aa hu.
Zingsuv ta, “Khaapama na khing?” ta pata a hiehriy. Ama ta, “I sacapaa pahning tie hing na pena chunglieta na cacuoluo kuo ta pakha, na cavyiluo kuo ta pakha amaa tu riypata bie pathyi sa tie,” a ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta, “Khaapama inaa hie ung ciy tapa pachang va ung ciy. I dang riypa panuo hing nama dang khu'a ma?” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Ma dang khu aa,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “I dang riypa panuo hing nama dang khu ra hmisi aa, cuorasala i cavyiluo hne i cacuoluo a tu riypa hing ca kama ta i pi khupa cuo vyi, i Paa ta a tingpa paciepa tie huo tana a cuo,” a ta.
Capa kaw ca ziytuv pahraa tie ta ama thyi tiyta, uvcanu pahning tie cunglie kha ama hi a haa.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta ku yi te, “Jentail byi tie ca ama uvpa tie cunglieta a chi yi te, uvtuv tie ta uvpa tie cunglie ama khing ta ama awsue tawpa kha nama pachang.
Niema hrawlie ca cahaacata cuo'a vyi, cuorasala niema hrawlie cawsaa lepa a cuo khingpa ca, nama changtaapa a cuo taa riypa tana a cuo,
niema hrawlie pakhanapa a cuo khingpa ca, nama sii a cuo taa riypa tana a cuo.
Cawsaa Sacapaa ca hriepapa cuo li pata, hriepatuv cuo riypa hne cawsaa hluvpuv a thla riypata a hringna pi riypa tana aa vaw,” a ta yi.
Zingsuv hne ziytuv tie Jeriko taata ama pya ning kha cawsaa hluvpuv ta ama ziy.
Luopuv kielie a daapa mingcue pahning ta Zingsuv na a vya sile tapa kha ama thyi tiyta, “Abyipa, David Sacapaa, malie ngiechi thi tie,” ta pata ama khi.
Cawsaazaapuv khata chuo yi te a dieta tah aw riypata ama chang, cuorasala iema ta, “Abyipa, David Sacapaa, malie ngiechi thi tie!” ta pata khuo vie ta ama khi hryly.
Zingsuv ca a daa te, iema kha ku yi te, “Khaapa malie tuepa se tapa ma nama khing?” a ta yi.
Iema ta, “Abyipa, ima ming hing pavuo sa la tapa na ma khing,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta ngiechisa yi te ama ming kha a hrie yi. Ama ming ca sungkha ta vuo pakhaa te ama kha ama ziy.
Jerusalem khy athaa luo kha a vya ngie viele yi te, Olif tluo lie a awpa Bethfeih khy ama vya phapa khata, Zingsuv ta ziytuv tie pahning kha hmieluo pathlielu yi te,
“Nama hmieluo lie a awpa khy luo kha vaa ung la, a taata cangpa laa sakha a zaa hre thluopa kha hmung paluo'a ung cate, pathluo ung la kama'a luo namaa vya chiy aa.
Pakhakha ta cuvkhaa aca ta kie yi ca, ‘Abyipa na a hu,’ ta tie ung. Aca pi paluo'a yi,” a ta.
Hingpa hmang hing profet ta a za ri ciepa a tlingna riypa tana a cuo. Profet ta,
“Zion sacanung ca chang tie ung, Mang tie, na siepahruo na nama'a luo a vaw nguoluo, ama ca cawsaa nangnepa cuo te laa na aa vya khang, Laataata na aa vya khang, va ta tie ung,” a ta.
Ziytuv tie ca si yi te Zingsuv ta a changpa haa yi khata ama tue.
Laa hne a taata kha a vya chiy yi te, pang kha a ke lie padie yi te Zingsuv ta aa khang.
Cawsaazaapuv hluvsa ta ama pang kha luopuv lie phaa yi te, chekha ta thingce zaw kha thli yi te luopuv lie ama phaa.

Zingsuv hmieluo ta a cakuolepa tie hne a hnangluo taata a paziylepa zaapuv khata, “Hosanna! David Sacapaa ca pathuosa tie ung! Abyipa ming ta a vawpa ca thluechiypa tana a cuo! Aa suo cepa vuoruo lie khiy Hosanna ta pata pathuosa pata cuose!” ta pata ama khi.
Jerusalem luo aa ngie tiyta, khypuv chung yalya ca a cali te, “Ahungtama a cuo,” ta yi te ama hiehriy.
Cawsaazaapuv ta, “Galilee ruo Nazareth khy ming profet Zingsuv tana a cuo,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ca biena-ing luo kha a ngie te biena-ing chunglie sue a zaapa tie hne a calyipa tie kha a papya diy yi. Tuokaa a thlepa tie cabya hne valale a zaapa tie thude zaw kha a nuopatyi diy.
Iema kyihuo khata, “Caapathe chunglieta, ‘Kama ing ca thlaachuona ing ama ta aa,’ ta pata aa cape; cuorasala niema ta aparuvpa tie a chuona hmang ta nama tue,” a ta yi.
Mingcuepa hne a phyi cabiepa tie kha biena-ing chunglie ama'a luo kha a vaw yi te a patluo sa yi.

Cuorasala tluobyi lepa tie hne phungbie saya tie ta kharuehaa hmang a tuepa kha hmung yi te, haatiy zaw ta, “David Sacapaa ca Hosanna ta pata pathuosa tie ung,” ta yi te biena-ing lie ama khipa kha ama thyi tiyta ama hi a haa.

Caacuonakawta Zingsuv kha, “Ama ripa ca na thyi ma?” ama ta. Zingsuv ta, “I thyi samaw! Caapathe ta, ‘Haatiy zaw, meme a pazaw kaliepa haaseta zaw kha, nama pathuosana ca na pari sa yi,’ a tapa kha ri buo va ung ca ma?” a ta yi.
Zingsuv ta a ruose yi te, khypuv chung taa khata pya te Bethani khy luo kha vaa te capa lie ca aa ri.
A mawluopa mawdiy ta khypuv chung luo a vya kaa pakhaa ning kha Zingsuv ca a nang a diy.

Luopuv kielie thyikuv kung kha hmung te a va pangie ca a hnaa ta li pata khaapahmuo hmung vyi. Caacuonakawta thyikuv kung ca, “Khatiy tahmuo na thyi pathyi khah tie,” a ta. Ca khu pahne ta thyikuv kung ca a caa.
Ziytuv tie ta capa ca ama hmung tiyta ama nang uo te, “Tuokhaatama thyikuv kung hing sungkha ta a caa diy hmuo,” ama ta.

Zingsuv ta, “Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, palung luoluena hnyi li pata nama zang kieca thyikuv kung lie i tuepa haa dyi hingta hmuo cuo li pata, hingpa tluo hing hmuo, ‘A hnyi la riyliy luo hue vaa thaw tie,’ ta ung la aa thaw aa.
Zangna cangta, thlaachuona ta nama hiepa tuokhaapa a cuo zaw, pi pata nama cuo aa,” a ta yi.

Zingsuv ca biena-ing luo kha a ngie te a pacuv nguoluo ning yi ta tluobyi lepa tie hne uvthyi tie kha aa thaa luo a vaw yi te, “Khaapa nawhnyina tama hingpa hmang hing na tue? Ahungma hingpa nawhnyina hing caa pi?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Kama zaw bie suokha ca hiehriy'a yi ang; ina palie khu kie ungca ca, khaapa nawhnyina tama hingpa hmang hing i tue tapa kha ica chang ra'a yi.
Johan tiynawna hing vuoruo taata ma, acuolikie cawsaapa'a taata ma?” a ta yi. Iema'a na iema kha a i yi te, “'Vuoruo taata,’ ta se pala, ‘Khaapanakawma Johan ca nama zang va?’ malie a ta aa.
‘Cawsaa'a taata,’ ta se pala, Johan ca cawsaazaapuv ta profet ta pata ama zang nakawta iema ca ciy amaa chiy hyi,” amaa ta.
Caacuonakawta Zingsuv kha, “Pachang vapuv,” ama ta. Zingsuv ta, “A cuo kieca, kama zaw, khaapa nawhnyina tama hingpa hmang zaw hing i tue tapa kha ca chang ra'a va yi ang,” a ta yi.
“Tuokhaatama nama rue? Cawsaa pakha za aw te sacapaa pahning a hnyi. A uvthyipa kha, ‘I sacapaa, ataning ca mingsuv diedung luo si la re va hrie tie,’ a ta.
Ama ta, ‘Si khing va ang,’ a ta; cuorasala a hnang taata a palung a thle te a si.
A sacapaa a syipa'a luo kha vaa te, capa haa ngiethie cata a chang ra. ‘I si aa, abyipa,’ a ta; cuorasala si li pata a aw.

Hingpa tie pahning lie hing ahung hing ma a paa khingnapa kha a tue?” a ta yi. “A uvthyipa,” ama ta. Zingsuv ta, “Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, ngukhyituv tie hne siyhrawnung tie na Khazing pena chung luo kha niema hluota a ngie'a yi.

Johan kha adangna luopuv pahmung sa riypata a vaw te zang va ung ciy; cuorasala ngukhyituv tie hne siyhrawnung tie zaw ta ama zang. Nama hmung thluo pata hmuo, a hnang taata nama palung kha a thle pata zang va ung ciy.

“Pakhingpuona a hrangpa kha naathlie tie ung. Luruo a hnyituv pakha ta mingsuv diedung tue te, piehu a padung, mingsuv nawna khue kha cu te, rievena tluophie zaw kha a sa. Cakhutaa cata a mingsuv diedung ca rehrietuv tie kha pahlie yi te ruo hrang luo khy a tlaw.
Mingsuv lu tiy aa de tiyta, rehrietuv tie'a luo kha a cuvu la riypata a sii zaw a pathlie yi.
Rehrietuv tie ta a sii zaw kha patuv yi te, pakha ama tuv, pakha thie yi te a hrangpa pakha ca alung ta ama vaa.
Luruo a hnyituvpa ta a sii hrangpa tie kha a hluv vie ta a pathlie pakhaa yi. Rehrietuv tie ta ama za tue taapa haa khata ama tue pakhaa.
A hnangcaw ce ta a sacapaa kha pathlie te, ‘I sacapaa hing ca ama hmiezaa ngiethie aa,’ a ta.
Cuorasala rehrietuv tie ta ama hmung tiyta, ‘Hingpa paa hingna a rucutuv ta a cuo, a vaw tie ung, thie ung sala a ru kha a la ung siy,’ amaa ta.
Caacuonakawta patuv yi te diedung khungthing luo kha thaw yi te ama thie.
“A cuo kieca diedung a hnyituvpa a vya chiy tiyta rehrietuv tie kha tuokhaa tana a tue thlu'a mang yi nama ta ma?” a ta yi.
Iema ta, “Capa cawsaa chiepa tie ca thie'a yi te, mingsuv lu cuo ningta a cuvu a pi khupa rehrietuv tie kha diedung ca a pahlie'a yi,” ama ta.

Zingsuv ta iema kyihuo khata, “Caapathe ta: ‘Ing satuv tie ta ama thawpa alung ca ingkiylung tana aa li. Capa ca Abyipa tuepa hmang ta cuo te, ma hmungna lieta nang-uo a chiysa va ma?' a tapa kha ri buo va ung ca ma?” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta, ica chang yi, Khazing pena ca niema'a taata lapa ta cuo'a te, pena thyipaa pha a hnyi riypa tie kha pi pata ama cuo aa.
Hingpa alung cunglie a tlapa ca kyipatlaa'a te, hingpa alung hingta a tlasuepa ca a zapatlaa diy aa,” a ta.
Tluobyi lepa tie hne Farasi ming ta a ripa pakhingpuona ca ama thyi tiyta, iema kaw na a ri tapa kha ama pachang.
Zingsuv kha ama patuv khing, cuorasala cawsaazaapuv kha ama ciy, tahematapakieca cawsaazaapuv ta Zingsuv kha profet tana a cuo ta pata ama zang nakawta a cuo.
Zingsuv ta iema kha pakhingpuona hmuo te bie a chang pakhaa yi.
“Vuoruo pena ca a sacapaa cuota achiyhie saduona a tuepa siepahruo pakha hne tana aa lu.
A sii zaw kha pathlie yi te kupa tie bangkhuo kha achiyhie saduona luo chiy riypata a pachang sa yi, cuorasala vya chiy khing va yi.

A hrangpa sii zaw kha pathlie pakhaa yi te, ‘Saduona ca ting ciepa ta a cuo tli, i cuetungpa hne sahring a thusapa zaw thie tli pate, zezaw bangkhuo ting ciepa ta a cuo tli. A chiyhie saduona luo ca a vaw tie ung, nama va ta aa,’ a ta yi.
Cuorasala siysaa ri lipa yi ta chekha ca lu luo ama si, chekha ca chadaw luo cakuo yi te,
a hrangpa tie ta a sii zaw kha patuv yi te, tuv yi te ama thie.
Siepahruo ca a hi a haa hringhruo. A rieka kha pathlie yi te lie a nawpa tie ca thie yi te ama khy kha myi ta ama rue.
Cakhutaata a sii zaw kha, ‘Achiyhie saduona ca ting ciepa ta a cuo tli, cuorasala i kupa tie ca a phuv a siy va yi.
Ata hingta azaa luopuv luo kha vaa ung la, nama hmungpa bangkhuo kha va ku tie ung,’ a ta yi.
A sii zaw ta azaa luopuv luo ca vaa yi te, ama hmungpa bangkhuo kha a chie a pha ta li pata pakiy yi te, cawsaa ca achiyhie saduona ing ta ama bi.
“Cuorasala Siepahruo ca ama kupa tie mang riypata aa vya ngie tiyta, achiyhiena cawsie a tue lipa pakha kha a hmung.
‘Liechung, khaapanakawma achiyhiena cawsie a tue li pata hingpa saduona chung luo hing naa ngie the?’ a ta. Cuorasala khaapahmuo palie vyi.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ta a changtaapa zaw kha, ‘A kuv hne a phyi kha ciy ung la khungthing khy zingna hmang, caana hne haa riena hmang luo kha thaw tie ung,’ a ta.
Tahematapakieca, kupa ca hluvsa yi te, a tlawpa ca ama caw,” a ta.
Farasi tie ca vaa yi te Zingsuv kha a bie ripa taata a suena patuv the riypata khue ama khuo.

Caacuonakawta Herod cawsaa chekha hne khata iema a ziypa tie kha pathlie yi te, “Saya, nama ca aa hmuopa dyi a ripa na cuopa kha ma pachang. Biehmisipa haata Khazing khingna kha na pacuv yi, cawsaa pahlyipale vaciy; a kuo ta a daa vaciy.
Caacuonakawta na ruenapa malie chang tie. Rom siepahruo ngukhyi pi riypa hing ma phungbie ta a pa-aw ma, a thlu ma?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta atingna pha lipa ama hnyipa kha pachang te, “Phahruocuo tie, khaapanakawma ina dyapasya ung ciy?
Ngukhyi pi riypa tuokaa ca na pahmung tie ung,” a ta. Ngu tuokaa denarii phiekha kha ama vya pi.
“Ahung hmiechang hne ahung ming ma a taa?” a ta yi.
“Siepahruo hmiechang hne siepahruo ming,” ama ta. Caacuonakawta, Zingsuv ta, “Caacuokieca siepahruo huopa kha siepahruo pi ung la, Khazing huopa kha Khazing pi tie ung,” a ta yi.
Capa ca ama thyi tiyta ama nang uo te ama kha thuse yi te ama cakuo.
Capa ning ngiethie cata thupakhaana aw vyi a tapa Sadusi ming chekha ca Zingsuv'a luo kha a vaw yi te bie ama hiehriy.
Iema ta, “Saya, Moses ta, ‘Cawsaa pakha ta saata hnyi li pata a thiy biephung kieca, nunghlyinung kha a uvnu pakha ta a hlaw'a te, a thiypa a uvnu cuo khata saata ama sapa aa,' ta pata malie a pacuv.
Hingpa kiema hrawlie hing uvcanu pasariy ama za aw; a pakhanapa paa ca napuv a chiy, saata hnyi li pata thiyse te, nunghlyinung ca a nuta tah aa hlaw.
Cahaa ngiethie cata a pahningnapa paa zaw ca thiy te, a pathungnapa paa zaw a thiy ra ngiethie, ama pasariy yalya ta cahaacata ama thiy.
A hnangcaw ce ta cawsaanung ca a thiy.
Thupakhaana ning thueta capa cawsaanung ca ahung napuv tama a cuo aa? Tahematapakieca ama pasariy ta ama kha amaa zaa hlaw kaluo,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Nama hla, tahematapakieca Caapathe hne Khazing cahrana kha pachang va ung ciy.
Thupakhaana chunglie ca a chiy a hie'a va tli yi, vuoruo lie a awpa avuoming haa tana ama cuo aa.
Athiypa thupakhaana kawlie Khazing ta aca changpa yi,
‘Kama ca Abraham Khazing, Isak Khazing, hne Jakob Khazing tana i cuo,’ a tapa kha ri buo va ung ca ma? Ama ca a hringpa tie Khazing tana a cuo, a thiypa tie Khazing ta cuo vyi,” a ta yi.
Cawsaazaapuv ca a pacuvnapa kha ama thyi tiyta ama nang ta a uo.
Zingsuv na Sadusi ming kha ama ri riy aw lina te ta a tue yi tapa kha Farasi ming ta ama thyi tiyta, a taw pakhaw yi te,
iema hraw taata phungbie saya pakha ta a dyapasya khing pata bie a hiehriy.
“Saya, nawbie hrawlie hing khaapa nawbie hing ma a le ce?” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “'Abyipa na Khazing ca na pathiypalung yalya, na hringna yalya, na ruena yalya ta due tie,'
tapa hingna a le cepa hne a biepuv cepa nawbie ta a cuo.
A suohningnapa nawbie ca: ‘Nama naa duepa haata na ingpaa kha va due tie,’ ta pata a cuo.
Moses phungbie bangkhuo hne profet tie pacuvna bangkhuo ca hingpa nawbie suohning lie hingna aa khung diy,” a ta.
Farasi tie amaa hmyana lie kha, Zingsuv ta hingpa bie hing a hiehriy yi:
“Messiah hing tuokhaatama nama rue? Ahung sacapaa tama a cuo?” a ta yi. Iema ta, “David sacapaa,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Khaapanakawma Thlaapa ta David kha, ‘Messiah hing, ‘Abyipa,’ a pata sa? David ta,
“Abyipa ta i Byipaapa kha ‘Na carie tie kha na phyipazaa rawlie i chi hluo li yi, i cacuoluo hingta a tu tie,’ a ta.
Cahaacata David ta Messiah ca i Byipaapa a ta kieca, tuokhaatama Messiah ca David sacapaa ta a cuo the aa?” a ta.
Zingsuv bie kha ahungtahmuo palie khu va yi, capa ning taa cata ama kha ahungtahmuo bie hiehriy nguo va tli yi.
Zingsuv ta cawsaazaapuv hne ziytuv tie kha,
“Phungbie saya tie hne Farasi tie hing Moses thude lie a tupa tana ama cuo.
Caacuonakawta aca pacuvpa mekaa yi kha tue ung la ziy tie ung. Cuorasala iema ama tuepa haata tue ra khah ung, tahematapakieca iema ca ama pacuvna haata tue va yi.
Aa riysapa hmang, a phya ruvsapa kha cawsaa letung cunglie khang yi te, cuorasala iema ta ca ama kuvdaw tahmuo hrie khing va yi.
Hmangting kha cawsaa hmung the riypata dyi ama tue. Ama caapathepa baw luvrina hne buorina kha pale yi te ama pangpe kha ama pasyi.
Pyi chunglie kha pa-uvsathyipa tie a tuna thude lie a tu khing yi te apungna-ing thude pha cepa lie amaa tu khing.
Chadaw tluo lie cawsaa ta pa-uvsathyina hne bie a chang pata saya ta riypa kha ama tlechuo.
Cuorasala niema ca, saya ta pata upa cuo'a va ung ciy, tahematapakieca saya pakha dyi hnyi ung cate, nama bangkhuo ta siengaachie tana nama cuo.
Cakhutaata chuelyi cunglie hing ahunghmuo i paa ta pata ku'a va ung ciy, tahematapakieca vuoruo lie Paa pakha dyina nama hnyi.
Pacuvtuv ta pata zaw ca u khah yi se, tahematapakieca pacuvtuv Messiah pakha dyina nama hnyi.
Niema hrawlie a le cepa ca nama changtaapa a cuo riypa tana a cuo.
Iema hne Iema a cyicalangpa bangkhuo ca pachung pata cuo'a yi te, iema hne iema a panepa bangkhuo ca cyicalang pata ama cuo aa.

“Cuorasala phungbie saya tie hne Farasi tie, phahruocuo tie, niema ca bawchie ciemuopa tana nama cuo! Tahematapakieca cawsaa kha Vuoruo Pena luo a ngie riypata nama khaakhuo. Niema zaw a ngie lipa ung cata, a ngie khingpa tie zaw kha luo nama khuo.

Phungbie saya tie hne Farasi tie, niema, phahruocuo tie ca bawchie ciemuopa tana nama cuo! Tahematapakieca nunghlyi zaw ing kha chuv ung cate, cawsaa hmung riypata thlaa kha a pasiysa ta namaa pachuo sa; Caacuonakawta a pasa viepa duotena na nama ang aa!

Phungbie saya tie hne Farasi tie, niema, phahruocuo tie ca bawchie ciemuopa tana nama cuo. Tahematapakieca cawsaa pakha chuo ama palung pathle sa riypata riyliy kha te ung cate ruo ting ta nama si. Nama hmung tlakuopa kha hell luo tla pata niema laata le hning ang riypata nama tue.

“Luochiytuv mingcuepa tie, niema ca bawchie ciemuopa tana nama cuo! Niema ta, ‘Cawsaa pakha ta hmangpathepa ming ri pata chie aa sa kieca chie aa sapa ca ta ama kha patuv'a vyi, cuorasala hmangpathepa chunglie a awpa siy ming ri pata chie aa sa kieca chie aa sapa ca ta a patuv aa,’ ta pata nama pacuv.
Mingcue a ngaapa tie! Khaapama a lesyi vie, siy ca ma acuolikie siy a pathesatuv hmangpathepa ca ma?

Cakhutaata niema ta, cawsaa pakha ta hriykhungrina tluophie ta chie aa sa kieca chie aa sapa ta patuv'a vyi, cuorasala hriykhungrina tluophie cunglie pipa lasaw ta chie aa sa kieca chie aa sapa ta a patuv aa nama ta.
Nama ming hing a cue suesaa ing! Pipa lasaw ma a biepuv vie pipa lasaw a pathe sapa hriykhungrina tluophie ca ma?
Caacuonakawta hriykhungrina tluophie ming ri pata chie a sapa ca a cunglie a awpa yalya hne tana chie aa sa.
Hmangpathepa ming ri pata chie aa sa kieca, ama ca a chunglie a awpa Khazing hne tana chie aa sa.
Vuoruo ming ri pata chie aa sa kieca, Khazing byithude hne a cunglie a tupa hneta chie aa sa pata a cuo.

“Phungbie saya tie hne Farasi tie, phahruocuo tie, niema ca bawchie ciemuopa tana nama cuo! Tiyhuo ca-ienapa putinan, hruohmie hne iesing zaw hmuota chehraachekha nama pi, cuorasala phungbie chunglie a biepuvsapa adangna, nangduena hne zang tluo a tlana ca hnang nama chaw. Hingpa zaw hing na nama ziy riypata a cuo, a hrangpa zaw kha dyathlaa li pata.
Luochiytuv mingcuepa tie! Macing sakha hmuo namaa thliy, cuorasala kala-uv ca nama paluo puo!

“Phungbie saya tie hne Farasi tie, niema, phahruocuo tie ca bawchie ciemuopa tana nama cuo! Nama panuo hne pakaa ca aleluo kha pathe paalaa khata nama pasiy, a chung luo ca karuo-awna hne malie nama chuvpa chechiy ta a bi.
Mingcue Farasi tie! Panuo chungluo kha pasiy taa ung la muo, aleluo zaw kha a pathe ra'a ta.

“Phungbie saya tie hne Farasi tie, phahruocuo tie, niema ca bawchie ciemuopa tana nama cuo! Niema ca thungruopa ama thuvpa thluo, a le taa mang pata a puvthesapa, a chung luo ca a thiypa ruv hne a thuv a hniepa tana a bi.
Cahaacata, niema zaw aleluo taata ca cawsaa mekaa cuota nama pha, cuorasala nama chungluo ca phahruo a cuo pakhina hne suena ta a bi.
“Phungbie saya tie hne Farasi tie, phahruocuo tie, niema ca bawchie ciemuopa tana nama cuo! Profet tie thluo zaw kha tuepa ung cate cawsaa aa dangpa tie thluolung kha nama pangi nama pasuo.
Cakhutaata niema ta, “Ma mingchingmingvuo tie chuo lie kha za aw se pala, profet tie thiena lie hing za aw ra hrahring'a vapuv,’ nama ta.
Caacuonakawta niema hrahring ta profet tie zaa thiepa ciypathla zaw nama cuopa kha nama paluo sa.
Nama mingchingmingvuo tie ta ama za patha cie tlipa hmang ca palang lalue tie ung.
Pariy zaw, pariy saata zaw! Tuokhaatama hell luo tla riypa biechina taata nama law the aa?

Caacuonakawta profet tie hne mingsing tie hne phungbie saya tie zaw kha niema'a luo i vya pathlie'a yi; chekha nama thie aa, chekha ca vieluo lie thie'a ung cate, chekha ca apungna-ing lie kha tuv'a ung cate khy kha taata khy kha luo namaa cade aa.

Caacuonakawta suena a hnyi lipa Abel thiena taata hmangpathepa hne hriykhungrina tluophie alalalieta nama thiepa Berekhiah sacapaa Zekhariah thiyse te ta, alyi lie palangpa, aa dangpa bangkhuo tie thiyse kawlieta duotena ca nama cunglie a tlung aa.
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, hingpa zaw hing ata chuo saa zaw cunglie hingna a tlung aa!

“Jerusalem, Jerusalem, profet tie kha thie yi cate nama'a luo vya pathliepa tie kha alung ta a vaasapa khypuv! Yi khazaa ulu ma aapuvnung ta a tachiyta zaw a mathlaa rawlie a pahmyapa haa yi ta na saata zaw hing pahmya pakhaw i khing, cuorasala nama ta khing vaciy.
Mang tie, na ing ca a duothlingpa tana thuse pata a cuo aa.
Ica chang yi, ‘Abyipa ming ta a vawpa ca thluechiypa tana a cuo,’ ta pata nama ri hluo li na hmung'a va tli ung ciy,” a ta yi.
Zingsuv ca Biena-ing taa khata pya te a cakuolepa khata ziytuv tie kha aa thaa luo a vaw yi te, biena-ing hne biena-ing hneta aa pazuepa ing zaw kha ama pahmung. Zingsuv ta,
“Hingpa hing nama hmung kaluo cuo va ma? Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, alung suokha hing hmuo a hrangpa suokha cunglie aa pacangcang pata aw'a va tli, a palang ta pacing diypa tana a cuo aa,” a ta.

Zingsuv Olif Tluocung lie aa tu nguoluo ning kha, ziytuv tie kha iema se ta ama'a luo a vaw yi te, “Malie chang tie, hingpa hmang hing khatiythuema a cuo aa? Naa vaw pakhaana cuo hne cuo chuona riypa khaapa pamangsana hmang ma a vya aw aa,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Ahungtahmuo aca dung li riypa yi ta a raaring tie ung.
Cawsaa hluvpuv i ming ta a vaw'a yi te, ‘Messiah tana i cuo,’ ta'a yi te cawsaa hluvpuv kha ama dung aa.
Rie amaa tuvna thuohlaa hne rie amaa tuv'a nangpa thuohlaa kha nama thyi aa; cuorasala nama thlaa zang khah se; tahematapakieca cahaapa hmang ca a tlung thluo aa, cuorasala a chuona ta cuo valie.
Mingphang phang kha hne phang kha, pena suokha hne suokha amaa du aa. Hmangting lieta cakuo tlung'a te, aling aa siy aa.
Hingpa bangkhuo hing bangkhuo hing ca nupazi aa pathanapa haa tana a cuo.
“Cakhutaata niema kha hrisaa riypa hne thie riypata malie kuv luo aca pi'a yi. Kama kawlieta mingphang ting ta aca hue'a yi.
Cawsaa hluvpuv ca ama zangna kha thuse'a yi te, pakha hne pakha kha a lyi'a yi te amaa hue aa.
Cakhutaata profet pakhipa hluvpuv kha vya pya'a yi te cawsaa hluvpuv kha ama dung aa.
Pha lina kha a pungzaale nakawta duena a cakingle aa.
Cuorasala a chuona te ta a ang pathla khupa ca khuo pata ama cuo aa.
Cakhutaata mingphang bangkhuo cuota tehte cuo riypata pena thuophaa ca chuelyi khyzaa ta phupa a cuo aa; cakhutaa dyi tana a chuona ca a cuo aa.
“Profet Daniel ta a ripa, ciy aa chiypa duvsamakhiepa kha hmang pathepa lie aa daapa nama hmung tiyta, (caa a rituv ta thyi the se),
Judea ruo chunglie a awpa ta tluocung luo kha a ruo yi se.
Ing thlungkhuv cunglie a awpa ta ing chunglie a awpa hmang la riypata cung khah se.
Lu lie a awpa ta a buohryicungle la riypata kaa khah se.
Capa ning hne cuo lie ca nu a phyapa canung hne haaseta a hnyipa canung ca bawchie ciemuopa tana a cuo!
Namaa ruona cuo hing thlasiy chung hne Sabbath ning aa chuo li riypata thlaachuo tie ung.
Tahematapakieca capa cuo lie ca chuelyi hruothu baataata ata cuo te ta a tlung buo lipa, hmieluo cuo thue zaw a tlung li riypa, ruvnaana na a tlung aa.
Capa ning hne cuo kha a pachang vie li kieca ahunghmuota hyazang'a va yi, cuorasala a tlawpa zaw vuo khata capa ning hne cuo ca pachang sa vie pata a cuo aa.
Cakhutaata pakhakha ta, ‘Mang tie, Messiah ca hingpa lie hing a aw hing!’ acuolikie, ‘Huepa lie hue a aw hue!’ aca ta kie zaw yi ma zang khah ungh.

Messiah pakhipa tie hne profet pakhipa tie kha vya pya'a yi te, a cuo khu kieca Khazing a tlaw ciepa zaw kha hmuo aa hmuo lipa luopuv luo a chiy riypata kharuehaa hmang lesapa hne pamangsana zaw kha ama tue aa.
Maw khya ung, a cuo a tling hluota tli hing ica changlu yi.
Caacuonakawta iema ta, ‘Mang tie! ama ca ruocaapa lie na a aw,’ aca ta kie zaw yi ma vaa khah ung. ‘Mang tie! ingkhuo chungliena a aw,’ aca ta kie zaw yi ma va zang khah ung.
Thinghlaa ca ningchiy taata a vya cakang te ningtla te a khepahlipa haa tana Cawsaa Sacapaa ca aa vaw aa.
Saa thiypa a awna lie kha luotaa ta amaa hmyasuele aa.
“Capa te-angna ning hne cuo a chuo khu pahne ta, ning ca zing'a te, thlaa ca vaa'a va tli; aasiy zaw avuo taata za tla'a te, vuoruo cahrana zaw ca amaa cahang aa.

Cakhutaata Cawsaa Sacapaa pamangsana ca avuo lie a luo'a te, alyi lieta mingphang bangkhuo ca ama caa aa. Cakhutaa cata Cawsaa Sacapaa ca vuoruo amyi cung taata cahrana hne rungnaa lesyina cangta aa zuvpa kha ama hmung aa.
Aa vuoming kha hmyakaa khuosa ta tungna cangta pathlie'a yi te, aa tlawpa tie kha chuelyi kiy paliy, avuo dena kuo vyicuo taa khata ama pahmya aa.
“Thyikuvkung'a taa hingta a cuv tie ung. A daw kya pakiy te a hnaa a thue tiyta cuovuo na a ngie tli tapa kha nama pachang.
Cahaacata, hingpa hmang bangkhuo nama hmung tiyta, ama ca thlake thabaw te a vya chiy tli tapa kha nama pachang aa.
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi: ata chuo cawsaa zaw hing hingpa hmang bangkhuo a vya cuo hluo li ca thiy'a va yi.
Alyi hne avuo ca ama ra aa, cuorasala kama bie ca ra'a vyi.
“Cuorasala, capa ning hne cuo kaw ca khatiy tama a cuo aa tapa kha ahungtahmuo pachang va yi; vuoruo lie a awpa avuoming cuose, Sacapaa cuose, pachang va yi; Paa kyalya dyina a pachang.
Cawsaa Sacapaa aa vaw thueta ca Noah chuo ning haa kha tana a cuo ra aa.
Tiypa-aa a tlung hluo, Noah kha tiypalaw chung luo aa ngiena te ta, cawsaa zaw ca ning yi dang yi te, canung hne capaa zaw amaa chiy amaa hie,
tiypa-aa vya tlung te a phya diy hluo te yi ta khaapama a vya tlung tapa kha pachang va yi. Cawsaa Sacapaa aa vaw thueta ca cahaaca tana a cuo ra aa.
Cakhutaata, lu lie a awpa pahning lie kha pakha la pata cuo'a te, pakha ca thuse pata a cuo aa.
Sung a suv hnepa canung pahning lie kha pakha la pata cuo'a te, pakha ca thuse pata a cuo aa.
Caacuonakawta singvaasa pata aw tie ung, tahematapakieca khatiy ningcuo lieta ma nama Byipaapa aa vaw aa tapa kha pachang va ung ciy.
Cuorasala hingpa hing pachang tie ung: Ing a hnyituv ta zuo khatiy tama aparuvpa aa vaw aa tapa kha a pachang kieca a hmung li pata huo'a te a ing kha paruv sa'a vyi.
Caacuonakawta niema zaw a tingpacie pata aw tie ung, tahematapakieca Cawsaa Sacapaa ca nama mangkhuo linapa cuo lie khana aa vaw aa.
“Ahung ma zang tluo aa tlapa hne a singpa sii, a byipaapa ta a ingchungkhue tie mangchiy riypa hne a sii hrangpa tie kha ama'a na a cuota lieta ama cuvu sa pi riypata a chipa ta a cuo?
Re a hrie nguoluo ningta a byipaapa ta a vya chiyhnuepa sii ca thluechiypa tana a cuo.
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, capa paa ca a byipaapa ta a hnyipa bangkhuo a mangchiytuv tana a chi aa.
Cuorasala capa sii ca ta ama hne ama kha, ‘I byipaapa ca a vya haa kalie aa,’ ta sala,
sii hrangpa tie kha tuvde yi te, a pariypa tie hne khata ning dang yi te a aw kieca,
a mangkhuo lina cuo ning hne a pachang lina cuo ning khata a byipaapa ca a vya chiy aa.
A cekary diy'a te, caana hne haa riena a awna hmang lie kha phahruocuo tie hne khata a chi pakhaw aa.
“Vuoruo Pena ca hing haa hing tana a cuo aa. Nungchiytuv satlie daw riypata ama myi-ing hne a pyapa lesaa pahraa haa tana ama cuo.
Iema hrawlie papangaa ca a ngaapa ta cuo yi te a hrangpa papangaa ca a singpa ta ama cuo.
A ngaapa tie ca myi-ing kha a cyi yi te myitiy a cyi va yi;
cuorasala a singpa tie ca ama myi-ing hne myitiy a bi pata ama rawpa pung kha amaa cyipuo.
Nungchiytuv satlie ca a vya chiy haa nakawta lesaa zaw ca tluv yi te amaa hmung.
Zuocang a chiypa khiy ta, ‘Nungchiytuv satlie na a vaw tli! Thu ung la va daw tie ung,’ ta pata ama khi.
Lesaa pahraa tie ca thu yi te ama myi-ing kha amaa pachie.
A ngaapa tie ta a singpa tie kha, ‘Myitiy malie pibuo thi tie ung, ma myi-ing na a thiy'a nang,’ ama ta.
Cuorasala a singpa tie ta, ‘Cuo the'a vyi, niema hne kiema hne malie a zu pakhaw the'a vyi, chadaw luo kha cakuo ung la nama vaa calyi pata na a pha vie aa,’ ama ta.
A ngaapa lesaa tie myitiy ama vaa calyi chung ta nungchiytuv satlie ca vya chiy te, a ting pacie pata a awpa papangaa tie hneta achiyhie saduona luo kha a ngie yi te ingchiy kha ama khaa.
Cakhutaa cata lesaa hrangpa tie ca vya chiy yi te, ‘Abyipa, Abyipa, malie pahaw tie,’ ama ta.
Cuorasala ama ta, ‘Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, niema kha ca pachang va yi ang,’ a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta a raaring pata huo tie ung, tahematapakieca a ning hne a cuo kha pachang va ung ciy.
“Vuoruo Pena ca khy tlawna luo a tha'a nang nakawta a sii zaw kha ku yi te a hnyipa mangchiy riypata bie a taa siypa tie haa tana a cuo.
Ama hmang tue khuna cyicuo zi ta tuokaa kha a pi yi: pakha kha talen suopangaa, pakha kha talen suohning, pakha kha talen suokha law ta a pi yi. Cakhutaa cata khy tlawna luo ca a si.
Talen suopangaa a hmungpa paa ta a tuokaa cata sung pali te, a hrangpa talen suopangaa amie a hmung.
Cahaacata talen suohning a hmungpa paa ta a hrangpa talen suohning amie a hmung ra.
Cuorasala talen suokha a hmungpa paa khata alyi kha cu te a byipaapa tuokaa kha a nu.
Cuo pasiypuv khutaata capa sii tie ama byipaapa ca vya chiy pakhaa te ama tuokaa hmuonapa kha a sieta tah a tue khyi yi.
Tuokaa talen suopangaa a hmungpa paa kha hmieluo vya pya te a mie talen suopangaa a vya pi. ‘Abyipa, kama kha tuokaa talen suopangaa ina za pi ciy. Mang tie! talen suopangaa i pamie,’ a ta.

A byipaapa ta, ‘A pha ciemuo, a phapa hne zang tluo aa tlapa sii, nama ca hmang cawta kawlie zang tluo aa tlapa tana na cuo, hmang hluvpuv mangchiytuv tana ica chi aa, zaa ngie la na byipaapa palungtluona hing zaa hraw ra tie,’ a ta.
Cakhutaata tuokaa talen suohning a hmungpa paa kha hmieluo vya pya ra te, ‘Abyipa, kama kha tuokaa talen suohning ina za pi ciy; mang tie! talen suohning i pamie,’ a ta.

A byipaapa ta, ‘A pha ciemuo, a phapa hne zang tluo aa tlapa sii, nama ca hmang cawta kawlie zang tluo aa tlapa tana na cuo, hmang hluvpuv mangchiytuv tana ica chi aa, zaa ngie la na byipaapa palungtluona hing zaa hraw ra tie,’ a ta.

Cakhutaata tuokaa talen suokha a hmungpa paa kha a hmieluo vya pya ra te, ‘Abyipa, nama ca cawsaa tateta-iepa, saciy na vaa lina lie sa hrie cate, ciy na cyi lina lieta a thyipaa a pahriypa na cuopa kha ica pachang;
caacuonakawta ca ciy angte na tuokaa talen suokha ca alyi chunglie i nu, na huopa hing a la tie,’ a ta.
A byipaapa ta, ‘A pha lipa hne a thaathiypa sii! Saciy i vaa lina lieta sa hrie angte, ciy i cyi lina hmang lieta thyipaa i pahriy tawpa na pachang ciy cuo va ma?
Caacuokieca i vya kaa thueta i tuokaa hne amie hne i hmung riypata i tuokaa ca bank lie na za chi riypa muo a cuo ta.
Caacuonakawta tuokaa kha ama'a taa hingta la ung la, talen suohraa a hnyipa paa kha pi tie ung.
Tahematapakieca a hnyipa tie bangkhuo kha a hluv vie ta pipa cuo'a yi te, a hlyikhungna te ta ama hnyi aa; cuorasala khaapahmuo a hnyi lipa tie kha ama hnyi tlakuopa kha hmuo lapa pata ama cuo aa.
Hingpa thlahnena a hnyi lipa sii hing ale khyzingna luo, caana hne haa riena hmang luo kha thaw tie ung,’ a ta.
“Cawsaa Sacapaa ca a rungnaana cangta avuoming bangkhuo hneta aa vaw tiyta, a byithude rungnaapa cunglie ca a tu'a te,
mingphang bangkhuo ca athaalie pahmya pata ama cuo aa. Tuvkhietuv ta tuv ca mie'a taata a chepa haata mingphang bangkhuo kha phuv hning ta a che'a yi.
Tuv tie kha a cacuoluo ta chi'a yi te mie tie kha a cavyiluo ta a chi'a yi.
Siepahruo ta a cacuoluo ta a awpa tie kha, ‘I paa ta thluechiy a pipa tie, a vaw ung la, chuelyi hruothu baataata niema cuota ting ciepa pena ru hing vya cu tie ung.
Tahematapakieca i nang diy te sa ina pi ung ciy, i tiy hrie te tiy ina pi ung ciy, khyche cuo angte ing inaa patlung sa ung ciy,
a buv a se riypa i hnyi li ning ta caw ina pi ung ciy, pasa angte ina mangsang ung ciy, thaw tla angte ina ve ung ciy,’ a ta'a yi.
Cawsaa aa dangpa tie ta, ‘Abyipa, khaapa ning ma na nang diy te sa maca pi, na tiy hrie te tiy maca pi buo?
Khaapa ning ma khyche cuo cate ing maacaa patlung sa, a buv a se riy hnyi li pata aw cate caw maca pi buo?
Khaapa ning ma pasa cate acuolikie thaw lie aw cate maca ve buo?’ ama ta aa.
Siepahruo ta, ‘Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, hingpa i uvnu zaw hrawlieta nutaa cepa a cuo zaw a cunglie nama tuepa ca kama cunglie nama tuepa tana a cuo,’ a ta'a yi.
Cakhutaata a cavyiluo ta a awpa tie kha, ‘Niema, chie sapa tie, i thaa taa hingta pya ung la khachie hne aa vuoming cuota ting ciepa a thiy buo lipa myi chung luo kha cakuo tie ung.
Tahematapakieca i nang diy te sa na pi va ung ciy, i tiy hrie te tiy na pi va ung ciy,
khyche cuo angte ing naa patlung sa va ung ciy, a buv a se riy hnyi li pata aw angte caw na pi va ung ciy; i pasa ning hne thaw i tla ning zaw na ve va ung ciy,’ a ta'a yi.

Cakhutaa iema ta, ‘Abyipa, kha tiy ning ma na nang a diy, na tiy a hrie, khyche ta na cuo, a buv a se riy hnyi li pata na aw, na pasa, thaw na tla pata ca hmung pate caa byase khing li pata ma aw buo?’ ama ta aa.
Cakhutaata ama ta, ‘Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, nutaa cepa cawsaa pakha naa bya khing lipa ca, kama inaa bya khing lipa ca tana a cuo,’ a ta'a yi.
Cakhutaata, capa tie ca chuozaa duotena ruo luo kha si'a yi te, cawsaa a dangpa tie ca chuozaa hringna luo kha ama si aa,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta hingpa bie bangkhuo hing a ri khutaata ziytuv tie kha,
“Nama pachangpa haata ning hning khutaata Lawsena Pyi vya cuo'a tli te, Cawsaa Sacapaa ca vieluo lie thie riypata pipa a cuo aa,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata tluobyi lepa tie hne uvthyi tie ca tluobyi le cepa Kaiafas ing lie kha a hmya yi te,
Zingsuv kha a paruvta tah patuv pata thie riypata khue ama khuo.
Cuorasala iema ta, “Pyi chung hingta ca tue'a va ung puv, cawsaa na hnaa a pahnaw'a yi,” amaa ta.
Zingsuv ca Bethani khy, caahminghmaa zaa phya buopa Simon ing lie a aw nguoluo ning kha
canung pakha a vaw te, alabaster ungthyi lie a bi pata a rawpa a muo ruv ciemuopa ziyhmyi kha cabya lie aa tu nguoluo pata a luv lie a bya.
Capa ca ziytuv tie ta ama hmung tiyta ama hi haa te, “A puohrie hringhruo de!
Hingpa ziyhmyi hing tuokaa a hluvsa ta zaa pata siypasa tie pi riypa a cuo raalaa pata,” ama ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta capa kaw ca a pachang tiyta, “Khaapanakawma hingpa nung hing hnaa nama pahnaw? I cuota hmang phapa na a tue.
Siypasa tie ca niema'a lie ama aw pari aa, cuorasala kama ca niema'a lie aw pari'a va ang.
Ziyhmyi ina byapa hing i riyy paby riypata a tingtuopa tana a cuo.
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, thuophaa ama phunapa chuelyi khy ting lie kha hingpa nung a tuepa hmang hing ama maw lina ta ama rile pari aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata ziytuv hlyihning hrawlie pakha ta a cuopa Judas Iskariot ca tluobyi lepa tie'a luo kha vaa te,
“Zingsuv hing nama kuv luo ica pi kie yi ca khaapama ina pi'a ung ciy?” a ta yi. Iema ta ngu tuokaa sawthung ama pi.
Cakhutaata ca Judas ca Zingsuv lyi riypa cuophaa dyi kha a bya.
Thiynung phuv lipa Viechuo Pyi a ning khana lie kha ziytuv tie ca Zingsuv'a luo kha a vaw yi te, “Lawsena Pyi Zuosa ca khaapa lieta pachie se pala ma na khing?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Khy chunglie cawsaa pakhapa'a luo kha vaa ung la, ‘Saya na, I cuo na a tling tli, naa ziytuv tie hne tana na ing lie Lawsena Pyi i tue khing, caa ta,’ va ta tie ung,” a ta yi.
Zingsuv ta a changpa haa yi cata ziytuv tie ta Lawsena Pyi sa ca ama pachie.
Zuoluo a vya cuo tiyta, Zingsuv ca ziytuv hlyihning tie hne khata cabya lie aa tu.
Sa ama ning nguoluo pata Zingsuv ta, “Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, niema chung taa pakha ta ina lyi'a ung ciy,” a ta.
Ziytuv tie ca ama ngie chi hringhruo te pakha hnang pakha ta ama kha, “Abyipa, kama ta i cuo ma?” ama ta kaluo.
Zingsuv ta, “Kama hne kuotung suokha chunglie a viechuo a naw hnepa hingna naa lyi aa.
Cawsaa Sacapaa ca Caapathe lie a kaw aa capepa haa tana a si aa, cuorasala Cawsaa Sacapaa a lyituvpa cuota ca bawchie ciemuopa tana a cuo! Capa paa ca puv li pata aw sala a cuota a pha vie aa,” a ta.
A lyituv Judas ta, “Saya, kama ta i cuo ma?” ta pata a hiehriy. Zingsuv ta, “Nama na a ri tli ciy,” a ta.
Sa ama ning nguoluo ning kha, Zingsuv ta viechuo kha la te thlaa a chuo khutaata chechi te, ziytuv tie kha a pi yi. “A la ung la ning tie ung, hingpa hing i pangpa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata panuo kha la te, Khazing kha palungtluona bie a hluo khutaata iema kha pi yi te, “Nama bangkhuo ta dang tie ung;
hingpa hing biekuona thiyse, cawsaa hluvpuv sue angiethena riypata i lyipa tana a cuo.
Ica chang yi, i Paa pena chunglie niema hne mingsuvtiy thaapa i dang hluo li hingpa mingsuvtiy hing dang pakhaa'a va tli ang,” a ta.
Hlaa ama sa khutaata Olif tluo luo ama si.

Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta iema kha, “Ata zuo lie hing nama bangkhuo hingta inaa ruose diy'a ung ciy, tahematapakieca Caapathe chunglieta, ‘Tuvkhietuv kha tuvsa'a angte, tuv zaw ca chepatlaa pata ama cuo aa,’ a ta.
Cuorasala pathu pakhaapa i cuo khutaata Galilee luo kha niema hmieluo ta i silu aa,” a ta yi.
Piter ta Zingsuv kha, “Iema bangkhuo ta acaa ruose zaw yi ta, kama ca caa ruose buo hluo'a va ang,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Biehmisi tana ica chang: Ata zuo aa a khang hluota yi thung ina thaw'a ciy,” a ta.
Piter ta, “Nama hne thiy ra riypa i cuo zaw ta ca thaw'a va ang,” a ta. Ziytuv tie bangkhuo ta cahaacata ama ta kaluo.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ca ziytuv tie hne khata Gethsemane ama tapa hmang luo kha vaa yi te iema kha, “Huepa lie thlaa i va chuo chung hing, hingpa lie hing zaa tu tie ung,” a ta yi.
Piter hne Zebedi sacapaa pahning tie kha aa chiyle yi, a ngie chi te a lalilahie a chiy.
Iema kyihuo khata, “I ngie chi hringhruo te, vuotaa i thiy'a nang. Hingpa lie hing za aw ung la a hmung li pata na huo mya ung,” a ta yi.

A cawta va cakuo vie te, alyi lie kha a bu te, “I Paa, a cuo khu pata a cuo kieca, hingpa panuo hingta na law thi se! Cuorasala kama khingna haata cuo khah se, nama khingna haata cuo hriy se,” ta pata thlaa a chuo.
Cakhutaata ziytuv tie'a luo kha vya kaa te amaa zaa hmungpa kha a hmung yi ca, Piter kyihuo khata, “A hmung li pata siymaluo pakha chuo hmuo na huo khu va ung ca ma?
Pasupaliyna chung luo nama tla li riypata a hmung li pata thlaachuo tie ung; pathiypalung ta ca a khing hmisi thluo, cuorasala saapa ca a thaazuo na a caw,” a ta.
Zingsuv ca a yihningnapa vaa pakhaa te thlaa a chuo. “I Paa, hing panuo hing dang li pata law the a aw li kieca, na khingnapa haata cuo thluo se,” a ta.
Ziytuv tie'a luo kha a vya kaa pakhaa ca amaa zaa hmungpa kha a hmung ngiethie yi, ama ming hetahmuo haw khu va yi.
Thuse pakhaa yi te, vaa te, a yi thungnapa thlaa a chuo pakhaa, a ri tawpa bie kha a ri pakhaa.
Cakhutaata ziytuv tie'a luo kha vya kaa te, “A hmung ung cate ma namaa pahy kalie thluo? Mang tie ung, a cuo na a tling tli, Cawsaa Sacapaa ca a suepa tie kuv chung luo lyi pata a cuo tli.
Thu tie ung, cakuo'a ung puv. Mang tie ung, naa lyituv ca a vya chiy tli hing,” a ta yi.

Zingsuv ta bie a ri nguoluo ning kha ziytuv hlyihning hraw taata pakha a cuopa Judas ca tluobyi lepa tie hne uvthyi tie ta ama pathliepa, zueziy hne tungbung a cyipa cawsaazaapuv hne khata ama vya chiy.
A lyituvpa ca ta zaapuv kha pamangsana pi yi te, “I pahnuopa paa ca nama patuv khingpa khata a cuo aa, patuv tie ung,” a ta yi.
Zingsuv'a luo kha vaa paluo te, “Saya, na cunglie diena aw se,” ta te a pahnuo.
Zingsuv ta, “Liechung, na tue khingpa ca tue tie,” a ta. Ca khu pahne ta a vaw yi te Zingsuv ca ama patuv.
Zingsuv hne a aw rapa pakha ta a zueziy kha a da te tluobyi lepa sii naakue kha a sa pathla.
Zingsuv ta, “Na zueziy kha a kaw luo pasuo tie; zueziy a hmuopa bangkhuo ca zueziy tana ama thiy aa.
I Paa kha abyana i hie kieca yi kha ta avuoming riekaphuv hlyihning laata a hluv vie ina za pathliepa khu tapa kha pachang va ca ma?
Cuorasala cahaacata a cuo kieca, tuokhaatama hing haa hing tana a cuo aa za tapa Caapathe bie ca a tling khu aa?” a ta.

Capa cuo ning ca ta Zingsuv ta cawsaazaapuv kha, “Zueziy hne tungbung a vya cyi ung cate ma kama ca damie haata patuv riypata namaa vaw? Ningting ta Biena-ing lie a tu angte ica pacuv ning yi kha na patuv vade ung ciy.
Cuorasala profet tie ta Caapathe chunglie ama ripa a tlingna riypa tana hingpa hmang bangkhuo hing a vya cuo,” a ta. Cakhutaata ziytuv tie bangkhuo ta ama kha thuse yi te amaa ruo.
Zingsuv ca a patuvpa tie khata tluobyi lepa Kaiafas ing luo kha cakuokhyi yi te capa lie ca phungbie saya tie hne uvthyi tie kha amaa zaa hmya.
Cuorasala Piter ta tluobyi lepa tlawhmie te khata aa hlapuo pata a ziy yi, tlawhmie chung luo kha a ngie te tuokhaatama hmang a vya cuo aa tapa pachang khing re pata rie a vepa tie'a lie kha aa tu.
Tluobyi lepa tie hne bieripatuv byi tie palang ta Zingsuv kha thie khu riypata a hanghiepa tehte kha huv yi te,
a hluvsa amaa vaw raalaa pata a suena suokha hmuo hmung khu va yi. A hnangcaw ce ta cawsaa pahning vya pya yi te,
“Hingpa paa hingta, ‘Khazing Biena-ing hing pacing diy'a angte ning thung chunglie i sa pakhaa khu aa,’ a ta,” ama ta.
Tluobyi lepa ta a daa te Zingsuv kha, “Palie riypa hnyi va ca ma? Hingpa tie ta sue aca phawpa yi hing khaapa bie tama a cuo?” a ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ca a dieta tah a aw. Cakhutaa cata tluobyi lepa ta, “A hringpa Khazing ming ta chie a sa angte na i ri: Khazing Sacapaa, Messiah ta na cuo kieca malie chang tie,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Na ri tli cahaw! Cuorasala ica chang yi, Ata taa hingta Cawsaa Sacapaa ca Cahrana cacuoluo kuo khata a tu'a te vuoruo amyi cung taata aa zuvpa kha nama hmung aa,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata tluobyi lepa ca a pang kha thlaa te, “Capa ca Khazing ripachiena tana a cuo! Pachangkhyituv hrangpa a hu va tli puv. Khazing ripachiena bie a ripa ca niema ta nama thyi tli.
Tuokhaatama nama rue?” a ta. Iema ta, “Thiy aa phuv,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata a hmie lie kha ama paciy ta pacha yi te ama tuv; chekha ta cabe yi te,
“Messiah, ahungma caa cabe tapa kha malie chang tie,” ama ta.
Piter ca ingle, tlawhmie lie aa tu nguoluo ning kha tluobyi lepa changtaanung kha ama'a luo a vaw te, “Nama zaw hing Galilee ming Zingsuv hne a khepa tana na cuo,” a ta.
Cuorasala iema bangkhuo hmielie kha a sie te, “Khaapama na ri tapa kha pachang va ang,” a ta.
Ahmiedaw luo kha a pya ca a hrangpa changtaanung ta ama kha hmung te athaalie a daapa tie kha, “Hingpa paa hing Nazareth khypa Zingsuv'a lie zaa aw rapa tana a cuo,” a ta yi.
Piter ta, “Hingpa paa hing i pachangpa cuo vyi,” ta pata chie a sa te aa sie pakhaa.
A cawta a awpa ta, capa lie a daapa tie ta Piter ca, “Nama hing iema'a lie a aw rapa tana na cuo hrahring, na uephya tana naa hnang,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Piter ta, “Nama ripa paa hing pachang hrahring va ang!” ta pata chie a sa te bie a kuo. Capa cuo lie ca aa a khang.
Piter ca Zingsuv ta a za changpa, “Aa a khang hluota pachang va ang, ta pata yi thung te ina thaw'a ciy,” a tapa bie kha aa kya thyi pakhaa. Ale luo kha pya te palung ityalya khata a caa.
Mawdiychie ta tluobyi lepa tie hne uvthyi tie ca a hmya yi te Zingsuv thie riypa kha khue ama khuo.
Ama kha pa-uo yi te ama ciy khutaata muokiy byi Pilat kuv luo kha ama pi.
Zingsuv a lyituv Judas ta Zingsuv ca thie riypa tana bie ama chipa tapa kha a pachang tiyta ngu tuokaa sawthung kha la te tluobyi lepa tie hne uvthyi tie kha a va pi pakhaa yi.
“Suena a hnyi lipa paa lyi angte thiyna luo i papha sapa ca i sue,” a ta. Cuorasala iema ta, “Kiema hne khaapama aa se, na tue the thiy ta vaa tue tie,” ama ta.
Tuokaa sawthung kha biena-ing chunglie ca thawsiy te a pya; cakuo te a vaa pa-uosa.
Tluobyi lepa tie ta tuokaa kha a haa yi te, “Hingpa tuokaa hing ca thiyse tuokaa tana a cuo, biena-ing suethiy lie chi riypa ca a phung ta cuo vyi,” ama ta.
Ama ri pakhaw khutaata bi vytuvpa paa lu kha ruohrang ming thluohmang riypata ama calyi.
Caacuonakawta capa lu ca ataning tepa ta Thiyse Lu ta pata ama u.
Cahaacata profet Jeremiah ta a za ri siypa bie ca a tling, “Israel ming ta capa paa calyina muo riypata bie ama chi ciepa ngu tuokaa sawthung kha la yi te,
Abyipa ta bie ina pipa haata bi vytuv lu calyina ta ama hmuo,” a za ta.
Zingsuv ca muokiy byipa hmiekunglie kha a daa te, muokiy byipa ca ta, “Judah ming siepahruo ta na cuo ma? ta pata a hiehriy. Zingsuv ta, “Na ripa haata i cuo,” a ta.
Cuorasala tluobyi lepa tie hne uvthyi tie ta sue ama phawpa kha suokha hmuo palie va yi.
Caacuonakawta Pilat ta, “Kha tluv tama sue aca phaw yi tapa hing thyi va ca ma?” a ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta bie palie vyi, kaa kha hmuo a palie li nakawta muokiy byipa ca a nang ta a uo.
Lawsena Pyi lieta muokiy byipa ta, cawsaazaapuv ta pathliepa riypata ama hiepa thaw a tlapa pakha kha a pathliepa taw yi.
Capa cuo ning ca zaapuv ta pachangpa thaw a tlapa pakha aw te, a ming ca Zingsuv Barabbas ta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta zaapuv kha amaa vya hmya ca Pilat ta, “Ahung hing malie pathliepa se tapa ma ina khing ung ciy? Zingsuv Barabbas ma acuolikie Messiah tapa Zingsuv ma?” a ta yi.
Tahematapakieca Pilat ta, iema ta a kuv chung luo Zingsuv ama pipa hing i-aw ama hnyi nakaw tana a cuo tapa kha a phasa pata a pachang.

Pilat ca bieripana thude lie aa tu nguoluo ning kha a napuvnung ta bie kya taa te, “Suena khaapahmuo a hnyi lipa paa kha a cunglie khaapahmuo tue lie ciy, tahematapakieca ama kawlie tana ataning i muo lieta riethyina a hluvsa i ang,” a ta.
Tluobyi lepa tie hne uvthyi tie ta cawsaazaapuv kha Barabbas kha pathlie riypa hne Zingsuv kha thie riypata ama pahie sa.
Muokiy byipa ta cawsaazaapuv kha, “Iema pahning lieta a ahung hing ma pathlie se ta pata ina khing ung ciy?” a ta pakhaa yi. Iema ta, “Barabbas!” ama ta.
Pilat ta, “Caacuokieca Messiah tapa Zingsuv hing tuokhaatama i tue aa?” a ta. Ama bangkhuo ta, “Vieluo lie thie tie!” ama ta.
Ama ta, “Khaapanakawma, khaapa pha lina ma a tue? a ta yi. Cuorasala khuo vie ta khi yi te, “Vieluo lie thie tie!” ama ta.

Pilat ta khaapahmuo tue khu va tli ang tapa hne hnaahnawnapa tlaku na a pya'a nang tapa kha a pachang nakawta, tiy kha a la te cawsaazaapuv hmielie kha a kuv a siy te, “Hingpa suena a hnyi lipa thiyse kawlie hing kama ca i pathe, niema tuepa tana a cuo,” a ta yi.
Cawsaazaapuv ca ta ama bangkhuo ta, “Hingpa paa thiyse ca kiema hne ma saata zaw cunglie tlung mang sue!” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Pilat ta Barabbas kha pathliepa yi te, Zingsuv ca a tuv khutaata vieluo lie thie riypata a pi yi.
Cakhutaata muokiy byipa rieka tie ta Zingsuv ca muokiy byipa ing luo ca a ngiekhyi yi te ama yalya ta ama cadung.
A pang kha hlepa yi te pang sepa ama pabuv.
Cakhutaata ahling ta ama phiepa lakhuv kha ama pakhuv. A cacuo kuv lie kha asung pahrie yi te, a hmiekunglie ama pakhuv pane yi te ama tue hyalya. “Judah siepahruo ca a hringtaa pasiy se!” ama ta.
Ama paciy ta pacha yi te, asung kha chuv yi te a luv lie amaa hluo.
Ama tue hyalya khutaata buohryi pasiypa kha thliepa yi te ama a caw kha ama pahryi pakhaa. Cakhutaata vieluo lie thie riypata ama sikhyi.
Ama pyalepa khata Sairin khy ming Simon ama tapa kha a taw yi te, Zingsuv vieluotung ca hripuo yi te ama papuv sa.
Golgotha (Luvruv Hmang tana siyluo tana a cuo) ama tapa hmang luo ama chiy tiyta,
capa lie ca Zingsuv kha mangkhaa haata a khapa tiy hne ama pyapa mingsuvtiy ama pi, cuorasala capa ca aa pacuo tiyta dang khing vyi.
Zingsuv ca vieluo lie thie yi te a caw kha vyisung a da yi te amaa re.
Cakhutaata capa lie ca a tu yi te ama kha ama huo.
“Hingpa paa hing Judah siepahruo Zingsuv tana a cuo,” tapa, sue ama phawnapa caa kha cape yi te a luv cunglie ama taa.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv'a lie ca damie pahning kha, pakha a cacuoluo, pakha a cavyiluo ta vieluo lie ama taa ra.
A hmungpaapa tie khata ama luv tisue yi te ama bieke ta,
“Biena-ing kha pacing diy'a angte ning thung chung ta i sa pakhaa diy aa a tapa, nama hne nama kha a khuo tie nie! Khazing Sacapaa ta na cuo kieca vieluo cung taa khata za cung tie,” ama ta.
Cahaacata tluobyi lepa tie, phungbie saya tie hne uvthyi tie zaw ta tue hyalya yi te,
“Malie ca a khuo yi, cuorasala ama hne ama ca a khuo khu vyi. Israel ming siepahruo ta muo a cuo ta; atabala hingta vieluo cung taata za cung sala ca ma zang'a muo.
Ama ta Khazing kha a buchuo pata, ‘Khazing Sacapaa tana i cuo,’ aa ta; Khazing ca ta a khing kie ata hingta za khuo se,” amaa ta.
Ama hne vieluo ama taa hnepa damie tie zaw khata ama tue hyalya ra.
Ningchung khingkhuo taata zuoluo siymaluo pathung te alyicung yalya lie zingna a tlung.
Siymaluo pathung hrawlie kha Zingsuv ca, “Eli, Eli, lema sabakthani?” ta pata khuopuv ta a khi. A siyluo ca, “I Khazing, i Khazing, khaapanakawma ina thaw ciy?” tana ta a cuo.
A thaalie a daapa chekha ta thyi yi te, “Elijah na a u,” ama ta.
Iema hraw taa pakha ta vaa ruo pahraa te pangcaw kha la te mingsuvtiy thuepa chunglie a naw khutaata aarasung daw lie ciypuo te dang riypata a pi.
Cuorasala a hrangpa tie ta, “Aw caw, ama khuo riypata Elijah aa vaw ma a vaw va ma tapa kha mang'a ung puv,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ca khuopuv ta khi pakhaa te a huv a ci.
Capa cuo lie ca ta Biena-ing pangzu ca a luv taata a lie te a tlaa. Alyi aa cahang, alung kyi te aa che.
Thluo zaw kha a pahaw yi te Khazing cawsaa pathepa a thiy ciepa a hluvsa kha ama thu pakhaa.
Zingsuv a thu pakhaa khutaata thluo chungtaata kya pya yi te, khypuv pathepa chung luo kha a ngie yi te cawsaa hluvpuv'a lie kha amaa luo.
Zingsuv a huopa riebyipa hne a rieka tie ca aling aa siypa hne hmang a cuopa ting kha ama hmung tiyta, ama thlaa zang hringhruo te, “Hingpa cawsaa hing Khazing Sacapaa hmisi tana a cuo,” ama ta.
Galilee ruo taata Zingsuv zaa ziy tawpa tie hne zaa bya tawpa tie canung a hluvsa zaw capa lie ca aw yi te luopaa taa khata ama mang.
Iema hrawlie ca Mary Magdalin, Jeim hne Josef nung Mary, hne Zebedi sacapaa tie ama nung zaw kha ama aw ra.
Zuoluocaw khata Arimathea khy taata Josef ama tapa, a hnyirungsapa paa, Zingsuv ziytuv zaa cuopa paa pakha a vya chiy.
Pilat kha vaa taw te Zingsuv riyy kha aa hie. Pilat ta, Zingsuv riyy kha Josef pi riypata naw a pi yi.
Caacuonakawta Josef ta Zingsuv riyy kha la te pawruo pang pathepa ta cataw te
ama thluo riypata alung ryi te a cupa thluo thaapa lie kha a paby. Cakhutaata lungphie lesapa ta thluokhuepakaa kha khaa te a cakuose.
Mary Magdalin hne Mary hrangpa pakha ca thluo luo kha a hyi yi te amaa tu.
A mawluopa, Sabbath ning lie kha tluobyi lepa tie hne Farasi tie ta Pilat kha a taw yi te,
“Abyipa, hingpa a hanghiepa paa hingta a hring ningta, ‘Ning thung khutaa pathu pakhaa pata na i cuo aa,’ a za tapa kha ma pachang.

Caacuonakawta a thluo kha ning thung te huo riypata naw pi tie yi, ca ta a cuo li kieca a ziytuv tie ta a riyy kha paruv'a yi te cawsaa kha, ‘Thiyna taa tana a thu pakhaa tli,’ ta'a yi te, a hnang ta malie ama dungnapa hing tawtaa ta malie ama dungnapa laata a ruv vie aa,” ama ta.
Pilat ta “A huotuv riypa rieka nama hnyi thluo kha, vaa ung la a pha khu chung ta va pahuo sa tie ung,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta a huotuv tie hne khata cakuo yi te thluo khaakhuvlung kha caa ama khe khutaata a phasa pata ama pahuo sa.
Sabbath khutaata a mawluopa, zaa kha chunglie a ning khanapa mawdiychie ta Mary Magdalin hne a hrangpa Mary ca thluo kha mang riypata ama vaa.
Sungkhapuv ta aling a siy te, Abyipa avuoming pakha ca vuoruo taata za cung te thluokhaakhuv kha hnyi te a cunglie aa tu.
A hmingsuo ca thinghlaa haata cuo te a cawsie ca cahue haata a ruo.
Thluo a huotuv tie ca ama kha ama ciy tuv nakawta a siysa yi te athiypa haata ama cuo.
Cuorasala avuoming ta canung tie kha, “Ciy khah ung, vieluo lie ama thiepa Zingsuv nama huvpa kha ica pachang yi.
Ama ca hingpa lie hing aw vyi, a ripa haa khata a thu pakhaa tli. A vaw ung la a laanapa hing mang tie ung.

Cakhutaata a catli pata cakuo ung la ziytuv tie kha, ‘Thiyna taata pathu pakhaa pata cuo tli te ata hing nama hmieluo kha tana Galilee luo a silu tli, capa lie cana nama va hmung aa,’ ta ung la va chang tie ung. Hingpa hingna niema cuota ica phyapa yi bie ta a cuo,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta thluo taa khata thlaazangpuona hne palungtluona cangta a catlisa pata kaa yi te, ziytuv tie chang riypata amaa ruo.
Zingsuv ta iema kha tlangkhy a taw yi te, “Niema'a lie thlaalungna aw mang sue!” a ta yi. Vaa yi te, a phyi kha a paw yi te amaa bie.
Zingsuv ta, “Ciy khah ung, cakuo ung la i uvnu tie kha Galilee luo si riypata va chang tie ung, capa lie cana ina hmung'a yi,” a ta.
Canung tie ama kaale nguoluo ning kha thluo a huopa tie chekha ca khypuv chung luo kha vaa yi te, hmang chiycuona bangkhuo kha tluobyi lepa tie ama va chang.
Tluobyi lepa tie ca Judah uvthyi tie hne khata a hmya yi te, rieka tie kha nawthuv tuokaa a hluvsa pi riypata khue ama khuo.
‘Zuo maa hmung chung ta ziytuv tie a vaw yi te na a riyy kha ama vya paruv,’ nama ta aa.
Hingpa bie hing muokiy byipa ta a thyi biephung kie zawma, kiema ta a palung patluo'a pate ruvnaana namaa taw li riypata maca rikuo'a yi,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta tuokaa kha a la yi te ama changpa haa khata ama tue. Capa bie ca Judah ming hrawlie ataning tepa hingta ama ripa bie ta a cuo.
Ziytuv hlyikha tie ca Zingsuv ta a ripa haa khata Galilee tluo luo kha ama si.
Ama kha hmung yi te amaa bie, cuorasala chekha ca ama palung a hring.
Zingsuv ta a ngie vie yi te, “Vuoruo hne alyi lie naw hnyina bangkhuo ca pi pata i cuo tli.
Caacuonakawta si ung la mingphang bangkhuo kha naa ziytuv va pacuo sa ung la, Paa hne Saa hne Thlaapa Pathe ming ta tiynawna va pi tie ung,
cakhutaata ica changpa bangkhuo yi hing ama ziy riypata va pacuv tie ung. Hingpa hing maw khah ung, chuozaa ta niema'a lie ica awpuo'a yi, cuo chuona te ta,” a ta yi.
Khazing Sacapaa Zingsuv Khrih thuophaa a pathanapa ca hing haa hingta a cuo.
Profet Isaiah ta, “Mang tie, nama luo caa sa daw riypa tana i biephyatuv kha na hmieluo ta i pathlie aa;
ueryi suokha ca ruocaapa lie kha u te: ‘Abyipa luopuv kha sapa tie ung, a luopuv ca padang tie ung!’” a tapa haa khata a cuo sasaw.
Tiynawtuv Johan ca ruocaapa lie kha vya pya te, sue angiethena cuota a ngiepachiy pata tiy a naw riypa kha a ukhyi.
Judea pe khyta bangkhuo taata hne Jerusalem khypuv taata cawsaa bangkhuo ca Johan'a luo kha vya pya yi te, ama suena kha a phu yi te Jordan cavaa lie kha tiy a naw yi.
Johan ca kala-uv hming ta taapa caw kha a tue te a se lie kha savang tesaw aa saw, khawbyapa hne khyitiy kha a ning.
Ama ta, “Kama laata hmang a tue khu viepa paa na i hnang taata a vawle nguoluo. Kama ca a bung pata a phyipakaw riy pathluo riypata hmuo a tla va ang.
Kama ca tiy ta tiynawna ica pi yi, cuorasala ama ca Thlaapa Pathe tana tiynawna aca pi'a yi,” a ta.
Capa ningkhue lie ca Zingsuv ca Nazareth pe Galilee taa khata Jordan cavaa luo kha Johan kuv ta tiy a naw riypata aa vaw.
Tiy chungtaata a kya thu pahne ta vuoruo a che te Thlaapa kha thuvruv haata a cunglie a za cungpa kha a hmung.
Vuoruo taata ueryi kha a zuv te, “Nama ca i Duepa i Sacapaa tana na cuo, na cunglie i palung a tling hringhruo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Thlaapa ta Zingsuv ca ruocaapa luo kha aa chiy.
Ruocaapa chunglie ca ning sawliy chung aw te, Setaa pasupaliyna kha a ang. Saa a hruopa zaw hneta ama aw; cadyiseca avuoming ta ama ca ama mangsang.
Johan kha ama patuv khutaata Zingsuv ca Galilee luo kha vaa te Khazing thuophaa kha a phu.
“Cuo ca a tling tli, Khazing pena ca aa ngie tli! A ngiepachiy ung la thuophaa hing zang tie ung,” a ta.
Zingsuv ca Galilee riyliy kielie a cakuole pata Simon hne a nuta Andru kha ngaa ama vaa nguoluo pata a hmung yi, tahematapakieca iema ca ngaa a vaapa tana ama cuo.
Zingsuv ta iema kyihuo khata, “Kama hing na ziy tie ung, cawsaa a patuvpa tana ica tue'a yi,” a ta.
Amaa sue kha thuse paluo yi te ama kha ama ziy.
A cawta a va cakuo vie pata a hrangpa uvcanu tie, Zebedi sacapaa Jeim hne Johan kha ama sawkawpalaw chunglie amaa sue ama thyi nguoluo pata a hmung yi.
A hmung pahne yi ta a ku yi; ama paa Zebedi hne sawkawpalaw kha rehrietuv tie hne khata thusesiy yi te ama kha ama ziy.
Kapernaum khy luo kha ama si; sabbath ning a vya chiy tiyta, Zingsuv ca apungna-ing luo kha a ngie te a pacuv yi.
A pacuvnazya kha ama kharue a haasa, tahematapakieca phungbie saya tie haata cuo li pata nawhnyituv pakha haata a pacuv nakaw yi ta a cuo.
Ca khu pahne ta apungna-ing chunglie a awpa, a pyalyipa thlaapa ta aa hryipa paa kha khi te,
“Nazareth khy ming Zingsuv, kiema hing tuokhaatama malie na tue khing? Kiema para riypata ma naa vaw? Ahungma tapa kha maca pachang, nama ca Khazing'a taata a vawpa A Pathepa tana na cuo,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “A dieta tah aw, hingpa paa chung taa hingta pya!” ta te a chuo.
A pyalyipa thlaapa ca ta cawsaapa ca khuosa ta siy te khuopuv ta a khi khutaata a chungtaata a pya.
Cawsaa zaw ca ama nang ta uo te pakha hne pakha kha, “Hingpa hing khaapatama a cuo? Naw hnyina cangta pacuvna thaapa tana a cuo! A pyalyipa thlaapa tie hmuo naw pi yi te a ri amaa ngie,” amaa ta.
A thuohlaa ca sungkha ta Galilee pe bangkhuo kha a ze paluo te a pathuo diy.
Apungna-ing taa khata ama pya pahne ta Jeim hne Johan hne khata Simon hne Andru tie ingchung luo kha amaa ngie.
Simon piynung ca a nge ling te iehmang cunglie aa ziena kaw kha ama chiy pahne ta ama chang paluo.
Ama'a luo ca vaa te, a kuvbuo ta la te a padaa. A nge lingpa ca cakaa te iema kha a mangsang yi.
Capa zuoluo, ning a tla tiyta a pasapa bangkhuo hne khuevuo ta a tuepa bangkhuo kha Zingsuv'a luo ca ama vya chiykhyi.
Khy ming bangkhuo ca chiypakaa athaalie kha amaa hmya.
Pasana phangting ta a pasapa a hluvpuv kha patluo sa yi te khuevuo hluvpuv zaw kha a papya. Khuevuo tie kha bie hehmuo pari sa va yi, tahematapakieca iema ta ama kha ama pachang.
Mawdiy khy dyi hluota Zingsuv ca thu te khy le ruoduona luo kha pya te thlaa a chuo.
Simon hne a viesaa zaw ta ama ca va huv yi te,
ama hmung pahne ta, “Cawsaa bangkhuo tana aca huv yi,” ama ta.
Ama ta palie yi te, “Hingpa cahriylie a awpa khy hrangpa luo zaw hing thuophaa i phu the riypata tlaw ra'a ung puv, tahematapakieca capa cana i vaw hnuochuopa ta a cuo,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Galilee pe kha tlaw diy te, apungna-ing chunglie kha phung chang yi te khuevuo zaw kha a papya.
Caahminghmaa a phyapa pakha ca Zingsuv'a luo kha a vaw te a pakhuv pane te, “Na khing pata a cuo kieca ina pathe sa khu ciy,” ta pata paa a kie.
Zingsuv ta ngie a chisa nakawta a kuv pazuo te a hrie. “Ica patluo sa khing. Pathe tie!” a ta.
Caahminghmaa pasanapa ta sungkha ta thuse te cawsaapa ca a pathe.
A raaringna khuosa ta a pi khutaata ama kha pathlie paluo te, Zingsuv ta,

“Naathlie tie, hingpa kaw hing ahunghmuo chang'a va yi ciy; cadyiseca tluobyipa'a luo kha vaa la vaa pamang sa tie, cakhutaata cawsaa hmiekunglie i pathe tli tapa paluosana ta Moses ta tue riypa a za tapa hriykhungrina kha pihluo tie,” a ta.

Cuorasala cawsaapa ca pya te capa kaw ca hya zangsa pata a rile nakawta bie ca pathuo diy te, Zingsuv ca a luohuo ta khy chung luo a ngie nguo li pata khyle luo ruo lie kha aw te, cawsaa ta hmangting taata ama vya pangie.
Ning cawta a ru khutaata Zingsuv ca Kapernaum luo kha a kaa tiyta, ing lie a awpa kaw kha a pathuo.
Cawsaa a hluvpuv amaa vaw nakawta ing chung luo ta li pata ingle lie hmuo awna hmang a patlaw va yi. Zingsuv ca phung kha a chang nguoluo yi.
Cawsaa chekha a vaw yi te, a pakyapa paa kha cawsaa papaliy ta a vya puvle yi te Zingsuv'a luo amaa vawkhyi.
Cawsaa ama chaa tuv nakawta ama'a luo kha vya chiykhyi khu va yi. Caacuonakawta Zingsuv awna a dadaw thlungkhuv kha za pahaw yi te cawsaapa ca a zienapa pangphaa hne khata ama za pachung.
Zingsuv ta ama zangna kha a hmung tiyta a pakyapa paa kha, “I sacapaa, na suena ca a ngiethe pata na cuo tli,” a ta.
Capa lie ca phungbie saya chekha tie a tu ra yi te ama palung chunglie kha,
“Khaapanakawma hingpa cawsaa hingta hing haa hingta bie a ri? Khazing ripachiena bie tana a cuo! Khazing pakha kyalya dyi muo suena a ngiethe khutuv ta a cuo ta,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta khaapama ama rue tapa kha a palung chunglie a pachang paluo nakawta iema kha, “Khaapanakawma cahaacata nama rue?
A pakyapa paa kyihuo hingta, ‘Na suena ca a ngiethe pata a cuo tli', tapa ma a na vie, ‘Thu la na pangphaa kha a la lah cakuo tie’ tapa ma a na vie'?
Cuorasala Cawsaa Sacapaa ca sue a ngiethe khuna naw a hnyi tapa hing pachang tie ung,” ta te a pakyapa paa kha,
“Ica chang, thu la, na pangphaa kha a la lah ing luo cakuo tie,” a ta.

Cawsaapa ca thu te a pangphaa kha a catlisa pata a la te iema bangkhuo hmiekunglie kha a pya; caacuonakawta ama bangkhuo ta ama nang uo hringhruo te Khazing kha ama pathuosa. “Hing haapa hing za hmung buo va puv,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ca riyliy kie luo kha a kaa pakhaa. Cawsaa bangkhuo ta a vya hmyasue yi te a pacuv yi.
A cakuopuole pata Alfeas sacapaa Levi kha ngukhyina zung lie aa tu nguoluo pata a hmung. Zingsuv ta, “Na ziy tie,” a ta ca thu te a ziyle paluo.

Zingsuv ta Levi ing lie zuosa ning riypata aa tu ning kha ngukhyituv hluvpuv hne a suepa tie ca Zingsuv hne ziytuv tie'a lie kha amaa tu ra, tahematapakieca capa lie ca ama a ziypa a hluvsa kha ama aw.

Farasi ming phungbie saya tie khata ngukhyituv tie'a nata a suepa zaw hneta Zingsuv ta sa a ningpa kha ama hmung tiyta, ziytuv tie kyihuo khata, “Khaapanakawma ngukhyituv tie'a nata a suepa tie zaw hneta sa a ning?” ama ta.

Zingsuv ta a thyi tiyta, iema kyihuo khata, “A tluopa cawsaa tie ta ca siyybyi a hu va yi, cuorasala a pasapa tie ta ca amaa hu; kama ca aa dangpa tie ku riypata a vaw va ang, a suepa tie ku riypa tana i vaw,” a ta yi.

Johan ziytuv tie hne Farasi ming ca sa ama uv. Cawsaa kha Zingsuv'a luo a vaw yi te, “Khaapanakawma tiynawtuv Johan ziytuv tie hne Farasi ming hing sa a uv yi te nama caa ziytuv tie hing sa a uv li pata ama aw?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta iema kha, “Napuv chiyna pyi luo kupa tie ca nungchiytuv satlie iema hne a aw chung ta sa ama uv the'a ma? Nungchiytuv satlie iema'a lie a aw chung bangkhuo ca sa a uv the'a va yi.
Nungchiytuv satlie kha iema'a taata ama lana cuo kha vya tlung'a te, capa thue cata sa amaa uv aa.
“Ahungtahmuo caw hlungpa kha caw thaapa ta a bie thla buo va yi; ama thla kieca, caw thaapa khata caw hlungpa kha thlaa lue hryly'a te a tlaa hryly aa.

Ahungtahmuo mingsuvtiy ahrang kha savang ungchuo hlungpa lie raw buo va yi; ama raw kieca, mingsuvtiy khata savang kha ning chi'a te, mingsuvtiy hne savang ungchuo hne khata ama ra diy aa. Mingsuvtiy ahrang ca savang ungchuo thaapa lie khana ama raw,” a ta.
Luo kha ca Sabbath ning ta Zingsuv hne ziytuv tie ca lu kha cahrawpaale yi te ama si. Ama sipuo luo ta ziytuv tie khata sa-uv kha ama pahriypuole.
Caacuonakawta Farasi ming ta Zingsuv kyihuo khata, “Mang tie, khaapanakawma phungbie ta a thlupa kha Sabbath ning ta ama tue?” ama ta.
Ama ta iema kha, “Ama hne a cawsaa zaw ning riy hnyi li pata ama nang a diy ning kha David ta khaapama a za tue tapa kha ri buo va ung ca ma?

Abiathar tluobyi lepa a cuo ningta, David ca Khazing ingchung luo kha a ngie te ahunghmuo ning phung a cuo lipa, tluobyi tie dyi ning riypa, Phuovaa viechuo kha ning te a viesaa zaw a pipa yi kha,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata iema kyihuo khata, “Sabbath ca cawsaa cuota sapa cuo te, cawsaa hing Sabbath cuota sapa cuo vyi;
caacuonakawta Cawsaa Sacapaa ca sabbath byi tana a cuo,” a ta yi.
Zingsuv ca apungna-ing luo kha a ngie pakhaa te capa lie ca a kuv a pakyapa cawsaa pakha a za aw.
Ama kha ama pachie khing nakawta, Sabbath ning ta hing a vya patluo sa ma vya patluo sa va ma tapa kha ama mangkhuo.
Zingsuv ta a kuv a pakyapa cawsaapa kyihuo khata, “Hmieluo hing vya pya,” a ta.
Cakhutaata cawsaazaapuv kha, “Ma phungbie ta Sabbath ning hing khaapa tue riypata ma malie a pa-aw? Hmang phapa tue riypa ma, ruvnaana pi riypa ma? Hringna khuo riypa ma, thie riypa?” a ta yi.
Cuorasala khaapahmuo palie va yi. A hihaasa pata mang yi te, ama palung lenazya kha a hmung tiy yi ta a ngie a chi. Cawsaapa kyihuo khata, “Na kuv pazuo,” a ta. Pazuo te a kuv ca a tluo.
Farasi ming ca pya yi te, Zingsuv para riypa khata Herod cawsaa zaw hneta khue ama khuo paluo.
Zingsuv hne ziytuv tie ca riyliy luo kha vaa yi te Galilee taata cawsaa hluvpuv khata ama ziy.
A hmang tuepa thuohlaa kha ama thyi nakawta Judea ruo, Jerusalem khy, Idumea pe, Jordan huesuo ruo, Tair hne Sidon khypuv cahriy taata cawsaa hluvpuv ama'a luo kha amaa vaw.
Cawsaa ama hluv hringhruo nakawta naa vya nuosue khu'a kie yi ta pata Zingsuv ta ziytuv tie kha sawkawpalaw suokha na pachiepa pacie tie ung, a ta yi.
Cawsaa hluvpuv patluo sa yi te a pasapa bangkhuo ta ama kha taw riypata a nuo ta amaa nuosue.
A pyalyipa thlaapa aa hryipa tie ta ama kha ama hmung pahne ta a hmielie kha a bu yi te, “Nama ca Khazing Sacapaa tana na cuo!” ta yi te khuopuv ta ama khi.
Zingsuv ta ahungtama a cuo tapa kha ahunghmuo pachang sa li riypata a cusa pata bie a pi yi.
Zingsuv ca tluocung luo kha kie te a ku khingpa tie kha ama'a luo ku yi te amaa vaw.
Ama ta lucuotuv ta pata ming a dipa hlyihning tie kha ama'a lie aw riypa, phung ri riypa hne
khachie papya khuna naw zaw hnyi riypata a tlaw yi te re a pi yi.
Aa tlawpa hlyihning tie ca: Simon (Zingsuv ta Piter ta pata ming a dipa);
Zebedi sacapaa Jeim hne a nuta Johan (Zingsuv ta Boanerges ta pata ming di yi te, a siyluo ca Paci saa zaw tana pata a cuo);
Andru, Filip, Bartholomew, Matthai, Thomas, Alfeas sacapaa Jeim, Thaddaius, phang a cuotuv Simon hne
Zingsuv a lyituv Judas Iskariot ta ama cuo.
Cawsaa ta amaa vya hmyasue pakhaa nakawta Zingsuv hne ziytuv tie ca sa hmuo ning the va yi.
A ingchungkhue tie ta capa ca ama thyi tiyta, ama kha thlu riypata ama vaa, tahematapakieca cawsaa ta “A ngaa tli,” ama ta.
Jerusalem taata a zuvpa phungbie saya tie ta, “Beelzebul na a hryi, capa khuevuo byipa ming ca tana khuevuo tie a papya yi,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta iema ca ku yi te pakhingpuona ta a chang yi. “Tuokhaatama Setaa ta Setaa ca a papya khu aa?
Pena suokha ca a che te iema'a na iema amaa du kieca capa pena ca a daa khu'a vyi.
Ingchungkhue khue kha zaw a che te iema'a na iema amaa du kieca a daa khu'a vyi.
Caacuonakawta Setaa pena ca a phuvphuv ta aa che kieca a daa khu'a vyi, ra'a te a vie aa.
Cuorasala cawsaa thaaruvpa paa kha ciypaki taa li pata ahunghmuo a ingchung luo a ngie pata a chechiy kha lapa nguo'a va yi, a ciypaki taa kie dyina a lapa nguo aa.
“Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, cawsaa hing ama suena hne Khazing a du pata bie ama ripa mekaa ca a ngiethe pata ama cuo aa;
cuorasala Thlaapa Pathe a du pata bie a ripa ca a ngiethe pata cuo'a va yi, tahematapakieca chuozaa aa hmangpa suena na ama tue,” a ta.
“Thlaapa chiepa na a hryi,” ama ta nakawta Zingsuv ta hing haa hingta a tapa yi ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata a nung hne a nuta zaw kha a vaw yi te, ingle lieta a daa yi te cawsaa kha ama paku sa.
Zingsuv ca cawsaazaapuv khata cadung yi te, “Na nung hne na nuta hne na sieta zaw ta caa taw khing yi te ale liena aca huo yi,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Ahung zaw kha ma i nung hne i nuta zaw ta a cuo yi?” a ta.
A thaalie ama cadung pata a tupa tie kha mang yi te, “I nung hne i nuta zaw ca hingpa lie hing ama aw hing!
Ahunghmuo cuo sala Khazing khingna a tuepa tie ca i nuta, i sieta, hne i nung tana ama cuo,” a ta yi.
Zingsuv ta Galilee riyliykie lie kha a pacuv pakhaa yi. A vya hmyasuepa cawsaazaapuv kha ama hluv tuv nakawta sawkawpalaw chung luo kha kie te aa tu; zaapuv ca ngiekuo lie kha amaa tu.
Pakhingpuona hmuo pata hmang hluvpuv kha pacuv yi te, a ripa ca:
“Naathlie tie ung! Saciy vaatuv pakha ca saciy vaa riypata a si.
Saciy kha a vaa tiyta, chekha ca luopuv lie kha tla te pavaa ta amaa haa.
Chekha ca lungdaapa, alyi aa paana lieta ama tla. Alyi kha a chaa li nakawta saciy ca a pu paluo.
Ning kya chiy te sadaa kha a e ca a thariy aa thuv li nakawta a caa diy paluo.
Saciy chekha ca ahling hrawlie kha a tla. Ahling kha kya le te a kalaa nakawta thyipaa hnyi khu vyi.
Saciy chekha ca alyi phana lieta ama tla, kya daa te, le te thyipaa ama hnyi: chekha le sawthung, chekha le sawcaruv, hne chekha ca le zakha te ama vyi,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Thyina naa a hnyipa ta ca thyi tie ung!” a ta yi.
Zingsuv ama seta a aw ning kha, ziytuv tie hne a thaalie a awpa a hrangpa tie khata pakhingpuona siyluo kha ama hiehriy.
Zingsuv ta iema kyihuo khata, “Khazing Pena bieparuv ca pi pata nama cuo tli, cuorasala ale lie a awpa tie ca pakhingpuona dyi ta pacuv pata ama cuo;

cahaacata, ‘Iema ca mang raalaa'a yi te hmungpasie the'a va yi, naathlie raalaa'a yi te a siyluo pachang the'a va yi. Capa ca Khazing'a luo amaa vya pali pakhaa li riypa hne ama suena kha a ngiethe ama cuo li riypata a cuo,’” a ta.
Zingsuv ta iema kyihuo khata, “Hing pakhingpuona hing pachang khu va ung ca ma? Caacuokieca tuokhaatama pakhingpuona bangkhuo changchiy ca nama pachang khu aa?
Saciy vaatuv ta Khazing bie kha a vaa.
Cawsaa chekha ca luopuv lieta a tlapa saciy haa khata ama cuo. Bie kha ama thyi tiyta Setaa kha a vaw paluo te ama chunglie saciy kha a lapa yi.
Cawsaa chekha ca lungdaapa lie a tlapa saciy haa khata ama cuo. Bie kha ama thyi tiyta palung tluosa pata ama cuhluo paluo.
Cuorasala ama chung luo aa thuvpuv ta hruo a thla li nakawta cuo pachangta dyi hring te, capa bie kawlieta ruvnaana hne hrisaana a aw tiyta amaa lie paluo.
Cawsaa chekha ca ahling hrawlie a tlapa saciy haa khata ama cuo.
Bie kha ama thyi, cuorasala chuelyi khysatungbangna kaw, hnyirung khingna kaw, hne khingna hrang phangphang ta capa bie ca kalaa yi te thyipaa hnyi khu va yi.
Cawsaa chekha ca alyi phanapa lie a tlapa saciy haata ama cuo. Bie kha ama thyi, cuhluo yi te thyipaa kha le sawthung, le sawcaruv, le zakha te ta ama hnyi,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Myi-ing kha vya cyi te beke rawlie acuolikie iehmang rawlie a chipa ama aw buo ma? Myi-ing vuona tung liena ama chi cuo va ma?
A paruv ta tuepa bangkhuo ca paluohuopa cuo'a te, buvkhungpa bangkhuo ca khena lie pahaw pata ama cuo aa.
Thyina naa a hnyipa ca thyi tie ung,” a ta.
Cakhutaata iema kyihuo khata, “Nama thyipa kha a phata tah rue tie ung, malie nama patangpa haa khata patangpa pata nama cuo ra aa, a cha hmuo chachiypa nama cuo kalie aa.
A hnyipa tie kha a hluv vie ta pipa cuo'a yi te, khaapahmuo a hnyi lipa tie kha ama hnyi tlakuopa kha hmuo lapa pata ama cuo aa,” a ta yi.
Zingsuv ta a ri kaliepa ca, “Khazing pena ca cawsaa pakha ta a lu lie saciy a vaapa hne tana aa lu.
Zuo ta a zie te a kya thu, saciy ca kya pu te a le, tuokhaatama a le tapa kha pachang vyi.
Chuelyi ta amata tah sa kha a papya, hmietaa ce ta a hnaa panuta kha pakiy te, cakhutaata a paa kya paa te sa-uv a hnyi.
Sa hrie aa de tiyta, a hrietuvpa paa ta tuokyi kha a la te a uo,” a ta yi.
Zingsuv ta a ri kaliepa ca, “Khazing pena hing khaapa hneta ma ma ri pakhing'a ung, acuolikie khaapa pakhingpuona hmuo'a pate ma ma ri aa?
Vuoruo pena ca uotuo hmung haa tana a cuo. Ama vaa ningta ca alyi lie saciy caw cepa ta a cuo.
Ama vaa ca, kya le te uohnaasiyyhnaa kung hrawlie a le cepa ta a cuo. A ce lesapa paka te pavaa zaw kha a ningdiy lieta buv amaa tue khu,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta cahaapa pakhingpuona a hluvsa kha hmuo te ama thyi the riypata iema'a lie kha bie a ri.
Pakhingpuona hmuo li pata iema'a lie kha bie ri vyi, cuorasala ziytuv tie hne iema seta ama aw ning kha hmang bangkhuo kha a siesa pata a chang yi.
Capa ning zuoluo a vya cuo tiyta, Zingsuv ta ziytuv tie kha, “Riyliy huesuo luo hue vaa ung puv,” a ta yi.
Ziytuv tie ca cawsaazaapuv kha thuse yi te Zingsuv kha aa tu pacienapa sawkawpalaw khata ama sikhyi. Sawkawpalaw hrangpa zaw kha a aw ra.
Thliychie khuopuv ta a hruo te tiylaw ta sawkawpalaw kha chi te vuotaa a tla'a nang.
Zingsuv ca sawkawpalaw hnangluo kuo ta lahya cunglie kha aa zie. Ziytuv tie ta pathu yi te, “Saya, vuotaa ma thiy'a nangpa hing siysaa malie ri va ca ma?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta thu te thliychie kha a chuo, tiylaw zaw kha, “Die!” a ta. Thliychie ca die te riyliy ca nesiyliy khata a aw.
Zingsuv ta ziytuv tie kha, “Khaapanakawma nama ciy? Ata tepa ta zangna hnyi tang va ung ca ma?” a ta yi.
Iema ca ama ciypuo ama nang-uopuo pata pakha hne pakha kha, “Thliychie hne tiylaw tahmuo a ri amaa ngiepa paa hing ahungtama a cuo?” amaa ta.
Iema ca riyliy huesuo luo, Gerasenes pe luo kha ama va pha.
Sawkawpalaw chungtaata Zingsuv a cung pahne ta thluokung lie a awpa a pyalyipa thlaapa ta aa hryipa cawsaa pakha ta aa vya taw.
Thluokung lie khy a sapa ta cuo te ahungtahmuo hre khu va yi.
A kuv hne a phyi kha thaabuoliriy ta yi hluvpuv ama za cakhiy, cuorasala thaabuoliriy kha chipachung diy te hrakyi ama khepa kha a ca-ang patlaa diy. Ahungtahmuo hri khu va yi.
Chung hne zuo hne thluokung lie hne tluo cunglie kha khi-ule te alung kha aa pa-uo sale.
Luohlaa taata Zingsuv a vya hmung pahne ta a vya ruo te a phyi thabaw lie kha a vya bu te,
“Cungnungce Khazing Sacapaa Zingsuv, tuokhaatama ina tue khing ciy? Duo na te thi khah ta pata Khazing ming ta paa ica kie,” ta pata khuosa ta a khi.
Tahematapakieca Zingsuv ta, “A pyalyipa thlaapa, hingpa paa chung taa hingta pya!” a ta nakawta a cuo.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta, “Na ming ahungma?” a ta. Ama ta, “I ming ca ‘Hluvpuv’ tana i cuo, tahematapakieca a hluvpuv ma ta,” a ta.
Capa ruocaapa taa cata a papya li riypa yi ta Zingsuv kha khuopuv ta paa a kie.
Capa kiecahriy, tluocung lie kha va a hluvpuv ama tle nguoluo.
A pyalyipa thlaapa tie ta Zingsuv kha, “Va chung luo hue malie pathlie tie, iema chung luo hue a ngie thi se puv,” ta pata paa ama kie.

Zingsuv ta a ngiena naw a pi yi. Cakhutaata a pyalyipa thlaapa tie ca cawsaapa chung taa cata pya yi te va chung luo ca ama vaa ngie. Va thawhning hraw ca lungkuo taa khata a zu yi te riyliy luo ama tlasa diy.
Va a khietuv tie ca a ruo yi te capa thuohlaa ca khypuv hne khyta luo kha ama va pathyi sa. Cawsaa ca pya yi te khaapama a cuo tapa kha ama va mang.
Zingsuv'a luo kha ama va pha tiyta khuevuo phuv ta amaa zaa hryi tawpa paa kha zaa tu te, caw a tue te lungsingpyata tah a awpa kha ama hmung ca ama ciysa.
A hmungpa tie ta khuevuo ta aa hryipa cawsaapa hne va cunglie khaapama a tlung tapa kha cawsaa zaw'a luo kha ama va ri.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv kha ama ruo taata pya riypata paa ama kie.
Sawkawpalaw luo Zingsuv a kie pahne ta, khuevuo ta a zaa hryipa paa khata, ama'a lie si ra riypata paa a kie.
Zingsuv ta bu te, “Ing luo na viesaa tie'a luo kha kaa hriy la Abyipa ta kha tluv tama nang aca due tapa hne na cuo ta a tuepa kaw kha va chang tie yi,” a ta.
Capa cawsaapa ca cakuo te Zingsuv ta a cunglie a tuepa kaw kha Dekhapolis ruo chunglie kha a phu. Cawsaa mekaa ca ama kharue a haa hringhruo.
Zingsuv ca riyliy huesuo luo kha vaa pakhaa te riyliy kielie kha cawsaa hluvsa ta amaa hmyapuo.
Apungna-ing uvthyi pakha ta a cuopa Jairu ama tapa paa kha vya chiy te, Zingsuv kha a hmung pahne ta a phyi thabaw lie kha a bu te
paa a kie byalya. “I sacanung ca vuotaa a thiy'a nang. Hring'a te a tluo khuna riypata a vaw la a cunglie na kuv vya khang thi tie,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Zingsuv ca capa paa hne cata a cakuo. Cawsaa hluvpuv ta ziy yi te ama kha ama hruv ama depaa patlaw.
Capa lie ca kung hraa hlyihning chung thiylang pasana ta a pasapa cawsaanung pakha a aw ra.
Siyybyi a hluvpuv ta za mang yi te a hnyipa bangkhuo kha a pachuo diy raalaa pata tluo vie li pata a ruv hryly.
Zingsuv kaw kha a thyi tiyta, cawsaazaapuv hraw taa khata a vaw te Zingsuv pang kha a hrie,
tahematapakieca ama ta, “A pang chuo hing i hrie kieca i tluo aa,” a ta.
Sungkha ta a thiy langpa kha aa due; a pasana taata a tluo tlipa kha a pangpa lieta aa pachang.
Zingsuv ta cahranapa na i chungtaata a pya tapa kha aa pachang pahne ta zaapuv'a luo kha a pali te, “Ahungma i pang a hrie?” a ta.
Ziytuv tie ta ama kha, “Cawsaa hluvpuv ta aca hruv a ca depaa patlawpa yi na hmung thluo pata tuokhaatama ‘Ahungma naa taw,’ na ta,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta a cahriycake kha mang te ahungma a pang a hrie tapa kha a pachang.
Cuorasala cawsaanung ta khaapama a cunglie a cuo tapa kha a pachang nakawta ciyna hne a cathangpuo pata a vaw te, Zingsuv hmielie ca a pakhuv vya pane te a cuopa bangkhuo kha a chang.
Zingsuv ta, “I sacanung na zangnapa na caa patluo sa. Thlaalungna hneta cakuo la na pasana taata va tluo tie,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta capa bie a ri nguoluo ning kha Jairu ing taata cawsaa chekha a vaw yi te, “Na sacanung ca a thiy tli, khaapanakawma sayapa ca riethyi na pi nguoluo ri,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta khaapama ama ri tapa kha thyi te, apungna-ing uvthyipa kyihuo khata, “Ciy khah, zangna dyi hnyi tie,” a ta.
Piter, Jeim, hne a nuta Johan ta li pata ahunghmuo a paziy sa va yi.
Apungna-ing uvthyipa ing luo kha ama chiy ca cawsaa khuosa ta ama khipa hne ama caa patlawpa kha a hmung.
Ingchung luo kha a ngie te iema kha, “Khaapanakawma khuopuv ta khi ung cate nama caa patlaw? Haatiynung hing thiy vyi, aa hmungpa tana a cuo,” a ta yi.
A pahnyi ta ama pahnyi sue. Caacuonakawta Zingsuv ta ingchung taa khata papya diy yi te, haatiynung a nung hne a paa, ama'a lie a awpa tie hne dyi khata haatiynung awna khuo luo kha amaa ngie.
A kuv ta la te, haatiynung kyihuo kha, “Talitha, kum,” a ta; a siyluo ca, “Haatiynung, thu tie,” tana ta a cuo.
Haatiynung ca sungkha ta kya thu te luo a cakuo. (Ama ca kung hraa hlyihning a tapa tana a cuo). Capa kawlie ca ta iema ca ama nang dyi a uo.
Zingsuv ta hingpa kaw hing ahunghmuo pachang sa'a va ung ciy ta pata khuopuv ta thlu yi te, haatiynung kha ning riypa pi riypata a chang yi.
Zingsuv ca capa hmang taa cata pya te a puvnapa khy luo kha ziytuv tie hneta ama va pha.

Sabbath ning kha apungna-ing lie pacuv yi te a pacuvna a thyipa a hluvpuv ca ama kharue a haasa. Iema ta, “Hingpa bangkhuo hing khaapa taata ma a hmung? Ama'a luo pipa hingpa singna hing tuokhaapa singna tama a cuo? A kuv ta a tuepa hing tuokhaapa cahrana hmang tue khuna tama a cuo? ama ta.

Ama ca Mary sacapaa tie, Jeim hne Joses hne Judas hne Simon tie uvta, lettamaapa kha cuo va ma? A sieta zaw hmuota hingpa lie, kiema'a lie hing na ama aw cuo va ma?” ta yi te siysaa ri li pata ama aw.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta iema kha, “Profet ca ama puvna khy, ama tieriy hne ama chungkhue lie ta li pata ca pa-uvsathyi li pata aw va yi” a ta yi.
A pasapa chekha cunglie a kuv khang te a patluo sapa yi ta li pata capa lie ca kharuehaa hmang khaapahmuo tue khu vyi.
Zangna ama hnyi linapa kha Zingsuv ca a kharue a haa hringhruo.
Ziytuv hlyihning tie kha ku yi te pahning pahning ta a pathlie yi. A pyalyipa thlaapa te khuna naw kha pi yi te,
“Ama khy tlawna luo kha khuecahryi ta li pata khaapahmuo a phya li riypata bie a taa yi; viechuo cuose, sahrie cuose, tuokaa cuose a phya li riypata bie taa yi te
cuorasala phanaah a pakaw riypa hne, buohryi zung hning ta a hryi li riypata bie a taa yi.
Iema kyihuo khata, “Ing ing kha luo kha namaa ngie tiyta, capa lie ca nama pya hluo li ta aw tie ung.
