Ingtlung caa dapa hne nama bie a naathlie khing lipa ama aw kieca nama pyase tiyta nama phyipazaa lie a bepa buvcing kha iema a du pata tehte cuo riypata a cakhawsue siy tie ung,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta pya yi te cawsaa kha ama suena taata amaa ngiepachiy riypata bie ca ama phu.
Khuevuo hluvpuv kha papya yi te a pasapa kha chiytiy thuv yi te ama patluo.

Zingsuv thuohlaa ca khy ting ta a pathuo nakawta Siepahruo Herod ta a thyi. Cawsaa chekha ta, “Tiynawtuv Johan na thiyna taata a thu pakhaa; caacuonakaw tana hing haapa kharuehaa hmang hing a tue khu,” ama ta.
Cuorasala a hrangpa tie ta, “Elijah tana a cuo,” ama ta. A hrangpa tie ta, “Hluo ning profet tie haapa profet pakha tana a cuo,” ama ta.
Cuorasala Herod ta a thyi tiyta, “Kama ta a luv i za pate sapa yi Johan khana thiyna taata a thu pakhaa,” a ta.
Herod pangpa ta cawsaa pathlie yi te Johan kha a za patuv sa yi, pahre sa yi te thaw a pathla. Napuv ta aa tuepa a nuta Filip napuvnung Herodias kawlieta cahaacata a tue pata a cuo.
Tahematapakieca Johan ta Herod kyihuo khata, “Na nuta napuv ca a hlaw riypata cuo vyi,” ta pata a za chang pari.
Caacuonakawta Herodias ta a palungruv ta Johan kha hue te a thie khing. Cuorasala thie khu vyi;
tahematapakieca Herod ta Johan kha aa dangpa hne a pathepa a cuopa kha pachang te a ciy nakawta a daakhuo. A bie kha a thyi tiyta a palung a kalaasa raalaa pata naa a thlie khingsa ngiethie.
Cuorasala Herod ta a puv ning alawna pyi kha tue te siepahruo chungkhue tie, cuzaa byi lepa tie, hne Galilee ruo luochiytuv tie sa a duo ning yi kha cuophaa aa vaw.
Herodias sacanung kha zaa ngie te a luo tiyta Herod hne a khyche tie kha ama palung a patluo yi. Caacuonakawta siepahruo ta lesaanung ca, “Na khingpa khaapa a cuo zaw naa hie la ica pi aa,” a ta.
Chie a sa te, “Ina hiepa ciy khaapa a cuo zaw ica pi aa, i ruo khingkhuo te hmuota ica pi aa,” a ta.
Ama ta pya te a nung kha a va hiehriy. “Khaapama i hie aa?” a ta. A nung ta, “Tiynawtuv Johan luv,” ta pata a palie.
Ama ta siepahruo'a luo kha kaa mala te, “Ata hingta tiynawtuv Johan luv kha daa pakhue hingta na pi la tapa na i khing,” a ta.
Siepahruo ca a ngie a chi hringhruo, cadyiseca bie aa kuo ciepa a cuo nakaw hne a khyche zaw hmie a mang nakaw yi ta a sacanung bie kha i khing vyi.
Sungkha ta rievetuv rieka pakha ca Johan luv kya cyi riypata naw pi te a pathlie. Riekapa ca thaw-ing luo kha vaa te Johan luv kha a te.
Daa pakhue ta kya cyile te lesaanung kha a pi. Cakhutaata lesaanung ta a nung kha a pi.
Capa thuohlaa ca Johan a ziytuv tie ta ama thyi pahne ta a vaw yi te a riyy kha la yi te ama paby.
Lucuotuv tie ca Zingsuv kha cadung yi te ama tuepa hne ama pacuvna kaw kha ama chang.

Zingsuv ta iema kyihuo khata, “Nama palang hingta ruo duothlingna luo kha a vaw ung la sungkha a pahy tie ung,” a ta yi. Tahematapakieca cawsaa a lie bungthawpa ama hluv tuv nakawta sa ningna cuo hmuo hnyi va yi.
Cakhutaata iemata tah ruo duothlingna luo kha sawkawpalaw ta ama si.
Cuorasala cawsaa hluvpuv ta hmung yi te, ama pachang nakawta khy ting taa khata vya pya yi te ama phyi ta ama si pahraa ca iema hluota a hmang luo kha ama va chiy lu.
Ngiekuo luo a pya tiyta cawsaazaapuv kha a hmung yi; iema cunglie kha kawpacuona a hnyi, tahematapakieca iema ca khietuv a hnyi lipa tuv haa tana ama cuo. Caacuonakawta iema kha a hluvsa a pacuv yi.
Ning aa vya ngie viele tiyta ziytuv tie ca ama'a luo kha a vaw yi te, “Ruocakung lieta a cuo, ning zaw aa ngiesa tli;
cawsaa hing pathlie yi la, hingpa cahriylie a awpa khy luo hing iemata tah ning riypa suokhakha vaa calyi yi se,” ama ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta, “Niema ta ning riypa suokhakha pi tie ung,” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Vaa pate ma, viechuo kha denarii zahning muo calyi'a pate ma duo'a yi,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Viechuo tluo khazaa ma nama hnyi? Cakuo ung la va mang tie ung,” a ta yi. Va mang yi te, “Viechuo tluo pangaa hne ngaa sahning,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta cawsaa kha a phuvphuv ta che ung la aphuv cunglie kha patu sa tie ung, a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta cawsaa ca zakha phuv, sawngaa phuv ta pata amaa tu.

Zingsuv ta viechuo tluo pangaa hne ngaa sahning kha la te, vuoruo luo ang te, alawna bie a hluo khutaata viechuo kha chechi te zaapuv kha re riypata ziytuv tie kha a pi yi. Ngaa sahning zaw kha chechi te iema kha a pi diy yi.
Ama bangkhuo ta ning yi te ama riy a bi.
Cakhutaata viechuo hne ngaa a zungpepa kha ama pahmya ca beke zung hraa hlyihning a bi.
Sa a ningpa capaa thawpangaa ama ta.
Ca khu pahne ta Zingsuv ta cawsaazaapuv a pathlie nguoluo ning yi khata ziytuv tie ca sawkawpalaw luo kha pakie sa yi te riyliy huesuo Bethsaida luo kha a pasi sa lu yi.
Zaapuv a pathlie khutaa yi ta tluocung luo kha thlaachuo riypata a kie.
Zuoluo vya chiy te sawkawpalaw riyliy khingkhuo luo a chiy ning kha Zingsuv ca ama seta tluo lie kha a aw.
Thliy kha a pali ta aa vya hruo nakawta ziytuv tie ta sawkawpalaw maw amaa nangkhyipa kha a hmung tiy yi ta, riyliy cunglie kha cakuo te mawdiy ta iema'a luo kha aa vaw. Iema kha law aa nang yi.
Cuorasala riyliy cunglie a cakuopa kha ama hmung tiyta athlaa ta ri yi te ama khi,
tahematapakieca ama bangkhuo ta ama kha hmung yite ama thlaa a zang hringhruo. Cuorasala iema kha sungkha ta chaw yi te, “Nama rie pha se, kama tana i cuo; ciy khah ung,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata sawkawpalaw chunglie iema'a luo kha kie te thliy ca a die. Ziytuv tie ca ama nang ta a uo hringhruo,
tahematapakieca ama palung kha le tuv te viechuo lie a tuepa kharuehaa hmang kha pachangpasie khu va yi.
Riyliy ama vya te khutaata, Genesaret lie kha cung yi te sawkawpalaw kha ama hre siy.
Sawkawpalaw ama thuse pahne khata Zingsuv a cuopa kha cawsaa ta ama pachang paluo.
Caacuonakawta capa ruo chung bangkhuo kha a catli pata si yi te Zingsuv a aw ta pata ama thyina hmang luo kha a pasapa ca ama pangphaa hneta ama vya chiykhyi.
Zingsuv a cakuonapa bangkhuo luo, khyta, khypuv, lu luo hne chadawtluo luo kha a pasapa ca vya chiykhyi yi te a pangpeta chuo ama hrie riypata paa ama kie; a pangpe a hriepa bangkhuo ca ama tluo.
Jerusalem taata a vawpa Farasi tie hne phungbie saya tie chekha ca Zingsuv'a luo kha a vya hmya yi te,
ziytuv tie kuv a siy li pata, ama kuv pyapa ta sa ama ningpa kha ama pachang.
(Farasi ming hne Judah ming palang ca mingnungmingpa tie phungluo kha ziy yi te kuv a siy li pata sa a ning lipa ta ama cuo;

chadaw taata ama calyipa bangkhuo zaw kha a phung haata pasiy taa li pata ning va yi. Cakhutaata phung hrangpa a hluvsa zaw kha ama ziy: a phung haata panuo pasiyna, bi pasiyna, hne daa kitali pasiyna tapa zaw ta ama cuo.)
Caacuonakawta Farasi tie hne phungbie saya tie ta Zingsuv kyihuo khata, “Khaapanakawma caa ziytuv tie ta mingnungmingpa tie phungluo haata aw lipa yi ta, kuv a siy li pata sa ama ning?” ama ta.

Zingsuv ta, “Isaiah ta niema phahruocuo tie kaw a za rilupa hing aa hmuopa tana a cuo. A capepa ca, ‘Hingpa cawsaa zaw hingta ama pakaa ta na pa-uvsathyi yi te, cuorasala ama pathiypalung ca kama hneta aa hlasa.
Cawsaa ta tuechawpa phung kha, ziy riypata ama pacuv, kama inaa biepa yi hing thlahnena khaapahmuo hnyi vyi,’ a ta.
Niema ca Khazing nawbie kha thaw ung cate cawsaa tuepa phungluo khana nama ziy,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata iema kyihuo khata, “Nama phungluo pacu sa riypata Khazing nawbie thawzya ca nama the ciemuo.
Tahematapakieca Moses ta, ‘Na nung hne na paa va ciyzaa yi, a nung acuolikie a paa kawchie a ripa ca a thiy hrahring aa,’ a ta.
Cuorasala niema ta, cawsaa pakhakha ta a nung hne a paa kha, ‘Niema byana riypa i tapa hing Korban tana a cuo,’ a ta kieca,
a nung a paa bya li pata a law khu, nama ta. (Korban siyluo ca Khazing'a luo pihluopa tana ta a cuo).
A chang pachaa ung cate nama za ziylepa nama phungluo ta Khazing bie kha nama pavie nama pavuvle. Cakhutaata hmang a hluvsa zaw kha hing haa hingta nama tue,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta cawsaazaapuv kha ku pakhaa yi te, “Nama bangkhuo ta naathlie ung la pachang tie ung.
Ale taata cawsaa chung luo a ngiepa hmang khata cawsaa kha papyapalyi khu vyi, Cuorasala chungluo taata aleluo a kya pyapa hmang khana cawsaa kha a papya a palyi khu.
Thyina naa a hnyipa ta thyi mang sue,” a ta.
Cawsaazaapuv kha thuse yi te ingchung luo aa ngie taata ziytuv tie ta a ripa pakhingpuona kaw kha ama hiehriy.
Zingsuv ta, “Niema zaw hepa ma pachang li pata a aw ra ung ciy! Ale taata cawsaa chung luo a ngiepa ca cawsaa kha papyapalyi khu vyi tapa ca pachang va ung ca ma?
A ngiepa ca cawsaa palung chung luo cuo li pata cawsaa riy chung luo kha a ngie te a pya pakhaa cuo va ma?” a ta yi. (Zingsuv ta sa bangkhuo ca a pathe a ta khingna ta a cuo).
A ri pazuepa ca, “Cawsaa chungtaata a pyapa na cawsaa kha a papya a palyi.
Cawsaa pathiypalung chungtaata a pyapa ruena pha lipa khana cawsaa kha, aparuvsuena, paruvna, lienawna,
nungvaathingsuena, karuo-awna, zyatena, dungviena, mang a daw lipa tuena, hietliena, malie thuopachina, a palena, ngaana hne pingruena tapa zaw kha a chiykhyi.
Hingpa a pha lipa bangkhuo hing cawsaa chungtaata a pyapa cuo yi te cawsaa a papya a palyi pata a cuo yi,” a ta.
Capa hmang taa cata pya te Zingsuv ca Tair pe luo kha a si. Ing kha luo kha a ngie te, capa lie a awpa kha ahunghmuo a pachang sa khing va yi. Cuorasala a nu khu vyi,
a pyalyipa thlaapa ta a sacanung aa hryipa, canung pakha ta Zingsuv kaw kha thyi paluo te, a vaw te Zingsuv phyi thabaw lie kha aa vya bu.
Cawsaanung ca Siria ruo Fonisia khy lie a puvpa Jentail zaanung ta a cuo. Ama ta Zingsuv kha a sacanung chungtaata khuevuo papya riypa khata paa a kie.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta, “Haatiy zaw kha ama riy bi pata pi taa ung siy, tahematapakieca haatiy sa kha la pata uv thawpa ca a hmuo vyi,” a ta.
Cuorasala cawsaanung ca ta, “Abyipa, cabya rawlie uv zaw tahmuo haatiy zaw pathlapa sa diydya kha ama ning ra taw muo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta, cawsaanung kha, “Cahaacata na ri nakawta, cakuo tie, khuevuo ta na sacanung kha a pyase tli,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta cawsaanung ca ing luo kha a cakuo, haatiynung ca khuevuo ta pyase tli te, iehmang cunglie a zaa zie thluopa kha a hmung.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ca Tair pe taa khata kaa te Sidon cahrawpaa pata Dekhapolis pe lie a awpa Galilee riyliy luo kha a si.
Cawsaa chekha ta a naa rue te bie a ri the lipa kha vya chiykhyi yi te a cunglie a kuv khang riypata Zingsuv kha paa ama kie.
Zingsuv ta cawsaazaapuv hraw taa khata ama selaw ta cakuokhyi te, a kuvdaw kha a naakary luo riy te, a paciy pacha te cawsaapa palyi ca a hrie.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ca avuo luo kha ang te, a huv kha pa-y te khuopuv ta a sung khutaata cawsaapa kha, “Effatha,” a ta, a siyluo ca, “A pahaw tie” tana ta a cuo.
Sungkha ta a naa pavuo te, a palyi ca a hya te a siesa pata bie a ri.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta ahunghmuo chang li riypata a thlu yi, cadyiseca thlu hryly yi, ri hryly yi, ama ta.
A ma kharue haa hringhruo te, “Hmang bangkhuo hing a phapa tana a tue, a naa a ruepa kha hmuo pathyi sa te, bie a ri khu lipa kha a pari sa khu,” ama ta.
Capa cuo hraw lie ca ta cawsaazaapuv kha a vya hmya pakhaa yi te ning riypa khaapahmuo ama hnyi li tiyta, Zingsuv ta ziytuv tie kha ku yi te,
“Cawsaazaapuv na i ngiechisa yi, tahematapakieca kama'a lie ning thung aw tli yi te ning riypa khaapahmuo hnyi va yi.
Ama nangdiy pata ing luo i pakaa kie yi ca luopuv liena ama hyle aa, chekha ca luohlaasa taata a vawpa tana ama cuo,” a ta.
Ziytuv tie ta, “Hingpa viehnangruo lie hing tuokhaatama hing zaa cawsaa hing sa ima duo khu'a yi?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Viechuo tluo khazaa ma nama hnyi?” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Tluo sariy,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata cawsaazaapuv kha alyi lie patu sa yi te, viechuo tluo sariy kha la te, palungtluona bie a hluo khutaata chechi te, cawsaazaapuv re riypata ziytuv tie kha pi yi te ama re.
Ngaa diyta a cawta zaw kha hnyi yi te, thluechiy a pi khutaata ziytuv tie kha a pare sa ra yi.
Ama bangkhuo ta ning yi te ama riy a bi, ziytuv tie ta aa ngaapa a zungpepa kha pakhaw yi te beke zung sariy a bi.
Cawsaa ca thaw paliy hraw ama ta. Cakhutaa cata a pathlie yi.
Ziytuv tie hneta sawkawpalaw luo kha a catlisa pata kie yi te Dalmanutha pe luo kha ama si.
Farasi tie chekha a vaw yi te Zingsuv hneta bie amaa i. Ama kha ama dyapasya khing nakawta, vuoruo taata a cuopa pamangsana suokha ama hie.

Zingsuv ca a huv kha pa-y te, “Khaapanakawma ata chuo saa zaw ta pamangsana tue riypata ina hie ung ciy? Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, tuokhaapa pamangsana hmuota ata chuo cawsaa zaw hmielie hing tue pata cuo'a vyi,” a ta.
Iema kha thuse yi te, sawkawpalaw chung luo kha a ngie pakhaa te, riyliy huesuo luo kha a vaa.
Ziytuv tie ta viechuo vya phyale ama maw nakawta sawkawpalaw chunglie kha viechuo tluo kha dyi ama hnyi.
Zingsuv ta, “Farasi tie thiynung hne Herod thiynung kha a raaring tie ung,” a ta yi.
Pakha hne pakha kha, “Viechuo ma hnyi li nakaw tana a cuo,” amaa ta.
Zingsuv ta amaa ruepa kha a pachang nakawta, “Khaapanakawma viechuo nama hnyi lina kaw ca nama ri nguoluo thluo? Ata tepa hingta pachangpasie the tang va ung ca ma? Nama palung ma aca paping yi?
Ming nama hnyi thluo pata, hmung va ung ca ma? Naa nama hnyi thluo pata, thyi va ung ca ma? A thyi the va tli ung ca ma?
Viechuo tluo pangaa kha chechi angte cawsaa thawpangaa i duo ning yi kha a zungpepa beke zung khazaa ma nama pakhaw?” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Zung hraa hlyihning,” ama ta.
“Viechuo tluo sariy ta cawsaa thaw paliy i duo ning yi kha haw a zungpepa beke zung khazaa ma nama pakhaw?” a ta yi. “Zung sariy,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata iema kha, “Ata tepa ta pachangpasie khu va ung ca ma?” a ta yi.
Bethsaida luo kha ama chiy. Cawsaa chekha ta mingcuepa pakha kha Zingsuv'a luo vya chiykhyi yi te a hrie riypata paa ama kie.
Zingsuv ta mingcuepa paa kha a kuv ta ca-yale te khyle luo kha a pyakhyi. A ming lie kha a paciy a be khutaata, a kuv kha a cunglie khang te, “Suokha chuo na hmung ma?” a ta.
Cawsaapa ca vuopaa kya ang te, “Cawsaa kha i hmung khu yi, cuorasala thingkungpa na a cakuole tapa haa tana i hmung yi,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta cawsaapa ming kha a kuv ta a taw pakhaa. Cawsaapa ta khuosa ta mang te a ming a vuo nakawta zezaw bangkhuo kha a siesa pata a hmung.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta ing luo kha padiy sa te, “Khy chung luo vaa ngie khya,” a ta.
Zingsuv ca ziytuv tie hneta Sisaria Filipi pe khyta luo kha ama tlaw. Luopuv lie kha ziytuv tie kyihuo ta, “Cawsaa ta kama hing ahung ina ta yi ma?” a ta yi.
Iema ta ama kha palie yi te, “Tiynawtuv Johan tana a cuo, a ca ta yi, a hrangpa tie ta, Elijah tana a cuo, ca ta yi te, a hrangpa tie ta Profet pakhakha tana a cuo, aca ta yi,” ama ta.
Ama ta, “Niema haw, ahung ina ta ung ca ma?” a ta yi. Piter ta, “Messiah tana na cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaa, a kaw kha ahunghmuo chang li riypata iema kha khuopuv ta bie a cung yi.

Cakhutaa cata Zingsuv ta ziytuv tie kha pacuv yi te, “Cawsaa Sacapaa ca te-angna khuopuv ta a taw'a te, uvthyi tie, tluobyi lepa tie, hne phungbie saya tie ta ama thaw aa, thie'a yi te, ning thung khutaata a thu pakhaa aa,” a ta yi.
Hingpa hing a siesa pata a chang yi. Cakhutaa cata Piter ta ama kha a kie luo cakuokhyi te a chuo.

Cuorasala Zingsuv ta ziytuv tie'a luo kha a pali te Piter kha a chuo hriy. “Setaa, i hnangluo kha a hnyi! Tahematapakieca na ruenapa hing Khazing khingna cunglie chi vaciy, cawsaa khingna cungliena na chi,” a ta.
Cawsaazaapuv hne ziytuv tie kha ku yi te, “Ahunghmuota kama naa ziytuv a cuo khingpa ca ama khingna kha thuse sala a vieluo kha a puv pata na ziy se.
Tahematapakieca a hringna aa bangpa a khingpa tie ca ama hringna kha a sung'a yi te, cuorasala kama cuo hne thuophaa cuota a hringna a pipa tie ca hringna kha ama hmung aa.
Cawsaa hingta chuelyi hing a yalya ta cu sala, a hringna aa sung kieca khaapama a thlahne aa?
A hringna kha khaapa hmang tama aa thla khu aa?
Hingpa a siyhrawpa hne a suepa chuo lie hing kama hne i bie a zaakhyipa ca, Cawsaa Sacapaa ta a Paa rungnaana hne a pathepa avuoming zaw hne aa zuv thueta ama kha a zaakhyi ra aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata, iema kha “Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, hingpa lie a daapa chekha hing Khazing pena ca cahrana hneta aa vawpa kha ama hmung hluo li a thiy li riypa ama aw,” ata yi.
Ning caruv khutaata Zingsuv ta Piter, Jeim hne Johan kha aa suosapa tluocung luo kiekhyi yi te iema selaw ta ama aw. Ama ming hmungna lie kha Zingsuv ca a hminghmie aa thle,
a caw ca a ruona luo ta aa li ta aa li, chuelyi lie a awpa ahungtahmuo cahaacata a ruona te ta pasuv khu'a va yi.
Capa lie ca Elijah hne Moses kha iema'a lie zaa luo yi te Zingsuv hne bie amaa rue.
Piter ta Zingsuv kha, “Saya, hingpa lie ma awpa hing kiema cuota a pha hringhruo, nama cuota suokha, Moses cuota suokha hne, Elijah cuota suokha ta pata thluodaa suothung maca sapa'a yi” a ta.
Ama thlaa a zang hringhruo nakawta Piter ca khaapama i ri tapa kha pachang vyi.
Amyi a vya zu te a ningdiy ta iema kha buv yi te, capa amyi chung taa cata ueryi suokha paring te, “Ama hing i Duepa i Sacapaa tana a cuo, a bie kha naathlie tie ung,” a ta.
Ama kiecahriy kha ama mang pahraa ca Zingsuv ta li pata iema'a lie kha ahunghmuo hmung va yi.
Tluocung taata ama za cungpuo pata, Zingsuv ta, Cawsaa Sacapaa hing thiyna taata a thu pakhaa hluo li nama hmungpa hing ahunghmuo chang'a va ung ciy, a ta yi.
A cuopa hmang kha ama chunglie ama pari, cadyiseca thiyna taata thupakhaana tapa ca khaapama a ri khingna ta a cuo aa? amaa ta.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv kha, “Khaapanakawma phungbie saya tie ta Elijah na a vaw taa aa, ama ta?” ta pata ama hiehriy.
Zingsuv ta, “Zezaw bangkhuo ting pacie riypata Elijah ca aa vaw taa hmisi. Cadyiseca khaapanakawma Caapathe ta Cawsaa Sacapaa ca khuopuv ta te-ang'a te ese nutaapa ta ama tue aa ta pata aa cape?
Cuorasala ica chang yi, Caapathe a ripa haata, Elijah ca a vaw tli te cawsaa ta ama khing thiy ta ama tue mangtli,” a ta yi.
Ziytuv tie'a luo ama va chiy ca, zaapuv ta za cadung yi te phungbie saya chekha hne bie amaa zaa i nguoluo.
Cawsaazaapuv ta Zingsuv kha ama va hmung pahne ta, ama kharue haasa te a ruo yi te bie ama vaa chang.
Zingsuv ta, ziytuv tie kha, “Khaapa kaw ma iema hneta namaa i? a ta yi.
Cawsaazaapuv chungtaata pakha ta, “Saya, I sacapaa na nama'a luo i vawkhyi, bie a pari sa khu lipa khuevuo na a hryi;

khuevuo a chunglie a vya pya kyry ta, alyi lie kha vaapatyi te, a pakaa taata a buvcaphawpa pya te a haa dyi rie te a siypakya; caa ziytuv tie kha khuevuo papya riypata paa i kie yi, cuorasala papya khu va yi,” a ta.

Zingsuv ta, “Niema, zangna a hnyi lipa zaw, kha cuo te ma niema'a lie hing i aw kalie a hu aa? Kha cuo te ma nama nang caw pata a chiyle namaa hu kalie aa? Haatiypa kha kama'a luo a vawkhyi tie ung,” a ta yi.
Iema ta haatiypa ca ama'a luo amaa vawkhyi. Thlaapa chiepa ta Zingsuv kha a hmung pahne ta haatiypa kha vaapatyi te alyi lie a lie te aa pahlangle, a pakaa taata abuv dyi a pya.
Zingsuv ta a paa kha, “Hing haa hingta a tanapa hing khacuo ma a ta tli?” a ta. “A cawta baataa tana a cuo.
Haatiypa kha a thie khing nakawta myi chung luo zaw yi hluvpuv pazu te tiy chung luo zaw yi hluvpuv a pathla. Malie naa bya khu kieca malie a bya thi tie,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Malie naa bya khu kieca na ta ma? Zangna a hnyipa cuota ca zezaw bangkhuo hing a cuo khu diy,” a ta.
Haatiypa a paa ca sungkha ta khi pathla te, “I zang; i zang linapa kha naa bya tie,” a ta.

Zingsuv ta iema'a luo zaapuv a maa vya ruolepa kha a hmung tiyta, a pyalyipa thlaapa kha chuo te, “Nama, thlaapa pyalyipa, haatiypa bie a pari sa the lipa hne naa a parue sapa hingpa paa chung taa hingta pya la khatiy ning hmuo a ngie pakhaa khah tie! ta pata naw ica pi,” a ta.
Thlaapa pyalyipa ca khuopuv ta khi te haatiypa kha a siy patyi khutaata a pya. Haatiypa ca a thiypa riyy haa kha ta cuo te, cawsaa hluv vie ta, “A thiy tli,” ama ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta a buo ta la te, pathu te aa kya daa.
Zingsuv kha ing chung luo aa ngie tiyta, ziytuv tie ta a paruvta tah, “Khaapanakawma thlaapa pyalyipa kha ma papya khu va?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Hingpa phang hing ca thlaachuona ta dyina a pya khu,” a ta yi.
Zingsuv hne ziytuv tie ca capa hmang taa cata pya yi te Galilee cahrawpaa pata ama si. Capa kaw ca Zingsuv ta ahunghmuo pachang sa khing va yi,
tahematapakieca ama ta ziytuv tie kha, “Cawsaa Sacapaa hing cawsaa kuv luo pi pata cuo'a te, ama thie aa, ama thie khutaata ning thung khutaata a thu pakhaa aa,” ta pata a pacuv yi.
Cuorasala khaapama a ri khing tapa kha pachang va yi, hiehriy riypa zaw kha a nguo va yi.
Kapernaum khy luo kha pha yi te ing chunglie a aw ning kha Zingsuv ta ziytuv tie kyihuo kha, “Luopuv lie kha khaapama namaa vya ile khya? a ta yi.
Cuorasala palie nguo va yi, tahematapakieca, luopuv lie kha, ahungma a le ce tapa kha amaa vya ile.
Zingsuv ca a tu te, ziytuv tie kha ku yi te iema kyihuo khata, “Ahunghmuo cuose malie hrawlie a le cepa a cuo khingpa ca a caw cepa hne cawsaa bangkhuo sii ta a cuo taa riypa tana a cuo,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata haatiy pakha kha la te iema hrawlie a padaa khutaata, a kuv ta a paw te,
“Ahunghmuo cuose kama ming ta hing haapa haatiy a cuhluopa ca kama naa cuhluopa ta cuo te, kama kha naa cuhluopa ca kama dyi cuo li pata kama naa pathlietuv a cuhluopa tana a cuo,” a ta yi.
Johan ta, “Saya, na ming ta khuevuo a papyapa pakha hmung pate muo, kiema malie a ziy li nakawta ma thlu ta,” a ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta, “Thlu ri khah ung; tahematapakieca i ming ta kharuehaa hmang a tuepa ta ca a nata tah i thuo na pachi'a vyi.
Malie a du lipa ca kiema cawsaa tana a cuo.
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, Khrih ming namaa cyi nakawta dang riypa tiy nuo kha caa pipa yi ca lawmuo kha hmung li pata aw hrahring'a vyi.

“Ahunghmuo cuo sala, hingpa haatiyta zaw pakhakha hing kama ina zangna taata luo a papie sapa ca nama rue lie sacuo rienapa alungtung pathlie pata riyliy luo thaw pata cuo sala nama cuota a pha vie aa.
Na kuv ta na zangna taata aca papie sa kieca na kuv kha te tie; a thiy buo lipa myi chung luo na kuv hra hning hneta tlapa laata ca kuv tling li pata hringna luo a ngiepa a pha vie aa.

chapters.text: Na phyi ta na zangna taata aca papie sa kieca, na phyi kha te tie; phyi hra hning hneta hell luo tlapa laata ca phyi tling li pata hringna luo a ngiepa a pha vie aa.

chapters.note: Kuvtie caataw chekha tie lie ca tluo 48 hneta aa lupa 44 hne 46 hing ca aw vyi

chapters.text: Na ming ta na zangna taata aca papie sa kieca cakhyi la thaw tie; ming hra hning hneta hell luo tlapa laata ca ming hra kha dyi ta hringna luo a ngiepa ca a pha vie aa.
Capa hmang lie ca ama lung ca thiy buo li'a pata, myi zaw thiy buo'a vyi.
“Cawsaa bangkhuo ca myi ta paciy haa khata pa-ie sapa ta ama cuo aa.
“Paciy ca a pha; cuorasala a iena kha a vie kieca, tuokhaatama na pa-ie sa pakhaa the aa? “Nama chunglie paciy kha hnyi ung la, pakha hne pakha a resa pata aw tie ung,” a ta yi.
Zingsuv ca capa hmang taa cata pya te Judea pe, Jordan cavaa huesuo luo kha a vaa. Cawsaazaapuv ta a vya hmyasue pakhaa hyi yi te a tue tawpa haa khata a pacuv pakhaa hyi yi.
Farasi tie chekha a vaw yi te ama dyapasya khing pata, “Capaa pakha ta napuv ma riypa kha phungbie ta a pa-aw ma?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Moses ta tuokhaatama naw aca pi yi?” a ta yi.
Iema ta, “Moses ta ca, capaa pakha ca a napuv kha manapa caa a pi kieca a ma khu, malie a ta,” ama ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta, “Nama palung a le tuv nakaw tana hingpa nawbie hing nama cuota a cape pata a cuo.
Cuorasala sahruo thu cuo ning taa khata, ‘Khazing ta capaa hne canung a sa yi'.
‘Caacuonakawta capaa ta a paa hne a nung kha thuse'a yi te a napuv hneta amaa hlaw aa,
pahning ca pang kha ta ama cuo aa'. Caacuonakawta iema ca pahning cuo va tli yi pang kha tana ama cuo.
Khazing ta a pahlawpa yi ca ahungtahmuo che khah yi se,” a ta.
Cakhutaata ing chunglie kha ziytuv tie ta capa kaw ca ama hiehriy pakhaa.
Zingsuv ta, “A napuv kha ma te canung hrangpa a hlawpa ca nungvaathingsuena a tuepa tana a cuo.
Cahaacata a navaapa kha thuse te capaa hrangpa a hlawpa ca nungvaathingsuena a tuepa tana a cuo,” a ta yi.
Cawsaa ta haatiy zaw kha a kuv ta taw naase yi ta pata Zingsuv'a luo kha amaa vawkhyi; cuorasala ziytuv tie ta cawsaa kha ama chuo.

Cuorasala Zingsuv ta a hmung yi ca a hi haa te, ziytuv tie kyihuo khata, “Haatiy tie kha kama'a luo a vaw yi se, thlu khah ung, tahematapakieca Khazing pena ca hing haapa haatiy zaw cuo hing tana a cuo.
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, ahunghmuo cuose haatiy zaw haa hingta Khazing pena a cuhluo lipa ca Khazing pena chung luo a ngie khu'a va yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata haatiy tie kha a paw yi te, a kuv kha ama cunglie khang te, thluechiy a pi yi.
Zingsuv khy tlawna luo aa thale ning ta cawsaa pakha kha a vya ruo te, a hmiekunglie a pakhuv vya pane te, “A phapa Saya, Chuozaa hringna cu riypata khaapama i tue aa?” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Khaapanakawma a phapa ina ta ciy? Khazing ta li pata ahunghmuo pha va yi.

Nawbie zaw ca na pachang thluo kha: ‘Lie va naw khah; Nungvaathingsuena tue khah; Paruv khah; A cuo lipa bie lie malie vaa daakhyi khah; Cawsaa va dung khah; Na nung hne na paa va ciyzaa yi’ ta pata a cuopa kha,” a ta.
Capa paa ca ta, “Saya, hing nawbie bangkhuo hing i cawta baataata i ziy diy ciepa tana a cuo,” a ta.

Zingsuv ta a mang, a cunglie duena hnyi te a tapa ca, “Suokha dyina na bu, cakuo la, na hnyipa kha zaa la tuokaa kha siypasa tie pi tie yi, vuoruo lie suethiy na hnyi aa, cakhutaata a vaw la na ziy tie,” a ta.
Capa bie a thyi tiyta, minghmie pha li cangta ngiechisa pata a cakuo, tahematapakieca ama ca a hnyirungsapa tana a cuo.
Zingsuv ta ziytuv tie kha mang paky yi te, “Khazing pena luo a hnyirungpa a ngie riypa hing kha tluv tama a ruv aa!” a ta yi.
Ziytuv tie ca capa bie kawlie ca ta ama kharue a haasa. Cuorasala Zingsuv ta, “I saa zaw, Khazing pena luo a ngie hing kha tluv tama a ruv!
A hnyirungpa Khazing pena luo a ngiepa laata kala-uv ciphang khue luo a ngiepa na a na vie,” a ta pakhaa yi.
Iema ca ama kharue haasa te, pakha hne pakha kha, “Cata a cuo kie, ahungma khuona ca a hmung khu aa?” amaa ta.
Zingsuv ta iema kha mang yi te, “Hingpa hing cawsaa cuota ca cuo khu vyi, cuorasala Khazing cuota ca a cuo khu; tahematapakieca Khazing cuota ca zezaw bangkhuo hing a cuo khu,” a ta yi.
Piter ta, “Mang tie, kiema ca zezaw bangkhuo thuse pate nama maca ziy tli,’ a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, kama hne thuophaa vuolieta a ing zaw cuose, a uvnu zaw cuose, a sieta zaw cuose, a nung cuose a paa cuose, a saata zaw cuose, a lu zaw cuose a thusepa ca,
ata chuo chunglie hrahring hingta ing zaw, uvnu zaw, sieta zaw, nung, hne saata zaw, lu zaw kha le zakha ta hmung'a te, hrisaana zaw a hmung aa. A vaw riypa chuo lie zaw chuozaa hringna a hmung aa.
Cuorasala hmaa a sapa a hluvpuv ca hnang chuo'a yi te, hnang a chuopa a hluvpuv ca hmaa ama sa aa,” a ta.

Jerusalem luo ama si nguoluo ning kha, Zingsuv ca hmaa luo kha a cakuo lu. Ziytuv tie ca ama nang ta uo te, a hrangpa ama hnang a paziy lepa tie zaw ama thlaa a zangsa. Zingsuv ta ziytuv hlyihning tie kha a hrangta tah ku pakhaa yi te a cunglie a tlung riypa kaw kha a chang yi.

“Mang tie ung, Jerusalem luo ma sithaw nguoluo ung hing, Cawsaa Sacapaa hing tluobyi lepa tie hne phungbie saya tie kuv luo pi pata cuo'a te, iema ta thie riypata bie ama chi aa; cakhutaata Jentail ming kuv luo kha ama pi aa;
ama tue hyalya aa, ama paciy ta ama pacha aa, sungpe ta chi'a yi te ama thie aa; cuorasala ning thung khutaata a thu pakhaa aa,” a ta yi.
Zebedi sacapaa Jeim hne Johan ta Zingsuv'a luo kha a vaw yi te, “Saya, khaapa maacaa hie zaw ta malie na tuepa riypa tana maca khing,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Khaapa malie tuepa se tapa ma ina khing ung ciy?” a ta yi.
Iema ta, “Na rungnaana chunglie na cacuoluo ta pakha, na cavyiluo ta pakha a tuna naw malie pi tie,” ama ta.

Cuorasala Zingsuv ta iema kyihuo khata, “Khaapama ina hie ung ciy tapa pachang va ung ciy. I dang riypa panuo hing nama dang khu'a ma, acuolikie tiy i naw riypa haa hingta namaa naw khu'a ma?” a ta yi.
Iema ta, “Ma tue khu thluo aa,” ama ta. Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta, “I dang riypa panuo hing nama dang khu sasaw thluo aa, tiy i naw riypa zaw hing namaa naw khu sasaw thluo aa.
Cuorasala i cacuoluo hne i cavyiluo a tu riypa hing ca kama ta i pi khupa cuo vyi, cuorasala capa hmang ca tingpa paciepa tie huo tana a cuo,” a ta yi.
Capa kaw ca ziytuv pahraa tie ta ama thyi tiyta, Jeim hne Johan cunglie kha ama hi a haa.
Caacuonakawta Zingsuv ta iema kha ku yi te, “Jentail ming hrawlie ca uvtuv tapa tie ta uvpa tie cunglie kha a chi yi te, ama khing ta ama awsue tawpa kha nama pachang.
Cuorasala niema hrawlie ca cahaacata cuo'a vyi; cuorasala nama hrawlie cawsaa lepa a cuo khingpa ca nama changtaapa a cuo riypa tana a cuo,
cakhutaata niema hrawlie pakhanapa a cuo khingpa ca niema bangkhuo sii kha a cuo taa riypa tana a cuo.
Cawsaa Sacapaa hmuota hriepapa cuo li pata, hriepatuv cuo riypa hne cawsaa hluvpuv a thla riypata a hringna pi riypa tana aa vaw,” a ta.
Zingsuv hne ziytuv tie ca Jeriko luo kha ama chiy. Ziytuv tie'a nata cawsaazaapuv hneta Jeriko taata ama pya ning kha Timau sacapaa, a mingcuepa a hielepa paa Bartimu kha luopuv kielie a zaa tu.
Nazareth khypa Zingsuv na a cuo tapa a pachang tiyta khuosa ta khi te, “David Sacapaa, Zingsuv, ngie na chi thi tie!” a ta.
Cawsaa hluvpuv ta ama kha duo riypata khuosa ta ama thlu, cuorasala, “David Sacapaa, ngie na chi thi tie!” ta pata khuo vie ta a khi hryly.
Zingsuv ta a daa te, “Va ku tie ung,” a ta yi. Caacuonakawta mingcuepaa ca ku yi te, “Na palung tluosa se, thu tie, aca ku cuv,” ama ta.
A pang kha thaw te, a cathlu te Zingsuv'a luo kha aa vaw.
Zingsuv ta, “Khaapa na tuepa se tapa ma na khing?” a ta. Mingcuepaa ta, “I sayapa, i ming hmung the pakhaa se tapa na i khingsa,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Cakuo tie, na zangnapa na caa patluo sa,” a ta. A ming ca sungkha ta vuo pakhaa te Zingsuv ca a ziyle.
Zingsuv hne ziytuv tie ca Jerusalem khy va pha tyalya'a nang caw, Bethfeih hne Bethani khy kielie a awpa Olif tluo athaa luo kha ama va chiy. Zingsuv ta ziytuv pahning kha pathlielu yi te,
“Nama hmieluo lie a awpa khy luo kha vaa ung la, khy chung luo namaa ngie pahne ta, amaa khang buo li liepa laataata aa hre thluopa kha nama hmung aa; pathluo ung la a vya chiy tie ung.
Pakhakha ta, ‘Khaapanakawma hingpa hing nama tue?’ aca ta kie yi ca, ‘Abyipa na a hu, maca vya pi pakhaa paluo'a yi,’ nama ta aa,” a ta yi.
Vaa yi te thlake a thaa, aleluo luopuv lie, laataata aa hrepa kha ama hmung. Ama pathluo nguoluopa khata,
a kielie a daapa chekha ta, “Khaapama nama tue, laataata khuhriy ca nama pathluo? ama ta.
Zingsuv ta a changpa haa yi khata palie yi te, a dale thluo ung, ama ta.
Laataata ca Zingsuv'a luo a vya chiy yi te, ama pang kha a ke lie padie yi te, Zingsuv ta aa khang.
Cawsaa hluvpuv ta ama pang kha luopuv lie phaa yi te, chekha ta a hnaa rungsapa thingce zaw kha thli yi te luopuv lie ca ama phaa ra.
Cakhutaata hmaa a sapa cuo yi se, a hnang taata a ziypa cuo yi se, khi yi te, “Hosanna! Abyipa ming ta a vawpa ca thluechiypa tana a cuo!
Mingpa David pena a vaw riypa ca thluechiy hmung mang sue. Aa suocena vuoruo lie khiy Hosanna ta pata cuo mang sue!” ama ta.
Zingsuv ca Jerusalem luo kha a ngie te, Biena-ing luo kha vaa te hmangting kha a va mang diy. Ning aa ngie tli nakawta ziytuv hlyihning hne khata Bethani khy luo kha ama kaa.
A mawluopa, Bethani taata ama vya kaa ning kha Zingsuv ca a nang a diy.

Luohlaa taata a hnaa rungsapa thyikuv kung kha a hmung ca, a thyi suokha chuo hmung'a ang ma ta pata vaa te a va mang. Aa thaa luo a chiy tiyta a hnaa dyi a hmung, tahematapakieca thyikuv a pathyi cuo ta cuo vyi.
Zingsuv ta thyikuv kung kha “Ahungtahmuo na thyi ca ce pakhaa khah tli yi se,” a ta. Ziytuv tie ta a ripa kha ama thyi.

Cakhutaata Jerusalem luo kha ama va pha. Zingsuv ca Biena-ing luo kha a ngie te, biena-ing chunglie chechiy a calyituv tie hne a zaatuv tie kha aa cade diy yi. Tuokaa a thlepa tie cabya hne valale a zaapa tie thude zaw kha pali diy te,
Biena-ing lie chechiy sikhyi bungthaw li tli riypata a thlu yi.

Cawsaa kha pacuv yi te a ripa ca “Caapathe chunglieta, ‘Kama ing ca mingphang bangkhuo cuota thlaachuona ing ta pata kupa a cuo aa, a ta cuo va ma'? Cuorasala niema ta aparuvpa tie a chuona hmang ta nama tue,” a ta.

Tluobyi lepa tie hne phungbie saya tie ta capa bie ca ama thyi tiyta, Zingsuv thiena riypa luo kha ama huv, cuorasala cawsaazaapuv yalya ta a pacuvpa cunglie kha ama kharue a haa diy nakawta Zingsuv kha ama ciy.
Zuoluo khyzing'a nang caw ta, Zingsuv hne ziytuv tie ca khypuv chungtaata ama pya.
Mawdiy ta luopuv lie ama silepa khata thyikuv kung ca a thariy te a caa diypa kha ama hmung.
Piter ta a thyi te Zingsuv kyihuo khata, “Saya, mang tie! Chie na sapa thyikuv kung kha a caa diy tli,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta iema kyihuo khata, “Khazing kha zang tie ung.

Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, nama pathiypalung chunglie zang lina hnyi li pata, nama ripa hing a cuo hrahring aa ta pata nama zang kieca, hingpa tluo hing, ‘Thu la riyliy luo hue vaa thaw tie,’ ta ung la, capa ca tuepa pata nama cuo aa.
Caacuonakawta ica chang yi, thlaachuona ta nama hiepa tuokhaapa a cuo zaw, i hmung tli ta pata zang tie ung, capa ca pi pata nama cuo aa.
“A daa ung cate thlaa nama chuo tiyta, pakhakha cunglie hihaana nama hnyipa kha a ngiethe ung la, vuoruo lie a awpa nama Paa ta niema nama suena zaw kha acaa ngiethe ra'a yi,” a ta.
(Cuorasala malie suena kha namaa ngiethe li kieca vuoruo lie a awpa nama Paa ta niema nama suena zaw kha caa ngiethe ra'a va yi.)
Jerusalem luo kha ama vya pha pakhaa. Zingsuv Biena-ing chunglie a cakuole nguoluo ning kha, tluobyi lepa tie, phungbie saya tie hne uvthyi tie kha a vaw yi te,
Zingsuv kyihuo khata, “Khaapa nawhnyina tama hingpa hmang hing na tue? Ahungma hingpa nawhnyina hing caa pi?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Kama zaw bie suokha ca hiehriy'a yi ang; na palie ung la, khaapa nawhnyina tama hingpa hmang hing i tue tapa kha ica chang'a yi.
Johan tiynawna hing vuoruo taata ma, acuolikie cawsaapa'a taata ma? Na palie tie ung” a ta yi.
Iema'a na iema kha a i yi te, “'Vuoruo taata,’ ta se pala, ‘Khaapanakawma Johan ca nama zang va,’ malie a ta aa.
‘Cawsaa taata,’ ta se pala, cawsaazaapuv kha ciy amaa chiy, tahematapakieca cawsaa bangkhuo ta Johan ca profet tapa kha ama zang,” amaa ta.
Caacuonakawta “Pachang vapuv,” ama ta. Zingsuv ta, “Kama zaw khaapa nawhnyina tama hingpa hmang zaw hing i tue tapa kha ca chang ra'a va yi ang,” a ta yi.

Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta pakhingpuona ta iema'a lie kha a ri. “Cawsaa pakha ta mingsuv diedung tue te, piehu a padung, mingsuv nawna khue kha cu te, rievena tluophie zaw kha a sa; cakhutaa cata a mingsuv diedung ca rehrietuv tie kha pahlie yi te ruo hrang luo khy a tlaw se.
Mingsuv lu tiy aa de tiyta, a siipaapa kha pathlie te a vyipa chungtaata ama a hmung riypa kha a va pala sa.
Cuorasala ama kha patuv yi te ama tuv khutaata a kuv cahri pata ama pathlie.
A siipaapa a hrangpa pakha a pathlie pakhaa, rehrietuv tie ta a luv lie kha tuv yi te nangzaahmiechi pata ama tue.
Cakhutaata a hrangpa pakha a pathlie ca capa paa ca ama thie. A hrangpa a hluvsa zaw kha cahaacata tue diy yi te, chekha ama tuv, chekha ama thie.
A hrangpa pakha, a due hringhruopa a sacapaa a hnyi kalie. A hnangcaw ce ta a sacapaa ca pathlie te, ‘I sacapaa hing ca ama hmiezaa ngiethie aa,’ a ta.
Cuorasala capa rehrietuv tie ca ta pakha hne pakha kha, ‘Ama hing na a rucutuv ta a cuo, a vaw tie ung, thie'a ung puv, a ru hing kiema huopa ta a cuo aa,’ amaa ta.
Caacuonakawta patuv yi te ama thie khutaata diedung khungthing luo ama thaw.
Cakhutaata diedung a hnyituvpa ta khaapa na a tue thlu'a mang nama ta ma? a ta yi. A vaw'a te rehrietuv tie kha a thie diy khutaa yi ta diedung kha a hrangpa tie a pi'a yi.
‘Caapathe chunglie ta: Ing satuv tie ta ama thawpa alung ca ingkiylung tana aa li;
capa ca Abyipa tuepa hmang ta cuo te, ma hmungna lieta nang-uo a chiysa va ma,' a tapa kha ri buo va ung ca ma?” a ta yi.
Hing pakhingpuona hing kiema muo malie a tapake ta tapa kha ama pachang tiyta, ama kha ama patuv khing, cuorasala cawsaazaapuv kha ama ciy. Caacuonakawta ama kha thuse yi te ama cakuo.
A ripa bie ta pa-uo the riypata Farasi ming chekha hne Herod cawsaa chekha kha Zingsuv'a luo ama pathlie.

Ama'a luo kha a vaw yi te, “Saya, nama ca aa hmuopa dyi a ripa na cuopa kha ma pachang, cawsaa pahlyipale vaciy, a kuo ta a daa vaciy, biehmisipa haata Khazing luopuv kha na pacuv yi. Rom siepahruo ngukhyi pipa hing ma phungbie ta a pa-aw ma, a thlu ma?
Ngukhyi ma pi'a ma, pi'a va pa ma?” ama ta. Zingsuv ta phahruo amaa cuo pakhipa kha pachang te, “Khaapanakawma ina dyapasya ung ciy? Denarii phie kha kha vya cyi ung la mang'a ang,” a ta yi.
Denarii phie kha ama vya cyi. Cakhutaata iema kyihuo khata, “Ahung hmiechang hne ahung ming ma a taa?” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Siepahruo hmiechang hne siepahruo ming,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Siepahruo huopa kha siepahruo pi ung la, Khazing huopa kha Khazing pi tie ung,” a ta yi. Zingsuv cunglie kha ama nang dyi a uo thluo.
Thiyna taata thupakhaana aw vyi a tapa Sadusi ming chekha ca Zingsuv'a luo kha a vaw yi te bie ama hiehriy.

Iema ta, “Saya, Moses ta malie a capepa siypa ca, ‘Cawsaa pakha ta saata hnyi li pata a napuv kha a thiyse biephung kieca, nunghlyinung kha a uvnu pakha ta a hlaw'a te a thiypa a uvnu cuo khata saata ama sapa aa,’ ta pata a cuo.
Uvcanu pasariy aw yi te, a pakhanapa paa ca napuv chiy te saata hnyi li pata a thiy.
Cakhutaata a pahningnapa paa ta cawsaanung ca a hlaw te saata hnyi li pata a thiy ra, a pathungnapa paa zaw kha cahaacata cuo te,
ama pasariy chunglie pakha tahmuo saata hnyi li pata ama thiy diy. A hnangcaw ce ta cawsaanung zaw kha a thiy ra.
Thupakhaana ning thueta capa cawsaanung ca ahung napuv tama a cuo aa. Tahematapakieca ama pasariy ta ama kha amaa zaa hlaw kaluo,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Caapathe cuose, Khazing cahrana cuose nama pachang lipa hingna nama hlana ta a cuo, cuo va ma?
Tahematapakieca thiyna taata ama thu pakhaa thue ca, a chiy a hie'a va tli yi, vuoruo lie a awpa avuoming haa tana ama cuo aa.

A thiypa tie thupakhaana kawlieta, Moses caa-uv chunglie ruohraw a kuonapa kawlie kha Khazing ta khaapama a ri tapa kha ri buo va ung ca ma? ‘Kama ca Abraham Khazing, Isak Khazing, hne Jakob Khazing tana i cuo, a tapa kha.'
Ama ca a hringpa tie Khazing cuo te a thiypa tie Khazing cuo vyi. Nama rue chie karuv,” a ta yi.
Phungbie saya pakha ca a vaw te, bie amaa ipa hne Zingsuv ta ama bie hiehriypa a palie thesapa yi kha a hmung tiyta, “Nawbie palang hrawlieta khaapa hing ma a biepuv ce?” ta pata a hiehriy.
Zingsuv ta, “A suokhanapa ca, ‘Thyi tie, Vya Israel: Abyipa ima Khazing pakha kyalya hingna Abyipa ta a cuo.
Abyipa na Khazing ca na pathiypalung yalya, na hringna yalya, na ruena yalya hne na cahrana yalya ta due tie,’ tapa hingta a cuo.
A suohningna ca, ‘Nama naa duepa haata na ingpaa kha va due tie,’ ta pata a cuo. Capa nawbie suohning laa cata a le viepa suokha hmuo aw vyi,” a ta.
Phungbie sayapa ta Zingsuv kyihuo khata, “Naa hmuo, Saya; na ripa ca aa hmuo, Abyipa dyi hingna Khazing ta a cuo, ama hlyitaw taa hingta khazing hrangpa aw va tli.

Khazing hing pathiypalung yalya, pachangna yalya, hne thaazuo yalya ta ma due riypa, hne nama naa duepa haata na ingpaa kha va due tie tapa hing sahring pang kha yalya ta myirue panaana ta pihluona hne hriykhungrina zaw laata a pha vie” a ta.
Zingsuv ta capa paa biepaliena a phazya kha a hmung tiyta, “Khazing pena hneta a hlasa vaciy,” a ta. Cakhutaata ca Zingsuv bie hiehriy riypa kha ahungtahmuo a nguo va tli yi.
Zingsuv ta Biena-ing chunglie a pacuv ning yi kha, “Khaapanakawma phungbie saya tie ta Messiah ca David sacapaa tana a cuo, ama ta the?
David ta Thlaapa Pathe pachangsana ta a phupa ca, Abyipa ta i Byipaapa kha “Na carie tie kha na phyipazaa rawlie i chi hluo li yi, i cacuoluo kuo hingta a tu tie,” a ta.
David mamaapa ta ama kha, ‘Abyipa,’ a ta; caacuokieca tuokhaatama Messiah ca David Sacapaa ta a cuo the aa?” a ta. Cawsaazaapuv ta Zingsuv bie kha palung thusa pata ama naathlie.

Zingsuv ta a pacuvna lie yi kha, “Phungbie saya tie kha a raaring tie ung, buohryi pasiypa a hryi pata a khiele khingpa, chadawtluo lieta cawsaa ta pa-uvsathyina hne bie amaa chang riypa kha a tlechuopa, hne
apungna-ing thude pha cepa lie hne pyi chunglie pa-uvsathyina hmang lieta a tupa kha a tlechuopa tana ama cuo.
Nunghlyi tie ing kha chuv yi te, mang aa ngiena riypata a pasiysa ta thlaa ama chuo. A ruv viepa duotena na ama ang aa,” a ta.
Zingsuv ca Biena-ing sue pathlana kielie kha a tu te, cawsaazaapuv zaw ta sue thingkaw chung luo tuokaa ama pathlapa kha a mang. A hnyirungpa a hluvpuv ca tuokaa a hluvsa ama pathla.
A siypasapa nunghlyinung kha a vaw te daa tuokaa piehning a pathla ra.
Zingsuv ta ziytuv tie kha ku yi te a changpa yi ca, “Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, hingpa a siypasapa nunghlyinung hingna malie laata tuokaa a hluv vie sue thingkaw luo a pasuo.
Malie ca ama hnyi hlyipa khana ama pasuo, cuorasala hingpa nung hing ca a siy a pasasa raalaa pata a hnyipa bangkhuo kha a pasuo, a hringna riypa bangkhuo khana a pasuo diy,” a ta.
Zingsuv ca Biena-ing taata a kya pya pata, ziytuv pakha ta, “Mang tie, Saya, kha tluv ta a lepa alung zaw'a nata kha tluv ta a lepa ing zaw ma!” a ta.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta, “Hing ing lepa puv hing nama hmung cuo ma? Alung suokha hing hmuota a hrangpa suokha cunglie aa pacangcang pata aw'a va tli, a palang ta pacing diypa tana a cuo aa,” a ta.
Zingsuv ca Biena-ing a rie-e Olif tluocung lie aa tu nguoluo ning kha, Piter, Jeim, Johan hne Andru ta a paruvta tah bie ama hiehriy.
“Malie chang tie, hingpa hmang hing khatiythuema a cuo aa? Hingpa hmang bangkhuo a vya tlingna riypata khaapa pamangsana hmang ma a vya aw aa?” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta iema kyihuo khata, “Ahungtahmuo aca dung li riypa yi ta a raaring tie ung.
Cawsaa hluvpuv kha i ming ta a vaw'a yi te, ‘Kama hingna Ama ta a cuo ang,’ ta'a yi te cawsaa hluvpuv kha ama dung aa.
Rie amaa tuvna thuohlaa hne rie amaa tuv'a nangpa thuohlaa kha nama thyi tiyta nama thlaa zang khah se; cahaapa hmang ca a tlung thluo aa, cuorasala a chuona cuo ca tlung va lie.
Mingphang phang kha hne phang kha amaa du aa, pena suokha hne suokha amaa du aa. Hmangting lieta aling a siy'a te, cakuo a tlung aa. Hingpa hing ca nupazi aa pathunapa haa tana a cuo.

“Niema zaw hrahring hing a raaring tie ung; zung luo ca chiykhyi'a yi te apungna-ing lie kha aca tuv'a yi; kama kawlieta uvtuv tie hne siepahruo tie hmielie kha a daa'a ung cate iema'a lie kha tehte nama cuo aa.
Cakhutaata thuophaa kha mingphang bangkhuo'a luo phu pata a cuo taa aa.

Bie ripa riypata zung luo acaa chiy tiy yi ta, tuokhaapa bie ma ma ri aa tapa kha nama palung rie thyi pacie khah se. Cuorasala capa cuo lieta aca pi thathiypa yi bie kha ri tie ung, tahematapakieca a ripa ca niema cuo va ung ciy, Thlaapa Pathe tana a cuo.
Uvta hne nuta kha thiyna phana te ta a lyi'a yi te, paa ta a saata zaw, saata zaw ta nung hne paa kha thiyna phana te ta ama lyi aa.
Kama kawlieta cawsaa bangkhuo ta aca hue'a yi. Cuorasala a chuona te ta a ang pathla khupa ca khuo pata ama cuo aa.
“Cuorasala ciy aa chiypa duvsamakhiepa a awna riypa a cuo lipa hmang lie a awpa kha nama hmung tiyta, (caa a rituv ta thyi the se), Judea ruo chunglie a awpa tie ca tluocung luo kha a ruo yi se.
Ing thlungkhuv cunglie a awpa ta chechiy la riypata ingchung luo cung pata a ngie khah se.
Lu lie a awpa ta a buohryicungle la riypata kaa khah se.
Capa ning hne cuo lie ca nu a phyapa canung hne haaseta a hnyipa canung cuota ca bawchie ciemuopa tana a cuo!
Hingpa hmang hing thlasiy chung a cuo li riypata thlaachuo tie ung!
Capa ning hne cuo lie ca Khazing ta chuelyi a sa baataata ataning te a tlung buo lipa hne a vya tlung buo li tli riypa ruvnaana na a tlung aa.
Abyipa ta capa ning hne cuo kha a pachang sa vie li kieca ahunghmuota hyazang'a va yi; cuorasala ama ta aa tlawpa zaw vuo khata capa ning hne cuo ca a pachang sa vie.
Capa cuo lie ca pakhakha ta niema kha, ‘Mang tie, Messiah ca hingpa lie hing a aw hing!’ acuolikie, ‘Mang tie, huepa lie hue a aw hue!’ aca ta kie zaw yi ma zang khah ungh.
Messiah pakhipa tie hne profet pakhipa tie vya pya'a yi te, a cuo khu kieca Khazing a tlaw ciepa zaw kha hmuo aa hmuo lipa luopuv luo a chiy riypata kharuehaa hmang hne pamangsana zaw ama tue aa.
Cuorasala padiypavuosa pata aw tie ung. Zezaw bangkhuo kha ica chang pacie diy yi.
“Capa te-angna ning hne cuo khutaa cata, ning ca zing'a te, thlaa ca vaa'a va tli.
Aasiy zaw avuo taata za tla'a te, vuoruo cahrana zaw ca amaa cahang aa.
Cakhutaata iema ta, Cawsaa Sacapaa ca amyi chunglieta cahrana hne rungnaa lesyina cangta aa zuvpa kha ama hmung aa.
Aa vuoming kha pathlie'a yi te, aa tlawpa tie kha chuelyi kiy paliy, alyi dena taata hne avuo dena taa khata a pahmya'a yi.
“Thyikuvkung taa hingta a cuv tie ung. A daw kya pakiy te a hnaa a kya thue tiyta cuovuo na a ngie tapa kha nama pachang.
Cahaacata hingpa hmang zaw a vya tlungpa kha nama hmung tiyta ama ca thlake te a vya chiy tli tapa kha nama pachang aa.
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, ata chuo cawsaa zaw hing hingpa hmang bangkhuo a vya cuo hluo li ca thiy'a va yi.
Alyi hne avuo ca ama ra aa, cuorasala kama bie ca ra'a vyi.
“Cuorasala capa ning hne cuo kaw ca ahungtahmuo pachang va yi, vuoruo lie a awpa avuoming cuose, Sacapaa cuose, pachang va yi, Paa kyalya dyina a pachang.
A raaring ung la singvaasa pata aw tie ung; tahematapakieca capa cuo ca khatiy tama aa vaw aa tapa kha pachang va ung ciy.

Capa ca cawsaa pakha kha khy tlaw riypata ing taata aa tha tiyta, a sii zaw kha ama cyicuo ta rehrie riypa a pi siy khu taa yi ta, chiypakaa a huopa paa zaw kha a phasa pata huo riypata bie a cung siypa paa hne tana aa lu.
Caacuonakawta singvaasa pata aw tie ung, tahematapakieca ing a hnyituv kha khatiy tama a vya chiy aa tapa pachang va ung ciy, zuoluo acuolikie zuocang acuolikie aakhang ta, acuolikie mawdiy
acuolikie namaa hmung chung tama tlangkhy aca vya chiyhnue'a yi tapa kha pachang va ung ciy.
Ica changpa yi hing cawsaa bangkhuo zaw i chang ra yi, a raaring tie ung,” a ta yi.

Hingpa hing Lawsena pyi hne Thiynung phuv lipa Viechuo pyi hluota ning hningna lie khata a cuo. Tluobyi lepa tie hne phungbie saya tie ta Zingsuv kha a paruvta tah patuv riypa hne thie riypata khue ama khuo;
tahematapakieca iema ta “Pyi chung hingta ca tue'a va ung puv, cawsaa zaw na hnaa a pahnaw'a yi,” ama ta.

Zingsuv ca Bethani khypa, caahminghmaa a phyapa Simon ing lie, cabya lie aa tu nguoluo ning kha canung pakha a vaw te alabaster ungthyi zungkha ta a muo ruv ciemuopa ziyhmyi kha vya cyi te capa ungthyi ca a tuvchi khutaata ziyhmyi kha Zingsuv luv lie a bya.
Capa lie a awpa cawsaa chekha ta hihaasa pata pakha hne pakha kha, “Khaapanakawma ziyhmyi ca hing haa hingta papuopahrie pata a tue?
Denarii zathung laata a hluv vie ta zaa pata tuokaa ca siypasa tie kha pi riypa tana a cuo,” ama ta. Cakhutaata cawsaanung kha khuopuv ta ama mawchie.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta, “Amata tah aw se! Khaapanakawma nama pataw nama pahrie? Kama cuota a phasapa re na a hrie.
Tahematapakieca siypasa tie ca nama aw hne pari aa, namaa bya khing ning namaa bya khu pari aa, cuorasala kama ca cipari ta na awhne'a va ung ciy.
Hingpa nung hingta a tue khupa kha a tue mangtli; pabyna cuo a pha hluota i pangpa kha ziyhmyi bya te a tingtuo mangtli.
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, thuophaa ama phunapa chuelyi khy ting lie kha hingpa nung a tuepa hmang hing ama maw lina ta ama rile pari aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata ziytuv hlyihning hrawlie pakha ta a cuopa Judas Iskariot ca Zingsuv lyi riypata tluobyi lepa tie'a luo kha a vaa.
A ripa kha ama thyi tiyta ama palung tluosa te tuokaa pi riypata bie ama kuo. Caacuonakawta Zingsuv lyi riypa cuophaa dyi kha a bya.

Thiynung phuv lipa Viechuo pyi a ning khana, Lawsena pyi tuvtaata ta hriykhungrina ama pihluona ning lie kha ziytuv tie ta Zingsuv kha, “Lawsena pyi saduonapa cuota khaapa lie va pachie yi se tapa ma malie na khing?” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Zingsuv ta ziytuv pahning kha pathlie yi te, iema kyihuo khata “Khypuv chung luo kha vaa ung la bi ta tiy a vya phyalepa paa kha namaa taw aa.
Capa paa ca paziyle ung la, a vaa ngienapa ing a hnyituvpa kha, ‘Saya na, khaapa khuo hing ma naa ziytuv tie hneta Lawsena pyi sa i ningna riypa khuo ta a cuo? a ta, va ta tie ung,’ a ta yi.
Ama ta a cung duo ingkhuo kusapa, chechiy tlingsa pata ama pachie ciepa khuo kha aca pahmung'a yi. Capa lie ca kiema cuo ca ta va pachie tie ung,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta ziytuv tie ca khypuv chung luo kha vaa yi te, Zingsuv ta a changpa dadang haa khata ama va hmung; capa lie ca Lawsena pyi sa kha ama pachie.
Zuoluo a vya cuo tiyta, Zingsuv ca ziytuv tie hne khata amaa vaw.
Cabya lie a tu yi te sa ama ning nguoluo ning kha, Zingsuv ta, “Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, niema chung taa pakha, kama hne sa a ning hnepa ta ina lyi'a ung ciy,” a ta yi.
Ziytuv tie ca ama ngie chi hringhruo te pakha hnang pakha ta ama kha, “Kama ta i cuo ma?” ta yi te ama hiehriy.
Zingsuv ta, “Niema hlyihning hrawlieta pakha, kama hne kuotung chunglie a viechuo a naw hnepa hing tana a cuo.
Cawsaa Sacapaa ca Caapathe lie a kaw aa capepa haa tana a si aa; cuorasala Cawsaa Sacapaa a lyituvpa ca bawchie ciemuopa tana a cuo! Capa paa ca puv li pata aw sala a cuota a pha vie aa,” a ta.
Sa ama ning nguoluo ning kha Zingsuv ta viechuo tluo kha kha la te, thlaa a chuo khutaata chechi te, ziytuv tie kha a pi yi. “A la ung la ning tie ung; i pangpa tana a cuo,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata panuo kha la te, palungtluona bie a hluo khutaata iema kha pi yi te, ama palang ta ama dang.
Ama ta, “Hingpa hing biekuona thiyse, cawsaa hluvpuv cuota i palangpa tana a cuo.
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, Khazing Pena chunglie mingsuvtiy thaapa i dang hluo li hing mingsuvtiy hing dang pakhaa'a va tli ang,” a ta.
Hlaa ama sa khutaata Olif tluo luo ama si.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta, “Nama bangkhuo hingta inaa ruose diy'a ung ciy, tahematapakieca Caapathe chunglieta, ‘Tuvkhietuv kha tuvsa'a angte, tuv zaw ca chepatlaa pata ama cuo aa,’ a ta.
Cuorasala pathu pakhaapa i cuo khutaata Galilee luo kha niema hmieluo ta i silu aa,” a ta.
Piter ta, “Iema bangkhuo ta acaa ruose zaw yi ta kama ca caa ruose buo hluo'a va ang,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta Piter kha, “Biehmisi tana ica chang, ataning, ata zuo hrahring, aa yi hning a khang hluota, yi thung ina thaw'a ciy,” a ta.
Cuorasala Piter ta a cusa pata, “Nama hne thiy riypa hmuo cuose angla ca thaw'a va ang,” a ta. Ama bangkhuo ta cahaacata ama ta ra.
Gethsemane ama tapa hmang luo kha vaa yi te, Zingsuv ta ziytuv tie kha, “Thlaa i chuo chung hing hingpa lie hing zaa tu tie ung,” a ta yi.
Piter, Jeim hne Johan kha aa chiyle yi, a nangping te a lalilahie a chiy.
Cakhutaata iema kha, “I ngie chi hringhruo te vuotaa i thiy'a nang, hingpa lie hing za aw ung la zaa hmung khya ung,” a ta yi.
A cawta va cakuo vie te alyi lie kha a bu te, a cuo khu kieca ruvnaana cuo chungtaata a law khuna riypata thlaa a chuo.
“Abba, I paa, na cuota ca khaapa bangkhuo a cuo khu diy. Hing panuo hing kama'a taata la tie; cuorasala kama khingna haata cuo li pata nama khingna haata cuo thluo se,” a ta.
Vya kaa te amaa zaa hmungpa kha a hmung yi ca; Piter kyihuo khata, “Simon, naa hmung ma? Siymaluo pakha chuo a hra khu va ca ma?
A hra ung la, pasupaliyna chung luo nama tla li riypata thlaachuo tie ung; pathiypalung ta ca a khing hmisi thluo, cuorasala saapa ca a thaazuo na a caw,” a ta.
Zingsuv ca vaa pakhaa te a ri ciepa kha ri pakhaa te thlaa a chuo pakhaa.
Cakhutaata a vya kaa ca amaa zaa hmungpa kha a hmung ngiethie yi; ama ming hetahmuo haw khu va yi, tuokhaatama ma chaw aa tapa zaw pachang va yi.
A yi thungnapa a vya kaa taata iema kha, “A hmung ung cate ma namaa pahy kalie thluo? Ade buo se! A cuo na a tling tli; Cawsaa Sacapaa ca a suepa tie kuv chung luo lyi pata a cuo tli.
Thu tie ung, cakuo'a ung puv. Mang tie ung, naa lyituv ca a vya chiy tli hing,” a ta.

Zingsuv ta bie a ri nguoluo ningta kha ziytuv hlyihning chunglie pakha ta a cuopa Judas kha tlangkhy a vya chiy. Ama hneta tluobyi lepa tie, phungbie saya tie hne uvthyi tie'a taata pathliepa, zueziy hne tungbung a cyipa cawsaazaapuv kha ama vya chiy ra.
A lyituvpa ca ta zaapuv kha pamangsana pi yi te: “I pahnuopa paa hingna nama patuv khingpa paa ta a cuo aa. Patuv ung la sikhyi tie ung,” a ta yi.
Judas ca a vya chiy tiyta, Zingsuv'a luo kha vaa paluo te, “Saya!” ta te a pahnuo.
Ca khu pahne ta Zingsuv ca patuv yi te ama cakhiy.
Cuorasala a thaalie a daapa tie chungtaata pakha ta a zueziy kha a phie te tluobyi lepa sii kha aa ce ca, a naakue kha a sa pathla.
Zingsuv ta iema kha, “Zueziy hne tungbung a vya cyi ung cate ma kama ca damie haata patuv riypata namaa vaw?
Ningting ta biena-ing chunglie niema hneta aw angte ica pacuv ning yi kha na patuv vade ung ciy. Cuorasala Caapathe bie ca tling thluo se,” a ta yi.
Ziytuv tie bangkhuo ca ama kha thuse yi te amaa ruo.
Satlie pakha, pawruo pang dyi a buvpa khata Zingsuv ca a ziyle.
Ama kha patuv amaa nang nakawta a pang kha thuse te a thliehripa ta aa ruo.
Zingsuv ca tluobyi le cepa ing luo kha a chiy yi te capa lie ca tluobyi lepa bangkhuo, uvthyi tie hne phungbie saya tie ca amaa zaa hmya.
Piter ta tluobyi lepa tlawhmie chung te khata aa hlapuo pata a ziy yi; rievetuv tie'a lie kha a tu te myi aa e ra.
Tluobyi lepa tie hne bieripatuv byi tie palang ta Zingsuv kha thie khu riypata a hanghiepa tehte kha ama huv; cuorasala suokha hmuo hmung khu va yi.
Tehte hluvpuv ta ama a du pata hangbie ama ri, cuorasala ama bie kha a saw vyi.
Cawsaa chekha a vya daa yi te ama a du pata hangbie ama ri.
“Cawsaa kuv ta sapa hingpa Biena-ing hing pacing diy'a angte ning thung chunglieta cawsaa kuv ta sa lipa biena-ing i sa pakhaa aa, a tapa na ma thyi,” ama ta.
Cuorasala capa lie ca hmuota ama bie a saw ngiethie vyi.
Cakhutaata tluobyi lepa ta iema hmiekunglie kha a daa te Zingsuv kha bie a hiehriy. “Palie riypa hnyi va ca ma? Hingpa tie ta sue aca phawpa yi hing khaapa bie tama a cuo?” a ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ca a dieta tah aw te palie vyi. Tluobyi lepa ta hiehriy pakhaa te, “Thluechiypa Khazing Sacapaa Messiah cata na cuo ma?” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “I cuo, ‘Cawsaa Sacapaa ca Cahrana cacuoluo kuo ta aa tupa kha hmung'a ung cate,' vuoruo amyi hneta aa zuvpa kha nama hmung aa,” a ta yi.
Tluobyi lepa ta a pang kha thlaa te, “Tehte hrangpa maa hu'a tli ma?
Khazing ripachiena bie a ripa ca nama thyi! Tuokhaatama nama rue?” a ta yi. Iema bangkhuo ta ama ca thiy tluo aa tla ta pata sue ama be.
Iema chunglie chekha ta Zingsuv kha ama paciy ta ama pacha, a ming kha pahruv yi te ama tuv. “Ahungma caa tuv, ri pachiy tie,” ama ta. Rievetuv tie zaw ta sikhyi yi te ama tuvpuole.
Piter ca tlawhmie lie a aw nguoluopa khata tluobyi lepa changtaanung pakha ta athaa luo kha aa vaw.
Piter myi aa e nguoluopa kha a hmung tiyta, ama kha mangpuo te, “Nama zaw hing Nazareth khypa Zingsuv hne a zaa aw pakhawpa tana na cuo,” a ta.
Cuorasala Piter ta a sie te, “Khaapama na ri tapa pachang va ang,” a ta. Cakhutaata a hmiedaw luo kha a pya. Ca khu pahne ta aa a khang.
Changtaanung ca ta capa lie ca hmung te aa thaalie a daapa tie kyihuo khata, “Hingpa paa hing iema chungtaata pakha tana a cuo,” a ta pakhaa.
Cuorasala Piter ta aa sie pakhaa. A cawta a aw pata aa thaalie a daapa tie ta, “Iema hraw taata pakha tana na cuo hrahring, tahematapakieca Galilee ming tana na cuo,” ama ta.
Cuorasala chie a sa te bie aa kuo khutaata, “A kaw nama ri nguoluopa paa hing pachang va ang,” a ta yi.
Capa cuo lie ca a yihningnapa aa a khang. Peter ca Zingsuv ta, “Aa yi hning a khang hluota yi thung ina thaw'a ciy,” a tapa bie kha aa thyi pakhaa. Cakhutaata khuopuv ta a caa.
Mawdiychie ta tluobyi lepa tie ca uvthyi tie, phungbie saya tie hne bieripatuv phuv tie hne khata a hmya yi te khue ama khuo. Zingsuv ca cakhiy yi te, a dale yi te Pilat kuv luo kha ama pi.
Pilat ta, “Judah ming siepahruo ta na cuo ma?” a ta. Zingsuv ta, “Na ripa haata i cuo,” a ta.
Tluobyi lepa tie ta Zingsuv kha sue a hluvsa ama phaw.
Pilat ta, “Palie riypa hnyi va ca ma? Kha tluv tama sue aca phaw yi tapa hing mang tie,” a ta pakhaa.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta a palie ngiethie li nakawta Pilat ca a nang ta a uo.
Lawsena pyi kyry ta Pilat ta thaw a tlapa tie chungtaata zaapuv ta ama hiepa pakha kha a pathliepa taw yi.
Capa cuo ning ca Barabbas ama tapa, rie thu ningta cawsaa zaa thiepa paa ca rie a thu rapa a hrangpa tie hne khata thaw ama tla.
Caacuonakawta cawsaazaapuv ca a vya hmya yi te Pilat kha iema cuota a tue tawpa haata tue riypata amaa hie.
Pilat ta, “Judah siepahruo hing ca pathliepa yi ang sala nama khing ma? a ta yi.
Tluobyi lepa tie ta a kuv chung luo Zingsuv ama vya pipa hing i-aw ama hnyi nakaw tana a cuo tapa kha Pilat ta a phasa pata a pachang.
Cuorasala tluobyi lepa tie khata cawsaazaapuv kha Barabbas kha pathliepa hriy riypata Pilat'a luo hie riypa kha ama pasu.
Pilat ta cawsaazaapuv kha, “Caacuokieca Judah siepahruo nama tapa paa hing tuokhaata tue se tapa ma ina khing ung ciy?” a ta.
Iema ta, “Vieluo lie thie tie!” ta pata khuopuv ta ama khi.
Pilat ta, “Khaapanakawma? Khaapa suena ma a tue?” a ta yi. Cuorasala, “Vieluo lie thie tie!” ta pata khuo vie ta ama khi.
Pilat ta cawsaazaapuv palung kha a patling khing nakawta Barabbas kha a pathliepa yi. Zingsuv ca sungpe ta a chi khutaata vieluo lie thie riypata a pi yi.
Rieka tie ta Zingsuv ca muokiy byipa tlawhmie luo kha a ngiekhyi yi te, (uvtuv byi zung lepa) ama riekaphuv viesaa bangkhuo kha ama u ra.
Zingsuv ca pang sepa kha ama pabuv; ahling ta byilakhuv kha phie yi te a luv lie ama pakhuv.
Saluo pi yi te, “Judah siepahruo ca a hringtaa pasiy se!” ama ta.
Asung ta a luv lie kha chi yi te, ama paciy ta ama pacha, a hmiekunglie ama pakhuv pane yi te amaa bie.
Ama tue hyalya khutaata a pang sepa kha hlepa yi te ama a caw kha ama pahryi pakhaa. Cakhutaata vieluo lie thie riypata ama pyakhyi.
Khyta taata khypuv luo a vaw te amaa thaalie a vya cakuolepa, Sairin khy ming, Alekzandar hne Rufas paa, Simon kha Zingsuv vieluotung ca hripuo yi te ama papuv sa.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ca Golgotha ama tapa hmang luo kha ama phakhyi (Golgotha a siyluo ca luvruv hmang tanapa tana a cuo).
Capa hmang lie ca mura hne ama pyapa mingsuvtiy kha ama pi; cuorasala dang khing vyi.
Cakhutaata ama ca vieluo lie kha thie yi te, a caw kha vyisung a da yi te amaa re.
Vieluo lie ama thiena cuo ca maw siymaluo pacaky cuo lieta a cuo.
Zingsuv sue ama phawnapa caa ca, “Judah Siepahruo,” ta pata a cuo.
Damie tie pahning kha a cacuoluo kuo ta pakha, a cavyiluo kuo ta pakha vieluo lie ama taa ra.
(Cahaacata Caapathe ta, “A suepa zaw hrawlie ripuopa ta a cuo,” a tapa ca a tling.)
A hmungpaapa tie khata ama ama luv tisue yi te, ama bieke ta, “Biena-ing kha pacing diy'a angte ning thung chung ta i sa pakhaa diy aa a tapa,
nama hne nama kha a khuo la vieluo cung taa khata za cung tie nie!” ama ta.
Cahaacata tluobyi lepa tie hne phungbie saya tie zaw ta Zingsuv kha tue hyalya yi te, “Malie ca a khuo yi, ama hne ama ca a khuo khu vyi.
Israel ming Siepahruo ca ata hingta vieluo cung taata za cung sala muo, hmung'a pate ma zang'a ta,” ama ta. Vieluo lie ama taa rapa pahning tie zaw khata ama kha ama tue hyalya ra.
Ningchung khingkhuo taata zuoluo siymaluo pathung te alyicung yalya lie zingna a tlung.
Zuoluo siymaluo pathung lie kha Zingsuv ca, “Eloi, Eloi, lema sabakthani?” ta pata khuopuv ta a khi. A siyluo ca, “I Khazing, i Khazing, khaapanakawma ina thaw ciy,” tana ta a cuo.
A thaalie a daapa chekha ta thyi yi te, “Naathlie tie ung, Elijah na a u,” ama ta.

Cawsaa pakha ca vaa ruo te pangcaw kha mingsuvtiy thuepa lie a naw khutaata, aarasung daw lie kha ciypuo te Zingsuv kha dang riypata a pi. “Huo pachiy ung, ama kha vieluo cung taata pachung riypata Elijah ca a vaw'a ma tapa kha mang'a ung puv,” a ta.
Zingsuv ca khuopuv ta khi te a huv a ci.
Biena-ing pangzu ca a luv taata a lie te che hning ta aa che.
A hmiepachaw pata a daapa riebyipa ta Zingsuv a thiynazya kha a hmung tiyta, “Hingpa paa hing Khazing Sacapaa hmisi tana a cuo,” a ta.
Capa lie ca luohlaa taata a suopa canung chekha zaw ama aw. Iema hrawlie ca Mary Magdalin, Jeim a syi viepa hne Joses ama nung Mary, hne Salome zaw ama aw ra.
Zingsuv Galilee lie a aw ning kha za ziy yi te zaa mangsang tawpa ta ama cuo. Jerusalem taata a khawpa a hrangpa canung a hluvpuv zaw capa lie ca ama aw ra.
Sabbath hluopa ning, Atingdawna ning zuoluo a vya chiy tiyta,
bieripatuv uvthyi zaw hrawlieta ama pa-uvsathyipa pakha, Khazing pena a tlung riypa a huo nguoluopa, Arimathea khypa Josef ca riephasa pata Pilat'a luo kha vaa te Zingsuv riyy kha a hie.
Pilat ca Zingsuv a thiy tli tapa kha a thyi tiyta khuopuv ta a kharue haa te, riebyipa kha u te a thiyna taata a pasiy tli ma ta pata a hiehriy.
Riebyipa'a taata a thiy tli tapa bie a thyi khutaata Josef kha a riyy ca a pi.
Josef ta pawruo pang zung kha calyi te a riyy kha pachung te a pahlaw khutaata alung ama ryipa thluo chunglie kha a paby. Cakhutaata lungkhaakhuv ta thluokhuepakaa ca a khaa siy pakhaa.
Mary Magdalin hne Joses nung Mary ta ama pabyna hmang kha ama hmung.
Sabbath ning a chuo khutaata, Mary Magdalin, Jeim nung Mary hne Salome ca Zingsuv riyy thuv riypata ziyhmyi kha ama calyi.
Ningzaa zaa kha a ning khanapa mawdiy ta thluo luo kha ama vaa.
Luopuv lieta pakha hne pakha kha, “Thluo khaakhuvlung kha ahungma malie a hnyipa aa?” amaa ta.
Ama mang ca thluo khaakhuvlung a lesapa ca a zaa hnyi tlipa kha ama hmung.
Thluo chung luo ama vaa ngie ca pang ruopa a buvpa satlie pakha cacuoluo kuo ta aa tupa kha hmung yi te amaa pahlusa.

Cuorasala ama ta, “Nama thlaa zang khah se; vieluo lie ama thiepa Nazareth khypa Zingsuv na nama huv cuo va ma? Ama ca a thu pakhaa tli; hingpa lie hing aw va tli. Ama ama pahlaanapa hmang hing mang tie ung.
Cakuo ung la ziytuv tie hne Piter kha, ama ca aca changlupa haa yi khata nama hmie luo tana Galilee luo a silu tli, capa lie ca na nama va hmung aa, ta pata va chang tie ung” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta pya yi te thluo taa khata amaa ruo, ciysa yi te ama nang dyi a uo nakawta ahunghmuota khaapahmuo chang va yi.
(Zaa kha lie a ning khanapa ning mawdiy ta a thu pakhaa khutaata Zingsuv ca khuevuo pasariy a papyanapa nung, Mary Magdalin'a lie kha aa luo taa.
Mary Magdalin ca vaa te ama hne zaa aw hnepa tie kha ama ngiechisa pata ama caa nguoluo ning kha a va chang yi.
Cuorasala Zingsuv a hringna kaw hne capa nung ta a hmungna kaw kha ama thyi tiyta zang va yi.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ca ziytuv tie pahning khyta luo ama tlawna lie kha a phang hrang ta aa luo.
Kaa yi te a hrangpa tie kha ama chang, cuorasala zang va yi.

Cakhutaata Zingsuv ca ziytuv hlyikha tie cabya lie amaa tu nguoluopa khata a luo te, zangna ama hnyi lina kaw hne ama palung a le tuvna kawlie kha a mawchie yi, tahematapakieca iema ta a thu pakhaa khutaata a hmungpa tie kha zang va yi.
Cakhutaata ziytuv tie kyihuo khata, “Chuelyicung yalya luo kha si ung la sapa bangkhuo kha thuophaa va chang tie ung.
Zang te tiy a nawpa ca khuo pata a cuo aa, a zang lipa ca suebieripana a ang aa.
A zangpa tie ca hingpa pamangsana hmang hing ama tue khu aa: i ming ta khuevuo ama papya aa; ryi thaapa kha ama cyi aa;
ama kuv ta pariy kha patuv'a yi te, thiysiyy ama dang zaw ta capa ca ta ruvnaana pi'a va yi; a pasapa cunglie ama kuv khang'a yi te ama tluo aa,” a ta yi.
Abyipa Zingsuv ca iema'a lie bie a ri khutaata vuoruo luo kha calang pata cuo te Khazing cacuoluo kuo ta aa tu.
Ziytuv tie ca ruo ting luo kha si yi te thuophaa kha ama phu; Abyipa ta iema'a lie kha re hrie te, ama phung ripa kha pamangsana hmang ta a pacu sale.)
Cawsaa hluvpuv ta kiema hrawlieta a zaa cuopa hmang kaw kha a pha ce pata cape a maa zaa zue.
A hruothu ningta ming ta zaa hmungpa tie malie ama changpa hne hing bie zaa phutuv tie ta kiema malie ama changpa haata ama cape.
Kama zaw ta hmang bangkhuo hing a hruothu taata a phasa pata i khieluo diy khutaata,

vya abyipa Theofilas, aca chang ciepa yi hne aa patuv pata hmang dangpa bangkhuo kha a tlingsa pata hne aa hmuosa pata na pachang riypata, hingpa caa hing na cuota suokha hnang suokha, aa paziy pata cape ra riypata bie i chi.
Herod kha Judea ruo lie siepahruo a cuo ningta, Abijah tluobyi phang a cuo rapa tluobyi Zekhariah a za aw. A napuvnung ca Aaron ciypathla ta cuo te a ming ca Elizabeth ta a cuo.
Ama pahning ta Khazing minghmungna lie aa dangpa cuo yi te Abyipa phungbie hne nawpipa bangkhuo chunglie risie riypa aw li pata ama hring.
Cuorasala saata hnyi khu va yi, tahematapakieca Elizabeth ca cing te, ama pahning ta ama nungpuv ama macuo mangtli.
Luo kha ca a re hrie cuo pha te Khazing hmiekunglie tluobyi re a hrie nguoluo ning kha,
Abyipa hmangpathepa chung luo a ngie pata, bienatluophie cunglie rangpa-ue rue riypata tluobyi tie ama ziyphung haata vyisung a da yi te ama kha amaa tlaw.
Rangpa-ue rue cuo ning ca cawsaa bangkhuo ca ale lie a daa yi te thlaa ama chuo nguoluo.
Cakhutaata, ama'a luo kha Abyipa avuoming pakha zaa luo te rangpa-ue ruenapa cacuoluo kuo khata aa daa.
Zekhariah ta a hmung ca a thlaa zangsa te a ciy hringhruo.
Cuorasala avuoming khata, “Ciy khah, Zekhariah! Na thlaachuona ca thyipa pata na cuo tli. Na napuvnung Elizabeth ta sacapaa ca sapa'a te ama kha Johan ta pata ming na sa aa.
Palungtluona hne alawna hnyi'a ung cate, ama puvna kawlie hingta cawsaa hluvpuv ama palung a tluo aa.
Tahematapakieca ama ca Abyipa hmungna lie cawsaa lepa a cuo aa. Mingsuvtiy cuose, sahmaa hne zuvre cuose, dang'a vyi; a za puv hluo taata Thlaapa Pathe ta a bi aa.
Israel ming hluvpuv kha ama Byipaapa ama Khazing'a luo a vya kaakhyi'a yi.

Ama ca Profet Elijah haata a cahrapa hne hmang a tue khupa ta a cuo aa. Nungpaa zaw pathiypalung kha saata zaw'a luo maa riypa cuose, ri a ngie lipa tie kha cawsaa phapa tie ruena pahnyi sa pakhaa riypa hne, Abyipa cawsaa zaw kha a cuota ting pacie pata chi riypata, Elijah thlaapa hne cahrana ta bi'a te Abyipa hmieluo ta a silu aa,” a ta.
Zekhariah ta avuoming kha, “Na ripa haata a cuo aa tapa kha tuokhaatama i pachang aa? Kama hing macuo tli angte i napuvnung zaw a nungpuvsa tli,” a ta.
Avuoming ta, “Kama hing Gabriel tana i cuo. Khazing hmiekunglie a daapa ta cuo angte, nama'a lie bie ri riypa hne hingpa thuophaa hing chang riypata pathliepa tana i cuo.
Cuorasala a ning hne a cuo a pha thueta a vya tling riypa i bie na zang li nakaw hingta, capa hmang a vya tlingna te, na ueryi chiy li pata, bie ri khu'a vaciy,” a ta.
Capa chung bangkhuo ca cawsaa ta Zekhariah kha huo yi te, hmangpathepa chunglie cacuo nanaa a rupa kha ama kharue a haa.
A kya pya tiyta iema kha chaw va tli yi, caacuonakawta hmangpathepa chungliena muocuo suokhakha a hmung tapa kha ama pachang. Iema'a lie kha a kuv a phyi dyi ta paluo sa te bie ri khu vyi.
A re hrie riypa a chuo taata ing luo kha a cakuo.
Cakhutaata a napuvnung Elizabeth ca nu phya te thla pangaa chung ale luo pya li pata a aw.
Elizabeth ta, “Abyipa ta i cuo ta a tuepa ca hingpa hing tana a cuo, tlechuona hne na za mang te i cawsaa zaw hrawlie nangzaana i za angpa kha ina lapa tli,” a ta.
A thla caruvnapa chunglie kha Khazing ta avuoming Gabriel ca Galilee ruo Nazareth khy lie a awpa,
David ciypathla Josef hneta a chiyhie riypata biekuona a hnyi tlipa lesaa pathenung Mary'a luo kha a pathlie.
Avuoming ca ama'a luo kha a vaw te, “Abyipa hmiephaa a hmung nung! Na cunglie thluechiy aw mang sue. Abyipa ca nama'a liena a aw” a ta.
Mary ca avuoming bie khata khuopuv ta a palung patawpamuo te hing bie-achangna hing tuokhaapa bie-achangna tama a cuo ta pata a siyluo kha nang-uosa pata a rue.
Avuoming ta, “Mary, Ciy khah, tahematapakieca Khazing na hmiephaa caa pi.
Nu phya'a cate, sacapaa hnyi'a cate a ming ca Zingsuv ta pata na sa aa.
Ama ca cawsaa lesyipa cuo'a te, Cungnungce Sacapaa ama ta aa. Abyipa Khazing ta a mingpa David byithude kha a pi aa.
Jakob ciypathla zaw cunglie kha chuozaa ta siepahruo cuo'a te, a pena ca chuo buo'a vyi,” a ta.
Mary ta avuoming kha, “Kama ca lesaa pathenung tana i cuo, tuokhaatama cahaacata a cuo the aa?” a ta.

Avuoming ta, “Thlaapa Pathe ca na cunglie za aw'a te, Cungnungce cahrana ta nama kha ningdiy haata aca buv aa. Caacuonakawta zaa puvpa sacapaa ca a pathepa ta cuo'a te, Khazing Sacapaa ta pata kupa a cuo aa.
Ata zaw hing nama tieriy ta a cuopa, a cing nung ama tapa Elizabeth ca a nungpuv tli pata sacapaa kha phya te thla caruv a ta tli.
Tahematapakieca Khazing ta a tue khu lipa khaapahmuo aw vyi,” a ta.
Mary ta, “Kama ca Khazing changtaanung tana i cuo, na ripa haata i cunglie tlung thluo se,” a ta. Cakhutaata avuoming ta a thuse.
Capa chung ca ta Mary ca a tha te tluocung ruo lie a awpa Judah ming khy khy kha luo kha a pahraasa pata a si.
Zekhariah ing luo kha a ngie te Elizabeth kha bie aa chang.
Mary ta Elizabeth bie aa changpa kha Elizabeth ta a thyi tiyta a riy chunglie a awpa nu ca aa cathlu. Elizabeth ca Thlaapa Pathe ta bi te, khuopuv ta u te,
“Nama ca canung bangkhuo hrawlie thluechiy ce nung tana na cuo, na hnyi riypa haatiy zaw hing thluechiypa tana a cuo.
Khaapanakawma hingpa hmang hing i cunglie tlung te, i Byipaapa a nung ta ina vya parie?
Nama bie inaa changpa i thyi pahne ta i chunglie nu ca palungtluona hne aa cathlu.
Abyipa ta ama'a luo a changpa bie ca a cunglie a tling hrahring aa ta pata a zang nung ca kha tluv ta thluechiypa tama a cuo!” a ta.
Cakhutaata Mary ta, “I pathiypalung ta Abyipa a pathuosa;
i hringna ca naa Khuotuv Khazing cunglie aa law,
ri tluo lipa a changtaanung hing, ama ta inaa thyi pari. Ataning taa hingta chuo bangkhuo ta thluechiynung ina ta'a yi,
Cungnungce Khazing ta i cunglie hmanglepuv a tue mangtli. A ming ca a pathe;
Chuo kha hnang chuo kha ta ama a ciyzaapa tie cunglie, a nangduena a paluo sa.
Ama ta a buo kha pazuo te a hruo a tlepa tie kha ama khuekhuona hne a chepatlaa diy yi.
A cahrasapa siepahruo tie kha ama byithude taata pacung yi te, nutaapa tie kha a calang yi;
ama nang a diypa tie kha hmang phapa ta ama riy pabi yi te, a hnyirungpa tie kha kuv cahri pata a padiy sa yi.
A nangduena a thyi pakhaana ta, a changtaapa Israel kha aa bya tli,
mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie hne Abraham'a lie hne a ciypathla tie cunglie chuozaa cuota bie aa kuopa haata,” a ta.
Mary ca Elizabeth'a lie kha thla thung tluv a aw khutaata a ing luo a kaa.
Elizabeth ca a ningthlaa vya tling te sacapaa a sa.
Abyipa na nangduena lesapa a pahmung sa tapa kha a ingpaa hne a tieriy zaw ta ama thyi tiyta ama palung a tluokhyi hringhruo.
A ning carinapa lieta haatiy kha vangdaw te riypata a vawkhyi yi te, a paa ming la pata, Zekhariah ta pata ming paphya amaa ting.
Cuorasala a nung ta, “Cuo vyi, ama ca Johan ta pata kupa tana a cuo aa,” a ta.
Iema ta, “Niema phang chunglie cahaapaapa ming a phyapa pakha hmuo aw va ung ciy,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata a paa kha ama kuv ta pahmungsana tue yi te, haatiy ming tuokhaatama a paphya khing tapa kha ama hiehriy.
Zekhariah ta caahnaa kha a hie yi te, “A ming ca Johan tana a cuo,” ta pata a cape. Ama bangkhuo ta ama kharue a haasa.
Ca khu pahne ta Zekhariah ca bie ri khu pakhaa te Khazing kha a pathuosa.
Ama ingpaa zaw ca ama thlaa zangsa te, capa chiycuona bangkhuo ca Judea pe tluocung ruo bangkhuo kha a pathuo.
Capa thuo a thyipa bangkhuo ta pacuo syalya yi te, “Hingpa haatiypa hing khaapama a vya lu syalya aa?” ama ta. Tahematapakieca Abyipa cahrana ca a cunglie a aw hmisi.
Cakhutaata a paa Zekhariah ca Thlaapa Pathe ta bi te hingpa profetbiephu hing a ri:
“Israel Khazing, Abyipa cunglie thluechiy aw mang sue, tahematapakieca a cawsaa zaw kha tlechuona hne mang yi te a khuo yi.
Ma cuota a cahrapa Khuotuv kha, a changtaapa David ciypathla chungtaata a padaa tli.
Hluo ning a pathepa profet tie palyipakaa taata bie a za ripa haata
ma carie tie hne malie a huepa tie kuv chungtaata khuo pata ma cuo aa.
Cahaacata ma mingchingmingvuo tie kha nangduena ta bie kuo yi te, a pathepa a biekuona kha aa thyi.
Kiema pi riypata Mingpa Abraham'a lie bie aa kuopa ca,
ma carie tie kuv taata khuo pata a cuopa kiema ta ciyna hnyi li pata
pathena hne adangna ta a hmiekunglie chuozaa ta a re ma hrie riypa khata a cuo.
I saa, nama ca Cungnungce profet ta pata kupa na cuo aa; tahematapakieca a luo zaw kha sa pacie riypata Abyipa hmieluo ta si'a cate,
a cawsaa zaw kha ama suena a ngiethe pata khuona kaw a pachang sa riypata na cuo aa.
Ma Khazing nangne nangduena thueta, cungluo taata mawdiy ningkhepa ma cunglie za cung'a te,
zingna chunglie a tupa tie hne thiyna ningdiy rawlie a awpa tie kha, khena pi riypata a cuo aa. Kiema kha diena luopuv luo malie aa chiy aa,” a ta.
Haatiy ca lethaw te thlaapa lie a cahra, Israel ming'a lie zaapuv hmung pata aa luo hluo li ruocaapa lie kha a aw.
Capa cuo ning ca Siepahruo Awkastas ta Rom uvna ruo chung bangkhuo lie cawsaa mingluv ri riypata naw a papya.
Capa mingluv rina ca a yikhanapa mingluv rina ta cuo te Kuirinias kha Siria ruo uvtuv a cuo ningta a cuo.
Cawsaa bangkhuo ca mingluv rina lie ming khung riypata ama khy cyicuo luo kha ama si.
Josef zaw Galilee pe Nazareth khy taata Siepahruo David khypuv, Judea pe Bethlehem khy luo kha a si. Tahematapakieca ama ca David ciypathla ta a cuo nakawta a cuo.
A pahaa ciepa hne nu hnyi riypata a mangkhuo nguoluopa Mary hne khata mingluv rina lie ming khung riypata ama si.
Bethlehem lie ama aw ning khata nu aw tiy a ta.
Sahrangta, sacapaata ca sa te pang ta a pahlaw khutaata cue hraky chunglie kha a pazie, tahematapakieca khyche banglaa lie kha iema cuota hmang aw va tli.
Capa hrawlie ca, ruo chunglie kha zuo ta ama tuvrung mangchiy yi te ruo lie a ripa tuvkhietuv tie ama aw.
Abyipa avuoming pakha iema'a lie kha a luo te, Abyipa rungnaana ca ama cahriylie a za khe nakawta ama ciy hringhruo.
Cuorasala avuoming ta iema kha, “Ciy khah ung; cawsaa bangkhuo cuota palungtluona lepuv a cuopa thuophaa na ica za phya yi:
Ataning hing David khy chunglie niema caa khuotuv Abyipa Messiah ca a puv tli!
Hingpa hing niema cuota pamangsana ta a cuo aa: Haaseta pakha ca pang ta pahlaw'a yi te cue hraky chunglie ama paziepa kha nama hmung aa,” a ta.
Sungkhabala ta vuoruo riekaphuv lepuv ca avuoming hneta zaa luo yi te Khazing kha hlaa ta ama pathuosa.
“Aa suo cepa vuoruo lie khiy Khazing ca pathuosa pata cuo mang sue; A duepa zaw awnapa alyi lie hing thlaalungna aw mang sue!” ama ta.

Avuoming ta thuse yi te vuoruo luo ama kaa tiyta, tuvkhietuv tie ca pakha hne pakha kha, “Bethlehem luo kha vaa ung sala, hing a cuo nguoluopa hmang, Abyipa ta malie a changpa hing va mang'a ung puv,” amaa ta.
Caacuonakawta si pahraa yi te Mary hne Josef hne cue hraky lie ama pathlingpa haaseta kha ama va hmung.
Ama hmung tiyta, haaseta kaw avuoming ta a ripa kha iema ca ama chang.
Tuvkhietuv tie ta ama ripa a thyipa bangkhuo ca ama kharue a haasa.
Cuorasala Mary ca capa bie bangkhuo kha a palung chunglie khung te a rue syalya pari.
Tuvkhietuv tie ca kaa yi te, avuoming ta ama changpa dala haata ama hmungpa hne ama thyipa kawlie kha Khazing ca ama pathuosa.
Ning cari khutaata, haaseta vangdaw te tiy a ta ning kha, a nung ta a phya hluo taata avuoming ta ama za ri ciepa ming, Zingsuv tapa kha ama paphya.
Moses phungbie haata a pathesana cuo kha a vya tling tiyta, haatiypa ca Abyipa hmiekung luo chiykhyi riypata Jerusalem luo kha ama sikhyi.
(Abyipa phungbie caa-uv chunglie, “Nama sahrang, capaasaata bangkhuo kha Abyipa'a luo na nama pi aa”), ta pata aa cape.
Abyipa phungbie lie a ripa haata, thuvruv sahning acuolikie valale sahning ta hriykhung a rina tue riypata ama sipa ta a cuo.

Khapa cuo ning kha cawsaa pakha, a ming Simeon ama tapa kha Jerusalem khy lie a za aw. Ama ca cawsaa aa dangpa, Khazing a ciyzaapa, Israel ming khuona hmung riypa cuo kha a huo nguoluopa cuo te, Thlaapa Pathe ta a awpuopa ta a cuo.
Thlaapa Pathe ta Abyipa Messiah na hmung hluo li thiy'a vaciy a ta.
Thlaapa ta a chiy te Simeon ca Biena-ing chung luo kha aa ngie. Phungbie haata tuepa riypata a nung hne a paa ta Zingsuv kha Biena-ing luo amaa ngiekhyi ca,
Simeon ta haatiypa ca a paw te Khazing kha a pathuosa,
“Abyipa, ataning hing na changtaapa ca na biekuona haata, hnaanguota tah i hringna na pakhung sa tli,
tahematapakieca i ming ta na khuona kha i hmung tli.
Mingphang bangkhuo hmiekunglie na tingtuopa khuona ca,
Jentail ming bangkhuo cuota na khingna a paluosatuv khena hne na cawsaa Israel ming rungnaana a phyatuv tana a cuo,” a ta.
A nung hne a paa ca haatiypa kaw a ripa kha ama thyi tiyta ama kharue a haa hringhruo.

Cakhutaata Simeon ta thluechiy pi yi te a nung Mary kyihuo khata, “Hingpa haatiypa hing Israel ming chunglie a hluvpuv a maa liena riypa hne ama thuna riypata Khazing ta lieriy a uopuopa tana a cuo. Ama ca Khazing'a taata a zuvpa pahmungsana hne
cawsaa hluvpuv ta ama palung chunglie ama ruepa aa luona riypata a cuo aa, cakhutaata zueziy ta na palung kha aca daw aa,” a ta.
Capa ning ca Asher phang Fanuel sacanung, profet nung Anna zaw kha a za aw ra. Ama ca nungpuvsa tli te, a navaapa hne amaa hlaw khutaata kung sariy chung dyi khy za sahne yi te,
kung sawcari kung paliy te a nunghlyi pata a cuo. Biena-ing kha thuse buo li pata chung hne zuo ta Khazing kha abie te sa uv te thlaa a chuo.
Capa cuota ning caci cata vya chiy te, Khazing kha pathuosa te Khazing ta Jerusalem aa thla riypa a huopa tie bangkhuo'a lie kha haatiypa kaw ca a ri.
Abyipa phungbie ta tue riypa a tapa bangkhuo kha ama patlung khutaata Galilee pe, ama khy Nazareth luo kha ama kaa.
Haatiy ca kya lethaw te a kya cahra; singna hne bi te Khazing'a taata hmiephaa a hmung.
A nung hne a paa ca kung tating ta Lawsena Pyi ning kha Jerusalem luo ama tlaw taw.
Zingsuv kung hraa hlyihning a ta ning kha ama tue tawpa haata pyi luo ca ama tlaw pakhaa.
Pyi kha chuo te ing luo ama kaa tiyta, haatiypa Zingsuv ca Jerusalem lie a ngaa siy te a nung hne a paa ta pachang va yi.
Zaapuv hrawlie na a kya si rale ta pata ama rue nakawta ning kha chung ama kya si. Cakhutaa dyi cata ama tieriy hne ama viesaa hrawlie kha ama huv.
Ama hmung li taata ama kha huv riypata Jerusalem luo ama kaa.
Ning thung khutaata Biena-ing chunglie ama hmung. Pacuvtuv tie hrawlie kha a tu te ama bie kha naathlie te bie zaw a za hiehriy nguoluo yi.
A bie a thyipa bangkhuo ca a singzya hne bie a paliezya yi kha ama nang ta a uosa.
A nung hne a paa ca ama hmung tiyta ama nang ta uosa te, a nung ta, “I saa, khaapanakawma hing haa hingta malie na tue? Mang tie, na paa hne kama ca ma palung rie thyisa pata muo maca huv ta,” a ta.
Ama ta iema kyihuo khata, “Khaapanakawma ina huv ung ciy? I Paa ing lie ca i aw riypata a cuopa kha pachang va ung ca ma?” a ta yi.
Cuorasala khaapama a ri tapa kha pachang va yi.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ca iema hne khata Nazareth luo za kaa te ama ri a ngiesa pata a aw. A nung ca hing hmang bangkhuo hing a palung chunglie a pari diy.
Zingsuv ca singna hne lethawle te Khazing hne cawsaa hmielie kha hmiephaa a hmung.

Rom Siepahruo Tiberius ta ruo a uvnapa kung hraa hlyipangaa a ta ning kha Pontius Pilat ca Judea ruo muokiy byi ta a cuo, Herod ca Galilee ruo uvtuv cuo te a nuta Filip ca Iturea hne Trakhonitis pe uvtuv ta a cuo; Lisanias ca Abilen uvtuv ta cuo te
Annas hne Kaiafas ca tluobyi lepa ta ama cuo. Capa cuo ning ca ruocaapa lie a awpa, Zekhariah sacapaa Johan'a luo kha Khazing bie aa vaw.
Ama ca Jordan cavaa kiecahriy ruo bangkhuo khata tlaw te, sue angiethena cuota a ngiepachiy pata tiy a naw riypa kha
profet Isaiah caa-uv chunglie a zaa capepa haa khata a ukhyi, “Cawsaa pakha ca ruocaapa lie kha u te: ‘Abyipa luopuv kha sapa tie ung, a luopuv ca padang tie ung,
Huekaw mekaa ca pabi pata cuo'a te, tluo hne tluothlue mekaa ca pacing pata a cuo aa. Luo aa kyipa kha padang pata cuo'a te, a bu hliehluvpa luo zaw kha pame pata a cuo aa.
Cawsaa bangkhuo ta Abyipa khuona ca hmung yi se’” a ta.
Tiy a naw riypata ama'a luo a vawpa cawsaazaapuv tie kha Johan ta, “Pariy ciypathla zaw! A vya tlung riypa Khazing hihaana chungtaata a ruo riypata ahung ma a raaringna caa pi yi?

Sue a ngiepachiyna hne aa phuvpa hringzya kha hnyi tie ung. Niema hne niema kha, ‘Abraham samingsahlaa tana ma cuo a ta khah ung'; ica chang yi, Khazing ca hingpa alung taa hingta Abraham samingsahlaa zaw kha a sa khu yi.
Ahryi ca thingkung thabaw lie pahlaa pacie pata cuo te thyiphaa a pathyi lipa thingkung bangkhuo ca hu pata myi chung luo thaw pata ama cuo aa,” a ta.
Cawsaazaapuv ta, “Caacuokieca khaapama ma tue aa?” ama ta.
Iema kha palie yi te, “Buohryicungle zung hning a hnyipa ta a hnyi lipa kha pibuo se, sa a hnyipa zaw ta cahaacata tue se,” a ta.
Ngukhyituv tie zaw kha tiy a naw riypata a vaw yi te, “Saya, khaapama ma tue aa?” ama ta.
Ama ta, “Khyi riypa tapa laata a hluv vie ta khyi khah ung,” a ta yi.
