Rieka tie zaw ta, “Kiema haw khaapama ma tue aa?” ama ta ra. Ama ta, “Ahung'a taata hmuo aa hmuo li pata hne pachiypahuo pata hruohra ta tuokaa hie khah ung. Nama rehrie muo lie kha nama palung tling se,” a ta yi.
Cawsaa ca aruechuona hne bi yi te, Johan hing Messiah cata a cuo'a ma ta yi te ama pacuo syalya.

Johan ta iema kha, “Kama ca tiy ta tiynawna ica pi yi, cuorasala kama laata a cahra viepa pakha a vaw nguoluo te kama ca a phyipakaw riy pathluo riypata hmuo a tla va ang. Ama ta niema kha Thlaapa Pathe hne myi ta tiy aca naw'a yi.
Ama ta a suo-aciyna pathe riypa hne sahang kha be luo raw riypata suo zinapa pahraa kha a kuv lie aa cyi; cuorasala a siypa ca a thiy buo lipa myi chunglie kha a rue aa,” a ta.
Johan ca cawsaa kha a phangphang ta pasu yi te, thuophaa a chang yi.
Cuorasala a nuta napuvnung Herodias kawlie hne a hrangpa hmang pha lipa a hluvsa a tuena kawlieta a chuopa uvtuv Herod ta
a zya chiepa kha chachiy hryly te Johan ca thaw a pathla.
Cawsaa bangkhuo kha tiy a maa naw, Zingsuv zaw kha tiy naw te thlaa a chuo nguoluo pata vuoruo ca a pahaw te,
Thlaapa Pathe ca thuvruv haa khata za cung te a cunglie kha a zaa cang. Cakhutaata vuoruo taata ueryi paring te, “Nama ca i Duepa i Sacapaa tana na cuo. Na cunglie i palung a tluo,” a ta.
Zingsuv ca re hrie a pathu ning kha kung sawthung hraw a cuo. Ama ca Heli sacapaa Josef sacapaa ta a cuo (a cuo ta pata ama zangpa haata).
Heli ca Matthat sacapaa ta a cuo, Matthat ca Levi sacapaa ta a cuo, Levi ca Melkhi sacapaa ta a cuo, Melkhi ca Jannai sacapaa ta a cuo, Jannai ca Josef sacapaa ta a cuo,
Josef ca Mattathias sacapaa ta a cuo, Mattathias ca Amos sacapaa ta a cuo, Amos ca Nahum sacapaa ta a cuo, Nahum ca Esli sacapaa ta a cuo, Esli ca Naggai sacapaa ta a cuo,
Naggai ca Maath sacapaa ta a cuo, Maath ca Mattathias sacapaa ta a cuo, Mattathias ca Semein sacapaa ta a cuo, Semein ca Josek sacapaa ta a cuo, Josek ca Joda sacapaa ta a cuo,
Joda ca Joanan sacapaa ta a cuo, Joanan ca Rhesa sacapaa ta a cuo, Rhesa ca Zerubbabel sacapaa ta a cuo, Zerubbabel ca Shealtiel sacapaa ta a cuo; Shealtiel ca Neri sacapaa ta a cuo,
Neri ca Melkhi sacapaa ta a cuo; Melkhi ca Addi sacapaa ta a cuo. Addi ca Kosam sacapaa ta a cuo, Kosam ca Elmadam sacapaa ta a cuo, Elmadam ca Er sacapaa ta a cuo,
Er ca Joshua sacapaa ta a cuo, Joshua ca Eliezer sacapaa ta a cuo, Eliezer ca Jorim sacapaa ta a cuo, Jorim ca Matthat sacapaa ta a cuo, Matthat ca Levi sacapaa ta a cuo;
Levi ca Simeon sacapaa ta a cuo, Simeon ca Judah sacapaa ta a cuo. Judah ca Josef sacapaa ta a cuo, Josef ca Jonam sacapaa ta a cuo, Jonam ca Eliakim sacapaa ta a cuo,
Eliakim ca Melea sacapaa ta a cuo, Melea ca Menna sacapaa ta a cuo, Menna ca Mattatha sacapaa ta a cuo, Mattatha ca Nathan sacapaa ta a cuo, Nathan ca David sacapaa ta a cuo,
David ca Jesse sacapaa ta a cuo, Jesse ca Obed sacapaa ta a cuo, Obed ca Boaz sacapaa ta a cuo, Boaz ca Sala sacapaa ta a cuo, Sala ca Nahshon sacapaa ta a cuo,

Nahshon ca Amminadab sacapaa ta a cuo, Amminadab ca Admin sacapaa ta a cuo, Admin ca Arni sacapaa ta a cuo, Arni ca Hezron sacapaa ta a cuo, Hezron ca Perez sacapaa ta a cuo, Perez ca Judah sacapaa ta a cuo,
Judah ca Jakob sacapaa ta a cuo, Jakob ca Isak sacapaa ta a cuo, Isak ca Abraham sacapaa ta a cuo, Abraham ca Terah sacapaa ta a cuo, Terah ca Nahor sacapaa ta a cuo,
Nahor ca Serug sacapaa ta a cuo, Serug ca Reu sacapaa ta a cuo, Reu ca Peleg sacapaa ta a cuo, Peleg ca Eber sacapaa ta a cuo, Eber ca Shelah sacapaa ta a cuo,
Shelah ca Kainan sacapaa ta a cuo, Kainan ca Arpaksad sacapaa ta a cuo, Arpaksad ca Shem sacapaa ta a cuo, Shem ca Noah sacapaa ta a cuo, Noah ca Lamek sacapaa ta a cuo,
Lamek ca Methuselah sacapaa ta a cuo, Methuselah ca Enok sacapaa ta a cuo, Enok ca Jared sacapaa ta a cuo, Jared ca Mahalaleel sacapaa ta a cuo, Mahalaleel ca Kainan sacapaa ta a cuo,
Kainan ca Enosh sacapaa ta a cuo, Enosh ca Seth sacapaa ta a cuo, Seth ca Adam sacapaa ta a cuo, Adam ca Khazing sacapaa ta a cuo.
Zingsuv ca Thlaapa Pathe ta a bi pata Jordan cavaa taa khata vya kaa te Thlaapa ta ruocaapa luo kha a sikhyi.
Capa lie ca khachie ta ning sawliy chung a pasupaliy. Capa chung bangkhuo ca khaapahmuo ning li pata a aw nakawta capa cuo a chuo pahne ta a nang khuopuv ta a diy.
Khachie ca ta, “Khazing sacapaa ta na cuo kieca hingpa alung hing viechuo ta aa li riypata naw pi tie,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta palie te, “Caapathe lieta, ‘Cawsaa hing sa dyi ta hring vyi,’ ta pata a capepa kha,” a ta.
Cakhutaata khachie ta aa suona luo kiekhyi te sungkhata lieta chuelyi pena bangkhuo kha a pahmung sa.
Khachie ta, “Nama kha iema rungnaana hne nawhnyina bangkhuo hing ica pi aa; tahematapakieca hingpa hing kama'a luo pipa cuo tli te, i khingpa ahunghmuo i pi khu yi.
Cakhutaata inaa bie ca kieca na huopa tana a cuo diy aa,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta palie te, “Caapathe lieta, ‘Abyipa, na Khazing kha abie la, ama re dyi kha hrie tie,' ta pata aa capepa kha,” a ta.
Cakhutaata khachie ta Jerusalem luo kha sikhyi te Biena-ing dawthlue lie kha a chi khutaata, “Khazing Sacapaa ta na cuo kieca hingpa taa hingta a thawpathla tie;
tahematapakieca Caapathe ta, ‘Khazing ta nama cuo hingta aa vuoming kha naw pi'a yi te,
iema ta ama kuv ta aca caba'a nakaw yi te, na phyi kha alung lie a phaw'a vaciy,’ a ta,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Caapathe ta, ‘Abyipa, na Khazing kha dyapasya khah,’ a ta,” ta pata a palie.
Khachie ca pasupaliyna phangphang a pachuo khutaata cuophaa a hmung pakhaana te ta cuo kha chung Zingsuv kha a thuse.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ca Thlaapa Pathe cahrana hne a bi pata Galilee luo kha a kaa. A thuohlaa ca capa ruo bangkhuo lie ca a pathuo diy.
Apungna-ing chunglie kha pacuv yi te cawsaa mekaa ta ama pathuosa.
Zingsuv ca a za lethawnapa Nazareth luo kha vaa te, a tue tawpa haata Sabbath ning kha apungna-ing luo a vaa. Caapathe ri riypata a daa te,
profet Isaiah caataw kha ama pi. Caataw ca pathluo te:

“Abyipa Thlaapa ca i cunglie a aw, tahematapakieca kama kha a siypasapa tie'a luo thuophaa phya riypata sathu ina pathuv. Sii ta a ziypa tie'a lie lawna bie pathyi riypa hne mingcuepa tie ta ama hmung pakhaa khu riypata cuose, hrisaapa tie hya pazang riypa hne
Abyipa thluechiy kung kha pathyi riypata ina pathlie,” ta pata aa capenapa kha a ri.
Zingsuv ca caataw kha kalang pakhaa te a mangchiytuv kha pi te aa tu. Apungna-ing lie a awpa bangkhuo ta ama ca ming vy li pata ama mang.
Cakhutaata iema kyihuo khata, “Ataning hingpa Caapathe hing nama thyina lieta a tling mangtli,” a ta yi.
Ama bangkhuo ta ama kha ri thuophaa yi te, a pakaa taata a pyapa vihnyina bie kha ama kharue ta a haa. Iema ta, “Hingpa paa hing Josef sacapaa khata cuo va ma?” amaa ta.

Zingsuv ta, “'Siyybyipa, nama hne nama a patluo sa tie law,’ tapa phungthluv kha ina risue'a ung ciy, tapa kha a phasa pata i pachang. Cakhutaata, ‘Kapernaum khy liena a tue ta pata ma thyipa zaw kha na puvnapa khy lie hing tue ra tie,’ ina ta'a ung ciy,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata, “Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, ahung profet hmuota a puvna khy lie cuhluo pata cuo buo vyi.
Cuorasala a hmisipa ca chang'a yi ang, Elijah chuo ning kha kung thung angkha a che khy kuo te ruo bangkhuo ta cakuo a tlung ning kha Israel ruo lie nunghlyi ama za hluvsa;
cuorasala Elijah ca Sidon pe Zarefath khy lie a awpa nunghlyinung'a luo ta li pata a ahung'a luo hmuo pathlie pata cuo vyi.
Elisha chuo ning zaw kha Israel ruo chunglie caahminghmaa ta a pasapa a hluvsa ama za aw, cuorasala Siria ming Naaman ta li pata pakha hmuo patluo sapa cuo va yi,” a ta yi.
Capa bie ca ama thyi tiyta, apungna-ing lie a awpa bangkhuo ca ama hi a haasa.
Thu yi te, Zingsuv kha khyle luo a dale yi te, ama khydaw tluo lungkuo taa khata nuopathla amaa nang.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ca iema hraw taa khata zuvpathla te a cakuo.
Zingsuv ca Galilee pe Kapernaum khypuv luo kha si te Sabbath ning ta a pacuv yi.
A pacuvnazya kha ama kharue a haasa, tahematapakieca nawhnyina hneta bie a ri nakawta a cuo.
Capa apungna-ing lie ca a pyalyipa khuevuo ta aa hryipa paa pakha aw te,

“Nazareth khypa Zingsuv, kiemata tah aw thluo pase! Tuokhaatama malie na tue khing? Kiema para riypata ma naa vaw? Nama ca a ahungtama na cuo tapa kha ica pachang. Khazing Cawsaa Pathepa tana na cuo,” ta pata khuopuv ta a khi.
Cuorasala, Zingsuv ta, “A dieta tah aw! Hingpa paa chung taa hingta pya,” ta te a chuo. Khuevuo ta cawsaapa ca ama hmiekunglie kha vaapatyi te, ruvnaana khaapahmuo pi li pata a chungtaata a pya.
Ama bangkhuo ta ama nang uosa te pakha hne pakha kha, “Hingpa bie hing tuokhaapa bie tama a cuo? Hingpa paa hingta nawhnyina hne cahrana ta bie pi te thlaapa chiepa tie ca ama pya!” a maa ta.
Zingsuv kaw ca capa ruo chung hmangting luo kha a pathuo.
Zingsuv ca apungna-ing taa khata pya te Simon ing luo kha aa ngie. Simon piynung a nge ling te a pasana kaw kha ama ca ama chang.
A thaalie kha vaa daapuo te, a ngelingna kha a chuo ca a nge kha a cakaa. Sungkhata kya thu te iema kha a mangsang yi.
Ning a tla ca a pasapa a hnyipa bangkhuo khata pasana a phangphang ta a pasapa tie kha Zingsuv'a luo ama vya chiykhyi; iema pakha cyicuo luv cunglie kha a kuv khang te a patluo sa yi.

Khuevuo zaw kha cawsaa hluvpuv chungtaata pya yi te, “Nama ca Khazing Sacapaa tana na cuo!” ta pata khuosa ta ama khi. Cuorasala iema kha chuo yi te bie pari sa va yi, tahematapakieca iema ta Messiah a cuopa kha ama pachang.
Khy a kya vuo pahne ta Zingsuv ca khy taa khata pya te ruoduona luo kha a cakuo. Cawsaa ta ama kha huv yi te ama hmung ca, a thuse li riypa yi ta ama thlu.
Cuorasala ama ta, “Khazing pena thuophaa ca khy hrang luo zaw i ri ra hrahring riypata a cuo, tahematapakieca hingpa repa hing tana pathlie pata i cuo,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Judea ruo chung apungna-ing zaw chunglie kha bie ca a phule.
Ning kha ca, Genesaret Tiyliy kielie Zingsuv aa daa ning kha, Khazing bie naathlie riypata cawsaa ca ama'a luo kha a nuo ta amaa nuopuo.
Zingsuv ta ngiekuo lie sawkawpalaw sahning a awpa kha a hmung. Ngaa a vaapa tie ca sawkawpalaw taa khata pya yi te ama'a sue kha ama pasiy nguoluo.
Capa sawkawpalaw hrawlie khata Simon huopa luo kha kie te ngiekuo taata a cawta aa hla viena luo kha va nuo riypata a chang. Zingsuv ca sawkawpalaw chunglie ca a tu te cawsaazaapuv kha a pacuv yi.
Bieri a patlung khutaata Simon kha, “Na sawkawpalaw hing tiy aa thuv viena luo hnyi la naa sue kha vaa tie,” a ta.
Simon ta, “Abyipa zuokhydyi ma vaa law pata sakha hmuo pa-uo vapuv. Cuorasala vaa ung la malie na ta kieca i vaa'a tle,” ta pata a palie.
Ama vaa ca ngaa a hluv hringhruo ama pa-uo nakawta amaa sue ca a tlaapuo diy'a nang.
Caacuonakawta palaw hrangpa cunglie ama viesaa tie kha ama kuv ta a kyi yi te byana ama hie. A vaw yi te sawkawpalaw sahning lie kha ngaa ca a bikaluv pata chi yi te tiy luo vuotaa a tla khyi'a nang.
Simon ta capa ca a hmung tiyta, Zingsuv phyi thabaw lie kha a pakhuv pane te, “Abyipa, na cakuose tie, tahematapakieca a suepa tana i cuo!” a ta.
Ama hne a viesaa tie ca ama pa-uopa ngaa kawlie kha ama nang ta a uosa.
Simon viesaa tie, Zebedi sacapaa tie Jeim hne Johan zaw kha ama nang a uosa ra. Zingsuv ta Simon kyihuo khata, “Na thlaa zang khah se; ata taa hingta ca cawsaa na na patuv'a tli,” a ta.
Ama sawkawpalaw ca ngiekuo lie kha padaa yi te, ama chechiy bangkhuo kha thuse yi te Zingsuv ca ama ziy.

Luo kha ca Zingsuv kha khypuv suokha lie a aw ningta capa khy lie ca caahminghmaa a phyapa paa kha a za aw. Capa paa ta Zingsuv kha a hmung tiyta, a hmiekunglie kha a bu te, “Abyipa, na khing pata a cuo kieca ina pathe sa khu ciy,” ta pata aa nue.
Zingsuv ta a kuv va pazuo te, ama kha hrie te, “Ica patluo sa khing. Pathe tie,” a ta. Capa paa ca sungkhabala ta a tluo.

Zingsuv ta ahunghmuo chang li riypata bie a pi. Ama ta, “Cakuo la tluobyipa'a luo kha vaa la vaa pamang sa tie; cawsaa hmiekunglie i pathe tli tapa paluosana ta, Moses ta tue riypa a za tapa hriykhungrina kha pihluo tie,” a ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv thuohlaa ca ning hrang laa khata a pathuo vie hryly, cawsaazaapuv ta a bie naathlie riypa hne ama pasana taata a patluo sa riypa yi ta ama kha amaa vya hmyasue.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ca zuvpathla te ruoduona luo kha cakuo te thlaa a chuo.

Ning kha ca Zingsuv ta a pacuv nguoluo ning yi kha Galilee hne Judea hne Jerusalem khyta mekaa taata a vya chiypa Farasi tie hne phungbie saya tie chekha zaw a thaalie ca a maa tu ra. A pasapa patluo sa khunapa cahrana ca Zingsuv cunglie kha a aw.
Cawsaa chekha ta a pakyapa paa kha a pangphaa hne a vya puvle yi te, ingchung luo zaa ngiekhyi pata Zingsuv hmielie vya chi riypa kha amaa zue.

Cuorasala cawsaa ama hluv tuv nakawta a chung luo kha a ngiekhyi khu va yi. Caacuonakawta thlungkhuv cung luo kha kiekhyi yi te, thlungkhuv kha za pahaw yi te cawsaa hrawlie Zingsuv hmiekunglie kha a pangphaa hneta ama za pachung.
Zingsuv ta ama zangna kha a hmung tiyta, “Liechung, na suena ca a ngiethe pata na cuo tli,” a ta.
Cakhutaata phungbie saya tie hne Farasi tie ta, “Khazing ripachiena bie a ripa paa hing ahungtama a cuo? Khazing pakha kyalya dyi muo suena a ngiethe khutuv ta a cuo ta,” amaa ta.
Zingsuv ta ama ruenapa ca pachang yi te, iema kha, “Khaapanakawma cahaacata nama rue?
‘Na suena ca a ngiethe pata a cuo tli,’ tapa ma a na vie, ‘Thu la cakuo,’ tapa ma a na vie?
Cuorasala, Cawsaa Sacapaa hing chuelyi lieta sue a ngiethe khuna naw a hnyi tapa nama pachangkhuna riypata ta te,” a pakyapa paa ca, “Ica chang, thu la na pangphaa kha a la lah ing luo cakuo!” a ta.
Sungkha ta, cawsaapa ca iema zaw hmielie kha thu te, aa zienapa pangphaa kha a la te Khazing pathuosana cangta ing luo a cakuo.
Ama bangkhuo ta ciysa yi te ama nang a uo hringhruo. Khazing kha pathuosa yi te “Ataning hing na kharuehaapa hmang ca ma hmung tli,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata, Zingsuv ca pya te ngukhyituv Levi ngukhyina zung lie aa tu nguoluopa kha hmung te, “Na ziy tie,” a ta.
Levi ca thu te, chechiy bangkhuo kha thuse te ama kha a ziy.
Cakhutaa Levi ta a ing lieta Zingsuv kha pyi lesapa tuepa te, capa lie ca ngukhyituv tie hne cawsaa hrangpa a hluvpuv zaw kha iema hne cata cabya lie amaa tu pakhaw.
Farasi tie hne ama phungbie saya tie chekha ta Zingsuv ziytuv tie'a lie kha a cie yi te, “Khaapanakawma ngukhyituv tie'a nata a suepa tie hneta nama ning nama dang pakhaw?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “A tluopa cawsaa tie ta ca siyybyi a hu va yi, cuorasala a pasapa tie ta ca amaa hu.
Kama ca aa dangpa tie ku riypata a vaw va ang, a suepa tie sue a ngiepachiyna luo ku riypa tana i vaw,” ta pata a palie yi.
Cakhutaata iema ta Zingsuv kha, “Johan ziytuv tie hne Farasi ming ziytuv tie ca ata'a na ata tah sa uv yi te thlaa ama chuo; cuorasala nama caa ziytuv tie ca ning yi dang yi te ama aw,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Nung chiy pyi a vya zawpa tie ca nungchiytuv satlie iema'a lie a aw chung kha sa nama pa-uv sa khu'a ma? Pa-uv sa khu'a va ung ciy!
Nungchiytuv satlie kha iema'a taata ama lana cuo kha vya tlung'a te, capa thue cata sa amaa uv aa,” a ta.

Zingsuv ta pakhingpuona suokha zaw a chang kalie yi: “Ahungtahmuo caw parangpa kha caw thaapa thlaa yi te a bie thla buo va yi; ama thla kieca caw thaapa dyi kha thlaa pata cuo'a te, caw parangpa lie abie a thla tiyta a ngie'a vyi.

Cakhutaata, ahungtahmuo mingsuvtiy thaapa kha savang ungchuo hlungpa luo raw buo va yi; ama raw kieca mingsuvtiy thaapa ta savang ungchuo kha ning chi'a te, mingsuvtiy ca zuv diy'a te savang ungchuo zaw a ra aa.
Cuorasala mingsuvtiy thaapa ca savang ungchuo thaapa lie raw riypa tana a cuo.
Cakhutaata ahungtahmuo mingsuvtiy hlungpa kha ama dang khutaata mingsuvtiy thaapa kha dang khing va yi. ‘A hlungpa na a pahuo vie,' ama ta,” a ta.
Zingsuv ca Sabbath ning ta lu kha cahrawpaale te a si. Ziytuv tie ta sa-uv kha pahriy paale yi te ama kuvpazaa lie ama cariy khutaata a chuo kha ama baale.
Farasi ming chekha ta, “Khaapanakawma phungbie ta a thlupa kha Sabbath ning ta nama tue?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Ama hne a cawsaa zaw ama nang a diy ningta David ta khaapama a za tue tapa kha ri buo va ung ca ma?
Khazing ingchung luo kha a ngie te tluobyi tie ta li pata ahungtahmuo ning hrue lipa, Phuovaa viechuo kha la te a ning khutaata a cawsaa zaw kha a pi yi cuo va ma?” a ta.
Cakhutaata, “Cawsaa Sacapaa ca sabbath byi tana a cuo,” a ta yi.
A ning hrangpa Sabbath ningta kha Zingsuv ca apungna-ing luo kha a ngie te a pacuv yi. Capa lie ca a cacuoluo kuv a pakyapa pakha a aw.
Phungbie saya tie hne Farasi ming chekha ta Zingsuv kha a suena ama huv khing nakawta Sabbath ning hing vya patluo sa ma tapa kha ci li pata ama mangkhuo.
Ama ruenapa kha a pachang thluo raalaa pata a kuv a pakyapa cawsaapa kha, “A vaw la hingpa lie hing a vya daa,” a ta. Cawsaapa ca thu te capa lie ca a vaa daa.
Zingsuv ta iema kha, “Ica hiehriy yi, Sabbath ning hing hmang pha tue riypa ma, ruvnaana pi riypa? Hringna khuo riypa ma para riypa?” a ta yi.
Iema kha mang paky yi te, cawsaapa kha, “Na kuv pazuo,” a ta. Pazuo te a kuv ca a tluo.
Ama hi haa hringhruo te, Zingsuv hing tuokhaatama ma tue aa tapa kha pakha hne pakha amaa rue.
Capa cuo ning ca Zingsuv ca thlaachuo riypata tluocung luo kie te Khazing'a luo kha zuokhydyi thlaa a chuo.
Khy a dyi tiyta ziytuv tie kha ku yi te hlyihning kha a tlaw yi te lucuotuv ta pata ming a pi yi.
Ama ming ca: Simon (Piter ama tapa paa) hne a nuta Andru, Jeim hne Johan, Filip hne Bartholomew,
Matthai hne Thomas, Alfeas sacapaa Jeim hne Simon (Phang a cuokhyituv ta pata ama upa),
Jeim sacapaa Judas, hne Zingsuv a lyituv Judas Iskariot ta ama cuo.

Zingsuv ca lucuotuv tie hneta tluocung taa khata za cung yi te, a se lie amaa daa. Judea ruo bangkhuo, Jerusalem khy hne riyliy kie khypuv ta a cuopa Tair hne Sidon khy taata cawsaa hluvpuv zaw ca capa lie ca ama aw.
Iema ca a bie naathlie riypa hne ama pasana taata patluo sa riypata a vawpa cuo yi te, thlaapa pyalyipa ta a tuepa tie zaw kha ama tluo.
Cawsaazaapuv yalya ta ama kha hrie khu amaa zue; tahematapakieca a chungtaata cahrana pya te a patluo sa diy nakaw yi ta a cuo.
Zingsuv ta ziytuv tie kha mang yi te, “A siypasapa tie ca thluechiypa tana nama cuo, tahematapakieca Khazing pena ca niema huopa tana a cuo.
Ata lieta a nang a diypa tie ca thluechiypa tana nama cuo, tahematapakieca nama riy pabi pata nama cuo aa. Ata lieta a caapa tie ca thluechiypa tana nama cuo, tahematapakieca nama pahnyi aa.
“Cawsaa Sacapaa kawlieta, cawsaa ta aca hue yi, aca thaw yi, biechie ta ca ta yi te nama thuo aca pachi kie yi ca thluechiypa tana nama cuo.
Capa ning lie ca nama palung tluo pata a cathlu tie ung, vuoruo lie nama cuota lawmuo ca a le hringhruo; tahematapakieca khapa haa kha tana ama mingchingmingvuo tie ta profet tie kha ama za tue.
“Cuorasala niema a hnyirungpa tie ca bawchie ciemuopa tana nama cuo, tahematapakieca hring anuona ca nama hmung tli.

Ata lie a riy a bipa tie ca bawchie ciemuopa tana nama cuo, tahematapakieca nangdiy pata na nama aw aa. Ata lie a pahnyipa tie ca bawchie ciemuopa tana nama cuo, tahematapakieca a ngiy a phie'a ung cate nama caa aa.
“Cawsaa bangkhuo ta nama thuophaa aca ri ning yi ca bawchie ciemuopa tana nama cuo, tahematapakieca capa ca ama mingchingmingvuo tie ta profet pakhipa tie'a lie ama za tuepa tana a cuo.
“Cuorasala i bie naa a thliepa niema ca ica chang yi, nama carie tie kha due ung la niema caa huepa tie cunglie kha hmang phapa tue tie ung;
chie caa sapa tie kha thluechiy pi ung la caa tuechiepa tie cuota thlaachuo tie ung.
Cawsaa pakhakha ta na be aca cabe kieca, kuokhaluo zaw kha chawpa tie; pakhakha ta na buohryicungle kha aca chuv kieca na buohryi zaw kha va pi chiy vie tie.
Ahung a cuo zaw ta na chechiy caa hiepa kha va pi la, cawsaa pakhakha ta na huopa ama la kieca va hie pakhaa khah tie yi.
Na tuepa yi se ta pata na khingpa kha malie cunglie va tuepa tie yi.
“Niema caa duepa tie dyi kha nama due kie ca khaapa athungna ma na hmung aa? A suepa tie ta hmuo iema a duepa tie kha ama due the ra.
Na cunglie phana a tuepa tie cunglie kyalya kha phana na tue kieca khaapa athungna ma na hmung aa? A suepa tie hmuo cahaacata ama tue ra cuo va ma?
I hmung pakhaa aa ta pata naa nguopuopa tie kyalya kha ducyi na pi kie yi ca khaapa athungna ma na hmung aa? A suepa tie ta hmuo du ama cyipa zaa hmung pakhaa riypata a suepa tie kha ducyi ama pi.

Cuorasala nama cariepa kha due ung la, phana kha tue ung la hmung pakhaa riypa kha a nguopuo li pata ducyi pi tie ung. Lawmuo a hluvsa hmung'a ung cate Cungnungce saata tah nama cuo aa. Tahematapakieca ama ca palungtluo a the lipa tie hne cawsaa pha lipa tie cunglie zaw a pha.
Nama Paa ca nangdue a thepa a cuopa haata malie kha va nangdue tie ung.

“Malie kha bie va ripa khah, caacuokieca nama zaw bie ripa pata cuo'a vaciy; malie kha sue va phaw khah, caacuokieca nama zaw suebe pata cuo'a vaciy; malie kha vaa ngiethe la a ngiethe pata na cuo ra aa.

Malie kha va pi la pi pata na cuo ra aa. A bikaluv pata, a khepuo pata, a carypuo pata hne a lepathlana te ta, pi pata na cuo aa. Malie cunglie na hmuopa panangna khata na nama zaw panangpa pata na cuo ra aa.”
Ama ta pakhingpuona suokha a chang vie yi: “Mingcue pakha ta a hrangpa mingcue pakha kha luo a chiy khu'a ma? Ama pahning ta khue luo tla'a va yi ma?
Ziytuv ca pacuvtuv laata le vie vyi, cuorasala aa cuv riypa pachuo te a the diypa ca a pacuvtuv tluv a ta aa.
Na ming chunglie thingtung kha hmuo rue li pata tuokhaatama na uvnu ming chunglie mingbuo kha na mang?

Tuokhaatama nama ming chunglie thingtung hmuo hmung the li pata na uvnu kha, ‘Uvnu, na ming chunglie mingbuo kha ca lapa'a ang,’ na ta the? Nama phahruocuo, na ming chunglie thingtung kha la taa la muo na uvnu ming chunglie mingbuo kha a siesa pata hmung'a cate na la the'a ta.
“Thingkung phapa ca thyi chiepa pathyi vyi; thingkung chiepa ta thyi phapa pathyi ra vyi;
tahematapakieca thingkung mekaa ca a thyi ta pachang khu pata a cuo. Ahling kung taata thyikuv lu pata cuo buo vyi, acuolikie sahming kung taata mingsuv lu pata cuo buo vyi.

Cawsaa phapa ta a palung chunglie a awpa hmang phapa kha papya te, cawsaa chiepa ta a palung chunglie a awpa hmang chiepa kha a papya ra; tahematapakieca pakaa ca pathiypalung chunglie a bipa khana a ri.
“Khaapanakawma niema ta, ‘Abyipa, Abyipa na ta ung cate ica changpa yi ca tue li pata nama aw?
Kama'a luo a vaw te, i bie kha naathlie te a ziypa ca khaapama a lu tapa kha ca pahmung'a yi ang.
Ama ca alung cunglie aa thuvsa pata khue cu te a tung kha thla te ing a sapa haa tana a cuo. Cavaa tiy za le te capa ing ca a za phaw raalaa pata a cusa pata sapa a cuo nakawta cahang khu vyi.
Cuorasala i bie kha thyi te a ziy lipa ca a hruo kha a cusa pata thla li pata ing a sapa haa tana a cuo. Tiy za le te a za phaw tiyta capa ing ca sungkha ta a lie te a rapatlaa diy,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta hing bie bangkhuo hing zaapuv thyi pata a ri khutaata Kapernaum khy luo kha aa ngie.
Capa lie a awpa riebyipa ta a due laalawpa a changtaapa pakha ca pasa te vuotaa a thiy'a nang.
Riebyipa ca Zingsuv kaw kha a thyi tiyta Judah uvthyi tie kha pathlie yi te, a vaw pata a changtaapa kha a patluo sa riypata paa apa kie sa yi.
Zingsuv'a luo ama pha tiyta, khuosa ta paa kie yi te, “Hingpa paa hing bya aa tla hrahringpa tana a cuo,
tahematapakieca ma mingphang malie due te apungna-ing zaw malie a sapatuv tana a cuo,” ama ta.

Caacuonakawta Zingsuv ca iema hne ca ta a cakuo, ing ama va pha'a nang tlipa khata riebyipa ta a viesaa zaw kha vya pathlie yi te, “Abyipa, na rie a pathyi khing khah, tahematapakieca kama ca i ingchung luo naa ngie riypata a tla va ang.
Caacuonakawta nama'a luo a vaw riypa kha a nguo va ang. Cuorasala na ryi kaa kha na pathlie kieca i changtaapa ca a tluo aa.

Tahematapakieca kama zaw hing i rieka tie hneta byi le viepa kuv rawlie a awpa tana i cuo. Pakha kha, ‘Cakuo!’ i ta kie cakuo te, a hrangpa pakha kha, ‘A vaw,’ i ta kie aa vaw; cakhutaata i sii a cuopa kha, ‘Hingpa hing tue,’ i ta kie a tue,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta capa bie ca a thyi tiyta a nang-uosa te, a hnangluo a pali te a ziypa cawsaazaapuv kha, “Ica chang yi, Israel ming chunglie hmuota hing haapa zangna hing hmung buo va ang,” a ta.
A pathliepa tie ca riebyipa ing luo kha ama kaa tiyta, a siipaapa a za tluopa kha ama hmung.
Ca khu pahne ta Zingsuv ca Nain ama tapa khy luo kha si te a ziytuv tie hne cawsaazaapuv khata ama ziy.
Khy hukaa a vya phapa khiy ta a thiypa a vya puvlepa tie kha ama vya pya. A thiypa ca nunghlyinung sacapaa, pakhata dyi a hnyi tlakuopa cuo te khychung ming a hluvsa ta a nung ca ama vya paziy.
Abyipa ta capa nung ca a hmung tiyta ngiechi hringhruo te, “Caa khah,” a ta.
Cakhutaata va cakuo te riyy thingkaw kha hrie te a vya puvlepa tie ca amaa daa. Zingsuv ta, “Satliepa, thu la ica ta!” a ta.
A thiypa ca kya thu te bie a ri, cakhutaata Zingsuv ta a nung'a luo kha a pi.
Iema bangkhuo ca ciysa yi te, Khazing kha ama pathuosa. “Kiema'a liena profet lepa aa luo! Khazing na a cawsaa zaw kha minghmie pha a pi tli yi!” ama ta.
Zingsuv thuohlaa ca Judea hne a kiecahriy ruo ting khata a pathuo.
Capa thuohlaa bangkhuo ca Johan kha ama a ziytuv tie ta ama chang. Caacuonakawta Johan ta iema hraw taata pahning kha ku yi te,
“Nama hing a vaw riypa paa cata na cuo ma, acuolikie cawsaa hrangpa kha ma huo kalie'a ma?” ta pata Abyipa kha va hiehriy riypata a pathlie yi.

“Zingsuv'a luo ama vya chiy tiyta, ‘Nama hing a vaw riypa paa cata na cuo ma, acuolikie cawsaa hrangpa kha ma huo kalie'a ma?’ ta pata hiehriy riypa tana tiynawtuv Johan ta malie a vya pathlie,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta cawsaa a hluvpuv kha ama pasanapa a phangphang hne thlaapa chiepa ta a tuena taa yi ta patluo sa yi te a ming cuepa zaw a pahmung sa khu pahne yi ta a cuo.

Iema kha palie yi te, “Vaa ung la nama hmungpa hne nama thyipa hing Johan ca va chang tie ung: a ming cuepa tie ta ama hmung, a phyi cabiepa tie ta ama cakuo, caahminghmaa a phyapa tie ama pathe, a naa ruepa tie ta ama thyi, a thiypa tie thu pakhaa yi te a siypasapa tie kha thuophaa chang pata ama cuo tli.
Kama naa du lipa tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo,” a ta yi.
Johan biephyatuv tie ama cakuo khu pahne ta, Zingsuv ta cawsaazaapuv kha Johan kaw a chang yi: “Khaapa mang riypata ma ruocaapa luo ca nama pya? Thliy ta a canyipa phiepahlaa kung ma?
Khaapa mang riypata ma nama pya? Cawsie phasapa a tuepa pakhakha mang riypata ma? Mang tie ung, cawsie phasapa a tuepa tie hne aa nuosa pata a awpa tie ca siepahruo ing lie muo ama aw ta.
Caacuokieca khaapa mang riypata ma nama pya? Profet ma? A cuo, ica chang yi, profet laata a le viepa tana a cuo.
Caapathe lie a kaw a capepa ca, ‘Mang tie, nama luo caa sa daw riypa tana i biephyatuv kha na hmieluo ta i pathlie aa,’ a ta.
Ica chang yi, canung ta ama sapa zaw hrawlieta Johan laata a le viepa ahunghmuo aw va yi; cuorasala Khazing pena chunglie a caw cepa ca Johan laata a le vie,” a ta.
(Ngukhyituv tie a te ra pata, a bie a thyipa cawsaa bangkhuo ta Khazing biedangpa ca amaa paw, tahematapakieca iema ca Johan tiynawna a angpa tana ama cuo.
Cuorasala Farasi ming hne Phungbie saya tie ca Johan tiynawna kha ang khing lipa yi ta Khazing ta ama cuota a tingpa kha ama thaw.)
“Ata chuo cawsaa zaw hing khaapa hneta ma i pakhingpuo'a yi? Khaapa hne ma amaa lu?

Chadawtluo lie a tu yi te phuv kha hne phuv kha a khisue pata, ‘Ramang maca tungpa yi, cuorasala luo va ung ciy; caana hlaa maacaa ngiypa yi, cuorasala caa va ung ciy,' a tapa haatiy tie hne tana amaa lu.
Tahematapakieca tiynawtuv Johan kha viechuo ning li pata hne mingsuv dang li pata aa vaw ca niema ta, ‘Khuevuo na a hnyi,’ nama ta.
Cawsaa Sacapaa ca ningpuo dangpuo pata aa vaw tiyta, niema ta, ‘Mang tie ung, ning a rangpa hne sahmaa a rangpa, ngukhyituv tie hne a suepa tie viesaa tana a cuo!’ nama ta.
Cadyiseca singna ca a saa a nu zaw na aa hmuo hrahring a paluo sa yi,” a ta.
Farasi ming pakha ta Zingsuv kha sa dung pakhaw riypata a ku. Zingsuv ta a ing luo ca vaa te cabya lie kha aa tu.
Capa khy lie a awpa a suepa canung pakha ta Farasipa ing liena Zingsuv ta sa a ning tapa kha a thyi tiyta, alabaster ungthyi suokha ta ziyhmyi kha a vya cyi.
Zingsuv hnangluo, a phyi thabaw lie kha a tu te, caa te a mingthliy ta Zingsuv phyi kha a tlasue nakawta a suo ta a hruv. Cakhutaata a phyi kha pahnuo te ziyhmyi a bya.

Sa ning a upa Farasipa ta a hmung tiyta, ama hne ama kha, “Hingpa paa hing profet ta a cuo hmisi kieca ama a hriepa a suenung hing ahungma tapa hne tuokhaapa cawsaanung ta ma a cuo tapa kha a pachang aa,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Simon ica chang khingpa na a aw,” a ta. Simon ta, “Saya, ri tie,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Tuokaa ducyi a pipa paa lie tuokaa ducyi a lapa pahning ama aw. Pakha ta denarii zapangaa a uo te a hrangpa pakha ta sawngaa aa uo.
Ama pi khu li tiyta ama pahning khata aa ngiethe yi. Caacuokieca ahung ma ama ca a due vie aa?” a ta.
Simon ta, “Lyibuo a hluv vie aa ngiethepa paa khana a due vie aa, tapa tana i rue,” a ta. Zingsuv ta, “Aa hmuopa na na ri,” a ta.

Cawsaanung'a luo kha a pali te Simon kha, “Hingpa nung hing na hmung ma? Na ing chung luo kha i vya ngie: cuorasala i phyi a siyna riypa tiy na pi vaciy, cadyiseca hingpa nung hingta i phyi kha a mingthliy ta pasiy te a suo ta a hruv.
Nama ca na pahnuo vaciy, cuorasala hingpa nung hing ca i vya ngie yalya ta ata te hingta ci li pata i phyi kha a pahnuo.
Nama ca i luv kha sathu na pathuv vaciy, cuorasala ama ca i phyi kha ziyhmyi ta a bya.
Caacuonakawta ica chang, a suena hluvpuv ca a ngiethe pata a cuo tli nakawta duena lepuv a paluo sa. Cuorasala a suena a cawta dyi a ngiethepa ca duena a cawta dyina a paluo sa ra,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta cawsaanung kha, “Na suena ca a ngiethe pata a cuo tli,” a ta.
Cuorasala saningna cabya lie ama hne a tuhnepa tie khata iema hrawlie kha, “Suena hmuo a ngiethepa paa hing ahungtama a cuo?” amaa ta.
Zingsuv ta cawsaanung kha, “Na zangna na caa khuo tli: thlaalungna hneta cakuo tie,” a ta.
Cakhutaata a ru hluota Zingsuv ca khypuv hne khyta hne khata tlawle te Khazing pena kaw thuophaa kha a ri. Ziytuv hlyihning tie khata ama ziy,
ama pasana hne thlaapa chiepa ta a tuena taa yi ta a patluo sapa canung tie ta a cuopa: a chungtaata thlaapa chiepa pasariy a papyapa Mary (Magdalin ta pata zaw ama ku nung),
Herod cuota kingkaatuv ta a cuopa Khuza napuvnung Joanna, Susanna, hne iema kha ama hnyi ama chie ta a byapa canung hrangpa a hluvpuv zaw khata ama ziy ra.
Khy kha hnang khy kha taata cawsaazaapuv ca Zingsuv'a luo kha a vaw yi te amaa vya pung tiyta hingpa pakhingpuona hing a chang yi:
“Saciy vaatuv pakha ca saciy vaa riypata a si. Saciy kha a vaa tiyta, chekha ca luopuv lie kha a tla nakawta cawsaa ta tlaw yi te pavaa ta amaa haa.
Chekha ca lungdaapa lieta tla te a kya daa paluo raalaa pata a lyi a pahna li nakawta a caa.
Saciy chekha ca ahling hrawlie a tla nakawta kya le hne te ahling ta a kalaa.
Saciy chekha ca lyiphaa lie tla te kya le te le zakha ta a vyi,” a ta. Hingpa bie a ripa hingta, “Thyina naa a hnyipa ta thyi mang sue” ta pata a khisue yi.
Cakhutaata a ziytuv tie ta, hingpa pakhingpuona ta a ri khingpa hing khaapatama a cuo, ta pata ama hiehriy.

Zingsuv ta, “Niema ca Khazing pena bieparuv pachang khuna kha pi pata nama cuo; cuorasala a hrangpa tie ca pakhingpuona hmuo pata i chang yi, caacuonakawta ‘Mang raalaa'a yi te hmungpasie the'a va yi, naathlie raalaa'a yi te a siyluo pachang the'a va yi,’ a ta.
“Hingpa pakhingpuona siyluo ca hing haa hing tana a cuo: Saciy ca Khazing bie ta a cuo.
Luopuv lie a tlapa tie ca Khazing bie a thyipa tie ta ama cuo; cakhutaata khachie kha a vaw te ama zang li riypa hne khuopa ta ama cuo li riypata ama palung chungtaata Khazing bie kha a lapa yi.
Lungdaa lie a tlapa tie ca, Khazing bie kha ama thyi tiyta palung tluosa pata ama cuhluo. Cuorasala a thariy a thla li nakawta cuo kha chung dyi zang yi te dyapasyana cuo a vya chiy tiyta amaa lie.
Ahling hrawlie a tlapa tie ca, Khazing bie kha thyi yi te, cuorasala palungriethyina, hnyirungna hne anuona zaw ta ama hringna kha a kalaa nakawta thyi phapa pathyi the va yi.
Cuorasala alyi phanapa lie a tlapa tie ca, Khazing bie kha ama thyi tiyta, a patuv paluo yi te, adangna hne pathiypalung phapa hneta a hringkhyi yi te thyi a pathyipa tie ta ama cuo.

“Ahunghmuota myi-ing ama vuo tiyta beke pakhuvsue buo va yi, iehmang rawlie zaw chi buo va yi, cuorasala ing chung luo a ngiepa tie ta khena ama hmung riypata myi-ing vuona tung cunglie khana ama patu taw.
Tahematapakieca suokha hmuo nupa a cuo li riypata suokha hmuo buvkhung pata cuo'a vyi, a paruv ta tuepa bangkhuo ca pachang pata cuo'a te, khena luo papya pata a cuo aa.

Caacuonakawta bie nama naathliezya kha a raaring tie ung; tahematapakieca a hnyipa tie kha a hluv vie ta pipa cuo'a yi te, a hnyi lipa tie ta i hnyi ta pata amaa ruepa kha hmuo lapa pata ama cuo aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv a nung hne a nuta zaw kha ama'a luo amaa vaw, cuorasala cawsaa ama hluv tuv nakawta a taw khu va yi.
Ama kha, “Na nung hne na nuta zaw ta caa taw khing yi te ale liena amaa daa nguoluo,” ama ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta iema kyihuo khata, “I nung hne i nuta zaw ca Khazing bie kha thyi yi te a tuepa tie kha tana ama cuo,” a ta.
Ning kha ca Zingsuv ta ziytuv tie hne khata sawkawpalaw chung luo kha a ngie yi te, iema kyihuo khata, “Tiyliy huesuo luo hue vaa'a ung puv,” a ta yi. Caacuonakawta a thu yi te,
sawkawpalaw ta ama sile nguoluo ning kha Zingsuv ca aa hmung. Thliychie a vya hruo te ama sawkawpalaw lie tiy a bi nakawta ciy aa chiysana chunglieta ama aw.
Ziytuv tie ta Zingsuv kha va pathu yi te, “Abyipa, Abyipa, vuotaa ma thiy diy'a nang pa hing!” ta pata ama khi. Zingsuv ca kya thu te thliychie hne tiylaw kha a chuo yi; nesiyliy khata ama die.

Ama ta iema kyihuo khata “Nama zangna ca khaapaliema a aw?” a ta yi. Iema ca ciysa yi te ama nang ta a uo, pakha hne pakha kha, “Thliychie hne tiylaw hmuo naw pi te, a ri amaa ngiepa paa hing ahungtama a cuo?” amaa ta.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv hne ziytuv tie ca Galilee riyliy huesuo Gerasenes pe luo kha ama chiy.

Zingsuv ca ngiekuo luo a va pya pahne ta capa khy lie a awpa khuevuo ta aa hryipa paa ta aa vya taw. Capa paa ca cuo pasiypuv caw a tue li pata aw te ing lie aw li pata thluokung lie khy a sapa ta a cuo.
Zingsuv kha a hmung tiyta, a phyi thabaw lie kha a vya bu te a ue a aw zawdya ta khi te, “Zingsuv, Cungnungce Khazing Sacapaa, tuokhaatama ina tue khing ciy? Icaa nue, ruvnaana na pi thi khah,” a ta.

Tahematapakieca Zingsuv ta thlaapa pyalyipa kha capa paa chung taa cata pya riypata naw a pi nakaw tana a cuo. (Cuo hluvpuv ca thlaapa pyalyipa ca ta patuv te, a kuv a phyi kha thaabuoliriy ta ciy yi te ama huo raalaa pata, thaariy kha chipachung diy te ruopahriy luo kha khuevuo cata a paruo taw.)
Zingsuv ta, “Na ming ahungma?” ta pata a hiehriy. Ama ta, “Hluvpuv” a ta; tahematapakieca khuevuo hluvpuv kha a chunglie amaa ngie nakaw tana a cuo.
Khuevuo tie ta Zingsuv kha, dena a hnyi lipa khue a thuvsapa chung luo kha malie pathla thi khah ama ta.
Capa hmang, tluope lie kha va a hluvsa ama patle nguoluo. Caacuonakawta khuevuo tie ta Zingsuv ca va chung luo a pangie sa riypa yi ta paa ama kie. Caacuonakawta naw a pi yi.
Cakhutaata khuevuo tie ca cawsaapa chung taa khata pya yi te va chung luo ca amaa ngie. Va bangkhuo ca lungkuo taa cata a zupathla yi te riyliy chung luo ama tlasa diy.
Va a khietuv tie ta cahaacata hmang a cuopa kha ama hmung tiyta a ruo yi te khypuv hne khyta luo kha capa thuohlaa ca ama pathyi sa.

Hmang a cuopa kha mang riypata cawsaa ca pya yi te, Zingsuv'a luo ama va pha ca, khuevuo ta ama pyase tlipa paa kha a phata tah caw a tue te palung singta tah Zingsuv phyi thabaw lie a zaa tupa kha ama hmung ca ama ciy hringhruo.
Khuevuo ta aa hryipa paa tuokhaatama a tluo tapa kha zaa hmungpa tie ta cawsaa zaw kha ama chang.
Cakhutaata Gerasenes kiecahriy lie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo ca ama ciysa nakawta Zingsuv kha a pyase riypa yi ta paa ama kie. Caacuonakawta Zingsuv ca sawkawpalaw luo kha kie te a kaa.
Khuevuo ta a pyasepa paa ta Zingsuv kha ama'a lie aw ra riypata paa a kie; cuorasala Zingsuv ta,

“Na ing luo kha kaa la Khazing ta kha tluv tama hmang pha aca tuepa tapa kha va pathyi sa tie,” ta te a pathlie. Caacuonakawta cakuo te Zingsuv ta a cuota kha tluv tama hmang pha a tue tapa kha khypuv chung bangkhuo khata a pathyi sale.
Zingsuv ca a vya kaa tiyta cawsaazaapuv ta alawna hneta ama daw, tahematapakieca ama bangkhuo ta ama kha ama za huo.
Ca khu pahne ta Jairu ama tapa apungna-ing uvthyipa paa kha a vya chiy. Zingsuv phyi thabaw lie kha a vya bu te a ing luo a vaw riypata paa a kie,
tahematapakieca kung hraa hlyihning a tapa, sacanung a hnyi tlakuopa khana a thiy'a nang nguoluo. Zingsuv ca cakuo te cawsaazaapuv khata a pahlaw ta ama pahlawle.
Capa lie ca kung hraa hlyihning chung thiylang pasana ta a pasapa cawsaanung pakha a aw; a hnyipa bangkhuo siyybyi tie'a lie a hmuo diy raalaa pata ahungtahmuo patluo khu va yi.
Zingsuv hnangluo taa khata a vaw te a pangpe kha a hrie ca sungkhabala ta a thiy langpa ca a ping.
Zingsuv ta, “Ahungma naa hrie?” a ta. Ahungtahmuo ca hrie vapuv, ama ta diy tiyta, Piter ta, “Abyipa, cawsaa ta ca cadung yi te aa nuo ta acaa nuosue patlawpa yi hing,” a ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta, “Pakhakha na naa hrie; tahematapakieca i chungtaata cahrana a pyapa na i pachang,” a ta.

Cawsaanung ta a nu khu'a va tli ang pata kha a pachang tiyta aa cathangsa hringhruo; Zingsuv phyi thabaw lie kha a vya bu te cawsaa bangkhuo hmielie ca, khaapanakawma Zingsuv kha a hrie tapa hne tuokhaatama sungkhabala ta a tluo tapa kaw kha a ri.
Zingsuv ta, “I sacanung, na zangnapa na caa patluo sa; hnaanguosa pata cakuo tie,” a ta.
Cahaacata Zingsuv bie a ri nguoluo ning ca, apungna-ing a uvtuvpa ing taata cawsaa pakha vya chiy te, “Na sacanung ca a thiy tli, sayapa kha hnaa pahnaw khah tie,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta capa bie a thyi tiyta, Jairu kha, “Na thlaa zang khah se! Zang thluo la na sacanung ca a tluo aa,” a ta.
Ing kha a va pha tiyta, Piter, Johan, Jeim hne haatiynung a nung hne a paa ta li pata ahunghmuo ingchung luo pangie sa va yi.
Ama bangkhuo ta haatiynung kha ama caa; cuorasala Zingsuv ta, “Caa khah ung; haatiynung hing thiy vyi, cuorasala aa hmung nguoluo,” a ta.
Haatiynung a thiy tapa kha ama pachang nakawta Zingsuv kha ama pahnyisue.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta haatiynung ca a kuv ta patuv te, “Thu tie, haatiynung,” ta pata a u.
A thlaapa kha vya kaa te sungkha ta a kya thu. Zingsuv ta ning riypa suokhakha pi riypata a chang yi.
A nung hne a paa ca a ca ang ta ama ca ang; cuorasala Zingsuv ta a cuopa hmang kha ahunghmuo chang li riypata a thlu yi.
Zingsuv ta ziytuv hlyihning kha suv kha lie ku pakhaw yi te cahrana hne khuevuo bangkhuo cunglie nawhnyina hne pasana patluo sa khunapa kha a pi yi.
Cakhutaata Khazing Pena kaw phu riypa hne a pasapa patluo sa riypata a pathlie yi.
Iema kyihuo khata, “Khy nama tlaw tiyta khaapahmuo a phya khah ung, khuecahryi cuose, sahrie cuose, viechuo cuose, tuokaa cuose, buohryi hlepa zaw cuose a phya khah ung.
Tuokhaapa ing chung luo namaa ngie zaw, capa lie ca aw ung la, capa taa cata pya tie ung.
Ingtlung caa dapa khy tie ca ama khy taata nama pya tiyta a raaringna pina ta nama phyipazaa lie buvcing kha a cakhawsue siy tie ung,” a ta yi.
Ziytuv tie ca a tha yi te khyta bangkhuo kha tlaw yi te thuophaa kha hmangting ta chang yi te a pasapa kha ama patluo sa.
Uvtuv Herod ta hmang a cuopa bangkhuo kha a thyi tiyta, a palung aa tawmuo ciemuo, tahematapakieca cawsaa chekha ta tiynawtuv Johan na thiyna taata a thu pakhaa, ama ta.
Chekha tie ta Elijah na a luo ta yi te, a hrangpa tie ta hluoning profet pakhakha na a vya hring pakhaa ama ta.
Herod ta, “Johan ca a luv i pate sa tli yi; cuorasala hing haa hingta a kaw i thyi nguoluopa paa hing ahungtama a cuo aa?” a ta. Cakhutaata Zingsuv kha hmung riypata aa zue.
Lucuotuv tie ca vya kaa yi te ama tuepa bangkhuo kha Zingsuv ama chang. Cakuokhyi yi te iema selaw ta Bethsaida ama tapa khypuv luo kha ama si.
Capa kaw ca cawsaazaapuv ta ama thyi tiyta, Zingsuv kha ama ziy; iema kha cuhluo yi te Khazing pena kaw kha chang yi te tluona a hupa tie kha a patluo sa yi.

Ning a tla'a nang tiyta hlyihning tie kha ama'a luo a vaw yi te, “Cawsaazaapuv hing pathlie yi la, hingpa cahriylie a awpa khyta luo kha va cakuo yi sala arina hne ning riypa zaw vaa huv yi se; tahematapakieca ma awnapa hing ruoduona hmang tana a cuo,” ama ta.

Cuorasala Zingsuv ta, “Niema ta ning riypa sa ca pi tie ung,” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Vaa pata hing cawsaa zaw bangkhuo cuota sa kha ma va calyi li kieca, viechuo tluo pangaa hne ngaa sahning ta li pata ma hnyi viepa aw vyi,” ama ta.
Tahematapakieca capa lie a awpa ca capaa thaw pangaa hraw ama ta. Zingsuv ta ziytuv tie kha, “Cawsaa hing phuv kha lie sawngaa kaluo ta patu tie ung,” a ta yi.
Cahaacata ama tue diy khutaata ama patu.
Cakhutaata viechuo tluo pangaa hne ngaa sahning kha la te, avuo luo ang te, Khazing a pathuosa khutaata chechi te cawsaazaapuv kha re riypata ziytuv tie kha a pi yi.
Ama bangkhuo ta ning yi te ama riy a bi diy. Ama pangaapa kha ama pahmya ca a zungpepa beke zung hraa hlyihning a ta.
Luo kha ca Zingsuv ama selaw ta thlaa a chuo nguoluo ning, ziytuv tie dyi a thaalie ama aw ning kha, “Cawsaazaapuv ta kama hing ahung ina ta yi ma,” ta pata a hiehriy yi.
Iema ta, “Chekha ta tiynawtuv Johan aca ta yi; cuorasala a hrangpa tie ta Elijah ca ta yi te, a hrangpa tie ta hluoning profet pakhakha na a vya hring pakhaa, aca ta yi,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Niema haw, ahung ina ta ung ca ma?” a ta yi. Piter ta, “Nama ca Khazing Messiah tana na cuo,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta capa kaw ca ahunghmuo chang li riypata iema kha khuopuv ta bie a cung yi.
“Cawsaapa Sacapaa ca khuopuv ta te-ang'a te, uvthyi tie, tluobyi lepa tie hne phungbie saya tie ta thaw'a yi te ama thie aa. Ning thungna lie kha pathu pakhaa pata a cuo aa,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata iema bangkhuo kha, “Ahunghmuo cuose kama naa ziytuv a cuo khingpa ca iema khingna kha thuse yi sala, ama vieluo kha ningting ta a puv pata na ziy yi se.
Tahematapakieca a hringna aa bangpa a khingpa tie ca ama hringna kha a sung'a yi te, cuorasala kama kawlieta a hringna a sungpa tie ca hringna kha ama hmung aa.
Iema ta Chuelyi hing a yalya ta cu ra hmuo yi sala ama hringna kha amaa sung kieca khaapama a thlahne aa?
Kama kha na zaakhyi te i bie a zaakhyipa ca, Cawsaa Sacapaa zaw ta a rungnaana, a Paa rungnaana hne a pathepa avuoming rungnaana hneta aa vaw thueta a zaakhyi ra'a yi.
Cuorasala biehmisi tana ica chang yi, hingpa lie a daapa chekha hing Khazing pena a tlungpa ama hmung hluo li a thiy li riypa ama aw,” a ta.
Hingpa bie a ri khutaata ning cari hraw a ta pata, Zingsuv ta Piter, Johan, hne Jeim kha ku yi te thlaachuo riypata tluo luo a kiekhyi yi.
Thlaa a chuo nguoluo ning kha a hmie ca a vya thle te a caw ca a ruona luo ta aa li ta aa li.
Sungkhabala ta cawsaa pahning, Moses hne Elijah ta ama kha bie a maa rue nguoluo pata ama hmung.
Rungnaana hneta zaa luo yi te Jerusalem lie a thiyna riypa kaw kha amaa rue.
Piter hne a viesaa zaw ca thuvhunglung khata amaa hmung; cuorasala amaa kya cha ca Zingsuv rungnaana hne ama hneta a daahnepa cawsaa pahning kha ama hmung.

Capa cawsaa pahning tie ta ama cakuose nguoluo ning kha Piter ta, “Abyipa, hingpa lie awpa hing kiema cuota a pha hringhruo; nama cuota suokha, Moses cuota suokha, hne Elijah cuota suokha ta pata thluodaa suothung maca sapa'a yi,” a ta. Khaapahmuo aa pachang li pata a ripa ta cuo.
Bie a ri nguoluo ning kha amyi kya pya te a ningdiy ta iema kha a pakhuo yi; amyi ta a pahlaw nakaw yi ta ziytuv tie ca ama ciy.
Amyi chungtaata ueryi suokha paring te, “Hingpa paa hing kama Sacapaa, i Tlawpa tana a cuo, a bie kha naathlie tie ung!” a ta.
Ueryi a chuo pahne ta Zingsuv kha ama selaw ta a awpa ama hmung. Ziytuv tie ca a dieta tah aw yi te ama hmungpa hmang kha capa chung ca ahunghmuo chang li pata ama aw.
A mawluopa, tluocung taata ama za cung tiyta, cawsaa hluvpuv ta ama vaa taw.
Cawsaazaapuv chungtaata cawsaa pakha ta khi te, “Saya, i sacapaa hing na mangpa thi tie tapa tana paa ica kie; pakha dyi i hnyi tlakuopa tana a cuo.
Sungkhabala ta thlaapa ta patuv te a khi a u, a pakaa taata a buvcaphawpa a pyana te ta a siy, khuosa ta tuvde te pyase khing vyi.
Caa ziytuv tie kha papya riypata paa i kie raalaa yi ca papya khu va yi,” a ta.

Zingsuv ta, “Niema, zangna a hnyi lipa, a pali a pahnaa ta a hringpa phang, kha cuo te ma niema'a lie i aw kalie a hu'a te nama nang ica caw kalie yi a hu aa? Na sacapaa ca hingpa luo hing a vawkhyi tie,” a ta.
Haatiypa ca aa vaw nguoluopa khata khuevuo ta alyi lie kha vaapatyi te a siy. Cuorasala Zingsuv ta thlaapa pyalyipa kha chuo te, haatiypa kha patluo sa te a paa kha a pi pakhaa.
Khazing lesyina kha ama hmung tiyta cawsaa bangkhuo ca ama nang ta a uo.
“Ica chang riypa yi hing naathlie tie ung: Cawsaa Sacapaa hing cawsaa kuv luo pi pata a cuo aa,” a ta yi.
Cuorasala ziytuv tie ta a ri khingna kha pachang va yi; a ri khingna kha nukhuo pata cuo yi te, capa kaw ca ama kha hiehriy riypata a nguo va yi.
Ziytuv tie chunglie bie a ina suokha aw te capa ca iema hrawlie ahungma a le ce ta pata a cuo.
Cuorasala ama chunglie ama ruepa kha a pachangtuv Zingsuv ta haatiy pakha kha la te a thaalie padaa te,

iema kyihuo khata, “Ahunghmuo cuose kama ming ta hingpa haatiy pakha a cuhluopa ca kama naa cuhluopa ta cuo te, kama naa cuhluopa ca naa pathlietuv a cuhluopa tana a cuo. Tahematapakieca niema hrawlie a caw cepa ca a le cepa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Johan ta, “Abyipa, na ming ta khuevuo a papyapa pakha hmung pate, kiema phuv a cuo li nakawta ma thlu,” a ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta, “Thlu khah ung, tahematapakieca niema caa du lipa ca niema caa byatuv tana a cuo,” a ta.
Zingsuv lathawna riypa cuo aa vya ngie hryly tiyta, Jerusalem luo si riypata aa tha.
A hmieluo kha biephyatuv tie pathlielu yi te, a cuota ting pacie riypata Samaria khy khy kha luo kha amaa ngie.
Cuorasala Jerusalem luo a caluo riypa ama pachang nakawta capa khy ming ca ta cuhluo va yi.
Ziytuv Jeim hne Johan ta capa ca ama hmung tiyta, “Abyipa iema a kuo riypata vuoruo taata myi za patla sa se pala na khing'a ma?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta a pali te a chuo yi.
Cakhutaata khy hrang luo kha ama caluo.
Luopuv lie ama cakuole nguoluo ning kha cawsaa pakha ta Zingsuv kha, “Na sina mekaa tana ica ziy aa,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Cahnie zaw ta khue hnyi yi te, avuo lie a zulepa pavaa zaw ta buv ama hnyi, cuorasala Cawsaa Sacapaa ca a luv china hmang hmuota hnyi vyi,” a ta.
A hrangpa pakha kha Zingsuv ta, “Na ziy tie,” a ta. Cuorasala capa paa ca ta, “Abyipa, cakuo'a angte i paa va paby taa ang,” a ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta, “A thiypa tie ta amaa thiypa ca paby yi se; cuorasala nama ca vaa la Khazing pena kaw kha va phu tie,” a ta.
A hrangpa pakha ta, “Abyipa, ica ziy aa; cuorasala vaa taa ang sala i ing lie zaa ngaapa tie kha bie vaa chang taa yi ang se,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Ahunghmuo cuose thetung a patuv tli pata hnangluo a palipuopa ca Khazing pena hneta a tla vyi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Abyipa ta a hrangpa sawsariy kha a tlaw yi te a khytlawna riypa khy ting hne hmangting luo kha pahning pahning ta a pathlielu yi.

Iema kyihuo khata, “Sa hrie riypa a hluvsa a aw raalaa pata a hrietuv ca a cawta dyina a aw yi, caacuonakawta sa hrie riypa a hnyituv Abyipa ta sa a hrietuv zaw a za pathlie riypa yi ta thlaachuo tie ung.
Si tie ung. Cahnie hraw luo pathliepa tuvtaata zaw haa tana niema kha ica pathlie yi.
Tuokaa baw cuose, sahrie cuose, phyipakaw cuose a phya khah ung; ahunghmuo luopuv lie bie a chang khah ung.
Ing ing kha lalaa luo namaa ngie tiyta, ‘Hing ing chunglie diena aw mang sue,’ ta taa tie ung.
Diena a khingpa ama aw kieca, diena ca nama cunglie aw mang sue; cuorasala diena a khingpa ama aw li kieca diena ca niema'a luo vya kaa se.
Capa ing lie ca aw ung la, khaapa aca pi zaw yi ta ning ung la dang tie ung; tahematapakieca re a hrietuv ca a hrie muo kha a hmung riypa tana a cuo. Ing kha hnang ing kha ta a palaw'a va ung ciy.
Khy kha lalaa luo namaa ngie tiyta ing acaa patlung sa kie yi ca, nama hmielie ama kya pachiepa bangkhuo kha ning ung la,
capa khy lie a awpa a pasapa kha patluo sa ung la, ‘Khazing pena ca namaa thaa luo a vya chiy tli,’ ta pata chang tie ung.
Cuorasala khy khy kha lalaa luo namaa ngie tiyta ingtlung aca da kie yi ca, luopuv luo kha pya ung la,
‘Nama pha lina paluo sana ta ma phyi lie malie a kaapa nama khy lie buvcing hmuota maca cakhawsue siy yi. Cakhutaata hingpa hing pachang tie ung: Khazing pena ca aa ngie tli,’ ta tie ung.
Ica chang yi, capa ning thue ca capa khy laa cata Sodom cuo tana nangduena a aw vie aa! a ta.

“Khorazin, bawchie ciemuopa tana na cuo! Bethsaida, bawchie ciemuopa tana na cuo! Niema'a lie tuepa kharuehaa hmang hing Tair hne Sidon lie tue pata za cuo sala, buri a buv pata, buvcuo a phuv'a yi te amaa ngiepachiynapa a za pasiysa'a mangtli!
Cuorasala bieripana ning thue ca niema laa hingta Tair hne Sidon cuo tana nangduena a aw vie aa.
Cakhutaata, nama Kapernaum, vuoruo te cyicalangpa tama na cuo aa? Cuo'a vyi, Hell luo thawpa tana na cuo aa, a ta.

“Ahunghmuo cuose niema bie caa naathliepa ca kama bie naa naathliepa ta cuo te, niema caa thawpa yi ca kama naa thawpa tana ama cuo, kama naa thawpa bangkhuo ca naa pathlietuv a thawpa tana ama cuo,” a ta.
Sawsariy tie ca palungtluo ciemuo pata vya kaa yi te, “Abyipa nama ming ta ca khuevuo tie hmuo ma ri malie amaa ngie,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Vuoruo taata thinghlaa haata Setaa a za tlapa na i hmung.
Mang tie ung, pariy hne tluociekuo zaw tlawpuo khuna hne nama carie tie cahrana cunglie nawhnyina zaw kha ica pi tli yi, khaapatahmuo ruvnaana ca pi'a va yi.
Khuevuo tie ta nama ri acaa ngie nakaw yi ta nama palung tluo khah se; cuorasala vuoruo lieta nama ming capepa a cuopa kha nama palung tluo hriy se,” a ta yi.

Khapa cuo ning kha Zingsuv ca Thlaapa Pathe ta palungtluona hne pabi sa te, “I paa, alyi hne avuo Byipa, a singpa hne a thepa tie'a taata na nupa kha haatiy tie'a lie na paluo sa nakawta icaa law; a cuo, i Paa, capa ca na vihnyina cangta na khingpa tana a cuo.

I Paa ta hmangting bangkhuo ina pi diy tli. Paa ta li pata sacapaa kha ahungtahmuo pachang va yi, Paa hing ahungtama a cuo tapa zaw kha Sacapaa hne Sacapaa ta a tlaw yi te iema'a lie a phupa tie ta li pata ca ahungtahmuo pachang va yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata, Zingsuv ca ziytuv tie'a luo kha a pali te iema dyi thyi pata, “Nama hmungpa hmang a hmungpa ming zaw ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo!
Ica chang yi, profet hluvpuv hne siepahruo hluvpuv zaw ta niema nama hmungpa hing ama za hmung khing hringhruo, cuorasala za hmung va yi, ama za thyi khing hringhruo, cuorasala za thyi va yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata phungbie saya pakha ta Zingsuv dyapasya riypata a daa te, “Saya, chuozaa hringna cu riypata khaapama i tue aa,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Phungbie chunglie tuokhaatama aa cape? Capa lie ca tuokhaatama na ri?” a ta.
Cawsaapa ta, “Abyipa na Khazing ca na pathiypalung yalya, na hringna yalya, na cahrana yalya, hne na ruena yalya ta due'a cate, nama naa duepa haata na ingpaa kha va due tie, a ta,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta, “Na ripa ca aa hmuo; capa ca va tue la na hring aa,” a ta.
Cuorasala ama hne ama kha duo a pacu khing nakawta, Zingsuv kyihuo khata, “Ahungma i ingpaa ta a cuo?” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Cawsaa pakha ca Jerusalem taata Jeriko luo kha a sibung. Damie tie ta patuv yi te, a caw kha hlepa diy yi te ama tuv khutaata a thiy'a nang pata thuse yi te amaa ruo.
Capa ning ca ta tluobyi pakha ca capa luopuv luo ca sibung te cawsaapa kha a hmung ca kuokhaluo ta a cahriy.
Cahaa ngiethie cata Levi ming pakha zaw capa hmang luo ca vya chiy te a hmung ca kuokhaluo ta a ca hriy ra.
Cuorasala Samaria ming pakha ca khy a tlaw pata capa luo ca vya chiy te cawsaapa kha a hmung ca a ngiechi hringhruo.

Capa paa'a luo ca vaa te a hmaa kha chiytiy hne mingsuvtiy a thuv khutaata a catawpa; cakhutaata cawsaapa ca a sahring cung luo kha khang te khyche arina ing luo kha vaakhyi te capa lie ca a mangchiy.

A mawluopa ta denarii phiehning kha thue te khyche arina ing a huotuv kha pi te, ‘Hingpa paa hing a phata tah za mangchiy la, ama cuota na pachuo viepa bangkhuo ca hingpa luo i vya kaa pakhaa thueta ica thung diy aa, a ta,’ a ta.
Hingpa cawsaa pathung hrawlie hing ahung hing ma damie tie ta ama patuvpa paa ingpaa ta a cuo ta pata na rue?” ta pata a hiehriy.
Phungbie sayapa ta, “Ama a ngiechituvpa kha,” ta pata a palie. Zingsuv ta, “Cakuo la capa haa cata va tue tie,” a ta.
Zingsuv hne a ziytuv tie khy ama tlawle ning kha khy khy kha luo chiy yi te Martha ama tapa nung ta a ing lie aa patlung sa yi.
Ama ta Mary ama tapa nutanung pakha hnyi te, Abyipa phyi thabaw lie kha a tu te a bie kha a naathlie.

Cuorasala Martha ca a re a hluvsa nakawta a palung rie a thyisa; caacuonakawta Zingsuv'a luo kha a vaw te, “Abyipa, i nutanung ta re bangkhuo kama dyi i naa ringpa hing na ngie aa raw thluo ma? Re vaa bya la ta tie,” a ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta, “Martha, Martha, nama ca hmang hluvpuv kawlieta na palungrie a thyi;
aa hu hmisipa suokha dyina a aw. Mary ta a pha viepa hmang ca a tlaw tli te ahungtahmuo chuv'a va yi,” a ta.
Zingsuv ca suv kha lie thlaa a chuo. A pachuo pahne ta a ziytuv pakha ta, “Abyipa, Johan ta a ziytuv tie thlaachuo a changpa haa yi ta thlaachuo malie chang ra tie,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Thlaa nama chuo tiyta: Ima Paa, Na ming ca pa-uvsathyi pata cuo mang sue. Na pena tlung paatie se.
Ningting ta maa hupa sa ca malie pi tie.
Ma cunglie a suepa tie maa ngiethepa haa yi ta, ma suena kha malie a ngiethe ra tie. Pasupaliyna luo malie papha sa thi khah,” nama ta aa, a ta.
Cakhutaata iema kyihuo khata, “Abiephungpa ta niema hrawlie pakhakha ta viesaa pakha nama hnyi, a ing luo kha zuocang ta vaa ung cate, ‘I viesaapa, viechuo tluo thung du na cyi caw thi tie;
i viesaa pakha atabala hing vya chiy te i pi riy hnyi va ang,’ a ta.
Ama ta ingchung taata, ‘Hnaa na pahnaw khah; ingchiy khaa tli pate i saata zaw hne maa zie tli; kya thu pata ca pi khu va tli ang,’ a ta.
Ica chang yi, a viesaa a cuo nakawta kya thu li pata hne viechuo kha pi paluo li pata aw ra hmuo sala a hie byalya nakawta kya thu'a te a khingpa mekaa kha a pi aa.
“Caacuonakawta ica chang yi, hie ung la pi pata nama cuo aa; huv ung la nama hmung aa; cakhaw ung la nama cuota ingchiy pahaw pata a cuo aa.
Tahematapakieca a hiepa bangkhuo ca pi pata cuo'a yi te, a huvpa bangkhuo ta ama hmung aa, a cakhawpa bangkhuo ca ingchiy kha pahawpa pata ama cuo aa.
Niema hrawlie hing na saata tah ngaa caa hie yi sala ngaa cuopa ta pariy a pipa pakha chuo nama aw'a ma?
Aatiy acaa hie pata tluociekuo a pipa nama aw'a ma?

Niema a pha lipa tie ta nama saata zaw kha tuokhaatama hmang phapa i pi aa tapa nama pachang kieca, vuoruo lie a awpa nama Paa changchiy ta ca ama'a lie a hiepa tie kha Thlaapa Pathe ca khatluv tama a pi tyly'a yi,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta bie a ri the lipa khuevuo kha papya te, khuevuo a pya khutaata bie a ri the lipa cawsaapa ca ta bie a ri ca cawsaazaapuv ca ama nang ta a uo.
Cuorasala cawsaa chekha ta, “Khuevuo tie byipa Beelzebul ming tana khuevuo tie a papya yi,” ama ta.
A hrangpa tie ta ama kha ama dyapasya khing nakawta, vuoruo taata a cuopa pamangsana suokha ama hie.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta ama ruenapa kha a pachang nakawta iema kha, “Tuokhaapa pena hmuo cuose iema hne iema a che yi te amaa du kieca ama ra aa, iema'a na iema a dupa chungkhue ca amaa chepatlaa.
Setaa zaw a phuv a phuv ta amaa du kieca, tuokhaatama a pena ca aa daa khu aa? Niema ta Beelzebul ming tana khuevuo a papya ina ta ung ciy.
Kama ta khuevuo kha Beelzebul ming ta i papya kie, niema cawsaa, khuevuo papyatuv tie kha ahung ming tama ama papya? Caacuonakawta iema cana nama bie caa ripatuv ta a cuo'a yi.
Cuorasala kama na Khazing cahrana ta khuevuo kha a papya ang ta pata a cuo kieca, Khazing Pena ca niema'a luo a vya pha tli.
A thaaruvpa paa ta a cehre bangkhuo hneta a ing kha a huo kieca a hnyipa hmang ca aa bang taw.
Cuorasala a thaaruv viepa paa ta a du te a te tiyta, aa buchuopa cehre kha lapa diy te a paruvpa chechiy kha a re diy yi.
Kama naa daakhyi lipa ca naa dutuv tana a cuo; pahmya pakhaw naa bya lipa ca a cadaapatlaatuv tana a cuo,” a ta.

“A pyalyipa thlaapa ca cawsaa chungtaa khata pya te, tiy aw linapa ruocaapa chunglie kha a pahyna hmang huv riypata aa khie. Suv kha hmuo a hmung khu li tiyta, ama ta, ‘I pyase ciepa i ing luo khana i kaa pakhaa aa,’ a ta.
A kaa ca, a ing kha a pathesa pata hne aa chikaky pata a za awpa kha a hmung.

Cakhutaata vaa te ama laata a chie viepa thlaapa chiepa pasariy kha a vya chiy yi te, a ngie yi te capa lie ca ama aw. Capa cawsaapa a chuona lie aa daahmang ca a za cuo taana laa khata a chie vie,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta hingpa bie a ri nguoluopa khata cawsaazaapuv chungtaata canung pakha kya khi te, “Nama caa phyapa pawpya hne nama na pazawpa ahnung ca thluechiypa tana a cuo! a ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta, “Khazing bie kha thyi yi te a ziypa tie na thluechiy viepa ta a cuo yi,” a ta.

Cawsaa ama vya hluv vie hryly tiyta, Zingsuv ta, “Ata chuo cawsaa hing a pha lipa tana ama cuo; pamangsana tuepa riypa ama hie, cuorasala Jonah pamangsana ta li pata pamangsana hrangpa khaapahmuo pahmung sa pata cuo'a va yi.
Jonah ca Nineveh cawsaa zaw cuota pamangsana a za cuopa haa khata Cawsaa Sacapaa zaw hing ata chuo cawsaa zaw cuota pamangsana tana a cuo ra aa.

Bieripana ning lieta sungluo ruo siepahruonung ca a daa'a te ata chuo cawsaa zaw hing sue a phaw'a yi, tahematapakieca Solomon singna kha naathlie riypa tana alyi dena luo taata a vya si; mang tie ung, Solomon laata a le viepa na hingpa lie hing a aw.

Bieripana ning thueta Nineveh khy ming zaw kha a daa'a yi te ata chuo cawsaa zaw kha sue ama phaw aa, tahematapakieca iema ca Jonah phupa bie tana sue amaa zaa ngiepachiy, mang tie ung, Jonah laata a le viepa na hingpa lie hing a aw!
“Ahunghmuota myi-ing ama vuo tiyta aa nuna hmang lieta chi buo va yi, cuorasala ingchung luo zaa ngiepa tie ta ama hmung the riypa tana myi-ing vuona tung cunglie khana ama chi.
Nama ming ca nama pangpa cuota myi-ing tana a cuo. Nama ming a tluo kieca nama pangpa yalya ta a khe aa; cuorasala nama ming a tluo li kieca nama pangpa ca a zing diy aa.
Caacuonakawta nama chunglie khena hing zingna a cuo li riypa kha pachangpasie tie ung.
Nama pangpa bangkhuo ca khe diy te, a khaapa kha hmuo zingna chunglie a aw li kieca, myi-ing ta aca khepa haa yi khata a khe diy aa,” a ta.
Bie a ri nguoluo ning kha Zingsuv ca Farasi ming pakha ta sa ning a ku; caacuonakawta vaa te sa ning riypata cabya lie kha aa tu.
Zingsuv ca sa a ning hluota a kuv aa siy lipa kha Farasi ming cata hmung te a kharue a haasa.
Caacuonakawta Abyipa ta, “Niema Farasi tie ca nama panuo hne nama pakaa kha aleluo dyi pasiy ung cate, cuorasala nama chungluo ca karuo-awna hne pha lina ta nama pabi.
A ngaapa tie! Aleluo a tuetuv Khazing ta a chungluo zaw kha a tue cuo va ma?
Caacuonakawta a chunglie a awpa hmang tie kha a siypasapa tie va pi ung la khaapa bangkhuo kha nama cuota a pathe aa.

“Cuorasala Farasi tie, niema ca bawchie ciemuopa tana nama cuo! Khazing kha putinan, hruohmie, iesing hne uohnaasiyyhnaa phangting kha chehraachekha nama pi pata adangna hne Khazing duena ca hnang nama chaw. Hingpa zaw hing tue'a ung cate muo a cunglie ma ri taapa zaw hing hnangchaw li pata nama aw'a ta.
Farasi tie, niema ca bawchie ciemuopa tana nama cuo! Apungna-ing pa-uvsathyipa tie thude lie a tupa hne chadawtluo lie pa-uvsathyina hneta bie a changpa ca nama tlechuosa.
Bawchie ciemuopa tana nama cuo! Niema ca aa hnangna ama tue lipa thluo, cawsaa zaw ta pachang li pata a cunglie ama cakuo tawpa haa kha tana nama cuo,” a ta yi.
Phungbie saya tie hrawlie pakha ta, “Saya hing haa hingta na ri tiyta kiema thuo zaw malie na pachipuo ra,” a ta.

Zingsuv ta, “Phungbie saya tie, niema zaw bawchie ciemuopa tana nama cuo! Cawsaa zaw cunglie kha hmang a riypa khang ung cate, cuorasala niema ca phyakhyi riypata nama kuvdaw ta hmuo de khing va ung ciy.
Bawchie ciemuopa tana nama cuo! Nama mingchingmingvuo tie ta ama za thiepa profet tie cuo khata thluo nama tuepa.
Caacuonakawta niema ca nama mingchingmingvuo tie ta ama za tuepa kha a daakhyituv hne a pacusatuv tana nama cuo, tahematapakieca iema ta profet tie kha thie yi te niema ta ama thluo nama tue.
Caacuonakawta muo Khazing Singna ta, ‘Kama ta profet tie hne biephyatuv tie zaw kha i pathliepa'a yi, iema chungtaata chekha kha thie'a yi te chekha kha ama hrisaa aa,’ a ta ta.
Caacuonakawta ata chuo cawsaa zaw hing Abel ama za nawna taata patha pata bienatluophie hne hmangpathepa alalalieta ama nawpa
Zekhariah'a nata chuelyi hruothu baataata ama za palangpa profet tie bangkhuo thiyse muo kha hie pata ama cuo aa. A cuo, ica chang yi, ata chuo cawsaa zaw'a lie hingna hie pata a cuo aa.
Niema Phungbie saya tie, bawchie ciemuopa tana nama cuo! Thesingna ing pahawnapa taw kha cake ung cate, niema zaw a ngie lipa ung cata a ngie khingpa tie zaw kha nama pakhuo,” a ta yi.
Ale luo a pya tiyta phungbie saya tie hne Farasi tie ta ama kha hue laalaw yi te, hmang a hluvpuv kaw kha bie hluvpuv ama hiehriy,
a ripa bie mamaapa chungtaata a suena patuv khu riypata mangkhuo yi te ama huo.
Cawsaa ca a thawthaw ta a vya hmya yi te amaa tlawpuole ciemuo ning kha Zingsuv ta ziytuv tie kyihuo ta a ri taapa ca, “Farasi tie thiynung kha a raaring tie ung, phahruo amaa cuo pakhina kha.
Buvkhungpa bangkhuo kha pahawpa cuo'a te, a paruv ta tuepa bangkhuo kha pachang pata a cuo aa.
Caacuonakawta a zingna lie nama ripa ca ningchung a vuona lie pathyi sa diy pata cuo'a te, ingchiy a khaakhungna chunglie a paruv ta nama ripa kha thlungkhuv daw taata phu pata a cuo aa.
“Viesaa zaw, ica chang yi, pangpa dyi thie khu te a hnang taata capa laata a chie viepa a tue khu lipa kha ciy khah ung.
Ahungma ciy riypa tapa kha ica chang'a yi, pangpa a thie khutaata hell luo pathla khuna naw a hnyipa kha ciy tie ung. A cuo, ica chang yi, ama kha ciy tie ung!
Mingbaw sapangaa ca pie hning tana ama zaa cuo va ma? Cuorasala mingbaw sakha kha hmuo Khazing ta maw vyi.
Nama luv lie nama suobuv hmuota a ri diy. Nama thlaa zang khah se; niema ca mingbaw a hluvpuv laata nama sungnaa vie.
“Ica chang yi, malie hmiekunglie naa daakhyipa ahunghmuo cuose, Cawsaa Sacapaa zaw ta Khazing avuoming hmiekunglie i daakhyi ra aa.
Cuorasala malie hmielie naa thawpa ca Cawsaa Sacapaa ta Khazing avuoming hmiekunglie i thaw ra aa.
Ahunghmuo cuose Cawsaa Sacapaa a du pata bie a ripa ca a ngiethe pata ama cuo aa, cuorasala Thlaapa Pathe a du pata bie a ripa ca a ngiethe pata cuo'a va yi.
Apungna-ing luo cuose, uvtuv tie hne nawhnyituv tie hmieluo aca chiykhyi tiy yi ta tuokhaa ta a pahrang'a angte ma tuokhaa ta i ri aa tapa kha nama palung rie thyi khah se.
Tahematapakieca capa cuo lie caci ta nama ri riypa ca Thlaapa Pathe na caa chang'a yi,” a ta yi.
Cawsaazaapuv hraw taata pakha ta, “Saya, i paa ru kha ina che riypata i uvta kha na changpa tie,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Liechung, ahungma niema bieripatuv riypata naa chi?” a ta.
Cakhutaata iema kha, “Karuo-awna phangting taa khata a cadang tie ung; tahematapakieca cawsaa pakha hringna ca a hnyirungna lie kha aw vyi,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata pakhingpuona suokha a chang yi: “A hnyirungsapa pakha ca a lu taata kung a vyi laalaw.
Ca tiyta a palung chunglie kha; ‘I sa bangkhuo hing i china tlaw va tli. Tuokhaata i tue kie ma a pha aa?’ a ta.
Cakhutaata ama ta, ‘Hing haa hing tana i tue aa: I sa-ing hing phi'a angte na a le vie ta i sa aa. Capa lie ca i sa hne i hmang bangkhuo kha i chi aa,’ a ta.
Cakhutaata i thlaapa kyihuo khata, “'Vya i thlaapa, kung pasiypuv acaa de riypa hmang ca na hnyi mangtli; a pahy hyalya la, ning la, dang la a nuosa pata hring tie,’ i ta aa,” a ta.
Cuorasala Khazing ta, ‘A ngaapa! Ata zuo hrahring hingta na hringna ca a chuo aa. Caacuonakawta na cuota naa pacungpa hmang bangkhuo hing ahung huo tama a cuo aa? a ta,’ a ta.
Caacuonakawta ama cuota chechiy aa pacung raalaa pata Khazing hmielie a hnyirung tlung lipa ca cahaaca tana ama cuo,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta ziytuv tie kha, “Caacuonakawta ica chang yi, khaapama nama ning aa, khaapa caw ma namaa tue aa ta pata nama pangpa kawlie hne nama hringna kawlie kha nama palung rie thyi khah se.
Tahematapakieca hringna ca sa laata biepuv vie te pangpa ca cawsie laata a biepuv vie.
Ra-aa khiy rue tie ung: saciy vaa va yi, sa zaw hrie va yi, chechiy chinapa ing hne sa-ing zaw hnyi va yi, cuorasala Khazing ta a caw yi! Niema ca pavaa laata kha tluv tama nama sungnaa vie!
Nama palung rie a thyi nakawta nama hringna siymaluo pakha chuo a pasiy sa vie khupa nama aw ma?
Cahaapaapa chechiy cawta hmuo nama tue khu li kieca khaapanakawma a hrangpa kawlie ca nama palung rie a thyi?

Lili paa khiy rue syalya tie ung, tuokhaatama ama le; re hrie va yi, palaa zaw pahie ra va yi; cuorasala ica chang yi, Solomon rungnaana bangkhuo ta hmuo hingpa paapaapa paa kha puvthena tluv hing ta vyi.

Ataning hring te mawluo myi chung luo hmaw riypa ruo lie aphuv hing Khazing ta hing tluv ta a tuepangi kieca, niema changchiy ca kha tluv tama aca tuepangi vie'a yi? Nama zangna hing a caw hringhruo de!
Caacuonakawta ning riypa hne dang riypa kaw kyalya rue pata nama palung rie thyi khah se.
Tahematapakieca chuelyi ming dyina hingpa hmang hing a rue pari yi. Nama Paa ta hingpa hmang zaw hing namaa hu tapa kha a pachang.
Caacuonakawta ama pena kha huv taa ung la, hingpa hmang zaw hing pipuo pata nama cuo aa,” a ta.
“Tuvrung cawta zaw, nama thlaa zang khah se, tahematapakieca niema'a luo pena pi riypa kha nama Paa palungtluona tana a cuo.

Nama hnyipa kha zaa ung la siypasapa tie kha pi tie ung. A caw the lipa tuokaa baw kha a tue ung la a ruvhangpa ta a paruv khu lina lie hne, alungpa ta a para khu lina vuoruo lie kha a chuo the li riypa sue kha a pacung tie ung.
Tahematapakieca nama sue a awna lie khana nama pathiypalung zaw a aw ra aa.
“A ting pacie pata aw ung la, nama myi-ing kha vuo pacie tie ung.
Napuv chiyna pyi taata a vya diypa ama byipaapa kha ingchiy a cakhaw pahne ta pahaw khu paluo riypata a huopa tie haa khata cuo tie ung.

Ama byipaapa a vya kaa tiyta a hra te a raaringna a hnyipa sii ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo; biehmisi tana ica chang yi, a tesaw kha a saw'a te, ning riypata patu'a yi te, iema kha a ysy a khaasie'a yi.
Zuocang ta aa vya diy kie cuose, khydyi caw ta aa vya diy kie cuose, a ting pacie pata ama aw pata a hmungpa sii tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo.
“Cuorasala hingpa hing pachang tie ung: ing a hnyituv ta aparuvpa aa vawna riypa cuo kha a pachang kieca a ing kha paruv sa'a vyi.
Niema zaw a tingpacie pata aw tie ung, tahematapakieca Cawsaa Sacapaa ca nama mangkhuo linapa cuo lie khana aa vaw aa,” a ta.
Piter ta, “Abyipa, hing pakhingpuona hing kiema cuota ma na ri, acuolikie cawsaazaapuv cuota ma a cuo?” a ta.
Abyipa ta, “Ahung ma zang tluo aa tlapa hne a singpa tluotlatuv, a byipaapa ta a sii tie kha ama'a na a cuota lieta ama cuvu sa pi riypata a chipa ta a cuo?
Re a hrie nguoluo ningta a byipaapa ta a vya chiyhnuepa sii ca thluechiypa tana a cuo.
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, capa paa ca a byipaapa ta a hnyipa bangkhuo a mangchiytuv tana a chi aa.
Cuorasala capa sii ca ta ama hne ama kha, ‘I byipaapa ca a vya haa kalie aa,’ ta sala a hrangpa siicanung zaw siicapaa zaw kha tuvde yi te, ning dang te a pariy kieca,
a mangkhuo lina cuo ning hne a pachang lina cuo ning khata a byipaapa ca a vya chiy aa. A cekary diy'a te zang tluo aa tla lipa tie hne khata a chi hne aa.
A byipaapa ta a patue sa khingpa a pachang thluo pata, a tingtuo pata a patue sa khingpa kha a tue lipa sii ca a pasasapa tuvna na a ang aa.

Cuorasala a byipaapa ta a patue sa khingpa a pachang li pata tuv aa tlapa hmang a tuepa ca dyadyata tah tuvpa tana a cuo aa. A hluvsa pipa ca a hluvsa hie pata cuo'a te, a hluv vie pipa ca a hluv vie hie pata a cuo aa.
“Alyi hing myi ta pahlaa riypa tana i vaw, a hlaa hunglung tli sala a pha'apa kha!
Tiy a naw riypa suokha hnyi angte, capa hmang a tlung hluo li ca kha tluv tama i palung rie a thyi!
Alyi luo diena phya riypa tana aa vaw ta pata ma ina rue ung ciy? Cuo vyi, ica chang yi, achena tlaku na i za phya!
Ata taa hingta papangaa a tapa chungkhue tie ca a che'a yi te, pathung ta pahning kha a du'a yi te, pahning ta pathung kha amaa du aa.

Iema ca amaa che aa: paa ta sacapaa kha a du'a te sacapaa ta paa kha aa du aa, nung ta sacanung kha a du'a te sacanung ta nung kha aa du aa, ningnung ta munung kha a du'a te munung ta ningnung kha aa du aa,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta cawsaazaapuv kha, “Niema ta ningtla taata amyi a kya thupa kha nama hmung tiyta, sungkha ta, ‘Khy na a saa aa,’ ta ung cate a saa sasaw.
Sungluo taata thliy a kya hruo tiyta, ‘A vya palingsa aa,’ ta ung cate a palingsa sasaw.
Phahruocuo tie! Niema ta alyi hne avuo kha mang ung cate khycuo khaapama a lu aa tapa kha nama pachang khu; caacuokieca khaapanakawma ata chuo ningkhue awzya hing nama pachang va?
“Khaapama aa hmuopa ta a cuo tapa kha khaapanakawma niemata tah bie namaa chi khu va?

Tazaa caa cyipa hne bieripatuv byi hmieluo nama cakuo ning kha luopuv lieta ama hne a dawraw riypa kha a zue tie; cahaacata na tue li kieca, bieripatuv byi hmieluo kha caa dale'a yi te, ama ta paliy byi kuv luo ca hluo'a te, paliy byi ta thaw aca pathla aa.
Ica chang yi, na lu riypa tuokaa a chuopatlienapa pie kha te ta na pi diy hluo li thaw chungtaata pya'a vaciy,” a ta.
Capa cuo lie caci ca ta capa lie a awpa cawsaa chekha ta Zingsuv kha, Pilat ta ama hriykhung a rinapa hne ama thiy a pyapatlawpa Galilee ming kaw kha ama chang.
Zingsuv ta iema kha, “Cahaacata thie pata a cuopa Galilee ming ca a hrangpa tie laata ama sue vie ta pata nama rue ma?
Sue vie va yi. Ica chang yi; nama suena namaa ngiepachiy li kieca iema haa kha tana nama thiy ra aa.
Siloam ingsuo a cing ningta a vysapa cawsaa hlyicari tie kha Jerusalem lie a awpa cawsaa hrangpa zaw laata ama sue vie ta pata nama rue ma?
Cuo vyi! Ica chang yi, nama suena namaa ngiepachiy li kieca, iema haa kha tana nama thiy diy ra aa,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta hingpa pakhingpuona hing a chang yi: “Cawsaa pakha ta a mingsuv diedung chunglie thyikuv kung kung kha a cyi. A pathyi a pathyi li a va mang tiyta khaapahmuo hmung vyi.

Caacuonakawta diedung a huotuvpa kha, ‘Mang tie! Kung thung chung bangkhuo a pathyi ma pathyi va ma tapa kha i ve taw pata a thyi thyi kha hmuo hmung buo va ang. Hupatyi tie! Khaapanakawma alyi phapa ca a ning pari aa?’ a ta.
Diedung a huotuv ta, ‘Abyipa, ata kung chuo hing ca pahlung caw tie; a thabaw vya'a angte aphuvlyi pi taa ang.
Huokung a pathyi kieca a pha ciemuo aa, a pathyi li kieca hupatyi lavuo ciy,’ a ta,” a ta.
Luo kha ca Sabbath ningta Zingsuv ta apungna-ing lie a pacuv yi.
Capa lie ca thlaapa chiepa ta a hryi te kung hraa hlyicari chung a phata tah a cakuo khu lipa cawsaanung pakha a aw. A ke a kang te a dangta tah a daa khu vyi.
Zingsuv ta a hmung tiyta, u te, “Cawsaanung, na pasanapa taata hya na zang tli,” a ta.
A kuv kha a cunglie chi te, sungkhabala ta capa nung ca a dangta tah a daa te Khazing kha a pathuosa.

Cuorasala apungna-ing a uvtuvpa ca Sabbath ning ta Zingsuv ta cawsaa a patluo sa nakawta a hi haa te, cawsaazaapuv kha, “Rehriena riypata ning caruv a aw, capa ning caruv chunglie ca a vaw ung la a vya patluo sa tie ung, Sabbath ning hingta cuo li pata!” a ta yi.

Cadyiseca Abyipa ta, “Niema phahruocuo tie! Ahunghmuo cuo ung la Sabbath ning ta nama cue hne nama laa kha a khuhriy pathluopa ung cate a ing taata papya ung cate tiy padang sa riypata nama tangle cuo va ma?
Setaa ta kung hraa hlyicari chung a ciypakipa, Abraham sacanung ta a cuopa hing Sabbath ning ta hingpa ciypakina taa hingta hya pazangpa cuo'a va ma?” a ta.
Cahaacata a ri tiyta, a dutuv tie kha ama nang pazaa yi te, cawsaazaapuv ca kharuehaa hmang a tuepa cunglie kha ama palung a tluo.
Caacuonakawta Zingsuv ta, “Khazing pena hing khaapa hneta ma aa lu? Khaapa hneta ma i pakhingpuo aa?
Cawsaa pakha ta uotuo hmung kha la te diedung lie a vaapa hne tana aa lu. Uotuo ca kya le te thingkungpa ta kya cuo te, pavaa zaw ta a ce cunglie buv amaa tue,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta thukhyi pakhaa te, “Khazing pena hing khaapa hneta ma i pakhingpuo aa?
Canung pakha ta viedie beke zung thung lie a pyapa, capa viedie a pathu sapa thiynung hne tana aa lu,” a ta.
Zingsuv ca Jerusalem luo a sipuo pata khypuv khyta kha capiepaa yi te a pacuv yi.
Chekha ta, “Abyipa, cawsaa cawta dyi ma khuona a hmung'a yi,” ama ta. Zingsuv ta,
“Ingchiypakaa baapa taata a ngie riypa kha a zue tie ung; tahematapakieca cawsaa hluvpuv ca a ngie kha amaa zue raalaa pata a ngie khu'a va yi.

Ing a hnyituvpa ca thu'a te ingchiy kha a khaa aa; niema ca ale lie kha a daa pata ingchiy kha cakhaw'a ung cate, ‘Abyipa, malie pahaw tie,’ nama ta tiyta, ‘Khaapa taata ma namaa vaw tapa kha ca pachang va yi ang,’ ta pata aca palie'a yi.
Cakhutaata niema ta, ‘Nama hne sa ninghne puv, tiy danghne puv ma za tapa kha, luopuv lie zaw malie na za pacuvpa kha,’ nama ta aa.
Cuorasala ama ta, ‘Khaapa taata ma namaa vaw tapa kha ca pachang va yi ang; niema pha lina a tuepa cawsaa zaw kama'a taa hingta pya ung la cakuo tie ung!’ aca ta'a yi.
Abraham, Isak, Jakob hne profet tie bangkhuo ca Khazing pena chunglie ama awpa kha nama hmung tiyta, niema ca ale luo thaw pata cuo'a ung cate, capa lie ca caana hne haa riena a aw aa!
Cawsaa ca ningchiy hne ningtla, chaluo hne sungluo taata a vaw'a yi te, Khazing pena chunglie kha sa ama ning aa.
Hnang a chuopa ca hmaa sa'a yi te, hmaa a sapa ca hnang ama chuo aa,” a ta.
Capa cuo ning ca ta Zingsuv'a luo kha Farasi tie chekha a vaw yi te, “Herod ta aca thie khing nakawta hingpa taa hingta pya tie,” ama ta.

Zingsuv ta, “Vaa ung la capa cahnie ca, ‘Naathlie tie, ataning hne mawluo ca khuevuo kha papya'a angte a pasapa kha i patluo sa'a yi, a ning thungnapa ning ta i re kha i patlung aa ta pata va chang tie ung.
Caacuonakawta ataning, mawluo hne hezuoning ca i cakuo nguoluo kalie thluo aa; tahematapakieca Jerusalem lie ta li pata a hrang lieta profet pakha thie riypa ca cuo khu vyi,’ a ta.

Jerusalem, Jerusalem, profet tie kha thie yi cate nama'a luo vya pathliepa tie kha alung ta a vaasapa khypuv! Yi khazaa ulu ma aapuvnung ta a tachiyta zaw a mathlaa rawlie a pahmyapa haa yi ta na saata zaw hing pahmya pakhaw i khing, cuorasala khing vaciy.
Mang tie, na ing ca thuse pata a cuo aa. Cakhutaata, ica chang, ‘Abyipa ming ta a vawpa ca thluechiypa tana a cuo,’ ta pata na rina cuo a vya pha hluo li na hmung'a va tli ciy,” a ta.
Luo kha ca Sabbath ning ta Zingsuv ca Farasi tie uvthyi pakha ing luo kha sa ning riypata vaa te, capa lie ca aa ngieta tah ama mangpathliy.
A kuv hne a phyi a thlingpa cawsaa pakha ca Zingsuv hmielie kha a aw.
Zingsuv ta phungbie saya tie hne Farasi tie kha, “Phungbie ta Sabbath ning ta a pasapa patluo sa riypa a pa-aw ma pa-aw va ma?” ta pata a hiehriy yi.
Cuorasala iema ta khaapahmuo ri va yi. Caacuonakawta Zingsuv ta cawsaapa ca ku te, patluo sa te, a cakuo sa.
Cakhutaata iema kha, “Niema hrawlieta pakhakha hing a saata ma acuolikie a cue ma Sabbath ning ta takhue chung luo tla sala Sabbath ning a cuo nakawta thue paluo li pata nama aw'a ma?” a ta yi.
Hingpa kawlie hingta khaapahmuo palie khu va yi.
Zingsuv ca khyche zaw ta a tuna hmang pha cepa amaa tlawpa kha a hmung tiyta, hing pakhingpuona hing a chang yi.
“Pakhakha ta napuv chiynapa pyi luo aca ku tiy yi ta a tuna pha cepa lie kha a tu khah ung. Nama laata cawsaa le viepa zaw kha ku ra biephung yi sala,
caa kutuvpa paa yi ta nama kha, ‘Ama hing tlyi thi tie,’ aca vya ta kieca nangzaahmiechi pata aa ne cepa luo naa tuna a hu aa.

Cuorasala sa ning aca ku tiy yi ta, aa ne cepa lie kha vaa tu la caa kutuvpa paa kha a vaw'a te, ‘Liechung, kya kie la a tuna aa suo viepa lie hing a kya tu tie,’ aca ta aa. Ca tiyta nama hne cabya lie a tuhnepa kupa cawsaazaapuv hmielie kha hmiephaa na cu aa.
Tahematapakieca iema hne iema a cyicalangpa bangkhuo ca pachung pata cuo'a yi te, iema hne iema a panepa bangkhuo ca cyicalang pata ama cuo aa,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta sa ning a kutuvpa paa kha, “Ningchung sa ning cuose zuoluo sa ning cuose na ku tiy yi ta, na viesaa, na uvnu, na tieriy hne a hnyirungpa na ingpaa kha ku khah yi; tahematapakieca iema ca nama kha ca ku hriy'a yi te, cahaacata na tuepa kha thung pata na cuo aa.
Cuorasala pyi na tue tiyta, a siypasapa, kuvsaw phyisawpa, hne mingcuepa tie kha ku tie yi.
Iema ta aca ku hriy khu li nakaw'a yi ta thluechiy na hmung aa, tahematapakieca aa dangpa tie thiyna taata ama thu pakhaa ning kha thung pata na cuo aa,” a ta.
Zuo sa ning ama ku rapa pakha ta capa bie ca vya thyi te, Zingsuv kha, “Khazing pena chung saduona pyi lie a tu ra riypa tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo!” a ta.
Zingsuv ta ama kha, “Cawsaa pakha ta saduona pyi lepuv tue te cawsaa a hluvsa a ku yi.
Saduona cuo aa de tiyta, a sii zaw kha a kupa tie'a luo pathlie yi te, ‘A vaw paa tie ung; zezaw bangkhuo pachie ciepa tana a cuo tli,’ a pata sa yi.
Cuorasala ama bangkhuo ta ama cuo the linapa kha ama ri kaluo diy. A pakhanapa paa ta ama kha, ‘Luruo suokha calyi angte i va mang na a hu, naa ngiethe thi tie,’ a ta.
A hrangpa pakha ta, ‘Cuetungpa tue pangaa calyi angte ata hing a chie a pha mangna ta re pahrie sa pachiy naase ang i ta ning cuo te naa ngiethe thi tie,’ a ta.
A hrangpa pakha ta, ‘Napuv i chiy khupa tahne ta cuo te a vaw hmuo'a va ang,’ a ta.

Caacuonakawta a changtaapa ca a byipaapa'a luo kha kaa te capa kaw ca a chang. A byipaapa ca a hi haasa te a changtaapa kyihuo khata, ‘Khychung luopuv lepa hne luopuv cawta zaw luo kha a catli pata vaa la a siypasapa, kuvsaw phyisawpa, hne mingcuepa tie kha a vya chiy tie yi,’ a ta.
A changtaapa ca ta, ‘Abyipa, na ripa haa khata i tue diy tli, cuorasala a khuo ca a tlaw kalie,’ a ta.
Cakhutaata a byipaapa ta a changtaapa kha, ‘Luopuv lepa hne luopuv cawta zaw luo kha vaa la, i ing a bi hluo li cawsaa kha a vya chiy tie yi.
Ica chang, i za ku ciepa tie ahunghmuo i zuosa duopa hing a pacuo'a va yi,’” a ta.
Cawsaazaapuv ta ama ziyle nguoluo pata Zingsuv ca a pali te iema kha,
“Ahunghmuo cuose kama'a luo a vawpa ca a nung hne a paa, a napuv hne a saata zaw, a uvnu hne a sieta zaw kha hue te, ama hne ama a hringna zaw kha aa hue li kieca naa ziytuv cuo khu'a vyi.
Ahunghmuo cuose vieluotung kha a puv pata kama hnang naa ziy lipa ca kama naa ziytuv cuo khu'a va yi.
Niema chung taa pakha ta ingsuo suokha sa aa ting kieca i palangna te i tuokaa ta aa de'a ma a de'a va ma tapa pachang riypata a tu pata a chuo riypa kha tue taa li pata a aw'a ma?
Cahaacata a tue taa li kieca inghruo kha a bang khutaata palang li pata aw'a te, a hmungpa bangkhuo ta ama pahnyisue aa.
‘Hingpa paa hing ing sa ca pathu raalaa te a palang khu va hing haw,’ a ma ta aa, a ta.

Siepahruo pakhakha ta a hrangpa siepahruo pakha kha rie aa du'a nang kieca, ama a du riypata rieka thawkiy hne a vya sipa siepahruo kha rieka thawhraa ta i du khu'a ma, a du khu'a va ang ma tapa kha a tu pata rue taa li pata a aw'a ma?
A du khu li riypata a cuo kieca, siepahruo hrangpa luohlaa lie a aw kalie ning kha, arena tue riypata luosituv kha a pathlie riypata a cuo.
Cahaacata, niema zaw hing nama hnyipa bangkhuo nama thuse li kieca pakha hmuo naa ziytuv cuo khu'a va ung ciy.
“Paciy ca a pha, cuorasala a iena kha a vie kieca tuokhaatama pa-ie sa pakhaa khu pata a cuo aa?
Alyi cuota thlahnena hnyi vyi, aphuvlyi ta zaw hmuo thepa cuo'a vyi; thaw riypa dyi tana a cuo tli. Thyina naa a hnyipa ta thyi tie ung!” a ta yi.
Ngukhyituv tie hne a suepa tie kha a bie naathlie riypata aa thaa luo a maa vaw.
Farasi tie hne Phungbie saya tie kha a cie yi te, “Hingpa paa hing a suepa tie kha cuhluo yi te iema hne sa zaw a ning!” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Zingsuv ta hingpa pakhingpuona hing a chang yi:
“Niema hrawlie pakha ta tuv zakha hnyi sala sakha a vie kieca, sawcaky hne sacaky kha ruocaapa lie thuse siy'a te a viepa sakha kha a hmung hluo li a huv aa, cuo va ma?
A va hmung tiyta, a letung cunglie vya khangle te a palung a tluo hringhruo.
Ing luo a vya chiy tiyta, a viesaa hne a ingpaa zaw kha ku yi te, ‘A viepa i tuv kha hmung tli angte naa lawkhyi tie ung,’ a ta yi.
Ica chang yi, cahaacata, sue a ngiepachiy a hu lipa aa dangpa sawcaky pacaky laata a suena a ngiepachiypa a suepa pakha kawlieta vuoruo lie palungtluona a le vie a aw aa,” a ta.
“Acuolikie, canung pakha ta ngu tuokaa phie hraa hnyi sela phie kha a pavie kieca myi-ing kha a vuo'a te, a ing kha phiy'a te, a hmung hluo li a cakiy a capie te ta a phasa pata a huv aa cuo va ma?.
A hmung tiyta, a viesaa hne a ingpaa zaw kha ku'a yi te, ‘I paviepa i tuokaa kha hmung tli angte naa lawkhyi tie ung,’ a ta'a yi.
Ica chang yi, cahaacata, a suena a ngiepachiypa a suepa pakha kawlieta Khazing avuoming ama palung a tluo,” a ta.
