Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta, “Luo kha ca sacapaa pahning a hnyipa paa a za aw.
A syi viepa paa ta a paa kha, ‘I paa, i hmung riypata a cuopa ru ca na pi tie,’ a ta. Caacuonakawta a paa ta ru ca a che yi.
Cakhutaata ning a ru hluota sacapaa a syi viepa ca a hnyipa bangkhuo kha la te khy luohlaa luo kha a tlaw. A duv a khing ta hring te a hnyipa bangkhuo ca a pahli diy.
A hnyipa bangkhuo a hmuo diy khutaata capa ruo lie ca khuopuv ta cakuo tlung te a kuv cahri pata a aw.
Caacuonakawta capa khy ming pakha'a luo kha re hrie riypata vaa te, capa paa ca ta va mangchiy riypata a lu luo kha a paphya.
Va ta a ningpa khukhu haw kha a riybina te ta a ning khingsa raalaa pata ahungtahmuo pi va yi.
A palung kya sing te, ‘I paa rehrietuv tie kha ning tie li tana viechuo ama hnyi, kama tlaku ca hingpa lie hing sa i maasa'a nang!'
Thu'a angte na i paa'a luo kha si'a angte, “I Paa, Khazing cunglie hne nama cunglieta i sue tli.
Na sacapaa cuo riypata a tla va tli ang; na rehrietuv pakha haata na chi ra thi tie,” i ta aa, a ta.
Caacuonakawta thu te a paa'a luo kha a si. Luohlaapuv lie a aw kalie pata a paa ta a va hmung ca, ngiechi hringhruo te, vaa ruo te, cakuv te a pahnuo.
A sacapaa ta, ‘I Paa, Khazing cunglie hne nama cunglieta i sue tli. Na sacapaa cuo riypata a tla va tli ang,' a ta.

Cuorasala a paa ta a changtaapa zaw kha u yi te, ‘A catli pata a vaw ung! Pang pha cepa kha vya cyi ung la pabuv tie ung; a kuvdaw lie hing kuvpahryi vya pahryi ung la, a phyi lie hing phyipakaw vya pakaw tie ung.
Cakhutaata cuetaata a thu cepa kha patuv ung la thie tie ung, ning ung sala a nuo ung siy;
tahematapakieca, i sacapaa hing za thiy te a hring pakhaa; za vie te i hmung pakhaa!’ a ta. Cahaacata pyi tue ca ama pathu.
“A sacapaa uvthyipa ca lu lieta a aw; lu taa cata vya si te ing athaa luo a vya chiy tiyta, hlaa sa pu hne luo pu kha a thyi.
Caacuonakawta a changtaapa pakha kha u te, ‘Khaapama a cuo nguoluo?’ ta pata a hiehriy.
Ama ta, ‘Na nuta kha ing luo vya kaa tena, hnaatluosapa hne a bangta tah a vya chiy nakawta, na paa ta cuetaata a thu cepa kha a thiepa,’ a ta.
Sacapaa uvthyipa ca a hi haa te ingchung luo a ngie khing li pata a aw. A paa ta kya pya te a ripasa.

Cuorasala a paa kha, ‘Naathlie tie, hing zaw kungnung na re kha sii haata hrie angte, na ri caa ngie li pata aw buo va ang. Cuorasala i viesaa zaw hne anuona pyi tue riypata mietaata sakha hmuo na pi buo vaciy!
Cuorasala siyhrawnung tie'a lieta na hnyipa bangkhuo a pachuo diypa, hingpa na sacapaa ing luo a vya kaa tiyta cuetaata a thu cepa na thiepa!’ ta pata a palie.
A paa ta palie te, ‘I sacapaa, nama ca kama'a lie aw pari cate i hnyipa bangkhuo hing nama huopa tana a cuo.
Cuorasala na nuta ca za thiy te ata hing a hring pakhaa, za vie te ata hing hmung pakhaa pata a cuo; caacuonakawta pyi tue pata palungtluona hne maa nuo riypa tana a cuo,’ a ta,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta ziytuv tie kha, “A hnyirungpa pakha za aw te tluotlatuv pakha a hnyi. Capa tluotlatuv cana na tuokaa kha a cuo lipa lie a hmuo ta pata ama chang.
Caacuonakawta ama ca ku te, ‘Na kaw i thyipa hing tuokhaatama a cuo? Na rehriena cazing kha a tlingsa pata na pi tie, tahematapakieca nama ca i tluotlatuv cuo khu'a va tli ciy,’ a ta.
Tluotlatuv ca ta ama hne ama kha, ‘Tuokhaatama i tue aa? I byipaapa ta i re taata ina papya'a tli. Alyi ta i chie khu'a va, malie a hie chaw riypa cata i nang a zaa.
Tluotlatuv taata ina papya tiyta cawsaa ta ama ing lie ina pa-aw sa khing riypa yi ta khaapama i tue aa tapa kha bie i chi na a hu,’ a ta.
Caacuonakawta a byipaapa'a lie lyibuo a awkhyipa tie kha pakha hnang pakha ta ku yi te, a pakhanapa paa kha, ‘I byipaapa kha khazaa ma naa uo?’ a ta.
Ama ta, ‘Olif chiytiy pung zakha,’ ta pata a palie. Tluotlatuv ca ta, ‘Na cazing kha va la, a catlisa pata a tu la sawngaa ta pare tie,’ a ta.
Cakhutaata a hrangpa pakha kha, ‘Nama haw khazaa ma naa uo?’ a ta. ‘Jungsacuochuo tuo zakha,’ ta pata a palie. ‘Tluotlatuv ca ta, ‘Na cazing kha va la lah sawcari ta pare tie,’ a ta.

Aa dang lipa tluotlatuv ca singvaasa pata hmang a tue nakawta a byipaapa ta a pathuosa; tahematapakieca ata chuo cawsaa zaw hing ama hmang tuenapa kawlie ca khena chunglie a awpa tie laata ama singvaa vie,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta ica chang yi, chuelyi suethiy a chuo tiyta chuozaa ta aa hmangpa ing lie cuhluopa nama cuona riypata chuelyi suethiy hing hmuo ung la viesaa a tue tie ung.
“Chechiy cawta lie zang tluo aa tlapa ca chechiy lepa lie zaw zang tluo aa tla ra; chechiy cawta kawlie zang tluo aa tla li kieca chechiy lepa kawlie zaw zang tluo a tla'a vyi.
Chuelyi sue patungpatiena kawlieta zang tluo namaa tla li kieca tuokhaatama hnyirungna hmisi ca pi pata nama cuo khu aa?
Malie chechiy cunglie hmuo zang tluo namaa tla li kieca tuokhaatama niema huo a cuopa chechiy ca aca pi khing'a yi.

Changtaapa pakha ca a byi pahning re kha hrie khu'a vyi; pakha kha hue'a te a hrangpa pakha kha a due aa, pakha'a lie kha zang tluo aa tlasa pata aw'a te pakha kha siysaa ri li pata a aw aa. Khazing re hne hnyirungna re kha hrie pakhe khu'a va ung ciy,” a ta yi.
Capa bangkhuo ca tuokaa a khingsapa Farasi tie ta ama thyi tiyta, Zingsuv kha ama pahnyisue.

Caacuonakawta Zingsuv ta, “Niema hing malie minghmungna lie ca a dang hruo namaa cuo; cuorasala Khazing ta nama pathiypalung kha aca pachang yi; tahematapakieca cawsaa ta muosung ciemuo pata ama ruepa ca Khazing hmiekunglieta duvsamakhie aa chiypa tana a cuo.

“Moses phungbie hne profet tie capepa caa zaw ca tiynawtuv Johan chuo te cuo kha tana a cuo; capa cuo ning taa cata Khazing pena thuophaa ca phu pata cuo te, cawsaa ting ta pena chung luo kha amaa ngie chuv patlaw.
Cuorasala phungbie chunglie a caw cepa caasuo suokhata hmuo a viepa laata alyi hne avuo rapa na a na vie aa.
“Ahunghmuo a napuv kha ma te canung hrangpa hne a hlawpa ca nungvaathingsuena a tuepa tana a cuo; cahaacata a navaapa hne a chepa canung a hlawpa zaw nungvaathingsuena a tuepa tana a cuo.
“Luo kha ca a hnyirungpa cawsaa pakha aw te, a ciycaapa hne cawthang phapa cawsie muo ruvpa kha a tue te ningtating ta tuokaa a hluvsa pachuo pata pyi a tue taw.
Lazaru ama tapa a siypasapa, a pangpa bangkhuo hmaa ta a buvpa paa ca
a cabya taata a tlapa kha a haa'a angte i riy a bi aa tapa hnabiesyina hneta a hnyirungpa paa chiypakaa lie kha laa te, uv kha a vaw te a hmaa kha ama vya pali taw.
“Siypasapa paa ca thiy te avuoming ta Abraham hne aw riypata ama sikhyi. A hnyirungpa paa zaw kha thiy te ama paby.
Hell chunglie riethyina a ang nguoluo pata cungluo kha a kya mang ca luohlaapuv taata Abraham hne aa thaalieta Lazaru kha a kya hmung yi.

Khuosa ta u te, ‘I paa Abraham, ngie na chi thi tie. Lazaru kha za pathlie thi la a kuv daw kha tiy luo naw sala i palyi lie hing na za pathlasue se, tahematapakieca hingpa myi chunglie hing i rie na a thyituv tli,’ a ta.

Cuorasala Abraham ta, ‘I sacapaa, na hring chunglie kha phana hmung tli cate, cahaacata Lazaru ta a pha lipa a cu. Cuorasala ata hing ca ama ca hingpa lie hing a nuosa pata aw te, nama ca ruvnaana na ang.
Ca hlyitaw taata maa lalalie hing ryihue a thuvsapa aw te, hingpa taata namaa'a luo a vya chiy khingpa zaw vya chiy khu lipa yi ta, nama'a taata kiema'a luo zaw a vaw khu aw vyi,’ a ta.
A hnyirungpa paa ta, ‘I paa, Lazaru kha i paa ing luo pathlie thi tie,
tahematapakieca uvnu papangaa hnyi yi angte iema chuo, hingpa te-angna luo hing ama vya chiy ra li riypata a raaringna va pi thi yi se,’ a ta.
Abraham ta, ‘Na uvnu zaw ta Moses hne profet tie ama hnyi; iema bie khana ama naathlie riypata a cuo,’ a ta.
A hnyirungpa paa ca ta, ‘Cuo vyi, i paa Abraham; thiyna taata pakhakha ta iema'a luo kha a vaa kieca ama suena kha amaa ngiepachiy aa,’ a ta.
Abraham ta, ‘Moses hne profet tie bie kha amaa ngie li kieca cawsaa pakhakha thiyna taata a thu pakhaa zaw ta zang hlyi'a va yi,’” a ta.
Zingsuv ta a ziytuv tie kyihuo khata, “A pachiyna cuo hing a aw pari aa, cuorasala capa hmang a pacuosatuv ca bawchie ciemuopa tana a cuo.
Hingpa haatiyta zaw pakhakha hing luo a papie sapa ca nama rue lie sacuo rienapa alungtung pathlie pata riyliy luo thaw pata cuo sala nama cuota a pha vie aa.
A raaring tie ung! Na uvnu kha a sue kieca pasiypa-ya tie, aa ngiepachiy kieca a ngiethe tie.
Capa cawsaa ca ning kha ta na cunglie yi sariy sue sala, a yi sariy ta nama'a luo kha a vaw te, ‘I ngiepachiy,’ aca ta kieca a ngiethe tie,” a ta.
Ziytuv tie ta Abyipa kha, “Ma zangna hing pale sa vie tie,” ama ta.
Abyipa ta, “Uotuo hmung tie zangna nama hnyi kieca, hingpa puvlung kung hing, ‘A kya phie la riyliy lie hue vaa caby tie,’ ta ung la nama ri acaa ngie'a yi.
“Niema hrawlie hing ahungma le thawna taata, acuolikie tuvkhiena taata atabala lie a vya chiypa nama sii kha, ‘Luo hing a vaw paluo la cabya lie a vya tu tie,’ a ta'a ung ciy?
‘Zuosa kha vya pachie la, buohryi pasiypa kha a hryi la, sa i ning chung hne i dang chung kha na mangchiy la, cakhutaa cata ning la dang tie,’ ta'a va ung ca ma?
Sii ca na changpa kha a tue nakawta alawna bie na hluo ma?
Niema zaw cahaaca tana nama cuo ra, tue riypata aca changpa yi nama tue diy tiyta, ‘Kiema ca dutle lipa sii tana ma cuo; ma tue riypata a cuopa dyi khana ma tue,’ ta tie ung,” a ta.
Zingsuv ca Jerusalem luo a si ning kha, Samaria hne Galilee alalalie khata a ziyle.
Khy khy kha luo kha aa ngie ca caahminghmaa a phyapa cawsaa pahraa ta amaa vya taw.
Luohlaa puo lie kha a daa yi te, “Zingsuv, Abyipa, malie ngiechi thi tie,” ta pata ama khi.
Zingsuv ta iema kha a hmung tiy yi ta, “Cakuo ung la tluobyi tie kha vaa pamang sa tie ung,” a ta yi. Ama vaale pata ama pathe.
Iema hrawlie pakha ta a tluopa kha aa hmung tiyta, kaa te Khazing kha ueryi paringsa pata a pathuosa.
Zingsuv phyi thabaw lie kha a bu te Zingsuv kha alawna bie a hluo. Ama ca Samaria ming ta a cuo.
Zingsuv ta, “Pahraa patluo sa pata cuo va yi ma? A hrangpa pacaky tie haw khaapaliema ama aw?
Hingpa ruohrangpa paa hing ta li pata pakha hmuo vya kaa pata Khazing pathuosa vade yi?” a ta.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta, “Thu la cakuo tie; na zangnapa na caa patluo sa,” a ta.
Luo kha ca Farasi tie ta Zingsuv kha khatiythuema Khazing pena ca a tlung aa ta pata ama hiehriy. Ama ta, “Khazing pena ca ming ta hmung khupa phang ta vya tlung'a vyi.
Ahungtahmuo, ‘Mang tie, hingpa lie hing na a aw! acuolikie, ‘Huepa lie hue na a aw!’ ta'a va yi; hmisi ta ripa kieca, Khazing pena ca niema chungliena a aw,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata a ziytuv tie kha, “Niema ta cawsaa sacapaa ningcuo ning kha chuo nama hmung khing hringhruo raalaa pata nama hmung khu lina cuo kha aa vaw nguoluo.
Niema kha, “Mang tie ung, huepa lie hue a aw hue! acuolikie, hingpa lie hing a aw hing!’ aca ta'a yi. Pya pata vaa lie ung ciy.
Thinghlaa ca avuo kiy kha taata kiy kha te a khepahlipa haa kha tana Cawsaa Sacapaa ca ama ning thueta ca a cuo aa.
Cuorasala a suokhana ta ama ca khuosa ta te-ang taa'a te ata chuo cawsaa tie hingta ama thaw taa aa.
Noah chuo ning haa khata Cawsaa Sacapaa chuo ning zaw kha a cuo ra aa.
Noah kha tiypalaw chung luo aa ngiena te ta, cawsaa zaw ca ning yi dang yi te, canung hne capaa zaw amaa chiy amaa hie. Cakhutaata tiypa-aa ca tlung te iema bangkhuo kha a para diy yi.
Cahaacata, Lot chuo ning zaw a cuo ra; ning yi dang yi te, zaa yi te ama calyi, ciy cyi yi te ing ama sa.
Cuorasala Lot ta Sodom a pyase ning kha vuoruo taata myi hne ke kha khy saa ta za saa te ama palang ta a thie diy yi.
Cawsaa Sacapaa aa luo thue ca cahaaca tana a cuo ra aa.
Capa ning thueta ca ing thlungkhuv cunglie a awpa ta ing chunglie a awpa chechiy la riypata cung khah se; cahaacata lu lie a awpa ta ing luo kaa khah se.
Lot napuvnung kha a thyi tie ung!
A hringna aa bangpa a khingpa tie ca ama hringna kha a sung'a yi te, a hringna a sungpa tie ca hringna kha ama hmung aa.
Ica chang yi, capa zuo ningta ca iehmang suokha lie a ziehnepa cawsaa pahning lie kha pakha ca la pata cuo'a te, pakha ca thuse pata a cuo aa.
Sung a suv hnepa canung pahning lie kha pakha ca la pata cuo'a te a hrangpa pakha ca thuse pata a cuo aa,” a ta.
(“Lu lie a awpa cawsaa pahning lie kha pakha ca la pata cuo'a te pakha ca thuse pata a cuo aa,”) a ta.
Cakhutaata, ama kha “Abyipa, Khaapaliema?” ta pata ama hiehriy. Zingsuv ta, “Saa thiypa a awna lie kha luotaa ta amaa hmyasuele aa” a ta.
Cakhutaata, Zingsuv ta ziytuv tie kha palung chuo li pata thlaachuo pari riypata pakhingpuona a chang yi.
Ama ta, “Khy khy kha lieta Khazing ciy li pata cawsaa hmie zaw a mang lipa bieripatuv byi pakha a aw.
Capa khy lie ca nunghlyinung pakha aw te, capa nunghlyinung ca ta, ‘Kama hne i cariepa alalalie kha bie malie ripa la tazaa naa cyipa cawsaa hmiekunglie hing duo na pacu tie,’ a vya ta byalya.
Cuo kha chung ca a pakaa, cuorasala a hnangcaw ta ca, ‘Khazing ciy li pata cawsaa hmie zaw i mang li raalaa pata
hing nunghlyinung hing hnaa ina pahnaw pari, a vaw byalya pata riethyi ina pi li riypata aa hmuopa tana bie ca i ripa aa,’ a ta,” a ta.
Abyipa ca ta, “A pha lipa bieripatuv byi ta a ripa hing naathlie tie ung.
Caacuokieca Khazing ta aa tlawpa, ama'a luo chung zuo ta a upa tie ca ama bie kha aa hmuo pata ripa li pata a aw'a yi ma? Iema a bya riypata a pahaa a pasaa'a ma?
Ica chang yi, Ama bie kha a catli pata, aa hmuo pata a ripa'a yi. Cuorasala Cawsaa Sacapaa aa vaw tiyta alyi lie hing zangna a hmung'a ma?” a ta.
Zingsuv ta hingpa pakhingpuona hing, iema'a na iema a zangpa, iema kha maa dang ta pata a rue yi te malie a nutaapa tie kha a chang yi.
“Cawsaa pahning kha thlaachuo riypata biena-ing luo ama cakuo, pakha ca Farasi ming ta cuo te a hrangpa pakha ca ngukhyituv ta a cuo.

Farasipa ca ama se ta a daa te hing haa hingta thlaa a chuo, ‘Khazing, kama ca malie haata a ruvhangpa, cawsaa a dung a viepa, aparuvsuena a tuepa hne, hingpa ngukhyituv zaw haa hingta i cuo li nakawta icaa law.
Zaa kha chunglie ning hning sa uv angte, i hmungpa bangkhuo taata chehraachekha ica pi,’ a ta.
Cuorasala ngukhyituv ca luohlaapuv luo khata a daa te avuo luo hmuo mang nguo li pata a cacunghnaa kha a cung te, ‘Khazing, a suepa kama hing ngie na chi thi tie,’ a ta.

Ica chang yi, a hrangpa paa kha cuo li pata hingpa paa hingna duopacu cie pata a ing luo a cakuo; tahematapakieca iema hne iema a cyicalangpa bangkhuo ca pachung pata cuo'a yi te, iema hne iema a panepa bangkhuo ca cyicalang pata ama cuo aa,” a ta.
Cawsaa ta haaseta zaw te kha hmuo a kuv ta hrie naase yi ta pata Zingsuv'a luo amaa vawkhyi. Ziytuv tie ta ama hmung tiyta, cahaacata tue li riypata khuosa ta ama thlu.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta ku yi te, “Haatiy zaw ca kama'a luo kha a vaw yi se, thlu khah ung; tahematapakieca Khazing pena ca hing haapa haatiy zaw cuo hing tana a cuo.
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, ahunghmuo cuose, Khazing pena kha haatiyta haa hingta a cuhluo lipa ca, capa pena chung luo ca a ngie khu buo hluo'a va yi,” a ta.
Uvtuv pakha ta Zingsuv kha, “A phapa Saya, chuozaa hringna cu riypata khaapama i tue aa?” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Khaapanakawma a phapa ina ta ciy? Khazing ta li pata ahunghmuo pha va yi.
Phungbie kha na pachang: ‘Nungvaathingsuena tue khah; Lie va naw khah; Paruv khah; A cuo lipa bie lie malie vaa daakhyi khah; Na nung hne na paa va ciyzaa yi,’ ta pata a cuopa kha a ta.
Capa paa ca ta, “Hingpa bangkhuo hing ca i cawta baataata i ziy ciepa tana a cuo,” a ta.

Zingsuv ta capa bie ca a thyi tiyta, “Naa bu kaliepa na suokha a aw. Na hnyipa bangkhuo kha zaa la na tuokaa kha a siypasapa tie pi tie yi, caacuokieca vuoruo lie suethiy na hnyi aa; cakhutaata a vaw la na ziy tie,” a ta.
Cuorasala cawsaapa ta capa bie ca a thyi tiyta a ngie a chi; tahematapakieca ama ca a hnyirungsapa tana a cuo.
Zingsuv ta ama kha mang te, “Khazing pena luo a hnyirungpa tie a ngie riypa hing kha tluv tama a ruv aa!
A hnyirungpa Khazing pena luo a ngie riypa laata ca kala-uv sakha ciphang khue chung luo a ngiepa na a na vie,” a ta.
A bie a thyipa tie ta, “Ahungma khuona ca a hmung khu aa?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Cawsaapa cuota a cuo khu lipa hing Khazing cuota ca a cuo khu,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Piter ta, “Mang tie, Kiema ca ma ing ma lu kha thuse pate nama maca ziy tli,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta iema kha, “Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, ahunghmuo cuose Khazing pena vuolieta, ing cuose, napuv cuose, uvnu zaw cuose, nungpaa zaw cuose, saata zaw cuose a thusepa ca
ata chuo lie hing ale hluvpuv ta hmung riypa hnyi'a te, a vaw riypa chuo lie zaw chuozaa hringna a hmung aa,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta ziytuv hlyihning tie kha a hrangta tah ku yi te, “Naathlie tie ungh! Jerusalem luo vaa'a ung pate capa lie ca profet tie ta Cawsaa Sacapaa kaw ama capepa bangkhuo kha a tling aa.
Ama ca Jentail ming kuv luo pi pata cuo'a te, iema ta ama tue hyalya aa, ama ese aa, ama paciy ta ama pacha aa.
Tuv'a yi te ama thie aa, cuorasala ning thungna lieta a thu pakhaa aa,” a ta.
Cuorasala ziytuv tie ta hingpa kaw hing khaapahmuo pachang va yi; a ri khingna kha nukhuo pata ama cuo nakawta khaapama a ri tapa kha pachang khu va yi.
Zingsuv ca Jeriko khy luo a vya chiy'a nang caw ta mingcuepa pakha ca luokie lie kha zaa tu te a za hie nguoluo yi.
A thaalie cawsaazaapuv ama vya cakuolepa pu kha a thyi tiyta, khaapama a cuo tapa kha a hiehriy yi.
Iema ta, “Nazareth khypa Zingsuv na a vawle,” ama ta.
Ama ta, “David Sacapaa, Zingsuv, ngie na chi thi tie!” ta pata a u.
Hmieluo lie a awpa cawsaa tie khata duo riypata khuosa ta ama thlu; cuorasala, “David Sacapaa, ngie na chi thi tie!” ta pata khuo vie ta a u hryly.
Zingsuv ca a daa te mingcuepa paa kha ama'a luo a vawkhyi riypata a chang yi. Aa thaa luo a vya chiy tiyta Zingsuv ta,
“Khaapa na tuepa se tapa ma na khing?” a ta. Ama ta, “Abyipa, i ming hmung the pakhaa se tapa na i khingsa,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Hmung tie, na zangnapa na caa khuo,” a ta.
A ming ca sungkha ta vuo pakhaa te, ama kha ziy te Khazing kha a pathuosa. Cawsaa bangkhuo ta ama kha ama hmung tiyta Khazing ama pathuosa.
Zingsuv ca Jeriko khychung kha cahraw te a sile.
Capa lie ca ngukhyituv byi lepa, a hnyirungsapa Zakie ama tapa kha a aw.
Zingsuv kha ahungma ta pata hmung aa zue, cuorasala ama ca cawsaa dang pachangpa ta cuo te cawsaazaapuv ta ama pakhuo nakawta hmung khu vyi.
Caacuonakawta cawsaazaapuv hmieluo kha a ruo te Zingsuv hmung riypata saikamor kung kha a kie.
Zingsuv ta capa hmang luo a vya chiy tiyta kya angchiy te, “Zakie, a catli pata za cung tie, tahematapakieca ataning hing na ing liena ica tlung aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta a catli pata za cung te alawna hneta Zingsuv kha a ing lie ca aa patlung sa.
A hmungpa bangkhuo ca a cie patlaw yi te, “Hingpa paa hing a suepa ing lie tlung riypa tana a vaa,” ama ta.

Zakie ta a daa te Abyipa kyihuo khata, “Mang tie, Abyipa, i hnyipa khingkhuo hing a siypasapa tie na i pi'a yi; cawsaa pakha hmung riypa kha dung angte i la pathlyi kieca, le paliy ta i pi pakhaa'a yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta, “Ataning hingpa ing lie hing khuona a tlung mangtli, tahematapakieca hingpa paa zaw hing Abraham sacapaa tana a cuo ra.
Cawsaa Sacapaa ca a viepa huv riypa hne khuo riypa tana aa vaw,” a ta.

Capa bie ama naathlie nguoluo ning kha, Zingsuv ta pazue te pakhingpuona suokha a chang yi, tahematapakieca ama ca Jerusalem kha pha'a nang tli te Khazing pena ca a vya tlung paluo'a tli ta pata ama rue.
Caacuonakawta ama ta, “Byi pakha ca ruo luohlaapuv luo kha si pata siepahruo a cuo khutaata ing luo vya kaa riypata aa ting.
A sii pahraa kha ku yi te pound phiehraa a pi khutaa yi ta, ‘I vya kaa hluo li sung za pali tie ung,’ a ta yi.
Cuorasala a ruo ming khata ama kha hue yi te, ‘Hingpa paa hingta malie a uv riypa khing vapuv,’ ta pata biephyatuv kha ama pathlie.
Capa paa ca siepahruo ta a cuo khutaata a vya kaa. Tuokaa a pipa a sii tie kha sung palina taata khazaa ma ama hmung tapa a pachang khing nakawta a paku sa yi.
A pakhanapa paa kha hmieluo vya pya te, ‘Abyipa ina pipa ciy tuokaa pound suohraa khata amie tuokaa pound suohraa i hmung,’ a ta.
Ama ta, ‘A pha, sii phapa tana na cuo! Hmang cawta kawlie zang tluo aa tlapa na cuo nakawta khypuv khy hraa kha uv tie,’ a ta.
A pahningnapa paa kha a vaw te, ‘Abyipa, na tuokaa kha tana a mie tuokaa pound suopangaa i hmung,’ a ta.
Capa paa kyihuo cata, ‘Nama zaw khypuv khy pangaa uv tie,’ a ta.
Cakhutaata, a hrangpa pakha kha a vaw te, ‘Abyipa, na tuokaa ca hingpa lie hing na a aw; pavya ta cataw angte na i chi,
tahematapakieca nama ca cawsaa tateta-iepa ta na cuo; na huopa a cuo lipa kha la cate ciy na cyi lina lie sa a hriepa na cuo nakawta ica ciy,’ a ta.
Ama ta, ‘Sii chiepa, na bie mamaapa tana na bie ica ripa aa. A tateta-iepa i cuopa hne i huopa a cuo lipa kha la angte, ciy i cyi lina lie sa i hriepa zaw kha ina pachang ciy cuo va ma?
Caacuokieca, khaapanakawma i tuokaa hing bank lie chi li pata na aw? Cahaacata za chi la ca i vya kaa tiyta i tuokaa kha amie hneta i hmung riypata a cuo,’ a ta.
A thaalie a daapa tie kha, ‘Tuokaa kha ama'a taa hingta la ung la tuokaa pound suohraa a hnyipa paa kha pi tie ung,’ a ta yi.
(Iema ta, ‘Abyipa ama ca tuokaa pound suohraa a hnyi tlipa kha!’ ama ta.)
Ama ta, ‘Ica chang yi, A hnyipa tie bangkhuo kha a hluv vie ta pipa cuo'a yi te, cuorasala khaapahmuo a hnyi lipa tie kha ama hnyi tlakuopa kha hmuo lapa pata ama cuo aa.
Cuorasala ama siepahruo cuo riypata naa khing lipa i carie tie kha hingpa luo hing a vawkhyi ung la i hmielie hing thie tie ung,’” a ta.
Zingsuv ca hingpa bie a ri khutaata ama hmieluo ta Jerusalem luo kha a si.
Olif tluo ama tapa hmang, Bethfeih hne Bethani khy athaa luo ama phapa khata, a ziytuv pahning kha hmieluo pathlielu yi te,

“Nama hmieluo lie a awpa khy luo kha vaa ung la, khy chung luo nama vaa ngiepa khata amaa khang buo li liepa laataata aa hre thluopa kha nama hmung aa. Pathluo ung la hingpa luo hing a vya chiy tie ung.
Pakhakha ta, ‘Khaapanakawma nama pathluo,’ aca ta kie yi ca, ‘Abyipa na a hu,’ nama ta aa,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta a pathliepa tie ca si yi te a changpa haa yi khata ama va hmung.
Laataata kha ama pathluo nguoluo pata, a ziy a cuopa tie ta iema kha, “Khaapanakawma nama pathluo?” ama ta.
Iema ta, “Abyipa na a hu,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv'a luo kha a vya chiyle yi te, ama pang kha a ke lie ama padie khutaata Zingsuv ca ama pakhang sa.
Laa aa khanglenapa luopuv lie kha cawsaa ta ama pang kha ama phaale.

Olif Tluo taata za cungbungnapa luopuv a va pha'a nangcaw khata a ziytuv cawsaa bangkhuo ca ama hmungpa, a tuepa kharuehaa hmang kawlie khata Khazing ama pathuosa, palungtluona hne khuopuv ta khi yi te,
“Abyipa ming ta a vawpa ca thluechiypa tana a cuo! Vuoruo lie thlaalungna aw sala, aa suo cepa vuoruo lie khiy rungnaana aw mang sue!” ama ta.
Cawsaazaapuv hraw taata Farasi tie chekha ta Zingsuv kha, “Saya, caa ziytuv tie hing padie sa tie yi,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Ica chang yi, iema hing ama die kieca alung zaw hingna a khi'a yi,” a ta.
Khypuv ca vaa ngie hryly te a hmung tiyta caa te,
“Ataning diena cuota tuepa hmang hing pachang the la ca! Cuorasala capa hmang zaw ca na ming hmungna taata nu pata ama cuo.
Na carie tie ta aca cadung diyna te ta riekhuocaaca kha ca sasue'a yi te aca khaakhuona cuo hne a kuo bangkhuo taata aca vya cadena yi cuo ca aa vaw aa.

Khazing ta aca vya pariena cuo kha pachang li pata naa pa-aw sa nakawta, nama hne na saata zaw kha alyi hne ca cariepuo'a yi te naa lung zaw suokha cunglie a hrangpa suokha hmuo aa pacangcang pata thuse'a va yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ca Biena-ing chung luo kha a ngie te chechiy a zaapa tie kha aa cade diy yi.
Cakhutaata, “Caapathe chunglieta, ‘Kama ing ca thlaachuona ing tana a cuo aa,’ a ta; cuorasala niema ta aparuvpa tie a chuona hmang ta nama tue,” a ta yi.
Zingsuv ca ningting ta biena-ing lie kha a pacuv yi. Tluobyi lepa tie, phungbie saya tie hne uvthyi tie ta ama thiena riypa luo kha ama huv byalya;
cuorasala cawsaa bangkhuo ta a bie suokha hmuo pahlyi khing lipa yi ta ama naathlie nakawta thie khuna luopuv hmung va yi.
Ning kha ca Zingsuv ta Biena-ing chunglie cawsaa kha pacuv yi te thuophaa a ri nguoluo ning kha, tluobyi lepa tie, phungbie saya tie hne uvthyi tie kha a vaw yi te,
“Malie chang tie, hingpa hmang zaw hing khaapa nawhnyina tama na tue? Ahungma hingpa nawhnyina hing caa pi?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Kama zaw bie suokha ca hiehriy'a yi angte na chang tie ung:
Johan tiynawna hing vuoruo taata ma, acuolikie cawsaapa'a taata ma?” a ta yi.
Iema'a na iema kha a rue pakhaw yi te, “'Vuoruo taata,’ ta se pala, ‘Khaapanakawma nama zang va?’ malie a ta aa.
‘Cawsaapa'a taata,’ ta se pala, cawsa bangkhuo ta alung ta malie ama vaa aa; tahematapakieca iema ta Johan ca profet ta pata ama zang,” amaa ta.
Caacuonakawta, khaapa taata ma aa vaw tapa pachang vapuv, ama ta.
Zingsuv ta iema kha, “Kama zaw khaapa nawhnyina tama hingpa hmang zaw hing i tue tapa kha ca chang ra'a va yi ang,” a ta yi.
Zingsuv ta cawsaa kha hingpa pakhingpuona hing a chang yi: “Cawsaa pakha ta mingsuv diedung tue te, rehrietuv tie kha pahlie yi te cuo pasiypuv chung ruo hrang luo khy a tlaw.
Mingsuv lu tiy aa de tiyta, rehrietuv tie'a luo kha a cuvu la riypata a sii pakha a pathlie. Cuorasala rehrietuv tie ta ama kha tuv yi te a kuv cahri pata ama pathlie.
Cakhutaata a sii hrangpa pakha kha a pathlie; capa paa zaw ca rehrietuv tie ta tuv yi te nangzaahmiechi pata ama tue khutaata a kuv cahri pata ama pathlie.
Cakhutaata a sii pathungnapa kha a pathlie ngiethie; rehrietuv tie ca ta capa paa zaw ca hmaa a phyana te ta tuv yi te khungthing luo ama thaw.
Cakhutaata mingsuv diedung a hnyituvpa ca ta, ‘Tuokhaatama i tue aa? I duepa i sacapaa hingna i pathlie aa, ama hing ca ama hmiezaa ngiethie aa,’ a ta.
Cuorasala rehrietuv tie ta ama kha ama hmung tiyta, pakha hne pakha kha, ‘Ama hingna a rucutuv ta a cuo; thie'a ung puv, cakiedyina a ru hing kiema huopa ta a cuo aa,’ amaa ta.
Caacuonakawta diedung khungthing luo kha thaw yi te ama thie. Cakhutaata mingsuv diedung a hnyituvpa ta rehrietuv tie kha tuokhaa tana a tue thlu'a mang yi nama ta ma?
A vaw'a te capa rehrietuv tie ca thie'a yi te diedung kha a hrangpa tie a pi'a yi,” a ta. Capa ca ama thyi tiyta, “Cuo hrue thi khah se!” ama ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta iema kha mang yi te, A cuo kie, “Caapathe chunglieta: ‘Ing satuv tie ta ama thawpa alung ca, ingkiylung tana aa li,' a tapa hing a siyluo khaapatama a cuo?
Ahunghmuo cuose hingpa alung cunglie a tlapa ca kyipatlaa'a yi te capa alung ta a tlasuepa tie ca ama zapatlaa diy aa,” a ta.
Phungbie saya tie hne tluobyi lepa tie ta kiema na malie a tapake tapa kha ama pachang tiyta, Zingsuv kha patuv paluopa ama khing, cuorasala cawsaa kha ama ciy.

Caacuonakawta ama kha mangpathliy yi te a bie mamaapa ta kalaa khu riypa hne naw a hnyituv muokiy byi kuv chung luo kha bie ripa riypata phakhyi khuna riypata cawsaa phapa haata a pa-aw sapa ngiepatlietuv tie kha ama pathlie.
Iema ca ta Zingsuv kha, “Saya, na ripa hne na pacuvna hing aa hmuo ta pata ma pachang, cawsaa pahlyipale vaciy, biehmisipa haata Khazing khingna kha na pacuv yi.
Rom siepahruo'a luo ngukhyi pipa hing ma phungbie ta a pa-aw ma, a thlu ma?” ama ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta ama zyatena kha a pachang nakawta,
“Ngu tuokaa phiekha na pahmung tie ung. Ahung hmiechang hne ahung ming ma a taa?” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Siepahruo hmiechang hne siepahruo ming,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Caacuokieca siepahruo huopa ca siepahruo kha pi ung la Khazing huopa ca Khazing kha pi tie ung,” a ta yi.
Cahaacata cawsaazaapuv hmielie kha a bie ripa ta patuv khu va yi; bie a paliepa yi kha ama nang ta uo te a dieta tah ama aw.
Thiyna taata thupakhaana aw vyi a tapa Sadusi ming chekha ca Zingsuv'a luo kha a vaw yi te bie ama hiehriy.

“Saya, Moses ta malie a capepa siypa ca, cawsaa pakha ta saata hnyi li pata a napuv kha a thiyse biephung kieca, nunghlyinung kha a uvnu pakha ta a hlaw'a te a thiypa a uvnu cuo khata saata ama sapa aa.
Uvnu pasariy aw yi te, a pakhanapa paa ca napuv chiy te saata hnyi li pata a thiy.
Cakhutaata a pahningnapa paa hne
a pathungnapa paa ta a hlaw yi te, cahaacata ama pasariy yalya ta saata sa li pata ama thiy diy.
A hnangcaw ce ta cawsaanung zaw ca a thiy ra.
Caacuonakawta thupakhaana ning thueta capa cawsaanung ca ahung napuv tama a cuo aa? Tahematapakieca ama pasariy ta ama kha amaa zaa hlaw kaluo,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta iema kha, “Ata chuo capaa hne canung ca amaa chiy amaa hie;
cuorasala a vaw riypa chuo lieta hring riypata aa tla tapa tie hne thiyna taata pathu pakhaapa tie ca a chiy a hie'a va tli yi.
Iema ca thiy khu'a va tli yi, tahematapakieca avuoming haata cuo'a yi te thupakhaana saata ama cuo nakawta Khazing saata tana ama cuo aa.

A kuo nguoluopa ruohraw kaw a capepa lieta Abyipa kha ‘Abraham Khazing, Isak Khazing, hne Jakob Khazing ta te Moses ta a ripa kha a thiypa tie ca hringna luo pathu pakhaa pata na ama cuo tapa kha a paluo sapa tana a cuo, a ta.
Ama ca a hringpa tie Khazing ta cuo te a thiypa tie Khazing ta cuo vyi; tahematapakieca cawsaa bangkhuo ca ama'a lie a hringpa selaw tana ama cuo,” a ta.
Phungbie saya tie chekha ta, “Saya, na bieripa ca a pha ciemuo!” ama ta.
Tahematapakieca ama kha bie hiehriy vie nguo va tli yi.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta iema kha, “Tuokhaatama Messiah ca David sacapaa tana a cuo, ama ta the?
David hrahring ta Salm caa-uv chunglie, “Abyipa ta i Byipaapa kha,
‘Na carie tie kha na phyipazaa rawlie chaapuo riypata i tue hluo li yi, i cacuoluo kuo hingta a tu tie, a tapa kha,’ a ta.
David ta Abyipa a ta kieca tuokhaatama Messiah ca ama sacapaa ta a cuo the aa?” a ta.
Cawsaa bangkhuo thyi pata ziytuv tie kha,

“Phungbie saya tie kha a raaring tie ung, iema ca buohryi pasiypa a hryi pata a khiele khingpa, chadawtluo lieta cawsaa ta pa-uvsathyina hne bie amaa chang riypa kha a tlechuopa, hne apungna-ing thude pha cepa lie hne pyi chunglie pa-uvsathyina hmang lieta a tupa kha a tlechuopa tana ama cuo;
Nunghlyi tie ing kha chuv yi te mang aa ngiena riypata a pasiysa ta thlaa ama chuo. A ruv viepa duotena na ama ang aa,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta a kya mang ca a hnyirungpa tie ta biena-ing tuokaa thingkaw lie sue ama pathla nguoluopa kha a hmung;
a siypasapa nunghlyinung ta piesepa pie hning a pathlapa zaw kha a hmung.
Ama ta, “Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, hingpa nunghlyinung hingna a hrangpa bangkhuo laata a hluv vie a pi;
tahematapakieca a hrangpa tie ca ama hnyipa a hluvsa chungtaata ama pipa tana a cuo, cuorasala hingpa nung hing ca a siy a pasasa thluo pata na a hringna cuota a hnyipa bangkhuo kha a pi diy,” a ta.
Chekha ta Biena-ing kha alung puvthesapa ta ama panginazya hne Khazing'a luo ama pihluopa lasaw kaw zaw kha ama ri tiyta, Zingsuv ta,
“Hingpa bangkhuo hing nama hmungpa haata, alung suokha hing hmuo a hrangpa suokha cunglie aa pacangcang pata a aw lina cuo kha aa vaw aa,” a ta.
Iema ta, “Saya, capa hmang ca khatiy thueta ma a cuo aa? Capa ca a vya tlung aa tapa pachangna ta khaapa pamangsana hmang ma a vya aw aa?” ta pata ama hiehriy.

Zingsuv ta, “Aca dung li riypa yi ta a raaring tie ung; tahematapakieca cawsaa hluvpuv kha i ming ta a vaw'a yi te, ‘Kama hingna Ama ta a cuo ang!’ ca ta'a yi te, ‘A cuo na a ngie tli,’ aca ta'a yi. Iema kha ziy khya ungh.
“Rie amaa tuvna hne a duna kaw nama thyi tiyta ciy khah ung; cahaapa hmang ca a vya tlung taa aa, cuorasala a chuona ta vya paziy paluo'a va lie,” a ta.
Cakhutaata iema kha, “Mingphang phang kha hne phang kha, pena suokha hne suokha amaa du aa;
aling khuosa ta a siy'a te, hmangting lie cakuona hne puvtlung pasana a tlung aa; ciy aa chiypa kharuehaa hmang hne pamangsana lesapa kha avuo taata aa luo aa.

“Cuorasala hingpa hmang bangkhuo a vya tlung hluota niema ca ca patuv'a yi te aca hrisaa'a yi; apungna-ing luo kha ca chiykhyi'a yi te thaw aca pathla'a yi; I ming kawlieta siepahruo tie hne uvtuv byi tie hmiekung luo aca chiykhyi'a yi.
Capa ca nama cuota tehtekhuona cuo pha tana a cuo aa.
Niema hne niema kha a rikuo pacie riypata nama palung chunglie kha a ting pacie khah ung,
tahematapakieca bie hne singna kha ca pi'a yi angte nama carie tie ahungtahmuo nama bie kha a du pata ca i khu'a va yi.
Nama nung nama paa, nama uvnu, nama tieriy hne nama viesaa tie ta calyi'a yi te chekha ca aca thie'a yi.
Kama kawlieta cawsaa bangkhuo ta aca hue'a yi.
Cuorasala nama luv lie suobuv buv kha hmuo vie'a vyi.
Namaa daapahrang khu kiena hringna nama hmung aa” a ta yi.
“Rieka tie ta Jerusalem ama cadungpa kha nama hmung tiyta a ru hluota a ra'a tli tapa kha nama pachang aa.
Ca tiyta Judea lie a awpa ca tluocung luo kha a ruo yi se, khypuv chunglie a awpa ta pya yi sala khyta lie a awpa tie ca khypuv chung luo kha a ngie khah yi se.
Tahematapakieca hingpa tie hing phuvlana ning tapa kha cuo te Caapathe ta a ripa bangkhuo a tlingna riypata a cuo.

Capa ning hne cuo lie ca nu a phyapa canung hne haaseta a hnyipa canung cuota ca bawchie ciemuopa tana a cuo! Tahematapakieca hingpa alyi cunglie hing ciy aa chiypa ruvnaana za tlung'a te, hingpa cawsaa zaw cunglie hing Khazing duotena a tlung aa.
Iema ca zueziy ta thiy'a yi te chekha ca chuelyi ruo ting luo kha sii ta a dapa ama cuo aa; Jentail ming ta Jerusalem kha iema cuo a tlingna te ama phyi ta ama chaapuo aa.
“Ning hne thlaapa hne aasiy lie khiy pamangsana hmang aa luo aa. Chuelyi cung ruo zaw ca riyliy tiylaw pachipa hne a khipa pu khata ciyna hne lalilahie chiy pata a tue'a yi.
Chuelyi cunglie a tlung riypa ama rue tiyta, cawsaa ca ama palung vie'a te amaa lie aa, tahematapakieca vuoruo cahrana zaw ca amaa cahang aa.
Cakhutaata, ‘Cawsaa sacapaa amyi chunglieta cahrana hne rungnaa lesyina cangta aa zuvpa kha,’ ama hmung aa.
Hingpa hmang zaw a vya chiy a vya cuole tiyta, a daa ung la nama hning pada tie ung, tahematapakieca niema athlana ning ca aa ngie tli,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta pakhingpuona suokha a chang yi: “Thyikuvkung hne thingkung bangkhuo kha mang tie ung;
a hnaa a kya pakiypa nama hmung tiyta, cuovuo na a ngie tli tapa kha nama pachang.
Cahaa cata, hingpa hmang zaw a vya tlungpa nama hmung tiyta, Khazing pena ca aa ngie tli tapa kha nama pachang aa.
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, Ata chuo cawsaa zaw hing hingpa hmang bangkhuo a vya cuo hluo li ca thiy'a va yi.
Alyi hne avuo ca ama ra aa, cuorasala kama bie ca ra'a vyi.
“A raaring tie ung, pariyna te ta ning dangna kaw hne khysatungbangna kawlie palungriethyina kaw dyi kha rue khah ung, capa ningkhue ca ta rue li pata ca vya pha'a yi te
cyihyi pa-uo ta aca pa-uo'a yi. Tahematapakieca capa ning ca chuelyi cunglie a awpa cawsaa bangkhuo cunglie a vya tlung aa.
A vya tlung riypa hmang bangkhuo taa hingta nama law khuna riypata thaazuo nama hnyi riypa hne Cawsaa Sacapaa hmielie namaa daa khuna riypata a raaringsa pata aw ung la thlaachuo pari tie ung,” a ta.
Zingsuv ca ningting ta Biena-ing lie kha pacuv yi te zuo a vya chiy tiyta pya te Olif ama tapa tluo luo kha aa kya ri taw.
Biena-ing lie a bie naathlie riypata cawsaa bangkhuo ca mawdiy ta ama thu.
Lawsena Pyi ama tapa Thiynung phuv lipa Viechuo pyi kha aa ngie tli.
Tluobyi lepa tie hne phungbie saya tie ca cawsaa kha ama ciy nakawta Zingsuv kha a paruvta tah thie riypata luopuv ama huv nguoluo.
Cakhutaata Setaa ca ziytuv hlyihning hrawlie pakha ta a cuopa Iskariot ama tapa Judah chung luo kha aa ngie.
Tluobyi lepa tie hne biena-ing a huotuv abyi tie'a luo kha vaa te Zingsuv kha iema'a luo a lyi khuna riypata bie a vaa rue yi.
Ama palung tluosa te tuokaa pi riypata ama palung a tling.
Ama zaw a palung tling te cawsaazaapuv pachang li pata iema kuv chung luo Zingsuv a pi the riypa yi cuophaa dyi kha a bya.
Thiynung phuv lipa Viechuo Pyi, Lawsena tuvtaata tah hriykhung a rina cuo kha a vya pha.
Caacuonakawta Zingsuv ta Piter hne Johan kha pathlie yi te, “Vaa ung la ima ning riypata Lawsena Pyi sa kha va pachie tie ung,” a ta yi.
Iema ta, “Khaapa lie va pachie yi se tapa ma malie na khing?” ama ta.
Ama ta, “Naathlie tie ung, khypuv chung luo nama vaa ngie tiyta tiybi ta tiy a vya cabalepa paa kha namaa taw aa. Aa ngienapa ing te khata va paziy ung la,
capa ing a hnyituvpa kha, ‘Saya na, khaapa khuo hing ma naa ziytuv tie hneta Lawsena Pyi sa i ningna riypa khuo ta a cuo? a ta,’ va ta tie ung, a ta yi.
A cung khuo lie thude hne cabya tluotlingsa pata ama chipa a khuo kusapa kha ca pahmung'a yi te capa lie ca va pachie tie ung,” a ta yi.
Vaa yi te Zingsuv ta a changpa dadang haa khata hmangting bangkhuo kha va hmung yi te capa lie ca Lawsena Pyi sa ca ama pachie.
A cuo a vya tling tiyta, Zingsuv ca ziytuv tie hne khata cabya lie aa tu.
Ama ta, “Hingpa Lawsena Pyi zuosa hing ruvnaana i ang hluota niema hne ning pakhaw riypa hing i khing hringhruo.
Tahematapakieca ica chang yi, Khazing pena chunglie hingpa hing patling sapa a cuo hluo li ning'a va tli ang,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ca panuo kha la te alawna bie a hluo khutaata, “Hingpa hing a la ung la a re tie ung;
ica chang yi, ata taa hingta Khazing pena a vya tlung hluo li hingpa mingsuvtiy hing dang'a va tli ang,” a ta.
Cakhutaata viechuo kha la te, alawna bie a hluo khutaata, chechi te iema kha pi yi te, “Hingpa hing niema cuota i pipa i pangpa tana a cuo, kama a thyi pakhaana riypata za tue mya ung,” a ta yi.
Cahaacata zuosa ama ning khutaata panuo kha la te, “Hingpa panuo, nama cuota i lyipa hing i thiyse chunglie biekuona thaapa tana a cuo.
Cuorasala mang tie ung! Kama naa lyituvpa ca hingpa cabya lie hing kama hneta maa tuhne hing.
Cawsaa Sacapaa ca rawrue ciepa haa tana a si aa, cuorasala ama a lyituvpa cuota ca bawchie ciemuopa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata iema pakha hne pakha kha, hing haapa hmang hing ahung hing ma a tue aa, ta pata amaa hiehriy.
Ziytuv tie hrawlie kha ahungma a le cepa ta rue riypata a cuo, ta pata bie a ina a puv.
Zingsuv ta, “Jentail ming siepahruo tie ta ca ama cawsaa zaw kha ama khing ta ama lesue; capa naw a hnyituv zaw ca phana a tuetuv tie, ama za ta taw.
Cuorasala niema'a lie ca cahaacata cuo'a vyi; niema hrawlie a le cepa ca a syi cepa haata aw'a te, luochiytuv a cuopa ca changtaapa haata a cuo riypa tana a cuo.
Ahungma a le vie? Sa ning riypata a tupa kha ma, sa a pituv kha ma? Cabya lie a tupa kha le vie va ma? Cuorasala kama ca niema hrawlie hing sa a pituv haa kha tana i aw,” a ta yi.
“Ruvnaana i ang chung bangkhuo naa awpuotuv ca niema tana nama cuo;
i Paa ta a pena ina pipa haata kama zaw ta niema kha ica pi'a yi.
I pena chunglie i cabya lie kha nama ning nama dang aa, byithude cunglie kha a tu'a ung cate Israel ming phang hraa hlyihning kha bie nama ripa aa,” a ta yi.
Zingsuv ta, “Simon, Simon, naathlie tie! Setaa ta niema bangkhuo kha suo cathlyi haata cathlyi riypata naw a hie tli.
Cuorasala, na zangna aa lie li riypata thlaa ica chuopa. Kama'a luo naa vya pali pakhaa tiyta na uvnu zaw kha thaazuo pi mya yi,” a ta.
Piter ta, “Abyipa nama hne thaw tlahne riypa hne thiy pakhaw riypata a ting pacie pata na i aw!” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Piter, ica chang, ata zuo lie hing, pachang va ang ta pata yi thung ina thaw hluo li ciy, aa khang'a vyi,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta ziytuv tie kha, “Tuokaa baw, sahrie, hne phyipakaw a cake li pata ica pathlie ning yi kha suokha chuo a tluo tling lipa a aw ma?” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Aw vyi, suokha hmuo aw vyi,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta iema kyihuo khata, “Cuorasala ata hing ca, tuokaa baw a hnyipa ca a phya se, cahaacata sahrie zaw a phya se. Zueziy a hnyi lipa ca a buohryicungle kha zaa sala a calyi se.

Tahematapakieca ica chang yi, Caapathe ta, ‘Ama ca a suepa tie hrawlie ripuo pata a cuo mangtli,’ ta pata kama kaw a capepa kha a tling aa; kama kaw ama capepa bangkhuo kha a vya tlingle lawmaw aa,” a ta.
Iema ta, “Mang tie, Abyipa, hinglie hing zueziy suohning a aw,” ama ta. “Capa zaa cata aa de aa!” ta pata a palie yi.
Zingsuv ca a tue tawpa haa khata pya te Olif Tluo luo kha kie te a ziytuv tie ta ama paziy.
A hmang luo a pha tiyta iema kha, “Pasupaliyna chung luo nama tla li riypata thlaachuo tie ung,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata alung vaa khang aa hlana luo kha vaa te, a pakhuv pane te thlaa a chuo.
“I Paa, na palung a tling pata a cuo kieca hingpa panuo hing na lapa thi tie; cuorasala kama khingna haata cuo li pata nama khingna haata cuo mang sue,” a ta. [
Vuoruo taata avuoming pakha zaa luo te thaa a pi.
Palung rie thyisa pata khuo vie ta thlaachuo te a mathle ca thiydiy haata alyi luo a tla.]
A thlaachuona taata thu te ziytuv tie'a luo kha a kaa tiyta amaa zaa hmung diypa kha a hmung yi, ama ngie a chisa nakawta a cuo.
Ama ta, “Khaapanakawma namaa hmung? Thu ung la pasupaliyna chung luo nama tla li riypata thlaachuo tie ung,” a ta yi.
Zingsuv bie a ri nguoluo kalie pata a ziytuv tie pahraa hlyihning chung taata pakha ta a cuopa Judas ta aa vya chiypa cawsaazaapuv kha ama vya chiy tlabya. Zingsuv kha pahnuo riypata a vaa ngie;
cuorasala Zingsuv ta, “Judas, Cawsaa Sacapaa hing pahnuona tama na lyi,” a ta.
A thaalie a awpa tie ta hmang a vya cuo riypa kha ama hmung tiyta, “Abyipa, zueziy hingta a ce'a kanaa yi pamaw?” ama ta.
Iema hraw taa pakha ta tluobyi lepa siipaapa kha a vya ce te a cacuoluo naakue a sa pathla.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta, “Ade se!” a ta. A naakue kha hrie te a patluo sa.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta ama patuv riypata a vawpa tluobyi lepa tie, biena-ing paliy byi tie hne uvthyi tie kha, “Kama hing damie ta na ri ung cate ma zueziy hne tungbung hneta namaa vaw?
Ningting ta niema hne Biena-ing chunglie i aw ning kha na patuv vade ung ciy. Cuorasala ata hing ca khyzingna huvhaa a cahra ning cuo te, niema cuo tana a cuo!” a ta yi.
Zingsuv ca patuv yi te tluobyi lepa ing luo kha ama sikhyi. Cuorasala Piter ta aa hlapuo a ziy yi.
Tlawhmie khingkhuo lieta myipung thaw yi te amaa tu pakhawna lie kha Piter ca aa tu ra.
Myi kielie aa tupa kha changtaanung pakha ta hmung te hmiedesuo ta mang te, “Hingpa paa zaw hing Zingsuv'a lie a aw rapa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cuorasala Piter ta, “Cawsaanung, capa paa ca pachang va ang,” a ta.
A cawta a awpa ta pakhapa ta hmung te, “Nama zaw hing iema hraw taa pakha tana na cuo,” a ta. Cuorasala Piter ta, “Cawsaapa, cuo va ang,” a ta.
Siymaluo pakha tluv khutaata a hrangpa pakha ta a cusa pata, “Hingpa paa hing Zingsuv hneta a aw rapa tana a cuo hrahring, tahematapakieca Galilee ming tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cuorasala Piter ta, “Cawsaapa, khaapa kaw ma na ri tapa pachang va ang!” a ta. Capa cuo lie, bie a ri nguoluo kaliepa cata aa a khang.
Abyipa ca a pali te Piter kha a mang. Cakhutaata Abyipa ta, “Ata zuo aa a khang hluota yi thung te ina thaw'a ciy,” a tapa kha Piter ta aa kya thyi.
Ale luo kha pya te palung ityalya khata a caa.
Zingsuv ca a patuvpa tie khata tue hyalya yi te ama tuv.
A ming kha pahruv yi te, “Ahungma caa tuv, ri tie,” ama ta.
Cahaacata esena bie kha a cunglie a hluvsa ama ri.
Khy a dyi taata Judah uvthyi tie, tluobyi lepa tie, hne phungbie saya tie kha a hmya yi te, Zingsuv ca bieripatuv phuv hmiekung luo kha ama chiykhyi.
Iema ta, “Messiah na cuo kie malie chang tie,” ama ta. Ama ta, “Ica chang zaw yi ta na zang'a va ung ciy;
bie ica hiehriy zaw yi ma na palie'a va ung ciy.
Cuorasala ata taa hingta Cawsaa Sacapaa ca Khazing cahrana cacuoluo kuo lie patu pata a cuo aa,” a ta.
Ama bangkhuo ta, “A cuo kie, Khazing Sacapaa ta na cuo ma?” ama ta. Ama ta, “I cuopa ca niema na a ri ung ciy,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaa iema ta, “Khaapa pachangkhyituv hrangpa ma a hu'a tli! Ama pakaa taa hrahring tana ma thyi tli!” ama ta.
Ama phuv yalya khata a thu yi te Zingsuv ca Pilat hmieluo ama chiykhyi.
Ama kha pachie yi te: “Hingpa paa hingta ma cawsaa zaw kha a cuo lipa luo aa chiy yi; siepahruo'a luo ngukhyi pi'a va ung ciy ta te, kama hingna Messiah, siepahruo ta a cuo ang, a ta,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Pilat ta, “Judah ming siepahruo ta na cuo ma?” a ta. Zingsuv ta, “Na ripa haata i cuo,” ta pata a palie.
Cakhutaata Pilat ta tluobyi lepa tie hne cawsaazaapuv kha, “Hingpa paa hing a suena hmung va ang,” a ta yi.
Cuorasala khi vie hryly yi te, “A pacuvna ta Judea pe bangkhuo hnaahnawna a chiykhyi, Galilee taata pathu te hingpa hmang te hing a vya chiy tli,” ama ta.
Capa ca Pilat ta a thyi tiyta, hingpa paa hing Galilee ming ta a cuo ma? ta pata a hiehriy yi.
Pilat ta Zingsuv ca Herod ta a uvnapa ruo chung taa tana a cuo tapa kha a pachang tiyta, Zingsuv ca Herod'a luo kha a paphya, capa cuo ning ca Herod zaw kha Jerusalem lie a aw ningta a cuo.
Herod ca Zingsuv a hmung tiyta a palung a tluo hringhruo, tahematapakieca Zingsuv kaw kha za thyi pari te a tuepa kharuehaa hmang hmung riypa kha aa nguopuo nakawta a hmung khingnapa a pasiysa tli.
Zingsuv kha bie a hluvsa a hiehriy, cuorasala Zingsuv ta kaa kha hmuo palie vyi.
A thaalie a tupa tluobyi lepa tie hne phungbie saya tie ta khuopuv ta sue ama phaw.
Herod hne a rieka tie zaw ta Zingsuv ca ese yi te ama tue hyalya; pang rungnaapa kha pabuv yi te Pilat'a luo kha ama paphya pakhaa.
Capa ning lie ca ta Herod hne Pilat ca viesaa ta amaa li; capa hluota ca carie tana ama za cuo.
Cakhutaata Pilat ta tluobyi lepa tie, uvthyi tie hne cawsaa zaw kha ku yi te,
“Niema ta hingpa paa hing cawsaa na a cuo lipa luo aa chiy yi ta pata kama'a luo nama vya chiykhyi. Niema hmielie hrahring i hiehriypasie tiyta niema ta nama pachiepa suena suokha hmuo hmung va ang.
Herod zaw ta hmung ra vyi, caacuonakawta kiema'a luo malie a vya paphya pakhaa. Hingpa cawsaapa hingta thiy aa phuvpa hmang suokha hmuo tue vyi.
Caacuonakawta asung ta pachisa'a yi angte i pathlie aa,” a ta.
(Lawsena pyi kyry ta Pilat ta thaw a tlapa pakha a pathliepa pari taw yi.)
Cawsaazaapuv ca khi yi te, “Ama kha thie tie! Barabbas kha malie pathliepa tie!” ama ta.
(Barabbas ca khypuv chunglie a duna a papuv sa nakaw hne lie a naw nakawta thaw ama pathlapa tana a cuo.)
Pilat ta Zingsuv kha a pathlie khing nakawta cawsaazaapuv'a lie kha bie a ri pakhaa;
cuorasala khi pakhaa yi te, “Vieluo lie thie tie! Vieluo lie thie tie!” ama ta.
Pilat ta a yi thungnapa ta, “Khaapa suena ma a tue? Thiy aa phuvpa suena a cunglie suokha hmuo hmung va ang! Asung ta pachi sa'a yi angte na i pathlie aa,” a ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ca vieluo lie thie riypata ama khi khu thiyta khi yi te ama hie cade pari nakawta, iema ueryi khata a te.
Caacuonakawta Pilat ta ama hiena haata pi riypata biechina a tue.
Ama khingpa paa, aduna a tue nakaw hne lie a naw nakawta thaw ama pathlapa paa kha pathliepa yi te, Zingsuv kha iema khingna haata ama kuv luo a pi yi.
Zingsuv ama sikhyilepa khata, khyta taata khypuv luo a vya chiypa Sairin khy ming Simon kha patuv yi te, vieluotung kha papuv sa yi te Zingsuv hnangluo kha ama paziy sa.
Cawsaa hluvpuv ta ziy yi te capa hrawlie ca a cacunghnaa a cung pata a caakhyi nguoluopa canung chekha zaw ama aw.
Zingsuv ta iema kha a palichiy yi te, “Jerusalem sacanung zaw, kama cuota ca caa khah ung; niema cuo hne nama saata zaw cuo khata caa hriy tie ung.
Tahematapakieca cawsaa ta, ‘A cingpa canung, nu a phya buo lipa hne haatiy ta aa hnung a pazaw buo lipa ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo!’ ama tana cuo kha a vya pha aa.
Cakhutaata cawsaa ta tluo zaw kha, ‘Malie za cingsue la!’ ta'a yi te tluothlue zaw kha, ‘Malie za buvkhung la!’ ama ta aa.
Tahematapakieca thing a hring ning hmuo hing haapa hmang hing tuepa a cuo kieca a rue taa changchiy ca khaapama a lu aa?” a ta.
A hrangpa, a suepa pahning kha, Zingsuv hne thie hne riypata ama sikhyi ra.
“Luvruv,” ama tapa hmang ama pha tiyta, capa hmang lie ca Zingsuv kha vieluo lie khepuo yi te, a suepa pahning zaw kha a cavyiluo ta pakha a cacuoluo ta pakha ta pata vieluo lie ama khepuo ra. [
Zingsuv ta, “I Paa! A ngiethe tie yi, tahematapakieca khaapama ma tue tapa kha pachang va yi,” ] a ta. Cakhutaata a caw kha a re riypata vyisung amaa da.
A thaalie a daapa cawsaa tie ta ama mang nguoluo ning kha Judah uvthyi tie ta tue hyalya yi te, “Malie ca a khuo yi; Khazing ta aa tlawpa Messiah a cuo kie ama hne ama kha a khuo se,” ama ta
Rieka tie zaw ta ama tue hyalya ra, khawchiy yi te mingsuvtiy thuepa kha pi yi te,
“Judah ming siepahruo ta na cuo kieca nama hne nama kha a khuo tie,” ama ta.
A luv cunglie ama taapa caa ca, “Hingpa paa hing Judah Siepahruo tana a cuo,” ta pata ama cape.
Capa lie ama pathlie rapa a suepa paa pakha ta bieke ta, “Nama ca Messiah cuo va ca ma? Nama hne nama kha a khuo la kiema zaw hing malie khuo tie nie!” a ta.
Cuorasala a hrangpa pakha khata ama kha chuo te, “Ama hne aa lupa biechina rawlie na aw nguoluo thluopa hingta ma Khazing ciy li pata na aw?
Kiema cuota biechina ama tuepa hing ca aa hmuopa tana a cuo, tahematapakieca ma hmang tuepa cunglie ang aa tlapa khana ma ang; cuorasala hingpa paa hing ca pha lina khaapahmuo tue vyi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv kyihuo khata, “Vya Zingsuv, na pena chung luo naa vaw tiyta naa thyi thi mya!” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Biehmisi tana ica chang, ataning kama hne Paradis lie na aw aa,” a ta.
Ningchung khingkhuo hraw taata zuoluo siymaluo pathung te alyicung yalya lie zingna a tlung.
Ning a zing chung cata Biena-ing pangzu ca tlaa te che hning ta aa che.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ca khuopuv ta khi te, “I Paa, i thlaapa ca na kuv chungluo na ica pi,” a ta. Capa ca a ri khutaata a huv a ci.
Riebyipa ca hmang a cuopa kha a hmung tiyta, Khazing kha pathuosa te, “Hingpa paa hing suena a hnyi bangby lipa tana a cuo!” a ta.
Capa hmang mang riypata a hmyapa cawsaa zaw ca hmang a cuopa kha ama hmung tiyta ama cacunghnaa kha a cung yi te amaa diy.
Pangpa ta Zingsuv a pachangpa bangkhuo hne Galilee ruo taata ama a ziypa canung zaw ca a luopaa khata a daa yi te ama suo.
Cawsaa phasapa hne a dangsapa Josef ama tapa paa ca bieripatuv phuv chunglie a te rapa a cuo raalaa pata
ama tingtuopa hne ama hmang tuepa kha a palung tling vyi. Ama ca Judah ming khy Arimathea taata cuo te Khazing pena a tlung riypa kha a huopa ta a cuo.
Pilat'a luo kha vaa te Zingsuv riyy kha a hie.
A riyy kha vieluo cung taata pachung te, pawruo ta cataw te, ahungtahmuo hmuo buo li liepa alung ama ryipa thluo chunglie a paby.
Capa cuo ca Atingdawna ning ta cuo te Sabbath ning kha aa thu tyalya tli.
Galilee ruo taata Zingsuv hneta a vawpa canung zaw ca Josef kha ziy yi te thluo hne Zingsuv riyy tuokhaatama ama chi tapa kha ama va mang.
Cakhutaata kaa yi te ziyhmyi hne sathu kha pachie pacie pata ama chi. Sabbath ning ca phungbie haa khata amaa pahy.
Zaapuv ning mawdiy ta canung zaw ca ziyhmyi ama pachiepa kha a cyi yi te thluo luo ama vaa.
Thluo khaakhuvlung a zaa hnyipa kha ama hmung,
cuorasala a chung luo amaa ngie tiyta, Zingsuv riyy kha hmung va yi.
Ama nang dyi a uo ning ta pang ruopa a buvpa cawsaa pahning kha sungkha ta amaa thaalie amaa vya daa.
Canung tie ca ama ciysa nakawta alyi luo kha amaa bung, cuorasala cawsaa tie ca ta, “Khaapanakawma a hringpa kha a thiypa zaw hrawlie nama huv?
Ama ca hingpa lie hing aw vyi, a thu pakhaa tli. Galilee lie a aw ningta khaapama aca chang yi tapa kha a thyi tie ung,
Cawsaa Sacapaa ca a suepa tie kuv luo kha pi pata cuo'a te, vieluo cunglie ama thie aa, ning thungna lieta a thu pakhaa aa,” a tapa kha, a ta yi.
Cakhutaata canung zaw ca a bie kha a kya thyi pakhaa yi te,
thluo taa cata vya kaa yi te, capa bangkhuo ca ziytuv hlyikha hne a hrangpa tie kha ama chang.
Capa kaw kha ziytuv tie a changpa tie ca Mary Magdalin, Joanna, Jeim nung Mary, hne iema'a lie a aw rapa canung hrangpa tie khata ama cuo.
Cuorasala capa bie ca ziytuv tie ta bie laliy lipa ta rue yi te zang li pata ama aw.
Cuorasala Piter ca a daa te thluo luo kha aa ruo; a bung te thluo chung luo kha a mang ca riyy catawnapa pawruo dyi a hmung; hmang a cuopa cunglie kha nang-uosana cangta ing luo a kaa.
Capa ning ngiethie lie ca ta ziytuv pahning ca Jerusalem taata me sariy hraw aa hlapa Emmaus ama tapa khy luo kha si yi te,
hmang a cuopa kaw kha amaa ruele.
Cahaacata bie amaa ruele nguoluo ning kha Zingsuv ta a vya ngie yi te iema hne khata a si rale,
cuorasala ama hmung raalaa pata pachang va yi.
Zingsuv ta iema kha, “Khaapa kaw ma nama cakuopuo pata namaa ruele?” a ta yi. Iema ca ngiechina hmiephya hneta a maa daa.

Cakhutaata iema chungtaata pakha, Kleopas ama tapa paa khata, “Jerusalem lie khyche na cuopa ta ata zaw chunglieta capa lie a chiy a cuopa hmang a pachang lipa ca nama dyi hingna a cuo thlu'a ciy?” a ta.

Ama ta, “Khaapa hmang ma?” ta pata a hiehriy. Iema ta, “Khazing hmielie hne cawsaa bangkhuo hmielie a ripa hne a tuepa hmang bangkhuo lie cahrana a hnyi ama tapa profet Nazareth Zingsuv cunglie a tlungpa hmang, ama ta.
Ma tluobyi lepa tie hne uvthyi tie ta thie riypata pi yi te vieluo cunglie ama thie.
Cuorasala kiema ta ca Israel ming malie a thlatuv riypa tana a cuo aa ta pata maa nguopuopa tana a cuo. Capa hmang a cuo khutaata ataning hing a ning thungnapa tana a cuo.
Ca hlyitaw taata, kiema phuv chungtaata canung chekha ta kiema kha a ca-ang ta malie ama ca-ang sa. Ata maw mawdiy ta thluo luo vaa yi te,
a riyy kha ama hmung li tiyta vya kaa yi te, avuoming kha muocuo ta hmung yi pate, iema ca ta, ama ca a hring, malie ama ta,’ ta pata malie ama chang.
Kiema phuv taata chekha ca thluo luo kha vaa yi te canung tie ama ripa dala haa khata ama va hmung; cuorasala ama ca hmung va yi,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta, “Nama ngaa hringhruo ing, profet tie ta ama ri ciepa zang hing namaa paruvsa hringhruo de!
Messiah ca hingpa bangkhuo hing a rungnaana luo aa ngie hluota a ang siy diy aa hu cuo va ma?” a ta.
Cakhutaata Moses taata pathu pata profet tie bangkhuo ta Caapathe chunglieta ama kaw ama capepa bangkhuo kha a changpasie yi.
Ama chiyna riypa khy ama pha tyalya caw ta Zingsuv ca a caluole riypa haa khata aa pa-aw sa.
Cuorasala khuosa ta thlu yi te, “Kiema'a lie hing a ri ra thluo tie, zuoluo cuo tli te a zing zaw a zing'a nang tli,” ama ta. Caacuonakawta iema'a lie tlung ra riypata a paziy yi.
Sa dung pakhaw riypata iema'a lie kha a tu te, viechuo kha la te, thlaa a chuo khutaata chechi te a pi yi.
Cakhutaa cata ama ming kha kya vuo te ama a cuopa kha ama pachang, cuorasala ama ming hmungna lieta a vie.
Pakha hne pakha kha, “Luopuv lie bie malie aa ruepa hne Caapathe siyluo malie a chang ning kha ma chunglie myi kuo ta malie kuo tlarya va ma kha?” a maa ta.
Sungkha ta thu yi te Jerusalem luo kha ama kaa pakhaa ca ziytuv hlyikha hne ama viesaa tie zaw amaa zaa pungpa kha ama va hmung.
“Abyipa ca a thu pakhaa hmisi, Simon'a liena aa luo!” ta pata ama za ri nguoluo.
Cakhutaata iema ta luopuv lie hmang a cuopa kaw hne Abyipa ta viechuo chechi te aa pachangsanapa yi kaw kha ama chang.
Capa kaw ca ama ri nguoluo pata iema hrawlie kha Zingsuv ca a vya daa te, “Niema'a lie thlaalungna aw mang sue,” a ta yi.
Athlaa na ma hmung ta pata rue yi te ama thlaa zang te amaa pahlusa.
Cuorasala iema kha, “Khaapanakawma ciy ung cate nama palung a luolue?
I kuv hne i phyi hing mang tie ung; kama ta i cuo thluopa hing. Na hrie ung la na mang tie ung; a thlaa ca kama haa hingta ruv hne saa a hnyi tlung li,” a ta yi.
Cahaacata ri te a kuv hne a phyi zaw ca a pahmung yi.
Ama palung a tluosa thluo pata zang khu tange lipa yi ta ama kharue a haasa ngiethie nakawta, iema kyihuo khata, “Ning riypa suokha chuo nama hnyi ma?” a ta yi.
Iema ta ngaa e ciepa pi yi te,
ama hmiekunglie kha la te a ning.

Cakhutaata iema kha, “Niema'a lie i aw ningta i za ripa bie kha hingpa hingta tli hing a cuo, Moses phungbie chung, profet tie capepa chunglie hne Salm chunglieta kama kaw ama za capepa bangkhuo ca a tling diy riypa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Ama palung kha pavuo sa yi te Caapathe ta a ripa kha ama kya pachang the.
Iema kha, “Ama capepa ca hingpa hing tana a cuo, Messiah ca ruvnaana kha ang'a te ning thungna lie a thu pakhaa aa,
cakhutaata ama ming ta sue a ngiepachiyna hne sue angiethena kaw kha Jerusalem taata pathu pata mingphang bangkhuo kha chang pata ama cuo aa.
Niema ca hingpa hmang bangkhuo a pachangkhyituv tana nama cuo.
Cakhutaata i Paa ta bie a kuo ciepa kha nama cung luo i za pathlie aa; caacuonakawta cungluo taata cahrana nama cung luo a za tlung hluo li khypuv chunglie hing aw tie ung,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata Bethani khy te kha sikhyi yi te, a kuv kha pazu te thluechiy a pi yi.
Thluechiy a pi nguoluopa yi ta, iema'a taata a che te vuoruo luo calang pata a cuo.
Ama kha abie yi te palung tluosa pata Jerusalem luo ama kaa.
Biena-ing chunglie kha aa pazue pata aw yi te Khazing ama pathuosa.
A hruothu ta Bie a za aw, capa Bie ca Khazing hneta aw te, capa Bie ca Khazing ta a cuo.
A hruothu baataata Bie ca Khazing hneta a za aw.
Hmangting bangkhuo ca capa Bie thue cata sapa cuo te, sapa hmang suokhata hing hmuo ama li pata sapa aw vyi.
Ama chunglie ca hringna aw te, capa hringna ca cawsaa bangkhuo cuota khena ta a cuo.
Khena ca zingna lie kha khe te zingna ta te vyi.
Khazing ta a za pathliepa pakha aw te, a ming ca Johan ta a cuo.
Ama thueta cawsaa bangkhuo ama zang diy riypata khena kaw kha tehte khuo riypata a vawpa pachangkhyituv ta a cuo.
Ama pangphie ca khena cuo vyi, cuorasala khena kaw ri riypata a vawpa tana a cuo.
Cawsaa bangkhuo a pakhe sapa khena hmisipa ca chuelyi luo kha aa vaw nguoluo tli.
Ama ca chuelyi lie hing aw te ama thueta chuelyi hing sapa a cuo; cuorasala chuelyi ta ama kha za pachang vyi.
Ama ca a khy a ruo ciepa luo kha aa vaw raalaa pata a cawsaa zaw ta cuhluo va yi.
Cuorasala ama kha cuhluo te a ming a zangpa ca Khazing saata cuo khuna kha a pi yi.
Iema ca chuelyi phung, cawsaa thiy hne saa ta sapa cuo va yi, Khazing ta a sapa tana ama cuo.
Bie ca cawsaa ta a li te kiema hrawlie khy a sa, vihnyina hne biehmisipa ta a bipa rungnaana ca hmung pate, a paa sacapaa pakha dyipa rungnaana tana a cuo.

(Johan ta ama kaw kha khuopuv ta u te tehte a khuopa ca, “Ama hing na kama ta i ripa, ‘Kama hnang ta a vaw te, kama laata a le viepa, tahematapakieca ama ca kama hluota a zaa aw tlipa tana a cuo,’ ica tapa yi khata a cuo,”) a ta.
Ama a tluotlingna chungtaata kiema bangkhuo ca vihnyina suokha hnang suokha ta ima hmung.
Phungbie ca Moses thueta malie pi te, vihnyina hne biehmisipa ca Zingsuv Khrih'a taa tana aa vaw.
Ahungtahmuo Khazing kha hmung buo va yi. Sacapaa pakha dyipa, Paa pathiypalung hne aa ngieta tah a awpa khata a paluo sa tli.
Judah uvthyi tie ta tluobyi tie hne Levi tie kha Jerusalem taata Johan'a luo pathlie yi te, “Ahungtama na cuo?” ta pata ama pahiehriy sa.
Johan ta bie nu li pata, a luohuo hne a siesa pata, “Kama ca Messiah ta cuo va ang,” a ta.
“Caacuokieca ahungtama na cuo? Elijah ta na cuo ma?” ta pata ama hiehriy. Johan ta, “Cuo va ang,” a ta. “Profet ta na cuo ma?” ta pata ama hiehriy. “Cuo va ang,” ta pata a palie yi.
“Cakhutaata iema ta ahungtama na cuo tapa kha malie chang tie. Malie a pathliepa tie'a luo bie ma chiykhyi na a hu. Caacuonakawta ahung tana i cuo naa ta ma?” ama ta.
Ama ta, profet Isaiah ta a ripa haa khata, “Kama ca, ‘Abyipa luopuv kha aa dangsa pata sa tie ung,' ta pata ruocaapa lie a upa ueryi kha tana i cuo,” a ta.
Iema ca Farasi tie ta ama vya pathliepa tie tana ama cuo.
Iema ca ta, “Nama ca Messiah acuolikie Elijah acuolikie Profet zaw na cuo tlung li kieca khaapanakawma tiy na naw yi?” ta pata ama hiehriy.
Johan ta, “Kama ca tiy ta tiy i naw yi, cuorasala nama hrawlie nama pachang lipa pakha a aw.
Ama ca kama hnangluo ta aa vaw nguoluo tli; cuorasala kama ca a phyipakaw riy pathluo riypata hmuo a tla va ang,” ta pata a palie yi.
Hingpa hmang a cuonapa ca Johan ta tiy a nawnapa Jordan cavaa huesuoluo kuo lie a awpa Bethani khy lie tana a cuo.
A mawluopa ta Johan ta Zingsuv ama'a luo aa vawle nguoluopa kha hmung te, “Chuelyi suena a sikhyituv Khazing Tuvtaata ca hingpa lie hingna a aw!
Ama hing na kama ta i ripa, ‘Kama hnang ta a vaw te kama laata a le viepa cawsaa, tahematapakieca ama ca kama hluota a zaa aw tlipa tana a cuo, ica tapa yi khata a cuo,’ a ta.
Kama hrahring ta ama kha za pachang va ang; cuorasala tiy ta tiynawna i pi hnuochuopa hing Israel ming hrawlie ama kha paluosapa a cuona riypa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Johan ta, “Vuoruo taata Thlaapa ca thuvruv haata za cung te a cunglie a zaa cangpa kha i hmung.

Kama hrahring ta ama kha za pachang va ang, cuorasala tiy ta tiynawna pi riypata naa pathlietuv ta, ‘Thlaapa za cung'a te a cunglie aa cangpa na hmungpa paa ca Thlaapa ta tiynawna a pituv riypa paa tana a cuo,’ ina ta.
Cakhutaata kama pangphie ta hmung angte, ‘Khazing Sacapaa tana a cuo,’ ta pata tehte i khuo,” a ta.
A mawluopa ta Johan ca a ziytuv tie pahning hneta amaa daahne nguoluo pata
Zingsuv a vya cakuolepa kha a hmung ca, “Khazing Tuvtaata khiy mang tie ung,” ta pata a u.
Capa bie a ripa ca a ziytuv tie pahning ta thyi yi te Zingsuv kha ama ziy.
Zingsuv ta a hnangluo a pali te ama ziypa kha a hmung yi ca, “Khaapama nama huv?” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Rabbi, khaapaliema na aw?” ta pata ama palie. (Rabbi tapa ca Pacuvtuv tana ta a cuo).
Iema kyihuo khata, “A vaw ung la vya mang tie ung,” a ta yi. Vaa yi te a awnapa kha ama va hmung, capa ning ca ama'a lieta ama aw. Capa cuo ca zuoluo siymaluo papaliy hraw ta a cuo.
Capa cawsaa pahning lieta Johan bie ripa kha thyi te a ziypa ca Simon Piter a nuta Andru khata a cuo.
A uvta Simon kha hmung taa te, “Messiah ca ma hmung tli,” a ta. (Messiah tapa ca Sathu pathuvpa tana ta a cuo).

Cakhutaata Simon ca Zingsuv'a luo kha a vaakhyi. Zingsuv ta ama ca mang te, “Nama ca Johan sacapaa Simon tana na cuo, Sefas ta pata kupa na cuo'a tli,” a ta. (Sefas tapa ca Piter tapa taata paliepa tana a cuo).
A mawluopa ta Zingsuv ca Galilee luo si aa ting. Filip kha hmung te, “Na ziy tie,” a ta.
Filip ca Andru hne Piter ama awnapa Bethsaida khy ming ta a cuo.

Filip ta Nathanael kha hmung te, “Moses ta Phungbie caa-uv chunglie a kaw a capepa hne profet tie zaw ta a kaw ama za capepa paa kha ma hmung tli. Ama ca Nazareth taata Josef sacapaa Zingsuv, tana a cuo,” a ta.
Nathanael ta, “Nazareth khy taata hmang phapa suokha chuo a pya the'a ma?” a ta. Filip ta, “A vaw la vya mang tie,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta ama'a luo Nathanael a vawlepa kha a hmung tiyta, ama hne aa patuv pata, “Israel ming hmisipa, a chunglie hanghiena khaapahmuo a aw lipa hing mang tie ung!” a ta.
Nathanael ta, “Tuokhaatama ina pachang ciy?” ta pata a hiehriy. Zingsuv ta, “Filip ta aca ku hluota thyikuv kung rawlie naa tu ning kha ica hmung tli,” a ta.
Nathanael ta, “Saya, nama ca Khazing Sacapaa tana na cuo! Israel ming Siepahruo tana na cuo!” ta pata a palie.
Zingsuv ta, “Thyikuv kung rawlie na aw ningta ica hmung tli, ica ta nakawta ma ina zang ciy? Hingpa zaw laa hingta a le viepa hmang na hmung viele kalie aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata ama kha, “Biehmisipa na ica chang yi, Vuoruo kha a pahaw'a te, Khazing avuoming zaw kha Cawsaa Sacapaa cunglie ama za cungpa hne ama kiepa kha nama hmung aa,” a ta.
Ning thungna lie kha Galilee pe Kaanaa khy lie ta achiyhiena pyi aw te Zingsuv nung kha capa lie ca a aw.
Zingsuv hne ziytuv tie zaw kha achiyhiena pyi luo ca ama ku ra.
Ama mingsuvtiy a chuo tiyta a nung ta Zingsuv kha, “Mingsuvtiy hnyi va tli yi,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Cawsaanung, capa ca nama'a na kama hneta khaapama aa se? I cuo pha valie,” a ta.
Zingsuv nung ta changtaapa tie kha, “Ama ta aca changpa yi bangkhuo kha tue mya ung,” a ta yi.
Judah ming ta ama phung haata a pathena riypata capa lie ca ruocuo suocaruv chi yi te, ruocuo suokha ta tiy gaalaan suokiy taata sawthung te aa tlaw.
Zingsuv ta changtaapa tie kha, “Ruocuo hing tiy pabi diy tie ung,” a ta yi. A lepalana te ta ama pabi.
Iema kyihuo khata, “Tiy kha siy ung la saduona pyi tluotlatuv kha va pi tie ung,” ta yi te, ama va pi.

Mingsuvtiy ta a lipa tiy ca tluotlatuv ca ta a pacuo te, hingpa mingsuvtiy hing khaapa taata ma aa vaw tapa kha a pachang li nakawta (Tiy a thepa changtaapa tie ta ca ama pachang thluo), nungchiytuv satlie ca ku te,
“Malie ca mingsuvtiy pahuo cepa kha thu taa yi te muo aa de pata ama dang khutaata mingsuvtiy cakhawpa kha ama pi ta. Cuorasala nama ca a pahuo cepa kha ata tepa ta na thu kalie,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta hingpa kharuehaa hmang suokhana hing Galilee pe Kaanaa khy lieta a tue; capa lie ca a rungnaana kha paluo sa te, a ziytuv tie ta ama kha ama zang.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv hne a nung, a nuta zaw, hne ziytuv tie ca Kapernaum khy luo kha zuv yi te ning cawta chung ama va aw.
Lawsena Pyi aa ngiesa tli nakawta Zingsuv ca Jerusalem luo kha a khaw.
Biena-ing chunglie kha cue hne tuv hne valale a zaapa tie hne tuokaa a thlepa tie zaw ama cabya lie amaa tupa kha a hmung yi.
Khuhriy kha china riypata a camaa te tuv hne cue zaw bangkhuo kha Biena-ing taata aa cade diy. Tuokaa thletuv tie tuokaa diyta zaw kha hipatlaa diy te ama cabya zaw kha a pali diy.
Valale a zaapa tie zaw kha, “Hingpa hmang zaw hing pyakhyi diy ung! I paa ing ca chadaw zaana ta hmuo khah tie ung!” ta pata naw a pi yi.
Ziytuv tie ca Caapathe ta, “Vya Khazing, na ing cuota i khingpasana ta myi haata ina kuo aa,” a tapa kha ama nang a kya vuo.
Cakhutaata Judah ming ta, “Hingpa hmang na tuena kawlie hingta khaapa pamangsana ma malie na pahmung sa aa?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Hingpa biena-ing hing para ung la ning thung chunglie i sa pakhaa aa,” a ta.
Judah ming ta, “Ning thung chung tama na sa pakhaa aa? Hingpa Biena-ing sana lie hing kung sawliy kung caruv tli hing ama za ru,” ama ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta biena-ing a tapa ca ama pangpa kha tana a cuo.
Thiyna taata pathupa a cuo khutaata, ziytuv tie ca hingpa hing muo a za ripa khata a cuo ta tapa kha ama nang vuo te Caapathe hne Zingsuv ripa bie kha ama zang.
Zingsuv ca Lawsena pyi chung Jerusalem lie a aw ning kha cawsaa hluvpuv ta kharuehaa hmang a tuepa zaw kha hmung yi te ama zang.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta ca a pathiypalung yalya ta zang diy va yi, tahematapakieca cawsaa bangkhuo kha a pachang diy yi.
Cawsaa kaw kha a hrangpa pakhakha ta changpasie a hu vyi; tahematapakieca ama palung chunglie khaapama a aw tapa kha a pachang diy.
Judah ming luochiytuv pakha, Nikodemu ama tapa Farasi ming pakha a za aw.

Zingsuv'a luo kha zuo ta vaa te, “Rabbi, nama ca Khazing'a taata a vawpa pacuvtuv na cuo tapa kha ma pachang; tahematapakieca kharuehaa hmang na tuepa zaw hing Khazing ta a awpuo lipa a ahungtahmuo tue khu'a va yi,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Biehmisi tana ica chang, ahunghmuota cungluo taata papuv sapa a cuo li kieca Khazing Pena kha hmung khu'a vyi,” a ta.
Nikodemu ta, “Tuokhaatama uvthyita pakha a cuo tlipa ca a puv pakhaa khu aa? A nung riy chung luo a ngie pakhaa pata puv pakhaapa ca a cuo khu'a ma?” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Biehmisi tana ica chang, ahunghmuota tiy hne Thlaapa ta a puv pakhaa li kieca Khazing Pena chung luo a ngie khu'a vyi.
Saapa ta sapa ca saapa cuo te, Thlaapa ta sapa ca thlaapa ta a cuo.
‘Cungluo taata a puv pakhaapa nama cuo hrahring na a hu,’ ica ta nakaw yi ta nama kharue haa khah se.
Thliy ca a khingna luo na aa hruo, a pu ca na thyi, cuorasala khaapa taata a vaw te ma khaapa luo a si tapa kha pachang vaciy. Thlaapa ta sapa a cuopa ca cahaaca tana ama cuo ra,” a ta.
Nikodemu ta, “Tuokhaatama capa ca a cuo khu aa?” a ta.
Zingsuv ta palie te, “Nama ca Israel ming pacuvtuv na cuo pata hingpa zaw hing hmuo pachang va ca ma? a ta.
“Biehmisi tana ica chang, kiema ca ma pachangpa kha tehte khuo pate ma hmungpa kha ma pathyi sa, cuorasala ahungtahmuo ma tehte khuopa kha cuhluo va ung ciy.
Hingpa alyi hmang kaw ica changpa yi hmuo nama zang li kieca, vuoruo hmang kaw ica chang tiy yi ta tuokhaatama nama zang khu the aa?
Vuoruo taata zaa cungpa Cawsaa Sacapaa ta li pata ahunghmuota vuoruo luo a kiepa aw buo va yi.
Moses ta ruocaapa lie daa pariy a taapa haata, Cawsaa Sacapaa ca taa pata a cuo aa;
ama a zangpa mekaa ca chuozaa hringna ama hmung aa.
“Khazing ta chuelyi hing a due hringhruo nakawta a hnyi tlakuopa a Sacapaa kha a pi, caacuonakawta ama a zangpa mekaa ca thiy'a va yi, chuozaa hringna ama hnyi aa.
“Hmisi ta ripa kieca, Khazing ta a Sacapaa ca chuelyi luo hing chuelyi suebieripana tue riypata za pathlie vyi, chuelyi khuo riypa tana a za pathlie.
Ama a zangpa ca suebieripana ang'a vyi, cuorasala a zang lipa ca suebieripana a ang tli, tahematapakieca Khazing Sacapaa pakha dyipa ming kha a zang li nakawta a cuo.

Bieripana tapa ca hing haa hing tana a cuo, khena ca chuelyi luo hing a vya tlung tli, cuorasala cawsaa ta khena laata zingna kha ama khing vie, tahematapakieca ama tuepa kha hmang pha lipa ta a cuo nakawta a cuo.
Hmang pha lipa a tuepa bangkhuo ca khena kha hue yi te khena luo a vaw khing va yi, tahematapakieca ama tuepa aa luo li riypa kha tana a cuo.
Cuorasala aa hmuopa a tuepa tie ca khena luo kha a vaw yi te ama tuepa ca Khazing khingna haa tana a cuo tapa kha khena ta a siesa pata a paluo sa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv hne ziytuv tie ca Judea pe khyta luo kha si yi te iema'a lie ca cuo kha chung aw te tiynawna zaw a pi yi.
Johan zaw ta Salim taata aa hla linapa Aenon lie kha tiynawna a pi ra yi, tahematapakieca capa hmang lie ca tiy a hluvsa a aw. Cawsaa ca ama'a luo kha a vaw yi te tiynawna kha a pi yi.
Johan kha thaw pathla valie yi.
Johan ziytuv tie hne Judah ming pakha alalalie kha a pathe sana kawlieta bie a ina a puv.

Iema ca Johan'a luo kha a vaw yi te, “Saya, Jordan cavaa huesuo lie nama hne zaa awpa paa, a kawluo tehte na khuopa paa khata tiynawna pi nguoluo yi te cawsaa bangkhuo ca ama'a luo kha ama vaa nguoluo,” ama ta.
Johan ta, “Vuoruo taata pipa a cuo li kieca ahungtahmuo khaapahmuo cu khu'a va yi.
Kama pangphie ta, ‘Kama ca Messiah ta cuo va ang, a hmieluo ta pathlie lupa tana i cuo,’ i tapa kawlieta tehte ca niema tana nama cuo.

Vaahnyituv lesaa a hnyipa ca nungchiytuv satlie tana a cuo. Nungchiytuv satlie athaalie a daa te a ueryi a thyipa a daakhyituv a viesaapa ca khuopuv ta a palung a tluo. Capa kawlie ca ta i palungtluona aa ky.
Ama ca lethaw'a te, kama ca i zuebung aa,” a ta.
A cung taata a zaa cungpa paa ca a hrangpa bangkhuo laata a le vie. Alyi taata a vawpa ca alyi hmang kaw kha a ri. Vuoruo taata a vawpa ca hmangting bangkhuo cunglie tana a aw.
Ama ta a hmungpa hne a thyipa kha tehte a khuo raalaa pata ahungtahmuo a tehte khuopa kha cuhluo va yi.
A tehte khuopa kha a cuhluopa ca Khazing ca a hmisipa tana a cuo tapa khana a pacu sa.
Khazing ta a pathliepa ca a Thlaapa kha tluotling pata a pi nakawta Khazing bie kha a ri.
Paa ta a Sacapaa kha due te hmangting bangkhuo kha a kuv cung luo a pi diy.
Sacapaa a zangpa mekaa ca chuozaa hringna ama hnyi; Sacapaa ri a ngie lipa mekaa ca hringna kha hmung'a va yi, Khazing hihaana khana ama ang aa.
“Zingsuv ca Johan laata ziytuv a hluv vie hnyi te tiynawna zaw a pi yi,” tapa khana Farasi ming ta ama thyi tapa kha Zingsuv ta a pachang.
Zingsuv pangphie cuo li pata ziytuv tie ta tiynawna ama pipa ta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Judea ruo taa khata pya te Galilee ruo luo kha a kaa.
Cuorasala Samaria ruo kha a cahraw.
Caacuonakawta Jacob ta a sacapaa Josef a pipa luruo hne aa ngieta tah a awpa Samaria pe Saikhar khy luo kha a pha.
Capa lie ca Jacob takhue kha aw te Zingsuv ca a nang a buosa nakawta takhue kie lie ca aa tu. Capa cuo ca ningchung hraw ta a cuo.
Samaria cawsaanung pakha ca tiy the riypata a vaw te, Zingsuv ta, “Tiy dang riypa na siy tie,” a ta.
(A ziytuv tie ca ning riypa calyi riypata khy chung luo ama vaa ningta a cuo.)

Samaria cawsaanung ca ta, “Judah ming pakha a cuopa ta Samaria canung pakha a cuopa kama'a lie dang riypa tiy inaa hiepa ca hing khaapanakawma?” a ta. (Judah ming ca Samaria ming hneta hmang a hraw pata hmuo khing va yi.)
Zingsuv ta, “Khazing lasaw hing khaapatama a cuo tapa hne tiy dang riypa caa hiepa paa hing ahungma tapa kha pachang la ca ama pali hing a hie'a cate hringna tiy kha aca pi aa,” a ta.
Cawsaanung ta, “Abyipa, tiypung ta na hnyi va, takhue ta aa thuvsa hyi. Khaapaliema capa hringna tiy ca na la aa?
Hingpa takhue malie a pipa mingpa Jacob laata i le vie ta pata ma naa rue? Ama hne a saata zaw hne a sahring zaw bangkhuo ta ama dangpa takhue tana a cuo,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Hingpa tiy a dangpa bangkhuo ca ama tiy a hrie pakhaa aa,
cuorasala kama ta i pipa tiy a dangpa tie ca khatiy tahmuo ama tiy hrie pakhaa'a va tli. I pi riypa yi tiy ca ama chunglie kha chuozaa hringna a pipa acaatiy ta aa li aa,” a ta.
Cawsaanung ta, “Abyipa, i tiy a hrie li tli riypa hne, hingpa luo zaw hing tiy the riypata i vaw li tli riypata capa tiy ca na pi tie!” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Cakuo la na navaapa kha va ku la a vaw pakhaa tie,” a ta.
Cawsaanung ta, “Navaa hnyi va ang,” ta pata a palie. Zingsuv ta, “'Navaa hnyi va ang na tapa hing aa hmuo';
cuorasala navaa papangaa hnyi tli cate ata lie naa hlawpa zaw hing na navaapa hmisi ta cuo vyi. Na ripa hing aa hmuo!” a ta.
Cawsaanung ta, “Abyipa, profet ta na cuopa ica pachang.
Kiema mingchingmingvuo tie ta ca hingpa tluo lie hing Khazing kha amaa zaa bie, cuorasala niema ta ca Khazing ca Jerusalem liena abie riypata a cuo nama ta,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Cawsaanung, kama hing na zang tie, niema ta hingpa tluo lie cuose, Jerusalem lie cuose Paa kha namaa bie lina riypa cuo ca aa vaw nguoluo tli.
Niema ca nama pachang lipa khana namaa bie; kiema ca ma pachangpa kha maa bie, tahematapakieca khuona ca Judah ming'a taata a vawpa tana a cuo.
Khazing abie hmisipa tie ta thlaapa hne biehmisipa ta Paa amaa biena cuo kha a vaw nguoluo te a vya tlung tli, tahematapakieca cahaacata a biepa cana Paa ta a khingpa a cuo.
Khazing ca Thlaapa ta cuo te abiepa tie ta Thlaapa hne biehmisipa ta amaa bie riypa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cawsaanung ta, “Messiah ca aa vaw aa tapa kha i pachang” (Khrih ta pata zaw ama kupa). “Ama aa vaw thueta hmangting bangkhuo kha a pathyi sa diy aa,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Nama hne bie a ri nguoluopa kama hing ama ca tana i cuo,” a ta.

Capa cuo lie ca Zingsuv a ziytuv tie ca vya chiy yi te cawsaanung hne bie amaa rue nguoluopa kha ama hmung tiyta ama nang a uosa. Cuorasala ahungtahmuo, “Khaapama naa hu?” acuolikie, “Khaapanakawma hingpa nung hing bie na rihne?” ta ra va yi.
Cakhutaata cawsaanung ca a tiybi kha thusesiy te khypuv luo kha a kaa. Cawsaa zaw kyihuo khata,
“I tue buopa hmang bangkhuo naa chang khu diypa paa hing vya mang tie ung! Ama hing Messiah ta cuo'a va ma?” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta khypuv taa cata pya yi te Zingsuv'a luo ca ama vaa.
Capa cuo ning ca ziytuv tie ta Zingsuv kha, “Saya, sa ning tie,” ama ta.
Cuorasala ama ta, “Niema ta a kaw nama pachang lipa ning riypa sa na i hnyi,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta ziytuv tie ca pakha hne pakha kha, “Pakhakha ta sa ama vya pi pata a cuo biephung'a ma?” amaa ta.
Zingsuv ta iema kha, “I sa ca naa pathlietuv khingna tue hne ina changpa re palangpa hing tana a cuo.

Niema ta, ‘Ata taa hingta thla paliy khu pahne ta sa hrie tiy a ta aa,’ nama ta cuo va ma? Cuorasala ica chang yi, nama cahriy kha suo tie ung; sa ca hming te hrie tiy aa de hringhruo tli tapa kha mang tie ung!
Sa a hrietuv ca a hrie muo kha pi pata cuo te chuozaa hringna cuota sa kha a papung nguoluo, caacuonakawta ciy a cyituv hne sa a hrietuv kha ama palung a tluo pakhaw aa.
‘Pakha ta ciy cyi te pakha ta sa a hrie,’ tapa bie ca hingpa lie hingna aa hmuo.
Nama thlu lina lieta sa hrie riypa tana ica pathlie yi; malie ta thlu yi te niema ta ama thlu ciena lie kha nama hrie,” a ta yi.
Cawsaanung ta, “I za tue buopa bangkhuo na ina chang diy,” ta pata tehte a khuo nakawta Samaria ming a hluvpuv ta ama zang.
Caacuonakawta Samaria ming ca Zingsuv'a luo amaa vaw tiyta, iema'a lie a pahy caw riypata paakie yi te, ning hning aa pahy siy.
A bie ripa kha thyi yi te cawsaa a hluv hryly ta ama zang.
Cawsaanung kyihuo khata, “Ata hing ca nama na ri nakawta cuo li pata kiema hrahring ta a bie ripa kha thyi pate, ama ca chuelyi Khuotuv a cuo hrahring tapa kha ma pachang,” ama ta.
Ning hning khutaata, Zingsuv ca capa hmang taa cata Galilee ruo luo kha a si.
(Tahematapakieca Zingsuv hrahring ta, “Profet ca a puvna ruo lie ca pa-uvsathyina hmung vyi,” a ta.)
Galilee luo a pha tiyta, Galilee ming ta ama kha ama daw, tahematapakieca Jerusalem pyi luo kha vaa ra yi te pyi chunglieta a tuepa bangkhuo kha ama hmung nakawta a cuo.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ca tiy kha mingsuvtiy ta a za pacuo sanapa Galilee pe Kaanaa khy luo kha a si pakhaa. Capa lie ca acuzaa byi pakha aw te a sacapaa ca Kapernaum khy lie kha a pasa.
Zingsuv na Judea ruo taata Galilee luo a vaw tapa kha a thyi tiyta, ama'a luo kha cakuo te, Kapernaum khy luo kha a zuv pata vuotaa a thiy'a nangpa a sacapaa kha patluo sa riypata paa a kie.
Zingsuv ta, “Pamangsana hne kharuehaa hmang nama hmung li kieca zang'a va ung ciy,” a ta yi.
Acuzaa byipa ca ta, “Abyipa, i saata a thiy hluo hingta a zuv tie,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Cakuo tie, na sacapaa ca a hring aa,” a ta. Capa paa ca ta Zingsuv bie kha zang te a cakuo.
A kaabung luo, luopuv lie kha a sii tie ta kya daw yi te, a sacapaa a tluo tlipa kha ama chang.
Ama ta, khaapa cuo taa khata ma a sacapaa ca a tluo vie? ta pata a hiehriy tiy yi ta, iema ta, “Azuochaning ningchung, siymaluo pakha lie khana a ngelingpa a cakaa,” ama ta.
Capa cuo ca Zingsuv ta, “Na sacapaa ca a tluo aa,” a za tapa cuo ta a cuopa kha a paa ca aa kya thyi pakhaa. Caacuonakawta ama hne a ingchungkhue tie bangkhuo ta ama zang.
Hingpa hing Zingsuv ta Judea ruo taata Galilee ruo luo aa vaw khutaata a tuepa kharuehaa hmang a suohningnapa ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata Jerusalem lie Judah ming pyi suokha aw te Zingsuv ca a khaw.
Jerusalem khy, tuv thlake ama tapa kielie Hebru ryi ta Beth-zatha ama tapa tiy-ang suokha aw te a kie lieta thluodaa suopangaa a aw.
Capa thluodaa chunglie ca, mingcuepa, a phyi cabiepa, a pakyapa ta pata a tluo lipa a hluvsa ama laa patlaw.

(Cuokhakha lieta Abyipa avuoming kha za cung te tiy kha a za katlu taw. Cahaacata tiy aa katlu pahne ta tiy chung luo a thaw taapa ca ama pasana taata ama tluo. Caacuonakawta a pasapa tie ca tiy aa katlu riypa kha ama huo.)
Capa lie ca kung sawthung kung cari a pasa tlipa capaa pakha a aw.
Zingsuv ta capa lie aa zie nguoluopa kha hmung te kung pasiypuv a pasa tlipa kha a pachang nakawta, “Na tluo khing ma?” a ta.
A pasapa paa ca ta, “Abyipa, tiy aa vya katlu pahne ta tiyliy chung luo naa naw riypa hnyi va ang; cung naase ang i ta pahne ta a hrangpa pakhakha ta i naa naw chuv lawmaw yi,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Thu la na pangphaa kha a la lah cakuo tie,” a ta.
Cawsaapa ca sungkha ta tluo te a pangphaa kha la te a cakuo. Capa ning ca Sabbath ning ta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Judah uvthyi tie ta tluona a hmungpa paa ca, “Ataning hing Sabbath ning ta cuo te na pangphaa naa puvlepa hing ima phung na a thlu,” ama ta.
Cuorasala ama ta, “Naa patluo sapa paa na na pangphaa kha a la lah cakuo tie, naa ta,” a ta.
Iema ta, “Na pangphaa kha a la lah cakuo tie caa tapa ca ahungma?” ama ta.
Cuorasala tluona a hmungpa paa ta pachang vyi, tahematapakieca Zingsuv ca capa lie a awpa cawsaazaapuv hraw luo kha a ngie te a vie tli.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta khapa paa kha Biena-ing lie hmung te, “Mang tie, patluo sapa na cuo tli hing! Na cunglie a ruv viepa a tlung li riypata suena tue vie khah tie lie ciy,” a ta.
Cawsaapa ca pya te Judah ming kyihuo khata a patluo sapa paa ca Zingsuv ta a cuopa kha a va chang yi.
Sabbath ning ta cahaapa hmang a tue nakawta Judah ming ta Zingsuv ca hrisaa hruo ama pathu.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta, “I Paa ca ata te hingta re a hrie nguoluo kalie, caacuonakawta kama zaw i hrie nguoluo ra,” a ta yi.
Sabbath ning a parapa dyi cuo li pata Khazing kha i Paa tana a cuo a ta nakawta Khazing hne tana aa pakhing ta yi te, Judah uvthyi tie ca Zingsuv thie riypa khata luo ama huv hryly.

Zingsuv ta iema kha, “Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, Sacapaa hing amata tah khaapahmuo tue khu vyi, cuorasala a paa ta a tuepa a hmungpa dyi khana a tue; tahematapakieca Paa ta a tuepa haa kha tana Sacapaa ta a tue ra.
Paa ta Sacapaa ca due te a tuepa bangkhuo kha a pahmung sa. Hingpa laa hingta tue riypa a le viepa kha pahmung sa kalie'a te nama nang a uosa aa.
Paa ta a thiypa pathu te hringna a pipa haata Sacapaa zaw ta a khingpa kha hringna a pi ra yi.
Paa ta ahunghmuo bie ripa va yi, cuorasala Sacapaa kha bie ripana naw bangkhuo a pi.
Caacuonakawta Paa a pa-uvsathyipa bangkhuo ta Sacapaa kha ama pa-uvsathyi ra aa. Ahunghmuo cuose Sacapaa a pa-uvsathyi lipa ca a pathlietuv Paa a pa-uvsathyi lipa tana a cuo.
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, i bie thyi te naa pathlietuv a zangpa ca chuozaa hringna a hnyi. Bieripana ang'a vyi, cuorasala thiyna taata hringna luo a caluo tli.
“Biehmisi tana ica chang yi: Athiypa tie ta Khazing Sacapaa ueryi thyi'a yi te, a thyipa tie ta hringna ama hmungna cuo kha a vaw'a te ata zaw hing a vya tlung nguoluo tli.
Paa hrahring ta ama'a na ama chunglie hringna a hnyipa haata Sacapaa zaw hing ama'a na ama chunglie hringna hnyi ra riypata naw a pi.
Cakhutaata ama ca Cawsaa Sacapaa a cuo nakawta bieripana naw kha a pi.
Hingpa kawlie hing nama nang uo khah se; a thiypa bangkhuo ta a ueryi kha thyi'a yi te ama thluo taata ama kya thuna cuo ca aa vaw nguoluo tli.
Hmang pha a tuepa tie ca hringna luo thupakhaa'a yi te, hmang pha lipa a tuepa tie ca suebieripana luo ama thu pakhaa aa,” a ta.
