“Kama ri ta khaapahmuo tue khu va ang. I thyipa haa dyi tana bie i ripa yi; caacuonakawta i bieripana ca aa dang, tahematapakieca kama khingna haata tue lipa angta naa pathlietuv khingna haata i tue nakawta a cuo.
“Kama ta kama kaw kha i ri kieca i ripa ca a hmuo'a vyi.
Cuorasala kama cuopa ta i kaw naa ripatuv pakha aw te kama kaw a ripa kha aa hmuo ta pata i pachang.
Niema ta Johan'a luo kha biephyatuv pathlie ung cate biehmisipa kha a ri.
Kha haapa pachangkhyituv cawsaa kha i hu nakawta cuo vyi; khuona nama hmung thena riypata i ripa tana a cuo.
Johan ca a ie nguoluopa a khepa myi-ing tana a cuo; cuo pachangta chung kha a khena chunglie a nuopa nama khing.
Cuorasala kama ca Johan laata a le viepa tehte khuo riypa na i hnyi. I Paa ta palang riypata ina pipa, i hrie nguoluopa re hingta kama cuota tehte khuo te i Paa ta pathliepa i cuopa kha a paluo sa.
Cakhutaata naa pathlietuv i Paa hrahring ta kama cuopa ta tehte a khuo. A ueryi thyi buo va ung ciy, a hmingsuo zaw hmung buo va ung ciy,
cakhutaata a bie ripa zaw nama palung chunglie pari va ung ciy, tahematapakieca a pathliepa paa kha nama zang li nakawta a cuo.
“Niema ta Caapathe chunglie nama huv, tahematapakieca capa chunglie ca na chuozaa hringna ma hmung ta pata nama rue. Hingpa Caapathe hing kama kaw a ripa tana a cuo.
Cuorasala hringna hmung riypata kama'a luo kha a vaw khing hyi va ung ciy.
Cawsaapa'a taata rungnaana kha cuhluo va ang.
Cuorasala nama chunglie Khazing duena nama hnyi lipa kha ica pachang yi.
I Paa ming ta i vaw raalaa pata na cuhluo va ung ciy; cawsaa pakhakha ama ming ta aa vaw kieca nama cuhluo hyi tlung aa.
Niema ca pakha hne pakha cung taata rungnaana kha a cuhluo ung cate Khazing'a taata rungnaana kha nama huv li kieca tuokhaatama kama ca ina zang khu'a ung ciy?
Kama hing Paa hmielie sue malie a betuv riypa tana a cuo ta pata na rue khah ung. A cunglie anguopuona nama hnyipa Moses na sue caa betuv riypa yi ta a cuo.
Moses hing nama zang kieca kama zaw hing ina zang ra'a ung ciy, tahematapakieca ama ca kama kaw khana a cape.
Cuorasala a capepa kha nama zang li kieca i ripa ca tuokhaatama nama zang the aa?” a ta yi.
Cakhutaa cata Zingsuv ca Tiberias riyliy ta pata zaw ama ku rapa Galilee riyliy huesuo luo kha a vaa.
A pasapa tie a patluo sapa yi kharuehaa hmang kha ama hmung nakawta cawsaa hluvpuv ta ama kha ama ziy.
Zingsuv ca tluocung luo kha kie te a ziytuv tie hneta amaa tu.
Judah ming Lawsena Pyi cuo kha aa ngie tli.
Zingsuv ca hmiehmie pase te cawsaazaapuv ama'a luo amaa vawpa kha a hmung tiyta Filip kyihuo kha, “Hingpa cawsaa bangkhuo ning riypa viechuo hing khaapaliema ma calyi aa?” a ta.
Hing haa hingta a hiehriypa hing Filip kha a dyapasya khing nakawta a cuo. Khaapama i tue aa tapa kha ama ta ca a pachang thluo.
Filip ta, “A cawta law ta amaa ky riypata hmuo denarii zahning muo viechuo ta a zu'a vyi,” a ta.
Ziytuv hrangpa pakha, Simon Piter nuta Andru ta,
“Hingpa lie hing barli viechuo tluo pangaa hne ngaa sahning a hnyipa haatiypa pakha a aw, cuorasala cawsaa hingpa zaa hing ca a zu the riypata cuo vyi,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Cawsaa kha patu sa tie ung,” a ta yi. Capa hmang lie ca aphuv a chaasa; cawsaa bangkhuo ca a tu yi te thawpangaa tluv ama ta.
Zingsuv ta viechuo kha la te, palungtluona bie a hluo khutaata, capa lie a tupa tie kha a re yi. Cahaacata ngaa zaw kha tue te cawsaa bangkhuo ta ama riy bisa pata ama ning.
Ama ning khutaata ziytuv tie kha, “Aa ngaapa a zungpepa kha pakhaw tie ung, a cawta hmuo a vievuv li riypata,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta barli viechuo tluo pangaa taata aa ngaapa a zungpepa kha ama pakhaw diy ca beke ta zung hraa hlyihning a bi.
Cawsaa ta kharuehaa hmang a tuepa kha ama hmung tiyta, “Chuelyi luo a vaw riypa profet tapa ca ama hrahring hing tana a cuo,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta iema kha a vaw'a yi te, na patuv'a yi te siepahruo cuo riypata hruohra ta ina hripuo'a yi tapa kha a pachang nakawta ama se ta zuvpathla te tluocung luo kha a kie.
Zuoluo ning aa ngie tiyta ziytuv tie ca riyliy luo kha zuv yi te,
sawkawpalaw kha a khang yi te, Kapernaum luo vaa riypata riyliy kha ama va te. Khy a zing tli, cuorasala Zingsuv ca iema'a luo kha a vaw valie.
Thliy aa hruo nakawta riyliy lie ca tiylaw a thu.
Sawkawpalaw ca me thung me paliy tluv ama va mawpa khata Zingsuv ca riyliy cunglie kha vya cakuo te sawkawpalaw luo aa vya ngiepa yi kha ama hmung ca ama thlaa a zangsa.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta, “Ciy khah ung, kama tana i cuo,” a ta yi.
Zingsuv ca sawkawpalaw luo kha pakie sa yi te amaa tingna hmang kha sungkha ta ama va pha.

A mawluopa ta riyliy huesuo lie a awpa cawsaazaapuv khata, capa lie ca sawkawpalaw suokha dyi aw te, Zingsuv kha capa sawkawpalaw khata ziytuv tie hne si li pata, iema selaw ta ama sipa kha ama hmung.
Tiberias taata a vya chiypa sawkawpalaw hrangpa tie ca, Abyipa ta palungtluona bie hluo te cawsaazaapuv viechuo ama ningnapa athaalie kha amaa vya pahy.
Cawsaazaapuv ta Zingsuv hne ziytuv tie ama aw lipa kha ama pachang tiyta, Zingsuv huv riypata sawkawpalaw kha a khang yi te Kapernaum khy luo kha ama si.
Iema ta Zingsuv kha riyliy huesuo lie ama va hmung tiyta, “Saya, khatiy tiy tama hingpa luo hing naa vaw?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, ina huvpa ungca hing kharuehaa hmang i tuepa nama hmung nakawta cuo li pata nama riy bina te viechuo nama ning nakaw tana a cuo.

A ra thepa sa cuota re hrie khah ung; cuorasala Cawsaa Sacapaa ta aca pi riypa yi chuozaa ta aa hmangpa hringna sa cuota re kha hrie tie ung. Tahematapakieca Paa Khazing ta ama cunglie kha palungtlingna caakhe a khe tli,” a ta.
Cakhutaata iema ta, “Khazing ta malie aa khingkhyipa re hrie riypata khaapama ma tue aa?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Khazing khingpa re ca ama ta a pathliepa paa zang kha tana a cuo,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta iema ta, “Hmung'a pate maca zang riypata khaapa pamangsana ma na tue aa? Khaapama na tue aa?
Caapathe ta, ‘Vuoruo taata ning riypa viechuo kha a pi yi,’ a tapa haata, ma mingchingmingvuo tie ca ruocaapa lie manna kha ama za ning,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta, “Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, vuoruo taata viechuo caa pipa yi ca Moses ta cuo vyi, vuoruo viechuo hmisipa caa pipa yi ca i Paa tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca Khazing pipa viechuo ca vuoruo taata zaa cungpa hing cuo te chuelyi kha hringna a pi,” a ta yi.
Iema ta, “Abyipa, capa viechuo ca malie pi pari tie,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Kama ca hringna viechuo tana i cuo. Kama'a luo a vawpa ca ahunghmuota a nang diy buo li'a pata kama naa zangpa ca ahunghmuota a tiy hrie buo'a va tli.
Cuorasala ica chang yi, na hmung tli ung cate na zang va ung ciy.
I Paa ta ina pipa bangkhuo ca kama'a luo a vaw'a yi te, kama'a luo a vawpa bangkhuo ca pakaa'a va yi ang,
tahematapakieca vuoruo taata i za cungpa hing kama khingna tue riypata cuo li pata naa pathlietuv khingna tue riypa tana a cuo.
Hingpa hingna naa pathlietuv khingna ta a cuo: ina pipa bangkhuo kha pakha hmuo pavie li pata ningchuonapa ning lie khiy ama palang ta hringna luo pathu riypa tana a cuo.
I Paa khingna hmisi ca Sacapaa kha hmung te a zangpa bangkhuo ta chuozaa hringna ama hmung riypa hing tana a cuo; cakhutaata kama ta ningchuona ning lie khiy hringna luo i pathu'a yi,” a ta.
“Kama hing vuoruo taata zaa cungpa viechuo tana i cuo,” a ta nakawta Judah ming ca a maa cie.
“Hingpa paa hing Josef sacapaa Zingsuv kha cuo va ma? A nung hne a paa kha ma pachang yi. Khaapanakawma vuoruo taa tana i za cung a ta the?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Namaa ciephuvluvpa ca duo tie ung.
Naa pathlietuv i Paa na kama'a luo a vya chiy yi ta li pata ca ahunghmuota kama'a luo a vaw khu'a va yi; cahaacata kama'a luo a vawpa ca ningchuona ning lie khiy hringna luo i pathu'a yi,” a ta.
Profet tie caa-uv lieta, ‘Iema ca Khazing na a pacuv'a yi,’ ta pata ama cape kha. Ahunghmuota i Paa ueryi kha thyi te ama'a taata a cuvpa bangkhuo ca kama'a luo kha amaa vaw.
Khazing'a taata zaa cungpa pakha ta li pata ahunghmuota Khazing hmung buo va yi, ama dyina Paa kha a hmung buo.
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, a zangpa ca chuozaa hringna a hnyi.
Kama ca hringna viechuo tana i cuo.
Nama mingchingmingvuo tie ta ruocaapa lie manna kha za ning yi te ama thiy ngiethie.
Hingpa hingna vuoruo taata zaa cungpa viechuo ta a cuo, caacuonakawta a ningpa mekaa ca thiy'a va yi.

Vuoruo taata zaa cungpa hringna viechuo ca kama hing tana i cuo. Hingpa viechuo a ningpa mekaa ca chuozaa ta ama hring aa; chuelyi hringna ama hmung riypata i pi riypa yi viechuo ca i saa hing tana a cuo,” a ta yi.
Judah ming ca iema hne iema kha a i yi te, “Tuokhaatama hingpa cawsaa hingta a saa ca ce riypata malie a pi the aa,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Zingsuv ta iema kha, “Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, Cawsaapa Sacapaa a saa kha ce li pata a thiy zaw nama dang li kieca nama chunglie hringna hnyi'a va ung ciy.
I saa a cepa hne i thiy a dangpa mekaa ca chuozaa hringna hnyi'a yi te ningchuona lieta hringna luo i pathu'a yi;
tahematapakieca i saa ca sa hmisipa ta cuo te i thiyse ca dang riypa hmisi ta a cuo.
I saa kha ce te i thiy a dangpa ca kama chunglie aw yi te kama zaw iema chunglie i aw ra.
A hringpa i Paa ta na pathlie te, i Paa thueta kama i hringpa haata kama naa ningpa mekaa ca kama thueta ama hring aa.

Vuoruo taata zaa cungpa viechuo ca hingpa hing tana a cuo; nama mingchingmingvuo tie ta za ning yi te ama thiypa haa khata cuo vyi, cuorasala hingpa viechuo a ningpa ca chuozaa ta ama hring aa,” a ta yi.
Hingpa bie hing Kapernaum khy apungna-ing lie a pacuv ning yi ta a ripa tana a cuo.
A ziytuv hluvpuv ta capa bie ca ama thyi tiyta, “Hingpa pacuvna hing a ruv ciemuo, ahungma a cuhluo khu aa?” ama ta.
Cuorasala, hingpa kawlieta a ziytuv tie amaa ciepa kha Zingsuv ta pachang te, iema kha, “Hingpa hingta nama palung aca para yi ma?
Cawsaa Sacapaa hing a hluota a za awna luo a kaapakhaapa kha hmung biephung ung la tuokhaatama nama aw aa?
Hringna malie a pipa ca Thlaapa tana a cuo; saapa hing ca khaapahmuo thlahne vyi. Niema'a lie i ripa bie hing thlaapa hne hringna bie ta a cuo.
Cuorasala niema hrawlie chekha ta ca zang va ung ciy,” a ta. Tahematapakieca Zingsuv ta a hruothu taata ahungma naa zang li riypa tapa hne ahungma naa lyi riypa tapa kha a pachang pacie diy.
Cakhutaata pazue te, “Hingpa nakaw hing muo i Paa ta a pa-aw li kie yi ca ahunghmuota kama'a luo a vaw khu'a va yi ica tapa yi khata a cuo ta,” a ta yi.
Capa nakaw ca ta Zingsuv a ziytuv a hluvpuv ca kaa yi te ama kha ziy va tli yi.
Caacuonakawta Zingsuv ta ziytuv hlyihning tie kha, “Niema haw nama cakuo ra'a ma?” a ta yi.
Simon Piter ta, “Abyipa, ahung'a luo ma ma cakuo aa? Chuozaa hringna bie a hnyipa ca nama tana na cuo.
Nama ca A Pathepa Khazing na cuopa kha zang pate ma pachang tli,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Kama na niema hlyihning tie hing caa tlaw yi ang cuo va ma? Cuorasala niema chungtaata pakha ca khachie tana nama cuo!” a ta yi.
Hlyihning chunglie pakha ta a cuo raalaa pata ama a lyituv riypa Simon Iskariot sacapaa Judas khana a ri khingpa ta a cuo.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ca Galilee pe chung kha a tlaw. Judah ming ta ama kha ama thie khing nakawta Judea pe luo ca tlaw khing vyi.
Judah ming Thluodaa pyi kha aa ngie tli.
Caacuonakawta a nuta zaw ta Zingsuv ca, “Na hmang tuepa hing caa ziytuv tie ta ama hmung riypata hingpa taa hingta pya la Judea pe luo si tie.
Cawsaa ta na pachang yi se tapa a khingpa ta ca hmang kha a paruvta tah tue va yi. Hingpa hmang hing na tue kieca chuelyi hing a pahmung sa thluo tie,” ama ta.
(A uvnu zaw tahmuo ama kha zang va yi.)
Zingsuv ta, “I cuo tling valie, cuorasala hingpa lie hing ca niema cuota a cuo pari thluo.
Niema ca chuelyi hingta ca hue khu va yi, cuorasala kama ca ina hue, tahematapakieca a hmang tuepa a pha li nakaw kha i ri pari nakawta a cuo.
Niema kha pyi luo ca cakuo tie ung. Kama ca cakuo'a va ang, i cuo tling valie,” a ta yi.
Hingpa hing ri te Galilee lie kha a aw thluo.
A nuta zaw pyi luo ama cakuo khutaata Zingsuv zaw a cakuo ra; cadyiseca a luohuo ta cuo li pata a paruvta tah a cakuo ra pata a cuo.
Pyi chunglie ca Judah ming ta huv yi te, “Khaapaliema a aw?” ta pata ama hiehriy.
Cawsaazaapuv ta a kaw kha ri yi te amaa cie. Chekha ta, “Ama ca cawsaa phapa tana a cuo,” ta yi te, chekha ta, “Cuo vyi, cawsaazaapuv a dungviepa tana a cuo,” ama ta.
Cuorasala Judah ming kha ama ciy nakawta ahungtahmuo a luohuo ta a kaw ri va yi.
Capa pyi khingkhuo hraw taa khata Zingsuv ca Biena-ing chung luo kha va kie te pacuv hruo aa thu.
Judah ming ca ama kharue haasa te, “Caa hmuo a cuv buo li pata tuokhaatama hing tluv nanaa hingta a the khu,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta iema kha palie yi te, “Ica pacuvpa yi hing kama'a taata cuo vyi, naa pathlietuv'a taa tana a cuo.
Khazing khingna tue a khingpa mekaa ta ca i pacuvna hing Khazing'a taata ma a cuo kama khingna ta i pacuvpa ta ma a cuo tapa kha ama pachang aa.
Ama khingna haata dyi bie a ripa ca ama rungnaana dyi a huvpa ta a cuo; cuorasala ama a pathlietuv huota rungnaana a huvpa ca aa dangpa ta cuo te a chunglie hanghiena aw vyi.
“Moses ta phungbie ca pi va yi ma? Cuorasala ahungtahmuo ziy va ung ciy. Khaapanakawma ina thie khing ung ciy?” a ta yi.
Cawsaazaapuv khata, “Khuevuo na na hnyi! Ahungma thie acaa nang?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Hmang suokha tue angte nama bangkhuo ta nama kharue a haa.
Moses ta vangdaw te riypata bie ca pi yi te (a pathutuv ca Moses cuo li pata mingpa tie zaw kha tana ama cuo) sabbath ning ta cawsaa kha vangdaw nama te.
Moses phungbie para li riypata cawsaa pakha kha Sabbath ning ta vangdaw nama te kieca, khaapanakawma Sabbath ning ta cawsaa pangpa yalya kha i patluo sa tiyta i cunglie nama hi a haa?
A cungphang cuona dyi mang pata bie chi khah ung, biedangpa kha mang ung la bie chi tie ung,” a ta yi.
Jerusalem khy ming chekha ta, “Thie amaa nangpa paa ca ama hing cuo va ma?
A luohuo ta hingpa lie hing bie ri te khaapahmuo ta hyi tlung va yi. Messiah tana a cuo tapa kha uvtuv tie ta ama pachang tli nakawta a cuo'a ma?
Hingpa paa hing khaapa taata ma aa vaw tapa kha ma pachang; cuorasala Messiah aa vaw thueta ca ahungtahmuo khaapa taata ma aa vaw tapa kha pachang'a va yi,” ama ta.

Zingsuv ta biena-ing chunglie a pacuv nguoluona lie kha khuopuv ta khi te, “Niema ta kama kha na pachang ung cate khaapa taata ma i vaw tapa zaw kha nama pachang. Kama ri ta a vaw va ang. Cuorasala naa pathlietuv hing a hmisipa ta cuo te niema ta pachang va ung ciy,
Kama ta ca i pachang, tahematapakieca ama ta na pathlie te ama'a taata a vawpa ta i cuo,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata iema ta patuv amaa nang, cuorasala ahungtahmuo patuv va yi, tahematapakieca a cuo kha tling valie.
Cawsaazaapuv chungtaata a hluvpuv ta zang yi te, “Messiah aa vaw thueta hingpa paa a tuepa laa hingta kharuehaa hmang a hluv vie a tue'a ma?” ama ta.
Cawsaazaapuv ta cahaacata a paruvta tah a kaw ama ripa kha Farasi tie ta ama thyi tiyta, tluobyi lepa tie hne Farasi tie ca ta Zingsuv patuv riypata biena-ing a huopa paliy tie kha ama pathlie.
Zingsuv ta, “Niema'a lie cuo pachangta chung aw'a angte naa pathlietuv'a luo i si aa.
Ina huv'a ung ciy, cuorasala na hmung'a va ung ciy, i awna luo zaw a vaw khu'a va ung ciy,” a ta.
Judah ming ca pakha hne pakha kha, “Ima hmung khu li riypata khaapa luo ma vaa aa ting? Aa chepatlaapa Grik ming'a luo si pata va pacuv a ting kanaa?
Na huv'a ung cate na hmung'a va ung ciy, ‘I awna luo zaw a vaw khu'a va ung ciy,’ a tapa ta a ri khingpa hing khaapatama a cuo aa?” amaa ta.
Pyi chuo ningpa hne a biepuv cepa ning lieta kha Zingsuv ca a daa te, khuopuv ta khi te, “A tiy a hriepa mekaa ta kama'a luo a vaw ung la,
kama naa zangpa mekaa ta vya dang yi se. Caapathe ta a ripa haata, ‘A zangtuv tie palung chungtaata hringna cavaa tiy kha a lang aa,’” a ta.

Zingsuv ta hing haa hingta a ri tiyta, ama a zangtuv zaw ta ama hmung riypa Thlaapa kaw kha a ripa ta a cuo. Capa cuo ning ca Thlaapa kha pi pata cuo valie yi, tahematapakieca Zingsuv kha rungnaana pi pata cuo valie.
A ripa kha ama thyi tiyta cawsaazaapuv chung taa chekha ta, “Hingpa paa hing Profet ta a cuo hrahring,” ama ta.
Chekha ta, “Messiah tana a cuo,” ama ta. Cuorasala chekha ta, “Messiah ca Galilee taata a puv riypata a cuo lipa puv.
Caapathe ta Messiah ca David ciypathla cuo'a te David awna khy Bethlehem taa tana a cuo aa, a tapa kha,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta cawsaazaapuv ca Zingsuv kawlie amaa che.
Chekha ta ama patuv khing, cuorasala ahungtahmuo patuv hmisi va yi.
Biena-ing paliy tie kha tluobyi lepa tie hne Farasi tie'a luo ama kaa tiyta, “Khaapanakawma nama patuv va?” ama ta.
Paliy tie ta, “Ahungtahmuo hing haa hingta bie ri buo va yi,” ama ta.
Farasi tie ta, “Niema te na aca dung ra tli yi ing!
Ma uvthyi tie hne Farasi tie pakha chuo ta ama zangpa nama pachang ma?
Cuorasala hingpa cawsaazaapuv, Moses phungbie a pachang lipa tie hing ca Khazing chiesapa tana ama cuo,” ama ta.
Iema hrawlie pakha ta cuo te, a hluota Zingsuv'a luo a vawbuopa paa, Nikodemu ama tapa paa ta iema kha,
“Ma phungbie ta ca, ahunghmuota a tuepa pachang riypata a bie naathlie taa li pata ca biechipana tue vyi cuo va ma?” a ta yi.
Iema ta, “Nama zaw Galilee taata cuo ra kanaa ciy? Caapathe kha va ri la, Galilee taata profet pakha hmuo pya buo vyi tapa kha na hmung aa,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata iema pakha cyicuo ca ing luo kha amaa diy.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ca Olif Tluo luo kha a kie.
Mawdiy chiekari ta Biena-ing luo kha a cakuo pakhaa. Cawsaa bangkhuo ta a vya hmyasue yi te Zingsuv ca a tu te a pacuv yi.
Phungbie saya tie hne Farasi tie ta nungvaathingsuena a tue ningta ama patuv nung kha a vawkhyi yi te zaapuv hmielie kha ama padaa.
Zingsuv kyihuo khata, “Saya, hingpa cawsaanung hing nungvaathingsuena a tue nguoluo pata patuvpa a cuo.
Moses ta ca hing haapa canung hing ca alung ta vaasa riypa tana a cuo, ta pata phungbie chunglie malie a chang. Nama haw tuokhaatama na rue?” ama ta.
Hing haa hingta bie ama hiehriypa ca ama kha ama pachie the riypata ama dyapasyapa tana a cuo. Zingsuv ca a bung te alyi lie kha a kuvdaw ta caa a cape.
Bie kha ama hiehriy canyi pari nakawta a daa te, “Niema hrawlie suena a tue buo lipa ta alung ta vaa taa tie ung,” a ta yi.
A bung pakhaa te alyi lie kha caa a cape pakhaa.
Capa bie ama thyi tiyta a uvthyi cepa taata patha te pakha hnang pakha ta ama cakuo diy. Zingsuv dyi a tuo te a hmiekunglie kha cawsaanung ca a daa thluo.
A dangta tah a kya daa te, “Cawsaanung, iema ca khaapaliema ama aw? Pakha tahmuo sue ca be va yi ma?” a ta.
Cawsaanung ca ta, “Abyipa, ahungtahmuo sue na be va yi,” a ta. Zingsuv ta, “A cuo kieca, kama zaw sue ca be ra'a va ang. Cakuo la ata taa hingta ca suena va tue pakhaa khah,” ] a ta.
Zingsuv ta iema kha chang pakhaa yi te, “Kama ca chuelyi khena tana i cuo, kama naa ziytuv ahunghmuota zingna chunglie cakuocavaa buo'a va yi, cuorasala hringna khena kha ama hnyi aa,” a ta yi.
Farasi tie ta, “Nama ta nama kaw naa ri nakawta na ripa ca khaapahmuo cuo vyi,” ama ta.

Zingsuv ta, “Kama kaw ca kama ta i ri zaw ta i ripa ca aa hmuopa tana a cuo, tahematapakieca khaapa taata a vaw angte ma khaapa luo i vaa aa tapa kha i pachang, cuorasala niema ca khaapa taata a vaw angte ma khaapa luo i vaa aa tapa kha pachang va ung ciy.
Niema ca cawsaa phung tana bieripana nama tue; kama ca ahung cunglie hmuo bieripana tue va ang.
Bieripana i tue kie zawma, i bieripana ca aa hmuo aa, tahematapakieca kama seta tue va ang; naa pathlietuv i Paa hneta ma tuepa tana a cuo.
Nama phungbie lieta, ‘Pachangkhyituv pahning ama ripa bie ca aa hmuo,’ ta pata aa cape.
Kama cuota kama ta tehte i khuo, cakhutaata kama naa pathlietuv i paa ta kama cuota tehte a khuo,” a ta.
Iema ta, “Na Paa ca khaapaliema a aw?” ama ta. Zingsuv ta, “Kama cuose, i Paa cuose malie pachang va ung ciy. Kama hing na pachang ung la ca i Paa zaw nama pachang ra aa,” a ta yi.

Zingsuv ta hingpa bie a ripa hing biena-ing chung sue pathlanapa thingkaw ama china khuo lie a pacuv ning yi ta a cuo, cuorasala ahungtahmuo patuv va yi, tahematapakieca a cuo a tling li lie nakawta a cuo.
Zingsuv ta iema ca chang pakhaa yi te, “Kama ca i si aa, ina huv'a ung ciy, cuorasala nama suena chunglie nama thiy aa. I sina luo ca vya si ra khu'a va ung ciy,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata Judah ming ta, “I sina luo ca vya si ra khu'a va ung ciy, a tapa ca, ‘Ama hne ama aa thie khing nakawta a cuo'a ma'?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Niema ca a rawluo ming ta nama cuo, kama ca cungluo taa tana i cuo. Niema ca hingpa chuelyi ming hingta nama cuo, kama ca hingpa chuelyi taa hingta cuo va ang.
Kama ta, nama suena liena nama thiy aa ica ta yi, kama hing ama kha tana i cuo tapa kha nama zang li kieca nama suena chungliena nama thiy aa,” a ta.
Iema ta, “Ahungtama na cuo,” ama ta. Zingsuv ta, “Ica chang pari tli yi kha saw.

Niema kaw hing ri riypa a hluvsa i hnyi, sue be riypa zaw a hluvsa i hnyi; cuorasala naa pathlietuv hing zang tluo aa tlapa cuo te, ama'a taata i thyipa dyina chuelyi lie hing i pathyipa yi ta a cuo,” a ta yi.
Paa kaw a changpa yi kha iema ta pachang the va yi.

Caacuonakawta Zingsuv ta, “Cawsaa Sacapaa hing vieluo lie nama pathlie khutaa kyalya ta kama ca ama tana i cuo, tapa kha ina pachang'a ung ciy; cakhutaata kama ri ta khaapahmuo i tue lipa hne i paa ta ina changpa haata i ripa kha nama pachang aa.
Naa pathlietuv ca kama'a lie aw te, kama se ta na thuse buo vyi, tahematapakieca ama palung a patluopa dyi khana i tue pari,” a ta.
Hingpa bie a ri nguoluo ning hingta cawsaa hluvpuv ta ama kha ama zang.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ta ama a zangtuv Judah ming kha, “I pacuvna hing nama ziy kieca niema ca naa ziytuv hmisi ta nama cuo;
biehmisipa kha pachang'a ung cate, capa biehmisipa ca ta hya aca pazang'a yi,” a ta.
Iema ta, “Kiema ca Abraham ciypathla cuo pate ahung sii hmuo cuo buo vapuv. ‘Hya aca pazang'a yi,’ na tapa hing khaapama na ri khing?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta iema kha, “Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, ahunghmuota suena a tuepa ca suena sii tana a cuo.
Sii ca chungkhue lie kha cipari ta aw vyi; sacapaa ca cipari ta a aw.
Caacuonakawta Sacapaa ta hya aca pazang kie yi ca cawsaa hyazangpa nama cuo hmisi aa.
Abraham ciypathla nama cuopa ca ica pachang yi; cuorasala thie inaa nang ung ciy, tahematapakieca i bie kha nama chunglie pari va ung ciy.
Kama ta i Paa'a lie i hmungpa kha i phu, niema ca nama paa'a taata nama thyipa kha nama tue riypa tana a cuo,” a ta yi.
Iema ta, “Abraham ca ima paa tana a cuo,” ama ta. Zingsuv ta, “Abraham saata zaw nama cuo kieca a tuepa haa khata muo nama tue ra'a ta.
Cuorasala Khazing'a taata i thyipa biehmisipa caa changpa yi kha thie inaa nang ung ciy. Abraham ta ca hing haapa hmang hing za tue vyi.
Niema ca nama paa ta a tuepa khana nama tue,” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Kiema ca riesaa ta cuo vapuv; paa pakha hnyi pate Khazing ama hrahring tana a cuo,” ama ta.

Zingsuv ta iema kha, “Khazing kha nama Paa ta a cuo kieca, kama hing ina due'a ung ciy, tahematapakieca kama ca Khazing'a taata a vaw angte hingpa lie hing i aw. Kama ri ta a vaw va ang, ama na naa pathlie.
Khaapanakawma i ripa hing nama pachang the va? I bie kha nama cuhluo li nakaw tana a cuo.

Niema ca nama paa khachie'a taata cuo ung cate nama paa khingna tue riypa kha namaa tlaw. A hruothu taata ama ca lie a nawpa cuo te biehmisipa lie a daa buo vyi, tahematapakieca a chunglie kha biehmisipa aw vyi. Hang te bie a ri tiyta a puvkhyipa hringzya haa khata a ri, tahematapakieca ama ca a hanghiepa hne hanghiena paa tana a cuo.
Cuorasala kama ca biehmisipa kha ica chang nakaw yi ta na zang va ung ciy.
Ahung hing ma i suena naa hmung khu ung ciy? Biehmisipa ica chang kie yi ca, khaapanakawma ina zang va ung ciy?
Khazing'a taata a cuopa tie ca Khazing bie kha ama naathlie. Khazing bie nama naathlie khing lipa hing ca Khazing'a taata nama cuo li nakaw tana a cuo,” a ta yi.
Judah ming ta, “Nama ca Samaria ming cuo cate khuevuo na caa hryi maca tapa hing maa hmuo cuo va ma?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Khuevuo hnyi va ang; kama ta i Paa kha i pa-uvsathyi, cuorasala niema ta kama kha i na nutaa ung ciy.
Kama ca kama rungnaana kha a huvpa cuo va ang; i rungnaana kha naa huvpatuv pakha aw te ama ca bieripatuv ta a cuo.
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, i bie a ziypa ahunghmuota thiy'a vyi,” a ta.

Judah ming ta, “Ata hing ca khuevuo na caa hryi hrahring tapa kha maca pachang. Abraham ca za thiy te profet tie zaw ama za thiy diy, cuorasala nama ta ca, ‘I bie a ziypa ca khatiy tahmuo thiy'a va yi,’ na ta.
A thiy tlipa mingpa Abraham laata i le vie naa ta ma? Profet tie zaw ama thiy diy tli. Ahungtama naa ri?” ama ta.

Zingsuv ta, “Kama hne kama kha rungnaana i pi kieca, i rungnaana ca khaapahmuo cuo vyi. Kama rungnaana naa pituv ca i Paa ta cuo te, nama pachang li raalaa pata, ‘Ama ca ma Khazing tana a cuo,’ nama tapa kha tana a cuo.
Cuorasala kama ca i pachang; pachang va ang i ta kieca, niema haata a hangpa tana i cuo aa. Cuorasala pachang angte, a bie kha i ziy.
Nama mingpa Abraham ca kama ningcuo hmung riypa kha zaa ngietie vyi; hmung hmisi te a palung a tluo hringhruo,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata Judah ming ca ta, “Kung sawngaa hmuo na tling li lie pa hingta ma Abraham ca na hmung?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, Abraham hluota i aw tli,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta alung kha a haa yi te vaa amaa nang, cuorasala Zingsuv ca a nu te biena-ing taa khata a zuvpathla.
Zingsuv ca a cakuole nguoluopa khata a mingcue pata zaa puvpa cawsaa pakha a hmung.
A ziytuv tie ta, “Rabbi, ahung suena kawlie ma mingcue pata a za puv? Ama suena kawlie ma, a nung hne a paa suena kawlie ma?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Ama suena kawlie zaw cuo vyi, a nung hne paa suena kawlie zaw cuo vyi; Khazing hmang tue khuna aa luona riypa tana mingcue pata a za puvpa hingta a cuo.
Ningchung a cuo chung hingta naa pathlietuv re ca ma hrie aa hu; ahungtahmuo re ama hrie khu lina zuo cuo ca aa vaw nguoluo tli.
Chuelyi lie i aw chung hing ca, kama hingna chuelyi khena ta a cuo ang,” a ta yi.
Cahaacata a ri khutaata, Zingsuv ta a lyi kha a paciy ta pacha te a cyi kha a tue khutaata cawsaapa ming lie kha thuv te,
ama kyihuo khata, “Cakuo la Siloam Tiy-ang lie kha na hmie vaa siy tie,” a ta. (Siloam tana siyluo ca pathlie tana ta a cuo). Caacuonakawta vaa te a hmie ca vaa siy te a ming ca vuo te a vya kaa.
A ingpaa tie hne sa a hiele tawpa kha zaa hmungpa tie ta, “Hingpa paa hing a tu te sa a hie tawpa kha cuo va ma?” ama ta.
A che ta, “A cuo,” ama ta, a che ta, “Cuo vyi, ama hne aa lupa pakha tana a cuo,” ama ta. Cawsaapa ca ta, “Kama hing tana a cuo,” a ta yi.
Cuorasala Iema ta, “Tuokhaatama na hmung pakhaa?” ta pata ama hiehriy.
Ama ta, “Zingsuv ama tapa paa ta acyi tue te, i ming lie na thuv te, ‘Siloam luo kha vaa la na hmie vaa siy tie,’ ina ta. Vaa angte i hmie i siy pahne ta i ming a hmung,” a ta yi.
Iema ta, “Capa paa ca khaapaliema a aw,” ama ta. Ama ta, “Pachang va ang,” a ta yi.
Iema ta a ming zaa cuepa paa kha Farasi tie'a luo ama vaakhyi.
Zingsuv ta acyi tue te a ming a patluo sanapa ning kha Sabbath ning ta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Farasi tie ta cawsaapa a ming a hmung pakhaana kaw ca ama hiehriy pakhaa. Capa paa ca ta, “I ming lie acyi ina thuv, i hmie a siy angte ata hing i hmung tli,” a ta yi.

Farasi chekha tie ta, “Hingpa paa hing Khazing'a taata cuo vyi, tahematapakieca Sabbath phung kha ziy vyi,” ama ta. Cuorasala, a hrangpa tie ta, “Tuokhaatama a suepa ta hing haapa kharuehaa hmang hing a tue khu aa?” ama ta ra. Cakhutaa cata amaa che.
Caacuonakawta mingcuepa paa kha hiehriy pakhaa yi te, “Na ming caa pahmung sa pakhaapa paa ca tuokhaatama na rue?” ama ta. Ama ta, “Profet tana a cuo,” a ta.
Judah ming ta ama ca a ming za cue te ata hing a hmung khu pakhaa tapa kha zang va yi. Caacuonakawta cawsaapa a nung hne a paa kha ku yi te,
“Ama hing nama sacapaa, a ming cuepa tana a za puv nama tapa ca a cuo ma? Tuokhaatama a hmung khu pakhaa?” ama ta.
A nung hne a paa ta, “Ama hing ma sacapaa a cuopa ma pachang, a ming cuepa ta a za puvpa zaw ma pachang.
Cuorasala tuokhaatama ata hing a hmung pakhaa tapa hne, ahungma a ming a pahmung sa tapa kha pachang vapuv. Ama hing hiehriy tie ung; uvthyita tana a cuo tli. Ama kaw ca ama na a ri aa,” ama ta.

A nung hne a paa ta cahaacata ama tapa ca Judah ming kha ama ciy nakawta a cuo; tahematapakieca Judah ming ta ahunghmuota Zingsuv hing Messiah tana a cuo ta pata i zang a tapa ca apungna-ing taata papyapa cuose ta pata naatlana ama za hnyi pacie tlipa ta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta, a nung hne a paa ta, “Uvthyi ra tli te ama kha hiehriy tie ung,” ama tapa khata a cuo.
Caacuonakawta a ming zaa cuepa paa ca a yihningna ta ku pakhaa yi te, “Khazing kha pathuosa tie! Hingpa cawsaapa hing a suepa a cuopa kha ma pachang,” ama ta.
Ama ta, “A suepa a cuo hne a cuo li pachang va ang. I pachang tangepa suokha ca: I ming a za cue, ata hing i hmung,” a ta.
Iema ta, “Tuokhaatama aca tue? Na ming hing tuokhaatama aca pahmung sa?” ama ta.
Ama ta, “Ca chang tli yi angte naathlie va ung ciy. Khaapanakawma nama thyi khing pakhaa? Niema zaw ama a ziytuv cuo khing ra kanaa ung ciy?” a ta yi.
Iema ta, esepuo pata “Nama hingna ama a ziytuv ta a cuo ciy, cuorasala kiema ca Moses a ziytuv tana ma cuo,” ama ta.
Khazing ta Moses'a lie bie a ripa kha ma pachang; cuorasala hingpa paa hing ca khaapa taata ma aa vaw tapa hmuo pachang vapuv,” ama ta.
Cawsaapa ta, “Nang-uopa tana a cuo de! Niema ta khaapa taata ma aa vaw tapa nama pachang va, cuorasala ama ta i ming ina patluo sa.
Khazing ta a suepa bie ca naathlie vyi tapa kha ma pachang; cuorasala ama abiepa hne ama khingna a ziypa kha a bie a naathliepa.
Mingcue pata a puvpa na pakhakha ta a ming a pahmung sa pakhaa tapa hing chuelyi hruothu baataata za thyi buopa ta cuo vyi.
Hingpa paa hing Khazing'a taata a cuo li kieca khaapahmuo tue khu'a vyi,” a ta.
Iema ta, “Suena chunglie a puvpa na cuo pata ma pacuv malie naa ting?” ta yi te apungna-ing chungtaata ama papya.
Zingsuv ta ama papyapa kha a thyi khutaata cawsaapa kha a taw te, “Cawsaa Sacapaa hing na zang ma?” a ta.
Cawsaapa cata, “Abyipa, ama ca i zang khu riypata ahungma tapa kha na chang tie,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Ama ca hmung tli cate, nama hne bie a ri nguoluopa hing tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cawsaapa cata, “Abyipa, i zang,” ta te aa bie.
Zingsuv ta, “Hing chuelyi luo i zuvpa hing mingcuepa tie ta hmung'a yi te a hmungpa tie kha mingcue pata amaa li riypata bie ripa riypa tana a cuo,” a ta.
A thaalie a awpa Farasi tie chekha ta a ripa kha thyi yi te, “Kiema hing mingcuepa ma cuo ma?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Mingcuepa ta cuo ung la ca suena hnyi'a va ung ciy. Cuorasala niema ta, ‘Ma hmung thluo,’ nama ta nakaw hing tana nama suena ca aa hmang,” a ta yi.
Zingsuv ta, “Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, tuvte chung luo kha thlake taata a ngie li pata luo hrang taata a ngiepa ca a ruvhangpa hne damie tana ama cuo.
Thlake taata a ngiepa ca tuvkhietuv ta a cuo.
Thlake a huopa ta thlake kha pahawpa te a tuv zaw ta a ryi ama thyi. A tuv kha ama ming ta ku yi te a pyakhyi yi.
A pyakhyi khutaa yi ta hmieluo sapa yi te a tuv zaw khata ama ziy, tahematapakieca a ueryi kha ama pachang.
Maliepa ca ziy khing'a va yi; amaa ruose aa, tahematapakieca maliepa tie ueryi ca pachang va yi,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta hingpa pahmungsana hing a chang yi, cuorasala khaapama a ri khing tapa kha pachang va yi.
Caacuonakawta Zingsuv ta changpakhaa yi te, “Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, kama ca tuv a ngienapa thlake tana i cuo.
Kama hluota a vawpa bangkhuo ca a ruvhangpa hne damie tana ama cuo; caacuonakawta tuv ta ama ueryi kha naathlie va yi.
Kama ca thlake tana i cuo. Kama'a taata a ngiepa mekaa ca amaa bang aa; a ngie'a yi, pya'a yi te aphuv panuta kha ama hmung aa.
A ruvhangpa ca paruv riypa, thie riypa hne para riypa dyi tana aa vaw. Kama ca hringna ama hnyi riypa hne lunghruo tlungsa pata ama hnyi riypa tana i vaw.
“Kama ca a phapa tuvkhietuv tana i cuo. A phapa tuvkhietuv ca a hringna kha a tuv cuota aa pi.
A hluo chawpa, tuvkhietuv a cuo lipa hne tuv hnyituv a cuo lipa ca cahnie aa vawpa a hmung tiyta tuv kha thuse te aa ruo. Cahnie ca ta tuv kha sie te a chepatlaa diy.
A hluo chawpa ta ca tuv cunglie kawpacuona a hnyi li nakawta a tuv kha aa ruose.
Kama ca tuvkhie pha tana i cuo.
Paa ta na pachang te kama ta i pachangpa haata i tuv kha pachang angte i tuv zaw ta ina pachang yi. Cakhutaata i tuv zaw cuo khata i hringna kha i pi.
Hingpa tuvte chunglieta a aw lipa tuv hrangpa i hnyi kalie. A vya chiy ra'a yi angte, i ryi kha ama naathlie aa. Tuvkhietuv pakha rawlie tuvrung rung kha ta ama cuo aa.
I hringna kha la pakhaa the riypata i hringna kha i pi nakawta Paa ta ina due.

I hringna ca ahungtahmuo na lapa khu vyi, cuorasala kama ta kama ri ta i pipa tana a cuo. Pi khuna naw hnyi angte la pakhaa khuna naw zaw i hnyi. Capa naw ca i Paa'a taata i hmungpa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Capa bie kawlie ca ta Judah ming hrawlie achena a aw pakhaa.
Cawsaa hluvpuv ta, “Khuevuo ta a hryi te a palung a ky va tli! Khaapanakawma a bie nama naathlie,” ama ta.
A hrangpa tie ta, “Khuevuo a hnyipa bie ta cuo vyi! Tuokhaatama khuevuo ta mingcuepa ca a pahmung sa pakhaa khu aa?” ama ta.
Capa cuo lie ca Jerusalem lieta Biena-ing Pihluona pyi ama tue ningta a cuo. Thlasiy ningta cuo te,
Zingsuv ca biena-ing chung Solomon hmiechue tapa lie aa khie nguoluo.
Judah ming ta a vya hmyasue yi te, “Khacuo ma malie na paluolue pari aa? Messiah ta na cuo kieca a siesa pata malie chang tie?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Ica chang tli yi, cuorasala na zang va ung ciy. I Paa ri ta i tuepa hmang hing kama kawluo tehte a khuopa ta ama cuo;
cuorasala i tuv nama cuo li nakawta zang va ung ciy.
I tuv ca i ueryi kha ama naathlie. Kama ta pachang yi angte iema ta ina ziy yi.
Iema ca chuozaa hringna pi yi angte, ra buo'a va yi. Ahungtahmuo i kuv chungtaata na chuv khu'a va yi.
Iema kha naa pituv i Paa ca zezaw bangkhuo laata le vie te, ahungtahmuo i Paa kuv chungtaata chuv khu'a va yi.
I Paa hne kama ca pakha tana ma cuo,” a ta.
Judah ming ta ama kha vaa riypata alung amaa haa pakhaa.
Zingsuv ta iema kha, “I Paa'a taata hmang phapa a hluvsa ica pahmung sa yi. Khaapa kawlie hingta ma alung ta vaa inaa nang ung ciy?” a ta yi.
Judah ming ta, “Hmang phapa na tuena kawlie alung ta maca vaa nangpa cuo vyi, cuorasala Khazing ripachiena bie na ri nakaw tana a cuo, cawsaa cakhawpa na cuo thluo pata Khazing ta naa tue!” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Nama phungbie chunglie, ‘Niema ca khazing tie tana nama cuo,’ ta pata a cape cuo va ma?
Khazing ta bie a pipa tie kha, ‘khazing tie,’ ta yi te, Caapathe kha para khu pata a cuo li kieca,
kama ta, “Kama ca Khazing Sacapaa tana i cuo,” i ta nakawta, Paa ta pathe sa te chuelyi luo a za pathliepa ca Khazing na chie a sa nama ta khu'a ma?
I Paa khingpa hmang i tue li kieca na zang khah ung.

Cuorasala i tue kieca, kama ina zang li zaw ung cata, i tuepa chuo hing zang tie ung, cakiedyina i Paa ca kama chunglie aw te kama ca i Paa chunglie i awpa kha pachang'a ung cate nama thyi the aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ca patuv amaa nang pakhaa, cuorasala iema kuv taa khata aa ruo.
Cakhutaata Zingsuv ca Jordan cavaa huesuo, Johan ta tiy a za nawnapa yi hmang luo kha va kaa te capa lie ca a aw.
Cawsaa a hluvsa a vaw yi te, “Johan ta kharuehaa hmang khaapahmuo tue vyi, cuorasala hingpa paa kaw a ripa bangkhuo ca aa hmuo diy,” ama ta.
Cawsaa hluvpuv ta capa lie ca ama kha ama zang.
Mary hne a uvtanung Martha ama awnapa Bethani khy lie a awpa Lazaru ama tapa paa kha a pasa.
Mary ca Abyipa phyi kha ziyhmyi ta bya te a suo ta a hruv nung khata a cuo; a pasapa Lazaru ca a caapaapa ta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta a sietanung tie ta Zingsuv'a luo kha biephyatuv pathlie yi te, “Abyipa, na duesapa kha na a pasa,” ama ta.

Cuorasala Zingsuv ta capa bie ca a thyi tiyta, “Hingpa pasana hing thiyna te cuo'a vyi; Khazing rungnaana aa luona riypa hne hingpa thue hingta Khazing Sacapaa zaw rungnaana a hmungna riypa tana a cuo aa,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta Martha hne a nutanung hne Lazaru kha a duesa raalaa pa yi ta
Lazaru a pasapa thuo a thyi khutaata a awnapa lie kha ning hning a aw siy kalie.
Cakhutaata ziytuv tie kha, “Judea luo si pakhaa'a ung puv,” a ta yi.
Ziytuv tie ta, “Rabbi, a ru hluota lie Judah ming ta alung ta aca vaa nangpa yi khata ma capa luo ca vaa pakhaa naa ting?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Ning kha ta siymaluo hlyihning a aw cuo va ma? Ningchung ta a cakuopa ca chuelyi khena kha ama hmung nakawta a pachiy va vyi.
Cuorasala zuo ta a cakuopa ca khena a aw li nakawta amaa pachiy,” a ta.
Capa bie ca a ri khutaata iema kha, “Ma viesaapa Lazaru ca aa hmung tli, cuorasala pathu riypata capa luo ca i vaa aa,” a ta.
Ziytuv tie ta, “Abyipa, aa hmung kieca a tluo aa,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta Lazaru a thiyna kaw kha a ri raalaa pata, iema ta ca aa hmung sasawpa kaw khana a ri ta pata ama rue.
Caacuonakawta Zingsuv ta siephele khata, “Lazaru ca a thiy tli.
Niema nama zang thena riypata capa lie i za aw lipa ca i palung a tluo, thu ung la ama'a luo ca vaa ung puv,” a ta yi.
Mingphie ama tapa paa Thomas ta a viesaa ziytuv tie kha, “Ama hne thiyhne riypata vaa ra ung siy,” a ta yi.
Zingsuv a va pha ning kha Lazaru ca thluo chunglie ning paliy a za aw tli.
Bethani ca Jerusalem taata me hning hraw dyi a hla te,
Judah ming hluvpuv ca ama caapaapa ta a thiysepa Martha hne Mary hnaa panguo riypata amaa vaw.
Martha ta Zingsuv na a vaw tapa a thyi pahne ta pya te a vaa taw, cuorasala Mary ca ing lie kha a aw.
Martha ta Zingsuv kha, “Abyipa, nama na hingpa lie hing a aw ciy tapa kieca i caapaapa hing thiy'a vyi.
Cuorasala ata hingta hmuo na hiepa bangkhuo ca Khazing ta aca pi aa tapa kha i pachang,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Na caapaapa ca a thu pakhaa aa,” a ta.
Martha ta, “Ningchuona ning lie khiy a thu pakhaa aa tapa ca i pachang,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Kama ca thupakhaana hne hringna tana i cuo. Kama naa zangpa ca a thiy hmuo thiy yi sala ama hring aa;
cakhutaata hring te kama naa zangpa mekaa ca thiy'a va tli yi. Hingpa hing na zang ma?” a ta.
Ama ta, “A cuo, Abyipa, nama ca chuelyi luo a zuvpa, Khazing Sacapaa, Messiah na cuopa kha ica zang,” a ta.
Hingpa bie a ri khutaata Martha ca vaa te a nutanung Mary kha a paruvta tah a va u. “Saya kha a vaw te nama na a ca padang,” a ta.
Mary ta a thyi pahne ta thu te ama a taw riypata a catlisa pata a cakuo.
Zingsuv ca khy chung luo kha vya chiy valie, Martha ta a vaa tawnapa hmang lie khana a aw kalie.
Ama hne ing chunglie aw yi te hnaa a panguopa Judah ming ta Mary thu te a catlisa pata a cakuopa kha ama hmung. Thluo luo na a va caa'a nang thlu aa ta pata ama rue nakawta ama paziy.
Mary ca Zingsuv awna luo kha va pha te a hmung pahne ta a phyi thabaw lie kha a pakhuv pane te, “Abyipa nama na hingpa lie hing a aw ciy tapa kieca i caapaapa hing thiy'a vyi!” a ta.
Zingsuv ta Mary a caapa hne ama hne a vaw rapa Judah ming ama caapa kha a hmung tiyta, khuopuv ta a palung pasa te a ngie a chi.
“Khaapaliema nama paby?” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Abyipa, a vaw la vya mang tie,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ca a caa.
Caacuonakawta Judah ming ta, “Mang tie ung, kha tluv tama a due,” ama ta.
Cuorasala chekha ta, “Mingcuepa hmuo a pahmung sa pakhaa khupa paa ta Lazaru hing thiy li riypata tue khu va ma?” ama ta.
Zingsuv ca a palung pha hringhruo li pata thluo luo kha a vaa. Capa thluo ca lungkaraw cuo te a pakaa ca lungphie suokha ta ama khaa.
Zingsuv ta, “Lungphie hing hnyi tie ung,” a ta yi. Athiypa paa sietanung Martha ta, “Abyipa, a pahnuosa'a tli, tahematapakieca a thiyna taata ning paliy a ta tli,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Na zang kieca Khazing rungnaana kha na hmung aa, ta pata ica chang tli cuo va ma?” a ta.
Caacuonakawta lungphie ca ama hnyi. Zingsuv ca vuopaa luo kha ang te, “I Paa, i bie ina naathliepa nakaw ca ta icaa law.
I bie ina naathlie pari ciy tapa i pachang, cuorasala hingpa lie a daapa cawsaazaapuv hingta nama ta na pathliepa i cuopa kha ama zang thena riypata i ripa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Hingpa bie a ri diy khu pahne ta khuopuv ta khi te, “Lazaru, kya pya!” a ta.
Athiypa ca a kuv hne a phyi kha riyy catawnapa pang ta a cataw te a hmie zaw aa cataw cangta a kya pya. Zingsuv ta, “Pathluopa ung la cakuo se,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Mary hneta a vawpa Judah ming a hluvsa ta Zingsuv hmang tuepa kha hmung yi te ama kha ama zang.
Cuorasala chekha ta Farasi tie'a luo kha vaa yi te Zingsuv hmang tuepa kha ama va chang.
Caacuonakawta Farasi tie hne tluobyi lepa tie ca bieripatuv phuv ahmyana kha pahry yi te, “Tuokhaatama ma tue aa? Hingpa paa hingta kharuehaa hmang a hluvsa a tue.
Hing haa hingta ma mangthluo kieca, cawsaa bangkhuo ta ama zang aa, Rom ming kha a vaw'a yi te ma hmang pathepa hne ma mingphang kha malie ama para diy aa,” ama ta.
Iema chungtaata pakha, Kaiafas ama tapa, capa kung ningta tluobyi lepa a hriepa paa ta, “Nama pachangpa aw vyi!
Mingphang phang kha yalya ta parapa laata cawsaa zaw cuota cawsaa pakha thiypa hing a pha vie tapa pachang va ung ca ma?” a ta yi.
Hingpa bie hing ama palung chiy ta a ripa cuo vyi, capa kung ca ama kha tluobyi lepa a cuopa haata Zingsuv ca mingphang cuota a thiy aa tapa hne;
mingphang cuo dyi cuo li pata Khazing saata aa chepatlaapa bangkhuo kha hmang kha ta pahmya riypa zaw ta a thiy aa ta pata profetbiephu a rilu pata a cuo.
Capa ning taa cata Zingsuv thie riypa kha khue ama khuo.

Caacuonakawta Zingsuv ca Judah ming hrawlie kha a luohuo ta cakuocavaa va tli, khapa taa khata pya te ruocaapa hne aa ngiena lie a awpa Efraim ama tapa khy luo kha vaa te capa lie ca a ziytuv tie hne khata ama aw.
Judah ming Lawsena Pyi kha a ngie tli te cawsaa hluvpuv ca pyi hluota a pathesana tue riypata khyta taa khata Jerusalem luo kha ama kie.
Zingsuv kha huv yi te Biena-ing lie amaa daapa khata pakha hne pakha kha, “Tuokhaatama na rue? Pyi luo hing a vaw li pata ca aw'a vyi nuo?” amaa ta.
Tluobyi lepa tie hne Farasi tie ta Zingsuv awnapa a pachangpa nama aw kieca, ma patuv thena riypata malie nama chang aa, ta pata bie ama pi.
Lawsena Pyi hluo, ning caruv lie kha Zingsuv ca thiyna taata a pathupa paa Lazaru a awnapa, Bethani khy luo kha a vaa.
Capa lie ca ama cuota zuosa duonapa ama tue. Martha ca sa pi a bya yite, Lazaru ca Zingsuv hneta cabya lie a tu pakhawpa tie hrawlie kha a aw ra.
Mary ta paw kha aa riypa, a phang phasapa hne a muo ruvsapa ziyhmyi thyi kha kha la te Zingsuv phyi kha bya te a suo ta a hruv. Ziyhmyi rang pa-ue ca ingchung bangkhuo kha aa ze diy.
Zingsuv ziytuv chungtaata pakha a cuopa, ama a lyituv riypa paa, Judas Iskariot khata,
“Khaapanakawma hingpa ziyhmyi hing denarii zathung ta zaa yi sala siypasa tie kha ama pi va?” a ta.
(Hing haa hingta bie a ripa hing siypasa tie kaw a pacuo nakawta cuo li pata aparuvpa a cuo nakaw tana a cuo; tuokaa baw a caketuv ta cuo te tuokaa kha a hmuo paruv taw.)
Zingsuv ta, “Ama hing hnaa pahnaw khah ung! I riyy paby ning huota aa chi riypa tana hingpa hing a calyi.
Siypasa tie ca niema hrawlie ama aw pari aa, cuorasala kama ca niema'a lie aw pari'a va ang,” a ta.

Judah ming hluvpuv ta Bethani liena Zingsuv a aw tapa kha ama thyi nakawta capa khy luo ca ama vaa. Zingsuv vuota dyi cuo li pata Zingsuv ta thiyna taata a pathupa Lazaru ama hmung khing nakawta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta tluobyi lepa tie ta Lazaru zaw kha thiepuo riypata khue ama khuo;
tahematapakieca Lazaru kawlie ca ta Judah ming hluvpuv ta iema kha thuse yi te Zingsuv kha ama zang.
A mawluopa ta ca Lawsena Pyi luo a vawpa cawsaazaapuv ta Jerusalem luona Zingsuv aa vaw tapa kha ama thyi.
Caacuonakawta ama daw riypata hngiesie hnaa a cyi yi te ama pya, “Hosanna! “Abyipa ming ta a vawpa ca thluechiypa tana a cuo. Israel Siepahruo ca!” ta pata ama khi.
Zingsuv ca laataata kha hmung te aa khang; Caapathe lie aa capepa haata:
“Zion sacanung, na thlaa zang khah se. Mang tie, na siepahruo ca aa vaw nguoluo, Laataata na aa vya khang!” a ta.

A hruothu lie ca ziytuv tie ta hingpa kaw hing za pachang khu va yi, cuorasala Zingsuv ca rungnaana pi pata a cuo tiyta, Caapathe ta a ripa hing ama kaw ta cuo te, ama tuepa hmang zaw kha ama huo tana a cuo tapa kha ama palung a vuo pakhaa.
Caacuonakawta Zingsuv ta Lazaru kha thluo chungtaata ku pathla te a pathu pakhaapa a hmungpa cawsaa tie khata hmang a cuopa kha ama ri pachaale.
Cahaapaapa kharuehaa hmang na a tue tapa kha cawsaazaapuv ta ama thyi nakawta ama kha amaa vya taw.
Farasi tie ta pakha hne pakha kha, “Hmung ung ca ma, khaapahmuo tue khu va ung ciy! Mang tie ung, chuelyi ming ta ama kha ama paziy diy tli hing haw!” amaa ta.
Pyi chunglie Khazing abie riypata Jerusalem luo a kiepa tie hrawlie kha Grik ming chekha ama aw ra.
Galilee pe Bethsaida khy ming Filip'a luo kha a vaw yi te, “Abyipa, Zingsuv na ma hmung khing,” ama ta.
Filip ta Andru kha va chang te, ama pahning ta Zingsuv'a luo kha vaa yi te ama va chang.
Zingsuv ta, “Cawsaa Sacapaa ta rungnaana a hmungna cuo ca a vya tlung tli.
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, saciy hmung kha ca alyi lie tuv pata a thiy taa li kieca suokha dyi tana a cuo pari aa; cuorasala a thiy taa kieca saciy a hluvsa a papung sa.
A hringna a duepa tie ca ama hringna kha a sung'a yi te, hing chuelyi lie a hringna a huepa tie ca chuozaa cuota hringna ama hnyi aa.
Ahunghmuo cuose i re a hriepa ca ina ziy hrahring aa, i changtaapa ta a cuopa ca i awna lie a aw ra aa. Ahunghmuo cuose i re a hrietuv ca Paa ta pa-uvsathyina a pi aa,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “I palung rie na a thyisa. Tuokhaatama i ri aa? ‘I Paa, hing cuo chung taa hingta na khuo tie,’ i ta'a ma? Cuo vyi, hingpa kawlie hingta ca muo hingpa cuo hing i vya pha ta.
I Paa, na ming ca parungnaa sa tie!” a ta. Cakhutaata, vuoruo taata ueryi paring te, “Rungnaana pi tli angte, i pi kalie aa,” a ta.
Capa lie a daapa cawsaazaapuv khata ueryi ca thyi yi te, chekha ta, khalung na a thy, ama ta. Chekha ta, “Avuoming na ama kha bie a chang,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Hingpa ueryi hing kama cuota cuo vyi, niema cuo tana a cuo,” a ta.
Hing chuelyi hing a bie ripa riypa cuo a tling tli; hingpa chuelyi uvtuv byi hing a cade pata a cuo aa.
Hing alyi taa hingta calangthawpa i cuo thueta cawsaa bangkhuo hing kama'a luo i da diy'a yi,” a ta.
Hing haa hingta a ripa hing tuokhaapa thiyna ma i ang aa tapa khana a paluo sa khing.

Cawsaazaapuv ta, “Phungbie taata ma thyipa ca, Messiah ca chuozaa tana a hring aa, a ta. Tuokhaatama Cawsaa Sacapaa ca calangthawpa tana a cuo aa, na ta the? Capa Cawsaa Sacapaa ca ahungtama a cuo?” ama ta.

Zingsuv ta, “Khena ca niema'a lie cuo pachangta chung a aw kalie aa. Khena nama hnyi chung hing zingna ta aca vya law li riypa yi ta cakuo tie ung. Zingna chunglie nama cakuo kieca khaapaliema nama cakuo tapa kha pachang va ung ciy.
Khena nama hnyi chung hingta khena saa zaw nama cuo khuna riypata khena ca zang tie ung,” a ta.
Ama hmungna lieta kharuehaa hmang a hluvsa a tue thluo pata ama kha zang va yi.
Capa ca profet Isaiah ta: “Abyipa, ma bie ca ahungma a zang, Abyipa kuv ca ahung'a luo ma aa luo?” ta pata a za ripa kha a tlingna riypa tana a cuo.
Cuorasala zang khu ngiethie va yi, Isaiah ngiethie ta,

"Ama ming ta ama mang li riypa hne, ama palung ta ama pachang li riypa hne, kama'a luo a vya pali'a yi te, i patluo sa pathlyi li riypa yi ta, ama ta ama ming pacue sa yi te, ama palung a paping yi,” ta pata a za ri.
Isaiah ta hing haa hingta a ripa ca Zingsuv rungnaana kha za hmung tli te a kaw zaw a za ri tli nakawta a cuo.
Cuorasala Judah ming uvthyi a hluvpuv zaw khata Zingsuv ca ama zang. Farasi tie ca apungna-ing taata malie papya'a kie yi ta pata a luohuo ta zang nguo va yi.
Iema ca cawsaa rungnaana kha Khazing'a taata hmungpa rungnaana laata ama khing vie.
Zingsuv ta khuopuv ta khi te: “Ahunghmuo cuose kama naa zangpa mekaa ca kama dyi ina zangpa cuo li pata kama naa pathlietuv zaw kha a zangpa tana a cuo.
Kama naa hmungpa ca naa pathlietuv zaw kha a hmungpa ta a cuo.
Kama naa zangpa ahunghmuo zingna chunglie ama aw li riypata hing chuelyi luo hing khena ta i vaw tli.
I bie kha thyi te a ziy lipa kha a bie ripa'a va ang. Kama ca chuelyi bie ripa riypata a vaw va ang, cuorasala khuo riypa tana i vaw.
Kama kha na thaw te i bie kha a cuhluo lipa ca bie a ripatuv riypa pakha a hnyi. Kama i ripa bie hingna ningchuona ning thueta a bie a ripatuv ta a cuo aa!
Tahematapakieca kama ri ta i ripa cuo vyi, cuorasala naa pathlietuv i Paa ama hrahring ta ri riypata ina changpa bie khana i ripa ta a cuo.
A nawbie ca chuozaa hringna tana a cuo tapa kha i pachang. Caacuonakawta i ripa bie hing Paa ta ina changpa haata i ripa tana a cuo,” a ta yi.

Lawsena Pyi hluota, Zingsuv ca hingpa chuelyi hing sise pata a Paa'a luo si riypa cuo a vya chiy tli tapa kha a pachang. Chuelyi lieta a awpa ama huopa a cuopa tie kha due pari yi te a chuona te ta a due yi.
Zingsuv kha lyi riypata khachie ta Simon Iskariot sacapaa Judas palung chunglie kha ruena a chi mangtli. Zuosa ama ning nguoluopa khata,
Zingsuv ca i Paa ta hmangting bangkhuo kha i kuv cung luo ina pi diy tli tapa hne, Khazing'a taata a vaw angte Khazing'a luo na i kaa pakhaa aa tapa kha a pachang nakawta,
cabya taa khata thu te a buohryi pasiypa kha a thlie khutaata pavya ta a se kha aa ri.
Cakhutaata zalungpakaa lie kha tiy patle te ziytuv tie phyi kha pasiy te a se lie aa ripa pavya khata a hruv yi.
Simon Piter luo a vya chiy tiyta ama ta, “Abyipa, nama ma i phyi naa pasiy'a ciy? a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Khaapama i tue tapa kha ata hing ca pachang vaciy, cuorasala a hnang taata ca na pachang aa,” a ta.
Piter ta, “I phyi ca na pasiy buo hluo'a vaciy,” a ta. Zingsuv ta, “Na phyi ica pasiy li kieca kama'a lie aw ra the'a va tli ciy,” a ta.
Simon Piter ta, “Abyipa, i phyi dyi cuo li pata i kuv hne i luv zaw hing na pasiy puo tie,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Tiy a siy tlipa ca a pathe diy tli nakawta a phyi ta li pata a hrang luo pasiy a hu vyi. Nama palang ta nama pathe, pakha ta li pata ca,” a ta yi.
Ama ta ca ahungma naa lyi aa tapa kha a pachang nakawta, “Nama palang ta ca pathe va ung ciy,” a ta pata a cuo.
Ama phyi a pasiy khutaa yi ta, a buohryi pasiypa kha a hryi te cabya luo kha vaa tu pakhaa te, “Niema'a lie i tuepa hmang hing a siyluo nama pachang ma?
Niema ta, Saya hne Abyipa ina tapa ungca hing namaa hmuo, tahematapakieca ina tapa haa ung cata i cuo sasaw.
Nama Byipaapa hne Saya ta a cuopa kama ta nama phyi kha ica pasiy kie yi ca niema zaw pakha hne pakha kha nama phyi namaa pasiy riypata a cuo.
Niema cuota a mangpuo riypa ica tuepa tli yi, niema cuota i tuepa haa khata niema zaw nama tue riypata a cuo.
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, changtaapa tie ca ama byipaapa laata le vie va yi, biephyatuv tie zaw a pathlietuv laata le vie va yi.
Hingpa hmang hing pachang ung cate nama tue kieca thluechiypa tana nama cuo.
Hingpa i ripa hing nama palang ta ica ta khingpa yi ta cuo vyi; i tlawpa ca i pachang thluo yi. Cuorasala Caapathe ta, ‘I sa a ningpa paa na hekhuo naa khuo, a tapa ca a tling aa hu,’ a ta.
Hmang hing a vya cuo sasaw tiyta kama hing ama ca tana i cuo tapa kha nama zang khu the riypata a cuo hluota ica chang pacie yi.
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, kama ta i pathliepa a cuhluopa ca kama naa cuhluopa ta cuo te, kama kha naa cuhluopa ca naa pathlietuv a cuhluopa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Capa bie a ri khutaata Zingsuv ca a palung rie thyisa te, “Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, niema chung taa pakha ta ina lyi'a ung ciy,” ta pata a ri pathla.
Ziytuv tie ca pakha hne pakha kha a mang yi te, ahung hing ma malie a ta khing a ta yi te nang-uosa pata ama aw.
Ziytuv tie chungtaata pakha ta a cuopa, Zingsuv ta a duepa paa kha Zingsuv a vaa pha pata aa tu.
Simon Piter ta a kuv a kyipa te, a ripa hing ahungma a ta khing hnuochuopa ta a cuo tapa kha a pahiehriy sa.
Caacuonakawta Zingsuv kha a hnyi chiy vie te, “Abyipa, ahungma?” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Viechuo hing tiyhuo pakaa luo naw'a angte i pipa paa hing tana a cuo aa,” a ta. Viechuo kha naw te Simon Iskariot sacapaa Judas kha a pi.
Viechuo kha a cuhluo khutaata a chung luo kha Setaa aa ngie. Zingsuv ta, “Na tue riypa ca a catli pata tue tie,” a ta.
Khaapanakawma cahaacata a ri tapa kha cabya cunglie a tupa ahungtahmuo pachang va yi.
Ziytuv tie chekha ta ca, Judas ca tuokaa baw a patuvpa a cuo nakawta, Zingsuv ta, “Pyi lie hmuo riypa ma a calyi sa,” acuolikie, siypasa tie kha ma suokhakha a papi sa yi, ta pata ama rue.
Judas ca viechuo a cuhluo khu pahne ta a pya paluo. Capa cuo ca zuo ta a cuo.
Judas a pya khu pahne ta Zingsuv ta, “Ata ca Cawsaa Sacapaa hing rungnaana pi pata a cuo tli; Khazing zaw kha Cawsaa Sacapaa thueta rungnaana a hmung tli.
Khazing ca Sacapaa thueta rungnaana a hmung kieca, Khazing ama hrahring ta Cawsaa Sacapaa kha rungnaana a pi paluo aa.
I saa zaw, kama ca niema'a lie a syi aw'a va tli ang. Ina huv'a ung ciy; cuorasala, ‘I sina luo ca vya si ra khu'a va ung ciy,’ ta pata Judah ming i chang pahaa yi khata niema zaw ica chang yi.
Phungbie thaapa na ica pi yi, pakha hne pakha a due tie ung. Kama ta ica duepa haa yi hingta pakha hne pakha namaa due riypa tana a cuo.
Pakha hne pakha namaa due kieca, khapa thue khata cawsaa bangkhuo ta kama naa ziytuv nama cuopa kha aca pachang'a yi,” a ta yi.
Simon Piter ta, “Abyipa, khaapa luo ma na vaa aa?” a ta. Zingsuv ta, “Ata hing ca i cakuona luo kha na ziy the'a valie ciy; cuorasala a hnang vie taata ina ziy'a ciy,” a ta.
Piter ta, “Abyipa, khaapanakawma ata hingta ica ziy khu'a va? I hringna hmuo na cuota i pi'a muo” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Kama cuota na hringna na pi'a ma? Biehmisi tana ica chang, aa a khang hluota yi thung ina thaw'a ciy,” a ta.
“Pathiypalung rie thyi pata aw khah ung. Khazing kha zang ung la kama zaw hing na zang tie ung.
I Paa ing lie awna riypa a khuo a hluvsa a aw. Cahaacata a cuo li kieca, niema awna hmang tue daw riypa tana i si, ica ta'a yi ma?
Si'a angte nama awna riypa hmang ica tue daw khutaa yi ta za kaa pakhaa'a angte kama awna lie nama aw ra riypata niema kha kama'a luo ica la'a yi.
I sina hmang luo a chiypa luopuv ca nama pachang,” a ta yi.
Thomas ta, “Abyipa, khaapa luo ma na si tapa kha pachang vapuv. Tuokhaatama luopuv ca ma pachang the aa?” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Kama ca luopuv, hne biehmisipa, hne hringna ta i cuo. Kama'a taata ta li pata ahunghmuo i Paa'a luo chiy the va yi.
Kama kha ina pachang kie ungca ca i Paa zaw kha nama pachang aa. Ata taa hingta ca ama kha pachang ung cate nama hmung mangtli” a ta yi.
Filip ta, “Abyipa, na Paa ca malie pahmung la ma palung a tlingsa aa,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Niema'a lie cuo pasiypuv i aw tli, ata tepa ta na pachang va ca ma, Filip? Kama naa hmungpa ca i Paa kha a hmung mangtli. Tuokhaatama ‘Paa kha malie pahmung tie,’ na ta?
Kama ca i Paa chunglie aw angte i Paa ca kama chunglie a awpa hing pachang va ca ma? Ica changpa yi bie hing kama palungchiy ta i ripa cuo vyi; i chunglie a awpa i Paa rehriena tana a cuo.
Kama ca i Paa chunglie aw angte i Paa ca kama chunglie a awpa kha zang tie ung; nama zang li kie zawma i tuepa hmang thue hingta na zang tie ung.
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, Kama naa zangpa ca i tuepa hmang hing tue khu ra'a yi te hingpa laa hingta a le viepa hmang hmuota ama tue aa, tahematapakieca i Paa'a luo kha i si'a nakawta a cuo.
Paa ta Sacapaa thueta rungnaana a hmung riypata kama ming ta nama hiepa bangkhuo kha i tue aa.
Khaapahmuo cuose i ming ta kama'a lie nama hiepa mekaa ca i tue aa,” a ta.
“Ina due kie ungca ca i nawbie kha nama ziy aa.
Paa kha hie'a angte niema'a lie chuozaa ta caa awkhyi riypa yi Byatuv hrangpa kha aca pi'a yi.

Ama ca biehmisipa Thlaapa, chuelyi ta a cuhluo khu lipa ta a cuo, tahematapakieca ama ca chuelyi ta a hmung buo li nakaw hne a pachang buo li nakawta a cuo. Ama ca niema'a lie aw te, niema chunglie a aw'a nakawta niema ta ca ama kha nama pachang.
“Niema dyise ta haaraata haata ca thuse'a va yi ang, niema'a luo i vya kaa pakhaa aa.
A cawta a aw pata chuelyi ta ca na hmung'a va tli, cuorasala niema ca ina hmung'a ung ciy; kama i hring nakawta niema zaw nama hring ra aa.
Capa ning thue ca ta kama ca i Paa chunglie i awpa kha cuose, kama chunglie niema nama awpa hne niema chunglie kama i awpa kha nama pachang aa.
I nawbie kha cuhluo te a ziypa ca kama naa duepa ta ama cuo. Kama naa duepa tie ca i Paa ta a due ra'a yi, kama zaw ta due ra'a yi angte iema'a lie kha i phu aa,” a ta.
Judas Iskariot a cuo lipa Judas ta, “Abyipa, chuelyi ming cunglie a phu li pata kiema'a lie dyi naa phu riypa ca tuokhaatama a cuo?” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Kama naa duepa ca i bie kha a ziy aa. I Paa ta iema kha due'a yi te iema'a luo kha a vaw'a pate iema hne khy ma sa hne aa.
Kama naa due lipa ca i bie kha ziy vyi. Nama thyipa bie hing kama bie ta cuo vyi, kama naa pathlietuv Paa bie tana a cuo.
“Niema'a lie i aw ningta hingpa bangkhuo hing ica chang yi.
Cuorasala i Paa ta kama ming ta a za pathlie riypa Byatuv Thlaapa Pathe ta hmangting kha ca pacuv'a yi te ica changpa bangkhuo yi kha aca pathyi sa pakhaa'a yi.
Thlaalungna na ica chipa siy yi; kama thlaalungna na ica pi yi. Chuelyi ta aca pipa haa yi ta ca pi va yi ang. Nama palung rie thyi khah se, ciyna zaw hnyi khah ung.
‘Ica sise'a yi, cuorasala i vya kaa pakhaa aa,’ ica tapa yi kha nama thyi. Kama kha ina due kie ungca ca i Paa'a luo i sipa kha namaa law aa, tahematapakieca i Paa ca kama laata a le vie.
A vya cuo hmisi thueta nama zang thena riypata a vya cuo hluota ica chang pacie yi.
Niema hneta bie a syi ri the'a va tli ang, tahematapakieca hingpa chuelyi a uvtuv ca aa vaw nguoluo tli. Ama ca i cunglie nawhnyina khaapahmuo hnyi vyi,
cuorasala chuelyi ming ta Paa i duepa kha ama pachangna riypata Paa ta ina changpa haa khata i tue. Thu tie ung, cakuo'a ung puv, a ta yi.
“Kama ca mingsuv kung hmisipa ta cuo angte i paa ca mingsuv diedung a hnyituv ta a cuo.
Kama chunglie a thyi a pathyi lipa ce bangkhuo kha a pasepathla diy. A thyi a pathyipa ce mekaa kha a pathyi hryly riypata a pathe.
Niema ca kama ica changpa yi bie khata aca pathe sa diy tli yi.

Kama hne a pazue ung la kama zaw niema kha icaa pazue ra'a yi. Mingsuv ce ca a kungpuvnung lie aa pazue li kieca amata tah a pathyi khu lipa haata niema zaw kama chunglie nama aw li kieca niemata tah thyi pathyi khu'a va ung ciy.

Kama ca mingsuv kung cuo angte niema ca a ce tana nama cuo. Ahunghmuo cuose kama chunglie aw te kama zaw ama chunglie i aw kieca thyi a hluvsa a pathyi aa, tahematapakieca kama li pata ca nama tue khupa khaapahmuo aw vyi.
Kama chunglie a aw lipa ca mingsuv ce caapa haa khata ale luo thaw pata nama cuo aa. Cahaapa a ce zaw ca pahmya yi te myi luo kha thaw yi te a kuo diy.
Kama chunglie aw ung cate i bie kha nama chunglie a aw kieca, nama khingpa bangkhuo kha naa hie ung la tuepa pata nama cuo aa.
Thyi a hluvsa nama pathyina thue hingta i Paa rungnaana kha paluo sa ung cate kama naa ziytuv nama cuonapa ta a cuo.
Paa ta ina duepa haata kama ta ica due ra yi; i duena chunglie hing aw tie ung.
I Paa phungbie kha ziy angte a duena chunglie i awpa haa hingta i phungbie nama ziy pata a cuo kieca i duena chunglie hing nama aw aa.
I palungtluona kha nama chunglie aw te namaa lawna ca a tling riypata hingpa bie hing ica chang yi.
“I nawbie ca hingpa hing tana a cuo. Kama ta niema ica duepa yi haa hingta pakha hne pakha kha a due ra tie ung.
Viesaa cuota hringna a pipa duena laa hingta a le viepa duena ca ahungtahmuo hnyi vyi.
Ica changpa yi hing nama tue kieca i viesaa ta nama cuo.

Niema ca changtaapa ca ta va tli yi ang, tahematapakieca changtaapa ta ca a byipaapa ta khaapama a tue tapa kha pachang vyi. Cuorasala kama ta ca viesaa ica ta yi; tahematapakieca i Paa'a taata i thyipa mekaa kha ica pachang sa diy yi.

Niema ta naa tlaw va ung ciy, cuorasala kama na caa tlaw yi ang. Kama ming ta ama'a luo nama hiepa bangkhuo kha Paa ta aca pi riypa yi ta aa hmangpa thyi kha va pathyi tie ung ta pata re ica chang yi.
Niema pakha hne pakha namaa due riypa tana hingpa nawbie zaw hing ica pi yi.
“Chuelyi ta aca hue kie yi ca, niema aca hue hluo yi ta kama na ina hue taa yi tapa kha pachang tie ung.
Chuelyi huopa ta cuo ung la ca chuelyi hingta a huopa haata aca duesa'a yi. Cuorasala kama ta chuelyi taa hingta caa tlaw yi angte a huopa nama cuo li tli nakawta chuelyi ta aca hue yi.

'Changtaapa tie ca ama byipaapa laata le vie buo va yi,’ ica tapa yi i bie kha a thyi tie ung. Iema ta kama kha ina hrisaa kie yi ca niema zaw aca hrisaa ra'a yi; kama bie kha ama ziy kieca niema bie zaw kha ama ziy ra aa.
Cuorasala kama cawsaa nama cuo nakawta hingpa hmang bangkhuo hing nama cunglieta ama tue aa, tahematapakieca kama naa pathlietuv kha pachang va yi.
Iema'a luo a vaw li pata hne iema kha bie chang li pata aw ang sala ama cunglie suena aw'a vyi, cuorasala ata hing ca sue a ngiethe khu pata cuo'a va yi.
Kama naa huepa mekaa ca i Paa zaw kha ama hue ra.
Ahungtahmuo ama tue buo lipa hing iema hrawlie tue li pata za aw ang sala ama suena aw'a vyi. Cuorasala ata hing ca i tuepa kha hmung yi te kama hne i Paa hneta malie ama hue.
‘Khaapa bie hmuo aw li pata na ina hue yi,’ ta pata ama phungbie chunglie aa capepa bie a tlingna riypa tana a cuo.
“I Paa'a taata niema'a luo i za pathlie riypa Byatuv, biehmisi Thlaapa a vaw'a te kama kaw kha tehte a khuo aa.
Niema zaw a hruothu taata kama'a lie a awpa nama cuo nakawta kama cuopa ta tehte nama khuo ra aa.
“Namaa lie pathlyi li riypata hingpa bie hing ica chang yi.
Apungna-ing taata aca papya'a yi. Niema caa thiepa tie ta ama tuepa hing Khazing re na i hrie ta pata ama ruena cuo a vya pha aa.
I Paa cuose kama cuose malie ama pachang li nakawta hing haa hingta nama cunglie ama tue aa.
Capa cuo ca a vya pha tiyta niema ta ica za chang pacie tlipa yi kha namaa thyi pakhaa riypata hingpa bie hing ica chang yi.
Cuorasala ata hing ca naa pathlietuv'a luo kha i si'a tli; cuorasala ahungtahmuo, ‘Khaapa luo ma na si aa?’ ta pata na hiehriy va ung ciy.
Cuorasala ica chang tiy yi ta nama ngie a chi hringhruo.
Cadyiseca biehmisi tana ica chang yi: i sipa hing niema phana cuo tana a cuo, i si li kieca Byatuv hing niema'a luo a vaw the'a vyi; cuorasala i si kieca, kama ta niema'a luo kha i za pathlie aa.
Ama kha aa vaw tiyta, chuelyi ming'a lie kha suena kawlie, adangna kawlie hne bieripana kawlieta ama ruenazya aa hmuo lina kaw kha a siesa pata a pachang sa'a yi:
suena kawlie ama ruenazya a hmuo vyi, tahematapakieca kama ina zang li nakaw yi ta a cuo.
Adangna kawlie ama ruenazya a hmuo vyi, tahematapakieca Paa'a luo si'a angte ina hmung li tli'a nakaw yi ta a cuo.
Bieripana kawlie ama ruenazya a hmuo vyi, tahematapakieca chuelyi uvtuv byi hing suebie ripa tlipa ta a cuo nakawta a cuo.
“Niema ica chang riypa yi a hluvsa i hnyi kalie, cuorasala ata hingta ca a cake khu the'a va ung ciy.

Biehmisipa Thlaapa aa vaw tiyta niema kha biehmisipa luo a caa chiy'a yi; ama ri ta khaapahmuo ri'a vyi, cuorasala a thyipa bangkhuo kha ri'a te a vaw riypa hmang kaw zaw kha niema'a lie a pathyi sa aa.
Kama i ripa bie kha la'a te aca pathyi sa'a nakaw yi ta kama kha rungnaana ina pi aa.
Paa hnyipa bangkhuo ca kama huopa tana ama cuo diy. Caacuonakawta kama i ripa bie kha la'a te na niema kha aca pathyi sa'a yi, i ta pata a cuo.
“Kha cuo a ta hluota kama kha na hmung'a va tli ung ciy, cuo pachangta khutaata ina hmung pakhaa'a ung ciy,” a ta.

Cakhutaata ama a ziytuv tie chekha ta pakha hne pakha kha, “Kha cuo a ta hluota kama kha na hmung'a va tli ung ciy, cuo pachangta khutaata ina hmung pakhaa ung ciy, tahematapakieca Paa'a luo na i si aa,” a tapa hing khaapama a ri khingna ta a cuo aa amaa ta.
Iema ta, “'Kha cuo a ta hluota,’ a tapa hing khaapama a ri khingpa a cuo aa? Khaapa kaw ma a ri tapa kha pachang vapuv,” amaa ta.

Ama ama hiehriy khingpa kha Zingsuv ta pachang te, “Kha cuo a ta hluota kama kha na hmung'a va tli ung ciy, cuo pachangta khutaata ina hmung pakhaa ung ciy,” i ta tiyta khaapama i ri khing tapa khana namaa rue cuo va ma?
Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, niema ca caa'a ung cate namaa ngiy aa, cuorasala chuelyi ca a palung a tluo aa; niema ca nama ngie chi'a te, cuorasala nama ngiechina ca palungtluona ta aa li aa.

Canung ca nu a pazi tiyta pasana a ang, tahematapakieca a cuo a tling nakawta a cuo. Cuorasala nu a za aw tiyta, chuelyi luo nuta thaapa pakha a za puv nakawta a palung tluo te a te-angna bangkhuo ca a maw pakhaa diy.
Caacuonakawta ata hing ca nama ngie a chi, cuorasala ca hmung pakhaa'a yi angte nama palung a tluo hringhruo aa, capa nama palungtluona ca ahungtahmuo ca chuv khu'a va yi.
Capa ning thueta ca kama kha khaapahmuo na hiehriy'a va ung ciy. Biehmisi tana ica chang yi, Kama ming ta nama hiepa mekaa ca Paa ta aca pi'a yi.
Ata tepa hingta ca i ming ta khaapahmuo hie va ung ciy. Hie ung la nama hmung aa; cahaacata nama palungtluona kha aa ky aa.
“Hingpa bangkhuo hing pahmungsana bie hmuo angte ica chang yi. Cuorasala i Paa kaw kha pahmungsana bie hmuo li pata siepaalaa khata ica changna yi cuo kha aa vaw aa.
Capa ning a vya pha tiyta niema ta i ming ta nama hie aa. Niema cuopa tana kama ta Paa'a luo kha ica hiepa'a yi ica tapa yi ta cuo vyi.
Kama kha na due ung cate Khazing'a taata i vawpa kha nama zang nakawta Paa hrahring ta niema kha aca due yi.
Kama ca Paa'a taata chuelyi luo hing i vaw; chuelyi taa hingta i Paa'a luo i kaa pakhaa aa,” a ta.
A ziytuv tie ta, “A cuo, ata hing ca pahmungsana hmuo li pata a siesa pata malie na chang.
Nama ca hmangting bangkhuo a pachangpa na cuopa kha pachang pate, ahungtahmuo khaapahmuo hiehriy a hu va tli ciy; capa ca ta Khazing'a taata a vawpa na cuopa kha malie a pazang sa,” ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Ata ca i na zang ung ca ma?

Nama palang ta ca chepatlaa diy'a yi te, nama ing cyicuo ta a diy'a ung cate kama dyi ta ina thusena ung ciy cuo kha a vaw nguoluo te ata hing a vya tlung tli. Cuorasala i Paa kha kama'a lie a aw nakawta kama dyi hmisi ta ca cuo va ang.
Kama chunglie thlaalungna nama hmung the riypata hingpa bie hing ica chang yi. Chuelyi lie hing ca hrisaana nama ang aa. Cuorasala nama riepha se; chuelyi ca i te tli,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta capa bie a ri khutaata avuo luo kha mang te, “I Paa, a cuo ca a vya pha tli; na Sacapaa ta rungnaana aca pi the riypata, na Sacapaa hing rungnaana pi tie.
Nama ta na pipa cawsaa zaw bangkhuo kha chuozaa hringna pi riypata nawhnyina kha na pi tli.
Chuozaa hringna tapa ca nama dyi aa hmuopa Khazing na cuopa pachangna, hne na pathliepa Zingsuv Khrih pachangna hing tana a cuo.
Hrie riypata ina pipa ciy re patlung tli angte hing alyi lie hing na ming ica parungnaa sa mangtli.
Caacuonakawta, i Paa, chuelyi sa hluota namaa lie i za hnyipa rungnaana khata na minghmungna lie hing na parungnaa sa thi tie.
“Chuelyi taata ku yi cate ina pipa tie cunglie na ming kha i paluo sa tli. Na huopa ta cuo yi te nama ta kama kha ina pi ciy, na bie kha ziy yi te
kama ina pipa mekaa ca hing nama'a taa tana a cuo tapa kha ama pachang.
Ina pipa ciy na bie kha i chang yi, iema ta cuhluo yi te nama'a taata a vawpa i cuopa kha pachang hmisi yi te nama pathliepa i cuopa zaw kha ama zang.
Iema cuota thlaa i chuo, chuelyi cuota thlaachuo va ang, cuorasala na huopa ta a cuopa ina pipa tie cuo khata thlaa i chuo.
Kama huopa bangkhuo hing nama huopa ta cuo yi te iema chung taa hingta i rungnaana aa luo.

Cakhutaata ata hing kama ca chuelyi lie aw'a va tli ang, nama'a luo i vaw'a tli; cuorasala iema ca chuelyi lie ama aw kalie aa. A pathepa i Paa, nama hne kama ca pang kha ma cuopa haata pang kha ama cuo the ra riypata, ina pipa tie yi ca hing na ming cahrana ta mangchiy thi tie yi.

Iema'a lie i aw ning hing ca, ina pipa tie ca hingna na ming cahrana ta i mangchiy yi. Kama ta mangchiy yi angte, Caapathe a tlingna riypata, vie riypa hrahring ta lieriy uopuopa paa ta li pata pakha hmuo vie va yi.
Ata hing kama ca nama'a luo i vaw aa; kama palungtluona kha iema chunglie tluotlingsa pata ama hnyina riypata hingpa bie hing chuelyi lie i aw ning ta i ri pata a cuo.
Na bie kha chang yi angte chuelyi ta iema ca a hue yi, tahematapakieca kama ca chuelyi huopa i cuo lipa haa khata iema zaw chuelyi huopa ama cuo li nakawta a cuo.
Iema hing chuelyi taata la riypata ica hiepa ta cuo vyi, cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa paa'a taata naa daakhuole riypa yi tana ica hie.
Kama hing chuelyi huopa i cuo lipa haata iema zaw chuelyi huopa ta cuo ra va yi.
Iema hing biehmisipa ta pathe sa tie yi; na bie ca biehmisipa tana a cuo.
Nama ta chuelyi luo ina pathliepa haa cata kama ta chuelyi luo i pathlie ra yi.
Iema zaw biehmisipa lie pathe sapa ama cuo riypata kama zaw i pathe sa.
“Iema cuo dyi hingta thlaa i chuopa cuo vyi, cuorasala iema ama ripa bie thueta kama naa zangpa tie bangkhuo pang kha ama cuo the riypa cuo zaw ta thlaa i chuo.
I Paa, chuelyi ming ta kama ca nama pathliepa i cuopa kha ama zang the riypata nama ca kama chunglie aw cate kama ca nama chunglie i awpa haata iema zaw kiema chunglie ama aw riypata thlaa i chuo.
Kiema pang kha ta ma cuopa haata iema zaw pang kha ama cuo riypata rungnaana ina pipa ca kha i pi yi.

Chuelyi ta kama ca nama pathliepa cuo angte kama ina duepa haa cata iema zaw na duepa yi kha ama pachang riypa hne iema zaw pang kha ama cuokaruv riypata kama ca iema chunglie aw angte nama ca kama chunglie na aw pata a cuo.
I Paa, kama kha chuelyi sa hluo taata ina due tli nakaw ca ta ina pipa ciy cawsaa tie hingta ina pipa ciy i rungnaana ama hmungna riypata kama i awna lie aw ra yi sala ta pata i khing.
“Aa dangpa i Paa, chuelyi ta nama kha ca pachang vyi, cuorasala kama ta ica pachang; hingpa tie hingta ina pathliepa ca kha ama pachang.
Nama ta ina duenapa ciy duena kha iema chunglie aw sala kama kha iema chunglie i aw riypata na ming ca iema kha pachang sa tli yi angte i pachang sa kalie'a yi,” a ta.
Hingpa bie zaw hing a ri khutaata Zingsuv ca a ziytuv tie hneta Kidron bawphie kha va te yi te capa lie a awpa diedung chung luo kha a ziytuv tie hneta amaa ngie.
Capa hmang lie ca Zingsuv hne ziytuv tie kha amaa taw lawmaw nakawta ama a lyituv Judas zaw ta capa hmang ca a pachang.
Caacuonakawta Judas ca tluobyi lepa tie hne Farasi tie ta ama pathliepa riekaphuv cawta hne paliy tie hne khata myi-ing hne myisaa hne cehre zaw kha a vya cyi yi te amaa vaw.
Zingsuv ca a cunglie a tlung riypa bangkhuo kha a pachang nakawta hmieluo kha pya te, “Ahungma nama huv,” ta pata a hiehriy yi.
Iema ta, “Nazareth khypa Zingsuv,” ama ta. Zingsuv ta, “Kama hing tana i cuo,” ta pata a palie yi. Ama a lyituv Judas ca iema hne khata amaa daa pakhaw.
Zingsuv ta, “Kama hing tana i cuo,” a ta pahne yi ta ama hnangluo a saw yi te alyi lie kha amaa yapatyi diy.
“Ahungma nama huv?” a ta pakhaa yi. “Nazareth khypa Zingsuv,’ ama ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Kama hing tana i cuo ica ta yi. Caacuonakawta kama na ina huv ung ciy tapa kieca hingpa cawsaa tie hing ca cakuo yi se,” a ta yi.
“Ina pipa tie yi ca hing pakha hmuo pavie va yi ang,” a tapa a bie kha a tlingna riypata hing haa hingta a ri pata a cuo.
Simon Piter ta a zueziy kha a phie te tluobyi lepa sii a cacuoluo naakue kha a sa pathla. Capa sii a ming ca Malkhas ta a cuo.
Zingsuv ta Piter kha, “Na zueziy kha a bya chung luo pasuo tie. Paa ta ina pipa panuo hing dang li pata ma i aw aa?” a ta.
Caacuonakawta rieka tie, abyi tie hne Judah paliy tie ta Zingsuv ca patuv yi te ama ciy khutaata
Kaiafas a napuvnung a paa ta a cuopa, capa kung ningta tluobyi lepa a hriepa Annas'a luo kha ama vaakhyi taa.
Kaiafas ca cawsaazaapuv cuota cawsaa pakha thiypa a pha vie ta pata Judah ming ruena a pituvpa khata a cuo.
Simon Piter hne a hrangpa ziytuv pakha ta Zingsuv kha ama ziy. Capa ziytuv hrangpa paa ca tluobyi lepa hne khata amaa pachang nakawta Zingsuv hne khata tluobyi lepa tlawhmie luo ca aa ngie ra.
Cuorasala Piter ca thlake athaalie, ale lie khata aa daa. Caacuonakawta tluobyi lepa hne a pachangpa ziytuv hrangpa ca va pya te, thlake a huo nung kha chang te Piter ca a chung luo a pangie.
Cawsaanung ca ta Piter kyihuo khata, “Nama zaw hing hingpa paa a ziytuv pakha ta cuo va ca ma?” a ta. Ama ta, “Cuo va ang,” a ta.
A kangsa nakawta sii tie hne paliy tie ca myihyi ta myi kha patiy yi te amaa daa luota amaa e. Piter zaw aa daa luota myi ca aa e ra.
Cakhutaata tluobyi lepa ta Zingsuv ca a ziytuv tie kaw hne a pacuvna kaw kha a hiehriy.
Zingsuv ta, “Kama ca a luohuo tana chuelyi lie hing bie i ri; Judah ming bangkhuo amaa hmyanapa apungna-ing lie hne biena-ing lieta muo i pacuv pari yi ta. A paruv ta suokha hmuo ri buo va ang.
Khaapanakawma kama ca ina hiehriy ciy? Khaapama i chang yi tapa a thyipa tie kha hiehriy tie yi; i ripa kha iema ta ama pachang thluo,” a ta.
Cahaacata a ri pahne ta a thaalie a daapa paliy pakha ta Zingsuv kha a hmie lie cabe te, “Tluobyi le cepa ma cahaacata na palie?” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “I ripa aa hmuo li kieca a hmuo lina kaw kha pasie sa tie. Cuorasala aa hmuopa kha i ri kieca khaapanakawma ina cabe ciy?” a ta.
Cakhutaata ama cakhiy yalya cata, Annas ta tluobyi lepa Kaiafas'a luo kha a paphya.
Piter ca aa daa luota myi aa e nguoluo ning kha, “Nama zaw hing ama a ziytuv pakha cuo va ca ma?” ama ta. Ama ta, “Cuo va ang,” ta pata a i yi.
Piter ta a naakue a sa pathlapa a tieriy ta a cuopa, tluobyi lepa a sii pakha ta, “Nama hing diedung lie kha Zingsuv hne ica hmung cuo va ma?” a ta.
Piter ta aa sie pakhaa hyi. Capa cuo lie ca aa a khang.

Cakhutaata Zingsuv kha Kaiafas ing taata Pilat zung luo kha ama vaakhyi. Capa cuo ca mawdiy ta a cuo. Iema ca muokiy byi zung chung luo kha a ngie va yi, tahematapakieca ama phung haata a papya a palyi li pata Lawsena Pyi sa kha ama ning khing nakawta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Pilat kha pya te, “Hingpa paa hing khaapa suena ma a hnyi?” a ta yi.
Iema ta, “Hingpa paa hing a suepa a cuo li kieca na kuv luo ca pi'a vapuv,” ama ta.
Pilat ta, “Vaakhyi ung la nama phungbie haata a bie ca va ripa tie ung,” a ta yi. Judah ming ta, “Kiema ca ahunghmuo thie khuna naw hnyi vapuv,” ama ta.
(Zingsuv ta tuokhaapa thiyna tama i thiy aa tapa a ri paciepa bie a tlingna riypata hing haa hingta a cuo pata a cuo.)
Cakhutaata Pilat ca zung chung luo kha a ngie pakhaa te, Zingsuv kha ku te, “Judah ming siepahruo ta na cuo ma?” ta pata a hiehriy.
Zingsuv ta, “Hingpa bie hing nama palungthu ta ma ina hiehriy ciy, acuolikie malie ta i kaw hing aca chang nakaw yi tama a cuo?” a ta.
Pilat ta, “Kama hing Judah ming ta i cuo ma? Na mingphang tie hne tluobyi lepa tie ta i kuv luo aca vya chipa yi hing. Na tuepa hmang ca khaapatama a cuo?” a ta.

Zingsuv ta, “I pena ca hingpa chuelyi lie hingta cuo vyi. I pena ca hingpa chuelyi lie hingta cuo sala ca Judah ming kuv luo i chiy li riypata naa ziytuv tie hingta a maa du aa. Cuorasala i pena ca hingpa chuelyi lie hingta cuo vyi,” a ta.

Pilat ta, “Caacuokieca siepahruo ta na cuo hmisi ma?” a ta. Zingsuv ta, “Nama ta siepahruo na cuo ina ta ciy. Hingpa repa hing tana i puv, biehmisipa a daakhyi riypa hing tana chuelyi luo hing i vaw. Biehmisipa chunglie a awpa mekaa ta ca i ueryi kha ama naathlie,” a ta.
Pilat ta, “Biehmisipa ca khaapa khata ma a cuo?” a ta.
Cuorasala nama phung a awpa haata Lawsena Pyi cuo lie cawsaa pakha ica pathliepa taw yi. Judah siepahruo hing ca pathliepa yi ang sala nama khing ma?” a ta yi.
Khuopuv ta khi yi te, “Hingpa paa hing cuo li pata Barabbas kha malie pathliepa tie,” ama ta. Barabbas ca damie tana a cuo.
Cakhutaata Pilat ta Zingsuv kha la te sungpe ta a pachi sa yi.
Rieka tie ta ahling lakhuv kha phie yi te a luv lie ama pakhuv, cakhutaata pang sepa kha ama pabuv.
Vaahnue yi te, “Judah siepahruo ca a hringtaa pasiy se!” ta yi te a hmie lie kha ama cabe.
Pilat ca pya pakhaa te, “Mang tie ung, ama ca a suena suokha hmuo hmung va ang tapa kha ica pachang sa khing nakaw yi ta i kya pyakhyi hing,” a ta.
Zingsuv ca ahling lakhuv a khuv te a pang sepa hne cata a kya pya. Pilat ta, “Mang tie ung, cawsaapa hing!” a ta yi.

Tluobyi lepa tie hne paliy tie ca ta ama kha ama hmung pahne ta, “Vieluo lie thie tie! Vieluo lie thie tie!” ta pata ama khi. Pilat ta, “A la ung la vieluo cunglie ca va thie tie ung; Kama ca a suena hmung va ang,” a ta yi.
Judah ming ta, “Ama ca Khazing Sacapaa tana i cuo a ta nakawta ima hnyipa phungbie haata thiy aa phuvpa tana a cuo,” ama ta.
Capa bie ca a thyi pahne ta Pilat ca a ciy vie hryly.
A zung chung luo kha a ngie pakhaa te Zingsuv kyihuo khata, “Khaapa taata ma na cuo?” ta pata a hiehriy. Cuorasala Zingsuv ta kaa kha hmuo palie vyi.
Caacuonakaw Pilat ta, “Na chaw khing va ca ma? Nama pathlie khuna, acuolikie vieluo cunglie thie khuna naw i hnyipa hing pachang va ca ma?” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Cungluo taata pi li pata ca i cunglie naw hnyi khu vaciy; caacuonakawta kama kha na kuv cungluo caa pituv hingna a sue vie,” a ta.

Capa khutaa cata Pilat ca Zingsuv pathlie khuna riypa luo kha a huv. Cuorasala Judah ming ca khi yi te, “Hingpa cawsaa hing na pathlie kieca Rom siepahruo viesaa ta cuo'a vaciy. Ahunghmuo cuose siepahruo tana i cuo a tapa ca Rom siepahruo cariepa tana a cuo,” ama ta.
Pilat ta hingpa bie a thyi tiyta, Zingsuv kha ale luo kya pyakhyi te Hebru ryi ta Gabbatha ama tapa, bieripana thude, Lungphie Phaa lie kha aa kya tu.
Capa cuo ca Lawsena Pyi cuota Atingdawna ning, ningchung hraw ta a cuo. Judah ming kyihuo khata, “Nama Siepahruo hing mang tie ung!” a ta yi.

Khi yi te, “Thie tie! Thie tie! Vieluo lie thie tie,” ama ta. Pilat ta, “Nama Siepahruo hing ma vieluo lie i thie aa?” a ta yi. Tluobyi lepa tie ta, “Rom siepahruo ta li pata siepahruo hnyi vapuv,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Pilat ta Zingsuv kha vieluo lie thie riypata iema kuv luo a pi yi.
A vieluo kha amata tah a puv te Hebru ryi ta Golgotha ama tapa, Luvruv Hmang tapa luo kha a pha.
Capa lie ca vieluo cunglie ama khepuo, a hrangpa pahning zaw kha khepuo ra yi te Zingsuv ca lielie ama patlung.
Pilat ta caa suokha cape te vieluo cunglie ca a taa. A capepa ca, “Nazareth khypa Zingsuv, Judah Siepahruo,” ta pata a cuo.
Zingsuv vieluo lie ama taana hmang ca khypuv hne aa hla li nakawta hne a caa ca Hebru ryi, Latin ryi, hne Grik ryi ta ama cape nakawta Judah ming hluvpuv ta ama ri.
Caacuonakawta Judah ming tluobyi lepa tie ta Pilat kha, “'Judah siepahruo,’ ta pata cape khah, cuorasala ‘Hingpa paa hingta Judah ming siepahruo tana i cuo, aa ta,’ ta pata cape tie,” ama ta.
Pilat ta, “I cape tlipa ca i cape tlipa tana a cuo,” a ta.

Rieka tie ta Zingsuv kha vieluo cunglie ama thie tiyta, a caw kha la yi te che paliy ta che yi te che kha law ta amaa la. A raw luo a patlungpa buohryi pasiypa zaw kha la yi te, a bienapa a caw aw li pata a luv taata a lie te ama taapa ta a cuo.

Caacuonakawta, pakha hne pakha kha, “Hingpa hing ca thlaa li pata vyisung ta a da ung siy,” amaa ta. Caapathe ta, “Iema ca i caw kha a che yi te, I buohryi kha vyisung amaa da,” a tapa a tlingna riypa tana a cuo.
Cahaa dala cata rieka tie ta ama tue. Capa ning ca ta Zingsuv vieluo athaalie a daapa ca a nung, a nung nutanung, Klopas napuvnung Mary, hne Mary Magdalin zaw khata ama cuo.
Zingsuv ta a nung hne athaalie a daapa a duepa a ziytuv kha a hmung tiy yi ta, a nung kha, “Cawsaanung, ama kha na sacapaa ta a cuo kha,” a ta.
A ziytuvpa zaw kha, “Hingpa lie hing na nung a aw hing,” a ta. Capa cuo taa cata a ziytuvpa ca ta Zingsuv nung kha a ing luo aa chiy.
Capa khutaa cata Zingsuv ta zezaw bangkhuo a tlung tli tapa kha pachang te (caapathe bie a tlingna riypata), “I tiy na a hrie,” a ta.
Capa lie ca bi suokha a bipa ta mingsuvtiy thuepa a aw. Caacuonakawta mingsuvtiy thuepa chung luo kha pangcaw naw yi te hissop aarasung daw lie kha ciypuo yi te Zingsuv ca a pakaa luo ama kya tuv.
Zingsuv ca mingsuvtiy thuepa kha vya saw te, “Aa lang tli,” a ta. A luv kha pangie te a huv a ci.

Capa ning ca Atingdawna ning a cuo nakawta ama thiepa tie riyy sabbath ning ta vieluo cunglie aa pathliepa kha Judah ming ta khing va yi. Tahematapakieca capa sabbath ning ca a pathe cepa ning ta a cuo. Caacuonakawta vieluo cunglie ama thiepa tie ngieluo kha thli pata ama riyy la riypata Pilat kha amaa hie.
Rieka tie kha vaa yi te Zingsuv hne ama thiehnepa pahning tie ngieluo kha ama thli.
Cuorasala Zingsuv'a luo ama chiy tiyta a thiy tlipa kha hmung yi te a ngieluo kha thli va yi.
Cadyiseca rieka pakha ta a vuo kha asyi ta kya daw te sungkha ta thiy hne tiy kha a kya pya.
(A ming ta a hmungpa paa hrahring ta tehte a khuopa cuo te niema zaw nama zang thena riypata a cuo. A tehte khuopa ca aa hmuopa cuo te ama ta biedangpa a ripa kha a pachang.)
Hingpa hmang hing Caapathe lieta, “A ruv suokha hmuo thli'a va yi,” a tapa a tlingna riypata a cuopa a cuo.
Caapathe a hrang lie zaw, “Iema ta ina dawpahlipa yi kama kha ina mang'a yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata Judah ming a ciy nakaw yi ta a paruvta tah Zingsuv hnang ziytuv a cuopa Arimathea khy ming Josef ta Zingsuv riyy la riypata Pilat kha a hie. Pilat ta a pi nakawta a riyy kha a la.
Zingsuv a taw riypata zuo ta a vaa buopa paa Nikodemu zaw kha Josef'a luo vaa te mura hne aloes pyapa ziyhmyi paw zakha tluv aa riypa kha aa cyi.
A riyy kha la yi te Judah ming riyy a pabyna phung haata ziyhmyi bya yi te pawruo ta ama cataw.
Zingsuv ama thiena hmang lie kha diedung suokha aw te capa diedung chunglie ca ahunghmuo ama paby buo linapa thluo thaapa suokha a aw.
