Judah ming Atingdawna ning a cuo nakaw hne aa ngie lie thluo a aw nakawta capa lie ca Zingsuv kha ama paby.
Zaa kha chunglie a ning khanapa ning mawdiy a zing kalie pata Mary Magdalin ca thluo luo kha vaa te thluokhaakhuv aa hnyipa kha a hmung.
Caacuonakawta Piter hne, Zingsuv ta a duepa ziytuv hrangpa'a luo kha a ruo te, “Abyipa kha thluo chungtaata la yi te khaapaliema ama chi tapa kha pachang vapuv,” a ta.
Piter hne a ziytuv hrangpa paa ca thu yi te thluo luo kha ama vaa.
Ama pahning ta a ruole yi te a ziytuv hrangpa ta Piter kha law te thluo luo kha a chiy taa.
A bung te a mang ca riyy catawnapa pawruo kha a hmung, cuorasala thluo chung luo kha a ngie vyi.
Simon Piter ca a hnang ta vya pha te thluo chung luo kha aa ngie ca, a riyy catawnapa pawruo hne
Zingsuv luv ama pahlawnapa pawruo a nanangta tah a za awpa kha a hmung.
Cakhutaata a vya pha taapa ziytuv hrangpa zaw kha thluo chung luo ca a ngie te hmung te a zang.
Thiyna taata a thu pakhaa aa ta pata Caapathe ta a ripa kha a ri khingnapa pachang khu valie yi.
Cakhutaata ziytuv tie ca ing luo kha ama kaa.
Mary ca thluo le lie kha a daa te a caa. A caapuo pata thluo chung luo kha a bung te a za mang ca
caw ruopa a tuepa avuoming pahning kha Zingsuv riyy ama chinapa a luvluo kuo ta pakha, a phyichaaluo kuo ta pakha amaa tupa kha a hmung.
Iema ca ta, “Cawsaanung, “Khaapanakawma na caa?” ama ta. Ama ta, “I byipaapa kha la yi te khaapaliema ama chi tapa pachang va ang,” a ta.
Capa bie a ri diy pahne ta a hnangluo aa pali ca capa lieta Zingsuv aa daapa kha a hmung, cuorasala Zingsuv a cuopa kha pachang vyi.
Zingsuv ta, “Cawsaanung, khaapanakawma na caa? Ahungma na huv?” a ta. Diedung a huopa paa ta ri te, “Abyipa, nama ta na la pata a cuo kieca na chinapa kha na chang la, vaa'a angte i va la aa,” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Mary!” a ta ca a palihnue te Hebru ryi ta “Rabbouni,” a ta. (A siyluo ca saya tana ta a cuo).

Zingsuv ta, “Na patuv khah, tahematapakieca Paa luo kha kie valie ang. Cuorasala i uvnu zaw'a luo kha vaa la, ‘I Paa hne nama Paa, i Khazing hne nama Khazing a cuopa'a luo khana i kie aa,’ a ta tapa kha va chang tie yi,” a ta.
Mary Magdalin ca ziytuv tie'a luo kha cakuo te, “Abyipa na i hmung,” ta pata a pathyi sa yi. Cakhutaata Abyipa ta ama'a lie a changpa bie zaw kha a chang yi.

Zaa kha chunglie a ning khanapa zuoluo ta ziytuv tie ca Judah ming ama ciy nakawta ingchiy khaa yi te amaa pungnapa lie kha Zingsuv ca a vaw te iema hrawlie kha a daa te, “Nama cunglie thlaalungna aw mang sue,” a ta yi.
Cahaacata a ri khutaata a kuv hne a vuo kha a pahmung yi. Ziytuv tie ca Abyipa kha ama hmung nakawta ama palung a tluosa.
Zingsuv ta iema kha, “Nama cunglie thlaalungna aw mang sue a ta pakhaa yi. Paa ta ina pathliepa haata kama zaw ta ica pathlie ra yi,” a ta yi.
Capa bie ca a ri khutaata, a huv ta hmung yi te, “Thlaapa Pathe kha hmung tie ung.
Cawsaa suena kha namaa ngiethe kieca a ngiethe pata ama cuo aa; namaa ngiethe li kieca a ngiethe li pata ama cuo aa,” a ta yi.
Ziytuv tie hlyihning hrawlie pakha a cuopa Thomas (Mingphie ama tapa) ca Zingsuv aa luo ning kha aw ra vyi.

Caacuonakawta ziytuv hrangpa tie ta, “Abyipa na ma hmung,” ta pata ama chang. Cuorasala ama ta, “A kuv lie thaakhe ta ama khepuonapa a hmaa i hmung lipa'a nata i kuvdaw ta capa a hmaa hne a vuo kha i hrie hluo li ca zang'a va ang,” a ta yi.

Zaa kha khutaata ziytuv tie ca ing chunglie kha aw pakhaa yi te, Thomas zaw a aw ra. Ingchiy kha ama khaa diy raalaa pata, Zingsuv ca zaa ngie te, iema hrawlie kha a daa te, “Nama cunglie thlaalungna aw mang sue,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata Thomas kyihuo khata, “I kuv hing vya mang la na kuvdaw ta vya hrie tie. Na kuv kha pazuo la i vuo hing hrie tie. Zang li pata aw khah tie, zang tie,” a ta.
Thomas ta, “I Byipaapa hne i Khazing!” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “Ina hmung nakaw ca ta ma ina zang ciy? Kama kha hmung li pata naa zangpa tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo,” a ta.
Hingpa caa-uv chunglie cape lipa Zingsuv ta ziytuv tie hmiekunglie a tuepa kharuehaa hmang a hluvsa a aw kalie.
Cuorasala hing zaa hing capepa cuo te cape hnuochuopa ca, Zingsuv ca Messiah, Khazing Sacapaa a cuopa kha zang ung cate capa zangna thue cata hringna nama hmungna riypa tana a cuo.
Cakhutaa cata Zingsuv ca Tiberias Riyliy kielie kha a ziytuv tie'a lie aa luo pakhaa. Aa luozya ca hing haa hingta a cuo.
Simon Piter, Mingphie ama tapa Thomas, Galilee pe Kaanaa khy ming Nathanael, Zebedi sacapaa tie hne a hrangpa ziytuv pahning ca suv kha ta ama aw.
Simon Piter ta, “Ngaa na i va vaa aa,” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Ma ca vya ziy aa,” ta yi te sawkawpalaw chung luo kha ama kie, cuorasala capa zuo ca sakha hmuo patuv va yi.
Khy a kya vuopa khiy ta, Zingsuv ca ngiekuo lie kha aa tu, cuorasala ziytuv tie ta Zingsuv a cuopa kha pachang va yi.
Zingsuv ta, “Satlie zaw ngaa sakha hmuo patuv va ung ca ma?” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Patuv vapuv,” ama ta.
Ama ta, “Sawkawpalaw cacuoluo kuo khata vaa ung la nama pa-uo buo aa,” a ta yi. Ama vaa ca ngaa a hluvsa aa uo nakawta amaa sue hmuo a da khu li pata ama aw.

Zingsuv ta a duepa ziytuvpa khata Piter kyihuo kha, “Abyipa tana a cuo!” a ta. Simon Piter ta Abyipa tana a cuo a tapa kha a thyi ca, a cahri pata a aw nakawta, caw kha a hryi te tiy chung luo kha aa zu.
Cuorasala ziytuv hrangpa tie ca sawkawpalaw luo kha kie yi te ngaa a bi pata a uopa asue ca daw zahning hraw dyi aa hlapa ngiekuo luo kha amaa dale.
Ngiekuo luo ama pha ca myi cunglie ngaa a zaa epa hne viechuo kha ama hmung.
Zingsuv ta, “Nama patuvpa ngaa chekha kha vya cyi tie ung,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta Simon Piter ca sawkawpalaw luo kha kie te ngaa lesapa zakha sawngaa sathung a uopa asue kha ngiekuo luo aa vya dale. Ngaa a hluvsa raalaa pata asue kha tlaa vyi.
Zingsuv ta, “A vaw ung la mawsa ning tie ung,” a ta yi. Abyipa ta a cuopa kha ama pachang thluo nakawta ahungtahmuo, “Ahungtama na cuo?” ta pata hiehriy nguo va yi.
Zingsuv ca a vaw te, viechuo kha la te a pi yi, cahaacata ngaa zaw kha a pi yi.
Hingpa hing thiyna taata a thu pakhaa khutaata a ziytuv tie'a lie a yi thungnapa aa luona tana a cuo.

Mawsa ama ning khutaata Zingsuv ta Piter kha, “Johan sacapaa Simon, iema laa hingta ina due vie ca ma?” a ta. Ama ta, “A cuo, Abyipa; ica duepa ca na pachang,” a ta. Zingsuv ta, “I tuvtaata zaw kha sa pi tie,” a ta.
A yihningnapa ta, “Johan sacapaa Simon, ina due ca ma?” a ta pakhaa. Ama ta, “A cuo, Abyipa; ica duepa kha na pachang,” a ta. Zingsuv ta, “I tuv zaw kha mangchiy tie,” a ta.

A yi thungnapa ta, “Johan sacapaa Simon, ina due ca ma?” a ta. Yi thung nanaa, “Ina due ca ma?” a ta nakawta Piter ca a ngie chi te, “Abyipa, nama ca hmangting a pachangtuv tana na cuo; ica duepa kha na pachang,” a ta. Zingsuv ta, “I tuv zaw kha sa pi tie,” a ta.

Biehmisi tana ica chang, Na kung panu ning hing ca namata tah na tesaw kha a saw cate na khingna luo bangkhuo kha na cakuo. Cuorasala na macuo thue ca na kuv kha pazuo'a cate, pakhakha ta tesaw kha ca pasaw'a te, na khing lina luo kha aca cakuokhyi aa,” a ta.
(Hing haa hingta a tapa hing tuokhaapa thiyna tama Piter ta Khazing rungnaana kha a paluo sa aa tapa khana a ri khing.) Cakhutaa cata, ama kha “Na ziy tie,” a ta.

Piter ca a pali te Zingsuv ta a duepa ziytuv ta a vya paziylepa yi kha a hmung. Ama ca zuosa ama ning ningta Zingsuv kha vaa pha te, “Abyipa, ahung hing ma caa lyi riypata a cuo?” a tapa paa khata a cuo.
Piter ta ama kha a hmung tiyta Zingsuv kha, “Abyipa, hingpa paa hing haw tuokhaatama a cuo aa?” a ta.
Zingsuv ta, “I vaw pakhaana te a hring riypata khing ang sala na cuota khaapama a pyinapa a aw? Na ziy tie!” a ta.

Caacuonakawta hing ziytuvpa hing thiy'a va tli ta pata iema hrawlie kha bie aa ze. Zingsuv ta thiy'a vyi ta pata a ripa cuo vyi, cuorasala, “I vaw pakhaana te a hring riypata khing ang sala na cuota khaapama a pyinapa a aw?” a tapa tana a cuo.
Hingpa paa ca a ziytuv cuo te hingpa kaw hing tehte a khuotuv hne a capetuv ta a cuo, a tehte khuopa ca aa hmuo tapa zaw kha ma pachang.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ta a tuepa hmang hrangpa a hluv hringhruo a aw. Capa bangkhuo ca ma cape kieca, capepa caa-uv ca chuelyi hingta a tlaw the'a vyi tapa tana i rue.
Duepa Theofilas, caa-uv taapa lie kha Zingsuv ta a tuepa hne a pacuvna kaw bangkhuo kha a hruothu taata
vuoruo luo a kiena te ta i cape. Capa ca aa tlawpa lucuotuv tie kha Thlaapa Pathe ta a pacuv khutaa yi ta a cuo.
A thiy khutaata ning sawliy chung iema'a lie kha a luo te, a hring pakhaa tapa kha i khu li riypata yi hluvpuv paluo sa te Khazing pena kaw kha a ri.
Iema'a lie a aw ning khata iema kha, Jerusalem pyase li pata Paa biekuona kha ama huo riypata bie a pi yi. Ama ta, “Kama'a taata nama thyipa bie ca hing haa hing tana a cuo;
Johan ca tiy tana tiynawna aca pi yi, cuorasala niema ca ataning taa hingta a ru li pata Thlaapa Pathe ta tiynawpa nama cuo aa,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta Zingsuv hne lucuotuv tie ca amaa hmya pakhaw tiyta, “Abyipa, ata hing Israel ming'a luo pena na pi pakhaana cuo ta a cuo ma?” ta pata ama hiehriy.
Zingsuv ta, “I Paa ta ama ri ta a tuepa ning hne cuo kha niema nama pachang a hu vyi.
Cuorasala Thlaapa Pathe nama cung luo a tlung tiyta cahrana hmung'a ung cate, Jerusalem khypuv, Judea, Samaria hne chuelyi dena te ta i pachangkhyituv nama cuo aa,” a ta yi.
Capa bie a ri khu pahne ta ama ming hmung pata lathawpa cuo te amyi ta vya pakhuo te hmung khu va tli yi.
Cahaacata a kielepa kha avuo luo angchiy yi te ama mang nguoluo pata caw ruopa a tuepa avuoming pahning amaa thaalie sungkha ta amaa vya daa.
Iema ta, “Galilee cawsaa zaw, khaapama namaa daa luota vuoruo luo ca nama mang nguoluo? Niema'a taata vuoruo luo lathawpa Zingsuv ca nama hmungpa dadang haa khata aa vaw pakhaa aa,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata lucuotuv tie ca Jerusalem taata me che dyi aa hlapa, Olif tluo taata Jerusalem luo kha ama vya kaa.

Khypuv chung luo ama vya pha tiyta ama aw tawnapa a cung khuo luo kha amaa ngie. Piter, hne Johan, Jeim, hne Andru, Filip hne Thomas, Bartholomew hne Matthai, Alfeas sacapaa Jeim, Phangcuokhyituv Simon hne Jeim sacapaa Judas ta ama cuo.
Ama bangkhuo ta thlaachuo riypata ata hne ata tah a taw yi te capa lie ca canung tie, Zingsuv nung Mary hne Zingsuv nuta zaw kha ama aw ra.
Capa ning ca zangtuv zaw (ama bangkhuo ta zakha pakiy hraw) hrawlie kha Piter ca a daa te,
“Viesaa zaw, Zingsuv a patuvpa tie luochiytuv ta a cuopa Judas kaw hne aa patuv pata David hmuo pata Thlaapa Pathe ta a za rilupa Caapathe bie ca a tling riypata a cuo.
Ama ca hing Khazing re lie hing hrievu pipa a cuo nakawta kiema hrawlie pasuvpuo pata a cuo,” a ta.
(Ama ta hmang pha lipa a tuena taata a hmungpa tuokaa khata lu suokha calyi te, capa lu lie ca aa bungkali pata tla te a riy a ke nakawta a chungriy bangkhuo ta a pya diy.
Capa kaw ca Jerusalem lie a awpa bangkhuo ta pachang yi te iema ryi ta capa lu ca Hakeldama ama ta, a siyluo ca, ‘Thiyse Lu,’ tana ta a cuo.)
“Salm caa-uv chunglieta, ‘A ing ca hri sala, a chunglie a aw riypa caking yi se'; cakhutaata, ‘A re kha cawsaa hrangpa ta a thle se,' ta pata aa cape.
Caacuonakawta Johan tiynawna taata ma Byipaapa Zingsuv kiema'a taata lapa a cuona te, kiema'a lie a ngie te pya te a aw chung bangkhuo,
kiema'a lie a aw rapa pakha ca kiema hneta Zingsuv thupakhaana pachangkhyituv a cuo ra hrahring na a hu,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta, cawsaa pahning Barsabbas ama tapa Josef, Justas zaw ama tapuopa hne Matthias ming kha ama chiykhyi.
Thlaachuo yi te, “Abyipa, nama ca cawsaa pathiypalung bangkhuo na pachang.
Judas ta a cu riypa hmang luo a sisepa, hingpa Khazing re hrie riypa hne lucuotuv cuo riypa hing iema pahning lie hingta ahungma naa tlaw tapa kha za paluo sa tie,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata vyisung amaa da ca Matthias ta a hmung nakawta ama ca lucuotuv hlyikha lie kha pahlawpuo pata a cuo.
Pentekos ning a vya pha tiyta zangtuv bangkhuo ca suv kha lie ama aw.
Sungkhabala ta vuoruo taata ueryi suokha ca thliysung pu haata za paring te amaa tunapa ing kha a bi diy.
Aa chepa palyi ca myipalyi haata iema hrawlie kha zaa luo te myipalyi suokha cyicuo ca iema pakha cyicuo cunglie kha aa cang.
Iema bangkhuo ca Thlaapa Pathe ta bi yi te Thlaapa ta a pipa yi cyicuo haa khata ryi hrangpa kha ama cyi.
Capa ning ca vuoruotyi ruo ting lie a awpa Judah ming kha Jerusalem lie ama aw ningta a cuo.
Capa ueryi ca ama thyi tiyta cawsaazaapuv kha a vya hmya yi te ama kharue a haa hringhruo, tahematapakieca zangtuv tie ama ripa kha a vawpa tie ta iema ryi cyicuo ta ama thyi nakawta a cuo.
Ama nang ta uosa te, “Ama bangkhuo hingta Galilee ryi a cyipa cuo va yi ma?
Caacuokieca tuokhaatama kiema pakha cyicuo ta ma puvnapa ryi ta ma thyi the?
Kiema ca Parthia ruo, Media ruo, Elam ruo, Mesopotamia ruo, Judea ruo, Kappadosia ruo, Pontas ruo, Asia ruo,
Frizia ruo, Pamfilia ruo, Izipt ruo, Libia ruo chung Sairin khy cahriylie a awpa ta ma cuo. Rom taata a vawpa khyche, Judah ming hne Judah biena luo a palawpa Jentail ming zaw ta ma cuo.
Krit ming hne Arabia ming zaw ta ma cuo, cuorasala Khazing ta a cahrana ta a tuepa hmang rungnaapa kaw kha ama ri tiyta ma ryi cyicuo ta ma thyi kaluo,” ama ta.
Ama bangkhuo ta nang-uo chungzing pata, “Hingpa hing a siyluo khaapatama a cuo aa,” amaa ta.
Cuorasala a hrangpa tie ta, esepuo pata, “Mingsuvtiy na ama pariy,” ama ta.
Cuorasala Piter ca ziytuv hlyikha tie hne khata a kya daa te a ryi kha khuosa ta pathlie te, “Judea ruo ming hne Jerusalem lie a awpa bangkhuo zaw, i ripa hing naathlie ung la pachang tie ung.
Hingpa tie hing niema nama ruenapa haata pariy va yi, tahematapakieca maw siymaluo pacaky dyina a ta baaning.
Hingpa hing ca profet Joel a za ripa kha tana a cuo:

‘Khazing ta, ningchuonapa lie ca cawsaa bangkhuo cunglie kha i Thlaapa i bya'a yi, nama sacanung hne nama sacapaa zaw ta profetbiephu ama ri aa, nama mingnu tie ta muocuo hmung'a yi te, nama nungpuv macuo tie ta muo ama sa aa.
Capa ning thue ca i siicanung hne i siicapaa zaw cunglie kha hmuo i Thlaapa bya'a yi angte, profetbiephu ama ri aa.
Cung luo avuo lie khiy kharuehaa hmang paluo'a angte, raw luo alyi lie hing pamangsana hmang i paluo aa, thiyse hne myi hne myikhuv chaapuv ta ama cuo aa.
Abyipa ning, a rungnaapa hne a lesyipa ning aa vaw hluota ning ca zing'a te, thlaapa ca thiyse haata a se aa.
Cakhutaata Abyipa ming a upa mekaa ca khuo pata ama cuo aa,’ a ta.

“Israel ming, i ripa bie hing naathlie tie ung: Nama pachangpa haata Nazareth khypa Zingsuv ca Khazing ta re a changpa tana a cuo tapa kha, Khazing ta ama hmuo pata a tuepa, a cahrana ta a tuepa hmang rungnaapa zaw, kharuehaa hmang zaw, hne pamangsana tie zaw hingta niema'a lie a paluo sa.
Khazing ta hmungdawna hne ama khuekhuona haata niema'a luo aca pipa yi Zingsuv ca cawsaa pha lipa tie kuv ta vieluo cunglie nama thie.
Cuorasala Khazing ta ama kha pathu pakhaa te thiyna taata a palaw sa, tahematapakieca thiyna ta ama kha patuv pari khu vyi.
Caacuonakawta David ta ama hne aa patuv pata, ‘Abyipa kha ci li pata i hmung pari, i cacuoluo kuo ta inaa daapuo pari nakawta a cahang'a va ang;
caacuonakawta i pathiypalung ca a law te, i bie ripa ca thaaphana hneta a bi; ca hlyitaw taata, i pangpasaa ca anguopuona hne tana a hring aa.
Tahematapakieca i thlaapa kha athiykhy lie thuse'a vaciy, na mingpathepa hing thluokhue lie lang riypata ca pase'a vaciy.
Hringna luopuv kha na pachang sa cate, ina awpuo nakaw ca ta i palung a tluo pari aa,’ a ta.
“Israel ming i uvnu zaw, mingpa David kaw hing a siesa pata ica chang'a yi. Ama ca thiy te ama paby, ataning tepa ta a thluo zaw kiema'a lie a aw kalie.
Ama ca profet a za cuopa haata, a ciypathla pakhakha kha ama siepahruo thude lie i patu aa ta pata Khazing ta bie a kuopa kha a pachang.
Capa ca hmungluna hneta David ta Messiah thupakhaana kaw a ripa ca, ‘Ama ca athiykhy lie thusepa cuo li'a pata, a pangpasaa ca thluo lie kha lang'a vyi,’ a ta.
Khazing ta hingpa Zingsuv hing thiyna taata pathu pakhaa te, kiema bangkhuo hing pachangkhyituv ta ma cuo.
Khazing cacuoluo kuo ta cyicalang pata cuo te, Paa ta bie a kuopa Thlaapa Pathe kha a hmung tli. Ata nama hmungpa hne nama thyipa hing kiema cunglie a za byapa ama lasaw tana a cuo.
David ca vuoruo luo kha kie vyi, cuorasala ama hrahring ta a ripa ca, ‘Abyipa ta i Byipaapa kha,
“Na carie tie kha na phyipazaa rawlie chaapuo riypata i tue hluo li yi, i cacuoluo kuo ta a tu tie, a tapa kha”’ a ta.
Caacuonakawta, Israel ming bangkhuo, niema ta vieluo lie nama thiepa Zingsuv hing Khazing ta Abyipa hne Messiah ta a tue tapa hing pachang tie ung,” a ta yi.
Capa bie ama thyi tiyta ama palung kha cahrie yi te Piter hne lucuotuv hrangpa tie kha, “Uvnu zaw, khaapama ma tue aa?” ama ta.

Piter ta, “Niema pakha cyicuo hingta sue a ngiethepa nama cuo riypata nama suena kha a ngiepachiy ung la Zingsuv Khrih ming ta tiy a naw tie ung; caacuokieca Khazing lasaw Thlaapa Pathe kha nama hmung aa.
Tahematapakieca biekuona ca Abyipa ma Khazing ta ama'a luo a kupa, niema, nama saata tie, hne luohlaa luo a awpa tie nama bangkhuo cuo tana a cuo,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata tehtekhuona bie hrangpa a hluvsa hmuo pata a pasu yi. “Hingpa chuo pha lipa chungtaa hingta niema hne niema kha a khuo tie ung,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta a bieripa a cuhluopa tie ca tiy naw yi te capa ning cata cawsaa thawthung amaa chachiy.
Iema ca lucuotuv tie pacuvna hne zangtuv tie a viesaana luo, viechuo ningpakhawna luo hne thlaachuona luo kha khuopuv ta amaa pi.
Kharuehaa hmang hluvpuv hne pamangsana hluvpuv kha lucuotuv tie ta ama tue nakawta cawsaa bangkhuo kha ama kharue a haasa.
A zangpa bangkhuo kha suv kha ta aw yi te chechiy bangkhuo kha amaa hraw;
ama hnyipa hmang kha zaa yi te ama hmungpa tuokaa kha amaa huna cyicuo haa khata amaa re.
Ning kha hnang ning kha, ama cuo hnyipa hluv vie bangkhuo kha biena-ing lie hmuo yi te, ama ing lie kha sa ning a hraw yi te pahyana hne palung tluosa pata ama ning.
Khazing kha pathuosa yi te cawsaa bangkhuo hmielie hmiephaa ama hmung. Cahaacata Abyipa ta khuona a hmungpa tie kha ning kha hnang ning kha ta iema'a luo a chachiy yi.
Ning kha ca zuoluo siymaluo pathung, thlaachuo cuo lie kha Piter hne Johan ca thlaachuo riypata Biena-ing luo ama cakuo.
A puv baataata a phyi cabiepa pakha kha amaa vya puvle. Biena-ing chung luo a ngiepa tie kha tuokaa a hie khu naase yi ta pata Thlake Puvthe tapa biena-ing thlake lie kha ningting ta ama chi taw.
Piter hne Johan kha biena-ing luo amaa ngie'a nangpa a hmung tiy yi ta aa hie yi.
Ama kha taapuo pata mang yi te, “Malie mang tie,” ama ta.
Suokhakha ca ina pi thlu'a yi tapa anguopuona hneta iema kha ming vy li pata a mang yi.
Cuorasala Piter ta, “Kama ca siy cuose, ngu cuose hnyi va ang, cuorasala i hnyipa na ica pi; Nazareth Zingsuv ming ta thu la cakuo tie,” a ta.
A cacuoluo kuv ta patuv te a padaa ca a phyi hra hning hne a cakhawruv zaw ca sungkha ta a thaa a vya ruv.
A cathlu te a daa te a cakuo, iema hne cata biena-ing chung luo kha a ngie te, cakuole a cathlule te Khazing kha a pathuosa.
Khazing pathuosa te a cakuopa kha cawsaa bangkhuo ta ama hmung.
Biena-ing Thlake Puvthe lieta a tu te a hie tawpa kha ama pachang nakawta a cunglie hmang a tlungpa kawlie kha ama kharue haa te ama nang dyi a uo.
Cawsaapa ca Solomon hmiechue tapa lie, Piter hne Johan athaalieta a awlepa kha ama hmung tiyta cawsaazaapuv ca kharuehaasa pata iema'a luo kha ama vaa.

Piter ta iema kha a hmung tiy yi ta, “Niema Israel ming, khaapanakawma hingpa hmang kawlie hing nama kharue haa te kiema tlaku kiema cahrana hne phana ta a cakuo sa khupa haata ming vy li pata malie nama mang?

Abraham Khazing, Isak Khazing, hne Jakob Khazing, ima mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing ta ama rungnaana ca a changtaapa Zingsuv'a lieta a pi tli. Ama ca Pilat kuv luo pi ung cate ama ta pathlie riypata bie a chi raalaa pata Pilat hmielie hrahring kha nama thaw ngiethie.
Niema ta a pathepa hne aa dangpa kha thaw ung cate lie a nawpa tlaku kha aca pathliepa riypa yi ta namaa hie.
Cakhutaata hringna luo cawsaa a chiytuvpa ca nama thie. Cuorasala Khazing ta ama kha thiyna taata pathu pakhaa te kiema hing capa kaw ca a pachangkhyituv ta ma cuo.

Cahaacata a ming kha a zang nakawta, a ming mamaapa khata nama hmungpa hne nama pachangpa hingpa paa hing cahrana a pi. Capa Zingsuv zangnapa ca ta ama kha niema hmiekunglie hrahring ta tluopasingna a pi.
“Viesaa zaw, ata zaw hing, niema hne nama uvtuv tie ta nama tuepa hing nama pachang li nakaw tana a cuo tapa i pachang.
Messiah ca a te-ang aa ta pata profet tie'a taata a za rilupa bie kha Khazing ta hing haa hingta a patling sa.
Caacuonakawta nama suenapa ca pathesapa nama cuo riypata a ngiepachiy ung la Khazing'a luo kha a pali tie ung.
Cakhutaata Abyipa ta thaazuo thaa lana cuo kha ca pi'a yi te niema cuota a tlaw ciepa Messiah, Zingsuv kha niema'a luo aca pi'a yi.
Ama ca Khazing ta hluo ning baataata a profet tie zaw cung taata a za ripa, hmangting bangkhuo sapathiyna cuo a tlung hluo li vuoruo lieta a aw aa.
Moses ta, ‘Abyipa nama Khazing ta na cawsaa zaw chung taa hingta kama haapa profet pakha a papuv sa aa. Niema ta aca changpa mekaa yi kha nama naathlie aa.
Capa profet bie a naathlie lipa bangkhuo ca mingphang chungtaata thaw pata ama cuo aa.’ a ta.
Profet Samuel hne ama hnang taata a vawpa profet zaw bangkhuo ta hingpa ning hne cuo kaw hing ama ri diypa ta a cuo.

Niema ca profet tie ciypathla ta cuo ung cate, Khazing ta nama mingchingmingvuo zaw a pipa yi, Abraham'a lie a ripa, ‘Nama samingsahlaa chung taa hing tana chuelyi ming bangkhuo hing thluechiy i pi'a yi,’ a tapa biekuona a hraw rapa tana nama cuo.
Khazing ta a changtaapa kha a pathu pakhaa tiyta, niema pakha cyicuo hing nama pha lina taata vya kaa pata thluechiy pi riypa tana a sacapaa kha niema'a luo hmietaa ce ta a vya pathlie,” a ta.
Piter hne Johan ta cawsaa zaw'a lie bie ama ri nguoluo ning kha tluobyi tie hne biena-ing a huopa uvtuv byi hne Sadusi ming kha a vaw yi te,
iema ta cawsaa kha za pacuv nguoluo yi te, thiyna taata thupakhaana ca Zingsuv chunglie tana a aw ta pata ama za ukhyi nguoluo nakawta ama hi a haa hringhruo.
Caacuonakawta iema kha patuv yi te, khy a zing tli nakawta a mawluopa te ta thaw-ing lieta ama chi.
Cuorasala ama ripa bie a thyipa tie ca zang yi te ama bangkhuo ta thawpangaa tluv ama ta.
A mawluopa ta ama uvtuv tie, uvthyi tie, phungbie saya tie hne,
tluobyi lepa Annas, Kaiafas, Johan, Alekzandar hne tluobyi lepa chungkhue cawsaa hrangpa zaw ca Jerusalem lie kha amaa hmya.
Lucuotuv tie kha a liekhingkhuo lie padaa yi te, “Ahung cahrana hne ahung ming tama hingpa hmang hing nama tue?” ta pata ama hiehriy.
Piter ca Thlaapa Pathe ta bi te iema kha, “Uvtuv byi hne uvthyi tie zaw,
a tluo lipa cawsaa pakha cunglie hmang pha tuena kaw hne tuokhaatama patluo sa pata a cuo tapa kha ataning hing malie nama hiehriy pata a cuo kieca,

niema ta vieluo cunglie za thie ung cate Khazing ta thiyna taata a pathu pakhaapa Nazareth khypa Zingsuv ming tana hingpa paa hing tluo paalaa khata nama hmiekunglie aa daa tapa hing niema bangkhuo hne Israel ming bangkhuo ta pachang tie ung.
Capa Zingsuv ca, ‘Niema, ingsatuv tie ta nama thawpa alung ca ingkiylung tana aa li,' a tapa kha tana a cuo.
Khuona ca ama chunglie dyina a aw, tahematapakieca chuelyi cung lie hing malie a khuo khutuv ming hrangpa suokha hmuo aw vyi,” a ta.

Iema ta Piter hne Johan riephanazya kha ama hmung tiyta hne caa a the lipa cawsaa cakhawpa ama cuopa kha ama pachang tiyta ama nang ta uo te, iema ca Zingsuv viesaa ama cuopa kha amaa kya thyi pakhaa.
Ama patluo sapa paa amaa thaalie aa daapa kha ama hmung thluo nakawta khaapahmuo i riypa hnyi va yi.
Caacuonakawta lucuotuv tie kha ing chungtaata papya yi te iema selaw ta capa kaw ca amaa rue pakhaw.

Pakha hne pakha kha, “Hingpa cawsaa zaw hing tuokhaatama ma tue'a ung? Iema ta kharuehaa hmang lepuv ama tuepa kha Jerusalem lie a awpa bangkhuo ta ama pachang diy nakawta i khu riypata a cuo hyi va, amaa ta.
Cuorasala hing hmang kaw hing cawsaa hraw luo aa ze hryly li riypata, hing cawsaa zaw hing Zingsuv ming ta ahung'a lie hmuo bie ri'a va tli ung ciy ta pata khuosa ta thlu'a ung puv,” amaa ta.
Caacuonakawta iema kha ku yi te Zingsuv ming ta bie ri li tli riypa hne pacuv li tli riypata bie ama pi.
Cuorasala Piter hne Johan ta, “Khazing hmungna lieta niema bie a ngiepa ma a hmuo vie aa, Khazing bie a ngiepa ma a hmuo vie aa tapa kha niema ta bie chi tie ung;
tahematapakieca kiema ca ma hmungpa hne ma thyipa kha ri li pata aw khu'a vapuv,” ta pata ama palie.
Cawsaa bangkhuo ta hmang a cuopa kawlie kha Khazing ama pathuosa nakawta iema duotena riypa kha a luo hmung khu va yi. Caacuonakawta ama pachiypahuo khutaata iema ca ama pathlie.
Tluona kharuehaa hmang tuepa pata a cuopa paa hing kung sawliy hlyi a tapa tana a cuo.
Ama pathlie khutaata lucuotuv tie ca ama viesaa tie'a luo kha vaa yi te tluobyi lepa tie hne uvthyi tie ta ama changpa bie kha ama va chang.
Ama thyi pahne ta Khazing'a luo kha khuopuv ta u yi te, “Lesyice Abyipa, alyi hne avuo, riyliy hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo a satuv,
na Thlaapa Pathe hmuo pata na changtaapa mingpa David'a lie bie za ri cate, ‘Khaapanakawma Jentail ming ca ama hi haa te, cawsaa zaw ta a cuo lipa khue ama rue?
Abyipa hne Messiah a du pata chuelyi siepahruo tie adaahmang la yi te, uvtuv tie hne amaa hmya pakhaw,’ na za ta.
Cahaacata hingpa khy chunglie hing Herod hne Pontius Pilat ca Jentail ming'a nata Israel ming hne khata Messiah ta naa tlawpa, a pathepa na changtaapa Zingsuv a du riypa khata,
nama ta lieriy na uopuopa bangkhuo kha a tling riypata amaa hmya pakhaw.
Caacuonakawta, Abyipa, iema pachiypahuona kha za pachang thi la, na changtaapa zaw ta riepha ciemuo pata na bie ama ri khu riypata zaa bya thi tie yi.
Cawsaa tluona riypata na buo ca pazuo la a pathepa na changtaapa Zingsuv ming ta pahmungsana hne kharuehaa hmang ca pa-aw sa thi tie,” ama ta.
Thlaa ama chuo khu pahne ta amaa hmyanapa ing ca a cahang te, Thlaapa Pathe ta bi yi te Khazing bie kha riephasa pata ama ri.
A zangpa bangkhuo ca ama buv yalya ta ama pathiypalung hne ama ruena a lu te ahungtahmuo ama hnyipa kha kama huopa ta lipa yi ta chechiy bangkhuo kha amaa hraw.
Lucuotuv tie ta Abyipa Zingsuv thupakhaana kha cahrana hne khuopuv ta ri yi te iema bangkhuo kha Khazing ta thluechiy a hluvsa ta a pi yi.
Iema hrawlieta aa huna lie aa phahlapa aw va yi, tahematapakieca ama hnyipa alyi hne ing bangkhuo kha zaa yi te, ama hmungpa tuokaa kha
lucuotuv tie phyi thabaw luo ama vya pahmya. Lucuotuv tie ta pakha cyicuo kha amaa huna haata ama re.
Cahaacata lucuotuv tie ta Barnabas (a siyluo ca thaazuo pituv sacapaa) ama tapa, Saipras lie a puvpa Levi ming Josef ca
a hnyipa a lu kha zaa te, a hmungpa tuokaa kha vya cyi te lucuotuv tie phyi thabaw lie kha a vya chi.
Cuorasala Ananias ama tapa paa hne a napuvnung Safira ca ama hnyipa hmang kha ama zaa;
ama hmungpa tuokaa che kha kha a napuvnung palung tlingkhyina hneta pangaabuo te chekha dyi kha lucuotuv tie phyi thabaw luo a vya chiykhyi.
Piter ta, “Ananias, khaapanakawma Thlaapa dung riypata Setaa hing na palung lie bi te alyi na zaanapa chekha kha naa pangaabuo?” a ta.

Na zaa hluo kha nama huopa ta cuo va ma? Caacuokieca na zaa khutaata na hmungpa a muo ca nama huopa ta cuo va ma? Khaapanakawma capa hmang tue riypa palung ca na phya? Kiema malie dung vaciy cuorasala Khazing na na dung,” a ta.
Ananias ca capa bie ca a thyi pahne ta a liepatyi te a thiy. Capa thuohlaa a thyipa bangkhuo ca ama ciy hringhruo.
Satlie tie a vaw yi te a riyy kha ama pahlaw khutaata a puvle yi te ama va paby.
Cakhutaata siymaluo pathung tluv a ru pata khaapa hmang ma a cuo tapa pachang li pata a napuvnung ca a zaa ngie.
Piter ta, “Na chang tie, nama hne na navaapa ta alyi kha hingpa zaata dyi hingta ma nama zaa?” a ta. Ama ta, “A cuo, ama zaa kha tana ma zaa,” a ta.

Cakhutaata Piter ta, “Khaapanakawma Abyipa Thlaapa kha dyapasya riypata nama palung a tling pakhaw? Mang tie, na navaapa vaa pabypa tie kha ingchiypakaa athaalie amaa daa kalie khiy, nama zaw acaa puvle ra'a yi,” a ta.
Sungkha ta Piter phyi thabaw lie kha a lie te a thiy. Satlie tie amaa zaa ngie ca a thiy rapa kha hmung yi te pyakhyi yi te a navaapa athaalie kha ama va paby.
Khrihsaabuv hne capa thuohlaa a thyipa bangkhuo ca ama ciy hringhruo.
Lucuotuv tie ta cawsaa hrawlie kha pamangsana hne kharuehaa hmang a hluvpuv ama tue. Zangtuv tie ca Solomon hmiechue lie kha palung a lusa pata amaa hmya.
Cawsaa hrangpa ahunghmuo vaa phuv nguo va yi, cuorasala cawsaazaapuv ta ca ama pathuosa.
Tuokhaata a cuo zaw canung hne capaa hne a hluv vie hryly ta Abyipa kha zang yi te ama buv luo ca amaa vya cha hryly.
Caacuonakawta Piter a vya cakuole pata a mingthlaapa ta sisuele naase yi ta pata a pasapa kha a vya puv yi te luopuv chunglie kha amaa phaa cunglie'a nata pangphaa cunglie kha ama pahlaa.
Jerusalem cahriy khypuv zaw taa khata cawsaa hluvpuv ca a vya hmya yi te, a pasapa hne thlaapa pyalyipa ta a tuepa tie kha a vawkhyi yi te, ama bangkhuo ta patluo sa pata ama cuo.
Cakhutaata tluobyi lepa hne, ama hne a aw hnepa Sadusi tie bangkhuo ta khuopuv ta ihnyi yi te lucuotuv tie kha
patuv yi te zaapuv thaw-ing lie kha thaw ama pathla.
Cuorasala zuo khata Abyipa avuoming ta thaw-ing chiypakaa kha pahaw te,
“Cakuo ung la, biena-ing chunglie kha a daa ung la, hingpa hringna kaw bie bangkhuo hing cawsaa kha va chang tie ung,” a ta yi.

Capa ca ama thyi tiyta, khy a dyi pahne khata ziytuv tie ca biena-ing chung luo kha a ngie yi te ama pacuv. Tluobyi le cepa hne ama hne a aw hnepa tie ama vya chiy tiyta, bieripatuv phuv tie hne Israel uvthyi bangkhuo kha a hmya pahry yi te, lucuotuv tie kha ama hmiekung luo vya chiykhyi riypata bie ama pi.
Cuorasala thaw-ing paliy tie kha ama vaa tiyta, iema kha thaw-ing chunglie hmung va yi; caacuonakawta kaa yi te ama va chang.
“Kiema ta thaw-ing a phasa pata a hre te rievetuv tie chiypakaa lie amaa daapa kha ma hmung yi, cuorasala ma pahaw tiyta a chunglie pakha hmuo hmung va yi puv,” ama ta.
Biena-ing uvtuv byipa hne tluobyi lepa tie ca capa bie ca ama thyi tiyta, ama nang ta uosa te khaapama a vya cuo aa tapa kha ama kharue ta a haasa.
Ca khu pahne ta cawsaa pakha vya chiy te, “Mang tie ung, thaw nama pathlapa cawsaa tie khana biena-ing chunglie a daa yi te cawsaa a pacuv ciemuo yi,” a ta.

Biena-ing uvtuv byipa ca paliy tie hne khata vaa te lucuotuv tie kha amaa vya chiy. Cuorasala hruohra ta nuopuole a dapuole pata ca cuo vyi, tahematapakieca cawsaa ta alung ta malie vaa'a kie yi tapa kha ama ciy.
Lucuotuv tie ca vya chiykhyi yi te, bieripatuv phuv hmielie kha padaa yi te tluobyi lepa ta bie a hiehriy yi.

“Hingpa paa ming hingta cawsaa pacuv'a va ung ciy ta pata a cusa pata bie maca pi mangtli yi. Cuorasala nama pacuvna pata Jerusalem ca pabi ung cate hingpa paa thiyse hing kiema luv cung luo pathla namaa ting,” a ta yi.
Cuorasala Piter hne lucuotuv tie ta, “Kiema ca cawsaa ri laata Khazing ri na maa ngie vie aa.
Thingkung cunglie pathlie ung cate nama thiepa Zingsuv ca ma mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing ta a pathu pakhaa mangtli.
Israel ming kha ama suena taata a ngiepachiy pata sue angiethena pi riypata Khazing ta ama ca luochiytuv hne khuotuv ta a cacuoluo kuo ta patu te a cyicalang tli.
Kiema ca hingpa hmang pachangkhyituv ta ma cuo, Khazing ta ama ri a ngiepa tie a pipa yi Thlaapa Pathe zaw kha pachangkhyituv ta a cuo ra,” ama ta.
Capa bie ca ama thyi tiyta ama hi haa laalaw te lucuotuv tie kha thie diy ama khing.

Cuorasala bieripatuv phuv lie pakha ta a cuo rapa, Gamaliel ama tapa Farasipa, cawsaa bangkhuo ta ama pa-uvsathyipa phungbie sayapa ta bieripatuv phuv hmielie kha a daa te lucuotuv tie kha ingle luo pyakhyi caw riypata bie a pi yi.
Ama ta Israel ming kha, “I phang kha Israel ming, iema cunglie tue nama khingpa hmang hing a raaringsa pata ruepathiy tie ung.

Ma hnangluo ning kha Theudas ama tapa paa za pya te, cawsaa cakhawpa ta cuo va ang aa ta nakawta cawsaa zapaliy tluv ta ama ziy. Cuorasala ama ca thie yi te a hnang a ziypa tie ca a chepatlaa yi te ama vie diy.
Cakhutaa cata Galilee ming Judas kha mingluv ri cuo ning khata za pya ra te, cawsaa ta ama za ziy ra raalaa ca ama zaw kha rana luo chiy te a ziypa tie zaw kha amaa zaa chepatlaa diy.
A taapa hmang kawlie zaw hing niema ta hingpa cawsaa zaw hing khaapahmuo ta khah ung, tahematapakieca hingpa hing cawsaa hmang tuepa ta a cuo kieca ra'a te,
cuorasala Khazing hmang tuepa ta a cuo kieca te khu the'a va ung ciy, niema tlaku na Khazing a dutuv ta a cuo pali'a ung ciy,” a ta yi. A bie ca a ngie yi te,
lucuotuv tie kha u yi te asung ta ama chi. Cakhutaata Zingsuv ming ta bie ri hrahring li tli riypata chang yi te ama pathlie.
Lucuotuv tie ca bieripatuv phuv hmie taata ama za pya tiyta, Zingsuv thueta nangzaahmiechi ang riypata maa tla ta pata a rue yi te ama palung a tluosa.
Cahaacata Zingsuv ca Messiah tana a cuo tapa kha Biena-ing lie cuose, ing lie cuose, ningting ta ci li pata pacuv yi te ama ukhyi.

Capa cuo hraw ning ca, ziytuv tie ca hluv vie le lawmaw yi te, Grik ryi a cyipa Judah ming ta Hebru ming kha ningting sa ning riypa a rena kawlie tana kiema nunghlyi tie ca hnang malie ama chawpa vie, ta pata ama kaw ama ri.
Caacuonakawta lucuotuv hlyihning tie ta ziytuv bangkhuo kha pakiy yi te, “Sapitiypi kawlieta Khazing bie ri kha hnang ma chaw kieca pha the'a vyi.
Caacuonakawta uvnu zaw, niema hraw taa hingta singna hne Thlaapa ta a bipa pasariy kha a tlaw ung la hingpa re hing iema pi pata cuo sala,
kiema hing ca thlaachuona hne Khazing bie rina lie kha thaa pahrang vie hriy pata cuose,” ama ta.

Ama bie ta zaapuv palung kha patluo te, zangna hne Thlaapa Pathe ta a bipa Steven, Filip, Prokhoras, Nikanor, Timon, Parmenas, hne Antiok khy taata Judah biena luo a ngiepa Jentail ming Nikolaus kha amaa tlaw.
Iema kha lucuotuv tie hmiekunglie padaa yi te, ama luv cunglie kha ama kuv khang yi te thlaa ama chuopa.
Khazing bie ca aa ze hryly; Jerusalem khy chunglie kha zangtuv hluv hryly yi te tluobyi hluvpuv zaw ta capa zangna ca amaa paw ra.
Khazing vihnyina hne cahrana ta a bipa Steven ta kharuehaana hne pahmungsana hmanglepa kha cawsaa zaw hrawlieta a tue.
Cuorasala sii taata hya a zangpa tie apungna-ing lie a pungpa chekha, Sairin, Alexandria, Silisia hne Asia taata a vawpa tie kha a daa yi te Steven hneta bie amaa i.
Cuorasala Steven ca singna hne Thlaapa Pathe ta bie a ri nakawta te khu va yi.
Caacuonakawta, cawsaa chekha kha, “Moses hne Khazing thuo pachi pata bie a ripa na ma thyi,” ta riypata biesakue ama khe.
Cahaacata cawsaazaapuv, uvthyi tie hne phungbie saya tie kha pasu yi te Steven kha patuv yi te bieripatuv phuv hmieluo kha ama vya chiykhyi.
Aa hmuo lipa pachangkhyituv tie kha ku yi te iema ca ta, “Hingpa paa hingta a pathepa ma biena-ing hne phungbie kha a du pata bie ri pari te,
hingpa Nazareth khypa Zingsuv hingta hingpa Biena-ing hing para patlaa diy'a te Moses ta malie a pipa phungbie bangkhuo hing a thle diy aa ta pata a ripa kha ma thyi,” ta pata ama ri.
Bieripatuv phuv chunglie a tupa bangkhuo ta Steven ca taapuo pata mang yi te a hmie ca avuoming hmie hneta aa lupa kha ama hmung.
Tluobyi lepa ta Steven ca, “Hing haa hingta ama tapa hing aa hmuopa a cuo ma?” a ta.
Steven ta: “Uvnu zaw'a nata paa zaw naathlie tie ung! Mingpa Abraham ca Haran lie a aw hluo, Mesopotamia ruo lie a za aw ning kha a lesyipa Khazing ca ama'a lie kha zaa luo te,
‘Na ruo hne na tieriy zaw kha thuse yi la ica pahmung sa riypa ruo luo kha si tie,’ a za ta.
Caacuonakawta Khaldi ruo kha pyase te Haran khy lie kha a va aw. A paa a thiy khutaata Khazing ta capa taa cata ata nama awnapa ruo luo hing a vya palaw.

Hingpa ruo lie hing phyipazaa pathlana khang hmuo ama kha ru a pi li raalaa pata, saata pakha hmuo a sa lipa khata nama hne na ciypathla zaw cuo tana hingpa ruo hing ru ta ica pi aa ta pata bie a za kuo.
Khazing ta, na ciypathla zaw ca malie ruo lie kha khyche ta ama cuo'a yi te, kung zapaliy chung bangkhuo sii ta a ziy'a yi te hrisaana ama ang aa.
‘Cuorasala a re ama hriepapa mingphang tie kha kama ta ama bie ripa'a yi angte, cakhutaa cata pya'a yi te hingpa hmang lie hing ina bie'a yi,’ a ta.

Cakhutaata Khazing ta Abraham kha vangdawtena biekuona kha a pi. Caacuonakawta Abraham ta Isak ca a puv khutaata ning cari a ta pata a vangdaw a te. Isak zaw ta a sacapaa Jakob kha cahaacata a vangdaw te te, Jakob zaw ta mingpa tie pahraa hlyihning kha ama vangdaw a te ra yi.
“Ma mingpa tie ta Josef kha ihnyi yi te Izipt ruo luo kha ama zaa. Cuorasala Khazing ta awpuo te

a za angpa ruvnaana chung bangkhuo taata hya a pazang sa. Izipt siepahruo Faro hmiekunglie aa daa tiyta, Khazing ta singna hne Faro minghmie pha hmung the riypa kha a za pi. Caacuonakawta Faro ta Izipt ruo bangkhuo uvtuv byi hne a siepahruo ing uvtuv byi ta a tue.
Izipt ruo hne Kanaan ruo chung bangkhuo lie kha cakuo tlung te ruvnaana khuopuv ta a tlung nakawta ma mingchingmingvuo tie kha sa ning riypa zaa hmung khu va yi.
Cuorasala Jacob ta Izipt ruo liena sa a aw tapa kha a thyi tiyta ma mingchingmingvuo tie kha a yikhanapa a pathlie yi.
Yihningnapa a pathliena lie yi kha Josef ta a uvnu zaw kha a pachang sa yi te Josef ingchungkhue kaw kha Faro ta a pachang yi.
Cakhutaata Josef ta a paa hne a ingchungkhue bangkhuo kha kya padaw sa yi te ama bangkhuo ta sawsariy papangaa ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Jacob ca Izipt luo kha za si te ama hne ma mingchingmingvuo tie ca capa lie ca ama thiy.
Ama riyy ca Shekhem luo kha sikhyi yi te Abraham ta Hamor mingphang tie'a lie ngu tuokaa ta a calyipa thluo lie kha ama paby.
“Cuorasala Khazing ta Abraham'a lie a tuepa biekuona a tlingna cuo aa vya ngie tiyta, Izipt lie ma cawsaa tie ca
Josef ta Izipt ruo a za uvpa a pachang lipa siepahruo hrangpa cuo te khata khuopuv ta ama pungzaa.
Ma mingphang kha za dung yi te a za hrisaa yi, ma mingchingmingvuo tie kha a puvthaapa haaseta zaw kha thiy naase yi ta pata hruohra ta ingle luo a pathaw sa yi.
Capa cuo ning khata Moses ca za puv te Khazing hmielie kha a puvthesa. A paa ing chunglie kha thla thung chung ama za mangchiy;
khungthing luo thawpa a cuo tiyta, Faro sacanung ta a sacapaa ta a la te a sapa hrahring haata a mangchiy.
Caacuonakawta Moses ca Izipt singna bangkhuo kha pacaw sa pata cuo te a bie lie hne a tuehriepa lie cahrana khuopuv ta a hnyi.
“Kung sawliy a tling tiyta a mingphang Israel ming parie riypa kha a palung chunglie a kya puv.
Iema hrawlie pakha kha Izipt ming pakha ta a za hrisaapa kha a hmung tiyta, a phangkha cawsaapa kha a bya te Iziptpa kha a thie.
Khazing ta iema hya pazang riypata ama a hmuopa kha a phangkha cawsaa zaw ta ama pachang thlu'a mang ta pata Moses ta a rue raalaa pata pachang va yi.
A mawluopa ta Israel ming pahning amaa tuvpa kha a hmung tiy yi ta, ‘Liechung zaw niema ca uvnu ta muo nama cuo ta, khaapanakawma namaa tuv?” ta yi te a ripatiy yi.
Cuorasala a viesaapa a hrutuvpa paa khata Moses kha vya nuo te, ‘Ahungma nama hing kiema uvtuv hne bieripatuv ta caa chi?
Azuochaning Iziptpa na thiepa haa khata ma ina thie khing ciy?’ a ta.
Capa bie ca a thyi pahne ta Moses ca a ruo te Midian ruo luo kha mingpe ta a va aw. Capa lie ca sacapaa pahning a sa.
“Kung sawliy khutaata Sinai Tluo athaalie, ruocaapa lie kha ruohraw a kuo nguoluopa myi chungtaata avuoming pakha kha ama'a lie aa luo.
Moses ca a hmungpa hmang cunglie kha a nang ta a uo; mangpasie riypata a vaa ngie ca capa myi chung taa cata,
‘Kama ca na mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing, Abraham Khazing, Isak Khazing, hne Jakob Khazing tana i cuo,’ ta pata Abyipa ueryi kha a thyi. Moses ca a cathangsa te a mang hmuo mang nguo vyi.
Cakhutaata Abyipa ta, ‘Na phyipakaw kha thlie tie, tahematapakieca naa daana hmang hing a pathepa hmang tana a cuo.

Izipt lieta a awpa i cawsaa zaw hrisaana ama angpa hne ama riethyina kha hmung tli angte amaa hrungna ueryi zaw kha i thyi tli. Iema khuo riypa tana i za cung. Ata hingta a vaw tie, Izipt luo na ica pathlie aa,’ a ta.
“'Ahungma uvtuv hne bieripatuv ta caa chi?’ ta yi te ama khing lipa Moses kha iema uvtuv hne hyapazangsatuv riypata ruohraw a kuopa myi hmuo pata Khazing ta iema'a luo a pathlie.
Iema kha Izipt ruo taata pyakhyi yi te Izipt ruo, Riyliy Sepa, hne ruocaapa lie kha kharuehaa hmang hne pamangsana kha kung sawliy chung a tue.
Israel ming kyihuo ta, ‘Khazing ta kama ina papuv sapa haa hingta na cawsaa zaw chung taa hingta na cuota profet pakha a papuv sa aa,’ zaa ta tuvpa kha Moses tana a cuo.

Ama ca Sinai Tluo lieta bie zaa changpa avuoming hneta ruocaapa lie Israel ming a hmyana lieta a awpa, ima mingchingmingvuo tie hneta khy a sapa, hne a hringpa Khazing bie kiema'a luo a chiy the riypata zaa cuhluotuv tana a cuo.
Ma mingchingmingvuo tie ta a ri zaa ngie khing lipa yi ta za thaw yi te Izipt ruo luo kaa riypa tlaku kha ama za khing.
Aaron kyihuo khata, ‘Luo malie a chiy riypa khazing tie kha malie tuepa tie, Izipt ruo taata malie a vya chiytuv Moses cunglie khaapama a tlung tapa kha pachang vapuv,’ ama ta.
Capa cuo ning ca cuetaata zuv kha tue yi te, kuvtuezuv'a lie kha hriykhung amaa ri, ama kuv ta ama tuepa kha pa-uvsathyina ama pi.

Cuorasala iema kha Khazing ta a palise yi te profet tie caa-uv chunglie ama capepa haa khata avuo aasiy kha a pabie sa yi: ‘Vya Israel ingchungkhue tie, ruocaapa lieta kung sawliy chung nama za aw ning kha sahring thie pata panaana hne hriykhungrina ina za pihluo ung ca ma?

Na za pihluo buo va ung ciy; Molokh khazing thluodaa kha a phyale ung cate, nama kuv ta nama tuepa nama khazing Refan aasiy zuv kha namaa cakele, caacuonakawta niema ca Babilon khung luo khana ica thaw'a yi,’ ta pata aa cape.

“Ma mingchingmingvuo tie khata Khazing kiema'a lie a aw tana pata thluodaa kha ruocaapa lieta ama za hnyile pari. Capa thluodaa ca Khazing ta Moses a chaw ningta a pahmung sapa haa khata tue pata a cuo.
Ma mingchingmingvuo tie, hne Joshua ca ama hmielie Khazing ta aa cadepa yi mingphang tie ruo ama lale ning kha capa thluodaa ca amaa sikhyile. Capa thluodaa ca David chuo te khata capa lie ca a aw.
David ca Khazing minghmie pha hmung te Jakob Khazing cuota ing suokha sa riypata Khazing zaa hiepa kha tana a cuo.
Cuorasala ing a satuv tange ca Solomon ta a cuo.
Cadyiseca Cungnungce ca cawsaa kuv ta tuepa ing lie aw vyi; profet tie ta,
‘Vuoruo hing i tuna ta cuo te, alyi hing i phyi pachungna tana a cuo. Tuokhaapa ing na sapa'a ung cate ma, i pahyna hmang ca khaapa khata a cuo aa?
Hing hmang bangkhuo hing i kuv ta i tue ciepa cuo va ma?’ a ta.
“A nangpingpa, pathiypalung hne naathyina lieta vangdaw a te lipa tie, nama mingchingmingvuo tie ta ama za tue tawpa haa tana Thlaapa Pathe hing namaa du pari.

Nama mingchingmingvuo tie ta ama za hrisaa lipa profet pakha chuo ama aw ma? Aa Dangpa Paa aa vaw riypa a rilupa tie kha za thie yi te, ata niema zaw hing ama a lyituv hne a thietuv tana nama vya cuo.
Avuoming ta ama za pipa phungbie kha a cuhluopa ca niema ta nama cuo raalaa pata, capa phungbie a ziy lipa ca niema ngiethie tana nama cuo,” a ta.
Capa bie ca ama thyi tiyta, ama hi haa hringhruo te Steven kha ama haa dyi ama rie sue.
Cuorasala Steven ca Thlaapa Pathe ta bi te, vuoruo luo kha a mang tiyta Khazing rungnaana hne Khazing cacuoluo kuo ta Zingsuv aa daapa kha a hmung.
Ama ta, “Mang tie ung, vuoruo ingchiypakaa kha a pahaw te Khazing cacuoluo kuo ta Cawsaa Sacapaa aa daapa khana i hmung!” a ta.
Cuorasala ama naa kha a paping yi te, khuopuv ta khi yi te amaa ruochiy.
Khyle luo kha a dapahriy yi te alung ta ama vaa. Alung ta a vaapa tie ca ta ama buohryicungle kha Saul ama tapa satliepa phyi thabaw lie ama papung.
Alung ta ama vaa nguoluo ning kha Steven ta, “Abyipa Zingsuv i thlaapa kha na cuhluo thi tie,” ta pata thlaa a chuo.
Cakhutaa cata a pakhuv pane te, “Abyipa ama suena hing a thyipa pari thi khah yi,” ta pata khuopuv ta a khi. Cahaacata a khi khu pahne ta a thiy.
Saul zaw ta Steven ama thiepa kha a palung a tlingkhyi yi.
Khazing a ciyzaapa chekha ta Steven kha paby yi te khuopuv ta caa yi te muochie ama sa.
Cuorasala Saul ca Khrihsaabuv kha para aa ting. Ing kha hnang ing kha ta cakuo te zangtuv tie kha canung capaa ta li pata a da yi te thaw a pathla yi.
Zangtuv aa chepatlaapa tie kha hmangting ta si yi te thuophaa ama ri.
Filip ca Samaria khypuv luo kha zuv te Messiah kaw thuophaa kha a ri.
A ripa kha thyi yi te a tuepa kharuehaa hmang kha ama hmung tiyta ama bangkhuo ta Filip bie kha a phata tah ama naathlie.
Thlaapa pyalyipa kha cawsaa hluvpuv chungtaata khuopuv ta khi yi te ama pya, a pakyapa tie hne a phyi cabiepa tie a hluvpuv zaw ama tluo.
Caacuonakawta capa khypuv lie ca palungtluona ta a bi.
Capa khypuv chunglie ca Simon ama tapa, pacuo a thepa pakha aw te Samaria ming zaw kha ama kharue a pahaa yi. Cawsaa ciemuopa pakha tana i cuo ta pata aa rue.
Cawsaa bangkhuo, a caw cepa taata a le cepa te ta a bie kha naathlie yi te, “Hing cawsaapa hing Alepa, Khazing cahrana, tapa kha tana a cuo,” ama ta.
A pacuothena khata iema kha cuo pasiypuv ama nang a pa-uo tli nakaw yi ta ama kha ama ziy.
Cuorasala Khazing pena thuophaa hne Filip ta Zingsuv ming a ukhyipa kha ama zang tiyta canung hne capaa hne tiy amaa naw.
Ama Simon hrahring zaw kha a zang ra. Tiy aa naw khutaata Filip kha a cakuona bangkhuo ta paziy te pamangsana hne kharuehaa hmanglepuv zaw kha a hmung tiyta a nang dyi a uo.
Jerusalem lie a awpa lucuotuv tie ta Samaria ming na Khazing bie a cuhluo yi tapa kha ama pachang tiyta Piter hne Johan kha iema'a luo ca ama pathlie.
Ama pahning cata sibung yi te Thlaapa Pathe ama cu riypata thlaa ama chuopa.
(Zingsuv ming ta tiy amaa nawpa dyi cuo te Thlaapa Pathe kha ahungtahmuo ting valie yi).
Piter hne Johan ta ama luv cunglie kha ama kuv khang yi te Thlaapa Pathe kha ama ting.
Lucuotuv tie ta ama cunglie ama kuv khang yi te Thlaapa ama ting tapa kha Simon ta a hmung tiyta, iema kha tuokaa pi yi te,
“Ama cunglie i kuv i khangpa mekaa ta Thlaapa Pathe ama ting the riypata hingpa cahrana hing kama zaw na pi ra tie ung,” a ta.
Cuorasala Piter ta, “Khazing pipa lasaw kha tuokaa ta calyi naa ting nakawta nama hne na tuokaa hne khata va lidie tie ung!
Khazing hmiekunglieta na pathiypalung a pha li nakawta ma re lie hing na hrie ra thena riypa aw vyi.
Hingpa na pha lina hing a ngiepachiy la a ngiethena na hmung riypata Abyipa'a luo kha thlaachuo tie.
Tahematapakieca nama ca ihnyina ta bi cate suena thaw chunglie a tlapa tana na cuo,” a ta.
Simon ta, “Na ripa suokha hmuo i cunglie a tlung li riypata thlaa na chuopa tie,” ta pata a palie.
Piter hne Johan ca ama hmungpa hne amaa tawpa kha ama ri khutaata hne Abyipa bie kha ama phu khutaata Jerusalem luo kha kaa yi te Samaria khyta hluvpuv lie kha thuophaa ama kya phupaale.

Cakhutaata Abyipa avuoming pakha ta Filip kha, “Thu la sungluo kha sibung la Jerusalem taata Gaza luo a sipa luopuv luo kha sibung tie,” a ta. (Capa luopuv ca ruocaapa chunglie a sipa luopuv tana a cuo).

Caacuonakawta thu te a si. Luopuv lie kha Ethiopia siepahruonung a suethiy bangkhuo a kingtuv, naw a hnyi ciemuopa, Ethiopia tiydiypa byi pakha a za aw. Ama ca Khazing abie riypata Jerusalem luo kha a khaw te
ing luo a kaale ningta a cuo; aruole cunglie kha a tu te profet Isaiah caa-uv kha a ri.
Thlaapa ta Filip kha, “Huepa aruole athaa luo hue vaa tie,” a ta.
Aruole luo kha vaa ruo te profet Isaiah caa-uv a ripa kha a thyi. Filip ta, “Na ripa hing a siyluo na pachang ma?” a ta.
Ama ta, “Pakhakha ta ina pasiepa li pata ca tuokhaatama i pachang the aa?” a ta. Cakhutaa cata Filip kha aruole luo kie riypata hry te aa thaalie a patu sa.
A za ri nguoluopa Caapathe lie caatluo ca: “Ama ca thie riypa tuv haata sikhyi yi te, a hming a ngutuv hmiekunglie tuvtaata khi li pata a awpa haata, kaa kha hmuo bie ri lipa tana a aw.
Nangzaana kha ang te a daakhuotuv ahunghmuo hnyi vyi. Ahungma a chuo kha a pasuv the aa? Tahematapakieca a hringna ca chuelyi taata lapa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Ethiopia byipa ca ta Filip kha, “Ca hiehriy thi'a ang, profet ta a ripa hing ahung kaw tama a cuo? Ama kaw ma, pakhakha kaw ma?” a ta.
Ca tiyta Filip ta, hingpa Caapathe taa hingta pathu pata Zingsuv kaw thuophaa kha ama ca a chang.
Cahaacata ama sibung nguoluopa ca ta tiy awna luo kha ama chiy ca, capa byi ca ta, “Mang tie, tiy a aw hing; tiy a naw riypata khaapama naa pakhuo aa?” a ta.
(Filip ta, “na pathiypalung yalya ta na zang kieca tiynawna hmung riypa na cuo,” a ta. Capa paa ca ta, “I zang, Zingsuv Khrih ca Khazing sacapaa tana a cuo tapa kha i zang,” a ta.)
Aruole kha padaa sa te, ama pahning ta tiy chung luo ca cung yi te Filip ta tiy a naw.
Tiy chungtaata ama kya pya ca Abyipa Thlaapa ta Filip kha la te a vie; tiydiypa khata hmung the va tli, cadyiseca ama ca palung tluo ciemuo pata ing luo kha a si.
Filip ca Azotus khy lie kha a vya luo te, Sisaria a chiyna te khata luopuv lie khy bangkhuo khata thuophaa a phule.
Capa cuo hraw ning ca Saul ta Abyipa ziytuv tie kha thie riypata a pachiypahuo nguoluo yi. Tluobyi le cepa'a luo kha vaa te,

Damaskas khy Judah ming apungna-ing uvtuv tie ta ama kha ama pachangna riypata caa aa hie. Aa tingpa ca capa khy lie kha Abyipa Luopuv a ziytuv ama aw pata a cuo kieca canung capaa ta li pata patuv pata Jerusalem luo thaw pathla riypata a chiy riypata a cuo.
Damaskas khy luo a va chiy'a nangpa khata, sungkhapuv ta vuoruo taata khena ta ama hne a cahriy kha a za khe.
Alyi lie kha a lie te ueryi suokha ta, “Saul, Saul, khaapanakawma ina hrisaa ciy?” a ta.
Saul ta, “Ahungtama na cuo, Abyipa? a ta. Paliena ueryi ta, “Na hrisaa nguoluopa Zingsuv tana i cuo.
Thu la khypuv chung luo kha vaa ngie tie, na tue riypa kha chang pata na cuo aa,” a ta.
Ama hne khy a tlaw hnepa tie ca a ca-ang ta ama ca-ang, tahematapakieca ueryi dyi kha thyi yi te ahunghmuo hmung va yi.
Saul ca a lyi taa khata kya thu te a ming a padyi raalaa ca khaapahmuo hmung the vyi; caacuonakawta a kuv ta ca-yale yi te Damaskas khychung luo kha amaa ngiekhyi.
Ning thung chung a ming hmung li pata, hne ning li dang li pata a aw.
Damaskas khychung lie ca Ananias ama tapa ziytuv pakha a aw. Muocuo chunglie kha Abyipa ta, “Ananias,” a ta. Ama ta, “Abyipa, hingpa lie hingna i aw,” a ta.
Abyipa ta, “Thu la Luo Aa Dangpa ama tapa luopuv luo kha vaa la Judas ing lie kha Tarsas khypa Saul ama tapa kha a aw ma ta pata va hiehriy tie yi. Ama ca thlaa a chuo nguoluo ningta a cuo.
Ananias ama tapa paa ta a ming a hmung pakhaa thena riypata a luv cunglie a kuv a khang nguoluopa khana muocuo ta a hmung,” a ta.
Cuorasala Ananias ta, “Abyipa, hingpa paa kaw hing cawsaa hluvpuv'a taata i thyi tli, Jerusalem lie a awpa na cawsaa pathepa zaw cunglieta hmang pha lipa khazaa ma a tue tapa hne
hingpa lie zaw hing nama ming caa upa zaw bangkhuo patuv riypata tluobyi lepa'a taata nawhnyina a lapa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cuorasala Abyipa ta, “Cakuo tie, tahematapakieca ama ca Jentail ming hne siepahruo tie'a lie, hne Israel ming hraw luo i ming a phyatuv hne a pachang satuv riypata i tlawpa i cehre tana a cuo.
Kama hrahring ta hingpa paa hing kama vuolieta kha tluv tama a te-ang tapa kha ica pahmung sa aa,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta Ananias ca ingchung luo kha a ngie te, Saul luv cunglie kha a kuv a khang khutaata, “Uvnu Saul, na ming a hmung pakhaa riypa hne Thlaapa Pathe ta na bi riypa tana hingpa luo naa vawnapa luopuv lieta nama'a lie a luopa Abyipa Zingsuv ta kama hing ina pathlie,” a ta.
Sungkhabala ta ngaaphuvhling haata a tapa kha Saul ming taata tla te a ming ca a hmung khu pakhaa. Cakhutaata thu te tiynawna a ang,
sa ning te thaazuo a hnyi pakhaa.
Apungna-ing lie kha, “Zingsuv ca Khazing Sacapaa tana a cuo,” ta pata a phu.

A bie ripa a thyipa bangkhuo ca ama nang ta uo te, “Hingpa paa hing Jerusalem lie Zingsuv a zangtuv tie a paratuv kha cuo va ma? Iema kha patuv pata tluobyi lepa tie'a luo chiykhyi riypata hingpa hmang luo a vawpa khata cuo va ma?” ama ta.
Saul ca cahrana hneta bi viele hryly te Zingsuv ca Messiah tana a cuo ta pata a ripa khata Damaskas khy lie a awpa Judah ming kha ama palung a pataw a pamuo yi.
Ning pasiypuv khutaata Judah ming ta thie riypata ama rawpa kha
Saul ta a pachang. Ama thie khu riypata thlake bangkhuo kha chungzuo ta ama huo;
cuorasala ama a ziytuv tie ta pasyi lie khung yi te zuo ta cakuokhyi yi te khypuv dungkhuona piehu khue taata ama pachung.
Jerusalem luo a chiy tiyta ziytuv tie a taw riypa kha aa zue; cuorasala ziytuv a cuo ra hrahring tli tapa kha ama zang li nakawta ama bangkhuo ta ama kha ama ciy.
Cuorasala Barnabas ta lucuotuv tie'a luo kha vaakhyi te luopuv lieta Abyipa a hmungna kaw, Abyipa ta ama'a lie bie a ripa, Damaskas lieta Khazing bie a phuna kaw tapa zaw kha a chang yi.
Caacuonakawta Jerusalem lieta iema'a lie kha hyazangsa pata aw te Abyipa ming ta riephasa pata phung a ri.
Grik ryi a cyipa Judah ming zaw hne khata bie a rue yi te a i zaw amaa i, cuorasala iema ta ama kha thie amaa nang.
Khapa kaw kha zangtuv tie ta ama thyi tiyta ama kha Sisaria luo paphya yi te Tarsas luo ama pasi.

Capa cuo ning ca Judea ruo, Galilee ruo hne Samaria ruo lie a awpa khrihsaabuv tie'a lie ca diena aw te a kiethaw ciemuo. Abyipa ciyzaana cangta hring yi te Thlaapa Pathe hnaanguona chunglie ama aw nakawta mingluv zaw ama hluv hryly.
Piter ca khyzaa ta a awpa zangtuv tie a tlawlepa yi ta Lidda lie a awpa a mingpathepa tie'a luo kha a chiy.
Capa lie ca a pakya nakawta kung cari chung a ziena lie a laa tlipa Ainias ama tapa paa kha a hmung.
Piter ta, “Ainias, Zingsuv Khrih na caa patluo sa tli, thu la na pangphaa kha lang tie,” a ta. Ainias ca sungkha ta a thu.
Lidda lie hne Sharon lie a awpa bangkhuo khata hmung yi te Abyipa'a luo amaa vya pali.
Joppa khy lie kha Tabitha ama ta nung ziytuv pakha aw te Grik ryi ta ca Dorkas ama ta. Ama ca hmang phapa tue pari te a siypasapa tie a bya paripa tana a cuo.
Capa cuo ning kha pasa te a thiy. A riyy ca pasiy yi te cungluo duo lieta ama pasing.

Lidda khy ca Joppa khy hne khata a ngie te, Lidda lieta Piter a awpa kha ziytuv tie ta ama pachang nakawta cawsaa pahning pathlie yi te, “A catli pata kiema'a luo a vaw thi tie,” ta pata paa ama va pakie sa.

Caacuonakawta Piter ca a pachie te iema hne cata a si. A va chiy pahne ta a cung duo luo kha ama kiekhyi. Nunghlyi bangkhuo ta aa thaalie kha a vya daa yi te ama caapuo pata a hring chung ta a taapapa yi buohryi hne caw hrangpa zaw kha ama pahmung.
Piter ta iema kha ale luo papya yi te, cakhutaa cata a pakhuv pane te thlaa a chuo. A riyy luo kha a pali te, “Tabitha, thu tie,” a ta. A ming kya padyi te Piter kha a hmung ca aa kya tu.
Piter ta a kuv kha hluo te a padaa. Cakhutaata zangtuv tie hne nunghlyi zaw kha u yi te a hring tapa kha a pahmung yi.
Capa thuohlaa ca Joppa khy kha a ze diy te cawsaa hluvpuv ta Abyipa kha ama zang.
Piter ca Joppa khy lieta Simon ama tapa savang re a hriepa paa'a lie kha cuo pasiypuv a aw.
Sisaria khy lieta Kornelias ama tapa paa pakha za aw te, Italy Riekaphuv ama tapa lie Rom riebyi pakha ta a cuo.
Ama ca a ingchungkhue tie yalya hneta biena luota te a maasapa hne Khazing a ciyzaapa, siypasa tie kha pahyasa pata pi yi te Khazing'a luo thlaa a chuo paripa ta a cuo.
Ning kha ca zuoluocaw siymaluo pathung hraw khata muocuo hmung te, capa chunglie ca avuoming pakha a vya ngie te, “Kornelias,” ta pata a upa kha siephele khata a hmung.
Avuoming ca a ciysapuo pata mangpasie te, “Khaapama, Abyipa,” a ta. Avuoming ta, “Na thlaachuona hne siypasa na byapa ca vuoruo luo kha kie te Khazing ta maw vyi.
Ata hingta Joppa luo kha Piter ama tapa Simon va ku riypata cawsaa pathlie la,
ama ca riyliy kielie a awpa, savang re a hriepa Simon ing lie khana a tlung,” a ta.
Ama'a lie bie a ripa avuoming a cakuo pahne ta sii pahning hne, biena luota te a maasapa ama a mangchiytuv rieka pakha kha u yi te,
hmang a cuopa bangkhuo kha a chang khutaa yi ta Joppa luo kha a pathlie yi.
A mawluopa zuoluocaw, vaa kupa tie khypuv luo ama va pha'a nang caw khata Piter ca thlungkhuv luo kha thlaachuo riypata a kie.
Piter ca a nang diy te sa a ning khing; sa ama tue nguoluopa khata i muo ma i singhring ma ta pata a aw.
Vuoruo a pahaw te pang haata a tapa hmang suokha, a kiy kiy paliy ta alyi luo ama za pathlapa kha a hmung.
A chunglie ca phyipaliypa saruopa phangting, aa va ta a vapa saruopa phangting hne pavaa a phangting ta ama aw.
Ueryi suokha ta, “Thu tie, Piter, thie yi la ning tie,” a ta.
Cuorasala Piter ta, “Ning'a va ang Abyipa, a pyalyipa hne a pathe lipa hmang ca khaapahmuo ning buo va ang,” a ta.
Ueryi ta a yihningnapa za chang pakhaa te, “Khazing ta a pathe a tapa ca nama ta a pyalyi ta'a vaciy,” a ta.
Cahaacata yi thung a cuo khutaata capa hmang ca sungkha ta vuoruo luo ama lathaw pakhaa.

Piter ca i hmungpa muocuo hing a siyluo khaapatama a cuo aa ta pata a kharue a haasa ningta Kornelias ta a pathliepa cawsaa tie kha tlangkhy ama vya chiy. Simon ing kha hiehriy yi te thlake athaalie amaa daa nguoluo.
Vya u yi te, Piter ama tapa Simon kha hingpa lie hing a aw ma? ama ta.
Piter ca muocuo a hmungpa kaw a pacuo nguoluo ning kha, Thlaapa ta, “Mang tie, cawsaa pathung na caa huv nguoluo yi,
Thu la cung tie, a paluolue li pata ziy tie yi, kama ta i vya pathliepa tana ama cuo,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Piter ca cawsaa tie'a luo kha cung te, “Kama hingna nama huv nguoluopa paa ta a cuo ang; nama'a vaw hnuochuopa ca khaapatama a cuo?” a ta yi.

Iema ta, “Riebyipa Kornelias ta malie a pathliepa tana ma cuo. Ama ca aa dangsapa hne Khazing a ciyzaapa ta cuo te, Judah ming bangkhuo ta ama pa-uvsathyipa tana a cuo. Na bie ripa thyi riypata Khazing avuoming pakha ta a ing luo naa vaw riypata ama kha bie a changpa tana a cuo,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta Piter ta iema kha ku yi te ing aa patlung sa yi. A mawluopa ta a pachie te iema hneta a si; Joppa taata zangtuv chekha zaw ama si ra.
A hezuoningpa ta Sisaria ama pha. Kornelias ca a tieriy hne a viesaa zaw kha ku yi te ama kha ama za mangkhuo nguoluo.
Piter ing luo a chiy pahne ta Kornelias ta a hladaw te a phyi thabaw lie vaa bu te aa bie.
Piter ta ama kha pathu te, “A daa tie, kama zaw cawsaa tana i cuo ra,” a ta.
Bie a ripuo pata ing chung luo kha aa ngie ca cawsaa hluvpuv amaa tupa kha hmung yi te,

“Judah ming pakha ca Jentail ming a viesaa riypa hne parie riypa hing phungbie ta a thlu tapa ca niema hrahring ta nama pachang; cuorasala ahung kha hmuo a pyalyipa hne a pathe lipa ta i hmung li riypata Khazing ta ina pahmung sa mangtli.
Caacuonakawta ina vya paku sa tiy ung cata i li pata i vya ziy yi. Khaapanakawma ina vya paku sa ung ciy tapa kha ata hing na chang tie ung,” a ta yi.
Kornelias ta, “Ma hnangluo ata tiy siymaluo pathung hingta, i ing chunglie thlaa i chuo nguoluo pata sungkhapuv ta pang ruopa a buvpa cawsaa pakha i hmielie a vya daa te,
‘Kornelias, Khazing ta na thlaachuona kha thyi te siypasa na byanapa zaw maw vyi.
Caacuonakawta Joppa luo kha cawsaa pathlie la Piter ama tapa Simon kha va paku sa tie yi; ama ca riyliy kielie a awpa, savang re a hriepa Simon ing lie khana a aw aa,’ ina ta.

Caacuonakawta nama ca a catli pata ca vya paku sa yi angte, nama zaw ngie na chi cate naa vaw. Caacuonakawta ata hing kiema bangkhuo ca Khazing hmielie aw pate, Khazing ta ri riypata aca changpa bangkhuo naathlie riypata ma cuo tli,” ta pata a palie.
Cakhutaa cata Piter ta, “Khazing ta cawsaa pahlyipale vyi tapa kha i pachang,
cuorasala khaapa mingphang ta a cuo zaw ama kha ciyzaa te aa dangpa hmang a tuepa bangkhuo ca Khazing ta a cuhluo yi.
Cawsaa bangkhuo Abyipa ta a cuopa Zingsuv Khrih ta a phupa diena ca Khazing ta Israel ming'a luo a pi yi tapa kha nama pachang.
Johan ta tiynawna kaw a ri khutaata Galilee taata pathu pata Judea pe bangkhuo capa thuohlaa aa zepa zaw kha nama pachang.

Khazing ta a awpuo nakawta, tuokhaatama Nazareth khypa Zingsuv kha Thlaapa Pathe hne cahrana a bya tapa kha cuose, tuokhaatama hmang phapa kha tue te khachie ta a tuepa bangkhuo kha a patluo sa yi tapa kha cuose, nama pachang.
Kiema ca Judea ruo chunglie hne Jerusalem lieta a tuepa bangkhuo kha a hmungtuv hne a pachangtuv tana ma cuo. Ama kha vieluo cunglie pathlie yi te ama thie.
Cuorasala Khazing ta ning thungna lieta ta pathu pakhaa te
cawsaa bangkhuo'a lie cuo li pata Khazing ta pachangkhyituv ta aa tlawpa kiema'a lie kha aa luo. Thiyna taata a thu pakhaa khutaata ama hne ma ning ma dang pakhaw.
Ama ta, cawsaa zaw kha thuophaa chang riypa hne ama ca Khazing ta a hringpa hne a thiypa tie bie a ripatuv riypata a chipa kha pachangkhyituv cuo riypata malie a chang.
Ama a zangpa bangkhuo a ming ta sue angiethena hmung riypa kaw kha profet bangkhuo ta ama za ri,” a ta yi.
Piter ta capa bie a ri nguoluo ning ca bie a thyipa bangkhuo cunglie kha Thlaapa Pathe a tla.
Piter hneta a vaw pakhawpa vangdaw a tepa zangtuv tie ta Jentail ming cunglie zaw te na Thlaapa Pathe lasaw kha bya pata a cuo tapa kha ama hmung tiyta ama nang a uo,
tahematapakieca iema ta ryiphanghrangpa kha cyi yi te Khazing ama pathuosa. Piter hneta a vaw rapa vangdaw a tepa zangtuv tie ca ama nang dyi a uo. Cakhutaata Piter ta,
“Kiema haata Thlaapa Pathe a hmung rapa, hingpa cawsaa zaw hing tiy ta tiynawna ang riypa kha ahungma a thlu khu'a yi?” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Zingsuv Khrih ming ta tiynawna pi riypata bie a pi yi. Cakhutaata Piter ca ning hluv vie awkhyi caw riypata ama thlu.
Judea ruo chunglie a awpa lucuotuv tie hne zangtuv tie ta Jentail ming na Khazing bie a cuhluo ra yi tapa kha ama thyi.
Caacuonakawta Piter kha Jerusalem luo a khaw ca vangdaw a tepa zangtuv tie ta caw-yi yi te,
“Khaapanakawma vangdaw te lipa tie a khe yi cate iema hne sa na ning hne yi?” ama ta.
Cakhutaata Piter ta capa kaw kha suokha hnang suokha ta chang yi te,
“Joppa lie thlaa i chuo nguoluo ning kha i muo ma i singhring ma i ta pata muocuo suokha i hmung. Vuoruo taata a kiy kiy paliy a awpa pang kusapa suokha kha i thaalie ama za pachung.
A ngieta tah i mang pasie ca, phyipaliypa ruosaa hne ingzue sahring, saahruo, aa va ta a vapa saruopa, hne pavaa zaw kha i hmung yi.
Ueryi suokha zaw kha thyi angte, ‘Thu tie, Piter, thie yi la ning tie,’ ina ta.
Cuorasala kama ta, ‘Abyipa, cuo the'a vyi; a pyalyipa hne a pathe lipa suokha hmuo i pakaa luo a ngie buo vyi,’ i ta.
Cuorasala vuoruo taa ueryi a yihningnapa thyi pakhaa angte, ‘Khazing ta a pathe a tapa ca nama ta a pyalyi ta'a vaciy,’ ina ta.
Cahaacata yi thung a cuo khutaata a bangkhuo ta vuoruo taata amaa zaa da pakhaa.
Capa cuota lie ca ta Sisaria taata ama vya pathliepa cawsaa pathung ca ma awnapa ing luo kha ama vya chiy.
Thlaapa ta iema hne si riypa hne iema hne kiema alalalie pahlyipalena tue li riypata ina chang. Hingpa uvnu pacaruv tie hne hingta si pakhaw pate Kornelias ing luo ca maa ngie.
Ama ta a ing chunglie avuoming pakha aa daa pata hmung te, ‘Joppa luo kha cawsaa pathlie yi la Piter ama tapa Simon kha va paku sa tie yi;
nama hne na ingchungkhue yalya ta khuona nama hmung riypata ama ta thuophaa kha aca chang'a yi,’ a tapa kha malie a chang.
Iema'a lie bie ri hruo i thu pahne ta a hruothu ningta kiema'a lie a cuopa haa khata iema cunglie kha Thlaapa Pathe a tla.
Ca khu pahne ta Abyipa ta, ‘Johan ca tiy ta tiynawna kha a pi, cuorasala niema ca Thlaapa Pathe tana tiynaw pata nama cuo aa,’ a za tapa kha i kya thyi.
Zingsuv Khrih ma zang nakawta Khazing ta malie a pipa lasaw kha iema zaw a pi ra kie yi ca Khazing kha pakhuo khu riypata kama ca ahungtama i cuo?” i ta.
Capa bie ca ama thyi tiyta vielie riypa hnyi li tlipa yi ta, Khazing kha pathuosa yi te, “Khazing na Jentail ming zaw hing sue a ngiepachiy pata hring riypa cuophaa a pi ra yi,” ama ta.
Steven kawlieta hrisaana ang yi te a chepatlaapa tie kha Fonisia, Saipras hne Antiok te khata chiy yi te Judah ming'a lie dyi kha thuophaa ama ri.
Cuorasala iema hrawlie ca Saipras ruo ming hne Sairin ming aw ra yi te iema ca ta Antiok luo kha si yi te Abyipa Zingsuv kaw Thuophaa ca Grik ryi a cyipa Judah ming'a lie zaw kha ama phu.
Abyipa cahrana ca iema'a lie aw te cawsaa hluvpuv ta zang yi te Abyipa'a luo kha amaa pali.
Capa thuohlaa ca Jerusalem Khrihsaabuv ta thyi yi te Barnabas kha Antiok luo ca ama pathlie.

Antiok luo ca chiy te Khazing vihnyina kha a hmung tiyta a palung tluo hringhruo te iema kha ama palang ta Abyipa'a lie kha zang tluo aa tlasa pata ama aw pari riypa hne amaa pipase pari riypata a pasu yi.
Ama ca cawsaa phapa, Thlaapa Pathe hne zangna ta a bipa cuo te cawsaa hluvpuv kha Abyipa'a luo aa chiy yi.
Cakhutaata Barnabas ca Saul kha huv riypata Tarsas luo kha si te,

a hmung tiyta Antiok luo aa vya chiyle. Kung kha chung bangkhuo Khrihsaabuv hne khata a taw yi te cawsaa hluvpuv kha ama pacuv. Hingpa Antiok lie hingna ziytuv tie kha, “Khrihsaa,” ta pata ama za u taa.
Khapa cuo ning kha profet chekha ca Jerusalem taata Antiok luo kha ama si.

Iema hraw taata pakha, a ming Agabas ama tapa paa kha a daa te chuelyi cung bangkhuo ta khuopuv ta cakuo a tlung aa tapa kha Thlaapa cahrana ta a rilu. (Capa cakuo ca Klaudias siepahruo a cuo ning khana a tlung).
Ziytuv tie khata iema ama ta khuna cyicuo ta Judea ruo chunglie a awpa zangtuv tie kha abyana pi riypata khue khuo yi te,
byanapa ca Barnabas hne Saul kuv ta khrihsaa uvthyi tie'a luo kha ama paphya.
Capa cuo hraw ning ca Siepahruo Herod ta khrihsaa ming chekha kha a hrisaa yi.
Johan uvnu Jeim kha zueziy ta a pathie sa yi.
Hingpa hingta Judah ming palung a patluo sa yi tapa kha a hmung tiyta Piter zaw kha patuv aa nang. Hingpa hing thiynung phuv lipa viechuo pyi cuo ningta a cuo.
A patuv khutaata thaw pathla te phuv kha lie rieka papaliy a awpa rieka phuv paliy kha rie a pave sa yi. Lawsena pyi khutaata cawsaazaapuv hmielie a bie ripa riypata aa ting pata a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Piter ca thaw chunglie aw te cadyiseca khrihsaabuv ta ama cuota Khazing'a luo kha khuopuv ta thlaa ama chuo.
Herod ta mawluo zaapuv hmielie bie i ripa aa a ta ningpa zuo ta Piter ca thaabuoliriy suohning ta ciy yi te rieka pahning alalalie kha aa zie. Thaw-ing chiypakaa zaw kha ama huo.
Sungkha ta Abyipa avuoming pakha a luo te thaw-ing chung ca a khe diy. Avuoming ta Piter ca a ke lie kha cabe te, “A catli pata thu!” ta te a pahra. A kuv taata thaabuoliriy ca a pathluo te a tla.
Avuoming ca ta, “Na tesaw kha a saw la na phyipakaw kha a pakaw tie,” a ta. Piter ta a changpa haa cata a tue. Cakhutaata avuoming ta, “Na pang kha a buv la na ziy,” a ta.
Piter ta thaw-ing le luo kha ziyle te cadyiseca avuoming ta a tuepa hing a cuo sasawpa a cuo ma tapa kha a nang vuo vyi; muocuo na i hmung ta pata a rue.

Rie a vepa tie ama huonapa suokhanapa hne suohningnapa law yi te khy chung luo caluonapa thaa thlake lepa luo ama chiy. Thlake ca amata tah a pahaw te ale luo pya yi te luopuv lie ama cakuole pata avuoming ta a thuse.
Piter ca a palung kya vuo te, “Ata hing ca i pasie tli, Abyipa ta aa vuoming kha za pathlie te Herod kuv chung taata hne Judah ming bangkhuo amaa mangkhuopa taata ina khuo tli,” a ta.
A kya pachangpasie pahne ta a ming hrangpa ta Marka ama tapa Johan a nung Mary ing luo kha a vaa.
Piter ta ingle luo ingchiypakaa kha a cakhaw ca a changtaanung Roda ama ta nung ta a kya chaw.
Piter ueryi tapa kha a pachang nakawta a palung tluo tuv te ingchiy pahaw cuo pata ing chung luo kha a ruo te Piter na ingchiypakaa lie a daa thluo, ta pata a pathyi yi.
Iema ta, “Ngaa tli kanaa ca maw?” ama ta. Cuorasala, ‘A cuo hrahring,’ a ta ngiethie. Iema ta, “Aa vuoming tana a cuo aa,” ama ta.
Capa chung bangkhuo ca Piter ca ingchiy kha a cakhaw byalya; ingchiy kya pahaw yi te ama hmung ca ama nang ta a uo thluo.

Piter ta a dieta tah aw riypata a kuv pazupa yi te Khazing ta tuokhaatama thaw-ing taata a papya tapa kha a chang khutaa yi ta, “Hingpa kaw hing Jeim hne zangtuv tie kha chang mya ung,” a ta yi. Cakhutaata pya te a hrang luo a cakuo.
Maw khy a dyi tiyta rieka tie ca Piter cunglie a cuopa kawlie kha amaa taw amaa hrie patlaw ciemuo.

Herod ta pahuv sa yi te ama hmung khu li taata thaw-ing rievetuv tie kha bie hiehriyna a tue khutaa yi ta thie riypata bie a pi yi. Cakhutaata ama ca Judea ruo taa khata Sisaria luo sibung te capa lie ca a aw.

Herod ca Tair ming hne Sidon ming cunglie kha a hi a haa. Caacuonakawta iema ca a phuv ta vya chiy yi te siepahruo ing uvtuv byi Blastas kha amaa ku khutaata siepahruo kha arena tue riypata paa ama kie. Tahematapakieca ama ruo lie sa ning riypa kha siepahruo ruo taata a vawpa a cuo nakawta a cuo.
Ama thli ciepa ningkhue a vya tling tiyta Herod ca a siepahruo cawsie kha a tue te siepahruo thude lie a tu te cawsaazaapuv'a lie kha bie a ri.
Cawsaa zaw ca ta, “khazing ueryi tana a cuo, cawsaa ueryi ta cuo vyi,” ama ta.
Herod ca rungnaana kha Khazing a pi li nakawta Abyipa avuoming ta sungkha ta tuv te alungpa tie ta ce yi te a thiy.
Cuorasala Khazing bie ca lethaw te aa ze hryly.
Barnabas hne Saul ca ama re ama patlung khutaata, Jerusalem luo kha kaa yi te a ming hrang ta Marka ama tapa Johan kha amaa chiyle.

Antiok khrihsaabuv lie kha profet hne pacuvtuv chekha ama aw: Iema ca, Barnabas, Niker ta pata ama kupa Simeon, Sairin khypa Lusias, Uvtuv byi Herod khuvkha viesaa ta a cuopa Manaen hne Saul ta ama cuo.
Sa ning a uv yi te Khazing amaa biena lie kha Thlaapa Pathe ta, “Barnabas hne Saul hing i changpa yi re kha ama hrie the riypata na sangpa pathlyi tie ung,” a ta.
Cakhutaata sa ning a uvna hne thlaachuona ta ama luv cunglie kha ama kuv khang yi te ama pathlie.
Barnabas hne Saul ca Thlaapa Pathe pathliepa ama cuopa haata Seleusia khy luo kha si yi te capa taa cata Saipras luo kha tiypalaw ta ama si.
Salamis luo kha chiy yi te Judah ming apungna-ing chunglie kha Khazing bie ama phu. Iema a byatuv riypata Johan kha amaa chiy.
Parala ruocaapa bangkhuo kha si yi te Pafos khy luo te ama chiy ca pacuo a thepa, Judah profet pakhipa, a ming Bar-Zingsuv ama tapa kha amaa taw.
Ama ca Khazing bie a thyi khing nakawta Barnabas hne Saul a kutuvpa, cawsaa sing ciemuopa, ruo uvtuv byi Sergius Paulus a viesaa ta a cuo.
Pacuo a thepa Elimas (Grik ming) ta ruo uvtuv byi ta Khazing a zang the li riypata Barnabas hne Paul kha a daakhuo yi.
Cuorasala Paul ama tapa Saul ca Thlaapa Pathe ta bi te, ama kha taapuo pata mang te,
“Khachie sacapaa, adangna bangkhuo cariepa, hanghiena hne pha lina ta a bipa, aa dangpa Abyipa bie kha hanghie pata tue riypa hing taw buo'a va ca ma?

Naathlie tie, Abyipa kuv ta nama kha caa du'a te, cuo kha chung na ming cue'a te ningkhepa kha hmung khu'a vaciy,” a ta. Sungkha ta myiching hne zingna ta pahlaw te a kuv ta a ca-yale riypa cawsaa kha pathuole te a huv.
Ruo-uvbyipa ta hmang a cuopa kha a hmung tiyta Khazing kha a zang, tahematapakieca Abyipa kaw ama pacuvpa khata a kharue a pahaa sa.
Cakhutaata Paul hne a viesaa tie ca Pafos taa khata Pamfilia ruo Perga khy luo kha tiypalaw ta ama si. Cadyiseca Johan ca iema kha thuse yi te Jerusalem luo a kaa.
Cuorasala iema ca Perga taa khata Pisidia ruo Antiok luo kha ama pha. Sabbath ning kha apungna-ing luo vaa yi te amaa tu.
Phungbie caa-uv hne profet caa-uv ama ri khutaata apungna-ing uvtuv byipa ta iema kha, “Uvnu zaw pasuna bie nama ri khingpa a aw kieca ri tie ung,” a ta yi.
Caacuonakawta Paul ca a daa te a kuv a pazu khutaata bie ri hruo aa thu: “Israel ming hne Khazing a ciypa a hrangpa tie zaw, i bie hing naathlie tie ung.
Hingpa Israel ming Khazing hingta ma mingchingmingvuo tie kha a tlaw yi te Izipt ruo lie khy ama sa ning kha mingphang lepa ta a tue yi. A cahrapa a kuv ta capa ruo taa cata a pyakhyi yi.
Kung sawliy chung ruocaapa lie kha a mangsang yi.
Kanaan ruo chunglie mingphang phang sariy kha a para khutaa yi ta kung zapaliy sawngaa chung capa ruo ca ru ta a pi yi.
Cakhutaata bieripatuv kha profet Samuel chuo te ta a pi yi.
Cakhutaata siepahruo kha a hie yi te Khazing ta Benjamin mingphang Kish sacapaa Saul kha pi yi te kung sawliy chung siepahruo a cuo.

Ama kha phie te David kha siepahruo a pacuo sa. Ama kawlieta Khazing ta a ripa ca: ‘Kama palung naa hmungpa Jesse sacapaa David kha i hmung tli; tue se ta pata i khingpa bangkhuo kha ama hingna a tue aa,’ a ta.
Hingpa paa ciypathla chung taa hingta Khazing ta bie a za kuo tlipa haa yi khata Israel ming ca khuotuv Zingsuv kha a pi yi.
Zingsuv aa vaw hluo khata, Johan ta Israel ming'a lie kha sue a ngiepachiyna hne aa patuvpa tiy-anawna kaw kha a u khyilu tli.

Johan ca a re a tlung'a nang caw khata, ‘Kama hing ahung ta pata ma ina rue ung ciy? Kama ca nama huo nguoluopa paa khata cuo va ang; cuorasala ama ca kama hnangluo taata a vaw'a te kama ca a phyipakaw riy pathluo riypata hmuo a tla va ang,’ a ta yi.
“I uvnu zaw, Abraham ingchungkhue ciypathla hne a hrangpa Khazing a ciyzaapa zaw, khuona bie ca kiema'a luo pi pata ma cuo tli.

Tahematapakieca Jerusalem lie a awpa tie hne ama uvthyi tie ta ama kha za pachang lipa yi ta sabbath ning kyry ta ama ripa profet tie bie zaw kha a siyluo thyi khu the va yi. Cadyiseca ama ama thiena thue khata profet bie kha ama patling sa.
Thie tluo aa tlapa suena a cunglie ama hmung li thluo pata thie riypata Pilat kha ama hie.
Ama kaw Caapathe lie aa capepa bangkhuo ama tue diy khutaata, vieluo cung taa khata pachung yi te thluo lie ama paby.
Cuorasala Khazing ta thiyna taata pathu te,
ama hneta Galilee taata Jerusalem te khy a tlawhne tawpa tie'a lie kha ning hluvpuv aa luo. Iema ca cawsaa zaw'a lie kha a pachangkhyituv ta ama cuo.
Khazing ta ma mingchingmingvuo tie'a lieta bie a za kuopa yi thuophaa khana ma ca vya phya yi.
Zingsuv kha pathu te kiema a samingsahlaa zaw cunglie hing a patling sa mangtli. Salm hla hningna lieta: ‘Nama ca i sacapaa tana na cuo; ataning hing na paa ta i cuo,’ ta pata aa cape.
Thiyna taata pathu tli te, thuvna luo khatiy tahmuo a kaa li tli riypa kaw kha Khazing ta a ripa ca, ‘David'a lieta a pathepa biekuona i za tuepa khana nama ica pi aa,’ a ta.
Caacuonakawta Salm caa-uv hmang hrang lieta a capepa ca, ‘A pathepa na cawsaapa ca thuvna a taw riypata pahya'a vaciy,’ a ta.
Tahematapakieca David ca ama chuo chunglie Khazing re kha a za hrie ra khutaata thiy te a mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha paby yi te a pangpa ca thluo chunglie kha a thuv.
Cuorasala Khazing ta thiyna taata a pathupa ca thuvna kha a taw va tli.
Caacuonakawta, uvnu zaw, Zingsuv thue hing tana sue angiethena ca niema'a luo phu pata a cuo, tapa kha pachang tie ung.
Capa Zingsuv thue ca tana a zangpa bangkhuo ca Moses phungbie ta hya aca pazang sa khu lipa yi suena taa khata hya nama zang.
Caacuonakawta profet tie ta ama ripa bie kha nama cunglie a tlung li riypata a raaring tie ung:

‘Mang tie ung, niema cawsaa ese a hmuopa tie, Nama nang uo sala thiy tie ung, tahematapakieca niema chuo liena re suokha i hrie, malie ta aca chang zaw yi tahmuo, nama zang buo hluo li riypa re suokha na i hrie,' tapa tana profet tie ta ama ri,” a ta.
Paul hne Barnabas ca ama pyapuolepa khata hmiezaa sabbath ning thueta capa zaw kaw kha ri pakhaa riypata ama hry.

Apungna-ing lie apung ama pachuo taata Judah ming hne Judah biena luo a ngiepa Jentail ming hluvpuv khata Paul hne Barnabas kha ama ziy. Lucuotuv tie ta iema kha bie chang yi te Khazing vihnyina chunglie ama aw pari riypata ama pasu.
Hmiezaa sabbath ning ca Abyipa bie naathlie riypata a khypuv yalya chaa ta amaa hmya.
Cuorasala Judah ming ta cawsaazaapuv amaa hmyapa kha ama hmung tiyta ihnyi yi te Paul ta a ripa kha esena cangta khuosa ta ama i.

Cakhutaata Paul hne Barnabas ca riephasa pata ri yi te, “Niema'a lieta Khazing bie ri taa riypa hing aa hu hringhruo. Cuorasala niema ta khing lipa ung cata chuozaa hringna hne aa phuv pata namaa rue li nakawta, ata hing ca Jentail ming'a luo na maa pali'a tli.

Tahematapakieca Khazing ta bie malie a pipa ca: ‘Niema ca Jentail ming cuota khena cuo riypa tana ica pachi tli yi, caacuonakawta khuona kha chuelyi dena te ta phya tie ung,’ tapa tana a cuo,” ama ta.
Capa bie ca Jentail ming ta ama thyi tiyta ama palung tluosa te Abyipa bie kha pathuosa yi te, chuozaa hringna hmung riypata lieriy uopuopa a hluvpuv kha zangtuv ta ama vya cuo.
Khazing bie ca capa ruo bangkhuo ca ta aa ze.
Cuorasala Judah ming ta Khazing bie luo te a maasapa hne pa-uvsathyi tluo aa tlapa canung tie hne khy uvthyi tie kha pasu yi te Paul hne Barnabas kha hrisaa yi te ama ruo taata ama papya.
Caacuonakawta iema cunglie ama palung tling lina paluosana ta ama phyipazaa lie buvcing kha a cakhawsue siy yi te Ikonium luo kha ama si.
Ziytuv tie ca palungtluona hne Thlaapa Pathe ta ama bi.
Cahaa ngiethie cata Paul hne Barnabas ca Ikonium khy Judah ming apungna-ing luo kha vaa yi te ama ri tawpa haa khata ama ri ca Judah ming hne Grik ming hluvpuv kha zangtuv ta ama vya cuo.
Cuorasala a zang lipa Judah ming ta Jentail ming kha pasu yi te zangtuv tie kha ama padu sa.

Caacuonakawta lucuotuv tie ca capa lie ca cuo pasiypuv aw yi te Abyipa bie kha riephasa pata ama ri. Abyipa ta a vihnyina bie ama ripa pacusana ta pahmungsana hne kharuehaa hmang tue khuna kha a pi yi.
Cuorasala capa khypuv lie a awpa tie ca a che yi te, Judah ming kuo luo phuv kha, lucuotuv tie kuo luo phuv kha ta ama aw.
Cakhutaata Jentail ming hne Judah ming ta iema uvtuv tie hne khata lucuotuv tie kha hrisaa riypa hne alung ta vaa riypata ama ting.
Lucuotuv tie ta capa kaw ca ama pachang tiyta Likaonia ruo khypuv ta a cuopa tie Listra khy, Derbe khy hne a cahriy khyta luo kha amaa ruo.
Capa lie ca thuophaa phu kha ama pazue.
Aa puvkhyipa ta a phyi a cabie nakawta luo a cakuo buo lipa paa pakha ca Listra khy lie kha aw te,
Paul ta a ripa bie kha naa a thlie. Paul ta tluo khuna riypa zangna na a hnyi tapa kha a hmung tiyta ama kha taapuo pata mang te,
ueryi paringsa pata, “Na phyi ta aa dangta tah a daa tie,” a ta. Cawsaapa ca a kya daa te luo a cakuo.
Paul ta a tuepa kha cawsaazaapuv ta ama hmung tiyta, Likaonian ryi ta khuopuv ta khi yi te, “Khazing tie na cawsaa hmingsuo ta a zaa cung yi,” ama ta.
Barnabas kha Zeus khazing tana a cuo ta yi te Paul kha bie a rituv a cuo nakawta Hermes khazing tana a cuo ama ta.
Khy khungthing lie a biena-ing a awpa Zeus khazing tluobyipa ta cuetungpa hne paapaapa pachiy kha khy hukaa luo vya cyi te cawsaazaapuv hne khata iema kha hriykhungrina ta abie amaa nang.
Lucuotuv Barnabas hne Paul ta capa kaw ca ama thyi tiyta ama caw kha thlaa yi te, cawsaazaapuv hraw luo kha a ruo yi te,

“Viesaa zaw, khaapanakawma hingpa hing nama tue? Kiema zaw niema haata cawsaa cakhawpa tana ma cuo. Thuophaa kha ca vya phya yi pate hingpa thlahnena a hnyi lipa hmang taa hingta alyi hne avuo, riyliy hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo a satuv a hringpa Khazing'a luo namaa pali riypata caa changtuv tana ma cuo.
Hluo ning ca Khazing ta mingphang bangkhuo kha ama khingpa luo ziy riypata luo a pa-aw yi.
Cuorasala a tuepa hmang phapa khata ama a awpa kha a paluo sa pari: avuo taata khy pasaa sa te ama'a na a cuo ta kung a pavyi sa, sa ca pi yi te nama palung aca patluo yi,” ta pata khuosa ta ama u.
Hing tluv bie ama ri pata hmuo hriykhungrina ta abie amaa nangpa kha ama thlu khu sungsiyta khiy tana a cuo.

Cuorasala Antiok taa hne Ikonium taata Judah ming kha a vaw yi te cawsaazaapuv kha iema kuo luo a daa riypata ama ripasa khu. Cakhutaata Paul kha alung ta vaa yi te a thiy tli ta pata ama rue nakawta khyle luo kha amaa dale.
Cuorasala ziytuv tie ta ama cadung nguoluo ning kha Paul ca kya thu te khypuv chung luo kha a vaa pakhaa. A mawluopa ta Barnabas hneta Derbe luo ama si.
Paul hne Barnabas ca capa khy lie ca thuophaa kha phu yi te ziytuv a hluvsa ama hmung. Cakhutaa cata Listra, Ikonium hne Antiok luo kha ama vya kaa.
Ziytuv tie kha zangna aa hmuopa chunglie a cusa pata ama aw riypata pasu yi te, “Khazing pena chung luo a ngie riypata ca hrisaana a hluvsa maa taw riypa tana a cuo,” ta pata thaazuo ama pi.
Khrihsaabuv cyicuo lie kha khrihsaa uvthyi tie ama chi khutaata ama zangpa Abyipa'a luo kha sa-uvna hne thlaachuona ta ama pi.
Cakhutaata Pisidia ruo kha cahrawpaa yi te Pamfilia ruo luo ama si.
Perga lieta thuophaa ama ri khutaata Attalia luo ama sibung.
Capa hmang taa cata Antiok luo kha tiypalaw ta ama kaa. Capa khy ca Khazing vihnyina ta a za changpa yi ama za palangpa re, hrie riypa hingta amaa zaa pinapa hmang kha tana a cuo.

Capa khy luo ama chiy pahne ta zangtuv tie kha pahmya yi te Khazing ta iema hmuo pata a hriepa bangkhuo hne tuokhaatama Khazing ta Jentail ming cuota zangna chiypakaa a pahawpa ra yi tapa kaw kha ama chang.
Capa lie ca zangtuv tie hne cuo pasiypuv ama aw pakhaw.
Judea taata cawsaa chekha ca Antiok luo a zuv yi te, “Moses phungbie haata vangdaw namaa te li kieca khuona hmung khu'a va ung ciy,” ta pata zangtuv uvnu zaw kha ama pacuv.

Capa pacuvna ca Paul hne Barnabas ta khuopuv ta ama i. Caacuonakawta Paul hne Barnabas, hne zangtuv chekha kha a tlaw yi te capa kaw ca lucuotuv tie hne khrihsaa uvthyi tie hneta a rue pakhaw riypata Jerusalem luo ama pathlie.
