Amaa tha ning kha khrihsaabuv ta pathlie yi te Fonisia hne Samaria ruo kha capiepaa yi te ama si. Jentail ming ta Khazing ama vya zangna kaw kha pathyisale yi te capa thuohlaa ca ta zangtuv zaw kha khuopuv ta ama palung a patluo yi.
Jerusalem luo ama chiy tiyta Khrihsaabuv hne lucuotuv tie, hne khrihsaa uvthyi tie ta alawna hneta cuhluo yi te iema'a lie ca Khazing rehriena kha a tlingsa pata ama pathyi sa.
Cuorasala Farasi phuv ta a cuopa zangtuv chekha a daa yi te, “Iema cuo hingta ca vangdaw a te riypa hne Moses phungbie ama ziy riypa ca aa hu hrahring,” ta pata ama ri.
Hingpa bie ri pakhaw riypata lucuotuv tie hne khrihsaa uvthyi tie ca amaa hmya.

A pasiypuv amaa i khutaata Piter kha a daa te, “Uvnu zaw, nama pachangna haata, Jentail ming ta thuophaa kha thyi yi te ama zang khuna riypata, iema'a luo capa thuophaa chang riypa cata a hluo vie taa khata Khazing ta kama hing niema hraw taata i naa tlaw.
Cawsaa pathiypalung a pachangtuv Khazing ta kiema'a lie a tuepa haa khata iema kha Thlaapa Pathe pi yi te tehte a khuo yi.
Zangna ta ama pathiypalung kha pathe sa te iema hne kiema alalalie kha pahlyipalena tue vyi.
Caacuonakawta khaapanakawma ma mingchingmingvuo tie zaw ta cuose, kiema ta cuose, ma phya khu lipa hmangriypa ca ziytuv tie ruetung lie khang ung cate Khazing kha dyapasya nama khing?
Cuo vyi, Zingsuv Khrih vihnyina tana khuona ma hmung aa ta pata ma zangpa haa hingta muo iema zaw ama cuo ra'a ta,” a ta.
Barnabas hne Paul ta, Khazing ta iema hmuo pata Jentail ming'a lie a tuepa pahmungsana hne kharuehaa hmang kaw ama ripa kha naathlie yi te aa hmyapa bangkhuo ca duokaring khata ama aw.
Bieri ama patlung khutaata Jeim ta, “I uvnu zaw, na naathlie tie ung.
Simon ta, Jentail ming kha Khazing ta kha tluv ta kawpacuo yi te ma iema hraw taata cawsaa chekha kha ama ming riypata aa tlaw yi tapa kha malie a chang pasie tli.
Capa bie ca profet tie bie hne khata aa chiyhne. Caapathe ta,
‘Hingpa khu taa hingta vya kaa pakhaa angte, aa lie ciepa David ing kha i sa pakhaa aa; a rana taa khata sa pakhaa'a angte, i padaa pakhaa aa.
Caacuonakawta mingphang hrangpa bangkhuo ta Abyipa kha huv'a yi te, Jentail ming bangkhuo zaw ta i ming kha ina u'a yi.
Hluo ning taata hingpa hmang hing tue te a pachangtuv, Abyipa na a ri,’ a ta.
Caacuonakawta kama i biechina ca, Khazing'a luo a vya maapa Jentail ming hing ruvna pi khah ung siy,

cuorasala caa paphya ung sala, kuvtuezuv ta a papya a palyipa tie kha cahriy riypa, aparuvsuena tue li riypa, hne a rue cadie pata ama thiepa saa hne thiy bangkhuo kha cahriy riypata chang hriy ung siy.
Tahematapakieca khypuv ting lie kha kung pasiypuv chung, Moses phungbie kha Sabbath ning kyry ta apungna-ing lie za ri pata a cuo tli,” a ta.

Cakhutaata lucuotuv tie, khrihsaa uvthyi tie hne Khrihsaabuv yalya palungtlingna ta iema hraw taata cawsaa a tlaw pata Barnabas hne Paul hneta Antiok luo pathlie riypa kha ama palung a tling. Iema hrawlie luochiytuv ta a cuopa Barsabbas ama tapa Judas hne Silas kha a tlaw yi te,

a raw luo caa hing ama paphya: “Kiema lucuotuv tie hne khrihsaa uvthyi tie, nama uvnu tie ta Antiok, Siria hne Silisia lieta a awpa Jentail ming zangtuv uvnu bangkhuo'a luo bie-achangna caa maca paphya yi.
Kiema hraw taata cawsaa chekha ta, kiema naw pina aw li pata nama palung rie thyi riypa hne nama palung chachiychaba riypa bie niema'a lie ama ripa kha ma thyi.
Caacuonakawta, zaapuv palung tling pata cawsaa kha a tlaw pate, Barnabas'a nata Paul hneta niema'a luo pathlie riypata bie ma chi.
Iema pahning hing Zingsuv Khrih cuota ama hringna pinguona te ta re a hrietuv ma duepa tana ama cuo.
Judas hne Silas kha niema'a luo pathlie pata cuo yi te iema palyipakaa hrahring ta capa bie ca aca chang'a yi.
Thlaapa Pathe hne kiema ta a raw luo aa husapa ziy riypa khu taa hingta a hrangpa hmangriypa nama cunglie khang riypata khing vapuv.

Namaa cadang riypa ca: Kuvtuezuv amaa bienapa saa ce li riypa; saathiy ning li riypa; a rue cadie pata thiepa saa ce li riypa; aparuvsuena tue li riypa zaw khata a cuo. Capa bangkhuo taa cata namaa ve khu kieca hmang phapa ta a cuo aa. Nama tluo pata,” ama ta.
Caacuonakawta iema ca pathlie yi te Antiok luo ca ama si. Zangtuv bangkhuo kha pahmya yi te caa ca ama pi.
Caa ca ama ri tiyta thaazuo ama pipa cunglie ama palung a tluo laalaw.
Profet ta a cuopa Judas hne Silas zaw ta zangtuv tie kha khuosa ta pasu yi te thaazuo ama pi.
Cuo pasiypuv ama aw khutaata zangtuv tie ta a pathlietuv tie'a luo kha diena hneta ama pathlie pakhaa.
(Cuorasala Silas ca capa lie ca aa ngaa siy.)
Cuorasala Paul hne Barnabas ca Antiok lie kha a ngaa yi te cawsaa hrangpa hluvpuv hneta Abyipa bie kha pacuv yi te ama chang.
Cakhutaata a ru li pata, Paul ta Barnabas kha, “Kaa sala, Abyipa bie ma za phu cienapa khy bangkhuo lieta zangtuv tie kha tlawle yi sala, khaapama ama lu tapa kha mangle yi siy,” a ta.
Barnabas ta Marka tapa Johan kha iema'a lie a chiylepa a khing.
Cuorasala Paul ta, Pamfilia lieta iema kha za thuse yi te iema hne re a hrie hne li tlipa paa kha a chiyle riypata khing vyi.
Khuopuv ta a ipuo yi te iema zaw amaa che. Barnabas ta Marka kha a la te Saipras luo kha tiypalaw ta ama si.
Cuorasala Paul ta Silas kha a tlaw te zangtuv tie ta Abyipa vihnyina chung luo pihluona ama hnyipa khutaata ama si.
Siria hne Silisia ruo kha cahraw yi te khrihsaabuv kha thaazuo ama pi.

Paul ca Derbe khy hne Listra khy luo kha a va chiy. Capa lie ca Khrihsaa a cuopa, a ming Timote ama tapa kha a aw. A nung ca Judah ming, zangtuv pakha ta cuo te, cuorasala a paa ca Grik ming ta a cuo.
Listra hne Ikonium lie a awpa zangtuv tie ta ama ca a thuophaa ama risapa ta a cuo.
Paul ta Timote ca aa chiyle khing nakawta a vangdaw a pate sa, tahematapakieca a paa ca Grik ming a cuopa kha capa lie a awpa Judah ming khata ama pachang.
Khy kha hnang khy kha ta tlawle yi te, Jerusalem lie a awpa lucuotuv tie hne khrihsaa uvthyi tie ta ama za chi ciepa phung kha ziy riypata iema kha ama changle.
Caacuonakawta khrihsaabuv ca zangna lie kya cahra vie hryly yi te ning kha hnang ning kha mingluv zaw ama hluv hryly.
Asia ruo chunglie kha a bie ri riypata Thlaapa Pathe ta a thlu nakaw yi ta Frizia ruo hne Galatia ruo chung kha khy ama tlaw.
Misia ruoriy ama phapa khata Bithinia ruo chung luo kha a ngie amaa ting. Cuorasala Zingsuv Thlaapa ta pa-aw va yi.
Caacuonakawta Troas luo kha ama sibung.
Zuo ta Paul ca muocuo a hmung: Masidonia cawsaa pakha a daa te ama kha “Masidonia luo a vaw la malie a vya bya tie,” a ta.
Paul ta muocuo a hmung khutaata Masidonia luo si riypa kha maa pachie paluo, tahematapakieca Khazing na iema'a luo thuophaa phu riypata malie a ku tapa kha ma pachangpasie.
Troas taata tiypalaw ta a tha pate Samothrasia luo kha a dangsa pata ma si. A mawluopa ta Neapolis luo ma chiy.
Capa taa cata Rom uvna ruo chung, Masidonia pe chunglieta khypuv ta a cuopa Filipi khy luo ma chiy. Capa khy lie ca ningcuo pasiypuv ma aw.
Sabbath ning ca khy chung taa khata pya pate cavaa kie luo ma cakuo. Capa lie ca thlaachuona hmang a aw thlu aa ta pata ma rue. A tu pate capa lie a hmyapa canung zaw hne cata bie ma ri.

Lidia ama ta nung, Khazing abiepa pakha ca ma bie kha a naathlie ra. Ama ca Thiatira khy ming ta cuo te caw ciycaapa a zaanung ta a cuo. Paul ta a ripa bie kha hmisi ta naathlie riypata Abyipa ta a pathiypalung a pahaw nung tana a cuo.

Ama hne a ingchungkhue tie tiy amaa naw khutaata, Lidia ta, “Abyipa a zang hrahring ta pata ina ruepa ung cata a cuo kieca, a vaw ung la i ing luo kha a vya pahy tie ung,” ta pata kiema kha khuosa ta paa malie a kie.
Ning kha ca thlaachuona hmang luo ma vaa pata hmungdawluna thlaapa a hnyipa siicanung lesaa pakha hneta maa taw. Hmieluo kaw a ri lu khunapa khata a ziy tie kha tuokaa a hluvsa a hmungpa yi.
Paul hne kiema malie a vya ziypuole pata, “Hing cawsaa zaw hing Cungnungce Khazing sii, khuona bie niema'a luo a phutuv tie tana ama cuo,” a ta.
Ning hluvpuv cahaacata a ta. Cuorasala Paul ta chaw khu li tli pata thlaapa kha a palihnue te, “Hingpa nung chung taa hingta pya riypa tana bie ica pi,” a ta. A ta khu pahne ta thlaapa ca a pya.
Ama a hnyituvpa tie ta ma tuokaa hmungnapa na a ra tli tapa kha ama hmung tiyta Paul hne Silas kha patuv yi te chadawtluo luo, nawhnyituv tie hmiekung luo kha amaa dale.
Bieripatuv byi zaw hmiekung luo kha chiykhyi yi te, “Hingpa cawsaa zaw hing Judah ming ta cuo yi te, ma khypuv chunglie hnaahnawna a chiykhyituv tana ama cuo,
kiema Rom ming ta maa paw khu li riypa hne ma ziy khu li riypa, phung kha ri yi te a daakhyipa tana ama cuo,” ama ta.
Cawsaazaapuv ca Paul hne Silas a duna kuo luo khata ama aw diy. Bieripatuv byi tie khata ama caw thlie pata asung ta tuv riypata naw ama pi.
Khuopuv ta ama tuv khutaata, thaw pathla yi te, thaw-ing byipa kha a phata tah pahuo sa riypata naw ama pi.
Naw ama pipa haa khata thaw-ing aa thuv cena khuo chunglie kha chi yi te ama phyi kha hrakyi ama khe.
Zuocang hraw ta ca Paul hne Silas ta thlaachuona hne hlaasana ta Khazing kha pathuosa yi te thaw a tlapa tie ca ta ama naathlie.
Sungkhapuv ta aling khuosa ta a siy te thaw-ing ca a thabaw te ta aa cahang; chiypakaa bangkhuo a pahaw te thaw a tlapa tie thaabuoliriy bangkhuo kha ama kuv taata aa pathluo diy.
Thaw-ing byipa ca a kya cha te thaw-ing chiypakaa bangkhuo aa pahawpa kha a hmung tiyta thaw a tlapa tie na a ruo diy tli yi ta pata a rue nakawta a zueziy kha a da te ama hne ama kha a thie aa nang.
Cuorasala Paul ca khuopuv ta khi te, “Nama hne nama kha ruvnaana a pi khah, ma bangkhuo ta ma aw diy tli hing,” a ta.
Thaw-ing byipa ca ta, myi vya cyi ung la ta yi te, thaw-ing chung luo kha a ruo te, a cathangsapuo pata Paul hne Silas phyi thabaw lie kha a vaa bu.
Cakhutaata ale luo pyakhyi yi te, “I byipaa zaw, khuopa i cuo riypata khaapama i tue aa? a ta yi.
Iema ta, “Abyipa Zingsuv kha zang la nama hne na ingchungkhue hneta khuopa nama cuo aa,” ama ta.
Abyipa bie ca ama hne a ing chunglie a awpa bangkhuo kha ama chang.
Capa zuo, capa cuo lie ca ta ama hmaa kha pasiypa yi te cakhutaata ama hne a ingchungkhue bangkhuo ta tiy amaa naw paluo.
Iema kha ing luo a chiy yi te sa a pi yi. Ama ta Khazing kha a zang nakawta ama hne a ingchungkhue bangkhuo ta ama palung a tluo hringhruo.
A mawluopa ta bieripatuv byi tie khata paliy tie kha vya pathlie yi te, “Khapa cawsaa tie kha za pathlie yi se,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata thaw-ing byipa ta Paul kha chang te, “Bieripatuv byi tie na niema kha pathlie riypata bie naa vya taa yi, caacuonakawta kya pya ung la diena hne cakuo tie ung,” a ta yi.

Cuorasala Paul ta palie te, “Kiema Rom cawsaa a cuopa kha bie ripa li pata zaapuv hmielie asung ta malie tuv yi te thaw malie ama pathla. Cakhutaata ata ca a paruvta tah pathlie malie amaa nang. Cahaacata cuo the'a vyi! Iema hrahring a vaw yi sala malie vya papya yi se,” a ta.
Paliy tie ta capa bie ca bieripatuv byi tie kha va chang yi te, Rom ming tana ma cuo ama tapa kha ama thyi tiyta ama thlaa a zang.
Caacuonakawta a vaw yi te paa ama vya kie. Thaw-ing taa khata papya yi te ama khypuv kha pyase riypata ama chang.
Caacuonakawta thaw-ing taa khata pya yi te Lydia ing luo kha ama vaa. Capa lie ca uvnu hne sieta zaw hne khata a taw yi te thaazuo ama pi khutaata capa khy taa cata ama pya.
Paul hne Silas ca Amfipolis khy hne Apollonia khy kha vya capiepaa yi te Thesalonika khy luo kha ama pha. Capa lie ca Judah ming apungna-ing kha a aw.
Paul ca a tue tawpa haa khata apungna-ing luo ca vaa te Sabbath ning ning thung chung bangkhuo iema hne khata Caapathe bie lie'apa kha amaa i.
Messiah ta ruvnaana a ang riypa hne thiy te a thu pakhaa hrahring aa hunapa kaw kha ri pasie te a paluo sa. “Kama ta ica chang nguoluopa yi hing capa Messiah, Zingsuv ca tana a cuo,” a ta yi.
Chekha ca ama palung sie te Paul hne Silas kha amaa hlaw, cahaacata Khazing a biepa Grik ming hluvpuv hne canung uvthyi hluvpuv zaw ta amaa vya hlaw ra.

Cuorasala Judah ming ta ihnyi yi te chadawtluo lie a khie cakhawpa zyazaa pha lipa tie kha pahmya yi te ama pakhipa-u sa nakawta khy chunglie kha hnaahnawna a puv. Paul hne Silas kha patuv pata zaapuv hmieluo chiykhyi riypata Jason ing kha ama va ching.
Iema kha ama hmung li taata Jason hne zangtuv chekha kha khypuv uvthyi tie'a luo kha a vya dale yi te, “Chuelyi a pali a pathipa hingpa cawsaa zaw hing hingpa hmang luo hing vya chiy yi te,
Jason ta a ing lie aa patlung sa yi. Siepahruo hrangpa Zingsuv ama tapa na a aw ta yi te Rom siepahruo nawhnyina kha amaa du,” ama ta.
Capa ca ama thyi tiyta khypuv uvtuv byi tie hne cawsaa zaw ca ama palung aa taw aa muosa.
Jason hne a hrangpa tie'a taata biekuona tuokaa ama la khutaata ama pathlie.
Capa zuo lie hrahring ca ta zangtuv tie ta Paul hne Silas kha Berea luo ama pasi sa. Ama chiy tiyta Judah ming apungna-ing luo kha ama cakuo.

Berea khy lie Judah ming ca Thesalonika khy ming laa khata bie cuhluo ama the vie; caacuonakawta bie kha palung thusa pata naathlie yi te a cuo ma cuo va ma tapa kha che the riypata ningting ta Caapathe kha ama mang.
Iema hraw taata cawsaa hluvpuv kha vya zang yi te pa-uvsathyi tluo aa tlapa Grik ming canung capaa a hluvpuv zaw ama vya zang ra.
Cuorasala Thesalonika lie a awpa Judah ming ta Paul na Berea lie Khazing bie a phu tapa kha ama thyi tiyta a vaw yi te cawsaazaapuv kha hnaahnawna tue riypata ama pasu.
Zangtuv tie ta sungkha ta Paul kha riyliy kie luo pathlie yi te Silas hne Timote ca amaa ngaa siy.
Paul a pathliepa tie ca Athens te kha va chiy ra yi te, Silas hne Timote ta ama ama vaa hlaw paluo riypa kha bie a taa khutaa yi ta ama kaa.
Paul ca Athens taata Silas hne Timote a huo nguoluo ning yi kha capa khy ca kuvtuezuv ta a bipa kha hmung te a palung rie a thyikhyisa.
Caacuonakawta apungna-ing lie cuose, chadawtluo lie zaw kha cuose, Judah ming'a nata Khazing a zangpa cawsaa tie hne khata a ning tating ta bie amaa i pari.

Epikurian pacuvtuv chekha hne Stoik pacuvtuv chekha zaw hne khata amaa i. Chekha ta “Hingpa a pasingsa te a khi cakhawpa paa hing khaapama a ri khing?” ama ta. A hrangpa tie ta, “Ruohrang ming khazing kaw a ripa tana a cuo thlu aa?” ama ta. (Cahaacata ama tapa ca Zingsuv hne a thupakhaana kaw thuophaa kha a ri nakaw tana a cuo.)
Caacuonakawta ama kha Areopagas ama tapa ahmyana hmang luo chiykhyi yi te, “Na ri nguoluopa pacuvna thaapa kaw hingna ma pachang khing.
Kiema cuota biethaapa cuo te a ri khingna hingna ma pachang khing,” ama ta.
Athens khy ming hne capa lie a awpa ruohrang ming ca ama cuo hnyipa bangkhuo kha biethaapa a changna hne naathliena ta ama hmuo diy.
Cakhutaata Paul ca Areopagas lie a vya hmyapa tie hmiekunglie kha a daa te, “Athens khy ming, kha tluv tama biena luota te nama maa tapa kha ica pachang yi.

Khychung lie kha a khie angte nama bienapa hmang kha i hmung tiyta, capa hraw taa cata, ‘Ma pachang lipa khazing cuota,’ ta pata caa aa capepa bienatluophie kha i hmung. Kama ta niema'a lie i phupa hing capa nama pachang li pata namaa biepa kaw ca tana a cuo.
Chuelyi hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo a satuv Khazing, alyi hne vuoruo Byi, cawsaa kuv ta sapa abiena hmang chunglie a aw lipa tana a cuo.
Khazing ca a hringpa bangkhuo kha hringna hne huv hne zezaw bangkhuo kha a pituv cuo te, cawsaa ta a cuota tuepa riypa kha aa hupa suokha hmuo aw vyi.
Cawsaa pakha chungtaata mingphang bangkhuo kha sa te alyi lie kha khy a pasa sa yi. Khacuo ma ama hring aa tapa hne ama awna riypa ruoriy zaw kha a thlipa pacie yi.
Tahematapakieca iema ta Khazing kha huv'a yi te ama hmung thena riypa tana a cuo. Cadyiseca Khazing ca kiema pakha cyicuo hne hingta a hla vyi.
‘Ama chunglie ma hring, cakuocavaa pate khy ma sa,’ ama tapa haata hne hlaa a phy thepa tie ta, ‘Kiema zaw hing ama samingsahlaa tana ma cuo,’ ama tapa haa kha tana a cuo.
Cahaacata kiema ca Khazing samingsahlaa ma cuo nakawta, a hringpa Khazing hing cawsaa kuvzung ta tuepa siy acuolikie, ngu acuolikie, alung kuvtuezuv haata ri riypata cuo vyi.
Khazing ta, cawsaa ta ama za pachang the lina cuo kha a hmung li hruo aa cuo raalaa pata, ata hing ca cawsaa bangkhuo kha ama hringna pha lipa bangkhuo taata a ngiepachiy riypata bie a pi yi.

Tahematapakieca aa tlaw ciepa paa thueta chuelyi hing adangna ta bie ripa riypata ning a thli pacie tli. Cawsaa bangkhuo ta hingpa hmang hing a cuo tapa ama pachang riypata ama kha thiyna taata a pathu sa,” a ta.
A thiypa thupakhaana kaw kha ama thyi tiyta, chekha ta ama pahnyisue; cuorasala chekha ta, “Hingpa kaw hing ma naathlie pakhaa khing,” ama ta.
Capa lie ca ta Paul ta a pyase yi.
Cuorasala chekha ta ama kha vaa hlaw yi te zangtuv ama vya cuo. Iema'a lie ca Areopagas ming Dionisias hne Damaris ama tapa canung pakha hne a hrangpa zaw ama aw ra.
Cakhutaata Paul ca Athens khy taa khata pya te Korin luo a si.

Capa lie ca Pontas ruo lie a puvpa, a ming Akuila ama tapa Judah ming pakha kha a napuvnung Prisilla hneta a va hmung yi. Iema ca siepahruo Kalaudias ta Judah ming bangkhuo Rom taata a papya nakaw yi ta Italy taata a vya chiy thaapa ta ama cuo.
Paul ta vaa taw yi te, ama haata pangthluodaa bie pata a riy a cawpa ama cuo ra nakawta iema'a lie kha aw te re ama hrie pakhaw.
Sabbath ning kyry ta Judah ming hne Grik ming kha ama palung a sie the riypata apungna-ing lie kha bie a rue yi te a changpasie yi.
Silas hne Timote kha Masidonia taata ama vya chiy tiyta, Paul ca a cuo bangkhuo kha Khazing bie phuna ta hmuo diy te, Judah ming kha, Zingsuv ca Messiah tana a cuo ta pata tehte a khuo yi.

Judah ming ta ama kha a du yi te ama hue tiyta, a palung tling lina paluosana ta a caw lie buvcing kha thysue siy yi te, “Nama thiyse ca niema luv cunglie tla mang sue! Kama ca i pathe. Ata taa hingta ca Jentail ming'a luo na i cakuo'a tli,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata apungna-ing taa khata pya te Khazing abiepa Titius Justas ama tapa paa ing luo kha a cakuo. Capa paa ing ca apungna-ing a vya paziypa khata a cuo.
Apungna-ing uvtuv byi a cuopa Krispas ca aa chungkhue yalya ta Abyipa kha ama zang; cakhutaata Paul ta a ripa bie a thyipa Korin ming a hluvpuv zaw ta zang yi te tiy amaa naw.
Zuo kha ca Paul ta muocuo hmung te, Abyipa ta, “Ciy khah, duo lie ciy, ri lawmaw tie;
ca awpuo angte, nama kha ruvnaana pi riypata ahungtahmuo na cunglie a kuv pathlie'a vyi, tahematapakieca hing khypuv chunglie hing i cawsaa na a hluvsa a aw yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Paul ca capa lie ca kung kha thla caruv aw te iema kha Khazing bie a pacuv yi.
Cuorasala Gallio ca Akhaia ruo uvtuv a cuo tiyta, Judah ming ta Paul kha a du yi te bieripana zung luo ama chiykhyi.
Iema ta, “Hingpa paa hingna cawsaa kha ma phung haata cuo li pata Khazing abie riypata a chang pari yi,” ama ta.

Paul ta bie a vya ri'a nangpa khata Gallio ta Judah ming kha, “Suena kawlie hne hmang pha lipa tuena kawlieta a cuo kieca zung luo nama vya chiykhyipa bie hing ca cuhluo'a yi angte a phata tah i rue a hu aa.
Cuorasala ata'apa hmang hing ca biesuo kaw, ming kaw hne niema phungluo kaw zaw ta a cuo nakawta niemata tah vaa ri tie ung; hingpa hmang kawlieta ca bieripatuv cuo khu va ang,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata zung chung taa cata a papya yi.
Cadyiseca iema bangkhuo khata apungna-ing uvtuv Sosthenes kha patuv yi te zung hmielie kha ama tuv. Cuorasala Gallio ta khapa zaw kha siysaa hetahmuo ripa va yi.

Paul ca Korin lie cuo pasiypuv a aw khutaata, zangtuv tie kha bie a chang yi te Prisilla'a nata Akuila hne khata tiypalaw ta Siria luo ama si. Tiypalaw ta ama si hluo khata Kenkhria khy lie kha biekuona a tue nakawta a suo aa ngu.
Efesa luo ama chiy tiyta iema kha thuse yi te apungna-ing luo kha vaa te Judah ming hneta bie amaa rue.
Iema ta a pasiy vie aw caw riypata ama thlu tiyta bie nesa pata a bu yi;
cuorasala aa thu'a nang caw ta, “Khazing khingna a aw kieca niema'a luo i vya kaa pakhaa aa,” a ta yi. Cakhutaa cata Efesa taa khata tiypalaw ta a pya.
Sisaria luo a pha tiyta Jerusalem luo kha khaw te khrihsaabuv kha bie aa kya chang yi. Cakhutaata Antiok luo kha a si.
Capa lie ca cuo pasiypuv a aw khutaata Galatia hne Frizia ruo kha suv kha hnang suv kha ta tlawle yi te a ziytuv bangkhuo kha thaazuo a pile yi.
Capa ning ca Alexandria khy lie a puvpa Judah ming, Apollo ama tapa paa ca Efesa khy luo kha aa vaw. Ama ca bie ri a thepa hne Caapathe kha a phata tah a pachangpa ta a cuo;
Abyipa Phungluo kaw kha pathiypalung hmisi ta hne a cuona dadang haata a pacuv yi. Cuorasala Johan tiynawna kaw dyi kha a pachang.
Apungna-ing lie kha riepha ciemuo pata ri te, cuorasala Prisilla hne Akuila ta ama thyi tiyta ama kha cakuokhyi yi te Khazing Phungluo kaw kha a cuona haata ama chang.

Apollo ca Akhaia ruo luo si kha aa ting tiyta zangtuv tie ta thaazuo pi yi te a phasa pata ama cuhluo riypata ziytuv tie'a luo kha caa ama cape. A va chiy tiyta Khazing vihnyina thueta zangtuv a cuopa tie kha khuopuv ta aa bya yi.
Tahematapakieca zaapuv hmielie bie a ina lieta Judah ming ama richienapa kha khuopuv ta paluo sa te, Zingsuv ca Messiah tana a cuo tapa kha Caapathe chungtaata a pahmung sa yi.
Apollo kha Korin lie a aw ningta Paul ca capa ruo chung kha cahraw pata khy tlaw te Efesa luo a chiy. Capa lie ca zangtuv chekha kha va hmung yi te,
“Zangtuv nama vya cuo ning khata, Thlaapa Pathe nama ting tli ma?” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Ting vapuv, Thlaapa Pathe a aw tapa hmuo thyi buo vapuv,” ama ta.
Cakhutaa cata ama ta, “Caacuokieca, tuokhaapa tiynawna ma nama ang?” a ta yi. Iema ta, “Johan tiynawna,” ama ta.
Paul ta, “Johan tiynawna ca sue a ngiepachiynapa tiynawna tana a cuo. Ama hnang taata a vaw riypa paa Zingsuv ama zang riypa tana cawsaa kha a chang yi,” a ta.
Capa ca ama thyi tiyta Zingsuv ming ta tiy amaa naw.
Paul ta ama cunglie a kuv a khang tiyta, iema cung luo kha Thlaapa Pathe tlung te, ryiphanghrangpa kha cyi yi te profetbiephu zaw kha ama ri.
Iema ca ama bangkhuo ta hlyihning hraw ama ta.
Paul ca apungna-ing luo kha a ngie te Khazing pena kaw kha riephasa pata hne cawsaa ta ama thyi thesa riypata thla thung chung a ri.

Cawsaa chekha ca ama palung pangsa te, zang khu lipa yi ta Phungluo kha cawsaa hmiekunglie ama rithuochi. Caacuonakaw Paul ta pyase yi te, a ziytuv tie kha a chiyle yi te Tirannas bierina ing tapa chunglie kha ningting ta a pacuv yi.
Cahaacata kung hning chung pazue te Asia ruo chunglie a awpa Judah ming hne Grik ming bangkhuo ca Abyipa bie kha ama thyi diy.
Khazing ta ning hrang a aw buo lipa kharuehaa hmang kha Paul kuv ta a tue.
A pavya hne a ruepaze kha hmuota a tluo lipa tie'a luo ama cyile tiyta, tluo yi te thlaapa chiepa kha ama chungtaata a pya.
Hmangting ta a khielepa khuevuo papyatuv tie Judah ming khata thlaapa chiepa a hnyipa tie cunglie kha Abyipa Zingsuv ming kha hmuo yi te, “Paul ta a ukhyipa Zingsuv ming tana ica papya,” ama ta
Judah ming tluobyi lepa Skeva sacapaa pasariy tie ta capa ca ama tue.
Cuorasala thlaapa chiepa ta, “Zingsuv i pachang, Paul zaw i pachang; cuorasala niema hing ahung zaw tama nama cuo?” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata thlaapa chiepa a hnyipa paa ca ta a vya zuchiy yi te tuv yi te a te nakaw yi ta ama thiy ama hnie hne ama thliehripa ta ing taata amaa ruo.
Capa bie ca Efesa lie a awpa Judah ming hne Grik ming bangkhuo ta ama thyi tiyta, ciysa yi te Abyipa Zingsuv ming kha ama pathuosa.
Zangtuv a vya cuopa a hluvpuv zaw khata ama za tue tawpa kha zaapuv hmielie ama phu.
Pacuo a thepa tie zaw ta ama caa-uv kha pakhaw yi te zaapuv hmielie myi ta ama rue. Capa caa-uv muo ca ama tue tiyta ngu tuokaa thaw sawngaa muo a ta.
Cahaacata Abyipa bie ca cahrana hne aa ze hryly.

Capa hmang bangkhuo a cuo khutaata, Paul ca Masidonia ruo hne Akhaia ruo kha cahrawpaale pata Jerusalem luo tlaw riypa aa ting. Ama ta, “Capa luo i chiy khutaata Rom zaw i hmung hrahring aa hu,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta ama a byatuv a cuopa Timote hne Erastas kha Masidonia luo pathlie yi te ama ca Asia ruo lie kha cuo pasiy vie a hmuo.
Hingpa hraw ning hing Phungluo kawlieta hnaahnawna khuopuv ta a aw.
Ngu a patle thepa Demetrias ama tapa paa ca Artemis khazingnung abiena ing zuvta kha ngu ta patle te capa re lie rehrietuv tie ca ama tuokaa hmungna luopuv a phasa.
Ama ta a rehrietuv tie hne iema haapa re a hrie rapa tie kha ku pakhaw yi te, “Uvnu zaw, hingpa rehriena taa hingta hnyirungna ma hmungpa ung ca nama pachang.

Niema zaw hmung ung cate nama pachangpa haata hingpa Paul hingta Efesa lie dyi cuo li pata Asia ruo bangkhuo lie a awpa cawsaa hluvpuv kha, cawsaa ta tuechawpa Khazing ca Khazing ta cuo vyi, ta pata chang yi te a pa zang sa diy tli yi.

Cakhutaata ima sungpalina zaw mingchiena aa taw riypa dyi cuo li pata khazingnung Artemis biena-ing zaw hing a ling zue'a te, Asia ruo hne chuelyi cung yalya ta amaa biepa a lesyina zaw hing a cungbung aa,” a ta yi.
Capa bie ca ama thyi tiyta ama hi haa te, “Efesa lie a awpa Artemis ca a lesyice!” ta pata khuopuv ta ama u.
Khy chunglie ca cahaacata khi-una ta a bi; cawsaa ta Paul hne khy a tlaw hnepa Masidonia ming Gaius hne Aristarkas kha a vya dale yi te pyi mangna hmang luo kha ama vya chiykhyi.
Paul ca ama pangpa ta cawsaazaapuv hmieluo pya riypa kha a khing, cuorasala zangtuv tie ta ama thlu.
A viesaa ta a cuopa Asia pe uvtuv chekha zaw ta pyi mangna hmang luo hrahring a ngie li riypata bie ama vya taa.
Capa cuo ning ca, chekha ta a phang hrang, a hrangpa chekha ta a phang hrang khata khi patlaw yi te, hluv vie bangkhuo khata khaapanakawma hingpa luo hing maa vya hmya tapa hmuo pachang va yi.

Judah ming ta hmieluo ama vya papyapa Alekzandar kha cawsaazaapuv chekha ta hingpa paa hingna hingpa hmang a chiykhyituv ta a cuo thlu aa ta pata ama rue. Alekzandar ta cawsaazaapuv ca a kuv pazu te a padie sa khutaa yi ta, ama a cuo lina kaw ri aa pachie.
Cuorasala ama ca Judah ming a cuopa kha ama pachang tiyta, “Efesa lie a awpa Artemis ca a lesyi ce,” ta yi te siymaluo pahning chung ama u.

Cuorasala khy caziypa ta cawsaazaapuv ca padie sa yi te, “Efesa khy ming, ahung hing ma Efesa khypuv ca a lesyipa Artemis biena-ing hne vuoruo taata zaa tlapa ama hmingsuo kuvtuezuv a awnapa tana a cuo tapa a pachang lipa a aw ung ciy?
Capa ca ahungtahmuo i khu riypata a cuo li nakawta a dieta tah nama aw riypata a cuo; khuerue taa li pata hmang nama tue cakhaw riypata cuo vyi.
Niema ta, ma biena-ing hmang zaw a paruv buo lipa hne ma khazingnung thuopachina bie zaw a ri buo lipa hingpa cawsaa zaw hing hingpa hmang luo nama vya chiykhyi.
Demetrias hne a rehriehne tie ta, ahung cunglie a cuo zaw ta, bie ama hnyi khing kieca bieripana zung pahaw yi te bieripatuv tie ama aw thluo. Capa lie ca tazaa vaa cyi thluo yi se.
Capa laa cata nama pachang khing hrangpa a aw kieca khy ming bangkhuo a hmyana lie kha bie chi riypata a cuo.

Ataning a puvpa hmang kawlie hingta kiema hing hnaahnawnapa na nama chiykhyi ta pata pasuena maa taw khu. Tahematapakieca hingpa hmang a cuona kaw hing a siesa pata ma ri khu riypa suokha hmuo aw vyi,” a ta.
Capa bie a ri khutaa cata a hmyapa tie kha a padiy sa diy yi.
Hnaahnawna a chuo khutaata Paul ta zangtuv tie kha ku yi te thaazuo pi yi te bie aa chang siy khutaa yi ta Masidonia luo a si.
Capa ruo chung ca cahraw te zangtuv tie kha thaazuo a hluvsa a pi khutaa yi ta Grik ruo luo kha pha te,
capa lie ca thla thung chung a aw. Siria luo kha tiypalaw ta a si'a nang tli pata Judah ming ta ama raw nakawta Masidonia luo kaa riypata bie aa chi pakhaa.
Berea khy ming Pirhas sacapaa Sopater, Thesalonika ming Aristarkas hne Sekandas, Derbe khy ming Gaius, hne Asia ruo taata Timote, Tikhikas hne Trofimas zaw kha ama hneta ama tlaw ra.
Iema kha silu yi te Troas khy taata malie ama za huo.
Cuorasala kiema ca Thiynung Phuv lipa Viechuo pyi khutaata Filipi taa khata tiypalaw ta ma si. Ning pangaa khutaata Troas khy lie kha va pha yi pate capa lie ca ning sariy ma aw.
Zaa kha chunglie a ning khana ning, Abyipa zuosa a hraw riypata maa taw pata, Paul ta iema kha bie a rue yi te, a mawluopa ca sile aa ting nakawta zuocang te ta a bieri kha a pazue.
Maa pungnapa a cung duo lie ca myi-ing a hluvpuv ama vuo.

Zutikhas ama tapa satlie pakha ca thlaluo-aw lie kha a tu te Paul ta a pasiypuv ta bie a ripazue nguoluo ning kha thuvhunglung khata aa hmung nakawta duothungna taa khata alyi luo tla te a thiy pata amaa haa.
Cuorasala Paul ca cung te, a bungchiy te aa paw khutaata, “Nama thlaa zang khah se, a hring thluo,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata Paul ca a cung duo luo kha kya kie te, viechuo kha chechi te ama ning khutaata, iema hne khata, khydyina te bie a rue yi te aa thale.
Satliepa ca a hring pata ing luo cakuokhyi yi te ama hnaa a nguosa.
Kiema ca tiypalaw ta Assos luo kha silu pate Paul kha kupaa riypata maa ting, tahematapakieca ama ca tluo luopuv ta si te kupaa riypata malie a chang ciepa ta a cuo.
Assos lie kha maa taw taata tiypalaw luo ca kie ra te Mitilene luo kha ma si.
Capa taa cata si pate a mawluopa ta Khios a rie-e luo kha ma chiy. A hezuoningpa ta Samos luo kha chiy pate, a khetuningpa ta Miletas luo kha ma chiy.
Paul ta Asia ruo chunglie cuo pachuo sa li riypata Efesa kha law pata si aa ting. Tahematapakieca, a cuo khu kieca, Pentekos ning kha Jerusalem lie awpa a khing.
Paul ta Melitas taa khata Efesa Khrihsaa uvthyi tie kha amaa vya taw riypata bie a taalu yi.
Amaa vya taw tiyta, iema kha, “Asia lie i phyi i pathla baataata ata tepa hingta nama hrawlie tuokhaatama i tu i daa tapa kha ina pachang ung ciy.
Rawcanawna'a nata mingthliy hneta Abyipa re kha hrie angte, Judah ming ina rawna taa yi ta a vawpa ruvnaana kha i ang law.
Ing kha hnang ing kha ta cuose, zaapuv kha a luohuo ta ica pacuv ning yi hne thuophaa i ukhyina lie kha nama cuota phana a cuopa ca suokha hmuo i nguo siypa aw vyi.
Judah ming nama cuo zaw, Grik ming nama cuo zaw Khazing'a luo kha a ngiepachiy pata Abyipa Zingsuv nama zang riypa kha ica chang yi.
Ata hing ca Thlaapa luochiyna haata khaapama i taw aa tapa kha pachang li pata Jerusalem luo i sile ningta a cuo.
I pachangpa ca, Thlaapa Pathe ta na chang te, khy ting taa tana thawtlana hne hrisaana ta ina huo tapa khata a cuo.
Cuorasala Abyipa Zingsuv'a taata i hmungpa, Khazing vihnyina kaw thuophaa phu riypa re hing i patlung pata a cuo kieca i hringna hing ca i cuota khaapatahmuo ri va ang.
“Ata lieta nama hrawlieta sibungsithaw angte Khazing pena kaw ica changpa tie niema ahung hingta hmuo i hmie na hmung pakhaa'a va tli ung ciy tapa kha i pachang.
Caacuonakawta ataning ta niema'a lie a siesa pata ica changpa yi ca, ahung thiyse kawlieta hmuo cuo sala kama ca i pathe,
tahematapakieca Khazing ta a tingpa kha nguo siy li pata niema'a lie ica chang diy yi.
Niema hne niema kha a mangchiy ung la Thlaapa Pathe ta mangchiy riypata aca pipa yi tuvrung zaw kha mangchiy tie ung. Khazing ta sacapaa thiyse ta a calyipa a khrihsaabuv zaw kha mangchiy tie ung.
I si khu taa hingta aa hruosapa cahnie zaw kha niema hraw luo a vaw'a yi te, tuvrung kha ca pangaa'a va yi tapa i pachang.
Niema phuv chung lalaapa taata cawsaa chekha ca zangtuv tie ta iema hnang ama ziy the riypata biehmisipa ri li pata ama hang aa.
Caacuonakawta a raaring ung la, kung thung chung bangkhuo, chung hne zuo hne a pahy li pata mingthliy hneta ica za changpa yi kha maw khah ung.
Ata hing ca niema kha Khazing'a luo cuose, ca pakiesathaw khu yi te pathe sa ciepa tie hrawlieta ru caa pipa yi a vihnyina thuophaa luo khana ica pi tli yi.
Ahung siy, ahung ngu hne ahung cawsie hmuota hietlie buo va yi ang.
Kama hne kama cuose, i viesaa zaw cuose i kuv ta re hrie angte i ringpa yi kha niema hrahring na a pachang ung ciy.

Hing haa hingta temaa pata rehriena taa hing tana a ruvnaapa tie maa bya aa tapa kha i tuepa bangkhuo taata ica pahmung sa tli yi. Abyi Zingsuv hrahring ta, ‘Hmungna luo laata pina luo na thluechiy a aw vie,’ a tapa kha maw khah ung,” a ta.
Capa bie ca a patlung taata ama pakhuv pane yi te thlaa ama chuo.
Ama caapuopa khata ama kha cakuv yi te ama pahnuo.
Na hmung pakhaa va tli ung ciy, a ta nakaw yi khata ama ngie a chi vie pacuo pata a cuo. Cakhutaa cata tiypalaw te kha ama va pathlie.
Iema hne maa che khutaata aa dangsa pata si pate Kos luo kha ma chiy; a mawluopa ta Rods luo kha chiy pate cakhutaata Patara luo ma chiy.
Fonisia luo a si'a nangpa tiypalaw kha hmung pate capa tiypalaw cata ma va caluo.
Saipras aa luona te chiy pate ma cavyiluo kuo ta ma thuse khutaata Siria luo chiy pate Tair lie kha ma cung, tahematapakieca capa lie ca ma tiypalaw kha a hmang a pachung.
Zangtuv tie kha a taw yi pate capa lie ca ning sariy ma aw. Thlaapa ta a changna haa yi ta Paul kha Jerusalem luo si li riypata ama thlu.

Cuorasala iema'a lie ma awnapa cuo ca chuo te, thuse yi pate maa tha pakhaa. Ama nung ama saa yalya hne khata khy le luo te malie ama vya pathlie. Capa riyliy kie lie ca ma pakhuv pane pate, iema hne cata thlaachuo pakhaw pate
pakha hne pakha kha, nama tluo pata, maa ta. Cakhutaata tiypalaw cung luo kha kie pate iema ca ama kaa.
Tair taa cata si pate Ptolemais luo kha ma chiy; zangtuv tie kha bie a chang yi pate iema'a lie ca ning kha ma aw.
A mawluopa ca a tha pakhaa pate Sisaria ma chiy. Uvthyi pasariy hrawlie pakha a cuopa, thuophaa a phutuv Filip ing lie kha ma tlung.
Navaa a hnyi lipa sacanung papaliy hnyi te iema ca profetbiephu ri khuna lasaw a hmungpa ta ama cuo.
Capa lie ca ning hluvpuv ma aw khutaata, Agabas ama tapa profet pakha Judea taata a za chiy.

Kiema'a luo kha a vaw te, Paul tesaw kha la te a phyi hne a kuv kha aa ciy khutaata, “Thlaapa Pathe na hing haa hingta naa chang, ‘Jerusalem lie a awpa Judah ming ta hingpa tesaw a hnyipa paa hing hing haa hingta ciy'a yi te Jentail ming kuv luo ama pi aa,’” a ta.
Capa bie ca ma thyi tiyta, kiema hne capa lie a awpa cawsaa zaw ca ta Jerusalem luo si li riypata ma thlu.

Cakhutaata, Paul ta, “Khaapama nama tue? Caa ung cate i pathiypalung ina pa-ichi ung ciy. Jerusalem lie hing ina ciypakang riypa dyi yi cuo li pata Zingsuv Khrih cuota thiy riypa hmuo muo i ting ta,” a ta yi.
Tuokhaata hmuo ripasa the a aw li nakawta, “Khazing khingna haa cuo thluo se,” tapa dyi ri the pate a dieta tah ma aw.
Cakhutaa cata a pachie pate Jerusalem luo ca ma si.
Sisaria khy taata a ziytuv chekha kha kiema hneta kya si ra yi te, iema ca ta a hluo baataata a ziytuv zaa cuopa, Saipras ming Mnason ing luo kha malie chiytha yi te capa lie ca ma aw.
Jerusalem luo ma chiy tiyta, uvnu zaw ta palung tluosa pata malie ama cuhluo.
A mawluopa ta Paul hne kiema zaw bangkhuo ca Jeim a taw riypata vaa pate Khrihsaa uvthyi tie bangkhuo kha ama aw ra.
Iema kha bie maa chang khutaa yi ta, Paul ta ama rehrienapa taata Jentail ming hrawlie Khazing hmang tuepa bangkhuo kha suokha hnang suokha ta a chang yi.
Capa bie ca ama thyi tiyta Khazing kha ama pathuosa. Cakhutaata ama kha, “Uvnu Paul, Judah ming hrawlie hing zangtuv thaw khazaa aw yi te ma phungbie kha tluv ta amaa daakhyi tapa hing na pachang.

Jentail ming hrawlie a awpa Judah ming kha, Moses phungbie kha thuse riypa hne ama saata zaw kha vangdaw te li riypa hne Judah phung kha ziy li riypa tana a pacuv yi, ta pata iema ta na kaw kha ama thyi tli.
Caacuonakawta tuokhaata tuepa tama a pha aa? Hingpa luo na vya chiypa hing ama pachang ngiethie hyi aa.
Caacuonakawta maca changpa hing tue tie. Kiema'a lie hing biekuona a tuepa cawsaa papaliy ama aw.

Iema hing ziy yi la a pathesana ama tuepa kha va tue ra la ama suo a nguna muo kha va liepa tie yi. Cata a cuo kieca na kaw ama thyipa hing suokha hmuo cuo vyi tapa hne nama hrahring phungbie na ziypa kha ama pachang aa.

Cuorasala zangtuv a vya cuopa Jentail ming kha ca kiema ta, kuvtuezuv lie hriykhung amaa rinapa saa ning li riypa, thiy ning li riypa, a rue cadie pata ama thiepa saa bangkhuo ce li riypa, hne aparuvsuena tue li riypa tapa ma bie chinapa caa kha ma paphya tli yi,” ama ta.

A mawluopa ta Paul ca cawsaa tie kha a chiy yi te a pathena a tue. Iema hne cata biena-ing luo kha a ngie te, khatiy tama a pathesana cuo a chuo aa tapa hne pakha cyicuo cuota hriykhung a rina ama tue riypa cuo zaw kha a chang yi.
A ning sariynapa a chuo'a nangpa khata, biena-ing chunglie Paul a awpa a hmungpa, Asia taata a vawpa Judah ming ta cawsaazaapuv kha ama pasu. Ama kha patuv yi te,

“Israel ming zaw, malie a bya tie ung! Hingpa paa hingna ma cawsaa, ma phungbie, hne hingpa hmang hing a du pata cawsaa mekaa kha hmangting lieta a pacuvle yi; Ca dyi cuo li pata Grik ming kha biena-ing chung luo a ngiekhyi yi te hing hmang pathepa hing a papya a palyi,” ta pata ama khi.
Tahematapakieca Efesa ming Trofimas hne khata khy chunglie za hmung yi te, Paul na biena-ing luo a ngiekhyi ta pata ama rue nakaw tana a cuo.
Khy chunglie ca hnaahnawna ta a bi. Cawsaa ca a vya ruo yi te, Paul kha biena-ing lie patuv yi te ale luo amaa dale khutaata biena-ing chiypakaa kha ama hre.
Ama kha thie amaa nang nguoluo pata Jerusalem khychung yalya tana hnaahnawna a aw tapa bie kha Rom riebyilepa'a luo a chiy.
Sungkhabala ta riebyi chekha hne rieka tie kha a chiy yi te iema'a luo ca amaa ruo. Riebyilepa hne rieka tie kha ama hmung taata Paul ama tuvpa ca ama taw.
Riebyilepa ta a vaw te Paul kha a patuv khutaata thaabuoliriy suohning ta cakhiy riypata bie pi yi te, ama kha ahung ta cuo te ma khaapama a za tue taw tapa kha a hiehriy yi.

Cawsaazaapuv hraw taata a che ta phang kha ta ama khi, a hrangpa a che ta a phanghrang ta ama khi patlaw nakawta riebyipa ca a cuo tangepa kha pachang khu li pata Paul kha riekate luo a ngiekhyi riypata naw a pi yi.
Hlyidaw te ama chiykhyipa khata cawsaazaapuv kha ama chaa tuv nakawta rieka tie ta a caba ta ama cabale.
A vya nuosuelepa cawsaazaapuv ca ta, “Thie tie ung!” ta pata ama khi.
Riekate luo ama vya sikhyi'a nangpa khata, Paul ta riebyilepa kha, “Bie suokha ca chang khu the'a ang ma?” a ta. Riebyipa ta, “Grik ryi ma na the?
Caacuokieca, ma hnangluo vie ningta cehre a cyipa cawsaa thawpaliy ruocaapa luo sikhyi te rie a thupa Iziptpa khata ca cuo vaciy nuo?” a ta.
Paul ta, “Kama ca Silisia ruo Tarsas khy, khypuv ming pathuopa lie a puvpa Judah ming tana i cuo. Paa na ica kie, cawsaazaapuv'a lie hing bie na pari sa thi tie,” a ta.
Riebyipa ta bie rina naw a pi tiyta, Paul ca hlyidaw cunglie kha a daa te, cawsaazaapuv'a luo kha a kuv pazu te a padie sa yi. Ama die diy khutaata iema'a lie kha Hebru ryi ta bie a ri.
“Uvnu zaw'a nata paa zaw, niema hmielieta i sue linapa bie i ripa hing na naathliepa tie ung,” a ta.
Hebru ryi ta a ripa kha ama thyi tiyta ama diekaring. Cakhutaa cata:

“Kama ca Silisia ruo Tarsas khy lieta a puvpa Judah ming tana i cuo, cuorasala i lenapa ca hingpa khy hingta a cuo. Gamaliel kuv rawlieta mingchingmingvuo tie zaw phungbie kha pacuvpa ta cuo angte niema zaw bangkhuo haa hingta Khazing cuota pang aa pipa tana i cuo.
Hing Phungluo a ziypa tie hing thiyna te ta za hrisaa yi angte, canung capaa ta patuv yi angte thaw-ing luo i za khungpa yi kha

tluobyi lepa hne bieripatuv phuv uvthyi tie bangkhuo hing naa pachangtuv ta ama cuo. Iema'a taa hingta Damaskas khy lie a awpa uvnu zaw pi riypa caa kha a la angte, capa lie a awpa tie ca patuv pata, cakhiy pata, Jerusalem luo chiykhyipa yi ta duo te riypa yi ta i si hning yi.
“Damaskas luo ca si angte i pha tyalya caw, ningchung hraw khiy ta avuo taata khena ta sungkha ta ina ka.
Alyi lie a lie angte ueryi suokha i thyipa ca, ‘Saul, Saul, khaapanakawma ina hrisaa ciy?’ ina ta.
Kama ta, ‘Abyipa, ahungtama na cuo?’ i ta. Ama ta, ‘Na hrisaa nguoluopa Nazareth Zingsuv tana i cuo,’ ina ta.
Kama'a lie a aw rapa tie ta khena dyi kha hmung yi te kama'a lie bie a ripa ueryi kha thyi va yi.
Kama ta, ‘Abyipa, khaapama i tue aa?’ i ta. Abyipa ta, ‘Thu la Damaskas luo kha si tie; Khazing ta hrie riypata aca pipa bangkhuo ca aca chang'a yi,’ ina ta.
Khena ta ina khetuv nakawta i ming ca hmung the li pata i viesaa zaw khata i kuv ta na ca-yale yi te Damaskas luo inaa chiyle yi.
“Phungbie kha ziy te Khazing'a luo aa pipasesa nakawta capa lie a awpa Judah ming bangkhuo ta ama rithuophaapa Ananias ama tapa paa kha
a vaw te, i thaalie kha a daa te, ‘Uvnu Saul, hmung pakhaa tie!’ ina ta. Capa cuota lie ca ta i ming ca vuo te ama kha i hmung.
Cakhutaata ama ta, ‘Ma mingchingmingvuo tie Khazing ta a khingna na pachang riypa, aa dangpa paa na hmung riypa, hne a ueryi na thyi riypata acaa tlaw tli;
tahematapakieca hing chuelyi lieta na hmungpa hne na thyipa bangkhuo hing a cuota pachangkhyituv riypa tana na cuo aa.
Caacuonakawta khaapama na haasaa? Thu la tiy a naw tie, ama ming kha u la na suena kha pathe sa tie,’ ina ta.
“Jerusalem luo i kaa khutaata biena-ing lie thlaa i chuo nguoluo ning kha muocuo hmung angte,
Zingsuv ta, ‘Jerusalem taa hingta a catli pata pya tie, tahematapakieca kama kaw tehte na khuopa kha cuhluo va yi,’ ina ta.
Kama ta, ‘Abyipa, apungna-ing ting ta vaa angte nama caa zangpa tie kha tuv yi angte thaw i pathlapa yi kha iema ta ama pachang.

Cakhutaata, nama kaw pachangkhyituv Steven thiyse palang yi te ama thie ning zaw kha kama hrahring amaa thaalie a daa angte, palung tlingsa pata, ama a thiepa tie buohryicungle kha i mangchiypa yi,’ i ta.
Cakhutaata, ama ta, ‘Cakuo tie, tahematapakieca Jentail ming hraw luo na ica pathlie aa,’ ina ta,” a ta.
Paul bie ripa kha hingpa te hing ca ama naathlie, cuorasala hingpa khutaa hingta ca, “Hing haapa cawsaa hing alyi lie aw khah se! Pahring riypata cuo vyi,” ama ta.
Ama khi nguoluo ning ca ama pang kha cathlu yi te buvcing kha avuo luo ama hi.
Riebyilepa ca ta khaapanakawma hing tluv ta a du yi te ama khi tapa kha pachangna riypata Paul kha riekate luo a chiy ung la, tuv ung la, bie hiehriy tie ung, ta pata naw a pi yi.
Cuorasala tuv riypata ama cakhiy khupa khiy ta, aa thaalieta a daapa riebyipa kha Paul ta, “Rom ruo ming pakha kha a bie ripa li pata tuv phung a cuo ma?” ta pata a hiehriy.
Riebyipa ta a thyi tiyta riebyilepa'a luo kha vaa te, “Khaapama na tue'a nang? Hingpa paa hing Rom ruo ming tana a cuo tli hing,” a ta.
Riebyilepa ta a vaw te Paul kha, “Na chang tie, Rom ruo ming ta na cuo ma?” a ta. Ama ta, “I cuo,” a ta.
Riebyilepa ta, “Rom ruo ming cuona hmung riypa hingta tuokaa a hluvsa i pachuo,” a ta. Paul ta, “Kama ca i zaa puvkhyipa tana Rom ruo ming i cuo,” a ta.
Bie a hiehriy'a nangpa mekaa ca sungkha ta a sawse diy yi te, Rom ruo ming a cuopa Paul a cakhiy tlamu nakawta riebyilepa zaw kha a thlaa a zang.

Riebyipa ca Judah ming ta Paul sue ama bepa hing khaapanakawma a cuo tapa kha a pachang khing nakawta a mawluopa ta Paul ca pathlie te tluobyi lepa tie hne bieripatuv tie bangkhuo kha a hmya riypata naw a pi yi. Paul kha a vya chiy te iema hmiekunglie ca a padaa.
Paul ta bieripatuv phuv kha a hmiepachaw pata mang yi te, “Uvnu zaw, ataning tepa hingta ca i hringna lie hing Khazing hmiekunglie i chiepha thleduona palung a pathe,” a ta.
Capa bie a ri khu pahne cata tluobyi lepa Ananias ta Paul athaalie a daapa tie kha a hmyataw cabe riypata naw a pi yi.

Paul ta ama kha, “Nama, thungruopa thuvpa lungruetlepie, Khazing na nama kha caa cabe aa, Phungbie haata kama bie ripa riypata naa tu thluopa hingta ma, nama ta phungbie para cate cabe ung la ina ta ciy?” a ta.
A thaalie a tupa tie ta, “Khazing tluobyi lepa na na ese,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata, Paul ta, “Uvnu zaw, tluobyi lepa a cuopa kha i pachang li nakaw tana a cuo; Caapathe lieta, ‘Nama cawsaa luochiytuv kha a thuo pachi'a va ung ciy a ta,’” a ta yi.

Paul ta chekha tie kha Sadusi ta cuo yi te chekha Farasi ta ama cuopa kha a pachang tiyta, bieripatuv phuv tie kha, “Uvnu zaw, Kama ca Farasi ming, Farasi tie saata tana i cuo. Hingpa lieta bie ripa riypata i cuopa hing a thiypa tie ama thu pakhaa aa tapa aruechuona i hnyi nakaw tana a cuo,” a ta.
Capa bie ca a ri tiyta, Farasi tie hne Sadusi tie alalalie kha ruena a che te a hmyapa tie ca phuv hning ta amaa che.
(Sadusi tie ta, thupakhaana, acuolikie avuoming, acuolikie thlaapa aw vyi ama ta, cuorasala Farasi tie ta ca a suothung ta ama zang diy.)
Khuopuv ta a i yi te, Farasi phungbie saya tie kha a daa yi te, “Hingpa paa hing a suenapa suokha hmuo hmung vapuv. Thlaapa acuolikie avuoming ta ama chang sasaw pata a cuo khu,” ama ta.

Khuopuv ta amaa i nakawta Paul kha a chuv'a yi te thlaachi diy'a kie yi ta pata riebyilepa kha a thlaa a zang. Caacuonakawta Paul kha hruohra ta za la pata riekate luo chi riypata rieka tie kha naw a pi yi.
Capa zuopa ca ta Abyipa kha a thaalie a daa te, “Khaapahmuo ciy khah! Tahematapakieca Jerusalem lie kama cuota tehte na khuopa haa hingta Rom lie zaw kama cuota tehte na khuo kalie aa,” a ta.
A mawluomawpa ta Judah ming ca a paruvta tah a taw yi te khue pha lipa ama khuo. Paul ma thie hluo li sa ning li tiy dang lipa tana ma aw aa ta yi te bie amaa kuo.
Capa a paruv ta khue pha lipa ama khuona lie ca cawsaa sawliy hlyi ama ta.
Iema ca tluobyi lepa tie hne uvthyi tie'a luo kha cakuo yi te, “Paul ma thie hluo li sa ning'a vapuv tapa tana a cusa pata bie maa kuo.

Caacuonakawta niema hne bieripatuv phuv tie ta, a kaw hing a sie vie ta a hiehriy khingpa haata a pa-aw sa ung la, Paul kha niema'a luo a za pathlie riypata riebyilepa kha hie tie ung. Hingpa luo hing a za chiy hluota ma thie aa,” ama ta.
Cahaacata thie riypata ama byapa kha Paul a tuvpaapa ta a pachang nakawta riekate luo kha vaa te Paul kha a chang.
Paul ta riebyipa pakha kha ku te, “Hingpa paa hing riebyilepa'a luo kha vaakhyi tie, bie chang riypa na a hnyi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta riebyilepa'a luo ca vaakhyi te, “Thaw a tlapa Paul khata na ku te na hing satliepa hing bie chang riypa a hnyi nakawta nama'a luo vaakhyi la ina ta,” a ta.
Riebyilepa ta a kuv ta ca-yale te ama selaw ta a cakuokhyi khutaata, “Khaapa bie ma ina chang khing ciy?” ta pata a hiehriy.
Ama ta, “Judah ming ta Paul kha a kaw na a sie vie ta ma pachang khing ta pata bieripatuv phuv hmiekung luo chiykhyi riypata nama'a luo hie riypa kha palungtlingna ama hnyi mangtli.

Cuorasala ama bie kha zang lie ciy, cawsaa sawliy hlyi na ama thie riypata luopuv lieta a bya yi. Paul ma thie hluo li ta sa ning li tiy dang lipa tana ma aw aa ta yi te bie amaa kuo mangtli. Iema ca a ting pacie diy pata aw yi te nama biechina hingna ama huo thluo,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta riebyilepa ta “Hingpa kaw ina changpa ca hing ahunghmuo chang khah yi,” ta te satliepa kha a pathlie.
Riebyilepa ca ta riebyi pahning kha ku yi te, “Ata zuo siymaluo pacaky ta Sisaria luo si riypata rieka zahning, aruo rieka sawsariy, hne asyi rieka zahning kha a pachie pacie pata chi tie yi.
Paul aa khang riypa aruo zaw kha pachiepa la muokiybyi Feliks'a luo kha aa bang aa susa pata chiykhyi tie ung,” a ta.
Riebyipa ta a raw luo haa hingta caa a cape:
“Kalaudias Lisias na Muokiybyipa Feliks'a luo bie-achangna caa caa paphya ang.
Hingpa cawsaapa hing Judah ming ta patuv yi te thie amaa nang, cuorasala Rom ruo ming a cuopa kha i pachang tiyta i rieka tie hneta ama kha ma khuo.
Khaapanakawma ama hing sue ama be tapa kha i pachang khing nakawta bieripatuv phuv luo kha i chiykhyi.
Iema phungbie hne aa patuv pata sue ama bepa ta cuo te thaw pathla riypa hne thiy riypata aa phuvpa suena suokha hmuo hnyi vyi.
Ama kha raw yi te thie amaa nangpa thuo i thyi tiyta, nama'a luo ca za paphya angte, sue a betuvpa tie zaw kha nama hmiekung luo tazaa va cyi ung la i ta yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta, rieka tie ca nawpipa ama cuopa haata, Paul kha va la yi te zuo ta Antipatris te ama sikhyi.
A mawluopa ca aruo rieka tie kha pathlie sa yi te, iema ca riekate luo ama vya kaa.
Sisaria luo chiy yi te caa kha muokiy byipa ca ama pi; Paul zaw kha a kuv luo ama pi ra.
Caa kha ri te, Paul kha khaapa pe ming tama a cuo tapa kha hiehriy te, Silisia pe ming a cuopa kha a pachang ca,
“Tazaa caa cyipa tie ama vya chiy taa tana na bie ica ripa aa,” a ta. Cakhutaata ama kha Herod siepahruo ing lie kha rieka ta huo riypata naw a pi yi.
Ning pangaa khutaata tluobyi lepa Ananias ca uvthyi chekha hne sih-ni Tertullas hne khata muokiybyipa'a luo kha a zuv yi te, Paul sue ama bena bie kha ama chang.

Paul kha amaa vya ngiekhyi tiyta, Tertullas ta hing haa hingta suebena bie kha a ri: “Abyipa, Nama thueta diena chunglie cuo pasiypuv vya aw pate, na singna thueta hingpa cawsaa zaw cuo hingta athlena thaapa a hluvpuv tue pata a cuo.
Hingpa bangkhuo hing hmangting lie a awpa kiema bangkhuo ta ma palung a tluokhyi hringhruo.
Na cuo kha a pasiy tuv ca lapa'a kie ang ta pata i ri riypa bie hing a pachangkhuna chung ta vya ri'a angte na naathliepa thi tie, ta pata paa ica kie.
Hingpa paa hing zaapuv hrawlie hnaahnawna a chiykhyituv, chuelyicung khy ting lie a awpa Judah ming hrawlie hnaahnawna a aw riypata pasutuv hne Nazareth buv ama tapa luochiytuv tana a cuo.
Biena-ing zaw kha papyapalyi aa chie nakawta ma patuv pata a cuo.
(Ma phungbie haata bie ripana ma hnyi khing raalaa pata riebyilepa Lusias ta kiema kuv taa khata hruohra ta malie chuv te ama sue a bepa tie kha nama hmieluo chiy riypata bie malie a pi.)
Ama hing bie na hiehriy kieca sue ma benapa bangkhuo hing a sie vie ta na pachang aa,” a ta.
Judah ming zaw ta suebena lie ca pahlaw yi te a ripa bangkhuo hing aa hmuopa se tana a cuo ama ta.

Muokiybyipa ta Paul kha bie ri riypata a kuv a va pazupa tiyta, Paul ta: “Nama ca hingpa mingphang cunglie hing kung pasiypuv chung bieripatuv byi na cuo tli tapa kha i pachang nakawta, i sue lina kaw hing palung tluosa pata i ri aa.
Na pachangna haata, Jerusalem luo Khazing abie riypata i khawnapa hing ning hraa hlyihning laata hluv vie valie.
Iema hingta biena-ing chunglie pakhakha hneta bie maa ipa cuose, apungna-ing chunglie'a nata khy chunglieta cawsaazaapuv kha pasu pata hnaahnawna i tuepa zaw na hmung va yi.
Sue ina bepa zaw yi hing ma aa hmuo hrahring ta pata na hmiekunglie hing ri khu tange va yi.

Cadyiseca, na hmiekunglieta i cuo thluo ta pata i ri khingpa ca, iema ta a sichiepa buv thaapa ama tapa, Phungluo haata ma mingchingmingvuo tie ta amaa zaa biepa Khazing kha abie angte, profet tie caa-uv lie aa capepa hne phungbie chunglie'apa bangkhuo kha i zang.
Iema zaw amaa nguopuo pata a cuopa, cawsaa hing a phapa hne a chiepa hne thiyna taata ama thu pakhaa aa tapa kha Khazing'a lieta nguopuona i hnyi.
Caacuonakawta Khazing hmielie hne cawsaa hmielieta chiepha thleduona palung pathesa pata i hring khuna riypata i zue pari.
Kung a pasiy myarya khutaata i mingphang tie abyana phya riypa hne Khazing'a luo hriykhungrina pihluo riypata Jerusalem luo hing i vya chiy.
Capa hmang i tue nguoluo ning, phung haata a pathena i tue khutaa khata biena-ing chunglie na hmung yi te, capa ning ca cawsaazaapuv zaw aw va yi, hnaahnawna suokha hmuo aw ra vyi.
Cuorasala Asia ruo taata Judah ming chekha aw yi te, kama kha sue ina be khing kie yi ca nama hmiekung luo hing a vaw pata sue ina be riypa yi ta a cuo.
Acuolikie hingpa lie a awpa tie hingta bieripatuv phuv hmielie i daa ning hing khaapa suena ma i tue tapa kha ri yi se.
Ama hmielie i daa ningta i ripa suokha dyi aw te, capa ca, ‘A thiypa tie thupakhaana kaw cuo te capa kawlie ca ta ataning na hmiekunglie i daapa hingta a cuo,’” a ta.
Cuorasala capa Phungluo kaw kha a phata tah a pachangpa Feliks ta, “Riebyilepa Lisias a za chiy taa tana na bie ica ripa aa,” ta te bieripana ning kha a pathaw.

Cakhutaa cata riebyipa kyihuo khata Paul kha thaw a tlapa tie khungcawnapa ing lie chi riypata naw pi te, cuorasala hyazang vie ta chi riypa hne ama kha aa huna lie ama mangsang the riypata a vya tawpa a viesaa zaw kha pakha hmuo thlu li riypata a chang.
Ning cawta a rupa khiy ta, Feliks ca Judah zaanung ta a cuopa a napuvnung Drusilla hneta a vaw yi te Paul kha ku te Khrih Zingsuv zangna kaw a ripa kha ama naathlie.
Paul ta adangna kaw, pangpa a cadangna kaw, a vaw riypa bieripana kaw tapa tie kha a ri tiyta Feliks ca a thlaa zang te, “Ata hing ca cakuo caw tie, cuo i hnyi taata ica ku pakhaa aa,” a ta.
Feliks ca, Paul ta tuokaa ina pi thlu aa ta pata aa nguopuo nakawta ata'a na ata tah a taw te bie aa rue.
Kung hning khutaata Feliks ca Porsias Festas ta aa thle. Feliks ta Judah ming palung a patluo khing nakawta, Paul kha thaw-ing lie a thuse siy.
Capa pe chung luo a pha taata ning thung a ta pata Festas ca Sisaria taata Jerusalem luo kha a khaw.
Capa lie ca tluobyi lepa tie hne Judah ming luochiytuv tie ta Paul sue ama benapa kha ama chang.
Festas kyihuo khata ngiechina pata Paul kha Jerusalem luo a palawpa riypa yi ta paa ama kie. Hmisi ta kieca Paul kha luopuv lie a bawkhuo pata thie riypata khue ama khuo.
Festas ta, Paul ca Sisaria thaw-ing chunglie aw thluo te kama zaw a ru hluota kaale i ting.
“Caacuonakawta naw a hnyipa tie kha kama hne hingta a zuv ra ung la cawsaapa kha a suena a aw kieca sue za be tie ung,” a ta yi.
Iema'a lie ning cari acuolikie ning hraa hraw a aw khutaata Sisaria luo kha a si. A mawluopa ta bierina thude lie kha a tu te Paul kha kya pyakhyi riypata naw a pi yi.
Paul a kya chiy tiyta Jerusalem taata a zuvpa Judah ming ca ama kha cadung yi te suebena bie kha a hluvsa ama ri, cuorasala ama suebena bie kha a hmuo hrahring ta pata ri khu va yi.
Paul ta a sue lina kaw kha ri te, “Kama ta Judah ming phungbie cuose, biena-ing cuose, siepahruo cuose a du pata suena suokha hmuo tue va ang,” a ta.
Cuorasala Festas ta Judah ming palung a hmung khing nakawta Paul kha, “Jerusalem luo khaw pata i hmielie bie ripa riypata na khing'a ma?” a ta.
Paul ta, “Rom siepahruo bieripana zung liena paduo i hu aa, hingpa lie hingna bie ripa riypata i cuo. A phasa pata na pachangpa haata Judah ming cunglie suena i tuepa aw vyi.

Suena tue angte thiy aa phuvpa i cuo kieca capa thiyna taa cata a ruo riypata a ting'a va ang. Cuorasala sue ina bepa yi hing aa hmuopa suokha hmuo a aw li kieca a ahungtahmuo kama hing iema kuv luo na pi khu vyi. Siepahruo'a luo na paduo i hu aa,” a ta.
Festas ca a viesaa bieripatuv phuv tie hneta bie amaa rue pakhaw khutaata, “Siepahruo'a luo paduo naa hupa haata siepahruo'a luo na na si aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata ning a pasiy myarya a ru pata, Agrippa Siepahruo hne Bernis ca Festas bie a chang riypata Sisaria luo ama chiy.
Ning a pasiy myarya ama aw khutaata Festas ta siepahruo kha Paul kaw ca a chang. “Hingpa lie hing Feliks ta thaw a pathla siypa cawsaa pakha a aw.
Jerusalem lie i aw ningta tluobyi lepa tie hne Judah uvthyi tie ta a kaw kha na chang yi te a bie ripa la sue pacu tie ina ta yi.
Kama ta, Rom ming phung ta ca sue be a cuopa ca sue a bepa tie hne a taw pata sue ama bepa kha a sue lina kaw a pasiena bie a ri hluota sue a bepa tie kuv luo pi riypata cuo vyi.
Caacuonakawta hingpa luo ama vya chiy pahne ta cuo pa ru li pata, a mawluopa ta bieripana zung lie kha a tu angte cawsaapa kha kya papya riypata naw i pi yi.
Sue a betuv tie kha a vya daa yi te sue ama vya be tiyta i mangkhuona haata sue be va yi.
Ama biena kawlieta bie amaa inapa hne Zingsuv ama tapa cawsaa pakha thiy te a hring pakhaa ta pata Paul ta a rina kawlieta amaa ina kaw kha ama ri.

Hingpa kaw hing tuokhaatama a sie vie ta i pachang khu aa tapa kha a ruena caw i pachang li nakawta, Paul kha, Jerusalem luo si pata sue aca bepa yi hing capa lie ca ca ripa se angla na khing'a ma i ta.
Cuorasala Paul ta Siepahruo'a luo duo a hu riypata thaw-ing chunglie chi caw riypa kha a khing nakawta thaw-ing chunglie chi caw riypata naw i pi yi,” a ta.
Agrippa ta Festas kha, “Capa paa bie ripa cana kama hrahring ta i thyi khing,” a ta. Festas ta, “Mawluo na thyi aa,” a ta.

Caacuonakawta a mawluopa ca Agrippa hne Bernis ca a rungnaasa pata zaapuv a pungna khuo luo kha riebyilepa tie'a nata khychung nungpaa tie hne khata amaa vya ngie. Cakhutaata Festas ta naw pi yi te Paul ca amaa vya ngiekhyi.

Festas ta, “Siepahruo Agrippa hne kiema hneta hingpa lie a awpa bangkhuo, hing nama hmungpa paa hing Jerusalem lie cuose, hingpa lie hing cuose, Judah ming bangkhuo ta hring a tla vyi ta yi te kama'a lie sue ama bepa paa ta a cuo.
Cuorasala hingpa paa hingta thiy aa phuvpa suena suokha hmuo tue vyi. Rom siepahruo'a luo paduo aa hu nakawta Rom luo paphya riypata bie i chi.

Cuorasala a kaw hing ma siepahruo'a luo cape ciemuo riypa hmung va ang. Caacuonakawta niema zaw bangkhuo hmiekung luo i vya chiykhyi. Siepahruo Agrippa, na hmiekung thathang luo i vya chiykhyi, tahematapakieca ama kha bie ma hiehriy khutaata cape riypa a cawta chuo i hnyi riypata i khing nakawta a cuo.
Kama cuo zaw ta thaw a tlapa pakha sue ama bena kha a sie pata cape khu li pata i paphya riypa ca a phapa ta cuo vyi,” a ta.
Agrippa ta Paul kha, “Na kaw kha nama ta vya ri tie,” a ta. Paul ta a kuv kha vya pazu te a sue lina kaw kha hing haa hingta a ri:
“Siepahruo Agrippa, ataning nama hmiekunglieta Judah ming ta sue ina bepa yi palie hriy pata i sue lina kaw ri the riypa cuo i hmung nakawta i vuo a pha ciemuo ta pata i rue.
Tahematapakieca Judah ming phungluo bangkhuo hne bie amaa ipa bangkhuo a pachang diytuv na cuo nakawta i bie ripa hing palung pasiysa pata naa na thliepa thi tie ta pata paa ica kie.
“Judah ming bangkhuo hingta i cawta baataata tuokhaatama i hring tapa kha ina pachang diy yi. A hruothu baataata kama ca i cawsaa zaw hrawlie hne Jerusalem lie a awpa i cuopa kha ina pachang yi.
Ama ri khing pata a cuo kieca, ma biena lieta a pakang a pahaa cepa Farasi tie ta i cuopa kha ama pachang.
Ata zaw hing Khazing ta ma mingchingmingvuo tie'a lieta a za pipa biekuona i nguopuona kawlieta bieripatuv phuv hmielie i daa pata a cuo.

Ca anguopuona ca Israel ming phang hraa hlyihning ta chung hne zuo hne Khazing zaa bie yi te ma hmung aa ta pata amaa zaa nguopuopa biekuona kha tana a cuo. Vya Abyipa, capa anguopuona kawlie cana, Judah ming ta sue ina bepa yi hingta a cuo.
Khaapanakawma Khazing na a thiypa a pathu pakhaa tapa hing a cuo the li pata nama rue?
“Hmisi ta ripa kieca, Nazareth khy ming Zingsuv kaw hing i du khu thiyta i du aa ta pata kama hrahring zaw i za rue buopa tana a cuo.

Capa ca na Jerusalem lie i za tuepa ta a cuo. Tluobyi lepa tie'a taata nawpina za la angte mingpathepa tie kha thaw chunglie i za pathlapa yi dyi cuo li pata iema ama thiena kawlie zaw a palung zaa tlingkhyipa tana i cuo.

Apungna-ing bangkhuo ta iema kha duo za tele yi angte, Khazing ming ama ripachie riypa kha i zaa zue. Iema cunglie i hi a za haa hringhruo nakawta iema hrisaa riypa khana ruohrang khypuv zaw te ta i sihnuele yi.
“Capa ruena hne cata, tluobyi lepa tie nawpina hne pathliena ta Damaskas khy luo kha i si.
Vya siepahruo, ningchung hraw ta luopuv lie i cakuole nguoluo pata ning laata a khe viepa avuo taata khena kha hmung angte, kama hne i viesaa zaw cahriylie kha a khe.
Ma bangkhuo ta alyi lie maa lie ning kha, Hebru ryi ta, ‘Saul, Saul, khaapanakawma ina hrisaa ciy? Asung cahrepa phyi ta chipa ca nama cuota muo pasana a cuo ta,’ a tapa kha i thyi.
Kama ta, ‘Abyipa, ahungtama na cuo?’ i ta. Abyipa ta, ‘Kama ca na hrisaa nguoluopa Zingsuv tana i cuo,’ ina ta.

Cuorasala thu la na phyi ta a daa tie; tahematapakieca hingpa repa hing tana nama'a lie i luo pata a cuo. Nama ca i changtaapa cuo riypa hne ataning kama kaw na hmungpa hing hne ica pahmung sa kalie riypa kaw kha tehte khuo riypa tana icaa tlaw.
Nama kha ica pathlienapa na cawsaa zaw hraw taa hne Jentail ming'a taata ica khuo aa.

Ama ming kha pavuo sa'a yi cate iema ca zingna taata khena luo, Setaa cahrana taata Khazing'a luo kha amaa vya pali aa. Cakhutaata ama suena taata a ngiethena kha hmung'a yi te kama zangna chunglieta pathesapa tie hrawlie kha ama aw ra aa,’ ina ta.
“Cakhutaa cata, Siepahruo Agrippa, kama ta capa vuoruo taata muocuo ca pa-uvsathyi li pata aw khu va ang.

A hmietaa ce ta Damaskas lie a awpa tie, cakhutaa Jerusalem hne Judea ruo chung bangkhuo hne Jentail ming'a luo te khata ama suena kha a ngiepachiy yi te Khazing'a luo amaa vya pali riypa hne ama sue a ngiepachiyna kha tuena ta ama paluo sa riypata phung kha i chang yi.
Capa kawlie ca tana Judah ming ta biena-ing chunglie kha na patuv yi te thie inaa nang yi.

Ataning tepa hingta Khazing ta na due te, hingpa lie hing a daa pata, a le a caw hmiekunglieta tehte i khuo pata a cuo. I ripa ca a hrangpa cuo li pata, Moses hne profet tie ta ama za ripa kha vya tling'a te,
Judah ming hne Jentail ming'a lie khuona khena kha pathyi sa riypata Messiah ca ruvnaana kha ang'a te thiyna taata pathu pakhaapa hmietaa cepa ta a cuo aa, tapa hing tana a cuo,” a ta.
Paul ta a sue lina kaw a ri nguoluopa khata, Festas ta vya khisue te, “Paul, na palung a hmuo va tli! A hluv tuv caw cate na naa ngaakhyi tli!” a ta.
Cuorasala Paul ta, “I palung aa hmuo lipa cuo vyi, Abyipa Festas, cuorasala lungsingpya tana biedangpa ica chang.

Hmisi ta kieca, siepahruo ta hingpa hmang kaw hing a pachang diy, caacuonakaw tana ama'a lie hing hyazangsa pata bie i ri. Tahematapakieca hingpa hmang hing nu pata, a cakiy lie tuepa a cuo li nakawta pachang li pata aw vaciy ta pata i zang.
Siepahruo Agrippa, profet tie na zang yi ma? Na zang tapa kha ica pachang,” a ta.
Agrippa ta Paul kha, “Hing cuo pachangta chunglie hing ma Khrihsaa pacuo sa inaa ting ciy?” a ta.
Paul ta, “A catli zaw a haa zaw nama dyi hmuo cuo li pata ataning i bie a naathliepa bangkhuo hingta kama haata nama cuo riypata thlaa i chuo, i thaabuoliriy hing ta li pata,” ta pata a palie.
Cakhutaata siepahruo ca a daa te, muokiybyipa hne Bernis hne iema hne a tupa tie zaw kha amaa daa ra.
Ama pyapuole pata, pakha hne pakha kha, “Hingpa paa hingta thawtla aa phuvpa hne thiy aa phuvpa suena a tuepa aw vyi,” amaa ta.
Agrippa ta Festas kha, “Hingpa paa hing Rom siepahruo'a luo na paduo aa hu va tapa kieca pathlie riypa tana a cuo raalaa aa,” a ta.
Italy luo tiypalaw ta si riypata bie chipa a cuo tiyta, Paul hne a hrangpa thaw a tlapa chekha kha Awkastas Riekaphuv tapa lieta riebyipa Julius kuv raw luo kha ama palaw.
Asia pe tiypalaw a dingnapa khy zaw capiepaale pata si a nangpa Adramittium khy taata tiypalaw kha maa khang. Masidonia ruo Thesalonika khy ming Aristarkas zaw kha kiema'a lie ca a si ra.
A mawluopa ta Sidon khy kha ma pha. Julius ca Paul'a lie kha phasa te a viesaa zaw'a luo cakuo riypa hne a viesaa zaw ta aa huna haata vya pihluo riypa hne mangchiy riypa zaw kha a pase.
Capa taa cata si pate kiemakuo luo dyi ta thliy a vya hruo nakawta, Saipras parala ruo thliynena luo kuo khata ma si.
Riyliy kha Silisia hne Pamfilia a dadaw taa khata te pate Lisia pe Mira khy luo kha ma pha.
Capa lie ca riebyipa ca ta Alekzandria taata Italy luo a si'a nangpa tiypalaw kha hmung te malie a pakhang sa.

Ning pasiypuv chung duvsaa ta malie sikhyi te a ruvsa pata Nidas khy a dadaw te kha ma pha. Thliy kha kiema'a luota aa vya hruo nakawta Krit parala thliynena luota si pate Salmon a rie-e luo kha ma chiy.
Ngiekuo hne aa ngieta khata a ruvsa pata si pate Lisia khypuv athaalie a awpa Hnaanguo Palaw Adingna ama tapa luo ma chiy.
Cuo pasiypuv pachuo tli pate, Athlana Ning kha a law tli nakawta tiypalaw ta sipa zaw kha ciy aa chiysa tli. Caacuonakawta Paul ta ruena pi yi te,
“I byipaa zaw, hingpa taa hingta ma luopuv hing ciy a chiy te rakyina lepuv zaw maa taw khu. Hmang hne tiypalaw dyi cuo li pata ma hringna zaw maa sung khu tapa tana i hmung,” a ta yi.
Cuorasala riebyipa ta Paul ripa laa khata tiypalaw byipa hne a hnyituvpa ripa kha a zang vie.

Tiypalaw a dingnapa ca thlasiy chung awna riypata a pha li nakawta hluv vie bangkhuo ta ca si pata Finiks ma pha khu kieca, capa lie ca thlasiy chung aw pata ama khing. Finiks ca Krit parala lie tiypalaw a dingna ta cuo te sungluo ningtlaluo hne chaluo ningtlaluo pachaw pata a awpa tana a cuo.

Sungluo taata thlasiy thliy neziyliy khata a kya hruo te ama tingnapa kha ima pha khu aa ta pata ama rue nakawta thaatungkyipa kha a dapuole yi te ngiekuo hne aa ngieta khata Krit parala luo ca ma si.
Cuorasala a ru hluota Krit luo taata, ningchiy chaluo thliy ama tapa khuosa ta a zaa hruo.
Ma tiypalaw ca thliy ta za de te hmieluo ma tung khu li nakawta thliy ca maa paphya sa thluo.
Kauda parala ruo cawta sungluo kuo thliynena hmang ma chiy taata tiypalaw ta aa cakelepa sawkawpalaw ca a ruvsapa ta a phata tah ma pachie hru.
Tiypalaw cung luo kha khang yi te khuhriy ta a cusa pata ama ciypuo. Sirtis viehnang tluo kha suv'a kie tapa ama ciy nakawta a pangzu kha pachung yi te tiypalaw ca thliy kha ama paphya sa.
Thliy ta khuopuv ta malie a de nguoluo thluo nakawta a mawluopa ta ca tiypalaw cunglie hmang kha ama thaw.
A ning thungnapa ta ca tiypalaw chechiy kha iema kuv ta la yi te ama thaw.
Ning pasiypuv chung ning cuose, aasiy cuose a luo li pata thliychie ca aa hruo nguoluo thluo nakawta, a hnangcaw ta ca hring riy'apa hmuo a nguopuo khu va tli puv.
Sa ning li pata a pasiypuv ama aw nakawta, Paul ca iema hrawlie kha a daa te, “Uvnu zaw, i ripa kha na zaa ngie ung la Krit taa khata si li pata ma aw kieca hing rakyina hing a taw'a vapuv.
Cuorasala nama thlaa zang khah se, tiypalaw dyi hing ra'a te niema hrawlieta pakha hmuo thiy'a va ung ciy.
Tahematapakieca azuohnie khana naa hnyituv hne i biepa Khazing avuoming i thaalie zaa daa te,
‘Paul, ciy khah, Rom siepahruo hmielie naa daa ngiethie aa; na khy tlawhnepa bangkhuo hringna zaw hing aa bang aa, ina ta,’ a ta.
Caacuonakawta, nama thlaa zang khah se, uvnu zaw, tahematapakieca ina changpa haa hingta a cuo hrahring aa ta pata Khazing'a lie zangna i hnyi.
Cuorasala thliy ta parala suokhakha luo malie a pazu aa,” a ta.
Zuo hraa hlyipaliynapa vya chiy te Adria riyliy va te pata thliy ta malie a phyale ning kha tiypalaw rehrietuv tie khata tluo hne tana maa ngie tli ta pata ama palung a hring.
Tiy kha ama taa ca luo kiy a ta. A cawta a awpa ta taa pakhaa yi te luo hraa hlyipangaa a tapa kha ama hmung.
Alung suv'a kie puv tapa kha ama ciy nakawta tiypalaw a hnangluo taa khata thaatungkyipa suopaliy kha pathla yi te thlaachuona hne khydyi riypa dyi kha ama huo.
Cuorasala tiypalaw rehrietuv tie kha a ruo a ting yi te, thaatungkyipa na ma pathla tapa haa khata a pa-aw sa yi te tiypalaw taa khata sawkawpalaw kha ama pachung.
Paul ta riebyipa hne rieka tie kha, “Hingpa cawsaa zaw hingna tiypalaw chunglie a aw va yi tapa kieca, hring khu'a va ung ciy,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaa cata rieka tie ta sawkawpalaw riy kha a cepachung yi te tiy ama paphya.
Khy a dyi hluota lie kha Paul ta iema bangkhuo kha sa ning riypata a chang yi. “Sa ning lipa'a nata kharuehaa vuosuo pata nama awnapa hing ataning ta ca ning hraa hlyipaliy a ta mangtli.
Caacuonakawta nama hringna cuota aa hu nakawta sa nama ning riypata paa ica kie yi. Tahematapakieca nama luv cunglieta suobuv buv kha hmuo vie'a vyi,” a ta yi.
Cahaacata a ri khutaata viechuo kha la te, Khazing kha alawna bie a hluo khutaata iema bangkhuo hmiekunglie kha chechi te a ning.
Ama bangkhuo ta ama thaa kya pha te sa kha ama ning kaluo.
(Khy a tlawpa ma bangkhuo ta zahning sawsariy pacaruv ma ta.)
Ama riy bisa pata ama ning diy khutaata tiypalaw kha a hy vie naase ta pata a chunglie jungsacuo kha tiy chung luo ama thaw.

Maw khy a kya dyi tiyta, tiypalaw rehrietuv tie ta ama hmungpa tluo kha pachang khu va yi. Cuorasala riyliy syipahyana lie ngiekuo kha ama va hmung tiyta a cuo khu kieca capa lie ca tiypalaw kha pading sa riypata amaa ting.

Caacuonakawta thaatungkyipa kha riyliy chunglie ama pathla siy. Cakhutaata tiypalaw mawnapa ama ciypuopa khuhriy kha ama pathluo. Ngiekuo luo a si the riypa khata a pangzu kha zu yi te tiypalaw ca thliy ama paphya sa.
Cuorasala viehnangtluo kha va suv te aa tuo thluo. Tiypalaw a luv luo a daw ca viehnang lie kha a vaa capang. Cuorasala a hnangluo kha tiylaw ta khuosa ta a de nakawta kechi te a kyi.
Rieka tie ta thaw a tlapa bangkhuo kha tiy a zu pata amaa ruo li riypata thie diy amaa nang.
Cuorasala riebyipa ta Paul kha a khuo khing nakawta amaa tingna haata patue sa va yi. Tiy a zu thepa bangkhuo ca tiypalaw taata a zupathla pata, tiy a zu pata ngiekuo luo pya riypa hne
aa ngaapa tie ca thingphie zaw tiypalaw kyinapa zaw kha a patuv kaluo riypata naw a pi yi. Cahaacata cawsaa bangkhuo ca aa bangta tah ngiekuo luo ma pha diy.
Ngiekuo luo aa bangsa pata ma chiy taata, capa parala ca Malta ama tapa parala ta a cuopa kha ma pachang.
Capa ruo ming ca kiema cunglieta ama pha hringhruo. Khy vya saa te a kangsa nakawta myi patiy yi te malie cadung sa yi te malie ama patu sa.
Paul ca thingpahri kha pakhaw te myi luo a hmawpa ta myi a ling nakawta thing chungtaata pariy sakha kya pya te Paul kuv kha a kaze.

Capa ruo ming ca ta pariy kha Paul kuv lie aa pathlie thluopa ama hmung tiyta, pakha hne pakha kha, “Hingpa paa hing cawsaa a thiepa tana a cuo aa; riyliy chungtaata hmuo hyazangna hmung ra sala adangna ta ca hring riypata pahya vyi,” amaa ta.
Cadyiseca Paul ta a kuv taa khata myi chung luo thypathla te ama ca khaapahmuo ta vyi.

Khatiy tama a pangpa bangkhuo ta kya thling'a te a liepatyi'a te a thiy aa tapa kha ama mangkhuo. A pasiypuv mangkhuo yi te khaapahmuo a ta li taata ama palung kha thle yi te, “Hingpa paa hing khazing pakha tana a cuo,” amaa ta.
Capa hmang hne aa ngie puonapa hmang lie kha capa parala uvtuv byipa Publius luruo kha a aw. Ama ta ing malie a patlung sa te ning thung chung a phasa pata malie a mangchiy.
Publius paa ca ngeling pata hne thiysechungparuo ta pasa te iehmang cunglie aa zie. Paul ta va parie te, a luv cunglie a kuv khang te, thlaachuopa te a patluo sa.
Capa hmang a cuo khutaa cata capa parala lie a awpa a tluo lipa bangkhuo kha a vaw yi te a patluo sa yi.
Lasaw a hluvsa malie pi yi te ma si'a nang taata zaw maa hupa bangkhuo kha tiypalaw cunglie malie ama sangpa diy.
Thla thung khutaata capa parala lie ca thlasiy chung a awpa, “Mingphie Uvcanu” ama tapa Alekzandria tiypalaw kha a khang pate ma si.
Sirakus ama tapa khy kha pha pate capa lie ca ning thung ma aw.
Cakhutaata, si pakhaa pate Rhekium ama tapa khy kha ma pha. A mawluopa ta sungluo thliy a kya hruo te a hezuoningpa ta Puteoli khy luo kha ma chiy.
Capa lie ca zangtuv uvnu zaw za aw yi te malie ama thlu nakawta zaa kha ma aw siy. Cakhutaata Rom luo ma vya si.

Capa lie a awpa zangtuv tie ta ma kaw kha malie ama thyi tiyta, Appius Chadaw ma tapa hne Banglaa Suothung tapa hmang te kha malie ama vya daw. Paul ta a hmung tiy yi ta Khazing pathuosa te thaazuo aa la.
Rom luo ma chiy tiyta, Paul ca ama a huo riypa rieka pakha pi yi te amata tah awna naw ama pi.

Ning thung khutaata Paul ta capa lie a awpa Judah uvthyi tie kha a ku pakhaw yi. Amaa vya hmya tiyta, Paul ta, “Uvnu zaw, ma cawsaa hne ma mingchingmingvuo tie phungluo kha i du li raalaa pata Jerusalem lie kha na patuv yi te Rom ming kuv luo ina pi tli yi.
Bie ina hiehriy tiy yi ta thiy aa phuvpa suena i tuepa khaapahmuo ama hmung li nakawta iema ta ina pathlie khing yi.
Cuorasala Judah ming ta ama khing li nakawta i cawsaa zaw cunglie suena khaapahmuo i tue li raalaa pata Rom siepahruo'a luo kha paduo i hie.
Capa kawlie ca ta caa taw yi angte niema hne bie icaa ruepa yi hingta a cuo. Hingpa thaabuoliriy ta ina cakhiypa yi hing Israel ming anguopuona kawlie tana a cuo,” a ta yi.
Iema ta, “Nama kawlie hingta Judea ruo taata caa hmung vapuv, a vaw pata na pha lina kaw caa vya ripa pakha hmuo aw va yi.
Cuorasala tuokhaatama na rue tapa kha nama'a taata ma thyi khing, tahematapakieca hingpa phuv kaw hne a patuvpa hingta hmangting lieta a duna bie ama rilepa ca ma pachang,” ama ta.

Ama hne a tawna riypa ning kha ama thli khutaata, aa rina luo kha a hluvpuv amaa vaw. Maw taata zuoluo te ta Khazing pena kaw kha tehte khuo te a pasie sa. Zingsuv kaw kha Moses phungbie taa hne profet caa-uv chung taa khata a changpasie yi.
Chekha ca a ripa kha ama palung vuo te, chekha ta ca zang va yi.

Caacuonakawta pakha hne pakha kha ama palung a lu khu vyi. Cahaacata ama pyapuolepa khata Paul ta, “Profet Isaiah taata Thlaapa Pathe ta nama mingchingmingvuo tie'a luo a za ripa hing aa hmuopa tana a cuo. A ripa ca:
‘Hingpa cawsaa zaw'a luo hing vaa la va chang tie yi, Naa ca nama thlie raalaa aa, cuorasala a siyluo pachang the'a va ung ciy, a mang ca nama mang raalaa aa, cuorasala hmungpasie the'a va ung ciy.

Tahematapakieca hingpa cawsaa tie palung ca ping te, ama naa ca thyi khu li pata, ama ming kha ama pasing; capa ca ama ming ta mang li'apa yi ta, ama naa ta thyi li'apa yi ta, ama palung ta pachang the li'apa yi ta, kama'a luo amaa vya pali li riypa hne kama ta i patluo sa li riypa yi kha tana a cuo,’ a ta.
Caacuonakawta ica pachang sa khingpa yi ca, Khazing khuona hing Jentail ming'a luo pasi pata cuo'a te iema ta ama cuhluo aa,” a ta.
(Paul ta hingpa bie a ri khu taa hingta Judah ming ca iema hne iema kha khuopuv ta amaa ipuole pata ama pya.)
Kung hning chung bangkhuo Paul ca amata tah aa hluopa ing lie kha aw te, ama a vya tawpa bangkhuo kha a cuhluo yi.
Khazing pena hne Zingsuv kaw kha riepha ciemuopa hne a pakhuopa aw li pata u khyi te a pacuv yi.
Zingsuv Khrih changtaapa hne lucuotuv riypata kupa, Khazing thuophaa phu riypata a nanang ta chipa,
profet tie hmuo pata sacapaa hne aa patuvpa Caapathe thuophaa chunglie bie za kuolupa,
thiysaa luo ta ripa kieca David ciypathla cuo te,
thlaapa luo hne a pathena luo kuo ta ripa kieca cahrana lepuv ta thiyna taata pathupa Khazing Sacapaa ma Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih thueta,
a vihnyina hne lucuotuv cuona kha hmung pata,
Zingsuv huota kupa niema hrahring zaw a te ra pata Jentail ming kha zangna chung luo a vya chiy riypata changpa, kama Paul ta,

A cawsaa pathepa cuo riypata Khazing ta ku te a duepa Rom lie a awpa bangkhuo kha: Ima Paa Khazing hne Abyipa Zingsuv Khrih'a taata vihnyina hne thlaalungna ca nama cunglie aw mang sue, ta pata bie icaa chang yi.
A suokhana ta, nama zangna ca chuelyi bangkhuo a pathuo nakawta, niema kawlie ca ta Zingsuv Khrih thueta i Khazing kha i pathuosa.
A sacapaa kaw thuophaa kha pathiypalung hmisi ta i phupa Khazing ca i thlaachuona lie niema kha ci li ta icaa thyipa yi kha naa pachangkhyituv a cuo.
Khazing ta luo na pahawpa sala a ru hluota niema'a luo ica vya tlaw khuna riypa yi ta thlaa i chuo.
Tahematapakieca niema hmung kha a ngietie lipa angta niema hne thlaapa lasaw kha a hraw pata thaazuo ica pi khing yi.
Capa ca niema hne kama kha ma zangna ta thaazuo a pi kaluo riypa kha tana a cuo.

Uvnu hne sieta zaw, ica pachang sa khingpa yi ca, niema tlaw riypa hing yi hluvpuv i ting tli, cuorasala naa pakhuopa suokhakha a aw pari. Jentail ming hrangpa'a taata ama palung i pathle sapa ama awpa haata niema hraw taa zaw ta a palung a thlepa pa-aw sa riypa ca i khing hringhruo.
Kama hing Grik ming hne Grik ming a cuo lipa tie'a lie cuose, a singpa hne a ngaapa tie'a lie zaw lyibuo i hnyi.
Caacuonakawta niema Rom lie a awpa tie'a lie zaw thuophaa phu riypa i khing hringhruopa cata a cuo.
Thuophaa hing zaakhyi va ang; tahematapakieca a zangpa bangkhuo khuona ama hmung riypata Khazing cahrana tana a cuo, Judah ming cuota cuo taa te Grik ming cuo zaw ta a cuo ra.
Caapathe chunglieta, “Aa dangpa cawsaa ca zangna tana a hring aa,” a tapa haata, zangna lieta aa bangpa, Khazing ta adangna kaw a ripa bie ca zangna cuo khata thuophaa chunglie ca aa luo.
Khazing hihaana ca vuoruo taata zaa luo te, iema pha lina ta biehmisipa a pakhuopa tie ama pha lina bangkhuo hne Khazing ama pachang lina kha aa du.
Tahematapakieca iema ta Khazing ama pachangkhuna riypa luo kha Khazing ta iema'a lie a siesa pata a paluo sa thluo.
Chuelyi hruothu baataata chuozaa ta aa hmangpa a cuona hne a cahrana ca, hmung khu a cuo li raalaa pata, a tuepa hmang taata pachang khu pata a cuo. Iema ca a ngiethe pata cuo'a va yi;

tahematapakieca Khazing kha ama pachang thluo pata ama hne aa phuvpa pa-uvsathyina kha pi lipa yi ta aa law zaw a law va yi. Ama ruena kha vievuv te, ruena a hnyi lipa ama pathiypalung ca a zing ta a zing.
Ma sing amaa ta raalaa pata a ngaapa tana ama cuo.
A thiy khu lipa Khazing rungnaana cuopa khata a thiykhupa cawsaa hne pavaa, acuolikie phyipaliypa saruopa hne aa va ta a vapa saruopa hne aa lupa kuvtuezuv kha amaa bie.
Caacuonakawta Khazing ta ama pathiypalung ta a hietliepa hmang pyalyipa kha patue sa thluo yi te, iema pakha hne pakha cunglie ama pangpa ling a pazue sapa hmang kha ama tue.
Tahematapakieca Khazing biehmisipa kha hangna ta thle yi te, satuv laata sapa kha abie yi te a re ama hrie. Satuv khana chuozaa pathuosa riypata a cuo! Amen.

Cahaacata a cuo nakawta Khazing ta iema kha pangpa ling a pazue sapa hmang hietliena luo kha a pathlie yi. Ama canung tie kha tahmuo tue phungpa awhnena kha hmuo lipa yi ta tue phung lipa awhnena kha ama hmuo.

Cahaa ngiethie cata capaa zaw ta canung hne tue phungpa awhnena kha thuse yi te capaa hne capaa tlaku ama aw hne. Capaa hne capaa ta nangzaa aa chiypa hmang kha ama tue nakawta iema hne aa phuvpa duotena kha ama hmung.
Cahaacata, iema ta Khazing pachang khingna pathiypalung kha ama hnyi li nakawta, Khazing ta a pyalyipa pathiypalung hnyi riypa khata pathlie thluo yi te tue li riypa hmang kha ama tue.
Iema ca chiena hne pha lina phangting, karuo-awna hne i-awna, hietliena, lienawna, aduna, hanghiena, zyatena hneta ama bi. Pakha hne pakha amaa caw-yi,
ama thuo amaa pachi, Khazing kha siysaa ri va yi, malie kha ama ese, ahruo ama tle, amaa pale, chiena tue kha ama rue byalya, nungpaa ri a ngie va yi,
ama ngaa, zangna hnyi va yi, nangduena hnyi va yi, malie kha ngiechi khing va yi.

Hing haa hingta a hringpa bangkhuo ca thiy amaa phuv tapa Khazing biechina kha ama pachang thluo raalaa pata, iema ama tuepa hlyitaw taata kha haapa hmang pha lipa a tuepa tie kha ama palung a tlingkhyi.

Caacuonakawta ahung nama cuo zaw ta a sie khu'a va ung ciy; tahematapakieca malie cunglie bieripana nama hnyi tiyta, ama tuepa kha nama tue ra thluo nakawta niema mamaapa khana sue bie namaa ripa pata a cuo.
“Niema ta, hing haapa hmang a tuepa tie cunglieta Khazing biechina hing aa hmuopa tana a cuo,” nama ta.
Ahungtama i cuo tapa kha namaa rue buo ma? Malie kha bie nama ripa tiyta iema tuepa kha nama tue ra thluo nakawta Khazing bieripana taata ima law thlu aa ta pata namaa rue ma?
Acuolikie a lepa a duena hne a palungpasiyna hne a ngiechina hing siysaa ri li pata aw kanaa ung ciy? Khazing duena ca sue a ngiepachiyna luo caa chiytuv tana a cuo tapa kha pachang va ung ca ma?
Cuorasala nama palung a le tuv nakawta Khazing ta adangna hne bie a chi ning, Khazing hihaana ning thueta nama cunglie a tlung riypa khana namaa pacung chiy tyly pata a cuo.
Pakha cyicuo kha ama tuena haata a thung'a yi.
Hmang phapa kha palung pasiysa pata tue yi te rungnaana, pa-uvsathyina hne a ra khu lipa chuozaa hringna a huvpa tie ca Khazing ta chuozaa hringna kha a pi'a yi.
Ama kaw dyi a pacuo te biehmisipa kha thuse pata pha lina a tuepa tie cunglie ca Khazing pathiylingna hne a ie ta a iepa a hihaana kha a tlung aa.
Pha lina a tuepa bangkhuo ca ruvnaana hne te-angna ama hmung aa; Judah ming ta hmung taa'a yi te Jentail ming ta ama paziy aa.
Cuorasala phana a tuepa bangkhuo ca rungnaana hne pa-uvsathyina hne thlaalungna kha ama hmung aa. Judah ming ta hmung taa'a yi te Jentail ming ta ama paziy aa.
Khazing ca ahung hmie hmuo mang vyi.
Phungbie li pata suena a tuepa tie ca phungbie li pata ra'a yi te, phungbie rawlieta a suepa tie ca phungbie ta bie ripa pata ama cuo aa.
Tahematapakieca Khazing hmiekunglie aa dangpa tie ca phungbie a thyipa tie khata cuo va yi, phungbie a ziypa tie kha na duopacu pata a cuo yi.
Phungbie a hnyi lipa Jentail ming ta, phungbie hmuo hnyi li pata aw raalaa yi sala, phungbie ta tue ung la a tapa kha palung thusa pata ama tuepa ca iema cuota phungbie na a cuo thluo.

Phungbie ta tue ung la a tapa kha ama palung chungliena aa cape tapa kha iema ta ama paluo sa. Ama chiepha thleduona khata ama tuepa hing aa hmuo ta pata aa daakhyi ning yi aw te, ama ruenapa khata sue a be ning yi hne a paduo ning yi a aw.
Kama i phupa thuophaa haa hingta, Khazing ta Zingsuv thueta cawsaa palungruv ruena kha bie a ripa ning thue ca cahaaca tana a cuo aa.
Caacuonakawta niema hne niema kha Judah ming a ta ung cate, phungbie lie kha a daa ung cate, Khazing hne namaa pazuena kawlie kha namaa pale.
Cakhutaata a khingna kha pachang ung cate phungbie ta pacuvpa nama cuo nakawta khaapama a pha ce tapa kha namaa tlaw the.
Niema hne niema kha mingcue tie luochiytuv, a zingna lie a awpa tie cuota khena,
a ngaapa tie pasiypa-yatuv hne haatiy tie pacuvtuv tana ma cuo tapa kha namaa pachang, tahematapakieca phungbie chunglie hing pachangna hne biehmisipa a tling pata ma hnyi nama ta.
Cakhutaata niema malie a pacuvtuv saya zaw, niema'a na niema ca haw a pacuv'a nang va ung ca ma? Paruv khah ung ta pata ri ung cate ma niema ta nama paruv?
Nungvaathingsuena tue khah ung ta ung cate ma niema ta nungvaathingsuena nama tue? Kuvtuezuv ca duvsa ung cate ma biena-ing chechiy ca nama paruv?
Phungbie lie a palepa tie, phungbie para ung cate ma Khazing ming nama pachie?
Caapathe lieta, “Niema Judah ming kawlie tana Jentail ming hrawlie Khazing thuo a chi,” a ta.
Phungbie nama ziy kie muo nama vangdaw a tena ca muo a hnyi'a ta; phungbie nama para kieca vangdaw a te lipa hne tana namaa lu aa.
