Caacuonakawta, vangdaw a te lipa paa ta phungbie kha a ziy kieca vangdaw a tepa paa haata rue pata cuo'a va ma?
Saapa lie vangdaw aa te li thluo pata phungbie a ziypa tie ta phungbie caa-uv hnyi te vangdaw aa te raalaa pata phungbie a parapa tie kha suebie aca ripa'a yi.
Caacuonakawta leluo cuonapa taa dyi ta Judah ming a cuopa ca Judah ming hmisipa ta cuo li pata leluo saapa ta vangdaw a tena ca vangdaw a tena hmisi ta cuo vyi.

A chung luo taata Judah ming a cuopa kha Judah ming hmisipa ta cuo te, vangdaw a tena hmisipa ca pathiypalung hne aa patuvpa hmang tana a cuo, thlaapa hmang ta cuo te caa ta capepa bie ta cuo vyi. Cahaapa cawsaa ca a hrang taata cuo li pata Khazing'a taata pathuosana kha a hmung aa.
Caacuokieca Judah ming amaa thung viena ca khaapa hingta ma a cuo? Acuolikie vangdaw a tena muo ca khaapa hingta ma a cuo?
Amaa thung viena a phangphang tana a aw. A suokhana ta Khazing bie kha cake sapa ta ama cuo.
A che kha zang aa tla lipa ama cuo kie haw, tuokhaatama a cuo aa? Iema zang tluo amaa tla lina khata Khazing zang tluo atlana kha a para'a ma?

Cuo changchiy vyi. Cawsaa bangkhuo hing a hangpa ma cuo zaw ta, Khazing ca zang tluo aa tla pari aa. Caapathe ta, “Na ripa bie ta aa dangpa na cuopa kha paluo sa'a te, na bie aca ripa thue yi ta na te aa,” a tapa haa khata a cuo aa.
Cuorasala kiema maa dang lina ta Khazing adangna kha a sie vie ta a paluo sa kieca, khaapama ri riypa a aw'a tli? Khazing ta duo malie a te tiyta a dang vyi ma ta'a ma? (Saapa bie na i ri).
Cuo changchiy vyi. Caacuokieca Khazing ta chuelyi hing tuokhaatama bie a ripa khu aa?
Cuorasala i hangthena hingta Khazing adangna kha paluo sa hryly te a ming rungnaana ta a cuo kieca, khaapanakawma kama ca a suepa haata bie ripapa i cuo kalie riypa a aw?

Khaapanakawma, cawsaa chekha ta malie pachie yi te, iema na a ri yi ta pata ama rilepa bie haa khata, “Phana aa vaw riypata hmang pha lipa tue'a ung puv,” ma ta va ung? Aa phuvsa pata suebie ripa pata ama cuo aa.
Caacuokieca tuokhaata? Kiema hing ma pha vie ung ma? Cuo changchiy vyi; ma ri ciepa haa khata Judah ming hne Grik ming hne suena cahrana rawlieta a awpa tana ma cuo.
Caapathe ta, “Aa dangpa pakha hmuo aw va yi, pakhata hmuo aw va yi;
Pachangna a hnyipa pakha hmuo aw lipa yi ta, Khazing a huvpa pakha hmuo aw va yi.
Ama bangkhuo ta sichie diy yi te, hmuosa a phapa pakha hmuo aw va yi. Kawpacuona a hnyipa pakha hmuo aw lipa yi ta, pakhata hmuo aw va yi.”
“Ama rawkariy ca aa pahawpa thluokhue haata cuo te, ama palyi kha dungna ta ama hmuo.” “Ama hmya rawlie pariy ca-ie aw te,
ama pakaa ca chiesana hne biechiepa ta a bi.”
“Thiyse palang riypata ama phyi kha a catli;
rana hne cuopasana kha ama luopuv lie bi te,
diena luopuv kha pachang va yi.”
“Ama ming padyi lieta Khazing ciyzaana aw vyi,” a tapa haa kha tana a cuo.

Ata hing ca phungbie ta tuokhaata a ri zaw ta, phungbie rawlie a awpa tie huota a ripa kha pachang pate, cahaacata a cuopa ca cawsaa mekaa kha duo yi sala, chuelyi yalya hing Khazing hmielie zang tluo aa tlana riypa kha tana a cuo.
“Phungbie ta a ripa ama tuena thueta ahunghmuo Khazing hmiekunglie duopacupa aw va yi,” tahematapakieca phungbie ca ama suena tlaku khana a paluo sa.
Cuorasala ata hing ca phungbie thueta cuo li pata luopuv hrang taata Khazing adangna ca a luo te phungbie hne profet tie zaw ta amaa daakhyi.
Zingsuv zangna thueta hmungpa ca Khazing adangna cuo te zangtuv bangkhuo cuota a cuo. Tahematapakieca pahlyipalena khaapahmuo aw vyi,
ma bangkhuo ta a suepa cuo pate Khazing rungnaana hneta imaa hla diy.
Cuorasala kiema ca Khrih Zingsuv'a taata a vawpa khuona taata, a vihnyina thueta lasaw ta duopacupa tana ma cuo.

Zingsuv Khrih ca Khazing ta a thiyse ta sue angiethena satuv riypata a chipa cuo te capa a ngiethena ca Zingsuv Khrih zangna thueta hmung riypa tana a cuo. Khazing ta hingpa hmang a tuepa hing ama adangna kha paluo sa riypa tana a cuo, tahematapakieca hluo ningta ama tuepa suena kha palung pasiysa pata a ngiethe yi te,
ata hing ca ama kha aa dangpa a cuona hne Zingsuv a zangtuv tie duopacupa ama cuona kha paluo sa riypata a cuo.
Caacuokieca, hruotle riypa khaapama a aw? Khaapahmuo aw vyi. Phungbie ma ziy nakawta a cuo ma? Cuo vyi. Zangna thue tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca cawsaapa hing phungbie ta a ripa re hriena thueta cuo li pata zangna thueta duopacupa a cuopa kha ma ri tli.
Acuolikie Khazing ca Judah ming Khazing dyi tama a cuo? Jentail ming Khazing zaw ta cuo ra va ma? A cuo, Jentail ming Khazing zaw ta a cuo ra.
Khazing ca pakha ta a cuo nakawta vangdaw a tepa tie kha zangna ta duopacu sa'a yi te, vangdaw a te lipa tie zaw kha zangna ngiethie ta duo a pacu sa'a yi.
Caacuokieca zangna thueta phungbie ca ma thaw tana ta a cuo ma? Cuo changchiy vyi. Phungbie khana ma pacu sa vie.
Caacuokieca malie a pathlatuv Abraham hing thiysaa luo hne aa patuv pata khaapa thlahnena ma a hmung?
Tahematapakieca, Abraham hing tuena thue tana duopacupa a cuo ta pata a cuo kieca, hruotle khyi riypa chekha a hnyi aa. Cuorasala Khazing hmiekunglie ca hruotle khyi riypa hnyi vyi.
Caapathe ta khaapa a ta ma? “Abraham ta Khazing kha zang te, capa a zangna ca adangna ta cuhluopa pata a cuo,” a ta.
Re a hriepa pakha ca a ninghlue kha lasaw tapa pata cuo vyi. A hrie muo tana a cuo.
Cuorasala tuena ta cuo li pata cawsaa pha lipa tie zaw amaa dang a tatuv Khazing a zangpa ca, a zangna khana adangna ta a cuhluopa.
Caacuonakawta tuena a te li pata Khazing ta aa dangpa ta a cuhluopa paa thluechiypa a cuonazya David ta a ripa ca:
“Khazing ta ama pha lina a ngiethe yi te, ama suena a buvkhungpa tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo.
Khazing ta a suenapa sue ta a ripa lipa ca thluechiypa tana a cuo,” a ta.
David ta a ripa thluechiy ca vangdaw tepa tie cuo dyi tama a cuo, vangdaw te lipa tie cuo zaw ta a cuo ra ma? Ma ripa ca, “Abraham zangna ca Khazing ta adangna ta a cuhluopa,” ta pata a cuo.
Tuokhaatama cuhluopa pata a cuo? Vangdaw aa te hluo ta ma aa te khutaata? Vangdaw aa te khutaata cuo vyi, aa te hluo tana a cuo.

Abraham ta vangdaw tepa cuona paluosanapa, a dangpa cuona ca vangdaw aa te hluo baataa khata zangna ta a cuhluo mangtli. Capa ca ama kha vangdaw a te li pata a zangpa tie paa ta pacuo sa riypa hne iema zaw bangkhuo kha adangna pi riypata a cuo.

Cahaacata ama ca vangdaw a tepa tie mingchingmingvuo ta zaw a cuo ngiethie, iema ca vangdaw amaa tepa dyi cuo li pata mingpa Abraham vangdaw aa te hluota a zangna hringzya haa khata ama hring ra nakawta a cuo.
Tahematapakieca chuelyi na na cu aa tapa biekuo ca Abraham hne a ciypathla tie ta phungbie ziyna taata ama hmungpa ta cuo vyi, cuorasala zangna ta hmungpa adangna thue tana a cuo.
Phungbie a ziypa tie na rucutuv a cuo'a yi tapa a cuo kieca zangna ca khaapatahmuo cuo li'a pata biekuona zaw a hrihripa tana a cuo aa.
Tahematapakieca phungbie ta ca Khazing hihaana kha chiykhyi te, cuorasala phungbie aw lina lie ca phungbie na ama patluo tapa zaw aw vyi.

Caacuonakawta biekuona ca zangna lieta hruo a bangpa cuo te, a vihnyina thueta Abraham ciypathla tie'a lieta vihnyina ta biekuopa tana a cuo. Phungbie a ziypa tie'a lie dyi cuo li pata Abraham zangna haata a zangpa tie cuo zaw ta a cuo.

(Tahematapakieca, “Mingphang hluvpuv paa tana ica tue tli”) ta pata Caapathe lie aa capepa haata ama ca a thiypa tie kha hringna pi yi te a aw lipa zaw a pa-aw satuv, ama ta a zangpa Khazing hmiekunglieta kiema zaw bangkhuo paa tana a cuo.
“Na ciypathla ca ama hluv hringhruo aa,” ta pata ri ciepa haata aruechuona khaapahmuo a aw lipa chung taa khata, “Mingphang hluvpuv paa tana i cuo aa,” tapa kha a zang.
Ama ca kung zakha a ta tli. Cuorasala a thiy ciepa haata a ta tlipa a pangpa kha a rue tiyta cuose, Sarah a cingna kaw kha a rue tiyta cuose, a zangna cung vie vyi.
Khazing biekuona kawlie kha zang lina ta ama kha cahang khu vyi. Cuorasala Khazing kha pathuosa te zangna lie kha lethaw te a cahra.
Khazing ta biekuo a pi ciepa ca a patlung sa hrahring aa tapa kha a cusa pata a zang.
Caacuonakawta a zangna kha “adangna ta a cuhluopa.”
“Aa dangpa tana a cuhluo,” tapa bie hing ama huo selaw ta capepa cuo vyi,
kiema zaw bangkhuo cuota capepa a cuo ra. Thiyna taata ma byipaapa Zingsuv a pathutuv kha a zangpa kiema zaw cuota a cuo ra aa.
Ama ca ma sue nakawta thiyna luo pachiy sapa cuo te Khazing hne maa rena riypata pathu pakhaapa tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta, kiema ca zangna thueta duopacupa ma cuo nakawta Zingsuv Khrih thueta Khazing hne maa re mangtli.
Ama thue cata Khazing vihnyina chung luo kha a ngie pate ma aw. Khazing rungnaana maa hraw aa ta pata maa nguopuo nakawta ma thaa a pha.
Capa dyi ca cuo vyi, te-angna maa taw zaw ta ma palung a tluo ngiethie, tahematapakieca te-angna ca chaw khuna kha chiykhyi te,
chaw khuna ta zyazaa chiykhyi te, zyazaa ta anguopuona kha a chiykhyi,

cakhutaata anguopuona ta kiema kha palung chuo pata malie chi vyi, tahematapakieca kiema'a luo malie a pipa Khazing duena ca Thlaapa Pathe'a taata ma pathiypalung chung luo kha a bya ta byapa tana a cuo.
Khaapahmuo a tue khu lipa ma cuo thluo ning, a cuo aa deta ning kha Khrih ca cawsaa a suepa cuo khata a thiy.
Cawsaa phapa cuota ca a thiy nguopa ama aw ri aa, cuorasala cawsaa aa dangpa cuota thiy ca a ruvpa hmang tana a cuo.
Cuorasala Khazing ta kha tluv tama malie a due tapa kha hing haa hingta a paluo sa; a suepa ma cuo nguoluo thluo ning kha Khrih ca kiema cuota a thiy.
A thiyse thueta kiema ca duopacupa ma cuo kieca, Khazing hihaana taata malie khuo li pata ca aw changchiy'a vyi.
A cariepa ma cuo nguoluo ningta a Sacapaa thiyna thueta Khazing hne pare sapa ma cuo kieca, capa pare sa ciepa ta a cuopa ca a hringna ta malie a khuo hryly aa.
Ca dyi ca cuo vyi, Khazing hneta arena malie a pahmung satuv ma Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih thueta Khazing'a lie kha maa law.

Caacuonakawta, cawsaa pakha kawlieta suena ca chuelyi luo hing tlung te, capa suena taa cata thiyna a tlung. Cakhutaata thiyna ca cawsaa bangkhuo cung luo a tlung, tahematapakieca ama bangkhuo ta ama sue nakawta a cuo.
Suena ca phungbie hluota chuelyi lie hing a za aw tli, cuorasala suena ca phungbie a aw lina lie ca suena ta ripa cuo vyi.
Tuokhaata a cuo zaw, thiyna ta Adam chuo taata Moses chuo te kha uv diy yi te, Adam suena haata a sue lipa zaw cunglie kha hmuota a uv diy yi. Adam ca a vaw riypa paa hmaathla paluosana tana a cuo.

Cuorasala a selawpa ta pipa lasaw ca suena hne a lu vyi. Tahematapakieca pakha suena kawlieta cawsaa hluvpuv kha ama thiy pata a cuo kieca, Zingsuv Khrih ama pakha vihnyina thueta malie a pipa Khazing vihnyina hne a selawpa ta pipa lasaw ca cawsaa hluvpuv cuota kha tluv tama a le vie aa?

A selawpa ta pipa Khazing lasaw hne cawsaa pakha suena ca a lu vyi. Suena suokha a vya paziypa bieripana ca, “Na sue,” tapa hingta a cuo, cuorasala suena hluvpuv a vya paziypa a selawpa ta pipa lasaw ca, maa phuv maa siy lipa “Sue vaciy,” tapa biechina tana a cuo.

Cawsaa pakha suena kawlieta thiyna ta cawsaa kha a uv pata a cuo kieca, Zingsuv Khrih pakha thueta tluo a tlingpa Khazing vihnyina hne a selawpa ta pipa adangna lasaw a cupa tie cunglie ca hringna ta kha tluv tama a uv vie'a yi?
Cawsaa pakha suena ta cawsaa bangkhuo kha suebie ripa pata a pacuo sapa haa yi ta cawsaa pakha adangna ta cawsaa bangkhuo cuota duopacuna hne hringna ta a cuo.
Cawsaa pakha ri a ngie lina kawlieta cawsaa hluvpuv kha a suepa ta a pacuo sapa haa yi ta, cawsaa pakha ri-angiena ta cawsaa hluvpuv kha aa dangpa ta a pacuo sa'a yi.
Phungbie kha a vya aw ca suena kha aa cha tyly, cuorasala suena aa chana hmang lie kha Khazing vihnyina ca aa cha hryly ra.
Caacuonakawta, suena ta thiyna taata malie a uvpa haata, vihnyina ta adangna taata malie uv ra te, ma Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih thueta chuozaa hringna luo kha malie aa chiy.
A cuo kieca tuokhaatama ma ta aa? Khazing vihnyina ca a cha hryly se ta pata suena ca ma tue hryly'a ma?
Tue changchiy'a vapuv. Suena lie ma thiy tli pata tuokhaatama a chunglie ca ma aw pari the aa?
Khrih Zingsuv chunglie tiy a nawpa kiema bangkhuo ca a thiyna chunglie zaw tiy maa naw tapa kha pachang va ung ca ma?

Caacuonakawta tiy maa naw ning khata ama hne paby pakhawpa cuo pate a thiyna lieta ma thiy ra tli; cahaacata Khrih ca Paa rungnaana ta a pathu pakhaapa haata kiema zaw hringna thaapa ta ma hring ra aa.
A thiyna lie ama hne ma thiy pakhaw kieca hringna luo pathu pakhaapa a cuona lie kha kiema zaw pathu pakhaa pakhawpa ta ma cuo ra aa.
Ma pangpa suena kha para riypata ma cawsaa hlungpa kha ama hneta vieluo lie khepuo pata a cuo tli tapa kha ma pachang. Capa ca suena sii ta ma cuo li tlina riypa tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca ahung a cuo zaw a thiypa ca suena taata hya a zangpa tana a cuo.
Cuorasala Khrih hneta ma thiy hne kieca ama hneta ma hring hne aa tapa kha ma zang.
Thiyna taata pathu pakhaa pata a cuopa Khrih ca thiypakhaa li tli pata thiyna ta uv'a va tli tapa kha ma pachang.
Suena lie ca yi kha ta aa de pata thiy te, a ta a hringna hing ca Khazing chunglie tana a hring.
Caacuonakawta niema zaw ta, suena lie ca thiy pate Khazing chunglie ca Khrih Zingsuv thueta ma hring ta pata namaa rue riypa tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta saapa khingna kha nama ziy li riypata a thiy thepa nama pangpa ca suena ta uv khah tie se.

Nama pangpa chebuo kha a pha lipa suena tuena riypata pi khah tie ung. Cuorasala thiyna taata hringna luo pathu pakhaapa haata nama pangpa chebuo kha Khazing'a luo kha aa dangpa hmang tuena riypata pi tie ung.
Tahematapakieca niema ca suena rawlie hring li pata vihnyina rawlie nama hring nakawta suena ta ca uv khah yi se.
Caacuokieca tuokhaata? Phungbie rawlie aw li pata vihnyina lie ma aw nakawta suena ca ma tue'a ma? Tue changchiy'a vapuv!

Niema ca pakhakha'a luo kha ri a ngiepa sii haata namaa pi kieca, suena ta a chiykhyipa thiyna lie a cuo zaw, ri-angiena ta a chiykhyipa adangna lie a cuo zaw namaa pipa paa sii ta nama cuopa kha pachang va ung ca ma?

Cuorasala Khazing ca pathuosa pata cuo mang sue. Tahematapakieca niema ca suena sii nama za cuo raalaa pata ata hing ca pacuvna nama hmungpa chungtaata biehmisipa kha pathiypalung hmisi ta nama ziy mangtli.
Suena taata hya pazangpa cuo ung cate, adangna sii ta nama cuo tli.

Nama thyi khu the li nakawta chuelyi bie ri ta i ri pata a cuo. Ahluo ta ca nama pangpa chebuo kha a pathe lipa hmang siicuona luo hne a le vie hrylypa pha lina luo namaa zaa pi. Cuorasala ata hing ca nama pangpa chebuo kha pathena luo caa chiykhyi riypa yi aa dangpa hmang siicuona luo kha a pi tie ung.
Suena sii ta nama cuo ning kha adangna hne aa patuv pata ca hya a zangpa tana nama cuo.
Caacuokieca ata lie nama nang a zaakhyipa hing ta li pata khaapa thlahnena ma nama hmung? Capa hmang zaw a chuona ca thiyna tana a cuo.
Cuorasala ata hing ca suena taata hya pazangpa cuo ung cate Khazing sii ta nama cuo mangtli. Thlahnena nama hmungpa ca pathesana ta cuo te a chuona ca chuozaa hringna tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca suena muo ca thiyna ta cuo te, cuorasala a selaw ta pipa Khazing lasaw ca ma Byipaapa Khrih Zingsuv chunglie chuozaa hringna tana a cuo.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, phungbie a pachangpa tie kyihuo ta phungbie ta ca cawsaa pakha kha a hring chung dyina a ciypakang khu ta pata i ripa kha pachang va ung ca ma?
Cahaacata navaa a hnyipa canung ca a navaapa a hring chung dyi phungbie ta ciypakang khu te, a navaapa a thiy kieca a navaapa kawlieta phungbie taata hya a zang tapa kha ma pachang.

Caacuonakawta a navaapa a hring thluo pata capaa hrangpa hneta a awhne kieca nungvaathingsuena a tuepa tana a cuo. Cuorasala a navaapa a thiy kieca capa phungbie taa cata hya a zangpa cuo te, navaa hrangpa a hnyi zaw ta nungvaathingsuena a tuepa ta cuo vyi.
Cahaacata, uvnu zaw, niema ca Zingsuv pangpa thueta phungbie lie a thiypa ta cuo ung cate, Khazing cuota thyi nama pathyi riypata thiyna taata caa pathu pakhaapa paa huopa tana nama cuo.
Thiysaa ta ma aw ning ca sue khingna kha phungbie thueta kya thu te thiyna cuota thyi pathyi riypata ma pangpa lie kha re a hrie.

Cuorasala ata hing ca phungbie taata hya a zangpa cuo pate, phungbie siicuona taata a thiypa ma cuo. Caacuonakawta kiema ca phung hlungpa, caa ta capepa phungbie rawlie sii cuo li'apa pata Thlaapa ta hringna thaapa chunglie khana ma hring hriy aa.

Caacuokieca tuokhaatama ma ta aa? Phungbie ca a sue ma? Sue changchiy vyi. Cuorasala phungbie a aw li kieca, suena kha pachang'a va ang. Phungbie ta, “Malie hmang kha hie va tlie khah,” a ta li kieca hietliena kha khaapama tapa pachang'a va ang.
Cuorasala suena ta nawbie kha hmuo pata i chunglie kha hietliena phangting a papya sa. Phungbie a aw li kieca suena ca a thiy.
Ahluo ta ca kama hing phungbie li pata za hring angte cuorasala nawbie aa vaw tiyta, suena ca kya thu te i thiy.
Hringna bie malie a kuopa nawbie ca i cuota thiyna ta a cuo.
Tahematapakieca suena ta nawbie kha a patuv pata kama kha na dung te ina thie.
Caacuonakawta phungbie ca a pathe, nawbie zaw a pathe, a dang te a pha.

Caacuokieca a phapa ma kama'a luo thiyna a vya chiykhyi? Cuo changchiy vyi. Thiyna a vya chiykhyituv ca suena tana a cuo. Suena ca suena a cuopa kha aa luo khuna riypata phana kha hmuo te i cunglie thiyna kha a patlung sa. Caacuonakawta nawbie thue khata suena a suezya kha aa luo hryly.
Phungbie ca thlaapa luo hmang ta a cuopa kha ma pachang; cuorasala kama ca saapa cuo angte suena chung luo sii cuo riypata zaapa tana i cuo.
I tuepa hing khaapama tapa pachang va ang. Tahematapakieca i khingpa kha tue lipa angta i huepa hmang caci kha i tue.
I khing lipa kha i tue kieca, phungbie a pha ta pata i palung a tling tana ta a cuo.
Cuorasala khapa hmang a tuepa kha kama ta cuo va ang, i chunglie a awpa suena tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca i saapa lie, i chunglieta hmang phapa suokha hmuo aw vyi tapa kha i pachang. Hmang phapa khingna kha i hnyi, cuorasala tue khu va ang.
Tahematapakieca kama i khingpa hmang phapa kha tue khu va ang, cuorasala i khing lipa pha lina khana i tue.
I khing lipa kha i tue pata a cuo kieca, capa hmang a tuepa ca kama cuo va ang, cuorasala i chunglie a awpa suena kha tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta hmang awtuvzya i hmungpa ca, hmang phapa i tue khing tiyta hmang pha lipa kha kama'a lieta a aw.
Tahematapakieca i hringna ta Khazing phungbie kha a khing,

cuorasala i chunglie phungbie hrangpa a za aw rapa kha pachang angte, capa phungbie ca i palung ta a pha a tapa phungbie a dutuv khata a cuo. Capa phung cata i chunglie a awpa suena sii khata ina tue.
Cawsaa palung rie thyipa tana i cuo! Hingpa saapa thiyna taa hingta ahungma naa khuo aa?
Abyipa Zingsuv Khrih thueta naa khuotuv Khazing ca pathuosa pata cuo mang sue! Caacuonakawta, i pathiypalung ta ca Khazing phungbie kha ziy angte, cuorasala i saapa ta ca suena phungbie kha i ziy.
Caacuonakawta Khrih Zingsuv chunglie a hringpa tie cuota ca suebieripana aw va tli.
Tahematapakieca Khrih Zingsuv chunglieta a awpa Thlaapa hringna phungbie ta suena hne thiyna phungbie chungtaata hya aca pazang yi.
Saapa thaa a dya nakawta phungbie ta a tue khu lipa kha Khazing ta a tue: ama sacapaa kha a suepa cawsaa thiysaa cuona haata suena te riypata za pathlie te suena kha saapa cuonapa lieta sue a be.
Capa ca saapa khingna haata cuo li pata Thlaapa khingna haata a ziypa tie hringna lieta aa dangpa tue riypa tapa phungbie a tling thena riypa tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca saapa khingna haata a awpa tie ca ama pathiypalung kha saapa hmang lie chi yi te, cuorasala Thlaapa khingna haata a hringpa tie ca ama pathiypalung kha Thlaapa hmang lie ama chi.
Saapa khingna chunglie pathiypalung chipa ca thiyna ta cuo te, cuorasala Thlaapa khingna chunglie pathiypalung chipa ca hringna hne thlaalungna tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta saapa khingna lie sangpa pathiypalung ca Khazing hne a carie te, Khazing phungbie kha ziy vyi, a ziy he ta ziy khu vyi.
Saapa khingna chunglie a awpa ta ca Khazing palung kha patluo khu vyi.
Cuorasala niema ca saapa khingna lie aw va ung ciy; Khazing Thlaapa kha nama chunglie khy a sa nakawta Thlaapa khingna chungliena nama aw. Khrih Thlaapa a hnyi lipa ahunghmuo ama huopa ta cuo va yi.
Cuorasala Khrih kha niema chunglie a aw kieca, nama pangpa ca suena kawlieta thiy ra sala Thlaapa ca adangna thueta a hring aa.

Zingsuv thiyna taata a pathu pakhaapa, ama Thlaapa kha niema'a lie khy a sa kieca, thiyna taata Zingsuv a pathu pakhaapa paa khata a thiy thepa nama pangpa kha niema'a lie khy a sapa Thlaapa thueta hringna aca pi'a yi.
Caacuonakawta, uvnu hne sieta zaw, kiema ca saapa khingna haata hring riypata, saapa lieta lyibuo a hnyipa cuo vapuv.
Tahematapakieca, saapa khingna haata nama aw pata a cuo kieca nama thiy aa; cuorasala pangpa ta a tuepa suena kha Thlaapa ta nama thie kieca nama hring aa.
Tahematapakieca Thlaapa ta aa chiypa bangkhuo ca Khazing saata tana ama cuo.
Niema ca ciyna luo caa pathla pakhaapa yi, siicuona thlaapa kha a tingpa ta cuo va ung ciy, cuorasala saata tah caa pacuo sapa yi, thlaapa khana nama ting. “Abba! I Paa!” nama tapa hing
Khazing saata ta ma cuonapa kha na capa Thlaapa ca hne kiema thlaapa ta tehte ama khuo pata a cuo.

A saata tah ma cuo kieca, rucutuv zaw ta ma cuo, Khazing rucutuv cuo pate Khrih hneta ru a cu hnepa ta ma cuo. Cata a cuo kieca ama hne rungnaana a hrawpa ma cuo riypata ama hneta ruvnaana a angpa ma cuo riypa tana a cuo.
Ata cuo lieta maa tawpa te-angna hing ca hmieluo ma cuota a vya luo riypa rungnaana hneta ca pakhingpuo tluo aa tlapa cuo vyi.
Khazing saata zaw paluopa ama cuona cuo kha sapa hmang bangkhuo ta a ngietie li pata ama huo.
Tahematapakieca sapa hmang bangkhuo hing iema khingna ta cuo li pata Khazing ta cuose a tapa haata vievuv diy riypata khuekhuo ciepa ta a cuo.
Anguopuona a awpa ca sapa hmang bangkhuo hing thuvna siicuona taata palaw sa pata cuo'a te Khazing saata zaw rungnaana kha ama hmung ra aa.
Ata cuo te hingta ca sapa hmang bangkhuo hing nupazipa haata amaa hrung amaa ie nguoluo tapa kha ma pachang.
Sapa hmang zaw dyi cuo li pata Thlaapa thyipaa taapa ta a cuopa kiema zaw hrahring hmuo ma pangpa malie a khuo riypa hne saata ta malie a tue riypa ma huopuo nguoluo pata maa hrung maa ie ra.
Tahematapakieca anguopuona thueta khuopa tana ma cuo. Ma hmungpuopa anguopuona ca anguopuona ta cuo vyi. Hmung thluopa ca ahungma a nguopuo aa?
Cuorasala ma hmung lipa kha maa nguopuo kieca, palungpasiyna hneta capa ca ma huo pata a cuo.

Cahaacata Thlaapa ta ma thaadyana lie kha malie aa bya; tahematapakieca tuokhaatama thlaa ma chuo aa tapa hmuo pachang vapuv, cuorasala capa Thlaapa ca ta ahrungna hne pakaa ta ri khu lipa bie ta paa malie a kiepa.
Cawsaa pathiypalung a mangpasiepa Khazing ca Thlaapa palungphya kha a pachang; tahematapakieca Thlaapa ta Khazing khingna haa khata mingpathepa tie cuota paa a kiepa nakaw yi tana a cuo.
Khazing a duepa tie hne Khazing ta a tingna haata a kupa tie cuota ca hmangting zawdya hingta a phana luota a tuepale yi tapa kha ma pachang.
Khazing ta a pachanglupa tie ca a Sacapaa hminghmie lu riypata lieriy a uopuo yi, capa a Sacapaa ca uvnu a hluvpuv hrawlie a uvthyi cepa cuo riypata a cuo.
Lieriy uopuopa tie kha ama ta a ku yi, a kupa tie kha duopacu yi te, duopacupa tie kha rungnaana a pi yi.
Cakhutaata capa zaw kawlie ca tuokhaatama ma ta aa? Khazing kha kiema'a luo malie aa cuo kieca ahungma malie a du khu aa?
A Sacapaa hmuo a khe li pata ma bangkhuo cuota malie a pi kieca a Sacapaa hne cata a hrangpa hmang bangkhuo kha malie pi li pata a aw'a ma?
Khazing ta aa tlawpa kha ahungma sue a be khu aa? Duo a pacutuv ca Khazing tana a cuo.
Ahungma sue a be aa? Khrih Zingsuv, thiy te a thupakhaapa, Khazing cacuoluo kuo ta a tupa na kiema cuota paa malie a kiepa pata a cuo.

Ahungma Khrih duena taata malie a pache khu aa? Ruvnaana ma, ngiechina ma, acuolikie hrisaana ma, acuolikie cakuona ma, abuv-ase riy hnyi li pata awna ma, acuolikie ciy aa chiypa hmang ma, acuolikie zueziy ma tapa tie hingta malie a che khu'a ma?
Caapathe lie a capepa ca, “Nama kawlieta ning-awningtlabu ta thie pata ma cuo; Thie riypata chipa tuv haa tana ma cuo,” ta pata a cuo.
Malie che khu'a vyi, hing hmang bangkhuo lieta kiema ca malie a duetuv ama thueta tetuv tie laata tetuv vie tana ma cuo.
Tahematapakieca thiyna cuose, hringna cuose, avuoming cuose, uvtuv tie ta cuo yi se, ata lie a cuopa hmang ta cuose, a vya chiy riypa hmang ta cuose, cahrana ta cuose,
aa suopa ta cuose, aa thuvpa ta cuose, sapa hmang suokhakha ta cuose, ma Byipaapa Khrih Zingsuv chunglie Khazing duena taata malie pache khu'a vyi tapa kha i pachangpasie.
Zingsuv ming tana a hmisipa i ri. Hang va ang tapa ca i chiepha thleduona ta Thlaapa Pathe thueta a pacu sa.
I pathiypalung chunglie ngiechina lepuv hne cuopasana i hnyi.
Tahematapakieca i cawsaa, saapa lieta i phang kha ta a cuopa tie cuota a cuo kieca, kama hing chiesa pata Khrih'a taata chepa cuo riypa kha hmuota i khing.
Iema ca Israel ming ta cuo yi te, saata ta pacuosapa, rungnaana a pipa, biekuona a pipa, phungbie a pipa, biena a pahnyi sapa, hne biekuona a hmungpa tie ta ama cuo.

Hluo ning mingpa tie'a taata pathlapa cuo yi te, iema'a taa cata Messiah ca thiy hne saa ta pathlapa a cuo. Ama ca Khazing cuo te, hmangting bangkhuo cunglie a awpa a cuo nakawta chuozaa pathuosa pata cuo mang sue. Amen.
Cata a cuo tiyta Khazing bie kha tling vyi tana ta cuo vyi. Tahematapakieca Israel ming bangkhuo ca Israel hmisi ta cuo va yi,
Abraham saata zaw bangkhuo ca a ciypathla hmisi ta cuo diy va yi; cuorasala, “Isak chungtaata a puvpa tie na na ciypathla ta ripa a cuo'a yi,” a ta.
A ri khingpa ca, cawsaa thiysaa cakhawpa ta sapa ca Khazing saata ta cuo va yi, cuorasala biekuona ta a puvpa saata zaw khana ciypathla ta ripa a cuo yi.
Tahematapakieca biekuona ta hing haa hingta a ri, “Capa cuo ning ca a vaw pakhaa'a angte, Sarah ta sacapaa a sa aa,” a ta.
Ca dyi ca cuo vyi; Rebekka ta a navaapa pakha dyipa ma mingpa Isak taata nu a phya ning yi kha capa hne cata aa lusapa hmang a cunglie a tlung.
Ama za puv hluo, a chie a pha khaapahmuo ama tue the hluo baataa khata, Khazing ta a tingpa atlawna ca
tuehriena thueta cuo li pata kupa cuona thueta aa pazuena riypata, Rebekka kha, “A uvthyipa ca a syipa rehrietuv tana a cuo aa,” ta pata changpa a cuo.
Caapathe lie aa capepa ca, “Jakob ca due angte, Esau ca i hue,” a ta.
Caacuokieca tuokhaatama ma ta aa? Khazing ca a dang vyi ma ta'a ma? Ta khu changchiy'a vapuv.
Tahematapakieca, Moses kyihuo khata, “I nangdue khingpa tie kha nangdue'a yi angte, kaw i pacuo khingpa tie kha kaw i pacuo'a yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta capa hmang ca cawsaa khingna hne temaana taata cuo vyi, cuorasala nangduena a hnyituv Khazing thue tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca Caapathe ta Faro kha, “I ming kha chuelyi bangkhuo ta ukhyipa a cuo riypata i cahrana kha na cunglie paluosa riypa atingna hneta icaa tlawpa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta a nangdue khingpa tie kha nangdue yi te, ama palung a cahra sa khingpa tie kha ama palung a cahra sa yi.
Cakhutaata, niema ta, “Caacuokieca, khaapanakawma Khazing ta sue malie a be the? A khingna ca ahungma a du khu?” nama ta aa.
Cuorasala nama, Khazing bie a i tuv cawsaapa hing ahungtama na cuo? Sapa hne vypa a cuopa ta satuv hne vytuv kha, “Khaapanakawma hing haa hingta ina tue ciy?” a ta the'a ma?
Bi vytuv ca acyi kha a khing ta tue khuna naw hnyi va ma? Acyi hlung kha chungtaata bi suokha ca a sungnaa vie ta hmuo riypa hne a hrangpa bi suokha ca hmuo cakhaw riypata sana naw a hnyi cuo va ma?
A hihaana kha paluo khing te a cahrana a paluo sa khingpa Khazing ta para riypata sapa hne hihaana a ang riypa tie kha palung pasiysa pata a ang law kie yi ca,
a rungnaana paluo sa the riypata ama rungnaana a hmung riypata aa tlaw ciepa kiema cunglie zaw hing a nangduena pi khuna naw zaw a hnyi.
Cahaacata malie a kupa kiema ca Judah ming chungtaata dyi cuo li pata Jentail ming chungtaata zaw a cuo ra.
Hosea chunglieta a za ri sasawpa ca, “I cawsaa ta a cuo lipa tie kha ‘I cawsaa,’ ta'a yi angte, I due li nung kha ‘I duesa nung,’ i ta aa,” a ta.
“'I cawsaa ta cuo va ung ciy,’ i tanapa hmang lie caci kha, a hringpa Khazing saata ta pata kupa ama cuo aa,” a ta.
Israel ming kaw hne aa patuv pata Isaiah ta, “Israel ca mingluv ta riyliy viehnang zaa ta hluv ra hmuo yi sala, aa ngaapa tie dyina khuo pata a cuo'a yi.
Tahematapakieca Abyipa ta alyi lie a biechina kha a catlisa pata hne a siesa pata a patling sa aa,” a ta.
Isaiah ta a za ri paciepa ca, “Cungnungce Abyipa ta cawsaa kha malie pangaapa buo li pata aw sala, Sodom haa khata cuo'a pate, Gomorrah haa khata tuepa tana ma cuo aa,” a ta.
Caacuokieca, tuokhaatama ma ta aa? Jentail ming adangna a huv lipa tie khata adangna hmung yi te, capa ca zangna thueta ama hmungpa adangna tana a cuo.
Cuorasala, Israel ming, phungbie kha a patuv pata adangna a huvpa tie ta ca phungbie kha patling khu va yi.
Khaapanakawma ama patling khu va? Zangna ta huv lipa yi ta tuehriena ta ama huv nakaw tana a cuo. A pachiyna alung lie kha a pachiy yi te amaa lie.
Caapathe ta, “Mang tie ung, cawsaa zaw a pachiy pata a liena riypa alung kha, Zion lieta i chi, ama a zangpa bangkhuo ca nangzaana a taw'a va yi,” a ta.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, i palung sehiena hneta Khazing'a luo thlaa i chuopa ca iema hing khuo pata ama cuo riypa hingta a cuo.
Tehte i khuo khupa ca, Khazing ca ama khingsa raalaa, cuorasala ama khingnazya ca aa hmuo lipa khingna tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca, Khazing'a taata a zuvpa adangna kha pachang li pata iema khingna luopuv kha huv yi te Khazing adangna luo kha a pipase khing va yi.
Khrih ca phungbie a chuona ta cuo te capa ca a zangpa bangkhuo ta adangna ama hmungna riypa tana a cuo.
Moses ta phungbie taata a vawpa adangna hne aa patuv pata a capepa ca, “Hingpa hmang zaw hing a tuepa ca hingpa hmang tuena thue hing tana a hring aa,” a ta.
Cuorasala zangna taata a vawpa adangna ta, “'Ahungma vuoruo luo a kie aa?’ ta pata na palung chunglie kha a ta khah,” (a ri khingna ca Khrih kha za cungkhyi riypata tanapa tana a cuo)
acuolikie, “Ahungma athiykhy luo a cung aa?” ta pata zaw a ta khah ung (a ri khingna ca Khrih kha thiyna taata kya pyakhyi riypata tanapa tana a cuo).

Cuorasala tuokhaatama ama ri? “Khazing bie ca naa thaa liena a aw, na hmya lie hne na pathiypalung chungliena a aw,” ta pata a cuo (a ri khingna ca kiema ta ma phupa Khazing zangna bie tanapa tana a cuo).
Na pakaa ta Zingsuv ca Abyipa tana a cuo ta pata phu cate, na pathiypalung chunglie Khazing na thiyna taata a pathu ta pata na zang kieca khuo pata na cuo aa.
Tahematapakieca pathiypalung ta a zangpa ca duopacupa ta cuo te, a pakaa ta a phupa ca khuo pata a cuo.
Caapathe ta, “Ama a zangpa mekaa ca nangzaana ang'a va yi,” a ta.
Tahematapakieca Judah ming hne Grik ming alalalieta pahlyipalena aw vyi; Abyipa pakha hing ma bangkhuo Byipa ta cuo te ama a kupa bangkhuo cuota a pahyasapa tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca, “Abyipa ming a upa mekaa ca khuo pata ama cuo aa,” a ta.
Cuorasala, ama zang li kieca tuokhaatama a ming ca ama u the aa? Bie ca ama thyi buo li kie tuokhaatama ama zang the aa? Cakhutaata, bie ca phu pata a cuo li kieca tuokhaatama ama thyi the aa?
Lucuotuv tie kha pathlie pata ama cuo li kieca tuokhaatama bie ca phu pata a cuo the aa? Caapathe ta, “Thuophaa a vya phyatuv tie phyi ca kha tluv tama a puvthe?” a ta.
Cuorasala ama bangkhuo ta thuophaa ca cuhluo va yi; tahematapakieca Isaiah ta, “Abyipa, ma bie ca ahungma a zang,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta zangna ca thyina taata a vaw te, thyina ca Khrih bie thue tana aa vaw.
Cuorasala ica hiehriy, bie ca thyi va yi ma? A thyi ca ama thyi thluo; tahematapakieca Caapathe ta, “Ama ueryi ca alyi aylya khata a pathuo, ama bie ca chuelyi dena te ta a pha,” a ta.

Hiehriyna suokha i tue khing kalie, Israel ming ta pachang va yi ma? Moses ta palie taa te, “Niema kha mingphang tling a cuo lipa tie cunglie hietliena ica pahnyi sa'a yi; niema ca a ngaapa mingphang tie'a lie kha nama hi ica pahaa sa'a yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Isaiah ta riepha ciemuo pata, “Kama kha naa huv lipa tie ta ina hmung yi; naa padang lipa tie kha i pahmung sa yi,” a ta.
Cuorasala, Israel kawlie ca, “Ri a ngie lipa tie hne bie i a hmuopa tie kha ning-aw ta i kuv i hluo pari yi,” a ta.
Caacuokieca, Khazing ta a cawsaa zaw ca a thaw yi ma? Thaw changchiy va yi! Kama hrahring hing Israel ming, Abraham saming, Benjamin phang ta i cuo.
Khazing ta hluo ning taata a za pachang ciepa a cawsaa zaw kha thaw va yi. Caapathe chunglie Elijah ta Israel ming kawlie kha Khazing'a luo tuokhaatama a ri tapa kha pachang va ung ca ma?
Elijah ta, “Abyipa, na profet tie kha thie yi te, na bienatluophie kha ama phi diy; kama dyi hingna a ngaa ang, kama hing hmuota thie inaa nang kalie yi,” a ta.
Cuorasala Khazing ta tuokhaatama a palie? “Kama cuota Baal hmiekunglie a pakhuv a pane lipa thaw sariy i pangaa kalie yi,” a ta.
Cahaacata ata cuo lie zaw hing Khazing ta vihnyina ta aa tlawpa amaa ngaa kalie.
Cuorasala capa aa tlawpa yi ca tuehriena thueta cuo li pata vihnyina thue tana a cuo. Caacuolikieca vihnyina ca vihnyina ta cuo'a vyi.
Cakhutaata, tuokhaatama ma ta aa? Israel ming ta ama huvpa kha hmung va yi. Aa tlawpa tie ta capa ca hmung yi te, cuorasala aa ngaapa tie ca ama palung kha a papang sa yi.
Caapathe lie a capepa ca, “Khazing ta iema kha ama palung pakhung sa yi te, ataning tepa hingta ama ming hmung li pata, ama naa zaw thyi vyi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata David ta ri te, “Ama cabya ca sariy hne cyihyi ta a li sala, ama cuota a pachiyna alung hne phuv a lana ta a li se.
Ama hmung the li riypata ama ming ca pacue pata cuo yi sala, ama ke ca chuozaa ta a kang se,” a ta.
Caacuokieca, iema ca amaa pachiy kie amaa lie'a ma? Cuo changchiy'a vyi. Cuorasala, iema amaa pachiyna thueta khuona ca Judah ming hietlie riypata Jentail ming'a luo kha aa vaw.

Iema a pachiyna ta chuelyi lie thluechiyna a hluvpuv chiykhyi te, iema a sungna ta Jentail ming cuota thluechiyna hluvpuv a chiykhyi kieca, a tlingta tah iema amaa te rapa ca kha tluv tama aa ky vie hryly aa!
Ata hing ca niema Jentail ming khana ica ta yi. Jentail ming'a luo lucuotuv i cuo chung bangkhuo ca i re ca i palesakhyi pari aa.
I mingphang zaw kha ama hie patlie sa pata a cawta chuo khuo khu the'a yi ang ma i tanapa tana cuo.
Tahematapakieca, iema kha thawpa ama cuona ca Khazing hne chuelyi arena ta a cuo kieca, iema kha cuhluo pata ama cuona ca khaapama a lu aa? A thiypa tie cuota hringna tana a cuo aa.
Viechuo tluo taata tluo kha kha Khazing pacuo pate a pathe pata a cuo kieca tluo hrangpa zaw bangkhuo kha pathe te, a thariy kha a pathe pata a cuo kieca a ce zaw kha ama pathe ra.
Cuorasala cyipa Olif kung a nge chekha kha te pata niema, ruo Olif kung a nge kha iema hmang lie ca patue pata, cyipa Olif kung thariy taata a la kha namaa hraw thluo pata a cuo kieca,
tepa nge tie cunglie ahruo tle khah ung. Ahruo nama tle kieca, niema ta a thariy kha ring lipa ung cata a thariy ta niema aca ringpa yi kha a thyi tie ung.
Nama ta, “Kama kha patue riypa tana a nge kha te pata ama cuo,” na ta aa.
Capa ca aa hmuopa a cuo. Iema ca ama zang li nakawta tepa ama cuo, cuorasala niema ca zangna thue dyi tana nama aw. Caacuonakawta ahruo tle khah ung, ciyna pathiypalung kha hnyi hriy tie ung.
Tahematapakieca Khazing ta a nge hmisipa kha ngie a buo li pata a aw kieca, niema zaw kha ngie caa buo ra'a va yi.

Cakhutaata, Khazing duena hne ciy aa chiyna kha a thyi tie ung. A liepa tie cuota ciy a chiysa te cuorasala Khazing ta niema cunglie a hnyipa duena ta a duena chunglie kha aca pa-aw sa pazue'a yi. Caacuolikieca niema zaw kha tepachung pata nama cuo ra aa.
Cakhutaata, Israel ming kha hmuo ama zang lina kha ama sise kieca patue pakhaa pata ama cuo aa, tahematapakieca Khazing ca iema kha patue pakhaa riypata cahrana a hnyi.

Tahematapakieca niema kha ruo Olif kung taata ca te yi te, a phung a cuo li raalaa pata cyipa Olif kung luo patue pata nama cuo kieca, a ce hmisipa ta a cuopa kha a kung puvnung luo patue pakhaapa ca kha tluv tama a na vie aa.

Caacuonakawta, uvnu hne sieta zaw, niema nama cuona laata a sing vie pata a rue khah ung. Hingpa bieparuv hingna ica pachang sa khing yi: Israel ming chekha cunglieta palung kuochaana tlung'a te, capa ca Jentail ming zangna chung luo a vaw riypa zaa amaa vawna cuo te khiy tana a cuo aa.
Cakhutaata Israel ming bangkhuo ca khuo pata ama cuo aa. Caapathe ta, “Zion taata khuona a vaw'a te, Jakob'a taata pha lina bangkhuo kha aa cade diy aa.”
“Ama suena kha i lapa thue yi ca, hingpa hingna iema hneta i tuepa biekuona ta a cuo aa,” a ta.

Thuophaa kawlie ta kieca iema ca Khazing cariepa ta cuo yi te, capa ca niema cuo tana a cuo. Cuorasala a tlawna ta ripa ta a cuo kieca iema ca ama mingchingmingvuo tie thueta Khazing ta a duepa tana ama cuo.
Tahematapakieca Khazing lasaw hne kuna ca thle bungthaw khu a aw lipa tana a cuo.
A hluota ca niema ca Khazing ri a zaa ngie li pata nama cuo, cuorasala ata lie hing Judah ming ri a ngie lina kawlieta niema ca Khazing nangduena kha nama hmung.
Caacuonakawta niema nama hmungpa nangduena thue khata iema zaw nangduena ama hmung ra riypata iema ca Khazing ri kha a ngie li pata a pa-aw sa yi.
Tahematapakieca cawsaa bangkhuo cunglie nangduena a hnyi the riypata Khazing ta ama bangkhuo khata ri a ngie lina thaw chunglie a chi diy yi.
Khazing hnyirungna hne singna hne pachangna hing aa thuv hringhruo de! A biechina ca kha tluv ta pachang ruv te ma, a luopuv ca kha tluv ta a lecade a ruv!
“Tahematapakieca ahungma Khazing pathiypalung kha a pachang? Ahungma ruena a pi khu?”
“Ama'a taata lasaw hmung pakhaa riypata, ahungma ama kha lasaw a pi buo?”
Tahematapakieca hmangting bangkhuo hing ama'a taata hne ama thueta hne ama huopa tana ama cuo diy. A cunglieta rungnaana chuozaa ta aw mang sue. Amen.

Caacuonakawta, uvnu hne sieta zaw, Khazing ngiechina thueta nama pangpa kha a pathepa hne cuhluo tluo aa tlapa a hringpa hriykhungrina haata Khazing'a luo kha a pi tie ung. Capa ca Khazing'a luo nama pi riypa biena hmisipa tana a cuo.

Hingpa chuelyi phung hing ziyle khah ung, cuorasala palung thaapa nama phyapa khata ca thle yi se. Cata a cuo kie dyina Khazing khingna hing khaapama a cuo, khaapama Khazing hmielie a phapa hne cuhluo tluo a tla te a tlingpa ta a cuo tapa kha nama pachangpasie khu aa.

Ina pipa vihnyina thueta niema pakha cyicuo kha ica chang yi. Namaa rue riypa laata aa suo vie ta a rue khah ung, cuorasala Khazing ta aca pipa yi zangna cyicuo haa khata nama cuona kha a pachang tie ung.
Pangpa suokha chunglie hing chebuo a hluvpuv aw te capa saapa chebuo rehriena ca a lu kaluo va yi.
Caacuonakawta kiema ca a hluvpuv ma cuo raalaa pata Khrih chunglie ca pang kha ta ma cuo. Pakha cyicuo ta ca pang kha chunglie chebuo ta ma cuo ung.
Kiema malie a pipa vihnyina haa khata aa nanangpa lasaw hnyi pate, capa ca profetbiephu ripa khata a cuo kieca zangna ma hnyipa zaa kha hmuo ung sala ri ung siy;
Khazing rehrie a cuo kieca hrie ung sala, pacuvtuv re a cuo kieca pacuv ung siy;

malie thaazuo pipa khata a cuo kieca malie kha thaazuo pi ung sala, malie pi pachaa riypata a cuo kieca pahyasa pata pi ung siy; luochiytuv re ta a cuo kieca temaana hne hrie ung sala, malie ngie va chi riypata a cuo kieca palung tluosa pata ngie va chi ung siy.
Duena ma tapa hing pathiypalung hmisi ta duena cuose. Hmang pha lipa kha va hue la, hmang phapa kha a patuv tie.
Pakha hne pakha kha viesaa duena ta a pasung a panaa ung la a due tie ung. Pakha hne pakha kha a pa-uvsathyi tie ung.
Nama thaa thuv khah se; palung thusa pata Khazing re kha hrie tie ung.
Anguopuona lie kha nama palung tluo se. Ruvnaana nama ang tiyta nama palung pasiy sala, thlaachuo pari tie ung.
Mingpathepa tie amaa huna kha pihluo ung la khychehluobaa due a thepa cuo tie ung.
Caa hrisaapa tie kha thluechiy pi tie ung; chiesa li pata thluechiy pi tie ung.
A palung a tluopa tie kha palung tluokhyi ung la, a caapa tie kha caakhyi tie ung.
Pakha hne pakha palung a lusa pata aw ung la, nama palung le khah se. Cuorasala aa phahlapa tie hne khata a khe the ung la, nama cuona laa khata a pasing sa vie khah ung.
Pakha hne pakha kha pha lina ta vieriy a thung khah ung, cuorasala cawsaa bangkhuo hmungna lieta a pha ama tapa kha tue a zue tie ung.
A cuo khu pata a cuo kieca cawsaa bangkhuo hne khata a re ung la diena hneta khy sa tie ung.

I duepa zaw, niema ta tah phuv a la khah ung, Khazing hihaana ta a hrie the riypa khata chi thluo tie ung. Caapathe chunglie aa capepa ca, Abyipa ta, “Phuvlana ca kama huopa tana a cuo, kama na a thung'a yi ang,” a ta.

“Caacuonakawta, na carie tie kha ama nang a diy kieca sa kha pi tie yi; ama tiy a hrie kieca dang riypa tiy kha pi tie yi. Cahaacata na tue kieca ama luv cunglie myihyi sekhalapa a papungpa tana na cuo aa,” a ta.
Pha lina kha a pate sa khah ung, cuorasala pha lina kha phana ta te tie ung.
Uvtuv byi kha ama ri a ngie tie ung; tahematapakieca Khazing'a taata a cuo li kieca uvtuv byi aw the vyi. Ata lie uvtuv byi tie zaw hing Khazing ta a padaapa tana ama cuo.
Caacuonakawta uvtuv byi a dupa ca Khazing ta re a pipa tie a dupa ta cuo yi te, bieripana na amaa taw aa.

Tahematapakieca uvtuv byi tie ca hmang pha a tuepa tie ta ciy riypa cuo vyi, pha lina a tuepa tie dyi ta ciy riypa tana a cuo. Uvtuv byi tie ciy li pata na aw khing ma? Caacuokieca hmang phapa kha tue la aca pathuosa aa;

tahematapakieca uvtuv byi ca nama phana cuota Khazing changtaapa a cuopa tana a cuo. Cuorasala hmang pha lipa na tue kieca, na ciy a hu aa, tahematapakieca uvtuv byi ca a cakhawpa ta zueziy kha a cyi vyi! Pha lina a tuetuvpa tie cunglie Khazing hihaana a patlung satuv Khazing changtaapa tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Khazing hihaana kawlie dyi ta cuo li pata nama chiepha thleduona kawlie zaw khata a ri kha a ngie riypata a cuo.
Ngukhyi nama pipa zaw hing, uvtuv byi tie ca ama cuo bangkhuo uvna luota a hmuopa Khazing changtaapa ama cuo nakaw tana a cuo.

Ama hmung riypa a cuopa bangkhuo kha pi tie ung, pangpa ngukhyi a hmung riypa kha pangpa ngukhyi pi ung la, nama hnyipa hmang ngukhyi a hmung riypa kha nama hnyipa hmang ngukhyi pi tie ung. Hmiezaa tluo a cuopa ca hmiezaa ung la, pa-uvsathyi tluo aa tlapa ca pa-uvsathyi tie ung.
Pakha hne pakha a due riypa ta li pata ahung cunglie hmuo lyibuo hnyi khah ung; tahematapakieca cawsaa hrangpa a duepa ca phungbie a patling sapa tana a cuo.

“Nungvaathingsuena tue khah; Lie va naw khah; Paruv khah; Malie hmang kha hie va tlie khah”; tapa nawbie hne nawbie hrangpa zaw bangkhuo ca, “Nama naa duepa haata na ingpaa kha va due tie,” tapa bie lie hingna amaa vya sawhmya diy.
Duena ta ingpaa cunglie pha lina tue buo vyi; caacuonakawta duena ca phungbie tlingna tana a cuo.

Capa khutaa cata, khaapa cuota ma a cuo tapa hne ata cuo hing ca maa hmungna taata maa kya chana cuo tana a cuo tapa kha nama pachang. Tahematapakieca khuona ca zangtuv ma vya cuo baaning ning laa khata malie aa vya ngie vie mangtli.
Zuo cuo ca khung tli te ningchung aa vya ngie tli. Caacuonakawta zingna hmang tuena kha thuse ung sala khena cehre kha a la ung siy.

Ningchung a cuopa haata pa-uvsathyi tluo aa tla pata aw ung sala, paringpasu pata hne sahmyisahmaa pariy pata aw khah ung siy, aparuvsuena tue khah ung siy, mang a ngie li pata aw khah ung siy, a hru a chie li pata hne i-aw a hnyi li pata aw ung siy.
Abyipa Zingsuv Khrih kha a hryi hriy ung la, saapa khingna palung patluo riypa kha huv khah ung siy.
Zangna luota a thaa a cawpa kha cuhluo tie ung, cuorasala ama khueruena kha nama i khing nakawta cuo khah se.
Cawsaa chekha ta ning phangting kha ning riypa tana a cuo ta pata ama zang ning kha zangna luo a thaa a cawpa tie ta uohnaasiyyhnaa dyi kha ama ning.
A phangtling ta a ningpa tie ta a ning lipa tie kha ese khah yi se. A ning lipa tie zaw ta a ningpa tie kha syi ra khah yi se; tahematapakieca Khazing ta iema kha a cuhluo ra yi.

Malie changtaapa tie bie ripa riypata nama ca ahungtama na cuo? Iema sue a ngiethe ama cuo riypa hne sue duotepa ama cuo riypa ca ama byipaapa biechina cunglie na a aw. Cakhutaata sue a ngiethepa zaw ama cuo aa, tahematapakieca Abyipa ca sue a ngiethe khutuv tana a cuo.

Cawsaa chekha ta ning ning kha kha ning hrangpa laata a pha vie ta pata ama rue ning kha a hrangpa tie ta ning bangkhuo hing aa lu ta pata ama rue. Ama bangkhuo ta ama palung lie'apa kha a siesa pata zang yi se.

Ning ning kha kha a sungnaa vie ta a ruepa ca Abyipa pa-uvsathyina ta pasungpanaa se. A phangtling ta a ningpa tie kha Abyipa pa-uvsathyina ta ama ningpa tana a cuo, tahematapakieca Khazing khana alawna bie ama hluo. A ning lipa tie zaw Abyipa pa-uvsathyina ta ama ning lipa cuo te, Khazing na alawna bie ama hluo ra.
Ahunghmuo kiema cuo dyi ta hring vapuv, ahunghmuo kiema cuo dyi ta thiy vapuv.
Ma hringpa ta a cuo kieca Abyipa cuota hring pate, ma thiy kie zaw Abyipa cuo tana ma thiy. Caacuonakawta ma thiy a cuo zaw, ma hring a cuo zaw, Abyipa huopa tana ma cuo.
Hingpa kawlie hing tana Khrih ca a thiypa hne a hringpa tie Abyi cuo riypata, thiy te a hring pakhaa pata a cuo.

Caacuokieca khaapanakawma nama uvnu hne nama sieta tie ca nama syi pachaa? Acuolikie, khaapanakawma nama uvnu hne nama sieta kha nama ese pachaa? Ma bangkhuo hingta Khazing hmielie bie ripa riypata a daa riypa tana ma cuo ung.
Caapathe lieta, “Kama Abyipa i hringpa haata, kama'a luo kha pakhuv bangkhuo ta vya pane'a te, palyi bangkhuo ta Khazing kha ama pathuosa aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata, kiema bangkhuo ca Khazing hmielie ma kaw maa ri kaluo aa.
Caacuonakawta pakha hne pakha kha a syi khah tli ung siy, cuorasala na uvnu luopuv lieta a pakhuo riypa hne a pachiyna riypa kha chi li riypata bie a chi pacie tie.
Abyipa Zingsuv chunglieta ina pachang sapa ca, khaapa hmang hing hmuo amata tah a pathe lipa aw vyi tapa hingta a cuo, cuorasala pathe vyi ta pata a ruepa cuota ca pathe vyi.
Nama na ningpa kawlieta na uvnu hne na sieta zaw ama palung a pasa kieca, nama ca duena chunglie a hringpa cuo vaciy. Na ningpa kawlie khata Khrih ta a thiykuopa cawsaa pakha arana cuo khah se.
Caacuonakawta nama ta a pha na tapa kha a chie pata ri riypata pacuo sa khah.
Tahematapakieca Khazing pena ca ning hne dang ta cuo vyi. Cuorasala Thlaapa Pathe lieta adangna, thlaalungna hne palungtluona tana a cuo.
Cahaacata Khrih re a hriepa ca Khazing hmielie cuhluo tluo aa tlapa hne cawsaa ta pathuosapa ta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta pakha hne pakha maa sathaw the riypa hne diena a chiykhyipa hmang kha hrie a zue ung siy.
Ningbaa kawlieta Khazing re kha para khah ung siy. Hmisi ta kieca hmang bangkhuo hing a pathe, cuorasala na ningpa kawlieta cawsaa hrangpa kha amaa lie kieca hmang phapa ta cuo vyi.
Na uvnu hne na sieta zaw aliena a cuo kieca saa ce a cuo zaw, mingsuvtiy dang a cuo zaw, hmang hrangpa a cuo zaw tue riypata cuo vyi.
Na zangna kha Khazing hmielieta a cusa pata chi thluo tie. Iema ta a cuo hmisi ama tapa kawlieta iema hne iema sue a be lipa tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo.
Cuorasala palung luolue pata a awpa tie ca ama ning kieca sue be pata ama cuo aa, tahematapakieca zangna ta ama tue li nakawta a cuo. Zangna taata a vaw lipa hmang tuena bangkhuo ca suena tana a cuo.
Zangna lie a cahrapa kiema ta zangna a cawpa tie thaazuo dyana kha ma dyichaw aa hu. Kiema palungtluona kha ma huv riypata cuo vyi.
Kiema pakha cyicuo hingta ma ingpaa tie amaa sathaw riypa hne ama phana cuota ama palung ma patluo riypa yi ta a cuo.
Caapathe lie, “Nama aca esenapa yi kha kama cung luo a tla,” ta pata a capepa haata, Khrih ca ama palungtluona dyi kha tue vyi.
Tahematapakieca Caapathe ta malie a pipa palungpasiyna hne palung cahrana thueta anguopuona ma hnyi the riypata, hluo ningta ama za capepa bangkhuo ca kiema pacuvna riypa tana a cuo.
Palungcuna hne palung cahrana pituv Khazing ta Zingsuv Khrih chunglie pakha hne pakha palung a lusa pata hring khuna ca pi thi yi se.
Cahaacata Abyipa Zingsuv Khrih a Paa hne Khazing kha palung a lusa pata nama pathuosa khu aa.
Khrih ta aca cuhluopa haa yi ta, Khazing ta rungnaana a hmung riypata pakha hne pakha kha a cuhluo tie ung.
Ica chang khingpa yi ca, Khrih ca Khazing biehmisipa cuo khata vangdaw tepa tie changtaapa ta a za cuo. Cahaacata a cuopa ca mingpa tie'a luo a za pipa yi biekuona pacu sa riypa hne

Khazing ca cawsaa cunglie nangduena a hnyi nakawta Jentail ming ta ama pathuosa na riypa kha tana a cuo. Caapathe ta, “Caacuonakawta, kama ta nama kha Jentail ming hrawlie caa law'a angte, na ming kha hlaa ta ica pathuosa aa”; a ta.
Cakhutaata ri pakhaa te, “Vya Jentail ming, a cawsaa zaw hne khata, nama palung tluo se”; a ta.
Ri pakhaa hyi te, “Niema Jentail ming bangkhuo, Khazing ca pathuosa ung la, cawsaa bangkhuo ta ama ca pathuosa yi se”; a ta.
Isaiah ta ri pakhaa te, “Jesse thariy kha kya pu'a te, Jentail ming uvtuv ta a cuo aa; Iema Jentail ming ta ama cunglie kha nguopuona ama hnyi aa,” a ta.
Thlaapa Pathe cahrana chunglieta anguopuona nama hnyina riypata, anguopuona Khazing ta zangna chunglie palungtluona hne thlaalungna ta ca pabi yi se.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, niema ca cawsaa phasapa cuo ung cate, pachangna hne nama bi thluo nakawta pakha hne pakha namaa cawpa thesa aa ta pata kama hrahring ta ica zang yi.
A cuo raalaa pata hing caa i vya capepa chekha lie hing niema pathyi sa pakhaa riypata riepha ciemuo pata i vya cape. Tahematapakieca Khazing ta ina pipa vihnyina thueta,

Khazing thuophaa hne aa patuv pata tluobyi rehriena lie kha Jentail ming'a luo Khrih Zingsuv rehrietuv i cuo riypa tana a cuo. Capa ca Jentail ming kha Khazing hmielie cuhluo aa tlapa hriykhungrina haata ama cuo riypa hne Thlaapa Pathe ta a pathe sapa ama cuona riypata a cuo.
Cakhutaata, Khrih Zingsuv hne maa patuvna thueta, Khazing re i hriepa kawlie hing a pale riypa i hnyi.
Tahematapakieca, Jentail ming'a taata pa-uvsathyina hmung riypata Khrih ta kama na hmuo te a patlungpa re kaw hing ri li pata aw khu'a va ang. Hingpa a tuepa hing bie ta cuose, tuena ta cuose,

pahmungsana hne kharuehaa hmang cahrana ta cuose, Khazing Thlaapa cahrana ta cuose, a tuepa tana a cuo. Caacuonakawta Jerusalem taata patha pata Illyrikum te ta Khrih thuophaa ca tluotlingsa pata i phu riypa tana a cuo.
Cahaacata i saduvthie ta a cuo paripa ca Khrih ama pachang buo lina lie thuophaa phu kha a cuo, tahematapakieca malie ta a hruo ama pathu ciena lieta i sa chiy li riypa khata a cuo.
Cuorasala Caapathe ta, “A kaw chang buo lipa tie khata hmung'a yi te, a kaw a thyi buo lipa tie ta ama pachang aa,” a ta.
Niema'a luo ica vya tlaw riypa yi ta yi hluvpuv naa pakhuopa ca hingpa hing tana a cuo.
Cuorasala, ata hing ca hingpa ruo lie hing kama cuota rehriena riypa hmang a aw li tli nakawta cuose, kung pasiypuv taa khata niema'a luo vya tlaw riypa kha i khingpa a cuo nakawta,
Spain luo i vya tlawpuo pata caa vya tawpaa yi ang sala, niema hne cuo kha chung aa nuosa pata maa khe khutaa ung ta, capa luo si riypa kha naa bya ung la tapa i khing.
Cadyiseca, ata hing ca Jerusalem lie mingpathepa tie cuota rehrie riypata i si.
Tahematapakieca Masidonia ruo hne Akhaia ruo lie a awpa tie ta Jerusalem lie a awpa mingpathepa tie hraw taata siypasa tie'a luo palung thusa pata ama pipa sue na a aw.

Capa hmang ama tuepa ca ama palung aa tluokhyisa, hmisi ta ripa kieca ama tue riypa hrahring ta a cuo; tahematapakieca, Jentail ming ta Judah ming thlaapa luo thluechiy kha amaa hraw kieca, Judah ming zaw ta chuelyi chechiy luo thluechiy kha Jentail ming'a taata amaa hraw ra riypata a cuo.

Caacuonakawta hingpa re hing patlung'a angte, i ri khingpa ca, iema cuota ama khyipa tuokaa bangkhuo a tlingsa pata iema kuv cung luo i pi khutaa yi ta, Spain luo i tlawpuo pata ica vya tlawpaale'a yi.
Ica vya tlaw tiy yi ta, Khrih thluechiy kha a tlingsa pata ica vya phya'a yi tapa kha i pachang.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, Abyipa Zingsuv Khrih hne Thlaapa duena ta paa ica kiepa yi ca, Kama cuo hingta Khazing'a luo kha thlaa na chuokhyi tie ung.
Judea ruo lie a awpa zanglituv tie kuv taata hya i zang khuna riypa hne Jerusalem lie i rehrie riypa hing mingpathepa tie cuota cuhluo tluo a cuo riypata thlaachuo tie ung.
Cahaacata, Khazing khingna a cuo kieca palungtluona hne niema'a luo vya chiy pata niema hrawlie thaazuo thaapa i lana ta a cuo aa.
Thlaalungna Khazing ca niema bangkhuo'a lie aw mang sue. Amen.
Kenkhria khrihsaabuv lie khrihsaa uvthyi a cuopa ma sietanung Fibi hing niema'a luo pachangsana i vya tue.

Mingpathepa tie hrawlieta a cuo riypa hmang a cuopa haata, ama kha Abyipa ming ta cuhluo ung la, niema'a taata abyana a caa hiepa yi bangkhuo kha pi tie ung. Tahematapakieca ama ca cawsaa hluvpuv hne kama cuo hrahring ta byatuv pha tana a cuo.
Khrih Zingsuv chunglie i rehriehne a cuopa Prisilla hne Akuila kha nama kuv ica patuv yi.
Iema ca kama hringna cuota ama luv a pi nguopa tana ama cuo. Iema'a lie i palung a tluopa dyi cuo vyi, Jentail khrihsaa bangkhuo zaw ama palung a tluo hringhruo.
Ama ing lie a pungpa khrihsaa tie zaw nama kuv ica patuv yi. Asia ruo taata Khrih a zang taapa ta a cuopa, i viesaa phapa Epenetas zaw na kuv ica patuv.
Niema hrawlie rehrie te amaa hringhruopa Mary kha na kuv ica patuv.

Andronikas hne Junias kha nama kuv ica patuv yi. Iema ca kama phangbuo, kama hne thaw a tla hnepa tana ama cuo. Iema ca lucuotuv tie ta ama za pachangsa pata cuo yi te kama hluota Khrihsaa ama za cuo tli.
Khrih chunglie i duepa Ampliatas kha na kuv ica patuv.
I duepa Stakhis hne Khrih re i hrie hnepa Urbanas kha nama kuv ica patuv yi.
Khrih zangna lie tlechuo aa chiysapa Apelles kha na kuv ica patuv. Aristobulus ingchungkhue tie kha nama kuv ica patuv yi.
I phangbuo a cuopa Herodion kha na kuv ica patuv. Narsissas chungkhue tie zaw kha Abyipa ming ta nama kuv ica patuv yi.
Abyipa rehrietuv Trifana hne Trifosa kha nama kuv ica patuv yi. Abyipa re lie te a maasapa, i duepa Persis kha na kuv ica patuv.
Abyipa ta aa tlawpa Rufas hne a nung, i nung ta a cuo rapa kha nama kuv ica patuv yi.
Asinkritas, Flegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas hne uvnu hne sieta zaw iema hne a awpa tie bangkhuo kha nama kuv ica patuv yi.
Filologas, Julia, Nereus hne a sietanung, Olimpas hne iema hneta a awpa tie bangkhuo nama kuv ica patuv yi.
Pakha hne pakha kha a pathepa a pahnuona ta bie a chang tie ung. Khrih huo a cuopa khrihsaabuv na nama kuv caa patuv yi.
Uv nu hne sieta zaw, achena hne aduna a chiykhyipa tie kha a raaring ung la, nama cuhluo ciepa pacuvna a du pata a rilepa tie kha cahriy tie ung.

Tahematapakieca, cahaapa cawsaa zaw kha ca Abyipa Khrih rehrietuv cuo lipa yi ta iema riyvaw cuo dyi ta a hriepa tana ama cuo. Ama bie pahniepa hne malie ama pata thenapa khata cawsaa zaaruo tie kha ama dung.

Thuophaa hne aa patuv pata zang tluo namaa tlana kha cawsaa bangkhuo ta ama pachang nakawta hingpa kawlie hingta i palung aca tluokhyi hringhruo yi. Hmang phapa kawlie kha singvaa ung la, hmang pha lipa suena ta acaa kaa li riypa yi ta icaa khingkhyi yi.
Diena Khazing ta Setaa kha nama phyipazaa rawlie chi'a te a carie patang aa. Abyipa Zingsuv Khrih vihnyina ca niema'a lie aw mang sue.
I rehriehne Timote ta nama kuv aca patuv yi. Cahaacata, i phangbuo a cuopa Lusias, Jason hne Sosipater zaw ta nama kuv aca patuv yi.
Kama Tertias, hingpa caapaphya a capetuvpa zaw hingta Abyipa ming ta nama kuv ica patuv yi.
I ingtlungpa hne khrihsaabuv apungna-ing hnyituv, Gaius zaw ta nama kuv aca patuv yi. Khypuv suekingtuv Erastas hne ma uvnupa Kuartas zaw ta nama kuv aca patuv yi.
(Ima Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih vihnyina ca niema bangkhuo'a lie aw mang sue. Amen.)
Kama i ripa hne i phupa Zingsuv Khrih thuophaa hne cuo pasiypuv chung za nupa, cuorasala ata hing phu pata a cuopa bieparuv haa khata niema thaazuo caa pi khupa yi ca Khazing tana a cuo.
Cakhutaata chuozaa a hringpa Khazing bie pina haata, zang yi te a bie ama ziy the riypata, profet tie capepa caa thueta, ama ca Jentail ming bangkhuo kha pachang sa pata a cuo tli.
A singpa Khazing pakha dyipa ca Zingsuv Khrih thueta chuozaa ta a ming rungnaa pata aw mang sue! Amen.
Khazing khingna thueta Khrih Zingsuv lucuotuv cuo riypata kupa kama Paul hne ma uvnupa Sosthenes ta,

Khazing mingpathepa cuo riypata kupa, hne Khrih Zingsuv chunglieta pathesapa Korin khy lie a awpa Khazing Khrihsaabuv hne, iema hne kiema Byipaapa ta a cuopa Abyipa Zingsuv Khrih ming ta kupa, hmangting lieta a awpa tie kha:
Ma Paa Khazing hne ima Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih'a taata vihnyina hne thlaalungna ca nama cunglie aw mang sue, ta pata bie maacaa chang yi.
Khrih Zingsuv thueta aca pipa yi vihnyina kawlie kha Khazing i pathuosa pari.
Tahematapakieca niema ca ama thueta bierina hne pachangna phangting lie kha a luo ting taata ama'a lie pa hnyirung sapa ta nama cuo.
Khrih kaw tehte ma khuopa kha niema hrawlie a cusa pata a aw tli tana ta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta ma Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih aa luona riypa nama huona lie hing thlaapa luo lasaw nama hmung lipa suokha hmuo aw vyi.
Ma Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih ning thueta suebepa nama cuo li riypata ama ta ningchuona ning te ta thaazuo aca pi'a yi.
Khazing ca zang tluo aa tla; ama thueta niema ca a sacapaa, ma Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih hne a viesaana hnyi riypata kupa nama cuo.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, niema bangkhuo nama palung a lusa sala, nama hrawlie achena aw li pata aa lupa atingna hnyi pata nama aw riypata Zingsuv Khrih ming ta paa ica kie yi.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, Khalawi chungkhue ta niema hrawlie a hru a ina a awpa kha ina chang yi.

I ri khingpa ca niema cyicuo ta, “Kama ca Paul phuv tana i cuo,” acuolikie “Kama ca Apollos phuv tana i cuo,” acuolikie “Kama ca Piter phuv tana i cuo,” acuolikie, “Kama ca Khrih a ziytuv tana i cuo,” nama ta.
Khrih hing chetuv a cuo ma? Paul hing ma nama cuota vieluo lie khepuopa ta a cuo? Acuolikie Paul ming tama tiy namaa naw?
Krispas hne Gaius ta li pata pakha hmuo tiy ica naw li nakaw yi ta Khazing ca i law.
Tahematapakieca ahungtahmuo i ming tana tiy maa naw a ta riypa aw va ung ciy.
(Stefanas hne a ingchungkhue zaw kha tiy i za naw ra yi; cakhutaata tiy i nawpa ama aw kalie ma tapa pachang va ang.)

Tahematapakieca Khrih ta tiynaw riypata na pathlie vyi. Thuophaa phu riypata pathliepa cuo angte, capa ca cawsaa bie rithena thueta cuo'a vyi, tahematapakieca Khrih vieluo hing cahrana hnyi li pata a aw pathlyi lina riypa tana a cuo.
Vieluo lie Khrih thiyna kaw hing rana luo a chiy nguoluopa tie cuota ca ngaana bie ta cuo te, cuorasala khuo nguoluopa kiema cuota ca Khazing cahrana tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca Caapathe ta, “Mingsing tie singna kha para'a angte, thleduothena a hnyipa tie thleduo khuna kha i pavie aa,” a ta.
Khaapaliema a singpa ca a aw? Phungbie saya ca khaapaliema a aw? Ata chuo bie i a thepa tie ca khaapaliema ama aw? Khazing ta chuelyi singna kha ngaana ta a pacuo sa tli cuo va ma?

Tahematapakieca Khazing singna chunglie hing chuelyi hingta singna ta Khazing a pachang khu li nakawta, ma phupa ngaana bie ama tapa thuophaa hingta a zangpa tie khuo riypa kha Khazing khingna tana a cuo.
Judah ming ta pahmungsana kha hie yi te Grik ming ta singna kha ama tlechuo,
cuorasala kiema ca Khrih vieluo lie a thiyna kaw kha phu pate, capa ca Judah ming cuota aliena cuo te Jentail ming cuota ngaana bie ta a cuo.
Cuorasala Khazing kupa Judah ming hne Grik ming cuota ca Khrih ca Khazing cahrana hne Khazing singna tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca Khazing ngaana ca cawsaa singna laata sing vie te, Khazing thaadyana ca cawsaa cahrana laata a thaa a ruv vie ngiethie.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, Khazing ta aca kuna yi kha rue syalya tie ung. Niema hrawlie hing cawsaa taana luota a singsapa, hmang a tue khupa hne phanghruo luota aa suopa hluvsa va ung ciy.
Cuorasala Khazing ta chuelyi lie a singpa tie nang pazaa riypata a ngaapa tie kha a tlaw yi te, a cahrapa tie nang pazaa riypata a thaa dyapa tie kha aa tlaw yi.
Khazing ta chuelyi lie esenutaapa tie hne siysaa ri lipa tie kha a tlaw yi te, a biepuvpa hmang tie kha khaapatahmuo ama cuo li riypata a biepuv lipa hmang kha aa tlaw.
Caacuonakawta Khazing hmielie ca ahungtahmuo a palepatie khu'a vyi.
Khazing ca Khrih Zingsuv thueta nama hringna hruo ta a cuo. Zingsuv ca kiema cuota Khazing'a taata a zuvpa singna, adangna, pathesana hne khuona ta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta, Caapathe lie a capepa ca, “A palepa ca Abyipa'a lie kha a pale se,” a ta.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, niema'a luo Khazing bieparuv phu riypata i vaw ning kha bie a thuvsapa hne singna kha hmuo va ang.
Tahematapakieca niema'a lie i aw ning kha Zingsuv Khrih hne vieluo lie ama thiena kaw ta li pata khaapahmuo pachang a hu vyi ta pata i za rue.
Niema'a luo kha thaadyasa pata hne ciypuopa hne a cathangpuo pata i vaw.
I ripa hne i phupa bie ca a hmisipa a lusapa cawsaa singna bie cuo li pata Thlaapa hne a cahrana paluosana ta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta nama zangna ca cawsaa singna cunglie bangpa cuo li pata Khazing cahrana cunglie bangpa tana a cuo.
Cuorasala ruena a ky tlipa tie cunglie ca singna bie kha ma ri. A cuo raalaa pata capa singna ca a rale nguoluopa ata chuo singna hne ata chuo uvtuv tie singna zaw ta cuo vyi.
Kiema ma ripa singna ca Khazing ta kiema rungnaana cuota chuelyi puv hluo taata a za rawrue paciepa, a paruv ta a za nupa, Khazing singna tana a cuo.
Ata chuo uvtuv tie pakha tahmuo pachang va yi; pachang yi sala rungnaana Byi kha vieluo lie thie'a va yi.
Cuorasala Caapathe ta, “Ming ta a za hmung buo lipa, naa ta a za thyi buo lipa hne, cawsaa palung lie a puv buo lipa hmang kha, Khazing ta ama a duetuv zaw cuota a tingtuo pacie,” a ta.
Hingpa hmang zaw hing Khazing ta Thlaapa ta kiema'a lie a paluo sa. Tahematapakieca Thlaapa ca hmangting bangkhuo hne Khazing tuepa aa thuvpa hmang bangkhuo kha hmuo huv te a paluohuo diy.

Cawsaa pakha a ruena hne a pacuona kha ama chunglie a awpa a thlaapa ta li pata ahungma a pachang khu? Cahaa ngiethie cata Khazing Thlaapa ta li pata ca Khazing ruena hne pacuona kha ahungtahmuo pachang khu va yi.
Kiema ma tingpa thlaapa hing chuelyi thlaapa ta cuo vyi, Khazing'a taata a zuvpa Thlaapa tana a cuo. Khazing ta malie a pipa lasaw kha ma pachang khuna riypata Khazing Thlaapa kha ma ting tli.
Caacuonakawta thlaapa cawsaa a cuopa tie kha thlaapa bie ma pacuv tiy yi ta, khapa hmang bangkhuo kha cawsaa singna ta pacuv lipa yi pata thlaapa singna ta ma pacuv yi.

Thlaapa cawsaa a cuo lipa tie ca Khazing Thlaapa lasaw kha ting va yi, capa hmang ca iema cuota ngaana ta cuo te, iema ta khapa hmang kha pachang khu va yi, tahematapakieca capa hmang ca thlaapa luo taa dyi ta pachangpasie khupa tana a cuo.
Thlaapa cawsaa zaw ta ca hmangting kha pachangpasie khu yi te, ahungtahmuo sue be khu va yi.
“Ahungma Khazing pathiypalung kha pachang te, a chang pachaa khu?” a ta. Cuorasala kiema ca Khrih pathiypalung a hnyituv tana ma cuo.

Caacuonakawta, uvnu hne sieta zaw, niema'a lie hing thlaapa cawsaa tie'a lie i ripa haata ri khu va ang; cuorasala saapa khingna ta a hringpa tie hne Khrih chunglie a haatiy kaliepa tie'a lie ripa haata dyina i ri khu.
Sacuopa ta cuo li pata ahnungtiy tana ica caw yi, tahematapakieca niema ca sacuopa a ning khu riypata cuo va ung ciy. Ata zaw hing cuo valie ung ciy,
tahematapakieca thiysaa tana nama hring nguoluo kalie. Nama hrawlieta hietliena hne a hru a ina a aw chung bangkhuo ca thiysaa khingna hne chuelyi cawsaa khingna haa tana nama hring cuo va ma?
Tahematapakieca pakha ta, “Kama ca Paul phuv tana i cuo,” ta ung cate a hrangpa pakha ta, “Kama ca Apollos phuv tana i cuo,” nama ta kieca saapa cawsaa cakhawpa cuo thluo va ung ca ma?
Caacuokieca Apollos ca khaapatama a cuo? Paul ca khaapatama a cuo? Iema ca niema nama zang thena riypata Khazing ta cyicuo ta re a pipa rehrietuv tana ama cuo.
Kama ta a ciy i tuv. Apollos ta tiy a bya, cuo ra sala a palesathawtuv ca Khazing tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta a ciy a tuvpa hne tiy a byapa ca a biepuv ta cuo va yi, cuorasala a pale satuv Khazing dyina a biepuv.
A ciy a tuvpa hne tiy a byapa ca aa lupa cuo yi te ama cyicuo ta ama hriena muo kha a hmung riypa tana ama cuo.
Tahematapakieca kiema ca Khazing changtaapa, re a hrie pakhawpa cuo pate, niema hing Khazing lu, Khazing ing ta nama cuo.
Khazing ta ina pipa vihnyina thueta ing sa a thesapa haata inghruo kha bang tli angte, a hrangpa pakha ta a cunglie kha a vya sa. A sapa pakha cyicuo ta tuokhaatama i sa aa tapa kha a raaring yi se.
Ahungtahmuo inghruo bang ciepa Zingsuv Khrih ta li pata inghruo hrangpa bang khu vyi.
Inghruo bang ciepa lie kha pakhakha ta siy, ngu, alung muosungpa, thing, ngiediy, sacuo kung tapa tie kha hmuo pata a sa kieca,
a satuv cyicuo ama hriepa re kha paluo sa pata a cuo aa. Tahematapakieca Bieripana ning thueta pakha cyicuo ta ama hriepa re ca khaapama a lu tapa kha myi ta dyapasya pata a cuo aa.
Inghruo bang ciepa lie ama sapa kha aa hmang kieca a satuv ca lawmuo a hmung aa.
A rehriepa ca myi ta a kuo kieca a sung'a te, ama ca khuo pata a cuo aa, cadyiseca myi chung taata hya a zangpa haa tana a cuo aa.
Niema ca Khazing biena-ing cuo ung cate, Khazing Thlaapa nama chunglie a awpa kha pachang va ung ca ma?
Pakhakha ta Khazing biena-ing kha a para kieca, Khazing ta capa cawsaa ca a para aa, tahematapakieca Khazing biena-ing ca pathe te, niema ca capa biena-ing ca tana nama cuo.
Niema hne niema kha a dung khah ung. Niema chunglieta ata chuo lie chuelyi taana ta i sing a tapa nama aw pata a cuo kieca, a singpa nama cuo riypata a ngaapa nama cuo na a hu.
Tahematapakieca hingpa chuelyi singna hing ca Khazing cuota ngaana tana a cuo. Caapathe ta, “Khazing ta mingsing tie kha ama zyatena mamaapa khata a pa-uo yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata, “Abyipa ta mingsing tie ruena ca muo hnyi lipa a cuopa kha a pachang,” a ta pakhaa.
Caacuonakawta ahungtahmuo cawsaa luochiytuv tie kawlie a pale khah se. Tahematapakieca hmangting hing niema huopa tana a cuo.
Paul cuose, Apollos cuose, Piter cuose, hing chuelyi cuose, thiyna hne hringna cuose, ata cuo cuose, hmieluo cuo cuose, hmangting bangkhuo hing niema huopa tana a cuo.
Cakhutaata niema hing Khrih huopa ta cuo ung cate, Khrih hing Khazing huopa ta a cuo.
Kiema kha Khrih changtaapa hne Khazing bieparuv kingkaatuv ta malie rue tie ung.
Ca hlyitaw taata kingkaatuv ca zang tluo aa tlapa ama cuo a hu.
Cuorasala niema ta cuose, khaapa chuelyi bieripana zung ta cuose i bie ina chipa zaw ung cata kama cuota ca hmang taata tana a cuo. Kama hne kama zaw i kaw hing bie a chi khu va ang.
Kama hne kama kha i pasuenapa aw vyi, cadyiseca i suena aw hrahring vyi ca a ta va ang. I bie naa ripatuv ca Abyipa tana a cuo.

Caacuonakawta a ningkhue a tling hluo, Abyipa aa vaw hluota ahunghmuo bie va ripa khah ung. Abyipa ca ata lieta zingna chunglie aa nu nguoluopa hmang hing khena luo chiykhyi'a te, pathiypalung ta aa tingpa zaw kha a paluo sa diy aa. Cakhutaata cawsaa bangkhuo ca iema hne aa phuvpa pathuosana kha Khazing'a taata ama hmung aa.

Uvnu hne sieta zaw, niema phana riypata hingpa bangkhuo hing kama hne Apollos kha pakhingpuona ta hmuo angte ica chang tli yi. Cahaacata niema ta “Caapathe lie cape ciepa lawpakhung pata,” nama tue li riypata kiema'a taata namaa cuv riypa hne ahung nama cuo zaw cawsaa pakha hmie mang pata pakha kha nama hue li riypa tana a cuo.
Ahungma niema hing malie laata caapa nanang vie yi? Khazing'a taata nama cuhluo lipa khaapama a aw? Nama cuhluo pata a cuo kieca lasaw ta a cuhluo lipa haata khaapama namaa palekhyi riypa a aw?
Niema ca nama khingpa bangkhuo nama hnyi! Nama hnyirung ciemuo tli! Kiema li pata siepahruo nama cuo tli. Kiema hne siepahruo cuo hne riypata siepahruo cuo sasaw ung la ca a pha'a pakha!

Khazing ta kiema lucuotuv tie hing thiy riypata bie ripa paciepa tie haata cawsaa bangkhuo hnangluo ta malie a chipa tana ma cuo tapa tana i rue. Tahematapakieca kiema ca chuelyi hne avuoming hne cawsaa zaw mangbaalaa riypata phusaapa tana ma cuo.

Kiema ca Khrih cuota a ngaapa cuo pate, niema ca Khrih chunglie a singpa tana nama cuo. Kiema ca ma thaa a dya, cuorasala niema ca nama thaa a ruv. Niema ca pa-uvsathyipa nama cuo, cuorasala kiema ca nutaapa tana ma cuo.
Ata cuo te hingta kiema ca nangdiy tiyhrie pata ma aw, ma cawsie ca pangbie thlapa ta a cuo, malie tuv malie de yi te ing li lu li pata ma aw,
ma kuvta tah rehrie pate ma riy maa caw. Chie malie ama sa tiyta thluechiy ma pi yi; malie ama hrisaa tiyta ma ang law;
ma thuo malie ama pachi tiyta duena ta ma palie yi. Ata tepa hingta kiema ca chuelyi ta thawpa hne hnehnawvaabuv haa tana ma cuo.
Hingpa caa hing niema nangzaana riypata i capepa ta cuo vyi, cuorasala i duepa saa zaw nama cuopa haata niema kha ica pasiypa-ya khing nakaw yi tana a cuo.

Tahematapakieca Khrih chunglie nama hringna lie hing mangchiytuv thawhraa nama hnyi zaw ta paa a hluvpuv hnyi va ung ciy. Kama ca thuophaa thueta Khrih Zingsuv chunglie nama hringna lie hing nama paa tana i cuo.
Caacuonakawta kama inaa mangpuo riypa ung cata ica pasu yi.

Capa kawlie cana khy ting lie a awpa khrihsaabuv bangkhuo lie i pacuvpa haa yi ta Khrih Zingsuv chunglie i hringzya kha niema pachang sa pakhaa riypata Abyipa chunglie i duepa hne zang tluo aa tlapa i sacapaa Timote kha niema'a luo i vya pathlie.
Niema'a luo a vaw li riy'apa haata na rue ung cate, chekha ca ahruo tle ung cate namaa pale.
Cuorasala Khazing khingna a cuo kieca niema'a luo ica vya tlaw patang'a yi. A hruotlepa hne aa palepa tie ama bie dyi kha cuo li pata ama hmang tue khuna kha i mang'a lie.
Tahematapakieca Khazing pena ca bie lie cuo li pata cahrana liena a aw.
Khaapama nama khing vie? Niema'a luo kha sungpe hneta ma i vaw aa, acuolikie duena hne pathiypalung nena tama i vaw aa?
Lawki ming hrawlie hmuo a aw lipa canungcapaa kaw luota suena na niema hrawlie a aw tapa kha ina chang yi. Cawsaa pakha na a paa napuvnung a ziekhyi ta pata a cuo.
Cata a cuo thluopa cata niema ca namaa pale kalie! Hmisi ta kieca nama ngie a chisa riypata cuo va ma? Capa hmang a tuetuv ca niema hraw taata nama papya riypata cuo va ma?
Pangpa ta niema'a lie i aw li raalaa pata, thlaapa ta niema'a lie i aw.
Niema'a lie a awpa haata cahaapa hmang a tuetuv cunglie ca Abyipa Zingsuv ming ta biechina i tue tli. Namaa pung tiyta ima Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih cahrana hneta i thlaapa ta niema'a lie a aw ra.
Capa cawsaa ca a pangpa para riypata Setaa'a luo kha pi tie ung, cakiedyina Abyipa Zingsuv khuona ning thueta a thlaapa kha khuona a hmung aa.
Namaa palepatiepa hing pha vyi. Thiynung a cawta tah viedie naw ciepa bangkhuo a pathu sa tapa kha pachang va ung ca ma?
Thiynung hlungpa kha thaw tie ung, cakiedyina niema ca thiynung phuv lipa a thaapa viedie nawpa haata nama cuo aa. Tahematapakieca lawsena pyi tuvtaata Khrih ca vieluo lie thie pata a cuo tli.
Caacuonakawta, lawsena pyi ca thiynung hlungpa ta a cuopa a pha lipa pathiypalung hne pha lina ta cuo li pata thiynung phuv lipa viechuo ta a cuopa pathena hne biehmisipa khata tue ung siy.
I caa paphyapa chunglieta i capepa ca canungcapaa kawlie thiysaa khingna a tuepa tie hneta a khe'a va ung ciy, i ta.

Hingpa chuelyi lie canungcapaa kawlie thiysaa khingna a tuepa tie, a karuo awpa tie hne a ruvhangpa tie, kuvtuezuv abiepa tie zaw i ta khingna ta cuo vyi, cahaacata a cuo kieca hingpa chuelyi taa hingta nama pya muo a hu'a ta.

Cuorasala, niema'a luo i vya capepa ca zangtuv tana i cuo a ta tlung pata canung capaa kawlie thiysaa khingna a tuepa, a karuo awpa, kuvtuezuv abiepa, cawsaa thuo a pachipa, sahmaa a pariypa hne a ruvhangpa tie hneta a khe'a va ung ciy tapa tana a cuo. Cahaapa cawsaa hneta ca sa hmuo ning pakhaw khah ung.
Hmisi ta ripa kieca, kama ta aleluo'apa tie bie i ripa riypa yi ta a cuo ma? Khrihsaabuv chunglie a awpa tie hingna ama bie nama ripa aa cuo va ma?
Khazing ta Khrihsaabuv khungthingluo ta a awpa tie kha bie a ripa'a yi. “Cawsaa pha lipa kha niema hraw taata papya tie ung.”
Niema hrawlie pakhakha ta nama uvnu cunglie palung tling lina nama hnyi pata a cuo kieca mingpathepa tie'a luo cakuo cuopa ta, tuokhaatama aa dang lipa chuelyi bierina zung luo nama cakuo nguo?
Mingpathepa tie na chuelyi bie a ripa'a yi tapa hing pachang va ung ca ma? Chuelyi hing niema na a bie a ripa'a ung ciy ta pata a cuo kieca hingpa bie saalipa hing ripa khu va ung ca ma?
Bie saalipa ta li pata avuoming bie hmuo kiema na a ripa'a yi puv tapa hing pachang va ung ca ma?
Cakhutaata bie saalipa nama hnyi tiyta Khrihsaabuv lie a aw lipa tie ma bieripatuv ta nama hmuo aa?
Nama nang zaa naase tapa tana i ri. Niema zangtuv pakha hne pakha alalalie bie chi riypata nama hrawlie mingsingpa pakha hmuo aw vyi tapa ca a cuo khu'a ma?
Zangtuv hne zangtuv tazaa a cyi ung cate ma zanglituv tie'a luo ca namaa chiykhyi?
Pakha hne pakha tazaa namaa cyipa hing niema cuota asungna tana a cuo pacie tli. Khaapanakawma nama ang hriy thluo va? Khaapanakawma namaa padung sa thluo va?
Cuorasala niema tlaku ta nama uvnu cunglie kha hmang pha lipa va tue ung cate nama dung.

Hmang pha lipa a tuepa tie ca Khazing pena cu'a va yi tapa kha pachang va ung ca ma? A dung khah ung; aparuvsuena a tuepa tie, kuvtuezuv abiepa tie, nungvaathingsuena a tuepa tie, capaa hne capaa, canung hne canung suena a tuepa tie,
aparuvpa tie, a karuo a awpa tie, sahmaa a pariypa tie, cawsaa thuo a pachipa tie hne a ruvhangpa tie ca Khazing pena cu'a va yi.
Niema chekha ca cahaapaapa ca tana nama za cuo. Cuorasala Abyipa Zingsuv Khrih ming hne ima Khazing Thlaapa chunglieta pasiypa, pathe sapa hne duopacupa ta nama cuo tli.
“I cuota hmangting hing tue anaa vyi,” cuorasala i cuota thlahnena naa pipa cuo vyi. “I cuota hmangting hing tue anaa vyi,” cuorasala khaapa hmang tahmuo sii ta naa ziy khah se.

“Sa ca pavaw cuota cuo te, pavaw ca sa cuota a cuo,” cuorasala Khazing ta a suohning hingta a para aa. Ma pangpa hing aparuvsuena tuena cuota hmuo riypa cuo vyi, cuorasala ma pangpa ca Abyipa cuota cuo te, Abyipa zaw ma pangpa cuota a cuo.
Khazing ta Abyipa kha thiyna taata pathu pakhaa te kiema zaw hing a cahrana ta malie a pathu pakhaa aa.
Nama pangpa hing Khrih pangpa chebuo a cuopa kha pachang va ung ca ma? Caacuonakawta Khrih pangpa chebuo kha la pata siyhrawnung pangpa chebuo ta i tue'a ma? Tue buo hluo'a va ang!
Siyhrawnung a awhnepa ca ama hne pang kha ama cuopa kha pachang va ung ca ma? Tahematapakieca Caapathe ta, “Iema pahning ca pang kha ta ama cuo aa,” a ta.
Cuorasala Abyipa hne a pazuepa ca ama hneta thlaapa lie suokha ama cuo aa.
Aparuvsuena kha cahriy tie ung. Cawsaa pakha ta a tuepa suena bangkhuo ca pangpa leluo ta cuo te, aparuvsuena a tuepa ca ama pangpa cunglie hrahring khana suena a tue.
Nama pangpa hing Khazing'a taata hmung ung cate nama chunglie a awpa Thlaapa Pathe biena-ing a cuopa pachang va ung ca ma? Niema ca niema huopa cuo va ung ciy;
a muo pipa ta calyipa tana nama cuo. Caacuonakawta nama pangpa kha Khazing rungnaana ta hmuo tie ung.
Niema nama capepa caa hne aa patuv pata ca: “Capaa hing napuv chiy li pata aw sala a pha,” nama ta.
Cuorasala canung capaa kawlie thiysaa khingna tue riypata pasupaliyna a hluv tuv nakawta capaa ta napuv a hnyi sala canung zaw navaa a hnyi se.
Navaapa ta a napuvnung cunglie kha navaapa a cuona kha patling sa sala napuvnung zaw ta a navaapa cunglieta napuvnung a cuona kha patling sa se.
Tahematapakieca napuvnung ta ama pangpa kha uv li pata, navaapa ta a uv. Cahaacata navaapa zaw ta ama pangpa kha uv li pata napuvnung ta a uv.

Thlaachuo riypata cuo kha kha thli pakhaw ung cate nama pahning palung tling pata namaa uv ta li pata ca pakha khingna kha pakha ta nama patling sa riypa kha a thlu khah ung. Nama thli pakhawpa cuo a chuo taata aw pakhaw pakhaa tie ung. Cata a cuo li kieca namaa ang khu li nakawta Setaa ta aca pasupaliy pathlyi'a yi.
Hingpa i ripa hing a pa-aw tana ica pa-aw yi, nawbie ica pipa yi ta cuo vyi.
Cawsaa bangkhuo kama haa hingta aw khu diy ung la i khingsa. Cuorasala Khazing ta malie a pipa lasaw ma hmungpa ca aa nanang diy.
Napuv navaa a hnyi li liepa cuo hne nunghlyi tie cuota ca kama haa hingta nung chiy li vaa hnyi li pata aw yi sala na a pha i ta.
Cuorasala amaa ang khu li kieca a chiyhie thluo yi se. Thiysaa khingna ta myi kuo ta kuopa laata ca a chiyhie pata a pha vie.
A chiyhie ciepa tie cuota hingpa bie, kama bie cuo li pata Abyipa nawbie hing ica chang yi, napuv ta navaa kha a che khah se,
(cuorasala aa che kieca navaa hnyi li pata aw se, acuolikie a navaapa kha a hlaw pakhaa se), navaapa zaw ta a napuvnung kha a che khah se.

A hrangpa tie cuota, Abyipa'a taata cuo li pata kama ta ica tapa yi ca, zangtuv pakhakha ta zanglituv napuv hnyi sala capa nung ca ta ama hne aw hne riypata a palung a tling thluo kieca ama kha a che khah se.
Canung pakhakha ta zanglituv navaa hnyi sala capa paa ca ta ama hne aw hne riypata a palung a tling thluo kieca ama kha a che khah se.

Tahematapakieca zanglituv navaapa ca a napuvnung thueta a pathepa ta vya cuo te, zanglituv napuvnung zaw a navaapa thueta a pathepa ta a vya cuo. Caacuolikieca, nama saata zaw kha pathe'a va yi, cuorasala ata hing ca a pathepa tana ama cuo.

Cuorasala zanglituv khata a chepa a khing kieca; a che thluo ung; cahaapaapa hmang kawlie ca zangtuv canung a cuo zaw capaa a cuo zaw nawbie ta ca ciypaki va yi. Tahematapakieca Khazing na a dieta tah aw riypata malie a u.
Napuvnung, na navaapa kha khuo khu'a va ang ta khu vaciy. Navaapa, na napuvnung kha khuo khu'a va ang ta khu vaciy.
Cawsaa bangkhuo Khazing ta cuose ta pata a ca china haa yi hne aca una haa dyi khata aw tie ung. Capa ca Khrihsaabuv bangkhuo ta i pacuvpa yi ta a cuo.

Cawsaa pakha ca vangdaw a te ciepa ta upa a cuo kieca, vangdaw aa tenapa hmaadaa kha para riypata a ting khah se. Cawsaa pakha ca vangdaw a te li pata upa a cuo kieca, vangdaw a te riypata a zue khah se.
Vangdaw a te hne a te li kha a biepuv pata cuo vyi, cuorasala Khazing nawbie ziy khana a biepuv.
Cawsaa cyicuo ta kupa nama za cuo ningta nama cuona haa khata aw pathla tie ung.
Aca ku ning kha sii ta na za cuo ma? Na za cuo zaw ta pyi vyi. Cuorasala hyazangna cuo na hmung kieca hyazang riypata a zue tie.
Tahematapakieca sii cuo ningta Khazing ta a upa tie ca Khazing'a lie a hyazangpa tana ama cuo. Cahaacata hyazangpa a cuo ningta kupa tie ca Khrih sii ta ama cuo.
Niema ca muo pi pata calyipa tana nama cuo; cawsaa sii ta a li khah ung.
Caacuonakaw, uvnu hne sieta zaw, tuokhaapa adaahmang lie nama aw pata aca ku zaw yi ta, aca kuna haa yi khata Khazing'a lie kha a hmang tie ung.
A chiyhie li liepa tie hne aa patuv pata Khazing biepina hnyi va ang, cuorasala zang tluo aa tlapa Khazing ngiechina thueta kama ta i ruenapa ica chang yi.
Ata maa tawpa palungriethyina hing ruepa kieca cawsaa pakha hing a ta aa daahmang haa hingta a aw pathla pata na a pha tapa tana i rue.
Napuv a hnyipa na cuo kieca na napuv hne a che riypata vaa ting khah. A chiyhie li liepa na cuo kieca napuv hnyi riypata vaa ting khah.

Namaa chiyhie kiema suena nama tue pata cuo vyi, lesaa ta navaa a hnyi kiema suena a tue pata cuo vyi. Cuorasala a chiyhiepa tie ca chuelyi palungriethyina kha amaa taw aa. Niema kha capa taa cata ica palaw sa khing yi.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, i ri khingpa ca, thli ciepa cuo hing a vya pachangsale tli nakawta, ata taa hingta ca napuv a hnyipa ta a hnyi lipa haa khata aw sala,
a ngiechi te a caapa tie ca a caa lipa haata aw yi se. A palung a tluopa tie ta a palung a tluo lipa haata aw yi sala, hmang a calyipa tie ta hmang a hnyi lipa haata aw yi se.
Hing chuelyi chechiy hne re a hriepa tie ta chuelyi chechiy hne re a hrie lipa haata aw tie ung. Tahematapakieca hing chuelyi chiycuona hmingsuo ca a chuole nguoluo tli.
Nama palung rie thyi khah se tapa na ica khing yi. Napuv a hnyi lipa ca Abyipa palung patluo riypa dyi kha rue te Abyipa kawlie dyi kha a palung rie a thyi.
Cuorasala napuv a hnyipa ca a napuv palung patluo khu riypata chuelyi kawlieta a palung rie thyi te,

a ruena kha aa che. Navaa a hnyi lipa canung, acuolikie lesaa pathenung ca tuokhaatama pangpa hne thlaapa lie i pathe khu aa ta pata Abyipa kaw kha ama palung rie thyi te, cuorasala navaa a hnyipa canung ca tuokhaatama a navaapa kha a palung i patluo khu aa ta pata chuelyi kawlie kha a palung rie a thyi.

Hing haa hingta i ripa hing niema phana cuota cuo te tue li riypa ta pata nama cunglie i khang khing nakawta cuo vyi. Hmang phapa kha tue'a ung cate nama pathiypalung hmisi ta Abyipa'a luo namaa pi riypa kha tana a cuo.
Pakhakha ta aa pahaa ciepa lesaa cunglie kha mang a ngie pata aw va ang ta pata a rue te, a khingna zaw kha cahra te aa hlaw khing kieca, a khingna haa khata a hlaw se. Suena ta cuo vyi.

Cuorasala ahung a cuo zaw, a palung kha a cusa pata sang te, ahungtahmuo hripuo li pata a khingna kha ama hne ama a uv khu te, capa nung ca a pahaapa lesaa a cuo yalya khata aw riypata a palung lie bie aa chi kieca hmang pha a tuepa tana a cuo aa.
Caacuonakawta a pahaapa lesaa kha a chiyhiepa ca hmang phapa kha tue te, a chiyhie lipa ta hmang pha viepa kha a tue.
