Napuv ca a navaapa a hring chung bangkhuo ca a hya zang vyi. A navaapa a thiy kieca a khingpa kha aa hlaw khu, cadyiseca Khazing a zangpa dyina aa hlaw aa.
Kama ta bie i chipa ca, a cuona yalya haa khata aw pathla sala aa nuo vie aa i ta; kama zaw Khazing Thlaapa Pathe kha i hnyi ra ta pata i rue.

Kuvtuezuv'a luo hriykhung a rina sa hne aa patuv pata, ma bangkhuo ta “pachangna ma hnyi diy kaluo,” tapa kha ma pachang. Pachangna hingta cawsaa kha ahruo patle sa te duena ta ca cawsaa kha a sathaw.
Cawsaa pakhakha ta i pachang ta pata aa rue kieca a pachang riypa zaa ta pachang valie.
Cuorasala Khazing kha a duepa ca Khazing ta a pachang.
Kuvtuezuv'a luo hriykhung a rinapa sa ningna kawlieta ma ri kieca, “kuvtuezuv ca a hringpa a cuo lipa kha,” pachang pate, “Khazing pakha ta li pata khazing hrangpa aw vyi,” tapa kha ma pachang.
Vuoruo lie cuose alyi lie cuose khazing ama tapa zaw ama aw ri aa. Cahaacata khazing a hluvpuv hne byi a hluvpuv ama aw zaw ta

kiema cuota ca Paa, Khazing pakha dyina a aw. Hmangting bangkhuo hing ama'a taata tuepa cuo te, kiema zaw hing ama cuota a hringpa tana ma cuo. Cakhutaata Abyi pakha, Zingsuv Khrih kha aw te hmangting bangkhuo hing ama'a taata cuo te, kiema zaw hing ama cuota a hringpa tana ma cuo.

Cadyiseca cawsaa bangkhuo ta capa pachangna ca hnyi va yi. Cawsaa chekha ca kuvtuezuv biena hne khata a zisa tli yi te ataning tepa hingta kuvtuezuv'a luo hriykhung amaa rinapa sa kha ama ning tiyta capa sa ca kuvtuezuv huopa tana a cuo ta pata ama zang. Ama ruena a caw nakawta capa sa ca malie a papya a palyi ta pata ama rue.
“Sa hingta kiema kha Khazing minghmie pha malie pahmung sa'a vyi.” Ma ning li zaw ta maa sung vie riypa aw vyi, ma ning kie zawma maa thung viena riypa aw vyi.
Cuorasala nama hyazangna kha a thaadyapa tie a pachiyna ta pacuo sa khah ung.

Nangvuona a hnyipa niema zaw ta kuvtuezuv bienatluophie lie a tu ung cate sa nama ningpa kha pachangna thaa a dyapa tie ta ca hmung biephung yi sala kuvtuezuv lie hriykhung a rina sa kha ning riypata thaa a patlung sapa ta cuo'a va ung ca ma?
Cahaacata Zingsuv ta a thiykuopa, a thaa a dyapa na uvnu ca nama nangvuona kawlieta a ra aa.
Cahaacata nama uvnu cunglie kha sue ung cate, a thaadyapa ama chiepha thleduona kha hmaa nama paphya nakawta Khrih'a lie nama sue.
Caacuonakawta, i ningpa sa hing i uvnu a liena ta a cuo kieca, i uvnu a lie li riypata khatiy tahmuo saa ce'a va tli ang.
Kama hing hya a zangpa pakha cuo naa ang? Kama hing lucuotuv pakha cuo naa ang? Ima Byipaapa Zingsuv zaa hmungpa cuo naa ang?
Malie cuota lucuotuv i cuo li zaw, niema cuo chuo ta ca i cuo, tahematapakieca niema ca Zingsuv chunglie lucuotuv i cuonapa a pacu satuv caakhe tana nama cuo.
Kama naa hiehriypasietuv tie i palienapa yi ca hingpa hing tana a cuo.
Ma re kawlie hing sa hne tiy hmung a tla va pa ma?
Lucuotuv hrangpa tie, Abyipa nuta zaw hne Piter haa hingta ma khy tlawna luo zangtuv napuv zaw a chiylena naw hnyi ra va pa ma?
Acuolikie Barnabas hne kama kyalya hing ma ma hringna cuota rehrie li pata a aw the li riypata a cuo puv?
Ahungma ama tuokaa hmuo pata rieka re a hrie buo? Ahungma a thyi thyi kha hmuo ce li pata mingsuv a cyi buo? Ahungma a tuv chungtaata a pyapa ahnungtiy dang li pata tuv a khie buo?
Hingpa hing cawsaa hmungnaluo kuo taata i ripa a cuo ma? Phungbie zaw ta hing haa hing tana a ri cuo va ma?
Moses phungbie chunglieta, “Suo a ciy nguoluopa cuetungpa kha a hmya hy khah ung,” a ta. Khazing ta a ri khingpa hing cuetungpa cuo tama a cuo?
Kiema cuo hingta a ripa cuo'a va ma? Kiema cuota aa capepa tana a cuo. Tahematapakieca le a thawpa ta anguopuona hne thaw te, sacuo a ciypa zaw thyipaa kha hmung ra riypa anguopuona hne tana aa ciy.
Niema'a lie thlaapa saciy kha tuv pate niema'a taata chuelyi chechiy kha ma hmung kieca a hluv tuv nama ta ma?

Cawsaa hrangpa tie ta niema'a taata hing haa hingta hmung riypa amaa nguopuo kieca kiema changchiy ca a hluv vie ta a nguopuo riypa cuo va pa ma? Cuorasala, cahaacata hmung riypa hing a zue buo vapuv, Khrih thuophaa kha luo a khuotuv ma cuo li riypata hmangting kha a ang tana ma ang hriy.
Biena-ing lie re a hriepa tie ca ning riypa kha biena-ing taata hmung yi te, bienatluophie lie hriykhungrina a tuepa tie zaw ta hriykhungrina taata cuvu ama hnyi tapa kha pachang va ung ca ma?
Cahaacata thuophaa a ripa tie zaw thuophaa rina taata ama riy amaa caw riypa tana a cuo tapa ca Abyipa bie pipa ta a cuo.

Cuorasala hingpa cuvu zaw hing i hmuopa aw vyi. Hingpa caa zaw hing cahaapa byana hmung riypata i capepa ta cuo vyi. Tahematapakieca hingpa i palesakhyipa i daahmang hing pakhakha ta khaahmuo a cuo li pata a tuepa laata ca a thiy hmuo i thiy khing vie.
Thuophaa na i phu tapa a cuo kieca i palena riypa aw vyi. Tahematapakieca i phu hrahring riypa tana a cuo. Thuophaa hingna i phu va tapa kieca bawchie ciemuopa tana i cuo aa.
Kama ri tana thuophaa hing i phu tapa a cuo kieca lawmuo hmung riypa i hnyi aa; cuorasala kama ri ta a cuo li kieca hrie riypata naw pipa tana i cuo.
Khaapa hing ma i lawmuo ca a cuo? Hingpa hing tana a cuo: muo pi li pata thuophaa phuthena hmung angte, i hmung riypa muo la li pata thuophaa i phupa hingna a cuo.
Caacuonakawta kama ca ahung sii hmuo i cuo li pata, cawsaa hluv vie hmung khu riypata kama hne kama kha cawsaa bangkhuo sii ta i tue.

Judah ming i la thena riypata Judah ming'a luo kha Judah ming haata i tue. Phungbie rawlie a awpa tie kha i la khuna riypata phungbie rawlie a awpa tie'a luo kha phungbie rawlie a awpa pakha haata i tue (phungbie rawlie i hring li raalaa pata).

Phungbie le luo a awpa tie i la khuna riypata phungbie le luo a awpa tie'a luo kha phungbie le lie a awpa pakha haata i tue (kama ca Khrih phungbie rawlie kha aw angte Khazing phungbie taata i law li raalaa pata).
Thaazuo a dyapa tie i la the riypa yi ta thaazuo a dyapa tie'a luo kha thaazuo a dyapa haata i tue. A cuo khuna chung ta chekha chuo khuo khu riypata cawsaa bangkhuo'a lie kha cuona ting ta i hrawle.
Hingpa bangkhuo hing thuophaa kawlieta i tuepa cuo te a thluechiy i hraw ra khing nakaw tana a cuo.
A ruo azuena lie kha a ruopa bangkhuo amaa zue raalaa pata pakha dyina lawmuo a hmung tapa kha pachang va ung ca ma? Caacuonakawta lawmuo hmung riypata a ruo tie ung.

Azuena lie a zue ra khingpa ca amaa cuv ning kha hmangting lieta iema hne iema kha khuopuv ta amaa cadang. Cahaacata ama tuepa ca a ra thepa paapaapa tieky lakhuv hmung riypa tana a cuo. Cuorasala kiema ca a ra the lipa paapaapa tieky lakhuv hmung riypa tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta cuokaa hnyi li pata a ruo cakhaw va ang. Cawsaa pakha ta thliy a phaw cakhawpa haa khata phaw va ang.
Cuorasala malie dyi kha chang pata kama tlaku thawpa i cuo pathlyi li riypata i pangpa kha khuopuv ta i hri.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, ma mingchingmingvuo tie bangkhuo ca amyi rawlie za aw yi te riyliy ama za tepa kha nama maw li riypata ica khing yi.
Moses hnang ziytuv cuo riypata amyi chunglie hne riyliy chunglie kha tiy amaa zaa naw.
Ama bangkhuo ta thlaapa sa kha za ning pakhaw yi te,
thlaapa tiy kha ama za dang pakhaw. Iema a ziylepa yi thlaapa alung taa khata tiy ca dang yi te capa alung ca Khrih ta a cuo.
Cata a cuo raalaa pata cawsaa hluv vie cunglie Khazing palung a tluo li nakawta iema kha ruocaapa lieta thie pata ama cuo.
Hingpa bangkhuo hing iema ama tuepa chiena kha ma tue khing ra li riypata kiema cuota a mangpuo riypa tana a cuo.
Caapathe ta, “Cawsaa zaw ca ning riypa hne dang riypa khata a tu yi te thu yi te ama luo,” a tapa haa khata iema chekha haata kuvtuezuv abiepa cuo khah ung.
Kiema ca iema hrawlie cawsaa chekha ta ama za tuepa haa khata aparuvsuena tue'a vapuv, cahaacata ama za tue nakawta ning kha chunglie thawkiy thawthung ama za thiy.
Iema chekha ta ama za tuepa haa khata kiema ca Khrih kha ima dyapasya riypata cuo vyi, cahaacata ama za tue nakawta pariy ta a za dawsa yi.
Iema chekha amaa zaa ciephuvluvpa haa khata a ciephuvluv khah ung, iema ca paratuv tie ta ama za para diy tli.
Iema'a lie a tlungpa hingpa hmang hing a raaringna riypata kiema chuotliepa saa zaw cuota capepa tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta a cusa pata na i daa a tapa ca aa lie li riypata a raaring se.

Namaa tawpa dyapasyana hing cawsaa cunglie a tlung buo lipa cuo vyi. Khazing ca zang tluo aa tlapa tana a cuo, niema nama ang khu lipa dyapasyana kha ca pa-ang sa'a va yi. Cuorasala namaa tawpa kha nama ang khuna riypata, capa pasupaliyna hne cata pyapathlana luopuv kha aca sapa puo'a yi.
Caacuonakawta, i duepa zaw, kuvtuezuv abiena ca cahriy tie ung.
Ruena a hnyipa tie bie changpa haa tana ica chang yi; i ripa hing niemata tah thleduo tie ung.

Abyipa zuosa lie ma hmuo pakhawpa palungtluona panuo cuota thlaa ma chuo tiyta Khrih thiyse na maa hraw ung cuo va ma? Viechuo chechi pate maa hrawpa zaw ung hing Khrih pangpa na maa hraw ung cuo va ma?
Viechuo tluo kha a cuo nakawta, kiema a hluvpuv hing pang kha tana ma cuo, tahematapakieca viechuo tluo kha maa hraw nakaw tana a cuo.
Israel ming kha pacuo syalya pachiy tie ung; hriykhung a rina saa a cepa bangkhuo ca bienatluophie re lie kha phuv kha tana ama cuo cuo va ma?
I ri khingpa ca khaapama a cuo? Kuvtuezuv ama pipa sa acuolikie kuvtuezuv hing a biepuv i ta khingna ta a cuo ma?
Cuo vyi, i ri khingpa ca lawki ming hriykhung a rinapa ca khuevuo'a luo ama pipa cuo te Khazing'a luo ama pipa cuo vyi. Niema ca khuevuo hne namaa viesaa riypata ca khing va yi ang.
Abyipa panuo hne khuevuo panuo kha dang pakhe khu va ung ciy. Abyipa cabya hne khuevuo cabya zaw dung pakhaw khu va ung ciy.
Abyipa ca a hietlie se tapa ma ima khing? Kiema ca ama laata cahra vie kanaa ung puv?
“Khaapa bangkhuo tue khu pata a cuo,” cuorasala hmangting hingta thlahnena malie pi vyi. “Khaapa bangkhuo tue khu pata a cuo,” cuorasala hmangting hingta malie sathaw vyi.
Niema phana dyi kha huv khah ung, cuorasala malie cuota phana kha huv tie ung.
Saa zaana lie ama zaapa bangkhuo kha na chiepha thleduona ta bie hiehriy tievya li pata va ning thluo tie.
Tahematapakieca “Alyi hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo hing Abyipa huopa tana a cuo.”
Zanglituv pakha ta sa ning aca ku kieca na chiepha thleduona lie bie hiehriyna suokha hmuo tue li pata na hmiekunglie ama pachiepa bangkhuo kha ning tie.
Cuorasala cawsaa pakhakha ta, “Hingpa sa hing hriykhungrina lie ama pipa sa tana a cuo,” aca ta kieca caa changtuvpa kaw pacuona hneta chiepha thleduona kawlieta ning li pata aw tie.
Chiepha thleduona i ta tiyta niema cuo li pata caa changtuvpa chiepha thleduona khana i ri khing pata a cuo. Khaapanakawma cawsaa pakha chiepha thleduona ta kama hyazangna kha ina pakhuo aa?
Sa kha thlaa a chuo angte i ning kieca, capa sa cuota thlaa i chuo nakaw ca ta khaapanakawma ina caw-yi'a yi?
Caacuonakawta, na ning kie cuose, na dang kie cuose, khaapa na tue kie zawma, na tuepa bangkhuo kha Khazing rungnaana cuota tue tie.
Judah ming cunglie cuose, Grik ming cunglie cuose, Khazing Khrihsaabuv cunglie cuose, patawpamuona tue khah.

Hmangting i tuena lie hing cawsaa bangkhuo palung patluo riypata a zue angte, kama phana kha huv lipa angta, cawsaa hluvpuv phana hmung riypa kha i huv. Capa ca cawsaa hluvpuv khuona ama hmung thena riypa tana a cuo.
Kama ta Khrih kha i mangpuopa haata kama kha naa mangpuo ra tie ung.
Hmangting kawlie kama kha naa thyi ung cate ica pacuv pachaapa yi phungluo kha nama ziy nakawta ica pathuosa yi.
Cuorasala nama pachang riypata ica khingpa yi ca, Khrih ca cawsaa bangkhuo luv ta cuo te, navaapa ca napuvnung luv ta a cuo, cakhutaata Khazing ca Khrih luv ta a cuo.
Capaa pakha ta thlaa a chuo tiyta hne profetbiephu a ri tiyta a luv kha aa khuv kieca a luv ling a pazuepa tana a cuo,
cuorasala canung pakha ta a luv kha a khuv li pata thlaachuo te profetbiephu a ri kieca a luv ling a pazuepa tana a cuo, a luv a pamyipa canung hne tana aa lu.
Caacuonakawta canung ta a luv kha aa khuv li kieca a suo kha a ngu lalue se; cuorasala canung pakha cuota suo a ngupa hne luv a pamyipa kha lingzuena ta a cuo kieca a luv kha a khuv se.
Capaa ca a luv kha aa khuv riypata cuo vyi, tahematapakieca ama ca Khazing hmingsuo a phyapa hne a rungnaana a paluo sapa tana a cuo; cuorasala canung ca capaa rungnaana a paluo satuv dyi tana a cuo.
Hmisi ta ripa kieca, capaa ca canung'a taata sapa cuo li pata, canung khana capaa'a taata sapa ta a cuo hriy.
Capaa ca canung cuota sapa cuo li pata, canung khana capaa cuota sapa ta a cuo.
Capa kawlie hne avuoming hmiemang pata canung pakha ca luvkhuv kha a khuv se.
Tuokhaata a cuo zaw, Abyipa chunglie ima hringna lie hingta ca capaa aw li pata canung ta ama seta a daa khu aw li pata, capaa zaw canung aw li pata ama seta a daa khu vyi.
Tahematapakieca canung ca capaa chungtaata sapa a cuopa haata capaa zaw canung chungtaata a puvpa tana a cuo. Cuorasala hmangting bangkhuo hing Khazing'a taata a vawpa tana a cuo.
Niemata tah bie a chi tie ung: canung ta a luv a khuv li pata Khazing'a luo thlaachuo riypa a pha'a ma?
Chuelyi hmang awtuvzya hingta capaa ta a suo a pasyi kieca a ling kha a pazue te,
canung ca a suo a syi kieca a rungnaana tana a cuo ta pata cuo va ma? Tahematapakieca a suo ca a luv a khuvna riypata pipa tana a cuo.
Cuorasala cawsaa pakhakha ta hingpa hing a i khing kieca kiema'a lie cuose, Khazing Khrihsaabuv'a lie cuose, cahaapaapa phungluo ca aw vyi, ta pata i ri khing.
Cadyiseca, a raw luo pacuvna kawlie hingta ca ca pathuosa khu va yi ang, tahematapakieca namaa pungnapa hingta phana laata chiena a chiykhyi vie.
Tahematapakieca, a suokhana ca Khrihsaabuv lie namaa pung tiyta phuv kha hne phuv kha palung a lu lina nama hnyi tapa kha thyi angte, aa hmuo buo thluo thlu aa ta pata i zang.
Hmisi ta ripa kieca, a phuv ta achena ca a aw aa hu thluo ra, cakiedyina niema hrawlie ahungma a hmisipa a cuo tapa kha aa luo aa.
Niema namaa pung pakhaw tiyta nama ningpa ca Abyipa zuosa ta cuo vyi.
Ning tiy a vya ta tiyta, nama huopa cyicuo kha a la ung cate nama ning; pakha ca a nang diy te pakha ca nama pariy.

Ningna dangna riypata ing hnyi va ung ca ma? Acuolikie, Khazing Khrihsaabuv kha nutaa pata khaapahmuo a hnyi lipa tie nang pazaa riypa ma nama khing? Khaapa bie ma ica chang'a yi? Ica pathuosa'a yi ma? Hingpa kawlie hingta ca ca pathuosa'a va yi ang!
Tahematapakieca ica pi pachaapa yi hing Abyipa'a taata i hmungpa tana a cuo. Abyipa Zingsuv ca ama lyi zuopa lie kha viechuo kha la te,
palungtluona bie a hluo khutaata, chechi te, “Hingpa hing niema cuota ica pipa yi i pangpa tana a cuo. Kama a thyi pakhaana riypata tue mya ung,” a ta yi.

Cahaa ngiethie cata, zuosa ama ning khutaata, panuo zaw kha la te, “Hingpa panuo hing i thiyse ta pacu sapa biekuona thaapa tana a cuo. Hingpa panuo nama dang kyry hingta kama a thyi pakhaana riypata tue mya ung,” a ta.
Tahematapakieca hingpa viechuo hing ning ung cate hingpa panuo hing nama dang kyry ta Abyipa thiyna khana ama aa vaw pakhaana te ta nama phu pata a cuo.
Caacuonakawta a hmuo tluopa a cuo li pata Abyipa viechuo kha ning te panuo kha a dangpa ca Abyipa pangpa hne thiyse lieta a suepa tana a cuo.
Nama hne nama kha a hiehriypasie taa la, cakhutaa dyi cata viechuo kha ning la panuo kha dang tie.
Tahematapakieca Abyipa pangpa kaw kha pachangpasie li pata viechuo kha ce te panuo a dangpa bangkhuo ca iema cunglie suena patlung riypata a ning a dangpa tana ama cuo.
Capa kawlie ca na niema a hluvpuv ca nama thaa dya te nama pasa, chekha ca nama thiy.
Kiema hne kiema kha maa hiehriypasie kieca bie ripa pata cuo'a vapuv.
Cuorasala, Abyipa ta kiema kha bie malie a ripa kieca chuelyi ming hneta sue be hnepa ma cuo li riypata malie a pasiy a pa-yapa tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta, i uvnu hne i sieta zaw, Abyipa zuosa hmuo riypata namaa pung tiyta, pakha hne pakha kha a huo mya ung.
Nama nang a diy kie ing lie kha ning tie ung. Cahaacata a cuo kieca, namaa pung thueta sue aca be riy yi aw'a vyi. Hmang hrangpa hne aa patuv pata ca i vya chiy thue tana ica pacuv pakhaa'a yi.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, thlaapa lasaw hne aa patuv pata, ca pachang sa lipa yi ta aw khing va ang.
Lawki ming nama za cuo ning kha a huv a sung lipa kuvtuezuv abie riypata ca za sawle yi te, luo nama za piepa kha nama pachang.

Caacuonakawta nama pachang riypata i khingpa ca Khazing Thlaapa ta bie a ripa ta ca, “Zingsuv ca chie sapa cuose,” ta buo'a va yi. Thlaapa Pathe thueta ta li pata ca, “Zingsuv ca Abyipa tana a cuo,” ta khu'a va yi.
Lasaw phangphang a aw raalaa pata, Thlaapa pakha'a taa tana a cuo diy.
Re a phangphang a aw raalaa pata, Abyipa pakha huona ma hrie diy.
Rehriena a phangphang a aw raalaa pata, khapa bangkhuo a pahrie a patue sapa yi ca Khazing pakha tana a cuo.
Zaapuv phana riypata pakha cyicuo kha Thlaapa paluohuo sa khunapa kha malie a pi.
Thlaapa ca ta pakha kha singna bie ri khu riypa pi te, capa Thlaapa ngiethie ca ta pakha kha pachangna bie ri khu riypata a pi.
A hrangpa pakha kha Thlaapa ca ta zangna pi te, capa Thlaapa ngiethie ca ta pakha kha patluo sana lasaw a pi.

A hrangpa pakha kha kharuehaa hmang tue khuna pi te, a hrangpa pakha kha profetbiephu ri thena a pi. A hrangpa pakha kha Thlaapa thleduothena pi te, a hrangpa pakha kha ryiphanghrangpa a phangphang cyi thena a pi, a hrangpa pakha kha ryiphanghrangpa pali thenapa a pi.
Hingpa bangkhuo a tuetuv hing Thlaapa pakha ta cuo te, a khingna haa khata cawsaa kha lasaw phang nanang kaluo ta a pi yi.
Pangpa ca suokha cuo te chebuo a hluvsa a hnyipa haata hne chebuo bangkhuo ca ama hluvsa raalaa pata pangpa suokha ta ama cuopa haata, Zingsuv chunglie zaw cahaacata a cuo.

Cahaacata kiema bangkhuo zaw hing Judah ming ma cuo zaw, Jentail ming ma cuo zaw, sii ma cuo zaw, hya a zangpa ma cuo zaw, ma bangkhuo hingta pangpa suokha chunglie kha Thlaapa pakha ta tiynawna malie pi te, ma bangkhuo hingta dang riypa, Thlaapa pakha kha pipa tana ma cuo.
Pangpa suokha lie hing chebuo suokha dyi aw li pata chebuo a hluvpuv ama aw.
Phyi ta, “Kama ca kuv i cuo li nakawta pangpa ta cuo va ang,” ta sala, capa ca ta chebuo cuo li tli pata pa-aw sa'a vyi.
Cahaacata naa ta, “Ming i cuo li nakawta pangpa ta cuo va ang,” ta sala, capa ca ta chebuo cuo li tli pata pa-aw sa'a vyi.
Ma pangpa bangkhuo hing ming ta cuo sala, tuokhaatama a thyi the aa? Ma pangpa bangkhuo hing naa ta cuo sala, tuokhaatama rang a thyi the aa?
Cuorasala a ta a cuona haa yalya hingta, Khazing ta, ama khingna haata, chebuo tie kha iema'a na ama awna riypa hmang lie kha a chi yi.
Chebuo suokha ta cuo diy yi sala, pangpa ca khaapaliema a aw aa?
Ata a cuona haa hingta, chebuo hluvpuv aw yi te, pangpa suokha ta a cuo.
Ming ta kuv kha, “Nama kha caa hu va ang,” ta khu vyi; luv zaw ta phyi kha, “Nama ca caa hu va ang,” ta khu ra'a vyi.
Hmisi ta ripa kieca, a thaa a dya viepa haata a tapa chebuo tie hing ama aw li pata a cuo the lipa tana ama cuo.
Pa-uvsathyi tluo a tla uo vyi ta pata ma ruepa tie kha khuo vie ta mangchiy pate, a puvthe uo lipa chebuo tie kha a puvthe vie ta ma pangi yi.
A puvthe viepa chebuo tie ca cahaacata tue a hu va yi. Cuorasala Khazing ta hmiezaa tluo aa tla uo lipa tie kha hmiezaana a le vie ta pi yi te pangpa kha a sa.
Capa ca pangpa chunglie palung a lu lina a aw li riypa hne chebuo tie kha amaa mangchiy the kaluo riypata a tue.
Chebuo suokha ta pasana a ang kieca pasakhyi kaluo yi te, chebuo suokha ta hmiezaana a hmung kieca amaa lawkhyi kaluo.
Niema ca Khrih pangpa cuo ung cate, pakha cyicuo hing capa pangpa chebuo ca tana nama cuo.

Khazing ta Khrihsaabuv lie re a pi tiy yi ta, a suokhana ta lucuotuv tie, a suohningna ta profet tie, a suothungna ta pacuvtuv tie, cakhutaa kharuehaa hmang a tuetuvpa tie, cakhutaata patluo sa khuna lasaw pipa tie, a paziy pata malie a bya khuna pipa tie, cakhutaata malie luochiy thena pipa tie, hne ryiphanghrangpa a phangphang ta a cyi khupa tie ta pata a pi yi.
Ama bangkhuo ta lucuotuv ama cuo ma? Ama bangkhuo ta profet ama cuo ma? Ama bangkhuo ta pacuvtuv ama cuo ma? Ama bangkhuo ta kharuehaa hmang ama tue ma?
Ama bangkhuo ta patluo sa khuna ama hnyi ma? Ama bangkhuo ta ryiphanghrangpa ama cyi ma? Ama bangkhuo ta ryiphanghrangpa kha ama palie the ma?
Cuorasala aa suo viepa lasaw hmung riypa kha a zue tie ung. Kama zaw ta a pha cepa luo kha ica pahmung sa'a yi.
Kama hingta cawsaa zaw ryiphanghrangpa tie hne avuoming ryi zaw kha hmuo the ra ang sala, duena i hnyi li kieca i ryi ca malie naa a ruepa daakhang pu hne chaaraa pu haa kha tana a cuo.
Profetbiephu ri khuna hnyi angte, bie a thuvpa bangkhuo i pachang diy khutaata pachangna phangting hnyi pata, tluo a hnyi khupa zangna i hnyi zaw ta duena i hnyi li kieca, khaapatahmuo cuo va ang.
I hnyipa bangkhuo kha malie pi diy yi angte i pangpa kha myi ta rue riypata i pi zaw ta, duena i hnyi li kieca khaapatahmuo cuo va ang.
Duena ca a palung a pasiy; kawpacuo a the; duena ca malie hietlie vyi, a pale a patie vyi, a hruo tle li pata
a palung chiehruv vyi. Duena ca ama phana dyi kha huv vyi; a hi haa paluo li pata a palung ra paluo vyi;
tue pathlyipa suena cunglieta a palung tluo vyi, cuorasala biehmisipa lie kha a palung a tluo.
Duena ca hmangting kha ang khu te, hmangting kha a zang, hmangting kha a nguopuo te hmangting lie te a maa khu.
Duena ca chuo buo vyi. Cuorasala profetbiephu zaw ca a chuo aa. Ryiphanghrangpa rithena zaw chuo'a te, thesingna zaw a chuo aa.
Tahematapakieca a chebuo dyi pachang pate, bie kha a che dyi ma phu.
Cuorasala a tlingpa a vya chiy tiyta a chebuo hing ca a chuo aa.
Haatiy i cuo ning kha haatiy haata bie i ri, haatiy haata rue angte, haatiy haata i ruepacuo. Uvthyita i vya cuo tiyta haatiy cuona kha i pachuo sa.

Tahematapakieca ata hing ca thlaluo lie a sie pawliy li pata maa hmungpa haata cuo pate, capa thueta ca a hmiepachaw pata ma hmung aa. Ata hing ca a chebuo dyi pachang angte, capa thueta ca kama kha ina pachangpasiepa haata a bangkhuo ta i pachang aa.
Ata hing aa hmang paripa hmang suothung aw te, zangna, anguopuona hne duena ta ama cuo, capa zaw hrawlieta a le cepa ca duena tana a cuo.
Duena kha a patuv ung la thlaapa lasaw hmung kha a zue tie ung. A hlyi vie ta profetbiephu rithena kha a zue tie ung.

Tahematapakieca ryiphanghrangpa a cyipa ca cawsaa'a lie kha a cyipa cuo li pata Khazing'a lie a cyipa tana a cuo. Tahematapakieca thlaapa chunglie bie aa thuvpa kha ama ri nakawta ahungtahmuo thyi va yi.
Cuorasala biephu a ripa tie ca cawsaa hrangpa tie amaa sathawna riypa, thaazuo pina hne hnaapanguona ta ama ri pata a cuo.
Ryiphanghrangpa a cyipa tie ca iema hne iema kha a sathaw yi te profetbiephu a ripa tie ca Khrihsaabuv kha ama sathaw.

Niema bangkhuo ryiphanghrangpa nama cyi riypa icaa khingkhyi raalaa pa yi ta, profetbiephu rithena kha icaa khingkhyi vie yi. Profetbiephu a ripa ca ryiphanghrangpa a cyipa laata aa suo vie. Khrihsaabuv aa sathaw khu riypata pakhakha ta a ri khingna kha a palie li kieca ryiphanghrangpa ca khaapahmuo thlahne vyi.

Uvnu hne sieta zaw, niema'a luo kha ryiphanghrangpa cyi pata a vaw ang sala niema kha Khazing biephu cuose, pachangna cuose, profetbiephu cuose, pacuvna cuose ica hnyi li kie yi ca khaapama a thlahne aa?

Hringna a hnyi lipa, tungpa chechiy ta a cuopa, ramang hne tingtuo zaw ama paring cakhawpa hne tana aa lu aa. A ue kha a siesa pata a pya li kieca khaapa ue ma ama tung tapa kha pachang khu a aw'a ma?
Hmyakaa a tungtuv ta rietuvna hmyakaa ue pachiy pata a siesa pata a tung li kieca ahungma rie tuv riypata a pachie pacie pata a aw aa?
Cahaacata ryiphanghrangpa nama cyipa ca a ri khingna thyi thepa a cuo li kieca khaapama ama ri tapa kha ahungma a pachang aa? Thliy chunglie bie ri cakhawpa tana a cuo aa.
Chuelyi cunglie hing ryi a phangphang ta aw te siyluo a hnyi lipa ryi suokha hmuo aw vyi.
Ryi phang kha ca a ri khingna i pachang li kieca a cyituvpa cuo khata kama ca ryi a thyi lipa ruohrang ming cuo angte, a cyituvpa zaw kha kama cuota a ryi thyi lipa ruohrang ming tana a cuo ra.
Caacuonakawta thlaapa lasaw kha nama hmung khing hringhruo kieca, khrihsaabuv a sathaw riypa lasaw kha hmung a zue tie ung.
Caacuonakawta, ryiphanghrangpa a cyipa pakha ca a ri khingna palie khu riypa kha thlaa a chuo se.
Tahematapakieca ryiphanghrangpa ta thlaa i chuo kieca, i thlaapa ta thlaa ca a chuo raalaa pata i pathiypalung lieta thlahnena aw vyi.
Caacuokieca khaapama i tue aa? Thlaapa ta thlaachuo'a angte, i pathiypalung ta zaw thlaa i chuo ra aa; thlaapa ta pathuosana hlaa sa'a angte, pathiypalung ta zaw i sa ra aa.
Caacuolikieca thlaapa ta thlaa na chuopa kha khaapama na ri tapa a pachang lipa ale cawsaa ta na thlaachuopa kha tuokhaatama “Amen” a ta the aa?
Nama ca Khazing kha a phasa pata na pathuosa raalaa pata cawsaa hrangpa cuota ca a sathawna aw vyi.
Niema bangkhuo laata ryiphanghrangpa a hluv vie i cyi nakawta Khazing kha i law.
Cuorasala, apungna chunglie malie pacuvna riypata ca ryiphanghrangpa biesuo thawhraa i cyipa laata thyipa ryi biesuo suopangaa khana i cyi hriy aa.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, nama khueruena hing haatiyta khueruena haata cuo khah se, uvthyita haata khuerue ung la, pha lina kawlie dyi kha haatiyta haata cuo tie ung.
Phungbie caa-uv chunglie, Abyipa ta, “Ryiphanghrangpa a cyipa tie hne ruohrang ming pakaa taata hingpa cawsaa zaw'a luo hing bie i ri aa; Cakhutaa cata hmuota na naathlie ngiethie'a va yi,” a ta.

Cakhutaata, ryiphanghrangpa ca zangtuv tie cuota cuo li pata zanglituv tie cuota pamangsana ta a cuopa haata profetbiephu rithena hing zanglituv tie cuota cuo li pata zangtuv tie cuota pamangsana ta a cuo ra.
Caacuonakawta, khrihsaabuv lie zangtuv tie bangkhuo a pung ung la, nama bangkhuo ta ryiphanghrangpa nama cyina lie kha zanglituv tie amaa zaa ngie kie, ama ngaa diy tli ca ta'a va yi ma?
Cuorasala nama bangkhuo ta profetbiephu kha nama ri kieca, zanglituv acuolikie ale cawsaa pakhakha a zaa ngie tiyta, nama bie khata a pathiypalung kha capya'a te a suena aa pachang aa.
A palungruv chunglie'apa kha a kya luo'a te, a pakhuv pane'a te Khazing kha abie'a te, “Nama hrawlie Khazing a aw hmisi,” a ta aa.

Caacuokieca, uvnu zaw, khaapama ma tue aa? Khazing abie riypata namaa pung tiyta, niema pakha cyicuo ta, hlaa sa a khingpa, a pacuv khingpa, Khazing biephu a ri khingpa, ryiphanghrangpa a cyi khingpa, a ri khingna a palie khingpa ta pata nama aw aa. Hingpa bangkhuo hing Khrihsaabuv a sathawna ta tue tie ung.
Ryiphanghrangpa a cyi khingpa nama aw kieca pahning acuolikie a hluv ce ta pathung ta ri yi sala, aa paziy pata ri yi se; cakhutaata pakha ta a ri khingna kha palie se.
A palie riypa ama aw li kieca, a dieta tah aw yi sala, iema hne Khazing'a lie kha ri yi se.
Profet pahning acuolikie pathung ta bie kha ri yi sala, a hrangpa tie ta ama ripa kha ruepacuo yi se.
A thaalie a tu rapa pakhakha'a lieta, Khazing biephu aa luo kieca, a ri taapa ca duo se.
Tahematapakieca, nama bangkhuo ta namaa cuv the riypa hne thaazuo namaa la thena riypata profetbiephu kha pakha hnang pakha ta nama ri khu.
Profet tie pathiypalung ta ca profet tie ri kha a ngie aa.
Tahematapakieca Khazing ca adang-apuo li pata hmang a tuepa cuo li pata diena Khazing tana a cuo. (Mingpathepa tie ta khrihsaabuv bangkhuo lie ama tuepa haa khata,
canung ca apungna lie kha a dieta tah aw yi se. Tahematapakieca iema ca bie rina naw hnyi va yi. Phungbie ta a ripa haa khata, aa ne vie ta aw yi se.
Ama pachang khingpa suokhakha a aw kieca ama navaapa kha ing lie hiehriy yi se. Khrihsaabuv chunglie bie ripa ca canung cuota nangzaa aa chiypa tana a cuo.
Khazing bie ca niema'a taata a hruo a thu kanaa? Acuolikie capa bie ca niema'a luo dyi hing chiy kanaa?)
Niema hrawlieta profet tana i cuo aa tapa tie, acuolikie thlaapa cahrana na i hmung aa tapa tie ta, ata niema'a luo i vya capepa caa hing Abyipa bie pipa tana a cuo tapa kha pachang yi se.
Hingpa hing khaapatahmuo a ri lipa ca khaapatahmuo ripa cuo'a vyi.
Caacuonakawta, viesaa zaw, profetbiephu ri kha khing ung la, ryiphanghrangpa cyi kha thlu khah ung;
cuorasala hmangting bangkhuo kha aa chaw aa rawsa pata hne aa dang aa puosa pata tue tie ung.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, ica za changpa yi thuophaa kha namaa thyi pakhaa pata i khing. Capa thuophaa ca cuhluo ung cate, nama zangna a cusa pata nama bangnapa ta a cuo.
Niema ta hingpa ica changpa yi thuophaa hing a cusa pata namaa patuv kieca khuopa ta cuo'a ung cate, a cusa pata namaa patuv li kieca nama zangna kha a hrihripa tana a cuo aa.
Tahematapakieca i za hmungpa, a biepuv ce ta pata niema ica chang pachaapa yi ca: Caapathe chunglie ama za capepa haata Khrih ca ma sue nakawta thiy te,
paby yi te, Caapathe lie aa capepa haata ning thungnapa lie pathu pakhaa pata a cuo.
Piter'a lie kha a luo te, cakhutaata lucuotuv hlyihning cunglie kha aa luo.
Cakhutaata a ziytuv zapangaa hlyi cunglie kha yi kha ta a luo te, chekha ca ama thiy tli raalaa pata hluv vie ca ama hring kalie.
Cakhutaata Jeim'a lie kha a luo te, lucuotuv bangkhuo'a lie kha aa luo.
A hnangcaw ce ta a ning thlaa tling li pata a puvpa haata a cuopa kama'a lie zaw kha aa luo.
Tahematapakieca kama ca lucuotuv tie hrawlie a caw cepa tana i cuo. Khazing khrihsaabuv kha i za hrisaa nakawta lucuotuv ta pata ku riypata hmuo a tla va ang.

Cuorasala Khazing vihnyina thueta kama ca ata i cuona haa hingta cuo angte, vi ina hnyina ca a cakhawpa ta cuo vyi. Lucuotuv hrangpa bangkhuo laata khuo vie ta rehrie angte, cuorasala capa ca kama ta i hriepa cuo li pata kama chunglie a awpa Khazing vihnyina ta a hriepa tana a cuo.
Kama cuo ang se, iema cuo yi se, ma bangkhuo ta thuophaa kha phu pate niema zaw nama zang.
Khrih ca thiyna taa tana a thu pakhaa ta pata phupa a cuo kieca, khaapanakawma niema chekha ta thiyna taata thupakhaana aw vyi ta pata nama ri the?
Thiyna taata thupakhaana na a aw va ta pata a cuo kieca, Khrih hing pathu pakhaa pata cuo'a vyi.
Khrih hing pathu pakhaa pata a cuo li kieca, ma thuophaa phupa hing a cakhawpa ta cuo'a te, nama zangna zaw a cakhawpa tana a cuo aa.

Kiema zaw te kha Khazing kaw a richiepa ta malie ama hmung aa, tahematapakieca, Khazing na Khrih kha thiyna taata a pathu ta pata Khazing kaw kha tehte ma khuo. Athiypa tie thupakhaa va yi ta pata a cuo kieca, Khazing ta Khrih kha thiyna taata a pathu pakhaa li nakaw tana a cuo aa.
Tahematapakieca a thiypa tie pathu pakhaa pata a cuo li kieca, Khrih zaw pathu pakhaa pata cuo'a vyi.
Khrih kha pathu pakhaa pata a cuo li kieca, nama zangna ca khaapahmuo cuo li'a pata nama suena chunglie a aw kaliepa tana nama cuo aa.
Cakhutaata Khrih zang pata, a thiypa tie zaw ama lidie diy aa.
Khrih chunglie maa nguopuona hing ma hring chung cuota dyi hingta a cuo kieca, cawsaa bangkhuo hrawlie ngiechi aa chiy cepa tana ma cuo aa.
Cuorasala Khrih ca thu pakhaa hmisi saw te, a thiypa tie hraw taata thyipaa taapa ta a cuo.
Thiyna ca cawsaa pakha thueta a tlungpa haata, thiyna taata thupakhaana zaw cawsaa pakha thue tana a tlung ra.
Tahematapakieca Adam kawlieta cawsaa bangkhuo ama thiypa haata, Khrih thueta cawsaa bangkhuo kha pahring pata ama cuo aa.
Cuorasala iema'a na ama cuo cyicuo ta pathu pakhaa pata ama cuo aa: thyipaa taapa ca Khrih ta cuo'a te, cakhutaata aa vaw ningta a cawsaa a cuopa tie ta ama cuo aa.
Cakhutaata cuo chuona kha vya tlung'a te, Khrih ta uvtuv bangkhuo, nawhnyina bangkhuo hne cahrana bangkhuo kha a para diy khutaata, pena ca a Paa Khazing'a luo kha a pi aa.
A carie bangkhuo kha a phyipazaa rawlie a chaapuona te yi ta a uv'a yi.
A hnangcaw ce ta para riypa a cariepa ca thiyna ta a cuo.

Tahematapakieca, “Khazing ta hmangting bangkhuo kha a phyipazaa rawlie a chi,” a ta. Cuorasala, “Hmangting bangkhuo kha a phyipazaa rawlie a chi,” a ta tiyta hmangting kha Khrih phyipazaa rawlie a chituv Abyipa ca ripuo pata cuo vyi tapa kha a sie.

Hmangting bangkhuo kha ama uvna rawlie chi diy pata a cuo tiyta, sacapaa hrahring hing hmangting bangkhuo ama phyipazaa rawlie a pachi sa diypa Khazing uvna rawlie kha aw'a te, Khazing ca hmangting bangkhuo cunglie uvtuv ta a cuo aa.
Caacuolikieca, a thiypa tie cuopa ta tiy a nawpa tie kha tuokhaata? Athiypa tie kha pathu pakhaa pata ama cuo li kie, khaapanakawma cawsaa ta iema cuopa ta tiy amaa naw aa?
Cakhutaata, khaapanakawma kiema hrahring hing ruvnaana chunglie ma aw pari?
Ningting tana i thiy! Uvnu hne sieta zaw, niema icaa palesakhyipa yi hing, a cuo hmisipa, ima Khrih Zingsuv chunglieta icaa palesakhyipa yi tana a cuo.

Efesa khy lie saahruo tie hne i zaa tuvpa kha cawsaapa a nguopuo cakhawna hneta cuo sala, khaapama ina thlahne aa? A thiypa tie pathu pakhaapa ama cuo li kieca, “Ning ung sala, dang ung siy, tahematapakieca mawluo ca ma thiy aa.”
Cawsaa ta ca dung khah yi se: “Viesaa pha lipa na zyazaa pha a para.”

Lungsingpya pata aw ung la pathiypalung pha hnyi tie ung. Suena tue khah tie ung, tahematapakieca cawsaa chekha ca Khazing kha pachang va yi. Nama nang zaa naase ta angte na hing haa hingta ica ta yi.
Chekha ta, “A thiypa tie hing tuokhaatama ama thu pakhaa aa? Tuokhaapa pangpa ma ama hnyi aa?” nama ta aa.
A ngaapa zaw! Na tuvpa saciy kha a thiy li pata a kya pu the ma?
Na tuvpa a ciy suokha, jungsacuo acuolikie saciy suokhakha ta cuo te, a kya le riypa a kung khata cuo cuo vyi.
Cuorasala Khazing ta ama khingna haata saciy ca a khingpa pangpa kha a pi. Saciy cyicuo khata iema'a na pangpa cyicuo ama hnyi.
Hringna a hnyipa bangkhuo ta ama hnyipa ngesaa hing a lu va yi, cawsaa ngesaa a phanghrang, saruopa ngesaa a phanghrang, pavaa ngesaa a phanghrang, ngaa ngesaa a phanghrang tana ama cuo.
Vuoruo pangpa aw te alyi pangpa a aw ra, cuorasala vuoruo pangpa rungnaana a phanghrang, alyi pangpa rungnaana a phanghrang tana a aw.
Ning rungnaana a phanghrang, thlaapa rungnaana a phanghrang, aasiy zaw rungnaana a phanghrang tana a aw; hmisi ta ripa kieca aasiy zaw hmuo suokha hne suokha ama rungnaana aa nanang kalie.
A thiypa tie thupakhaana zaw cahaaca tana a cuo. Saapa pangpa ca ma paby ningta a thuv thepa cuo te, pathu pakhaapa a cuo tiyta ca a thuv the lipa tana a cuo.
Pabypa a cuo ning ca a hming chiepa hne a thaadyapa cuo te, pathu pakhaapa a cuo thue ca a puvthepa hne a cahrapa ta a cuo aa.
Paby ning ca chuelyi pangpa cuo te, pathu pakhaa thue ca thlaapa pangpa tana a cuo aa.
Caapathe ta, “Cawsaa taapa Adam ca a hringpa cawsaa ta a cuo,” a ta. A hnangcawpa Adam ca hringna a pipa thlaapa tana a cuo.
Cuorasala a aw taapa ca thlaapa kha cuo li pata, saapa pangpa kha tana a cuo, cakhutaa ca tana thlaapa ca aa vaw.
Cawsaa taapa Adam ca alyi taata cuo te, alyi diypa taata sapa tana a cuo; cuorasala Adam pahningnapa ca vuoruo taa tana a cuo.
Alyi huopa a cuopa tie ca alyi ta sapa haa khata cuo yi te, vuoruo huopa a cuopa tie ca vuoruo taata pa haa khata ama cuo.
Alyi ta sapa hmingsuo kha ma phyapa haata vuoruo taata pa hmingsuo zaw kha ma phya riypata a cuo.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, i ripa ca hing haa hingta a cuo: thiy hne saa ta ca Khazing pena kha cu khu'a vyi, a ra khupa ta a ra khu lipa ru kha cu khu'a vyi.

Naathlie tie ung, aa thuvpa bieparuv na ica chang'a yi! Kiema bangkhuo hing thiy diy'a vapuv, cuorasala a hnangcaw cepa hmyakaa ama tung thueta kiema bangkhuo hing sungkhata lie, ming vy hluota lieta maa thle aa. Hmyakaa kha tung'a yi te, a thiypa tie kha a ra the lipa luo pathu pakhaa pata ama cuo aa, cakhutaata kiema kha maa thle aa.
Tahematapakieca hingpa a ra thepa pangpa hingta a ra the lipa kha a hryi'a te, hingpa a thiy thepa pangpa hingta a thiy the lipa kha aa hryi aa.

Hingpa a ra thepa pangpa ta a ra the lipa kha a hryi'a te, hingpa a thiy thepa pangpa ta a thiy the lipa pangpa kha a hryi tiyta Caapathe lie cape siypa kha a tling aa: “Thiyna ca tena chunglie pahlipadiepa a cuo tli.”
“Vya thiyna, na tena ca khaapaliema a aw? Vya thiyna, na ca-ie ca khaapaliema a aw?”
Thiyna ca-ie ca suena cuo te, suena cahrana ca phungbie ta a cuo.
Cuorasala, ima Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih thueta tena malie a pituv Khazing ca pathuosa pata aw mang sue.

Caacuonakawta, i duepa zaw, a cusa pata a daa tie ung. Khaapatahmuo ca hnyi khu khah yi se. Abyipa re kha a pha ce pata hrie pari tie ung, tahematapakieca Abyipa re nama hriepa bangkhuo ca a hripa ta cuo vyi tapa kha nama pachang.
Mingpathepa tie cuota sue pina hne aa patuv pata, Galatia khrihsaabuv tie i changpa yi kha tue ra tie ung.
Kama i vya chiy thueta sue khyichaw aa hu li riypata a zaa tating ning khana lie kha nama cyicuo ta nama hmungpa tuokaa chungtaata chebuo ung la pacung pacie tie ung.
Kama i vya chiy thueta, palung tling pata namaa tlawpa tie kha Jerusalem luo nama lasaw paphya riypata caa hneta ma pathlie'a yi.
Kama si riypata aa hu kie zawma, kama kha ina ziy'a yi.
Masidonia ruo cahrawpaa pata vya si i ting nakawta cahaacata i tlawpaale khutaata niema'a luo kha i vya chiy aa.
Khaapa luo i tlaw zaw, ina patlaw sa riypa ung cata, niema'a lie kha thlasiy a chuona te khiy hmuo i aw the aa.
Capiepaale siy pata niema hne a hmungpa ca i palung tling the'a vyi. Khazing khingna ta a cuo kieca, cuo kha chung ca niema'a lie aw na i ting.
Cuorasala Pentekos te khiy ca Efesa liena aw i ting.
Tahematapakieca a hma a sisa riypa re kha i cuota a pahaw te, kama naa dutuv a hluvsa zaw ama aw.
Timote kha niema'a luo a vya chiy kieca, niema hrawlie ciyna a hnyi li riypata a phata tah za mangsang mya ung, ama ca kama haata Abyipa re a hriepa tana a cuo.
Ahungtahmuo ese khah yi se. Kama hne uvnu zaw ta ma mangkhuo nguoluo nakawta, kama'a luo a vya chiy the riypata a bya tie ung.
Ma uvnupa Apollo hne aa patuv pata i ri kieca, viesaa hrang tie zaw hne khata niema'a luo vya tlaw riypata khuosa ta i chang raalaa pata, vya tlaw khing valie. A cuo aa raw thue tana a vya tlaw aa.
Singvaasa pata aw tie ung. Nama zangna lie kha a cusa pata a daa tie ung. Nama rie pha sala cahra tie ung.
Nama tuepa bangkhuo kha duena ta tue tie ung.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, Stefanas chungkhue ca Akhaia pe lie khrihsaa a cuo taapa ta cuo yi te, Khazing mingpathepa tie cuota aa pisapa ta ama cuopa kha nama pachang.
Cahaapa cawsaa tie hne iema hne re a hrie hnepa bangkhuo tie ri kha a ngie ung ta pata paa ica kie yi.
Stefanas hne Fortunatus hne Akhaikas ama vya chiy nakawta i palung a tluo, nama na aw lipa hmuo malie ama pamaw sa;
tahematapakieca kama palung ina patluopa haa yi ta niema palung zaw aca patluo ra yi. Cahaapa cawsaa tie ca pasungpanaa riypa tana ama cuo.
Asia ruo lie a awpa khrihsaabuv tie na nama kuv caa patuv yi. Akuila hne Prisilla hne ama ing lie a pungpa khrihsaabuv na thaa phasa pata nama kuv caa patuv yi.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw bangkhuo na nama kuv caa patuv yi. Pakha hne pakha kha a pathepa a pahnuona ta bie a chang tie ung.
Kama Paul na hingpa bie-achangna caa hing i kuv ta a cape ang.
Ahunghmuo cuose, Abyipa a due lipa ca a cunglie chiesana tlung se. Marana tha: Ima Byipaapa, a vaw buo tie!
Abyipa Zingsuv vihnyina ca niema'a lie aw mang sue.
Khrih Zingsuv thueta ica duenapa yi ca nama bangkhuo cunglie aw mang sue.
Khazing khingna ta Khrih Zingsuv lucuotuv a cuopa kama Paul hne ima nuta Timote ta, Korin khy lie a awpa Khazing khrihsaabuv hne Akhaia pe khy ting lie a awpa mingpathepa tie'a luo kha:
Ima Paa Khazing hne Abyipa Zingsuv Khrih'a taata vihnyina hne thlaalungna ca nama cunglie aw mang sue, ta pata bie maacaa chang yi.
Ima Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih a Paa hne a Khazing, ngie malie a chituv ma Paa, hnaanguona Khazing ca pathuosa pata cuo mang sue.
Riethyivuosuona bangkhuo lie hnaa malie a panguotuv cuo te, cahaacata kiema zaw ta ama'a taata ma hmungpa hnaapanguona kha hmuo pata riethyivuosuona a ang rapa tie kha hnaa ma panguo ra yi.
Tahematapakieca Khrih te-angna bangkhuo lie a hraw rapa ma cuopa haata Khrih thueta hnaapanguona zaw a hmungpa ta ma cuo.

Kiema na riethyivuosuona a ang puv tapa kieca niema hnaanguona hne khuona cuo tana a cuo. Kiema na hnaapanguopa ta a cuo puv tapa kieca niema zaw hnaapanguopa cuo ung cate, kiema ima hmungpa te-angna kha palungpasiyna hne nama ang khuna riypata thaazuo nama hmungna ta a cuo.
Niema cuota maa nguopuona ca a cahang buo'a vyi; tahematapakieca kiema te-angna namaa hrawpa haata hnaapanguopa ma cuona zaw namaa hraw ra aa tapa kha ma pachang.

Uvnu hne sieta zaw, Asia ruo chunglie riethyivuosuona ma angpa kha pachang li pata nama aw riypa khing vapuv; tahematapakieca khuopuv ta, ma ang khu lina te ta malie pavy yi te hring riypa hmuo zaa nguopuo khu vapuv.

Thiy riypata bie ripapa tana ma cuo tli tapa tana maa zaa rue. Cuorasala hing haa hingta a cuopa ca kiema hne kiema kha a ring li pata a thiypa a pathu pakhaatuv Khazing maa ring the riypa kha tana a cuo.
Ciy aa chiypa thiyna chungtaata kiema malie a khuopa ama ta malie a khuo canyi aa. Thlaachuona ta malie namaa byapa haata, malie a khuo canyi aa ta pata ama'a lie kha maa nguopuo.
Caacuonakawta cawsaa hluvpuv thlaachuona thueta, kiema ma hmungpa thluechiyna kawlie hingta, cawsaa hluvpuv ta kiema cuopa ta alawna bie ama ri aa.

Kiema maa palesakhyipa, ma chiepha thleduona ta tehte a khuopa ca: hing chuelyi lie ma hringzya hne niema hne maa pazuena lie hing chuelyi singna ta cuo li pata Khazing vihnyina hne pathiypalung hmisi tana a cuo tapa khata a cuo.
Tahematapakieca niema nama ri khupa hne nama pachang khupa ta li pata a hrangpa suokha hmuo niema'a luo ma vya capepa aw vyi.

Niema ta a chebuo nama pachang tlipa haa hingta a chuona te ta nama pachang aa tapa kha icaa nguopuo yi; cahaacata Abyipa Zingsuv ning a vya tlung tiyta kiema ca niema a palesakhyipa cuo'a pate niema zaw kiema a palesakhyipa nama cuo aa.
Hingpa hing a siesa pata i pachang nakawta, palungtluona le hning nama hmung riypata niema'a luo ica vya tlaw taa khing yi.
Masidonia luo i tlawpuo pata ca vya tlawpaa khing yi angte, Masidonia taata niema'a luo vya kaa pakhaa pata, Judea luo ina pathlie riypa ung cata i khing.

Hing haa hingta i tue khing tiyta a tuebung a tuethawpa i lu ma? Cuo kha chunglieta, “A cuo, a cuo” ama ta khutaata, “Cuo vyi, cuo vyi,” a ta pakhaapa chuelyi cawsaa cakhawpa tie haata i tuepa a cuo ma?
Khazing ca zang tluo aa tlapa a cuopa haata, niema'a lie ima ripa bie ca, “A Cuo hne Cuo Vyi,” ta pata a cuo riypata cuo vyi.

Tahematapakieca, Silvanus hne Timote hne kama ta niema'a lie ima phupa Khazing Sacapaa Zingsuv Khrih ca, “A cuo hne Cuo vyi,” a pahlawpa ta cuo vyi. Cuorasala ama'a lie ca, “A cuo,” tapa tana a cuo pari.
Tahematapakieca ama ca Khazing biekuona bangkhuo lie kha, “A cuo,” tana a cuo. Caacuonakaw ca ta muo Khazing pathuosa riypata Zingsuv thueta, “Amen,” ma ta pata a cuo ta.
Cuorasala kiema hne niema hne Khrih chunglie malie pa-aw sa te sathu malie a pathuvpa ca Khazing tana a cuo.
Kiema cuota malie a chipa paciepa bangkhuo suokha hnang suokha ta ima hmung thena riypata ma cunglie kha caa malie khe te, ma pathiypalung lie Thlaapa malie a pi.
Naa pachangkhyituv ca Khazing ta a cuo: Korin luo i vaw pakhaa lipa ca niema nama thaa duo naase ica ta nakaw yi tana a cuo.
Nama zangna cunglie kha uv caa ting va yi ang; cadyiseca nama palung aa nuona riypata niema hne re a hrie pakhawpa tana ma cuo vie hriy, tahematapakieca niema ca zangna lie a cusa pata namaa daa.
Caacuonakawta niema palung pasa sa pakhaa riypa laata ca ica vya tlaw li riypa yi ta i palung lie bie i chi.
Tahematapakieca nama palung ca pasa sa pathlyi yi ang sala, ama lie kha niema ta li pata i palung naa patluo riypa ahungma a aw aa?

I vaw thueta i palung naa patluo riypa tie ta i palung ina pasa sa li riypa ung cata hingpa caa hing i vya cape pata a cuo; tahematapakieca kama palungtluona ca niema bangkhuo palungtluona ta a cuo ra tapa kha a phasa pata i zang.

Kama ta pathiypalung rie thyisapa ta hne mingthliy yi hluvpuv lang pata caa cape angte ica vya paphyapa yi hing niema palung pasa sa riypata cuo li pata, kha tluv tama ica due yi tapa nama pachangna riypa tana a cuo.
Cawsaa pakhakha ta ngiechina a patlung sa kieca kama dyi cuo li pata niema bangkhuo zaw kha nama palung aca pasa sa yi. Hingpa bie hing niema'a lie khuo tuv ta ri khing va ang.
Niema hluv vie bangkhuo ta duo nama tepa kha a cuota aa de tli.
Caacuonakawta a ang khu lina te ta a ngie a chi li riypata ama kha a ngiethe ung la a hnaa panguo tie ung.
Nama due hmisipa kha paluo sa tie ung ta pata paa ica kie yi.
Niema ta hmangting bangkhuo lie ri-angiena nama hnyi ma, hnyi va ung ca ma tapa kha pachang riypata hing caa hing i vya cape pata a cuo.
Niema ta namaa ngiethepa bangkhuo kha i ngiethe ra aa. Kama ta suokhakha kha i ngiethe pata a cuo kieca niema cuota Khrih hmiekunglie i ngiethepa tana a cuo.
Hing haa hingta ma tuenapa ca setaa ta a raw malie a patlung li riypa tana a cuo, tahematapakieca setaa ruena hne tingna ca ma pachang diypa tana a cuo.
Khrih thuophaa phu riypata Troas luo i vaw ning kha Abyipa thueta i cuo ta luopuv aa pahaw tapa kha i pachang.
Cuorasala i uvnupa Titas i hmung li nakawta i palung rie a thyi. Caacuonakawta iema kha bie a changsiy yi angte Masidonia ruo luo kha i caluo.
Cuorasala Khazing ca a law ung siy. Khrih thueta kiema kha tena luo malie a chiy te, kiema kha hmuo pata Khrih thuophaa ca ama ma pachangna thueta hmangting luo kha rangpa-ue haata aa ze tli.
Tahematapakieca kiema ca Khazing cuota khuo nguoluopa tie hne a viele nguoluopa tie hrawlie Khrih rangpa-ue tana ma cuo.
A vie nguoluopa tie cuota ca thiyna rangpahnuopa cuo pate khuo nguoluopa tie cuota ca hringna rangpa-ue tana ma cuo. Hingpa hmang kawlie hingta ahungma a tlingpa a aw aa?

Caacuonakawta kiema ca Khazing bie kha a muo nasa pata a zaapa tie haa khata cuo vapuv; Khazing pathliepa ma cuona haata, Khrih thueta a bie kha a hmiekunglie pathiypalung hmisi ta a ripa tana ma cuo.
Hing haa hingta ma ta tiyta kiema hne kiema a pathuosa pakhaa kanaa puv? Cawsaa chekha haata niema'a luo, acuolikie niema'a taata pachangkhyina caa a hu kanaa puv?
Niema khana cawsaa bangkhuo ri riypata ma palung chunglie capepa caa ta a cuo ung ciy.
Niema ta kiema thueta Khrih capepa caa nama cuopa kha nama paluo sa. Capa caa ca caatiy ta alung cunglie capepa cuo li pata a hringpa Khazing Thlaapa ta cawsaa pathiypalung cunglie capepa tana a cuo.
Capa ca Zingsuv thueta Khazing'a lie ma hnyipa anguona tana a cuo.
Hmang suokhakha hing kiema'a taa tana a cuo ta khuna hnyi vapuv, kiema tuehrie khuna ca Khazing'a taa tana a cuo.

Ama na kiema kha biekuo thaa rehrietuv cuo riypata tuehrie khuna malie a pi. Capa biekuo thaa ca caa ta capepa phungbie cuo li pata thlaapa kha tana a cuo hriy. Caa ta capepa phungbie ta ca cawsaa kha thie te, cuorasala Thlaapa ta ca cawsaa kha hringna a pi.

Thiyna a chiykhyipa rehriena, sata ta khe yi te alung cunglie capepa caa ca rungnaana hne vya bi te, a zuebung luo a cuo raalaa pata, Moses hmie ca a rungnaa tuv nakawta Israel ming ta a hmiepachaw pata ama mang khu li kieca,
Thlaapa rehriena ca kha tluv tama a rungnaa vie aa?
Cawsaa suebena re hmuo a rungnaa kieca cawsaa duopacuna re ca kha tluv tama a rungnaa vie aa!
Hmisi ta ripa kieca, a hluo ningta zaa rungnaasapa ca ama laata a rungnaa viepa nakaw khata a rungnaana a vie tli.
Tahematapakieca cuo pachangta dyi a awpa hmuo rungnaana a hnyi kieca, chuozaa ta aa hmangpa changchiy ca kha tluv tama rungnaana a hnyi vie aa!
Hing haapa aruechuona ma hnyi nakawta ma rie a phasa.
Israel ming ta na hmung khah yi se ta pata zuebungle te a rungnaana a viepa, a hmie kha luvkhuv a khuvpa Moses haa khata cuo vapuv.

Cuorasala ama pathiypalung ca a pang hringhruo. Hmisi ta ripa kieca, ataning tepa hingta, biekuo hlung ama ri kyry ta ama hmie kha capa luvkhuv cata a pakhuv kalie yi. Tahematapakieca capa luvkhuv ca Khrih thue kyalya dyi tana hle khupa a cuo.
A cuo, ataning tepa hingta Moses phungbie kha ama ri tiyta ama pathiypalung kha luvkhuv khata a pakhuv kalie yi.
Cuorasala cawsaa pakha kha Abyipa'a luo aa thle tiyta a luvkhuv ca a hle te thaw pata a cuo.
Abyipa ca Thlaapa ta cuo te, Abyipa Thlaapa a awna lie ca hyazangna a aw.

Kiema bangkhuo ca ma luvkhuv kha hlepa tlipa ma cuo nakawta Abyipa rungnaana ca thlaluo lie maa hmungpa haa khata ma hmung. Tahematapakieca capa rungnaana ca Thlaapa ta a cuopa Abyipa'a taata a vawpa a cuo nakawta ama ma lu riypa hne ma rungnaa hryly riypata ma hringna kha malie a thlele nguoluo.
Khazing ta, hingpa re hing a nangduena thueta malie a pahrie sapa a cuo nakawta ma palung chuo buo vyi.

A paruv ta tuepa nangzaa aa chiypa hmang bangkhuo kha thaw diy pate, zyate pata hmang tue kha khing lipa pata, Khazing bie zaw kha a cuo li pata ri vapuv. Cuorasala biehmisipa kha a siesa pata paluo sa pate, cawsaa ta ama chiepha thleduona lie pathuosa tluo aa tla pata malie ama hmungthena riypata Khazing hmielie kha ma hring.
Ma phupa thuophaa hing aa buvkhung kie zawma, a ra nguoluopa tie cuo tana aa buvkhung aa.
Iema kawlie hingta ca, hingpa chuelyi khazing hingta a zang lipa tie pathiypalung kha pazing te, Khazing hmingsuo ta a cuopa Khrih rungnaana thuophaa khena kha ama hmung khu li riypata a tue yi.
Tahematapakieca kiema kaw kha ma phupa cuo li pata Zingsuv Khrih ca Abyipa a cuona kaw hne kiema zaw Zingsuv kawlieta niema sii ma cuona kaw kha ma phupa ta a cuo.
“Khena ca zingna chunglie kha khe se,” a tapa Khazing ta Zingsuv Khrih hmielie Khazing rungnaana ta a cuopa pachangna kha ma pathiypalung chunglie malie a pakhepa.
Cuorasala hingpa kharuehaa aa chiypa cahrana hing kiema'a taata cuo li pata Khazing huopa a cuonazya kha a siena riypata kiema ta capa thlaapa suethiy ca alyi bi chunglieta ma chaw.
A kuo ting taata malie ama cariepuo raalaa pata kepatlaa vapuv; palung luolue pata ma aw, cuorasala ma palung chuo buo vyi;
malie ama hrisaa, cuorasala thawpa ta cuo vapuv; malie ama chipatyi, cuorasala rakyi vapuv;
ma pangpa lieta Zingsuv hringna kha aa luo the riypata Zingsuv thiyna kha ma pangpa ta ma phyale pari.
A thiykhupa ma pangpa lie hing Zingsuv hringna aa luo khu riypata Zingsuv cuota thiy tyalya'a nang pata khy ma sa.
Caacuonakawta kiema chunglie ca thiyna ta re hrie te niema chunglie ca hringna ta re a hrie.
Caapathe chunglie, “I zang nakawta i ri,” a tapa haata, kiema zaw capa zangna thlaapa ca ma hnyi nakawta zang pate ma ri.
Tahematapakieca Abyipa Zingsuv a pathu pakhaapa paa khata kiema zaw hing Zingsuv hne khata malie pathu'a te, niema hneta a hmiekung luo kha malie aa chiy aa ta pata ma pachang.
A cuo, hingpa bangkhuo hing niema cuota cuo te, Khazing vihnyina ca cawsaa hluv vie'a luo kha a pha hrylypa haata, Khazing rungnaana cunglie alawna hne pathuosana ca a le hryly aa.
Caacuonakawta ma palung chuo buo vyi. Ma saapa cuona ca ning kha hnang ning kha ta zuebung viele ra sala, ma thlaapa cuona ca ning kha hnang ning kha ta a thaa viele.
Cuo khata dyi ma angpa ruvnaana hingta pakhingpuo sa a pha lipa chuozaa rungnaana kha malie a tingtuopa.
Tahematapakieca, kiema ta maa mangpuopa ca hmung khupa cuo li pata, hmung khu lipa tana a cuo; hmung khupa ca cuo pachangta cuo dyi cuo te, cuorasala hmung khu lipa ca chuozaa cuota a cuo.
Kiema ma awna hingpa alyi thluodaa hing parapa a cuo tiyta, cawsaa kuv ta sa lipa, Khazing ta malie a pipa chuozaa ta vuoruo lie aa hmangpa ing ma hnyi tapa kha ma pachang.
Hingpa alyi thluodaa lie hing ca a hrung byalya pate vuoruo ma ing ta malie za pabuv sala tapa kha ma vuosa taw.
Capa ing ta pabuvpa ma cuo tiyta pangpa li pata aw'a vapuv.

Hingpa chuelyi thluodaa lie ma aw kalie ning hing ca, ma hmang a riypa rawlie maa hrung maa ie. Cahaacata maa hrungpa ca hingpa ma chuelyi thluodaa hing ma thaw khing nakawta cuo li pata a pha viepa vuoruo ma ing ta pabuvpa cuopa sala a thiy thepa ma pangpa hing hringna ta vya buvkhung se tapa ma khing nakawta a cuo.
Hingpa hmang cuo hingta kiema kha malie a tingtuotuv ca Khazing ta cuo te, Thlaapa kha bietena ta malie a pi.
Caacuonakawta palung cahrana hnyi pari pate, hing pangpa ta ma aw chung bangkhuo hing ca Abyipa hneta maa hla tapa kha ma pachang.
Tahematapakieca kiema ca zangna ta hring pate hmungna ta hring vapuv.
Palung cahrasa pata aw pate hingpa ma pangpa hing sise hriy pata Abyipa ing lie aw riypa kha maa tlawpa a cuo.
Caacuonakawta hingpa ma ing lie hing ma aw a cuo zaw, khiypa ma ing lie khiy ma aw a cuo zaw, a palung ma patluo riypa khana maa tingpa ta a cuo.
Ma bangkhuo hingta Khrih bieripana thude hmieluo chiy'a pate, pangpasaa ta ma tuepa haa khata a chie cuose, a pha cuose a muo ma hmung aa.

Khazing ciypa hing khaapama a cuo tapa kha ma pachang nakawta malie kha sawle maa zue byalya. Khazing ta a phasa pata malie pachang te, niema zaw kiema kha nama chiepha thleduona lie a phasa pata malie nama pachang ta pata i nguopuo.

Niema'a lie kha kiema hne kiema maa pathuosa pakhaapa cuo li pata, niema ta malie namaa palesakhyi the riypata cuophaa maca pipa yi tana a cuo hriy. Cakiedyina pathiypalung chung kha mang li pata leluo cuona dyi kha mang te a palepa tie bie kha nama palie the aa.
Ma ngaa kieca, Khazing cuota cuo te, ma sing kieca niema cuota a cuo.
Tahematapakieca cawsaa bangkhuo cuota cawsaa pakha a thiy nakawta cawsaa bangkhuo ta ama thiy ra tapa kha ma pachang khutaata ca Khrih duena khana malie a uv tli.
Cawsaa bangkhuo cuota a thiy hnuochuonapa ca, cawsaa hingta ama hring chung hing iema cuo dyi ta hring lipa yi ta, iema cuota thiyna ang te a thupakhaapa cuota ama hringna riypa kha tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta, ata taa hingta ca, ahunghmuota cawsaa kuo taa dyi ta mang va tli yi puv; Zingsuv kha cawsaa kuo taa dyi ta ma za mang taw zaw ta, ata hing ca cahaacata mang va tli puv.
Ahunghmuota Khrih chunglie a aw kieca cawsaa thaapa tana a cuo: a hringna hlungpa ca chuo tli te, hringna thaapa kha aa pathu tli!
Hingpa bangkhuo hing Khazing'a taa tana a cuo, Khrih thueta ama hne malie pare sa te, capa arena re hrie riypa cata kiema kha hrievu malie a pi.
Capa ma phupa bie ca, Khrih thueta Khazing ta chuelyi ming bangkhuo kha ama hne pare sa tli yi te, ama suena kha ripa vatli yi, capa arena thuophaa ri riypa re cana kiema kha malie a pi.
Caacuonakawta kiema ca Khrih cuota luosituv cuo pate, kiema hmuo pata Khazing ta niema kha paa aca kie yi. Khazing hneta a re thi ung la, ta pata kiema ta Khrih cuopa ta paa maca kie yi.
Khrih ca suena hnyi vyi, cuorasala kiema vuopa khata Khazing ta kiema suena kha a pahraw sa. Capa ca ama hne maa pazuena thueta Khazing adangna maa hraw the riypa kha tana a cuo.
Khazing hne re a hrie hnepa ma cuopa haata, a vihnyina nama tingpa kha a cakhawpa ta nama pacuo sa li riypata paa maca kie yi.

Khazing ta a ripa ca, “Cuhluo the riypa cuo ning kha ca naathlie yi angte, khuona ningcuo lie kha icaa bya yi,” a ta. Naathlie tie ung, ata hingna cuhluo riypata aa rawpuna cuo ta a cuo; naathlie tie ung, ata hingna khuona cuo ta a cuo!
Ma rehriena lie suebepa ma cuo li riypata ahunghmuo ama luopuv lie pakhuotuv chi vapuv.
Khazing changtaapa ma cuopa kha a luo bangkhuo taata aa luo riypata te-angna, ruvnaana, vuochina,
tuvdena, thawpathlana, zaapuv ta tuechiena, rehruopa hriena, zuo a hmung lipa ta awna, hne nangdiyna zaw kha palung pasiysa pata ma ang.
Palung pathena, pachangna, palung pasiyna, kawpacuona, thlaapa lie pathena, duena hmisi,
biehmisipa rina hne Khazing cahrana kha hmuo pata Khazing rehrietuv ma cuopa kha ma paluo sa; adangna cehre kha ma cavyi ma cacuo ta maa hrie.
Malie pathuosapuo yi te, malie ama esepuo, ma kawchie malie ri yi te ma thuophaa malie ama ri. A hanghiepa ta malie ri yi te, cuorasala biehmisipa ma ri thluo.

Pachang lipa haata malie ama mang, cuorasala cawsaa bangkhuo pachangpa ta ma cuo. Athiypa haata malie hmung yi te, cuorasala, malie mang tie ung, ma hring thluo hing. Duo malie ama te, cuorasala malie thie tange va yi.
Ma ngie a chi raalaa pata ma palung a tluo pari. Ma siy a pasa raalaa pata cawsaa hluvpuv ma padawphaa sa yi. Khaapahmuo ma hnyi li raalaa pata, hmangting bangkhuo a hnyituv ta ma cuo.
Korin khy lie a awpa duepa viesaa zaw, a siesa pata na maca chang yi; ma pathiypalung ingchiy hing a kusa tana maca pahawpa tli yi hing.
Maca duena yi hing chebuo va tli pa hing, niema dyina a chebuo ung ciy.
Kuokhaluo ta ripa kieca, saata zaw chang tana ica chang tli yi hing. Nama pathiypalung kha a kusa ta malie pahawpa ra tie ung.
Zanglituv tie hneta a khe khah ung. Tuokhaatama adangna hne a dang lina ca amaa khe the aa? Khena hne zingna zaw tuokhaatama ama aw hne the aa?
Tuokhaatama Khrih hne Beliar ca ama palung aa lu the aa? Zangtuv hne zanglituv ca khaapama amaa hraw hne the aa?

Khazing Biena-ing hne kuvtuezuv tie ca amaa tla the'a ma? Tahematapakieca kiema ca a hringpa Khazing biena-ing tana ma cuo; Khazing ta, “Kama kha iema hrawlie aw'a angte, iema hrawlie i khie aa, kama ca ama Khazing ta cuo'a angte, iema ca i cawsaa ta ama cuo aa.
Caacuonakawta, Abyipa ta, iema hraw taa khata pya ung la, iema'a taa khata a nanang ta aw tie ung, a ta. A pathe lipa khaapahmuo taw li pata nama aw kieca, ica cuhluo'a yi.
Kama ca nama paa ta cuo'a angte, niema ca kama sacapaa hne sacanung zaw ta nama cuo aa, ta pata Lesyice Abyipa ta a ta,” a ta.
I duepa zaw, kiema ca hingpa biekuona zawdya hing ma hnyi nakawta ima pangpa hne ima thlaapa malie a papya a palyipa bangkhuo taata a pathe ung sala, Khazing ciyzaana hne a pathe pata aw ung siy.
Nama palung chunglie malie pari tie ung. Ahung cunglie hmuo suena tue vapuv, ahunghmuo para vapuv, ahunghmuo ese nutaa vapuv.
Niema ica pasue khing nakaw yi ta i ripa cuo vyi, i ri ciepa haata niema ca thiy kie thiy kha hring kie hring kha ta pata ma palung chunglie a awpa tana nama cuo.
Ica ri thuophaa pari yi, icaa palesakhyi yi, i hnaa ina panguo ung ciy, riethyivuosuona ma ang ning zaw i law hryly.
Masidonia luo ma vya chiy khutaa khata hmuo a pahyna cuo hnyi vapuv. A kuo ting taata riethyina ma ang. Ale luo taata malie a du yi te chung luo ta ciyna ma hnyi.
Cuorasala palung a rapa tie zaw hnaanguona a ripa Khazing ta Titas a vya chiyna thueta ma palung hnaa malie a panguo.

A vya chiypa dyi cuo li pata, a hnaanguona nama rina kaw, malie nama vuona kaw, nama ngiechina kaw, kha tluv tama kama ina hmung khing ung ciy tapa kaw zaw malie a chang tiyta i palung a tluo vie hryly.

Tahematapakieca i caapaphya ta nama ngie aca pachi zaw yi ta i capepa kha a ngiepachiy va ang. I caa na nama ngie caa pachi yi tapa kha i pachang tiyta, i ngiepachiy raalaa pata cuo kha ta dyi tana a cuo.

Ata hing ca i palung a tluo; nama ngie a chi nakawta cuo li pata nama ngiechina ta a ngiepachiyna luo aacaa chiy nakaw yi ta a cuo. Nama ngiechina ca Khazing khingna haata a cuo nakawta kiema kawlie namaa sungpa aw vyi.
Tahematapakieca Khazing khingna haata ngiechina khata khuona luo a chiykhyipa palung athlena papya sa te, a ngiepachiy riypa aw vyi. Cuorasala chuelyi ngiechina ta ca thiyna na a chiykhyi.

Tahematapakieca Khazing khingna haata ngiechina khata kha tluv tama nama palung aca pathu yi, ama sue linazya kha kha tluv tama nama paluo khing, hmang pha lipa nama hmung tiyta, kha tluv tama nama palung a pasa, nama thlaa a zang, kha tluv tama ina vuo ung ciy, kha tluv tama a pha lipa a tuetuv kha duo nama te khing, tapa kha rue tie ung. Hingpa kawlie hingta sue vapuv tapa kha niema hrahring zaw ta namaa pasie.

Caacuonakawta, niema'a luo caa i vya cape tiyta, pha lina a tuetuv kawlie zaw cuo li pata, pha lina tuena a angtuv kawlie zaw cuo vyi, cuorasala kha tluv tama malie namaa khingkhyi tapa kha Khazing hmielie aa luo riypa tana a cuo.
Capa ca na ma hnaanguona ta a cuo. Kiema hnaanguopa dyi cuo vyi, Titas palungtluona cunglieta maa law vie hyi. Tahematapakieca niema bangkhuo thueta a palung a diesa laalaw.

Titas hmielie kha icaa palesakhyi yi, icaa palesakhyipa haa yi ta niema zaw i hmie na pachi va ung ciy. Maca changpa bangkhuo yi hing a hmisipa a cuopa haata, Titas hmielie maacaa palesakhyipa zaw yi hing a hmisipa a cuo tapa kha aa luo.
Nama bangkhuo ta pa-uvsathyi ung cate ciyna hne a cathangpuo pata nama cuhluopa kha a rue syalya pakhaa tiyta a pathiypalung hing niema'a luo dyina a aw.
I pathiypalung bangkhuo ta caa buchuo yi angte i palung a tluo hringhruo.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, Masidonia khrihsaabuv tie'a lie pipa Khazing vihnyina kaw kha maca pachang sa khing yi.
Iema ca riethyivuosuosa pata ama aw raalaa pata ama palung tluo tuvna hne khuopuv ta ama siypasana khata pahyasa pata pina luo aa chiy yi.
Tahematapakieca, iema ca ama cuo khu thiy tana palung thusa pata ama pi tapa kha i ri nguo, ama cuo khuna khungthing te tana ama pi.
Hingpa mingpathepa tie cuota rehriena lie hing amaa bya ra riypata kiema kha khuopuv ta paa malie ama kie.
Hingpa hing kiema ta ma za mangkhuona te dyi yi cuo li pata, iema'a na iema kha Abyipa'a luo a pi yi te, Abyipa khingna haata kiema'a luo zaw kha malie amaa pi.
Caacuonakawta hingpa re zaa pathutuv Titas kha hingpa duena re hing niema hrawlie kha a patlung pathla riypata ma chang.

Niema ca, zangna, bierina, pachangna, palungthuna, kiema malie nama duena kawlie hne hmangting kawlieta a pha ce pata nama tue tlipa haata, hingpa duena re kawlie zaw hing a pha ce pata nama patlung riypata maacaa khingkhyi yi.
Hingpa hing naw ica pipa yi ta cuo vyi, cuorasala nama duena hing a hmisipa a cuonazya kha i pachang khing nakawta malie tie palungthuna kha i vya paluo sapa tana a cuo.

Tahematapakieca, nama Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih pahyanazya kha nama pachang, a hnyirungsa raalaa pata, niema cuota siypasapa ta aa li, capa ca ama siypasana thueta niema kha a hnyirungpa nama cuona riypa tana a cuo.
Capa kawlie ca ta ruena ica pi khingpa yi ca, huokung ningta nama za pathapa, a hrie zaw nama za hrie khingsapa re kha nama cuota a phapa tana a cuo,
ata hingta patlung tie ung. Nama hrie khingsapa haa khata nama cuo khu thiy ta temaa ungla niemata tah palang tie ung.
Pi khingna pathiypalung nama hnyi kieca nama hnyi lipa hmang kha mang li pata nama hnyipa hmang kha mang pata cupa pata nama cuo aa.
Malie a bya riypata niema cunglie hmangriy khang riypa kha i ri khingpa cuo vyi, cuorasala nama phuv hning ta namaa khing namaa nguo the riypata,
ata lie nama hnyirungsa ning hing aa hubupa tie kha a bya ung la, niema zaw a hubu pata nama aw ningta iema ta a caa bya'a yi.
Caapathe ta, “A hluvsa a pacungpa ta a hluv tuv hnyi li pata, a cawta a pacungpa ta a phahla hlyi vyi,” a ta.
Kama ta niema a bya khingna pathiypalung i hnyipa haata Titas zaw a pahnyi sa ratuv Khazing ca a law ung siy.
Tahematapakieca kiema ta paa ma kie pakha malie a cuhluopa dyi cuo li pata, niema kha acaa bya khing tuv nakaw yi ta ama palungthuta tah niema'a luo kha aa vaw aa.
Thuophaa a phuna kawlieta Khrihsaabuv lie a ming pathuopa ma uvnupa kha ama hneta niema'a luo ma vya pathlie.

Capa dyi cuo li pata, Khazing rungnaana hne kiema maacaa khingkhyina yi kha paluo sa riypata kiema ma hrie nguoluopa duena re kawlie zaw hing kiema hne tlaw hne riypata khrihsaabuv ta re ama pipa tana a cuo.
Hingpa pahyasa pata pipa lasaw kaw rehriena lie hing suebena maa taw li riypata maa cadangsa.
Khazing hmiekunglie dyi cuo li pata cawsaa hmiekunglie zaw a phapa hmang tue kha maa tingpa a cuo.

Cakhutaata, iema hne hingta ma uvnupa pakha vya pathlie pate, ama ca cuo hluvpuv ma hiehriypasie ciepa cuo te a bya khingna pathiypalung a hnyipa a cuopa kha ma pachang, ata changchiy hing ca niema kha aca zang tuv nakaw yi ta acaa bya khing hryly yi.
Titas hing niema abyana kawlieta i viesaa hne i rehrie hne cuo te, ma uvnu zaw hing ca khrihsaabuv biephyatuv tie, Khrih rungnaana zaw ta ama cuo.
Caacuonakawta kiema ta maacaa palesakhyina kaw yi hne nama duena kha khrihsaabuv hmiekunglie kha aa luohuosa pata paluo sa tie ung.
Mingpathepa tie cuota rehrie riypa kawlie niema'a luo caa cape aa hu ta pata rue va ang.

Tahematapakieca cawsaa a bya nama khingsapa kha i pachang tli nakawta niema kaw kha Masidonia tie'a lieta ica vaa palesakhyi tli yi. Akhaia tie ca azuokung ning taa khata a bya riypata a ting pacie pata na ama aw tli, a ta yi. Capa niema palungthuna cata cawsaa hluvpuv palung a pathu sa yi.
Cuorasala capa kawlie ca ta maacaa palesakhyina yi kha a hripa a cuo li riypata, a ting pacie pata nama aw riypata, uvnu zaw kha i vya pathlie yi.
Cata cuo li pata, Masidonia tie ta kama kha na vya ziy yi sala a ting pacie pata nama aw lipa kha aca hmung kie yi ca, hingpa kawlie hing niema dyi cuo li pata kiema zaw kha ma nang a zaasa aa.

Caacuonakawta uvnu zaw kha niema'a luo vya pathlielupa yi ta, pi riypata bie namaa kuo ciepa lasaw kha pahmyalu aa hu ta pata i rue. Cahaacata i vya chiy tiyta ting pacie pata za aw'a te, hripuo pata pipa cuo li pata palung thusa pata nama pipa lasaw a cuopa kha aa luo aa.
Saciy a cawta dyi a vaapa ca thyipaa a cawta dyi pahriy'a te, a hluvpuv ta a vaapa ca a hluvpuv a pahriy aa tapa kha maw khah ung.

Ahung nama cuo zaw, nama palung lie namaa thlina zaa khata pi tie ung, ngie a buopuo pata pi khah se, pi lisa pha vyi ta pata pi khah se, tahematapakieca palungtluosa pata a pipa tie khana Khazing ta a due yi.
Khazing ca namaa huna laata a hlyi ta thluechiy phangting caa pi khutuv yi cuo te, hmangting kha aa de pata hnyi'a ung cate, hmang pha tuena phangting lie kha a bya khutuv nama cuo aa.
Caapathe ta, “Pahyasa pata siypasa tie kha pi yi te, aa dangna ca chuozaa ta aa hmang,” a ta.
Saciy a vaatuv kha vaa riypa saciy hne ning riypa sa a pituv ta nama vaa riypa saciy kha a hluvsa ta ca pi'a yi te, namaa dangnapa thyipaa kha a hluvsa aca pahriy sa'a yi.
Pahyasa pata a hluvsa nama pi khu riypata Khazing ta aa ky aa casa pata aca pahring sa'a yi. Kiema'a taata ama hmungpa nama lasaw kawlieta iema ta Khazing ama pathuosa aa.
Tahematapakieca, hingpa re nama hriepa hingta mingpathepa tie amaa huna dyi kha aa byapa yi ta cuo li pata Khazing'a luo palungtluona bie rina zaw kha a hluvpuv a pa-aw sa.

Hingpa re nama hriena lieta, Khrih thuophaa nama cuhluopa kha ri-angiena hneta namaa hringkhyinapa hne mingpathepa tie hne cawsaa hrangpa tie cuota pahyasa pata nama pinapa khata Khazing kha a parungnaa sa.
Khazing vihnyina a hlyi ta nama cunglie a tlung nakawta aca vuosapuo pa yi ta nama cuota thlaa ama chuo.
Ri tie lipa a lasaw thue khata Khazing ca a law pata cuo mang sue.
Nama hmiekunglie i aw ningta a pane angte luohlaa luo i aw tiyta riephasa pata bie a ri thepa kama Paul ta Khrih nangnena hne duena ta paa ica kie yi.
Niema hne i aw ning hing cawsaa phung tana ama aw ta pata malie a ruepa tie kha anguona hne riephasa pata a du aa hu li riypata paa ica kie yi.
Cawsaapa haata ma aw hmisi, cuorasala ma cawsaa cuona ta rie a du vapuv.
Tahematapakieca kiema ma rie a duna cehre ca cawsaapa cehre ta cuo vyi, a cusapa cariekyikuo zaw a para khupa Khazing cahrana kha tana a cuo.
Khazing pachangna kha a pakhuopa bie a ina hne a palena kha para pate, Khrih ri a ngie riypata cawsaa ruena mekaa kha sii ta ma tue yi.
Nama ri-angiena tluo a tling khutaata ri a ngie lipa mekaa kha duote riypata a ting pacie pata ma aw.
Niema ca hmang kha a cungphang dyi tana nama mang. Khrih huopa tana ma cuo namaa ta nguo kieca, niema haa khata kiema zaw Khrih huopa ma cuo rapa kha a thyi tie ung.
Abyipa ta niema kha para riypata cuo li pata sathaw riypata malie a pipa nawhnyina kha i palesakhyi tuv kie zawma a zaakhyi va ang.
I caapaphya ta caa pachiypa yi i lu riypa hing khing va ang.
Tahematapakieca iema ta, “A caa ca kacu te a cahra, cuorasala a pangpa ta a aw pata ca khaapapuv ta cuo tlung vyi, a bie zaw naathlie tluo'apa aw vyi,” ama ta.
Cahaapa cawsaa zaw ca ta, ma aw li pata caa lie ma ripa hing, ma aw thue zaw ta ma tue aa tapa hing pachang yi se.
Iema hne iema a pathuosapa tie hne khata ca a pakhing pata a ripuo nguo'a va yi puv. Cuorasala iema hne iema kha malie hneta amaa pakhing tiyta ama ngaanapa khana ama paluo sa.
Cadyiseca, kiema hing a hlyikhung ta a pale'a vapuv, Khazing ta malie a pipa re, luriy chunglie khana ri'a pate ma aw aa. Capa chunglie ca niema'a lie ma hriepa re zaw hing a te ra.
Niema'a luo ma vya chiy ning kha ma ruoriy law pata ma vya chiypa cuo vyi; kiema ca Khrih thuophaa hneta niema'a luo a vya chiy taapa tana ma cuo.

Kiema ca a luriy law pata malie hrie ciepa re lieta a palepa cuo vapuv; cuorasala kiema maa ruechuopa ca, nama zangna kha le viele'a te, niema hrawlie ma rehriena ruo zaw kha a ku viele riypa kha tana a cuo.
Cahaacata malie tie hrie ciepa re lie kha a pale li pata niema nama awna ruo zaw kha law pata, thuophaa kha ma ri khu aa.
“A palepa ca Abyipa'a lie kha a pale se.”
Tahematapakieca Khazing ta a khingpa tie ca iema hne iema a pathuosapa tie kha cuo lipa yi ta Abyipa ta a pathuosapa tie kha tana ama cuo.
I ngaapuo hriehruv kie zaw a angzya ina the riypa ung cata i khing. Na ang law tie ung!
Khazing hietliena tana ica hietlie yi, tahematapakieca lesaa pathenung pakha kha navaa pakha'a luo tung patuvpa haata niema kha Khrih'a luo ica pi khing nakaw yi tana a cuo.
Cuorasala pariy ta, a zyatena ta Evi kha a dungpa haata, nama pathiypalung kha a dangsa pata hne a pathesa pata Khrih'a luo namaa pina taata dungpa nama cuo pathlyi riypa kha i ciysa.

Cawsaa pakhakha ta kiema ma phupa cuo li pata Zingsuv hrangpa kha a phu kie cuose, acuolikie niema ta nama cuhluo ciepa thlaapa kha cuo li pata thlaapa hrangpa kha a paw ung cate, niema nama cuhluo ciepa kha cuo li pata thuophaa hrangpa zaw kha namaa paw paluo lawmaw.
Hingpa lucuotuv aa suo cepa nama tapa tie laa hingta i ne vie ta pata a rue va ang.
Bieri luota i the li zaw ta pachangna luo ta ca a ne va ang; hmangting kaw kha a luo phangting ta a siesa pata ma paluo sa tli.
Niema kha cyicalang riypata kama kha a pane angte, Khazing thuophaa kha a selawpa ta ica changpa yi ca i sue ma?
Niema cuota re hrie riypata iema'a taata abyana i lapa ca Khrihsaabuv hrangpa taata i chuvpa yi tana a cuo.

Niema'a lie i aw ning, i husa ning kha ahunghmuo nama hmang ca pariy va yi ang, Masidonia taata a vawpa i viesaa tie na i hupa kha naa pi yi. Caacuonakawta a cuo khu chung ta nama hmang ica pariy li riypa yi kha i za cahriypa haata hmieluo zaw i cahriy aa.
Khrih biehmisipa kha i chunglie a awpa haata, i palenapa hing Akhaia pe lie ca ahungtahmuo padie sa khu'a va yi.
Khaapanakawma? Ica due li nakaw yi ma? Ica duepa yi ca Khazing na a pachang!
Kiema hne hingta amaa khing amaa nguo ta pata cawsaa ta ama rue riypa a khingpa tie ama khingna kha a du riypata i hriepa hing i hrie pazue kalie aa.
Tahematapakieca cahaapa hruotle tie ca lucuotuv pakhipa, malie a dung thepa rehrietuv cuo yi te, Khrih lucuotuv pakhipa tie tana ama cuo.
Kharuehaa riypa cuo vyi. Setaa hmuota khena avuoming aa cuo pakhi.
Caacuonakawta a rehrietuv tie ta adangna rehrietuv tie haata amaa cuo pakhi kieca kharuehaa riypa hmang cuo vyi. A chuona lie ca ama tuepa hne aa phuvpa khana ama pahriy aa.
I ri canyi, ahungtahmuo a ngaapa ta na rue khah yi se; ina rue kie zaw ung ca ma, a cawta i pale the ra riypata na rue thluo tie ung.
Ata riephasa pata i palepa hing Abyipa nawhnyina ta i palepa cuo vyi, cuorasala a ngaapa haa tana i pale pata a cuo.
Ama cawsaa cuona ta a palepa ama hluvsa nakawta i pale ra aa.
Tahematapakieca, nama singsa nakawta a ngaapa tie kha nama chaw khusa.
Niema ca sii ta caa ziypa tie, caa dung caa viepa tie, caa mangbungpa tie, nama be caa tungpa tie zaw kha namaa ngiethe khusa.
Cahaapa tuena kawlie ma phahlasapa ca nangzaa na a chiy puv! Cuorasala, pakhakha ta hmang suokhakha kawlie aa pale kieca, a ngaapa haata ri thluo'a ang, kama zaw capa kawlie ca i pale ra aa.
Iema ca Hebru ming ta ama cuo ma? Kama zaw i cuo ra. Israel ming ta ama cuo ma? Kama zaw i cuo ra. Abraham ciypathla ta ama cuo ma? Kama zaw i cuo ra.

Iema ca Khrih rehrietuv ta ama cuo ma? A ngaapa haata ri thluo'a ang, Khrih rehrietuv a pha viepa pakha tana i cuo. Khuo vie ta re i hrie, thaw a hluv vie i tla, ri tie li na tuv yi te, vuotaasiy thiy'a nangna yi hluvpuv i taw.
Yi sawliy tlingna yi kha dyi a bupa sungpe ta china kha Judah ming kuv taata yi pangaa i ang.
Asung ta yi thung ina tuv yi. Alung ta luo kha ina vaa yi. Tiypalaw ta luo thung na rakhyi te zuo kha hne ning kha chung riyliy tiy ta ina phya.

Khytlawna lieta, cavaa tiy ciy aa chiypa, damie kuv lie ciy aa chiypa, i cawsaa zaw'a taata ruvnaana, Jentail ming'a taata ruvnaana, khypuv chunglie ciy aa chiypa, ruocaapa lie ciy aa chiypa, riyliy chunglie ciy aa chiypa, hne uvnu pakhipa hne sieta pakhipa tie'a taata ruvnaana zaw kha i ang.
Riethyisa pata rehrie angte ruvnaana chunglie i hring. Zuokhydyi mingsaa pasing li pata i aw. Nangdiy tiyhrie pata hne sa ning li pata i aw. Nangkhysa pata hne a buv a se riy hnyi li pata i aw.
A hrangpa ca ta li pata khrihsaabuv kaw i pacuonapa hingta ningting ta a vy ta ina vy.
Pakhakha thaazuo a dya kie, i thaazuo dya li pata i aw'a ma? Pakhakha suena chunglie aa lie kie, i se hie li pata i aw'a ma?
I pale kieca, i thaadyana a paluo sapa hmang kawlie khana i pale aa.
Khazing hne Abyipa Zingsuv a Paa ta i hang lipa kha a pachang, ama ca chuozaa pathuosa pata cuo mang sue.
Damaskas lie i aw ning kha siepahruo Aretas kuv rawlie a awpa muokiybyipa khata kama patuv riypata khypuv kha a cadung sa yi.
Cuorasala khypuv dungkhuona piehu thlaluo-aw taa khata pasyi ta na pachung yi te ama kuv chungtaata i law.
A thlahnena khaapahmuo a aw li zaw ta i pale aa hu, cuorasala Abyipa'a taata muocuo hne biephu kaw tana a cuo aa.

Ma hnangluo kung hraa hlyipaliy ning kha Khrihsaa a cuopa cawsaa pakha ca avuo duothungna te ta ama lathawpa kha i pachang. A pangpa ta ma a cuo, cuo va ma tapa ca pachang va ang, Khazing na a pachang.
A pangpa ta ma a cuo, cuo va ma pachang va ang, Khazing na a pachang i tapa capa cawsaapa paa ca
Paradis luo calang yi te cawsaapa ri byi lipa hne cawsaapa chang riypata pahya lipa bie kha a thyi.
Capa paa cuopa ca ta i pale aa, cuorasala i thaadyana kawlie ta li pata ca kama kaw ca a pale'a va ang.

I pale khing pata a cuo kie zawma a ngaapa ta ca cuo'a va ang, tahematapakieca a hmisipa dyi kha i ri'a nakawta a cuo. Cuorasala pakhakha ta ina hmungnapa hne kama'a taata a thyipa laata aa suo vie ta ina hmung li riypata a pale'a va ang.
Caacuonakawta a hlyi vie ta i hmungpa biephu kawlieta i pale tuv li riypata Setaa pathliepa haata re a hriepa ahling suokha kha i pangpa chunglie hing ina pi.
Hingpa hmang hingta ina thuse riypata Abyipa'a lie kha yi thung te paa i kie.

Cuorasala, Abyipa ta, “I vihnyina hing na cuota aa desa, cahrana ca thaadyana liena a tling,” ina ta. Caacuonakawta, Khrih cahrana ca kama'a lie a aw riypata i thaadyana lie kha khuo vie ta i palung tluo te i pale.
Caacuonakawta, thaadyana, esena, ruvnaana, hrisaana, hne vuochina zaw kha palung tlingsa pata Khrih cuota i ang; tahematapakieca i thaadya ning khana i cahra ningta a cuo.

I ngaa ciemuo! Niema na naa pangaa ung ciy. Hmisi ta kieca niema na naa pathuosa riypata a cuo ung ciy. Tahematapakieca kama hing khaapahmuo i cuo li raalaa pata lucuotuv aa suo cepa tie laa hingta a ne vie changchiy va ang.
Lucuotuv hmisi cuona ca palungpasiyna, pamangsana hne kharuehaa hmang tuena ta niema hrawlie paluo sa pata a cuo tli.
Hmangriy ta icaa tue lipa yi ta li pata Khrihsaabuv hrangpa tie laata khaapalie kha ma a chie vie ta ica tue yi? Hingpa i tuepathlyina hing ca naa ngiethe tie ung!

A yithungna niema'a luo a vaw riypata a ting cie pata i aw tli. Nama cuota hmangriy cuo'a va ang, tahematapakieca nama hnyipa sue cuo li pata niema na icaa hu yi. Saata zaw ta nungpaa cuota sue pacung riypa cuo li pata, nungpaa ta saata zaw cuota sue pacung riypata a cuo hriy.
Niema cuota i hnyipa kha palung tluo ce pata a hmuopa ca kama cuo angte, i pangpa zaw niema cuota hmuopa i cuo aa. Niema kha ica due vie thluopa yi tama kama kha na due uo li pata nama aw aa?
Nama cuota hmangriy cuo va ang ta pata rue'a ung puv. Cadyiseca niema ta a zyatepa, cawsaa a dungpa ina ta ung ciy.
Niema'a luo i vya pathliepa pakhakha'a taa khata a thungna i huvpa aw kanaa?

Titas kha niema'a luo tlaw riypata chang angte, zangtuv uvnu pakha kha ama hneta i vya pathlie. Titas zaw niema'a taata athungna a lapa aw vyi cuo va ma? Kiema ca aa lupa pathiypalung tana aa lupa re kha ma hrie pakhaw cuo va ma?

Niema hmiekunglie na kiema hne kiema a paduona bie ama ri ta pata malie rue pari kanaa ung ciy? Zingsuv ming tana Khazing hmiekunglie bie ma ri. Duepa zaw, ma tuepa bangkhuo hing niema sathawna riypa tana a cuo.

Niema'a luo i vya chiy tiyta, hing haa hingta cuo yi sala ica tapa haa yi ta nama cuo li pathlyi riypa hne kama zaw hing haa hingta cuose nama tapa haata i cuo li pathlyi riypa kha i thlaa a zang. A hru a ina, hietliena, hihaana, kiema kaw dyi a pacuona, kawchie rina, caw-yina, hruotlena, a luopuv li pata hringna tapa tie nama hrawlie a aw pathlyi riypa zaw i thlaa a zang.

Niema'a luo i vya chiy pakhaa tiyta, Khazing ta nama hmiekunglie nangzaa pata ina pa-aw sa pathlyi aa tapa kha i thlaa a zang. Cawsaa hluvpuv ta hring pyalyipa, aparuvsuena thiysaa khingna ama za tuepa kha a ngiepachiy li pata ama awna kawlieta ngiechisa pata i caa riypa kha i thlaa a zang.
Ata lie hne hingta ca niema'a luo ica vya tlawpa yi hing a yithungna ta a cuo. “Sue a bena suokhakha ca pachangkhyituv pahning acuolikie pathung a aw kiena pacu sa pata a cuo aa.”

Niema'a luo a yihningnapa i vaw ning kha suena zaa tuepa tie hne a hrangpa tie kyihuo khata, i vya chiy pakhaa pata a cuo kieca ca diy'a va tli yi ang hing, i ta pahaa yi khata, ata luohlaa luo i aw ning hingta a raaringna i pi yi.
Khrih na kama'a taata bie a ri tapa kha a cuo hmisi ma ta pata nama pachang khing. Khrih hing niema'a lie re a hrie tiyta a thaa dya vyi, a cahra.

Tahematapakieca ama ca thaadyasa pata vieluo cunglie ama thie, cuorasala Khazing cahrana tana a hring. Kiema zaw ama chunglie ma thaa a dya, cuorasala niema'a lie re ma hrie tiyta Khazing cahrana thue tana ama hne ma hring aa.

Niema hne niema kha zangna chunglie ma aw ma ta pata a mangpasie tie ung. A dyapasya tie ung. Zingsuv Khrih nama chunglie a awpa kha a pasie va ung ca ma? Namaa pasie li kieca namaa mangpasiena lie tling va ung ciy!
Ma hluetlingpa kha nama hmung aa ta pata i nguopuo.

Hmang pha lipa nama tue li riypata Khazing'a luo thlaa maca chuopa yi. Kiema ca a mangpasiena lie ma tling tana ta cuo li pata, a tling lipa ma lu zaw ta niema ca aa hmuopa kha nama tue riypata a cuo.
Tahematapakieca biehmisipa ca maa daakhyi ta li pata ca aa du ta ca a du khu vapuv.

Kiema ma thaa a dya zaw ta niema nama cahra kieca ma palung a tluo. Tahematapakieca kiema ma thaa dya te niema nama cahra ning kha ma palung a tluo. Cawsaa tluotlingpa nama cuo khu riypata kiema ma thlaachuona ta a cuo.

Caacuonakawta luohlaa taata hingpa caa hing i vya cape pata a cuo, tahematapakieca niema parana cuo li pata sathawna riypata Abyipa ina pipa nawhnyina hing niema'a luo i vaw thueta khuosa ta i hmuo pathlyi lina riypa tana a cuo.

A hnangcaw ce ta, uvnu hne sieta zaw, nama tluopa ta za aw mya ung! Nama hringzya zaa pare ung la paa ica kiepa yi hing naathlie tie ung. Nama palung a lu sala diena hne aw tie ung. Cata a cuo kieca duena hne thlaalungna Khazing ca niema'a lie a aw aa.
Pakha hne pakha kha a pathepa a pahnuona ta bie a chang tie ung. Mingpathepa tie bangkhuo na bie a caa chang yi.
Abyipa Zingsuv Khrih vihnyina, Khazing duena, hne Thlaapa Pathe a viesaana ca nama bangkhuo cunglie aw mang sue.
Cawsaa ta ina pathlie nakaw yi hne cawsaa nawhnyina ta cuo li pata, Zingsuv Khrih hne ama kha thiyna taata a pathu pakhaapa ma Paa Khazing ta changpa lucuotuv kama Paul hne
kama hne a awpa Khazing chungkhue uvnu bangkhuo ta, Galati khrihsaabuv tie kha:
Abyipa Zingsuv Khrih hne ma Paa Khazing'a taata vihnyina hne thlaalungna ca nama cunglie aw mang sue, ta pata bie maacaa chang yi.
Ata chuo, chuo chiepa chung taa hingta kiema kha hya pazang sa riypata, ma Paa Khazing khingna haata, Khrih ca ma suena cuo khata aa pi.
Rungnaana ca ama'a lie chuozaa ta aw mang sue. Amen.
Khrih vihnyina chung luo caa kupa yi kha a catlisa pata thuse ung cate thuophaa hrangpa luo namaa palipa ca i nang na ina pa-uo ung ciy.
Thuophaa hrangpa a aw nakawta i ripa cuo li pata, nama palung caa paluoluepa tie hne Khrih thuophaa kha thle a nangpa chekha ama aw nakawta ica tapa yi ta a cuo.
Cuorasala, kiema ma cuo zaw, vuoruo taata avuoming ama cuo zaw tahmuo, kiema ma phupa thuophaa hne aa lu lipa thuophaa kha niema'a lie ama phu kieca, chiesa pata cuo yi se!
Ma ri ciepa haa khata, ata hing i ri canyi, nama cuhluo ciepa thuophaa hne aa lu lipa thuophaa a phutuv pakhakha a aw kieca, chiesa pata cuo mang sue!

Kama hing cawsaa hmiephaa hmung riypa ma i zue, Khazing hmiephaa hmung riypa ma? Acuolikie cawsaa palung patluo riypa a zue kanaa ang? Ata tepa hing tana cawsaa palung patluo kha i zue tapa kieca, Khrih sii ca cuo khu'a va ang.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, kama i phupa thuophaa hing cawsaa'a taata cuo vyi tapa kha ica pachang sa khing yi.
Tahematapakieca, hingpa thuophaa hing cawsaa'a taata i hmungpa cuo li pata cawsaa ta ina changpa yi zaw cuo vyi. Cuorasala Zingsuv Khrih ta a phupa bie thueta i hmungpa tana a cuo.
