Judah phung chunglie i za hringzya kha ina pachangpasie ung ciy. Khazing khrihsaabuv kha khuopuv ta za hrisaa angte para riypata i zaa zue.
I phangbuo khuvhyi hrawlieta Judah phung luo zaa pi vie angte, ma mingchingmingvuo tie phungluo kha karuo awsa pata i zaa daakhyi.
Cuorasala i puv hluo baataata naa tlaw te a vihnyina ta naa upa Khazing ta,
a Sacapaa kha Jentail ming'a luo i phu riypata, a Sacapaa kha kama'a luo palung tluosa pata a za paluo sa tiyta, ahunghmuo ruena ca hie va yi ang.
Kama hluota lucuotuv zaa cuo tlipa tie a taw riypa zaw ta Jerusalem luo khaw va ang. Cuorasala Arabia ruo luo kha a catli pata si angte, cakhutaa cata Damaskas luo i za kaa.
Kung thung khutaata Piter parie riypata Jerusalem luo khaw angte ama'a lie ning hraa hlyipangaa i aw.
Abyipa nuta Jeim ta li pata lucuotuv hrangpa ahunghmuo a taw va yi ang.
Hing haa hingta i vya capepa hing Khazing hmielie hang va ang.
Cakhutaa cata, Siria hne Silisia pe luo kha si angte,
capa tepa cata Judea pe lie a awpa khrihsaabuv tie ta na pachang valie yi.
“Kiema malie zaa hrisaa tuvpa khana para a zaa zuepa zangna kaw kha a phu nguoluo,” tapa dyi kha za thyi yi te,
kama kawlie kha Khazing ama pathuosa.
Kung hraa hlyipaliy khutaata Jerusalem luo kha Barnabas hneta khaw pakhaa pate, Titas kha i chiyle.

Biephu a aw nakawta i khaw pata a cuo. I hrie nguoluopa hne i za hriepa zaw bangkhuo kha a cakhawpa cuo vyi tapa ama pasiena riypata, Jentail ming hrawlie i za phupa thuophaa kaw kha ama uvthyi zaw hne pangpa ta maa tawna lie i chang yi.
Kama hne a awpa Titas kha hmuo Grik ming a cuo raalaa pata vangdaw a te riypata hripuo va ang.
Zangtuv pakhipa chekha ca Khrih Zingsuv zangna thueta ma hnyipa hyazangna kawlie kha sii ta malie amaa ziy pakhaa khing nakawta kiema chung luo kha a paruv ta amaa vya ngie.
Thuophaa hmisipa kha niema'a lie aa hmang riypata, iema kha sungkhata hmuo a pate sa va yi puv.
Cawsaa ta pachangpa uvthyi tie khata ruena suokha hmuo na pi va yi (Iema hingta i cuota a nanangna ina pipa yi aw vyi; Khazing ca hmiemang pata pahlyipalena tue vyi).

Cahaacata ruena pi changchiy ca, Piter ca Khazing ta vangdaw a tepa tie'a luo thuophaa phu riypata hrievu a pipa haa khata kama kha vangdaw a te lipa tie'a luo thuophaa phu riypata hrievu ina pipa kha ama hmung tiyta hne
(tahematapakieca Khazing ta Piter kha vangdaw a tepa tie'a luo thuophaa phu riypata lucuotuv ta a tuepa haata kama zaw kha vangdaw a te lipa tie'a luo lucuotuv ta ina tue ra),

luochiytuv a tungpuv vie ta ripa Jeim hne Piter hne Johan ta Khazing ta ina pipa vihnyina kha ama hmung tiyta, rehriehne tana ma cuo tanapa paluosana ta Barnabas hne kama kha ma kuv malie amaa buo. Kiema kha Jentail ming'a luo si riypa hne iema kha vangdaw a tepa tie'a luo si riypata ma palung a tling.
Iema ta malie ama patue sa khingpa suokha ca cawsaa siypasapa tie kha a thyi riypa cuo te, capa ca kama ta temaa pata i hrie khing paripa re tana a cuo.
Cuorasala Antiok luo Piter a vya chiy tiyta, a paana kawlie kha hmiedesuo ta i chuo, tahematapakieca chuo riypa tana aa tue.

Jeim ta a vya pathliepa cawsaa zaw ama vya chiyna te khata ca Jentail ming hneta sa a ning pakhaw taw. Cuorasala iema ama vya chiy khutaata ca vangdaw a tepa phuv kha a ciy nakaw yi ta hnangluo a saw te amata tah a aw.
Judah ming hrangpa tie zaw ta ama kha a hlaw yi te, iema phahruocuona kawlie khata Barnabas zaw te kha luo ama pasi sa chie ra.

Cuorasala thuophaa hmisipa haata ama ziy lipa kha i hmung tiyta iema bangkhuo hmielieta, Piter kha, “Judah ming na cuo thluo pata Judah ming haata aw li pata Jentail ming haata na aw kieca, tuokhaatama Jentail ming ca Judah ming haata aw riypata na hripuo khu'a yi?” i ta.
Kiema ca ma thukina hrahring ta Judah ming cuo pate Jentail ming, a suepa tie ta cuo vapuv.

Cuorasala cawsaa hing phungbie ziyna thueta cuo li pata Khrih Zingsuv zangna thue tana duopacupa ma cuo tapa kha ma pachang. Kiema ca phungbie ziyna thueta cuo li pata, Khrih zangna thueta duopacupa cuo riypa tana Zingsuv Khrih kha ma zang. Tahematapakieca ahunghmuota phungbie ziyna thueta duopacupa cuo the'a va yi.
Cuorasala kiema ca Khrih thueta duopacupa cuo riypa kha maa zue nguoluo pata a suepa ma cuopa kha malie ama hmung kieca, Khrih ca suena rehrietuv tana a cuo tana ta a cuo'a ma? Cuo changchiy vyi!
I za phi ciepa hmang kha i sa pakhaa kieca, kama ca phungbie a parapa i cuopa khana i paluo sa.
Tahematapakieca Khazing'a lie hring riypata phungbie thueta phungbie lie ca i thiy tli. Zingsuv hne vieluo lie taa hnepa ta cuo angte,
ata a hringpa hing kama ta cuo va ang, i chunglie a hringpa Khrih tana a cuo. Ata saapa ta i hringpa zaw hing na due te i cuota a hringna a pipa Khazing Sacapaa i zangna thue tana a cuo.
Khazing vihnyina i para pata cuo vyi; phungbie thue tana duopacuna aa vaw ta pata a cuo kieca, Zingsuv ca khaahmuo lipa cuota a thiypa tana a cuo aa.
Galati ming a ngaapa tie! Ahungma caa pamya yi? Zingsuv Khrih vieluo cunglie a thiynapa ca nama ming lie a siesa pata paluo sapa a cuo tli!
Niema'a taata i pachang khingpa suokha dyipa ca: Thlaapa hing phungbie ziyna thueta ma nama hmung acuolikie nama thyipa nama zang nakawta ma nama hmung?
Nama ngaa hringhruo de? Thlaapa ta patha ung cate ma saapa ta nama pachuo sa'a nang?
Hingpa hmang hingna a cakhawpa ta a cuo hmisi ta pata a cuo kieca namaa tawpa hmang bangkhuo kha a cakhawpa tama a cuo aa?
Thlaapa ca pi yi te kharuehaa hmang zaw nama hrawlie a tuepa Khazing hing phungbie nama ziyna thueta ma a tue acuolikie nama thyipa nama zangna thueta ma a tue?
Abraham ta, “Khazing kha zang te, capa a zangna ca adangna ta cuhluopa pata a cuo.”
Caacuonakawta a zangpa ca Abraham ciypathla ta ama cuopa kha pachang tie ung.

Khazing ta Jentail ming kha zangna thueta adangna luo a papha sa'a yi tapa kha Caapathe ta a hmunglu nakawta Abraham kha thuophaa za changlu te, “Jentail ming bangkhuo ca nama thue tana thluechiy ama hmung aa,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta, a zangpa bangkhuo ca zangna paa Abraham hneta thluechiy pi pata ama cuo.
Tahematapakieca phungbie ziyna a buchuopa bangkhuo ca chiesana rawlie na ama aw. Caapathe ta, “Phungbie caa-uv chunglie a capepa bangkhuo kha a ziy lipa bangkhuo ca chiesapa tana ama cuo,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta ahunghmuota Khazing hmielie phungbie thueta duopacupa aw va yi; tahematapakieca, Caapathe ta, “Aa dangpa cawsaa ca zangna tana a hring aa,” a ta.
Cuorasala phungbie ca zangna cunglie kha a pahnie vyi. “Phungbie kha a ziypa ca capa phungbie ziyna thue ca tana a hring aa,” a ta.
Khrih ca kiema cuota chiesana ang te, kiema kha phungbie chiesana taata malie a khuo. Caapathe ta, “Thingkung cunglie pathliepa bangkhuo ca chiesapa tana ama cuo,” a ta.
Hingpa hmang ta a tingpa ca, Abraham thluechiy ca Khrih Zingsuv thueta Jentail ming'a luo a tlung riypa hne kiema ta zangna thueta Thlaapa ta biekuopa kha ma hmungna riy'apa tana a cuo.

Uvnu hne sieta zaw, ningting maa tawpa taata pakhingpuona suokha ca pi'a yi ang. Cawsaa ta palung tlingsa pata tue yi te ming ama thuv tlipa biekuona ca chachiy khu zaw aw li pata para khu zaw aw vyi.

Cahaacata Khazing ta Abraham hne a samingsahlaa cunglie biekuona a tue. A hluvsapa tie'a luo ripa haata, “Na samingsahlaa zaw,” ta li pata, “Na samingsahlaa,” tapa dyi ta a cuo. Capa ca cawsaa pakha, Khrih dyi khata a cuo.
I ri khingpa ca, kung zapaliy sawthung khutaata a vawpa phungbie ta a hluo baataata Khazing hne za tue ciepa biekuona kha para vyi, biekuona kha a cakhawpa ta pacuo sa vyi.
Tahematapakieca, rucuna ca phungbie taa tana aa vaw ta pata a cuo kieca, capa ca biekuona taata a vawpa cuo vyi; cuorasala Khazing ta ca Abraham kha biekuona tana rucuna kha a pi.

Caacuokieca, phungbie aa tingna ca khaapatama a cuo? Biekuona ta a ri khingpa samingsahlaa aa vaw hluota tuepa suena kawlieta phungbie ca chachiy pata a cuo. Capa phungbie ca avuoming ta luosituv pakha'a taata pi pachaa pata a cuo.
Luosituv ca phuv kha laata a hluv viena lie khana re a hrie pata a cuo; cuorasala Khazing ca pakha dyi ta a cuo.

Caacuokieca phungbie hne Khazing biekuona ca aa capie ma? Cuo changchiy vyi! Tahematapakieca, cawsaa hing hringna a pikhutuv phungbie kha za pipa cuo yi sala, cawsaa hingta phungbie thueta Khazing duopacuna kha ama hmung diy aa.
Cuorasala Caapathe ta, hmangting bangkhuo hing suena rawlie na a aw ta te, capa ca a zangtuv tie kha Zingsuv Khrih zangna thue dyi ta biekuopa kha pipa ama cuo riypata a cuo.
Zangna aa vaw hluota, kiema kha phungbie ta thaw malie pathla te, zangna aa luona cuo te khata malie a hrekhung.
Caacuonakawta kiema ca zangna ta duopacupa ma cuona riypata, phungbie ca Khrih aa vawna te khata kiema malie a mangchiytuv ta a cuo.
Cuorasala zangna ca a vaw tli te, kiema ca mangchiytuv phungbie a hu va tli puv.
Tahematapakieca kiema bangkhuo ca Khrih Zingsuv zangna thueta Khazing saata ta ma cuo.
Khrih ming ta tiy a nawpa bangkhuo ca Khrih kha namaa hryi tli.
Judah ming hne Grik ming, sii hne hya a zangpa, capaa hne canung, ta pata pananangna aw va tli; nama bangkhuo ta Khrih Zingsuv chunglie pang kha tana nama cuo.
Caacuonakawta Khrih huopa nama cuo kieca, niema ca Abraham samingsahlaa cuo ung cate, biekuona haata rucutuv tana nama cuo.
I ri khingpa ca hingpa hing tana a cuo: rucutuv riypa kha kung tlingpa a cuo hluota ca hmangting bangkhuo kha a hnyituv cuorasala sii hne aa hlyi aa lena aw vyi.
A paa ta a tingpapa cuo a tling hluo li bangkhuo ca mangchiytuv kuv cunglie khana a aw.
Caacuonakawta, kiema zaw kung tling lipa ma cuo chung ca chuelyi hmang a uvtuv thlaapa sii tana ma cuo.
Cuorasala a cuo a vya tling tiyta ca Khazing ta a Sacapaa a za pathlie. Canung chungtaata phungbie rawlie a puv.
Phungbie rawlie a awpa tie a thla riypa hne kiema kha Khazing saata ta ma cuo thena riypata a cuo.
A saata ma cuo nakawta, Khazing ta Thlaapa kha ma pathiypalung chung luo za pathlie te, capa Thlaapa ca ta, “Abba! I Paa!” ta pata a u.
Caacuonakawta niema ca sii ta cuo va tli ung ciy, cuorasala saata tana nama cuo. Khazing saata nama cuo tli nakawta rucutuv zaw nama cuo.
Hluo ning, Khazing nama za pachang hluo ca, Khazing a cuo lipa tie sii ta nama za cuo.

Cadyiseca, ata hing ca Khazing kha pachang tli ung cate, Khazing zaw ta aca pachang tli yi. Tuokhaatama a thaazuo dyapa, thlahnena a hnyi lipa thlaapa tie'a luo ca namaa pali aa? Tuokhaatama iema sii ca nama cuo pakhaa khing?
Niema ta ning pa-ipa, thlaa pa-ipa, khycuo pa-ipa hne kung pa-ipa hnyi ung cate namaa uv.
Nama cuota i hriepa re hing paviepavuv lie ung ciy tapa na i thlaa a zangsa.
Viesaa zaw, kama haa hingta cuo ra ung ta pata paa ica kie yi, tahematapakieca kama zaw niema haa tana i cuo tli. Kama'a lie nama tue pathlyipa aw vyi.
A yikhanapa niema'a lie thuophaa i za phupa ca pangpasaa lie i tluo li nakaw tana a cuo tapa kha nama pachang.
I tluo lipa ca niema cuota hmangriy a cuo raalaa pata, na za ese lipa ung cata na za mangbung va ung ciy, cuorasala Khazing avuoming haata hne Khrih Zingsuv haata ina za cuhluo ung ciy.
Nama za hnyipa palungtluona kha tuokhaatama aa tue tli? Cuo the sala nama ming hmuo cakhyi pata ina za pi khing ung ciy tapa kha kama pangpa ta i ri nguo.
Biehmisipa ica chang nakaw yi ta nama carie ta a li kanaa ang?
Cawsaa chekha ca nama kaw caa pacuosapa ama lu raalaa pata amaa tingpa ca pha vyi. Niema kha kiema'a taata che pata iema'a luo kuo dyi a daa riypata aca khing yi.
Cahaacata kawpacuona ca a tingna phapa hne a cuo kieca niema'a lie i aw ning dyi cuo li pata cipari ta a pha.
I duepa i saata zaw, Khrih kha nama chunglie a aw hluo li chung bangkhuo ca nupazipa haa kha tana pasana ca i ang pari aa.
Ata hing niema'a lie aw ang sala i ryikaa zaw hing thle khu ang se tapa i khingsa; nama cuo tana i palung rie a thyi hringhruo.
Phungbie rawlie a aw khingpa tie zaw, na chang tie ung, phungbie ca ziy'a va ung ca ma?
Caapathe ta, Abraham ca sacapaa pahning hnyi te, pakha ca siizaanung hneta a hnyipa cuo te pakha ca hyazang pata a aw nung hneta a hnyipa a cuo.
Siizaanung saata ca saapa ta sapa cuo te hyazang pata a aw nung saata ca biekuona thueta sapa a cuo.

Hingpa hing pakhingpuona ta a cuo: Hingpa canung pahning hing biekuona suohning ta ama cuo. Biekuona suokha ca Sinai Tluo taata pipa cuo te, a saata zaw ca sii cuo riypata a sa yi. Capa ca Hagar ta a cuo.
Hagar ca Arabia ruo lie a awpa Sinai Tluo tana ta cuo te ata lieta a saata zaw hneta sii a cuo nguoluopa Jerusalem hing a ri khingnapa tana a cuo.
Cuorasala a hrangpa cawsaanung ca cungluo a awpa Jerusalem kha a ri khingpa ta cuo te, ama ca hya a zangpa kiema ma nung tana a cuo.

Tahematapakieca Caapathe ta, “Nama a cing nung, saata a sa buo li nung, na palung tluo se, nupazina a ang buo li nung, hlaa sa la u tie; tahematapakieca thawpa cawsaanung ta a sapa saata zaw khana a vaapa hne a awpa cawsaanung saata zaw laata a hluv vie'a yi,” a ta.
Uvnu zaw, niema ca biekuopa saata, Isak haa tana nama cuo.
Cuorasala saapa ta sapa saata ta Thlaapa ta sapa saata kha a hrisaapa haata ata zaw hing a cuo.
Cuorasala Caapathe ta tuokhaatama a ri? “Siizaanung hne a sacapaa hing a cade tie yi; siizaanung saata ta ca a hyazangpa cawsaanung saata hneta ru cu hne khu'a vyi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta, uvnu zaw, kiema ca siizaanung saata ta cuo vapuv, hyazang pata a awpa cawsaanung saata tana ma cuo.
Khrih ta hya malie a pazang sa nakawta hya a zangpa tana ma cuo. Caacuonakawta, a cu pata a daa ung la sii ta a li pakhaa khah ung.
Naathlie tie ung! Kama Paul na caa chang yi ang. Vangdaw kha namaa te kieca Khrih ca nama cuota thlahnena khaapahmuo hnyi'a vyi.
Ica chang pakhaa yi, vangdaw a tepa ta ca phungbie kha a bangkhuo ta a ziy riypa tana a cuo.
Phungbie ta duopacuna hmung a khingpa ca niema hne niema kha Khrih'a taata a chepa tana nama cuo; Khazing vihnyina khungthing luo a awpa tana nama cuo.
Tahematapakieca, kiema ca Thlaapa thue tana zangna ta adangna kha ma hmung aa ta pata a nguopuo pate a ngietie li pata ma huo.

Tahematapakieca Khrih Zingsuv chunglie a hringpa tie cuota ca vangdawtena cuose, vangdaw te lina cuose khaapahmuo thlahne vyi; a thlahnepa suokha ca duena ta re a hriepa zangna suokha kyalya kha tana a cuo.
Nama sizya a za phasa thluo. Biehmisipa ziy kha ahungma caa thlu yi?
Cahaapa dungna ca caa kutuvpa yi Khazing'a taata ca cuo vyi.
Thiynung a cawta tah viedie naw ciepa bangkhuo kha a pathu sa.
Ruena hrang hnyi'a va ung ciy ta pata ica zang yi. Cuorasala ahung a cuo zaw nama palung caa paluolue sapa yi hing ca a suena muo a hmung aa.

Cuorasala, uvnu zaw, vangdaw te hing aa hu thluo ta pata i ri kalie kieca, khaapanakawma hrisaana ca i ang pari thluo? Cahaacata za ri ang sala ca vieluo kaw i ripa hing ta ruvnaana khaapahmuo chiykhyi'a vyi.
Caa pataw caa pahriepa tie hing ama tiy a lu lalue yi sala a pha'apa kha!

Uvnu hne sieta zaw, niema ca hya a zangpa cuo riypata kupa tana nama cuo. Capa nama hyazangna ca saapa khingtlingna cuo dyi ta hmuo khah ung. Cuorasala pakha hne pakha kha duena ta a mangsang tie ung.
Tahematapakieca phungbie bangkhuo ca, “Nama naa duepa haata na ingpaa kha va due tie,” tapa phungbie suokha lie hingna a tling diy.
Cadyiseca, niema pakha hne pakha namaa hru namaa i kieca pakha hne pakha khana namaa parapakyi diy pathlyi aa tapa kha a cadang tie ung.
Thlaapa ta hring ung la saapa khingna kha a lunghruo patlung khah ung.
Tahematapakieca saapa khingna ca Thlaapa khingna ta a du te, Thlaapa khingna zaw kha saapa khingna ta aa du. Iema hing amaa carie nakawta nama khingpa kha tue khu va ung ciy.
Cuorasala Thlaapa ta acaa chiy kie yi ca phungbie ta ca uv va tli yi.
Saapa khingna a tuepa tie ca amaa luotaalaa thluo: aparuvsuena, a pyalyipa zyazaa, zyazaa pha lipa,
kuvtuezuv abiena, ca-iena, huena, a hru a ina, karuo-awna, hihaana, a i a chuena, achena,

hietliena, sahmyisahmaa pariyna, pariy cangta khi-una, hne cahaapa hmang zaw ca tana ama cuo. A raaringna ica za pi tlipa haa yi ta, ica pi pakhaa yi: hing haapa hmang a tuepa tie ca Khazing pena cu'a va yi.
Cuorasala, Thlaapa thyipaa ca duena, palungtluona, diena, palungpasiyna, malie ngiechina, pahyana, zang tluo atlana,
nangnena hne kiema hne kiema a uv khuna zaw ta a cuo. Hingpa hmang zaw hing a dupa phungbie aw vyi.
Cakhutaata Khrih Zingsuv huopa ta a cuopa ta ca a saapa hne saapa khingna bangkhuo kha vieluo lieta a thie tli.
Thlaapa ta ma hring kieca, Thlaapa ta luo malie a chiy se.
Ahruo tle khah ung siy, pakha hne pakha a zue a tie khah ung siy, pakha hne pakha hie a tliena hnyi khah ung siy.
Viesaa zaw, cawsaa pakha ta suena a tuepa kha nama hmung kieca Thlaapa a tingpa niema ta ama kha nangnena hneta luodangpa luo a chiy tie ung. Pasupaliyna luo nama chiy li riypa zaw a raaring tie ung.
Pakha hne pakha hmangriy a phyakhyi ung la cahaacata Khrih phungbie kha patling sa tie ung.
Khaapahmuo cuo tlung li pata cawsaa ciemuopa ta a ruepa tie ca iema hne iema a dungpa tana ama cuo.
Cawsaa bangkhuo ta iema ama tuehriepa kha a mangpasie yi se. Malie tuehriepa hne pakhingpuo a hu li pata niemata tah nama palung a tluo aa.
Tahematapakieca cawsaa bangkhuo ta kiema hmang cyicuo kha phya riypa tana a cuo.
Khazing bie pacuv pata a cuopa tie ca hmang pha ama cupa bangkhuo kha pacuvtuv hneta amaa hraw riypa tana a cuo.
Ahungtahmuo ca dung khah yi se; Khazing ca dung khu riypa cuo vyi, na vaapa haa kha tana na pahriy aa.
Na saapa cuona ta na vaa kieca, saapa taata rana kha pahriy'a cate, cuorasala, Thlaapa cuona ta na vaa kieca, Thlaapa taata a vawpa chuozaa hringna kha na pahriy aa.
Hmang phapa tue riypa kha thaachi li pata aw ung siy. Taw li pata maa zue kieca a cuo aa de tiyta thyipaa kha ma pahriy aa.
Cakhutaata, cuophaa ma hnyi tiy mekaa ta cawsaa bangkhuo cuota hmang pha tue kha a zue ung sala, a hlyi vie ta zangna luota ma chungkhue tie cuota a zue ung siy.
I kuv hrahring ta caasuo pangkatupa ta i capepa caa hing mang tie ung.
Saapa lie mingphana a hmung khingpa tie ta niema kha vangdaw a te riypata aca pasu yi. Capa ca Khrih vieluotaana kawlieta hrisaana ama ang li riypata ama tuepa tana a cuo.
Vangdaw a tepa tie tahmuo phungbie kha ziy va yi, cuorasala niema kha vangdaw aca pate sa khingpa yi ca nama saapa phung ziyna kawlieta amaa pale khing nakaw tana a cuo.

Kama ca ima Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih vieluo kaw ta li pata khaapa kawlie hmuota a pale'a va ang, Khrih vieluo thue hingta chuelyi ca i cuota vieluo lie khepuopa cuo tli te, kama zaw chuelyi cuota vieluo lie khepuopa i cuo tli.
Tahematapakieca vangdawtena cuose, vangdaw te lina cuose khaapahmuo thlahne vyi, cuorasala sathaapa cuona hingna a thlahnepa ta a cuo.
Hingpa phung a ziypa tie cunglie hne Khazing cawsaa Israel ming zaw cunglie diena hne nangduena aw mang sue.
Ata taa hingta pathu pata ahungtahmuo riethyi na pi khah tli se; tahematapakieca Zingsuv hmaa hne hmaadaa khana i pangpa cunglieta i phya thluo.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, Abyipa Zingsuv Khrih vihnyina ca niema'a lie aw mang sue. Amen.
Khazing khingna ta Khrih Zingsuv lucuotuv a cuopa kama Paul ta, Khrih Zingsuv thueta zang tluo aa tlapa Efesa lie a awpa mingpathepa tie kha:
Ima Paa Khazing'a taata hne Abyipa Zingsuv Khrih'a taata vihnyina hne thlaalungna ca niema'a lie aw mang sue ta pata bie icaa chang yi.
Ima Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih a Paa hne Khazing ca pathuosa pata cuo mang sue. Ama ca vuoruo lie thlaapa thluechiy phangting kha Khrih thueta kiema malie a pituv tana a cuo.
A hmiekunglie a pathepa hne syisaa riy a aw lipa ma cuo riypata chuelyi sa hluo baataata Khrih chunglie kha duena ta malie aa tlaw.
Kiema ca Zingsuv Khrih thueta a saata tah cuhluo riypata a phapa ama khingna haata lieriy malie a uopuopa tana ma cuo.
A duesapa Sacapaa thueta malie a pipa a rungnaapa a vihnyina kawlieta Khazing ca pathuosa ung siy.
Khrih thiyse thueta khuona hne sue angiethena kha
Khazing ta pahyasa pata malie a pipa a vihnyina thueta ma hmung.
Ama ta a singna hne aa thuvpa a pachangna ta a ting ciepa kha hrie te Khrih thueta a patling sa khingpa a bieparuv ca kiema'a lie a paluo sa.
A cuo a tling tiyta Khazing ta vuoruo lie a awpa hmang bangkhuo hne alyi lie a awpa hmang bangkhuo kha Khrih'a lie suv kha ta pahmya diy aa ting.
Ama khingna haata hmangting bangkhuo kha a patlungpa Abyipa a tingna haata kiema kha Khrih thueta rucutuv ta malie a tue.
Caacuonakawta, Khrih cunglie anguopuona a hnyi taapa kiema ca a rungnaana pathuosa riypata hring ung siy.
Niema zaw, biehmisipa, khuona thuophaa kha thyi ung cate ama nama zang tiyta biekuo ciepa Thlaapa Pathe ta caa khepa tana nama cuo tli.
Thlaapa Pathe ca ama rungnaana ma pathuosa the riypata Khazing cawsaa a cuopa zaw ta ma cupa ru cuota biekuona tana a cuo.
Abyipa Zingsuv nama zangna hne mingpathepa tie cunglie nama hnyipa duena kha i thyi tli.
Capa kawlie cata i thlaachuona lie niema kha caa thyi pari yi angte palungtluona bie kha i hluo pari.
Ima Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih a Khazing, rungnaana Paa ta niema kha ama nama pachangna riypata singna thlaapa hne biephu a ca pi riy'apa yi ta thlaa ica chuopa yi.

Cahaacata nama pachangna pathiypalung a pahaw sala, Abyipa ta a tuepa a lepa a rungnaana kha pachang pata, Abyipa ta aca u hnuochuonapa yi anguopuona hne mingpathepa tie ta ama hmung riypa ru hing kha tluv tama a rungnaa tapa kha pachang'a ung cate,
kiema ama a zangtuv zaw cuota a cahrana hing kha tluv tama a le tapa zaw kha nama pachang riypata thlaa i chuo.
Khazing ta Zingsuv kha pathu te vuoruo lie ama cacuoluo kuo ta a patu khutaata capa re hrie khuna cahrana ca a pi.

Khrih ca uvtuv bangkhuo hne nawhnyina bangkhuo hne cahrana bangkhuo hne byi bangkhuo cunglie kha chi te, ata chuo lie dyi cuo li pata hmieluo chuo lie zaw ku pata a cuo riypa ming zawdya cunglie ming sung cepa kha a pi.
Khazing ta hmangting bangkhuo kha Khrih phyipazaa rawlie chi te, hmangting bangkhuo cunglie Byi tana a cuo ta te Khrihsaabuv luv ta a chi.
Khrihsaabuv ca Khrih pangpa ta cuo te, hmangting bangkhuo a patling sana ama tlingna tana a cuo.
Niema ca nama pha li nakaw hne nama sue nakawta thlaapa luota thiyna chunglie nama za aw.
Chuelyi phungluo pha lipa kha cuose, alyi hne avuo alalalie thliy chunglie cahrana a hnyipa uvtuv kha cuose, ri a ngie lipa tie hrawlie re a hrie nguoluopa thlaapa kha cuose nama za paziy.
Kiema bangkhuo zaw hing iema hrawlie kha saapa khingna ziy pata za aw pate, iema zaw bangkhuo haa khata Khazing hihaana a ang riypa tana ma za cuo.
Cuorasala nangduena ta a bipa Khazing ta a lesapa kiema malie a duenapa khata
ma pha lina kawlieta a thiy tlipa kiema kha Khrih hneta malie a pahring sa pakhaa. Khazing vihnyina thueta khuopa tana nama cuo.
Khrih Zingsuv hneta malie pathu pakhaa te ama hne vuoruo lie byi cuo hne riypata malie a patu hne.
Cahaacata Khrih Zingsuv thueta kiema malie a duena hne a vihnyina ca kha tluv tama a le tapa kha a vaw riypa chuo lie zaw pahmung sa a khing.
Tahematapakieca niema ca vihnyina thueta zangna ta khuopa tana nama cuo. Niema nama tuena thueta cuo vyi; Khazing lasaw tana a cuo.
Hriena thueta a cuo li nakawta ahunghmuo a pale khah se.
Tahematapakieca kiema ca Khrih Zingsuv thueta re phapa hrie riypata sapa cuo pate, cahaapa hringzya hnyi riypa cata Khazing ta a tingtuo paciepa tana ma cuo.
Niema ca a hluota ca saapa cuona ta Jentail ming za cuo ung cate, saapa lie cawsaapa kuv ta “vangdaw a tepa tie” ta “vangdaw a te lipa” aca za tapa yi kha maw khah ung.

Capa cuo ning ca Khrih hne a patuvna za hnyi va ung ciy. Israel ming'a lie khyche za cuo ung cate, Khazing pipa biekuona hne namaa zaa hla, chuelyi lie hing anguopuona hnyi li pata hne Khazing hnyi li pata nama za aw.
Cuorasala hluo ningta luohlaapuv luo zaa aw tawpa niema ca Khrih thiyse thueta a ngieta luo ku pata nama cuo tli.

Tahematapakieca ama ca kiema ma diena ta cuo te, Judah ming hne Jentail ming kha ama pangpa hrahring ta pang kha ta a pacuo sa yi. Iema a chetuv yi lungruetlepie, amaa lalalie a awpa huena kha a pacing.
Ama ta phungbie kha a nawbie hne a phungluo bangkhuo hne khata para te, mingphang phang hning kha ama thueta mingphang thaapa phang kha ta sa yi te diena a tue.
Vieluo cunglie a thiyna thue khata amaa cariena kha pachuo sa te, ama phuv hning khata Khazing'a luo pang kha cuo riypata a vya chiy yi te a pare yi.
Caacuonakawta, ama ca a vaw te niema luohlaa luo a awpa tie hne luongie lie a awpa tie'a lie kha diena thuophaa ca a ukhyi.
Caacuonakawta Khrih thueta ima phuv hning hingta Thlaapa pakha chunglie a taw pate Paa hmiekung luo ma chiy.
Cahaacata niema ca khyche hne ruohrang ming cuo va tli ung ciy, mingpathepa tie hne khata ruo kha cawsaa cuo tli ung cate Khazing chungkhue cawsaa zaw tana nama cuo.
Lucuotuv tie hne profet tie bang ciepa inghruo cunglieta sapatuepa ta cuo ung cate ingkiy tung ca Khrih Zingsuv ama hrahring kha tana a cuo.
Ing kha bangpa khata Khrih chunglie ca a patue diy te, Abyipa thueta a pathepa biena-ing ta a li te a lethaw.
Ama hne namaa pazuena thueta niema zaw hing Khazing awna ing cuo riypata thlaapa ta sa pakhawpa tana nama cuo.
Hingpa kawlie hing tana kama Paul ca niema Jentail ming cuota Khrih Zingsuv ming ta thaw a tlapa i cuo pata a cuo.
Khazing ta niema cuota hingpa re hrie riypa hing a vihnyina thueta ina pipa tana a cuo tapa kha nama pachang diy thluo tli aa.
Khazing ta tuokhaatama biephu hmuo pata a bieparuv kha ina pachang sa tapa a cunglie a cawta i cape mangtli.
Capa i capepa ca nama ri kieca Khrih bieparuv i pachangna kaw kha nama pachang aa.
Ahluo ta ca hingpa bieparuv hing cawsaa kha za pachang sa va yi. Cuorasala ata hing ca a pathepa ama lucuotuv tie hne profet tie'a lie kha Thlaapa ta a phu mangtli.
Capa bieparuv ca, thuophaa thueta Jentail ming ca Judah ming hneta ru a cu hnepa, pang kha chunglie chebuo, hne Khrih Zingsuv thueta tuepa biekuona thluechiy a hmung ra riypa tana ama cuo.
Thuophaa rehrietuv i cuopa ca Khazing vihnyina lasaw cuo te, Khazing ta a cahrana ta a hriepa re lie hing vihnyina ta ina pipa tana a cuo.
Kama ca mingpathepa tie hrawlie a caw cepa laata a caw viepa i cuo raalaa pata Khrih hnyirungna a chuo khu lipa thuophaa ca Jentail ming'a luo ri riypata vihnyina ta ina pi.
Hmangting a satuv Khazing chunglie chuo hluvpuv za nupa bieparuv kha cawsaa bangkhuo pahmung sa riypata a cuo.
Cata a tuepa ca vuoruo lie a awpa uvtuv tie hne nawhnyituv tie ta Khazing singna phangting zawdya kha Khrihsaabuv thueta ama vya pachangna riypa tana a cuo.
Capa ca chuozaa ta a zaa tingpa haa khata Khazing ta ma Byipaapa Khrih Zingsuv thueta a patlingsapa tana a cuo.
Ama thue hne ama ma zangna thueta Khazing'a luo kha riephasapa hne a nguosa pata a ngie khuna ma hnyi.
Caacuonakawta niema cuota i angpa ruvnaana kawlie hingta nama palung chuo khah se ta pata thlaa i chuo; niema cuota phana selaw tana a cuo.
Hingpa kawlie hingta ma Paa hmielie pakhuv pane pata thlaa i chuo.
Ama ca vuoruo hne alyi lie a awpa ingchungkhue bangkhuo ta ama ming ama lanapa hruo tana a cuo.
Abyipa ca rungnaa lesyina hne a bipa haata, nama chung luo cawsaa cuona kha a Thlaapa ta thaazuo aca pi riypa yi ta thlaa i chuo.
Niema ca duena chunglieta a hruo thlapa hne bangpa nama cuopa haata nama zangna thueta Khrih ca nama pathiypalung lie aw mang sue.
Mingpathepa tie hne khata Khrih duena a kuzya hne a syizya, aa suozya hne aa thuvzya pachang khunapa nama hnyi riypata thlaa i chuo.
Cakhutaata thesingna ta a pachang diy khu lipa Khrih duena kha pachang'a ung cate Khazing tluotlingna hneta nama bi riypata thlaa i chuo.
Ma chunglie a cahrana ta re a hrietuv ta ca maa hie thepa hne ma rue khupa laata hmuo ale ta hmang a tue khu.
Khazing ca khrihsaabuv chunglie, Khrih Zingsuv thueta chuozaa taa chuozaa te a ming rungnaa pata aw mang sue. Amen.
Caacuonakawta, Abyipa rehriena kawlie thaw a tlapa kama ta, Khazing ta aca una yi hne aa phuvpa hringzya kha hnyi tie ung ta pata paa ica kie yi.
Rawcanawna hne palungnena hne palungpasiyna ta pakha hne pakha kha duena chunglieta a ngiethe tie ung.
Diena chunglie saw pakhawpa thlaapa chunglie pang kha cuona kha nama pahmang khuna riypata nama cuo khuna chung ta a zue tie ung.
Niema ca aca ku tiy yi ta anguopuona suokha chung luo kha kupa nama cuopa haata, pangpa suokha dyi aw te Thlaapa suokha dyina a aw.
Abyi pakha, zangna suokha, tiynawna suokha dyina a aw.
Khazing pakha dyi aw te cawsaa bangkhuo Paa, hmangting bangkhuo cunglie Byi, hmangting bangkhuo chunglie rehrie te hmangting bangkhuo chunglie a awpa tana a cuo.
Cuorasala kiema pakha cyicuo hing Khrih ta malie a pipa lasaw zi haa khata vihnyina pipa tana ma cuo.
Caacuonakawta ta, “Abyipa ca aa suona luo kha a kie tiyta patuvpa sii a hluvsa kha kiekhyi yi te, a cawsaa kha lasaw a pi yi,” ta pata a cuo.
(“Aa suo luo kie te,” a ta tiyta, a ri khingpa khaapatama a cuo? Abyipa ca aa nepa alyi luo na a za cung tana pata cuo va ma?
A raw luo zaa cungpa khana hmangting bangkhuo patling sa diy riypata avuo laata aa suo viena luo kha a kie.)
Abyipa ta malie a pipa lasaw ca, chekha kha lucuotuv, chekha kha profet, chekha kha thuophaa phutuv, chekha kha pastor hne chekha kha saya ta cuo te,
capa ca mingpathepa tie ta Khazing re kha hrie the'a yi te Khrih pangpa kha ama sathawna riypata a cuo.
Zangna hne Khazing Sacapaa pachangna lie kha suv kha ta a taw pakhaw diy pata Khrih a cuona zaa khata a puvtlingpa ma cuona riypa kha tana a cuo.
Kiema ca a zyatepa tie dungna hne pacuvna, tiylaw hne thliychie haata a tapa chunglie duvkhing ta pazu bungthawpa, haatiyta haata cuo khah ung siy.
Cuorasala, biehmisipa kha duena ta ri ung sala, ma luv ta a cuopa Khrih chunglie kha a kuo ting ta lethaw ung siy.

Luv a cuopa Khrih rawlie ca pangpa chebuo bangkhuo ca thariytha-uo hne cakhiycabuo bangkhuo khata aa rawsa pata pazue diy yi te pang kha ta ama cuo. Pangpa chebuo bangkhuo ta iema hrie riypa re kha a phasa pata ama hrie tiyta pangpa suokha yalya khata duena chunglie a lethaw.
Abyipa ming ta a cusa pata bie ica cung yi: Zanglituv tie ama awpa haata nama aw riypa cuo va tli. Iema ruenapa ca a hripa tana a cuo.
Ama pathiypalung kha a zing. Ama pachang li nakaw hne ama palung a cuotuv nakawta Khazing pipa hringna taa khata amaa hla.
Nangzaa pachang li pata hne a cadangna hne a angna hnyi nguocuo li pata, mang a ngie lipa suena phangting kha ama tue.
Khrih phungluo namaa cuvpa ca cahaacata cuo vyi.
Zingsuv chunglie a awpa biehmisipa haa khata, pacuvpa cuo ung cate a kaw kha nama thyi hmisi mangtli.
Saapa khingna ta dung te a parapa nama hringna hlungpa kha thuse riypata pacuvpa tana nama cuo.
Nama pathiypalung hne nama ruena lie kha sathaapa nama cuo riypa tana a cuo.
A hmisipa adangna hne pathena lie Khazing hmingsuo a lu pata sapa hringna thaapa kha a hryi tie ung.
Caacuonakawta, hanghiena bie ri khah tie ung. Ma ingpaa kha biehmisipa chang kaluo ung siy. Tahematapakieca chungkhue cawsaa tana ma cuo ung.
Na hi hmuo haa ra sala sue tuena te ta cuo khah se. Na hihaa cangta ning patla sa khah.
Khachie kha cuo pi khah.
A paruvthepa ta paruv khah tie se. Riethyivuosuopa tie zaw a bya khu riypata ama kuv hrahring ta adangna hne re hrie yi sala viehlue hriy yi se.
Nama pakaa taata biechiepa pya khah se. Cuorasala a thyipa tie kha thlahnena a pi riypa hne amaa huna lie a sathawpa a cuo riypata biephapa dyi kha ri tie ung.
Khuona ning thue cuota nama caakhena ta a cuopa Khazing Thlaapa Pathe kha a ngie pachi khah ung.
Huena, hihaana, bie a ina, bie a pachiena hne pathiypalung pha lipa bangkhuo kha thaw diy tie ung.
Zingsuv thueta Khazing ta acaa ngiethepa haa yi khata nangnena hnyi ung la pakha hne pakha kha a due ung la a ngiethe tie ung.
Caacuonakawta duepa saata zaw nama cuopa haata, Khazing a mangpuo pata a hringpa cuo tie ung.
Khrih ta malie a due nakawta Khazing'a luo kha rangpa-ue pihluona hne hriykhungrina ta aa pihluopa haata duena chunglie hring tie ung.
Niema ca Khazing mingpathepa nama cuopa haata, nama hrawlie kha aparuvsuena kaw, a pathe lipa hmangting kaw, karuo-awna kaw tapa zaw ca a ri hmuo ri khah ung,
Bie pyalyipa, biechiepa hne chiephu bie zaw ca nama ri riypa hetahmuo cuo vyi; capa zaw ri cuopa cata Khazing kha pathuosa tie ung.

Aparuvsuena a tuepa, mang a ngie li pata a hringpa hne a karuo-awpa tie (karuo-awna ca kuvtuezuv abiepa hne tana aa lu) ca Khrih hne Khazing pena lie ru cu riypa khaapahmuo hnyi'a va yi tapa kha nama pachang.
Ahungtahmuo siyluo a hnyi lipa bie ta ca dung khah yi se. Hingpa zaw kawlie hing tana Khazing hihaana ca ri a ngie lipa tie cunglie a tlung.
Caacuonakawta iema kha a khe khah ung.
Ahluo ta ca zingna za cuo ung cate, cuorasala ata hing ca Abyipa thueta khena tana nama cuo. Khena saa haa khata hring tie ung.
Tahematapakieca, khena thyipaa ca phana, adangna hne a hmisipa lie tana hmung pata a cuo.
Abyipa palung a patluopa hmang kha tue a zue tie ung.
Hmang phapa a chiykhyi lipa zingna hmang tuena lie kha aw ra khah ung, a phu tuv khata phu hriy tie ung.
Tahematapakieca cahaapaapa cawsaa zaw ta a paruvta tah ama tuepa hmang ca a ri ta ri riypa khiy tahmuo nangzaa na a chiy.
Cuorasala khena ta a paluosapa bangkhuo ca hmung khupa ta vya cuo yi te,
hmung khupa ta a vya cuopa bangkhuo ca khena ta ama cuo. Caacuonakawta, “Aa hmungpa, kya thu tie! Thiyna taata kya thu la, cakhutaata Khrih ca na cunglie a khe aa,” ta pata a cuo.
Tuokhaatama i hring aa tapa kha a raaring ung la, a ngaapa haata cuo li pata a singpa haata aw tie ung.
Ma ningkhue hing cuo chie ning chiepa a cuo nakawta cuo pha nama hnyipa kha muo hnyisa pata hmuo tie ung.
Caacuonakawta a ngaapa cuo khah ung, cuorasala Abyipa khingna hing khaapatama a cuo tapa kha pachang a zue tie ung.
Sahmaa pariy khah ung, tahematapakieca anuopaluena tana a cuo. Cuorasala Thlaapa ta bi tie ung.
Salm hlaa, khrihsaa hlaa hne pathuosana hlaa kha niema hrawlie nama sapa haata, Abyipa kha hlaa ue puvthepa ta nama pathiypalung hmisi ta pathuosa tie ung.
Hmangting kawlieta Paa Khazing kha ma Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih ming ta cipari pathuosa tie ung.
Khrih nama pa-uvsathyina ta pakha hne pakha kha nama ri a ngie tie ung.
Napuvnung zaw Abyipa ri namaa ngiepa haata nama navaapa ri kha a ngie tie ung.
Khrih ca khrihsaabuv luv a cuopa haata, navaapa ca napuvnung luv tana a cuo. Khrih ca khrihsaabuv khuotuv cuo te khrihsaabuv ca a pangpa ta a cuo.
Khrihsaabuv ta Khrih ri kha aa ngiepa haata napuvnung zaw ta hmangting kawlie kha navaapa ri a ngie riypa tana a cuo.
Navaapa zaw, Khrih ta khrihsaabuv kha due te a hringna a pipa haata nama napuvnung kha due tie ung.
Hing haa hingta a tuepa ca khrihsaabuv hing Abyipa bie ta tiy chunglie pasiy pata a pathe sapa tana a cuo.
Cahaacata khrihsaabuv ca a pya a lyipa aw li, aa hlaw aa kaapa aw li, a pathepa hne syisaa riy aw li pata rungnaana chunglie a kuv luo pi riypa a khing nakawta a cuo.
Cahaacata navaapa ta ama pangpa aa duepa haata napuvnung kha a due riypa tana a cuo.
Ahungtahmuo ama pangpa kha a hue buo vyi, cuorasala Khrih ta khrihsaabuv cunglie a tuepa haata a phasa pata a mangsang riypa tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca kiema ca a pangpa chebuo tana ma cuo.
“Caacuonakawta capaa ta a nung hne a paa kha thuse'a yi te, a napuv hneta amaa hlaw aa, pahning ca pang kha ta ama cuo aa.”
Hingpa hing a lesapa bieparuv ta cuo te, kama ta Khrih hne khrihsaabuv khana a ri khing ica ta yi.
Cadyiseca, niema pakha cyicuo ta niema pangpa namaa duepa haa khata nama napuvnung kha due ung la, napuvnung zaw ta navaapa kha pa-uvsathyi tie ung.
Saata zaw Abyipa ming ta nama nung hne nama paa ri kha a ngie tie ung. Tahematapakieca hmang phapa tana a cuo.
“Na nung hne na paa va ciyzaa yi,” tapa ca nawbie suokhana ta cuo te,
biekuopuopa ca, “Na cuota pha'a te chuelyi lie na hring a pasiy aa,” ta pata a cuo.
Paa zaw, nama saata zaw kha ama hihaa riypata tue khah ung, cuorasala Abyipa pasiypa-yana hne zyazaa haata palethaw sa tie ung.
Sii zaw, Khrih ri kha namaa ngiepa haata nama ziy tie kha ciyzaana hne pathiypalung hmisi ta ama ri a ngie tie ung.
Aca hmungna lie dyi yi iema palung patluo riypata cuo li pata, Khrih sii nama cuona haa khata nama pathiypalung hmisi ta Khazing khingna kha tue tie ung.
Re nama hrie tiyta cawsaa huo tana ma hrie ta pata rue li pata Abyipa huo tana ma hrie ta pata rue ung la thaathusa pata hrie tie ung.
Sii ta ma cuo zaw, hyazangpa ta ma cuo zaw, ma tuepa phana hne aa lupa lawmuo na ma hmung aa tapa kha pachang tie ung.

Niema ziy tie zaw cahaacata nama sii tie cunglie kha tue ra tie ung. Pachiypahuo khah ung, tahematapakieca, niema hne nama sii tie zaw vuoruo lie aa lupa Ziy pakha dyi nama hnyipa kha nama pachang, ama'a lie ca pahlyipalena aw vyi.
A hnangcaw ce ta, Abyipa thueta hne a cahrana thaazuo thueta a cahra sa tie ung.
Khachie dungna kha namaa du khuna riypata Khazing rieduna cawsie kha a tling pata a hryi tie ung.
Tahematapakieca maa dupa carie hing cawsaapa cuo li pata, uvtuv tie, nawhnyituv tie, a zingpa chuelyi cahrana hne avuo lie a awpa thlaapa chiepa cahrana zaw ta ama cuo.
Caacuonakawta ning pha lipa lie kha namaa daapahrang khu riypa hne a tlungna te ta a cusa pata namaa daapahrang khuna riypata Khazing rieduna cawsie kha a tling pata a hryi tie ung.
Caacuonakawta a daa ung la biehmisipa kha tesaw haata nama se lie a saw ung la, adangna kha cacunghnaapakaw haata a hryi tie ung.
Nama phyipakaw cuota diena thuophaa phu khingna thaathuna kha a pakaw tie ung.
Capa bangkhuo hne cata, zangna kha phya haata a cyi ung la, capa ca ta a pha lipa paa ta a vya kapa myi haata a iepa cuoti zaw kha nama pache khu aa.
Khuona kha thaalakhuv haata a khuv ung la Thlaapa zueziy ta a cuopa Khazing bie kha a cyi tie ung.
Thlaachuona hne ahiena kha Thlaapa luochiyna hneta cipari tue tie ung. A chuona te khata padiypavuosa pata aw ung la mingpathepa tie cuo khata palung pasiysa pata thlaachuo tie ung.
Kama zaw bie i ri tiyta, ri riypa bie pipa i cuo riypa hne thuophaa bieparuv kha riephasa pata a pachang sa khutuv i cuo riypata thlaa na chuopa tie ung.
Capa repa ca tana luosituv ca cuo angte thaw chunglie i aw. I ri riypata a cuopa haata riephasa pata i ri khuna riypata thlaa na chuopa tie ung.

Taikhikas ta niema kha aca chang diy'a nakaw yi ta tuokhaata aw angte ma, khaapa hmang i tue nguoluo tapa kha nama pachang aa. Ama ca ma duepa hne Abyipa re lieta zang tluo aa tlapa ma uvnu tana a cuo.
Tuokhaatama ma aw tapa kha pachang sa riypa hne niema thaazuo pi riypa tingna cangta i vya pathliepa tana a cuo.
Paa Khazing hne Abyipa Zingsuv Khrih'a taata thlaalungna, zangna hne duena ca zangtuv nama bangkhuo cunglie aw mang sue.
Ima Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih kha a lang buo lipa duena ta a duepa nama bangkhuo cunglie Khazing vihnyina aw mang sue.
Khrih changtaapa ta a cuopa Paul hne Timote ta, Filipi khy lie a awpa Khrih Zingsuv chunglie mingpathepa tie bangkhuo hne, khrihsaabuv luochiytuv tie hne khrihsaa uvthyi tie kha:
Ma Paa Khazing hne Abyipa Zingsuv Khrih'a taata vihnyina hne thlaalungna ca niema'a lie aw mang sue, ta pata bie maacaa chang yi.
Icaa thyi kyry yi ta i Khazing'a luo kha alawna bie hluo angte,
nama cuota thlaa i chuo kyry ta alawna hne i chuo taw.
Tahematapakieca thuophaa i phu baataata ataning tepa hingta inaa bya ung ciy.
Nama hrawlie hingpa re phapa hrie a pathupa hingta, Zingsuv Khrih aa vawna ning lieta, a patlungna te a hrie aa tapa kha i pachangpasie.

Hing haa hingta niema bangkhuo kaw i ruepa hing i cuota a pha, tahematapakieca nama palung lie na pari ung cate, i thawtlana lie hne thuophaa a cusa pata i daakhyina kawlie nama bangkhuo ta Khazing vihnyina kha kama hne namaa hraw.
Tahematapakieca Khrih Zingsuv duena lieta niema kha kha tluv tama ica vuo yi tapa kha naa pachangkhyituv ca Khazing tana a cuo.
Namaa duena ca pachangna hne bie thleduothena hneta bi pata a lethawna riypata thlaa i chuo.
Cahaacata khaapa hing ma a pha ce tapa kha a tlaw the'a ung cate Khrih aa vawna ning te ta a pathepa hne syi riy a aw lipa nama cuo aa.
Khazing rungnaana hne pathuosana cuota Zingsuv Khrih'a taata a vawpa adangna thyipaa hne khata bi tie ung.
Uvnu zaw i cunglie a tlungpa hmang hingta thuophaa aa zena riypata byatuv a cuozya kha ica pachang sa khing yi.
I thawtlapa hing Khrih cuo tana a cuo tapa kha siepahruo ing a huopa bangkhuo hne cawsaa mekaa ta ama pachang.
I thawtlana hingta uvnu hne sieta hluv vie bangkhuo kha Abyipa ama nguonapa pacu sa vie yi te, riepha viena hne ciyna aw li pata thuophaa kha a pari sa nguo yi.
Chekha ta Khrih kaw kha hietliena hne a zue a tiena pathiypalung hneta ama ri, cuorasala chekha ta ca a khingkhyina hneta ama ri.
Capa tie ca ta Khrih kaw kha duena hneta ama phu, tahematapakieca thuophaa a daakhyi riypata hingpa hmang lie chipa i cuopa kha ama pachang nakawta a cuo.
Chekha ta ca Khrih kaw kha palung pathena hne cuo li pata iema phana cuo dyi ta ri yi te, thaw i tlana lie hing ruvnaana ta tlungchiy hryly se tapa kha ama khing.
Caacuokieca tuokhaatama a cuo aa? Aa hmuo lipa atingna hne a cuo zaw, aa hmuopa atingna hne a cuo zaw, tuokhaata a cuo zaw Khrih kaw kha ama phu thluo kieca i palung a tluo.
A cuo, i palung a tluo pari thluo aa, tahematapakieca nama thlaachuona thueta hne Zingsuv Khrih Thlaapa abyana thueta capa ca thaw taata hya i zangna riypa tana a cuo aa tapa kha i pachang.

Tuokhaata hmuo cuo sala, nangzaa pata cuo'a va ang. Riephasa pata i ripa thue hingta, i thiy a cuo zaw i hring a cuo zaw, Khrih ca i pangpa lie za cyicalangpa a cuopa haa khata ata zaw hing cyicalangpa cuo sala tapa hing i khingpa hne i nguopuo cepa ta a cuo.
Kama cuota ca hringna hing Khrih ta cuo te thiyna zaw hing aa thung viena tana a cuo.
Saapa ta i hring kalie kieca, re phapa a hluv vie i hrie khuna ta a cuo aa; khaapa hing ma i tlaw aa tapa pachang khu va ang.
I palung na kuo hning ta a vaa: khing na i tlaw aa tapa kieca, thiy pata Khrih hneta awpa hingta a cuo, tahematapakieca capa ca a pha vie karaa pata a cuo.
Cuorasala saapa ta aw kalie riypa hing niema cuota aa hu viepa ta a cuo hyi.
Capa ca a siesa pata i pachang nakawta, nama kiethaw riypa hne zangna lie nama palung a tluo the riypata niema bangkhuo hne hingta i hring kalie aa.
Cahaacata niema'a luo i vya chiy pakhaana thueta Khrih Zingsuv chunglie namaa lawna ca a le hryly aa.

Tuokhaata a cuo zaw, Khrih thuophaa hne aa phuvpa hringna kha hnyi tie ung. Niema'a luo a vaw pata icaa taw khu kie yi a cuo zaw, icaa taw khu li kie yi a cuo zaw, palung a lusa pata a daa pakhaw ung cate, thuophaa zangna kawlieta rie a du pakhawpa nama cuo nakawta

caa dutuv tie ta tuokhaata hmuo aca pachiy aca pahuo khu li riypa yi khana i thyi khingpa ta a cuo. Capa ca ta iema cuota rana cuo te niema cuota ca khuona a cuopa kha a paluo sa aa. Hingpa hing Khazing tuepa tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca Khrih nama zangna lie dyi cuo li pata a cuota ruvnaana ang riypa zaw kha vihnyina ta cuophaa pipa nama cuo.
Abyipa cuota rie i dupa kha na za hmung ung cate ata tepa hingta i dupa kha nama thyi. Niema zaw capa rie cana namaa du nguoluo ra.
Cakhutaata Khrih chunglie nama hringna khata thaazuo ca pi yi te, a duena taata hnaanguona, Thlaapa chunglie a viesaana, kawpacuona hne ngie a china zaw kha niema'a lie a aw kieca,
ruena aa lupa hnyi ung la, aa due zaw a due kaluo ung la, palung a lusa pata i lawna kha na paky tie ung.
Kiema kaw dyi a pacuona hne a mangkhangna ta khaapahmuo tue khah ung, cuorasala malie kha kama laata ama pha vie tapa rue ung la, rawcanawna hne aw tie ung.
Malie khingna kha hmung the a zue ung la niema khingna dyi kha rue khah ung.
Nama palungphya ca Khrih Zingsuv ta a za hnyipa palungphya khata cuo se.
Ama ca Khazing cuona kha a hnyi raalaa pata, Khazing hne a pakhing riypa kha hruohra ta a chuv vyi.
Cuorasala a cuona yalya kha thuse te, siicuona kha a la pata, cawsaa hmingsuo haata a puv. Cawsaa cuona kha a la te,
rawcanawna hneta a hring, thiyna te ta ri a ngie te, vieluo cunglie kha a thiy.
Caacuonakawta Khazing ta aa suopuv ta cyicalang te, ming zawdya hrawlieta, aa cungnung cepa ming kha a pi.
Caacuonakawta vuoruo, chuelyi hne chuelyi rawlie a awpa mekaa ta, Zingsuv ming ta ama pakhuv pane'a yi te,
Paa Khazing rungnaana cuota, Zingsuv ca Byi tana a cuo ta pata, ama phu aa.
Caacuonakawta, i duepa zaw, i ri inaa ngie paripa haa ung cata, i aw ning dyi cuo li pata, i aw li ning zaw, nama khuona cuo khata ciyna hne thlaazangna ta khuo vie ta hrie tie ung.
Tahematapakieca Khazing ca ama palung a patlingpa re kha nama hrie khing riypa hne nama hrie khu riypata cahrana caa pipa yi tana a cuo.
Hmang bangkhuo kha a ciepuopa hne a hrupuo a ipuo pata hrie khah ung.
Cahaacata na niema ca a zyatepa hne a pha lipa chuo chung taa hingta syi riy a aw lipa hne suena a hnyi lipa Khazing saata cuo'a ung cate chuelyi lie hing aasiy haata nama khe aa.
A cusa pata hringna bie namaa patuvna thue khata i hriepa bangkhuo kha a cakhawpa ta cuo vyi tapa kha Khrih aa vaw tiyta i palesakhyi khu aa.
Cuorasala zangna ta nama pipa, hriykhung namaa rinapa cunglie kha i thiyse hing bya pata a cuo zawma, niema bangkhuo hneta i palung tluo'a te,
niema bangkhuo zaw kama hneta nama palung tluo'a te namaa law riypata a cuo.
Niema thuohlaa thyi pata i thaa a pha the riypata a ru hluota niema'a luo Timote vya pathlie riypa kha Abyipa Zingsuv ming ta i nguopuo.
Ama haata niema phana cuota kawpacuona caa hnyi hmisi the riypa yi ahunghmuo kama'a lie aw va yi.
A hrangpa bangkhuo ca Zingsuv Khrih khingna huv li pata iema khingna dyina ama huv.
Cuorasala Timote ca paa hne saa haata thuophaa phuna re kha kama hne a hrie hnepa a cuopa ca pachang aa tlapa a cuo.
Caacuonakawta i kaw hing tuokhaatama a cuo tapa aa cie pahne ta niema'a luo vya pathlie'a angte,
kama zaw ica vya tlaw patang'a yi ta pata Abyipa ming ta i zang.
I huna lie a bya riypata nama vya pathliepa, i rehriehnepa hne i rieka piy ta a cuopa, Khazing rehrietuv i nuta Epafroditas hing niema'a luo i vya pathlie aa hu ta pata i rue.
Tahematapakieca niema bangkhuo kha aca vuosa yi, cakhutaata a pasana kaw kha nama thyi nakawta a palung pha the vyi.
A thiy'a nangna te ta a pasa hmisi. Cuorasala Khazing ta nangdue te, ama dyi cuo li pata kama hrahring zaw kha ngiechina suokha hnang suokha i taw li riypata nang ina due.
Caacuonakawta nama hmung pakhaa tiyta nama palung a nuo'a te, kama zaw i palungriethyina aa hy vie riypata ama kha i vya pathlie mala khingsa.
Ama kha alawna hne cuhluo tie ung. Ama haapa cawsaa kha pa-uvsathyi tie ung.
Tahematapakieca, Khrih re kawlie kha vuotaa a za thiy'a nang. Niema ta i cuota nama hrie khu li riypa re khana thiy zaw hring zaw ta pata a hrie.
A chuona ta ca, uvnu hne sieta zaw, Abyipa'a lie kha a law tie ung. I cape ciepa niema'a luo vya cape pakhaa riypa hing a ngiering va ang. Niema cuota namaa bangsuna ta zaw a cuo.
Uv tie kha a raaring tie ung, a pha lipa hmang a tuetuv tie kha a raaring tie ung, vangdaw a te riypa kaw a ri byalyapa tie kha a raaring tie ung.
Tahematapakieca, Thlaapa ta Khazing a biepa tie, Khrih Zingsuv kha a palesakhyipa tie hne saapa a buchuo lipa tie kiema hingna vangdaw a tepa ta a cuo puv.
Cuorasala, kama zaw hing saapa hmang a buchuona kaw ripa kieca, a buchuo riy a hnyipa paa tana i cuo. Pakhakha ta saapa hmang a buchuo riypa a hnyi kieca, kama na a hluv vie a hnyi ang.
Ning cari a ta pata vangdaw tepa, Israel cawsaa, Benjamin mingphang, Hebru nungpaa ta sapa Hebru aa thliepa; phungbie luota ripa kie Farasi;
Judah phung i daakhyi tuv nakawta khrihsaabuv hrisaatuv; phungbie thueta adangna luo zaw ta syisaa riy a aw lipa paa tana i cuo.
Cuorasala i cuota athungna ta i za ruepa hingpa hmang bangkhuo hing ata hing ca Khrih thueta asungna tana i rue diy tli.

Ca dyi ca cuo vyi, hmangting zawdya laata a sungnaa viepa i Byipaapa Khrih Zingsuv i pachangna thue hingta hmangting bangkhuo kha a sungkaruepa tana i rue. Caacuonakawta hmangting zawdya kha i thaw diy, Khrih i cu thena riypata ca khapa zaw kha ca hnehnaw haa tana i rue.
Phungbie taata a vawpa kama adangna kha cuo li pata, Khrih zangna thueta a vawpa adangna, Khazing'a taata a zuvpa zangna lie hruo a bangpa adangna khana ama hneta maa pazue thena riypata a cuo.
Ama thiyna lie thiy ra pata, a thupakhaana cahrana hne a te-angna a hraw pata Khrih pachang kha i khing.
Cahaacata kie dyina thiyna taata pathu pakhaapa i cuo aa.

Hingpa hmang hing i hmung tli tanapa cuo li pata, i tingna luo na i pha tli tanapa zaw cuo vyi. Cuorasala Khrih Zingsuv ta a huopa ta ina tue tli nakawta capa hmang ca i huopa a cuo khu riypata i ruo nguoluo.
I duepa zaw, capa hmang ca i huopa ta a cuo tli ta pata rue va ang; cuorasala i tuepa hmang suokha ca: hnangluo ta a awpa hmang kha maw angte hmieluo ta a awpa hmang kha pha i zue.
Khrih Zingsuv thueta vuoruo taata Khazing kuna lawmuo kha hmung riypata kawtung luo kha i ruo.
Kiema, ruena a ky tlipa tie ta ca cahaapa palungphya kha hnyi ung siy. Ruena phanghrang ta a hnyipa nama aw kieca Khazing ta capa zaw ca niema'a lie a paluo sa aa.
Ataning te ta ima ziypa phungluo hing ziy thluo ung siy.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, kama hringzya hing naa mangpuo tie ung. Kiema hrawlie nama hmungpa mangpuo tluo aa tlapa tie haata a hringpa tie kha a mangpuo tie ung.
Tahematapakieca, yi hluvpuv ica chang tlipa haa yi ta ata zaw hing mingthliy hneta ica chang pakhaa yi; cawsaa hluvpuv ca Khrih vieluo kha a cariepa tana ama hring.
Iema chuona ca rana ta cuo te, ama khazing ca ama riy ama vaw khata a cuo; ama rungnaana ca ama nangzaana khata cuo te, ama pathiypalung ca chuelyi hmang lie dyi khana ama chi.
Cuorasala kiema ca vuoruo ming cuo pate malie a khuotuv Abyipa Zingsuv Khrih vuoruo taata aa zuv riypa kha a ngietie vapuv.
Hmangting zawdya kha ama uvna raw luo a vya chi khupa a cahrana ta a thaadyapa ma pangpa kha a rungnaapa ama pangpa haa khata malie a thle aa.
Caacuonakawta, i duesapa hne i vuosapa, i palungtluona hne i byilakhuv ta a cuopa uvnu hne sieta zaw, cahaacata Abyipa chunglie kha a cusa pata a daa mya ung, i duepa zaw.
Euodia hne Sintikhe kha paa ica kie yi, Abyipa chunglie nama palung a palu tie ung.

Zang tluo aa tlapa i rehriehne, hingpa canung tie hing zaa bya thi yi la ta pata paa ica kie. Tahematapakieca, iema ca Klement hne, hringna caa-uv chunglie ming capepa a hrangpa i rehriehne tie hne khata thuophaa phuna re kha kama hne a hrie hnepa tana ama cuo.
Abyipa chunglie kha nama palung tluo pari se; i ri canyi aa, nama palung tluo se.
Nama nangnena kha cawsaa bangkhuo ta pachang yi se. Abyipa ca aa vaw patang aa.
Khaapa kawlie hmuo nama palung rie thyi khah se. Cuorasala, hmangting kawlie kha thlaachuona, ryiphaacyina hne palungtluona hluona ta nama khingpa kha Khazing ca pachang sa tie ung.
Caacuonakawta cawsaa pachangna ta a pha khu lipa Khazing thlaalungna ta nama pathiypalung hne nama ruena kha Khrih Zingsuv chunglie aa bangta tah a chi aa.

A hnangcaw ce ta, i duepa zaw, aa hmuopa, pathuosa tluo aa tlapa, aa dangpa, a pathepa, palungtluo aa chiypa, khing aa chiypa, a pha cepa hne pathuosa aa phuvpa suokhakha a aw kieca, capa kaw ca nama palung lie pari tie ung.
Kama'a taata namaa cuvpa, nama cuhluopa, nama thyipa hne nama hmungpa tie kha tue a zue tie ung. Diena Khazing ca niema'a lie aw mang sue.

Kaw ina pacuonapa ung ca kha cuo pasiypuv khutaata nama paluo sa pakhaa nakawta Abyipa'a lie khuopuv ta i palung a tluo. Hmisi ta kieca i cuo ina ruesa ung ciy, cuorasala paluosana cuo za hnyi va ung ciy.
I hubunapa kha i paluo sa khing pata cuo vyi; tahematapakieca i hnyi thathiypa lie palung tling pata aw kha i the tli.

Phahlavuosuo pata awpa hing khaapama a lu tapa pachang angte, a hlyikhung ta hnyipa hing khaapama a lu tapa i pachang. I riy a bi ning cuose, i nang a diy ning cuose, a hluvpuv i hnyi ning cuose, i phahla ning cuose, cuona a phangphang lie kha hringzya i the tli.
Thaa naa patlungtuv Khrih thueta hmangting bangkhuo kha i tue khu.
Tuokhaata a cuo zaw, i palung rie thyi ningta inaa bya nakaw ung cata icaa law yi.

Niema Filipi khy ming ta nama pachang thluo kha, thuophaa i za ri thaa ning, Masidonia ruo luo i si ning kha niema ta li pata khaapa khrihsaabuv tahmuo pihluona hne cuhluona re lieta kama hne a zaa hrawpa aw va yi.
Tahematapakieca Thesalonika khy lie i aw ning kha a bya i huna lieta yi kha laata a hluv vie inaa bya ung ciy.
Nama lasaw hmung i khingpa dyi cuo vyi, nama cazing lie amie a pahlaw chiy vie se tapa khana i khing.

I hupa laata a hluv vie tana ina pi ung ciy; ata lie Epafroditas'a taata i cuhluopa nama lasaw, rangpa-ue pihluona, cuhluo aa tlapa hriykhungrina hne Khazing palung a patluopa cunglie hing i palung a tling hringhruo.
Cakhutaata, i Khazing ta Khrih Zingsuv chunglie hne a rungnaana chunglie a hnyirungna ta nama phahlana lie kha nama palung ca patling yi se.
Ima Paa Khazing ca chuozaa ta pathuosa pata cuo mang sue. Amen.
Khrih Zingsuv chunglie mingpathepa mekaa kha nama kuv ica patuv yi. Kama hne a awpa i viesaa tie zaw ta nama kuv aca patuv yi.
Mingpathepa tie bangkhuo, a hlyi ta siepahruo ingchungkhue tie ta nama kuv aca patuv yi.
Abyipa Zingsuv Khrih vihnyina ca niema'a lie aw mang sue.
Khazing khingna thueta Khrih Zingsuv lucuotuv ta a cuopa kama Paul hne ma uvnupa Timote ta,

Kolose khy lie a awpa, mingpathepa tie hne zang tluo aa tlapa Khrih chunglie uvnu hne sieta zaw kha: Ma paa Khazing'a taata vihnyina hne thlaalungna ca nama cunglie aw mang sue ta pata bie icaa chang yi.
Niema cuota thlaa ma chuo kyry ta ma Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih a Paa Khazing ming kha ma pathuosa.
Tahematapakieca Khrih Zingsuv nama zangna hne mingpathepa tie bangkhuo nama duena kaw kha ma thyi tli.
Capa ca nama cuota vuoruo lie chi ciepa anguopuona, biehmisipa, thuophaa chunglie nama za thyi ciepa thue kha tana a cuo.
Capa thuophaa ca chuelyi khyzaa lie kha a thyi pathyi te a lethawpa haata niema'a lie zaw kha Khazing vihnyina hmisipa nama pachang ning taa khata thyi a pathyi ra tli.
Capa ca ma duepa, ma rehriehne changtaapa ta a cuopa Epafras taata nama thyi pata a cuo. Ama ca niema cuota zang tluo aa tlapa Khrih rehrietuv tana a cuo.
Ama ta Thlaapa ta aca pipa yi duena nama hnyina kaw kha malie a chang.

Caacuonakawta hingpa kaw ma thyi ning taata aa pathu pata niema ca thlaapa hne aa patuvpa singna hne pachangna hnyi pata Khazing khingna pachangna hne nama bi riypata ci li ta thlaa maca chuopa pari yi.

Cahaacata niema ca hmang pha tuena lie kha thyipaa pha hnyi'a ung cate, Khazing pachangna lie kha nama lethawpa haata, Khazing palung kha patluo'a ung cate, Abyipa hne aa phuvpa hringna kha nama hnyi aa.
Ama rungnaa cahrana taata a vawpa thaazuo bangkhuo khata niema kha ca cahra sa yi se, hmangting bangkhuo kha palungpasiyna hneta a ang khupa nama cuo riypata ca pacung ca pahlaa yi se.
Khena chunglie mingpathepa tie ru caa pahraw sa ra tuv yi ma Paa ca alawna hne pathuosa tie ung.
Zingna cahrana chung taa khata malie thue te a duepa a Sacapaa pena chung luo kha malie aa ngiekhyi.
Ama thueta a thlapa cuo pate sue a ngiethe pata ma cuo.
Khrih ca hmung khu lipa Khazing hminghmie ta cuo te sapa hmang bangkhuo hrawlie sa-uvthyi ta a cuo.

Tahematapakieca alyi hne avuo lie a awpa hmang bangkhuo hing ama thueta sapa cuo te, hmung khupa hne hmung khu lipa hmang bangkhuo, siepahruo uvna thude, uvpa ruo hne uvtuv tie, cahrana bangkhuo hne hmangting bangkhuo hing ama thueta hne ama huota sapa tana ama cuo.
Ama ca hmangting bangkhuo hluota za aw tli te, hmangting bangkhuo ca ama chunglie amaa saw pakhaw diy.

Ama ca a pangpa ta a cuopa khrihsaabuv a luv ta cuo te, a hruothuna, a thiypa tie chungtaata pathu pakhaapa sa-uvthyi ta a cuo. Cahaacata a cuopa ca hmangting bangkhuo hrawlie pakhana a cuo parina riypata a cuo.
Tahematapakieca ama chunglie Khazing cuona a tlingpa bangkhuo a aw riypa kha palung tluo pata cuo te,
vieluo lie thiyse thueta a tuepa diena hne ama thueta, Khazing ta alyi lie acuolikie vuoruo lie a awpa hmangting bangkhuo hne arena tue riypa kha a palung a tluo.
Niema ca a hluota ca Khazing hne zaa hlapa, aduna pathiypalung zaa hnyipa hne hmang pha lipa zaa tuepa tana nama cuo.
Cuorasala, ata hing ca Khrih a saapa pangpa thiyna ta niema kha caa re yi te, a pathepa, syisaa riy a aw lipa hne suena hnyi li pata Khazing hmieluo chiykhyi acaa ting yi.

Namaa daana hmang ciepa, nama zangna lie kha a cusa pata a daa tie ung. Nama thyi ciepa thuophaa thueta namaa nguopuopa biekuona taa khata a palaw khah ung. Capa ca avuo rawlie sapa bangkhuo'a luo phupa thuophaa ta cuo te, kama Paul hing capa thuophaa sii ca tana i cuo.
Niema cuota i te-angna kawlie hingta i palung a tluo. Tahematapakieca i saapa te-angna hingta Khrih ta a pangpa ta a cuopa khrihsaabuv cuota a te-angna kha i patling sa ra pata a cuo.
Khazing bie kha tluotlingsa pata nama pachangna riypata, kama ca, Khazing ta niema cuo khata khrihsaabuv changtaapa ta ina tue tli.
Capa bie ca chuo bangkhuo lieta za nupa bieparuv cuo te, cuorasala ata hing ca a mingpathepa tie'a luo kha phu pata a cuo.

Capa mingpathepa tie ca, nupa bieparuv rungnaana hne hnyirungna ca Jentail ming hrawlie kha tluv tama a le tapa kha pachang sa riypata Khazing ta aa tlawpa tana ama cuo. Capa bieparuv ca a rungnaapa, namaa nguopuona ta a cuopa, nama chunglie a awpa Khrih kha tana a cuo.

Cawsaa bangkhuo kha Khrih chunglie a tlingpa hringna hneta Khazing hmieluo ma chiykhyi khuna riypata Khrih kaw ca phu pate singna ma hnyipa bangkhuo hmuo pata cawsaa bangkhuo kha a raaringna pi yi pate ma pacuv yi.
Hingpa hmang a cuo khuna riypa hingta ama ta ina pipa i chunglie a awpa cahrana hmuo pata khuopuv ta a zue angte i hrie.
Niema cuota cuose, Laodisia lie a awpa tie cuota cuose, i pangpa ta naa hmung lipa bangkhuo cuota kha tluv tama i zue law tapa kha ica pachang sa khing yi.

Kama i tingpa ca iema ta Khazing bieparuv Zingsuv kha ama pachang khu the riypa hne pachangna hmisi taata a pyapa hnaanguona kha hnyi yi sala pathiypalung cahra sapa hne duena lieta pang kha ama cuo riypa kha tana a cuo.
Khrih ca Khazing singna hne pachangna a sungnaapa suethiy aa nunapa tana a cuo.
Ahungtahmuo niema kha biephapa a lu raalaa pata aa hmuo lipa bie a ina ta ca dung khah yi se.
I pangpa ta niema'a lie i aw li raalaa pata thlaapa ta niema'a lie i aw. Palung cahrasa pata hne Khrih zangna chunglie a cusa pata namaa daapa kha hmung angte i palung a tluo.
Caacuonakawta Abyipa Khrih Zingsuv kha nama za cuhluopa haata ama chunglie kha hring patlung tie ung.
Ama chunglie kha zangna ta hruo bang pata a sathaw tie ung. Aca za pacuv tlipa haa yi khata alawna bie kha hluo pari tie ung.
Khrih'a taata cuo li pata, cawsaapa phungluo hne hing chuelyi phung taata a cuopa, muo a hnyi lipa ruena hmuo pata a ahungtahmuo sii ta ca tue khah yi se.
Tahematapakieca, Khazing cuona bangkhuo ca saapa hminghmie ta Khrih chunglie aw te,
niema zaw uvtuv bangkhuo hne nawhnyina bangkhuo luv ta a cuopa Khrih'a lie kha hringna tluotling nama hnyi.
Ama chunglie ngiethie ca thlaapa ta vangdaw a te ung cate saapa ta vangdawtena kha nama thaw.
Niema ca Khrih chunglie kha tiynawna ta pabypa nama cuo. Cahaacata Khrih kha thiyna taata a pathu pakhaapa Khazing cahrana ta zangna thueta Khrih hneta pathu pakhaapa nama cuo aa.
Cakhutaata niema ca nama suena hne saapa ta vangdaw namaa te lina chunglieta a thiypa nama za cuo ning kha Khazing ta nama suena bangkhuo kha caa ngiethe yi te ama hne aca pahring yi.
Ma suenapa cazing ca a duotena phung bangkhuo hne khata vieluo cunglie khepuo te a hruv diy.
Ama ta uvtuv tie hne nawhnyina zaw kha vieluotaana ta te yi te cawsaazaapuv a mangpuo riypata a tue yi.
Caacuonakawta sa hne tiy kawlie cuose, biena luo pyi, thlathaa pyi hne sabbath kawlie cuose, ahungtahmuo niema kha sue ca be khah yi se.
Hingpa zaw hing ca a vaw riypa hmang a mingthlaapa ta cuo te, a hmisipa ca Khrih tana a cuo.

Kiema hne kiema aa hmuo li pata a panena kaw hne avuoming abiena kaw khuopuv ta a daakhyi te a ripa, muocuo a hmung nakawta cawsaa hrangpa laata i suo vie ta pata a rue te saapa ruena ta a palepa tie khata aa phahla pata ca hmung khah yi se.

Iema ca luv ta a cuopa Khrih hne khata a pazue va yi. Luv ta a cuopa Khrih'a taa khata pangpa ca sa kha hmung te, cakhiycabuo hne thariytha-uo zaw khata ama cakhiy. Cahaacata Khazing khingna haa khata ama lethaw.
Niema ca Khrih hneta hing chuelyi phung taa hingta nama thiy tli kieca khaapanakawma hing chuelyi ming haata nama hring?
Khaapanakawma, “Hrie khah, a pacuo khah, de khah” tapa phung ca nama ziy?
Hingpa phung bangkhuo hing ca cawsaa ta changpa hne pacuvpa dyi ta cuo te a ziypa tie hne tana ama thiy hne aa.
Hingpa phung hing biena luota a pa-ypa cuo a zuena, a panena hne, khuopuv ta pangpa a hrisaana cuota singna phung a lu raalaa pata saapa khingna te khu tangena riypata ca a thlahnenapa aw vyi.
Caacuonakawta, Khrih hne pathu pakhaapa nama cuo kieca, Khazing cacuoluo kuo ta a tupa Khrih a awnapa cungluo hmang kha huv tie ung.
Nama pathiypalung kha cungluo hmang lie chi ung la, chuelyi hmang lie chi khah ung.
Tahematapakieca niema ca thiy tli ung cate nama hringna ca Khrih hneta Khazing chunglie nupa tana nama cuo.
Nama hringna ta a cuopa Khrih kha aa luo thueta niema zaw ama hneta rungnaana hne namaa luo ra aa.

Caacuonakawta nama chunglie a awpa chuelyi hmang: aparuvsuena, a pyalyipa hringna, khingna cahratuvna, a pha lipa khingna, hne karuo-awna (karuo-awna ca kuvtuezuv abiena phang kha tana a cuo) bangkhuo kha thie tie ung.
Capa zaw kawlie ca tana Khazing hihaana ca ri a ngie lipa tie cunglie a tlung aa.
Hingpa zaw hing iema hrawlie nama za aw ningta niema zaw nama za ziypa hringzya tana a cuo.
Cuorasala ata hing ca hihaana, pathiy chiena tapa tie kha thaw ung la, malie kaw rina, malie thuopachina tapa tie kha nama pakaa taata pya khah se.
Pakha hne pakha kha a dung khah ung. Nama cawsaa cuona hlungpa ca a zyazaa hne khata thlie siy tli ung cate,
hringna thaapa kha namaa hryi tli. Capa hringna thaapa ca a satuv hminghmie a lu riypata pachangna chunglie kha sapathiypa ta a cuo.

Ca sapathiyna chunglie ca, Grik ming hne Judah ming tapa cuose, vangdaw tepa hne vangdaw te lipa tapa cuose, a ngaapa, saruopa haata a ngaapa phang, sii hne hyazangpa tapa aw vyi; cuorasala Khrih ca hmangting zawdya ta cuo te hmangting zawdya chunglie kha a aw.
Khazing ta caa tlaw yi te, a pathesapa hne a duepa nama cuopa haata, kawpacuona, ngiechina, rawcanawna, palungnena, hne palungpasiyna kha hnyi tie ung.

Pakha hne pakha kha a chaw law ung la, pakhakha ta a hrangpa pakha cunglie kha palung tling lina a hnyi kie zawma a ngiethe tie ung. Abyipa ta niema acaa ngiethepa haa yi khata niema zaw pakha hne pakha kha a ngiethe tie ung.
Ca bangkhuo khutaa cata duena kha chachiy tie ung. Duena ca hmangting zawdya kha aa chaw aa rawsa pata hne tluotlingsa pata a saw pakhawpa tana a cuo.
Nama pathiypalung kha Khrih diena ta ca uv yi se. Hmisi ta ripa kieca capa luo cana pang kha cuo riypata kupa nama cuo. Nama palung tluo se.

Khrih bie ca nama chunglie kha aw sala, singna ta pakha hne pakha kha a pacuv ung la a pasiy a pa-ya tie ung. Sam hlaa, Khazing pathuosana hlaa hne thlaapa luo hlaa zaw kha palungtluona hneta Khazing'a luo sa tie ung.
Khaapa bie nama ri zaw, khaapa hmang nama tue zaw, Abyipa Zingsuv ming ta ri ung la tue tie ung. Paa Khazing ca ama thue khata pathuosa tie ung.
Napuvnung zaw, nama navaapa ri kha a ngie tie ung; capa ca a Abyipa'a lie nama tue riypa tana a cuo.
Navaapa zaw, nama napuvnung kha due ung la bie aa hruopa ta chaw khah ung.
Haatiy zaw hmangting zawdya lieta nama nung hne nama paa ri kha a ngie tie ung, tahematapakieca capa ca Abyipa'a lieta cuhluo aa tlapa nama hrievu tana a cuo.
Paa zaw, nama saata kha ama hi pahaa khah ung, ama palung na a ra pathlyi aa.
Sii zaw, nama chuelyi ziy tie kha aca hmungna lie dyi yi iema palung patluo riypa cuo li pata pathiypalung hmisi hne Khazing ciyzaana cangta hmangting zawdya lie kha ama ri a ngie tie ung.
Khaapa re a cuo zaw, nama ziy tie huona ma hrie ta li pata Abyipa huona ma hrie ta pata palung hmisi ta hrie tie ung.
Abyipa'a taata nama cu riypa ru khana nama lawmuo ta a cuo aa tapa kha nama pachang. Abyipa Zingsuv re a hriepa tana nama cuo.
Tahematapakieca hmang pha lipa a tuepa ca a tuepa hmang pha lipa cuota duotena kha a ang aa. Abyipa'a lie ca pahlyipalena aw vyi.
Ziy tie zaw, nama sii tie kha aa dangpa hne a phapa ta mangsang tie ung, tahematapakieca niema zaw vuoruo lie ziy nama hnyi rapa kha nama pachang.
Thlaachuo kha temaa ung la, pathiypalung a hy syalya khata palungtluona bie hluona cangta pazue pari tie ung.
Khazing ta thaw i tla hnuochuopa a bie cuota cuose, ma phu riypa Khrih bieparuv cuota cuose, ingchiy malie a pahawpa riypa hne
i phu riypa zaa ta a siesa pata i phu khuna riypata kiema cuo zaw kha thlaachuo tie ung.
Zangtuv a cuo lipa hrawlie kha singvaasa pata a tu a daa ung la, cuo pha nama hnyipa kha muo hnyisa pata hmuo tie ung.
Nama bie ca naathlie aa nuopa hne a thlung-iepa cuo sala cawsaa bangkhuo kha tuokhaata i chaw kie yi ma a pha aa tapa kha a zue tie ung.
Taikhikas ta i kaw bangkhuo kha aca chang'a yi; ama ca Khrih chunglie i duepa uvnu, zang tluo aa tlapa Khazing rehrietuv, hne i rehriehnepa tana a cuo.
Tuokhaatama ma aw tapa kha pachangsa riypa hne niema thaazuo pi riypa tingna cangta i vya pathliepa tana a cuo.
Ama ca zang tluo aa tlapa hne i duepa uvnu, niema chunglie pakha ta a cuopa Onesimas hne tana aa vaw aa. Hingpa lie a chiy a cuopa hmang bangkhuo kha aca chang'a yi.
Thaw i tlahnepa Aristarkas ta nama kuv aca patuv yi; Barnabas tuvpaapa Marka zaw ta nama kuv aca patuv yi. Ama kaw kha ica chang tli yi. Niema'a luo aa vaw kieca za cuhluo mya ung.
Justas ama tapa paa Zingsuv zaw ta nama kuv aca patuv yi. Iema dyi hing Khazing pena cuota i rehriehne zaw hrawlie vangdaw a tepa tie cuo yi te, i hnaa naa panguotuv ta ama cuo.

Niema chungtaata pakha ta a cuopa Epafras, Khrih Zingsuv sii a cuopa ta nama kuv aca patuv yi. Niema kha ruena a kysa pata hne Khazing khingna bangkhuo kha a tlingsa pata nama pachang riypata nama cuota thlaa a chuo pari.
Ama ta niema cuota hne Laodisia lie a awpa tie cuota hne Hierapolis lie a awpa tie cuota khuopuv ta re a hriepa kha kama ta tehte i khuo khu.
Ma duepa siyybyi Luka hne Demas ta nama kuv aca patuv yi.
Laodisia lie a awpa uvnu hne sieta zaw cuose, Nimfa hne a ing lie a pungpa khrihsaabuv tie cuose bie i vya changpa yi kha na changpa pachaa tie ung.
Hingpa caa hing niema'a lie nama ri khutaata, Laodisia khrihsaabuv lie zaw kha ri ra yi se; Laodisia taata aca vya paphyapa yi caa zaw kha ri tie ung.
Cakhutaata Arkhipas kha, “Abyipa ming ta naa lapa re kha palang mya,” ta pata za chang tie ung.
Kama Paul na hingpa bie-achangna caa hing i kuv ta a cape ang. I thaabuoliriy hing maw khah ung. Khazing vihnyina nama cunglie aw mang sue.

Paul, Silas hne Timote ta, ma Paa Khazing hne Abyipa Zingsuv Khrih huopa ta a cuopa, Thesalonika khy lie a awpa khrihsaabuv kha: Vihnyina hne thlaalungna ca nama cunglie aw mang sue, ta pata bie maacaa chang yi.
Niema bangkhuo kawlieta Khazing kha ci li pata pathuosa pate thlaa maca chuopa pari yi.
Zangna ta nama hriepa re, duena ta nama hriepa re hne ima Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih'a lie a cusa pata namaa nguopuona zaw kha maa thyi pari.
Tahematapakieca Khazing ta a duepa uvnu hne sieta zaw, ama ta acaa tlawpa yi kha ma pachang.

Tahematapakieca, niema'a luo thuophaa ma vya chiykhyipa hing bie dyi ta cuo li pata cahrana hne Thlaapa Pathe hne biehmisipa a cuopa kha pachangpasiena hneta a cuo. Nama hrawlie ma aw ning kha niema cuota tuokhaapa cawsaa tama macuo tapa kha malie nama pachang.
Kiema hne Abyipa kha malie a mangpuo ung cate hrisaana chunglie a cuo raalaa pata thuophaa kha Thlaapa Pathe ta aca pipa yi alawna hneta nama cuhluo.
Caacuonakawta niema ca Masidonia hne Akhaia lie a awpa zangtuv tie cuota a mangpuo tluo aa tlapa ta nama cuo.

Tahematapakieca, niema'a taata a vya paring pa Abyipa bie ca Masidonia ruo hne Akhaia ruo luo dyi kha cuo li pata ruo ting khata a ze te, Khazing nama zangnapa ca ama pachang nakawta capa kaw ca kiema ri hmuo a hu va tli.

Tahematapakieca ama pe lie a awpa tie khata niema hrawlie ma aw ningta tuokhaatama malie nama cuhluo tapa kaw hne kuvtuezuv abiena taata Khazing'a luo namaa vya palina kaw hne a hringpa hne a hmisipa Khazing re nama hriena kaw cuose,
thiyna taata pathu pakhaapa hne a vaw riypa Khazing hihaana taata malie a khuotuv a Sacapaa Zingsuv vuoruo taata aa vaw riypa zaw nama huona kaw kha malie ama chang.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, niema'a luo maa vawpa ca a cakhawpa ta cuo vyi tapa kha nama pachang.
Cuorasala Filipi lie kha nangzaasa pata hrisaana ma ang raalaa pata, nama pachangna haata, aduna lepuv a awna cangta Khazing'a taata thaazuo kha hmung pate, niema kha Khazing thuophaa maca chang yi.
Tahematapakieca maca changpa lie yi hing aa dang lipa acuolikie atingna pha lipa hne dungna aw vyi.
Cuorasala Khazing ta thuophaa ri riypa hingta aa phuvpa ta malie a chipa haata cawsaa palung patluo riypa kha cuo li pata ma pathiypalung malie a hmungpa Khazing palung patluo riypa kha tana ma ri.
Nama pachangpa haata hne Khazing ca malie a daakhyituv a cuopa haata, niema'a luo kha patapaluona bie hne a vaw buo lipa pata, karuo-awna hne a tue pakhi pata zaw a vaw buo vapuv.
Khrih lucuotuv ma cuopa haata caa hie khutuv ma cuo raalaa pata, niema'a taata cuose, a hrangpa tie'a taata cuose, cawsaa pathuosa riypa kha ma huvpa cuo vyi.
Cuorasala nung ta a saata kha a nesa pata a mangchiypa haata niema hrawlie kha a nesa pata ma aw.
Cahaacata niema kha maca due hringhruo nakaw yi ta Khazing thuophaa dyi kha cuo li pata ma hringna kha hmuo maca pi khing yi. Ma due hringhruopa tana nama cuo tli.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, riethyi thaabuosa pata re ma hriepa kha malie nama pachang. Khazing thuophaa niema'a lie ma phu tiyta, nama cuota hmangriy ma cuo li riypata chung hne zuo ta li pata re ma hrie.
Zangtuv a cuopa niema cunglieta ma tuepa ca a pathepa, aa hmuopa hne syi riy a aw lipa a cuopa kha niema ca tehte cuo ung cate, Khazing zaw a cuo ra.
Nama pachangna haata, Paa ta a saata zaw a hmungpa haa yi tana maca hmung yi.
Niema kha a pena hne a rungnaana luo caa kupa yi Khazing hne aa phuv pata nama hring riypata thaazuo ca pi yi pate maca pasu yi, paa maca kie yi.

Kiema'a taata nama thyipa Khazing bie kha nama cuhluo tiyta, cawsaapa bie haata nama cuhluopa cuo li pata, niema zangtuv tie chunglie re a hriepa, Khazing bie kha a cuona haata nama cuhluo nakawta kiema zaw Khazing'a luo ci li pata alawna ma hluo.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, Judea ruo chunglie a awpa Khazing khrihsaabuv hne Khrih Zingsuv cawsaa zaw ta Judah ming'a taata ama ang tawpa khana niema zaw nama cawsaa tie'a taata nama ang ra pata a cuo.
Judah ming ca Abyipa Zingsuv hne profet tie kha thie yi te kiema zaw malie a cadepa tie tana ama cuo. Khazing kha a ngie pachi yi te cawsaa bangkhuo kha amaa du.

Khuona ama hmung riypata Jentail ming thuophaa chang riypa kha hmuo malie amaa daakhuo. Cahaacata iema ca ama suena kha ama chachiy hryly. Cuorasala a chuona lie ca Khazing hihaana ca iema cungluo kha a tlung.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, pathiypalung ta cuo li pata saapa lie cuo khata maa che chungta lie hing hmuo ca vuo hringhruo yi pate nama hmie maca hmung khingsa yi.
Niema'a luo vya tlaw pakhaa riypa kha khing pate, kama Paul zaw hing niema vya tlaw riypa kha yi hluvpuv i zue raalaa pata Setaa ta luo malie a khaakhuo.
Ma Byipaapa Zingsuv aa vaw thueta khaapa hing ma a hmiekunglie maa nguopuona, ma palungtluona, hne maa palesakhyipa byilakhuv ta a cuo aa? Niema ta cuo'a va ung ca ma?
A cuo, niema hing na ma rungnaana hne ma palungtluona ta a cuo ung ciy.
A chuona lie ca ma aw khu li tli nakawta kiema dyi Athens khy lie kha a ngaa pata,
a uvnu hne Khrih thuophaa phuna kawlie Khazing re ma hrie hnepa Timote kha nama zangna lie a cusa pata namaa daa khuna riypa hne niema thaazuo pi riypata cuose,
hing hrisaana kawlie hingta pakha hmuo namaa cahang li riypata niema'a luo ma vya pathlie. Hmisi ta ripa kieca hingpa hmang ang riypa hingta a tlawpa ma cuopa kha niema hrahring ta nama pachang.
Niema'a lie ma aw ning kha hrisaana ang riypa hing maca chang paciepa yi ta cuo te, ata hing nama pachangna haata a vya tlung hmisi.

Capa kawlie ca ta i aw khu li tli nakawta nama zangna hing khaapama a lu tapa pachang riypa hne pasupaliytuv hingta ca pasu ca paliy'a yi te ma re hrie ciepa kha a hripa ta cuo'a kie ta pata Timote kha i vya pathlie pata a cuo.

Cuorasala Timote ca a ru hluota lie kha niema'a taata vya chiy te nama zangna hne duena kaw thuohlaa phapa kha malie a vya phya. Kiema ta maca vuosapa haa yi ta duena hne malie namaa thyi paripa kha malie a chang.
Caacuonakawta uvnu hne sieta zaw, ma ngiechi ning hne hrisaana ma ang ning kha nama zangna kaw ma thyipa khata thaazuo malie a pi.
Abyipa'a lie a cusa pata namaa daapa kaw ma thyipa ca, ma cuota, ma hringna huv tana a cuo.
Niema kawlieta Khazing hmiekunglie ma hnyipa ma palungtluona kawlie hingta Khazing kha tuokhaatama maa law aa?
Niema hne hmie a hmung pata, zangna lie namaa bupa kha a bya khu riypata chung zuo ta li pata pathiypalung hmisi ta thlaa ma chuo.
Ma Paa Khazing ama hrahring hne ma Byipaapa Zingsuv ta niema'a luo maa vawna riypa kha luo malie a chiy thi se.
Kiema ta niema maca duena yi a lepa haa hingta, niema pakha hne pakha namaa duena hne cawsaa bangkhuo nama duena kha Abyipa ta pale sa ra mang sue.
Ima Byipaapa Zingsuv ca a mingpathepa tie hne aa vaw thueta, nama pathiypalung thaa kha ca patlung yi sala, ima Paa Khazing hmielie syisaapa nama cuo li riypata ca pathe sa yi se.

Uvnu hne sieta zaw, a chuona lieta i ri khingpa ca tuokhaata aw'a pate ma Khazing palung ma patluo aa tapa kha namaa cuv ciepa a cuopa haata namaa zue vie hryly riypata, Abyipa Zingsuv ming ta maca pasu yi.
Tahematapakieca Zingsuv ming ta tuokhaatama maca pacuv yi tapa kha nama pachang.
Khazing khingna ca niema pathe sa riypa kha a cuo nakawta aparuvsuena kha cahriy tie ung.
A pathepa hne pa-uvsathyi aa tlapa luopuv chunglieta nama pangpa kha tuokhaatama ma uv aa tapa ca nama pachang.
Khazing a pachang lipa Jentail ming haata saapa khingna lie kha hring khah ung.

Pathiypalung hmisi ta a raaringna maca za pilupa haa yi ta hne maca za changpa haa yi ta, Khazing ca vieriy a thungpa a cuo nakawta, hingpa kawlie hing ahungtahmuo a uvnu hne a sieta kha dungvie khah se.
Tahematapakieca Khazing ca a pyalyipa luo cuo li pata pathena luo na malie a ku.
Caacuonakawta hingpa pacuvna hing a thawpa ca cawsaa nawhnyina kha a thawpa cuo li pata niema'a luo Thlaapa Pathe caa pipa yi Khazing kha a thawpa tana a cuo.
Nama uvnu hne sieta zaw duena kawlieta ahungtahmuo niema'a luo caa cape a hu vyi, tahematapakieca niema pakha hne pakha a due riypata Khazing pacuv ciepa tana nama cuo.
Cahaacata Masidonia lie a awpa uvnu hne sieta zaw kha nama due hmisi. Cuorasala, duepa zaw, cahaacata tue riypa kha a zue hryly ung la ta pata maca pasu yi.
Maca pasupa haa yi khata a dieta tah khysa kha a ting ung la, niema nama reta kha hrie ung la, niema kuvta khata nama riy a caw tie ung.
Cahaacata zanglituv tie pa-uvsathyina hne mangthawna kha hmung'a ung cate ahunghmuo a buchuo a hu li pata nama aw aa.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, anguopuona a hnyi lipa tie ngiechipa haata nama ngie a chi li riypata a thiypa tie kaw hne aa patuvpa kha pachang sa li pata ca aw khing va yi puv.
Zingsuv ca thiy te a thu pakhaa tapa ma zang; caacuonakawta Zingsuv zang te a thiypa ca ama hneta Khazing ta a pathu pakhaa'a yi ta pata ma zang.
Capa kawlie ca ta Abyipa bie ta a siesa pata maca changpa yi ca, Abyipa aa vawna te ta a hring kaliepa kiema ta a thiypa tie kha hmiechue khu'a va yi puv ta pata a cuo.

Tahematapakieca Abyipa ama hrahring kha nawpina ueryi, avuoming uvtuv ueryi hne Khazing hmyakaa ueryi zaw hne khata vuoruo taata za cung'a te, Zingsuv zangna cangta a thiypa tie kha hmietaa ce ta ama thu pakhaa aa.
Cakhutaa cata avuo lieta Abyipa a taw riypata kiema a hring kaliepa tie kha iema zaw hne cata amyi cungluo khiy calang pata cuo'a pate, Abyipa hne chuozaa ta ma aw aa.
Caacuonakawta hingpa bie hingta pakha hne pakha kha thaazuo a pi tie ung.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, a ning'a na a cuo hne aa patuv pata niema'a luo caa cape a hu vyi.
Tahematapakieca Abyipa ning ca zuo ta aparuvpa haa tana aa vaw aa tapa kha a phasa pata nama pachang.
Cawsaa ta, “Diena hne a bang a suna a aw,” ama ta ning kha nu a phyapa canung ta nupazina a angpa haata ama cunglie rana sungkha ta vya tlung'a te, ahunghmuo law'a va yi.
Cuorasala duepa zaw niema ca zingna chunglie nama aw li nakawta capa ningkhue cata aparuvpa haata nama nang capa uo'a va yi.
Tahematapakieca niema ca khena saata hne ningchung saata tah cuo ung cate kiema zaw zingna, zuo saata tah cuo vapuv.
Caacuonakawta kiema ca malie zaw amaa hmungpa haa khata a hmung li pata, a hra ung sala palungsingta tah aw ung siy.
Tahematapakieca a hmungpa ca zuo ta a hmung te, a pariypa zaw zuo tana a pariy.

Cuorasala kiema ca ningchung saata tah ma cuo nakawta palung singta tah aw ung sala, zangna hne duena kha cacunghnaapakaw haa khata a hryi ung sala, khuona anguopuona kha thaalakhuv haata a khuv ung siy.
Tahematapakieca Khazing ta kiema kha a hihaana ang riypata malie a tingpa cuo li pata, ima Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih thueta khuona cu riypata lieriy uopuopa tana ma cuo.
Kiema ca maa hra zaw maa hmung zaw ama hne aw pakhaw riypata malie a thiykuopa tana ma cuo.
Caacuonakawta ata nama tue nguoluopa haa hingta pakha hne pakha kha thaazuo a pi ung la a sathaw tie ung.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, paa na maca kie yi: niema hrawlie rehrietuv tie hne Abyipa'a lie niema luochiytuv tie hne caa pasiy caa pa-yatuv tie kha pa-uvsathyi tie ung.
Ama hriepa re thue khata hmiezaana aa suo cepa pi ung la due tie ung. Nama hrawlie diena aw mang sue.

Duepa zaw, a thaathuvpa tie kha pasiypa-ya ung la, a palung cawpa tie kha thaazuo pi tie ung. A thaadyapa tie kha thaazuo pi ung la ama bangkhuo cunglie kha nama palung pasiy se ta pata paa maca kie yi.
Pakha hmuo a chiepa ta vieriy namaa thung li riypa hne pakha hne pakha cunglie hne cawsaa bangkhuo cunglie hmang phapa nama tue khu pari riypa kha a zue tie ung.
Nama palung tluo pari se,
ci li ta thlaachuo ung la,
khaapa hmang namaa taw zaw ta alawna bie hluo tie ung; tahematapakieca Khazing ta Khrih Zingsuv chunglie hing haa hingta hring yi se ta pata acaa khingkhyipa yi tana a cuo.
Thlaapa kha pache khah ung.
Profet tie bie kha siysaa ri li pata aw khah ung.
Cuorasala hmangting kha dyapasya ung la, a phapa kha a patuv ung la
a pha lipa mekaa kha cahriy tie ung.

Thlaalungna Khazing ama hrahring ta ca pathe sa karuv yi sala, ima Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih aa vaw thueta, nama thlaapa, nama pathiypalung hne nama pangpa kha syi riy a aw lipa hne tluotlingsa pata ca sang yi se.
Niema caa kupa paa ca zang tluo aa tlapa a cuo nakawta capa ca a tue aa.
Duepa zaw, thlaa malie chuopa tie ung.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw bangkhuo kha a pathepa a pahnuona ta bie a chang tie ung.
Hingpa caa hing iema bangkhuo hmielie ri riypata Abyipa ming ta naw ica pi yi.
Ima Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih vihnyina ca niema'a lie aw mang sue.
Paul, Silas hne Timote ta, ma Paa Khazing hne ma Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih chunglie a awpa Thesalonika khrihsaabuv kha:
Ma Paa Khazing hne Abyipa Zingsuv Khrih ta vihnyina hne thlaalungna ca pi mang yi sue, ta pata bie maacaa chang yi.

Uvnu hne sieta zaw, kiema ca niema kawlie hing Khazing kha maa law pari riypa tana a cuo. Tahematapakieca nama zangna kha lethaw te cawsaa bangkhuo ta pakha hne pakha namaa duena zaw a lethaw nguoluo nakawta cahaacata Khazing maa lawpa ca aa hmuopa tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta hrisaana chunglie nama angpa riethyina cangta zangna chunglie a cusa pata namaa daa nakawta Khazing khrihsaabuv tie hrawlie kha kiema hrahring ta maacaa palesakhyi yi.

Hingpa hingna aa dangpa Khazing biechina paluosana ta a cuo. Niema zaw Khazing pena cuota riethyina a ang rapa nama cuo nakawta capa Khazing pena hne aa phuv aa siypa pacuo sa riypata tingpa nama cuo.
Tahematapakieca Khazing ta niema riethyi caa pipa tie kha riethyina pi ra'a yi te,
riethyina a angpa niema kha a pahyna ca pi'a yi te kiema zaw malie a pi ra aa. Abyipa Zingsuv kha a lesyipa aa vuoming hne myipalyi chunglie amaa zaa luo tiyta,
Khazing a pachang lipa hne ma Byipaapa Zingsuv thuophaa a ziy lipa tie kha vieriy thung'a yi te riethyi a pi'a yi.
Iema ca chuozaa ranapa duotena kha ama ang aa. Abyipa hmiekung taa khata a cade'a yi te, a rungnaapa a cahrana kha hmung'a va yi.

Abyipa ca a mingpathepa tie ta parungnaa sa riypata hne zangtuv tie bangkhuo pathuosa riypata aa vaw thueta capa ning lie ca niema zaw a pathuosapa tie hrawlie ca nama aw ra aa, tahematapakieca niema ca maca changpa yi thuophaa nama zang nakawta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Khazing ta aca una yi hne aa phuvpa ta ca chi yi sala, nama biechina hne zangna ta nama hriepa re bangkhuo lie kha a cahrana ta tluotlingna aca pi riypa yi ta thlaa maca chuopa pari yi.
