Cahaacata, ima Byipaapa Zingsuv ming ca niema hrawlie kha rungnaana hmung'a te, ma Khazing hne Abyipa Zingsuv Khrih vihnyina thueta niema zaw ama'a taata rungnaana kha nama hmung ra aa.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, ma Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih aa vawna riypa kaw hne pahmya pakhawpa ma cuo riypa kawlieta maacaa nue khingpa yi ca,
pathiypalung ta cuose, bie ta cuose, caa ta cuose, kiema'a taata aa vawpa haata Abyipa ning ca a vya chiy tli, ama tapa kawlieta pathiypalung a cahang pata namaa pahlu li riypa hingta a cuo.
Ahungtahmuo ca dung khah yi se; tahematapakieca capa ning ca biena luo aduna aa vaw taa lipa'a nata para riypata lieriy uopuopa cawsaa pha lipa paa aa vya luo hluota ca vya tlung'a vyi.

Cawsaa ta khazing ta pata ama ruepa bangkhuo hne amaa biepa bangkhuo kha a du'a te, capa zaw cungluo ca ta aa chi aa. Cahaacata a thude kha Khazing biena-ing chunglie patu'a te, ama hne ama kha Khazing tana i cuo aa ta aa.
Niema'a lie i aw ningta ica za changpa yi kha a thyi va ung ca ma?
A cuo aa de thueta aa luo riypata a daakhuotuv a awpa kha nama pachang.
Tahematapakieca cawsaa pha lipa paa ca a paruvta tah re a hrie nguoluo tli, cuorasala a daakhuopa kha phe pata a cuo hluo li ca tuokhaata hmuo a luo the'a valie.
Cakhutaa cata cawsaa pha lipa paa ca a vya luo'a te, Abyipa Zingsuv ta a pakaa taata a pyapa a huv ta ama kha thie'a te, aa vawna huvhaa ta ama kha a para aa.
Cawsaa pha lipa paa ca Setaa hmang tuepa taa khata a vya luo'a te, cahrana phangting, kharuehaa hmang phangting hne,
rana luo a chiy riypa tie cuota a pha lipa dungna phangting hmuo pata aa vaw aa, tahematapakieca khuona ama hmung the riypata biehmisipa kha khing li pata ama thaw.
Caacuonakawta a cuo lipa kha ama zangna riypata Khazing ta a ruvsapa dungna kha a pathliesue yi.
Cahaacata biehmisipa zang li pata aa dang lipa hmang lie a palung a tluopa bangkhuo ca sue be pata ama cuo aa.

Khazing ta a duepa uvnu hne sieta zaw, niema kawlie hingta Khazing ca alawna bie ma hluo pari aa. Tahematapakieca Thlaapa ta pathesana thueta hne biehmisipa zangna thueta Khazing ta caa tlaw yi te khuona cuota thyipaa taapa ta aca tue yi.
Hingpa a tingna hne hingta, ma Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih rungnaana nama hmung the riypata kiema ma phupa thuophaa ta aca ku yi.
Cakhutaata, uvnu hne sieta zaw, a cusa pata a daa ung la bie ta cuose, caa ta cuose, maca changpa yi ziyphung kha a patuv tie ung.
Kiema kha malie due te, a vihnyina thueta hnaanguona hne anguopuona malie a pipa ma Paa Khazing hne ma Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih ama hrahring ta,
nama palung hnaa ca panguo yi sala re phapa hne bie phapa bangkhuo lie kha thaazuo ca pi yi se.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, a chuona ta ica taa khingpa yi ca, Abyipa bie niema'a lie aa zepa haa khata a catli pata a ze te, rungnaana a hmung riypata thlaa malie chuopa tie ung.
Cawsaa bangkhuo ta zangna ama hnyi li nakawta cawsaa pha lipa tie hne cawsaa suepa tie kuv taata khuopa ma cuo riypata thlaa malie chuopa tie ung.
Cuorasala Abyipa ca zang tluo aa tlapa a cuo nakawta a pha lipa paa kuv chungtaata aca khuo'a yi.
Kiema ta maca changpa yi kha tue nguoluo ung cate hmieluo zaw nama tue aa ta pata Abyipa'a lie nguona ma hnyi.
Khazing duena hne Khrih te-ang khuna kha nama hnyi riypata Abyipa ta luo caa chiy yi se.
Duepa zaw, re a hrie khing lipa tie hne kiema maca changpa yi phungluo haata a aw khing lipa tie kha cahriy ung ta pata ma Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih ming ta naw maca pi yi.
Tahematapakieca niema hrahring ta kiema a mangpuo pata nama aw riypa kha nama pachang; niema'a lie ma aw ning kha ma thaa thuv vyi.
A muo pi li pata ahung sa hmuo ning vapuv. Cuorasala ahung cuo tahmuo hmangriy ma cuo li riypata chungzuo ta re ma hrie.
Cahaacata ma tuepa ca niema'a taata abyana pi riypata a hie khuna ma hnyi li nakawta cuo vyi, malie namaa mangpuo thena riypata ma tuepa tana a cuo.
Niema'a lie ma aw ning kha tahmuo, “Re a hrie khing lipa ca sa ning khah se,” ta pata naw maca pi tli yi.
Tahematapakieca niema chekha ca nama thaathuv te re khaapahmuo hrie li pata malie kawlie bie dyi a rangpa nama aw ta pata ma thyi.
Cahaapaapa cawsaa tie kha, ama riy a cawna re kha a diesa pata hrie yi se, ta pata naw pi yi pate ma pasu yi.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, aa hmuopa hmang tue kha nama palung chuo khah se.
Hingpa caa lie ma ripa hing a ziy khing lipa ca a nang a zaa the riypata a viesaa khah ung.
Cariepa haata hmung li pata, zangtuv haa khata a raaringna pi tie ung.
Thlaalungna Byi ama hrahring ta a luo bangkhuo taata cipari ta diena ca pi mang yi sue. Niema bangkhuo'a lieta Abyipa aw mang sue.
Kama Paul na hingpa bie-achangna caa hing i kuv ta a cape ang. I caa bangkhuo lieta ming i thuv; hingpa hing i caa capezya ta a cuo.
Ima Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih vihnyina ca niema bangkhuo'a lie aw mang sue.
Maa Khuotuv Khazing maa nguopuona ta a cuopa Khrih Zingsuv thueta, Khrih Zingsuv lucuotuv a cuopa Paul ta,
Zangna lie i saata tah a cuopa Timote kha: Paa Khazing hne Khrih Zingsuv'a taata vihnyina, nangduena hne thlaalungna ca na cunglie aw mang sue ta pata bie icaa chang.
Masidonia luo i tlaw ningta ica changpa haa khata Efesa khy lie kha zaa ngaa la aa dang lipa pacuvna a pacuvtuv tie kha pacuv li tli riypata za thlu karue yi tapa ica khing.

Zangna ta pachang khu a cuopa Khazing khuekhuona kaw kha pacuv cuopa ta, a i a chuena dyi a chiykhyipa phungpa cakhawpa hne a chuo the lipa thukina cazing kaw rina lie zaw ta amaa pituv li riypa khata thlu tie yi
Hing haapa bietaana ta aa tingpa ca pathiypalung pathepa, a chie a pha thleduona hne zangna singsaapa taata a pyapa duena tana a cuo.
Cawsaa chekha ca hingpa taa hingta luopie yi te siyluo a hnyi lipa a i a chue cakhawna luo kha ama chiy.
Khaapa ma ma ri tapa kha pachang li pata hne amaa daakhyipa kha khaapa ta ma a cuo tapa pachang li pata phungbie saya cuo kha ama khing.
A cuona haata hmuopa kieca phungbie hing a pha tapa ca ma pachang.

Kiema ta ma pachangpa ca phungbie hing aa dangpa tie cuota sapa cuo li pata phungbie a ziy lipa tie hne ri a ngie lipa tie, Khazing abie lipa tie hne a suepa tie, a pathe lipa tie hne Khazing siysaa ri li pata biena a hnyi lipa tie, a nung hne a paa a thiepa tie, cawsaa a thiepa tie,

aparuvsuena a tuepa tie, canungcapaa phung li pata aw hne a hmuopa tie, sii ta sung a palipa tie, a hangpa tie, aa hmuo lipa lie tehte a cuopa tie, aa hmuopa pacuvna hne a carie pata a awpa tie cuota tuepa tana a cuo.
Capa pacuvna ca pathuo sa tluo aa tlapa Khazing ta kama phu riypata ina pipa a rungnaapa thuophaa haa kha tana a cuo.
Kama thaazuo naa pituv Khrih Zingsuv ma Byipaapa kha i law, tahematapakieca zang tluo aa tlapa ta na rue te a re hrie riypata ina hmuo.

Ahluo ta ca Khazing thuo a pachituv, hrisaatuv, hne hnaapahnawtuv ta i za cuo. Cuorasala, Khazing nangduena kha i hmung, tahematapakieca pachang li pata hne zang li pata i za tuepa a cuo nakaw tana a cuo.
Abyipa vihnyina ca Khrih Zingsuv chunglie zangna hne duena zaw hne khata i cuota a le ta a lepathla.
Khrih Zingsuv ca a suepa khuo riypa tana chuelyi luo aa zuv tapa ca aa hmuopa hne cuhluo aa tlapa tana a cuo. Capa a suepa zaw hrawlie ca kama hing a sue cepa tana i cuo.

Cuorasala capa kawlie ca ta Abyipa ta nang ina due pata a cuo. Zingsuv Khrih ta a sue cepa i cuona cangta chuozaa hringna hmung riypata ama a vya zang riypa tie a mangpuo riypata na tue te, a cuo khuna chung ta i cunglie kha a palung a pasiy.
Chuozaa Siepahruo, a thiy the lipa, hmung khu a cuo lipa, ama dyi Khazing a cuopa ca pa-uvsathyina hne rungnaana kha chuozaa ta pi pata cuo mang sue. Amen.
I sacapaa, Timote, nama kawlieta profet tie ama za ri ciepa haata, capa bie ca ziy pata a pha ce pata naa du khu riypata ica chang.
Zangna hne a chie a pha thleduona kha a patuv pari tie. Cawsaa chekha ca chiepha thleduona siysaa ama ri li nakawta ama zangna kha a ra tli.
Iema hrawlie ca Hymenaias hne Alekzandar kha amaa te ra. Khazing thuo pachi li riypa amaa cuv the riypata iema kha Setaa kuv chung luo i pi tli yi.
Cakhutaata, a hmietaa ce ta ica chang khingpa yi ca, cawsaa bangkhuo cuota Khazing'a luo kha ryiphaacyina, thlaachuona, thlaa a chuopana, hne palungtluona bie hluona kha hnyi tie ung.
Hnaanguo pata hne a dieta tah ma aw the riypa hne Khazing ciyzaana hne zyazaa phana ta ma aw the riypata siepahruo hne re lepa a hriepa tie cuota thlaachuo tie ung.
Capa ca Khuotuv Khazing hmielieta aa hmuopa hne cuhluo tluo aa tlapa ta a cuo.
Abyipa ca cawsaa bangkhuo khuopa cuo riypa hne biehmisipa ama pachang riypa kha a khing.
Tahematapakieca, Khazing pakha dyi aw te, Khazing hne cawsaa alalalie arena a tuetuv pakha dyi a aw. Ama ca cawsaa ta a cuopa Khrih Zingsuv cuo te,
cawsaa bangkhuo khuo riypata a luv a pipa tana a cuo. Capa ca ningcuo aa de tiyta paluosapa tana a cuo.
Capa repa ca tana kama hing tluo-utuv hne lucuotuv, Jentail ming hrawlie zangna hne biehmisipa pacuvtuv ta tuepa i cuo. Biehmisipa na ica chang yi, hang va ang.
Caacuonakawta, capaa bangkhuo ca hmangting lie kha hihaa lipa hne a hru a i li pata nama kuv pathepa kha pazu ung la thlaa nama chuo riypata i khing.
Cahaacata, canung zaw kha aa de aa khaw pata hne mang aa ngie pata caw a tue yi se. Ama suo kha tuepaluena te ta a cataw pata siy, pale lungvaa hne caw muo ruv tuvpa kha a tue khah yi se.
Cuorasala Khazing a ciyzaapa canung zyazaa ta a cuopa hmang pha tuena kha a hryi hriy yi se.
Canung ca rawcanawna hneta a dieta tah a cuv se.
Ahung canung hmuo cuose pacuvtuv cuo riypa hne capaa cunglie naw hnyi riypata khing va ang; a dieta tah aw thluo se.
Tahematapakieca Adam kha sa taapa cuo te cakhutaata Evi kha sa pata a cuo.
Adam ca dung khupa cuo li pata, Evi kha dung khupa cuo te suena a tuetuv ta a cuo.
Cuorasala canung ca zangna, duena, pathena hneta mang a ngiesa pata a aw kieca saata sana thue hingta khuopa a cuo aa.
Ahung a cuo zaw khrihsaabuv luochiytuv cuo kha a khing kieca re phapa a khingpa tana a cuo, tapa bie ca aa hmuopa bie tana a cuo.
Khrihsaabuv luochiytuv ca syi riy a aw lipa, napuv pakha dyi a hnyipa, a cadang thepa, singvaasa pata a awpa, pa-uvsathyi tluo a tlapa, khyche a duepa, pacuv a thepa cuo'a te,
sahmaa a pariy thepa cuo'a vyi, tuvde a hmuopa cuo li pata a palung a nepa a cuo aa. Malie hne a hru thepa cuo li pata tuokaa a khing tuvpa cuo'a vyi.
A ingchungkhue a phata tah luo a chiy khupa cuo'a te a saata zaw ca malie ri a ngiepa hne cawsaa pa-uvsathyi a thepa ama cuo aa.
Ama ingchungkhue hmuo luo a chiy the li kieca Khazing khrihsaabuv ca tuokhaatama a mangchiy khu aa?
Khrihsaa a cuo thaapa cuo'a vyi. Caacuolikieca ahruo tle pata a pale pathlyi'a te khachie suebieripana luo khana a tla pathlyi aa.
Ca hlyitaw taata, ama ca ale luo a awpa tie ta ama pa-uvsathyipa a cuo aa. Caacuolikieca a thuo chi'a te khachie cyihyi liena aa uo pathlyi aa.
Cahaacata khrihsaa uvthyi zaw ca aa cung aa hlaapa ama cuo aa. Bie a khing lipa, sahmaa a pariy lipa hne tuokaa luota a karuo a aw lipa ama cuo aa.
A pathepa chiepha thleduona ta zangna bieparuv kha aa y pata a patuvpa ama cuo aa.
Dyapasya taapa cuo'a yi te syi riy a aw lipa ama cuo kieca khrihsaa uvthyi kha hrie yi se.
Canung zaw ca aa cung aa hlaapa cuo'a yi te, cawsaa kawchie a ripa cuo'a va yi. Cuorasala a cadang thepa hne hmangting lie zang tluo aa tlapa ama cuo aa.
Khrihsaa uvthyi ca napuv pakha dyi hnyi'a te, ama saata hne ama ingchungkhue kha luo a chiy thepa ama cuo aa.
A phata tah re a hriepa khrihsaa uvthyi ca hmiephaa hmung yi te Khrih Zingsuv ama zangna kaw kha riephasa pata ama ri nguo.
A ru hluota niema'a luo i vya tlaw khu thlu aa ta pata i nguopuo, cuorasala hingpa caa niema'a luo i vya capepa ca,
i vya haa pathlyi kieca, Khazing chungkhue lie hing tuokhaatama ma aw aa tapa kha nama pachang riypa tana a cuo. A hringpa Khazing khrihsaabuv ca biehmisipa a tungpuv hne a hruo tana a cuo.

Ma biena bieparuv hing kha tluv tama a le tapa kha ahungtahmuo zang li pata aw va yi. Ama ca saapa ta a luo te, thlaapa lie duopacupa tana a cuo. Avuoming ta hmung yi te, Jentail ming hrawlie phupa ta a cuo. Alyicung bangkhuo lie zang yi te, rungnaana luo lathawpa tana a cuo.
Hmieluo thue ca cawsaa chekha ta zangna kha thuse'a yi te, dung a thepa thlaapa hne khuevuo tie pacuvna kha ama ziy aa, ta pata Thlaapa ta a siesa pata a ri.
Hingpa pacuvna ca thaa lingpa ta ama pakuo nakawta a chiepha thleduona a thiypa, a hanghiepa phahruocuo tie'a taata a vawpa tana a cuo.

Iema ca ta achiyhiena kha thlu yi te, ning li riypa ama tapa sa chekha zaw a aw. Capa sa ca zangtuv tie hne biehmisipa a pachangpa tie ta palungtluona bierina cangta cuhluo riypa, Khazing ta a tuepa sa tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca Khazing ta a sapa bangkhuo ca pha te khaapa hing hmuo thaw riy aw vyi, palungtluona bierina cangta cuhluo riypa tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca Khazing bie hne thlaachuona khata a pathe sapa tana a cuo.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw kha hingpa pacuvna hing na chang kie yi ca na za ziy ciepa aa hmuopa pacuvna hne zangna bie lieta a lethawpa a phapa Khrih Zingsuv changtaapa ta na cuo aa.
Khazing hne biena a pa-uvsathyi lipa phungpa cakhawpa hne nungpuv tie phungpa kha cahriy tie. Khazing ciyzaa riypa kha a zue tie.
Tahematapakieca saapa temaana khata thlahnena a hnyi rapa haata Khazing ciyzaana ca a luo ting ta thlahnena a hnyi. Ata ma hringna cuota hne a vaw riypa ma hringna cuota biekuona a hnyi.
Capa bie ca aa hmuopa hne cuhluo aa phuvpa tana a cuo.

Hingpa repa hing tana riethyisa pata te ma maa lawpa ta a cuo. Tahematapakieca maa nguopuona kha a hringpa Khazing'a lieta ma bang. Ama ca cawsaa bangkhuo a khuotuv hne a hlyi ta zangtuv tie a khuotuv ta a cuo.
Hingpa tie hing na naa daakhyi riypa hne na pacuv riypata a cuo.
Mingnu na cuo nakawta ahungtahmuo ca mangbung khah yi se, cuorasala na bierikuovy hne na awtuvzyazaa lie cuose, duedingna, zangna hne pathena lie kha zangtuv tie cuota a mangpuo riypata aw tie.
Kama i vya chiyna te ta zaapuv hmielie Caapathe rina, pasuna hne pacuvna kha za tue pari tie.
Uvthyi tie ta na cunglie ama kuv ama khang ningta profetbiephu ta aca pipa thlaapa lasaw kha siysaa ri li pata aw lie ciy.
Cawsaa bangkhuo ta na lethawpa kha ama hmung the riypata khapa hmang zaw kha tue la iema cuo khata a pi tie.
Nama'a na nama kha cuose, na pacuvna lie cuose a raaring tie. Hingpa zaw hing ci li pata tue tie, cahaacata na tue kieca nama kha a khuo khu'a cate na bie a naathlietuv tie zaw kha na khuo khu'a yi.
Uvthyi vie kha chuo khah, na paa haa khata rue la chang tie. A syi vie tie kha na nuta haata rue tie yi.
Canung uvthyi vie tie kha na nung haata rue yi la, canung a syi vie tie kha pathiypalung pathesa pata na sieta haata rue tie yi.
Nunghlyi a cuo hmisipa tie kha pa-uvsathyi tie yi.

Nunghlyi ta saata acuolikie samingta a hnyi kieca iema chungkhue cuota biena luo phung ta a cuopa ama hrie riypa kha a cuv taa yi sala ama nungpaa tie kha mangsang hriy yi se; tahematapakieca capa ca Khazing hmungna lie palungtluo aa chiypa tana a cuo.
Ama se ta a awpa nunghlyi hmisipa ca anguopuona kha Khazing'a lie chi te, chung hne zuo hne ci li pata thlaa a chuo.
Cuorasala saapa anuona cuota a hringpa nunghlyi ca a hringpa ta a thiypa tana a cuo.
Iema ca syisaapa ama cuo li riypata hingpa nawbie hing pi tie yi.
Ahunghmuo cuose a tieriy, a hlyi vie ta a chungkhue kha mangchiy li pata a aw kieca zangna a thawpa hne zanglituv tie laata a chie viepa tana a cuo.
Kung sawcaruv a hlyipa hne yi kha dyi navaa zaa hnyi buopa kha nunghlyi cazing lie pangie tie.

Re phapa hriena lie ming a hnyipa, a saata zaw a phasa pata a mangchiypa, khyche a duepa, mingpathepa tie phyi a pasiypa, ruvnaana a tawpa tie a byapa, hne hmang phapa tuena lie a cuo hne a thaazuo a pipa a cuo aa.
A kung nu viepa nunghlyi tie kha ca cazing lie pangie khah yi; tahematapakieca saapa khingna ta Khrih hne che'a yi te navaa ama hnyi khing aa.
Cahaacata bie amaa kuo taapa kha ama para nakawta suebepa ama cuo aa.
Ca dyi cuo li pata, ing kha hnang ing kha ta a khie yi te thaathuvna ta ama cuo kha ama pachuo. Ama thaathuvpa dyi cuo li pata malie kaw ri yi te, bierangle yi te ri li'apa ting ta ama ri.
Caacuonakawta a kung nu viepa nunghlyi ca navaa hnyi pakhaa thluo yi sala, saa sa yi sala amaa chungkhue kha mangchiy yi se tapa i khing. Cata a cuo kieca ma carie tie ta malie rithuochi khu'a va yi.
Tahematapakieca nunghlyi chekha ca Setaa ziy riypata amaa pali tli.

Zangtuv canung ta nunghlyi hmisipa tieriy a hnyi kieca, ama ta mangchiy sala khrihsaabuv hmangriy cuo khah se. Cakiedyina khrihsaabuv ta a buchuo riy a hnyi hmisi lipa nunghlyi tie kha aa bya khu'a yi.
Khrihsaabuv kha a phasa pata mangsang te a hlyi ta phungri hne pacuv kha te a maapa khrihsaabuv luochiytuv tie ca hrie muo le hning ta hmung aa phuvpa tana ama cuo.
Tahematapakieca Caapathe ta, “Suo a ciy nguoluopa cuetungpa kha a hmya hy khah ung,” ta te, “Rehrietuv ca hrie muo kha hmung aa tla,” a ta.
A caw ce ta a daakhyituv pahning pathung chuo ama aw li kieca khrihsaabuv luochiytuv kha sue ama phaw tiyta cuhluo khah.
Suena a tuepa tie kha zaapuv hmielie pasiypa-ya yi la a hrangpa zaw kha ama ciy aa.
Hingpa pacuvna hing akuo ta a daana hne pahlyipalena hnyi li pata na ziy riypata Khazing hmielie hne Khrih Zingsuv hmielie hne a tlawpa avuoming hmielieta a raaringna ica pi.
Ahung cunglie hmuo Khazing rehrietuv cuo riypata a catli pata na kuv va khang khah. Malie tie suena lie va aw ra khah; a pathe pata aw tie.
Na riy a pasa thesa nakaw khata tiy dyi dang li tli pata mingsuvtiy kha a cawta tah dang tie.
Cawsaa chekha suena ca a siesa pata a luo te ama suena ca iema hluota bieripana luo a chiy taa ning kha, a hrangpa tie suena ca a hnang ta aa luo.
Cahaacata re phapa hriena zaw a luo te, aa luo li kie zawma nu pari khu aw vyi.
Sii a cuopa bangkhuo ta ama ziy tie kha pa-uvsathyi riypa tana ama cuo ta pata rue yi se. Cakiedyina Khazing ming hne pacuvna kha ripachie li pata ama aw aa.

Zangtuv a cuopa ziy a hnyipa tie ta khrihsaa uvnu na ama cuo ra thluo ta pata nama ziy tie kha pa-uvsathyi li pata aw khah ung. Nama re hriepa thlahnena a hmungpa tie ca nama duepa hne zangtuv tie ta ama cuo nakawta ama re kha khuo vie ta hrie tie ung.
Ahung a cuo zaw, a phanghrang ta pacuv yi te ima Byipaapa Khrih Zingsuv bie aa hmuopa hne ma biena phung haata pacuvna kha a cuhluo lipa ca,
a hruotlepa, khaapahmuo a pachang lipa, a hnaatluo lipa ruena hnyi pata, biesuo kawlie zaw a i a chue khingpa tana ama cuo. Capa ca ta hietliena, palung a lu lina, kawchie a rina hne a ruvphuvna,
biena hing hnyirungna luopuv suokha ta rue yi te a pha lipa palungphya a hnyipa tie hne biehmisipa a hringkhyi lipa tie zaw hneta ci li pata bie a ina kha a chiykhyi.
A hnyi thathiypa cunglie a palung a tlingpa cuota ca biena hing hnyirungna ta a cuo hmisi.
Tahematapakieca chuelyi luo hing khaapahmuo zaa puvkhyi vapuv, cahaacata khaapahmuo a phyale khu'a vapuv.
Caacuonakawta ning riypa sa hne a buv a se riypa cawsie ma hnyi kieca ma palung a tling riypa tana a cuo.
Cuorasala hnyirung a khingpa ca pasupaliyna luo kha tla yi te rakyina luo a chiykhyi khupa yi ngaana hne ciy aa chiypa ama khingna khata cyihyi pa-uo ta a pa-uo yi.
Tuokaa khing tuvna hing pha lina phangting pyanapa thabaw tana a cuo. Cawsaa chekha ca hnyirung ama khing tuvna lie kha zangna taata luo pie yi te ngiechi kharuehaa vuosuo pata ama aw.
Cuorasala nama ca Khazing cawsaa na cuo nakawta hingpa zaw hing cahriy la, adangna, Khazing ciyzaana, zangna, duena, ang khuna hne palungnena zaw kha hnyi tie.
Zangna cuota aduna lie hing a pha ce pata temaa la chuozaa hringna kha hmung a zue tie. Capa repa cata kupa cuo ung cate cawsaa hluvpuv hmiekunglieta tehte nama khuopa khata a cuo.
Hmangting bangkhuo hringna a pituv Khazing hne Pontius Pilat hmiekunglie a phata tah tehte a khuopa Khrih Zingsuv hmiekunglie ica changpa ca,
ma Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih aa luona te ta hingpa nawbie hing syisaa riy aw li pata ziy tie.
Capa ning ca thluechiypa ta a cuopa pakha dyipa Lesyice, siepahruo tie Siepahruo, hne byi tie Byi a cuopa Khazing ta a ningcuo aa raw ce ningta a vya patlung sa aa.

Ama dyi hingna a thiy the lipa, cadi nguo a cuo lipa, khena chunglie a awpa hne ahungtahmuo ama hmung buo lipa hne ama hmung khu lipa ta a cuo. A cunglieta pa-uvsathyina hne chuozaa pena naw aw mang sue. Amen.

Hing chuelyi lie a hnyirungpa tie kha amaa palepatie li riypata hne aa hmang lipa hnyirungna cunglie anguopuona khuo tuv ta ama hnyi li riypata chang tie yi. Cuorasala ma hring anuona riypata hmangting kha pahyasa pata malie a pipa Khazing cunglie kha anguopuona hnyi hriy yi se.
Phana tue hne hmang phapa tuena lie hnyirung pata pahyana hne malie a pi pachaa thepa ama cuo riypata chang tie yi.
Cahaacata iema ca hmieluo ama hruo cuna riypata suethiy a pacungpa cuo'a yi te hringna hmisi ta a cuopa hringna kha ama hmung aa.
Timote, nama'a lieta pipa hmang kha a phata tah kingkaa tie. A pyalyipa hne siyluo a hnyi lipa bie a inapa, cawsaa chekha ta aa hmuo li pata, “singna,” ama tapa kha cahriy tie.
Cawsaa chekha ta capa singna ca ma hnyi ta pata a rue yi te zangna kha ama hla. Niema'a lie vihnyina aw mang sue.
Khrih Zingsuv chunglie a awpa, hringna hne aa patuvpa biekuona haata Khazing khingna chunglie Khrih Zingsuv lucuotuv ta a cuopa kama Paul ta,
I duepa i sacapaa Timote kha: Paa Khazing hne ma Byipaapa Khrih Zingsuv'a taata vihnyina, nangduena hne thlaalungna ca na cunglie aw mang sue, ta pata bie icaa chang.
Ma mingchingmingvuo tie ta amaa zaa biepa haata palung pathesa pata i biepa Khazing ca, chungzuo ta i thlaachuona lie icaa thyi kyry ta i law pari.
Na mingthliy tlapa kha a thyi pari angte alawna hne i bi riypata nama kha ica hmung khingsa.
Nama'a lie a awpa a pakhipa ta a cuo lipa na zangna kha i thyi. Capa zangna ca na mingnung Lois hne na nung Zunis ta za hnyi taa yi te nama zaw hing na hnyi ra ta pata i zang.
Caacuonakawta na cunglie i kuv i khangna thueta na chunglie a awpa Khazing lasaw kha na pahring pari riypata ica pasu.
Tahematapakieca Khazing ta riechiena thlaapa kha malie a pipa cuo li pata cahrana, duena hne kiema pangpa a uv khuna thlaapa khana malie a pi.

Cakhutaata Abyipa kaw tehte khuopa kha na nang zaa khah se. Ama cuota thaw a tlapa kama zaw hing na zaakhyi ra khah. Cuorasala Abyipa cahrana lie kha a daa la thuophaa cuota ruvnaana ang kha kama hing naa hraw tie.

Khazing ta malie khuo te a pathepa kuna ta malie a kupa ca kiema hriena thueta cuo li pata ama atingna hne vihnyina thue tana a cuo. Hingpa a vihnyina hing cuo aa thu hluo taata Khrih Zingsuv thueta pipa ma cuo tli,
cuorasala capa vihnyina ca Khuotuv Khrih Zingsuv aa luona thueta phupa ta cuo te, ama ta thiyna kha para te hringna hne thiy khu li tlina kha thuophaa thueta khena luo a vya chiykhyi.
Capa thuophaa pathyi sa riypa ca tana kama hing tluo-utuv, lucuotuv hne pacuvtuv re pi pata i cuo.

Capa kawlie ca tana hingpa ruvnaana hing i ang pata a cuo. Cuorasala i nang zaa vyi, tahematapakieca ahungma i zang tapa kha pachang angte, na zang te ina pipa hmang kha capa ning te cata a cake khu aa ta pata a siesa pata i zang.
Kama'a taata na thyipa a tluotlingpa pacuvna kha Khrih Zingsuv chunglie a awpa zangna hne duena ta a patuv tie.
Kiema chunglie a awpa Thlaapa Pathe abyana khata nama'a lie aca pipa rusungpa kha a phata tah mangsang tie.
Asia ruo lie a awpa bangkhuo ta inaa ruosepa yi kha na pachang, capa zaw hrawlie ca Figelas hne Hermogenes zaw amaa te ra.
Onesiforas chungkhue tie kha Abyipa ta nangdue thi yi se, tahematapakieca yi hluvpuv thaazuo thaa na pi te thaabuoliriy ta cakhiypa i cuopa hing na zaakhyi vyi.
Rom luo a vya chiy pahne ta palung hmisi ta na huv te inaa taw.
Abyipa ta a hnangcaw cepa ning lie khiy a nangduena pahmung sa mang sue! Efesa lie kha i cuota kha tluv tama re a hrie tapa kha a phasa pata nama pachang.
I sacapaa, nama ca Khrih Zingsuv'a lieta a awpa vihnyina chunglie kha a cahrasa pata aw tie.
Tehte hluvpuv hmielie kama'a taata na thyipa kha malie a pacuv pachaa khu riypa, zang tluo aa tlapa tie kha pi tie yi.
Khrih Zingsuv rieka pha pakha haa khata ruvnaana kha ang ra tie.
Rieka lie re a hrie nguoluopa ta ca a byipaapa palung patling riypa kha aa tingpa a cuo nakawta re hrangpa lie kha a kalaa ra vyi.
Cakhutaata cang-iena azuena lie zaw kha ziyphung haata a zue lipa ca ahunghmuo tena lakhuv hmung va yi.
Re hrie te a maapa, lu a thlupa ca thyipaa kha a hmung taa riypa tana a cuo.
Ica changpa yi hing rue ung la Abyipa ta hmangting lie kha pachangna aca pi'a yi.
I phupa thuophaa ta a cuopa, thiyna taata a thupakhaapa David saming Zingsuv Khrih kha maw khah.
Capa kawlie cana a suepa haata thaabuoliriy ta cakhiyna te ta ruvnaana i ang. Cuorasala Khazing bie ca thaabuoliriy ta hre khupa cuo vyi.
Caacuonakawta a tlawpa tie ta Khrih Zingsuv'a lie a awpa khuona kha chuozaa rungnaana hneta ama cu the riypata hmangting kha i ang law.
A raw luo'apa bie hing aa hmuopa bie tana a cuo. Ama hneta ma thiy kieca, ama hneta ma hring pakhaw aa;
ma ang khu kieca, ama hneta ma uv pakhaw aa; ama kha ma thaw kieca, ama zaw ta malie a thaw ra aa;
kiema ta zangna ma hnyi li zawta, ama ca zang tluo aa tla pari, tahematapakieca ama hne ama kha a thaw khu vyi.
Khaapahmuo thlahnena hnyi li pata a thyituv tie dyi a parapa bie a ina kha cahriy riypata iema kha Khazing hmielie a raaringna pi yi la chang canyi lawmaw tie yi.
A hmisipa bie kha a phata tah pasie sa khu te a zaakhyi riy a hnyi lipa hne ama ta a pha a tapa rehrietuv pakha adaahmang taata nama hne nama kha a pha ce pata Khazing'a luo a pi tie.
A pyalyipa hne siyluo a hnyi lipa bie a ina kha cahriy tie, tahematapakieca cawsaa khana Khazing siysaa ri lina luo aa chiy hryly'a yi.
Iema pacuvna ca a cakule hrylypa hmaachie hne tana aa lu. Iema hrawlie ca Hymenaias hne Filetas ama aw ra.
Iema ca biehmisipa taata pie yi te a thiypa tie thupakhaana ca a tlung tli ta pata cawsaa chekha tie zangna kha ama pataw ama pamuo.
Cuorasala Khazing padaapa hruopatu ca cu te, capa hruo lie ca, “Abyipa ta ama huopa tie kha a pachang yi,” tapa hne, “Abyipa ming a upa mekaa ca pha lina taa khata amaa yi se,” ta pata caa aa khe.
Ing lesapa suokha chunglie kha siy hne ngu ta dyi cuo li pata thing hne acyi ta ama tuepa biphie zaw aw yi te, chekha ca a sungnaa vie ta hmuopa cuo yi te chekha ca a cakhawpa ta hmuopa ama cuo.
I ripa haa khata iema hne iema a pathe sapa tie bangkhuo ca ing a hnyituv cuota pathesapa hne cuo sungnaapa ning lieta hmuopa hmang pha ta cuo'a yi te, re phapa bangkhuo lie hmuo thepa ama cuo aa.
Mingnu cuo ningta saapa khingna kha cahriy la, pathiypalung pathesa pata Abyipa a upa tie hne khata adangna, zangna, duena, hne thlaalungna kha hmung a zue tie.
Ngaana hne pachang laliy li pata bie a ina kha cahriy tie. Ahruna dyina a chiykhyi tapa kha na pachang.
Abyipa changtaapa ca malie hne a hru thepa cuo'a vyi. Cuorasala cawsaa bangkhuo cunglie duedingna a hnyipa, pacuvtuv pha, a palung pasiypa hne,
a dutuv tie kha palungnena hne a pasiy a pa-yapa a cuo aa. Khazing ta a ngiepachiyna hne biehmisipa pachangna kha pi'a yi te,
khachie ta ama khingna tue riypata a hrenapa yi cyihyi taa khata ama law ngiethie aa.
Ning hnangcaw luo thueta ca ruvnaana cuo a hluvpuv a tlung aa tapa kha pachang tie.
Tahematapakieca cawsaa ca iema cuo dyi a ruepa, tuokaa a khingpa, ahruo a tlepa, a palung a lepa, malie a esepa, a nungpaa a ciyzaa lipa, duena a pachang the lipa, a pathe lipa,
cawsaa palung a phya lipa, malie a ngiethe khu lipa, malie thuochi a ripa, a cadang li pata tuokaa a hmuo cakhawpa, aa hruopa, hmang pha a huepa,
malie a lyipa, rue taa li pata re a hriepa, a mingchiepa, Khazing khing li pata anuona a khingpa,
a cungphang ta Khazing khing pakhi yi te a cahrana a paw lipa ama cuo aa. Iema kha cahriy tie yi.
Tahematapakieca iema chungtaata chekha ca ama ingchung luo kha a ngie hnue yi te, ama khingna ziy pata suena hne a hringpa, a ruena a cawpa canung tie kha ama sawle khu.
Hingpa canung tie hing amaa cuv byalya raalaa pata biehmisipa pachangna te pha khu the va yi.
Jannes hne Jambres ta Moses kha amaa dupa haata ruena a pha lipa hne a pakhipa zangna a hnyipa cawsaa zaw khata biehmisipa kha amaa du ra.
Cuorasala iema ca a syi ru'a va yi. A cunglie ma ripa cawsaa pahning tie haa khata ama ngaanapa ca cawsaa bangkhuo hmielie phu pata a cuo aa.
Ata hing nama ca i pacuvna, i zyazaa, i tingnapa, i zangna, i palungpasiyna, i duena, zangna lie i cuna zaw kha na hmung mangtli.
Antiok, Ikonium hne Listra lie i angpa hrisaana hne ruvnaana zaw kha na hmung mangtli. Tuokhaapa hrisaana ma i ang! Cuorasala Khazing ta khapa bangkhuo taa khata ina khuo.
Hmisi ta kieca, Khrih Zingsuv chunglie Khazing ciyzaana hring a hnyi khingpa bangkhuo ca hrisaana ama ang aa.
Cuorasala cawsaa pha lipa hne a hanghiepa tie ca ama pha lina kha ruv vie hryly'a te, cawsaa kha dung'a yi te cawsaa ta ama dung aa.
Cadyiseca, nama ca naa zaa cuvpa hne a cupa na zangna lie kha a cusa pata a daa pazue tie. Ahung'a taata ma naa cuv aa tapa kha pachang cate,
Khrih Zingsuv na zangna thueta nama kha khuona hmung riypata luo caa pahmung sa khupa Caapathe kha na cawta baataata tuokhaatama na za pachang tapa kha na pachang.
Caapathe hing a bangkhuo ta Khazing ta huv a sungsuepa cuo te, pacuvna, aa hmuo lipa pacuvnapa ina, aa hmuo lipa hmang parena, aa dangta tah hringna riypata pacuvna ta a thlahnepa tana a cuo.
Cahaacata Khazing rehrietuv ca a tluotlingpa cuo'a te hmang pha ting tue riypata cehre phangtling a hnyipa a cuo aa.
Khazing hmielie hne, a hringpa hne a thiypa bangkhuo bie a ripa riypa Khrih Zingsuv ming hne aa vawna riypa hne a pena kawlieta khuopuv ta ica pasu.
Thuophaa kha phu tie; cuo aa raw zaw aa raw li zaw ci li pata phu tie; ama palung sie riypata chang yi, chuo yi, thaazuo pi yi la palung pasiysa pata pacuv tie yi.
Tahematapakieca cawsaa ta aa hmuopa pacuvna kha ziy li pata iema khingna haata a pacuvtuv kha ama huvna cuo hne,
biehmisipa naathlie khing li pata a palise'a yi te phungpahlaapa ama naathliena cuo kha a vya pha aa.
Nama dyi ca, singvaasa pata aw la, ruvnaana kha ang law la, thuophaa phuna re kha hrie tie. Na hrie riypa Khazing re kha tluotlingsa pata hrie tie.
Kama ca, bienatluophie lie ama lyipa hriykhungrina tiy haata i hringna pina cuo a vya tlung tli. I silena riypa cuo ca a vya pha tli.
Rietuvna kha a phasa pata i patlung tli. A ruo azuena lie kha a chuona te i ruo tli. Zangna kha a cusa pata i patuv tli.

Ata taa hingta ca adangna lakhuv kha chipa pata cuo angte, capa ca aa dangpa bieripatuv byi, Abyipa ta ningchuoningpa thueta ina pi aa. Kama dyi cuo li pata ama aa vawna riypa a ngietie li pata a huopa bangkhuo zaw kha a pi ra'a yi.
Kama'a luo a catlisa pata a vaw riypa kha a zue tie.
Tahematapakieca Demas ca hingpa chuelyi hing a tlechuo vie nakawta Thesalonika luo ina sise tli. Kresen ca Galati luo na sise te Titas ca Dalmatia luo ina sise.
Luka dyina kama'a lie a aw. Marka kha a vya chiyle tie, ama ca i hrie riypa Khazing re lie a thlahnesapa tana a cuo.
Taikhikas kha Efesa luo i paphya.
Naa vaw thueta Troas khy Karpas'a lie i chi siypa buohryi pasiypa kha na vya phya tie. Caa-uv hne a hlyi ta savang caa-uv kha vya maw lie ciy.
Daa a patlepa Alexander na ruvnaana lepuv naa pi; Abyipa ta a tuena haata a thung aa.
Nama zaw a raaring tie, tahematapakieca ma ripa bie kha khuopuv ta a dupa tana a cuo.
A yikhanapa bie ina ripa ning yi ca ahungtahmuo naa daakhyi va yi; inaa ruose diy yi. Khazing ta suena ta ripa hrue khah yi se.
Cuorasala thuophaa kha tluotlingsa pata i phu khu riypa hne Jentail ming bangkhuo ta ama thyi khu riypata Abyipa ta na awkhyi te thaazuo ina pi. Cahaacata kama ca chingde pakaa taata khuopa i cuo.
Abyipa ta pha lina bangkhuo chung taa khata na khuo'a te, a vuoruo pena chung luo ca inaa ngiekhyi aa. A cunglie rungnaana chuozaa ta aw mang sue.
Prisilla hne Akuila hne Onesiforas chungkhue tie kha ama kuv i patuv yi.
Erastas ca Korin khy lie a ngaa te, Trofimas ca a pasa cangta Miletas lie i thuse.
Thlasiy hluota naa vaw khu riypata a zue tie. Zubulas, Pudens, Linas, Klaudia hne, uvnu hne sieta zaw bangkhuo na nama kuv caa patuv yi.
Abyipa ca na thlaapa hneta aw thi se. Vihnyina ca niema bangkhuo cunglie aw mang sue.
Khazing changtaapa hne Zingsuv Khrih lucuotuv ta a cuopa, Khazing aa tlawpa tie ta zangna hne biehmisipa ama pachangna lie Khazing ciyzaana hne ama lethaw hryly riypata pathliepa,
a hang buo lipa Khazing ta capa chuozaa hringna anguopuona ca cuo aa pathu hluo taata bie a kuo ciepa,
a cuo aa de ningta a phupa thuophaa kha phu riypata Khuotuv Khazing biepina haata zang pata re pipa kama Paul ta,
Zangna suokha a hrawna chunglie i saata hmisi ta a cuopa Titas kha: Paa Khazing hne Khuotuv Khrih Zingsuv'a taata vihnyina hne thlaalungna ca na cunglie aw mang sue, ta pata bie icaa chang.
Krit lie ica chi siynapa ca ica changpa haa khata, hrie riypata a ngaa kaliepa re kha a phata tah na hrie riypa hne khy ting ta Khrihsaa uvthyi chi riypa kha tana a cuo.
Khrihsaa uvthyi pakha ca, syisaa riy a hnyi lipa, napuv pakha dyi a hnyipa, a saata zaw zangtuv cuo'a yi te anuopaana luota thuochi a phyapa hne ri a ngie lipa cuo'a va yi.

Khrihsaabuv luochiytuv ca Khazing re lie kingkaatuv a cuopa haata, syisaa riy a aw lipa a cuo aa. Ama ca a hruotlepa, a pathiy pachangpa, sahmaa a pariy thepa, tuvde a hmuopa hne a karuo awpa cuo'a vyi.
Cuorasala, ama ca khyche a duepa, phana a khingpa, a singvaapa, aa dangpa, Khazing re lie te a maapa, ama hne ama a uv khupa a cuo aa.
Ama ca pacuvna aa hmuopa kha a cusa pata a patuv'a te, aa hmuopa phungluo kha a pacuv khupa hne aa hmuo lipa pacuvna kha a i khupa ta a cuo aa.
Tahematapakieca a du a hmuopa cawsaa hluvpuv, thlahnena a hnyi lipa bie a ripa hne a hanghiepa hluvpuv aw yi te, a hlyi ta vangdaw a tepa tie chungtaata ama cuo.
A dieta tah aw yi se, tahematapakieca aa hmuo li pata, tuokaa hmung khingna vuota pacuv riypata a pha lipa kha pacuv yi te chungkhue bangkhuo ngie ama pachi.
Iema chunglie pakha ta a cuopa ama profet pakha ta, “Krit ming ca a hang paripa, saruopa haata cawsaa pha lipa, a thaathiypa hne ning a rangpa tana ama cuo,” a ta.
Capa tehtekhuona ca aa hmuopa tana a cuo. Aa hmuopa zangna ama hnyi the riypata capa kawlie ca khuosa ta chuo tie yi.
Judah ming phungpa hne biehmisipa a dupa tie nawbie kha siysaa ri li pata aw tie.
A pathepa tie cuota hmangting hing pathe te, a rapa hne a zang lipa tie cuota ca a pathepa aw vyi. Ama pathiypalung hne ama chiepha thleduona khana a ra tli.
Iema ca Khazing kha ma pachang ama ta raalaa pata, ama tuesana khata ama kha ama thaw. Iema ca duv aa chiypa, ri a ngie lipa, hne tuokhaapa hmang phapa hneta hmuo aa tla lipa tana ama cuo.
Cuorasala nama ca, aa hmuopa ziyphung hne aa tlapa pacuvna kha pacuv tie.
Capaa macuo vie tie kha a ruepacuo thepa, aa hmuochuopa, a ruedaw thepa, zangna aa hmuopa a hnyipa, duena a hnyipa hne ang khuna a hnyipa ama cuo riypata chang tie yi.

Cahaacata canung nungpuv vie tie zaw kha hringcuozyazaa lie pa-uvsathyi aa tlapa, malie thuo a pachipa hne dang li pata a aw khu lipa ama cuo li riypata chang tie yi. Khaapa hing ma a pha tapa kha amaa cuv riypata chang tie yi.
Iema ta canung kung nu vie tie kha navaapa a duepa, saata zaw a duepa,

iema hne iema a uv khupa, hringzya pathepa a hnyipa, ingchungkhue luochiy a thepa, malie kaw a pacuopa, a navaapa a ciyzaapa, ama cuo riypata chang yi se. Cakiedyina Khazing bie hing a thuochi li pata a aw aa.
Cahaacata capaa kung nu vie tie zaw kha iema hne iema amaa uv khu riypata pasu tie yi.
Nama hrahring kha re phapa lie a mangpuo aa tla riypata aw la, na pacuvna lie zaw yi kha aa hmuochuosa pata pacuv tie yi.
Syisaa khu li riypa biephapa kha hmuo la, kiema malie a dutuv tie kha ma thuochi ri riypa khaapahmuo ama hnyi li nakawta ama nang a zaa aa.
Sii tie kha ama ziy zaw a ciyzaapa hne ama palung a patluopa ama cuo riypa hne bie ama palie li riypata chang tie yi.
A cawta tah nuparuvpa tue li pata zang tluo aa tlapa ama cuona kha paluo sa yi se. Cakiedyina Khuotuv Khazing pacuvna kha hmangting lieta a papuvthe sapa ama cuo aa.
Tahematapakieca Khazing vihnyina ca cawsaa bangkhuo khuona cuota aa luo tli.

Capa vihnyina cata kiema kha Khazing siysaa ri lina hne chuelyi khingna kha thaw pata hingpa ma chuo chunglie hing kiema hne kiema a uv khupa, aa dangpa, hne Khazing a ciyzaapa ma cuo riypata malie a pacuv.
Cahaacata kiema ca thlue aa chiypa anguopuona hne a lesyipa Khazing hne Khuotuv, Zingsuv Khrih rungnaana aa luo riypa kha ma huo nguoluo.
Ama ca pha lina bangkhuo taata kiema kha a thla riypa hne ama cuo hrahring ta a pathepa cuo riypa hne hmang pha a tue khingpa ama cawsaa zaw cuo riypata kiema cuota a hringna a pipa tana a cuo.
Hingpa kaw hing pathyisa tie; nawhnyina hneta pasu yi la pacu sa tie. Ahungtahmuo ca mangbung khah yi se.
Iema kha uvtuv tie hne nawhnyituv tie ri a ngie riypata chang pakhaa tie yi. Cawsaa pa-uvsathyi riypa, hmang phapa bangkhuo tue riypa,
pakha hmuota biechiepa ta chaw li riypa, a hru a ina kha cahriy riypa, nangne riypa, hne cawsaa bangkhuo hmielie a pane pata aw riypa kha chang tie yi.

Tahematapakieca, ahluo ta ca kiema hrahring zaw hing za ngaasa pate ri a ngie li pata luo ma za vie. Saapa khingna phangting hne anuona lie kha sii za cuo pate, pha lina hne hietliena, duv aa chiypa hne manghnue aa chiypa, pakha hne pakha ahuena lie kha ma cuo ma za pachuo sa.
Cuorasala kiema Khuotuv Khazing phana hne duena aa luo tiyta,
kiema kha malie a khuo. Capa malie a khuopa ca kiema ma tuepa hmang phapa kawlie cuo li pata a nangduena thueta hne tiy ta puvpathiyna hne a Thlaapa Pathe ta sapathiyna thueta a cuo.
Malie a Khuotuv Zingsuv Khrih thueta Thlaapa ca kiema cunglie kha a hluvpuv ta byapa ma cuo.
Cahaacata kiema ca chuozaa hringna anguopuona thueta a rucutuv cuo riypata a vihnyina ta duopacupa ma cuo.

Capa bie ca aa hmuopa bie tana a cuo. Khazing a zang tlipa tie ta ca hmang pha tuena lieta iema hne iema amaa pi riypa kha namaa daakhyi riypata icaa khingkhyi yi. Hingpa hmang hing cawsaa bangkhuo cuota a pha cepa hne a thlahnepa ta a cuo.
Cuorasala ngaana bie a ina, thukina cazing kaw a ina, ruena a lu lina, hne phungbie kaw a ina zaw kha cahriy tie, thlahnena hne muo a hnyi lipa tana a cuo.
Buv chunglie achena a tuepa kha a raaringna yi kha yi hning na pi khutaata acaa ngie li kieca a khe khah tie ung.
Cahaapa cawsaa kha ca a pali a pahnaa ta a hringpa hne a suepa ta cuo te a suena ta suebie a ripa aa tapa kha na pachang.
Nama'a luo Artemas acuolikie Taikhikas i vya pathlie tiyta i awnapa Nikopolis luo a vaw riypata a zue la i khing, tahematapakieca thlasiy chung ca hingpa lie hing aw riypa tana i ting.
Sih-ni Zenas hne Apollos ama khytlawna lie kha amaa hupa tluo a tling riypata na cuo khu chung ta zaa bya tie yi.
Cawsaa ca a cakhawpa ama cuo li riypata, aa huna lie hmuo tluo a tlapa ama cuo the riypata hne re pha hriena lie aa pipa ama cuo riypata a cuv yi se.
Kama'a lie a awpa bangkhuo na nama kuv caa patuv yi. Zangna lie malie a duepa tie kha ama kuv na patuvpa tie yi. Nama bangkhuo cunglie vihnyina aw mang sue.
Khrih Zingsuv kawlieta thaw a tlapa kama Paul hne ma uvnupa Timote ta,
ma viesaa hne ma rieka piy ta a cuopa Filemon, ma sieta Apfia, ma rieka piy Arkhipas hne na ing lie a pungpa khrihsaabuv kha:
Ma Paa Khazing hne ma Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih'a taata vihnyina hne thlaalungna ca nama cunglie aw mang sue, ta pata bie maacaa chang yi.
I thlaachuona lie caa thyi pari angte Khazing kha i pathuosa.
Tahematapakieca mingpathepa tie na duenapa yi hne Abyipa Zingsuv na zangna kha i thyi.
Zingsuv Khrih cuota ma hrie riypa a phapa bangkhuo na pachangpasie thueta na zangna kaw na phupa kha a hma a si riypata thlaa ica chuopa.
I nuta, na duena ta i palung khuopuv ta na patluo sa te thaazuo ina pi. Tahematapakieca nama ta mingpathepa tie palung kha na patluo yi.
Capa kawlie ca ta, na hrie riypa re kawlie kha Khrih ming ta riephasa pata naw ica pi nguo raalaa pata,
kama Paul ta uvthyi vie cuona taa hne Khrih Zingsuv cuota thaw a tlapa cuona taata duena hneta paa ica kie.
Thaw i tla nguoluo chung ta i saata ta a vya cuopa Onesimas cuota paa ica kie.
Ahluo ta ca na cuota khaapahmuo thlahne vyi, cuorasala ata hing ca nama hne kama ma cuota a thlahnepa a cuo tli.
Ama kha, i pathiy i palung hneta nama'a luo ica paphya pakhaa.
Thuophaa kawlie thaw i tlana lie hing kama kha mangsang riypata, nama cuopa ta na awpuo sala ta pata i khing.
Cuorasala nama palung tling li pata khaapahmuo tue khing va ang, tahematapakieca na hmang pha tuena hing hripuo nakawta cuo li pata nama palung thu ta a cuopa i khing.
Nama hne kaa kha aa chepa hing ama kha chuozaa ta na hnyi khuna riypa tana a cuo thlu aa.

Na cuota sii pakha haata cuo li pata sii laata aa suo viepa duepa uvnu pakha ta a cuo tli. A hlyi ta kama cuota zaw cuo te, nama cuota changchiy ca thiysaa lie hne Abyipa chunglieta na duepa uvnu ta a cuo.
Caacuonakawta kama kha na rehriehne ta ina ruepa cata a cuo kieca, kama ina cuhluo riypa haa cata ama kha cuhluo tie.
Ama ta na cunglie suena suokhakha a tue kie cuose, suokhakha acaa uo kie cuose, kama cazing lie kha khung tie.
Kama Paul na hingpa hing i kuv ta a cape ang: Ica thung hrahring aa. Kama'a lie nama pangpa hrahring inaa uopa ca kha ca ri a hu li tlipa tana i rue.
A cuo, i nuta, Abyipa ming ta ica hiepa hing na pi tie! Khrih chunglie i palung na patluo tie.
I ripa laa hingta hmuo a pha vie ta na tue aa tapa kha pachangna cangta hne na ri-angiena kha zangna cangta nama'a luo caa i vya cape pata a cuo.
I vya ri khing kaliepa ca, i tlungna riypata ingkhuo khuo kha na za chipa pacie tie, tahematapakieca niema thlaachuona thueta niema'a luo i vya chiy pakhaa thlu aa ta pata i nguopuo.
Khrih Zingsuv'a lie thaw i tlahnepa Epafras ta na kuv aca patuv.
I rehriehne a cuopa Marka, Aristarkas, Demas, hne Luka zaw ta na kuv aca patuv yi.
Abyipa Zingsuv Khrih vihnyina ca niema'a lie aw mang sue.
Hluo ningta ca Khazing ta ma mingchingmingvuo tie'a lie kha profet tie hmuo pata a luo phangphang ta yi hluvpuv bie a za ri.
Cuorasala ata chuotliepa chuo lie hing ca a Sacapaa'a taata kiema'a lie kha bie a ri. Khazing ta ama kha hmangting bangkhuo rucutuv riypata tue te chuelyi zaw hing ama thueta sapa a cuo.

Sacapaa ca Khazing rungnaana a paluo satuv hne Khazing ama hrahring a lupa ta sapa a cuo. A cahrapa a bie ta hmangting bangkhuo kha a pacu sa. Sue pathesana kha tue te, Cungnungce Khazing cacuoluo kuo ta aa tu.
Ama a pipa ming ca avuoming ming laata aa suo viepa haata ama ca avuoming laata a le vie karaapa ta a cuo.

Tahematapakieca Khazing ta tuokhaapa avuoming kha hmuo, “Nama ca i Sacapaa tana na cuo; ataning hing na Paa ta i cuo,” ta va yi. Acuolikie, “Kama ca a Paa ta cuo'a angte, ama ca i Sacapaa ta a cuo aa,” ta buo ra vyi.
Cakhutaata, Khazing ta sa-uvthyi kha chuelyi luo aa chiy ningta a ripa ca, “Khazing avuoming bangkhuo ta ama hing abie ung,” a ta.
Avuoming kawlieta ca, “Avuoming kha thliy ta tue yi te, a changtaapa tie kha myihlaa ta a tue yi,” a ta.
Cuorasala Sacapaa kawlieta ca, “Vya Khazing, naa Byithude ca chuozaa ta a hmang mang sue, aa dangpa siepahruo khuecahryi ca na pena khuecahryi tana a cuo.
Nama ca adangna kha tlechuo cate pha lina kha na hue; caacuonakawta Khazing, na Khazing ta na viesaa zaw laata ca cyicalang vie te, palungtluona sathu kha aca pathuv,” a ta.
Cakhutaata, “Abyipa, a hruothu taata nama ta chuelyi hing sa cate, avuo zaw hing nama kuvzung tana a cuo;
iema ca ra'a yi te, cuorasala nama ca naa hmang aa; iema ca pang haata caw diy'a yi te,
buohryi haata na kadiy thluv'a yi, iema ca caw haata thlepa ama cuo aa. Cuorasala nama ca na hmanghmangpa ta cuo pari'a cate, na hringna kungkhue kha khatiy tahmuo chuo'a vyi,” a ta.
Cuorasala tuokhaapa avuoming kha hmuo, “Na carie zaw kha na phyi rawlie chaapuo riypata i tue hluo li yi, i cacuoluo kuo ta a tu tie,” a ta buo yi ma?
Avuoming bangkhuo hing khuona ru a cu riypa tie mangchiy riypata pathliepa Abyipa re a hrietuv thlaapa cuo va yi ma?
Caacuonakawta luopie ziy pata ma vie li riypata ma thyipa biehmisipa kha a phata tah rue ung siy.
Avuoming ta ama pathyisapa bie hing aa hmuo ta pata cuo te, suena bangkhuo hne ri a ngie lina bangkhuo cuota duotena ang riypata a cuo kieca,

kiema ta hing tluv ta a lesyipa khuona hing siysaa ri li pata ma aw kieca, tuokhaatama sue duotena taata ma law khu aa? Hingpa khuona thuophaa hing Abyipa ama hrahring ta phu taa te, cakhutaata a thyipa tie ta aa hmuopa a cuopa kha kiema'a lie ama phu pachaa.
Khazing zaw ta capa ca pahmungsana zaw, kharuehaa hmang zaw, kharuehaa hmang tuena a phangphang zaw khata tehte khuo te, Thlaapa Pathe lasaw zaw kha ama khingna haata a re yi.
Khazing ta kiema ma ri nguoluopa, a vaw riypa chuelyi hing avuoming kuv raw luo pi va yi.
Cuorasala cawsaa pakha ta Caapathe suv kha lie tehte a khuopa ca, “Cawsaa hing khaapata cuo te ma kaw na pacuo? A thiy thepa hing khaapata cuo te ma se na hie?
Iema kha cuo khata chung avuoming laata a cawta aa ne vie ta na tue yi; rungnaana hne pa-uvsathyina byilakhuv kha pakhuv yi cate,

hmangting bangkhuo kha iema phyipazaa rawlie na chi,” a ta. Hmangting bangkhuo kha iema kuv raw luo na a chi diy ma ta tiyta, Khazing ta iema uvna leluo ta a chipa suokha hmuo aw vyi. Cuorasala ata hing ca hmangting bangkhuo iema kuv rawlie a awpa kha hmung valie puv.

Cadyiseca, Khazing vihnyina thueta cawsaa bangkhuo cuota thiyna ang riypata cuo khata chung avuoming laata aa ne vie ta chipa Zingsuv ca thiyna ruvnaana a angna thue khata rungnaana hne pa-uvsathyina byilakhuv ca pakhuv pata a cuo.

Hmangting bangkhuo a tuetuv hne a pa-aw satuv Khazing ta cawsaa hluvpuv kha rungnaana pahmung sa riypata ama zangna hruothuna byi a cuopa kha te-angna taata a tling pata a tuepa ca aa tlapa hmang hrahring tana a cuo.
Duo a pacu satuv hne duopacu sapa tie paa ca pakha tana a cuo. Caacuonakaw tana iema kha, uvnu hne sieta zaw ta pata ku riypata Zingsuv a nang a zaa lipa khata a cuo.
Ama ta, “Na ming ca i uvnu hne sieta zaw'a luo ukhyi'a angte, cawsaazaapuv hrawlie kha ica pathuosa aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata, “Ama na i zang aa,” a ta. Cakhutaata, “Khazing ta ina pipa i saata zaw hrawlie, hingpa lie hingna i aw,” a ta pakhaa.
Saata zaw ta thiy hne saa cuona suokha kha amaa hraw nakawta Zingsuv zaw capa thiy hne saa cuona ca aa hraw ra. Cahaacata a tuepa ca thiyna a angna thue khata thiyna uvtuv khachie kha para pata,
thiyna ciynapa ta ama hringzung lie sii ta aa ziypa tie kha lawna pi riypata a cuo.
Avuoming a bya riypata aa vawpa cuo li pata Abraham ciypathla zaw a bya riypa tana aa vaw tapa ca a siesa.

Caacuonakawta hmangting lie kha a uvnu hne sieta zaw haa khata a cuo a hu te, cata a cuona ca cawsaa ta sue angiethena ama cu riypata Khazing re a hriena lie kha nangduena hne zang tluo aa tlapa tluobyi lepa a cuona riypa tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca ama hrahring ta a te-angna ta pasupaliyna kha a ang tli nakawta pasupaliyna a angpa tie kha aa bya khu yi.
Caacuonakawta, vuoruo taata a pathe pata u pakhawpa uvnu hne sieta zaw, lucuotuv hne tluobyi lepa tana a cuo ta pata ma zangpa Zingsuv kaw hing rue syalya tie ung .
Moses ca Khazing ingchungkhue re lie zang tluo aa tlapa haa khata Zingsuv zaw ta ama a tlawtuv Khazing cunglie zang tluo aa tla ra.
Ing laata ing satuv kha pa-uvsathyina a hmung viepa haata Zingsuv ca Moses laata pa-uvsathyina a hmung vie.
(Tahematapakieca ing mekaa ca cawsaa pakhakha ta sapa a cuopa haata hmangting bangkhuo satuv ca Khazing ta a cuo.)
Moses ca Khazing ta hmieluo thue a ri riypa kha tehte a khuotuv riypa a cuopa haata Khazing ing lie kha zang tluo aa tla pata a aw.
Cadyiseca, Khrih ca Sacapaa a cuopa haata Khazing ing lie kha zang tluo aa tlapa ta a cuo. Kiema zaw hing ma zangna hne maa palesakhyipa anguopuona kha a cusa pata maa patuv kieca a ing ta ma cuo.
Caacuonakawta, Thlaapa Pathe ta a ripa haata, “Ataning hing a ueryi nama thyi kieca,
ruocaapa lie kama inaa zaa du ning haa yi khata, nama palung le khah se.
Kung sawliy chung i re hriepa ama hmung thluo pata, khapa hmang lie kha inaa zaa du yi.
Caacuonakawta capa chuo cawsaa zaw cunglie kha i hi haa te, ‘Ama palung kha si chie pari te, i luopuv kha pachang va yi,’ i ta.
I hi haa pata chie i sapa haa yi ta, ‘Iema ca i pahyna luo kha a ngie'a va yi,’” i ta.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, a hringpa Khazing a ruosena te ta zang lina pathiypalung chiepa kha niema pakha hmuo nama hnyi li riypata a raaring tie ung.
Cuorasala hangthenapa suena ta nama palung aca pale sa li riypa yi ta, “ataning,” ma tapa a aw chung bangkhuo a ning tating ta pakha hne pakha kha a pasu tie ung.
Tahematapakieca a hruothu baataata ma za hnyipa hnaanguona kha a chuona te ta a cusa pata maa patuv kie kyalya na, Khrih hne a hraw rapa ta ma cuo aa.
Caapathe ta, “Ataning hing a ueryi nama thyi kieca, amaa zaa du ning haa khata nama palung le khah se,” a ta.
Ahungma a ueryi thyi te a dutuv ca a cuo? Moses luochiyna rawlieta Izipt ruo a vya pyasepa tie kha cuo va yi ma?
Ahung cunglie ma kung sawliy chung a hi a haa? Suena ama tue nakawta ruocaapa lie a thiypa tie cunglie kha cuo va ma?
Ri namaa ngie li kieca ama aa pahyna luo kha a ngie khu'a va ung ciy ta pata ahung kha ma chie a sa yi?
Caacuonakawta ama zang lina kawlieta adingna luo amaa ngie khu lipa kha ma hmung.
Caacuonakawta, apahyna luo a ngiena riypa biekuo aa pahaw kalie ningta, niema pakha hmuo a ngie li pata nama aw li riypata a raaring ung siy.
Tahematapakieca thuophaa ca iema'a luo a chiypa haata kiema'a luo zaw a chiy ra. Cuorasala zangna ta amaa paw li nakawta ama thyipa bie ta iema kha thlahne va yi.

A zangpa kiema ca Khazing ta a ripa haata apahyna luo kha maa ngie. Khazing ta, “I hi haa pata chie i sapa haa yi ta, ‘Iema ca i pahyna luo kha a ngie'a va yi,’” a ta. Chuelyi a sa baataata a re ca a patlung tli raalaa pata hing haa hingta a ri.
Tahematapakieca suv kha lieta ning sariyna kaw hne aa patuv pata a raw luo haa hingta a ri, “Khazing ca ning sariyna lie kha a re taata aa pahy,” a ta.
Calie ngiethie cata, “Iema ca i pahyna luo kha a ngie'a va yi,” a ta pakhaa.
Caacuonakawta a ngie riypa chekha a ngaa kalie yi te, thuophaa zaa thyi taapa tie ca ri amaa ngie li nakawta a ngie khu va yi.

Khazing ta ning ning kha kha, “ataning,” ta pata thli te Caapathe lie a ri ciepa haata cuo pasiypuv khutaa khata David'a lie a ripa ca, “Ataning hing, a ueryi nama thyi kieca, nama palung le khah se,” a ta.
Joshua ta apahyna hing za pi yi sala, Khazing ta ning hrangpa kaw hing ri'a vyi.
Cahaacata a cuo nakawta sabbath apahyna ca Khazing cawsaa zaw cuota a aw kalie.
Tahematapakieca Khazing ca a re taata aa pahypa haata, Khazing apahyna luo a ngiepa tie zaw ama re taata amaa pahy ra aa.
Capa iema ri a ngie lina haa cata kiema pakha hmuo Khazing apahyna luo a ngie li pata ma aw li riypata a cuo khu chung ta a zue ung siy.

Khazing bie ca hring te a cahra. Kuo hning ta a cahrepa zueziy laata a cahre vie. Pathiypalung hne thlaapa kha cuose, ruv cakhiy hne ruv lathliy kha cuose dawpahli khu te, pathiypalung ta aa tingpa hne a ruepa zaw kha a pachang diy.
Sapa hmang khaapahmuo a hmiekunglie a nu khu vyi. Cuorasala ama hmielie ca a luotaalaa diy te ama'a lie kha ma kaw cyicuo ca maa ri kaluo aa.
Caacuonakawta kiema ca vuoruo luo a chiy tlipa a lesyipa tluobyi le cepa, Zingsuv, Khazing Sacapaa kha ma hnyi nakawta ma zangna kha a cusa pata patuv ung siy.

Tahematapakieca ma tluobyi lepa ca ma thaadyana lie kha kaw malie a pacuo lipa hne ngie malie a chi lipa cuo vyi, cuorasala kiema haata akuo ting taata pasupaliyna a taw rapa cuo te, suena ca hnyi vyi.
Caacuonakawta aa hu cuo ningta nangduena hne vihnyina kha ma hmung the riypata a vihnyina byithude luo ca riephasa pata pangie ung siy.
Cawsaa zaw hraw taata a tlawpa tluobyi lepa bangkhuo ca cawsaa bangkhuo cuota Khazing kha lasaw a pi riypa hne sue angiethena cuota hriykhungrina a tue riypata re pipa tana ama cuo.
Ama zaw a thaadyapa a cuo ra nakawta ruena a cawpa hne luo a piepa tie cunglie kha kawpacuona a hnyi.
Cahaacata a cuo nakawta ama cuo hne cawsaa zaw cuo khata hriykhungrina kha a tue aa hu.
Hing pa-uvsathyina a hmungpa re hing ahungtahmuo ama hne ama a pi khu vyi. Cuorasala Aaron a kupa haa khata Khazing ta a ku kie dyi hrie khu pata a cuo.
Caacuonakawta Khrih zaw ama hne ama kha tluobyi lepa cuo riypata a cyicalang vyi. Cuorasala ama kha, “Nama ca i Sacapaa tana na cuo, ataning hing na Paa ta i cuo,” ta te,
a hrangpa suv kha lie zaw, “Nama ca Melkhizedek tluobyi cuona phung haata, chuozaa tluobyi tana na cuo,” a tatuv khana tluobyi lepa luo a cyicalang.
Zingsuv ca saapa ta a aw ningta thiyna taata a khuo khutuv Khazing'a luo kha khuosa ta khi te mingthliy hneta thlaachuona ta paa a kie. Pa-uvsathyi aa tlapa aa pina thueta thyipa pata a cuo.
Khazing Sacapaa a cuo raalaa pata a te-angna khata ri-angiena aa cuv.
Tluo a tlingpa ta tuepa a cuo tiyta ama ri a ngiepa bangkhuo cuota chuozaa khuona hruopuv ta a vya cuo.
Khazing ta Melkhizedek tluobyi cuona phung haata tluobyi lepa ta a pacuo sa.
Hingpa kawlie hingta ri riypa a hluvsa ma hnyi, cuorasala bie nama thyi the li nakawta niema'a lie pasie sa hing a ruv ciemuo.
Ata hing ca pacuvtuv cuo riypa hmuo namaa de tli raalaa pata Khazing bie kha a hruothu taata pacuv pakhaatuv namaa hu. Sacuopa cuo li pata ahnungtiy pi namaa hu.
Ahnungtiy a dangpa ca haaseta ta cuo yi te, adangna bie kha thyi khu the valie yi.
Cuorasala sacuopa ca uvthyita cuota cuo te, iema ca amaa tawpa hmang khata a chiepa hne a phapa thleduo the riypata a pacuv tlipa tie tana ama cuo.

Caacuonakawta Khrih kaw a hruothuna pacuvna luo kha kaa li tli pata sang siy tli ung sala a tluotlingpa pacuvna luo kha tungle ung siy. Thiyna luo malie a chiypa re taata a ngiepachiyna kaw, Khazing zangna kaw,
tiynawna kaw, kuvkhangna kaw, a thiypa tie thupakhaana kaw, hne chuozaa suebieripana kaw zaw kha ca a pacuv pakhaa a hu va tli.
Khazing ta malie a khingkhyi kieca hmieluo na ma tung'a ung.
Tahematapakieca Khazing khena chunglie zaa aw buo tlipa tie, vuoruo lasaw kha a pacuo buo tli yi te Thlaapa Pathe a ting buo tlipa tie,
Khazing bie a phazya kha a pacuo tlipa tie hne a vaw riypa chuo a cahrana kha a pacuo tlipa tie

ama cuo raalaa pata a lie pakhaapa tie ca sue a ngiepachiyna luo kaakhyi pakhaa khu pata cuo va yi. Tahematapakieca Khazing Sacapaa kha vieluo lie khepuo pakhaa yi te cawsaa hmielie nangzaa hmiechi ta a tue pakhaapa tana ama cuo.
Zaa saa canyi lawmawpa khytiy kha saw te lu a thlupa paa cuota thyipaa pha a papyapa alyi ca Khazing thluechiy a hmungpa alyi tana a cuo.
Cuorasala capa alyi ca ta ahling kung hne aphuv dyi a papu sa kieca a thlahnena aw li'a pata a chuona ta ca chiesa pata myi ta rue riypa tana a cuo aa.
Duepa zaw, hing haa hingta ma ri raalaa pata niema kawlieta ca khuona a hnyipa hmang pha viepa na nama hmung aa ta pate ma hnaa a nguo.
Tahematapakieca Khazing ca aa dang lipa cuo vyi; ama hmiemangna cangta duena ta nama hriepa re hne mingpathepa tie nama mangchiynapa, ata tepa ta zaw nama tue nguoluopa hing maw'a vyi.
Niema bangkhuo hingta namaa nguopuopa a tlingna te ta kha haapa palungthuna kha a chuona te ta hnyi patlung ung tapa maca khing yi.
Cakiedyina niema ca nama thaa thuv li pata zangna hne palungpasiyna ta Khazing biekuopa a hmungpa tie haa khata nama hring khu aa.
Khazing ta Abraham'a lie biekuona a za tue ning kha ama ming laata a le viepa ming hmuo riy a aw li nakawta ama ming kha hmuo te,
“Thluechiy ca pi'a angte ica papungpazaa sa hrahring aa,” a ta.
Abraham ca palung pasiysa pata a huo nakawta bie aa kuopa ca a hmung.
Cawsaa ta ama laata a le viepa ming ta chie aa sa kieca capa chiesana ca ta a i a chuena bangkhuo kha a pachuo sa.
Cahaacata Khazing ta atingna ca a thle khu'a vyi tapa kha a biekuona rucutuv tie'a lie a siesa pata a pachang sa khing tiy yi ta, chiesana ta bie a kuo yi.

Caacuonakawta thle khu a aw lipa hmang suohning, Khazing zaw ta a cuo lina kaw paluo sa riypata a cuo khu lipa hmang thueta ama'a lie a canawpa kiema ca ma hmiekunglieta ama chipa aruechuona kha va patuv riypata khuopuv ta thaazuo malie a pi.
Ma hringna cuota a hmisipa hne tiypalaw thaatungkyipa haata a tapa a nguopuona ca hnyi pate, capa maa nguopuona ca biena-ing pangzu hnangluo chungching abiena hmang te khata a vaa ngie.
Kiema cuopa ta a ruo lupa Zingsuv ca capa luo ca a ngie te Melkhizedek tluobyi cuona phung haata chuozaa tluobyi lepa ta aa li.
“Melkhizedek ca Salem siepahruo cuo te, Cungnungce Khazing tluobyi ta a cuo. Ama ca siepahruo tie a du yi te a te diyna taata a vya kaapa Abraham kha va daw te thluechiy a pi.”

Ama'a luo ca Abraham ta, “hmangting bangkhuo chung taa khata chehraachekha,” kha a pi. A ming siyluo a suokhana ca, “adangna siepahruo,” ta pata cuo te, cakhutaata ama ca Salem siepahruo zaw ta a cuo nakawta a ming siyluo ca, “diena siepahruo,” tapa zaw ta a cuo.
Nung li paa li, thukina aw li pata, a hringna hruothuna hne a chuona zaw aw vyi. Cuorasala ama ca Khazing Sacapaa haa khata cuo te, chuozaa ta aa hmangpa tluobyi ta a cuo.
Ma mingpa Abraham ta hmuo carie kuv taata a lapa hruosue chehraachekha a pipa paa hing kha tluv tama a lesyi tapa kha rue tie ung.
Levi ciypathla chungtaata tluobyi re a hriepa tie ca Abraham ciypathla, ama uvnu ta a cuopa cawsaa zaw'a taata chehraachekha la riypa kha nawbie ta a pa-aw yi.
Cuorasala, Levi ciypathla ta a cuo lipa paa ta Abraham'a taata chehraachekha kha pakhaw te, biekuona a hmungpa paa kha thluechiy a pi.
A le viepa na a caw viepa thluechiy a pi tapa ca i khu riypa cuo vyi.
Suv kha lie ca, a thiy thepa cawsaa na chehraachekha a hmung ta te, a hrangpa suv kha lie ca a hring ta pata tehte ama khuopa na chehraachekha a hmung, a ta.
Chehraachekha a hmungpa Levi na Abraham'a taa khata chehraachekha a pi ta khu pata a cuo.
Tahematapakieca Melkhizedek ta Abraham aa taw ning kha Levi ca a mingpa chunglie khana a aw kalie.

Cawsaa ca Levi ming tluobyi cuona taata phungbie kha hmung yi te tluotlingna ama za hmung pata a cuo kieca, Aaron phang tluobyi cuona cuo li pata Melkhizedek tluobyi cuona phung haapa tluobyi cuona ca khaapanakawma aa hu kalie?
Caacuonakawta tluobyi cuona aa thle kieca, phungbie zaw aa thle aa hu ra.
Hing haa hingta a kaw ama ripa paa hing mingphang hrangpa ta cuo te, hingpa mingphang chung taa hingta pakha hmuo bienatluophie lie tluobyi a hriepa aw buo va yi.
Tahematapakieca ma Byipaapa ca Judah phang chungtaata a cuopa kha a siesa pata pachangpa cuo te, Moses ta tluobyi kaw kha a ri tiyta hingpa phang kaw hne aa patuvpa hingta ri vyi.
Melkhizedek hneta aa lupa tluobyi phanghrangpa a pya tiyta capa ca a sie vie hryly.
Ama ca a phungpa haata saapa ciypathla cuona taata tluobyi a cuopa cuo li pata para khu a cuo lipa hringna cahrana taata tluobyi a cuopa tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca Caapathe ta, “Nama ca Melkhizedek tluobyi cuona phung haapa, chuozaa tluobyi tana na cuo,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta nawbie taapa ca a thaa dya te a tling li nakawta para pata a cuo
(tahematapakieca phungbie ca tluotling vyi); cuorasala ata hing ca anguopuona pha viepa kha a vaw te capa thue cata Khazing kha maa ngie ung.
Capa ca chie a sana ta pacu sa pata a cuo; tahematapakieca a hrangpa tie ca chie a sana aw lipa tana tluobyi ama vya cuo.
Cuorasala ama ca chie a sana tana tluobyi a vya cuo, tahematapakieca Khazing ta, “Abyipa ta chiesana hneta bie aa kuo, a palung kha thle buo'a vyi, ‘Nama ca chuozaa tluobyi tana na cuo,’” a ta.
Capa ca ta Zingsuv ca a pha viepa biekuona pacusatuv ta a tue.
Cakhutaata a hluo tluobyi tie ca thiyna ta za pha yi te ama re kha ama hrie patlung khu li nakawta a mingluv ta ama hluvsa;
cuorasala ama ca chuozaa ta a hring nakawta a tluobyi cuona kha aa hmang.
Caacuonakawta ama thueta Khazing a pangiepa bangkhuo kha a khuo khu pari yi, tahematapakieca chuozaa ta a hring nakawta Khazing kha paa a kiepa khu pari yi.
Caacuonakawta cahaapa tluobyi lepa ma hnyipa ca a phasapa tana a cuo. Ama ca a pathepa, risie riy a aw lipa, pyalyina a hnyi lipa, a suepa tie'a taata chepa hne vuoruo luo cyicalangpa tana a cuo.

Ama ca a hrangpa tluobyi lepa tie haa khata a suokhana ta ama suena cuota cuose, cawsaa zaw suena cuota cuose ning kha hnang ning kha ta hriykhungrina tue a hu vyi. Ama hne ama hriykhungrina ta aa pina lie kha chuozaa cuo aa zu pata yi kha ta hriykhungrina a tue tli pata a cuo.

Phungbie ta ca thaadyana a hnyipa tie kha tluobyi lepa ta a tue yi, cuorasala phungbie khutaata a vawpa, chiesana cangta tuepa biekuona ta ca chuozaa ta tluotlingna a hnyipa Sacapaa kha tluobyi lepa ta a tue tli.
Ata ma ri nguoluopa ta a ri khing cepa ca hingpa hing tana a cuo: Vuoruo Khazing byithude cacuoluo kuo ta a tupa tluobyi lepa ma hnyi, tapa hingta a cuo.
Ama ca cawsaa ta sapa cuo li pata Abyipa ta a sapa hmangpathepa hne a hmisipa thluodaa lie kha tluobyi lepa ta a cuo.

Tluobyi lepa mekaa ca Khazing'a luo pihluopa lasaw hne hriykhungrinapa sahring kha Khazing'a luo pihluo riypa a cuo nakawta, capa tluobyi cuo zaw ca ta hriykhungrina ta pihluo riypa suokhakha a hnyi aa hu.
Abyipa hing alyi cunglie a awpa cuo sala tluobyi cuo khu'a vyi, tahematapakieca phungbie haata hriykhungrina lasaw a pihluotuv tluobyi na a aw yi.

Iema ta hmangpathepa lie ama tuepa abiena ca vuoruo lie a awpa abiena a mingthlaapa paluosana tana a cuo. Tahematapakieca Moses ta pangthluodaa sa aa nang ning kha Khazing ta a raaringna pi te, “Tluocung lie ica pahmung sapa haa kha tana na sa aa,” a ta.
Cuorasala Zingsuv ca a pha vie karaapa tluobyi re kha pipa tana a cuo. Ama ca a pha viepa biekuona hneta aa patuvpa, Khazing hne cawsaa alalalie a pha viepa biekuona luosituv tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca a suokhanapa biekuona khana tling lina zaa hnyi va tapa kieca biekuona hrangpa aa huna riypa khaapahmuo aw vyi.
Khazing ta iema tling lina kha hmung te a ripa ca: “Abyipa ta, Israel ingchungkhue hne Judah ingchungkhue tie hneta biekuona thaapa i tuena riypa ning ca aa vaw nguoluo tli.

Izipt ruo chungtaata pyakhyi riypata ama kuv ta ca-ya yi angte luo i chiy ning yi ta ama mingchingmingvuo tie hneta i za tuepa biekuona haa khata cuo'a vyi. I biekuona kha ama ziypazue li nakawta, kama zaw iema cunglie kawpacuona hnyi va ang, Abyipa ta a ta.

Hmieluo thueta Israel ming hne i tue riypa biekuona ca hingpa hing tana a cuo, Abyipa ta a ta. I phungbie kha ama ruena chunglie chi'a angte, ama pathiypalung cunglie i cape aa. Kama kha ama Khazing cuo'a angte, Iema kha i cawsaa ta ama cuo aa.
Cakhutaata, ‘Abyipa kha pachang tie ung,’ ta pata pakha hne pakha kha a pacuv pata a chang'a va tli yi, tahematapakieca iema bangkhuo, a caw cepa taata a le cepa te khata ina pachang'a yi.
Caacuonakawta ama pha lina lie kha nangdue'a yi angte, ama suena kha a thyipa'a va tli yi ang,” a ta.
Khazing ta, “biekuo thaapa,” a tapa hingta biekuo taapa ca a ralepa hne a hlungpa ta a pali. A ralepa hne a hlungpa ca a ru hluota a vie paluo aa.
Biekuo taapa khata biena lie ziy riypa phung hne chuelyi lie hmangpathepa zaw a hnyi.
Tahematapakieca bienathluodaa kha sa yi te, a chuekhana kha hmangpathepa ama ta. Capa khuo chunglie ca myi vuona tung, cabya, hne Phuovaa viechuo zaw kha a aw.
A suohningna pangzu hnanglie kha Hmang Pathe Cepa tapa khuo a aw.

Capa chunglie ca rangpa-ue ruenapa siy bienatluophie hne a kuo bangkhuo siy ta ama pakhuv diypa biekuona thingkaw zaw kha a aw. Capa thingkaw chunglie ca manna viechuo chinapa siy bi, a daw a pakiypa Aaron khuecahryi hne biekuona capenapa lungphie zaw ama aw.
Capa cunglie ca rungnaana hne a bipa cherubim tie ta ama mathlaa ama pazu khuopa nangduena thude kha a aw. Ata hing ca capa zaw kaw hing tluotling pata ri khu'a vapuv.
Cahaacata ama pachiepazu diy khutaata tluobyi tie ca a chuekhana hmangpathepa chung luo kha ningting ta a ngie yi te, ama re kha ama hrie.
Cuorasala chuehningna chung luo ca tluobyi lepa dyi kha kung kha ta yi kha a ngie te, thiyse kha a cyi te ama cuo hne cawsaa ta lunghaaraa cuo li pata ama tuepa suena cuo khata hriykhungrina a tue.
Capa ca ta Bienathluodaa a chuekhanapa a aw chung bangkhuo ca hmangpathepa luo a ngienapa luopuv ca a pahaw valie tapa kha Thlaapa ta malie a pachang sa.
Hingpa hing ata chuo cuona pahmungsana ta cuo te, Khazing'a luo pipa lasaw hne hriykhungrina zaw hingta Khazing abietuv tie pathiypalung kha patling sa khu tange vyi.
Hingpa hmang zaw hing ca sa hne tiy dang riypa hne tiynawna phangphang hneta aa patuvpa, Khazing ta hmangting a parena cuo te dyi ta hmuo riypa, saapa hne aa patuvpa ziyphung tana a cuo.

Cuorasala Khrih ca a vaw tlipa hmang phapa hneta aa patuvpa tluobyi lepa cuona hne aa vaw tiyta, cawsaa kuv ta tue lipa, sapa chuelyi taata a cuo lipa, a le viepa hne tluo a tlingpa bienathluodaa taa khata
Hmang Pathepa luo kha luo kha ta chuozaa cuota a ngie te, mie thiy hne cuetaata thiy ta cuo li pata, ama pangpa thiy caci kha a cyi te chuozaa athlana kha malie a tuepa.
Tahematapakieca, a pathe lipa tie cunglie hipa mie thiy, cuetungpa thiy hne cuelaanung ruenapa buvcuo ta iema kha a pathe sa kie yi ca,

chuozaa Thlaapa thueta, risie riy aw li pata ama hne ama kha Khazing'a luo a pipa Khrih thiyse changchiy ta ca ima chiepha thleduona kha thiyna hne a patuvpa re taata a hringpa Khazing biena luo malie pathe sa li pata a aw'a ma?

Caacuonakawta Khrih ca ama a upa zaw ta biekuopa chuozaa ru kha ama cuna riypata biekuona thaapa lie arena luosituv tana a cuo. Tahematapakieca biekuo taapa lieta cawsaa ta ama za tuepa suena taata iema a thla riypa khata thiyna a ang.
Ru-ahuvna kaw ripa kieca ru-ahuvna caa a cape siypa hing a thiy hmisi tli tapa kha pacu sa taa riypa tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca ru a huvtuv a hring chung bangkhuo ca ru-ahuvna caa ca hmuo khu aw valie, a thiy khutaa kyalya dyi tana hmuo khu a aw.
Caacuonakaw tana biekuo taapa kha hmuo thiyse lipa ta ca pacu sa li pata a cuo.

Tahematapakieca phungbie lie a awpa haata, Moses ta nawbie bangkhuo kha cawsaa bangkhuo'a luo a za pathyi sa ning yi kha, tiy hneta pyapa cuetaata thiy hne mie thiy kha la te, hissop thingdaw hne tuvhming pang sepa kha hmuo pata nawbie caataw hne cawsaa zaw kha hi yi te,
“Hingpa hing Khazing ta niema bie aca kuopa yi biekuona thiyse tana a cuo,” a ta yi.
Cahaacata bienathluodaa hne abiena lie hmuopa bi bangkhuo kha thiyse ta a hi.
Hmisi ta ripa kieca, phungbie rawlie ca hmangting bangkhuo hing thiyse ta pathe sa te, thiyse lang li pata ca sue angiethena aw vyi.
Cakhutaata, vuoruo hmang hmingsuo a cakepa hmang zaw kha cahaapa phung ca ta pathe sa aa hu. Cuorasala vuoruo hmang hmisipa tie ta ca hingpa laa hingta a pha viepa hriykhungrina kha amaa hu.

Tahematapakieca, Zingsuv ca a hmisipa hmingsuo a cakepa, cawsaa kuv ta tuepa hmangpathepa luo kha a ngie vyi, cuorasala kiema zaw cuota Khazing hmiekunglie a luo riypata vuoruo luo hrahring kha aa ngie.
Tluobyi le cepa ta Hmang Pathepa chung luo kha ama thiy ta a cuo lipa thiy kha a cyi pata kung tating ta aa ngiepa haata Khrih ca ama pangpa a pi pata hriykhungrina tue pari a hu vyi.

Cahaacata a cuo li kieca chuelyi hruothu baataata ruvnaana a ang pakhaa pari na a hu aa. Cuorasala, sue pathena riypata ama pangpa kha hriykhungrina ta a pi te, cuo chuona lie kha yi kha ta chuozaa cuo aa de pata a zaa luo.
Cawsaa hing yi kha dyi thiy'a te bieripana ang riypata a cuo aa.

Cahaacata cawsaa hluvpuv suena phya riypata ama pangpa kha hriykhungrina ta yi kha dyi a pipa Zingsuv ca, a yihningna a luo'a te, capa aa luona lie ca suena kaw ri riypa cuo li tli pata a ngietie li pata ama a mangkhuopa tie khuo riypata a cuo aa.

Phungbie ca a vaw riypa hmang phapa a mingthlaapa dyi ta cuo te, a hmisipa hmingsuo a cuo li nakawta kung tating, aa pazue pata tuepa, aa lupa hriykhungrina khata ama'a luo a vaapa tie kha tluotlingna pi khu va yi.
Cata cuo li pata yi kha dyi hriykhung amaa ripa khata za pathe yi sala, suena na ma hnyi tapa kha rue'a va tli laa yi te, hriykhungrina kha tue'a va tli yi cuo va ma?
Cuorasala hingpa hriykhungrina hing ca ama suena kha kung tating ta a pathyi sa pakhaapa tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca cuetungpa thiy hne mie thiy zaw ta ca suena kha pathe sa khu vyi.
Caacuonakawta Khrih chuelyi luo aa vaw ningta a ripa ca: “Hriykhungrina hne pihluopa zaw kha khing vaciy, cuorasala kama cuota pangpasaa kha ina tingtuopa tli ciy;
myirue panaana ta pihluopa hne sue pathe sa panaana ta pihluopa cunglie kha na palung tluo vyi.
Cakhutaata, Kama ta, ‘Mang tie, Khazing, kama ca na khingna tue riypata i vaw tli, Vya Khazing,' (caataw caa-uv chunglie ca kama kaw na a cape) i ta,” a ta.

Ama ta, a cunglieta, “Nama ca hriykhungrina hne pihluopa hne myirue panaana hne sue pathe sa panaana ta pihluopa kha khing lipa cata na palung tluo vyi,” a ta tiyta, (hingpa tie hing phungbie haata pihluopa tana a cuo)
chachiy pakhaa te, “Kama ca na khingna tue riypata i vaw tli,” a ta kalie. Khazing ta suohningna kha pacu sa riypata suokhana kha a para.
Zingsuv Khrih ta Khazing khingna haata luo kha ta chuozaa cuo aa de riypata a pangpa ta hriykhungrina a tuepa thueta kiema bangkhuo ca pathesapa ma cuo.
Tluobyi tie ca ningting ta ama re kha hrie yi te suena a pathe sa khu lipa hriykhungrina kha ama tue pakhaa byalya.
Cuorasala Khrih ca suena cuota yi kha ta chuozaa cuo aa depa hriykhungrina a tue khutaata, “Khazing cacuoluo khata a tu te,”
“a carie tie kha a phyichaana ta tuepa ama cuo hluo li,” a huo.
Tahematapakieca luo kha hriykhungrina ta suena taata a pathepa tie ca chuozaa ta tluotlingna a pi yi.
Thlaapa Pathe ta kiema'a lie tehte a khuopa ca,
“Hmieluo thueta, iema hne i tue riypa biekuona ca, hingpa hing tana a cuo, Abyipa ta a ta. I phungbie kha ama pathiypalung chunglie chi'a angte, ama ruena cunglie i cape aa,” a ta.
A ri kaliepa ca, “Ama suena hne ama pha lina kha a thyipa'a va tli yi ang,” a ta.
Sue angiethena a awna hmang lie ca sue pathena cuota hriykhungrina a hu va tli.
Caacuonakawta, viesaa zaw, Zingsuv thiyse thueta hmangpathepa luo a ngie riypa kha a cusa pata anguona ma hnyi.
Capa a thiyse ca Abyipa ta a pangpa ta a cuopa pangzu kha thlaa pata kiema cuota a pahawpa hringna luopuv thaapa tana a cuo.
Cakhutaata vuoruo lie Khazing ing uvtuv tluobyi lepa ma hnyi.
Pathiypalung hmisi hne zangnguona ta Khazing kha a ngie'a ung puv. Ruena pha lipa taata pathe sapa pathiypalung hne a pathepa tiy ta pasiypa pangpa ta ama kha a ngie ung siy.
Bie malie a kuotuv Khazing ca zang tluo aa tlapa a cuo nakawta maa nguopuopa ca a cusa pata a patuv ung siy.
Cakhutaata a due riypa hne hmang pha tue riypa kha pakha hne pakha tuokhaatama maa pasu aa tapa kha rue ung siy.
Chekha ta ama tue tawpa haata, hmangkha ta namaa pung pakhawpa kha pathli khah ung. Nama pachangna haata, Abyipa Ning kha aa ngie hryly nakawta pakha hne pakha kha thaazuo a pi tie ung.
Tahematapakieca biehmisipa kha ma pachang thluo tli pata ngie a rawsa pata ma sue pari thluo kieca suepathena riypata hriykhungrina aw the'a va tli.
Cuorasala bieripana hne a dutuv tie a kuo diy riypa hihaana myi dyi khana ciyna hne huo riypa a cuo'a tli.
Moses phungbie a patluopa mekaa ca, “pachangkhyituv pahning acuolikie pathung,” ta tehte ama khuo kieca nangduena aw li pata thiepa ama cuo.

Caacuokieca, Khazing Sacapaa kha ciyzaana aw li pata a thawpa, iema suena taata a pathesapa biekuona thiyse kha siysaa a ri lipa, hne vihnyina Thlaapa kha a esepa ca kha tluv ta a ruv viepa duotenapa na ama ang thlu aa ta pata ma nama rue?
“Phuvlana ca kama huopa tana a cuo, kama na a thung'a yi ang” a tapa hne, Abyipa na a cawsaa zaw kha bie a ripa'a yi,” a tatuv kha ma pachang.
A hringpa Khazing kuv chung luo tla riypa ca ciy aa chiysa.
Cuorasala Khazing khena luo nama chiy khutaata te-angna chunglie a ruvsa pata nama za awna cuo, ahluo ta nama ningcuo kha rue pakhaa tie ung.
Cuo khakha ca zaapuv hmielie kha esena hne hrisaana za ang ung cate, cuo khakha ca khuopuv ta hrisaapa tie kha nama te-ang khyi.

Tahematapakieca thaw chunglie a awpa tie kha kawpacuona hnyi ung cate, hingpa laa hingta a pha viepa hne a cu viepa nama hnyi tapa kha nama pachang nakawta, nama hnyipa chechiy aca chuv diy zaw yi ta palungtluosa pata nama pi.
Caacuonakawta nama zangnguona kha thuse khah ung; lawmuo lepuv na aca phya'a yi.
Khazing khingna kha tue pata a biekuopa nama cu the riypata palung pasiysa pata aw tie ung.
Tahematapakieca Caapathe ta, “A ru hluota lieta, a vaw riypa paa ca aa vaw aa; ru'a vyi;
cuorasala aa dangpa i cawsaa ca zangna ta hring'a te, hnangluo a palipa bangkhuo cunglie ca, i palung tluo'a vyi,” a ta.
Cuorasala kiema ca hnangluo a palipa tie hne a viepa tie chunglie cuo li pata zangna hnyi te khuona a cupa tie tana ma cuo.
Zangna ma tapa ca maa nguopuopa kha ma hmung hrahring aa ta pata zangna hne, hmisi ta a awpa hne a cuopa hmang, ma ming ta ma hmung lipa hmang a aw, ta pata zangnapa kha tana a cuo.
Cahaapa zangna ama za hnyi nakaw tana ma mingchingmingvuo tie zaw ta Khazing palung kha ama za hmung.
Chuelyi hing Khazing bie tana sapa a cuo tapa kha zangna ta ma pachang. Caacuonakawta hmung khupa hmang hing hmung khu lipa hmang taata tuepa a cuopa kha aa luo.

Abel ta Kain laata cuhluo tluo aa tla viepa hriykhungrina a pihluopa ca zangna thue tana a cuo. Capa zangna thue cata cawsaa aa dangpa ta cuhluopa cuo te, Khazing hrahring ta a lasaw kha a cuhluo. Ama ca a thiy tli, cuorasala a zangna cata ata tepa hingta bie a ri kalie.
Enok ca zangna thueta thiyna a taw li pata lapa a cuo; “Khazing ta a la nakawta hmung khu pata cuo va tli.” Tahematapakieca ama ca lapa a cuo hluota “Khazing palung a hmungpa tana a cuo.”
Zangna li pata ca Khazing palung patluo khu pata cuo vyi. Ama'a luo a pangiepa bangkhuo ta, Khazing a aw tapa hne ama a huvpa kha lawmuo a pi yi, tapa kha ama zang riypata a cuo.

Noah ca Khazing ta hmung li liepa kaw a raaringna a pipa kha zang te a ingchungkhue khuo riypata tiypalaw a sa. Capa a zangna cata chuelyi kha sue be te ama ca zangna taata a vawpa adangna rucutuv ta aa li.
Abraham ca ru ta a cu riypa ruo luo kha kupa a cuo tiyta, khaapa luo ma i si aa tapa a pachang li pata ri a ngie te zangna ta a si.
Khazing ta bie a kuopa ruo lie kha ruohrang ming haata cuo kha chung zangna ta khy a sa. Biekuona suokha ru a cu pakhawpa Isak hne Jakob hne khata thluodaa chunglie kha khy ama sa.
Tahematapakieca Khazing ta patungpatie te a hruo a bangpa khypuv khana anguopuona hne a huo.

Abraham ca macuosa tli te, Sarah zaw saa a sa khu lipa a cuo raalaa pata, zangna thueta paa cuo khuna cahrana kha a hmung. Tahematapakieca biekuona a pituv kha zang tluo aa tla ta pata a zang nakaw tana a cuo.
Athiypa haata a cuo tli raalaa pata, capa cawsaa pakha chung taa cata, a ciypathla zaw ca puv yi te, “avuo lie aasiy zaa hne riyliy kielie ri tie lipa viehnang zaa,” ama ta.

Hingpa cawsaa bangkhuo hing Khazing ta bie a kuopa yi kha hmung li pata zangna chunglie ama thiy. Cuorasala luohlaa taata suo yi te bie amaa chang paluo. Chuelyi lie hing khyche hne ruohrang ming tana ma cuo ama ta.
Tahematapakieca hing haa hingta a ripa cawsaa zaw hingta iema huo a cuopa ruo na ama huv tapa kha ama paluo sa.
Iema ca ama thuse tlipa ruo khana ngie amaa buo pakhaa tapa cuo sala, kaa pakhaa riypa cuophaa ama za hnyi ri aa.

Cuorasala iema ta ama vuopa ruo ca ruo pha viepa, vuoruo tana a cuo. Caacuonakawta Khazing ca iema Khazing ta pata ama u riypa kha a nang zaa vyi. Tahematapakieca khypuv kha iema cuota a tingtuopa mangtli yi.

Abraham ta dyapasyana a ang ningta a sacapaa Isak hriykhungrina ta a pipa ca zangna thue tana a cuo. Biekuona zaa hmungpa paa ca a sacapaa pakha dyipa kha hriykhungrina ta pi riypa a ting pacie diy tli.
“Isak chungtaata a puvpa tie na na ciypathla ta ripa a cuo'a yi,” ta pata biekuopa tana a za cuo.
Khazing ca a thiypa zaw kha a pathu pakhaa khu ta pata a zang. A ripa haata Isak ca thiyna taa tana a vya thu pakhaa ta riypa tana a cuo hmisi.
Isak ta Jakob hne Esau kha hmieluo cuota thluechiy a pipa yi ca zangna thue tana a cuo.
Jakob ta a thiy'a nang cawta Josef sacapaa zaw thluechiy a pipa yi ca zangna thue tana a cuo, “a khuecahryi daw kha aa padu pata a bung te Khazing aa bie.”
Josef ta, a thiy'a nang cawta Israel ming Izipt ruo taata ama pya riypa a ripa hne a thiy tiyta a riyy kha tuokhaatama nama za tue aa ta pata a ri siypa ca zangna thue tana a cuo.

A za puv khutaata thla thung a tana te ta a nungpaa zaw ta Moses ama nupa kha zangna thue tana a cuo. Tahematapakieca haatiy thyi khing aa chiysapa kha ama hmung tiyta siepahruo bie kha hmuo ciy khu va yi.
Moses kha a kya lethaw tiyta ama ca Faro sacanung a sacapaa tana a cuo ta pata kupa a khing lipa kha zangna thue tana a cuo.
Suena chunglie cuo pachangta chung anuona laata Khazing cawsaa zaw hneta ruvnaana ang riypa kha aa tlaw viepa ca zangna thue tana a cuo.
Izipt ruo hnyirungna laata Khrih cuota nutaana angpa ca a sungnaa vie karaa ta pata a rue. Tahematapakieca lawmuo a hmung riypa khana a pachanglu.
Siepahruo hihaana kha hmuo ciy li pata Izipt ruo taata pya te, hmung khu a aw lipa Khazing a hmungpa haata palung pasiysa pata a ang lawpa ca zangna thue tana a cuo.
Sa-uvthyi zaw a thiepa khata Israel ming sa-uvthyi zaw kha a thie li riypa yi ta Lawsena pyi tue te ingchiypakaa tung lie thiy a pahi sapa yi kha zangna thue tana a cuo.
Israel ming ta Riyliy Sepa kha alyi huvpa haata ama tepa ca zangna thue tana a cuo; cuorasala Izipt ming ta te amaa zue tiyta tiy lie ama puo diy.
Ning sariy ama cahlung khutaata Jeriko khypuv dungkhuo a cingpa ca zangna thue tana a cuo.
Israel ming ngiepatlietuv tie kha a nu nakaw yi ta Khazing ri a ngie lipa tie hneta siyhrawnung Rahab a thiy ra lipa kha zangna thue tana a cuo.
I ri vie kalie'a ma? Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jefthah, David, Samuel hne profet tie zaw kaw ri riypa kha a cuo ta naa zu'a vyi.
Zangna ta pena hluvpuv kha ama te, aa dangsa pata ruo ama uv, Khazing ta bie a kuopa yi kha ama hmung, chingde pakaa kha ama paping,
a hlaa nguoluopa myi kha ama pache, zueziy taata ama law, thaadyana taata thaazuo ama hmung, rietuvna lie kha cahra yi te ruohrang rieka tie kha ama te.
Canung tie zaw ta ama cawsaa a thiypa tie kha pathu pakhaapa ama cuopa ta ama hmung. A hrangpa tie ta a pha viepa hringna luo thupakhaa riypata lawna kha hmung khing lipa yi ta tuechiena ama ang.
Cawsaa chekha ta pahnyisuena hne tuvna kha ang yi te, thaabuoliriy ta ciypakina hne thawtlana zaw kha ama ang.
Alung ta vaasa yi te, hluo ta ama tepachung, zueziy ta thie yi te, tuv vang zaw mie vang zaw kha a hryi yi te siypasa pata ama aw, riethyivuosuo pata aw yi te hrisaana ama ang.
Chuelyi hing iema hneta a phuv vyi. Iema ca ruocaa lie hne tluo lie kha a khiele yi te, lungkaraw hne alyikhue lie kha ama aw.
Iema bangkhuo hing ama zangna kawlieta pathuosapa ama cuo raalaa pata Khazing biekuopa hmang kha hmung va yi.
Khazing ta kiema cuota a pha viepa hmang kha malie a tingpa nakawta kiema hne li pata ca tluotlingna hmung'a va yi.

Caacuonakawta hing tluv ta a hluvpa pachangkhyituv tie ta amyi haata malie ama cadung nakawta hmangriypa bangkhuo hne malie a bepuopa suena hing thawsiy pata ma hmiekunglieta a awpa a ruo azuena lie hing temaana hne a ruo ung siy.

Ma zangna hruo a pathutuv hne a patling satuv Zingsuv kha ci li pata mang ung siy. Hmieluo ta a cu riypa palungtluona vuo khata vieluo cunglie thiyna nangzaana kha siysaa ri li pata ang te, ata hing ca Khazing byithude cacuoluo kuo ta aa tu.
Nama palung rie thyi te nama palung a ra li riypata ama hrahring ta a suepa tie ta hue yi te amaa duna kha kha tluv tama a ang tapa kha rue tie ung.
Sue namaa duna lie kha nama thiyse langna te tange ta ca a du valie ung ciy.
Khazing ta i saa zaw ta pata aca pasupa yi kha maw kanaa ung ciy? “I saa, Khazing pasiypa-yana kha siysaa ri li pata aw khah, duo aca te tiyta na palung chuo khah se.
Tahematapakieca Abyipa ca a duepa tie kha pasiypa-ya taw yi te, a cuhluopa a saata zaw mekaa kha duo a te taw yi.”
Pasiypa-yana cuota namaa tawpa ruvnaana kha ang law tie ung. Khazing na a saata zaw haata caa rue yi. A paa ta a pasiypa-ya lipa saata ama aw buo ma?
Saata bangkhuo ta amaa tawpa pasiypa-yana kha namaa taw li kieca saata hmisi cuo li pata riesaa ta nama cuo nakaw tana a cuo aa.
Ca hlyitaw taata, malie a pasiy a pa-ya riypa saapa luo nungpaa kha hnyi yi pate ma pa-uvsathyi yi. Hringna ma hmung the riypata thlaapa luo ma Paa ri changchiy ca a ngie tyly riypata cuo'a va ma?

Tahematapakieca ma paa tie ta ca a pha ce ama tapa haata cuo pachangta chung malie pasiypa-ya yi te, cuorasala Khazing ta ca kiema phana riypa hne ama pathena maa hraw the riypa tana kiema kha malie a pasiypa-ya.
Pasiypa-yana ca ma ang ningta ca palungtluo a chiy li pata ngiechi aa chiypa tana ma rue. Cuorasala cahaacata pasiypa-yapa tie ca a hnang taata adangnapa diena thyipaa khana ama hmung aa.
Caacuonakawta a risa tlipa nama buo kha pazu ung la aa cathangpa nama pakhuv kha cahra sa tie ung,
nama cakuona luopuv kha padang tie ung. Cakiedyina nama phyi cabiepa kha sawkhaw pathla li pata a tluo aa.
