Cawsaa bangkhuo hneta a re riypa kha a zue ung la a pathepa hringna kha hnyi a zue tie ung. Hring pathepa hnyi li pata ca ahungtahmuo Khazing kha hmung'a va yi.

Khazing vihnyina kha ahungtahmuo cu li pata nama aw li riypata a raaring tie ung. A khapa thingkung kya pu te ruvnaana a patlung sa nakawta cawsaa hluvpuv kha a papya a palyipa haa yi ta cuo khah ung.
Ahunghmuota aparuvsuena tue khah ung, thlaapa luo hmang kha siysaa ri li pata sa yi kha ning ta sa-uvthyi cuona a zaapa Esau haata nama cuo li riypata a raaring tie ung.
A hnang taata thluechiy kha a cu khing tiyta bu pata cuo te, mingthliy hneta thluechiy kha a huv raalaa pata a ngiepachiyna cuo hnyi va tli.
Niema ca hrie khu a cuopa tluo, myi a hlaa nguoluopa, khyzingna, thliychierichie,
hmyakaa ue paringna hne a thyipa tie ta iema'a lie bie hrangpa a ri vie li tli riypata paakiena ueryi luo kha namaa vaw pata cuo vyi.
(Tahematapakieca, “Saruopa hmuota tluo a de khu kieca alung ta vaasapa cuose,” ta pata pipa bie kha ang khu va yi.
Ama hmungpa ca ciy aa chiytuv nakawta Moses ta, “Ciy tuv angte na i cathang,” a ta.)
Cuorasala niema ca Zion tluo hne a hringpa Khazing khypuv, vuoruo Jerusalem, ri tie a aw lipa avuoming amaa hmyana hmang luo khana namaa vaw.
Cahaacata vuoruo lie ming khungpa sa-uvthyi zaw ahmyana, cawsaa bangkhuo bieripatuv Khazing awna, aa dangpa zaw tluotlingna a pituv thlaapa zaw awna,
biekuona thaapa hne arena a satuv Zingsuv awna, hne Abel thiyse laata bie pha viepa a ripa, hipa thiyse awna hmang luo khana namaa vaw.

Niema bie caa changtuvpa yi bie kha i li riypata a raaring tie ung. Tahematapakieca chuelyi lieta iema kha a raaringna a pituv bie amaa ngie li pata hmuo duotena taata ama law li kieca, vuoruo taata a raaringna malie a pituv bie kha maa ngie li kie changchiy ca kha tluv tama duotena taata law li pata ma aw hryly aa.
Khapa cuo ning kha a ueryi ta chuelyi kha a cahang; cuorasala ata lie bie malie a kuopa ca, “Chuelyi dyi cuo li pata avuo zaw kha yi kha i cahang kalie aa,” a ta.
Hingpa, “Yi kha i cahang vie kalie aa,” tapa hingta cahang khu lipa hmang zaw aa hmang riypata cahang khu a cuopa, sapa hmang tie kha hnyi pata ama cuo aa tapa na a paluo sa.
Caacuonakawta, aa cahang khu lipa pena kha ma hmung nakawta a law ung siy. Khazing kha alawna hneta cuhluo tluo a tla pata pa-uvsathyina hne ciyzaana ta abie ung siy.
Tahematapakieca ma Khazing ca a kuo khupa myi tana a cuo.
Uvcanu haata pakha hne pakha kha a due pari tie ung.
Khyche kha ing a patlung sa ung la due tie ung. Tahematapakieca chekha ca cahaacata ama tuepa tana ama pachang li pata avuoming kha amaa patlung sa.
Thaw a tlapa tie kha maw khah ung, iema hne thaw a tla pakhawpa haa khata a rue tie ung. Tuechiena a angpa tie kha maw khah ung, niema zaw tuechiena a ang rapa haa khata a rue tie ung.

Achiyhiena kha cawsaa bangkhuo ta pa-uvsathyi yi se. Nung hne vaa ca zang tluo aa tla pata aw kaluo yi se; tahematapakieca aparuvsuena a tuepa hne nungvaathingsuena a tuepa ca Khazing na ama bie a ripa'a yi.
Tuokaa khing tuv khah ung; nama hnyi thathiypa lie kha nama palung tling se. Tahematapakieca Abyipa na, “Ca thuse buo li'apa yi angta ca thaw buo'a va yi ang,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta riephasa pata, “Abyipa ca naa byatuv tana a cuo; Khaapahmuo ciy'a va ang. Ahungma tuokhaa naa ta khu aa?” ta nguo tie ung.
Khazing bie caa zaa changpa yi nama luochiytuv taapa tie kha a thyi pari tie ung. Ama hringzya taata a kya pyapa phana kha rue pathiy ung la, iema zangna kha a mangpuo tie ung.
Zingsuv Khrih ca azuochaning hne ataning hne chuozaa ta a nanang buo vyi.

Pacuvna thaahluopa a phangphang ta luo capa pie sa khah yi se; tahematapakieca a ziytuv tie cuota thlahnena a hnyi lipa sa kaw phungluo ziyna ta ma pathiypalung thaa kha patlung li pata vihnyina ta ma pathiypalung thaa kha patlung hriy ung siy.
Bienathluodaa lie re a hrietuv tie ta a cunglie hriykhungrina sa ningna naw ama hnyi lipa bienatluophie suokha ma hnyi ung.
Tahematapakieca sue hriykhungrina cuota tluobyi lepa ta hmangpathepa luo a thiy aa ngiekhyipa hriykhungrina sahring a pangpa ca a rina hmang khungthing luo kha tana myi ta ama rue.
Caacuonakaw tana Zingsuv zaw kha a thiyse ta cawsaa zaw pathe khu riypata khypuv khungthing luota ruvnaana a ang pata a cuo.
Caacuonakawta kiema zaw ama'a luo, a rina hmang khungthing luo kha pya ung sala ama a angpa nangzaana kha ang ra ung siy.
Tahematapakieca hingpa lie hing aa hmangpa khypuv hnyi vapuv, cuorasala a vaw riypa khypuv khana maa mangkhuo.
Cakhutaata ama thueta Khazing ca pathuosa pari ung siy, capa ca ma pakaa ta Abyipa ming ma pathuosapa kha tana a cuo.
Hmang phapa tuena hne nama hnyipa malie a hraw riypa kha siysaa ri li pata aw khah ung. Tahematapakieca kha haapa hriykhungrina khana Khazing palung a patluopa ta a cuo.

Nama luochiytuv tie kha ciyzaa ung la ama ri a ngie tie ung. Tahematapakieca niema kha ca mangchiy yi te ama rehriepa kha Abyipa'a luo ama chang khing'a nakawta, ama re kha palung tluosa pata ama hrie the riypata ama ri kha a ngie tie ung. Ama ngiechipuo pata hrie yi sala niema cuota pha the'a vyi.
Thlaa malie chuopa tie ung; hmangting kha pa-uvsathyi tluo aa tla pata ma hrie khing nakawta ma chiepha thleduona ca a pathe.
Niema'a luo a catli pata ina vya pachiy sa khu riypata thlaa nama chuo riypa kha khuopuv ta icaa hu yi.
Chuozaa biekuona thiyse thueta a lesyipa tuvkhietuv ta a cuopa Abyipa Zingsuv kha thiyna taata a pathu pakhaapa diena Khazing ta
Zingsuv Khrih thueta a khingna hne kiema hrawlie ama palung a patluo riypa hmang a hrie khu riypata hmang phapa bangkhuo ta tluo ca patling yi se. Rungnaana ca ama'a lie chuozaa ta aw mang sue.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, a pachangta tah i vya capepa ica pasunapa yi i bie hing palung pasiysa pata nama ziy riypata paa ica kie yi.
Ma uvnupa Timote kha thaw chungtaata a pya tli tapa ica pachang sa khing yi. A vya chiy hmuo kieca, niema icaa taw thue yi hing i vya chiyle aa.
Luo caa chiytuv tie hne mingpathepa tie kha bie naa changpa tie ung. Italy ruo lie a awpa ma uvnu zaw ta bie acaa chang yi.
Vihnyina ca nama bangkhuo cunglie aw mang sue.
Khazing hne Abyipa Zingsuv Khrih changtaapa ta a cuopa Jeim ta, Chuelyi khy ting ta aa chepatlaapa phang hraa hlyihning tie kha: Bie icaa chang yi.
I uvnu hne sieta zaw, pasupaliyna phangting hne namaa taw tiyta nama palung tluo se,
tahematapakieca nama zangna lie dyapasyana namaa tawpa khata ang khuna aca pahnyi sa yi tapa kha nama pachang.
Nama phahlana aw li pata ruena aa kypa hne tluo a tlingpa nama cuo riypata nama ang khuna kha paky tie ung.
Niema hrawlie pakhakha ta singna aa phahla kieca, cawsaa bangkhuo kha palung tlingsa pata hne pahyasa pata a pipa Khazing kha a hie se.
Cuorasala palung luolue li pata zangna ta a hie se, tahematapakieca palung luoluena a hnyipa ca thliychie ta a pazupa riyliy tiylaw haa tana a cuo,
tahematapakieca a palung luolue te palung lung hning a phyapa hne hmangting lie a palung a hmang lipa ca Abyipa'a taata suokhakha hmung riypa kha a nguopuo khah se.
Zangtuv aa phahlapa ca calangthawpa a cuo tiyta a palung tluo sala,
zangtuv a hnyirungpa ca pachungpa a cuo tiyta a palung tluo se, tahematapakieca a hnyirungpa ca ruo chunglie paapaapa haata a lang aa.
Ning ca kya chiy te a paling tiyta ruo kha a e, paapaapa ca zung te a puvthena kha a ra. A hnyirungpa tie ca cahaacata cuo'a yi te, ama re lie amaa taw amaa muo yalya kha tana ra'a yi te ama vie aa.
Pasupaliyna a ang khupa ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo. Cahaacata dyapasyana kha a ang khupa ca ama ta a duepa zaw'a lie Abyipa ta bie a kuopa yi hringna byilakhuv khana ama hmung aa.
Pasupaliyna na ang tiyta, “Khazing na naa pasu naa paliy,” ta khah; tahematapakieca Khazing ca pha lina ta pasupaliy khu li pata ama zaw ta pakha hmuo pasupaliy va yi.
Cuorasala cawsaa pakha ca a saapa khingna khata pasupaliy khu te a dung a vie khu.
Capa a khingna ca nu haata phya te suena kha a pachuo, suena ca ale khing a tlung tiyta thiyna a pachuo.
Duepa zaw dung khupa ta cuo khah ung.
Pahyasa pata pipa bangkhuo hne lasaw tluotlingpa ca cung luo taa tana ama cuo. Khena Paa'a taata zaa cungpa ta cuo te, ama'a lie ca ningdiy haata a hnyilena hne athlena aw vyi.
A sapa hrawlie thyipaa taapa cuo riypata a tingnapa a tling khuna riypata biehmisipa lie kha malie a sa.
I duepa zaw hingpa hing a thyi pari tie ung: ahung nama cuo zaw naathliena lie kha catli ung la, bierina lie hne hihaana lie kha nama lie a riy se.
Tahematapakieca nama hihaana hingta Khazing adangna kha paluo sa khu vyi.
Caacuonakawta a pyalyipa hne a pha lipa zyazaa bangkhuo ca thaw ung la nama hringna caa khuo khupa yi nama chunglie tuv ciepa a bie kha a panena hne cuhluo tie ung.
Khazing bie kha a tue ta a tuetuv cuo tie ung, a thyi dyi thyi pata niema hne niema a dungpa cuo khah ung.
Tahematapakieca Khazing bie kha a thyi dyi thyi te a tue lipa ca iema hne iema kha thlaluo lie a mangpa haa tana ama cuo;
iema hne iema kha a mang yi te ama cakuo khutaata khaapama ma lu tapa kha ama maw paluo.

Cuorasala hyazangna phungbie, tluo a tlingpa phungbie lie kha a mang yi te a ziy paripa tie ca a thyi dyi thyi te a maw paluopa cuo li pata tue te a ziypa ama cuo nakawta ama tuena cunglie kha thluechiy pipa tana ama cuo aa.
Pakhakha ta biena luo a zuepa tana i cuo ta sala a palyi kha aa ve khu li kieca a pathiypalung kha a dungpa cuo te a bienapa ca muo hnyi vyi.
Paa Khazing hmielieta pathe te pyalyina a hnyi lipa biena tapa ca: ruvnaana a tawpa haaraa hne nunghlyi mangchiypa hne ama hne ama kha chuelyi pyalyina ta aa kaa li riypata a vena kha tana a cuo.
I uvnu hne sieta zaw, ima rungnaana Byi Zingsuv Khrih a zangpa nama cuopa haata hmiemang parung khah ung.
Abiephungpa ta cawsaa pakha kha siy kuvpahryi hne cawphasapa a tue pata namaa pungna luo kha a vaw te, siypasapa pakha kha caw a cawkarawpa hneta aa vaw ra tiyta,
cawphapa a tuepa kyihuo khata, “Hingpa lie hing a tu tie,” ta ung cate a siypasapa kyihuo khata, “Hue lie hue vaa daa tie,” acuolikie, “I phyi thabaw lie dakhang lie hing a tu tie,” nama ta kieca,
niema hrawlie kha pahlyipalena nama tue pata cuo te, ruena pha lipa hne tana biechina nama tue cuo va ma?

I duepa uvnu hne sieta zaw, naathlie tie ung. Khazing ta hingpa chuelyi lieta siypasapa tie hing zangna lie a hnyirungpa cuo riypa hne ama a duepa zaw bie a kuopa yi pena ru cu riypa tana aa tlaw yi cuo va ma?
Cuorasala niema ca siypasapa tie kha nama ese. A hnyirungpa tie khana caa tlawpuo yi cuo va ma? Bieripana zung luo caa dalepa yi kha iema na a cuo yi cuo va ma?
Niema aca paphyapa yi ming pha cepa kha a thuo a pachipa ca iema na a cuo yi cuo va ma?
“Nama naa duepa haata na ingpaa kha va due tie,” tapa Caapathe lie phungbie sungnaapa hing nama patling sa kieca hmang pha a tuepa ta nama cuo.
Cuorasala pahlyipalena na tue kieca suena a tuepa cuo cate, phungbie ta a suepa ta pata bie aca chipa.
Tahematapakieca ahung a cuo zaw phungbie bangkhuo a ziy pata suokha a ziy li kieca phungbie bangkhuo a ziy lipa tana aa li.
Tahematapakieca, “Nungvaathingsuena tue khah,” a tapa khana, “Lie va naw khah,” a ta ra. Nungvaathingsuena na tue li raalaa pata lie na naw kieca phungbie a ziy lipa tana na cuo.
Caacuonakawta hyazangna phungbie ta bie a ripa riypa tie haata ri ung la tue tie ung.
Tahematapakieca nangduena a hnyi lipa kha nangduena aw li pata bieripa pata a cuo aa; nangduena na bieripana ca a te.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, pakhakha ta zangna na i hnyi ta sala tuena ta a paluo sa li kieca khaapama a thlahne aa? Capa a zangna cata ama kha a khuo khu'a ma?
Na uvnu acuolikie na sieta kha caw a tue riy hnyi li pata hne ningting ning riypa sa zaw hnyi li pata aw sala,
niema hrawlie pakhakha ta, “Diena hneta cakuo tie ung; a lungsa pata aw ung la riy bisa pata ning tie ung,” nama ta pata amaa hupa kha nama pi tlung li kieca khaapama a thlahne aa?
Tuena a hnyi lipa zangna ca a thiypa tana a cuo.
Cuorasala chekha ta, “Nama ta zangna hnyi cate kama ta tuena i hnyi,” ama ta aa. Tuena a te lipa na zangna ca na pahmung la, kama ta i zangna kha i tuena ta ica pahmung aa.
Khazing ca pakha tana a cuo tapa kha na zang; a phasa. Khuevuo tahmuo zang te aa cathang.
Ruena a hnyi lipa zaw, tuena a hnyi lipa zangna ca a thlahnenapa aw vyi tapa kha ica pahmung sa'a yi ma?
Ma mingpa Abraham ca a sacapaa Isak kha hriykhungrina ta bienatluophie lie a pi tiyta na a tuena thueta duopacupa a cuo cuo va ma?
Zangna ca tuena hneta a chiy pakhaw te, tuena thue ta zangna ca tluo a tling tapa kha nama pachang.
Cahaacata Caapathe ta, “Abraham ta Khazing kha zang te, capa a zangna ca adangna ta cuhluopa pata a cuo,” a tapa kha a tling. Caacuonakawta ama ca Khazing viesaa ta pata a cuo.
Cawsaa pakha ca a zangna dyi ta cuo li pata a tuena thueta duopacupa a cuo tapa kha nama pachang.
Cahaacata, siyhrawnung Rahab zaw kha biephyatuv tie kha ing a patlung sa yi te luo hrang taata a paruv ta a pathlienapa yi tuena thue kha tana duopacupa a cuo cuo va ma?
Tahematapakieca pangpa ca thlaapa li pata ca a thiypa haata, zangna zaw tuena li pata ca a thiy ra.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, niema a hluvpuv kha pacuvtuv nama cuo riypa cuo vyi, tahematapakieca kiema pacuvtuv tie hing malie laata a hlyi vie ta bie ripa pata ma cuo aa tapa kha nama pachang.
Tahematapakieca ma bangkhuo hingta hrie chie tue chiepa a hluvpuv ma hnyi. Bie rina lie richiena a hnyi lipa ca cawsaa tlingpa ta cuo te, a pangpa a uv khupa tana a cuo.
Aruo ca ma ri malie a ngie se ta pata a pakaa lie hmyakhe ma tuv kieca a pangpa yalya ta ma khingna luo ma pasi sa khu.
Tiypalaw khiy rue tie ung: a lesapa cuo te a cahrasapa thliy ta a pasi sa, cuorasala a cawkariyta tah a cuopa a palawmaana ta uv te a mawtuv ta a khingna luo kha a pasi sa.
Cahaacata palyi hing a cawta tah a cuo, cuorasala khuopuv ta aa pale taw. A cawkariypa myihliy ta ruo a kupuv a pakuo sa khupa kha nama pachang.

Palyi ca myi haa tana a cuo. Ma palyi ca ma pangpa chebuo zaw hrawlie a awpa pha lina aa hmyana hmang ta cuo te, ma pangpa bangkhuo kha a papyalyi sa. Ma hringna kha myi luo hmaw te, ama hne ama zaw kha hell taata a thupa myi luo aa hmaw.
Cawsaa hingta saruopa hne pavaa phangting, aa valepa hne aa thiylepa saruo phangting hne tiy chunglie a awpa saruopa phangting hing hri te a pasing khu,
cuorasala palyi a hri khupa ahunghmuo aw va yi. Thiyna ca-ie hneta a bipa, aa pahy buo lipa pha lina tana a cuo.
Ma palyi hingta Abyipa hne Paa Khazing kha pathuosa pate, capa palyi ngiethie cata Khazing hmingsuo a lu pata sapa cawsaa kha chie ma sa.
Thluechiy bie hne chiesana kha pakaa suokha taa cata a pya. I uvnu hne sieta zaw, cahaacata a cuo riypata cuo vyi.
Tiyhnaa suokha taata tiy thlungpa hne tiy khapa ama pya hne the'a ma?
I uvnu hne sieta zaw, thyikuv kung ta Olif thyi a pathyi the ma? Mingsuv kung ta thyikuv thyi a pathyi the ma? Tiy iepa zaw ta tiy thlungpa papya khu vyi.
Nama hrawlieta ahung hing ma a singpa hne a pachangpa ta a cuo ung ciy? Nama hringzya phapa, singna taata a pyapa nangnena hneta nama hriepa re khata paluo sa tie ung.
Cuorasala nama palung chunglieta hietliena hne niema kaw dyi a pacuona a aw kieca biehmisipa kha a du pata suena hne a palena kha tue khah ung.
Cahaapa singna ca cungluo taata a zuvpa cuo vyi, cuorasala chuelyi singna, thlaapa hmang a cuo lipa hne a pha lipa tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca hietliena hne kiema kaw dyi a pacuona a awna hmang lie ca a re lina hne pha lina phangting zaw a aw aa.
Cuorasala cungluo taata a zuvpa singna ca a suokhana ta a pathe, cakhutaata diena hne a bi, a nang a ne, a viesaa a the, nangduena hne thyipaa pha ta bi te, pahlyipalena hne phahruocuona hnyi vyi.
Diena a tuetuv tie ta diena chunglie ama tuvpa saciy taata ama pahriypa ca adangna tana a cuo.
Niema hrawlie namaa hru namaa inapa hing khaapa taata ma aa vaw? Nama chunglie rie a du nguoluopa nama saapa khingna taa tana aa vaw cuo va ma?
Suokhakha khing ung cate nama hnyi khu li nakawta cawsaa nama thie. Suokhakha kha khing ung cate nama hmung khu li nakawta namaa hru namaa i. Nama hie li nakaw tana nama hmung va.
Nama hie raalaa pata zaw hmung va ung ciy, tahematapakieca saapa anuona lie hmuo riypata aa hmuo li pata nama hie.

Nung hne vaa kawlie zang tluo aa tla lipa cawsaa zaw! Chuelyi hne a viesaapa hing Khazing hne a cariena tana a cuo tapa pachang va ung ca ma? Caacuonakawta chuelyi hne a viesaa a khingpa bangkhuo ca Khazing carie tana amaa li.
Caapathe ta, “Khazing ta ma chunglie a chipa thlaapa kha a duesa nakawta aa hrakuo,” a tapa hing ata cakhawpa ta rue kanaa ung ciy?
Cuorasala ama ta a hluv vie ta vi malie a hnyi; caacuonakawta, “Khazing ca a hruotlepa kha a du te, cuorasala raw a canawpa kha vi a hnyi yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta Khazing ri kha a ngie tie ung. Khachie kha a du ung la niema'a taata aa ruo aa.
Khazing kha a ngie ung la ama zaw acaa ngie ra'a yi. Niema a suepa zaw, nama kuv kha a siy tie ung. Niema a palunghluvpa tie zaw nama pathiypalung kha pathe sa tie ung.
Nama ngiechisa pata angiy-aphie ung la caa tie ung. Nama pahnyiparingna kha angiy-aphiena ta thle ung la namaa nuonapa kha ngiechina ta thle tie ung.
Abyipa hmiekunglie kha a pane ung la ama ta aca cyicalang'a yi.

Uvnu hne sieta zaw, pakha hne pakha kha nama thuo a pachi khah ung. Malie thuo a pachipa hne malie sue a bepa ca phungbie thuo a pachipa hne sue a bepa tana a cuo; cuorasala phungbie kha sue na be kieca nama ca phungbie a ziypa cuo li pata phungbie kha bie a ripapa tana na cuo aa.
Phungbie malie a pituv hne bieripa khuna a hnyipa ca pakha dyi aw te ama ca malie a khuo khutuv hne malie a para khutuv ta a cuo. Na ingpaa zaw bie a ripa riypata nama ca ahungtama na cuo?
“Ataning acuolikie mawluo khiy capa khy luo ca si'a pate, capa lie ca kung kha aw'a pate, sung pali'a pate tuokaa ma huv aa,” a tapa zaw, ata hingta a vaw ung la naathlie tie ung.
Mawluo hing khaapama a lu aa tapa pachang va ung ciy. Nama hringna hing khaapatama a cuo? Niema ca ata hing sungkhata a vya zu te a vie paluopa amyi haa tana nama cuo.
“Khazing khingna ta a cuo kieca hring'a pate capa ca hne khapa kha ma tue aa,” ta hriy tie ung.
Cadyiseca niema ca a hruo tle ung cate namaa pale; capa hruotlena bangkhuo ca pha lina tana a cuo.
Cakhutaata, hmang pha tue riypa pachang thluo pata a tue lipa ca suena a tuepa tana a cuo.
A hnyirungpa zaw, a vaw ung la nama cunglie a vya chiy riypa ruvnaana kawlie kha caa ung la a ngiy tie ung.
Nama hnyirungna ca hmaw diy te nama caw ca a pabung diy tli.
Nama siy hne nama ngu ca a se ta ce diy te, capa a se ca ta niema kha caa du'a yi te nama saa kha myi haata aca ning'a yi. Niema ca ning hnang cepa cuo tana sue hne thiy kha namaa pacung.
Naathlie tie ung! Nama lu lie rehrietuv tie kha dung ung cate namaa pangaapa ama thavie muo una ueryi hne sa caa hriepatuv tie zaw khina ueryi na Cungnungce Abyipa naa luo a chiy tli.
Hing alyi lie hing lunghruo tlungsa pata anuona chunglie nama hring; aca thiena riypa yi ning hne cuo cuota namaa pathu pacie.
Niema caa vielie lipa aa dangpa tie kha sue be ung cate nama thie.

Caacuonakawta duepa zaw Abyipa aa vawna te ta palung pasiysa pata aw tie ung. Lu a thlupa ta khytiy taapa hne khytiy hnangpa aa vawna te khata a lu taata a sungnaapa sa a vyi riypa kha palungpasiysa pata a huo taw.
Niema zaw nama palung a pasiy riypa tana a cuo. Nama palung a pacu tie ung, tahematapakieca Abyipa aa vawna riypa cuo ca aa ngie tli.
I duepa zaw, bie ripapa nama cuo li riypata pakha hne pakha cunglie kha a cie khah ung. Mang tie ung, bieripatuv ca chiypakaa liena aa daa!
I duepa zaw, Abyipa ming ta bie a phupa profet tie te-angna hne palungpasiyna kha a mangpuo tie ung.

Hmisi ta kieca ang khuna a hnyipa tie kha thluechiypa tie ma ta yi. Job ang khuna kaw kha nama thyi mangtli. Abyipa aa tingna hne kha tluv tama kawpacuona hnyi te nangduena a hnyi tapa kha nama hmung mangtli.

Cakhutaa cata, i duepa zaw, vuoruo cuose, alyi cuose, a hrangpa suokhakha ming ta cuose chie a sa khah ung. Suebieripana nama ang li riypata a cuo nama tapa kha “A cuo” ta ung la, cuo vyi nama tapa kha “Cuo vyi” ta tie ung.
Nama hrawlie ruvnaana a tawpa nama aw ma? Thlaachuo yi se. A palung a tluopa nama aw ma? Pathuosana hlaa kha sa yi se.
Nama hrawlie a tluo lipa nama aw ma? Khrihsaa luochiytuv tie kha ku yi sala, iema ta Abyipa ming ta chiytiy thuv yi sala thlaachuopa yi se.
Zangna ta thlaa ama chuona khata a pasapa kha a khuo aa. Abyipa ta patluo sa'a te, suena a tuepa zaw kha a ngiethe aa.
Caacuonakawta pakha hne pakha'a lie kha nama suena a phu ung la, thlaa a chuopa tie ung, caacuokieca patluo sa pata nama cuo aa. Aa dangpa thlaachuona ca cahra te hmang tue khuna a hnyi.
Elijah kha kiema haapa cawsaa tana a cuo ra. Khy saa li riypata khuopuv ta thlaa a chuo tiyta, kung thung hne thla caruv chung khy saa vyi.
Cakhutaata thlaa a chuo pakhaa ca avuo ta khy pasaa sa te alyi ta kung a pavyi sa.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw, biehmisipa taata a viepa pakhakha kha a hrangpa pakha ta a vya kaakhyi pakhaa tiyta,
capa a suepa a vya kaakhyi pakhaapa ca a suepa thlaapa kha thiyna taata khuo te, suena hluvpuv zaw kha a buvkhung tapa kha pachang tie ung.
Zingsuv Khrih lucuotuv a cuopa Piter ta, Pontas, Galatia, Kappadosia, Asia hne Bithinia luo carie rieciy ta aa chepatlaapa,
Zingsuv Khrih ri a ngie riypa hne a thiyse ta pathe sa riypata Paa Khazing ta aa tlawpa tie'a luo kha: Vihnyina hne thlaalungna ca niema'a lie tluotlingsa pata aw mang sue, ta pata bie icaa chang yi.
Ma Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih Paa hne Khazing ca pathuosa pata cuo mang sue. A lepa a duena chunglie kha Zingsuv Khrih thupakhaana thueta a hringpa anguopuona chung luo cuose,
vuoruo lie niema cuota chipa, a ra khu li tlipa, a pyalyi khu lipa, a lang khu lipa chung luo kha a thaa ta malie a papuv sa.
Niema ca ningchuoningpa thueta a vya luo riypa khuona cuota zangna thueta Khazing cahrana ta mangchiypa tana nama cuo.
Ata lie hing dyapasyana phangphang chunglie ruvnaana nama ang zaw ta hing hmang kawlie hing a law tie ung.

A ra thepa siy kha hmuo myi ta dyapasya pata a cuo. Siy laata a muo ruv viepa nama zangna kha a hmisipa a cuo ma ta pata dyapasya a cuopa ca Zingsuv aa luo thueta pathuosana hne rungnaana hne pa-uvsathyina nama hmungna riypa tana a cuo.
Ama kha nama hmung li raalaa pata nama due; ata hing ama kha nama hmung li raalaa pata ama kha zang ung cate, pakaa ta ri khu lipa a sungnaapa palungtluona nama hnyi.
Tahematapakieca nama zangna muo ta a cuopa nama thlaapa khuona khana nama hmung.
Hingpa khuona hne aa patuvpa hingta, niema cuota a vya cuo riypa vihnyina kha profetbiephu a ripa profet tie ta a phasa pata ama za huv pata a cuo.

Iema chunglie a awpa Thlaapa ta a pahmung sana haa yi ta Khrih cuota lieriy uopuopa ruvnaana hne a vya pazuepa rungnaana kaw kha tehte ama khuolu tiyta, ahungtama a cuo aa tapa hne khatiy tama a cuo aa tapa kha ama khieluo.

Iema ca iema cuota hrie lipa yi ta niema cuota ama hriepa kha pahmung sa pata cuo yi te, capa hmang hne aa patuv pata, vuoruo taata pathliepa Thlaapa Pathe hmuo pata niema'a luo thuophaa zaa phyapa tie thueta ata hing niema'a luo pathyi sa pata a cuo tli. Hingpa hmang hing avuoming tahmuo ama za hmung khing hringhruopa tana a cuo.

Caacuonakawta re hrie riypata nama pathiypalung lie a ting pacie pata aw tie ung; a ting pacie pata aw ung la Zingsuv Khrih aa luo thueta nama hmung riypa vihnyina lie kha namaa nguopuona ca bang tie ung.
Ri a ngiesapa haatiyta haa khata aw ung la Khazing nama za pachang li ningta nama za hnyipa saapa khingna kha ziy khah ung.
Niema caa utuv Khazing ca a pathepa a cuopa haata, nama tuepa bangkhuo lie kha pathe ra tie ung.
Tahematapakieca Caapathe ta “Niema ca nama pathe aa, tahematapakieca Kama ca a pathepa tana i cuo,” a ta.
Cawsaa bangkhuo kha pahlyipale li pata ama tuena haata bie a ripatuv yi kha Paa ta pata ngiechi namaa hie kieca, hing chuelyi lie khyche nama cuo chung bangkhuo hing ama kha ciyzaa pata aw tie ung.
Nama mingchingmingvuo tie'a taata ru nama cupa, khaapahmuo thlahnena a hnyi lipa hringzya taata a thlapa nama cuopa kha nama pachang. A ra thepa hmang ta a cuopa siy hne ngu ta cuo li pata
tluotling lina hne risie riy a aw lipa tuvtaata haapa, a muo sungpa Khrih thiyse ta a thlapa tana nama cuo.
Ama ca chuelyi sa hluo baataata a tlawpa ta cuo te, cuorasala ning hnangcawpa cuo lie hing niema cuota paluohuo pata a cuo.
Ama kha thiyna taata pathu pakhaa te rungnaana a pituv Khazing kha ama thue cata nama zang. Capa nakaw ca tana nama zangna hne namaa nguopuona ca Khazing cunglieta aa bang.
Biehmisipa kha nama ziyna thueta nama thlaapa ca pathe sapa cuo tli te, canakaw ca ta pakha hne pakha kha nama pathiypalung hmisi ta khuopuv ta namaa due.
A hringpa hne aa hmangpa Khazing bie thueta a ra thepa cuo li pata a ra the lipa saciy taata a thaa ta a puvpa tama nama cuo.
Tahematapakieca “Cawsaa bangkhuo ca aphuv haa tana ama cuo, ama rungnaana bangkhuo zaw aphuv paa haa tana ama cuo. Aphuv ca caa te paapaapa zaw ama lang,
cuorasala Abyipa bie ca chuozaa ta aa hmang,” a ta. Capa bie ca niema'a lie phupa thuophaa hing tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta zyatena hne hanghiena bangkhuo, a dang linapa, malie hietliena hne malie kawchie rina bangkhuo kha thaw diy tli tie ung.
A puv thaapa haaseta haata a pathepa thlaapa ahnungtiy kha khing ung la, capa thlaapa ahnungtiy thue cata nama hmungpa khuona chunglie kha nama lethaw aa.
Ata hing Abyipa phana ca namaa pacuo hmisi tli.
Cawsaa ta hmuo thaw ra yi sala Khazing ta a sungnaapa ta ri te aa tlawpa, a hringpa alung, Abyipa'a luo ca a vaw tie ung.

A hringpa alung haata thlaapa ing sana lie ca hmuopa ta cuo tie ung. Capa ca niema kha a pathepa tluobyi phang nama cuo riypa hne Khazing cuhluo tluo aa tlapa thlaapa luo hriykhungrina kha Zingsuv Khrih thueta nama tue khuna riypa tana a cuo.
Tahematapakieca Caapathe lie a ripa ca, “Mang tie ung, alung suokha ca Zion lie kha chi angte, a tlawpa hne muosungpa ingkiylung tana a cuo; ama a zangpa ahunghmuo nangzaa pata aw'a vyi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata niema a zangpa tie cuota ca ama ca muosungpa ta a cuo, cuorasala a zang lipa tie cuota ca, “Ingsatuv tie ta ama thawpa alung ca ingkiylung tungpuv ce ta a li'a te,
“Iema a pachiyna alung, Iema a liena alungpuvnung ta a cuo aa,” a ta. Iema ca lieriy uopuopa ama cuopa haata Khazing bie kha amaa ngie li nakawta amaa pachiy.

Cuorasala niema ca a tlawpa mingphang, siepahruo tluobyi, a pathepa mingphang, Khazing cawsaa tana nama cuo. Khyzingna chungtaata nang-uo aa chiypa khena luo caa kutuv yi Khazing ta kharuehaa hmang a tuepa kha tluo-ukhyi riypata a tlawpa tana nama cuo.
Ahluo ta ca niema ca Khazing cawsaa za cuo va ung ciy, cuorasala ata hing ca Khazing cawsaa ta nama cuo; Ahluo ta ca niema ca nangduena ca za hnyi va yi, cuorasala ata hing ca nangdue pata nama cuo.
Duepa zaw, khyche hne mingpe ta nama cuopa haata thlaapa hne aa dupa saapa khingna kha cahriy tie ung ta pata paa ica kie yi.

Jentail ming hrawlie kha ciyzaa tluo aa tla pata aw tie ung. Pha lina a tuetuv ta pata nama thuo ca pachi ra yi sala ciyzaa tluo aa tla pata nama hringpa kha hmung'a yi te, Khazing ca cawsaa bie ripa riypata aa vaw tiyta ama pathuosa aa.
Khazing hmie mang pata cawsaa ta tuepa nawhnyina bangkhuo kha ziy ung la, aa suo cepa siepahruo kha cuose,
pha lina a tuepa tie kha duote pata hmang pha a tuepa tie kha pathuosana pi riypata pathliepa byi tie kha cuose, ama ri a ngie tie ung.
Tahematapakieca hmang pha nama tuenapa khata a ngaapa tie khi cakhawna kha nama padie riypa ca Khazing khingna tana a cuo.
Khazing changtaapa nama cuona haata, cawsaa hyazangpa haata aw tie ung, cuorasala nama hyazangna ca pha lina buvkhungna ta hmuo khah ung.
Cawsaa bangkhuo kha pa-uvsathyi tie ung. Zangna lieta nama uvnu kha due tie ung. Khazing kha ciy ung la siepahruo kha ciyzaa tie ung.
Sii zaw, nama ziy tie kha pa-uvsathyi ung la ama ri kha a ngie tie ung. Duena hnyi te a nang nepa dyi cuo li pata a pyathupa ri zaw kha a ngie tie ung.
Tahematapakieca Khazing khingna nama pachang nakawta aa luo li pata ruvnaana nama ang kieca thluechiy na nama hmung aa.
Hmang nama tue chiena kawlieta tuvna nama ang kieca khaapama a thlahne? Cuorasala hmang pha nama tuena kawlieta ruvnaana nama ang kieca, Khazing thluechiy na nama hmung aa.
Capa repa ca tana kupa nama cuo, tahematapakieca Khrih zaw kha niema cuota ang tli te, a phyihnie nama paziy the riypata a mangpuo riypa aca chipa siy tli yi.
“Ama ca suena tue vyi, a pakaa taata hangna bie pya buo vyi.”
Bie chiepa ta ama chaw tiyta, bie chiepa ta palie va yi; ruvnaana a ang tiyta a hru va yi; cuorasala aa dang pata bieripana a tuetuv'a luo na ama hne ama kha aa pi.
Suena taata law pata adangna chunglie ma hring the riypata ama hrahring ta a pangpa ta vieluo cunglie ma suena kha phya te, niema ca a hmaa ta nama tluo mangtli.
Tahematapakieca niema ca luo za vie ung cate, cuorasala ata hing ca tuvkhietuv hne nama thlaapa caa mangchiytuv'a luo nama vya kaa tli.

Cahaacata, napuv zaw nama navaapa ri kha a ngie tie ung. Iema chekha ca Khazing bie kha ama zang li kie zawma bie kaa kha hmuo ri a hu li pata ama napuvnung a cuopa niema awtuvzyazaa khata zangtuv a pacuo sa'a yi.
Tahematapakieca a pathepa hne pa-uvsathyi aa tlapa nama hringzya kha ama hmung nakawta a cuo.
Niema namaa panginapa ca aleluo taata hmung khupa nama suo a phiezya, siy hne ngu namaa tuezya, hne caw namaa tuezya lie zaw kha cuo li pata,
Khazing hmielie a muosungpa hne chungluo lieta a pangina, a puvthe paripa nangnena hne diena palungphya khata cuo hriy se.
Capa ca na hluo ningta Khazing a nguopuopa a pathepa canung zaw ta ama navaapa ri a ngie pata amaa panginazya ta zaa cuo.
Sarah ca Abraham ri kha a ngie te ama kha abyipa a ta. Niema zaw phana tue ung cate ciyna khaapahmuo nama hnyi li kieca Sarah sacanung zaw tana nama cuo.

Cahaa ngiethie cata niema, navaapa zaw, nama napuvnung hne nama aw tiyta, niema laata a thaadya viepa ama cuopa hne iema zaw muosungpa hringna rucutuv ama cuopa kha pachang pata pa-uvsathyi tie ung, caacuokieca nama thlaachuona kha khaapatahmuo ca pakhuo'a va yi.
A hnangcaw ce ta i ri khingpa ca nama bangkhuo ta, nama palung a lu se, kawpacuona a hnyi ung, pakha hne pakha a due ung la, nangnena hne rawcanawna hnyi tie ung.
Pha lina kha pha lina ta a thung khah ung, biechiepa kha biechiepa ta a vielie khah ung; cuorasala thluechiy pina ta a thung hriy tie ung.
Tahematapakieca, “Aa nuosa pata hring khing te, ningcuo phapa a hmung khingpa ca, biechiepa ri kha a cadang yi sala, hangbie ri zaw kha cahriy yi se,
hmang pha lipa kha cahriy yi sala hmang phapa kha tue yi se; diena kha huv yi sala hmung a zue yi se.
Tahematapakieca Abyipa ta aa dangpa tie kha mangchiy pari yi te, ama thlaachuona kha a thyipa yi. Cuorasala pha lina a tuepa tie ca Abyipa ta hmiephaa pi va yi.”
Phana tue a khingpa na cuo kieca ahungma ruvnaana caa pi aa?
Cuorasala hmang pha na tue pata na te-angna na hmung tapa kieca thluechiypa tana na cuo. Aca pachiy zaw yi ta ciy khah ung, nama kharue zaw haa khah se.

Cuorasala nama pathiypalung chunglie Khrih kha Abyi ta hnyi ung la ciyzaa tie ung. Nama hnyipa anguopuona kawlieta caa hiehriypa pakhakha ama aw tiyta nama palie khu paluo riypata a ting pacie pata aw tie ung.

Nama palie tiyta nangnena hne pa-uvsathyina hneta palie tie ung. Nama chiepha thleduona kha a pathe pata chi tie ung. Cakiedyina Khrih chunglie nama tuepa zyazaa phapa kawlieta niema kha ca hue yi te nama thuo caa pachipa tie kha ama nang a zaa aa.
Te-angna hing na Khazing khingna ta a cuo ta pata a cuo kieca, hmang pha lipa tuena kawlieta te-angpa laata ca hmang pha tuena kawlieta te-angpa a pha vie.

Tahematapakieca Khrih hrahring zaw kha suena cuota yi kha ta aa dena te ta a thiy, niema kha Khazing'a luo a chiy riypata aa dangpa ca aa dang lipa zaw cuota a thiy. Ama ca saapa lie a thiy raalaa pata, thlaapa lie ca pahring pakhaa pata a cuo.
Capa thlaapa ca ta thaw a tlapa thlaapa tie kha phung a va chang yi.

Capa thaw a tlapa thlaapa tie ca Noah ta tiypalaw a sa ning kha Khazing ta palung pasiysa pata a huo raalaa pa yi ta, a ri a ngie lipa tie ta ama cuo. Capa lie ca cawsaa a cawta, ama bangkhuo ta pacari dyina tiy chung taa khata khuopa a cuo yi.

Capa ca ta a paluosalupa tiynawna ta ata hing niema kha aca khuo yi. Tiynawna ca nama pangpa lie a pyalyipa pasiyna ta cuo vyi, cuorasala Zingsuv Khrih thupakhaana thueta a phapa chiepha thleduona kha Khazing'a luo a hiena tana a cuo.
Zingsuv Khrih ca vuoruo luo kie te, a paa cacuoluo kuo ta a tu te, avuoming nawhnyina hne cahrana bangkhuo kha a uv diy yi.
Caacuonakawta Khrih ca a pangpa ta a za te-ang nakawta niema zaw cahaacata ang khu riypata a ting pacie pata aw tie ung. Tahematapakieca saapa ta a te-angpa ca suena hneta aa che tli.
Capa ca hingpa alyi lie a ngaapa nama hringna hing cawsaa khingna haa cuo li pata Khazing khingna haata nama hring khuna riypa tana a cuo.

Jentail ming ta ama tue khingpa hmang ta a cuopa saapa anuona, saapa khingna, sahmaa pariyna, khi-u pata anuona, khing ta ningdangna, duv aa chiypa kuvtuezuv abiena zaw kha aa de aa khaw pata nama tue ra mangtli.
Niema ca kha haapaapa duvkhing ta anuopaana lie kha nama aw ra li tli nakawta ama kharue haa te nama thuo aca pachi yi.
Cuorasala a thiypa hne a hringpa tie kha bie ripa riypata a ting pacie pata a awpa Khazing hmielie kha ama bie ca ripa pata ama cuo aa.

Caacuonakaw ca tana a thiypa tie'a luo zaw kha thuophaa ca phu pata a cuo. Cawsaa bangkhuo kha bie ripa pata ama cuopa haata iema zaw saapa lie ca bie ripa pata ama cuo raalaa pata thlaapa lie ca Khazing a hringpa haata ama hringna riypa tana a cuo.
Hmangting bangkhuo a chuona riypa cuo aa ngie tli. Caacuonakawta thlaa nama chuo khuna riypata a cadangna hnyi ung la singvaasa pata aw tie ung.
Capa zaw khutaa cata, pakha hne pakha kha a due pari tie ung, tahematapakieca duena ca suena hluvpuv khana a buvkhung.
A ciepuo li pata pakha hne pakha kha ing a patlung sa tie ung.
Khazing lasaw phangphang kingkaatuv pha nama cuopa haata ama'a taata nama hmungpa lasaw kha pakha cyicuo phana cuota hmuo tie ung.

Khazing ca Zingsuv Khrih thueta hmangting bangkhuo lie a rungnaa thena riypata phung a ripa ta Khazing bie hrahring kha ri sala, a re a hriepa ta Khazing ta a pipa thaazuo ta hrie se. Rungnaana hne cahrana ca chuozaa ta chuozaa te ama huopa cuo mang sue. Amen.
Duepa zaw, niema dyapasya riypata niema hrawlie a tlapa riethyina myi cunglie kha hmang a tlung buo lipa na kiema'a lie a tlung ta pata nama kharue haa khah se.
Cuorasala a rungnaana aa luo tiyta alawna hne palung tluo pata nama khi-u the riypata Khrih te-angna a hrawpa haa khata a law tie ung.
Zingsuv ming kawlieta thuochi nama phya kieca, thluechiypa tana nama cuo, tahematapakieca rungnaana thlaapa, Khazing thlaapa na nama cunglieta a aw.
Cuorasala niema pakha hing hmuo lienawna, paruvna, pha lina tuena kawlie hne cawsaa riethyi pina kawlieta ca te-ang khah ung.
Cadyiseca khrihsaa cuona kawlie tana nama te-ang ta pata a cuo kieca nama ngie chi khah se.

Tahematapakieca Khazing chungkhue tie taata patha pata bie ripana cuo ca a vya tlung tli; capa ca na kiema'a taata a patha ta pata a cuo kieca, Khazing thuophaa kha siysaa a ri lipa tie ama chuona ca khaapama a lu aa?
Cakhutaata, “Aa dangpa tie khuopa ama cuo riypa kha hmuo a ruv pata a cuo kieca, A suepa tie hne Khazing a pachang lipa tie changchiy ca tuokhaatama a cuo aa?”
Caacuonakawta, Khazing khingna haata a te-angpa tie ca phana ama tuepuo nguoluopa khata zang tluo aa tlapa Satuv Khazing'a luo kha a pi karue yi se.

Khrihsaa luochiytuv pakha adaahmang taata hne Khrih te-angna kha tehte a khuotuv pakha adaahmang taata cuose, a vya luo riypa rungnaana a hraw ra riypa a cuopa kama ta khrihsaa luochiytuv tie kha ica pasu yi.

Niema mangchiy riypata aca pipa yi Khazing tuvrung kha nama re a cuo nakaw dyi cuo li pata palung thusa pata mangchiy tie ung. Hrie muo hmung khing nakaw dyi cuo li pata hrie khingna pathiypalung hrahring hnyi ung la hrie tie ung.
Niema mangchiy riypata aca pipa yi tuvrung kha a uv ta uv khah ung, cuorasala acaa mangpuo riypa yi ta aw tie ung.
Cakiedyina tuvkhie byi ce aa luo tiyta a lang buo lipa rungnaana byilakhuv nama hmung aa.

Cahaa ngiethie cata niema kung nu vie tie ta uvthyi vie tie ri kha a ngie tie ung. Nama bangkhuo ta rawcanawna caw kha a hryi ung la pakha hne pakha kha a bya tie ung. Tahematapakieca Caapathe ta, “Khazing ta a palepa tie kha a du yi te, raw a canawpa tie kha vi a hnyi yi,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta a cuo aa de tiyta cyicalangpa nama cuo riypata a cahrapa Khazing kuv rawlie kha rawcanawna hneta khysa tie ung.
Niema kha aca mangchiy pari nakaw yi ta nama palungriethyina bangkhuo kha ama cunglie pachung tie ung.
Singvaasa pata hne padiypavuosa pata aw tie ung. Nama cariepa ta a cuopa khachie ca aa rung nguoluopa chingde haa tana a sie riypa kha huv te aa khie nguoluo.
Nama zangna kha a pacu ung la ama kha a du tie ung, tahematapakieca chuelyi lie a awpa nama uvnu hne sieta zaw bangkhuo hing cahaaca tana ama te-ang tapa kha nama pachangpa a cuo.

Cuo pachangta chung nama te-ang khutaata Khrih chunglie chuozaa rungnaana luo caa kupa yi, vihnyina bangkhuo a hnyituv Khazing ama hrahring ta namaa hupa kha ca pi'a yi te aca paraw pathiy'a yi, thaa ca patlung'a yi te aca pacu'a yi.
Cahrana ca chuozaa ta ama huopa cuo mang sue. Amen.

Kama ta niema kha thaazuo pi riypa hne hingpa hing aa hmuopa Khazing vihnyina tana a cuo tapa kha tehtekhuona ta zang tluo aa tlapa uvnu tana a cuo ta pata i ruepa Silvanus'a taata hingpa caa pachangta hing ica paphya yi. Hingpa vihnyina chunglie hing a cusa pata a daa tie ung.
Niema hneta a tlaw pakhawpa ta a cuopa Babilon lie a awpa Khrihsaabuv hne i sacapaa Marka zaw ta nama kuv aca patuv yi.
Pakha hne pakha kha nama kuv a patuv ung la duena ta a pahnuo tie ung. Khrih chunglie a awpa nama bangkhuo cunglie thlaalungna aw mang sue.
Khazing changtaapa hne lucuotuv a cuopa Simon Piter na, Ma Khazing hne Khuotuv Zingsuv Khrih adangna thueta kiema zangna tluv ta a sungnaapa zangna a hmung rapa niema kha caa caa paphya yi ang.
Khazing hne ima Byipaapa Zingsuv nama pachangna thueta vihnyina hne thlaalungna ca niema'a lie aa kysa pata aw mang sue.
Ama rungnaana hne phana thueta kiema malie a kutuv kha ma pachangna thueta hringna hne phana cuota maa hupa hmangting bangkhuo kha ama cahrana ta malie a pi tli.
A sungnaapa hne ale hringhruopa biekuona malie a pipa thue cata, karuo-awna kawlieta hingpa chuelyi lie a awpa rana taata law khu'a ung cate Khazing cuona kha namaa hraw ra khu aa.
Caacuonakawta nama zangna lie phana chachiy kha a zue ung la, phana lie kha pachangna chachiy tie ung;
pachangna lie kha kiema hne kiema a uv khuna kha chachiy ung la, kiema hne kiema a uv khuna lie kha ang khuna chachiy tie ung;
ang khuna lie kha Khazing ciyzaana chachiy ung la, Khazing ciyzaana lie kha uvnu kawpacuona chachiy ung la, uvnu kawpacuona lie kha duena chachiy tie ung.

Hingpa cuona hing niema huopa cuo sala niema hrawlie a lethaw kieca, hingpa cuona hingta ma Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih pachangna chunglie kha thlahnena a hnyi lipa hne a thyi a pathyi lipa ca pacuo sa'a va yi.
Hingpa cuona a hnyi lipa ca luongieta te dyi a hmungpa hne mingcuepa cuo te, a suena taata pathe sa tlipa a cuopa kha hmuo a mawpa tana a cuo.
Caacuonakawta uvnu hne sieta zaw, aca kuna yi hne acaa tlawna yi hing pacu sa hryly tie ung, cahaacata nama tue kieca a pachiy buo'a va ung ciy.
Cahaacata niema ca ma Byipaapa hne Khuotuv Zingsuv Khrih chuozaa pena chung luo a ngie riypa kha pahyasa pata pipa nama cuo aa.
Caacuonakawta hingpa zaw hing nama pachang ciepa hne niema'a lie a awpa biehmisipa chunglie a cusa pata a aw ciepa a cuo raalaa pata pathyi sa pakhaa icaa ting yi.
I pangpa ta i aw chung bangkhuo ca hingpa bie pachang sa pakhaa pari riypa hing a pha ta pata i rue.
Tahematapakieca ima Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih ta a siesa pata ina pachang sapa haata thiyna ta ina pha patang aa tapa kha i pachang.
I thiy khutaata hingpa hmang zaw hing namaa thyi pakhaa pari riypata i cuo khuna chung ta i zue aa.

Tahematapakieca ima Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih a cahrana hne aa vawna kaw kha maca pachang sa tiy yi ta singvaasa pata tuechawpa phungpahlaapa hmuo pata maca changpa yi cuo vyi, cuorasala a lesyina kha ming ta a hmungpa tana ma cuo.
Tahematapakieca Paa Khazing'a taata pa-uvsathyina hne rungnaana a hmung ningta Rungnaana Cungnungce'a taata ueryi a zuvpa ca, “Hingpa hing i Duepa i Sacapaa, i palung naa hmungsapa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Ama hneta tluo pathepa lie ma aw ningta vuoruo taata capa ueryi ca kiema hrahring ta ma thyi.

Caacuonakawta profet tie ama ripa a cu viepa bie zaw ma hnyi. Khy kya dyi te nama palung chunglie dyivaa aasiy a kya khena te ta niema ta hingpa bie hing a zingna lieta a khepa myi-ing haata a biepuvsa pata nama rue riypa tana a cuo.
Caapathe lie a awpa profetbiephu hing pakha dyi ta ama khingna haata a siyluo ri khu a aw lipa kha nama pachang riypata a cuo.
Tahematapakieca khaapa profetbiephu hmuota cawsaa khingna taata a vaw vyi, cuorasala Thlaapa Pathe ta a pahrapa tie ta Khazing'a taata bie kha ama ripa tana a cuo.

Cuorasala hluo ning Israel ming hrawlie kha profet pakhipa tie ama za aw; cahaacata niema hrawlie zaw pacuvtuv pha lipa aw'a yi te malie a parapa ruena kha ama chiykhyi aa. Iema a thlatuv yi ama Byipaapa kha hmuo thaw'a yi te ama cunglie kha a catlisa pata rana ama patlung sa aa.
Cata a cuona cangta cawsaa hluvpuv ta a pyalyipa ama zyazaa kha ziy yi te, iema kawlie ca ta biehmisipa luo ca ripachie pata a cuo aa.
Karuo aw pata niema kha dungviena bie ta aca pata'a yi. Hluo ning taata thli ciepa iema duotena ca a lie a riy vyi, iema rana riypa zaw a hmung vyi.
Khazing ta avuoming a suepa tie kha pahlung li pata hell luo thaw yi te biechinapa ning te pahuo sa riypata aa thuv cepa zingna thaabuoliriy ta a hre yi.
Hluoning chuelyi zaw kha Khazing ta za pahlung ngiethie vyi. Adangna biephyatuv Noah kha a hrangpa pasariy hneta a khuo raalaa pata Khazing a ciyzaa lipa chuelyi cunglie kha tiypa-aa a patlung sa.
Sodom hne Gomorrah khypuv kha myi ta duote te buvcuo ta a pali; Khazing siysaa a ri lipa tie cuota a raaringna riypata a tue.
Zyazaa pha lipa a pyalyipa awzya ta khuopuv ta a palung rie a pathyipa Lot kha a khuo.
Capa cawsaa aa dangpa paa ca iema'a lie kha ning kha hnang ning kha ta khysa te, a hmungpa hne a thyipa ama tuepa a pha lipa khata aa dangpa a palung kha khuopuv ta a pasa sa.
Abyipa ta Khazing a ciyzaapa kha pasupaliyna ama angpa chungtaata tuokhaatama i khuo'a yi tapa kha pachang te, cawsaa pha lipa tie kha bieripana ning te ta duotena chunglie chi riypa zaw a pachang.

Cahaapa tie ca a hlyi ta a pyalyipa saapa khingna luo ziy pata Khazing nawhnyina siysaa a ri lipa tie ta ama cuo. Iema ca ama rie pha te ama khing a pasa, rungnaana a hnyipa tie thuo pachi riypa kha hmuo ciy va yi.
Avuoming hing iema laata a lesyi viepa hne a cahra viepa ama cuo raalaa pata Abyipa hmiekunglie ca iema kha thuo pachi pata bie ripana tue'a va yi.
Cadyiseca, hingpa cawsaa tie hing ca a khingpa tue cakhaw riypata sapa, patuv pata thie riypata zaa puvpa, ruena a hnyi lipa saruopa haata cuo yi te,

ama tue chiepa duotena a ang nguoluopa tana ama cuo. Iema ca ningchungsaaraa ta ningdang pata duvkhing ta khi-upa kha anuona ta ama ri. Iema ca nangzaa aa chiypa hne dutla lipa cuo yi te, niema hne pyi nama tue pakhawna lie zaw amaa nuona chunglie duvkhing ta a khi a u pata ama cuo.
Nungvaathingsuena tue khingna ming dyi kha padyi yi te, ama sue khingna ca die buo vyi. Ama palung a diydyapa tie kha ama dung. Karuo awna pathiypalung ama hnyi. Chiesapa saa zaw tana ama cuo.
Aa dangpa luopuv kha thuse yi te luo ama vie, hmang pha lipa tuena muo a khingsapa Beor sacapaa Balaam luopuv kha ama ziy.
Cuorasala a suena kawlieta chuopa cuo te, bie a ri the lipa laa ta cawsaapa ryi cyi te profet ngaana kha a thlu.
Hingpa cawsaa tie ca a hnaa a ky tlipa acaa hne thliychie ta a phyalepa myiching haata cuo yi te, aa thuv cepa zingna kha chipa pata ama cuo.
Tahematapakieca iema ca siyluo a hnyi lipa hruotlena bie kha ri yi te, suena lie a awpa tie'a taata a vya law thaa baaningpa tie kha saapa sue khingna hneta ama dung.
Lawna na maca pi'a yi, ta pata bie kuo yi te, cuorasala iema hrahring kha rana sii ta ama cuo. Tahematapakieca cawsaa hing suokhakha ta a te kieca capa a tetuv sii ca tana a cuo.

Tahematapakieca ma Byipaapa hne Khuotuv Zingsuv Khrih pachangna thueta chuelyi pyalyina taata ama law khutaata capa chuelyi pyalyina ca ta patuv pakhaa te a te pakhaa kie yi ca ama cuona thaapa ca ama cuona hlungpa laa khata a chie vie.
Adangna luo kha ama pachang khutaata iema'a luo ama pipa nawbie pathepa kha thuse pata hnangluo ama kaapa laata ca za pachang bangby li pata aw yi sala a pha vie aa.
“Uv ta a paliy kha ning pakhaa te, Va ca pasiy khutaata zaw caakaw luo na aa naw pakhaa,” tapa aa hmuopa phungthluv kha na ama cunglie a tlung.

Duepa zaw, ata i caa hing niema'a luo i vya capepa a yihningnapa caa ta a cuo. Hingpa i caa suohning chunglie hing a pathepa nama pathiypalung pathu sa riypa khana ica pachang sa pakhaapa yi ta a cuo.
A pathepa profet tie ta hluo ningta ama za ripa bie hne Abyipa hne Khuotuv ta lucuotuv tie'a taata a ripa nawbie kha namaa thyi pakhaa riypa tana a cuo.
Suokhana ta nama pachang riypa ca, ningchuoningpa thueta ca malie a tue hyalyapa tie kha ama saapa khingna ziy pata tue hyalyana hne a vaw'a yi te,

“Aa vaw pakhaana riypa biekuo ca khaapaliema a aw? Hluo ning ma mingchingmingvuo tie ama za thiy taata pathu pata hmangting bangkhuo hing chuelyi sahruo thu ning haa kha tana ama aw thluo!” ama ta aa.
Hluo ningta Khazing bie ta avuo hing za aw te, chuelyi hing tiy chungtaata hne tiy ta sapa a cuopa hne,
capa bie ca ta chuelyi hing tiy ta pasiypa cuo te a rapa kha a pachang li hruo amaa cuo karue.
Cuorasala capa Khazing bie ngiethie ca ta ata chuelyi hing myi ta para riypata bieripana ning hne Khazing siysaa a ri lipa tie parana ning te ta padue cawpa a cuo.
Cuorasala duepa zaw, hingpa suokha hing ca maw khah ung. Khazing cuota ca ning kha hing kung thawkha haata cuo te, kung thawkha hing ning kha haata a cuo.

Cawsaa chekha ta ama ruepa haata, Abyipa hing a biekuona kawlieta haasaa vyi, cuorasala pakha hmuo ra li pata cawsaa bangkhuo sue a ngiepachiy riypa a khing nakaw tana niema'a lie a palung a pasiy pata a cuo.

Cuorasala Abyipa ning ca aparuvpa haa tana aa vaw aa. Capa thueta ca avuo ca ueryi lesapa hneta li'a te, a chunglie hmangting bangkhuo zaw myi ta para pata ama cuo aa. Chuelyi hne a cunglie a awpa hmangting bangkhuo zaw ama vie diy aa.
Hmangting bangkhuo hing cahaacata para riypa a cuo nakawta a pathepa hring hne Khazing ciyzaana hring lie hring riypata tuokhaapa cawsaa ma nama cuo a hu?
Khazing aa vawna'apa ning kha a ngietie li pata huo tie ung. Tahematapakieca avuo ca myi ta ruepa cuo'a te a vie aa, a chunglie a awpa hmang zaw kha myi ta a tiy ta palangpa ama cuo aa.
Cuorasala, a biekuona haata, kiema ca adangna ta a pahruopa avuo thaapa hne alyi thaapa khana ma huo.
Caacuonakawta, duepa zaw, niema ca hingpa hmang nama huo ning hing a cawta hmuo sue bepa nama cuo li riypa hne ama hne diena nama hmung riypata a zue tie ung.
Ma Byipaapa palungpasiyna kha khuona haata rue tie ung. Ma duepa Paul ta Khazing ta a pipa singna ta niema'a luo a vya capepa caa lie kha

capa kaw cana a caa bangkhuo lie a ripa haa khata a ri. Capa chunglie ca pachang a ruvsapa chekha aw te, pachangna a hnyi lipa hne a palung a diydyapa cawsaa zaw ta ca a hrangpa Caapathe lie ama tue tawpa haa khata a siyluo kha a pali a pahnaa ta papya yi te iema rana kha ama chiykhyi.

Caacuonakawta, duepa zaw, a raaringna bie ica changlupa haa yi ta Khazing siysaa a ri lipa tie ta sichiena luo acaa chiy li riypa yi hne a bangsa pata nama awnapa kha nama pavie li riypata a raaring tie ung.
Cahaacata ma Byipaapa hne khuotuv Zingsuv Khrih vihnyina hne pachangna chunglie kha lethaw tie ung. Rungnaana ca ata hne chuozaa ta ama'a lie aw pari mang sue. Amen.
Hringna bie hne aa patuv pata hluo ning taata zaa aw ciepa, ma za thyi ciepa, ma ming ta ma za hmung ciepa, ma za mang ciepa hne ma kuv ta ma za hrie ciepa kha niema'a luo maca pathyi sa yi.
Capa hringna ca paluohuopa a cuo tiyta, hmung pate a kaw kha tehte ma khuo. Kiema'a luo phu pata cuo te Paa hneta a awpa capa chuozaa hringna kaw ca niema'a luo maca pathyi sa yi.

Kiema hne a viesaana hnyi ra naase ung ciy ta pata ma hmungpa hne ma thyipa kha niema'a luo maca pathyi sa yi. Hmisi ta ca maa viesaanapa hing Paa hne cuose, Sacapaa Zingsuv Khrih hne cuose a viesaana tana a cuo.
Maa lawna aa ky riypa tana hing caa hing niema'a luo ma vya cape pata a cuo.
Sacapaa'a taata thyi pate niema'a luo ma phupa bie ca, Khazing ca khena cuo te ama chunglie ca zingna aw vyi, ta pata a cuo.
Ama hne tana maa viesaa ma ta pata zingna chunglie ma aw thluo kieca, a hanghiepa cuo pate biehmisipa lie hring vapuv.
Cuorasala ama ca khena chunglie a awpa haata khena lie ma aw kieca, pakha hne pakha a viesaa'a pate Sacapaa Zingsuv thiyse ta ma suena bangkhuo taata malie a pasiy aa.
Kiema ta suena hnyi vapuv ma ta kieca, kiema hne kiema a dungpa tana ma cuo. Ma chunglie biehmisipa aw vyi.
Ma suena kha ma phu kieca zang tluo aa tlapa hne aa dangpa ama ta ma suena kha malie a ngiethe'a te, a pha lipa bangkhuo taata malie a pathe sa aa.
Kiema ta sue vapuv maa ta kieca, ama kha a hangpa ta pacuo sa pate, a bie ca kiema chunglie aw vyi.
I saa zaw, hingpa caa niema'a luo i vya capepa hing suena nama tue lina riypa tana a cuo. Cuorasala pakhakha ta suena nama tue kieca Paa hmielie malie a rikuotuv, aa dangpa Zingsuv Khrih ma hnyi.
Ama ca kiema suena cuo dyi ta cuo li pata chuelyi suena bangkhuo cuota suena muo thungna riypata hriykhungrina tana a cuo.
A nawbie khana ma ziy tapa kieca ama ima pachangnapa kha maa pasie aa.
“Ama kha i pachang,” a ta raalaa pata a nawbie a ziy lipa ca a hanghiepa ta cuo te, cahaapaapa cawsaa chunglie ca biehmisipa aw vyi.
Cuorasala a bie kha a ziypa ca Khazing duena kha a chunglieta a bi. Cahaaca tana Khazing chunglie ma awpa kha maa pacie aa.
“Khazing chungliena i hring,” a tapa ca Khrih a hringzya haa kha tana a hring aa.
Duepa zaw, niema'a luo i vya capepa hing nawbie thaapa ta cuo vyi, cuorasala a hruothu taata nama za hnyipa nawbie hlungpa kha tana a cuo. Capa nawbie hlungpa ca nama za thyi ciepa kha tana a cuo.
Cadyiseca, ata niema'a luo i vya capepa hing ca Khrih'a lie hne niema'a lieta aa hmuopa nawbie thaapa tana a cuo, tahematapakieca zingna ca khung tli te khena hmisipa ca a khe mangtli.
Cawsaa pakhakha ta, “Khena chungliena i aw,” a ta pata a uvnu hne sieta zaw kha a hue kalie kie yi ca zingna chungliena a aw kalie.
A uvnu hne a sieta a duepa ca khena chunglie a awpa ta cuo te, cahaapa cawsaa ca a chunglie a pachiyna riypa aw vyi.

Cuorasala a uvnu kha a huepa pakhakha ca zingna chunglie a awpa ta cuo te, zingna chunglie a cakuo nakawta a cakuona riypa luo kha pachang vyi, tahematapakieca zingna khata a ming a pacue nakawta a cuo.
I saata zaw, niema'a luo kha caa i vya cape, tahematapakieca a ming thueta nama suena a ngiethepa nama cuo nakaw tana a cuo.

Paa tie zaw, niema'a luo kha caa i vya cape, tahematapakieca ahungma a hruothu baataata a aw tapa kha niema na a pachang ung ciy. Mingnu zaw, niema'a luo kha caa i vya cape, tahematapakieca a pha lipa paa kha nama te nakawta a cuo.

I saanu zaw, niema'a luo kha caa i vya cape, tahematapakieca Paa kha nama pachang nakawta a cuo. Paa tie zaw, niema'a luo kha caa i vya cape, tahematapakieca a hruothu taata zaa awpa kha ahungma tapa nama pachang. Mingnu zaw, niema'a luo kha caa i vya cape, tahematapakieca niema ca nama cahra, Khazing bie ca niema'a lie aw te, a pha lipa paa kha nama te.
Chuelyi hne a chunglie a awpa hmang kha tlechuo khah ung. Cahaapa chuelyi a tlechuopa tie chunglie ca Paa duena aw vyi.
Chuelyi lie a awpa saapa khingna, ming ta hmung khingna, hnyirungna lie hruotlena tapa zaw bangkhuo hing chuelyi taata a vawpa selaw ta cuo yi te Paa'a taata a vawpa cuo va yi.
Chuelyi hne chuelyi ta a khingpa zaw bangkhuo ca chuole lawmaw yi te, cuorasala Khazing khingna a tuepa tie ca chuozaa ta ama hring.

I saanu zaw, cuo chuonapa ca ata hing tana a cuo! Khrih a dutuv ca aa vaw nguoluo tli ta pata nama thyipa haata, Khrih a dutuv a hluvsa ca ata hing amaa vaw nguoluo tli. Caacuonakawta cuo chuonapa ca ata hing tana a cuo tapa kha ma pachang.

Iema ca kiema'a taata ama pya tli, cuorasala kiema cawsaa ta za cuo va yi; kiema cawsaa ta za cuo yi sala ca, kiema hne hingta ama aw thluo aa. Cuorasala kiema'a taata ama pyapa hingta pakha hmuota kiema cawsaa cuo va yi tapa kha a paluo sa.
Cuorasala niema ca A pathepa paa ta sathu pathuvpa ta cuo ung cate nama bangkhuo ta pachangna nama hnyi.
Niema'a luo caa i vya capepa hing biehmisipa nama pachang li nakawta cuo li pata nama pachang nakawta hanghiena ca biehmisipa taata cuo buo vyi tapa kha nama pachangna riypa tana a cuo.
Ahungma a hanghiepa cata a cuo? Zingsuv ca Khrih ta cuo vyi a tatuv cata cuo va ma? Paa hne Sacapaa a thawpa ca Khrih a dutuv tana a cuo.
Sacapaa a thawpa ca Paa zaw kha thaw te, Sacapaa a cuhluopa ta Paa zaw kha a cuhluo.
A hruothu baataata nama za thyipa kha nama chunglie pa-aw sa mya ung. A hruothu baataata nama za thyipa kha nama chunglie a aw kieca, niema zaw Sacapaa hne Paa chunglie nama aw aa.
Hingpa hingna Khrih ama hrahring ta bie malie a kuopa chuozaa hringna cata a cuo.
Niema dung caa nangpa tie kawlieta hingpa caa hing niema'a luo i vya cape.

Ama'a taata nama hmungpa thlaapa kha niema'a lie a aw nakawta ahungtahmuo pacuv a hu va ung ciy. Cuorasala ama thlaapa ta hmangting kaw kha aca pacuvpa haa yi ta hne capa aca pacuvpa yi ca hanghiena cuo li pata a hmisipa a cuopa haata, aca pacuvpa haa yi cata ama chunglie aw tie ung.
I saata zaw, ama chunglie aw tie ung. Cakiedyina ama aa vaw thueta anguona hnyi'a pate a hmiekunglie nangzaana hnyi li pata ma aw aa.
Khrih ca aa dang tapa kha nama pachang kieca, adangna a tuepa bangkhuo ca Khazing'a taata a puvpa tana ama cuo tapa kha nama pachangpasie aa.

Khazing ta kha tluv tama malie a due tapa hing pacuo tie ung. Khazing saata ta pata kupa ma cuo; ma cuo hmisi saw. Chuelyi ta kiema malie a pachang lipa hing Khazing kha a pachang li nakaw tana a cuo.

Duepa zaw, ata hing kiema ca Khazing saata tah ma cuo ung; Hmieluo khaapama ma lu aa tapa ca pachang valie puv. Ma pachangpa ca: Khrih aa luo thueta, kiema ca ama haata cuo'a pate a cuona dadang haa khata ma hmung aa.
Ama'a lieta capa anguopuona a hnyipa bangkhuo ca Khrih a pathepa haa khata iema hne iema kha amaa pathe sa ra.
Suena a tuepa bangkhuo ca Khazing phungbie a parapa tana ama cuo; suena ca Khazing phungbie parana kha tana a cuo.
Khrih ca cawsaa suena pathe sa riypa tana aa vaw tapa kha pachang ung cate, ama'a lie ca suena aw vyi tapa kha nama pachang.
Khrih chunglie a awpa ahungtahmuo suena tue va tli yi; suena a tuepa ahungtahmuo Khrih kha hmung va yi, a pachang zaw pachang va yi.
I saata zaw, ahunghmuo a padung sa khah ung. Khrih ca aa dangpa a cuopa haa khata aa dangpa hmang a tuepa bangkhuo ca aa dangpa ama cuo.

Suena a tuepa bangkhuo ca khachie saata tana ama cuo; tahematapakieca khachie ca a hruothu baataata suena a tuepa tana a cuo. Khazing Sacapaa aa luo hnuochuonapa ca khachie rehriena para riypa tana a cuo.
Khazing'a taata a puvpa ca suena kha tue va yi, tahematapakieca Khazing saciy kha ama chunglie aw te, sue khu va yi, tahematapakieca Khazing'a taata a puvpa ama cuo nakaw tana a cuo.
Khazing saata a cuopa hne khachie saata a cuopa ca cahaacata a hnang yi te, hmang phapa a tue lipa bangkhuo ca Khazing'a taata cuo va yi, a uvnu a due lipa zaw cuo ra va yi.
A hruothu taata nama za thyipa bie ca, pakha hne pakha a due ung la ta pata a cuo.

A pha lipa paa'a taata a vawpa Kain ta a nuta a thiepa haata ma cuo riypata cuo vyi. Khaapanakawma a nuta ca a thie? Tahematapakieca a hmang tuepa kha a dang li pata a nuta hmang tuepa kha aa dang nakawta a cuo.
Uvnu hne sieta zaw chuelyi ta aca hue tiy yi ta nama kharue haa khah se.
Tahematapakieca pakha hne pakha maa due nakawta thiyna taata hringna luo ma caluo tli tapa kha ma pachang ung.
A uvnu hne a sieta a huepa bangkhuo ca lie a nawpa tana ama cuo, lie a nawpa ca chuozaa hringna hnyi va yi tapa kha nama pachang.
Abyipa ta kiema cuota a hringna a pi nakawta duena tapa kha ma pachang. Kiema zaw pakha hne pakha cuota ma hringna maa pi riypa tana a cuo.
Pakhakha ca hnyirungsa te a uvnu acuolikie a sieta zaw ama siy a pasasapa kha a hmung thluo pata aa bya khing li kie yi ca Khazing duena ca a chunglie tuokhaatama a aw the aa?
I saata zaw, ryi hne kaa dyi ta cuo li pata biehmisipa hne tuena ta a due ung siy.
Cahaacata kiema ca biehmisipa taata ma cuopa kha pachang'a pate ama hmielie ma hnaa a nguo aa.
Tahematapakieca Khazing ca ma pathiypalung laata lesyi vie te hmangting bangkhuo kha a pachang.
I duepa zaw, ma pathiypalung na sue malie a be va tapa kieca, Khazing hmielie riephana ma hnyi.
Tahematapakieca a nawbie kha ziy pate ama palung ma patluo nakawta ma hiepa bangkhuo kha ma hmung.
Abyipa nawbie ca, ama bie malie a pipa haata, a Sacapaa Zingsuv Khrih kha zang pata pakha hne pakha a due riypa kha tana a cuo.
A nawbie a ziypa bangkhuo ca ama chunglie aw yi te ama zaw iema chunglie a aw. Cakhutaata kiema chunglie ama a awpa kha malie a pipa a Thlaapa thueta ma pachang.

Duepa zaw, Thlaapa bangkhuo kha zang khah ung; cuorasala Khazing'a taata a vawpa thlaapa a cuo ma cuo va ma tapa kha dyapasya tie ung; tahematapakieca profet pakhipa a hluvpuv kha chuelyi luo ama vya pya tli.
Hing haa hingta Khazing Thlaapa kha nama pachang aa: Zingsuv Khrih ca saapa cuona tana aa vaw a tapa thlaapa mekaa ca Khazing'a taata a vawpa thlaapa cuo te,

cahaacata a ta lipa thlaapa mekaa ca Khazing'a taata a vawpa thlaapa cuo vyi. Khrih a dupa thlaapa tana ama cuo. Capa thlaapa ca aa vaw nguoluo tli tapa kha thyi tli ung cate, ata hing hingpa chuelyi lie hing a aw tli.
I saata zaw, niema ca Khazing'a taata cuo ung cate iema kha nama te mangtli; tahematapakieca niema chunglie a awpa ca chuelyi lie a awpa laata a lesyi vie.
Iema ca chuelyi taata ama cuo; caacuonakawta ama ripa ca chuelyi bie ta cuo te, chuelyi ta iema bie kha a naathlie.

Kiema ca Khazing'a taa tana ma cuo. Khazing a pachangpa bangkhuo ta ma bie kha naathlie yi te, Khazing'a taata a cuo lipa bangkhuo ca ma bie kha naathlie va yi. Capa taa cata a hmisipa thlaapa hne a pakhipa thlaapa kha ma pachang.
Duepa zaw, pakha hne pakha a due ung siy, tahematapakieca Khazing ca duena tana a cuo; duena a hnyipa bangkhuo ca Khazing saata cuo yi te Khazing kha ama pachang.
Duena a hnyi lipa ca Khazing kha pachang vyi, tahematapakieca Khazing ca duena tana a cuo.
Sacapaa thueta ma hring thena riypata Khazing ca a Sacapaa pakha dyipa kha chuelyi luo a za pathlie; cahaacata Khazing duena ca kiema'a luo kha a zaa phu.
Hingpa hingna duena ta a cuo, duena ma tapa ca kiema ta Khazing ma duepa kha cuo li pata, ama ta kiema kha malie due te ma sue hriykhungrina cuota a Sacapaa a za pathliepa hingta a cuo.
Duepa zaw, Khazing ta kiema hing malie a due hringhruo nakawta, kiema zaw pakha hne pakha maa due riypa tana a cuo.
Ahungtahmuo Khazing kha hmung buo vyi; pakha hne pakha maa due kieca Khazing kha kiema chunglie aw te, a duena kha kiema chunglie aa ky.
Khazing ta a Thlaapa kha malie a pi nakawta, kiema ca ama chunglie aw pate ama zaw kiema chunglie a awpa kha ma pachang.
Paa ta a Sacapaa kha chuelyi Khuotuv ta a za pathliepa kha hmung pate tehte ma khuo.
Zingsuv ca Khazing Sacapaa tana a cuo a tapa tie chunglie Khazing aw te, iema zaw Khazing chunglie ama aw.
Caacuonakawta Khazing ta kiema'a lie a hnyipa duena kha pachang pate ma zang. Khazing ca duena tana a cuo, duena chunglie a awpa ca Khazing chunglie a awpa cuo yi te, Khazing zaw iema chunglie a aw.
Hingpa chuelyi lie hing Khrih haata ma hring nakawta bieripana ning thueta ma rie a phana riypata duena ca kiema chunglie hing haa hingta a tling.
Duena chunglie ca ciyna aw vyi, a tlingpa duena ta ca ciyna kha a papya diy. Tahematapakieca ciyna ca duotena hneta aa patuv nakawta, ciyna a hnyipa ta ca a tlingpa duena luo kha chiy khu vyi.
Khazing ta kiema kha malie a due taa nakawta kiema zaw ta ma due.
“Khazing na i due,” a ta raalaa pata a uvnu hne a sieta kha a huepa ca a hangpa tana a cuo; ming ta hmungpa a uvnu hne a sieta hmuo a due li kieca ming ta hmung lipa Khazing ca due khu the'a vyi.
Ama'a taata ma hmungpa nawbie ca hingpa hing tana a cuo: Khazing a duepa ta ca a uvnu hne a sieta zaw kha a due ra'a yi.
Zingsuv ca Khrih ta a cuo tapa a zangpa bangkhuo ca Khazing saata ta cuo yi te, nungpaa a duepa bangkhuo ta saata kha ama due ra.
Khazing saata zaw ma duepa yi maa pachangna ca Khazing kha due pate a nawbie ma ziypa hingta a cuo.
Khazing na ma due ma tapa ca a nawbie ma ziypa hingta a cuo. Cakhutaata a nawbie ziypa ca ma cuota hmangriypa cuo vyi.
Tahematapakieca Khazing'a taata a puvpa bangkhuo ta ca chuelyi kha ama te.
Ahungma chuelyi hing a te? Zingsuv ca Khazing Sacapaa tana a cuo ta pata a zangpa na a te cuo va ma?
Tiy hne thiy ta a vawpa ca Zingsuv Khrih tana a cuo, tiy hne dyi ta cuo li pata tiy hne thiy hneta a cuo. Thlaapa ca tehte khuotuv ta cuo te, biehmisipa Thlaapa zaw ta a cuo.
Tehte khuotuv suothung ama aw:
Thlaapa hne tiy hne thiy ta cuo yi te aa lu pata tehte ama khuo.
Kiema ta cawsaa tehtekhuona kha ma cuhluo kieca Khazing tehtekhuona ca capa laa cata a le vie, tahematapakieca Khazing ta a Sacapaa kaw tehte a khuopa tana a cuo.

Khazing Sacapaa a zangpa tie ta ama palung chunglie tehte khuo riypa ama hnyi. Khazing a zang lipa tie ca Khazing ta a Sacapaa kawlie tehte a khuopa kha ama zang li nakawta Khazing kha a hangpa ta ama tue.
Capa tehtekhuona ca: Khazing ta chuozaa hringna malie pi te, capa hringna ca a Sacapaa chunglie a awpa ta a cuo.
Sacapaa a hnyipa ca hringna kha a hnyi. Khazing Sacapaa a hnyi lipa ca hringna kha hnyi vyi.
Khazing Sacapaa ming a zangpa tie ta chuozaa hringna nama hnyipa kha namaa pachangna riypata hingpa caa hing niema'a luo i vya cape.
Ama khingna hne aa ziy pata maa hie kieca ama ta malie a thyi ta pata ama chunglie riephana ma hnyi.
Cakhutaata khaapa maa hie zaw malie a thyi tapa kha ma pachang kieca ama'a taata maa hiepa bangkhuo kha ma hmung tli ta pata ma pachang.

Na uvnu acuolikie na sieta ta thiyna a phakhyi lipa suena a tuepa kha na hmung kieca Khazing'a luo kha thlaachuopa la thiyna a phakhyipa suena a tue lipa cahaapa cawsaa ca Khazing ta hringna a pi aa. Thiyna a phakhyipa suena a aw; capa kawlie ca ta thlaa nama chuo aa i ta pata cuo vyi.
Hmang tuesuepa bangkhuo hing suena ta a cuo, cuorasala thiyna a phakhyi lipa suena a aw.
Khazing'a taata a puvpa ca suena tuepazue vyi tapa kha ma pachang. Khazing sacapaa ta ama kha a daakhuo nakawta a pha lipa paa ta taw khu vyi.
Khazing saata ma cuopa hne chuelyi hing a pha lipa paa cahrana rawlie a awpa kha ma pachang.

Cakhutaata Khazing Sacapaa kha a vaw te a hmisipa ama ma pachangna riypa hne a hmisipa a Sacapaa Zingsuv Khrih chunglie ma awpa kha ma pachangna riypata nangvuona malie a pipa kha ma pachang. Ama ca a hmisipa Khazing hne chuozaa hringna ta a cuo.
I saata zaw, kuvtuezuv kha cahriy tie ung.
Macuopa ta, biehmisipa chunglieta i duepa, kama dyi ta ica duepa yi cuo li pata biehmisipa a pachangpa bangkhuo ta aca duepa yi, a tlawpa nungcuo hne a saata zaw kha,
ma chunglie a awpa hne chuozaa ta a aw riypa biehmisipa kawlieta:
Biehmisipa hne duena chunglie a aw pakhawpa niema'a lieta, Paa Khazing hne Paa Khazing Sacapaa Zingsuv Khrih'a taata vihnyina, nangduena hne thlaalungna aw mang sue.
Paa ta bie malie a pipa haata na saata zaw chekha na biehmisipa lie a hring yi tapa i hmung tiyta i palung a tluo hringhruo.
Caacuonakawta duepa nung, pakha hne pakha a due ung siy ta pata paa ica kie. Hingpa hing nawbie thaapa i vya cape pata cuo vyi, a hruothu taata ma za hnyipa kha tana a cuo.
Duena ma tapa ca a nawbie ziy pata hringpa hingna a cuo. Capa a nawbie ca nama ziy aa ta pata a hluo baataata nama za thyipa kha tana a cuo.
Zingsuv ca thiysaa tana aa vaw tapa a paw lipa dungvietuv hluvpuv kha chuelyi luo ama vya pya tli. Cahaapaapa cawsaa bangkhuo ca dungvietuv hne Khrih a dutuv tana ama cuo.
Ma hrie hnuochuopa kha namaa sung li riypa hne nama lawmuo kha a tlingsa pata nama hmung riypata a raaring pata aw tie ung.
Khrih pacuvna chunglie aw li pata a hlyi ta si te a hringpa ca Khazing kha hnyi vyi. Pacuvna chunglie a awpa bangkhuo ca Paa hne Sacapaa kha a hnyi.
Capa pacuvna a cyi li pata niema'a luo a vawpa ahunghmuo ing chung luo pangie khah ung; bie zaw a chang khah ung.
Tahematapakieca iema kha bie a changpa ca hmang pha lipa ama tuepa lie khana namaa hraw ra tana ta a cuo.
Niema'a luo cape riypa a hluvsa i hnyi raalaa pata caahnaa hne caatiy ca hmuo'a va ang. Maa lawna aa kyna riypata niema'a luo a vaw'a angte hmie a hmung pata bie maa rue'a ung ta pata i hnabie a syi.
A tlawpa na nutanung a saata zaw ta bie acaa chang yi.
Macuopa ta biehmisipa lieta i duepa Gaius'a kha bie icaa chang.
I duepa, thlaapa luota hnaatluo pata na awpa haata hmangting bangkhuo hing na cuota aa rawsa pata aw sala, na hnaa a tluo riypata thlaa ica chuopa.
Viesaa chekha vya chiy yi te biehmisipa lie zang tluo naa tlanazya hne biehmisipa lie na hringnazya kha tehte ama khuo tiyta i palung a tluo hringhruo.
I saata zaw na biehmisipa lie a hring yi tapa i thyipa laa hingta i palung naa patluo viepa aw vyi.
I duepa, viesaa cuota cuose, caa pachang buo lipa tie cuo zaw te ta, khaapa re na hrie zaw ta zang tluo aa tlasa pata na hrie.
Na duena kaw kha khrihsaabuv lie tehte ama khuo. Khazing hne aa tlapa palungphya hnyi pata ama si khu riypa kha a bya tie yi.
Tahematapakieca zanglituv tie'a taata abyana khaapahmuo la li pata Khrih cuota khy a tlawpa ta ama cuo.
Caacuonakawta biehmisipa lie rehriehnetuv ma cuo riypata cahaapa cawsaa zaw kha maa bya riypa yi ta a cuo.
Khrihsaabuv'a luo kha caa pachangta i cape; cuorasala ama hne ama kha pakhana lie a chi khingpa Diotrefes ta kiema ri kha a ngie khing vyi.

Caacuonakawta i vaw kieca a cuo li pata kiema kaw a ripa bangkhuo kha i phu diy aa. Capa dyi cata a palung tling li pata uvnu zaw kha ing a patlung sa khing li pata ing a patlung sa khingpa tie zaw kha thlu yi te khrihsaabuv taata a papya yi.
I duepa zaw, a pha lipa kha a mangpuo khah ung, a phapa kha a mangpuo hriy tie ung. Hmang phapa a tuepa ca Khazing'a taata cuo te, hmang pha lipa a tuepa ca Khazing kha hmung vyi.
Cawsaa bangkhuo ta Demetrias ca pathuosa yi te biehmisipa zaw ta a pathuosa. Kiema zaw ta a cuo ta tehte khuo pate ma tehtekhuona aa hmuopa kha nama pachang.
Niema'a luo cape riypa a hluvsa i hnyi; cuorasala caasung hne caatiy hmuo pata cape hriy li pata,
niema hne a ru hluota hmie a hmung pata bie maa rue aa ta pata i nguopuo.
Na cunglie thlaalungna aw se. Viesaa zaw ta bie acaa chang yi. Ma viesaa zaw pakha cyicuo kha bie malie a changpa tie yi.
Zingsuv Khrih changtaapa hne Jeim nuta ta a cuopa Judas na, Khazing kupa, Paa Khazing ta a duepa hne Zingsuv Khrih mangsangna chunglie a awpa tie kha caa caa paphya yi ang.
Nangduena thlaalungna hne duena ca niema'a lie aa kysa pata aw mang sue.

Duepa zaw, ma bangkhuo ta maa hrawpa khuona kaw hing niema'a luo cape riypata palung thusa pata i ting nguoluo ningta cawsaa pathepa tie'a luo yi kha ta a tling pata a pipa yi zangna hing namaa daakhyi riypata paakie namaa hu hrahring ta pata i hmung.

Tahematapakieca ma Khazing vihnyina kha a pali a pahnaa ta tue yi te siyhrawna ta a hmuopa tie, pakha dyipa ma Ziypaapa hne Abyipa Zingsuv Khrih a thawpa tie ca niema hraw luo kha a paruvta tah amaa ngie tli. Iema ca Khazing a zang lipa ama cuona haata duotena ang riypata hluo ning taata thli paciepa tie tana ama cuo.
Abyipa ca Israel ming kha Izipt ruo chungtaata khuo yi te cakhutaata a zang lipa tie a parapa yi kha ica chang diy tli raalaa pa yi ta ica pachang sa pakhaa khing yi.
Amaa daahmang lie aw li pata aa rawpusapa ama awna hmang a thusepa avuoming kha bieripana Ning rungnaapa cuo thue huopa ta aa thuv cepa zingna chunglie kha chuozaa thaabuoliriy ta a hre yi.

Cahaacata, Sodom hne Gomorrah hne a kiecahriy khypuv zaw kha iema palungphya ca hnyi yi te, aparuvsuena tue yi te a phung lipa saapa khingna ama hnyi nakawta chuozaa myi chunglie duotena ama angpa ca cawsaa bangkhuo a cadangna riypa tana a cuo.
Cahaacata, hingpa muo a sa thepa tie zaw hingta ama pangpasaa kha papyapalyi yi te, nawhnyina kha ama i khutaata a rungnaapa tie thuo kha ama pachi.
Cuorasala avuoming byi Mikhael ca Moses riyy kawlie khachie hne bie amaa i ning kha ripachiena bie risue nguo li pata, “Abyipa na caa chuo!” a ta.
Cuorasala hingpa cawsaa zaw hingta ca ama pachang lipa mekaa kha ripachie yi te, capa amaa puvkhyipa pachangna cata iema kha ruena a hnyi lipa saruopa haata a para yi.
Iema ca bawchie ciemuopa tana ama cuo! Tahematapakieca iema ca Kain luopuv kha ziy yi te, tuokaa vuota Balaam a sichiena luo kha ama si ra. Korah aduna luo lie kha ama ra.

Iema ca niema hneta pyi luo ama chiy ning kha kuochi li pata a nuo yi te ama ningdang nakawta nama duena pyi zaw a papya a palyipa tana ama cuo. Iema ca thliy ta a phyalepa khytiy a vyi lipa amyi, a thariy te ama phiepuo nakawta yi hning a thiypa a thyi a pathyi lipa thlasiypaa thingkung haa tana ama cuo.
A nangzaanapa buv a papyapa riyliy tiylaw, hne a zulepa aasiy haata cuo yi te, aa thuv cepa zingna kha chuozaa ta chipa pata ama cuo.
Adam taata chuosariynapa Enok ta hingpa kaw hing a za rilupa ca, “Mang tie ung, Abyipa ca a mingpathepa thawhraa hneta a vaw te,

cawsaa bangkhuo kha bie a ripa'a yi. Khazing ciyzaa li pata cawsaa ta ama tuepa hmang bangkhuo cuota hne Khazing a ciyzaa lipa a suepa tie ta ama a du pata ama ripa bie bangkhuo cuota bie a chipa'a yi,” a ta.
Iema ca a cie thepa tie hne malie suena a huv thepa tie, iema saapa khingna a ziypa tie, a bietung lepa tie, iema phana cuota malie a patapa tie tana ama cuo.
Cuorasala, i duepa zaw, ma Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih a ziytuv tie ta ama za rilupa kha maw lie ung ciy;
tahematapakieca iema ta, “Ning chuonapa cuo thueta ca cawsaa a esepa tie hne Khazing ciyzaa li pata iema saapa khingna a ziypa tie amaa vya luo aa,” ama ta.
Thlaapa a hnyi lipa capa chuelyi cawsaa zaw ca ta achena ama chiykhyi aa.
Cuorasala i duepa niema zaw ca a pathe cepa nama zangna lie kha a sathaw ung la, Thlaapa Pathe'a lie kha thlaachuo tie ung.
Khazing duena chunglie kha aw ung la, chuozaa hringna luo malie a chiypa ma Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih nangduena kha a mangkhuo tie ung.
Palung luolue pata a awpa tie cunglie kha nangduena hnyi ung la,
iema kha myi chungtaata thue ung la khuo tie ung. Ciyzaana cangta malie kha nangdue ung la, cadyiseca ama saapa khingna ta aa hlawpa ama cawsie kha ca hue tie ung.
A lie li pata caa pa-aw sa khutuv hne a hmiekunglie caw-yi riy khaapahmuo aw li pata palung tluosa pata caa padaa sa khutuv yi,

maa khuotuv Khazing pakha dyipa cunglieta, ma Byipaapa Zingsuv Khrih thueta, rungnaana, lesyina, cahrana, hne nawhnyina ca a chuo ciepa cuo hne ata cuo hne hmieluo cuo bangkhuo, chuozaa ta aw mang sue. Amen.

Hingpa hing Zingsuv Khrih biephu tana a cuo. A ru hluota a vya cuo riypa biephu kha a changtaapa tie'a luo pahmung sa riypata Khazing ta a pipa tana a cuo. A changtaapa Johan'a luo kha aa vuoming pathlie te a pachang sapa ta a cuo.
Johan ta Khazing bie hne Zingsuv Khrih kaw a hmungpa bangkhuo kha a chang yi.
Hingpa profetbiephu hing aa thyisa pata a ripa hne ama ripa kha thyi te a chunglie aa capepa haata a ziypa ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo; tahematapakieca cuo na a ngie tli.

Asia ruo chunglie a awpa Khrihsaabuv suosariy tie'a luo kha kama Johan ta caa ica paphya yi: A aw nguoluopa, zaa aw tlipa hne a vya aw riypa Khazing'a taata cuose, byithude hmielie a awpa thlaapa suosariy'a taata cuose,

zang tluo aa tlapa pachangkhyituv, thiyna taata a thupa tie hrawlie sacapaa taapa, hne chuelyi siepahruo tie siepahruo ta a cuopa Zingsuv Khrih'a taata vihnyina hne thlaalungna ca nama cunglie aw mang sue. Malie due te a thiyse ta ma suena chungtaata malie a khuopa,
kiema kha pena ruo suokha cuo riypata malie tue te tluobyi ta malie a tuetuv Paa Khazing cunglie ca rungnaana hne nawhnyina chuozaa ta aw mang sue. Amen.

Mang tie ung! Ama ca amyi hne tana aa vaw; cawsaa mekaa ta hmung yi te, a dawpahlipa tie zaw khata ama hmung aa; chuelyi mingphang zaw bangkhuo ca ama kawlieta ama caa aa. Cahaacata a cuo hrahring aa. Amen.
Abyipa Khazing ta, “Kama ca Alfa hne Omega,” a aw nguoluopa, zaa aw tlipa hne a vya aw riypa Lesyice tana i cuo, a ta.

Hrisaana hne a pena hne palung pasiysa pata nama anglawna lie zaw Zingsuv ziytuv cuona taata a hraw rapa nama uvnupa kama Johan ca Khazing bie hne Zingsuv kaw tehte i khuona kawlieta Patmos parala lie ina chi yi.
Abyipa ning lieta kha thlaapa ta bi angte, i hnangkaa taata hmyakaa haata ueryi a paringsapa kha thyi angte,
“Na hmungpa kha caa-uv chunglie cape la Efesa, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thiatira, Sardis, Filadelfia hne Laodisia khy lie a awpa khrihsaabuv suosariy luo kha paphya tie,” ina ta.
Cakhutaa cata a ueryi ta bie naa changpa kha mang riypata i pali tiyta siy myi vuona tung suosariy kha i hmung.
Capa siy myi vuona tung zaw hrawlie ca a cacunghnaa lie siy cacunghnaapaze kha a paze te buohryi pasiypa a hryipa Cawsaa Sacapaa hne aa lupa pakha kha i hmung.
A luv hne a suo ca tuvhming ruopa hne cahue haata a ruo; a ming ca myihlaa haata a cuo.
A phyi ca sumyi chunglie ama rue khutaata aa li dyi aa lina te ta ama hnapa daa hneta aa lu. A ueryi ca tiysue lesapa pu haata a cuo.
A cacuoluo kuv lie aasiy suosariy a cyi te, a pakaa taata kuo hning ta a cahrepa zueziy a kya pya. A hmie ca khuosa ta a khepa ningkhepa haata a khe.
Ama i hmung pahne ta kama ca a thiypa haata a phyi thabaw lie i liepatyi. Cuorasala a cacuoluo kuv kha i cunglie chi te, “Ciy khah; kama ca a hmietaa ce hne a hnangcaw ce tana i cuo.
A hringpa zaw ta i cuo. I za thiy, cuorasala mang tie, chuozaa ta i hring tli. Cakhutaata Thiyna hne Athiykhy tawh zaw kha i hnyi.
Na hmungpa hmang, a cuo nguoluopa hne a vya cuo riypa hmang kaw zaw kha cape tie.

I cacuoluo kuv lie na hmungpa aasiy suosariy hne siy myi vuona tung suosariy tie ta ama ri khingpa bieparuv ca hing haa hing tana a cuo: aasiy suosariy ca khrihsaabuv suosariy tie avuoming cuo yi te, siy myi vuona tung suosariy ca khrihsaabuv suosariy ta ama cuo.

“Efesa khy lie a awpa khrihsaabuv avuoming'a luo kha hing haa hingta cape tie: A cacuoluo kuv lie aasiy suosariy a cyi te siy myi vuona tung suosariy alalalie a cakuolepa bie ca hing haa hing tana a cuo:

“Na re hriepa kha i pachang, te namaa nguoluopa hne palung pasiysa pata na ang lawnapa kha i pachang. Hmang pha lipa a tuepa tie na chaw the lipa hne lucuotuv na i cuo amaa ta raalaa pata a cuo lipa tie na dyapasyanapa yi hne a hangpa ama cuopa na hmung khuna kha i pachang.
Na palung pasiysa pata ang cate i ming kawlie na te-angna hne riethyi ang cate na palung a chuo lipa zaw kha i pachang.
Cuorasala ica pasuenapa suokha ca a hruothu ta na za hnyipa duena kha hnyi va tli ciy.

Khaapa adaahmang taa kha tama naa lie tapa kha a thyi la, a ngiepachiy la a hruothu ta na za tuepa hmang kha tue pakhaa tie. Cata cuo li pata, na suenapa kha naa ngiepachiy li kieca namaa'a luo kha a vaw'a angte na siy myi vuona tung kha a awna taata i palaw aa.
Cadyiseca ica rithuophaa khingpa suokha ca kama ta i huepa Nikolas ziytuv tie ama tuepa kha na hue rapa hingta a cuo.
Thlaapa ta khrihsaabuv tie'a luo a ripa hing thyina naa a hnyipa mekaa ta thyi mang yi sue. Tena a hmungpa mekaa ca Khazing paradis lie a awpa hringna thingthyi khana ningna naw i pi'a yi.
“Smyrna khy lie a awpa khrihsaabuv avuoming'a luo kha hing haa hingta cape tie: A hmietaa ce hne a hnangcaw ce ta a cuopa, thiy te a hring pakhaapa bie ca hing haa hing tana a cuo:

“Na hnyirungsa raalaa pata ruvnaana na angpa hne siypasana na angpa kha i pachang. Judah ming tana ma cuo a ta raalaa yi te a cuo lipa tie, cuorasala Setaa apungna-ing ta a cuopa tie ta na thuo aca pachipa yi kha i pachang.

Na te-ang riypa kha ciy khah. Naathlie tie, dyapasya riypata khachie ta niema chung taa chekha kha thaw aca pathla'a yi. Ning hraa chung riethyina nama ang aa. Thiyna te ta zang tluo aa tla pata aw la hringna byilakhuv kha ica pi aa.
Thlaapa ta khrihsaabuv tie'a luo a ripa hing thyina naa a hnyipa mekaa ta thyi mang yi sue. Tena a hmungpa ca yi hning thiyna ta para khu'a va tli.
“Pergamum khy lie a awpa khrihsaabuv avuoming'a luo kha hing haa hingta cape tie: Kuo hning ta a cahrepa zueziy a hnyituv bie ca hing haa hing tana a cuo:

“Na awna hmang kha ica pachang, capa hmang ca Setaa byithude awna hmang ta a cuo. Niema zaw hrawlie ama thiepa, zang tluo aa tlapa naa pachangkhyituv Antipas kha Setaa awna hmang lie ama thie ning tahmuo na zangna kha thaw lipa cata i ming kha a cusa pata naa patuv.

Cuorasala ica pasuenapa a cawta a aw: niema'a lieta Balaam pacuvna a ziypa cawsaa chekha ama aw. Balaam ta Balak kha Israel ming hmielie a pachiyna a cuo riypata kuvtuezuv amaa bienapa sa ning riypa hne aparuvsuena tue riypata a pacuv.
Cahaacata Nikolas ziytuv tie pacuvna a ziypa zaw nama aw ngiethie.
A ngiepachiy tie ung, cata a cuo li kieca niema'a luo kha a vaw patang'a angte i pakaa taata a pyapa zueziy ta iema kha i du'a yi.

Thlaapa ta khrihsaabuv tie'a luo a ripa hing naa a hnyipa mekaa ta thyi mang yi sue. Tena a hmungpa bangkhuo ca nupa manna chebuo kha i pi'a yi. Alung ruopa zaw kha pi'a yi angte, capa alung ruopa cunglie ca a cutuv ta li pata ahungtahmuo ama pachang lipa ming thaapa kha aa cape.

“Thiatira khy lie a awpa khrihsaabuv avuoming'a luo kha hing haa hingta cape tie: Hingpa bie hing myihlaa haapa ming hnyi te sumyi chunglie ama rue khutaata aa li dyi aa lina te ta ama hnapa daa haapa phyi a hnyipa Khazing Sacapaa bie tana a cuo:
“Na re hriepa kha i pachang. Duena na hnyipa, na zangna, na rehriepa hne palung pasiysa pata na ang lawpa zaw i pachang. Na za hrie taapa laata a hnang ta na hriepa hing a le vie tapa zaw i pachang.

Cuorasala ica pasuenapa a cawta a aw: Profet tana i cuo a ta te i changtaapa tie kha aparuvsuena tue riypa hne kuvtuezuv amaa bienapa sa ning riypata pacuv te a dungpa yi Jezebel kha na chaw khusapa hingta a cuo.
A ngiepachiyna cuo kha i pi, cuorasala aparuvsuena hring taata a ngiepachiy khing vyi.
Mang tie, ama kha iehmang cunglie thaw'a angte, ama hne nungvaathingsuena a tuepa tie zaw kha ama suena amaa ngiepachiy li kieca a ruvsapa te-angna na amaa taw aa.

A saata zaw kha i thie'a yi. Khrihsaabuv bangkhuo ta kama ca pathiypalung hne palungphya a mangpasiepa i cuopa kha ina pachang'a yi. Niema pakha cyicuo kha nama hriepa hne aa phuvpa hrie muo ica pi'a yi.

Cuorasala hingpa pacuvna hing a ziy lipa, chekha ta, ‘Setaa bieparuv aa thuvpa,’ ama tapa kha a cuv lipa, Thiatira lie a awpa niema aa ngaapa tie nama cunglie kha hingpa hmangriypa hing khang khing va ang.
Nama hnyipa kha i vawna te a cusa pata a patuv tie ung.
Tena hmung te i re kha a chuona te ta aa pazue pata a hriepa mekaa ca, mingphang zaw cunglie nawhnyina kha i pi'a yi.
Iema kha thaa khuecahryi ta uv'a yi te, alyi bi dechipa haa khata ama dechi aa.
Kama zaw i Paa'a taata nawhnyina i hmungpa haata iema kha nawhnyina i pi'a yi. Dyivaa aasiy zaw kha i pi'a yi.
Thlaapa ta khrihsaabuv tie'a luo a ripa hing naa a hnyipa mekaa ta thyi mang yi sue.

“Sardis khy lie a awpa khrihsaabuv avuoming'a luo kha hing haa hingta cape tie: Khazing thlaapa pasariy hne aasiy suosariy a hnyipa bie ca hing haa hing tana a cuo: “Na re hriepa i pachang; a hring ta pata ming a hnyipa na cuo raalaa pata na thiy.
A kya cha la, vuotaa a thiy'a nangpa aa tuopa kha thaa patlung tie, tahematapakieca i Khazing hmielieta na re kha tluo a tlingpa ta hmung va ang.

Na za cuhluopa hne na thyipa kha maw khah; capa ca ziy la na suena kha a ngiepachiy tie. Naa kya cha li pata a cuo kieca aparuvpa haata a vaw'a angte, nama'a luo kha khaapa cuo lie ma i vaw aa tapa na pachang'a vaciy.
Cadyiseca Sardis khy lieta a cawsie a papya a palyi lipa cawsaa a cawta na hnyi kalie; iema ca aa phuvpa ama cuo nakawta pang ruopa kha a buv'a yi te kama hneta ama cakuo pakhawle aa.
Tena na hmung kieca iema haata pang ruopa kha a buv ra'a cate, hringna caa-uv chungtaata na ming kha ca hruv'a va ang. I Paa hne aa vuoming hmiekunglieta na ming kha i daakhyi aa.
Thlaapa ta khrihsaabuv tie'a luo a ripa hing naa a hnyipa mekaa ta thyi mang yi sue.
