“Filadelfia khy lieta a awpa khrihsaabuv avuoming'a luo kha hing haa hingta cape tie: Hingpa zaw hing a pathepa hne biehmisipa ta a cuopa, David tawh a hnyipa, a khaa tiyta ahungtahmuo ama pahaw khu lipa, a pahaw tiyta ahungtahmuo ama khaa khu lipa paa bie tana a cuo.

“Na re hriepa kha i pachang. Mang tie, ahunghmuo ama khaa khu lipa ingchiypakaa kha na hmielie ica pahawpa. Na thaazuo a dya tapa kha ica pachang, cadyiseca i ming kha thaw khing lipa cata i bie kha na ziy.

Judah ming tana ma cuo a ta raalaa yi te a cuo lipa, a hangpa tie, Setaa apungna-ing ta a cuopa tie kha na phyi thabaw luo a vaw pata vya pabu sa'a yi angte nama ica duenazya kha ama pachang riypata i tue'a yi.
Tahematapakieca i bie kha palung pasiysa pata anglawna hne na ziy nakawta chuelyi cunglie a awpa bangkhuo dyapasya riypata a vaw riypa pasupaliyna taa khata ica khuo aa.
I vaw patang aa; na byilakhuv kha malie ta ama la li riypata na hnyi ciepa kha a cusa pata patuv tie.

Tena na hmung kieca i Khazing biena-ing chunglie kha asuvtung ta ca tue'a angte, khatiy tahmuo capa biena-ing taa cata pya'a va tli ciy. I Khazing ming hne vuoruo lie i Khazing'a taata zaa cungpa Jerusalem khypuv thaapa ming hne kama ming thaapa kha na cunglie i cape aa.
Thlaapa ta khrihsaabuv tie'a luo a ripa hing naa a hnyipa mekaa ta thyi mang yi sue.
“Laodisia khy lieta a awpa khrihsaabuv avuoming'a luo kha hing haa hingta cape tie: Khazing sapa bangkhuo lie a hruothuna ta a cuopa, zang tluo aa tlapa biehmisipa pachangkhyituv Amen bie tana a cuo:
“Na re hriepa kha i pachang; nama ca a cakaa zaw cakaa ra vaciy, a sa zaw sa ra vaciy. Na cakaa kie cakaa, na sa kie sa tapa ica khing.
Caacuonakawta, nama ca lalung duodyi cuo cate, a cakaa zaw cakaa li, a sa zaw sa li pata na aw nakawta i pakaa taata ica pacha'a nang tli.
Nama ta, ‘I hnyirung, i ky i ca, khaapahmuo a hu va ang,’ na ta. Palung phakhyi aa chiy li tlipa, ngiechichawhmaa aa chiypa, dawchiepa, mingcuepa hne thliehripa ta na awpa kha a pachang vaciy.

Caacuonakawta na hnyirungna riypata myi ta rue pata pathe sa ciepa siy kha kama'a taata naa calyi riypata ruena ica pi. Na thliehripa ta na awpa na nangzaana caa pahruv riypata pang ruopa naa calyi riypa hne na hmung thena riypata na ming lie naa thuv riypa siyy naa calyi riypata ruena ica pi.
I duepa zaw ca sue be yi angte i pasiypa-ya yi. Caacuonakawta a hmuochuo la na suenapa kha a ngiepachiy tie.

Naathlie tie! Ingchiypakaa lie a daa angte i cakhaw nguoluo; i ryi kha thyi cate ingchiy ina pahaw ca kieca nama'a luo kha a zaa ngie'a angte, nama'a lieta sa i ning aa, nama zaw kama'a lieta sa na ning ra aa.
Kama ca tena hmung angte i Paa hneta a byithude cunglie maa tu pakhawpa haata, tena a hmungpa ca kama byithude cunglie a tu pakhawna naw kha i pi aa.
Thlaapa ta khrihsaabuv tie'a luo a ripa hing naa a hnyipa mekaa ta thyi mang yi sue.”

Cakhutaa cata i mang ca, vuoruo lie ingchiypakaa suokha aa pahawpa kha i hmung. Hmyakaa haata paring te kama'a luo bie a za ri nguoluopa i thyi taapa ca, “Hingpa luo hing kya kie la hingpa khu taa hingta khaapama a vya cuo aa tapa kha ica pahmung aa,” ina ta.
Sungkhabala ta thlaapa ta bi angte, vuoruo lie a tupa byithude suokha hne a cunglie a tupa pakha kha i hmung.
Capa lie a tupa ca jasper lungvaa hne karnelian lungvaa haata khe te, byithude ca emerald lungvaa haata a tapa buvtuvruoriy ta a cadung.
Byithude ca a hrangpa byithude suokiy suopaliy ta cadung yi te, capa byithude zaw cunglie ca ama luv lie siylakhuv a khuv yi te pang ruopa a buvpa uvthyi pakiy papaliy amaa tu.
Byithude taa cata thinghlaa a cakang te khalung aa thy. Byithude hmiekunglie ca myisaa vuopa suosariy aw te, capa tie ca Khazing thlaapa suosariy ta ama cuo.
Byithude hmiekunglie ca thlaluo lung haata a pasingpa riyliy a aw. Byithude cahriy, a kuo cyicuo lie ca a hmieluo hne a hnangluo hne ming ta a bipa a hringpa saruopa papaliy ama aw.

A pakhanapa saruopa ca chingde hneta a lu te a pahningnapa saruopa ca cuetungpa hneta aa lu, a pathungnapa saruopa a hmie ca cawsaa hmie hneta a lu te, a papaliynapa saruopa ca aa zulepa hmungthlu hneta aa lu.

A hringpa saruopa papaliy ca mathlaa suocaruv law hnyi yi te ama chungluo hne ama leluo hne ming ta a bi diy. Chung hne zuo ta taw li pata hlaa sa yi te, “A pathe, a pathe, a pathe, Lesyice Abyipa Khazing, a zaa aw tlipa, a aw nguoluopa hne a vya aw riypa tana a cuo,” ama ta.
A hringpa saruopa tie ta byithude cunglie a tupa, chuozaa taata chuozaa te a hringpa ca rungnaana, pa-uvsathyina hne alawna ta ama pathuosa.

Cahaacata ama pathuosa ning ca uvthyi pakiy papaliy tie ca chuozaa taata chuozaa te a hringpa, byithude cunglie a tupa paa hmielie ca a bu yi te amaa bie; ama byilakhuv kha byithude hmielie ca chi yi te,

“Ma Byipaapa hne ma Khazing, Nama ca rungnaana, pa-uvsathyina hne cahrana cu tluo aa tlapa tana na cuo. Tahematapakieca, hmangting zawdya kha nama ta tue cate, Na khingna haata na sapa hne a hringpa tana ama cuo,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata byithude lie a tupa pakha kuv chunglie kha caataw suokha i hmung. Capa caataw ca a chung luo hne a hnangluo ta caa a cape diy te caakhe suosariy ta amaa cung.
Cakhutaata a thaaruvpa avuoming pakha ta a ueryi paringsa pata, “Ahungma caataw kha pahaw pata caakhe kha para riypata a tla aa?” a ta.
Cuorasala vuoruo lie cuose, alyi lie cuose, alyi rawlie cuose, capa caataw ca pahaw pata a chung luo a mang khu riypa pakha hmuo aw va yi.
Capa caataw ca pahaw pata a chung luo mang khu riypata aa tlapa pakha hmuo ama hmung khu li nakawta kama ca khuopuv ta i caa.
Ca tiyta uvthyi pakhapa khata, “Caa khah, Judah phang, David Ciyhruo ta a cuopa ca tena kha a hmung tli. Ama ta caakhe suosariy hne caataw kha a pahaw khu aa,” ina ta.

Cakhutaata byithude hne a hringpa saruopa papaliy alalalie Tuvtaata aa daapa kha i hmung. Tuvtaata ca thie ciepa hneta aa lu. Kiy suosariy hne ming suosariy hnyi te, capa ming suosariy ca alyi cung bangkhuo luo pathliepa Khazing thlaapa pasariy tana a cuo.
Ama ca ta vaa te, byithude cunglie a tupa paa cacuoluo kuv lie caataw ca a la.

Caataw kha a la tiyta a hringpa saruopa papaliy hne uvthyi pakiy papaliy tie ca tingtuo suokha law hne mingpathepa tie thlaachuona ta a cuopa rangpa-ue hne a bipa siy kuotung kha amaa hrie kaluo pata Tuvtaata hmiekunglie kha amaa vya bu.

Hlaa thaapa kha ama sa: “Nama ca caataw la riypa hne caakhe pahaw riypata naa tla, tahematapakieca nama ca ca thie yi te, na thiyse ta, mingphang ting, ryi ting, cawsaa ting hne ruo ting chungtaata mingpathepa tie kha Khazing cuota na calyi tli.
Iema ca ma Khazing re hrie riypata pena suokha hne tluobyi zaw ta tue yi cate, iema ta alyi hing ama uv aa,” ama ta.
Cakhutaa cata i mang ca, byithude hne a hringpa saruopa tie hne uvthyi tie a cadungpa avuoming ri tie lipa tie ueryi kha i thyi.
Ama ueryi a aw zawdya ta ama sapa ca, “Ama thiepa Tuvtaata ca, cahrana hne hnyirungna hne singna hne lesyina hne, pa-uvsathyina hne rungnaana hne thluechiy kha hmung aa tla!” ama ta.

Cakhutaa cata vuoruo hne alyi hne alyi raw hne riyliy hne ama chunglie a awpa sapa hmang zaw bangkhuo ta hlaa sa yi te, “Byithude cunglie a tupa hne Tuvtaata cunglie, thluechiyna hne pa-uvsathyina hne rungnaana hne lesyina ca chuozaa taata chuozaa te aw mang sue!” ama ta.
Cakhutaa cata a hringpa saruopa papaliy tie ca ta, “Amen!” ta yi te a bu yi te amaa bie.
Cakhutaata Tuvtaata tah caakhe suosariy chungtaata suokha a pahawpa kha i hmung. Cakhutaata a hringpa saruopa papaliy chung taa pakha ta khalung a thypa ueryi haata, “A vaw!” a tapa kha i thyi.
Mang angte aruo ruopa sakha i hmung! A khangpa paa ta liy suokha a hnyi; byilakhuv kha pi yi te tena hmung canyi lawmaw riypata a pyale.
Caakhe suohningna kha a pahaw tiyta, a hringpa saruopa pahningna ta, “A vaw!” ta pata a upa kha i thyi.
Aruo hrangpa sakha kya pya te a sepa ta a cuo. A khangtuvpa ca cawsaa pakha hne pakha amaa thie riypata alyi taata diena kha la riypata naw ama pi; cakhutaata zueziy lesapa zaw kha ama pi.

Tuvtaata ca caakhe suothungna kha a pahaw tiyta, a hringpa saruopa pathungna ta, “A vaw!” ta pata a upa kha i thyi. I mang ca aruo vawpa sakha i hmung. A khangtuvpa ta a kuv lie cyipathlienapa suokha aa hrie.

A hringpa saruopa papaliy hraw taata pakha ueryi haata i thyipa ca, “Ning kha thavie ta jungsacuo chuo libang zung kha, barli kie libang zung thung, cuorasala olif chiytiy hne mingsuvtiy ca para khah!” a ta.
Caakhe suopaliyna kha a pahaw tiyta, a hringpa saruopa papaliynapa ta, “A vaw!” ta pata a unapa ueryi kha i thyi.

I mang ca a pyipa aruo sakha i hmung. A khangtuvpa ming ca Thiyna ta pata cuo te ama ca Athiykhy ta a vya paziyle. Chuelyi che paliy che kha cunglie nawhnyina pi pata cuo yi te, zueziy ta cuose, cakuo ta cuose, puvtlungna ta cuose, aa hruopa saruopa ta cuose cawsaa thie khuna naw kha ama hmung.
Caakhe suopangaana kha a pahaw tiyta, Khazing bie kawlie cuose, tehte amaa khuona kawlie cuose ama thiepa thlaapa tie kha bienatluophie rawlieta i hmung yi. Iema ca ta,
“Lesyice Abyipa, a pathepa hne biehmisipa, khatiy te khiy ma hing alyi cawsaa tie hing bie ripa li pata hne ma thiyse kawlie phuv la li pata na aw'a yi?” ta pata khuosa ta ama khi.
Iema pakha cyicuo ca pang ruopa kha pi yi te, iema haata thie ra riypata a cuopa ama changtaapa tie hne ama uvnu hne sieta zaw ama tlingna te ta cuo pachangta chung a pahy caw riypata ama chang.
Caakhe suocaruvna kha a pahaw tiyta, i mang ca aling khuopuv ta aa siy; ning ca pangcaw vawpa haata vaw te, thlaapa punglungpa ca thiyse haata aa li.
Avuo aasiy zaw ca khysuv ta cahang te thyikuv hipa a kung taata a zungpa haata alyi luo ama za zung,
Avuo ca caataw haata a kalang te a vie, tluo bangkhuo hne parala zaw ca ama awna taata amaa palaw diy.
Chuelyi siepahruo tie, uvtuv tie, riebyi tie, a hnyirungpa hne nawhnyituv tie, cawsaa bangkhuo, sii hne hya a zangpa bangkhuo ca lungkaraw lie hne alungpuvnung alalalie amaa nu diy.
Tluo hne alungpuvnung kha u yi te, “Malie za vy ung la Tuvtaata hihaana taata hne byithude cunglie a tupa hmiekung taa hingta malie nu thi tie ung;
tahematapakieca iema hihaana ningkhue lepuv ca vya tlung te ahungma a ang khu the aa?” ta pata ama khi.
Cakhutaa cata alyi kiy paliy lie avuoming papaliy amaa daapa kha i hmung. Alyi lie cuose, riyliy lie cuose, thingkung cunglie cuose a hruo li riypata thliy luopuv suopaliy kha ama patuv.

Avuoming a hrangpa pakha ta a hringpa Khazing caakhe kha a hrie te ningchiyna luo taata a kya kiepa kha i hmung. Alyi hne riyliy para riypata cahrana ama pipa avuoming papaliy kha ueryi paringsa pata u yi te,
“Ma Khazing sii zaw kha ama puo lie caa ma khe diy hluo li yi alyi hne riyliy hne thingkung zaw kha para khah ung,” a ta yi.
Cakhutaata Israel mingphang mekaa taata caa ama khepa bangkhuo ca ting kha thaw sawliy thaw paliy a cuopa kha i thyi.
Judah phang chungtaata thaw hraa hlyihning, Reuben phang chungtaata thaw hraa hlyihning, Gad phang chungtaata thaw hraa hlyihning,
Asher phang chungtaata thaw hraa hlyihning, Naftali phang chungtaata thaw hraa hlyihning, Manasseh phang chungtaata thaw hraa hlyihning,
Simeon phang chungtaata thaw hraa hlyihning, Levi phang chungtaata thaw hraa hlyihning, Issakhar phang chungtaata thaw hraa hlyihning,
Zebulun phang chungtaata thaw hraa hlyihning, Josef phang chungtaata thaw hraa hlyihning, Benjamin phang chungtaata thawhraa hlyihning ta ama cuo.

Cakhutaa cata i mang ca ahungtahmuo ama ri tie li riypa cawsaazaapuv kha i hmung yi. Iema ca ruo ting, phang ting hruo ting taa hne ryi ting taata cuo yi te, pang ruopa amaa buv, ama kuv lie hngiesie hnaa a cyi yi te byithude hmielie hne tuvtaata hmielie kha amaa daa.
Khuosa ta khi yi te, “Khuona ca byithude cunglie a tupa ma Khazing hne Tuvtaata huopa tana a cuo!” ama ta.
Avuoming bangkhuo ca byithude hne uvthyi tie hne a hringpa saruopa tie kha cadung yi te amaa tu, byithude hmielie kha a khuv yi te Khazing kha amaa bie.

Hlaa sa yi te, “Amen! Thluechiy hne rungnaana hne singna hne palungtluona bie hluona hne pa-uvsathyina hne cahrana hne lesyina ca chuozaa taata chuozaa te ma Khazing huopa ta cuo mang sue! Amen,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata uvthyi zaw hraw taata pakha ta kama kha, “Pang ruopa a buvpa tie hing ahung zaw tama ama cuo? Khaapa taata ma amaa vaw? ina ta.
Kama ta, “Abyipa, nama na a pachang ciy,” i ta. Cakhutaata ama ta, “Iema ca ruvnaana lesapa chungtaata a vya lawpa tie tana ama cuo. Ama pang kha tuvtaata thiy lie pasuv yi te a ruo phaalaa tli.
Capa kawlie ca tana Khazing byithude hmielie aw yi te, Biena-ing chunglie chung hne zuo hne amaa bie, byithude lie a tupa khata iema ca a mangchiy yi.
Ama nang diy li tli'a pata, ama tiy zaw hrie'a va tli; ningsaa ta e'a va tli yi, a lingpa khaapatahmuo riethyi pi'a va tli yi;

tahematapakieca byithude liekhingkhuo lie a awpa Tuvtaata ca ama tuvkhietuv cuo'a te, ama ta iema kha hringna tiyhnaa luo aa chiy'a yi, cakhutaata Khazing ta ama mingthliy bangkhuo kha a hruvpa diy'a yi,” a ta.
Tuvtaata ta caakhe suopangaana a pahaw tiyta, siymaluo a che chung vuoruo lie kha a duokaring.
Cakhutaata avuoming pasariy Khazing hmielie amaa daapa kha hmung yi angte iema kha hmyakaa suokha law ama pi.

Siy ziyhmyibi a cyipa avuoming a hrangpa pakha a vaw te bienatluophie lie kha aa daa. Mingpathepa tie thlaachuona hneta byithude hmielie a awpa siy bienatluophie cunglie biena pihluo riypata capa avuoming ca ziyhmyi a hluvsa ama pi.
Avuoming kuv taata ziyhmyi khuv ca mingpathepa tie thlaachuona hneta Khazing hmiekung luo ca a khuv thaw.
Cakhutaata avuoming ca ta ziyhmyibi kha la te, bienatluophie lie myi kha a khung chiy khutaata alyi luo kha a thaw ca alyi lie ca khalung aa thy, paci a tla, thinghlaa a cakang te aling aa siy.
Hmyakaa suosariy a hnyipa avuoming pasariy ca hmyakaa tung riypata a ting cie pata ama aw.

A pakhana avuoming ta a hmyakaa kha a tung ca, thiy hne aa pyapa ari hne myi kha alyi luo za tla te alyi che thung che kha ca myi ta a kuo. Thingkungpa che thung che kha ca uv sa diy te aphuv hringpa bangkhuo zaw a kuo sa diy.
A pahningna avuoming ta a hmyakaa kha a tung ca, myi a hlaa nguoluopa tluo lepuv haata a tapa suokha ca riyliy luo kha ama thaw.
Riyliy che thung che kha ca thiy ta a li te, riyliy chunglie a awpa saruopa che thung che kha ca ama thiy. Tiypalaw che thung che kha zaw ama ra.
A pathungna avuoming ta a hmyakaa kha a tung ca, myisaa vuopa haata a tapa aasiy lesapa suokha ca avuo taata cavaa hne acaa che thung che kha bangkhuo cung luo kha a tla.
Capa aasiy ming ca, “Khana,” ta pata a cuo. Tiy che thung che kha ca a kha nakawta capa tiy a dangpa cawsaa hluvpuv ca ama thiy.

A papaliyna avuoming ta a hmyakaa kha a tung ca, ning che thung che kha, thlaapa che thung che kha, hne aasiy che thung che kha ca dechi pata cuo te, ama khena che thung che kha ca a zing. Ningchung che thung che kha zuo che thung che kha zaw khena hnyi li pata a aw.

Cakhutaata i mang ca, avuo khingkhuo lie a pathlaapa hmungthlu sakha ta ueryi paringsa pata a khipa kha i thyi. “A hrangpa avuoming pathung ta ama tung riypa hmyakaa a vya paring kieca chuelyi ming cuota bawchie ciemuopa, bawchie ciemuopa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata a papangaana avuoming ta a hmyakaa kha a tung ca, avuo taata alyi luo aasiy suokha a tlapa kha i hmung. Ama ca dena a hnyi lipa khue pahawna tawh kha ama pi.
Dena a hnyi lipa khue kha a pahaw ca capa khue chung taa cata a lesapa myipung taata a pyapa myikhuv haa khata myikhuv ca a tawpuv ta a kya pya, capa myikhuv cata ning hne avuo kha a pazing.
Myikhuv taa cata khawbyapa kha pya yi te alyi luo ama za cung. Iema ca tluociekuo cahranapa haapa kha pi pata ama cuo.
Chuelyi lieta a awpa aphuv cuose, tuokhaapa a hringpa kung bangkhuo hne thingkung zaw kha para li pata ama puo lie Khazing caakhe a hnyi lipa cawsaa kyalya dyi kha para riypata changpa ama cuo.
Cawsaa kha thie tlung li pata thla pangaa chung hrisaana naw ama pi. Cawsaa ama hrisaa tiyta a pasanazya ca tluociekuo ta cawsaa a be ning haa kha tana a pasa.
Capa ningkhue thue ca cawsaa ta thiyna kha huv'a yi te, cuorasala hmung'a va yi, thiyna kha a ku'a yi te, cuorasala thiyna ta iema kha a ruose'a yi.
Capa khawbyapa tie hmingsuo ca rie tuv riypata pachie paciepa aruo hne tana amaa lu. Ama luv lie ca siy ta tuepa byilakhuv haapa kha a khuv yi te, ama hmie ca cawsaa hmie kha ama lu.
Ama suo ca canung suo kha lu te, ama haa ca chingde haa kha a lu.
Thaa cacunghnaapakaw haapa phuvhling kha hnyi yi te, ama mathlaa pu ca rietuvna luo a ruole nguoluopa aruole pu hne tana aa lu.
Malie a be thepa tluociekuo lahmyi haapa kha hnyi yi te, capa lahmyi lie ca cawsaa kha thla pangaa chung riethyi a pi khupa cahrana ama hnyi.
Dena a hnyi lipa khue avuoming kha siepahruo ta hnyi yi te, a ming ca Hebru ryi ta Abaddon ta yi te Grik ryi ta Apollyon ama ta.
A suokhana bawchiena ca chuo te, hingpa khu taa hingta a vaw riypa a hrangpa suohning a aw kalie.
Cakhutaata pacaruvnapa avuoming ta a hmyakaa kha a tung ca, Khazing hmiekunglie a awpa siy bienatluophie kiy suopaliy taa khata ueryi i thyi.
Hmyakaa a hnyipa a pacaruvnapa avuoming ca ta, “Cavaa lesapa Zufrates lie ama hrepa avuoming papaliy kha pathlie ung,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta avuoming papaliy ca ama pathlie. Iema ca capa cuo, capa ning, capa thlaa, capa kung, lie hrahring ca ta cawsaa che thung che kha kha thie riypata chi paciepa tie ta ama cuo.
Aruo rieka bangkhuo ca ting thawhning ama ta, ta pata i thyi.

Muocuo i hmungpa lieta i hmungpa aruo hne a khangtuv tie ca hing haa hingta a cuo. A khangtuv tie ca myi haata a sepa, safaiar lungvaa haata a dungpa, ke haata a mepa cacunghnaapakaw kha amaa pakaw. Amaa ruo luv ca chingde luv kha lu te, ama pakaa taa khata myi, myikhuv hne ke kha ama pya.
Capa ama pakaa taata a pyapa myi, myikhuv hne ke taata a pyapa puvtlungna ca ta cawsaa che thung che kha ca a thie yi.
Aruo zaw ama cahrana ca ama pakaa lie hne ama lahmyi lie tana a aw. Ama lahmyi ca pariy lu te luv ama hnyi; capa ca ta ruvnaana kha ama pi.

Capa puvtlungna ta a thie lipa, aa ngaapa cawsaa zaw ca ama kuv ta ama tuepa hmang kawlie kha a ngiepachiy va yi: khuevuo abie kha cuose, siy, ngu, daa, alung hne thing ta ama tuepa, a hmung the lipa, a thyi the lipa hne a cakuo the lipa kuvtuezuv abie zaw kha thuse hlyi va yi.
Ca hlyitaw taata cawsaa ama thiena, malie ama ca-iena, aparuvsuena ama tuena hne ama paruv thena taa zaw khata a ngiepachiy va yi.

Cakhutaata vuoruo taata a thaaruvsapa avuoming hrangpa pakha a za cungpa kha i hmung. Ama ca amyi ta pahlaw te a luv cunglie buvtuvruoriy a aw; a hmie ca ning haata cuo te, a phyi ca myitung haata a cuo.
Ama ta caataw taata pake ciepa kha a kuv lie aa cyi. A cacuoluo phyi kha riyliy lie a chaa, a cavyiluo phyi kha alyi lie chaa te
chingde aa hrungpa haa khata khuopuv ta a khi. Ama a khi tiyta khalung suo sariy aa thy.
Khalung suo sariy aa thy tiyta caa cape kha i nang. Cuorasala vuoruo taata ueryi suokha thyi angte, “Khalung suo sariy aa thy pata a ripa kha cape li pata caakhe la chi caw tie,” ina ta.
Cakhutaa cata riyliy lie hne alyi lie aa daa pata i hmungpa avuoming khata a cacuoluo kuv kha avuo luo pazu te,
avuo hne a chunglie a awpa, riyliy hne a chunglie a awpa, chuozaa ta chuozaa te a hringpa ming ta chie aa sapa ca, “Ru'a va tli,
cuorasala a pasariyna avuoming ta a hmyakaa a tung ningpa ca ama ta a changtaapa profet tie'a luo a za pathyi ciepa Khazing bieparuv kha a tling aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata i thyipa vuoruo taata ueryi khata kama'a lie a ri pakhaapa ca, “Vaa la, riyliy lie hne alyi lie a daapa avuoming kuv lieta pake ciepa caataw kha va la tie,” ina ta.
Caacuonakawta avuoming'a luo kha vaa angte, caataw taata kha na pi tie, i ta ca, “A la lah ning tie; na pavaw chunglie kha a kha raalaa'a pata, na pakaa lie ca khyitiy haa tana a thlung aa,” ina ta.
Caacuonakawta caataw taata kha avuoming kuv taa cata la angte i ning ca i pakaa lie kha khyitiy haata a thlung. Cuorasala i ning khutaata i pavaw lie kha a kha.
Cakhutaata iema ta, “Nama ca cawsaa hluvpuv, mingphang hluvpuv, ryi hluvpuv hne siepahruo zaw'a luo khana biephu na ri pakhaa aa,” ina ta yi.
Cakhutaata khuecahryi a lupa taanapa asung suokha kha na pi te, “A vaw la, Khazing biena-ing hne bienatluophie kha taa la capa lieta abiepa tie mingluv kha ri tie yi.

Cuorasala biena-ing tlawhmie kha ca taa'a vaciy; pangaa tie, tahematapakieca khapa kha ca Khazing abie lipa tie'a luo pi pata cuo te iema ta khypuv pathepa kha thla sawliy hne thla hning chung amaa ciybaruv diy aa.
Cakhutaata buri a buvpa i tehte pahning tie kha ning thawkha zahning sawcaruv chung profetbiephu ri khuna naw i pi'a yi,” ana ta.
Iema ca alyi byi hmiekunglieta a daapa olif thingkung kung hning hne myi vuona tung suohning ta ama cuo.
Pakhakha ta ruvnaana a pi'a nang kie yi ca, ama pakaa taata myi kya pya te ama carie tie kha a kuo'a yi. Iema riethyi a pipa ahunghmuo cahaacata thiepa ama cuo aa.

Iema ta profetbiephu ama ri nguoluo ningta khy a saa li riypata avuo khaana naw kha ama hnyi. Tiy kha thiy ta pali riypa naw hnyi yi te, ama khing ning kyry ta alyi kha pasana phangphang ta ruvnaana ama pi khu.
Tehte amaa khuo khutaata dena a hnyi lipa khue chungtaata saahruo kha kya pya te, iema kha rie a du'a yi te a te khutaa yi ta a thie'a yi.
Ama riyy ca mingpakhipa ta Sodom hne Izipt ama tapa, ama Byipaapa vieluo lie ama za taanapa khypuv lepa luopuv cunglie kha a laa aa.
Phang ting ciy ting hne ryi ting taata cawsaa zaw khata ning thung angkha a che chung ama riyy kha mang'a yi te thluo chung luo paby riypa zaw ama thlu aa.

Alyi lie khy a sapa tie ca iema chiycuona kawlie kha ama palung tluo'a te, lasaw zaw amaa thle aa, tahematapakieca hingpa profet pahning tie hing alyi lie khy a sapa tie kha zaa tuechiepa tie tana ama cuo.
Cuorasala ning thung hne a che khutaata Khazing'a taata hringna huv kha iema chung luo a ngie te ama phyi ta amaa daa, a hmungpa bangkhuo ca ama phuv te aa hling.
Cakhutaata vuoruo taata ueryi paringsapa kha thyi yi te, “Hingpa luo hing kya kie ung!” a ta yi. Ama carie tie ta ama mang nguoluopa khata amyi chung vuoruo luo kha ama kie.
Capa cuota lie ca aling khuopuv ta a siy te, khypuv ca che hraa lie che kha ra te cawsaa thaw sariy ama thiy. Aa ngaapa tie ca ciy tuv hringhruo yi te vuoruo Khazing rungnaana kha ama pathuosa.
Suohningnapa bawchiena ca a chuo tli. Suothungnapa bawchiena kha a ru hluota aa vaw aa.

Cakhutaata a pasariyna avuoming ta a hmyakaa kha a tung ca vuoruo lie ueryi paringsapa ta, “Chuelyi pena ca ma Byipaapa hne Messiah pena ta a li tli te, chuozaa taata chuozaa te ama ta a uv aa,” a ta.
Cakhutaata Khazing hmiekung, amaa byithude cunglie a tupa uvthyi pakiy papaliy ca a bu yi te Khazing kha amaa bie.
Hlaa sa yi te, “Lesyice Abyipa Khazing, nama ca maca pathuosa, nama ca a aw nguoluopa, hne a zaa aw tlipa tana na cuo. Tahematapakieca a lesyipa na cahrana kha hmuo cate uv hruo kha naa pathu tli.

Mingphang zaw ca ama hi haa te, cuorasala a thiypa tie bieripa riypa cuo hne na hihaana ca aa vaw tli, na changtaapa na profet tie hne, na mingpathepa tie hne na ming caa ciyzaapa bangkhuo, a le a caw ta li pata lawmuo pi riypata hne, chuelyi a parapa tie kha para riypata a cuo,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata vuoruo lie Khazing biena-ing ca a pahaw te, a biekuona thingkaw kha biena-ing chunglie ca aa luo; thinghlaa aa cakang, khalung khuopuv ta aa thy, aling a siy te ari khuopuv ta a tla.
Cakhutaata avuo lie khiy kharuehaa hmang suokha aa luo. Canung pakha ca ning khiy a cawsie ta aa tue, thlaapa kha a phyi ta chaa te, aasiy suohraa hlyihning ta tuepa byilakhuv kha a luv lie aa khuv.
Nu phya te a puv'a nang tli nakawta nupazi te a khi nguoluo.
Cakhutaata avuo lie ca a hrangpa kharuehaa hmang suokha aa luo. A lesapa riyhre sepa sakha, luv suosariy hne kiy suohraa a hnyipa a luo te, a luv lie ca byilakhuv suosariy aa khuv.

A lahmyi ta avuo lie a awpa aasiy che thung che kha kha phiy pathla te alyi luo a thaw. Cakhutaa cata a saata a za puv pahne ta paluo naase ang ta pata riyhre ca a saata zaa aw'a nangpa cawsaanung hmiekunglie kha aa daa.
Cawsaanung ca ta mingphang bangkhuo thaa khuecahryi ta a uv riypa sacapaa kha a sa. Cuorasala a saata ca la paluo yi te Khazing hne aa byilakhuv hmieluo kha ama chiykhyi.
Cawsaanung ca ning thawkha zahning sawcaruv chung mangchiypa a cuo riypata Khazing ta a cuota a parawpa ruocaapa luo kha aa ruo.
Vuoruo lie rie thu te Mikhael hne aa vuoming khata riyhre kha amaa du. Riyhre hne aa vuoming ta ama tuv hriy,
cuorasala amaa sung nakawta iema cuota vuoruo lie hmang aw va tli.
Riyhre lesapa, khyhluo pariy, Khachie hne Setaa ama tapa, chuelyi bangkhuo a dungtuv ca aa vuoming hne khata alyi luo ama za thaw.

Cakhutaata vuoruo lieta ueryi paringsapa suokha thyi angte, “Ata hing ca khuona, cahrana hne, Khazing pena hne, Messiah nawhnyina kha aa vaw tli, tahematapakieca ma uvnu zaw kha Khazing hmielie chungzuo ta sue a betuv ca, thaw pathla pata a cuo tli.
Tuvtaata thiyse thue hne tehte ama khuona bie thueta ama kha ama te mangtli, tahematapakieca ama hringna pi kha zaa pahya yi te thiy zaw amaa zaa nguo.

Vuoruo hne a chunglie a awpa tie zaw, nama palung tluo se! Cuorasala alyi hne riyliy cuota ca bawchie hringhruopa tana a cuo, khachie ca khuopuv ta hihaana cangta niema'a luo a za cung tli, tahematapakieca ama cuota cuo a pachangsa tlipa khana a pachang!” a ta.
Riyhre ca alyi luo ama thawpa kha aa hmung tiyta sacapaa a sapa cawsaanung kha aa cade paluo.

Cuorasala cawsaanung ca pariy lepa awna taa khata ruocaapa luo aa zu khuna riypata hmungthlu lesapa mathlaa kha ama pi. Capa hmang lie ca cuo kha chung, cuo hning chung hne cuo che chung kha mangchiy pata a cuo aa.
Pariy ca ta cawsaanung kha tiy lepa ta phya naase ta pata a pakaa chungtaata tiy kha cavaa haata a papya.
Cuorasala alyi ta cawsaanung kha a bya te riyhre ta a pakaa taata a papyapa tiy kha a pakaa kya uo te a saw diy.
Riyhre ca cawsaanung cunglie kha a hi haasa te Khazing nawbie a ziypa hne Zingsuv kaw tehte a khuopa aa tuo kaliepa a saata zaw kha a du riypata a pya.
Cakhutaata riyhre ca riyliy kie viehnang cunglie kha aa daa.

Cakhutaata riyliy taata saahruo sakha a kya pyapa kha i hmung. Kiy suohraa hne luv suosariy hnyi te, a kiy zaw cunglie ca byilakhuv suohraa aw yi te a luv zaw cunglie ca Khazing rithuochina ming ama aw.
I hmungpa saahruo ca kyiching hneta a lu te, a phyi ca cavaw phyi hneta aa lu, a pakaa ca chingde pakaa hne aa lu. Riyhre ta a cahrana hne a byilakhuv hne nawhnyina lepa kha a pi.
A luv suokha ca thiykhyi tluopa hmaa zaa phya tlipa na a lu, cuorasala capa hmaa taa cata a tluo tli. Alyicung bangkhuo ta ama kharue haa te ama kha ama ziy.
Iema ta riyhre kha amaa bie, tahematapakieca a nawhnyina kha saahruo a pi nakawta a cuo. Saahruo zaw kha abie yi te, “Ahungma saahruo haapa hing a aw, ahungma ama a du khu aa?” ama ta.
Saahruo ca Khazing rithuochina biechiepa ri kha pa-awpa cuo te, thla sawliy thla hning chung hmuo the riypata nawhnyina ama pi.
Khazing rithuochi riypata a pakaa kha uo te, Khazing ming, Khazing awna hmang hne vuoruo lie a awpa tie kha a rithuochi yi.
Mingpathepa tie kha a du pata te riypa zaw kha pa-awpa a cuo. Mingphang mekaa, cawsaa mekaa, ryi phang mekaa hne ruo mekaa cunglie kha nawhnyina ama pi.
Ama thie ciepa Tuvtaata hringna caa-uv chunglie chuelyi hruothu baataata ama ming cape lipa, chuelyi lie khy a sapa bangkhuo ta ama kha amaa bie aa.
Thyina naa a hnyipa ta thyi yi se:

Sii ta a da riypa na cuo kieca, siicuona luo na si aa. Zueziy ta malie na thie kieca, zueziy ta thie pata na cuo ra aa. Hingpa hing ca mingpathepa tie ta ang khuna hne zangna ama hnyi riypata pasuna tana a cuo.
Cakhutaata saahruo sahningna alyi taata a kya pyapa kha i hmung. Tuvtaata haata kiy suohning hnyi te riyhre haata bie a ri.

Saahruo sakhana ta a hnyipa nawhnyina bangkhuo kha ama cuopa ta hmuo te alyi hne a chunglie a awpa bangkhuo kha thiykhyi khupa hmaa za phya te a tluo pakhaapa saahruo pakhana kha a bie riypata naw a pi yi.
Kharuehaa hmang a lepa puv zaw kha tue te cawsaa bangkhuo hmiekunglie kha vuoruo taata alyi luo myi a za pathla.
Saahruo suokhana cuopa ta tue khu riypata ama pa-awpa kharuehaa hmang kha hmuo te a dung yi. Zueziy hmaa phya te a hring kaliepa saahruo kuvtuezuv kha sa riypata a chang yi.
Saahruo sahningna ca saahruo sakhana kuvtuezuv kha huv pi pata bie pari sa khuna hne ama abie lipa tie zaw thie khuna naw kha ama pi.
Capa saahruo ca ta a lepa hne a cawpa, a hnyirungpa hne siypasapa, a hyazangpa hne sii bangkhuo kha ama cacuoluo kuv acuolikie ama puo lie a hnangna a patue sa yi.
Saahruo ming acuolikie a ming nangbaa, aa hnangnapa kha a hnyi lipa ca hmang kha a calyi zaw calyi khu li pata a zaa zaw zaa khu ra va yi.

Hingpa lie hing singna hmuo aa hu ciemuo: singna a hnyipa ta saahruo nangbaa siyluo ca tue yi se, hingpa nangbaa hing cawsaa pakha nangbaa tana a cuo. Capa nangbaa ca zacaruv sawcaruv suocaruv ta a cuo.
Cakhutaa cata i mang ca Zion Tluo lieta Tuvtaata aa daapa kha i hmung. Ama puo lieta iema ming hne ama Paa ming aa capepa ting kha thaw sawliy thaw paliy ama hneta ama awpa zaw kha i hmung.
Cakhutaa cata vuoruo taata ueryi thyi angte, capa ueryi ca tiysue lesapa pu hne khalung pu haata a cuo. Ueryi i thyipa ca tingtuo a tungpa tie ta ama tingtuolepa ama tungpa ue haa tana a cuo.

Iema ca ta byithude hne saruopa a hringpa papaliy hmielie hne uvthyi zaw hmielie kha hlaa thaapa ama sa. Alyi taata khuopa ting kha thaw sawliy thaw paliy tie ta li pata ahungtahmuo capa hlaa ca the khu va yi.

Iema ca canung hne aa papya aa palyi lipa, a pathepa, hne Tuvtaata a cakuona luo mekaa ta a ziylepa tie ta ama cuo. Iema ca cawsaa hraw taata Khazing hne Tuvtaata cuota khuopa thyipaa taapa tie ta ama cuo.
Ama pakaa taata hangna bie pya vyi; risie riypa zaw aw va yi.

Cakhutaata avuoming hrangpa pakha avuo liekhingkhuo lie aa zu nguoluopa kha i hmung. Ama ca alyi lie a awpa ruo mekaa, mingphang mekaa, ryi mekaa hne cawsaa mekaa'a luo pathyi sa riypa chuozaa thuophaa pathyi satuv ta a cuo.
Ueryi paringsapa ta a ripa ca, “Khazing kha ciyzaa ung la rungnaana pi tie ung, a bieripana ning na a vya tlung tli; alyi hne avuo, riyliy hne cavaa zaw a satuv kha abie tie ung,” a ta.

Cakhutaa cata avuoming hrangpa, a pahningna ta paziy te a ripa ca, “Aa lie tli, a lesyipa Babilon ca aa lie tli! A saapa huenapa Khazing hihaana mingsuv kha mingphang ting a padang sapa cawsaanung tana a cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata a pathungna avuoming a hrangpa ta ueryi paringsapa ta a khipa ca, “Saahruo hne a kuvtuezuv kha abiepa hne ama puo lie hne ama kuv lieta aa hnangna a hnyipa tie ca
Khazing hihaana panuo chung luo khaapahmuo pyapa aw li pata ama lyipa Khazing mingsuv khana ama dang aa. Iema ca a pathepa avuoming hne Tuvtaata hmielie kha myi hne ke ta hrisaana kha ang'a yi te,
iema ama hrisaanapa myikhuv ca chuozaa ta a khuvthaw pari aa. Saahruo hne ama kuvtuezuv abiepa hne a ming aa hnangnapa a hmungpa tie ca ama cuota chungzuo ta a hyna cuo aw'a vyi,” a ta.
Hingpa hing Khazing nawbie a ziypa tie hne Zingsuv zangna kha a cusa pata a patuvpa mingpathepa tie cuota ang khuna ama hnyi aa hu tana ta a cuo.

Cakhutaata vuoruo taata ueryi suokha thyi angte, “Cape tie: Abyipa zangna cangta a thiypa tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo,” ina ta. Thlaapa ta, “A cuo, iema ca ama rehriena taa khata a pahy'a yi te, ama tuena ta iema kha a paziyle'a yi,” a ta.
I mang ca amyi ruopa suokha hmung angte, capa cunglie ca Cawsaa Sacapaa a lupa pakha kha a luv cunglie siy byilakhuv a khuv te a kuv lie tuokyi cahresapa suokha aa cyi pata i hmung.

Avuoming a hrangpa pakha biena-ing chungtaata kya pya te, amyi cunglie a tupa pakha kha ueryi paringsapa ta u te, “Na tuokyi kha hmuo la uo tie, tahematapakieca alyi sa hing a hmingsa tli nakawta uona cuo khana a de tli,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta amyi cunglie a tupa paa ta a tuokyi kha alyi cung luo kha va pahie te sa ca a uo.
Cakhutaata avuoming a hrangpa kha vuoruo biena-ing chungtaata kya pya te, ama zaw tuokyi cahresapa suokha a hnyi.

A hrangpa avuoming, myi cunglie naw a hnyituv kha bienatluophie taata kya pya te, tuokyi cahresapa a hnyituv avuoming kyihuo khata, a ueryi paringsapa ta, “Mingsuv kha a hmingsa tli nakawta na tuokyi cahresapa kha hmuo la alyi mingsuv zaw kha pahmya tie,” a ta.
Caacuonakawta avuoming ta a tuokyi kha pahie te alyi taata mingsuv kha pahmya te Khazing hihaana mingsuv aciyna chung luo kha a thaw.
Cakhutaata mingsuv ca khypuv le luo mingsuv a ciyna lie kha amaa ciy ca mingsuv aciyna chung taa cata thiyse ca aruo hmyakhe te aa suo pata me zahning tluv te ta a lang.

Cakhutaata avuo lieta a lesyipa hne kharuehaa aa chiypa pahmungsana hmang suokha i hmung. Avuoming pasariy hne puvtlung pasana suosariy cuo yi te capa ca a hnangcaw cepa ta a cuo. Tahematapakieca Khazing hihaana a chuona tana a cuo.

Cakhutaata myi hneta aa pyapa thlaluo riyliy haapa suokha i hmung. Saahruo hne a kuvtuezuv hne a ming nangbaa a tetuv tie kha ama kuv lieta Khazing tingtuolepa kha a cyi yi te thlaluo riyliy kielie amaa daapa ta i hmung.

Iema ca Khazing changtaapa Moses hlaa hne Tuvtaata hlaa kha ama sa: “Lesyice Abyipa Khazing, Kha tluv tama na hmang tuepa hing lesyi te kharuehaa aa chiy! Biedangpa hne biehmisipa ca na luopuv tana a cuo, mingphang zaw Siepahruo!

Abyipa, ahungma nama ca ciy li pata hne na ming kha parungnaa sa li pata a aw aa? Tahematapakieca nama pakha dyi hingna a pathe ciy. Mingphang bangkhuo hing na hmiekung luo a vaw'a yi te, nama kha acaa bie'a yi, tahematapakieca na bieripana ca aa luo tli,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata i mang ca, vuoruo lie tehtekhuona thluodaa biena-ing aa pahawpa kha i hmung.
Avuoming pasariy kha puvtlung pasana suosariy hne biena-ing chungtaata ama kya pya. Iema ca a pathepa a khepa pang kha a buv yi te, ama cacunghnaa kha siy cacunghnaapaze amaa paze.
Cakhutaa cata a hringpa saruopa papaliy chung taata pakha ta avuoming pasariy ca chuozaa ta a hringpa Khazing hihaana ta a bipa siy kuotung suosariy kha a pi yi.
Biena-ing ca Khazing rungnaana hne a cahrana taata a pyapa myikhuv ta bi te, avuoming pasariy tie puvtlung pasana suosariy ama chuo hluo li biena-ing chung luo ca pakha hmuo a ngie khu va yi.
Biena-ing taata ueryi paringsapa suokha ta avuoming pasariy kha, “Vaa ung la Khazing hihaana kuotung suosariy kha alyi cung luo va lyi tie ung,” a tapa yi kha i thyi.
Avuoming pakhanapa ta a kuotung kha alyi luo a bung ca saahruo a hnangna a hnyipa hne ama kuvtuezuv abiepa tie cunglie kha a pahnuosapa hne a pasasapa hmaa a kya aw.
Pahningnapa avuoming ta a kuotung kha riyliy luo a bung. Tiy ca a thiypa riyy chungtaata a pyapa thiy haata a li te riyliy chunglie a awpa a hringpa bangkhuo kha ama thiy diy.
Pathungnapa avuoming ta a kuotung kha cavaa hne acaa luo kha a bungh ca thiy ta amaa li.

Cakhutaata tiy a uvtuv avuoming ta, “Hluo ning taata za aw te ata lie zaw a awpa Vya A Pathepa, nama ca aa dangpa tana na cuo, tahematapakieca hingpa hmang zaw cunglie hing nama na bieripana a tue ciy;
iema ta mingpathepa tie hne profet tie thiy kha ama za palang nakawta, ama dang riypata thiy kha na pi yi. Capa ca iema amaa phuvpa tana a cuo!” a ta.
Cakhutaata bienatluophie ta a paliepa kha thyi angte, “A cuo, Vya Lesyice Abyipa Khazing, na bieripana ca a hmuo te aa dang,” a ta.
Papaliynapa avuoming ta a kuotung kha ning cungluo bungh te, ning ca cawsaa kha myi haata kuona naw pi pata a cuo.
Iema ca a lingsuesaapa lingna ta kuo yi te, cuorasala puvtlung pasana cunglie naw a hnyituv Khazing ming kha chie ama sa. A ngiepachiy pata Khazing ming kha pathuosa va yi.
Papangaanapa avuoming ta a kuotung kha saahruo byithude cunglie a bungh. Saahruo uvna chunglie kha khyzingna a tlung. Cawsaa ca ama palyi kha a ce yi te,
ama angpa pasana hne hmaa kawlieta vuoruo Khazing kha chie ama sa. Ama tuepa hmang pha lipa kha a ngiepachiy va yi.
Pacaruvnapa avuoming ta a kuotung kha Zufrates cavaapuv cunglie a bungh. Ningchiyluo taata siepahruo tie cuota luo pa-aw riypata cavaa ca a ky.
Cakhutaata riyhre pakaa taata cuose, saahruo pakaa taata cuose, profet pakhipa pakaa taata cuose, ca-uv a lupa thlaapa pyalyipa pathung amaa vawpa kha i hmung.
Iema ca khuevuo thlaapa ta ama cuo, kharuehaa hmang kha tue yi te, Lesyice Khazing rietuvnapa ning thue cuota pahmya riypa yi ta ruo ting siepahruo tie'a luo kha ama si.
(“Mang tie ung, aparuvpa haa tana i vaw aa! A thliehripa ta aa khie li riypa hne a nangzaana a paluo li riypata a hmung li pata hne cawsie a tue ciepa ta a awpa ca thluechiypa tana a cuo.”)
Cakhutaata khuevuo thlaapa tie ca ta siepahruo tie kha Hebru ryi ta Armageddon ama tapa hmang lie ama pahmya.
Pasariynapa avuoming ta a kuotung kha thliy lieta a bungh. Biena-ing chung byithude taata ueryi paringsapa suokha a kya thyi te, “Aa lang tli!” a ta.

Cakhutaa cata thinghlaa aa cakang, khalung aa thy, paci tla te aling khuopuv ta aa siy. Chuelyi lie cawsaa ama aw baataata cahaapa aling ca a siy buo vyi, aling a siy buopa hrawlie a ruv cepa tana a cuo.
Khypuv lesyipa ca che thung ta a chechi te, ruo ting lie khypuv zaw ca ama ra. Khazing ta a lesyipa Babilon kha maw li pata a hihaana mingsuv panuo kha a padang sa.
Parala bangkhuo ca a ruo diy yi te, tluo zaw kha hmung khu aw va tli yi.
Ari pangkatupa, paw zakha te aa riypa kha avuo taata cawsaa zaw cungluo ca a za tla. Ciy aa chiy hringhruopa, ari ta puv a patlung sana kawlie ca ta cawsaa ta Khazing kha chie ama sa.
Cakhutaata kuotung suosariy a hnyipa avuoming pasariy chungtaata pakha kha a vaw te, “A vaw tie, tiy cunglie a tupa a lesyipa siyhrawnung ta a ang riypa bieripana na ica pahmung sa aa.
Alyi siepahruo tie ta ama hne aparuvsuena tue yi te chuelyi lie khy a sapa tie ta hingpa nung aparuvsuena mingsuv kha ama pariy,” ina ta.

Caacuonakawta ama ta thlaapa cahrana ta kama kha ruocaapa luo na sikhyi te, cawsaanung pakha ca chiesanapa ming ta a bipa, luv suosariy hne kiy suohraa a hnyipa, a sepa saahruo cunglie aa tupa kha i hmung.

Capa cawsaanung ca a ciycaapa hne a sedungpa caw kha a tue te siy hne alung sungnaapa hne palelungvaa ta aa pangi. A kuv lie kha duvsamakhie aa chiypa hne a pathe lipa ta a bipa aparuvsuena a tuenapa siy panuo kha aa hrie.
A puo lie aa capepa ming, a ri khingna nupa ca, “A lesyipa Babilon, alyi lie a awpa duvsamakhie aa chiypa hne siyhrawnung tie zaw nung,” ta pata a cuo.
Capa canung ca mingpathepa tie thiy hne Zingsuv cuota tehte a cuopa tie thiy a pariypa kha i hmung. Capa nung ca i hmung tiyta, i nang ta a uo.

Cuorasala avuoming ca ta, “Khaapanakawma ca tluv nanaa ta na nang a uo? Cawsaanung hne ama a phyalepa a luv suosariy a hnyipa hne a kiy suohraa a hnyipa saahruo a ri khingna nupa siyluo ca ica chang aa.

Na hmungpa saahruo ca a hluota za aw te, ata hing ca aw va tli. Dena a hnyi lipa khue chung taa khata kya pya'a te a ra aa. Chuelyi hruothu baataata hringna caa-uv chunglie ama ming cape lipa, chuelyi lie khy a sapa tie ta saahruo kha ama hmung tiyta ama nang a uo sa aa. Tahematapakieca a hluota za aw te, ata hing a aw li tli raalaa pata a vya aw pakhaa aa.
“Hingpa kawlie hing singna hne pachangna aa hu: luv suosariy ca cawsaanung aa tunapa tluo suosariy ta a cuo; siepahruo pasariy zaw ta a cuo ra.
Capa siepahruo tie chung taa cata papangaa ca ama thiy tli, pakha hring kalie te, a hrangpa pakha ca a vaw valie; aa vaw thue zaw ta cuo pachangta dyina a aw aa.
A hluota za aw te ata hing a aw li tlipa saahruo ca a pacarinapa a cuo raalaa pata siepahruo pasariy chunglieta pakha ta cuo te, rana luo a chiy riypa tana a cuo.
Na hmungpa kiy suohraa ca uvpa ruo a hnyi li liepa siepahruo pahraa ta cuo yi te, cuorasala saahruo hneta siymaluo pakha chung uv hne riypata siepahruo nawhnyina kha pipa ama cuo aa.
Iema ca saahruo'a luo ama cahrana hne ama nawhnyina kha pi riypata ama palung aa lusa.

Tuvtaata kha amaa du aa, cuorasala Tuvtaata tah a te'a yi. Tahematapakieca ama ca byi tie Byi hne siepahruo tie Siepahruo tana a cuo. Ama'a lie a awpa tie ca kupa tie, a tlawpa tie hne zang tluo aa tlapa tie tana ama cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata, “Siyhrawnung aa tunapa na hmungpa tiy ca ruo ting taata ryi ting a cyipa mingphang ting tana ama cuo.
Na hmungpa kiy suohraa tie hne saahruo khata siyhrawnung kha huesa'a yi te, ama kha para'a yi te a thliehripa ta ama chi aa. A saa kha a ce chuv'a yi te myi ta ama rue aa.
Tahematapakieca Khazing ta a bie ripa a tling hluo li, iema ama uvpa ruo kha saahruo'a luo pi pata ama aa tingpa ama hrie khing riypa kha ama palung chunglie a chi.
Na hmungpa cawsaanung hing chuelyi siepahruo tie a uvtuv khypuv tana a cuo,” ina ta.
Cakhutaa cata vuoruo taata avuoming hrangpa a za cungpa kha i hmung. Nawhnyina lepuv kha hnyi te, a khena ta chuelyi kha a pakhe diy.

Ueryi a paring suesaapa ta khi te, “A lie tli, a lesyipa Babilon ca aa lie tli! Khuevuo zaw awna hmang tana aa li, a pyalyipa thlaapa zaw tlena hmang, a pyalyipa pavaa zaw awna hmang hne, a pyalyipa hne duv aa chiypa saahruo zaw awna hmang tana aa li.

Tahematapakieca mingphang bangkhuo ta, aparuvsuena a mingsuv kha pariy yi te, alyi siepahruo tie ta ama hneta aparuvsuena kha ama tue. Alyi lie sung a palituv tie ca, a saapa lunghruo tlung hring cahrana kha ta a pa hnyirung sa yi,” a ta.
Cakhutaata vuoruo taata ueryi hrangpa kha thyi angte, “I cawsaa zaw, a suena chunglie nama aw ra li riypa hne, a angpa puvtlung pasana kha namaa hraw ra li riypata, ama'a taa khata kya pya tie ung,
tahematapakieca a suena ca avuo dena te ta a pung te, Khazing ta a pha lina kha maw vyi.

Ama ta aca za tuepa haa yi khata ama kha tue ung la, a tuepa kha le hning ta thung tie ung, ama ta niema cuota a za pya ciepa panuo lie kha, ama cuota le hning a cahra pata pya ung la padang sa tie ung.

Rungnaana hne lunghruo tlung hring ama hne ama a zaa pina zaa khata, riethyivuosuona hne ngiechina kha pi tie ung. Tahematapakieca a palung chunglieta, ‘Siepahruonung adaahmang taa tana ruo i uv; nunghlyi ta cuo va ang, ngiechina ca a taw buo'a va ang,’ a ta.

Caacuonakawta ning kha chunglieta a cunglie puvtlung pasana a tlung aa, pasachiepa hne angiy-aphiena hne cakuona kha a taw'a te, ama ca myi ta ruepa a cuo aa; tahematapakieca a bie a ripatuv ca Abyipa Khazing a lesyipa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Ama hneta aparuvsuena tue yi te lunghruo tlungsa pata zaa hringpa alyi siepahruo tie ca ama ruenapa myikhuv ama hmung tiyta pahya li pata ama caa aa.

A te-angna kha ama ciy nakawta luohlaa taa khata, “Bawchie ciemuopa de, bawchie ciemuopa de, khypuv lesyipa, Babilon, a cahrapa khypuv! Na cuota bieripana ca siymaluo pakha chungta liena a vya tlung de,” ama ta aa.
Cakhutaata chuelyi cung sung a palipa tie ta a muochie sa yi te ama caa, tahematapakieca ama chechiy kha ahungtahmuo calyi va tli yi.

Siy, ngu, alung muosungpa, palelungvaa, palaa ta taapa cawthang phapa, a ciycaapa caw, puv ta taapa caw, a rang pa-uepa thing phangting, ale nue ta tuepa chechiy phangting, thing muosungpa ta tuepa chechiy phangting, daa, thaa, alung ruopa ta tuepa chechiy phangting,

thinghaw pa-uepa, tiyhuo ca-ienapa bangkhuo, maasalaa, mura ziyhmyi, frankinsens ziyhmyi, mingsuv, olif chiytiy, jungsacuo viedie, jungsacuochuo, cue, tuv, aruo hne aruole, sii hne cawsaa hringna zaw kha ahungtahmuo calyi va tli yi.
“Na hringna ta a vuopa thyipaa bangkhuo ca, nama'a taata khungle diy tli, tluesiyliy khata na awna hne na lesyina zaw ama vie diy tli, hmung pakhaa khupa ta cuo'a va tli!” ama ta.
Hingpa hmang hne chechiy ta sung a palipa, ama'a taata a hnyirungpa tie ca a te-angna kha ama ciy nakawta luohlaa taa khata a daa yi te, ngiechina hneta ama caa aa.
“Bawchie ciemuopa de, bawchie ciemuopa de! khypuv lesyipa, a ciycaapa hne a sedungpa cawthang phapa kha a tue cate, siy, alung muosungpa hne palelungvaa ta naa zaa pangi!

Capa hnyirungna ca siymaluo pakha chungliena ama vie diy thluo!” ama ta aa. Tiypalaw mawtuv byi bangkhuo, palaw a ziypa tie, palaw lie re a hriepa tie hne riyliy cunglie sung a palipa tie bangkhuo zaw ta
ama a kuonapa myikhuv kha ama hmung tiyta luohlaa taa khata a daa yi te, “Khaapa khypuv ma hingpa khypuv haa hingta zaa lesyi buo?” ama ta.

Cakhutaa cata ama luv lie alyidiypa a phuv yi te, “Bawchie ciemuopa de, bawchie ciemuopa de, khypuv lesyipa, riyliy lie tiypalaw a hnyipa tie bangkhuo kha a hnyirungna ta a palesyi sa nung! Ama ca siymaluo pakha chunglie tana para pata a cuo.

Vya vuoruo, hingpa cawsaanung kawlie hingta na palung tluo se, niema mingpathepa tie hne lucuotuv tie hne profet tie zaw nama palung tluo se! Tahematapakieca Khazing ca niema cuo tana ama a du pata bieripana a tue tli,” ta pata ama khi.

Cakhutaata a cahrasapa avuoming pakha ta sacuo rienapa lungtung haapa alung suokha kha riyliy luo thaw te, “A lepa Babilon khypuv ca, hing haapa tuechiena hne hingta na riyliy luo kha thaw tapa a cuo aa, khatiy tahmuo hmung pakhaapa cuo'a va tli;

cakhutaata tingtuo tung pata hlaa a sapa tie ueryi hne, ramang a tungpa tie hne hmyakaa a tungpa tie ama tungpa ue kha nama'a lie thyi pata cuo'a va tli; Tuokhaapa kuvzung a thepa pakha kha hmuo, nama'a lie hmung pata cuo'a va tli. Sacuo rienapa alung pu zaw kha khatiy tahmuo nama'a lie thyipa cuo'a va tli.

Cakhutaa cata myi-ing khena kha, nama'a lie hmungpa cuo li tli'a pata, nungchiytuv satlie hne vaahnyituv lesaa ueryi zaw kha thyi pata cuo'a va tli. Tahematapakieca na sungpalituv tie ca alyi lie a lesyipa tie ta cuo yi te, mingphang bangkhuo ca na pacuo thena ta na dung diy tli yi.
Na chunglie kha profet tie hne mingpathepa tie hne alyi lie za thiepa bangkhuo tie ama thiy kha hmung pata a cuo tli,” a ta.
Cakhutaata vuoruo lieta cawsaa hluvpuv ueryi haapa kha thyi angte, “Hallelujah! Khuona hne rungnaana hne cahrana ca Khazing huopa tana a cuo,
tahematapakieca a bieripana ca a hmuo te aa dang. Aparuvsuena ta alyi a para nung, a lesyinung siyhrawnung kha bie a ripa tli. A sii zaw thiyse kawlie ama kha phuv a la hriy mangtli,” ama ta.
Luo kha khi pakhaa yi te, “Hallelujah! Ama a kuonapa myikhuv ca chuozaa ta chuozaa te a khuvthaw pari,” ama ta.
Cakhutaata uvthyi pakiy papaliy hne a hringpa saruopa papaliy ca byithude lieta a tupa Khazing kha abie yi te, “Amen. Hallelujah!” ama ta.
Byithude taata ueryi suokha ta, “Niema a sii zaw bangkhuo hne, ama a ciypa a le a caw ta, Khazing ca pathuosa tie ung,” ama ta.
Cakhutaa cata cawsaa hluvpuv ueryi hneta aa lupa ueryi, tiysue lesapa ryi hne khalung pu haapa ueryi suokha kha i thyi. “Hallelujah! Lesyice Abyipa ma Khazing ca siepahruo a cuo nakawta,
a nuo ung sala a law ung siy, a rungnaana kha pathuosa ung siy, tahematapakieca Tuvtaata nungchiyna cuo a vya tlung tli. Vaahnyituv lesaa ca a ting pacie pata aw te,
Cawthang phapa, a khepa hne a pathesapa kha, a tue riypata ama pi,” a ta. Tahematapakieca cawthang phapa ca mingpathepa tie hmang pha tuenapa tana a cuo, a ta.

Cakhutaata avuoming pakha ta, “Hingpa hing cape tie: Tuvtaata nungchiyna pyi saduona luo kupa ca thluechiypa tana a cuo,” ina ta. Cakhutaa cata, “Hingpa bie hing Khazing biehmisipa tana a cuo,” ina ta.

Ca tiyta ama kha abie riypata a phyi thabaw lie i bu, cuorasala ama ta, “A bu khah! Kama zaw nama hne na viesaa zaw haa khata Zingsuv kaw tehte a khuotuv changtaapa pakha tana i cuo. Khazing kha abie hriy tie! Tahematapakieca Zingsuv ta a phupa biehmisipa hingna profet tie kha profetbiephu a pari sapa cahrana ta a cuo,” a ta.
Cakhutaata vuoruo aa pahawpa kha hmung angte aruo ruopa sakha aa luo. A khangtuvpa ca Zangtluo-atla hne Biehmisipa ama ta. Adangna hneta bieripana tue te rie aa du.
A ming ca myihlaa haata cuo te a luv cunglieta byilakhuv a hluvsa aa khuv. Cape ciepa ming suokha hnyi te ama ta li pata ahungtahmuo pachang va yi.
Ama ca thiy lie nawpa caw kha a tue te, a ming ca Khazing Bie ama ta.
A khesapa hne a pathepa cawthang phapa a hryipa vuoruo rieka tie ta aruo a khang yi te ama ziyle.

A pakaa taata zueziy cahresapa kya pya te capa zueziy ca ta mingphang zaw kha a te yi. Iema kha thaa khuecahryi ta uv'a yi te, Lesyice Khazing hihaana mingsuv a ciynapa khue lieta mingsuv kha aa ciy aa.
A pang cunglie hne a baw lie kha a ming cape yi te, “Siepahruo tie Siepahruo hne byi tie Byi,” ta pata a cuo.

Cakhutaata avuoming pakha ning cunglie aa daapa kha i hmung. Avuo khingkhuo lie a zulepa pavaa tie kha a ueryi paringsapa ta ku yi te, “A vaw ung la Khazing sa duona rungnaapa luo kha a vya hmya tie ung.
Siepahruo tie saa, riebyi tie saa, a lesyipa tie saa, aruo saa hne a khangtuv tie saa, hyazangpa tie hne sii tie saa, a cawpa hne a lepa tie saa ce riypa khata a vya hmya tie ung,” a ta.
Cakhutaa cata saahruo hne alyi siepahruo tie kha ama rieka hneta a hmya yi te aruo a khangpa hne a rieka tie kha rie amaa du.

Saahruo ca a hmiekunglie kharuehaa hmang a tue tawpa profet pakhipa hne khata ama patuv. Capa kharuehaa hmang a tuepa ca ta saahruo a hnangnapa a hmungpa tie hne a kuvtuezuv abiepa tie kha a dung yi. Iema pahning tie ca ama hringpa ta ke myiliy chung luo kha ama thaw.
Aa ngaapa tie ca aruo a khangpa paa pakaa taata a pyapa zueziy ta thie diy yi te, ama saa ca pavaa bangkhuo ta ning khu thiy ta ama ning.
Cakhutaata a kuv lieta dena a hnyi lipa khue tawh hne thaabuoliriy a lesapa a cyi nguoluopa avuoming pakha vuoruo taata a za cungpa kha i hmung.
Ama ta hluoning pariy ta a cuopa riyhre, Khachie hne Setaa ta a cuopa kha patuv te kung thawkha a hre.
Cawsaa zaw a dung li tlina riypa yi ta kung thawkha a chuona te cakhiy te, khue chung luo kha pathla te khaakhung te caa a khe. Cakhutaa cata cuo pachangta chung pathliepa a cuo aa.

Cakhutaata byithude zaw kha hmung angte, a cunglie a tupa tie ca bie ripa khuna naw kha ama pi. Zingsuv kaw tehte ama khuo nakaw hne Khazing bie kawlieta ama luv ama tepa tie thlaapa zaw kha i hmung. Iema ca saahruo hne a kuvtuezuv kha abie lipa yi ta saahruo a hnangnapa zaw kha ama puo lie hne ama kuv lieta hnyi va yi. Iema ca kya hring yi te Khrih hneta kung thawkha chung ama uv aa.
(Aa ngaa kaliepa a thiypa tie ca kung thawkha a chuona te ta kya hring va yi). Capa ca a yikhanapa thupakhaana ta a cuo.

Yi kha thupakhaana lieta a aw rapa tie ca thluechiypa hne a pathepa tana ama cuo. Hingpa tie cunglie hing yi hning thiyna ta naw hnyi vyi, cuorasala iema ca Khazing hne Khrih tluobyi ta cuo'a yi te ama hneta kung thawkha ama uv aa.
Kung thawkha a chuo taata Setaa ca a thawtlana taata pathlie pata cuo'a te,
alyi kiy paliy lieta a awpa Gog hne Magog tapa mingphang zaw kha dung riypata aa thu aa. Iema ca rie tuv riypata pahmya yi te riyliy kielie viehnang zaa ama ta.
Iema ca alyi khy ting hne hmangting khata cahraw yi te, mingpathepa tie awnapa hne Khazing duepa khypuv kha ama cadung. Cuorasala avuo taata myi za tla te a kuo diy yi.
Cakhutaa cata iema a dungpa yi khachie kha saahruo hne profet pakhipa zaw awnapa ke myiliy luo ama thaw. Iema ca capa hmang lie ca chungzuo ta chuozaa hrisaa pata ama cuo aa.
Cakhutaata a lesyipa byithude ruopa hne a cunglie a tupa pakha kha i hmung. Alyi hne avuo ca a hmiekung taata a ruo yi te awna hmang hmung va yi.

Cakhutaa cata a thiypa a le a caw ta byithude hmielie amaa daapa hne caa-uv zaw ama pakepa kha i hmung. Hringna caa-uv ama tapa caa-uv hrangpa suokha zaw kha ama pake. Caa-uv chunglie aa capepa haata, a thiypa tie ca iema ama tuena haa khata bie ama ripa.
Riyliy ta a chunglie a awpa a thiypa kha kya papya te, Thiyna hne Athiykhy zaw ta iema'a lie a awpa a thiypa tie kha kya papya yi te, iema bangkhuo ca ama tuena haa khata bie ripa pata ama cuo.
Cakhutaa cata Thiyna hne Athiykhy ca myiliy luo kha ama thaw. Hingpa myiliy hing yi hning thiyna ta a cuo.
Hringna caa-uv lie a ming cape lipa mekaa ca myiliy chung luo ca ama thaw.
Cakhutaata vuoruo thaapa hne alyi thaapa kha i hmung, tahematapakieca vuoruo taapa hne alyi taapa ca vie yi te riyliy ca aw va tli.
Cakhutaa cata khypuv pathepa, Jerusalem thaapa kha vuoruo lie Khazing'a taata a za cungpa kha i hmung, vaahnyituv lesaa a navaapa cuota aa pangipa haata aa pangi.

Byithude taata ueryi paringsapa suokha i thyipa ca, “Mang tie ung, Khazing ing ca cawsaa hrawlie na a aw. Iema'a lie kha khysa'a te, ama Khazing ta a cuo aa; iema ca a cawsaa ta cuo'a yi te, Khazing ama hrahring kha iema'a lie a aw aa;
ama mingthliy kha hruvpa'a yi te, thiyna aw'a va tli. Ngiechina hne caana hne riethyivuosuona zaw aw'a va tli, zaa aw taapa hmang ca ama vie diy tli,” a ta.

Cakhutaata byithude cunglie a tupa paa ta, “Mang tie, hmang bangkhuo a thaapa ta i tue diy hing,” ina ta. “Hingpa hing cape tie, tahematapakieca hingpa bie hing zang tluo aa tlapa hne biehmisipa tana a cuo,” ina ta vie.
Cakhutaa cata, “Re a tlung mangtli! Kama ca Alfa hne Omega, a hruothuna hne a chuona tana i cuo. A tiy a hriepa tie kha hringna tiyhnaa taata tiy kha a muo li pata i pi'a yi, ina ta.
Tena a hmungpa tie ca hingpa hmang zaw hing ru ta cu'a yi te, kama ca ama Khazing ta cuo'a angte iema ca i saata zaw ta ama cuo aa.

Cuorasala a riechiepa, a zang lipa, a pyalyipa, lie a nawpa tie, aparuvsuena a tuepa tie, ca-ie a thepa tie, kuvtuezuv abiepa tie, hne a hanghiepa tie bangkhuo awna hmang ca ke myiliy, yi hning thiyna kha tana a cuo,” a ta.

Cakhutaata avuoming pasariy chungtaata pakha ta a cuopa, a hnangcaw cepa, puvtlung pasana suosariy hneta a bipa kuotung suosariy a hnyipa kha a vaw te, “A vaw tie, vaahnyituv lesaa, Tuvtaata napuv khana ica pahmung aa,” ina ta.
Thlaapa ta bi angte, avuoming ca ta a lesapa hne aa suosapa tluocung luo kha inaa chiy. Capa lie ca vuoruo Khazing'a taata khypuv pathepa Jerusalem a za cungpa kha ina pahmung.
Capa khypuv ca Khazing rungnaana ta bi te, jasper alung muosungpa haata khe te, thlaluo lung haata a pasing.

A lesapa hne aa suosapa khypuv ca cadungna piehu hnyi te thlake suohraa hlyihning a hnyi. Thlake zaw lie ca avuoming pahraa hlyihning ama aw. Thlake zaw cunglie ca Israel ming phang hraa hlyihning ming kha a cape te,
capa thlake zaw ca ningchiyluo kuo ta suothung, chaluo kuo ta suothung, sungluo kuo ta suothung hne ningtlaluo kuo ta suothung ta ama aw.
Khypuv cadungna lungrue tlepie ca inghruo suohraa hlyihning hnyi te capa zaw cunglie ca Tuvtaata lucuotuv pahraa hlyihning ming kha aa cape.
Kama bie naa rihnepa avuoming ca khypuv hne a thlake zaw hne a lungrue tlepie kha taa riypata taanapa siy khuecahryi kha a hnyi.
Khypuv ca a tung hne a phyi aa khing diy. Avuoming ca ta a khuecahryi ta khypuv ca a taa tiyta, a tung, a phyi hne aa suonapa ca a khing diy yi te, me thawkha zapangaa kaluo ta a cuo.
A piehu zaw kha a taa ca avuoming ta ama hmuopa cawsaa taana ta daw zakha sawliy suopaliy aa suo.
A lungrue tlepie ca jasper lungvaa ta sa yi te, khypuv ca thlaluo haata a pasingpa siy pathepa ta ama sa.

Khypuv cadungna lungrue tlepie inghruo ca alung muosungpa a phangphang ta ama pangi. A thabaw ce lieta jasper lungvaa, a paziypa ta safaiar lungvaa, a suothungna lieta agate lungvaa, a suopaliyna ta emerald lungvaa,

a suopangaana ta oniks lungvaa, a suocaruvna ta karnelian lungvaa, a suosariyna ta khrisolait lungvaa, a suocarina ta beril lungvaa, a suocakyna ta topaz lungvaa, a suohraana ta khrisoparase lungvaa, a hlyikhana ta jacinth lungvaa hne a hlyihningna ta amethist lungvaa ta a cuo.

Khypuv thlake suohraahlyihning ca pale lungvaa hlyihning ta tuepa cuo te, thlake suokha cyicuo ca pale lungvaa suokha kaluo ta a cuo. Khypuv luopuv lepa ca siy pathepa ta tuepa cuo te thlaluo haata a pasing.
Khypuv chunglie ca biena-ing hmung va ang, tahematapakieca biena-ing ca Lesyice Abyipa Khazing hne Tuvtaata kha tana a cuo.
Khypuv ca a khe riypa ning hne thlaapa zaw a hu vyi, tahematapakieca Khazing rungnaana kha a khena ta cuo te, a myi-ing ca Tuvtaata kha tana a cuo.
Mingphang bangkhuo ca a khena thue cata cakuona luopuv hmung'a yi te, chuelyi siepahruo tie zaw ta capa khypuv chung luo ca ama rungnaana kha ama'a vya ngiekhyi aa.
Khypuv thlake ca ning-aw ta aa pahaw aa, tahematapakieca capa lie ca zuo tapa aw'a vyi.
Cawsaa ta mingphang zaw rungnaana hne lesyina kha capa khypuv luo ca ama'a vya ngiekhyi aa.

Cuorasala a pathe lipa khaapa hmuo capa khypuv luo ca a ngie khu'a vyi. Duvsamakhie aa chiypa hmang a tuepa tie hne a hanghiepa tie zaw a ngie khu'a va yi. Tuvtaata hringna caa-uv lie ming capepa tie dyina a ngie khu'a yi.
Cakhutaata avuoming ta thlaluo haata a pasingpa hringna cavaa tiy kha ina pahmung, capa cavaa ca Khazing hne Tuvtaata byithude taata za lang te,

khypuv liekhingkhuo lieta luopuv lie kha tathlyalya ta a lang. Cavaa kie kuo vyicuo lie ca a thyi phang hraa hlyihning kha thla kha phang kha ta thla ting ta a pathyipa hringna thingkung aw te, a hnaa ca mingphang zawdya cuota tluona ta a cuo.
Chiesapa hmang suokha hmuo capa hmang lie ca aw'a vyi. Cuorasala capa khypuv lie ca Khazing hne Tuvtaata byithude dyi aw'a te, a changtaapa zaw ta ama kha amaa bie aa.
A hmie kha hmung'a yi te, ama puo lie kha a ming cape pata ama cuo aa.
Capa lie ca zuo aw li tli'a pata, myi-ing khena hne ning khena zaw a hu'a va tli, tahematapakieca Abyipa Khazing ca ama khena ta cuo'a te, iema ca chuozaa taata chuozaa te byi ama cuo aa.

Cakhutaata avuoming ca ta, “Hingpa bie zaw hing zang tluo aa tlapa hne biehmisipa ta ama cuo, tahematapakieca profet tie ama thlaapa zaw Khazing ta a cuopa Abyipa ta a vya cuo paluo riypa hmang kha pahmung sa riypata aa vuoming kha a pathlie yi,” ina ta.
“Mang tie, i vaw paluo aa! Hingpa caa-uv profetbiephu hing a ziypa ca thluechiypa tana a cuo,” a ta.
Hingpa hmang a thyituv hne a hmungtuv hing kama Johan tana i cuo. Hingpa hmang thyi angte i hmung tiyta naa pahmung satuv avuoming kha abie riypata a phyi thabaw lie i bu ca,
ama ta, “Naa bie khah! Kama zaw hing nama hne na viesaa profet tie hne hingpa caa-uv chunglie aa capepa bie a ziypa tie haa khata changtaapa tana i cuo ra, Khazing kha abie hriy tie,” ina ta.
Cakhutaata ama ta, “Hingpa caa-uv chunglie aa capepa profetbiephu hing caa khe khah, tahematapakieca cuo na a ngie tli.
Hmang pha lipa a tuepa ca tue thluo sala, duv aa chiypa ca duv aa chiy pata hring thluo se. Cawsaa phapa ca a phapa kha tue pazue sala a pathepa ca a pathe pata hring pazue se,” ina ta.
“Mang tie, i vaw patang aa; cawsaa mekaa kha ama hriepa cyicuo haata pi riypata lawmuo kha i vya cyi.
Kama ca Alfa hne Omega, a hmietaa cepa hne a hnangcaw cepa, a hruothuna hne a chuona tana i cuo,” a ta.
Ama pang kha a pasuvpa tie ca thluechiypa tana ama cuo, hringna thingkung taata thingthyi ningna naw hne thlake taata khypuv chung luo a ngie khuna naw kha ama hnyi aa.
Khypuv khungthing lie a awpa tie ca uv tie hne ca-ie a thepa tie hne aparuvsuena a tuepa tie hne lie a nawpa tie hne kuvtuezuv abiepa tie, hne hanghiepa kha tlechuo te a tuepa mekaa kha tana ama cuo.
“Khrihsaabuv cuota tehtekhuona hne niema'a luo aa vuoming zaa pathliepa ca Kama, Zingsuv tana i cuo. Kama ca a hruopuv hne David samingsahlaa cuo angte dyivaa aasiy khepa tana i cuo,” a ta.
Thlaapa hne vaahnyituv lesaa ta, “A vaw tie,” ama ta. A thyipa mekaa zaw ta, “A vaw tie,” ta yi se. Tiy a hriepa mekaa a vaw yi se. Hringna tiy a la khingpa mekaa ta a muo li pata a la yi se.

Hingpa caa-uv lie profetbiephu a thyipa mekaa hing a raaringna ica pi yi: hingpa bie lie hing ahungtahmuo bie hrangpa a chachiy kieca Khazing ta capa cawsaa ca hingpa caa-uv chunglie capepa puvtlung pasana kha a chachiy aa.

Ahung a cuo zaw hingpa caa-uv chunglie a awpa profetbiephu a thawpa ca Khazing ta hingpa caa-uv chunglie a capepa hringna thingkung taata a cu riypa hne khypuv pathepa chunglie a cu riypa kha a thawpa aa.
Hingpa bie bangkhuo tehte a khuotuv ta, “I vaw patang hrahring aa,” a ta. Amen. Abyipa Zingsuv, A vaw paatie!
Abyipa Zingsuv Khrih vihnyina ca mingpathepa tie bangkhuo'a lie aw mang sue. Amen.
